English: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
Masaai: Ore apa te nkiterunoto, neitaa Enkai keper o enkop.

English: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
Masaai: Ore apa enkop nemeeta shoto, nemetii toki naa enaimin natii oriong o enguton, ore Enkiyang'et e Nkai nelo tioriong inkariak.

English: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai; inchoo metijing'a ewang'an, nejing ewang'an.

English: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai ajo ai sidai ewang'an. Nerishu Enkai ewang'an aitung'uaa enaimin.

English: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.
Masaai: Neipot Enkai ewang'an ajo endama, neipot enaimin ajo enkewarie. Neaku eetae enteipa o entadekenya enkolong e dukuya.

English: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo metaa ketii o loing'ang'e erishata oo nkariak, naa inchoo metirisha inkariak o nkariak.”

English: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
Masaai: Neitayu Enkai oloing'ang'e nerish inkariak natii abori oloing'ang'e o nkariak naatii shumata oloing'ang'e, neaku nejia.

English: And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.
Masaai: Neipot Enkai oloing'ang'e ajo Keper. Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e are.

English: And God said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo inkariak natii abori e keper eiturrurrokino pooki nebo, naa inchoo enkop natoyio eibalayu.” Neaku neija.

English: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Neipot Enkai enkop natoiyio ajo Enkop, ore inkariak naaiturrurro tenebo neipot ajo inaaiposha. Nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

English: And God said, Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb yielding seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after his kind, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth: and it was so.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Inchoo enkop metoiu inkaitubulu, inkaitubulu naaiu ilanterera, o lkeek loo lng'anayio ooiu ilanterera too mpukunot enye te enkop.” Neaku neija.

English: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Neiu enkop inkaitubulu enyena, o nkaitubulu naaiu ilanterera te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o lkeek ooiu ilng'anayio too lanterera lenye anaa empukunoto enye. Nedol Enkai ajo ai sidai.

English: And the evening and the morning were the third day.
Masaai: Metaa eetae enteipa neetae entadekenya enkolong e uni.

English: And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:
Masaai: Nejo Enkai “inchoo metaa keetae iwang'aritin to loing'ang'e le keper peyie erishu endama te nkewarie, neaku sii ilooitodolu ilmonek too nkatitin oo nkolong'i o larin.

English: And let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.
Masaai: Inchoo sii metaa ketii iwang'aritin oloing'ang'e le keper peyie eisho ewang'an enkop.” Neaku neija.

English: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.
Masaai: Neitayu Enkai iwang'aritin are sapuki, ore ina wang'an sapuk neitore endama, ore ewang'an kiti neitore enkewarie. Neitayu sii ilakir.

English: And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth,
Masaai: Nepik ninche oloing'ang'e le keper peyie eisho ewang'an enkop neitore endama o enkewarie.

English: And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Nerishu sii ewang'an tiatua enaimin, nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

English: And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
Masaai: Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e ong'uan.

English: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “Inchoo metijing'a nkariak ntokitin naaishu, inchoo sii imotonyi meshomo to loing'ang'e le keper aaingat enkop.”

English: And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Metaa eitaa Enkai ing'uesi sapuki oo naaiposha o ntokitin naaishu pooki, o naaiserpepiari naatii atua enaiposha too mpukunot enye, o pooki motonyi terisioroto oo mpukunot enye, nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

English: And God blessed them, saying, Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let fowl multiply in the earth.
Masaai: Nemayian Enkai ninche ejo, “Entoisho niponariri aaiput inkariak oo naaiposha, naa nchoo sii imotonyi o loing'ang'e metubula te enkop.”

English: And the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
Masaai: Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e imiet.

English: And God said, Let the earth bring forth the living creature after his kind, cattle, and creeping thing, and beast of the earth after his kind: and it was so.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “Inchoo enkop meyau ing'uesi naaishu te risioroto oo mpukunot enye; inkishu o ng'uesi naaiserpepiari te nkop o ng'uesi e nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye.” Neaku neija.

English: And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
Masaai: Neitayu Enkai ing'uesi e nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye o nkishu te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop te risioroto empukunoto enye. Nedol Enkai ajo aisidai.

English: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai; “Emaitobira tung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto ang onyaanyukie iyiook, nikincho ninche meitoria isinkir le naiposha, o motonyi oloing'ang'e, o nkishu, o enkop pooki o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop.”

English: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them.
Masaai: Metaa eitayio Enkai oltung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan. Te nkitanyaanyukoto Enkai eitayio ninye ninche, olee o eng'oruoi.

English: And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.
Masaai: Nemayian Enkai ninche, nejoki “Entoisho entoponari emputa enkop nintorere. Entoria sii isinkir le naiposha o motony o loing'ang'e, o pooki toki ake ninye naishu naiseuseu te nkop.”

English: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Ng'ura, aaishoo iyie pooki aitubului naiu ilanterera natii oriong enkop, o pooki shani oota ilanterera too ilng'anayio lenyena intaa endaa.

English: And to every beast of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to every thing that creepeth upon the earth, wherein there is life, I have given every green herb for meat: and it was so.
Masaai: O pooki ng'ues e nkop, o pooki motonyi o loing'ang'e, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, o pooki toki naata enkiyang'et e nkishui aaishoo enkaitubului pooki nanyori peyie intaa endaa.” Neaku neija.

English: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai pooki toki naitobirua ajo aisidai katukul. Neaku teipa neaku tadekenya enkolong e ile.

English: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
Masaai: Metaa eidipaki keper o enkop o lorora pooki lenye.

English: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naapishana eidipa Enkai ina siaai enye nataasa neeng'iyeng'a te nkolong e naapishana te siaai enye pooki nataasa.

English: And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
Masaai: Metaa etamayiana Enkai enkolong e naapishana neitisiny, amu teina olong apa eeng'iyeng'e Enkai te siaai enye pooki nataasa enkitobirare.

English: These are the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,
Masaai: Kuna ninche iishoritin e keper o enkop ina kata pee eitobiri. Ore te nkolong apa naitobirua Olaitoriani Enkai enkop o keper,

English: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
Masaai: eton meetae hoo ilkeek te nkop anaa nkaitubulu naabulu tiong'ota eton eitu eisho Olaitoriani enkop menoto enchan, nemeetae sii apa oltung'ani otur enkop.

English: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
Masaai: Kake enkinuku ake nadumunye te nkop aitashal oriong e nkop, pooki.

English: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani Enkai aitobiru oltung'ani te nterit enkop. Nekutaki inkumeishin enyena entooma e nkishui, neaku oltung'ani oloota enkishui.

English: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
Masaai: Neun Olaitoriani Enkai enkurma, te Eden te nkalo oloosaen. Nepik ilo tung'ani oitobira atua.

English: And out of the ground made the LORD God to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
Masaai: Neitubulu te nkop Olaitoriani Enkai ilkeek pooki oitiship inkonyek naa sidain sii te ndaa. Euno sii apa olchani le nkishui te mpolos enkurma. Netii sii olchani le eng'eno, oo supati, o ntorrok.

English: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.
Masaai: Eturuke sii olkeju oing'uaa Eden opik enkurma enkare. Neoro ilo keju teine aaku ilkejek oong'uan.

English: The name of the first is Pison: that is it which compasseth the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;
Masaai: Ore enkarna olkeju le dukuya naa keji Pishon, naa ninye ilo oruko aman enkop pooki e Hafila, ine netii sahabu.

English: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
Masaai: Naa ore saabu eina kop aisidai. Etii isoito oimerlel te sidano.

English: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
Masaai: Ore olkeju li are naa Gihon; naa ninye oshi oman enkop pooki e Kush.

English: And the name of the third river is Hiddekel: that is it which goeth toward the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
Masaai: Ore olkeju li okuni naa Tigris, nerukokino enkalo oloosaen te Asiria. Ore olkeju liong'uan naa Frati.

English: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
Masaai: Neya Olaitoriani Enkai ilo tung'ani apik ninye enkurma e Eden peyie etur neramat sii.

English: And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:
Masaai: Neitanap Olaitoriani Enkai oltung'ani ajoki, “Ore pooki shani otii atua enkurma indim ainosa,

English: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.
Masaai: kake ore olchani le ng'eno oo supati o ntorrok minya ake, amu ore kenya enkolong ninya, meeta inchere pee miye.”

English: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Meishiaakino neton olee aa ninye ake, ekaitaiki enkaretoni naishaakino ninye.”

English: And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
Masaai: Metaa neitayu Olaitoriani Enkai pooki ng'ues e ong'ota o motonyi pooki oloing'ang'e neyau ninche enetii oltung'ani, pee edol eneiko teneisho ninche nkarn; naa ore enkarna ake ninye naba anaa enaishoo pooki toki neaku ina.

English: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.
Masaai: Neisho ilo tung'ani inkarn inkishu pooki, o nena motonyi oloing'ange o pooki ng'ues e ong'ata; kake ore ilo tung'ani eitu etumi enkaretoni naishaakino ninye.

English: And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;
Masaai: Metaa etipika Olaitoriani Enkai injo naairoshi ilo tung'ani meirurayu. Ore eirura, neitayu olarasi obo lenye nenuk ine wueji too nkiri.

English: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
Masaai: Ore ilo arasi oitayio Olaitoriani Enkai te ilo tung'ani neitaa enkitok, nerikoki ninye ilo tung'ani.

English: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
Masaai: Nejo ilo tung'ani, “Esipa ele taata oloito loo loik laainei, naa eoroti osesen lai. Ekeipoti ninye aajo enkitok amu eitayioki ninye tiatua olee.”

English: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.
Masaai: metaa eorore olee menye o ng'otonye, neibung'are enkitok enye neaku pokira are osesen obo.

English: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
Masaai: Ore apa ilo tungani o enkitok enye meeta apa entoki naishopito nemedol enkurruna.

English: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
Masaai: Ore apa olasurai naa aing'en oleng alang ing'uesi pooki naaitobira Olaitoriani Enkai. Neikilikuan ninye enkitok ajoki, “Eji ketejo doi Enkai, ‘Eminya pooki ng'anayio lo lchani otii ena kurma?’ ”

English: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok olasurai, “Aikiindim iyiook aainosa ilng'anayio pooki loo lkeek le nkurma,

English: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
Masaai: kake etejo Enkai, ‘Eminya ilo ng'anayioi leilo shani otii empolos enkurma, nimishoroo hoo ninye arashu iyeye.’ ”

English: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
Masaai: Kake etiaka olasurai enkitok, “Miyeye ntae;

English: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
Masaai: amu eyiolo Enkai ajo ore tininosinoso ninye nebolo inkonyek inyi, nitiuu anaa Enkai, niyiolouu isupati o ntorrok.”

English: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol enkitok ilo shani ajo sidai te ndaa, naa olchani sii oitiship inkonyek, naa olchani sii onguarrayu oiteng'en oltung'ani neitayu olng'anayioi lenyena neinos; neisho sii olpayian lenye embata, neinos ninye.

English: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
Masaai: Ore inkonyek e pokira nebolo, neyiolou ina kata aajo meishopo. Nerip mbenek olng'aboli aitaa nkilani.

English: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
Masaai: Nening ninche oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai elo te nkurma eiropija enkolong. Ore olpayian o enkitok enye neisudori peyie medol Enkai tiatua ilkeek le nkurma.

English: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
Masaai: Kake eipoto Olaitoriani Enkai ilo tungani nejoki ninye: “Kaji itii iyie?”

English: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
Masaai: Neng'amaa ajoki, “Atoning'o oltoilo lino te nkurma, naureishoyu amu atoduaa ajo maishopo naipirri aisudori.”

English: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai, “Aing'ae likitiaaka minchopo? Inosa o lng'anayioi lo lchani laitanapa apa intae ajoki eminya?”

English: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
Masaai: Nejo ilo tung'ani, “Ore ina kitok apa nikinchoo metaa tenebo nanu, ninye naaishoo olng'anayioi lo lchani, mainosa.”

English: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
Masaai: Ina pee ejoki Olaitoriani Enkai enkitok, “Kaa bae ena nitaasa?” Nejo enkitok, “Olasurai laateleja nanya.”

English: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Enkai olasurai, “Ore amu itaasa ena, kitediaaki iyie aaitulus too nkishu pooki o ng'uesi pooki entim, keaku iserpepiari te nkop, naa enterit ninye endaa ino, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino.

English: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
Masaai: Ekapik olomang'ati erishata ino o enkitok. Neijia sii etiu erishata e ishoi ino o eishoi enye. Ekepurd ninye elukunya ino, ore iyie niony entutunyo enye.”

English: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye enkitok, “Kaaponiki nanu emion te ishoi ino, te mion sapuk iiu inkera. Ore iyieunot inono pooki keaku ino lpayian lino, neaku sii ninye likintore iyie.”

English: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Adam, “Ore amu itoning'o oltoilo le nkitok ino, ninosa, ilo ng'anayioi lo lchani laaitanapa ajoki ‘Minya,’ etediaki enkop tenkaraki iyie, ekeaku enenkinyinyiret ake inya te nkishui ino pooki.

English: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
Masaai: Kebulu ilkiku o ntulele te nkurma, neaku inya nena aitubulu oo nkurman.

English: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
Masaai: Te nkinyinyiret inya endaa, ometaba anaa nirrinyokino enterit, amu teine apa kintobiruaki. Ira enterit naa enterit irrinyokino.”

English: And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
Masaai: Neisho ilo tung'ani enkitok enye enkarna ajo Hawa amu ninye ng'otonye oo looishu pooki.

English: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
Masaai: Neitobiraki Olaitoriani Enkai Adam o enkitok enye nkilani oo ndapan, neishopoki ninche.

English: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ng'ura, etotiwuo oltung'ani anaa obo lang etayiolo isidain o ntorrok; ore tena kata, neidim ninye aitorioki enkaina enye olchani le nkishui ainosa, neishu ninye intarasi.”

English: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
Masaai: Metaa eitayio Olaitoriani Enkai ninye te nkurma e Eden peyie epuo aatur enkop apa naitobirunyeki ninche.

English: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
Masaai: Nearaa ninye ilo tung'ani. Ore te nkalo oloo saen e Eden, etipika ninye olmalaika, o lalem oyupuyup oman pooki alo peyie errip enkoitoi olchani le nkishui.

English: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
Masaai: Neyiolou Adam enkitok enye, neiroshiu neiu Kain ejo: “Anoto olee te retoto o Laitoriani.”

English: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
Masaai: Neitoki aiu olalashe lenye Abel. Ore apa Abel naa olairritani loo ntare, ore Kain naa olaturoni le nkop.

English: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie enkata, neyaki Kain Olaitoriani enkishoroto oo lng'anayio lenyena le nkop.

English: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering:
Masaai: Neyau sii ninye Abel ilkikaunot loo ntare enyena naapir. Neng'amaa Olaitoriani Abel tenebo enkishooroto enye.

English: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.
Masaai: Kake eitu eng'amaa Kain tenebo enkishooroto enye. Negoro Kain nesot enkomom oleng.

English: And the LORD said unto Cain, Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Kain, “Ainyoo peyie itagore naa ainyoo peyie isot enkomom?

English: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
Masaai: Amaa tiniaas isupati aimiking'amari? Naa teneitu ias isupati kigira ing'ok aarresh te nkutuk enkaji, naa iyie eyieu neibung kake eishiaakino nimir ninye.”

English: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.
Masaai: Nejoki Kain olalashe lenye Abel, “Maape ong'ata.” Ore peyie ebaiki ong'ata nedumakino Kain olalashe lenye Abel aar metua.

English: And the LORD said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Kain, “Koree olalashe lino Abel?” Nejo, “Mayiolo, ainanu oshi olairritani lo la lashe lai?”

English: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Kaa bae ena nitaasa?” Aagira oltoilo lo sarge lo lalashe lino aishiraki te nkop.

English: And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother's blood from thy hand;
Masaai: Ore taata iyie kitediaaki te nkop, ina natabolo enkutuk enye ang'amaa osarge lo lalashe lino te nkaina ino.

English: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
Masaai: Tinitur enkop, nemeiu ninye ae toki. Iyaku olaisikani olimana te nkop.

English: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
Masaai: Nejoki Kain Olaitoriani, “Aisapuk enkitamioto ai alang enaidimu.

English: Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall slay me.
Masaai: Ng'urai amu kitaarayie nanu ena olong aitung'uaa enkop, nikintalam sii enkomom ino peyie madol, naaku ololo te nkop metaa ore oltung'ani laatum naar nanu matua.”

English: And the LORD said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Aime neijia etiu.” Ore oltung'ani oar Kain metua, neitamei ninye kat naapishana. Nepik Olaitoriani olmishire Kain peyie ore oloinepu ninye nemear metua.

English: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Kain enkomom o Laitoriani, nelo amany enkop e Nod natii oloo saen e Eden.

English: And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city, and called the name of the city, after the name of his son, Enoch.
Masaai: Neyiolou Kain enkitok enye, nenutayu neiu Enok, neshet enkanasa, neipot ina anasa ajo Enok anaa enkarna o layioni lenye.

English: And unto Enoch was born Irad: and Irad begat Mehujael: and Mehujael begat Methusael: and Methusael begat Lamech.
Masaai: Neikini Enok Irad, neiu Irad Mehujael, neiu Mehujael Metushael neiu Metushael Lamek,

English: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
Masaai: Neyam Lamek inkituaak are. Ore enkarna e nabo naa keji Ada, neji enkarna enkae Sila.

English: And Adah bare Jabal: he was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of such as have cattle.
Masaai: Neiu Ada Yabal laa ninye apa menye le lelo ootoni too lng'oborri neramat sii inkishu.

English: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.
Masaai: Neji enkarna o lalashe lenye Yubal, laa ninye menye le lelo oosh ilwululi loo usin o ndulen.

English: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal-cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.
Masaai: Neiu Sila Tubalkain, laa ninye olkunoni oidong'u inkinantani too suyan, o sekenke. Neji enkanashe e Tubalkain Naama.

English: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
Masaai: Nejoki Lamek inkituaak enyena, “Ada o Sila, entoning oltoilo lai; intae nakituaak e Lamek enining'o enajo nanu: Ataara oltung'ani metua laatipika olbae, laa olbarnoti laatoosho nanu.

English: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
Masaai: Tenaa keitalaki elap Kain kat naapishana, nesipa ajo ore Lamek naa katitin ntomoni naapishana kat naapishana.”

English: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
Masaai: Neyiolou Adam enkitok enye aigil, neiu enkayioni neipot enkarna enye ajo Seti, amu etejo, “Aanyaaka Enkai apikaki nanu ae kerai najing ewueji e Abel amu etaara Kain ninye metua.”

English: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitokini aaiki Seti olayioni, neipoti enkarna enye aajo Enosh. Ore ina kata eiterutua iltung'ana aaipot enkarna Olaitoriani.

English: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
Masaai: Ore ena buku naa ene ishoi e Adam. Ore peyie eitayu Enkai oltung'ani, eitayio ninye te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan.

English: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
Masaai: Eitayio ninye olee o eng'oruoi nemayian ninche neipot ninche ajo, tung'ani peyie eitobiru.

English: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Adam ilarin iip nabo o tomoni uni, neaku ninye menye lo layioni laa ninye kewan enyaanyukie, neipot ninye ajo Seti.

English: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Ore inkolong'i e Adam anaa peyie eaku menye le Seti naa ilarin iip isiet. Neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Adam naa ilarin iip naaudo o tomoni uni, neye ninye.

English: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
Masaai: Eishua Seti ilarin iip nabo o imiet, neaku menye le Enosh.

English: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik seti anaa peyie eini Enosh ilarin iip isiet o naapishana, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Seti naa ilarin iip naaudo o tomon aare, neye ninye.

English: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
Masaai: Ore peyie ebik Enosh ilarin intomoni naaudo, neaku menye le Kanan.

English: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Enosh eidipaki aatoiu Kanan ilarin iip isiet o tomon o imiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie,

English: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
Masaai: metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Enosh naa ilarin iip naaudo o imiet, neye ninye.

English: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
Masaai: Ore peyie ebik Kenan ilarin intomoni naapishana, neaku menye le Mahalel,

English: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: nebik Kenan etoiwuoki Mahalel ilarin iip isiet o artam, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
Masaai: Neaku inkolong'i pooki e Kenan ilarin iip naaudo o tomon, neye ninye.

English: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Mahalel ilarin ntomoni ile o imiet, neaku menye le Yared.

English: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Mahalel etoiwuoki Yared ilarin iip isiet o tomoni uni, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Mahalel naa ilarin iip isiet o ntomoni naaudo oimiet, neye ninye.

English: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Yared ilarin iip o ntomoni ile oare, neaku menye Enok.

English: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Yared etoiwuoki Enok ilarin iip isiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Yared naa ilarin iip naaudo o ntomoni ile oare, neye ninye.

English: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Enok ilarin ntomoni ile o imiet, neaku menye le Metusela.

English: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Eiriamariyie Enok Enkai eidipaki aatoiu Metusela ilarin iip uni, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i e Enok naa ilarin iip uni o ntomoni ile o imiet.

English: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
Masaai: Nelo Enok tenebo Enkai, nelai ninye amu ewa Enkai ninye.

English: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Metusela ilarin iip o ntomoni isiet o naapishana, neaku menye le Lamek.

English: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Metusela etoiwuoki Lamek ilarin iip naapishana o ntomoni isiet oare, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Metusela naa ilarin iip naaudo o ntomoni ile o naaudo neye ninye.

English: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Lamek ilarin iip o ntomoni isiet oare, neiu olayioni,

English: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
Masaai: neipot enkarna enye ajo Noa ejo: “Ore tiatua enkop natediaa Olaitoriani, ele ninye oyooki ayaki iyiook enkilejilej too siaaitin ang o too nyamalaritin oo nkaik ang.”

English: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
Masaai: Nebik Lamek etoiwuoki Noa ilarin iip imiet o ntomoni naaudo o imiet, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
Masaai: Metaa ore inkolong'i pooki e Lamek naa iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o naapishana, neye ninye.

English: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Masaai: Ore etaa Noa oloo larin iip imiet, neaku menye le Shem, o Ham, o Shafet.

English: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
Masaai: Ore peyie eiteru iltung'ana aaponari tioriong enkop, netoikioki ninche intoyie,

English: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
Masaai: nedol ilayiok le Nkai intoyie oo ltung'ana ajo aisidain, neyaki ate inkituaak anaa enagelu tenena, anaa enayieu.

English: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani: “Meitoki enkiyanget ai amany tung'ani ntarasi, amu ore ninye naa osesen. Keaku inkolong'i enyena ilarin iip nabo o tikitam.”

English: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
Masaai: Etii sii apa Ilnefilim enkop te nena olong'i, ore peyie epuonu ilayiok le Nkai aajing'aki aayiolou intoyie oo ltung'ana, neiki ninche inkera. Naa kulo apa iltung'ana magil liopa laa aiyiolot oleng.

English: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
Masaai: Nedol Olaitoriani enkarrueisho e tung'ani ajo etaa sapuk te nkop oleng, naa ore emusunoto endamunoto enye pooki e atua oltau naa entorroni ake eponaa.

English: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
Masaai: Neinosu Olaitoriani enkaraki naitobira oltung'ani te nkop, netum osina sapuk.

English: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani: “Kajutu tioriong enkop oltung'ani laitobira, tung'ani tenebo eng'ues, o pooki toki naiserpepiari, o motonyi o loing'ang'e, amu aanyaaka ainosu ajo ainyoo apa peyie aitobirua ninche.”

English: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake enoto Noa omom too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: These are the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with God.
Masaai: Kuna ninche iishoritin e Noa. Ore apa Noa naa oltung'ani oitashe too sipat, nemeeta entioto to lporror lenye: eiriamariyie Noa Enkai.

English: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Masaai: Eeta sii apa Noa ilayiok o kuni, Shem, o Ham o Yafet.

English: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
Masaai: Etarruoyie apa enkop oleng too nkonyek e Enkai, neiputa ninye o larrabal.

English: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai enkop ajo etarruoyie oleng. Amu ore iseseni pooki neitarruoitie inkoitoi enye te nkop.

English: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Noa, “Atumuta to ltau ajo kaiting'ie pooki sesen, amu eiputa enkop o larrabal tenkaraki ninche, ng'ura kaidaikie nanu ninche o enkop.

English: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
Masaai: “Intaiki kewan esafina olchani le Gofer, nipik ilgilat atua esafina, nimur atua o oriong te nkoronko.

English: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
Masaai: Naa inji ayieu ninkunu. Ore enkadori e safina naa intemat e nkaina iip uni, ore elalai naa intemat e nkaina onom, ore enkilepata eiteru te kop naa intemat e nkaina tomoni uni.

English: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it.
Masaai: Ntushura sii esafina, ning'uaa erishata e ntemata nabo e nkaina, pee eyau ewang'an. Nipik sii kutuk aji e matua. Nipik atua iorot oo nkajijik e abori, e empolos, o neshumata.

English: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura kayau olairrag loo nkariak shumata enkop, peyie eishu iseseni pooki oota enkiyang'et enkishui, napuku tiabori keper. Ore pooki toki natii enkop naa keye.

English: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.
Masaai: Kake kaitasheyie olning'o lo sotua lai o iyie, naa aijing iyie e safina, iyie o layiok linono, o enkitok ino, o nkituaak oo layiok linono tenebo iyie.

English: And of every living thing of all flesh, two of every sort shalt thou bring into the ark, to keep them alive with thee; they shall be male and female.
Masaai: O pooki toki naishu e pooki sesen, iyau maare e pooki pukunoto atua e safina. Niramat ninche peyie meye; naa ore pooki naa oloing'oni ake o elipong.

English: Of fowls after their kind, and of cattle after their kind, of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind, two of every sort shall come unto thee, to keep them alive.
Masaai: Enoo motonyi te risioroto oo mpukunot enye enoo ng'uesi te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, enoo naaiserpepiari te risioroto e mpukunoto enye. Ejing maare anaa impukunot enye enitii, peyie iramat meye.

English: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten, and thou shalt gather it to thee; and it shall be for food for thee, and for them.
Masaai: Ore sii, ayieu niya atua e safina indaiki oo mpukunot pooki tushuma. Naa keaku endaa ino o ninche.”

English: Thus did Noah; according to all that God commanded him, so did he.
Masaai: Neas Noa ena; etaasa nena pooki naaitanapa Enkai ninye.

English: And the LORD said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Noa: “Tijing'a iyie o enkaji ino pooki atua e safina, amu atoduaa ajo ira oltung'ani oitashe too sipat te dukuya nanu tena ishoi.

English: Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the male and his female: and of beasts that are not clean by two, the male and his female.
Masaai: Iwa ing'uesi maare naapishana nemeeta entioto, oloing'oni ake o elipong. Iwa sii ing'uesi maare naapishana naata intiot, oloing'oni ake o elipong.

English: Of fowls also of the air by sevens, the male and the female; to keep seed alive upon the face of all the earth.
Masaai: Niya sii imotonyi oloing'ang'e maare naapishana, oloing'oni ake o elipong peyie eitubulaa impukunot enye tioriong enkop.

English: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore teneishunye inkolong'i naapishana, kairriu enchan shumata enkop too nkolong'i artam o nkewaritin artam. Metaa ore pooki toki naitobira, kajutu tioriong enkop.”

English: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
Masaai: Neas Noa nena pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore apa Noa ina kata naa oloo larin iip ile te moruao, peyie elotu olairrag le nkare shumata enkop.

English: And Noah went in, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him, into the ark, because of the waters of the flood.
Masaai: Neaku ore Noa tenebo ilayiok lenyena o enkitok enye, o nkituaak oo layiok lenyena tenebo ninye, nejing e safina aailany olairrag le nkare.

English: Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth,
Masaai: Ore ing'uesi pooki nemeeta ntiyiot o ng'uesi pooki naata ntiyot, o motonyi, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop,

English: There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
Masaai: maare maare, aa oloing'oni ake o elipong, etijing'a atua e safina tenebo Noa anaa enaitanapa Enkai Noa.

English: And it came to pass after seven days, that the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i naapishana, neiput olairrag sapuk le nkare shumata enkop.

English: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
Masaai: Ore to lari le iip ile le nkishui e Noa, to lapa li are enkolong e tomon o naapishana olapa, nedanya inkonyek oo nkariak naagut aaruko, nebolo sii ilusien e keper.

English: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
Masaai: Neshaiki enchan e shumata enkop inkolong'i artam o nkewaritin artam.

English: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;
Masaai: Te ina olong ake etijing'a Noa, o Shem, o Ham, o Yafet ilayiok le Noa, o enkitok e Noa, o nkituaak uni oo layiok lenyena atua esafina.

English: They, and every beast after his kind, and all the cattle after their kind, and every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind, and every fowl after his kind, every bird of every sort.
Masaai: Ninche o pooki ng'ues te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, onkishu pooki te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o motonyi pooki te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o pooki motonyi e pooki pukunoto.

English: And they went in unto Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh, wherein is the breath of life.
Masaai: Nejing pooki atua e safina tenebo Noa, maare maare oo seseni pooki oota enkishui.

English: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the LORD shut him in.
Masaai: Ore nena naatijinga, oloing'oni o elipong e pooki toki naata osesen, nejing atua, anaa enaitanapa Enkai Noa. Neikenoo Olaitoriani ninye tiatua.

English: And the flood was forty days upon the earth; and the waters increased, and bare up the ark, and it was lift up above the earth.
Masaai: Nebik olairrag le nkare tioriong enkop nkolong'i artam, neponari enkare o metudumu aing'atie enkop ailepie e safina.

English: And the waters prevailed, and were increased greatly upon the earth; and the ark went upon the face of the waters.
Masaai: Neponari enkare oleng neiput enkop, nepor esafina shumata nkariak.

English: And the waters prevailed exceedingly upon the earth; and all the high hills, that were under the whole heaven, were covered.
Masaai: Neponari enkare oleng te nkop, ometaa ore ildoinyo pooki adoru ootii abori keper neimisieki.

English: Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.
Masaai: Neitemoo enkare ildoinyo pooki metaa eng'uton ntemat e nkaina tomon o imiet.

English: And all flesh died that moved upon the earth, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of beast, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth, and every man:
Masaai: Neye pooki toki naata osesen naloolo te shumata enkop. Imotonyi, o nkishu, o ng'uesi, o pooki toki naishu te nkop, o pooki tung'ani,

English: All in whose nostrils was the breath of life, of all that was in the dry land, died.
Masaai: o pooki toki natii enkop natoyio naata enkiyang'et e enkishui, neye pooki.

English: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
Masaai: Etujutuoki pooki toki naishu natii enkoriong enkop, aa tung'ani, o ng'uesi, o pooki toki naiserpepiari, o motonyi oloing'ang'e, etujutuo ninye pooki te nkop. Noa ake etung'uayioki tenebo ilooboitare tiatua e safina.

English: And the waters prevailed upon the earth an hundred and fifty days.
Masaai: Nebik inkariak tioriong enkop inkolong'i iip o onom.

English: And God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged;
Masaai: Kake etadamua Enkai Noa o ng'uesi pooki, o nkishu pooki naaboitare ninye te safina. Neisho Enkai osiwuo meima shumata enkop, nengoroo enkare,

English: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained;
Masaai: neiken sii inkonyek oo nkariak e ng'uton o lusien e keper. Neguarra enchan e keper.

English: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
Masaai: Neiteru enkare te nkop ang'oroo. Ore te nkiting'oto enkolong, e iip o onom, etong'oroyie enkare aaku kiti,

English: And the ark rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, upon the mountains of Ararat.
Masaai: ore to lapa liopishana, te nkolong e tomon o naapishana o lapa, nedou esafina airrag te nchumata o ldoinyo le Ararat.

English: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month: in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, were the tops of the mountains seen.
Masaai: Nengoroo inkariak o metabaiki olapa le tomon. Ore peyie ebau enkiting'oto o lapa le tomon, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelioyu inchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: And it came to pass at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i artam, nebol Noa elusie eina safina naitobirua apa.

English: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye olkurruk, neloolo to loing'ang'e ometoito nkariak eishunye enkare.

English: Also he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from off the face of the ground;
Masaai: Neitoki airriwaa enturkulu meing'urai tenaa keishunye inkariak ti oriong enkop.

English: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot, and she returned unto him into the ark, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth: then he put forth his hand, and took her, and pulled her in unto him into the ark.
Masaai: Kake eitu etum eneroro, nerrinyokino ninye atua e safina, amu eton etii inkariak oriong enkop pooki. Neitorioo ninye enkaina enye aibung ninye neyau ninye atua e safina ine netii;

English: And he stayed yet other seven days; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark;
Masaai: Neitoki aanyu kulie olong'i naapishana, neitoki aigil airriwaa enturkulu aitupuku te safina.

English: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye enturkulu teipa naa ng'ura eeta embeneyioi nashal te nkutuk enye naitayio to lchani lo loirien. Neyiolou ina kata Noa ajo eishunye enkare te nkop.

English: And he stayed yet other seven days; and sent forth the dove; which returned not again unto him any more.
Masaai: Neitoki Noa aanyu kulie olong'i naapishana, neirriwaa enturkulu kake eitu eigil arrinyokino ninye.

English: And it came to pass in the six hundredth and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth: and Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and, behold, the face of the ground was dry.
Masaai: Ore to lari le iip ile o obo, to lapa le dukuya enkolong e dukuya o lapa, eishunye inkariak tioriong enkop neiwuang'ie Noa enkikenet e Safina, naa ng'ura, nedol ajo etoyio oriong enkop.

English: And in the second month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, was the earth dried.
Masaai: Ore to lapa li are te nkolong e tikitam o naapishana o lapa, netoyio apa enkop.

English: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Enkai Noa ajoki,

English: Go forth of the ark, thou, and thy wife, and thy sons, and thy sons' wives with thee.
Masaai: “Tupuku te safina, iyie o enkitok ino, o layiok linono, o nkituaak oo layiok linono, mpungo shomo,

English: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee, of all flesh, both of fowl, and of cattle, and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth; that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply upon the earth.
Masaai: toshoru tenebo iyie pooki toki naishu natii tenebo iyie e pooki sesen, imotonyi, o ng'uesi, o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, peyie etum aatoisho aatubul aaiputa enkop.”

English: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
Masaai: Neipung Noa alo, o layiok lenyena, o enkitok enye, o nkituaak oo layiok lenyena.

English: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every fowl, and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth, after their kinds, went forth out of the ark.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ues, o pooki toki naiserpepiari, o pooki motonyi o pooki toki nalo tioriong enkop nepuku pooki anaa impukunot enye aaing'uaa e Safina nepuo.

English: And Noah builded an altar unto the LORD; and took of every clean beast, and of every clean fowl, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
Masaai: Ina peyie eshetaki Noa Olaitoriani ewueji olasar, neya pooki ng'ues nemeeta entioto, o pooki motonyi, nemeeta entioto, neitaki Enkai olasar opejori te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And the LORD smelled a sweet savour; and the LORD said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake; for the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.
Masaai: Ore peyie eing'uaya Olaitoriani esong'ouna narropil, nejo Olaitoriani toltau lenye; “Maitoki aekata adek enkop tenkaraki oltung'ani, amu ore endamunoto oltau lo ltung'ani eiteru te keraisho naa intorrok, nemaitoki aekata aidakie pooki toki naishu anaa enataasa.

English: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.
Masaai: Ore eton eetae enkop, meishunye enkata eunore o enkata enkisampuare oo ndaiki, o enkirobi o enkirowuaj, olodalu, oloirujuruj, o endama o enkewarie.”

English: And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.
Masaai: Nemayian Enkai Noa o layiok lenyena, nejoki ninche: “Entoisho entubul entoponari, emputa enkop.

English: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moveth upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.
Masaai: Keureyuni intae neponari sii oloputukunyi te pooki ng'ues natii enkop, o pooki motonyi oloing'ang'e o pooki toki naiserpepiari te nkop, o pooki sinkirri le naiposha, keaku inkaik inyi etii.

English: Every moving thing that liveth shall be meat for you; even as the green herb have I given you all things.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki naishu nalo keaku endaa te intae anaa enaishoo intae endiati nanyori, aaishoo intae pooki toki.

English: But flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat.
Masaai: Minyanya ake inkiri naata enkishui enye, aa inchere osarge lenye.

English: And surely your blood of your lives will I require; at the hand of every beast will I require it, and at the hand of man; at the hand of every man's brother will I require the life of man.
Masaai: Amu ore to sarge le nkishui naa kaitalaku te nkitalukunoto; kaitalaku nanu te pooki ng'ues o te tung'ani; ore te pooki alashe lo ltung'ani naitalaku te nkishui oltung'ani.

English: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloibukoo osarge lo ltung'ani, naa oltung'ani oibukoo osarge lenye, amu eitayio Enkai oltung'ani te nkitanyaanyukoto enye makewan.

English: And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein.
Masaai: Ore intae, entubul entoponari entaa kumok emputa enkop.”

English: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Noa o te nebo ilayiok lenyena ooboitare:

English: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you;
Masaai: “Ing'ura ajo, kaitasheyie osotua lo lning'o o iyie o tenebo eishoi nikisuju,

English: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.
Masaai: o pooki toki naishu nikiboitare, o imotonyi, o inkishu, o pooki ng'ues enkop nikiboitare, o pooki ake ninye natupukuo tiatua e safina.

English: And I will establish my covenant with you; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie osotua lai o ntae, laa inchere maitoki aekata amut iseseni pooki to loirrag le nkare, nemeitoki aekata enkop amuta te nkare.”

English: And God said, This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
Masaai: Nejo Enkai: “Ele ninye olmonekie lo sotua lo lning'o laitayu te rishata ai intae, o pooki toki naishu natii tenebo intae o too lporori oosuju.

English: I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
Masaai: Atipika olokirrai lai atua enkatampoi naa keaku olmonekie lo sotua lai o enkop.

English: And it shall come to pass, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud:
Masaai: Teneyau inkatampo te shumata enkop, nedoli olokirrai te nkatampoi,

English: And I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.
Masaai: Naa kadamu nanu osotua lolning'o lai otii erishata ai o intae, o pooki toki naishu e pooki sesen, nemeitoki aekata nkariak aaku olairrag sapuk omut iseseni pooki.

English: And the bow shall be in the cloud; and I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore etii olokirrai atua inkatampo, naa kaing'or ninye nadamu osotua lai lo lning'o ntarasi otii erishata Enkai o pooki toki naishu natii oriong enkop.”

English: And God said unto Noah, This is the token of the covenant, which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Noa: “Ele ninye olmonekie lo sotua laitasheyie te rishata ai o pooki sesen otii oriong enkop.”

English: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
Masaai: Metaa ore ilayiok le Noa ootupukutuo te safina naa Shem, o Ham, o Yafet. Naa Ham apa menye le Kanaan.

English: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.
Masaai: Ore kulo pokira okuni naa ilayiok le Noa, naa ninche ooibulaitie enkop pooki.

English: And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:
Masaai: Noa apa olaturoni le dukuya le nkop etuuno ninye enkurma oo sabibu.

English: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
Masaai: Neok Noa enaisho oo lsabibu nemera oleng neirrag to lng'obor lenye meishopo.

English: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without.
Masaai: Nedol Ham laa ninye menye le Kanaan emasipaisho e menye. Neliki ilalashera lenyena aare te boo.

English: And Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it upon both their shoulders, and went backward, and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were backward, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyau Shem o Yafet olkila eiteleikino iloilila lenye, nepuo te siadi, neitoip emasipaisho e Papaai lenye; ore inkomomi enye neingorie dikae, neitu ninche edol emasipaisho e papaai lenye.

English: And Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done unto him.
Masaai: Ore peyie einyototo Noa te merai e naisho, neyiolou enaitaasa olayioni lenye oti ninye,

English: And he said, Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
Masaai: nejo ninye, “Metedeki Kanaan, keaku ninye orrindik loo rrindiki too ilalashera lenyena.”

English: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
Masaai: Nejo ake sii: “Metamayiana Olaitoriani Enkai ai Shem, naa inchoo Kanaan metaa orrindik lenye.

English: God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
Masaai: Meitubulu Enkai Yafet naa inchoo metotona to lng'obor le Shem, neaku Kanaan osinka lenye.”

English: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye olairrag le nkare, enyaaka Noa abik ilarin iip uni o onom.

English: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
Masaai: Ore inkolong'i pooki e Noa naa ilarin iip naaudo o onom neye ninye.

English: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.
Masaai: Kuna iishoritin oo layiok le Noa, Shem, o Ham o Yafet, netoikioki ninche ilayiok te siadi olairrag le nkare.

English: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yafet naa kulo: Gomer, o Madai, o Yafan, o Tubal, o Mishek, o Tiras.

English: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gomer naa Askenas, o Rifat, o Togarma,

English: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Yafan naa Elisha, o Tarshish, o Kitim, o Dodaim.

English: By these were the isles of the Gentiles divided in their lands; every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.
Masaai: Te kulo etegelari iltungana loo lkirinen le naiposha aaidapashari. Ore kulo naa ilayiok le Yafet too nkuapi enye, oltung'ani ake o enkutuk enye, too lmareita lenye tiatua iloshon lenye.

English: And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ham naa Kush, o Misri, o Put, o Kanaan.

English: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabtecha: and the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kush naa Seba, o Hafila, o Sabta, o Raama, o Sabteka. Ore ilayiok le Raama naa Sheba, o Dedan.

English: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.
Masaai: Neiu Kush Nimrod laa ninye apa otang'asa aaku oltung'ani magilani te nkop.

English: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa Nimrod naa olang'oroni magilani te dukuya Olaitoriani. Ore enkaraki ina etejoki, “Olotiu anaa Nimrod olang'oroni magilani te dukuya Olaitoriani.”

English: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
Masaai: Ore enkiterunoto enkitoo enye naa Babel, o Erek, o Akad, o Kalneh o lelo pooki ootii enkop e Shinar.

English: Out of that land went forth Asshur, and builded Nineveh, and the city Rehoboth, and Calah,
Masaai: Nepuku teina kop alo Asiria neshet Ninawi o Rehobosuira, o Kala;

English: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah: the same is a great city.
Masaai: o Rasen te rishata e Ninawi o Kala, aa ninye enkanasa kitok.

English: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
Masaai: Neaku Misri menye le Ludi o Anami, o Lehabi, o Naftuhi.

English: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (out of whom came Philistim,) and Caphtorim.
Masaai: O Patrusi, o Kasluhi, (laa ninye eing'uaa Ilfilisti) o Kafitori.

English: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn, and Heth,
Masaai: Neaku Kanaan menye le Sidon ilo kikau lenye, o Het,

English: And the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgasite,
Masaai: o Lyebusi o Lamori, o Lgirgashi,

English: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
Masaai: o Lhifi, o Larki, Olsini,

English: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad.
Masaai: o Larfadi o Lsemari, o Lhamat; ore te siadi neidapasha ilmarei le Kanaan too nkuapi.

English: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as thou comest to Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest, unto Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Admah, and Zeboim, even unto Lasha.
Masaai: Ore olpolosie le Kanaan edumunye te Sidon te nkalo e Gerar, ometabaiki Gasa, te nkalo e Sodom o Gomorra o Adma, o Siboiim ometabaiki Lasha.

English: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok loo loshon lenye.

English: Unto Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder, even to him were children born.
Masaai: Naa Shem sii menye loo nkera pooki e Eber, olalashe botor le Yafet, etoikioki sii ninye nkera.

English: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shem naa, Elam, o Ashur, o Arpakashad, o Lud, o Aram.

English: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Aram naa Usi, o Hul, o Geter, o Mash.

English: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
Masaai: Neaku Arpakashad menye le shela, neaku Shela menye le Eber.

English: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.
Masaai: Neikini Eber ilayiok oare, nejo obo enkarna Peleg, amu too nkolong'i enyena etoore enkop. Neji olalashe lenye Yokitan.

English: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
Masaai: Neaku Yokitan menye Almodad, o Shelaf, o Hasarmafet o Yara, o

English: And Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,
Masaai: Hadoran, o Usal, o Dikla,

English: And Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
Masaai: o Obal, o Abimael, o Sheba,

English: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.
Masaai: o Ofir, o Hafila o Yobab; ore lelo pooki naa ilayiok le Yokitan.

English: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest unto Sephar a mount of the east.
Masaai: Ore emanyisho enye epuku aing'uaa Mesha te nkalo e Sefar o metabaiki enkop oo ldoinyo te nkilepunoto enkolong.

English: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Shem to lmarei lenye, o too nkutukie enye, o too nkuapi enye, o too loshon lenye.

English: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmarei loo layiok le Noa, te risioroto oo ishoritin enye, too loshon lenye. Naa te kulo eidapashakinote iloshon oriong enkop eidipa atulusoi oloirrag le nkare.

English: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
Masaai: Ore apa enkop pooki naa enkutuk nabo eeta o rorei kuti.

English: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
Masaai: Neaku ore peyie eidurru iltung'ana aaing'uaa oloosaen netum enkop naisiasha te nkop e Shinar, neitaa ine emanyisho enye.

English: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
Masaai: Nejokino ninche maate, “Wootu emaitayu Ilmatofali le sarng'ab nikipej te nkima oleng.” Neshetishore ilmatofali te rishata oo soito o lami te rishata osinyai oshula o enturoto.

English: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
Masaai: Ina pee ejo: “Wootu emateshetaki ate enkanasa naata oltalet olo abaiki keper, nikintaiki ate enkarna peyie mikindapashakino ineelakua ti oriong enkop pooki.”

English: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
Masaai: Nedou Olaitoriani aing'or ina anasa o ilo talet otesheta inkera oo ltung'ana.

English: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, olorere obo ninche, neiro pooki enkutuk nabo, naa ena enkiterunoto oo siaaitin naas. Naa ore pooki nayieu neas metii engoloto te ninche.

English: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech.
Masaai: Wootu, emaape aadoyio aitarruoo enkutuk enye, peyie meitoki aaning'uno maate te nkiroroto.”

English: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
Masaai: Metaa eidapashaka Olaitoriani ninche oriong enkop pooki teine, nepal enchetata e nkanasa.

English: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
Masaai: Enkaraki eina peyie etejoki enkarna enye Babel, amu teine apa etomilo Olaitoriani enkutuk enkop pooki, naa teine eidapashaka Olaitoriani ninche oriong enkop pooki.

English: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
Masaai: Kulo ile ishoi e Shem. Ore peyie eaku Shem oloo larin iip nabo, etaa ninye menye le Arpakashad ilarin aare anaa neishunye oloirrag le nkare,

English: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: enyaaka Shem abik ilarin iip imiet eidipaki aatoiu Arpakashad, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Arpakashad ilarin tomoni uni o miet, neaku menye le Shela.

English: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Arpakashad abik ilarin iip ong'uan o okuni eidipaki aatoiu Shela, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Shela ilarin tomoni uni, etaa ninye menye le Eber.

English: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Shela abik ilarin iip ong'uan o okuni eidipaki aatoiu Eber, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Eber ilarin tomoni uni oong'uan, etaa ninye menye le Peleg.

English: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Eber abik ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni eidipaki aatoiu Peleg, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Peleg ilarin tomoni uni, etaa ninye menye le Reu.

English: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Peleg abik ilarin iip are o naaudo eidipaki aatoiu Reu, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Reu ilarin tomoni uni o aare, etaa ninye menye le Serug.

English: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Reu abik ilarin iip are o opishana eidipaki aatoiu Serug, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Serug ilarin tomoni uni, etaa menye le Nahor.

English: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Serug abik ilarin iip are eidipaki aatoiu Nahor, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Nahor ilarin tikitam ooudo, etaa ninye menye le Terah.

English: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Enyaaka Nahor abik ilarin iip o tomon o ooudo eidipaki aatoiu Terah, neeta apa kulikae ayiok o ntoyie.

English: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu Tera ilarin ntomoni naapishana etaa ninye menye le Abram, o Nahor o Haran.

English: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
Masaai: Naa kulo ile ishoi e Tera. Ore apa Tera naa menye le Abram, o Nahor, o Haran. Ore apa Haran naa menye le Lot.

English: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
Masaai: Nesiooyo Haran aye te dukuya Papaai lenye Tera teina kop natoiyeki ninye e Uri oo Ilkaldayo.

English: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
Masaai: Neyam Abram o Nahor inkituaak, neji enkitok e Abram Sarai, neji ene Nahor Milka, entito e Haran aa menye Milka o Iska.

English: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
Masaai: Ore apa Sarai naa koolupi amu meeta apa enkerai.

English: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
Masaai: Nerik Tera Abram olayioni lenye, o Lot olayioni le Haran olayioni lo layioni lenye, o Sarai, enkitok olayioni lenye Abram, nepuku aing'uaa pooki Uri oo Lkaldayo aapuo enkop e Kanaan. Ore peyie ebau Haran, eetuo aitaa ine emanyisho.

English: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
Masaai: Ore inkolong'i e Tera naa ilarin iip are o imiet neye ninye te Haran.

English: Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:
Masaai: “Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, ‘Tupuku shomo tung'uai enkop ino o ltung'ana linono le sotua, o enkaji e papaai lino, shomo enkop naautaki.

English: And I will make of thee a great nation, and I will bless thee, and make thy name great; and thou shalt be a blessing:
Masaai: Naa kaaitainye iyie olosho sapuk, naa kaamayian iyie, naitaa enkarna ino kitok metaa iyaku emayianata.

English: And I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee: and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed.
Masaai: Ekamayian lelo likimayian ore ilo likidek naa kadek. Te iyie emayian ilmarei pooki le nkop ate.’ ”

English: So Abram departed, as the LORD had spoken unto him; and Lot went with him: and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa Abram anaa enatiaaka Olaitoriani ninye, neiriamariyie Lot ninye, eshomo Abram aing'uaa Haran aa oloo larin ntomoni naapishana o imiet.

English: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls that they had gotten in Haran; and they went forth to go into the land of Canaan; and into the land of Canaan they came.
Masaai: Nerik Abram enkitok enye Sarai, o Lot olayioni lo lalashe lenye, o masaa pooki enye naatasotutuo, o ltung'ana oonoto te Haran, nepuku aapuo enkop e Kanaan. Ore peyie ebau enkop e Kanaan,

English: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Sichem, unto the plain of Moreh. And the Canaanite was then in the land.
Masaai: nedung Abram atua enkop o meshomo ewueji e Shekem o metabaiki eor e More. Ore ina rishata naa Lkanaan oomanya ina kop.

English: And the LORD appeared unto Abram, and said, Unto thy seed will I give this land: and there builded he an altar unto the LORD, who appeared unto him.
Masaai: Neipang'aki Olaitoriani Abram nejoki, “Ekaisho eishoi ino ena kop.” Metaa eteshetaka Abram Enkai teine olperere lo lasar ilo Aitoriani oipang'aka ninye.

English: And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: and there he builded an altar unto the LORD, and called upon the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Neidur teine nelo oldoinyo le nkalo oloo saen e Betel, neun olng'obor lenye. Etii Betel enkalo e Moikuape, netii Ai oloo saen. Neshetaki teine olaitoriani olperere lo lasar neipot ninye enkarna o Laitoriani.

English: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
Masaai: Neitoki Abram aidur teine neito alo enkalo e Negeb.

English: And there was a famine in the land: and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there; for the famine was grievous in the land.
Masaai: Netii apa enkop olameyu oleng. Nedou Abram alotu enkop e Misiri, aparan, amu etagolo olameyu asapuku te nkop.

English: And it came to pass, when he was come near to enter into Egypt, that he said unto Sarai his wife, Behold now, I know that thou art a fair woman to look upon:
Masaai: Ore pee eaku kebau Misiri, nejoki Sarai enkitok enye, “Ayiolo ajo aira enkitok sidai te neing'ori,

English: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Egyptians shall see thee, that they shall say, This is his wife: and they will kill me, but they will save thee alive.
Masaai: naa tinikidol Ilmisiri, naa kejo, enkitok ele tung'ani ena. Naa kaar nanu matua nikincho iyie inchu.

English: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
Masaai: Tejo ira enkanashe ai peyie atum eseriani te nkaraki iyie, netum enkorrok ai atumunyana te iyie.”

English: And it came to pass, that, when Abram was come into Egypt, the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing Abram Misiri, nedol Ilmisiri aajo aisidai ina kitok oleng.

English: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her, and commended her before Pharaoh: and the woman was taken into Pharaoh's house.
Masaai: Nedol ilkituaak le Farao ninye, nepejoo te Farao, neriki ninye enkaji e Farao.

English: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki Sarai, eitaasaki Abram isupati, metaa keeta intare, olmong'i, o nkishu, o sirkon, o laisiaayiak, o nkaisiaayiak, osirkon lipong'a o ntamesin.

English: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram's wife.
Masaai: Kake eitamio Olaitoriani Farao o enkaji enye to lmeitai kitok te nkaraki Sarai enkitok e Abram.

English: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?
Masaai: Neipot Farao Abram ajoki, “Kainyoo ena nikintaasa nanu? Ainyoo peyie eitu kiliki ajoki enkitok ino ninye?

English: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
Masaai: Ainyoo iyie pee itejo, enkanashe ai ninye,” metaa aawa ninye ayam aitaa enkitok ai? Ore naa iyie, nena enkitok ino toriko enchom.

English: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
Masaai: Neishoru Farao inkitanapat aisho iltung'ana te karaki Abram; neisho ninye meshomo, tenebo enkitok enye, o pooki toki naata.

English: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
Masaai: Metaa eilepa Abram alo aing'uaa Misiri, ninye o enkitok enye, o pooki toki naata, tenebo Lot aapuo enkop e Negeb.

English: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.
Masaai: Naa karsis oleng Abram too nkishu o te nkosholai, o te sahabu.

English: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
Masaai: Neidur ninye aing'uaa Negeb ometabaiki Betel ewueji apa netii olng'obor lenye te nkiterunoto aa erishata Betel o Ai.

English: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Ewueji apa netang'asa aitobirie olperere lo lasar. Neipot Abram teine enkarna o Laitoriani.

English: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.
Masaai: Ore sii ninye Lot oiriamunore Abram eboitare ninye neeta sii ninye inkishu, o ntare, olng'oborri,

English: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.
Masaai: metaa meishaa enkop pokira aare te nemanya, amu aikumok imasaa e pookira.
