English: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram's cattle and the herdmen of Lot's cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.
Masaai: Nejing enchankar ilchekuti loo nkishu e Abram olchekuti loo nkishu e Lot. Ore apa ina kata, eton emanya Ilkanaan o Lperisi enkop.

English: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.
Masaai: Nejoki Abram Lot, “Meishiaakino sii ake nejing erishata ang, enchankar, anaa ejing erishata oo lchekuti linono o lchekuti laainei amu aikira emudong.

English: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.
Masaai: Aimetii enkop pooki dukuya iyie? Toorori te nanu. Teniito iyie enkaina e kedienye, naito ene tatene naa tiniito iyie ene tatene, naito nanu ene kedienye.”

English: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.
Masaai: Neraposhu Lot inkonyek enyena, nedol ajo ore oyerata le Yordan keeta inkariak te pooki wueji, anaa enkurma o Laitoriani, anaa enkop e Misiri te nkalo e Soar, ina kata eton eitu eidaikie Olaitoriani Sodom o Gomorra.

English: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
Masaai: Metaa negelaki Lot kewan oyerata pooki le Yordan, nelo ninye oloo saen. Neoro o Abram teine.

English: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.
Masaai: Nemany Abram e nkop e Kanaan, nemany Lot inkanas natii inkanas o Yarata, neidurrie olng'obor lenye ometabaiki Sodom.

English: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana le Sodom naa kaarruok, naa ilaingokok oleng te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, eidipa atoorori Lot ainguaa ninye, “Taraposhu inkonyek inono ing'ura aiteru teine nitii, moikuape, o kopikop o loo saen o oloo ntoluo.

English: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.
Masaai: Ore ina kop pooki nidolita, naa kaaisho iyie tenebo eishoi ino ntarasi.

English: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.
Masaai: Kaitaba eishoi ino anaa enterit enkop; metaa te neidimayu meikena oltung'ani enterit enkop, neidimayu sii meikeni eishoi ino.

English: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.
Masaai: Tudumunye, shomo tudungo eneba enkadori o endapasho enkop, amu aaishoo iyie.”

English: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku eidurrie Abram olng'obor lenye nelotu abik too lkeek oonyaanyukie ilngabolo le Mamre otii Hebron. Ore teine Neshetaki Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar.

English: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i e Amrefel olaiguanani le Shina, Ariok olaiguanani le Elisar, Kedorloamer olaiguanani le Elam, o Tidal olaiguanani le Gooim,

English: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.
Masaai: eipirutua kulo aiguanak olarrabal aarare Bera olaiguanani le Sodom, o Birsha olaiguanani le Gomora, o Shinab olaiguanani le Adma. O Shemeber olaiguanani le Sibooiim, olaiguanani le Bela aa ninye Soar.)

English: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
Masaai: Neitushulu kulo pooki enjore aitaa nabo to erata le Siddim (aa taa enaiposha e munyan).

English: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
Masaai: Neisiaai Kederlaomer ilarin tomon aare, ore to lari le tomon oo kuni neiser ninche.

English: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oo ng'uan nelotu Kederlaomer, o laiguanak otii tenebo ninye aar Ilrefai te Ashterot-Karnaim, o Susim te Ham, o Emin te Sharekiriatiam.

English: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
Masaai: Olhori to ldoinyo lenye le Seir, ometabaiki Elparan olpolosie liong'ota.

English: And they returned, and came to Enmishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that dwelt in Hazezontamar.
Masaai: Neshukunye aapuo En-mishapat (aa ninye Kadesh) near enkop pooki oo Lmaleki, near sii Ilamori lelo oomanya Hasason tamar.

English: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani le Sodom o laiguanani le Adma, o Seboiim o Bela (aa ninye Soar), neipang aapuo aajing olarrabal to erata le sidim

English: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.
Masaai: aashetaki tenebo Kederlaomer olaiguanani le Elam, olaiguanani Tidal le Gooim, o Amrefel olaiguanani le Shina, o Ariok olaiguanani le Elisar. Ilaiguanak oong'uan egilunore ilaiguanak imiet.

English: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.
Masaai: Nebore o erata le Siddim ingumot naaturuno enturoto. Ore eilanyisho ilaiguanak le Sodom o Gomora, etusulakinote kulikae nena gumot, ore olkulikae nesaru oldoinyo.

English: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.
Masaai: Metaa ewaita ilmang'ati imasaa e Sodom o Gomorra, o ndaiki enye pooki nepuo.

English: And they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
Masaai: Ewaita sii ninye Lot, olayioni lo lalashe le Abram omanya Sodom tenebo imasaa enyena nepuo.

English: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.
Masaai: Ore obo oilanyishe, eewuo ainosaki Abram Olheburaniai omanya ina kata embata oo lkeek oonyanyukie ilng'abolo te Mamre o Lamori, olalashe le Eshkol o Aner, laa ilootoning'ore ninche Abram.

English: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.
Masaai: Ore peyie ening Abram inchere ewaki oltung'ani lenye le mudong eararoto, nerik iltung'ana ooyiolo olarrabal laa iinot le nkaji enye, iltung'ana oora esiana iip uni o tomon oisiet, nelo asujaa ninche ometabaiki Dan.

English: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
Masaai: Neor ninye iltimito lenyena agilunore ninche kewarie. Etii sii ninye o ilaisiaayiak lenyena olarrabal, metaa ore ninye tenebo ilaisiaayiak lenyena, etudumutua ninche nemiraa ometabaiki Hoba natii moikuape e Dameski.

English: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.
Masaai: Nerrinyu ninye imasaa pooki naawaki tenebo sii oltung'ani lenye le mudong Lot, omasaa enyena, o nkituaak o ltung'ana.

English: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king's dale.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip atushukunye eisulie olarrabal le Kedorloamer tenebo ilaiguanak ooboitare, etupukuo olaiguanani le Sodom alo anang'are to erata le Shafe, (aa ninye o erata lo laiguanani.)

English: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.
Masaai: Neyau Melkisedek olaiguanani le Salem e mukate o enaisho oo sabibu: ore apa ninye naa Olapolosani le Nkai natii shumata aisul.

English: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
Masaai: Nemayian ninye ejo; “Metamayiana Enkai natii shumata aisul Abram, ilo oitobira shumata o enkop.

English: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.
Masaai: Metamayiana Enkai natii shumata aisul, ilo otipika ilmang'ati linono inkaik inono.” Neisho Abram ninye ematua e tomon e pooki toki.

English: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani le Sodom Abram, “Inchooki olorere ake, ore imasaa niya aitaa ininono.”

English: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,
Masaai: Kake etiaka Abram olaiguanani le Sodom, “Ainosa olmumai to Laitoriani Enkai natii shumata aisul, oitobira shumata o enkop,

English: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:
Masaai: inchere maya hoo pito ebaiki enkeene enamuke, anaa toki ino pooki, peyie mijo ake aitaa nanu Abram karsis.

English: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.
Masaai: Meeta toki naya nanu meteleku entoki nainosa ilbarnot laainei, o ematua oo ltung'ana laaturubare, aa Aner, o Eshkol, o Mamre erubata enye.”

English: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi e kuna baa, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Abram te nduaata ejo, “Miureishoyu Abram, ara nanu elong'o ino, kesapuku oleng enkishooroto nikinchori iyie.”

English: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
Masaai: Kake etejo Abram, “Olaitoriani Enkai, ainyoo doi kincho, adolita ajo eloito enkishon dukuya maata enkerai, ore olajung'oni le nkaji ai naa Eliesa le Dameski?”

English: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ajo Abram, “Ng'urai, esipa eitu kincho nanu eishoi, ore osinka otoiwuoki te nkaji ai ninye oyooki aaku olajung'oni lai.”

English: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.
Masaai: Ng'ura, neirorie Olaitoriani ninye ajo, “Ore ele tung'ani meaku olajung'oni lino, olayioni loo nkiri inono ninye likijung.”

English: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.
Masaai: Neipang'unye ninye boo nejoki, “Ng'ura sii iyie keper, ninken ilakir tenaa aindim atipika esiana.” Neitoki ake ajoki, “Metaa neijia ebayu eishoi ino.”

English: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.
Masaai: Neiruk ninye Olaitoriani, neikenakini ninye aajo oloitashe too sipat.

English: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Ara Olaitoriani likintayio te Uri oo lkadayo peyie aaisho iyie ena kop intaa enino.”

English: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
Masaai: Kake etejo Abram, “Oi Olaitoriani Enkai, kaji aiko tenayiolou ajo keaku enaai?”

English: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Iyakaki entawuo oo larin okuni, o enkine oo larin okuni, o lmeregesh loo larin okuni, o enturkulu, o enkuoo e nturkulu.”

English: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.
Masaai: Neyaki Abram ninye kuna tokitin pooki nesash ninche maare neiteleiki enkiperrati nabo aishiaakinye enkae; kake eitu edung nena motonyi asash.

English: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
Masaai: Ore pee edoiki ilkurragoso nena popoki, neiture Abram aitalamaa.

English: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
Masaai: Ore etaa kedoyio enkolong, netir injo naairoshi Abram; naa ing'ura, etijinga oloputukunyi kitok le naimin kitok shumata ninye.

English: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Abram, “Tayiolo miata olng'ash ajo keaku eishoi ino ilomon te nkop neme enenye, neaku sii irrindiki teine, naa keibookini enkop too larin iip ong'uan;

English: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
Masaai: kake kayau endungokinoto enkiguana olosho pooki oisiaaita, ore tesiadi, nepuku ninche teina kop etudupote.

English: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.
Masaai: Ore iyie, ilo enetii iloo papaai lino to sotua, aikinukari itaa olpayian kitok oitobirakine enkirragata.

English: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.
Masaai: Naa keshukunye ninche ene te ishoi e ong'uan, amu eton eitu elulung'ayu ing'ok oo Lamori.”

English: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.
Masaai: Ore peyie edoyio enkolong etomisimiso enkop, ng'ura, nelioyu emoti napuru, o lang'at le nkima elo te rishata e nena sashat.

English: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:
Masaai: Ore teina olong, eitobira Olaitoriani osotua o Abram ejoki, “Ore iishoritin inono ekaisho ena kop, eiteru to lkeju le Misiri o metabaiki olkeju sapuk ilo keju le Frati.

English: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,
Masaai: enkop oo Lkanaan, o Lkeniti, o Lkenisi, o Lkadmoni,

English: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,
Masaai: o Lhiti, O Lperisi, o lrafai

English: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.
Masaai: o Lamori, o Lkanaani, o Lgirgashi, o Lyebusi.”

English: Now Sarai Abram's wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
Masaai: Ore Sarai enkitok e Abram eitu eiki Abram inkera. Neeta apa enkaisiaayiani e Misiri naji enkarna enye Haga.

English: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.
Masaai: Nejoki Sarai Abram, “Ng'ura sii ake, aatudung'o Olaitoriani eishoi, shomo enetii enkaisiaayiani ai, amu ebaiki natum inkera te ninye.” Neiruk Abram oltoilo le Sarai.

English: And Sarai Abram's wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.
Masaai: Metaa ore eishua Abram ilarin tomon te nkop e Kanaan, ore Sarai enkitok e Abram, neya Haga ina aisiaayiani enye oo Lmisiri, neisho Abram olpayian lenye meitaa enkitok enye.

English: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
Masaai: Nelo Abram enetii Haga, neiroshiu. Ore peyie edol enkaisiaayiani ajo eiroshiwuo, nemenu Sarai.

English: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Sarai Abram, “Inchoo ntorrok naaitaasitae meetu shumata iyie. Aaishoo iyie enkaisiaayiani ai ntamuata nkaik ore peyie edol ajo eiroshiwuo naamenu nanu. Inchoo Olaitoriani eiguanare erishata ai o enino!”

English: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Abram Sarai, “Ng'ura, etii enkaisiaayiani ino inkaik inono, intaasa anaa enidol eishiaakino te iyie.” Neisomit Sarai ninye aisilisil o meisikie aitung'uaa kewan.

English: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.
Masaai: Neinepu olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye tembata enchorro enkare ti ong'ata. Etii ina shorro enkoitoi nalo Shur.

English: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Haga enkaisiaayiani e Sarai, kaji iyie ing'uaa naa kaji iloito?” Nejo Haga, “Kaisikita ailany ina naaitore ai naji Sarai.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu Sarai nilo ayanyit ninye.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ajoki ninye, “Ekaponaa oleng eishoi ino metaa meikenayu te nkumoi.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika ninye, “Ng'ura ajo inuta, naa iiu enkayioni, nimpot enkarna enye ajo Ishmael, amu etoning'o Enkai osina lino.”

English: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man's hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.
Masaai: Naa keaku ninye osikiria le ntim tiatua iltung'ana, keaku ore enkaina enye ear pooki tung'ani, ore inkaik e pooki tung'ani keaku kearr ninye. Naa keibayu ninye ilalashera lenyena.

English: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?
Masaai: Metaa neipot enkarna Olaitoriani oirorie ninye ejo, “Ira iyie Enkai nadolita,” amu etejo, “Esipa doi katoduaa Enkai naton aishu aidipa atoduaa ninye.”

English: Wherefore the well was called  Beerlahairoi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki eina eishooki ina shorro enkarna aajo Beerlahairoi, netii ninye erishata e Kadesh o Bered.

English: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son's name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.
Masaai: Neiki Haga Abram enkayioni, neipot Abram enkarna enkayioni enye natoikio Haga ajo Ishmael.

English: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
Masaai: Ore apa Abram naa oloo larin ntomoni isiet o ile pee eiki Haga ninye Ishmael.

English: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku Abram oloo larin intomoni naaudo o naaudo neipang'aki ninye Olaitoriani nejoki, “Ara nanu Enkai magilani, shomo te dukuya nanu miata entioto,

English: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
Masaai: naa kaitobir osotua lai te rishata ai o iyie, naa kaaponaa oleng.”

English: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
Masaai: Nebatata Abram te nkomom enye, neirorie Enkai ninye ajoki,

English: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
Masaai: “Ing'ura etii osotua lai tenebo iyie, naa iyaku menye loo loshon kumok.

English: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
Masaai: Mikintokini aajo enkarna Abram, kake keaku aikiji enkarna ino Abraham amu aaitaa iyie menye loo lororani too loshon.

English: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
Masaai: Naa kaapon oleng, naa kaitayu iloshon tiatua iyie, naa kepuku ilaiguanak tiatua iyie.

English: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie nanu osotua lai te rishata ai o iyie o eishoi ino indipa iyie atulusoi tiatua iishoritin enye olning'o lo sotua lai loo ntarasi. Naa kaaku Enkai te iyie o tenebo eishoi ino nikisuju.

English: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.
Masaai: Naa kaaisho iyie tenebo eishoi ino nikisuju enkop nitaayie omon, enkop pooki e Kanaan metaa enino oo ntarasi naa kaaku Enkai enye.”

English: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.
Masaai: Neitoki Enkai ajoki Abraham, “Ore iyie imbung'a olning'o lai, lo sotua iyie o eishoi ino too iishoritin pooki naapuonu te siadi iyie.

English: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.
Masaai: Osotua lai ele, limbung iyie, te rishata ai o iyie o eishoi nikisuju iyie: ore pooki lee tiatua intae, naa kemurati.

English: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.
Masaai: Kemurati intae isuaten oo seseni linyi, naa keaku ina olmonekie lo sotua te rishata ai o ntae.

English: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oitabayie inkolong'i isiet naa kemurati, pooki lee tiatua iishoritin pooki, oloba anaa olotoiwuoki te nkaji ino, anaa oloinyanguaki too mpisai inono te pooki omoni leme oinoti linyi.

English: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
Masaai: Ore ilo oino te nkaji ino oilo oinyanguno too mpesai, nemurati pokira. Metaa etii osotua lai atua iseseni linyi anaa osotua loo ntarasi

English: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
Masaai: Ore pooki lee lememurata esuate o sesen lenye, nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena amu etigila osotua lai.”

English: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Abraham, “Ore Sarai enkitok ino, mintoki aipot ninye ajo Sarai, kake keaku keji enkarna enye Sara.

English: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.
Masaai: Naa kamayian nanu ninye, ore sii naa kaaisho iyie enkayioni te ninye. Naa kamayian nanu ninye neaku ninye ng'otonye oo loshon, kepukunye ninye ilaiguanak loo loreren.”

English: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
Masaai: Nebatata Abraham te nkomom enye nekueni eirorie kewan ejo; “Keikini enkerai olpayian kitok oitabayie ilarin iip nabo? Keidim Sara naitabayie ilarin ntomoni naudo atoiu enkerai?”

English: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
Masaai: Nejoki Abraham Enkai, “Oi eishiaakino nincho Ishmael metotona te dukuya iyie.”

English: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “A'a, esipa eikiiki enkitok ino Sara enkayioni, naa impot enkarna enye ajo Isaak, naa kaitasheyie osotua lai o ninye, metaa osotua loo ntarasi o too iishoritin naapuonu te siadi ninye.

English: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.
Masaai: Ore Ishmael, aatoning'o iyie, ng'ura, kamayian nanu ninye naitubulaa naponaa oleng. Naa keaku ninye menye ilaiguanak tomon aare, naa kaitaa ninye olosho sapuk.

English: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
Masaai: Kake kaitasheyie nanu osotua lai te Isaak, aikiiki Sara iyie tena rishata, telde ari olotu.”

English: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip airorie ninye, nelo Enkai aing'uaa Abraham.

English: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
Masaai: Neya Abraham olayioni lenye o tenebo irrindiki pooki ootoiwuoki te nkaji enye anaa iloinyang'uaki too mpisai enyena o pooki lee otii atua ilewa le nkaji e Abraham, nemurat pooki isuaten oo seseni lenye ina olong, anaa enaitanapa Enkai ninye.

English: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
Masaai: Ore apa Abraham naa oloo larin intomoni naudo o naudo ina kata peyie emurati esuate osesen lenye.

English: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
Masaai: Ore Ishmael olayioni lenye naa oloo larin tomon oo kuni peyie emurati esuate osesen lenye.

English: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.
Masaai: Ore teina olong ake nemurati Abraham tenebo olayioni lenye Ishmael.

English: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
Masaai: O lelo lewa pooki le nkaji enye, inot le nkaji enye, o lelo ooinyang'uaki too mpesai too lomon, nemurati pooki tenebo ninye.

English: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;
Masaai: Neipang'aki Olaitoriani ninye te mbata oo lkeek oo nyaanyukie lng'abolo te Mamre, etonita te kutukaji olng'obor lenye eirowua enkolong.

English: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,
Masaai: Neraposhu inkonyek enyena neing'orisho, naa ng'ura, eitashe iltung'ana okuni te dukuya ninye. Ore pee edol ninche, nepuku akuetu tiatua olng'obor anang'are ninche, neirrugo ninye abaiki enkop ejo:

English: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:
Masaai: “Olaitoriani lai, tenanoto omom too nkonyek inono, migiroo ake osinka lino.

English: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:
Masaai: Inchoo eyauni enkiti are peyie intukuyieyie inkejek inyi, niyeng'iyeng'ang'a te ntonata olchani.

English: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.
Masaai: Naa kayau enkiti daa peyie intokiki aagolu nindimidimi aashom itagolo amu iimutua enetii osinka linyi.” Nejo ninche, “Taasa anaa enitejo.”

English: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
Masaai: Neisarrisar Abraham alo atua olng'obor enetii Sara, nejoki ninye, “Isiosionie imboreitin uni e ntapa napuyiapuy nimpurj aitobir imukateni.”

English: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.
Masaai: Neipirri Abraham alo enetii inkishu enyena, nereu olashe onana sidai, neisho olaisiaayiani lenye, meisiosiono aitobir.

English: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.
Masaai: Neyau eng'orno, o kule, o ilo ashe onana oitobira airragie te dukuya ninche. Neitashe te mbata ninche te ntonata olchani einosita endaa.

English: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Koree doi Sara enkitok ino?” Neng'amaaa ajoki,

English: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.
Masaai: “Etii atua olng'obor.” Nejoki Olaitoriani, “Meeta duoo inchere peyie maarrinyokino iyie te nkata olorujuruj, ore Sara enkitok ino, keaku anaata enkayioni ina kata.” Ore eiro einining'isho ake Sara te nkutuk olng'obor ti oriong e Abraham.

English: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.
Masaai: Etaa apa moruak oleng ina kata Abraham o Sara, etaa kituaak oleng, metaa meekure duoo ninye eidim Sara atoiu enkerai.

English: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?
Masaai: Nekweni Sara makewan ejo: “Aidipa ataa moruo, netamorua sii ninye olpayian lai, katum nanu murruna?”

English: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Abraham, “Ainyoo doi peyie etakuenia Sara nejo, ‘Kesipa hoo doi ajo kaiu enkerai, nataa taata moruo?’

English: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.
Masaai: Keetae entoki nagol to Laitoriani? Ore te nkata nageluno kaashukokino te nkata oloirujuruj, naa ketum Sara enkayioni.”

English: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.
Masaai: Kake etomikio Sara ajo, “Eitu nanu akueni,” amu etureishe. Kake etiaka, ninye “A-a esipa itakuenia iyie.”

English: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.
Masaai: Neinyototo lelo tung'ana te ine neing'or enkalo e Sodom neiriamariyie Abraham ninche aitarioo.

English: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kaisudorie Abraham embae netaa kaas,

English: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
Masaai: amaa adolita ajo ore Abraham naa keaku olosho kitok magilani, ore iloshon pooki le nkop kemayian ate te ninye?

English: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.
Masaai: A'a, amu ategelua ninye peyie atum aitanapa nkera enyena olmarei lenye osuju ninye meibung'a orrekie lo Laitoriani eas isupati o sipat, peyie etum Olaitoriani ayaki Abraham imbaa naaisiligie ninye.”

English: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;
Masaai: Metaa nejoki Olaitoriani, “Ore amu etaa olkiyioi sapuk te nkaraki Sodom o Gomora, netaa torrok oleng ing'ok tiatua

English: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.
Masaai: e kadoyio alo aing'or tenaa ketaasa te risioroto olkiyioi oewuo enatii, naa tenemeneijia, nayiolou.”

English: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.
Masaai: Neibelekenya iltung'ana te ine, nepuo aaitoriokino enkalo e Sodom. Kake eitirring'e Abraham aitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
Masaai: Nenyiku Abraham nejo, “Amaa doi aindaikie isupati tenebo iltorrok?

English: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?
Masaai: Amaa naaji te netii iltung'ana onom supati atua ina anasa, indim aidakie ewueji pooki nimipalie lelo supati onom otii atua?

English: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?
Masaai: Metalakuana ena bae te iyie pee mias ena bae, aar metuata isupati o ltorrok, eji metaa kenyaanyuk osupat o ltorrono! Metalakuana ina bae te iyie! Amaa ilo oiguanare enkop pooki aimeas esipata?”

English: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tenatum tiatua Sodom iltung'ana onom ooitashe too sipat, naa kapal enkanasa pooki te nkaraki ninche.”

English: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:
Masaai: Newal Abraham ajo, “Ing'ura ajo, ayaua kewan peyie airorie Olaitoriani, nara nanu enterit o nkuruon.

English: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
Masaai: Amaa sa teneng'oru imiet te onom le lelo ooitashe too sipat, indaikie enkanasa pooki enkaraki natong'oro imiet.” Nejo Olaitoriani, “Maidaikie ninye tenainepu artam o miet te ine.”

English: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty's sake.
Masaai: Neitoki ake airorie ninye ejo, “Oo tenaa artam etumi te ine?” Neng'amaaa ajoki, “Ore enkaraki lelo artam, maas ina.”

English: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
Masaai: Neitoki Abraham ajo, “Oi mincho Olaitoriani egoro naa kairo. Oo tenaa tomoni oni etumi te ine?” Newal ninye, “Maas nanu ina tenatum tomoni uni te ine.”

English: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty's sake.
Masaai: Nejo Abraham, “Ing'ura ajo ayaua kewan airorie Olaitoriani. Oo tenaa tikitam etumi te ine?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore tenkaraki lelo tikitam maidaikie ninye.”

English: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
Masaai: Neitoki Abraham ajo, “Oi mincho Olaitoriani egoro, naa kairo ena ae nabo ake. Oo tenetumi tomon te ine.” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore enkaraki e lelo tomon maidaikie nanu ninye.”

English: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.
Masaai: Nelo Olaitoriani aing'uaa ine, eidipa airorie Abraham. Nerrinyo Abraham alo ewueji enye.

English: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;
Masaai: Nepuonu ilmalaika oare Sodom teipa, ore Lot egira apa aton te kishomi e Sodom. Ore peyie edol Lot ninche, neinyototo alo anang'are, neirrugo aitabaiki e nkomom enye enkop,

English: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant's house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.
Masaai: nejo, “Ilkituaak laainei embelekenyunye atasayia intae entijing enkaji osinka linyi, erraga, nintukuku inkejek inyi, nidumunyenye tadekenya aayok aapuo.” Nejo ninche, “A'a, aikiirrag enkoitoi nalala.”

English: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.
Masaai: Kake etasayia Lot ninche oleng, o meibelekenyakinoto enkaji enye, neitaiki ninche osirua, nepejoki ninche imukateni neitu eisuisheki neinos ninche.

English: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eirura ninche eetuo iltung'ana le nkanasa e Sodom ilooti o lbotoro olorere pooki o metabaiki olobayie aaman enkaji,

English: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.
Masaai: neipot Lot ejoki, “Koree iltung'ana ooetuo enitii ena kewarie? Intupuku ninche enikitii peyie kitum aatayiolo ninche.”

English: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,
Masaai: Neipang'aki Lot ninche teboo, nerrinyoki enkikenet enkaji.

English: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Atasayia intae ilalashera laainei emiaas entorroni naba inji.

English: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.
Masaai: Eng'ura, aata intoyie are nemeyiolo olee, entasho matorikoki intae peyie ipuopuo aitaas eniyieuu ore kulo tung'ana emintaas ae amu eetuo aajing oloip le nkaji ai.”

English: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.
Masaai: Kake etiakita ninche ninye, “Wuang'a iyie,” nejo sii, “Eewuo ele tung'ani aa olomoni naa ninye olotu aiguanare iyiook! Etaa kintaas iyie entorroni nalang enikintaas ninche.” Nerrumokino pooki aairony Lot, nenyikaki enkaji peyie egil kutuk aji.

English: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.
Masaai: Kake eitaituo lelo tung'ana inkaik neyietaki Lot atua enkaji natii neiken kutuk aji.

English: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
Masaai: Neosh te modoki lelo tung'ana otii boo e kutuk aji e ina ilooti o lbotoro metaa eitanaura ate eirrapurrapu enetii kutuk aji.

English: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana Lot, “Ae yata kulikae tung'ana tene?” Aa ilaputak linono, o ntoyie, anaa tung'ani ake ninye liata te nkanasa, intupuku ninche tiatua ene wueji.

English: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.
Masaai: Amu etinyikua peyie kindaikie ene wueji, amu etasapuka olkiyioi lenye te dukuya Enkai, neirriwua iyiook Olaitoriani maidaikie.

English: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
Masaai: Neipang Lot alo airorie ilaputak ooyam intoyie enyena, nejoki “Enyoito entupuku tene wueji, amu etinyikua peyie eidakie Olaitoriani enkanasa.” Kake etotiuo ninye too laputak anaa oltung'ani oiguranie ninche.

English: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.
Masaai: Ore enasirie neisiosionie ilmalaika Lot ejoki, “Inyo toriko enkitok ino o ntoyie inono pokira are naatii ene, pee mindaaya te nkitamioto ena anasa.

English: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
Masaai: Kake etotona ailitilito, ometaba anaa neibung lelo tung'ana enkaina enye o enkitok enye, o ntoyie enyena pokira are. Ore tenkaraki olng'ur le Nkai te ninye, eyautua ninye auluo enkanasa.

English: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.
Masaai: Ore peyie eitupuku ninche ninye, etiakita, “Isikie enkishui ino, niminang ake silig, nimintashe ake te dikae to yarata isikaki indoinyo pee mindaaya.”

English: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:
Masaai: Nejo Lot, “Oi mme neijia Olaitoriani lai.

English: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:
Masaai: Ing'ura ajo enoto osinka lino omom too nkonyek inono, nitoponayie olng'ur lino te nanu anaa pee intajeu enkishon ai, kake maidim aisikaki indoinyo eitu aainepu enkidaata naye nanu.

English: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
Masaai: Ing'ura enda anasa nataana naa kiti sii, nchooki makuetiki ine aime kiti ninye? Naa keitajeuni enkishui ai.”

English: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Ing'ura ajo aatonyorrikia sii ina bae, metaa maidaikie ina anasa nitejo.

English: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
Masaai: Tasioi isikaki ine, amu maas ae o tabai ine.” Enkaraki ina peyie etejoki enkarna eina anasa Soar.

English: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
Masaai: Eilepua enkolong ina kata nabau Lot Soar,

English: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;
Masaai: neitashaiki Olaitoriani Sodom o Gomorra isoito o oyupuyup o oishu o enkima, eing'uaa Olaitoriani eimu keper.

English: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.
Masaai: Nemut ninye nena anas, o erata pooki o pooki omanya inkanas, o pooki toki nabulu e nkop.

English: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
Masaai: Kake etanang'a enkitok e Lot silig esujita ninye, neaku ninye eng'ape e Munyan.

English: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham tadekenya alo ewueji neitasheyie te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.
Masaai: Neing'or ninye enkalo e Sodom o Gomorra o enkalo enkop pooki o yerata, naa ng'ura, upe eilepita empuruo eina kop anaa empuruo olkokuet.

English: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.
Masaai: Metaa ina apa emutata oo nkanas natii oerata. Etadamua Enkai Abraham neirriwaa Lot aitung'uaa atua ineemuti, anaa peyie emut inkanas naamanya Lot.

English: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.
Masaai: Nepuku Lot aing'uaa Soar, amany ildoinyo tenebo ntoyie enyena pokira are amu ekeure apa atotona te Soar, metaa etamanya enkapune tenebo ntoyie enyena pokira are.

English: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:
Masaai: Nejoki entito botor enkanashe “Etamorua papa, nemetii oltung'ani te nkop oboitare iyiook to rrekie le kiyama.

English: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
Masaai: Wou, maitemera papa enaisho oo sabibu peyie kisiap ninye nikintudupaki ninye eishoi.”

English: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
Masaai: Neitemer menye te naisho oo sabibu ina kewarie, nejing entito botor aisiap menye, neitu eyiolou Lot enkata naisiapa ninye o enkata natupukuo aing'uaa.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
Masaai: Ore peyie eaku enkolong e are, nejoki entito botor enkiti, “Ing'ura ajo aisiapa ng'ole papa; manyaaki aisho ninye enaisho ena kewarie, nilo sii iyie aisiap peyie kitum aaitudupai eishoi e papa lang.”

English: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
Masaai: Neitemer menye te naisho oo sabibu ina kewarie nasuju, nedumunye entito kiti aisiap menye, neitu eyiolou Lot enkata naisiapa ninye o enkata natudumunye.

English: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.
Masaai: Metaa nenutayu isilan pokira are e Lot te menye.

English: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
Masaai: Ore entito botor etoiwuo enkayioni neipot enkarna enye ajo Moab, naa ninye menye lo Lmoabu ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.
Masaai: Neiu sii ninye enkiti enkayioni, neipot enkarna enye ajo Ben-ammi, naa ninye menye loo Lamoni o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.
Masaai: Neidur Abraham te ine alo enkalo enkop e Negeb, nemany erishata e Kadesh o Shur nelo sii Gerar.

English: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
Masaai: Etejo Abraham tialo Sara enkitok enye, “Enkanashe ai ninye.” Ore olaiguanani Abimelek le Gerar, eirriwayie enkutuk meyauni Sara aayaki.

English: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife.
Masaai: Kake eewuo Enkai kewarie enetii Abimelek te nkidetidet, nejoki, “Ing'ura ira iyie oltung'ani otua tenkaraki ina kitok niwa, amu ore ninye naa enkitok e likae tung'ani.”

English: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
Masaai: Ore eton eitu elo Abimelek anyikaki ninye, etejo, “Olaitoriani, oar metuata iltung'ana loo sipat?

English: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.
Masaai: Keitu aajoki ninye makewan, ‘Enkanashe ai ninye?’ Netejo sii ninye enkitok, ‘Olalashe lai ninye.’ Metaa e supatisho oltau o sidano ataasie ena.”

English: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai ninye teina kidetidet, “Ee ekayiolo ajo itaasa ena te supatisho oltau lino, kake nanu laaibooyie peyie mikintaas eng'oki, metaa eitu aaisho iyie iseyie ninye.

English: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.
Masaai: Ore tena kata ayieu nirrinyoki olpayian enkitok enye, amu ore ninye naa oloiboni le Nkai, naa aikiomonoki ninye peyie nipok. Kake Naa tinimirrinyu iyie ninye, tayiolo ajo meeta inchere peyie miye, iyie o pooki toki ino.”

English: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.
Masaai: Neinyototo Abimelek tadekenya enasirie, neipotu ilaisiaayiak lenyena pooki neinosaki ninche kuna baa pooki, neureishoyu iltung'ana oleng.

English: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.
Masaai: Neipotu Abimelek Abraham, nejoki ninye, “Kaa bae ena nintaasa iyiook? Naa kaa ng'oki aaitaasa nanu iyie eji metaa kiyaka iyie nanu o enkitoria ai eng'oki sapuk? Kintaasa nanu imbaa nemeishaakino neasi.”

English: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
Masaai: Nejoki Abimelek Abraham, “Ainyoo endamunoto niata peyie itaasa ena bae?”

English: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
Masaai: Nejo Abraham, “Ataasa amu atadamua ajo, metii ene euriata e Nkai katukul, naa kaari enkaraki enkitok ai.

English: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
Masaai: Ore sii enkae, ekesipa doi tenajo enkanashe ai amu ore ninye, naa entito e papaai lai neme entito e yieyio lai, netaa enkitok ai.

English: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.
Masaai: Ore apa peyie aaisho Enkai maidurra te nkaji e papa, naatiaaka ninye, ‘Ena embae nikintaas nanu, ore pooki wueji nikijing', tejo tialo nanu, olalashe lai ninye.’ ”

English: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
Masaai: Neitayu Abimelek intare, o lmong'i o lewa o ng'oruo irrindiki, neisho pooki Abraham nerrinyoki ninye enkitok enye Sara.

English: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.
Masaai: Nejo, Abimelek, “Ore enkop ai pooki, etii dukuya ino tamanya pooki neba anaa eninyor.”

English: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.
Masaai: Nejoki Sara, “Ing'ura aishoo olalashe lino inkoshola enkalifu nabo, naaku ine nkitoipoto ino too nkonyek e lelo pooki likiboitare, ore te dukuya lelo pooki neaku aikinkenakini esipata.”

English: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.
Masaai: Neomon Abraham Enkai, neishiunye Enkai Abimelek tenebo enkitok enye ng'oruo rrindiki metaa etoiwutuo inkera.

English: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
Masaai: Amu eteena apa Olaitoriani ng'ueseti enkaji pooki e Abimelek tenkaraki Sara enkitok e Abraham.

English: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
Masaai: Nemutan Olaitoriani Sara anaa apa enatejo, neitaas ninye anaa enaisiligie.

English: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
Masaai: Nenutayu Sara neiki Abraham enkayioni te nkata e moruao enye, te nkata erishata natiaka ninye Enkai.

English: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
Masaai: Neipot Abraham enkarna enkayioni enye natoikio ninye Sara ajo Isaak.

English: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
Masaai: Nemurat Abraham enkayioni enye Isaak etaa oloo nkolong'i isiet, te inoto, anaa enaitanapa Enkai ninye.

English: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.
Masaai: Etaa Abraham oloo larin iip peyie eikini ninye enkayioni enye Isaak.

English: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
Masaai: Nejo Sara, “Aaitobiraka nanu Enkai enkuenia; ore pooki ng'ae oning, naa kaakueniyie nanu.”

English: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aing'ae aikata oidima atiaaki Abraham inchere keitanak Sara inkera? Ore ake eyia, natoikio ninye enkayioni te nkata emoruao enye.”

English: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
Masaai: Nebulu ina kerai, neoruni ilki, neitobir Abraham osirua sapuk ina olong naoruni Isaak ilki.

English: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.
Masaai: Nedol Sara enkayioni e Hagar olmisiri, natoikio ninye Abraham eiguran o enkayioni enye Isaak.

English: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Abraham, “Taarai impang'ie ena kitok rrindik tenebo enkayioni enye, amu meaku enkayioni ena kitok rrindik olajung'oni tenebo olayioni lai Isaak.”

English: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.
Masaai: Neaku torrono oleng ina bae te dukuya Abraham te nkaraki enkayioni enye.

English: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Enkai Abraham, “Mincho kintagor ororei le nkerai o tenkaraki enkitok ino rrindik, ore pooki nikijoki Sara, taasa ina. Amu Isaak eipotieki eishoi ino.

English: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.
Masaai: Naa kaitayu sii olosho tiatua enkayioni enkitok rrindik, amu ole ishoi ino sii ninye.”

English: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham tadekenya enasirie, neya endaa o lbene lolchoni le nkare; neisho Hagar meiteleiki oloililai lenye tenebo ina kerai neisho ninche meshomo. Nedumunye alo nelimana ti ong'ota e Beer-sheba.

English: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.
Masaai: Ore peyie emita enkare natii olbene lolchoni neing'uaa enkerai te ntonata osanag.

English: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.
Masaai: Nelo aing'uaa aton tenelamita te wueji neba anaa engororoto e mbae. Amu etejo, “Mincho aduaaki keeya enkerai ai.” Ore eton tenelamita ninye, neilepie enkerai oltoilo aishir.

English: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.
Masaai: Nening Enkai oltoilo leina ayioni, neipot olmalaika le Nkai Hagar eing'uaa keper nejoki ninye, “Ainyoo nikigira aitanyamal iyie Hagar? Miureishoyu, amu etoning'o Enkai oltoilo le nkishirata leina ayioni te ine netii.

English: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.
Masaai: Inyo tudumu enkerai imbung'a tukurraki nkaik inono, amu kaitaa ninye olosho kitok.”

English: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.
Masaai: Nebol Enkai inkonyek e Haga nedol enchorro enkare, nelo aiput ilo bene lenye lo lchoni enkare neisho ina ayioni metooko.

English: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
Masaai: Netii Enkai tenebo enkayioni nebulu ninye nebik tiong'ota, neaku olang'oroni padan le nkawuo.

English: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nebik tiong'ata e paran, neyamaki ng'otonye enkitok naitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata, etiaakita Abimelek tenebo Fiko aa olkitok le njore, Abraham,

English: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.
Masaai: “Etii Enkai tenebo iyie too siaaitin pooki nias, ore naa taata, ayieu ninos olmumai te nanu ajo te Nkai mikintaas emonkoi, anaa intaas enkerai ai, anaa intaas eishoi ai. Kake ore anaa ina supatisho naaitaasa, ninye sii nanu intaasaki te ina kop nitaayie omoni.”

English: And Abraham said, I will swear.
Masaai: Nejo Abraham, “Kanya olmumai.”

English: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech's servants had violently taken away.
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki Abraham Abimelek tenkaraki enchorro natoorutuo isinkan le Abimelek.

English: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.
Masaai: Nejo Abimelek, “Mayiolo ajo aing'ae otaasa ena bae, eitu sii kiliki, neitu aekata aning ometabaiki ena olong.”

English: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.
Masaai: Neyau Abraham nkerra o lmong'i neisho ninche Abimelek, neitayu pokira olning'o.

English: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
Masaai: Negelu Abraham isupeni naapishana e kerra too ntare meitasho oopeny.

English: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?
Masaai: Nejoki Abimeleki Abraham, “Ainyoo eitodolu kuna supeni naapishana e kerra nitegelua meitasho oopeny.”

English: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ore kuna supeni naapishana e kerra ining'amaa too nkaik aainei metaa iyaku iyie olchakeni lai inchere atuturo ena shorro.”

English: Wherefore he called that place Beersheba; because there they sware both of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, neji ine Beer-sheba, amu te ine einosa pokira oare olmumai.

English: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
Masaai: Metaa eitaituo ninche olning'o te Beer-sheba. Nerrinyo Abimelek tenebo Fiko olkitok lenye le njore enkop oo Lfilisti.

English: And Abraham planted a grove in Beersheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.
Masaai: Neun Abraham enchani nanyaanyukie oloilei te Beer-sheba, neipot ninye te ine enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai oo ntarasi.

English: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines' land many days.
Masaai: Nebik Abraham te nkop oo Lfilisti inkolong'i kumok.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie kuna baa etetema Enkai Abraham ejoki ninye, “Abraham” nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Toriko olayioni lino Isaak ilo laa ninye ake iata, ilo linyor, nipuopuo enkop e Moria, nintayu ninye te ine metaa olasar o pejori te nchumata o ldoinyo obo laaliki.”

English: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.
Masaai: Metaa einyo Abraham tadekenya enasirie neirot osikiria lenye, nerik ilbarnot lenyena oare tenebo enkayioni enye Isaak. Nedung'u ilkeek ooinokie olasar opejori, nedumunye alo ewueji netiaka ninye Enkai.

English: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni, neraposhu Abraham inkonyek nedol ewueji nelakua.

English: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.
Masaai: Nejoki Abraham ilbarnot lenyena, “Entotoni tene tenebo ele sikiria pee alo nanu o enkayioni idie aaseremisho peyie kintoki aashukunye.”

English: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
Masaai: Neya Abraham ilkeek ooinokieki olasar opejori, neiteleiki oloililai le Isaak enkayioni enye. Nenap te nkaina enye enkima o enkalem. Nepuo pokira are aairiamari.

English: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
Masaai: Nejoki Isaak papaai lenye Abraham, “Papaai!” Nejo Abraham “Nele nanu enkayioni ai.” Nejo Isaak, “Ing'ura ajo kiata enkima o lkeek paa koree doi olkuo le ker likintainye olasar opejori?”

English: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
Masaai: Nejo Abraham, “Ekeisho Enkai kewan olkuo le ker lolasar o pejori enkayioni ai.” Kaae nepuo pokira are aairiamari.

English: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.
Masaai: Ore peyie ebau ewueji natuutaka Enkai ninye, neshetu Abraham olperere lo lasar te ine neirragie ilkeek aitobiraki, neen Isaak enkayioni enye, neirragie ninye te wueji o lasar te nchumata oo lkeek.

English: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.
Masaai: Neitorioo Abraham enkaina enye nedumu enkalem nayieng'ie enkayioni enye.

English: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
Masaai: Kake eipoto ninye olmalaika lo Laitoriani eing'uaa keper ejoki, “Abraham! Abraham!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.
Masaai: Nejo, olmalaika, “Minteleiki enkaina ino enkayioni anaa intaas ninye ae, amu atayiolo taata ajo iure Enkai amu atoduaa ajo eitu kimitiki enkayioni ino ina naa ninye ake iata.”

English: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.
Masaai: Neraposhu Abraham inkonyek enyena aing'orisho nedol te siadi ninye olmeregesh otaasha entim imowuarak enyena, nelo Abraham aya ilo meregesh, neitayu ninye aitaa olasar opejori te rishata e nkayioni enye.

English: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovahjireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.
Masaai: Neipot Abraham ine wueji ajo, “Eneishorunye Olaitoriani.” Naa ina arna eeta ine o taata, ore to ldoinyo lo Laitoriani keishoruni.

English: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aipot Abraham enkata e are eing'uaa shumata.

English: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:
Masaai: Nejo, “Ainosa nanu olmumai te nkewan ai ejo Olaitoriani, ore amu itaasa ena neitu imit enkayioni ino aa ninye ake iata,

English: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;
Masaai: ekaamayian iyie oleng', naa kaponaa eishoi ino metotiwuo anaa ilakir le keper netiu sii anaa osinyai le nkiyopata enaiposha. Ore eishoi ino neaku e nenye kishomi oo lmang'ati lenye.

English: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
Masaai: Naa tiatua eishoi ino emayian iloshon le nkop pooki ate, amu itoning'o oltoilo lai.”

English: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
Masaai: Nerrinyokino Abraham ilbarnot lenyena, nedumunye pooki aapuo Beer-sheba. Nebik Abraham te Beer-sheba.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
Masaai: Neaku ore ti oriong kuna baa, etiakaki Abraham, “Ing'ura sii ajo, etoikio Milka olalashe lino Nahor inkera.

English: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,
Masaai: Usi ilo kikau lenye, o Obus olalashe lenye, o Kemuel menye le Aram.

English: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.
Masaai: Keseed, o Haso, o Pildash, o Yidlaf o Betuel.”

English: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham's brother.
Masaai: Neaku Betuel menye le Rebeka. Lelo pokira isiet etoikio Milka olalashe le Abraham Nahor.

English: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, ore ina apiani naji enkarna enye Reuma, etoiwuo Teba, o Gaham, o Tahash, o Maaka.

English: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.
Masaai: Eishua apa Sara ilarin iip o tikitam o naapishana, lelo apa larin le nkishui e Sara.

English: And Sarah died in Kirjatharba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
Masaai: Neye Sara te Keriath-arba (aa ninye Hebron), te nkop e Kanaan. Nelotu Abraham aishiraki to sina Sara, neishir oleng.

English: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham te dukuya ina tang'atang'a enye, nejoki lelo Hiti,

English: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
Masaai: “Ara olomoni o lalotoni tiatua intae, enchooki ewueji tiatua intae metaa ewueji enkurare pee atum atuturoi entang'atang'a ai aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei.”

English: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,
Masaai: Newaliki Ilhiti Abraham aajoki,

English: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.
Masaai: “Toning'o iyiook olkitok lai, ira iyie olkitok magilani tiatua iyiook. Tuturoi entang'atang'a ino te nkurare naba anaa enigelu too nkuraren ang', meetae hoo obo lang Likimitiki enkurare enye anaa kimitiki iturorie entang'atang'a ino.”

English: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
Masaai: Neinyototo Abraham neirrugo te dukuya lelo Hiti oopeny enkop.

English: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Tiniyieuu nanukaa entang'atang'a ai aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, entoning enajo, entoomonokoki te Efron olayioni le Sohar,

English: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
Masaai: peyie aaisho enkapune e Makpela naata to lpijata lo lokeri lenye. Inchoo maaishoo te nkinyang'a enye pooki idolitata metaa ewueji ai oo nkuraren.”

English: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,
Masaai: Neton sii apa ninye Efron tiatua Lhiti. Newaliki Efron ilo Hiti Abraham ening'ito ilhiti o pooki oim kishomi e nkanasa, ajo:

English: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.
Masaai: “A-a, olkitok lai, toning'o enajo, ekaisho olokeri tenebo enkapune natii atua, te dukuya ilayiok pooki lo lorere lai, aaishoo iyie tunukarie entang'atang'a ino.”

English: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.
Masaai: Neirugo Abraham te dukuya olorere le ina kop.

English: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.
Masaai: Nejoki Efron ening'ito olorere le ina kop, “Kake tenaa aikining', aatasayia inchooki matalaa iropiani olokeri, tang'amai elaata te nanu peyie atum atuturoi entang'atang'a ai te ine.”

English: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
Masaai: Newaliki Efron Abraham ajoki,

English: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.
Masaai: “Olkitok lai, toning'oki: amaa eoroti e nkop neimu shekeli iip ong'uan e nkosholai, ainyoo ina te rishata ai o iyie? Tuturoi entang'atang'a ino.”

English: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.
Masaai: Nening'okino Abraham o Efron ina laata. Neikenaki Abraham Efron inkoshola naaipotuo ening'ito Lhiti, shekeli iip ong'uan e nkosholai anaa enkinyiang'a oo lamirak.

English: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure
Masaai: Metaa ore olokeri le Efron otii Makpela natii oloosaen le Mamre olokeri oota enkapune tiatua o lkeek ootii olokeri, enkop pooki,

English: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
Masaai: eishooki Abraham metaa enenye te dukuya Ilhiti, o lelo pooki ooim enkishomi ejing enkanasa.

English: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidipayu ina neturoo Abraham Sara enkitok enye te nkapune olokeri le Makpela natii oloo saen le Mamre (aa ninye Hebron) te nkop oo Lkanaan.

English: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.
Masaai: Ore olokeri tenebo enkapune natii atua eishooitie Lhiti aaisho Abraham metaa ewueji e nkurare oo ltung'ana lenyena.

English: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.
Masaai: Etaa apa Abraham olpayian kitok otobikoyie ilarin kumok oleng', netamayiana Olaitoriani Abraham te pooki toki.

English: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:
Masaai: Nejoki Abraham osinka lenye otobiko oleng te nkaji laa ninye oitasheiki imasaa enyena pooki, “Tipika enkaina ino abori enkupes ai,

English: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:
Masaai: naa kaainosie iyie olmumai to Laitoriani, te Nkai e keper o enkop, inchere miyamaki olayioni lai enkitok too ntoyie oo Lkanaan laa ninche amanya atua.

English: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
Masaai: Kake ilo enkop ai olgelata lai, nirikoki olayioni lai Isaak enkitok.”

English: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
Masaai: Nejoki olaisiaayiani ninye, “Eidimayu metanya enkitok aasuju alotu ena kop, karik olayioni lino arriny ina kop apa ning'uaa?”

English: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
Masaai: Nejoki Abraham ninye, “Toduaa ake mirriny olayioni lai ine.

English: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father's house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e keper laaitayio nanu te nkaji e papaai lai o te nkop apa naatoinyieki, laairorie naainosie olmumai aajoki, ‘Iishoritin inono aisho ena kop.’ Ekeirriwaa olmalaika lenye te dukuya iyie, naa ilo iyie arikoki olayioni lai entito te ine.

English: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.
Masaai: Naa tenemeyieu enkitok nikisuju iyie, nimikintoki olmumai lai aibung': kake mirrinyoki ake olayioni lai ine.”

English: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.
Masaai: Metaa nepik osinka enkaina enye abori enkupes e Abraham olkitok lenye, nenya olmumai tenkaraki ina bae.

English: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.
Masaai: Nereu osinka intamesin tomon olkitok lenye nelo eya nkishorot kumok oo mpukunot pooki to lkitok lenye nedumunye alo Mesopotamia, enkanasa e Nahor.

English: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.
Masaai: Neitigil intamesin kung tiauluo enkanasa te mbata enchorro etaa teipa erishata napuonu inkituaak aaoku enkare.

English: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Oi o Laitoriani Enkai o lkitok lai Abraham, inchooki ena olong dupoto aatoomono iyie, nintodolu enyorrata ino nauno to olkitok lai Abraham.

English: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:
Masaai: Ng'ura, aitashe nanu te mbata enchorro e nkare, ore intoyie oo ltung'ana lena anasa egira aapuku aaipang'u aoku enkare.

English: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.
Masaai: Inchoo metaa ore entito najoki, aatoomono intadou emoti ino matooko enkare, naajoki tooko, naa kaokoki sii intamesin inono inchoo metaa ninye itegelaka osinka lino Isaak. Teina ayiolou ajo intodolua enyorrata nauno to olkitok lai.”

English: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eishu inkirorot, nemaniki Rabeka entito e Betuel olayioni le Milka, enkitok e Nahor olalashe le Abraham elotu eeta emoti to loililai lenye.

English: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.
Masaai: Naa entito sidai oleng tiong'u, eselenkei neitu aikata eyiolou olee, nedoiki enchorro, neigany emoti enye, neilepu.

English: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
Masaai: Nekuet osinka anang'are ninye nejoki, “Aatoomono inchooki enkiti are naok te moti ino.”

English: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tooko olkitok lai”, nesiokisioki aitadou emoti te nkaina enye neisho ninye metooko.

English: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip aishoo ninye metooko, etiaka, Ekaokoki sii intamesin inono o metaba anaa neraposho.”

English: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
Masaai: Metaa eijililiaka emoti enye empeut neipirri arrinyo enchorro aoku omeitaraposho intamesin enyena pooki.

English: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.
Masaai: Neing'or osinka ninye aitirring'a meiro, ajurru tenaa keitudupo Olaitoriani elutunoto enye anaa keitu.

English: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;
