Masaai: Ina peyie eipotu Yakobo ilayiok lenyena nejoki, “Enturrurroto tenebo, pee atum atoliki intae imbaa naatiu too nkolong'i naapuonu.

English: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.
Masaai: Enturrurroto entoning, intae ilayiok le Yakobo, nining'ining'i Israel papaai linyi.

English: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
Masaai: Ruben, ira iyie olkikau lai, engolon ai, naa olng'anayioi le dukuya lai le ngolon ai. Oloituruk lo lwuasa naa oloituruk te ngolon.

English: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.
Masaai: Olemeitirring'a anaa enkare, miaku iyie ololus te pooki, amu itijing'aka endapash e papaai lino; ina peyie isarkionie ninye ishomo endapash ai ainyal.

English: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
Masaai: Ore Simion o Lawi naa ilalashera, ore imasaa enye olarrabal naa ilalema lenye.

English: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
Masaai: Oi oltau lai, milotu ake enkiguana enye; Oi lotau lai, mintaa ninche encholiek. Amu te ngoro enye ear iltung'ana metuata, naa to lwuasa lenye etudung'o errishet o lkiteng.

English: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
Masaai: Metedeki engoro enye, amu kepi ninye; o engoro enye napi, amu ketolo! Ekaor ninche tiatua Yakobo, naidapash ninche tiatua Israel.

English: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.
Masaai: Yuda, aikisis iyie ilalashera linono; Neibung inkaik inono imurto oo lmang'ati linono; ore ilayiok le papaai lino naa keirrugo te dukuya iyie.

English: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
Masaai: Ore Yuda naa ketiu anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny; olotu eing'uaa engorore, enkerai ai ilepa iyie Itadowuo iyie anaa olng'atuny aibung, Anaa elipong olng'atuny, aing'ae oitieu atuputu ninye,

English: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
Masaai: Meing'uaa eng'udi e nkitoria enkaji e Yuda, arashu orinka le nkitoria empolos oo nkejek enyena, ometaba anaa nebaiki ninye olopeny, neaku enenye enkanyit oo iltung'ana pooki.

English: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass's colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
Masaai: Neeniki osikiria lenye olchani lo sabibu, ore olkurrarru lenye neeniki ilo sabibu gelunoti, Neisuj ninye inkilani enyena te naisho oo sabibu, neisuj inkilani enyena too lng'anayio oonyokie anaa osarge.

English: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
Masaai: Ekedoru inkonyek enyena te naisho oo sabibu, Neibor ilala lenyena te okoto e kule,

English: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
Masaai: Ore Sebulon naa kemany embata enaiposha, naa keaku ewueji neitasheyie imelin, Ore olpolosie lenye netii Sidon.

English: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
Masaai: Ore Isaakar naa osikiria ogol, neirrag te rishata oo muatat oo ntare;

English: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
Masaai: Etoduaa ajo ore eneyeng'iyeng'areki naa aisidai, naa ekeitishipisho enkop, metaa eirruguo oloililae lenye anap, neaku orrindik te siaai naarakini.

English: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Ekeiguanare Dan iltung'ana lenyena, anaa obo loo loshon le Israel.

English: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
Masaai: Keaku Dan olasurai te nkoitoi, enturbubua te nkoitoi, ina naony intutuny oo mbartan, ometusulu ilo okedito embarta.

English: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
Masaai: Ekaanyu enjeunoto ino, iyie Olaitoriani.

English: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
Masaai: Kerasaki ilapurrok Gad, kake eibelekenyakino ninye ninche amir ninche.

English: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
Masaai: Ore enkop e Asheri naa keiu endaa sapuk, Naa keitayu ninye endaa nanya olkitok.

English: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
Masaai: Ore Naftali naa enkolii naipirri etalaayioki, neitayu ororei sidai.

English: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
Masaai: Ore Yosef naa olng'osila oiu ilng'anayio, olng'osila loo lng'anayio te nkong'u enkare; eibulaa ilng'osil lenyena esuntai.

English: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
Masaai: Earare ilang'orok loo mbaa ninye te ng'olon, neng'or ninye, neitagor ninye oleng;

English: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)
Masaai: Nemeing'unung'unieki hoo enkawuo enye, neitaariyiani inkaik enyena, inkaik Olmagilani le Yakobo (Te nkarna e ilo Shekut, Endapidapoi e Israel)

English: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
Masaai: Te Nkai e papaai lino laa ninye likiret iyie, Te Nkai Magilani laa ninye likimayian iyie, Too mayianat e keper e shumata. Imayianat oo neegut nairrag tiabori, imayianat oo lki o ene ng'uset.

English: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
Masaai: Ore Imayianat e papaai lino naa Magil aalus too mayianat oo ldoinyo loo ntarasi, Ore nena tokitin sidain naaing'uaa ndoinyo oo ntarasi; metotonie ninche endukuya e Yosef, o emaupe eilo apa otoorori too lalashera lenyena.

English: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
Masaai: Ore Benchamen, naa osuyiani otang'arase, neyooki enasirie aar eng'ues, ore teipa neor iyarunot.”

English: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa iloshon tomon oare le Israel; naa ina apa eitanapa menye pooki emayian ninye ninche, emayianaki pooki ng'ae emayianata naishiaakino ninye.

English: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
Masaai: Ina pee eitanap ninye ninche ejoki ninche, “Ore amu ekalo enetii iltung'ana lainei te keeya; etunukayioki tenebo iloo papa te nkapune natii enkurma e Efron le Hiti.

English: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
Masaai: Ina apune natii enkurma e Makpela, oloo saen le Mamre te nkop e Kanaan, nainyiang'ua apa Abraham tenebo ina kurma e Efron lo Lhiti aitaa enenye nanukarie iltung'ana lenyena.

English: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
Masaai: Teine apa etunukaitie ninche Abraham o Sara enkitok enye naa te ninye sii etunukayioki Isaak o Rebeka enkitok enye; naa teine sii atunukayie Lea.

English: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
Masaai: Ore ina kurma tenebo ina apune natii atua neinyang'uaki apa too Lhiti.”

English: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yakobo aitanapa ilayiok lenyena, nerriny inkejek enyena endapash, neirurayie ina. Nepiki ninye eneiturrurrorre olorere lenye pooki.

English: And Joseph fell upon his father's face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
Masaai: Ina pee ebatatakino Yosef enkomom e menye neishiraki ninye, neng'utut ninye.

English: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.
Masaai: Neitanap Yosef isinkan lenyena lelo kitarrini meitobira osesen le papaai lenye pee mengueyu. Metaa eitobira ilkitarrini osesen le Israel pee mengueyu.

English: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
Masaai: Ewa enkielata inoshi ake olong'i artam naasieki ina siaai e nkitobirata o sesen. Neishiraki Ilmisiri ninye too nkolong'i ntomoni naapishana.

English: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
Masaai: Ore pee eishunye inkolong'i naaishirakinyeki ninye, neirorie Yosef olmarei pooki le Farao ejoki, “Ore taata tenanoto omom too nkonyek inyi eroro, atasayia intae entiaki Farao,

English: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.
Masaai: aainosie apa papa olmumai aajoki, ‘Etaa kaye: te nkurare ai natuturoko kewan te nkop e Kanaan, ninye kinukarierie nanu.’ Metaa ore naa taata nchooki nanu mashomo atasayia ntae, pee alo anukaa papa, pee aitoki ashukunye.”

English: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.
Masaai: Newal Farao ajo, “Shomo, tunukai papaai lino anaa apa enikinosie olmumai.”

English: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
Masaai: Metaa eshomo Yosef anukaa papaai lenye, neiriamarie ninye isinkan pooki le Farao, o lpayiani lo lmarei lenye pooki tenebo ilpayiani pooki le nkop e Misiri.

English: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
Masaai: Tenebo enkaji pooki e menye, o Yosef, o lalashera lenyena, o lmarei pooki le papaai lenye, nkera enye ake etung'uayioki o ntare, o nkishu te nkop e Goshen.

English: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.
Masaai: Metaa eshomo tenebo ninye ingarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan; metaa olorora kitok apa oleng.

English: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau olkurroto oidong'ishoreki te wueji neji Atad natii oloo saen le Yordan, neishir teine olkiyioi sapuk le nkishirita o sina; neitobiraki Yosef enkishirata e papaai lenye too nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abelmizraim, which is beyond Jordan.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Ilkanaani aa ninche iloopeny ina kop enkishirata to lkurroto ooidongishoreki le Atad, nejo ninche, “Ore ena kishirata naa eno sina kitok too Lmisiri.” Metaa eishooki apa ine wueji enkarna aajo Abel-Misraim; naa dukuya e Yordan etii.

English: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
Masaai: Ina apa eitaasa ilayiok lenyena menye anaa enaitanapa ninche;

English: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.
Masaai: amu etanapa apa ilayiok lenyena ninye aaya enkop e Kanaan, nenukaa ninye te nkapune natii enkurma e Makpela, natii oloo saen le Mamre, nainyiang'ua apa Abraham tenebo enkurma e Efron lo Lhiti, metaa ewueji enye oo nkuraren.

English: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atunukai papaai lenye, neshuko Yosef alo Misiri tenebo ilalashera lenyena o lelo pooki oiriamariyie ninye epuo aanukaa papaai lenye.

English: And when Joseph's brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol ilalashera le Yosef aajo etua papaai lenye nejo ninche, “Ebaiki taa neibayu iyiook Yosef neitalak iyiook enapa lap nikintaasa iyiook ninye.”

English: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,
Masaai: Metaa eirriwaitie ninche olkilikuai aairriwaki Yosef ejoki, “Eishorua apa papaai lino ena kitanapata eton eitu eye ejo,

English: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
Masaai: ‘Entiaki Yosef, tapalaki, aatasayia enkitarruorroto oo lalashera linono o engoki enye, amu kintaasa ninche iyie entorroni.’ Ore naa taata, kisai iyie, tapalaki inkitadiaat oo sinkan le Nkai e papaai lino.” Neishir Yosef pee eirorie ninche ninye.

English: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilalashera nebatata te dukuya ninye nejoki, “Ng'ura, aikira iyiook isinkan linono.”

English: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yosef ninche, “Emiureishoyu, katii nanu ewueji e Nkai?

English: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.
Masaai: Ore te intae, naa entorroni apa kiyiewuakiki; kake eitaa ninye Enkai esidai, pee etum aitopuaa iltung'ana kumok anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.
Masaai: Metaa emiureishoyu; kaisho intae eretoto tenebo o nkera inyi.” Neijia eikuna aitisipaki ninche neitagol ninche.

English: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father's house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.
Masaai: Metaa etotona Yosef te Misiri, ninye tenebo olmarei le papaai lenye; nebik Yosef ilarin iip o tomon.

English: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph's knees.
Masaai: Einepua Yosef adol eishoi o layioni lenye Efraim e uni, etodua sii inkera e Makir olayioni le Manase naatoikioki olmarei le Yosef.

English: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
Masaai: Nejoki Yosef ilalashera lenyena, “Etaa kaye, kake kelotu Enkai amutan intae, nelotu aitayu intae aitung'uaa ena kop arik intae enkop nainosakinye Abraham olmumai, o Isaak o Yakobo.”

English: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.
Masaai: Nenya Yosef olmumai too layiok le Israel ejoki, “Kemutan intae Enkai, naa entanap iloik lainei entung'uai ena kop.”

English: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
Masaai: Metaa eirure Yosef, aa oloo larin iip o tomon te moruao; neitobir ninche osesen lenye pee mengueyu, nepiki osesen lenye osanduku te Misiri.

English: Now these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt; every man and his household came with Jacob.
Masaai: Kuna inkarn oo layiok le Yakobo ooetuo apa Misiri te nebo ninye, oltung'ani ake o lmarei lenye:

English: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah,
Masaai: Ruben o Simion o Lawi o Yuda,

English: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin,
Masaai: Isakar o Sebulon o Benchamen,

English: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
Masaai: Dan o Naftali, Gad o Asheri.

English: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.
Masaai: Ore eishoi pooki e Yakobo naa iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana; netii Yosef apa laa obo lenye ina kata Misiri.

English: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
Masaai: Neye Yosef o lalashera lenyena pooki, o ina ishoi pooki.

English: And the children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and waxed exceeding mighty; and the land was filled with them.
Masaai: Kake ore apa eishoi e Israel naa kebul oleng neponari aaku kumok; neponari ninche neaku olosho ogol; neaku ore ina kop ninche oobore.

English: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.
Masaai: Neitokini aaput likae aiguanani te Misiri lemeyiolo Yosef.

English: And he said unto his people, Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana lenyena, “Ng'ura, eikumok oleng iltung'ana loo Siraeli, negol oleng te iyiook.

English: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply, and it come to pass, that, when there falleth out any war, they join also unto our enemies, and fight against us, and so get them up out of the land.
Masaai: Wootu, maing'uraki ninche olosek, pee mebul ake, pee te nelo ake nikitum olarrabal, neibung'are ilmang'ati lang neing'ar iyook paa keisik te nkop.”

English: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens. And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities, Pithom and Raamses.
Masaai: Neaku kepik ilaitasheikinok ooitasheiki ninche pee eisilisil ninche te sinkaisho nagol; neshetaki Farao nkanas naashumishoreki naaji Pisom o Ramases.

English: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and grew. And they were grieved because of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore anaa enaibookini ninche enkop, neponari neidapashakino enkop. Nejing iltung'ana le Misiri enkuretisho too ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:
Masaai: Neaku eisho ninche iltung'ana loo Siraeli meisiaaisho to sina sapuk.

English: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
Masaai: Nepik enkishui enye emion te sinkaisho nagol, te nturoto o too soito, o too mpukunot pooki e siaai ti ong'ata; ore too siaitin enye pooki neisho ninche meisiaaisho te sinkaisho nagol.

English: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani le Misiri ajoki inkaitoyiok oo Lhebrania, aa keji nabo Shifra neji enkae Pua,

English: And he said, When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women, and see them upon the stools; if it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.
Masaai: “Ti nintoishosho nkituaak oo Lhebrania nidolidolo ina kata eisho, tenaa enkayioni niariara ninye metua; kake tenaa entito enchoo eton eishu.”

English: But the midwives feared God, and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the men children alive.
Masaai: Kake keure apa nena aitoyiok Enkai, neitu eas anaa enaitanapa ninche olaiguanani le Misiri, kake eishoo inkayiok etoni eishu.

English: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
Masaai: Metaa eipoto olaiguanani le Misiri nena aitoyiok, nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo pee itaasa ena, ninchosho nkayiok eishu?”

English: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women; for they are lively, and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them.
Masaai: Nejoki nena aitoyiok Farao, “Enkaraki nemetiu nkituaak oo Lhebrania anaa nkituaak oo Lmisiri; amu kegol nkituaak oo Lhebrania oishuaa, naa keisho eton eitu ebau enkaitoyioni.”

English: Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.
Masaai: Neitaas Enkai esidai nena aitoyiok; neponari iltung'ana aagolu neaku kumok oleng.

English: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naure nena aitoyiok Enkai neisho ninche ilmareita.

English: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river, and every daughter ye shall save alive.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aitanap iltung'ana lenyena pooki ajo, “Ore pooki ayioni naini too Lhebrania ninang'akiki olkeju oji Nail, kake enchoo intoyie eishu.”

English: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
Masaai: Nelo oltung'ani obo le nkaji e Lawi ayam entito e Lawi.

English: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
Masaai: Nenutayu ina kitok neiu enkayioni, ore ake pee edol ajo enkerai sidai, neisudoo ninye ilapaitin okuni.

English: And when she could not longer hide him, she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child therein; and she laid it in the flags by the river's brink.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku meekure eisudoroyu, neshetaki ninye enkikapu naitobiraki too seyia nemur te ntoki naji laam; nepik ninye enkerai atua paa kepik ina kikapu atua iseyia te mbata o lkeju.

English: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
Masaai: Neitashe enkanashe enye te nelakua, pee eyiolou enaitaasi ninye.

English: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
Masaai: Ore ina kata ake nelotu entito e Farao adou aisuja to lkeju, nepuonu nkaisiaayiak enyena te mbata o lkeju; nedol ninye enkikapu ti atua iseyia, neirriwaa enkaisiaayiani enye meyau.

English: And when she had opened it, she saw the child: and, behold, the babe wept. And she had compassion on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebol nedol enkerai, dol, eishirita ina looyo. Neing'urrie ninye nejo, “Enoo nkera oo Lhebrania ena.”

English: Then said his sister to Pharaoh's daughter, Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for thee?
Masaai: Nejoki enkanashe eina looyo enye entito e Farao, “Aalo aipotoki enkaibung'ani too nkituaak oo Lhebrania pee kintubulaki ena kerai?”

English: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the maid went and called the child's mother.
Masaai: Nejoki entito e Farao ninye, “Shomo.” Nelo entito aipotu ng'otonye ina kerai.

English: And Pharaoh's daughter said unto her, Take this child away, and nurse it for me, and I will give thee thy wages. And the woman took the child, and nursed it.
Masaai: Nejoki entito e Farao ninye, “Iwa ina kerai, pee kintubulaki nanu, naa kaaisho nanu olekoisiaayio lino.” Neya ina kitok enkerai aitubulu.

English: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
Masaai: Nebulu ina kerai, neyau ninye ayaki entito e Farao, neaku ninye olayioni lenye, neipot enkarna enye ajo Musa, amu etejo, “Te nkaraki naitayio ninye ti atua ina are.”

English: And it came to pass in those days, when Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens: and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong, etubulua Musa, neipang alo enetii iltung'ana lenyena nedol enkiroishi e siaai nagol naasita. Neitoki adol Olmisiri earita Iheburaniai, obo loo ltung'ana lenyena.

English: And he looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.
Masaai: Neing'oring'orisho, ore ake pee edol ajo melio oltung'ani hoo obo, near ninye ilo Misiri metua nenukaa ti atua osinyai.

English: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
Masaai: Ore pee eitoki aipang likae kekun, ng'ura Ilhebrania aare oopupung'a; nejoki ninye ilo tung'ani oitarruoyie, “Kainyoo pee iar oltung'ani lo lorere lino?”

English: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Kaing'ae likintaa iyie olkitok o larishani te iyiook? Ijo pee kiar nanu matua anaa enitaara Olmisiri metua?” Neirut Musa, nejo, “Esipa etayioloki ena bae.”

English: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to slay Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian: and he sat down by a well.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Farao ina, neing'oru pee ear Musa metua. Kake eisika Musa ailany Farao, nebik te nkop e Midian neton te mbata e nchorro.

English: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father's flock.
Masaai: Etii apa olapolosani le Midian oota isilan naapishana, nepuonu aaoku enkare neiput impeuti pee eitook ntare e menye.

English: And the shepherds came and drove them away: but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.
Masaai: nepuonu ilairritak loontare aaraa ninche, kake eitasho Musa aretu ninche, neitook ntare enye.

English: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enetii menye lenye Reul, nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaji taata eikununo pee ietuo aasieku?”

English: And they said, An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and also drew water enough for us, and watered the flock.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Olmisiri oitajeuo iyiook too nkaik oo lchekuti o metooku ninye enkare neitook ntare.”

English: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye nena silan enyena, “Paa kaji etii ninye? Kainyoo pee itung'uaitie ilo tung'ani? Empoto ninye pee elotu ainos endaa.”

English: And Moses was content to dwell with the man: and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter.
Masaai: Nenyorraa Musa aton te nebo ilo tung'ani, neisho ninye Musa entito enye naji Sipora.

English: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Gershom: for he said, I have been a stranger in a strange land.
Masaai: Neiki ninye enkayioni, nejo ninye enkarna enye Gershom, amu etejo ninye, “Ara olomoni te nkop neme enaai.”

English: And it came to pass in process of time, that the king of Egypt died: and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie ilarin ooikash, neye ilo aiguanani le Misiri. Neton ake eisomita iltung'ana loo Siraeli te sinkaisho enye, neyietu aaishiru eretoto; ore ilo kiyioi lenye le sinkaisho neilep enetii Enkai.

English: And God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.
Masaai: Nening Enkai ilo somit lenye, nedamu Enkai olning'o lenye lo sotua o Abraham o Isaak, o tenebo Yakobo.

English: And God looked upon the children of Israel, and God had respect unto them.
Masaai: Nedol Enkai iltungana le Israel, neyiolou Enkai empukunoto enye.

English: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb.
Masaai: Eing'orita apa Musa ntare o laputani lenye oji Yesro, laa olapolosani le Midian, nerikoo eluaata enye aipirie enkalo o loontoluo le Midian, nelotu ewueji neji Horeb ilo doinyo le Nkai.

English: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
Masaai: Neipang'aki ninye olmalaika le Nkai to lng'ejep le nkima opuku te mpolos o sanag, neing'or, naa ng'ura, eyupuyupito osanag, neitu emut enkima.

English: And Moses said, I will now turn aside, and see this great sight, why the bush is not burnt.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Ekaibelekenya aing'or ena pukunoto e nking'asia kitok, inchere kainyoo pee eitu enya enkima ilo sanag.”

English: And when the LORD saw that he turned aside to see, God called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Olaitoriani ajo eibelekenye aing'or, neipot Enkai ninye ti atua empolos o sanag, nejo, “Musa, Musa!” Nejo ninye, “Nele nanu.”

English: And he said, Draw not nigh hither: put off thy shoes from off thy feet, for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki, “Milotu anyiku, intayu inamuka inono too nkejek inono, amu ore ine wueji nintasheyie naa ewueji nesinya.”

English: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
Masaai: Neitoki ajo, “Ara nanu Enkai e papa lino, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isak o Enkai e Yakobo.” Neisudoo Musa enkomom enye amu keure aing'ura Enkai.

English: And the LORD said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Atoduaa osomit loo ltung'ana laainei ootii Misiri, natoning'o olkiyioi lenye te nkaraki ilaitasheikinok lenye; ayiolo olosilisili lenye,

English: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey; unto the place of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
Masaai: naewuo nanu adou pee aitajeu ninche metupuku aing'uaa enkaina oo ltung'ana le Misiri, nayau ailepunye ninche metupuku aing'uaa ina kop nepuonu enkop sidai nalala naruko inaishi o kule, aapuo ewueji oo Lkanaani, o Lhiti, Ilamori, Ilperesi, Ilhifi o Lyebusi.

English: Now therefore, behold, the cry of the children of Israel is come unto me: and I have also seen the oppression wherewith the Egyptians oppress them.
Masaai: Ore taata, ng'ura eewuo olkiyioi loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli enatii, natodua enkibookinoto e nkop naibookito iltung'ana le Misiri ninche.

English: Come now therefore, and I will send thee unto Pharaoh, that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt.
Masaai: Wou, amu kaairriwaa nanu iyie enetii Farao, pee itum ashomo aitayu iltung'ana laainei, lelo ayiok loo Siraeli, metupuku aing'uaa Misiri.”

English: And Moses said unto God, Who am I, that I should go unto Pharaoh, and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Musa Enkai, “Kara nanu ng'ae olo enetii Farao, nayau ilayiok loo Siraeli aaitung'uaa Misiri?”

English: And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this shall be a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ekaaku te nebo iyie, naa ena nalo aaku olmonekie te iyie, nchere aairriwayie: ore ake pee indip aitupuku iltung'ana aitung'uai Misiri naa ipuonunu aaisiaai Enkai tele doinyo.”

English: And Moses said unto God, Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki Enkai, “Amaa te nalotu enetii iltung'ana loo Siraeli najoki ninche ‘Aairriwua nanu Enkai oo loo papaai linyi maeu enitii ntae’; naaikilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Keji ng'ae enkarna enye?’ kaa ajoki ninche?”

English: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM: and he said, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Musa, “ARA NANU ILO ORA.” Neitoki ajo, “Tiaaki ena iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘ARA NANU laairriwua nanu enitii.’ ”

English: And God said moreover unto Moses, Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath sent me unto you: this is my name for ever, and this is my memorial unto all generations.
Masaai: Neitoki Enkai ajoki Musa, “Tiaaki ena iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isaak o Enkai e Yakobo naairriwua nanu enitii’ ena enkarna ai ntarasi, naa ninye aadamunye iishoritin pooki.

English: Go, and gather the elders of Israel together, and say unto them, The LORD God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, appeared unto me, saying, I have surely visited you, and seen that which is done to you in Egypt:
Masaai: Shomo inturrurro ilpayiani loo Siraeli te nebo, nijoki ninche, ‘Aaipang'aka nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi Enkai e Abraham, o ene Isaak, o ene Yakobo, ejo, “Atisipua intae o ina naitaasaki intae te Misiri;

English: And I have said, I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt unto the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, unto a land flowing with milk and honey.
Masaai: naa kamut nchere kayau intae ailepunye aaitung'uaa osina le Misiri, aapuonu enkop o Lkanaani, Ilhiti, Ilamori, Ilperesi, Ilhifi te nebo o Lyebusi, enkop naruko kule o naishi.” ’

English: And they shall hearken to thy voice: and thou shalt come, thou and the elders of Israel, unto the king of Egypt, and ye shall say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath met with us: and now let us go, we beseech thee, three days' journey into the wilderness, that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God.
Masaai: Naa kenyoraa ninche ina nijoki; nilo iyie o lpayiani loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani le Misiri nijokiki ninye, ‘Enotore iyiook Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lhebrania; ore taata nikiomon iyie, nchoo iyiook maape nkolong'i uni ong'ata, pee kitum aatopolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’

English: And I am sure that the king of Egypt will not let you go, no, not by a mighty hand.
Masaai: Ayiolo ajo meisho ntae olaiguanani le Misiri ipuopuo meteleku ake te nkaraki enkaina naata enkidimata naas ti atua ninye; ore te siadi ina niyaya karsisisho e Misiri.

English: And I will stretch out my hand, and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof: and after that he will let you go.
Masaai: Metaa kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aosh Misiri too mbaa pooki e nkingasia nalo nanu aas teine, ore te siadi ina naa kaisho intae enchom.

English: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians: and it shall come to pass, that, when ye go, ye shall not go empty:
Masaai: Naa kaisho nanu kulo tungana omom too nkonyek oo Lmisiri, naa ore tenipuopuo, nimipuopuo too nkaik naarook.

English: But every woman shall borrow of her neighbour, and of her that sojourneth in her house, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment: and ye shall put them upon your sons, and upon your daughters; and ye shall spoil the Egyptians.
Masaai: Kake ore pooki kitok neomon ene latia enye, oina naboitare tiaji, imasaa e nkosholai o sahabu, o nkilani, nipik ninche ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono, ore teina niyaya karsisisho e Misiri.”

English: And Moses answered and said, But, behold, they will not believe me, nor hearken unto my voice: for they will say, The LORD hath not appeared unto thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa awalu, nejo, “Ng'ura, maairuk ninche nanu aashu ening enajoki, amu kejo ninche, ‘Eitu kimpang'aki iyie Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: And the LORD said unto him, What is that in thine hand? And he said, A rod.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Kainyoo ina nimbung'ita te nkaina?” Nejoki ninye, “Eng'udi.”

English: And he said, Cast it on the ground. And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent; and Moses fled from before it.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Tanang'aki enkop.” Nenang'aki enkop, neaku ina ng'udi olasurai; neipirri Musa ailany.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Put forth thine hand, and take it by the tail. And he put forth his hand, and caught it, and it became a rod in his hand:
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino mbung'a olkidong'oe.” Neitorioo enkaina enye neibung, neitoki aaku eng'udi te nkaina enye.

English: That they may believe that the LORD God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, hath appeared unto thee.
Masaai: “Pee etum aairuko nchere Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, Enkai e Abraham, Enkai e Isaak o Enkai e Yakobo nikimpang'aka iyie.”

English: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tipika enkaina ino olgoo lino.” Nepik ninye enkaina enye olgoo lenye; ore pee eitayu, ng'ura, etijing'a enkaina enye enkeeya oo lbolot, neibor anaa enturoto.

English: And he said, Put thine hand into thy bosom again. And he put his hand into his bosom again; and plucked it out of his bosom, and, behold, it was turned again as his other flesh.
Masaai: Neitoki Enkai ajo, “Nyaaki tipika enkaina ino atua olgoo lino.” Neitoki ninye apik enkaina enye atua olgoo lenye; ore ake pee eitayu, ng'ura eitotiwuoki anaa osesen lenye pooki.

English: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe thee, neither hearken to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.
Masaai: Nejo Enkai, “Naa ti nimikiruk ninche, arashu te nemenyorraa enkitoduaata e dukuya, neidim ninche aairuko ina kitoduaata e are.

English: And it shall come to pass, if they will not believe also these two signs, neither hearken unto thy voice, that thou shalt take of the water of the river, and pour it upon the dry land: and the water which thou takest out of the river shall become blood upon the dry land.
Masaai: Ore pe meiruk ninche ebaiki nena kitoduaat pokira arashu ening enijoki, niya iyie enkare to lkeju le Nail nilo abukoki enkop natoyio; ore ina are nilo aya to lkeju le Nail naa keaku osarge ti oriong enkop natoyio.”

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, O my Lord, I am not eloquent, neither heretofore, nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant: but I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Musa Olaitoriani, “Olaitoriani lai, mara nanu oltung'ani arriyia te nkiguana, arashu ebaiki ena kata pee irorie osinka lino; kake kaimalees te nkiroroto na kaasha sii olng'ejep.”

English: And the LORD said unto him, Who hath made man's mouth? or who maketh the dumb, or deaf, or the seeing, or the blind? have not I the LORD?
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki ninye, “Kaing'ae oitobira enkutuk e tung'ani oitiming'an te nkiroroto o te ning'oto, aashu oitodolisho aashu aitamodok? Aime nanu, Olaitoriani ake?

English: Now therefore go, and I will be with thy mouth, and teach thee what thou shalt say.
Masaai: Shomo naa taata, naa kaaku nanu te nebo enkutuk ino naaitayiolo enijo.”

English: And he said, O my Lord, send, I pray thee, by the hand of him whom thou wilt send.
Masaai: Kake etiaka ninye, “Oi, Olaitoriani lai, aatoomono, irriwai likae tung'ani.”

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Moses, and he said, Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother? I know that he can speak well. And also, behold, he cometh forth to meet thee: and when he seeth thee, he will be glad in his heart.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro e Nkai te nkaraki Musa neitoki ajo, “Aimetii Aron ilo alashe lino loo Lawi? Ayiolo ajo keidim airoro aituana naa ng'ura, elotu ninye pee kinang'are, naa ore pee kidol ninye neshipayu to ltau lenye.

English: And thou shalt speak unto him, and put words in his mouth: and I will be with thy mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what ye shall do.
Masaai: Nirorie iyie ninye nipik irorei enkutuk enye, naa kaitaarriyian nanu enkutuk ino o enkutuk enye naaitayiolo iyie eniaas.

English: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people: and he shall be, even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth, and thou shalt be to him instead of God.
Masaai: Keirorie ninye iltung'ana te rishata ino, neaku ninye enkutuk te iyie, nitiu te ninye anaa Enkai.

English: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.
Masaai: Naa iya te nkaina ino ena ng'udi, naa ninye iasie nkitoduaat.

English: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law, and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Musa alo ashuko enetii Yesero olaputani lenye, nejoki ninye, “Aatoomono, nchooki nanu mashomo ashuko, pee ashukokino iltung'ana lang ootii Misiri pee adol tenaa keton eishu.” Nejoki Yesero Musa, “Shomo te seriani.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses in Midian, Go, return into Egypt: for all the men are dead which sought thy life.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa te Midian, “Shomo tushukoyu Misiri; amu ore iltung'ana pooki apa ooing'oru enkishui ino netuata.”

English: And Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them upon an ass, and he returned to the land of Egypt: and Moses took the rod of God in his hand.
Masaai: Nedumu Musa enkitok enye o layiok lenyena nepik osikiria, nelo ashuko enkop e Misiri; naa ore te nkaina enye neya Musa eng'udi e Nkai.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, When thou goest to return into Egypt, see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh, which I have put in thine hand: but I will harden his heart, that he shall not let the people go.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore irrinyo alo Misiri, toduaa nchere itaasa te dukuya Farao nena pooki enking'asia natipika nanu engolon ina kake kaitagol nanu oltau lenye, pee meisho ninye iltung'ana meshomo.

English: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD, Israel is my son, even my firstborn:
Masaai: Naa ilo ajoki Farao, ‘Etejo Olaitoriani inchere, ore Israel naa olkikau lai,

English: And I say unto thee, Let my son go, that he may serve me: and if thou refuse to let him go, behold, I will slay thy son, even thy firstborn.
Masaai: naajoki naa iyie, “Nchoo olayioni lai elo pee aatum aisiaayia nanu.” Ti nimitiki ninye elo naar nanu ilo kikau lino metua.’ ”

English: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
Masaai: Ore te ine wueji neirraga te nkoitoi nenang'are Olaitoriani ninye nejo aar ninye metua.

English: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet, and said, Surely a bloody husband art thou to me.
Masaai: Neitayu Sipora olmurunya nedung'u isuaaten oo layiok lenyena amurat paa keelie nkejek e Musa, nejo,

English: So he let him go: then she said, A bloody husband thou art, because of the circumcision.
Masaai: “Esipa ira olayamisho lo sarge te nkaraki emuratare.”

English: And the LORD said to Aaron, Go into the wilderness to meet Moses. And he went, and met him in the mount of God, and kissed him.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Aron, “Shomo ong'ata tanang'are Musa.” Nelo ninye nenang'are ninye to ldoinyo le Nkai neng'utut ninye.

English: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the LORD who had sent him, and all the signs which he had commanded him.
Masaai: Neliki Musa Aron irorei pooki lo Laitoriani laa ninche eirriunye ninye, o nkitoduaat pooki naaitanapa ninye metaasa.

English: And Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel:
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Aron aaiturrur te nebo ilpayiani loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And Aaron spake all the words which the LORD had spoken unto Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
Masaai: Neliki Aron ninche irorei pooki ootiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, neas nkitoduaat te dukuya iltung'ana.

English: And the people believed: and when they heard that the LORD had visited the children of Israel, and that he had looked upon their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshipped.
Masaai: Neiruk iltung'ana; ore ake pee ening nchere etumutana Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli netoduaa osina lenye, neirrug ninche ilukuny enye aaserem.

English: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nelo Musa o Aron enetii Farao nejoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, pee aatum aaitaiki osirua ti ong'ata.’ ”

English: And Pharaoh said, Who is the LORD, that I should obey his voice to let Israel go? I know not the LORD, neither will I let Israel go.
Masaai: Kake etejo Farao, “Kaing'ae Olaitoriani, laidim nanu atoning'o oltoilo lenye naisho Isiraeli epuo.”

English: And they said, The God of the Hebrews hath met with us: let us go, we pray thee, three days' journey into the desert, and sacrifice unto the LORD our God; lest he fall upon us with pestilence, or with the sword.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Enotore iyiook Enkai oo Lhebrania; nchoo iyiook maape, kitoomono iyie, maape elototo oo nkolong'i uni ti ong'ata pee kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai, mear ake iyiook to lmeitai aashu to lalem.”

English: And the king of Egypt said unto them, Wherefore do ye, Moses and Aaron, let the people from their works? get you unto your burdens.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche olaiguanani le Misiri, “Musa o Aron, kainyoo pee iyaya iltung'ana aaitung'uaa esiaai enye? Entorrinyoto enchom isiaaitin inyi.”

English: And Pharaoh said, Behold, the people of the land now are many, and ye make them rest from their burdens.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao ajo, “Ng'ura, ajo aikumok taata kulo tung'ana tena kop niyeng'iyeng'ie iyie ninche too siaitin enye!”

English: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
Masaai: Ore te ina olong ake neitanap Farao ilaitasheikinok le siaai o lkituaak le siai,

English: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
Masaai: “Mintokiki ae kata aaisho iltung'ana olkujita oitayunye ilmatofali anaa oshi eninkoko; enchoo ninche epuo aasotu olkujita maate.

English: And the tale of the bricks, which they did make heretofore, ye shall lay upon them; ye shall not diminish ought thereof: for they be idle; therefore they cry, saying, Let us go and sacrifice to our God.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lmatofali apa naitayu enchoo eaku lelo ake, emintong'oriki ninche, amu aiturua ninche; neaku keishir, ‘Nchoo iyiook maape aaitaiki Enkai ang olasar.’

English: Let there more work be laid upon the men, that they may labour therein; and let them not regard vain words.
Masaai: Nchoo esiaai nagol oleng eiteeki iltung'ana, pee etum aataasisho nemeitoki aainining lelo rorei le lejare.”

English: And the taskmasters of the people went out, and their officers, and they spake to the people, saying, Thus saith Pharaoh, I will not give you straw.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo lelo aitasheikinok o ilkituaak le siaai nejoki iltung'ana, “Ejo Farao nji, ‘Maisho nanu ntae olkujita.

English: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
Masaai: Enchom maate, eyau olkujita linyi te wueji neba anaa enitumiemie; kake ore esiaai meitong'ori hoo ninye peno.’ ”

English: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw.
Masaai: Neidapashakino iltung'ana enkop pooki e Misiri aasotu suut aaitaa olkujita.

English: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
Masaai: Netem apa lelo aitasheikinok aarrumoki ninche esiaai, ejoki, “Entabai esiaai inyi, e anaake, anaa apa eetae olkujita.”

English: And the officers of the children of Israel, which Pharaoh's taskmasters had set over them, were beaten, and demanded, Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day, as heretofore?
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, laa ninche etipika ilaitasheikinok le Farao meitasheiki ninche, neari, neikilikuani aajoki, “Kainyoo pee eitu iasiasa esiaai inyi aaitobir ilmatofali taata anaa apa?”

English: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh, saying, Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants?
Masaai: Nepuonu lelo kituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli aaishiraki Farao, “Kainyoo pee intaas iyiook, isinkan linono, ena?

English: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
Masaai: Meetae olkujita ooishooki isinkan linono, ore ake eyia, nejoki ninche iyiook, ‘Entobira ilmatofali!’ Naa ng'ura earitae isinkan linono, kake ore enkitarruoroto netii atua iltung'ana linono ake.”

English: But he said, Ye are idle, ye are idle: therefore ye say, Let us go and do sacrifice to the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Irara turua, irara turua, neaku ijojo, ‘Nchoo iyiook maape aapolosaki Olaitoriani.’

English: Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.
Masaai: Enchom taata, naa entaasisho; amu meetae olkujita oishori intae, ore ake eyia, niyauu enoshi ake siana oo lmatofali.”

English: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.
Masaai: Nedol ilkituaak loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli aajo etii ninche erishata torrono, ina kata pee ejo ninche, “Meitong'ori hoo ninye peno esiana oo lmatofali linyi lintayuyu anaake.”

English: And they met Moses and Aaron, who stood in the way, as they came forth from Pharaoh:
Masaai: Netumore ninche Musa o Aron, eanyita apa ninche, epuku aaing'ua enetii Farao.

English: And they said unto them, The LORD look upon you, and judge; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of his servants, to put a sword in their hand to slay us.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Nchoo eing'or ntae Olaitoriani neiguanare, amu intaa ntae iyiook ilarruok te dukuya Farao o laisiaayiak lenyena, nitipika olalem enkaina enye pee ear iyiook matuata.”

English: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Lord, wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people? why is it that thou hast sent me?
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aibelekenyakino Olaitoriani nejo, “Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee kintasima airriu nanu?

English: For since I came to Pharaoh to speak in thy name, he hath done evil to this people; neither hast thou delivered thy people at all.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa nalotu enetii Farao airo te nkarna ino, neitaasa ninye ntorrok kulo tung'ana, neitu iyie intajeu iltung'ana linono tukul.

English: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh: for with a strong hand shall he let them go, and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Idol taata iyie ina naitaas Farao; amu te nkaina nagol eisho ninche meshomo, ee te nkaina nagol earaa ninche meshomo aaing'uaa enkop enye.”

English: And God spake unto Moses, and said unto him, I am the LORD:
Masaai: Neitoki Enkai ajoki Musa, “Ara Olaitoriani.

English: And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, by the name of God Almighty, but by my name JEHOVAH was I not known to them.
Masaai: Aipang'aka apa Abraham, o Isaak, o Yakobo anaa Enkai Magilani, kake ore te nkarna ai naji Olaitoriani eitu aitayiolo ninche.

English: And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.
Masaai: Aitobirua sii osotua lai o ninche, pee aisho ninche enkop e Kanaan, enkop apa natobikie aa lomon.

English: And I have also heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage; and I have remembered my covenant.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia natoning'o osina loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli ooitaa Lmisiri isinkan natadamua naa ilo ning'o lai.

English: Wherefore say unto the children of Israel, I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians, and I will rid you out of their bondage, and I will redeem you with a stretched out arm, and with great judgments:
Masaai: Tiaaki naa iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Ara nanu Olaitoriani, naa kayau nanu ntae aitung'uaa esinkaisho enye, naa kalaku nanu ntae te nkaina naitoriori o too nkiasin sapuki e nkiguana.

English: And I will take you to me for a people, and I will be to you a God: and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God, which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians.
Masaai: Naya nanu ntae aitaa iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai inyi, naa iyiolouu ntae aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa ninye nayaua ntae aitung'uaa abori ilolan le sinkaisho oo Lmisiri.

English: And I will bring you in unto the land, concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it you for an heritage: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kayau nanu ntae atua enkop apa nainosa olmumai ajo kaisho Abraham, o Isaak, o Yakobo; kaisho nanu ntae metaa eninyi enkorrok. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel: but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit, and for cruel bondage.
Masaai: Neliki Musa iltung'ana loo Siraeli nena, kake eitu ninche ening Musa nkaraki iltauja lenye oitingo osiligi te sinkaisho enye eng'ogong'i.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Go in, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, that he let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Masaai: “Shomo tijing'aki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, tiaaki meishoo iltung'ana loo Siraeli meipang'a aapuo te nkop enye.”

English: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, eitu ninche aaning nanu iltung'ana loo Siraeli; kaji naa eiko te naaning nanu Farao, nara oltung'ani leme arriyia te nkiroroto?”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel, and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake eirorie Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, neisho ninche enkitanapata nayaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli o Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, pee eriku iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
Masaai: Kuna ninche lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye: ilayiok le Ruben, olkikau le Israel; Hanok, Palu, Hesron, o Karmi, kulo ninche ilmareita le Ruben.

English: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman: these are the families of Simeon.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Simion: Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Sohar, o Shaul, olayioni le nkitok oo Lkanaani; kulo ninche ilmareita le Simion.

English: And these are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari: and the years of the life of Levi were an hundred thirty and seven years.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Lawi te risioroto oo ishoritin enye: Gershon, Kohas, o Merari, ore larin le nkishui e Lawi naa ilarin iip o tomoni uni o oopishana.

English: The sons of Gershon; Libni, and Shimi, according to their families.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Geshom: Libni o Shimei, too lmareita lenye.

English: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel: and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Kohas: Amram, Ishar, Hebron o Usiel, era ilarin le nkishui e Kohas iip o tomoni uni o okuni.

English: And the sons of Merari; Mahali and Mushi: these are the families of Levi according to their generations.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Merari: Mahali o Mushi. Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Lawi te risioroto oo ishoritin enye.

English: And Amram took him Jochebed his father's sister to wife; and she bare him Aaron and Moses: and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years.
Masaai: Ewa Amram Yokobet ayam enkanashe e menye neiki ninye Aron o Musa, era ilarin le nkishui e Amram iip o tomoni uni o oopishana.

English: And the sons of Izhar; Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Ishar: Kora, Nefeg o Sichri.

English: And the sons of Uzziel; Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.
Masaai: O layiok le Usiel: Mishael, Elsafan o Sisri.

English: And Aaron took him Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab, sister of Naashon, to wife; and she bare him Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Neya Aron ayam Elisheba, entito e Aminadab naa enkanashe e Nashon; neiki ninye Nadab o Abihu o Eliesa te nebo Isamar.

English: And the sons of Korah; Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korhites.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kora naa Alir o Elkana te nebo Abiasaf; kulo ninche ilmareita loo Lkorati.

English: And Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife; and she bare him Phinehas: these are the heads of the fathers of the Levites according to their families.
Masaai: Neya Eliesa, olayioni le Aron, ayam entito nabo oo ntoyie e Putiel; neiki ninye Finihas. Kuna ninche lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo Lawi too lmareita lenye.

English: These are that Aaron and Moses, to whom the LORD said, Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.
Masaai: Kulo lelo, Aron o Musa, laa ninche etiaka Olaitoriani, “Entayu iltung'ana loo Siraeli metupuku aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri too lororani lenye.”

English: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt: these are that Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Ninche apa ooirorie Farao olaiguanani le Misiri eimaki enkitayunoto oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli metung'uai Misiri, kulo lelo Musa o Aron.

English: And it came to pass on the day when the LORD spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt,
Masaai: Ore te ina olong neirorie Olaitoriani Musa te nkop e Misiri,

English: That the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, I am the LORD: speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee.
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ara nanu Olaitoriani; tiaaki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nena pooki naatiaka.”

English: And Moses said before the LORD, Behold, I am of uncircumcised lips, and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, ara nanu oleme arriyia te nkiroroto, kaji naa eiko Farao te naaning?”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, See, I have made thee a god to Pharaoh: and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Toduaaki maaitotiu anaa Enkai te Farao neaku Aron olalashe lino oloiboni lino.

English: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee: and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh, that he send the children of Israel out of his land.
Masaai: Ilo iyie airo nena pooki naaitanapa; ore Aron olalashe lino nejoki Farao meishoo iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo aaing'uaa enkop enye.

English: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and multiply my signs and my wonders in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake kaitagol oltau le Farao, naa ore hoo tenaponaa nkitoduaat aainei o mbaa e nking'asia te nkop e Misiri,

English: But Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you, that I may lay my hand upon Egypt, and bring forth mine armies, and my people the children of Israel, out of the land of Egypt by great judgments.
Masaai: mikining iyie Farao; naitoki nanu aiteleiki enkaina ai shumata Misiri naitayu olorora lai, iltung'ana laainei lelo ayiok loo Siraeli, metupuku aaing'uaa Misiri too nkiasin sapuki e nkiguana.

English: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt, and bring out the children of Israel from among them.
Masaai: Neyiolou Ilmisiri aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani te naitorioo enkaina ai te shumata Misiri naitayu iltung'ana loo Siraeli metupuku ti atua ninche.”

English: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Aron ina, neas anaa enaitanapa ninche Olaitoriani.

English: And Moses was fourscore years old, and Aaron fourscore and three years old, when they spake unto Pharaoh.
Masaai: Ore Musa naa oloo larin ntomoni isiet ore Aron naa oloo larin ntomoni isiet o okuni ina kata pee eirorie ninche Farao.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent.
Masaai: “Enchoo ake pee ejoki ntae Farao, ‘Entisipa ate te asata o lbulabuli,’ nijoki Aron, ‘Tudumu ina ng'udi ino tanang'aki enkop te dukuya Farao, pee etum ataa olasurai.’ ”

English: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh, and they did so as the LORD had commanded: and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh, and before his servants, and it became a serpent.
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Aron enetii Farao neas anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; nenang'aki Aron ina ng'udi enye enkop te dukuya Farao o sinkan lenyena, neaku ina ng'udi olasurai.

English: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
Masaai: Neipot Farao ilang'eni lenyena o lasakutok; ore sii ninche, lelo ang'eni le tung'ana le Misiri, neas ina te sakutore enye.

English: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
Masaai: Amu etanang'aka pooki tung'ani eng'udi enye enkop, neaku ilasuriaa. Kake etoijoyie eng'udi e Aron ing'udisin enye.

English: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Neton ake eitagoloki oltau le Farao, nemening ninye ninche anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh's heart is hardened, he refuseth to let the people go.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Eitagoloki oltau le Farao, pee meisho ninye iltung'ana meshomo.

English: Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning; lo, he goeth out unto the water; and thou shalt stand by the river's brink against he come; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand.
Masaai: Shomo enetii Farao tadekenya, ina kata elo enkare; taanyu ninye te ngilata o lkeju niya iyie te nkaina ino ina ng'udi apa naibelekenya aaku olasurai.

English: And thou shalt say unto him, The LORD God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee, saying, Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness: and, behold, hitherto thou wouldest not hear.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie ninye, ‘Airriwua nanu Olaitoriani enitii, Enkai o Lhebrania ejo, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, pee aatum aaisiaayia ti ong'ata; naa ng'ura, eton ake eitu iruk.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, In this thou shalt know that I am the LORD: behold, I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river, and they shall be turned to blood.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Tena iyie iyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani: ng'ura, ekaosh nanu enkare natii atua olkeju le Nail tena ng'udi naata te nkaina ai, naa keibelekenya aaku osarge.

English: And the fish that is in the river shall die, and the river shall stink; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river.
Masaai: Neye isinkir ootii atua olkeju le Nail neng'ueyu ilo keju le Nail.” ’ ”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt, upon their streams, upon their rivers, and upon their ponds, and upon all their pools of water, that they may become blood; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt, both in vessels of wood, and in vessels of stone.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Tudumu eng'udi ino nintorioo enkaina ino ti oriong nkariak e Misiri, ti oriong ilkejek lenye, o erat lenye, o mugurri enye o lchorroi lenye, pooki loo nkariak, pee etum aataa osarge, neaku osarge te nkop pooki e Misiri too oketa oo nkeek o too oketa oo soito.’ ”

English: And Moses and Aaron did so, as the LORD commanded; and he lifted up the rod, and smote the waters that were in the river, in the sight of Pharaoh, and in the sight of his servants; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Aron anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; ore te dukuya Farao o te dukuya ilaisiaayiak lenyena, neilepie ninye eng'udi neosh ina are apa natii atua olkeju le Nail; ore ina are pooki apa natii atua olkeju le Nail newala ina are pooki apa natii atua olkeju le Nail aaku osarge.

English: And the fish that was in the river died; and the river stank, and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neye isinkir ootii atua olkeju le Nail; neng'ueyu olkeju le Nail o metaa meidim Ilmisiri aatook enkare naing'uaa olkeju le Nail; neaku osarge te nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, neither did he hearken unto them; as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Kake etaasa sii ninche ilasakutok le Misiri ina te sakutore enye; neton ake egol oltau le Farao, nemening ninye ninche anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.

English: And Pharaoh turned and went into his house, neither did he set his heart to this also.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Farao nelo atua enkaji enye, neitu duoo ninye epik ena oltau ashilaa.

English: And all the Egyptians digged round about the river for water to drink; for they could not drink of the water of the river.
Masaai: Netur Ilmisiri pooki mbat o lkeju le Nail aaing'oru enkare naok, amu meidim aatook enkare e ilo keju le Nail.

English: And seven days were fulfilled, after that the LORD had smitten the river.
Masaai: Nelusoo nkolong'i naapishana anaa pee eosh Olaitoriani olkeju le Nail.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Go unto Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Shomo tijing'aki Farao nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo peyie aatum aaisiaayia.

English: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
Masaai: Kake ti niany iyie incho ninche epuo, ng'ura naar enkop ino pooki too ntuaan.

English: And the river shall bring forth frogs abundantly, which shall go up and come into thine house, and into thy bedchamber, and upon thy bed, and into the house of thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thine ovens, and into thy kneadingtroughs:
Masaai: Neboreyu olkeju le Nail te nena tuaan naapuonu tiatua enkaji ino, o atua olgilata lino oirragi o enchumata endapash ino, o atua nkajijik oo laisiaayiak linono o noo ltung'ana linono, o ine wueji neyierishoreki o ngirran inono naaipurjishoreki.

English: And the frogs shall come up both on thee, and upon thy people, and upon all thy servants.
Masaai: Eikipuonu nena tuaan aaked iyie, o ltung'ana linono o sinkan linono.” ’ ”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Ntorioi enkaina ino o eng'udi ino te shumata oo lkejek, o te shumata oo erat, o te shumata oo lturot, nchoo ntuaan meetu enkop e Misiri!’ ”

English: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt; and the frogs came up, and covered the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitorioo Aron enkaina enye tioriong nkariak e Misiri, neilepu ntuaan neiput enkop e Misiri.

English: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neas ilasakutok anaa ina te sakutore enye, neyau ntuaan oriong enkop e Misiri.

English: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron, and said, Intreat the LORD, that he may take away the frogs from me, and from my people; and I will let the people go, that they may do sacrifice unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron nejoki, “Entoomon Olaitoriani meiwuang'ie ntuaan maatung'uai nanu o ltung'ana laainei; naa kaisho nanu iltung'ana epuo aapolosaki Olaitoriani.”

English: And Moses said unto Pharaoh, Glory over me: when shall I intreat for thee, and for thy servants, and for thy people, to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses, that they may remain in the river only?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Farao, “Tiaakaki ake duoo iyie anaa eniyieu, kanu iyieu naaomonoki, o laisiaayiak linono o ltung'ana linono, peyie emuti ntuaan te iyie, o too nkajijik inono metaa olkeju le Nail ake etii.”

English: And he said, To morrow. And he said, Be it according to thy word: that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the LORD our God.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Taisere.” Nejo Musa, “Metotiwuo anaa ina nitejo, peyie iyiolouu aajo metii likae onyaanyukie Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: And the frogs shall depart from thee, and from thy houses, and from thy servants, and from thy people; they shall remain in the river only.
Masaai: Eikipuo ntuaan aaing'uaa iyie o nkajijik inono o laisiaayiak linono o ltung'ana linono; neaku to lkeju ake le Nail eing'uari.”

English: And Moses and Aaron went out from Pharaoh: and Moses cried unto the LORD because of the frogs which he had brought against Pharaoh.
Masaai: Neipang Musa o Aron aapuo aaing'uaa Farao, neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani te nkaraki ntuaan, anaa enatoning'okinote o Farao.

English: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and the frogs died out of the houses, out of the villages, and out of the fields.
Masaai: Neas Olaitoriani te risioroto ororei le Musa, neye ntuaan too nkajijik o too ndung'orot o too nkong'at.

English: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninche too olchalai neing'usilu enkop.

English: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Kake ore ake peyie edol Farao ajo eikasha enkop, neitagol oltau lenye, nemening ninye; anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch out thy rod, and smite the dust of the land, that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tiaaki Aron, ‘Ntorioi eng'udi ino toosho enterit e nkop, peyie eaku enkojong'ani te nkop pooki e Misiri.’ ”

English: And they did so; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod, and smote the dust of the earth, and it became lice in man, and in beast; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neiko ninche neijia; neitorioo Aron enkaina enye o eng'udi enye neosh enterit e nkop, nelotu enkojong'ani ajing'aki tung'ani o eng'ues; neaku enterit pooki e nkop enkojong'ani te nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.
Masaai: Netem ilang'eni le tung'ana te ng'eno enye aayau enkojong'ani eitu eidim. Neaku keetae enkojong'ani te pooki tung'ani o te pooki ng'ues.

English: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Nejoki ilang'eni le tung'ana Farao, “Olkimojino le Nkai ele.” Kake eitogoloki oltau le Farao neaku mening ninche; anaa enatejo apa Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh; lo, he cometh forth to the water; and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tayooki inyo tadekenya taanyu Farao elotu enetii enkare, nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.

English: Else, if thou wilt not let my people go, behold, I will send swarms of flies upon thee, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people, and into thy houses: and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies, and also the ground whereon they are.
Masaai: Naa, ti nimincho iltung'ana laainei epuo, ng'ura, naaitame airriwaki iyie emus oo lojong'a o laisiaayiak linono, o ltung'ana linono, o atua nkajijik inono, neiput inkajijik oo le Misiri emus oo lojong'a, o ina kop naitasheyie ninche.

English: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen, in which my people dwell, that no swarms of flies shall be there; to the end thou mayest know that I am the LORD in the midst of the earth.
Masaai: Kake ore te ina olong naoru enkop e Goshen, naa ninye etonie iltung'ana laainei, metaa mejing emus oo lojong'a ine, peyie iyiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani otii empolos e nkop.

English: And I will put a division between my people and thy people: to morrow shall this sign be.
Masaai: Metaa kaoru nanu ltung'ana laainei o ltung'ana linono. Taisere eaku ele monekie.” ’ ”

English: And the LORD did so; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh, and into his servants' houses, and into all the land of Egypt: the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Olaitoriani; nelotu emus kitok oo lojong'a atua enkaji e Farao o atua nkajijik oo laisiaayiak lenyena; ore atua enkop pooki e Misiri nerruoyo enkop te nkaraki oo lojong'a.

English: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron, and said, Go ye, sacrifice to your God in the land.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron nejoki, “Enchom, entopolosaki Enkai inyi tiatua ena kop.”

English: And Moses said, It is not meet so to do; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the LORD our God: lo, shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes, and will they not stone us?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Musa, “Meishiaakino ti nikiaas ina; amu eikipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang ilasarri ooitagor Ilmisiri. Amaa ti nikipolos ilasarri ooitagor Ilmisiri te dukuya nkonyek enye, aimear iyiook too soito?

English: We will go three days' journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to the LORD our God, as he shall command us.
Masaai: Eikipuo elototo oo nkolong'i uni ti ong'ata peyie kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai anaa enaitanap iyiook.”

English: And Pharaoh said, I will let you go, that ye may sacrifice to the LORD your God in the wilderness; only ye shall not go very far away: intreat for me.
Masaai: Nejo Farao, “Ekaisho intae enchom peyie ipolosakiki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ti ong'ata; kake mipuopuo aalamari oleng. Entoomonokoki.”

English: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki, “Ng'ura, kaaipang alo aing'uaa naa kaaomonoki to Laitoriani peyie elo emus oo lojong'a aing'uaa Farao, neing'uaa ilaisiaayiak lenyena, neing'uaa iltung'ana lenyena taisere; enyor ake nemeitoki Farao alej iyiook, amitiki iltung'ana meshomo aapolosaki Olaitoriani.”

English: And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
Masaai: Nelo Musa aing'uaa Farao, neomon Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
Masaai: Neas Olaitoriani anaa enaikilikuanua Musa, neiwuang'ie ina mus oo lojong'a te Farao, o too laisiaayiak lenyena o too ltung'ana lenyena; eitu eing'uari obo.

English: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
Masaai: Kake eitagolo ake sii Farao oltau lenye tena kata, neitu eisho iltung'ana meshomo.

English: Then the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Shomo tijing'aki Farao, nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lhebrania, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, peyie aatum aaisiaayia.

English: For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,
Masaai: Amu ti niany iyie incho ninche epuo niton aibok ninche,

English: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.
Masaai: ng'ura, nedoiki intae enkaina o Laitoriani olmeitai torrono nkishu inyi naatii ong'ata, mbartan, isirkon, ntamesin, iluaat oo nkishu o luaat oo ntare.

English: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.
Masaai: Nerish Olaitoriani nkishu oo Siraeli o nkishu e Misiri, metaa meye hoo toki te nena pooki naara inoo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.” ’ ”

English: And the LORD appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the LORD shall do this thing in the land.
Masaai: Nedung'u Olaitoriani enkata, ejo “Taaisere eas Olaitoriani ena bae ti atua ena kop.”

English: And the LORD did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.
Masaai: Ore ake peyie ekenyu neas Olaitoriani ena bae; neye nkishu pooki oo Lmisiri, kake ore nkishu oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli eitu ninye eye nabo.

English: And Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead. And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, and he did not let the people go.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Farao olkilikuai, naa ng'ura, eitu ninye eye hoo nabo oo nkishu oo Siraeli. Kake eitagoloki oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho iltung'ana meshomo.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses and unto Aaron, Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace, and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Entayutu mboreitin oo nkaik oo nkurruon to lkokuet, ninchosho Musa metanang'aki shumata te dukuya Farao.

English: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast, throughout all the land of Egypt.
