Masaai: Naa keaku enterit napuyiapui te nkop pooki e Misiri, neaku iltuduta ooiwotiota aaku mpaldakani te tung'ani o te ng'ues te nkop pooki e Misiri.”

English: And they took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward heaven; and it became a boil breaking forth with blains upon man, and upon beast.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche nkurruon to lkokuet, neitashe te dukuya Farao, nenang'aa Musa aipirie shumata, neaku iltuduta ooiwotiota aaku mpaldakani torrok te tung'ani o te ng'ues.

English: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils; for the boil was upon the magicians, and upon all the Egyptians.
Masaai: Neitu eidimu lelo ang'eni le tung'ana oitasheito te dukuya Musa te nkaraki iltuduta, amu etijing'a iltuduta lelo ang'eni le tung'ana loo Lmisiri pooki.

English: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had spoken unto Moses.
Masaai: Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye ening ninche anaa enairorie Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Rise up early in the morning, and stand before Pharaoh, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, Let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tayooki inyo tadekenya shomo ntasho te dukuya Farao nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lhebrania, “Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.

English: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart, and upon thy servants, and upon thy people; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore ena kata naa kairriwaki ilmeita laainei pooki meetu oltau lino, o laisiaayiak linono peyie itum atayiolo ajo metii likae laanyaanyukie te nkop pooki.

English: For now I will stretch out my hand, that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore taata anaata atudumua enkaina ai naaosh iyie o ltung'ana linono to lmeitai naa anaata kiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa enkop.

English: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up, for to shew in thee my power; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth.
Masaai: Kake te nkaraki ena aatapala inchu, peyie aaitodol iyie engolon ai peyie eibalunyeki enkarna ai te nkop pooki.

English: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people, that thou wilt not let them go?
Masaai: Eton ake ijukaa kewan too ltung'ana laainei, nimincho ninche meshomo.

English: Behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore taisere tena saa naitasha enchan oo soito neitu ae kata etumi te Misiri ebaiki apa peyie eiteruni o metabaiki taata.

English: Send therefore now, and gather thy cattle, and all that thou hast in the field; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field, and shall not be brought home, the hail shall come down upon them, and they shall die.
Masaai: Ore naa taata irriwai ilkiliku meitushuri nkishu o pooki toki niatata too lng'oborri; amu kelotu enchan oo soito ashaiki pooki tung'ani o eng'ues pooki natii ong'ata nemeitokini aayau ang, naa keye.” ’ ”

English: He that feared the word of the LORD among the servants of Pharaoh made his servants and his cattle flee into the houses:
Masaai: Ore ilo oure ororei lo Laitoriani ti atua ilaisiaayiak le Farao neisikie isinkan lenyena o nkishu aaya atua nkajijik;

English: And he that regarded not the word of the LORD left his servants and his cattle in the field.
Masaai: kake ore ilo leitu eshilaa ororei lo Laitoriani neing'uaa isinkan lenyena o nkishu enyena ti ong'ata.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch forth thine hand toward heaven, that there may be hail in all the land of Egypt, upon man, and upon beast, and upon every herb of the field, throughout the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ing'orie shumata, peyie ejing enchan oo soito enkop pooki e Misiri.”

English: And Moses stretched forth his rod toward heaven: and the LORD sent thunder and hail, and the fire ran along upon the ground; and the LORD rained hail upon the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa eng'udi enye aing'orie keper; neirriu Olaitoriani enkikurrukur o enchan oo soito, nedou enkima alotu enkop. Neitasha Olaitoriani enchan oo soito te nkop e Misiri.

English: So there was hail, and fire mingled with the hail, very grievous, such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.
Masaai: Netii enchan oo soito o enkima naimerlelita ti atua enchan oo soito, enchan oo soito sapuk oleng, neitu ae kata ejing enkop e Misiri ebaiki apa pee eaku olosho.

English: And the hail smote throughout all the land of Egypt all that was in the field, both man and beast; and the hail smote every herb of the field, and brake every tree of the field.
Masaai: Near enchan oo soito pooki toki natii ong'ata te nkop pooki e Misiri, aa tung'ani o eng'ues; near enchan oo soito pooki aitubului e ong'ata, negil pooki shani li ong'ata.

English: Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, was there no hail.
Masaai: Ti atua enkop e Goshen ake, ine apa netii iltung'ana loo Siraeli metii enchan oo soito.

English: And Pharaoh sent, and called for Moses and Aaron, and said unto them, I have sinned this time: the LORD is righteous, and I and my people are wicked.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Farao iltung'ana, neipot Musa o Aron, nejoki ninche, “Ataasa nanu ing'ok tena rishata; Olaitoriani ninye olasipani ore nanu o ltung'ana laainei nikira ilenkarrueisho.

English: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
Masaai: Entoomon Olaitoriani, amu eidipa iyiook ena kikurrukur o ena shan oo soito; ekaisho ntae enchom, nimintokiki aabik.”

English: And Moses said unto him, As soon as I am gone out of the city, I will spread abroad my hands unto the LORD; and the thunder shall cease, neither shall there be any more hail; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the LORD'S.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninye, “Ore ake peyie alo auluo ena ang, naitorioki Olaitoriani nkaik aainei, negira enkikurrukur nemeitoki atii enchan oo soito peyie itum atayiolo ajo eno Laitoriani enkop.

English: But as for thee and thy servants, I know that ye will not yet fear the LORD God.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie o laisiaayiak linono ayiolo nanu ajo eton ake miurere Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.
Masaai: (Eitarruoyioki enkaitubului naji enkatani o shairi, amu eo apa shairi neitapuka enkatani.

English: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
Masaai: Kake eitu eitarruorri enkano amu eimutie te mbulunoto.)

English: And Moses went out of the city from Pharaoh, and spread abroad his hands unto the LORD: and the thunders and hail ceased, and the rain was not poured upon the earth.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Musa Farao alo auluo ina ang, neitorioki Olaitoriani nkaik enyena, neishunye enkikurrukur o enchan o soito neitu eitoki ashaiki oriong enkop.

English: And when Pharaoh saw that the rain and the hail and the thunders were ceased, he sinned yet more, and hardened his heart, he and his servants.
Masaai: Ore ake peyie edol Farao ajo eishunye enchan, o enchan oo soito o enkikurrukur neigil aas eng'oki, neitagol oltau lenye, ninye o laisiaayiak lenyena.

English: And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened, neither would he let the children of Israel go; as the LORD had spoken by Moses.
Masaai: Neaku eitagoloki oltau le Farao neitu eisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo; anaa enairoro Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go in unto Pharaoh: for I have hardened his heart, and the heart of his servants, that I might shew these my signs before him:
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Tijing'aki Farao; amu aitagolo oltau lenye o oltau loo laisiaayiak lenyena, peyie atum aitoduaai kuna kitoduaat aainei enking'asia nataasa ti atua ninche,

English: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son, and of thy son's son, what things I have wrought in Egypt, and my signs which I have done among them; that ye may know how that I am the LORD.
Masaai: peyie itum aitoning'o olayioni lino o layioni lo layioni lino enaikuna peyie aitomod Ilmisiri too nkitoduaat aainei enking'asia nataasa ti atua ninche; peyie iyiolouu nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And Moses and Aaron came in unto Pharaoh, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of the Hebrews, How long wilt thou refuse to humble thyself before me? let my people go, that they may serve me.
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Aron atua ine netii Farao, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Lhebrania, ‘Iany kenya o anu intobor kewan te dukuya nanu? Nchoo iltung'ana laainei epuo, peyie aatum aaisiaayia nanu.

English: Else, if thou refuse to let my people go, behold, to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast:
Masaai: Amu ti nimitiki iltung'ana laainei epuo, ng'ura, ore taisere nayau olmaati atua enkop ino,

English: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
Masaai: naa keitoip oriong e nkop, metaa metii hoo ng'ae oidim atoduaa enkop; nenya ina nikitelekakaki te nchan oo soito, naa kenya pooki shani lino onyori obulu ti ong'ata,

English: And they shall fill thy houses, and the houses of all thy servants, and the houses of all the Egyptians; which neither thy fathers, nor thy fathers' fathers have seen, since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day. And he turned himself, and went out from Pharaoh.
Masaai: naa keiput nkajijik inono, o nkajijik oo laisiaayiak linono pooki o noo Lmisiri pooki; te nkoitoi neitu ae kata edol iloo papaai lino o loo nkakuyiaa lino, ebaiki apa peyie epuonu oriong e nkopo taata.’ ” Neibelekenya ninye neipang aing'uaa Farao.

English: And Pharaoh's servants said unto him, How long shall this man be a snare unto us? let the men go, that they may serve the LORD their God: knowest thou not yet that Egypt is destroyed?
Masaai: Nejoki ilaisiaayiak le Farao ninye, “Keaku kenya ele tung'ani orreshet te iyiook o anu? Enchoo kulo tung'ana epuo, peyie etum aaisiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai enye; keton ake midol ajo eitarruoyioki Misiri?”

English: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh: and he said unto them, Go, serve the LORD your God: but who are they that shall go?
Masaai: Neshukuni Musa o Aron meetu enetii Farao; nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom esiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; kake kakua oopuo?”

English: And Moses said, We will go with our young and with our old, with our sons and with our daughters, with our flocks and with our herds will we go; for we must hold a feast unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Eikipuo iyiook o elelero ang o enkitoo ang; eikipuo iyiook o layiok lang o ntoyie ang o nkerrai ang o nchoo ang amu meeta inchere mikintaiki Olaitoriani osirua.”

English: And he said unto them, Let the LORD be so with you, as I will let you go, and your little ones: look to it; for evil is before you.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo ntae tenaa kaisho ae kata ntae o ng'aturan inyi enchom! Ng'ura ajo iatata nkitobirat torrok too ndamunot inyi.

English: Not so: go now ye that are men, and serve the LORD; for that ye did desire. And they were driven out from Pharaoh's presence.
Masaai: A-a! Enchom ilewa ake, esiaayia Olaitoriani, amu ina iyieuu.” Nerumori ninche aaitung'uaa ine netii Farao.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts, that they may come up upon the land of Egypt, and eat every herb of the land, even all that the hail hath left.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ti oriong e nkop e Misiri te nkaraki olmaati, peyie elotu oriong e nkop e Misiri, nenya pooki aitubului te nkop, pooki toki natung'uayie enchan oo soito.”

English: And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt, and the LORD brought an east wind upon the land all that day, and all that night; and when it was morning, the east wind brought the locusts.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa eng'udi enye ti oriong e nkop e Misiri, neyau Olaitoriani olkutati le nkilepunoto e nkolong ina kop endama pooki o ina kewarie pooki; ore ake peyie ekenyu eyaua duoo olkutati lenkilepunoto e nkolong olmaati.

English: And the locusts went up over all the land of Egypt, and rested in all the coasts of Egypt: very grievous were they; before them there were no such locusts as they, neither after them shall be such.
Masaai: Nelotu olmaati oriong e nkop pooki e Misiri, neton te nkop pooki e Misiri, emus sapuk oleng o lmaati neitu ae kata etumi nemeitokini ae kata aatum.

English: For they covered the face of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened; and they did eat every herb of the land, and all the fruit of the trees which the hail had left: and there remained not any green thing in the trees, or in the herbs of the field, through all the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Amu eitoipo oriong e nkop pooki, neaku eitomisimisoki enkop, nenya ninche pooki aitubului te nkop o pooki ng'anayioi loo lkeek otelekua enchan oo soito; eitu eleku hoo toki nabo nanyori, mme olchani neme enkaitubului e ong'ata, te nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste; and he said, I have sinned against the LORD your God, and against you.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aipot Musa o Aron te naipuk, nejo “Ataasa eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi o te ntae.

English: Now therefore forgive, I pray thee, my sin only this once, and intreat the LORD your God, that he may take away from me this death only.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entapalakaki eng'oki ai, atoomono ntae, ena kata ake, nikiomonokiki to Laitoriani Enkai inyi peyie eiwuang'ie ake ninye ena keeya te nanu.”

English: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
Masaai: Neipang alo aing'uaa Farao neomon Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD turned a mighty strong west wind, which took away the locusts, and cast them into the Red sea; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt.
Masaai: Neibelekeny Olaitoriani olkutati te ndoyioroto e nkolong laa ninye otudumua Olmaati neya arrumoki atua Enaiposha Nanyokie; eitu ninye eing'uari olmaati obo te nkop pooki e Misiri.

English: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go.
Masaai: Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho nkera oo Isiraeli epuo.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand toward heaven, that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt, even darkness which may be felt.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino ing'orie keper peyie ejing enaimin enkop e Misiri, enaimin narok ong'u.”

English: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days:
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye aing'orie keper nejing enaimin sapuk atua enkop e Misiri nkolong'i uni;

English: They saw not one another, neither rose any from his place for three days: but all the children of Israel had light in their dwellings.
Masaai: neitu ninche eduaa maate neitu edumunye hoo ng'ae te wueji enye too nkolong'i uni; kake eeta iltung'ana loo Siraeli pooki ewang'an te ine nemanya ninche.

English: And Pharaoh called unto Moses, and said, Go ye, serve the LORD; only let your flocks and your herds be stayed: let your little ones also go with you.
Masaai: Neitoki Farao aipot Musa nejo, “Enchom esiayia Olaitoriani; eidim sii nkera inyi aashom te nebo intae; enchoo ake metaa nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi eing'uari.”

English: And Moses said, Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings, that we may sacrifice unto the LORD our God.
Masaai: Kake etejo Musa, “Meeta nchere peyie mincho iyiook maitayu ilasarri o nkishorot naapejori, peyie kipolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Our cattle also shall go with us; there shall not an hoof be left behind; for thereof must we take to serve the LORD our God; and we know not with what we must serve the LORD, until we come thither.
Masaai: Ekepuo sii nkishu ang te nebo iyiook; meing'uari ninye oloisotoo, amu eikiya ninche peyie kipuo aaisiai Olaitoriani Enkai ang, nimikiyiolo aajo kainyoo kisiaayie Olaitoriani o metaba anaa nikibaya ine.”

English: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let them go.
Masaai: Kake eitagolo Olaitoriani Farao oltau, nemeisho ninche meshomo.

English: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
Masaai: Nejoki Farao ninye, “Shomo tung'uayioki, toduaa kewan miking'il ae kata adol enkomom ai; amu ore akenya enkolong nidol enkomom ai niye.”

English: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Anaa enitejo! Maigil adol enkomom ino.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh, and upon Egypt; afterwards he will let you go hence: when he shall let you go, he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Eng'or olmeitai obo layaki Farao o Misiri; ore te siadi naa keisho ntae enchom, te neisho ntae enchom naa kearaa ntae enchom katukul.

English: Speak now in the ears of the people, and let every man borrow of his neighbour, and every woman of her neighbour, jewels of silver, and jewels of gold.
Masaai: Iroro naa taata metoning'o iltung'ana, peyie eomonu, pooki lee to lelatia enye, o pooki kitok ene latia enye ilgiso le nkosholai o sahabu.”

English: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh's servants, and in the sight of the people.
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani omom iltung'ana too nkonyek oo Lmisiri. Ore sii ele tung'ani oji Musa naa eikitok apa oleng te nkop e Misiri te dukuya ilaisiaayiak le Farao o te dukuya iltung'ana.

English: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ore te nkalo empolos e nkewarie naa Kaloolo ti atua enkop e Misiri.

English: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
Masaai: Ore ilkikaunot pooki ti atua enkop e Misiri naa keye, ebaiki ilo kikau le Farao otonita to lorika lenye le nkitoo o metabaiki olkikau le ina sinka natii oriong ine neidong'ieki, enkurma, lkikaunot pooki loo nkishu.

English: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt, such as there was none like it, nor shall be like it any more.
Masaai: Naa keaku olkiyioi sapuk ti atua enkop pooki e Misiri, leitu ae kata eaku nemeitoki ae kata aaku.

English: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the LORD doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore te pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana loo Siraeli aa oltung'ani aashu ing'uesi, mebuaaki ninye oldia ninche; peyie itumutumu aatayiolo nchere keor arishu Olaitoriani Ilmisiri o Siraeli.

English: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
Masaai: Ore kulo aisiaayiak linono pooki naa kedou aapuonu enatii, naairrugokino nanu ejo, ‘Tupuku iyie, o ltung'ana pooki likisujita iyie.’ Ore te siadi ina napuku nanu.” Neipang ninye aing'uaa Farao te ngoro sapuk.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Mikining Farao iyie; peyie eponari nena enking'asia aainei ti atua enkop e Misiri.”

English: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Aron kuna pooki e nking'asia te dukuya Farao. Neitagol Olaitoriani oltau le Farao, neitu ninye eisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo aaipang te nkop enye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron tiatua enkop e Misiri,

English: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
Masaai: “Keaku ele apa te ntae enkiterunoto oo lapaitin; ekeaku olapa le dukuya lo lari te ntae.

English: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
Masaai: Entiaaki olturrur pooki loo Siraeli nchere ore te nkolong e tomon ele apa naa keitayu ake pooki tung'ani olkuoo le ker te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye olkuoo le ker ake te nkaji;

English: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
Masaai: naa tenaa eikiti oleng enkaji to lkuo le ker, ore ake oltung'ani o lelatia enye otashare enkaji enye neitayu te risioroto esiana oo ltung'ana; anaa enaidim ake oltung'ani ainosa nintayuyu olkuo le ker obo.

English: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
Masaai: Ore ilo kuo le ker linyi enchoo metaa meeta entioto, ositima lo lari obo, nintayuyu ti atua nkerra arashu ti atua nkineji;

English: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
Masaai: nintaanyunyu ometabaiki enkolong e tomon o ong'uan ele apa, ina kata nayieng'ie eumata pooki o lturrur loo Siraeli ilkuoo lenye le kerra teipa.

English: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche embata o sarge, nepik ntaloishin pokira are e kutuk aji o emolinka e kutuk aji enena ajijik naainosie ilkuoo le kerra.

English: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
Masaai: Nenya ninche nkiri ina kewarie, naatapejoki; te nebo imukateni neitu eisuijieki nenya sii mbenek naadua.

English: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
Masaai: Eminya ake te nena ejon arashu eitokitokieki te nkare, kake epejo endukuya enye te nebo loilelek lenyena o enkoshoke enye.

English: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
Masaai: Nimilekuku ake ae toki enye o mekenyu, ore pooki toki naton o mekenyu nipejoo.

English: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
Masaai: Naa tena oitoi inyanya; eena ntae impolosi, etii namuka nkejek inyi netii ng'udisin inyi nkaik inyi; ninyanya te naipuk. Eng'iroroto ena o Laitoriani.

English: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Amu kaim atua enkop e Misiri ina kewarie, naar metuata ilkikaunot pooki ti atua enkop e Misiri nadung'oki nanu enkiguana. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Keaku ilo sarge olmonekie te ntae, too nkajijik nitii; naa te nadol osarge nagiroo ntae, nemetii olmeitai ojing ntae peyie emut ntae te naar enkop e Misiri.

English: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the LORD throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
Masaai: “Keaku ena olong te ntae enitumutumu aadamu, nimbung'ubung'u aitaa osirua to Laitoriani; ore ti atua ishoritin inyi pooki embung'a anaa enkitanapata oo ntarasi.

English: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
Masaai: “Enosa imukateni neitu eisuijieki nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e dukuya niwuang'ieng'ie enkisuijo aaitayu too nkajijik inyi, amu te nenya oltung'ani emukate naisuijo, ebaiki enkolong edukuya o metabaiki enkolong e naapishana nekepari ilo tung'ani aaitung'uaa Isiraeli.

English: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya entuum olturrur osinya; meetae esiaai naitayuni te nena olong'i; kake ina nanya pooki ng'ae ake ntobiriri.

English: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
Masaai: Ning'oring'oro osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, amu te ina olong apa aitayio ilororani linyi aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri: metaa embung'a ena olong ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, anaa enkitanapata oo ntarasi.

English: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le dukuya te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan o lapa te nkalo e nteipa, ninyanya imukateni neitu eisuijieki ninkoko neijia o metabaiki enkolong e tikitam o obo o lapa te nkalo e nteipa.

English: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naapishana enchoo metaa metumi enkisuijo too nkajijik inyi; amu te nenya oltung'ani emukate naisuijo, nekepari ilo tung'ani aitung'uaa olturrur loo Siraeli, enyor naa oldokunoti arashu oino teina kop.

English: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
Masaai: Minyanya pooki toki naisuijo; ore too manyishoritin inyi pooki enosa imukateni neitu eisuijieki.”

English: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
Masaai: Neipot Musa ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nejoki ninche, “Entegelaki ate ilkuoo le kerra te risioroto oo lmareita linyi, niyieng'iyieng'e ilo kuoo le ker le ng'iroroto.

English: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
Masaai: Nintayuyu orridati le nkaitubului naji hisopu nilopilopiepie ilo sarge otii eng'irra, paa ieliele emolink'a oo ntaloishin pokira are te ilo sarge otii eng'ira; nemetii hoo obo linyi oipang aim kutuk aji e nkaji enye o mekenyu.

English: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
Masaai: Amu kegiroo Olaitoriani alo aar metuata Ilmisiri; naa ore te nedol osarge te molinka o too ntaloishin pokira e kutuk aji negiroo Olaitoriani kutuk aji nemeisho ilo arani metijing'u nkajijik inyi peyie ear ntae entuata.

English: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
Masaai: Embung'a ele kerreti anaa enkitanapata te ntae o too nkera inyi ntarasi.

English: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the LORD will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
Masaai: Ore kenya ake peyie ipuonunu enkop naisho ntae Olaitoriani, anaa enatejo, nimbung'ubung'u ena kisiaayiare.

English: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
Masaai: Ore ake peyie kijoki nkera inono, ‘Kene nyoo ena kisiaayiare?’

English: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the LORD'S passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
Masaai: Tejo iyie, ‘Olasar lo Laitoriani le Pasaka, amu etogiroyie apa nkajijik oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te Misiri apa peyie ear Lmisiri kake etapala nkajijik ang.’ ” Neirrug iltung'ana ilukuny enyeneserem.

English: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli aas ina; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa o Aron neiko neijia.

English: And it came to pass, that at midnight the LORD smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos e nkewarie near metuata Olaitoriani ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, ebaiki ilo kikau le Farao oton to lorika lenye le nkitoo o metabaiki olkikau le ilo o ena te nkaji naenishoreki, o ilkikaunot pooki loo nkishu.

English: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
Masaai: Neinyototo Farao kewarie, ninye, o laisiaayiak lenyena pooki o Ilmisiri pooki; netii apa olkiyioi sapuk Misiri amu metii apa enkaji neitu eye oltung'ani obo.

English: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the LORD, as ye have said.
Masaai: Neipot ninye Musa o Aron te nkewarie, nejo, “Enyeito, enchom entung'uai iltung'ana laainei, intae o ltung'ana loo Siraeli; enchom esiayia Olaitoriani, anaa apa enitejo.

English: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
Masaai: Ewaita nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi anaa enitejo, enchom naa entamayianaki sii nanu.”

English: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
Masaai: Neipukie Ilmisiri iltung'ana, peyie earaa ninche metupuku aaing'uaa enkop te nkisarrisar amu etejo, “Kituata pooki.”

English: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
Masaai: Neya iltung'ana enkurma enye eton eitu eisuijiek, o ngirran naaipurjishoreki neimulumulari too nkilani enye nenap too loilila.

English: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
Masaai: Netaasa sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa enatiaaka Musa, amu etoomonutuo ilgiso loo Lmisiri le nkosholai o le sahabu, o nkilani;

English: And the LORD gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
Masaai: neishoo Olaitoriani iltung'ana omom te dukuya Ilmisiri metaa eishoo nena naatoomunutuo. Nedupore Isiraeli Ilmisiri.

English: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te Rameses o metabaiki Sukot, ilewa oobaya nkalifuni ile too nkejek, metii nkituaak o nkera.

English: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
Masaai: Nelo sii olorora oshula te nebo ninche, o nkishu kumok oleng; o nkerrai o nchoo.

English: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
Masaai: Nepej ninche imukateni neitu eisuijieki enapa kurma nayautua aaitung'uaa Misiri neitu eishori metotoni, neitu sii eitobiraki ate endaa.

English: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
Masaai: Ore enkata natotona iltung'ana loo Siraeli te Misiri naa ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni.

English: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the LORD went out from the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilarin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni, te ina olong kewan, neipang aapuo ilororani pooki lo Laitoriani aaing'uaa Misiri.

English: It is a night to be much observed unto the LORD for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the LORD to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
Masaai: Enkewarie apa netagolie Olaitoriani ninche, aitupuku ninche te nkop e Misiri; metaa ore ena kewarie naa enkewarie naing'ori to Laitoriani iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli ti atua iishoritin enye pooki.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Ena enkitanapata o sirua le Ng'iroroto: meetae oltung'ani omoni oinos ilo sirua.

English: But every man's servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
Masaai: Kake ore pooki rrindik oinyiang'uaki too mpisai neidim ainosa te neidipi aatumurat ninye.

English: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
Masaai: Meinos olamutanani arashu olaisiaayiani oigeroki.

English: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
Masaai: Te nkaji nabo einos; minosinoso ake hoo ae kiring'o aaipang'unye ti aji; nimigiligili ake oloito lenye.

English: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
Masaai: Nchoo eibung ena olturrur pooki loo Siraeli.

English: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the LORD, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
Masaai: Naa te nelotu oltung'ani omoni aton te nebo ntae neyieu neitaiki Olaitoriani osirua le ng'iroroto, nchoo metumurati ilewa lenyena pooki. Kake meetae oltung'ani le memurata onya.

English: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
Masaai: Enkitanapata nabo ake eetae to inoti o to ltung'ani omoni oton ti atua intae.”

English: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
Masaai: Neiko neijia iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, neas ninche.

English: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the LORD did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong ake neitayu Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri too lororani lenye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntisinyakaki nanu ilkikaunot pooki;

English: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
Masaai: ore pooki toki naitera abol enkoshoke ti atua Siraeli te tung'ani o te ng'ues naa enaai.”

English: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Entadamu ena olong; naa ninye apa itupukunye aaing'uaa Misiri, aaing'uaa enkaji e sinkaisho, amu te ngolon e nkaina eitayio ntae Olaitoriani aaitung'uaa ene wueji; meinosi emukate naisuijieki.

English: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae ena olong to lapa le Abibu.

English: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.
Masaai: Ore ake te neyau intae Olaitoriani atua enkop oo Lkanaani, o Ilhiti, o Ilamori, o Ilhifi o Lyebusi, apa nainosa olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho intae enkop naruko kule o enaisho, nimbung'ubung'u ena kisiaayiare tele apa.

English: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to the LORD.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i naapishana, enosa imukateni neitu eisuijieki, ore te nkolong e naapishana neaku osirua to Laitoriani.

English: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.
Masaai: Imukateni neitu eisuijieki einosi too nkolong'i naapishana; medoli emukate naisuijieki te ntae, nemedoli emukate naisuijieki te nkop inyi.

English: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
Masaai: Nijoki akenya olayioni lino te ina olong ‘Enkaraki e ina naaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani apa pee apuku aing'uaa Misiri.’

English: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD'S law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa ketiu te iyie anaa enkitoduaata te nkaina ino netiu anaa endamunoto te rishata oo nkonyek inono, pee etum enkitanapata o Laitoriani atijing'a enkutuk ino; amu te nkaina nagol kiyaua iyie Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri.

English: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
Masaai: Metaa imbung naa ena kitanapata te nkata enye nageluno te pooki ari.

English: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,
Masaai: “Ore akenya ti nikiyau Olaitoriani enkop oo Lkanaani, anaa enainosa olmumai te iyie o too loo papaai linyi, naa eikincho iyie.

English: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD'S.
Masaai: Ninteng'el iyie te nkaraki Olaitoriani nena pooki naatang'asa aabol enkoshoke. Ore ilkikaunot pooki loo nkishu inono oora ilbung'aiko, neaku ilo Laitoriani.

English: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.
Masaai: Ore olkurrarru pooki le sikiria ong'asi aaiu, nelakuni to sitima le ker, naa te nimilaku iyie ninye niburukush emurt enye. Ore olkikau pooki loo layiok linyi nilaku.

English: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What is this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
Masaai: Ore te nkata nalotu te nikinkilikuan olayioni lino, ajoki, ‘Kainyoo doi eutu ena?’ nijoki iyie ninye, ‘Te ngolon e nkaina eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri, aitung'uaa enkaji e sinkaisho.

English: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
Masaai: Amu ore apa pee eany Farao te ngolong'u eisho iyiook maape near Olaitoriani ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, olkikau le tung'ani o le nkiteng. Metaa kapolosaki Olaitoriani ilbung'aiko pooki ootang'asa aabol enkoshoke; kake ore ilkikaunot pooki loo layiok laainei nawalu.’

English: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa keaku olmishire te nkaina ino arashu te rishata oo nkonyek inono, amu te nkaina nagol eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri.”

English: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
Masaai: Ore apa pee eisho Farao iltung'ana meshomo, neitu erikoo Olaitoriani ninche aimie nkoitoi e nkop oo Lfilisti, hoo naa ina apa nataana; amu etejo, “Mayieu neibelekenya iltung'ana te nedol olarrabal, neshuko aapuo Misiri.”

English: But God led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake etorikoyie Enkai iltung'ana aitamanaa te nkoitoi o lpurkel aing'orie Enaiposha Nanyokie. Neilepu iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri eterretenate to larrabal.

English: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
Masaai: Neya Musa iloik lo sesen le Yosef te nebo ninye, amu eitayio apa Yosef enkutuk neinos olmumai too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ejo, “Kemutan intae Enkai; naa eiyaya intae iloik laainei te nebo intae aaitung'uaa Misiri.”

English: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche te Sukot neitayu ilng'oborri te Esam, te bayie o lpurkel.

English: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
Masaai: Nelo Olaitoriani dukuya ninche dama te nkatampoi naikununo anaa eng'ape pee erikoo ninche te nkoitoi, ore te nkewarie naa te nkima naikununo anaa eng'ape pee eitawang'aki ninche, pee etum aashom dama o kewarie.

English: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
Masaai: Ore ina atampoi neikununo anaa eng'ape te ndama o enkima naikununo anaa eng'ape te nkewarie neitu eiwuang te dukuya iltung'ana.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli metushukoto siadi aapik ilng'oborri dukuya e Pi-ha-hirot, erishata e Migdol o enaiposha, dukuya e Baal-sefon; enteshet ilng'oborri empirakinye embata e naiposha.

English: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.
Masaai: Amu ejo ninye Farao ti alo iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Eibookoki ninche atua ina kop eibooyie ninche olpurkel.’

English: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am the LORD. And they did so.
Masaai: Naa kaitagol nanu oltau le Farao, naa kesujaa ninche natum enkisisa te Farao o te njore enye pooki; naa keyiolou Ilmisiri aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.” Neiko ninche neijia.

English: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini olaiguanani le Misiri aajoki eisika iltung'ana, neibelekenya endamunoto e Farao o enoo laisiaayiak lenyena ti alo iltung'ana, nejo ninche, “Kainyoo ena nikitaasa nchere kinchoo Siraeli meshomo meekure esiaai iyiook?”

English: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
Masaai: Neitobir ninye engarri enye oo mbartan nedumu enjore enye,

English: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
Masaai: neya ingarrin oo mbartan naageluno iip ile o kulie garrin oo mbartan e Misiri ekedito ilkituaak ninche pooki.

English: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.
Masaai: Neitagol Olaitoriani oltau le Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nesujaa ninye iltung'ana loo Siraeli ooisula aapuku te ng'olong'u.

English: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.
Masaai: Nesujaa Ilmisiri ninche, mbartan pooki e Farao, o ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan o enjore enye, neinepu ninche too lng'oborri te mbata e naiposha, te mbata e Pi-ha-hirot, te dukuya e Baal-sefon.

English: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee enyiku Farao, neraposhu iltung'ana loo Siraeli nkonyek enye, naa ng'ura, epuonu Ilmisiri te siadi ninche; neureishoyu oleng. Neishiraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli Olaitoriani;

English: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
Masaai: nejoki ninche Musa, “Kenkaraki nemetii nkuraren Misiri pee iyaua iyiook matuata to lpurkel? Kainyoo intaasa iyiook iyaua iyiook aitung'uaa Misiri?

English: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
Masaai: Aime ena apa kitiaakita iyie te Misiri, ‘Tapala iyiook naa nchoo maisiaayia Ilmisiri?’ Amu enaikash apa te iyiook ti nikisiai Ilmisiri alang ti nikiye to lpurkel.”

English: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Emiureishoyu, entasheito tukul, metii olng'ash pee idolidolo enjeunoto o Laitoriani, naitobiraki ninye ntae taata; amu ore kulo Misiri idolitata taata, mintokiki ae kata aadol.

English: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
Masaai: Kemitu intae Olaitoriani, metaa entirring'ata.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Wherefore criest thou unto me? speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kainyoo pee kinchiraki nanu? Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli meshomo dukuya.

English: But lift thou up thy rod, and stretch out thine hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
Masaai: Tudumu ilepie eng'udi ino, nintorioo enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha tooro, pee etum iltung'ana loo Siraeli aashom te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha.

English: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
Masaai: Naa kaitagol iltauja loo Lmisiri pee epuo atua aasujaa ninche, naa katum enkitoo te Farao o te njore enye pooki, too ngarrin oo mbartan oo too lakedok loo mbartan.

English: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the LORD, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
Masaai: Neyiolou Ilmisiri aajo, ara nanu Olaitoriani, te naidip nanu anoto enkitoo te Farao, too ngarrin oo mbartan o too lakedok loo mbartan.”

English: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika le Nkai apa orikito te dukuya e njore oo Siraeli aiwuang'a nelo siadi ninche; ore ina atampoi naikununo anaa eng'ape neiwuang'a te dukuya ninche neitashe te siadi ninche.

English: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
Masaai: Alotu te rishata e njore e Misiri o enjore oo Siraeli. Netii ina atampoi o enaimin; nelusoo enkewarie meetae enaewuo anyikaki enkae enkewarie pooki.

English: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and the LORD caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha; nereu Olaitoriani enaiposha siadi to siwuo ogol le nkilepunoto e nkolong e nkewarie pooki, neitaa enaiposha enkop natoyio, neoro nkariak.

English: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli ti atua empolos e naiposha aaim enkop natoyio, etaa nkariak esuntai te ninche te nkaina e tatene o te kedienye.

English: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
Masaai: Nesujaa Ilmisiri, nepuo atua emirta ninche nepuo empolos e naiposha, mbartan pooki e Farao, ngarrin oo mbartan enyena, o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan.

English: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
Masaai: Ore tadekenya enasirie neing'or Olaitoriani ti atua ina kima naikununo anaa eng'ape o ina atampoi enjore o Lmisiri neisirng'ang'ie enjore oo Lmisiri,

English: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Israel; for the LORD fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
Masaai: aun nkejek oo ngarrin enye metupurpurrito te lototo; nejo Ilmisiri, “Emaisika te dukuya Siraeli; amu kemitu ninche Olaitoriani aing'arraki Ilmisiri.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Stretch out thine hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ntorioi enkaina ino te shumata enaiposha, pee eshukunye enkare shumata Ilmisiri, o shumata ingarrin enye oo mbartan o shumata ilakedok lenye loo mbartan.”

English: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and the LORD overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
Masaai: Neitorioo Musa enkaina enye te shumata enaiposha, neshukunye enaiposha enoshi ake kirragata enye emanaa enkakenya; nejo Ilmisiri maisika aailany enkare kake eibooko ninche Olaitoriani empolos enaiposha.

English: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
Masaai: Neshukunye inkariak neimisie ingarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan o ina jore pooki e Farao, natusujaka ninche atua enaiposha; eitu ninye eleku obo lenye.

English: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
Masaai: Kake eshomo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha, etaa nkariak esuntai te ninche te nkaina enye e tatene o te kedienye.

English: Thus the LORD saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Olaitoriani aitajeu Isiraeli ina olong too nkaik oo Lmisiri; nedol Isiraeli Ilmisiri etuata te mbata e naiposha.

English: And Israel saw that great work which the LORD did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared the LORD, and believed the LORD, and his servant Moses.
Masaai: Nedol Isiraeli esiaai sapuk naitaasa Olaitoriani Ilmisiri, neureyu iltung'ana Olaitoriani; neiruk ninche Olaitoriani o olaisiaayiani lenye Musa.

English: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Masaai: Neranyaki Musa o ltung'ana loo Siraeli Olaitoriani ele sinkolio ejo, “Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani, amu etimirishe oleng; ore embarta o lakedoni lenye etanang'aka atua enaiposha.

English: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
Masaai: Olaitoriani engolon ai naa osinkolio lai, netaa sii enjeunoto ai; Enkai ai ena naa kaisis ninye, Enkai e papa lai, naa karrep ninye.

English: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani naa oltung'ani lo larrabal; keji enkarna enye Olaitoriani.

English: Pharaoh's chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
Masaai: “Etanang'aka ingarrin oo mbartan e Farao o enjore enye atua enaiposha; ore ilkituaak lenyena gelunot eimiso te Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
Masaai: Eimulumulaitie ninche inkariak; nepuo ninche aadoiki atua eng'uton anaa osoit.

English: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
Masaai: Ore enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, keitoreisho te ngolon, ore enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, kegiligili olmang'atinta.

English: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
Masaai: Ore te ngolon e nkitoo ino, nimir lelo liking'orunore; irriwaa engoro ino neyupuyupoki ninche anaa olkujita.

English: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
Masaai: Ore te nkutata oo nkumeishin inono neiturrurro nkariak, neitashe inkariak aarupa, netoyu enegut ti atua enaiposha.

English: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
Masaai: Etejo olmang'atinta, ‘Ekasujaa, ekainepu; naor nanu iyarunot enye naya pooki toki nayieu; nashutu nanu olalem lai, near enkaina ai ninche metuata.’

English: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
Masaai: Itukuta te nkijape ino, neitemoo ninche enaiposha; neimis anaa osoit ti atua inkariak kituaak.

English: Who is like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who is like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
Masaai: “Kaing'ae likinyaanyukie, iyie Olaitoriani, ti atua inkaitin? Kaing'ae otiu anaa iyie, kitok te sinyatisho, Olourei too nkiaasin e nkitoo, oas isapuki e nking'asia.

English: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
Masaai: Intorioyie iyie enkaina ino e tatene, neijoo ninche enkop.

English: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
Masaai: “Te nyorrata ino osotua itoriko lelo tung'ana litokordua, ituutayie iyie te ngolon ino meshomo emanyisho ino sinyati.

English: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
Masaai: Etoning'o iloreren, neikirikira ninche; eibung'a emion lelo ootoni te Filistia.

English: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
Masaai: Eiputukunyo ilaiguanak le Edom; eibung'a ilarikok le Moabu olokirikiri; Etalepori to lkirutoto lelo pooki oomanya Kanaan.

English: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, which thou hast purchased.
Masaai: Nejing ninche olkirutoto o enkuretisho; te nkaraki enkitoo e nkaina ino, eitirring'ate ninche anaa osoit, o metaba anaa nelusoo iltung'ana linono, Olaitoriani, o metaba anaa nelusoo lelo apa linyiang'ua.

English: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established.
Masaai: Intijing'u iyie ninche atua, niun ninche te nchumata o ldoinyo lino, ine wueji, Olaitoriani, nintobira te nkaraki emanyisho ino, ine nesinya, Olaitoriani, nintobira iyie te nkaina ino.

English: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ekeitoreisho Olaitoriani ntarasi o ntarasi.”

English: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
Masaai: Amu ore apa pee epuo mbartan e Farao o ngarrin enyena oo mbartan o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan atua enaiposha, neyau Olaitoriani ashuku inkariak e naiposha shumata ninche; kake eshomo iltung'ana loo Siraeli te nkop natoyio te mpolos e naiposha.

English: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
Masaai: Neitoki Miriam, ina oiboni, anashe e Aron, adumu entampuri te nkaina enye; neipang inkituaak pooki aasuj ninye too ntampurini eipidipid aaranyisho.

English: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
Masaai: Neranyaki Miriam ninche ejo: “Entaranyaki Olaitoriani amu etimirishe te nkitoo; ore embarta o ilo okedito netanang'aka ninye atua enaiposha.”

English: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
Masaai: Nerikoo Musa Isiraeli dukuya aaing'uaa Enaiposha Nanyokie, nepuo olpurkel le Shuri; nepuo nkolong'i uni to lpurkel neitu etum enkare.

English: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu Mara, neitu eidim aatook enkare e Mara amu kedua, neaku etejoki ine Mara.

English: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Musa, ejo, “Kainyoo kiok?”

English: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
Masaai: Neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani; neitodol ninye Olaitoriani olchani, nenang'aki atua enkare nemelonu enkare. Neisho ninche Olaitoriani nkitanapat teine naatum aaishuyie, netem ninche te ine ejo,

English: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the LORD that healeth thee.
Masaai: “Tinining'ining'i intae oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, niasiasa ina sidai too nkonyek enyena, nining'ining'i nkitanapat enyena nimbung'ubung'u pooki, nemapik hoo nabo oo nkeyaitin ntae apa natipika Ilmisiri; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oishiunye intae.”

English: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aapuonu Elim, ine apa netii nchorroi tomon o are e nkare, o ltuka ntomoni naapishana, neitayu ilng'oborri te ine te mbata e nkare.

English: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche aapuo aaing'uaa Elim, nepuonu olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli olpurkel le Sini, otii erishata e Elim o Sinai, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa li are eidipa aashom te nkop e Misiri.

English: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Misiri Musa o Aron te ilo purkel,

English: And the children of Israel said unto them, Would to God we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Enaikash apa tenaa eikituata te nkaina o Laitoriani te nkop e Misiri, ina kata apa kitoni te mbata oo motio oo nkiri nikinya imukateni aaraposho; amu impang'unye intae iyiook aayau ele purkel, aar ena umata pooki te sumash.”

English: Then said the LORD unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ng'ura, ekashau imukateni naaing'uaa shumata te nkaraki intae; naa keipang'u iltung'ana aaiturrurru endaa naidip ina olong, pee atem ninche tenaa keibung nkitanapat aainei anaa emeibung'.

English: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ile eitobir nena naayau atua aji naa keaku katitin are eiturrur anaake.”

English: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel, At even, then ye shall know that the LORD hath brought you out from the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa o Aron iltung'ana pooki loo siraeli, “Ore teipa niyiolouu aajo Olaitoriani apa oyaua intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri;

English: And in the morning, then ye shall see the glory of the LORD; for that he heareth your murmurings against the LORD: and what are we, that ye murmur against us?
Masaai: ore tadekenya nidolidolo enkitoo o Laitoriani amu etoning'o ninye inking'unyung'unyat inyi ing'unyung'unyakiki Olaitoriani. amu eikira iyiook nyoo pee ing'unyung'unyakiki iyiook?”

English: And Moses said, This shall be, when the LORD shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that the LORD heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Te neisho intae Olaitoriani teipa inkiri ninosinoso neisho intae tadekenya imukateni aiputaki, amu etoning'o Olaitoriani inking'unyung'unyakinot inyi ning'unyung'unyakita ninye. Eikira iyook nyoo? Ore enking'unyung'uny inyi neme enaang kake eno Laitoriani.”

English: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Tiaaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Entinyiku wootu dukuya Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninye inking'unyung'unyat inyi.’ ”

English: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.
Masaai: Ore anaa enairorie Aron olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, neing'or enkalo o lpurkel, ng'ura, neliooyu enkitoo o Laitoriani te nkatampoi.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel: speak unto them, saying, At even ye shall eat flesh, and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread; and ye shall know that I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Atoning'o inking'unyung'unyat oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli; tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore te nteipa ninosinoso inkiri, ore tadekenya neiputakini intae imukateni, ee iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.’ ”

English: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
Masaai: Ore teipa nepuonu nkurlen neiput lelo ng'oborri; ore tadekenya neirrag enkolioolio aman lelo ng'oborri.

English: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumunye enkolioolio te nkop netii enkoriong e ilo purkel entoki naibor, napurupurana natii oriong enkop, (naikununo anaa soito le nchan).

English: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana loo Siraeli nejokino maate, “Kainyoo ena?” Amu meyiolo apa ninche aajo kainyoo ina. Nejoki Musa ninche, “Emukate naa ninye eishoo Olaitoriani intae enosa.

English: This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take ye every man for them which are in his tents.
Masaai: Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani: ‘Entasotu, pooki tung'ani te ntae, anaa enaidim ainosa; ewaita emborei emoti naji omer, te risioroto e siana oo ltung'ana naba anaa enaata ake oltung'ani to lng'obor lenye.’ ”

English: And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
Masaai: Neas ina iltung'ana loo Siraeli, nesotu ilkulikae nkumok, nesotu kulikae nkuti.

English: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee etem te mborei e ina moti naji omer, ore ilo apa otasotuo nkumok nemeeta entoki natelekua, ore ilo otasotuo nkuti netaraposhe; etasotuo ake oltung'ani enaba anaa enaidim ainosa.

English: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninche, “Emincho oltung'ani eshum o mekenyu.”

English: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening Musa; etelekutua embata o mekenyiki neiu ilkuru neng'ueyu; negorokino Musa ninche.

English: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
Masaai: Nesotu ninche anaake tadekenya, oltung'ani ake anaa enaidim ainosa, kake ore ake pee eirowuaju enkolong neshola.

English: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ile nesotu imukateni katitin are oo noshi ake, iyierat are ake oltung'ani; ore ake pee epuonu ilarikok pooki lo lturrur aaliki Musa,

English: And he said unto them, This is that which the LORD hath said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the LORD: bake that which ye will bake to day, and seethe that ye will seethe; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
Masaai: nejoki ninye ninche, “Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani: ‘Enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng taisere, sabato sinyati o Laitoriani; entapej ina nipejipeje niyieriyiere ina niyieriyiere; ore ina pooki naleku nirragiegie o mekenyu.’ ”

English: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
Masaai: Neirragie ninche o metaba anaa nekenyu, anaa enatasayiaka Musa ninche, neitu eng'uoyu neitu ejing ilkuru.

English: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto the LORD: to day ye shall not find it in the field.
Masaai: Nejo Musa “Enosa taata, amu ore taata naa sabato o Laitoriani, mitumutumu taata ti ong'ata.

English: Six days ye shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile isotutu; kake ore te nkolong e naapishana aa ene sabato nemetii hoo toki.”

English: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naapishana nepuo kulikae tung'ana aasotu neitu etum hoo toki.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws?
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Ianyianya akenya imbungubungu nkitanapat o nkirorot aainei o anu?

English: See, for that the LORD hath given you the sabbath, therefore he giveth you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide ye every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
Masaai: Toduaa! Eishoo intae Olaitoriani sabato, metaa ore te nkolong e ile neisho intae imukateni oo nkolong'i are; totona pooki tung'ani te ntae te wueji enye, emincho oltung'ani eipang alo te wueji enye te nkolong e naapishana.”

English: So the people rested on the seventh day.
Masaai: Neyeng'iyeng'a iltung'ana te nkolong e naapishana.

English: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
Masaai: Nejo enkaji oo Siraeli enkarna e ina daa mana; neikununo anaa ilanterera ooibor, netiu emeloni enye anaa enoo nkaukau naaitobiraki te naisho.

English: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Ena eitanapishe Olaitoriani: ‘Enchoo emborei e moti oo nkulukuok naji omer eshumi ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, pee etum aatodol ina mukate naitotiyie nanu intae to lpurkel, inakata apa pee aitupuku intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’ ”

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Tudumu eng'irra tipika emborei e omer e mana atua nirragie te dukuya o Laitoriani, neshumi tiatua iishoritin inyi.”

English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
Masaai: Anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neiko neijia Aron airragie te dukuya Enchakenisho, metushumi.

English: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
Masaai: Neinos iltung'ana loo Siraeli mana ilarin artam, o metaba anaa nepuonu olpolosie le nkop e Kanaan.

English: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
Masaai: (Ore omer naa erubata e tomon e efa.)

English: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of the LORD, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
Masaai: Nepuo olturrur pooki loo Siraeli to lpurkel le Sini too lkirragarien, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, neitayu ilng'oborri te Refidim; kake metii apa enkare naok iltung'ana.

English: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide ye with me? wherefore do ye tempt the LORD?
Masaai: Neilepilepaki iltung'ana Musa, nejo, “Nchoo iyiook enkare nikiok.” Nejoki Musa ninche, “Kainyoo pee kilepilepakiki nanu? Kainyoo pee itemiteme Olaitoriani?”

English: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
Masaai: Kake etotiro iltung'ana enkure oleng, neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Musa, nejo, “Kainyoo apa pee iyaua iyiook aaitung'uaa Misiri, nilotu aar iyiook matuata o nkera ang o nkishu ang te nkure?”

English: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
Masaai: Neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani nejo, “Kaa aitaas kulo tung'ana? Etaa ninche kejo pee aanang too soito.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with thee of the elders of Israel; and thy rod, wherewith thou smotest the river, take in thine hand, and go.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Togiroi iltung'ana te dukuya, nishoroo te nebo iyie embata oo lpayiani loo Siraeli; niya te nkaina ino ina ng'udi apa nitooshie olkeju le Nail, nilo.

English: Behold, I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb; and thou shalt smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel.
Masaai: Ng'ura kalo nanu aitashe te dukuya iyie te idie te nchumata e ndapidapoi te Horeb, niosh iyie ina dapidapoi, naa kepuku enkare ti atua ninye, pee etum iltung'ana aatook.” Neas Musa ina te dukuya ilpayiani loo Siraeli.

English: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Israel, and because they tempted the LORD, saying, Is the LORD among us, or not?
Masaai: Nejo ninye enkarna eine wueji Masa o Meriba, te nkaraki enkilepilep oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, o enkaraki natetema ninche Olaitoriani ejo. “Ketii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook arashu metii?”

English: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
Masaai: Neitoki Amalek alotu nearare Isiraeli te Refidim.

English: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Yoshua, “Tegelaki iyiook ilewa, nimpang'ipang'a aapuo, entaarata o Amalek; ore taisere naitashe nanu te nchumata e ndoinyo aata ina ng'udi e Nkai te nkaina ai.”

English: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
Masaai: Neas Yoshua enatiaaka Musa, nearare Amalek; nelo Musa o Aron o Huri enchumata e ndoinyo.

English: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
Masaai: Ore ake te neilepie Musa enkaina, nemirisho Isiraeli, ore ake te neitadou enkaina enye, nemirisho Ilmaleki.

English: But Moses' hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
Masaai: Kake etanaurate inkaik e Musa, neyau ninche osoit nepik abori ninye, netonie ninye nedumu Aron o Huri inkaik enyena aailepie, obo ake te nchoto nabo o likae ti ae shoto; metaa keitirring'a eitoriori inkaik enyena o metadoi enkolong.

English: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Nemir Yoshua aitadoyio Ilmaleki o ltung'ana lenyena neshurt te nepi o lalem.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ing'ero ena te mbuku metaa endamunoto niliki Yoshua ajoki ekamut nanu aimisie endamunoto oo Ilmaleki aiwuang'ie ti abori keper.”

English: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Jehovahnissi:
Masaai: Neshetu Musa olperere lo lasar nejo enkarna enye, Olaitoriani ninye enanka ai

English: For he said, Because the LORD hath sworn that the LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
Masaai: ejo, “Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai nchere kearare ninye Ilmaleki ebaiki eishoi o eishoi.”

English: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses' father in law, heard of all that God had done for Moses, and for Israel his people, and that the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt;
Masaai: Nening Yesero, ilo apolosani le Midian, olaputani le Musa, nena pooki naaitaasa Enkai Musa o Siraeli iltung'ana lenyena, eneikunuwua Olaitoriani eitayu Isiraeli aitung'uaa Misiri.

English: Then Jethro, Moses' father in law, took Zipporah, Moses' wife, after he had sent her back,
Masaai: Nelotu ninye enetii Musa, neshoru te nebo ninye Sipora, enkitok e Musa natung'uayioki apa te siadi,

English: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
Masaai: o Gerishom o Eliesa, ilayiok lenyena pokira oare. (Etejo Musa, “Ataa apa olomoni te nkop oo le eiking'a neaku etejo olayioni obo Gerishom.”)

English: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the God of my father, said he, was mine help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
Masaai: Ore enkarna o likae naa Eliesa. (Amu etejo, “Enkai apa e papa lai ereretoto ai, naaitajeu nanu to lalem le Farao.”)

English: And Jethro, Moses' father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of God:
Masaai: Nelotu Yesero, olaputani le Musa, o layiok lenyena o enkitok enye enetii Musa to lpurkel te ine apa netipika ilng'oborri to ldoinyo.

English: And he said unto Moses, I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee, and thy wife, and her two sons with her.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejoki oltung'ani obo Musa, “Elotu olaputani lino, Yesero, enitii tenebo enkitok ino o layiok lenyena pokira oare,”

English: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
Masaai: neipang Musa alo anang'are olaputani lenye, neirrugokino neng'utut ninye; neikilikuana maate ilomon lenye nejing ninche atua olng'obor.

English: And Moses told his father in law all that the LORD had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel's sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how the LORD delivered them.
Masaai: Neliki Musa olaputani lenye nena pooki naaitaasa Olaitoriani Farao o Ilmisiri te nkaraki Isiraeli, o sinaitin oogol pooki ooetuo shumata ninche te nkoitoi.

English: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
Masaai: Neng'idayu Yesero te pooki sidai naitaasa Olaitoriani Isiraeli, te ina nayaua ninche aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lmisiri.
