English: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel: and Aaron shall bear their names before the LORD upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
Masaai: Nipik lelo soito pooki inkaloli ooronyi le ina kila dorrop, pee eaku isoito oodamunyeki ilayiok le Israel; nenap Aron inkarn enye te dukuya o Laitoriani too ronyi lenyena pee edamuni.

English: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
Masaai: Nipik nkikodot are e sahabu.

English: And two chains of pure gold at the ends; of wreathen work shalt thou make them, and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches.
Masaai: O lpisia oare le sahabu nasila, ooirina anaa empito nipik nimbung'ie ina sahabu naikodore enkila.

English: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it; of gold, of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine twined linen, shalt thou make it.
Masaai: “Nintobir sii ina kila o lgoo e nkiguana, te nkarriyiano, anaa ina kila dorrop, te sahabu, o too usin pusi o morijo o mpilei o kitani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
Masaai: Nerisioroyu nkaloli pooki, netasha, entemata e ndap enkadoro o entemata e ndap endapasho.

English: And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
Masaai: Nipik ilkererin oong'uan loo soito, olkereri lo ltotoi barrikoi, oltotoi onyori o oltotoi onyokie oleng oaku olkereri le dukuya.

English: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
Masaai: Ore olkereri li are naa oltotoi sintet, oltotoi pus oata iltiil o ltotoi sidai oji almasi;

English: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
Masaai: ore olkereri li okuni naa oltotoi pile, oltotoi owang oji agat, o ltotoi pile oji ametist

English: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
Masaai: ore olkereri li ong'uan naa oltotoi oji beril, oltotoi oji oniks oltotoi pus oji Jaspa. Neitobir te nkikodo e sahabu.

English: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
Masaai: Nepik isoito tomon o are o nkarn enye anaa inkarn oo layiok le Israel. Netiu ninche anaa olmishire, meetae ake olemeguetuno enkarna enye, too loshon tomon aare.

English: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.
Masaai: Nintobiraki ina kila o lgoo ilpisia ooipila anaa impi, le sahabu nasila;

English: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate two rings of gold, and shalt put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: nintobiraki ina kila o lgoo ilgiso oare le sahabu nipik lelo giso oare ilpijat pokira oare le mbene o lgoo.

English: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: Nipik lelo pisia aare le sahabu ooipila atua lelo giso ootii ile mowuarak le mbene o lgoo.

English: And the other two ends of the two wreathen chains thou shalt fasten in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod before it.
Masaai: Ore ineeiting'ie lelo pisia oare ooipila nimbung'ie lelo kererin oare le nkikodo e sahabu, nimbung'ie te nkalo e dukuya te nena keenta e nkila dorrop naatii ironyi.

English: And thou shalt make two rings of gold, and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof, which is in the side of the ephod inward.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu ilgiso aare le sahabu nimbungie lelo lemowuarak aare le nkila to lgoo te nkalo e atua te mbata e ina kila dorrop.

English: And two other rings of gold thou shalt make, and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart thereof, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu ilgiso aare le sahabu, nimbung'ie ninche te nkalo e dukuya ti abori nena keenta are e nkila dorrop natii ironyi, te nchumata ina kimeita e nkila dorrop naripuno te nkarriyiano.

English: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.
Masaai: Neitutum ninche ina kila o lgoo too lgiso lenyena o lgisoi le ina kila dorrop te nkeene pus, pee eirrag te ina kimeita e nkila dorrop naripuno te nkarriyiano, pee melolong'u ina kila o lgoo teina kila dorrop.

English: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Israel in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goeth in unto the holy place, for a memorial before the LORD continually.
Masaai: “Nenap ninye Aron inkarn oo layiok le Israel te ina kila o lgoo e nkiguana, to ltau lenye, te nelo ninye atua ine wueji nesinya, pee edamuni ninche anaake te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And thou shalt put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron's heart, when he goeth in before the LORD: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Israel upon his heart before the LORD continually.
Masaai: Ore ina kila o lgoo e nkiguana tipika Urimu o Sumimu, pee eaku ketii ninche oltau le Aron, te nebo ninye enkata nilo dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku kenapita ninye Aron enkiguana oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli to ltau lenye te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake.

English: And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
Masaai: “Nintayu iyie olkila li oriong pus muj le ina kila dorrop.

English: And there shall be an hole in the top of it, in the midst thereof: it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it, as it were the hole of an habergeon, that it be not rent.
Masaai: Nipik ilo kila enaudoto naimieki endukuya; ore ina audoto neitamani eripata anaa enaudoto e nkila pee mepolosa.

English: And beneath upon the hem of it thou shalt make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, round about the hem thereof; and bells of gold between them round about:
Masaai: Ore eripata enye ti abori tiripaki ilonyek le usi pus, o empile o enanyokie aitaman, o ntualan e sahabu erishata enye,

English: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
Masaai: entuala e sahabu o long'u, nemanaa te ripata e abori olkila.

English: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the LORD, and when he cometh out, that he die not.
Masaai: Neishop Aron ele kila te neisiaaisho anaa olapolosani. Ore enkorui enye nening'i te nelo atua ine wueji sinyati dukuya Olaitoriani, o te neipang'u boo, pee meye.

English: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
Masaai: “Nintayu enchili e sahabu nasila niguetaki oriong enye, anaa isirat lo lmishire, ‘Sinyati to Laitoriani.’

English: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
Masaai: Nieniki ina arasha narridieki endukuya te nkeene pus; tipika enkalo e dukuya e ina arasha narridieki endukuya.

English: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
Masaai: Neishop Aron te nkomom enye, neya ninye Aron enkorrok enye pooki torroni naitayuni to lasar osinya, oyanyit iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa nkishorot enye naasinya. Neton ina masaai anaake te nkomom enye, pee eng'amari nena kishorot te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen, and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen, and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework.
Masaai: “Niripu olkila te siaai tenkarriyiano te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui, nintayu ina arasha narridieki endukuya te nkarasha sidai napuyiapui, nintayu enkimeita aikodu to ltidu.

English: And for Aaron's sons thou shalt make coats, and thou shalt make for them girdles, and bonnets shalt thou make for them, for glory and for beauty.
Masaai: “Ore ilayiok le Aron nintaiki ilkilani, o nkimeitani o imaupen. Nintayu ninche te nkitoo o te nkishiaa.

English: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother, and his sons with him; and shalt anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Ninchopoki lelo kilani Aron olalashe lino, te nebo ilayiok lenyena, nibukoki eilata aput ninche, nikinteng'elaki peyie aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak.

English: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach:
Masaai: Nintaiki nkilani e atua te nkarasha sidai pee eitoip emasipaisho enye; nkilani naabaiki mpolosi nebaiki nkupesir;

English: And they shall be upon Aaron, and upon his sons, when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation, or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place; that they bear not iniquity, and die: it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him.
Masaai: neishop Aron o layiok lenyena te nepuonu aanyikaki olperere lo lasar aaisiaisho te wueji sinyati, meyaki ake ate entorroni meye. Naa keaku ena enkitanapata nauno te ninye o too ishoritin enyena te siadi ninye.

English: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them, to minister unto me in the priest's office: Take one young bullock, and two rams without blemish,
Masaai: “Nji nkuna te nintisiny ninche, pee aatum aaisiaya anaa ilapolosak. Iwa oloing'oni obo oti o lmeregeshi aare le meeta entioto,

English: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.
Masaai: o mukateni neitu eisuijieki o mukateni naamelok neitu eisuijieki naatipikaki eilata, o nkaukau o mukateni neitu eisuijieki naaelieki eilata. Te nkano sidai napuyiapui intayu ninche.

English: And thou shalt put them into one basket, and bring them in the basket, with the bullock and the two rams.
Masaai: Nepik atua entutua nabo, niyau ninche teina tutua, niyau ilo oing'oni o lelo meregeshi pokira oare.

English: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
Masaai: Niyau Aron o layiok lenyena kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo, nintuku ninche te nkare.

English: And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:
Masaai: Nintayu nkilani ninchopoki Aron enkila e oriong o enkila dorrop, o enkila o lgoo nien empolos te ina kimeita naripuno te nkarriyano e ina kila dorrop.

English: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
Masaai: Ninchopoki enkarasha narridieki endukuya enye. Nipik ilo marisian osinya enchumata e ina arasha.

English: Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.
Masaai: Niyau ina ilata naputishoreki, nibukoki endukuya enye aput ninye.

English: And thou shalt bring his sons, and put coats upon them.
Masaai: Nintoki ayau ilayiok lenyena, ninchopoki ninche inkilani,

English: And thou shalt gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.
Masaai: nien impolosi enye too nkimeitani, ninchopoki imaupen; neaku enenye empolosare te nkitanapata nauno. Inji nkuna iput Aron o layiok lenyena apik esiaai sinyati.

English: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock.
Masaai: “Nintoki ayau oloing'oni dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo. Neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya e ilo oing'oni,

English: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: niar ilo oing'oni metua te dukuya Olaitoriani te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo.

English: And thou shalt take of the blood of the bullock, and put it upon the horns of the altar with thy finger, and pour all the blood beside the bottom of the altar.
Masaai: Niya embata o sarge lo loing'oni nipik imowuarak olperere lo lasar to lkimojino lino; ore olikae sarge mbukoi ti abori olperere lo lasar.

English: And thou shalt take all the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul that is above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and burn them upon the altar.
Masaai: Niya ina kurriny pooki naimulumul imonyit o lkina le monyua, o lairakuj pokira aare eeta enkurriny enye, nipej ninche ten chumata olperere.

English: But the flesh of the bullock, and his skin, and his dung, shalt thou burn with fire without the camp: it is a sin offering.
Masaai: Kake ore nkiri o loing'oni, o lchoni lenye, o emodiei enye, nipejoo ninche te nkima tialuo ina ang oo lng'oborri; olasar ninye te nkaraki ing'ok.

English: Thou shalt also take one ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: “Nintoiki aitayu obo loo lmeregeshi, neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya e ilo meregesh,

English: And thou shalt slay the ram, and thou shalt take his blood, and sprinkle it round about upon the altar.
Masaai: niyieng ilo meregesh, nisuaaya osarge lenye te mbata o lperere lo lasar aitaman.

English: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
Masaai: Nintoki adung'udung ilo meregesh, metaa nkutiti kiri, nintuku enkoshoke enye o loilelek nipik ninche te nebo irubat enyena o endukuya enye,

English: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar: it is a burnt offering unto the LORD: it is a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: nipejoo olmeregesh pooki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar; olasar opejori te nkima ninye to Laitoriani, esong'ouna naitishipisho, o lasar le nkima to Laitoriani.

English: And thou shalt take the other ram; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: “Nintoki aitayu olikae meregesh, neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye endukuya o lmeregesh,

English: Then shalt thou kill the ram, and take of his blood, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron, and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons, and upon the thumb of their right hand, and upon the great toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: niyieng ilo meregesh, niya embata o sarge nipik esegerua e nkiok e tatene e Aron o segeruani oo nkiyiaa e tatene oo layiok lenyena, o lmogirrani loo nkaik enye e tatene, o lmogirrani loo nkejek enye e tatene ore ilo sarge otashare olperere lo lasar nisuaaya aitaman.

English: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
Masaai: Nisuaaya olikai sarge otii enchumata o lperere lo lasar o ina ilata naputishoreki nisuaaki Aron, o lkilani lenyena, o layiok lenyena o lkilani loo layiok lenyena te nebo ninye. Ore ninye o lkilani lenyena nesinyayu, o layiok lenyena, o lkilani loo layiok lenyena te nebo ninye.

English: Also thou shalt take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
Masaai: “Nintoki sii aitayu eilata o lmeregesh, o eilata o lkidong'oe o enkurriny e nkoshoke, o lkina le monyua o lairakuj pokira are eeta enkurriny enye o emuro e tatene (amu olmeregesh oputishoreki opikieki Aron o layiok lenyena esiaai sinyati),

English: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
Masaai: nintayu ti atua ntutuan oo mukateni neitu eisuijieki natii dukuya Olaitoriani, emukate nabo namelok natii o enkaukau nabo eilata,

English: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the LORD.
Masaai: o emukate nipik kuna pooki nkaik e Aron, o nkaik oo layiok lenyena, niyukuyuk iyie ninche metaa olasar oyukuyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And thou shalt receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before the LORD: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nintoki iyie aitayu too nkaik enye, nipejoo to lperere lo lasar metoponai olasar opejori, pee eaku esong'ouna naitishipisho te dukuya Olaitoriani; olasar le nkima to Laitoriani.

English: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron's consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before the LORD: and it shall be thy part.
Masaai: “Nintayu oloikulu le ilo meregesh otuputieki Aron aapik esiaai sinyati, niyuk pee eaku olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; neaku erubata ino.

English: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
Masaai: Nintisiny oloikulu lo lasar oyuki, o ena muro aa ninye erubata o lapolosani, nayukoki, naa ninye eishoruaki teilo meregesh oputishoreki amu te nkaraki Aron o te nkaraki layiok lenyena.

English: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons' by a statute for ever from the children of Israel: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Naa keaku ninche ine Aron o noo layiok lenyena, erubata enye naisho ninche iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaake, too lasarri lenye le seriani; neaku olasar lenye to Laitoriani.

English: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons' after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
Masaai: “Ore lelo kilani sinyat le Aron naa keaku iloo layiok lenyena oosuju ninye, pee ebukokini eilata eishopito, neputi ninche eishopito.

English: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
Masaai: Ore ilo ayioni oaku olapolosani erishata enye neishop ninche inkolong'i naapishana, tenelotu atua olng'obor le ntumo aisiaaisho te wueji sinyati.

English: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
Masaai: “Niya ilo meregesh oputishoreki niyier nkiri enyena te wueji sinyati.

English: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nenya Aron o layiok lenyena nkiri e ilo meregesh o mukateni naatii atua ltutuan te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo.

English: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
Masaai: Nenya ninche nena tokitin naaitobirieki to lning'o lo sotua, pee epikieki ninche esiaai sinyati, neitisinyi, kake menya oltung'ani le boo, amu eisinyat ninche.

English: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
Masaai: Kake te neleku ae kirring'o naputishoreki arashu emukate o mekenyu, nipejoo iyie te nkima ina natelekua, meinosi ninye, amu eisinyati.

English: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
Masaai: “Nintaas ina Aron o layiok lenyena, te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa; too nkolong'i naapishana ipik ninche ina siaai sinyati.

English: And thou shalt offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and thou shalt cleanse the altar, when thou hast made an atonement for it, and thou shalt anoint it, to sanctify it.
Masaai: Ore ake te nkolong nintayu, nipolos oloing'oni pee eaku olasar loo ng'ok lo lning'o lo sotua. Nintayu sii olasar loo ng'ok te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, ti nintayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye, nibukoki ninye eilata, aitisiny.

English: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i naapishana intayu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, nintisiny, neaku ilo perere lo lasar sinyati oleng; ore pooki toki naiseyie olperere lo lasar nesinyayu.

English: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
Masaai: “Naa ele olasar lintayu te nchumata o lperere lo lasar, ilkuoo oare le kerra lo lari obo, anaake te nkolong.

English: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even:
Masaai: Topolosa olkuoo obo le ker tadekenya, ore olikae kuo le ker nipolos teipa.

English: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
Masaai: Ore te nebo ilo kuoo le ker le dukuya irrantilini aare le nkano nasila naipurjare, emborei o ltulet leilata sidai, o emborei o ltulet le naisho oo sabibu pee eaku olasar.

English: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even, and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore olikae kuo le ker topolosa teipa ninko anaa ilo le tadekenya, nintayu te nebo ninye olasar le nkurma naidong'o, o lasar opikuni. Olasar le nkima ele to Laitoriani, neitishipisho esong'ouna enye.

English: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD: where I will meet you, to speak there unto thee.
Masaai: keaku ninye olasar opeji anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi te kutuk aji o lng'obor le ntumo, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te ine natumore nanu intae, pee airorie nanu intae te ine.

English: And there I will meet with the children of Israel, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
Masaai: Te ine atumore iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neitisiny enkitoo ai ine.

English: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Naitisiny nanu ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar; naitisiny sii Aron o layiok lenyena, pee aaisiaai ninche anaa ilapolosak.

English: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will be their God.
Masaai: Namany nanu atua ltungana le Israel, naaku Enkai enye.

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am the LORD their God.
Masaai: Neyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, oyaua ninche aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, pee atum nanu atotona ti atua ninche. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shalt thou make it.
Masaai: “Intobira olperere lo lasar pee ipejorie enkorropil enchumata enye. Too nkeek o lerai intobira.

English: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
Masaai: Entemata nabo enkadoro naa entemata nabo endapasho. Nerisioroyu nkaloli pooki, naa intemat are enkilepata; ore mowuarak enyena naa entoki nabo o lperere.

English: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about.
Masaai: Tumura te sahabu nasila enkoriong enye o matuan o mouarak enyena. Nipik enkamanaa e sahabu aitaman.

English: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
Masaai: Nintobiraki ilgiso oare le sahabu, ti abori enkamanaa, too nkaloli enyena pokira are, pee eibung nena bokishi naa ninche enapieki.

English: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
Masaai: Nintayu imbokishi o lerai nimur ninche te sahabu.

English: And thou shalt put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.
Masaai: Nipik ninye dukuya ilo liatua otii embata o sanduku le nchakenisho, otii dukuya olorika lo lng'ur, te nchumata shakenisho, te ine natumore nanu ntae.

English: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
Masaai: Nepej Aron enkorropil naisonkoyo oleng te nchumata enye, anaake tadekenya te neitobir iltaai nepej.

English: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations.
Masaai: Naa ore te neinok Aron iltaai teipa nepej, enkorropil oo nkolong'i pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.
Masaai: Mintayuyu ake enkorropil nemesinya te nchumata te ine, arashu olasar opejori, arashu olasar le nkurma naidong'o nimibukokiki olasar opikuni.

English: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitobir Aron olning'o lo sotua too mowuarak enyena kata nabo to lari; teilo sarge lo lasar loo ng'ok lo lning'o lo sotua eitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua nabo kata to lari ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki. Kesinya oleng to Laitoriani.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
Masaai: “Teninkenikene ltung'ana loo Siraeli, aayiolou esiana neishoru ake pooki ng'ae elakunoto te nkaraki enkorrok enye to Laitoriani te ninken iyie ninche, pee mejing ake olmeitai atua ninche te ninken iyie ninche.

English: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oikenayioki te nkikenare neishoru ena: olpisiai loo mpisai naaji shekeli te risioroto e shekeli eine wueji sinyati. Neitayu olpisiai le shekeli anaa olasar to Laitoriani.

English: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oikenayioki te nkikena, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, neishoru olasar to Laitoriani.

English: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
Masaai: Meishoru olkarsis inkumok nemeishoru olaisinani inkuti, to lpisiai le shekeli, te ninchoru olasar lo Laitoriani aitaiyu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan ino.

English: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.
Masaai: Niya iyie impisai o lning'o lo sotua too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, nigelu aitaa ine nkisiaayiare o lng'obor le ntumo, pee eyau iltung'ana loo Siraeli metadamuni te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee intobiribiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki intae maate.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.
Masaai: “Intobira olmoti lo suyai oitukuoreki; ore eneitotonieki enye naa eno suyai, pee eitukuoreki. Nipik erishata o lng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, nipik enkare atua,

English: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
Masaai: pee aa ninye eitukuyie Aron o layiok lenyena inkaik enye o nkejek enye.

English: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:
Masaai: Te nepuo atua olng'obor le ntumo, arashu te nepuonu embata o lperere lo lasar aaisiaisho, aapejoki Olaitoriani olasar te nkima, neitukuo ninche te nkare, meye ake.

English: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
Masaai: Neituku ninche inkaik enye o nkejek enye, meye ake. Neaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi te ninche, o te ninye o too ishoritin enyena ti atua ishoritin enye pooki.”

English: Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Ore tenebo nena neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
Masaai: “Ntayu isonkoyoni sidain oleng; shekeli iip imiet e manoo, naruko, o lpisiai le nena loo nkabobok o sinantei naarropil oleng, aa taa shekeli iip are o onom,

English: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
Masaai: o shekeli iip imiet o sinantei oojuno, te risioroto e ntemata e wueji sinyati, o eilata oo loirienito mboreitin imiet e mpirbil.

English: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
Masaai: Nintayu iyie te kuna eilata nasinya naputishoreki.

English: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
Masaai: Nibukoki aitisiny ilo ng'obor le ntumo o ilo sanduku le nchakenisho,

English: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
Masaai: o emesa o ntokitin enyena pooki, o enkitashet oo ltaai o ntokitin enyena pooki, o lperere le nkorropil,

English: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
Masaai: o lperere lo lasar opejorieki ilasarri tenebo ntokitin enyena, o eng'irra naitukuoreki o enkitotonet enye.

English: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.
Masaai: Nintisiny iyie ninche pee etum aataa sinyat tukul. Ore pooki naiseyie ninye neaku sinyati.

English: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Nibukoki Aron o layiok lenyena aitisiny ninche, pee aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak.

English: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Keaku ena eilata ai sinyati naputishoreki ti atua ishoritin inyi.

English: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
Masaai: Nemebukokini iseseni ake le pooki ng'ae, nimintayu ae nanyaanyukie te nkitobirunoto; kesinya ninye, naa keton esinya te iyie.

English: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Ore pooki tung'ani oitobira aitushulu ae nanyaanyukie, arashu pooki ng'ae opik ae te ninye oltung'ani le boo neiwuang'ieki ti atua iltung'ana lenyena.’ ”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Intayu intokitin naarropil, naaji natafi, o shekeli o kelbena; o ntokitin naarropil te nebo olbani osila nerisioroyu pooki.

English: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
Masaai: Intobira enkorropil naitushulaki te nkarriyiano, olaitobirani loo sonkoyoni natipikaki emunyan aasil neitisinyi;

English: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
Masaai: nindong iyie embata enye kiti oleng, nipik embata enye dukuya enchakenisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo te ine naatumore nanu iyie; neaku ninye te iyie sinyati oleng.

English: And as for the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkorropil nintayu te risioroto e enkitushulata enye, nimintayu te nkaraki intae maate, keaku ninye te ntae sinyati to Laitoriani.

English: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oitayu ae nanyaanyukie pee easishore anaa esonkoyo neiwuang'ieki ti atua iltung'ana lenyena.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
Masaai: “Ng'ura, aipoto nanu te nkarna e Besalel olayioni le Uri, olayioni le Huri, lo losho le Yuda:

English: And I have filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
Masaai: naiputa nanu ninye Enkiyang'et e Nkai, te nkidimata o te nkalamasisho, o te ng'eno o te nkarriyiano pooki.

English: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
Masaai: Pee eipiru mbaa e nkarriyiano, neasisho te sahabu, o te nkosholai o to suyai,

English: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
Masaai: te ndung'oto oo soito oopiki iwuejitin, o te nguetata oo nkeek, te siaai e nkarriyiano pooki.

English: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded thee;
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ategelua nanu te nebo ninye Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak, lo losho le Dan; naishoo nanu iltung'ana pooki oodupa enkidimata, pee etum aaitobira nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie:

English: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
Masaai: ilo ng'obor le ntumo, o ilo sanduku le nchakenisho, o ilo orika lo lng'ur otii enchumata enye, o masaa pooki e ilo ng'obor,

English: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
Masaai: emesa o ntokitin enyena, o ina kitashet o ltaa e sahabu nasila te nebo ntokitin enyena pooki, olperere le nkorropil,

English: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
Masaai: o ilo perere lo lasar opejori te nebo ntokitin, enyena pooki, o lmoti oitukuoreki o eneitotonieki enye,

English: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office,
Masaai: o lelo kilani ootiripuaki aaikod le Aron olapolosani, o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, te nkisiaayiare enye anaa ilapolosak,

English: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do.
Masaai: o ina ilata naputishoreki o enkorropil naisonkoyo e ine wueji sinyati. Anaa nena pooki naaitanapa iyie. Neas ninche.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ‘Embung'a Sabatoni aainei amu olmonekie ele te rishata ai o ntae ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere, nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny intae.

English: Ye shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defileth it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever doeth any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: Embung'a sabato amu eisinyati te ntae; ore pooki ng'ae oisarkionie neari metua; ore oltung'ani oasisho te ina olong neiwuang'ieki ninye ti atua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD: whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile easi esiaai kake ore enkolong e naapishana naa sabato e nkiyeng'iyeng naitisinyi, sinyati to Laitoriani; ore oltung'ani oas pooki siaai te nkolong e sabato neari metua.

English: Wherefore the children of Israel shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
Masaai: Metaa keibung iltung'ana loo Siraeli sabato, neing'or sabato ti atua iishoritin enye pooki, anaa osotua loo ntarasi.

English: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
Masaai: Olmonekie ele intarasi te rishata ai o ltung'ana loo Siraeli nchere too nkolong'i ile eitobira Olaitoriani keper o enkop; ore te nkolong e naapishana neidip esiaai neyeng'iyeng'a.’ ”

English: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of God.
Masaai: Neisho ninye Musa, ina kata pee eidip airorie te nchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai nena baoi are e nchakenisho, imbaoi o soit, naaigero tolkimojino le Nkai.

English: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana aajo eimutie Musa eitu elotu adou to ldoinyo, neiturrurro iltung'ana aasotokino Aron, nejoki ninye, “Inyo, intaiki iyiook nkaitin naapuo te dukuya iyiook, amu ore ele Musa, ele tung'ani laa ninye oyaua iyiook ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo iyiook enataase te ninye.”

English: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
Masaai: Nejoki Aron ninche, “Entayutu lelo giso le sahabu ootii nkiyiaa oo nkituaak inyi, o ilayiok linyi, o ntoyie inyi, nikiyakiki nanu.”

English: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
Masaai: Neitayu iltung'ana pooki ilgiso le sahabu ootii nkiyiaa enye, neyaki ninche Aron.

English: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neng'amu ninye ina sahabu too nkaik enye, neitobir te ntoki naguetishoreki, neitayu olashe le sahabu natosholaki; nejo ninche, “Kuna ninche nkaitin inyi, intae Isiraeli, naayautua aailepunye aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri!”

English: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Aron ena, neshetu ninye olperere lo laser te dukuya ninye; neitubulaa Aron ajo, “Ore taisere naa keaku osirua lo Laitoriani.”

English: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
Masaai: Neinyototo ninche aayooki taisere, neitayu ilasarri oopejori, neyau ilasarri le seriani; netoni iltung'ana aadaa neokisho, neinyototo aaiguran.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tadoi shomo; amu ore iltung'ana linono, laa ninche apa iyaua ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, neinyala ate aagil nkitanapat,

English: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: neibelekenyate aapaashaa aasioki aaing'uaa enkoitoi apa naa ninye aitanapa ninche; eitaikitia ate olashe oitobiruaki te sahabu nashola, neteserema ninche ninye neitaiki ninye olasar, nejo, ‘Kuna ninche nkaitin inyi intae Isiraeli, naa ninche naayautua intae aailepunye aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’ ”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Atoduaa kulo tung'ana, naa ng'ura, iltung'ana oosho murto

English: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
Masaai: ore naa tung'uayioki nanu, pee etum engoro ayupuyupo neirowuaju te ninche amu aidim aidaikie ninche, kake ore te iyie naitayu olorere kitok.”

English: And Moses besought the LORD his God, and said, LORD, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
Masaai: Kake etasayia Musa Olaitoriani Enkai enye nejo, “Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee eyupuyup engoro ino airowuaju te nkaraki iltung'ana linono laa ninche apa iyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri te ngolon sapuk o te nkaina e nkidimata?

English: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ejo Ilmisiri, e ntorroni apake eyiaraki ninche, pee eitupukuo alotu aar metuata too ldoinyo, nemut ninche aiwuang'ie ti oriong e nkop? Mbelekenyayu tapala engoro ino napi, nirridutena torroni te nkaraki iltung'ana linono.

English: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
Masaai: “Tadamu Abraham, o Isaak, o Isirael, isinkan linono, laa te ninche inosa olmumai te kewan ino, nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Kaponaa nanu eishoi ino anaa ilakir le shumata; ore ena kop pooki natonyorra aishoru, naa kaisho nanu eishoi ino nejung ninche ntarasi.’ ”

English: And the LORD repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
Masaai: Neirridu Olaitoriani ina torroni natadamua aitaas iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Musa, nelo adoyio to ldoinyo eeta mbaoi are e nchakenisho too nkaik enyena, mbaoi naaigero too nkaloli pokira are; eigero te nkalo nabo neigero te nkae alo.

English: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
Masaai: Ore nena soito dapashi naa esiaai e Nkai, ore ilkigerot naa ilkigerot le Nkai ootaguetakaki oriong nena soito dapashi.

English: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Yoshua ololepilepi loo ltung'ana ebuakita, nejoki ninye Musa, “Etii ololepilepi lo larrabal atua enkang oo lng'oborri.”

English: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
Masaai: Nejo, “Mme oltoilo le mbuakunoto e nkisulata arashu oltoilo le nkishirata e mirata, kake oltoilo le ranyare ilo laning'ito.”

English: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses' anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
Masaai: Ore ake enyiku aataaniki ilng'oborri nedol ilo ashe o sinkolio, neyupuyup engoro e Musa airowuaju nenang'aa ninye nena baoi too nkaik enyena, nebel ninche te ntonata o ldoinyo.

English: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
Masaai: Neya ninye ilo ashe oitobirutua ninche, nepejoo ninye te nkima, neidong aitaa empunyua, neidapashaki oriong enkare, neitook iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina are.

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Kainyoo kintaasa kulo tung'ana pee iyaua eng'oki sapuk shumata ninche?”

English: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
Masaai: Nejo Aron, “Mincho engoro o lkitok lai eyupuyup airowuaju; iyiolo iyie kulo tung'ana nchere eiulokinote entorroni.

English: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
Masaai: Amu aatiaakita ninche nanu, ‘Ntobiraki iyiook nkaitin, naapuo te dukuya iyiook; amu ore ele Musa, ilo tung'ani oyaua iyiook ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo iyiook enatotiwuo te ninye.’

English: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninche, ‘Enchoo pooki ng'ae oota sahabu eitayu,’ naaisho ninche nanu, nanang'aki nanu atua enkima, nepukunye ine ele ashe.”

English: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Musa ajo meekure eitoriayu iltung'ana (etapalayie Aron metaa meitoriayu, aitukurru ninche ti atua ilmang'ati lenye),

English: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
Masaai: neitoki Musa aitashe te nkishomi e ina ang oo lng'oborri, nejo, “Kaing'ae ole nkalo o Laitoriani? Wou enatii.” Neiturrurro ilayiok le Lawi maate te ine netii ninye.

English: And he said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Teena pooki ng'ae olalem te mpolos enye, nilo aman enkang oo lng'oborri pooki ebaiki kishomi o enkae kishomi ning'l ake ashukunye, taara pooki tung'ani olalashe lenye, o lencholuek enye olelatia enye.’ ”

English: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
Masaai: Neas ilayiok le Lawi te risioroto ororei le Musa; nebatata ina olong iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni.

English: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Ore taata nituputo ate te nkisiayiare o Laitoriani, pooki ng'ae te nkinyiang'a o layioni lenye o eno lalashe lenye, pee eisho ninye Enkai ntae emayianata ena olong taata.”

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the LORD; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
Masaai: Ore taisere nejoki Musa iltung'ana, “Itaasa intae eng'oki sapuk. Ore taata naa kailep alo enetii Olaitoariani; amu ebaiki naitobir olningo lo sotua te nkaraki ing'ok inyi.”

English: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
Masaai: Neaku enyaaka Musa ashuko alo enetii Olaitoriani nejo, “Wooi etaasa kulo tung'ana eng'oki torrono oleng; eitayutuo nkaitin te sahabu neserem ninche.

English: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin--; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
Masaai: Tapalaki sii ake ninche eng'oki enye; naa ti nimipalaki, tujutoki aatasayia ti atua ina buku ino apa niking'erie.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore pooki ng'ae otaasa eng'oki te nanu, ninye ajut enkarna enye ti atua embuku ai.

English: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
Masaai: Kake shomo taata toriko iltung'ana ine wueji apa naatiaaka; ng'ura, kelo olmalaika lai te dukuya iyie. Ore ake eyia, ore ina olong nabau nanu naitame ing'ok enye te shumata ninche.”

English: And the LORD plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Olaitoriani olmeitai iltung'ana, enkaraki naitayutuo ilo ashe oitayio Aron.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Entudumunye enchom, intae o lelo tung'ana apa liyaua ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, meshomo ina kop apa naa ninye ainosie olmumai pee aisho Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, ajoki ‘Eishoi inyi aisho ninye.’

English: And I will send an angel before thee; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
Masaai: Naa kairriwaa nanu olmalaika dukuya intae, naaraa nanu meshomo Ilkanaani, Ilamori, o Ilhiti, o Lperesi, Lhifi o Lyebusi.

English: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of thee; for thou art a stiffnecked people: lest I consume thee in the way.
Masaai: Elepa enchom ina kop naruko kule o naishi; kake malo nanu ti atua intae, maidaikie ake intae te nkoitoi, amu irara iltung'ana oosho murto.”

English: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana kulo onom torrok, neishir, nemetii oltung'ani oonyaaka apika imasaa enyena.

English: For the LORD had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Israel, Ye are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment, and consume thee: therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee, that I may know what to do unto thee.
Masaai: Amu etiaaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ‘Irara iltung'ana oosho murto; te nalo nanu te nkata nabo ti atua intae, naidaikie intae. Ore naa taata entayutu imasaa inyi entung'uai ate, pee ayiolou enaitaas intae.’ ”

English: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
Masaai: Metaa netupurro iltung'ana loo Siraeli ate too masaa enye, ebaiki oldoinyo le Horeb neito idia alo dukuya.

English: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought the LORD went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
Masaai: Naa kesesh apa eya Musa olng'obor nelo aun aitaman ina ang oo lng'oborri, nejo ninye olng'obor le ntumo. Ore pooki ng'ae oing'oru Olaitoriani neipang alo ilo ng'obor le ntumo otii auluo ina ang oo lng'oborri.

English: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
Masaai: Ore ake enkata naipang Musa alo olng'obor, neinyototo iltung'ana pooki aaitashe, neitashe ake oltung'ani te kutukaji o lng'obor lenye, neduaaya Musa ometaba anaa nejing atua ilo ng'obor.

English: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and the LORD talked with Moses.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee ejing Musa olng'obor, neirorie Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki ina ng'ape e nkatampoi eitashe te nkutuk o lng'obor, neinyototo iltung'ana pooki aaitashe aaserem, oltung'ani ake te kutuk aji o lng'obor lenye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaketh unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa eing'ura too nkomomi anaa oltung'ani te neirorie olchore lenye. Ore pee eitoki Musa ashuko alo atua ina ang oo lng'oborri, ore osinka lenye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo barnoti neitu elo aing'uaa ilo ng'obor.

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, See, thou sayest unto me, Bring up this people: and thou hast not let me know whom thou wilt send with me. Yet thou hast said, I know thee by name, and thou hast also found grace in my sight.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura ajo kitiaaka nanu, ‘Toriku kulo tung'ana ilepunye,’ kake eitu kincho nanu matayiolo ajo kaing'ae irriwaa te nebo nanu. Ninyaaka ajo, ‘Kaayiolo nanu iyie enkarna, ninoto sii kirotetisho too nkonyek aainei.’

English: Now therefore, I pray thee, if I have found grace in thy sight, shew me now thy way, that I may know thee, that I may find grace in thy sight: and consider that this nation is thy people.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, aatoomono, tenaa kanoto kirotetisho too nkonyek inono, ntoduaaki taata nanu inkoitoi inono, pee aatum nanu atayiolo iyie natum kirotetisho too nkonyek inono. Tadamu sii ajo ore ele osho naa iltung'ana linono.”

English: And he said, My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kalo nanu te nebo intae, naa kaisho nanu intae enkiyeng'iyeng.”

English: And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Enkai, “Ti nimilo iyie te nebo iyiook, miya iyiook aituang'uaa ene.

English: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight? is it not in that thou goest with us? so shall we be separated, I and thy people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: Amu kaji naa eikoni pee eyiolouni aajo anoto kirotetisho too nkonyek inono, nanu o ltung'ana linono? Aime ti nilo iyie te nebo iyiook, pee kimbalayu iyiook, nanu o ltung'ana linono too ltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop?”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken: for thou hast found grace in my sight, and I know thee by name.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ore nena baa nitejo naa kaas; amu inoto kirotetisho too nkonyek aainei, naa kaayiolo nanu iyie enkarna.”

English: And he said, I beseech thee, shew me thy glory.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Aatoomono nanu iyie ntoduaaki enkitoo ino.”

English: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Kaisho nanu enkishiaa ai pooki meshomo te dukuya iyie, naibalunye te dukuya iyie enkarna ai, ‘Olaitoriani’; naipirisie nanu ilo laipirisie naing'urrie ilo laing'urrie.”

English: And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kake mindim iyie atoduaa enkomom ai; amu meetae oltung'ani odol enkomom ai neishu.”

English: And the LORD said, Behold, there is a place by me, and thou shalt stand upon a rock:
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Ng'ura, etii ewueji te mbata nanu naa ninye intasheyie te shumata e ndapidapoi;

English: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
Masaai: naa ore ina kata kigiroo enkitoo ai naapik iyie olbaata le ina dapidapoi, naaimulumul nanu iyie te nkaina ino o metaba anaa nalusoo,

English: And I will take away mine hand, and thou shalt see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
Masaai: naitoki nanu aya enkaina ai, nikidol iyie nanu enkoriong ai, kake medoli enkomom ai.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tagueta isoito are dapashi naanyaanyukie inapa e dukuya, pee aiger nanu te nena soito dapashi irorei ootii nena soito dapashi e dukuya, apa nitebela.

English: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
Masaai: Tanapayu tadekenya, nilepu tadekenya alotu oldoinyo le Sinai, niyau kewan enatii te ine te nchumata o ldoinyo.

English: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani oilepu alotu te nebo iyie, naa nchoo metaa meetae oltung'ani odoli too doinyo pooki; nchoo eaku medaa nkishu o nkerrai te dukuya ilo doinyo.”

English: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the LORD had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
Masaai: Neguetu Musa mbaoi dapashi are oo soito naanyaanyukie inapa e dukuya, nedumunye ayooki tadekenya neilep alo enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye, neya te nkaina enye nena soito naagueta dapashi.

English: And the LORD descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Nedou Olaitoriani te nkatampoi neitashe te nebo ninye te ine neibalunye enkarna o Laitoriani.

English: And the LORD passed by before him, and proclaimed, The LORD, The LORD God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
Masaai: Neim Olaitoriani dukuya Musa nejo, “Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani, Enkai o lng'ur o empiris nemesioki agoro, nebore enyorrata nauno enkisiligata

English: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children's children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
Masaai: neibung enyorrata nauno too ltung'ana iip tomon, epalaki entorroni, o enkitarruoroto o eng'oki, kake mme oloikenaki oltung'ana loo ng'ok esipata tukul, naasujaki nkera ing'ok oo loo menye, o nkera oo nkera enye, o metabaiki eishoi e uni o eni ong'uan.”

English: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
Masaai: Neirrug Musa endukuya enye asioki metabaiki enkop, neserem.

English: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tenaa taata kanoto kirotetisho too nkonyek inono, Olaitoriani, nchoo Olaitoriani, aatomono iyie, shomo ti atua iyiook, hoo nikira iltung'ana oosho murto, nipalaki iyiook entorroni ang o ing'ok ang, niya iyiook mataa enjung'ore ino.”

English: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the LORD: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ng'ura, kaitayu nanu osotua. Ore te dukuya iltung'ana linono pooki naas nanu ine nking'asia, neitu ae kata easi ti atua enkop pooki arashu ti ae kop; ore lelo tung'ana litii iyie atua ninche nedol esiaai o Laitoriani; amu entoki naitureisho aitaas intae.

English: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
Masaai: “Imbung'a ina naaitanap iyie ena olong. Ng'ura, kaaraa nanu aipang'ie te dukuya intae Ilamori, Ilkanaani, Ilhiti, Ilperesi o Ilhifi, o Lyebusi.

English: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
Masaai: Toduaa ake kewan mintayu ake osotua o lelo oomanya enkop pooki nilo, meaku ake orreshet ti atua intae.

English: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
Masaai: Tusulaki enkop ilperereni loo lasarri lenye, nigil ing'apeta enye, nidung auroki enkop nena kitanyaanyukot naaji Asherim.

English: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
Masaai: (Amu miserem iyie ae Ai, amu ara Olaitoriani laa ore enkarna enye naa Olom, naa Enkai oo lom).

English: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
Masaai: Mintayu ake olning'o lelo oomanya enkop, amu te neas enkiborra oo nkonyek erubare nkaitin enye, nepolosaki ilasarri nkaitin enye, nikintoomon iyie obo lenye, nidaa iyie te ilo asar lenye,

English: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
Masaai: niya iyie intoyie enye ayamaki ilayiok linono, neas intoyie enkiborra oo nkonyek esujaa nkaitin enye neitasuroki ilayiok linono enkibor oo nkonyek esujaa nkaitin enye.

English: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
Masaai: “Mintobiraki kewan nkaitin oo ntokitin naatosholaki neidong'i.

English: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
Masaai: “Mbung'a osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki. Too nkolong'i naapishana inosa mukateni neitu eisuijieki, anaa enaaitanapa, te ina kata nategeluaki to lapa le Abibu; amu teilo apa apa iewuo aipang'u aing'uaa Misiri.

English: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
Masaai: Ore pooki natabolo enkoshoke e ng'otonye naa enaai, ilewa linono pooki, olbung'aiko loo nkishu, o lkikaunot pooki loo nkishu o loo nkerra.

English: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
Masaai: Ore olkikau lo sikiria niwalu to lkuoo le ker, arashu ti nimiwalu nigil emurt enye. Ore ilkikaunot pooki loo layiok linono niwalu akordu nemetii hoo obo olotu dukuya nanu meeta toki.

English: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
Masaai: “Too nkolong'i ile taasisho, kake ore te nkolong e naapishana niyeng'iyeng'a; ore te nkata e nkiremore o te nkisampuare niyeng'iyeng'a.

English: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year's end.
Masaai: Ning'or aibung osirua loo wikii, olng'anayio le dukuya le nkisampuare e nkano, osirua lenkiturrurrorre te siadi ari.

English: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.
Masaai: Katitin uni to lari eliooyu ilewa linono pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai, Enkai oo Siraeli.

English: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the LORD thy God thrice in the year.
Masaai: Amu kanang'aa nanu aiturraa iloreren te dukuya ntae; naitalala nanu ilpolosien linyi; nemetii oltung'ani ong'uar enkop inyi, ti nilepu alo alioyu te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino katitin uni tolari.

English: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
Masaai: “Mintayu ake osarge lo lasar lai te nebo entoki naisuijo, nimincho sii olasar lo sirua le Ngiroroto eirrag o mekenyu.

English: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother's milk.
Masaai: Ore lelo ng'anayio le dukuya ooituruku too lng'anayio le dukuya le nkop ino niyau atua enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ino. Nimiyierie olkuoo kule e ng'otonye.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ing'ero kulo rorei; te risioroto e kulo rorei aitayio osotua te nebo iyie o te nebo Isiraeli.”

English: And he was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
Masaai: Netii apa ninye ine te nebo Olaitoriani nkolong'i artam o nkewaritin artam, neitu enya emukate arashu eok enkare. Neiger ninye te nena soito dapashi irorei lo sotua, nena kitanapat tomon.

English: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses' hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
Masaai: Ore pee edou Musa to ldoinyo le Sinai, eeta mbaoi are dapashi e nchakenisho te nkaina enye elotu adou aing'uaa oldoinyo, neitu eyiolou Musa ajo etawang'a enkomom enye te nkaraki natigire airo te nebo Enkai.

English: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Aron o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli Musa, ng'ura, kewang enkomom enye, neureyu ninche epuonu aanyikaki ninye.

English: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
Masaai: Kake eipotuo Musa ninche; neshukokino ninye Aron o larikok pooki lo lorere, neiro Musa te nebo ninche.

English: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the LORD had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nepuonu aanyiku iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, neisho ninye ninche te nkitanapata nena pooki naairoro Olaitoriani te nebo ninye to ldoinyo le Sinai.

English: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Musa airorie ninche neitoip enkomom enye te nkarasha.

English: But when Moses went in before the LORD to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
Masaai: Kake ore ake tenelo Musa dukuya Olaitoriani airo te nebo ninye, neiwuang'ie ina arasha naitoipie enkomom, o metaba anaa nelotu boo; naa ore te nelotu boo neliki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina naitanapaki ninye,

English: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses' face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
Masaai: nedol iltung'ana loo Siraeli enkomom e Musa, neitoki Musa aitoip enkomom enye ometaba anaa nelo atua airo tenebo ninye.

English: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Israel together, and said unto them, These are the words which the LORD hath commanded, that ye should do them.
Masaai: Neiturrurru Musa olorere pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli nejoki ninche, “Kuna ninche ntokitin naaitanapa intae Olaitoriani entaas.

English: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to the LORD: whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death.
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile easi esiaai inyi, kake ore te nkolong e naapishana nitumutumu sabato sinyati e nkiyeng'iyeng to Laitoriani; ore pooki ng'ae oas esiaai te ina olong neari metua.

English: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
Masaai: Minokinoko enkima too nkajijik inyi te nkolong e sabato.”

English: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD commanded, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Musa olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, “Ena toki ninye eitanapishe Olaitoriani.

English: Take ye from among you an offering unto the LORD: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of the LORD; gold, and silver, and brass,
Masaai: Eyautu ti atua ntae enkishoroto eyaki Olaitoriani; ore pooki ng'ae oata oltau le leng'on nchoo ninye eyaki Olaitoriani enkishooroto; sahabu, o enkosholai o suyai;

English: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
Masaai: o iusin pusi, o morijo o mpilei o katani napuyiapui napiyaya; o lpapit loo nkineji,

English: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
Masaai: o ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o noo nkineji, o nkeek o lerai,

English: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
Masaai: o eilata oo ltaai, isonkoyoni te ina ilata naputishoreki, o te nkorropil naisonkoyo,

English: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
Masaai: oltoto barrikon, o ltoto pee epiki enkila dorrop o embene o lgoo.

English: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
Masaai: “Ninchosho pooki tung'ani oata enkidimata ti atua intae meetu aitobir nena pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani: olng'obor le Nkai,

English: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
Masaai: olng'obor lenye o entoki naitushurieki o enkitushurata enye, o lala oo lolo lenyena, o rubat enyena, o loom lenyena, ing'apeta enyena o neeitotonieki enyena;

English: The ark, and the staves thereof, with the mercy seat, and the vail of the covering,
Masaai: ilo sanduku o nkeek enyena, ilo orika lo lng'ur o ilo liatua lenye,

English: The table, and his staves, and all his vessels, and the shewbread,
Masaai: o ina mesa o mbokishi enyena o masaa enyena pooki, o ina mukate naitoduari;

English: The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,
Masaai: nena kitasheta oo ltaai sii te nkaraki ewang'an te nebo imasaa enyena o ltaai lenyena, o eilata o ltaa;

English: And the incense altar, and his staves, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle,
Masaai: olperere le nkorropil te nebo mbokishi enyena, o ina ilata naputishoreki o ina orropil naisonkoyo o ilo odung'oro le kutuk aji te kutuk aji o lng'obor le Nkai;

English: The altar of burnt offering, with his brasen grate, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
Masaai: ilo perere lo lasar opejori te nebo ina ng'esherrie enye o suyai, imbokishi enyena o ntokitin enyena pooki oilo moti oitukuoreki o eneitotonieki enye;

English: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and their sockets, and the hanging for the door of the court,
Masaai: o nena kisiong'at endung'oroto, ing'apeta enyena o neeitotonieki enyena o ilo odung'oroto le kishomi e ndung'oroto;

English: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
Masaai: nena sheito e nkaji e Nkai o nena sheito o olodung'oro, o nkeenta enye;

English: The cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest's office.
Masaai: nena kilani naaripuno aaitobiruno te nkaraki enkisiaayiare te wueji sinyati, lelo kilani oosinya le Aron ilo apolosani, o lelo kilani loo layiok lenyena, te nkisiayiare enye anaa ilapolosak.

English: And all the congregation of the children of Israel departed from the presence of Moses.
Masaai: Nepuo olorere pooki loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te ine netii Musa.

English: And they came, every one whose heart stirred him up, and every one whom his spirit made willing, and they brought the LORD'S offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation, and for all his service, and for the holy garments.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche, ore pooki ng'ae otudumua oltau lenye, o pooki otuputuo oltau lenye, neyau enkishoroto o Laitoriani pee easishoreki te ilo ng'obor le ntumo, o te nkisiayiare enye pooki, o te lelo kilani oosinya.

English: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche, ilewa o nkituaak; ore pooki oora ilo ltau le yieunoto neyau ilgameta, o lmiintoni, o lgiso, o mankek (isaen loo murto) o lkataarri, o ntokitin oo mpukunot pooki e sahabu eiteng'elaki ake pooki tung'ani Olaitoriani enkishoroto e sahabu Olaitoriani.

English: And every man, with whom was found blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair, and red skins of rams, and badgers' skins, brought them.
Masaai: Ore pooki tung'ani oinepuaki eeta iusin pusi arashu morijo, arashu mpilei arashu katani napuyiapui napiyaya, arashu ilpapit loo nkineji arashu ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi arashu inoo nkineji, neyau ninche.

English: Every one that did offer an offering of silver and brass brought the LORD'S offering: and every man, with whom was found shittim wood for any work of the service, brought it.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oidim aitayu enkishoroto e nkosholai arashu osuyai neyau anaa enkishoroto o Laitoriani; ore pooki tung'ani oinepuni eeta enchata o lerai naata tipat te siaai, neyau ninye.

English: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.
Masaai: Ore nkituaak pooki naata enkidimata napiyayisho too nkaik enye, neyau nena naapiyaya, too usin pusi, o morijo o mpilei o te katani sidai napuyiapui;

English: And all the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun goats' hair.
Masaai: ore nena kituaak pooki naatudumutua iltauja lenye te nkarriyiano nepiyai ilpapit loo nkineji.

English: And the rulers brought onyx stones, and stones to be set, for the ephod, and for the breastplate;
Masaai: Neyau ilarikok iltoto barrikon ooji oniks o soito pee epiki, te nkaraki enkila dorrop o ina bene o lgoo,

English: And spice, and oil for the light, and for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.
Masaai: o sonkoyoni o eilata te nkaraki ewang'an, o ina ilata naputishoreki, o enkorropil naisonkoyo.

English: The children of Israel brought a willing offering unto the LORD, every man and woman, whose heart made them willing to bring for all manner of work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Ore ilewa pooki o nkituaak, lelo tung'ana loo Siraeli, ootupututuo iltauja lenye eyau pooki toki te nkaraki ina siaai naitanapishe Olaitoriani te Musa metaasi neyau nkishorot enye olpela aaisho o Laitoriani.

English: And Moses said unto the children of Israel, See, the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
Masaai: Nejoki Musa iltung'ana loo Siraeli, “Eng'ura, eipoto Olaitoriani te nkarna Besalel olayioni le Uri, olayioni le Huri lo losho le Yuda;

English: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;
Masaai: neiputa Enkai ninye te nkiyang'et e Nkai, te nkidimata, o te nkalamasisho, o te ng'eno, o te nkarriyiano.

English: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
Masaai: Pee eipiru nkitobirat e nkarriyiano, neasisho te sahabu o te nkosholai o to suyai,

English: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work.
Masaai: te ndung'oto oo soito oopiki o te ng'uetata oo nkeek, te siaai e nkarriyiano pooki.

English: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye enkidimata enye naiteng'enishore, ninye te nebo o Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak lo losho le Dan.

English: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart, to work all manner of work, of the engraver, and of the cunning workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, and in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of them that do any work, and of those that devise cunning work.
Masaai: Eiputa ninye ninche te nkidimata metaasa empukunoto e siaai pooki naas laguetak loo soito, o ilasirak, o laripak loo usin pusi, o morijo o mpilei, o katani naapuyiapui napiyaya arashu ilashetak, te pooki pukunoto o laisiaayiani arashu olaipirunoni arriyia.

English: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD had commanded.
Masaai: “Ore Besalel o Oholiab o pooki tung'ani oota enkidimata, o enkalamasisho oishoo Olaitoriani metayiolo eneiko te neas pooki siaai e nchetare e ine wueji sinyati, neas te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani.”

English: And Moses called Bezaleel and Aholiab, and every wise hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even every one whose heart stirred him up to come unto the work to do it:
Masaai: Neipot Musa Besalel o Oholiab o pooki tung'ani oota enkidimata otipika Olaitoriani enkarriyiano o pooki ng'ae odumu oltau lenye meeu aas esiaai;
