English: And they received of Moses all the offering, which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, to make it withal. And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning.
Masaai: neng'amu ninche te Musa nena kishorunot pooki o lpela naayautua iltung'ana loo Siraeli pee easieki esiaai e ine wueji sinyati. Neitoki ake ninche aayaki ninye nkishorot olpela pooki akenya,

English: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
Masaai: o metaba anaa nepuonu lelo tung'ana pooki oata enkidimata apa oasita esiaai e mpukunoto pooki te ine wueji sinyati, oltung'ani ake te ina siaai apa naasita,

English: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
Masaai: nejoki Musa, “Ekeyau iltung'ana ntokitin kumok oleng naalusoo te asata e ina siaai apa naitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani mataas.”

English: And Moses gave commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, Let neither man nor woman make any more work for the offering of the sanctuary. So the people were restrained from bringing.
Masaai: Neishoru Musa enkitanapata, neitubulari olomoni ti atua ina ang oo lng'oborri, aajo “Mincho olee arashu enkitok eitoki aas ae toki ti alo nkishorot e ine wueji sinyati.” Neiboori iltung'ana pee meitoki aayau.

English: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it, and too much.
Masaai: Amu ore ntokitin naata ninche naa keidip neasieki esiaai pooki, neleku.

English: And every wise hearted man among them that wrought the work of the tabernacle made ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work made he them.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki oata enkidimata ti atua lelo oasisho neitobir enkaji e Nkai too lkarash tomon; neitayu te katani napuyiapui napiyaya o too usin pusi, o morijo o mpilei, o lkerubi oitayioki te nkarriyiano.

English: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: the curtains were all of one size.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro o lkarasha obo naa intemat tikitam o isiet, ore endapasho naa intemat ong'uan; nerisio ilkarash pooki te nkadoro.

English: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
Masaai: Neitutum ninye ilkarash imiet te nebo ore ilkulikae karash imiet neitutum te nebo.

English: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
Masaai: Neitayu ilidat oo lgoso pusi te manaroto e nkalo e oriong o lkarasha te ina tukus e dukuya; neitoki aiko neijia, neitayu ninche, te manaroto e oriong oo lkarash te ina tukus e dukuya; neitoki aiko neijia, neitayu ninche, te manaroto e oriong o lkarasha te ina tukus e are;

English: Fifty loops made he in one curtain, and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second: the loops held one curtain to another.
Masaai: neitayu ninye ilidat oolgoso onom to lkarasha obo, neitoki aitayu ilidat oo lgoso onom te manaroto o lkarasha le ina tukus e are; ore nena lidat oo lgoso naa keipirakino maate.

English: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilala oo lolo onom le sahabu, neitutumie lelo karash te nebo te lelo gameta; metaa ore ina aji e Nkai naa nabo.

English: And he made curtains of goats' hair for the tent over the tabernacle: eleven curtains he made them.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilkarash loo lpapit loo nkineji te nkaraki olng'obor meitushura enkaji e Nkai; neitayu ninye ilkarash tomon o obo.

English: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain: the eleven curtains were of one size.
Masaai: Ore ake enkadoro e pooki karasha naa intemat tomoni uni, naa ore ake endapasho e pooki karasha naa intemat ong'uan; ore lelo karash tomon o obo nerisio.

English: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
Masaai: Neitutum ninye ilkarash imiet maate, o lkarash ile maate.

English: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
Masaai: Neitayu ilidat oolgoso onom te manaroto e nkalo e oriong olkarasha le ntukus nabo, olgoso onom te manaroto olikae eitutum ilkarash.

English: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilala oololo onom lo suyai pee eitutumie olng'obor te nebo pee etum ataa entoki nabo tukul.

English: And he made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of badgers' skins above that.
Masaai: Neitaiki ninye ilo ng'obor eneitushurieki too ndapan naanota oo lmeregeshi, o ndapan oo nkineji.

English: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood, standing up.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye, aitobir irubat oo sunta naaitashe eilo ng'obor le Nkai too nkeek o lerai.

English: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
Masaai: Intemat tomon apa enkadoro e rubata nabo naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho e rubata.

English: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neeta pooki rubata ilng'amat are, ooiruburubieki te nebo; neas ninye ena too rubat oosunta pooki e ilo ng'obor le Nkai.

English: And he made boards for the tabernacle; twenty boards for the south side southward:
Masaai: Neitayu ninye irubat e ilo ng'obor le Nkai aikunu nji; irubat tikitam te nkalo e kopikop,

English: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
Masaai: neitobir ninye nkitotoneta artam e nkosholai ti abori nena rubat tikitam, nkitotoneta are ti abori erubata nabo too lng'amat lenyena aare, o nkitotoneta are ti abori olikae liatua too rubat enyena pokira are.

English: And for the other side of the tabernacle, which is toward the north corner, he made twenty boards,
Masaai: Ore te nchoto e are e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, te nkalo e moikuape, neitayu ninye irubat tikitam

English: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
Masaai: o nkitotoneta enye artam e nkosholai are ti abori erubata nabo o nkitotoneta are ti abori enkae rubata.

English: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.
Masaai: Ore tioriong e ilo ng'obor le Nkai te nkalo o loontoluo neitobir irubat ile.

English: And two boards made he for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye irubat are too lpijat lo ng'obor le Nkai tioriong.

English: And they were coupled beneath, and coupled together at the head thereof, to one ring: thus he did to both of them in both the corners.
Masaai: Naa kerisha apa ti abori kake eibung'a te shumata, to lgisoi le dukuya; neitayu ninye pokira are aikunu inji, too lpijat pokira aare.

English: And there were eight boards; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver, under every board two sockets.
Masaai: Era apa irubat isiet te nebo nkitotoneta enye e nkosholai nkitotoneta, tomon o ile, ore tiabori erubata nabo, naa nkitotoneta are.

English: And he made bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
Masaai: Neitayu ninye iloom lo lerai, iloom imiet too rubat te nkalo nabo e ilo ng'obor le Nkai,

English: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
Masaai: o loom imiet te nkae shoto e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, o loom imiet too rubat e ilo ng'obor le Nkai tioriong te nkalo o loontoluo.

English: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye oloomi le polos pee eimieki ebaiki enkalo nabo o metabaiki enkae aitorit alo irubat.

English: And he overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.
Masaai: Nemur ninye nena rubat te sahabu, neitayu ilgiso lenye le sahabu too laibung'ak le lelo loom, nemur lelo loom te sahabu.

English: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye oliatua lolkarasha loo usin pusi, o morijo, o mpilei, o katani napuyiapui napiyaya; o lkerubi ooitobiruaki te nkarriyiano.

English: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold: their hooks were of gold; and he cast for them four sockets of silver.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ninye neitayu ing'apeta ong'uan o lerai nemuraa ninche te sahabu; ore ilala oololo lenye naa ile sahabu neiteleiki ninche nkitotoneta ong'uan e nkosholai.

English: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;
Masaai: Neitayu sii olkarasha le kutukaji te nkaraki kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor, too nkarash naaripuno too usin pusi, o morijo, o mpilei o enkatani napuyiapui napiyaya, naikodo te siaai o ltidu;

English: And the five pillars of it with their hooks: and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold: but their five sockets were of brass.
Masaai: o ng'apeta enyena pokira imiet te nebo ilala lenyena oololo, nemuraa enchumata enye o nkeek enye te sahabu, kake ore nkitotoneta enye pokira imiet naa ino suyai.

English: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
Masaai: Neitayu Besalel osanduku loo nkeek o lerai, intemat are o lpisiai enkadoro, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho enye, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai enkilepata enye.

English: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
Masaai: Nemur ninye te sahabu nasila atua o oriong nepik enkamanaa e sahabu aitaman.

English: And he cast for it four rings of gold, to be set by the four corners of it; even two rings upon the one side of it, and two rings upon the other side of it.
Masaai: Neitayu ilgiso oong'uan oonapieki le sahabu neibung'ie ninche lelo pijat lenyena pokira oong'uan, etii ake ilgiso aare enkalo nabo netii ilgiso aare enkae alo.

English: And he made staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Masaai: Neitayu imbokishi naanapieki o lerai, nemur ninche te sahabu,

English: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
Masaai: nepik mbokishi lelo giso te pooki shoto e ilo sanduku pee enapieki ilo sanduku.

English: And he made the mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half was the length thereof, and one cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olorika lo lng'ur le sahabu nasila, intemat are o lpisiai enkadoro enye naa entemata nabo o lpisiai endapasho enye.

English: And he made two cherubims of gold, beaten out of one piece made he them, on the two ends of the mercy seat;
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu ilkerubi aare ooidong'uno te sahabu, neitayu ninche too matuan pokira are e ilo orika lo lng'ur,

English: One cherub on the end on this side, and another cherub on the other end on that side: out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
Masaai: nepik olkerubi bayie nabo, nepik olikae kerubi enkae bayie; te ntoki nabo o ilo orika lo lng'ur eitobira ninye lelo kerubi too matuan enyena pokira are.

English: And the cherubims spread out their wings on high, and covered with their wings over the mercy seat, with their faces one to another; even to the mercy seatward were the faces of the cherubims.
Masaai: Nelak lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aaitorioo, neitoip ilo orika lo lng'ur too naipuko enye eing'ura inkomomi enye maate, neing'or inkomomi e lelo kerubi ilo orika lo lng'ur.

English: And he made the table of shittim wood: two cubits was the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof:
Masaai: Neitoki sii aitayu emesa too nkeek o lerai; intemat are enkadoro, naa entemata nabo endapasho, naa entemata nabo o lpisiai enkilepata;

English: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
Masaai: neimulumul ninye te sahabu nasinya, nepik enkamanaa e sahabu aitaman.

English: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
Masaai: Nepik aitaman erubata naba anaa endap e nkaina te ndapasho nepik enkamanaa e sahabu ina rubata.

English: And he cast for it four rings of gold, and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye ilgiso oong'uan le sahabu neeniki lelo giso lelo pijat pokira oong'uan too nkejek enyena.

English: Over against the border were the rings, the places for the staves to bear the table.
Masaai: Netaaniki lelo giso ina rubata, ilooibung mbokishi naanapie ina mesa.

English: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold, to bear the table.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye imbokishi oo nkeek o lerai pee enapieki ina mesa, nemuraa ninche te sahabu.

English: And he made the vessels which were upon the table, his dishes, and his spoons, and his bowls, and his covers to cover withal, of pure gold.
Masaai: Neitoki aitayu ntokitin e sahabu nasila naa ninche epiki enchumata emesa o isaanini enyena, o ngirran o enkorropil, o lbakulini o siang'aun naapikunyeki olasar obukuni.

English: And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:
Masaai: Neitoki sii aitayu enkitashet o ltaa e sahabu nasila. Ore enkitotonata enye o empolos enkitashet neitayuni te siaai e nkidong'ore; ore inkikompeni enyena, o rubat enyena, o ntapuka enyena naaentoki nabo.

English: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
Masaai: Netii apa ilng'osil ile ooipang'u too murten enyena, neipang'u ilng'osil okuni le ina kibung'et o ltaa te nkae alo enye.

English: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch, a knop and a flower; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch, a knop and a flower: so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick.
Masaai: Netii nkikompeni uni naaitayioki aaikunu anaa ilgululu, meetae ake ene meeta endukuya e entapukai, o lng'osila o nkikompeni uni naaitayioki aaikunu anaa ilgululu, meetae ake ene meeta endukuyao entapukai to likae ng'osila; nepuo lelo ng'osil pokira ile aaipang te ina kitashet o ltaa.

English: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
Masaai: Ore te ina kibung'et o ltaa kewan, netii nkikompeni naaitayioki aaikunu anaa ilgululu lo lchani onyaanyukie oseki, te nebo ilukuny enye o ntapuka enye,

English: And a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches going out of it.
Masaai: netii ake elukunya e rubata nabo te nebo ninye ti abori ilng'osil oare ooiriamari te lelo ng'osil ile oipang'u te ninye.

English: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
Masaai: Ore lukuny enye o lng'osil lenye naa entoki nabo; ore pooki umata naa entoki nabo e siaai enkidong'ore e sahabu nasila.

English: And he made his seven lamps, and his snuffers, and his snuffdishes, of pure gold.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu iltaai lenyena oopishana, o ntokitin naarieki iltaai lenye o ngirran dapashi enyena e sahabu nasila.

English: Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye te nebo ntokitin enyena pooki te ntalanta e sahabu nasila.

English: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood: the length of it was a cubit, and the breadth of it a cubit; it was foursquare; and two cubits was the height of it; the horns thereof were of the same.
Masaai: Neitayu olperere lo lasar le nkorropil too nkeek o lerai; ore enkadoro enye naa entemata nabo naa entemata nabo endapasho, naa kerisioro apa, naa intemat are enkilepata; ore apa imouarak enyena naa entoki nabo o ninye.

English: And he overlaid it with pure gold, both the top of it, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns of it: also he made unto it a crown of gold round about.
Masaai: Nemur ninye te sahabu nasila, enchumata enye, o matuan enyena aitaman, o mowuarak enyena; neitoki aitayu enkamanaa e sahabu aitaman,

English: And he made two rings of gold for it under the crown thereof, by the two corners of it, upon the two sides thereof, to be places for the staves to bear it withal.
Masaai: neitoki aitayu ilgiso aare le sahabu apik ti abori enkamanaa, too nkaloli enyena naaipirakino, pee eibung nena bokishi naanapieki.

English: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with gold.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye imbokishi o lerai nemuraa ninche te sahabu.

English: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
Masaai: Neitayu sii ninye eilata nasinya naputishoreki enkorropil naisonkoyo naaitushula olaitobirani loo sonkoyoni.

English: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olperere lo lasar opejori too nkeek o lerai; naa intemat imiet apa enkadoro enye naa intemat imiet endapasho, naa kerisioro apa, naa intemat uni enkilepata.

English: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
Masaai: Neitaiki ninye imowuarak too lpijat lenyena pokira oong'uan; ore nena mowuarak enyena naa entoki nabo o ninye, nemur ninye to suyai.

English: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye ntokitin pooki o lperere lo lasar, imotioo, o inkisureta, o ngirran, o nkurteta o nena kiyuketa e nkima; ore nena tokitin enyena pooki neitobiru ninye to suyai.

English: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.
Masaai: Neitaiki ninye ilo perere lo lasar eng'esherrie, naitobiruno to suyai ti abori elutoroto enye, aitoritie olperere lo lasar ti abori.

English: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ilgiso oong'uan ilpijat pokira oong'uan o lpijat le ina ng'esherrie o suyai pee eibung nena ong'uan oo lpijat le ina ng'esherrie o suyai pee eibung nena bokishi;

English: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.
Masaai: neitobir ninye too imbokishi oo nkeek o lerai, nemur ninche to suyai.

English: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.
Masaai: Neimie ninye nena bokishi atua lelo giso too murten e ilo perere lo lasar, pee enapieki ninche; neitobir too mbaoi aitugum.

English: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olmoti lo suyai oitukuoreki o ina kitotonet enye o suyai, naitayioki too nking'ureta e nena kituaak apa naaisiaaisho te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:
Masaai: Neitayu ninye endung'oroto, te nkalo e kopikop, ore nena kisiong'at e ndung'oroto naa katani napuyiapui napiyaya;

English: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.
Masaai: nera ing'apeta enye tikitam naa tikitam nena kitotoneta o suyai, kake ore ilala oo lolo le nena ng'apeta o nena keek enye naa ine enkosholai.

English: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo e moikuape naa intemat iip naa tikitam ing'apeta enye; ore nkitotoneta enye naa tikitam, o suyai, kake ore ilala oo lolo loo ng'apeta, ore irubat enyena naa ine nkosholai.

English: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo o loontoluo netii ilkarash oo isiong'a loo ntemat onom, o ng'apeta enye o neeitotonieki tomon; o neegum tomon ore iyasheta loo ng'apeta o rubat enye naa ene nkosholai.

English: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong, naa intemat onom.

English: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Masaai: Ore ilkarash ooisiong'a te ntaloishi nabo e kishomi naa intemat tomon o imiet, o ng'apeta uni o nkitotoneta uni.

English: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
Masaai: Ore, e nkae matua; tena aina o tenda aina te mbata e kishomi e ndung'oroto netii ilkarash ooisiong'a loo ntemat tomon o imiet te nebo ing'apeta uni o nkitotoneta uni.

English: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
Masaai: Ore lelo karash pooki ooisiong'a oomanita le ndung'oroto naa ile nkatani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
Masaai: Ore ntoneta oo ng'apeta naa ino suyai, kake ore ilala oo lolo loo ng'apeta o rubat enye naa ine nkosholai; ore enkimulumulata oo lukuny enye naa te nkosholai ake sii; ore ing'apeta pooki e ilopaashe neiruburubaki te nkosholai.

English: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
Masaai: Ore olkarasha le kishomi le ndung'oroto neikoduno te siaai o ltidu te usi pus o emorijoi o empile o enkatani napuyiapui napiyaya intemat tikitam enkadoro naa intemat imiet endapasho eilep, enyaanyukie ilkarash ooisiong'a le ina dung'oroto.

English: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
Masaai: Ore ing'apeta enye naa ong'uan; ore nkitotoneta enye pokira ong'uan naa suyai, o lala o lolo lenye le nkosholai, o emurata oo lukuny enye o rubat enye e nkosholai.

English: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
Masaai: Ore ncheito pooki e ilo ng'obor le Nkai o ne ina dung'oroto naamanaa naa ino suyai.

English: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ena esiana oo ntokitin e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho, anaa enaikenaki te ina kitanapata e Musa, te nkisiayiare oo Lawi ti abori erubaroto e Isamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.

English: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Besalel olayioni le Uri olayioni le Huri lo losho le Yuda, oitobira nena pooki naaitanapa Enkai Musa;

English: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
Masaai: ore te nebo ninye netii Oholiab olayioni le Ahisamak lo losho le Dan, olaitobirunoni o laipirunoni naa olaikodoni too usin pusi, o morijo o mpilei o katani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore ina sahabu apa nataasishoreki te siaai, te nchetare pooki e wueji sinyati teina sahabu naishorutua iltung'ana, naa talanta tikitam ooudo o shekeli iip naapishana o tomoni uni te risioroto eshekeli e wueji sinyati.

English: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
Masaai: Ore enkosholai naing'uaa olorere pooki apa ooikenaki, naa talanta iip nabo o imiet, te risioroto e shekeli e wueji sinyati.

English: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
Masaai: Beka nabo te lukunya, aa taa (olpisiai le shekeli te risioroto e wueji sinyati) te pooki ng'ae apa oikenaki, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, too ltung'ana iip ile, o nkalifuni uni, o iip imiet oonom.

English: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
Masaai: Ore ntalantani iip e nkosholai naa inaaitobirieki apa nkitotoneta e wueji sinyati, o nkitotoneta e ilo karasha le ndung'oroto nera iip too ntalantani iip e ntalanta ake te nkitotonet.

English: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
Masaai: Ore too shekeli enkalifu o iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o imiet neitobir ilala oo lolo te nkaraki ing'apeta nemur ilukuny enye neitobiraki ninche irubat.

English: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
Masaai: Ore ilo suyai apa oishoruaki naa ntalantani ntomoni naapishana, o shekeli nkalifuni are o iip ong'uan;

English: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
Masaai: naa ninche eitobirie ninye nkitotoneta te nkaraki kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, olperere lo lasar lo suyai o eng'esherrie o suyai te nkaraki ninye o ntokitin pooki e ilo perere lo lasar;

English: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
Masaai: o nkitotoneta naamanita ina dung'oroto o nkitotoneta e kishomi e ina dung'oroto, o ncheito pooki o lng'obor le Nkai, o ncheito pooki naamanaa te dung'oroto.

English: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore too usin pusi o morijo o mpilei neitobir ninche te nkarriyiano ilkilani sidain, pee eisiaaishoreki te wueji sinyati; neitobir ninche lelo kilani oosinya te nkaraki Aron; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye enkila dorrop e sahabu, too usin pusi o morijo o mpilei, o katani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
Masaai: Neidong ninche sahabu aaitadapash neboru nkorin ronkeni pee easishoreki aaitobirie ina arasha sidai, o nena tokitin pusi o morijo o mpilei, o katani napuyiapui napiyaya te nkarriyiano.

English: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
Masaai: Neitobir te nkaraki ina kila dorrop irubat oo ronyi, neitutumieki ninye ilcholo lenyena pokira are.

English: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore ina kimeita narripuno te nkarriyiano neenieki ninye, pee eibung ninye, naa te nena tokitin eripuno o te ina arriyiano, te sahabu o usin pusi o morijo o mpilei, o katani napuyiapui napiyaya nashetuno anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neirragie isoito barrikon ooji oniks neikodi te sahabu, nepiki te nkarriyiano te nebo nkarn oo layiok le Isirael.

English: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ninche imatuan pokira are oo ronyi le ina kila dorrop, pee eaku soito oodamishoreki te nkaraki ilayiok le Isirael; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye enkila o lgoo te siaai e nkarriyiano, anaa ina kila dorrop te sahabu o usin pusi o morijo o mpilei, o katani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
Masaai: Nerisioro apa nkaloli pooki; ore apa ina kila o lgoo naa katitin are, entemata e ndap enkadoro naa entemata e ndap endapasho katitin are.

English: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
Masaai: Nepik atua ilkererin oong'uan loo soito. Olkereri loo ltoto barrikon, o oltoto sikitok, oltoto oonyori, olkereri le dukuya.

English: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
Masaai: Ore olkereri liaare naa iltoto oonyori, iltoto pusi ooitiil o ltoto sidain ooji almasi;

English: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
Masaai: ore olkereri li okuni naa iltoto pilei, osoit oji agate iltoto oowang o ltoto sinteti;

English: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
Masaai: ore olkereri li ong'uan naa iltoto oonyori, o iltoto barrikon, ooji oniks o ltoto pusi; neripakino apa kuna te sahabu.

English: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
Masaai: Kulo apa iltoto tomon aare o nkarn enye anaa nkarn oo layiok le Israel; netiu apa anaa ilmishiren, meeta ake olemeguetakino enkarna enye, too loshon pokira tomon aare.

English: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
Masaai: Neitobir ninche te ina kila o lgoo ilpisia oo ooipila oikununo anaa nkeenta, le sahabu nasila;

English: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: nepik ilkererin aare le sahabu o lgiso aare le sahabu, nepik ilgiso ilpijat pokira aare le ina kila olgoo;

English: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
Masaai: nepik ninche nena keenta are e sahabu atua lelo giso pokira aare ootii ilpijat pokira aare le ina kila o lgoo.

English: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
Masaai: Ore nkiting'ot pokira are e nena keenta neibung'ieki lelo kererin pokira aare; neiko neijia aaibung'ie te nkalo e dukuya ooronyi le ina kila dorrop.

English: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaitobir ilgiso aare le sahabu, nepik ninche ilcholo pokira aare le ina kila o lgoo te nkalo enye e atua te mbata e ina kila dorrop.

English: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche ilgiso aare le sahabu, neibung'ie te nkalo e dukuya ti abori ironyi pokira aare le ina kila dorrop.

English: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neitutum ina kila o lgoo too lgiso lenyena o lelo giso le nkila dorrop te nkeene pus, metaa kepetita ina kimeita narripuno te nkarriyiano ina kila dorrop, pee melolong'u ake te ina kila dorrop; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
Masaai: Neitoki sii aitobir olkila oodo li atua ina kila dorrop laa eipus emua;

English: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
Masaai: ore ine neimieki endukuya te ilo kila oodo neikununo anaa enenkila, neeta erripata namanaa pee mepolosa.

English: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
Masaai: Ore erripata e abori e ilo kila oodo neripakini ilonyek oopurupurana too usin pusi, o morijo ompilei o katani napuyiapui napiyaya.

English: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
Masaai: Neitoki sii aitobir ntualan e sahabu nasila, nepik nena tualan errishata oo lonyek oopurupurana te ina manaroto e abori erripata o lkila;

English: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: entuala o long'u, o entuala o long'u emanaa te ripata e abori olkila te nkaraki enkisiaayiare; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
Masaai: Neitoki sii aaitobir Ilkilani li oriong te nkarasha napiyaya te nkaraki Aron o layiok lenyena,

English: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
Masaai: o ina arasha naenieki endukuya naitobiruno te katani napuyiapui te nkarasha naripuno sidai, o maupen e katani napuyiapui o nena kilani e atua e katani napuyiapui;

English: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: o enkimeita e katani napuyiapui napiyaya naripa too usin pusi, o morijo, o mpilei naikodo te siaai o ltidu; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaitobir enchili e sahabu nasila e ilo marisian sinyati nesiraki ninye enkarna anaa enkarna nataguetakaki to lmishire, “Sinyati to Laitoriani.”

English: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neeniki ninche ninye te nkeene pus, aakurraki shumata ina arasha naeniki endukuya; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
Masaai: Neidipayu esiaai pooki e ilo ng'obor le Nkai; o ilo ng'obor le ntumo, netaasa iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa; neaku etaasa ninche.

English: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
Masaai: Neyau ninche ilo ng'obor enetii Musa, ilo ng'obor o ntokitin enyena pooki, o lala lenyena oo lolo, o rubat oo isunta enyena, o loom lenyena, o ng'apeta enyena, o nkitotoneta enyena;

English: And the covering of rams' skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers' skins, and the vail of the covering,
Masaai: nena dapan naanota oo lmeregeshi o noo nkineji naaitushurieki o lkarash lo liatua oodung'ieki;

English: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
Masaai: o sanduku le nchakenisho o nkeek enyena, o lorika lo lng'ur;

English: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
Masaai: o emesa te nebo imasaa enyena pooki, o emukate e nkitoduaroto;

English: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
Masaai: o enkibung'et oo ltaai le sahabu nasila o ltaai lenyena te nebo ntukusi oo ltaai o ntokitin enye pooki, o eilata oo ltaai;

English: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
Masaai: olperere lo lasar le sahabu, o eilata naputishoreki o enkorropil naisonkoyo o lkarasha oisiong'a le kutuk aji o lng'obor,

English: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
Masaai: ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai o eng'esherrie enye o suyai, o mbokishi o ntokitin enyena pooki; o ilo moti oitukuoreki o enkitotonet enye;

English: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
Masaai: lelo karash ooisiong'a le ndung'oroto o ng'apeta enyena, o nkitotoneta enyena, o lkarash le kishomi e ndung'oroto, o inkeenta enyena o ncheito enyena; o masaa pooki te nkisiayiare e ilo ng'obor le Nkai; o ilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons' garments, to minister in the priest's office.
Masaai: lelo kilani ooitobiruno te nkisiayiare e wueji sinyati; lelo kilani oosinya le Aron olapolosani, o Ilkilani loo layiok lenyena pee easisho anaa ilapolosak.

English: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel made all the work.
Masaai: Anaa nena pooki apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa esiaai pooki, naa ng'ura, etaasa ninche; anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani, neaku etaasa ninche ina. Nemayian Musa ninche.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya tesheta iyie olng'obor le Nkai o ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
Masaai: Nipik atua ilo sanduku le nchakenisho, nidung'oo ilo sanduku to lkarasha loliaatua.

English: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
Masaai: Nintijing'u emesa, nipik ntokitin enyena aitobiraki; niyau nkitasheta oo ltaai nipik iltaai lenyena.

English: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nipik olperere lo lasar le sahabu o enkorropil dukuya ilo sanduku le nchakenisho, nintoki apik enkarasha e kutuk aji o lng'obor le Nkai.

English: And thou shalt set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
Masaai: Nipik olperere lo lasar opejori dukuya kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le Nkai ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shalt put water therein.
Masaai: nipik ilo moti oitukuoreki erishata e ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, nipik enkare.

English: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
Masaai: Nintoki apik endung'oroto aitaman, niik olkarasha le kishomi e ndung'oroto.

English: And thou shalt take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shalt hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu eilata naputishoreki, nibukoki ilo ng'obor le Nkai o pooki toki natii atua, nintisiny ninye o masaa enyena pooki; naa keaku ninye sinyati.

English: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
Masaai: Nintoki sii abukoki eilata olperere lo lasar opejori o ntokitin enyena pooki, nintisiny ilo perere naa kesinyayu ilo perere oleng.

English: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
Masaai: Nintoki sii abukoki eilata ilo moti oitukuoreki o eneitotonieki, nintisiny ninye.

English: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
Masaai: Nintoki ariku Aron o layiok lenyena kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nintuku ninche te nkare.

English: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest's office.
Masaai: Ninchopoki Aron ilkilani oosinya, nibukoki ninye eilata aput, nikinteng'elaki ninye, peyie aatum aisiaya anaa olapolosani.

English: And thou shalt bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
Masaai: Niriku sii ilayiok lenyena ninchopoki ninche ilkilani,

English: And thou shalt anoint them, as thou didst anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest's office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
Masaai: nibukoki ninche eilata aput, anaa enituputo menye lenye pee aatum aaisiaayia anaa ilapolosak; ore ina putoto embukokinoto enye e ilata neng'amari ninche metaa ilapolosak nkatitin pooki ti atua iishoritin enye pooki.”

English: Thus did Moses: according to all that the LORD commanded him, so did he.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Musa; te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye, neaku etaasa ninye.

English: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le dukuya to lari li aare, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, neitasheyieki olng'obor le Nkai.

English: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
Masaai: Neshet Musa olng'obor le manyisho e Nkai; neirragie nkitotoneta enyena, nepik irubat oo sunta enyena, nepik imbokishi enyena, neun ing'apeta enyena;

English: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: neisalaash olkarasha te shumata o lng'obor le Nkai neitushur o lng'obor shumata ninye, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
Masaai: Neya ninye ina shakenisho nepik atua osanduku, nepik nkeek ilo sanduku nepik ilo orika lo lng'ur enchumata e ilo sanduku;

English: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: neitoki ayau ninche osanduku atua ilo ng'obor le Nkai, nepik ilkarash le ndung'oroto nedung'oo ilo sanduku le nchakenisho; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoariani Musa.

English: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
Masaai: Nepik ninye emesa atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nkalo e moikuape e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ti oriong ilo karasha lo liatua,

English: And he set the bread in order upon it before the LORD; as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Masaai: nepik emukate aitobiraki te nchumata enye te dukuya Olaitoriani; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
Masaai: Nepik ninye nkitasheta oo ltaai atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, enkipirakinoto eina mesa te nkalo e kopikop e ilo ng'obor le Nkai.

English: And he lighted the lamps before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Nepik iltaai te dukuya Olaitoriani; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
Masaai: Nepik ninye olperere lo lasar le sahabu atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo te dukuya ilo karasha lo liatua,

English: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: nepej te ine enkorropil naisonkoyo tenchumta enye anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nepik ilkarash oodung'oo kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le manyisho e Nkai.

English: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninye olperere lo lasar opejori kutuk aji eilo ng'obor le Nkai oilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitayu te nchumata enye olasar opejori o lasar le nkurma naidong'o; anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ilo moti oitukuoreki erishata e ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, nepik enkare naitukuoreki;

English: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
Masaai: naa ninye eisujie Musa o Aron o layiok lenyena nkaik enye o nkejek enye;

English: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: te nepuo ninche atua olng'obor le ntumo naa te neetaniki ninche olperere lo lasar, neitukuo; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
Masaai: Neitasheyie ninye endung'oroto aitaman ilo ng'obor le Nkai o lperere lo lasar nepik ninye olkarasha te kishomi e ina dung'oroto. Neaku eidipa Musa esiai.

English: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neitoki enkatampoi aitoip ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neiput enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.

English: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neitu eidim Musa atijing'a atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, amu etobikie enkatampoi shumata ninye, neiput enkitoo o Laitoriani ilo ng'obor.

English: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:
Masaai: Ore tiatua ilotot enye pooki, enkata ake nayae ina atampoi aaiwuang'ie teilo ng'obor, nepuo iltung'ana loo Siraeli dukuya;

English: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
Masaai: kake teneitu eyae ina atampoi aailepie, neitu ninche epuo, ometabau ina olong nayae aailepie.

English: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.
Masaai: Amu ore tiatua ilolot enye pooki netii enkatampoi o Laitoriani shumata ilo ng'obor dama, netii enkima atua ninye kewarie, te dukuya ina aji pooki e Israel.

English: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
Masaai: Neipotu Olaitoriani Musa, neirorie ninye teilo ng'obor le ntumo, ejo,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
Masaai: “Irorie iltung'ana loo Siraeli nijoki ninche, teneishoru ake oltung'ani te intae olasar aisho Olaitoriani, niyauu ilasarri linyi loo nkishu aashu iloo ntare.

English: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore olasar lenye naa olasar opejori oing'uaa eluaata oo nkishu, neyau ninye olbung'ae lemeeta entioto, neishooyo ninye te kutuk aji olng'obor le ntumo, pee etum ninye ataa keng'amaroyu te dukuya Olaitoriani;

English: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
Masaai: neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eilo asar opejori, naa keng'amari te nkaraki ninye pee eitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye.

English: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Neyieng ninye oloing'oni te dukuya o Laitoriani; ore lelo ayiok le Aron lelo apolosak neyau osarge, neisuaaya ilo sarge aaitaman ilo perere lo lasar ootii kutuk aji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
Masaai: Neyieng ninye ilo asar opejori nedung'udung aitaa rubat,

English: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Aron ilo apolosani neinok enkima tenchumata olperere lo lasar

English: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
Masaai: nepik ilkeek aaitobiraki enkima; ore lelo ayiok le Aron apolosak nepik nena rubat enkima elukunya, o eilata aaitobiraki te nchumata lelo keek ootii enkima te nchumata olperere lo lasar;

English: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: kake ore ore sorri e nkoshoke o loilelek lenyena neituku ninye te nkare. Nepejoo olapolosani pooki te nchumata olperere lo lasar, anaa olasar opejori, olasar le mpejoroto te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore enkishorunoto enye o lasar opejori naa eluaata oo ntare eing'uaa nkerra aashu nkineji, naa keishoru ninye ositima lemeeta entioto;

English: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
Masaai: neyieng ninye te nkalo e moikuape olperere lo lasar te dukuya Olaitoriani, ore ilayiok le Aron lelo apolosak neisuaaya osarge lenye aaitaman ilo perere lo lasar.

English: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
Masaai: Nedung'udung aaitaa rubat tenebo endukuya enye o eilata, neirragie olapolosani ninche aitobiraki aiteleiki lelo keek ootii enkima te nchumata olperere lo lasar;

English: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: kake ore sorri e nkayaitie o loilelek neituku ninye te nkare. Ore ilo apolosani neitayu olasar pooki, nepejoo ninye to lperere lo lasar, olasar ninye opejori, olasar le mpejoroto te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore olasar lenye to Laitoriani naa olasar opejori loo motonyi, neyau ninye olasar lenye loo nturkuluoni aashu ntukurluoni kutiti.

English: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
Masaai: Neyau olapolosani olperere lo lasar; ore osarge lenye neibukori te mbata olperere lo lasar;

English: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
Masaai: naa keitayu ninye enkoshoke enye tenebo nkopir nenang'aki embata olperere lo lasar te nkalo o loosaen ewueji oo nkuruon;

English: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: nepolos ninye ina motonyi too naipuko enyena kake meor aitaa are. Nepejoo olapolosani te nchumata olperere lo lasar, te nchumata e lelo keek ootii enkima; olasar opejori ninye, olasar le nkima esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
Masaai: “Teneyau ake oltung'ani enkishorunoto e ntapa napuyiapui anaa olasar to Laitoriani, naa keaku ina kishorunoto enye olasar le ntapa sidai; nebukoki ninye eilata ina tapa, nepik olbani oriong ninye,

English: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
Masaai: neyaki ilayiok le Aron lelo apolosak. Neitayu ninye teina tapa napuyiapui emborei e nkaina eina tapa o eilata tenebo olbani pooki; nepejoo olapolosani ena metaa endamunoto te nchumata olperere lo lasar, olasar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
Masaai: Ore entapa natelekua neaku ene Aron o layiok lenyena. Ninye erubata nasinya aisul too lasarri oopejokini te nkima Olaitoriani.

English: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
Masaai: “Teniyau iyie enkishorunoto e ntapa natapejoki to ljiko opising'a, aaitaa olasar, naa keaku imukateni neitu eisuishieki, e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, napuyiapui

English: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
Masaai: naa tenaa ore enkishorunoto ino naa olasar le ntapa nateyiaraki te nkarae, nchoo eaku ole ntapa sidai neitu eisuishieki, naipurjaki te eilata;

English: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
Masaai: tebela ntaa imbelibelat nibukoki eilata oriong enye; olasar le ntapa ninye.

English: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ore enkishorunoto ino naa olasar le ntapa nateyiaraki te moti eitobiruni te ntapa sidai o eilata.

English: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
Masaai: Naa iyau iyie ina kishorunoto e ntapa naitobiraki te kuna tokitin ayaki Olaitoriani; ore ake pee eitarasakini olapolosani, neyau ninye ilo perere lo lasar.

English: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani teina kishoroto entapa ina rubata endamunoto nepejoo ena rubata te nchumata olperere lo lasar, olasar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
Masaai: Ore entoki natelekua teilo asar le ntapa neaku ene Aron o layiok lenyena; erubata naa ninye nasinya aisul o lasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani.

English: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
Masaai: “Meetae enkishoroto e ntapa nayakini Olaitoriani naitobiruni te ntoki naisuisho, amu mipejokiki Olaitoriani te nkima entoki naisuisho aashu pooki aisho anaa olasar le nkima.

English: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
Masaai: Ore anaa enkishorunoto oo lng'anayio le dukuya indimidimi intae aayaki ninche Olaitoriani, kake meishoori ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar aaitaa esong'ouna narropil.

English: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
Masaai: Tipika nena kishorot inono pooki e ntapa emunyan, nimincho ake eaku metii emunyan o lning'o lo osotua lino o Enkai ino o lasar lino le ntapa; ore too nkishorot inono pooki nchooi emunyan.

English: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
Masaai: “Teninchooyo iyie enkishoroto e ntapa oo lng'anayio le dukuya aisho Olaitoriani, ninchooyo iyie anaa olasar le ntapa loo lng'anayio le dukuya, ina tapa naidong'oki naing'uaa lukuny e ntapa naatisilaki te nkima.

English: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
Masaai: Nibukoki iyie eilata oriong ninye, ninteleiki olbani oriong enye, olasar le ntapa ninye.

English: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nepejoo olapolosani anaa entoki nadamuni eoroti eina tapa naidong'oki o eilata tenebo olbani pooki; olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani.

English: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore enkishoroto o ltung'ani naa olasar le seriani, neishooyo ninye enkiteng te luata, olbung'ae aashu entawuo, nchoo eishooyo ina nemeeta entioto te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: Neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eilo asar lenye neyieng ninye te kutuk aji eilo ng'obor le ntumo; ore lelo ayiok le Aron, lelo apolosak neisuaaki ilo osarge ilo perere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
Masaai: Ore teilo asar le seriani oishoruaki, anaa enkishoroto naishori te nkima Olaitoriani, neishooyo ninye enkurriny pooki naimulumulita enkoshoke o enkurriny pooki e nkoshoke.

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
Masaai: O lairakuj pokira oare tenebo ina kurriny naimulumulita ninche oilo kina le moinyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj.

English: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nepejoo ilayiok le Aron te nchumata olperere lo lasar ti oriong ilo asar opejori, otii enchumata oo nkeek te nkima, olasar le mpejoroto te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore enkishoroto enye o lasar le seriani oishori Olaitoriani naa enkiteng naing'ua eluaata olbung'ae aashu entauo neishoru enemeeta entioto.

English: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
Masaai: Teneishoru ninye olkuoo le ker aitaa olasar lenye, neishoru ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
Masaai: eiteleiki enkaina enye endukuya eilo asar lenye, neyieng ninye te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo; ore lelo ayiok le Aron neisuaaki osarge ilo perere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
Masaai: Ore teilo asar le seriani anaa enkishoroto napejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, neishooyo ninye eilata enye, eilata o lkidong'oe, aitabaiki oloito le nkoriong oina kurriny naimulumulita enkoshoke, o enkurriny pooki e nkoshoke,

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
Masaai: o lairakuj pokira oare oina kurriny naimulumulita ninche, oilo kina le monyua neya ninye tenebo ilairakuj.

English: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nepejoo olapolosani ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar anaa endaa naishoruaki tialo enkima aaisho Olaitoriani.

English: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
Masaai: “Tenaa ore enkishoroto enye naa enkine, nchoo eishoru ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
Masaai: neiteleiki enkaina enye endukuya enye neyieng ninye te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ore lelo ayiok le Aron neisuaaki osarge olperere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
Masaai: Netum taa aishooi te ninye, anaa olasar lenye oishori te nkima Olaitoriani, ina kurriny naimulumulita enkoshoke o enkurriny pooki enkoshoke,

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
Masaai: o lairakuj pokira oare tenebo ina kurriny enye, oilo kina le monyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj.

English: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the LORD'S.
Masaai: Nepejoo olapolosani ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar anaa endaa naishoori te nkima metaa esong'ouna narropil. Ore enkurriny pooki naa eno Laitoriani.

English: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
Masaai: Keaku ena enkitanapata e anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, tiatua imanyishoritin inyi pooki, nchere minyanya intae enkurriny aashu osarge.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, teneas oltung'ani ingok eitu eotiki tiae nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi, neas nabo te ninche,

English: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
Masaai: tenaa olapolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput oas eng'oki, ayau entorroni shumata iltung'ana, nchoo ninye eitayu tenkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa oloti oing'oni lemeeta entioto aisho Olaitoriani metaaolasar le ng'oki.

English: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninye ilo oing'oni kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo dukuya Olaitoriani, neiteleiki enkaina enye endukuya eilo oing'oni, neyieng ilo oing'oni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput neya embata osarge leilo oing'oni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the vail of the sanctuary.
Masaai: neitadoiki olapolosani olkimojino lenye atua ilo sarge neisuaaki embata osarge katitin naapishana dukuya Olaitoriani te dukuya ilo karasha le wueji sinyati.

English: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nepik ilo apolosani embata eilo sarge imowuarak ol perere lo lasar naatii enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani, apa otii atua olng'obor le ntumo. Ore ilo likae sarge lo loing'oni neibukoo te ntonata olperere opejorieki olasar otii kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
Masaai: Ore enkurriny pooki eilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki neitayu ninye, ina kurriny naimulumul isorri e nkoshoke o ina kurriny pooki e nkoshoke,

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
Masaai: o lairakuj lenyena pokira oare tenebo enkurriny enye oilo kina le moinyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj

English: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
Masaai: (anaa ake enayae to lkiteng lo lasar le seriani), nepejoo olapolosani tenchumata olperere lo lasar opejori.

English: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
Masaai: Kake ore olchoni leilo oing'oni o nkiri enyena tenebo endukuya enye, o loilelek lenyena, o sorri enyena e nkoshoke o moyok enyena

English: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
Masaai: nenap ninye oloing'oni pooki auluo ewueji nemeiduruk ine neibukorieki nkuruon, nepejoo ninye te nkima oo lkeek; ore te ine wueji neibukorieki nkuruon.

English: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
Masaai: “Teneas olturrur pooki loo Siraeli eng'oki eitu eotiki ore ina toki naisudoro too nkonyek eumata, neas ninche nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi neaku ilooitarruoitie;

English: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ore ake teneyiolouni ina ng'oki nataasa ninche, neitayu ina umata oloti oing'oni metaa olasar le ng'oki, neyauni ninye dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
Masaai: ore ilpayiani leilo turrur neiteleiki nkaik enye endukuya eilo oing'oni te dukuya Olaitoriani, neyieng'i ilo oing'oni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Neyau taa ilo apolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput embata o sarge leilo oing'oni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
Masaai: Neitadoiki olapolosani olkimojino lenye atua ilo sarge neisuaaki katitin naapishana dukuya Olaitoriani tioriong olkarasha le wueji sinyati.

English: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nepik ninye embata o sarge enchumata oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar otiii atua olng'obor le ntumo dukuya Olaitoriani; ore olikae sarge neibukoo te ntonata eilo perere lo lasar opejori otii kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki neitayu ninye nepejoo te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
Masaai: Ina ninye eitaas ilo oing'oni; anaa enaitaasa ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, neijia sii eiko tele. Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche, naa kepalakini ninche.

English: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
Masaai: Nenap ninye ilo oing'oni auluo ilng'oborri nepejoo anaa enatapejoyie oloing'oni le dukuya; o lasar le ng'oki te nkaraki eumata.

English: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
Masaai: “Teneas oloitoreisho eng'oki, neas eitu eotiki ae nabo oo mbaa pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani Enkai enye pee measi, neaku oloitarruoyie,

English: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
Masaai: ore pee eitayioloi ninye ina ng'oki nataasa, neyau ninye anaa olasar lenye enkine, ositima lemeeta entioto,

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it is a sin offering.
Masaai: neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eina kine, neyieng ninye te wueji neyieng'ieki lelo asarri oopejori te dukuya Olaitoriani; olasar le ng'oki ninye.

English: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata eilo sarge lo lasar le ng'oki to lkimojino lenye nepik imowuarak olperere lo lasar opejorieki lasarri, neibukoo olikae sarge te ntonata olperere lo lasar opejorieki lasarri.

English: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki nepejoo te nchumata o lperere lo lasar, anaa enkurriny olasar loo nkishorot e seriani; neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye too ng'ok enyena, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
Masaai: “Teneas oltung'ani ake duoo eng'oki eitu eotiki aas ae nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi, neaku oloitarruoyie,

English: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
Masaai: ore ake pee eitayioloi ninye ina ng'oki nataasa neyau ninye aitaa enkishoroto enye enkine, esupen nemeeta entioto, te nkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa.

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
Masaai: Neiteleiki ninye enkaina enye endukuya eina kine o lasar le ng'oki, neyieng ilo asar le ng'oki te wueji neyieng'ieki ilasarri oopejori.

English: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata eilo sarge lenye to lkimojino lenye nepik nchumat oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar opejorieki ilasarri, neibukoo olikae sarge te ntonata eilo perere lo lasar.

English: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Neitayu enkurriny enye pooki, anaa enaitayuni ina kurriny to lasar le seriani, nepejoo olapolosani te nchumata olperere lo lasar metaa esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; neitayu olapolosani olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki ninye, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
Masaai: “Teneyau ninye olkuoo le ker metaa enkishoroto enye o lasar le ng'oki, nchoo ninye eyau esupen nemeeta entioto,

English: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
Masaai: neiteleiki enkaina enye, endukuya eilo asar le ng'oki neyieng ninye aitaa olasar opejori.

English: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata o sarge leilo asar le ng'oki to lkimojino lenye nepik nchumat oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar opejorieki ilasarri, neibukoo olikae sarge lenye te ntonata olperere lo lasar.

English: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki neitayuni anaa enaitayuni enkurriny o lker lo lasar le seriani, nepejoo olapolosani te nchumata olperere lo lasar, apejoki Olaitoriani te nkima te nchumata ine wueji oo nkishorot; neitayu olapolosani olasar olning'o lo sotuat enkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa ninye, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: “Tenelo neas oltung'ani ake ninye eng'oki eipotuoki enkiguana meitayu shakenisho hoo naa olchakeni ninye, ore tenetoduaa ninye aashu tenetayiolo ina bae, ore ake etiu neijia nemelimu, nenap ninye eng'oki e ntorroni enye.

English: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
Masaai: Aashu tenelo neiseyie ake ninye oltung'ani entoki nemesinya, aa empopok e ng'ues nemesinya aashu empopok e nkiteng nemesinya aashu empopok oo ntokitin nemesinya naa embae naisudoro ena te ninye, neaku ninye ole mesinya, neaku ninye oloitarruoyie.

English: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
Masaai: Aashu tenelo neiseyie ninye mbaa nemesinya oo ltung'ana e pooki pukunoto laa te ninye eaku olemesinya, ore ina bae neisudoro te ninye, ore ake pee elotu ayiolou ina bae neaku ninye oloitarruoyie.

English: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
Masaai: Aashu tenelo neiro oltung'ani te nkutuk enye ainos olmumai pee eas entorroni aashu eas esidai olmumai ake duoo ninye oinos iltung'ana, naa tenaa embae ena naisudoro te ninye, ore ake pee elotu ayiolou neaku ninye te pooki e kuna oloitarruoyie.

English: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
Masaai: Tenaa oloitarruoyie oltung'ani tiae nabo e kuna, neibalunye ninye ina ng'oki nataasa,

English: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
Masaai: naa keyaki ninye nkishorot enyena e nkitarruorroto Olaitoriani teina ng'oki nataasa, esupen naing'ua eluaata oo ntare, olker aashu enkine pee eaku olasar le ng'oki, neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye teina ng'oki nataasa.

English: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
Masaai: “Kake tenemeeta ninye olker, neyau naa, anaa enkishoroto enye te nkitarruorroto nataasa to Laitoriani, teina ng'oki nataasa ninye, nturkuluoni are anaa nturkuluoni are kutiti, nabo naaku olasar le ng'oki o enkae naaku olasar opejori.

English: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
