Masaai: Neyau ninye ninche enetii olapolosani, laa ninye ong'as aishooyo ina o lasar le ng'oki; neburukush ninye endukuya enye te murt enye kake medung'oo

English: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
Masaai: neisuaaki ninye embata o sarge leilo asar le ng'oki embata olperer lo lasar, ore olikae sarge nebukoki ninye e ntonata o lperere lo lasar; olasar le ng'oki ninye.

English: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aishooyo eniare metaa olasar opejori terisioroto oo nkitanapat; neitobiru olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye teina ng'oki nataasa ninye, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
Masaai: “Kake tenemeeta ninye nturkuluoni are, aashu nturkuluoni are kutiti, neyau naa, anaa enkishoroto enye teina ng'oki nataasa ninye, ematua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui metaa enkishoroto te nkaraki eng'oki, nemepik ninye eilata shumata ina tapa, nemepik olbani shumata enye, amu olasar ninye le ng'oki.

English: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it is a sin offering.
Masaai: Neyau ninye enetii olapolosani, neitayu ilo apolosani emborei enkaina eina tapa metaa erubata nadamuni nepejoo ina to lperere lo lasar, apejoki Olaitoriani teine neishoorieki ilasarri oopejori; olasar le ng'oki ninye.

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
Masaai: Neijia eiko olapolosani aitobiraki ninye olasar olning'o lo sotua teina ng'oki nataasa ninye tiae nabo e kuna baa naa kepalakini ninye. Ore enaleku neaku eno lapolosani anaa enkishoroto e ntapa.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
Masaai: “Tenelo neas oltung'ani ake ninye embae naainyal enkirukoto, neas eng'oki eitu eotiki, te pooki toki e nena sinyat o Laitoriani nchoo eyau ninye, neyau anaa enkishoroto enye o lasar lenkitarruorroto to Laitoriani, olmeregesh lemeeta entioto aitayu tiatua eluaata, nidung'oki iyie enkinyiang'a te shekeli e nkosholai terisioroto e shekeli e wueji sinyati; olasar le nkitarruorroto ninye.

English: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Nelak sii ninye ina apa naitarruoyie tialo ina bae sinyati, neponiki e rubata eimiet ina, neisho olapolosani; neitobiraki olapolosani ninye olning'o lo sotua teilo meregesh lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: “Tenelo neas ing'ok oltung'ani aas nabo oo mbaa naaitanapishe Olaitoriani pee measi, hoo duoo ninye nemeyiolo, ore ake eyia netaa ninye oloitarruoyie naa kenap ninye enkitarruorroto enye.

English: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Neyau ninye enetii olapolosani olmeregesh lemeeta entioto aitayu te luata enye, nitudung'oko iyie enkinyiang'a nchere keishiakino enkinyiang'a e laata o lasar le nkitarruorroto, neitobir olapolosani olasar lo lning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye teina kitadiata nataasa ninye eitu eotiki; naa kepalakini ninye.

English: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
Masaai: Olasar le nkitarruorroto ilo; eitarruoyie ninye te dukuya, Olaitoriani.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
Masaai: “Tenelo ake neas oltung'ani eng'oki, neas embae naainyal enkirukoto tialo Olaitoriani, alej ole latia enye too mpisai naashumi aashu te embae natoning'okinoteki aashu aikonyaa, aashu aitorogony ole latia enye

English: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
Masaai: aashu adumu entoki naimina nelejishore ainos olmumai te lejare, tiae nabo oo mbaa naas iltung'ana netaasa eng'oki teina.

English: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
Masaai: Teneaku etaasa oltung'ani eng'oki neaku oloitarruoyie nerrinyu ninye ina toki nawa te nkikonyare, aashu ina nanoto te nkitorogonyata, aashu ina naishooki ninye meiteng'ela, aashu ina toki apa naimina natudumua ninye,

English: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
Masaai: aashu ae toki ake ninye nainosie ninye olmumai te lejare; nerrinyu ninye elulung'a neponiki erubata e imiet, neisho ilo ora olopeny, teina olong o lasar le nkitarruorroto enye.

English: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
Masaai: Naa keyaki ninye olapolosani olasar lenye le nkitarruorroto, aisho Olaitoriani olmeregesh lemeeta entioto aitayu tiatua eluaata enye, litudung'oko iyie enkinyiang'a nchere keiririkino olasar le nkitarruorroto;

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
Masaai: neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa kepalakini ninye te pooki bae naba anaa enataasa oltung'ani neaku oloitarruoyie.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
Masaai: “Ntanapa Aron o layiok lenyena, tiaaki, Ena enkitanapata o lasar opejori. Ore ilo asar opejori neton te nchumata oo ng'esherreta o lperere lo lasar enkewarie pooki o mekenyu, ore enkima olperere lo lasar neishori metobiko ayupuyup te nchumata enye.

English: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
Masaai: Neishop olapolosani olkila lenye le kitani napuyiapui neishop enkila e atua e kitani napuyiapui, neitayu taa nena kuruon eilo asar otumuta enkima etapejoyioki to lperere lo lasar, nepik ninche embata olperere lo lasar.

English: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
Masaai: Neitoki aitayu nena kilani naaishopito neishop kulie kilani, nenap nena kuruon aya auluo ilng'oborri ewueji nemeiduruk.

English: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore ina kima olperere lo lasar nepali meyupuyupo, meishori metua, nepik olapolosani ilkeek e nkima ine anaake tadekenya, neirragie ilo asar opejori aiteleiki aitobiraki, nepejoo te nchumata enye enkurriny eilo asar le seriani.

English: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
Masaai: Neishori enkima meyupuyupo te shumata olperere lo lasar nkatitin pooki, meishori metua.

English: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
Masaai: “Ena enkitanapata o lasar le ntapa. Ilayiok le Aron ooishooyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya ilo perere lo lasar.

English: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitayu obo emborei enkaina eina tapa napuyiapui o lasar le ntapa tenebo eilata o lbani pooki otii enchumata eina tapa o lasar, nepejoo ena metaa erubata nadamuni tenchumata olperere lo lasar, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
Masaai: Ore enkae pooki neinos Aron o layiok lenyena; nenyae ninye eitu eisuishieki tiatua ewueji sinyati; tiatua olgoriet leilo ng'obor le ntumo neinos ninche.

English: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
Masaai: Nemepeji ninye tenebo entoki naisuisho. Aishoo nanu ninche metaa erubata to lasar lai opejori te nkima, entoki ena nasinya oleng naikununo anaa olasar le ng'oki o lasar le nkitarruorroto.

English: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
Masaai: Eidim pooki lee too layiok le Aron ainosa ninye, anaa enaibalunyeki ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, tialo ilasarri lo Laitoriani oopejori te nkima; ore oloba anaa oloiseyie ninche neaku sinyati.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
Masaai: “Ele ninye olasar oisho Aron o layiok lenyena Olaitoriani teina olong nabukokini ninye eilata aaput: ematua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui metaa olasar le ntapa li anaake, olpisiai lenye tadekenya o likae pisiai teipa.

English: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitobiruni te eilata teina girra nayierishoreki, niyau iyie eipurjaki aaitobiraki, too rubat naatapejoki anaa olasar le ntapa, ninchooyo anaa esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani tiatua ilayiok le Aron, laa ninye etubukokoki eilata aaput pee etonie olorika lenye, neitarasaki ninye Olaitoriani anaa apa enaibalunyeki ntarasi; nepejori pooki.

English: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
Masaai: Ore pooki asar le ntapa lo lapolosani nepejori pooki nemeinosi ninye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it is most holy.
Masaai: “Tiaki Aron o layiok lenyena, ena enkitanapata o lasar le ng'oki. Ore te wueji neteyieng'ieki olasar opejori, neyieng'i ilo asar le ng'oki te dukuya Olaitoriani; naa kesinya ninye oleng.

English: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani oishooyo olasar te nkaraki eng'oki nenya ninye; nenya ninye tiatua ine wueji sinyati, tiatua olgoriet lo lng'obor le ntumo.

English: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki naiseyie nkiri eilo asar neaku sinyati; naa tenelo neisuaakino osarge lenye olkila, nintuku iyie ilo sarge tiatua ewueji sinyati.

English: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
Masaai: Ore ina moti oo nkulupuok nateyierieki nkiri nerrarri; kake tenaa emoti osuyai eteyierieki neiutuuti ina, neitukui te nkare.

English: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
Masaai: Neidim pooki lee tiatua ilapolosak ainosa, entoki nasinya ena oleng.

English: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
Masaai: Kake meetae olasar le ng'oki onyae nkiri eyauaki osarge lenye atua olng'obor le ntumo pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua tiatua ine wueji sinyati, kepejori ninye te nkima.

English: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata o lasar le nkitarruorroto. Eisinyati ninye oleng;

English: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
Masaai: ore teine wueji neyieng'ieki ilasarri oopejori teine eyieng' ninche olasar le nkitarruorroto, ore osarge lenye neisuaakini enchumata olperere lo lasar aaitaman.

English: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
Masaai: Ore enkurriny enye pooki neishoori, ina eilata olkidong'oe, oina kurriny pooki naimulumulita enkoshoke,

English: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
Masaai: o lairakuj pokira oare oina kurriny naimulumulita ninche, oilo kina lemoinyua oya ninye tenebo ilairakuj;

English: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a trespass offering.
Masaai: nepejoo olapolosani ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar anaa nkishorot naapejokini te nkima Olaitoriani; olasar le nkitarruorroto ninye.

English: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
Masaai: Eidim pooki lee tiatua ilapolosak ainosa, nenyae tiatua ewueji sinyati, eisinyati ninye oleng.

English: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
Masaai: Ore olasar le nkitarruroroto, neikununo anaa olasar le ng'oki, nabo enkitanapata e pokira; ore ilo apolosani oitayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye neya ninye.

English: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
Masaai: Neya ilo apolosani oitayu olasar opejori lo ltung'ani ake ninye olchoni leilo asar opejori oitayio ninye.

English: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
Masaai: Ore pooki kishoroto e ntapa natapejoki tiatua ewueji napejishoreki o pooki toki naitobiraki te ngirra aashu teneyierishoreki naa eneilo apolosani oitarasayie aishooyo.

English: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
Masaai: Ore pooki kishoroto e ntapa, naipurjakaki teilata aashu enatoyio, neaku enoo layiok pooki le Aron, neishori pooki aaitorisioki.

English: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Naa ena enkitanapata o lasar le seriani oidim oltung'ani aishoo Olaitoriani.

English: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
Masaai: Teneishooyo ninye te nashe, neishooyo ninye imukateni neitu eisuishieki naaipurjaki te ilata, o nkaukau neitu eisuishieki o emukate e ntapa naelieki eilata napuyiapui naaipurjaki te eilata aaitobiraki.

English: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ilo asar lenye le seriani le nkishoroto e nashe neyau ninye enkishoroto enye tenebo imukateni naaisuishieki.

English: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore te kuna neishooyo ninye emukate nabo te pooki kishoroto, anaa enkishoroto to Laitoriani, neaku ena kishoroto eneilo apolosani oisuaki ilo sarge lo lasar le seriani.

English: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
Masaai: Ore nkiri eilo asar lenye le seriani le nkishoroto e nashe nenyae teina olong olasar lenye; meisho ninye ae eleku o mekenyu.

English: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
Masaai: Kake tenaa ore olasar le nkishoroto enye naa enkitabaroto aashu enkishoroto olpela neinosi teina olong naishorua ninye olasar lenye, ore taisere entoki natelekua neinosi,

English: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
Masaai: kake ore entoki naleku too nkiri eilo asar te nkolong e uni nepejori te nkima.

English: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: Teneinosi pooki toki oo nkiri eilo asar lenye le seriani te nkolong e uni, ore ilo oishorua ilo asar nemeng'amuni, nemeikenakini ninye ilo asar; neaku ilo asar olminong ore ilo oinos nenap ninye enkitarruorroto enye.

English: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
Masaai: “Ore nkiri naaiseyie pooki toki nemesinya nemeinosi; nepejori te nkima. Ore lelo pooki lemeiduruk neidim aainosa nkiri,

English: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: kake ore ilo tung'ani onya nkiri eilo asar lo Laitoriani le seriani eata ninye olduruk, nedung'ori ilo tung'ani aaitung'uaa iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Naa teneiseyie oltung'ani ake ninye entoki naiduruk nemesinya, tenaa olduruk te tung'ani aashu eng'ues nemesinya aashu ae toki naiduruk o lminong paa keitoki ainos nkiri olasar lo Laitoriani le seriani, neiwuang'ieki ilo tung'ani tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, minyanya intae eilata, olkiteng, aashu enker, aashu enkine.

English: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
Masaai: Ore eilata e ng'ues natua openy, o eilata eina natara ilowuarak, neidimi aataasishore tiae oitoi, kake meeta nchere pee inosa intae.

English: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki tung'ani oinos eilata e ng'ues naa ninye eishorieki Olaitoriani olasar te nkima neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenyena.

English: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
Masaai: Niminosinoso sii osarge tukul, aa olemotonyi aashu aa oleng'ues, te pooki wueji nimanyimanya.

English: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloinos pooki sarge, neiwuang'ieki ilo tung'ani too ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, ore ilo oishoru olasar le seriani loo nkishorot enyena aisho Olaitoriani neyaki ninye ina kishoroto enye Olaitoriani; teilo asar loo nkishorunot enyena e seriani.

English: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninye too nkaik enyena makewan nena kishorunot naapejorieki te nkima olasar lo laitoriani; neyau ninye ina ilata tenebo oloikulu, pee etumi aayuko ilo oikulu olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
Masaai: Nepejoo olapolosani eilata te nchumata olperere lo lasar, kake ore oloikulu neaku ole Aron o layiok lenyena.

English: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore emuro e tatene nincho olapolosani anaa enkishoroto naing'uaa olasar lino loo nkishorot inono e seriani.

English: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
Masaai: Ore ilo tiatua ilayiok le Aron oishooyo osarge lo lasar le seriani o eilata neishori emuro enkalo e tatene metaa erubata enye.

English: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oikulu oyuki oina muro naishoori aawa nanu too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, aitayu tiatua ilasarri lenye loo nkishorot e seriani, naisho nanu ninche Aron ilo apolosani o layiok lenyena, anaa erubata e anaake naitayu iltung'ana le Israel.

English: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;
Masaai: Ena ninye erubata e Aron o layiok lenyena naing'ua nena kishorot naapejorieki te nkima olasar lo laitoriani, naiteng'elakaki ninche ina olong apa naitarasayioki ninche pee eisiaisho anaa lapolosak lo Laitoriani;

English: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
Masaai: eitanapishe Olaitoriani ena pee eishori ninche iltung'ana le Israel, ina olong apa natubukokoki ninche eilata aaput; erubata enye anaake tiatua iishoritin enye pooki.”

English: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata o lasar opejori, olasar le ntapa, olasar le ng'oki, o lasar le nkitarruorroto, o le nkitisinyata o lasarri le seriani,

English: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: apa naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa te nchumata oldoinyo le Sinai, ina olong apa naitanapa ninye iltung'ana le Israel pee eyaki nkishorot enye Olaitoriani to lpurkel le Sinai.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
Masaai: “Toriko Aron o layiok lenyena tenebo ninye, neya lkilani o eilata naputishoreki o loing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, olmeregeshi oare, o enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuishieki;

English: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ninturrur eumata pooki te kutukaji olng'obor le ntumo.” Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Neiturrurri eumata te kutukaji olng'obor le ntumo.

English: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ilo turrur “Embae ena naitanapishe Olaitoriani metaasi.”

English: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
Masaai: Neriku Musa Aron o layiok lenyena neituku ninche te nkare.

English: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
Masaai: Neishopoki ninye olkila lioriong nerreten ninye te nkimeita, neitoki aishopoki ninye enkila sapuk, neishopoki tioriong enkila dorrop neen teina keene naripuno te nkarriyiano eina kila dorrop aeniki ninye.

English: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
Masaai: Nepik ninye enkila olgoo ore ina kila olgoo nepik Urim o Tumim.

English: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninye enkarasha endukuya enye, ore ina arasha te nkalo enkomom nepik enkishili e sahabu, ina ilo marisian sinyati le nkitoo anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
Masaai: Ina pee eya Musa ina ilata naputishoreki neitisiny ilo ng'obor le Nkai o pooki toki natii atua, neitisiny ninche.

English: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
Masaai: Neisuaaki ninye embata eina ilata enchumata olperere lo lasar katitin naapishana, nebukoki ilo perere lo lasar tenebo imasaa enyena pooki, o lmoti oitukuoreki o enkitotonet enye, pee eitisiny ninche.

English: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
Masaai: Nebukoki embata eina ilata naputishoreki endukuya e Aron neput ninye neitisiny ninye.

English: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neyau Musa lelo ayiok le Aron, neishopoki ninche ilkilani nerreten ninche too nkimeitani nkoishuaa nepik ninche imaupen, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
Masaai: Neitoki ayau ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki; ore Aron o layiok lenyena neiteleiki nkaik enye endukuya eilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki.

English: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
Masaai: Neyieng Musa ninye, neitayu osarge, ore to lkimojino lenye nepik enchumata oo mowuarak eilo perere lo lasar aitaman, neitisiny ilo perere lo lasar, neibukoo ilo likae sarge te ntonata olpererelo lasar, neitisiny ninye, pee eitobiru olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki ninye.

English: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye enkurriny pooki enkoshoke olkina le moinyua o lairrakuj pokira oare tenebo enkurriny enye, nepejoo Musa ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oing'oni, o lchoni lenye, o nkiri enyena, o modiok enyena nepejoo ninye te nkima tiauluo ilng'oborri, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitarasaa ilo meregesh lo lasar opejori neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena nkaik enye endukuya eilo meregesh.

English: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: Neyieng Musa ninye, neisuaaki osarge enchumata eilo perere lo lasar aitaman.

English: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edung'i ilo meregesh aarishirish, nepejoo Musa endukuya o nena rubat o enkurriny.

English: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitukui isorri e nkoshoke o loilelek te nkare, nepejoo Musa olmeregesh pooki to lperere lo lasar, anaa olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil, olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
Masaai: Neitoki aitarasaa olmeregesh liare, ilo meregesh le nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik; neiteleiki Aron o layiok lenyena nkaik enye endukuya eilo meregesh.

English: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
Masaai: Neyieng Musa ninye, neitayu embata eilo sarge lenye nepik enkitipet enkiok e Aron e tatene o lmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene o le nkeju enye e tatene.

English: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
Masaai: Neyauni ilayiok le Aron, nepik Musa oloti sarge nkitipeti oo nkiyiaa enye e tatene, o lmogirrani loo nkaik enye e tatene olmogirrani lenye le tene; neitoki Musa aisuaki osarge olperere lo lasar aitaman.

English: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
Masaai: Neitoki aitayu enkurriny o eilata olkidong'oe, oina kurriny pooki e nkoshoke, olkina le monyua, o lairakuj pokira oare o enkurriny enye, o emuro e tatene;

English: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
Masaai: ore teina kikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuishieki natii dukuya Olaitoriani neitayu ninye emukate nabo neitu eisuishieki, ore emukate nabo tenebo eilata, o enkaukau nabo neitatashaki ninche ina ilata oina muro e tatene;

English: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.
Masaai: nepik ninye kuna pooki nkaik e Aron o nkaik oo layiok lenyena, neyuk ninche anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aya ninche too nkaik enye, nepejoo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar tenebo nena kishorunot naapejori; anaa olasar le nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, esong'ouna narropil, olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani.

English: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neya Musa oloikulu neyuk ninye anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; erubata apa e Musa ena to lmeregesh lo lasar le nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aya embata eina ilata naputishoreki o embata eilo sarge otii enchumata olperere lo lasar, neisuaaki Aron o lkilani lenyena, o layiok lenyena sii o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, neaku eitisinya ninye Aron o lkilani lenyena, o layiok lenyena o lkilani loo layiok lenyena, tenebo ninye.

English: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron o layiok lenyena, “Enteyier nena kiri te kutukaji o lng'obor le ntumo ninosinoso teine o nena mukateni naatii atua ina kikapu oo nkishorot enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, anaa enaitanapishe nanu, ajo, 'Aron o layiok lenyena ooinos nena;

English: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
Masaai: ore entoki naleku too nkiri o too mukateni nipejoo te nkima.

English: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
Masaai: Nimipuopuo intae aaipang te kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo too nkolong'i naapishana, o metaba anaa neishunye nkolong'i enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, amu nkolong'i naapishana ine nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik te iyie.

English: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
Masaai: Anaa enataase taata, eitanapishe Olaitoriani metaasi pee eitobiri olning'o lo osotua te nkaraki intae.

English: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
Masaai: Ore te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo entobik teine dama o kewarie too nkolong'i naapishana, intabayaya nena naaitanapishe Olaitoriani, pee miyeye ake; amu nena nanu aaitanapaki.”

English: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Neas Aron o layiok lenyena nena tokitin pooki naaitanapishe Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neipotu Musa Aron o layiok lenyena o lpayiani le Israel,

English: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD.
Masaai: nejoki ninye Aron, “Iwa iyie oloti oing'oni intayunye olasar le ng'oki o lmeregesh ntayunye olasar opejori, ore te pokira meetae oloota entioto, nintarasaa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
Masaai: Nijoki iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Ewaita ositima le kine, oaku olasar le ng'oki, o lashe o sitima le ker, naa ilo lari obo pooki nemetii oloata entioto, pee eaku olasar opejori

English: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
Masaai: o lkiteng o lmeregesh metaa olasar le seriani, pee ipolososo intae te dukuya Olaitoriani o enkishoroto e ntapa naipurja te ilata, amu ore taata keipang'aki intae Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninche nena naaitanapishe Musa dukuya olng'obor le ntumo, neigutu olturrur pooki anyiku neitashe te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
Masaai: Nejo Musa, “Ena bae eitanapa intae Olaitoriani pee iasiasa; naa keipang'aki intae enkitoo o Laitoriani.”

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki Aron, “Tinyikaki olperere lo lasar, nintayu olasar lino le ng'oki ino o lasar lino opejori, nintobir olning'o le sotua te nkorrok ino o too ltung'ana; niyau enkishooroto e kulo tung'ana nintayu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche; anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani.”

English: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
Masaai: Nenyikaki Aron ilo perere lo lasar, neyieng ilo ashe lo lasar le ng'oki, te nkaraki enkorrok enye.

English: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
Masaai: Neitarasaki ilayiok le Aron ninye osarge, neitadoiki ninye olkimojino lenye atua osarge nepik osarge nena mowuarak o lperere lo lasar, nebukoki ilo sarge entonata o lperere lo lasar;

English: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: kake ore enkurriny o lairakuj o lkina le monyua o ilo asar le ng'oki etapejoyie ninye te nchumata olperere lo lasar, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
Masaai: Ore nkiri o lchoni nepejoo ninye te nkima tiauluo ilng'oborri.

English: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
Masaai: Neyieng ninye ilo asar opejori; neyaki ilayiok le Aron ninye osarge, neisuaaki ninye enchumata olperere lo lasar aitaman.

English: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
Masaai: Neyaki ninche ninye ilo asar opejori eitaaki rubat, o endukuya; nepejoo ninye ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
Masaai: Neituku ninye isorri e nkoshoke o loilelek nepejoo ninche tenebo ilo asar opejori te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
Masaai: Neitoki aitarasaa nkishorot oo ltung'ana, neya ina kine o lasar le ng'oki te nkaraki iltung'ana, neyieng ninye, neishooyo ninye te nkaraki eng'oki anaa ilo asar le dukuya le ng'oki.

English: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
Masaai: Neitarasaa ninye ilo asar opejori, neishooyo ninye te risioroto e nkitanapata.

English: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
Masaai: Neitoki aitarasaa ilo asar le ntapa, neiput nkaik enyena, nepejoo te nchumata olperere lo lasar, aitatashaki ilo asar opejori le nkakenya.

English: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
Masaai: Nepolos sii olkiteng o lmeregesh, ilo asar le seriani te nkaraki iltung'ana neyaki ilayiok le Aron ninye osarge neisuaaki enchumata olperere lo lasar aitaman,

English: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
Masaai: ore enkurriny eilo kiteng o eno lmeregesh, o eilata o lkidong'oe leilo meregesh, oina kurriny naimulumul isorri enkoshoke, o lairakuj, o lkina le moinyua;

English: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
Masaai: neiteleiki ninche ina kurriny enchumata oo luikuluaa, nepejoo ninye ina kurriny te nchumata olperere lo lasar,

English: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
Masaai: kake ore lelo oikuluaa o emuro e tatene eyuko Aron anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani; anaa enaitanapishe Musa.

English: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
Masaai: Neilepie Aron nkaik enyena aipirie iltung'ana nemayian ninche; nelotu ninye adou teine neishoorieki ilo asar opejori le ng'oki o lasar le seriani.

English: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
Masaai: Nepuo Musa o Aron atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo ore ake pee eipang'u ninche aapuonu boo nemayian ninche iltung'ana, neliooyu enkitoo o Laitoriani too ltung'ana pooki.

English: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
Masaai: Nelotu enkima naing'uaa dukuya Olaitoriani nemut ilo asar opejori oina kurriny natii shumata olperere lo lasar; ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki ina, nebuaku ninche nebatata too nkomomi enye.

English: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
Masaai: Ore apa Nadab o Abihu, lelo ayiok le Aron, meetae ake oleitu eyau emoti enye e nkima, nepik enkima atua, nepik enkorropil atua, neishooyo ninche enkima nemesinya te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu eitu eitanap Olaitoriani ninche meishooi.

English: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
Masaai: Nelotu enkima eing'uaa dukuya Olaitoriani nemut ninche, neye ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Ena bae etejo Olaitoriani, ‘kaitoduaaya nanu kewan nchere kara sinyati tiatua lekua laataaniki nanu, ore te dukuya iltung'ana pooki naaisisi nanu.’ ” Negira Aron.

English: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
Masaai: Neipotu Musa Mishael o Elisafan, ilayiok le Usiel olenkapu le Aron, nejoki ninche, “Entinyiku, entanap ilalashera linyi ewuang'ie tiatua ewueji sinyati ewaita auluo ilng'oborri.”

English: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
Masaai: Nenyiku ninche, nenap ninche too lkilani lenye aaya auluo ilng'oborri anaa enatejo Musa.

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa ajoki Aron o Eliesa o Itamar, lelo ayiok lenyena, “Emincho ake olpapita loo lukuny inyi eisiong'a, nimipolososo ilkilani linyi, pee miyeye ake, pee melotu engoro shumata ele turrur pooki; kake ore lelo alashera linyi, ina aji pooki e Israel neidim aaishira teina kinosata enkima nainuaa Olaitoriani.

English: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
Masaai: Nimipuopuo intae boo aaipang te kutukaji ele ng'obor le ntumo, pee miyeye ake; amu ore eilata o Laitoriani naputishoreki netii shumata intae.” Neas ninche te risioroto o rorei le Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani airorie Aron, ajoki,

English: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
Masaai: “Miok ake enaisho aashu ae toki naoki napi, iyie aashu lelo ayiok linono ootii tenebo iyie, tenilo atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, pee miyeye ake; keaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
Masaai: Pee itumutumu aaitirishu enasinya o enemesinya, e nemeiduruk o enaiduruk;

English: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: ninteng'ening'ene intae iltung'ana le Israel nena kitanapat pooki naairoro Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.”

English: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron o Eliesa o Itamar, lelo ayiok lenyena ootelekutua, “Entayu ilo asar le ntapa otelekua te lelo asarri oopejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, ninosinoso meisuisho te mbata olperere lo lasar, amu eisinyati oleng,

English: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
Masaai: ninosinoso intae te wueji sinyati, amu erubata ino o erubata oo layiok linono te nena kishorot naapejokini te nkima Olaitoriani; amu ina nanu aaitanapaki.

English: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oikulu oyukoki oina muro naishoruaki indimidimi aainosa te pooki wueji nemeiduruk, iyie o layiok linono o ntoyie inono tenebo iyie, amu eishoruaki ninche anaa erubata ino o erubata oo layiok linono te lelo asarri le seriani loo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
Masaai: Ore ina muro naishoruaki oilo oikulu oyuki keyau ninche tenebo lelo asarri e nkima oina kurriny, pee eyuki anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa olino o loo layiok linono tenebo iyie anaa erubata inyi ntarasi, anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani.”

English: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
Masaai: Neikilikuanua apa Musa ajurru ina kine o lasar le ng'oki, naa ng'ura etapejoyioki! Negorokino apa ninye Eliesa o Itamar, lelo ayiok le Aron apa ootelekutua, ejo

English: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
Masaai: “Kainyoo intae pee eitu inosinoso olasar le ng'oki tiatua ewueji sinyati naa entoki nasinya ninye oleng nikinchooki apa iyie pee itum atanapa entorroni ele turrur pee intobir olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani?

English: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eitu eyauni osarge lenye atua ewueji sinyati esipa eishaakino ninosa iyie tiatua e wueji sinyati, anaa enaitanapishe nanu.”

English: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
Masaai: Nejoki Aron Musa, “Ng'ura, eishooitie taata ninche olasar lenye le ng'oki o lasar lenye opejori te dukuya Olaitoriani, ore ake eyia aatadoikito nanu mbaa naaikununo nji! Amaa naaji tenaa kainosa nanu olasar le ng'oki taata, kanaata eaku keng'amaroyu te dukuya Olaitoriani?”

English: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Musa ina neshipa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
Masaai: “Entiaki iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Kuna ntokitin naaishu nindimidimi intae aainosa tiatua ing'uesi pooki naatii oriong enkop.

English: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki nasasha loisotok neinyaku eng'amurai, tiatua ing'uesi indimidimi aainosa.

English: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia ore tiatua nena naainyaku ingamura aashu esasha iloisotok niminosinoso kuna: entames amu keinyaku ninye eng'amurai kake mesasha loisotok, mesinya te intae.

English: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
Masaai: O enkijujur, amu keinyaku ninye eng'amurai kake mesasha iloisotok, mesinya te intae.

English: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
Masaai: Ore enkitejo, amu keinyaku ninye eng'amurai kake mesasha ninye iloisotok, mesinya te ntae.

English: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
Masaai: Olbitir amu kesasha ninye iloisotok kake meinyaku eng'amurai, mesinya te ntae.

English: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
Masaai: Ore nkiri enye minosinoso ake, ore mpopoki enye miseyieyie ake; mesinya ninche te intae.

English: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
Masaai: “Ndimidimi intae aainosa kuna, e pooki e nena naatii atua nkariak, ore pooki toki natii atua nkariak naata lopir o lpala aa atua enaiposha etii aashu ilkejek ndimidimi intae aainosa.

English: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
Masaai: Kake ore pooki toki natii inaaiposha aashu atua ilkejek nemeeta lopir, aashu ilpala, te nena naapuo tiatua nkariak o nena naaishu naatii atua nkariak naa olminong te intae.

English: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
Masaai: Nchoo eaku ninche olminong te intae, ore nkiri enye niminosinoso, ore mpopoki enye niminyikakiki. Nchoo eaku olminong te intae.

English: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki natii atua nkariak naa entoki nemeeta lopir o lpala naa olminong te intae.

English: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
Masaai: “Naa kuna naaku olminong tialo imotonyi, nemeinosi ninche, amu olminong ninche: olkurragos o lmotonyi loo lmurran, o lmotonyi sapuk le nkare,

English: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
Masaai: o enkolepo, o lenkalem te risioroto oo mpukunot enye,

English: Every raven after his kind;
Masaai: o pooki kurruk te risioroto oo mpukunot enyena,

English: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
Masaai: o esidai, olmuntut, olmagiro, o entilalu terisioroto oo mpukunot enyena,

English: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
Masaai: o emotonyi oo nkiyiaa o enagor kewan, o enaibalasho.

English: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
Masaai: Olkupelia, o enaadokutuk o enkinyankik, o entirriid, o encharab

English: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
Masaai: o entilagos o emotoroki o mpukunot enyena, o lembae nabo, o enagor kewan.

English: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
Masaai: “Ore ntokitin pooki naata inaipuko naapuo too nkejek ong'uan naa olminong te intae.

English: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, ore tiatua nena nyaun naata nkopir naapuo too nkejek moo ng'uan indimidimi intae aainosa nena naata ndapi too nkejek enye, naa ninche epuoyie te nkop.

English: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
Masaai: Ore te ninche nindimidimi aainosa olmaati te risioroto oo mpukunot enye, o entiantianyi o mpukunot enyena, o entaboi o mpukunot enyena o entargeeti o mpukunot enyena,

English: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
Masaai: kake ore nkulie nyaun pooki naata nkopir, neeta nkejek moo ng'uan naa olminong te ntae.

English: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: “Naa te kuna iakuku intae ilo lduruk, ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie mpopoki enye neiduruku ninye o metaa teipa,

English: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: ore pooki ng'ae ake ninye onap ae rubata oo mpopoki nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena neton ninye eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ues naiperra loisotok kake meeta loisotok oare, aashu meinyaku eng'amurai naa enturuj te intae, ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ninche neiduruku.

English: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki naapuo too ndapi, tiatua nena ng'uesi oo nkejek moo ng'uan naa olduruk te ntae; ore oloba anaa oloiseyie empopok enye neiduruku ometaa teipa.

English: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
Masaai: Ore ilo onap empopok enye nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena, neaku oloiduruk o metaa teipa; keiduruk ninche te ntae.

English: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
Masaai: “Naa kuna naara olduruk te intae tiatua nena tokitin naaikurtutari tioriong enkop: olmaima, enderoni, olmokua te risioroto oo mpukunot enyena,

English: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
Masaai: olmokua, olmaima, olpur, ologilalem, o tanki.

English: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Kuna naaiduruk te intae tiatua nena naaikurtutari; ore ilo oba anaa oloiseyie ninche teneye neton eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki toki nadoiki ninche etuata neaku enaiduruk, oi aa enchata, aashu enkila aashu olchoni, aashu olbene; pooki masaai ake ninye naasishoreki te pooki pukunoto; meeta nchere meitadoikini atua enkare, neton ninye aa olminong o metaa teipa; neitoki taa asidanu.

English: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
Masaai: Naa tenedoiki ake ninye nabo enye atua entoki naitobiruaki too nkulukuok ore ina toki pooki natii atua neaku eiduruk, ore ina moti oo nkulukuok entadany ninye.

English: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki daa natii atua naidimi aainosa, netubukokine enkare neaku keiduruk; ore entoki pooki naidimi aatook too masaa naijo kuna neaku keiduruk.

English: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki naba anaa enadoiki erubata ake ninye oo mpopoki enye neaku keiduruk, aa enepejishoreki aashu eneyierishoreki, nchoo ebeli aaitaa mbelibelat; keiduruk ninche naa keaku olduruk teintae.

English: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore ake etiu neijia ina ong'u enkare aashu eng'umoto natii enkare naa eisidai; kake ore ake teneshoroo mpopoki enye neaku keiduruk.

English: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
Masaai: Naa tenedoiki ake ninye erubata oo mpopoki enye ilanterera oopuoi aaun, ore lelo anterera naa aisidain ake;

English: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
Masaai: kake teneshuma olantererai tiatua enkare, nedoiki ake ninye pooki rubata enchumata e nena popoki e ilo antererai neaku keiduruk te intae.

English: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: “Naa teneye ake ninye eng'ues nabo e nena nindimidimi aainosa, ore ilo oiseyie empopok enye neaku oloiduruk o metaa teipa,

English: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: ore ilo onya nkiri enyena nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena neaku oloiduruk o metaa teipa. Ore sii ilo onap empopok nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena, neaku oloiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
Masaai: “Ore pooki toki naikurtutari ti oriong enkop naa keiduruk; meinosi ninye.

English: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
Masaai: Ore entoki naba anaa enalo te nkoshoke enye aashu pooki nalo too nkejek ong'uan aashu pooki toki naata nkejek kumok, nena tokitin pooki naaikurtutari ti oriong enkop, eminya ake, amu olminong ninche.

English: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
Masaai: Emintaa ake ate olminong te pooki toki naikurtutari; nimindurukiekie ate te ninche, pee miakuku ake ilolminong.

English: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, entisinya naa ate, pee iakuku sinyat amu kara nanu sinyati. Emindurukie ake ate tiae toki naikurtutari neiserpepiari ti oriong enkop.

English: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani ilo apa oitayio intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, pee aaku Enkai inyi, entaa naa sinyat, amu kara nanu sinyati.”

English: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata naipirta pooki ng'ues o entaritiki o pooki toki naishu nalo tiatua nkariak o pooki toki naishu naikurtutari ti oriong enkop,

English: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
Masaai: pee erishu nena naara inaaiduruk o nena nemeiduruk o nena ng'uesi naaishu naaidimi aainosa o nena ng'uesi naaishu nemeidimi aainosa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
Masaai: Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, tenenutayu enkitok, neiu enkayioni, neaku ninye enaiduruk too nkolong'i naapishana anaa te rishata enye o lapa, neiduruku ninye.

English: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet nemurati ina ayioni.

English: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye abik nkolong'i tomoni uni oo kuni teilo sarge lenye le nkitisinyata; nemeishori ninye meiseyie entoki sinyati aashu elotu atua enkaji Enkai o metaba anaa neishunye nkolong'i enyena enkitisinyata.

English: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
Masaai: Kake teneiu ninye entito, nebik ninye nkolong'i tomon oo ng'uan anaa te rishata enye olapa, nebik ninye teilo sarge lenye lenkitisinyata nkolong'i ntomoni ile o ile.

English: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
Masaai: “Ore pee eishunye nkolong'i enyena enkitisinyata aa to layioni aashu te ntito, neyaki ninye olapolosani te kutukaji olng'obor le ntumo olkuoo le ker lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori, o enturkuluo kiti aashu nturkuluoni naaku olasar le ng'oki.

English: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
Masaai: Neishooyo olapolosani te dukuya Olaitoriani neitobir olning'o lo osotua te nkaraki ninye, nesinyayu ninye teina rukunoto osarge lenye. Ena ninye enkitanapata tialo ina naiu enkerai aa enkayioni aashu entito.

English: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
Masaai: Naa tenemeidim ninye anoto olkuoo le ker, neya ninye nturkuluoni are aashu nturkuluoni are kutiti, nabo te nkaraki olasar opejori o enkae te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki. Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, nesinyayu ninye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
Masaai: “Teneeta oltung'ani enetukurrunye to sesen lenye aashu oltudutai aashu olpepedoi, neibelekenya aaku enkeeya oo lbolot to lchoni lo sesen lenye, neyakini ninye Aron olapolosani aashu obo loo layiok lenyena lelo apolosak.

English: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
Masaai: Nejur ilo apolosani ine netii olpepedoi olchoni to sesen lenye, naa teneibelekenyate ilpapit leine wueji netii olpepedoi lenye, aaiborru, nelioyu ina muoyian etugumo to sesen lenye, naa enkeeya oo lbolot ina, ore pee eidip olapolosani atujurro ninye, neibalunye ninye ajo oloiduruk.

English: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
Masaai: Kake teneibor ilo pepedoi otii olchoni lo sesen lenye, nelioo ajo eitu eturoyu alang olchoni, neitu eibelekenya olpapita leine eitu eturoyu alang olchoni, neitu eibelekenya olpapita leine aiborru, neikenoo olapolosani ilo tamuoyiai nkolong'i naapishana,

English: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
Masaai: neitoki olapolosani ajur ninye te nkolong e naapishana. Naa tenetujurro too nkonyek enyena ina muoyian, neitu eitoki ina muoyian aponari to lchoni neitoki olapolosani aikenoo ninye kulie olong'i naapishana.

English: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani ajur ninye te nkolong e naapishana naa tenetunukunye ilo pepedoi neitu eitoki ina keeya adaari to lchoni, neibalunye olapolosani ajo meiduruk ninye; olpepedoi ake, neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena nesidanu.

English: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
Masaai: Kake tenetadaari ilo pepedoi to lchoni lo sesen, ina kata eidipa aitoduaai kewan to lapolosani te nkitukuoto enye; neigil ninye alotu dukuya olapolosani;

English: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
Masaai: nejur olapolosani ninye, naa tenetubulayie ilo pepedoi to lchoni lo sesen lenye, netum olapolosani aibalunye nchere keiduruk enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
Masaai: “Teneidimu oltung'ani enkeeya oo lbolot, neyakini ninye olapolosani.

English: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
Masaai: Nejur olapolosani ninye, naa tenetii enetukurrunye neibor olchoni lo sesen lenye, neibelekenyate ilpapit leine aaiborru, niewotiote ine wueji

English: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
Masaai: naa enkeeya oo lbolot torrono natijing'a olchoni lo sesen lenye, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo keiduruk. Neikenoo olapolosani ninye aiwuang'ie to lorere amu keiduruk ninye.

English: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
Masaai: Naa teneipang'u ina keeya oo lbolot to lchoni lo sesen lenye, metaa eibulua enkeeya oo lbolot olchoni pooki lo sesen leilo tung'ani omuoi ebaiki endukuya o metabaiki nkejek, anaa enadol olapolosani

English: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
Masaai: nejur olapolosani ninye, naa teneibulua ina keeya oo lbolot osesen lenye, pooki neibalunye ninye ajo eisidai meiduruk teina muoyian; eibelekenye pooki aiborru, metaa meiduruk ninye.

English: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
Masaai: Kake tenelioyu ineewotiotate te ninye, neaku ninye oloiduruk.

English: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
Masaai: Nejur olapolosani ine neiwotiote, neibalunye ninye ajo keiduruk, ore ewueji neiwotiote to sesen naa keiduruk; amu enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
Masaai: Kake teneitoki ine neiwotiote aibelekenya neiborru, nelotu ninye enetii olapolosani,

English: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
Masaai: nejur olapolosani ninye, ore ake pee eibelekenya ina keeya aiborru, neibalunye olapolosani ilo tung'ani omuoi ajo meiduruk; eisidai ninye.

English: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
Masaai: “Naa tenetii oltudutai osesen lo ltung'ani, neishiu

English: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
Masaai: ore ine wueji apa oltudutai nejing ewueji naibor neteijia aashu ewueji oo ltipot ooibor o loo nyokie, nepuoi aaitodol olapolosani;

English: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
Masaai: ore olapolosani nejur ine, naa teneliooyu egut alang olchoni lo sesen ore ilpapit leine neibelekenyate aaiborru neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo olo lduruk, enkeeya oo lbolot ninye nayopua ilo tudutai.

English: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
Masaai: Kake tenejur olapolosani ine, ore ilpapit leine neitu eiborru neitu egutu alang olchoni lo sesen kake etunukunye neikenoo olapolosani ninye aiwuang'ie to lorere nkolong'i naapishana;

English: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
Masaai: naa tenedaari to lchoni lo sesen, netum taa olapolosani aibalunye ninye nchere oloiduruk; etijing'a ninye enkeeya oo olbolot.

English: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
Masaai: Kake tenetoni lelo tipot te wueji nebo nemeponari naa enkiporoi ake oltudutai, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo meiduruk.

English: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
Masaai: “Naa teneeta osesen ewueji neinosa enkima to lchoni lenye, ore ine wueji neinosa enkima neaku oltipoti, onyokie aashu oloibor,

English: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
Masaai: nejur olapolosani ine, ore pee eibelekenyate ilpapit leine aaiborru netugumo ine alang olchoni lo sesen, naa enkeeya o lbolot, ninye nayopua ina kinosata enkima, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo olo lduruk; enkeeya oo lbolot ena.

English: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
Masaai: Kake tenejur olapolosani ine ore ilpapit leine neitu eiborru neitu egutu alang osesen, kake etunukunye, neikenoo olapolosani ninye aiwuang'ie nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
Masaai: Nelotu olapolosani ajur ninye te nkolong e naapishana; naa teneibulayie to lchoni lo sesen lenye, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo oloiduruk naa keeta, enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
Masaai: Kake teneton ilo tipoti te wueji nebo nemeibulaa to sesen, kake etunukunye kake enetejia ake teina kinosata enkima neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo meeta entioto; amu enkiporoi enkima ake.

English: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
Masaai: “Naa teneeta olee anaa enkitok enkeeya te ndukuya anaa to lboony.

English: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
Masaai: Nejur olapolosani ine; ore pee elioyu ine egut alang olchoni lo sesen lenye, ore ilpapit leine naa eisikitok naa nelamilama, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo olduruk; amu olpepedoi ilo, enkeeya oo lbolot e ndukuya aashu enolboony.

English: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
Masaai: Naa tenejur olapolosani ina muoyian e mion, nelioyu ajo megut alang olchoni lo sesen, nemetii ilpapit oorook ine, netum taa olapolosani aikenoi ilo tung'ani oota olpepedoi nkolong'i naapishana,

English: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
Masaai: ore te nkolong e naapishana nejur olapolosani ina keeya; naa teneitu eibulaa ilo pepedoi nemetii ilpapit sikitok, nemelio ilo pepedoi etugumo alang olchoni lo sesen,

English: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
Masaai: netum taa ilo tung'ani atabarno kewan kake mebarn ilo pepedoi; neitoki olapolosani aikenoo ilo tung'ani oata olpepedoi kulie olong'i naapishana

English: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
Masaai: ore te nkolong e naapishana neitoki olapolosani ajur ilo pepedoi, naa teneitu eibulaa ilo pepedoi to sesen nelioyu ajo megut alang olchoni lo sesen neibalunye olapolosani ajo meiduruk; neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena, nesidanu.

English: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
Masaai: Kake teneibulayie ilo pepedoi osesen eidipaki aaisuja ninye,

English: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
Masaai: neitoki olapolosani ajur ninye, ore ake pee eibulayie ilo pepedoi osesen lenye, nemeeta tipat pee eitoki olapolosani aing'oru ilpapit sikitok; amu keiduruk ninye

English: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
Masaai: kake tenetujurruoki ilo pepedoi too nkonyek enyena, netubulakitia ilpapit oorook neishiuo ilo pepedoi, meeta ninye entioto, neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo meiduruk ninye.

English: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
Masaai: “Teneeta olee aashu enkitok iltipot to lchoni lo sesen lenye, iltipot ooibor,

English: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
Masaai: nelo olapolosani ajur, ore lelo tipot lo lchoni lo sesen lenye nemeibor oleng, naa ilgeet ootijing'a osesen lenye; meeta ninye olduruk.

English: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
Masaai: “Teneishunye ilpapit aapuku te ndukuya oltung'ani, naa endukuya ake natukurre, kake meeta ninye olduruk.

English: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
Masaai: Naa teneishunye ilpapit lo ltung'ani te nkalo enkomom enye o nkushu, naa endukuya ake natukurre te nkalo enkomom, kake meeta ninye olduruk.

English: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
