Masaai: Kake tenetii ina kurroto e ndukuya aashu ina kurroto enkalo enkomom oloti pepedoi onyokie neibor, naa enkeeya oo lbolot natijing'a enkurroto enye e ndukuya aashu ina kurroto enye enkalo enkomom.

English: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
Masaai: Nelotu naa olapolosani ajur ninye naa tenenyokie neibor ine neteijia tenkurrunoto enye e ndukuya anaa te nelio etiu anaa empukunoto enkeeya oo lbolot to lchoni lo sesen,

English: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
Masaai: naa oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot ninye, neata ninye olduruk; neibalunye olapolosani ninye ajo olo lduruk endukuya etii ina keeya enye.

English: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
Masaai: “Ore ilo tung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot nchoo eishop nkilani naapolosa neisho ilpapit le ndukuya enye eisiong'a, neimulumul ninye enkutuk enye ajo, ‘Olo lduruk olo lduruk.’

English: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
Masaai: Nebik ninye aa oltung'ani oata olduruk enkata pooki naba anaa enaata ina keeya; neaku ninye olaata entioto; neton ninye openy te wueji enye tiauluo ilng'borri.

English: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
Masaai: “Tenejing olduruk le nkeeya oo lbolot atua olkila, aa olkila loo ntare aashu olkila le kitani,

English: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
Masaai: tenaa oloripuno too usin anaa oloo nkarash naapuyiapui, anaa oloo lpapit loo ntare, anaa oloo ndapan, anaa ole pooki toki naitobiruaki too ndapan, anaa ole pooki toki naripuno too ndapan

English: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
Masaai: naa tenelioyu naa enkeeya oo lbolot enyori anaa enyokie to lkila, aa taa olkila oripuno too usin, anaa oloo ntokitin naapuyiapui, anaa oloo lpapit loo ntare, anaa oloo ndapan, anaa ole pooki toki naitobiraki too ndapan, naa enkeeya oo lbolot naa kepuoi aaitodol olapolosani.

English: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
Masaai: Nelo olapolosani ajur ina keeya, neikenoo ina naata enkeeya nkolong'i naapishana;

English: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
Masaai: neitoki taa alo ajur ina keeya te nkolong e naapishana. Teneibulayie enkeeya ilo kila, oripuno anaa oloo ntokitin naapuyiapui, anaa oloo ndapan, o endapana naasishoreki keiduruk ninye.

English: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye apejoo ilo kila, aa oloripuno too usin, arashu oloo ntokitin naapiyaya, anaa oloo lpapit loo ntare anaa ole kitani napuyiapui, anaa pooki toki oo ndapan, amu enkeeya torrono ina, naa kepejori te nkima.

English: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
Masaai: “Naa tenejur olapolosani, neitu eitoki ina keeya adaari teilo kila oripuno anaa o too ntokitin naapiyaya, anaa oloripuno anaa pooki toki oo ndapan,

English: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
Masaai: netum naa olapolosani aitanapisho meitukui ina toki natijing'a enkeeya neikenoo ninye nkulie olong'i naapishana;

English: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
Masaai: neitoki olapolosani ajur ina toki natijing'a enkeeya ina kata eidipaki aaitukuo. Naa teneitu eibelekenya emua e ilo tipoti le nkeeya, hoo neitu eibulaa ina keeya, naa olduruk; nipejoo iyie ninye te nkima, aa enkalo e oriong etii ilo tipoti le nkeeya oo lbolot aashu ene dukuya.

English: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
Masaai: “Kake tenejur olapolosani, nedol ajo eimisiloyie ilo tipoti eidipaki aaitukuo, netum naa ninye aigeru ilo tipoti aitayu teilo kila, aashu te ndapana, aashu teina naripuno aashu teina oo ntokitin naapiyaya.

English: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
Masaai: Naa teneigil aliooyu to lkila, oripuno too usin, anaa oloo ntokitin naapiyaya, anaa naaripuno o pooki toki oo ndapan, naa kegira adaari. Nilo apejoo te nkima ina natii enkeeya.

English: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo kila, oripuno too usin, anaa too ntokitin naapiyaya anaa pooki toki oo ndapan nemeekure etii oltipoti le nkeeya indipa intae aaitukuo, neitokini aaigil aaituku, kat are nesidanu taa.”

English: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata e nkeeya oo lbolot to lkila loo lpapit loo nkerra aashu le kitani, aa oloripuno aashu oloo ntokitin naapiyaya, aashu enaripuno aashu ae toki oo ndapan, pee eutu tenaa keeta olduruk aashu tenaa meeta olduruk.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
Masaai: “Ena naaku enkitanapata tialo ilo oata enkeeya oo lbolot teina olong enkitukuoto enye; keyakini ninye olapolosani,

English: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
Masaai: neipang olapolosani alo auluo ilng'oborri nelo ilo apolosani ajur ninye. Ore ake pee eishiwuo ina keeya oo lbolot teilo oata enkeeya oo lbolot,

English: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
Masaai: neitanap olapolosani ninche mewaita te nkaraki ninye ilo oituku imotonyi are sidain nemeiduruk naaishu o nkeek oo ntarakua o enkarasha nanyokie o hisopo;

English: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
Masaai: neitanap olapolosani ninche meteyiang'a nabo e nena motonyi tiatua emoti oo nkulukuok te nkare naruko.

English: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
Masaai: Neya ninye ina motonyi naishu tenebo nkeek oo ntarakua oina arasha nanyokie o hisopo, neitadoiki ninche oina motonyi naishu atua ilo sarge leina motonyi nateyieng'aki te shumata ina are naruko

English: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
Masaai: neisuaaki ilo oitisinyi teina keeya oo lbolot katitin naapishana; netum taa aibalunye ninye nchere meiduruk, neing'ueiki ina motonyi naishu aisho meshomo te nkisiajata.

English: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitisiny neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena, nebarn endukuya enye pooki, neituku kewan te nkare, nesidanu ninye, ore tesiadi ina nelotu ninye atua ang, kake keton teboo olng'obor lenye nkolong'i naapishana. Ore te nkolong e naapishana nebarn pooki te ndukuya.

English: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
Masaai: Nebarn ninye olmunyei lenye, olpapit loo nkonyek o lpapit lenyena pooki. Neitoki aituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku osesen lenye te nkare, neaku ninye olemeiduruk.

English: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e isiet neya ninye isitiman oare le kerra lemeeta entioto o esupen nabo e ker olari obo nemeeta entioto, o lasar le ntapa imatuan uni e tomon e efa, entapa napuyiapui naipurjakaki eilata, o ltulet obo le ilata.

English: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani oituku ninye nepik ilo tung'ani oitukui o kuna tokitin dukuya Olaitoriani, te kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
Masaai: Neya olapolosani obo le lelo sitiman le kerra, nepolos ninye metaa olasar le ngoki tenebo ilo tulet le ilata, neyuk ninche anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:
Masaai: neyieng ninye ilo kuo le ker te wueji neyieng'ieki olasar le ngoki, o lasar opejori, te wueji sinyati, te nkaraki olasar le nkitarruorroto, ore olasar le ngoki, naa eneilo apolosani, kesinya ninye oleng.

English: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
Masaai: Neya olapolosani embata eilo sarge lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, nepik olapolosani enchumata enkitipet e nkiok e tatene eilo oitukui, o enchumata olmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene, o le nkeju enye e tatene.

English: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aya embata eilata natii oltulet nebukoki endap enye e nkaina e kedienye

English: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
Masaai: neitadoiki olkimojino lenye le tatene atua ina ilata natii endap enkaina enye e kedienye neisuaaya embata eina ilata to lkimojino lenye katitin naapishana te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
Masaai: Ore embata eina ilata naleku te nkaina enye nepik olapolosani enchumata enkitipet e nkiok e tatene eilo oitukui, o enchumata olmogirra lenye le nkaina e tatene, o le nkeju enye e tatene, shumata ilo sarge lo lasar le nkitarruorroto;

English: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
Masaai: ore ina ae ilata natii enkaina o lapolosani nepik ninye endukuya eilo oitisinyi. Neitobir taa olapolosani o lasar olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
Masaai: Neishooyo olapolosani olasar le ngoki, aitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ilo oitisinyi te nkaraki enkiduruk enye. Ore te siadi neitoki ayieng olasar opejori,

English: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
Masaai: neishooyo olapolosani ilo asar opejori, o lasar le ntapa te nchumata olperere lo lasar. Neijia eiko olapolosani aitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, neaku ninye olemeiduruk.

English: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
Masaai: “Kake tenaa aisinani ninye nemeidim anoto ntokitin kumok, neya naa ositima obo le ker pee eaku olasar le nkitarruorroto oyuki, pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, o ematua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa, o oltulet le ilata.

English: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
Masaai: O nturkuluoni are sii aashu nturkuluoni kutiti are, anaa enaidim ninye anoto; ore nabo naa olasar le ngoki ore enkae naa olasar opejori.

English: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neyau ninye ninche te nkaraki enkitukuoto enye ine netii olapolosani, kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo, dukuya Olaitoriani;

English: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:
Masaai: neya olapolosani ilo kuo le ker lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, o ilo tulet le ilata, neyuk olapolosani ninche metaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ayieng ilo kuo le ker lo lasar le nkitarruorroto, neya olapolosani embata osarge leilo asar le nkitarruorroto, nepik enchumata enkitipet e nkiok e tatene eilo oitukui, o enchumata olmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene, o lmogirra le nkeju enye e tatene.

English: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
Masaai: Nebukoki olapolosani embata eilata endap enkaina enye e kedienye;

English: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
Masaai: neisuaki to lkimojino lenye le tatene embata eina ilata natii endap enkaina enye e kedienye katitin naapishana te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
Masaai: Nepik olapolosani embata eina ilata natii enkaina enye enchumata enkitipet enkiok e tatene eilo oitisinyi, olmogirra le nkaina enye e tatene, o le nkeju enye e tatene, teine wueji duoo netipikieki osarge lo lasar le nkitarruorroto;

English: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
Masaai: ore ina ae ilata naleku te nkaina olapolosani nepik ninye endukuya eilo oitisinyi, pee eitobiraki ninye olning'o lo sotua te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
Masaai: Neishooyo ninye olasar loo nturkuluoni aashu nturkuluoni kutiti anaa ake duoo enaidim aishooi,

English: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
Masaai: nabo te nkaraki olasar le ngoki o enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori tenebo olasar le ntapa, neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te dukuya Olaitoriani tenkaraki ilo oitukui.

English: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata te nkaraki ilo oata enkeeya oo lbolot, lemeidim ninye anoto olasar le nkitukuoto enye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
Masaai: “Tenipuonunu kenya ina kop e Kanaan naisho nanu intae metaa eninyi, tenapik nanu enkeeya oo lbolot atua enkaji tiatua ina kop inyi,

English: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
Masaai: ore ilo openy enkaji nelotu ajoki olapolosani, ‘Etii enkeeya nemayiolo atua enkaji ai.’

English: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
Masaai: Neitanapisho olapolosani ajo meitayuni ntokitin naatii ina aji eton eitu elo olapolosani ajurru ina keeya, pee meibalunyeki nena pooki naatii atua ina aji aajo keiduruk; ore te siadi neitoki olapolosani alo atua adol ina aji.

English: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
Masaai: Nelo ninye ajurru ina keeya, naa tenetii enkeeya isunta eina aji etii iltipot oo nyori o loonyokie, naa tenelioo aa eijo kegut aalang esuntai,

English: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
Masaai: neipang olapolosani teina aji alo kutukaji, neiken ina aji nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani alotu te nkolong e naapishana, aing'uraa, ore pee eidapashakine enkeeya isunta eina aji,

English: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
Masaai: netum taa olapolosani aitanapisho meitayuni lelo soito ootii enkeeya nenang'akini ninche atua ewueji neiduruk tiatua enkanasa;

English: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
Masaai: neisho ninye iliatuani leina aji meiutuuti nkaloli pooki, ore ina punyua nayutuutuni nepuoi aaibukoo te wueji neiduruk tiauluo enkanasa;

English: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
Masaai: neitokini taa aayau kulikae soito nepiki erishata e lekua soito, neyau ninye ae turoto nemurie enkaji.

English: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
Masaai: “Teneitoki ina keeya aigil ajing ina aji, eidipa ninye aitayu isoito neyutuuto ina aji neitoki amur le nturoto,

English: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
Masaai: nelo olapolosani aing'uraa, naa teneibulua ina keeya ina aji, naa enkeeya oo lbolot torrono natijing'a atua ina aji keiduruk ninye.

English: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
Masaai: Naa keuroo ninye ina aji, o soito lenyena o mbaoi enyena o ina turoto pooki e nkaji, nenap ninye ninche auluo enkanasa aya ewueji neiduruk.

English: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore sii oltung'ani ojing ina aji eton eikeno neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa;

English: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
Masaai: ore ilo oirrag tiatua ina aji neituku ilkilani lenyena, ore oloinos endaa tiatua ina o aji neituku ilkilani lenyena.

English: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
Masaai: “Kake tenelotu olapolosani ajurrisho, neitu eibulu ina keeya ina aji ina kata eidipaki aatumur te nturoto, neibalunye olapolosani ina aji ajo meiduruk, amu eishiunyeki ina keeya.

English: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
Masaai: Ore te nkipooto eina aji neya ninye nturkuluoni are kutiti, tenebo nkeek oltarakuai o enkarasha nanyokie o hisopo,

English: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
Masaai: neyieng emotonyi tiatua emoti oo nkulupuok te shumata enkare naruko,

English: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
Masaai: neitoki aya nena keek oltarakuai o hisopo oina arasha nanyokie tenebo ina motonyi naishu. Neitadoiki ninche atua ilo sarge le motonyi nateyieng'aki tiatua enkare naruko, neisuaki enkaji katitin naapishana.

English: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
Masaai: Neipok ina aji teilo sarge le motonyi, o te nkare naruko o teina motonyi naishu, o too nkeek oo ntarakua, o te hisopo oina arasha nanyokie.

English: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
Masaai: Neitoki taa aisho ina motonyi naishu meipang'a alo tiatua ina anasa alo ong'ota, neaku keitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ina aji naa kesidanu ninye aaku meiduruk.”

English: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata tialo pooki keeya oo lbolot, o to lpepedoi,

English: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
Masaai: te nkeeya oo lbolot natii enkila aashu atua aji,

English: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
Masaai: te wueji netejia aashu teneiwotiote aashu oltipoti

English: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
Masaai: pee etumi aaitodolu enkata naiduruk o enkata nemeiduruk. Ena ninye enkitanapata te nkaraki enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
Masaai: “Entiaki iltung'ana le Israel, teneeta ake ninye oltung'ani osupetai to sesen, ore erukoto eilo supetai lenye naa keiduruk.

English: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
Masaai: Naa ena ninye enkitanapata enkiduruk enye teilo supetai oruko: teneruko ilo supetai lenye aashu tenetudung'e, naa enkiduruk ake te ninye.

English: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki dapash nairrag ilo tung'ani oata osupetai neiduruku ore pooki toki natonie ninye neiduruku.

English: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseiyie endapash enye neituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae otonie pooki toki natotonie ilo oata erukoto, neituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare, neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie osesen leilo tung'ani oata osupetai neituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare neton eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Naa tenenotaki ilo oata osupetai oltung'ani lemeiduruk, nelo ninye aituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare neton ninye eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki natonieki te mbarta tenetonie ilo oata osupetai neiduruku.

English: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie pooki toki natii abori ninye neiduruku o metaa teipa, ore ilo onap entoki neijo ina nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ilo tung'ani oata osupetai eitu eng'as aisuj nkaik enyena te nkare nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
Masaai: Ore ngirran naaitobiruaki too nkulupuok naaiseyie ilo oata osupetai nepuoi aabel; ore engirra pooki naguetuno te nchata neisuji te nkare.

English: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
Masaai: “Ore ilo oata osupetai teneitukui te nkaraki ilo supetai lenye, netum taa aikenaki kewan nkolong'i naapishana enkitukuoto, neituku ilkilani lenyena, nelo aituku osesen lenye te nkare naruko neaku taa olemeiduruk.

English: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neyau ninye nturkuluoni are aashu nturkuluoni are kutiti, nelotu dukuya Olaitoriani te kutukaji ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neisho ninche olapolosani;

English: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
Masaai: neishooyo olapolosani ninche, nabo te nkaraki olasar le ngoki o enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori; neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkaraki ilo supetai lenye.

English: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: “Naa teneitayu olee enkare e lewaisho to sesen lenye, nelo ninye aituku osesen lenye pooki te nkare neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore pooki kila o pooki shoni oitashala enkare e lewaisho neitukui te nkare, neton ninye eiduruk o metaa teipa.

English: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Teneboitare olee enkitok nepuku enkare e lewaisho, nepuo pokira aaituku ate te nkare, netoni ninche eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: “Teneitayu enkitok osarge, aa empukunoto e oshiaake to sesen lenye, neton ninye te nkiduruk enye nkolong'i naapishana ore oloba anaa oloiseyie ninye neiduruku ometaa teipa.

English: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki napetaa ninye te nena olong'i enyena e nkiduruk neiduruku; ore sii pooki toki natonie ninye naa keiduruku.

English: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie endapash enye nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie pooki toki natonie ninye neituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare, neton eiduruk ometaa teipa;

English: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: ore duoo ninye tenaa endapash aashu pooki toki natonie, teneiseyie neiduruku ninye ometaa teipa.

English: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
Masaai: Naa teneboitare oltung'ani ninye, nejing olduruk leina kitok ninye, neaku ninye oloiduruk nkolong'i naapishana; ore pooki dapash nairrag ninye neiduruku.

English: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
Masaai: “Teneitayu enkitok osarge too nkolong'i kumok, neme te nkata enye enkiduruk, teneeta erukoto naitogiroo inoshi olong'i e nkiduruk enye, neton ninye tiatua enkiduruk; anaa ake too nkolong'i enyena enkiduruk, keiduruku ninye.

English: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
Masaai: Ore endapash pooki nairrag ninye too nkolong'i pooki o sarge, netiu te ninye anaa endapash enkiduruk; ore pooki toki natonie ninye neiduruku, anaa ake tenkiduruk e nena olong'i enyena osarge.

English: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloiseyie kuna tokitin neiduruku ninye, neituku ilkilani lenyena, neituku kewan te nkare neton ninye eiduruk ometaa teipa.

English: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
Masaai: Kake teneitukui ninye te rukoto enye, neikenaki ninye kewan enye nkolong'i naapishana, ore tesiadi ina neaku ninye meiduruk.

English: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neyau ninye nturkuluoni are aashu nturkuluoni are kutiti, neyaki ninche olapolosani, te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
Masaai: Neishooyo olapolosani nabo te nkaraki olasar le ngoki o enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori; neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkaraki ilo sarge lenye le nkiduruk.

English: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
Masaai: “Nejia enkuna entooru iltung'ana le Israel metung'uai enkiduruk enye, pee meye ake tiatua enkiduruk enye neisarkionie olng'obor lai sinyati otii atua ninche.”

English: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata eilo oata osupetai o ilo oitayu enkare e lewaisho to sesen lenye netum enkiduruk teina.

English: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
Masaai: O teina sii namuoi te nkiduruk enye; aa taa, te pooki ng'ae, olee aashu enkitok, naata osupetai, o to lee oboitare ina kitok naiduruk.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa, eidipa lelo ayiok pokira oare le Aron aatuata, ina kata apa pee enyiku ninche aapuonu dukuya Olaitoriani neye;

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaaki Aron ilo alashe lino pee melotu nkatitin pooki atua ine wueji sinyati tiatua ilo karasha, dukuya ilo orika lo lng'ur otii shumata osanduku, pee meye ake; amu kaliooyu nanu teina atampoi natii shumata ilo orika lo lng'ur.

English: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
Masaai: Kake nji eikununye Aron tenelotu atua ine wueji sinyati nelotu eata oloti oing'oni lo lasar le ngoki o lmeregesh lo lasar opejori.

English: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
Masaai: Neishop ninye ilo kila osinya le kitani, neishop ninye nkilani e atua e kitani to sesen lenye, nerretena te nkimeita e kitani, neishop enkopiyia e kitani, kuna ninche nkilani naasinya. Neituku ninye osesen lenye te nkare paa keishop taa.

English: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
Masaai: Neya ninye teilo turrur loo ltung'ana le Israel isitiman oare le kineji te nkaraki olasar le ngoki, o lmeregesh obo te nkaraki olasar opejori.

English: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
Masaai: “Neitayu Aron oloing'oni metaa olasar le ngoki te nkaraki kewan enye, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan enye o enkaji enye.

English: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aitayu nkineji are, nepik ninche dukuya Olaitoriani te kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
Masaai: neoshoki Aron enkukuo nena kineji pokira are, aoshoki enkukuo te nkaraki Olaitoriani o te nkaraki Asasel.

English: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD'S lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
Masaai: Neitarasaki Aron ina kine natadoikio enkukuo te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neishooyo ninye metaa olasar le ngoki;

English: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
Masaai: kake ore ina kine natooshokoki enkukuo te nkaraki Asasel nepuo aaitarasaki eishu te dukuya Olaitoriani pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, pee etumi aaishoo meshomo adung ong'ata alo Asasel.

English: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
Masaai: “Neitarasaa Aron ilo oing'oni metaa olasar le ngoki te nkaraki kewan enye o enkaji enye; nelo ninye ayieng ilo oing'oni metaa olasar lenye makewan.

English: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
Masaai: Neitoki aya olmoti obore nkuk naaishu naaing'uaa olperere lo lasar te dukuya Olaitoriani, o mboreitin are enkaina enkorropil naidongoki aarrar; neyau ninye atua lelo karash lo lng'obor

English: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
Masaai: nepik ina orropil enkima te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee etum enkatampoi eina puruo aimulumula ilo orika lolng'ur otii enchumata e wueji enchakenisho pee meye ake;

English: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
Masaai: neya ninye embata o sarge leilo oing'oni, neisuaaya to lkimojino lenye te dukuya eilo orika lo lng'ur, otii dukuya e ilo orika lo lng'ur neisuaaki ninye ilo sarge to lkimojino lenye katitin naapishana.

English: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
Masaai: “Neitoki ninye ayieng ina kine o lasar le ngoki te nkaraki iltung'ana neyau osarge lenye atua lelo karash oodung'oro le wueji sinyati, neitaas ilo sarge anaa enaitaasa ilo sarge lo loing'oni, aisuaki enchumata eilo orika lo lng'ur o dukuya ilo orika lo lng'ur.

English: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
Masaai: Neiko ninye neijia aitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ine wueji sinyati, te nkaraki enkiduruk oo ltung'ana le Israel, o te nkaraki nkitapong'ot enye, o ngok enye pooki; neiko sii neijia te nkaraki ilo ng'obor le ntumo, otii tenebo ninche empolos oo lduruki lenye.

English: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
Masaai: Nemetii oltung'ani hoo obo atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ina kata ejing olapolosani atua alo aitobir olning'o lo sotua tiatua ine wueji sinyati ometaba anaa neipang'u ninye alotu boo neidipa aitobira olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan enye o enkaji enye oeumata pooki oo Siraeli.

English: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aipang'u alo ilo perere lo lasar otii dukuya Olaitoriani neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, neya ninye embata eilo sarge lo loing'oni o ilo sarge le nkine, nepik nena mowuarak o lperere lo lasar aitaman.

English: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neisuaaya embata o sarge te nchumata eye to lkimojino lenye katitin naapishana, neituku ninye neitisiny teina tioto oo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
Masaai: “Ore ake pee eidip aitobira olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ine wueji sinyati o ilo ng'obor le ntumo o lperere lo lasar, neitarasaa ninye ina kine naishu;

English: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
Masaai: neiteleiki Aron nkaik enyena pokira are endukuya eina kine naishu, neibalunye te shumata ninye nkitarruorot pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, o nkitapong'ot enye pooki, ing'ok enye pooki; nepik ninye ninche enchumata e ndukuya eina kine, neisho ninye meshomo ong'ata te nkaina oltung'ani oidipaki aaibalie.

English: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
Masaai: Nenap ina kine nkitarruorot enye pooki alo enkop nememanya; neisho ninye ina kine meshomo ti ong'ota.

English: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
Masaai: “Neitoki Aron alotu atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitayu ninye lelo kilani le kitani apa ooishopo ina kata pee elo ewueji sinyati, neing'uaa ninche teine;

English: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
Masaai: neituku ninye osesen lenye te nkare teine wueji sinyati, neitoki aishop lelo kilani lenyena, neipang'u alotu neishooyo ilo asar lenye opejori o ilo asar opejori te nkaraki iltung'ana, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki kewan enye o te nkaraki iltung'ana.

English: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
Masaai: Ore ina kurriny o lasar le ngoki nepejoo ninye te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
Masaai: Ore elo alaaya ina kine meshomo Asasel neituku ilkilani lenyena neituku osesen lenye te nkare, ore te siadi ena neidim aeu atua enkang oo ng'oborri.

English: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
Masaai: Ore ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ngoki o ina kine o lasar le ngoki apa ooyawuaki o sargeta lenye pee eitainyeki olning'o lo sotua tiatua ine wueji sinyati, nenapi aaitupuku aayau auluo ilng'oborri; ore endapana olchoni o nkiri enye o moyok enye nepejori te nkima.

English: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
Masaai: Ore ilo opejoo ninche nelo aituku ilkilani lenyena neituku osesen lenye te nkare ore te siadi ena neidim ninye aeu atua ilng'oborri.

English: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
Masaai: “Naa keaku ena enkitanapata te intae ntarasi nchere ore to lapa liopishana, te nkolong e tomon o lapa nieniene ate aapukoo, nimiasiasa esiaai, aa oinoti aashu oldokunoti oewuo aton tiatua intae;

English: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
Masaai: amu tena olong epuoi aaitobiraki intae, olning'o lo sotua tialo ing'ok inyi pooki naa keitisinyi intae te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
Masaai: Enkolong e sabato ina e nkiyeng'iyeng te intae, naa intanyamalala ate aaen ate aaitupukoo ate; enkitanapata ena ntarasi.

English: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
Masaai: Ore ilo apolosani otubukokoki eilata aaput neitisinyaki metaa olapolosani te rishata e papaai lenye nelo aitobir olning'o lo sotua eishopito lelo kilani oosinya le kitani;

English: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
Masaai: neitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ina aji e Enkai, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki olng'obor le ntumo o te nkaraki olperere lo lasar, neitobir ninye olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ilapolosak o te nkaraki iltung'ana pooki leina umata.

English: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Naa keaku ena enkitanapata oo ntarasi te intae; nchere keidimi aitobiraki iltung'ana le Israel olning'o lo sotua kata nabo to lari te nkaraki ing'ok enye pooki.” Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena, o iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, Ena bae eitanapishe Olaitoriani.

English: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
Masaai: Teneyieng ake ninye oltung'ani le nkaji e Israel olkiteng aashu olker aashu enkine tiatua enkang oo lng'oborri aashu eyieng tiauluo,

English: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
Masaai: nemeyau ninye kutukaji eilo ng'bor le ntumo, pee eishooyo anaa enkishooroto to Laitoriani te dukuya ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, neikenakini ilo tung'ani aajo eata entioto o sarge; eibukoyie ninye osarge; neyae ilo tung'ani aaiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ena naa te nkaraki pee etum iltung'ana le Israel aayau lelo asarri lenye aayieng ti ong'ata, pee etum aayaki ninche Olaitoriani, ine netii olapolosani te kutukaji ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neyieng ninche anaa lasarri loo nkishorot e seriani to Laitoriani;

English: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: nelo olapolosani aisuaki osarge enchumata o lperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nepejoo enkurriny metaa esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
Masaai: Metaa meigil aekata ninche aayiang'aki ilasarri lenye loo loiriruani, laa ninye etololoitore. Keaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi te nkaraki ninche tiatua iishoreitin enye pooki.

English: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
Masaai: “Naa tiaaki iyie ninche, ore pooki tung'ani le nkaji e Israel aashu o le lelo tung'ana omon oo etuo aatoni tiatua ninche oishorua olasar opejori,

English: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: nemeyau kutukaji olng'obor le ntumo, pee epolosaki ninye Olaitoriani; ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
Masaai: “Ore pooki tung'ani le nkaji e Israel aashu o le lelo tung'ana omon ootoni tiatua ninche, te nenya osarge, naing'orie nanu enkomom ai te ngoro ilo tung'ani oinosa osarge, naiwuang'ie ninye tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
Masaai: Amu ore enkishui oo nkiri naa atua osarge etii, naishooyie nanu te nkaraki intae te nchumata olperere lo lasar pee eitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki iltauja linyi; amu osarge oitobir olning'o lo sotua, te nkaraki e nkishui.

English: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
Masaai: Neaku atiaaka nanu iltung'ana le Israel, Meetae oltung'ani tiatua intae oinos osarge, nemeinos ilo tung'ani omoni oton tiatua intae osarge.

English: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
Masaai: Ore sii pooki tung'ani too ltung'ana le Israel aashu lelo omon ootii atua ninche olo arresh aibung eng'ues aashu emotonyi pee etumi aainosa neibukoo osarge lenye neitemoo too nkulukuok.

English: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
Masaai: “Amu ore enkishui e pooki toki naishu naa osarge lenye etii. Neaku atiaaka nanu iltung'ana le Israel, Eminos ake osarge li ae toki ake ninye pooki, amu ore enkishui e pooki toki naishu naa osarge lenye etii; ore pooki ng'ae oinos osarge neiwuang'ieki ninye.

English: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
Masaai: Ore pooki tung'ani oinos entoki natua openy aashu enataara louarak te ntim, aa oinoti aashu olomoni oidurrua, nelo ninye aituku ilkilani lenyena, neisuj osesen lenye te nkare, neton ninye eata olduruk o metaa teipa, netum taa atisidana.

English: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: Kake tenemeituku ninye ilkilani lenyena anaa eituku ososen lenye nenap ninye entorroni enye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
Masaai: Miasiasa anaa enaasita ninche te nkop e Misiri, teine apa nemanya intae, nimiasiasa anaa enaasi te nkop e Kanaan teine nayaita nanu intae nimipuopuo intae too nkiguanat enye.

English: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Entaas intae nkiguanat aainei nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei nipuoyieyie ninche. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Embung'a naa nkitanapat aainei o nkiguanat aainei, naa teneas oltung'ani neton eishu: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Metii oltung'ani te intae onyikaki o likae lenye le sotua auru ilkilani aitalioo emasipaisho enye. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Masaai: Mioru ake papaai lino ilkilani aitaa olmasipai amu emasipaisho e ng'utunyi ina. Ng'utunyi ina nimilo naa aitalioo emasipaisho enye.

English: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
Masaai: Milo aitalioo emasipaisho e nkitok e papaai lino; amu emasipaisho e papaai lino ina.

English: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkanashe ino, ning'arie menye aashu ina tito e ng'utunyi aa einoti eang aashu enayawuaki.

English: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
Masaai: Nimintalioo emasipaisho entito o layioni lino aashu ene ntito e ntito ino amu ore emasipaisho enye naa emasipaisho ino makewan.

English: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e ntito ning'arie menye, ina naino te papaai lino, amu enkanashe ino ninye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkanashe e papaai lino amu eno lmarei le papaai lino ninye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho enkanashe e ng'utunyi amu eno lmarei le yieyioo lino ninye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho o lalashe papaai lino, aa taa minyikaki enkitok enye; amu nkapu ino ninye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkitok o layioni lino, amu entito ino ninye, mintalioo emasipaisho enye.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkitok o lalashe lino, amu emasipaisho o lalashe lino.

English: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
Masaai: Mintalioo emasipaisho e nkitok tenebo entito enye, nimiya entito o layioni lenye aashu entito e ntioto enye aitalioo emasipaisho enye; nkanashera inono ninche, entorroni ina.

English: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
Masaai: Nimiya enkanashe enkitok ino ayam eton eishu enkanashe enye.

English: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
Masaai: “Milo enetii enkitok aboitare eton etii erishata enye o lapa.

English: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
Masaai: Nimiboitare enkitok olelatia ino apik kewan entioto te ninye.

English: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Minchooyo ae nabo oo nkera inono meitarasari to lasar le nkima aaisho enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai e Molek aisarkionie enkarna e Nkai ino; Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
Masaai: Miboitare ake olee aitaa enkitok; entaboi ina.

English: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
Masaai: Nimiboitare ake eng'ues pooki aisarkionie kewan te ninye, nemeisho enkitok kewan eng'ues metaboitare, entaboi ina.

English: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
Masaai: “Emisarkionie ate tiae nabo e kuna baa, amu te kuna pooki eisarkionie ate lelo oshon pooki laaraa nanu te dukuya intae.

English: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
Masaai: Neaku enkop enaisarkionieki, neaku aitamio nanu enkitarruorroto enye, nelopu enkop lelo oomanya.

English: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
Masaai: Kake embung'a intae nkitanapat aainei o nkiguanat aainei nimiasiasa ae nabo e kuna tabo, aa oinoti aashu ilo dokunoti oidurrua alotu atua intae.

English: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
Masaai: (Amu ore kuna baa o lminong pooki etaasa apa iltung'ana lena kop, lelo apa ootii dukuya intae, neaku eisarkionieki enkop);

English: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
Masaai: pee melopu ake intae enkop, tenisarkionienie, anaa apa enatolopua ilo osho otii dukuya intae.

English: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
Masaai: Amu ore oloba anaa oloas nabo e kuna baa olminong, ore lelo tung'ana oas neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenye.

English: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Metaa embung'a enkitanapata ai nimiasiasa aikata ae nabo e kuna tabo oo lkuaki apa ootaasaki te dukuya intae, nimisarkionienie ate te ninche: ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
Masaai: “Tiaaki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel, iakuku intae sinyat; amu ore nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa kara sinyati.

English: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Nchoo eyanyit pooki ng'ae te intae ng'otonye o menye, nimbung'ubung'u sabatoni aainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Emimbelekenyakino nkitanyaanyukot aashu intobirakiki ate nkaitin oo ntokitin naasholuno: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
Masaai: “Tenintarasaa olasar loo nkishorot e seriani aaisho Olaitoriani, entarasai intae pee etumi aatang'amai intae.

English: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
Masaai: Neinosi ina olong ake nintarasaitie, aashu taisere, ore pooki toki naleku ometaa enkolong e uni nepuoi aapejoo te nkima.

English: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
Masaai: Teneinosi ninye penyo te nkolong e uni, naa olminong; meitokini aang'amaa,

English: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: ore pooki ng'ae oinos nenap entorroni enye, enkaraki naisarkionie ninye entoki sinyati o Laitoriani; ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenye.

English: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
Masaai: “Tenisampu enkurma nituturo te nkop ino, nimisampu aitabaiki ineebayie nimishuko alo agilu lelo ng'osil ootung'uayioki.

English: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Miishu ilng'anayio to sabibu lino, nimisotu lelo ootusulari to sabibu lino. Tung'uai ninche te nkaraki ilaisinak o tenkaraki olomoni. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
Masaai: “Mipurrisho, nimiasisho te sunkureisho, nemilej oltung'ani olikae.

English: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Niminosinoso ilmuma te nkarna ai te sunkureisho, pee misarkionienie enkarna e Nkai inyi. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
Masaai: “Mintorogony o lelatia ino aashu ipur ninye. Mincho olmushaara lo sinka lino eirrag te nkaji ino enkewarie pooki o mekenyu.

English: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Midek oltung'ani ming'ani nimipikaki oltung'ani modooni entoki narror, kake turia Enkai ino. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
Masaai: “Mipik enyorrakinoto endung'oto enkiguana, mipik olkep olaisinani nimiureyu ilo kitok, kake te sipata tudung'oki enkiguana olelatia ino.

English: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Milo iyie idie o idie anaa olaitang'oroni tiatua iltung'ana linono, nimintashe iyie aitang'or enkishui o lelatia ino: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
Masaai: “Mimbayu olalashe lino tiatua oltau lino kake entoning'oto pee minap ake eng'oki te nkaraki ninye.

English: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Mintalaku ake elap aashu iata enkiba tiatua oltau tialo ilayiok loo ltung'ana linyi, kake tonyorra olelatia ino anaa kewan ino. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
Masaai: “Embung'a nkitanapat aainei, miputokiki nkishu inyi iloing'ok loo mpukunot naapaasha, nimiun tiatua enkurma ino mpukunot are oo lanterera niminchop olkila oripa too mpukunot are oo nkarash.

English: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
Masaai: “Teneboitare olee enkitok nara errindik natisira, likae lee neton eitu elakuni aashu eishoori ae toki, nejurri ina bae, neari ninche metuata, enkaraki naa errindik ina kitok.

English: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
Masaai: Kake keyau ilo lee enkishoroto o lasar le nkitarruorroto ayaki Olaitoriani, kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo, neyau ninye olmeregesh metaa olasar le nkitarruoroto.

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye teilo meregesh lo lasar le nkitarruorroto te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa ninye; ore ina ng'oki nataasa ninye nepalakini.

English: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
Masaai: “Tenipuopuo kenya aajing ina kop niunuunu mpukunot pooki oo lkeek te nkaraki endaa, niyiolouu lelo ng'anayio lenye aajo etomitikioki intae ilarin okuni, minosinoso ninche.

English: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan nesinyayu ilng'anayio lenye pooki, enkishoroto enkisisa to Laitoriani.

English: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Kake ore to lari le imiet nindimidimi aainosa ilng'anayio lenye, pee etum aaishoo intae emponaroto sapuk. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
Masaai: “Minosinoso pooki toki natii osarge atua. Emimbonishorere nimisiaishore ntaleng'o.

English: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
Masaai: Emintamanaa endung'oto oo lpapit loo lmowuarak loo lukuny inyi nimibarnibarna mbat oo lmunyo linyi.

English: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Eming'am iseseni linyi te nkaraki iloo tuata aashu imishiriri ate: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
Masaai: “Misarkionie entito ino aisho metaa emulayoi, meiput ake enkop entorroni e nkiborra oo nkonyek neaku enkop enabore esuujisho.

English: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Embung'a sabatoni aainei niyanyititi enkaji ai Sinyati. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Emipuopuo aaikilikuanishore iltungana ooirorie loiriruani loo lootuata aashu lasakutok. Emipuopuo aaing'oru ninche, aaisarkionie ate te ninche: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Tudumunye iyie te dukuya lelo ooibor lukuny, iyanyita oltung'ani moruo naa turia Enkai ino. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
Masaai: “Teneidurru oltung'ani omoni alotu amany enkop ino mintaas ninye entorrono.

English: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Ore ilo omoni likindurraka naa keyooki atiu anaa oinoti tiatua intae, naa tonyorra naa ninye anaa kewan. Amu irara sii apa intae ilomon te nkop e Misiri: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
Masaai: “Mias entorrono te ndung'oto e nkiguana, te ntemata enkadoro aashu te nkineneng enkiroishi aashu te nkumoi.

English: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ng'oru ntemeta nemetii elejare o entemata e nkiroishi nemetii elejare, o soito le nkiroishi leme le lejare efa nairirikino o hini nairirikino. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri.

English: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Embung'a naa nkiguanat aainei pooki o nkitanapat aainei pooki niasiasa ninche. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel ore pooki tung'ani loo ltung'ana le Israel aashu o le lelo omon ooidurrakita aamany atua Israel, oishooyo nabo oo nkera enyena aaisho Molek neari metua; ore iltung'ana lena kop near ninye too soito.

English: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
Masaai: Nanu kewan oibelekenyakino aipirakinore ilo tung'ani naiwuang'ie nanu ninye tiatua iltung'ana lenyena, enkaraki naishooyie nabo oo nkera enyena aisho Molek, nepik enkaji ai entioto neisarkionie enkarna ai sinyati.

English: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
Masaai: Naa teneisudoo iltung'ana leina kop ilo tung'ani ina kata eishooyo nabo oo nkera enyena aisho Molek, neany ear ninye metua,

English: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
Masaai: naibelekenyakino nanu aarare ilo tung'ani naarare olmarei lenye, naitayu nanu ninche aiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenye, ninye o lelo pooki oosujita ninye te nkiborra oo nkonyek e sujata e Molek.

English: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
Masaai: “Teneibelekenyakino oltung'ani ltung'ana oirorie iloiriruani o lasakutok, aiborrie onyek te ninche, naibelekenyakino nanu ilo tung'ani aarare naitayu nanu ninye aiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenye.

English: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Entisinya naa ate niakuku sinyat, amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
Masaai: Embung'a nkiguanat aainei, niasiasa ninche, Ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny intae.

English: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ng'ae odek menye aashu ng'otonye neari metua; etedia ninye menye aashu ng'otonye, neaku ore osarge lenye shumata ninye etii.

English: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: “Teneloloito oltung'ani te nkitok o lelatia enye, ore pokira olee o enkitok natololoitare neari metuata.

English: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani oboitare te loloito enkitok e papaai lenye netaboluo nkilani e papaai lenye, ore ninche pokira are neari metuata, ore osarge lenye neaku shumata ninche etii.

English: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
Masaai: Ore olee oboitare enkitok o layioni lenye, neari pokira are metuata; etaasa ninche embae busus, ore osarge lenye neaku shumata ninche.

English: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
Masaai: Teneboitare olee olikae lee anaa enkitok, ore ninche pokira netaasa olminong, naa keari ninche metuata, ore osarge lenye neaku shumata ninche.

English: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
Masaai: Teneyam oltung'ani entito o ng'otonye tenebo, naa entorroni ina, naa kepejori ninche te nkima, ilo lee o nena kituaak, pee meitoki esuujisho atii atua intae.

English: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
Masaai: Teneboitare oltung'ani eng'ues aloloitore, neari ninye metua, ore ina ng'ues neari metua.

English: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
Masaai: Teneing'oru enkitok eng'ues aboitare te loloito neari ina kitok metua ore ina ng'ues neari ninye metua ore osarge lenye neaku shumata ninche etii.

English: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
Masaai: “Teneyam oltung'ani enkanashe enye, ina nang'arie menye, aashu enkanashe nangarie kina, nelo ninye aboitare nedol olee emasipaisho enye nedol entito emasipaisho olee naa embae e sulare ina, naa keiwuang'ieki ninche te dukuya nkera olorere lenye; etaboluo ninye nkilani enkanashe enye, naa kenap ninye entorroni enye.

English: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
Masaai: Teneboitare olee enkitok eata emuoyian enye, nebolu nkilani enyena, netusula ninye erukunoto enye, neitalioo ninye erukunoto osarge lenye; ore ninche pokira are naa keiwuang'ieki tiatua iltung'ana lenye.

English: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
Masaai: Mintalioo ake emasipaisho enkanashe yieyioo lino aashu ene nkanashe papaai lino, amu ore ina naa nkilani itooruo oltung'ani le sotua lo lmarei; naa kenap ninche entorroni enye.

English: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
Masaai: Teneboitare oltung'ani enkitok olenkapu lenye, naa kenap ninche eng'oki enye, neye eitu etum nkera.

English: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
Masaai: Teneya oltung'ani enkitok olalashe lenye naa embae nemesinya ina netaboluo ninye nkilani olalashe lenye nemetum ninche nkera.

English: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
Masaai: “Embung'a naa nkitanapat aainei pooki o nkiguanat aainei pooki, niasiasa ninche paa ore ina kop nariku nanu intae entamany nemelopu intae aitayu.

English: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
Masaai: Nimipuopuo aasujaa olkerreti leilo orere laaraa nanu te dukuya intae, amu etaasa apa ninche kuna baa pooki naibayie nanu ninche.

English: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
Masaai: Kake atiaaka nanu intae, ‘Ijung'ujung'u intae enkop enye, naa kaisho nanu intae metaa eninyi, ina kop naruko kule o naishi.’ Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, otirishua intae aitung'uaa loreren.

English: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
Masaai: Enoto naa entirishu eng'ues nasinyari o enemesinyari, o te motonyi nasinyari o enemesinyari, emindurukie naa ate te ng'ues aashu emotonyi aashu tiae toki naikurtutari te nkop, apa natorishie nanu intae nchere mesinyari.

English: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
Masaai: Entaa intae sinyat te nkaraki nanu; amu ore nanu Olaitoriani naa kara sinyati natirishua intae aitung'uaa iloreren, pee itumutumu aataa ilkulainei.

English: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
Masaai: “Ore olee aashu enkitok nairorie oltung'ani otua aashu esakutisho neari metua, neari ninche too soito, ore osarge lenye neaku shumata ninche etii.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Irorie ilapolosak, lelo ayiok le Aron nijoki ninche meetae olenye oisarkionie kewan to ltung'ani otua tiatua iltung'ana lenye,

English: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
Masaai: meteleku ake to ltung'ani le sotua lo lmarei, aa ng'otonye, aa papaai lenye aa, olayioni lenye, aa entito enye, aa o lalashe lenye,

English: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
