Masaai: aashu eselenkei nemeyiolo olee enye neitu eyami naa ninye enyikare amu meeta olmoruo; ore teina neidim ninye aisarkionie kewan.

English: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
Masaai: Nemepik kewan olduruk tenaa kitok tiatua iltung'ana lenyena, metaa keidurukie kewan.

English: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
Masaai: Nemipik nkurrot ilukuny enye nemebarn mbat oo lmunyo lenye aashu edung'udung iseseni lenye.

English: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
Masaai: Keaku ninche sinyat te nkaraki Enkai enye, nemeisarkionie enkarna e Nkai enye, keitarasaa ninche ilasarri te nkima aaitarasaki Olaitoriani, ina mukate e Nkai enye; metaa keaku ninche sinyat.

English: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
Masaai: Nemeyam ninche emulayoi, aashu enkitok naisarkionieki, aashu enkitok natung'uayie olmoruo lenye, amu ore olapolosani naa eisinyati te nkaraki Enkai enye.

English: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.
Masaai: Intisinya ninye, amu keitarasaa ninye emukate e Nkai ino; keaku ninye sinyati te iyie, amu ore nanu Olaitoriani ilo likintisiny, ara sinyati.

English: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
Masaai: Ore entito e pooki apolosani teneisarkionie kewan neiborrie onyek naa papaai lenye eisarkionie nepejori ninye te nkima.

English: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
Masaai: “Ore olapolosani ora kitok tiatua ilalashera lenyena, otubukokoki endukuya enye eilata aaput neitisinyaki meishopo ilkilani nemeisho olpapita le ndukuya enye meisiong'ayu aashu epolos ilkilani lenyena.

English: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
Masaai: Nemelo ninye ayiaya osesen lo ltung'ani otua, aashu epik kewan entioto te papaai lenye aashu te ng'otonye;

English: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.
Masaai: nemeipang ninye alo tiatua ewueji sinyati, aashu eisarkionie ewueji sinyati e Nkai enye; amu ore ina kitisinyata e mbukokinoto e ilata naputishoreki e Nkai enye netii shumata ninye: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
Masaai: Naa keyam ninye eselenkei nemeyiolo olee aitaa enkitok.

English: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
Masaai: Ore enkoliai, aashu enatung'uayie olmoruo lenye aashu enaisarkionieki aashu emulayoi ore kuna meeyam ninye; kake nchoo ninye eyam eselenkei nemeyiolo olee o lorere lenye;

English: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
Masaai: pee meisarkionie ake eishoi tiatua olorere lenye; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron, meetae hoo obo tiatua eishoi ino too ishooritin enye pooki oata entioto oidim atinyiku aitarasai emukate e Enkai enye.

English: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
Masaai: Amu meetae oltung'ani oata entioto oidim atinyiku, oltung'ani modooni aashu olmaima o ltung'ani tarrush aashu olemelulung'a osesen.

English: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
Masaai: Aashu oltung'ani ogila enkeju aashu ologila enkaina,

English: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
Masaai: anaa oloruja enkoriong, anaa olkorriot lemebulu, anaa oloata oltialei anaa oloata ilpepedo, anaa oloata ilbolot to sesen lenye anaa oloidong'oki aaitaa osunash,

English: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
Masaai: meetae oltung'ani le ishoi e Aron ilo apolosani oata eleyiata oidim atinyiku aitarasai nkishorot o Laitoriani naapejori te nkima, ore amu keeta naa eleyiata menyiku ninye alotu aitarasaa emukate e Nkai enye.

English: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
Masaai: Ekeidim ninye ainosa emukate e Nkai enye eine wueji sinyati aisul o enoo ntokitin sinyat,

English: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
Masaai: kake melotu ninye ataaniki olkarasha lo lodung'oro le wueji sinyati aashu ataaniki olperere lo lasar, amu keata ninye eleyiata, pee melotu ninye aisarkionie iwuejitin aainei sinyat; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.”

English: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kuna etiaaka Musa Aron o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana pooki le Israel.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena metalama nena tokitin naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel naaishoo ninche nanu, pee meisarkionie enkarna ai sinyati: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore pooki ng'ae tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki, too lporori linyi pooki, tenenyikaki nena tokitin sinyat, naaitisinyakitia iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, eata kereek, ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa ine natii: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo le ishoi e Aron oata enkeeya oo lbolot, aashu eruko nkimek oidim ainosa nena tokitin sinyat ometaba anaa neaku bioto. Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie entoki nemesinya aibung empopok aashu oltung'ani opuku enkare e lewaisho,

English: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
Masaai: anaa oloba anaa oloiseyie entoki naikurtutari naidim aidurukie ninye, aashu oltung'ani oidim aitasuroki enkiduruk, naba ake duoo ninye anaa enaata,

English: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
Masaai: ore ilo tung'ani oiseyie mbaa naaikununo neijia neaku ninye oloiduruk ometaa teipa nemeinos nena tokitin sinyat meteleku ake teneituku osesen lenye te nkare.

English: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edoyio enkolong nemeitoki ninye aiduruk; ore te siadi neidim ninye ainosa nena tokitin sinyat, amu kuna ninche ndaiki enyena.

English: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore entoki natua openy, aashu enainosa ng'uesi entim meinos ninye, apik kewan olduruk te ninche: Ara nanu Olaitoriani!’

English: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
Masaai: Nchoo naa ninche eibung nkitanapat aainei, pee menap ing'ok te nkaraki ninye, neye ninche teine neisarkionie nkitanapat aainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.

English: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
Masaai: “Meinos olomoni ina toki sinyati, ore olomoni lo lapolosani aashu osinka lo lmushaara nemeinos ina toki sinyati.

English: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
Masaai: Kake teneinyang'u olapolosani orrindik too mpisai aitaa emasaai enye makewan, neidim ilo rrindik ainosa ina toki; ore lelo ootoiwuoki tiatua enkaji enye neidim aainosa ina daa enye.

English: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
Masaai: Teneyam oltung'ani leeiking'a entito o lapolosani nemeinos ina tito nena kishorot oo ntokitin sinyat.

English: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
Masaai: Kake tenaa enkoliai ina tito olapolosani aashu etung'uayie olmoruo lenye, nemeeta nkera, neshukunye alotu enkang e menye, anaa apake te keraisho, neidim ninye ainosa ina daa e menye; ore ake eyia meetae oltung'ani leeiking'a oidim ainosa ina daa.

English: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
Masaai: Naa teneinos oltung'ani ina toki sinyati meyiolo ajo endaa sinyati neponiki ninye ematua e imiet e tomon oo ntokitin enyena alak, neisho ina toki sinyati olapolosani.

English: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
Masaai: Meisarkionie ilapolosak nena tokitin sinyat oo ltung'ana le Israel, naaitarasaki ninche Olaitoriani,

English: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
Masaai: aaitarasaki ninche metanapa enkitarruoroto o enkitadiata, te nkinosata e nena tokitin enye sinyat, amu ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
Masaai: “Tiaaki Aron o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana pooki le Israel, Teneitayu ake oltung'ani le nkaji e Siraeli aashu oloeuo amanyisho tiatua Israel olasar lenye, tenaa entoki olmumai lenye aashu tenaa enkishorunoto to ltau lo lpela naitarasakini Olaitoriani anaa olasar opejori,

English: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
Masaai: pooki ake pee eng'amaroyu naa tenaa olbung'ae lemeeta entioto aa oloo nkishu aashu oo loo nkerra aashu o loo nkineji.

English: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
Masaai: Kake emipolos ake entoki naata entioto, amu meng'amaroyu ina tialo intae.

English: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
Masaai: Naa tenepolos ake ninye oltung'ani olasar le seriani apolosaki Olaitoriani, pee eitabaya olmumai aashu tenaa olasar lo lpela, oing'uaa eluaata oo nkishu aashu eluaata oo ntare, naa pooki ake pee eng'amaroyu naa tenaa bayaroti nemetii entioto atua ninye.

English: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ng'uesi modook aashu ng'ojinia maiman, anaa nemelulung'a seseni anaa enaruko nkimek, anaa enaata olpepedoi, emipolosaki Olaitoriani nena ng'uesi aashu intaikinyenye ilasarri oopejokini te nkima Olaitoriani te nchumata olperere lo lasar.

English: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
Masaai: Ore oloing'oni aashu ositima le ker oata erubata osesen lenye naado aashu endorrop nindimidimi intae aitaa olasar lo lpela, kake ore to lasar le nkitabaroto olmumai menyorrarri.

English: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ues natokurdaki ilterege lenyena aashu eidong'oki, aashu etopolosaki aashu etegelemaki mipolosakiki Olaitoriani aashu intaunyenye ilasarri tiatua enkop inyi;

English: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
Masaai: nimintobiriri anaa endaa e Nkai inyi pooki ake ninye ng'ues nayaua oltungani omoni. Amu keeta ninche ntiot tenkaraki melulunga ninche nemeng'amaroyu tialo intae.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Teneini olbung'ae aashu ositima le ker aashu ole kine, neton ninye nkolong'i naapishana tenebo ng'otonye, ore te nkolong e isiet neaku keng'amaroyu anaa olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani.

English: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
Masaai: Naa tenaa duoo enkiteng ng'otonye aashu enker nimiyieng ninye tenebo olashe o ngotonye aashu olkuo o ngotonye te nkolong nabo.

English: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
Masaai: Naa tenipolos olasar le nkishoroto e nashe apolosaki Olaitoriani nipolos naa pee etum ataa keng'amaroyu.

English: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Neinosi ninye teina olong ake, nimileku ae toki mekenyiki: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Metaa embung'a nkitanapat aainei niasiasa ninche: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
Masaai: Nimisarkionienie ake enkarna ai sinyati, kake kaayanyituni nanu tiatua iltung'ana le Israel: Ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny intae,

English: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: apa oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri pee aaku Enkai inyi: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel ore lelo siruai gelunot lo Laitoriani, lilimunyenye aaibalunye nchere iumat sinyat lelo siruai laainei kulo ninche isiruai gelunot naa ninche kulo.

English: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
Masaai: Nkolong'i ile easi esiai; kake ore te nkolong e naapishana naa enkolong e sabato naitirring'ae aayeng'iyeng'a, eumata sinyati, miasiasa intae esiaai ina olong. Sabato ina to Laitoriani tiatua imanyishoreitin inyi pooki.

English: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
Masaai: “Kulo ninche lelo siruai oogeluno to Laitoriani, nena umat naasinya, naa ninche ipuopuo aalimu aaibalunye too nkatitin enye naategelakaki ninche.

English: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD'S passover.
Masaai: “Ore to lapa le dukuya te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan o lapa, teipa, naa pasaka o Laitoriani.

English: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet eilo apa ake naa osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki to Laitoriani, ninosinoso intae imukateni neitu eisuishieki nkolong'i naapishana.

English: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya nintayuyu eumata sinyati, nimiasiasa esiaai nagol.

English: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
Masaai: Kake intarasaa ilasarri te nkima aaitarasaki Olaitoriani nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e naapishana naa eumata sinyati, nimiasiasa esiaai nagol.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel tenipuonunu kenya atua ina kop naisho nanu intae nisampumpu ilng'anayio lenyena, eyaki intae irridat loo lng'anayio le dukuya le nkisampuare olapolosani;

English: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
Masaai: nelo ninye ayuk ilo rridati te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee itumutumu aanoto eng'amaroto, ore pee ekenyu etulusoyie sabato neyuk olapolosani ilo rridati.

English: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ore ina olong niyukuyuku ilo rridati, nipolososo olkuo leker lo lari obo lemeeta entioto anaa olasar opejokini Olaitoriani.

English: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
Masaai: Ore ilo asar le ntapa opudakini naa rubat are e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, pee eitayunyeki olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, esong'ouna narropil o lasar le ntoki naoki tenebo ninye naa enaisho oo sabibu erubata e ong'uan etomon ninye.

English: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Masaai: Niminosinoso intae imukateni aashu ilpaek ootoito aashu ilooshal ometabau ina olong, ometaba anaa niyauu ilasarri le Nkai inyi; enkitanapata ena oo ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi too manyishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
Masaai: “Ninkenikene intae ebaiki ina akenya etulusoyie sabato, ebaiki ina akenya apa niyautua orridati lo lasar oyuki wikii naapishana naalulung'a,

English: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: aaikenu nkolong'i onom ometabaiki ina akenya nasuju sabato e naapishana; nitumutumu taa aaitarasaki olasar leina tapa ng'ejuk Olaitoriani.

English: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
Masaai: Niyauu intae tiatua imanyishoritin inyi imukateni are pee eyuki, naaitobirunyeki irubat are tiatua e tomon e Efa, naa ine ntapa napuyiapui, naa kepeji ninche tenebo enkisuijoi, anaa ilng'anayio le dukuya ooishori Olaitoriani.

English: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nintarasaa intae tenebo nena mukateni ilkuoo le kerra oopishana lo lari obo lemeeta ntioot, o loti oing'oni obo, olmeregeshi oare, neaku ninche olasar opejokini te nkima Olaitoriani tenebo olasar lenye le ntapa o lasarri lenye ooki, anaa olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
Masaai: Nipolososo ositima obo le kine metaa olasar le ng'oki, o lkuoo oare le kerra lo lari obo anaa lasarri le seriani.

English: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
Masaai: Neyuk olapolosani ninche tenebo ina mukate oo lng'anayio le dukuya anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya o Laitoriani, tenebo lelo kuoo oare le kerra; neaku ninche sinyat to Laitoriani tenkaraki olapolosani.

English: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
Masaai: Nilimu aibalunye ina olong nintayuyu eumata sinyati, nimiasiasa esiaai nagol enkitanapata ena ntarasi tiatua imanyishoreitin inyi pooki, tiatua iishoritin inyi.

English: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Naa tenisampumpu intae nkurman inyi nimisampumpu aaitabaiki nkiting'ot, nimisotisoto ina kurma nitudung'o te nkisampuare entung'uai ninche te nkaraki olaisinani o lomoni: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, ore to lapa liopishana te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nimbung'ubung'u enkolong naeng'ieng'ae aaitirring'a, endamunoto nalimuni aaibalunye te oshoto oo ntarumpetani, eumata sinyati.

English: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nimiasiasa esiaai nagol nintarasakiki Olaitoriani olasar opejori te nkima.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e tomon eilo apa liopishana naa enkolong o lning'o lo sotua naa keaku te intae enkata e umata sinyati, naa ieniene ate aaitupukoo nintarasakiki Olaitoriani olasar opejori tenkima.

English: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
Masaai: Nimiaasiasa esiaai teina olong; amu enkolong o lning'o lo sotua, pee eitobiri olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: Amu ore oltung'ani lemeen kewan aitupukoo teina olong neitayuni aaiwuang'ie too ltung'ana lenyena.

English: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloas esiaai teina olong, ore ilo tung'ani naidaikie aiwuang'ie tiatua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Masaai: Miasiasa intae esiai: Keaku ina enkitanapata ntarasi tiatua iishoritin too manyishoritin inyi pooki.

English: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
Masaai: Keaku te intae enkolong naeng'ieng'ae aaitirring'a nieniene ate aaitupukoo. Ore te nkolong e naaudo o lapa eiteru teipa, eiteru te nteipa ometabaiki teipa imbung'ubung'u intae sabato inyi.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet ele apa liopishana o too nkolong'i naapishana naa osirua loo lng'oborri lo Laitoriani.

English: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya naa keaku eumata sinyati, miasiasa intae esiaai nagol.

English: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
Masaai: Nkolong'i naapishana intarasaa intae ilasarri oopejori te nkima aaisho Olaitoriani, ore te nkolong e isiet nimbung'ubung'u eumata sinyati nintarasakiki olasar opejori te nkima Olaitoriani, eumata e seremare ina. Miasiasa intae esiai nagol.

English: These are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
Masaai: “Kulo ninche isiruai oogeluno lo Laitoriani, laa ninche ilimumu aaibalunye anaa iumat naasinya naaitarasakinyeki Olaitoriani ilasarri te nkima, ilasarri ooki olasar ake te nkolong enye naishiaakino.

English: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
Masaai: Tenebo nena sabatoni o Laitoriani o tenebo nkishorot inyi o tenebo lelo muma linyi pooki o tenebo nena kishorot inyi pooki o lpela ninchosho intae Olaitoriani.

English: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa liopishana, indipa intae aaiturrurro ilng'anayio le nkop, nipuopuo intae aaibung osirua lo Laitoriani nkolong'i naapishana, neaku enkolong e naapishana enaeng'iyeng'ae aaitirring'a neaku sii enkolong e isiet enaeng'iyeng'ae aaitirring'a.

English: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
Masaai: Nintayuyu intae te nkolong e dukuya ilng'anayio le lelo keek sidain, o ilng'osil loo ltuka, o ilng'osil lo lchani olit, ning'idayuyu te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
Masaai: Nimbung'ubung'u intae anaa osirua lo Laitoriani nkolong'i naapishana tiatua olari; enkitanapata ena oo ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki; mbung'ubung'u intae ina to lapa liopishana.

English: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
Masaai: Nitonini too lng'oborri nkolong'i naapishana; ore lelo pooki ooikino Israel netoni too lng'oborri,

English: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: pee etum iishoritin inyi aatayiolo nchere aishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel metotoni too lng'oborri ina kata apa ayau ninche aipang'unye te nkop e Misiri: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Musa aibalakinye iltung'ana le Israel isiruai oogeluno to Laitoriani.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel pee kiyaki iyie eilata nasila oo loirienito te nkaraki oltaa, pee eton oltaa eyupuyup anaake.

English: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
Masaai: Ore tioriong ilo karasha le nchakenisho tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nepik Aron ine aitobiraki ebaiki teipa ometaa tadekenya dukuya Olaitoriani anaake; keaku ena enkitanapata ntarasi tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
Masaai: Kepik ninye iltaai aitobiraki aiteleiki lelo iketa loo ltaai le sahabu nasila te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake.

English: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
Masaai: “Niya iyie entapa napuyiapui nipej imukateni tomon oare eina tapa; naa irubat are e tomon e Efa ake emukate.

English: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
Masaai: Nirragie ninche aitatash maare, neaku ile etatashaki te nchumata eina misa e sahabu nasila.

English: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nipik iyie olbani osila tenebo ake olkereri, pee etum atupudare ina mukate anaa erubata nadamuni napuoi aaisho Olaitoriani te nkima.

English: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
Masaai: Ore te pooki olong e sabato neirragie Aron aitobiraki te dukuya Olaitoriani anaake terishata oo ltung'ana le Israel anaa olning'o lo sotua ntarasi.

English: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
Masaai: Naa keaku te nkaraki Aron o layiok lenyena, neinos ninche tiatua ine wueji sinyati, amu ore te ninye naa erubata sinyati oleng naing'uaa nena kishorot naapejokini te nkima Olaitoriani, embae nadamuni anaake.”

English: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
Masaai: Ore apa olayioni le nkitok oo Siraeli laa o le Misiri menye, nelo ninye tenebo iltung'ana le Israel; ore ilo ayioni le nkitok e oo Siraeli o ltung'ani le Israel neitarrikino tiatua enkang oo lng'oborri.

English: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the LORD, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
Masaai: Ore ilo ayioni le nkitok oo Siraeli nemor ina Arna nedek. Neyau ninche ninye enetii Musa. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Shelomit, entito e Dibri, oloshole Dan.

English: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
Masaai: Neikenoo ninche ninye ometaba anaa neibalakinyeki ninche yieuna o laitoriani.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
Masaai: “Empang'unye tiatua enkang oo lng'oborri ilo otedekishe; naa nchoo lelo pooki ootoning'o ninye eiteleiki nkaik enye endukuya enye, naa nchoo eumata pooki ear ninye too soito.

English: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
Masaai: Naa entiaaki lelo tung'ana le Israel, ore ilo pooki odek Enkai enye nenap eng'oki enye.

English: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD, shall be put to death.
Masaai: Ore ilo omor enkarna o Laitoriani neari metua. Near ninye olturrur pooki too soito, ilo omoni o ilo inoti. Tenemor ninye ina Arna neari metua.

English: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Ore ilo oar oltung'ani metua, neari metua.

English: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
Masaai: Ore ilo oar eng'ues metua, nelak enkishui ake o te nkishui.

English: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
Masaai: Tenepik oltung'ani ole latia enye olbae, ore anaa enataasa keitaasi sii ninye,

English: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
Masaai: engilata o loito te ng'ilata oloito, enkong'u te nkong'u, o lalae to lalae, anaa enaitaasa ninye olikae neija sii ninye eitaasi.

English: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
Masaai: Ore ilo oar eng'ues metua nelak ore ilo oar oltung'ani metua neari sii ninye metua.

English: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Embung'a intae enkitanapata nabo to lomoni o to inoti; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neaku eirorie apa Musa iltung'ana le Israel, neyaki ninche ninye ilo otedekishe te nkang oo lng'oborri, nenang ninche ninye too soito. Neiko neijia iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa te nchumata oldoinyo le Sinai,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, tenipuonunu kenya ina kop naisho intae, neibung ina kop sabato te nkaraki Olaitoriani,

English: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
Masaai: ilarin ile intae iunuunu nkurman inyi, naa ilarin ile intobiriri ilng'anayio linyi, nisotisoto ilng'anayio lenye;

English: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
Masaai: kake ore to lari liopishana neaku sabato naeng'ieng'are ina meturo, sabato to Laitoriani; miunuunu intae nkurman inyi aashu intobiriri ilng'anayio linyi.

English: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
Masaai: Ore ina nabulu openy tiatua enkisampuare inyi nimintayuyu aaya, ore isabibu leilo shani leitu eitobiri nimisotisoto intae; keaku olari oengieng'ae aaitirring'a te nkaraki ina kop.

English: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
Masaai: Ore ina sabato ena kop naa keisho intae endaa intae maate, o rrindiki linyi loo lewa o loo ng'oruo o sinkan lo lmushaara oilo omoni oton tenebo iyie;

English: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
Masaai: o nkishu inono sii o nena ng'uesi naatii atua enkop ino, ore pooki naaiu enkop naa keaku endaa.

English: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
Masaai: “Naa einken iyie iwikii naapishana oo larin, katitin naapishana ilarin oopishana, peyie aa ore nena katitin naapishana o nena wikii naapishana oo larin neaku ilarin artam ooudo.

English: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
Masaai: Nintoki taa airriwaa oltung'ani meshomo enkop pooki aosh entarumpeta aitadar te nkolong e tomon o lari liopishana; ore teina olong o lning'o lo sotua niosh entarumpeta aitadar tiatua enkop ino pooki.

English: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
Masaai: Nintisinyinyi olari lionom nilimumu aaibalunye elakunoto tiatua ina kop pooki aaliki lelo pooki oomanya; naa keaku osirua te intae, ina kata errinyokino ake oltung'ani te ntae ntokitin enyena o lmarei lenye.

English: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
Masaai: Ore teilo ari lionom naa keaku osirua te intae, ore teina nimiunishosho aashu isampumpu ina nabulu openy, aashu isotutu ilng'anayio loo sabibu leitu eitobiri.

English: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
Masaai: Amu osirua naa; keaku sinyati te intae, ninosinoso intae nena naabulu too nkurman.

English: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
Masaai: “Ore tiatua ele ari lo sirua nerrinyo ake oltung'ani te intae alo enetii imasaa enyena.

English: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
Masaai: Naa tenimiraki ole latia ino aashu teninyang'u to le latia ino, niminyalakinono maate.

English: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
Masaai: Ore anaa eneba ilarin te siadi ilo sirua neijia eba enkinyiang'a teilo lelatia ino, naa terisioroto oo larin loo ndaiki kimiraki ninye.

English: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
Masaai: Tenaa kumok ilarin niponaa iyie enkinyang'a, naa tenaa kuti ilarin nintaa kiti enkinyiang'a, amu esiana oo larin ninye kimirakinye iyie.

English: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Eminyala intae maate kake entureita Enkai inyi; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
Masaai: “Neaku embung'a intae nkitanapat aainei nimbung'ubung'u nkiguanat aainei niasiasa ninche; pee itonini tiatua ina kop te seriani.

English: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
Masaai: Keiu ina kop ilng'anayio lenyena, ninosinoso intae aaraposho nitonini tiatua ninye te seriani.

English: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
Masaai: Naa tenijojo intae, “Kainyoo kinya teilo ari liopishana, tenimikiun aashu kinturrur enkurma ang?”

English: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
Masaai: Kairriwaki nanu emayianata ai shumata intae to lari le ile pee etum atoiu ilng'anayio too larin okuni.

English: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
Masaai: Ore iunishosho to lari le isiet ninosinoso endaa musana; ometabau olari lioudo olotunye endaa enye, inosinoso endaa musana.

English: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
Masaai: Memiri enkop te nkinyang'a e katukul, amu enaai enkop; amu irara intae ilomon ooidurrakita tenebo nanu.

English: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
Masaai: Naa ore tiatua ina pooki nitii entipik enkinyang'a e lakunoto.

English: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
Masaai: “Teneaku aisinani olalashe lino, nemir embata oo masaa enyena, ore ilo alashe onyikare nelotu akordu ina natimira olalashe lenye.

English: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
Masaai: Tenemeeta oltung'ani olikae okordu ina, kake neitoki ninye adupoyu netum ntokitin naakordunye,

English: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
Masaai: nchoo ninye eiken ilarin ebaiki ina kata apa pee emir neitoki ninye alak aitulus teilo tung'ani apa otimiraka, nerrinyokino taa ayau atua imasaa enyena.

English: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
Masaai: Kake tenemeeta ninye ntokitin naaidip naarrinyokinye kewan enye, neaku naa ore apa ina natimira neton too nkaik eilo apa oinyang'ua ometabau olari le Yubilii, ore te Yubilii nelaari ninye nerrinyokino ninye imasaa enyena.

English: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
Masaai: “Tenemir oltung'ani enkaji enye namanya, natii atua enkanasa nasheta, isunta neidim ninye aitalaku tiatua olari olulung'a eidipaki aatimir; to lari olulung'a elo ninye atum esipata nakordunye.

English: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
Masaai: Naa teneitu ekorduni tiaatua olari olulung'a, ore ina aji natii atua ina anasa nasheta sunta neitisipi katukul aajo enetii apa ilo oinyang'ua, tiatua iishoritin enyena pooki; nemepuoi aarriny tolari le Yubili.

English: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
Masaai: Kake ore nkajijik e nena ang'itie kutiti nemeeta isunta naamanita ninche neitanyaanyukieki inkurman enkop; keidimi aatokordu, naa kepuoi aarriny to lari le Yubilii.

English: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia nena anas oo Lawi nena ajijik naatii atua nkanas enye keidim ile lawi aatokordu pooki kata.

English: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Naa tenetii obo Lawi lemeasishore esipata enye enkordunoto, ore apa ina aji natimiraki tiatua enkanasa enye nerrinyuni to lari le Yubilii; amu ore nena ajijik naatii atua nkanas oo Lawi naa imasaa enye tiatua ltung'ana le Israel.

English: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
Masaai: Kake ore nkurman e nena nemeidimi aatimir amu imasaa enye nena ntarasi.

English: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
Masaai: “Naa teneaku olalashe lino aisinani, neaku meidim ataretu kewan tenebo iyie, tareto iyie ninye, anaa olomoni anaa olamutanani likiewuo ashulare.

English: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
Masaai: Ming'orunye ninye dupoto aashu ing'orunye toki, kake turia Enkai ino; pee etum olalashe lino atotona te mbata iyie.

English: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
Masaai: Misilenoki iyie ninye mpisai inono te mponikinoto nimincho iyie ninye endaa ino aing'oru dupoto.

English: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo likiyawua iyie aitupuku te nkop e Misiri pee kincho iyie enkop e Kanaan; neaku ninye Enkai ino.

English: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
Masaai: “Naa teneaku olalashe lino aisinani te mbata iyie, nikimiraki iyie kewan enye, mincho iyie ninye mikisiaayia anaa orrindik.

English: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
Masaai: Keaku ninye tenebo iyie olaisiaayiani lolmushaara o anaa sii olomoni. Eikisiaai ninye iyie ometabau olari le Yubilii;

English: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
Masaai: nikitum taa ashomo atung'uai, ninye o nkera enyena naatii tenebo ninye, neshuko alo enetii olmarei lenye, neshuko alo enetii imasaa o loo menye.

English: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
Masaai: Amu isinkan lainei ninche, apa layaua nanu aitupuku te nkop e Misiri; mepuoi aamir ninche anaa rrindiki.

English: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
Masaai: Milo iyie aitore ninye te nkisikong'ata kake turia Enkai ino.

English: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
Masaai: Ore tialo ilewa aashu ing'oruo rrindiki linono ooba anaa iliaata indim iyie ainyiang'u ilewa aashu ing'oruo rrindiki tiatua lelo oshon likimanita iyie.

English: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
Masaai: indim sii te lelo omon likindurrakita iyie o te lelo mareita lenye ootii tenebo iyie, te lelo ootoiwuoki tiatua enkop ino; neaku ninche imasaa inono.

English: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
Masaai: Ninguekiki ilayiok linyi te siadi intae, pee ejung aaitaa imasaa enye intarasi; ndimidimi intae aaitaa ninche irrindiki, kake ore te shumata ilalashera linyi lelo tung'ana le Israel mintorere, oltung'ani ake olikae tenkisikong'ata.

English: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
Masaai: “Tenelo neaku olomoni aashu ilo oidurrua karsis, ore olalashe lino otashare neaku aisinani nemiraki kewan ilo omoni aashu ilo oidurrua otii tenebo iyie, aashu obo lo lmarei leilo tung'ani omoni,

English: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
Masaai: ore eidipaki aatimir ninye neidimi aatokordu ninye; keidim obo loo lalashera lenyena atalaku ninye.

English: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
Masaai: Aashu olenkapu lenye aashu enkerai olenkapu lenye, neidim atalaku ninye, aashu oltung'ani le sotua onyikare oleng ora ololmarei lenye neidim atalaku ninye; aashu tenekarsisu neidim atalaku kewan.

English: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
Masaai: Neiken ninye tenebo ilo apa oyawua ninye ebaiki ilo ari apa otimirakinye kewan ninye ometabau olari le Yubilii, ore enkinyang'a e lakunoto enye neaku te risioroto oo larin. Ore apa enkata natii ninye tenebo ilo ora olopeny neikenari anaa enkata olaisiaayiani lolmushaara.

English: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
Masaai: Naa teneton etii ilarin kumok, ore te risioroto enye nerriny alak ninche teina kinyang'a apa natalaaki te nkaraki ninye, enkinyang'a e lakunoto enye.

English: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
Masaai: Naa teneng'or ilkuti arin pee ebau olari le Yubilii, neikenakino ninche, ore te risioroto oo larin le nkisiayiare oong'or te ninye nelak ninye mpisai te nkaraki elakunoto enye.

English: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
Masaai: Ore anaa osinka lo lmushaara to lari ake o to lari neijia ninye etiu tenebo ilo; nemeitore ninye ninye te nkisikong'ata te dukuya iyie.

English: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
Masaai: Naa teneitu elakuni ninye te kuna oitoi; nepuoi naa aalaaya ninye to lari le Yubilii, ninye o nkera enyena naatii tenebo ninye.

English: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Amu ore te nanu iltung'ana le Israel naa isinkan, isinkan laainei ninche layaua nanu aitupuku te nkop e Misiri: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Emintobirakiki intae ate nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nimishetishete nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuno aashu e ng'ape, nimintasheyieyie intae osoit le nkitanyaanyukoto tiatua enkop inyi, pee irrugokinono ninche; amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
Masaai: Embung'a intae isabatoni aainei niyanyititi emanyisho ai sinyati. Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
Masaai: “Tinipuopuo intae too nkiguanat aainei nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei, niaasiasa ninche,

English: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
Masaai: naisho nanu intae enchan inyi too rishat enye, netum enkop atoisho ore ilkeek le nkurma neiu ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
Masaai: Ore esototo oo nkurman inyi nebik ometabau enkata nasotuni isabibu, nebik isabibu ometabau enkata e unore. Ninosinoso intae emukate inyi aaraposho nibikibiki tiatua enkop inyi te seriani.

English: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
Masaai: Naa kaishoru nanu eseriani tiatua ena kop; naa irurara intae nemeetae oltung'ani oiture intae; naiwuang'ie nanu ing'uesi torrok tena kop, nemeitoki olalem atii enkop inyi.

English: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
Masaai: Naa imirimiri intae ilmang'ati linyi, naa kebatata ninche te dukuya intae to lalem.

English: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
Masaai: Imiet linyi oopuo aamir iip, ore iip linyi nepuo aamir nkalifuni tomon; ore ilmang'ati linyi naa kepuo aabatata te dukuya intae to lalem.

English: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
Masaai: Naa kaing'or nanu intae naisho intae entoisho napon intae, naitadedeyie nanu osotua lai o intae.

English: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
Masaai: Naa inosinoso intae endaa musana apa nitushuma, nintokiki aaiwuang'ie ina musana pee itumutumu enipikipiki eng'ejuk.

English: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
Masaai: Naa kaitobir nanu emanyisho ai tiatua intae, nemeibelekenya oltau lai aibayu intae.

English: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
Masaai: Naa kalo nanu tiatua intae naaku Enkai inyi, niakuku intae iltung'ana laainei.

English: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ilo apa oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, pee mintokiki aaku irrindiki lenye, natigila nanu isekenke e rrindikisho enye, naisho intae enchom ntorioriri.

English: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
Masaai: “Kake tenimikining'ining'i intae nanu, nimiasiasa kuna kitanapat pooki.

English: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
Masaai: Tenianyianya intae nkiguanat aainei, naa teneibeyu oltau linyi nkikoot aainei, metaa miasiasa intae nkitanapat aainei, pooki, kake igiligili intae osotua lai,

English: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
Masaai: naitaas nanu intae ena: Nayau nanu shumata intae entaboi naluam intae, enkeeya nemeishiuni, o lkirobi, oitarruo nkonyek neitemen enkishui inyi. Naa keaku tempesho iunuunu ilanterera linyi, amu keinos ninche ilmang'ati linyi,

English: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
Masaai: kaipirakinore nanu intae aarare, naa keari intae te dukuya ilmang'ati linyi, ore lekua ooiba intae naa kepuo aaitore intae, naa ilanyishosho intae meetae oltung'ani omirta intae.

English: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
Masaai: Naa ore etii kuna pooki nimikining'ining'i intae naitame intae aitulus katitin naapishana te nkaraki ing'ok inyi, nagil nanu olwuasa le ngolon inyi,

English: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
Masaai: naa kagil nanu olwuasa le ngolon inyi, naitaa nanu oloing'ang'e linyi metotiwuo anaa esekenkei naitotiu enkop inyi anaa osuyai.

English: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
Masaai: Neaku pesho enkisiaayiare e ngolon inyi, amu meitoki enkop inyi aiu entoki naponari, ore ilkeek leina kop nemeitoki aaiu ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
Masaai: “Naa tenikipaasharere intae nanu, nimikining'ining'i nanu, nayau nanu shumata intae ilmeita kumok, aitulus katitin naapishana anaa enkumoi oo ng'ok inyi.

English: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
Masaai: Naisho nanu ing'uesi e ntim meetu atua intae, naa ninche naapuonu aapur intae aaya nkera inyi, neinyal nchoo inyi, neitaa intae kuti, pee eitoliyioi nkoitoi inyi.

English: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
Masaai: “Naa tenimikishukokinono intae nanu tena kitamioto, kake aikipuopuo aapaashare nanu,

English: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
Masaai: napaashare sii nanu intae, naosh nanu makewan intae aitulus katitin naapishana te nkaraki ing'ok inyi.

English: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
Masaai: Naa kayau nanu olalem shumata intae, pee atum aitalaku elap te nkaraki ilo sotua, naa teninturrurrorro intae tiatua inkanas inyi, naa kairriu nanu olmeitai atua intae naa keyai intae aapik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati linyi.

English: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
Masaai: Ore ina kata tenagil nanu ewueji inyi nepejunyeki imukateni, neaku tomon nkituaak naapeju imukateni inyi te wueji nebo, naa keyau ninche imukateni inyi te ntemata e nkiroishi, ninosinoso intae, nimiraposhosho.

English: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
Masaai: “Naa tenimikining'ining'i nanu etii kuna pooki, kake ipuopuo torrekie laapaashare nanu,

English: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
Masaai: nalo sii nanu apaashare ntae te ngoro napi, naitame nanu intae makewan katitin naapishana te nkaraki ing'ok inyi.

English: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
Masaai: Inosinoso intae inkiri oo layiok linyi, ninosinoso inkiri oo ntoyie inyi.

English: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
Masaai: Naa kaidaikie nanu iwuejitin inyi e shumata nasulaki e nkop ilperereni linyi loo lasarri le nkorropil, nanang'aki mpopoki inyi nchumat enena kitanyaanyukot inyi nemeishu; neibelekenya oltau lai aibayu intae.

English: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
Masaai: Naitaa nanu nkanas inyi ilmuateni naitomijoon nkajijik inyi sinyat, nemaitoki nanu aing'uaya isonkoyoni inyi naarropil.

English: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
Masaai: Naitoliyio nanu ina kop, pee etum lelo mang'ati linyi ootii atua aaing'asiakinoto.

English: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
Masaai: Naa kaidapashaki nanu intae iloshon, nashutu nanu olalem te siadi intae neaku enkop inyi ololiyiote, neaku nkanas inyi ilmuateni.

English: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
Masaai: “Neshipakino taa ina kop isabatoni enyena ina kata aa mijooni, ina kata iyie itii enkop oo lmang'ati linono; netum taa enkop ayeng'iyeng'ayu neshipakino isabatoni enyena.

English: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
Masaai: Ore teina rishata pooki nairrag ninye aa mijooni neyeng'iyeng'a ina kop, tenkiyeng'iyeng'ata apa nemeeta isabatoni inyi emanya intae ina kop.

English: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
Masaai: Ore lelo linyi ooleku napik enkuretisho atua iltauja lenye teina kop oo lmang'ati lenye; ore embeneyio nakutita osiuo neisikie ninche, naa keisik aailanyisho anaa ilooilany olalem, naa kepuo ninche memirta toki.

English: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
Masaai: Naa kerrorro ninche aarrorrokino ake oltung'ani olikae, anaa oltung'ani oilany olalem, hoo nememirta ninche toki, nemintoki aata engolon nintasheyie te dukuya ilmang'ati linono.

English: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie aidaaya tenebo iloreren ore ina kop oo lmang'ati linono nikinos iyie.

English: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
Masaai: Ore lelo linyi tiatua enkop oo lmang'ati linyi nengoroo enkishui enye te nkaraki ing'ok enye ore sii te nkaraki ing'ok oo loo menye nengoroo e nkishui enye anaa ninche.

English: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
Masaai: “Kake teneirridu ninche ntorrok enye o ntorrok oo loo menye teina suujisho naaitaasa ninche nanu, o teina sii naashomo ninche aapaashare nanu

English: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
Masaai: omashomo nanu apaashare ninche nayau nanu ninche atua enkop oo lmang'ati lenye; teneitobor naa lelo tauja lenye lememurata neibelekenya teina torroni enye;

English: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
Masaai: natum naa atadamu osotua lai o Yakobo nadamu nanu osotua lai o Isaak o sotua lai o Abraham, nadamu nanu ina kop.

English: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
Masaai: Kake keing'ua ninche ina kop neshipakino ninye isabatoni enyena ina kata eirrag aa mijooni metii ninche; naa keibelekenya ninche teina torroni, enkaraki apa natemenaitie nkitanapat aainei, neibayu iltauja lenye nkiguanat aainei.

English: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia te nena pooki, ina kata etii ninche atua enkop oo lmang'ati lenye nemamenaa nanu ninche, nemaibayu nanu ninche ometaa kaidaikie nanu ninche katukul nagil osotua o ninche, amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye;

English: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
Masaai: kake ore te nkaraki ninche kadamu osotua o loo nkakuyiaa lenye apa layaua nanu ninche aitupuku te nkop e Misiri too nkonyek oo loshon, pee atum nanu ataa Enkai enye; Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkiguanat o nkikoot o nkitanapat naaitobira Olaitoriani te rishata enye o ltung'ana le Israel te nchumata oldoinyo le Sinai aimunye Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, tenenya oltung'ani olmumai o ltung'ani te nkaraki Olaitoriani te ntemata ino,

English: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
Masaai: ore naa entemata e nkinyiang'a ino olee ebaiki ilarin tikitam omeitabaiki ilarin ntomoni ile naa keaku shekeli onom e nkosholai, te risioroto eina shekeli e wueji sinyati.

English: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
Masaai: Naa tenaa eng'oruoi ilo tung'ani neaku entemata ino shekeli tomoni uni.

English: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ilarin imiet oltung'ani neilep o metabaiki ilarin tikitam, ore entemata ino to lee naa shekeli tikitam, ore te ng'oruoi naa shekeli tomon.

English: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
Masaai: Naa tenaa olapa obo embotoro oltung'ani neilep o metabaiki ilarin imiet ore entemata ino to lee naa keaku shekeli imiet e nkosholai, ore te ng'oruoi naa keaku shekeli uni e nkosholai.

English: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
Masaai: Naa tenaa ilarin ntomoni ile oltung'ani neilep neaku ore entemata e nkinyiang'a ino tialo olee naa keaku shekeli tomon o imiet, ore te ng'oruoi naa keaku shekeli tomon.

English: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
Masaai: Naa tenaa aisinani oltung'ani oleng meidim atalaa enkiririkinoto ino neyau ninye ilo tung'ani dukuya olapolosani netem olapolosani ninye; te risioroto eilo tung'ani apa oinosie olmumai.

English: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
Masaai: “Naa tenaa eng'ues naaku entoki napolosi, napolosakini Olaitoriani, ore pooki toki naikununo neijia napolosaki ake ninye oltung'ani Olaitoriani naa kesinya.

English: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
Masaai: Mewalie ninye ae toki aashu eibelekenyie ninye, esidai te ntorrono, aashu entorrono te sidai; naa teneitobir ninye ae kibelekenyata e ng'ues o eng'ues, neaku naa ore pokira ina o idia naibelekenyaki neaku sinyati.

English: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
Masaai: Naa tenaa eng'ues nemesinya anaa enemeishoori anaa olasar to Laitoriani neyau naa ilo tung'ani ina ng'ues dukuya olapolosani,

English: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
Masaai: nepik olapolosani ina ng'ues entemata e nkinyiang'a tenaa eisidai aashu tenaa torrono; anaa enitem iyie olapolosani ninye, neaku neijia etiu enkinyiang'a.

English: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
Masaai: Kake teneyieu ninye nekordu ninye neponaa e rubata e imiet e tomon entemata e nkinyiang'a.

English: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
Masaai: “Teneitayu oltung'ani enkaji enye metaa sinyati to Laitoriani, nelo olapolosani atem tenaa aisidai aashu torrono; ore anaa enatem olapolosani naa neijia etiu enkinyiang'a.

English: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
Masaai: Naa teneyieu ilo oishoo Olaitoriani ina aji nekordu enkaji enye, nelo ninye aponaa erubata e imiet e tomon entemata e nkinyiang'a too mpisai neaku taa enkaji enenye.

English: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
Masaai: “Naa teneiteng'elaki oltung'ani Olaitoriani ometua e nkurma enye naa enenye te njung'ore ore entemata ino e nkinyiang'a naa te risioroto e unoto enye. Ore omeri nabo (mpilbil ile kutiti) e shairi neaku shekeli onom oo ropiyiani, enkosholai.

English: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
Masaai: Naa teneiteng'el ninye aitisinyaki Olaitoriani enkurma enye ebaiki olari le Yubilii, neaku anaa ina temata ino e nkinyiang'a nalulung'a.

English: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
Masaai: Kake teneiteng'elaki ninye Olaitoriani enkurma enye te siadi Yubilii neikenaki taa olapolosani esiana oo mpisai te risioroto oo larin oong'or ometabau olari le Yubilii, neiwuang'ieki taa erubata teina kikenata ino.

English: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
Masaai: Naa teneyieu ilo oiteng'ela enkurma nekordu, neponaa naa erubata e imiet e tomon oo mpisai, neaku taa enenye.

English: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
Masaai: Kake tenemeyieu ninye nekordu ina kurma, aashu tenetimiraka ninye ina kurma likae tung'ani nemeitokini aaigil aakordu;

English: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
Masaai: kake ore ina kurma tenelakuni to lari le Yubilii, neaku sinyati to Laitoriani, ore anaa enkurma naishoruno, keaku olapolosani ninye olopeny.

English: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
Masaai: Teneiteng'elaki ninye Olaitoriani enkurma nainyiang'ua ina apa neme enenye natujung'o,

English: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
Masaai: netum naa olapolosani aikena entemata enye e nkinyiang'a ometabaiki olari le Yubilii, nelo taa ilo tung'ani aishooyo esiana e nkinyiang'a te ina olong anaa entoki sinyati to laitoriani.

English: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
Masaai: Ore to lari le Yubilii nerrinyokino ina kurma ilo apa oinyang'unyeki, aa enenye apa ina kop natujung'o.

English: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
Masaai: Ore pooki temata e nkinyiang'a naa te risioroto e shekeli e wueji sinyati, ore ngerrai tikitam naa shekeli nabo.

English: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD'S firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD'S.
Masaai: “Kake ore olkikaunot loo ng'uesi naa ilo Laitoriani, meetae oltung'ani oidim aiteng'ela; aa olkiteng aashu enker, ino Laitoriani.

English: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
Masaai: Naa tenaa eng'ues nemesinya, neinyiang'u naa ninye te ntemata ino e nkinyiang'a, neponiki erubata e imiet, naa teneitu ekorduni nemiri te ntemata ino e nkinyiang'a.

English: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Kake meetae entoki naiteng'elaki, ina naiteng'elaki oltung'ani Olaitoriani, e pooki toki ake ninye naata, aa oltung'ani aashu eng'ues, aashu enkurma enye natujung'o, naidimi aatimir aashu aatokordu; ore pooki toki naiteng'elakaki naa eisinyati oleng to Laitoriani.

English: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Meetae hoo ng'ae oiteng'elaki, oidimi aaidaikie tukul tiatua iltung'ana oidimi aatokordu keari ake metua.

English: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore pooki matua e tomon e nkop, aa lanterera le nkop aashu ilng'anayio loo lkeek naa ilo Laitoriani; kesinya ninche to Laitoriani.

English: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
Masaai: Teneyieu oltung'ani nekordu ae nabo e matua enye e tomon oo nkishorot enyena nelo naa ninye aponaa ematua e imiet e tomon.

English: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ematua pooki e tomon oo nkishu aashu inoo nkerrai, ore eng'ues pooki e tomon e nena pooki naaim abori eng'udi olchekut, naa keaku sinyati to Laitoriani.

English: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
Masaai: Meikilikuanu oltung'ani tenaa eisidai aashu torrono, aashu ewalu ninye; tenelo newalu ninye, neaku ore pokira ina natawalunyeki o ina natawaluaki neaku sinyati, nemekorduni ninye.”

English: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkitanapat naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel to ldoinyo le Sinai.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
Masaai: Eirorie apa Olaitoriani Musa tiong'ata e Sinai, ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa li are, to lari li are ina kata eidipa aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri

English: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
Masaai: nejoki, “Nkena esiana e umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, anaa ilmareita, o anaa nkajijik oo loo menye, nkajijik te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, pooki lee, pooki lukunya o lee,

English: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki ti atua Israel ooidim aashom enjore enkena intae o Aron ninche, anaa ilturrurri.

English: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
Masaai: Neaku te nebo intae oltung'ani ake te pooki osho ore ake ilo tung'ani naa ninye endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye.

English: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn e lelo tung'ana oopuonu aaku te nebo intae. Neing'uaa olosho le Ruben Elisur olayioni le Shedeur;

English: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Simion Shelumiel olayioni le Shurishadi;

English: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Yuda Nahashon olayioni le Aminadab;

English: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Isaakar Natanel olayioni le Saur;

English: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Sebulon Eliab olayioni le Helon;

English: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Masaai: ore too layiok le Yosef o te Efraim, naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud;

English: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Manase Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur;

English: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Benchamen Abidan olayioni le Gideon; neing'uaa olosho le Dan Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai;

English: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Asheri, Pagiel olayioni le Oharan;

English: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Gad Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel;

English: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
Masaai: neing'uaa olosho le Naftali Ahira olayioni le Enan.”

English: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo ootegeluaki to lturrur, lelo arikok loo loshon lenye, aa ninche ilukuny oo loshon le Israel.

English: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
Masaai: Nerik Musa o Aron kulo tung'ana ootegeluaki;

English: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
Masaai: ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa li are, neiturrur ninche eumata pooki te nebo, neiger ninche ate anaa ilmareita, anaa nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, ilukuny pooki

English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
