Masaai: anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa. Neaku eikena apa ninye ninche ti ong'ata e Sinai.

English: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Ruben ilo kikau le Israel, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, o lukuny pooki, o pooki lee ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o losho le Ruben naa nkalifuni artam o ile o iip imiet.

English: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Simeon, iishoritin enye, too lmareita, lenye too nkajijik oo loo menye, lelo apa lenye ooikenaki, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ilukuny pooki, pooki lee ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
Masaai: nera apa esiana o losho le Simeon nkalifuni onom o oudo o iip uni.

English: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Gad, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, lelo pooki ooidim aashom enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Gad nkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile o onom.

English: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Yuda, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Yuda nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana oo ong'uan o iip ile.

English: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Isaakar, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep; pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Isaakar nkalifuni onom oong'uan o iip ong'uan.

English: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Sebulon, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Sebulon nkalifuni onom o oopishana o iip ong'uan.

English: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Yosef aa taa iltung'ana le Efraim, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani ake ninye oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Efraim nkalifuni artam o iip imiet.

English: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Manase, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani ake ninye oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Manase nkalifuni tomoni uni o are o iip are.

English: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Benchamen, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Benchamen nkalifuni tomoni uni o imiet o iip ong'uan.

English: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Dan, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Dan nkalifuni ntomoni ile o are o iip naapishana.

English: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Asheri, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Asheri nkalifuni artam o obo o iip imiet.

English: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana le Naftali, iishoritin enye, too lmareita lenye, too nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki tung'ani oidim ashomo enjore:

English: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: nera esiana o losho le Naftali nkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.

English: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo laa ninche eikenaki, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te retoto oo lpayiani le Israel, iltung'ana tomon o are, ore ake oltung'ani netii te rishata e nkaji e papaai lenye.

English: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
Masaai: Neaku ore esiana pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, too nkajijik oo loo menye, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, pooki ng'ae ooidim ashomo enjore te Israel

English: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
Masaai: ore apa esiana enye pooki naa nkalifuni iip ile o okuni o iip imiet o onom.

English: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eikenari ile Lawi aaitusuj iloshon loo loomenye te nebo ninche.

English: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Amu etiaka Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
Masaai: “Olosho le Lawi ake ninye minken, nimisir ninche aiken te nebo iltung'ana le Israel;

English: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
Masaai: kake tegelu ile Lawi meitasheiki olng'obor le nchakenisho neitasheiki nena masaa enyena, neitasheiki nena tokitin pooki eine; nenap ninche ilo ng'obor o ntokitin enyena, neisiai ninye, neitaman ilo ng'obor emanyisho.

English: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkata naidurrieki ilo ng'obor, naa te nepuoi aaun, naa ile Lawi ooun. Naa tenenyiku likae tung'ani, neari ninye metua.

English: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
Masaai: Nchoo iltung'ana le Israel eun ilng'oborri lenye anaa ilturrurri, o ltung'ani ake to lng'obor lenye makewan, oltung'ani ake te rishata enye makewan;

English: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
Masaai: kake ore ile Lawi neitaman ilng'oborri lenye ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho, pee metumi ake embae naitagorisho ti alo eumata oo ltung'ana le Israel; naa ile Lawi ooitasheiki ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho.”

English: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
Masaai: Neijia apa eikuna iltung'ana le Israel; etaasa apa ninche te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
Masaai: “Nchoo iltung'ana le Israel emanyisho tembata e nanka enye, to lmonekie loo nkajijik oo loo menye, nchoo eun ilng'oborri aaipirie ilo ng'obor le ntumo te pooki shoto.

English: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanyisho te nkalo o loo saen - te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong naa keaku enanka o lng'obor le Yuda too lturrurri lenye, aa ore olarikoni lo lturrur le Yuda naa Nahashon olayioni le Aminadab;

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan o iip ile.

English: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooitoki aaun ilng'oborri aatashare ninye naa olosho le Isaakar, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Isaakar naa Natanel olayioni le Suar,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni onom o ong'uan o iip ong'uan.

English: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
Masaai: Nesuju olosho le Sebulon, naa Eliab olayioni le Helon olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Sebulon,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni onom o opishana o iip ong'uan.

English: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
Masaai: Ore esiana nalulung'a e lelo ng'oborri le Yuda, too lturrurri lenye naa nkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet o ile o iip ong'uan. Ninche oong'as aapuo.

English: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo e kopikop naa enanka oo lng'oborri le Ruben too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Ruben naa Elisur olayioni le Shedeur,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni artam o ile o iip imiet.

English: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooun ilng'oborri aasujaki ninche naa olosho le Simeon, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Simeon naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni onom o oudo o iip uni.

English: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
Masaai: Nesujaki olosho le Gad, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Gad naa Elisaf olayioni le Reuel,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile o onom.

English: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Ruben, too lturrurri lenye naa nkalifuni iip o onom o obo o iip ong'uan o onom. Ninche oaku ili are.

English: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
Masaai: “Neitokini aaitusuj olng'obor le ntumo, nepiki ilo ng'obor loo Lawi empolos oo lng'oborri; ore anaa enamanyisho ninche nchoo eiko neijia, aapik ake olng'obor erishata enye, enanka ake o enanka.

English: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo naa enanka oo lng'oborri le Efraim, too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Efraim naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni artam o iip imiet.

English: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Masaai: Ore olosujaki ninche naa olosho le Manase, ore olarikoni loo ltungana le Manase naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni tomoni uni o are o iip are.

English: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Masaai: Neitoki asuju olosho le Benchamen, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Benchamen naa Abidan olayioni le Gideon,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni tomoni uni o imiet o iip ong'uan.

English: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Efraim, too lturrurri lenye naa nkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet o iip nabo. Ninche oaku ili okuni.

English: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo e moikuape naa enkereri oo lng'oborri le Dan too lturrurri lenye, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Dan naa Ahi-eser olayioni le Amishadai,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni ntomoni ile o are o iip naapishana.

English: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Masaai: Ore lelo oosujaki ninche too lng'oborri naa olosho le Asheri, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Asheri naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye naa nkalifuni artam o obo o iip imiet.

English: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
Masaai: Neitoki asuju olosho le Naftali, ore olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Naftali naa Ahira olayioni le Enan,

English: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana o lorora lenye anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.

English: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lng'oborri le Dan naa nkalifuni iip nabo o onom o opishana o iip ile. Ninche oobayie anaa too nankan.”

English: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
Masaai: Kulo ninche iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaikenaki too nkajijik oo loo menye; ore lelo pooki apa ootii ilng'oborri ooikenaki too lturrurri lenye naa nkalifuni iip ile o okuni o iip imiet o onom.

English: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eikeni ile Lawi te nebo iltung'ana le Israel, anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Neijia apa eikuna iltung'ana le Israel. Ore te risioroto e ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neiko ninche neijia aaun ilng'oborri too nkererin, oltung'ani ake to lmarei lenye te risiorotoe nkaji e papaai lenye.

English: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
Masaai: Kuna ninche iishoritin e Aron o Musa teina kata pee eirorie Olaitoriani Musa to ldoinyo le Sinai.

English: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Aron: Nadab olkikau, o Abihu, o Eleasar o Itamar;

English: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
Masaai: kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Aron, lelo apolosak ootubukokoki eilata aaput, laa ninche etegelua pee eisiaisho anaa lapolosak.

English: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
Masaai: Kake ore Nadab o Abihu netuata te dukuya Olaitoriani ina kata apa pee eishoru olasar le nkima nemesinya te dukuya Olaitoriani ti ong'ata e Sinai; nemeeta apa ninche nkera. Neaku Eliesa o Itamar apa ooisiaishote anaa lapolosak te nkata e nkishui e Aron papaai lenye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
Masaai: “Toriku olosho le Lawi ntinyiku, nipik ninche dukuya Aron ilo apolosani, pee etum ninche aaisiaayia ninye.

English: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eitabaya enkisiaayiare te ninye o to lturrur pooki te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, anaa enaisiaisho ninche ti atua olng'obor le Nkai;

English: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
Masaai: nchoo ninche eitaisheiki imasaa pooki e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nejing enkisiaayiare te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel anaa te neisiaaisho ninche to lng'obor.

English: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ninchooyo iyie ile Lawi aisho Aron o layiok lenyena; eishooki ninche ninye tukul ti atua iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Masaai: Nigelu iyie Aron o layiok lenyena, nejing ninche esiai enye e mpolosare; kake te nelotu likae tung'ani anyiku neari metua.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
Masaai: “Ng'ura, aitayu nanu ile Lawi aitung'uaa atua iltung'ana le Israel te rishata e pooki kikau too ltung'ana le Israel. Keaku ore ile Lawi naa ilaainei,

English: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
Masaai: amu ore ilkikaunot pooki naa ilaainei; ore apa ina olong natara nanu metuata ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri, aitisinyaka nanu kewan ilkikaunot pooki tiatua Israel aa olayioni le tung'ani o le eng'ues; keaku ninche ilaainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa ti ong'ata e Sinai,

English: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
Masaai: “Nkena ilayiok le Lawi, anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye o too lmareita; ore pooki lee lo lapa obo neilep nkenai.”

English: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
Masaai: Neaku eikena apa Musa ninche te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, anaa enaitanapaki.

English: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Naa kulo apa ilayiok le Lawi anaa too nkarn enye: Gershon o Kohat o Merari.

English: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
Masaai: Naa kuna ninche nkarn oo layiok le Gershon too lmareita lenye: Libni o Shimei.

English: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kohat anaa too lmareita lenye naa: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron o Usiel.

English: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari anaa too lmareita lenye naa; Mahili o Mushi. Kulo ninche ilmareita loo lawi anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
Masaai: Ore apa ile Gershon naa olmarei le Libni o lmarei le Shimei; kulo apa ilmareita loo le Gershon.

English: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye te risioroto e nkikena oo lewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip imiet.

English: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita loo le Gershon neun ilng'oborri ti oriong olng'obor le Nkai te nkalo o loo ntoluo,

English: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
Masaai: te nebo Eliasaaf, olayioni le Lael aa ninye endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye too le Gershon.

English: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: Ore apa enkitanapata oo layiok le Gershon te ilo ng'obor le ntumo, naa pee eing'or ilo ng'obor le Nkai, olng'obor kewan o enkimulumulata enye o enkikenet e kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo o neeikishoreki to lgoriet,

English: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
Masaai: o enkikenet o lgoriet, ilo omanita olng'obor le Nkai o lperere lo lasar, o nkeenta enyena, o enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna.

English: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
Masaai: Ore too le Kohat naa olmarei loo le Amram, olmarei loo le Ishart, o lmarei loo le Hebron, o lmarei loo le Usiel; kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Kohat.

English: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni isiet o iip ile, lelo ooisiaisho te wueji sinyati.

English: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita loo layiok le Kohat neun ilng'oborri lenye te nkalo e kopikop o lng'obor le Nkai,

English: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
Masaai: te nebo Elisafan olayioni le Usiel, aa ninye endukuya te nkaji oo loo menye too lmareita loo le Kohat.

English: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
Masaai: Ore enaitanapaki ninche naa pee eing'or osanduku, o emesa, o iketa oo iltaai o lpereren loo lasarri nena masaa e wueji sinyati naa ninche eisiaishore ilapolosak, o lkarasha lo lodung'oro o enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna baa.

English: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani neaku ninye olkitok loo larikok loo Lawi neitasheiki lelo aitasheikinok le wueji sinyati.

English: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
Masaai: Ore too ile Merari naa olmarei loo le Mahili o lmarei loo le Mushi: kulo ninche ilmareita le Merari.

English: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye te risioroto e nkikena oo lewa ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni ile o iip are.

English: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
Masaai: Ore endukuya e nkaji oo loo menye lo lmarei le Merari naa Suriel olayioni le Abihail; neun ninche ilng'oborri lenye te nkalo e moikuape o lng'obor le Nkai.

English: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
Masaai: Ore esiaai nategeluaki aaitanap ilayiok le Merari naa irubat oo sunta e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, inkeek, o ng'apeta, o nkitotoneta oo ng'apeta o ntokitin naaidikidikore; enkisiaayiare pooki naipirta kuna baa;

English: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
Masaai: te nebo sii nena ng'apeta o lgoriet naamanaa, o nkitotoneta enye, o ncheito enye o nkeenta.

English: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Masaai: Ore ilooun olng'obor lenye te dukuya olng'obor le Nkai te nkalo o loo saen, te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong naa Musa o Aron o layiok lenyena, eitaisheiki mbaa pooki e seremare teine wueji sinyati o pooki naasi, te nkarakii ltung'ana le Israel; naa ore ake oltung'ani onyiku neari metua.

English: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki apa ooikenaki too le Lawi, laa ninche apa eikena Musa o Aron te nkitanapata o Laitoriani, anaa too lmareita, ore ilewa pooki ebaiki olapa obo neilep naa nkalifuni tikitam o are.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa, “Nkena lewa kikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel, ebaiki olapa obo neilep, niya esiana enye anaa too nkarn.

English: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nincho ile Lawi metaa ilaainei - Ara nanu Olaitoriani, te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel, nkishu oo le Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki loo nkishu oo ltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eikena apa Musa ilkikaunot pooki ti atua iltung'ana le Israel, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
Masaai: Neiken ilkikaunot pooki lewa, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn, ore ebaiki olapa obo neilep anaa enaikenaki naa nkalifuni tikitam oare o iip are o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Iwa ile Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki ti atua iltung'ana le Israel, o nkishu oo le Lawi te rishata oo nkishu enye; neaku Ilawi ilaainei: Ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
Masaai: Ore te nkordunoto e lelo kikaunot iip are o ntomoni naapishana o kuni le lelo kikaunot loo ltung'ana le Israel, ootulusoitie aagiroo esiana oo le Lawi,

English: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
Masaai: ntayu shekeli imiet ake te pooki tungani, neitorisiokini shekeli e wueji sinyati; ina shekeli gera tikitam

English: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
Masaai: nincho nena pisai e lelo ootuluso esiana enye, oolootalakuaki, nincho Aron o layiok lenyena.”

English: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa Musa nena pisai oo ltung'ana ootuluso, ootalakutua ile Lawi ootalakuaki.

English: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
Masaai: Ore too lkikaunot loo ltung'ana le Israel neya iropiyiani, shekeli enkalifu nabo o iip uni o ntomoni ile o imiet, naaitorisiokoki shekeli e wueji sinyati;

English: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: neisho Musa nena pisai e lakunoto Aron o layiok lenyena te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
Masaai: “Nkena esiana oo layiok le Kohat, tirishu ti atua ilayiok le Lawi, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, lelo pooki ooidim aatijing enkisiaayiare, pee easisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
Masaai: Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo layiok le Kohat ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo: nena tokitin naasinya oleng.

English: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
Masaai: Te nedotuni ilng'oborri, nejing Aron o layiok lenyena atua olng'obor aaitayu olkarasha lo lodung'oro, neimulumul ilo sanduku le nchakenisho te ninye;

English: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
Masaai: neitoki aapik shumata ninye enkimulumulet endapana e nkine, neisalaashaki shumata ina kila pus alak, neitokini aapik nkeek enyena.

English: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
Masaai: Ore enchumata e ina mesa o e mukate e nkitoduaroto neisalaashaki ninche enkila pus, neiteleiki shumata ninye, isaanini, o masaa e nkorropil, o ngirran, onoosi te nkaraki ilo asar ooki; ore sii nena mukateni e anaake netii shumata ina mesa;

English: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
Masaai: neitoki aaisalaashaki shumata ninche enkarasha sintet, neitoki aaimulumulaki shumata endapana e nkine, nepik nkeek enyena.

English: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaya enkarasha pus, neimulumul ina kitashet o ltaa te nkaraki ewang'an, te nebo iltaai lenyena, o lkinoketa o ngirran enye, o masaa pooki e ilata naapikieki:

English: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
Masaai: nepik ninche te nebo imasaa enyena pooki neimulumuli te ndapana e nkine nepiki ninye shumata nkeek enyena naanapieki.

English: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
Masaai: Ore shumata ilo perere lo lasar oitobiruno te sahabu neisalaashaki enkarasha pus, neimulumul shumata ninye te ndapana e nkine, neitokini aapik nkeek enyena;

English: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
Masaai: neitoki ninche aaya nena masaa pooki e nkisiayiare naasishoreki ti atua ine wueji sinyati; nepik ninche atua enkila pus, neitoki aaimulumul ninche te ndapana e nkine, neiteleiki ninche nkeek enyena naanapieki.

English: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaitayu nkuruon to lperere lo lasar, neisalaashaki ninche enkarasha sintet;

English: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
Masaai: neiteleiki shumata ninye nena masaa pooki o lperere lo lasar, naa ninche easishoreki te nkisiayiare te ine, o motioo e nkima o njipeta, o lkurteta, o ngirran, nena masaa pooki o lperere lo lasar; neisalaashaki shumata ninche nena endapana e nkine, neisuroki nkeek enyena.

English: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eidip Aron o layiok lenyena aaimulumula ine wueji sinyati o nena masaa pooki e wueji sinyati, ina kata edumuni ilng'oborri, neitoki ilayiok le Kohat aapuonu aanap kuna, kake meibung ninche nena tokitin sinyat, pee meye ake. Kuna ninche intokitin e ilo ng'obor le ntumo naa ninche enap ilayiok le Kohat.

English: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
Masaai: “Ore Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani neitasheiki eilata oo ltaai, o enkorropil, ilo asar le ntapa li anaake, o ina ilata naputishoreki o enkitasheikinoto pooki eilo ng'obor le Nkai o nena pooki naatii atua, o ine wueji sinyati o masaa enyena.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
Masaai: “Mincho olosho loo lmareita le Kohat eimisieki aaiwuang'ie too le Lawi;

English: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
Masaai: kake entaasa ninche ena pee etum ninche aatopok nemeye te nepuonu aanyikaki nena tokitin naasinya aaisul: nchoo elo Aron o layiok lenyena atua olng'obor negelaki ake oltung'ani esiai enye o lola lenye,

English: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
Masaai: kake mejing ninche atua aapuo aaing'or nena tokitin naasinya hoo te nkata ninye nabo, pee meye ake.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
Masaai: “Nkena sii esiana oo layiok le Gershon, too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye;

English: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ebaiki larin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, nkena ninche, lelo pooki ooidim aatijing enkisiaayiare, pee easisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
Masaai: Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo le Gershon, te nkisiayare o te napata oo lolan:

English: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: kenap ninche ilkarash lo lng'obor le Nkai, o lng'obor le ntumo te nebo enkimulumulet enye, o enkimulumulet e ndapana e nkine natii shumata ninye, o enkikenet e kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
Masaai: o nkisiong'at o lgoriet, o enkikenet e ine nejing'ieki olgos lo lgoriet omanita ine wueji sinyati o lperere lo lasar, o nkeenta enyena, o masaa pooki e nkisiayiare; naa keas ninche nena pooki naaishiakinore ninche neas.

English: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
Masaai: Ore esiaai pooki oo layiok loo le Gershon naa Aron o layiok lenyena ooitasheiki te ina pooki napuo ninche aanap.

English: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oo lmareita loo layiok le Gershon ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ore esiaai enye naa keaku abori enkitasheikinoto e Itamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.

English: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
Masaai: “Ore ti alo ilayiok le Merari nkena ninche anaa too lmareita lenye, o too nkajijik oo loo menye;

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni neilep o metabaiki ilarin onom. Nkena ninche pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
Masaai: Naa ena apa eitanapaki ninche metaasa, anaa esiaai enye pooki ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo; nena rubat oo sunta o lng'obor le Nkai, te nebo nkeek enyena, ing'apeta o nkitotoneta.

English: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
Masaai: o ng'apeta e ilo goriet omanita te nebo nkitotoneta, o ncheito, o nkeenta te nebo imasaa enyena pooki o ntelon enyena pooki. Nioriki aipotoki nena masaa naaishiakino ninche nenap.

English: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkisiaayiare oolmareita loo layiok le Merari, ninye enkisiaayiare enye nalulung'a ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo ti abori enkitasheikinoto e Itamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.”

English: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
Masaai: Neitoki Musa o Aron o larikok lo lturrur aaiken ilayiok le Kohat, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidima enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiaai ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye anaa too lmareita lenye naa nkalifuni are o iip naapishana o onom.

English: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Ena apa ninye esiana oo lmareita loo le Kohat, lelo pooki ooisiaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
Masaai: Ore esiana oo layiok le Gershon, anaa too lmareita lenye, o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare aisiaaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye naa nkalifuni are o iip ile o tomoni uni.

English: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
Masaai: Ena ninye esiana oo lmareita loo layiok le Gershon, lelo pooki apa ooisiaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani.

English: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lmareita loo layiok le Merari, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni o metabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare, pee eas esiai ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo

English: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: ore esiana enye anaa too lmareita naa nkalifuni uni o iip are.

English: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo apa ooikenaki too lmareita loo layiok le Merari, ooikena Musa o Aron te risioroto e nkitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooikenaki too le Lawi, laa ninche eikena Musa o Aron o Larikok le Israel, anaa too lmareita lenye o too nkajijik oo loo menye,

English: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,
Masaai: ebaiki ilarin tomoni uni neilep ometabaiki ilarin onom, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oidim atijing'a enkisiaayiare neasisho anap ilolan ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
Masaai: ore lelo lenye ooikenaki naa nkalifuni isiet o iip imiet o ntomoni isiet.

English: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa negeluni ninche, oltung'ani ake te siaai enye e nkisiayiare aashu te napare; kaae neiken ninye ninche aiko neijia, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel pee eipang'unye ti atua ilng'oborri pooki ng'ae ake ninye oata enkeeya oolbolot, o pooki ng'ae oata olbae loo nkimek, o pooki ng'ae lemesinya oiseyie oltung'ani otua;

English: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
Masaai: impang'ie pokira, olee o eng'oruoi. Tipika ninche auluo ilng'oborri, pee meisarkionie ilng'oborri lenye, laa empolos enye ninye emanyisho ai.”

English: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neas ina iltung'ana le Israel, neipang'ie ninche too lng'oborri meshomo auluo; ore anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani Musa, ina etaasa iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel Te neas olee aashu enkitok pooki engoki ake ninye naas iltung'ana aagil enkirukoto to Laitoriani, neaku ilo tung'ani olarruoni

English: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
Masaai: nelimu ninye aibalunye ina ngoki nataasa, neitobir ninye elaata nalulung'a te ina kitarruoroto enye, aponaa erubata e imiet te ina, neisho ilo laa ninye einyala.

English: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
Masaai: Kake te nemeeta oltung'ani iltung'ana lenye ooidimi aatalaaki teina kitarruoroto, ore ina laakinoto neaku eno Laitoriani te nkaraki olapolosani neponikini ilo ker lo lningo lo sotua laa ninye eitobirakinyeki ninye olning'o lo sotua.

English: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
Masaai: Ore nkishorot pooki, o ntokitin pooki naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel, nena naayaki ninche ilo apolosani neaku inenyena;

English: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
Masaai: o ntokitin naasinya e pooki tung'ani ake ninye neaku inolapolosani; ore pooki toki naba anaa enaisho oltung'ani olapolosani neaku eneye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel te nelo nepong'ori enkitok e likae moruo ake ninye, neas emarmalisho ti alo ninye,

English: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
Masaai: te nelo neboitare olee ninye, neisudori ina bae too nkonyek o lmoruo lenye, neaku mejurrunoyu hoo neinosie kewan olduruk, nemeetae olchakeni oishakenoki ninye, amu eitu eibung'akini ina bae;

English: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
Masaai: naa te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata ninye, netum olom ti alo ina kitok enye natipika kewan olduruk; aashu te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata ninye, netum ninye olom ti alo ina kitok enye hoo neitu ninye enosie kewan olduruk.

English: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
Masaai: Nchoo naa eriku ilo lee ina kitok enye enetii olapolosani, neyau enkishoroto naipirta ina kitok, erubata e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui; nemebukoki ninye eilata shumata ina tapa nemepik enkorropil, amu olasar le ntapa lo lom ilo. Olasar le ntapa le ndamunoto, odamunyeki entorroni.

English: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
Masaai: “Neyau olapolosani ina kitok aitinyiku, nepik ninye dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
Masaai: neitoki olapolosani ayau enkare nasinya te moti oo nkulupuok, neya enkiti terit to ltiren le ina aji e Nkai nepik atua ina are.

English: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
Masaai: Nepik ilo apolosani ina kitok dukuya Olaitoriani, nelak ilpapit le ndukuya enye, nepik nkaik enyena ina tapa o lasar le ndamunoto, aa ninye o lasar le ntapa lo lom. Ore te nkaina enye neibung olapolosani ina are e nduaran naa ninye nayau oldeket.

English: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
Masaai: Neinosie taa olapolosani ina kitok olmumai, ejo, ‘Te nemeetae olee litaboitare, naa te neitu iyie imbelekenya aibelekenyakino olduruk, eton itii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lino, talakunoyu iyie tena are nadua nayau oldeket.

English: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
Masaai: Kake ti nitapong'ori iyie hoo nitii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lino, naa ti ninosie kewan olduruk neaku kitaboitare likae lee leme olmoruo lino,’

English: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
Masaai: (nchoo naa olapolosani einosie ina kitok olmumai lo ldeket, nejoki ina kitok), ‘Kintaa iyie o Laitoriani oldeket o lmumai ti atua iltung'ana linono, ti nikincho Olaitoriani meibibiari enkupes ino neiteijia osesen lino;

English: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
Masaai: metaa ore ena are nayau enduaran, nchoo elo atua enkoshoke ino, neiteijia osesen lino neibibiaa enkupes ino.’ Nejo ina kitok, ‘Esai, Esai.’

English: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
Masaai: “Neitoki olapolosani aiger kulo deketa ti atua embuku, nejut ninche te ina are e nduaran,

English: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
Masaai: neitook ninye ina kitok ina are e nduaran nayau oldeket ore ina are nayau oldeket nelo atua ninye nepik ninye emion kitok.

English: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aya ilo asar le ntapa otii enkaina e ina kitok, neyuk ilo asar le ntapa te dukuya Olaitoriani neitoki ayau enchumata o lperere lo lasar.

English: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
Masaai: Neitoki olapolosani aya emborei e nkaina e ilo asar le ntapa anaa erubata enye nadamuni, nepej ninye te nchumata o lperere lo lasar; ore te siadi neitoki aitook ina kitok enkare.

English: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aitooko ina kitok enkare, te nelo ninye neaku einosie kewan olduruk neas emarmalisho ti alo olmoruo lenye, ore ina are nayau oldeket nejing atua ninye nepik emion kitok, nejeyu osesen lenye neibibiari enkupes enye, neaku ina kitok oldeket ti atua iltung'ana lenyena.

English: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
Masaai: Kake te neitu einosie ina kitok kewan olduruk metaa meeta ninye entioto, nelakunoyu ninye naa keiu nkera.

English: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
Masaai: “Ena ninye enkitanapata too mbaa naatii olom, te nelo enkitok natii abori enkitoria o lmoruo lenye aimalimal neinosie kewan olduruk.

English: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
Masaai: Aashu te nelotu oltau lo lom shumata oltung'ani netum ninye olom ti alo enkitok enye; nepik ninye ina kitok dukuya Olaitoriani, nedungoki olapolosani enkiguana tena kitanapata pooki.

English: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
Masaai: Nchoo olee eton meeta entioto kake ore enkitok keitalaki entorroni enye.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD:
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nelo nenya oltung'ani olmumai, olee aashu enkitok, te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee eaku osinyati to Laitoriani, neiteng'elaki kewan o Laitoriani,

English: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
Masaai: nchoo eiteng'el kewan te naisho oo sabibu o te naisho napi, meok ninye ae toki naironyuaki too sabibu aashu enaisho napi; nemeinos isabibu ooshal aashu ilootoito.

English: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
Masaai: Ore te nena nkolong'i pooki e nkiteng'elata enye nemeinos ninye ae toki naitobiruaki too sabibu o metabaiki ninye ilanterera lenyena aashu nkabobok enyena.

English: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
Masaai: “Ore nkolong'i pooki e ilo mumai lenye le nkiteng'elata meiseyie olmurunya endukuya enye; o metaba anaa neishunye ina kata apa naiteng'elaka ninye kewan Olaitoriani. Keaku ninye sinyati; keisho ninye iyenat oo lpapit lenyena metoodorito.

English: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
Masaai: “Ore te nena olong'i pooki naaiteng'elaki ninye kewan Olaitoriani nemenyikaki olmeneng'ani.

English: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
Masaai: Aa olayioni le menye aashu olayioni le ng'otonye, aashu olo lalashe aashu enkanashe, te neye ninche. Kepik ninye kewan eleyiata; enkaraki natii enkiteng'elata naiteng'elaka kewan Olaitoriani shumata endukuya enye.

English: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i pooki naaiteng'elaka ninye kewan Olaitoriani naa kesinya ninye to Laitoriani.

English: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
Masaai: “Naa te neye oltung'ani nabo kata etashare ninye, nepik eleyiata ina dukuya enye naiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani, nelo ninye abarn endukuya enye te nkolong e nkitukuo; te nkolong e naapishana elo ninye abarn.

English: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet, neyau ninye nturkuluoni are aashu ntaritik are ayaki olapolosani te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
Masaai: nepolos olapolosani nabo te nkaraki olasar loo ngok, nepolos enkae te nkaraki olasar opejori, neitobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninye, enkaraki nataasa ninye engoki aiseyie ilo meneng'ani. Neitisiny ninye endukuya enye ina olong ake,

English: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
Masaai: neitengelaki kewan Olaitoriani too nkolong'i enyena e nkiteng'elata, neyau olkuo le ker sitima lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar le nkitarruoroto; kake ore enaduoo kata e dukuya neaku pesho, amu ore enkiteng'elata enye neidurukieki.

English: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: “Naa ena enkitanapata e ilo lo lmumai, te nelulung'ayu enkata enye e nkiteng'elata: neyauni ninye kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
Masaai: Neitarasaki ninye enkishoroto enye Olaitoriani, olkuo obo le ker sitima lemeeta entioto te nkaraki olasar opejori, o esupen nabo e ker o lari obo nemeeta entioto naaku olasar loo ngok, o lmeregesh obo lemeeta entioto oaku olasar le seriani,

English: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
Masaai: o enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, o mukateni e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, o mukateni naapejo naaelieki eilata, o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.

English: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
Masaai: Neitarasaa olapolosani ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitayu olasar lenye le ngoki o lasar lenye opejori.

English: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olmeregesh metaa olasar le seriani to Laitoriani, tenebo enkikapu oo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, neyau sii olapolosani olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki.

English: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore ilo lo lmumai nebarn ina dukuya enye naitisinyaki te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neya ninye lelo papit le ndukuya enye naitisinyaki nelo apik enkima ti abori ilo asar le seriani.

English: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
Masaai: Neitayu olapolosani orony le ilo meregesh eidipaki aaitokitokie, neitayu emukate nabo neitu eisuishieki ti atua enkikapu o emukate nabo napejo neitu eisuishieki nepik ninche aiteleiki nkaik e ilo lo lmumai. Ore ake pee eidip ninye atabarnoi ilpapit le nkitisinyata enye,

English: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
Masaai: neyuk olapolosani ninche metaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, neaku kuna daiki erubata nasinya to lapolosani te nebo oloikulu oyoki o ina muro naishoruaki; ore te siadi ina neidim ilo lo lmumai atooko enaisho oo sabibu.

English: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
Masaai: “Ena ninye enkitanapata eilo oinos olmumai. Ore olasar lenye oishori Olaitoriani neitorisiokini olmumai lenye anaa oloinos olmumai te nebo pooki toki ake ninye naba anaa enaata ninye te risioroto e ilo mumai oinos ninye, neiko ninye nejia te risioroto e nkitanapata e nkiteng'elata enye olmumai eitisinyaki kewan Olaitoriani.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaki Aron o layiok lenyena,

English: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
Masaai: Nji enkuna ti nimayianana iltung'ana le Israel entejo,

English: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
Masaai: Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani nikigolie:

English: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
Masaai: Mikintawang'aki Olaitoriani enkomom enye, niking'urrie:

English: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
Masaai: Mikinchoo Olaitoriani omom, nikincho seriani.

English: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
Masaai: “Naa nchoo ninche metipika enkarna ai shumata lelo tung'ana le Israel pee amayian nanu ninche.”

English: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong pee eidip Musa atuuno olng'obor le Nkai, nebukoki eilata neitisiny ninye te nebo imasaa enyena nebukoki eilata neitisiny olperere lo lasar, te nebo imasaa pooki,

English: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
Masaai: ore larikok le Israel, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye ilarikok loo loshon otii shumata lelo apa ooikenaki,

English: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
Masaai: neishoru neyau nkishorot enye dukuya Olaitoriani, ngarrin ile naaimulumula, o lmong'i tomon o are, ore ake engarri netii larikok oare ore ake olarikoni neeta olkiteng, nepolos ninche te dukuya ilo ng'obor le Nkai.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
Masaai: “Tang'amai kuna naaing'uaa ninche, pee etumi aataasishore ninche, pee etumi aataasishore ninche te nkisiayiare e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nincho ninche lelo le Lawi, oltung'ani ake te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye.”

English: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
Masaai: Neaku etang'amayie apa Musa nena garrin o lelo mong'i neisho ninye ile Lawi.

English: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
Masaai: Ore ngarrin are o lmong'i oong'uan neisho ilayiok le Gershon te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye.

English: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Ore ngarrin ong'uan o lmong'i isiet neisho ilayiok le Merari, te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye erikoo Itamar olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani.

English: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
Masaai: Kake ore too layiok le Kohat neitu eishori ninche toki, enkaraki naitanapaki apa ninche meing'ura nena tokitin naasinya naanapi too loilila.

English: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
Masaai: Ore larikok neishooyo lasarri te nkaraki enkitisinyata o lperere lo lasar te ina olong apa natubukokoki eilata aaitisiny, neishooyo lelo arikok ilasarri lenye te dukuya olperere lo lasar.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keishori ninche ilasarri lenye, olarikoni ake te nkolong enye, te nkaraki enkitisinyata o lperere lo lasar.”

English: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
Masaai: Ore apa ilo otang'asa aitayu olasar lenye te nkolon e dukuya naa Nashon olayioni le Aminadab, lo losho le Yuda;

English: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani e nkosholai naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni enkiroishi enye, o engirra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, ebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata aaitaa olasar le ntapa;

English: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil,

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, o lkuo obo le ker sitima le ker lo lari obo te nkaraki olasar opejori;

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: olkine obo oaku olasar loo ngok.

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Masaai: Naa ore to lasar loo nkishorot le seriani, naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o lkineji imiet o lkerra imiet lo lari obo. Ele apa olasar le Nashon olayioni le Aminadab.

English: On the second day Nethaneel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, did offer:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e are neitayu olasar Natanel olayioni le Suar, ilo arikoni le Isaakar;

English: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: neitayu ninye to lasar lenye e saani nabo e nkosholai naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip o tomoni uni, o engirra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai, nebore pokira entapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata pee eaku olasar le ntapa.

English: One spoon of gold of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: O enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli nabore enkorropil;

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, o lker obo lo lari obo oaku olasar opejori;

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: olkine obo oaku olasar loo ngok;

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Masaai: ore to lasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, o lkineji imiet, o sitiman le kerra imiet lo lari obo. Ele ninye olasar le Natanel olayioni le Suar.

English: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun, did offer:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni naa Eliabu olayioni le Helon, ilo arikoni loo ltung'ana le Sebulon:

English: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
Masaai: ore olasar lenye naa esaani nabo e nkosholai, naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni e nkosholai, naa ore enkiroishi enye naa shekeli iip nabo o tomoni uni, o eng'irra nabo e nkosholai e shekeli ntomoni naapishana, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai nebore pokira are entapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata metaa olasar le ntapa;

English: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
Masaai: o enkijiko nabo e sahabu e shekeli tomon nabore enkorropil;

English: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
Masaai: o loing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, ositima le ker lo lari obo, oaku olasar opejori,

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ngoki,

English: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliab the son of Helon.
Masaai: naa ore to lasar le seriani naa ilmong'i oare, o lmeregeshi imiet, isitiman imiet le kineji o sitiman imiet le kerra lo lari obo. Ele apa ninye olasar le Eliab olayioni le Helon.

English: On the fourth day Elizur the son of Shedeur, prince of the children of Reuben, did offer:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan naa Elisuri olayioni le Shedeur, olarikoni loo ltung'ana le Ruben.

English: His offering was one silver charger of the weight of an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:

English: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

English: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
Masaai: ore ake esaani e nkosholai nabo te ninche naa shekeli ntomoni naapishana, ore enkosholai pooki e kuna masaa naa shekeli nkalifuni are o iip ong'uan te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai,

English: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
Masaai: ore nena kijikoni tomon o are e sahabu naabore enkorropil, eeta ake nabo enkiroishi e shekeli tomon, te risioroto e shekeli e nkaji e Nkai ore sahabu pooki e nena kijikoni naa shekeli iip o tikitam.

English: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
Masaai: Ore nkishu pooki o lasar opejori naa iloingok tomon o are, o lmeregeshi tomon oare, o sitiman tomon o are le kerra lo lari obo te nebo olasar lenye le ntapa; o sitiman tomon o are le kineji lo lasar le ngoki.

English: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
Masaai: Ore nkishu pooki o lasar le seriani naa iloingok tikitam o ng'uan, o lmeregeshi ntomoni ile, o sitiman le kineji ntomoni ile, ore sitiman le kerra lo lari obo naa ntomoni ile. Ele apa ninye olasar le nkitisinyata lo lperere lo lasar eidipaki aatubukoki eilata aaitisinya.

English: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
Masaai: Ore apa pee elo Musa atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo airorie Olaitoriani, nening ninye oltoilo eirorie ninye eing'uaa shumata ilo orika lo lng'ur apa otii shumata osanduku le nchakenisho, eimu erishata e lelo kerubi pokira oare; neirorie ninye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki apa Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
Masaai: “Tiaki Aron, ti nindip atipika iltaai nkitasheta, ore lelo taai oopishana neitawang'isho te dukuya ina kitashet oo ltaai.”

English: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neiko neijia Aron; nepik ninye iltaai lenyena meitawang'a dukuya ina kitashet oo ltaai, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.
