English: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
Masaai: Naa ena apa enkitobirunoto e ilo iket lo ltaa, naa sahabu naidongoki ebaiki entonata enye o metabaiki ntapuka enyena esiaai e nkidong'ore, te risioroto e ilo rrekie otuutaka Olaitoriani Musa. Neaku eitobirua ninye ilo iket.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
Masaai: “Toriko ile Lawi intung'uai iltung'ana le Israel, nintuku ninche.

English: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
Masaai: Naa neijia nkuna ninche, ntukuo ninche, isuaaki ninche enkare enkitisinyata, nebarn ninche iseseni lenye, neituku nkilani enye, neitisiny ate.

English: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eya oloti oing'oni o lasar lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata, nintoki aya likae oti oing'oni oaku olasar le ngoki.

English: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
Masaai: Niyau iyie lelo le Lawi meetu dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ninturrur ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
Masaai: Ore ake pee iyau lelo le Lawi dukuya Olaitoriani, ore iltung'ana le Israel, neiteleiki nkaik enye lelo le Lawi.

English: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
Masaai: Neishooyo Aron ile Lawi te dukuya Olaitoriani pee eaku olasar oyuki oing'uaa iltung'ana le Israel pee eaku enenye enkisiaayiare o Laitoriani.

English: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo Lawi aaiteleiki nkaik enye ilukuny e lelo oing'ok; nipolos iyie obo pee eaku olasar le ngoki ore olikae neaku olasar opejori oishori Olaitoriani, pee eitobir osotua lo lning lo Laitoriani too le Lawi.

English: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie ile Lawi meetu abori Aron o layiok lenyena, pee eishooyo ninche anaa olasar oyuki to Laitoriani.

English: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
Masaai: “Neijia nkuna nteng'ela ile Lawi ntung'uai atua iltung'ana le Israel, neaku ile Lawi ilaainei.

English: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ine nepuo ile Lawi atua aaisiaisho ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te nindip iyie aitukuo ninche ninchooyo ninche anaa olasar oyuki.

English: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
Masaai: Amu aaishooki nanu ninche tukul iltung'ana le Israel; te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki le Israel, ore ilkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel aawa nanu makewan ninche.

English: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
Masaai: Amu ore ilkikaunot pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel naa laainei, o lo ltung'ani o le ng'ues; ore apa teina olong nataara nanu metuata ilkikaunot pooki te nkop e Misiri aitisinyaka nanu ninche kewan,

English: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
Masaai: naawa nanu ile Lawi te rishata oo lkikaunot pooki ti atua iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
Masaai: Naishooyie nanu ile Lawi anaa enkishoroto aisho Aron o layiok lenyena, aitung'uaa iltung'ana le Israel, pee eas enkisiaayiare te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, neitobir osotua lo lningo te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, pee mejing ake olmeitai atua iltung'ana le Israel te nelo nenyikaki iltung'ana le Israel enkaji e Nkai.”

English: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
Masaai: Ina apa eitaasa Musa o Aron o lturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel ile Lawi; ore te risioroto e ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa too naaipirta ile Lawi neitaas ninche iltung'ana le Israel ina.

English: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
Masaai: Neitisiny ile Lawi ate aalam ingok, neituku nkilani enye; neishooyo Aron ninche anaa olasar oyuki te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitobir Aron osotua lo lningo te nkaraki ninche eituku ninche.

English: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nepuo ile Lawi atua aas enkisiaayiare enye ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, aasisho ti abori Aron o layiok lenyena. Ore anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa too naaipirta ile Lawi ina ninye eitaasa ninche.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
Masaai: “Kuna baa naaishiakino too le Lawi: ore ebaiki ilarin tikitam o imiet neilep kepuo ninche aas enkisiaayiare ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo;

English: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
Masaai: naa ore ebaiki ilarin onom neing'uaa ninche enkisiaayiare nemeitoki aaisiaaisho,

English: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
Masaai: kake keisiaai ilalashera lenye tiatua olng'obor le ntumo, neibung iutarot, kake meisiaaisho ninche. Nji iyie ilo aaitaas ile Lawi arishaki isiaaitin enye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa tiong'ata e Sinai, to lapa le dukuya lo lari liare eidipa aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, ejo, tejo

English: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
Masaai: “Nchoo iltung'ana le Israel eibung Pasaka te rishata enye nategeluaki.

English: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan ele apa, teipa, nimbung'ubung'u te nkata enye nategeluaki te risioroto oo nkikoot pooki, o nkiguanat pooki ipuopuo intae aaibung.”

English: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
Masaai: Neaku etiaka Musa iltung'ana le Israel pee eibung pasaka.

English: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neibung ninche pasaka to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan o lapa, teipa, tiongota e Sinai; te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, neas iltung'ana le Israel ina.

English: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
Masaai: Netii apa ilkuti tung'ana lemesinya ooiseyie osesen lo ltung'ani otua, neaku meidim ninche aaibung'a sabato teina olong; nepuonu ninche dukuya Musa o Aron teina olong.

English: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana ninche, “Kira iyiook ilo oiduruk amu kiseyie osesen lo ltung'ani otua; kainyoo pee etekepayioki iyiook eitu kinchooyo olasar lo Laitoriani te nkata nategeluaki tiatua iltung'ana le Israel?”

English: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninche, “Entasho, pee atum atoning'o enaitanapisho Olaitoriani tialo intae.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
Masaai: Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel, “Teneiduruk ake ninye oltung'ani tiatua intae, anaa olayioni le ishoi inyi, eiseyie oltung'ani otua, ana elakua te lototo enye apa nashomo, naa keibung ake pasaka.

English: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
Masaai: Ore to lapa liare, te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan naa keibung; keinos ninche tenebo imukateni neitu eisuishieki, o mbenek naadua.

English: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
Masaai: Nemeleku ninche toki o mekenyu, nemegil oloito lenye; te risioroto oo nkikoot pooki e pasaka eibung ninche.

English: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo tung'ani oiduruk nemetii elototo, kake nekepari aany eibung pasaka, ore ilo tung'ani neiwuang'ieki too ltung'ana lenyena amu eitu eishoru olasar lo Laitoriani te rishata enye nageluno; nenap ilo tung'ani engoki enye.

English: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
Masaai: Naa tenelotu oltung'ani omoni amanyisho tiatua intae, neibung pasaka to Laitoriani, te risioroto oo nkikoot e pasaka, nea naa ninye ina. Enkikoo nabo intae ipupuo aata, to lomoni o to inoti.”

English: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
Masaai: Ore apa ina olong natuunoki olng'obor le Nkai, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor le Nkai, ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho; ore teipa netii ina atampoi shumata ilo ng'obor nelioo eikununo anaa enkima o mekenyu.

English: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
Masaai: Netiu neijia anaake, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor dama, o elioto e nkima te nkewarie.

English: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
Masaai: Naa ore ake te neiwuang'ieki ina atampoi te nchumata e ilo ng'obor, ore te siadi ina nedumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaidur; naa ore ake ewueji nedoiki ina atampoi neun iltung'ana loo Siraeli ilng'oborri teine.

English: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
Masaai: Naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani edumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaidur, naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani sii eun ninche ilng'oborri; ore te nkata naba anaa enabik enkatampoi te nchumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, nebik ninche too lng'oborri.

English: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
Masaai: Ore duoo ninye tenaa nkolong'i kumok ebik enkatampoi te nchumata e ilo ng'obor le Nkai, neibung iltung'ana loo Siraeli enkitanapata o Laitoriani, nemedumunye ninche aaidur.

English: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
Masaai: Ore apa kulie katitin na nkuti olong'i ake etii ina atampoi shumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, naa ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani nebik ninche too lng'oborri ore ake te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani nedumunye ninche aaidur.

English: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
Masaai: Ore ake sii apa kulie katitin etotona enkatampoi ebaiki teipa o mekenyu; naa ore ake pee edumuni aailepie enkatampoi tadekenya, nedumunye ninche aaidur aashu te netobiko enkolong nabo o enkewarie, ore ake pee eiwuang'ieki ina atampoi nedumunye ninche aaidur.

English: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
Masaai: Tenaa nkolong'i are apa aashu olapa, aashu enkata naado, etobiko ina atampoi te nchumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai, neton te ine, nebik iltung'ana loo Siraeli too lng'oborri, nemedumunye aaidur

English: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: kake te neyae aailepie, nedumunye ninche aaidur. Te nkitanapata o Laitoriani eun ninche ilng'oborri, naa te nkitanapata o Laitoriani edumunye ninche aapuo; eibung'a apa ninche enkitanapata o Laitoriani, ina kitanapata o Laitoriani naimu Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
Masaai: “Ntobira ntarumpetani are e nkosholai te nkarriyiano ndong'u ninche, neaku ninche impotunye eumata, naa ninche egilieki ilng'oborri.

English: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Naa te nekuti pokira are, neiturrurrunye eumata pooki aapuonu enitii te kutukaji ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
Masaai: Kake tenaa nabo ake etukutaki, naa ilarikok, nena lukuny oo loshon loo Siraeli, likinturrurrokino.

English: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
Masaai: Naa ti niosh abuaku ore lelo ng'oborri ootii enkalo o loo saen nedumunye,

English: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
Masaai: ore pee intoki aosh abuaku e niare, ore lelo ng'oborri ootii enkalo e kopikop nedumunye aaidur. Embuakunoto eoshi enkata naba anaa enadumunye ninche.

English: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
Masaai: Kake tenaa eumata eiturrurri te nebo, nikut, kake mipik embuakunoto.

English: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
Masaai: Ore lelo ayiok le Aron, lelo apolosak, nekut ntarumpetani. Ore eoshoto oo ntarumpetani naa keaku te intae enkitanapata e anaake tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
Masaai: Naa tenipuopuo enjore te nkop inyi aagilunore ilo mang'atinta linyi oibooki intae enkop, nitumokiki taa aaitadara ntarumpetani, pee edamuni intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, neitajeuni intae too lmang'ati linyi.

English: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Ore sii too nkatitin e ng'ida - too siruai linyi lo lapa ng'ejuk o te kulikae siruai te sayiata e Nkai - tukuta nena tarumpetani ina kata intarasaa ilasarri linyi oopejori o lasarri linyi le seriani pee atum taa atareto intae: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”

English: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
Masaai: Ore to lari li are, to lapa li are te nkolong e tikitam o lapa nedumuni enkatampoi aailepie aaitung'uaa shumata ilo ng'obor le Nkai le nchakenisho,

English: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
Masaai: nedumunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa ntukusi aaidur aaing'uaa ongata e Sinai; nelo ina atampoi airrag tiongota e Paran.

English: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche aaidur te nkata e dukuya te nkitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa.

English: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
Masaai: Ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Yuda etang'asaki aaun too ntukusi enye, naa Nashon olayioni le Aminadab olarikoni lenye.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
Masaai: Ore apa olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Isaakar naa Natanel olayioni le Suar.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
Masaai: Ore apa olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Sebulon naa Eliab olayioni le Helon.

English: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
Masaai: Naa ore apa te nedotuni olng'obor le ntumo, naa ilayiok le Gershon o layiok le Merari laa ninche apa oonap ilo ng'obor le Nkai, nedumunye aaidur.

English: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
Masaai: Neitoki asuj olturrur loo lng'oborri le Ruben too ntukusi enye, ore olarikoni lenye naa Elisuri olayioni le Shedeur.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Simeon naa Shelumiel olayioni le Surishadai.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Gad naa Eliasaf olayioni le Deuel.

English: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
Masaai: Neitoki ile Kohat aadumunye aaidur, enapita nena tokitin naasinya, neitasheyie ilo ng'obor le Nkai eton eitu ebau ninche.

English: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
Masaai: Neitoki entukus oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Efraim adumunye too lturrurri lenye; ore olarikoni lenye naa Elishama olayioni le Amihud.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Manase naa Gamaliel olayioni le Pedasur.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo ltung'ana le Benchamen naa Abidan olayioni le Gideon.

English: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
Masaai: Neitoki enkereri oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Dan aa ninche ootii siadi ilng'oborri pooki, aadumunye too lturrurri lenye; ore olarikoni lo lorora lenye naa Ahieser olayioni le Amishadai.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo lorora loo ltung'ana lo losho le Asheri naa Pagiel olayioni le Okran.

English: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo lorora loo ltung'ana le Naftali naa Ahira olayioni le Enan.

English: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
Masaai: Ena apa empukunoto e lototo oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli te risioroto oo lororani lenye, te nedumunye aaidur.

English: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Hobab olayioni le Ruel ilo Midiani, aputani le Musa, “Eikidumunye iyiook aapuo ine wueji natejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kaisho nanu intae’ wootu te nebo iyiook, amu eikintaas iyiook intae esidai; amu eisiligie Olaitoriani Isiraeli embae sidai.”

English: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
Masaai: Kake etiaka apa ninye, “Malo nanu; kaorori nanu alo enkop ai makewan o lorere lai.”

English: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki, “Aatoomono, ming'uaa iyiook, amu iyiolo enikipuo aaiko kiun ilng'oborri ti ong'ata naa eilo iyie aaku nkonyek te iyiook.

English: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
Masaai: Naa ti nilo iyie te nebo iyiook, ore pooki toki sidai naba anaa enaitaas iyiook Olaitoriani, nikintaas iyiook iyie ina ake.”

English: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa ninche aapuo to ldoinyo le Nkai elototo oo nkolong'i uni; ore ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani nelo te dukuya ninche te ina lototo oo nkolong'i uni, pee etum aing'uraki ninche ewueji nepuo aayeng'iyeng'are.

English: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
Masaai: Netii apa enkatampoi o Laitoriani shumata ninche dama enkata ake naba anaa enadumunye ninche aaidur too lng'oborri.

English: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
Masaai: Naa ore ake enkata naba anaa enadumuni ilo sanduku aaya, nejo Musa, “Tudumunye, iyie Olaitoriani, naa nchoo ilmang'ati linono eisardak naa nchoo lelo likimba iyie eilanyisho te dukuya iyie.”

English: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eirragieki, nejo ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu iyie Olaitoriani nkalifuni iip tomon oo Siraeli.”

English: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki iltung'ana Olaitoriani te nkaraki enyamali enye; ore ake pee ening Olaitoriani ina neyupuyup engoro enye, nepej engoro o Laitoriani atua ninche, neinos kulie wuejitin e lelo ng'oborri.

English: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana aaishiraki Musa, neomon Musa Olaitoriani neye ina kima.

English: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
Masaai: Neaku keji apa enkarna ene wueji Tabera enkaraki natapejo enkima o Laitoriani atua ninche.

English: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana loo loreren ootii atua ninche netum kuuru oleng, neitoki sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli aaishir nejo, “Oi napaji kitum nkiri nikinos!

English: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
Masaai: Eikidamu isinkir apa likinos te Misiri pesho, o nkaitubulu naaijo ilmalenken, o kitunkuu o mbenek naainosi, o kulie tokitin kumok;

English: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
Masaai: kake ore taata eishunye engolon ang, nemeetae hoo ae toki meteleku ake ena manna king'or.”

English: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
Masaai: Ore apa ina manna neikununo anaa ilanterera, kutiti; ore elioto enye naa eisikitok neibor.

English: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
Masaai: Nemanimanaa apa iltung'ana aapuo aasotu, neidong too soito ooyutuutishoreki aashu eidongito te nkidong'et neitokitokie too motioo, neitayunye imukateni; ore enkishamu enye neikununo anaa enoo mukateni naayiera te ilata.

English: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
Masaai: Te nedoiki enkoileelio ilng'oborri kewarie neitadou manna.

English: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
Masaai: Nening Musa iltung'ana eyietu aaishir too lmareita lenye, oltung'ani ake te kutukaji o lng'obor lenye; neyupuyup airowuaju engoro o Laitoriani oleng, neisinanuo Musa.

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani, “Kainyoo iye pee intaasa entorroni osinka lino? Naa kainyoo nanu pee eitu atum omon too nkonyek inono, neaku kinteleikia nanu olola le kulo tung'ana pooki?

English: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
Masaai: Katoiuo nanu te nutai kulo tung'ana pooki? Kai nanu otoiuo ninche, metaa eikijoki iyie nanu, ‘Tanapa to lgoo lino, anaa enanap enkaibung'ani enkerai nanakita, aya ina kop ninosie iyie olmumai pee incho loo menye?’

English: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
Masaai: Kaji nanu atumie nkiri naisho kulo tung'ana pooki? Amu keyietu ninche aaishir te dukuya nanu nejo, ‘Nchoo iyiook nkiri, pee kitum aainosa.’

English: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
Masaai: Maidim nanu atanapa kulo tung'ana openy, keiroishi ele ola oleng te nanu.

English: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
Masaai: Tenaa kena kintaas nanu taaraki matua nabo kata, te nanoto omom too nkonyek inono, pee madol nanu entorroni ai.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Nturrurrokoki nanu iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana loo ilpayiani le Israel, lelo liyiolo iyie ajo ilpayiani lo lorere o larikok loo ltung'ana, nincho ninche meitasho te ine te nebo iyie.

English: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
Masaai: Naa kadou nanu alotu airorie intae te ine. Naa kaya nanu embata e ina kiyang'et natii shumata iyie napik shumata ninche; naa kenap ninche ilo ola le kulo tung'ana te nebo iyie, pee mintoki iyie anap openy.

English: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie iltung'ana, ‘Entisinya ate taisere ninosinoso nkiri; amu nchira intae too nkiyiaa o Laitoriani, ijojo, “Kaing'ae naisho iyiook nkiri nikinya? Amu eikash apa kitii Misiri.” Ore naa keisho intae Olaitoriani nkiri, naa inosinoso intae.

English: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
Masaai: Minosinoso intae enkolong nabo, aashu nkolong'i are, aashu nkolong'i imiet, aashu nkolong'i tomon, aashu nkolong'i tikitam,

English: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
Masaai: kake olapa olulung'a, o metaba anaa neimu intae nkumeishin, nirikaka, enkaraki nitanyaita intae Olaitoriani otii te nebo intae, ninchirishiri te dukuya ninye, ijojo, “Kainyoo iyiook pee kitupukutuo te nkop e Misiri?” ’ ”

English: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
Masaai: Kake etejo Musa, “Ore kulo tung'ana latii nanu atua oobaya nkalifuni iip ile oopuo too nkejek; eji nijo iyie, ‘Kaisho nanu nkiri, pee etum aainosa olapa olulung'a!’

English: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
Masaai: Ke nkishu o nkerrai eyieng'i te nkaraki ninche, pee eitaraposhi ninche? Arashu keisinkir pooki le naiposha eiturrurruni te nkaraki ninche, pee eitaraposhi ninche?”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keitodorropaki enkaina o Laitoriani? Ore taata idol iyie tenaa kesipayu ororei lai te iyie aashu mesipayu.”

English: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
Masaai: Neaku eipang'a apa Musa alo ajoki iltung'ana ilomon lo Laitoriani; neiturrur ninye iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana loo lpayiani loo ltung'ana, neitaman ninche olng'obor.

English: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
Masaai: Nelotu Olaitoriani te nkatampoi airorie ninye, neya embata e ina kiyang'et natii shumata ninye nepik shumata lelo payiani ntomoni naapishana; ore pee eirrag ina kiyang'et te shumata ninche, neibonisho ninche. Kake eitu eitoki aaiko neijia.

English: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
Masaai: Neing'uari apa iltung'ana oare too lng'oborri, neji obo Eldad ore o likae neji Medad, netonie enkiyang'et ninche; neaku ninche te nebo lelo ooigeroki kake eitu ninche eipang aapuo ilo ng'obor, neaku eibonishote ninche ti atua ilo ng'obor.

English: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
Masaai: Nekuet olbarnoti obo alo ajoki Musa, “Eibonisho Eldad o Medad to lng'obor.”

English: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo aisiaayiani le Musa, obo le lelo tung'ana oogeluno, nejo, “Olkitok lai Musa, tomitiki ninche.”

English: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD'S people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
Masaai: Kake etiaka Musa ninye, “Iata iyie olom te nkaraki nanu? Oo napaji tenaa ore iltung'ana pooki lo Laitoriani, naa loibonok, naaji te nepik Olaitoriani enkiyang'et enye shumata ninche.”

English: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Musa o lpayiani le Israel aapuo ilng'oborri.

English: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: Nedumunye olkutati oing'uaa Olaitoriani, neyau nkurleen aitung'uaa enkalo e naiposha, neisho ninche edou te mbata oo lng'oborri, eneba anaa elototo e nkolong nabo tena shoto o elototo e nkolong nabo te nkae shoto, te manaroto oo lng'oborri, naa eneba anaa intemat are e nkaina eirrag ti oriong enkop.

English: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana ina olong pooki, o enkewarie pooki, o ina olong pooki natusujua nesotu nkurleen, ore olotasotuo nkuti naa nkikapuni tomon, neisalaashaki ninche ate aaitaman ilng'oborri.

English: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
Masaai: Ore ina kata eton etii nena kiri irishat oo lala lenye eton eitu einos aamut, neyupuyupoki engoro o Laitoriani iltung'ana, near Olaitoriani olorere to lmeitai kitok.

English: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
Masaai: Neaku etejoki apa enkarna e ine wueji Kibrot-hatafa. Enkaraki naa te ine apa etunukayioki lelo tung'ana lo lorok.

English: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana te Kibrot-hatafa nepuo Haserot nebik ninche te Haserot.

English: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
Masaai: Etukurra Miriam o Aron Musa te nkaraki ina kitok oo Lkushi nayama, amu entito oo Lkushi apa eyamua;

English: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Ke Musa aa ninye ake eirorie Olaitoriani? Keitu sii ninye eirorie iyiook?” Nening Olaitoriani ina.

English: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
Masaai: Ore apa ilo tung'ani oji Musa naa oltung'ani obor oleng alang iltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop.

English: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron o Miriam, “Entupuku wootu, intae pokira uni atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.” Neipang'u pokira uni aapuonu.

English: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
Masaai: Nedou Olaitoriani alotu kop te ng'ape neitashe te kutukaji o lng'obor, neipot Aron o Miriam, nepuonu pokira are dukuya.

English: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Entoning irorei laainei: Tenaa ketii oloiboni atua intae, ore nanu Olaitoriani makewan naitayiolo kewan ai ninye te nduata nairorie ninye te nkidetidet.

English: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
Masaai: Mme neijia to sinka lai Musa; ninye eishooki enkaji ai pooki.

English: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
Masaai: Ore ninye kairorie nanu kiwalikino too nkutukie, te nkibalakinoto, neme te nkiroroto misil; naa keing'or ninye eneikununo Olaitoriani. Kainyoo naa pee miurere intae aatukur ilo sinka lai Musa?”

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani ti alo ninche, nelo aing'uaa;

English: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
Masaai: ore ake pee eiwuang ina atampoi te shumata ilo ng'obor, ng'ura, nejing Miriam enkeeya oo lbolot naibor anaa enturoto. Neibelekenya Aron aing'or Miriam, naa ng'ura, etijing'a ninye enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
Masaai: Nejoki Aron Musa, “Oi lo kitok lai, mintame iyiook amu kitaasa iyiook te modai, nikitaasa eng'oki.

English: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
Masaai: Mincho ninye etiu anaa enatua, naidaa nkiri o sesen apa pee eiu ng'otonye.”

English: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
Masaai: Neishiraki Musa Olaitoriani, ejo, “Nchiunye ninye, Na Ai, aatasayia.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Amaa naaji tenaa ketonotaka menye miriam enkomom enye, aimekurru ninye nkolong'i naapishana? Nchoo ninye eikenori ti auluo ilng'oborri nkolong'i naapishana, ore te siadi ina neidimi aanyaaki aaitijing'u.”

English: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
Masaai: Neaku eikenoyioki apa Miriam ti auluo ilng'oborri nkolong'i naapishana, neitu edumunye iltung'ana aapuo o metaba anaa neitokini aaitijing'u Miriam.

English: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina nedumunye iltung'ana aapuo te Haserot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri ti ong'ata e Paran.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Irriwai iltung'ana meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan, naisho nanu iltung'ana loo Siraeli;

English: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
Masaai: ore ake te pooki osho loo loo menye irriwai oltung'ani, ore ake oltung'ani naa olarikoni ti atua ninche.”

English: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie apa Musa ninche ti ong'ata e Paran, te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani, o lelo tung'ana pooki aa lukuny oo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
Masaai: Naa kuna apa nkarn enye: Ore to losho le Ruben naa Shamua olayioni le Sakuri;

English: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
Masaai: ore to losho le Simeon naa Shafat olayioni le Hor;

English: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Masaai: ore to losho le Yuda, naa Kalebu olayioni le Yefune;

English: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
Masaai: ore to losho le Isaakar naa Igal olayioni le Yosef;

English: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
Masaai: ore to losho le Efraim naa Hoshea olayioni le Nuni;

English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
Masaai: ore to losho le Benchamen, naa Palti olayioni le Rafu,

English: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Sebulon, naa Gadiel olayioni le Sodi;

English: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Yosef aa taa to losho olayioni le Manase, naa Gad olayioni le Susi;

English: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
Masaai: ore to losho le Dan naa Amiel olayioni le Gemali;

English: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
Masaai: ore to losho le Asheri naa Setur olayioni le Mikael;

English: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Naftali na Nahabi olayioni le Fopsi;

English: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
Masaai: ore to losho le Gad naa Geuel olayioni le Maki.

English: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
Masaai: Kuna apa nkarn e lelo tung'ana ooirriwayie Musa meshomo aaikitalan ina kop. Neisho apa Musa Hoshea olayioni le Nuni enkarna, nejo Yoshua.

English: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
Masaai: Neirriwaa apa Musa ninche meshomo aaikitalan ina kop e Kanaan, nejoki ninche, “Elepa enchom Negeb te idie, nilepilepe aapuo ina kop oo ldoinyo,

English: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
Masaai: nidolidolo aajo kaji eikununo ina kop, tenaa kegol iltung'ana oomanya aashu tenaa keshal,

English: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
Masaai: aashu tenaa ae kuti anaa aikumok o aashu sii tenaa eisidai ina kop namanya ninche anaa torrono, o aashu sii tenaa ore nena anas naamanya ninche naa ilng'oborri tenaa isempewueti,

English: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
Masaai: o nchere eikarsis enkop tenaa kaaisinani, ketii ilkeek anaa metii. Entagoluoto, niyauu embata oo lng'anayio le ina kop.” Ore apa ina kata naa erishata oo sabibu le dukuya ooto.

English: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa ninche aapuo aaikitalan enkop ebaiki ong'ata e Sin o metabaiki Rehob; embata e nejing'ieki Hamat;

English: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
Masaai: nepuo apa ninche Negeb, neitoki aapuonu Hebron; o Ahiman, o Sheshai, o Talmai, ore apa lelo le ishoi e Anak naa ine etii. (Eteshetaki apa Hebron ilarin oopishana te dukuya Soan te Misiri.)

English: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aapuonu oerata le Eshkol, nedung'u ninche te ine olng'osila otii enkimarrimarrati nabo oo sabibu, nenap iltung'ana oare te nchata; eyautua sii ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka o lng'abolo.

English: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
Masaai: Keji apa ine wueji oerata le Eshkol, te nkaraki ina kimarrimarrati natudung'utuo iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i artam neshukunye ninche eing'uaa ina kitalanare e ina kop.

English: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche enetii Musa o Aron o ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel ti ong'ata e Paran, te Kadesh; neyaki ninche olomoni o ina umata pooki, neitodol ninche ilng'anayio le ina kop.

English: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kitabaitie iyiook ina kop apa nirriwayie iyiook; keruko kule o naishi, naa kulo ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia kegol iltung'ana oomanya ina kop, naa kesheta nkanas enye nelala oleng; ore te nebo ina kitoduaa eishoi e Anak te ine.

English: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
Masaai: Ore Ilmaleki nemanya enkop e Negeb, ore ile Hiti o Iyebusi o le Amori nemanya ina kop oo ndoinyo, netii ile Kanaan embata e naiposha, olkeju le Yordan.”

English: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
Masaai: Kake eitigira apa Kalebu olorere te dukuya Musa, nejo ninye “Mailepa iyiook aapuo nabo kata, pee kipuo aamany, amu eikindim iyiook aaibung'a ina kop.”

English: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo tung'ana ooshomo te nebo ninye nejo, “Mikindim iyiook aashom aairisha ilo orere; amu kegol ninche aalang iyiook.”

English: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
Masaai: Neaku eyakitia apa ninche iltung'ana le Israel olomoni torrono le ina kop nashomo aaikitalan, ejo, “Ore ina kop nikishomo iyiook aaikitalan naa enkop nainos lelo oomanya, ore lelo tung'ana pooki likitoduaa te ina kop naa adoru naa iltung'ana sapuki oleng.

English: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
Masaai: Ore teine nikitoduaa ile Nefilim, (lelo ayiok le Anak apa ooing'uaa Nefilim,) nikitiu iyiook anaa ntargeet, neijia iyiook kitotiutuo te ninche.”

English: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
Masaai: Neyietu ina umata pooki aishir, neishir iltung'ana ina kewarie.

English: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki le Israel neing'unyung'unyaki Musa o Aron; nejoki ina umata pooki ninche, “Aimeikash apa tenaa ekituata te nkop e Misiri arashu tenaa eikituata tena ong'ata!

English: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani ena kop, pee kipuonu aabatata to lalem? Ore nkituaak ang o nkera ang naa keaku inaari metuata; aimeikash naaji te iyiook te nikirrinyo aapuo Misiri?”

English: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
Masaai: Nejokino ninche maate, “Mategelu iyiook olarikoni pee kirrinyo aapuo Misiri.”

English: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa o Aron aabatata too nkomomi te dukuya ina umata e ilo turrur loo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
Masaai: Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o Kalebu olayioni le Yefune apa ootii te nebo lelo ooshomo aaikitalan enkop, nepolos ilkilani lenye,

English: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
Masaai: nejoki ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, “Ore ina kop nikishomo iyiook aaikitalan naa enkop sidai oleng.

English: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: Tenaa keshipakino iyiook Olaitoriani, naa keyau iyiook atua ena kop neisho iyiook, ena kop naruko kule o naishi.

English: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.
Masaai: Emigolong'aki ake duoo intae Olaitoriani; nimiureyuyu lelo tung'ana le ina kop, amu emukate ninche te iyiook; eiwuang'ie olchurie lenye aaitung'uaa ninche netii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook; emiureyu ninche.”

English: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake etejo olturrur pooki pee enang ninche too soito. Nelioyu enkitoo o Laitoriani to lng'obor le ntumo too ltung'ana pooki le Israel.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Kaamenu akenya kulo tung'ana o anu? Ketoni ninche eitu aairuk nanu o anu, aasita kuna kitoduaat pooki nataasa nanu ti atua ninche?

English: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
Masaai: Kaosh nanu ninche to lmeitai nemaitujung ninche, naa kaitayu nanu te iyie olosho kitok naa magilani alang ninche.”

English: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
Masaai: Kake etiaka Musa Olaitoriani, “Ekening naa ile Misiri ina, amu intubulua iyie ele orere te ngolon ino aitung'uaa ile Misiri,

English: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
Masaai: naa kepuo ninche aaliki kulo oomanya ena kop. Etoning'o apa ninche nchere, ore iyie Olaitoriani itii atua ele orere; amu ore iyie Olaitoriani nitoduare ninche too nkonyek, neitashe enkatampoi ino te shumata ninche nilo iyie te dukuya ninche, te ng'ape e nkatampoi dama o te ng'ape e nkima kewarie.

English: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
Masaai: Ore taata te niar ele orere metuata anaa oltung'ani obo, ore apa lelo oshon ootoning'o enkaisisa ino nejo,

English: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
Masaai: ‘Enkaraki nemeidim Olaitoriani ayau ele orere atua ina kop nainosie olmumai pee eisho ninche, neaku etara ninche metuata ti ong'ata.’

English: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
Masaai: Ore naa taata, aatoomono nanu, nchoo engolon o Laitoriani eaku kitok anaa apa enisiligie ninche, ijo,

English: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
Masaai: ‘Mesioki Olaitoriani agoro, neton ninye te nyorrata nauno, nepalaki iltung'ana te ntorroni o te ngolon e nkong'u, kake meeta ninye nchere pee eiwuang'ie eng'oki eitu eitabaiki entorroni oo loo menye shumata nkera enye, shumata e ishoi e uni o shumata eishoi e ong'uan.’

English: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
Masaai: Tapalaki entorroni e tung'ana, aatoomono nanu iyie, te risioroto e nkitoo e nyorrata ino, o te risioroto e mpalikinoto ino nitapalaka iyie ele orere, ebaiki apa te Misiri o taata.”

English: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Atapalaka nanu ninche te risioroto o rorei lino;

English: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
Masaai: kake esipa ore anaa enaishu nanu, o anaa sii enabore enkop pooki enkitoo enkisisa o Laitoriani,

English: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
Masaai: meetae obo le kulo tung'ana ootoduaa enkitoo enkisisa ai o nkitoduaat aainei nataasa te Misiri o tiongota ore ake sii atetema kuna katitin tomon, neitu ening oltoilo lai

English: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
Masaai: olo adol ina kop apa nainosie nanu olmumai pee aisho loo menye; nemeetae obo le lelo laatemenaitie nanu olo adol ina kop.

English: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
Masaai: Kake ore osinka lai Kalebu, enkaraki naata ninye oltau opaashaa naatusuja ninye nanu tukul, kayau nanu ninye atua ina kop apa nashomo,

English: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
Masaai: ore eishoi enye naa kepuo aaya ina kop. Ore taata amu emanya Ilmaleki o le Kanaan iyerat, tayooki mbelekenyayu shomo ong'ata aim enkoitoi Enaiposha Nanyokie.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa o Aron,

English: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
Masaai: “Kaaing'unyung'unyaki akenya ena umata torrono o anu? Atoning'o nanu enking'unyung'uny oo ltung'ana le Israel aaing'unyung'unyaki nanu.

English: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani ojo, ‘Ore ina nitejo intae too nkiyiaa aainei kaitaas nanu intae.

English: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,
Masaai: Ore mpopoki inyi kepuo aairragaa tena ong'ata, ore te siana inyi pooki ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, le lelo laaing'unyung'unyakitia nanu,

English: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Masaai: meetae obo olo atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai nchere kaisho intae entamany, meteleku ake Kalebu olayioni le Yefune o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
Masaai: Kake ore nena kera inyi apa nitejo kearari kaitijing nanu ina kop, naa kepuo ninche aayiolou ina kop apa nitemenaitie.

English: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
Masaai: Kake ore intae keiput mpopoki inyi ena ong'ata.

English: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
Masaai: Naa keaku nkera inyi ilchekuti loo ntare to lpurkel ilarin artam netum ninche osina te nkaraki nimisiligayuyu o metaba anaa neirrag mpopoki olobayie linyi tiongata.

English: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
Masaai: Te risioroto e siana oo nkolong'i apa nikinkitalana enkop, nkolong'i artam, te nkolong ake to lari, inapinapa intae entorroni inyi, ilarin artam, naa ipuopuo intae aayiolou engoro ai.’

English: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
Masaai: Nanu, Olaitoriani oiroro; esipa ena nanu ayooki aitaas ele turrur torrono pooki laaiturrurrokine nanu: ore tena ongota naa kepuonu ninche enkiting'oto enye tukul, naa te ine epuo aaye.”

English: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana apa ooirriwayie Musa meikitalana ina kop, lelo apa ootushukunye neisho olturrur meing'unyung'unyaki ninye neyau olkilikuai torrono ina kop,

English: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
Masaai: lelo tung'ana apa ooyautua olkilikuai torrono le ina kop, neye ninche to lmeitai te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
Masaai: Kake ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o Kalebu olayioni le Yefune neitu eye, te nebo lelo tung'ana apa ooshomo aaikitalan enkop.

English: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa kulo rorei iltung'ana pooki le Israel neishir iltung'ana eisinanuo oleng.

English: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.
Masaai: Neyooki ninche aainyototo tadekenya oleng nepuo eneika e ina kop oo ldoinyo ejo, “Ng'ura kitii iyiook ene, eikilep iyiook aapuo ine wueji apa neisiligie Olaitoriani iyiook; amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki.”

English: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
Masaai: Kake etejo Musa, “Kainyoo naa taata pee igolong'akiki intae enkitanapata o Laitoriani, amu melo dukuya intae?

English: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
Masaai: Milepilepe intae aapuo, pee meari intae aairragie te dukuya ilmang'ati linyi, amu metii Olaitoriani te nebo intae.

English: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
Masaai: Amu ore te idie netii Ilmaleki o le Kanaan dukuya intae, naa ipuopuo intae aabatata to lalem, enkaraki nimbelekenyate intae aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani, meitoki Olaitoriani atii te nebo intae.”

English: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
Masaai: Kake eshomo ake duoo ninche eneika te ina kop oo ldoinyo, hoo neitu eipang osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, o Musa aaing'uaa ilng'oborri.

English: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
Masaai: Neitoki Ilmaleki o Lkanaan apa oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo aadou aapuonu, nemir ninche, nesujaa ninche, o metabaiki Horma.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
Masaai: Ti nipuonunu akenya ina kop nipuopuo aamany,

English: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
Masaai: ina naisho nanu intae, ninchosho Olaitoriani nkishorot naaing'uaa eluata oo nkishu, aashu enoo ntare, olasar le nkima aashu olasar opejori, aashu olasar ake duo, pee intabayaya ilo mumai aashu olasar lo lpela, aashu too lasarri linyi ootegeluaki pee intobirakiki esong'ouna narropil Olaitoriani,

English: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
Masaai: ore naa ilo oyau nkishorot enyena neisho sii Olaitoriani olasar le ntapa le matua e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui eipurjaki te rubata e ong'uan e ilata,

English: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
Masaai: o enaisho te nkaraki olasar ooki, ore erubata e ong'uan nintobir te nebo olasar opejori, aashu te nkaraki olasar, to lkuo ake le ker.

English: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
Masaai: Aashu ore to lmeregesh nintobir to lasar le ntapa intemat are e matua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui naipurja too mboreitin uni e ilata,

English: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: naa ore to lasar ooki nintayu mboreitin uni e naisho pee eaku olng'usil orropil to Laitoriani.

English: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
Masaai: Naa ti nintobir oloing'oni pee eaku olasar opejori, aashu olasar, pee intabaya olmumai, aashu olasar le seriani to Laitoriani,

English: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
Masaai: neitayu ake oltung'ani te nebo ilo oing'oni olasar le ntapa loo mboreitin uni e matua e tomon e efa entapa napuyiapui, naipurjaki te ilata naitorit empirbil.

English: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ninchooyo to lasar ooki empirbil naitorit e naisho oo sabibu pee eaku olasar le nkima, olng'usil orropil to Laitoriani.

English: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
Masaai: Neijia epuoi aaiko te pooki oing'oni aashu to lmeregesh, aashu te pooki sitima le ker aashu to le kine,

English: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
Masaai: ore te risioroto e ina siana nintobiriri, naa neijia enkuna te pooki ng'ae te risioroto e siana enye.

English: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki inot linyi nchoo eas kuna baa tena oitoi, aaishooyo olasar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani.

English: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
Masaai: Naa te neewuo oltung'ani leiking'a amanyisho te nebo intae, aashu te netii likae tung'ani atua intae too ishoritin inyi, neyieu ninye neishoru olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, nchoo ninye eas anaa eniasiasa.

English: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore te umata naa keaku enkitanapata nabo ake, te intae o to lomoni otii te nebo intae, enkitanapata nabikoo ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki, ore anaa enitiuu naa neijia etiu ilo omoni te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
Masaai: Keaku enkitanapata nabo o enkikoo nabo te iyie o te ilo omoni omanyisho te nebo intae.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nipuonunu atua ina kop nayau nanu intae,

English: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: naa ore ake pee inosinoso endaa e ina kop, nintarasakiki Olaitoriani enkishoroto.

English: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
Masaai: Ore ina tapa inyi e nkiterata ninchooyoyo emukate naaku olasar; ore anaa olasar oing'uaa osoit oituutishoreki, ninchooyoyo.

English: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
Masaai: Ore ilo asar linyi le ntapa enkiterata enchorie Olaitoriani olasar tiatua iishoritin inyi pooki.

English: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,
Masaai: “Kake ti ntarruoo nimimbung'ubung'u kuna kitanapat naairoro Olaitoriani aimunye Musa,

English: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
Masaai: ebaiki ina olong apa naishorua Olaitoriani nkitanapat neito dukuya ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki,

English: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
Masaai: kake te neitadiaki te nkaraki meyiolo eumata neitayu naa ina umata pooki oloti oing'oni oaku olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, te nebo olasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki te risioroto e nkitanapata, o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki.

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
Masaai: Neitobir olapolosani olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel, naa kepalakini ninye, amu enkitapong'oto apake, neyautua ninche olasar lenye, ilo asar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani, neyau ilo asar lenye le ng'oki dukuya Olaitoriani, te nkaraki ina kitarruoroto enye.

English: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
Masaai: Ore ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel naa kepalakini o ilo omoni otii te nebo ninche, amu etijing'a apa ilo orere pooki ina kitarruoroto.

English: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
Masaai: “Te neas oltung'ani eng'oki eitu eotiki, neitayu ninye esupen e kine o lari obo naaku olasar le ng'oki.

English: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: Neitobir olopolosani osotua lo lning'o te dukuya o Laitoriani te nkaraki ilo tung'ani otaasa enkitarruoroto, teneas ninye eng'oki eitu eotiki, naa kepalakini ninye.

English: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
Masaai: Nchoo eaku enkitanapata nabo iata te ilo oas pooki toki eitu eotiki, o te ilo ora oinoti le Israel o te ilo omoni otamanyishe ti atua intae.

English: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo tung'ani oas pooki toki te otikinoto, aa oinoti aasho olomoni neinyala Olaitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani naa keiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa iltung'ana lenye.

English: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
Masaai: Enkaraki natemenayie ninye ororei lo Laitoriani, netigila enkitanapata enye, ore ilo tung'ani keiwuang'ieki tukul, ore eng'oki enye naa keaku shumata ninye.”

English: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
Masaai: Ore apa eton etii iltung'ana le Israel olpurkel netum ninche oltung'ani osotu ilkeek te nkolong' e sabato.

English: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo oonoto ninye esotu ilkeek, neyau ninye enetii Musa o Aron, o ilo turrur pooki.

English: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
Masaai: Neikenori ninye, amu eitu apa eibalunyeki enaitaasi ninye.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Keari ilo tung'ani metua; naa kenang' ilo turrur pooki ninye too soito o metua ti auluo ilng'oborri.”

English: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neyau ilo turrur pooki ninye auluo nenang' ninye o metua too soito, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
Masaai: “Irorie iltung'ana le Israel nintanap ninche pee epik ilkisialisal ilcholo loo lkilani lenye ti atua iishoritin enye pooki ore ake olkisialisialati le pooki sholoi enkeene pus;

English: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
Masaai: naa keaku te iyie olkisialisialati oing'or nedamuni nkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani, pee easi ninche, mme pee isujaa oltau lino makewan o nkonyek inono makewan.

English: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
Masaai: Neaku entadamu niasiasa nkitanapat aainei pooki niakuku sinyat to Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ilo apa likintayio iyie aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, pee aaku Enkai inyi. Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
Masaai: Ore apa Kora olayioni le Ishar, olayioni le Kohat olayioni le Lawi, o Datan o Abiram ilayiok le Eliabu, o Oni olayioni le Pelet, olayioni le Ruben,

English: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
Masaai: neya iltung'ana, nedumunye ninche te dukuya Musa, te nebo esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel iltung'ana iip are o onom arikok le ilo turrur ootegeluaki te ina umata, iltung'ana yiolot oleng;

English: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
Masaai: neiturrurro ninche maate te nebo aarare Musa o Aron, nejoki ninche, “Ishomo intae aalus! Amu ore ele turrur pooki kesinya, pooki ng'ae lenye, netii Olaitoriani atua ninche; kainyoo naa pee ilepiepie intae ate aaitulus te umata o Laitoriani?”

English: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening' Musa ena, nebatata ninye te nkomom enye;

English: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
Masaai: nejoki ninye Kora o ina sholiek enye pooki, “Ore tadekenya keyooki Olaitoriani aitodolu ajo kalo olenye, naa kalo osinya, neisho meeu anyikaki ninye, ore ilo olo ninye agelu naa keisho meeu anyikaki ninye.

English: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
Masaai: Taasa iyie ena, ewaita eng'irra e nkima, Kora o encholiek enye pooki,

English: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
Masaai: entipik enkima atua ninche nipikipiki enkorropil shumata ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani taisere, ore ilo tung'ani oyooki Olaitoriani agelu neaku ilo sinyati. Ishomo aaitulus ilayiok le Lawi!”

English: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Kora, “Entoning' taata, intae ilayiok le Lawi!

English: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
Masaai: Kentoki kiti ena te intae nchere etegelayie intae Enkai oo Siraeli aitung'uaa olturrur le Israel, pee eitataaniki intae kewan, pee iasiasa enkisiaayiare te ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, nintasheshe te dukuya olturrur aaisiaai ninche;

English: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
Masaai: amaa amu kiyaua ninye aitinyikaki kewan, o lalashera linono lelo ayiok le Lawi te nebo iyie, ing'oruru sii intae empolosare?

English: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
Masaai: Ore naa meitiship Olaitoriani ena nchere ore iyie o encholiek ino pooki inturrurrote te nebo; Kainyoo pee ing'unyung'unyakiki Aron?”

English: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
Masaai: Neirriwaa Musa olkilikuai aipotu Datan o Abiram lelo ayiok le Eliab; nejo ninche, “Mikipuonu iyiook.

English: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
Masaai: Kembae kiti ena nchere iyaua iyiook ailepunye te ina kop naruko kule o naishi pee ilotu aar iyiook matuata tiong'ota, pee itumoki sii aitaa kewan kitok te shumata iyiook?

English: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
Masaai: Ore ninye eitu iyie iyau iyiook ina kop naruko kule o naishi, neitu incho iyiook enjung'ore e nkop o nkurman oo lng'anayio. Ikurtu iyie nkonyek e kulo tung'ana? Mikipuonu iyiook.”

English: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
Masaai: Negoro apa Musa oleng', nejoki Olaitoriani, “Mishilaa iyie olasar lenye. Eitu ninye nanu aya osikiria lenye neitu ainyal obo lenye.”

English: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Kora, “Wou taisere dukuya Olaitoriani, iyie o encholiek ino, o Aron.

English: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
Masaai: Naa inchoo ake oltung'ani eya eng'irra enye oo nkuk o lasar, nepik enkorropil shumata ninye, neyau ake pooki ng'ae te intae dukuya Olaitoriani eng'irra enye, ngirran iip are o onom; ore sii iyie o Aron neyau ake oltung'ani eng'irra enye.”

English: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa oltung'ani ake eng'irra enye, nepik nkimaitie atua neiteleiki enkorropil shumata, neitashe te kutuk aji ilo ng'obor le ntumo te nebo Musa o Aron.

English: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
Masaai: Neitoki Kora aiturrur ilo turrur pooki aipirakinye ninche kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo. Neliooyu enkitoo enkisisa o Laitoriani teina umata pooki.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa o Aron,
