English: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
Masaai: “Entoor ate ewuang'a tena umata, pee atum nanu aidaikie ninche nabo kata.”

English: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
Masaai: Nebatata ninche too nkomomi enye, nejo, “Na Ai, na Ai ooltauja le pooki naishu, keas oltung'ani obo eng'oki nigorokino eumata pooki?”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
Masaai: “Tiaki ena umata, ‘Ewuang'a tena manyisho e Kora o Datan o Abiram.’ ”

English: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa adumunye alo enetii Datan o Abiram; nesujaa ilpayiani le Israel ninye.

English: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ina umata, “Ewuang'a, atoomono intae enchom, entung'uai ilng'oborri le kulo tung'ana arruok, nimimbung'ubung'u hoo ae toki enye pooki pee memuti ake intae tenebo nena ng'ok enye pooki.”

English: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
Masaai: Neaku eipang'a apa ninche aaing'uaa emanyisho e Kora, o Datan o Abiram; neipang'u Datan o Abiram nepuonu aaitashe te kutukaji oo lng'oborri lenye, te nebo nkituaak enye, o layiok lenye, o nkera enye kutiti.

English: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
Masaai: Nejo Musa “Tena taa iyiolouu nchere Olaitoriani laairriua mataasa kuna siaitin pooki neme te nkaraki kewan ai.

English: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.
Masaai: Te neye kulo tung'ana enkeeya e oshiake oo ltung'ana pooki aashu te neinepu entaboi oo ltung'ana pooki, neaku naa eitu aairriu Olaitoriani.

English: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
Masaai: Kake te neitobiru Olaitoriani entoki ng'ejuk, nebol enkop enkutuk enye, neijoo ninche tenebo imasaa enye pooki aapuo enemeneng'a aishu, niyiolouu taa nchere Olaitoriani etemenaitie kulo tung'ana.”

English: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
Masaai: Ore enaidipie airoro kulo rorei pooki ore enkop ti abori ninche neiperra; nebol enkop enkutuk enye

English: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
Masaai: neijoo ninche, o lmareita lenye, o lelo tung'ana pooki le Kora o masaa enye.

English: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
Masaai: Neaku ore ninche o nena pooki naara nkunenye nedoyio eishu aapuo enemeneng'a neikeno enkop te shumata ninche, neidak ninche te mpolos e ina umata.

English: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
Masaai: Ore lelo Siraeli pooki oomanita ninche, neisik to lkiyioi lenye, amu etejo ninche, “Eji pee meijoo iyiook enkop.”

English: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
Masaai: Nedou enkima naing'uaa Olaitoriani, nemut lelo tung'ana iip are o onom apa oopejito enkorropil.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
Masaai: “Tiaki Eliesa olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani, pee eitayu nena girran naapejieki enkorropil te nkima; neitalamaa enkima neidapashaa. Amu kesinya ninche.

English: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore nena girran e kulo tung'ana ootaasa eng'oki aainosie enkishui enye, nchoo ninche eidong'unyeki ngirran naaiteleikini olasar, amu eishorutua apa ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani; metaa kesinya ninche. Neaku kepuo ninche aaku enkitanyaanyukoto too ltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa Eliesa ilo apolosani nena girran o suyai, apa naaishorutua lelo ootapejoyioki, neidong'i aaitaa entoki naimulumulieki olperere lo lasar,

English: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: pee eaku enkitadamunoto too ltung'ana le Israel pee metii hoo obo leme olapolosani, leme olayioni le ishoi e Aron, onyiku alotu apej enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani, metiu ake anaa Kora o encholiek enye - anaa apa enatiaka Olaitoriani Eliesa aimunye Musa.

English: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu neing'unyung'unyaki eumata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel Musa o Aron, ejo, “Itaara intae metuata iltung'ana lo Laitoriani.”

English: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiturrurrokino ina umata Musa o Aron, neibelekenya ninche aaing'or olng'obor le ntumo; naa ng'ura, neimulumul enkatampoi ilo ng'obor, neliooyu enkitoo enkisisa o Laitoriani.

English: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nelotu Musa o Aron dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo,

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
Masaai: “Enchom entung'uai atua umata, pee atum nanu aidaikie ninche nabo kata.” Nerriaa ninche too nkomomi.

English: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Aron, “Ntayu engirra ino e nkorropil, nipik enkima atua naing'uaa olperere lo lasar, nipik enkorropil shumata ninye, ninap aitasioyo ine netii eumata, nintobir olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche; amu etupukuo engoro naing'uaa Olaitoriani, neiterua alotu o olmeitai.”

English: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
Masaai: Kaae neyau Aron anaa enatiaka Musa nekuet alo empolos eumata naa ng'ura, eidipa aiteru olmeitai ti atua iltung'ana; neinok ninye enkorropil, neitobir olning'o lo sotua o ltung'ana.

English: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
Masaai: Neitashe ninye te rishata oo loo tuata o looishu; neishieki olmeitai.

English: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ootuata to lmeitai naa nkalifuni tomon oong'uan o iip naapishana, metii lekua ootuata te siaai e Kora.

English: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
Masaai: Nerrinyokino Aron Musa te kutuk aji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ina kata pee eish olmeitai.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Musa nejoki,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
Masaai: “Irorie iltung'ana le Israel, niyau te ninche ing'udisin, nabo ake te nkaji oo loo menye, niyau too larikok pooki te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ing'udisin tomon oare. Ng'ero ake enkarna o ltung'ani te ng'udi enye

English: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
Masaai: ninger enkarna e Aron te ng'udi e Lawi. Amu keaku keetae eng'udi nabo te ndukuya e pooki aji oo loo menye.

English: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
Masaai: Shomo tipika ninche atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, dukuya ina shakenisho, teine naalotu atumore.

English: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
Masaai: Ore eng'udi e ilo lagelu nejing nkaitubulu naisho taa meisha te nanu ina king'unyung'uny oo ltung'ana le Israel niking'unyung'unyaki ninche iyie.”

English: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
Masaai: Neirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel neisho lelo arikok lenye pooki ninye ing'udisin, nabo ake to larikoni, ore te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ng'udisin tomon oare, ore eng'udi e Aron naa nabo e nena ng'udisin enye.

English: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.
Masaai: Nepik Musa nena ng'udisin dukuya Olaitoriani ti atua ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho.

English: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nelo Musa atua ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho; naa ng'ura, ore eng'udi e Aron te nkaji e Lawi etijing'a nkaitubulu nejing ilng'osil neitapuku, neiu ilng'anayio ooto.

English: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
Masaai: Neyau Musa nena ng'udisin pooki aitung'uaa dukuya Olaitoriani, ayau dukuya iltung'ana pooki le Israel; neing'or neya ake oltung'ani eng'udi enye.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Torrinyoki eng'udi e Aron dukuya enchakenisho, pee eshumi aitaa enkitoduata too loogolong'u, pee itum aishie ina king'unyung'uny enye naaing'unyung'unyaki ninche nanu, pee meye ake.”

English: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.
Masaai: Ina etaasa Musa. Ore anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani neas ninye ina.

English: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Musa, “Ng'ura, eikindaaya iyiook, kiisha iyiook, kiisha iyiook pooki.

English: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae olotu anyikaki olng'obor lo Laitoriani neye. Eikindaaya iyiook pooki?”

English: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Aron, “Ore iyie o layiok linono, o enkaji e papaai lino te nebo iyie, iyaya intae entorroni ti alo ine wueji sinyati; ore iyie o layiok linono niyaya entorroni ti alo empolosare.

English: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
Masaai: Naa ore te nebo iyie toshoru sii ilalashera linono, ilo osho le Lawi, ilo osho le papaai lino, pee kitum ninche aatushulare, nikisiaai iyie ina kata itii iyie o layiok linono dukuya ilo ng'obor le nchakenisho.

English: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
Masaai: Eikisiaai ninche iyie neas enkisiaayiare pooki e ilo ng'obor; kake menyikaki ninche nena masaa e ine wueji sinyati aashu enyiku aapuonu olperere lo lasar, meye ake ninche aashu iye iyie.

English: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
Masaai: Nchoo kishulare ninche, nejing'u atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, te ina kisiaayiare pooki e ilo ng'obor; nemeetae likae tung'ani hoo obo likilotu anyikaki.

English: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nijing iyie enkisiaayiare e ine wueji sinyati o enkisiaayiare o lperere lo lasar pee meitoki alotu engoro shumata iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, aawa nanu ilalashera linono lelo le Lawi aitung'uaa atua iltung'ana le Israel, enkishoroto ninche te iyie, naaishooki Olaitoriani, pee eas enkisiaayiare e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
Masaai: Ore iyie o layiok linono te nebo iyie nijing'ijing'i empolosare te pooki naipirta olperere lo lasar o ina natii atua olodung'oro; nisiaisho iyie. Aaishoo nanu empolosare ino metaa enkishoroto, ore pooki ng'ae olotu anyiku neari metua.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Aron naa, “Ng'ura, aaishoo nanu iyie pooki toki naba anaa enatushumaki too nkishorot naaitakiaiki nanu, o nena tokitin pooki naaitisinyaki oo ltung'ana le Israel; aaisho nanu iyie ninche metaa erubata oo layiok linono metaa erubata enye e anaake.

English: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
Masaai: Keaku enino ina nasinya aisul naiteng'elaki neitu epejori te nkima; ore pooki kishoroto enye o lasar, o pooki asar lenye le ng'oki laaisho ninche nanu naa keaku kesinya oleng te iyie o too layiok linono.

English: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
Masaai: Te wueji nesinya oleng inosa iyie ina naa kesinya ina te iyie.

English: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
Masaai: Enino sii ena, ilo asar loo nkishorunot enye, ore lelo asarri pooki ooyuki loo ltung'ana le Israel; aaishoo nanu iyie ninche, o layiok linono o ntoyie inono te nebo iyie, metaa erubata ino e anaake. Ore pooki ng'ae le meeta entioto otii atua enkaji ino neidim ainosa.

English: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
Masaai: Ore ina ilata sidai aisul, o ina aisho pooki sidai o entapa, lelo ng'anayio le dukuya ooisho ninche Olaitoriani, aaishoo nanu iyie.

English: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
Masaai: Ore lelo ng'anayio oong'as ooku te pooki natii atua ina kop, ooyaki ninche Olaitoriani, naa keaku ilkulinyi; ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta entioto otii atua enkaji ino neidim ainosa.

English: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
Masaai: Ore pooki naiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani ti atua Siraeli naa keaku eninyi.

English: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
Masaai: Ore pooki kikau aa olayioni le tung'ani aashu olayioni le ng'ues, ilo oishori Olaitoriani naa keaku olinyi, ore ake eyia olkikau le tung'ani tokordu ainyiang'u, ore olkikau pooki le ng'ues lemesinya inyang'u tokordu.

English: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
Masaai: Ore enkinyiang'a e nkordunoto enye (aa te mbotoro o lapa obo ikordu ninche) tipika shekeli imiet e nkosholai, te risioroto e shekeli e ine wueji sinyati.

English: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore olkikau le nkiteng, aashu olkikau le nker aashu olkikau le nkine, mikordu ainyiang'u; kesinya ninche. Isuaaki osarge lenye shumata olperere lo lasar, nipejoo eilata enye metaa olasar opejori te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani;

English: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
Masaai: kake ore nkiri enye naa keaku nkuninyi, anaa ilo oikulu oyukoki o anaa ina muro enkalo e tatene naara ininono.

English: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
Masaai: Ore nena tokitin pooki naasinya naaisho iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, aaishoo nanu iyie, o layiok linono o ntoyie inono naatii te nebo iyie, metaa erubata e anaake. O sotua le munyan ele ntarasi te dukuya Olaitoriani, te iyie o te ishoi ino natii te nebo iyie.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Aron, “Miata iyie enjung'ore ti atua enkop enye, nimiata erubata ti atua ninche; ara nanu erubata ino nara enjung'ore ino tiatua iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: “Ore ile Lawi aishoo nanu ninche pooki ematua e tomon ti atua Siraeli metaa enjung'ore enye, pee eaku ole rrinyore te ina kisiaayiare enye naisiaisho, ore ina kisiaayiare enye netii atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
Masaai: Ore naa ebaiki taata mepuonu iltung'ana le Israel aanyikaki ilo ng'obor le ntumo, menap ake ng'ok neye.

English: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
Masaai: Kake lelo le Lawi oas enkisiaayiare o ilo ng'obor le ntumo, naa kenap ninche ina ng'oki enye; keaku ena enkitanapata nadamuni ti atua iishoritin inyi pooki; ore ti atua iltung'ana le Israel meeta ninche enjung'ore.

English: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
Masaai: Amu ore ina rubata e tomon oo ltung'ana le Israel naitarasaki ninche Olaitoriani anaa olasar, aishoo nanu ile Lawi metaa enjung'ore; metaa atejo nanu ti alo ninche nchere metum enjung'ore ti atua iltung'ana loo siraeli.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, even a tenth part of the tithe.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii, shomo tiaaki ile Lawi, ‘Ti niyaya too ltung'ana le Israel ina matua e tomon naishoo nanu intae te ninche pee eaku enjung'ore inyi nintokiki naa sii intae aaitayu olasar te ina aaisho Olaitoriani, ematua e tomon napukunye ematua e tomon.

English: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
Masaai: Naa keikenari ilo asar linyi anaa entapa o soit oituutishoreki aashu anaa enaisho naing'uaa enkironyet.

English: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.
Masaai: Neaku intarasakiki sii intae Olaitoriani olasar oing'uaa nena matuan inyi e tomon, ning'amumu too ltung'ana le Israel. Naa ore te nena ninchosho ilo asar lo Laitoriani Aron ilo apolosani.

English: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
Masaai: Ore ti atua nena kishorot inyi pooki, entarasai pooki kishoroto naipirakinore Olaitoriani, ina naisul pooki, ninchooyoyo ina naisul pooki.’

English: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
Masaai: Metaa tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Ti nindipidipi aaishooi ilo asar, ina naisul, ore ina naleku neikenakini ile Lawi anaa entoki naing'uaa olkurroto oidong'ishoreki anaa entoki naingua enkironyet oo sabibu;

English: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: nindim iyie ainosa te pooki wueji, iyie o enkaji ino, amu enkishoroto ino te nkaraki enkisiaayiare ino ti atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
Masaai: Niminap iyie eng'oki te nkinosata e ina, indipa iyie aishooi enaisul kake emisarkionie nena tokitin naasinya oo ltung'ana le Israel, pee miyeye ake.’ ”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron,

English: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
Masaai: “Ena enkitanapata naitanapishe Olaitoriani. Tiaaki iltung'ana le Israel pee kiyaki enkashe nanyokie nemeeta eleyiata nemeeta entioto neitu ae kata eenikini enchata emurt.

English: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
Masaai: Nilo aisho ina ashe Eliesa olapolosani, neipang'ieki ninye aaya auluo nepuoi aayieng te dukuya ninye.

English: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
Masaai: Ore Eliesa olapolosani neya embata o sarge le ina ashe to lkimojino lenye, neisuaki embata e ilo sarge dukuya e ilo ng'obor le ntumo katitin naapishana.

English: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
Masaai: Ore ina ashe nepejori, te dukuya ninye, nepejori olchoni lenye, o nkiri enyena, o sarge lenye nepejori sii imoyok enyena;

English: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
Masaai: neya olapolosani nkeek o ltarakwai o mbenek e hisopo, o enkarasha nanyokie nenang'aki empolos eine nepejorieki ina ashe.

English: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina, neituku olapolosani ilkilani lenyena nebukoki kewan enkare, netum taa atijing'a ilng'oborri; kake keton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa.

English: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
Masaai: Ore ilo opejoo ina ashe neituku ilkilani lenyena te nkare neituku osesen lenye te nkare, neton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa.

English: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani osinya nesotu nkuruon e ina ashe nelo apik auluo ilngoborri e ewueji nemetii olduruk; neshumi ninche te nkaraki eumata oo ltung'ana le Israel te nkaraki enkare naitisinyishoreki, te nkitukuoroto oo ng'ok.

English: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiturrur nkuruon e ina ashe neituku ilkarash lenyena neton ninye mesinya o metaa teipa. Naa keaku ena te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel o te nkaraki ilo omoni otamanyishe ti atua ninche, enkitanapata ena oo nkatitin pooki.

English: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
Masaai: “Ore ilo oiseyie olmeneng'ani le likae tung'ani ake ninye, nesarkionu nkolong'i naapishana.

English: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye eituku kewan te nkare te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, pee etum taa atisinyayu; kake te nemeituku ninye kewan te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, nemesinyayu ninye.

English: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie olmeneng'ani, ilo sesen ake ninye lo ltung'ani otua, nemeituku kewan, neiduruku olng'obor lo Laitoriani, ore ilo tung'ani nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie ti atua Israel; enkaraki neitu eisuakini enkare enkitisinyata shumata ninye, keaku ninye mesinya eton olduruk lenye te shumata ninye.

English: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
Masaai: “Ena ninye enkitanapata te neye oltung'ani ti atua olng'obor: ore pooki ng'ae ojing'u atua olng'obor, o pooki ng'ae otii atua olng'obor neaku olemesinya nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki nang'a nemepising'a neiduruku.

English: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ti ong'ata oiseyie ilo otasesekuanaki to lalem, aashu olmeneng'ani, aashu oloito lo ltung'ani, aashu enkurare neaku olemesinya nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
Masaai: Ore te ilo lemesinya nchoo eyae embata oo nkuruon e ilo asar otapejoyioki loo ng'ok, o enkare naruko napiki empirbil;

English: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
Masaai: nelotu taa oltung'ani osinya aitayu mbenek e nchani naji hisopo, neitadoiki atua ina are, neisuaki shumata ilo ng'obor, o shumata imasaa pooki ilorikan o shumata lelo tung'ana ootii ine, o shumata ilo oiseyie oloito, aashu olotasesekuanaki, aashu olotua, aashu enkurare;

English: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
Masaai: ore ilo tung'ani osinya neisuaki ilo tung'ani lemesinya te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana, ore te nkolong e naapishana neitisiny ninye, neituku ninye ilkilani lenyena neituku kewan te nkare, ore pee eaku teipa nesinyayu ninye.

English: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
Masaai: “Kake ore ilo tung'ani lemesinya nemeituku kewan, nedung'ori ilo tung'ani aitung'uaa atua eumata, enkaraki naidurukie ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani; enkaraki neitu ebukokini enkare e enkitisinyata shumata ninye, mesinya ninye.

English: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
Masaai: Naa keaku enkitanapata oo nkatitin pooki te ninche. Ore ilo oisuaaya ina are naitisinyishoreki neituku ilkilani lenyena neaku mesinya o metaa teipa.

English: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
Masaai: Ore entoki pooki naba anaa enaiseyie oltung'ani lemesinya neaku enemesinya; ore pooki ng'ae oiseyie ina neaku oltung'ani le mesinya o metaa teipa.”

English: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel, ina umata pooki, nepuonu ina ong'ata e Sin, to lapa le dukuya, netoni lelo tung'ana te Kadesh; neye Miriam te ine, nenukari ninye te ine.

English: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
Masaai: Nemetii apa enkare naok ina umata; neiturrurro ninche maate aarare Musa nearare Aron.

English: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
Masaai: Neishankarrare lelo tung'ana Musa, nejoki, “Enaikash apa tenaa eikituata ina kata apa pee eye ilalashera lang te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee iyaua ena umata o Laitoriani atua ena ongata, pee kipuonu aaye tene, iyiook o nkishu ang.

English: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
Masaai: Naa kainyoo pee ilepunye iyiook aitupuku te Misiri, ayau iyiook ene wueji torrono? Mme ewueji ene e nkurma, aashu ilng'abolo aashu isabibu aashu ilng'anayio ooji kukumanka; nemetii enkare naoki.”

English: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Aron aaing'uaa ine netii eumata aapuo kutukaji eilo ng'obor le ntumo, nebatata too nkomomi enye. Neliooyu enkitoo o Laitoriani te ninche,

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
Masaai: “Iwa ina ng'udi, nilo aiturrur ina umata, iyie o Aron ilo alashe lino, nijoki ina dapidapoi te dukuya nkonyek enye meishoru enkare; neaku iyau iyie enkare naing'uaa atua endapidapoi te nkaraki ninche; nincho metooko ina umata o nkishu enye.”

English: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
Masaai: Neya Musa ina ng'udi te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
Masaai: Neiturrur Musa o Aron ina umata te nebo te dukuya ina dapidapoi nejoki ninche, “Entoning taata, intae iloogolongu; Aikiyaki iyiook intae enkare naing'uaa ena dapidapoi?”

English: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
Masaai: Neilepie Musa enkaina enye aosh ina dapidapoi te ina ng'udi enye katitin are; nerukunye enkare te nkumoi, neok ina umata, o nkishu enye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron, “Ore enkaraki neitu intae kirukuruku nanu, pee kintisinyinyi nanu too nkonyek e kulo tung'ana le Israel, miyauu naa ena umata aaitijing atua ina kop naishoo ninche.”

English: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.
Masaai: Nkariak e Meriba kuna, naa te ine eishankarrare iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, neitodolu ninye esinyatisho enye te ninche.

English: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
Masaai: Eirriwayie apa Musa ilkiliku te Kadesh meshomo enetii olaiguanani le Edom, nejoki, “Nji ejo olalashe linyi Israel: iyiolo iyie enyamali pooki nikinoto iyiook:

English: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
Masaai: ena kata apa pee epuo loo papa Misiri nikibik iyiook te Misiri enkata naado; ore lelo le Misiri neitaas iyiook entorroni o loo papa;

English: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
Masaai: ore ake pee kinchiraki Olaitoriani, nening ninye oltoilo lang, neirriwaki iyiook olmalaika oilepunye iyiook aitupuku te Misiri, naa noolo iyiook ootii Kadesh, enkanasa natii olpolosie le nkop ino.

English: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
Masaai: Nchoo naa taata iyiook maima atua enkop ino. Mikiimaa iyiook inkurman aashu ilokerin loo sabibu, nimikiok enkare to lchorro; enkoitoi nalala o laiguanani kiim. Mikimbelekenya iyiook aaim enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kedienye, o metaba anaa nikimpang ti atua enkop ino.”

English: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
Masaai: Kake etiaka apa Edom ninye, “Miim iyie enkop ai, maalotu ake aarare to lalem.”

English: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel ninye, “Eikipuo iyiook aaim enkoitoi nalala; naa ti nikiok iyiook enkare ino, nanu o nkishu aainei, nalak nanu; nchooki ake duoo maimai too nkejek, metii ae toki.”

English: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
Masaai: Kake etejo apa ninye, “Mipuopuo intae aaim.” Nelotu Edom aarare ninche eeta iltung'ana kumok, o enjore nagol.

English: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
Masaai: Neaku etanya apa Edom eisho Isirael enkoitoi naaim te nkop enye, nerrinyo Isiraeli aaing'uaa ninye.

English: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aaing'uaa Kadesh, ore lelo tung'ana le Israel ina umata pooki, nepuonu oldoinyo le Hor.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Aron to ldoinyo le Hor, to lpolosie le nkop e Edom,

English: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
Masaai: “Kelo Aron eneiturrurrore iltung'ana lenyena apa ootuata; amu mejing ninye atua ina kop naishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel, amu etogolong'aka apa enkitanapata ai too nkariak e Meriba.

English: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
Masaai: Iwa Aron o Eliesa olayioni lenye niyau ninche enchumata oldoinyo le Hor;

English: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
Masaai: nioru Aron ikilani lenyena ninchopoki Eliesa olayioni lenye; nelo Aron eneiturrurrokino iltung'ana lenyena, naa keye ninye te ine.”

English: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
Masaai: Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, neilep ninche aapuo enchumata oldoinyo le Hor eing'orita ina umata pooki.

English: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
Masaai: Neitayu Musa lelo kilani le Aron, neishopoki Eliesa olayioni lenye; neye Aron te ine te nchumata o ldoinyo. Neitoki Musa o Eliesa aadou te ilo doinyo.

English: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ina umata pooki aajo etua Aron neishiraki enkaji pooki e Israel Aron nkolong'i tomoni uni.

English: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilo Kanaani aiguanani le Arad apa omanya Negeb, nchere eletu Israel aaimu enkoitoi e Afarim, nearare ninye Israel, neibung kulikae lenye araya.

English: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
Masaai: Neinos Israel olmumai to Laitoriani, nejo, “Ti ninchoru iyie ele orere apik enkaina ai, nalo naa nanu aidaikie nkanas enye tukul.”

English: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
Masaai: Nening Olaitoriani oltoilo le Israel, neishooyo lelo le Kanaan; neidaikie Siraeli ninche o nkanas enye. Neaku keji ene wueji Horma.

English: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
Masaai: Nedumunye to ldoinyo le Hor neim enkoitoi Enaiposha Nanyokie, aapuo aamanaa te nkop e Edom; nesi iltung'ana te nkoitoi.

English: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
Masaai: Neiro ninche mbaa torrok ti alo Enkai o Musa. Neing'unyung'uny ninche ejo, “Kainyoo pee iyaua iyiook aitupuku te nkop e Misiri maetu aaye tene tiong'ota? Amu metii endaa nemetii enkare, neitirika iyiook ena daa nemeeta tipat.”

English: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani ilasuriaa oopi atua iltung'ana, neony ninche iltung'ana, o metaa etuata iltung'ana kumok le Israel.

English: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana enetii Musa, nejoki, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, amu kiroro iyiook mbaa torrok ti alo Olaitoriani o tialo iyie; toomono Olaitoriani pee eiwuang'ie ninye ilasuriaa te iyiook.” Neaku etoomonoko Musa iltung'ana.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ntobira olasurai opi nipik shumata eng'ape; ore ake pooki ng'ae oonyi, te neing'or ninye, nepok.”

English: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
Masaai: Neaku eitobirua Musa olasurai lo suyai nepik shumata e ng'ape; naa te nelo neony olasurai likae tung'ani, neing'or ninye ilo asurai lo suyai nepok.

English: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Obot.

English: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye te Obot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Iye-abarim, te ilo purkel oipirare Moab, te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong.

English: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
Masaai: Nedumunye te ine aapuo, neun ilng'oborri to erata le Sared.

English: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
Masaai: Nedumunye te ine aapuo neun ilng'oborri te nkae shoto e Arnon, naa ninye natii ina ongata, olo abaiki olpolosie loo le Amori; amu ore apa Anon naa ninye olpolosie le Moab, te rishata e Moab o le Amori.

English: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
Masaai: Neaku etejoki apa te mbuku oo njorin o Laitoriani, “Waheb te Sufa, o erat le Arnon,

English: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
Masaai: o lelo ooshong'ishong le lelo erat oopuo aabaya entonata e Ari, nepuo o meikobo olpolosie le Moab.”

English: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
Masaai: Nepuo te ine o metabaiki Beeri, aa taa, olchorro apa laa ninye etiakinye Olaitoriani Musa, “Nturrurro iltung'ana te nebo, pee aisho nanu enkare.”

English: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
Masaai: Nerany apa Israel ele sinkolio: “Turukunye, na shorro! - Entaranyaki ninye! -

English: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
Masaai: ena shorro apa natuturo ilkituaak, natoota ilooyanyiti loo ltung'ana, too rinkan lenye le nkitoo o too ng'udisin enye.” Neitoki aadumunye to lpurkel nepuo Matana.

English: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
Masaai: Nedumunye te Matana nepuo Nahaliel, nedumunye te Nahaliel nepuo Bamot,

English: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
Masaai: nedumunye te Bamot nepuo ilo erata otii enkop e Moab, enchumata e Pisga, ine nerumaki kop o lpurkel.

English: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Israel airriwaki Sihon ilkiliku, ilo aiguanani le Amori, ejo,

English: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.
Masaai: “Nchooki nanu maima atua enkop ino; mikimbelekenya iyiook aapuo olokeri aashu enkurma oo sabibu mikiok iyiook enkare enchorro; eikipuo iyiook aaim ina oitoi nalala o laiguanani, o metaba anaa nikimpang ti atua enkop ino.”

English: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
Masaai: Kake etanya Sihon eisho Israel meima atua enkop enye. Neiturrur ninye iltung'ana lenyena pooki te nebo, neipang alo aarare Israel to lpurkel, nebau Yahas, nearare Israel.

English: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
Masaai: Nesesekuan Israel ninye te nepi o lalem, neya enkop enye ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok, o meshomo abaiki ile Amori; amu Yaser apa olpolosie loo le Amori.

English: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
Masaai: Neya Israel nena anas pooki, nemany Israel nena anas pooki oo le Amori, te Heshbon, o nkang'itie enyena pooki kutiti.

English: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
Masaai: Amu Heshbon apa enkanasa e Sihon ilo aiguanani loo le Amori, laa ninye otaarare olaiguanani le dukuya le Moab, neya enkop pooki aitung'uaa ninye, o metabaiki Arnon.

English: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
Masaai: Neaku kejo ilaranyak loo nkatinin, “Wootu Heshbon, nchoo esheti ninye, nchoo enkanasa e Sihon metesheti aaitagol.

English: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
Masaai: Amu eipang'ua enkima te Heshbon, eipang'ua olng'ejep le nkima te nkanasa e Sihon, Eidaikie Ari e Moab, o lkituaak loo neeika e Arnon.

English: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
Masaai: Oi iyie, Moab! Ndaaitie lo tung'ana le Kemosh! Eitaa ninye ilayiok lenyena ilaisikak, neitaa ntoyie enyena iyararot, o laiguanani le Amori, oji Sihon.

English: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
Masaai: Eidaa eishoi enye te Heshbon, o metabaiki Dibon, kindaikie iyiook o metaba anaa nebaiki enkima Medeba.”

English: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
Masaai: Nemany apa Israel enkop oo le Amori.

English: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Musa iltung'ana meshomo aaikitalan Yaser; neya ninche nkang'itie enye kutiti, neiwuang'ie lelo apa le Amori oomanya ine.

English: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaibelekenya neilep aaim enkoitoi e Bashan; ore Oog olaiguanani le Bashan nelotu aarare ninche, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, pee epuo aaitayu olarrabal te Edrei.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani Musa, “Miureyu iyie ninye; amu aishorua nanu ninye apik atua nkaik inono, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, o enkop enye; naa ilo iyie aitaas ninye anaa enintaasa Sihon olaiguanani le Amori, apa omanya Heshbon.”

English: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
Masaai: Neaku etasesekuana apa ninche ninye, o layiok lenyena, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, o metaba anaa neaku meetae obo ataa olaishirani otelekua te ninye; neya ninche ina kop aaitaa enenye.

English: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadumunye, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te ina kop naisiaja e Moab, te lido kekun le Yordan te mbata Yeriko.

English: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
Masaai: Netodua apa Balak olayioni le Sipor nena pooki naaitaasa Isiraeli ile Amori.

English: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neirut oleng Moab te nkaraki iltung'ana, amu eikumok apa oleng; eidimua apa Moab enkuretisho eure iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
Masaai: Nejoki Moab lelo payiani le Midian, “Kemeju taata ele orora pooki toki namanita iyiook, anaa enameju olkiteng nkujit e ong'ata.” Neaku ore apa Balak olayioni le Sipor, laa ninye apa olaiguanani le Moab te ina kata,

English: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
Masaai: neirriwaki Balak ilkiliku Balaam olayioni le Beor te Peter, apa aa ninye nataaniki Olkeju, ti atua enkop e Amawa pee eipotu ninye, ajoki, “Ng'ura, eileputua olorere te Misiri; oitoipo oriong olchoni le nkop, naaetuo aatalakinore te manyisho.

English: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
Masaai: Wou naa taata, tediaa kulo tung'ana enkaraki nanu, amu eimagil ninche te nanu; abaiki namir nanu ninche naidurrie nanu ninche tena kop; amu ayiolo nanu ajo ore ilo limayian iyie nemayiana ore ilo lidek netediaki.”

English: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
Masaai: Nepuo ilpayiani le Moab o lpayiani le Midian eibung'ita mpisai naalakieki enaibon too nkaik enye; nepuonu ninche enetii Balaam, neisho ninye olkilikuai le Balak.

English: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Erraga ene ena kewarie, amu kayaki nanu intae olomoni anaa enaairorie nanu Olaitoriani;” neaku etotoni apa lelo kituaak le Moab te nebo Balaam.

English: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
Masaai: Nelotu Enkai enetii Balaam nejoki, “Kakua tung'ana kulo ootii te nebo iyie?”

English: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam Enkai, “Balak olayioni le Sipor, olaiguanani le Moab ninye laairriwaka ejo,

English: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
Masaai: ‘Ng'ura eileputua olorere te Misiri neiput oriong olchoni le nkop; wou naa taata tediaa te nkaraki nanu; abaiki naarare nanu ninche naidurrie ninche.’ ”

English: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai Balam, “Milo iyie te nebo ninche; midek iyie kulo tung'ana, amu kemayiana ninche.”

English: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
Masaai: Neinyototo Balam tadekenya, nejoki lelo kituaak le Balak, “Enchom enkop inyi, amu etanya Olaitoriani alo te nebo intae.”

English: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye lelo kituaak le Moab nepuo enetii Balak, nejoki. “Etanya Balaam elotu te nebo iyiook.”

English: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
Masaai: Neigil ake Balak airriwaa ilkituaak, iltung'ana kumok neyanyit alang lelo le dukuya.

English: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche enetii Balaam nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Balak olayioni le Sipor: ‘Mincho kimbooyo ae toki eitu ilotu enatii;

English: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
Masaai: amu esipa kaaisho nanu iyie enkanyit kitok, ore entoki pooki naba anaa enikijoki iyie naa kaas; wou tediaa ele orere te nkaraki nanu.’ ”

English: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
Masaai: Kake etawala apa Balaam ajoki lelo sinkan le Balak, “Ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa kaaisho Balak enkaji enye ebore enkosholai o sahabu, maidim nanu ashomo atogiroi enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai ai, aitodorropu aasho aitulus.

English: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.
Masaai: Atoomono naa intae, enyaaki erraga ene ena kewarie, pee atum atayiolo enaaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu.”

English: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
Masaai: Nelotu Enkai enetii Balaam kewarie nejoki ninye, “Tenaa eikietuo lelo tung'ana aaipot iyie, inyo, shomo te nebo ninche; kake ina ake naajoki iyie, ninye taasa.”

English: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa Balaam tadekenya, neirot esikiria enye, nelo te nebo lelo kituaak le Moab.

English: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
Masaai: Kake eyupuyupo engoro e Nkai te nkaraki nashomo ninye; nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkoitoi anaa olmangatinta lenye. Nekedito apa Balaam osikiria, netii isinkan lenyena oare te nebo ninye.

English: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
Masaai: Nedol ilo sikiria olmalaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te nkoitoi eeta enchutati olalem te nkaina enye; neibelekenya ina sikiria apaash enkoitoi, nelo ong'ata; neosh Balaam ina sikiria aboiniki enkoitoi.

English: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani alo aitashe to lgos le nkoitoi napirik, terishata oo sabibu, netii ake esuntai pooki shoto.

English: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ina sikiria ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, nelo arepaa esuntai, nepudaki enkeju e Balaam esuntai; neitoki ninye aosh.

English: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aigut alo dukuya, nelo aitashe te wueji ronkai te nkoitoi, nemetii ewueji neibelekenyakino te nkalo e tatene aashu te nkalo e kedienye.

English: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ina sikiria olmalaika lo Laitoriani, neirrag te nkop ti abori Balaam; neyupuyup engoro e Balaam, neosh ninye ina sikiria te ng'udi enye.

English: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
Masaai: Nebol Olaitoriani enkutuk e ina sikiria, nejoki ninye Balaam, “Kainyoo nanu aaitaasa iyie, pee kitoosho iyie nanu katitin uni?”

English: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam ina sikiria, “Enkaraki nikigira iyie aiguranie nanu. Enyor napaji naa kaata olalem, pee aatum atara iyie tua.”

English: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
Masaai: Nejoki ina sikiria Balaam, “Emara nanu esikiria ino, naa ninye intakedo te nkishui ino pooki o metabaiki ena olong? Katamoo nanu aaitaas iyie ena?” Nejoki Balaam, “A-a.”

English: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
Masaai: Nebol Olaitoriani nkonyek e Balaam, nedol ninye ilo malaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te nkoitoi eeta enchutati o lalem te nkaina enye; neirrug Balaam endukuya enye, nebatata te nkomom.

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee itoosho esikiria ino kuna katitin uni? Ng'ura, aewuo nanu pee aaibooyo amu ore enkoitoi ino naa kepaashare enkoitoi ai;

English: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
Masaai: naatoduaa nanu ena sikiria, naaibelekenya apaash nanu kuna katitin pokira uni. Te neme kaaibelekenye ninye apaash, esipa, anaata aatara iyie tua napal ninye eishu.”

English: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam ajoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki, amu eitu nanu ayiolou ajo itii enkoitoi pee kimbooyo nanu. Ore naa taata, tenaa embae torrono ena too nkonyek inono, karrinyo nanu alo.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Balaam, “Shomo iyie te nebo kulo tung'ana; kake ilo rorei ake laaliki ninye shomo iroro.” Neaku eshomo apa Balaam te nebo lelo kituaak le Balak.

English: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Balak nchere eewuo Balaam, neipang ninye alo anang'are ninye te nkanasa e Moab, te ilo polosie oitayu olkeju te Arnon, te ilo polosie kewan.

English: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
Masaai: Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Keitu nanu airriu ilkiliku pee kimpoti iyie? Kainyoo pee eitu iyie ilotu enatii? Eimaaidim nanu ayanyita iyie?” Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Oi, aewuo nanu enitii?

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
Masaai: Keton nanu aata ae golon nairorie ai toki? Ilo rorei opik Enkai enkutuk ai, ninye nanu airo.”

English: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
Masaai: Nelo Balaam te nebo Balak, nepuonu Kariat-husot.

English: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
Masaai: Nepolos Balak ilmong'i o ntare, neyaki Balaam o lelo kituaak ootii te nebo ninye.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nerik Balak Balaam o metabaiki Bamotbaal; ore te ine nedol ninye emurte nataaniki oo ltung'ana.

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam ajoki Balak, “Teshetakaki nanu ilperereni oopishana lo lasar tene, nikincho nanu iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana.”

English: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
Masaai: Neas Balak anaa ina natejo Balaam; ore Balak o Balaam neishoru ake to lperere lo lasar oloing'oni o lmeregesh.

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam ajoki Balak, “Ntasho te mbata o lasar lino opejori, mashomo nanu, eidimayu naalotu nanu Olaitoriani atumore; naa ore pooki naba anaa enaaitodol nanu naaliki iyie.” Neilep ninye alo ewueji neisiaja neika.

English: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
Masaai: Netumore Enkai Balaam; nejoki Balaam ninye, “Aitobira ilperereni lo lasar oopishana, naishorua nanu te nchumata e pooki perere, oloing'oni o lmeregesh.”

English: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
Masaai: Nepik Olaitoriani ororei enkutuk e Balaam, nejoki ninye, “Torrinyoyu iyie shomo enetii Balak, naa nji shomo tiaki.”

English: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
Masaai: Nerrinyo ninye alo enetii ninye, naa ng'ura, eitashe ninye te nebo ilkituaak pooki le Moab te mbata e ilo asar lenye opejori.

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
Masaai: Neraposhoki Balaam ajo, “Te Aram aaipoto nanu Balak, ilo aiguanani le Moab oing'uaa ildoinyio lo loo saen: ‘Wou tediaa Yakobo enkaraki nanu, naa wou ilepilepaki Israel!’

English: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?
Masaai: Kaji nanu aiko te nadek ilo leitu edek Enkai? Kaji nanu aiko te nailepilepaki ilo leitu eilepilepaki Enkai?

English: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
Masaai: Amu ore too nchumat oo ldoinyo nadol nanu ninye, te nchumata oo ndoinyo aing'or nanu ninye; ng'ura, olorere ninche ootoni o openy, nemeitushulaki ninche ate kulikae oreren!

English: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
Masaai: Kaing'ae naidim aikena nkera e Yakobo naaba anaa enterit, aashu ematua e ong'uan e Israel? Ntasho matua nanu keeya o ltung'ani supat, naa nchoo enkiting'oto ai etiu anaa enenye!”

English: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
Masaai: Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Kainyoo ena nikintaasa iyie nanu? Aayawua iyie pee ilotu adek ilmang'ati laainei, naa ng'ura, meeta ae nitaasa eitamayiana ake.”

English: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
Masaai: Newal ninye ajo, “Eimaning nanu nairo ina natipika Olaitoriani atua enkutuk ai?”

English: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
Masaai: Nejoki Balak ninye, “Wou te nebo nanu maape dikai wueji, nindimie iyie atodolie ninche; idol iyie emurte nabayie te ninche, kake midol ninche pooki; pee itum iyie atediaa ninche enkaraki nanu te ine.”

English: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
Masaai: Nerik ninye ong'ata e Sifim, o meitabaiki enchumata e Pisga, neshet ilperereni oopishana lo lasar neishoru ake oloing'oni o lmeregesh to lperere ake pooki lo lasar.

English: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Ntasho tene te mbata o lasar lino opejori, mashomo atumore Olaitoriani te idie.”

English: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
Masaai: Netumore Olaitoriani Balaam, nepik ororei enkutuk enye, nejo ninye, “Torrinyokinoyu Balak, naa nji shomo tiaki.”

English: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
Masaai: Nelo enetii ninye, naa ng'ura, eitashe ninye te mbata o lasar lenye opejori, o lkituaak le Moab te nebo ninye. Nejoki Balak ninye, “Kainyoo etejo Olaitoriani?”

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam araposhoki, nejo, “Inyo, Balak, toning'o; toning'oki nanu ara Sipor:

English: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
Masaai: Mme oltung'ani Enkai, eji metaa kelejisho, aashu enkerai e tung'ani eji metaa keirridu. Amaa, keiro ninye nemeitabaya? aashu kelimu ninye nemeas?

English: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, atang'amua nanu enkitanapata pee amayianisho; etamayianishe ninye, nemalak nanu.

English: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
Masaai: Eitu ninye eing'or olbuket le Yakobo; neitu ninye edol entorroni te Israel. Etii Olaitoriani Enkai enye te nebo ninche, ore embuakunoto o laiguanani netii te nebo ninche.

English: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
Masaai: Eyawua Enkai ninche aitung'uaa Misiri, netiu apa ninche anaa loata imouarak olosokuan.

English: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
Masaai: Meetae eushei ti alo Yakobo, metii esakut ti alo Israel; kepuoi taata aajo ti alo Yakobo o Israel, ‘Kaa etaasa Enkai!’

English: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ele orere! Eilepa anaa elipong o lng'atuny, edumunye anaa olng'atuny odumunye; nemeirrag ninye o metaba anaa neinos ina ng'ues narreshito, neok osarge le ina natasesekuanaki.”

English: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
Masaai: Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Midek ninche katukul, nimimayian ninche katukul.”

English: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Balaam Balak ajoki, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie inchere, ‘Ore pooki naajoki Olaitoriani, naa ina ake aas?’ ”

English: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
Masaai: Nejoki Balak Balaam, “Wou taata maatoriko nanu dikai wueji; amu ebaiki neitiship ine Enkai pee idek iyie ninche te nkaraki nanu.”

English: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
Masaai: Nerik Balak Balaam enchumata o ldoinyo le Peor ine netalita olpurkel.

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Teshetakaki nanu tene ilperereni oopishana lo lasar, nikincho nanu tene iloing'ok oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana.”

English: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
Masaai: Neas Balak anaa enatiaka Balaam, neishooyo ninye oloing'oni o lmeregesh te pooki perere lo lasar.

English: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Balaam nchere keitiship Olaitoriani te nemayian ninye Israel, neitu ninye elo, anaa te kulie katitin, aing'oru ntaleng'o, kake eipirie ninye enkomom enye olpurkel.

English: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
Masaai: Neshumu Balaam nkonyek enyena, nedol Israel etii ilng'oborri, anaa loshon. Nelotu Enkiyang'et e Nkai shumata ninye,

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
Masaai: neraposhoki ninye, nejo, “Irorei le Balaam olayioni le Beor, irorei le ilo tung'ani otaboloki nkong'u enye,

English: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
Masaai: irorei le ilo oning irorei le Nkai, ilo odol enduata o Laidimani, otabatate, kake meimulumul nkonyek enyena:

English: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
Masaai: kebaa enkishiaa oo lng'oborri linono, iyie Yakobo, o emanyisho ino, iyie Israel!

English: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
Masaai: Eikununo anaa ierat oopuo eniado, anaa nkurman naatii embata e wuaso, enyaanyukie o sugoroi otuno Olaitoriani, eikununo anaa iltarakua ootii embata e nkare.

English: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
Masaai: Kedooyo enkare too ltooi lenyena, ore olantererai lenye neaku nkariak kumok etii, ore olaiguanani lenye naa ninye olusoo alang Agag, ore enkitoo enye naa kebul.

English: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
Masaai: Eyawua Enkai ninye aitupuku te Misiri; netiu ninye anaa oloata mouarak o losokuan, kelo ninye aijoo lelo oshon mang'ati lenyena, negil iloik lenye aitaa mbelibelat, neng'or ninche too mbaa enyena.

English: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
Masaai: Eirraga ninye anaa olng'atuny, naa amaa, amu eikununo anaa elipong o lng'atuny, aing'ae olo ainyeyie ninye? Emayiana pooki ng'ae likimayian iyie, nediaa pooki ng'ae likidek iyie.”

English: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro e Balak ti alo Balaam, neosh ninye nkaik, neitoki Balak ajoki Balaam, “Aaipotuo nanu iyie pee ilotu adek ilmang'ati laainei, naa ng'ura, itamayiana iyie ninche kuna katitin pokira uni.

English: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
Masaai: Ore naa taata isika shomo ewueji ino; atejo apa nanu, ‘Kaanyanyit iyie,’ kake kimboo Olaitoriani amitiki enkanyit.”

English: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Balaam Balak, “Keitu apa nanu ajoki lelo kiliku linono likirriwaka nanu,

English: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?
Masaai: ‘Tenaa napaji ninye kaaisho Balak enkaji enye ebore enkosholai o sahabu, nemaidim ake ashomo atapaasha ororei lo Laitoriani, aas esidai aashu entorrono te yieunoto ai makewan, ore ina najo Olaitoriani naa ina nanu airo?’

English: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
Masaai: Ore naa, ng'ura, kalo nanu enetii iltung'ana laainei; wou, pee aaliki nanu enepuo kulo tung'ana aaitaas iltung'ana linyi, too nkolong'i e siadi.”

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
Masaai: Neitoki ninye araposhoki, nejo, “Irorei le Balaam olayioni le Beor, irorei lo ltung'ani otaboloki enkong'u enye,

English: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
Masaai: irorei le ilo oning irorei le Nkai, neyiolo eng'eno e Ilo otii shumata Aisul ilo odol enduata o Laidimani, ilo obatata, kake eitu eimulumul nkonyek enyena.

English: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
Masaai: Adolita nanu ninye, kake mme tena kata; adolita ninye, kake mme taana; eipang'ua olakira ti atua Yakobo, naa keilepu eng'udi enkitoo te Israel; kedany ninye olpura le nkomom le Moab. negiligil ilayiok pooki le Sheti.

English: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
Masaai: Kepuoi aaya Edom, ore Seir, ilmang'ati lenyena naa kepuoi aaya, eitobirari ninye Israel aisulu,

English: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
Masaai: Te Yakobo easisho engolon e nkitoo, ore lelo aishirak too nkanas neidaikieki!”

English: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aing'or Amalek, neraposhoki ajo, “Amalek apa olayioni le dukuya loo loshon, kake ore te siadi naa keidaikieki.”

English: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
Masaai: Neitoki aing'or ile Kain, neraposhoki, nejo, “Kegol neserian ina manyisho ino, ore enkaji netipikaki enchumata endapidapoi;

English: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, keidaikieki Kain. Kenkata kenya nabaa kiyaita Ashur aaraya?”

English: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
Masaai: Neitoki araposhoki ajo, “Amaa, kaing'ae kenya elekuni te neas Enkai ena?

English: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
Masaai: Kake kepuonu imelin naaing'uaa Kitim, naa kepuonu aaisilisil Ashur o Eber; kake kelo ake sii ninye aidak.”

English: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
Masaai: Neitoki Balaam adumunye nelo ewueji enye; nelo sii Balak te nkoitoi enye.

English: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata emanya Israel Shitim neiteru iltung'ana aaiborrie onyek too ntoyie e Moab.

English: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
Masaai: Ore kuna ng'oruo neitoomon iltung'ana too lasarri loo nkaitin enye, neinos iltung'ana, neirrugokino inkaitin enye.

English: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eteenikia Israel kewan Baal e Peor. Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani ti alo Israel;

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Iwa lelo arikok pooki loo ltung'ana, ililio ninche to ldalati te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee etum ina goro napi o Laitoriani atapaasha Israel.”
