English: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa lelo arishak le Israel, “Nchoo ake pooki ng'ae te intae esesekuan oltung'ani lenye oteenikia kewan esinkaisho e Baal e Peor.”

English: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore oltung'ani obo loo ltung'ana le Israel, nelotu ayau enkitok e Midian atua olmarei lenye, too nkonyek e Musa o too nkonyek e ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel ina kata apa eishirita ninche te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Finehas olayioni le Eliesa, ilo ayioni le Aron olapolosani, nedumunye ninye alo aing'uaa ilo turrur, nedumu empere te nkaina enye

English: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
Masaai: nelo asujaa ilo tung'ani le Israel o meshomo olgilata li atua, nerem pokira are, ilo tung'ani le Israel o ina kitok, aipang'ie empere to sesen lenye. Ina taa pee eiwuang'ieki olmeitai too ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, lelo apa ootuata to lmeitai naa nkalifuni tikitam o ong'uan.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
Masaai: “Ore Finehas, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron olapolosani, neiwuang'ie engoro ai too laiguanani nchere eeta ninye olom lai ti atua ninche, metaa eitu nanu amut iltung'ana le Israel to lom lai.

English: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
Masaai: Metaa tejo, ‘Ng'ura, kaisho nanu ninye osotua lai le seriani;

English: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
Masaai: naa keaku te ninye o te ishoi enye, te siadi ninye, ilo ning'o lo sotua le mpolosare e anaake, enkaraki naata ninye olom te nkaraki Enkai enye, neitobira olning'o lo sotua too ltung'ana le Israel!’ ”

English: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e ilo tung'ani le Israel otasesekuanaki te nebo enkitok e Midian, naa Simri olayioni le Salu, laa endukuya enkaji oo loo menye le nkaji oo le Simeon.

English: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e ina kitok e Midian natasesekuanaki naa Kosbi entito e Suri, naa ninye apa endukuya o lorere le nkaji oo loo e menye te Midian.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
Masaai: “Ntanyamala ile Midian, niosh aar ninche;

English: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
Masaai: amu kintanyamala ninche iyie te nkeleekisho enye, amu ninye etelejie intae te ina bae e Peor, o te ina bae e Kosbi, ina tito o lkitok le Midian, ina anashe enye apa nataraki metua te nkolong o lmeitai te mbae e Peor.”

English: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie ilo meitai nejoki Olaitoriani Musa o Eliesa olayioni le Aron olapolosani,

English: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
Masaai: “Enkena ina umata pooki, oo ltung'ana le Israel, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, too nkajijik oo loo menye, pooki ti atua Siraeli ooidim aashom enjore.”

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neirorie ninche too nkisiajat e Moab te mbata o lkeju le Yordan te Yeriko, ejo,

English: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: “Enkena iltung'ana, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep,” anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa. Ore lelo tung'ana le Israel ooetuo aaipang'u te nkop e Misiri, naa:

English: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
Masaai: Ruben ilo kikau le Israel; ilayiok le Ruben, ile Hanok, ilo marei loo le Hanok; le Palu, olmarei loo le Palu;

English: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
Masaai: ile Hesron, olmarei loo le Hesron; ile Karmi, olmarei loo le Karmi.

English: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Ruben; ore esiana enye naa nkalifuni artam o okuni o iip naapishana o tomoni uni.

English: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Palu naa: Eliab.

English: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Eliab naa: Nemuel, Datan o Abiram. Kulo apa, Datan o Abiram etegeluaki te umata, ootekeshare Musa o Aron to lturrur le Kora, ina kata apa pee ekeshare ninche Olaitoriani,

English: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
Masaai: neng'a enkop enkutuk enye neijoo ninche te nebo Kora, ore ake eye ilo turrur, ore ake pee emut enkima iltung'ana iip are o onom, neaku ninche enkikoo.

English: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
Masaai: Ore ake etiu ina, eitu eye ilayiok le Kora.

English: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Nemuel, olmarei loo le Nemuel; ile Yamin, olmarei loo le Yamin, ile Yakin, olmarei loo le Yakin;

English: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
Masaai: ile Sera, olmarei loo le Sera; ile Shaul, olmarei loo le Shaul.

English: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Simeon, nkalifuni tikitam o are o iip o are.

English: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Gad to risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Sefon, oo lmarei loo le Sefon, ile Hagi, olmarei loo le Hagi, ile Shuni, olmarei loo le Shuni;

English: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
Masaai: ile Osini, olmarei loo le Osini, ile Eri, olmarei loo le Eri;

English: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
Masaai: ile Arod, olmarei loo le Arod; ile Areli, olmarei loo le Areli.

English: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Gad, te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni artam o iip imiet.

English: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yuda naa Eri o Onan; netuata apa Eri o Onan te nkop e Kanaan.

English: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye naa: ile Shela, olmarei loo le Shela; ile Peres, olmarei loo le Peres, ile Sera, olmarei loo le Sera.

English: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Peres naa: ile Hesron, olmarei loo le Hesron; ile Hamul, olmarei loo le Hamul.

English: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche ilmareita le Yuda te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o ile o iip imiet.

English: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Isaakar te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Tola, olmarei loo le Tola; ile Puni, olmarei loo le Puni;

English: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
Masaai: ile Yashub, olmarei loo le Yashub; ile Shimron, olmarei loo le Shimron.

English: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche ilmareita le Isaakar te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni ntomoni ile o ong'uan o iip uni.

English: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Sebulon te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Sered, olmarei loo le Sered, ile Elon, olmarei loo le Elon; ile Yaleel, olmarei loo le Yaleel.

English: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Sebulon te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni ntomoni ile o iip imiet.

English: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yosef te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: Manase o Efraim.

English: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Manase: ile Makir, olmarei loo le Makir, naa Makir apa ninye menye le Gilead. Ile Gilead, olmarei loo le Gilead.

English: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Gilead: Ileseri; ile Heler, olmarei loo le Heler, ile Helek o lmarei loo le Helek,

English: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
Masaai: ile Asiriel, olmarei loo le Asiriel; o le Shekem, olmarei loo le Shekem,

English: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
Masaai: o le Shemida, olmarei loo le Shemida; o le Heper, olmarei loo le Heper.

English: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore apa Selofehad olayioni le Heper meeta ilayiok, kake keeta ntoyie; ore nkarn oo ntoyie e Selofehad naa Mahala, o Noa, o Hogla, O Milka, o Tirsa.

English: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo le Manase, ore esiana enye naa nkalifuni onom o oare o iip naapishana.

English: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Efraim te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ile Shutela, olmarei loo le Shutela; ile Bekeri, olmarei loo le Bekeri; ile Tahani; olmarei loo le Tahani.

English: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
Masaai: Naa kulo ninche ilayiok le Shutela; ile Erani, olmarei loo le Erani.

English: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Efraim te risioroto e siana enye, nkalifuni tomoni uni oare o iip imiet. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yosef te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Bela; ile Ashebel, olmarei loo le Ashbel; ile Ahiram, olmareita loo le Ahiram;

English: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
Masaai: ile Shefufam, olmarei loo le Shefufam; ile Hufam, olmareita loo le Hufam.

English: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Bela naa Ardi o Naaman: ile Ardi, olmareita loo le Ardi; ile Naaman, olmarei loo le Naaman.

English: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ore esiana enye naa nkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ile.

English: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Dan te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Shuham, olmarei loo le Shuham. Kulo ninche ilmareita le Dan te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita pooki loo le Shuham, te risioroto e siana enye, naa nkalifuni ntomoni ile o ong'uan o iip ong'uan.

English: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Asheri te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Imna, olmarei loo le Imna; ile Ishfi; olmarei loo le Ishfi; ile Beria, olmarei loo le Beria.

English: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Beria: ile Heberi, olmarei loo le Heberi; ile Malkiel, olmarei loo le Malkiel.

English: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
Masaai: Ore enkarna e ntito e Asheri naa Sera.

English: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita loo layiok le Asheri te risioroto e siana enye nkalifuni onom o okuni o iip ong'uan.

English: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Naftali te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Yaseel, olmarei loo le Yaseel; ile Guni, olmarei loo le Guni;

English: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
Masaai: ile Yeser, olmarei loo le Yeser; ile Shilem, olmarei loo le Shilem.

English: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita le Naftali te risioroto oo lmareita lenye; ore esiana enye naa nkalifuni artam o imiet o iip ong'uan.

English: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Ena apa esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel, nkalifuni iip ile o obo o iip naapishana o tomoni uni.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa;

English: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
Masaai: “Keorikini kulo tung'ana enkop pee eaku enjung'ore, te risioroto e siana oo nkarn.

English: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
Masaai: Ore olosho sapuk nchoo enjung'ore sapuk, ore olosho oti nchoo enjung'ore kiti; ore pooki osho neishori ake enjung'ore enye te risioroto e siana enye.

English: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
Masaai: Kake keoshokini ina kop enkukuo; te risioroto oo nkarn oo loshon loo loo menye enjung ninche.

English: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
Masaai: Keori ina jung'ore enye te risioroto e nkukuo to losho sapuk o to loti.”

English: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ile Lawi anaa enaikenaki te risioroto oo lmareita lenye: ile Gershon, olmarei loo le Gershon; ile Kohat, olmarei loo le Kohat; ile Merari, olmarei loo le Merari.

English: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilmareita le Lawi: olmarei loo le Libni, olmarei loo le Hebron, olmarei loo le Mala, olmarei loo le Mushi, olmarei loo le Kora. Naa Kohat apa menye le Amram.

English: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
Masaai: Ore apa enkitok e Amram naa keji Yokebed, entito e Lawi, apa natoikioki Lawi te Misiri; neiki ninye Amram Aron o Musa o Miriam enkanashe enye.

English: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Ore to lmarei le Aron neini Nadab, o Abihu, o Eliesa o Itamar.

English: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
Masaai: Kake etua apa Nadab o Abihu ina kata apa pee eitarasaki enkima nemesinya Olaitoriani.

English: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ooikenaki te ninche naa nkalifuni tikitam o okuni, pooki lee lo lari obo neilep; amu eitu apa eikeni ninche te nebo iltung'ana le Israel, amu meetae apa enjung'ore naishooki ninche te nebo iltung'ana le Israel.

English: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche lelo ooikena Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, laa ninche esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel too nkisiajat e Moab te mbata olkeju le Yordan te Yeriko.

English: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: Kake ore ti atua kulo metii hoo oltung'ani oikena Musa aashu Aron ilo apolosani, apa oikena iltung'ana le Israel ti ong'ata e Sinai.

English: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Masaai: Amu etiaka Olaitoriani ninche, “Kepuo ninche aaye tiong'ota.” Eitu apa eleku oltung'ani te ninche, Kaleb ake olayioni le Yefune o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
Masaai: Neitoki aanyiku nena toyie e Selofehad olayioni le Hefer, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Makir, olayioni le Manase, olayioni le Yosef. Ore apa nkarn e nena toyie enyena naa: Mahala, o Noa, o Hogla, o Milka, o Tirsa.

English: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
Masaai: Neitashe ninche te dukuya Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, o te dukuya lelo arikok o ina umata, te kutukaji e ilo ng'obor le ntumo, ejo,

English: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
Masaai: “Etua apa papa lang tiong'ota; metii apa ninye ina umata, e lelo ooiturrurrote aapaashare Olaitoriani te ncholuek e Kora, kake etua te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan; nemeeta apa layiok.

English: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eiwuang'ieki enkarna e papa lang to lmarei lenye, enkaraki nemeeta olayioni? Nchoo iyiook erubata ti atua ilalashera le papa.”

English: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau Musa ilo omoni lenye dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
Masaai: “Etisipa nena toyie e Selofehad; nchoo ninche erubata e njung'ore ti atua ilalashera le menye, nincho ina jung'ore e menye lenye meshomo aaku enenye,

English: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Te neye oltung'ani, nemeeta olayioni, nincho enjung'ore enye meshomo aaku ene ntito enye.

English: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
Masaai: Naa te nemeeta entito, nincho enjung'ore enye eaku enoo lalashera lenyena.

English: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
Masaai: Naa te nemeeta lalashera, nincho naa enjung'ore enye ilalashera le menye.

English: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Naa te nemeeta menye lalashera nincho naa enjung'ore enye oltung'ani lenye, laa ninye onyikare olmarei lenye, pee eya ninye. Naa keaku ena too ltung'ana le Israel enkitanapata o enkikoo, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.’ ”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ilepa shomo enchumata ele doinyo le Abarim, pee idol ena kop naishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee indip atoduaa ninye, nintoki sii iyie alo eneiturrure iltung'ana linono apa ootuata anaa apa enashomo olalashe lino Aron,

English: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
Masaai: enkaraki nitogolong'aka ororei lai ti ong'ata e Sin, ina kata apa eing'unyung'uny eumata maayanyit aaitisiny nanu te nena ariak apa naatii dukuya nkonyek enye. (Nkariak kuna e Meriba e Kadesh tiong'ata e Sin.)

English: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Musa Olaitoriani,

English: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
Masaai: “Nchoo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo nkiyang'eta e pooki naaishu, egelu oltung'ani oitasheiki ena umata,

English: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
Masaai: oipang alo dukuya ninche, nejing'u alotu te dukuya ninche, orikoo ninche aipang'ie neriku ninche aitijing'u; pee metiu eumata o Laitoriani anaa nkerra nemeeta olchekut.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Iwa Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo tung'ani otii enkiyang'et atua ninye, ninteleiki nkaik shumata ninye;

English: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
Masaai: nchoo ninye meitasho te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani o ina umata pooki, nintanap aisho enkitoo te dukuya ninche.

English: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
Masaai: Nchopoki ninye embata e nkitoria ino, pee etum eumata pooki oo ltung'ana le Israel aatoning.

English: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
Masaai: Naa keitashe ninye te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani, laa ninye oikilikuanisho te nkaraki ninye, te nkiguana e Urim te dukuya Olaitoriani; to rorei lenye eipang ninche aapuo naa to rorei lenye ninche ejin'u atua, ninye o ltung'ana pooki le Israel ootii te nebo ninye, ina umata pooki.”

English: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
Masaai: Neas Musa anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani; neya ninye Yoshua neitasheyie ninye te dukuya Eliesa ilo apolosani, o ina umata pooki,

English: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: neiteleiki ninye nkaik enyena shumata ninye, neitanap ninye aisho enkitoo anaa enatuutua Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel, tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore olasar lai, endaa ai too lasarri laainei le nkima, esong'ouna ai narropil, embung'a pee kintarasakiki nanu te rishata enye.’

English: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
Masaai: Naa tiaaki iyie ninche, Olasar le nkima ele linchosho intae Olaitoriani: isitiman oare le kerra lo lari obo, lemeeta entibili, anaake, pee eaku olasar loo nkolong'i pooki.

English: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
Masaai: Ore olkuo obo nipolososo tadekenya, ore olikae kuo nipolososo teipa;

English: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
Masaai: ore ematua e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui nintayuyu pee eaku olasar le ntapa, naipurjaki te matua e ong'uan e hini e ilata naidong'oki.

English: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: Olasar ele opejori anaake, apa oitanapishoteki to ldoinyo le Sinai, te nkaraki esong'ouna narropil, olasar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani.

English: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.
Masaai: Ore olasar ooki naa erubata nabo e ong'uan e hini to sitima ake obo; te ine wueji sinyati shomo tipika ilo asar ooki oirrusha nchoo Olaitoriani.

English: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore olikae kuoo shomo topolosa teipa, anaa ilo asar le ntapa le tadekenya, o anaa ilo asar ooki, shomo nchooi anaa olasar le nkima, esong'ouna nerropil te nkaraki Olaitoriani.

English: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e sabato naa isitiman oare le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto, o ematua e are e tomon e Efa e ntapa napuyiapui pee eaku olasar le ntapa, eipurjaki te ilata o ilo asar lenye ooki:

English: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: ele ninye olasar opejori le pooki olong e sabato, te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar ooki.

English: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
Masaai: “Ore too nkiterunot oo lapaitin linyi ninchooyoyo olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani: iloing'ok oare ooti, o lmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto;

English: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
Masaai: o matuan uni e tomon e efa e ntapa napuyiapui pee eaku olasar le ntapa, naipurjaki te ilata, te pooki oing'oni, o matuan are e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata to lmeregesh obo;

English: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: o ematua nabo e tomon e ntapa napuyiapui naipurjaki te ilata anaa olasar le ntapa to lkuoo ake obo le ker; pee eaku olasar opejori le song'ouna narropil; olasar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani.

English: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
Masaai: Ore olasar lenye ooki naa keaku olpisiai le hini le naisho oo sabibu to loing'oni ake obo o entemata e uni e hini to lmeregesh, naa entemata e uni e ong'uan e hini to lkuoo le ker; ele ninye olasar opejori te pooki apa too lapaitin pooki lo lari

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: o sitima obo sii le kine te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki oishori Olaitoriani; keitayuni ninye te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan olapa le dukuya naa pasaka o Laitoriani.

English: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet ele apa naa o sirua; nkolong'i naapishana einosi imukateni neitu eisuishieki.

English: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya naa keaku eumata sinyati: mias esiaai e sinkaisho,

English: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
Masaai: kake enchooi olasar le nkima, olasar opejori te nkaraki Olaitoriani: iloing'ok oare ooti, olmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo; toduaa nchere meeta entioto;

English: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
Masaai: o lasarri sii lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata; imatuan uni e efa te tomon nchooi to loingoni obo, o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh;

English: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
Masaai: nchooi ematua nabo e tomon te pooki meregesh le lelo oopishana;

English: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine pee eaku olasar le ng'oki pee eitayunyeki olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki iyie.

English: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
Masaai: Nchooi iyie kuna te nebo olasar opejori le tadekenya, laa olasar le mpejoroto le anaake.

English: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: Naa te ina oitoi ake inchooi anaake, too nkolong'i naapishana, ina daa o lasar opejori te nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; keitarasari ninye te nebo ilo asar le anaake o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkolong e naapishana nimbung'ubung'u eumata nasinya; nimiasiasa esiaai nagol.

English: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong oo lng'anayio le dukuya, ti ninchooyo iyie olasar le ntapa te nkaraki entapa ng'ejuk naishori Olaitoriani, te ilo sirua linyi loo wikii, ninturrurrorro aaibung eumata sinyati; nimiasiasa esiaai nagol,

English: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
Masaai: kake entarasai olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani: iloing'ok oare ooti, o lmeregesh obo, isitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo;

English: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
Masaai: o lasar le ntapa napuyiapui, naipurja te ilata, o matuan uni e tomon e efa to loing'oni ake obo, o matuan are e tomon e efa to lmeregesh,

English: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
Masaai: o ematua nabo e tomon te pooki ake ninye sitima le ker le lelo oopishana;

English: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
Masaai: te nebo o sitima obo le kine, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki intae.

English: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
Masaai: Ore te nebo ilo asar opejori le anaake, o lasar lenye le ntapa, ntarasai iyie ninche te nebo o ilo asar lenye ooki. Todua nchere meeta ninche entioto.

English: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana, enturrurroto embung'a eumata nasinya; miasiasa esiaai nagol. Enkolong ina te intae nioshiosho imouarak,

English: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: ninchooyoyo olasar opejori, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; oloing'oni obo oti, o lmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto;

English: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
Masaai: o lasar sii lenye le ntapa napuyiapui, naipurjaki te ilata, o ematua e uni e tomon e efa to loing'oni ake, ematua e are e tomon to lmeregesh,

English: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
Masaai: o ematua nabo e tomon to sitima ake le ker le lelo oopishana;

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
Masaai: te nebo ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, pee eitobir osotua lo lning'o te nkaraki intae;

English: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
Masaai: nepudare ilo asar opejori lo lapa ng'ejuk, olasar lenye le ntapa, o ilo asar opejori le anaake, o lasar lenye le ntapa, o lasar lenye ooki, te risioroto e ina kitanapa enye, esong'ouna narropil, olasar le nkima oishori Olaitoriani.

English: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e tomon ele apa li opishana, ninturrurrorro intae aaibung eumata sinyati, nieniene ate, nimiasiasa esiai,

English: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
Masaai: kake entarasai olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani, esong'uona narropil: oloing'oni obo oti, olmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo; nchoo eaku meeta ntiot;

English: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
Masaai: o lasarri lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata, o matuan uni e tomon e efa, to loing'oni obo, o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh obo,

English: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
Masaai: e ematua nabo e tomon te pooki sitima le ker le lelo oopishana:

English: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, te nebo ilo asar lenye le leilo sotua lo lning'o o ilo asar le anaake opejori, o ilo asar lenye le ntapa, o lasarri lenye ooki.

English: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa li opishana, ninturrurrorro aaibung eumata nasinya; miasiasa esiaai nagol embung'a osirua lo Laitoriani nkolong'i naapishana;

English: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
Masaai: ninchooyoyo olasar opejori, ilo asar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani, iloing'ok tomon o okuni, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo; naa lelo lemeeta ntiot;

English: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
Masaai: o lasari lenye le ntapa napuyiapui naipurja te ilata, o matuan uni e tomon e efa ti obo ake le lelo oing'ok tomon o okuni, o matuan are e tomon to lmeregesh ake obo te lelo pokira are,

English: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
Masaai: o ematua nabo e tomon te pooki sitima le lelo sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan;

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar le anaake, o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasarri lenye ooki.

English: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e are entopolos iloing'ok tomon o are ooti, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki te lelo oing'ok, o loo lmeregeshi, o loo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
Masaai: o sitima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori li anaake, o lasar lenye le ntapa, o lasarri lenye ooki.

English: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e uni naa iloing'ok tomon o obo, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasarri ooki te lelo oing'ok, o loo lmeregeshi, o loo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata.

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: Te nebo sii ositima obo le kine to lasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.

English: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e ong'uan naa iloing'ok tomon, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,

English: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lasarri ooki, te lelo oing'ok, o lelo meregeshi, o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, o lasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki.

English: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e imiet naa iloing'ok ooudo, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman le kerra tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lelo asarri ooki te lelo oing'ok o te lelo meregeshi, o lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine to lasar le ng'oki; epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e ile naa iloing'ok isiet, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo ilo asar le ntapa o lasarri ooki te lelo oing'ok, o too lmeregeshi, o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, ilo asar lenye le ntapa o lelo asarri lenye ooki.

English: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e naapishana naa iloing'ok oopishana, o lmeregeshi oare, o sitiman tomon o ong'uan lo lari obo lemeeta ntiot,

English: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: te nebo olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, te lelo oing'ok o lelo meregeshi o lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenata te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake, ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
Masaai: “Ore te nkolong e isiet embung'a eumata nasinya: miasiasa esiaai nagol,

English: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
Masaai: kake enchooi olasar opejori, ilo asar le nkima, esong'ouna narropil to Laitoriani; aapolos oloing'oni obo, o lmeregesh obo, o sitiman oopishana le kerra lo lari obo lemeeta entioto,

English: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
Masaai: o lasar le ntapa o lasarri ooki, to loing'oni ake, o to lmeregesh, o te lelo sitiman le kerra, te nkikenare te risioroto e nkitanapata;

English: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
Masaai: te nebo sii ositima obo le kine oaku olasar le ng'oki, epudare ilo asar opejori le anaake o ilo asar lenye le ntapa o ilo asar lenye ooki.

English: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche ntarasakiki Olaitoriani te lelo siruai linyi oogeluno, te nebo lelo asarri linosie olmumai, o lasarri linyi le yieunoto, te nkaraki lelo asarri linyi oopejori, o lasarri linyi le ntapa, o lasarri linyi ooki, o lasarri linyi le seriani.”

English: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neliki Musa iltung'ana le Israel pooki toki anaa ake enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ilukuny oo loshon loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, “Ena ninye eitanapishe Olaitoriani.

English: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
Masaai: Te neinos oltung'ani olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, aashu te neinos olmumai pee een kewan te mbae natejo, nchoo ninye eaku olemeitupuk olomoni lenye; nchoo ninye eas te risioroto e ina pooki naimua enkutuk enye.

English: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
Masaai: Aashu te neinos enkitok olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neen kewan enye te ina bae natejo, ina kata eton etii enkaji e papaai lenye, te kitisho enye,

English: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
Masaai: nening menye ilo mumai lenye, o ina natejo ninye, nateenie ninye kewan, nemejoki ninye ae, ore ilo mumai lenye pooki neunoyu. Ore pooki natejo ninye aen kewan neunoyu.

English: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
Masaai: Kake te neany menye enyorraa ilo mumai ina olong apa pee ening, nemeitoki atii olmumai te ninye, nemetii eenata e kewan nauno, naa kepalaki Olaitoriani ninye te nkaraki naa menye otomitikio ninye.

English: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
Masaai: Naa te neyama olmoruo, ina kata eton etii eenata eilo mumai lenye, aashu nena kirorot e nkutuk enye naateenie ninye kewan,

English: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
Masaai: nening olmoruo lenye ina, neitu ejoki ae ina kata pee ening, ore naa ilo mumai lenye naa keuno, ore nena baa enyena naateenie kewan naa keunoyu.

English: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.
Masaai: Kake ore te ina olong apa natoning'o olmoruo lenye, neany ninye enyorraa, neitaa naa parmetii ilo mumai lenye apa oinosa, o nena kirorot e nkutuk enye, apa naa ninche eteenie kewan. Naa kepalaki Olaitoriani ninye.

English: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
Masaai: Kake ore pooki mumai le nkoliai, aashu le nkitok natung'uayie olmoruo lenye, ore ake ninye entoki nateenie kewan, naa keitalakuni te ninye.

English: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
Masaai: Naa te neinos ninye olmumai ti atua enkaji olpayian lenye e, aashu een kewan enye to lmumai,

English: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
Masaai: nening olpayian lenye ina, neitu ejoki ninye ae, neitu erishie ninye; ore ilo mumai lenye pooki naa keunoyu, ore enkiroroto ake pooki nateenie ninye kewan naa keunoyu.

English: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
Masaai: Kake te neitaa olmoruo lenye parmetii neitaa pesho ina olong apa pee ening, neaku naa, ore embae pooki naimu enkutuk enye naipirta olmumai lenye aashu naipirta ina enata e kewan nemelo aunoyu; eitaa olmoruo lenye pesho, naa kepalaki Olaitoriani ninye.

English: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
Masaai: Ore olmumai pooki, o enata olmumai nainosie oltung'ani kewan osina, keidim olmoruo lenye atuuno, aashu eidim aitaa parmetii.

English: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
Masaai: Kake te nemejoki olmoruo lenye ae te nkolong ake ninye, neitubulaa naa ilo mumai le nkitok enye, o nena pooki naatejo ninye aenie kewan, nena naatii shumata ninye; eitubula ninye ninche enkaraki neitu ejoki ae ina olong apa naning nena baa.

English: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
Masaai: Kake te neitaa nena baa pesho neitaa parmetii eidipa ninye atoning'o, nenap naa ninye eng'oki e nkitok enye.”

English: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkitanapat naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, naaipirta olee o enkitok enye, olpayian o entito enye, te lelero enye, eton etii enkaji e papaai lenye.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
Masaai: “Ntalaku elap oo ltung'ana le Israel too ltungana le Midian; ore te siadi ina naa ilo iyie eneiturrorrore iltung'ana linono apa ootuata aye.”

English: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa olorere, “Enterreten iltung'ana tiatua intae oopuo enjore pee etum aashom aataarare iltungana le Midian, pee eitalaku elap o Laitoriani te Midian.

English: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
Masaai: Irriwai enkalifu ake to losho pooki le Israel pee epuo enjore.”

English: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
Masaai: Neaku oishoruaki apa kulo, ooing'uaa lelo oora nkalifuni le Israel, oing'uaa ake enkalifu nabo olosho obo, nenapa lelo oora nkalifuni tomon o are aapuo enjore.

English: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Musa ninche meshomo enjore eing'uaa ake enkalifu nabo olosho obo, te nebo Finehas olayioni le Eliesa ilo apolosani, tenebo nena masaa eine wueji sinyati, neeta te nkaina enye entarumpeta naosh.

English: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
Masaai: Nearare ninche iltung'ana le Midian anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa, near metua olee ake ninye pooki.

English: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
Masaai: Near metuata ilaiguanak le Midian te nebo lelo kulikae ootasesekuanaki, Efi, o Rekem, o Surian, o Hur, o Reba lelo aiguanak imiet te Midian neitoki sii aasesekuan Balaam olayioni le Beor to lalem.

English: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Israel neraya nena kituaak e Midian o nkera enye; neraya sii nkishu enye pooki, o nkerrai o ntokitin enye pooki.

English: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
Masaai: Ore nkanas enye pooki too wuejitin neemanya o lng'oborri lenye pooki, nepejoo te nkima,

English: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
Masaai: neya nena pooki naatarutua, aa iltung'ana o nkishu.

English: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Neyau lelo o yarunot o masaa naaruno enetii Musa, o Eliesa ilo apolosani, o ina umata oo ltung'ana le Israel, te lelo ng'oborri ootii enkisiajata e Moab te mbata o lkeju le Yordan te netaaniki Yeriko.

English: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani, o lelo arikok pooki le leina umata, neipung aapuo aanang'are ina jore ti auluo.

English: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
Masaai: Netagorokine apa Musa lelo kituaak le njore, lelo arikok loo nkalifuni o lelo arikok loo maa iip, ooetuo eing'ua enjore.

English: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninche, “Itapala intae nkituaak pooki eishu?

English: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kuna apa naaishoo iltung'ana le Israel, te nkiteng'enare e Balaam metogolong'aki Olaitoriani, te ina bae e Peor, neaku eewuo olmeitai atua eumata o Laitoriani.

English: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entaar pooki lee ti atua nena kera kutiti metua, niariara pooki ng'oruoi nataboitare olee metua.

English: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
Masaai: Kake ore nena silan pooki kutiti neitu ai kata eboitare olee entapal eishu metaa nkuninyi.

English: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
Masaai: Nchoo etoni ti auluo nkolong'i naapishana; pooki ng'ae ake ninye linyi otasesekuana oltung'ani, o pooki ng'ae oiseyie olmeneng'ani, entisinya ate o lelo yarunot linyi te nkolong e uni o te nkolong e naapishana.

English: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
Masaai: Entisinya enkila ake pooki o pooki toki o lchoni, o pooki toki naitobiraki too lpapit loo nkineji, o pooki toki naguetuno te nchata.”

English: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
Masaai: Nejoki Eliesa ilo apolosani lelo tung'ana ooshomo enjore: “Ena ninye enkikoo e ina kitanapata naitanapa Olaitoriani Musa:

English: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
Masaai: sahabu ake o enkosholai o suyai o esekenkei o empirbil o ntokitin naaikununo neijia,

English: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki nemeinos enkima, niimiemie atua enkima naa kesinyayu ninye asidanu. Ore ake etiu neijia, keitukui sii te nkare e nkitisinyata, ore pooki toki nemepikayu enkima, niimiemie atua enkima.

English: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
Masaai: Entukuo ilkilani linyi te nkolong e naapishana, niakuku taa sidain; ore te siadi ina nipuonunu taa atua ilng'oborri.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
Masaai: “Nkena nena tokitin naa taaruaki, aa iltung'ana o aa nchoo, iyie o Eliesa ilo apolosani o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye e ina umata;

English: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
Masaai: nior nena naataaruaki katitin are, aoriki lelo morran apa ooshomo enjore o e umata pooki.

English: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
Masaai: Neitalaki iltungana le njore o Laitoriani kodi naing'uaa lelo tung'ana le njore ooshomo enjore, obo ake ti atua iip imiet, too ltung'ana o too lmong'i, o too sirkon, o too nkerrai;

English: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.
Masaai: intayu olpisiai lenye nincho Eliesa ilo apolosani pee eaku olasar to Laitoriani.

English: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore to lpisiai loo Siraeli loo ltung'ana, le nena tokitin ntayu nabo ti atua onom ake ninye, too ltung'ana, o too lmong'i, o sirkon, o too nkerrai, o too nchoo pooki, ninchosho ninche ile Lawi laa ninche ooing'or olng'obor lo Laitoriani.”

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neas Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
Masaai: Ore apa nena yarunot naatelekutua naawaita lelo tung'ana le njore naa nkerra nkalifuni iip ile o ntomoni naapishana o imiet,

English: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
Masaai: o nkishu nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana o are,

English: And threescore and one thousand asses,
Masaai: isirkon nkalifuni ntomoni ile o obo,

English: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
Masaai: o ltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni o are, o nkituaak neitu ai kata eboitare olee.

English: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
Masaai: Ore ilo pisiai leina rubata e le lelo apa ooshomo enjore, ore esiana enye naa nkerra nkalifuni iip uni o tomoni uni o opishana o iip imiet,

English: And the LORD'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
Masaai: ore elaakinoto o Laitoriani naa nkerra iip ile o ntomoni naapishana o imiet.

English: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and twelve.
Masaai: Ore nkishu naa nkalifuni tomoni uni oile, ore te kuna naa ntomoni naapishana oare elaakinoto o Laitoriani.

English: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute was threescore and one.
Masaai: Ore isirkon naa nkalifuni tomoni uni o iip imiet, ore te kuna naa ntomoni ile o obo elaakinoto o Laitoriani.

English: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute was thirty and two persons.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana naa nkalifuni tomon o ile, ore erubat o Laitoriani naa iltung'ana tomoni uni o are.

English: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Neishooyo Musa ina laakinoto, naa ninye olasar to Laitoriani, neisho Eliesa ilo apolosani, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
Masaai: Ore inaaing'uaa ilo pisiai te nkalo oo ltung'ana le Israel apa naategelayie Musa aitung'uaa ine lelo tung'ana apa ooshomo enjore

English: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
Masaai: ore apa olpisiai le nena teina umata naa nkerra nkalifuni iip uni o tomoni uni o opishana o iip imiet,

English: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
Masaai: o nkishu nkalifuni tomoni uni o ile,

English: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
Masaai: o sirkon nkalifuni tomoni uni o iip imiet,

English: And sixteen thousand persons;)
Masaai: o ltung'ana nkalifuni tomon o ile.

English: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore inaaing'uaa ilo pisiai loo ltung'ana le Israel neya Musa nabo te pooki onom, aa too ltung'ana o too nchoo, neisho ninche lelo le Lawi ooing'or olng'obor lo Laitoriani; anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak ooitasheiki nkalifuni e njore o lelo arikok loo nkalifuni o lairikok le lelo maa iip aapuonu aanyikaki Musa,

English: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
Masaai: nejoki ninche Musa, “Eikena isinkan linono lelo tung'ana le njore ootii abori erikore ang, nemetii oltung'ani oiwuang'a te yiook.

English: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
Masaai: Nikiyautua iyiook olasar lo Laitoriani, entoki ake ninye nanoto oltung'ani, ntokitin e sahabu, ilkataarri o mankek, o ilgiso, o sakankarri, o saen, pee kipuonu aaitobiraki ate osotua lo lning'o te dukuya Olaitoriani.”

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neng'amaa te ninche ina sahabu pooki apa naitaaki imasaa.

English: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
Masaai: Ore ina sahabu pooki oo nkishorot naishoo ninche Olaitoriani, eing'uaa lelo arikok le lelo oora nkalifuni le njore, o lelo le maa iip naa shekeli nkalifuni tomon o ile o iip naapishana o onom.

English: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
Masaai: (Ore apa lelo tung'ana le njore newaita nena naatarutua ewa ake oltung'ani nkunenyena.)

English: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani neng'amaa ina sahabu te lelo arikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip neyau atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, pee eaku entoki nadamuni too ltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Ruben o layiok le Gad na keeta nkishu kumok oleng, nedol ninche enkop e Yaser o enkop e Gilead, naa ng'ura, kenyor apa ine wueji nkishu.

English: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
Masaai: Neaku eetuo apa lelo ayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben aajoki Musa o Eliesa ilo apolosani o lelo arikok le umata,

English: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
Masaai: “Atorat, o Dibon, o Yaser, o Nimra, o Heshbon, o Eliele, o Sebam, o Nebo, o Beon,

English: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
Masaai: ore ena kop natara Olaitoriani te dukuya eumata e Israel, naa enkop nanyor nkishu, neeta isinkan linono nkishu.”

English: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Tenaa eikinoto iyiook omon too nkonyek inono, nchoo naa isinkan linono meishori ena kop meitaa enenye; mintalang iyiook olkeju le Yordan.”

English: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
Masaai: Kake etiaka Musa lelo ayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben, “Kepuo ilalashera linyi enjore itonini intae tene?

English: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee intashalishala iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel, aamitiki elang aapuo ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani ninche?

English: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
Masaai: Ina apa etaasa loo papaai linyi ina kata pee airriwaa nanu ninche te Kadesh-Barnea meshomo aadol ina kop.

English: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
Masaai: Amu ore apa pee epuo ninche oerata le Eshkol nepuo aadol ina kop, neitashal iltauja loo ltung'ana le Israel aamitiki epuo ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani ninche.

English: And the LORD'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
Masaai: Neyupuyup apa engoro o Laitoriani te ina olong, neinos ninye olmumai ejo,

English: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
Masaai: ‘Esipa meetae hoo obo le lelo tung'ana apa ooileputua aapuonu te Misiri, ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep olo adol ina kop apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, enkaraki neitu ninche aaunokino aasuj nanu;

English: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
Masaai: meteleku ake Kalebu olayioni le Yefune ilo loo Lkenise o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni amu etusuja ninche Olaitoriani katukul.’

English: And the LORD'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani ti alo Siraeli, neisho ninche metilimanata ti ong'ata ilarin artam, o metaba anaa neishunye ilo porror apa pooki otaasa entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, itubulua ajing erishata oo loo minyi, entipat oo ltung'ana aing'okok, pee iponaa oleng ina goro o Laitoriani napi ti alo Siraeli!

English: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
Masaai: Amu ti nimbelekenyanya aany isujusuju ninye, naa keigil ninye apalaa ninche ti ong'ata, nendaikiekie intae kulo tung'ana pooki.”

English: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aanyikaki ninye nejoki, “Eikishetu iyiook imuatat tene te nkaraki nkerrai ang, o nkanas te nkaraki nkera ang,

English: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
Masaai: kake eikidumu iyiook iruparen, nikinapa aapuo dukuya iltung'ana le Israel o metaba anaa nikintabau ninche ewueji enye; ore nkera ang kutiti netoni too nkanas naasheta sunta te nkaraki lelo oomanya ina kop.

English: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
Masaai: Mikirrinyunye iyiook aapuonu nkang'itie ang o metaba anaa nejung oltung'ani ake pooki le Israel enjung'ore enye.

English: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
Masaai: Amu mikijung iyiook te nebo ninche lido kekun le Yordan neito idia alo; amu ore enjung'ore ang neeuo ena shoto e Yordan neito enkalo oloosaen.”

English: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
Masaai: Neaku etiaaka apa Musa ninche, “Ti niasiasa intae ena, tenaa eidumumu intae iruparen aapuo enjore te dukuya Olaitoriani,

English: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
Masaai: ore ake pooki tung'ani linyi oata ruparen nelang olkeju le Yordan alo te dukuya Olaitoriani, o metaba anaa nearaa ilmang'ati lenyena aiwuang'ie te dukuya ninye,

English: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
Masaai: neisulieki ina kop te dukuya Olaitoriani; ore naa te siadi ina nindimidimi aatorrinyoto, nimintokiki aatakinore to Laitoriani o te Israel; ore ena kop naa keaku eninyi te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
Masaai: Kake ti nimiasiasa ina, ng'ura, nitaasa naa eng'oki to Laitoriani; naa entayiolo nchere meeta nchere, esipa meinepu intae ina ng'oki inyi.

English: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
Masaai: Enteshetu nkanas te nkaraki nkera inyi kutiti, o muatat te nkaraki nkerrai inyi; niasiasa ina nisiligishore.”

English: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben nejoki Musa, “Keas isinkan linono anaa enaitanapisho olkitok lai.

English: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
Masaai: Ore nkera ang kutiti, o nkituaak ang, o ntare ang o nkishu ang pooki, kebik te idie too nkanas e Gilead;

English: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
Masaai: kake kegiroo isinkan linono aapuo, pooki tung'ani ake otanape alo enjore, nelo enjore te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa enaitanapisho olkitok lai.”

English: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
Masaai: Neisho Musa enkitanapata naipirta ninche Eliesa ilo apolosani, o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, oo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
Masaai: Nejoki Musa ninche, “Te nelang ile Gad o ile Ruben, pooki ng'ae otanape alo enjore te dukuya o Laitoriani, nelang te nebo intae olkeju le Yordan neisulieki ina kop to dukuya intae, ninchosho taa ninche enkop e Gilead metaa enenye;

English: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: kake te nemelang ninche te nebo intae; etanapate, nepuo naa aatum enkop te nebo intae te nkop e Kanaan.”

English: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
Masaai: Newal lelo le Gad o lelo le Ruben aajo, “Ore anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani isinkan linono, ina kipuo aas.

English: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
Masaai: Eikilang iyiook olkeju le Yordan kitanapate te dukuya Olaitoriani aapuo enkop e Kanaan, ore ina jung'ore ang niking'uaa te lido kekun le Yordan.”

English: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
Masaai: Neisho Musa ninche, lelo le Gad o lelo ayiok le Ruben o lpisiai lo losho le Manase, olayioni le Yosef, enkitoria e Sihon olaiguanani le Amori, o enkitoria e Oog olaiguanani le Bashan, ina kop o nkanas enyena te nebo ilpolosien lenye, nkanas e ina kop ti atua enkop pooki.

English: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
Masaai: Neshet lelo le Gad Dibon, o Atorat, o Aroen

English: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
Masaai: o Atrot-shofan, o Yaser o Yogebeha,

English: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
Masaai: Bet-nimra o Bet-haran, nkanas naasheta sunta, o muatat oo nkerrai.

English: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
Masaai: Ore ile Ruben neshet Heshbon, o Eleale, o Kiriataim,

English: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
Masaai: o Nebo, o Baal-meon (eibelekenyaki nkarn enye), o Sibma, neisho ninche kulie arn nena anas naatesheta ninche.

English: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Makir o layiok le Manase nepuo Gilead neya aaitaa enenye.

English: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
Masaai: Neisho Musa Makir olayioni le Manase Gilead, nemany ninye ine.

English: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
Masaai: Ore Yair olayioni le Manase nelo aya nkang'itie enye neisho ninche enkarna ajo Hafot-yair.

English: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
Masaai: Nelo Noba aya Kenat o nkang'itie enye neisho ninye enkarna ajo Noba, aipotie kewan.

English: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilkirragarien loo ltung'ana le Israel, ina kata apa pee eipung aapuo aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri, too lororani lenye erikito Musa o Aron.

English: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
Masaai: Neiger Musa nkiterunot e lototo enye, anaa ilkirragarien pooki wueji ake ninye, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani; naa kulo apa ilkirragarien lenye te risioroto oo wuejitin neetang'asa aaimaa.

English: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
Masaai: Etudumunye ninche te Ramases to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa; te ina olong nasuju pasaka, neipung iltung'ana le Israel aapuo eishuro te dukuya ile Misiri pooki,

English: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
Masaai: ina kata enukaa ile Misiri ilkikaunot lenye pooki ootara Olaitoriani ti atua ninche; ore nkaitin enye nedung'oki Olaitoriani enkiguana.

English: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
