Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa iltung'ana le Israel te Ramases, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Sukot.

English: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Sukot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Efam, natii embata e ong'ota.

English: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye te Etam neibelekenya aarrinyo Pi-ha-hirot, aa ninye natii enkalo oloo saen le Baal-sefon; nepuo ninche aaun ilng'oborri te netaaniki Migdol.

English: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te neipirare Hahirot neim empolos e naiposha nepuo olpurkel, nepuo elototo oo nkolong'i uni tiongata e Etam, neun ilng'oborri te Mara.

English: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Mara nepuonu Elim; ore apa te Elim netii nchorroi tomon o are oo nkariak o ltuka ntomoni naapishana, neun ninche ilng'oborri te ine.

English: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye te Elim noun ilng'oborri te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie neun ilng'oborri tiongata e Sin.

English: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye tiongata e Sin neun ilng'oborri te Dofka.

English: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche te Dofka nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Alush.

English: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Alush nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Refidim, te ine apa nemetii enkare naok iltung'ana.

English: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Refidim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri tiong'ata e Sinai.

English: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye tiongata e Sinai, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Kibrot-hatafa.

English: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kibrot-hatafa nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Heserot.

English: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Heserot, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Ritma.

English: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Ritma nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Rimon-peres.

English: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Rimon-peres, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Libna.

English: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Libna nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Risa.

English: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Risa nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Kehelata.

English: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kehelata nepuo aaun ilng'oborri to ldoinyo le Shefer.

English: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye to doinyo le Shefer nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Harada.

English: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Harada nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Makelot.

English: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Makelot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Tahat.

English: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Tahat nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Tera.

English: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Tera nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Mitka.

English: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Mitka nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Hashmona

English: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Hashmona nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Moserot.

English: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Moserot, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Bene-yakan.

English: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Bene-Yakan, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Hor-hagidgad.

English: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Hor-hagidgad, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Yotbata.

English: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Yotbata, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Abrona.

English: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Abrona nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Esion-geber.

English: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Esion-geber nepuo aaun ilng'oborri tiong'ata e Sin (aa taa Kadesh ina).

English: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Kadesh nepuo aaun ilng'oborri to ldoinyo le Hor, to lkirene le nkop e Edom.

English: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
Masaai: Ore Aron ilo apolosani neilep alo enchumata o ldoinyo le Hor anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani, nelo aye te ine, to lari li artam eidipa iltung'ana le Israel aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le imiet.

English: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
Masaai: Naa oloo larin iip o tikitam o okuni apa Aron ina kata pee eye to ldoinyo le Hor.

English: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ilo Kanaani, olaiguanani le Arad, apa omanya Negeb te nkop e Kanaan, nening ina lotunoto oo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye to ldoinyo le Hor nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Salmona.

English: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Salmona, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Punon.

English: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Punon, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Obot.

English: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Obot nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Iye-abarim te nkop oo le Moab.

English: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Iyim, nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Dibon-gad.

English: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Dibon-gad nepuo aaun ilng'oborri te Almon-diblataim.

English: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye te Almon-diblataim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri too ldoinyo le Abarim, te nkipirakinoto e Nebo.

English: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aadumunye too ldoinyo le Abarim nepuo aaun ilng'oborri too nkisiajat e Moab te mbata e Yordan eipirare Yeriko.

English: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
Masaai: Neun ninche ilng'oborri te mbata e Yordan ebaiki Bet-Yeshimot o metabaiki Abel-shitim too nkisiajat e Moab.

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa te nena kisiajat e Moab te mbata e Yordan eipirare Yeriko,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, Ti nilang'ilang'a Yordan aapuo enkop e Kanaan,

English: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
Masaai: nipuopuo naa aaraa lelo pooki oomanya ina kop aaiwuang'ie te dukuya intae nindaikiekie nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo soito, nindaikiekie nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaipurjuno, nigiligili nene wuejitin neeika naaitainyeki lasarri pooki;

English: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
Masaai: niyaya ina kop aaitaa eninyi nimanyimanya, amu aishoo nanu intae ina kop pee iyaya.

English: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
Masaai: Ijung'ujung'u intae ina kop te oshoto e nkukuo te risioroto oo lmareita linyi; ore olosho kitok neishori enjung'ore kitok, ore olosho oti neishori enjung'ore kiti; anaa ake enadoiki enkukuo oltung'ani, neaku ina enenye; nijung'ujung'u te risioroto oo loshon loo loo papaai linyi.

English: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
Masaai: Kake ti nimiaraa lelo oomaaya ina kop aaiwang'ie te dukuya intae ore lelo lilekuku netiu anaa iltidii too nkonyek inyi o lkiku too matuan inyi, naa kepuo ninche aaitanyamal intae te ina kop nipuopuo aamany.

English: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
Masaai: Naa kalo nanu aitaas intae ina duoo natadamua pee aitaas ninche.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel tiaaki ninche, Ti nipuopuo aajing enkop e Kanaan, (ena kop nalo aaku enjungore inyi, ina kop e Kanaan ebaiki e enebaiki),

English: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
Masaai: ore enkalo inyi e kopikop naa keaku ebaiki ongata e Sin amanaa tolkirine le Edom, naa ore olpolosie linyi te nkalo e kopikop naa ebaiki enkiting'oto Enaiposha e Munyan te nkalo o loosaen;

English: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
Masaai: nelo olpolosie linyi neirrugo aing'or kopikop e nkilepunoto tenkalo e Akrabim, nedung alo Sin, ore enkiting'oto enye naa keaku kopikop e Kadesh-Bar nea; neitoki adoyio alo o metabai Hasar-adari, negiroo alo Asmon;

English: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
Masaai: neitoki olpolosie aibelekenya te Asmon o meshomo Ereyiet e Misiri, ore enkitingoto enye naa te naiposha.

English: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
Masaai: “Ore to lpolosie lo loontoluo nchoo eaku Enaiposha Kitok o lo manaa lenye; ele ninye eaku olpolosie lino lo loontoluo.

English: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
Masaai: “Ele olo aaku olpolosie lino le moikuape: ore ebaiki Enaiposha Kitok, entipik olpolosie linyi o metabaiki oldoinyo le Hor;

English: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
Masaai: ore ebaiki oldoinyo le Hor entipik olpolosie o metabaiki enkutuk e Hamat, ore enkiting'oto e ilo polosie nelo aaku Sedad’

English: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie alo abaya Sifron, ore enkiting'oto enye nelo aaku Hasar-enan ele ninye; olo aaku olpolosie linyi le moikuape.

English: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
Masaai: “Entobira ilpolosien linyi lo loo saen ebaiki Hasar-enan o metabaiki Shefam;

English: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
Masaai: nedoyio ilo polosie alo ebaiki te Shefam o metabaiki Ribla te nkalo o loo saen le Aim; nedoyio ilo polosie alo o metabaiki olmanie le naiposha e Kineret te nkalo oloosaen;

English: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
Masaai: nedoyio ilo polosie alo olkeju le Yordan, ore enkiting'oto enye nelo aaku Enaiposha e Munyan. Ena ninye nalo aaku enkop inyi emanita ilpolosien pooki.”

English: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
Masaai: Neitanap Musa iltung'ana le Israel ejo, “Ena kop intae ipuopuo aajung te oshoto e nkukuo, naa ninye eitanapishe Olaitoriani pee eisho iloshon ooudo o lpisiai lo losho;

English: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
Masaai: amu ore olosho loo layiok le Ruben too nkajijik oo loo menye, o losho loo le Gad too nkajijik oo loo menye, netang'amutua enjung'ore enye, o lpisiai sii lo losho le Manase;

English: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
Masaai: ore lelo oshon pokira oare o ilo pisiai lo losho netang'amutua enjung'ore enye te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, etalita Yeriko, te nkalo o loosaen, te neilepunye enkolong.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa,

English: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche nkarn oo ltung'ana e lelo tung'ana oopuo aadung'oki intae enkop naaku enjung'ore inyi: Eliesa ilo apolosani o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
Masaai: Iwa ake olarikoni obo te pooki osho, pee epuo aaor enkop naaku enjung'ore.

English: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn e lelo tung'ana: ore olosho le Yuda, naa Kalebu olayioni le Yefune.

English: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
Masaai: Ore olo losho loo layiok le Simeon naa Shemuel olayioni le Amihud.

English: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
Masaai: Ore olo losho loo layiok le Benchamen naa Elida olayioni le Kislon.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Dan naa Buki olayioni le Yogli.

English: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
Masaai: Ore oloo layiok le Yosef: lo losho lo layiok le Manase, ore olarikoni naa Haniel olayioni le Efod.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Efraim, naa Kemuel olayioni le Shiftan.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Sebulon, naa Elisafan olayioni le Parnak.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Isaakar naa Paltiel olayioni le Asaan.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Asheri naa Ahihud olayioni le Shelomi.

English: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni lo losho loo layiok le Naftali naa Padehel olayioni le Amihud.

English: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo lewa apa ooitanapa Olaitoriani metooriki ina jung'ore iltung'ana le Israel te nkop e Kanaan.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa too nkisiajat e Moab, te mbata o lkeyu le Yordan, etalita Yeriko,

English: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
Masaai: “Ntanapa iltung'ana le Israel, nchere pee eisho ile Lawi enjung'ore naaku enenye, nkanas naapuo aamany; nincho sii lelo le Lawi ndaat oo nchoo naamanita nena anas.

English: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
Masaai: Ore nena anas naa nkunenye naamany ore nena daat oo nchoo naa inoo nkishu enye o masaa enye o enoo ng'uesi enye.

English: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
Masaai: Ore nena daat oo nchoo e nena anas nipuopuo intae aaisho ile Lawi, nchoo ebaiki esuntai e nkanasa neito idia alo nelo iroruat iip ong'uan o onom too nkaloli pooki.

English: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
Masaai: Entetem auluo enkanasa, ore te nkalo o loo saen naa iroruat nkalifuni are, ore te nkalo e kopikop naa iroruat nkalifuni are, ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo naa iroruat nkalifuni are, ore enkalo e moikuape naa iroruat nkalifuni are, niaku ina anasa naitorit, keaku ena enenye, nairritishore too nkanas enye.

English: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
Masaai: Ore nena anas nilo iyie aisho ile Lawi naa nena anas naasaruni naa ninche nchosho oltung'ani oitayu loikop metasaru, ore te nebo nena ipuopuo intae aaishooyo nkanas artam o are.

English: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
Masaai: Ore nena anas pooki nipuopuo intae aaisho ile Lawi naa artam o isiet te nebo ndaat enye oo nchoo.

English: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
Masaai: Naa ore te nena anas nipuopuo intae aaishooyo naaing'uaa imasaa oo ltung'ana le Israel, ore to losho kitok niyaya nkumok, ore to losho oti niyaya nkuti; olosho ake te risioroto e njung'ore natujung'o ninye, neisho ake nkanas enyena ile Lawi.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Musa,

English: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, te nipuopuo aalang olkeju le Yordan aapuo enkop e Kanaan,

English: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
Masaai: nigelulu naa nkanas naaku nkanas naasaruni te nkaraki intae, pee etum pooki ng'ae oitayu loikop, oar oltung'ani metua eitu eotiki atasaru.

English: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
Masaai: Ore nena anas naa keaku te intae inaasaruni te nkaraki ilo oitalaku elap, pee meari ilo otasesekuanishe metua o metaba anaa neitashe te dukuya eumata omeiguanareki.

English: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
Masaai: Ore nena anas ninchooyoyo naa nena anas inyi ile naasaruni.

English: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
Masaai: Enchoru nkanas uni te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, o nkanas uni te nkop e Kanaan naaku nkanas naasaruni.

English: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
Masaai: Ore kuna anas pokira ile naa keaku inaasaru iltung'ana le Israel, o ilo omoni o ilo otamanyishe ti atua ninche, pee etum pooki ng'ae oitayu loikop, oar oltung'ani metua te eitu eotiki atasaru.

English: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: “Kake te neosh ninye olikae to sekenkei, neaku etua ilo, naa oloo loikop ninye; ore ilo oitayio loikop naa keari metua.

English: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Naa te nenang ninye olikae to soit oata te nkaina neaku etua ilo tung'ani, naa oloo loikop ninye; ore oltung'ani oitayu loikop naa keari metua.

English: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
Masaai: Aashu te neosh ninye olikae te nchata naibung'ita te nkaina, naidim ataara oltung'ani metua neaku etua ilo, netaa ninye oloo loikop; ore oltung'ani oitayu loikop neari ninye metua.

English: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitalaku osarge ninye makewan oar ilo aitayio iloikop metua; te nenang'are ninye near ninye metua.

English: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
Masaai: Naa tenerem ninye tenkaraki enkiba, anaa eipony ninye, aashu etarresho ninye, neaku etua,

English: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
Masaai: aashu ore te mang'atisho neosh ninye te nkaina enye, neaku etua ilo, ore naa ilo otooshishe neari ninye metua; oloo loikop ninye; ore ilo oitalaku osarge near ilo oitayio loikop metua, te nenang'are ninye.

English: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
Masaai: “Kake tenetaremo ninye nabo kata to lbuket metii mang'atisho, aashu enang ninye ti ae toki eitu eresh aanyu,

English: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
Masaai: anaa easishore osoit oidim atara oltung'ani metua, neaku etua ilo tung'ani, hoo duoo neme olmang'atinta lenye, nemeyieuaki duoo entorroni,

English: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
Masaai: nerish naa ina umata ilo oitayio loikop o ilo oitalaku osarge te risioroto e kuna kikoot.

English: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
Masaai: Ore ina umata nekordu ilo oitayio loikop te nkaina e ilo oitalaku osarge, ore ina umata nepik ninye atua ina anasa enye nasaruni, naa ninye elo aisikaki, nelo ninye aton te ine o metaba anaa neye ilo apolosani kitok apa otubukokoki eilata nasinya aaput.

English: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
Masaai: Kake te nelo ilo tung'ani oitayio loikop, te nkata ake ninye pooki agiroo ilpolosien le ina anasa enye nasaruni, apa naa ninye eisikaka,

English: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
Masaai: ore ilo oitalaku osarge neinepu ninye ti oriong ilpolosien le ina anasa enye nasaruni, near ilo oitalaku osarge ilo oitayio loikop, nemeeta entioto o sarge.

English: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
Masaai: Amu meeta nchere meton ilo tung'ani ti atua ina anasa enye nasaruni o metabau keeya o lapolosani kitok; kake ore te siadi enkeeya o lapolosani kitok neidim ilo tung'ani atorrinyoyu ashomo enkop enye.

English: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Masaai: “Ore kuna baa naa keaku enkitanapata o endung'oto e nkiguana te intae, too iishoritin inyi pooki o ti atua imanyishoreitin inyi pooki.

English: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
Masaai: Te near oltung'ani ake olikae metua, ore ilo oitayio loikop neari metua te nchakenisho oo lchakenini; kake meetae oltung'ani oari metua te nchakenisho olchakeni obo.

English: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, eming'amaa ntokitin e lakunoto e nkishui e ilo oitayio loikop, oata enkitarruoroto e keeya; kake keari ninye metua.

English: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
Masaai: Niming'amaa entoki e lakunoto e ilo oisikaka enkanasa enye nasaruni, pee etum ninye atorrinyoyu alo aton te ina kop te dukuya keeya o lapolosani kitok.

English: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
Masaai: Emisarkionie naa ena kop nitii; amu keisarkionie osarge enkop, nemeetae entoki naitobiri naidim aipoo, amu ore ilo sarge otubukokine enkop, meteleku ake osarge le ilo oibukoyie.

English: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
Masaai: Emisarkionie naa ena kop nimanyanya naa ninye sii nanu atii atua; amu ore nanu Olaitoriani namanya atua iltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
Masaai: Ore lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, oo lmareita loo layiok le Gilead, olayioni le Makir, olayioni le Manase o loo nkajijik oo loo menye oo layiok le Yosef, nepuonu aanyiku neiro te dukuya Musa o te dukuya larikok, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo ltung'ana le Israel,

English: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Eitanapa apa Olaitoriani olkitok lai pee eishooyo enkop anaa enjung'ore te oshoto e nkukuo aisho iltung'ana le Israel, neitanapaki apa olkitok lai o Laitoriani pee eisho enjung'ore e Selofehad olalashe lang ntoyie enyena.

English: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
Masaai: Kake tenaa keyama ninche obo ake ninye loo layiok le kulie oshon loo ltung'ana le Israel ore naa enjung'ore enye neyae aaitung'uaa enjung'ore oo loo papa, neponikini ina jung'ore e ilo osho ora olenye; neaku keiwuang'ieki te oshoto enkukuo e ina jung'ore ang.

English: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
Masaai: Naa te nebau ilo sirua loo ltung'ana le Israel odamunyeki ilarin onom, neitokini aaponaa enjung'ore enye aaponiki ilo osho ora olenye; ore enjung'ore enye neyai aaitung'uaa enjung'ore olosho loo loopapa.”

English: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
Masaai: Neitanap Musa iltung'ana le Israel te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, ejo, “Etisipa olosho loo layiok le Yosef.

English: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
Masaai: Ena ninye eitanapisho Olaitoriani ti alo nena toyie e Selofehad, ‘Nchoo ninche meyama oloba anaa oladol aajo sidai, kake nchoo ake duoo eyami ti atua ilmarei lo losho loo loo menye.

English: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
Masaai: Ore enjung'ore oo ltung'ana le Israel nemeibelekenyi to losho obo aaya olikae osho, amu ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana le Israel neibung'are enjung'ore o losho loo loo menye.

English: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
Masaai: Naa ore entito pooki ake naata enjung'ore te pooki ake ninye osho loo ltung'ana le Israel naa kelo aaku enkitok e obo lo losho lolmarei le menye, pee aa ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana le Israel netum anoto enjung'ore oo loomenye.

English: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
Masaai: Metaa meetae enjung'ore naibelekenyi aaitung'uaa olosho obo aaya olikae; amu ore ake pooki osho loo tung'ana le Israel neibung'are enjung'ore enye.’ ”

English: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
Masaai: Ore nena toyie e Selofehad neas anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa;

English: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
Masaai: amu ore Mahalal, o Tirsa, o Hogla, o Mika o Noa, nena toyie e Selofehad neyama layiok loo lalashera le menye.

English: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
Masaai: Eyamaki apa ninche too lmareita loo layiok le Manase olayioni le Yosef, ore enjung'ore enye neton to losho lo lmarei le papaai lenye.

English: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkitanapat o nkiguanat apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, too nkisiajat e Moab, te mbata olkeju le Yordan etalita Yeriko.

English: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
Masaai: Kulo ninche irorei apa ooirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel pooki te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan ti ong'ata, te Araba te nkipirakinoto e Sufu, te rishata e Paran o Tofel, o Laban, o Heserot o Disahab.

English: (There are eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
Masaai: Nkolong'i tomon oobo elototo ebaiki Horeb te nkoitoi o ldoinyo le Seir o metabaiki Kadesh-Barnea,

English: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
Masaai: ore to lari le artam, te nkolong e dukuya olapa le tomon oobo, neirorie Musa iltung'ana le Israel te risioroto e nena pooki naaishoo ninye Olaitoriani aitanap ninche.

English: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
Masaai: Ina kata eidipa ninye atimira Sihon olaiguanani loo Lamori apa omanya Heshbon o Oog olaiguanani le Bashan apa omanya Ashtarot o Edrei.

English: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
Masaai: Ore te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, te nkop e Moab, neinosu Musa ena kitanapata, ejo,

English: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
Masaai: “Etiaaka apa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang te Horeb, ‘Itobiko intae oleng tele doinyo;

English: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
Masaai: embelekenyunye enteru elototo inyi, nipuopuo ina kop oo ldoinyo e Amori, ole latia enye pooki te Araba, teina kop oo ldoinyo o te nkop nashong'ishong, o Negeb, o lomanaa le naiposha, ina kop oo Lkanaan, o Lebanon o metabaiki ilo keju kitok, ilo keju le Frati.

English: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
Masaai: Ng'ura airragie nanu enkop te dukuya intae. Enchom intae ewaita ina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai linyi te Abraham, te Isaak o te Yakobo, pee eisho ninche o eishoi enye tesiadi ninche.’

English: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
Masaai: “Ore apa teina kata atiaaka intae, ‘Maidim nanu openy atanapa intae,

English: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
Masaai: etopona intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa ng'ura, ibaba intae ena olong anaa ilakir le shumata te nkumoi.

English: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
Masaai: Meitaa intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi katitin enkalifu te nkumoi alang enibaba. Nemayian intae, anaa enaisiligie intae!

English: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
Masaai: Kaji nanu aiko openy te nanap enkiroishi o lola linyi, o loo larrabali linyi?’

English: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
Masaai: Entegelu iltung'ana ng'eni, oodamisho neeta eyiolounoto, te risioroto oo loshon linyi, pee agelu nanu ninche metaa ilaitasheikinok linyi.

English: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
Masaai: Nikitawalikitia intae, aajo, ‘Ore ina bae nitejo naa eisidai te nikiaas iyiook.’

English: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
Masaai: Neaku aawa apa nanu lelo arikok loo loshon linyi, lelo tung'ana ng'eni arriyiak, naitaa ninche ilarikok linyi, ilaitasheikinok loo nkalifuni o ilaitasheikinok loo maa iip, o ilaitasheikinok loo maa-onom, o laitasheikinok loo maa tomon ilkituaak tiatua iloshon linyi pooki.

English: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
Masaai: Naitanap apa nanu ilarishak linyi te ina kata, ajoki ‘Entoning nkiguanat oo lalashera linyi entirish ninche, nidung'udung'u enkiguana te sipata te rishata o ltung'ani o lalashe lenye, aashu ilo likae otii te nebo ninye.

English: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
Masaai: Nimiatata olkep te ndung'okinoto e nkiguana; entoning oltung'ani oti o lkitok, tenkitorisiokinoto; miureyu enkomom o ltung'ani amu ore endung'okinoto enkiguana naa ene Nkai, ore ilo rorei ogol te iyie niyau enatii nanu, naa kaning nanu,’

English: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
Masaai: naitanapa apa nanu intae teina kata nena tokitin pooki naaishiakino niasiasa.

English: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
Masaai: “Kitudumunye apa iyiook te Horeb, nikipuo aaim ina ong'ata sapuk nagol nitoduaa, kiimita ina oitoi eina kop oo ldoinyo nalo Amori, anaa enaitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang; nikipuonu Kadesh-Barnea.

English: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki intae, ‘Itabautua intae enkop oo ldoinyo e Amori, apa naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
Masaai: Ng'ura eirragie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ena kop te dukuya intae; elepa enchom, ewaita anaa apa enatiaka intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi; miureishoyuyu niming'aing'aiyiayia.’

English: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
Masaai: Nikipuonunu intae pooki aanyikaki nanu, nijojo, ‘Emairriwai iltung'ana meituruko te iyiook aajur enkop, neyaki iyiook olomoni le nkoitoi nikiim o nena anas nikipuo.’

English: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
Masaai: Etalie apa ina bae aa sidai te nanu, nagelu nanu iltung'ana tomon oare te intae, oltung'ani obo ake to losho;

English: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
Masaai: neibelekenya ninche neilep aapuo ina kop oo ndoinyo, nebau oerata le Eshkol neikitalan.

English: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
Masaai: Neyau ninche too nkaik enye embata oo lng'anayio leina kop neitadou aayaki iyiook, neitoki aayaki iyiook olkilikuai, nejo, ‘Enkop sidai ina naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’

English: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
Masaai: “Ore ake eyia eitu intae ipuopuo, kake itogolong'akita enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai inyi;

English: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
Masaai: Ning'unyung'unyunyu tiatua ilng'oborri linyi, nijojo ‘Enkaraki naiba iyiook Olaitoriani pee eitupukuo iyiook te nkop e Misiri, pee elotu apik iyiook atua nkaik oo Lamoni, pee eidaikie iyiook.

English: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyiook kiilep aapuo aaing'oru? Eitalepoitie ilalashera lang iltauja lang, ejo, “Eisapuki lelo tung'ana naa adoru aalang iyiook; eikituaak nena anas naashetuno aabaiki shumata; ore sii kitoduaa ilayiok le Anakim teine.” ’

English: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki intae, eming'aeng'ai aashu iureyuyu ninche.

English: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi oshi laa ninye orikoo intae, ninye makewan olo aarisho amitu intae, anaa apa enaitaasa ninye intae te Misiri te dukuya nkonyek inyi,

English: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
Masaai: o tiong'ata teine apa netodolie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi enap intae, anaa enanap oltung'ani enkerai enye teina oitoi apa pooki niima o metaba anaa nipuonunu ene wueji.

English: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
Masaai: Ore ake etii ele rorei eitu, intae irukuruku Olaitoriani Enkai inyi,

English: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
Masaai: laa ninye apa oshomo dukuya intae te nkoitoi pee eing'uraki intae ewueji niunienie ilng'oborri linyi, nerikoo intae te nkima kewarie, pee eitodol intae enkoitoi niimiimi, nerikoo intae te nkatampoi te ndama.

English: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
Masaai: “Nening Olaitoriani lelo rorei linyi, negoro, neinos ninye olmumai ejo,

English: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
Masaai: ‘Medol ninye oltung'ani obo le ilo porror torrono, ina kop apa nainosie olmumai nchere kaisho loo papaai linyi,

English: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
Masaai: meteleku ake Kaleb olayioni le Yefune; kelo ninye adol, ninye ake o nkera enyena alo nanu aisho ina kop metororua ninye too nkejek enyena, enkaraki nairukurukore ninye tukul Olaitoriani!’

English: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
Masaai: Aatagorokine sii nanu, Olaitoriani te nkaraki intae, nejo, ‘Milo sii iyie ajing atua ine,

English: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
Masaai: Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo oitashe te dukuya iyie, ninye olo ajing; ntagolo ninye oshoke, amu ninye olo aidimie Israel metujung'o ina kop.

English: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
Masaai: Ore nena kera inyi nitejo intae keidaikieki o nkera inono, nena nemeyiolo taata ninche esidai o entorrono, kepuo ninche atua ine, naa kaisho nanu ninche ina kop, naa keya ninche aaitaa enenye.

English: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, mbelekenyayu, shomo ong'ata mpira enkalo Enaiposha Nanyokie.’

English: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
Masaai: “Nikintokiki intae aawalaki nanu nijojo, ‘Kitasa eng'oki to Laitoriani, eikilep iyiook aapuo olarrabal, anaa enaitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’ Nerretena ake pooki tung'ani too masaa enyena olarrabal, ejo tenaa kelelek eilepakini ina kop oo ndoinyo.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Tiaaki ninche, Emilep aapuo olarrabal amu matii nanu atua intae, pee memiri ake intae te dukuya ilmang'ati linyi.’

English: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
Masaai: Neaku airorie nanu intae nianyianya intae ining'ining'i; kake itogolong'akita enkitanapata o Laitoriani, ore to lwuasa linyi nilepilepe aapuo ina kop oo ldoinyo.

English: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Amori oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo nepuonu aarare intae, nemir intae anaa enamirisho ilotorok, near intae aairragie te Seir, o metabaiki Horma.

English: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
Masaai: Nirrinyunyenye intae aapuonu aaishir te dukuya Olaitoriani; kake eitu ening Olaitoriani oltoilo linyi neitu eisho intae enkiok.

English: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
Masaai: Neaku itobiko intae te Kadesh nkolong'i kumok, te nena olong'i apa nitobiko intae teine.

English: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
Masaai: “Nikintoki aaibelekenya nikipuo ong'ata, enkalo Enaiposha Nanyokie, anaa apa enaatiaka Olaitoriani; ore too nkolong'i kumok nikipuo aamanaa te Seir.

English: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu,

English: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
Masaai: ‘Itamanaitie intae te le doinyo te nkata naado; embelekenyata enchom enkalo e moikuape.

English: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
Masaai: Naa ntanapa lelo tung'ana letaa ijojo pee iimiimi olpolosie loo lalashera linyi, lelo ayiok le Esau, oomanya Seir; keureishoyu ninche te nkaraki intae metaa eng'ura ate oleng;

English: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
Masaai: emiarare ninche, amu maisho nanu intae hoo enkop enye, a-a hoo ninye eneba endap e nkeju amu aishoo nanu Esau oldoinyo le Seir metaa olenye.

English: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae aainyiang'u endaa te ninche too mpisai, pee itumutumu aainosa, naa einyang'ung'u sii enkare te ninche too mpisai, pee itumutumu aatook.

English: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
Masaai: Amu etamayiana intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te siaai pooki oo nkaik inyi; eyiolo ninye enkiimata inyi ena ong'ata sapuk; ore te kulo arin artam etaa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo intae; eitu eng'oriki intae toki.’

English: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
Masaai: Neaku kishomo apa iyiook, nikigiroo ilalashera lang lelo ayiok le Esau, oomanya Seir, nikigiroo enkoitoi e Araba ebaiki Elat o Esiong'eber. “Nikimbelekenya aaing'or enkalo olpurkel le Moab.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Mintanyamal iltung'ana le Moab aashu intayunye ninche olarrabal, amu maisho nanu intae erubata ninye nabo enkop enye metaa eninyi, amu aishoo nanu Ari ilayiok le Lutu meitaa enenye.’

English: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
Masaai: Iltung'ana le Emim apa oomanya ine.

English: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
Masaai: Olosho kitok naa kumok naa adoru anaa iltung'ana le Anaki; neishooki sii ninche enkarna anaa ile Anak naji Refaim, kake keipot iltung'ana le Moab ninche aajo Emim.

English: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
Masaai: Emanya sii apa ile Hori Seir, kake etaraitie ilayiok le Esau ninche, neidaikie ninche te dukuya ninche, nemanyisho ninche te rishata enye; anaa apa enaikuna Israel teina kop enye, apa naishoo ninche Olaitoriani.

English: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
Masaai: Entudumunye naa taata, nipuopuo aalang olkeju le Seredi. Neaku kishomo iyiook aalang olkeju le Seredi.

English: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
Masaai: Ore enkata ebaiki pee kipuo iyiook te Kadesh-Barnea omatalang olkeju le Seredi naa ilarin tomoni uni o isiet, o metaba anaa neaku ore olporror pooki, aa taa lelo tung'ana lo larrabal neidaaya ninche too lng'oborri, anaa apa enainosie Olaitoriani ninche olmumai.

English: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
Masaai: Amu esipa enkaina o Laitoriani apa naarare ninche, pee eidaikie ninche te lelo ng'oborri, o metaba anaa neidak ninche.

English: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
Masaai: “Neaku ore ake pee eidak lelo tung'ana pooki to larrabal neye ninche tiatua olorere,

English: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
Masaai: naajoki nanu Olaitoriani,

English: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
Masaai: ‘Ore ena olong ilo iyie adung olpolosie le Moab te Ari;

English: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
Masaai: Ore ake pee itaaniki enkop oo layiok le Amon, nimintanyamal ninche aashu iarare ninche, amu maaisho nanu iyie erubata ninye nabo enkop oo layiok le Amon metaa enino, amu aishoo nanu layiok le Lutu meitaa enenye.’

English: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
Masaai: (Ore sii ine naa keyioloi nchere enkop e Refaim; Refaim apa emanya ine, kake kejo ile Amoni ninche Samsumim,

English: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
Masaai: olorere kitok naa kumok, naa adoru anaa ile Anakim, kake eidakie Olaitoriani ninche te dukuya ninche, neoruni ninche ina kop nemanyi te rishata enye:

English: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
Masaai: anaa apa enaitaasa ninye ilayiok le Esau oomanya Seir ina kata apa pee eidaikie ninye ile Hori te dukuya ninche, neoruni enkop enye nemanyi te rishata enye o tene.

English: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
Masaai: Ore ile Afim, lelo oomanya nkang'itie kutiti ometabaiki Gasa, ore lelo le Kaftorim apa ooing'ua Kafta neidaikie ninche nemany enkop enye te rishata enye.)

English: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
Masaai: Entudumunye enteru elototo inyi, nipuopuo lido kekun o erata le Arnon, ng'ura, aishorua nanu apik atua enkaina ino Sihon ilo Amori, aiguanani le Heshbon, o enkop enye; nteru iwa niarare ninye to larrabal.

English: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
Masaai: Ore ena olong kaiteru nanu apik enkiputukuny olkirutoto te nkaraki iyie shumata kulo ootii abori pooki, pee epuo ninche aaning ilomon likimpirta iyie neikirikira neirut te nkaraki iyie.

English: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
Masaai: “Nairriwaa apa nanu ilkiliku teina ong'ata e Kedemot airriwaki Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon, too rorei le seriani, ajoki,

English: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
Masaai: ‘Nchooki nanu maimai atua enkop ino; enkoitoi ake aim nanu, nemaiwuang nanu alo enkaina e tatene aashu ene kedienye.

English: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
Masaai: Eikimiraki iyie nanu endaa too mpisai, pee atum ainosa, nikincho nanu enkare too ropiyiani, pee atum atooko; nchooki ake duoo iyie enaimaa too nkejek,

English: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
Masaai: anaa apa enaitaasa nanu ilayiok le Esau oomanya Seir o Lmoabu oomanya Ari, o metaba anaa nalang alo lido kekun le Yordan ajing atua ina kop naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’

English: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
Masaai: Kake eitu eisho iyiook Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon matogiroi ninye, amu eitagolo Olaitoriani Enkai inyi oltau lenye pee etum ninye aishoru atipika enkaina inyi anaa ena olong.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Ng'ura, aiterua nanu aisho intae Sihon o enkop enye; enteru ewaita, pee itumutumu aatamany ena kop.’

English: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
Masaai: Nelotu Sihon aarare iyiook, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, neitayu olarrabal te Yahas.

English: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
Masaai: Neishoru Olaitoriani Enkai ang ninye, nikimir iyiook ninye, o layiok lenyena, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
Masaai: Nikimbung iyiook nkanas enyena teina kata nikindaikie tukul pooki anasa, ilewa, o nkituaak, o nkera; meetae hoo obo otung'uayioki eishu.

English: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
Masaai: Nkishu kiwaita aaraya tenebo iyarunot e nena anas nikimbung'a.

English: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
Masaai: Ore ebaiki Aroer naa ninye natii embata o erata le Arnon, o ebaiki ina anasa natii oerata ometabaiki Gilead meetae enkanasa nalusoo te iyiook; eishorua Olaitoriani Enkai ang pooki apik atua nkaik ang.

English: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
Masaai: Ina kop pooki ake oo layiok le Amon eitu inyikakiki, aa taa, inkiyopat o lkeju le Yaboko o nkanas eina kop oo ldoinyo, o pooki wueji neitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang ajoki emipuo.

English: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
Masaai: “Nikintoki iyiook aaibelekenya nikipuo aaim enkoitoi e Bashan; neipang'u Oog ilo aiguanani le Bashan alotu aarare iyiook, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, nearare iyiook te Edrei.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
Masaai: Kake aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Miureyu ninye; amu aishorua nanu ninye, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, o enkop enye apik atua enkaina ino, naa ilo iyie aitaas ninye anaa enintaasa Sihon ilo aiguanani le Amori, apa omanya Heshbon.’

English: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
Masaai: Neaku eishorua sii Olaitoriani Enkai ang apik atua enkaina ang Oog, ilo aiguanani le Bashan, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, nikiosh iyiook ninye o metaba anaa neaku meeta ninye olaishirani otelekakaki ninye.

English: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Masaai: Nikiya iyiook nena anas enyena pooki teina kata meetae hoo enkanasa neitu iyiook kiya te ninche - nkanas ntomoni ile, enkop pooki e Argob, ina kitoria e Oog tiatua Bashan.

English: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
Masaai: Ore kuna pooki naa nkanas apa naasheta isunta adoru, o nchomito oo sekenke, ore tenebo nena netii nkang'itie kutiti kumok oleng nemesheta sunta.

English: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
Masaai: Nikindaikie iyiook ninche katukul anaa apa enikinkuna Sihon, ilo aiguanani le Heshbon, aaidaikie pooki anasa, ilewa, o nkituaak o nkera.

English: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
Masaai: Kake ore nkishu pooki o nena masaa naatii nkang'itie kiwaita aaraya.

English: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
Masaai: Neaku kiwaita iyiook ina kop teina kata too nkaik e lelo aiguanak oare le Amori ootii lido kekun le Yordan, ebaiki oerata le Arnon o metabaiki oldoinyo le Hermon.

English: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
Masaai: (Kejo apa lelo le Sidon oldoinyo le Hermon Sirioni, nejo ile Amori Senir).

English: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
Masaai: Ore nena anas pooki eina kop naiperere Gilead pooki o Bashan pooki, ebaiki Saleka o Adrei, nkanas e nkitoria e Oog tiatua Bashan.

English: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
Masaai: Amu Oog ake ilo aiguanani le Bashan etung'ueikiaki olpisiai le Refaim, ng'ura, ore endapash enye naa ene sekenkei; aimetii ninye atua Raba o lelo Amoni? Ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat naaudo ore endapasho naa ntemat ong'uan te ntemata e nkaina o ltung'ani.

English: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
Masaai: Ore apa pee kiya iyiook ina kop teina kata, naisho nanu ile Ruben o le Gad ina kop eiteru te Aroer, natii olkirine lo oerata le Afnon, o lpisiai oitorit ina kop oo ldoinyo e Gilead tenebo nkanas enyena;

English: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
Masaai: ore ina ae kop pooki e Gilead o Bashan pooki, ina kitoria e Oog, aa taa, ina kop pooki e Argob aishoo nanu olpisiai oitorit Manase. Ore ina Bashan pooki naa keji enkop e Refaim.

English: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-Havothjair, unto this day.
Masaai: Ore Yair ilo le Manase neya ina kop pooki e Argob, aa taa Bashan, o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lgeshuri - oloo Lmakaati neipotie nena ang'itie kutiti kewan ajo, Hofot-Yair, anaa enatiu o taata.

English: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
Masaai: Ore Hakir naisho nanu Gilead,

English: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Masaai: ore ile Ruben o le Gad naishoo nanu ina kop ebaiki Gilead o metabaiki oerata le Arnon, tenebo empolos o erata metaa olpolosie o metabaiki olkeju le Yabok, ilo polosie loo Lamori;

English: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
Masaai: o Araban sii tenebo Yordan pee eaku olpolosie, ebaiki Kineret o metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, ina aiposha naisukut, tiabori lelo jurumi le Pisga te nkalo o loo saen.

English: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
Masaai: “Naitanap apa nanu intae teina kata, ajoki, ‘Eishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ena kop pee eaku eninyi; ore lelo lewa linyi ootanapate keeim ninche ene eeta ruparen te dukuya ilalashera linyi, lelo tung'ana le Israel.

English: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
Masaai: Kake ore nkituaak inyi, o nkera inyi kutiti, o nkishu inyi (ayiolo nanu ajo iatata nkishu kumok) netoni ninche te nena anas naishoo nanu intae,

English: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
Masaai: ometaba anaa neisho Olaitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng ilalashera linyi, anaa enaishoo intae, nemany sii ninche ina kop naisho Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninche te lido kekun le Yordan; nitumutumu taa aatorrinyoto, oltung'ani ake, ashomo ine wueji enye naishoo nanu intae.’

English: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
Masaai: Naitanapa apa nanu Yoshua ina kata ajoki, “Etoduaa nkonyek inono nena pooki naataasa Olaitoriani Enkai ino te kulo aiguanak pokira oare; neijia elo aiko Olaitoriani too nkitoriat pooki nilo iyie aimaa,

English: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
Masaai: miureyu ninche amu Olaitoriani Enkai ino oarisho te nkaraki iyie.”

English: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
Masaai: “Nasai nanu Olaitoriani ina kata, ajoki,

English: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
Masaai: ‘Olaitoriani Enkai, nterua iyie aitodol osinka lino enkitoo ino o emagilanisho e nkaina ino; amu kaa ai naatae te keper aashu te nkop naaidim ataasa siaaitin naaijo kuna o nkiaasin magil naaijo ininono?

English: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu matalang'a alo, aatoomono, pee alo adol ina kop sidai te lido kekun le Yordan, idia kop sidai oo ldoinyo, o Lebanon!’

English: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
Masaai: Kake aatagorokine apa nanu Olaitoriani te nkaraki intae, neitu ninye aaning nanu; naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Tabaiki iyie ine; mikingil iyie airorie nanu tialo ena bae.

English: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
Masaai: Ilepa shomo enchumata e Pisga; nishumu inkonyek inono aing'or enkalo oloo ntoluo, naa ng'ura etii ina kop nkonyek inono, amu milo iyie alang ele keju le Yordan.

English: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
Masaai: Kake ntanapa Yoshua, nintagol ninye oshoke nintipij ninye, amu kelang ninye aimu te dukuya kulo tung'ana, naa kelo ninye aitujung ninche ina nilo iyie adol.’

English: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
Masaai: Neaku kitobiko apa iyiook tiatua ilo erata otalakinore Betpeor.

English: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata iyie, Israel, toning'o nkitanapat o kuna kikoot naiteng'en nanu intae, niasiasa ninche, pee itumutumu aatopok nipuopuo aaya ina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi.

English: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
Masaai: “Miponaa ororei teina kitanapata naishoo nanu intae, nimiwuang'ieng'ie; pee itumutumu aaibung'a nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi naitanapa nanu intae.

English: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
Masaai: Etoduaa nkonyek inyi ina nataasa Olaitoriani te Baal-peor; amu eidaikie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi aishie tiatua intae lelo tung'ana pooki ootusujaitie ina kitanyaanyukoto e nkai e Peor.

English: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
Masaai: Kake ore intae ooibung'a aakurraki nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, ninchushu pooki ena olong.

English: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
Masaai: Eng'ura, aiteng'ena nanu intae nkikoot, anaa enaaitanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ai, nchere pee ipuopuo aas teina kop nipuopuo aaya.

English: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
Masaai: Embung'a ninche niasiasa; amu kelo ina aaku eng'eno inyi o eyiolounoto inyi te dukuya iltung'ana, laa, tenening ninche kuna kikoot pooki, nejo, ‘Esipa ore ele osho kitok naa oloo ltung'ana ng'eni.’

English: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
Masaai: Amu kalo osho kitok oata enkai nataaniki anaa enataana Olaitoriani Enkai ang te iyiook, enkata pooki naba anaa enikimpot ninye?

English: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
Masaai: Naa kalo likae osho kitok oata nkikoot o nkiguanat naasipa anaa ena kitanapata nairragie nanu te dukuya intae ena olong?

English: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons' sons;
Masaai: “Tagolie ake kewan, ning'or oltau lino oleng, pee mikirikino ake nena tokitin naatoduaa nkonyek inono, pee milo alamari to ltau lino too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino; ntayiolo ninche nkera inono, o nkera oo nkera inono

English: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
Masaai: eninkuna apa ina olong pee intashe te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino te Horeb, pee aajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Inturrurrokoki nanu kulo tung'ana, pee aitoning nanu ninche irorei laainei, pee aayiolou ninche naaureyu nanu nkolong'i pooki naaishu ninche tioriong enkop, netum sii aaiteng'ena nkera enye nena baa.’

English: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
Masaai: Nietuo apa intae aanyiku nintasheshe te ntonata o ldoinyo, ina kata eyupuyup ilo doinyo te nkima nebaiki olng'ejep keper, neimulumul enkatampoi kitok o empuruo.

English: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
Masaai: Neirorie intae Olaitoriani tiatua empolos eina kima; nining'ining'i oltoilo loo rorei lenyena, kake eitu idolidolo ilo oiro; oltoilo ake itoning'o.

English: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
Masaai: Neibalakinye ninye intae olning'o lenye lo sotua, ilo oitanapa intae pee iasiasa, aa taa, nena kitanapat tomon, neiger ninye ninche too mbelat oo soito naagueta.

English: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
Masaai: Naaitanap nanu Olaitoriani ina kata pee aiteng'en intae nena kikoot o nkiguanat, pee itumutumu aataas ninche teina kop nipuopuo aaya.

English: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina, entujurroto maate. Amu eitu apa idolidolo ilo oiroro teina olong nairorie intae Olaitoriani te Horeb te mpolos enkima,

English: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
Masaai: entodol ate minyalinyala ate aaitobiru nkitanyaanyukot naagueta, te nkaraki intae maate, te mpukunoto e ae toki, te mpukunoto olee aashu e ng'oruoi,

English: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
Masaai: te mpukunoto e ae ng'ues ake ninye natii oriong enkop, te mpukunoto e ae motonyi ake ninye nakuet to loing'ang'e,

English: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
Masaai: te mpukunoto e ae toki ake ninye naiserpepiari te nkop, te mpukunoto osinkirri ake ninye otii atua enkare tiabori enkop.

English: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
Masaai: Naa entodol ate mishumumu ake nkonyek inyi aaing'or shumata, ore ake pee idolidolo enkolong, o lapa o lakir, ilo orora pooki le shumata, neiyiatari intae nipuopuo aaserem ninche nisiayiayia ninche, nena tokitin naatoorikia Olaitoriani Enkai ino iltung'ana pooki ootii abori shumata pooki.

English: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
Masaai: Kake kintayio iyie Olaitoriani, nikintupuku aitung'uaa olkokuet le sekenkei oyupuyup, aitupuku te Misiri, pee iaku olorere lenye kewan, anaa enatiu taata.

English: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, aatagorokine apa nanu Olaitoriani te nkaraki intae, neinos ninye olmumai nchere malang nanu Yordan, o nchere sii, malo nanu ajing ina kop sidai naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee ijung'ujung'u.

English: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
Masaai: Amu meeta nchere maye nanu tena kop, meeta nchere kashomo nanu lido kekun le Yordan kake ilang'ilang'a intae aapuo aaya ina kop sidai.

English: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
Masaai: Eng'ura ate, merikino ake intae olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, apa oitobira ninye tenebo intae, nimintobiruru enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta e ae ake ninye pukunoto natomitikio intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa enkima nanyaisho, Enkai olom.

English: When thou shalt beget children, and children's children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
Masaai: “Te nitum nkera o nkera oo nkera inono, nimoruau teina kop, tenipong'ori aitobiru enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta te mpukunoto ake ninye ae toki, ore te asata eina bae torrono te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino, aitagor ninye,

English: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
Masaai: kaipotu nanu keper o enkop pee kinchakenoki iyie ena olong, nchere ipuopuo nabo kata aaidaaya nipuopuo aaye te lido kekun le Yordan; mipuopuo intae aabik teina kop, kake keidaikieki intae.

English: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
Masaai: Naa kelo Olaitoriani aidapashaki intae iloreren, niakuku kuti tiatua lelo oshon ooreu intae Olaitoriani.

English: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men's hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
Masaai: Ore teine nipuopuo aaisiaai nkaitin oo nkeek o noo soito, ina siaai oo nkaik e tung'ana, ina nemedolisho, nemening'isho nemenya endaa, nemeing'uaya toki.

English: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
Masaai: Kake ore teine ning'oruru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa eitumutumu intae ninye, tenililitutu aaing'oru ninye too ltauja linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki.

English: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
Masaai: Tenijing'ijing'i intae atua osina, nepuonu kuna baa pooki shumata intae too nkolong'i e siadi, nirrinyokinono intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye,

English: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
Masaai: amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa Enkai olng'ur; meitiak ninye intae neidaikie intae nemerikino ninye ilo ning'o lo sotua loo loo papaai linyi apa oinosie olmumai tialo ninche ntarasi.

English: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
Masaai: “Nkilikuanisho taata tialo nena olong'i naatulusoitie, nena apa e dukuya te iyie, ebaiki ina olong apa naitayu Enkai oltung'ani apik oriong enkop, ninkilikuanisho ebaiki eluboto nabo e keper o metabaiki enkae, tenaa ketaase aekata embae kitok naikununo nji aashu tenaa ketoning'oki aekata.

English: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
Masaai: Ketii apa aekata iltung'ana oo toning'o oltoilo le Nkai eiro te mpolos enkima, anaa enitoning'o intae neton ake inchushu?

English: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
Masaai: Tenaa keetae aekata enkai nashomo ayaki kewan olosho aitung'uaa empolos e likae osho, too ntemat, o too nkitoduaat, o too mbaa enking'asia o to larrabal te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o too ntabo sapuki, te risioroto e nena pooki naataasa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te nkaraki intae te Misiri te dukuya nkonyek inyi?

English: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
