Masaai: Ore te intae, neitodoluaki apa, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, metii likae oponieki ninye,

English: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
Masaai: te shumata eishoo ninye intae entoning oltoilo lenye, pee etum aiteng'ena intae, ore te nkop neisho intae entodol ina kima enye kitok, nining'ining'i intae irorei lenyena epuku te mpolos eina kima.

English: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki natonyorra apa ninye iloo papaai linyi negelu eishoi enye te siadi ninche, neitayu intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, te ngolon enye kitok, etii ninye tenebo intae.

English: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
Masaai: Nearaa ninche te dukuya intae iloshon kituaak naa magil aalanag intae maate pee etum aisho intae ina kop enye metaa enjung'ore inyi anaa enatiu taata;

English: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
Masaai: entayiolo naa taata, ena olong nipikipiki iltauja linyi nchere, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai te shumata o tiabori enkop; meetae likae.

English: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
Masaai: Metaa embung'a nkikoot enyena o nkitanapat enyena, nena naitanapa nanu intae ena olong, pee iserianunu intae o nkera inyi te siadi intae, nitumokiki aaitoodoro nkolong'i inyi teina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ntarasi.”

English: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
Masaai: Neiteng'el Musa nkanas uni te nkalo o loo saen lido kekun le Yordan,

English: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
Masaai: pee etum aisikaki oltung'ani oitayu loikop, ilo oar metua o lelatia enye te sesekuan, meatakinore mang'atisho too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, neaku tenesaru ninye nabo e kuna anas neidim aitajeu enkishui enye.

English: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
Masaai: Beser tiatua ina kop naitoriori too ltung'ana le Ruben, o Ramoti tiatua Gilead too ltung'ana le Gad, o Galan tiatua Bashan too ltung'ana le Manase.

English: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
Masaai: Ena enkitanapata nairragie Musa te dukuya nkera oo Siraeli;

English: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
Masaai: kuna ninche enchakenisho, o nkikoot o nkitanapat naa ninche eirorie Musa nkera oo Siraeli ina kata apa eipang'u aapuku te nkop e Misiri,

English: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
Masaai: te lido kekun le Yordan teilo erata oipirakinore Bet-peor, tiatua enkop e Sihon olaiguanani le Amori, apa omanya Heshbon laa ninye etimira Musa o nkera e Israel ina kata apa pee eipang'u ninche te Misiri.

English: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
Masaai: Neya ninche ina kop enye o enkop e Oog olaiguanani le Bashan, o lelo aiguanak oare le Amori, apa oomanya enkalo o loo saen te idia alo Yordan;

English: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
Masaai: ebaiki Aroer, aa ninye naigaraki oerata le Arnon ometabaiki oldoinyo le Sirion (aa taa Hermon)

English: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
Masaai: tenebo ina Araba pooki te nkalo o loo saen le Yordan o metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, tiabori nena kishong'ishong'at e Pisga.

English: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
Masaai: Neiturrurru Musa iltung'ana pooki le Israel, nejoki ninche, “Entoning intae Israel nkikoot o kuna kitanapat nairo nanu too nkiyiaa inyi ena olong, niyiolouu intae ning'oring'oro ate pee iasiasa.

English: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
Masaai: Eitobirua apa Olaitoriani Enkai ang olning'o lo sotua o iyiook te Horeb.

English: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
Masaai: Mme apa loo papa eitobirie Olaitoriani Enkai ang ele ning'o lo sotua, kake iyiook, kulo pooki ootii ene ooishu ena olong.

English: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
Masaai: Eirorie intae Olaitoriani nchororo nkomomi to ldoinyo, te mpolos eina kima,

English: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
Masaai: ina kata aitashe nanu te rishata Olaitoriani o intae teina kata, pee eibalakinye intae ororei lo Laitoriani; amu itureishote apa te nkaraki ina kima, neitu ilepilepe aapuo enchumata oldoinyo. Nejo ninye:

English: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
Masaai: “ ‘Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo likiyaua iyie aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, aitupuku te nkaji e sinkaisho.

English: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
Masaai: “ ‘Miata kulie aitin neme nanu.

English: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
Masaai: “ ‘Mintobiraki kewan enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai nagueta, aashu empukunoto e ae toki natii shumata aashu enatii abori enkop, aashu ina natii atua enkare tiabori enkop;

English: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
Masaai: mirrugokino ninche nimiserem ninche; amu ore nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino naa kara Enkai olom, naitusuj nkera ing'ok oo loo menye o metabaiki eishoi e uni o eniong'uan e lelo laaiba nanu,

English: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
Masaai: kake kaitodolu enyorrata too nkalifuni e lelo laanyor neibung nkitanapat aainei.

English: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
Masaai: “ ‘Mimpot enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ino te nkiguran: amu meikenaa Olaitoriani ajo eitu eitarruoo ilo oipot enkarna enye te nkiguran.

English: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
Masaai: “ ‘Mbung'a enkolong e Sabato, pee intisiny, anaa enikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
Masaai: Too nkolong'i ile taasisho, nias esiai ino pooki;

English: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
Masaai: kake ore enkolong e naapishana naa sabato to Laitoriani Enkai ino; ore teina olong mias hoo ae siai, iyie aashu olayioni lino, aashu entito ino, aashu olaisiaayiani lino, aashu enkaisiaayiani ino, aashu olkiteng lino, aashu osikiria, lino aashu ae ake ninye nabo oo nkishu inono, aashu olomoni otii atua enkaji ino, pee etum aeng'iyeng'ayu olaisiaayiani lino lee o enkaisiaayiani ino tenebo iyie.

English: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
Masaai: Tadamu nchere ira apa osinka te nkop e Misiri, nikintupuku Olaitoriani Enkai ino teine te nkaina enye magilani naitoriori; metaa kintanapa iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino pee imbung enkolong e Sabato.

English: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Masaai: “ ‘Iyanyita papaai lino o ng'utunyi, anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, pee itum ataseriana, nitum atoponai nkolong'i inono, teina kop naaisho nanu iyie.

English: Thou shalt not kill.
Masaai: “ ‘Miar metua

English: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
Masaai: “ ‘Miloloito,

English: Neither shalt thou steal.
Masaai: “ ‘Nimipurrisho.

English: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
Masaai: “ ‘Niminteeniki ilo le latia ino elejare.

English: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour's wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour's house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour's.
Masaai: “ ‘Niming'uar enkitok eilo le latia ino; niming'uar enkaji eilo le latia ino, aashu enkurma enye, aashu olaisiaayiani lenye aashu enkaisiaayiani enye, aashu olkiteng lenye, aashu osikiria lenye, aashu pooki toki ake ninye eilo le latia ino.’

English: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
Masaai: “Kulo rorei eirorie intae Olaitoriani te umata inyi pooki to ldoinyo eimunye empolos e nkima, o enkatampoi o enaimin kitok, to ltoilo kitok; neitu ninye eitoki aponaa toki. Neiger ninye kulo rorei too soito naagueta, naaisho ninye nanu.

English: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
Masaai: “Ore ake pee ining'ining'i ilo toilo epuku te mpolos eina aimin, ina kata eyupuyupito oldoinyo te nkima, nikipuonunu intae aanyikaki, ilukuny pooki oo loshon linyi, olpayiani linyi;

English: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
Masaai: nijojo intae, ‘Ng'ura, eitoduaa iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang enkisisa enye o enkitoo, nikitoning'o iyiook oltoilo lenye epuku te mpolos enkima; kitoduaa iyiook ena olong Enkai eirorie iltung'ana neton ake eishu lelo tung'ana.

English: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
Masaai: Amaa naa taata kainyoo iyiook pee kiye? Amu kemut iyiook ena kima kitok; tenikintoki iyiook aaning oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ang, nikiye.

English: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
Masaai: Amu kaing'ae too looishu pooki oata osesen, otoning'o oltoilo le Nkai naishu eiro eimu empolos e nkima, anaa enikitoning'o iyiook, neton ake kinchu.

English: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
Masaai: Enchom entinyikakaki pee ining'ining'i nena pooki naajo Olaitoriani Enkai ang; nilikiki iyiook nena pooki naaliki intae Olaitoriani Enkai ang; amu eikining iyiook nikiaas.’

English: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
Masaai: “Nening Olaitoriani irorei linyi ina kata apa pee kirorierie nanu; naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Atoning'o nanu irorei le kulo tung'ana likitiakitia ninche; eiroro ninche te sipata nena pooki naatejo.

English: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
Masaai: Oi oshi tenaa keeta ena damunoto anaa ena olong nkolong'i pooki, pee aaureyu nanu neibung nkitanapat aainei pooki, pee etum ninche aataseriana tenebo nkera enye ntarasi.

English: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
Masaai: Shomo tiaaki ninche, “Entorrinyokinoto ilng'oborri linyi.”

English: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, intasho tene te mbata nanu, pee aaliki nkitanapat pooki, o nkikoot o nkiguanat nilo aiteng'en ninche, pee epuo ninche aas teina kop nalo nanu aisho ninche.’

English: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
Masaai: Shomo naa toduaa kewan pee ias anaa enikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino; nimimbelekenya alo enkalo e tatene aashu ene kedienye.

English: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
Masaai: Shomo teina oitoi pooki nikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino, pee itum atopuaa, nitum sii ataseriana, nitumutumu aatobikoi tiatua ina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani.

English: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
Masaai: “Ena enkitanapata, o enkikoo o nkiguanat naaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee aiteng'en intae, pee itumutumu aataas teina kop nipuopuo aaya;

English: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
Masaai: pee itum aturia Olaitoriani Enkai ino, iyie o layioni lino o layiok loo layiok linono, nimbung'ubung'u kuna kikoot pooki, o nkitanapat enyena, naitanap nanu intae, too nkolong'i pooki enkishui inyi; pee etumi aatoponai nkolong'i inyi.

English: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: Toning'o naa, iyie Israel ning'or kewan pee iyau kuna kitanapat; pee itum ataseriana, nitum sii atoponari oleng, anaa apa enaisiligie intae Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi tiatua ina kop naruko naishi o kule.

English: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
Masaai: “Toning'o iyie Israel: ore Olaitoriani Enkai ang naa Olaitoriani obo;

English: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
Masaai: tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki, o te nkishui ino pooki, o te nkidimata ino pooki.

English: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
Masaai: Ore kulo rorei laaitanap nanu iyie ena olong nchoo ejing oltau lino;

English: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
Masaai: nilo iyie aunoki aiteng'en nkera inono, niimaki kulo omon teniton tiatua enkaji ino, o tenilo te nkoitoi, o tenirrag, o tenidumunye.

English: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
Masaai: Niyeniki ninche enkaina ino metaa olmonekie, netiu ninche anaa nkishiliaa te rishata oo nkonyek inyi.

English: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
Masaai: Nisir ninche too mbokishi e kutukaji e nkaji ino o too ntaloishin e kishomi.

English: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
Masaai: “Ore kenya ake pee kiyau Olaitoriani Enkai ino atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai too loo papaai linyi te Abraham, o te Isaak, o te Yakobo, pee eisho intae nkanas sapuki naa sidain neitu ishetishete,

English: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
Masaai: o nkajijik naabore ntokitin pooki sidain neitu intae mputuputu, o lchorroi ooturo leitu intae ituruturu, o nkurman oo sabibu o noo loirienito leitu intae iunuunu, naa tenidaa intae aaraposho,

English: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
Masaai: ning'oring'oro naa ate merikino ake intae Olaitoriani, ilo laa ninye oitupukuo intae aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitung'uaa enkaji e sinkaisho.

English: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
Masaai: Shomo turia Olaitoriani Enkai ino; shomo isiayia ninye, ninos olmumai te nkarna enye.

English: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
Masaai: Milo ake asujaa kulie aitin, nena aitin e lelo tung'ana likimanita iyie.

English: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai ino ilo otii empolos inyi naa Enkai olom; pee meyupuyup ake engoro Olaitoriani Enkai ino tialo yie, nikindaikie ninye aiwuang'ie tioriong enkop.

English: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
Masaai: “Nimitem Olaitoriani Enkai ino, anaa enitetema ninye te Masa.

English: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
Masaai: Mbung'a tukurraki nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino o shakenisho enye, o nkikoot enyena apa nikintanapa ninye.

English: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
Masaai: Naa ias iyie esidai naishiakino too nkonyek o Laitoriani, pee itum ataseriana, nitum sii ashomo aawa ina kop sidai apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai pee eisho iloo papaai linyi

English: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
Masaai: nchere kerrumoo ninye aipang'ie ilmang'ati linyi te dukuya intae, anaa enaisiligishore Olaitoriani.

English: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
Masaai: “Ore akenya tinikinkilikuan olayioni lino te nkata nalotu ajoki, ‘Kainyoo eutu ena shakenisho, o kuna kikoot o nkitanapat, o nkiguanat nikintanapa iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang?’

English: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh's bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
Masaai: Nitum taa atiaki olayioni lino, ‘Eikira apa irrindiki le Farao te Misiri; neyau iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri te nkaina magilani;

English: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
Masaai: neitodolu Olaitoriani nkitoduaat o mbaa enking'asia, mbaa sapuki naaitureisho tialo Misiri o tialo Farao o enkaji enye pooki, nikidol too nkonyek ang;

English: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
Masaai: neyau ninye iyiook aitupuku teine, pee etum aitijing'u iyiook neisho iyiook ina kop apa nainosie ninye olmumai pee eisho loo papa.

English: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
Masaai: Neitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani pee kiaas kuna kikoot pooki, pee kiureyu Olaitoriani Enkai ang, te nkaraki eseriani ang maate e anaake, pee etum ninye atagolie iyiook metaa eikinchu anaa enikitiu ena olong.

English: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
Masaai: Naa kelo ena aaku esipata te iyiook, teniking'or aabaraki pee kiaas ena kitanapata pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang anaa enaitanapa ninye iyiook.’

English: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
Masaai: “Teneyau akenya intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi atua ina kop nijing'itata aapuo aaya, neiwuang'ie ninye lelo oreren ootii dukuya intae, Ilhiti, o Ilgashi, o Ilamori, o Ilkanaani, o Ilperesi o Ilhafi, o Lyebusi, lelo oshon pokira oopishana kituaak naa magil aalang intae,

English: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
Masaai: naa teneishoru ninche Olaitoriani apik nkaik inyi, nimirimiri intae ninche, nitumutumu taa aaidaikie ninche katukul; emipuo ake aaitobir olning'o o ninche, nimintodolulu olng'ur te ninche.

English: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
Masaai: Nimiyamama intae o ninche aaisho intoyie inyi ilayiok lenye aashu aayamaki ntoyie enye ilayiok linyi.

English: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
Masaai: Amu keidim ninche aaibelekenya ilayiok linyi maaitoki aairukurukore nanu, pee eisiaai kulie aitin enye; netum engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyupo tialo intae, naa keidim ninye aidaikie intae nabo kata.

English: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
Masaai: Kake nji intae entaasa ninche: enchom entigil ilperereni lenye loo lasarri nintaa ing'apeta enye mbelibelat, nitururu aadotu ina kitanyaanyukoto enye e nkai naji Asherim aapejoo te nkima nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin naaguetuno.

English: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: “Amu irara intae olorere oitisinyakaki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; etegelua intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee iakuku olorere lenye makewan, negelu intae tiatua lelo oreren pooki ootii oriong enkop.

English: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
Masaai: Mme apa enkaraki nirara intae kumok aalang ilkulikae tung'ana pee etipika Olaitoriani enyorrata enye shumata intae negelu intae, amu intae apa kuti aalang iloreren pooki;

English: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
Masaai: kake enkaraki nanyor intae Olaitoriani; neibung'ita ninye ilo mumai apa oinosie loo papaai linyi, ina pee eyaua intae Olaitoriani aipang'unye te nkaina magilani, nekordu intae Olaitoriani aitupuku te nkaji e sinkaisho, aitung'uaa enkaina e Farao ilo aiguanani le Misiri.

English: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
Masaai: Tayiolo naa nchere, Olaitoriani Enkai ino ninye Enkai, ina Ai naisiligayu naibung olning'o o enyorrata nauno te lelo oonyor ninye neibung nkitanapat enyena, ometabaiki iishoritin enkalifu,

English: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
Masaai: neitalaku te lelo ooiba ninye, eidaikie ninche; meshololo te lelo ooiba ninye, keitalaku te ninye teine ake.

English: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
Masaai: Eng'ura naa pee iasiasa ina kitanapata, o nena kikoot, o nkiguanat naitanapa nanu intae ena olong.

English: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki nitoning'o intae kuna kiguanat, nimbung'ubung'u niasiasa ninche, keibung Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo intae ilo ning'o oina nyorrata nauno apa nainosie olmumai too loo papaai linyi nchere keibung.

English: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
Masaai: Kenyorru ninye intae, nemayian intae, nepon intae, kemayian sii lelo ng'anayio lo sesen lino o lelo ng'anayio le nkop ino, enkurma ino, o enaisho oo sabibu ino, o eilata ino, nepon nkishu inono o ntare inono teina kop apa nainosie olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho intae.

English: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
Masaai: Kemayian intae aaitulus too loreren pooki; meitokini aata olee aashu eng'oruoi olupi tiatua intae, aashu tiatua nchoo inyi.

English: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
Masaai: Naa kelo Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie tiatua intae emuoyian pooki nemeetae hoo nabo te nena muoyiaritin torrok e Misiri niyiololo, nalotu shumata intae kake keiteleiki ninye shumata lelo pooki ooiba intae.

English: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
Masaai: Naa ipuopuo intae aaidaikie lelo oreren pooki ooisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, melo hoo enkong'u inyi aing'urrie ninche, nimilo iyie aisiaai nkaitin enye, amu kelo ina aaku orreshet te intae.

English: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
Masaai: “Tenijo iyie to ltau lino, ‘Eikituaak kulo oshon aalang iyiook, kaji nanu aiko tenaiwuang'ie ninche?’

English: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
Masaai: Milo iyie aureyu ninche, kake shomo tadamu ina apa naitaasa Olaitoriani Enkai ino Farao o Misiri pooki,

English: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
Masaai: nena baa sapuki nitoduaa iyie too nkonyek inono, nena kitoduaat o nena enking'asia, ina aina magilani, oina aina naitoriori naa ninye kintupukunye Olaitoriani Enkai ino; naa neijia elo Olaitoriani Enkai ino aiko te lelo oreren pooki liure.

English: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
Masaai: Keirriu sii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi olmeitai atua ninche, ometaba anaa ore ninye lelo ooleku eisudori eure intae neidak.

English: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
Masaai: Mimputukuny te nkaraki ninche; amu etii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi empolos inyi, ina Ai kitok naitureisho.

English: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
Masaai: Keiwuang'ie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi kulo oshon te dukuya iyie aa kutiti; mindaikie iyie ninche pooki nabo kata, pee mikirasaki ake ing'uesi entim.

English: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
Masaai: Kake eikintarasaki iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino ninche, nepik ninche olmilo o metaba anaa neidak.

English: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
Masaai: Neishoru ninye ilaiguanak lenye apik nkaik inyi, nimisie iyie enkarna enye aiwuang'ie te nkop; meetae hoo oltung'ani obo likindim ashomo aipirakinore, o metaba anaa nindaikie ninche.

English: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno oo nkaitin enye shomo tapejoi te nkima; ming'uar ina osholai anaa ina sahabu napetokino ninche, nimiyaya intae maate, mijing'ijing'i ake orreshet; amu oldeket ina to Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
Masaai: Nimiyauu nkajijik inyi ina toki nara olminong, miakuku ake oldeket anaa ninye, mbai tukul nilam amu entoki nadiaa.

English: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
Masaai: “Ore kuna kitanapat naitanapa nanu intae ena olong enchom entisipu entaas, pee itumutumu aatopok niponariri, nipuopuo aaya ina kop nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai pee eisho loo papaai linyi.

English: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
Masaai: Nidamumu ina oitoi pooki natorikunye intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te kulo arin artam tiong'ata, pee etum ninye aitoborro intae, netem intae, pee etum atayiolo ina natii iltauja linyi, tenaa imbung'ubung'u,

English: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
Masaai: neitobor ninye intae, neisho intae esumash, neitoti intae te Mana, apa nimiyiololo intae, nemeyiolo sii apa loo papaai linyi; pee etum ninye aitayiolo intae nchere, meishu oltung'ani te nkaraki endaa ake, kake keishu oltung'ani te nkaraki pooki toki naing'uaa enkutuk o Laitoriani.

English: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
Masaai: Eitu apa epolosa nkilani inyi, neitu ejeyu nkejek inyi, te kulo arin artam.

English: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
Masaai: Tayiolo naa to ltau lino nchere, ore anaa enaitame oltung'ani enkerai enye aikintame sii ninye iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
Masaai: Metaa shomo mbung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, alo too nkoitoi enyena niureyu ninye.

English: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
Masaai: Amu eikiyau iyie Olaitoriani Enkai atua enkop sidai, enkop oo nong'ot naatii nkariak, neetii nchorroi oo nkonyek, naarukunye too erat o too ldoinyo,

English: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
Masaai: enkop e nkano o entapa, enkop oo sabibu o lng'abolo, o lng'anayio, enkop oo loirienito o enaisho,

English: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
Masaai: ina enkop nilo iyie aadaare nimintoki aekata aisumashu, nimilaunye toki, ina kop naa ore isoito lenyena naa sekenke, ore too ldoinyo linono nilo aturu osuyai.

English: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
Masaai: Nilo iyie adaa araposho, nisis Olaitoriani Enkai ino teina kop sidai nikinchoo ninye iyie.

English: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
Masaai: “Toduaa naa ake mikirikino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nipal eitu imbung nena kitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena o nkiguanat enyena naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong.

English: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
Masaai: Pee tenilo nidaa araposho, nishet nkajijik sidain nimany,

English: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
Masaai: ore teneponari nkishu inono o ntare, neponari nkoshola inono o sahabu, ore nena pooki niata neponari,

English: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
Masaai: nedumunye taa oltau lino, nikirikino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, laa ninye likiyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitupuku te nkaji e sinkaisho,

English: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
Masaai: laa ninye likitorikoyie aimie ilo purkel kitok, ilo otii lasuriaa torrok o nkolupani oina kop natoyio nemetii enkare, laa ninye likiyaka iyie enkare aimunye e ndapidapoi nagol.

English: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
Masaai: Naa ninye likintotio iyie tiong'ata teina mana apa nemeyiolo loo papaai linyi; pee kitum aitoborro nikitem iyie, pee kitum ninye aitaasa esidai te siadi.

English: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
Masaai: Toduaa kewan, pee mijo ake to ltau lino, ‘Engolon ai o enkidimata e nkaina ai anotie nanu kuna masaa!

English: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
Masaai: Tadamu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, amu ninye likincho iyie engolon niakunye karsis; pee etum aitudupa ilo mumai apa oinosie loo papaai linyi, anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
Masaai: Naa tenikirikino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nilo arubare kulie aitin nisiaai ninche niserem ninche, kaaunoki nanu aikok ena olong nchere ilo ake aidak.

English: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
Masaai: Anaa lelo oshon ooishoo Olaitoriani mediaa te dukuya nkonyek inono, enkaraki nimiyieu iyie nining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
Masaai: “Toning'o iyie Israel, ilo taata iyie alang Yordan, pee ilo aiwuang'ie nimany lelo oshon kituaak naa magil te intae, nena anas naateshetaki aaitabaiki shumata,

English: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
Masaai: lelo tung'ana oogol naa adoru, lelo ayiok le Anakim, liyiololo intae, nitoning'o intae nijojo, ‘Kaing'ae naidim aitasheikinore ilayiok le Anak?’

English: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
Masaai: Tayiolo naa ena olong nchere ore ilo oloito te dukuya intae anaa enkima nanyaisho naa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; keidaikie ninche neishie ninche te dukuya intae; metaa ipuopuo intae aamiraa ninche, nimutumutu ninche nabo kata, anaa enaisiligie Olaitorianiintae.

English: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
Masaai: “Milo ake ajo to ltau lino, teneidip Olaitoriani aturrumoi ninche te dukuya intae, ‘Tenkaraki esupatisho ai peyie aayawua nanu Olaitoriani maawa ena kop,’ amu enkaraki entorroni e kulo oshon pee eturrumoyie Olaitoriani ninche te dukuya intae.

English: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
Masaai: Mme te nkaraki esupatisho ino aashu emborron oltau lino pee ilo iyie aya ina kop enye; kake te nkaraki entorroni e kulo oshon pee earaa Olaitoriani ninche aipang'ie te dukuya intae, pee etum ninye atudupa ilo rorei apa oinosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loopapaai linyi, Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo.

English: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
Masaai: “Tayiolo naa nchere, mikinchorita iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino ena kop sidai te nkaraki esupatisho; amu ira iyie olorere ogolong'u.

English: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
Masaai: Tadamu nimincho kirikino ina apa nintagoro Olaitoriani Enkai ino to lpurkel; ebaiki ina olong apa nitupukuo iyie te nkop e Misiri ometaba anaa nilotu ene wueji, igolong'aki oshiake Olaitoriani.

English: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
Masaai: Ore ninye apa to ldoinyo le Horeb nintagoro intae Olaitoriani, negorokino intae Olaitoriani oleng eyieu eidaikie intae.

English: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
Masaai: Ore apa nena soito naagueta, nena soito dapashi o lning'o lo sotua apa naaitobira Olaitoriani tenebo intae, natobiko nanu to ldoinyo nkolong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam; neitu nanu anya endaa anaa aok enkare.

English: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
Masaai: Naaisho nanu Olaitoriani nena soito are naagueta naaigeroki to lkimojino le Nkai, neigerokino ninche lelo rorei pooki apa ooirorie Olaitoriani intae to ldoinyo aimunye empolos enkima teina olong apa eumata.

English: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena olong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam naaisho nanu Olaitoriani nena soito pokira are naagueta, nena soito olning'o lo sotua.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
Masaai: Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, ‘Tudumunye, shomo tadoi tasiooi tung'uai ene; amu ore iltung'ana linono apa liyaua aitung'uaa Misiri netaasa entorroni; eibelekenyate ninche aasioki aapaash ina oitoi apa naitanapa ninche; eitobirakitia ninche ate enkitanyaanyukoto naasholuno.’

English: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
Masaai: “Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, ‘Atoduaa nanu kulo tung'ana, naa ng'ura iltung'ana oogolong'u ninche;

English: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
Masaai: tapalaki nanu, pee atumoki aidaikie, naiwuang'ie nanu enkarna enye te nkop, naitayu nanu te iyie olosho magilani naa kitok alang ninche.’

English: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
Masaai: Neaku aibelekenye apa nanu nadou to ldoinyo, naa keyupuyup apa ilo doinyo te nkima; ore nena soito are naagueta olning'o lo sotua netii nkaik ainei.

English: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
Masaai: Naing'orisho nanu, naa ng'ura, itaasa intae eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; intobirakitia ate olashe osholuno; itasiokitio intae aaibelekenya aaing'uaa ina oitoi naitanapa intae Olaitoriani.

English: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
Masaai: Neaku aibung'a apa nanu nena soito pokira are naagueta, narrar nanu ninche te dukuya nkonyek inyi.

English: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
Masaai: Nairrabalakino nanu enkop te dukuya Olaitoriani anaa apake, nkolong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam; neitu ainos endaa aashu aok enkare, te nkaraki ina ng'oki pooki nitaasa, aas ina bae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, aaitagor ninye.

English: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
Masaai: Amu kaure apa nanu engoro oina pijan apa naata Olaitoriani tialo intae, ometaa kejo aidaikie intae. Kake aatoning'o ake sii Olaitoriani ina kata.

English: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
Masaai: Netagorokine sii apa Olaitoriani Aron ometaa kejo aidaikie ninye; naomonoki sii apa ninye Aron ina kata.

English: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu adumu ina ng'oki torrono, ilo ashe apa lintobira napejoo te nkima nabelibel ninye, ayutuyut ometotiuo anaa empunyua; nanang'aki nanu ina punyua enye ina reyiet nadou to ldoinyo.

English: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
Masaai: “Ore sii apa te Tabera, o te Masa o te Kibrotafa intagoro intae Olaitoriani,

English: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
Masaai: naa ore apa pee eirriwaa intae Olaitoriani Kadesh-Barnea, ejo, ‘Elepa enchom embung'a ina kop naishoo nanu intae’ nitogolong'akita intae enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, neitu intae irukuruku ninye aashu ining'ining'i oltoilo lenye.

English: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
Masaai: Itaa intae iloogolong'aki Olaitoriani ebaiki ina olong natayiolo intae.

English: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
Masaai: “Neaku airrabalakine nanu enkop te dukuya Olaitoriani te kuna olong'i artam e nkewarieitin artam, naatejo Olaitoriani keidaikie intae.

English: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
Masaai: Naomon nanu Olaitoriani najo, ‘Olaitoriani Enkai, Ooi mindaikie iltung'ana linono o enjung'ore ino, laa iyie otokordua te nkitoo ino, naa iyie oitupukuo te nkop e Misiri te nkaina magilani.

English: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
Masaai: Tadamu isinkan linono, Abraham o Isaak o Yakobo; mishilaa engolon enkong'u ele orere, aashu ntorrok enye, aashu eng'oki enye,

English: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
Masaai: mejo ake ina kop nintupukunye iyiook, “Enkaraki apa nemeidim Olaitoriani ayau ninche atua ina kop apa naisiligie ninche, naa ore enkaraki naibayie ninye ninche eitupukuo ninche pee elotu aar ninche tiong'ata.”

English: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
Masaai: Amu iltung'ana linono ninche naa enjung'ore ino ninche, laa iyie oitupukuo ninche te ngolon ino kitok o te nkaina ino naitoriori.’

English: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
Masaai: “Ore apa teina kata naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Tagueta mbaoi are o soit naatiu anaa inapa e dukuya, nilepu alotu enatii to ldoinyo, nintobir osanduku loo nkeek.

English: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
Masaai: Naa kaiger nanu te nena soito dapashi irorei ootii nena soito e dukuya nitebela, nipik iyie ninche atua osanduku.

English: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
Masaai: Neaku aitobira apa nanu osanduku too nkeek, naguetu mbaoi are o soit naatiu anaa ine dukuya, nailep alo oldoinyo aata nena soito pokira te nkaina ai.

English: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
Masaai: Neiger ninye te nena soito, anaa apa ine dukuya, nena kitanapat tomon apa naairorie intae Olaitoriani to ldoinyo eimunye empolos enkima teina olong apa eumata; naaisho nanu Olaitoriani nena soito.

English: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
Masaai: Naibelekenya nanu nadou to ldoinyo, napik nena soito atua ilo sanduku laitobira; naa ine taata etii, anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest's office in his stead.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana le Israel te Beerot Beneyaakan ometabaiki Mosera. Neye Aron teine naa teine etunukayioki; Neisiaisho olayioni lenye Eliesa anaa olapolosani te rishata enye.

English: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
Masaai: Nedumunye teine nepuo Gadugoda, nedumunye te Gadugoda nepuo Yotbata, enkop oo nchorroi oo nkariak.

English: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata neiteng'el Olaitoriani olosho le Lawi pee enap ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua le Nkai, neitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani aaisiaai ninye nemayianisho te nkarna enye o taata.

English: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
Masaai: Metaa meeta Lawi erubata e njung'ore tiatua ilalashera lenyena; Olaitoriani ninye enjung'ore enye, anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninye.

English: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
Masaai: “Naton nanu to ldoinyo anaa apa te nkata e dukuya, nkolong'i artam o nkewarieitin artam, naatoning'o sii apa Olaitoriani ina kata; neany Olaitoriani eidaikie intae.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Tudumunye, shomo te lototo ino tijing'a dukuya iltung'ana, pee etum ninche aashum aaibung'a ina kop, apa nainosie olmumai too loo menye pee aisho ninche.’

English: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
Masaai: “Amaa taata Israel, kainyoo eyieu Olaitoriani Enkai ino te iyie, neme teniureyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nilo too nkoitoi enyena pooki, ninyorru ninye, nisiaai Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki.

English: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
Masaai: Nimbung nena kitanapat o nkiguanat o Laitoriani naaitanapa nanu iyie ena olong te nkaraki eseriani ino.

English: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD'S thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
Masaai: Ng'ura eno Laitoriani keper nalakua aisul, o enkop o pooki toki natii atua;

English: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
Masaai: kake ore eyia, etonyorra Olaitoriani to ltau lenye loo papaai linyi negelu ninye eishoi enye te siadi ninche, aitulus too loreren pooki, anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
Masaai: Entumurat naa isuaten oo ltauja linyi, nimintokiki aagolong'u.

English: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai ino naa Enkai oo nkaitin naa Olaitoriani loo laitoriak. Ina Ai kitok magilani naitureisho, nemeeta olkep nemeropayu.

English: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
Masaai: Keiguanare ninye te sipata olokishi o enkoliai, nenyor ninye ilo omoni, neisho ninye endaa o nkilani.

English: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Tonyorra naa ilo ora omoni; amu irara sii apa intae omon te nkop e Misiri.

English: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
Masaai: Shomo turia Olaitoriani Enkai ino, shomo isiayia ninye nimbung'are ninye, naa te nkarna enye inosinoso olmumai.

English: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
Masaai: Ninye enkisisa inyi, ninye Enkai inyi, ina nataasa kuna baa kituaak naaitureisho naatoduaa nkonyek inyi.

English: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
Masaai: Eshomo apa iloo papaai linyi Misiri aa iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana; ore taata neitotiuo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi anaa ilakir le shumata te nkumoi.

English: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
Masaai: “Shomo naa tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nimbung enkitanapata enye, o nkikoot enyena o nkiguanat enyena, o nkitanapat enyena anaake.

English: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
Masaai: Naa entadamu ena olong (nchere, mme nkera inyi nanu airorie neitu eyiolou aashu edol) entadamu nkitamiot o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, enkitoo enye, o enkaina enye magilani o enkaina enye naitoriori.

English: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
Masaai: Nena kitoduaat enyena o nkiaasin enyena apa naaitaasa ninye te Misiri, Farao olaiguanani le Misiri; o enkop enye pooki,

English: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
Masaai: oina apa naitaasa ninye enjore e Misiri, nena bartan enye o nena garrin enye oo mbartan; ina naikuna ninye pee eitaya ninche enkare Enaiposha Nanyokie ina kata esujita ninche intae, ina naikuna Olaitoriani pee eidaikie ninche o taata;

English: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
Masaai: oina naitaasa intae ti ong'ata ometaba anaa nipuonunu ene wueji

English: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
Masaai: oina naitaasa ninye Datan o Abiram lelo ayiok le Aliab, olayioni le Ruben, ina natabolo enkop enkutuk neijoo ninche tenebo ilmareita lenye, o lng'oborri lenye, o pooki toki naishu apa nasujita ninche, te mpolos e Israel pooki;

English: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.
Masaai: Amu etoduaa nkonyek inyi ina siaai pooki kitok o Laitoriani nataasa.

English: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
Masaai: “Enchom naa embung'a kuna kitanapat pooki naitanapa nanu intae ena olong, pee itumutumu aatagol, nipuopuo aaya ina kop nilang'akiki aapuo aaya,

English: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: nibikoo sii teina kop nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho ninche o eishoi enye, ina kop naruko kule o enaisho.

English: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
Masaai: Amu ore ine nijing'itata aaya nemetiu anaa enkop e Misiri ning'uaa, ina kop nituunie intae ilanterera linyi nipikipiki enkare too nkejek inyi, anaa olchampa loo mpogai;

English: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
Masaai: kake ore ina kop nilang'itata aapuo aaya naa enkop oo ldoinyo o nong'ot ine neshaiki ninche enchan naing'uaa keper,

English: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
Masaai: enkop ina nagolie Olaitoriani te nkaraki intae; eing'orita nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai ino shumata ninye anaake, ebaiki enkiterunoto o lari o metabaiki enkiting'oto o lari.

English: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
Masaai: “Naa tenimbung'ubung'u intae kuna kitanapat aainei naitanap nanu intae ena olong, aanyorru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nisiayiayia ninye too ltauja linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki,

English: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
Masaai: naa keishoru ninye enchan te nkop inyi too nkatitin enyena, ina shan oltumurel naituruku oina shan oo nkokua, pee itumutumu aaiturrurro tiatua enkurma inyi o sabibu linyi o eilata inyi.

English: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
Masaai: Naa keishoru ninye nkujit te nkop inyi te nkaraki nkishu inyi, nidaa intae aaraposho.

English: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
Masaai: Entodol ate emileja too ltauja linyi, nimbelekenyanya aaisiaai kulie aitin niserememe ninche,

English: And then the LORD'S wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
Masaai: ore engoro o Laitoriani neyupuyup tialo intae, neiken ninye shumata, ometaa meetae enchan, nemeiu enkop ilng'anayio, nindaayaya nabo kata aaishunye teina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani.

English: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
Masaai: “Entushum naa kulo rorei laainei too ltauja linyi, o te nkishui inyi; nieniene ninche metaa olmonekie too nkaik inyi, netiu ninche anaa enkishili too nkomomi inyi.

English: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
Masaai: Ninteng'ening'ene ninche nkera inyi, niimakiki ninche itonini too nkajijik inyi o ipuopuo te nkoitoi, o irurara o itonini.

English: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
Masaai: Ningerigere ninche too molinkaishi oo nkutukie oo nkajijik inyi o too nchomito inyi.

English: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
Masaai: Pee etumi aatopon inkolong'i inono o nkolong'i oo nkera inono teina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai linyi pee eisho ninche, anaa enatii keper shumata enkop.

English: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
Masaai: Amu tenigolie kewan aas ena kitanapata naaitanap nanu iyie taasa, anyorru Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nilo too nkoitoi enyena pooki, nimbung'are ninye,

English: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
Masaai: nearaa Olaitoriani kulo oshon pooki ootii dukuya ino, niyaya iloshon kituaak naa magil aalang intae.

English: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji neroro nkejek inyi naa keaku eninyi; ore enkop inyi naa keiteru ebaiki ong'ata o Lebanon o ebaiki olkeju le Frati o metabaiki enaiposha enkalo oloo ntoluo.

English: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani likiindim ashomo airisha; kelo Olaitoriani opik enkuretisho te nkaraki intae o loputukunyi te nkaraki intae shumata ina kop pooki niimiimi, anaa enaisiligie ninye intae.

English: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
Masaai: “Ng'ura kapik nanu dukuya intae ena olong emayianata o ldeket:

English: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
Masaai: emayianata tenimbung'ubung'u nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, naitanapa apa nanu intae ena olong,

English: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
Masaai: oldeket, tenimibung'ubung'u intae nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, nimbelekenyanya aaing'uaa ina oitoi naitanapa nanu intae ena olong, nipuopuo aasujaa kulie aitin apa neitu intae iyiolouu.

English: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
Masaai: Naa teneyau intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi atua ina kop nijing'itata aapuo aaya, enchom entamayianisho to ldoinyo le Gerisim nidekishosho to ldoinyo le Ebal.

English: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
Masaai: Aimetii ninche lido kekun le Yordan, enkalo o loo ntoluo enkoitoi dapash endoyioroto enkolong, tiatua enkop oo Lkanaani apa laa ninche emanya Araba, eipirakinore Gilgal embata oo lkeek le More?

English: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
Masaai: Amu ipuopuo intae aalang Yordan, nipuopuo aaya ina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani; naa tenindipidipi aawaita nimanyimanya,

English: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.
Masaai: enchom entodol ate entabaraki pee iasiasa nena kikoot pooki o nkiguanat naitanapa nanu intae ena olong.

English: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche nkikoot o nkiguanat nilo iyie aing'or te ina kop nikichoo iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi pee iya, too nkolong'i pooki ninchu tioriong enkop.

English: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
Masaai: Shomo tukul indaikie nena wuejitin pooki apa neeisiayie nkaitin enye lelo oshon litimira nkaitin enye, too nchumat oo ldoinyo o too nchumat oo ndoinyo kutiti o tiabori pooki shani onyori;

English: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
Masaai: tusulai ilpereren lenye loo lasarri; nintaa irrarrat ing'apeta enye, nipejoo Asherim enye te nkima; nisulaki iyie enkop nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaitaa nkaitin, nindaikiekie enkarna enye aaishie teine wueji.

English: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
Masaai: Milo iyie aiko neijia to Laitoriani Enkai ino,

English: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
Masaai: kake ilo iyie aing'oru ine wueji negelu Olaitoriani Enkai ino tiatua iloshon linyi pooki pee ipikipiki enkarna enye nintaa ine emanyisho enye; neijia eikenari,

English: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
Masaai: naa neijia enkuna eyau ilasarri linyi oopejori o nkishorot inyi, e matua e tomon, o lasarri ooitarasari, o lasarri to lmumai, o nkishorot o lpela, o lkikaunot linyi loo nkishu o loo ntare;

English: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
Masaai: ore teine nipuopuo aadaa te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nipuopuo aang'ida, intae olmareita linyi, teina pooki nipuopuo aas aa te ninye emayian intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
Masaai: Miasiasa intae terisioroto e kuna pooki nikiaasita iyiook tene taata, easita ake pooki tung'ani enaba anaa enaishiakino too nkonyek enyena makewan,

English: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
Masaai: amu eton intae eitu ipuonunu ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata oina jung'ore naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
Masaai: Kake tenilang'ilang'a intae aapuo lido kekun le Yordan, nitonini teina kop naisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi entujung, naa teneisho ninye intae enkiyeng'iyeng te lelo mang'ati linyi pooki oomanita intae, metaa itonini te seriani,

English: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
Masaai: ore teine wueji nelo agelu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee epik enkarna enye metobiko teine, ine eyau nena pooki naitanap intae; ilasarri linyi oopejori o nkishorot inyi, o ematua inyi e tomon o nena kishorot nintarasaa, o nena kishorot ninosie olmumai pee inchosho Olaitoriani.

English: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
Masaai: Ning'idayuyu intae te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, o layiok linyi o ntoyie inyi o sinkan lewa, o sinkan inyi ng'oruo, o lawi ootii atua nkang'itie inyi, enkaraki nemeeta ninye erubata aashu enjung'ore tiatua intae.

English: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
Masaai: Toduaa naa pee mintayu olasar lino opejori te pooki wueji nidol;

English: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
Masaai: kake teine negelu Olaitoriani ti obo loo loshon, linyi, teine iyie shomo intayu ilasarri linyi oopejori naa teine shomo taasa kuna pooki, naaitanap iyie.

English: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
Masaai: “Ore tenebo nena, indimidimi aateyieng eng'ues ninosinoso tiatua nkang'itie inyi, anaa eniyieuu, te risioroto e mayianata o laitoriani Enkai inyi naishoo ninye intae; ore ilo osinyari, o lemesinyari keidim ainosa, anaa naaji enkoilii anaa empanas;

English: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
Masaai: osarge ake miinos; tubukoki ninye enkop anaa enkare.

English: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
Masaai: Mindimidimi aainosa tiatua nkang'itie ina rubata O Laitoriani e ntapa inyi aashu enoo sabibu aashu eneilata, aashu iloo ntare, aashu pooki ake ninye asar linchorutua te nkinosata olmumai, aashu lelo asarri linyi le nyorrata, aashu lelo asarri lintarasaa,

English: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
Masaai: kake indimidimi intae aainosa te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, teine wueji nelo Olaitoriani Enkai ino agelu, ninos iyie o layioni lino o entito ino, o sinka lino lee o esinka ino ng'oruoi, oilo tung'ani loo Lawi otii atua nkang'itie inyi, nilo iyie ang'ida te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino teina pooki nilo aas.

English: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
Masaai: Toduaa naa kewan minturraa ilo tung'ani loo Lawi otii atua te nkata pooki naba anaa enitii atua enkop ino.

English: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
Masaai: “Teneponaa Olaitoriani Enkai ino enkop ino, anaa enikisiligie ninye, nijo iyie, ‘Kainos nanu nkiri,’ amu itang'uarra nkiri, indim ainosa nkiri naaba anaa iniyieu.

English: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
Masaai: Tenaa kelakua ine wueji nategelua Olaitoriani Enkai ino pee epik enkarna enye nindim naa ateyiang'a enkiteng ino nabo aashu ina ker ino nabo nikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino, anaa enaaitanapa nanu iyie; nindim iyie ainosa tiatua nkang'itie inyi anaa eniyieu.

English: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
Masaai: Ore anaa enainosi enkoilii o empanas, neaku indim sii iyie ainosa; ore ilo osinyari olemesinyari neidim ainosa.

English: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
Masaai: Tayiolo ntisipa pee minos osarge, amu ore osarge naa enkishui, niminos iyie enkishui tenebo nkiri.

English: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
Masaai: Minos iyie osarge, naa tubukoki enkop anaa enkare.

English: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Minos iyie osarge pee eitobirari mbaa inono pooki o noo nkera inono itulusoyie. Tenias iyie esidai too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:
Masaai: Kake ore nena tokitin sinyat (naatabaitie te iyie, o lasarri linono, shomo iyie iwa, nilo ine wueji negelu Olaitoriani,

English: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
Masaai: nilo aitayu lelo asarri linono oopejori, nkiri o sarge, te nchumata olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino; ore ilo sarge loo lasarri linono nepuoi aabukoki enchumata olperere lo lasar lo laitoriani Enkai ino, kake indim ainosa nkiri.

English: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Toduaa kewan pee imbung kulo rorei pooki laaitanapa nanu pee iserianu iyie o nkera inono itulusoyie ntarasi, te nias iyie ina sidai neishiakino too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
Masaai: “Tenelo akenya neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te dukuya intae lelo oshon lipuopuo intae aaya enkop enye, niwuang'ieng'ie intae ninche nimanyimanya enkop enye,

English: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
Masaai: entodol ate mijing'ijing'i ake orreshet aasujaa ninche, eidipaki aaidaikie ninche te dukuya nkonyek inyi, niminkilikuanunu nkaitin enye, ijojo, ‘Kaji apa eiko kulo oshon teneisiai nkaitin enye? - pee aiko sii nanu neijia!’

English: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
Masaai: Mias iyie ina to Laitoriani Enkai ino; amu ore pooki toki nara olminong naiba Olaitoriani eitaasa apa ninche nkaitin enye; amu kepejoo doi ninye ilayiok o ntoyie enye te nkima aapejoki nkaitin enye.

English: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
Masaai: “Ore ina toki ake ninye pooki naaitanapa nanu tisipu pee ias; miponiki iyie toki aashu intong'or toki.

English: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
Masaai: “Tenedumunye oloiboni tiatua intae, aashu olaidetidetani loo nkidetidetat, neisho intae enkitoduaata aashu embae e nking'asia,

English: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
Masaai: nelotu ina kitoduaata aashu ina bae e nking'asia natiaka ninye intae aaku, naa tenejo ninye, ‘Maape iyiook aasujaa kulie aitin apa neitu intae iyiolouu, naa maisiaayia iyiook ninche,’

English: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
Masaai: nimining'ining'i intae lelo rorei leilo oiboni aashu ilo aidetidetani loo nkidetidetat; amu ketem, intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee eyiolou tenaa inyorrinyorro intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi to ltauja linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki

English: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
Masaai: shomo iyie tudumunye tusujai Olaitoriani Enkai ino niureyu ninye, nimbung nkitanapat enyena nining oltoilo lenye, nisiai ninye nimbung'are ninye.

English: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oiboni aashu ilo aidetidetani loo nkidetidetat neari metua, amu eiteng'enishe ninye engolong'akinoto tialo Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo laa ninye likiyaua iyie aitupuku tiatua enkop e Misiri, nikikordu ninye iyie aitung'uaa enkaji esinkaisho, pee kitum aitung'uai ina oitoi nikintanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino pee iim. Neaku iwuang'ie iyie entorroni te mpolos inyi

English: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
Masaai: tenikiliki alej aitapong'oo olalashe lino ling'arie kina, aashu olayioni lino, aashu entito ino, aashu ina kitok ino ninyor, aashu ilo shore lino linyor anaa kewan ino, ejo, ‘Maape iyiook aaisiaai kulie aitin; neitu aekata iyiolouu intae aashu iloo papaai linyi,

English: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
Masaai: ore embata e nena aitin e lelo tung'ana oo manita intae, etaaniki intae aashu elamita intae, ebaiki eluboto nabo enkop o metabaiki enkae luboto,

English: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
Masaai: misujaa iyie ninye nimimbung ninye, nimincho meing'urrie ninye, nimipal iyie ninye nimimitu iyie ninye

English: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
Masaai: kake taara iyie ninye metua inchoo eaku enkaina ino naituruk near ninye metua, ore te siadi naa nkaik oo ltung'ana pooki.

English: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
Masaai: Tanang'a iyie ninye too soito metua, enkaraki niking'orua ninye aitapong'oo to Laitoriani Enkai ino, laa ninye likiyaua aitupuku te nkop e Misiri aitupuku tiatua enkaji e sinkaisho.

English: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
Masaai: Pee ening Iltung'ana pooki le Israel, neureishoyu, nemeigil aekata aas entorroni naikununo nji tiatua intae.

English: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,
Masaai: “Tenining iyie te nabo e nena anas nikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai tobikie teine,

English: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
