English: At his day thou shalt give him his hire, neither shall the sun go down upon it; for he is poor, and setteth his heart upon it: lest he cry against thee unto the LORD, and it be sin unto thee.
Masaai: nchoo ninye olmushaara lenye te nkolong naishiaakino, eton eitu edoyio enkolong (amu oltung'ani aisinani ninye ina eisiliga oltau lenye; pee mikinchiraki ake to Laitoriani, neaku eng'oki te iyie.

English: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
Masaai: “Meari ilpayiani metuata te nkaraki nkera enye, nemeari nkera metuata te nkaraki iloo menye; oltung'ani ake neari metua te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.

English: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, nor of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment to pledge:
Masaai: “Mimbelekeny esipata teilo tung'ani omoni, aashu teilo okishi aashu iya olkila le nkoliai te enata e sile;

English: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee thence: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
Masaai: kake tadamu nchere ira apa iyie orrindik te Misiri nikikordu iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino ainyiang'u teine; metaa kaaitanap nanu iyie taasa ena.

English: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.
Masaai: “Teninturrur enkurma ino aisampu, nikirikino ilkuti ng'osil loo lukuny tiatua enkurma mirrinyo alo ayau; nchoo eaku oleilo tung'ani omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai; pee kitum Olaitoriani Enkai ino atamayiana te siaai pooki oo nkaik inono.

English: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
Masaai: Tenirrarru ilng'anayio linono, ming'il arrarru aishu; nchoo eaku ileilo tung'ani omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai.

English: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean it afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
Masaai: Tenisotu isabibu linono ming'il asotu nchoo eaku ileilo tung'ani omoni, o lokishi o enkoliai.

English: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
Masaai: Tadamu nchere ira apa iyie orrindik tiatua enkop e Misiri; metaa kaaitanap nanu iyie taasa ena.

English: If there be a controversy between men, and they come unto judgment, that the judges may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.
Masaai: “Teneishankarra iltung'ana, nepuonu kotini, nedung ilarishak enkiguana te ninche, nepali ilo asipani neiguanareki ilo arruoni,

English: And it shall be, if the wicked man be worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down, and to be beaten before his face, according to his fault, by a certain number.
Masaai: tenelo neaku eoshoto naishiakino ilo tung'ani, neisho oladung'oni le nkiguana ilo tung'ani meirraga te nkop neari te dukuya ninye ioshot naairirikino enkitarruoroto enye.

English: Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed: lest, if he should exceed, and beat him above these with many stripes, then thy brother should seem vile unto thee.
Masaai: Amu eidimi aishoo ninye ioshot artam kake meitulusi; amu tenelo likae tung'ani aponiki ninye ioshot naalang kuna, netemenayioki naa ilo alashe lino too nkonyek inono.

English: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
Masaai: “Mien olkiteng enkutuk eidong'ito entapa.

English: If brethren dwell together, and one of them die, and have no child, the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger: her husband's brother shall go in unto her, and take her to him to wife, and perform the duty of an husband's brother unto her.
Masaai: “Tenetoni ilalashera tenebo, neye obo lenye meeta olayioni, ore ina kitok eilo otua, meyami teboo ilo marei oltung'ani leeiking'a; ore olalashe olmoruo lenye nchoo elo ayiolou, neya ninye aitaa enkitok enye, neitaas ninye enaishiakino neitaas enkitok olalashe lenye.

English: And it shall be, that the firstborn which she beareth shall succeed in the name of his brother which is dead, that his name be not put out of Israel.
Masaai: Ore olayioni ong'as aiu neya enkarna eilo alashe lenye otua, pee meiwuang'ieki enkarna enye tiatua Israel.

English: And if the man like not to take his brother's wife, then let his brother's wife go up to the gate unto the elders, and say, My husband's brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel, he will not perform the duty of my husband's brother.
Masaai: Naa tenemeyieu ilo lee neyam enkitok o lalashe lenye, nelo ina kitok o lalashe lenye auluo enetii ilpayiani, nejoki, ‘Etanya olalashe lo lmoruo lai eun enkarna o lalashe lenye te Israel; meas ninye esiaai o lalashe lenye te nanu.’

English: Then the elders of his city shall call him, and speak unto him: and if he stand to it, and say, I like not to take her;
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani leina anasa enye, neipotu ninye, neirorie ninye: naa teneuno, ejo, ‘Mayieu nanu naya ninye’,

English: Then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother's house.
Masaai: nelo naa ina kitok o lalashe lenye enetii ninye teine netii lelo payiani, neitayu enamuke enye te nkeju enye, nenotaki enkomom enye; newaliki ajoki, ‘Ena emookini aaitaas olee le meshet enkaji o lalashe lenye.’

English: And his name shall be called in Israel, The house of him that hath his shoe loosed.
Masaai: Ore enkarna enkaji enye kemookini aajo te Israel, enkaji e ilo oitayioki enamuke te nkeju enye.

English: When men strive together one with another, and the wife of the one draweth near for to deliver her husband out of the hand of him that smiteth him, and putteth forth her hand, and taketh him by the secrets:
Masaai: “Teneara ilewa maate, nelotu enkitok e obo amitu olmoruo teilo oarita ninye, neitorioo enkaina enye aibung elewaisho,

English: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.
Masaai: tudung'oi enkaina enye; ming'urrie ninye.

English: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
Masaai: “Mipik olbene lino mpukunot are oo soito ootemieki enkiroishi, o sapuk o enkiti.

English: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures, a great and a small.
Masaai: Mipik enkaji ino mpukunot are e ntemeta enalala o enkiti.

English: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight, a perfect and just measure shalt thou have: that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Masaai: Entemet nabore nesipa ninye taasishore naa entemet nalulung'a ninye taasishore; pee etum nkolong'i inono aatoponari teina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: For all that do such things, and all that do unrighteously, are an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo pooki oas mbaa naijo kuna, lelo pooki oasisho te lejare naa entoki olminong to Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;
Masaai: “Tadamu ina apa nikintaasa Amaleki te nkoitoi, ina kata ipuonunu aaing'uaa Misiri,

English: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
Masaai: ina kata apa pee kirasaki te nkoitoi inaure nitashala, nedung'oo to lkidong'oe linyi lelo pooki apa ooyietunye te siadi intae; neitu ninye eureyu Enkai.

English: Therefore it shall be, when the LORD thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it, that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven; thou shalt not forget it.
Masaai: Metaa tenikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino enkiyeng'iyeng too lmang'ati linono pooki likimanita, tiatua ina kop nikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino metaa enjung'ore ino niya; nilo aiwuang'ie Amaleki tioriong enkop; mincho ake kirikino.

English: And it shall be, when thou art come in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and possessest it, and dwellest therein;
Masaai: “Tenilotu akenya ina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino tujung'o niya iyie ina kop, nimany,

English: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt put it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name there.
Masaai: iwa embata e lelo ng'anayio le dukuya le nkop, lelo lisampua teina kop nikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nipik iyie ninche enkikapu, nilo iyie ine wueji negelu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, pee eitamany enkarna enye ine.

English: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days, and say unto him, I profess this day unto the LORD thy God, that I am come unto the country which the LORD sware unto our fathers for to give us.
Masaai: Nilo iyie enetii ilo apolosani oasisho teina kata, nijoki ninye, ‘Aibalie nanu ena olong to Laitoriani nchere, atabaua atua ina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papa pee eisho iyiook.’

English: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand, and set it down before the altar of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Neya olapolosani enkikapu too nkaik inono neirragie te dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:
Masaai: “Niwalu iyie te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ajo ‘Oltung'ani le Aramea alotoni apa papa, nedoyio ninye alo Misiri nebik teine, naa eikuti apa ninche, nebul teine neaku olosho, ogol, magilani naakitok.

English: And the Egyptians evil entreated us, and afflicted us, and laid upon us hard bondage:
Masaai: Neisorutuo apa iyiook iltung'ana le Misiri, neisomit iyiook, neiteleiki shumata iyiook rrindikisho nagol.

English: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:
Masaai: Nikinchiraki iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo papa nening Olaitoriani oltoilo lang, nedol enkitamioto ang, o eyekenyata ang, o enkitorogonyata ang;

English: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:
Masaai: eyaua iyiook Olaitoriani aitupuku te Misiri te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o te nkiputukuny kitok o too nkitoduaat o mbaa enking'asia

English: And he hath brought us into this place, and hath given us this land, even a land that floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: neyau ninye iyiook atua ene wueji neisho iyiook ena kop, enkop naruko naishi o kule.

English: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land, which thou, O LORD, hast given me. And thou shalt set it before the LORD thy God, and worship before the LORD thy God:
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ayaua taata nanu ilng'anayio le dukuya lena kop, naa iyie Olaitoriani likinchoo nanu.’ Niragie te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino; niserem te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino;

English: And thou shalt rejoice in every good thing which the LORD thy God hath given unto thee, and unto thine house, thou, and the Levite, and the stranger that is among you.
Masaai: ning'idayu iyie te nena pooki supati nikinchoo iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino o lmarei lino, iyie o Lawi o ilo tung'ani omoni otii atua intae.

English: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;
Masaai: “Ore tenindip aitayu e matua pooki e tomon oo nkishorunot inono enkisampuare to lari liokuni, aa ninye olari oitayunyeki e matua e tomon eishori Olawi, o lomoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai pee etum ninche aainosa tiatua nkang'itie inyi neraposho,

English: Then thou shalt say before the LORD thy God, I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house, and also have given them unto the Levite, and unto the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me: I have not transgressed thy commandments, neither have I forgotten them:
Masaai: nitum taa atejo te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ‘Aiwuang'ie nanu ina rubata nasinya tiatua enkaji ai, naidipa aishoo Olawi, o Lomoni, o Lokishi o enkoliai, te risioroto eina kitanapata pooki nikintanapa iyie nanu; eitu nanu agil nabo oo nkitanapat inono neitu aarikino nabo;

English: I have not eaten thereof in my mourning, neither have I taken away ought thereof for any unclean use, nor given ought thereof for the dead: but I have hearkened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that thou hast commanded me.
Masaai: eitu nanu ainos ae nabo e matua e tomon ina kata aishirita to sina; aashu aiwuang'ie nabo enye ina kata aata olminong, aashu aisho ae nabo ilootuata; atoning'o nanu oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkaiai, ataasa nanu te risioroto e nena pooki nikintanapa nanu.

English: Look down from thy holy habitation, from heaven, and bless thy people Israel, and the land which thou hast given us, as thou swarest unto our fathers, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: Ng'ura itii emanyisho ino sinyati, itii shumata, nimayian iltung'ana linono Israel oena kop ninchoo iyie iyiook, anaa apa eninosie olmumai too loo papa, enkop naruko naishi o kule.’

English: This day the LORD thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments: thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
Masaai: “Ore ena olong kintanapa iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino pee ias kuna kitanapat o nkikoot; toduaa naa pee ias ninche to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki.

English: Thou hast avouched the LORD this day to be thy God, and to walk in his ways, and to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and to hearken unto his voice:
Masaai: Ndipa iyie aibalunye ena olong tialo Olaitoriani nchere ninye Enkai ino, naa ilo iyie too nkoitoi enyena, o nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena naa eilo aning oltoilo lenye;

English: And the LORD hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people, as he hath promised thee, and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments;
Masaai: neibalunye Olaitoriani ena olong tialo iyie nchere ira olorere lenye makewan, anaa apa enaisiligie intae, naa imbung'ubung'u intae nkitanapat enyena,

English: And to make thee high above all nations which he hath made, in praise, and in name, and in honour; and that thou mayest be an holy people unto the LORD thy God, as he hath spoken.
Masaai: pee etum ninye ailepie intae te shumata lelo oshon pooki ooitobira, te nkisisa, o to lning'o o te nkanyit naa iakuku sii olorere osinya to Laitoriani Enkai inyi anaa enairoro ninye.”

English: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, Keep all the commandments which I command you this day.
Masaai: Ore Musa o lpayiani le Israel neitanap olorere ejo, “Embung'a kuna kitanapat pooki naitanap nanu intae ena olong,

English: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
Masaai: naa ore akenya ina olong nilang'ilang'a olkeju le Yordan aapuo ina kop naisho Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, intae, nintasheyieyie isoito sapuki nimurumuru ninche te nturoto;

English: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law, when thou art passed over, that thou mayest go in unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, a land that floweth with milk and honey; as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee.
Masaai: ninger te shumata ninche lelo rorei lena kitanapata, tenindip atalang'a ashomo ina kop, nikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ina kop naruko naishi o kule, anaa apa enaisiligie intae Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi.

English: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan, that ye shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and thou shalt plaister them with plaister.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee indipidipi aatalang olkeju le Yordan, nintasheyieyie kulo soito laa ninche nanu aitanapa intae ena olong te nchumata oldoinyo le Ebal, nimurumuru ninche te nturoto.

English: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.
Masaai: Ore teine nishetu olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, olperere lo lasar loo soito, neminteleiki ninche esekenkei.

English: Thou shalt build the altar of the LORD thy God of whole stones: and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD thy God:
Masaai: Nishetu olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino too soito le megueta; ninchooyo olasar opejori te nchumata enye, aitaiki Olaitoriani Enkai ino;

English: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.
Masaai: nipolos olasar le seriani, ninos iyie teine, ning'ida te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
Masaai: Ninger te nchumata e lelo soito lelo rorei pooki lena kitanapata meibalata.”

English: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Israel, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Israel; this day thou art become the people of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Nejoki Musa o lelo apolosak le Lawi Israel pooki, “Entigirata entoning, intae Israel: ore ena Olong itaa intae olorere lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Thou shalt therefore obey the voice of the LORD thy God, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command thee this day.
Masaai: Toning'o naa oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, mbung'a kuna kitanapat enyena o nkiguanat enyena naaitanapa nanu iyie ena olong.”

English: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
Masaai: neitoki Musa airorie ilo orere ina olong ake, ejo,

English: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
Masaai: “Tenindipidipi aatalang olkeju le Yordan nchoo kulo eitashe to ldoinyo le Gerisim, pee emayian olorere. Simion, o Lawi, o Yuda, o Isaakar, o Yosef, o Benchamen.

English: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
Masaai: Naa nchoo kulo eitashe te nchumata oldoinyo le Ebal teina siai: Ruben, o Gad, o Asheri, o Sebulon, o Dan, o Naftali.

English: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice,
Masaai: Neibalunye Ilawi too ltung'ana pooki le Israel to ltoilo sapuk aajo.

English: Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image, an abomination unto the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and putteth it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki iltung'ana ooitobiru enkitanyaanyukoto nagueta aashu enamuruni, olminong to Laitoriani, entoki naaitobiruni too nkaik o ltung'ani arriyia, neirragieki aaisudoo.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that setteth light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo lemeyanyit menye aashu ng'otonye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour's landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oiwuang'ie olpolosie leilo le latia enye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oitapong'oo oltung'ani modooni te nkoitoi.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that perverteth the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oibelekeny esipata tialo oltung'ani omoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that lieth with his father's wife; because he uncovereth his father's skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oboitare enkitok e menye enkaraki eiwuang'ie ninye ilkilani leina nara ene papaai lenye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki olololoitore empukunoto ake ninye eng'ues.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oboitare enkanashe enye, aa entito e menye aashu enang'arie kina.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oboitare enkaputani.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oar metua olelatia enye.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo oropi metaara metua oltung'ani lemeeta entioto.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
Masaai: “ ‘Etediaki ilo le meitabaya irorei lena kitanapata aas ninche.’ Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo ‘Esai.’

English: And it shall come to pass, if thou shalt hearken diligently unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the LORD thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth:
Masaai: “Naa tenining iyie oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, aing'or pee ias nena kitanapat pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie ena olong, nikilepie ninye iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino aitulusoo tenining iyie too loreren pooki le nkop.

English: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Ore kuna mayianat pooki naa kepuonu shumata iyie, nedooyo tenining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai.

English: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
Masaai: “Eikimayian iyie tiatua enkanasa, nikimayiani iyie tiong'ata.

English: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
Masaai: “Kemayiani ilng'anayio lo sesen lino, o lng'anayio le nkop ino, o lng'anayio loo nkishu inono, oina ponunoto oo nkerrai inyi.

English: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
Masaai: “Kemayiani olbene lino oina tapa ino naipurjaki.

English: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
Masaai: “Eikimayiani iyie ijing'u o impang auluo.

English: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
Masaai: “Keisho Olaitoriani lelo mang'ati linono likidumakino, iyie metimirari ninche te dukuya iyie; eikipuonu ninche aadumakino eimu enkoitoi nabo neisik te dukuya iyie eim, nkoitoi naapishana.

English: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
Masaai: Keirriu Olaitoriani imayianat shumata ino tiatua ilchumat linono o leina pooki nias iyie; nikimayian iyie teina kop nikincho Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
Masaai: Keitubul intae Olaitoriani pee iakuku iltung'ana sinyat te nkaraki kewan enye, anaa apa enainosa olmumai te intae, tenimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, nipuopuo too nkoitoi enyena.

English: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le nkop pooki nedol nchere eipotoki intae te nkarna o Laitoriani; naa keureyu ninche intae.

English: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
Masaai: Naa eikincho iyie Olaitoriani tudupoyu te karsisisho o too lng'anayio lo sesen lino o too lng'anayio loo nkishu inono, o too lng'anayio le nkop ino tiatua ina kop nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai lino pee kincho iyie.

English: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
Masaai: Eikiboloki iyie Olaitoriani olchumati lenye le shumata, pee eishoru enchan tenkop ino too rishat enyena, nemayian esiai oo nkaik inono; neaku isilenoki iyie nkuapi kumok kake misilenu iyie.

English: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
Masaai: Naa eikintaa iyie Olaitoriani endukuya, mme olkidong'oe, naa eilepu ake alotu shumata, nimidoyio; tenimbung nena kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong, ing'ura pee ias ninche,

English: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
Masaai: nimimbelekenya tiobo le kulo rorei laaitanap nanu iyie ena olong, alo enkalo e tatene aashu ene kedienye, alo asujaa kulie aitin aisiaai ninche.

English: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
Masaai: “Kake tenimining iyie oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino aashu teniming'or pee ias nkitanapat enyena pooki o nkikoot enyena naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong, ore kulo deketa pooki nepuonu shumata iyie.

English: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
Masaai: Kideki iyie te nkanasa nikideki tiong'ata.

English: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
Masaai: Etediaki enkikapu ino netediaki ina toki ino naipurjishoreki,

English: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
Masaai: Etediaki ilng'anayio lo sesen lino o lng'anayio le nkop ino, oina ponaroto oo nkishu inono, o lelelo loo ntare inono.

English: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
Masaai: Kitediaki iyie tenijing'u, nikitediaki tenimpung.

English: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
Masaai: “Kepik Olaitoriani shumata iyie ildeketa, o lmilo, osina tenena pooki nilo iyie aas, ometaba anaa nikindaikieki nindaaya asioki, te nkaraki entorroni oo nkiaasin inono, enkaraki nikitung'uayie iyie nanu.

English: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
Masaai: Keisho Olaitoriani olmeitai mikindikidikore ometaba anaa nikimut aishu teina kop niloito aya.

English: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
Masaai: Eikiosh iyie Olaitoriani te njipai o lgoo, o to lkirobi o te ng'ion o te nkiyupuyup enkima o to lameyu, o too oshot o too mpaldakani, nikisuj iyie kulo meita, o metaba anaa nindaaya.

English: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
Masaai: Ore te keper te shumata endukuya ino neaku osuyai ore enkop tiabori iyie neaku esekenkei.

English: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
Masaai: Keitaa Olaitoriani enchan eina kop ino empunyua o enterit, nikidoiki iyie te shumata ometaba anaa nikindaikieki.

English: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
Masaai: “Eikincho iyie Olaitoriani mikitimira ilmang'ati linono, nimimpang iyie alo aim enkoitoi nabo alo aarare ninche, nisikisiki aaim nkoitoi naapishana te dukuya ninche; naa ipuopuo intae aaku entaboi e nking'asia too nkitoriat pooki enkop.

English: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
Masaai: Ore mpopong'i inyi neaku endaa too ntaritik oloing'ang'e o too lowuarak lentim; nemeitokini aata hoo obo oiture ninche meshomo.

English: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
Masaai: Eikiosh iyie Olaitoriani too ltuduta le Misiri oo too mpaldakani o too lpepedo o te ng'ion nemeishiunoyu.

English: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
Masaai: Eikiosh iyie Olaitoriani to loirirua o te modoki o te miloi oo ndamunot;

English: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
Masaai: naa ilo iyie irrapirrapisho dama, anaa enairrapirrapisho oltung'ani modooni te naimin, nimidupoyu iyie too nkoitoi inono; naa keaku eikintorogonyi nikipurri anaake, nemetumi hoo obo likiretu iyie.

English: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
Masaai: Isai iyie enkitok, nelotu likae lee ayiolou; nishetu enkaji kake mimany, niun enkurma oo sabibu kake minos isabibu lenye.

English: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
Masaai: Keyieng'i olkiteng lino te dukuya inkonyek inono, niminos iyie nkiri enyena; ore osikiria neisimari aaya te dukuya enkomom ino, nimikirrinyokini iyie; ore nkerra inono neishori ilmang'ati linono, nemetii hoo obo likiretu iyie.

English: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono naa keishori likae orere, eing'orita nkonyek inono, omeiliilai eyieu ninche endama pooki; nemetii engolon enkaina ino pee eibooyo ina.

English: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
Masaai: Ilo osho limiyiolo iyie olotu ainos lelo ng'anayio le nkop ino o le siaai ino pooki, naa iaku ake oloibookini enkop o loinyali anaake,

English: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
Masaai: ometaba anaa nikijing oloirirua teina nadol nkonyek inono.

English: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
Masaai: Eikiosh Olaitoriani nkung o lorroki too ltuduta torrok lemikindimi aaishiunye, ebaiki endap enkeju ino ometabaiki enerang'irang te ndukuya ino.

English: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
Masaai: Eikiyaki iyie Olaitoriani, oilo aiguanani litipika shumata ino ilo osho leitu aekata iyiolou neitu eyiolou loo papaai linyi, ore teine nisiai kulie aitin oo nkeek o noo soito.

English: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie aaku entoki naimakini, endung'et e rashe, o entoki naimakini tiatua iloreren pooki teine nereu intae Olaitoriani.

English: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
Masaai: Iya iyie ilanterera kumok aun te nkurma, naa ilkuti ake ilo aisampu tiatua; amu kelotu olmaati nemut ninche.

English: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
Masaai: Iun iyie nkurman oo sabibu nintobir ninche, kake miok iyie enaisho enye, niminturrur ilng'anayio amu kelo ainos olkurto tiatua enkop inyi pooki.

English: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
Masaai: Ilo iyie atum iloirienito tiatua enkop ino pooki, kake miyelare eilata enye, amu kerrarrunye ilng'anayio lenye.

English: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
Masaai: Iiu iyie ilayiok o ntoyie, kake meaku ninche nkuninono, amu keyae ninche aaraya.

English: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
Masaai: Ore ilkeek linono pooki o lng'anayio le nkop ino naa keaku ilo lmaati.

English: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani omoni otii atua intae naa keilepieki meeu shumata iyie oleng nidou iyie alotu abori oleng.

English: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
Masaai: Eikisilenoki ninye kake misilenoki iyie ninye; keaku ninye endukuya niaku iyie olkidong'oe.

English: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
Masaai: Ore kulo deketa pooki naa kepuonu shumata iyie nikisuj nikigiroo iyie, ometaba anaa nikindaikieki, enkaraki neitu ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, aibung nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena apa nikintanapa ninye iyie.

English: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
Masaai: Kepuonu ninche shumata iyie anaa enkitoduaata o enking'asia, o shumata eishoi ino ntarasi.

English: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki neitu iyie isiai Olaitoriani Enkai ino te ng'ida o te nchipai o ltau lino, te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa,

English: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
Masaai: ore naa ilo iyie aisiaai lelo mang'ati linono likirriwaki Olaitoriani mikietu aar, te sumash o te nkure, te masipaisho o te yieunoto oo ntokitin pooki; naa kepik ninye enapet e sekenkei emurt ino ometaba anaa nikindaikie ninye.

English: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
Masaai: Eikirriwaki iyie Olaitoriani olosho likilotu aarare eing'uaa enelakua, eing'uaa eneiting'ie enkop, olosho oneneng anaa olmotonyi olo ti ai, ilo osho limiyiolo iyie enkutuk enye.

English: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
Masaai: Olosho ogogong le meshilaa likae tung'ani moruo nemeing'urrie oloti,

English: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
Masaai: naa kepuo aainos ilasho loo nkishu inono o lng'anayio le nkop ino, ometaba anaa nikindaikieki ilo osho sii limikilekaki iyie entapa aashu enaisho oo sabibu aashu eilata aashu emponaroto oo nkishu inono aashu ilkuoo loo ntare inono ometaba anaa nikindaikie ninche.

English: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
Masaai: Eikimuat ninche aaman too nkang'itie inono pooki, ometaba anaa neurori nena sunta inono adoru naagol apa nisiliga tiatua enkop ino pooki, nikimuat ninche aaman too nkang'itie inono pooki, tiatua enkop ino pooki apa nikinchoo Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie ainos eishoi o sesen lino makewan, nkiri oo layiok linono o ntoyie, nena nikinchoo Olaitoriani Enkai ino, teina nikimani aamuat, o to sina likipik ilmang'ati linono.

English: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
Masaai: Ore ilo lee bioto oitubuluaki te supatisho te ntae keroku oshoke tialo olalashe lenye, o te nkitok enye o teilo pisiai otelekua loo nkera enyena;

English: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
Masaai: ometaa meisho ninye nabo nena kiri oo nkera enyena naainosita ninye, amu meetae entoki natelekakaki ninye, teina namani aamuat o teilo sina oisomit intae ilmang'ati linyi tiatua nkang'itie inono pooki.

English: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
Masaai: Ore ina kitok bioto neitubuluaki te supatisho, neitu aekata eroro enkop eji amu eisikarre negogong'u ninye tialo olmoruo lenye, o te nkayioni enye o te ntito enye.

English: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
Masaai: Ore ina mudong naimua erishata oo nkejek enyena, o nkera enyena naatoiwuo ninye, neisudoo pee errinyokino ainos, amu kaa naa easi teina namani aamuat enkang o to sina likisomit iyie ilmang'ati linono too nkang'itie inono.

English: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
Masaai: “Teniming'or iyie pee ias kulo rorei pooki lena kitanapata ooigero tena buku pee itum aturia ena arna kitok naitureisho, o Laitoriani Enkai ino,

English: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
Masaai: nikirriwaki iyie Olaitoriani o eishoi ino ilmeita le nking'asia, ilmeita torrok oobik, o emuoyian torrono nabik.

English: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
Masaai: Naa eikintoki ninye airriwaki iyie imuoyiaritin pooki e Misiri, nena apa niure; naa eikisuj ninche.

English: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
Masaai: O pooki muoyian sii o pooki meitai le meigero tena buku oo nkitanapat, eikirriwaki iyie Olaitoriani ometaba anaa nindaaya.

English: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Ore hoo nibaba apa anaa osinyai le naiposha te nkumoi iakuku kuti; enkaraki neitu ining'ining'i oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
Masaai: Naa ore apa anaa enikitonyorra Olaitoriani aitaas esidai nikintubul neijia eiko Olaitoriani eyau enkidaaroto o mutai shumata iyie; nikiwuang'ieki iyie teina kop nijing'ita alo aya.

English: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
Masaai: Neidapash intae Olaitoriani tiatua iloreren pooki ebaiki eluboto nabo enkop ometabaiki enkae. Ore teine nilo aisiaai kulie aitin, oo nkeek o noo soito apa neitu aekata iyiolou neitu eyiolou loo papaai linyi.

English: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
Masaai: Ore tiatua lelo oshon nimitum enkiyagata nimitum eneitasheyie nkejek inono, kake eikilo iyie aisho Olaitoriani teine oltau oikirikira, o nkonyek naailiilaa, o ltau olepori.

English: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
Masaai: Neisiong'a enkishui ino te dukuya iyie ore dama o kewarie iaku ole batisho nimiata osiligi le nkishui, nemeidim aitadedeyie osiligi le nkishui ino.

English: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya tadekenya nijo iyie, ‘Oi naaji tenaa teipa!’ Ore teipa nijo iyie, ‘Oi naaji tenaa tadekenya’ te nkaraki ina batisho naure oltau lino, o nena baa naadol nkonyek inono.

English: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
Masaai: Naa eikirrinyu iyie Olaitoriani too melin ayau Misiri, elototo naisiligishoreki nchere ming'il aekata alo; ore teine ninyoraa aaishooyo ate meinyang'ai intae ilmang'ati linyi anaa rrindiki lewa o ng'oruo, kake meetae oltung'ani oinyang'u intae.”

English: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
Masaai: Kulo ninche irorei leilo ning'o lo sotua oitanapa Olaitoriani Musa pee eitobir oltung'ana le Israel te nkop e Moab, tenebo ilo ning'o lo sotua apa oitobira ninye tenebo ninche te nkop e Horeb.

English: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
Masaai: Neipotu Musa iltung'ana pooki le Israel nejoki ninche, “Itoduaa intae ina pooki nataasa Olaitoriani too nkonyek inyi te nkop e Misiri, ina naitaasa Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki o enkop enye pooki,

English: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
Masaai: nena temat sapuki nitoduaa too nkonyek inyi, nena kitoduaat o nena baa sapuki enking'asia;

English: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
Masaai: kake ore ebaiki ena olong eitu eisho intae Olaitoriani eng'eno niyiolounyenye, aashu nkonyek nidolielie aashu nkiyiaa nining'ieng'ie.

English: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
Masaai: Atorikoyie nanu intae ilarin artam tiong'ata neitu emuta ilkilani linyi linchopitoto neitu emutari inamuka too nkejek inyi,

English: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: eitu intae inosinoso imukateni neitu intae iokioko enaisho aashu enaitemerisho; pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
Masaai: Ore apa pee ipuonunu intae ene wueji, neetuo aarare intae, Shilo olaiguanani le Heshbon o Oog ilo aiguanani le Bashan, kake kitimira iyiook ninche;

English: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
Masaai: nikiya iyiook enkop enye, nikincho metaa enjung'ore too ltung'ana le Reuben, o le Gad, o lpisiai loo ltung'ana le Manase.

English: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
Masaai: Metaa eng'ura naa pee imbung'ubung'u irorei lele ning'o lo sotua, pee itumutumu aatubul te nena pooki niasiasa.

English: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
Masaai: “Ntasheshe taata intae ena olong te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ilkituaak loo loshon linyi, o lpayiani linyi, o larikok linyi, o lewa pooki le Israel,

English: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
Masaai: o nkera inyi, o nkituaak inyi, o lomon ootii atua ilng'oborri linyi, oilo obarn ilpapit loo nkerra o ilo likiokoki enkare,

English: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
Masaai: pee itum atijing'a ilo ning'o le nkinosata o lmumai lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, oitobir Olaitoriani Enkai ino tenebo iyie ena olong;

English: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
Masaai: pee etum ninye aitubula intae ena olong anaa iltung'ana lenyena, pee etum sii ninye ataa Enkai inyi, anaa apa enaisiligie intae, anaa sii apa enainosa ninye olmumai too loo papaai linyi, te Abraham, o te Isaak o te Yakobo.

English: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
Masaai: Neme te intae ake aitobir ele ning'o lo lmumai,

English: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
Masaai: kake tenebo sii ilo lemetii ene tenebo iyiook ena olong tenebo ilo oitashe tenebo iyiook ena olong te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
Masaai: “Iyiololo apa intae kimanya enkop e Misiri, oina kata kipuonu aaimu empolos e lelo oshon apa likitopolosutua;

English: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
Masaai: nitoduaa intae nena tokitin enye naaitagorisho, nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin nkeek o noo soito, o nenkosholai o ne sahabu, apa naatii atua ninche.

English: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
Masaai: Entodol naa melo ake oltung'ani tiatua intae, olee aashu enkitok aashu olmarei aashu olosho, oibelekeny oltau lenye ena olong aing'uaa Olaitoriani Enkai ang alo aisiaai nkaitin e kulo oshon; mejing ake atua intae entonai naata esayiet o lng'anayio losotua oodua.

English: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
Masaai: Ilo tung'ani laa tenening kulo rorei lele ning'o lo lmumai, nemayian kewan to ltau, ejo, ‘Kaserianu nanu hoo tenaa kalo te ngolon oltau lai.’ Ore ena naa keidim ataa keyau enkidaata e ntoki nashal o enatoyio.

English: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
Masaai: Mepalaki ninye Olaitoriani, kake ore engoro o Laitoriani o lom lenye naa keidim atupuru teilo tung'ani, ore ildeketa ooigero tiatua ena buku netonie ninye, neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani enkarna enye tiabori keper.

English: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
Masaai: Nekepu Olaitoriani ninye tiatua iloshon pooki le Israel te ntorroni, te risioroto oo ldeketa pooki lele ning'o lo sotua ooigero tiatua ena buku oo nkitanapat.

English: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
Masaai: Ore too ishoritin naapuonu, ore nkera inyi naabulu te siadi intae, o ltung'ani olotu eing'uaa enkop nalakua, nejo, ina kata tenedol ioshot eina kop, o nena muoyiaritin naaitamuoyia Olaitoriani

English: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
Masaai: ina kop pooki naitaa Olaitoriani enkima o emunyan, o enkop natumuta enkima nemeunishoreki nemebulaki toki; ina kop nemebulaki nkujit, ewueji netaaraki aaiko anaa Sodom o Gomora, o Adam, o Seboim, nena apa naatanang'ayie Olaitoriani te ngoro enye napi.

English: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
Masaai: Ee keyooki iloshon pooki aajo, ‘Kainyoo pee eitaas Olaitoriani ena kop nji. Kainyoo eutu ena kirouaj e ngoro enye kitok?’

English: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana aajo, ‘Enkaraki natung'uaitie ninche olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, apa oitobira ninye tenebo ninche ina kata apa pee eitupuku ninche te nkop e Misiri,

English: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
Masaai: nepuo ninche aaisiai kulie aitin neserem ninche, nkaitin apa neitu eyiolou ninche neitu egelaki Olaitoriani ninche;

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
Masaai: neaku einuakaki engoro o Laitoriani tenkaraki ena kop, neyau shumata ninye ildeketa pooki ooigero tena buku;

English: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
Masaai: nedotu Olaitoriani ninche aitung'uaa enkop enye te ngoro o te mpijan o te ngoro sapuk, nenang'aki ninche atua ae kop, anaa enatiu ena olong.’

English: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
Masaai: “Ore nena tokitin naaisudoro naa ino Laitoriani Enkai ang; kake ore nena naaibalunyeki naa nkunaang o noo nkera ang ntarasi, pee kitum aataas irorei pooki lena kitanapata.

English: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
Masaai: “Naa tenepuonu kuna tokitin pooki shumata iyie, emayianata o ldeket, kuna nairragie nanu te dukuya iyie nidamu iyie ninche tiatua lelo oshon likiterewa Olaitoriani Enkai ino,

English: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
Masaai: nirrinyokino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, iyie o nkera inono, nining oltoilo lenye te kuna pooki naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong, to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino, iyie o nkera inono, nining oltoilo lenye te kuna pooki naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong, to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki,

English: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
Masaai: nikitum naa Olaitoriani Enkai ino aing'urrie iyie, niking'il aiturrur iyie aitung'uaa lelo oreren pooki apa likindapashaka Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
Masaai: Tenaa duoo ninye shumata keper oleng apa kindapashakaki naa teine kirrinyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, naa teine king'amu ninye iyie;

English: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
Masaai: nikiyau iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino atua ina kop apa oo loo papaai linyi, pee itum aitaa enino; nikintubul ninye iyie niakuku kumok aalang iloo papaai linyi.

English: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
Masaai: Nemurat Olaitoriani Enkai ino oltau lino o ltau le ishoi ino, pee itum atonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki; pee itum atopuaa.

English: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
Masaai: Nepik Olaitoriani Enkai ino kulo deketa pooki shumata ilmang'ati linono o lelo apa likisilisilo.

English: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
Masaai: Ning'il iyie aning irorei lo Laitoriani nimbung nena kitanapat enyena pooki naaitanap nanu iyie ena olong.

English: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
Masaai: Eikincho iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino tubula oleng, te siaai oo nkaik inono, o too lng'anayio lo sesen lino, o too lng'anayio loo nkishu inono, o too lng'anayio le nkop ino; amu keitoki Olaitoriani ashipakino pee kintubul iyie, anaa apa enatishipakine loo papaai lino.

English: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
Masaai: Tenining iyie oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ino, aibung nkitanapat enyena o nkikoot enyena naaigero tena buku oo nkitanapat, tenirrinyokino iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki o te nkishui ino pooki.

English: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
Masaai: “Amu ore ena kitanapata naitanap nanu intae ena olong megol oleng te intae, nemelakua.

English: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
Masaai: Mme shumata etii, metaa ijo, ‘Kalo ailep alo shumata te nkaraki iyiook, pee eyaki iyiook, pee kitum iyiook aatoning nikiaas.

English: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
Masaai: Neme lido kekun le naiposha etii, metaa ijo iyie, kalo olo alang enaiposha te nkaraki iyiook, pee elo ayaki iyiook, pee kitum aatoning nikiaas?’

English: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
Masaai: Kake eikitaaniki iyie ele rorei oleng; enkutuk ino etii o atua oltau lino, pee itum ataasa.

English: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
Masaai: “Ng'ura airragie nanu ena olong te dukuya iyie puaan o mbaa sidain, keeya o entorroni.

English: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
Masaai: Tenining iyie kuna kitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino naaitanap nanu ena olong, anyorru Olaitoriani Enkai ino, alo too nkoitoi enyena, nimbung nkitanapat enyena o nkikoot o nkiguanat nitum taa atopuaa nibul, nikimayian Olaitoriani Enkai ino tiatua ina kop nijing'ita alo aya.

English: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
Masaai: Kake teneibelekenya oltau lino niany ining, nikiyae shomo teserema kulie aitin nisiaai ninche,

English: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
Masaai: kaaibalakinye nanu iyie ena olong nchere, ilo aidaaya; milo abik tiatua ina kop nilang'aki to lkeju le Yordan alo aya.

English: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
Masaai: Kaipotu nanu keper o enkop nikinchakenoki iyie ena olong, nchere airragie nanu te dukuya iyie puaan o keeya, emayianata o ldeket, ore naa tegelu puaan, pee itum iyie o eishoi ino atobikoi,

English: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
Masaai: ninyorru Olaitoriani Enkai ino, nining oltoilo lenye, nisuj ninye; amu enkishui ina te iyie o emponaroto oo nkolong'i, pee itum atobiko tiatua ina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo papaai linyi, te Abraham, o te Isaak, o te Yakobo pee eisho ninche.”

English: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
Masaai: Nelo Musa dukuya airorie Israel pooki kulo rorei,

English: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ara taata nanu oloo larin iip o tikitam ena olong; meekure aidim aipang'a arashu atijing'u. Aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Milo iyie alang ele keju le Yordan.’

English: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai ino makewan likilo arikoo; kelo ninye aidaikie kulo oshon ootii dukuya iyie pee itum aiwuang'ie ninche, nelo Yoshua arikoo intae te dukuya, anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.

English: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
Masaai: Naa keitaas Olaitoriani ninche anaa enaitaasa Sihon o Oog, lelo aiguanak le Amori, o enkop enye, ina kata apa pee eidaikie ninche.

English: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
Masaai: Naa keishoru Olaitoriani ninche aisho intae, nipuopuo intae aaitaas ninche te risioroto ena kitanapata pooki naitanap nanu intae.

English: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
Masaai: Entagoluoto nintagololo oishuaa, miureishoyuyu nimimputukunyunyu te nkaraki ninche, amu Olaitoriani Enkai ino ilo olo te dukuya iyie; mikintiak ninye nimiking'uaa.”

English: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
Masaai: Neipotu Musa Yoshua, nejoki ninye te dukuya Israel pooki, “Tonyua nintagol oshoke; amu ilo iyie o ele orere atua ina kop apa nainosie Olaitoriani olmumai too loo menye pee eisho ninche; naa iyie olo aisho ninche.

English: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye olo te dukuya iyie; keaku ninye tenebo iyie; mikintiak ninye aashu king'uaa; miureishoyu nimishalu.”

English: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
Masaai: Neiger Musa ena kitanapata neisho ilapolosak lelo ayiok le Lawi, apa ootanapa osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, o lpayiani pooki le Israel.

English: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
Masaai: Neitanapa Musa ninche ejo, “Ore ake te nkiting'oto e pooki arin oopishana, teina kata nategeluaki pee epalakinoi isilen, to sirua loo lng'oborri,

English: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
Masaai: ina kata epuonu Israel pooki aalioyu te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ino, teine wueji negelu ninye, nilo aisum ena kitanapata te dukuya Israel pooki metoning'o.

English: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
Masaai: Nturrurro iltung'ana ilewa o nkituaak o elelero, oilo tung'ani omoni otii atua nkang'itie inyi, pee etum ninche aatayiolo neureyu Olaitoriani Enkai, neing'or pee eas lelo rorei pooki loo nkitanapat,

English: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
Masaai: paa ore nena kera enye nemeyiolo ena kitanapata, netum aatoning, neyiolou aatureita Olaitoriani Enkai, te nkata naba anaa eninchu teina kop nilo alang'aki te lido kekun le Yordan alo aya.”

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ng'ura etupunyutua nkolong'i pee iye iyie; mpotu Yoshua, nipuonunu atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo, pee atum aitanapa ninye.”

English: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Nelo Musa o Yoshua atua ilo ng'obor le ng'ape e nkatampoi, ore ina ng'ape e nkatampoi neitashe te mbata e kutukaji eilo ng'obor.

English: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa, “Ng'ura etataana enkata niye iyie, nirura tenebo iloo papaai linyi; naa kedumunye ele orere te nkibor oo nkonyek nesuj kulie aitin ng'ejuko ena kop napuo ninche aashulare ninche, naa kaapuo ninche aaing'uaa nanu negil ilo ning'o lai lo sotua apa laitobira o ninche.

English: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
Masaai: Netum taa engoro ai ayupuyupo tialo ninche teina olong, naing'uaa nanu ninche naisudoo enkomom ai teine, nemuti ninche; nepuonu ntorrok kumok o nyamalitin shumata ninche, ometaa kejo ninche teina olong, ‘Aimeetuo kuna torrok shumata iyiook enkaraki nemetii Enkai ang atua iyiook?’

English: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
Masaai: Naa kaisudoo nanu enkomom ai katukul ina olong te nkaraki ina torroni nataasa ninche, amu eibelekenyakinote ninche kulie aitin.

English: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore naa taata ngero ele sinkolio, ninteng'en ninye iltung'ana le Israel; tipika ninye atua nkutukie enye, pee etum ele sinkolio ataa shakeni te nanu tialo iltung'ana le Israel.

English: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
Masaai: Amu ore aidipa nanu ayau ninche atua ina kop naruko naishi o kule, apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho loo menye, netadaate ninche neraposho nepiru, naa keibelekenyakino ninche kulie aitin neisiaai ninche, naamenaa ninche nanu negil olning'o lai.

English: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
Masaai: Naa tenelo akenya nepuonu ntorrok kumok o nyamalitin shumata ninche, nerany ninche ele sinkolio metaa shakeni (amu merikinisho ilo sinkolio too nkutukie oo nkera enye); amu ayiolo nanu nena kipirakinot naaitobirita ninche, apa eton eitu ayau ninche atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho ninche.”

English: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eigero apa Musa ilo sinkolio ina olong ake, neiteng'en ninye iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
Masaai: Neitanap Olaitoriani Yoshua olayioni le Nuni nejoki, “Tonyuaa nintagol oshoke; amu eilo iyie ayau nkera e Israel atua ina kop apa nainosie olmumai pee aisho ninche. Kaaku nanu tenebo iyie.”

English: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Musa aigero irorei lena kitanapata tiatua embuku, omeitabaiki enkiting'oto,

English: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
Masaai: neitanap Musa lelo tung'ana loo Lawi apa oonap osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani ejoki,

English: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
Masaai: “Ewaita ena buku oo nkitanapat, nipikipiki embata eilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, pee etum ninye ataa teine shakenisho tialo intae.

English: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu enkiseroto o engolon enkong'u inyi; ng'ura, ena olong itogolong'akita intae Olaitoriani; kebaa naa kenya engolong'akinoto te siadi keeya ai!

English: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
Masaai: Enturrurrokoki nanu ilpayiani pooki loo loshon linyi, o larikok linyi pee atumoki airoro kulo rorei too nkiyiaa enye naipotu shumata o enkop meishakenoki ninche.

English: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu ajo ore te siadi keeya ai meeta nchere miasiasa entorroni, nimbelekenyanya aapaash ina oitoi apa naitanapa nanu intae; naa ore too nkolong'i naapuonu nejing intae entorroni, enkaraki naa eiyookiki intae aas entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani, aaitagor ninye tialo esiai oo nkaik inyi.”

English: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
Masaai: Neitoki taa Musa airo irorei leilo sinkolio ometaba anaa neishakino nkiyiaa eina umata e Israel:

English: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
Masaai: “Toning'o iyie shumata, amu kairo nanu; nchoo enkop ening irorei le nkutuk ai.

English: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
Masaai: Metadou nkiteng'enat aainei edou anaa enchan, nchoo enkiroroto ai etiu anaa enkoileelio, anaa enchan nashaiki nkujit naanyori, o anaa enkirujuruj nashaiki mbenek.

English: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
Masaai: Amu kaibalunye nanu enkarna o Laitoriani. Enchoo enkitoo Enkai ang!

English: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
Masaai: “Endapidapoi ninye, nelulung'a esiai enye amu kesipa nkoitoi pooki enyena. Enkai naisiligayu nemeeta entioto, Kesipa neitoriori ninye.

English: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
Masaai: Etaasa ninche entorroni tialo ninye, meekure ninche aa nkera enyena tenkaraki olminong lenye; eishoi ninche nagolong'u netapong'ori ninche.

English: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
Masaai: Kena intae ilaakiki Olaitoriani, loorere omoda lemedamisho? Aime papaai linyi, ninye ilo oitobira intae, laa ninye oitobirua intae neitubul intae?

English: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
Masaai: Tadamu nkolong'i e opa, tadamu ilarin loo ishoritin kumok; nkilikuana papaai lino, amu aikintodol, ninkilikuan ilpayiani linyi, amu aikiliki ninche iyie.

English: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa pee eisho ilo otii shumata aisul iloshon njung'oreitin enye, ore apa pee eorrior iltung'ana, nepik ninye ilpolosien loo loreren te risioroto esiana oo nkera e Nkai.

English: For the LORD'S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
Masaai: Amu ore erubata o Laitoriani naa iltung'ana lenyena Yakobo ninye erubata enye najung.

English: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
Masaai: “Enoto apa ninye to lpurkel ti ong'ata te nkop natoyio; neman ninye, neing'or ninye, negolie ninye anaa esoit enkong'u enye.

English: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
Masaai: Anaa olkurragos oitobir enkaji enye, negolie nkera enyena, nelak inaipuko enyena aibung ninche, too naipuko enyena.

English: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
Masaai: Olaitoriani apa otorikoyie ninye openy, nemeetae apa ae ai omoni tenebo ninye.

English: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani ninye meima iwuejitin neeika enkop, neinos ninche ilng'anayio le nkop neisho ninye meibibiu olkenkei te ndapidapoi, o eilata te ndapidapoi.

English: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
Masaai: Ing'orn oo nkishu o kule oo ntare, tenebo iila oo lkuo le kerra o lmeregeshi, iluat oo nchoo e Bashan o nkineji, o enkano sidai aisul ore to sarge loo sabibu niokioko enaisho.

English: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
Masaai: “Kake etopiro Yeshurun, neroisho too nkejek; itopiro iyie nisapuku, nisipayu; neitoki ninye aing'uaa Enkai naa ninye naitobirua ninye, nesukeny endapidapoi e njeunoto enye.

English: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
Masaai: Nedumaki ninche ninye olom te kulie aitin; ore too mbaa bususi neitagor ninche ninye.

English: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
Masaai: Nepolosaki ninche iloiriruani, leme nkaitin, nena aitin neitu aekata eyiolou ninche nena aitin naaetuo det, neitu aekata ninye eidetidetu loo papaai linyi.

English: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
Masaai: Neitu ishilaa ina dapidapoi natoiuo intae nerikino intae ina Ai natoiuo intae.

English: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
Masaai: “Etoduaa Olaitoriani ina neiturraa ninche, te nkaraki ina naitagoro ninye ilayiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena.

English: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, ‘Kaisudoo nanu enkomom ai te ninche, pee adol enebaya ninche amu eishoi marmali ninche, nkera nemeisiligayu.

English: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
Masaai: Aatudumakitia ninche olom teina neme enkai aaitagoro ninche nanu too nkitanyaanyukot enye. Neaku kadumaki nanu ninche olom te lelo leme iltung'ana, kaitagor nanu ninche teilo osho omoda.

English: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
Masaai: Amu eyupuyupieki enkima te ngoro ai, naa keyupuyup ometabaiki enguton e nemeneng'a, nemut enkop o nena naabulu neinok too lbakunot loo ldoinyo.

English: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
Masaai: “ ‘Nasotoki nanu intorrok shumata ninche nang'orie nanu ninche mbaa aainei o maishaki;

English: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
Masaai: kemenayu ninche to lameyu, nemut ninche enkolong napejisho, o nkeeyaitin torrok, nairriwaki nanu ninche ilala loo lowuarak meinosa ninche.

English: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
Masaai: Ore te wueji neisiaja near ninche olalem ore tiatua aji neaku neidaikie ilbarnot o selenken, enkerai nanakita tenebo olmoruo oibor elukunya.

English: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
Masaai: anaata naaji atejo, “Kaidapash ninche meshomo oleng, kaisho nanu ninche metaa meitokini aadamu tiatua iltung'ana.”

English: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
Masaai: Teneme naaji ilmang'ati lenye medamu ake embae nemesipa pee melo ake nejo, “Enkaina ang natimirishe, mme Olaitoriani oyaua ena pooki.” ’

English: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
Masaai: “Amu olosho ninche lemeeta kiguana nemetii eyiolounoto atua ninche.

English: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
Masaai: Tenaa aing'eni apa ninche, anaata etayioloito ena, anaata etumusutuo enkiting'oto enye!

English: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
Masaai: Kaji eiko oltung'ani obo tenemir enkalifu, naa kaji eiko oare tenedumu nkalifuni tomon mekueta, teneme Endapidapoi enye natimira ninche, netapalayie ninche Olaitoriani?

English: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
Masaai: Amu metiu Endapidapoi enye anaa Endapidapoi ang, keishakenoki doi ninye ilmang'ati lang ina.

English: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
