Masaai: Amu ore eishoi enye naa osabibu le Sodom epukunye, o nkurman e Gomora; ore isabibu lenye naa isabibu le sayiet, ore inkimarrimarrat enye naa kedua.

English: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
Masaai: Ore enaisho enye oo sabibu naa esayiet oo lasuriaa, esayiet torrono e nturbubua.

English: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
Masaai: “Keitu eshumi kuna tenkaraki nanu, nemishirakini olchumati lai?

English: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
Masaai: Enaai elap naa kaitalaku, teneideketari enkeju enye amu etataana enkolong enkidaata enye; naa kelotu keeya enye asioki.

English: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
Masaai: Amu keilepunye Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena neing'urrie isinkan lenyena, tenedol ninye ajo eishunye engolon enye, neitu elakuni hoo obo, oloena aashu ololakuno.

English: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
Masaai: Paa keitoki taa ajo, ‘Koree nkaitin enye, ina dapidapoi nashomo ninche aasaru.

English: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
Masaai: Ina nainosa ineepir oo lasarri lenye neok enaisho oo lasarri lenye ooki? Nchoo ninche edumunye pee kiretu iyie, nchoo ninche mikitomitu iyie!

English: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
Masaai: “ ‘Toduaa naa taata nchere, nanu, ee nanu, ninye ilo nemeetae ae ai napudare, kaar nanu matua naitopiu; kapik nanu olbae naishiunye; nemeetae hoo ng'ae oidim atokordu te nkaina ai.

English: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
Masaai: Amu kadumu nanu enkarna ai aitabaiki keper, nainos olmumai, anaa enaishu nanu ntarasi.

English: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
Masaai: Tenaii nanu olalem lai neibung enkaina ai enkiguana naitalaku nanu too lmang'ati laainei, naitalaku nanu te lelo laaiba nanu.

English: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
Masaai: Kaitemer nanu mbaa aainei te naisho nemut olalem lai ninche tenebo lelo ootaraki o loo ena, te nena lukuny oo lpapit adoru loo lmang'ati.’

English: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
Masaai: “Esisa iltung'ana lenyena, lo oreren amu keitalaku ninye osarge loo sinkan lenyena, neitalaku elap too lmang'ati lenyena neitobir olkipoket te nkop oo ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
Masaai: Nelotu Musa airo kulo rorei pooki lele sinkolio aitoning iltung'ana, ninye o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Musa airoro kulo rorei pooki te Israel pooki,

English: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
Masaai: nejoki ninye ninche, “Embung'a too ltauja kulo rorei laliki intae ena olong, pee itumutumu aaitanapa ninche nkera inyi, pee etum ninche aaing'ura neas irorei pooki lena kitanapata.

English: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
Masaai: Amu mme rorei le pesho kulo te intae, kake enkishui inyi, ore enkaraki ina, ipuopuo aabikoo teina kop nilang'akiki te lido kekun le Yordan nipuopuo aaya.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Musa ina kata,

English: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
Masaai: “Takedo ele doinyo le Abarim, oldoinyo le Nebo, otii enkop e Moab, oipirakinore Yeriko; ning'or ina kop e Kanaan naisho nanu iltung'ana le Israel meitaa enenye;

English: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
Masaai: nilo iyie aye teilo doinyo liked enchumata, nikinturrurrokini iltung'ana linono, anaa apa enatua Aron olalashe lino to ldoinyo le Hori neiturrurrokini iltung'ana lenyena:

English: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
Masaai: enkaraki apa neitu intae kirukuruku nanu tiatua iltung'ana le Israel too nkariak e Moribat-Kardesh, to lpurkel le Sin; enkaraki neitu intae kiyanyitutu aaitaa sinyati te mpolos oo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
Masaai: Amu idol iyie ina kop te dukuya iyie kake milo iyie ine, atua ina kop naishoo nanu iltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
Masaai: Ena ninye ina mayianata apa e Musa ilo tung'ani le Nkai natamayiana nkera e Israel eton eitu eye.

English: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Eewuo Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sinai, neilepie iyiook anaa enkolong te Seir, newang'u to ldoinyo le Paran, nelotu ninye eing'uaa nkalifuni iip tomon oo sinyat, eeta enkima nayupuyup te nkaina enye.

English: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
Masaai: Ee kenyor ninye iltung'ana lenyena ore apa lelo pooki ooiteng'elakaki ninye netii atua enkaina enye; nesujaa ninche orrekie lenye, neng'amu eutaroto te iyie,

English: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
Masaai: ore apa pee eitanap iyiook Musa enkitanapata, metaa enjung'ore to lturrur le Yakobo.

English: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
Masaai: Neaku Olaitoriani olaiguanani le Yoshurun, ina kata apa pee etumo ilkituaak loo ltung'ana iloshon pooki le Israel tenebo.

English: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
Masaai: “Nchoo Ruben eishu, mincho eye, nimincho iltung'ana lenyena eaku kuti.”

English: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
Masaai: Nejo ninye ena tialo Yuda, “Toning'o Olaitoriani, oltoilo le Yuda, niyau ninye aitijing'u enetii iltung'ana lenyena, tomitu iyie too nkaik inono, niaku eretoto too lmang'ati lenyena.”

English: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
Masaai: Ore too le Lawi nejo, “Nchoo Lawi Tumimu ino nincho Urimu ino ilo osinya ilo apa litetema te Masa ninchankarrare ninye too nkariak e Meriba;

English: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
Masaai: ilo apa otejo tialo menye o ng'otonye ‘Mashilaa nanu ninche’; eiturrayie ninye ilalashera lenyena, nepalaa nkera enyena, amu eibung'a ninche ororei lino neibung olning'o lino.

English: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
Masaai: Keiteng'en ninche Yakobo nkiguanat inono; neiteng'en Israel nkitanapat inono kepik ninche enkorropil dukuya iyie o lasar opejori enchumata olperere lino lo lasar.

English: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, tamayiana imasaa enyena, ning'amaa esiai oo nkaik enyena; tarrarra mpolosi oo lmang'ati lenyena, e lelo ooiba ninye, pee meigil aadumunye.

English: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the LORD shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
Masaai: Ore te Benchamen nejo ninye, “Olkirotet lo Laitoriani keton ninye te seriani te ninye; Keimulumul ninye endama pooki, neitaa ninye erishata oo ronyi lenyena emanyisho enye.”

English: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
Masaai: Ore tialo Yosef nejo ninye, “Metamayiana Olaitoriani enkop enye, too ntokitin enyena supati e shumata, o too naatii ineegut olodo le nkop,

English: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
Masaai: too lng'anayio sidain le nkolong o te nena kumok oo lapaitin,

English: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
Masaai: o te nena sidain naaimu lelo doinyo oina borei naing'uaa nena doinyo musan oo ntarasi

English: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
Masaai: tenebo nena kishorot sidain enkop o enkiputakinoto enye, o enyorrata eilo apa otii osanag, meetu kuna shumata endukuya e Yosef o enerang'irang te lukunya eilo ora olkitok tiatua ilalashera lenyena.

English: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
Masaai: Ore oloing'oni lenye kikau neeta engolon, ore mowuarak enyena naa imowuarak o larro, naa ninche errumorie iloreren, nerumoo pooki omeitabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop; ore lelo naa lelo oora nkalifuni iip tomon le Efraim, ore kulo naa lelo oara nkalifuni le Manase.”

English: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
Masaai: Ore tialo Sebulon nejo ninye, “Ting'idayu iyie Sebulon, te nimpang auluo, ning'idayu Isaakar tiatua ilng'obori linono.

English: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
Masaai: Keipotu ninche iloreren meetu ilo doinyo lenye; ore teine neitayu ilasarri lenye; sidain amu keaku ninche enkarsisisho oo naaiposha, o nena masaa naaisudoro o sinyai.”

English: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
Masaai: Ore tialo Gad nejo ninye, “Metamayiana ilo oitalala Gad! Etiu Gad anaa olng'atuny, kepolos ninye enkaina, o enerang'irang te ndukuya.

English: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
Masaai: Etegelaka ninye kewan ewueji neisul te nkop, amu teine apa eiteng'elaki erubata oloitoreisho; nelo ninye enetii ilkituaak loo ltung'ana, nedung'oki Israel enkiguana, o nena kiguanat naasipa o Laitoriani.”

English: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
Masaai: Ore tialo Dan nejo ninye, “Ore Dan naa enkerai o lng'atuny, ina naipidito te Bashan.”

English: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
Masaai: Ore tialo Naftali nejo ninye “Oo Naftali, ndipakine ntokitin supati, nikimputa esupatisho o Laitoriani iwa enaiposha o kopikop.”

English: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
Masaai: Ore tialo Asheri nejo ninye, “Metamayiani aaitulus too layiok, nchoo ninye etum omom too lalashera lenyena, naa nchoo eitadoiki enkeju enye eilata.

English: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
Masaai: Metaa nchomito inono ine sekenkei neponari engolon ino anaa nkolong'i inono.

English: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
Masaai: “Meetae likae onyaanyukie Enkai, iyie, Yeshurun, ilo olo te keper pee kilotu aret, neimu nkatampo te nkitoo enye.

English: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
Masaai: Ina Ai oo ntarasi ninye emanyisho ino ore abori iyie netii nkaik oo ntarasi naa kerewaa ninye olmang'atinta te dukuya iyie, nejo, Ndaikie.

English: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
Masaai: Neaku etobiko apa Israel te seriani, te nchorro e Yakobo ake, teina kop e ntapa o enaisho oo sabibu ee, keper enye naitadou enkoileelio.

English: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
Masaai: Imayiana iyie Israel, Oo Israel! Kaing'ae likinyaanyukie, olorere oitajeu Olaitoriani, ina long'o e retoto inyi, o lalem le nkisulata inyi! Kepuonu ilmang'ati linyi aasai intae naa ipuopuo intae aaituny iwuejitin enye e shumata.”

English: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
Masaai: Neilep Musa teina kisiajata e Moab alo oldoinyo le Nebo, enchumata e Pisga, aa ninye naipirakinore Yeriko. Neitodol Olaitoriani ninye ina kop pooki, Gilead ometabaiki Dan,

English: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
Masaai: o Naftali pooki ina kop e Efraim, o Manase, o enkop pooki e Yuda ometabaiki enaiposha o loo ntoluo,

English: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
Masaai: e Negeb o enkisiajata, aa taa ilo erata le Yeriko ina anasa oo ltuka ometabaiki Soar.

English: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki ninye, “Ena kop apa ina nainosie olmumai o Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, nchere, ‘Kalo nanu aisho eishoi enye!’ Aaishoo nanu iyie toduaa too nkonyek inono, kake milo iyie ine.”

English: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Musa osinka le Nkai teine te nkop e Moab, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani,

English: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
Masaai: nenukaa Olaitoriani ninye to erata te nkop e Moab eipirakinore Bet-peor; kake meetae oltung'ani oyiolo enkurare enye otaata.

English: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
Masaai: Oloo larin iip o tikitam apa Musa pee eye; neitu eiliilaa nkonyek enyena aashu neitu engoroo engolon enye.

English: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
Masaai: Neishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Musa too nkisiajat e Moab nkolong'i e nkishirakinoto o sina tenkaraki Musa.

English: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua olayioni le Nuni nebore oltau le ng'eno nagut, amu eiteleikia apa Musa nkaik enyena shumata ninye; neaku etoning'o iltung'ana le Israel ninye; neas ninche anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
Masaai: Neitu aekata edumunye te Israel oloiboni le Nkai laaijo Musa, laa keyiolore Olaitoriani too nkomomi,

English: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
Masaai: meetae likae laaijo ninye too nkitoduaat o too nenking'asia naaishoo Olaitoriani ninye metaasa te nkop e Misiri, te Farao o too sinkan lenyena pooki o te nkop enye pooki.

English: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
Masaai: O teina golon pooki magilani o nena kiaasin kituaak naaitureisho naataasa Musa te dukuya Israel pooki.

English: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the LORD it came to pass, that the LORD spake unto Joshua the son of Nun, Moses' minister, saying,
Masaai: Ore te siadi keeya e Musa ilo sinka lo Laitoriani, nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua olayioni le Nuni ilo sinka le Musa,

English: Moses my servant is dead; now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, thou, and all this people, unto the land which I do give to them, even to the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Etua Musa osinka lai; ore naa taata tudumunye, shomo talang'a Yordan, iyie o kulo tung'ana pooki, enchom atua ina kop naishorita nanu ninche, iltung'ana le Israel.

English: Every place that the sole of your foot shall tread upon, that have I given unto you, as I said unto Moses.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji neroro iroruat oo nkejek inyi aishoo nanu intae, anaa apa enaisiligie nanu Musa.

English: From the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your coast.
Masaai: Ebaiki olpurkel o ena Lebanon o metabaiki olkeju kitok, ilo keju le Frati, enkop pooki oo Lhiti o metabaiki enaiposha kitok te nkalo e ndoyioroto e nkolong, naa keaku enkop inyi.

English: There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani likindim aitasheikinore too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino. Ore apa anaa enatii nanu te nebo Musa, neijia aiko kaaku nanu te nebo iyie; maaitiak nanu iyie nemaaing'uaa nanu iyie.

English: Be strong and of a good courage: for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give them.
Masaai: Tonyuaa nintagoluo amu iyie oidimie kulo metujung'o ina kop nainosie nanu olmumai too loo menye pee aisho ninche.

English: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
Masaai: Tonyuaa ake duoo iyie nintagoluo oleng, ning'or pee ias te risioroto e nena kitanapat pooki apa nikintanapa Musa osinka lai; mimbelekenya apaash alo enkaina e tatene aashu ene kedienye, pee itum aisula te pooki wueji neba anaa enilo.

English: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
Masaai: Ore ena buku oo nkitanapat mincho epuku te nkutuk ino, kake mbirribirra mbaa enyena dama o kewarie, pee itum atujurru ataasa te risioroto e nena pooki naaigero ti atua ninye; amu ina kata ake ebul enkoitoi ino, naa ina kata itum enkisulata sidai.

English: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
Masaai: Keitu nanu aaitanap iyie? Tonyuaa nintagoluo; miureishoyu, niming'aeng'ae, amu etii Olaitoriani Enkai ino te nebo iyie te pooki wueji nilo.”

English: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua aitanap ilkituaak loo ltung'ana ejo,

English: Pass through the host, and command the people, saying, Prepare you victuals; for within three days ye shall pass over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land, which the LORD your God giveth you to possess it.
Masaai: “Eima atua enkang oo lng'oborri, nintanapapa olorere, ‘Entobira ndaiki inyi; amu ore te rishata oo nkolong'i uni naa ilang'ilang'a intae Yordan, pee ipuopuo aaibung ina kop apa naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi pee iyaya.’ ”

English: And to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh, spake Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Ore ti alo ile Ruben, o le Gad, o olpisiai lo losho le Manase nejoki Yoshua,

English: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, saying, The LORD your God hath given you rest, and hath given you this land.
Masaai: “Entadamu ororei apa oitanapa intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa keisho intae ewueji e nkiyeng'iyeng, naa keisho ninye intae ena kop.’

English: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed, all the mighty men of valour, and help them;
Masaai: Ore nkituaak inyi, o nkera inyi, o nkishu inyi naa ketoni ti atua ina kop apa naishoo intae Musa te lido kekun le Yordan; kake ore iltung'ana pooki oogol ti atua intae nepuo etanapate te dukuya ilalashera linyi neretu ninche,

English: Until the LORD have given your brethren rest, as he hath given you, and they also have possessed the land which the LORD your God giveth them: then ye shall return unto the land of your possession, and enjoy it, which Moses the LORD'S servant gave you on this side Jordan toward the sunrising.
Masaai: o metaba anaa neisho Olaitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng ilalashera linyi o intae sii, neya sii ninche ina kop naisho ninche Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; nitumutumu taa aatushukokinoto enkop inyi, niyaya ninye, ina kop apa naishoo intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong.”

English: And they answered Joshua, saying, All that thou commandest us we will do, and whithersoever thou sendest us, we will go.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche Yoshua ejo, “Ore nena pooki nintanapa iyiook naa eikiaas, ore eneba anaa enirriwaa iyiook naa eikipuo.

English: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things, so will we hearken unto thee: only the LORD thy God be with thee, as he was with Moses.
Masaai: Ore apa anaa enikitoning'o Musa too mbaa pooki, neijia sii kinko aaning iyie; metaa ake duoo ninye Olaitoriani Enkai ino te nebo iyie, anaa apa enatii te nebo Musa!

English: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa olikipaash aany enkitanapata ino negolong'aki irorei linono, enaba anaa enintanap ninye naa keari metua. Tonyuaa ake duoo iyie nintagoluo.”

English: And Joshua the son of Nun sent out of Shittim two men to spy secretly, saying, Go view the land, even Jericho. And they went, and came into an harlot's house, named Rahab, and lodged there.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoshua olayioni le Nuni te nkisudoroto iltung'ana oare te Shitumu metaa ilaikitalak, ejo, “Enchom, eng'ura enkop, neisul Yeriko.” Nepuo ninche, nepuonu enkaji e mulayoi apa naji enkarna enye Rahabu, neirrag ninche ine.

English: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, Behold, there came men in hither to night of the children of Israel to search out the country.
Masaai: Netolikioki apa olaiguanani le Yeriko aajoki, “Ng'ura, etii kulikae tung'ana le Israel ooetuo ene duoo kewarie pee ejur enkop.”

English: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ilo aiguanani le Yeriko iltung'ana enkaji e Rahabu, ejo, “Ntayu lelo tung'ana ooetuo enkaji ino, lelo ootijing'a enkaji ino; amu enkop pooki eetuo ninche aajur.”

English: And the woman took the two men, and hid them, and said thus, There came men unto me, but I wist not whence they were:
Masaai: Kake ewa apa ina kitok lelo tung'ana pokira oare aisudoo; nejo ninye, “Esipa eetuo iltung'ana enatii nanu, kake mayiolo nanu ajo kaji eing'uaa ninche;

English: And it came to pass about the time of shutting of the gate, when it was dark, that the men went out: whither the men went I wot not: pursue after them quickly; for ye shall overtake them.
Masaai: ore ake pee eaku keikeni kishomi, etomisimiso, neipang lelo tung'ana aapuo, ore eneshomo lelo tung'ana mayiolo nanu; entasioki entusujai ninche amu inepupu.”

English: But she had brought them up to the roof of the house, and hid them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order upon the roof.
Masaai: Kake eyaua apa ninye ninche enchumata e nkaji, neisudoo ninche too ndupa apa naa ninche naaitobirare te nchumata e nkaji.

English: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
Masaai: Neaku etusujaitie iltung'ana ninche te nkoitoi nalo Yordan, o metabaiki ilang'at; nerisio ake eipang'a iltung'ana aapuo neikeni kishomi.

English: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eirura ninche, neilepu ninye alotu enetii ninche te nchumata e nkaji,

English: And she said unto the men, I know that the LORD hath given you the land, and that your terror is fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land faint because of you.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Ayiolo nanu nchere eishoo Olaitoriani intae ena kop, naa ore euriata nikiure intae etijing'a iyiook, naa ore iloomanya ena kop pooki nelepori te dukuya intae.

English: For we have heard how the LORD dried up the water of the Red sea for you, when ye came out of Egypt; and what ye did unto the two kings of the Amorites, that were on the other side Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom ye utterly destroyed.
Masaai: Amu kitoning'oitie iyiook ina naitoyio Olaitoriani nkariak e Naiposha Nanyokie te dukuya intae ina kata pee impang'ung'u aapuku te Misiri, o ina nintaasa lelo aiguanak loo Lamori apa ootii lido kekun le Yordan, o Sihon o Oog, apa lindaikie ninche katukul.

English: And as soon as we had heard these things, our hearts did melt, neither did there remain any more courage in any man, because of you: for the LORD your God, he is God in heaven above, and in earth beneath.
Masaai: Ore ake pee kining ina, nikilepori, nemeetae empijan natelekua te likae lee hoo obo, te nkaraki intae; amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninye ilo ora Enkai te shumata o ti abori te nkop.

English: Now therefore, I pray you, swear unto me by the LORD, since I have shewed you kindness, that ye will also shew kindness unto my father's house, and give me a true token:
Masaai: Ore naa taata, enosakaki olmumai to Laitoriani nchere ore anaa enaitaasa nanu intae te supatisho, naa eikintaasiasa sii intae te supatisho o enkaji e papa nikinchosho nanu olmonekie osipa,

English: And that ye will save alive my father, and my mother, and my brethren, and my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death.
Masaai: nintajeuu pee meye papa o yieyio, o lalashera laainei o nkanashera, o lelo pooki oora ilkulenye, nikordudu enkishui ang aaitung'uaa keeya.”

English: And the men answered her, Our life for yours, if ye utter not this our business. And it shall be, when the LORD hath given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana ninye, “Enkishui ang te rishata e nkishui inyi, te neaku eitu ilikio kuna baa ang, nikitum taa aaitaasa iyie te supatisho o te nkisiligata te neisho iyiook Olaitoriani ena kop.”

English: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
Masaai: Neitadoyio ninye ninche te nkeene aimie elusie, amu ore apa enkaji enye naa esuntai e nkanasa apa eshetakino.

English: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom ildoinyo, meinepu ake intae lelo oosujita intae; nisudoriri te ine nkolong'i uni, o metaba anaa neshukunye lelo oosujita intae, nitumutumu taa aashom aaima enkoitoi inyi.”

English: And the men said unto her, We will be blameless of this thine oath which thou hast made us swear.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana ninye, “Mikiyieu iyiook nikiaata eleyiata ti alo ele mumai linosie iyiook.

English: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ti nikipuonu akenya aarasaki ena kop, teeniki enkarasha nanyokie ele dirisha liimie iyiook; nisot ti atua enkaji ino papaai lino o yieyioo lino, o lalashera linono o lelo pooki le nkaji e papaai lino.

English: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
Masaai: Te neipang oltung'ani boo aim kutuk aji e nkaji ino nelo enkoitoi, ore osarge lenye neaku shumata endukuya enye etii, nimikintoki iyiook aata eleyiata; kake te neiteleikini enkaina aar oltung'ani ake ninye otii te nebo iyie ti atua aji, neaku osarge lenye shumata lukuny ang etii.

English: And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.
Masaai: Kake ti nilikio kuna baa ang, nimikintoki iyiook aata eleyiata ti alo ele mumai linosie iyie iyiook.”

English: And she said, According unto your words, so be it. And she sent them away, and they departed: and she bound the scarlet line in the window.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Anaa enitejo intae, nchoo etiu neijia.” Neisho ninche meshomo, nepuo ninche, neeniki ninye enkarasha nanyokie oldirisha.

English: And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aajing ildoinyo, netoni te ine nkolong'i uni, o metaba anaa neshukunye lelo apa oosujita ninche; amu eing'orutua apa lelo oosujita ninche; te nkoitoi pooki neitu etum toki.

English: So the two men returned, and descended from the mountain, and passed over, and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all things that befell them:
Masaai: Neitoki lelo tung'ana pokira oare aadou too ldoinyo, nelang olkeju, nepuo enetii Yoshua olayioni le Nuni; neliki ninye nena pooki naatupukokitio ninche.

English: And they said unto Joshua, Truly the LORD hath delivered into our hands all the land; for even all the inhabitants of the country do faint because of us.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Yoshua, “Esipa eishorua Olaitoriani enkop pooki apik inkaik ang; netalepori sii lelo pooki oomanya ina kop te nkaraki iyiook.”

English: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya enasirie nedumunye Yoshua nelo ninye Shitimu, te nebo iltung'ana pooki le Israel; nepuonu Yordan, neirrag ninche ine eton eitu elang.

English: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i uni neim ilkituaak atua ilng'oborri pooki

English: And they commanded the people, saying, When ye see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests the Levites bearing it, then ye shall remove from your place, and go after it.
Masaai: neitanap iltung'ana aajo, “Ti nidolidolo intae osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi enapita ilapolosak le Lawi, nipuopuo aaing'uaa iwuejitin inyi aasuj ninye,

English: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.
Masaai: pee itumutumu aatayiolo enkoitoi niimiimi, amu eitu ae kata iimiimi ena oitoi. Kake enchoo ejing erishata intae o ilo sanduku, erishata naba anaa intemat e nkaina inkalifuni are; emipuonunu intae aanyikaki ninye.”

English: And Joshua said unto the people, Sanctify yourselves: for to morrow the LORD will do wonders among you.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajoki iltung'ana, “Entisinya ate; amu ore taisere naa keas Olaitoriani inenking'asia ti atua intae.”

English: And Joshua spake unto the priests, saying, Take up the ark of the covenant, and pass over before the people. And they took up the ark of the covenant, and went before the people.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua ilapolosak, “Entudumu osanduku lo sotua enchom dukuya iltung'ana.” Nedumu ninche ilo sanduku lo sotua nepuo dukuya iltung'ana.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yoshua, “Ore ena olong kaang'as nanu ailepie iyie too nkonyek e Israel pooki, pee etum ninche aatayiolo nchere, ore apa anaa enatii nanu te nebo Musa, kaaku sii te nebo iyie.

English: And thou shalt command the priests that bear the ark of the covenant, saying, When ye are come to the brink of the water of Jordan, ye shall stand still in Jordan.
Masaai: Naa intanapa iyie lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua, nchere, ‘Ore pee ipuonunu aabaiki emurt e nkare e Yordan nintasheshe intae aaitirring'a te Yordan.’ ”

English: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, Come hither, and hear the words of the LORD your God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua iltung'ana le Israel, “Wootu ene, entoning irorei lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And Joshua said, Hereby ye shall know that the living God is among you, and that he will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Perizzites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Jebusites.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajo, “Tena intae iyiolouu nchere etii Enkai naishu atua intae, naa nchere meitadiak ninye eitu earaa te dukuya intae Ilkanaani, o Ilhiti, o Ilhifi, o Ilperesi, o Ilgilgashi, o Lamori o Ilyebusi.

English: Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani le nkop pooki naa kegiroo intae alo Yordan.

English: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, out of every tribe a man.
Masaai: Ore naa taata ewaita iltung'ana tomon oare too loshon le Israel, to losho ake oltung'ani.

English: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of Jordan, that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above; and they shall stand upon an heap.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eroro ndapi oo nkejek e lelo apolosak oo napita osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani le nkop pooki nkariak e Yordan, neitasheyieki nkariak e Yordan meitoki aaruko, ore nena ariak naadou eing'uaa shumata neitashe aarupa to lturrur obo.”

English: And it came to pass, when the people removed from their tents, to pass over Jordan, and the priests bearing the ark of the covenant before the people;
Masaai: Neaku ore ake pee edumunye iltung'ana too lng'oborri lenye ejo pee elang Yordan to nebo lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua te dukuya iltung'ana,

English: And as they that bare the ark were come unto Jordan, and the feet of the priests that bare the ark were dipped in the brim of the water, (for Jordan overfloweth all his banks all the time of harvest,)
Masaai: ore ake pee epuonu lelo oonapita osanduku lo sotua Yordan, nedoiki nkejek e lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku atua enkare (naa kenang'ari apa Yordan aim ingilat te nkata pooki e nkisampuare),

English: That the waters which came down from above stood and rose up upon an heap very far from the city Adam, that is beside Zaretan: and those that came down toward the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, failed, and were cut off: and the people passed over right against Jericho.
Masaai: ore nkariak naadou eing'uaa shumata neitashe aaku orupati olo enelakua abaiki Adam, ina anasa apa natii embata e Saretani, ore nena ariak naanang'ari aadoyio aapuo enaiposha e Araba, ina Enaiposha e Munyan, nedung'o katukul; nelang iltung'ana aaim enkishaakinoto e Yeriko.

English: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan, and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground, until all the people were passed clean over Jordan.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata eimita Israel pooki enkop natoyio, ore lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani neitashe te nkop natoyio te mpolos o lkeju le Yordan, o metaba anaa neidip olosho pooki atalang'a Yordan.

English: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip olosho pooki atalang'a olkeju le Yordan, nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua,

English: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
Masaai: “Ntayu iltung'ana tomon oare ti atua iltung'ana, ti atua ake olosho oltung'ani obo,

English: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests' feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
Masaai: nintanap ninche ajoki, ‘Entayu isoito tomon oare tene te mpolos olkeju le Yordan, te ine wueji neitasheyie nkejek oo lapolosak, ninapinapa aaya te nebo intae, nirragiegie ninche te wueji ade nirragirraga kewarie.’ ”

English: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua aipotu iltung'ana tomon oare ti atua iltung'ana le Israel, laa ninche etegelua, oltung'ani ake to losho;

English: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take ye up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:
Masaai: nejoki Yoshua ninche, “Entogiroi osanduku lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi enchom empolos e Yordan, nidumu ake oltung'ani osoit anap to loililai lino, te risioroto e siana oo loshon le Israel,

English: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?
Masaai: pee etum ena ataa olmonekie ti atua intae, ore akenya te neikilikuan intae inkera inyi te nkata nalotu aajoki, ‘Kainyoo tipat e kulo soito te intae?’

English: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.
Masaai: Nitumutumu taa aatiaki ninche nchere etudung'ote apa nkariak e Yordan te dukuya o sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani; ore apa pee elang'u Yordan, nedung'o nkariak e Yordan. Neaku keaku kulo soito too ltung'ana le Israel enkitadamunoto ntarasi.

English: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
Masaai: Neas iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaitanapa Yoshua, nedumu isoito tomon o are te mpolos e Yordan, te risioroto e siana oo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel, anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani Yoshua; nenap ninche aaya ine wueji apa neshomo aairrag, neirragie ninche te ine.

English: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
Masaai: Neirragie Yoshua isoito tomon o are aitobiraki te mpolos e Yordan, te ine wueji apa neitasheyie nkejek e lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku lo sotua; netii ninche ine ebaiki ena olong.

English: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until every thing was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
Masaai: Amu ore apa lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku neitasheito te mpolos e Yordan, o metaba anaa neidipayu pooki toki apa naitanapa Olaitoriani Yoshua metiaaki iltung'ana, te risioroto e nena apa pooki naaitanapa Musa Yoshua. Nelang iltung'ana ilo keju te nkisarrisar;

English: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
Masaai: ore ake pee eidip iltung'ana pooki aatalang, nelang ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani o lapolosak te dukuya lelo tung'ana.

English: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ruben o layiok le Gad o lpisiai lo losho le Manase nelang etanapate te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel, anaa apa enatiaka Musa ninche;

English: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
Masaai: iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni artam ooterretenate te nkaraki olarrabal ootalang'a te dukuya Olaitoriani aapuo olarrabal, aapuo nkisiajat e Yeriko.

English: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
Masaai: Ore apa ina olong neilepie Olaitoriani Yoshua too nkonyek e Israel pooki; neyanyitu ninche ninye anaa apa enayanyit Musa, nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.

English: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua,

English: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
Masaai: “Ntanapa lelo apolosak oonapita osanduku ilo sanduku le nchakenisho meilepu aapuku te Yordan.”

English: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.
Masaai: Neitanap taa Yoshua lelo apolosak ejo, “Elepu entupuku te Yordan.”

English: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests' feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eilepu lelo apolosak apa oonapita osanduku lo Laitoriani ti atua empolos e Yordan, neroro nkejek e lelo apolosak enkop natoyio, nerrinyokino nkariak e Yordan erishata enye nenang'ari aaim ngilat o lkeju, anaa apake.

English: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
Masaai: Neilepu iltung'ana aapuku ti atua Yordan te nkolong e tomon o lapa le dukuya, neitayu ilng'oborri te Gilgal to lpolosie le nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong le Yeriko.

English: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
Masaai: Ore lelo soito tomon o are apa ooitayutuo ninche ti atua Yordan, neirragie Yoshua apik Gilgal.

English: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Israel, “Te neikilikuan akenya nkera inyi iloo papaai lenye te nkata nalotu aajoki, ‘Kainyoo tipat e kulo soito?’

English: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
Masaai: Nitumokiki taa aaitayiolo nkera inyi nchere, ‘Etalang'a apa Israel ele keju le Yordan aaim enkop natoyio.’

English: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
Masaai: Amu eitoyio Olaitoriani Enkai inyi inkariak e Yordan te nkaraki intae o metaba anaa nilang'ilang'a, anaa apa enaikuna Olaitoriani Enkai inyi Enaiposha Nanyokie, apa naitoyio te nkaraki iyiook o metaba anaa nikilang,

English: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.
Masaai: pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo nchere ore enkaina o Laitoriani naa aimagilani; pee itumutumu aatureita Olaitoriani ntarasi.”

English: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorites, which were on the side of Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanites, which were by the sea, heard that the LORD had dried up the waters of Jordan from before the children of Israel, until we were passed over, that their heart melted, neither was there spirit in them any more, because of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilaiguanak pooki loo Lamori apa ootii lido kekun Yordan enkalo o loo ntoluo, o laiguanak pooki loo Lkanaani apa ootii embata e naiposha, nchere eitoyio Olaitoriani nkariak e Yordan te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel o metaba anaa nelang'u nelepori ninche, neitu eitokini aata hoo obo oata oltau te ninche, te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel.

English: At that time the LORD said unto Joshua, Make thee sharp knives, and circumcise again the children of Israel the second time.
Masaai: Ore apa te ina kata nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Ntobira nkalema oo soito oogol pee intoki amurat iltung'ana le Israel enkata e are.”

English: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
Masaai: Neitayu Yoshua nkalema oo soito, nemurat iltung'ana le Israel te Gibeat-haaralot.

English: And this is the cause why Joshua did circumcise: All the people that came out of Egypt, that were males, even all the men of war, died in the wilderness by the way, after they came out of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa te nkaraki ena apa pee etumurata Yoshua ninche: ore apa ilayiok pooki loo ltung'ana ooetuo eing'ua Misiri, iltung'ana pooki lo larrabal, netuata ninche te nkoitoi to lpurkel pee eidip ake aatupuku aatung'uai Misiri.

English: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.
Masaai: Ore hoo netumurataki apa iltung'ana pooki ooipang'utua aapuonu, kake ore eyia lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootoiuoki te nkoitoi to lpurkel eidipa ninche aatupuku te Misiri neton apa eitu emurati.

English: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people that were men of war, which came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: unto whom the LORD sware that he would not shew them the land, which the LORD sware unto their fathers that he would give us, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
Masaai: Amu eshomo apa iltung'ana le Israel ilarin artam to lpurkel, o metaba anaa neishunye olosho pooki, lelo tung'ana lo larrabal apa ooipang'utua aapuku te Misiri, enkaraki neitu apa ening ninche oltoilo lo Laitoriani; ore ti alo ninche neinosa Olaitoriani olmumai nchere meisho ninche metoduaa ina kop nainosakinye Olaitoriani olmumai loo papaai lenye pee eisho iyiook, enkop naruko kule o naishi.

English: And their children, whom he raised up in their stead, them Joshua circumcised: for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them by the way.
Masaai: Neaku nkera enye apa etudumua ninye te rishata enye, ninche etumurata Yoshua; amu memurata apa, enkaraki neitu apa emurati ninche te nkoitoi.

English: And it came to pass, when they had done circumcising all the people, that they abode in their places in the camp, till they were whole.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidipayu emuratare o losho pooki, netoni ninche ti atua ilng'oborri o metaba anaa neishiu.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, This day have I rolled away the reproach of Egypt from off you. Wherefore the name of the place is called Gilgal unto this day.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Ore ena olong aibeleleng'oyie nanu esulare e Misiri aitung'uaa intae.” Neaku ore enkarna e ine wueji naa keji Gilgal o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
Masaai: Ore eton etii iltung'ana le Israel ilng'oborri te Gilgal nenya ninche Pasaka te nkolong e tomon o ong'uan o lapa teipa too nkisiajat e Yeriko.

English: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu te siadi Pasaka, te ina olong, nenya ninche ilng'anayio le ina kop, imukateni neitu eisuijieki o entapa natapejoki.

English: And the manna ceased on the morrow after they had eaten of the old corn of the land; neither had the children of Israel manna any more; but they did eat of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
Masaai: Neishunye mana pee ekenyu ina kata apa enya ilng'anayio le ina kop; neitu eitoki iltung'ana le Israel aatum mana, kake einosa ilng'anayio le nkop e Kanaan te ilo ari.

English: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, there stood a man over against him with his sword drawn in his hand: and Joshua went unto him, and said unto him, Art thou for us, or for our adversaries?
Masaai: Ore apa etii Yoshua embata e Yeriko, neshumu nkonyek enyena aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, eitashe oltung'ani te mbata ninye eeta olalem lenye oshutuno te nkaina enye; nelo Yoshua enetii ninye nejoki ninye, “Eira iyie ole nkalo ang, aashu oloo lmang'ati lang?”

English: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of the LORD am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “A-a; kake aewuo nanu anaa olarikoni le njore o Laitoriani.” Nebatata Yoshua te nkomom enye o metabaiki enkop, neserem, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo ejoki Olaitoriani lai osinka lenye?”

English: And the captain of the LORD'S host said unto Joshua, Loose thy shoe from off thy foot; for the place whereon thou standest is holy. And Joshua did so.
Masaai: Ore ilo arikoni le njore o Laitoriani nejoki Yoshua, “Ntayu inamuka inono too nkejek inono; amu ore ine wueji nintasheyie naa eisinyati.” Neas Yoshua ina.

English: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.
Masaai: Naa keikeno apa Yeriko ti atua o ti oriong te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel; meetae apa oltung'ani olo boo nemeetae olojing'u.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, See, I have given into thine hand Jericho, and the king thereof, and the mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Toduaa, aishorua nanu apik nkaik inono Yeriko, te nebo olaiguanani lenye o ltung'ana magil lo larrabal.

English: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
Masaai: Tamana iyie ina anasa, ore iltung'ana pooki lo larrabal nepuo aaman enkanasa te nkata nabo. Ninkoko neijia too nkolong'i ile.

English: And seven priests shall bear before the ark seven trumpets of rams' horns: and the seventh day ye shall compass the city seven times, and the priests shall blow with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak oopishana nenap imouarak naapishana oo lmeregeshi te dukuya ilo sanduku; ore te nkolong e naapishana, nimanimana enkanasa katitin naapishana, ekutita ilapolosak imouarak:

English: And it shall come to pass, that when they make a long blast with the ram's horn, and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat, and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him.
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eitayu ninche eoshoto naado te nena mouarak oo lmeregeshi, ore ake pee ining'ining'i oltoilo le mouo, nebuaku iltung'ana pooki te mbuakunoto kitok; neurunye esuntai e nkanasa abaiki enkop, nepuo iltung'ana dukuya, oltung'ani ake neiulokino dukuya ninye.”

English: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said unto them, Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD.
Masaai: Neipotu Yoshua olayioni le Nuni ilapolosak nejoki ninche, “Ewaita osanduku lo sotua, ninchosho ilapolosak oopishana enap imouarak naapishana oo lmeregeshi te dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani.”

English: And he said unto the people, Pass on, and compass the city, and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana, “Enchom dukuya; entaman enkanasa, ninchosho lelo tung'ana oata imasaa o larrabal egiroo aapuo dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani.”

English: And it came to pass, when Joshua had spoken unto the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams' horns passed on before the LORD, and blew with the trumpets: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD followed them.
Masaai: Naa ore apa anaa enaitanapa Yoshua iltung'ana, ore lelo apolosak oopishana oonapita imouarak naapishana oo lmeregeshi te dukuya Olaitoriani nepuo dukuya, eoshito imouarak, esujita ninche ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani.

English: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets, and the rereward came after the ark, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana apa oata imasaa o larrabal nepuo te dukuya lelo apolosak ooshito imouarak ore lelo ootii siadi nesuju ilo sanduku, eoshito imouarak.

English: And Joshua had commanded the people, saying, Ye shall not shout, nor make any noise with your voice, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I bid you shout; then shall ye shout.
Masaai: Kake eitanapa apa Yoshua iltung'ana ajoki, “Mibuakuku ake aashu inchosho oltoilo linyi ening'oyu, nemepuku hoo ororei obo aimu inkutukie inyi, o metabau ina olong najokinye intae entabuaku.”

English: So the ark of the LORD compassed the city, going about it once: and they came into the camp, and lodged in the camp.
Masaai: Neisho ninye ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani meitamani enkanasa, neman ninye nabo kata; nepuonu ninche ilng'oborri lenye, neirrag ninche ina kewarie ilng'oborri.

English: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yoshua tadekenya enasirie, nedumu ilapolosak osanduku lo Laitoriani.

English: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark of the LORD went on continually, and blew with the trumpets: and the armed men went before them; but the rereward came after the ark of the LORD, the priests going on, and blowing with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore lelo apolosak apa oonapita nena mouarak naapishana oo lmeregeshi te dukuya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani neituruk, eoshito mouarak aaigil; ore lelo tung'ana apa oata imasaa o larrabal nepuo tedukuya ninche, ore apa lelo ootii siadi nesuju osanduku lo Laitoriani, ina kata eoshitoi imouarak aaigil.

English: And the second day they compassed the city once, and returned into the camp: so they did six days.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e are neman ninche enkanasa kata nabo, neshukunye aapuonu ilng'oborri. Neiko ninche neijia too nkolong'i ile.

English: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they rose early about the dawning of the day, and compassed the city after the same manner seven times: only on that day they compassed the city seven times.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naapishana nedumunye ninche enasirie, neman enkanasa anaa oshiake katitin naapishana: naa ina olong ake apa etamana ninche enkanasa katitin naapishana.

English: And it came to pass at the seventh time, when the priests blew with the trumpets, Joshua said unto the people, Shout; for the LORD hath given you the city.
Masaai: Ore te nkata e naapishana, eidipa ilapolosak aatoosh imouarak, nejoki Yoshua iltung'ana, “Entabuaku; amu eishoo intae Olaitoriani ena anasa.

English: And the city shall be accursed, even it, and all that are therein, to the LORD: only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all that are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
Masaai: Ore ena anasa o pooki natii atua ninye neidaikieki tukul te nkaraki Olaitoriani; Rahabu ina mulayoi ake o lelo pooki ootii te nebo ninye ti atua enkaji enye naapok, enkaraki apa naisudoyie ninye lelo aikitalak likirriwaitie.

English: And ye, in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest ye make yourselves accursed, when ye take of the accursed thing, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.
Masaai: Kake ore intae, entalama ate nena tokitin naaiteng'elakaki enkidaaroto, pee meaku ake ore inteng'ela intae ninche niyaya nabo e nena tokitin naaiteng'elaki nintaa ilng'oborri le Israel entoki e nkidaaroto, niyauu enyamali shumata ninye.

English: But all the silver, and gold, and vessels of brass and iron, are consecrated unto the LORD: they shall come into the treasury of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore enkosholai pooki o sahabu, o masaa o suyai o esekenkei, naa eisinyat to Laitoriani keyae ninche atua olchumati lo Laitoriani.”

English: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets: and it came to pass, when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
Masaai: Nebuaku iltung'ana neoshi imouarak. Erisio ake etoning'o iltung'ana oltoilo le mouo, neilepie iltung'ana embuakunoto kitok, neurori esuntai abaiki enkop, nejing iltung'ana atua ina anasa, neitoriokino ake oltung'ani dukuya enye, neya ninche ina anasa.

English: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, and sheep, and ass, with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaidaikie tukul pooki natii atua ina anasa, ilewa o nkituaak, ilooti o lbotoro, o lmong'i o nkerra o sirkon te nepi o lalem.

English: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country, Go into the harlot's house, and bring out thence the woman, and all that she hath, as ye sware unto her.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua lelo tung'ana oare apa ooikitalana ina kop, “Enchom atua enkaji e ina mulayoi, nimpang'unyenye ti atua ninye ina kitok, o lelo pooki oora ilkulenye, anaa apa eninosakitia ninye olmumai.”

English: And the young men that were spies went in, and brought out Rahab, and her father, and her mother, and her brethren, and all that she had; and they brought out all her kindred, and left them without the camp of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo barnot apa oora ilaikitalak nepuo atua aji, neipang'unye Rahabu, o papaai lenye, o ng'otonye o lalashera o pooki oora ilkulenye; neyau ninche olmarei lenye pooki, nepik ninche auluo ilng'oborri le Israel.

English: And they burnt the city with fire, and all that was therein: only the silver, and the gold, and the vessels of brass and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninche ina anasa te nkima o pooki naatii atua ninche; enkosholai ake o sahabu, o masaa o suyai o nesekenkei, etipika ninche atua olchumati le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
Masaai: Kake ore Rahabu ina mulayoi, o enkaji e papaai lenye o pooki oora ilkulenye, eitajeuo Yoshua metopua; neton ninye ti atua Israel o metabaiki ena olong, enkaraki apa natunuka ilaikitalak ooirriua Yoshua meikitalana Yeriko.

English: And Joshua adjured them at that time, saying, Cursed be the man before the LORD, that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho: he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
Masaai: Neirragakinye Yoshua ninche olmumai te ina kata, ejo “Ediaa te dukuya Olaitoriani ilo tung'ani odumunye neigil ashet ena anasa e Yeriko; te nkinyang'a o lkikau lenye epik ninye olkitamanyunoto lenye, naa te nkinyang'a o ldung'oret lenye epik ninye nchomito enyena.”

English: So the LORD was with Joshua; and his fame was noised throughout all the country.
Masaai: Neaku etii apa Olaitoriani tenebo Yoshua; ore olning'o lenye neibulu enkop pooki.

English: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the accursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed thing: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake etigila apa iltung'ana le Israel enkirukoto ti alo nena tokitin apa naaitengelaki; amu ore Akan olayioni le Karmi, olayioni le Sabdi, olayioni le Sera lo losho le Yuda, eewa embata e nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki; neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Bethaven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoshua iltung'ana te Yeriko meshomo enkang e Ai, apa nataaniki Bet-afen, enkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e Betel, nejoki ninche, “Elepa enchom enkitalana enkop.” Neilep iltung'ana aapuo aaikitalan Ai.

English: And they returned to Joshua, and said unto him, Let not all the people go up; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai; and make not all the people to labour thither; for they are but few.
Masaai: Neshukunye ninche enetii Yoshua, nejoki ninye, “Mincho iltung'ana pooki eilep aapuo, kake nchoo iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni are aashu nkalifuni uni eilep aapuo, aaibung Ai; mincho iltung'ana pooki epuo aanauru te ine amu ei kuti ninche.”

English: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men: and they fled before the men of Ai.
Masaai: Neaku iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni ake ooilepa aapuo ti atua iltung'ana le Israel; nepuo aaisik te dukuya iltung'ana le Ai,

English: And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men: for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim, and smote them in the going down: wherefore the hearts of the people melted, and became as water.
Masaai: nesesekuan iltung'ana le Ai iltung'ana oobaya tomoni uni o ile lenye, nemiraa ninche te kishomi o meitabaiki Shebarim, nesesekuan ninche to loshong'ishong'i nelepori iltauja loo ltung'ana netiu anaa enkare.

English: And Joshua rent his clothes, and fell to the earth upon his face before the ark of the LORD until the eventide, he and the elders of Israel, and put dust upon their heads.
Masaai: Nepolos Yoshua nkilani enyena nebatatakino enkop te nkomom enye te dukuya ilo sanduku ometaba anaa neaku teipa, ninye te nebo ilpayiani le Israel; nepik enterit ilukuny enye.

English: And Joshua said, Alas, O Lord GOD, wherefore hast thou at all brought this people over Jordan, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? would to God we had been content, and dwelt on the other side Jordan!
Masaai: Nejo Yoshua, “Ee, Olaitoriani Enkai, kainyoo apa pee intasima aitalang'u kulo tung'ana Yordan, pee ilotu aishooyo iyiook apik atua nkaik oo Lamori, pee eidaikie iyiook? Enaikash apa ti nikitobiko te lido kekun le Yordan!

English: O Lord, what shall I say, when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies!
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kaa nanu eton ajo eibelekenyate Israel aaisho oriong ilmang'ati lenye!

English: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?
Masaai: Amu ore Ilkanaani o lelo pooki oomanya ena kop naa keyooki aaning ena, nemuat iyiook aaman nedung'oo enkarna ang aaiwuang'ie te nkop; naa kaa iyie ias te nkaraki enkarna ino kitok?”

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Get thee up; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Tudumunye, kainyoo iyie pee itabatate aiko nji te nkomom ino?

English: Israel hath sinned, and they have also transgressed my covenant which I commanded them: for they have even taken of the accursed thing, and have also stolen, and dissembled also, and they have put it even among their own stuff.
Masaai: Etaasa Israel eng'oki; etigila ninche olning'o lai apa laitanapa nanu ninche, ewaita ninche embata oo ntokitin apa naaiteng'elaki, etupurrishote ninche nelejisho, nepik ninche atua imasaa enye.

English: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they were accursed: neither will I be with you any more, except ye destroy the accursed from among you.
Masaai: Neaku meidim iltung'ana le Israel aaitasheiki ilmang'ati lenye, eibelekenyate ninche aaisho oriong ilmang'ati lenye, enkaraki nataa ninche entoki e nkidaata. Maitoki ae kata nanu aaku te nebo iyie, aashu ake ti nindaikie nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki aitung'uaa atua intae.

English: Up, sanctify the people, and say, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow: for thus saith the LORD God of Israel, There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee, O Israel: thou canst not stand before thine enemies, until ye take away the accursed thing from among you.
Masaai: Tudumunye, ntisinya iltung'ana, nijoki, ‘Entisinya ate te nkaraki taisere, amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, “Ntokitin apa naaiteng'elaki kuna naatii atua intae, Israel; mindim iyie aitasho te dukuya ilmang'ati, linono, o metaba anaa nintayu nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki aiwuang'ie ti atua iyie.”

English: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes: and it shall be, that the tribe which the LORD taketh shall come according to the families thereof; and the family which the LORD shall take shall come by households; and the household which the LORD shall take shall come man by man.
Masaai: Ore naa tadekenya keyauni intae aaitinyiku anaa too loshon linyi; ore ilo osho oya Olaitoriani nelotu anyiku anaa too lmareita; ore ilo marei oya Olaitoriani neyauni aaitinyiku anaa too nkajijik; ore ina aji naya Olaitoriani nelotu anyiku oltung'ani ake oltung'ani.

English: And it shall be, that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire, he and all that he hath: because he hath transgressed the covenant of the LORD, and because he hath wrought folly in Israel.
Masaai: Naa ore ilo oyai eeta nena tokitin apa naaiteng'elaki nepejori te nkima, ninye o ntokitin pooki naata ninye, enkaraki natigila ninye olning'o lo Laitoriani, o enkaraki nataasa ninye embae e sulare ti atua Israel.’ ”

English: So Joshua rose up early in the morning, and brought Israel by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken:
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye apa Yoshua tadekenya enasirie, neyau Israel aitinyiku olosho o losho, neyae olosho le Yuda;

English: And he brought the family of Judah; and he took the family of the Zarhites: and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man; and Zabdi was taken:
Masaai: neyau ninye aitinyiku ilmareita le Yuda, neyae olmarei loo Lsera; neyau ninye aitinyiku to lmarei loo Lsera oltung'ani o ltung'ani; neyae Sabdi;

English: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
Masaai: neyau ninye aitinyiku enkaji enye oltung'ani ake oltung'ani, neyae Akan, olayioni le Karmi, olayioni le Sabdi, olayioni le Sera lo losho le Yuda.

English: And Joshua said unto Achan, My son, give, I pray thee, glory to the LORD God of Israel, and make confession unto him; and tell me now what thou hast done; hide it not from me.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajoki Akan, “Enkerai ai, nchoo enkitoo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, nincho ninye enkisisa; naa tolikioki taata nanu enitaasa iyie; mikisudoriyie nanu.”

English: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
Masaai: Newaliki Akan Yoshua ajoki, “Esipa ataasa nanu eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai e Israel, naa ena nanu ataasa:

English: When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.
Masaai: Ore ake pee adol ti atua nena naatarayioki olkila sidai oing'uaa Shinari o shekeli iip are e nkosholai o lbelati le sahabu oata shekeli onom te nkiroishi, nang'uar nanu ninche, naya ninche; naa ng'ura, enukaro ninche ti atua enkop ti atua olng'obor lai, etii enkosholai ti abori.”

English: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran unto the tent; and, behold, it was hid in his tent, and the silver under it.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yoshua iltung'ana, neipirri ninche aapuo olng'obor; naa ng'ura, keturoro apa ti atua olng'obor lenye etii enkosholai abori.

English: And they took them out of the midst of the tent, and brought them unto Joshua, and unto all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the LORD.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche ti atua olng'obor neyau ninche enetii Yoshua o ltung'ana pooki le Israel; neirragie ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver, and the garment, and the wedge of gold, and his sons, and his daughters, and his oxen, and his asses, and his sheep, and his tent, and all that he had: and they brought them unto the valley of Achor.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua o Siraeli pooki ootii te nebo ninye neya Akan olayioni le Sera, o enkosholai, o lkila o ilo belati le sahabu, o layiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena, o lmong'i lenyena o sirkon lenyena o nkerra, o lng'obor lenye o pooki toki apa naata ninye; neyauni ninche oerata le Akori.

English: And Joshua said, Why hast thou troubled us? the LORD shall trouble thee this day. And all Israel stoned him with stones, and burned them with fire, after they had stoned them with stones.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua, “Kainyoo iyie pee iyaka iyiook enyamali? Eikiyaki iyie Olaitoriani enyamali taata.” Nenang Israel pooki ninye too soito; nepejori ninche te nkima, nenang ninche too soito.

English: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
Masaai: Nesot ninche te shumata ninye enkurare kitok too soito leton etii o metabaiki ena olong neibelekenya taa Olaitoriani te ina goro enye nayupuyup. Neaku ore ebaiki ena olong ore enkarna e ine wueji naa keji oerata le Akori.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear not, neither be thou dismayed: take all the people of war with thee, and arise, go up to Ai: see, I have given into thy hand the king of Ai, and his people, and his city, and his land:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Miureishoyu niming'aing'ai; iwa lelo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal te nebo iyie, naa tudumunye, ilepa shomo Ai; toduaa ajo aishorua nanu apik atua enkaina ino olaiguanani le Ai, o ltung'ana lenyena, enkanasa enye o enkop enye.

English: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.
Masaai: Naa intaasiasa intae Ai o laiguanani lenye anaa apa enintaasa Yeriko o laiguanani lenye; kake ewaita ntokitin enyena o nkishu entarai; entipik olnukata empirakinye enkanasa ti oriong.”

English: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai: and Joshua chose out thirty thousand mighty men of valour, and sent them away by night.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yoshua te nebo ltung'ana pooki lo larrabal, pee eilep aapuo Ai, negelu Yoshua iltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni magil oodupa, neirriwaa ninche kewarie.

English: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
Masaai: Neitanap ninye ninche ajoki, “Ng'ura, irragirraga intae aanuka aaishiaakinore enkanasa, aaimu ninye ti oriong; emipuopuo intae aalamari oleng te ina anasa, kake enterretenata pee irasakiki.

English: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
Masaai: Ore nanu, o ltung'ana pooki ootii te nebo nanu, nikipuo aanyikaki ina anasa. Naa ore te neipang'u ninche aapuonu aarare iyiook, anaa apa, nikimpirri aailanyisho te dukuya ninche;

English: (For they will come out after us) till we have drawn them from the city; for they will say, They flee before us, as at the first: therefore we will flee before them.
Masaai: naa keipang'u ninche aapuonu aamir iyiook, o metaba anaa nikiya ninche enelakua te ina anasa; amu kejo ninche, ‘Eisika aailany iyiook, anaa apa.’ Neaku eikisik iyiook aailany ninche;

English: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
Masaai: nitumokiki taa aatudumunye aatupuku te ilo nukata nimbung'ubung'u ina anasa; amu keisho intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi apik atua enkaina inyi.

English: And it shall be, when ye have taken the city, that ye shall set the city on fire: according to the commandment of the LORD shall ye do. See, I have commanded you.
Masaai: Naa ore te nindipidipi aawaita ina anasa, nipikipiki intae ina anasa enkima, niasiasa anaa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani; entodol nchere aitanapa nanu intae.”

English: Joshua therefore sent them forth: and they went to lie in ambush, and abode between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie apa ninche Yoshua; nepuo ninche ewueji o lnukata, neirrag te rishata e Betel o Ai, enkalo e ndoyoroto e Ai; kake etotona apa Yoshua ina kewarie te nebo iltung'ana.

English: And Joshua rose up early in the morning, and numbered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yoshua tadekenya enasirie neiturrur iltung'ana, neilep alo te nebo ilpayiani le Israel neituruk te dukuya iltung'ana alo Ai.

English: And all the people, even the people of war that were with him, went up, and drew nigh, and came before the city, and pitched on the north side of Ai: now there was a valley between them and Ai.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki apa lo larrabal ootii te nebo ninye neilep aapuo nenyikaa aataaniki ina anasa; nepik ilng'oborri enkalo e moikuape e Ai.

English: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
Masaai: Neya ninye arik iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni imiet, nepik ninche atua olnukata te rishata e Betel o Ai, te nkalo o loo ntoluo le nkanasa.

English: And when they had set the people, even all the host that was on the north of the city, and their liers in wait on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
Masaai: neitobiraki ninche iltimito, etii oltim kitok enkalo e moikuape e ina anasa netii oriong enye enkalo o loo ntoluo e nkanasa. Kake eirraga apa Yoshua ina kewarie atua oerata.

English: And it came to pass, when the king of Ai saw it, that they hasted and rose up early, and the men of the city went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at a time appointed, before the plain; but he wist not that there were liers in ambush against him behind the city.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani le Ai ena, ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, lelo tung'ana le ina anasa, neisarrisar neipang aapuo tadekenya aaishong'ishong, aaipirri enkalo e Araba pee enang'are Israel aarare; kake eitu apa eyiolou nchere etii olnukata oarare ninye otii oriong ina anasa.

English: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore Yoshua o Israel pooki neitaakuno ketaraki te dukuya ninche, neisik aapuo enkalo e ong'ata.

English: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
Masaai: Neaku ore iltung'ana pooki apa ootii atua enkanasa neipotuni te nebo pee esujaa ninche, naa ore esujita ninche Yoshua nerikori aaitalam ina anasa.

English: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
Masaai: Metii apa oltung'ani hoo obo otung'uayioki te Ai arashu te Betel, leitu eipang alo asujaa Israel; neing'uaa ninche enkanasa ebolo, nesujaa Israel.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Ntorioi ina pere natii enkaina ino ing'orie Ai, amu kaaisho nanu iyie apik atua enkaina ino.” Neitorioo Yoshua ina pere apa natii enkaina enye aing'orie ina anasa.

English: And the ambush arose quickly out of their place, and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand: and they entered into the city, and took it, and hasted and set the city on fire.
Masaai: Ore lelo apa ootii olnukata nedumunye nabo kata aapuku te ine wueji apa nenukare, nerisio ake eitorioyie ninye enkaina enye, nekuet ninche nejing atua ina anasa neya ninye; neisarrisar aapik atua ina anasa enkima.

English: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and, behold, the smoke of the city ascended up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that way: and the people that fled to the wilderness turned back upon the pursuers.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee eing'or lelo tung'ana apa le Ai siadi, ng'ura, neilep empuruo e ina anasa alo shumata; nemeekure eeta engolon naisikakinye ena shoto aashu idia, amu ore lelo tung'ana apa ooisikakitia ong'ata neibelekenyakinote lelo apa oosujita.
