English: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city, and that the smoke of the city ascended, then they turned again, and slew the men of Ai.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Yoshua o Israel pooki nchere eibung'a lelo apa ootii olnukata enkanasa, neilepa empuruo e ina anasa alo shumata, neibelekenyunye aar metuata lelo tung'ana le Ai.

English: And the other issued out of the city against them; so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side: and they smote them, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
Masaai: Neipang'u ilkulikae ooing'uaa enkanasa aapuonu aarare ninche; nejing empolos e Israel, etii ilkulikae ena shoto netii ilkulikae idia shoto; nesesekuan Israel ninche, o metaba anaa neaku metii hoo obo otelekua aashu otuluayie.

English: And the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
Masaai: Kake ore olaiguanani le Ai neya ninche eishu, neyau ninye enetii Yoshua.

English: And it came to pass, when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness wherein they chased them, and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword, until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned unto Ai, and smote it with the edge of the sword.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Israel atara metuata lelo pooki apa oomanya Ai ti atua ina ong'ata naisiaja apa natusujakitia ninche ore ninche pooki o metabaiki olobayie lenye netabatatate te nepi o lalem, neshukunye Israel pooki aapuonu Ai neosh ninche te nepi o lalem.

English: And so it was, that all that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the men of Ai.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki apa ootabatatate ina olong, ilewa o nkituaak naa nkalifuni tomon o are, iltung'ana pooki le Ai.

English: For Joshua drew not his hand back, wherewith he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa eshuk Yoshua enkaina enye, naa ninye apa eitorioriyie ina pere, o metaba anaa neidaikie tukul lelo pooki apa oomanya Ai.

English: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves, according unto the word of the LORD which he commanded Joshua.
Masaai: Nkishu ake o masaa e ina anasa apa ewaita Israel aaitaa ntokitin naataraitie, te risioroto e ilo rorei lo Laitoriani apa oitanapa Yoshua.

English: And Joshua burnt Ai, and made it an heap for ever, even a desolation unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku etapejoyie Yoshua Ai, neitaa ninye intarasi osototi le nkidaata, anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until eventide: and as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his carcase down from the tree, and cast it at the entering of the gate of the city, and raise thereon a great heap of stones, that remaineth unto this day.
Masaai: Neilili ninye ilo aiguanani le Ai to lchani o metaa teipa; ore pee eaku kedoyio enkolong neitanapisho Yoshua, neitayu ninche aaitadou osesen lenye to lchani nenang'aki enejing'ieki kishomi e ina anasa nepik shumata ninye osototi kitok loo soito, leton eitashe te ine o taata.

English: Then Joshua built an altar unto the LORD God of Israel in mount Ebal,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ashet olperere lo lasar to ldoinyo le Ebal, ashetaki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel,

English: As Moses the servant of the LORD commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of whole stones, over which no man hath lift up any iron: and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the LORD, and sacrificed peace offerings.
Masaai: anaa apa enaitanapa Musa ilo sinka lo Laitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, anaa enaigero ti atua embuku oo nkitanapat e Musa, “Olperere lo lasar loo soito lemegueta, leitu ae kata eiteleiki oltung'ani enguetet e sekenkei;” neishooyo ninche te nchumata enye ilasarri oopejori aaisho Olaitoriani, nepolos ilasarri le seriani.

English: And he wrote there upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he wrote in the presence of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore te ine, etii iltung'ana le Israel, neiger te nchumata oo soito enkigilata e nkitanapata e Musa, apa naigero ninye.

English: And all Israel, and their elders, and officers, and their judges, stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, as well the stranger, as he that was born among them; half of them over against mount Gerizim, and half of them over against mount Ebal; as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
Masaai: Ore Israel pooki, oldokunoti o inoti, te nebo ilpayiani lenye o lkituaak o larishak lenye, neitashe too nkipirakinot e ilo sanduku te dukuya lapolosak le Lawi apa oonap ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo Laitoriani, etii olpisiai lenye dukuya oldoinyo le Geresim netii olpisiai lenye dukuya oldoinyo le Ebal, anaa apa enaitanapishe Musa ilo sinka lo Laitoriani te dukuya, nchere pee emayian ninche iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and cursings, according to all that is written in the book of the law.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena neisuma ninye irorei pooki le nkitanapata, emayianata o ldeket, te risioroto e nena pooki naaigeroki ti atua embuku oo nkitanapat.

English: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded, which Joshua read not before all the congregation of Israel, with the women, and the little ones, and the strangers that were conversant among them.
Masaai: Meetae apa ororei hoo obo le nena pooki apa naaitanapishe Musa neitu eisuma Yoshua te dukuya ina umata pooki e Israel, o nkituaak o nkera kutiti, o ldokunot apa ootii atua ninche.

English: And it came to pass, when all the kings which were on this side Jordan, in the hills, and in the valleys, and in all the coasts of the great sea over against Lebanon, the Hittite, and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard thereof;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilaiguanak pooki apa ootii lido kekun Yordan ina kop oo ldoinyo o ina kop nagum ilo omanaa pooki le naiposha kitok te nkalo e Lebanon, o Lhiti, o Lamori, o Lkanaani, o Lperisi,

English: That they gathered themselves together, to fight with Joshua and with Israel, with one accord.
Masaai: neiturrurro ninche te nebo pee earare Yoshua o Israel.

English: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai,
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening lelo apa oomanya Gibeon ina apa naitaasa Yoshua Yeriko o Ai,

English: They did work wilily, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks upon their asses, and wine bottles, old, and rent, and bound up;
Masaai: ore ninche te nkalo enye neas enkeleekisho neitobir ninche ndaiki, neyau ilkuniyiani ootopolosate nepik nkoriong'i oo sirkon lenye, o lbenia le naisho, oopolosa nepololo nerami,

English: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
Masaai: o namuka naatumutate too nkejek enye, o nkilani naapolosa; ore endaa enye pooki netoyio nebaa.

English: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal, and said unto him, and to the men of Israel, We be come from a far country: now therefore make ye a league with us.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche enetii Yoshua too lng'oborri te Gilgal, nejoki ninye o ltung'ana le Israel, “Kietuo iyiook king'ua enkop nalakua; neaku ntobira taata iyie olning'o o iyiook.”

English: And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?
Masaai: Kake etiakitia iltung'ana le Israel lelo Hafi, “Ebaiki naa atua iyiook intae itii; kaji naa kinko iyiook ti nikintobir olning'o o intae?”

English: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Yoshua, “Eikira iyiook isinkan linono.” Nejoki Yoshua ninche, “Eirara intae akua? Naa kaji intae ing'uaa?”

English: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Enkop nalakua eing'uaa isinkan linono te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ino; amu kitoning'o iyiook ilomon lenyena, o nena pooki naataasa ninye te Misiri,

English: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites, that were beyond Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, which was at Ashtaroth.
Masaai: o nena pooki naaitaasa ninye ilaiguanak loo Lamori apa otii lido kekun Yordan, Sihon ilo aiguanani le Heshbon, o Oog olaiguanani le Bashan ilo apa omanya Ashtarot.

English: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us, saying, Take victuals with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say unto them, We are your servants: therefore now make ye a league with us.
Masaai: Ore ilpayiani lang o lelo pooki oomanya enkop ang netiakitia iyiook, ‘Ewaita endaa too nkaik inyi te lototo, nipuopuo aanang'are ninche, nijokiki ninche, “Kira iyiook isinkan linyi; wootu naa taata, entobira olning'o te nebo iyiook.” ’

English: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
Masaai: Nena emukate ang; eton apa eirowua ina kata pee kintayu too nkajijik ang aaitaa endaa te nkoitoi ina olong apa nikitudumunye aapuonu enitii intae; kake ore taata, ng'ura, etoyio netabee,

English: And these bottles of wine, which we filled, were new; and, behold, they be rent: and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey.
Masaai: ore kulo benia le naisho naa aing'ejuko apa pee kimput iyiook ninche, naa ng'ura, etadanyate; ore kulo kilani o namuka ang netumutate tena lototo naado.”

English: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku etang'amutua apa nena daiki enye, neitu eikilikuanu eutaroto to Laitoriani.

English: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
Masaai: Neitayu Yoshua eseriani te nebo ninche, neitayu olning'o te nebo ninche, pee eisho ninche epok; ore lelo kituaak apa lo lturrur neinosaki ninche olmumai.

English: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them, that they heard that they were their neighbours, and that they dwelt among them.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i uni eidipa ninche aaitobira olning'o te nebo ninche, nening ninche nchere ilelatia enye ninche, naa atua ninche oshi ake etii.

English: And the children of Israel journeyed, and came unto their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, and Chephirah, and Beeroth, and Kirjathjearim.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana le Israel aapuo nebaya nkanas enye te nkolong e uni. Ore apa nkanas enye naa Gibeon, Chefira, Be-erot, o Kiriat-yearim.

English: And the children of Israel smote them not, because the princes of the congregation had sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel. And all the congregation murmured against the princes.
Masaai: Kake eitu ear iltung'ana le Israel ninche metuata, amu ore apa ilkituaak lo lturrur neinosa olmumai to Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel. Neing'unyung'uny olturrur pooki te nkaraki lelo arikok.

English: But all the princes said unto all the congregation, We have sworn unto them by the LORD God of Israel: now therefore we may not touch them.
Masaai: Kake etiakitia lelo arikok pooki olturrur, “Kinosakitia iyiook ninche olmumai to Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ore taata mikindim iyiook aaiseyie ninche.

English: This we will do to them; we will even let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath which we sware unto them.
Masaai: Ena iyiook maitaasa ninche, nikincho ninche epok, mejing ake engoro shumata iyiook, te nkaraki ilo mumai apa likinosakitia ninche.”

English: And the princes said unto them, Let them live; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation; as the princes had promised them.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo kituaak ninche, “Enchoo ninche epok.” Neaku ninche ilaiperrak loo lkeek neoku enkare te nkaraki olturrur pooki, anaa enatiakitia lelo kituaak ninche.

English: And Joshua called for them, and he spake unto them, saying, Wherefore have ye beguiled us, saying, We are very far from you; when ye dwell among us?
Masaai: Neipotu Yoshua ninche, nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee iteleja iyiook, aajo, ‘Eikilakuaniki iyiook intae oleng;’ aa atua iyiook ake itii?

English: Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.
Masaai: Ore naa taata iakuku intae iloodiaa, ore ilkulikae te intae naa keaku irrindiki anaake, ilaiperrak loo lkeek o laokunok le nkare te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai.”

English: And they answered Joshua, and said, Because it was certainly told thy servants, how that the LORD thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you, therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche Yoshua aajo, “Ore enkaraki natolikioki apa isinkan linono aaitisipaki nchere eitanapa Olaitoriani Enkai ino osinka lenye Musa pee eisho intae ena kop pooki, pee indaikiekie lelo pooki oomanya ena kop aaiwuang'ie te dukuya intae; neaku kitureishote iyiook oleng te nkaraki enkishui ang te dukuya intae; nikiaas ena bae.

English: And now, behold, we are in thine hand: as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us, do.
Masaai: Naa ore taata, ng'ura, kitii iyiook atua enkaina ino: taasa anaa enidol ajo sidai neishaakino too nkonyek inono ti nintaas iyiook.”

English: And so did he unto them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, that they slew them not.
Masaai: Neaku eitaasa ninye ninche, nekordu ninche aitayu ti atua enkaina oo ltung'ana le Israel; neitu ninche ear ninche metuata.

English: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation, and for the altar of the LORD, even unto this day, in the place which he should choose.
Masaai: Kake eitaa apa Yoshua ninche ina olong ilaiperrak o laokunok le nkare te nkaraki ilo turrur o te nkaraki olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, pee emooki ninche aas ina o metabaiki ena olong, te ine wueji netegelua ninye.

English: Now it came to pass, when Adonizedek king of Jerusalem had heard how Joshua had taken Ai, and had utterly destroyed it; as he had done to Jericho and her king, so he had done to Ai and her king; and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel, and were among them;
Masaai: Ore apa pee ening Adoni-sedek olaiguanani le Yerusalem eneikuna Yoshua pee eibung Ai, neidaikie ninye katukul, aitaas Ai o laiguanani lenye anaa apa enaitaasa Yeriko o laiguanani lenye, o ina naitobira lelo oomanya Gibeon eseriani o Israel netii atua ninche.

English: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
Masaai: Neureishoyu ninye oleng, amu enkanasa kitok apa Gibeon, anaa ake duoo ae anasa e nkitoo, o enkaraki naa eikitok apa alang Ai naa magil iltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: Wherefore Adonizedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron, and unto Piram king of Jarmuth, and unto Japhia king of Lachish, and unto Debir king of Eglon, saying,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neirriwaki Adoni-sedek olaiguanani le Yerusalem Hoham olkilikuai ilo aiguanani le Hebron, o Piram olaiguanani le Yarmut, o Yafia olaiguanani le lakish, neirriwaki sii Debir olaiguanani le Eglon, ejoki,

English: Come up unto me, and help me, that we may smite Gibeon: for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Wootu enatii nanu, entaretuoki nanu, emataar iyiook Gibeon; amu eitobira ninye eseriani o Yoshua o te nebo iltung'ana le Israel.”

English: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, the king of Eglon, gathered themselves together, and went up, they and all their hosts, and encamped before Gibeon, and made war against it.
Masaai: Ore lelo aiguanak pokira imiet loo Lamori, o ilo aiguanani le Yerusalem, o ilo aiguanani le Hebron, o ilo aiguanani le Yarmut, o ilo aiguanani le Lakish, o laiguanani le Eglon neiturrur iltimito lenye, nepuo ninche te nebo njorin enye pooki neitayu ninche ilng'oborri aaipirakinore Gibeon, neitayunye ninye olarrabal.

English: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal, saying, Slack not thy hand from thy servants; come up to us quickly, and save us, and help us: for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us.
Masaai: Neirriwaki lelo tung'ana le Gibeon Yoshua olkilikuai too lng'oborri te Gilgal, ejo, “Miyeng'iyeng'ie iyie enkaina te nkaraki isinkan linono; tasieku wou enikitii, pee intajeu iyiook, niretu iyiook, amu ore kulo aiguanak pooki loo Lamori oomanya enkop oo ldoinyo neiturrurrote te nkaraki iyiook.”

English: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he, and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Neaku eilepa apa Yoshua te Gilgal, ninye o ltung'ana pooki lo larrabal te nebo ninye, o ltung'ana pooki magil oodupa.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Fear them not: for I have delivered them into thine hand; there shall not a man of them stand before thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Miureyu ninche, amu aishooyie nanu ninche apik atua nkaik inono; meitashe hoo oltung'ani lenye te dukuya intae.”

English: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly, and went up from Gilgal all night.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo apa Yoshua enetii ninche aipang'aki te luamata, eewuo apa enkewarie pooki eing'uaa Gilgal.

English: And the LORD discomfited them before Israel, and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them along the way that goeth up to Bethhoron, and smote them to Azekah, and unto Makkedah.
Masaai: Nepik ninche Olaitoriani olkirutoto te dukuya Israel, laa ninche ootasesekuana ninche te sesekuanata kitok te Gibeon, nemiraa ninche aaimie enkoitoi nashong'ishong e Bet-horon near ninche metuata o metabaiki Aseka o Makeda.

English: And it came to pass, as they fled from before Israel, and were in the going down to Bethhoron, that the LORD cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.
Masaai: Naa ore eisikita ninche te dukuya Israel, epuoito ninche aadoyio to loshong'ishong'i le Bet-horon, nenang'u Olaitoriani aitadou isoito sapuki aitung'uaa shumata aitadoiki ninche ebaiki Aseka, neye ninche; ilkumok apa ootuata te nkaraki isoito le nchan aalang iltung'ana ootara Israel to lalem.

English: Then spake Joshua to the LORD in the day when the LORD delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, Sun, stand thou still upon Gibeon; and thou, Moon, in the valley of Ajalon.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua airorie Olaitoriani te ina olong apa naishooyie Olaitoriani Ilamori aisho iltung'ana le Israel; nejo ninye too nkonyek e Israel, “Na olong, ntasho iyie ntirring'ayu te Gibeon, naa ore sii iyie Lo apa intasho to erata le Ajalon.”

English: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
Masaai: Neitashe enkolong aitirring'a, neuno olapa, o metaba anaa neitalaku ilo osho elap too lmang'ati lenye. Aimeigero ena ti atua embuku e Yashar? Eitasho enkolong te mpolos e shumata, neitu eitasim adoyio te ndama pooki.

English: And there was no day like that before it or after it, that the LORD hearkened unto the voice of a man: for the LORD fought for Israel.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata etumi enkolong naaijo ena too nkolong'i naatulusoitie o too naatusujutua, eji nening Enkai oltoilo lo ltung'ani; amu etijing'a apa Olaitoriani olarrabal te nkaraki Israel.

English: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ashukunye o Israel pooki te nebo ninye aapuonu ilng'oborri te Gilgal.

English: But these five kings fled, and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
Masaai: Neisik apa kulo aiguanak pokira imiet, neisudoo ate ti atua enkapune te Makeda.

English: And it was told Joshua, saying, The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah.
Masaai: Netolikioki apa Yoshua, “Ore lelo aiguanak pokira imiet nenotoki eisudori ti atua enkapune te Makeda.”

English: And Joshua said, Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave, and set men by it for to keep them:
Masaai: Nejo Yoshua, “Emperiperaki isoito sapuki enkutuk e ina apune, nipikipiki iltung'ana embata enye pee errip ninche;

English: And stay ye not, but pursue after your enemies, and smite the hindmost of them; suffer them not to enter into their cities: for the LORD your God hath delivered them into your hand.
Masaai: kake emitonini intae te ine, entusujai ilmang'ati linyi, entadoiki ilo kidong'oe lenye, emincho ninche metijing'a nkanas enye; amu eishorua Olaitoriani Enkai inyi apik atua enkaina inyi.”

English: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Yoshua o ltung'ana le Israel aatasesekuan ninche te sesekuanata kitok, o metaba anaa nejutuni ninche, ore ake ilo pisiai, arashu ore ake ilo pisiai lenye otelekua pee ejing atua nena ang'itie naagol naasheta sunta,

English: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace: none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
Masaai: neshukunye iltung'ana pooki eserian aapuonu enetii Yoshua too lng'oborri te Makeda; nemetii ninye oltung'ani hoo obo otabolo enkutuk te ntorroni ti alo likae tung'ani ninye obo le Israel.

English: Then said Joshua, Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings unto me out of the cave.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajo, “Entabol enkutuk e nkapune nimpang'unyenye lelo aiguanak pokira imiet te nkapune aayau enatii nanu.”

English: And they did so, and brought forth those five kings unto him out of the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
Masaai: Neiko ninche neijia, neyau lelo aiguanak pokira imiet aaitayu te nkapune aayaki ninye, olaiguanani le Yerusalem, o laiguanani le Hebron, o laiguanani le Yarmit, o laiguanani le Lakish, o laiguanani le Eglon.

English: And it came to pass, when they brought out those kings unto Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him, Come near, put your feet upon the necks of these kings. And they came near, and put their feet upon the necks of them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipang'unye ninche lelo aiguanak aayau enetii Yoshua, neipotu Yoshua iltung'ana pooki le Israel, nejoki lelo kituaak apa loo ltung'ana le njore ooshomo te nebo ninye, “Wootu entinyiku, entipik nkejek inyi enchumata oo murto e kulo aiguanak.” Nepuonu ninche aanyiku nepik nkejek enye nchumat oomurto e lelo aiguanak aaroro.

English: And Joshua said unto them, Fear not, nor be dismayed, be strong and of good courage: for thus shall the LORD do to all your enemies against whom ye fight.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua ninche, “Emiureishoyu niming'aing'ayiayia; entagoluoto nipijuju; amu nji eiko Olaitoriani ilmang'ati linyi pooki laa ninche iararere.”

English: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
Masaai: Ore te siadi near Yoshua ninche metuata, neilili ninche too lkeek imiet. Neililio ninche te lelo keek o metaa teipa;

English: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun, that Joshua commanded, and they took them down off the trees, and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid, and laid great stones in the cave's mouth, which remain until this very day.
Masaai: kake ore te ndoyioroto e nkolong, neitanapisho Yoshua, neitayuni ninche aaitadou too lkeek, nenang'akini ninche atua ina apune apa naisudorie ate, nepik isoito sapuki enkutuk e ina apune, leton etii o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And that day Joshua took Makkedah, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof he utterly destroyed, them, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he did unto the king of Jericho.
Masaai: Neya apa Yoshua Makeda ina olong, near ninye olaiguanani lenye te nepi o lalem; neidaikie ninye tukul pooki tung'ani otii atua, eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani; neitaas ilo aiguanani le Makeda anaa apa enaitaasa olaiguanani le Yeriko.

English: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, unto Libnah, and fought against Libnah:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua alo agiroo Makeda, o Israel pooki te nebo ninye, nelo Libna, nearare Libna;

English: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
Masaai: neitoki sii Olaitoriani aishooyo ninye o laiguanani lenye apik atua enkaina e Israel; near Yoshua ninye te nepi o lalem, o pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye; eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani obo ti atua ninye eishu; neitaas olaiguanani lenye anaa apa enaitaasa olaiguanani le Yeriko.

English: And Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, unto Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it:
Masaai: Nelo Yoshua agiroo Libna, o Israel pooki te nebo ninye, nelo Lakish, nemuat aaman ninye, neibung ninye:

English: And the LORD delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, which took it on the second day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
Masaai: neishooyo Olaitoriani Lakish apik atua enkaina e Israel, neya ninye te nkolong e are, near ninye te nepi o lalem, o pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye, anaa apa enaitaasa ninye Libna.

English: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua smote him and his people, until he had left him none remaining.
Masaai: Neitoki Horam olaiguanani le Geser alotu aretu Lakish; near Yoshua ninye o ltung'ana lenyena, o metaba anaa neing'uaa ninye meishu hoo oltung'ani obo.

English: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it, and fought against it:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua te nebo Israel pooki aagiroo Lakish nepuo Eglon; neng'adu ninche ninye, neibung ninye;

English: And they took it on that day, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
Masaai: neya ninche ninye ina olong, near ninye te nepi o lalem; ore pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye neidaikie tukul ina olong, anaa apa enaitaasa Lakish.

English: And Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, unto Hebron; and they fought against it:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua te nebo Israel pooki aagiroo Eglon nepuo Hebron; neibung ninche ninye,

English: And they took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof, and all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon; but destroyed it utterly, and all the souls that were therein.
Masaai: neya ninye, near ninye te nepi o lalem, olaiguanani lenye o nkang'itie enyena, o pooki tung'ani otii atua; eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani hoo obo oishu anaa apa enaitaasa Eglon, neidaikie ninye tukul te nebo pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye.

English: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and fought against it:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua, te nebo Israel pooki, aashukunye aapuonu Debir neibung ninye,

English: And he took it, and the king thereof, and all the cities thereof; and they smote them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein; he left none remaining: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir, and to the king thereof; as he had done also to Libnah, and to her king.
Masaai: neya ninye te nebo olaiguanani lenye o nkang'itie enyena pooki; near ninche te nepi o lalem, neidaikie tukul pooki tung'ani otii atua ninye, eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani obo eishu; ore anaa apa enataasa te Hebron o te Libna o laiguanani lenye neijia sii eikuna Debir o laiguanani lenye.

English: So Joshua smote all the country of the hills, and of the south, and of the vale, and of the springs, and all their kings: he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the LORD God of Israel commanded.
Masaai: Neaku eisula apa Yoshua enkop pooki, ina kop oo ldoinyo e Negeb, o ina kop nagum o neeshong'ishong, o laiguanak lenye pooki; eitu ninye eleku hoo oltung'ani oishu, kake eidaikie tukul pooki ng'ae oishu, anaa apa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
Masaai: Nemir apa Yoshua ninche ebaiki Kadesh-Barnea o metabaiki Gasa, o enkop pooki e Goshen ebaiki Gibeon.

English: And all these kings and their land did Joshua take at one time, because the LORD God of Israel fought for Israel.
Masaai: Neya apa Yoshua kulo aiguanak pooki o nkuapi enye te nkata nabo, amu etijing'a Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel olarrabal te nkaraki Israel.

English: And Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, unto the camp to Gilgal.
Masaai: neshukunye taa Yoshua, o Israel pooki te nebo ninye, aapuonu ilng'oborri te Gilgal.

English: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Yabin olaiguanani le Hasor ena, neirriwaki olkilikuai Yobab olaiguanani le Madon, o laiguanani le Shimron, o laiguanani le Akshaf;

English: And to the kings that were on the north of the mountains, and of the plains south of Chinneroth, and in the valley, and in the borders of Dor on the west,
Masaai: o laiguanak apa ootii moikuape ina kop oo ldoinyo o atua Araba kopikop e Kineret, o atua ina kop nagum, o atua Nafat-dor te nkalo o loontoluo,

English: And to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and to the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the mountains, and to the Hivite under Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
Masaai: Ilkanaani te nkalo o loo saen o to loontoluo, o Lamori, o Lhiti, o Lperisi, o Lyebusi, ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo, o Lhifi ti abori Hermon ti atua enkop e Mispa.

English: And they went out, they and all their hosts with them, much people, even as the sand that is upon the sea shore in multitude, with horses and chariots very many.
Masaai: Neipang'u ninche aapuonu, te nebo iltimito lenye pooki, olorora kitok, eba esiana enye anaa osinyai le mbata e naiposha, neeta mbartan kumok oleng o ngarrin oo mbartan.

English: And when all these kings were met together, they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa kulo aiguanak pooki neitutum njorin enye, nepuonu aaitayu ilng'oborri te nebo too nkariak e Merom, pee earare Israel.

English: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Be not afraid because of them: for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel: thou shalt hough their horses, and burn their chariots with fire.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yoshua, “Miureyu iyie ninche, amu ore taisere tena saa naa kaishoru nanu ninche pooki, etuata tesesekuana, aisho Israel, nidung'udung'u irrisheta mbartan enye, nipejoo ngarrin enye oo mbartan te nkima.”

English: So Joshua came, and all the people of war with him, against them by the waters of Merom suddenly; and they fell upon them.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo apa Yoshua aipang'aki ninche nabo kata te nebo iltung'ana lenyena pooki lo larrabal, te mbata oo nkariak e Merom, nedoiki ninche.

English: And the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel, who smote them, and chased them unto great Zidon, and unto Misrephothmaim, and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward; and they smote them, until they left them none remaining.
Masaai: Neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua enkaina e Israel, apa ootara ninche nemiraa ninche eneba anaa Sidon kitok o Mirsefot-maim, o enkalo o loo saen eneba anaa o erata le Mispe; nesesekuan ninche, o metaba anaa neing'ua ninche eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani oishu.

English: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
Masaai: Neitaas Yoshua ninche anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye; etudung'o rrisheta mbartan enye, nepejoo ngarrin enye oo mbartan te nkima.

English: And Joshua at that time turned back, and took Hazor, and smote the king thereof with the sword: for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms.
Masaai: Neibelekenya apa Yoshua te ina kata, neya Hasor, nesesekuan olaiguanani lenye to lalem; amu ore Hasor li apa naa ninye endukuya e nena kitoriat pooki.

English: And they smote all the souls that were therein with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them: there was not any left to breathe: and he burnt Hazor with fire.
Masaai: Nepik ninche olalem lelo pooki apa ootii atua ninye, aaidaikie ninche tukul; eitu ninye eing'uari obo leton eiresa, nepejoo ninye Hasor te nkima.

English: And all the cities of those kings, and all the kings of them, did Joshua take, and smote them with the edge of the sword, and he utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD commanded.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas pooki e lelo aiguanak, o laiguanak lenye pooki, neya Yoshua ninche near ninche te nepi o lalem, aidaikie ninche tukul, anaa apa enaitanapishe Musa osinka lo Laitoriani.

English: But as for the cities that stood still in their strength, Israel burned none of them, save Hazor only; that did Joshua burn.
Masaai: Kake meetae apa enkanasa hoo nabo te nena apa naaitashe too ldoinyo natapejoitie Israel, meteleku ake Hasor, naa ninye etapejoyie Yoshua.

English: And all the spoil of these cities, and the cattle, the children of Israel took for a prey unto themselves; but every man they smote with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them, neither left they any to breathe.
Masaai: Ore imasaa pooki e kuna anas o nkishu neya iltung'ana le Israel aaitaa intokitin naataraitie, kake ore pooki tung'ani nesesekuan ninche te nepi o lalem, o metaba anaa neidaikie ninche tukul, neitu ninye eleku obo eiresa.

English: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa osinka lenye, neitanapa sii apa Musa Yoshua, netaasa apa Yoshua ina; eitu ninye eing'uaa ae toki measa te nena apa pooki naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: So Joshua took all that land, the hills, and all the south country, and all the land of Goshen, and the valley, and the plain, and the mountain of Israel, and the valley of the same;
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa Yoshua ina kop pooki, ina kop oo ldoinyo o Negeb pooki, o enkop e Goshen pooki o ina kop pooki nagum o Araba o ina kop oo ldoinyo e Israel o enkop nagum,

English: Even from the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir, even unto Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon under mount Hermon: and all their kings he took, and smote them, and slew them.
Masaai: ebaiki oldoinyo le Halak, ilo oshumunye aing'or Seir, o metabaiki Baalgad to erata le Lebanon ti abori oldoinyo le Hermon. Neya ninye ilaiguanak lenye pooki, nesesekuan ninche, near ninye ninche metuata.

English: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
Masaai: Neitayuo apa Yoshua olarrabal te nkata naado o lelo aiguanak pooki.

English: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon: all other they took in battle.
Masaai: Meetae apa ninye enkanasa nabo naitayio osotua o Israel, meteleku ake Ilhafi, lelo oomanya Gibeon; nerik apa ninche pooki olarrabal.

English: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that he might destroy them utterly, and that they might have no favour, but that he might destroy them, as the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Amu enkitobirata apa o Laitoriani pee eitagol iltauja lenye pee etum aaetu aataarare Israel to larrabal, pee etumi aaidaikie ninche katukul, nemeng'amu ninche olng'ur kake pee eishuni anaa apaenaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And at that time came Joshua, and cut off the Anakims from the mountains, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel: Joshua destroyed them utterly with their cities.
Masaai: Nelotu apa Yoshua te ina kata, nejutu katukul aiwuang'ie Anakim te ina kop oo ldoinyo, neiwuang'ie to Hebron, neiwuang'ie te Debir, neiwuang'ie te Anab, neiwuang'ie sii te ina kop oo ldoinyo e Yuda, neiwuang'ie sii te ina kop oo ldoinyo e Israel; neidaikie Yoshua ninche tukul te nebo nkanas enye.

English: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, there remained.
Masaai: Meetae apa hoo obo le Anakim otelekua ti atua enkop oo ltung'ana le Israel; te Gasa ake, ti atua Gati, o ti atua Ashdod, etelekutua embata.

English: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD said unto Moses; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. And the land rested from war.
Masaai: Neaku ewa apa Yoshua enkop pooki te risioroto e nena pooki apa naatiaka Olaitoriani Musa, neishooyo Yoshua metaa enjung'ore te Israel te risioroto eorikinoto oo loshon lenye. Neitirring'a enkop to larrabal.

English: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
Masaai: Kulo apa ilaiguanak le ina kop, ootimira iltung'ana le Israel, neya ina kop enye te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong ebaiki oerata le Arnon o metabaiki oldoinyo le Hermon, o Araba pooki te nkalo o loosaen:

English: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
Masaai: Sihon olaiguanani loo Lamori apa omanya Heshbon, naa ninye apa oitore ebaiki Aroer natii olomanaa lo erata le Arnon, o metabaiki empolos o erata o metabaiki olkeju le Yabok, ilo polosie loo Lamori, aa taa, olpisiai le Gilead,

English: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah:
Masaai: O Araba o metabaiki enaiposha e Kineret te nkalo o loo saen, o te nkalo e Bet-yeshimot, o metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, ina aiposha naisukut, enkalo e kopikop o metabaiki abori lelo jurumi le Pisga;

English: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
Masaai: o Oog olaiguanani le Bashan, obo apa lo lpisiai le Refaim, apa omanya Ashtarot o Edrei,

English: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
Masaai: naa ninye apa oitore oldoinyo le Hermon o Saleka o Bashan pooki o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lkishi o Lmaakati, o lpisiai le Gilead o metabaiki olpolosie le Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon.

English: Them did Moses the servant of the LORD and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the LORD gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
Masaai: Etimira apa ninche Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te nebo iltung'ana le Israel; neishooyo Musa ilo sinka lo Laitoriani enkop enye metaa enkop oo le Ruben, ole Gad olpisiai lo losho le Manase.

English: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baalgad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
Masaai: Naa kulo apa ilaiguanak le ina kop ootimira Yoshua o ltung'ana le Israel te nkalo o loontoluo le Yordan, ebaiki Baal-gad ti atua oerata le Lebanon o metabaiki ilo doinyo le Halak, oshumunye aing'or Seir (neisho Yoshua ina kop enye iloshon le Israel meitaa enenye te risioroto enkiririkinoto enye,

English: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
Masaai: ti atua ina kop nagum, ti atua Araba, o tiatua nkishong'ishong'at, ti atua ong'ata ooti atua negeb, ina kop oo Lhiti, o Lamori, o Lkanaani, o Lperisi, o Lhafi o Lyebusi):

English: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Yeriko; obo, olaiguanani le Ai aa ninye natashare Betel, obo:

English: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Yerusalem, obo; olaiguanani le Hebron, obo;

English: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Yarmut, obo; olaiguanani le Lakish, obo;

English: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Eglon, obo; olaiguanani le Geser, obo;

English: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Debir, obo; olaiguanani le Geder, obo;

English: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Horma, obo; olaiguanani le Aradi, obo;

English: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Libna, obo; olaiguanani le Adulam, obo;

English: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Makeda, obo; olaiguanani le Betel, obo;

English: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Tapua, obo; olaiguanani le Hafer; obo;

English: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Afek, obo; olaiguanani le Lasharon, obo;

English: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Maden, obo; olaiguanani le Hasor, obo;

English: The king of Shimronmeron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Shimron-meron, obo; olaiguanani le Akshaf, obo;

English: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Taanak, obo; olaiguanani le Megido, obo;

English: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Kedesh, obo; olaiguanani le Yokneam ti atua Karmel, obo;

English: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
Masaai: olaiguanani le Dori te Nafat-dor, obo; olaiguanani le Goiim ti atua Galilaya, obo;

English: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
Masaai: olaiguanani le Tirsar, obo: ore pooki neaku tomoni uni o obo.

English: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the LORD said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
Masaai: Netamorua apa Yoshua neaku oloo larin kumok; nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Itamorua iyie nitaa oloo larin kumok, neton ake etii enkop sapuk oleng naji pee eyae.

English: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
Masaai: Ena kop ina neton eng'or: nkuapi pooki oo Lfilisti, o nekua pooki oo Lgerushi

English: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
Masaai: (ebaiki Shihor te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e Misiri, moikuape te nkalo o lpolosie le Ekron, eyioloi ninye aajo enoo Lkanaani; netii ilaitoriak imiet loo Lfilisti, lekua le Gasa, o Ashdod, o Ashkelon, Gati o Ekron), o lekua le Afiim,

English: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
Masaai: ore te nkalo e kopikop, naa enkop pooki oo Lkanaani, o Meara nara ninye enoo Lsidoni o metabaiki Afek, o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lamori,

English: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baalgad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
Masaai: o enkop oo Lgibali o Lebanon pooki, te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong, ebaiki Baalgad ti abori oldoinyo le Hermon o metabaiki enejing'ieki Hamat,

English: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephothmaim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
Masaai: ore lelo pooki oomanya ina kop oo ldoinyo ebaiki Lebanon o metabaiki Misrefot-maim, o metabaiki doi ninye Isidoni pooki. Kamiraa nanu makewan aipang'ie te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel; kake tooriki ake duoo iyie ina kop iltung'ana le Israel metaa enjung'ore enye, anaa apa enaaitanapa nanu iyie.

English: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
Masaai: Ore naa taata tooro ena kop metaa enjung'ore too loshon oopishana o lpisiai lo losho le Manase.”

English: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them;
Masaai: Ore olikae pisiai lo losho le Manase o le Ruben o le Gad neng'amu enjung'ore enye, apa naishoo ninche Musa, te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo o loosaen, anaa enaishoo ninche Musa osinka lo Laitoriani:

English: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
Masaai: ebaiki Aroer aa ninye apa natii olomanaa lo erata le Arnon, o ina anasa natii empolos o erata o ina kop naluaa e Medeba o metabaiki Dibon;

English: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
Masaai: o nkanas pooki e Sihon olaiguanani loo Lamori, apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Heshbon, o metabaiki olpolosie loo Lamoni;

English: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
Masaai: o Gilead o nkuapi oo Lgeshuri o Lmaakati, o ldoinyo le Hermon pooki, o Bashan pooki o metabaiki Saleka;

English: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
Masaai: enkitoria pooki e Oog te Bashan, laa ninye apa oitoreisho ti atua Ashtarot etii atua Edrei (ninye apake etelekuaki to lpisiai le Refaim); kulo apa etimira Musa nearaa aipang'ie.

English: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu apa earaa iltung'ana le Israel Ilgeshuri aashu Ilmaakati; kake etobiko apa Ilgeshuri o Lmaakati te mpolos e Israel o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
Masaai: Olosho le Lawi ake eitu eisho Musa enjung'ore; nkishorot o lasar opejori te nkima eisho Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel ninche metaa enjung'ore enye anaa apa enatiaka ninye.

English: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
Masaai: Neishoo apa Musa enjung'ore olosho loo Leruben te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
Masaai: Neaku ore apa enkop enye naa ebaiki Aroer, aa ninye apa olomanaa lo erata le Arnon, o ina anasa natii empolos oerata, o ina kop pooki naluaa te mbata e Medeba;

English: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamothbaal, and Beth-Baalmeon,
Masaai: te nebo Heshbon, o nena anas pooki naatii atua ina kop naluaa; Dibon o Bamot-baal, o Bet-baa-meon,

English: And Jahaza, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
Masaai: o Yahas, o Kedemot o Mefaat,

English: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mount of the valley,
Masaai: o Kiriataim o Sibma, o Seret-shahar te nchumata o ldoinyo le ilo erata,

English: And Bethpeor, and Ashdothpisgah, and Bethjeshimoth,
Masaai: o Betpeor o ljurumi le Pisga, o Betjeshimot,

English: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
Masaai: aa taa nkanas pooki e ina kop naluaa, o enkitoria pooki e Sihon olaiguanani loo Lamori, apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Heshbon, laa ninye apa etimira Musa te nebo ilarikok le Midian, Efi o Rekem o Sur o Huri o Reba ilkituaak le Sihon, laa ninye apa omanya ina kop.

English: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
Masaai: Ore sii Balaam, olayioni le Beor, ilo asakutoni, near iltung'ana le Israel ninye metua to lalem te nebo lelo apa lenye ootasesekuanaki.

English: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
Masaai: Ore apa olpolosie loo ltung'ana le Ruben naa Yordan orish. Ena apa enjung'ore oo le Ruben, te risioroto oo lmareita lenye o nkanas o nkang'itie kutiti.

English: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Musa aisho enjung'ore olosho le Gad, te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
Masaai: Ore apa enkop enye naa Yaser o nkanas pooki e Gilead o lpisiai le nkop oo Lamori, o metabaiki Aroer, ina natii enkalo o loo saen le Raba,

English: And from Heshbon unto Ramathmizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
Masaai: o ebaiki Heshbon o metabaiki Ramat-mispe o Betonim, o ebaiki Mahanaim o metabaiki enkop e Debir,

English: And in the valley, Betharam, and Bethnimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
Masaai: o atua oerata le Bet-haram, o Bet-nimra, o Sukot, o Safon, o ina ae kitoria pooki e Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon, aitaa Yordan olpolosie, o metabaiki enkalo e abori enaiposha e Kineret te nkalo o loo saen te lido kekun le Yordan.

English: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore oo le Gad te risioroto oo lmareita lenye, o nkanas enye o nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
Masaai: Neitoki Musa aisho enjung'ore olpisiai lo losho le Manase; etoorikiaki apa olpisiai lo losho le Manase te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
Masaai: Nelo apa enkop enye abaiki Mahanaim, neim Bashan pooki, o atua enkitoria pooki e Oog, olaiguanani le Bashan o nkang'itie pooki e Yair, nena naatii atua Bashan, nkanas ntomoni ile,

English: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
Masaai: o lpisiai le Gilead, o Ashtarot, o Edrei, nena anas e nkitoria e Oog ti atua Bashan, etoorikiaki apa kuna iltung'ana le Makir olayioni le Manase aaisho olpisiai loo le Makir te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
Masaai: Kuna apa njung'oreitin naaishooyie Musa too nkisiajat e Moab, te lido kekun le Yordan te nkalo o loo saen le Yeriko.

English: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the LORD God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
Masaai: Kake ore ti alo olosho le Lawi eitu eisho Musa enjung'ore; Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel ninye enjung'ore enye, anaa apa enatiaka ninye ninche.

English: And these are the countries which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance to them.
Masaai: Naa kuna apa njung'oreitin naatang'amutua iltung'ana le Israel te nkop e Kanaan, apa naaishoo ninche Eliesa olapolosani o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o lukuny oo lmareita loo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel.

English: By lot was their inheritance, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes, and for the half tribe.
Masaai: Ore apa enjung'ore enye naa te nkukuo, anaa apa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa te lelo oshon ooudo o lpisiai loo loshon.

English: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them.
Masaai: Amu eishoo apa Musa enjung'ore iloshon oare o lpisiai obo loo loshon te lido kekun le Yordan; kake ore ti alo ile Lawi eitu ninye eishooyo enjung'ore ti atua ninche.

English: For the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land, save cities to dwell in, with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance.
Masaai: Amu ore apa iltung'ana le Yosef naa iloshon oare, Manase o Efraim; nemeetae apa erubata naishooki ile Lawi te ina kop, nkanas ake eishooki naatonie, te nebo iwuejitin neeirritishore te nkaraki nchoo enye o neetumie ndaiki enye.

English: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
Masaai: Etaasa apa iltung'ana le Israel anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa; neor ninche enkop.

English: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him, Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Yuda aapuonu enetii Yoshua te Gilgal; ore Kaleb olayioni le Yefune ilo loo Lkeni nejoki ninye, “Iyiolo iyie apa enatiaka Olaitoriani Musa oltung'ani le Nkai te Kadesh-Barnea ti alo nanu o iyie.

English: Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart.
Masaai: Ara apa nanu o loo larin artam ina kata apa pee aairriwaa nanu Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te Kadesh-Barnea mashomo aikitalan enkop; naitoki nanu arrinyoki ninye olomoni anaa apa enatiu ti atua oltau lai.

English: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
Masaai: Kake ore ilalashera laainei apa ooshomo te nebo nanu neitalepoo oltau loo ltung'ana, ore eyia naiting'ie nanu asuj Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And Moses sware on that day, saying, Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance, and thy children's for ever, because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God.
Masaai: Nenya Musa olmumai ina olong, ajo, ‘Esipa ore enkop natororua enkeju ino naa keaku enjung'ore te iyie o too nkera inono ntarasi enkaraki ninting'ie iyie asuj Olaitoriani Enkai ai.’

English: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
Masaai: Naa ore taata, ng'ura, aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani aishu, anaa enatejo ninye, ore kulo arin artam o imiet ebaiki ina kata apa nairorie Olaitoriani Musa ele rorei, ina kata eloito Israel to lpurkel, ore taata ara nanu ena olong o loo larin ntomoni isiet o imiet.

English: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me: as my strength was then, even so is my strength now, for war, both to go out, and to come in.
Masaai: Eton ake agol ena olong anaa apa enatiu ina olong apa pee aairriwaa Musa, etiu engolon ai taata anaa engolon ai ina kata apa, to larrabal o te lototo o elotunoto.

English: Now therefore give me this mountain, whereof the LORD spake in that day; for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims were there, and that the cities were great and fenced: if so be the LORD will be with me, then I shall be able to drive them out, as the LORD said.
Masaai: Neaku naa taata, nchooki nanu ena kop oo ldoinyo apa naa ninye eimaka Olaitoriani ina olong; amu itoning'o apa iyie ina olong eneikununo ile Anakim te ine, eeta nkang'itie naasheta kituaak; ebaiki netii Olaitoriani te nebo nanu, naa kamiraa nanu ninche aipang'ie anaa enatejo Olaitoriani.”

English: And Joshua blessed him, and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance.
Masaai: Nemayian Yoshua ninye, neisho ninye Hebron Kaleb olayioni le Yefune metaa enjung'ore enye.

English: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day, because that he wholly followed the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku etaa apa Hebron enjung'ore e Kaleb olayioni le Yefune loo Lkeni o metabaiki ena olong, enkaraki apa naiting'ie ninye asuj Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: And the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba; which Arba was a great man among the Anakims. And the land had rest from war.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna e Hebron naa keji Kiriat-arba, ore ele Arba naa ninye apa oltung'ani kitok oleng ti atua Anakim. Neitirring'a taa enkop to larrabal.

English: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast.
Masaai: Ore apa erubata oo ltung'ana lo losho le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye nelo abaiki enkalo e moikuape o metabaiki olpolosie le Edom, o metabaiki olpurkel le Sin te nelakua oleng te nkalo emoikuape.

English: And their south border was from the shore of the salt sea, from the bay that looketh southward:
Masaai: Ore olpolosie lenye le nkalo e moikuape nedumunye te nkiting'oto Enaiposha e Munyan ebaiki olkina le naiposha oing'or enkalo e moikuape:

English: And it went out to the south side to Maalehacrabbim, and passed along to Zin, and ascended up on the south side unto Kadeshbarnea, and passed along to Hezron, and went up to Adar, and fetched a compass to Karkaa:
Masaai: nelo aipir enkalo e moikuape enkilepakinoto e Akarabim, negiroo o meshomo Sin nelo o metabaiki moikuape e Kadesh-Barnea, aipirakinore Hesron, o metabaiki Adar, neboina o metabaiki Karka,

English: From thence it passed toward Azmon, and went out unto the river of Egypt; and the goings out of that coast were at the sea: this shall be your south coast.
Masaai: negiroo o metabaiki Asmon, neipang alo o metabaiki enong'oto e Misiri, nelotu enkiting'oto enye te naiposha. Ele oaku olpolosie linyi te nkalo e moikuape.

English: And the east border was the salt sea, even unto the end of Jordan. And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan:
Masaai: Ore olpolosie le nkalo o loo saen naa Enaiposha e Munyan naisukut, o metabaiki enkutuk o lkeju le Yordan. Ore olpolosie le nkalo e kopikop neiteru te mbata e naiposha te nkutuk o lkeju le Yordan;

English: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
Masaai: nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki Bet-hogla, nelo agiroo kopikop e Bet-araba; nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki osoit le Bohan olayioni le Ruben;

English: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that is before the going up to Adummim, which is on the south side of the river: and the border passed toward the waters of Enshemesh, and the goings out thereof were at Enrogel:
Masaai: nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki Debir ebaiki oerata le Akor o meshomo enkalo e kopikop neibelekenya aing'or Gilgal, aa ninye apa natalakinore enkilepakinoto e Adamin, aa ninye apa natii enkalo e moikuape e ilo erata; nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki nkariak e En-shemesh, nelo aiting te En-rogel;

English: And the border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom unto the south side of the Jebusite; the same is Jerusalem: and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lieth before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the valley of the giants northward:
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie adumunye o meshomo embata oerata lo layioni le Hinom te murte moikuape oo Lyebusi (aa taa Yerusalem) nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki enchumata e ilo doinyo o talakinore oerata le Hinom, te nkalo o loo ntoluo te nkalo e moikuape te ine neiting'ie o erata le Refaim;

English: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and went out to the cities of mount Ephron; and the border was drawn to Baalah, which is Kirjathjearim:
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie ayiatari te nchumata e ilo doinyo o metabaiki enkong'u oo nkariak e Neftoa nedumunye teine o metabaiki nkanas o ldoinyo le Efron; neitoki ilo polosie aloja nemanaa nelo Baala (aa taa, Kiriat-yearim);

English: And the border compassed from Baalah westward unto mount Seir, and passed along unto the side of mount Jearim, which is Chesalon, on the north side, and went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed on to Timnah:
Masaai: neman ilo polosie enkalo oloontoluo le Baala o metabaiki oldoinyo le Seir, negiroo o meshomo oljurum lo ldoinyo le Yearim te nkalo e kopikop Kesalon nedoyio o meshomo Betshemesh, nelo agiroo Timna.

English: And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward: and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.
Masaai: Nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki oljurum lo ldoinyo te nkalo e kopikop e Ekron, neitoki ilo polosie aloja nemanaa o meshomo Shikeron, negiroo alo o metabaiki Yabneel; nelo ilo polosie o meiting'oki enaiposha.

English: And the west border was to the great sea, and the coast thereof. This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families.
Masaai: Ore apa olpolosie le nkalo o loo ntoluo naa ina aiposha kitok o ilo omanaa lenye. Ele ninye olpolosie omanita iltung'ana le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the LORD to Joshua, even the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani naitanapa Yoshua, eishoo ninye Kaleb olayioni le Yefune erubata ti atua iltung'ana le Yuda, Kiriat-arba, aa taa Hebron (Arba apa menye le Anak).

English: And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
Masaai: nearaa apa Kaleb te ine lelo ayiok pokira okuni le Anak, Sheshai o Ahiman o Talmai, lelo le ishoi e Anak.

English: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher.
Masaai: Neilep ninye teine alo aarare lelo oomanya Debir; ore apa enkarna e Debir ti apa naa keji Kiriat-seper.

English: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
Masaai: Nejo apa Kaleb, “Ore Oltung'ani oar Kiriat-seper, neya ninye, naisho nanu ninye Aksa entito ai meyama.”

English: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
Masaai: Neya Otniel olayioni le Kenas, olalashe le Kaleb, neisho Kaleb ninye Aksa entito ninye meyama,

English: And it came to pass, as she came unto him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wouldest thou?
Masaai: nejoki meikilikuana papaai lenye meishoo enkop, nedou ninye to sikiria lenye, nejoki Kaleb ninye, “Kainyoo iyie iyieu?”

English: Who answered, Give me a blessing; for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And he gave her the upper springs, and the nether springs.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nchooki nanu enkishoroto; ore kitipika nanu atua enkop e Negeb, nyaaki sii nchooki nanu nkonyek oo nkariak.” Neisho Kaleb ninye nkonyek oo nkariak e shumata o niabori.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho loo ltung'ana le Yuda te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And the uttermost cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the coast of Edom southward were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur,
Masaai: Ore nkanas naara inolosho loo ltung'ana le Yuda te nkiting'oto e nkalo e moikuape ti alo olpolosie le Edom, naa Kabseel, o Eder, o Yagur,

English: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah,
Masaai: o Kina, o Dimona, o Adaba,

English: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan,
Masaai: o Kedesh, o Hasor, o Itnan,

English: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
Masaai: o Sifu, o Talemu, o Bealot,

English: And Hazor, Hadattah, and Kerioth, and Hezron, which is Hazor,
Masaai: o Hasor-hadata, o Keriothesron, (aa taa Hasor),

English: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
Masaai: o Amam, o Shema, o Molada,

English: And Hazargaddah, and Heshmon, and Bethpalet,
Masaai: o Hasar-gada, o Heshmon, o Bet-pelet,

English: And Hazarshual, and Beersheba, and Bizjothjah,
Masaai: o Hasar-shual, o Beer-sheba, o Bisiotia,

English: Baalah, and Iim, and Azem,
Masaai: o Baala, o Iyumu, o Esem,

English: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah,
Masaai: o Eltolad, o Chesil, o Horma,

English: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah,
Masaai: o Siklag, o Madmana, o Sansana,

English: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon: all the cities are twenty and nine, with their villages:
Masaai: o Lebaot, o Shilhim, o Ain, o Rimon; ore te umata naa nkanas tikitam o obo tenebo inkang'itie kutiti.

English: And in the valley, Eshtaol, and Zoreah, and Ashnah,
Masaai: Ore te ina kop nagum naa Eshtaol, o Sora, o Ashna,

English: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam,
Masaai: o Sanoa, o En-ganim, o Tapua, o Enam,

English: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah,
Masaai: o Yarmut, o Adulam, o Soko, o Aseka,

English: And Sharaim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Sharaim, o Aditaim, o Gedera, o Gederotaim: nkanas tomon o ong'uan te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdalgad,
Masaai: O Senan, o Hadasha, o Migdal-gad,

English: And Dilean, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel,
Masaai: o Dilean, o Mispe, o Yokteel,

English: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon,
Masaai: o Lakish, o Boskat, o Eglon,

English: And Cabbon, and Lahmam, and Kithlish,
Masaai: o Kabon, o Laham, o Kitilish,

English: And Gederoth, Bethdagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Gederat, o Bet-dagon, o Naama, o Makeda: nkanas tomon o ile te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan,
Masaai: O Libna, o Eter, o Ashan,

English: And Jiphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib,
Masaai: o Ifta, o Ashna, o Nesib,

English: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Keila, o Aksib o Maresha: nkanas naaudo o nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
Masaai: O Ekron, te nebo nkanas enyena o nkang'itie kutiti,

English: From Ekron even unto the sea, all that lay near Ashdod, with their villages:
Masaai: ebaiki Ekron o metabaiki enaiposha ina apa pooki natii embata e Ashdod, te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: Ashdod with her towns and her villages, Gaza with her towns and her villages, unto the river of Egypt, and the great sea, and the border thereof:
Masaai: Ashdod, inkang'itie enyena o nkang'itie enyena kutiti o metabaiki enong'oto e Misiri, o enaiposha kitok te nebo olomanaa lenye.

English: And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,
Masaai: Ore te ina kop oo ldoinyo, naa Shamir, Yatir, Soko,

English: And Dannah, and Kirjathsannah, which is Debir,
Masaai: o Dana, o Kiriat-sana (aa taa Debir),

English: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim,
Masaai: o Anab, o Eshtemo, o Anim,

English: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Goshen, o Holon, o Gilo: nkanas tomon o obo te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
Masaai: O Arabu, o Duma, o Eshan,

English: And Janum, and Bethtappuah, and Aphekah,
Masaai: o Yanim, o Bet-tapua, o Ajeka,

English: And Humtah, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, and Zior; nine cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Humta, o Kiriat-araba (aa taa, Hebron), o Sior: nkanas naaudo o nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Juttah,
Masaai: O Maen, o Karmel, o Sifi, o Yuta,

English: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah,
Masaai: o Yesreel, o Yokdeam, o Sanoa,

English: Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Kain, o Gibea, o Timna: nkanas tomon te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Halhul, Bethzur, and Gedor,
Masaai: O Halhul, o Bet-sur, o Gedori,

English: And Maarath, and Bethanoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages:
Masaai: o Maarat, o Bet-anot, o Eltekon: nkanas ile te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjathjearim, and Rabbah; two cities with their villages:
Masaai: O Kiriat-baal (aa taa Kiriat-yearim) o Raba: nkanas are te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
Masaai: Ore ti atua olpurkel, naa Bet-araba, o Midin, o Sekaka,

English: And Nibshan, and the city of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
Masaai: Nibshan, o Enkanasa e Munyan, o En-gedi: nkanas ile te nebo nkang'itie kutiti.

English: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
Masaai: Kake ore Ilyebusi, lelo oomanya Yerusalem, eitu eidimu iltung'ana le Yuda aatarai ninche; neaku etobiko apa Ilyebusi te nebo iltung'ana le Yuda te Yerusalem o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho, unto the water of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Bethel,
Masaai: Ore apa eorikinoto e ishoi e Yosef nelo ebaiki Yordan agiroo Yeriko, o loo saen loo nkariak e Yeriko, o metabaiki atua olpurkel, eilep te Yeriko, o metabaiki atua olpurkel, eilep te Yeriko o metijing'a atua ina kop oo ldoinyo o metabaiki Betel.

English: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
Masaai: Neitoki alo te Betel o metabaiki Lusi, negiroo alo o metabaiki Atarot, ina kop oo Larkit;

English: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti, unto the coast of Bethhoron the nether, and to Gezer: and the goings out thereof are at the sea.
Masaai: neitoki adoyio aing'or enkalo oloo ntoluo o metabaiki enkop oo Lyafelet o metabaiki ina kop e Bet-horon ti abori, neitoki alo Geser nelo aiting te naiposha.

English: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Yosef, o Manase o Efraim neng'amu enjung'ore enye.

English: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus: even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Atarothaddar, unto Bethhoron the upper;
Masaai: Ore apa enkop oo le Efraim too lmareita lenye netiu nji: ore olpolosie le njung'ore enye te nkalo o loo saen naa Atarotadar o metabaiki shumata Bet-horon,

English: And the border went out toward the sea to Michmethah on the north side; and the border went about eastward unto Taanathshiloh, and passed by it on the east to Janohah;
Masaai: nelo ilo polosie o metabaiki enaiposha, te nkalo e kopikop Mikmetal; ore te nkalo o loo saen neloja olpolosie aing'or enkalo e Taanat-shilo, nelo agiroo aimu te nkalo o loo saen o metabaiki Yanoa,

English: And it went down from Janohah to Ataroth, and to Naarath, and came to Jericho, and went out at Jordan.
Masaai: neitoki adoyio alo te Yanoa o metabaiki Atarot o Naara, nerepaa Yeriko, nelo aiting te Yordan.

English: The border went out from Tappuah westward unto the river Kanah; and the goings out thereof were at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim by their families.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki Tapua nelo olpolosie enkalo o loo ntoluo o metabaiki enong'oto e Kana, nelo aiting te naiposha. Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho loo le Efraim too lmareita lenye,

English: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
Masaai: te nebo nena ang'itie naaiteng'elakaki ile Efraim ti atua enjung'ore oo le Manase, nena ang'itie pooki o nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer: but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day, and serve under tribute.
Masaai: Neitu apa earaa ninche lelo Kanaani apa oomanya Geser: neaku etobiko apa Ilkanaani te mpolos e Efraim o metabaiki ena olong kake etaa rrindiki pee eas esiaai nagol.

English: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
Masaai: Neitokini aaisho erubata olosho le Manase, amu ninye apa olkikau le Yosef. O Makir olkikau le Manase, menye le Gilead, neorikini ninche Gilead o Bashan, amu oltung'ani apa lo larrabal.

English: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
Masaai: Neitokini aaoriki irubat lelo kulikae lo losho le Manase, too lmareita lenye, Abiesa, o Helek, o Asriel, o Shekem, o Hafer o Shenuda; kulo apa ilayiok ootoiuo Manase olayioni le Yosef, too lmareita lenye.

English: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore apa Selofehad olayioni le Hefer, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Makir, olayioni le Manase, nemeeta apa ilayiok, kake ntoyie apake eeta; naa kuna nkarn e nena toyie enyena: o Mahala, o Noa, o Hogla, o Milka, o Tinsa.

English: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche dukuya Eliesa olapolosani o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o larikok, nejo, “Eitanapa apa Olaitoriani Musa pee eisho iyiook enjung'ore te nebo ilalashera lang.” Neaku ore te risioroto e nkitanapata o Laitoriani eishoo ninye ninche enjung'ore te nebo ilalashera le papaai lenye.

English: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
Masaai: Ina apa pee enoto Manase irubat tomon, metii enkop e Gilead o Bashan, apa naatii lido likae kekun le Yordan;

English: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh's sons had the land of Gilead.
Masaai: enkaraki natang'amutua intoyie e Manase enjung'ore te nebo ilayiok lenyena. Ore enkop e Gilead neorikini lelo kulikae le ishoi e Manase.

English: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
Masaai: Ore enkop e Manase nelo abaiki Asheri o metabaiki Mikmetat apa naa enkalo o loo saen le Shekem; nelo olpolosie enkalo e moikuape o metabaiki lelo oomanya Entapua.

English: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
Masaai: Ore apa enkop e Tapua naa ene Manase, kake ore enkang e Tapua apa natii olpolosie le Manase naa enoo layiok le Efraim.

English: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
Masaai: Nelo ilo polosie adoyio o metabaiki enong'oto e Kana. Ore nkanas tene, te nkalo e moikuape e nong'oto ti atua nkanas e Manase, naa ine Efraim. Nelo apa olpolosie le Manase enkalo e kopikop e ina nong'oto nelo aiting te naiposha;

English: Southward it was Ephraim's, and northward it was Manasseh's, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
Masaai: ore enkop te nkalo e moikuape naa ene Efraim, ore te nkalo e kopikop naa ene Manase, nelo enaiposha aitayu olpolosie; ore te nkalo e kopikop nebaiki Isaakar.

English: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
Masaai: Ore ake sii ti atua Isaakar o ti atua Asheri neeta apa Manase Betshean o nkang'itie enyena, o Ibleam o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Dori o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Endor o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Taanak o nkang'itie enyena, o lelo oomanya Megido o nkang'itie enyena, ore ene uni naa Nafat.

English: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu apa eidimu ilayiok le Manase aaibung'a nena anas; kake eting'iriakinote Ilkanaani aabik te ina kop.
