English: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute; but did not utterly drive them out.
Masaai: Kake ore apa pee eponari iltung'ana le Israel aagolu, nepik ninche Ilkanaani enkisiaayiare nagol, neitu earaa ninche tukul aaipang'ie.

English: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
Masaai: Neirorie olosho le Yosef Yoshua, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee kinchoo nanu erubata nabo o eoroti nabo metaa enjung'ore, hoo nara olosho loo ltung'ana kumok, naatamayiana nanu Olaitoriani aiko nji?”

English: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua ninche, “Te nirara intae olosho loo ltung'ana kumok, elepa enchom entim, ore te ine, nisiajakinyenye ate enkop te ina kop oo Lperisi o ene Rafaim, amu ore ena kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim naa eironkai te intae.”

English: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
Masaai: Nejo olosho le Yosef, “Meidip iyiook ena kop oo ldoinyo; ore ake sii kulo Kanaani pooki oomanya enkop naisiaja naa keeta ngarrin oo mbartan oo sekenke, lekua ootii Betshean o nkang'itie enyena o lekua ootii oerata le Yesreel.”

English: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajoki enkaji e Yosef o Efraim o Manase, “Irara intae olosho loo ltung'ana kumok, niatata enkidimata kitok; mintokiki intae aata erubata nabo ake,

English: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
Masaai: kake keaku eninyi ena kop oo ldoinyo, ore hoo naa entim, isiajayieyie intae niyaya ninye aaitabaiki ilpolosien lenyena oolakua; amu iyookiki intae aaraa aaipang'ie lelo Kanaani, hoo neeta ninche ngarrin oo mbartan oo sekenke, hoo naa kegol.”

English: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there. And the land was subdued before them.
Masaai: Neitoki olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel auma te Shilo nepik olng'obor le ntumo ine; neirrag apa ina kop naibung'aki te dukuya ninche.

English: And there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes, which had not yet received their inheritance.
Masaai: Netelekutua apa ti atua iltung'ana le Israel iloshon oopishana leton eitu eorikini enjung'ore enye.

English: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel, How long are ye slack to go to possess the land, which the LORD God of your fathers hath given you?
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua iltung'ana le Israel, “Eintashaluoluo akenya o anu mijing'ijing'i atua aapuo aaibung ena kop, apa naishoo intae Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi?

English: Give out from among you three men for each tribe: and I will send them, and they shall rise, and go through the land, and describe it according to the inheritance of them; and they shall come again to me.
Masaai: Enchoru iltung'ana okuni ake to losho, pee airriwaa nanu ninche meshomo aailep nedou te ina kop, nasirakino ninche anaa injung'oreitin enye, neitoki ninche aapuonu enatii nanu.

English: And they shall divide it into seven parts: Judah shall abide in their coast on the south, and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aaor aaitaa irubat naapishana, nebik Yuda te nkop enye te nkalo e moikuape, nebik enkaji e Yosef te nkop enye te nkalo e kopikop.

English: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.
Masaai: Naa entisir intae ina kop too orot naapishana niyauu lelo sirat ene natii nanu; amu kaosh nanu enkukuo te nkaraki intae tene te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: But the Levites have no part among you; for the priesthood of the LORD is their inheritance: and Gad, and Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave them.
Masaai: Meeta lelo le Lawi erubata ti atua intae, amu empolosare o Laitoriani ninye enjung'ore enye; ore Gad o Ruben o lpisiai lo losho le Manase netang'amutua enjung'ore enye te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo o loo saen, apa naishoo ninche Musa osinka lo Laitoriani.”

English: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
Masaai: Nedumunye apa lelo tung'ana aaiteru elototo enye; neitanap Yoshua lelo apa ooshomo aasir eoroto e nkop, ajoki, “Enchom elepa nidouu nisirisiri eoroto e nkop, nintokiki aashukunye aapuonu enatii; amu kaosh nanu enkukuo te nkaraki intae tene te dukuya Olaitoriani te Shilo.”

English: And the men went and passed through the land, and described it by cities into seven parts in a book, and came again to Joshua to the host at Shiloh.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa lelo tung'ana neilep nedou ti atua ina kop nepik atua embuku eoroto enye anaa too nkang'itie ti atua iorot naapishana; neitoki ninche aapuonu enetii Yoshua too lng'oborri te Shilo,

English: And Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD: and there Joshua divided the land unto the children of Israel according to their divisions.
Masaai: neosh Yoshua enkukuo te nkaraki ninche te Shilo te dukuya Olaitoriani; neoriki Yoshua enkop te ine iltung'ana le Israel, olosho ake erubata enye.

English: And the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families: and the coast of their lot came forth between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu erubata o losho le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye, ore ina kop naishooki ninye nejing erishata o losho le Yuda o losho le Yosef.

English: And their border on the north side was from Jordan; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side, and went up through the mountains westward; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Bethaven.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo e moikuape neiteru olpolosie lenye te Yordan, neilep ilo polosie alo enkilepakinoto e Yeriko te nkalo e moikuape, neitoki ailep aim ina kop oo ldoinyo te nkalo o loo ntoluo; nelo aiting to lpurkel le Bet-hafen.

English: And the border went over from thence toward Luz, to the side of Luz, which is Bethel, southward; and the border descended to Atarothadar, near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Bethhoron.
Masaai: Nedumunye olpolosie te ine aim enkalo e kopikop aipir Lusi, o metabaiki enkilepakinoto e Lusi (aa ninye Betel), neitoki ilo polosie adoyio alo Atarot-adar, te nchumata e ilo doinyo otii enkalo e kopikop tiabori Bet-horon.

English: And the border was drawn thence, and compassed the corner of the sea southward, from the hill that lieth before Beth-horon southward; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjathbaal, which is Kirjath-jearim, a city of the children of Judah: this was the west quarter.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo polosie alo aim enkae shoto, aibelekenya te nkalo o loo ntoluo aing'or moikuape te ilo doinyo otii enkalo e moikuape, eipirakinore Bet-horon, nelo aiting te Kiriat-baal (Kiriat-Yearim taa ena), enkanasa nara eno losho le Yuda. Ena naitayu enkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: And the south quarter was from the end of Kirjathjearim, and the border went out on the west, and went out to the well of waters of Nephtoah:
Masaai: Ore te enkalo e kopikop neiteru too mbat e Kiriat-yearim; nelo olpolosie te ine o metabaiki Efron, o meshomo nkonyek oo nkariak e Neftoa;

English: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom, and which is in the valley of the giants on the north, and descended to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of Jebusi on the south, and descended to Enrogel,
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie adoyio o meshomo olpolosie lo ldoinyo otalita oerata lo layioni le Hinom, otii enkalo e moikuape eneiting'ie oerata le Refaim; neitoki adoiki oerata le Hinom, enkalo e kopikop enkilepakinoto oo Lyebusi, nedoyio alo En-rogel;

English: And was drawn from the north, and went forth to Enshemesh, and went forth toward Geliloth, which is over against the going up of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
Masaai: neitoki alo Gelilot, ina naipirakinore enkilepakinoto e Adumim; neitoki adoyio o meshomo osoit le Bohan olayioni le Ruben;

English: And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:
Masaai: negiroo alo o meshomo osegel le Bet-araba nedoyio o meshomo Araba;

English: And the border passed along to the side of Bethhoglah northward: and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan: this was the south coast.
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie agiroo alo o meshomo moikuape o segel le Bet-hogla; nelo ilo polosie aiting te moikuape olomanaa le Enaiposha e Munyan, te kopikop e Yordan; ele ninye olpolosie le kopikop.

English: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the coasts thereof round about, according to their families.
Masaai: Neitayu Yordan olpolosie lenye te nkalo o loo saen. Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Benchamen, te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena, olpolosie ake olpolosie emanaa.

English: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, and Bethhoglah, and the valley of Keziz,
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas o losho le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenye naa Yeriko, o Bet-hogla, o Emekesis,

English: And Betharabah, and Zemaraim, and Bethel,
Masaai: Bet-araba, o Semaraim, o Betel,

English: And Avim, and Parah, and Ophrah,
Masaai: Afiim, o Para, o Ofra,

English: And Chepharhaammonai, and Ophni, and Gaba; twelve cities with their villages:
Masaai: Kefarmoni, o Ofni, o Geba - nkanas tomon o are te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti:

English: Gibeon, and Ramah, and Beeroth,
Masaai: Gibeon, o Rama, o Beerot,

English: And Mizpeh, and Chephirah, and Mozah,
Masaai: o Mispe, o Kefira, o Mosa,

English: And Rekem, and Irpeel, and Taralah,
Masaai: Rekem, o Irpeel, o Tarala,

English: And Zelah, Eleph, and Jebusi, which is Jerusalem, Gibeath, and Kirjath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
Masaai: o Sela, o Ha-elef, o Yebus (aa taa Yerusalem), o Gibea o Kiriat-yearim - nkanas tomon o ong'uan te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti. Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Benchamen te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena.

English: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
Masaai: Neitoki e rubata eare alotu o losho le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena; netii apa enjung'ore enye empolos e njung'ore o losho le Yuda.

English: And they had in their inheritance Beersheba, or Sheba, and Moladah,
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye aitaa enjung'ore enye Beer-sheba, o Sheba, o Molada,

English: And Hazarshual, and Balah, and Azem,
Masaai: o Hasar-shual, o Bala, o Esem,

English: And Eltolad, and Bethul, and Hormah,
Masaai: o Eltolad, o Betul, o Horma,

English: And Ziklag, and Bethmarcaboth, and Hazarsusah,
Masaai: o Siklag, o Bet-markabot, o Hasar-susa,

English: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
Masaai: o Betlebaot, o Sharuhen - nkanas tomon o okuni te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti;

English: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
Masaai: o En-rimon, o Eter, o Ashan - nkanas ong'uan te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti;

English: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalathbeer, Ramath of the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
Masaai: te nebo nena ang'itie pooki kutiti naamanita kuna anas o metabaiki Baalat-beer, o Rama e Negeb. Ena apa enjung'ore o losho le Simeon te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena.

English: Out of the portion of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon: for the part of the children of Judah was too much for them: therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of them.
Masaai: Ore apa enjung'ore o losho le Simeon neitayu ematua e nkop e Yuda; amu ore apa erubata o losho le Yuda; naa eidapash oleng te ninche, netum olosho le Simeon enjung'ore te mpolos e njung'ore enye.

English: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families: and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid:
Masaai: Nelotu erubata e uni te nkaraki olosho le Sebulon, te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena. Ore ina kop e njung'ore enye nelo abaya Sarid;

English: And their border went up toward the sea, and Maralah, and reached to Dabbasheth, and reached to the river that is before Jokneam;
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie alo enkalo o loo ntoluo, nelo abaya Mareal, nelo aikob Dabeshet, neitoki abaya enong'oto natii enkalo o loo saen le Yoknear;

English: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chislothtabor, and then goeth out to Daberath, and goeth up to Japhia,
Masaai: nedumunye te Sarid aipir enkae shoto enkalo o loo saen aing'or eneilepunye enkolong o metabaiki olpolosie le Kislot-tabor; nelo te ine o metabaiki Daberat, neitoki ailep alo Yafia;

English: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gittahhepher, to Ittahkazin, and goeth out to Remmonmethoar to Neah;
Masaai: nedumunye neim enkalo o loo saen aing'or eneilepunye enkolong o metabaiki Gad-hefer, o metabaiki Et-kasin, nelo o metabaiki Rimon neloja aing'or Nea;

English: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
Masaai: neitoki alo te nkalo e moikuape aboina olpolosie aing'or Hanaton, nelo aiting to erata le Iftahel;

English: And Kattath, and Nahallal, and Shimron, and Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
Masaai: o Katat, o Nahalal, o Shimron, o Idala, o Betlehem - nkanas tomon o are te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Sebulon, te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena - kuna anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: And the fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
Masaai: Nelotu erubata e ong'uan te nkaraki Isaakar, te nkaraki olosho le Isaakar te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena.

English: And their border was toward Jezreel, and Chesulloth, and Shunem,
Masaai: Ore olpolosie lenye neitushulu Yesreel, o Kesulot, o Shunem,

English: And Hapharaim, and Shion, and Anaharath,
Masaai: o Hafaraim, o Shion, o Anaharat,

English: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
Masaai: o Rabit, o Kishion, o Ebes,

English: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;
Masaai: o Remet, o Enganim, o Enhadad, o Bet-pases;

English: And the coast reacheth to Tabor, and Shahazimah, and Bethshemesh; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
Masaai: nelo sii ilo polosie aikop Tabor, o Shahasuma, o Bet-shemesh, nelo ilo polosie lenye aiting te Yordan - nkanas tomon o ile te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Isaakar te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena - nena anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: And the fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu erubata e imiet te nkaraki olosho le Asheri te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And their border was Helkath, and Hali, and Beten, and Achshaph,
Masaai: Ore enkop enye neitushulu Helkat, o Hali, o Beton, o Aksaf,

English: And Alammelech, and Amad, and Misheal; and reacheth to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath;
Masaai: o Alamelek, o Amad, o Mishal; ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo nelo aikop Karmel o Shihor-libnat,

English: And turneth toward the sunrising to Bethdagon, and reacheth to Zebulun, and to the valley of Jiphthahel toward the north side of Bethemek, and Neiel, and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand,
Masaai: neitoki aibelekenya aing'or enkalo o loo saen, nelo Bet-dagon, o meikobo Sebulon oerata le Iftahel te nkalo e moikuape o meshomo Bet-emek o Niel, neitoki alo te nkalo e moikuape o meshomo Kabul,

English: And Hebron, and Rehob, and Hammon, and Kanah, even unto great Zidon;
Masaai: o Ebron, o Rehobu, o Hamon, o Kana o metabaiki Sidon Kitok;

English: And then the coast turneth to Ramah, and to the strong city Tyre; and the coast turneth to Hosah; and the outgoings thereof are at the sea from the coast to Achzib:
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie aibelekenya aingor enkalo e Rama, ometabaiki enkanasa nasheta sunta e Turo; neitoki ilo polosie alo ometabaiki Hosa, nelo aiting te naiposha; Mahalab, o Aksib.

English: Ummah also, and Aphek, and Rehob: twenty and two cities with their villages.
Masaai: O Uma, o Afek, o Rehob - nkanas tikitam o are te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Asheri te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena - kuna anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu erubata e ile te nkaraki olosho le Naftali, te nkaraki olosho le Naftali, te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And their coast was from Heleph, from Allon to Zaanannim, and Adami, Nekeb, and Jabneel, unto Lakum; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan:
Masaai: Nedumunye olpolosie lenye te Helef o te Saananim o Adaminekok, o Yabneel, o meshomo Lakum; nelo aiting te Yordan;

English: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznothtabor, and goeth out from thence to Hukkok, and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side, and reacheth to Asher on the west side, and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising.
Masaai: neitoki ilo polosie aboina aing'or enkalo o loo ntoluo o meshomo Asnot-tabor, nelo te ine o metabaiki Hukok, nelo aikob Sebulon te nkalo e kopikop, neikob, Asheri te nkalo o loo ntoluo; neikob Yuda te nkalo o loo saen le Yordan.

English: And the fenced cities are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas naasheta sunta naa Sidim, o Seer, o Hamat, o Rakat, o Kineret,

English: And Adamah, and Ramah, and Hazor,
Masaai: o Adama, o Rama, o Hasor,

English: And Kedesh, and Edrei, and Enhazor,
Masaai: o Kedesh, o Edrei, o En-hasor,

English: And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.
Masaai: o Yironi, o Migdalel, o Horem, o Betanat o Bet-shemesh - nkanas tomon o oudo te nebo nkang'itie enye kutiti.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families, the cities and their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Naftali te risioroto oo lmareita lenye - kuna anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutit.

English: And the seventh lot came out for the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu erubata e naapishana te nkaraki olosho le Dan, te risioroto oo lmareita lenye.

English: And the coast of their inheritance was Zorah, and Eshtaol, and Irshemesh,
Masaai: Ore enkop e njung'ore enye neitushulu o Sora, o Eshtaol, o Ir-shemesh,

English: And Shaalabbin, and Ajalon, and Jethlah,
Masaai: o Sha-alabin, o Aijalon, o Itla,

English: And Elon, and Thimnathah, and Ekron,
Masaai: o Elon, o Timna, o Ekron,

English: And Eltekeh, and Gibbethon, and Baalath,
Masaai: o Elteke, o Gibeton, o Baalat,

English: And Jehud, and Beneberak, and Gathrimmon,
Masaai: o Yehud, o Bene-berak, o Bat-rimon,

English: And Mejarkon, and Rakkon, with the border before Japho.
Masaai: o Me-yarkon o Rakon o ina kop apa naipirakinore Yopa.

English: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them: therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem, and took it, and smote it with the edge of the sword, and possessed it, and dwelt therein, and called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elau lelo le Dan enkop enye, nepuo lelo le Dan aarare Leshem, ore ake pee eidip aaibung'a ina kop nepik ninye olalem neya ninye nemany atua, neipot Leshem aajo, Dan; aaipotie enkarna e nkakuyiaa lenye.

English: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families, these cities with their villages.
Masaai: Ena ninye enjung'ore o losho le Dan, te risioroto oo lmareita lenyena - kuna anas te nebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts, the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip ninche aatoor enkop aitaa injung'oreitin, neisho lelo tung'ana le Israel enjung'ore ti atua ninche Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: According to the word of the LORD they gave him the city which he asked, even Timnathserah in mount Ephraim: and he built the city, and dwelt therein.
Masaai: O teina kitanapata o Laitoriani neisho ninche ninye ina anasa natoomonuo, Timnat-sera te ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim; neitoki ninye ashetu ina anasa nemany atua.

English: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel, divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the LORD, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation. So they made an end of dividing the country.
Masaai: Kuna ninche njung'oreitin apa naatoorikitia Eliesa olapolosani, o Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo ltung'ana le Israel, iltung'ana te oshoto e nkukuo te Shilo, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te kutukaji o lng'obor le ntumo. Neaku eidipa apa ninche aatudung enkop.

English: The LORD also spake unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yoshua,

English: Speak to the children of Israel, saying, Appoint out for you cities of refuge, whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses:
Masaai: “Tiaki iltung'ana le Israel, ‘Entegelu nkanas naasaruni, apa naa ninche nanu atiaaka intae aimunye Musa,

English: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
Masaai: nchere, ore oltung'ani oar olikae metua eitu eotiki aashu eitu ebaraki neidim akuetiki ine; keaku ninche te intae enesaruni te nkaraki ilo oitalaku elap to sarge.

English: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city, and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city unto them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
Masaai: Neisikaki ninye nabo e nena anas nelo aitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi e ina anasa, nelimu mbaa enyena ainosaki ilpayiani le ina anasa; netum taa ninche aawaita ninye aaitijing'a atua enkanasa; neisho ninye ewueji, neton ninye te nebo ninche.

English: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
Masaai: Naa ore ake te nesuju ilo oitalaku elap to sarge ninye, nemeishooyo ninche ilo otasesekuanishe aapik nkaik enyena, amu etasesekuana apa ninye ilo le latia enye eitu eotiki, meetayie apa ninye olomang'ati too nkolong'i naatulusoitie.

English: And he shall dwell in that city, until he stand before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days: then shall the slayer return, and come unto his own city, and unto his own house, unto the city from whence he fled.
Masaai: Naa keton ninye ti atua ina anasa o metaba anaa neaku eitasho ninye te dukuya olturrur meiguanareki, o metaba anaa neye ilo ora olapolosani kitok te ina kata; neaku taa keidim ilo apa otasesekuanishe anyaaki ashomo enkang enye makewan o enkaji enye makewan, ina ang apa naa ninye eisikie.’ ”

English: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali, and Shechem in mount Ephraim, and Kirjatharba, which is Hebron, in the mountain of Judah.
Masaai: Neaku eiteng'ela apa ninche Kedesh te Galilaya ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Naftali, o Shekem ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, o Kiriat-arba, (aa taa Hebron) ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Yuda.

English: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
Masaai: Ore te lido kekun Yordan te nkalo o loo saen le Yeriko, negelu ninche Beser ti atua ilo purkel le nkop naitoriori, enkop o losho le Ruben, o Ramot ti atua Gilead, enkop o losho le Gad; o Golan ti atua Bashan, enkop o losho le Manase.

English: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them, that whosoever killeth any person at unawares might flee thither, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, until he stood before the congregation.
Masaai: Kuna ninche nena anas apa naaiteng'elakaki iltung'ana pooki le Israel, olomoni omanya ina kop atua ninche, pee aa ore pooki ng'ae oar oltung'ani metua eitu eotiki neidim aisikaki ine pee melo ake aye te nkaina e ilo oitalaku elap to sarge o metaba anaa neitashe ninye te dukuya olturrur.

English: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
Masaai: Neitoki aapuonu ilukuny oo nkajijik oo le Lawi enetii Eliesa ilo apolosani o enetii Yoshua olayioni le Nuni o enetii ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loshon loo ltung'ana le Israel;

English: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
Masaai: nejoki ninche te Shilo ti atua enkop e Kanaan, “Eitanapishe apa Olaitoriani aimunye Musa nchere pee eishori iyiook nkanas nikimany te nebo ineeirritishoreki te nkaraki nkishu ang.”

English: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkaraki enkitanapata o Laitoriani neisho iltung'ana le Israel lelo le Lawi kuna anas o neeirritishoreki metaa enjung'ore enye.

English: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
Masaai: Nelotu erubata te nkaraki ilmareita loo Lkohat. Neaku ore lelo le Lawi apa oora ile ishoi e Aron olapolosani neng'amu te oshoto e nkukuo too loshon le Yuda, o Simeon, o Benchamen, nkanas tomon o okuni.

English: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae loo Lkohat neng'amu te oshoto e nkukuo too lmareita lo losho le Efraim o to losho le Dan o to lpisiai lo losho le Manase nkanas tomon.

English: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
Masaai: Neng'amu ile Gershon te oshoto e nkukuo too lmareita to losho le Isaakar, o to losho le Asheri, o to losho le Naftali, o to lpisiai lo losho le Manase nkanas tomon o okuni.

English: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
Masaai: Ore ile Merari te risioroto oolmareita lenye neng'amu to losho le Ruben, o to losho le Gad o to losho le Sebulon, nkanas tomon o are.

English: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Kuna anas apa o neeirritishoreki eishoo iltung'ana le Israel te oshoto enkukuo ile Lawi, anaa apa enaitanapishe Olaitoriani aimunye Musa.

English: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
Masaai: Ore ti alo olosho le Yuda o losho le Simeon neishooyo ninche kuna anas naaipoto too nkarn,

English: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
Masaai: apa naataa ine lelo le ishoi e Aron, obo loo lmareita loo le Kohat apa loo le Lawi; amu ninche etadoikio enkukuo asioki.

English: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
Masaai: Neisho ninche Kiriat-arba (aa Arba taa menye le Anak) aa Hebron taa ina, ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Yuda, te nebo nene wuejitin neeirritishoreki neemanita.

English: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
Masaai: Kake ore nkurman e nkanasa o nkang'itie enyena kutiti neishori Kaleb olayioni le Yefune metaa nkunenyena.

English: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore te lelo le ishoi e Aron ilo apolosani neishori Hebron, ina anasa nasaru olotasesekuanishe, te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
Masaai: Yatir te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Eshtemoa te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
Masaai: Holon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Debir te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
Masaai: Ain te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Yuta te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Bet-shemesh te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas naaudo naaing'uaa kulo oshon pokira oare;

English: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
Masaai: nepuku sii to losho le Benchamen Gibeon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Geba te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Anatot te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Almon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas naaudo.

English: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas e lelo le ishoi e Aron naa nkanas tomon o okuni te nebo iwuejitin enye neeirritishoreki.

English: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae loo Lkohat oora iloo lmareita loo Lkohat loo Lawi, ore apa nkanas naatoorikiaki ninche naa olosho le Efraim eing'uaa.

English: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ninche apa eishooki Shekem, ina anasa nasaru olotasesekuanishe, te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki te ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, Geser te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Kibsa-im te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Bet-horon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore inaaing'uaa olosho le Dan naa El-teke te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Gibeton te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gath-rimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Aijalon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
Masaai: ore inaaing'uaa olpisiai lo losho le Manase, naa Taanak te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki o Gat-rimon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas are.

English: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas e lelo kulikae tung'ana loo Lkohat naa tomon pooki te nebo iwuejitin enye neeirritishoreki.

English: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
Masaai: Ore te lelo le Gershon, lo olmarei obo loo lmareita le Lawi, neishori olpisiai le nkop e Manase, Golan te Bashan te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas are;

English: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore to losho le Isaakar neishori Kishion te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Daberat te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Yarmut te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, En-ganim te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
Masaai: naa ore to losho le Asheri, neishori Mishal te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Abdon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Helkat te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Rehob te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
Masaai: naa ore to losho le Naftali, neishori Kedesh te Galilaya te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, ina anasa e sarunoto te ilo otasesekuanishe, Hamot-dor te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Kartan te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas uni.

English: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas oo lmareita loo le Gershon naa tomon o okuni pooki te nebo iwuejitin enye neeirritishoreki.

English: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae loo Lawi, lelo mareita loo Lmerari neishori ninche to losho le Sebulon, Yokne-am te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Karta te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Dimna te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Nahalal te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore to losho le Ruben neishori Beser te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Yahas te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
Masaai: Kedemot te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, o Mefaat te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan;

English: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore to losho le Gad, neishori Ramot te Gilead te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, ina anasa e sarunoto te ilo otasesekuanishe, Mahanaim te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki,

English: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
Masaai: Heshbon te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki, Yasar te nebo iwuejitin enyena neeirritishoreki - nkanas ong'uan te umata.

English: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
Masaai: Ore ti alo nkanas oo lmareita loo Lmerari, aa taa lelo ootelekutua too lmareita le Lawi, nena apa naatoorikiaki ninche, naa nkanas tomon o are pooki.

English: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
Masaai: Ore apa nkanas oo le Lawi ti atua ina kop oo ltung'ana le Israel naa nkanas artam o isiet pooki te nebo iwuejitin enye neeirritishoreki.

English: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
Masaai: Ore kuna anas neeta ake pooki anasa ewueji enye neirritishoreki namanita ninye; neijia apa etiu te kuna anas pooki.

English: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
Masaai: Neaku eishoo Olaitoriani Israel ina kop pooki apa nainosie ninye olmumai nchere keisho loo menye; ore ake eibung ina kop, nemany ninche ine.

English: And the LORD gave them rest round about, according to all that he sware unto their fathers: and there stood not a man of all their enemies before them; the LORD delivered all their enemies into their hand.
Masaai: Neisho ninche Olaitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng te pooki shoto anaa apa enainosa ninye olmumai too loo menye; meetae hoo ninye obo loo lmang'ati lenye oidima aitasheikinore ninche, amu eishooyie apa Olaitoriani ilmang'ati lenye pooki apik atua nkaik enye.

English: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
Masaai: Meetae hoo enkisiligata nabo e nena kisiligat apa sidain naaisiligie Olaitoriani enkaji e Israel neitu ebaya; etabaitie pooki.

English: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
Masaai: neitoki Yoshua aipotu ile Ruben o le Gad, o lpisiai lo losho le Manase,

English: And said unto them, Ye have kept all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you:
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Embung'a intae nena pooki apa naaitanapa intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, nitoning'o intae oltoilo lai te nena pooki naitanapa nanu intae;

English: Ye have not left your brethren these many days unto this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the LORD your God.
Masaai: eitu intae ipuopuo aaing'uaa ilalashera linyi te kuna olong'i pooki o metabaiki ena olong, kake itorripote intae pee imbung'ubung'u enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And now the LORD your God hath given rest unto your brethren, as he promised them: therefore now return ye, and get you unto your tents, and unto the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you on the other side Jordan.
Masaai: Ore taata neishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi enkiyeng'iyeng too lalashera linyi, anaa apa enaitanapa ninche; ore naa embelekenyata enchom nkang'itie inyi ti atua ina kop inyi, apa naa ninye eishoo intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani te lido kekun le Yordan.

English: But take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law, which Moses the servant of the LORD charged you, to love the LORD your God, and to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and to cleave unto him, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul.
Masaai: Entonyok eng'ura ina kitanapata naishoo intae Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, pee inyorrurru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, nipuopuo too nkoitoi enyena, nimbung'arere ninye nisiaayiayia ninye to ltau linyi pooki o te nkishui inyi pooki.”

English: So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away: and they went unto their tents.
Masaai: Neaku etamayiana apa Yoshua ninche neisho ninche meshomo, nepuo ninche nkang'itie enye.

English: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh Moses had given possession in Bashan: but unto the other half thereof gave Joshua among their brethren on this side Jordan westward. And when Joshua sent them away also unto their tents, then he blessed them,
Masaai: Ore apa olpisiai obo lo losho le Manase neishoo Musa enkop te Bashan; kake ore olikae pisiai eishoo ninche Yoshua enkop te mbata oo lalashera lenye te nkop natii o loo ntoluo le Yordan. Ore ake pee eisho Yoshua ninche meshomo nkang'itie enye nemayian ninche, nejoki,

English: And he spake unto them, saying, Return with much riches unto your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver, and with gold, and with brass, and with iron, and with very much raiment: divide the spoil of your enemies with your brethren.
Masaai: “Entushukoto enchom nkang'itie inyi te karsisisho sapuk o te nebo nkishu kumok oleng, o enkosholai, o sahabu, o suyai, o esekenkei, o te nebo nkilani kumok; entooriki nena nitaarutua ilalashera linyi.”

English: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh returned, and departed from the children of Israel out of Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan, to go unto the country of Gilead, to the land of their possession, whereof they were possessed, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Neaku etushukote apa lelo le Ruben o le Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase aapuo nkang'itie, aaorore iltung'ana le Israel te Shilo, aa ninye apa natii enkop e Kanaan, aapuo enkop e Gilead, enkop enye maate apa naibung'a maate te nkitanapata o Laitoriani naimua Musa.

English: And when they came unto the borders of Jordan, that are in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh built there an altar by Jordan, a great altar to see to.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enkop natii embata e Yordan ti tua enkop e Kanaan neshet ile Ruben o le Gad o lpisiai le Manase olperere lo lasar te ine te mbata e Yordan, olperere lo lasar kitok oleng.

English: And the children of Israel heard say, Behold, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh have built an altar over against the land of Canaan, in the borders of Jordan, at the passage of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nening iltung'ana le Israel eji, “Ng'ura etesheta ile Ruben ole Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase olperere lo lasar te dukuya enkop e Kanaan, ti atua ina kop nataaniki Yordan, te ina shoto apa nara enoo ltung'ana le Israel.”

English: And when the children of Israel heard of it, the whole congregation of the children of Israel gathered themselves together at Shiloh, to go up to war against them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana le Israel ina, neiturrurro olturrur pooki loo ltung'ana le Israel te Shilo, pee earare ninche.

English: And the children of Israel sent unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, into the land of Gilead, Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest,
Masaai: Neirriwaki iltung'ana le Israel olkilikuai iltung'ana le Ruben o le Gad o ilo pisiai lo losho le Manase te nkop e Gilead, Finehas olayioni le Eliasa olapolosani,

English: And with him ten princes, of each chief house a prince throughout all the tribes of Israel; and each one was an head of the house of their fathers among the thousands of Israel.
Masaai: netii te nebo ninye ilaiguanak tomon, obo ake loo loshon loo lmareita le Israel.

English: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche enetii ile Ruben, o le Gad o ilo pisiai le Manase te nkop e Gilead, nejoki ninche,

English: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?
Masaai: “Nji ejo olturrur lo Laitoriani, ‘Kaa taboi ena nitaasa intae ti alo Enkai e Israel aaibelekenya ena olong aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani, te ina niteshetakita ate ena olong olperere lo lasar te ngolong'akinoto o Laitoriani?

English: Is the iniquity of Peor too little for us, from which we are not cleansed until this day, although there was a plague in the congregation of the LORD,
Masaai: Keitu iyiook kiaas eng'oki sapuk te Peor neton eitu o tene kintisiny ate, naa tenkaraki ninye pee eewuo olmeitai shumata olturrur lo Laitoriani,

English: But that ye must turn away this day from following the LORD? and it will be, seeing ye rebel to day against the LORD, that to morrow he will be wroth with the whole congregation of Israel.
Masaai: eji pee imbelekenyanya ena olong aaing'uaa Olaitoriani? Naa ti nigolong'akiki ena olong Olaitoriani naa kegorokino ninye olturrur pooki le Israel taisere.

English: Notwithstanding, if the land of your possession be unclean, then pass ye over unto the land of the possession of the LORD, wherein the LORD'S tabernacle dwelleth, and take possession among us: but rebel not against the LORD, nor rebel against us, in building you an altar beside the altar of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Kake ore taata, te nemesinya enkop inyi, entogiru wootu atua enkop o Laitoriani ine netii olng'obor lo Laitoriani, nimbung'akiki ate enkop ti atua iyiook; emigolong'akiki ake duoo intae Olaitoriani, aashu intaa iyiook iloogolong'u te nchetakinoto nishetakiki ate olperere lo lasar leme ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Did not Achan the son of Zerah commit a trespass in the accursed thing, and wrath fell on all the congregation of Israel? and that man perished not alone in his iniquity.
Masaai: Keitu apa eiturraa Akan olayioni le Sera enkirukoto ti alo nena baa naaiteng'elaki, nedoiki engoro olturrur pooki le Israel? Neme ninye ake oidaa te nkitarruoroto enye.’ ”

English: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
Masaai: Neitoki lelo le Ruben, o le Gad, o lpisiai le Manase aajo te walikinoto e nena lukuny oo lmareita le Israel,

English: The LORD God of gods, the LORD God of gods, he knoweth, and Israel he shall know; if it be in rebellion, or if in transgression against the LORD, (save us not this day,)
Masaai: “Olmagilani, Enkai, Olaitoriani! Olmagilani, Enkai, Olaitoriani! Eyiolo ninye; naa nchoo sii Israel eyiolou makewan! Tenaa ei te ngolong'akinoto, anaa te anyata e nkirukoto ti alo Olaitoriani, mileku iyiook taata

English: That we have built us an altar to turn from following the LORD, or if to offer thereon burnt offering or meat offering, or if to offer peace offerings thereon, let the LORD himself require it;
Masaai: te nkaraki enchetata o lperere lo lasar pee kitum aaibelekenyata aatung'uai esujata o Laitoriani; aashu tenaa eikitaasa iyiook ina pee kitum aaishoru ilasarri oopejori aashu ilasarri le nkurma aashu ilasarri le seriani te nchumata enye, metaa Olaitoriani makewan oitalak iyiook.

English: And if we have not rather done it for fear of this thing, saying, In time to come your children might speak unto our children, saying, What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel?
Masaai: A-a, kake kitaasa iyiook te nkuretisho nchere ore te nkata nalotu neidim nkera inyi aatiaki nkera ang, ‘Kaa intae iporokiki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel?

English: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you, ye children of Reuben and children of Gad; ye have no part in the LORD: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD.
Masaai: Amu eitaa Olaitoriani Yordan olpolosie lang o intae, ore intae ile Ruben o ile Gad; miatata intae erubata ti atua Olaitoriani.’ Neaku keidim nkera inyi aaitapala nkera ang eseremata o Laitoriani.

English: Therefore we said, Let us now prepare to build us an altar, not for burnt offering, nor for sacrifice:
Masaai: Neaku kitejo apa, ‘Mateshetu iyiook olperere lo lasar, neme olopejorieki nkishorunot, neme ino lasar.

English: But that it may be a witness between us, and you, and our generations after us, that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings, and with our sacrifices, and with our peace offerings; that your children may not say to our children in time to come, Ye have no part in the LORD.
Masaai: Kake pee eaku shakeni te iyiook o te intae o ishoritin te siadi iyiook, inchere eikintayu iyiook olasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ninye too nkishorot ang naapejori o lasarri o nkishorot e seriani; pee meyooki ake nkera inyi aajoki nkera ang te nkata nalotu, “Miatata intae erubata ti atua Olaitoriani.” ’

English: Therefore said we, that it shall be, when they should so say to us or to our generations in time to come, that we may say again, Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD, which our fathers made, not for burnt offerings, nor for sacrifices; but it is a witness between us and you.
Masaai: Nikijo apa iyiook, te nelo nejokini iyiook ena aashu eishoi ang te nkata nalotu, nikindim iyiook aatejo, ‘Eng'ura, enkitanyaanyukoto o lperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, apa naitobira iloo papa, neme too nkishorot naapejori, neme too lasarri, kake pee eaku enchakenisho te iyiook o te intae.’

English: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD, and turn this day from following the LORD, to build an altar for burnt offerings, for meat offerings, or for sacrifices, beside the altar of the LORD our God that is before his tabernacle.
Masaai: Kilome mikigolong'aki iyiook Olaitoriani aaibelekenya ena olong aaing'uaa esujata o Laitoriani te nchetata o lperere lo lasar te nkaraki nkishorot naapejori, o nkishorot e nkurma aashu olasar. Mikishet iyiook likae perere lo lasar meteleku ake ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang oitashe te dukuya olng'obor lenye!”

English: And when Phinehas the priest, and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which were with him, heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake, it pleased them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Finehas ilo apolosani o lelo kituaak lo lturrur o nena lukuny oo lmareita le Israel apa naatii te nebo ninye, lelo rorei ootejo ile Ruben o le Gad o le Manase, neitiship ninche oleng.

English: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the children of Manasseh, This day we perceive that the LORD is among us, because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Finehas ilo apolosani ayioni le Eliesa ile Ruben o le Gad, o le Manase, “Kiyiolo iyiook, ena olong aajo etii Olaitoriani atua iyiook, amu eitu intae iasiasa ena kitarruoroto to Laitoriani; ore taata intajeutuo intae iltung'ana le Israel te nkaina o Laitoriani.”

English: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
Masaai: Neitoki Finehas olayioni le Eliesa ilo apolosani, o lkituaak aashuko too le Ruben, o le Gad te nkop e Gilead aapuo enkop e Kanaan, enetii iltung'ana le Israel neyaki ilomon.

English: And the thing pleased the children of Israel; and the children of Israel blessed God, and did not intend to go up against them in battle, to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt.
Masaai: Neitiship lelo omon lelo tung'ana le Israel, neisis iltung'ana le Israel Enkai, neitu eigil aaimaki olarrabal tialo ninche, pee eidaikie ina kop apa natamanya ile Ruben o le Gad.

English: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar Ed: for it shall be a witness between us that the LORD is God.
Masaai: Nejo apa ile Ruben o le Gad enkarna e ilo perere lo lasar “Shakeni;” amu etejo ninche, “shakeni ninye te iyiook nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.”

English: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i kumok, eidipa Olaitoriani aishoo Israel enkiyeng'iyeng ti alo ilmang'ati lenye oomanita ninche, netamorua Yoshua oleng neaku oloo larin kumok,

English: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:
Masaai: neipotu Yoshua Israel pooki, ilpayiani lenye, o lukuny oo nkajijik, olarishak lenye o lkituaak, nejoki ninche, “Atamorua taata nanu nataa oloo larin kumok;

English: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.
Masaai: nitoduaa intae nena pooki naaitaasa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi kuna kuapi pooki te nkaraki intae, amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ninye otijing'a olarrabal te nkaraki intae.

English: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.
Masaai: Ng'ura, atoorikia nanu intae metaa enjung'ore too loshon linyi nena kuapi naang'or, te nebo nkuapi pooki naidipa nanu aiwuang'ie, ebaiki Yordan o metabaiki enaiposha kitok te nkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.
Masaai: Kerrumoo ninche arriny siadi Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te dukuya intae nereu ninche aiwuang'ie too nkonyek inyi; naa iyaya intae enkop enye anaa apa enaisiligie intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;
Masaai: Metaa entuunoto embung'a niasiasa nena pooki naaigero ti atua embuku oo nkitanapat e Musa, nimimbelekenyanya aaing'uaa aapuo enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kedienye,

English: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:
Masaai: pee mishularere ake kuna kuapi naatelekutua naatii atua intae, aashu impotipoto nkaitin enye, aashu inyanya olmumai te ninche, aashu isiayiayia ninche, aashu irrugokinono ninche,

English: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.
Masaai: kake enteenikinoto Olaitoriani Enkai inyi anaa enitaasa intae o metabaiki ena olong.

English: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.
Masaai: Amu etaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya intae nkuapi kituaak naagol, ore tialo intae meetae oltung'ani oidima aitasheikinore intae o metabaiki ena olong.

English: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.
Masaai: Oltung'ani obo te intae odumu enkalifu meisika, amu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi otii olarrabal te nkaraki intae, anaa apa enaisiligie intae.

English: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.
Masaai: Entujurroto naa maate, pee inyorrurru Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:
Masaai: Amu ti nimbelekenyanya aaibung'are olpisiai le kuna kuapi naatelekutua tene ti atua intae niyamama o ninche, pee iyamiyama nkituaak enye neyam nkuninyi,

English: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
Masaai: entayiolo te sipata nchere meitoki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi areu kuna kuapi te dukuya intae; kake keaku ninche orreshet te intae, enchipishipi too sunta inyi o lkiku too nkonyek inyi, o metaba anaa nindaayaya aaishunye tena kop sidai naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata etaa nanu kalo anaa enapuo iltung'ana pooki, niyiololo intae too ltauja linyi o te nkishui inyi, intae pooki, nchere, meetae embae hoo nabo neitu ebaya te nena baa pooki sidain naaisiligishore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi ti alo intae, eetuo pooki aabaya te nkaraki intae, meetae hoo nabo neitu ebaya.

English: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.
Masaai: Kake ore anaa enaitabayioki nena baa pooki sidain naaisiligishore Olaitoriani ti alo intae, neijia sii eiko Olaitoriani ayaki intae ntorrok pooki, o metaba anaa nemut intae aiwuang'ie tena kop sidai apa naishoo intae Olaitoriani Enkai,

English: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
Masaai: ti nigiligili olning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, apa oitanapa ninye intae, nipuopuo aaisiai kulie aitin, nirrugokinono ninche. Netum taa engoro o Laitoriani ayupuyupo te nkaraki intae nindaayaya intae aaing'uaa ina kop sidai naishoo ninye intae.”

English: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua aiturrur iloshon pooki le Israel te Shekem, neipotu ilpayiani, ilukuny oo nkajijik, o larishak o lkituaak le Israel, neyau ninche ate dukuya Enkai.

English: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua lelo tung'ana pooki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ‘Etamanya apa loo papaai linyi lido kekun Frati, Tera menye le Abraham o Nahori; neisiaai ninche kulie aitin.

English: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood, and led him throughout all the land of Canaan, and multiplied his seed, and gave him Isaac.
Masaai: Naya apa nanu papaai linyi Abraham aitayu te lido kekun olkeju narik nanu ninye ti atua enkop e Kanaan pooki; naitubul eishoi enye aitaa kumok. Aishoo nanu ninye Isaak;

English: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave unto Esau mount Seir, to possess it; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.
Masaai: naisho Isaak Yakobo o Esau. Naisho nanu Esau ina kop oo ldoinyo e Seir meitaa enenye, kake eshomo Yakobo o nkera enyena Misiri.

English: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
Masaai: Nairriwaa nanu Musa o Aron, naar nanu enkop e Misiri te nena nataasa nanu ti atua ninche; ore te siadi naipang'unye nanu intae.

English: And I brought your fathers out of Egypt: and ye came unto the sea; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea.
Masaai: Naipang'unye nanu loo papaai linyi aitung'uaa Misiri, nipuonunu enaiposha; nesuju apa Ilmisiri loo papaai linyi too ngarrin o too mbartan o meetu Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: And when they cried unto the LORD, he put darkness between you and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them, and covered them; and your eyes have seen what I have done in Egypt: and ye dwelt in the wilderness a long season.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eishiraki ninche Olaitoriani nepik ninye enaimin erishata intae o lelo Misiri, naisho enaiposha meeu shumata ninche neitemoo ninche; netoduaa nkonyek inyi enaitaasa nanu Misiri; nitotoni intae to lpurkel enkata naado.

English: And I brought you into the land of the Amorites, which dwelt on the other side Jordan; and they fought with you: and I gave them into your hand, that ye might possess their land; and I destroyed them from before you.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ayau intae enkop oo Lamori, laa ninche apa ootii lido likae kekun le Yordan; nearare ninche intae, naishoru nanu ninche apik atua nkaik inyi, niyaya intae enkop enye aaitaa eninyi, naidaikie nanu ninche te dukuya intae.

English: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
Masaai: Neitoki adumunye Balak olayioni le Sipor, olaiguanani le Moab, nearare Israel; neirriwaa olkilikuai aitoomon Balaam olayioni le Beor meeu adek intae,

English: But I would not hearken unto Balaam; therefore he blessed you still: so I delivered you out of his hand.
Masaai: kake eitu nanu aning Balaam; neaku etamayiana ninye intae; neaku atokordua nanu intae aitung'uaa enkaina enye.

English: And ye went over Jordan, and came unto Jericho: and the men of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; and I delivered them into your hand.
Masaai: Nitalang'utua apa intae Yordan nipuonunu Yeriko, nearare intae iltung'ana le Yeriko, o Lamori sii, o Lperisi o Lkanaan, o Lhiti, o Lgigashi o Lhifi, o Lyebusi; naishoru nanu ninche apik atua nkaik inyi.

English: And I sent the hornet before you, which drave them out from before you, even the two kings of the Amorites; but not with thy sword, nor with thy bow.
Masaai: Napik nanu enkuretisho dukuya intae naa enkaraki ena apa mme olalem linyi neme enkawuo inyi, natimirayie lelo aiguanak oare loo Lamori.

English: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
Masaai: Aishoo nanu intae enkop neitu iekarere, o nkanas neitu ishetishete, nibikitoto intae ti atua ninche ninyanya ilng'anayio le nkurma o sabibu leitu iunuunu.’

English: Now therefore fear the LORD, and serve him in sincerity and in truth: and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood, and in Egypt; and serve ye the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata entureita Olaitoriani nisiayiayia ninye to ltau owang o te sipata (metii esunkureisho); ewuang'ie nena aitin apa naaisiaayia iloo papaai linyi te lido kekun Yordan; o te Misiri nisiayiayia Olaitoriani.

English: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ti nimiyieuu intae nisiayiayia Olaitoriani, entegelu ena olong olisiayiayia tenaa ai nena aitin apa naaisiaayia iloo papaai linyi te lido kekun Yordan aashu tenaa ai nena aitin oo Lamori naa enkop enye itii; kake ore nanu o olmarei lai naa aikisiaai Olaitoriani.”

English: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the LORD, to serve other gods;
Masaai: Newal iltung'ana aajo, “Kilome miking'uaa iyiook Olaitoriani, aapuo aaisiai kulie aitin;

English: For the LORD our God, he it is that brought us up and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and which did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way wherein we went, and among all the people through whom we passed:
Masaai: amu Olaitoriani Enkai ang apa oyaua iyiook o loo papa aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitupuku te nkaji e sinkaisho, naa ninye apa otaasa nena kitoduaat sapuki too nkonyek ang, negolie iyiook te ina oitoi pooki apa nikiima o ti atua iltung'ana pooki apa likiimaitie atua ninche;

English: And the LORD drave out from before us all the people, even the Amorites which dwelt in the land: therefore will we also serve the LORD; for he is our God.
Masaai: nearaa Olaitoriani te dukuya iyiook iloreren pooki, Ilamori apa laa ninche emanya ena kop; metaa eikisiai sii iyiook Olaitoriani, amu ninye Enkai ang.”

English: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye cannot serve the LORD: for he is an holy God; he is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yoshua iltung'ana, “Mindimidimi intae aaisiaayia Olaitoriani, amu Enkai sinyati ninye; Enkai o lom ninye; mepalaki ninye nkitarruorot inyi aashu ing'ok inyi.

English: If ye forsake the LORD, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.
Masaai: Tining'uaa intae Olaitoriani aapuo aaisiai nkaitin omon, naa keibelekenya sii ninye neitaas intae entorrono, nemut intae, eidipa aitaasa intae esidai.”

English: And the people said unto Joshua, Nay; but we will serve the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana Yoshua, “A-a; eikisiai iyiook Olaitoriani.”

English: And Joshua said unto the people, Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the LORD, to serve him. And they said, We are witnesses.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoshua ajoki iltung'ana, “Irara intae ilchakenini ti alo intae maate nchere itudutaitie Olaitoriani pee isiayiayia ninye.” Nejo ninche, “Kira iyiook ilchakenini.”

English: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ewuang'ie naa nena aitin omon naatii atua intae nimbelekenyakiki oltau linyi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.”

English: And the people said unto Joshua, The LORD our God will we serve, and his voice will we obey.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana Yoshua, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang iyiook kisiaai, naa oltoilo lenye iyiook kining.”

English: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and set them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
Masaai: Neitobir Yoshua olning'o o ltung'ana ina olong, neisho ninche nkitanapat o nkikoot te Shekem.

English: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God, and took a great stone, and set it up there under an oak, that was by the sanctuary of the LORD.
Masaai: Neiger Yoshua kulo rorei ti atua embuku oo nkitanapat e Nkai; neya osoit kitok neitasheyie te ine ti abori olchani te ine wueji o Laitoriani.

English: And Joshua said unto all the people, Behold, this stone shall be a witness unto us; for it hath heard all the words of the LORD which he spake unto us: it shall be therefore a witness unto you, lest ye deny your God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoshua lelo tung'ana pooki, “Ng'ura, ore ele soit naa keaku shakenisho ti alo iyiook; amu etoning'o ninye irorei pooki lo Laitoriani ootiaka ninye iyiook; metaa keaku shakeni ti alo intae, pee mintaasiasa ake entorroni Enkai inyi.”

English: So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.
Masaai: Neisho taa Yoshua iltung'ana meshomo, oltung'ani ake nelo enjung'ore enye.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna baa neye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, osinka lo Laitoriani, aa oloo larin iip o tomon.

English: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathserah, which is in mount Ephraim, on the north side of the hill of Gaash.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche ninye ti atua enjung'ore enye te Timnat-sera, apa naa ninye natii ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, moikuape o ldoinyo le Gaash.

English: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.
Masaai: Neisiaai Israel Olaitoriani too nkolong'i pooki e Yoshua, o nkolong'i pooki e lelo payiani apa ootung'uayie Yoshua, apa ooyiolo esiaai pooki nataasa Olaitoriani te nkaraki Israel.

English: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.
Masaai: Ore iloik le Yosef apa ooyautua iltung'ana le Israel te Misiri nenukari te Shekem, ti atua erubata e nkop apa nainyiang'ua Yakobo too layiok le Hamor menye Shekem too mpisai iip; netaa apa ine enjung'ore oo layiok le Yosef.

English: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him in a hill that pertained to Phinehas his son, which was given him in mount Ephraim.
Masaai: Neye sii Eliesa olayioni le Aron nenukaa ninche ninye te Gibeya, te nkang e Finehas olayioni lenye, apa naishooki ninye ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim.

English: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
Masaai: Ore te siadi keeya e Yoshua neikilikuanishore iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani ejo, “Kaing'ae ong'as aituruk alo te nkaraki iyiook pee earare Ilkanaani?”

English: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Yuda oilep alo; ng'ura aishooyie nanu enkop apik atua enkaina enye.”

English: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yuda Simion olalashe lenye, “Ilepu wou te nebo nanu tamanya atua ena kop naatoorikiaki nanu, pee kitum aataarare Ilkanaani; ore sii nanu naa kaiko neijia alo te nebo iyie atua ina kop nikitoorikiaki iyie.” Nelo Simion te nebo ninye.

English: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
Masaai: Neilep Yuda alo neishooyo Olaitoriani Ilkanaani o Lperesi apik atua enkaina enye, nemir apa ninche nkalifuni tomon enye te Besek.

English: And they found Adonibezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
Masaai: Nepuonu apa ninche aadoiki Adoni-besek te Besek, nearare ninye, neisulie Ilkanaani o Lperesi.

English: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
Masaai: Neisik Adoni-besek; kake etimira, neibung ninye, nedung'oo ninche ilmogirrani lenyena loo nkaik o loo nkejek.

English: And Adonibezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
Masaai: Nejo Adoni-besek, “Ore apa ilaiguanak ntomoni naapishana ootudung'oyioki ilmogirrani lenye loo nkaik o loo nkejek naa ti abori emesa ai esotu ndaiki naadoyio; anaa enataasa nanu, neaku aaitalakua nanu Enkai.” Neyau ninche ninye Yerusalem, neye ninye te ine.

English: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
Masaai: Nearare iltung'ana le Yuda Yerusalem, neibung, near te nepi o lalem nepik ina anasa enkima.

English: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena nepuo iltung'ana le Yuda aarare Ilkanaani apa oomanya enkop oo ldoinyo ti atua Negeb o te ina kop nagum.

English: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
Masaai: Nelo Yuda aarare lelo Kanaani apa oomanya Hebron, ore apa enkarna e Hebron naa keji Kiriat Arba; near neisulie ninche Sheshai o Ahiman o Talmai.

English: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjathsepher:
Masaai: Nedumunye te ine nepuo aarare lelo oomanya Debir. Ore apa enkarna e Debir naa keji Kiriat-sefer.

English: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjathsepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
Masaai: Nejo Kaleb, “Ore ilo orasaki Kiriat-sefer neya ninye, naisho ninye Aksa entito ai meitaa enkitok enye.”

English: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
Masaai: Neya Otniel olayioni le Kenas, olalashe oti le Kaleb, neisho Kaleb ninye Aksa ina tito enye meitaa enkitok.

English: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
Masaai: Ore ake pee eyam ninye, neikilikuan Aksa ninye metoomono menye enkop; nedou ninye to sikiria lenye, nejoki Kaleb ninye, “Kainyoo iyieu?”

English: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nchooki enkishoroto; ore amu kiterewa nanu mashomo enkop e Negeb, nchooki sii nkonyek e nkare.” Neisho Kaleb ninye nkonyek e nkare e shumata o ni abori.

English: And the children of the Kenite, Moses' father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
Masaai: Ore lelo le ishoi e Keni, ilo aputani le Musa, neilep aapuo te nebo iltung'ana le Yuda te ina anasa oo ltuka nepuo ong'ata e Yuda apa natii Negeb embata e Aradi; nepuo ninche aatoni te nebo lelo tung'ana.

English: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
Masaai: Nelo Yuda te nebo Simion olalashe lenye, nemir ninche Ilkanaani apa oomanya Sefat, neidaikie tukul. Neaku keji apa enkarna e ina anasa Horma.

English: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
Masaai: Ewa sii apa Yuda Gasa te nebo enkop enye, o Ashkelon te nebo enkop enye, o Ekron te nebo enkop enye.

English: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
Masaai: Netii apa Olaitoriani te nebo Yuda neya ninye aitaa enenye ina kop oo ldoinyo, kake eitu apa eidimu ataarai aipang'ie lelo oomanya enkisiajata, amu eeta apa ninche ngarrin oo sekenke.

English: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
Masaai: Neishooyioki apa Hebron aaisho Kaleb anaa apa enatejo Musa; nearaa Kaleb aipang'ie ti atua ninye lelo ayiok pokira okuni le Anak.

English: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
Masaai: Kake eitu earaa iltung'ana le Benchamen Ilyebusi apa oomanya Yerusalem; neaku etobiko apa Ilyebusi te nebo iltung'ana le Benchamen te Yerusalem ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
Masaai: Ore sii apa enkaji e Yosef neilep aapuo aarare Betel; netii Olaitoriani te nebo ninche.

English: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
Masaai: Neirriwaa enkaji e Yosef ilaikitalak meshomo aaikeern Betel. (Ore apa enkarna e ina anasa naa keji Lus).

English: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
Masaai: Nedol lelo aikitalak oltung'ani eipang'u te nkanasa, nejoki, “Tuutaki sii ake iyiook enkoitoi nalo atua enkanasa, pee kintaas iyie esidai.”

English: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
Masaai: Neitodol ninye ninche enkoitoi nalo atua ina anasa; near ninche ina anasa te nepi o lalem, kake eishoo ninche ilo tung'ani te nebo olmarei lenye meshomo.

English: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
Masaai: Nelo ilo tung'ani enkop oo Lhiti nelo ashet enkanasa nejo enkarna enye Lus; ina enkarna enye o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Bethshean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Manase aipang'ie lelo oomanya Betshean o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, aashu Taanak o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, aashu lelo oomanya Dori o nkang'itie enyena kutiti aashu lelo oomanya Ibleam o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, aashu lelo oomanya Megido o nkang'itie enyena kutiti; kake eting'iria Ilkanaani aabik ti atua ina kop.

English: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
Masaai: Ore ake pee egolu Israel, nepik ninche Ilkanaani enkisiaayiare nagol, kake eitu earaa ninche aaipang'ie tukul.

English: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Efraim aipang'ie lelo Kanaani oomanya Geser; kake etobiko Ilkanaani ti atua Geser te nebo ninche.

English: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
