Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Sebulon aipang'ie lelo oomanya Kitron, aashu lelo oomanya Nahalol; kake etobiko Ilkanaani ti atua ninche neaku ilenkisiaayiare nagol.

English: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Asheri aipang'ie lelo oomanya Ako, aashu lelo oomanya Sidon, aashu ile Ahalab, aashu ile Aksib, aashu ile Helba, aashu ile Afik, aashu ile Rehob;

English: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
Masaai: kake etobiko apa ile Asheri ti atua Ilkanaani lelo oomanya ina kop; amu eitu earaa ninche aaipang'ie.

English: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Bethshemesh, nor the inhabitants of Bethanath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Bethshemesh and of Bethanath became tributaries unto them.
Masaai: Eitu apa earaa Naftali aaipang'ie lelo oomanya Bet-she-mesh, aashu lelo oomanya Bet-anat, kake etobiko ninche ti atua lelo Kanaani oomanya ina kop; ore ake eyia, ore lelo oomanya Bet-she-mesh, o le Bet-anat netaa ilenkisiaayiare nagol te ninche.

English: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
Masaai: Nerrumoki apa Ilamori ile Dan enkop oo ndoinyo, amu eitu apa eisho ninche meetu enkisiajata tiabori;

English: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
Masaai: neng'iri Ilamori aabik ti atua Har-heres, o ti atua Aiyalon, o ti atua Sha-albim, kake eturokine enkaina e nkaji e Yosef ninche te ngolon, neaku ile nkisiaayiare nagol.

English: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
Masaai: Ore olpolosie loo Lamori nelo te nkilepunoto e Akrabim ebaiki Sela neilep.

English: And an angel of the LORD came up from Gilgal to Bochim, and said, I made you to go up out of Egypt, and have brought you unto the land which I sware unto your fathers; and I said, I will never break my covenant with you.
Masaai: Neilep apa olmalaika lo Laitoriani te Gilgal alo Bokim. Nejo ninye, “Ayaua apa nanu intae ailepunye te Misiri, nayau intae atua ina kop apa nainosa olmumai pee aisho loo papaai linyi. Atejo apa, ‘Magil ae kata olning'o lai o intae,

English: And ye shall make no league with the inhabitants of this land; ye shall throw down their altars: but ye have not obeyed my voice: why have ye done this?
Masaai: nimintobiribiri sii intae olning'o o kulo oomanya ena kop; niaariara ilpereren lenye lo lasar’ kake eitu intae imbung'ubung'u enkitanapata ai. Kainyoo ena nitaasa intae?

English: Wherefore I also said, I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be as thorns in your sides, and their gods shall be a snare unto you.
Masaai: Neaku ajoki taata intae, maaraa ninche aipang'ie te dukuya intae; kake keaku ninche ilmang'ati te intae, naa keaku nkaitin enye orreshet te intae.”

English: And it came to pass, when the angel of the LORD spake these words unto all the children of Israel, that the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiro ilo malaika lo Laitoriani kulo rorei too ltung'ana pooki le Israel, neyietu iltung'ana aaishir.

English: And they called the name of that place Bochim: and they sacrificed there unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neisho ninche ine wueji enkarna aajo Bokim; neitaiki Olaitoriani olasar te ine.

English: And when Joshua had let the people go, the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eisho Yoshua iltung'ana meshomo, nepuo lelo tung'ana le Israel oltung'ani ake enjung'ore enye, pee elo aya enkop.

English: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.
Masaai: Neisiaai iltung'ana Olaitoriani nkolong'i pooki e Yoshua, o nkolong'i pooki e lelo payiani apa ootii te siadi Yoshua, apa ootoduaa ina siaai pooki kitok nataasa Olaitoriani te nkaraki Israel.

English: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.
Masaai: Neye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni, ilo sinka lo Laitoriani, aa oloo larin iip o tomon.

English: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnathheres, in the mount of Ephraim, on the north side of the hill Gaash.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche ninye to lpolosie le njung'ore enye te Timat-heres, ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, te moikuape oldoinyo le Gaash.

English: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers: and there arose another generation after them, which knew not the LORD, nor yet the works which he had done for Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa ina ishoi pooki neishunye sii ninche aaye; neitoki ailepu ae ishoi te siadi ninche, apa nemeyiolo ninye Olaitoriani aashu esiaai apa nataasa ninye te nkaraki Israel.

English: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim:
Masaai: Neas lelo tung'ana le Israel entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani neisiaai inkaitin e Baal;

English: And they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked the LORD to anger.
Masaai: neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye apa laa ninye nayaua ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; nepuo ninche aasujaa kulie aitin, ti atua nena aitin oo loreren apa oomanita ninche, neirrugokino ninche; neitagor ninche Olaitoriani.

English: And they forsook the LORD, and served Baal and Ashtaroth.
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Ashtarot.

English: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them, and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about, so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies.
Masaai: Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani ti alo Israel, neishooyo ninye ninche apik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye nemiraki ninche engolon e lelo mangati oomanita ninche, o metaa meekure eidim aairisha ilmang'ati lenye.

English: Whithersoever they went out, the hand of the LORD was against them for evil, as the LORD had said, and as the LORD had sworn unto them: and they were greatly distressed.
Masaai: Kejo ake maape, negilunore ninche enkaina o Laitoriani te ntorroni anaa apa enatejo Olaitoriani, o anaa sii enainosa Olaitoriani olmumai ti alo ninche, neing'aing'ai ninche oleng.

English: Nevertheless the LORD raised up judges, which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them.
Masaai: Neput Olaitoriani ilarishak, ooitajeu ninche aaitayu te ngolon e lelo apa ootaraitie ninche.

English: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu ninche ening ilarishak lenye, amu eiborrie onyek esujaa kulie aitin neirrugokino ninche; eibelekenyate apa nabo kata aapong ina oitoi naa ninye apa eima loo menye, lelo apa oibung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani, neitu ninche eas ina.

English: And when the LORD raised them up judges, then the LORD was with the judge, and delivered them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge: for it repented the LORD because of their groanings by reason of them that oppressed them and vexed them.
Masaai: Ore ake anaa te neput Olaitoriani ilarishak te nkaraki ninche, netii Olaitoriani te nebo ilo arishani, neitajeu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye too nkolong'i pooki e ilo arishani; amu eing'urrie apa Olaitoriani ninche te nkaraki osina lenye te nkaraki lelo apa ooisomita ninche neinosie osina.

English: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
Masaai: Kake ore apa te neye olarishani, neibelekenya ninche neas ntorrok alang iloo menye, epuo aasujaa kulie aitin, neisiaai ninche neirrugokino ninche; eitu apa ninche epal ae nabo oo mbaa enye torrok aashu nena enye engolong'u.

English: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel; and he said, Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and have not hearkened unto my voice;
Masaai: Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki Israel; nejo ninye, “Ore enkaraki natigila kulo tung'ana olning'o lai apa laitanapa nanu loo menye, neitu ening oltoilo lai,

English: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died:
Masaai: meekure nanu ebaiki taata aaraa aipang'ie te dukuya ninche hoo ninye olosho obo te lelo apa ootung'uayie Yoshua pee eye,

English: That through them I may prove Israel, whether they will keep the way of the LORD to walk therein, as their fathers did keep it, or not.
Masaai: paa ore te ninche natum nanu atetema Israel, tenaa keshilaa aapuo te nkoitoi e Nkai, anaa apa enataasa iloomenye aashu eneitu.”

English: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
Masaai: Neaku etapala apa Olaitoriani lelo oshon, eitu earaa ninche aipang'ie nabo kata, neitu ninye eishooyo ninche apik atua engolon e Yoshua.

English: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
Masaai: Kulo apa iloshon ootelekua Olaitoriani pee etemie ninche Israel, aa taa lelo pooki ti atua Israel leitu ae kata eyiolou likae arrabal obo te Kanaan;

English: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
Masaai: enkaraki ena apa pee etum iishoritin oo ltung'ana le Israel aatayioloito olarrabal, pee etum ninye aiteng'ena ninche olarrabal, amu eitu apa eyiolou.

English: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo oreren: Ilkituaak imiet loo Lfilisti, o Lkanaani pooki, le Sidon, o Lhafi apa oomanya oldoinyo le Lebanon, ebaiki oldoinyo le Baalhermon ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat.

English: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Ilootemieki Israel apa ninche, pee eyiolouni tenaa keidim Israel aibung'a nkitanapat o Laitoriani apa naaitanapa ninye loo menye te Musa.

English: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
Masaai: Neaku etobiko apa iltung'ana le Israel ti atua Ilkanaani, o Ilhiti, Ilamori, Ilperisi, Ilhifi o Lyebusi;

English: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
Masaai: neyam ninche ntoyie enye aaitaa nkituaak enye, ore ntoyie enye maate neisho ilayiok le lelo oreren, neisiaai nkaitin enye.

English: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
Masaai: Neas iltung'ana le Israel entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, nerikino ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Asherot.

English: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
Masaai: Neaku eyupuyupo apa engoro o Laitoriani ti alo Israel nemir ninche metijing'a atua enkaina e Kushan-rishataim olaiguanani le Mesopotamia neisiaai iltung'ana le Israel Kushan-rishataim ilarin isiet.

English: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, neisho Olaitoriani olakordunoni te nkaraki iltung'ana le Israel, laa ninye apa otokordua ninche Otiniel olayioni le Kenas, olalashe oti le Kaleb.

English: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
Masaai: Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye, neaku ninye olarishani te Israel; neilep ninye alo olarrabal neishooyo Olaitoriani Kushan-rishataim, olaiguanani le Mesepotamia apik atua enkaina enye; neisulu enkaina enye Kushan-rishataim.

English: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
Masaai: Netum taa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam. Neye Otiniel olayioni le Kenas.

English: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaigil aas entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani; neitagol Olaitoriani Eglon olaiguanani le Moab metaarare Israel, enkaraki nataasa ninche entorroni too nkonyek o Loitoriani.

English: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
Masaai: Neiturrurroki ninye kewan Ilamori o Lmaleki nelo amir Israel neya ninche ina anasa oo ltuka aaitaa enenye.

English: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
Masaai: Neisiaai iltung'ana le Israel Eglon olaiguanani le Moab ilarin tomon o isiet.

English: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani neisho Olaitoriani ninche olakordunoni, Ehudi, olayioni le Gera, lolosho le Benchamen, oltung'ani kedienye. Neirriwaa iltung'ana le Israel ninye meyaki Eglon olaiguanani le Moab kodi.

English: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
Masaai: Neitobiraki Ehudi kewan olalem opi nkaloli pokira are laa entemet nabo e nkaina o lpisiai enkadoro, neeniki ninye enkupes enye e nkeju e tatene aitabolu nkilani enyena.

English: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
Masaai: Neitarasaa ninye ina kishoroto aisho Eglon olaiguanani le Moab, naa oltung'ani apa opir oleng.

English: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Ehudi aitarasai ina kodi, neisho lelo tung'ana meshomo apa ooyautua ina kodi.

English: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
Masaai: Kake eibelekenyunye ninye makewan ashukunye te nena kitanyaanyukot oo soito naaguetuno naatii embata e Gilgal, nejo, “Aata nanu olkilikuai laakurraki olaiguanani.” Nejo ninye, “Entigirata.” Ore apa lelo pooki ooisiaaita ninye neipang aapuo aaing'uaa ninye.

English: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
Masaai: Nelotu Ehudi enetii ninye, etonita openy ti atua olgilata lenye oirobi le shumata. Nejo Ehudi, “Aata olkilikuai oing'uaa Enkai te nkaraki iyie.” Nedumunye ninye to lorika lenye.

English: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
Masaai: Neitorioo Ehudi enkaina enye e kedienye, neshutu olalem te nkupes enye e tatene neisuroki atua enkoshoke enye;

English: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
Masaai: nejing pooki o olkidong'oi lenye, neibung enkurriny ilo alem, amu eitu apa eshutu ilo alem te nkoshoke enye; nebukunye enkorotik e nkoshoke.

English: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
Masaai: Neipang'u Ehudi boo, neiken nkutukie oo nkajijik e ilo gilata le shumata, neen.

English: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
Masaai: Ore eidipa ashomo, nepuonu ilaisiaayiak; ore pee edol aajo keikeno nkutukie e lelo gilat le shumata, nejo ninche, “Ebaiki naa kewan ebakita ti atua ilo gilata oirobi.”

English: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
Masaai: Neanyisho ninche o metaba anaa nepalari; kake ore ake eton eitu ebol ninye nkutukie e lelo gilat le shumata, neitayu ninche olbolet nebol; neirragita te ine olkitok lenye to ltiren etua.

English: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
Masaai: Neisika duoo Ehudi aluaya ina kata eanyisho ninche, nelo agiroo nena kitanyaanyukot naaguetuno too soito, neisik alo Se-ira.

English: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaya neosh entarumpeta te ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, nepuo iltung'ana le Israel te nebo ninye aadoyio te ina kop oo ndoinyo, etii ninye dukuya ninche.

English: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Entusujuaki; amu eishorua Olaitoriani ilmang'ati linyi lelo Moabu apik atua enkaina inyi.” Neaku etadoitie apa ninche aasujaa ninye, neibung ilang'at olkeju le Yordan naaimu Ilmoabu, neitu ninche eisho hoo oltung'ani obo metalang'u.

English: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
Masaai: Near ninche ina olong iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni tomon loo Lmoabu, oogol pooki, eitu ninye eimisho obo.

English: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
Masaai: Neaku etimiraki apa Moab ina olong nejing abori enkaina e Israel. Netum apa ina kop enkiyeng'iyeng too larin ntomoni isiet.

English: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Shamgar olayioni le Anat, apa laa ninye otara metuata iltung'ana iip ile loo Lfilisti te ng'udi nareyieki lmong'i, netokordua sii ninye Israel.

English: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the LORD, when Ehud was dead.
Masaai: Neigil ake iltung'ana le Israel aas entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, ina kata eidipa Ehudi atua.

English: And the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, that reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose host was Sisera, which dwelt in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
Masaai: Nemir Olaitoriani ninche metijing'a atua enkaina e Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan, apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Hasor; ore apa olarikoni le njore enye naa Sisera, nemanya apa ninye Harosheta-goiim.

English: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD: for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aaishiraki Olaitoriani metaretu; amu eeta apa ninye ngarrin iip naaudo oo sekenke, neisomita apa iltung'ana le Israel te nkisikong'ata too larin tikitam.

English: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
Masaai: Ore apa Debora enkoiboni e Nkai, ina kitok e Lapidot, naa ninye apa narishita Israel te ina kata.

English: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in mount Ephraim: and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
Masaai: Neton apa ninye te ntonata o ltukai le Debora te rishata e Rama o Betel ti atua ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim; neilepu iltung'ana le Israel aapuonu enetii ninye te rishare.

English: And she sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedeshnaphtali, and said unto him, Hath not the LORD God of Israel commanded, saying, Go and draw toward mount Tabor, and take with thee ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye olkilikuai aipotu Barak olayioni le Abinoam te Kedesh ti atua Naftali, nejoki ninye, “Kintanapa iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ejo, ‘Shomo, nturrurro iltung'ana linono to ldoinyo le Tabor iwa iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon lo losho le Naftali o lo losho le Sebulon.

English: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into thine hand.
Masaai: Naa kayietu nanu Sisera, ilo kitok le njore e Yabin, pee kilotu atumore te mbata o lkeju le Kishon te nebo ngarrin enyena o ltimito lenyena; naa kaishoru nanu ninye apik atua enkaina ino.’ ”

English: And Barak said unto her, If thou wilt go with me, then I will go: but if thou wilt not go with me, then I will not go.
Masaai: Nejoki Barak ninye, “Ti nilo iyie te nebo nanu, nalo, kake te nimilo iyie te nebo nanu, nemalo nanu.”

English: And she said, I will surely go with thee: notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour; for the LORD shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman. And Deborah arose, and went with Barak to Kedesh.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ore te sipata kalo nanu te nebo iyie; ore eyia, ore ina oitoi niim iyie nemeyau enkisisa ino, amu kemir Olaitoriani Sisera apik atua enkaina e nkitok.” Nedumunye Debora alo te nebo Barak Kedesh.

English: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet: and Deborah went up with him.
Masaai: Neipotu Barak Sebulon o Naftali meetu Kedesh; neilep iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon aasujaa ninye, nelo sii Debora te nebo ninye.

English: Now Heber the Kenite, which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses, had severed himself from the Kenites, and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanaim, which is by Kedesh.
Masaai: Netoorote apa Heberi ilo le Keni o Lkeni, lelo le ishoi e Hobabu olaputani le Musa, nelo aunoki olng'obor lenye olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli te Sa-ananim, apa nataaniki Kedesh.

English: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Sisera nchere eshomo Barak olayioni le Abinoam oldoinyo le Tabor,

English: And Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people that were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles unto the river of Kishon.
Masaai: neipotu Sisera ngarrin enyena pooki, ngarrin iip naaudo oo sekenke, o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, ebaiki Haroshet-hagoiim o metabaiki olkeju le Kishon.

English: And Deborah said unto Barak, Up; for this is the day in which the LORD hath delivered Sisera into thine hand: is not the LORD gone out before thee? So Barak went down from mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.
Masaai: Nejoki Debora Barak, “Tudumunye! Amu ena olong eishooyie Olaitoriani Sisera apik atua enkaina ino. Aime Olaitoriani olo te dukuya iyie?” Nedoiyio Barak to ldoinyo le Tabor tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oosujita ninye.

English: And the LORD discomfited Sisera, and all his chariots, and all his host, with the edge of the sword before Barak; so that Sisera lighted down off his chariot, and fled away on his feet.
Masaai: Nemir Olaitoriani Sisera o ngarrin enyena pooki o enjore enye pooki te dukuya Barak nepik enepi olalem; nedou Sisera te ngarri enye neisik alo too nkejek.

English: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
Masaai: Nesujaa Barak nena garrin o mbartan o enjore o meshomo Haroshet-ha-goiim, ore ina jore pooki e Sisera nebatata te nepi olalem; eitu ninye eleku oltung'ani.

English: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
Masaai: Kake eisika apa Sisera too nkejek o meshomo olng'obor le Yael, enkitok e Heberi loo Lkeni, amu etii apa eseriani erishata e Yabin olaiguanani le Hasor o enkaji e Heberi ilo Keni.

English: And Jael went out to meet Sisera, and said unto him, Turn in, my lord, turn in to me; fear not. And when he had turned in unto her into the tent, she covered him with a mantle.
Masaai: Neipang'u Yael alotu anang'are Sisera, nejoki ninye, “Wou, olkitok lai, wou enkaji ai, miureishoyu.” Neaku eibelekenyunye ninye ajing atua olng'obor lenye neimulumul ninye to lmukeka.

English: And he said unto her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water to drink; for I am thirsty. And she opened a bottle of milk, and gave him drink, and covered him.
Masaai: Nejoki Sisera ninye, “Nchooki siaake enkiti are naok; amu kaata enkure.” Nebol ninye olbene lo lchoni le kule neisho ninye metooko neitoki aimulumul ninye.

English: Again he said unto her, Stand in the door of the tent, and it shall be, when any man doth come and enquire of thee, and say, Is there any man here? that thou shalt say, No.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Ntasho te kutuk aji o lng'obor, naa ore pooki tung'ani likilotu aikilikuan ajoki, ‘Ketii oltung'ani ene?’ tejo, ‘Metii.’ ”

English: Then Jael Heber's wife took a nail of the tent, and took an hammer in her hand, and went softly unto him, and smote the nail into his temples, and fastened it into the ground: for he was fast asleep and weary. So he died.
Masaai: Kake eewa apa Yael ina kitok e Heberi encheitoi o Lng'obor, neya enyuntu te nkaina enye, nelo ninye aakutiti, neoshoki encheitoi eseder enye nepudaki enkop, kaae neye ninye te nauri.

English: And, behold, as Barak pursued Sisera, Jael came out to meet him, and said unto him, Come, and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest. And when he came into her tent, behold, Sisera lay dead, and the nail was in his temples.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura ore esujita Barak Sisera nelo Yael anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye, “Wou maaitoduaa ilo tung'ani ligira aing'oru.” Nelo ninye atua olng'obor lenye, neirrag Sisera te ine etua, etii encheitoi o lng'obor olpura le nkomom enye.

English: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku ore apa ina olong etimira Enkai Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And the hand of the children of Israel prospered, and prevailed against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
Masaai: Netum enkaina oo ltung'ana le Israel engolon oleng ti alo Yabin ilo aiguanani le Kanaan, o metaba anaa neidaikie Yabin olaiguanani le Kanaan.

English: Then sang Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam on that day, saying,
Masaai: Ore apa ina olong nerany Debora o Barak olayioni le Abinoam.

English: Praise ye the LORD for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki natijing'a ilkituaak dukuya te Israel, ore enkaraki naitayutuo iltung'ana ate te yieunoto, meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: “Entoning intae Laaiguanak, enchoru enkiok, lo kituaak; Olaitoriani nanu aranyaki, kaoshoki nanu olkerempe, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: LORD, when thou wentest out of Seir, when thou marchedst out of the field of Edom, the earth trembled, and the heavens dropped, the clouds also dropped water.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani, ore ishomo iyie aaing'uaa Seir, nilo iyie te nkop e Edom, neikirikira enkop, neitong'u shumata, ee, neitong'u inkatambo enkare.

English: The mountains melted from before the LORD, even that Sinai from before the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani, lido Sinai te dukuya Enkai e Israel.

English: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
Masaai: “Ore apa too nkolong'i e Shamgar, olayioni le Anat, ore apa too nkolong'i e Yael, eishunye ilapuayak, ore lelo oopuaya neim embata oo nkoitoi.

English: The inhabitants of the villages ceased, they ceased in Israel, until that I Deborah arose, that I arose a mother in Israel.
Masaai: Eishunye iloing'ok te Israel, eishunye ninche o metaba anaa nilotu iyie Debora alotu anaa ng'otonye te Israel.

English: They chose new gods; then was war in the gates: was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel?
Masaai: Te negeluni apa kulie aitin, neaku nchomito etii olarrabal, Amaa, ketumi apa elong'o anaa empere ti atua nkalifuni artam te Israel?

English: My heart is toward the governors of Israel, that offered themselves willingly among the people. Bless ye the LORD.
Masaai: Eipirta oltau lai ilarikok le njore e Israel, lelo apa ooitayutuo ate te yieunoto ti alo iltung'ana. Meisisi Olaitoriani.

English: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
Masaai: “Embalunye ninye, intae ilooked isirkon barrikon, intae ilootonie ilmukekani oogol enkinyiang'a, o intae iloopuo te nkoitoi.

English: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.
Masaai: Ore too ltoiloishi loo laranyak, too wuejitin oo nkariak, ore te ine nelikioo aaigil nkisulat o Laitoriani, enkisulata oo loing'ok lenye ti atua Israel. “Neruko aadoyio aaim nchomito iltung'ana lo Laitoriani.

English: Awake, awake, Deborah: awake, awake, utter a song: arise, Barak, and lead thy captivity captive, thou son of Abinoam.
Masaai: “Inyo, Inyo, Debora! Inyo, inyo taranya osinkolio! Tudumunye, Barak, toriko lelo litarayie, La ayioni le Abinoam.

English: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people: the LORD made me have dominion over the mighty.
Masaai: Nedoyio aapuo ilo pisiai loo lkituaak; neruko aadoyio iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, te nkaraki ninye, aapuo aarare lelo magil.

English: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki Efraim nepuonu ninche aaipang'u nejing oerata, kisujita iyie Benchamen tenebo iltung'ana linono; ore te Makir neruko ilkituaak aapuo, ore te Sebulon neruko aapuo lelo oonap esiare o larikoni.

English: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah; even Issachar, and also Barak: he was sent on foot into the valley. For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart.
Masaai: Eetuo ilkituaak le Isaakar te nebo Debora, o Isaakar oisiligayu te Barak; atua ilo erata ekuetikitia aasuj ninye. Ore ti atua ilgilat le Ruben netii apa eoro sapuk.

English: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds, to hear the bleatings of the flocks? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee itotona too ntare ijo pee ining nkisulat oo ntare? Ore ti atua ilgilat le Ruben netii eoro sapuk eitu emut tenaa keidim aaetu.

English: Gilead abode beyond Jordan: and why did Dan remain in ships? Asher continued on the sea shore, and abode in his breaches.
Masaai: Etotona Gilead te lido kekun Yordan; oo Dan, kainyoo pee etotona ninye too melin? Etotona Asheri aitirring'a to lomanaa le naiposha, neton abik te nedounyeki.

English: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.
Masaai: Ore Sebulon naa olorere otipika enkishui batisho o metabaiki keeya neijia sii etiu Naftali, too neerupa ti ong'ata.

English: The kings came and fought, then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo; they took no gain of money.
Masaai: “Eetuo ilaiguanak, neitayu olarrabal; nearare ilaiguanak le Kanaan, te Taanak, te mbata oo nkariak e Megido; neitu ninche etum iyarunot e nkosholai.

English: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
Masaai: Ore te shumata keper etarate ilakir, ore epuoito ninche nearare Sisera.

English: The river of Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. O my soul, thou hast trodden down strength.
Masaai: Ore ilo keju le Kishon onang'ari neya ninche, ina are naisarrisar, olkeju le Kishon. Lo tau lai, shomo dukuya te ngolon.

English: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings, the pransings of their mighty ones.
Masaai: “Neitayu oltoilo le ndarata nkejek oo mbartan, engorori, aang'orori mbartan o larrabal.

English: Curse ye Meroz, said the angel of the LORD, curse ye bitterly the inhabitants thereof; because they came not to the help of the LORD, to the help of the LORD against the mighty.
Masaai: “Tediaa Meros, neijia ejo olmalaika lo Laitoriani, tediaa te nduaran lelo oo manya ninye, amu eitu ninche epuonu aaretu Olaitoriani, aapuonu aaretu Olaitoriani earare lelo magil.

English: Blessed above women shall Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite be, blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
Masaai: “Emayiana Yael aisul too nkituaak, ina kitok e Heber loo Lkeni, emayiana aisul ti atua nena kituaak naamanya lng'oborri.

English: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
Masaai: Eikilikuanua ninye enkare neisho ninye kule, eyaka ninye kule naaoto te ngirra e nkitoo.

English: She put her hand to the nail, and her right hand to the workmen's hammer; and with the hammer she smote Sisera, she smote off his head, when she had pierced and stricken through his temples.
Masaai: Etipika ninye enkaina enye encheitoi o lng'obor, ore te enkaina enye e tatene neibung enyuntu o laisiaayiani, neosh ninye Sisera, nedany endukuya enye, neud eseder enye.

English: At her feet he bowed, he fell, he lay down: at her feet he bowed, he fell: where he bowed, there he fell down dead.
Masaai: Eirruge ninye nebatata, neirrag ninye too nkejek e Yael; too nkejek enyena eirruge neirrag, ore ine neirrugore neirrag etua.

English: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?
Masaai: “Te lusie ninye eturumishe, neishir ng'otonye e Sisera erumisho te lusie, ‘Kainyoo pee eimutie engarri enye oo mbartan eitu elotu? Kainyoo pee eimutie oltoilo loo nkejek oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan?’

English: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
Masaai: Ore nena kituaak enyena ng'eni newaliki, A-a, etawalikia ninye kewan,

English: Have they not sped? have they not divided the prey; to every man a damsel or two; to Sisera a prey of divers colours, a prey of divers colours of needlework, of divers colours of needlework on both sides, meet for the necks of them that take the spoil?
Masaai: ‘Aimetumito neorita nena naataarutua, neya ake oltung'ani entito nabo aashu are; ore te Sisera naa inkilani oomuain kumok, inkilani naaikodo, mpukunot are oomuain naaikodo te murt ai anaa iyarunot?’

English: So let all thine enemies perish, O LORD: but let them that love him be as the sun when he goeth forth in his might. And the land had rest forty years.
Masaai: “Meidaa aaiko neijia ilmang'ati linono Olaitoriani! Kake ore ilchoreta nchoo eilepu anaa enkolong eilepu te ngolon enye.” Netum apa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam.

English: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
Masaai: Etaasa apa iltung'ana le Israel entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua nkaik e Midian ilarin oopishana.

English: And the hand of Midian prevailed against Israel: and because of the Midianites the children of Israel made them the dens which are in the mountains, and caves, and strong holds.
Masaai: Netum enkaina e Midian engolon alang Israel; ore te nkaraki Midian neitaiki iltung'ana le Israel ate ngumot too ldoinyo, o nkapuniaa o sempewueti.

English: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up against them;
Masaai: Amu ore ake enkata pooki naun Isiraeli ilanterera, nepuonu Ilmidian o Ilmaleki o iltung'ana lo loo saen aarasaki ninche;

English: And they encamped against them, and destroyed the increase of the earth, till thou come unto Gaza, and left no sustenance for Israel, neither sheep, nor ox, nor ass.
Masaai: nepuonu ninche aaitayu ilng'oborri aarare ninche neinyal nena daiki naatuunoki, o metabaiki elatia enye Gasa, neing'uaa Israel metii endaa, nemetii enker aashu olkiteng aashu osikiria.

English: For they came up with their cattle and their tents, and they came as grasshoppers for multitude; for both they and their camels were without number: and they entered into the land to destroy it.
Masaai: Amu kepuonu apa ninche te nebo nkishu enye o lng'oborri lenye, nepuonu eba anaa olmaati te nkumoi; ore ninche o ntamesin enye meikenayu, neaku keinyal apa enkop te nepuonu.

English: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitadou apa Midian Israel oleng,

English: And it came to pass, when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD because of the Midianites,
Masaai: neishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani te nkaraki Ilmidian,

English: That the LORD sent a prophet unto the children of Israel, which said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I brought you up from Egypt, and brought you forth out of the house of bondage;
Masaai: neirriwaki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel oloiboni; nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Atorikoyie apa nanu intae ailepunye aitung'uaa Misiri, naipang'unye intae te nkaji esinkaisho;

English: And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all that oppressed you, and drave them out from before you, and gave you their land;
Masaai: nakordu intae te nkaina oo Lmisiri o te nkaina e lelo pooki ooibooki intae enkop, naaraa ninche te dukuya intae, naisho intae enkop enye;

English: And I said unto you, I am the LORD your God; fear not the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but ye have not obeyed my voice.
Masaai: najoki nanu intae, ‘Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; mintokiki intae aayanyitu inkaitin oo Lamori, laa atua enkop enye imanyanya!’ Kake eitu intae ining'ining'i oltoilo lai.”

English: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
Masaai: Nelotu apa olmalaika lo Laitoriani neton ti abori olchani te Ofra, apa laa ole Yoash Olabiesiri, ina kata apa eidong'ito olayioni lenye Gideon enkano te nkironyet oo sabibu, ejo pee eisudoo tenkaraki Ilmidian.

English: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
Masaai: Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye nejoki, “Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie, iyie oloing'oni magilani.”

English: And Gideon said unto him, Oh my Lord, if the LORD be with us, why then is all this befallen us? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of, saying, Did not the LORD bring us up from Egypt? but now the LORD hath forsaken us, and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites.
Masaai: Nejoki Gideon ninye, “Aatoomono, olkitok, amaa tenaa ketii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook, kainyoo naa pee etadoikitio kuna iyiook pooki? Naa koree nkiasin enyena pooki e nking'asia apa naainosakitia iyiook iloo papa, ejo, ‘Keitu ninye eilepunye iyiook Olaitoriani aitung'uaa Misiri?’ Kake ore taata eiturrayie iyiook Olaitoriani neishooyie iyiook apik atua nkaik oo Lmidian.”

English: And the LORD looked upon him, and said, Go in this thy might, and thou shalt save Israel from the hand of the Midianites: have not I sent thee?
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani ninye nejoki, “Shomo tena magilanisho ino tokordu Israel te nkaina e Midian; aime nanu laairriwayie?”

English: And he said unto him, Oh my Lord, wherewith shall I save Israel? behold, my family is poor in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Aatoomono, Olaitoriani, kaji nanu aiko te nakordu Israel? Ng'ura, ajo ore olgilata lang naa ninye oloti te Manase, naa nanu oloti lo lmarei lang.”

English: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Ee, kake atii nanu te nebo iyie, naa iosh iyie Ilmidian anaa oltung'ani obo.”

English: And he said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, then shew me a sign that thou talkest with me.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Tenaa taata kanoto omom te iyie, ntoduaaki naa olmonekie inchere iyie doi ilo likirorie nanu.

English: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
Masaai: Milo iyie aing'uaa ene, aatoomono, o metaba anaa nalotu nanu enitii, pee ayau enkishoroto ai, nairragie te dukuya iyie.” Nejo ninye, “Katon nanu o metaba anaa nishukunye.”

English: And Gideon went in, and made ready a kid, and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour: the flesh he put in a basket, and he put the broth in a pot, and brought it out unto him under the oak, and presented it.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Gideon enkaji enye neyieng olkuoo, neitobir imukateni neitu eisuijieki e nkurma; nepik nkiri atua enkikapu, nepik imotori atua emoti, neyaki ninye ti abori olchani, neitarasaki ninche.

English: And the angel of God said unto him, Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes, and lay them upon this rock, and pour out the broth. And he did so.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Ntayu nena kiri o nena mukateni neitu eisuijieki tipika ninche enchumata ena dapidapoi nibukoki imotori shumata ninche.” Neiko ninye neijia.

English: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aitorioo ina ng'udi apa natii enkaina enye, neiseyie nena kiri o nena mukateni apa neitu eisuijieki; neipang'u enkima teine te ndapidapoi neinos nena kiri o nena mukateni neitu eisuijieki; neimin ilo malaika lo Laitoriani too nkonyek enyena.

English: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O Lord GOD! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.
Masaai: Nemusu taa Gideon inchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye; nejo Gideon, “Oi nanu, Olaitoriani Enkai! Amu atoduare nanu olmalaika lo Laitoriani king'ura too nkomomi.”

English: And the LORD said unto him, Peace be unto thee; fear not: thou shalt not die.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani ninye, “Metaa eseriani te nebo iyie, miureishoyu, miye iyie.”

English: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Masaai: Neshetaki Gideon te ine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar, nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani eseriani.” Ore ebaiki ena olong neton eitashe ilo perere te Ofra nara enoo Ilabiesi.

English: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Take thy father's young bullock, even the second bullock of seven years old, and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath, and cut down the grove that is by it:
Masaai: Ore ina kewarie nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Iwa oloing'oni li are le papaai lino, ilo oing'oni le papaai lino loo larin oopishana, niuroki enkop ilo perere lo lasar le Baal oata papaai lino, nidung ina Ashera natii embata enye;

English: And build an altar unto the LORD thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
Masaai: nishet olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ino te nchumata o sempewuet tene, nirragie isoito aitobiraki, niyau ilo oing'oni li are nintaa olasar opejori te nena keek e ina Ashera nidung meirraga te nkop.”

English: Then Gideon took ten men of his servants, and did as the LORD had said unto him: and so it was, because he feared his father's household, and the men of the city, that he could not do it by day, that he did it by night.
Masaai: Neya Gideon iltung'ana tomon te lelo aisiaayiak lenyena, neas anaa enatiaka Olaitoriani ninye, kake ore amu keure apa aataas dama te nkaraki olmarei lenye, o lelo tung'ana le ina ang, etaasa apa ninye ina kewarie.

English: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning, behold, the altar of Baal was cast down, and the grove was cut down that was by it, and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built.
Masaai: Ore pee einyototo iltung'ana te ina ang tadekenya enasirie ng'ura etigilaki olperere lo lasar le Baal, ore ina Ashera apa natii embata enye netudung'oki meirraga te nkop, ore ilo oing'oni li are neitaaki olasar te nchumata e ilo perere lo lasar oteshetaki.

English: And they said one to another, Who hath done this thing? And when they enquired and asked, they said, Gideon the son of Joash hath done this thing.
Masaai: Nejokino ninche maate, “Kaing'ae otaasa ena?” Ore ake pee eidip aatakekenu neikilikuanu, nejo ninche, “Gideon olayioni le Yoash otaasa ena.”

English: Then the men of the city said unto Joash, Bring out thy son, that he may die: because he hath cast down the altar of Baal, and because he hath cut down the grove that was by it.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana te ina ang Yoash, “Mpang'unye olayioni lino, pee etum atua, amu etusulua ninye olperere lo lasar le Baal, netudung'o ina Ashera natashare.”

English: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
Masaai: Nejoki Yoash lelo pooki apa ooing'orunore ninye, “Ai Baal ing'oring'oro intae? Arashu orrekie lenye igolielie? Ore oloba anaa oloing'or ninye neyookini aar metua tadekenya. Tenaa ke nkai ninye nchoo eing'or kewan amu etusulayioki aauroo olperere lenye lo lasar.”

English: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
Masaai: Neaku ore ebaiki ina olong etaa keji ninye Yerubaal, aa taa, “Nchoo Baal eng'or agilunore ninye” amu etusulayie ninye auroo olperere lenye lo lasar.

English: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the children of the east were gathered together, and went over, and pitched in the valley of Jezreel.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Midian o le Amaleki o iltung'ana le nkalo o loo saen aaipotuno te nebo, nelang'u Yordan neshet ilng'oborri to oerata le Yesereel.

English: But the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet; and Abiezer was gathered after him.
Masaai: Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Gideon, neosh ninye entarumpeta neipotuni iltung'ana le Abiesiri metusujai ninye.

English: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku meshomo atua Manase pooki, neipotuni sii ninche metusujai ninche. Neitoki airriwaa ilkiliku meshomo Asheri, o Sebulon, o Naftali neilep ninche aapuo aanang'are ninche.

English: And Gideon said unto God, If thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said,
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon ajoki Enkai, “Tenaa eikordu iyie Israel te nkaina ai anaa enitejo,

English: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
Masaai: ng'ura, kairragie nanu endapana enker te wueji neidong'ieki enkano; ore ake pee ejing enkoleelio endapana ake, netoyio enkae wueji pooki, nayiolou taa ajo ikordu iyie Israel te nkaina ai, anaa enitejo iyie.”

English: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
Masaai: Netiu neijia. Ore ake pee einyototo ninye tadekenya enasirie neirony ina dapana, neironyu enkoileelio naiputa olbakuli enkare.

English: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon ajoki Enkai, “Mincho iyie engoro ino eyupuyup ti alo nanu, kake nchooki nanu mairoro ena kata nabo ake, aatoomono, nchooki nanu manyaaki atem ena kata nabo endapana; aatoomono, nchoo endapana ake metoyio, ore enkae kop pooki nchoo ejing enkoileelio.”

English: And God did so that night: for it was dry upon the fleece only, and there was dew on all the ground.
Masaai: Neiko Enkai neijia ina kewarie; amu etoyio apa endapana ake, ore enkop pooki nejing enkoileelio.

English: Then Jerubbaal, who is Gideon, and all the people that were with him, rose up early, and pitched beside the well of Harod: so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them, by the hill of Moreh, in the valley.
Masaai: Neitoki Yerubaal (aa taa Gideon) o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye aadumunye tadekenya nepuo aaitayu ilng'oborri te mbata enchorro e Harod; netii apa ilng'oborri le Midian moikuape enye, embata oldoinyo le More, ti atua oerata.

English: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Eikumok kulo tung'ana ootii te nebo iyie te nanu, te naishoru ile Midian apik atua nkaik enye, mewuasayu ake Israel ti alo nanu, ejo, ‘Enkaina ai makewan naatokordua nanu.

English: Now therefore go to, proclaim in the ears of the people, saying, Whosoever is fearful and afraid, let him return and depart early from mount Gilead. And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand; and there remained ten thousand.
Masaai: Ore naa taata mbalunye too nkiyiaa oo ltung'ana, tejo, ore pooki ng'ae otureishe neikirikira, nchoo ninye eshuko alo ang.’ ” Netem Gideon ninche, neshuko iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oare, neleku iltung'ana tomon.

English: And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people are yet too many; bring them down unto the water, and I will try them for thee there: and it shall be, that of whom I say unto thee, This shall go with thee, the same shall go with thee; and of whomsoever I say unto thee, This shall not go with thee, the same shall not go.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Eton aa kumok kulo tung'ana oleng; toriko ninche metadoi aapuo enkare pee atem nanu ninche te ine; ore olaajoki nanu, ‘Kelo ele tung'ani te nebo iyie,’ nelo te nebo iyie, ore oloba anaa olaajoki, ‘Melo ele tung'ani te nebo iyie’, melo ninye.”

English: So he brought down the people unto the water: and the LORD said unto Gideon, Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue, as a dog lappeth, him shalt thou set by himself; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink.
Masaai: Nerik ninye iltung'ana enkare; nejoki Olaitoriani Gideon, “Ore pooki oilab enkare to lng'ejep lenye, anaa enailab oldia, taaraki ninye enkalo nabo, neijia ake sii nkuna ilo ogil kung aok enkare.”

English: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
Masaai: Ore esiana e lelo ooilap enkare, epik nkaik enye nkutukie enye naa iltung'ana iip uni; kake ore ilkulikae tung'ana pooki negil kung aaok enkare.

English: And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Gideon, “Ore te lelo tung'ana iip uni ooilap enkare naa kakordu nanu intae napik iltung'ana le Midian atua inkaik inyi; naa nchoo lelo kulikae tung'ana meshomo pooki tung'ani enkang enye.”

English: So the people took victuals in their hand, and their trumpets: and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent, and retained those three hundred men: and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley.
Masaai: Neya ninye iltooi le lelo tung'ana o ntarumpetani too nkaik enye, neisho ninye lelo kulikae pooki le Israel meshomo ake oltung'ani olng'obor lenye, kake eiboo lelo tung'ana apa iip uni; netii apa ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Midian abori ninye to erata.

English: And it came to pass the same night, that the LORD said unto him, Arise, get thee down unto the host; for I have delivered it into thine hand.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kewarie nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tudumunye shomo tadoi taara enkang oo lng'oborri, amu aishorua nanu apik enkaina ino.

English: But if thou fear to go down, go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host:
Masaai: Kake ti niure iyie ashomo, tadoi shomo ina ang oo lng'oborri te nebo Pura, osinka lino;

English: And thou shalt hear what they say; and afterward shall thine hands be strengthened to go down unto the host. Then went he down with Phurah his servant unto the outside of the armed men that were in the host.
Masaai: amu ilo iyie aning enejo ninche; ore te siadi ina nikigolu oshoke pee ilo arasaki lelo ng'oborri.” Nedoyio ninye alo te nebo Pura, ilo sinka lenye, nepuo enetii iltung'ana oobayie ooata imasaa olarrabal le lelo ng'oborri.

English: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude; and their camels were without number, as the sand by the sea side for multitude.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Midian o le Maleki o ltung'ana pooki lo loo saen neirrag to erata eba anaa olmaati te nkumoi; ore ntamesin enye nemeikenayu, eba anaa osinyai le nkiyopata e naiposha te nkumoi.

English: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Gideon, ng'ura etii oltung'ani oinosaki ole ncholiek enye enkidetidet; nejoki, “Ng'ura aidetidetua nanu emukate natadoikio atua enkang oo lng'oborri le Midian, nelotu olng'obor obo, neosh neibelekeny airragie ti oriong, neaku tenkop eirrag ilo ng'obor.”

English: And his fellow answered and said, This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel: for into his hand hath God delivered Midian, and all the host.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo oboitare ajoki, “Mme likae ele leme olalem le Gideon olayioni le Yoash, oltung'ani le Israel; atua enkaina enye etipika Enkai Midian o lorora lenye pooki.”

English: And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Gideon elimunoto e ina kidetidet o empukunoto enye, neserem; neshuko alo ilng'oborri le Israel, nejo, “Entudumunye, amu eishorua Olaitoriani ilo orora le Midian apik atua enkaina inyi.”

English: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
Masaai: Neor ninye lelo tung'ana iip uni aitaa ilturrurri okuni, nepik intarumpetani nkaik enye pooki, o iltooi lemetii enkare, nepik ilkilang'ilang'eta ti atua nena tooi.

English: And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Eng'uraki nanu, niasiasa enaas; te nalotu nanu auluo e nkang oo lng'oborri entaas anaa enaas nanu.

English: When I blow with a trumpet, I and all that are with me, then blow ye the trumpets also on every side of all the camp, and say, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
Masaai: Te naosh nanu entarumpeta, nanu o lelo pooki ootii te nebo nanu, entoosh sii intae intarumpetani te pooki shoto e nkang oo lng'oborri, nibuakuku aajo, ‘Te nkaraki Olaitoriani o te nkaraki Gideon.’ ”

English: So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.
Masaai: Nelotu Gideon o lelo tung'ana iip apa ootii te nebo ninye auluo e nkang oo lng'oborri te mpolos e nkewarie, ina kata ake pee eibelekenya ilarripok, nekut ninche intarumpetani, nedany lelo tooiapa ootii nkaik enye.

English: And the three companies blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers, and held the lamps in their left hands, and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal: and they cried, The sword of the LORD, and of Gideon.
Masaai: Neosh lelo turrurri okuni intarumopetani nedany lelo tooi; neibung too nkaik enye e kedienye inkilang'ilang'eta; ore too nkaik enye e tatene neibung'ita intarumpetani pee eosh; nebuaku ninche aajo, “Olalem lo Laitoriani o Gideon!”

English: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp: and all the host ran, and cried, and fled.
Masaai: Neitashe ninche oltung'ani ake te wueji enye emanita ina ang oo lng'oborri, nekuet ina jore pooki, neyietu aaishir, neisik.

English: And the three hundred blew the trumpets, and the LORD set every man's sword against his fellow, even throughout all the host: and the host fled to Bethshittah in Zererath, and to the border of Abelmeholah, unto Tabbath.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eosh nena tarumpetani iip uni neiuloki Olaitoriani olalem ake lo ltung'ani olikae tung'ani o enjore pooki; neisik ina jore o meshomo Betshita enkalo e Serera, o metabaiki olpolosie le Abel-mehola, te mbata e Tabat.

English: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali, and out of Asher, and out of all Manasseh, and pursued after the Midianites.
Masaai: Neipotuni iltung'ana le Israel te Naftali o te Asheri o te Manase pooki metusujai aamir iltung'ana le Midian.

English: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Gideon ilkiliku aibulunye ina kop pooki oo ldoinyo e Efraim, ejo, “Entadou wootu mataarare iltung'ana le Midian, nimbung'ubung'u nena ariak ebaiki Betbara o Yordan.” Neipotuni iltung'ana pooki le Efraim, neibung ninche nkariak ebaiki Betbara, o Yordan sii.

English: And they took two princes of the Midianites, Oreb and Zeeb; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb, and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb, and pursued Midian, and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan.
Masaai: Neya ninche lelo kituaak pokira oare le Midian, Oreb o Seeb; near ninche Oreb metua te ndapidapoi e Oreb, ore Seeb near metua te nkironyet oo sabibu e Seeb, ina kata esujita ninche iltung'ana le Midian; neyau ninche ilukuny e Oreb o Seeb enetii Gideon telido keku le Yordan.

English: And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Efraim ninye, “Kainyoo ena nintaasa iyie iyiook, eitu impot iyiook te nilo aarare Midian?” Neilepilepaki ninye oleng.

English: And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaa nanu ataasa te naaitanyaanyukieki intae? Aimesidan ilekunot oo sabibu le Efraim alang enkisampuare e Abisi?

English: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb: and what was I able to do in comparison of you? Then their anger was abated toward him, when he had said that.
Masaai: Eishorua Enkai apik atua inkaik inyi lelo kituaak le Midian, Oreb o Seeb: kaa nanu aaidim ataasa te naaitanyaanyukieki intae?” Neyagaa taa engoro enye apa natagorokinote apa ninye, ina kata pee ejo neijia.

English: And Gideon came to Jordan, and passed over, he, and the three hundred men that were with him, faint, yet pursuing them.
Masaai: Nelotu Gideon Yordan nelang alo lido kekun, ninye o lelo tung'ana iip uni apa ootii te nebo ninye, enaurate nesujita ake olmang'atinta.

English: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
Masaai: Neaku etiaka apa ninye lelo tung'ana le Sukot, “Atoomono intae, enchoo sii ake endaa kulo tung'ana laasujita nanu, amu etaa keiterre, nasujita nanu Seba o Salmuna, lelo aiguanak le Midian.”

English: And the princes of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thine army?
Masaai: Nejo lelo kituaak le Sukot, “Keidipa Seba o Salmuna aatijing atua enkaina ino metaa eji eikincho iyiook endaa enjore ino?”

English: And Gideon said, Therefore when the LORD hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.
Masaai: Nejo Gideon, “Ore te nkaraki ena, ore akenya te nelo nepik Olaitoriani Seba o Salmuna enkaina ai nayiet nanu iseseni linyi too ikiku lo lpurkel o te ntamejoi.”

English: And he went up thence to Penuel, and spake unto them likewise: and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him.
Masaai: Nedumunye te ine nelo Penuel, neirorie iltung'ana te ine te ina oitoi; newaliki iltung'ana le Penuel ninye anaa apa enatawalikitia iltung'ana le Sukot.

English: And he spake also unto the men of Penuel, saying, When I come again in peace, I will break down this tower.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Penuel, “Ore te naitoki ashukunye te seriani nagil ele talet asulu.”

English: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor, and their hosts with them, about fifteen thousand men, all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east: for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword.
Masaai: Netii apa Seba o Salmuna Karkor te nebo enjore enye, iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni tomon o imiet, lelo pooki apa ootelekuaki te njore pooki oo ltung'ana lo loosaen; amu etabatatate apa iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o tikitam ooata lalema.

English: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host: for the host was secure.
Masaai: Neilep apa Gideon aim enkoitoi naim intamesin to loosaen le Neba o Yogbeha nerasaki ina jore; amu merripo apa ina jore.

English: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled, he pursued after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and discomfited all the host.
Masaai: Neisik Seba o Salmuna; nemir ninye ninche neibung lelo aiguanak pokira oare le Midian, Seba o Salmuna, nepik ninye ina jore pooki olkirutoto.

English: And Gideon the son of Joash returned from battle before the sun was up,
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon olayioni le Yoash ashukunye to larrabal aimu embata e nkilepunoto e Heresi.

English: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth, and enquired of him: and he described unto him the princes of Succoth, and the elders thereof, even threescore and seventeen men.
Masaai: Neibung olbarnoti le Sukot, neikilikuanishore ninye, neigeroki ilo barnoti ninye ilkituaak loo lpayiani le Sukot, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana o opishana.

English: And he came unto the men of Succoth, and said, Behold Zebah and Zalmunna, with whom ye did upbraid me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna now in thine hand, that we should give bread unto thy men that are weary?
Masaai: Nelotu ninye enetii iltung'ana le Sukot, nejoki, “Eng'ura Seba o Salmuna, laa ninche apa kinkorojie nanu ijojo, ‘Keidipa Seba o Salmuna, aatijing atua enkaina ino pee kitum aaishoo endaa lelo tung'ana linono ooiterre?’ ”

English: And he took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
Masaai: Neya ninye ilpayiani le ina anasa neya ilkiku lo lpurkel o entamejoi neiteng'enie ninche iltung'ana le Sukot.

English: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
Masaai: Negil ninye asulu oltapeet le Penuel, nesesekuan iltung'ana le ina anasa.

English: Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki Seba o Salmuna, “Koree apa iltung'ana litasesekuana te Tabor?” Newal ninche, “Anaa eninkununo iyie, neijia apa eikununo ninche, oltung'ani ake te ninche; kenyaanyukie apa ninche ilayiok lo laiguanani.”

English: And he said, They were my brethren, even the sons of my mother: as the LORD liveth, if ye had saved them alive, I would not slay you.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ilalashara laainei apa ninche, ilayiok le yieyio; ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, tenaa apa eintajeutuo ninche aaitopok, anaata nanu masesekuan intae.”

English: And he said unto Jether his firstborn, Up, and slay them. But the youth drew not his sword: for he feared, because he was yet a youth.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Yeter olkikau lenye, “Tudumunye tasesekuana ninche.” Kake eitu apa eshutu ilo barnoti olalem lenye; amu eturia, enkaraki apa neton aa olbarnoti.

English: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Rise thou, and fall upon us: for as the man is, so is his strength. And Gideon arose, and slew Zebah and Zalmunna, and took away the ornaments that were on their camels' necks.
Masaai: Neitoki Seba o Salmuna aajo, “Tudumunye makewan tadoiki iyiook: amu ore anaa enatiu oltung'ani, naa neijia etiu engolon enye.” Nedumunye Gideon nesesekuan Seba o Salmuna, neya nena masaa apa naatii imurto o ntamesin enye.

English: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon, Rule thou over us, both thou, and thy son, and thy son's son also: for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aajoki Gideon, “Ntoria iyiook, iyie o layioni o layioni lo layioni lino, amu itokordua iyiook aitayu te nkaina e Midian.”

English: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.
Masaai: Nejoki Gideon ninche, “Maitore nanu intae, nemeitore intae olayioni lai; Olaitoriani ninye oitore intae.”

English: And Gideon said unto them, I would desire a request of you, that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey. (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
Masaai: Neitoki Gideon ajoki ninche, “Enchooki nanu matoomono intae nabo toki; enchooki nanu pooki ng'ae te intae ilgiso loo nkiyiaa apa liwaita le lelo tung'ana litaara.” (Amu eeta apa ninche ilgiso loo nkiyaa le sahabu, enkaraki naa ile Ishmael.)

English: And they answered, We will willingly give them. And they spread a garment, and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey.
Masaai: Newal ninche aajo, “Eikinchoru iyiook te nyorrata.” Neisalaash ninche olkila, nenang'aki ine pooki tung'ani lelo giso loo nkiyiaa apa ooyaua.

English: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold; beside ornaments, and collars, and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian, and beside the chains that were about their camels' necks.
Masaai: Ore enkiroishi e lelo giso loo nkiyiaa le sahabu apa ootoomonuo naa shekeli e sahabu enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana, te nebo imasaa o nkilani sinteti apa naaishopito lelo kituaak le Midian o lkataarri apa ootii imurto oo ntamesin enye.

English: And Gideon made an ephod thereof, and put it in his city, even in Ophrah: and all Israel went thither a whoring after it: which thing became a snare unto Gideon, and to his house.
Masaai: Neitayunye Gideon enkila dorrop nepik ninye enkanasa enye makewan, Ofra; neloloito Israel pooki te ninye, neaku orreshet te Gideon o to lmarei lenye.

English: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel, so that they lifted up their heads no more. And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon.
Masaai: Neaku etimira apa iltung'ana le Israel Midian, neitu ae kata eigil aairish ninche. Netum apa enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin artam too nkolong'i e Gideon.

English: And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house.
Masaai: Nelo apa Yerubaal olayioni le Yoash aton te nkaji enye.

English: And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten: for he had many wives.
Masaai: Neeta apa Gideon ilayiok ntomoni naapishana, inot lenyena, amu keeta apa nkituaak kumok.

English: And his concubine that was in Shechem, she also bare him a son, whose name he called Abimelech.
Masaai: Ore apa enkapiani enye natii Shekem neiu sii ninye olayioni, neji enkarna enye Abimelek.

English: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age, and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
Masaai: Neye apa Gideon olayioni le Yoash etaa moruo oleng, nenukari ninye te nkurare e Yoash papaai lenye, te Ofra oo Labiesi.

English: And it came to pass, as soon as Gideon was dead, that the children of Israel turned again, and went a whoring after Baalim, and made Baalberith their god.
Masaai: Erisio ake etua Gideon, neibelekenya iltung'ana le Israel aaloloito aasujaa inkaitin e Baal, neitaa Baal-berit enkai enye.

English: And the children of Israel remembered not the LORD their God, who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side:
Masaai: Neitu eitoki iltung'ana le Israel aadamu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninye apa otokordua ninche aitayu te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenye pooki te pooki shoto:

English: Neither shewed they kindness to the house of Jerubbaal, namely, Gideon, according to all the goodness which he had shewed unto Israel.
Masaai: neitu ninche eitaas isidain olmarei le Yerubaal (aa taa Gideon) te nkaraki nena pooki sidain naaitaasa ninye Israel.

English: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
Masaai: Nelo apa Abimelek olayioni le Yerubaal Shekem, enetii ilalashera ng'otonye nejoki ninche o lgilata pooki lo lmarei le ng'otonye,

English: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
Masaai: “Entejo too nkiyiaa e kulo oomanya Shekem, ‘Kaa naikash te intae, te neitore intae ilayiok pokira ntomoni naapishana anaa te neitore intae obo?’ Entadamu sii aajo ara nanu oloito linyi o erubata inyi.”

English: And his mother's brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
Masaai: Neiro ilalashera ng'otonye kulo rorei pooki te rishata enye too inkiyiaa oo ltung'ana pooki te Shekem: neng'amaa iltauja lenye pee esujaa Abimelek, amu etejo ninche, “Olalashe lang ninye.”

English: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baalberith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
Masaai: Neisho ninche ninye mpisai e nkosholai ntomoni naapishana naaig'uaa enkaji e Baal-berit, naa ninche eigerie Abimelek iltung'ana le pesho arruok, apa ootusuja ninye.

English: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
Masaai: Nelo ninye enkaji e papaai lenye te Ofra nesesekuan ilalashera lenyena, lelo ayiok le Yerubaal, pokira ntomoni naapishana, te nchumata osoit obo; kake etelekuaki apa Yotam olayioni oti le Yerubaal, amu eisudoyie kewan.

English: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
Masaai: Neiturrurrunye lelo oomanya Shekem te nebo, o Bet-milo pooki, nepuo ninche neitaa Abimelek olaiguanani, te mbata o lchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli le ng'ape te Shekem.

English: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, ye men of Shechem, that God may hearken unto you.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Yotam, nelo ninye aitashe te nchumata o ldoinyo le Gerisim, neyietu aishir nejoki ninche, “Entoning'oki nanu lo tung'ana le Shekem, pee etum Enkai atoning'o intae.

English: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign thou over us.
Masaai: Eshomo apa ilkeek aagelaki ate olaiguanani, nejoki ninche oltamiyoi, ‘Ntoria iyiook.’

English: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tamiyioi ninche, ‘Kaing'uaa nanu eilata ai naa ninye eyanyitieki nkaitin o ltung'ana, nalo alimana ti atua ilkeek?’

English: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come thou, and reign over us.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo keek olng'aboli, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.’

English: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo ng'aboli ninche, ‘Kalo nanu aing'uaa emeloni ai o lng'anayio ilai sidai nalo alimana too lkeek?’

English: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo keek osabibu, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.’

English: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo sabibu ninche,

English: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
Masaai: ‘Kalo nanu aing'uaa enaisho ai oo sabibu naa ninye naitiship nkaitin o ltung'ana alo alimana too lkeek?’ Nejoki ilkeek pooki olchani onyaanyukie olayakuji, ‘Wou iyie ntoria iyiook.

English: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo shani onyaanyukie olayakuji lelokeek, ‘Tinikibukokiki nanu eilata aaitaa olaiguanani maitoria intae, wootu naa entaseriana to loip lai; naa te neme neijia, nchoo meipang'u enkima te ilo shani loo lkiku nemut lelo tarakua le Lebanon.’

English: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
Masaai: “Ore naa taata, tenaa eitaasa apa intae te nkirukoto sidai o te nkanyit ina kata apa pee intaa intae Abimelek olaiguanani, naa tenintaasa apa intae esidai Yerubaal o enkaji enye, nintaasa intae ninye anaa enaishiaakino nkiaasin enyena

English: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
Masaai: amu etarishe papa te nkaraki intae, nepik enkishui enye batisho, nekordu intae aitung'uaa enkaina e Midian;

English: And ye are risen up against my father's house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
Masaai: nitudumakinote intae enkaji e papa aarare ena olong, nitasesekuana intae ilayiok lenyena, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana te nchumata osoit obo, nintaa Abimelek olayioni le nkapiani, olaiguanani oitore lelo oomanya Shekem, enkaraki naa olalashe linyi.

English: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
Masaai: Tenaa eitaasa apa te nkirukoto sidai o te nkanyit o Yerubaal o enkaji enye ena olong, enting'idakinoto naa Abimelek, naa nchoo sii ninye eng'idakino intae,

English: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
Masaai: kake te neme neijia, nchoo enkima epuku te Abimelek, nemut lelo oomanya Shekem o Bet-milo nemut Abimelek.”

English: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
Masaai: Nekuet Yotam aisik, nelo Beer-sheba nebik te ine, te nkaraki naure Abimelek olalashe lenye.

English: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel,
Masaai: Neitore Abimelek Israel ilarin okuni.

English: Then God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
Masaai: Neirriu Enkai oltau torrono erishata e Abimelek o lelo tung'ana le Shekem; ore lelo tung'ana le Shekem neitaas Abimelek te nkeleekisho;

English: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
Masaai: nchere ore ina torroni apa naitaasaki lelo ayiok pokira ntomoni naapishana le Yerubaal naa kelotu osarge lenye shumata Abimelek olalashe lenye, laa ninye apa otasesekuana ninche, o shumata lelo tung'ana le Shekem laa ninche apa ooitagolo nkaik enyena metesesekuana ilalashera lenyena.

English: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
Masaai: Nepik lelo tung'ana le Shekem iltung'ana olnukata pee ear ninye te nchumata o ldoinyo, neoru ninche ntokitin lelo pooki apa ootogiroitie ninche te nkoitoi, nelikini Abimelek.
