English: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
Masaai: Nelo apa Gaal olayioni le Ebed Shekem te nebo ilalashera lenyena, neisilig apa iltung'ana le Shekem ninye.

English: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
Masaai: Neipang ninche aapuo nkurman, nesotu ninche isabibu te nena kurman enye oo sabibu, neirony ninche, nenya osirua, nepuo atua enkaji e nkai enye, nedaa neokisho nedek Abimelek.

English: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
Masaai: Nejo Gaal olayioni le Ebed, “Kaing'ae Abimelek naa eikira iyiook nyoo ile Shekem, eji pee kisiaai ninye? Keitu eisiaai olayioni le Yerubaal o Sebul, olkitok lenye, iltung'ana le Hamori, menye le Shekem? Kainyoo naa pee kisiaai iyiook ninye?

English: And would to God this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase thine army, and come out.
Masaai: Tenaa naaji kaabori enkaina ai etii ele orere anaata aiwuang'ie Abimelek. Anaata ajoki Abimelek, ‘Toponai enjore ino, nimpang'u alotu.’ ”

English: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Sebul ilo apa laa ninye oitore enkanasa irorei le Gaal olayioni le Ebed, neyupuyup engoro enye.

English: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against thee.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku enetii Abimelek te Aruma, ejo, “Ng'ura, ore Gaal olayioni le Ebed o lalashera lenyena eetuo Shekem, neingolingola ninche enkanasa pee kiarare iyie.

English: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
Masaai: Ore naa taata, shomo kewarie, iyie o lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo iyie nirragirraga aanyu ti ong'ata.

English: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, thou shalt rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against thee, then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion.
Masaai: Ore te nkakenya, ore ake pee eng'oru enkolong iltiil, nidumunyenye aayooki nikuetikiki ina anasa; ore ake pee kimpang'aki ninye o lelo tung'ana ootii te nebo ninye aapuonu aarare, entaasa ninche anaa enaishiaakino.”

English: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
Masaai: Nedumunye Abimelek o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye kewarie, neirrag aanyisho pee earare Shekem too lturrurri oong'uan.

English: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
Masaai: Neipang Gaal olayioni le Ebed alo aitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi e nkanasa; nedumunye Abimelek o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye to lnukata.

English: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Gaal lelo tung'ana nejoki Sebul, “Ng'ura, edou iltung'ana aapuonu too nchumat oo ldoinyo!” Nejoki Sebul ninye, “Iloipi loo ldoinyo idol, nijo iltung'ana.”

English: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
Masaai: Neitoki Gaal airo nejo, “Ng'ura, edou iltung'ana aaing'uaa empolos e nkop, ore oltim obo nelotu aimu enkalo o lchani loo lamusok onyaanyukie olng'aboli.”

English: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now thy mouth, wherewith thou saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
Masaai: Neitoki Sebul ajoki ninye, “Koree naa taata enkutuk ino, iyie apa otejo ‘Kainyoo ninye Abimelek eji metaa eikisiaai ninye?’ Aime kulo tung'ana apa itemena? Mpang'a taata shomo taarare ninche.”

English: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
Masaai: Neipang Gaal alo ajing dukuya iltung'ana le Shekem nearare Abimelek.

English: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
Masaai: Nemir Abimelek ninye, neisik ninye te dukuya Abimelek, nebatata ilkumok ootipikaki ilbaa, o metabaiki enejing'ieki kishomi.

English: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
Masaai: Nebik Abimelek te Aruma; nearaa Sebul Gaal o lalashera lenyena, pee meitoki ninche aatoni te Shekem.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
Masaai: Ore taisere neipang lelo tung'ana aapuo ong'ata. Nelikini Abimelek.

English: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
Masaai: Nedung ninye iltung'ana lenyena metaa ilturrurri okuni, neirrag aanyisho ti ong'ata: neing'orisho ninye nedol iltung'ana eipang'u aapuku te nkanasa, nedumunye ninye, aar ninche nesesekuan ninche.

English: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
Masaai: Neisarrisar Abimelek o ilo tim apa otii te nebo ninye nepuo aaitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi e nkanasa, ina kata eisarisaraki lelo timito pokira oare o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii ong'ata nesesekuan ninche.

English: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
Masaai: Nearare Abimelek ina anasa ina olong pooki, neya ninye ina anasa near metuata lelo tung'ana apa ootii atua, nemut ina anasa nebukoki enkop e munyan.

English: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii oltalet le Shekem ina, nejing ninche osempewuet le nkaji e Elberit.

English: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
Masaai: Netolikioki apa Abimelek nchere eiturrurrote iltung'ana pooki to ltalet le Shekem te nebo.

English: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What ye have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
Masaai: Neilep Abimelek alo oldoinyo le Salmon, ninye o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye; nedumu Abimelek entolu te nkaina enye, nedung'u olng'osila lo lchani, nedumu aiteleiki oloililai lenye. Nejoki lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Ore ina nikitoduaa nanu aasita, esarisara entaas, anaa enataasa nanu.”

English: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
Masaai: Neaku etudung'uo pooki ng'ae te lelo tung'ana olng'osila lenye nesuj Abimelek neirishakini ilo sempewuet, nepik ilo sempewuet enkima te shumata ninche, neaku etuata apa sii ninche iltung'ana pooki to ltalet le Shekem, iltung'ana oobaya enkalifu ilewa o nkituaak.

English: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
Masaai: Neitoki Abimelek alo Tebes, nelo aitayu ilng'oborri aarare Tebes, neya ninye.

English: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
Masaai: Kake etii apa oltalet ogol atua ina anasa, ore iltung'ana pooki le nkanasa neisik aapuo ine, ilewa pooki o nkituaak, neikenoo ate ti atua ine; nepuo ninche enchumata o ltalet.

English: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
Masaai: Nelotu Abimelek ilo talet, nearare ninye, nenyiku alotu enkutuk e ilo talet pee epejoo ninye te nkima.

English: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
Masaai: Nenang'u enkitok nabo nenang'aki osoit le shumata oituutishoreki endukuya e Abimelek, nedany elukunya enye.

English: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
Masaai: Neipotu nabo kata ilo barnoti apa onapaki ruparen, nejoki ninye, “Tushutu olalem lino taaraki nanu matua, mejo ake ilewa ti alo nanu, ‘Enkitok natara ninye metua.’ ” Nerem ilo barnoti aipang'ie olalem, neye ninye.

English: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Israel nchere etua Abimelek, nepuo ninche oltung'ani ake enkang enye.

English: Thus God rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
Masaai: Neijia eikuna Olaitoriani Enkai aitalaku entorroni e Abimelek apa nataasa ti alo papaai lenye pee ear ilalashera lenyena pokira ntomoni naapishana.

English: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
Masaai: Neisho sii Enkai entorroni pooki oo ltung'ana le Shekem metadoiki nchumat oo lukuny enye, nelotu shumata ninche ilo deket apa le Yotam olayioni le Yerubaal.

English: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore te siadi Abimelek nedumunye pee ekordu Israel Tola olayioni le Pua, olayioni le Dodo, oltung'ani le Isaakar, neton apa ninye te Shamir ti atua ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim.

English: And he judged Israel twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
Masaai: Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam ookuni. Neye ninye, nenukari te Shamir.

English: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Israel twenty and two years.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye nedumunye Yair, ilo le Gilead, laa ninye apa otaa olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam oare.

English: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havothjair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye ilayiok tomoni uni ooked isirkon tomoni uni; neeta apa ninche nkanas tomoni uni, naaji Hoyot-yair o metabaiki ena olong, apa naatii enkop e Gilead.

English: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
Masaai: Neye apa Yair nenukari te Kamon.

English: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook the LORD, and served not him.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aas entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neisiaai inkaitin e Baal o Ashtarot, nena aitin e Siria, o nkaitin e Sidon, o nkaitin e Moab, o nkaitin oo Lamori, o nkaitin oo Lfilisti, neing'uaa ninche Olaitoriani, neitu eisiaai ninye.

English: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Israel, nemir ninye ninche metijing'a atua enkaina oo Lfilisti o atua enkaina oo Lamori,

English: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Israel: eighteen years, all the children of Israel that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
Masaai: neisomit ninche neibooki enkop iltung'ana le Israel te ilo ari. Ore too larin tomon o isiet neibooki ninche enkop lelo tung'ana le Israel apa ootii lido kekun Yordan te nkop oo Lamori, apa natii Gilead.

English: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Israel was sore distressed.
Masaai: Nelang'u Ilamori Yordan aapuonu sii aarare Yuda earare Benchamen nearare enkaji e Efraim; neaku etudupa osina Israel oleng.

English: And the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, saying, We have sinned against thee, both because we have forsaken our God, and also served Baalim.
Masaai: Neishiraki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, ejo, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki ti alo iyie, enkaraki nikitung'uaitie Enkai ang nikisiaai inkaitin e Baal.”

English: And the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, “Keitu apa nanu akordu intae aitung'uaa Ilmisiri naitung'uaa Ilamori, naitung'uaa Ilamoni naitung'uaa Ilfilisti?

English: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and ye cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
Masaai: Eibookito sii intae enkop iltung'ana le Sidon, o Lmaleki, o Lmaoni; nikinchirakiki intae nanu, nakordu nanu intae aitayu ti atua nkaik enye.

English: Yet ye have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia kitung'uaitie intae nanu nipuopuo aaisiaai kulie aitin; neaku maitoki nanu akordu intae.

English: Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
Masaai: Enchom enchiraki nena aitin nitudutaitie; nchoo ninche ekordu intae te nkata inyi o sina.”

English: And the children of Israel said unto the LORD, We have sinned: do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee; deliver us only, we pray thee, this day.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana le Israel Olaitoriani, “Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki; ntaasa iyiook anaa enidol eishiaakino te iyie; kake tokordu ake duoo iyie iyiook, kitoomono iyie ena olong.”

English: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served the LORD: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninche nena aitin omon apa naatii atua ninche, neisiaai Olaitoriani, netum ninye emion oleng te nkaraki osina le Israel.

English: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
Masaai: neipotuni apa iltung'ana le Amon metanapata, nepik ninche ilng'oborri lenye Gilead, neiturrurro sii ninche iltung'ana le Israel te nebo, nepik ilng'oborri lenye Mispa.

English: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana, lelo arikok le Gilead, nejokino maate, “Kalo tung'ani oiteru aarare ile Amon? Ninye oaku olkitok te lelo pooki oomanya Gilead.”

English: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
Masaai: Ore apa Yepta ilo le Gilead naa olmurrani magilani, kake olayioni apa le mulayoi ninye. Gilead apa menye le Yepta.

English: And Gilead's wife bare him sons; and his wife's sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, Thou shalt not inherit in our father's house; for thou art the son of a strange woman.
Masaai: Ore apa enkitok e Gilead neiki sii ninye ilayiok; ore ake pee ebulu lelo ayiok le ina kitok enye, nearaa ninche Yepta, nejoki ninye, “Mijung iyie enkaji e papa lang; amu ira iyie oliae kitok.”

English: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
Masaai: Neisik Yepta aing'uaa ilalashera lenyena, nelo abik te nkop e Tob; neiturrurrokino iltung'ana le pesho Yepta, nepuo aarisho te nebo ninye.

English: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata neitayunye iltung'ana le Amon olarrabal Israel.

English: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitayunye iltung'ana le Amon Israel olarrabal, nepuo ilpayiani le Gilead aariku Yepta te nkop e Tob;

English: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
Masaai: nejoki ninche Yepta, “Wou taa olarikoni lang, pee kitum iyiook aataarare Ilamoni.”

English: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not ye hate me, and expel me out of my father's house? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress?
Masaai: Kake etiaka Yepta lelo payiani le Gilead, “Keitu apa intae kimbayuyu nanu, nikiaraa nanu aaipang'ie te nkaji e papa lai? Kainyoo taata pee ietuo enatii nanu iatata enyamali?”

English: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to thee now, that thou mayest go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo payiani le Gilead Yepta, “Ena pee kimbelekenyakinote taata iyiook iyie, pee itum ashomo te nebo iyiook niarare Ilamoni, niaku olarikoni lang te lelo pooki oomanya Gilead.”

English: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and the LORD deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
Masaai: Nejoki Yepta lelo payiani le Gilead, “Ti nikintokiki nanu aaya ang mashomo aarare Ilamoni, ore ake pee aaisho Olaitoriani ninche, naaku nanu olarikoni linyi.”

English: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, The LORD be witness between us, if we do not so according to thy words.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo payiani le Gilead Yepta, “Olaitoriani olo aaku shakeni te rishata ang, esipa eikiaas iyiook anaa enitejo.”

English: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before the LORD in Mizpeh.
Masaai: Nelo Yepta te nebo lelo payiani le Gilead, neitaa ninye iltung'ana endukuya o larikoni te shumata ninche; neiro irorei lenyena pooki te dukuya Olaitoriani te Mispa.

English: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come against me to fight in my land?
Masaai: Neitoki Yepta airriwaa ilkiliku enetii olaiguanani le Amon nejoki, “Kainyoo iyie kiatakinore nanu, pee iewuo enatii nanu, pee iarare enkop ai?”

English: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Israel took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo aiguanani le Amon lelo apa ooirriwayie Yepta ajoki, “Enkaraki naa ore apa Israel pee elotu te Misiri neya enkop ai, ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok nelo abaiki Yordan; ore naa taata torrinyu te seriani.”

English: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
Masaai: Neitoki Yepta airriwaki ilkiliku olaiguanani le Amon,

English: And said unto him, Thus saith Jephthah, Israel took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
Masaai: nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Yepta: Eitu eya Israel enkop e Moab aashu enkop e Amon,

English: But when Israel came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
Masaai: kake ore apa pee eilepu Israel te Misiri nepuo aaim olpurkel o metabaiki Enaiposha Nanyokie nepuonu Kadesh.

English: Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray thee, pass through thy land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Israel abode in Kadesh.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Israel ilkiliku olaiguanani le Edom, ejo, ‘Nchoo siaake iyiook maima enkop ino.’ kake etanya olaiguanani le Edom ening. Neitoki sii airriwaki ilkiliku olaiguanani le Moab, kake eitu enyorraa. Neaku etobiko apa Israel te Kadesh.

English: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
Masaai: Neim ninche olpurkel pooki nepuo aamanaa te nkop e Edom o enkop e Moab, nepuo aaitayu ilng'oborri te nkae shoto e Arnon; kake eitu ninche ejing atua enkop e Moab, ore apa Arnon naa ninye olpolosie le Moab.

English: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said unto him, Let us pass, we pray thee, through thy land into my place.
Masaai: Neitoki Israel aairriwaki ilkiliku Sihon loo Lamori, o laiguanani le Heshbon; nejoki Israel ninye, ‘Nchoo sii ake iyiook matulusoi kitasayia iyie, aaim enkop ino aapuo enkop ang.’

English: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eisilig Sihon Israel meima enkop enye; neaku eiturrurro apa Sihon iltung'ana lenyena pooki te nebo, neitayu ilng'oborri te Yahas, nearare Israel.

English: And the LORD God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel, and they smote them: so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
Masaai: Neishoru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel Sihon o ltung'ana lenyena pooki apik atua nkaik e Israel, nemir Israel ninche; neya taa Israel ina kop pooki oo Lamori, apa oomanya ina kop.

English: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
Masaai: Neya sii ina kop pooki oo Lamori ebaiki Arnon o metabaiki Yabok o ebaiki olpurkel o metabaiki Yordan.

English: So now the LORD God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel, and shouldest thou possess it?
Masaai: Neaku taa, Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ninye otarayie aoru Ilamori te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena, Israel; naa amaa iya iyie ninche araya?

English: Wilt not thou possess that which Chemosh thy god giveth thee to possess? So whomsoever the LORD our God shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
Masaai: Eimiya iyie ina nikincho Kemosh enkai ino? Ore ina pooki natarua Olaitoriani Enkai ang te dukuya iyiook nikiya iyiook.

English: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
Masaai: Eira iyie supat alang Balak olayioni le Sipor, olaiguanani le Moab? Ketekeshare ae kata ninye Israel anaa keshomo ae kata aarare ninche?

English: While Israel dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did ye not recover them within that time?
Masaai: Amaa apa ebikito Israel te Heshbon o too nkang'itie enye kutiti, o ti atua Aroer o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o ti atua nena anas pooki apa naatii embata e Arnon, too larin iip uni, kainyoo apaiyie pee eitu iya nena kuapi te ina kata?

English: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee, but thou doest me wrong to war against me: the LORD the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Eitu naa nanu aas eng'oki ti alo iyie, nikintaasa iyie nanu entorrono aitayunye olarrabal; nchoo Olaitoriani, ilo Arishani eaku olarishani too ltung'ana le Israel o too ltung'ana le Amon.”

English: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo aiguanani le Amon eitu eshilaa ilo kilikuai le Yepta apa oirriwaka ninye.

English: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Yepta, nelo agiroo Gilead o Manase, negiroo alo Mispa e Gilead, aim Gilead negiroo Mispa e Gilead alo enetii ile Amon.

English: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands,
Masaai: Nenya Yepta olmumai to Laitoriani, nejo, “Tenaa einchoru iyie ile Amon apik atua nkaik aainei,

English: Then it shall be, that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD'S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
Masaai: neaku ore pooki ng'ae oipang'u aimu nkutukie e nkaji ai, pee aalotu anang'are nanu, te narrinyo alotu aisula ile Amon, neaku olo Laitoriani, naishoru nanu ninye metaa olasar opejori.”

English: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and the LORD delivered them into his hands.
Masaai: Nelang Yepta alo enetii ile Amon aarare ninche neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua inkaik enyena.

English: And he smote them from Aroer, even till thou come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Near ninche ebaiki Aroer o metabaiki elatia e Minit, nkanas tikitam, o metabaiki Abel-keramim, te sesekuanata kitok oleng. Neaku etimiraki apa ile Amon te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
Masaai: Neitoki Yepta alotu enkang enye te Mispa, naa ng'ura, neipang'u entito enye alotu anang'are ninye eranyisho neosh entampuri, naa ninye apake enkerai naata, meeta apa ae tito aashu olayioni.

English: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! thou hast brought me very low, and thou art one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto the LORD, and I cannot go back.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ninye, nepolos nkilani enyena, nejo, “Ee entito ai! Kintadouo iyie nanu oleng, nitaa iyie enkipirunoto e nyamali sapuk te nanu; amu ataboloko nanu Olaitoriani enkutuk ai nemaidim ainyaai olmumai lai.”

English: And she said unto him, My father, if thou hast opened thy mouth unto the LORD, do to me according to that which hath proceeded out of thy mouth; forasmuch as the LORD hath taken vengeance for thee of thine enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Nejoki ina tito enye ninye, “Papa, ti nitaboloko iyie Olaitoriani enkutuk ino, ntaasaki nanu enaba anaa enaimua enkutuk ino, amu kitalaaka Olaitoriani too lmang'ati linono te lelo le Amon.”

English: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye menye, “Nchoo maaitaasi ena bae; nchooki ake duoo iyie ilapaitin oare, pee alo nanu aisampash too ldoinyo aishiraki titoisho ai, nanu o esirit ai.”

English: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
Masaai: Nejoki menye, “Shomo.” Neisho ninye meshomo ilapaitin oare; nelo ninye ina tito, ninye o encholuek enye, nelo aishiraki titoisho enye too nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo lapaitin oare, neshukunye ninye enetii papaai lenye, apa oitaasa ninye te risioroto e ilo mumai apa oinosa. Eitu ae kata eyiolou ina tito olee. Neaku apa olkerreti te Israel

English: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
Masaai: nchere kepuo ake ntoyie e Israel to lari aaishiraki entito e Yepta ilo le Gilead nkolong'i ong'uan to lari.

English: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didst not call us to go with thee? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire.
Masaai: Neipotuni apa iltung'ana le Efraim metanapata, nelang ninche aapuo Sapon nejoki Yepta, “Kainyoo iyie pee italang'a alo aarare Ilamoni, neitu impotu iyiook pee kipuo te nebo iyie? Eikipejoo iyiook enkaji ino itii atua te nkima.”

English: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, ye delivered me not out of their hands.
Masaai: Nejoki Yepta ninche, “Ore nanu o ltung'ana laainei nikitii olarrabal kitok te nebo Ilamoni; ore ake pee aipotu nanu intae, neitu kikordudu nanu te nkaina enye.

English: And when I saw that ye delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and the LORD delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
Masaai: Ore ake pee adol ajo mikikordudu intae nanu, naya nanu enkishui ai te nkaina ai, nalang alo aarare Ilamoni, neishoru Olaitoriani ninche apik nkaik aainei kainyoo naa taata pee ileputua intae aapuonu enatii ena olong, pee kipuonunu aarare nanu?”

English: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
Masaai: Neiturrur Yepta iltung'ana pooki le Gilead nearare Efraim, nesesekuan iltung'ana le Gilead Efraim, enkaraki natejo, “Irara intae ilaisikak le Efraim, intae ile Gilead, te mpolos e Efraim o Manase.”

English: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Art thou an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
Masaai: Neya lelo tung'ana le Gilead ilang'at e Yordan pee earare ile Efraim. Naa ore ake pee ejo oltung'ani le lelo apa ootimiraki le Efraim, “Ntasho nanu matalang'a alo,” nejoki ninye iltung'ana le Gilead, “Eira iyie ole Efraim?” Ore ake pee ejo ninye, “A-a,”

English: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
Masaai: nejoki ninche ninye, “Tejo naa Shibolet,” nejo ninye “Sibolet” amu meidim ninye atejo ina aitobiraki; neibung taa ninye near metua too lang'at e Yordan. Nebatata ina kata te ine ilung'ana le Efraim nkalifuni artam oare.

English: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
Masaai: Neaku Yepta olarishani le Israel ilarin ile. Neye Yepta nenukari te nkanasa enye e Gilead.

English: And after him Ibzan of Bethlehem judged Israel.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Ibsan le Betlehem otaa olarishani le Israel.

English: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye ilayiok tomoni uni; o ntoyie tomoni uni, neishooyo meyami iltung'ana leme lo lgilata lenye neyau ntoyie e boo neme no lgilata lenye meyama ilayiok lenyena. Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin oopishana.

English: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Bethlehem.
Masaai: Neaku etua Ibsan nenukari te Betlehem.

English: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Israel; and he judged Israel ten years.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Elon le Sebulon otaa olarishani le Israel, netaa apa ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tomon.

English: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Elon aye, ilo le Sebulon nenukari te Aiyalon te nkop e Sebulon.

English: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Israel.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Abdon olayioni le Hilel le Piraton otaa olarishani le Israel.

English: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye ilayiok artam o lakuyiaani tomoni uni, apa ooked isirkon ntomoni naapishana; neaku ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin isiet.

English: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
Masaai: Neitoki aye Abdon ilo ayioni le Hilel le Piraton, nenukari te Piraton te nkop e Efraim, te ina kop oo ndoinyo oo Lmaleki.

English: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana le Israel aas entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani; neishooyo Olaitoriani ninche apik atua enkaina oo Lfilisti too larin artam.

English: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
Masaai: Netii apa oltung'ani obo le Sora, lo losho le Dan, oji enkarna enye Manoa; naa koolupi apa enkitok enye nemeeta nkera.

English: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, thou art barren, and bearest not: but thou shalt conceive, and bear a son.
Masaai: Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani ina kitok nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, ira iyie olupi nimiaata nkera; kake inutayu iyie niiu olayioni.

English: Now therefore beware, I pray thee, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
Masaai: Metaa, ng'ura kewan, miok enaisho oo sabibu aashu enaisho napi, niminya entoki nemesinya,

English: For, lo, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: amu, ng'ura, inutayu iyie niiu olayioni. Nemeetae olmurunya olotu shumata endukuya enye, amu ore ina ayioni naa keaku Olnasarayoi te Nkai ebaiki einoto enye; naa keiteru ninye akordu Israel aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.”

English: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of God came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
Masaai: Nelotu ina kitok ajoki olmoruo lenye, “Eewuo oltung'ani le Nkai enatii nanu, ore empukunoto enye nenyaanyukie empukunoto o lmalaika le Nkai, keitureisho oleng; eitu nanu aikilikuan ninye eneing'uaa neitu ninye aaliki enkarna enye;

English: But he said unto me, Behold, thou shalt conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death.
Masaai: kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, ‘Ng'ura, inutayu iyie niiu enkayioni; metaa naa miok enaisho oo sabibu aashu ae aisho napi niminya entoki nemesinya, amu keaku ina ayioni Olnasarayoi te Nkai ebaiki einoto o metabaiki keeya enye.’ ”

English: Then Manoah intreated the LORD, and said, O my Lord, let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
Masaai: Neomon Manoa Olaitoriani, nejo, “Olaitoriani lai, aatoomono iyie, nchoo ilo tung'ani le Nkai lirriua menyaaki alotu enikitii iyiook, aiteng'en iyiook enikintaas ina ayioni naini.”

English: And God hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
Masaai: Nening Enkai oltoilo le Manoa, neigil ilo malaika le Nkai alotu enetii ina kitok etonita te nkurma; kake metii apa Manoa olmoruo lenye te nebo ninye.

English: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man hath appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
Masaai: Nekuet ina kitok te nkisarrisar alo ajoki olmoruo lenye, “Ng'ura ore olapa tung'ani oewuo enatii enapa olong aanyaaka aipang'aki.”

English: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Art thou the man that spakest unto the woman? And he said, I am.
Masaai: Nedumunye Manoa nelo asuj enkitok enye, nelotu enetii ilo tung'ani nejoki ninye, “Kaiyie apa ilo tung'ani oirorie ena kitok?” Nejoki ninye, “Nanu ilo.”

English: And Manoah said, Now let thy words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
Masaai: Nejo Manoa, “Amaa, akenya te nebaya irorei linono, kaji kenya etiu ina ayioni, naa kaa kenya eas?”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Manoa, “Ore nena pooki natiaaka ena kitok nchoo ninye eing'or.

English: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
Masaai: Menya ninye ae toki naing'uaa isabibu nemeok enaisho aashu ae toki nemesinya; ore nena pooki naitanapa ninye nchoo ninye eas.”

English: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Manoa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Aatoomono, nchoo iyiook maiboo iyie pee kintobiraki iyie olkuoo le kine.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto Manoah, Though thou detain me, I will not eat of thy bread: and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering, thou must offer it unto the LORD. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani Manoa, “Tinikimbok iyie nanu, nemanya nanu endaa ino; kake ti nintobir olasar opejori, ntobiraki naa Olaitoriani.” (Amu eitu apa eyiolou Manoa nchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye.)

English: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, What is thy name, that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour?
Masaai: Nejoki Manoa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, “Eikiji ng'ae enkarna, pee aa te nelo kenya nebaya irorei linono, nikitum aaishoo iyie enkanyit?”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani ninye, “Kainyoo pee inkilikuanu enkarna ai, itoduaa ajo enenking'asia?”

English: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto the LORD: and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
Masaai: Neya Manoa olkuoo le kine te nebo enkishoroto e ntapa, neitaiki te nchumata endapidapoi Olaitoriani olasar, ilo laa ninye oas inenking'asia.

English: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eilep olng'ejep le nkima alo shumata epuku te ilo asar, neilep ilo malaika te ilo ng'ejep le nkima lo lasar eing'orita Manoa o enkitok enye; nebatata aaitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop.

English: But the angel of the LORD did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of the LORD.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata eigil ilo malaika lo Laitoriani aipang'aki Manoa o enkitok enye. Neyiolou apa Manoa nchere olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye.

English: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen God.
Masaai: Nejoki Manoa enkitok enye, “Esipa eikiye iyiook, amu kitoduaa iyiook Enkai.”

English: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka enkitok enye ninye, “Tenaa keyieu apa Olaitoriani near iyiook matuata, anaata eitu ninye eng'amu ilo asar opejori o lasar le ntapa too nkaik ang, aashu eitodol iyiook kuna baa pooki, aashu eliki iyiook mbaa naaijo kuna.”

English: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
Masaai: Neiu ina kitok olayioni, neisho enkarna enye ajo Samson; nebulu ina ayioni, nemayian Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And the Spirit of the LORD began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Masaai: neitera Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani aputu ninye ti atua Mahane-dan te rishata e Sora o Eshtaol.

English: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
Masaai: Nedoyio apa Samson alo Timna, ore te Timna nedol entito nabo oo Lfilisti.

English: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
Masaai: Neilepu ninye alotu, nejoki menye o ng'otonye, “Atoduaa nanu entito nabo oo Lfilisti te Timna; entorikokoki nanu metaa enkitok ai.”

English: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
Masaai: Kake etiaakitia menye o ng'otonye ninye, “Aimeetae enkitok ti atua ntoyie o lgilata linyi, aashu ti atua iltung'ana lang pooki, eji pee ilo ayamu enkitok too Lfilisti lememurata?” Kake etiaaka Samson menye, “Torikokoki nanu ninye; amu aaitiship ninye nanu oleng.”

English: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
Masaai: Meyiolo apa menye o ng'otonye nchere Olaitoriani eing'uaa ina; amu keing'oru apa ninye erishata naarie Ilfilisti. Ore apa ina kata naa Ilfilisti ooitore Israel.

English: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
Masaai: Nedoyio Samson o menye o ng'otonye aapuo Timna, nepuo enkurma oo lng'anayio e Timna. Naa ng'ura, neikurrukurroki ninye olkuoo lo lng'atuny;

English: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
Masaai: nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye te ngolon, nepolos ninye ilo ng'atuny anaa oltung'ani opolos olkuoo le kine; nemeeta apa ninye toki te nkaina enye. Kake eitu apa ninye eliki menye aashu ng'otonye enataasa ninye.

English: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
Masaai: Nedoyio ninye alo airorie ina kitok; neitiship ina kitok Samson oleng.

English: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata nerrinyo alo aya ninye; neibelekenya aing'or empopong o lng'atuny, naa ng'ura, etii olemaat loo lotorok ina popong o lng'atuny, o enaisho oo lotorok.

English: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
Masaai: Nebelu ninye neibung too nkaik enyena, nelo, ainosaa eloito; nelotu enetii menye o ng'otonye, neisho ninche embata, nenya ninche. Kake eitu ninye eliki ninche nchere te mpopong o lng'atuny eitayio ina aisho oo lotorok.

English: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
Masaai: Nedoyio menye alo enetii ina kitok, neitobir Samson osirua te ine, amu neijia apa eiko ilbarnot.

English: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana ninye, neyau ninche iltung'ana tomoni uni pee epuonu aaku te nebo ninye.

English: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
Masaai: Nejoki Samson ninche, “Kaisho nanu intae oloyiote, naa ti nikindimidimi aatoliki nanu eneikununo, ti atua kuna olong'i naapishana o sirua, niyiolouu aajo kainyoo, naisho nanu intae nkilani tomoni uni e kitani o kulie kilani tomoni uni sidain;

English: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.
Masaai: kake ti nimikindimidimi aatoliki nanu nchere kainyoo, nikinchosho intae nanu nkilani tomoni uni e kitani, o nkilani sidain.” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tolimu oloyiote lino matoning.”

English: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Oyiote: Etupukuo enainosi tiatua ina nainosisho. Etupukuo entoki namelok aimu ina nagol.” Neitu ninche eidim aatayiolo ilo oyiote too nkolong'i uni.

English: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson's wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan nejoki ninche ina kitok e Samson, “Ilejileja olmoruo lino metoliki iyiook nchere kainyoo ilo oyiote mikipejoo ake iyie o enkaji e papaai lino te nkima. Ntoomono apa iyiook pee itumutumu aawaita imasaa ang?”

English: And Samson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?
Masaai: Ore ina kitok e Samson neishir te dukuya ninye, nejoki, “Eikimba iyie, mikinyor nanu; itipikaka iyie oloyiote iltung'ana lang, neitu ninye kiliki nanu ajoki kainyoo.” Nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, eitu aliki papa aashu yieyio, paa eijo iyie aliki?”

English: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
Masaai: Neishir ninye te dukuya ninye nena olong'i naapishana apa osirua lenye; ore te nkolong e naapishana neliki ina kitok enye, amu eitirrishaka apa ninye oleng. Neliki ina kitok oloyiote lelo tung'ana lenye.

English: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
Masaai: Nejoki ilewa apa le ina anasa ninye te nkolong e naapishana eton eitu edoyio enkolong, “Kainyoo namelok alang enaisho oo lotorok? Kainyoo nagol alang olng'atuny?” Nejoki Samson ninche, “Teneme enkashe ai itukurrishore intae, anaata intae eitu itumutumu oloyiote lai.”

English: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father's house.
Masaai: Nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani te ngolon shumata ninye, nedoyio ninye alo Ashkelon near metuata iltung'ana tomoni uni le ina ang, neya ntokitin enye neisho nkilani lelo apa ootolimutuo oloyiote. Ore te ngoro napi neshuko alo enkaji e papaai lenye.

English: But Samson's wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
Masaai: Neishori ina kitok e Samson ilo apa oboitare ninye, aa ninye apa shepu-lkerra lenye.

English: But it came to pass within a while after, in the time of wheat harvest, that Samson visited his wife with a kid; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the chamber. But her father would not suffer him to go in.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie enkiti rishata, te nkata naisampuni enkano, nelo Samson amutan enkitok enye, neyaki olkuoo le kine; nejo ninye, “Kalo nanu adol enkitok ai ti atua aji.” Kake eitu apa eisho menye meshomo atua aji.

English: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
Masaai: Nejoki menye le ina kitok, “Kajo apa eimba ninye oleng naisho ninye ilo apa liboitare. Aimesidai ina anashe enye kiti alang ninye? Aatoomono iwa ninye te rishata e nkae.”

English: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
Masaai: Nejoki Samson ninche, “Ore tena kata maaitokini nanu aailap ti alo Ilfilisti te naitaas ninche entorrono.”

English: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
Masaai: Nelo Samson neibung mbariak iip uni, neya ilkilang'ilang'eta neitutum ninche ilkidong'o, nepik ake enkilang'ilang'et erishata oo lkidong'o oare.

English: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitudup nena kilang'ilang'eta enkima neisho nena bariak meshomo aaim atua enkano oo Lfilisti nepejoo isotot o enkano nauno o nkurman oo loirienito.

English: Then the Philistines said, Who hath done this? And they answered, Samson, the son in law of the Timnite, because he had taken his wife, and given her to his companion. And the Philistines came up, and burnt her and her father with fire.
Masaai: Nejo Ilfilisti, “Kang'ae otaasa ena?” Nejo ninche, “Samson, ilo aputani lo Ltimini, enkaraki nawa ninye enkitok enye neisho ilo apa oboitare ninye.” Neilepu Ilfilisti aaponu nepejoo ninye o papaai lenye te nkima.

English: And Samson said unto them, Though ye have done this, yet will I be avenged of you, and after that I will cease.
Masaai: Nejoki Samson ninche, “Tenaa ena intae iasiasa, kanya nanu olmumai pee aitalak intae, ore te siadi ina nalo nanu.”

English: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.
Masaai: Near ninye ninche oleng metuata te nkumoi; nedoyio alo aton ti atua enkapune natii endapidapoi e Etam.

English: Then the Philistines went up, and pitched in Judah, and spread themselves in Lehi.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfilisti nepik ilng'oborri Yuda, neibung enkang e Lehi.

English: And the men of Judah said, Why are ye come up against us? And they answered, To bind Samson are we come up, to do to him as he hath done to us.
Masaai: Nejo iltung'ana le Yuda, “Kainyoo intae pee ileputua aapuonu aarare iyiook?” Nejo ninche, “Kileputua iyiook aapuonu aaen Samson, aaitaas ninye anaa enaitaasa iyiook.”

English: Then three thousand men of Judah went to the top of the rock Etam, and said to Samson, Knowest thou not that the Philistines are rulers over us? what is this that thou hast done unto us? And he said unto them, As they did unto me, so have I done unto them.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana nkalifuni uni le Yuda enchumata e ndapidapoi e Etam, nejoki Samson, “Eimiyiolo iyie nchere Ilfilisti ilaitoriak te shumata iyiook kainyoo naa ena nintaasa iyie iyiook?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Anaa enaaitaasa ninche nanu, ina sii nanu aitaasa ninche.”

English: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kietuo iyiook aaen iyie, pee kitum aaishooi iyie ti atua nkaik oo Lfilisti.” Nejoki Samson ninche, “Enosa olmumai nchere mikiaariara intae maate.”

English: And they spake unto him, saying, No; but we will bind thee fast, and deliver thee into their hand: but surely we will not kill thee. And they bound him with two new cords, and brought him up from the rock.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “A-a; eikien ake iyiook iyie nikinchooyo iyie aapik atua nkaik enye; mikiaar iyiook iyie tua.” Neen ninche ninye too lgoso ng'ejuko oare, neyau aailepunye te ndapidapoi.

English: And when he came unto Lehi, the Philistines shouted against him: and the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire, and his bands loosed from off his hands.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu ninye Lehi, nepuonu Lfilisti aanang'are ninye ebuaku; nelotu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye te ngolon; ore lelo goso apa ootii nkaik enyena netiu anaa iusin naaibung'a enkima; ore ienat enyena neshola too nkaik enyena.

English: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
Masaai: Netum ninye oltagiligili oshal lo sikiria, neitorioo enkaina adumu, ore te ilo tagiligili nesesekuan iltung'ana enkalifu.

English: And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.
Masaai: Nejo Samson, “Ore to ltagiligili lo sikiria naa osototi te shumata osototi. To ltagiligili lo sikiria atasesekuana nanu iltung'ana enkalifu.”

English: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking, that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand, and called that place Ramathlehi.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip ninye airoro, nenang'aa ilo tagiligili lo sikiria te nkaina enye; neji apa enkarna e ine wueji Ramat-lehi.

English: And he was sore athirst, and called on the LORD, and said, Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant: and now shall I die for thirst, and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised?
Masaai: Netir apa ninye enkure oleng, neipot ninye Olaitoriani nejo, “Nchorua iyie enkordunoto kitok te nkaina o sinka lino; naa kaye nanu taata te nkure, nabatatakino atua nkaik oo lememurata?”

English: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.
Masaai: Nebol Enkai engumoto te Lehi, nepuku enkare te ine, ore ake pee eok, neitoki apok, nepiu. Neaku ore enkarna enye etejoki apa En-hakore; etii ine Lehi o taata.

English: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.
Masaai: Neaku ninye olarishani le Israel too nkolong'i oo Lfilisti ilarin tikitam.

English: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
Masaai: Nelo apa Samson Gasa, nedol ninye emulayoi te ine, nelo enetii ninye.

English: And it was told the Gazites, saying, Samson is come hither. And they compassed him in, and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, In the morning, when it is day, we shall kill him.
Masaai: Netiaakaki apa lelo le Gasa, “Eeuo Samson ene,” neman ninche ine wueji neirrag aanyu ninye enkewarie pooki te nkishomi e ina anasa. Negira ninche enkewarie pooki, ejo, “Mataanyu iyiook o mekenyu, pee kitum aataar ninye metua.”

English: And Samson lay till midnight, and arose at midnight, and took the doors of the gate of the city, and the two posts, and went away with them, bar and all, and put them upon his shoulders, and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron.
Masaai: Kake eirure apa Samson o metaa empolos e nkewarie; ore te mpolos e nkewarie nedumunye neya nkikeneta e kishomi e ina anasa o ng'apeta pokira are, nedotu ninche, te nebo osekenkei o pooki toki, neiteleiki ninche oloililai nenap ninche enchumata e ina doinyo apa natii dukuya Hebron.

English: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nenyorru enkitok apa natii oerata le Sorek, naji enkarna enye Delila.

English: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and said unto her, Entice him, and see wherein his great strength lieth, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him: and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti enetii ninye nejoki ninye, “Ilejileja ninye, pee idol enetii engolon enye kitok, naa tiaa oitoi kiindim aaitojoola ninye, pee kitum iyiook aateen ninye nikigilu ninye; nikisilisil; naa eikincho iyiook iyie oltung'ani ake mpisai enkalifu nabo o iip nabo e nkosholai.”

English: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Delila Samson, “Tolikioki sii ake enetii ena golon ino kitok, naa kaji naaji kinkoni ti nikieni, pee kitum oltung'ani atigilu.”

English: And Samson said unto her, If they bind me with seven green withs that were never dried, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
Masaai: Nejoki Samson ninye, “Te naaeni nanu too mpi oo nkai ng'ejuko naapishana neton eitu etoyu, nashalu nanu, natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

English: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green withs which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
Masaai: Neyaki ilkituaak loo Lfilisti ninye mpi oo nkai naapishana ng'ejuko neenie ninye.

English: Now there were men lying in wait, abiding with her in the chamber. And she said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he brake the withs, as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire. So his strength was not known.
Masaai: Neeta apa Delila iltung'ana ooisudori ti atua olgilata ti aji. Nejoki Delila Samson, “Kipuonu Lfilisti aaibung, Samson!” Nedung ninye nena pi anaa usin naaibung'a enkima. Neaku meyioloi apa enkisudoroto e ngolon enye.

English: And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.
Masaai: Neitoki Delila ajoki Samson, “Ng'ura, kitusukenya nanu, nikiteleja nanu; tolikioki sii ake enikinkoni pee kimbung'i.”

English: And he said unto her, If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied, then shall I be weak, and be as another man.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Te naaeni nanu too lgoso ng'ejuko leitu ae kata eenishoreki, nashalu nanu natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

English: Delilah therefore took new ropes, and bound him therewith, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And there were liers in wait abiding in the chamber. And he brake them from off his arms like a thread.
Masaai: Neyau Delila lelo goso ng'ejuko neen ninye te ninche, nejoki ninye, “Kipuonu Ilfilisti aaibung, Samson!” Ore apa iltung'ana ooisudori netii olgilata ti atua aji, nedung lelo goso too nkaik enyena anaa eusi.

English: And Delilah said unto Samson, Hitherto thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: tell me wherewith thou mightest be bound. And he said unto her, If thou weavest the seven locks of my head with the web.
Masaai: Neitoki Delila ajoki Samson, “Ore o tene kitusukenya nanu, nikilej nanu; tolikioki nanu enikinkoni ti nikimbung'i.” Nejoki Samson ninye, “Ti nishet kuna tukusi aainei naapishana e ndukuya ai te nkarasha nintirrish oleng te ncheitoi, nashalu nanu natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

English: And she fastened it with the pin, and said unto him, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awaked out of his sleep, and went away with the pin of the beam, and with the web.
Masaai: Neaku ore apa eirura Samson, neitayu Delila nena enat oolpapit pokira naapishana neshetaki enkarasha neitirrish ninche aunoki encheitoi, nejoki ninye, “Kipuonu Ilfilisti aaibung iyie Samson!” Neinyototo ninye too njo enyena nedotu encheitoi neshurta ina arasha nashetakino.

English: And she said unto him, How canst thou say, I love thee, when thine heart is not with me? thou hast mocked me these three times, and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth.
Masaai: Nejoki Delila ninye, “Kaji iyie inko ti nijo, ‘Kaanyor nanu iyie,’ te nemetii oltau lino te nebo nanu? Kitusunkenya iyie kuna katitin pokira uni, neitu iyie kiliki enetii engolon ino kitok.”

English: And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitirrishaki Delila ninye too rorei lenyena anaake, neitagor ninye, nenauru oltau lenye oleng.

English: That he told her all his heart, and said unto her, There hath not come a razor upon mine head; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother's womb: if I be shaven, then my strength will go from me, and I shall become weak, and be like any other man.
Masaai: Neliki ninye mbaa enyena pooki, nejoki Delila, “Eitu ae kata eim olmurunya endukuya ai; amu ataa apa nanu Olnasarayoi te Nkai atii enkoshoke e yieyio. Ore ake naaji pee aabarni, naaing'uaa nanu engolon ai, nashalu nanu natiu anaa pooki tung'ani.”

English: And when Delilah saw that he had told her all his heart, she sent and called for the lords of the Philistines, saying, Come up this once, for he hath shewed me all his heart. Then the lords of the Philistines came up unto her, and brought money in their hand.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Delila ajo etolikio ninye mbaa enyena pooki, neirriwaa olkilikuai aipotu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti pooki, ejo, “Elepu wootu ena kata nabo, amu aatolikio mbaa enyena pooki.” Neilepu ilkituaak loo Lfilisti aapuonu enetii ninye, neyau mpisiai too nkaik enye.

English: And she made him sleep upon her knees; and she called for a man, and she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head; and she began to afflict him, and his strength went from him.
Masaai: Neisho ninye meirurayu too nkejek enyena; neipotu ninye oltung'ani, neisho ninye metabarnu nena enat naapishana oo lpapit le ndukuya enye. Neiteru aitanyamal ninye, neing'ua engolon enye ninye.

English: And she said, The Philistines be upon thee, Samson. And he awoke out of his sleep, and said, I will go out as at other times before, and shake myself. And he wist not that the LORD was departed from him.
Masaai: Nejo Delila, “Kimbung'ita iyie Ilfilisti, Samson!” Neinyototo ninye too njo, nejo, “Kaipang nanu alo boo anaa oshi ake nkulie katitin, narerio.” Neitu apa eyiolou ninye ajo etung'uayie Olaitoriani ninye.

English: But the Philistines took him, and put out his eyes, and brought him down to Gaza, and bound him with fetters of brass; and he did grind in the prison house.
Masaai: Neibung Ilfilisti ninye nekurtu nkonyek enyena neitadou ninye aayau Gasa, neen ninye too lpisia lo suyai; neidong apa ninye enkano etii atua korokoroni.

English: Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.
Masaai: Kake enyaakita apa ilpapit le ndukuya enye aabulu ina kata eidipaki aatabarn.

English: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god, and to rejoice: for they said, Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand.
Masaai: Neiturrurro apa ilkituaak loo Lfilisti pee etum aaitaiki olasar kitok Dagon, enkai enye, neshipa sii, amu etejo apa ninche, “Eishorua enkai ang Samson ilo mang'atinta lang apik atua nkaik ang.”

English: And when the people saw him, they praised their god: for they said, Our god hath delivered into our hands our enemy, and the destroyer of our country, which slew many of us.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana ninye neisis enkai enye; amu etejo ninche, “Eishorua enkai ang olmang'atinta lang apik atua enkaina ang, laa ninye apa otumuta enkop ang, netasesekuana ilkumok lang.”

English: And it came to pass, when their hearts were merry, that they said, Call for Samson, that he may make us sport. And they called for Samson out of the prison house; and he made them sport: and they set him between the pillars.
Masaai: Ore eting'idate iltauja lenye, nejo ninche, “Empoto Samson pee elotu aitiship iyiook.” Neipotu ninche ninye ti atua korokoroni, pee eitiship ninye ninche. Neisho ninche ninye meitasho te rishata oo ng'apeta are;

English: And Samson said unto the lad that held him by the hand, Suffer me that I may feel the pillars whereupon the house standeth, that I may lean upon them.
Masaai: nejoki Samson enkayioni apa naa ninye narik aibung enkaina, “Ntasho sii iyie mairrapirrapa ng'apeta naairishaa ena aji, pee atum aigarakinoyu ninche.”

English: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women, that beheld while Samson made sport.
Masaai: Nebore apa ina aji ilewa o nkituaak; netii apa ilkituaak pooki loo Lfilisti ine; ore enchumata enkaji netii apa iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni ilewa o nkituaak, ooing'orisho ina kata eiguran Samson.

English: And Samson called unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once, O God, that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes.
Masaai: Neipot Samson Olaitoriani ajo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tadamuaki nanu, nikintagol nanu aatasayia ena kata nabo, Na Ai, pee atum aitalaku too Lfilisti nabo oo nkonyek aainei.”

English: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood, and on which it was borne up, of the one with his right hand, and of the other with his left.
Masaai: Neibung nena ng'apeta pokira are apa naatii empolos enkaji, naa ninche apa naairisha e nkaji, neirishakino te ngolon enye pooki shumata ninche, neibung te nkaina enye e tatene nabo ng'ape neibung tene kedienye enkae.

English: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.
Masaai: Nejo Samson, “Ntasho nanu matua te nebo Ilfilisti.” Neirrugo ninye te ngolon enye pooki; neurokino ina aji lelo kituaak o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii atua. Neaku ore iltung'ana apa ootuata te keeya enye naa eikumok aalang lelo apa ootasesekuana ninye eton eishu.

English: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down, and took him, and brought him up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father. And he judged Israel twenty years.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilalashera lenyena o lmarei lenye pooki aaya ninye neilepunye ninye aapuonu aanukaa te rishata e Sora o Eshtaol te nkurare e Manoa papaai lenye. Etaa apa ninye olarishani le Israel ilarin tikitam.

English: And there was a man of mount Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani le nkop oo ndoinyo e Efraim oji enkarna enye Mika.

English: And he said unto his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee, about which thou cursedst, and spakest of also in mine ears, behold, the silver is with me; I took it. And his mother said, Blessed be thou of the LORD, my son.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ng'otonye, “Ore inapa pisai enkalifu nabo o iip nabo e nkosholai apa nikitooruoki iyie, naa ninche itedekishore, nidekisho too nkiyiaa aainei, ng'ura, aata nanu nena oshola; nanu apa oowa.” Nejo ng'otonye, “Metamayiana Olaitoriani enkayioni ai.”

English: And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, his mother said, I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a graven image and a molten image: now therefore I will restore it unto thee.
Masaai: Nerrinyu ninye nena oshola apa enkalifu nabo o iip nabo aisho ng'otonye; nejo ng'otonye, “Kaiteng'el nanu kuna oshola aisho Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie te nkaina ai te nkaraki olayioni lai, pee eitayunyeki enkitanyaanyukoto e Nkai naguetuni o enkitanyaanyukoto nasholuni; ore naa taata kaarrinyoki nanu iyie.”

English: Yet he restored the money unto his mother; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver, and gave them to the founder, who made thereof a graven image and a molten image: and they were in the house of Micah.
Masaai: Neaku ore apa pee errinyoki ninye ng'otonye nena pisai, neya ng'otonye mpisai iip are e nkosholai, neisho ninche ilkunono oopej enkosholai laa ninye oitobira enkitanyaanyukoto naguetuni o enkitanyaanyukoto nasholuni; nepiki apa enkaji e Mika.

English: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
Masaai: Neeta apa ltung'ani oji Mika enkaji oo nkaitin. Neitobiru ninye nkitanyaanyukot o enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak; neput olayioni obo loo layiok lenyena aitaa olapolosani lenye.

English: In those days there was no king in Israel, but every man did that which was right in his own eyes.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel; keas apa pooki ng'ae enaba anaa esidai too nkonyek enyena makewan.

English: And there was a young man out of Bethlehemjudah of the family of Judah, who was a Levite, and he sojourned there.
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani le Betlehem ti atua Yuda, lo lmarei le Yuda, laa olawi apa ninye; neidurraki apa ninye ine.

English: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
Masaai: Nelo apa ilo tung'ani aing'uaa enkang e Betlehem te Yuda alo aton te wueji neidim anotie erishata; ore eidurrita ninye nelotu ina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim enetii enkaji e Mika.

English: And Micah said unto him, Whence comest thou? And he said unto him, I am a Levite of Bethlehemjudah, and I go to sojourn where I may find a place.
Masaai: Nejoki Mika ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejoki ninye, “Ara nanu Olawi le Betlehem ti atua Yuda, naa kalo amany ewueji naidim anotie erishata.”

English: And Micah said unto him, Dwell with me, and be unto me a father and a priest, and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year, and a suit of apparel, and thy victuals. So the Levite went in.
Masaai: Nejoki Mika ninye, “Totona te nebo nanu pee iaku te nanu papa o lapolosani naaisho nanu mpisai tomon e nkosholai to lari o nkilani o endaa.”

English: And the Levite was content to dwell with the man; and the young man was unto him as one of his sons.
Masaai: Nenyorraa ilo Lawi abik te nebo ilo tung'ani; netiu ilo barnoti te ninye anaa obo loo layiok lenyena.

English: And Micah consecrated the Levite; and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
Masaai: Neput Mika ilo Lawi, neaku ilo barnoti olapolosani lenye, netii apa ninye atua enkaji e Mika.

English: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.
Masaai: Nejo apa Mika, “Ayiolo taata ajo kaaitopok Olaitoriani, amu aata Olawi aitaa olapolosani lai.”

English: In those days there was no king in Israel: and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i nemeetae olaiguanani te Israel. Ore apa te nena olong'i neing'oru olosho le Dan enjung'ore enye maate ewueji nemany; amu ore ebaiki ina kata meetae enjung'ore ti atua iloshon loo Siraeli nanoto ninche.

English: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.
Masaai: Neirriu apa ile Dan iltung'ana imiet oodupa ti atua iltung'ana lo losho lenye pooki, eing'uaa Sora neing'uaa Eshtaol, pee epuonu aaikitalan enkop nejur; nejokini ninche, “Enchom entujur enkop.” Nepuonu apa ninche ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, ine netii enkaji e Mika, neirrag ine.

English: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought thee hither? and what makest thou in this place? and what hast thou here?
Masaai: Ore apa etii ninche embata e nkaji e Mika, neyiolou ninche oltoilo le ilo barnoti le Lawi; neibelekenya ninche nejoki ninye, “Kaing'ae likiyaua iyie ine? Kainyoo iyie iasita tene wueji? Kainyoo esiaai ino tene?”

English: And he said unto them, Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me, and hath hired me, and I am his priest.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji o nji aaitaasa nanu Mika: aaigero nanu, naaitaa nanu olapolosani lenye.”

English: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nkilikuanishore Enkai, kitoomono iyie, pee kitum aatayiolo tenaa kerasaa ena lototo nikipuoito.”

English: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before the LORD is your way wherein ye go.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo apolosani ninche, “Enchom te seriani. Ore ina lototo nipuopuo netii abori enkong'u o Laitoriani.”

English: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo tung'ana pokira imiet, nepuonu Laish, nedol iltung'ana apa ootii ine, eneikununo oltonei lenye te seriani, te mpukunoto oo le Sidon, eitirring'a nememuso, meeta entoki nabo e nkop nang'or, neeta karsisisho, o eneba elakuaniki ile Sidon nemeeta enaporokinore likae tung'ani.

English: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say ye?
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ninche enetii ilalashera lenye te Sora o Eshtaol, nejoki ilalashera lenye ninche, “Kainyoo intae ilimumu?”

English: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are ye still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Entudumunye, maape iyiook aarare ninche; amu kitoduaa iyiook ina kop, naa ng'ura, kepir oleng. Eimiatata intae eniaasiasa? Emiyieta intae te lototo, kake entijing atua ina kop embung'a.

English: When ye go, ye shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for God hath given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.
Masaai: Ti nipuopuo intae, naa ipuopuo aainepu iltung'ana lememuso. Kelala ina kop; ee, eishorua Enkai apik atua nkaik inyi, ewueji nemeeta entoki hoo nabo ena kop nemetii.”

English: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
Masaai: Nedumunye iltung'ana iip ile lo losho le Dan, ootanapate too roparen o larrabal, nepuo eing'uaa Sora o Eshtaol,

English: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjathjearim, in Judah: wherefore they called that place Mahanehdan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjathjearim.
Masaai: neilep aapuo neitayu ilng'oborri te Kiriat-Yearim ti atua Yuda. Ore te nkaraki ena naa keji ine wueji Mahanedan o taata; ng'ura, etii enkalo o loo ntoluo le Kiriat-yearim.

English: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
Masaai: Negiroo ninche ine nepuo ina kop oo ndoinyo e Efraim, nepuonu enkaji e Mika.

English: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do ye know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what ye have to do.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo tung'ana apa imiet ooshomo aaikitalan enkop e Laish lelo alashera lenye, “Iyiololo intae aajo ore atua kuna ajijik netii enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o Terafim e nkitanyaanyukoto naaguetuno o naasholuno? Ore naa taata entayiolo eniaasiasa.”

English: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino ninche ine, nepuonu enkaji e ilo barnoti le Lawi te nkang e Mika, neikilikuan ninye ilomon lenyena.

English: And the six hundred men appointed with their weapons of war, which were of the children of Dan, stood by the entering of the gate.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo tung'ana iip ile le Dan, ootanapate too roparen enye o larrabal, neitashe te nejing'ieki kishomi;

English: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up, and came in thither, and took the graven image, and the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image: and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war.
Masaai: ore lelo tung'ana imiet apa ooshomo aaikeern enkop neilep aapuo, nejing atua nepuo aaitayu ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, ina kila o lgoo oolapolosak, o enkitanyaanyukoto o Terafim, o ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno, ina kata eitashe olapolosani te mbata ewueji nejing'ieki kishomi te nebo lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootanapate too masaa enye o larrabal.

English: And these went into Micah's house, and fetched the carved image, the ephod, and the teraphim, and the molten image. Then said the priest unto them, What do ye?
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuo kulo atua enkaji e Mika neya ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, o enkila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o Terafim, o ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno, nejoki ilo apolosani ninche, “Kainyoo intae iasitata?”

English: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tigirayu, tipika enkaina ino enkutuk ino, nilotu te nebo iyiook, niaku te iyiook papa o lapolosani. Kenaikash iyie ti niaku olapolosani te nkaji o ltung'ani obo, anaa ei ti niaku olapolosani to losho to lmarei le Israel?”

English: And the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.
Masaai: Neshipayu oltau le ilo apolosani; neitayu ninye ina kila o lgoo oo lapolosak, o Terafim ina kitanyaanyukoto naguetuno, nelo ninye te nebo lelo tung'ana.

English: So they turned and departed, and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them.
Masaai: Neibelekenya ninche nepuo, nepik nkera kutiti o nchoo o masaa dukuya ninche.

English: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men that were in the houses near to Micah's house were gathered together, and overtook the children of Dan.
Masaai: Ore eshomo ninche aalam enkang e Mika, neishiruni iltung'ana ootii nkajijik ootaaniki enkaji e Mika, nepuo ninche aainepu lelo tung'ana le Dan.
