English: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak loo Lfilisti nepuo te maa iip o too nkalifuni, ore Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena nepuo ninche te siadi te nebo Akish,

English: Then said the princes of the Philistines, What do these Hebrews here? And Achish said unto the princes of the Philistines, Is not this David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, which hath been with me these days, or these years, and I have found no fault in him since he fell unto me unto this day?
Masaai: nejo ilkituaak le njore loo Lfilisti, “Kainyoo easita kulo Hebrania tene?” Nejoki Akish lelo kituaak le njore loo Lfilisti, “Aime Daudi ele, osinka le Saul, olaiguanani le Israel, otaa ninye te nebo nanu too nkolong'i o too larin, naa ore anaa neing'uaa ninye alotu enatii nanu eitu atum entorroni ti atua ninye o metabaiki ena olong.”

English: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him, Make this fellow return, that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him, and let him not go down with us to battle, lest in the battle he be an adversary to us: for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master? should it not be with the heads of these men?
Masaai: Kake etagorokinote ilkituaak le njore oo lfilisti ninye; nejoki ninye ilkituaak le njore oo lfilisti, “Tushuko ele tung'ani, pee etum atorrinyoyu ashomo ewueji apa nitiaaka ninye; medoyio ninye alo te nebo iyiook olarrabal, meaku ake to larrabal olmang'atinta te iyiook. amu kaji eiko ele tung'ani te neitayu osotua o lkitok lenye. Aime too lukuny e kulo tung'ana tene?

English: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
Masaai: Aime ele Daudi, oshi ilo oranyakino maate too sinkolioitin ejo: ‘Etaara Saul inkalifuni enyena, near Daudi nkalifuni tomon enyena!’ ”

English: Then Achish called David, and said unto him, Surely, as the LORD liveth, thou hast been upright, and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight: for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day: nevertheless the lords favour thee not.
Masaai: Neipotu Akish Daudi nejoki ninye, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, isiligayu oshi iyie, ore te nanu kadol aa sidai te nilo apuku nijing te nebo nanu to larrabal, amu eitu nanu atum entoki torrono ti atua iyie ebaiki enkolong apa elotunoto ino niewuo enatii o metabaiki ena olong. Ore ake eyia mikinyorraa ilkituaak.

English: Wherefore now return, and go in peace, that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines.
Masaai: Neaku tushukoyu shomo taata, naa shomo te seriani, pee mintagor ake ilkituaak loo Lfilisti.”

English: And David said unto Achish, But what have I done? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day, that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Akish, “Kake kaa nanu ataasa? Kainyoo iyie inoto to sinka lino ebaiki enkolong apa natijing'a enkisiaayiare ino o taata, nchere malo nanu aarare ilmang'ati lo kitok lai olaiguanani?”

English: And Achish answered and said to David, I know that thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
Masaai: Newaliki Akish Daudi ajoki, “Ayiolo ajo miata eleyiata too nkonyek aainei anaa olmalaika le Nkai; ore ake eyia, etejo ilkituaak le njore loo lfilisti, ‘Meilep ninye alo te nebo iyiook olarrabal.’

English: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
Masaai: Ore naa tayooki tudumunye tadekenya te nebo isinkan lelo lo lkitok lino apa ooetuo te nebo iyie, nipuopuo anaa ake pee ewang'aki intae.”

English: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena aayooki tadekenya, aashuko aapuo enkop oo lfilisti. Kake eshomo Ilfilisti Yesreel.

English: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata pee elotu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena Siklag te nkolong e uni, netaara Ilmaleki Negeb o Siklag. Eisulie ninche Siklag nepejoo te nkima.

English: And had taken the women captives, that were therein: they slew not any, either great or small, but carried them away, and went on their way.
Masaai: Neya nkituaak o pooki ootii atua, ilooti o lkituaak; eitu ear hoo ng'ae metua, kake etanapa ninche aaya, nepuo enkoitoi enye.

English: So David and his men came to the city, and, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captives.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena ina anasa, neinepu etapejoki te nkima, ore nkituaak enye o layiok lenye o ntoyie enye netaraayioki aaya.

English: Then David and the people that were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o ltung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye neyietu aaishir o metaba anaa neaku meeta engolon naishirie.

English: And David's two wives were taken captives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
Masaai: Ore nkituaak pokira are e Daudi newaki sii ninche aaraya, Ahinoam e Yesreel o Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel.

English: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
Masaai: Nenyamalu Daudi oleng; amu ejo iltung'ana pee enang ninye too soito, enkaraki etamioto iltung'ana pooki too ltauja, oltung'ani ake too layiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena. Kake eitagolo Daudi kewan ti atua Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And David said to Abiathar the priest, Ahimelech's son, I pray thee, bring me hither the ephod. And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Abiatar olapolosani, olayioni le Ahimelek, “Iyakaki nanu enkila dorrop.” Neaku eyaka Abiatar ina kila dorrop Daudi.

English: And David enquired at the LORD, saying, Shall I pursue after this troop? shall I overtake them? And he answered him, Pursue: for thou shalt surely overtake them, and without fail recover all.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Amaa, kasujaa nanu ele wuampa Kamir nanu ninche?” Newaliki ninye ninye, “Tusujai, amu esipa imir, nesipa imitu akordu.”

English: So David went, he and the six hundred men that were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those that were left behind stayed.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi o lelo tung'ana iip ile apa ootii te nebo ninye nepuonu ninche oreyiet te Besor, ina netonie lelo ooing'uari te siadi.

English: But David pursued, he and four hundred men: for two hundred abode behind, which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Daudi agiroo ine te sujaroto, ninye o ltung'ana iip ong'uan; netoni iltung'ana iip are te siadi, lelo apa oonaurate oleng leitu eidim aatalang oreyiet le Besor.

English: And they found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to David, and gave him bread, and he did eat; and they made him drink water;
Masaai: Netum ninche Olmisiri te nkop naisiaja, neyau ninye enetii Daudi; neisho ninche emukate nenya ninye, neisho enkare naok,

English: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
Masaai: neisho ninche ninye embelati e mukate oo lng'abolo o nkimarrat are oo sabibu. Ore ake pee enya ninye, nepiu oltau lenye; amu eitu apa ninye enya endaa arashu eok enkare too nkolong'i uni o nkewaritin uni.

English: And David said unto him, To whom belongest thou? and whence art thou? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days agone I fell sick.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Aira iyie oleng'ae? Naa kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejo ninye, “Ara nanu olbarnoti le Misiri, osinka lo Lamaleki; naatung'uayie nanu olkitok enkaraki natamueyia too nkolong'i uni naatulusoitie.

English: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
Masaai: Kitaara apa iyiook Negeb oo Lkerite o ina nara ene Yuda o Negeb e Kaleb; nikipejoo Siklag te nkima.”

English: And David said to him, Canst thou bring me down to this company? And he said, Swear unto me by God, that thou wilt neither kill me, nor deliver me into the hands of my master, and I will bring thee down to this company.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Eikirik enetii ilo wuampa?” Nejo ninye, “Inosakaki nanu olmumai te Nkai, nchere mikiar matua, arashu kiya nanu apik atua nkaik o lkitok lai, naa kaarik enetii ele wuampa.”

English: And when he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad upon all the earth, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Judah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku etoriko ninye aitadoyio, ng'ura, eidapashate ninche te nkop pooki, edaa neokisho neranyisho, te nkaraki nena tokitin kumok naataarutua te nkop oo Lfilisti o te nkop e Yuda.

English: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day: and there escaped not a man of them, save four hundred young men, which rode upon camels, and fled.
Masaai: Near Daudi ninche aiteru teipa o metabaiki enteipa e nkae olong. neitu eisik hoo obo lenye, meteleku ilbarnot iip ong'uan apa ookedito ntamesin neisik.

English: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
Masaai: Nerrinyu Daudi nena pooki apa naataaraitie Ilmaleki; nekordu Daudi nkituaak enyena pokira are.

English: And there was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor any thing that they had taken to them: David recovered all.
Masaai: Neitu eimin toki aa kiti o aa sapuk, ilayiok arashu ntoyie, imasaa arashu ae toki apa nawaki; eyaua Daudi ashuku pooki.

English: And David took all the flocks and the herds, which they drave before those other cattle, and said, This is David's spoil.
Masaai: Eibung'a sii apa Daudi nkerrai pooki o nchoo; nereu iltung'ana nena shoo te dukuya ninye, nejo, “Iyarunot e Daudi kuna.”

English: And David came to the two hundred men, which were so faint that they could not follow David, whom they had made also to abide at the brook Besor: and they went forth to meet David, and to meet the people that were with him: and when David came near to the people, he saluted them.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi alotu enetii lelo tung'ana apa iip are oonaurate oleng neitu esuj Daudi, neing'uari apa ninche to erata le Besor; neipang ninche aapuo aanang'are Daudi nenang'are lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye; ore pee elotu Daudi anyikaki iltung'ana neiroroki ninche.

English: Then answered all the wicked men and men of Belial, of those that went with David, and said, Because they went not with us, we will not give them ought of the spoil that we have recovered, save to every man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki arruok o ltung'ana oora pesho apa ooshomo te nebo Daudi nejo, “Ore enkaraki neitu ninche epuo te nebo iyiook, mikincho iyiook ninche toki e kuna yarunot nikitushukutuo, meteleku ake nchere keidim pooki ng'ae atoriko enkitok enye o nkera, nelo.”

English: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
Masaai: Kake etejo Daudi, “Minkoko neijia, ilalashera laainei, te ina naishoo iyiook Olaitoriani; etagolie ninye iyiook neishoru apik atua enkaina ang ilo wuampa apa oewuo aar iyiook.

English: For who will hearken unto you in this matter? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle, so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff: they shall part alike.
Masaai: Kaing'ae oinining intae tena bae? Amu ore anaa enatiu erubata e ilo olo olarrabal, neijia sii etiu erubata e ilo oton too lolan keng'ar ninche aaitoris.”

English: And it was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina olong neito dukuya neitaa ina nkiguanat o nkitanapat te Israel o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the LORD;
Masaai: Ore apa elotu Daudi Siklag, neiteng'el embata oo yarunot pee eisho ilchoreta lenyena, ilpayiani le Yuda; ejo, “Nena enkishoroto te intae naing'uaa nena naaruno too lmang'ati lo Laitoriani;”

English: To them which were in Bethel, and to them which were in south Ramoth, and to them which were in Jattir,
Masaai: ene lelo ootii Betel, o lootii Ramot e Negeb, te Yatir,

English: And to them which were in Aroer, and to them which were in Siphmoth, and to them which were in Eshtemoa,
Masaai: ootii Aroer, o Sifmot, o Eshtemoa,

English: And to them which were in Rachal, and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites,
Masaai: otii Rakal atua inkanas oo Ljerahami, o nkanas oo Lkeni,

English: And to them which were in Hormah, and to them which were in Chorashan, and to them which were in Athach,
Masaai: ootii Horma, o Borashan, o Atak,

English: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
Masaai: ootii Hebron, too wuejitin pooki neeshomo Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena.

English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
Masaai: Nearare apa Ilfilisti Israel; neipirri iltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Ilfilisti neidaikieki to Ldoinyo le Gilboa.

English: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Melchishua, Saul's sons.
Masaai: Neinepu Ilfilisti Saul o layiok lenyena; near Ilfilisti Yonatan o Abinadab o Malikishua, lelo ayiok le Saul.

English: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.
Masaai: Neitirrishaki olarrabal Saul oleng, netum ninye ilang'orok loo mbaa, netum olbae torrono te lelo ang'orok loo mbaa.

English: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul ilo anapani lenye loo ruparen, “Intayu olalem lino taremoki meipanga te nanu, maapuonu ake kulo lememurata aa ng'ung'ur nanu, naaitaa nanu enkiguran.” Kake meidim ilo anapani lenye loo ruparen; amu eturia oleng. Neaku eitayio Saul olalem lenye makewan, nebatatakino.

English: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword, and died with him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ilo anapani lenye loo ruparen ajo etua Saul, nebatatakino sii ninye olalem lenye, neye te nebo ninye.

English: So Saul died, and his three sons, and his armourbearer, and all his men, that same day together.
Masaai: Neaku etua Saul o layiok lenyena pokira okuni, o lanapani lenye loo ruparen, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki, te nkolong nabo te nebo.

English: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley, and they that were on the other side Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana le Israel apa ootii likae kekun o erata o lekua ootii te idia alo Yordan nchere eisika iltung'ana le Israel, netua Saul o layiok lenyena, neing'uaa ninche inkang'itie enye neisik; nepuonu Ilfilisti nebik ti atua ninche.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu, ore pee epuonu Ilfilisti aapur lelo ootaraki metuata, netum ninche Saul o layiok lenyena pokira okuni eirrag to Oldoinyo le Gilboa.

English: And they cut off his head, and stripped off his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to publish it in the house of their idols, and among the people.
Masaai: Nedung'oo ninche endukuya enye, nelaku iruparen neirriwaa ilkiliku ti atua enkop pooki oo lfilisti, mewaita ilomon sidain aayaki inkaitin enye o ltung'ana.

English: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth: and they fastened his body to the wall of Bethshan.
Masaai: Nepik iruparen o larrabal enkaji e nkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Ashtarot; nesheiki osesen lenye esuntai e Bet-shan.

English: And when the inhabitants of  Jabeshgilead heard of that which the Philistines had done to Saul;
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening lelo oomanya Yabesh-Gilead ina naitaasa Ilfilisti Saul,

English: All the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Bethshan, and came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
Masaai: nedumunye iltung'ana pooki oopi, nepuo enkewarie pooki, neitayu osesen le Saul o seseni loo layiok lenyena aaitung'uaa esuntai e Bet-shan; nepuonu ninche Yabesh nepejoo ninche te ine.

English: And they took their bones, and buried them under a tree at Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
Masaai: Neya iloik lenye nenukaa ti abori olchani oji olkuaju te Yabesh, nepukoo ninche nkolong'i naapishana.

English: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and David had abode two days in Ziklag;
Masaai: Ore eidipa Saul atua eidipa Daudi atushukunye te mutata oo Lmaleki, neton Daudi nkolong'i are te Siklag;

English: It came even to pass on the third day, that, behold, a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent, and earth upon his head: and so it was, when he came to David, that he fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
Masaai: ore te nkolong e uni, ng'ura, nelotu oltung'ani oing'uaa ilng'oborri le Saul, epolosa nkilani enyena netii enterit endukuya enye. Ore ake pee elotu enetii Daudi, neirrugo abaiki enkop nesai ninye.

English: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Nejoki, “Kaisikua nanu aing'uaa ilng'oborri le Israel.”

English: And David said unto him, How went the matter? I pray thee, tell me. And he answered, That the people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kaji eikunari mbaa? Tolikioki nanu.” Newalu ninye, nejo “Eisika iltung'ana aaing'uaa olarrabal, ore sii ilkumok loo ltung'ana neirragaa etuata ore Saul o olayioni lenye Yonatan etuata sii ninche.”

English: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ilo barnoti otiaka ninye, “Kainyoo nikintayiolo iyie nchere etua Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye?”

English: And the young man that told him said, As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa, behold, Saul leaned upon his spear; and, lo, the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo barnoti apa otiaka ninye, “Aishiaakinore ake duoo atii enchumata oldoinyo le Gilboa; netii Saul airishakino empere enye, naa ng'ura, etinyikakitia ngarrin o lakedok loo mbartan emir ninye.

English: And when he looked behind him, he saw me, and called unto me. And I answered, Here am I.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eingor siadi enye, naadol nanu, naaipot. Nairukisho nanu ajo, ‘Nele nanu.’

English: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye, ‘Ira iyie alo?’ Nawaliki, ‘Ara nanu Olmaleki.’

English: He said unto me again, Stand, I pray thee, upon me, and slay me: for anguish is come upon me, because my life is yet whole in me.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, ‘Ntasho te mbata nanu tasesekuanaki; amu aanoto nanu osina, neton ake eishu enkishui ai ti atua nanu.’

English: So I stood upon him, and slew him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was upon his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them hither unto my lord.
Masaai: Neaku aitasho nanu te mbata ninye, nasesekuan ninye, amu aitisipa ajo meidim anyaaki atopuaa eidipa atabatatayu; naya ilo marisian apa le nkitoo otii endukuya enye o lkataar apa otii enkaina enye, nayaua ninche ene netii olkitok lai.”

English: Then David took hold on his clothes, and rent them; and likewise all the men that were with him:
Masaai: Neibung Daudi nkilani enyena, nepolos, neiko sii neijia lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye;

English: And they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Saul, and for Jonathan his son, and for the people of the LORD, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
Masaai: neishir ninche neitayu ilkiyio nepukoo o metaa teipa te nkaraki Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye o te nkaraki iltung'ana lo Laitoriani o te nkaraki enkaji e Israel, enkaraki etabatatate ninche to lalem.

English: And David said unto the young man that told him, Whence art thou? And he answered, I am the son of a stranger, an Amalekite.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ilo barnoti apa otiaaka ninye, “Kaji iyie ing'uaa?” Newaliki, “Ara nanu olayioni leilo omoni lo Lmaleki.”

English: And David said unto him, How wast thou not afraid to stretch forth thine hand to destroy the LORD'S anointed?
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee eitu iureyu idumu enkaina ino ainyal ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput?”

English: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
Masaai: Neipotu Daudi obo loo lbarnot nejoki, “Shomo, taara ninye metua.” Neosh oltung'ani Olmaleki metua.

English: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD'S anointed.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ninye, “Metaa osarge lino shumata endukuya ino; amu enkutuk ino kewan nikinchakenoko iyie, ejo, ‘Atasesekuana nanu ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput.’ ”

English: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
Masaai: Nerany Daudi ele sinkolio le nkishirata, aishiraki Saul o Yonatan olayioni lenye.

English: (Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.)
Masaai: nejo ninye keiteng'eni iltung'ana le Yuda; ng'ura kesira te mbuku e Yashar. Nejo:

English: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
Masaai: “Etua enkitoo ino, iyie Israel, etasesekuanaki te shumata iwuejitin inono neeika! Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil!

English: Tell it not in Gath, publish it not in the streets of Askelon; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
Masaai: Milikioo ena te Gas, emintubulaa ena too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa e Askelon; meng'idayu ake intoyie oo Lfilisti, mewuasayu ake ntoyie e lelo lememurata.

English: Ye mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew, neither let there be rain, upon you, nor fields of offerings: for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away, the shield of Saul, as though he had not been anointed with oil.
Masaai: “Intae ildoinyo le Gilboa, nchoo metaa metii empaso arashu enchan shumata intae arashu enkaitubului nabulu te nkop! Amu te ine eidurukieki elong'o e ilo magilani, elong'o e Saul, eitu eelieki eilata.

English: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan turned not back, and the sword of Saul returned not empty.
Masaai: “To sarge le lelo oosesekuani, te ilata e lelo magil, eitu eshuko enkawuo e Yonatan, neitu eshukunye olalem le Saul erok.

English: Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
Masaai: “Saul o Yonatan oonyorri naa shaati! Ore te nkishui o te keeya merisha ninche; neneneng ninche aalang ilkurragoso, negol ninche aalang ilng'atunyo.

English: Ye daughters of Israel, weep over Saul, who clothed you in scarlet, with other delights, who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel.
Masaai: “Intae ntoyie oo Siraeli enchiraki Saul, oishopo intae too kilani naanyokioo, neikodo nkilani inyi te sahabu.

English: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! O Jonathan, thou wast slain in thine high places.
Masaai: “Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil, te mpolos o larrabal! “Eirrag Yonatan etasesekuanaki te nchumata oo wuejitin inono neeika

English: I am distressed for thee, my brother Jonathan: very pleasant hast thou been unto me: thy love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
Masaai: Aisinanuo te nkaraki iye olalashe lai Yonatan; eikishipakino apa iyie nanu oleng; ore apa enyorrata ino te nanu naa enking'asia, kegiroo enyorrata oo nkituaak.

English: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
Masaai: “Kaji eikunakinote embatatata lelo magil, ore imasaa o larrabal nerruoyo!”

English: And it came to pass after this, that David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah? And the LORD said unto him, Go up. And David said, Whither shall I go up? And he said, Unto Hebron.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, “Kailep nanu alo atua ae nabo oo nkang'itie e Yuda?” Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Ilepa shomo.” Nejo Daudi, “Kaa ailep alo?” Nejo ninye, “Shomo Hebron.”

English: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
Masaai: Neaku eilepa Daudi nelo ine, te nebo sii nkituaak enyena pokira are, Ahinoam e Yesreel o Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel.

English: And his men that were with him did David bring up, every man with his household: and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron.
Masaai: Neyau Daudi ailepunye lelo tung'ana lenyena apa ootii te nebo ninye, oltung'ani ake o enkaji enye; nebik ninche too nkang'itie e Hebron.

English: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. And they told David, saying, That the men of  Jabeshgilead were they that buried Saul.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltungana le Yuda, nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput teine aaitaa olaiguanani le nkaji e Yuda. Ore ake pee eliki ninche Daudi aajoki, “Iltung'ana le Yabesh Gilead apa ootunukaitie Saul,”

English: And David sent messengers unto the men of  Jabeshgilead, and said unto them, Blessed be ye of the LORD, that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord, even unto Saul, and have buried him.
Masaai: neirriwaki Daudi ilkiliku lelo tung'ana le Yabesh gilead, nejoki ninche, “Entaa intae iloomayiana to Laitoriani, enkaraki nintodolutua intae ena anyit te Saul, olkitok linyi, ninukaa ninye!

English: And now the LORD shew kindness and truth unto you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because ye have done this thing.
Masaai: Meitodua intae Olaitoriani enyorrata nauno o enkisiligata! Naa kaitaas nanu intae esidai enkaraki nitaasa ena bae.

English: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
Masaai: Ore naa enchoo metagolo nkaik inyi, nipijuju; amu etua Saul olkitok linyi, naatubukokitio nanu enkaji e Yuda eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata ninche.”

English: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
Masaai: Ore apa Abna olayioni le Ner, olkitok le njore e Saul, neya Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, neyau ninye Mahanaim,

English: And made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
Masaai: neitaa Abna ninye olaiguanani te shumata Gilead o Ashuri o Yesreel o Efraim o Benchamen o Israel pooki.

English: Ishbosheth Saul's son was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.
Masaai: Ore apa Ishboshet, ilo ayioni le Saul, naa ilarin artam ina kata pee eiteru aitore Israel, neitore ninye ilarin oare. Kake etusujaitie enkaji e Yuda Daudi.

English: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.
Masaai: Ore enkata apa nara Daudi olaiguanani te Hebron te shumata enkaji e Yuda naa ilarin oopishana o lapaitin ile.

English: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
Masaai: Ore Abna olayioni le Ner o sinkan le Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, neipang aapuo te Mahanaim nepuo Gibeon.

English: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
Masaai: Ore Yoab olayioni le Seruiya, o sinkan le Daudi, neipang aapuo nenang'are ninche te nchorro e Gibeon; netoni ninche, obo te nchoto nabo e nchorro o likae te nkae shoto e nchorro.

English: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
Masaai: Nejoki Abna Yoab, “Nchoo ilbarnot edumunye aarany te dukuya iyiook.” Nejo Yoab, “Nchoo edumunye ninche.”

English: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
Masaai: Kaae nedumunye ninche nepuo te siana enye, tomon oare ile Benchamen o Ishboshet ilo ayioni le Saul, o tomon oare loo sinkin le Daudi.

English: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
Masaai: Neibung ake oltung'ani ilo oarare endukuya nerrumoki olalem lenye eluboto e ilo oarare; neaku etabatatate te nebo. Neaku etejoki apa ine wueji Helkat-hasurim, naa Gibeon etii.

English: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before the servants of David.
Masaai: Nerrishu olarrabal ina olong, nemiri Abna o ltung'ana loo Siraeli te dukuya isinkan le Daudi.

English: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.
Masaai: Netii apa ine ilayiok pokira okuni le Seruiya, Yoab, Abishai o Asahel. Naa keneneng apa Asahel too nkejek anaa enkolii e ong'ata;

English: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
Masaai: nemir Asahel Abna, ore eloito nemeibelekenya aing'or enkaina e tatene arashu enkaina e kedienye esujaa Abna.

English: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Art thou Asahel? And he answered, I am.
Masaai: Nenang Abna silig nejo, “Kaiyie Asahel?” Newalu ninye, nejo “Ee nanu.”

English: And Abner said to him, Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left, and lay thee hold on one of the young men, and take thee his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
Masaai: Nejoki Abna ninye, “Shomo enkaina ino e tatene arashu ene kedienye, imbung'a obo loo lbarnot, pee iya nena naataarua ninye.” Kake meyieu Asahel neibelekenya te sujata enye.

English: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
Masaai: Neitoki Abna aigil ajoki Asahel, “Shomo mikintoki asuj kainyoo pee aar nanu iyie tua? Kaji naa aiko te nashumaki enkomom ai olalashe lino Yoab?”

English: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
Masaai: Kake etanya ninye elo aapaash neaku etaremo Abna ninye enkoshoke to lng'urrat le mpere enye, neaku eipang'ua empere te nkoriong enye, nebatata ninye te ine, neye te ine apa netii. Ore lelo apa pooki ooetuo ine wueji netabatatare Asahel neye, neitashe aaitirring'a.

English: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lieth before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
Masaai: Kake etimira Yoab o Abishai Abna; ore edoyio enkolong nepuonu ninche oldoinyo le Ama, laa ninye otii dukuya Gia te nkoitoi nalo olpurkel le Gibeon.

English: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
Masaai: Neiturrurro tenebo iltung'ana le Benchamen te siadi Abna, neaku olwuampa obo, neitashe te ntopij o ldoinyo.

English: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren?
Masaai: Neipot Abna Yoab, nejoki, “Amaa, keaku kedaa olalem ntarasi? Aimiyiolo ajo keduaru enkiting'oto? Kebaa kenya enkata pee imbok iltung'ana linono metapala emirata oo lalashera lenye?”

English: And Joab said, As God liveth, unless thou hadst spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
Masaai: Nejo Yoab, “Anaa enaishu Enkai, te neme iroro, esipa anaata etapala iltung'ana esujata oo lalashera lenye tadekenya.”

English: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
Masaai: Neaku etoosho Yoab emowuo; neitashe iltung'ana pooki, neitu eitoki aasujaa Israel, arashu eitoki aara.

English: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
Masaai: Ore Abna o ltung'ana lenyena nepuo ina kewarie pooki nepuo aaim atua Araba; nelang ninche olkeju le Yordan, nepuo entadekenya pooki o meetu Mahanaim.

English: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
Masaai: Neshukunye Yoab te mirata e Abna; ore ake pee eidip aiturrurro iltung'ana pooki te nebo, nemetii isinkan le Daudi iltung'ana tomon ooudo metii Asahel.

English: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner's men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.
Masaai: Kake etaara isinkan le Daudi iltung'ana iip uni o ntomoni ile metuata too ltung'ana le Abna lo losho le Benchamen.

English: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Bethlehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
Masaai: Neya Yoab o ltung'ana lenyena osesen le Asahel, nenukaa te nkurare e papaai lenye, apa natii Betlehem. Nelo Yoab o ltung'ana lenyena enkewarie pooki, neilepaki ninche enkolong te Hebron.

English: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
Masaai: Etii apa te nkata naado olarrabal te rishata enkaji e Saul o enkaji e Daudi; neponari Daudi agolu edoyio enkaji e Saul ashalu.

English: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
Masaai: Neikini Daudi ilayiok te Hebron: ore olkikau lenye naa Amnon, le Ahinoam e Yesreel;

English: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
Masaai: ore oliare, Kileab, le Abigail ina oliai apa e Nabal le Karmel; ore oliokuni, Absalom olayioni le Maaka ina tito e Talmai olaiguanani le Geshur;

English: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
Masaai: ore oliong'uan, Adonija olayioni le Hagis; ore oleimiet, Sefatia olayioni le Abital;

English: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David's wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
Masaai: ore olayioni le ile, Isrem, le Egla, enkitok e Daudi. Etoikioki kulo Daudi te Hebron.

English: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
Masaai: Ore etii olarrabal erishata e nkaji e Saul o enkaji e Daudi, neitagolito Abna kewan ti atua enkaji e Saul.

English: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ishbosheth said to Abner, Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father's concubine?
Masaai: Neeta apa Saul enkapiani naji enkarna Rispa, entito e Aia; nejoki Ishboshet Abna, “Kainyoo pee ishomo iyie ajing'aki enkapiani e papaai lai?”

English: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
Masaai: Negoro oleng Abna te lelo rorei le Ishboshet, nejo, “Kara nanu endukuya o ldia le Yuda? Ore ena olong eton ake aitodolu enkanyit te nkaji e Saul papaai lino, too lalashera lenyena, o too lchoreta lenyena, neton eitu aaishooyo iyie apik nkaik e Daudi; ore taata niking'uanare nanu te nkaraki enkitok.

English: So do God to Abner, and more also, except, as the LORD hath sworn to David, even so I do to him;
Masaai: Metaasa sii Enkai ena te Abna, neitulusoo sii, te neitu nanu aitabaya te Daudi ina apa nainosakinye Olaitoriani ninye olmumai,

English: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.
Masaai: aitarasaa enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaji e Saul, neitasheyie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi te shumata Israel o te shumata Yuda, ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba.”

English: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
Masaai: Neitu eitoki Ishboshet aidimu atawaliki Abna likae omoni, amu eturia ninye.

English: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make thy league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with thee, to bring about all Israel unto thee.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Abna ilkiliku enetii Daudi te Hebron, ejo, “Keneng'ae ena kop? Intobira olning'o lino o nanu, naa ng'ura keaku enkaina ai te nebo iyie pee ayau Israel pooki enitii iyie.”

English: And he said, Well; I will make a league with thee: but one thing I require of thee, that is, Thou shalt not see my face, except thou first bring Michal Saul's daughter, when thou comest to see my face.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Sidai; Kaitobir nanu olning'o o iyie; kake nabo toki nanu aayieunye iyie; nchere midol iyie enkomom ai, arashu ake te niyau Mikal, entito e Saul, te nikilotu adol enkomom ai.”

English: And David sent messengers to Ishbosheth Saul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Daudi ilkiliku Ishboshet olayioni le Saul, ejoki, “Nchooki nanu enkitok ai Mikal, naa ninye apa atisira te nkinyang'a oo suaten iip oo Lfilisti.”

English: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Ishboshet ilkiliku, neya ninye aitung'uaa olmoruo lenye Paltiel olayioni le Laish.

English: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
Masaai: Kake eshomo olmoruo lenye te nebo ninye, eishir asujaa ninye te nkoitoi pooki o metabai Bahurim. Nejoki Abna ninye, “Shomo, torrinyoyu;” nerrinyo ninye.

English: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you:
Masaai: Neiguanakini Abna te nebo ilpayiani le Israel, ejo, “Ore te nkata naje natulusoyie ning'oruru intae Daudi aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata intae.

English: Now then do it: for the LORD hath spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entabai intae; amu eitanapa Olaitoriani Daudi, ejo, ‘Te nkaina o sinka lai Daudi aitajeu nanu iltung'ana laainei Israel aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti; naitung'uaa enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye pooki.’ ”

English: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
Masaai: Neirorie sii Abna Benchamen; neitoki Abna alo aliki Daudi te Hebron nena pooki naatodua Israel; pooki o enkaji e Benchamen pooki aajo sidain te neas.

English: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Abna te nebo iltung'ana tikitam enetii Daudi te Hebron, neitobiraki Daudi osirua Abna o lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo ninye.

English: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with thee, and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
Masaai: Nejoki Abna Daudi, “Kadumunye nanu alo, naa kaiturrurroki Israel pooki olkitok lai olaiguanani, pee etum ninche aaitobira olning'o o iyie, pee itum iyie aitoreisho te shumata nena pooki naayieu oltau lino.” Neaku eishoo Daudi Abna meshomo; nelo ninye te serian.

English: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata nebau lelo sinkan le Daudi te nebo Yoab eing'uaa enjore, neyau iyarunot kumok te nebo ninche. Kake metii apa Abna te nebo Daudi te Hebron, amu eishoo ninye meshomo, nelo ninye te seriani.

English: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he hath sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau Yoab o ina jore pooki apa natii te nebo ninye, nejokini Yoab, “Eewuo Abna olayioni le Ner enetii olaiguanani, neishoo ninye meshomo, neshomo ninye te seriani.”

English: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What hast thou done? behold, Abner came unto thee; why is it that thou hast sent him away, and he is quite gone?
Masaai: Nelo Yoab enetii olaiguanani nejo, “Kaa iyie itaasa? Ng'ura eewuo Abna enitii, kainyoo pee inchoo ninye meshomo, neaku eshomo?

English: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive thee, and to know thy going out and thy coming in, and to know all that thou doest.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie ajo kiewuo Abna ilo ayioni le Ner alej, neyiolou elototo ino e boo o elotunoto ino e atua, neyiolou nena pooki niasita.”

English: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
Masaai: Ore eipang'u Yoab aing'uaa ine aing'uaa ine netii Daudi, neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku metusujai Abna, nerik ninye aashuku teilo kesumet le Sira; kake eitu eyiolou Daudi ina.

English: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
Masaai: Ore ake pee errinyunye Abna Hebron, neya Yoab ninye enkilepata te mpolos e kishomi pee eiro te nebo ninye too nkurrat, ore te ine nerem ninye enkoshoke, neye ninye, te nkaraki ilo sarge le Asahel olalashe lenye.

English: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before the LORD for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
Masaai: Ore te siadi, ina kata pee ening Daudi ina, nejo ninye, “Ore nanu o enkitoria ai mikiata entioto ntarasi te dukuya o Laitoriani te nkaraki osarge le Abna ilo ayioni le Ner.

English: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falleth on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
Masaai: Metaa endukuya e Yoab edoiki o enchumata enkaji pooki e papaai lenye; naa nchoo metaa melai aekata te nkaji e Yoab oltung'ani oata nkimek arashu enkeeya oo lbolot arashu oloibung'i entirma arashu olosesekuani to lalem, arashu ololau endaa.”

English: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
Masaai: Kaae near metua Yoab o Abishai olalashe lenye Abna, enkaraki etara apa ninye metua olalashe lenye Asahel ti atua olarrabal te Gibeon.

English: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki Yoab o lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye, “Entopolos inkilani inyi, nirrotianana ilkuniyiani, ninchirishiri te dukuya Abna.” Nesujaa olaiguanani Daudi ilo sanduku otii osesen.

English: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche Abna te Hebron, neyietu olaiguanani aishir te nkurare e Abna; neishir iltung'ana pooki.

English: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
Masaai: Nerany olaiguanani osinkolio lo lkiyioi, ejo “Keye Abna anaa enaiko olmodai?

English: Thy hands were not bound, nor thy feet put into fetters: as a man falleth before wicked men, so fellest thou. And all the people wept again over him.
Masaai: Meena apa nkaik inono, nemeena apa nkejek inono; Ore anaa enabatata oltung'ani te dukuya lelo torrok itabatate iyie.” Neitoki iltung'ana pooki aaishiraki ninye.

English: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do God to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana pooki aailejilej Daudi meinosa endaa eton aa dama; kake einosa Daudi olmumai, ejo, “Meikuna Enkai neijia te nanu, neitulusoo sii, te naishamisham endaa arashu ae toki eton eitu edoyio enkolong?”

English: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
Masaai: Nedol iltung'ana pooki ina, neitiship ina ninche, amu ore apa pooki toki naas olaiguanani neitiship iltung'ana.

English: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
Masaai: Neaku etayioloito iltung'ana pooki o Israel pooki ina olong nchere mme eyieunoto apa o laiguanani pee ear Abna olayioni le Ner.

English: And the king said unto his servants, Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel?
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, “Aimiyiololo intae aajo olayioni lo laiguanani naa oltung'ani o Turori ena olong te Israel?

English: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: the LORD shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
Masaai: Nashal nanu ena olong, hoo naatubukokoki eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani; ore kulo tung'ana, ayiok le Seruiya naa kegolong'u oleng te nanu. Nchoo elaaki Olaitoriani olarruoni te risioroto enkarruoisho enye!”

English: And when Saul's son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ishboshet, olayioni le Saul, nchere etua Abna te Hebron, neiropijaa empijan enye, ore Israel pooki neiputukuny.

English: And Saul's son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:
Masaai: Neeta apa olayioni le Saul iltung'ana oare laa ilkituaak loo Ltimito le njore; ore enkarna e obo naa Baana, ore enkarna o likae naa Rekab, ilayiok le Rimon oltung'ani le Benchamen oing'uaa Be-erot (amu keyioloi sii apa ninye Be-erot aajo ematua e Benchamen;

English: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
Masaai: eisika apa Ilbeeroti aapuo Gitam netoni ninche te ine o metabaiki ena olong.)

English: And Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
Masaai: Neeta apa Yonatan olayioni le Saul olayioni maima tarrushi nkejek enyena. Naa oloo larin imiet apa ninye ina kata pee epuonu ilomon ooipirta Saul o Yonatan eing'uaa Yesreel; nedumu ninye enkaibung'ani enye, neisik, naa ore eisik te nkisarrisar enye, nebatata, neakunye ine olmaima. Ore apa enkarna enye naa Mefiboshet.

English: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Rimon ilo tung'ani le Be-erot naa Rekab o Baana, nepuo ninche, ore tenkata e nkipirata e nkolong nepuonu ninche enkaji e Ishboshet, etii ninye enkiyeng'iyeng enye a enaipiriee nkolong.

English: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore enkaing'urani e kutuk aji negelita enkano, kake eimugo ninye neirura; neaku etasaakinote Rekab o Baana olalashe lenye atua aji.

English: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing'u ninche atua aji eirrag ninye te ndapash enye ti atua ilo gilata le ndapash, nerem ninye, near metua nedung'u endukuya enye. Neya ninche endukuya enye nepuo aaim enkoitoi e Araba enkewarie pooki,

English: And they brought the head of Ishbosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ishbosheth the son of Saul thine enemy, which sought thy life; and the LORD hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
Masaai: neyau ninche endukuya e Ishboshet, enetii Daudi te Hebron. Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Nena endukuya e Ishboshet, olayioni le Saul, olmang'atinta lino oing'orua apa enkishui ino; eitalaku Olaitoriani elap o lkitok lai olaiguanani ena olong te Saul te ishoi enye.”

English: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As the LORD liveth, who hath redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Daudi Rekab o Baana olalashe lenye, lelo ayiok le Rimon ilo le Be-erot ajoki, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, otokordua enkishui ai aitayu ti atua embatisho pooki,

English: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
Masaai: ore apa pee aajoki oltung'ani obo nanu, ‘Ng'ura, etua Saul.’ Nejo ninye keyaua ilomon sidain, naibung ninye naar ninye metua te Siklag, aa ilo apa olerrinyore laishoo nanu ninye too lomon lenyena.

English: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
Masaai: Kebaa naa elusoo, te netaara iltung'ana torrok oltung'ani supat ti atua enkaji enye te nchumata e ndapash enye, aimaikilikuanu nanu osarge lenye te nkaina inyi, namut intae aiwuang'ie te nkop?”

English: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ishbosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
Masaai: Neitanap Daudi ilbarnot lenyena, metaara ninche metuata, nedung'oo nkaik enye o nkejek, neilili ninche te mbata o lchorro te Hebron. Kake ewaita ninche endukuya e Ishboshet, nenukaa te nkurare e Abna te Hebron.

English: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
Masaai: Nepuonu iloshon pooki loo Siraeli enetii Daudi te Hebron, nejo, “Ng'ura, kira iyiook iloik linono o nkiri o sesen lino.

English: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD said to thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be a captain over Israel.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, apa aa Saul olaiguanani te shumata iyiook, iyie apa otorikoyie aipang'ie niriku aitijing'u Israel; nikijoki Olaitoriani iyie, ‘Iaku iyie olchekut loo ltung'ana laainei, Israel, niaku kitok te shumata Israel.’ ”

English: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the LORD: and they anointed David king over Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eetuo ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli enetii olaiguanani te Hebron; neitobir olaiguanani Daudi olning'o te nebo ninche te Hebron te dukuya o Laitoriani, nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te shumata Israel.

English: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
Masaai: Naa oloo larin tomoni uni apa Daudi pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilarin artam.

English: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah.
Masaai: Ore te Hebron neitore ninye Yuda ilarin oopishana o lapaitin ile; ore te Yerusalem neitore Israel pooki o Yuda ilarin tomoni uni o okuni.

English: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani o ltung'ana lenyena Yerusalem aarare Ilyebusi, lelo oomanya ina kop, apa ootiaakitia Daudi, “Milotu iyie ajing'u atua ene, kake eikimbooyo ninye ilmodook o lmaiman” - ejo, “Meidim ae kata Daudi aeu atua ine.”

English: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
Masaai: Ore eyia eibung'a Daudi eng'ape e Sion, aa taa, enkanasa e Daudi.

English: And David said on that day, Whosoever getteth up to the gutter, and smiteth the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David's soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi te ina olong, “Ore pooki ng'ae olo aar Ilyebusi, nchoo eilep to lbaata le nkare pee erasaki lelo modook o lmaiman, apa ooiba oltau le Daudi.” Neaku etejoki, “Ore olmodooni o lmaima melotu atua aji.”

English: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
Masaai: Nebik Daudi ti atua ilo sempewuet nejo ninye enkanasa e Daudi. Neshet Daudi ina anasa aitamanaa ebaiki Milo neito atua.

English: And David went on, and grew great, and the LORD God of hosts was with him.
Masaai: Neaku Daudi kitok oleng oleng, amu ore Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, etii apa te nebo ninye.

English: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
Masaai: Ore Hiram olaiguanani le Turo neirriwaa ilkiliku enetii Daudi, neirriwaa sii iltarakua o laguetak loo nkeek o laguetak loo soito laa ninche ooteshetakitia Daudi enkaji.

English: And David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel's sake.
Masaai: Neyiolou Daudi nchere eitasheyie Olaitoriani ninye aitaa olaiguanani le Israel, o nchere eilepunye ninye enkitoo enye te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena Israel.

English: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
Masaai: Neya Daudi nkapiak kumok o nkituaak te Yerusalem, eidipa aeu eing'uaa Hebron; neikini Daudi ilayiok kumok o ntoyie.

English: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn e lelo ootoikioki ninye te Yerusalem: o Shamua, o Shobab, o Natan, o Solomon,

English: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
Masaai: o Ibar, o Elishua, o Nefeg, o Yafia,

English: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
Masaai: o Elishama, o Eliada, o Elifelet.

English: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ilfilisti nchere etubukokoki Daudi eilata aaitaa olaiguanani te Israel, neilepu Ilfilisti pooki eing'oru Daudi; kake etoning'o Daudi ina nelo aisudori to sempewuet.

English: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Neaku eetuo apa Ilfilisti neidapashakino oerata le Rafadim.

English: And David enquired of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into thine hand.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, ejo, “Amaa, kalo nanu aarare Ilfilisti? Inchoru iyie ninche apik atua enkaina ai?” Nejoki Olaitoriani Daudi, “Ilepa shomo; amu esipa kaishoru nanu Ilfilisti apik atua enkaina ino.”

English: And David came to Baalperazim, and David smote them there, and said, The LORD hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baalperazim.
Masaai: Nelotu Daudi Baalperasim, nemir Daudi ninche te ine; nejo ninye, “Etigila Olaitoriani ilmang'ati laainei te dukuya nanu, anaa olairrag le enkare teneosh enkuaas.” Neaku ore enkarna e ine wuejinaa keji Baalperasim.

English: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Ilfilisti nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye te ine, nenap Daudi o ltung'ana lenyena ninche aaya.

English: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Ilfilisti aaigil aailepu aapuonu, neidapashakino oerata le Refaim.

English: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani, nejo ninye, “Milep alo; shomo tamanai iimu te siadi, nilotu enetii ninche te nkishiaakinoto oo lkeek adoru.

English: And let it be, when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt bestir thyself: for then shall the LORD go out before thee, to smite the host of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ining oltoilo le lototo te nchumata oo lkeek, ina kata tonyuaa amu etaa eipang Olaitoriani alo te dukuya ino aar enjore oo Lfilisti.”

English: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
Masaai: Neas Daudi anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninye, near Ilfilisti ebaiki Geba o metabaiki Gesa.

English: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi aiturrur lelo tung'ana pooki gelunot te Israel, nkalifuni tomoni uni.

English: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.
Masaai: Nedumunye Daudi nelo te nebo iltung'ana pooki apa ootii te nebo ninye ebaiki Baale-Yuda, pee eyau aailepunye aaitung'uaa ine osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye eipotieki enkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani oton ninye te nkitoo te nchumata oo lkerubi.

English: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
Masaai: Nenap ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai te ngarri ng'ejuk, neyau ninye aaipang'unye te nkaji e Abinadab apa natii enchumata e ndoinyo; ore Usa o Ahio lelo ayiok le Abinadab nereu ina garri ng'ejuk,

English: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
Masaai: te nebo ilo sanduku le Nkai; nelo Ahio dukuya ilo sanduku.

English: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o enkaji pooki e Israel neiguranita apa te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkidimata enye, too sinkolioitin, too lwululi loo usin, o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o ntampurini o kule kinantani, o saanini naaitooshi aaranyishore.

English: And when they came to Nachon's threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ninche ilo kurroto oidong'ishoreki le Nakon neitorioki Usa enkaina enye ilo sanduku le Nkai, neibung amu etarrorrote lelo mong'i.

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro e Nkai te nkaraki Usa, near Enkai ninye te ine te nkaraki naitorioyie enkaina enye aibung ilo sanduku; neye ninye te ine te mbata ilo sanduku le Nkai.

English: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perezuzzah to this day.
Masaai: Negoro apa Daudi enkaraki natara Olaitoriani Usa; ore ine wueji naa keji Peres-usa, o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
Masaai: Neureyu apa Daudi Olaitoriani ina olong; nejo ninye, “Kaji eiko te nelotu osanduku lo Laitoriani enatii nanu?”

English: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
Masaai: Neaku meyieu apa Daudi neya ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani atua enkanasa e Daudi; kake eiteng'ela Daudi aya enkaji e Obed-e-dom ilo Giti.

English: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obededom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obededom, and all his household.
Masaai: Neton ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani ti atua enkaji e Obed-e-dom ilo Giti ilapaitin okuni; nemayian Olaitoriani Obed-e-dom o enkaji enye pooki.

English: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obededom into the city of David with gladness.
Masaai: Nelikini apa olaiguanani Daudi aajoki, “Etamayiana Olaitoriani enkaji e Obed-e-dom o pooki nara enenye, te nkaraki ilo sanduku le Nkai.” Neaku eshomo Daudi neyau ailepunye ilo sanduku le Nkai aitung'uaa e nkaji e Obed-e-dom aya enkanasa e Daudi eng'ida;

English: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
Masaai: ore ake pee epuo lelo oonapita ilo sanduku le Nkai iroruat ile, nepolos ninye olkiteng o lashe opir.

English: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
Masaai: Neiguran Daudi te dukuya Olaitoriani te nkidimata enye pooki; neterretene apa Daudi te nkarasha dorrop napuyiapui.

English: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
Masaai: Neaku eyaua apa Daudi o enkaji e Israel pooki osanduku le Nkai aailepunye te mbuakunoto o to ltoilo le mowuo.

English: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul's daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
Masaai: Ore elotu ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani atua ina anasa e Daudi, neing'orisho Mikal entito e Saul te lusie, nedol Olaiguanani Daudi eipid neiguran te dukuya Olaitoriani; nemenu ninye to ltau lenye.

English: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninche atua ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, neirragie ninye te wueji enye, ti atua olng'obor otuuno Daudi te nkaraki ninye; neishoru Daudi ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Daudi aishooi ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani, nemayian ninye iltung'ana te nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani,

English: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
Masaai: neishooyo ti atua iltung'ana pooki ina siamo pooki e Israel, ilewa o nkituaak, o ltung'ani ake emukate napurupurana, o ldung'oti le nkiring'o o emukate oo lng'anayio ooitoyioki. Nepuo iltung'ana pooki le Israel, oltung'ani ake enkang enye.

English: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
Masaai: Neshuko Daudi alo amayian enkaji enye. Kake eipang'ua Mikal entito e Saul alotu anang'are Daudi, nejo, “Kebaa duoo taata enkanyit nayanyita olaiguanani le Israel kewan, aiturraa duoo taata nkilani te dukuya nkonyek oo nkaisiaayiak oo sinkan lenyena, anaa obo loo ltung'ana oomoda oiturraa nkilani medol enkurruna!”

English: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Mikal, “Te dukuya Olaitoriani laa ninye apa laategelua te shumata papaai lino, o te shumata enkaji enye pooki naagelu nanu aitaa kitok te shumata Israel, iltung'ana lo Laitoriani - naa kashipa nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
Masaai: Naa kasul nanu kewan oleng aitalang ena, naaitadouni too nkonyek inono; kake ore te nena sinkan naa ninche iimaka, ore ninche naa kaayanyit nanu oleng.”

English: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
Masaai: Ore Mikal ina tito e Saul neitu ae kata etum enkerai o metua.

English: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and the LORD had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
Masaai: Ore apa ebikito olaiguanani te nkaji enye, neishoo ninye Olaitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng too lmang'ati lenyena pooki oomanita,

English: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains.
Masaai: nejoki olaiguanani Natan ilo oiboni, “Ng'ura taata, abikito nanu te nkaji oo ltarakua, kake ore osanduku le Nkai netonita ti atua olng'obor.”

English: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in thine heart; for the LORD is with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Natan olaiguanani, “Shomo, taasa ina pooki natii atua oltau lino; amu etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie.”

English: And it came to pass that night, that the word of the LORD came unto Nathan, saying,
Masaai: Kake ore ina kewarie ake nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Natan ajoki,

English: Go and tell my servant David, Thus saith the LORD, Shalt thou build me an house for me to dwell in?
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Amaa, eikishetaki iyie enkaji nabikie atua?

English: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata nanu aton ti atua enkaji ebaiki enkolong apa nailepunye iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa Misiri o metabaiki ena olong, kake to lng'obor oshi aloolo aitaa emanyisho ai.

English: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Israel spake I a word with any of the tribes of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people Israel, saying, Why build ye not me an house of cedar?
Masaai: Ore ti atua iwuejitin pooki nashomo nanu te nebo iltung'ana pooki le Israel, eitu nanu airo ororei te likae hoo obo loo larishak loo Israeli laa ninche aitanapa meirrita iltung'ana laainei Israeli, ajoki “Kainyoo pee eitu kishetakiki nanu enkaji oo ltarakua?” ’

English: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:
Masaai: Ore naa nji tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, aawa apa nanu iyie aitung'uaa enkirritare, aitung'uaa esujata oo nkerra, pee itum ataa olkitok te shumata iltung'ana laainei Israel;

English: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest, and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight, and have made thee a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.
Masaai: natii nanu te nebo iyie te pooki wueji nishomo, naar ilmang'ati linono pooki aiwuang'ie te dukuya ino; naa kaaitobiraki nanu iyie enkarna kitok, anaa enkarna e lelo kituaak le nkop.

English: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
Masaai: Naa kagelu nanu ewueji te nkaraki iltung'ana laainei Israel, naun nanu ninche, pee etum aatobik te wueji enye maate, nemeitokini ae kata aaitanyamal; nemeitoki iltung'ana lo larrabal aaisilisil ninche, anaa apa,

English: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel, and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies. Also the LORD telleth thee that he will make thee an house.
Masaai: ebaiki ina kata apa nagelu ilarishak apik shumata iltung'ana laainei Israel; naa kaaisho nanu iyie enkiyeng'iyeng too lmang'ati linono pooki. Ore ake eibalunye Olaitoriani te iyie nchere, eikintaa iyie Olaitoriani enkaji.

English: And when thy days be fulfilled, and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, I will set up thy seed after thee, which shall proceed out of thy bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
Masaai: Ore te neiputayu nkolong'i inono nirrag iyie te nebo loo papaai lino, nadamu nanu eishoi ino te siadi iyie, ilo olotu aing'uaa osesen lino, naitubulaa nanu enkitoo enye.

English: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
Masaai: Keshet ninye enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai, naa kaitasheyie nanu olorika le nkitoo enye ntarasi.

English: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
Masaai: Naaku nanu papaai lenye, neaku ninye olayioni lai. Te neas ninye entorroni, naitame nanu ninye te ng'udi e tung'ana, o too oshot e tung'ana;

English: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before thee.
Masaai: kake maiwuang'ie nanu enyorrata ai nauno aitung'uaa ninye, anaa apa enaiwuang'ie te Saul, ilo apa laiwuang'ie nanu te dukuya iyie.

English: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
Masaai: Ore enkaji ino o enkitoria naa keitisipi te dukuya nanu; ore olorika lino le nkitoo keitasheyieki ntarasi.’ ”

English: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e kulo rorei, o te risioroto ena duata pooki, neirorie Natan Daudi.

English: Then went king David in, and sat before the LORD, and he said, Who am I, O Lord GOD? and what is my house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani Daudi atua neton te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, “Kara nanu ng'ae, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kainyoo enkaji ai, metaa eikiyaua nanu eneba nji?

English: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight, O Lord GOD; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant's house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Lord GOD?
Masaai: Ore ake eyia naa entoki kiti apa ena too nkonyek inono, Olaitoriani Enkai; iroro sii iyie te nkaraki enkaji o sinka lino te nkata sapuk nalotu, nikintoduaa nanu iishoritin naapuonu, Olaitoriani Enkai!

English: And what can David say more unto thee? for thou, Lord GOD, knowest thy servant.
Masaai: Naa kainyoo epon Daudi pee kijoki iyie? Amu iyiolo iyie osinka lino, Olaitoriani Enkai!

English: For thy word's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all these great things, to make thy servant know them.
Masaai: Te nkaraki enkisiligata ino, naa te risioroto oltau lino, itaasa iyie ena enkitoo aidimie osinka lino metayiolo ina.

English: Wherefore thou art great, O LORD God: for there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Masaai: Metaa ira iyie kitok, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai; amu metii likae oikununo anaa iyie, nemetii ae Ai neme iyie ake, te risioroto e nena pooki nikitoning'o too nkiyiaa ang.

English: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
Masaai: Kalo likae orere ti oriong e nkop oikununo anaa iltung'ana linono Israel, laa ninche eshomo Enkai akordu aitaa iltung'ana lenyena, aitobiraki kewan enkarna, neas te nkaraki ninche intokitin kituaak naaitureisho, te araroto te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena iloreren o nkaitin enye?

English: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.
Masaai: Nintasheyie te nkaraki kewan ino iltung'ana linono Israel metaa iltung'ana linono ntarasi; ore iyie, Olaitoriani, niaku Enkai enye.

English: And now, O LORD God, the word that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as thou hast said.
Masaai: Ore taata, Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, ntisipa ntarasi ilo rorei liroro iyie oipirta osinka lino neipirta enkaji enye, nias anaa eniroro;

English: And let thy name be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God over Israel: and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee.
Masaai: naa kerupi enkarna ino ntarasi, eji, ‘Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye Enkai oo Siraeli,’ ore enkaji o sinka lino Daudi neitubulari te dukuya iyie.

English: For thou, O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, hast revealed to thy servant, saying, I will build thee an house: therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee.
Masaai: Amu iyie, ee Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, naitayio ena bolunoto aitodol osinka lino, ijo, ‘Kaashetaki iyie enkaji;’ neaku etagolo osinka lino oshoke pee kiomon iyie ena omono.

English: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
Masaai: Ore taata, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyie Enkai, nesipa irorei linono, nisiligie ena toki sidai osinka lino;

English: Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may continue for ever before thee: for thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it: and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever.
Masaai: ore naa taata tishipayu iyie pee imayian enkaji osinka lino, pee etum ashomo dukuya ntarasi te dukuya iyie; amu ore iyie, ee Olaitoriani Enkai, niroro, naa te mayianata ino emayiani enkaji o sinka lino ntarasi.”

English: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Methegammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nemir Daudi Ilfilisti neitore ninche, neya Daudi Metegama aitung'uaa enkaina oo Lfilisti.

English: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
Masaai: Nemir ninye Moab, netem ninche to lgosoi lkereri, aisho ninche meirraga te nkop; ore ilkererin oare netemi pee eari metuata, ore olkereri obo olulung'a nepali. Neaku Ilmoabu isinkan le Daudi neyaki kodi.

English: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Daudi amir Hadadesa olayioni le Rehob, olaiguanani le Soba, eloito arrinyu enkitoo enye to lkeju le Frati.

English: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
Masaai: Neya Daudi aitung'uaa ninye enkalifu o iip naapishana o sikarini ooked mbartan, oo sikarini nkalifuni tikitam oopuo too nkejek nedung Daudi irrisheta mbartan pooki oo ngarrin, kake etelekua inaaidip ngarrin iip oo mbartan.

English: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu Isiria le Dameski aaretu Hadadesa ilo aiguanani le Soba, near Daudi metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oare loo Siria.

English: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
Masaai: Nepik Daudi iltimito atua Aram e Dameski; neaku Isiria isinkan le Daudi neyaki kodi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi metimirisho te pooki wueji neba anaa eneshomo.

English: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neya Daudi ilong'oi e sahabu apa naanapita isinkan le Hadadesa, neyau ninche Yerusalem.
