English: So the LORD sent a pestilence upon Israel from the morning even to the time appointed: and there died of the people from Dan even to Beersheba seventy thousand men.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka Olaitoriani Israel olmeitai ebaiki tadekenya o metabaiki enkata apa natudung'uoki; neye te ine iltung'ana ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana.

English: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it, the LORD repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed the people, It is enough: stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitorioo olmalaika enkaina enye aing'orie Yerusalem pee eidaikie, neirridu Olaitoriani ina torroni, nejoki ilo malaika apa oasita ina mutata ti atua iltung'ana, “Eidipe; tushuko taata enkaina ino.” Netii apa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani embata ewueji neidong'ishoreki e Arauna Olyebusi.

English: And David spake unto the LORD when he saw the angel that smote the people, and said, Lo, I have sinned, and I have done wickedly: but these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, be against me, and against my father's house.
Masaai: Neirorie Daudi Olaitoriani ina kata pee edol ilo malaika apa oarita iltung'ana, nejo, “Oi, ataasa nanu eng'oki, nataasa entorroni; kake amaa kuna kerra, kaa etaasa ninche? Nchoo enkaina ino, aatoomono, aar nanu near enkaji e papa.”

English: And Gad came that day to David, and said unto him, Go up, rear an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite.
Masaai: Nelotu Gad ina olong enetii Daudi, nejoki ninye, “Shomo ilepa, tataaniki olperere lo lasar enetii Olaitoriani te ine wueji neidong'ishoreki e Arauna o Ljebusi.”

English: And David, according to the saying of Gad, went up as the LORD commanded.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Daudi ailep to rorei le Gad, anaa enaitanapishe olaiguanani.

English: And Araunah looked, and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him: and Araunah went out, and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground.
Masaai: Ore ake eing'orisho Arauna airrugo, nedol olaiguanani o sinkan lenyena epuonu aayiaya ninye; nelo Arauna, neserem olaiguanani neitabaiki enkomom enye enkop.

English: And Araunah said, Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To buy the threshingfloor of thee, to build an altar unto the LORD, that the plague may be stayed from the people.
Masaai: Nejo Arauna, “Kainyoo pee eewuo olkitok lai olaiguanani enetii osinka lenye?” Nejo Daudi, “Pee ainyiang'u ene wueji neidong'ishoreki te iyie pee atum ateshetaki olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, pee etumi aaiwuang'ie olmeitai too ltung'ana.”

English: And Araunah said unto David, Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him: behold, here be oxen for burnt sacrifice, and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood.
Masaai: Nejoki Arauna Daudi, “Nchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani eya neishoru ina nadol aa sidai te ninye; noolo ilmong'i lo lasar opejori, ore ntokitin naaidong'ishoreki o nkeek oo lmong'i naa keaku ilkeek.

English: All these things did Araunah, as a king, give unto the king. And Araunah said unto the king, The LORD thy God accept thee.
Masaai: Ore kuna pooki, olaiguanani, eishoo Arauna olaiguanani.” Nejoki Arauna olaiguanani, “Mikitang'amai iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.”

English: And the king said unto Araunah, Nay; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price: neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the LORD my God of that which doth cost me nothing. So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
Masaai: Kake etiaka olaiguanani Arauna, “A-a, kake kainyiang'u nanu te iyie te nkinyang'a; maishoru nanu olasar opejori to Laitoriani eitu nanu ainosie toki.” Neaku einyiang'ua Daudi ine wueji neidong'ishoreki, o lmong'i te shekeli onom e nkosholai.

English: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. So the LORD was intreated for the land, and the plague was stayed from Israel.
Masaai: Neshetaki Daudi te ine Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar, neishoru olasar opejori o lasar le seriani. Neaku etoning'o Olaitoriani eomonokinoto enkop, neiwuang'ieki olmeitai aaitung'uaa Israel.

English: Now king David was old and stricken in years; and they covered him with clothes, but he gat no heat.
Masaai: Etamorua apa olaiguanani Daudi neaku oloo larin kumok. Ore hoo ninye teneimulumuli too ilkilani nemeirouaju osesen.

English: Wherefore his servants said unto him, Let there be sought for my lord the king a young virgin: and let her stand before the king, and let her cherish him, and let her lie in thy bosom, that my lord the king may get heat.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etiakita isinkan lenyena, “Nchoo eing'urakini enkiti siankiki olkitok lai olaiguanani, naa nchoo ninye eboitare olaiguanani, pee egolie ninye; nchoo ninye eirrag to lgoo lino pee etum olkitok lai olaiguanani airouaja.”

English: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel, and found Abishag a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
Masaai: Neaku eing'orutua ninche esiankiki sidai te nkishiaa tiatua enkop pooki e Israel, nepuo aatum Abishag e Shunam, neyaki ninye olaiguanani.

English: And the damsel was very fair, and cherished the king, and ministered to him: but the king knew her not.
Masaai: Eisidai apa ina siankiki oleng te nkishiaa, neaku ninye enkaing'urani o laiguanani neisiaai ninye; kake eitu eboitare olaiguanani ninye.

English: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, I will be king: and he prepared him chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
Masaai: Ore apa Adonija olayioni le Hagit neitaa kewan kitok ejo, “Kaaku nanu olaiguanani.” Neitobiraki kewan ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan, o ltung'ana onom oo kuet te dukuya ninye.

English: And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying, Why hast thou done so? and he also was a very goodly man; and his mother bare him after Absalom.
Masaai: Neitu aekata eitagor menye ninye eikilikuan ajoki, “Kainyoo pee itaasa ena o ena?” Oltung'ani sii apa sidai ninye te nkishiaa, naa ninye etoiuoki eirukurukore Absalom.

English: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest: and they following Adonijah helped him.
Masaai: Eiroro ninche o Yoab olayioni le Seruyia tenebo Abiata olapolosani; nesujaa ninche Adonija neretu ninye.

English: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
Masaai: Kake ore Sadok ilo apolosani o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, o Natan oloiboni le Nkai, o Shimei, o Rei o lelo tung'ana le Daudi magil nemetii ninche enkalo e Adonija.

English: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by Enrogel, and called all his brethren the king's sons, and all the men of Judah the king's servants:
Masaai: Nepolos Adonija ilkerra, o lmong'i o ntokitin naapir te ndapidapoi oo lasuriaa, te mbata e Norogel, neitoomon ninye ilalashera lenyena pooki, lelo ayiok lo laiguanani, o lelo tung'ana pooki kituaak le Yuda.

English: But Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, and the mighty men, and Solomon his brother, he called not.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye eitoomon Natan oloiboni le Nkai arashu Benaia arashu lelo tung'ana magil lo lalashe lenye Solomon.

English: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign, and David our lord knoweth it not?
Masaai: Neitoki Natan ajoki Betsheba ngotonye Solomon, “Keitu iyie ining ajo etaa Adonija olayioni le Hagit olaiguanani nemeyiolo Daudi olkitok lang?

English: Now therefore come, let me, I pray thee, give thee counsel, that thou mayest save thine own life, and the life of thy son Solomon.
Masaai: Ore naa taata wou maaishoo nanu eutaroto, pee itum aitajeu enkishui ino makewan o enkishui o layioni lino Solomon.

English: Go and get thee in unto king David, and say unto him, Didst not thou, my lord, O king, swear unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne? why then doth Adonijah reign?
Masaai: Shomo nabo kata tijing'aki olaiguanani Daudi, nijoki ninye, ‘Keitu apa iyie olkitok lai olaiguanani, inos olmumai te sinka ino, ijo, “Solomon olayioni lino oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa ketonie ninye olorika lai le nkitoo?” Kainyoo naa pee etaa Adonija olaiguanani?’

English: Behold, while thou yet talkest there with the king, I also will come in after thee, and confirm thy words.
Masaai: Ore eton irorie olaiguanani, najing'u sii nanu te siadi iyie naitisip irorei linono.”

English: And Bathsheba went in unto the king into the chamber: and the king was very old; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Betsheba enetii olaiguanani tiatua enkaji enye, netamorua olaiguanani oleng, o Abishag ina e Shunam neisiaaita olaiguanani.

English: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
Masaai: Neirrugo Betsheba aisho olaiguanani enkanyit, nejoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo iyieu?”

English: And she said unto him, My lord, thou swarest by the LORD thy God unto thine handmaid, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Olkitok lai, inosie apa esinka ino olmumai, to Laitoriani Enkai ino, ijo, ‘Solomon olayioni lino oitoreisho tesiadi nanu, naa ketonie ninye olorika lai le nkitoo.’

English: And now, behold, Adonijah reigneth; and now, my lord the king, thou knowest it not:
Masaai: Ore naa taata, ng'ura, Adonija ninye olaiguanani, hoo nimiyiolo ninye iyie olkitok lai olaiguanani.

English: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
Masaai: Etopolosa ninye ilmong'i, o ntokitin naapir o nkerra kumok, neitoomono ninye ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani, Abiata ilo apolosani o Yoab olarikoni le njore, kake ore Solomon osinka lino eitu eitoomon.

English: And thou, my lord, O king, the eyes of all Israel are upon thee, that thou shouldest tell them who shall sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
Masaai: Ore naa taata olkitok lai olaiguanani, iyie eing'orita nkonyek pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli pee iliki ninche ololo atonie olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai olaiguanani tesiadi ninye.

English: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
Masaai: Amu eidimayu naa tenelo olkitok lai olaiguanani aaku tenebo loo menye naaikenari nanu o Solomon olayioni lai anaa ilaitarruorrok.”

English: And, lo, while she yet talked with the king, Nathan the prophet also came in.
Masaai: Ore eton ninye eirorie olaiguanani, nejing'u Natan oloiboni le Nkai.

English: And they told the king, saying, Behold Nathan the prophet. And when he was come in before the king, he bowed himself before the king with his face to the ground.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche olaiguanani, “Nele Natan oloiboni le Nkai.” Ore pee ejing'u ninye alotu aitashe te dukuya olaiguanani, neirrugo ninye te dukuya olaiguanani, neitabaiki enkomom enye enkop.

English: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
Masaai: Nejo Natan, “Olkitok lai olaiguanani, itejo iyie, ‘Adonija oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa kelo atonie olorika lai le nkitoo?’

English: For he is gone down this day, and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the king's sons, and the captains of the host, and Abiathar the priest; and, behold, they eat and drink before him, and say, God save king Adonijah.
Masaai: Amu eshomo ninye ena olong apolos ilmong'i, o ntokitin naapir o nkerra kumok, neitoomono ilayiok pooki lo laiguanani, Yoab olarikoni le njore, o Abiatar olapolosani; naa ng'ura edaa ninche neokisho te dukuya ninye, nejo ‘Tobikoi olaiguanani Adonija!’

English: But me, even me thy servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and thy servant Solomon, hath he not called.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu osinka lino, o Sadok olapolosani o Benaia, olayioni le Yehoida, o sinka lino Solomon, neitu ninye eitoomon.

English: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
Masaai: Kolkitok lang olaiguanani oyaua ena bae neitu iyie iliki isinkan linono nchere kalo otonie olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai te siadi ninye.

English: Then king David answered and said, Call me Bathsheba. And she came into the king's presence, and stood before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Daudi awalu nejo, “Empotokoki Betsheba.” Neaku eewuo ninye enetii olaiguanani, neitashe te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: And the king sware, and said, As the LORD liveth, that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress,
Masaai: Neinos olaiguanani olmumai, ejo, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye laatokordua oltau lai te pooki mang'atinta,

English: Even as I sware unto thee by the LORD God of Israel, saying, Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead; even so will I certainly do this day.
Masaai: anaa enainosa olmumai te iyie te nkarna o Laitoriani, e Nkai e Israel, ajo Solomon olayioni lino oitoreisho te siadi nanu, naa ketonie ninye olorika lai le nkitoo te rishata ai; neijia ake sii aiko ena olong.”

English: Then Bathsheba bowed with her face to the earth, and did reverence to the king, and said, Let my lord king David live for ever.
Masaai: Neirrugo Betsheba aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop, neisho olaiguanani enkanyit, nejo, “Metobikoi olkitok lai olaiguanani Daudi ntarasi!”

English: And king David said, Call me Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani Daudi, “Empotokoki Sadok olapolosani, o Natan oloiboni le Nkai o Benaia olayioni le Yehoiada.” Neaku eetuo ninche dukuya olaiguanani.

English: The king also said unto them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule, and bring him down to Gihon:
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Ewaita tenebo intae isinkan lo lkitok linyi, ninchosho Solomon olayioni lai metakedo enyumpu ai nintadou ninye te Gibon;

English: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel: and blow ye with the trumpet, and say, God save king Solomon.
Masaai: ninchosho Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai metubukoki ninye eilata aaput metaa olaiguanani le Israel; nintokiki aaosh emowuo, nijojo, tobikoi olaiguanani Solomon!

English: Then ye shall come up after him, that he may come and sit upon my throne; for he shall be king in my stead: and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
Masaai: Nintokiki taa aailepu aasuju ninye, nelotu ninye atonie olorika lai le nkitoo, amu ninye oaku olaiguanani te rishata ai; nategelua nanu ninye meitoria Israel o Yuda.”

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, Amen: the LORD God of my lord the king say so too.
Masaai: Newaliki Benaia olayioni le Yehoida olaiguanani ajo “Esai! meiruko Olaitoriani lai, Enkai anaa enatii Olaitoriani tenebo olkitok lai olaiguanani, metotiwuo neija.

English: As the LORD hath been with my lord the king, even so be he with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatii Olaitoriani tenebo olkitok lai olaiguanani, metaa sii tenebo Solomon, neitaa kitok olorika lenye le nkitoo aitalang olorika le nkitoo lo lkitok lai Daudi!”

English: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, went down, and caused Solomon to ride upon king David's mule, and brought him to Gihon.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida o lkeresi o lpelesi aaitaked Solomon enyumpu o laiguanani Daudi neyau ninye Gibon.

English: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle, and anointed Solomon. And they blew the trumpet; and all the people said, God save king Solomon.
Masaai: Ore teine neya Sadok olapolosani olmouo le ilata to lng'obor nebukoki Solomon aput. Neitoki ninche aaosh emowuo; nejo iltung'ana pooki tobikoi olaiguanani Solomon.

English: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
Masaai: Neilep iltung'ana pooki aasujaa ninye, ekutita ndulen, neng'ida te nchipai sapuk, ometaa keikirikirie ndarat enye enkop.

English: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar?
Masaai: Nening Adonija o lomon pooki ootii tenebo ninye ina shipai o osirua. Ore pee ening Yoab oltoilo le ntarumpeta nejo, “Kainyoo ele odoo te nkanasa?”

English: And while he yet spake, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came: and Adonijah said unto him, Come in; for thou art a valiant man, and bringest good tidings.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorita, ng'ura, nelotu Yonatan olayioni le Abiata; nejo Adonija, “Tijing'u, amu ira iyie oltung'ani le tipat oyau ilomon.”

English: And Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, Verily our lord king David hath made Solomon king.
Masaai: Newaliki Yonatan Adonija ajoki, “A-a amu eitaa olkitok lang olaiguanani Daudi Solomon olaiguanani;

English: And the king hath sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and they have caused him to ride upon the king's mule:
Masaai: neirriwayie olaiguanani tenebo ninye Sadok olapolosani, o Natan oloiboni le Nkai, o Benaia olayioni le Yehoida o Lkeresi o lLpelesi, neishoo ninche ninye metakedo enyumpu o laiguanani.

English: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon: and they are come up from thence rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that ye have heard.
Masaai: Netubukokitio Sadok olapolosani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai ninye eilata aaput aaitaa olaiguanani te Gihon, neilepa ninche aapuo teine eng'ida. Neaku enkanasa enkilepilep. Ena kilepilep ina nitoning'oitie.

English: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
Masaai: Etonita taata Solomon to lorika le nkitoo.

English: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
Masaai: Ore sii eetuo ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani aaisho enashe olkitok lang Daudi ejo, ‘Eishoo Enkai ino enkarna e Solomon metoning'oyu alang enkarna ino, neitaa olorika lenye le nkitoo kitok alang olino.’ Neirrugo olaiguanani te ndapash.

English: And also thus said the king, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which hath given one to sit on my throne this day, mine eyes even seeing it.
Masaai: Neitoki sii olaiguanani ajo, ‘Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, laa ninye oishoo obo le ishoi ai metotonie olorika lai le nkitoo ena olong, adolita too nkonyek aainei.’ ”

English: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
Masaai: Neikirikira ilomon pooki le Adonija to lkirutoto, nedumunye, nelo ake oltung'ani aim enkoitoi enye makewan.

English: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon, and arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
Masaai: Neureyu Adonija Solomon, nedumunye ninye, neibung imouarak olperere lo lasar.

English: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
Masaai: Nelikini Solomon aajoki, “Ng'ura keure Adonija olaiguanani Solomon; amu eji eibung'a ninye imouarak o lperere lo lasar, nejo, ‘Nchoo olaiguanani Solomon eng'as ainos olmumai nchere mesesekuan ninye osinka lenye to lalem.’ ”

English: And Solomon said, If he will shew himself a worthy man, there shall not an hair of him fall to the earth: but if wickedness shall be found in him, he shall die.
Masaai: Nejo Solomon, “Teneitodolu ninye neitisip nchere oltung'ani le tipat, meiseyieki ninye olpapita hoo obo le ndukuya enye.”

English: So king Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and bowed himself to king Solomon: and Solomon said unto him, Go to thine house.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie olaiguanani Solomon olkilikuai neyauni ninye aaitung'uaa olperere lo lasar. Nelotu ninye airrugokino Solomon aisho ninye enkanyit; nejoki Solomon ninye, “Shomo enkaji ino.”

English: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku keye Daudi, neitanap Solomon olayioni lenye; ejo

English: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
Masaai: “Etataana enkata ai pee alo aye. Ntagoluoyu niaaku olee,

English: And keep the charge of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, to keep his statutes, and his commandments, and his judgments, and his testimonies, as it is written in the law of Moses, that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest, and whithersoever thou turnest thyself:
Masaai: nimbung nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai ino, aim inkoitoi enyena, nimbung nkiguanat enyena, o nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena, o enchakenisho enye, anaa enaigero too nkitanapat e Musa, pee itum atudupayu te pooki niaas o te pooki wueji niim;

English: That the LORD may continue his word which he spake concerning me, saying, If thy children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail thee (said he) a man on the throne of Israel.
Masaai: pee etum Olaitoriani aitabai ina apa nairoro tialo nanu ejo, ‘Teneing'or ilayiok linono nkoitoi enye, aapuo te dukuya nanu too sipat, too ltauja lenye pooki o te nkishui enye, melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo too Siraeli’.

English: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel, unto Abner the son of Ner, and unto Amasa the son of Jether, whom he slew, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii iyiolo enaaitaasa nanu Yoab olayioni le Seruyia, ina naitaasa ilkituaak oare le njore oo Siraeli, Abna olayioni le Neer o Amasa olayioni le Yeser, oo tasesekuana ninye. Eitalakua ninye te nkata e seriani, elap o sarge apa oibukoyioki to larrabal, nepik osarge lemeeta entioto enkimeita natii empolos ai, nepik inamuka naatii nkejek aainei.

English: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
Masaai: Entaasisho naa nabo kata te risioroto e ng'eno inyi, kake emincho ina lukunya enye naibor edoiki enemeneng'a te seriani.

English: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those that eat at thy table: for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother.
Masaai: Kake ntoduaa esupatisho lelo ayiok le Barsilai le Gilead, nincho ninche eaku tenebo lelo oodaa te Misa ino; amu teina supatisho aatang'amutua ninche nanu apa pee aisik ailany Absalom olalashe lino.

English: And, behold, thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite of Bahurim, which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim: but he came down to meet me at Jordan, and I sware to him by the LORD, saying, I will not put thee to death with the sword.
Masaai: Netii sii tenebo iyie Shimei olayioni le Gera, le Benchamen oing'ua Bahurin, laa ninye apa laatediaa to ldeket torrono teina olong apa nashomo Mahanaim; kake ore ake pee aalotu anang'are nanu to lkeju le Yordan, nainosaki nanu ninye olmumai to Laitoriani, ajoki, ‘Maar nanu iyie tua to lalem.’

English: Now therefore hold him not guiltless: for thou art a wise man, and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood.
Masaai: Ore naa taata eminkenaa ninye aajo meeta entioto, naa ore amu ira iyie oltung'ani ng'en; iyiolo iyie enilo aitaas, niyau iyie ina lukunya enye naibor enemeneng'a etii osarge.”

English: So David slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David.
Masaai: Neirura Daudi anaa loo menye, aye, nenukari ninye te nkanasa e Daudi.

English: And the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore apa enkata naitoreisho Daudi te Israel naa ilarin artam eitoreishe ninye ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni te Yerusalem.

English: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
Masaai: Neaku etotona Solomon to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi papaai lenye ore enkitoo enye neitashe auno.

English: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
Masaai: Neitoki Adonija olayioni le Hagit alotu enetii Betsheba ngotonye Solomon. Nejoki ninye, “Aite seriani iewuo iyie?” Nejo ninye “Teseriani.”

English: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
Masaai: Neitoki ajo, “Aata embae naaliki iyie.” Nejoki ninye, “Tolimu.”

English: And he said, Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: howbeit the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's: for it was his from the LORD.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Iyiolo iyie ajo enaai apa enkitoria, naa nanu apa eisiligita Israel pooki pee aitore ninche; kake eibelekenye enkitoria neaku eno lalashe lai, amu enenye apake eing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani.

English: And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.
Masaai: Ore naa taata aata embae nabo naomonu te iyie, nimikianyaki iyie nanu.” Nejoki Betsheba ninye, “Tolimu.”

English: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aatoomono nkilikuana olaiguanani Solomon, amu mikianyaki ninye, pee aaisho nanu Abishag e Shunam maitaa enkitok ai.”

English: And Bathsheba said, Well; I will speak for thee unto the king.
Masaai: Nejo Betsheba, “Eisidai; kairorie olaiguanani te rishata ino.”

English: Bathsheba therefore went unto king Solomon, to speak unto him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself unto her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a seat to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Betsheba enetii olaiguanani Solomon, pee eirorie ninye te rishata e Adonija. Nedumunye olaiguanani anang'are ninye, neirrugokino ninye, neitoki aton to lorika lenye le nkitoo, neitoki aipotu olorika meyakini ngotonye olaiguanani, neton ninye te nkaina enye e tatene.

English: Then she said, I desire one small petition of thee; I pray thee, say me not nay. And the king said unto her, Ask on, my mother: for I will not say thee nay.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Aata enkiti omonunoto nabo naaomon iyie, mikianyaki iyie nanu.” Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Tolimu eomonunoto ino yieyio lai, amu maanyaki nanu iyie.”

English: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Nchoo Abishag e Shunam meishori Adonija olalashe lino meyama.” Nejoki olaiguanani Solomon ngotonye, “Paa kainyoo peyie aa Abishag e Shunam iomonu meishori Adonija?

English: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
Masaai: Toomonoki sii ninye enkitoria; amu olalashe lai botor ninye, ore too matuan enyena netii Abiatar olapolosani o Yoab olayioni le Seruyia.”

English: Then king Solomon sware by the LORD, saying, God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah have not spoken this word against his own life.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Solomon ainos olmumai to Laitoriani ejo, “Maaitaasa Olaitoriani ena naaitulus tenemeinosieki ele rorei enkishui e Adonija!

English: Now therefore, as the LORD liveth, which hath established me, and set me on the throne of David my father, and who hath made me an house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death this day.
Masaai: Ore naa taata anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye laaitasheyie nanu aitagol, naaitoton nanu to lorika le Daudi papaai lai, laa ninye laaitaa nanu olmarei, anaa apa enaisiligishore, keari Adonija metua ena olong.”

English: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he fell upon him that he died.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwayie olaiguanani Solomon Benaia olayioni le Yehoida; neosh ninye anang'ie enkop, neye ninye.

English: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king, Get thee to Anathoth, unto thine own fields; for thou art worthy of death: but I will not at this time put thee to death, because thou barest the ark of the Lord GOD before David my father, and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted.
Masaai: Ore tialo Abiatar olapolosani, nejo olaiguanani, “Shomo Anasot, enkop inyi amu keeya nikiririkino iyie. Kake maar nanu iyie tua tena kata, amu itanapa apa osanduku lo Laitoriani te dukuya Daudi papaai lai, o enkaraki sii nitang'arie apa papa isinaitin lenyena pooki.”

English: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the LORD; that he might fulfil the word of the LORD, which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
Masaai: Neaku etaarayie Solomon Abiatar pee meitoki aaku olapolosani lo Laitoriani, neitabaya ororei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro ninye eipirta enkaji e Eli te Shilo.

English: Then tidings came to Joab: for Joab had turned after Adonijah, though he turned not after Absalom. And Joab fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaiki ilomon Yoab, amu etijing'a apa Yoab Adonija enkoriong, hoo neitu ejing Absalom, neisikaki Yoab olng'obor lo Laitoriani nelo aibung imouarak o lperere lo lasar.

English: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the LORD; and, behold, he is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, fall upon him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini olaiguanani Solomon, nchere, “Eisika Yoab alo atua olng'obor lo Laitoriani, naa ng'ura, etii ninye embata olperere lo lasar.” Neirriwaa Solomon Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, ejo, “Shomo toosho ninye tanang'ie enkop.”

English: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the LORD, and said unto him, Thus saith the king, Come forth. And he said, Nay; but I will die here. And Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Benaia atua ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani nejoki ninye, “Eitanapishe olaiguanani ejo, ‘Tupuku’ ” kake etejo ninye, “A'a tene nanu aye.” Neitoki Benaia ayaki olaiguanani olomoni ajoki, “Nji ejo Yoab naa ena einosa olmumai ajo.”

English: And the king said unto him, Do as he hath said, and fall upon him, and bury him; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood, which Joab shed, from me, and from the house of my father.
Masaai: Newaliki olaiguanani ninye ajoki, “Taasa anaa enatejo ninye toosho ninye tanang'ie enkop, nilo anukaa; pee eiwuang'ieki te nanu o te nkaji e papaai lai entorroni o sarge lemeeta entioto oibukoyie Yoab.

English: And the LORD shall return his blood upon his own head, who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he, and slew them with the sword, my father David not knowing thereof, to wit, Abner the son of Ner, captain of the host of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the host of Judah.
Masaai: Neyau Olaitoriani arrinyu nkiasin enyena e nkibukoroto o sarge shumata endukuya enye makewan, amu ore apa meyiolo papa Daudi, etarasaka ninye nesesekuan to lalem iltung'ana oare supati naa iletipat aalang ninye, Abna olayioni le Neer, ilo kitok le njore oo Siraeli o Amasa olayioni le Yeter, olkitok le njore e Yuda.

English: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab, and upon the head of his seed for ever: but upon David, and upon his seed, and upon his house, and upon his throne, shall there be peace for ever from the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku kerrinyunye isargeta lenye aapuonu shumata endukuya e Yoab o shumata oo lukuny eishoi enye, intarasi; kake ore tialo Daudi, o eishoi enye o enkaji enye o lorika lenye le nkitoo, naa keaku eseriani naing'uaa Olaitoriani ntarasi moitie.”

English: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up, and fell upon him, and slew him: and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
Masaai: Nedumunye Benaia olayioni le Yehoida alo neosh ninye anang'ie enkop, near ninye metua, nenukari ninye tiatua enkaji enye makewan tiong'ota.

English: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
Masaai: Nepik olaiguanani Benaia olayioni le Yehoida aitaa olkitok le njore te rishata e Yoab, nepik olaiguanani Sadok metaa olapolosani terishata e Abiatar.

English: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Build thee an house in Jerusalem, and dwell there, and go not forth thence any whither.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olkilikuai aipotu Shimei nejoki, ninye, “Teshetaki kewan enkaji te Yerusalem, nibik teine, nimilo iyie teine aidurraki dikae.

English: For it shall be, that on the day thou goest out, and passest over the brook Kidron, thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die: thy blood shall be upon thine own head.
Masaai: Amu ore akenya enkolong nilo, alang enongoto e Kebron, tayiolo ntisipa nchere meeta nchere miye. Ore osarge lino nelotu shumata endukuya ino makewan.”

English: And Shimei said unto the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king hath said, so will thy servant do. And Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
Masaai: Nejoki Shemei olaiguanani, “Ore ina nitejo iyie naa eisidai; ore anaa enatejo olkitok lai olaiguanani, ina elo osinka lino aas.” Neaku etobiko Shimei te Yerusalem nkolong'i kumok.

English: And it came to pass at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, Behold, thy servants be in Gath.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie ilarin okuni, neisik irrindiki oare le Shimei aapuo enetii Akish olayioni le Maaka, olaiguanani le Gaat. Ore pee elikini Shimei aajoki, “Ng'ura etii irrindiki linono Gaat.”

English: And Shimei arose, and saddled his ass, and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants: and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
Masaai: Nedumunye Shimei neirot osikiria nelo Gaat enetii Akish, aing'oru irrindiki lenyena; nelo Shimei arrinyu irrindiki lenyena te Gaat.

English: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and was come again.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Solomon aajoki eshomo Shimei te Yerusalem nelo Gaat neitoki arrinyunye,

English: And the king sent and called for Shimei, and said unto him, Did I not make thee to swear by the LORD, and protested unto thee, saying, Know for a certain, on the day thou goest out, and walkest abroad any whither, that thou shalt surely die? and thou saidst unto me, The word that I have heard is good.
Masaai: neirriwaa olaiguanani olkilikuai aipotu Shimei, nejoki ninye “Keitu apa nanu aainosie iyie olmumai to Laitoriani, naairorie oleng aikok ajoki, ‘Tayiolo ntisipa nchere ore akenya enkolong nilo ake ninye dikae wueji, niye iyie?’ Nikijoki iyie nanu, ‘Ore enitejo naa eisidai; kairuk nanu.’

English: Why then hast thou not kept the oath of the LORD, and the commandment that I have charged thee with?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa peyie eitu iyie imbung olmumai to Laitoriani oina kitanapata naaitanapa nanu iyie?”

English: The king said moreover to Shimei, Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to, that thou didst to David my father: therefore the LORD shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head;
Masaai: neitoki ake sii olaiguanani ajoki Shimei, “Iyiolo iyie to ltau lino ina torroni apa nintaasa Daudi papa lai; neaku kerrinyu Olaitoriani entorroni ino shumata endukuya ino.

English: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
Masaai: Kake kemayian Olaitoriani olaiguanani Solomon, ore olorika le nkitoo le Daudi neitasheyieki te dukuya Olaitoriani ntarasi.”

English: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; which went out, and fell upon him, that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aitanap Benaia olayioni le Yehoida; neipang ninye alo aosh ninye anang'ie enkop, neye ninye. Neaku eitasheyieki apa enkitoo te nkitoria e Solomon.

English: And Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of David, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of the LORD, and the wall of Jerusalem round about.
Masaai: Eitobira apa Solomon osotua o Farao olaiguanani le Misiri; neyam ninye entito e Farao, neriku ninye atua enkanasa e Daudi, o metaba anaa neidip atesheta enkaji enye makewan o enkaji o Laitoriani o esuntai naman Yerusalem.

English: Only the people sacrificed in high places, because there was no house built unto the name of the LORD, until those days.
Masaai: Too wuejitin neeika apa epolosisho iltung'ana, amu meetae apa enkaji naidipaki aateshet naipotieki Olaitoriani.

English: And Solomon loved the LORD, walking in the statutes of David his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in high places.
Masaai: Enyor apa Solomon Olaitoriani, nelo too nkikoot e Daudi papaai lenye. Kake eitayu apa ninye ilasarri nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
Masaai: Nelo apa olaiguanani Gibeon alo apolosisho teine amu ine apa ewueji neika kitok; naa keishooyo apa Solomon ilasarri oopejori enkalifu tenchumata eilo perere lo lasar.

English: In Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon in a dream by night: and God said, Ask what I shall give thee.
Masaai: Ore te Gibeon neipang'aki Olaitoriani Solomon te nkidetidet kewarie, nejo Enkai, “Toomonu entoki niyieu naaisho.” Nejo Solomon,

English: And Solomon said, Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy, according as he walked before thee in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with thee; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness, that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
Masaai: “Ntodolua iyie enyorrata kitok nauno to sinka lino Daudi, papa lai, enkaraki nashomo ninye te dukuya iyie te supatisho, o too sipat o to ltau oitoriori tialo iyie, nimbung'a iyie te ninye ena nyorrata kitok nauno, ninchoo ninye olayioni otonie olorika lenye le nkitoo ena olong.

English: And now, O LORD my God, thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father: and I am but a little child: I know not how to go out or come in.
Masaai: Ore taata, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, intaa iyie osinka lino olaiguanani te rishata e Daudi papa lai, hoo ninye naa kara nanu enkerai; mayiolo nanu aipang'a nemayiolo atijing'u.

English: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
Masaai: Netii osinka lino atua iltung'ana linono litegelaka, olorere kitok, lemeidimi aaikena te nkumoi anaa aatayiolo esiana te nkumoi.

English: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people, that I may discern between good and bad: for who is able to judge this thy so great a people?
Masaai: Nchoo naa osinka lino endamunoto e ningunoto pee etum aitoria ltung'ana linono, pee atum atumusu atirishu mbaa sidain o ntorrok, amu kaing'ae oidim aitoria ele orere lino kitok?”

English: And the speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
Masaai: Etishipakine apa Olaitoriani nchere ena bae etoomono Solomon.

English: And God said unto him, Because thou hast asked this thing, and hast not asked for thyself long life; neither hast asked riches for thyself, nor hast asked the life of thine enemies; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment;
Masaai: Nejoki Enkai ninye, “Ore enkaraki ninkilikuanua ena, neitu iomonu enkishui naado tenkaraki enkishui ino, anaa karsisisho, anaa enkishui oo lmang'ati linono, kake itoomonoko kewan pee kinchori eyiolounoto pee imusu esidai,

English: Behold, I have done according to thy words: lo, I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart; so that there was none like thee before thee, neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee.
Masaai: ng'ura kaaitaas naa nanu taata te risioto o rorei lino. Ng'ura aaisho nanu iyie endamunoto e ng'eno nimusunye mbaa, metaa meetae olikinyaanyukie otulusoyie nemeetae oloyooki atiu anaa iyie tesiadi iyie.

English: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour: so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days.
Masaai: Aaisho sii nena neitu iomonu, karsisisho o enkanyit ometaa meetae likae aiguanani likintanyaanyukieki too nkolong'i inono pooki.

English: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
Masaai: Naa tenilo iyie too nkoitoi aainei, aibung nkitanapat aainei o nkikoot aainei, anaa apa enataasa papaai lino Daudi, naitoodor nkolong'i inono.”

English: And Solomon awoke; and, behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem, and stood before the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
Masaai: Neputunye Solomon, naa ng'ura, enkidetidet ake, Neitoki alotu Yerusalem, neitashe te dukuya osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, neishooyo nkishorot o lasarri oopejori, o lasarri le seriani, neitobir osirua tenkaraki isinkan lenyena pooki.

English: Then came there two women, that were harlots, unto the king, and stood before him.
Masaai: Neitoki nkituaak are naibor onyek aapuonu enetii olaiguanani neitashe te dukuya ninye.

English: And the one woman said, O my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
Masaai: Nejo enkitok nabo e nena, “Oi olkitok lai, ore ena kitok o nanu naa enkaji nabo kimanya; naisho nanu eton kishula teina aji.

English: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also: and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni aidipa atoisho, neitoki sii ninye ena kitok aisho; naa iyiook ake, metii hoo likae tung'ani tenebo iyiook tiatua aji, iyiook ake pokira are naatii atua aji.

English: And this woman's child died in the night; because she overlaid it.
Masaai: Ore enkayioni ena kitok neye kewarie amu etepetayie ninye.

English: And she arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while thine handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye te mpolos e nkewarie neya enkayioni ai te mbata ai ina kata eirura esinka ino, neirragie ninye to lgoo lenye. Neirragie ina kerai enye natua to lgoo lai.

English: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead: but when I had considered it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, which I did bear.
Masaai: Ore pee ainyototo tadekenya aaitanak enkerai ai, ng'ura etua; kake ore ake pee aaing'or nanu asipu tadekenya, ng'ura mme enapa kerai natoiuo.”

English: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
Masaai: Kake etejo ina ae kitok, “A'a enaai ena kerai naishu, naa enino ena natua.” Neitoki enaduoo e dukuya ajo, “A'a, enino ina natua, naa enaai ena kerai naishu.” Neijia eikuna eiro te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: Then said the king, The one saith, This is my son that liveth, and thy son is the dead: and the other saith, Nay; but thy son is the dead, and my son is the living.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajo, “Ejo ake nabo, ‘Enaai ena kerai naishu, netua enkayioni ino’; nejo enkae; ‘A'a; amu enkayioni ino natua naa enkayioni ai ena naishu.’ ”

English: And the king said, Bring me a sword. And they brought a sword before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajo, “Eyakaki nanu olalem.” Neaku eyauaki olalem dukuya olaiguanani.

English: And the king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani, “Entoor ina kerai naishu katitin are, nincho ematua nabo enkitok nabo ninchosho enkae rubata enkae kitok.”

English: Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.
Masaai: Ore ina kitok apa naishu enkayioni enye nejoki olaiguanani, enkaraki naata ninye enkirimo to ltau te nkaraki enkayioni enye. “Oi olkitok lai, nchoo ninye meewa ina kerai naishu, nimimper ninye.” Kake etejo ina ae kitok, “Nchoo eaku mme enaai neme enino, tasasha ninye matoor.”

English: Then the king answered and said, Give her the living child, and in no wise slay it: she is the mother thereof.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani awalu ajo, “Enchoo ena kerai naishu enkitok e dukuya, nimisajisasha ake, amu ninye ngotonye.”

English: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do judgment.
Masaai: Nening Israel pooki enkiguana natudung'o olaiguanani; neing'asiakino ninche olaiguanani; amu etumusutuo aajo etii engeno e Nkai atua ninye pee inguana too sipat.

English: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
Masaai: Olaiguanani Solomon apa oiguanaki enkop e Israel pooki,

English: And these were the princes which he had; Azariah the son of Zadok the priest,
Masaai: naa kulo apa iltung'ana lenyena kituaak: Asaria olayioni le Sadok apa olapolosani;

English: Elihoreph and Ahiah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder.
Masaai: Elihoref o Ahija ilayiok le Shisha ninche apa ilaigerok; Yehoshefat olayioni le Ahilud apa olashumani loo mbaa;

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host: and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests:
Masaai: Benaia olayioni le Yehoida apa olkitok le njore; naa Sadok o Abiatar ninche apa ilapolosak;

English: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
Masaai: Asaira olayioni le Natan apa oitasheiki lelo kituaak, Sabud olayioni le Natan ninye apa olapolosani naa olchore lo laiguanani;

English: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
Masaai: Ahishar ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo; naa Adomiram olayioni le Abna ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siai oo nkaik.

English: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, which provided victuals for the king and his household: each man his month in a year made provision.
Masaai: Eeta apa Solomon iltung'ana tomon oare kituaak te Israel pooki, laa ninche ooisho olaiguanani endaa o lmarei lenye pooki; ore ake oltung'ani neishoru endaa to lapa obo to lari.

English: And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn enye, Benhuri teina kop oo ldoinyio e Efraim,

English: The son of Dekar, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Bethshemesh, and Elonbethhanan:
Masaai: o Ben-deker te nkop e Makas, o Shaalbim o Betshemesh o Elenbet-hanan

English: The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:
Masaai: o Ben-hesed, te nkop e Arubot (enenye apa enkop e Soko o enkop pooki e Hefer)

English: The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
Masaai: Ben-abin apa te nkop pooki e Nafat-do (eyama apa ninye Tafat entito e Solomon);

English: Baana the son of Ahilud; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo, and all Bethshean, which is by Zartanah beneath Jezreel, from Bethshean to Abelmeholah, even unto the place that is beyond Jokneam:
Masaai: Baana olayioni le Ahilud te nkop e Taanak, o Megido o Betshean pooki apa naa ninye natii embata e Saretan tiabori Yesreel, neitoki adumunye teine ometabaiki Abel-mehola, ometabaiki enkae shoto e Yokmeam;

English: The son of Geber, in Ramothgilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
Masaai: Benkeber, apa te nkop e Ramot-gilead (eeta apa ninye nkang'itie e Yair olayioni le Manase apa naatii Gilead; neeta sii olkerenket le Argob, otii enkalo e Argob, tiatua enkop e Basham, nkanas ntomoni ile kituaak naasheta sunta o nchomito o suyai);

English: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
Masaai: Ahinadab olayioni le Ido apa te nkop e Mahanaim;

English: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife:
Masaai: Ahinaas te nkop e Naftali (eyama apa ninye Basemat entito e Solomon);

English: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth:
Masaai: Baana olayioni le Hushai, te nkop e Asher o te Bealot;

English: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar:
Masaai: Yehoshefat olayioni le Parua te nkop e Isaakar;

English: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin:
Masaai: Shimei olayioni le Ela te nkop e Benchamen;

English: Geber the son of Uri was in the country of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer which was in the land.
Masaai: Geber olayioni le Uri te nkop e Gilead, teina kop e Sihon olaiguanani le Amori o Oog olaiguanani le Bashan. Netii apa oltung'ani obo kitok enkop e Yuda.

English: Judah and Israel were many, as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking, and making merry.
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana le Yuda o Israel naa eikumok anaa osinyai le naiposha, nedaa apa ninche neokisho neshipayu.

English: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines, and unto the border of Egypt: they brought presents, and served Solomon all the days of his life.
Masaai: Eitoria apa Solomon nena kitoriat pooki ebaiki olkeju le Frati ometabaiki ina kop oo Lfilisti ometabaiki olpolosie le Misiri; neyau ninche kodi neisiaai Solomon too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye.

English: And Solomon's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,
Masaai: Ore apa endaa e Solomon te nkolong nabo, naa mboreitin nkalifuni imiet e ntapa napuyiapui o mboreitin nkalifuni tomon e mpirbil e nkano.

English: Ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and an hundred sheep, beside harts, and roebucks, and fallowdeer, and fatted fowl.
Masaai: o lmong'i tomon oopir, o nkishu o lokeri tikitam naapir, o nkerra iip, ore tenebo nena, ng'uesi naanyanyukie nkoliin, o ronkon, o motonyi naapir.

English: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the river: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
Masaai: Amu eeta apa ninye enkitoria te nkop pooki o loo ntoluo to lkeju le Frati ebaiki Tipsa ometabaiki Gasa, te shumata ilaiguanak pooki le Frati; neeta ninye eseriani too nchot pooki naamanita ninye.

English: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore Yuda o Israel netoni te Seriani; ebaiki Dan o metabaiki Beer-sheba, eton ake oltung'ani tiabori osabibu lenye o tiabori olng'aboli lenye, too nkolong'i pooki e Solomon.

English: And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
Masaai: Eeta sii apa Solomon ilaleta nkalifuni artam loo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni tomon oare.

English: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon's table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo tung'ana kituaak neisho ninche Solomon endaa o pooki oopuonu emisa o laiguanani Solomon, oltung'ani ake neishooyo endaa to lapa lenye; eitu ninche eisho metongoro hoo toki.

English: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
Masaai: Eyauaki sii shairi o lkujita loo mbartan aaitasioki te wueji neyieuni. Neyau ake oltung'ani te risioroto enkitanapata naitanapaki.

English: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
Masaai: Neisho Enkai Solomon engeno nagut o ening'unoto nemeimakinoyu, neiputaki engeno naba anaa osinyai le naiposha,

English: And Solomon's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east country, and all the wisdom of Egypt.
Masaai: neaku ore engeno nagut e Solomon kelusoo te engeno oo ltung'ana pooki to loosaen, o engeno pooki e Misiri.

English: For he was wiser than all men; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all nations round about.
Masaai: Amu aingen apa ninye alang iltung'ana pooki, ngen alang Etan le Esrahiti o Heman o Kalkol, o Darda lelo ayiok le Mahol; nelo olning'o lenye neibulaa lelo oreren pooki oo manita.

English: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.
Masaai: Eiroro sii ndung'eta e rashe nkalifuni uni; ore isinkoliotin lenyena naa enkalifu nabo o imiet.

English: And he spake of trees, from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall: he spake also of beasts, and of fowl, and of creeping things, and of fishes.
Masaai: Eimaka sii ilkeek, ebaiki lelo tarakua otii Lebanon ometabaiki ina hisopu nabulu too sunta neimaki sii ing'uesi, o ntaritik o ntokitin naaiserpepiari o sinkir.

English: And there came of all people to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all kings of the earth, which had heard of his wisdom.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa iloreren pooki aainining engeno nagut e Solomon, o looing'uaa ilaiguanak pooki le nkop, ootoning'oitie engeno nagut e Solomon.

English: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
Masaai: Eirriwaka apa Hiram olaiguanani le Turo Solomon isinkan lenyena etoning'o nchere etuputoki aaitaa olaiguanani te rishata e papaai lenye, amu kenyor apa Hiram Daudi.

English: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
Masaai: Neirriwaki Solomon Hiram olkilikuai ajoki,

English: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
Masaai: “Iyiolo ajo eitu apa etumoki papaai lai Daudi atesheta enkaji te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai te nkaraki olarrabal amu etang'adutua apa ilmang'ati lenyena ninye, ometaba anaa nepik Olaitoriani ninche abori nkejek enyena.

English: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
Masaai: Kake ore taata aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ai enkiyeng'iyeng te pooki shoto. Metii olmang'atinta nemetii enyamali.

English: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
Masaai: Neaku atejo kashetu enkaji te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai, anaa apa enatiaaka Olaitoriani Daudi papaai lai, ‘Ore olayioni lino laa ninye nanu apik olorika lino le nkitoo, te rishata ino, ninye oshetu enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai.’

English: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
Masaai: Ore naa taata ntanapisho pee aadung'okini ltarakua le Lebanon; ore ilaisiaayiak laainei, neibung'are ilaisiaayiak linono naa kalaaki nanu isinkan linono olekoisiaayio anaa enijo; amu iyiolo iyie ajo meetae likae oyiolo atuuroi iltarakua anaa iltung'ana le Sidon.

English: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Hiram lelo omon le Solomon neshipayu oleng, nejo ninye, “Meisisi Olaitoriani ena olong, oishoo Daudi olayioni ngen oitore ele orere kitok.”

English: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Hiram Solomon olkilikuai ejoki, “Atoning'o nanu ilo kilikuai likirriwaka; naa kaas nanu nena pooki ninkilikuanua tialo mbaoi o ltarakua o no lchani onyaanyukie oltarakuai.

English: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
Masaai: Keitadou ilaisiaayiak laainei lelo keek te Lebanon neyau embata enaiposha, neen ninche tenebo naaitadoiki te naiposha meetu ewueji niyieu naisho ninche meiperi teine, ning'amaa iyie ninche; ore te nkalo ino naa kayieu nincho iltung'ana laainei endaa.”

English: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
Masaai: Neaku eishoo apa Hiram Solomon mbaoi pooki oltarakuai o lerai naaba anaa inaayieu,

English: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
Masaai: neisho Solomon Hiram mboreitin e mpirbil nkalifuni tikitam e nkano meitaa endaa enkaji enye, o mboreitin empirbil e ilata nkalifuni tikitam. Neisho Solomon Hiram kuna te pooki ari.

English: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani Solomon engeno, anaa apa enaisiligie ninye, neaku ketii apa eseriani erishata e Hiram o Solomon, ore lelo pokira neitobir olning'o.

English: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
Masaai: Neitayu olaiguanani Solomon iltung'ana oas esiaai te Israel pooki; ore lelo tung'ana naa nkalifuni tomoni uni.

English: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche meshomo Lebanon, nepuo ake iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon te nkata nabo to lapa, netii ake iltung'ana Lebanon to lapa obo, netii ang ilapaitin oare. Adoniram apa olkitok le lelo tung'ana oasisho.

English: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
Masaai: Eeta sii apa Solomon iltung'ana nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana oonapisho o laguetak loo soito nkalifuni ntomoni isiet te nkop oo ldoinyo.

English: Beside the chief of Solomon's officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
Masaai: Ore tenebo lelo etii sii iltung'ana kituaak le Solomon nkalifuni uni o iip uni ooitasheiki esiaai, ninche ooitasheiki lelo tung'ana oonapisho te siai.

English: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
Masaai: Ore te nkitanapata o laiguanani, nenap ninche isoito sapuki; oogol enkinyiang'a pee etum aatipik olkitamanyunoto le nkaji too soito oogueta.

English: And Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
Masaai: Neaku ore apa ilashetak le Solomon o lashetak le Hiraim, oltung'ana le Gebal neas esiaai e nguetare neitobir mbaoi o soito pee eshet enkaji.

English: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo larin iip ong'uan o ntomoni isiet eidipa iltung'ana loo Siraeli aatupuku te nkop e Misiri, to lari liong'uan eitore Solomon Israel, to lapa oji ole Sif, aa ninye olapa liare, neiteru ninye ashet enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And the house which king Solomon built for the LORD, the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits.
Masaai: Ore apa ina aji natesheta olaiguanani Solomon naa ntemat e nkaina ntomoni ile enkadoro, naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam endapasho naa ntemat e nkaina tomoni uni e nkadoro nailep.

English: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
Masaai: Naa ore olgoriet otii enkalo najing'ieki enkaji naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam, nerisioro endapasho e nkaji, naa ntemat tomon e nkaina eng'uton te dukuya ina aji.

English: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ilusien naaitobiruaki te nkarriyiano

English: And against the wall of the house he built chambers round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle: and he made chambers round about:
Masaai: Neitobir sii aitaman isunta eina aji nkajijik naakedo too nchot pooki.

English: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.
Masaai: Ore enkaji eabori naa ntemat imiet e nkaina endapasho, ore enkaji e polos naa ntemat ile e nkaina endapasho, ore enkaji e uni te shumata naa ntemat e nkaina naapishana endapasho. Ore te manaroto eina aji neitodorropu isunta pee meibung ake nena rishinani isunta e ina aji.

English: And the house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready before it was brought thither: so that there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
Masaai: Ore apa pee esheti ina aji naa too soito ooitobiraki te wueji neguetishoreki; pee mening'i ake enyuntu anaa entolu anaa ae toki e sekenkei tiatua enkaji e Nkai, ina kata eshetitae.

English: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.
Masaai: Ore enejing'ieki ilo gilata liabori naa enkalo e kopikop eina aji; naa nkedeta eimi pee epuoi olgilata le polos, nepuoyieki sii olgilata liokuni.

English: So he built the house, and finished it; and covered the house with beams and boards of cedar.
Masaai: Neaku etesheta ninye ina aji neidip; nepik enkitoipet e shumata too mbaoi o ltarakuai.

English: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye lelo gilat meishiaakino ake olgilata ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro, neibung'ieki enkaji too mbaoi oltarakuai.

English: And the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Solomon,

English: Concerning this house which thou art in building, if thou wilt walk in my statutes, and execute my judgments, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I perform my word with thee, which I spake unto David thy father:
Masaai: nejo, “Ore ena aji nishetita iyie, tenilo iyie too nkikoot aainei nimbung nkitanapat aainei pooki nirubare ninche, natum taa atuuno ilo rorei te iyie, apa lairorie Daudi papaai lino.

English: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
Masaai: Naa kabik nanu tiatua nkera e Israel nemaing'uaa nanu iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.”

English: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.
Masaai: Neaku etesheta Solomon ina aji, neidip ninye.

English: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the cieling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.
Masaai: Neikod isunta eina aji tiatua too mbaoi oltarakuai, ore ebaiki oltiren le nkaji ometabaiki enkimulumulet e shumata, nepik nkeek; ore oltiren leina aji neimulumul too nkeek oltepesi.

English: And he built twenty cubits on the sides of the house, both the floor and the walls with boards of cedar: he even built them for it within, even for the oracle, even for the most holy place.
Masaai: Etesheta ninye oriong ina aji apik mbaoi o lerai erishata oo ntemat e nkaina tikitam; etesheta ebaiki oltiren ometabaiki enchumata e suntai, neshet ine aiko anaa atua ina aji e Nkai, anaa ewueji sinyati aisul.

English: And the house, that is, the temple before it, was forty cubits long.
Masaai: Ore ilo gilata le wueji sinyati oleng naa ntemat tomon oisiet e nkaina enkadoro.

English: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
Masaai: Ore iltarakua ootii atua ina aji negueti aikunu anaa imalasin o ntapuka naalaa; naa iltarakua ake pooki, medoli ninye osoit.

English: And the oracle he prepared in the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore atua ina aji e Nkai, neitobir ninye olgilata liatua tukul, pee etum atipika ine osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani.

English: And the oracle in the forepart was twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof: and he overlaid it with pure gold; and so covered the altar which was of cedar.
Masaai: Ore apa ilo gilata liatua naa ntemat tikitam e nkaina enkadoro, naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam endapasho, naa ntemet e nkaina tikitam enkadoro nailep, nemura pooki wueji te sahabu nasila, nepik olpisiaai le sahabu metaleng'o dukuya ilo gilata liatua, nemur ninye te sahabu.

English: So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
Masaai: Nemur Solomon atua ina aji te sahabu nasila, nepik ninye olpisiaai aitalang ine wueji sinyati, nemur te sahabu.

English: And the whole house he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the house: also the whole altar that was by the oracle he overlaid with gold.
Masaai: Nemur ninye enkaji pooki te sahabu ometaba anaa neidipayu enkaji pooki. Ore sii ilo perere lo lasar liatua ewueji sinyati nemur te sahabu.

English: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
Masaai: Ore tiatua ine wueji sinyati neitobir ninye ilkerubi oare loo nkeek o loirien, ore ake obo, ntemat tomon e nkaina enkadoro.

English: And five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing unto the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
Masaai: Ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro e naipukoi o lkerubi obo. Naa ntemat imiet ebaiki enkiting'oto e naipukoi nabo o metabaiki enkae aipukoi.

English: And the other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubims were of one measure and one size.
Masaai: Ore olikae kerubi naa ntemat tomon ake sii ninye. Entemata nabo lelo kerubi naa empukunoto nabo.

English: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro olkerubi obo naa ntemat tomon e nkaina, naa neijia ake sii etiu ilo likae.

English: And he set the cherubims within the inner house: and they stretched forth the wings of the cherubims, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
Masaai: Nepik ninye lelo kerubi ewueji e atua eina aji; ore inaipuko e lelo kerubi nelaki aaisalaash ometaa kebaiki enaipukoi e obo e suntai nebaiki enaipukoi o likae e suntai; ore nkulie aipuko enye nebaikino te mpolos e nkaji.

English: And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.
Masaai: Nemur ninye lelo kerubi te sahabu.

English: And he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, within and without.
Masaai: Ore isunta eina aji neikodi aaguetaki ilkerubi oltuka o ntapuka naalaa, neikodi too lgilat o tioriong o too liatuani.

English: And the floor of the house he overlaid with gold, within and without.
Masaai: Ore oltiren le nkaji nemur te sahabu tiatua o tioriong.

English: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.
Masaai: Ore te wueji nejing'ieki ine wueji sinyati nepik nkikeneta o loirien; ore imolinkaishi neriwi aaitobiraki, nemur ninye.

English: The two doors also were of olive tree; and he carved upon them carvings of cherubims and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold, and spread gold upon the cherubims, and upon the palm trees.
Masaai: Neimulumul ninye aikod nena kikeneta e kutukaji pokira are oo loirienito too ntokitin naaguetuno anaa ilkerubi, o ltuka o ntapuka dapashi, nemur lelo kerubi te sahabu o lelo tuka.

English: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
Masaai: Neaku eitobira ninye teine nejing'ieki imolinkaishi e kutukaji o loirien, neisho metorisioto nkaloli pooki,

English: And the two doors were of fir tree: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
Masaai: o nkikenata are e kutukaji oltepesi, ore imatuan are e nkikenet nabo naa keshukunoyu eikeni o eboli naa neijia eitiu enkae matua e nkikenet.

English: And he carved thereon cherubims and palm trees and open flowers: and covered them with gold fitted upon the carved work.
Masaai: Ore nena kikeneta neikodi aapik olkerubi, o ltuka o ntapuka, nemur ninche te sahabu, anaa ina natipikaka nena tokitin naaguetuno.

English: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye olodung'oro liatua too lkererin okuni loo soito ooguetuno o too ng'apeta oltarakuai.

English: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan nepiki ina aji o Laitoriani olkitamanyunoto, to lapa le Sif.

English: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts thereof, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le tomon oobo, to lapa oji ole Buul, laa ninye olapa le imiet neidipayu ina aji too nkaloli pooki, terisioroto oo nkitobirat enyena pooki apa naaitobirakaki ninye. Ilarin oopishana etesheta ninye ina aji.

English: But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
Masaai: Ilarin tomon ookuni apa etesheta Solomon enkaji enye, neidip ninye enchetata enkaji pooki.

English: He built also the house of the forest of Lebanon; the length thereof was an hundred cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits, upon four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams upon the pillars.
Masaai: Etesheta ninye enkaji e ntim e Lebanon; ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat enkaina iip nabo ore endapasho naa ntemat e nkaina onom, ore enkadoro eilep naa ntemat e nkaina tomoni uni, neteshetaki apa too lkererin ooiriamari okuni too ng'apeta o ltarakuai, o rishinani oltarakuai te shumata ing'apeta.

English: And it was covered with cedar above upon the beams, that lay on forty five pillars, fifteen in a row.
Masaai: Neimulumuli apa shumata lelo gilat te lelo tarakua ootipikaki shumata nena ng'apeta artam oimiet, etii ake iltarakua tomon o imiet olkereri obo.

English: And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.
Masaai: Netii apa irubat oo lusien olkereri ake obo, netii apa ilusien aaipira too nkaloli pokira, katitin uni.

English: And all the doors and posts were square, with the windows: and light was against light in three ranks.
Masaai: Ore njing'eta pooki oo nkajijik o lusien naa kerisioro too nchot pooki. Ore ake elusie neipirakinore elusie katitin uni eiriamari maare.

English: And he made a porch of pillars; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof thirty cubits: and the porch was before them: and the other pillars and the thick beam were before them.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye enkaji nalala oo ng'apeta; ore enkadoro enye naa ntemat onom e nkaina, ore endapasho enye naa ntemat tomoni uni e nkaina. Netii apa olodungoro dukuya enye oitobiruno too ng'apeta, netii enkitushuret dukuya ninye.

English: Then he made a porch for the throne where he might judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from one side of the floor to the other.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye enkaji nalala o lorika le nkitoo teine nedung'ie ninye enkiguana, aa taa enkaji e nkiguana, neitobiri too ltarakua ebaiki oltiren o metabaiki shumata enye.

English: And his house where he dwelt had another court within the porch, which was of the like work. Solomon made also an house for Pharaoh's daughter, whom he had taken to wife, like unto this porch.
Masaai: Ore enkaji enye makewan naa ninye, etonie, tiae dung'oroto te siadi ina aji nalala, naa neijia ake eikunuaki olchetei. Enyaaka ake sii Solomon aitobiru enkaji natiu anaa ena aji nalala tenkaraki entito e Farao apa nayama.

English: All these were of costly stones, according to the measures of hewed stones, sawed with saws, within and without, even from the foundation unto the coping, and so on the outside toward the great court.
Masaai: Eitobiruaki kuna pooki too soito oogol enkinyiang'a, ootaguetaki te risioroto naba anaa enairirikino, neiriri te musumeno, oriong o atua, ebaiki olkitamanyunoto o metabaiki shumata. Ore ebaiki endung'oroto e nkaji o Laitoriani o metabaiki endung'oroto kitok.

English: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
Masaai: Ore apa olkitamanyunoto naa oloo soito oogol enkinyiang'a, isoito sapuki oleng, isoito loo ntemat isiet anaa ntemat tomon enkaina.

English: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
Masaai: Ore shumata naa isoito oogol enkinyiang'a, ooguetuno anaa enairirikino, tenebo iltarakua.

English: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
Masaai: Ore apa ina dung'oroto kitok neeta ilkererin okuni too soito oogueta oomanita o lkereri loo loom to ltarakuai, neeta sii nena ina dung'oroto e atua e nkaji o Laitoriani, o lodung'oro ojing'ieki enkaji.

English: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani Solomon meyauni Huram aaitung'uaa Turo.

English: He was a widow's son of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass: and he was filled with wisdom, and understanding, and cunning to work all works in brass. And he came to king Solomon, and wrought all his work.
Masaai: Olayioni apa ninye le nkoliai o losho le Naftali, ore menye naa oltung'ani le Turo, olaitobirani lo suyai; naa ngen apa ninye oleng, neeta engeno nagut sapuk o ening'unoto o enkarriyiano te nkitobirata e pooki siaai o suyai. Nelotu ninye enetii olaiguanani Solomon, neas esiaai enye pooki.

English: For he cast two pillars of brass, of eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits did compass either of them about.
Masaai: Etipika apa ninye ing'apeta are o suyai. Ntemat tomon oisiet enkadoro e ng'ape nabo, naa enkopito ntemat tomon oare enkaina naaman ake eng'ape nabo negum nchumat enye. Ore apa enkirrushai enye naa ilkimojik oong'uan neijia apa eikununo ing'apeta pokira are.

English: And he made two chapiters of molten brass, to set upon the tops of the pillars: the height of the one chapiter was five cubits, and the height of the other chapiter was five cubits:
Masaai: Neitoki sii aitobir ntokitin e shumata naaikununo anaa nkopiyiani enkitoo, to suyai otosholaki, pee epiki shumata e nena ng'apeta; ore apa enkadoro entoki nabo naa ntemat imiet e nkaina.

English: And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
Masaai: Neitoki aitobiru ntokitin are naashetuno anaa ilmarisiani to lpisiai, nepik shumata nena ng'apeta, netii ake ina toki nashetuno anaa olmarisian shumata nabo ng'ape netii enkae shumata enkae ng'ape.

English: And he made the pillars, and two rows round about upon the one network, to cover the chapiters that were upon the top, with pomegranates: and so did he for the other chapiter.
Masaai: Neitoki ake sii aitobiru ilgululu oopurupurana oonyaanyukie kukumanka ilkererin oare pee eitoip nena lukuny oo ng'apeta.

English: And the chapiters that were upon the top of the pillars were of lily work in the porch, four cubits.
Masaai: Ore apa nena kikompeni naatii ilukuny e nena ng'apeta neitobiruaki anaa ntapuka, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina.

English: And the chapiters upon the two pillars had pomegranates also above, over against the belly which was by the network: and the pomegranates were two hundred in rows round about upon the other chapiter.
Masaai: Netii apa nena kikompeni ilukuny e nena ng'apeta are, o shumata ina natii embata ena ripata olmarisian, netii apa ilgululu iip are, emanaa too lkererin oare, naa neija eikununo enkae toki te nchumata enkae ng'ape.

English: And he set up the pillars in the porch of the temple: and he set up the right pillar, and called the name thereof Jachin: and he set up the left pillar, and called the name thereof Boaz.
Masaai: Neitasheyie ninye nena ng'apeta ntaloishin pokira are e wueji nejing'ieki enkaji e Nkai; nepik ninye eng'ape enkalo e kopikop nejo enkarna eine Yakini; neitoki, apik eng'ape enkalo e moikuape nejo enkarna enye Boas.

English: And upon the top of the pillars was lily work: so was the work of the pillars finished.
