Masaai: Ore too nchumat oo ng'apeta netii ntokitin naaitobiruaki anaa ntapuka sidain. Neaku eidipe apa esiaai oo ng'apeta.

English: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
Masaai: Neitoki aitobir olmoti sapuk lo suyai otosholaki; naa kepurupurana ilo moti, naa ntemat tomon e nkaina ebaiki enchoto nabo e nkererema ometabaiki enkae shoto. Naa ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro ebaiki kop o metabaiki shumata. Naa ntemat tomoni uni emanaroto enye.

English: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
Masaai: Ore abori enkererema enye netii iltuleta oomanita, ore lelo tuleta naa ilkererin oare, neenikini ilo moti metaa entoki nabo.

English: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
Masaai: Neitakedi ilo moti shumata iloing'ok tomon oare lo suyai, neing'orita okuni lenye enkalo e moikuape, neing'orita okuni endoyioroto e nkolong, neing'orita okuni kopikop, neing'orita okuni enkalo o loo ntoluo; ore apa ilo moti naa shumata ninche eiteleikino. Ore enkalo enye pooki e siadi naa atua etii.

English: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
Masaai: Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore enkererema enye neikununo anaa enkererema e nkikompe, eikunuaki anaa entapukai sidai. Naa iltooi ooitukuoreki nkalifuni are enkare natii ilo moti.

English: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii aitobir nkejek tomon naatonie ilo moti. Ore ake enkitotonet nabo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina enkadoro, naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina endapasho, naa ntemat uni e nkaina enkadoro nailep.

English: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
Masaai: Ele apa olchetunei loo nkitotoneta. Etipikaki nkeek meibung'a enkamanaa e oriong,

English: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
Masaai: ore nena keek naatipikaki enkamanaa e oriong naguetakino ilng'atunyo, o loing'ok, o lkerubi. Ore enchumata nena rubat te shumata o tiabori lelo ng'atunyo, o loing'ok, netii ilmarisiani le siaai naikoduno.

English: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eeta ake enkitotonet nabo nkejek e ngarri o ng'uan o suyai o ltidii lo suyai, ore ilpijat pokira oong'uan naa ineeirisharieki ilo moti. Ore nena rishinani neikodoki too lmarisiani te pooki shoto.

English: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
Masaai: Ore enjing'et enye naa enchumata enye etii neilep enkadoro e ntemata nabo e nkaina, ore ina jing'et enye naa kepurupurana naa entemata nabo olpisiai enguton. Ore ina jing'et enye neeta imolinkaishi ore irubat enyena naa kerisioro nchot pooki, mepurupurana.

English: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
Masaai: Netii apa nena kejek pokira ong'uan nkeek e abori. Ore apa nkeek naaibung nkejek naa entoki nabo o nkitotoneta. Ore enkadoro enkeju naa entemet nabo e nkaina olpisiai.

English: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
Masaai: Neitobiraki apa nena kejek anaa nkejek oo ngarrin oo mbartan; ore nkeek enye o enkamanaa o ltidii o eneibungare, naa ino suyai.

English: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
Masaai: Neeta ake te pooki garri nkeek onguan naairishaa tiabori, naa nabo ninche o engarri.

English: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
Masaai: Ore te nchumata e nkitotonet netii entoki napurupurana aa olpisiai le ntemata e nkaina enkadoro nailep; ore enchumata eina kitotonet, irishinani enyena o nkeek enyena naa entoki nabo o ninye.

English: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
Masaai: Ore tioriong nena rishinani o tioriong nkeek neguetaki ilkerubi, o lng'atunyo, o iltuka, te risioroto e rishata e nabo ake enye, neitaman olmarisian.

English: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
Masaai: Ore tele rrekie neitobiru nkitotoneta tomon; neitobiruni pooki aaitanyaanyuk te risioroto o te mpukunoto.

English: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
Masaai: Neitobiru ninye ilmotioo tomon lo suyai; ore ake olmoti obo neeta mboreitin oo ltooi artam ooitukuoreki, ore ake olmoti obo naa ntemat ong'uan e nkaina, etii ake olmoti nkitotoneta tomon.

English: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
Masaai: Nepik ninye nena kitasheta imiet enkalo e kopikop eina aji, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape enkaji, nepik ilo moti olpijata aaitorit kopikop o loo saen leina aji.

English: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Eitobira apa sii Hiram imotioo, o nchempei naata ilala, o ngirran. Neaku eidipa apa Hiram esiaai pooki nataasaka Solomon tialo ina aji Olaitoriani:

English: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
Masaai: nena ng'apeta pokira are, o lelo bakulini pokira oare apa otii nchumat e nena ng'apeta, o nena sosin pokira are naaimulumul ilbakulini ootii nchumat oo ng'apeta.

English: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
Masaai: O lelo gululu iip ong'uan le nena sosin pokira are, ilkererin oare loo lgululu ake te sos nabo, pee eimulumul lelo bakulini oare loo nchumat oo ng'apeta;

English: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
Masaai: o nena kitasheta tomon o lelo motioo tomon ootii shumata nkitasheta tomon,

English: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
Masaai: oilo moti obo, o lelo oing'ok tomon oare ootii abori ilo moti.

English: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of the LORD, were of bright brass.
Masaai: Ore nena motioo, o nena kurteta, o ngirran, ore kuna masaa pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naaitobiraka Hiram olaiguanani Solomon, naa ino suyai otisikaki.

English: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
Masaai: Ore teina kisiajata e Yordan neiturraa olaiguanani ninche teina kop e nterit natii erishata e Sukot o Seretan.

English: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
Masaai: Neing'ua Solomon nena masaa pooki eitu etemi aaineneng enkaraki naa eikumok apa oleng. Ore enkiroishi o suyai neitu apa eyiolouni.

English: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of the LORD: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
Masaai: Neaku eitobira apa Solomon ntokitin pooki naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani: ilo perere lo lasar le sahabu, ina misa e sahabu tenkaraki emukate naitisinyaki

English: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
Masaai: o nkitasheta oo ltaai e sahabu nasila, imiet te nkalo e kopikop o imiet te nkalo e moikuape, eitu ebaiki ilo gilata liatua; o ntapuka, o ltaai, o ntokitin naarieki iltaai e sahabu:

English: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
Masaai: o nkikompeni o nkalema o ngirran, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ngirran e nkima, e sahabu, tenkaraki nena kikeneta e kutukaji e atua ilo gilata liatua, ine wueji nesinya aisul, o nena kikeneta olgos le nkaji e Nkai.

English: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku ina siaai pooki apa etaasa olaiguanani Solomon neidipayu ina aji o Laitoriani. Neitoki Solomon ayau nena tokitin apa naaitisinya Daudi papaai lenye, ina osholai, oina sahabu o nena masaa, neshum ninche te wueji neshumishoreki tiatua enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon aiturrur ilpayiani loo Siraeli o larikok pooki loo loshon, lelo arikok loo nkajijik oo loo menye, loo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, meetu dukuya olaiguanani Solomon te Yerusalem, pee eyau osanduku lo lning'o lo Laitoriani aaitung'uaa enkanasa e Daudi, aa taa Sion.

English: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
Masaai: Neiturrurrokino ilewa pooki loo Siraeli olaiguanani Solomon to sirua to lapa le Etamin, laa ninye olapa liopishana.

English: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nedumu ilapolosak ilo sanduku.

English: And they brought up the ark of the LORD, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
Masaai: Neyau ninche ilo sanduku lo Laitoriani, oilo ng'obor, o nena tokitin pooki naasinya apa naatii atua ilo ng'obor, neyau ilapolosak o Lawi nena pooki.

English: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani Solomon o eumata pooki oo siraeli, apa naiturrurre te dukuya ninye, netii tenebo ninye te dukuya ilo sanduku, nepolos nkerra kumok oleng olmong'i lemeikenayu te nkumoi.

English: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
Masaai: Neitoki ilapolosak aayau ilo sanduku lo lning'o ewueji enye, tiatua ilo gilata liatua le nkaji, tiatua ine nesinya aisul. Tiabori inaipuko oo lkerubi.

English: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
Masaai: Amu kelak apa lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aaitushur ilo sanduku o nkeek enyena.

English: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
Masaai: Naa kaadoru apa nena keek oleng ometaa kelioo ineeiting'ie te wueji sinyati eton eitu ejing'i ine wueji sinyati e atua. Kake melioo te boo; netii ninche ine o taata.

English: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Metii apa toki atua ilo sanduku meteleku ake inapa soito are dapashi naatipika Musa ine te Horeb, teine apa neitobirie Olaitoriani olning'o o ltung'ana loo Siraeli, apa pee epuku aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipang'u ilapolosak aaing'uaa ine wueji sinyati, neiput enkatampoi enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neaku meidim ilapolosak aaitasho aaisiaaisho tenkaraki ina atampoi; amu eiputa enkitoo o laitoriani enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon ajo, “Etipika Olaitoriani enkolong keper, kake etejo ninye keton ninye te naimin namisimis.

English: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in, a settled place for thee to abide in for ever.
Masaai: Aateshetaka nanu iyie ewueji e shumata. Ewueji nimany iyie ntarasi.”

English: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Israel: (and all the congregation of Israel stood;)
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aibelekenya aing'or olorere, nemayian ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli. Neitashe ina kata eumata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and hath with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Meisisi Enkai, oo Siraeli, laa ninye oitabayie te nkaina enye ina apa naisiligie te nkutuk enye Daudi papaai lai, ejo,

English: Since the day that I brought forth my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.
Masaai: ‘Ore ebaiki enkolong nayaua iltung'ana laainei loo Siraeli aitung'uaa Misiri, eitu nanu agelu enkanasa too loshon pooki loo Siraeli naa ninye ashetie enkaji, pee etum enkarna ai ataa ketii ine; kake ategelua nanu Daudi pee eaku oloitore iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.’

English: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Etii apa atua oltau le Daudi papaai lai pee eshet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli.

English: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
Masaai: Kake etiaka apa Olaitoriani Daudi papa, ‘Ore amu etii apa oltau lino pee ishet enkaji te nkaraki enkarna ai, itaasa iyie embae sidai amu etii apa ena atua oltau lino.

English: Nevertheless thou shalt not build the house; but thy son that shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia mishet iyie ina aji, olayioni lino likiikini ninye olo ashet ina aji tenkaraki enkarna ai.’

English: And the LORD hath performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Ore taata eitabayie Olaitoriani enkisiligata enye apa naisiligishore, amu atijing'a nanu erishata e Daudi papaai lai, naton to lorika le nkitoo le Israel, anaa apa enaisiligishore Olaitoriani, natesheta nanu enkaji te nkaraki enkarna Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore teina naishorua nanu ewueji nepiki osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye etii atua olning'o lo Laitoriani, apa oitobira tenebo loo papa, apa pee eyau ninche aaitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.”

English: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon aitashe te dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki oo Siraeli, neitorio nkaik enyena pokira are ailepie shumata;

English: And he said, LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart:
Masaai: nejo ninye “Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, meetae Enkai nikinyaanyukie, te shumata te keper, arashu tiabori te nkop, imbung olning'o nintodolu enyorrata nauno too sinkan linono, oopuo te dukuya iyie too ltauja lenye pooki;

English: Who hast kept with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him: thou spakest also with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
Masaai: iyie apa oibung'a te papaai Daudi ina nimbalunye te ninye; ee iroro iyie te nkutuk ino, te nkarna ino nintabaya ina ena olong.

English: Therefore now, LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that thou promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as thou hast walked before me.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Olaitoriani, Enkai, e Israel, mbung'a to sinka lino Daudi, te papaai lai; ina apa nisiligie ninye ijo, “Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani oitashe te dukuya nanu, pee etonie olorika le nkitoo le Israel, teneing'or ake duoo ninye ilayiok linono nkoitoi enye, nepuo te dukuya nanu anaa apa enishomo te dukuya nanu.’

English: And now, O God of Israel, let thy word, I pray thee, be verified, which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father.
Masaai: Ore naa taata na Ai e Israel, nchoo ilo rorei lino meitabari apa lirorie osinka lino Daudi, papaai lai.

English: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
Masaai: “Kake amaa, kemany Enkai enkop? Ng'ura mikiishaa iyie shumata o keper nalakua; kebaa naa enkitisho ena aji natesheta nanu!

English: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which thy servant prayeth before thee to day:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia itishilayie iyie enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye, Olaitoriani Enkai ai. Toning'o enkishirata o enkomono naomon osinka lino te dukuya iyie ena olong;

English: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
Masaai: pee etum nkonyek inono aataboloto dama o kewarie aaing'ura ena aji, ene wueji nitejo iyie, ‘keaku keton enkarna ai teine.’ Pee itum iyie atoning'o ena omono naomon osinka lino te nkaraki ene wueji.

English: And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place: and when thou hearest, forgive.
Masaai: Nining iyie enkomono esayiata o sinka lino oltung'ana linono Isiraeli, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji; ee toning'o iyie itii keper ina manyisho ino; tenining, nipalaki iyiook.

English: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house:
Masaai: “Teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo olelatia enye neinosieki ninye olmumai, nelotu ninye ainos olmumai te dukuya olperere lino lo lasar tiatua ena aji,

English: Then hear thou in heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
Masaai: nining naa iyie te keper, niaas embae nguanare iyie isinkan linono, nidung'oki enkiguana ilo arruoni, ayau enkarruoisho enye shumata endukuya enye makewan, nimbalunye ilo asipani alaaki ninye te risioroto e supatisho enye.

English: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee, and shall turn again to thee, and confess thy name, and pray, and make supplication unto thee in this house:
Masaai: Tenemir ilmang'ati iltung'ana linono le Israel, enkaraki nataasa eng'oki tialo iyie,

English: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers.
Masaai: tenikimbelekenyakino ninche, neibalunye enkarna ino, neomon aasaisho te dukuya iyie tiatua ena aji; nining iyie te keper, nipalaki ing'ok oo ltung'ana linono. Torrinyu ninche ina kop ninchoo loo menye.

English: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou afflictest them:
Masaai: “Teneikeno keper neaku meetae enchan, enkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki tialo iyie, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji, neibalunye enkarna ino, neibelekenya aaing'uaa ing'ok enye ina kata intamio iyie ninche,

English: Then hear thou in heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon thy land, which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance.
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie te keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo sinkan linono, Isiraeli, te nintengen iyie ninche enkoitoi napuo aaim, nincho iyie ninche enchan, naa ninye inchoo iltung'ana linono metaa ninye enjungore.

English: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
Masaai: “Tenelotu olameyu enkop, anaa olmeitai, anaa enkidaata oo ndaiki, anaa olmaati arashu olkurto; teneman aamuat ninche ilmang'ati lenye tiae anasa nabo oo nkanas enye; to lmeitai ake ninye pooki, o te muoyian ake ninye naba anaa enatii;

English: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all thy people Israel, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
Masaai: Teneomon te nkomono ake pooki, o te sayiata ake pooki nasaisho pooki tung'ani arashu iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli pooki, eyiolo ake oltung'ani emion oltau lenye makewan, neilepie nkaik enyena aipirie ena aji,

English: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou, even thou only, knowest the hearts of all the children of men;)
Masaai: nining naa iyie te keper teina manyisho ino, nipalaki ninche, niaas embae, nincho ake pooki tung'ani te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena pooki, amu iyie ake, iyie ake, openy oyiolo iltauja too nkera pooki e tung'ani.

English: That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
Masaai: Pee kitum ninche aatureita nkolongi pooki naaishu teina kop apa ninchoo iyie loo menye.

English: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of thy people Israel, but cometh out of a far country for thy name's sake;
Masaai: “Ore tenebo nena, tenelotu oltung'ani loo loreren, leme o loo ltung'ana linono Isiraeli, oing'uaa enkop nalakua, nelotu tenkaraki enkarna ino,

English: (For they shall hear of thy great name, and of thy strong hand, and of thy stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
Masaai: (amu kening'oo ninche enkarna ino kitok, o enkarna ino magilani, o enkaina ino naitoriori, tenelotu ninye neomon eing'or ena aji,

English: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for: that all people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by thy name.
Masaai: toning'o iyie te keper, teina manyisho ino, niaas te risioroto e nena naaomonu ilo tung'ani loo loreren te iyie; pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aataiyiolo enkarna ino nikiureyu iyie, anaa enatiu iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, netum sii aatayiolo nchere ore ena aji natesheta nanu naa enkarna ino eipotieki.

English: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever thou shalt send them, and shall pray unto the LORD toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house that I have built for thy name:
Masaai: “Teneipang iltung'ana linono aapuo olarrabal aagilunore ilmang'ati lenye, te nkoitoi ake ninye naba anaa enirriwayie ninche meima, neomon ninche Olaitoriani eing'or ina anasa nitegelua iyie oenkaji natesheta nanu te nkaraki enkarna ino,

English: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie itii keper enkomono o esayiata enye, nincho ninche meisula.

English: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man that sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
Masaai: “Teneas ninche eng'oki tialo iyie - amu meetae oltung'ani lemeas eng'oki, nigorokino iyie ninche, nincho iyie ninche ilmang'ati lenye, neaku ewaki ninche aaraya enkop oo lmang'ati lenye, elakua o etaana;

English: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
Masaai: Kake tenepik ninche iltauja lenye teina kop apa nataarayioki aaya, neirridu ninche, nikisai ninche iyie teina kop oo lmang'ati lenye apa ooibung'a ninche nejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, kitogolong'utua nikitaasa entorroni’;

English: And so return unto thee with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto thee toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, the city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name:
Masaai: teneirridu ninche too ndamunot enye pooki o too ltauja lenye pooki tiatua ina kop oo lmang'ati lenye, apa oowaita ninche aaraya, nikiomon ninche eing'orita enkop enye, apa ninchoo iyie loo menye, ina anasa nitegelua iyie, o ina aji natesheta nanu tenkaraki enkarna ino;

English: Then hear thou their prayer and their supplication in heaven thy dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie ninche te keper teina manyisho ino, enkomono enye o esayiata enye. Nchoo ninche meisula.

English: And forgive thy people that have sinned against thee, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against thee, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
Masaai: Tapalaki lelo tung'ana linono ootaasa eng'oki tialo iyie, tapalaki nkitarruorrot enye pooki naataasa tialo iyie. Nchoo ninche olng'ur too nkonyek e lelo ooibung'a aaraya ninche pee etum aaing'urrie ninche.

English: For they be thy people, and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
Masaai: (Amu iltung'ana linono ninche, naa enjung'ore ino ninche apa niyaua iyie aitung'uaa Misiri, aitung'uaa atua olmoti le nkima loo senkenke).

English: That thine eyes may be open unto the supplication of thy servant, and unto the supplication of thy people Israel, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto thee.
Masaai: Nchoo nkonyek inono metoduaa esayiata o sinka lino o esayiata oo sinkan linono Isiraeli, nining ninche enkata naba anaa enikimpot iyie.

English: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be thine inheritance, as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant, when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord GOD.
Masaai: Amu nteng'ela iyie ninche too loreren pooki le nkop, pee eaku enjung'ore ino, anaa apa enimbalunye te Musa, osinka lino, apa pee iyau loo papa aitung'uaa Misiri, Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the LORD, he arose from before the altar of the LORD, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Solomon atejo ena omono pooki o esayiare to Laitoriani, neinyototo ninye aing'uaa dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, te wueji duoo netigilie kung neilepie nkaik enyena aing'orie keper.

English: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
Masaai: Neitashe ninye nemayian eumata pooki oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli to ltoilo kitok, ejo,

English: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
Masaai: “Meisisi Olaitoriani laa ninye oishoo enkiyeng'iyeng iltung'ana lenyena loo Siraeli, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naaisiligishore ninye. Meetae ninye ororei obo otong'oro too nkisiligat enyena sidain, naatolikio apa ninye Musa osinka lenye.

English: The LORD our God be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
Masaai: Metaa Olaitoriani Enkai ang tenebo iyiook anaa apa enatii tenebo loo papa; metaa meing'uaa ninye iyiook nemeiturraa iyiook.

English: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
Masaai: Pee etum aitonyorra iltauja lang kewan enye pee kipuo too nkoitoi enyena pooki, nikimbung nkitanapat enyena, o nkikoot enyena, o nkiguanat enyena, apa naaitanapa ninye loo papa.

English: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before the LORD, be nigh unto the LORD our God day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Israel at all times, as the matter shall require:
Masaai: Nchoo kulo rorei laainei, laa ninche atasaishore te dukuya Olaitoriani, etaaniki Olaitoriani Enkai ang dama o kewarie, naa nchoo ninye meisula osinka lenye, neisulu iltung'ana lenyena Isiraeli, anaa ake enaishiaakino te pooki olong.

English: That all the people of the earth may know that the LORD is God, and that there is none else.
Masaai: Pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai. Meetae likae.

English: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
Masaai: Enchoo naa iltauja linyi eitoriori te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai, nipuopuo too nkiguanat enyena, nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat enyena anaa ena olong.”

English: And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani, o Siraeli pooki ootii tenebo, aaitayu olasar te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neishooyo Solomon anaa ilasarri le seriani to Laitoriani ilmong'i nkalifuni tikitam oare o nkerra nkalifuni iip nabo o tikitam. Neaku eitisinya olaiguanani o iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before the LORD was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
Masaai: Ore ake teina olong nemayian olaiguanani empolos e ndung'oroto apa natii dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani. Amu teine eitayio olasar opejori o lasar le ntapa o rubat naapir o lasar le seriani, amu ore apa ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai otii ine naa aikiti oleng, tenepiki olasar opejori o lasar le ntapa, o rubat naapir o lasar le seriani.

English: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before the LORD our God, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
Masaai: Neaku eeta apa Solomon osirua teina kata, o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye, eumata kitok nabaiki enejing'ieki Hamat o metabaiki oerata le Misiri, te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai ang, nkolong'i naapishana.

English: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the LORD had done for David his servant, and for Israel his people.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neisho iltung'ana meshomo, nemayian lelo tung'ana olaiguanani, nepuo taa nkang'itie enye eng'ida neshipa too ltauja tenkaraki esupatisho pooki naitoduaa Olaitoriani Daudi osinka lenye o Siraeli lelo tung'ana lenyena.

English: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Solomon atesheta ina aji o Laitoriani o enkaji o laiguanani o pooki apa naayieu Solomon neshet,

English: That the LORD appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
Masaai: neitoki Olaitoriani aipang'aki Solomon enkata eare, anaa apa enaipang'aka ninye te Gibeon.

English: And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Atoning'o enkomono ino o esayiata ino, nitoomono iyie te dukuya nanu. Aitisinya nanu ena aji nitesheta iyie, natipika enkarna ai ine ntarasi. Ore nkonyek aainei oltau lai keaku ine etii nkatitin pooki.

English: And if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded thee, and wilt keep my statutes and my judgments:
Masaai: Kake ore tialo iyie, tenaa eilo te dukuya nanu, anaa apa papaai lino Daudi, to ltau le mborron o esupatisho, aas te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa, nimbung nkiguanat aainei o nkikoot,

English: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever, as I promised to David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel.
Masaai: naun aitubulaa olorika le nkitoria ino te Isirael ntarasi, anaa apa enaisiligie Daudi papaai lino, ajoki, ‘Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo te Israel.’

English: But if ye shall at all turn from following me, ye or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
Masaai: Kake tenimbelekenya apaash esujata ai, iyie anaa nkera inono, nimimbung nkitanapat aainei, o nkiguanat aainei natipika nanu dukuya intae, nipuopuo aaisiaai kulie aitin niserememe ninche,

English: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
Masaai: naiwuang'ie naa nanu Isiraeli teina kop apa naishoo ninche; ore ina aji apa naitisinya nanu tenkaraki enkarna ai naiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, neaku Isirael endung'et e rashe o entoki naimakini too loreren.

English: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
Masaai: Neaku ena aji olchala le nkidaata, ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo neiputukuny, neisulisho, nejo ninche, ‘Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena kop o tena aji?

English: And they shall answer, Because they forsook the LORD their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath the LORD brought upon them all this evil.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aajo, ‘Enkaraki natung'uaitie Olaitoriani Enkai enye, naa ninye apa nayaua loo menye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, neibung'are kulie aitin, neserem ninche neisiaai ninche. Ore enkaraki ina eyaua Olaitoriani ena torroni pooki shumata ninche.’ ”

English: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the LORD, and the king's house,
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie ilarin tikitam, eidipa Solomon atesheta nena ajijik pokira are, enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
Masaai: o enkaji olaiguanani, neidipa Hiram olaiguanani le Turo aishoo Solomon iltarakua o mbaoi o sahabu, anaa enayieu. Eishoo sii ninye olaiguanani Solomon Hiram nkanas tikitam tiatua enkop e Galilaya.

English: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee elotu Hiram te Turo adol nena anas naaishoo Solomon ninye, neitu eitiship ninye.

English: And he said, What cities are these which thou hast given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku etejo ninye, “Kaji eikununo kuna anas nikinchoo iyie nanu olalashe lai?” “Neaku etejoki apa ninche, enkop Kabul o taata.

English: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
Masaai: Neirriwaka apa Hiram olaiguanani ntalantani iip o tikitam e sahabu.

English: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
Masaai: Naa nji eikununo enkisiaayiare, apa nataasa olaiguanani Solomon eshet enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji enye makewan, o Milo, o esuntai e Yerusalem, o Hasor, o Megido, o Geser.

English: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon's wife.
Masaai: (Ore apa Farao olaiguanani le Misiri neshomo aibung Geser nepejoo ninye te nkima, netaara apa ninye Ilkanaani oomanya ina anasa metuata, neishooyo enkanasa anaa enkishooroto enkiyama te ntito enye, ina kitok e Solomon.

English: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
Masaai: Neaku enyaaka apa Solomon ashet Geser) o Bet-horon e abori

English: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
Masaai: o Baalat, o Tamar tiong'ota, tiatua enkop e Yuda,

English: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
Masaai: o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki apa naata Solomon, o nkanas oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan o nkanas oo lakedok lenyena loo mbartan, o pooki toki apa nayieu Solomon neshet te Yerusalem, otiatua Lebanon, o tiatua enkop pooki enkitoria enye.

English: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootelekutua Ilamori, o Ilhiti, Olperesi, o Lhifi, o Lyebusi, lelo apa leme ilo lorere loo Siraeli

English: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
Masaai: ore ina ishoi enye natelekuaki, teina kop, lelo apa leitu eidaikie iltung'ana loo Siraeli tukul - ore kulo neitaa Solomon irrindiki le nkisiaayiare enye, netiu ninche neija o metabaiki ena olong.

English: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
Masaai: Kake ore too ltung'ana loo Isiraeli eitu eitaa Solomon irrindiki. Isikarini apa ninche, iltung'ana lenyena kituaak apa ninche. Ilkituaak le njore, ilarikok le njore, o lkituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan.

English: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
Masaai: Ore kulo naa iltung'ana kituaak ooitasheiki esiaai e Solomon iip imiet ninche o onom, laa ninche ooitasheiki iltung'ana aasak le siaai.

English: But Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
Masaai: Kake eshomo ina tito e Farao teina anasa e Daudi nelo enkaji enye makewan apa nateshetaka Solomon ninye, neitoki ashetu Milo.

English: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the LORD, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the LORD. So he finished the house.
Masaai: Katitin uni apa to lari eitayu Solomon ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani te nchumata ilo perere lo lasar apa oteshetaka Olaitoriani. Nepej enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku eidipa apa ninye enkaji.

English: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
Masaai: Eitobira sii apa Solomon imelin kumok te Esiong'eber naa ninye nataaniki Eliton, to lomanaa le naiposha Nanyokie, te nkop e Edom.

English: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Hiram tenebo nena melin kumok isinkan lenyena, iltung'ana oopuo too nkariak, ootamoo enaiposha, tenebo isinkan le Solomon.

English: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche Ofir neyau sahabu teine naa ore esapuko enye ntalantani tikitam, neyaki ninche olaiguanani Solomon.

English: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the LORD, she came to prove him with hard questions.
Masaai: Naa ore apa pee ening enkaiguanani e Sheba enkishoroto e Solomon tialo enkarna o Laitoriani, nelotu atem ninye too nkikilikuanat naagol.

English: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
Masaai: Nelotu apa ninye Yerusalem erikito iltung'ana kumok oleng, o ntamesin naanapita isonkoyoni, o sahabu kitok oleng, o soito oogol enkinyiang'a; ore ake pee elotu enetii Solomon, neliki ninye nena pooki naadamu naayieu neikilikuanu.

English: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
Masaai: Newal Solomon nkikilikuanat enyena pooki; meetae entoki neitu eliki olaiguanani ninye.

English: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon's wisdom, and the house that he had built,
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ina aiguanani e Sheba ina ng'eno nagut o laiguanani pooki, oina aji natesheta,

English: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
Masaai: o endaa natii emesa enye, oltonei loo lkituaak lenyena, o enkisiaayiare oo sinkan lenyena, nkilani enye, o lanapak lenyena loo nkikompeni o lasarri lenyena oopejori ooishooyo ninye tiatua enkaji Olaitoriani, eitu eitoki aidim atejo ae.

English: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye olaiguanani, “Ekesipa ilomon apa latoning'o nanu te nkop ai makewan, ooipirta mbaa inono o engeno ino.

English: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa nanu anyorraa lelo omon o maeu adol too nkonyek aainei makewan, naa ng'ura, eitu apa aalikini nanu mbaa pooki; ore engeno ino o karsisisho ino kelusoo te nena natoning'o nanu.

English: Happy are thy men, happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and that hear thy wisdom.
Masaai: Emunyak nkituaak inono, nemunyak isinkan linono, ootii dukuya iyie anaake nening engeno

English: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee, to set thee on the throne of Israel: because the LORD loved Israel for ever, therefore made he thee king, to do judgment and justice.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino; amu kitishipakine ninye iyie, nikipik iyie olorika le nkitoo le Israel! Ore enkaraki natonyorra Olaitoriani Israel ntarasi, kintaaninye iyie olaiguanani, pee itum atudung'o enkiguana niaas isupati.”

English: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aisho olaiguanani ntalantani iip o tikitam e sahabu, o sonkoyoni kumok oleng o soito oogol enkinyiang'a. Eitu aekata eitokini aatum enkorropil naba anaa ina naishoo enkaiguanani e Sheba olaiguanani Solomon.

English: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
Masaai: Ore nena melin e Hiram apa naayautua sahabu te Efir neyau aaitung'uaa Ofir ilkeek kumok o soito oogol enkinyiang'a.

English: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the LORD, and for the king's house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
Masaai: Neitaa olaiguanani lelo keek irishinani enkaji o Laitoriani, o ne nkaji o laiguanani. O lwululi loo usin o nkai oo sinkolioitin tenkaraki ilaranyak. Eitu aekata eitokini aayau lelo keek, anaa aadol ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
Masaai: Neisho Solomon ina aiguanani e Sheba nena pooki naayieu ninye. Entoki ake ninye natoomonuo metii nena naaishooki ninye tialo karsisisho o laiguanani Solomon. Neaku etorrinye apa ninye nelo enkop enye, tenebo isinkan lenyena.

English: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
Masaai: Naa ore apa enkiroishi e sahabu nayakaki Solomon to lari obo naa ntalantani iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile e sahabu,

English: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
Masaai: metii ina apa naing'uaa ilbiasharani o kodi oo lamirak o naaing'uaa ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o lbalusuni leina kop.

English: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
Masaai: Neitobir olaiguanani Solomon ilong'oi iip are dapashi naaidong'uoki te sahabu; ore ake nabo naa shekeli iip ile e sahabu enkiroishi.

English: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
Masaai: Neitobiru ninye ilong'oi iip uni naaidong'uoki te sahabu, nepik ake elong'o nabo nkiloi are e sahabu. Nepik olaiguanani nena long'oi atua enkaji natii atua entim e Lebanon.

English: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
Masaai: Neitayu sii olaiguanani olorika le nkitoo kitok too lala loo lkanchaoni, nemur ninye te sahabu nasila.

English: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
Masaai: Eeta apa ilo orika le nkitoo nkedeta ile, ore tioriong olorika le nkitoo netii endukuya o lashe, ore ake enkalo nabo olorika netii ineeiteleikini nkaik, olng'atunyo oare ooitashe tembata oo neiteleikini nkaik,

English: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
Masaai: neitashe sii ilng'atunyo tomon oare teine, netii ake obo enkalo nabo e nkedet. Eitu aekata etumi embae nanyaanyukie ena te nkitoria ake ninye pooki.

English: And all king Solomon's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore apa ntokitin pooki naaokishoreki o laiguanani naa ine sahabu, ore imasaa pooki enkaji natii entim e Lebanon naa ine sahabu nasila. Meetae ine nkosholai, meshilari apa nena aaitaa toki toonkolong'i e Solomon.

English: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
Masaai: Amu eeta apa olaiguanani imelin e Tarshish te naiposha tenebo imelin e Hiram. Ore ake kata nabo te rishata oo larin okuni nepuonu imelin kumok naaing'uaa Tarshish enapita sahabu, o enkosholai, o lala loo lkanchaoni, olkuluoin, o motonyi sidain.

English: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
Masaai: Kaae nelusoo olaiguanani Solomon too laiguanak pooki le nkop, te karsisisho o te ng'eno.

English: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
Masaai: Neing'oru enkop pooki enetii Solomon pee epuonu aaning engeno enye, natipika Enkai atua endukuya enye.

English: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
Masaai: Neyau ake pooki tung'ani enkishooroto enye, ntokitin e nkosholai o ne sahabu, o lkarash, o manemane, o enkorropil, o mbartan, o nyumpui, neyau nkumok te pooki ari.

English: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon aiturrur tenebo ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo mbartan; eeta apa ninye ngarrin oo mbartan enkalifu nabo o iip ong'uan, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni tomon oare, apa ootipika ninye nena anas oo ngarrin oo mbartan tenebo sii olaiguanani te Yerusalem.

English: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
Masaai: Neitaa olaiguanani enkosholai entoki nalelek tumoto te Yerusalem, neitotiu anaa isoito, ore iltarakua nebayu anaa ilkeek lo lpurkel.

English: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
Masaai: Ore apa imbartan e Solomon naa Misiri eing'uaa o Kilikia. Ore lelo ooinyiang'u engarri oo mbartan te Misiri te shekeli iip uni e nkosholai, ore embarta naa te shekeli iip o onom;

English: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
Masaai: neaku ore tialo ilbiasharani lo laiguanani nemirakini mbartan ilaiguanak pooki loo Lhiti o laiguanak le Siria.

English: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
Masaai: Etonyorra apa Olaiguanani Solomon nkituaak kumok oo loreren; entito e Farao, o enoo Lmoabu, o enoo le Amon o enoo le Edom, o enoo le Sidon, o nkituaak oo Lhiti, nena e lelo oreren apa ootiaaka Olaitoriani iltung'ana loo Siraeli,

English: Of the nations concerning which the LORD said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
Masaai: “Emiyama ake o ninche, nemeyama ninche o ntae. Amu esipa kepuo ninche aaibelekeny iltauja linyi nisujaa nkaitin enye.” Neibung apa Solomon kuna te nyorrata.

English: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye nkituaak iip naapishana, o nkapiak iip uni, ore nena kituaak enyena neibelekenya oltau lenye.

English: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as was the heart of David his father.
Masaai: Ore anaa nemoruau Solomon eibelekenya nkituaak enyena oltau lenye metusujai nkaitin enye; neitu eibung'are oltau lenye oleng Olaitoriani Enkai enye, anaa enatiu apa oltau le Daudi papaai lenye.

English: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
Masaai: Amu etusujayie Solomon Ashtoret ina ai ng'oruoi e Sidon, nesujaa Milkom ilo minong loo le Amoni.

English: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the LORD, and went not fully after the LORD, as did David his father.
Masaai: Neaku etaasa apa Solomon entorrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitu ninye, eunokino asujaa Olaitoriani anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon ashetu ewueji e shumata e Kermosh ilo minong le Moab o ene Molek oilo minong le Amon, to ldoinyo te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e Yerusalem.

English: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
Masaai: Neiko ninye neijia te nena kituaak enyena pooki oo loreren naapej enkorropil nepolosaki nkaitin enye.

English: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from the LORD God of Israel, which had appeared unto him twice,
Masaai: Negorokino apa Olaitoriani Solomon enkaraki naibelekenye oltau lenye aing'uaa Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, naipang'aka ninye katitin are

English: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
Masaai: neitanapa ninye tialo ena bae pee melo arubare kulie aitin; kake eitu ninye eibung ina naitanapa Olaitoriani.

English: Wherefore the LORD said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of thee, and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded thee, I will surely rend the kingdom from thee, and will give it to thy servant.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nejoki Olaitoriani Solomon, “Ore amu ena itadamua, neitu imbung olning'o lai lo sotua o nkiguanat aainei naaitanapa nanu iyie esipa, kadung'oo nanu enkitoria ino aiwuang'ie te iyie naisho osinka lino.

English: Notwithstanding in thy days I will not do it for David thy father's sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of thy son.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkaraki Daudi papaai lino, maas nanu ena too nkolong'i e nkishui ino, kake kalo nanu adung'oo enkitoria te nkaina o layioni lino.

English: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, madung'oo nanu enkitoria pooki; kake kaisho nanu olosho obo olayioni lino, tenkaraki Daudi osinka lai, o tenkaraki Yerusalem naa ninye ategelua.”

English: And the LORD stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
Masaai: Nedumu Olaitoriani olmang'atinta metigilunore Solomon, oji Hadad le Edom. Ole nkaji enkitoo apa ninye te Edom.

English: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
Masaai: Amu ore apa etii Daudi Edom, ore Yoab olarikoni le njore neilep alo anukaa ilootuata

English: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
Masaai: Near Hadad metuata ilewa pooki le Edom. (Amu etobiko apa Yoab o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli te Edom ilapaitin ile, ometaba anaa neishie pooki lee te Edom.)

English: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
Masaai: Kake eisikaka Hadad Misiri tenebo kulikae tung'ana le Edom loo sinkan le menye, neton apa aa enkerai kiti Hadad.

English: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche te Midian nepuonu Paran, neshoru kulikae te Paran nepuonu Misiri, enetii Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, laa ninye oishoo Enkaji, neikenaki ninye eorikinoto endaa, neisho ninye enkop.

English: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
Masaai: Netum Hadad omom oleng too nkonyek e Farao, neaku eishoo meyama enkanashe enkitok enye, enkanashe e Tafenes ina kitok o laiguanani.

English: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh's house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh's household among the sons of Pharaoh.
Masaai: Ore ina anashe e Tefenes neiki ninye olayioni oji Genabat, laa te nkaji e Farao eoru Tafenes ninye ilki, netii apa Genebat enkaji e Farao aboitare ilayiok le Farao.

English: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to mine own country.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Hadad ajo eirure Daudi tenebo loo menye, netua sii Yoab olarikoni le njore, nejoki Hadad Farao, “Nchooki nanu mashomo enkop ang.”

English: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what hast thou lacked with me, that, behold, thou seekest to go to thine own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Farao ninye, “Kainyoo nikitong'orikia te nanu, eji metaa ing'oru arrinyo enkop inyi? Nejoki Hadad ninye, “Nchooki ake duoo mashomo.”

English: And God stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
Masaai: Neitoki Enkai adumu likae mang'atinta oji Rason olayioni Eliada, apa oisika aing'uaa olkitok lenye Hadadesa olaiguanani le Soba.

English: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
Masaai: Neiturrurroki ninye kewan iltung'ana neaku olarikoni loo larruok, ina kata apa eidipa Daudi atasesekuanisho; nepuo ninche Dameski nebik teine, neitaa ninche ninye olaiguanani le Dameski.

English: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
Masaai: Olmang'atinta apa le Israel ninye too nkolong'i pooki e Solomon, neas ntorrok anaa apa enataasa Hadad. Neaku olmang'atinta le Israel, neitore Siria.

English: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon's servant, whose mother's name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
Masaai: Ore apa Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat le Efraim e Sereda, ore osinka le Solomon, oji enkarna e ng'otonye Seruyia, naa enkoliai, neinyototokino sii ninye olaiguanani agilunore.

English: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ena apa pee etudumakine olaiguanani. Etesheta apa Solomon Milo, neram esuntai apa natigile te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye.

English: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
Masaai: Oltung'ani apa ogol oleng Yeroboam, naa ore ake pee edol Solomon ajo kaarriyia ilo barnoti, neisho meitasheiki esiaai pooki oo nkaik e nkaji e Yosef.

English: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata, pee eipang Yeroboam te Yerusalem, netumore oloiboni le Nkai oji Ahija le Shilo. Neishopito apa Ahija enkila ng'ejuk; netumo lelo pokira aa ninche ake te nkisiajata.

English: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
Masaai: Neitoki Ahija aibung enaduoo kila ng'ejuk naishopito nepolos aitayu ndung'ot tomon aare.

English: And he said to Jeroboam, Take thee ten pieces: for thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to thee:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Yeroboam, “Iwa iyie ndung'ot tomon, amu inji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Ng'ura, etaa kajo pee adung'oo enkitoria te nkaina e Solomon, naa kaaisho iyie iloshon tomon,

English: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel:)
Masaai: (kake ketum ninye olosho obo tenkaraki osinka lai Daudi o tenkaraki Yerusalem, ina anasa naa ninye ategelua too loshon loo Siraeli;)

English: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in mine eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naatung'uayie nanu Solomon, nelo aserem Ashterot ina ai ng'oruoi oo le Sidon, o Kemosh ina ai e Moab, o Milkom ina ai oo Lamori, neitu eaas esidai too nkonyek aainei, neitu eibung nkikoot aainei, o nkiguanat aainei, anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant's sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia maya nanu enkitoo pooki aitung'uaa enkaina enye; kake kaitaa nanu ninye olarikoni too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye tenkaraki Daudi osinka lai, laa ninye ategelua, neibung'a ninye nkitanapat aainei o nkiguanat aainei;

English: But I will take the kingdom out of his son's hand, and will give it unto thee, even ten tribes.
Masaai: kake kaya nanu enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaina o layioni lenye naaisho nanu iyie iloshon tomon.

English: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
Masaai: Kake ore olayioni lenye kaisho nanu olosho obo, pee etum Daudi osinka lai ataa keeta oltaa te dukuya nanu anaake te Yerusalem, teina anasa nategelua nanu apik enkarna ai.

English: And I will take thee, and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth, and shalt be king over Israel.
Masaai: Naa kaaya nanu iyie, nilo aitore nena pooki naang'uar oltau lino, nilo aaku olaiguanani te Israel.

English: And it shall be, if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee, and wilt walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with thee, and build thee a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Israel unto thee.
Masaai: Naa tenining iyie nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie, nilo too nkoitoi aainei, niaas isupati too nkonyek aainei, aibung nkikoot aainei, anaa apa enataasa Daudi osinka lai, naaku nanu tenebo iyie, nashetu nanu enkaji ino aitubul, anaa apa enateshetaka Daudi, naaisho nanu iyie Israel.

English: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
Masaai: Naa ore tenkaraki ena kaitame nanu eishoi e Daudi, kake mme ntarasi.’ ”

English: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
Masaai: Neing'oru taa Solomon pee ear Yeroboam metua: kake etudumunye Yeroboam, neisikaki Misiri, nelo enetii Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri, neton ninye te Misiri ometabau keeya e Solomon.

English: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nkiaasin pooki e Solomon, o nena pooki naataasa, o engeno enye nagut, neigeroki te mbuku oo nkiasin e Solomon.

English: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
Masaai: Ore apa enkata naitoria Solomon Yerusalem o Israel pooki naa ilarin artam.

English: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Solomon aye tenebo loo menye, nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye; neitoreisho Rehoboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Israel were come to Shechem to make him king.
Masaai: Nelo Rehoboam Shekem, eshomo apa Isiraeli pooki Shekem aaitaa ninye olaiguanani.

English: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ina, (Amu eton apa etii Misiri, ine apa neisikaka ailany olaiguanani Solomon) neitoki Yeroboam ashukunye te Misiri.

English: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche olkilikuai aaipotu ninye; ore Yeroboam o eumata oo Siraeli pooki nepuonu aajoki Rehoboam,

English: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve thee.
Masaai: “Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto. Ore naa taata nteneneng'a ina kisiaayiare nagol e papaai lino, oina shata nairoishi oo murto natii shumata iyiook, naa aikisiaai iyiook iyie.”

English: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom entung'uayioki too nkolong'i uni, nintokiki aashukunye enatii.” Neaku eshomo iltung'ana.

English: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam aikilikuanishore ilpayiani kituaak apa laa ninche ooitashe te dukuya papaai lenye Solomon, apa eton eishu, nejoki, “Kaa kiutakiki matawaliki ele orere?”

English: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Tenaa iyaku iyie osinka le kulo tung'ana ena olong, nisiaai ninche, nirorie iyie ninche te supatisho tiniwaliki ninche, naa keaku ninche isinkan linono ntarasi.”

English: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
Masaai: Kake etanya ninye ina utaroto natuutakita lelo payiani kituaak, neing'oru eutaroto oolbarnot le sirit enye, neitasheyie te dukuya ninye.

English: And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaa intae iututu pee kiwaliki ele orere laatiaakitia nanu, ‘Nteneneng'a ina shata oo murto apa natipika papaai lino shumata iyiook?’ ”

English: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it lighter unto us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo barnot le sirit enye, “Nji shomo tiaki ele orere likijoki ninche, ‘Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto, kake inteneneng'aki iyie iyiook’; nji iyie shomo tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore enkilinta ai naa eisapuk alang empolos e papaai.

English: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father hath chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
Masaai: Naa ore taata, teneiteleikia papaai intae olchata oiroishi le murt, kaponaa nanu ilo shata linyi loo murto. Eitamio intae papaai too lishien, kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.’ ”

English: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo Yeroboam tenebo iltung'ana pooki enetii Rehoboam te nkolong e uni, anaa enatejo olaiguanani nejoki olaiguanani ninche, “Enyaaki wootu enatii te nkolong e uni.”

English: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men's counsel that they gave him;
Masaai: Newalaki olaiguanani iltung'ana te nkitarrikinoto, neany ina utaroto naishoo ilpayiani kituaak.

English: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
Masaai: Neirorie olorere anaa enatuutakitia ninye ilbarnot, ejoki, “Eiroshiyie apa papaai enchata inyi oo murto, naa kaponaa nanu ina shata inyi oo murto; eitamio apa intae papaai too lishien kake kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.”

English: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from the LORD, that he might perform his saying, which the LORD spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
Masaai: Neaku eitu ening olaiguanani olorere, amu embae ena nayaua Olaitoriani pee etum aitabai ororei lenye, apa oiroro Olaitoriani aimunye Ahija le Shilon aliki Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

English: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Israel: now see to thine own house, David. So Israel departed unto their tents.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Isiraeli pooki aajo eitu ening olaiguanani ninche, newaliki olorere olaiguanani, aajoki, “Kaa rubata iyiook kiata te Daudi? Mikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese. Enchom ilng'oborri linyi intae Israel! Ng'ura naa taata enkaji ino makewan Daudi.”

English: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Isiraeli ilng'oborri lenye. Kake eitoria apa Rehoboam iltung'ana loo Siraeli oomanya atua nkanas e Yuda.

English: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam airriwaa Adoram, laa ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai oo nkaik. Nenang iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli ninye too soito ometua. Neisarisaraki olaiguanani Rehoboam aked engari enye oo mbartan, neisikaki Yerusalem.

English: So Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku etekepari apa Isiraeli aagilunore enkaji e Daudi ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And it came to pass, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Israel: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening iltung'ana pooki loo siraeli nchere etorrinyunye Yeroboam, neirriwaa olkilikuai aaipotu ninye meeu eumata, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te shumata Isiraeli pooki. Meetae hoo obo otusujayie enkaji e Daudi, meteleku ake olosho le Yuda.

English: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Rehoboam Yerusalem, neiturrurru enkaji e Yuda pooki o losho le Benchamen, iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet, gelunot ooked ngarrin oo mbartan, pee earare enkaji e Israel, pee errinyoki enkitoria Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon.

English: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
Masaai: Kake eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Shemaia, ilo tung'ani le Nkai, ejo

English: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
Masaai: “Tiaki Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, olaiguanani le Yuda, o ltung'ana pooki le nkaji e Yuda o e ne Benchamen, o kulikae tung'ana pooki,

English: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of the LORD, and returned to depart, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: nji ejo Olaitoriani, milo iyie aarare ilalashera linono, lelo tung'ana le Israel. Torrinyoyu pooki ng'ae shomo enkang enye, amu ore ena bae naa nanu eing'uaa.” Neaku etoning'o ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, nerrinyo aapuo nkang'itie, te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeroboam ashet Shekem teina kop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, nelo abik teine, neitoki alo teine nelo ashet Penuel.

English: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
Masaai: Nejo Yeroboam to ltau lenye, “Kerrinyunye taata enkitoria alotu enkaji e Daudi,

English: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Judah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah.
Masaai: teneilep kulo tung'ana aapuo aaitayu ilasarri te nkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem. Neitoki iltauja le kulo tung'ana aaibelekenyakino olkitok lenye, Rehoboam olaiguanani le Yuda, naar ninche nanu matua nerrinyokino Rehoboam olaiguanani le Yuda.”

English: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Neaku eiguane olaiguanani, neitobir ilasho oare le sahabu. Nejoki olorere, “Ishomo intae Yerusalem enkata naado. Eng'ura nkaitin inyi intae Israel, naa ninche apa naaitayutuo intae te nkop e Misiri.”

English: And he set the one in Bethel, and the other put he in Dan.
Masaai: Neitasheyie ninye nabo te Betel nepik enkae Dan.

English: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
Masaai: Neaku ina bae eng'oki, amu eshomo iltung'ana aayiaya nabo te Betel, nepuo aayiaya enkae te Dan.

English: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
Masaai: Eitobira sii apa nkajijik too wuejitin e shumata, negelu ilapolosak tiatua olorere pooki, leme iloo Lawi.

English: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Judah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Bethel, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
Masaai: Negelu Yeroboam osirua te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa le isiet, anaa apa osirua oatae te Yuda, neitayu ninye ilasarri te nchumata olperere lo lasar; neaku etaasa ninye ina te Betel, apolosaki lelo asho ooitobira. Nepik ilapolosak Betel too wuejitin e shumata neeitobira ninye.

English: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Bethel the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Israel: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
Masaai: Neilep ninye alo ilo perere lo lasar oitobira te Betel te nkolong e tomon o imiet, to lapa le isiet, teilo apa otegelua ninye to ltau lenye makewan; neitisiny ilo sirua tenkaraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neilep alo olperere lo lasar apej enkorropil.

English: And, behold, there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the LORD unto Bethel: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
Masaai: Ore te nkintanapata o Laitoriani, nelotu oltung'ani le Nkai eing'uaa Yuda nelotu Betel. Neitashe apa Yeroboam tembata o lperere lo lasar apej enkorropil.

English: And he cried against the altar in the word of the LORD, and said, O altar, altar, thus saith the LORD; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon thee shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon thee, and men's bones shall be burnt upon thee.
Masaai: Neishiraki ilo tung'ani le Nkai olperere lo lasar to rorei lo Laitoriani ejo, “Lo perere lo lasar, lo perere, nji ejo Olaitriani: ‘Ng'ura, keikini enkaji e Daudi enkayioni, naa keji enkarna enye Yosia, naa kepolos ninye te shumata iyie lelo apolosak loo wuejitin e shumata, lelo oopej enkorropil te shumata iyie, naa kepuoi aapejoo iloik loo ltung'ana te shumata iyie.’ ”

English: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which the LORD hath spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
Masaai: Neishoru ninye olmonekie teina olong ake, ejo, “Olmonekie ele oiroro Olaitoriani; ejo, ‘Ng'ura kegili ele perere lo lasar aasulaki enkop, ore nena kuruon naatii enchumata enye nebukokini enkop.’ ”

English: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, which had cried against the altar in Bethel, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
