Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani ina kiroroto o ltung'ani le Nkai, naishiraka ilo perere lo lasar te Betel, neitorio enkaina enye teilo perere lo lasar ajo, “Embung'a ninye.” Ore ina aina enye duoo naitorioyie aimbung'ie ninye, netoyu, ometaa meekure errinyo.

English: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Nedanya sii olperere lo lasar neibukori nkuruon teilo perere lo lasar, te risioroto eilo monekie oishorua ilo tung'ani le Nkai to rorei lo Laitoriani.

English: And the king answered and said unto the man of God, Intreat now the face of the LORD thy God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of God besought the LORD, and the king's hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Toomonokoki taata to Laitoriani Enkai ino, pee etum enkaina ai anyaaki atisidana.” Neomon ilo tung'ani le Nkai Olaitoriani, neitoki enkaina olaiguanani aishiu, netiu anaa duoo.

English: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani ajoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Wou maape ang pee ilo ainos endaa, naaisho sii enkishoroto.”

English: And the man of God said unto the king, If thou wilt give me half thine house, I will not go in with thee, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai olaiguanani, “Tenikincho ninye olpisiaai le nkaji ino, maairiamariyie nanu iyie. Nemainos nanu endaa aashu aok enkare tene wueji;

English: For so was it charged me by the word of the LORD, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.
Masaai: amu ina apa aaitanapa ororei lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Minos endaa nimiok enkare, nimilo aim enkoitoi duoo niimua.’ ”

English: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Bethel.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye aim ae oitoi, neitu eibelekenya aim enkoitoi duoo naimua elotu Betel.

English: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
Masaai: Netii apa oloiboni moruo Betel. Nepuonu ilayiok lenyena aaliki nena pooki naataasa oltung'ani le Nkai ina olong te Betel; o lelo rorei sii ootiaaka olaiguanani, neliki ninche papaai lenye.

English: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went, which came from Judah.
Masaai: Nejoki papaai lenye ninche, “Kaa oitoi eima?” Neitodol ilayiok lenyena ninye ina oitoi naimua oltung'ani le Nkai oing'uaa Yuda.

English: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilayiok lenyena, “Erotokoki osikiria,” Neirotoki ninche ninye osikiria, neked ninye.

English: And went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah? And he said, I am.
Masaai: Nelo ninye asujaa ilo tung'ani le Nkai neinepu etonita te ntonata olchani, oji olmaloni; nejoki ninye, “Eiyie doi oltung'ani le Nkai oing'uaa Yuda?” Nejoki ninye, “Ee nanu.”

English: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Wou maape ang pee ilo ainos endaa.”

English: And he said, I may not return with thee, nor go in with thee: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place:
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Marrinyo nanu alo tenebo iyie, anaa alo ajing atua aji tenebo iyie; nemainos nanu endaa anaa aok enkare tenebo iyie tene wueji;

English: For it was said to me by the word of the LORD, Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest.
Masaai: amu aatiaka nanu ororei lo Laitoriani, ‘Minos endaa nimiok enkare teine, nimirrinyo aim enkoitoi duoo niimua.’ ”

English: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Ara sii nanu oloiboni le Nkai anaa iyie, naairorie nanu olmalaika to rorei lo Laitoriani, ejo, ‘Torrinyu ninye meeu tenebo iyie enkaji ino pee etum ainosa endaa neok enkare.’ ”

English: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
Masaai: Kake eteleja apa ninye ninye. Neaku eshomo tenebo ninye neinos endaa te nkaji enye neok enkare.

English: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of the LORD came unto the prophet that brought him back:
Masaai: Ore etonita ninche te mesa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ilo oiboni apa otorrinyuo ninye ariku;

English: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,
Masaai: neishiraki ninye ilo tung'ani le Nkai apa oing'uaa Yuda, ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki neitu imbung ororei lo Laitoriani, neitu imbung nkitanapat Olaitoriani Enkai, kake itorrinyunye,

English: But camest back, and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which the LORD did say to thee, Eat no bread, and drink no water; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers.
Masaai: ninya endaa niok enkare tene wueji, nikitiaaka apa ninye iyie “Minos endaa nimiok enkare.” Mepuoi aanukaa osesen lino te nkurare oo loo papaai lino.’ ”

English: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip ainosa endaa neokisho neirotoki osikiria ilo oiboni duoo otorrinyuo ariku.

English: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
Masaai: Ore eloito nenang'are olng'atuny ninye te nkoitoi near ninye metua. Nenang'akini osesen lenye enkoitoi, neitashe osikiria tembata enye; neitashe sii olng'atuny te mbata o sesen.

English: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura! etogiroitie iltung'ana nedol osesen otanang'akaki e nkoitoi, neitashe olng'atuny te mbata. Nepuonu aaimaki teina anasa apa namanya ilo oiboni moruo.

English: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the LORD: therefore the LORD hath delivered him unto the lion, which hath torn him, and slain him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake unto him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilo oiboni apa otorrinyuo ninye te nkoitoi ina, nejo ninye, “Oltung'ani le Nkai ilo; leitu ening ororei lo Laitoriani; neaku eishooyie Olaitoriani meinosa olng'atuny, neinos olng'atuny ninye aar metua, terisioroto eilo rorei oirorie ninye.”

English: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ilayiok lenyena, “Erotokoki nanu esikiria” neaku eirotokoki ninye esikiria,

English: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
Masaai: Nelo ninye neinepu ninye eirrag te nkoitoi, neitashe osikiria o lng'atuny te mbata ilo sesen Neitu einos olng'atuny ilo sesen neitu eony ilo sikiria.

English: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
Masaai: Neya ilo oiboni osesen leilo tung'ani le Nkai neiteleiki osikiria, nerrinyu ayau enkanasa pee eishiraki nenukaa.

English: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
Masaai: Neirragie ilo sesen anukaa te nkurare enye makewan; neishiraki ninche ninye ejo,

English: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
Masaai: “Ee olalashe lai!” Ore ake pee eidip atunukai ninye, nejoki ilayiok lenyena, “Tenaye akenya, entunukayioki te nkurare natunukarieki oltung'ani le Nkai; erragie iloik laainei tembata oo loik lenyena.

English: For the saying which he cried by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
Masaai: Amu ore ina kiroroto apa naishiraka to rorei lo Laitoriani olperere lo lasar te Betel, o nkajijik pooki oo wuejitin e shumata naati nkanas e Samaria, esipa, keyookini aaitabaya.”

English: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena eitu eibelekenya nkoitoi e Yeroboam torrok, kake enyaaka aitayu ilapolosak too wuejitin e shumata tiatua olorere pooki; te pooki ooyieu, neitisiny metaa ilapolosak too wuejitin e shumata.

English: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
Masaai: Neaku ena bae eng'oki te nkaji e Yeroboam, o metaa eiwuang'ieki neidaikieki aaishie te nkop.

English: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nemuoyu olayioni oji Abija, olayioni le Yeroboam.

English: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray thee, and disguise thyself, that thou be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get thee to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
Masaai: Nejoki Yeroboam enkitok enye, “Tudumunye nimbelekenya, pee meyiolouni ake ajo ira enkitok e Yeroboam, nilo Shilo; ng'ura etii oloiboni oji Ahija ine laa ninye apa oibonuo tialo nanu nchere kaaku olaiguanani le kulo tung'ana.

English: And take with thee ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell thee what shall become of the child.
Masaai: Toshoroi imukateni tomon, o embata oo mukateni naamelook o siang'au le naisho, nilo enetii ninye; pee kiliki ninye enatiu enkerai.”

English: And Jeroboam's wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
Masaai: Neas enkitok e Yeroboam ina, nedumunye ninye nelo Shilo, nelo enkaji e Ahija. Nemeekure apa edolisho Ahija amu eiliilaitie nkonyek enyena te nkaraki emoruao.

English: And the LORD said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shalt thou say unto her: for it shall be, when she cometh in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Ahija, “Ng'ura, kilotu enkitok e Yeroboam aikilikuanishore tenkaraki olayioni lenye; amu kemuoi ninye. Ena o ena tiaaki ninye.” Ore ake pee ebau neitaakuno kaae kitok.

English: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, thou wife of Jeroboam; why feignest thou thyself to be another? for I am sent to thee with heavy tidings.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Ahija oltoilo loo roruat enyena, ejing'u aimu kutukaji, nejoki “Tijing'u ena kitok e Yeroboam; kainyoo pee intaakuno eira likae tung'ani? Amu aaitanapaki ilomon ooiroishi tenkaraki iyie.

English: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people, and made thee prince over my people Israel,
Masaai: Shomo tiaaki Yeroboam ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli. “Ore amu aailepie iyie tiatua iltung'ana pooki, naaitaa iyie olarikoni te shumata iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli,

English: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it thee: and yet thou hast not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in mine eyes;
Masaai: natudung'oyie enkitoria aitung'uaa enkaji e Daudi, naaisho iyie; neitu ake sii itiu anaa osinka lai Daudi, apa oibung nkitanapat aainei naasuj ninye nanu to ltau lenye pooki, aas ake nena sidain too nkonyek aainei,

English: But hast done evil above all that were before thee: for thou hast gone and made thee other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and hast cast me behind thy back:
Masaai: kake ore iyie itaasa ntorrok aitalang nena pooki apa naatii dukuya iyie, nishomo dukuya aitobiraki kewan kulie aitin, o nkitanyaanyukot naasholuno, nikintagor nanu, nikincho nanu oriong. Ore naa ng'ura,

English: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
Masaai: kayau nanu entorroni shumata enkaji e Yeroboam, naiwuang'ie te Yeroboam pooki lee, aa oloena o lolakuno tiatua Israel pooki, namut nanu enkaji e Yeroboam tukul, anaa enapejoo oltung'ani olchala neishie.

English: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lo lmarei le Yeroboam oye tena anasa neinos ildiain. Ore pooki ng'ae oye tiong'ata neinos intaritik oloing'ang'e; amu Olaitoriani oiroro ena.” ’

English: Arise thou therefore, get thee to thine own house: and when thy feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
Masaai: “Tudumunye naa taata shomo enkaji ino. Naa tenebaiki nkejek inono enkanasa, neye ina kerai.

English: And all Israel shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward the LORD God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
Masaai: Naa keishiraki Isiraeli pooki ninye, nenukaa ninye; amu ore ilo laa ninye eeta Yeroboam naa kenukari te nkurare, amu atua ninye ake enotieki entoki naitiship Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, tiatua enkaji e Yeroboam.

English: Moreover the LORD shall raise him up a king over Israel, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
Masaai: Ore ake sii kedumu Olaitoriani tenkaraki kewan enye olaiguanani olotu shumata Isiraeli, laa ninye olo aiwuang'ie enkaji e Yeroboam.

English: For the LORD shall smite Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Israel out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking the LORD to anger.
Masaai: Naa keosh Olaitoriani Isirael neitotiu anaa oseyiai oikirikira tiatua enkare, naitayu isiraeli aiwuang'ie tena kop sidai apa naishoo loo menye, neidapashaki ninche teidia alo Frati, enkaraki naitobira ninche Asherim enye neitagor Olaitoriani.

English: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Naa kepalaa ninye Isiraeli tenkaraki ina ng'oki e Yeroboam, apa naataasa neitaas sii iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”

English: And Jeroboam's wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
Masaai: Nerrinyo enkitok e Yeroboam alo Tirsa. Ore ake pee ebau embata enkaji enye, neye enkerai.

English: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
Masaai: Nenukaa Isiraeli pooki ninye neishiraki terisioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Ahija oloiboni le Nkai.

English: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore kulie kiaasin e Yeroboam, ilarrabali, o enkitoria enye, ng'ura, eigeroki ninche te mbuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore enkata apa naitoreishe Yeroboam, naa ilarin tikitam oare, neirura aye anaa loo menye neitoreisho Nadab te rishata enye.

English: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD did choose out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
Masaai: Eitoria apa Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon Yuda. Ore apa pee eiteru Rehoboam aitoreisho naa oloo larin artam oobo. Eitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oopishana te Yerusalem, teina anasa naa ninye etegelua Olaitoriani tiatua iloshon pooki loo Siraeli, pee etum atipika enkarna enye ine. Naa keji apa enkarna e ng'otonye Naama e Amon.

English: And Judah did evil in the sight of the LORD, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
Masaai: Neas apa Yuda embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitagor ninche ninye nepik olom tenkaraki nena ng'ok enye naataasa.

English: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
Masaai: Amu eteshetakitia sii ninche ate iwuejitin e shumata, o ng'apeta o Asherim, te pooki wueji neika o tiabori pooki shani onyori

English: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
Masaai: neetae sii apa ilewa le nkisiaayiare e seremare enkibor oo nkonyek teina kop. Etaasa ninche te risioroto e nena pooki olminong te lelo oreren apa ootaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
Masaai: Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Rehoboam neilepu Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri alotu agilunore Yerusalem;

English: And he took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
Masaai: neya ninye ilchumat te nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat te nkaji o laiguanani, neya ninye pooki toki. Neya sii nena long'oi pooki e sahabu apa naaitobira Solomon;

English: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king's house.
Masaai: neitobir olaiguanani Rehoboam ilong'oi o suyai apik erishata e nena, neisho ninche lelo kituaak le rripore, apa oorripito kutukaji e nkaji o laiguanani.

English: And it was so, when the king went into the house of the LORD, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
Masaai: Naa ore ake tenelo olaiguanani enkaji o Laitoriani, nenapu olarriponi nena long'oi ayau enkaji e rripore.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Rehoboam o pooki apa naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
Masaai: Neeta apa Rehoboam o Yeroboam olarrabal anaake.

English: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Rehoboam, neye anaa loo menye nenukari too nkuraren oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Naama e Amon. neitoreisho Abijam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
Masaai: Ore apa to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o layioni le Nebat, neiteru Abijan aitoreisho te Yuda.

English: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
Masaai: Neitoreisho ninye ilarin okuni te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Maaka entito e Abishalom.

English: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
Masaai: Neas ninye ing'ok pooki apa naataasa menye te dukuya ninye, nemeitoriori oltau lenye tialo Olaitoriani Enkai enye, anaa apa oltau le Daudi papaai lenye.

English: Nevertheless for David's sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia tenkaraki Daudi, neisho ninye Olaitoriani oltaa te Yerusalem, aisho olayioni lenye metijing'a erishata enye, neitasheyie Yerusalem;

English: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
Masaai: enkaraki apa nataasa Daudi mbaa supati too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitu ninye eibelekenya te pooki toki naitanapa ninye Olaitoriani, too nkolong'i pooki enkishui enye, meteleku ake te mbae naipirta Uria ilo le Hiti.

English: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
Masaai: Neeta Rehoboam o Yeroboam olarrabal too nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Abijam, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda. Neeta apa Abijan olarrabal o Yeroboam.

English: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Abijam neye anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Asa olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam le nkitoria e Yeroboam olaiguanani loo Siraeli neiteru Asa aitoreisho te Yuda.

English: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
Masaai: Neitoreisho ilarin artam oobo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Maaka entito e Abishalom.

English: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.
Masaai: Neas Asa mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani anaa apa enataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie lelo lewa le nkisiaayiare e seremare enkiborra oo nkonyek apa naitobira loo menye.

English: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ieki sii Maaka ng'otonye meitoki aaku enkaiguanani enkaraki naata apa enkitanyaanyukoto olminong apa naitobirakaki Ashera, nesulaki Asa ina kitanyaanyukoto enkop nepejoo to erata le Kedron.

English: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika. Ore ake eyia, keitoriori apa oltau le Asa tialo Olaitoriani katukul, nkolong'i pooki enkishiu enye.

English: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
Masaai: Neyau ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani ntokitin apa naaitisinya menye o naaitisinya ninye makewan, enkosholai, o sahabu o masaa.

English: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
Masaai: Netii apa olarrabal erishata e Asa o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli too nkolong'i enye pooki.

English: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
Masaai: Eshomo Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli agilunore Yuda, neshet Rama, pee etum aibooi pooki ng'ae olotu enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Benhadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
Masaai: Neyau Asa enkosholai pooki oina sahabu apa natelekua to lchumati le nkaji Olaitoriani, o to lchumati le nkaji o Laitoriani, nepik nkaik oo sinkan lenyena. Neirriwaa olaiguanani Asa ninche meshomo enetii Benhadad olayioni le Tabrimon olayioni le Hesion, olaiguanani le Siria, laa Dameski apa namanya, nejoki,

English: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
Masaai: “Maibung'ata iyiook pokira anaa apa enatiu papaai o papaai lino: ng'ura aairriwaka nanu iyie enkishoroto e nkosholai o sahabu. Shomo ntobira osotua lino o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli, pee aatum atung'uai nanu.”

English: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-Bethmaachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
Masaai: Nening Benhadad enatejo olaiguanani Asa, neirriwaa ilarikok lenyena le njore meshomo aagilunore nkanas oo Siraeli, nemir Ljion, o Dan, o Abelbet-Maaka o Kinerut pooki tenebo enkop pooki e Naftali.

English: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Baasha ina, neitu eitoki ashet Rama, nelo ninye abik te Tirsa.

English: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Asa alimu enkitanapata, tiatua Yuda pooki, pee meing'uari ninye oltung'ani obo, pee epuo aaya lelo soito apa le Rama o mbaoi enyena, apa naa ninche eshetishore Baasha, nelo olaiguanani Asa ashetie Geba e Benchamen o Mispa.

English: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Asa, enkidimata enye pooki, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o nkanas naatesheta ninye, neigero pooki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli. Kake ore etamorua ninye netum emuoyian too nkejek enyena.

English: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Asa neye anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkurare oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Yehoshafat olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
Masaai: Neiteru Nadab olayioni le Yeroboam aitoreisho tiatua Isiraeli, to lari liare le Asa ilo aiguanani le Yuda. Neitoreishe ninye te Israel ilarin oare.

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye ntorrok te dukuya nkonyek Olaitoriani, nelo aibung olkuaak, le menye. Neas ing'ok nerikoki Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
Masaai: Ore Baasha olayioni le Ahija lo losho le Isaakar, nerresh ninye. Near Baasha ninye metua te Gibeton nara enoo lfilisti, amu eirraga apa Nadab o Siraeli pooki aang'adu Gibeton.

English: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neaku etaara Baasha ninye metua to lari liokuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye te rishata e Nadab.

English: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
Masaai: Ore ake pee eaku olaiguanani nesesekuan enkaji e Yeroboam pooki, eitu ninye eing'uaa olaishirani te nkaji e Yeroboam. Eidakie pooki te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye oji Ahija le Shilo.

English: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
Masaai: Naa tenkaraki nena ng'ok e Yeroboam apa naataasa, nerikoki Israel metaasa engoki, o enkaraki ina naitagoro ninye Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Nadab, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
Masaai: Neeta apa Asa olarrabal, o Baasha ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli too nkolong'i enye pooki.

English: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
Masaai: Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Baasha olayioni le Ahija aitore Israel pooki te Tisra, neitoreisho ilarin tikitam oong'uan.

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye intorrok too nkonyek Olaitoriani, neibung orrekie le Yeroboam teina ng'oki natorikoko Israeli metaasa.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Yehu olayioni le Hanani tenkaraki Baasha, ejo,

English: Forasmuch as I exalted thee out of the dust, and made thee prince over my people Israel; and thou hast walked in the way of Jeroboam, and hast made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
Masaai: “Ore anaa naadumu ailepie iyie aitung'uaa nkulukuok, naaitaa iyie olarikoni loo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli, nimbung'a iyie orrekie le Yeroboam, nitorikoko iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok, kintagoro nanu tenkaraki ing'ok enye.

English: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaiwuang'ie nanu katukul, Baasha o enkaji enye aishie. naitotiu enkaji ino anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nabat.

English: Him that dieth of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dieth of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae to lmarei le Baasha oye tiatua enkanasa, neinos ildiain. Ore pooki ng'ae oye tiong'ota neinos ilmotonyi lo loing'ang'e.”

English: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkiaasin e Baasha, o naataasa, o enkidimata enye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Baasha neye anaa loo menye nenukari te Tirsa; neitoreisho Ela olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of the LORD against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of the LORD, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
Masaai: Neitoki ororei Lo Laitoriani alotu eimu Yehu oloiboni le Nkai, olayioni le Hanani. Baasha o enkaji enye apa eipirta ilo rorei, tenkaraki entorroni pooki apa nataasa too nkonyek Olaitoriani, neitagor ninye teina siaai oo nkaik enyena, neiko anaa apa Yeroboam, nenyaaka sii aidaikie.

English: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Judah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Israel in Tirzah, two years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam o ile lo laiguanani Asa le Yuda, neitore Ela olayioni le Baasha Isiraeli te Tirsa. neitoreisho ilarin oare.

English: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
Masaai: Kake etarresho Simri, ilo kitok lo lpisiaai loo ngarrin oo mbartan ninye. Ore apa etii ninye Tirsa, eokisho nemera te nkaji e Arsa, laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji te Tirsa,

English: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his stead.
Masaai: nejing'u Simiri neosh ninye anang'ie enkop, near metua to lari le tikitam oopishana le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.

English: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiteru aitoreisho, ore ake enatonie to lorika lenye le nkitoo, near enkaji e Baasha pooki metuata. Eitu ninye eing'uaa olee obo lo lmarei lenye anaa ilchoreta lenyena.

English: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
Masaai: Neidaikie Simri anaa enkaji e Baasha pooki, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa oiroro tialo Baasha aimunye Yehu oloiboni le Nkai,

English: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Israel to sin, in provoking the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
Masaai: tenkaraki ing'ok pooki e Baasha o ng'ok e Ela olayioni lenye apa naataasa ninche. Eitagoro ninche Olaitoriani Enkai oo siraeli too nkitanyaanyukot enye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Ela o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam oo pishana le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda neitoreisho Simri nkolong'i naapishana te Tirsa. Netii apa iltimito ootuuno ilng'oborri egilunore Gibeton oo Lfilisti,

English: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri hath conspired, and hath also slain the king: wherefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Israel that day in the camp.
Masaai: ore lelo timito ootii ilng'oborri nening eji, “Etarresho Simri olaiguanani near metua.” Ore enkaraki ina neitaa Isiraeli pooki Omori ilo kitok le njore, metaa olaiguanani le Israel ina olong oo lng'oborri.

English: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
Masaai: Neaku eilepa Omori aing'uaa Gibeton o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye. Nepuo aang'adu Tirsa.

English: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king's house, and burnt the king's house over him with fire, and died,
Masaai: ore ake pee edol Simiri nchere eibung'aki enkanasa, nelo ninye olgilata liatua le nkaji o laiguanani, nepejoo inaa aji o laiguanani etii atua, neye ninye.

English: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the LORD, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Israel to sin.
Masaai: Etua tenkaraki e nena ng'ok enyena naataasa, neas ntorrok te dukuya Olaitoriani, neibung olkerreti le Yeroboam. O tenkaraki sii ng'ok naataasa erikoki Isiraeli ing'ok.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Simiri, oina natarreshishe, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
Masaai: Etoorote apa iltung'ana loo Siraeli katitin are: etusujaitie olpisiaai loo ltung'ana Tibni olayioni le Ginat aaitaa olaiguanani. Etusujaitie olikae pisiaai Omori.

English: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo tung'ana ootusujaitie Omori, nemir lelo ootusuja Tibni olayioni le Ginat. Neaku etua Tibni neaku Omori ninye olaiguanani.

English: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni oo kuni le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Omori aitore Israel, neitoreisho ilarin tomon oare. Too larin ile eitoria Tirsa.

English: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
Masaai: Einyiang'ua apa ninye endoinyo e Samaria te Shemer neinosie ntalantani are e nkosholai, neitobir apa ninye ina doinyo ashet, nejo enkarna eina anasa natesheta Samaria, eipotie enkarna e Shemer, olopeny ina doinyio.

English: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.
Masaai: Neas Omori ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neas ntorrok aitulus te lelo pooki ooituruko te dukuya ninye.

English: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin, to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger with their vanities.
Masaai: Amu eibung'a ninye olkerreti le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat. Ore too ng'ok naatorikoko ninye Israeli metaasa, neitagor Olaitoriani Enkai oo siraeli, tenkaraki nkitanyaanyukot enye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin naataasa Omori, oina kidimata naitodolua, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Omori neye anaa loo menye. nenukari te Samaria. Neitoreisho Ahab olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o isiet le nkitoria e Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Ahab olayioni le Omori aitore Isiraeli te Samaria. Neitoreisho ilarin tikitam oong'uan.

English: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD above all that were before him.
Masaai: Neas Ahab olayioni le Omori ntorrok te dukuya Olaitoriani aitulus te lelo apa ooituruko te dukuya ninye.

English: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
Masaai: Ore edol anaa entoki nalelek te ninye teneibung olkerreti le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, neyau ninye Yesebel entito e Etabal olaiguanani le Sidon aitaa enkitok enye. Nelo ninye aisiai Baal neserem ninye.

English: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
Masaai: Neshetaki ninye Baal olperere lo lasar tiatua enkaji e Baal apa natesheta te Samaria.

English: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke the LORD God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him.
Masaai: Neitobir Ahab ashera. Etaasa Ahab mbaa kumok aitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli aitulus too laiguanak pooki loo Siraeli apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

English: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i enyena neshet Hiel le Betel Yeriko. Etipika ninye olkitamanyunoto ainosie Abiram olkikau lenye, nepik nchomito ainosie Segub olayioni lenye oti, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro aimunye Yoshua olayioni le Nuni.

English: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As the LORD God of Israel liveth, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
Masaai: Nejoki apa Eliya le Tishbi te Gilead, nejoki Ahab, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, laa te dukuya ninye aitashe, metumi enkinuku aashu enchan te kuna olong'i, meteleku ake to rorei lai.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ninye, ejo,

English: Get thee hence, and turn thee eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
Masaai: shomo tung'uai ine nimbelekenya alo enkalo o loosaen, nilo aisudori to erata le Kerit. Aa taa oloo saen lo lkeju le Yordan.

English: And it shall be, that thou shalt drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed thee there.
Masaai: Shomo tooko enkare eilo erata amu aitanapa nanu ilkurruki pee kintoti iyie teine.

English: So he went and did according unto the word of the LORD: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani. Nelo ninye abik tembata eilo erata le Kerit tenkalo oloosaen to lkeju le Yordan.

English: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
Masaai: Neyaki ilkurruki ninye imukateni o nkiri tadekenya, neyaki sii teipa, neokisho teilo shorro.

English: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti kata netoyu ilo shorro, amu meetae apa enchan teina kop.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto him, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii ninye, nejoki,

English: Arise, get thee to Zarephath, which belongeth to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain thee.
Masaai: “Tudumunye, shomo Serafat e Sidon, nilo abik teine. Ng'ura aitanapa nanu enkoliai teine pee kintoti iyie.”

English: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray thee, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye ninye nelo Serafat. Ore ake pee ebaiki kishomi enkanasa, ng'ura etii enkoliai ine nasotu ilkeek, neipot ninye nejoki, “Iyakaki nanu enkiti are te nkikompe, pee aok.”

English: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray thee, a morsel of bread in thine hand.
Masaai: Ore eloito ina oliai ayau enkare, neipotu ninye ajoki, “Iyakaki nanu embelati e mukate te nkaina ino.”

English: And she said, As the LORD thy God liveth, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
Masaai: Nejoki ina oliai ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, eitu nanu apej toki, emborei enkaina e ntapa ake aata te siang'au o enkiti ilata to ltulet. Naa ore taata, ilkuti keek nanu asotu pee alo ayier tenkaraki kewan ai o enkayioni ai, pee kitum aainosa nikiye.”

English: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as thou hast said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for thee and for thy son.
Masaai: Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Miureisho, shomo taasa anaa enitejo; kake tang'asa ntobirakaki enkiti mukate nikiyaki, ore tesiadi ina nintoki taa aitobiraki kewan o enkayioni ino.

English: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that the LORD sendeth rain upon the earth.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, ‘Ore ilo siang'au le ntapa metoyu aekata, ore ilo tulet le ilata nemeishunye aekata ometabau ina olong nairriwaki Olaitoriani enchan enkop.’ ”

English: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
Masaai: Nelo ninye aas anaa enatejo Eliya; ore ninye o Eliya olmarei lenye neinos endaa nkolong'i kumok.

English: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Elijah.
Masaai: Ore ilo siang'au le ntapa neitu aekata etoyu, neitu aekata eishunye ilo tulet le ilata, terisioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani oirorie Eliya.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena olong'i nemuoyu enkayioni eina oliai. Neitirrishaki emuoyian oleng o metaa meekure eyang.

English: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Eliya, “Kaa kiaatakinore iyie nanu, lo tung'ani le Nkai? Iewuo iyie enatii pee edamuni eng'oki ai, niyau keeya e nkayioni ai!”

English: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
Masaai: Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Inchooki sii iyie ina ayioni ino.” Neya ninye ina ayioni too nkaik e ngotonye, nenap ninye aya olgilata le shumata ine apa neirrag ninye, neirragie te ndapash enye makewan.

English: And he cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
Masaai: Neishiraki ninye Olaitoriani ejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyaka iyie entorroni shumata ena oliai apa naa ninye aewuo airragaa, aar enkayioni enye metua?”

English: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto the LORD, and said, O LORD my God, I pray thee, let this child's soul come into him again.
Masaai: Neitoriori ninye te shumata ina ayioni katitin uni, neishiraki Olaitoriani, ejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, nchoo enkishui ena kerai errinyokino.”

English: And the LORD heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
Masaai: Nening Olaitoriani olkiyioi le Eliya; nerrinyokino ina kerai enkishui enye aitoki, nepiu ninye.

English: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
Masaai: Neya Eliya ina kerai, neitadou aitung'uaa ilo gilata le shumata, neyau olgilata neitarasaki ngotonye; nejo Eliya, “Ng'ura eishu enkayioni ino.

English: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that thou art a man of God, and that the word of the LORD in thy mouth is truth.
Masaai: Nejoki ina kitok Eliya, “Ayiolo taa taata ajo ira iyie oltung'ani le Nkai, nesipa ororei lo Laitoriani te nkutuk ino.”

English: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of the LORD came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i kumok, nelotu ororei le Nkai enetii Eliya, to lari liokuni, ejo, “Shomo ntoduaai kewan te Ahab, amu kairriwaki nanu enchan enkop.”

English: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
Masaai: Kaae nelo Eliya aitoduaaya kewan te Ahab. Ore apa ina kata netirrisha olameyu te Samaria.

English: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the LORD greatly:
Masaai: Neipotu Ahab Obadiah laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji enye. Naa keyanyit apa Obadiah Olaitoriani oleng.

English: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the LORD, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee earaa Yesebel iloibonok lo Laitoriani, neya Obadia iloibonok le Nkai iip nelo aisudoo moo onom te nkapune, neitoti ninche too mukateni o te nkare.

English: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
Masaai: Neipotu Ahab Obadiah nejoki, “Shomo atua enkop pooki, o nchorroi pooki oo nkariak o erat pooki, amu ebaiki nikitum nkujit nikincho mbartan o nyumpui meye, pee mikintiany ake embata oo ng'uesi.”

English: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
Masaai: Neaku etooro apa ninche enkop pokira oare, pee etum aashom. Nelo Ahab enkae alo nelo Obadia enkae alo openy.

English: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Art thou that my lord Elijah?
Masaai: Ore eloito Obadia te nkoitoi, ng'ura, nenang'are Eliya ninye; neyiolou Obadia ninye, nebatata te nkomom abaiki enkop, nejo, “Kaiyie ele olkitok lai Eliya?”

English: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Ee nanu. Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino, ‘Ng'ura ajo etii Eliya ene!’ ”

English: And he said, What have I sinned, that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
Masaai: Nejoki Obadia ninye, “Kaa ng'oki ataasa nanu, eji metaa nchooyo osinka lino apik enkaina e Ahab, maataara nanu matua?

English: As the LORD thy God liveth, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found thee not.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, meetae olorere aashu enkitoria neitu eirriwaa olkitok lai ilkiliku king'oru iyie, naa tenejo ninche, ‘Metii ninye ene,’ neinosie olmumai ina kitoria aashu ilo orere, nchere eitu ninche kitum iyie.

English: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
Masaai: Eji ore taata nijo iyie, ‘Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino, “Ng'ura, etii Eliya ene.” ’

English: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from thee, that the Spirit of the LORD shall carry thee whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find thee, he shall slay me: but I thy servant fear the LORD from my youth.
Masaai: Naa tenaaorore nanu iyie nikiya iyie enkiyang'et o Laitoriani ewueji nemayiolo, niaaku tenalo nanu ajoki Ahab ina, nikilau ninye, naar nanu matua, hoo nayanyita nanu osinka lino Olaitoriani ebaiki telelero ai.

English: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of the LORD, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD'S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
Masaai: Aimetolikioki apa olkitok lai enataasa ina kata apa ear Yesebel iloibonok lo Laitoriani, naisudoo nanu iloibonok iip lo Laitoriani, moonom tiatua enkapune, naitoti nanu ninche too mukateni o te nkare?

English: And now thou sayest, Go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
Masaai: Eji nijo taata iyie, “Shomo tiaaki olkitok lino, ng'ura etii Eliya ene.” Pee aar nanu matua.

English: And Elijah said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
Masaai: Nejo Eliya, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa te dukuya ninye nanu aitashe, kalo ake aitoduaaya kewan ai te ninye taata.”

English: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
Masaai: Kaae nelo Obadia atumore Ahab, neliki ninye. Nelo Ahab atumore Eliya.

English: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Art thou he that troubleth Israel?
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Ahab Eliya, nejoki ninye, “Kaa iyie doi ele, olaitanyamalani loo Siraeli?” Newaliki ninye ajoki,

English: And he answered, I have not troubled Israel; but thou, and thy father's house, in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the LORD, and thou hast followed Baalim.
Masaai: “Eitu nanu aitanyamal Isirael kake iyie oitanyamala, o enkaji e papaai lino, enkaraki nitalama nkitanapat o Laitoriani, nisujaa Baal.

English: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel's table.
Masaai: Ore naa taata shomo nturrurrokoki iltung'ana loo Siraeli to ldoinyo le Karmel, o lelo oibonok pokira iip ong'uan o onom le Baal. O lelo oibonok iip ong'uan le Ashera, oodaa te Mesa e Yesebel.”

English: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
Masaai: Neipotu Ahab iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, neiturrur iloibonok tenebo to ldoinyo le Karmel.

English: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt ye between two opinions? if the LORD be God, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
Masaai: Nelotu Eliya anyikaki iltung'ana pooki nejoki, “Ibukaashasha akenya o anu too ndamunot are? Tenaa Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, entusuj ninye; kake tenaa Baal nisujaa ninye.” Neitu ewaliki iltung'ana ororei hoo obo.

English: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of the LORD; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki iltung'ana, “Nanu ake openy taata otelekua too loibonok lo Laitoriani; kake ore iloibonok le Baal naa iip ong'uan o onom.

English: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
Masaai: Nchoo meishori iyiook iloing'ok oare naa nchoo ninche metegelaki ate obo, nedung'udung neiteleiki ilkeek, kake emipik enkima ine. Naa kaitobir sii nanu olikae oing'oni naiteleiki ilkeek, nemapik enkima ine.

English: And call ye on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the LORD: and the God that answereth by fire, let him be God. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
Masaai: Nimpotipoto enkarna e nkai inyi, naipot sii nanu enkarna Olaitoriani. Ore Enkai nawalu te nkima naa ninye Enkai.” Newalu iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Enkiroroto sidai.”

English: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for ye are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki lelo oibonok le Baal “Entegelaki ate oloing'oni obo ning'asing'asa aaitobir, amu intae ilkumok. Nimpotipoto enkarna e nkai inyi, kake emipik enkima.”

English: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
Masaai: Neya ninche oloing'oni obo oishooki ninche, neitobir ninye, neipot enkarna e Baal ebaiki tadekenya ometaa dama, ejo, “Oo Baal tawaliki iyiook!” Kake eitu etumi oltoilo anaa oltung'ani otawala. Neitiam ninche aaman ilo perere lo lasar apa oitobira.

English: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
Masaai: Ore eipira enkolong neikoroj Eliya ninche, ejo “Entabuaku oleng amu enkai ninye, ebaiki negira adamisho oleng, aashu enyamalita, aashu eshomo nkang'itie. Aashu ebaiki neirura naa keishiaakino neinyeyieki.”

English: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
Masaai: Neishir ninche aabuaku, nedung'udung ate too lalema anaa enatiu olkerreti lenye, ometaba anaa nerukunye osarge too seseni lenye.

English: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo enkipirrata e nkolong, nelimana ninche aaibonisho ometabau erishata naishoori olasar. Kake meetae oltoilo otoning'oki, metii ewalata, nemetii oltung'ani otishilayie.

English: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of the LORD that was broken down.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki iltung'ana pooki, “Wootu entinyikakaki,” nepuonu iltung'ana pooki aanyikaki ninye. Neram ninye ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otigilaki.

English: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of the LORD came, saying, Israel shall be thy name:
Masaai: Neya Eliya isoito tomon oare te risioroto e siana oo layiok le Yakobo, laa ninche apa eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii, “Ejo keaku eikiji enkarna ino Isiraeli.”

English: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
Masaai: Ore te lelo soito neshetu olperere lo lasar te nkarna Olaitoriani. Netur ninye engumoto aitaman emanaroto olperer lo lasar, oba tendapasho anaa ilanterera oare.

English: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
Masaai: Nepik ilkeek aitobiraki. Nedung'udung ilo oing'oni aitaa ndung'udung'ot neiteleiki shumata lelo keek. Neitoki ninye ajo, “Emputa iltooi oong'uan enkare, nibukokiki olasar opejori, tenchumata oo lkeek.”

English: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
Masaai: Neitoki ajo, “Engilie entubukoki” neigilie ninche eniare. “Neitoki ajo “Engilie ene uni;” neigilie ninche ene uni.

English: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
Masaai: Neigilie ninche ene uni. Neruko enkare teilo perere lo lasar, neiput ine negum nemanaa to lperere lo lasar.

English: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known this day that thou art God in Israel, and that I am thy servant, and that I have done all these things at thy word.
Masaai: Ore te nkata naishoori olasar le nkitukuo, nelotu oloiboni Eliya anyiku nejo, “Oi Olaitoriani, naa Ai e Abraham, o Isaak, o Israel, nchoo eyiolouni ena olong nchere iyie Enkai tiatua Israeli. Nara nanu osinka lino, naa tenkarna ino nanu ataasa kuna kitoduat pooki.

English: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
Masaai: Tawalikiaki nanu Olaitoriani, tawalikiaki pee eyiolou kulo tung'ana nchere, iyie Olaitoriani ora Enkai, naa iyie oibelekenya iltauja lenye.”

English: Then the fire of the LORD fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
Masaai: Nedou enkima o Laitoriani, neinos ilo asar, olkeek o soito, o enterit neishu ina are apa natii ewueji negum nemanaa to lperere lo lasar.

English: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, The LORD, he is the God; the LORD, he is the God.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki ina, nebatata aaitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop; nejo, “Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.”

English: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninche, “Embung'a lelo oibonok le Baal; emincho ninye elo obo.” Neibung'i ninche, neyau Eliya ninche aitadou ayau olchorro le Kishon, near ninche metuata teine.

English: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get thee up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki Ahab, “Ilepa shomo tadaayu niokisho; amu ening'o oltoilo le nchan eshaita.” Kaae nelo Ahab adaa neokisho.

English: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
Masaai: Neilep Eliya alo enchumata oldoinyo le Karmel, neirrugo abaiki enkop, nepik enkomom enye erishata oo nkung enyena.

English: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye osinka lenye, “Ilepa taata shomo, ning'or enkalo e naiposha.” Neilep ninye alo neing'or, nejo, “Metii toki.”

English: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea, like a man's hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare thy chariot, and get thee down, that the rain stop thee not.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Nyaaki shomo katitin naapishana.” Ore te nkata e naapishana nejo ninye, “Ng'ura etii enkiti atampoi naikununo anaa enkaina oltung'ani nailepu tiatua enaiposha.” Neitoki ajoki, “Ilepu shomo tiaaki Ahab, ‘Ntobira engarri ino oo mbartan nidoyio alo, pee mikimbok ake enchan.’ ”

English: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata neroku shumata too nkatampo o to siwuo, nelotu enchan kitok, neked Ahab engarri enye nelo Yesreel.

English: And the hand of the LORD was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
Masaai: Netii apa enkaina Olaitoriani shumata Eliya; nerreten ninye empolos enye nekuet aituruk te Ahab nelo enjing'et e Yesreel.

English: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
Masaai: Neliki Ahab Yesebel nena pooki naataasa Eliya. Oina sii natara metuata iloibonok pooki to lalem.

English: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesebel airriwaki Eliya olkilikuai, ejo, “Maaitaasa nanu nkaitin ina, naaitulus sii, teneitu nanu aitotiu enkishui ino anaa enkishui e obo lenye tena saa taisere.”

English: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongeth to Judah, and left his servant there.
Masaai: Neureishoyu ninye neinyototo aisik, nelo Beer-sheba e Yuda neing'uaa osinka lenye teine.

English: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
Masaai: Kake ore ninye makewan eshomo elototo enkolong nabo tiong'ota. Nelo aton te ntonata olchani oata oloip. Neomonu pee eye, ejo, “Eiririkine Olaitoriani, iwuang'ie enkishui ai, amu maikash nanu too loo papa.”

English: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
Masaai: Neirrag ninye airura to loip lo lchani, naa ng'ura neiseyie olmalaika ninye nejoki ninye, “Tudumunye inosa endaa.”

English: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
Masaai: Neing'orisho ninye, naa ng'ura etii embata e ndukuya enye emukate natapejoki too soito ooirowua, o esiang'au e nkare. Nedaa ninye neokisho, neitoki airrag.

English: And the angel of the LORD came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for thee.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika lo Laitoriani enkata e are, neiseyie ninye, nejoki, “Tudumunye inosa endaa, amu kegolu elototo te iyie.”

English: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye nedaa neokisho, nelo te ngolon eina daa nainosa too nkolong'i artam, o nkewarietin artam, omeshomo Horeb ilo doinyo le Nkai.

English: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of the LORD came to him, and he said unto him, What doest thou here, Elijah?
Masaai: Nebau ninye enkapune neirrag ine, naa ng'ura, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii ninye, nejoki ninye, “Kaa iasita tene, Eliya?”

English: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aata apa nanu olom to Laitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, amu etanyaita iltung'ana loo Siraeli olning'o lino, nesulaa ilpereren loo lasarri, near iloibonok linono metuata to lalem; metaa nanu ake, nanu ake openy otelekua; neing'oru ninche enkishui ai, pee eiwuang'ie.”

English: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before the LORD. And, behold, the LORD passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before the LORD; but the LORD was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but the LORD was not in the earthquake:
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Shomo ntasho te nchumata o ldoinyo te dukuya Olaitoriani.” Naa ng'ura eloito Olaitoriani agiroo, nekut olkutati kitok ogol lelo doinyo, nebel ndapidapo aitaa mbelibelat te dukuya Olaitoriani, kake metii Olaitoriani atua olkutati. Ore te siadi olkutati nelotu enkikirikirata enkop, kake metii Olaitoriani atua enkikirikirata e Nkop.

English: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
Masaai: Ore te siadi enkikirikirata enkop nelotu enkima, kake metii Olaitoriani atua enkima. Ore te siadi enkima nelotu oloti toilo obor.

English: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What doest thou here, Elijah?
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Eliya ina, neimulumul enkomom enye to lkila nelo aitashe te nkutuk e nkapune. Naa ng'ura nelotu oltoilo enetii ninye, nejoki, “Kaa iyie iasita tene, Eliya?”

English: And he said, I have been very jealous for the LORD God of hosts: because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant, thrown down thine altars, and slain thy prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Aata apa nanu olom te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani amu etanyaita iltung'ana loo Siraeli olning'o lino, neuroo ilpereren linono loo lasarri, near iloibonok linono metuata tolalem, netaa nanu ake openy otelekua, neing'oru ninche enkishui ai peyie eiwuang'ie.”

English: And the LORD said unto him, Go, return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when thou comest, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Torrinyoyu shomo te nkoitoi ino enkalo e ong'ata e Dameski; ore ake pee ibaya, nilo abukoki eilata Hasael, aput metaa olaiguanani le Siria.

English: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shalt thou anoint to be king over Israel: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abelmeholah shalt thou anoint to be prophet in thy room.
Masaai: Niput Yehu olayioni le Nimshi metaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Ore Elisha olayioni le Shefat le Abel-mehola, nibukoki eilata aput metaa oloiboni le Nkai te rishata ino.

English: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
Masaai: Ore ilo oilanya olalem le Hasael nelo Yehu aar metua. Ore ilo oilany olalem le Yehu nelo Elisha aar metua.

English: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Israel, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which hath not kissed him.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia kaleku nanu nkalifuni naapishana tiatua Isiraeli, lelo pooki leitu egilaki kung neitu eirrugokino Baal, o pooki leitu eng'utut Baal.”

English: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
Masaai: Kaae nelo Eliya teine, nelo atum Elisha olayioni le Shefat eturishore ilmong'i tomon oare. Netii apa ninye tenebo ilo kiteng le tomon oare. Negiroo Eliya ninye nenang'aki olkila lenye.

English: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
Masaai: Neing'ua Elisha lelo mong'i nekuet asujaa Eliya, nejoki ninye, “Nchooki nanu mashomo ang'utut papaai o yieyioo aisho ole sere, pee aatum atusuja iyie.” Nejoki Eliya ninye, “Torrinyoyu shomo; amu kaa nanu aaitaasa iyie?”

English: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.
Masaai: Nerrinyo ninye te sujata enye, neitayu nena keek oo murto oo lmong'i neyieng ninche. Neyier nkiri enye tenebo nkeek oo murto oo lmong'i. Neisho iltung'ana meinosa, neinos ninche. Neitoki ninye adumunye alo asujaa Eliya nelo aisiaai ninye.

English: And Benhadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
Masaai: Eiturrurro apa Benhadad iltung'ana lenyena tenebo. Netii ilaiguanak tomoni uni oare tenebo ninye, neeta mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan. Nelo ninye aman Samaria neitayunye olarrabal.

English: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city, and said unto him, Thus saith Benhadad,
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye ilkiliku enkanasa e Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Benhadad.

English: Thy silver and thy gold is mine; thy wives also and thy children, even the goodliest, are mine.
Masaai: ‘Ore enkosholai ino o sahabu ino naa nkunainei. Inaainei nkituaak inono o nkera inono.’ ”

English: And the king of Israel answered and said, My lord, O king, according to thy saying, I am thine, and all that I have.
Masaai: Newal olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo, “Ore anaa enitejo olkitok lai, lo aiguanani, ara nanu olino, o nena pooki naata nanu.”

English: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaketh Benhadad, saying, Although I have sent unto thee, saying, Thou shalt deliver me thy silver, and thy gold, and thy wives, and thy children;
Masaai: Neitoki ilkiliku aapuonu ejo, “Nji ejo Benhadad: ‘Aairriwaka nanu iyie ilkiliku ajo, “Iyakaki nanu enkosholai ino, o sahabu ino, o nkituaak inono o nkera inono.”

English: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time, and they shall search thine house, and the houses of thy servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia kaairriwaki nanu isinkan laainei taisere tena saa, naa kepuonu aajur enkaji ino o nkajijik oo sinkan linono, neya pooki toki naitiship ninche.’ ”

English: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur ilpayiani pooki leina kop, nejoki, “Entisipu taata nidolidolo aajo enyamali eing'oru ele tung'ani. Amu aairriwaka ninye nanu olkilikuai te nkaraki nkituaak aainei o nkera aainei, o tenkaraki enkosholai ai osahabu, nemaata nanu entoki natomito.”

English: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani pooki oltung'ana pooki, nejoki ninye, “Mining iyie ninye niminyorraa.”

English: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
Masaai: Kaae nejoki ninye lelo ooirriwua Benhadad, “Entiaaki olkitok lai olaiguanani, ‘Ore nena pooki e dukuya niyieu tialo osinka lino, kaas nanu, kake ore ena bae maidim nanu ataasa.’ ” Nerrinyo lelo ooirriwuaki neyaki ninye olkilikuai. Neirriwaki Benhadad ninye olkilikuai nejoki,

English: And Benhadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.
Masaai: “Maaitaasa nanu nkaitin ina naaitulus, tenaa kelekuni ninye enterit te Samaria naaiput nkaik ang.”

English: And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.
Masaai: Newal olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo, “Entiaaki ninye, ‘Mincho ilo orreten imasaa enyena o larrabal ewuasa anaa ilo olaku.’ ”

English: And it came to pass, when Benhadad heard this message, as he was drinking, he and the kings in the pavilions,that he said unto his servants, Set yourselves in array. And they set themselves in array against the city.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Benhadad ilo kilikuai eokisho tenebo ilaiguanak too lng'oborri, nejoki ninye ltung'ana lenyena, “Entijing irrishat inyi to larrabal.” Nejing ninche irrishat enye aarasaki ina anasa.

English: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into thine hand this day; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nelotu oloiboni le Nkai anyikaki Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli nejoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Itoduaa iyie ele orora kitok pooki? Ng'ura kaishoru ninche apik nkaik inono ena olong; naa ilo iyie ayiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, Thou.
Masaai: Neitoki Ahab ajo, “Aitialo ng'ae?” Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Tialo isinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi.” Neitoki Ahab ajo, “Kaing'ae oiteru olarrabal?” Newaliki ajo, “Iyie.”

English: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aipotu lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi, naa iip are ninche o tomoni uni oare, ore te siadi ninche neitoki aipotu iltung'ana loo Siraeli, nkalifuni naapishana.

English: And they went out at noon. But Benhadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty and two kings that helped him.
Masaai: Neipang ninche aapuo te nkipirata enkolong, ina kata eokisho Benhadad too lng'oborri, ninye o lelo aiguanak tikitam oare apa ootareto ninye.

English: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
Masaai: Ore lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni loo lkerenketi neituruk aapuo. Neirriu Benhadad iltung'ana, nepuo aajoki ninye, “Eilepu iltung'ana aapuonu te Samaria.”

English: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tenaa eiteseriani eetuo ninche, eyau ninche eishu, naa tenaa eitolarrabal epuonu iyau ninche eishu.”

English: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city, and the army which followed them.
Masaai: Kaae neipang kulo aapuo te nkanasa, lelo sinkan loo lbalusuni too lkerenketi, oina jore natusujayie ninche.

English: And they slew every one his man: and the Syrians fled; and Israel pursued them: and Benhadad the king of Syria escaped on an horse with the horsemen.
Masaai: Near ake oltung'ani oltung'ani oipirare; neilanyisho iltung'ana le Siria, nesujaa Isiraeli ninche, kake eilanyishe Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria te mbarta tenebo ilakedok loo mbartan.

English: And the king of Israel went out, and smote the horses and chariots, and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli aibung mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan, near iltung'ana le Siria oleng.

English: And the prophet came to the king of Israel, and said unto him, Go, strengthen thyself, and mark, and see what thou doest: for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee.
Masaai: Neitoki oloiboni le Nkai alotu anyikaki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nejoki ninye, “Wou, ntagoluoyu, nidamu oleng enilo aas; amu ore telde ari, naa eikilotu olaiguanani le Siria agilunore.”

English: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him, Their gods are gods of the hills; therefore they were stronger than we; but let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
Masaai: Nejoki isinkan lo laiguanani le Siria ninye, “Ore nkaitin enye naa nkaitin oo ldoinyo, neaku kegol ninche aalang iyiook. Metaa maape iyiook aarare ninche te nkop naisiaja, nemeeta nchere pee eitu kimir ninche.

English: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
Masaai: Naa nji nkuna, iwuang'ie ilaiguanak too wuejitin enye, nipik ilarikok le njore irrishat enye;

English: And number thee an army, like the army that thou hast lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot: and we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they. And he hearkened unto their voice, and did so.
