Masaai: nimpotu enjore naikununo anaa enapa natimiraki. Aipirakinye embarta enkae barta o engarri oo mbartan enkae garri oo mbartan; nikipuo iyiook aarare ninche te nkop naisiaja nemeeta nchere pee eitu iyiook kigolu aalang ninche.” Nening ninye enatejo ninche, neas ina.

English: And it came to pass at the return of the year, that Benhadad numbered the Syrians, and went up to Aphek, to fight against Israel.
Masaai: Ore teina rishata o lari neipotu Benhadad aiturrur enjore e Siria, neilep aapuo Afek, pee earare Isiraeli.

English: And the children of Israel were numbered, and were all present, and went against them: and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids; but the Syrians filled the country.
Masaai: Neipotuni Iltung'ana loo Siraeli, neishori ninche imasaa o larrabal, nepuo aarare ninche. Neun iltung'ana loo Siraeli ilng'oborri te dukuya ninche netiu anaa iluaat are kutiti oo nkineji, kake eiputa iltung'ana le Siria enkop.

English: And there came a man of God, and spake unto the king of Israel, and said, Thus saith the LORD, Because the Syrians have said, The LORD is God of the hills, but he is not God of the valleys, therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Nelotu oltung'ani le Nkai anyiku nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore amu etejo iltung'ana le Siria eji, “Ore Olaitoriani naa enkai oo ldoinyo, kake mme enkai oo erat ninye,” ore enkaraki ina, kaishoru nanu ele orora pooki apik nkaik inono, pee itum iyie atayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: And they pitched one over against the other seven days. And so it was, that in the seventh day the battle was joined: and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day.
Masaai: Neun ninche ilng'oborri aaipirakinore ninche nkolong'i naapishana. Ore te nkolong e naapishana neitutumi olarrabal. Neosh iltung'ana loo Siraeli iltung'ana le Siria, isikarini nkalifuni iip nabo oopuo too nkejek te nkolong nabo.

English: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
Masaai: Neisikaki ilkulikae enkanasa e Afek, neurokino esuntai iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam e lelo ootelekutua. Neisik sii ninye Benhadad nelo ajing olgilata liatua le nkanasa.

English: And his servants said unto him, Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray thee, put sackcloth on our loins, and ropes upon our heads, and go out to the king of Israel: peradventure he will save thy life.
Masaai: Nejoki isinkan lenyena ninye, “Ng'ura, kitoning'o iyiook nchere, ore ilaiguanak le nkaji e Israel, naa ilaiguanak oata olng'ur. Nchoo iyiook maishopo ilkuniyiani too mpolosi ang, nikipik nkeenta ilukuny ang, nikipuo enetii olaiguanani loo Siraeli; amu ebaiki nikipal iyie nchu.”

English: So they girded sackcloth on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said, Thy servant Benhadad saith, I pray thee, let me live. And he said, Is he yet alive? he is my brother.
Masaai: Kaae nerrotian ninche ilkuniyiani too mpolosi enye, nepik nkeenta ilukuny enye, nepuo enetii olaiguanani loo Siraeli, nejoki, “Etejo osinka lino Benhadad, “Aatoomono nchooki nanu aishu.’ ” Nejo ninye, “Keton ake eishu? Olalashe lai ninye.”

English: Now the men did diligently observe whether any thing would come from him, and did hastily catch it: and they said, Thy brother Benhadad. Then he said, Go ye, bring him. Then Benhadad came forth to him; and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
Masaai: Neanyita apa lelo tung'ana pee etum ororei supat, netum ninche nabo kata to laiguanani, nejo ninche, “Ee olalashe lino Benhadad.” Neitoki ninye ajo, “Enchom entoriku ninye.” Nelotu Benhadad enetii ninye, neisho ninye metijing'a engarri oo mbartan.

English: And Benhadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
Masaai: Nejoki Benhadad ninye, “Ore nkanasa natooruo papaai, papaai lino kaarrinyoki nanu; nindim iyie atasheta iwuejitin neemirishoreki te Dameski, anaa apa enataasa papaai te Samaria.” Nejo Ahab, “Kaaisho nanu iyie shomo te kulo rorei.” Kaae neitobir olning'o o ninye neisho meshomo.

English: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the LORD, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man refused to smite him.
Masaai: Nejoki oltung'ani obo loo layiok loo loibonok olikae te nkitanapata Olaitoriani, “Tooshoki nanu, aatoomono” kake etanya ilo tung'ani eosh ninye.

English: Then said he unto him, Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the LORD, behold, as soon as thou art departed from me, a lion shall slay thee. And as soon as he was departed from him, a lion found him, and slew him.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninye, “Ore amu itanya ining oltoilo lo Laitoriani, ng'ura, teneaku ishomo nikilo olng'atuny aar tua.” Ore pee elo aing'uaa nenang'are olng'atuny ninye near metua.

English: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye atum likae tung'ani, nejoki, “Tooshoki nanu, aatoomono.” Neosh ilo tung'ani ninye nepik olbae.

English: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
Masaai: Kaae nelo ilo oiboni le Nkai nelo aanyu olaiguanani te mbata enkoitoi, eteena too nkarash ilo bae otii olpura le nkomom.

English: And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.
Masaai: Ore ejo olaiguanani agiroo, neishiraki ninye olaiguanani ejo, “Eshomo osinka lino empolos olarrabal, naa ng'ura, eibelekenye osikari neyau oltung'ani enatii, naajoki nanu, ‘Ng'ura ele tung'ani; naa tenelo neluaya, neinosieki enkishui ino enkishui enye, aashu ilak entalanta e nkosholai.’

English: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.
Masaai: Ore enyamalita osinka lino tene o teidie, neluaya ninye.” Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninye, “Neija elo atiu endung'okinoto ino enkiguana; amu iyie makewan otudung'o ina.”

English: And he hasted, and took the ashes away from his face; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets.
Masaai: Nesiokisioki aitayu ina arasha natii olpura le nkomom, neyiolou olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajo obo loo loibonok le Nkai.

English: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki ninchoo elo too nkaik inono, ilo tung'ani apa laiteng'elaka enkidaaroto, ore enkaraki ina, keinosieki enkishui ino enkishui enye. Neinosieki enkishui oo ltung'ana linono enkishui oo ltung'ana lenyena.’ ”

English: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased, and came to Samaria.
Masaai: Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli enkaji enye te Samaria eiruto neeta osina.

English: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
Masaai: Neeta apa Nabot le Yesreel enkurma oo lng'anayio te Yesreel, te mbata e nkaji e nkitoo e Ahab olaiguanani le Samaria.

English: And Ahab spake unto Naboth, saying, Give me thy vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near unto my house: and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it; or, if it seem good to thee, I will give thee the worth of it in money.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ena nejoki Ahab Nabot, “Nchooki nanu enkurma ino oo lng'anayio pee aitaa olchampa loo mbenek, amu ketaaniki enkaji ai. Naa kaaisho nanu enkurma sidai oo sabibu naa tenidol eishiaakino, naaisho elaakinoto enye too mpisai.”

English: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Nabot Ahab, “Too loo papa nanu atujung'o ena kurma, oo lng'anayio. Metomito Olaitoriani tenaa kaaisho nanu iyie.”

English: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him: for he had said, I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers. And he laid him down upon his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.
Masaai: Nelo Ahab enkaji enye eeta osina netagore enkaraki ina natiaka Nabot le Yesreel ninye. Amu etejo ninye, “Maaisho nanu iyie enjung'ore oo loo papa.” Neirrag ninye te ndapash enye, neibelekeny ninye endukuya enye aing'or idia alo neany einos endaa.

English: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said unto him, Why is thy spirit so sad, that thou eatest no bread?
Masaai: Kake eewuo enkitok enye Yesebel enetii ninye nejoki, “Kainyoo pee eeta oltau lino osina eji neaku minos endaa?”

English: And he said unto her, Because I spake unto Naboth the Jezreelite, and said unto him, Give me thy vineyard for money; or else, if it please thee, I will give thee another vineyard for it: and he answered, I will not give thee my vineyard.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, ninye, “Enkaraki nairorie nanu Nabot le Yesreel, najoki nanu ninye, ‘Timirakaki nanu enkurma ino oo lng'anayio too ropiyiani, aashu tenidol eishiaakino, nawalu nanu tiae kurma oolng'anayio.’ Newalu ninye ajo, ‘Maaisho nanu enkurma ai oo lng'anayio.’ ”

English: And Jezebel his wife said unto him, Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel? arise, and eat bread, and let thine heart be merry: I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesebel ina kitok enye ninye, “Keton aa iyie oitore Israel? Tudumunye inosa endaa, nincho metishipayu oltau lino; amu kaaisho nanu iyie ina kurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot le Yesreel.”

English: So she wrote letters in Ahab's name, and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city, dwelling with Naboth.
Masaai: Neiger ninye mpala te nkarna e Ahab, nemishir ninche to lmishire lenye, neirriwaki lelo payiani o ltung'ana kituaak ooboitare Nabot teina anasa enye.

English: And she wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people:
Masaai: Neiger ninye te nena pala ajo, “Embalie enkolong naeni aapukoo, neishori Nabot enkitoo aaitulusoo too ltung'ana.

English: And set two men, sons of Belial, before him, to bear witness against him, saying, Thou didst blaspheme God and the king. And then carry him out, and stone him, that he may die.
Masaai: Nipikipiki iltung'ana oare lemeeta tipat, meetu aaitang'or ninye. Naa nchoo ninche eishankarrarre ninye ejo, ‘Itediaa iyie Enkai o laiguanani!’ Nimbung'ubung'u taa ninye aaya auluo, ninang'inang'a too soito metua.”

English: And the men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city, did as Jezebel had sent unto them, and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana leina anasa, ilpayiani, o lkituaak apa oomanya ina anasa, neas anaa enatolikio Yesebel ninche. Anaa enaigeroki te nena pala naaigeroko ninye ninche.

English: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
Masaai: Neibalunye ninche enkolong naeni aapukoo, neisho Nabot enkitoo aaitulusoo too ltung'ana.

English: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
Masaai: Ore ilooti tung'ana oare le pesho, nepuonu aaitang'or ninye, nepuonu lelo le pesho aaishankarrare Nabot te dukuya iltung'ana, ejo, “Etediaa Nabot Enkai o laiguanani.” Neya ninche ninye auluo enkanasa nenang ninye metua too soito.

English: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aairriwaki Yesebel olkilikuai ejo, “Etanang'aki Nabot too soito, etua ninye.”

English: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned, and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give thee for money: for Naboth is not alive, but dead.
Masaai: Ore ake ina kata pee ening Yesebel nchere etanang'aki Nabot ometua too soito, nejoki Yesebel Ahab, “Inyo tudumunye, inyo shomo iwa enkurma oo lng'anayio apa nikitomitikio Nabot too mpisai. Amu meekure eishu Nabot, etua ninye.”

English: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
Masaai: Ore ake ina kata pee ening Ahab ajo etua Nabot, nedumunye Ahab adoyio alo aya enkurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot le Yesreel, pee eitaa enenye.

English: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Elija le Tishibi ejo,

English: Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, which is in Samaria: behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, whither he is gone down to possess it.
Masaai: “Tudumunye shomo tanang'are Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, etii ninye Samaria. Ng'ura etii ninye atua enkurma oo lng'anayio e Nabot, neshomo ninye aya ine aitaa enenye.

English: And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Hast thou killed, and also taken possession? And thou shalt speak unto him, saying, Thus saith the LORD, In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood, even thine.
Masaai: Shomo iyie tiaaki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Itara iyie oltung'ani metua niya ntokitin enyena?” ’ Nintoki ajoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore ine wueji apa nemejie ildiain osarge le Nabot, teine epuo ildiain aamej osarge lino.” ’ ”

English: And Ahab said to Elijah, Hast thou found me, O mine enemy? And he answered, I have found thee: because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Nejoki Ahab Elija, “Ekinepua nanu lo mang'atinta lai?” Newaliki ajoki, “Ee aainepua, amu itegelaka iyie kewan pee ias mbaa torrok te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Behold, I will bring evil upon thee, and will take away thy posterity, and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel,
Masaai: Ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata iyie, kaaiwuang'ie nanu iyie aishie, naiwuang'ie nanu te Ahab pooki lee, tiatua Israel, oloena o lolakuno.

English: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger, and made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Naa kaitotiu nanu enkaji ino anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, o enkaji e Baasha olayioni le Ahija, tenkaraki ena goro nikintagoro nanu. O enkaraki sii nitorikoko Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.
Masaai: Ore tialo Yesebel neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, ‘Keinos ildiain Yesebel too lpolosien le Yesreel.’

English: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lolmarei le Ahab oye tiatua enkanasa neinos ildiain; ore pooki ng'ae oye tiong'ata neinos ilmotonyi.”

English: But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the LORD, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.
Masaai: Meetae apa oltung'ani otegelaka kewan aas mbaa torrok te dukuya o Laitoriani anaa Ahab oisisayie ninye enkitok enye Yesebel.

English: And he did very abominably in following idols, according to all things as did the Amorites, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye ntabo arubare nkitanyaanyukot. Etaasa ninye anaa apa Ilamori, laa ninche eiturrayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo siraeli.

English: And it came to pass, when Ahab heard those words, that he rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his flesh, and fasted, and lay in sackcloth, and went softly.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ahab lelo rorei, nepolos nkilani enyena, neishopoki kewan ilkuniyiani, neen ninye apukoo neirrag too lkuniyiani, nelo ninye to sina.

English: And the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Elija le Tishibi, ejo,

English: Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me? because he humbleth himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days: but in his son's days will I bring the evil upon his house.
Masaai: “Itoduaa ajo eitoborro Ahab kewan te dukuya nanu? Ore enkaraki naitoborro ninye kewan te dukuya nanu, mayau nanu entorroni too nkolong'i enyena. Too nkolong'i oo layiok lenyena nanu ayau entorroni shumata enkaji enye.”

English: And they continued three years without war between Syria and Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa too larin okuni netoni iltung'ana le Israel o le Siria te seriani.

English: And it came to pass in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore to lari liokuni nelotu Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda enetii olaiguanani le Israel.

English: And the king of Israel said unto his servants, Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, and we be still, and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli isinkan lenyena, “Iyiololo intae aajo enaang oshi Ramot-gilead, naa eikigira oshi iyiook, mikiyieu nikiya aaoru olaiguanani le Siria?”

English: And he said unto Jehoshaphat, Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth-gilead? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as thou art, my people as thy people, my horses as thy horses.
Masaai: Nejoki Ahab Yehoshafat, “Eikiriamariyie iyie nanu pee kipuo olarrabal te Ramot-gilead.” Nejoki Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Atiu ake nanu enitiu, netiu iltung'ana laainei anaa enatiu iltung'ana linono, netiu mbartan aainei anaa nkuninono.”

English: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
Masaai: Nejoki Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Tang'asa naa nkilikuanu ororei oing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

English: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall I go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrur iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, oobaya iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “kalo nanu olarrabal aarare Ramot-gilead anaa aimalo?” Nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik o laiguanani.”

English: And Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
Masaai: Kake enyaaka Yehoshafat ajo, “Aimeekure etii ene likae oiboni lo Laitoriani likinkilikuanishore?”

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani. Mikaia olayioni le Imla, kake kaiba nanu ninye amu maaibonoki aekata ninye embae sidai, ntorrok ake aaibonoki.” Nejo Yehoshafat, “Mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.”

English: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, Hasten hither Micaiah the son of Imlah.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu oltung'ani kitok nejoki, “Toriku ntasieku Mikaia olayioni le Imla.”

English: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata netonita olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani le Yuda too lorikan lenye le nkitoo, etukusote too lkilani lenye. Netoni ninche te wueji neidong'ishoreki tembata enkishomi e Samaria. Neibonisho apa iloibonok pooki te dukuya ninche.

English: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made him horns of iron: and he said, Thus saith the LORD, With these shalt thou push the Syrians, until thou have consumed them.
Masaai: Ore Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neitobiraki kewan imouarak e sekenkei, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Te kuna ipuopuo intae aarrumoo iltung'ana le Siria ometaba anaa neidak.’ ”

English: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the king's hand.
Masaai: Neibonisho iloibonok pooki aaiko neijia, nejo ninche, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead timirisho; amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik olaiguanani.”

English: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani apa oirriwayioki meshomo aipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura, ore irorei loo loibonok pooki naa eisidain tialo olaiguanani; nchoo irorei linono metotiwuo anaa irorei liobo lenye, niro mbaa sidain.”

English: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
Masaai: Kake etejo Mikaia, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ina naajoki nanu Olaitoriani ninye alo airo.”

English: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu ninye enetii olaiguanani, neikilikuan olaiguanani ninye ajoki, “Mikaia eikipuo iyiook olarrabal te Ramot-Gilead anaa aimikipuo?” Newalu ninye ajo, “Shomo timirisho, amu keishoru Olaitoriani apik nkaik olaiguanani.”

English: And the king said unto him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou tell me nothing but that which is true in the name of the LORD?
Masaai: Kake etiaka olaiguanani ninye, “Ae katitin aja nanu aaikilikuan pee iro esipata ake te nkarna Olaitoriani?”

English: And he said, I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills, as sheep that have not a shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master: let them return every man to his house in peace.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Atoduaa nanu Isiraeli pooki eidapashate too ldoinyo anaa ntare nemeeta olchekut; nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Meeta kulo olaitasheikinoni, nchoo ake errinyo pooki ng'ae enkang enye te seriani.’ ”

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me, but evil?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie meibonu ninye embae sidai, kake entorrono eibonu?”

English: And he said, Hear thou therefore the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.
Masaai: Neitoki Mikaia ajo, “Entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eton to lorika lenye le nkitoo. Ore olorora pooki le shumata neitashe te mbata enye te nkalo e tatene o te kedienye.

English: And the LORD said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one said on this manner, and another said on that manner.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kaing'ae ilo olo alej Ahab, meilepa ninye alo metaari metua te Ramot-gilead?’ Nejo ake oltung'ani embae nabo nejo olikae enkae bae.

English: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et naishu aitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, ‘Kalo nanu alej ninye.’

English: And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith? And he said, I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, ‘Kaitiaa oitoi?’ Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu aaku ololejisho too nkutukie oo loibonok pooki.’ Nejo ninye, ‘Ilo iyie alej ninye naa ilo aidimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.’

English: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil concerning thee.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata, ng'ura etipika Olaitoriani oltau le lejare kulo oibonok pooki; eimaka Olaitoriani embae torrono tialo iyie.”

English: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
Masaai: Nenyiku Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neosh Mikaia eseder, nejoki, “Kaji eiko enkiyang'et o Laitoriani tenepuku te nanu nelotu airo te iyie?”

English: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see in that day, when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura, ilo kenya adol teina olong nilo ajing'ie olgilata liaji isudori.”

English: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
Masaai: Nejo ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Embung'a Mikaia eyaki Amon olbalusui le nkanasa, o Yoash olayioni lo laiguanani;

English: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
Masaai: nipuopuo aajo, ‘Nji ejo olaiguanani, “Entipik ena tung'ani atua korokoroni nintotiti ninye too mukateni o te nkare ake ometaba anaa narrinyunye te seriani.” ’ ”

English: And Micaiah said, If thou return at all in peace, the LORD hath not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Tenirrinyunye iyie te seriani, neitu naa aairorie nanu Olaitoriani.” Neitoki ajo, “Entoning lo tung'ana pooki!”

English: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
Masaai: Kaae nelo apa olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda Ramot-gilead.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put thou on thy robes. And the king of Israel disguised himself, and went into the battle.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kalo nanu anapa pee alo olarrabal, kake nchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Nelo olaiguanani loo Siraeli anapa nelo olarrabal.

English: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Israel.
Masaai: Neitanap apa olaiguanani le Siria lelo arikok le pokira tomoni uni oare loo ngarrin oo mbartan, ejo, “Emiaar oltung'ani kitok aashu oloti, kake olkitok loo Siraeli ake entaar.”

English: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Israel. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo akedok loo ngarrin oo mbartan Yehoshafat, nejo, “Esipa olaiguanani le Israel.” Kaae neibelekenya aarare ninye, neyietu Yehoshafat aishir.

English: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo arikok loo ngarrin oo mbartan ajo mme olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neibelekenya aapuo te sujaroto enye.

English: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
Masaai: Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata e long'o enye, to lgoo. Ore enkaraki ina nejoki olaiguanani ilo arewani le ngarri enye oo mbartan, “Mbelekenyayu, iwaki matung'uai olarrabal, amu aatipikaki olbae.”

English: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
Masaai: Neirowuaju olarrabal ina olong, neigarakino olaiguanani engarri enye eing'or enkalo oo ltung'ana le Siria. Ore pee eaku teipa neye ninye, ore osarge leina ng'oroto neiput oltiren leina garri oo mbartan.

English: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
Masaai: Ore etaa kedoyio enkolong neibulu olkiyioi enkop pooki, eji, “Shomo pooki tung'ani enkanasa enye, nelo pooki tung'ani enkop enye!”

English: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
Masaai: Kaae neaku etua olaiguanani, neyauni ninye Samaria; nepuoi aanukaa ninye te Samaria.

English: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of the LORD which he spake.
Masaai: Nepuoi aaituku ina garri oo mbartan to lchorro le Samaria nemej ildiain ilo sarge lenye, ore nkituaak naaibor onyek neituku ate teilo sarge, te risioroto eilo rorei le Nkai apa oiroro ninye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Ahab, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o ina aji oo lala loo lkanchaoni apa natesheta ninye, o nena anas pooki apa naatesheta ninye, neigero tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak loo Siraeli.

English: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Kaae neirura Ahab neye anaa loo menye, neitoreisho Ahasia te rishata enye.

English: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
Masaai: Neiteru Yehoshafat olayioni le Asa aitore Yuda to lari liong'uan le enkitoria e Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli.

English: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni o imiet apa Yehoshafat pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Asuba entito e Shilhi.

English: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of the LORD: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
Masaai: Nerubare ninye orrekie le Asa Papaai lenye, eitu ninye eibelekenya apaash easata oo mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani. Ore ake eyia eitu eyai iwuejitin neeika, ore iltung'ana neitayu ilasarri nepej enkorropil te nena wuejitin neeika.

English: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
Masaai: Eitobira sii apa Yehoshafat osotua o laiguanani loo Siraeli.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, oina kidimata enye naitodolua, oina nashomo olarrabal, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai le lelo ooibor onyek apa ootelekutua too nkolong'i e papaai lenye, neishie ninche teina kop.

English: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
Masaai: Meetae apa olaiguanani te Edom; olaiguanani oti ninye apa etegeluaki

English: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Eziongeber.
Masaai: neitobir Yehoshafat imelin e Tarshish pee epuo Ofir aayau sahabu; kake eitu ninche epuo, amu eidaaitie nena melin te Esiong'eber.

English: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with thy servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
Masaai: Neitoki Ahasia Olayioni le Ahab ajoki Yehoshafat, “Nchoo isinkan laainei epuo tenebo isinkan linono too melin.” Kake eitu enyorraa Yehoshafat.

English: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Yehoshafat airura neye anaa loo menye, nenukari te nkurare oo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
Masaai: Neiteru Ahasia olayioni le Ahab aitoreisho te Isirael te Samaria to lari le tomon oopishana le nkitoria e Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oare te Israel.

English: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye embae torrono too nkonyek o Laitoriani, nerubare orrekie le papaai lenye, o rrekie le ng'otonye, o rrekie le Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, laa ninye apa oitapong'oyie Isiraeli metaasa eng'oki.

English: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger the LORD God of Israel, according to all that his father had done.
Masaai: Eisiaayia apa ninye Baal neserem ninye, neitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, te pooki oitoi apa nataasa menye.

English: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.
Masaai: Ore eidipa Ahab atua, neiser Moab apaashare Israel.

English: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
Masaai: Nesulunye apa Ahasia to lkitara le nkaji e shumata, te Samaria, neirrag ninye etamuoyia. Neaku eirriwayie ninye ilkiliku ajoki olorere, “Enchom enkilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron tenaa kaishiu nanu tena muoyian.”

English: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that ye go to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka olmalaika le Nkai Eliya le Tishibit, “Tudumunye shomo tanang'are ilkiliku lo laiguanani le Samaria, nijoki ninche, ‘Kenkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israeli pee ishomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron?’

English: Now therefore thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die. And Elijah departed.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Mipuku iyie teina dapash nitii, kake esipa iye iyie.’ ” Nelo Eliya.

English: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
Masaai: Nerrinyo lelo tung'ana lo lkilikuai aapuo enetii olaiguanani, nejoki ninye ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee itorrinyunye?”

English: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Is it not because there is not a God in Israel, that thou sendest to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron? therefore thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Eewuo oltung'ani anang'are iyiook, nejoki iyiook, ‘Entorrinyoto enchom enetii ilo aiguanani oirriwua intae, nijokiki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kenkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israel pee irriwayie ilkiliku meshomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron? Ore enkaraki ina midou iyie teina dapash nitii, kake iye iyie.’ ”

English: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaa pukunoto o ltung'ani ilo tung'ani oewuo anang'are intae, nejoki intae kuna baa?”

English: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche ninye aajoki, “Eishopito enkila oo lpapit neeta enkimeita o lchoni te mpolos enye.” Nejo ninye, “Eliya le Tishibit ilo.”

English: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, Thou man of God, the king hath said, Come down.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaki ninye olkitok le njore loo ltung'ana onom. Neilep ninye alo enetii Eliya, etonita te nchumata e ndoinyo, nejoki ninye, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, ejo olaiguanani, ‘Tadou wou.’ ”

English: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of God, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Eliya ilo arikoni le njore loo ltung'ana onom, “Tenaa kara nanu oltung'ani le Nkai, nchoo edou enkima naing'uaa shumata, nikinos iyie o lelo tung'ana linono onom.” Nedou enkima naing'uaa shumata neinos ilo tung'ani o lelo tung'ana lenyena onom.

English: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of God, thus hath the king said, Come down quickly.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaki ninye o likae kitok le njore loo ltung'ana onom, tenebo iltung'ana lenyena pokira onom. Neilep ninye alo enetii nejoki ninye, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, enkitanapata o laiguanani ena, ‘Tasioki tadou!’ ”

English: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of God, let fire come down from heaven, and consume thee and thy fifty. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Eliya ajoki ninche, “Tenaa kara nanu oltung'ani le Nkai, nchoo edou enkima naing'uaa shumata nikinos iyie o kulo tung'ana linono pokira onom.” Nedou enkima e Nkai naing'uaa shumata neinos ninye o lelo tung'ana lenyena pokira onom.

English: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of God, I pray thee, let my life, and the life of these fifty thy servants, be precious in thy sight.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olarikoni le ntukus e uni oo ltung'ana onom, tenebo iltung'ana lenyena onom. Ore ilo arikoni liokuni le njore loo ltung'ana onom, neilep alo. Nelotu agil kung te dukuya Eliya, nesai ninye ajoki, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, aatoomono iyie, nchoo enkishui ai o enkishui e kulo sinkan linono menoto tipat too nkonyek inono.

English: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.
Masaai: Ng'ura etadowuo enkima naing'uaa shumata neinos lelo arikok le njore loo ltung'ana maa onom, o lelo tung'ana lenye maa onom. Kake ore naa taata nchoo enkishui ai menoto tipat too nkonyek inono.”

English: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika le Nkai ajoki Eliya, “Tadoi shomo tenebo ninye; miureyu iyie ninye.” Nedumunye ninye nedoyio alo tenebo ninye, enetii olaiguanani.

English: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baalzebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up, but shalt surely die.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki irriwayie ilkiliku meshomo aaikilikuanishore Baalsebub, ina ai e Ekron, kenkaraki nemeetae Enkai te Israel, pee inkilikuanishore too rorei lenyena? Ore enkaraki ina midou iyie teina dapash nishomo, ajing', kake meeta nchere pee miye iyie.’ ”

English: So he died according to the word of the LORD which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; because he had no son.
Masaai: Neaku etua ninye terisioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani oiroro Eliya. Neaku Yoram olalashe lenye olaiguanani terishata enye, to lari liare le Yehoram olayioni le Yehoshafat, olaiguanani le Yuda. Amu meeta apa Ahasia olayioni.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Ahasia naataasa ninye, neigero tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And it came to pass, when the LORD would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
Masaai: Ore etaa kejo pee eya Olaitoriani Eliya ailepie shumata, to lkutati, negira Eliya o Elisha aairiamari te nkoitoi eing'uaa Gilgal.

English: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Bethel. And Elisha said unto him, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they went down to Bethel.
Masaai: Nejoki Eliya Elisha, “Totona tene aatoomono amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Betel.” Kake etejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani o anaa eninchu iyie makewan, maaing'uaaa nanu.” Nedoyio ninche aapuo Betel.

English: And the sons of the prophets that were at Bethel came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilayiok loo loibonok le Nkai nejoki Elisha, “Iyiolo iyie ajo keya taata Olaitoriani olkitok lino, nikintung'uaa iyie?” Nejo ninye, “Ee kayiolo, entirring'ata ake intae.”

English: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninye, “Elisha, totona tene, aatoomono amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Yeriko.” Kake etejo ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa eninchu iyie makewan, maaing'uaaa nanu iyie.” Nepuonu ninche Yeriko.

English: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the LORD will take away thy master from thy head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold ye your peace.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok loo loibonok le Nkai ootii Yeriko nepuonu aataaniki Elisha, nejoki ninye, “Iyiolo iyie ajo keya taata Olaitoriani olkitok lino nikintung'uaa iyie?” Newal ninye ajo, “Ee kayiolo, entirring'ata ake intae.

English: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray thee, here; for the LORD hath sent me to Jordan. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And they two went on.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliya ajoki ninye, “Totona tene, aatoomono, amu aairriwayie nanu Olaitoriani Yordan.” Kake etejo ninye, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, o anaa eninchu iyie makewan maaing'uaaa nanu iyie.” Neaku eiriamari aapuo pokira oare.

English: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana onom le lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai, neitashe tenelakuaniki ninche, neitashe ninche pokira oare tembata olkeju le Yordan.

English: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
Masaai: Neitayu Eliya olkila lenye nenunuk, neoshie enkare, neoro enkare neito ena shoto o enda shoto. Neim ninche pokira oare ine etaa enkop natoyio.

English: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for thee, before I be taken away from thee. And Elisha said, I pray thee, let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aatalang', nejoki Eliya Elisha, “Tolimu embae niyieu naaitaas eton eitu aayae aaitung'uaa iyie.” Nejo Elisha, “Aatoomono, ntujung'oki nanu enkiyanget inokat are oltau lino.”

English: And he said, Thou hast asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if thou see me when I am taken from thee, it shall be so unto thee; but if not, it shall not be so.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Inkilikuanua iyie embae nagol, kake ore ake eyia, tenikiduaaya nanu aayaitae aaitung'uaa iyie, naa ketiu neijia te iyie, kake tenimikiduaaya iyie, nemetiu neijia.”

English: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
Masaai: Ore epuoito ninche einosaa lomon, ng'ura, nerish ninche pokira oare engarri oo mbartan e nkima. Nelo Eliya to lkutati shumata.

English: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
Masaai: Nedol Elisha ina bae, neishir ajo, “Papaai lai! Papaai lai! ngarrin oo mbartan e Israel o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan!” Neitu ninye eitoki adol Eliya. Neitoki ninye aibung ilkilani lenyena, nepolos aitaa are.

English: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
Masaai: Nedumu ninye ilo kila apa oitadoikio ninye, nerrinyo ninye nelo aitashe tembata olkeju le Yordan.

English: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is the LORD God of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye adumu olapa kila le Eliya oitadoikio ninye, neoshie enkare, ejo, “Koree Olaitoriani, Enkai e Eliya?” Ore ake pee eosh enkare, neoro enkare, nelo ena shoto o enda shoto; nelang Elisha alo.

English: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai apa ootii Yeriko ninye, nejo ninche, “Etii Enkiyang'et e Eliya Shumata Elisha.” Nepuonu ninche aanang'are ninye, neirrugo aaitabaiki nkomomi enkop te dukuya ninye.

English: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with thy servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray thee, and seek thy master: lest peradventure the Spirit of the LORD hath taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, Ye shall not send.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Etii tenebo isinkan linono iltung'ana onom oogol; aatoomono nchoo ninche epuo aaing'oru olkitok lino, ebaiki neewa ninye Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani nelo anang'aki ninye likae doinyo, aashu epik atua oerata.” Nejo ninye, “Mirriwaa intae ninche.”

English: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eitirrishaki ninye o metaba anaa nedol enkurruna, nejo ninye, “Erriwai.” Neirriwaa ninche iltung'ana onom; ore too nkolong'i uni, neing'oru ninye kake eitu etum ninye.

English: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
Masaai: Nerrinyunye ninche aapuonu enetii ninye etonita te Yeriko, nejoki ninye ninche, “Keitu nanu ajoki intae emipuopuo?”

English: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.
Masaai: Nejoki apa iltung'ana le nkanasa Elisha, “Ng'ura, eisidai ena anasa, anaa enadolita olkitok lai; kake eitorrono enkare, nemeisho enkop.”

English: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Eyakaki nanu olbakuli ng'ejuk, nipikipiki emunyan atua.” Neyaki ninche ninye.

English: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus saith the LORD, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
Masaai: Nelo ninye enetii enchorro e nkare neisuaaki emunyan atua, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani aitamelono nanu ena are, ore ebaiki ena kata meitokini ae kata aatum keeya anaa olkibiroto tialo ena are.”

English: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
Masaai: Neaku eitamelonoki apa ina are ometabaiki ena olong', terisioroto eilo rorei apa oiroro Elisha.

English: And he went up from thence unto Bethel: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, thou bald head; go up, thou bald head.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye teine nelo Betel; ore eloito ninye te nkoitoi, nepuonu nkuti ayiok aakueniyie ninye, ejo, “Ilepa shomo iyie olokurro lukunya! Ilepa shomo olokurro elukunya!”

English: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of the LORD. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
Masaai: Neibelekenya ninye anang silig, ore ake pee edol ninche, nedek ninche te nkarna o Laitoriani. Neipang'u tiatua entim ilng'arurum oare le ntim nedung nena ayiok artam o are aaitaa ndung'udung'ot.

English: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Nedumunye teine nelo oldoinyo le Karmel neitoki arrinyo alo Samaria.

English: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le tomon oo kuni le nkitoria e Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, etaa Yehoram olayioni le Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli te nkop e Samaria. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oare.

English: And he wrought evil in the sight of the LORD; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, hoo neitu etiu anaa menye o ng'otonye, amu eiwuang'ie ninye eng'ape e Baal apa naitobira papaai lenye.

English: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eibung'are ninye eng'oki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, apa natorikoko Israel metaasa eng'oki. Eitu ninye eing'uaa ina ng'oki.

English: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
Masaai: Ore apa Mesha olaiguanani le Moab naa olaramatani loo nkerra. Naa ore ake to lari neisho olaiguanani le Israel ilkuoo le kerra nkalifuni iip nabo. O lpapit loo nkerra loo lmeregeshi nkalifuni iip nabo.

English: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee eye Ahab, neiser olaiguanani le Moab apaashare olaiguanani le Israel.

English: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa teina kata olaiguanani Yehoram tiatua enkop e Samaria pooki, neiturrur Isiraeli pooki.

English: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab hath rebelled against me: wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as thou art, my people as thy people, and my horses as thy horses.
Masaai: Nelo ninye airriwaki olkilikuai Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki, “Eisero olaiguanani le Moab tialo nanu; aimikiriamariye nanu olarrabal le Moab?” Nejoki ninye, “Kalo nanu; atiu nanu anaa enitiu iyie, netiu iltung'ana linono anaa iltung'ana laaainei, netiu mbartan aainei anaa mbartan inono.”

English: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Kaa oitoi iyiook kipuo aaim?” Newal Yehoram ajo, “Enkoitoi e ong'ata e Edom.”

English: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Judah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo olaiguanani le Israel tenebo olaiguanani le Yuda o laiguanani le Edom. Ore ake pee eidip ninche aashom elototo oo nkolong'i naapishana, neishunye enkare naok enjore o enaok ng'uesi apa naasujita ninche.

English: And the king of Israel said, Alas! that the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Israel ajo, “Wooi Ee! Eipotuo Olaitoriani kulo aiguanak pokira okuni pee elotu apik ninche nkaik e Moab.”

English: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD, that we may enquire of the LORD by him? And one of the king of Israel's servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
Masaai: Nejo Yehoshafat, “Aimeetae oloiboni le Nkai tene pee kitum iyiook aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani?” Neitoki obo osinka loo lelo sinkan lo laiguanani loo Siraeli awal ajo, “Etii Elisha olayioni le Shefat ene, laa ninye apa otubukoko enkare nkaik e Eliya.”

English: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the LORD is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
Masaai: Nejo Yehoshafat, “Etii ororei lo Laitoriani tenebo ninye.” Nedoyio olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat o laiguanani le Edom aapuo enetii ninye.

English: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel, What have I to do with thee? get thee to the prophets of thy father, and to the prophets of thy mother. And the king of Israel said unto him, Nay: for the LORD hath called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha olaiguanani loo Siraeli, “Kainyoo nanu aatakinore iyie? Shomo enetii iloibonok le papaai lino o loibonok le yieyioo lino.” Kake etiaaka olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninye, “A-a; Olaitoriani oipotuo kulo aiguanak pokira okuni apik nkaik e Moab.”

English: And Elisha said, As the LORD of hosts liveth, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward thee, nor see thee.
Masaai: Nejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa ninye nanu aisiaai, teneme napaji Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, anaata maashilaa iyie nemaaing'or iyie.

English: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.
Masaai: Kake ore naa taata entorikokoki olaranyani.” Ore ake pee eranyisho olaranyani, nelotu engolon o Laitoriani shumata ninye.

English: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore ele erata otoyio kaiput nanu enkare.’

English: For thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not see wind, neither shall ye see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that ye may drink, both ye, and your cattle, and your beasts.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani ‘Midolidolo intae olkutati anaa enchan, kake ore ele erata pooki naa keiputi enkare, pee itumutumu aatook, intae, o nkishu inyi, o ng'uesi inyi.’

English: And this is but a light thing in the sight of the LORD: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
Masaai: Embae nalelek ena too nkonyek o Laitoriani; naa keishoru sii Ilmoabu apik atua nkaik inyi.

English: And ye shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
Masaai: Naa ipuopuo intae aaibung pooki anasa nasheta isunta, o pooki anasa yioloti, niuroo pooki shani sidai, nimbooyoyo nkonyek oo nkariak pooki, ninyalinyala pooki kop sidai too soito.”

English: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasuju tadekenya, etaa enkata naishoori ilasarri, ng'ura, nelotu enkare naing'uaa enkalo e Edom, o metaba anaa neiput enkare enkop.

English: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ilmoabu nchere eetuo ilaiguanak aagilunore ninche, ore pooki ooidim aatanap imasaa o larrabal, eiteru to loti o metabaiki to lbotor, neipotuni nepuoi aaibok to lpolosie.

English: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumunye ninche tadekenya, nedal enkolong ina are, nedol Ilmoabu enkare te dukuya ninche enyokie anaa osarge.

English: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Osarge ele; esipa etumutakinote ilaiguanak maate, netaarate maate. Ore naa taata, Moab nalo aya iyarunot.”

English: And when they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee epuonu ninche, ilng'oborri le Israel, nedumunye Israeli nerasaki Ilmoabu, o metaba anaa neipirri aailanyisho te dukuya ninche. Nepuo ninche dukuya ear Ilmoabu too lalema epuoito.

English: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kirharaseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
Masaai: Neibung ninche nkanas, ore te pooki kop sidai, nenang'aki pooki tung'ana osoit, ometaba anaa neiput isoito. Neibooyo pooki ong'u naruko enkare, neuroo ilkeek pooki sidain, ometaba anaa niaaku isoito ake ootelekutua te Kiharet. Neng'adu ilang'orok loo soito te nkopito ine neisulie.

English: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani le Moab ajo etii olarrabal agilunore ninye, neshoroo iltung'ana oata ilalema, iip naapishana pee epuo aagiroo olaiguanani le Edom, kake eitu ninche eidim aashom.

English: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ayau olkikau lenye laa ninye ojing te rishata enye te nkitoria, neitayu ninye aitaa olasar opejori te nchumata e suntai. Nejing engoro napi Israel, nepuo ninche aaing'uaa ninye nerrinyo aapuo enkop enye.

English: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Thy servant my husband is dead; and thou knowest that thy servant did fear the LORD: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
Masaai: Ore enkitok e obo le lelo ayiok loo loibonok le Nkai, neishiraki Elisha ejo, “Etua osinka lino olmoruo lai; niyiolo iyie ajo keure apa osinka lino Olaitoriani. Kake eewuo ilo apa likiaata esile enye aya nkera aainei pokira are aitaa irrindiki lenyena.”

English: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Kaa iyieu naitaas nanu? Tolikioki nanu entoki niaata tiatua aji?” Nejoki ninye, “Meeta esinka ino toki tiaji meteleku esiang'au e ilata.”

English: Then he said, Go, borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Shomo enetii olelatia ino toomonu imasaa e aji to lelatia ino pooki, imasaa nemetii toki naa kumok.

English: And when thou art come in, thou shalt shut the door upon thee and upon thy sons, and shalt pour out into all those vessels, and thou shalt set aside that which is full.
Masaai: Nintoki alo atua aji ninkenoo kewan tiaji o layiok linono, nipik eilata nena masaa pooki, naa teneiput nabo, ninteng'el.”

English: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye aing'uaa Elisha, nelo aikenoo kewan o layiok lenyena. Ore ebukoki ninye eilata, neyau ilayiok lenyena nena kulie masaa aaitinyikaki ninye.

English: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiputayu nena masaa, nejoki ninye olayioni lenye, “Nyaaki iyakaki enkae.” Nejoki olayioni lenye ninye, “Meekure etii ae.” Neishunye erukunoto eina ilata.

English: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
Masaai: Neipang'u ninye nelotu aliki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, nejoki ninye, “Shomo timira ina ilata nilo alak isilen inono, ore iyie o layiok linono ninosinoso enkae ilata.”

English: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong nelo Elisha Shunem, netii ine enkitok karsis natiaaka ninye pee einos endaa. Naa ore apa enkata pooki naim ine nelo ainos endaa te nkaji enye.

English: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of God, which passeth by us continually.
Masaai: Nejoki ina kitok olpayian lenye, “Ng'ura ore taata, kamusu nanu ajo, oltung'ani osinya le Nkai ele, oimita ena oitoi ang anaake.

English: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
Masaai: Maitobira iyiook enkiti aji naitushura netii isunta, nikipikaki ninye endapash, o emesa, o lorika, o ltaa, paa ore enkata ake pooki nalotu ninye enikitii, neidim ashomo ine.”

English: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong nelotu ninye ine, nelo ninye ilo gilata neyeng'iyeng'a teine.

English: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Gehasi osinka lenye, “Mpotu ena kitok e shunam.” Ore ake pee eipotu ninye, neitashe ina kitok te dukuya ninye.

English: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, thou hast been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for thee? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among mine own people.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo sinka ninye, “Irorie iyie ninye, ng'ura ajo itanyamala iyie oleng te nkaraki iyiook, kaa iyieu nikintaasi iyie? Iyieu neirorieki terishata ino olaiguanani tenaa olkitok le njore?” Newalu ina kitok ajo, “Atua olorere lang nanu atii.”

English: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she hath no child, and her husband is old.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki, “Kaa naa eitaasi ninye?” Newal Gehasi ajo, “Meeta ninye olayioni, netamorua olpayian lenye.”

English: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Mpotu ninye.” Ore ake pee eipotu ninye, nelotu ninye aitashe te kutukaji.

English: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, thou shalt embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, thou man of God, do not lie unto thine handmaid.
Masaai: Nejo Elisha, “Ore tena rishata tenemanu olari naa eitum iyie enkayioni.” Nejo ina kitok, “A-a olkitok lai, lo tung'ani le Nkai, milej iyie esinka ino.”

English: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
Masaai: Kake eiroshiwuo apa ina kitok, neiu enkayioni te rishata naaijo ina, te rishata o loirujuruj anaa apa enatiaaka Elisha ninye.

English: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
Masaai: Ore etubulua ina kerai nelo nabo olong enetii papaai lenye tiatua ilaisampuak.

English: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye papaai lenye, “Oi endukuya ai, endukuya ai!” Nejoki papaai lenye osinka lenye, “Ewaita ninye enetii ng'otonye.”

English: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumu ilo sinka ninye, neyau enetii ng'otonye, neton ina kerai too nkejek e ng'otonye o meiulo enkolong', neye.

English: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
Masaai: Nedumu ninye nelo airragie te ndapash o ltung'ani le Nkai, neiken kutukaji, neipang alo.

English: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.
Masaai: Neitoki aipot olpayian lenye, nejoki, “Irriwakaki obo loo laisiaayiak o esikiria nabo, pee atum nanu atasiooi ashomo enetii oltung'ani le Nkai, naitoki arrinyunye.”

English: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee iyieu nilo enetii ninye taata? Mme olapa ng'ejuk neme sabato.” Nejo ina kitok, “Kesidanu mbaa.”

English: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
Masaai: Neirot ninye esikiria, nejoki osinka lenye, “Isiosionie osikiria, nimilo akiti ometaba anaa naajoki.”

English: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
Masaai: Neaku etudumunye ninye nelotu ine netii oltung'ani le Nkai, to ldoinyo le Karmel. Ore ake pee edol oltung'ani le Nkai ina kitok elotu, nejoki ninye Gehasi osinka lenye, ng'ura elotu enkitok e Shunam te idie.

English: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with thee? is it well with thy husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
Masaai: Kueta nabo kata shomo tanang'are ninye, nijoki ninye, Aisidan mbaa tialo iyie? Aisidan mbaa tialo eno lpayian lino? Aisidan mbaa tialo enkerai ino? Newal ninye ajo, “Aisidain.”

English: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid it from me, and hath not told me.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu ina kitok oldoinyo ine netii oltung'ani le Nkai, neibung ninye nkejek enyena, nelotu Gehasi aiwuang'ie ninye. Kake etejo ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Tapala ninye, amu etii ninye atua osina ogol; neisudoyie Olaitoriani tialo nanu. Neitu aaliki nanu.”

English: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
Masaai: Neitoki ina kitok ajo, “Kaatoomono nanu olkitok lai olayioni? Keitu nanu ajo, mikilej nanu?”

English: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai Gehasi, “Terretena empolos ino, ninap eng'udi ai te nkaina ino, nilo. Teninang'are oltung'ani nimiroroki ninye, naa tenikiroroki ninye niming'amaa, nilo aiteleiki ena ng'udi enkomom eina kerai.”

English: And the mother of the child said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.
Masaai: Neitoki ng'otonye ina kerai ajo, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani o anaa eninchu iyie makewan maaing'uaaa nanu.” Neaku etudumunye ninye nesuj ninye.

English: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
Masaai: Neituruk Gehasi alo neiteleiki ina ng'udi enkomom eina kerai kake eitu etumi enkikashata anaa enkitoduaata e nkishui. Neaku etorrinye alo anang'are ninye, nejoki ninche, “Eitu einyototo ina kerai.”

English: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ejing'u Elisha atua ina aji, nedol ina kerai eirrag etua te ndapash enye.

English: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nelo ninye atua aji neiken kutukaji neaku ninche ake pokira are tiatua ina aji. Neomon Olaitoriani.

English: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
Masaai: Neilepaki ninye endapash neirrag te nchumata eina kerai, nepik enkutuk enye enkutuk eina kerai, nepik nkonyek enyena nkonyek eina kerai, neiteleiki nkaik enyena nkaik eina kerai, neitoriori ninye te nchumata ina kerai, neirowuaju osesen leina kerai.

English: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
Masaai: Neitoki ainyototo nelo nabo kata amanimanaa tiatua aji, neitoki ailepaki endapash eina kerai, nesing ina kerai katitin naapishana, nebol nkonyek enyena.

English: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
Masaai: Neitanap ninye Gehasi ajoki, “Mpotu ena kitok e Shunam.” Neipotu Gehasi ninye. Ore ake pee elotu ina kitok enetii Elisha, nejoki ninye, “Tudumu enkayioni ino.”

English: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye nebatata too nkejek enyena, neirrugo abaiki enkop; neitoki adumu enkayioni enye neipang alo boo.

English: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
Masaai: Neitoki Elisha alotu Gilgal naa aisapuk olameyu teina kop. Ore etonita nkera oo loibonok le Nkai te dukuya ninye, nejoki ninye, osinka lenye, “Ntobira emoti sapuk pee iyier endaa te nkaraki ninche.”

English: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
Masaai: Nelo obo lenye ong'ata asotu ilkeek le ntim, netum olchani loo lng'anayio liong'ota, ore teilo shani neitayu ilng'anayio, nelotu adung'udung'oki emoti endaa, nemeyiolo ninye ajo kainyoo lelo.

English: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
Masaai: Nebukoki ninche lelo tung'ana meinosa. Kake ore einosita ninche ina daa, neishir aajo, “Lo tung'ani le Nkai, enkeeya natii atua ena moti!” Nelaikino ninche aainosa.

English: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Eyau naa endaa.” Nenang'aki atua ina moti, nejo, “Entooriki iltung'ana, pee etum aainosa.” Neitu eitoki atii entoki torrono atua ina moti.

English: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
Masaai: Nelotu oltung'ani oing'uaa Baal-shalisha, neyaki oltung'ani le Nkai imukateni tikitam e shairi, o lng'osil ng'erng'er le ntapa ootii olbene lenye. Nejo Elisha, “Nchoo kuna iltung'ana pee etum aainosa.”

English: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
Masaai: Kake etejo osinka lenye, “Kaji nanu aiko te naisho kuna iltung'ana iip nabo?” Neigil Elisha ajo, “Nchoo ninche iltung'ana, pee etum aainosa, amu neijia ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Keinos ninche neleku.’ ”

English: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku eirragie ninye ina daa te dukuya ninche, neinos ninche, neleku, te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
Masaai: Ore apa Naaman olkitok le njore o laiguanani le Siria, naa oltung'ani kitok to lkitok lenye netum omom oleng', amu te nkaraki ninye apa eishoo Olaitoriani Siria enkisulata. Oltung'ani apa magilani yioloti, kake eeta enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana le Siria te njore enye nabo, neraya enkiti sila aisiaayiani te nkop oo Siraeli, naa enkitok e Naaman apa eisiaai.

English: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
Masaai: Nejoki ina sila ina kitok e Naaman, “Tenaa napaji ketumore olkitok lai oloiboni le Nkai otii Samaria anaata eishiunye ninye teina keeya enye oo lbolot.”

English: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel.
Masaai: Nelo Naaman atua aji nelo ajoki olkitok lenye, “Nji eiroro ajo ena aisiaayiani naing'uaa enkop oo Siraeli.”

English: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
Masaai: Nejo, olaiguanani le Siria, “Shomo taata, amu kairriwaki nanu empalai olaiguanani loo Siraeli.” Neaku eshomo ninye, neshoroo talanta tomon, o shekeli nkalifuni ile e sahabu, o ntukusi tomon oo nkilani.

English: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
Masaai: Neyaki ina palai olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neigero ajo, “Tenebau ena palai enitii, tayiolo nchere aairriwaka Naaman osinka lai, pee itum aishiunye ninye teina keeya enye oo lbolot.”

English: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eisum olaiguanani loo Siraeli ina palai, nepolos nkilani enyena nejo, “Kara nanu Enkai, naar metua neitoki aitopiu, eji metaa kaairriwaki ele tung'ani olkilikuai pee aishiunye oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot? Tadamu pee idol ajo olarrabal eing'oru te nanu.”

English: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Elisha, ilo tung'ani le Nkai ajo etopolosa olaiguanani loo Siraeli nkilani, neirriwaki olaiguanani olkilikuai, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee itopolosa nkilani inono? Nchoo ninye elotu enatii pee eyiolou ajo etii oloiboni le Nkai Israel.”

English: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo Naaman too mbartan enyena, o ngarrin oo mbartan, neitashe te kutuk aji e Nkaji e Elisha.

English: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Elisha ninye olkilikuai ejoki, “Shomo intukuoyu to lkeju le Yordan katitin naapishana, pee esidanu osesen lino nilaari aishiu.”

English: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
Masaai: Kake etagore apa Naaman oleng, nelo ejoito, “Ng'ura, kajo duoo nanu kelotu enatii, neitashe, neipot enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai enye, neyuk enkaina enye te shumata ene wueji naaya, neishiu enkeeya oo lbolot.

English: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
Masaai: Amaa Abana o Fabar, lelo kejek le Dameski, aimesidan ninche aalang nkariak pooki e Israel? Aimaidim nanu aitukuore nena naishiu?” Neaku eibelekenye ninye alo te ngoro.

English: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing, wouldest thou not have done it? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
Masaai: Kake eetuo isinkan lenyena aataaniki nejoki ninye, “Papa lai, amaa tenaa eikintanapa oloiboni le Nkai entoki sapuk, aime anaata itaasa? Kebaa naa elusoo tenetejo ninye, ‘Ntukuoyu pee isidanu?’ ”

English: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
Masaai: Nedoyio ninye nelo adoiki olkeju le Yordan katitin naapishana, te risioroto o rorei lo ltung'ani le Nkai, neishiu osesen lenye netiu anaa osesen le nkerai kiti nesidanu.

English: And he returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no God in earth, but in Israel: now therefore, I pray thee, take a blessing of thy servant.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye arrinyunye alotu enetii oltung'ani le Nkai nejoki, ninye o encholuek enye pooki, nelotu aitashe te dukuya ninye, nejo ninye, “Ng'ura ayiolo nanu ajo meetae Enkai te nkop pooki meteleku te Israeli. Tang'amai naa taata enkishoroto naing'uaa osinka lino.”

English: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
