Masaai: Kake etejo Elisha, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye nanu aisiaai, mang'amu nanu hoo toki.” Nesai ninye metang'amu kake etanya.

English: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given to thy servant two mules' burden of earth? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Naaman ajo, “Teniming'amaa, aatoomono naa, nchoo naa meishori osinka lino inyumpui are naanap ilolan, amu ore ebaiki ena olong', meigil osinka lino aitayu olasar opejori, anaa olasar liae ai meteleku ake Olaitoriani.

English: In this thing the LORD pardon thy servant, that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, the LORD pardon thy servant in this thing.
Masaai: Ore tena bae metapalaki Olaitoriani osinka lino: Tenelo olkitok lai atua enkaji e Rimion aserem teine, naigarakino nanu enkaina ai, nairrugo nanu tiatua enkaji e Rimon, metapalaki Olaitoriani osinka lenye tena bae.” Nejoki Elisha Naaman, “Shomo te seriani.”

English: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
Masaai: Kake ore eidipa Naaman ashomo atung'uai Elisha te nkiti rishata,

English: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Behold, my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as the LORD liveth, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
Masaai: ore Gehasi ilo sinka le Elisha, nejo, “Dol ajo etapala olkitok lai ele tung'ani oji Naaman le Siria, neitu eng'amaa te nkaina enye nena tokitin naayawua ninye. Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, kasujaa nanu ninye pee atum toki te ninye.”

English: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
Masaai: Neaku etusujayie Gehasi Naaman. Ore ake pee edol Naaman oltung'ani okuetu osujaa ninye, nedou ninye te ngarri oo mbartan nenang'are ninye. Nejo, “Keseriani ake?” Nejo ninye “Eseriani ake.”

English: And he said, All is well. My master hath sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray thee, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
Masaai: Nejo Gehasi, “Aairriwua nanu olkitok lai pee ajoki, ‘Eetuo tena kata enatii nanu ilbarnot ooing'uaa enkop oo ldoinyo e Efraim, ilbarnot oare loo layiok loo loibonok le Nkai, aatoomono nchoo ninche entalanta e nkosholai, o ntukusi are oo nkilani.’ ”

English: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
Masaai: Nejo Naaman, “Tang'amu ntalantani are te nchipai.” Nesai ninye, neineneng nena talantani are e nkosholai too lbenia oare, tenebo ntukusi are oo nkilani, neiteleiki ninche isinkan lenyena oare. Neya ninche aanap te dukuya Gehasi.

English: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu endoinyo, neya nena tokitin too nkaik enye, nepik ninche atua enkaji enye, neisho lelo tung'ana meshomo, nedumunye ninche aapuo.

English: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence comest thou, Gehazi? And he said, Thy servant went no whither.
Masaai: Nejing ninye atua aji nelo aitashe te dukuya olkitok lenye, nejoki Elisha ninye, “Kaji duoo ishomo Gehasi?” Nejo ninye, “Meeta eneshomo osinka lino.”

English: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka ninye, “Keitu nanu alo tenebo iyie te nkiyang'et ina kata pee eibelekenya oltung'ani le ngarri enye embarta pee kinang'are? Kenkata ina nang'amarieki mpisai o nkilani o eilata oo loirienito o sabibu, o nkerra, o lmong'i, o sinkan o nkaisiaayiak?

English: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto thee, and unto thy seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
Masaai: Ore naa enkeeya oo lbolot e Naaman naa eikimbung iyie, o eishoi ino ntarasi.” Nelo Gehasi teine netii ninye etaa ole nkeeya oo lbolot. Neibor anaa soito le nchan.

English: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with thee is too strait for us.
Masaai: Etiaakita apa nkera oo loibonok le Nkai Elisha, “Ng'ura ajo eikiti ene wueji nikitii tiabori eutaroto ino.

English: Let us go, we pray thee, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go ye.
Masaai: Nchoo iyiook maape Yordan neyau ake pooki ng'ae te iyiook embokishi, pee kintobir ewueji nikibikie teine.” Newaliki ajo, “Enchom.”

English: And one said, Be content, I pray thee, and go with thy servants. And he answered, I will go.
Masaai: Neitoki obo lenye ajoki, “Tonyorrai shomo tenebo isinkan linono.” Newalu ninye ajo, “Kalo nanu.”

English: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ninye tenebo ninche. Ore ake pee epuonu ninche Yordan nedung ilkeek.

English: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
Masaai: Kake ore egira obo lenye auroo olchani nedoiki entolu enye atua enkare, neishir ninye ajo, “Oi olkitok lai! Katoomonuo apa ena tolu.”

English: And the man of God said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ajo, “Eitiaji etadoiyie.” Ore ake pee eitodol ninye ine wueji, nedung'u ninye enchata e ntolu nenang'aki ine, nepor ina dukuya e ntolu enkare.

English: Therefore said he, Take it up to thee. And he put out his hand, and took it.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Intayu.” Neitorioo ninye enkaina enye neitayu.

English: Then the king of Syria warred against Israel, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
Masaai: Ore apa earare olaiguanani le Siria Isiraeli, neiguana ninye o sinkan lenyena ejo, “Ore te wueji neje o eneje naun nanu ilng'oborri laainei.”

English: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel, saying, Beware that thou pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
Masaai: Kake eirriwaka oltung'ani le Nkai olkilikuai olaiguanani loo Siraeli ejo, “Toduaa ake migiroo ene wueji, amu etadoitie iltung'ana le Siria aapuo ine.”

English: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli oltung'ani meshomo ine netiaaka ninye oltung'ani le Nkai. Neaku ninye oikok ninye, neitajeuo ninye kewan katitin naagiroo nabo anaa are.

English: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will ye not shew me which of us is for the king of Israel?
Masaai: Nenyamalu oltau lo laiguanani le Siria te nkaraki ena bae; neipotu isinkan lenyena nejoki ninche, “Aimikintodolidolo nanu nchere kalo tiatua iyiook otii enkalo o laiguanani loo Siraeli?”

English: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
Masaai: Nejoki obo loo sinkan lenyena, “Meetae, lo kitok lai, olaiguanani kake Elisha ilo oiboni le Nkai otii atua Israel, ninye ojoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli lelo rorei liro iyie tiatua olgilata lino le rruat.”

English: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Enchom entodol enetii ninye, pee airriwaa nanu iltung'ana meshomo aayau ninye.” Nejokini ninye, “Ng'ura etii ninye Dotan.”

English: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye mbartan meshomo ine, o ngarrin oo mbartan o enjore kitok nepuonu ninche kewarie, neman enkanasa aang'adu.

English: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
Masaai: Ore ake pee einyototo osinka loltung'ani le Nkai tadekenya, neipang alo boo, ng'ura etamana duoo enjore oo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan enkanasa. Nejo ilo sinka, “Oi lokitok lai! Kaa iyiook kiaas?”

English: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Miureisho, amu ore lelo ootii tenebo iyiook naa eikumok aalang lelo ootii tenebo ninche.”

English: And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
Masaai: Neitoki Elisha aomon nejo, “Olaitoriani, aatoomono iyie tabolo nkonyek enyena pee etum atoduaa.” Nebol Olaitoriani nkonyek eilo barnoti, nedol ninye, naa ng'ura, ebore ilo doinyo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan e nkima naamanita Elisha.

English: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto the LORD, and said, Smite this people, I pray thee, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu iltung'ana le Siria aagilunore ninye, neomon Elisha Olaitoriani, nejo, “Toosho kulo tung'ana aatoomono, ntamodoo.” Neaku etoosho aitamodok ninche te risioroto e nkomono e Elisha.

English: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek. But he led them to Samaria.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha ninche, “Mme enkoitoi ena, neme enkanasa ena; entusujaki nanu, pee arikoki nanu intae ilo tung'ani ling'oruru.” Nerik ninye ninche Samaria.

English: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, LORD, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And the LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
Masaai: Ore ake enabaunye ninche Samaria, nejo Elisha, “Olaitoriani, tabolo nkonyek e kulo tung'ana, pee etum aatodolisho.” Nebol Olaitoriani nkonyek enye, nedolishoyu ninche, ng'ura etii ninche empolos e Samaria.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol olaiguanani loo Siraeli ninche, nejoki Elisha, “Papaai lai, aar ninche metuata?”

English: And he answered, Thou shalt not smite them: wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
Masaai: Aar ninche metuata, “Newal ninche ajo miaar iyie ninche metuata lelo litaarua to lalem lino o too mbaa inono? Nchoo ninche endaa o enkare, pee etum ainosa neok, nepuo enetii olkitok lenye.”

English: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Israel.
Masaai: Neitobiraki ninye ninche osirua sapuk; ore ake pee eidip aainosa endaa neokisho, neisho ninche meshomo, nepuo ninche enetii olkitok lenye. Neitu aekata eitoki iltung'ana le Siria aapuonu aarasaki enkop e Israel.

English: And it came to pass after this, that Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nena neipotu Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria enjore enye pooki, neilep alo aman ang'adu Samaria.

English: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass's head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove's dung for five pieces of silver.
Masaai: Netii apa olameyu kitok Samaria, ina kata pee eman ninche ninye. Etaa apa ore endukuya o sikiria naa shekeli ntomoni isiet e nkosholai emirieki, ore enkiti pirbil oo nkik e nturkuluo naa shekeli imiet e nkosholai.

English: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
Masaai: Ore apa eloito olaiguanani loo Siraeli te nchumata e suntai, neishiraki ninye enkitok, ejoki, “Taretuoki, olkitok lai olaiguanani!”

English: And he said, If the LORD do not help thee, whence shall I help thee? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Amaa teneitu kiret Olaitoriani kaji nanu aiko tenaaret? Te wueji neidong'ishoreki arashu te wueji neironyieki isabibu?”

English: And the king said unto her, What aileth thee? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give thy son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Kainyoo enyamali ino?” Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Aatiaaka nanu ena kitok, ‘Iyau enkerai ino pee kinos ninye taata, ore taisere nikinos enkerai ai.’

English: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give thy son, that we may eat him: and she hath hid her son.
Masaai: Nikiyier iyiook enkerai ai nikinos. Ore pee ekenyu najoki nanu ninye, ‘Iyau enkerai ino, pee kitum aainosa’; neisudoo ninye enkerai enye.”

English: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani irorei leina kitok, nepolos nkilani enyena ore ina kata negira ninye alo te nchumata e suntai nedol iltung'ana naa ng'ura, eishopito ninye ilkuniyiani tiatua nkilani enyena.

English: Then he said, God do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Maaitaasa nanu Olaitoriani ena neitulusoo, teneitu edung'ori endukuya e Elisha olayioni le Shefat ena olong.”

English: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head? look, when the messenger cometh, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master's feet behind him?
Masaai: Netonita apa Elisha te nkaji enye, netonita ilpayiani tenebo ninye. Neirriwayie apa olaiguanani oltung'ani, kake ore eton eitu ebaiki ilo kilikuai Elisha, nejoki Elisha lelo payiani, “Idolidolo aajo eirriwua ele oitayu iloikop oltung'ani laalotu adung'oo endukuya? Eng'orisho ore ake pee elotu ilo kilikuai ninkenikene kutukaji, nimbung'ubung'u enkikenet e kutukaji aaibooyo ninye. Aimening'o oltoilo loo nkejuk olkitok lenye te siadi ninye?”

English: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the LORD; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?
Masaai: Ore eton eirorita ninye o lelo payiani, nedou olaiguanani alotu enetii ninye, nejoki, “Ore ena nyamali naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa! Kainyoo nanu pee aitoki aanyu Olaitoriani?”

English: Then Elisha said, Hear ye the word of the LORD; Thus saith the LORD, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ore taisere tena rishata, nemiri entemet empirbil entapa napuyiapui te shekeli nabo, ore mpirbili are e shairi te shekeli nabo, te kishomi e Samaria.

English: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, Behold, if the LORD would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilo kitok le njore laa ninye apa eigarakino o laiguanani, nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Amaa napaji tenaa kebol Olaitoriani ilusien e keper, keitabari ena bae?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, “Ilo iyie adol too nkonyek inono, kake minos iyie.”

English: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
Masaai: Netii apa iltung'ana oong'uan oata enkeeya oo lbolot ootii embata e kishomi; nejokino ninche maate, “Kainyoo iyiook pee kitoni tene o matuata?

English: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
Masaai: Tenikijo iyiook matijing atua enkanasa; netii olameyu atua enkanasa, naa eikipuo aaye teine. Naa tenekitoni tene nikiye ake sii. Maape naa taata ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria. Tenetapala ninche iyiook, nikinchu, naa tenetaara iyiook matuata, nikiye naa.”

English: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche, pee emirimiru enteipa aapuo ilng'oborri le Siria, kake ore ake pee ebau emanaroto oo lng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria, ng'ura, metii hoo toki ine.

English: For the Lord had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Israel hath hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
Masaai: Amu eishoo apa Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Siria metoning'o oltoilo loo ngarrin oo mbartan, o loo mbartan, o ltoilo le njore kitok, neaku etiaakinote maate, “Ng'ura, eipotuo olaiguanani loo Siraeli, aiger o laiguanani le Hiti, o laiguanani le Misiri meetu aarare iyiook.”

English: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
Masaai: Neisik ninche ina teipa aailanyisho, neing'uaa ilng'oborri lenye, o mbartan enye, o sirkon lenye, neing'uaa ilng'oborri etiu anaa duoo ake. Neilanyisho aaitajeu enkishui enye.

English: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu kulo tung'ana le nkeeya oo lbolot emanaroto oo lng'oborri, nejing ninche atua olng'obor, nedaa neokisho, neya ninche enkosholai o sahabu o nkilani nepuo aaisudoo. Neitoki aapuonu nejing likae ng'obor, neya ntokitin tiatua ilo ng'obor, nepuo aaisudoo.

English: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king's household.
Masaai: Neitoki aajokino maate, “Mme embae sidai iyiook kiaasita. Ore ena olong naa enkolong oo lomon supati. Tenikigira iyiook o mekenyu, naa kebaiki iyiook enkitamioto. Ore naa taata, wootu maape aajoki enkaji o laiguanani.”

English: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche aaipot ilarripok loo nchomito e nkanasa, neliki ninche aajoki, “Kishomo iyiook ilng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria, ng'ura medoli nemening'i hoo oltung'ani obo teine, meteleku ake mbartan naaena o sirkon ooena, netiu lelo ng'oborri anaa apake.”

English: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.
Masaai: Neipotisho lelo arripok le kishomi, nelimuni ina bae tiatua enkaji o laiguanani.

English: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
Masaai: Nedumunye olaiguanani kewarie, nejoki isinkan lenyena, “Kaliki nanu intae ina naitobira iltung'ana le Siria tialo iyiook. Eyiolo ninche aajo eikisumash; neaku eipang'a ninche too lng'oborri aapuo aaisudori te nkop naisiaja, ejo, ‘Teneipangu ninche te nkanasa, nikiya iyiook ninche, eishu meshomo eyararoto nikijing atua enkanasa.’ ”

English: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.
Masaai: Nejo obo loo sinkan lenyena, “Nchoo ilkuti tung'ana eya nena bartan imiet apa naatelekutua, amu idolitata aajo, ore kulo ootelekutua netiu ake anaa ilo orora pooki le Israel oidaa. Mairriwuai ninche meshomo aadol.”

English: They took therefore two chariot horses; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians, saying, Go and see.
Masaai: Neyau ninche iltung'ana oare oo kedito mbartan, neirriwaa olaiguanani ninche meshomo aasujaa enjore e Siria, nejoki, “Enchom entodol.”

English: And they went after them unto Jordan: and, lo, all the way was full of garments and vessels, which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. And the messengers returned, and told the king.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aasujaa ninche ometabaiki olkeju le Yordan; naa ng'ura, ore te nkoitoi pooki, naa mpurdat oo nkilani o ntokitin naaiturraitie iltung'ana le Siria te nkisarrisar. Nerrinyunye lelo tung'ana ooirriwayioki, neliki olaiguanani.

English: And the people went out, and spoiled the tents of the Syrians. So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Neipang iltung'ana nepuo aar lelo ng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Siria. Neaku ore empirbil entapa napuyiapui nemiri te shekeli nabo, ore mpirbili are e shairi nemiri te shekeli nabo te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani.

English: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate: and the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died, as the man of God had said, who spake when the king came down to him.
Masaai: Netegelua apa olaiguanani olkitok le njore laa ninye eisilig, metaa olarriponi le kishomi. Neitunyoo iltung'ana ninye te kishomi o metua, anaa enatejo oltung'ani le Nkai, ina kata pee elotu olaiguanani aduaare ninye.

English: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, Two measures of barley for a shekel, and a measure of fine flour for a shekel, shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria:
Masaai: Amu ore ina kata pee ejoki oltung'ani le Nkai olaiguanani, “Kemirieki mpirbili are e shairi te shekeli nabo, neinosieki empirbil e ntapa napuyiapui shekeli nabo, taisere, tena rishata, te kishomi e Samaria.”

English: And that lord answered the man of God, and said, Now, behold, if the LORD should make windows in heaven, might such a thing be? And he said, Behold, thou shalt see it with thine eyes, but shalt not eat thereof.
Masaai: Etawalikia apa ilo kitok le njore oltung'ani le Nkai ajoki, “Amaa napaji tenaa kebol Olaitoriani ilusien te keper, keitabari ena bae?” Nejoki ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, “Ilo iyie adol too nkonyek inono, kake miinos iyie ina daa.”

English: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
Masaai: Neaku neijia ake etotiwuo te ninye, amu eitunyoitie iltung'ana ninye te kishomi neye.

English: Then spake Elisha unto the woman, whose son he had restored to life, saying, Arise, and go thou and thine household, and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn: for the LORD hath called for a famine; and it shall also come upon the land seven years.
Masaai: Etiaka apa Elisha ina kitok naitopiwuoki enkerai enye, “Inyo tenebo olmarei lino, shomo tamanya ewueji neba anaa enitamanya, amu eipotuo Olaitoriani olameyu, naa kelotu ajing ena kop too larin oopishana.”

English: And the woman arose, and did after the saying of the man of God: and she went with her household, and sojourned in the land of the Philistines seven years.
Masaai: Nedumunye ina kitok alo te risioroto o rorei leilo tung'ani le Nkai. Nedumunye ninye o lmarei lenye nelo amany enkop oo Lfilisti ilarin oo pishana.

English: And it came to pass at the seven years' end, that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines: and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land.
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin oopishana, eidipa ina kitok atushukunye te nkop oo Lfilisti, nelo asai olaiguanani te nkaraki enkaji enye.

English: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, Tell me, I pray thee, all the great things that Elisha hath done.
Masaai: Negira apa olaiguanani airorie Gehasi osinka lo ltung'ani le Nkai, ajoki, “Tolikioki nanu kuna mbaa pooki sapuki naataasa Elisha.”

English: And it came to pass, as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life, that, behold, the woman, whose son he had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. And Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
Masaai: Ore egira ninye aliki olaiguanani eneikuna Elisha pee eitopiu oltung'ani otua, ng'ura, ore ina kitok apa naitopiwuoki enkerai enye, nesai olaiguanani te nkaraki enkaji enye o enkurma enye. Nejo Gehasi, “Olkitok lai, lo aiguanani, nena ina kitok naa nena ina kerai enye apa naitopiwuoki.”

English: And when the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed unto her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eikilikuan olaiguanani ina kitok, neliki ninye. Negelu olaiguanani oltung'ani kitok tenkaraki ina kitok, ejo, “Torrinyoki ninye entoki pooki nara enenye, tenebo endaa pooki naing'uaa enkurma enye, ebaiki enkolong apa nashomo tena kop o metabaiki taata.”

English: And Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick; and it was told him, saying, The man of God is come hither.
Masaai: Eshomo apa Elisha Dameski. Naa kemuoi Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria; ore pee elikini ninye, aajoki, “Etii oltung'ani le Nkai ene,”

English: And the king said unto Hazael, Take a present in thine hand, and go, meet the man of God, and enquire of the LORD by him, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
Masaai: nejoki olaiguanani Hasael, “Toshoroi enkishoroto shomo notore oltung'ani le Nkai, ninkilikuanishore Olaitoriani tialo ninye ajoki, ‘Kaishiu nanu tena muoyian?’ ”

English: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Thy son Benhadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee, saying, Shall I recover of this disease?
Masaai: Nelo Hasael anagare ninye, neshoroo enkishooroto, mpukunot pooki oo ntokitin sidain e Dameski, ilolan loo ntamesin onom, ore pee aitashe te dukuya ninye, nejoki, “Aairiwua nanu olayioni lino Benhadad, olaiguanani le Asiria maeu enitii ejo, ‘Kaishiu nanu tena muoyian?’

English: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Shomo tiaaki ninye, ‘Inchiu iyie’, kake aaitoduaa nanu Olaitoriani nchere meeta nchere pee miye.”

English: And he settled his countenance stedfastly, until he was ashamed: and the man of God wept.
Masaai: Neshumu nkonyek enyena aing'or ninye, ometaba anaa nedol enkurruna. Neishir ilo tung'ani le Nkai.

English: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.
Masaai: Nejo Hasael, “Kainyoo pee eishir olkitok lai?” Newaliki ajoki, “Enkaraki naiyolo entorroni nilo aitaas iltung'ana loo Siraeli; ilo iyie apejoo isempewueti lenye, nilo aar metuata ilbarnot lenye to lalem, nidung'udung' nkera enye aitaa ndung'udung'ot, niaar metuata nena kituaak enye naairoshiutuo.”

English: And Hazael said, But what, is thy servant a dog, that he should do this great thing? And Elisha answered, The LORD hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria.
Masaai: Nejoki Hasael ninye, “Kainyoo ninye osinka lino, laa oldia ake, eji metaa keas ena bae sapuk?” Newaliki Elisha ajoki, “Aaitoduaa nanu Olaitoriani nchere ilo aaku olaiguanani le Siria.”

English: So he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to thee? And he answered, He told me that thou shouldest surely recover.
Masaai: Nelo ninye aing'uaa Elisha, nelo enetii olkitok lenye, nejoki ilo kitok lenye ninye, “Kaa iyie kitiaaka Elisha?” Newaliki ninye ajo, “Aatiaaka ninye inchiu iyie.”

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ekenyu, nedumu ninye olkarasha le dapash, neitadoiki enkare neisalaashaki enkomom enye, ometua ninye. Neaku Hasael olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neiteru Yehoram olayioni le Yehoshafat ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni oare apa ninye pee eiteru aaku olaiguanani, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem.

English: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Ahab: for the daughter of Ahab was his wife: and he did evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Neibung ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel, anaa apa enataasa enkaji e Ahab, amu entito e Ahab apa enkitok enye. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Yet the LORD would not destroy Judah for David his servant's sake, as he promised him to give him alway a light, and to his children.
Masaai: Kake eitu ake eidaikie Olaitoriani Yuda, te nkaraki Daudi osinka lenye, amu eisiligie apa Olaitoriani pee eisho ninye oltaa, o layiok lenyena ntarasi.

English: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i enyena, neorori Edom te nkitoria e Yuda, negelaki ate olaiguanani lenye maate.

English: So Joram went over to Zair, and all the chariots with him: and he rose by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him about, and the captains of the chariots: and the people fled into their tents.
Masaai: Nelo Yoram agiroo Saair tenebo ngarrin enyena pooki oo mbartan, nedumunye kewarie, ore ninye o lelo kituaak loo ngarrin e njore, near aamut lelo tung'ana pooki le Edom apa oo manita ninye. Kake eilanyishe enjore enye alo ang.

English: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
Masaai: Neaku etoorori apa Edom te nkitoria e Yuda ometabaiki ena olong. Neitoki ake sii Libna aorori teina kata.

English: And the rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yoram, o nena pooki naataasa ninye neigeroki te mbuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yoram etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Ahasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oare le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab, olaiguanani loo Siraeli, neitaae Ahasia olayioni le Yoram olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru aitoreisho.

English: Two and twenty years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Athaliah, the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam oare apa Ahasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye olari obo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Atalia, naa nkakuyiaa lenye apa Omori olaiguanani loo Siraeli.

English: And he walked in the way of the house of Ahab, and did evil in the sight of the LORD, as did the house of Ahab: for he was the son in law of the house of Ahab.
Masaai: Eibung'a sii apa ninye orrekie le nkaji e Ahab, neas mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa apa enataasa enkaji e Ahab. Amu olaputani apa ninye lo lmarei le Ahab.

English: And he went with Joram the son of Ahab to the war against Hazael king of Syria in Ramothgilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
Masaai: Eshomo apa ninye tenebo Yoram olayioni le Ahab aarare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria te Ramot-Gilead nepuo iltung'ana le Siria aapik Yoram olbae teine.

English: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye olaiguanani Yoram metabaki te Yesreel, lelo baa lenyena ootipika iltung'ana le Siria te Ramot, ina kata apa pee earare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Nedoyio Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram, olaiguanani le Yuda alo adol Yoram olayioni le Ahab te Yesreel, amu kemuoi apa ninye.

English: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets, and said unto him, Gird up thy loins, and take this box of oil in thine hand, and go to Ramothgilead:
Masaai: Neitoki Elisha aipotu obo loo layiok loo loibonok le Nkai nejoki ninye, “Terretena empolos ino, niya ele tulet le ilata, nilo Ramot-Gilead.

English: And when thou comest thither, look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brethren, and carry him to an inner chamber;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ibaya, ning'oru Yehu olayioni le Yehoshafat olayioni le Nimshi; nijing'aki ninye, nirik ninye aitung'uaa ilchoreta lenyena, nirik ninye enkilepata to lgilata liatua.

English: Then take the box of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and tarry not.
Masaai: Nintoki adumu ilo tulet le ilata, nibukoki eilata endukuya enye, nijo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, aatubukoko nanu eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani le Israel.’ Nintoki abol kutukaji nisik, mintoki aton teine.”

English: So the young man, even the young man the prophet, went to Ramothgilead.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo ilo barnoti oiboni Ramot-Gilead.

English: And when he came, behold, the captains of the host were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to thee, O captain. And Jehu said, Unto which of all us? And he said, To thee, O captain.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu ng'ura, etii ilarikok le njore enkiguana, nejo ninye, “Aata olkilikuai lino lo kitok le njore.” Nejoki, Yehu, “Kalo obo te iyiook pooki.” Nejoki ninye, “Iyie lo kitok.”

English: And he arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I have anointed thee king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninye nelo atua aji, nelotu ilo barnoti abukoki eilata endukuya enye, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, aatubukoko nanu eilata aaput aitaa olaiguanani loo ltung'ana lo Laitoriani, Isiraeli.

English: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie aosh enkaji e Ahab olkitok lino, pee atum nanu aitalaku elap te Yesebel, ilo sarge loo sinkan laainei, lelo oibonok le Nkai, o sarge le lelo sinkan pooki lo Laitoriani.

English: For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:
Masaai: Amu ore ina aji pooki e Ahab naa keidaaya; naa kaiwuang'ie nanu olee pooki aishie, o rrindik o lolakuno tiatua Israel.

English: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah:
Masaai: Naa kaitotiu nanu enkaji e Ahab anaa enkaji e Yeroboam olayioni le Nabat, naitotiu anaa enkaji e Baasha olayioni le Ahija.

English: And the dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. And he opened the door, and fled.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ildiain aainos Yesebel to lpolosie le Yesreel, nemeetae oltung'ani onukaa ninye.” Nebol ilo barnoti kutukaji neisik.

English: Then Jehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said unto him, Is all well? wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? And he said unto them, Ye know the man, and his communication.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipang'u Yehu alotu enetii isinkan lo lkitok lenye, nejoki ninche ninye, “Aisidain mbaa? Kainyoo pee eewuo ele tung'ani omoda enitii?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Iyiololo intae ele tung'ani o enkiroroto enye.”

English: And they said, It is false; tell us now. And he said, Thus and thus spake he to me, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I have anointed thee king over Israel.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Mesipa ina; toliki iyiook.” Nejo ninye, “Nji o inji aatiaka ninye nanu, nejo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Kaabukoki eilata aput aitaa olaiguanani loo Siraeli.’ ”

English: Then they hasted, and took every man his garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew with trumpets, saying, Jehu is king.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata neya pooki ng'ae nkilani enyena neirragie tiabori nkejek e Yehu, neosh ntarumpetani, neibalunye aajo, “Olaiguanani Yehu.”

English: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram had kept Ramothgilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria.
Masaai: Etarresho apa Yehu olayioni le Yehoshafat olayioni le Nimshi pee ear Yoram metua. Ore apa Yoram o Siraeli pooki, nerripisho ninche te Ramot-Gilead te nkaraki Hasael olaiguanani le Siria;

English: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) And Jehu said, If it be your minds, then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.
Masaai: kake etorrinyunye apa olaiguanani Yoram metabaki te Yesreel te nkaraki ilbaa apa ootipika ninye iltung'ana le Siria, ina kata apa pee earare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Neaku etejo Yehu, “Tenaa ena endamunoto ino, mincho naa oltung'ani hoo obo eipang te nkanasa alo ainosaa ilomon te Yesreel.”

English: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
Masaai: Neirot Yehu ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, nelo Yesreel, amu teine apa eirragita Yoram. Neewuo apa Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda amutan Yoram.

English: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
Masaai: Ore apa olarriponi negira aitashe to ltalet te Yesreel, neikeern encholuek e Yehu egira alotu, nejo, “Adolita olturrur,” Nejo Yoram, “Iwa olakedoni le mbarta pee elo anang'are ninche, naa nchoo ninye ejo, ‘Keseriani ake?’ ”

English: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu said, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me. And the watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he cometh not again.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo oltung'ani okedito embarta anang'are ninye, nejoki, “Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Keseriani ake.’ ” Nejoki Yehu, “Kaa iyie intaasa eseriani? mbelekenyayu tusujuaki.” Nelikioo olarriponi ina ejo, “Etabaikia olkilikuai ninche, kake merrinyunye ninye.”

English: Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.
Masaai: Neitoki Yoram airriwaa likae kilikuai oewuo ine netii ninche, nejoki, “Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Keseriani ake,’ ” neitoki Yehu ajoki, “Kenenyoo eseriani? Mbelekenyayu tusujuaki.”

English: And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.
Masaai: Neitoki ake olarriponi alikioo ajo, “Etabaikia ninye ninche, kake megira ninye arrinyunye. Ore elotunoto neikununo anaa elotunoto e Yehu olayioni le Nimshi amu kekuetu te ngolon oleng.”

English: And Joram said, Make ready. And his chariot was made ready. And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out against Jehu, and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
Masaai: Nejo Yoram, “Entobira engarri ai oo mbartan.” Neipang'u Yoram olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda, meetae ake olemetii engarri enye oo mbartan, nepuo aanang'are Yehu, nepuo aanang'aa te wueji e Nabot le Yesreel.

English: And it came to pass, when Joram saw Jehu, that he said, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many?
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Yoram Yehu, nejoki ninye, “Ke seriani ake Yehu?” Newaliki ajoki, “Kaa seriani etumi, eba nji enkiborra oo nkonyek o esakutore e ng'utunyi Yesebel te nkumoi?”

English: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Yoram ailanyisho, ejoki Ahasia “Olosek Ahasia!”

English: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
Masaai: Neyietu Yehu enkawuo enye te ngolon enye pooki, neng'or Yoram erishata oo ronyi, nelo embae ang'or oltau lenye, neimis ninye tiatua engarri oo mbartan.

English: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite: for remember how that, when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden upon him;
Masaai: Nejoki Yehu Bidkar olaretoni lenye, “Ilepie ninye nilo aiturraa te wueji e Nabot le Yesreel. Amu idamu iyie enapa kata kiriamari kikedito mbartan te siadi Ahab papaai lenye, nchere eiroro Olaitoriani ena kitanapata tialo ninye:

English: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, saith the LORD; and I will requite thee in this plat, saith the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: ‘Ore te sipata, anaa enatoduaa ngole osarge le Nabot, o sarge loo layiok lenyena Olaitoriani ojo kaitalaku nanu te iyie tene wueji.’ Ore naa taata iwa iyie ninye nilo anang'aa ninye teine wueji te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani.”

English: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. And Jehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot. And they did so at the going up to Gur, which is by Ibleam. And he fled to Megiddo, and died there.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Ahasia olaiguanani le Yuda ena, neisik alo enkalo e Bet-hagan. Nesujaa sii Yehu ninye, nejo, “Entang'or sii ninye.” Neng'or ninche ninye etii atua engarri oo mbartan te nkilepata e Guur, te mbata e Iblem. Neisikaki ninye Megido nelo aye teine.

English: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David.
Masaai: Nenap isinkan lenyena te ngarri oo mbartan neya Yerusalem, nepuo aanukaa ninye te nkurare enye, tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi.

English: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo le nkitoria e Yoram olayioni le Ahab neiteru Ahasia aitoreisho te Yuda.

English: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
Masaai: Ore apa pee elotu Yehu Yesreel, nening Yesebel ina; nesir nkonyek enyena, neitobir akus endukuya enye, nerumisho te lusie.

English: And as Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, Had Zimri peace, who slew his master?
Masaai: Ore eimu Yehu kishomi, nejo ninye, “Keseriani ake iyie Simri, oloata iloikop lo lkitok lenye?”

English: And he lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
Masaai: Neshumu Yehu nkonyek enyena aing'or elusie, nejo, “Kalo ilo otii embata ai? Kalo?” Ore iltung'ana oare okuni naa sunaishi oogelema neing'or ninye.

English: And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Entusulaki ninye enkop.” Nesulaki ninche ninye enkop; ore embata o sarge lenye neisuakino esuntai, o mbartan, neitunyoo mbartan ninye.

English: And when he was come in, he did eat and drink, and said, Go, see now this cursed woman, and bury her: for she is a king's daughter.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajing atua aji nedaa neokisho; nejo, “Entodol ena kitok nadiaa, enchom entunukai ninye; amu entito o laiguanani ninye.”

English: And they went to bury her: but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee epuo ninche aanukaa ninye, neitu edol toki meteleku ake endukuya o nkejek, o ndapi oo nkaik.

English: Wherefore they came again, and told him. And he said, This is the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel:
Masaai: Ore ake pee errinyunye ninche aaliki ninye, nejo ninye, “Ororei lo Laitoriani ele, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Elisha le Tishbi, ejo, ‘Ore to lpolosie le Yesreel naa keinos ildiain nkiri o sesen le Yesebel;

English: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel; so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
Masaai: naa ketiu empopok e Yesebel anaa emodioi eirrag tioriong enkop, to lpolosie le Yesreel, ometaa meetae oltung'ani ojo, Yesebel ena.’ ”

English: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. And Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, unto the rulers of Jezreel, to the elders, and to them that brought up Ahab's children, saying,
Masaai: Eeta apa Ahab ilayiok ntomoni naapishana te Samaria. Neiger Yehu mpala airriwaa Samaria, airriwaki ilaitoriak le nkanasa, o lpayiani, o laing'urak loo layiok le Ahab, ejo,

English: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fenced city also, and armour;
Masaai: “Tenebau ena palai enitii, amu iatata ilayiok lo lkitok linyi tenebo intae, niaatata ngarrin oo mbartan, o mbartan, o nkanas naasheta sunta, o masaa o larrabal,

English: Look even out the best and meetest of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
Masaai: entegelu oloisul ogol te lelo ayiok lo lkitok linyi, ninchosho ninye olorika le papaai lenye, nimitutu enkaji olkitok linyi.”

English: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, two kings stood not before him: how then shall we stand?
Masaai: Kake eiruto ninche oleng, nejo, “Ng'ura eitu eigaraa ilaiguanak oare ninye; kaji naa iyiook kinko tenikintasheikinore ninye?”

English: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilo aitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo, o laitasheikinoni le nkanasa, tenebo ilpayiani, o laing'urak, neirriwaki Yehu olkilikuai ejo, “Kira iyiook isinkan linono, naa eikiaas pooki nintanap iyiook. Mikintaa iyiook likae tung'ani, olaiguanani; taasa enaba anaa enidol aa sidai too nkonyek inono.”

English: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If ye be mine, and if ye will hearken unto my voice, take ye the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by to morrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, which brought them up.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aigeroki ninche enkae palai e are, ajoki, “Tenaa enkalo ai itii, naa tenaa eikining'ining'i nanu, entudung'oi ilukuny oo layiok lo lkitok linyi, nipuopuo aapuonu enatii taisere te Yesreel tena rishata.” Ore apa lelo ayiok lo laiguanani pokira ntomoni naapishana, netii tenebo iltung'ana kituaak le nkanasa, laa ninche apa ooitubulu ninche.

English: And it came to pass, when the letter came to them, that they took the king's sons, and slew seventy persons, and put their heads in baskets, and sent him them to Jezreel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau ina palai enetii ninche, neibung ninche lelo ayiok lo laiguanani, near metuata, iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana, nepik ilukuny enye nkikapuni, neyau ninche enetii Yehu te Yesreel.

English: And there came a messenger, and told him, saying, They have brought the heads of the king's sons. And he said, Lay ye them in two heaps at the entering in of the gate until the morning.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu olkilikuai ajoki ninye, “Eyautua ninche ilukuny oo layiok lo laiguanani,” nejo ninye, “Erragie ninche too lturrurri oare tembata e kishomi o mekenyu.”

English: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
Masaai: Ore tadekenya pee eipang ninye alo boo, neitashe ajoki iltung'ana pooki, “Miatata intae entioto. Nanu apa otarresho olkitok lai, naar ninye metua; kake aing'ae natara metuata kulo pooki?

English: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the LORD, which the LORD spake concerning the house of Ahab: for the LORD hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah.
Masaai: Entayiolo naa nchere, menya enkop ororei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro ninye oipirta olmarei le Ahab; amu etaasa Olaitoriani ina apa natejo ninye aimunye osinka lenye Eliya.”

English: So Jehu slew all that remained of the house of Ahab in Jezreel, and all his great men, and his kinsfolks, and his priests, until he left him none remaining.
Masaai: Near Yehu metuata lelo pooki apa ootelekutua te nkaji e Ahab te Yesreel, o ltung'ana lenyena kituaak, o lchoreta lenyena yiolot, o lapolosak lenyena, ometaba anaa neishu pooki.

English: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
Masaai: Neitoki ninye adumunye nelo Samaria. Ore te nkoitoi etii ninye Beteked ewueji oo lairritak loo ntare,

English: Jehu met with the brethren of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, Who are ye? And they answered, We are the brethren of Ahaziah; and we go down to salute the children of the king and the children of the queen.
Masaai: nenang'are Yehu iltung'ana lo lmarei lenye lo laiguanani le Yuda oji Ahasia, nejoki ninche, “Irara akua?” Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Kira iyiook ilo lmarei le Ahasia, nikietuo iyiook aamutan iltung'ana le nkaji e nkitoo, o layiok le nkitok o laiguanani.”

English: And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ewaita ninche eishu.” Neyae ninche eishu, nepuo ninche aar metuata te ngumoto e Beteked, iltung'ana artam oare neitu elekuni obo lenye.

English: And when he was departed thence, he lighted on Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him: and he saluted him, and said to him, Is thine heart right, as my heart is with thy heart? And Jehonadab answered, It is. If it be, give me thine hand. And he gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.
Masaai: Ore pee edumunye ninye alo teine, nenang'are Yehonadab olayioni le Rekab elotu anang'are ninye; neiroroki ninye, nejoki, “Ketiu oltau lino te nanu anaa enatiu olalai te iyie?” Nejo Yehonadab, “Ee” Nejoki Yehu, “Tenaa neijia nchooki enkaina ino.” Neisho ninye Yehu enkaina. Neyiataa Yehu ninye apik engarri oo mbartan.

English: And he said, Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD. So they made him ride in his chariot.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Wou tusujaki pee idol enyuaata naata to Laitoriani.” Kae neked ninye tenebo ninye engarri enye oo mbartan.

English: And when he came to Samaria, he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria, till he had destroyed him, according to the saying of the LORD, which he spake to Elijah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Samaria, near metua lelo pooki apa ootelekutua lo lmarei le Ahab ootii Samaria, ometaba anaa neishu pooki, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani apa otiaka Eliya.

English: And Jehu gathered all the people together, and said unto them, Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu shall serve him much.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehu aiturrur iltung'ana pooki, nejoki ninche, “Eisiaayia apa Ahab Baal penyo; kake kelo Yehu aisiaai ninye oleng.

English: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal, all his servants, and all his priests; let none be wanting: for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal; whosoever shall be wanting, he shall not live. But Jehu did it in subtilty, to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal.
Masaai: Ore naa taata empotokoki nanu iloibonok pooki le Baal, o laseremak lenyena pooki o lapolosak lenyena pooki; emincho eaku metii ninye olemetii, amu aata olasar kitok laitaiki Baal. Ore oltung'ani lemelotu neari metua.” Etaasa apa Yehu ina te nkalamasisho ejo pee eidaikie ilapolosak le Baal.

English: And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.
Masaai: Neitanapisho Yehu ajo, “Entobira eumata kitok te nkaraki Baal.” Neaku eibalunye ninche.

English: And Jehu sent through all Israel: and all the worshippers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that came not. And they came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was full from one end to another.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yehu ilkiliku meshomo Israel pooki, nepuonu ilaseremak pooki le Baal, neaku meetae oltung'ani leitu elotu. Nejing ninche atua enkaji e Baal, neiputayu ina aji e Baal ebaiki esuntai ometabaiki enkae suntai.

English: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo laa ninye oitasheiki osanduku oshumishoreki, “Iyau masaa o ntokitin enkisiaayiare te nkaraki eseremare e Baal.” Neyau ninye nena masaa,

English: And Jehu went, and Jehonadab the son of Rechab, into the house of Baal, and said unto the worshippers of Baal, Search, and look that there be here with you none of the servants of the LORD, but the worshippers of Baal only.
Masaai: nelo Yehu atua ina aji e Baal tenebo Yehonadab olayioni le Rekab; nejoki ilaseremak le Baal, “Entujurru entodol nchere metii osinka lo Laitoriani hoo obo atua intae. Kake ilaseremak le Baal ake.”

English: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings, Jehu appointed fourscore men without, and said, If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape, he that letteth him go, his life shall be for the life of him.
Masaai: Neitoki alo atua aji aishooyo inkishorot neitayu ilasarri oopejori. Netipika apa Yehu iltung'ana ntomoni isiet boo, nejoki, “Ore oltung'ani obo te lelo latipika nkaik inono metuluai neiturraa enkishui enye.”

English: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, that Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, Go in, and slay them; let none come forth. And they smote them with the edge of the sword; and the guard and the captains cast them out, and went to the city of the house of Baal.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aishooi nkishorot o lasar opejori, nejoki Yehu olarriponi o lkituaak, “Entijing'aki entaar metuata; emincho oltung'ani obo eimisho.” Ore ake pee eidip aatar ninche too lalema, ore ilo arriponi o lkituaak nenang'aki ninche boo, nepuo olgilata li atua te nkaji e Baal.

English: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal, and burned them.
Masaai: Neipang'unye ninche ina ng'ape apa natii enkaji e Baal, nepejoo.

English: And they brake down the image of Baal, and brake down the house of Baal, and made it a draught house unto this day.
Masaai: Neidaikie ninche ina ng'ape e Baal, neidaikie ina aji e Baal, neitaa enkaji narotokini ometabaiki ena olong.

English: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
Masaai: Neijia eikuna Yehu eishie Baal tiatua Israel.

English: Howbeit from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, Jehu departed not from after them, to wit, the golden calves that were in Bethel, and that were in Dan.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eibelekenya Yehu apaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa te ninche apa aitapong'oyie Isiraeli, meteserema ilasho le sahabu te Betel o te Dan.

English: And the LORD said unto Jehu, Because thou hast done well in executing that which is right in mine eyes, and hast done unto the house of Ahab according to all that was in mine heart, thy children of the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Yehu, “Ore enkaraki nitaasa esidai too nkonyek aainei, nintaasa enkaji e Ahab te risioroto e nena pooki naatii oltau lai, ore ilayiok linono le ishoi e ong'uan, kepuo aatonie olorika le nkitoo too Siraeli.”

English: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Kake mme arriyia apa Yehu te nkibung'ata oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani. Enkai oo Siraeli, to ltau lenye pooki; eitu apa ninye epaash ing'ok e Yeroboam naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: In those days the LORD began to cut Israel short: and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel;
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, neiteru Olaitoriani adung'oo kulie wuejitin e nkop oo Siraeli. Etimira apa Hasael ninche eisulie tialo ilpolosien le Israel pooki.

English: From Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.
Masaai: Ebaiki olkeju le Yordan te nkalo o loo saen, o enkop pooki e Gilead, o ene Gad, o ene Ruben o ene Manase, ebaiki Aroa, te mbata o erata oji Arnon, aa taa Gilead o Bashan.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Yehu, o nena pooki nataasa ninye o enkidimata enye pooki, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And Jehu slept with his fathers: and they buried him in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yehu etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te Samaria. Neitoreisho Yehoahas olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years.
Masaai: Ore apa enkata naitoria Isiraeli te Samaria naa ilarin tikitam o isiet.

English: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Atalaia ng'otonye Ahasia ajo etua olayioni lenye, nedumunye ninye aidaikie enkaji pooki e nkitoo.

English: But Jehosheba, the daughter of king Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons which were slain; and they hid him, even him and his nurse, in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.
Masaai: Kake ore Yehosheba, ina tito o laiguanani Yoram, enkanashe e Ahasia, neya Yoash olayioni le Ahasia, nepurroo ninye nelo aisudoo aitung'uaa lelo ayiok lo laiguanani apa ooji pee eari metuata, nepik ninye o enkaibung'ani enye atua olgilata oirragi. Neisudoo ninye te nkaraki Atalia, neaku eitu eari ninye metua.

English: And he was with her hid in the house of the LORD six years. And Athaliah did reign over the land.
Masaai: Neboitare Yoash ninye ilarin ile, eisudoo tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, naa Atalia naitoreisho ina kata teina kop.

English: And the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the rulers over hundreds, with the captains and the guard, and brought them to him into the house of the LORD, and made a covenant with them, and took an oath of them in the house of the LORD, and shewed them the king's son.
Masaai: Kake ore to lari liopishana neirriwaki olapolosani oji Yehoida olkilikuai lelo aitasheikinok loo larripok le nkaji e nkitoo, nejoki ninche pee epuonu enkaji e Nkai. Ore teine neinosie ninche olmumai pee ening'okino ina apa naitobira pee eas. Neitodol ninche olayioni lo laiguanani.

English: And he commanded them, saying, This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king's house;
Masaai: Neitanap ninye ninche ajoki, “Ena bae intae enchom entaas: ore erubata inyi e uni, lelo ooipang'u aaing'uaa enkisiaayiare te nkolong e sabato, nerrip enkaji o laiguanani

English: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur; and a third part at the gate behind the guard: so shall ye keep the watch of the house, that it be not broken down.
Masaai: netii enkae rubata e uni kishomi e Suri, ore enkae rubata e uni nelo kishomi natii oriong ilarripok, nerrip lelo enkaji e nkitoo.

English: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath, even they shall keep the watch of the house of the LORD about the king.
Masaai: Ore ntukusi inyi are naapuonu enkisiaayiare te nkolong e sabato, nerrip enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: And ye shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand: and he that cometh within the ranges, let him be slain: and be ye with the king as he goeth out and as he cometh in.
Masaai: neman ninche aang'adu olaiguanani, oltung'ani ake eibung'ita imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina. Ore pooki ng'ae onyikaki lelo turrurri neari metua. Etaa tenebo o laiguanani teneipang auluo o tenejing'u.”

English: And the captains over the hundreds did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that should go out on the sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.
Masaai: Neas lelo kituaak le njore te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapishe Yehoida olapolosani neriku ake pooki lenye oltung'ani lenye lemetii enkisiaayiare te nkolong e sabato, tenebo lelo oopuonu aajing enkisiaayiare te nkolong e sabato, nepuonu enetii Yehoida olapolosani.

English: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David's spears and shields, that were in the temple of the LORD.
Masaai: Neyaki ilo apolosani lelo kituaak le njore iremeta o long'oi apa naara ino laiguanani Daudi, naatii atua enkaji o laiguanani;

English: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.
Masaai: neitashe lelo arripok neibung'ita ake pooki tung'ani imasaa enyena o larrabal too nkaik enyena, ebaiki enkalo e kopikop e nkaji o metabaiki enkalo e moikuape, neman olperere lo lasar oina aji.

English: And he brought forth the king's son, and put the crown upon him, and gave him the testimony; and they made him king, and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, God save the king.
Masaai: Neipang'unye ninye ilo ayioni lo laiguanani neishopoki enkopiyia e nkitoo, neisho ninye enchakenisho, neibalunyeki ninye aaitaa olaiguanani nebukokini eilata aaput. Neosh ninche nkaik ejo, “Metobikoi olaiguanani.”

English: And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the temple of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eining'oo Atalia enkilepilep oo larripok tenebo iltung'ana, nelo ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani ine netii iltung'ana;

English: And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.
Masaai: nejo aing'orisho, eitashe olaiguanani te mbata e ng'ape, anaa enatiu olkerreti lenye, ore ilarikok le njore o laoshok loo ntarumpetani ootashare olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki leina kop, neshipa neosh ntarumpetani. Nepolos Atalia nkilani enyena neishir ajo, “Entorroni! Entorroni!”

English: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword. For the priest had said, Let her not be slain in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitanap olapolosani Yehoida ilarikok le njore laa ninche apa ooitasheiki esikari ajoki, “Eyau ninye eimunye erishata oo ltimito naa iariara pooki tung'ani osuj ninye to lalem.” Amu etejo apa ilo apolosani, “Mincho eari ninye metua tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: And they laid hands on her; and she went by the way by the which the horses came into the king's house: and there was she slain.
Masaai: Neaku eibung'a ninche ninye; neim ninye erishata e kishomi oo mbartan nelo enkaji o laiguanani, nepuoi aar ninye metua teine.

English: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD'S people; between the king also and the people.
Masaai: Neitobir Yehoida olning'o te rishata o Laitoriani o laiguanani o ltung'ana, nchere eaku ninche iltung'ana lo Laitoriani; neitobir sii olning'o te rishata o laiguanani o ltung'ana.

English: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal, and brake it down; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. And the priest appointed officers over the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana pooki leina kop aapuo enkaji e Baal neuroo ninye, o lperereni lenyena loo lasarri, ore nkitanyaanyukot enyena nebel aaitaa mbelibelat. Near Matan ilo apolosani le Baal metua te dukuya lelo pereren loo lasarri. Nepik ilo apolosani ilarripok ooing'or enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he took the rulers over hundreds, and the captains, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the house of the LORD, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king's house. And he sat on the throne of the kings.
Masaai: Neyau ninye lelo arikok le njore, o laitasheikinok le nkaji e nkitoo, o larripok, o ltung'ana pooki leina kop; neriku ninche pooki olaiguanani te nkaji o Laitoriani, nepuo aaim kishomi oo larripok, nepuo enkaji o laiguanani. Neton ninye to lorika le nkitoo lo laiguanani.

English: And all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was in quiet: and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king's house.
Masaai: Neshipayu iltung'ana pooki leina kop. Neitirring'a ina anasa ina kata eidipaki aatar Atalia metua to lalem te enkaji o laiguanani.

English: Seven years old was Jehoash when he began to reign.
Masaai: Oloo larin oopishana apa Yehoash pee eiteru aitoreisho.

English: In the seventh year of Jehu Jehoash began to reign; and forty years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zibiah of Beersheba.
Masaai: Ore apa to lari liopishana le nkitoria e Yehu, neiteru Yehoash aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin artam oare te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Sibia e Beer-sheba.

English: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him.
Masaai: Neas Yehoash mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani too nkolong'i enyena pooki, amu eiteng'ena apa olapolosani Yehoida ninye.

English: But the high places were not taken away: the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika, metaa eshomo iltung'ana dukuya epolosisho nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: And Jehoash said to the priests, All the money of the dedicated things that is brought into the house of the LORD, even the money of every one that passeth the account, the money that every man is set at, and all the money that cometh into any man's heart to bring into the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Nejoki Yehoash lelo apolosak, “Ore kuna pisai pooki oo ntokitin sinyat naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nena pisai naaikenakaki pooki ng'ae - nena pisai naaikenakaki iltung'ana pooki, o nena pisai naadumaki oltau oltung'ani meyau atua enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: Let the priests take it to them, every man of his acquaintance: and let them repair the breaches of the house, wheresoever any breach shall be found.
Masaai: nchoo ilapolosak eya, eya ake oltung'ani te lelo ooyiolo. Naa nchoo ninche eitobir ina aji aaram te nkata ake naba anaa enadoli ewueji nerami.

English: But it was so, that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house.
Masaai: Kake ore to lari le tikitam ookuni le nkitoria o laiguanani Yehoash, neitu eram ilapolosak ina aji.

English: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and the other priests, and said unto them, Why repair ye not the breaches of the house? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance, but deliver it for the breaches of the house.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, neipotu olaiguanani Yehoash Yehoida olapolosani o kulikae apolosak nejoki ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee mintobiriri enkaji aaram? Ore naa taata mintokiki aaya mpesai te lelo liyiolorere, kake enchooi nena pisai pee eitobirieki enkaji.”

English: And the priests consented to receive no more money of the people, neither to repair the breaches of the house.
Masaai: Nenyorraa lelo apolosak pee meitoki aaya kulie pisai too ltung'ana, nemeitobir ninche aaram ina aji.

English: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoida ilo apolosani adumu osanduku, nepik enaudoto enkikenet enye, nepik ilo sanduku embata o lperere lo lasar, te nkalo e tatene, te wueji nejing'ieki enkaji o Laitoriani; ore lelo apolosak oorip kutukaji nepik atua ine nena pisai pooki naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ore ake enkata nadoli aajo aikumok mpisai naatii atua ilo sanduku, nelotu olasirani lo laiguanani o lapolosani kitok, aaiken neenaa ninche too lbenia oo notoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And they gave the money, being told, into the hands of them that did the work, that had the oversight of the house of the LORD: and they laid it out to the carpenters and builders, that wrought upon the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Neisho ninche nena pisai naaidipaki aaikena lelo aasak le siaai ooitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani; nelaaki ninche lelo aguetak loo nkeek, o lashetak ooshetita ina aji o Laitoriani.

English: And to masons, and hewers of stone, and to buy timber and hewed stone to repair the breaches of the house of the LORD, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.
Masaai: Neisho sii ilashetak loo soito o ladung'ok loo soito. Neinyiang'u sii mbaoi o soito ooitobirieki enkaji o Laitoriani aaram.

English: Howbeit there were not made for the house of the LORD bowls of silver, snuffers, basons, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Kake eitu eishoori te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani ntokitin naaitobirieki, ngirran e nkosholai, o ntokitin naarieki enkima, o lbakulini, o ntarumpetani, anaa kulie masaa e sahabu, arashu ine nkosholai, te nena pisai apa naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Amu eishooki apa nena pisai ilaitobirak le nkaji ooramita enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
Masaai: Neitu apa eikilikuani metolimu enkikenakinoto te lelo tung'ana ooishooitie nena pisai too nkaik enye, aalaaki lelo aisiaayiak, amu etaasishote apa ninche te nkoitoi naisiligayu.

English: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests'.
Masaai: Ore mpisai o lasar le nkitarruorroto o no lasar le ng'oki, neitu eyauni atua enkaji o Laitoriani; inoo lapolosak nena.

English: Then Hazael king of Syria went up, and fought against Gath, and took it: and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nelo Hasael olaiguanani le Siria aarare Gaat, neya ninye. Kake ore ake pee eibelekenya Hasael aing'or Yerusalem,

English: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram, and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own hallowed things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and in the king's house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria: and he went away from Jerusalem.
Masaai: neya Yehoash ilo aiguanani le Yuda nena kishorot pooki apa naaitisinya, Yehoshafat o Yoram o Ahasia, lelo aiguanak apa le Yuda, oara iloo menye. O nena kishorot naaitisinya ninye makewan, o sahabu pooki apa natii atua ilchumat le nkaji o Laitoriani, o enkaji o laiguanani neirriwaki nena pooki Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Nelo Hasael aing'uaa Yerusalem.

English: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa kulie kiaasin e Yoash, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And his servants arose, and made a conspiracy, and slew Joash in the house of Millo, which goeth down to Silla.
Masaai: Nedumunye isinkan lenyena aarreshisho, near Yoash metua te nkaji e Milo teina oitoi nadoyio alo Sila.

English: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Isinkan lenyena apa, Yasakar olayioni le Shimet o Yehoshad olayioni le Shomer ootanang'ie ninye enkop, neaku etua ninye nenukari tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Amasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned seventeen years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam ookuni le nkitoria e Yoash olayioni le Ahasia, olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Yehoahas olayioni le Yehu aitoreisho te Israel o te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oopishana.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani nerubare ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli. Eitu ninye eing'uaa nena ng'ok.

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, all their days.
Masaai: Neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Isiraeli, neishooyo ninche apik nkaik e Hasael olaiguanani le Siria, o nkaik e Benhadad olayioni le Hasael.

English: And Jehoahaz besought the LORD, and the LORD hearkened unto him: for he saw the oppression of Israel, because the king of Syria oppressed them.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoahas aishiraki Olaitoriani, nening Olaitoriani ninye; amu etoduaa ninye ina kibookinoto naibookoki Israel enkop, oina naibooko ninche olaiguanani le Siria enkop.

English: (And the LORD gave Israel a saviour, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians: and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents, as beforetime.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eishoo Olaitoriani Isiraeli olaitajeunoni, neaku eitajeutuo ninche too nkaik oo ltung'ana le Siria. Nebik iltung'ana le Israel too nkang'itie enye anaa apa ake.

English: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu ninche eing'uaa ing'ok e nkaji e Yeroboam, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli. Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie lenye, neitobik Asher te Samaria.

English: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria had destroyed them, and had made them like the dust by threshing.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa eing'ueikini Yehoahas enjore oo ltung'ana onom loo mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan tomon o ltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oopuo too nkejek. Amu eidaikie apa olaiguanani le Siria ninche neitotiu ninche anaa enterit te wueji neidong'ishoreki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoahas o nena pooki naataasa neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria: and Joash his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Yehoahas etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye te Samaria neitoreisho Yoash olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the thirty and seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned sixteen years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni oopishana le nkitoria e Yoash olaiguanani le Yuda neiteru Yehoas olayioni le Yehoahas aitore Isirael te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel sin: but he walked therein.
