Masaai: Etaasa apa sii ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, eitu ninye epaash ing'ok pooki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok. Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie lenye aas ing'ok.

English: And the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Yoash, o nena pooki naataasa, oina magilanisho naa ninye etigilunore Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel?

English: And Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne: and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Yoash etua anaa loo menye, netonie Yeroboam olorika lenye le nkitoo; nenukari Yoash te Samaria tenebo ilaiguanak le Israel.

English: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died. And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him, and wept over his face, and said, O my father, my father, the chariot of Israel, and the horsemen thereof.
Masaai: Ore apa pee ejing Elisha emuoyian naa ninye naawa, nelo Yoash olaiguanani le Israel enetii ninye neishir ninye te dukuya Elisha ejo, “Papaai lai, papaai lai! Ngarrin oo mbartan e Israel o lakedok lenyena loo mbartan!”

English: And Elisha said unto him, Take bow and arrows. And he took unto him bow and arrows.
Masaai: Nejoki Elisha ninye, “Iwa enkawuo o mbaa;” neya ninye enkawuo o mbaa.

English: And he said to the king of Israel, Put thine hand upon the bow. And he put his hand upon it: and Elisha put his hands upon the king's hands.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki olaiguanani le Israel, “Teyietu enkawuo,” neyietu ninye, neiteleiki Elisha nkaik enyena endukuya o laiguanani.

English: And he said, Open the window eastward. And he opened it. Then Elisha said, Shoot. And he shot. And he said, The arrow of the LORD'S deliverance, and the arrow of deliverance from Syria: for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek, till thou have consumed them.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Tabolo elusie te nkalo oloosaen,” nebol olaiguanani elusie. Neitoki Elisha ajoki ninye, “Tang'oroi embae,” nengoroo olaiguanani embae. Nejoki Elisha, “Embae o Laitoriani e nkisulata embae e nkisulata namirieki Siria! Amu ilo aarare Siria te Afek ometaba anaa niishie ninche.”

English: And he said, Take the arrows. And he took them. And he said unto the king of Israel, Smite upon the ground. And he smote thrice, and stayed.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Iwa nena baa.” Neya olaiguanani nena baa. Nejoki ninye ilo aiguanani le Israel, “Tooshie nena baa enkop;” neoshie ninye enkop katitin uni, neitirring'a.

English: And the man of God was wroth with him, and said, Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it: whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice.
Masaai: Negorokino ilo tung'ani le Nkai ninye, nejoki, “Anaata napaji itooshie enkop katitin imiet anaa ile; naa anaata ilo aar Siria ometaba anaa niishie ninche, kake ore taata katitin uni ake ilo aosh Siria.”

English: And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Elisha nenukari ninye. Ore ilooti wuampan loo Lmoabu naa kegira apa aarasaki ina kop te rishata o loirujuruj teilo ari.

English: And it came to pass, as they were burying a man, that, behold, they spied a band of men; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha: and when the man was let down, and touched the bones of Elisha, he revived, and stood up on his feet.
Masaai: Ore ina kata enukari oltung'ani otua, ng'ura nedoli entukus eilo wuampa nenang'akini ilo tung'ani otua atua enkurare e Elisha; eji ore ake pee eiseyie ilo tung'ani iloik le Elisha, nepiu neitashe too nkejek enyena.

English: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.
Masaai: Ore apa Hasael olaiguanani le Siria neibooko Isiraeli enkop too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoahas.

English: And the LORD was gracious unto them, and had compassion on them, and had respect unto them, because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them, neither cast he them from his presence as yet.
Masaai: Kake eing'urrie Olaitoriani ninche, neibelekenyakino ninche, te nkaraki osotua lenye o Abraham, o Isaak, o Yakobo, neaku meidaikie ninye ninche; nemearaa ninche aitung'uaa kewan ometabaiki taata.

English: So Hazael king of Syria died; and Ben-hadad his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eye Hasael olaiguanani le Siria, neaku Benhadad olayioni lenye olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: And Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities, which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Three times did Joash beat him, and recovered the cities of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoash olayioni le Yehoahas aya te Benhadad olayioni le Hasael nena anas apa naatooruo ninye Yehoas papaai lenye to larrabal. Katitin uni etimira Yoash ninye nerrinyu nena anas oo Siraeli.

English: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari liare le nkitoria e Yoash olayioni le Yoahas, olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru aitoreisho Amasia olayioni le Yoash, ilo aiguanani le Yuda.

English: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam ooudo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yeho-adin e Yerusalem.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, yet not like David his father: he did according to all things as Joash his father did.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake mme sii anaa apa Daudi papaai lenye. Etaasa ninye too mbaa pooki anaa enataasa papaai lenye Yoash.

English: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: as yet the people did sacrifice and burnt incense on the high places.
Masaai: Kake eitu eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika, eton ake eitayu iltung'ana ilasarri nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: And it came to pass, as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand, that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidipi aaishoo enkitoo metaa ninye olaiguanani, near ninye isinkan lenyena metuata, laa ninche apa ootasesekuana menye.

English: But the children of the murderers he slew not: according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, wherein the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye ear nkera e lelo tung'ana oata iloikop, te risioroto e nena naaigeroki te mbuku oo nkitanapat e Musa. Teine apa neitanapishe Olaitoriani ajo, “Meari iloo menye metuata te nkaraki nkera, nemeari nkera metuata te nkaraki loo menye; kake keye ake pooki ng'ae te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.”

English: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand, and took Selah by war, and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day.
Masaai: Etaara apa ninye iltung'ana le Edom nkalifuni tomon metuata to erata le munyan, neya enkanasa e Sela to larrabal, neisho ninye enkarna ajo Yokteel, naa ninye enkarna enye o taata.

English: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia airriwaa ilkiliku meshomo enetii Yoash olayioni le Yehoahas, olayioni le Yehu, olaiguanani le Israel, ajoki, “Wou maing'urata iyiook too nkomomi.”

English: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel airriwaki olkilikuai olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki, “Etiaaka apa olkikuei lo doinyo le Lebanon oltarakuai, ‘nchoru entito ino meyama olayioni lai.’ Nelotu eng'ues entim e Lebanon aim ine neituny ilo kikuei.

English: Thou hast indeed smitten Edom, and thine heart hath lifted thee up: glory of this, and tarry at home: for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
Masaai: Esipa itoosho iyie Edom, nikinting'ida iyie oltau lino. Ndipakinoyu naa iyie te nkitoo ino nintirring'a tiang. Amu kainyoo iyie pee ing'oru enyamali ijo pee ibatata iyie tenebo Yuda.”

English: But Amaziah would not hear. Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Bethshemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
Masaai: Kake eitu ening Amasia ina. Neaku etudumunye Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel alo, ore ninye o Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda neipirakino to larrabal te Bet-shenesh, e Yuda.

English: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled every man to their tents.
Masaai: Nemir Israel Yuda neisik pooki tung'ani alo enkang enye.

English: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
Masaai: Neibung Yehoash olaiguanani le Israel Amasia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, olayioni le Yehoash, olayioni le Ahasia te Betshe-mesh, nelotu Yerusalem neuroo esuntai e Yerusalem erishata oo ntemat e nkaina iip ong'uan, ebaiki kishomi e Efraim ometabaiki kishomi o lpijata.

English: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Neya ninye sahabu pooki o enkosholai, o masaa pooki apa naainepuaki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o tiatua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani, o ltung'ana apa ootarayioki, neyau ninche Samaria.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yehoash apa naataasa ninye, o enkidimata enye oina nataarare Amasia olaiguanani le Yuda, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yehoash etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye te Samaria, tenebo ilaiguanak le Israel; neitoreisho Yeroboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
Masaai: Etobiko apa Amasia olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Yuda, ilarin tomon o imiet, te siadi enkeeya e Yehoash olayioni le Yehoahas olaiguanani le Israel.

English: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Amasia, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: Now they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem: and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish, and slew him there.
Masaai: Nerresh ninche ninye te Yerusalem, neisikaki enkop e Lakish. Kake eirriwakita ninche iltung'ana le Lakish, nepuo ninche aar ninye metua teine.

English: And they brought him on horses: and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David.
Masaai: Nenapu ninche ninye too mbartan; nepuoi aanukaa ninye te Yerusalem tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi.

English: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
Masaai: Neya iltung'ana pooki le Yuda Asaria, laa oloo larin tomon o ile, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te rishata e papaai lenye Amasia.

English: He built Elath, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
Masaai: Etesheta apa ninye Elat nerrinyoki Yuda, ina kata eidipa olaiguanani atua tenebo loo menye.

English: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria, and reigned forty and one years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o imiet le nkitoria e Amasia olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel aitoreisho te Samaria. neitoreisho ninye ilarin artam oobo.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani. Eitu ninye epaash ing'ok pooki e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli.

English: He restored the coast of Israel from the entering of Hamath unto the sea of the plain, according to the word of the LORD God of Israel, which he spake by the hand of his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet, which was of Gathhepher.
Masaai: Etorrinyuo ninye olpolosie pooki le Israel ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamatoo metabaiki enaiposha e Araba, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, apa oiroro aimunye osinka lenye Yona olayioni le Amitai, ilo oiboni le Nkai; oing'uaa Gat-hafer.

English: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter: for there was not any shut up, nor any left, nor any helper for Israel.
Masaai: Amu etoduaa apa Olaitoriani nchere ore ina kibookinoto e nkop oo Siraeli naa keme, amu meetae hoo obo otelekua, oloena anaa ololakuno, nemeetae oltung'ani oret Isiraeli.

English: And the LORD said not that he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven: but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa ejo Olaitoriani keiwuang'ie enkarna e Israel tiabori keper. Neaku eitajeuo ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he warred, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which belonged to Judah, for Israel, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yeroboam, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, o enkidimata enye, o larrabali lenyena, oina natorrinyoko Israel Dameski o Hamat, naa ene Yuda apa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yeroboam etua anaa apa loo menye, lelo aiguanak le Israel. Neitoreisho Sakaria olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam oopishana le nkitoria e Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru Asaria olayioni le Amasia, ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: Sixteen years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned two and fifty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomon o ile apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin onom oare te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yekolia e Yerusalem.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah had done;
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa Amasia papaai lenye.

English: Save that the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia eitu eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika; neton ake epej iltung'ana enkorropil too wuejitin neeika.

English: And the LORD smote the king, so that he was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house. And Jotham the king's son was over the house, judging the people of the land.
Masaai: Neosh Olaitoriani ilo aiguanani, neaku ninye olayioni le nkeeya oo lbolot ometabaiki ina olong apa natua ninye. Neton apa ninye te nkaji enye etekepayioki. Naa Yotam apa olayioni lo laiguanani oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, neitore iltung'ana leina kop.

English: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Amasia, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Asaria etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari ninye tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Yatam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o isiet le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Sakaria olayioni le Yeroboam aitoreisho too Siraeli te nkop e Samaria, ilapaitin ile.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his fathers had done: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa apa enataasa papaai lenye. Eitu ninye epaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli.

English: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Nerresh Shalum olayioni le Yabesh ninye, neosh ninye abatat te Ibleam, near ninye metua, neitoreisho te rishata enye.

English: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Sekaria, ng'ura, eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: This was the word of the LORD which he spake unto Jehu, saying, Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation. And so it came to pass.
Masaai: (Ina apa enkisiligata naishoo Olaitoriani Yehu, ajoki, “Ketonie ilayiok linono olorika le nkitoo le Israel ometabaiki e ishoi e ong'uan,” nelotu aaku ina.)

English: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
Masaai: Eiterua apa Shalum olayioni le Yabesh aitoreisho to lari le tomoni uni o naaudo le nkitoria e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho ninye olapa obo te Samaria.

English: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neitoki Menaham olayioni le Gadi alotu eing'uaa Tirsa nelotu Samaria, neosh ninye Shalum olayioni le Yebesh te Samaria near ninye metua, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.

English: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Shalum, ina rreshoto natarreshishe, ng'ura, eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata near Manahem Tipua o pooki ootii atua, o lpolosien lenyena ebaiki Tirsa neito idia alo. Etaara apa tenkaraki neitu ninche ebolu ninye, nedanyaa nkoishua nkituaak pooki naairoishi.

English: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Judah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Israel, and reigned ten years in Samaria.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o naaudo le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda neiteru Menahen olayioni le Gadi aitoreisho te Israel, neitoreisho ilarin tomon te Samaria.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani; eitu ninye epaash te nkishui enye pooki ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, naa ninche eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
Masaai: Nelotu Pul olaiguanani le Asiria aarare ina kop; neisho Menahem Pul ntalantani enkalifu nabo e nkosholai, pee etum ninye ataretu ninye, meitagolo enkitoria enye.

English: And Menahem exacted the money of Israel, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
Masaai: Netasotuo apa Menahem nena pisai te Israel, aa taa, too ltung'ana pooki karsisi. Neitayu ake oltung'ani shekeli onom aisho olaiguanani le Asiria. Neaku etorrinye olaiguanani le Asiria, neitu eitoki aton teina kop.

English: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Manahem, nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Mehahem etua anaa apa loo menye, neitoreisho Pekalia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned two years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le onom oare le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Pekahia olayioni le Menahem aitore Isiraeli te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani; eitu ninye epaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli.

English: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king's house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
Masaai: Ore Peka ilo kitok lenye le enjore, olayioni le Remalia, nerresh ninye tenebo iltung'ana onom le Gilead ilo aiguanani, near ninye metua te Samaria, too lgilat le nkaji e nkitoo. Neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye.

English: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Pekahia, o nena pooki naataasa, ng'ura, eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le onom o are le nkitoria e Asaria olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Peka olayioni le Remalia aitore Isiraeli te Samaria, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani. Eitu ninye epaash ing'ok e Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat naa ninche apa eitapong'orie Isiraeli metaasa ing'ok.

English: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-Bethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i e Peka olaiguanani le Israel nelotu Tiglat-Pilesa olaiguanani le Asiria neibung nkanas e Ijon, o Abel-bet-maka, o Yanoa, o Kadesh, o Hasor, o Gilead o Galilaya, o enkop pooki e Naftali; neya iltung'ana eararoto te Asiria.

English: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
Masaai: Neitoki Hoshea, olayioni le Ela arresh Peka olayioni le Remalia, neosh ninye, near metua, neitoreisho ninye te rishata enye, to lari le tikitam le nkitoria e Yotam olayioni le Usia.

English: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Peka, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, ng'ura, eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari liare le nkitoria e Peka olayioni le Remalia, olaiguanani le Israel, neiteru Yotam olayioni le Usia ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa o imiet ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yerusha entito e Sadok.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitorian, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa papaai lenye Usia.

English: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika. Eton ake epolosisho iltung'ana nepej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika. Etesheta apa ninye kishomi e shumata e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiasin e Yoram, o nena pooki naataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: In those days the LORD began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i neiteru Olaitoriani airriwaa Resin olaiguanani le Siria o Peka olayioni le Remalia meshomo aagilunore Yuda.

English: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yotan etua anaa loo menye, nenukari ninye tenebo loo menye, tiatua enkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Ahas olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oopishana le nkitoria e Peka olayioni le Remalia neiteru Ahas olayioni le Yotan, olaiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD his God, like David his father.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa Ahas pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem. Neitu ninye eas mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai enye, anaa apa enataasa papaai lenye Daudi.

English: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake eibung'a ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel. Etapejoyie ninye olayioni leye aitaa olasar, te risioroto e ilo minong loo loshon apa ootaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya Isiraeli.

English: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye ilasarri nepejoo enkorropil too wuejitin neeika; o too nchumat oo ldoinyo, o tiabori pooki shani onyori.

English: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
Masaai: Neitoki Resin olaiguanani le Siria o Peka olayioni le Remalia, olaiguanani le Israel aapuonu aaitayunye Yerusalem olarrabal, neman Ahas aang'adu kake eitu emir ninye.

English: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Jews from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nerrinyu olaiguanani le Edom enkanasa e Elat, metaa ene Edom, nearaa iltung'ana le Yuda aitung'uaa enkanasa e Elat; nepuonu iltung'ana le Edom Elat nebik ninche teine o taata.

English: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, saying, I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Israel, which rise up against me.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka Ahas ilkiliku Tiglat-pilesa olaiguanani le Asiria, ejo, “Ara nanu osinka lino, nara olayioni lino. Wou tokorduaki nanu too nkaik o laiguanani le Siria o too nkaik o laiguanani le Israel, amu aatarasakitia ninche.”

English: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Ahas adumu enkosholai o sahabu pooki natii enkaji o Laitoriani o atua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani, neirriwaa anaa enkishooroto aisho olaiguanani le Asiria.

English: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
Masaai: Nening olaiguanani le Asiria ninye. Nelo olaiguanani le Asiria agilunore Dameski, neya ninye, neya iltung'ana eararoto te Kiir, near Resin metua.

English: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elo olaiguanani Ahas Dameski atumore Tiglat-pilesa olaiguanani le Asiria, nelo ninye olperere lo lasar otii Dameski. Neirriwaki olaiguanani olapolosani oji Uria empukunoto eilo perere lo lasar, o enkitobirunoto enye, o mbaa enyena pooki.

English: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
Masaai: Neshetu ilo apolosani oji Uria olperere lo lasar oikununo anaa ilo, te risioroto e nena pooki naairriwaka ninye olaiguanani Ahas te Dameski, neaku eitobira olapolosani Uria ina, eton eitu ebau olaiguanani Ahas te Dameski.

English: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
Masaai: Ore ake pee errinyunye olaiguanani te Dameski nelo aing'or ilo perere lo lasar. Neitoki olaiguanani anyikaki ilo perere lo lasar. nelo aked shumata enye,

English: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
Masaai: nepejoo ilasarri lenyena o lasarri le ntapa, nebukoki olasar opikuni, neisuaki osarge lenye lo lasar le seriani enchumata eilo perere lo lasar le seriani.

English: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before the LORD, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of the LORD, and put it on the north side of the altar.
Masaai: Ore ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai apa otii dukuya Olaitoriani, neiwuang'ie ninye te dukuya enkaji, teine wueji e rishata olperere lenye lo lasar o enkaji o Laitoriani, nelo apik enkalo e moikuape eilo perere lenye lo lasar.

English: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king's burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Ahas Uria, ilo apolosani, ejo, “Ore te nchumata eilo perere kitok lo lasar, entapejoi olasar le nkakenya opejori, o lasar teipa le ntapa opejori, o lasar lo laiguanani opejori, o lasar lenye le ntapa, o lasar opejori loo ltung'ana pooki leina kop, o lasar lenye le ntapa, o lasar lenye ooki, nisuakiki shumata ninye osarge pooki lo lasar opejori, o sarge pooki lo lasar, kake ore ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai naa nanu ake olo aikilikuanishore.

English: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
Masaai: Neas Uria ilo apolosani nena pooki anaa enaitanapa olaiguanani Ahas ninye.

English: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
Masaai: Nedung olaiguanani nena kitotoneta enkitashoto, neiwuang'ie ilo moti oitukuoreki aitung'uaa ninche, neiwuang'ie ilo moti le nkare aitung'uaa lelo mong'i ooitobiruno to suyai apa ootii tiabori, neiteleiki ninye isoito.

English: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king's entry without, turned he from the house of the LORD for the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Ore ine wueji apa neitobiraki te nkaraki sabato, tiatua enkaji o laiguanani, oina kishomi e auluo o laiguanani, neiwuang'ie ninye tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, te nkaraki ilo aiguanani le Asiria.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Ahas naataasa eigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Ahas etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari ninye tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi; neitoreisho Hesekia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oare le nkitoria e Ahas olaiguanani le Yuda, neiteru Hosea olayioni le Elan aitoreisho te Samaria, neitore ninye Isiraeli. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin ooudo.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake eitu sii etiu anaa ilaiguanak le Israel apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

English: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
Masaai: Nelotu Shalmanesa olaiguanani le Asiria agilunore ninye. Neaku Hoshea osinka lenye, nelaaki ninye kodi.

English: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
Masaai: Kake enoto apa olaiguanani le Asiria enkitang'oroto te Hoshea; amu eirriwaka apa ninye ilkiliku Soo, olaiguanani le Misiri, neitu eitoki alaaki ninye kodi anaa apa enataasa too larin oo tulusoitie. Ore enkaraki ina neikenoo olaiguanani le Asiria ninye, neen tiatua korokoroni.

English: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Samaria aibung ina kop pooki, nelotu Samaria, ore too larin okuni, neman Samaria agadu.

English: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
Masaai: Ore to lari lioudo le nkitoria e Hoshea, neibung olaiguanani le Asiria Samaria, neya Isiraeli ootii Asiria nepik ninche enkanasa e Hala o embata olkeju le Habo, o olkeju le Gosan, o atua nkanas oo Lmedi.

English: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
Masaai: Netiu neijia, amu etaasa apa iltung'ana le Israel eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninye oitayio ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, neitupuku te nkaina e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri. Eteserema ninche kulie aitin,

English: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
Masaai: neibung olkerreti le lelo oreren apa ootarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel, neibung lelo kerreti ooiteng'enishote ilaiguanak le Israel.

English: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
Masaai: Negolong'aki iltung'ana le Israel too nkisudorot mbaa torrok naaiba Olaitoriani Enkai enye, neas mbaa torrok. Eteshetakita ninche ate iwuejitin neeika too nkang'itie enye pooki, ebaiki oltalet ometabaiki enkanasa nasheta isunta.

English: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
Masaai: Etipikakitia ninche ate ing'apeta o Asherim te pooki doinyo naado, o tiabori pooki shani onyori.

English: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
Masaai: Ore teine nepuo aapejoo enkorropil too wuejitin pooki neeika anaa apa enataasa lelo oshon ooiwuang'ie Olaitoriani te dukuya ninche. Neas ninche mbaa torrok neitagor Olaitoriani.

English: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
Masaai: Neisiaai naa ninche nkitanyaanyukot naa ninche apa etiaakinye Olaitoriani ninche, “Emiaas intae ena.”

English: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eikoo apa Olaitoriani Israel o Yuda te pooki oiboni le Nkai, o te pooki aduaani, ejo, “Embelekenyata entapaash nkoitoi inyi torrok, nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei, o nkikoot aainei, te risioroto e nena kitanapat apa naitanapa loo papaai linyi, o nena nairriwaka intae too sinkan laaainei, lelo oiboonok le Nkai.”

English: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening, kake etogolong'akita anaa apa loo menye, amu eitu apa eiruk Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
Masaai: Etemenaitie ninche nkikoot enyena, oilo sotua lenye apa oitobira o loo menye o nena kikoot naaishoo ninye ninche. Eshomo ninche aasujaa nkitanyaanyukot neme Enkai, neaku ilootapong'ori, neibung ninche olkerreti le lelo oshon oomanita ninche, laa ninche apa eitanapa Olaitoriani nchere pee metiu anaa ninche.

English: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
Masaai: Nepaash ninche nkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitobiraki ate nkitanyaanyukot naasholuno oo lasho oare, neitobir Asherim, neserem olorora pooki le shumata, neisiaai Baal.

English: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
Masaai: Nepejoo ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye anaa ilasarri, neasishore ninche enaibon o esakutore, nemir ate pee etum aataas entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitagor ninye.

English: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etagorokine Olaitoriani Isiraeli oleng, neiwuang'ie ninche te dukuya ninche; eitu eing'uari toki meteleku olosho le Yuda ake.

English: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
Masaai: Eitu apa sii ninye eibung Yuda nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai enye, kake eibung'a ilo kerreti apa oiteng'en Isiraeli ninche.

English: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
Masaai: Neany Olaitoriani eishoi e Israel pooki, nepik ninche osina, nepik ninche atua nkaik oo lainyalak, ometaba anaa nenang'aa ninche aiwuang'ie te dukuya enye.

English: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aiwuang'ie Isiraeli te nkaji e Daudi, neitaa ninche Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat olaiguanani. Nerikoo Yeroboam Isiraeli aitapaash esujata o Laitoriani, nerikoki ninche metaasa eng'oki sapuk.

English: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
Masaai: Eturubare iltung'ana le Israel nena ng'ok pooki apa naataasa Yeroboam. Eitu ninche epaash nena ng'ok,

English: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
Masaai: ometaba anaa neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani Isiraeli too nkonyek enyena, anaa apa enairoro aimunye isinkan lenyena lelo oibonok le Nkai. Neaku eshomo Isiraeli eararoto, neing'uaa enkop enye maate nepuo Asiria, netoni teine ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
Masaai: Neyau olaiguanani le Asiria iltung'ana ooing'uaa Babilon, Kuta, o Afa, o Hamat, o Shefafaim, nepik ninche nkanas e Samaria, terishata oo ltung'ana le Israel. Neya ninche Samaria nebik too nkanas enyena.

English: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto e manyisho enye teine, neitu ninche eureyu Olaitoriani ore enkaraki ina neirriwaki Olaitoriani ilng'atunyo atua ninche, neinos lelo ng'atunyo kulikae lenye.

English: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
Masaai: Nelikini olaiguanani le Asiria aajoki, “Ore lelo oshon apa liwa te araroto nilo apik nkanas e Asiria, meyiolo ninche nkitanapat e Nkai eina kop. Ore enkaraki ina eirriwayie ninye ilng'atunyo atua ninche, naa ng'ura, earita ninche iltung'ana metuata. Amu meyiolo ninche nkitanapata e Nkai eina kop.”

English: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Asiria aitanapisho ajo, “Erriwai ine obo loo lapolosak apa litaaraitie ninchosho ninye meshomo abik teine; pee eiteng'enisho nkitanapat e Nkai eina kop.”

English: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo obo le lelo apolosak apa ootaarayioki te Samaria nelotu abik te Betel, neiteng'en ninche eneiko teneureyu Olaitoriani.

English: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
Masaai: Kake meetae apa olosho lemeitobir nkaitin enye maate, nepik ninche nkajijik oo wuejitin neeika apa naaitobira ltung'ana le Samaria, nepik ake olosho nena anas apa naabikie ninche.

English: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Babilon neitobir Sukot-be-not. Ore iltung'ana le Kut, neitobir Nergal, ore iltung'ana le Hamat, neitobir Ashima.

English: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Efrit neitayu Nibas o Tarka; ore iltung'ana le Sefafit nenukaa nkera enye tenkaraki Adramalek o Anamelek nena aitin e Shefafaim.

English: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
Masaai: Etureita sii apa ninche Olaitoriani, negelaki ate mpukunot pooki oo ltung'ana aaitaa ilapolosak loo wuejitin neeika, pee eitayu ilasarri too wuejitin neeika.

English: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
Masaai: Neaku etureita ninche Olaitoriani kake eisiaayia sii nkaitin enye maate, aasujaa orrekie le lelo oshon apa oo tarayioki aaya eararoto tenebo ninche.

English: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ena olong neas ninche ilo rrekie apake. Meure ninche Olaitoriani, nemerubare ninche nkikoot anaa nkiguanat, anaa nkitanapat apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani nkera e Yakobo laa ninye apa etejoki Israel.

English: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
Masaai: Eitobira apa Olaitoriani olning'o lo sotua o ninche, neitanap ninche ajoki, “Miureyuyu intae kulie aitin, nimirrugokinono ninche anaa isiaayiayia ninche, anaa ipolosakiki ninche.

English: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
Masaai: Kake Olaitoriani entureita laa ninye apa oyawua intae aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, te ngolon kitok, o te nkaina naitoriori. Ninye errugokinoto, naa ninye entopolosaki.

English: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
Masaai: Ore nena kikoot o nkiguenat, oina kitanapata apa naigeroki intae, entaas entobiraki. Miureyuyu intae kulie aitin.

English: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
Masaai: Niminchosho erikino intae osotua lai apa laitobiraka intae. Miureyuyu intae kulie aitin.

English: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
Masaai: Kake entureita Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, naa kekordu ninye intae aitupuku too nkaik oo lmang'ati linyi.”

English: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, mening'isho ninche, kake etaasa ninche te risioroto olkerreti lenye liopa.

English: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children's children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku eteserema apa kulo oshon neisiaai sii nkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot naaguetuno, neijia sii eikununo nkera enye, o nkera oo nkera enye. Ore apa enataasa loo menye, neas sii ninche ina ometabaiki ena olong.

English: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.
Masaai: Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria e Hoshea olayioni le Ela, ilo aiguanani le Israel, neiteru Hesekia olayioni le Ahas ilo aiguanani le Yuda aitoreisho.

English: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho. Neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam ooudo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Abi entito e Sekaria.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa Daudi papaai lenye.

English: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie ninye iwuejitin neeika, neuroo ing'apeta, nedung Asherim. Nebel aitaa mbelibelat ilo asurai apa lo suyai oitobira Musa, amu ore ebaiki nena olong'i kepejoo apa iltung'ana le Israel enkorropil teine. Keji apa ine Nehushatan.

English: He trusted in the LORD God of Israel; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah, nor any that were before him.
Masaai: Eisiliga apa ninye Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli; neaku meetae oltung'ani oikununo anaa ninye too laiguanak pooki le Yuda te siadi ninye, anaa te lelo apa ootii te dukuya ninye.

English: For he clave to the LORD, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.
Masaai: Eiruko apa ninye Olaitoriani, eitu epaash esujata enye, kake eibung'a nena kitanapat apa naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa.

English: And the LORD was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
Masaai: Netii apa Olaitoriani tenebo ninye, ore pooki wueji neshomo, ninye nedupoyu. Etapong'ori ninye olaiguanani le Asiria neany eisiaai ninye.

English: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
Masaai: Etaara apa ninye Ilfilisti ebaiki Gasa o metabaiki ilpolosien lenyena, o ebaiki oltalet ometabaiki enkanasa nasheta isunta.

English: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan le nkitoria e Hesekia, laa ninye olari liopishana le nkitoria e Hosea olayioni le Ela, ilo aiguanani le Israel nelotu Shalamanesa olaiguanani le Asiria agilunore Samaria neman ninye ang'adu.

English: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto oo larin okuni neya ninye. Ore to lari le ile le nkitoria e Hesekia laa ninye olioudo le nkitoria e Hoshea, olaiguanani le Israel, neyai Samaria.

English: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
Masaai: Eewa apa olaiguanani le Asiria Isiraeli eararoto te Asiria, nelo apik ninche atua Hala, nepik embata olkeju le Gosam, o atua nkanas oo Lmedi,

English: Because they obeyed not the voice of the LORD their God, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
Masaai: enkaraki neitu ninche ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, kake etogolong'akita ilo sotua, o nena sii pooki apa naaitanapishe Musa osinka lo Laitoriani, neitu ening anaa eibung.

English: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah, and took them.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oo ong'uan le nkitoria o laiguanani Hesekia, nelotu Senakerib olaiguanani le Asiria agilunore nkanas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda, neya ninche.

English: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which thou puttest on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda olkilikuai olaiguanani le Asiria te Lakish, ejo, “Ataasa nanu entorroni; tapalaki nanu, naa ore pooki toki nikintelekiki nanu naa kanap.” Ore apa entoki nayieu olaiguanani le Asiria to laiguanani le Yuda naa talanta iip uni e nkosholai, o talanta tomoni uni e sahabu.

English: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king's house.
Masaai: Neisho Hesekia ninye enkosholai pooki apa nanotoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o tiatua ilchumat le nkaji o laiguanani.

English: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the LORD, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nekinyu Hesekia sahabu pooki too nkutukie oo nkajijik e nkaji o Laitoriani, o ntaloishin oo nkutukie oo nkajijik apa naatumura Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, neisho olaiguanani le Asiria.

English: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller's field.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani le Asiria Tatan le Rabsari, o Rabshake eeta enjore kitok, naing'uaa Lakish pee erasaki Hesekia te Yerusalem. Ore ake pee ebau nepuonu aaitashe tembata olchorro le shumata, otii enkoitoi oo laitobirak loo nkilani.

English: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eipotu olaiguanani neipang'aki ninche Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia, laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, o Shebna laa ninye apa olasirani, o Yoa olayioni le Asaf ilo aigeroni.

English: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
Masaai: Nejoki Rabshake ninche, “Entiaaki Hesekia, ‘Nji ejo olaiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria: ‘Kainyoo iyie ingarakino?

English: Thou sayest, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
Masaai: Eijo doi kiaku irorei ake engolon to larrabal? Kaing'ae taata iyie ingarakino, peyie kitogolong'aka nanu?

English: Now, behold, thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
Masaai: Ng'ura ajo Misiri iyie ingarakino, ilo peresi otigile, orem enkaina e pooki tung'ana ooingarakino. Neijia etiu Farao olaiguanani le Misiri te pooki tung'ani oigarakino ninye.

English: But if ye say unto me, We trust in the LORD our God: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
Masaai: Kake tenikijoki iyie nanu, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang kingarakino iyiook” aime ilo eiwuang'ie Hesekia iwuejitin enyena neeika, ejoki Yuda, o Yerusalem, “Te dukuya ele perere lo lasar intae enteseremisho te Yerusalem?”

English: Now therefore, I pray thee, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
Masaai: Wootu taata matoning'oto o lkitok lai olaiguanani le Asiria: Kaaisho nanu iyie mbartan iip are; tenindim iyie te nkalo ino atipika ilakedok shumata ninche.

English: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
Masaai: Kaji naa iyie inko tenintasheikinore obo ninye le lelo aisiaayiak ooti lo lkitok lai aa Misiri ingarakino too ngarrin oo mbartan o too mbartan?

English: Am I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
Masaai: Amaa ake sii, aijo ke nkaraki nemetii Olaitoriani pee aewuo nanu agilunore ena kop naidaikie ninye? Aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, shomo tigilunore ene wueji, nindaikie.’ ”

English: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, to thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Jews' language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia, o Shebna o Yoa, aajoki Rabshake, “Kitoomono iyie, irorei isinkan linono te nkutuk e Aramea, amu ninye kiyiolo. Mintoki airorie iyiook te nkutuk e Yuda metoning'o iltung'ana ootii esuntai.”

English: But Rabshakeh said unto them, Hath my master sent me to thy master, and to thee, to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Rebshake ninche, “Aatiaaka olkitok lai pee aliki kulo rorei olkitok linyi, o ntae, neme lelo tung'ana ootii esuntai, ootaa ore tenebo intae, keinos nkik enye maate neok nkulak enye?”

English: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
Masaai: Neitoki Rabshake aitashe nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk, te nkutuk e Yuda, ajo, “Entoning irorei lo laiguanani kitok, olaiguanani le Asiria!

English: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
Masaai: Nji ejo olaiguanani: ‘Emincho Hesekia meteleja intae, amu meidim ninye aitajeu intae te nkaina ai.

English: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Emincho Hesekia ejoki intae eji pee ingarakinono Olaitoriani ejo, ‘Ekesipa kekordu iyiook Olaitoriani, nemeishoori ena anasa aapik nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.’

English: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat ye every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern:
Masaai: Emining intae Hesekia, amu nji ejo olaiguanani le Asiria; ‘Ntobira olning'o o nanu, nilotu enatii; ore pooki ng'ae te intae, neinos enkurma enye oo sabibu, neinos pooki ng'ae ilng'anayio lo lng'aboli lenye; neok pooki ng'ae enkare olchorro lenye;

English: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that ye may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, The LORD will deliver us.
Masaai: ometaba anaa narik entae enkop naikununo anaa enkop inyi, enkop e ntapa o enaisho oo sabibu, enkop oo mukateni o nkurman oo sabibu. Enkop oo loirienito o enaisho, pee ipuopuo aapok, nimiyeye. Nimining'ining'i Hesekia teneitapong'oo intae, ejo, “kekordu iyiook Olaitoriani.

English: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
Masaai: Keetae aekata enkai oo loreren naitajeuo enkop enye te nkaina o laiguanani le Asiria?

English: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand?
Masaai: Koree nkaitin e Hamat o Arpad? Koree nkaitin e Sefarfaim, Hena o Ifaa? Ketokordutua ninche Samaria aaitupuku tiae aina hoo nabo?

English: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of mine hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand?
Masaai: Kaa tiatua nkaitin oo nkuapi, natokordua nkuapi enye aitupuku te nkaina ai, eji metaa kekordu Olaitoriani Yerusalem aitupuku te nkaina ai?’ ”

English: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
Masaai: Kake etigirate iltung'ana neitu ewaliki ninye olomoni hoo obo; amu ore apa enkitanapata o laiguanani naa, “Kejo emiwaliki ninye.”

English: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
Masaai: Ore Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, o Shebna, ilo aigeroko, o Yoa olayioni le Asaf ilo asirani, nepuonu enetii Hesekia etopolosa nkilani enye, neliki ninche ninye lelo rorei le Rabshake.

English: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Hesekia ina, nepolos nkilani enyena neimulumul kewan too lkuniyiani nelo atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye Eliakim, laa ninye apa oitasheiki enkaji e nkitoo, o Shebna ilo aigeroni, o lapolosak kituaak ooimulumula ate too kuniyiani, neirriwaki ninche Isaya olayioni le Amos.

English: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nji ejo Hesekia, ‘Ore ena olong naa enkolong o sina, enkolong e nkisikong'ata naa enkolong e sulare, etoiwuoki nkera nemeeta ninche engolon nabulunye.

English: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.
Masaai: Ebaiki netoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino lelo rorei pooki le Rabshake, laa ninye eirriwua olkitok lenye ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu amor Enkai naishu. Keisikong Enkai ninye tenkaraki lelo rorei ootoning'o. Ore naa taata ilepie enkomono tenkaraki ilo pisiai otelekua.”

English: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu isinkan lo laiguanani Hesekia enetii Isaya,

English: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say to your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words which thou hast heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Masaai: nejoki Isaya ninche, “Entiaaki olkitok linyi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Miureishoyu tenkaraki lelo rorei litoning'o, laa ninche aatusukenyie nanu isinkan leilo aiguanani le Asiria.

English: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
Masaai: Ng'ura kapik nanu ninye oltau lo lkirutoto oitoning olkukui, nerrinyo alo enkop enye makewan, naisho nanu metabatatayu to lalem tiatua enkop enye makewan.’ ”

English: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Rabshake neinepu olaiguanani le Asiria earare Libna; amu etoning'o ninye nchere etung'uayie olaiguanani Lakish.

English: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against thee: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani nchere etudumunye Tihaka olaiguanani le Etiopia, alotu aarare ninche, neirriwaki ilkiliku arewaki Hesekia ejo,

English: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Masaai: “Nji enchom entiaki Hesekia, olaiguanani le Yuda, ‘Mincho kilej ina Ai nisiligita tenikisiligie ninye iyie nchere meyae Yerusalem aapik nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.

English: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shalt thou be delivered?
Masaai: Ng'ura itoning'o iyie enaitaasa ilaiguanak le Asiria nkuapi pooki, eidaike ninche katukul. Paa ijo iyie eikikorduni?

English: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
Masaai: Amaa nena aitin oo loreren ketokordutua ninche, lelo oshon apa ooidaikie loo papa, Gosan, o Haran, o Resef o ltung'ana le Eden apa ootii Telasa?

English: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?
Masaai: Koree olaiguanani le Hamat, o laiguanani le Arpad, o laiguanani le nkanasa e Sefarfaim o laiguanani le Hena, anaa olaiguanani le Ifaa?’ ”

English: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Hesekia ina palai too nkaik e lelo kiliku, neisuma; neilep Hesekia alo enkaji o Laitoriani, neisalaash ina palai te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, O LORD God of Israel, which dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; thou hast made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Neomon Hesekia te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, iton iyie to lorika le nkitoo te shumata ilkerubi. Ira iyie Enkai, naa iyie ake Enkai, tiatua nkitoriat pooki e nkop. Iyie oitobira keper o enkop.

English: LORD, bow down thine ear, and hear: open, LORD, thine eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent him to reproach the living God.
Masaai: Irrugu enkiok ino Olaitoriani toning'o, tabolo nkonyek inono, Olaitoriani toduaa, nining kulo rorei le Senakerib, ooirriwua ninye pee elotu amor Enkai naishu.

English: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
Masaai: Esipata, Olaitoriani, nchere eitomijoono ilaiguanak le Asiria iloreren o nkuapi enye,

English: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
Masaai: nenang'aki nkaitin enye atua enkima; amu mme nkaitin apa ninche, kake esiaai oo nkaik e tung'ani oo nkeek o soito. Ore enkaraki ina eidaikieki ninche.

English: Now therefore, O LORD our God, I beseech thee, save thou us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD God, even thou only.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, ntajeu iyiook, aatasayia, ntung'uai iyiook enkaina enye, pee etum nkitoriat pooki e nkop aatayiolo nchere, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie ake Enkai.”

English: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya olayioni le Amos airriwaki Hesekia olkilikuai ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli: ore ina omono nikitoomono te nkaraki Senakerib olaiguanani le Asiria, atoning'o nanu.

English: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
Masaai: Ele rorei eiroro Olaitoriani oipirta ninye: “Kitemenayie ninye iyie, kitusurdaanya ninye iyie na tito e Sion; eipirripir endukuya enye te siadi iyie; na tito e Yerusalem.

English: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: “Kaing'ae doi ilo litamoro nisurdaany? Kaing'ae ilo lidumaki oltoilo lino, nishumaki nkonyek inono to lwuasa? Ilo osinya le Israel!

English: By thy messengers thou hast reproached the Lord, and hast said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.
Masaai: Ore te lelo kiliku linono nitamoro Olaitoriani, nitejo iyie, ‘Ore te nkumoi oo ngarrin aainei oo mbartan, ailepa nanu alo nchumat oo ldoinyo, o mashomo atua Lebanon, atuuroyie nanu iltarakua lenyena adoru aaisul, o lelo keek lenyena gelunot; atijing'a nanu atua nalo atua ina tim enye nagol.

English: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
Masaai: Atuturuo ilchorroi naok nkariak enkop eeiking'a, naaituny nanu too nkejek aainei nchorroi pooki neelepo e Misiri.”

English: Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.
Masaai: “Keitu aekata iyie ining ajo aitobira apa ina te musano? Aitobira apa nanu moitie ena taata nalo aitabaya, nchere ore nkanas naasheta isunta naa ilo aitaa osototi loo suut.

English: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
Masaai: Meeta apa lelo oomanya engolon, neiputukunyo neidang, etotiutuo ninche anaa nkaitubulu e ong'ota, o anaa nkujit naanana, etotiutuo anaa nkujit naabulu too nchumat oo nkajijik, te nekut olkutati eton eitu ebulu.

English: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
Masaai: “Kake ayiolo nanu oltonei lino, o enkipang'ata ino o enjing'unoto ino, oina nikigilunore iyie nanu.

English: Because thy rage against me and thy tumult is come up into mine ears, therefore I will put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nikitigilunore iyie nanu, netabaikia enkitokoos ino nkiyiaa aainei, kapik nanu olalae lai oololo enkume ino, napik olgisoi lai enkutuk ino, naarriny nanu iyie aing'orie ina oitoi niimua.

English: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
Masaai: “Naa ena nalo aaku olmonekie te intae: ore tele ari, ninosinoso intae nena naabulu oopeny, ore to lari liare ninosinoso nena ake ore to lari liokuni, niunuunu nisampumpu, niunuunu isabibu, ninosinoso ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
Masaai: Ore ilo pisiai oleku le nkaji e Yuda neitoki aibung ntona, neiu ilng'anayio.

English: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
Masaai: Amu te Yerusalem epuku ilo pisiai, naa to ldoinyo le Sion epuku olturrur le lelo ooleku. Olom lo Laitoriani olo aas ena.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo olaiguanani le Asiria, melotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, anaa engoroo embae teine, anaa elotu ataanikini ninye eeta elong'o, anaa elotu aman ang'adu.

English: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina oitoi apa naimua ninye, ina ake eitoki aim arrinyo, nemelotu ninye ena anasa, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For I will defend this city, to save it, for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
Masaai: Amu kamitu nanu ena anasa aitajeu tenkaraki kewan ai o tenkaraki o sinka lai Daudi.”

English: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of the LORD went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
Masaai: Ore ina kewarie nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani aar metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o ntomoni isiet o imiet too lng'oborri le Asiria: ore ake pee einyototo iltung'ana tadekenya, ng'ura etuata kulo pooki.

English: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
Masaai: Nedumunye taa Senakerib olaiguanani le Asiria alo ang, nelo abik te Ninawi.

English: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore eseremisho ninye tiatua enkaji e Nisrok, ina ai enye, near Adramelek o Sheresa, lelo ayiok lenyena ninye to lalem, neisik aapuo enkop e Ararat. Neitoreisho Esarhadon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order; for thou shalt die, and not live.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, etamuoyia Hesekia ometaa kejo pee eye. Nelotu Isaya, ilo oiboni le Nkai enetii ninye, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ntobira mbaa olmarei lino, amu iye iyie, minchiu iyie.’ ”

English: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Neibelekenya Hesekia aing'orie enkomom enye esuntai neomon Olaitoriani ejo,

English: I beseech thee, O LORD, remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
Masaai: “Tadamu taata Olaitoriani, aatasayia iyie, ina nashomo nanu te dukuya iyie too sipat, o to ltau pooki, nataasa nanu mbaa sidain too nkonyek inono.” Neishir Hesekia te mion.

English: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of the LORD came to him, saying,
Masaai: Ore eton eitu elo Isaya aipang to lgoriet le polos, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii nejoki,

English: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will heal thee: on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the LORD.
Masaai: “Torrinyoyu, nilo ajoki Hesekia, ilo kitok loo ltung'ana laainei, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Daudi papaai lino: Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino. Atoduaa nanu ilkiyio linono; ng'ura kaaishiunye nanu iyie; ore te nkolong e uni, naa ilep iyie alo enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And I will add unto thy days fifteen years; and I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
Masaai: Naa kaponaa nanu ilarin tomon o imiet te nkishui ino. Kaakordu nanu iyie o ena anasa aitayu te nkaina o laiguanani le Asiria, naa kamitu nanu ena anasa te nkaraki kewan ai, o tenkaraki o sinka lai Daudi.’ ”

English: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
Masaai: Nejo Isaya, “Iyau emukate oo lng'abolo, naa o nchoo epuo ninche aaiteleiki oltudutai, pee etum ninye aishiu.”

English: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of the LORD the third day?
Masaai: Nejoki Hesekia Isaya, “Kainyoo enkitodolunoto nchere kaaishiunye nanu Olaitoriani, naa kayooki nanu alo enkaji o Laitoriani te nkolong e uni?”

English: And Isaiah said, This sign shalt thou have of the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he hath spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?
Masaai: Nejoki Isaya ninye, “Ele olmonekie te iyie oing'uaa Olaitoriani, nchere keas Olaitoriani ina toki naisiligishore ninye. Kelo oloip dukuya iroruat tomon anaa errinyo siadi iroruat tomon?”

English: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
Masaai: Newalu Hesekia ajo, “Kelelek pee eadoru oloip alo iroruat tomon alang tenerrinyo siadi iroruat tomon.”

English: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
Masaai: Neishiraki Isaya ilo oiboni le Nkai Olaitoriani, nerrinyunye oloip siadi iroruat tomon, nerrinyo enkolong aipirakinore enkoitoi o sagam le Ahas.

English: At that time Berodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata, neirriwaa Merodak-baladan olayioni le Bat-adam, ilo aiguanani le Babilon ilkiliku ooyautua mpala o enkishoroto enetii Hesekia, amu etoning'o apa ninye ajo etamuoyia Hesekia.

English: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
Masaai: Neitoomon Hesekia ninche, neitodol ninche ilchumat pooki le nkaji enye, ina osholai, o sahabu o enkorropil, o eilata nagol enkinyiang'a o ewueji enye oo masaa o larrabal, o nena pooki apa naatii nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki. Meetae apa entoki natii atua enkaji enye, anaa pooki toki e nkitoria enye neitu eitodol Hesekia ninche.

English: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ilo oiboni le Nkai alotu enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kaa etejo kulo tung'ana? Naa kanu eetuo ninche enitii?” Nejo Hesekia, “Enkop nalakua eing'uaa ninche, Babilon eing'uaa ninche.”
