English: And he said, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki olaiguanani, “Kainyoo ninche etoduaa te nkaji ino?” Newalu Hesekia ajo, “Etoduaa ninche nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ai. Meetae entoki tiatua nena ajijik aainei naashumishoreki neitu nanu aitodol ninche.”

English: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ajoki Hesekia, “Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani:

English: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house,and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, ore nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ino, o nena apa naatushuma loo papaai lino o metabaiki ena olong, naa kenapi aaya Babilon; meing'uari toki, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Ore embata oo layiok linono makewan likitoikioki iyie, neyai sii ninche naa kepuo aaku isunaishi oogelema tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Babilon.”

English: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia ajoki Isaya, “Ore ilo rorei lo Laitoriani liroro naa aisidai. Neijia etiu, eetae eseriani o enkitirring'a too nkolong'i aainei.”

English: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Hesekia o enkidimata enye pooki, o ilo shorro oitobira ninye, o ewueji neimieki enkare, neyau enkare atua enkanasa, neigeroki pooki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Hesekia etua anaa apa loo menye; neitoreisho Manase olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hephzibah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomon oare apa Manase pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin onom o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Hefasiba.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, after the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto eilo minong apa oasita lelo oreren ootaarayie Olaitoriani te dukuya iloshon loo Siraeli.

English: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Israel; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
Masaai: Amu enyaaka apa ninye ashet iwuejitin neeika apa naaidaikie papaai lenye Hesekia, neshetaki Baal ilpereren loo lasarri, neitobir ashera, anaa apa enataasa Ahab olaiguanani le Israel. Neserem ninye olorora pooki le keper neisiaai ninche.

English: And he built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye ilpereren loo lasarri tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, laa ninche apa etejo Olaitoriani, “Atua Yerusalem nanu alo apik enkarna ai.”

English: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye ilpereren loo lasarri ashetaki olorora pooki le keper, too lgorieti pokira oare le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
Masaai: Nepejoo olayioni lenye anaa olasar, neas ninye mbaa e naibon o easata oo mbaa e nking'asia. Neasishore ninye ilaitumusumusok o lasakutok. Etaasa ninye mbaa kumok torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neitagor ninye.

English: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which the LORD said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
Masaai: Ore ina kitanyaanyukoto e Ashera apa naitobira ninye nepik ninye atua ina aji natiaaka Olaitoriani Daudi, o Solomon olayioni lenye, “Atua ena aji o atua Yerusalem naa ninche nanu ategelua too loshon pooki loo Siraeli, nchere kapik nanu enkarna ai ntarasi.

English: Neither will I make the feet of Israel move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
Masaai: Nemaitoki nanu aisho nkejek oo ltung'ana laainei loo Siraeli menyaaki aalimana, aapuku teina kop apa naishoo loo menye. Oi ake duoo ninche easisho te risioroto e nena pooki naitanapa ninche, o te risioroto eina kitanapata pooki naitanapa osinka lai Musa ninche.”

English: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening'isho nelejaki Manase ninche metaasa ntorrok aaitulus te lelo oreren apa ooidaikie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: And the LORD spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani eimunye lelo sinkan lenyena, lelo oibonok le Nkai,

English: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations, and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki nataasa Manase, olaiguanani le Yuda, ele minong, netaasa mbaa torrok aitulus nena oo Lamori, apa laa ninche ootii te dukuya ninye, nerikoki Yuda metaasa eng'oki te nena kitanyaanyukot enyena;

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.
Masaai: ore naa enkaraki ina, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ng'ura, kayau nanu shumata Yerusalem o Yuda, entorroni naikununo neijia naa ore ake nkiyiaa pooki naaning neng'eyu.

English: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
Masaai: Naa kalo nanu aitorioo te shumata Yerusalem olkereri le ntemat le Samaria, o latemani lo nkitorioroto le nkaji e Ahab, naa kajut nanu Yerusalem anaa enajut oltung'ani engirra najutu ninche aiwuang'ie naibelekenyu atua aing'orie oriong,

English: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
Masaai: naa kaiturraa nanu ilo pisiai le njung'ore ai, naishooyo nanu apik ninche atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, neaku ninche eararoto too lmang'ati lenye pooki.

English: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight,and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki nataasa ninche mbaa torrok too nkonyek aainei naaitagoro ninche nanu, ebaiki ina olong apa naitupukutuo loo menye te Misiri o metabaiki ena olong.”

English: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eibukoyie Manase osarge sapuk oleng lemeeta entioto, omeiputa Yerusalem ebaiki enchoto nabo ometabaiki enkae shoto. Eeta ake sii eng'oki eina apa natorikoko Yuda metaasa ing'ok, neaku etaasa mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Manase, o nena pooki naataasa, o ina ng'oki nataasa, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Manase etua tenebo apa loo menye, nenukari ninye te nkurma natii embata e nkaji enye. Tiatua e nkurma e Usa; neitoreisho Amon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o are apa Amon pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oare te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Meshulemet entito e Harus le Yotba.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as his father Manasseh did.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek O laitoriani, anaa enataasa papaai lenye Manase.

English: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
Masaai: Eibung'a ninye orrekie le papaai lenye, neisiaai nena kitanyaanyukot apa naaisiaayia papaai lenye, neserem ninche.

English: And he forsook the LORD God of his fathers, and walked not in the way of the LORD.
Masaai: Etung'uayie ninye Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neitu ninye eibung enkoitoi o Laitoriani.

English: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
Masaai: Nerresh isinkan le Amon ninye, near ilo aiguanani metua te nkaji enye.

English: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
Masaai: Kake etaara apa iltung'ana leina kop lelo tung'ana pooki metuata apa ootarresho olaiguanani Amon, neitaa lelo tung'ana leina kop Yosia ilo ayioni lenye olaiguanani le rishata enye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin pooki e Amon apa naataasa, neigeroki tiatua mbukui oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Nenukari ninye te nkurare enye tiatua enkurma e Usa; neitoreisho Yosia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
Masaai: Oloo larin isiet apa Yosia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomoni uni oobo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Yedida entito e Adaia le Boskat.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neibung orrekie le Daudi papaai lenye, neitu ninye eibelekenya alo enkaina e tatene anaa enkalo e kedienye.

English: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o laiguanani Yosia, neirriwaa olaiguanani Shafan olayioni le Asalia, olayioni le Meshulam, laa ninye olaigeroni le nkaji o Laitoriani, ejo,

English: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
Masaai: “Ilepa shomo enetii Hilkia ilo apolosani kitok, pee etum aigero esiana oo mpisai naayauaki enkaji o Laitoriani, nena naatang'amutua lelo arripok le kishomi too ltung'ana;

English: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,
Masaai: naa nchoo eishori lelo aitasheikinok loo laisiaayiak le nkaji o Laitoriani. Nchoo ninche meishoo lelo aisiaayiak ootii enkaji o Laitoriani, aaram ina aji.

English: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
Masaai: Aa taa ilaguetak loo mbaoi, o lashetak, o lashetak loo soito, neinyiang'unyieki mbaoi neturuni soito pee eitobirieki aaram ina aji.

English: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
Masaai: Kake meikeni nena pisai tialo ninche amu keasisho ninche te nkoitoi naisiligayu.

English: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
Masaai: Nejoki Hilkia ilo apolosani kitok Shefat olaigeroni, “Anoto nanu embuku oo nkitanapat tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.” Neisho Hilkia ina buku Shafan, neisum ninye.

English: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Thy servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nelotu Shafan ilo aigeroni enetii olaiguanani, neliki olaiguanani ajoki, “Eitayutuo isinkan linono nena pisai naanotoki tiatua enkaji, newaita ninche aapik nkaik e lelo aisiaayiak ooitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Shafan ilo aigeroni ajoki olaiguanani, “Aaishoo nanu Hilkia olapolosani embuku.” Neisum Shafan ina buku te dukuya olaiguanani.

English: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani irorei leina buku oo nkitanapat, nepolos nkilani enyena.

English: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king's, saying,
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Hilkia ilo apolosani, o Ahikam olayioni le Shafan o Akobor olayioni le Mikaia, o Shafan olaigeroni, o Asaiya osinka lo laiguanani ejo,

English: Go ye, enquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
Masaai: “Enchom enkilikuanishore Olaitoriani te nkaraki nanu, o te nkaraki olorere, o te nkaraki Yuda pooki, tialo rorei ootii ena buku nanotoki, amu aikitok engoro o Laitoriani nayupuyupo te nkaraki iyiook, enkaraki neitu eibung iloo papa irorei lena buku, pee eas nena pooki naaigeroki, naaipirta iyiook.”

English: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
Masaai: Nelo Hilkia ilo apolosani o Ahikam, o Akobor, o Shafan, o Asaya enetii Hulda ina oiboni. Ore apa ina oiboni naa enkitok e Shulam olayioni le Tikfa, olayioni le Harhas. Olaing'urani apa lo sanduku loo nkilani ilo payian le Huda, (naa Yerusalem apa namanya ninche), ina manyisho e are ina kata pee eirorie ninche.

English: And she said unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell the man that sent you to me,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli: ‘Tiaki ilo tung'ani likirriwua enatii,

English: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ene wueji, o shumata lelo oomanya, lelo rorei pooki leina buku ooisuma olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Enkaraki naatung'uaitie ninche nanu, netapejo ninche enkorropil te nkaraki nkulie aitin, pee aatum ninche aaitagoro teina siaai pooki oo nkaik enye. Ore enkaraki ina keyupuyup engoro ai tenkaraki ene wueji, nemeyagaa.

English: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;
Masaai: Kake ore te nkaraki olaiguanani le Yuda, laa ninye likirriwua pee inkilikuanishore Olaitoriani, nji iyie shomo tiaaki ninye, Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel: Ore tialo lelo rorei likitoning'o,

English: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the LORD, when thou heardest what I spake against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and hast rent thy clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: ore enkaraki nairridua oltau lino, nintoborro kewan te dukuya Olaitoriani, ina kata pee ining ajo airoro inaaipirta ene wueji, o lelo oomanya, nchere keaku ninche olmuaate o ldeket, nitopolosa iye nkilani inono ninchir te dukuya nanu. Aatoning'o sii nanu iye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Behold therefore, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered into thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil which I will bring upon this place. And they brought the king word again.
Masaai: Ore naa, ng'ura, kaaya nanu iyie aiturrurroki loo papaai lino apa oo tuata, nilo aiturrurro te nkurare ino te seriani, nemedol nkonyek inono ina torroni nayau nanu ene wueji.’ ” Neyaki ninche olaiguanani ilo rorei.

English: And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa olkilikuai, nepuonu ilpayiani pooki le Yuda o Yerusalem aaiturrurrokino.

English: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neilep olaiguanani alo enkaji o Laitoriani, netii iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem, o lapolosak o loibonok le Nkai, o ltung'ana pooki, ilooti o lkituaak; neisum ninye ening'ito ninche irorei pooki leina buku o sotua apa nanotoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book. And all the people stood to the covenant.
Masaai: Neitashe olaiguanani te mbata oo ng'apeta neitobir olning'o te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee esuj orrekie lo Laitoriani neibung nkitanapat enyena, o enchakenisho enye o nkikoot enyena, to ltau lenye pooki, o te nkishui enye pooki, pee eas irorei leilo ning'o lo sotua ooigero tena buku; neibung'are ltung'ana pooki tenebo ninye teilo ning'o lo sotua.

English: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the door, to bring forth out of the temple of the LORD all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the grove, and for all the host of heaven: and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and carried the ashes of them unto Bethel.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Hilkia ilo apolosani kitok, o lapolosak oosujaki te nkitoo, o laing'urak le kishomi, pee eipang'unyeki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani nena masaa pooki apa naaitobirakaki Baal, o Ashera, o lorora pooki le keper. Nepejoo ninye ninche tiauluo Yerusalem too nkong'at e Kedron, nenap nkuruon enye aaya Betel.

English: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninye lelo apolosak apa ootuputo ilaiguanak le Yuda pee epej enkorropil too wuejitin neeika too nkanas e Yuda naamanita Yerusalem; o kulie sii oopejoki Baal enkorropil, aapejoki enkolong o lapa, o lakir, o lorora pooki le keper.

English: And he brought out the grove from the house of the LORD, without Jerusalem, unto the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and stamped it small to powder, and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people.
Masaai: Neipang'unye ninye ashera aitung'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani, neya auluo Yerusalem, neya oerata le Kedron, nelo apejoo to erata le Kedron, neidong aitaa empunyua neisuaki ina punyua nkuraren oo ltung'ana le setia.

English: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.
Masaai: Negil ninye nkajijik oo lewa le nkisiaayiare e seremare e nkiborra oo nkonyek, apa naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani. Ine apa eripunye nkituaak nkisiong'at e Ashera.

English: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba, and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man's left hand at the gate of the city.
Masaai: Neyau lelo apolosak lenye pooki aitupuku too nkanas e Yuda, neisarkionie ninye wuejitin neeika apa naapejie ilapolosak enkorropil, ebaiki Geba o metabaiki Beer-sheba; neitoki ninye agil auroo nena wuejitin neeika oo nchomito apa naatii enejing'ieki kishomi e Yoshua ilo balusui le nkanasa, apa naatii enkalo e Kedienye teina kishomi e nkanasa.

English: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, eitu epuonu lelo apolosak loo wuejitin neeika aapuonu olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te Yerusalem. Kake einosa ninche imukateni neitu eisuijieki tiatua ilalashera lenye.

English: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.
Masaai: Neisarkionie ninye Tofet, ina natii oerata loo layiok le Hinom, pee meitoki atii hoo obo opejoo olayioni lenye anaa entito enye aitaa olasar oishori Molek.

English: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninye nena bartan naaitisinya ilaiguanak le Yuda te nkaraki eseremata enkolong, te nejing'ieki enkaji o laitoriani, te mbata e nkaji e Natan-Melek, laa ninye olkitok. Etapejoyie apa ninye nena garrin oo mbartan naaseremieki enkolong te nkima.

English: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the LORD, did the king beat down, and brake them down from thence, and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Ore lelo pereren loo lasarri ootii enchumata enkaji e shumata e nkaji e Ahas, apa naaitobira ilaiguanak le Yuda, o lpereren apa ooitobira Manase too lgorieti pokira oare le nkaji o Laitoriani, nesulu ninche aitadou nebel aitaa mbelibelat, nenang'aki ina punyua enye atua oerata le Kedron.

English: And the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mount of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had builded for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of the Moabites, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aisarkionie iwuejitin neeika apa naatii enkalo oloo saen le Yerusalem, o metabaiki kopikop o ldoinyo le ntorroni, naateshetaka apa Solomon olaiguanani le Israeli Ashterot, ilo minong loo le Sidon, neitobiraki sii Kemosh ilo minong loo le Moab, o Milkoni ilo minong loo Lamoni.

English: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
Masaai: Negil ninye aitaa mbelibelat nena ng'apeta, neuroo asulaki enkop Asherim, neiput iwuejitin enye iloik loo ltung'ana.

English: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, both that altar and the high place he brake down, and burned the high place, and stamped it small to powder, and burned the grove.
Masaai: Ore ake sii ilo perere lo lasar apa otii Betel, ine wueji neika apa natesheta Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat, laa ninye otorikoko Isiraeli metaasa eng'oki, ore ilo perere lo lasar tenebo ewueji neika nesulu auroo nebel aitaa mbelibelat isoito lenyena, nerrar aitaa enterit; neitoki sii apejoo Ashera.

English: And as Josiah turned himself, he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount, and sent, and took the bones out of the sepulchres, and burned them upon the altar, and polluted it, according to the word of the LORD which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these words.
Masaai: Ore ejo Yosia eibelekenya, nedol nkuraren teine to ldoinyo, neirriwaa olkilikuai meyauni iloik aaitupuku too nkuraren, nepejoo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar, neisarkionie ninye, te risioroto eilo rorei lo Laitoriani apa otolimuo oltung'ani le Nkai, laa ninye apa otolimuo aibonu kuna baa.

English: Then he said, What title is that that I see? And the men of the city told him, It is the sepulchre of the man of God, which came from Judah, and proclaimed these things that thou hast done against the altar of Bethel.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Kainyoo idia kurare, nadolita nanu?” Nejoki iltung'ana leina anasa ninye, “Enkurare o ltung'ani le Nkai apa oing'uaa Yuda, nelotu aibonu kuna baa niyewuo iyie aas tialo olperere lo lasar te Betel.”

English: And he said, Let him alone; let no man move his bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Metotiwuo ninye neijia; nchoo eaku meiwuang'ieki iloik lenyena.” Neaku etapala ninche iloik lenyena teine, tenebo iloik leilo oiboni le Nkai oing'uaa Samaria.

English: And all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.
Masaai: Ore nena wuejitin apa oo lpereren naatii iwuejitin neeika too nkanas e Samaria, naaitobira ilaiguanak loo Siraeli, neitagor Olaitoriani, neiwuang'ie Yosia. Eitaasa ninye ninche anaa ina pooki nataasa te Betel.

English: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars, and burned men's bones upon them, and returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Near ninye metuata ilapolosak loo wuejitin neeika apa ootii ine, too nchumat oo lpereren loo lasarri, nepejoo iloik loo ltung'ana te shumata ninche. Nerrinyo ninye alo Yerusalem.

English: And the king commanded all the people, saying, Keep the passover unto the LORD your God, as it is written in the book of this covenant.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani iltung'ana pooki ajoki, “Embung'a osirua le ngiroroto oji pasaka tenkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, anaa enaigeroki tiatua ena buku o sotua.”

English: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;
Masaai: Amu meetae aekata osirua le ngiroroto oji Pasaka onyaakaki aaibung ebaiki nkolong'i oo larishak apa oorish Isiraeli, anaa too nkolong'i oo laiguanak loo Siraeli, anaa iloo laiguanak le Yuda;

English: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, wherein this passover was holden to the LORD in Jerusalem.
Masaai: kake ore to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o laiguanani Yosia, neibung'i ena pasaka te nkaraki Olaitoriani te Yerusalem.

English: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits, and the wizards, and the images, and the idols, and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, did Josiah put away, that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii apa Yosia aiwuang'ie ilaitumusumusok o lasakutok, o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin o ilo minong pooki otii ina kop e Yuda o Yerusalem, pee etumoki aitudupai irorei leina kitanapata ooigero tiatua ina buku apa nanoto Hilkia olapolosani tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And like unto him was there no king before him, that turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; neither after him arose there any like him.
Masaai: Ore apa te dukuya ninye nemetii olaiguanani oikununo anaa ninye, oibelekenyakine Olaitoriani, to ltau lenye pooki, o te nkishui enye pooki, o te nkidimata enye pooki, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Musa pooki, neitu eitokini aatum likae laaijo ninye te siadi ninye.

English: Notwithstanding the LORD turned not from the fierceness of his great wrath, wherewith his anger was kindled against Judah, because of all the provocations that Manasseh had provoked him withal.
Masaai: Neton ake eitu eibelekenya Olaitoriani teina goro enye napi, naa te ninye apa eyupuyupo egoro o Laitoriani tialo Yuda te nkaraki nena pooki naaitagorie Manase ninye.

English: And the LORD said, I will remove Judah also out of my sight, as I have removed Israel, and will cast off this city Jerusalem which I have chosen, and the house of which I said, My name shall be there.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Kaiwuang'ie sii Yuda too nkonyek aainei, anaa apa enaiwuang'ie Israel, nanang'aa nanu ena anasa apa nategelua, Yerusalem oina aji apa natejo nanu ninye etii enkarna ai.”

English: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yosia, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: In his days Pharaohnechoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates: and king Josiah went against him; and he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
Masaai: Ore apa too nkolong'i enyena, nelo Farao Neko, olaiguanani le Misiri enetii olaiguanani le Asiria, to lkeju le Frati. Nelo olaiguanani Yosia atumore ninye, near Farao Neko ninye metua te Megido, ina kata pee edol ninye.

English: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo, and brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own sepulchre. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead.
Masaai: Nenap isinkan lenyena ninye etua te ngarri oo mbartan te Megido neyau ninye Yerusalem, nenukaa ninye te nkurare enye makewan. Neyau iltung'ana leina kop Yehoahas, olayioni le Yosia, nebukoki ninye eilata aaput, neitaa ninye olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa ookuni Yehoahas pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilapaitin okuni te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Hamutal, entito e Yeremia olayioni le Libna.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa loo menye.

English: And Pharaohnechoh put him in bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of an hundred talents of silver, and a talent of gold.
Masaai: Neen Farao Neko ninye te Ribla te nkop e Hamat, pee meitoki ninye aitoreisho te Yerusalem, nepik ninye ina kop kodi e talanta iip nabo e nkosholai o talanta nabo e sahabu.

English: And Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the room of Josiah his father, and turned his name to Jehoiakim, and took Jehoahaz away: and he came to Egypt, and died there.
Masaai: Neitaa Farao Neko Eliakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani te rishata e Yosia papaai lenye. Neibelekeny ninye enkarna enye aitaa Yohoiakim. Kake eiwuang'ie ninye Yehoahas, nelotu ninye Misiri neye teine.

English: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaohnechoh.
Masaai: Neishooyo Yehoiakim enkosholai o Sahabu aisho Farao, kake eitalaa ninye ina kop kodi pee eitayu mpisai te risioroto e nkitanapata e Farao. Eitalakua ninye enkosholai o sahabu too ltung'ana leina kop, te pooki tung'ani te risioroto e nkikena enye, pee eisho Farao Neko.

English: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa oimiet Yehoiakim pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Sebida entito e Pedaia.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa loo papaai lenye.

English: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant three years: then he turned and rebelled against him.
Masaai: Ore apa aa olaiguanani Yehoiakim, neilepu Nebukadnesa, alotu neaku Yehoiakin osinka lenye ilarin okuni. Neitoki ninye aibelekenya agilunore ninye.

English: And the LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldees, and bands of the Syrians, and bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by his servants the prophets.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Olaitoriani metigilunore ninye ilwuampan loo ltung'ana loo Lkaldayo o too ltung'ana le Moab o loo ltung'ana le Amori, neirriwaki ninche meshomo aarasaki Yuda neidaikie ninye, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, apa oiroro aimunye isinkan lenyena, lelo oibonok le Nkai.

English: Surely at the commandment of the LORD came this upon Judah, to remove them out of his sight, for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did;
Masaai: Eewuo ena bae shumata Yuda te nkitanapata o Laitoriani, pee eiwuang'ie ninche too nkonyek enyena, tenkaraki ing'ok e Manase, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa ninye.

English: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.
Masaai: O tenkaraki sii ilo sarge lemeeta entioto apa oibukoyie ninye, amu eiputa apa ninye Yerusalem, osarge lemeeta entioto, neaku meidim Olaitoriani ataapalaki ninye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoiakim, o nena pooki naataasa ninye, neigeroki tiatua embuku oo ntepen oo laiguanak le Yuda.

English: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Yehoiakim etua anaa apa loo menye, neitoreisho Yehoiakim olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
Masaai: Eitu eitoki olaiguanani le Misiri aipang'u te nkop enye, amu eewa olaiguanani le Babilon nena pooki apa naara ino laiguanani le Misiri ebaiki oerata le Misiri o metabaiki olkeju le Frati.

English: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. And his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomon o isiet apa Yehoiakin pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilapaitin okuni te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Nabusta, entito e Elnatan.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa loo papaai lenye.

English: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata neilepu isinkan le Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon aapuonu Yerusalem, neibung'i ina anasa aang'adu.

English: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, and his servants did besiege it.
Masaai: Ore Nebukadnesa, olaiguanani le Babilon nelotu ina anasa ina kata etang'adutua isinkan lenyena;

English: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon, he, and his mother, and his servants, and his princes, and his officers: and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign.
Masaai: ore Yehoiakin olaiguanani le Yuda, neitarasaki kewan olaiguanani le Babilon, kewan enye, o ng'otonye o sinkan lenyena, o lkituaak lenyena, o sinkan le nkaji enye e nkitoo. Neen olaiguanani le Babilon ninye, neya ninye, to lari le isiet le nkitoria enye.

English: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.
Masaai: Nenap ninye aya lelo shumat pooki le nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat le nkaji o laiguanani, nedung aitaa mbelibelat imasaa pooki e sahabu naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naaitobira Solomon olaiguanani loo Siraeli, anaa apa enatolimuo Olaitoriani.

English: And he carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valour, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths: none remained, save the poorest sort of the people of the land.
Masaai: Etanapa ninye aya Yerusalem pooki, o lkituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki magil yiolot, iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon ooibung'aki, o ltung'ana pooki arriyiak te nguetare, o too sekenke. Meetae hoo obo otelekua, meteleku ake lelo tung'ana ake aisinak oleng leina kop.

English: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
Masaai: Neya ninye Yehoiakin Babilon; o ng'otonye olaiguanani, o nkituaak o laiguanani, o lkituaak lenyena o ltung'ana kituaak leina kop. Eewa ninye te araroto aitung'uaa Yerusalem nerik Babilon.

English: And all the men of might, even seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths a thousand, all that were strong and apt for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.
Masaai: Neyau olaiguanani le Babilon lelo yarunot Babilon, lelo tung'ana pooki yiolot, nkalifuni naapishana, o ltung'ana arriyiak te nguetare, o loo sekenke, iltung'ana enkalifu nabo, ore lelo pooki naa iltung'ana oogol neishiaakino to olarrabal.

English: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Babilon aitaa Matania olenkapu le Yehoiakin, olaiguanani te rishata enye, neibelekeny enkarna enye ajo Sedekia.

English: Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam oobo apa Sedekia ina kata pee eaku olaiguanani, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o obo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Hamutal, entito e Yeremia le Libna.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki naataasa Yehoiakin.

English: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Amu ore te nkaraki engoro o Laitoriani, etabawua e rishata te Yerusalem o te Yuda, naiturrayie ninye ninche aitalam kewan. Negolong'aki Sedekia olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he, and all his host, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it; and they built forts against it round about.
Masaai: Ore to lari lioudo le nkitoria enye, to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nelotu Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon tenebo enjore enye pooki agilunore Yerusalem, neng'adu ninye aman, nepik ninche engumoto aaitaman enkanasa.

English: And the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
Masaai: Neaku etang'aduaki enkanasa ometaa olari le tomon oobo le nkitoria olaiguanani Sedekia.

English: And on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine prevailed in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naaudo o lapa liong'uan nerasu olameyu teina anasa, amu meekure eetae endaa too ltung'ana leina kop.

English: And the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between two walls, which is by the king's garden: (now the Chaldees were against the city round about:) and the king went the way toward the plain.
Masaai: Neitobiri elusie teina anasa; neisik olaiguanani kewarie o ltung'ana pooki le njore, aaim enkoitoi e kishomi natii erishata oo sunta, embata e nkurma o laiguanani, hoo netang'adutua apa Ilkaldayo ina anasa. Nepuo ninche aaim enkoitoi e Araba.

English: And the army of the Chaldees pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho: and all his army were scattered from him.
Masaai: Kake etusujaitie apa enjore oo Lkaldayo olaiguanani nepuo aainepu ninye too nkisiajat e Yeriko. Neidapasha enjore enye pooki aaing'uaa ninye.

English: So they took the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they gave judgment upon him.
Masaai: Neibung ninche olaiguanani neyau enetii olaiguanani le Babilon te Ribla, nedung'oki ninye enkiguana.

English: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.
Masaai: Near ninche ilayiok le Sedekia metuata too nkonyek enyena neen ninye too lpisia, neya ninche ninye Babilon.

English: And in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which is the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, unto Jerusalem:
Masaai: Ore to lapa le imiet, te nkolong e naapishana o lapa aa ninye olari le tomon o oudo le nkitoria e Nebukadnesa, olaiguanani le Babilon, nelotu Nebusaradan ilo kitok loo larripok lo olaiguanani, osinka leilo aiguanani le Babilon, alotu Yerusalem.

English: And he burnt the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all the houses of Jerusalem, and every great man's house burnt he with fire.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninye enkaji o Laitoriani, o enkaji o laiguanani, o nkajijik pooki e Yerusalem. Ore pooki aji kitok, nepejoo ninye.

English: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
Masaai: Ore ina jore pooki oo lkaldayo, apa ootii tenebo ilo kitok le rripore, neuroo isunta pooki naamanita Yerusalem.

English: Now the rest of the people that were left in the city, and the fugitives that fell away to the king of Babylon, with the remnant of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae tung'ana pooki apa ootung'uayioki tiatua enkanasa, o lelo ooisika, aaisikaki olaiguanani le Babilon, tenebo ilo orora pooki, neya Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore eyararoto.

English: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
Masaai: Kake etung'uayie apa ilo kitok le rripore embata oo ltung'ana aisinak oleng leina kop, pee eaku ilooitobir isabibu, o laturok.

English: And the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, did the Chaldees break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore nena ng'apeta o suyai apa naatii enkaji o Laitoriani, o nkitotoneta enyena o ilo moti lo suyai, apa naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nebel ilkaldayo aaitaa mbelibelat, nenap ilo suyai aaya Babilon.

English: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
Masaai: Neya ninche imotioo, o nchempei, o nkuteta e nkima, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o masaa pooki o suyai apa naasishoreki te nkaji e Nkai o motioo,

English: And the firepans, and the bowls, and such things as were of gold, in gold, and of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
Masaai: o lbakulini. Ore apa nena tokitin e sahabu neya ilo kitok le rripore anaa sahabu ore ina nara enkosholai neya anaa enkosholai.

English: The two pillars, one sea, and the bases which Solomon had made for the house of the LORD; the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
Masaai: Ore tialo nena ng'apeta pokira are, o ilo moti, o nkitotoneta enyena, apa naaitobira Solomon te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani, ore enkiroishi eilo suyai pooki nemeimakinoyu te nkiroishi.

English: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
Masaai: Ore enkadoro e ng'ape nabo naa ntemat e nkaina tomon o isiet, ore enchumata enye netii osunyai. Ore enkadoro eina dukuya naa ntemat e nkaina uni.

English: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
Masaai: Neya ilo kitok le rripore Seria olapolosani kitok o Sefania ilo apolosani liare, o lelo arripok le kishomi pokira okuni;

English: And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king's presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:
Masaai: ore teina anasa neya ilo kitok apa oitasheiki iltung'ana le njore, o ltung'ana imiet lo lkiama lo laiguanani apa ooinepuaki te nkanasa; o laigeroni lo lkitok le njore laa ninye apa oipotuo iltung'ana leina kop, o ltung'ana ntomoni ile loo ltung'ana leina kop apa oonotoki teina anasa.

English: And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:
Masaai: Ore Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore neya ninche, neyau ninche enetii olaiguanani le Babilon te Ribla.

English: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
Masaai: Near olaiguanani le Babilon ninche, near metuata te Ribla, tiatua enkop e Hamat. Neaku eewaki apa Yuda eyararoto aaitung'uaa enkop enye.

English: And as for the people that remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler.
Masaai: Ore te shumata lelo tung'ana oo telekutua te nkop e Yuda, lelo apa ootung'uayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, negelu ninye Gedalia olayioni le Ahikan, olayioni le Shafan, aitaa olbalusui.

English: And when all the captains of the armies, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, there came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Careah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilarikok pooki le njore, teina kop naisiaja nchere eitaaki tenebo iltung'ana lenye nchere eitaa olaiguanani le Babilon Gedalia o lbalusui, nepuonu ninche tenebo iltung'ana lenye enetii Gedalia te Mispa, aa taa Ishmael olayioni le Natania, o Yohanan olayioni le Karea, o Seriai olayioni le Tahumet le Netofat, o Yaasania olayioni le Maakat.

English: And Gedaliah sware to them, and to their men, and said unto them, Fear not to be the servants of the Chaldees: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon; and it shall be well with you.
Masaai: Neinos Gedalia olmumai tialo ninche o ltung'ana lenye, ejo, “Emiureishoyu intae te nkaraki ilkituaak loo lkaldayo. Entobik intae tena kop, nisiaayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon, amu keserianu te intae.”

English: But it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, came, and ten men with him, and smote Gedaliah, that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldees that were with him at Mizpah.
Masaai: Kake ore to lapa liopishana, nelotu Elishama, leilo marei le nkitoo, tenebo iltung'ana lenyena tomon, nerasaki Gedalia near metua, tenebo Ilyahudi o Lkaldayo apa ootii tenebo ninye te Mispa.

English: And all the people, both small and great, and the captains of the armies, arose, and came to Egypt: for they were afraid of the Chaldees.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana pooki, ilooti o lkituaak o larikok loo njorin, aadumunye nepuo Misiri, amu keure apa Ilkadayo.

English: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison;
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni oopishana le yararoto e Yehoiakin olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le tomon oare, te nkolong e tikitam oopishana o lapa, nelaaya Efil Merodak, ilo aiguanani le Babilon, teilo ari oitera aitoreisho, Yehoiakin olaiguanani le Yuda metupuku te jela.

English: And he spake kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon;
Masaai: Neirorie ninye te supatisho, neisho ninye olorika olus too lorikan loo laiguanak apa ootii tenebo ninye te Babilon.

English: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
Masaai: Neaku eitayio Yehoiakin lelo kilani lenyena le jela, ore too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui enye neinos ninye endaa te mesa o laiguanani.

English: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
Masaai: Ore te retoto enye, eishooki apa ninye eretoto e anaake naishoo olaiguanani, ore ake te nkolong neng'amaa erubata, te nkishui enye pooki.

English: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
Masaai: Adam, Seti, Enosh,

English: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
Masaai: Kenan o Mahalael, Yared;

English: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
Masaai: Enok, o Metusela, o Lamek

English: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Masaai: Noa, o Shem, o Ham o Yafet.

English: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Yafet naa Gomer, o Magog, o Madai o Yafan, o Tubal o Meshek o Tiras.

English: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gomer naa Askenas, o Difat, o Togarma.

English: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yafan naa Elisha, o Tarshish o Kitim o Rodanim.

English: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ham naa Kushi o Misiri o Puti o Kanaan.

English: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kushi naa Seba, o Hafila, o Sabta o Raama o Sableka. Ore ilayiok le Raama naa Sheba o Dedan.

English: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
Masaai: Kushi apa menye le Nimrod, naa ninye otang'asa aaku oltung'ani magilani te nkop.

English: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Napthtuhim,
Masaai: Misiri apa menye le Ludim, o Anamim, o Lehabim, o Napatuhim, o

English: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
Masaai: Patusim o Kusluhim (aa ine taa eing'uaa Ilfilisti, o Kaftorim.)

English: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
Masaai: Kanaan apa menye le Sidon, ilo kikau lenye, o Heti,

English: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
Masaai: o Lyebusi o Lamori o Lgirgashi,

English: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
Masaai: o Lhifi ole Arki o Lsini, o

English: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
Masaai: Lafadi, o Lsamari, o Lhamati.

English: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shem naa Elam o Ashur o Arpakashad o Lud, o Aram o Usi o Huli o Feter, o Meshek,

English: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
Masaai: Apakashad apa menye le Shela; naa Shela menye le Eber.

English: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother's name was Joktan.
Masaai: Etoikioki apa Eber ilayiok oare, ore enkarna e obo naa Peleg (amu too nkolong'i enyena apa etooroki enkop) ore enkarna o lalashe naa Yoktin.

English: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
Masaai: Yoktin apa menye le Almodad, o Shelaf o Hasamafet, o Yera.

English: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
Masaai: o Hadoram, o Usal, o Dikla,

English: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
Masaai: o Ebal o Abimael o Sheba,

English: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
Masaai: o Ofir, o Hafila o Yobab; ore kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Yoktan.

English: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
Masaai: O shem, o Arpakshad o Shela,

English: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
Masaai: o Eber o Peleg o Reu;

English: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
Masaai: o Serug o Nahor o Tera;

English: Abram; the same is Abraham.
Masaai: o Abram aa taa Abraham.

English: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Abraham naa Isaak o Ishmael.

English: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
Masaai: Kuna ninche iiishoritin enye. Ore olkikau le Ishmael naa Nebaiot; o Kedar, o Adbel Mibsan,

English: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
Masaai: o Mishma, o Duma, o Masa, o Hadad, o Tema,

English: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
Masaai: o Yetur o Nafish o Kedema. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ishmael.

English: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Ketura, ina apiani e Abraham, netoiuo Simra, o Yokshan o Medan o Midian o Ishbak o Shua. Ore ilayiok le Yokshan naa Sheba o Dedan.

English: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Midian, Efa o Efer, o Hanok o Abida o Eldaa. Kulo pooki ninche eishoi e Ketura.

English: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
Masaai: Abraham apa menye le Isaak. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Isaak, Esau o Israel.

English: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Esau naa Elfas, o Reul, o Yeush, Yalaam o Kora.

English: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Elfas naa Teman, o Omar o Sefi o Satam o Kenas o Timna o Amaleki.

English: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ruel, Nahat, o Serak, o Shama o Miisa.

English: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Seir: Lotan, o Shobal, o Sibeon, o Anak, o Dishon, o Eser o Dishan.

English: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan's sister.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Lotan: Hori o Homan, ore apa enkanashe e Lotan naa Timna.

English: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Shobai: Alian o Manahat o Ebai, o Shefi, o Onam. Ore ilayiok le Sibeon naa Aia o Anak.

English: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Anak: Dishon ore ilayiok le Dishon naa Hamran o Eshban, o Itran o Keran.

English: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Eser, Bilhan, o Saafan o Yaakan. Ore ilayiok le Dishon naa Usi o Aran.

English: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
Masaai: Kulo aiguanak apa ooitoreisho te enkop e Edom, eton eitu eitore hoo likae aiguanani Isiraeli: Bela ole Boer, laa ninye eipotieki enkanasa naji Dinhaba.

English: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Bela neitoreisho Yohab ole Serak te rishata enye.

English: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Yohab, neitoreisho Husam ole nkop oo Ltaman te rishata enye.

English: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Husham ore Hadad ole Bedad laa ninye apa otimira Midian te nkop e Moab neitoreisho te rishata enye; ore enkarna enkanasa enye naa Afit.

English: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Hadad, neitoreisho Samala le Masreka te rishata enye.

English: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Samli, ore Shaul le Rehobot to lkeju le Frati neitoreisho te rishata enye.

English: And when Shaul was dead, Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Shaul neitoreisho Baalhanan ole Akbor te rishata enye.

English: And when Baalhanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Baalhanan neitoreisho Hadad te rishata enye, ore enkarna e nkanasa naa Pai, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Mahetabel, entito e Matred, entito e Mesaba. Neye Hadad.

English: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak loo loshon le Edom naa; olaiguanani Timna, o Alka, Yetet,

English: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
Masaai: o Oholibama, o Ela, o Pinon o Kenas,

English: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
Masaai: o Teman, o Mibsar, o Magdiel, o Iram,

English: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
Masaai: kulo ninche ilaiguanak le Edom.

English: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Israel, Ruben, o Simion o Lawi, o Yuda, o Isaakar, o Sebulon,

English: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
Masaai: o Dan, o Yosef, o Benchamen, o Naftali, o Gaad, o Asheri,

English: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the LORD; and he slew him.
Masaai: kulo ninche ilayiok le Yuda. Eer, o Onan, o Shela, ore kulo pokira okuni apa etoikio Betshua oo Lkanaani ninye. Ore apa Eer ilo kikau le Yuda naa oltung'ani arruoni te dukuya Olaitoriani. Neaku etara Olaitoriani ninye metua.

English: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
Masaai: Ore ina tito apa nayama olayioni lenye naji Tamar, neiki ninye Peres o Serak. Eeta apa Yuda ilayiok imiet.

English: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Peres: Hesron o Hamul.

English: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Serak naa Simri, o Etan, o Hemian, o Kalkol o Dara, imiet pooki.

English: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Kormi; Akar ilo aing'oling'olani loo Siraeli, laa ninye apa otigila nkitanapat too ntokitin naaitisinyakaki Enkai,

English: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
Masaai: ore olayioni le Etan naa Asaria.

English: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
Masaai: Kulo ayiok apa etoikioki Hesron: Yerameel, o Ram, o Kelubia.

English: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
Masaai: Ram apa menye le Aminadab, naa Aminadab apa menye le Nahashon, ilo kitok loo layiok le Yuda.

English: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
Masaai: Nahashon apa menye le Salma, Salma le Boas,

English: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
Masaai: Boas le Obed, Obed le Yese

English: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
Masaai: Yese apa menye le Eliab naa ninye olkikau. Aminadab oliare, o Shimea aa ninye oliokuni.

English: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
Masaai: Natanel oliong'uan,

English: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
Masaai: Radai ole imiet, Osem ole ile

English: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
Masaai: Daudi oliopishana, ore nkanashera enye naa Seruyia, o Abigail. Ore ilayiok le Seruyia naa Abishai, o Yoab, o Asahel. Lelo pokira okuni.

English: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
Masaai: Etoiuo apa Abigail Amasa, ore menye le Amasa naa Yeter le Ishmael.

English: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
Masaai: Eeta apa Kaleb olayioni le Hesron nkera naatoiuo enkitok enye naji Asuba, ore te Yeriot, naa kuna nkarn oo layiok lenyena, Yesher, o Shobab, o Adron.

English: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
Masaai: Ore pee eye Asuba, neyam Kaleb Efarat naa ninye natoiuo Huri.

English: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
Masaai: Huri apa menye le Uri naa Uri menye le Besalel.

English: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nelo Hesron ayam entito e Makir, menye le Gilead. Neyamisho ninye aa oloo larin ntomoni ile, neiki ina tito ninye Segub.

English: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Naa Segub apa menye le Yair, laa ninye apa oata nkanas tikitam ookuni te nkop e Gilead.

English: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
Masaai: Kake etaaraitie apa Geshur o Aram nkanas e Hofotajir, o Kenat, o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, nkang'itie ntomoni ile. Ore kuna pooki naa inoo le ishoi oo le Makir, menye le Gilead.

English: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi te keeya e Hesron, nelo Kaleb ayiolou Efarata, enkitok e Hesron papaai lenye. Neiki ina kitok ninye Ashuri, menye le Tekoa.

English: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yerameel ilo kikau le Hesron: Ram ilo kikau lenye, o Buna, o Oren o Osem o Ahija.

English: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
Masaai: Eeta sii apa Yerameel enkae kitok, naji enkarna enye Atara; naa ninye apa ngotonye e Onam.

English: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ram ilo kikau le Yerameel: Maas o Yamin o Eker.

English: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Onam: Shamai o Yuda ore ilayiok le Shamai naa Nadab o Abishur.

English: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
Masaai: Ore apa enkarna enkitok e Abishur naa Abihail neiki Abishu Ababan o Molid.

English: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Nadab naa; Seled o Apaim, neye Selad meeta enkerai.

English: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Apaim naa Ishi, ore ilayiok le Ishi, naa Sheshan, ore ilayiok le Sheshan naa Ahalai.

English: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
Masaai: Naa kulo ilayiok le Yada, olalashe le Shamai, o Yeter o Yonatan. Etua apa Yeter meeta enkerai.

English: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yonatan: Pelet o Sasa. Ore kulo naa ile ishoi e Yerameel.

English: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
Masaai: Meeta apa Sheshem ilayiok, ntoyie ake eeta. Neeta apa Sheshem Olmisiri rrindik oji enkarna enye Yerha.

English: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
Masaai: Neishooyo Sheshan ina tito enye meyama Yerha, orrindik lenye. Neiu ina tito Atai,

English: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
Masaai: Atai apa menye le Natan,

English: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
Masaai: naa Natan menye le Sabad. Sabad apa menye le Efla naa Efla menye le Obed.

English: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
Masaai: Obed apa menye le Yehu, naa Yehu menye le Asaria.

English: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
Masaai: Asaria apa menye le Heles,

English: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
Masaai: naa Heles menye le Eleasa. Eleasa menye le Sismai naa Sismai menye le Shalum.

English: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
Masaai: Shalum menye le Yekemia naa Yekemia menye le Elishama.

English: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Kaleb ilo alashe le Yerameel: Marehash ilo kikau lenye, laa ninye menye le Sif, ore ilayiok le Maresha olkikau lenye naa

English: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
Masaai: ilayiok le Hebron: Kora, Tapua, o Rekem o Shema,

English: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
Masaai: Shema apa menye le Raham, menye le Yorkeam; aa menye Shamai apa Rekem,

English: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur.
Masaai: kulo ninche ilayiok le Shamai: Maon: naa Maon apa menye le Betsar.

English: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
Masaai: Ore sii apa Efa ina apiani e Kaleb, neiu Haran, o Mosa o Geses, naa Haran apa menye le Geses.

English: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yehadai; Regem, o Yotam, o Gesham o Pelet o Efa, o Shaaf.

English: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
Masaai: Ore Maaka ina apiani e Kaleb neiu Sheber o Tirhana.

English: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
Masaai: Etoiuo sii Shaaf menye le Madmana, o Shefa menye le Makbena o menye le Gibea; ore apa entito e Kaleb naa keji Aksa.

English: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim,
Masaai: Kulo apa ileishoi e Kaleb. Ilayiok le Huri ilo kikau le Efrata: Shobal menye le Kiriat-yearim,

English: Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
Masaai: Salma menye le Betlehem o Heref menye le Betgader.

English: And Shobal the father of Kirjathjearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
Masaai: Eeta apa Shobal menye le Kiriat jearim kulikae ayiok; Haroe laa ninye olpisiai loo lmonubot.

English: And the families of Kirjathjearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
Masaai: Ore ilmareita loo Lkiriat-yearim naa Iltiriti, o Iputi, o Ilchumati o Imishirati, naa kulo eing'uaa Ilsoriti o Ilshitoa.

English: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Solma: Betlehem o Lnetofari o Arot-bet-Yoab, o lpisia loo Lmahahati, o Lsori.

English: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
Masaai: Ore sii ilmareita loo laigerok apa oomanya Yabes, naa Iltirati o Ichimeat o Lsukati. Ore kulo naa Ilkeni apa ooetuo aaing'uaa Hamat, menye lolmarei le Rekab.

English: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Daudi apa ootoikioki ninye te Hebron: Ore olkikau naa Amon, otoiwuo Ahinoam oo Lyesreel; ore oliare naa Daniel, otoiwuo Abigail e Karmel.

English: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
Masaai: Ore oliokuni naa Absalom apa laa Maaka ng'otonye. Entito e Talmai olaiguanani le Geshur. Ore oliong'uan anaa Adonija, neji ng'otonye Hagit.

English: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
Masaai: Ore oleimiet naa Shefatia otoiwuo Abital; ore ole ile naa Itream otoiwuo enkitok enye Egla.

English: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
Masaai: Etoikioki apa ninye kulo pokira ile te Hebron, teine apa neitoreisho ilarin oopishana o lapaitin ile. Neitoreisho ninye te Yerusalem ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni.

English: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo ootoikioki ninye te Yerusalem: Shimei o Shobab, o Natan, o Solomon, lelo oong'uan etoiuo Betshua entito e Amiel.

English: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
Masaai: Neitokini aaiu Ibar, o Elishama, o Elifelet,

English: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
Masaai: o Noga, o Nefeg o Yafia,

English: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
Masaai: o Elishama, o Eliada, o Elifelet, ooudo,

English: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
Masaai: ilayiok le Daudi kulo pooki metii ilayiok loo nkapiak; naa Tamar enkanashe enye.

English: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
Masaai: Ore eishoi e Solomon naa: Rehoboam o Abija olayioni lenye, o Asa olayioni lenye, o Yehoshefat olayioni lenye,

English: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
Masaai: o Yoram olayioni lenye, o Ahasia olayioni lenye, o Yoash olayioni lenye,

English: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
Masaai: O Amasai olayioni lenye, o Asaria olayioni lenye o Yotan olayioni lenye,

English: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
Masaai: o Ahas olayioni lenye. O Hesekia olayioni lenye o Manase olayioni lenye,

English: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
Masaai: o Amon olayioni lenye, o Yosia olayioni lenye.

English: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yosia naa: Yohanan olkikau lenye, ore oliare naa Yehoiakim, ore oliokuni naa Sedekia, ore oliong'uan naa Shulum.

English: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
Masaai: Ore eishoi e Yehoiakim naa: Yekonia olayioni lenye o Sedekia olayioni lenye.

English: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
Masaai: Ore eishoi e Yehoiakin ilo apa oshomo eyararoto naa: Shealtiel olayioni lenye,

English: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
Masaai: o Malkiram, o Pedaia, o Shenasa, o Yekania, o Hoshama, o Nedabisha.

English: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pedaia naa Serubabel o Shimei; ore ilayiok le Serubabel naa Meshulam o Hanania naa Shelomit enkanashe enye,

English: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
Masaai: o Heshuba, o Obel, o Berekia, o Hasadia, o Yushabhesed, ninche pokira imiet.

English: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hanania, naa Peletia o Yeshaia, o layioni lenye Refaina, o layioni lenye Arnan, o layioni lenye Obadia, o layioni lenye Shekania.

English: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shekania naa Shemaia. Ore ilayiok le Shemaia naa Hatush, o Lgal, o Baria, o Neris o Shafat, kulo pokira ile.

English: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Neara naa Elioenai, Hiskia, o Asrikam, kulo pokira okuni.

English: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Elioenai naa: Hodafia, o Eliashib, o Pelaia, o Akub, o Yohanan, o Delaia, o Anani, kulo pokira oopishana.

English: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yuda naa, Peres, o Hesron, o Karmi, o Huri, o Shobal.

English: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
Masaai: Reaia ole Shobal apa menye le Yahat, naa Yahat menye le Ahumei o Lahad. Kulo apa ilmareita loo le Sorat.

English: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
Masaai: Kulo apa ilayiok le Etam: Yesreel, o Ishma o Ldbash; ore enkarna e nkanashe enye naa Haseloponi.

English: And Penuel the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.
Masaai: Naa Panuel apa menye le Gedor, naa Eser menye le Hushash. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Huri, ilo kikau le Efrata, menye le Betlehem.

English: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Masaai: Eeta apa Ashuhur, menye le Tekoa nkituaak are, Heba, o Naara;

English: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
Masaai: Neiki Naara ninye Ahusum, o Hefer, o Temeni, O Haashatari. Kulo ninche apa ilayiok le Naara.

English: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Hela: Seret, o Ishar, o Etanan.

English: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
Masaai: Koos apa menye le Anub, o Sebeba, o lmareita le Aharhel olayioni le Harum.

English: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
Masaai: Yabes apa oning'o oleng too lalashera lenyena; neisho apa ninye ng'otonye enkarna ajo Yabes, ejo, “Enkaraki natoiuo ninye te mion.”

English: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
Masaai: Neomon Yabes Enkai e Israel ejo, “Tamayianaki Na Ai, nikiponiki enkop, nchoo enkaina ino eaku tenebo nanu, naamitu nanu te mbatisho pooki pee maatum nanu!” Neisho Enkai ninye ina natoomonuo.

English: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
Masaai: Keleb ilo alashe le Shusha apa menye le Mekir, laa ninye menye le Eshton.

English: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
Masaai: Eshton apa menye le Betrafa, o Pasea, o Tihina menye le Irnabash. Kulo ninche iltung'ana le Reka.

English: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kenas naa: Otiniel, o Seraia. Ore ilayiok le Otimiel naa: Hanat o Meonotai.

English: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
Masaai: Meonotai apa menye le Ofra: naa Serai apa menye le Yoab menye Geharashim, neijia apa ejo ninche amu iltung'ana arriyiak.

English: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kaleb olayioni le Yefune naa: Iru, o Ela, o Naam; ore ilayiok le Ela naa Kenas.

English: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yehaledel naa: Sif o Sifa, o Tiria, o Asarel.

English: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Esrahi naa: Yeter, o Mered, o Efer, o Yolon. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Bitia entito e Farao, apa nayama Mered, nenutayu ninye neiu Meriam o Shamai o Ishba menye le Eshtemoa.

English: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
