Masaai: Ore ina kitok enye oo Lyahudi neiu Yared menye le Gedor, o Heber menye le Soko, o Yekutiel menye le Samoa.

English: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le nkitok e Hodia, ina anashe e Naham, naa iloomenye le Keila le Garmit o Eshtemoa le Maakuti.

English: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shimon naa: Amon, o Rina, o Benhanan, o Tilon. Ore ilayiok le Ishi naa Sohet, o Bensohet.

English: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shela ole Yuda naa: Eer menye le Leka, o Laada menye le Maresha, o lmareita le nkaji oo laitobirak oopuyiapui te Bet-ashbea.

English: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
Masaai: Ore Yokim oltung'ana le Koseba, o Yoash o Saraf apa laa ninye oitoreisho te Moab nerrinyo alo Lahem. (ore apa kuna baa naa iniopa oleng.)

English: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo aitobirak loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok naa ninche oomanya Netaim o Gedera: Nebik ninche teine tenebo olaiguanani tenkaraki esiaai enye.

English: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Simeon naa: Nemuel, o Yamin, o Yarib, o Serak o Shaul;

English: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
Masaai: Shalum apa olayioni lenye, o Mibsai olayioni lenye, o Mibsam olayioni lenye o Mishma olayioni lenye.

English: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Mishma naa: Hamuel olayioni lenye, o Sakur olayioni lenye o Shimei olayioni lenye.

English: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
Masaai: Eeta apa Shimei ilayiok tomon o ile o ntoyie ile; kake meeta apa ilalashera lenyena nkera kumok, neitu eponari ilmareita lenye anaa iltung'ana le Yuda.

English: And they dwelt at Beersheba, and Moladah, and Hazarshual,
Masaai: Nebik apa ninche te Beersheba, o te Moloda, o te Hasar-shual,

English: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
Masaai: o te Bilha, o te Esem, o te Tolad,

English: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
Masaai: o te Betuel, o te Horma, o te Siklag,

English: And at Bethmarcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
Masaai: o te Betmarkobat, o te Harsarsusim, o te Betbiri, o te Sharraim. Kuna ninche nkanas enye o metabaiki enkitoria e Daudi.

English: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
Masaai: Ore nkang'itie enye naa Efan, o Ain, o Rimon, o Token o Ashan, nkanas imiet.

English: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
Masaai: Ore tenebo nena ang'itie enye pooki naamanita o kuna anas ometabaiki baal, kuna apa imanyiishoritin enye neigero iiishoritin enye.

English: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
Masaai: Meshohab, o Yamlek, o Yosha, apa ilayiok le Amasai.

English: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
Masaai: Yoel o Yehu apa ilayiok le Yoshibia olayioni le Seraia, olayioni le Asiel.

English: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
Masaai: Elioenai o Yaakoba o Yeshohaia, o Asaia, o Adiel, o Yesimeil o Benaia,

English: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
Masaai: o Sifa ole Shifi olayioni le Alon, o layioni le Yedaia, olayioni le Shimri, olayioni le Shemaia

English: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
Masaai: ore kulo ooipotoki nkarn ninche apa ilkituaak too lmareita lenye, ore nkajijik oo loo menye nebul oleng,

English: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
Masaai: Eshomo apa ninche enejing'ieki Gedor nepuo enkalo o loo saen lo erata, eing'oru ndaat oo nkerrai enye,

English: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
Masaai: nepuo aatum ndaat sidain teine, amu kelala ina kop, nebor oilole, neserian; ore apa iloomanya ine te dukuya naa ile Ham.

English: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
Masaai: Ore kulo ooigeroki nkarn ninche apa loo nkolong'i e Hesekia, olaiguanani le Yuda, neidaikie ilng'oborri lenye o Lmeunin apa oomanya ine, neishieki ninche teine o taata, nemany ninche ina kop enye enkaraki natii ine ndaat oo nkerrai enye.

English: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae lenye, iltung'ana oobaya iip imiet too le Simeon, nepuo oldoinyio le Seir, ore ilarikok lenye naa Pelatia, o Neara, o Refaia, o Usiel, ilayiok le Ishi.

English: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
Masaai: Neidaikie ninche ilo pisiai apa le Ameleki oisika nebik ninye teine o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father's bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
Masaai: Kulo ile ishoi e Ruben ilo kikau le Israel, (ore enkaraki natijing'a enkaji e papaai lenye, meekure eikenari aajo olkikau. Ore erishata enye neishori ilayiok le Yosef olayioni le Israel. Amu eitu eigeri enkarna enye te mbuku oo iishoritin anaa olkikau.

English: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph's:)
Masaai: Ore hoo naa Yuda apa ogol alang ilalashera lenyena, naa ninye eimu ilo kitok, kake ene Yosef enjung'ore o lkikau.)

English: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ruben ilo kikau le Israel naa: Hanok, o Palu, o Hesron, o Karmi.

English: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Yoel: Shemia olayioni lenye, o Gog olayioni lenye, o Shimei olayioni lenye,

English: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
Masaai: o Mika olayioni lenye, o Reaia olayioni lenye, o Baal olayioni lenye,

English: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
Masaai: o Beara olayioni lenye, laa ninye apa eewa olaiguanani Tilgat Pilnesa le Asiria te yararoto. Ninye apa oltung'ani kitok too le Ruben.

English: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana lenye too lmareita lenye, ina kata pee eigeri iiishoritin enye naa: ore olkitok lenye naa Yerel, o Sakaria,

English: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baalmeon:
Masaai: o Bela olayioni le Asas, olayioni le Shema, olayioni le Yoel, apa omanya Aroer ometabaiki Nebo o Baalmeon.

English: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
Masaai: Etobiko sii apa te nkalo o loo saen ometabaiki olpolosie lo lpurkel tena shoto e Frati, amu etoponari apa nkishu enye te nkop e Gilead.

English: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i e Saul neitayunye iltung'ana le Hagrit olarrabal, neibung ninche, nebik ninche too lng'oborri lenye te nkop pooki e Gilead te nkalo oloosaen.

English: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
Masaai: Etamanya apa ilayiok le Gad aatashare ninche te nkop e Bashan ometabaiki Saleka.

English: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
Masaai: Yoel apa olkitok nesujaki Shafan o Yanai o Shafat te Bashan.

English: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
Masaai: Ore olorere lenye te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa: Mikael, o Meshulam, o Sheba, o Yorai, o Yakan, o Sia, o Eber, lelo pokira oopishana.

English: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
Masaai: Kulo apa ilayiok le Abihail olayioni le Huri olayioni le Yaroa, olayioni le Gilead, olayioni le Mikael, olayioni le Yeshishai, olayioni le Yohado, olayioni le Buus;

English: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ahis olayioni le Abdiel, olayioni le Guni ninye apa olkitok te nkaji e menye;

English: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
Masaai: nebik apa ninye te Gilead, tiatua Bashan o too nkang'itie enyena, o teina kop pooki nairritishoreki e Sharon o meiting'ie.

English: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
Masaai: Eigeroki apa kuna baa pooki anaa iishoritin too nkolong'i e Yotam olaiguanani le Yuda o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel.

English: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
Masaai: Ore tiatua iloshon le Ruben ore Gad o lpisiaai lo losho le Manase, neeta iltung'ana magil, oata long'oi o lalema, neeta nkai, naa arriyiak to larrabal, naa nkalifuni artam oong'uan, o iip naapishana o ntomoni ile, neterretenate ninche te nkisiaayiare.

English: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche olarrabal o Lhagri, olyetur, Olmafish, Olnadab;

English: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
Masaai: ore ake pee eng'amu ninche eretoto pee egilunore ninche, ore Ilhagri, o lelo pooki ootii tenebo ninche neishoori aapik nkaik oo le Ruben, amu Olaitoriani eishirakitia ninche to larrabal, neisho ninche Enkai eomonunoto enye enkaraki naisiliga ninche ninye.

English: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
Masaai: Neya ninche nkishu enye, o ntamesin enye nkalifuni onom, o nkerra nkalifuni iip are o onom, o sirkon nkalifuni are, o ltung'ana ooishu nkalifuni iip nabo.

English: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
Masaai: Amu eirragaitie ilkumok etuata, amu ore ilo arrabal naa ole Nkai. Nebik ninche te nkop enye ometabau eyararoto.

English: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai loo ltung'ana le Manase nebik teina kop, neaku ninche kumok oleng te Bashan o metabaiki Baarhermon, o Senir, o ldoinyio le Hermon.

English: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye: Efer, o Ishi, o Eliel, o Esriel, o Yeremia, o Hadafia, o Yadiel, lelo murran magil, ooning'o, laa lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
Masaai: Kake etogolong'okita ninche Enkai oo loomenye, neiborrie onyek aarubare nkaitin oo ltung'ana leina kop apa naaidaikie Enkai te dukuya ninche.

English: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neputu Enkai e Israel oltau le Puul, olaiguanani le Asiria, o ltau le Tilgal-Pilnesa, olaiguanani le Asiria, nearaa ninche meshomo, aa taa ile Ruben o le Gad, o lpisiaai loo ltung'ana le Manase, nereu ninche Hala, o Habor, o Hara, nereu sii olkeju le Gosan ometabaiki ena olong.

English: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Kulo ilayiok le Lawi: Gershom, o Kohat, o Merari.

English: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kohat naa: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron o Usiel.

English: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Kuna nkera e Amram: Aron, o Musa, o Miriam. Kulo ilayiok le Aron: Nadab o Abihu, o Eliesa, o Itamar.

English: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
Masaai: Eliesa apa menye le Finehas, naa Finehas menye le Abishua

English: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
Masaai: Abishua menye le Buki, Buki menye le Usi,

English: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
Masaai: Usi menye le Serahia, Serahia menye le Meraiot,

English: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
Masaai: Meraiot menye le Amaria, Amaria menye le Ahitub,

English: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
Masaai: Ahitub menye le Sadok, Sadok menye le Ahimaas,

English: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
Masaai: Ahimaas menye le Asaria, Asaria menye le Yohanan,

English: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
Masaai: naa Yohanan menye le Asaria. (ninye apa ilo oisiaaisho anaa olapolosani teina aji apa natesheta Solomon te Yerusalem)

English: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
Masaai: Asaria apa menye le Amaria, naa Amaria menye le Ahitub

English: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
Masaai: Ahitub menye le Sadok naa Sadok menye le Shalum,

English: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
Masaai: Shalum menye le Hilkia; Hilkia menye le Asaria,

English: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
Masaai: Asaria menye le Seraia, naa Seraia le Yehosadak;

English: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
Masaai: nelo apa Yohosadak eyararoto ina kata pee eirriwaa Olaitoriani Yuda o Yerusalem meshomo eyararoto te nkaina e Nebukadnesa.

English: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Lawi: Gershom, o Kohat, o Merari.

English: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn oo layiok le Gershom: Libni o Shimei.

English: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Kohat: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron o Usiel.

English: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Merari: Mahali, o Mishi, kulo ninche ilmareita loo Lawi terisioroto oo loo menye.

English: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
Masaai: Ile Gershom: Libni, olayioni lenye, o Yohat olayioni lenye, o Sima olayioni lenye,

English: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
Masaai: o Yoash olayioni lenye, o Ido olayioni lenye, o Serak olayioni lenye, o Yeaterai olayioni lenye.

English: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Kohat: Aminadab olayioni lenye, o Kora olayioni lenye, o Asir olayioni lenye.

English: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
Masaai: O Elkana olayioni lenye, o Ebiasaf olayioni lenye o Asir olayioni lenye

English: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
Masaai: o Tahat olayioni lenye, o Uriel olayioni lenye, o Usia olayioni lenye, o Shaul olayioni lenye.

English: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Elkana: Amasai, o Ahimot o,

English: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
Masaai: Elkana olayioni lenye, o Sofai olayioni lenye, o Nahat olayioni lenye,

English: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
Masaai: o Eliab olayioni lenye o Yeroham olayioni lenye, o Elkana olayioni lenye.

English: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Samuel: Yoel olkikau lenye, ore olosuju naa Abija.

English: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Merari: Mahali, o Libni olayioni lenye, o Shimei olayioni lenye, o Usa olayioni lenye,

English: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
Masaai: o Shimea olayioni lenye, o Higia olayioni lenye o Asaia olayioni lenye.

English: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa etipika Daudi meitasheiki esiaai e Ranyare tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, eidipaki aairragie osanduku lo sotua teine.

English: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
Masaai: Etaranyishote apa ninche te dukuya ilo ng'obor le wueji sinyati, ometaba anaa neshetu Solomon enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem; neas ninche ina siaai enye anaa enaishiakino.

English: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa lelo tenebo ilayiok lenye. Ore too layiok le Kohat naa: Haman olaranyani ole Yoel, olayioni le Samuel,

English: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
Masaai: olayioni le Elkana, olayioni le Yehoram, olayioni le Eliel, olayioni le Toa,

English: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
Masaai: olayioni le Suf, olayioni le Elkana, olayioni le Mahat, olayioni le Amasai,

English: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
Masaai: olayioni le Elkana olayioni le Yoel, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Sefania,

English: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
Masaai: olayioni le Tahat, olayioni le Asir, olayioni le Ebiasaf, olayioni le Kora,

English: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
Masaai: olayioni le Ishar, olayioni le Kohat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Israel;

English: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
Masaai: o lalashe lenye Asafu laa ninye apa oitashe te nkalo enye e tatene, aa taa Asafu ole Berekia, olayioni le Shimea,

English: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
Masaai: olayioni le Mikaeli olayioni le Baaseia, olayioni le Malkija,

English: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
Masaai: olayioni le Etni, olayioni le Serak, olayioni le Adaia,

English: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
Masaai: olayioni le Elan, olayioni le Sima, olayioni le Shimei

English: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
Masaai: o layioni le Yahat, olayioni le Gershom, olayioni le Lawi.

English: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
Masaai: Ore te nkalo e kedienye netii ilalashera lenye, lelo ayiok le Merari: Etam ole Kishi, olayioni le Abdi; olayioni le Maluk,

English: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
Masaai: olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Amasai, olayioni le Hilkia,

English: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
Masaai: olayioni le Amsi, olayioni le Beni, olayioni le Shemer,

English: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
Masaai: olayioni le Mahali, olayioni le Mushi, olayioni le Merari, olayioni le Lawi;

English: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
Masaai: ore ilalashera lenye Ilawi netegelakaki enkisiaayiare pooki e wueji sinyati tiatua enkaji Enkai.

English: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
Masaai: Kake ore apa Aron o layiok lenyena neitayu ilasarri te nchumata olperere loo lasarri oopejoro te nchumata olperere le nkorropil tenkaraki esiaai pooki eine wueji sinyati oleng. Neitobir sii olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki Israel, te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapishe Musa osinka le Nkai.

English: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Aron: Eliesa olayioni lenye, o Finehas olayioni lenye, o Abishua olayioni lenye,

English: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
Masaai: o Buki olayioni lenye, o Usi olayioni lenye, o Serahia olayioni lenye,

English: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Masaai: o Meraiot olayioni lenye, o Amaria olayioni lenye o Ahitab olayioni lenye,

English: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
Masaai: o Sadok olayioni lenye, o Ahimaas olayioni lenye.

English: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
Masaai: Kuna ninche imanyishoritin enye terisioroto oo wuejitin neetamanya ninche too lpolosien lenye. Ore too layiok le Aron loo lmareita le Kohat, naa ena erubata enye.

English: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
Masaai: Eishooki ninche Hebron tiatua enkop e Yuda o nena daat oo nchoo naamanita,

English: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
Masaai: kake ore nkong'at embata e ina anasa o nkang'itie kutiti neishori Kalebu ole Yefune.

English: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Aron neishori nena anas e sarunoto, Hebron o Libna, tenebo ndaat enye oo nchoo, Yatir o Eshtemoa tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
Masaai: o Hilen tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Debir tenebo ndaat enyena, oo nchoo,

English: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
Masaai: o Ashan tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Bet-shemesh tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
Masaai: Ore olosho le Benchamen neishori Geba tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Alemet tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Anatot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo. Ore nkanas enye pooki too lmareita lenye naa tomon oo kuni.

English: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootelekutua le Kohat, neishori te oshoto e nkukuo, anaa ilmareita leilo osho olpisiai lo losho le Manase, nkanas tomon.

English: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
Masaai: Ore ile Gershom te risioroto oo lmareita lenye neorikini nkanas tomon ookuni, o losho le Isaakar, o Asheri, o Naftali, o Manase te Bashan.

English: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
Masaai: Ore too le Merari te risioroto oo lmareita lenye neorikini Nkanas tomon oare to losho le Ruben, o Gad, o Sebulon.

English: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
Masaai: Kaae neisho iltung'ana le Israel ile Lawi nkanas tenebo ndaat enye oo nchoo.

English: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
Masaai: Neisho sii ninche te oshoto e nkukuo kuna anas naaipotoki tene oo loshon le Yuda, o Simeon o Benchamen.

English: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore kulikae mareita loo layiok le Kohat neeta nkanas natii enkop enye apa anaa inolosho le Efraim.

English: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ninche apa eishooki nkanas e sarunoto. Shekem tenebo nena daat enyena oo nchoo, te nkop oo ldoinyio e Efraim. O Geser tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
Masaai: O Yokmeam tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo. O Bet-horon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:
Masaai: o Aijalon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Gatrimon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
Masaai: ore to lpisiaai le nkop o losho le Manase neya Aner tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Bileam tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, te nkaraki lelo mareita loo le Kohat.

English: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
Masaai: Ore ile Gershom neishori olpisiaai le nkop e Manase: Golan te Bashan, tenebo nkanas enyena pooki o Ashtarot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
Masaai: ore to losho le Isakar neyai Kadesh tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Damerat tenebo nena ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
Masaai: o Ramot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Anem tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore to losho le Asheri neyai: Mashal tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Abdon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
Masaai: o Hukok tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Rahob tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
Masaai: Ore to losho le Naftali neyai: Kadesh te Galilaya tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Hamon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Kiriataim tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun. Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
Masaai: Ore lelo ootelekutua loo le Merari, neorikini ewueji olosho le Sebulon: Rimono tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo: o Tabor tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo,

English: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
Masaai: o te lido kekun lo lkeju le Yordan, te Yeriko, te nkalo oloo saen to lkeju le Yordan, ore to losho le Ruben neyai: Beser tiong'ota, tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Yahasa tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o

English: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
Masaai: Kedemot tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Mafaat tenebo ndaat enyena, oo nchoo.

English: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
Masaai: Ore to losho le Gad neyai, Ramot te Gilead tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo, o Mahanaim tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo

English: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
Masaai: o Hesbon tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo o Yaser tenebo ndaat enyena oo nchoo.

English: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Isaakar; Tola, o Pua o Yashub, o Shimron, lelo pokira oong'uan.

English: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father's house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Tola, Usi, o Refaia, o Yeriel, o Yahamai, o Ibsam, o Shemuel, ninche ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, aa taa Tola, Lmurran magil too lporori lenye. Ore esiana enye too nkolong'i e Daudi naa nkalifuni tikitam oare o iip ile.

English: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Usi: Israhia. Ore ilayiok le Israma naa: Mikael, o Obadia, o Yoel, o Ishia, lelo pokira imiet, naa iltung'ana kituaak pooki.

English: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninche too iishoritin enye, terisioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, naa iltimito le njore, nkalifuni tomoni uni oile, amu eeta apa ninche nkituaak kumok o layiok.

English: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana lenye ootii ilmareita le Isaakar naa nkalifuni ntomoni isiet oopishana pooki, ilmurran magil, eigeroki nkarn enye anaa iishoritin.

English: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Benchamen: Bela, o Besher, o Yediael, lelo pokira okuni.

English: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Bela: Esron, o Usi, o Usiel o Yerimot o Iri, lelo pokira imiet, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ilmurran magil. Ore enkigeroto enye anaa too iishoritin enye naa nkalifuni tikitam oare o tomoni uni oong'uan.

English: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Beker: Semira o Yoash, o Eliesa, o Elioenai, o Omori, o Yeremot, o Abija o Anatot o Alemet. Ore apa kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Beker.

English: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of the fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
Masaai: Ore enkigeroto oo nkarn enye te risioroto oo iishoritin enye, anaa lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, lelo murran magil naa nkalifuni tikitam o iip are.

English: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yediel: Bilhan. Ore ilayiok le Bilhan naa Yeush o Benchamen, o Ehud, o Shenana, Sesan, o Tarshish o Ahishahar.

English: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yediel kulo pooki te risioroto oo lukuny oo nkajijik oo loomenye, ilmurran magil ninche. Nkalifuni tomon oopishana o iip are esiana enye, ilooterretenate to larrabal.

English: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
Masaai: Ore Shupim o Hupim naa ilayiok le Iri, ore Hushim naa obo loo layiok le Aher.

English: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Naftali: Yahasiel, o Guni, o Yeser, o Shalum, ilo le ishoi e Bilhal.

English: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
Masaai: Ilayiok le Manase: Asriel laa ninye apa etoikio enkapiani enye e Aramean, etoiuo sii apa Makir menye le Gilead.

English: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister's name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
Masaai: Eyamaka sii apa Makir Hupim o Shupim. Ore enkarna e nkanashe enye naa Maaka. Ore enkarna e nkanashe enye e are naa Selofehad; neiu apa Selofehad ntoyie.

English: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
Masaai: Ore Maaka ina kitok e Makir neiu olayioni, neisho enkarna ajo Peres, ore enkarna o lalashe lenye naa Sheresh: Ore ilayiok lenyena naa Olam o Rakem.

English: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Ulam: Bedan. Kulo apa ilayiok le Gilead ole Makir, olayioni le Manase.

English: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
Masaai: Ore enkanashe enye Hamoleket neiu Ishod, o Abiesa, o Mahala.

English: And the sons of Shemidah were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shemida naa Ahian, o Shekem, o Likihi o Aniam.

English: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Efraim: Shutela, o Bered, olayioni lenye, o Tahat olayioni lenye, o Eleada olayioni lenye, o Tahat olayioni lenye,

English: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
Masaai: o Sabad olayioni lenye, o Shutela olayioni lenye, o Eser o Elead laa ninche apa ootasesekuana iltung'ana le Gat apa ootoiwuoki teina kop, enkaraki naetuo ninche aaibung nkishu enye.

English: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
Masaai: Neishiraki ninche Efraim papaai lenye nkolong'i kumok nepuonu ilalashera lenye aaitagol ninche.

English: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
Masaai: Nelo Efraim ayiolou enkitok enye, nenutayu ninye neiu enkayioni, neisho ninye enkarna ajo, Beria, enkaraki natijing'a entorroni atua enkaji enye.

English: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Bethhoron the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)
Masaai: Ore entito enye naa keji Sheera, naa ninye apa natesheta Betoron e abori o ene shumata o Usensheera.

English: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
Masaai: Rafan apa olayioni lenye, o Rashef olayioni lenye o Tela, olayioni lenye,

English: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Masaai: o Ladan olayioni lenye o Amihud olayioni lenye, o Elishama, olayioni lenye

English: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son.
Masaai: o Nuni olayioni lenye o Yoshua olayioni lenye.

English: And their possessions and habitations were, Bethel and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
Masaai: Ore apa emanyisho enye o masaa enye naa Betel o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o enkalo oloo saen le Naaran, o enkalo o loo ntoluo le Geser o nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Shekem o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o Aya o nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Bethshean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
Masaai: Tenebo sii ilpolosien loo le Manase, o Betshean tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o Taanak o nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o Dor o nkang'itie enyena kutiti. Kunen apa neemanya ilayiok le Yosef ole Israel.

English: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Asheri: Imna, o Ishfa o Ishfi, o Beria o enkanashe enye Sera.

English: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Beria: Heber o Malkiel, laa ninche apa iloomenye le Birsait.

English: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
Masaai: Herber apa menye le Yafet, o Shomer, o Hatam, o enkanashe enye Shua.

English: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yafet: Pasak, o Bimhal, o Ashfat. Kulo ninche ilayiok le Yafet.

English: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Shemer olalashe lenye: Roga, o Yehuba, o Aram.

English: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Helem olalashe lenye: Sofa, o Imna, o Shelesh, o Amal.

English: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
Masaai: Ilayiok le Sofa: Sua, o Harnefen o Shual, o Beri, o Imra,

English: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
Masaai: o Beser, o Hod, Shama, o Shilsha, o Iltran, o Beera.

English: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Yater: Yefune o Pispa o Ara.

English: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Ula: Ara, o Hamiel, o Risia.

English: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana le Asheri, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ilootonyorrayioki naa ilmurran magil, ilarikok loo lkituaak. Ore esiana enye anaa too iishoritin enye tenkaraki enkisiaayiare o larrabal, naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam o ile.

English: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
Masaai: Benchamen apa menye le Bela ilo kikau lenye, o Ashbel oliare, o Ahara oliokuni,

English: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
Masaai: o Noha oliong'uan, o Rafa ole imiet.

English: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
Masaai: Neeta apa Bela ilayiok: Adar, o Gera o Abihab,

English: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
Masaai: o Abishua, o Naaman, o Ahoa, o

English: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
Masaai: Gera, o Shefufan, o Huram.

English: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilayiok le Ehud (ninche apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye le lelo oomanya Geba, neewaki apa ninche eyararoto nepuo Mahat.)

English: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
Masaai: Naaman o Ahija o Gera, aa taa Heglam, laa ninye apa menye le Usa o Ahihud.

English: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
Masaai: Neeta apa Shaharaim ilayiok te nkop e Moab ina kata eidipa ataarai nkituaak enyena, Hushim o Baara.

English: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
Masaai: Etoikio ninye enkitok enye Hodesh nkera: Yobab o Sibia, o Meshia, o Melkam,

English: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
Masaai: o Yeus, o Sakia, o Mimra. Kulo apa ilayiok lenyena, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
Masaai: Eeta sii apa ilayiok ootoiuo Hushim enkitok enye: Abitub o Elpaal.

English: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
Masaai: O Eber, o Misham, o Shemed laa ninye apa otesheta Ono o Lod o nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
Masaai: Ore Beria o Shema, (naa ninche apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, te lelo oomanya enkop e Yalon, lelo oomir iltung'ana le Gat).

English: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
Masaai: O Ahio o Shashak o Yeremot.

English: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
Masaai: Ore Sebediah, o Arad o Eder,

English: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
Masaai: o Mikael, o Ishpa o Yoha naa ilayiok le Beria.

English: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
Masaai: Ore Sebadia o Meshulam, o Hiski, o Heber,

English: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
Masaai: o Ishmerai, o Islia o Yobab naa ilayiok le Elpaal.

English: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
Masaai: Ore Yakim o Sikri, o Sabdi,

English: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
Masaai: o Elienai o Siletia o Eliel,

English: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
Masaai: o Adaia, o Beraia o Shiurat naa ilayiok le Shimei.

English: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
Masaai: Ore Ishpan, o Eber o Eliel,

English: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
Masaai: o Abdon, o Sikri, o Hanan,

English: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
Masaai: o Hanania, o Elam, o Antotija,

English: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
Masaai: o Ifdeia o Penuel, naa ilayiok le Shashak.

English: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
Masaai: Ore Shamsherai, o sheharia, o Atalia, o

English: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
Masaai: Yaareshia o Eliya o Sikri, naa ilayiok le Yeroham.

English: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto oo iishoritin enye, iltung'ana kituaak ninche. Nebik kulo te Yerusalem.

English: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
Masaai: Ore Yaiel menye le Gibeon nebik te Gibeon, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Maaka.

English: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
Masaai: Ore olkikau lenye naa: Abdon, nesuju Suur, o Kish, o Baal, o Nadab,

English: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
Masaai: o Gedor, o Ahio, o Seker,

English: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
Masaai: o Miklot, (ninye apa menye le Shimea) Etamanyishote sii apa kulo aatashare ilalashera lenye te Yerusalem, tenebo iltung'ana lenye.

English: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
Masaai: Neer apa menye le Kish, Kish menye le Saul, naa Saul menye le Yonatan, o Malkishua o Abinadab o Eshbaal.

English: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
Masaai: Ore apa olayioni le Yonatan naa Meribaal; naa Meribaal apa menye le Mika.

English: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Mika: Pison o Melek, o Tarea o Ahas.

English: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
Masaai: Ahas apa menye le Yehoada; naa Yehoada menye le Alemet, o Asmefet, o Simri. Simri apa menye le Mosa.

English: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
Masaai: Mosa apa menye le Binea; naa Rafa olayioni lenye, o Eliesa, o Asel olayioni lenye.

English: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
Masaai: Eeta apa Asel ilayiok ile, naa kuna nkarn enye Asikarni o Bokero, o Ishmael, o Shearia, o Obadia, o Hanan. Ore kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Asel.

English: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Eshek olalashe lenye: Ulam olkikau lenye, o Yeush laa ninye oliare, o Elifelet laa ninye oliokuni.

English: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Ulam naa ilmorran magil, oata nkai, neeta nkera kumok, o nkera oo nkera enye, iip nabo o onom. Ore kulo pooki naa ile Benchamen.

English: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
Masaai: Eigeroki apa nkarn oo ltung'ana pooki le Israel anaa too iishoritin enye, neigeroki pooki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Israel. Neewaki apa iltung'ana le Yuda eyararoto te Babilon tenkaraki nemeisiligayu ninche.

English: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana le dukuya ootang'asa aamany iwuejitin tiatua nkanas enye naa ile Israel, o lapolosak, o le Lawi o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana le Yuda, na Benchamen o Efraim, o Manase nebik te Yerusalem.

English: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
Masaai: Utai ole Amihud, olayioni le Omri, olayioni le Imri, olayioni le Bani, oing'uaa ilayiok le Peres olayioni le Yuda.

English: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
Masaai: Ore too le Shilo naa: Asaia ilo kikau, o layiok lenyena.

English: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Serak naa: Yeul o lalashera lenyena, iip ile o ntomoni naaudo.

English: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
Masaai: Ore loo le Benchamen naa: Salu olayioni le Meshulam ole Hodafia, olayioni le Hasenau,

English: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
Masaai: o Ibneaia olayioni le Yeroham, o Elak olayioni le Usi olayioni le Mikri, o Meshulam olayioni le Shefatia olayioni le Reul, olayioni le Ibnija,

English: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
Masaai: ore ilalashera lenyena te risioroto oo iiishoritin enye naa iip naaudo o onom o ile. Ore kulo pooki naa lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
Masaai: Ore too lapolosak naa Yedaia, o Yehoiarib o Yakin,

English: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
Masaai: o Asaria olayioni le Hilkia, olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Sadok, ilo aitasheikinoni kitok le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
Masaai: O Pashur olayioni le Malkija o Maasai olayioni le Adiel, olayioni le Yehesera, olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Meshilamit, olayioni le Imer.

English: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ilalashera lenye o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana o ntomoni ile. Iltung'ana oata enkidimata oleng ninche, tenkaraki e nkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
Masaai: Ore too Lawi apa naa Shemaia olayioni le Hashub, olayioni le Asrikam, olayioni le Hasabia, loo layiok le Merari;

English: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
Masaai: o Babakar, o Heresh, o Galal, o Matamia olayioni le Mika, olayioni le Mikiri, olayioni le Asaf.

English: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
Masaai: O Obadiah olayioni le Shemaia, olayioni le Galal, olayioni le Yedutum, o Berekia olayioni le Asa, olayioni le Elkana laa ninche apa oomanya nkang'itie kutiti oo Lnetofati.

English: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
Masaai: Ore apa ilarripok le kishomi naa, Shalum, o Akun, o Talmon o Ahinam o lalashera lenyena, (aa Shalum olkitok).

English: Who hitherto waited in the king's gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
Masaai: Netipikaki lelo metorripo kishomi o laiguanani te nkalo o loosaen. Kulo apa ninche ilarripok le kishomi te nkang oo lng'oborri oo le Lawi.

English: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the LORD, were keepers of the entry.
Masaai: Ore Shalum olayioni le Kore, olayioni le Ebisaf, olayioni le Kora o lalashera lenyena, o enkaji e menye, lelo le Kora, naa ninche apa ooitasheiki esiaai e nkisampuare, ninche ilaing'urak le wueji nejing'ieki olng'obor anaa apa enaitasheiki iloo menye ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, nerrip kishomi.

English: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.
Masaai: Naa Finehas olayioni le Eliesa ninye apa oitasheiki ninche too nkolong'i naatulusoitie; netii Olaitoriani tenebo ninye.

English: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Masaai: Sekaria olayioni le Meshelemia apa olaing'urani le kishomi eilo ng'obor le ntumo.

English: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki ootegeluaki metaa larripok loo njing'eta olng'obor, naa iip are o tomon oare. Neigeroki ninche too iishoritin tiatua nkang'itie enye. Ore Daudi o Samuel ilo aduaani nepik ninche esiaai enye enkaraki naisiligayu ninche.

English: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
Masaai: Neaku ninche o layiok lenye ooitasheiki nchomito naajing'ieki enkaji o Laitoriani, o metabaiki ena olong, ina aji olng'obor, aaku ilarripok.

English: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo arripok loo nchomito netii imatuan ong'uan, oloosaen, o loontoluo, o kopikop o moikuape;

English: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
Masaai: ore lelo alashera lenye apa ootii nkang'itie enye nepuonu apa too rishat oo nkolong'i naapishana anaake, pee eaku tenebo kulo,

English: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
Masaai: amu ore apa lelo aitasheikinok le kishomi ong'uan kituaak, laa ile Lawi, naa ninche ooitasheiki nkajijik o neeshumishoreki e nkaji e Nkai;

English: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
Masaai: netoni aaman enkaji e Nkai amu ninche ilaing'urak, naa ninche oobol nchomito tadekenya anaake.

English: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
Masaai: Ore kulikae lenye neitasheiki imasaa e nkisiaayiare, amu keyieuni apa neikeni ninche teneitijing'uni o teneipang'ieki aaya.

English: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
Masaai: Ore kulikae lenye negeluni meitasheiki ilorikan o masaa pooki naasinya, o ina tapa napuyiapui, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata o enkorropil o sonkoyoni.

English: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
Masaai: Ore kulikae le lelo ayiok loo lapolosak neitushul isonkoyoni,

English: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
Masaai: ore Matitia obo loo Lawi, ilo kikau le Shalum le Kora, naa ninye oitasheiki enkitobirata oo mukateni dapashi.

English: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
Masaai: Ore sii kulikae alashera lenye le Kohat neitasheiki emukate e nkitoduaaroto, pee eitobir te pooki sabato.

English: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
Masaai: Naa kulo apa ilaranyak, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too le Lawi, oobikito too lgilat le nkaji e Nkai, lemetii ae kisiayiare, amu etii apa ninche esiaai enye dama o kewarie.

English: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too le Lawi, te risioroto oo iishoritin enye, lelo arikok apa oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:
Masaai: Emanya apa Gibeon menye le Gibeon, oji Yeiel, ore enkarna e nkitok enye naa Maaka,

English: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
Masaai: ore olkikau lenye naa Abdon, nesuju Sur, o Kish o Baal, o Neer, o Nadab,

English: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
Masaai: o Gedor o Ahio, o Sakaria, o Miklot,

English: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
Masaai: naa Miklot apa menye le Shimeam, ore sii kulo nemanyisho aataaniki ilalashera lenye te Yerusalem, tenebo iltung'ana lenye.

English: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
Masaai: Neer apa menye le Kish naa Kish menye le Saul, naa Saul menye le Yonatan, o Malkishua, o Aminadab o Esbaal:

English: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.
Masaai: ore olayioni le Yonatan naa Meribaal; naa Meribaal menye le Mika.

English: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Mika naa Pison, o Melek, o Taharea, o Ahas,

English: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
Masaai: naa Ahas apa menye le Yara, naa Yara menye le Alemet, o Asmafet, o Simri; naa Simri menye le Mosa.

English: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
Masaai: Mosa apa menye le Binea naa Refaia olayioni lenye, naa Eliesa olayioni lenye o Asiel olayioni lenye.

English: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
Masaai: Eeta apa Asel ilayiok ile naa kuna nkarn enye: Askrikam, o Bokeru, o Ishmael, o Shearia, o Obadia, o Hanan; kulo apa ninche ilayiok le Asel.

English: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
Masaai: Etaarare apa Ilfilisti Isiraeli neilanyisho iltung'ana le Israel te dukuya Ilfilisti, neari ninche meirragai etuata to ldoinyio le Gilboa.

English: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
Masaai: Neinepu Ilfilisti Saul o layiok lenyena; nesesekuan Ilfilisti Yonatan o Aminadab o Malkishua, lelo ayiok le Saul.

English: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
Masaai: Neirowuaju olarrabal ina olong tialo Saul, neinepu iltung'ana loo mbaa ninye; neng'or iltung'ana loo mbaa ninye nepik olbae.

English: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
Masaai: Nejoki Saul ilo anapani lenye loo masaa o larrabal, “Tushutu olalem lino, taremieki nanu matua, pee maapuonu ake kulo tung'ana lememurata aasul.” Kake etanya ilo anapani loo masaa enyena o larrabal; amu etureishe ninye oleng. Ore enkaraki ina neshutu Saul olalem lenye makewan nebatatakino.

English: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ilo anapani loo masaa enyena o larrabal ajo etua Saul, nebatatakino sii ninye olalem lenye, neye.

English: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Saul; ninye o layiok lenyena pokira okuni neidak enkaji enye pooki tenebo.

English: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki le Israel apa ootii atua oerata aajo eilanyishe enjore, netua sii Saul o layiok lenyena, neing'uaa ninche nkang'itie enye, neisik; nepuonu Ilfilisti aamany ninche.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu, ina kata pee epuo Ilfilisti aapur lelo ootuata, netum ninche Saul o layiok lenyena eirrag to ldoinyio le Gilboa.

English: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche imasaa enyena, neya endukuya enye o masaa enyena o larrabal, neiriwaa ilkiliku aaibulunye enkop pooki oo Lfilisti, pee eyae ilomon supati aayaki nkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin, oltung'ana.

English: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
Masaai: Nepik ninche imasaa enyena o larrabal atua enkaji oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye, neeniki endukuya enye enkaji e nkai naji Dagon.

English: And when all  Jabeshgilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Yabesh-gilead pooki nena naaitaasa Ilfilisti Saul,

English: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
Masaai: nedumunye lelo lewa pooki magil, neya osesen le Saul o loo layiok lenyena neyau ninche Yabesh. Nenukaa ninche iloik lenye tentonata olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli te Yabesh, neen ate aapukoo nkolong'i naapishana.

English: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
Masaai: Neaku etua apa Saul tenkaraki ina nemeisiligayu; meisilig apa ninye o Laitoriani amu eitu ninye eibung nkitanapat o Laitoriani nelo aikilikuanishore iloiriruani, eingoru eutaroto

English: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
Masaai: neitu ninye eing'oru eutaroto o Laitoriani. Ore enkaraki ina etara Olaitoriani ninye metua, neibelekenyaki enkitoo Daudi olayioni le Yese.

English: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana pooki le Israel aaiturrurro tenebo te netii Daudi te Hebron, nejo ninche, “Ng'ura, kira iyiook oloito lino o sesen lino.

English: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, o enapa kata doi ninye aa olaiguanani Saul, iyie apa orikoo Israel aipang'ie nintijing'u; nikitiaaka iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ‘Iyie oaku olairritani loo iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli, naa ilo aaku olkitok oitore iltung'ana laainei le Israel.’ ”

English: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel.
Masaai: Neaku eetuo ilpayiani pooki le Israel enetii olaiguanani te Hebron; neitobir Daudi olning'o o ninche te Hebron te dukuya Olaitoriani. Nebukoki ninche Daudi eilata aaput metaa olaiguanani le Israel, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani oimunye Samuel.

English: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
Masaai: Ore Daudi, o ltung'ana pooki le Israel nepuo Yerusalem, aa taa Yebus, ine apa netii Ilyebusi lelo oomanya ina kop.

English: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo oomanya Yebus Daudi, “Milotu iye ine.” Ore ake eyia neibung Daudi ina ang nagol e Sion, aa taa, enkanasa e Daudi.

English: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Ore oltung'ani oiter arasaki Ilyebusi naa keaku olkitok neaku olarikoni le njore.” Ore olayioni le Seroya, neituruk alo, neaku etaa ninye olkitok.

English: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
Masaai: Nebik Daudi tiatua ina ang nasheta sunta, neaku etejoki apa ine enkanasa e Daudi.

English: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
Masaai: Neshet ninye ina anasa aitamanaa ebaiki Milo neidip aitamanaa. Neitoki Yoab aram ineetebelate te nkanasa.

English: So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.
Masaai: Neponari Daudi aaku kitok oleng, amu etii apa Olaitoriani loo lororani tenebo ninye.

English: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
Masaai: Naa kulo apa ilkituaak le lelo tung'ana le Daudi magil, laa ninche ootijing'a ninye enkoriong te nkitoria enye, tenebo Israel pooki, pee eitaa ninche olaiguanani, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani oipirta Israel.

English: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, and Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
Masaai: Kulo lelo tung'ana le Daudi magil; Yashabean le Hakomon, ilo arikoni le lelo okuni, etara ninye te mpere iltung'ana iip uni near pooki metuata te nkata nabo.

English: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
Masaai: Ore oliare ninye te lelo pokira okuni magil naa, Eliesa olayioni le Dodo, le Ahoti.

English: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
Masaai: Etii apa ninye tenebo Daudi te Pas-damim ina kata apa pee eiturrurro Ilfilisti teine to larrabal. Etii apa ine enkurma nabore shairi neisik iltung'ana aailany Ilfilisti.

English: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.
Masaai: Kake eitasho ninye te mpolos eina kurma neisulie, nesesekuan Ilfilisti, neitajeu Olaitoriani ninche te nkisulata kitok.

English: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Ore lelo okuni le lelo tung'ana pokira tomoni uni kituaak nedoyio aapuo endapidapoi ine netii Daudi te nkapune e Adulam, ina kata etii enjore oo Lfilisti ilng'oborri to erata le Refaim.

English: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
Masaai: Netii apa Daudi ina kata atua osempewuet; netii oltim loo Ilfilisti ina kata Betlehem.

English: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Bethlehem, that is at the gate!
Masaai: Nejo Daudi eeta enkure, “Woi naaji tenatum oltung'ani laayaki enkare naok to lchorro le Betlehem otii embata e kishomi!”

English: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the LORD,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana okuni magil neim atua ilng'oborri loo Lfilisti; nepuo aaoku enkare teilo shorro le Betlehem otii embata e kishomi, neyaki Daudi. Kake eitu eok Daudi, etubukoko ninye Olaitoriani,

English: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
Masaai: nejo, “Maatalama nanu ena te dukuya Olaitoriani tenaa kaas ena. Kaok nanu osarge le nkishui le kulo lewa? amu etipika ninche enkishui enye batisho pee eyau.” Kuna baa etaasa lelo tung'ana okuni magil.

English: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
Masaai: Ore apa Abishai, olalashe le Yoab laa olarikoni le tomoni uni. Near ninye te mpere iltung'ana iip uni metuata, nening'oyu enkarna enye tenebo lelo okuni.

English: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
Masaai: Ninye apa yioloti oleng te lelo tomoni uni, neaku olarikoni lenye, kake eitu etiu anaa lelo pokira okuni.

English: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
Masaai: Naa ore apa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida naa oltung'ani oning'o oleng te Kabseel olaasani loo mbaa sapuki; etara ninye iltung'ana oare yiolot le Moab metuata. Eshomo sii apa ajing'aki olng'atuny te ngumoto near metua teina olong apa naiputa enkirobi enkop.

English: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian's hand, and slew him with his own spear.
Masaai: Etara sii apa metua Olmisiri, ilo tung'ani apa sapuk laa ntemat e nkaina imiet enkadoro, eeta ilo Misiri empere enye naba anaa embokishi; kake eshomo Benaia enetii ninye eeta eng'udi ake, newuapaa empere te nkaina e ilo Misiri near ninye metua te mpere enye makewan.

English: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
Masaai: Kuna baa etaasa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida, nening'oyu enkarna enye tenebo lelo tung'ana okuni magil.

English: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
Masaai: Ening'o apa ninye oleng te lelo tomoni uni, kake menyaanyukie lelo pokira okuni. Nepik Daudi ninye meitasheiki lelo arripok lenyena.

English: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
Masaai: Ore apa lelo tung'ana magil loo njorin naa Asahel, olalashe le Yoab, o Elhanan olayioni le Dodo le Betlehem,

English: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
Masaai: o Shumot le Harod, o Heles le Peloni,

English: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
Masaai: o Ira olayioni le Ilkedesh le Tekoa, o Abiesa le Anatot,

English: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
Masaai: o Sibekai, le Hushati, o Ilai le Ahoti,

English: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
Masaai: o Maharia le Netofa, o Heled olayioni le Baana le Netofam, o

English: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
Masaai: Itai olayioni le Ribai le Gibea loo le Benchamen, o Benaia le Piraton,

English: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
Masaai: o Hurai too nchorroi e Gash, o Abiel le Abati,

English: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
Masaai: o Asmafet le Baharum, o Eliaba le Shaalbon,

English: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
Masaai: o Hashem, le Gison, o Yonatan olayioni le Shagee le Harari,

English: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
Masaai: o Ahinoam olayioni le Sakar le Harari, o Elifat olayioni le Uri,

English: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
Masaai: o Hafer le Mecherat, o Ahija le Pelon

English: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
Masaai: o Hesso le Karmel, o Naarai olayioni le Esbai,

English: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
Masaai: o Yoel olalashe le Natan, o Mibar olayioni le Hagri,

English: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
Masaai: o Selek le Amon, o Naharai le Beerot, ilo anapani loo masaa olarrabal e Yoab olayioni le Seruya.

English: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
Masaai: O ira le Itiri, o Gareb le Itiri,

English: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
Masaai: o Uria le Hiti, o Sabad olayioni le Ahalai,

English: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
Masaai: o Adina olayioni le Shisa le Ruben, olarikoni loo le Ruben, tomoni uni ootii tenebo ninye,

English: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
Masaai: o Hanan olayioni le Maaka o Yoshafat le Mitini,

English: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
Masaai: o Usia le Asheri, o Shama o Yerel ilayiok le Hotam le Arori,

English: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
Masaai: o Yediel olayioni le Shiuri o Yoha olalashe lenye, le Tisi,

English: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
Masaai: o Eliel le Mahafi, o Yeribai o Yoshafia, ilayiok le Elnaan, o Itam, o Itma le Moab,

English: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
Masaai: o Eliel, o Obed, o Yaasiel le Moraba.

English: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa ooetuo enetii Daudi te Siklag, ina kata metumoki ashomo oleng tenkaraki Saul olayioni le Kish; netii apa ninche tenebo lelo tung'ana magil ootareto ninye to larrabal.

English: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul's brethren of Benjamin.
Masaai: Iltung'ana oong'oroo mbaa ninche, naa keidim ninche aatang'oroi mbaa nenang'aa isoito te nkopito, te nkaina e tatene aashu te kedienye. Ile Benchamen ninche, lo lgilata le Saul.

English: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
Masaai: Ore apa olkitok lenye naa Ahiesa, nesujaki Yoash, naa ilayiok le Shemaa pokira, le Gibea; o Yesiel sii o Pelet ilayiok le Asmafet; o Beraka, o Yehu le Anatot,

English: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
Masaai: o Ishmai le Gibeon, ilo tung'ani magilani te lelo tomoni uni naa olarikoni le lelo tomoni uni; o Yeremia o Yohasiel, o Yohanan, o Yosabad le Gedera,

English: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
Masaai: o Elusai, o Yerimot, o Bealia, o Shemaria, o Shefatia, le Harufi,

English: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and PrAzareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
Masaai: o Elkana, o Ishia, o Asarel, o Yoeser, o Yashobeam, le Kora;

English: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
Masaai: o Yaela, o Sebadia, lelo ayiok le Yeroham le Gedor.

English: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
Masaai: Ore too le Gad nepuo enetii Daudi to sempewuet otii ong'ata ilmurran magil oogol, arriyiak too long'oi o remeta, ootiu nkomomi enye anaa iloo ng'atunyo, neneneng anaa ntarakueti too nchumat oo ldoinyio:

English: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
Masaai: Esa laa ninye olkitok, o Obadia aa ninye oliare, o Eliab aa ninye oliokuni,

English: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
Masaai: o Mishamana aa ninye oliong'uan, o Yeremia aa ninye olayioni le imiet,

English: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
Masaai: o Atai aa ninye olayioni le ile, o Eliel, aa ninye oliopishana,

English: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
Masaai: o Yohanan aa ninye olayioni le isiet, o Elasabad aa ninye olioudo,

English: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
Masaai: o Yeremia naa ninye olayioni le tomon, o Makabania aa ninye olayioni le tomon oobo.

English: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa le Gad ninche ilkituaak le njore. Ore ilkuti naa shumata e iip nabo, ore ilkumok naa shumata enkalifu nabo.

English: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
Masaai: Kulo tung'ana apa lelo ootalang'a olkeju le Yordan to lapa le dukuya, ina kata edooyo enkare aim mpoorri, neisikie lelo pooki ootii ierat, te nkalo o loo saen o to loo ntoluo.

English: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana le Benchamen o Yuda nepuonu osempewuet enetii Daudi.

English: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
Masaai: Nelo Daudi anang'are ninche nejoki ninche, “Tenaa iyetuo intae enatii nanu to sotua, pee kiretutu nanu, naa keibung'are oltau lai intae; kake tenaa ietuo pee kikaldaa too lmang'ati laainei, hoo tenemaata entorroni nataasa nchoo naa edol Enkai oo loo papa neitalaku te intae.”

English: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Amasia, ilo kitok le tomoni uni, nejo ninye: “Kira iyiook ilkulinono iyie Daudi; kitii tenebo iyie ara Yese! Eseriani, eseriani te iyie naa eseriani too laretok linono! Amu kiretu iyie Enkai ino.” Neng'amu Daudi ninche, neitaa ninche ilkituaak loo ltimito lenyena le njore.

English: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana le Manase neisik aapuo enetii Daudi ina kata pee epuonu Ilfilisti olarrabal aarare Saul. (Ore ake eyia eitu ninye eretu Lfilisti, amu eiguanate ilaitoriak lenye nearaa ninye, ejo, “Ilukuny ang edung'ori, teneing'uaa ninye iyiook nerrinyokino olkitok lenye Saul.”)

English: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuo Siklag nepuo kulo tung'ana le Manase enetii ninye: Adna, o Yodabad, o Yediel, o Mikael, o Yosabad, o Elihu o Siletai, o laiguanak le nkalifu te Manase.

English: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
Masaai: Etareto apa ninche Daudi tialo olturrur loo lapurrok, amu iltung'ana apa oopi ninche naa magil, naa ilarikok le njore.

English: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
Masaai: Amu ore apa too nkolong'i pooki naa kepuonu apa iltung'ana enetii Daudi, ometaba anaa neaku olorora kitok le njore, nebayu anaa enjore e Nkai.

English: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Ena ninye esiana e lelo timito le njore le Daudi, apa ooetuo enetii Daudi te Hebron, pee eibelekeny enkitoria e Saul aaibelekenyaki Daudi, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani.

English: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
