Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Yuda oata ilong'oi o remeta naa nkalifuni ile o iip isiet ilturrurri ootanapate.

English: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
Masaai: Ore too le Simeon, iltung'ana magil arriyiak to larrabal, naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip nabo.

English: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ore too le Lawi naa nkalifuni ong'uan o iip ile,

English: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
Masaai: ore ilo kitok oji Yehoida le nkaji e Aron, ore tenebo ninye netii iltung'ana nkalifuni uni o iip naapishana.

English: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father's house twenty and two captains.
Masaai: Ore Sadok, ilo barnoti magilani nepi netii tenebo ilarikok le njore tikitam oare lolmarei lenye.

English: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
Masaai: Ore too le Benchamen, ilo le ntalipa oo Saul, netii iltung'ana nkalifuni uni, ore ilkumok lenye neibung'are enkaji e Saul.

English: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore too le Efraim naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam o iip isiet, iltung'ana magil oopi, iltung'ana ooning'o too nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai lo losho le Manase naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon oisiet, laa ninche apa etegeluaki pee epuonu aaitaa Daudi olaiguanani.

English: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
Masaai: Ore too le Isaakar, lelo tung'ana ang'eni ooyiolo nkatitin, ooyiolo enayieu Israel neas, naa iltung'ana kituaak iip are, tenebo lelo alashera lenye pooki ootii abori enkitoria enye.

English: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
Masaai: Ore too le Sebulon naa iltung'ana nkalifuni onom, ootanapate to larrabal neeta masaa pooki e njore o larrabal, pee eretu Daudi to ltau obo metii olng'ash.

English: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Naftali naa ilkituaak le njore enkalifu nabo ootii tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni oopishana oata ilong'oi o remeta.

English: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ore too le Dan naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oisiet o iip ile iltung'ana ootanapate pee epuo olarrabal.

English: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Asheri naa iltung'ana nkalifuni artam o iip ile arriyiak te pooki arrabal.

English: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Ruben o le Gad o lpisiai lo losho le Manase ootii lido kekun olkeju le Yordan naa iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o tikitam oota imasaa pooki olarrabal.

English: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
Masaai: Ore kulo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal, neishopo iruparen, nepuonu Hebron eeta eyieunoto pee eitaa Daudi olaiguanani le Israel pooki. Neijia sii apa etiu ilkulikae tung'ana le Israel, etumuta nabo pee eitaa Daudi olaiguanani.

English: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
Masaai: Netii apa ninche tenebo Daudi too nkolong'i uni, einos endaa neokisho, amu eitobirakitia apa ilalashera lenye ina.

English: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
Masaai: Ore sii lelo le latia enye ebaiki Isaakar o Sebulon o Naftali, nepuonu enapita ndaiki too sirkon, o too ntamesin o too nyumpui, o too lmong'i, neyau ndaiki kumok, o mukateni oo lng'abolo, o sabibu ooitoyioki, o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata, o lmong'i o lkerra, amu keetae apa enchipai te Israel.

English: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore apa Daudi ilarikok loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip o pooki arikoni.

English: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi ina umata oo Siraeli, “Tenidolidolo intae eishiakino, naa tenaa eyieunoto o Olaitoriani Enkai ang, mairriwaki olkilikuai lelo alashera lang apa ootung'uaiyioki te nkop e Israel, o tenebo lelo apolosak ootii atua nena anas naata ndaat oo nchoo pee etum ninche aaetu tenebo enikitii.

English: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
Masaai: Naa manyaaki iyiook aayau osanduku le Nkai ene nikitii amu kitapalaitie apa too nkolong'i e Saul.”

English: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
Masaai: Nenyorraa ina umata pooki aas ina, amu eisidai apa ina bae too nkonyek o lorere.

English: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.
Masaai: Neiturrur apa Daudi Israel pooki ebaiki Shihor e Misiri o meetu enejing'ieki Hamat, pee eyau osanduku le Nkai te Kiriat-Yearim.

English: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o ltung'ana le Israel pooki neilep aapuo Baala, aa taa Kiriat-Yearim natii Yuda, pee epuo aayau teine osanduku le Nkai, laa ninye eipotieki Olaitoriani oton te nchumata oo Lkerubi.

English: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
Masaai: Nenap ninche ilo sanduku le Nkai te ngarri ng'ejuk, aaitung'uaa enkaji e Aminadab, naa Usa, o Ahio apa ooreu ina garri.

English: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
Masaai: Ore Daudi o Siraeli pooki neshipa te dukuya Enkai te nkidimata enye pooki, to sinkolio, o to lwulul loo usin, o too nkai oo sinkolioitin, o too ndulen o too nkinantani dapashi o too ntarumpetani.

English: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau olkurroto oidong'ishoreki le Kidon, neiteleiki Usa enkaina enye ilo sanduku, amu etarrorre apa ilo kiteng,

English: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
Masaai: neyupuyup engoro o Laitoriani tialo Usa; neosh ninye tenkaraki naitorioyie enkaina enye aibung ilo sanduku; neye ninye teine te dukuya Enkai.

English: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
Masaai: Negoro Daudi enkaraki natarasaka Olaitoriani Usa; ore ine wueji neaku keji Peres Usa; o taata.

English: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
Masaai: Neureyu Daudi Olaitoriani oleng ina olong, nejo ninye, “Kaji nanu aiko tenayau osanduku le Nkai enkaji ai?”

English: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.
Masaai: Neaku eitu eya Daudi ilo sanduku ang, atua enkanasa e Daudi, kake eibakibakie aya enkaji e Obed-edom le Giti.

English: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obededom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obededom, and all that he had.
Masaai: Neton ilo sanduku le Nkai te nkaji e Obed-edom ilapaitin okuni, nemayian Olaitoriani enkaji e Obed-edom o pooki toki naata.

English: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
Masaai: Eirriwayie apa Hiram olaiguanani le Turo olkilikuai enetii Daudi, o ltarakua, o laguetak loo soito sii o laguetak loo mbaoi, pee eshetaki enkaji.

English: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
Masaai: Nemusu Daudi ajo eitasheyie Olaitoriani ninye metaa olaiguanani le Israel, ore enkitoria enye neisisi oleng te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena Israel.

English: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
Masaai: Neyam Daudi nkituaak kumok te Yerusalem, netum Daudi ilayiok kumok o ntoyie.

English: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
Masaai: Kuna ninche nkarn o nena kera naanoto ninye te Yerusalem: Shamua, o Shobab, o Natan, o Solomon,

English: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
Masaai: o Ibar, o Elishua, o Elpelet,

English: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
Masaai: o Noga, o Negef, o Yafia,

English: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
Masaai: o Elishama, o Bediada, o Elifelet.

English: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Lfilisti etuputoki Daudi aaitaa olaiguanani te Israel pooki, nepuo Lfilisti pooki aaing'oru Daudi; nening Daudi ina nelo agilunore ninche.

English: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Neetuo apa Lfilisti nerasaki oerata le Refaim.

English: And David enquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the LORD said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Daudi Olaitoriani ejo, “Kalo nanu aarare Lfilisti?” Nchoru iyie ninche apik atua enkaina ai? Newaliki Olaitoriani ninye ejo, “Ilepa shomo, amu kaishoru nanu ninche apik atua enkaina ino.”

English: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.
Masaai: Neilep ninye alo Baalperasim, nemir Daudi ninche teine; nejo Daudi, “Etusulaka Enkai ilmang'ati laainei enkaina ai, anaa oloirrag le nkare.” Ore enkaraki ina naa keji enkarna eine wueji Baalperasim.

English: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Lfilisti nkaitin enye teine neitanapisho Daudi pee epejori.

English: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
Masaai: Neigil ake Lfilisti aarasaki ilo erata.

English: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eigil Daudi aikilikuanishore Enkai, nejoki Enkai ninye, “Milo iyie asujaa ninche; tamanai shomo pee ilo arasaki ninche te nkishaakinoto oo lkeek ooji Balsham.

English: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ining oltoilo le nkiyukoto te nchumata oo lkeek le basasam, shomo taa tarasaki ninche; amu eshomo Enkai te dukuya iyie pee eosh enjore oo lfilisti.”

English: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
Masaai: Neas Daudi anaa enaitanapa Enkai, near ninche enjore oo Lfilisti ebaiki Gibeon ometabaiki Geser.

English: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.
Masaai: Nelo olning'o le Daudi aibulaa too nkuapi pooki neyau Olaitoriani euriata enye shumata nkuapi pooki.

English: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
Masaai: Eteshetaka apa Daudi kewan nkajijik te nkanasa e Daudi; neitobir ewueji nepiki osanduku le Nkai, neunoki olng'obor shumata ninye.

English: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Meetae hoo oltung'ani obo meteleku Ilawi ake ooidim aatanap osanduku le Nkai, amu etegelua Olaitoriani ninche metanapa osanduku lo Laitoriani, neisiai ninye ntarasi.”

English: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
Masaai: Neiturrur Daudi Israel pooki te Yerusalem, pee etum aayau osanduku lo Laitoriani ewueji enye; ine apa neitobiraki.

English: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
Masaai: Neiturrur Daudi tenebo ilayiok le Aron o Lawi:

English: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
Masaai: loo layiok le Kora, o Uriel ilo kitok, tenebo lelo alashera lenyena iip o tikitam;

English: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
Masaai: ore too layiok le Merari, naa Asaia ilo kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena iip are o tikitam.

English: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Gershom, naa Yoel ilo kitok tenebo ilalashera lenyena iip o tomoni uni;

English: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
Masaai: ore too layiok le Elisafan, naa Shemaia ilo kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena iip are.

English: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Hebron naa Eliel ilo kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena ntomoni isiet.

English: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Usiel naa Aminadab ilo kitok tenebo ilalashera lenyena iip o tomon oare.

English: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi aipotu ilapolosak, Sadok o Abiata o Lawi, o Uriel, o Asaia, o Yoel, o Shemaia, o Eliel, o Aminadab,

English: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Irara intae ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too Lawi, entisinya naa ate, intae o lalashera linyi, pee itumutumu aayau osanduku lo Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli, ine wueji naitobiraka nanu ninye.

English: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki neitu apa intae inapinapa te dukuya, etagorokine iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang, enkaraki neitu iyiook kishilaa teina oitoi, nategeluaki.”

English: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Kaae neitisiny ate ilapolosak o Lawi, pee etum aayau osanduku lo Laitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Nenapu Ilawi ilo sanduku le Nkai too loilila lenye too mbokishi, anaa apa enaitanapishe Musa te risioroto o rorei lo laitoriani.

English: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Daudi aitanap lelo kituaak loo Lawi, pee egelu ilalashera lenye pee eranyisho nebuaku te oshoto oo nkinantani, too nkai oo sinkoliotin, o lwululi loo usin o nkinantani, neilepie oltoilo le ng'ida.

English: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
Masaai: Neaku etegelutua apa Ilawi Heman olayioni le Yoel o lalashera lenyena, Asaf olayioni le Berekia; o layiok le Merari, o lalashera lenye, o Etam olayioni le Kushaia;

English: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, the porters.
Masaai: ore tenebo ninche netii ilalashera lenye te ntukus e are e Sakaria o Yaasiel, o shemiramot, o Yehiel, o Uni, o Eliab o Benaia o Maaseia, o Matitia, o Elifele, o Mikneia, o larripok le kishomi, Obed-edom o Yaeil.

English: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
Masaai: Ore ilaranyak Heman o Asaf o Etan naa pee eosh aaitabuaku nkinantani dapashi o suyai,

English: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
Masaai: ore Sakaria, o Asiel, o Shemiramot, o Yehiel, o Uni, o Eliab o Maaseia, o Benaia, neosh ninche nkai oo sinkolioitin, te risioroto o ltoilo le Alamot;

English: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
Masaai: kake ore Matitia o Elifele, o Mikneia, o Obed-edom o Yerel, o Asasia, nerikoo eoshoto oo lwululi loo usin, terisioroto oltoilo le Shemnit,

English: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
Masaai: o Kenania olarikoni lo sinkolio too Lawi, ninye orikoo osinkolio, amu keyiolo apa.

English: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
Masaai: Ore Berekia o Elkana neaku ilarripok le kutukaji ine netii osanduku.

English: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
Masaai: Ore Shebania o Yoshefat, o Natanel, o Amasai, o Sakaria, o Benaia, o Eliesa, lelo apolosak, ninche oosh ntarumpetani te dukuya ilo sanduku le Nkai. Ore sii Obed-edom o Yehia naa ninche ilarripok le kutukaji eine netii osanduku.

English: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa Daudi o lpayiani, o lkituaak loo nkalifuni, aayau osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani te nkaji e Obed-edom te ng'ida.

English: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
Masaai: Naa ore amu etareto apa Olaitoriani lelo Lawi oonapita osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, etopolosa ninche iloing'ok oopishana, o ilmeregeshi oopishana.

English: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
Masaai: Neishopito apa Daudi olkila le kitani sidai napiyaya, naa neijia sii eikununo lelo Lawi pooki oonapita osanduku, o laranyak, o Kenania ilo arikoni lo sinkolio o laranyak; neishop Daudi enkila olgoo e Kitani.

English: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
Masaai: Neaku eyautua iltung'ana le Israel pooki osanduku le lning'o lo Laitoriani too mbuakunot, o to ltoilo le mouo, o ntarumpetani, o nkinantani dapashi, nebuaku aaranyisho too nkai oo sinkoliotin, o lwululi loo usin.

English: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
Masaai: Ore egira ilo sanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani alotu enkanasa e Daudi, nerum Mikal entito e Saul Daudi te lusie, nedol olaiguanani Daudi eranyisho eipid aranyisho neng'ida; nemenaa ninye to ltau lenye.

English: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
Masaai: Neyau ninche aaitijing'u ilo sanduku le Nkai, nepik atua ilo ng'obor otuuno Daudi tenkaraki ninye; neitayu ninche olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani te dukuya Enkai.

English: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Daudi aitayu olasar oopejori o lasarri le seriani, nemayian olorere te nkarna Olaitoriani,

English: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
Masaai: neorioriki iltung'ana le Israel pooki, ilewa o ntomonok, neisho ake oltung'ani embelati e mukate, o ldung'oti le nkiring'o, o emukate oo lng'abolo.

English: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:
Masaai: Neitoki sii agelu kulikae tung'ana loo Lawi pee eaku ilaisiaayiak te dukuya osanduku lo Laitoriani, pee edamu, neranyisho neisho enashe, neisis Olaitoriani Enkai e Israeli.

English: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
Masaai: Asaf apa olkitok lenye nesujaki Sakaria, o Yeiel, o Shemuramot, o Yehiel, o Matitia, o Eliab, o Benaia, o Obed-edom, o Yeiel, laa ninche oowosh nkai oo sinkoloitin, o lwululi loo usin; naa Asafowosh enkinanta oo saanini dapashi,

English: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
Masaai: ore Benaia o Yahasiel, lelo apolosak naa ninche oowosh ntarumpetani anaake te dukuya ilo sanduku lo sotua le Nkai.

English: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong, neng'as Daudi agelu metaranyi isinkolioitin le nkishooroto e nashe, nerany Asaf o lalashera lenyena.

English: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalie nkiaasin enyena tiatua iloreren!

English: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Masaai: Entaranyaki ninye, entaranyaki ninye enkisisa entolimu isiaaitin enyena pooki e nking'asia!

English: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
Masaai: Entaa enkarna enye kitok sinyati; nchoo iltauja le lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani eng'ida!

English: Seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
Masaai: Eng'oru Olaitoriani o engolon enye, eng'oru ninye anaake!

English: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
Masaai: Entadamu nena siaaitin enking'asia naataasa ninye, o enkiguana natudung'o ninye.

English: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
Masaai: Na ishoi e Abraham, ilo sinka lenye, lo ayiok le Yakobo, oogeluno.

English: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai ang ninye, etii nkiguanat enyena enkop pooki.

English: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
Masaai: Eibung ninye osotua lenye ntarasi; teilo rorei apa otejo ninye too iishoritin enkalifu nabo.

English: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
Masaai: Ilo sotua apa oitobira ninye o Abraham, ina kisiligata o lmumai tenkaraki Isaak,

English: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
Masaai: naitasheyie ninye metaa enkitanapata te Yakobo, metaa olning'o lo sotua te Israel,

English: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
Masaai: ejo, “Iyie nanu aisho enkop e Kanaan, erubata ina naaku enjung'ore ino.”

English: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
Masaai: Ore apa aa kuti ninche nemedupa ninche, naa ilomon,

English: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
Masaai: elimana ninche to losho o to losho, te nkitoria nabo ometabaiki likae orere,

English: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
Masaai: eitu ninye eisho likae tung'ani meibooki ninche enkop; neisikong ninye ilaiguanak tenkaraki ninche,

English: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
Masaai: ejo “Miseyie lelo lainei ootubukokoki eilata aaput, miinyal ake iloibonok laainei!”

English: Sing unto the LORD, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
Masaai: Taranyaki Olaitoriani na kop pooki, mbalunye enjeunoto enye nkolong'i pooki.

English: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
Masaai: Mbalunye enkitoo e nkisisa enye too nkuapi pooki, o nena siaaitin enyena e nking'asia too loreren pooki!

English: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
Masaai: Amu aikitok Olaitoriani, naa keisisi ninye oleng, naa keyanyituni ninye aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.

English: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
Masaai: Amu ore nkaitin pooki oo loreren naa nkitanyaanyukot, kake Olaitoriani oitobira keper.

English: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
Masaai: Etii enkanyit o enkitoo dukuya ninye; netii engolon o eng'ida emanyisho enye.

English: Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo too lmareita pooki loo loreren, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon!

English: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo naishiakino enkarna enye; eyau enkishoroto nipuonunu dukuya ninye! Enteserem Olaitoriani te seremata sinyati;

English: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
Masaai: nkirikirayu te dukuya ninye na kop pooki; ee, eitashe enkop pooki aitirring'a, nemeigusugusieki aekata.

English: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
Masaai: Nchoo eshipayu keper, neng'idayu enkop, naa nchoo ninche ejo tiatua iloshon, “Olaitoriani oitoreisho!”

English: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
Masaai: Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha, o nena pooki naabore atua ninye, nchoo eosh enkop olkerempe o pooki toki natii atua.

English: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the LORD, because he cometh to judge the earth.
Masaai: Neranyisho ilkeek le ntim te ng'ida, te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu kelotu ninye aiguanare enkop.

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo enashe Olaitoriani, amu aisupat ninye; amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi!

English: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
Masaai: Tejo sii iyie: “Tokordu iyiook, Na Ai e njeunoto ang, ninturrurru iyiook nintajeu tiatua iloshon, pee kitum aaishoo enashe enkarna ino, niking'idare enkisisa ino.

English: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ebaiki ntarasi o ntarasi!” Kaae nejo iltung'ana pooki, “Esai”, naa meisisi Olaitoriani.

English: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:
Masaai: Neaku etung'uayie apa Daudi Asaf o lalashera lenyena teine te dukuya osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, pee eisiaisho anaake te dukuya ilo sanduku anaa enayieuni te pooki olong,

English: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
Masaai: o Obed-edom o lalashera lenyena ntomoni ile oisiet; ina kata aa ilarripok le kishomi Obed-edom, olayioni le Yehutum o Hosa naa larripok le kishomi.

English: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that was at Gibeon,
Masaai: Neing'uaa sii Sadok ilo apolosani o lalashera lenyena lelo apolosak te dukuya ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani, teine wueji neika te Gibeon.

English: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;
Masaai: Pee eitaki Olaitoriani ilasarri oopejori anaake tadekenya o teipa, te risioroto e nena pooki naaigeroki te nkitanapata o Laitoriani naitanapa ninye Israel.

English: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever;
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninye netii Heman o Yedutum, o lelo kulikae ootegeluaki neipoti nkarn meishoo enashe o Laitoriani, amu ebik enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
Masaai: Neeta apa Heman o Yedutum ntarumpetani o nkinantani dapashi tenkaraki osinkolio, o ntokitin naaranyieki osinkolio osinya. Netegeluaki apa ilayiok le Yedutum meitasheiki kishomi.

English: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
Masaai: Neitoki iltung'ana pooki aarrinyo nelo ake oltung'ani enkaji enye nelo Daudi pee emayian olmarei lenye.

English: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.
Masaai: Ore apa etobiko Daudi te nkaji enye, nejoki ninye Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai, “Ng'ura, abikito nanu tiatua enkaji oo ltarakua, kake ore osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani naa olng'obor etii.”

English: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Natan Daudi, “Taasa ina pooki natii atua oltau lino, amu etii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie.”

English: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
Masaai: Kake ore ina kewarie ake, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Natan, ejo,

English: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, nji ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Mikishetaki iyie enkaji nabikie.

English: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
Masaai: Amu eitu aekata nanu abik te nkaji ebaiki apa ina olong natorikoyie Isirael ometabaiki ena olong, kake ashomo nanu arukoo ilng'oborri, naimaa emanyisho o emanyisho.

English: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
Masaai: Ore too wuejitin pooki nashomo nanu tenebo Isiraeli pooki, neitu airo ororei te pooki tung'ani le lelo arishak le Israel, apa laitanapa pee eirrita iltung'ana laainei, ajo, “Kainyoo pee eitu intae kishetakiki enkaji oo ltarakua?” ’

English: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
Masaai: Ore naa taata nji shomo tiaaki osinka lai Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, aaitayio apa nanu te nkirrita oo ntare, te sujata oo nkerra, pee itum ataa olkitok loo ltung'ana laainei Israel;

English: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
Masaai: natii nanu tenebo iyie te pooki wueji nishomo, naiwuang'ie nanu ilmang'ati linono te dukuya iyie naa kaaitobiraki nanu iyie enkarna naikununo anaa nkarn e lelo kituaak le nkop.

English: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
Masaai: Naa kagelu nanu ewueji tenkaraki iltung'ana laainei le Isirael, naun nanu ninche, pee etum ninche aatobik te wueji enye maate, nemeitokini aekata aaitanyamal; nemeitoki aekata ilarruok aaisilisil ninche anaa apa.

English: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.
Masaai: Ebaiki ina kata apa nategelua ilarishak meitoria iltung'ana laainei le Isirael. Naa kamir nanu ilmang'ati linyi pooki. Ore ake si aaibalakinye nanu iyie nchere eikishetaki Olaitoriani enkaji.

English: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
Masaai: Teneiputayu inkolong'i inono pee irura aye anaa iloo papaai lino, naa kadumu nanu eishoi ino te siadi iyie, obo loo layiok linono inot, naitubulaa nanu enkitoria enye.

English: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
Masaai: Kaalo ninye ashetaki nanu enkaji, naa kaitubulaa nanu olorika lenye le nkitoo ntarasi.

English: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
Masaai: Kaaku nanu menye lenye neaku ninye enkerai ai. Maiwuang'ie nanu ina nyorrata ai nauno te ninye, anaa apa enaiwuang'ie teilo otii te dukuya iyie.

English: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
Masaai: Kake kaitasheyie nanu ninye tiatua enkaji o te nkitoria ai ntarasi ore olorika lenye le nkitoo enye neitubulari ntarasi.’ ”

English: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e kulo rorei pooki o te risioroto ena duata pooki, neirorie Natan Daudi.

English: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Daudi alo atua aji, neton te dukuya Olaitoriani, nejo, “Kara nanu ng'ae iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kainyoo enkaji ai, eji metaa kiyaua iyie naba nji?

English: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
Masaai: Naa embae kiti ena too nkonyek inono, iyie Enkai; niroro sii aimaki enkaji osinka lino te nkata sapuk nalotu, nikitoduaa iyie nanu iishoritin naapuonu, Olaitoriani Enkai!

English: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
Masaai: Naa kainyoo eitoki Daudi ajo tialo iyie inchoo meyanyituni osinka lino? Amu iyiolo iyie osinka lino.

English: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
Masaai: Ore tenkaraki osinka lino, iyie Olaitoriani, o terisioroto oltau lino makewan, iyaua iyie ena kitoo pooki, nchoo metayiolouni kuna baa pooki sapuki.

English: O LORD, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
Masaai: Meetae likae laaijo iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, nemeetae ae Ai neme iyie, te risioroto e nena pooki nikitoning'o too nkiyiaa ang.

English: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
Masaai: Kalo likae osho te nkop onyaanyukie iltung'ana linono Israel, laa ninche eshomo Enkai akordu pee eaku iltung'ana lenyena, pee intobiraki kewan enkarna too mbaa sapuki naaitureisho, aaraa aipang'ie iloshon te dukuya iltung'ana linono, apa litokordua ninche aitayu te Misiri.

English: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
Masaai: Nintaa iyie iltung'ana linono te Israel metaa iltung'ana linono ntarasi, niaku iyie, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
Masaai: Ore naa taata iyie Olaitoriani nchoo ilo rorei liroro oipirta osinka lino, neipirta enkaji enye meitubulari ntarasi, niaas anaa eniroro;

English: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
Masaai: neitasheyieki enkarna ino neibalieki ntarasi, ejo, ‘Olaitoriani loo lororani Enkai e Israel, ninye Enkai oo Siraeli.’ Ore enkaji osinka lino Daudi naa keitasheyieki te dukuya iyie.

English: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
Masaai: Amu iyie, Enkai ai, naitalio to sinka lino nchere ishetaki ninye Enkaji, ore enkaraki ina etagolo osinka lino oshoke pee eomon te dukuya iyie.

English: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
Masaai: Ore naa taata iyie Olaitoriani, iyie Enkai, nisiligishore iyie ena bae sidai tialo osinka lino.

English: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and it shall be blessed for ever.
Masaai: Ore naa taata nchoo kintiship iyie pee imayian enkaji o sinka lino, pee elo ninye dukuya anaake ntarasi te dukuya iyie; amu ore entoki nitamayiana iyie Olaitoriani nemayiana ntarasi.”

English: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi e nkiti rishata neitoki Daudi arasaki Ilfilisti nemir ninche. Ewa ninye aoru ninche enkanasa e Gaat o nkang'itie naataaniki kutiti neoru Ilfilisti.

English: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
Masaai: Etimira sii apa Ilmoabu ootaa isinkan lenyena nelak kodi.

English: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi arasaki olaiguanani Hadadesa le nkop e Siria naji Soba, natii embata enkop e Hamat, amu keyieu apa Hadadesa neing'oru pee eitore ina kop aimu te nkalo e shumata e Frati.

English: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
Masaai: Neibung Daudi ingarrin enyena oo mbartan enkalifu nabo, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni naapishana, o sikarini nkalifuni tikitam oopuo too nkejek. Nemut Daudi mbartan pooki oo ngarrin, neing'uaa ake inaaidip ngarrin iip nabo.

English: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eirriu Isiria le Dameski enjore nalotu aretu olaiguanani Hadadesa olaiguanani le Soba, neibung Daudi ina jore near metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oare le Siria,

English: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
Masaai: neitoki airriwaa iltimito le njore ilpolosien lenye, neaku ile Siria isinkan le Daudi neitaiki ninye kodi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi meisula te pooki wueji.

English: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neibung Daudi nena long'oi e sahabu apa naanapita ilkituaak le Hadadesa, neya ninche Yerusalem.

English: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii aya osuyai kitok le Tibha o te Kun, nena anas apa naaitore Hadadesa (ilo suyai apa enyaaka Solomon aasishore te siadi aitayunye ilmotioo, o ng'apeta, o masaa o suyai.)

English: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Toi le Hamat nchere etimira Daudi enjore pooki e Hadadesa, ilo aiguanani le Soba,

English: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
Masaai: neirriwaa olayioni lenye Hodoram meshomo enetii Daudi, pee eiroroki ninye, neisho ninye enchunet, enkaraki natimira Hadadesa; amu kesesh apa egilunore Hadadesa Toi to larrabal. Neirriwaki ninye mpukunot pooki oo masaa e sahabu, o enkosholai, ono suyai.

English: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
Masaai: Ore ake kuna pooki neitisinyaki Daudi Olaitoriani, tenebo ina osholai o sahabu apa nayaua too loshon, o te Edom, o Moab o too Lamoni, o too Lfilisti o too Lmaleki.

English: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
Masaai: Ore Abishai olayioni le Seruya near metuata nkalifuni tomon o isiet oo le Edom, to erata le munyan.

English: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltimito le njore Edom; neaku lelo pooki le Edom isinkan le Daudi. Neisho Olaitoriani Daudi enkisulata te pooki wueji neshomo.

English: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
Masaai: Neaku eitoreisho Daudi te Israel pooki, neitoreisho ninye too sipat o too nkiririkinot too ltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: And Joab the son Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
Masaai: Naa Yoab olayioni le Seruya apa olkitok le njore, naa Yehoshafat olayioni le Ahilud olasirani;

English: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
Masaai: naa Sadok olayioni le Ahitab o Ahimelek olayioni le Abiata ilapolosak; naa Shafsha olaigeroni;

English: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
Masaai: naa Benaia olayioni le Yehoiada oitasheiki Ilkeriti o lpeleti. Ore ilayiok le Daudi naa ninche ilkituaak te nkisiayiare o laiguanani.

English: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore apa tesiadi ena, neye Nahash olaiguanani loo Lamori, neitoreisho olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Kaitaas nanu ine supatisho Hanan olayioni le Nahash, amu aaitaasa apa menye ine supatisho.” Neaku eirriwayie Daudi ilkiliku pee epuoi aaitagol ninye tenkaraki keeya e menye. Nepuonu isinkan le Daudi enetii Hanan teina kop oo Lamori, pee eitagol ninye,

English: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
Masaai: kake etiaakitia lelo kituaak loo Lamori Hanan, “Ijo iyie eji ore amu kirriwaka Daudi ilarumak naa papaai lino eyanyit? Aime keetuo isinkan lenyena enitii pee ejurrisho, neibelekeny enkop aaikeern?

English: Wherefore Hanun took David's servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
Masaai: Neaku etang'amua Hanan isinkan le Daudi, nebarn ninche, nedung'oo nkilani enye aitoritie too mpolosi, neisho ninche meshomo;

English: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
Masaai: nepuo ninche. Ore ake pee elikini Daudi kulo tung'ana, neirriwaa iltung'ana metanang'are ninche, amu etipikaki apa lelo tung'ana esulare oleng. Nejo olaiguanani, “Entobik te Yeriko ometaba anaa nebulu ilmunyo linyi nintokiki aapuonu.”

English: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Ilamori aajo eitagoro Daudi, neirriwaa Hanan ntalantani enkalifu nabo e nkosholai pee eisilenu ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan te Mesopotamia, tenetii Aramaaka, o te Soba.

English: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
Masaai: Neisilenu ninche ngarrin oo mbartan nkalifuni tomoni uni oare, o laiguanani le Maaka tenebo enjore enye, apa naewuo aun ilng'oborri te Madeba. Neipotuni Ilamori metupuku too nkanas aapuonu olarrabal.

English: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Daudi ina, neirriwaa enjore pooki oo ltung'ana magil.

English: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilamori neluakino olarrabal etanapate te nejing'ieki enkanasa, ore lelo aiguanak apa ooetuo netii ninche iwuejitin enye maate te wueji neisiaja.

English: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Yoab ajo eimua ninye olarrabal te dukuya o te siadi, negelu iltung'ana arriyiak le Israel, neitobiraki olarrabal too le Siria.

English: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Ore kulikae tung'ana lenyena nepik abori erikoto e Abishai olalashe lenye, neitoluakini ninche metaarare Ilamoni.

English: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Tenaa kegol Siria oleng te nanu nikipuonunu aaretu nanu; naa te negol Ilamori oleng te intae, naa karetu intae.

English: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the LORD do that which is good in his sight.
Masaai: Entagoluoto naa mataa lewa to losho lang, o nkanas e Nkai ang; naa metaasa Olaitoriani ina naishiakino te ninye.”

English: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
Masaai: Nepuonu Yoab o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninye aaigutaki ile Siria to larrabal; neilanyisho ninche te dukuya ninye.

English: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Ilamoni aajo eilanyishote Isiria, neilanyisho sii ninche te dukuya Abishai, ilo alashe le Yoab, nepuo aajing atua enkanasa. Nelo Yoab Yerusalem.

English: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee edol Isiria aajo etimira Isiraeli ninche, neirriwaa ilkiliku meyauni lelo Siria apa ootii te idia alo olkeju le Frati, tenebo Shofak le njore e Hadadesa te dukuya ninche.

English: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini Daudi, neiturrur Isiraeli pooki tenebo, nelang olkeju le Yordan, nepuonu enetii ninche, neitoloku iltimito lenyena aipirakinye ninche. Ore ake pee eitobir Daudi olarrabal tenkaraki Siria, nearare ninche ninye.

English: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
Masaai: Neilanyisho Isiria te dukuya Isiraeli, near Daudi to lalem iltung'ana le Siria nkalifuni naapishana e lelo ooreu ngarrin oo mbartan, o nkalifuni artam oo loopuo too nkejek near sii metua Shofak ilo kitok le njore.

English: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol isinkan le Hadadesa nchere etimira Isiraeli ninche, neitayu osotua o Daudi, neaku ilaisiaayiak lenyena. Neaku meyieu Isiria neigil aaretu Ilamoni.

English: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto eilo ari, ina kata napuoyie ilaiguanak olarrabal, nerikoo Yoab enjore, nerasaki enkop oo Lamori, nelotu amuatu Aman enkang e Raba, neibelekeny ina ang agil.

English: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David's head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
Masaai: Neitayu Daudi enkopiyia e nkitoo te ndukuya o laiguanani lenye; nedol ajo entalanta e sahabu enkiroishi enye; naa osoit ogol enkinyiang'a, nepiki endukuya e Daudi. Neitoki ninye aya nena yarunot eina anasa ntokitin kumok.

English: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki ayau iltung'ana apa ootii atua ina anasa, nepik ninche esiaai oo nkaik, too musumenoni o sekenke o ntoluo. Neiko Daudi neijia too nkanas pooki oo Lamori. Nerrinyo Daudi o ltung'ana pooki aapuo Yerusalem.

English: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ena nedumunye olarrabal o Lfilisti, te Gasa, near Sebekai le Hushati Sipai metua, laa oleina ishoi apa oo ltung'ana sapuki; nemiri Lfilisti.

English: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.
Masaai: Neitoki apuku olarrabal loo Lfilisti; near Elhanan olalashe Yair Lahami metua olalashe le Goliat le Giti, ilo apa oba enchata enye empere anaa embokishi sapuk.

English: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
Masaai: Neitoki ake apuku olarrabal te Gat, teine netii oltung'ani sapuk oleng neado, neeta ilkimojik ile loo nkaik, o lkimojik ile loo nkejek te pooki aina o te pooki keju, neaku tikitam oong'uan ilkimojik lenyena pooki. Naa oleishoi sii ninye e lelo tung'ana sapuki.

English: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David's brother slew him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee emor Isiraeli, near Yonatan olayioni le Shimea, to lelem ninye metua. Olalashe le Daudi apa Shimea.

English: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
Masaai: Ile ishoi apa oo ltung'ana sapuki kulo tung'ana ootii Gat, nebatata ninche aaye te nkaina e Daudi o too nkaik oo sinkan, lenyena.

English: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
Masaai: Eitasho apa oloirirua agilunore Isirael, neputu Daudi meikena Isiraeli.

English: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
Masaai: Neaku etiaaka Daudi Yoab o larikok le njore, “Shomo nkena Isiraeli, ebaiki Beersheba o metabaiki Dan, nikiyaki nanu oratioti, pee atum atayiolo esiana enye.”

English: And Joab answered, The LORD make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord's servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Yoab, “Metoponai Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena te maaip terisioroto enkumoi enye. Amaa ninche pooki olkitok lai olaiguanani, aime isinkan linono pooki? Kainyoo naa pee eyieu olkitok lai ena? Kainyoo pee eyaki ninye ena kitarruorroto Israel?

English: Nevertheless the king's word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake etirrisha ororei lo laiguanani tialo Yoab, neaku eshomo Yoab atua Israel pooki, nerrinyunye Yerusalem.

English: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
Masaai: Neisho Yoab esiana oo ltung'ana Daudi. Ore tiatua Israel pooki netii iltung'ana milion nabo o nkalifuni iip nabo oata ilalema, Ore te Yuda naa nkalifuni iip ong'uan o ntomoni naapishana iltung'ana oata ilalema.

English: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king's word was abominable to Joab.
Masaai: Kake eitu eikenaki Lawi o Benchamen teina kikena, amu eitagoro apa irorei lo laiguanani Yoab.

English: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eitiship ena bae Olaitoriani, neosh ninye Israel.

English: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Enkai, “Ataasa nanu eng'oki oleng ataasa ena bae. Kake ore naa taata aatoomono nanu iyie, iwuang'ie entorroni o sinka lino; amu ataasa nanu ena te modai.”

English: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David's seer, saying,
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani Gad, ilo aduani le Daudi ejo,

English: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the LORD, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki Daudi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, mbaa uni aaisho nanu iyie; tegelu nabo te ninche, pee aatum nanu aishoo iyie.’ ”

English: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Choose thee
Masaai: Nelotu Gad enetii Daudi nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Iwa ina niyieu:

English: Either three years' famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the LORD, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
Masaai: Ilarin okuni lo lameyu, aashu ilapaitin okuni likintanyamal ilmang'ati linono, nikinepu olalem loo lmang'ati linono; arashu nkolong'i uni o lalem lo Laitoriani, olmeitai le nkop, neidaikie olmalaika lo Laitoriani tiatua enkop e Israel pooki.’ Toduta ewalata nayaki ilo laairriwua.”

English: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the LORD; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
Masaai: neitoki Daudi ajoki Gad, “Atii nanu atua osina sapuk; nchooki nanu matabatatakinoyu enkaina o Laitoriani, amu aisapuk olng'ur lenye oleng, kake mincho nanu abatatakino enkaina e tung'ani.”

English: So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka Olaitoriani olmeitai shumata Isiraeli; neye teine iltung'ana le Israel nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana.

English: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the LORD beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the LORD stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olmalaika Yerusalem pee eidakie ninye; kake ore etaa keidaikie, neing'or Olaitoriani neirridu ina torroni; nejoki ninye ilo malaika le nkidaata, “Eidip ina; torrinyo taata enkaina ino.” Neitashe apa ilo malaika lo Laitoriani tembata e wuejineiutuutishoreki e Onan le Yebusi.

English: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the LORD stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
Masaai: Nedumu Daudi nkonyek enyena nedol olmalaika lo Laitoriani eitashe te rishata e nkop o shumata, neeta te nkaina enye olalem otushutuaki te nchashur neitoriokini shumata Yerusalem. Neishop Daudi olpayiani ilkuniyiani, nebatata too nkomomi enye.

English: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O LORD my God, be on me, and on my father's house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Enkai, “Aime nanu doi oitanapishe meikeni olorere? Nanu otaasa eng'oki naas ena bae torrono. Kake amaa kuna kerra, kaa ninche etaasa? Nchoo naa enkaina ino Olaitoriani aatoomono, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, maatara nanu o enkaji e papaai lai; kake mincho olmeitai elotu shumata iltung'ana linono.”

English: Then the angel of the LORD commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the LORD in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo malaika le Nkai aitanap Gad metiaki Daudi nchere, pee elo aitobiraki olasar Olaitoriani te wueji neiutuutishoreki, e onan le Yebusi.

English: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Nelo Daudi teilo rorei le Gad oiroro te nkarna o Laitoriani.

English: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
Masaai: Neidong'ito apa Onan enkano; neibelekenya nedol olmalaika ore lelo ayiok lenyena pokira oong'uan neisudori.

English: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
Masaai: Ore elotu Daudi enetii Onan neing'orisho Onan nedol Daudi, nelo ninye teilo kurroto oiutuutishoreki neirrugo aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop, aisho Daudi enkanyit.

English: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the LORD: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Onan, “Nchooki nanu olkurroto oiutuutishoreki pee ashetie olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani timirakaki nanu te nkinyiang'a nalulung'a, pee etumi aaiwuang'ie olmeitai too ltung'ana.”

English: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo,I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
Masaai: Neitoki Onan ajoki Daudi, “Iwa iyie; naa nchoo olkitok lai olaiguanani eas ina naishiakino te ninye, ng'ura kaishoru nanu ilmong'i pee eitaae olasar opejori, ore kuna keek naaidong'ishoreki neaku ilkeek, neaku enkano olasar le ntapa. Kaishoru nanu pooki.”

English: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka olaiguanani Daudi Onan, “A'a, kake kainyiang'u nanu te nkinyiang'a nalulung'a; mayaki nanu Olaitoriani entoki nara enino, anaa aitayu ilasarri oopejori leitu ainyiang'u.”

English: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
Masaai: Neaku etalaaka Daudi Onan shekeli iip ile e sahabu te nkiroishi, tenkaraki ine wueji.

English: And David built there an altar unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the LORD; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
Masaai: Neshetu Daudi teine olperere lo lasar, lo Laitoriani, neitarasaa olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani, neipot enkarna o Laitoriani, newaliki Olaitoriani ninye te nkima, naing'uaa keper naewuo shumata ilo perere lo lasar opejori.

English: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
Masaai: neitanap Olaitoriani ilo malaika, nerrinyoki olalem atua enchashur.

English: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
Masaai: Ore teina kata, ore ake pee edol Daudi ajo etawalikia Olaitoriani ninye teilo kurroto oiutuutishoreki le Onan loo Lyebusi, neitobir ninye ilasarri lenyena teine.

English: For the tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
Masaai: Amu ore apa ilo ng'obor le manyisho Olaitoriani, oitobira Musa tiong'ota, o ilo perere lo lasar opejori netii apa ina kata ewueji neika te Gibeon;

English: But David could not go before it to enquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the LORD.
Masaai: kake meidim apa Daudi ashomo aitasho te dukuya ninye aikilikuanishore Enkai, amu keure apa olalem leilo malaika lo Laitoriani.

English: Then David said, This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajo, “Ene nelo aaku enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai, naa ene nelo aaku olperere lo lasar opejori te Israel.”

English: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
Masaai: Neitanapisho Daudi pee eiturrurri tenebo iltung'ana pooki omon ootii atua enkop e Israel, nepik iladung'ok loo soito, pee eitobir isoito oogueta ooshetieki enkaji e Nkai.

English: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
Masaai: Neishoru sii Daudi isekenke kumok naaitayunyeki ilmushumaani loo nkutukie oo nkajijik o nkikeneta, tenebo osuyai kitok oleng lemeimakinoyu enkiroishi.

English: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
Masaai: O mbaoi o oltarakuai nemeikenayu; amu eyautua iltung'ana le Sidon, o le Tiro mbaoi kumok o ltarakuai aayaki Daudi.

English: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
Masaai: Amu etejo apa Daudi, “Ore Solomon olayioni lai, naa koti, nemeyiolo toki, naa ore ena aji nashetakini Olaitoriani naa aisidai oleng, nening'o neeta enkitoo te nkop pooki; kaitobir nanu mbaa olchetei leina aji.” Neaku eishorua Daudi ntokitin kumok e nchetare eton eitu eye.

English: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki aipotu Solomon ilo ayioni lenye, neitanap metesheta enkaji Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God:
Masaai: Nejoki Daudi Solomon, “Enkerai ai, aata apa to ltau lai pee ashetu enkaji te nkarna Olaitoriani Enkai, ai.

English: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
Masaai: Kake eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii, ejo, ‘Mbukoyie iyie osarge sapuk nitijing'a ilarrabali kumok sapuki; mishetu iyie enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai, amu imbukoyie iyie osarge sapuk te dukuya nanu o tioriong enkop.

English: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eikiikini iyie enkayioni, naa keaku ninye oltung'ani le seriani. Kaisho nanu ninye eseriani too lmang'ati lenyena pooki oomanita; amu keaku keji enkarna enye Solomon, naa kaishoru nanu eseriani o enkitirring'a te Israel too nkolong'i enyena.

English: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
Masaai: Ninye olo ashet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai. Keaku ninye enkerai ai naaku nanu menye lenye, naa kaitasheyie nanu olorika lenye le nkitoo tiatua Israel ntarasi.’

English: Now, my son, the LORD be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the LORD thy God, as he hath said of thee.
Masaai: Ore naa taata enkerai ai, metaa Olaitoriani tenebo iyie, pee itum atudupoyu te nchetata enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ino, anaa apa enairoro ninye tialo iyie.

English: Only the LORD give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Mikinchoo ake ninye Olaitoriani eng'eno o ening'unoto, peyie tinikincho ninye enkitanapata naipirta Isiraeli, nitum aibung'a enkitanapata o Laitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
Masaai: Nitum taa atudupoyu, tenijurru, nimbung nena kikoot o nkiguanat naaitanapa Olaitoriani Musa tenkaraki Israeli. Ntagoluoyu, nintagol oshoke. Miureishoyu; mipalari.

English: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the LORD an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
Masaai: Ore te mion kitok oleng, naishorua nanu tenkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani ntalantani nkalifuni iip nabo e sahabu, o ntalantani milion nabo e nkosholai o suyai, o esekenkei nemetemayu, amu aikumok apa oleng. Aishorua sii mbaoi o soito. Ore te kuna nemeeta nchere pee miponaa.

English: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
Masaai: Iyata isinkan kumok oleng; iladung'ok loo soito, o lashetak loo soito, o laguetak loo mbaoi, o mpukunot pooki oo laisiaayiak arriyiak lemeikenayu. Iltung'ana arriyiak te siaai,

English: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the LORD be with thee.
Masaai: e sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o sekenke. Entudumunye entaasisho! Metaa Olaitoriani tenebo intae!”

English: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
Masaai: Eitanapa sii apa Daudi ilarikok pooki le Israel pee eretu Solomon, ilo ayioni lenye ejo,

English: Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
Masaai: “Aimetii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo intae? Naa keitu ninye eisho intae eseriani te pooki shoto? Amu eyaua ninye lelo oomanya ena kop apik atua nkaik aainei; naa keaku enkop abori Olaitoriani etii o ltung'ana lenyena.

English: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the LORD your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Esiaayia naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai inyi too ltauja. Entudumunye enteshet ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani Enkai inyi, pee etumi aayau nena masaa sinyat atua ina aji nateshetaki tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani.”

English: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee emoruau Daudi, neitaa Solomon olayioni lenye metaa olaiguanani le Israel.

English: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
Masaai: Neiturrur Daudi ilarikok pooki le Israel, o lapolosak pooki loo Lawi.

English: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi, neikeni pooki oata ilarin tomoni uni neilep, ore esiana enye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tomoni uni oisiet.

English: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officers and judges:
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Ore nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan e kulo, ninche ooitasheiki esiaai e nkaji Olaitoriani, ore nkalifuni ile neaku ilkituaak o larishak.

English: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
Masaai: Ore ilarripok le kishomi naa nkalifuni ong'uan, naa nkalifuni oong'uan oisis Olaitoriani te nena kinantani naitobira nanu pee eisisieki.”

English: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
Masaai: Neitobir Daudi ninche aorrior aaitaa ilturrurri aitusuj ilayiok le Lawi: Gershom, o Kohat, o Merari.

English: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
Masaai: Ore apa ilayiok le Gershom naa Ladan, o Shimei.

English: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ladan naa: Yehiel aa ninye olkitok, o Setam, o Yoel, lelo pokira okuni.

English: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Shimei naa Shelomot, o Hasiel, o Haran, lelo pokira okuni. Kulo apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too le Ladan.

English: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shimei naa: Yahat, o Sina o Yeush, o Beria. Ilayiok apa le Shimei kulo pokira oong'uan.

English: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
Masaai: Yohat apa ninye olkitok, naa Sisa o liare; kake meeta apa Yeush o Beria ilayiok kumok, neaku eitaaki ninche olmarei obo.

English: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kohat naa: Amram, o Ishar, o Hebron, o Usiel, lelo pokira oong'uan.

English: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Amram naa: Aron o Musa. Eiteng'elaki apa Aron pee eitisiny nena tokitin naasinya oleng, pee etum ninye o layiok lenyena aataa iloopej enkorropil te dukuya Olaitoriani, neisiaaisho ninye, nemayianisho te nkarna enye ntarasi.

English: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
Masaai: Kake ore ilayiok le Musa ilo tung'ani le Nkai, neishooki nkarn oo ltung'ana le Lawi.

English: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
Masaai: Nkarn oo layiok le Musa: Gershom o Eliesa.

English: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gershom naa Shebuel aa ninye olkitok,

English: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Eliesa naa: Rehabia aa ninye olkitok, nemeeta apa Eliesa kulikae ayiok, kake aikumok apa ilayiok le Rehabia oleng.

English: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ishar naa, Shelomit aa ninye olkitok.

English: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hebron naa: Yeria aa ninye olkitok, o Amaria aa ninye oliare, o Yahasiel aa ninye oliokuni o Yekameam aa ninye oliong'uan.

English: Of the sons of Uzziel; Micah the first, and Jesiah the second.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Usiel naa: Mika aa ninye olkitok o Ishia aa ninye oliare.

English: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari naa: Mahali o Mushi. Ore ilayiok le Mahali naa: Eliesa o Kish.

English: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
Masaai: Etua apa Eliesa meeta ilayiok, ntoyie ake eeta; ore iltung'ana lenye, lelo ayiok le Kish, neyam ninche.

English: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Mushi naa: Mahali, o Eder, o Yeremot, lelo pokira okuni.

English: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the LORD, from the age of twenty years and upward.
Masaai: Kulo apa ninche ilayiok le Lawi anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, anaa enaigeroki ninche te risioroto e siana oo nkarn e pooki ng'ae ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep, te lelo ooas esiaai e nkisiaayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani.

English: For David said, The LORD God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
Masaai: Amu etejo apa Daudi, “Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, eishoo eseriani iltung'ana lenyena, nebik ninye te Yerusalem ntarasi.

English: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
Masaai: Metaa meekure eeta tipat nanapie Ilawi olng'obor le Nkai o kulie tokitin ake pooki e nkisiaayiare.”

English: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
Masaai: Amu ore too rorei oobayie le Daudi, naa ena esiana oo Lawi ebaiki ilarin tikitam neilep.

English: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the LORD, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
Masaai: “Kake ore esiaai enye naa pee eretu ilayiok le Aron te nkisiayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani aaing'or Ilgorieti o too lgilat le nkaji, neituku nena pooki sinyat, neas pooki siaai te nkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai;

English: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
Masaai: neretisho te nkisiaayiare e mukate e nkitoduaaroto, o entapa tenkaraki olasar le ntapa, naa ninye eitobirieki imukateni neitu eisuishieki, o lasar loo mukateni naatapejoki, o lasar oitushula te ilata, o ntemat pooki e nkumoi o esapuko.

English: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise at even;
Masaai: Naa keitashe ninche anaake tadekenya aaisho enashe neisis Olaitoriani, naa neijia sii etiu teipa.

English: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the LORD in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the LORD:
Masaai: O enkata ake pooki naishori Olaitoriani olasar opejori te nkolong e sabato, o to lapa ng'ejuk, o too nkolong'i o Sirua, terisioroto e siana nayieuni te ninche, anaake te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neijia ninche eiko aaing'or olng'obor le ntumo o ewueji sinyati, negolie ninche ilayiok le Aron, lelo alashera lenye, te nkisiaayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani.”

English: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Masaai: Ore ilturrurri loo layiok le Aron naa ninche kulo. Ore ilayiok le Aron naa: Nadab, o Abihu, o Eliesa, o Itamar,

English: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest's office.
