Masaai: kake etasiokito apa Nadab o Abihu aaye te dukuya papaai lenye, nemeeta ninche nkera, neaku etaa Eliesa o Itamar ilapolosak.

English: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
Masaai: Ore te retoto e Sadok obo loo layiok le Eliesa, o Ahimelek obo loo layiok le Hamar, neitobir Daudi nkitobirat te risioroto e nkisiayiare enye.

English: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore amu enotoki apa iltung'ana kituaak tiatua ilayiok le Eliesa alang too layiok le Itamar, etipikaki ninche ilturrurri tomon o ile tiabori ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, too layiok le Eliesa, o isiet too layiok le Itamar.

English: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
Masaai: Eitobira ninche te oshoto e nkukuo, aaitanyaanyuk pooki, amu eetae apa ilkituaak anaake te wueji sinyati, o lkituaak le Nkai tiatua ilayiok le Eliesa o layiok le Itamar.

English: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
Masaai: Ore ilo aigeroni oji Shemaia olayioni le Nataniel, loo Lawi, neiger ninche pooki te dukuya olaiguanani, olkituaak, o Sadok olapolosani, o Ahimelek olayioni le Abiata, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye oo lapolosak o Lawi; negeluni enkaji nabo too le Eliesa negeluni nabo too le Itamar.

English: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
Masaai: Etadoikio enkukuo e dukuya Yehoirib, nedoiki eniare Yedaia,

English: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
Masaai: nedoiki ene uni Harim, nedoiki ene ong'uan Seorim,

English: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
Masaai: nedoiki ene imiet Malkija, nedoiki ene ile Mijamin,

English: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
Masaai: nedoiki ene naapishana Hakos, nedoiki ene isiet Abija,

English: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
Masaai: nedoiki ene naaudo Yeshua, nedoiki ene tomon Shekenia,

English: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon oobo Eliashib, nedoiki ene tomon oare Yakim,

English: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon ookuni Hupa, nedoiki ene tomon oong'uan Yeshebeab,

English: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon o imiet Bilga, nedoiki ene tomon o ile Imer,

English: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon oopishana Hesir, nedoiki ene tomon o isiet Hapiser,

English: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon ooudo Petahia, nedoiki ene tikitam Yeheskel,

English: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
Masaai: nedoiki ene tikitam oobo Yakin, nedoiki ene tikitam oare Gamul,

English: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
Masaai: nedoiki ene tikitam oo kuni Delai, nedoiki ene tikitam oo ng'uan Maasia,

English: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
Masaai: egeluno apa kulo pooki te nkisiaayiare enye pee epuonu atua enkaji Olaitoriani terisioroto eilo kerreti apa oitasheyie Aron papaai lenye tenkaraki ninche, anaa enaitanapa ninye Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
Masaai: Naa kuna nkarn e kulikae ayiok le Lawi: ore too layiok le Amram naa, Shubael; ore too layiok le Shubael, naa Yehedia.

English: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Rahedia naa: Ishia aa ninye olkitok.

English: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
Masaai: Ore too le Isharit, naa Shelemot; ore too layiok le Shelemot naa Yahat.

English: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Hebron naa Yeria aa ninye olkitok, naa Amaria oliare, naa Yahasiel oliokuni, naa Yekameam oliong'uan.

English: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Usiel naa Mika, ore too layiok le Mika naa Shamir.

English: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
Masaai: Ore olalashe le Mika naa Ishia; ore ilayiok le Ishia naa Sakaria.

English: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari naa Mahali o Mushi. Ore ilayiok le Yaasia naa Beno.

English: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Merari naa Yaasia, o Beno, o Shoham, o Sakur, o Ibri.

English: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Mahali naa: Eliesa ilo apa lemeeta ilayiok.

English: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Kish naa Yerameel.

English: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Mushi naa Mahali, o Eder, o Yerimot. Kulo apa ilayiok loo Lawi te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
Masaai: Ore sii kulo, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, o lalashera lenye ooti, neosh sii ninche enkukuo, anaa ake ilalashera lenye, lelo ayiok le Aron, te dukuya olaiguanani Daudi, o Sadok o Ahimelek, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye e lelo apolosak le Lawi.

English: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
Masaai: Ore Daudi o lelo kituaak le nkisiayiare neiteng'el kulikae te nkaraki enkisiaayiare embata oo layiok le Asaf le Heman o le Yedutum, laa ninche apa ooibonisho too lwululi loo usin, o too nkai oosinkolioitin, o too nkinantani dapashi. Ore lelo ootaasa esiaai enkisiaayiare enye naa:

English: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Asaf, naa, Sekur, o Yosef, o Natania, o Aharela, lelo ayiok le Asaf te utaroto e Asaf, laa ninye apa oibonisho te utaroto o laiguanani.

English: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Yedutum naa Gedalia, o Seri, o Yeshaia, o Shemei, o Hashabia o Matitia, lelo pokira ile, tiabori eutaroto e papaai lenye Yedutum, laa ninye apa oibonisho to lwulul loo usin, eishooyo enashe neisis Olaitoriani.

English: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Heman naa: Bukia, o Matania, o Usiel o Shebuel, o Yerimot, o Hania, o Hanani, o Eliata, o Gidalti, o Romantieser, o Yoshbekasha, o Meloti, o Hotir, o Mahasiot.

English: All these were the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Heman, oladuaani lo laiguanani le Seer, terisioroto enkisiligata e Nkai pee eitaa ninye kitok, amu eishoo apa Enkai Heman ilayiok tomon oong'uan o ntoyie uni.

English: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
Masaai: Etii apa ninche pooki abori eutaroto e papaai lenye to sinkolio le nkaji e Nkai, too nkinantani, o nkai oo sinkoliotin, o lwululi loo usin, tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai. Ore Asaf, o Yedutum, o Heman netii abori enkitanapata o laiguanani.

English: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the LORD, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
Masaai: Ore esiana enye tenebo lelo alashera lenye, apa ooiteng'enaki te ranyakinoto o Laitoriani, lelo pooki arriyiak, naa iip are o ntomoni isiet.

English: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
Masaai: Neosh ninche enkukuo tenkaraki isiaaitin enye, kutiti o sapuki. Olaiteng'enani o loiteng'eni.

English: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
Masaai: Nedoiki enkukuo e dukuya Asaf lo lmarei le Yosef; nedoiki eniare Gedalia, ninye olalashera lenyena, o layiok lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene uni Sakar o layiok lenyena o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare,

English: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki eniong'uan Isri, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene imiet Natania, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare,

English: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene ile Bukia, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare,

English: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene naapishana Yesherela, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare,

English: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene isiet Yeshaia, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare,

English: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene naaudo Matania, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira, tomon oare;

English: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon Shimei, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The eleventh to PrAzareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon oobo Asarel, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon oare Hashabia, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: nedoiki ene tomon ookuni Shubael, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oo ng'uan nedoiki Matitia, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oimiet, nedoiki Yeremot, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oile, nedoiki Hanania, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oopishana, nedoiki Yashbekasha, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon oisiet, nedoiki Hanani, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera pokira tomon oare;

English: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tomon ooudo, nedoiki Malotu, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tikitam nedoiki Eliata, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tikitam oobo, nedoiki Hatir, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tikitam oare nedoiki Gatalti, o layiok lenyena o lalashera lenyena, pokira tomon oare;

English: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
Masaai: ore ene tikitam ookuni nedoiki Mahasiot, o layiok lenyena o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare;

English: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
Masaai: ore ene tikitam oong'uan, nedoiki Romatiesa, o layiok lenyena, o lalashera lenyena pokira tomon oare.

English: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
Masaai: Ore tialo eoroto oo larripok loo nchomito: ore too ltung'ana le Kora naa Meshelemia olayioni le Kore, obo loo layiok le Asaf.

English: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
Masaai: Neeta apa Meshelemia ilayiok: Sakaria aa ninye olkikau, naa Yediael oliare, naa Sebadia oliokuni, naa Yatiniel oliong'uan,

English: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
Masaai: naa Elam olayioni le imiet, naa Yehohanaan olayioni le ile, naa Eliehoenia oliopishana.

English: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
Masaai: Neeta sii apa Obed-edom ilayiok: naa Shemaia olkikau, naa Yehosabad oliare, naa Yoa oliokuni, naa Sakar oliong'uan, naa Netanel olayioni le imiet,

English: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
Masaai: naa Amiel olayioni le ile, naa Isaakar oliopishana, naa Peuletai olayioni le isiet; amu etamayiana apa Enkai ninye.

English: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Ore sii apa tialo olayioni lenye Shemaia, netoiuoki ilayiok laa ninche ootaa ilaitoriak loo nkajijik oo loo menye, amu iltung'ana apa oata enkidimata kitok oleng.

English: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shimeia, naa, Otini, o Refael, o Obed, o Elisabad, neeta apa ilalashera lenye enkidimata, Elihu o Shimeia.

English: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa ilo lmarei le Obed-edom, tenebo ilayiok lenye o lalashera lenye. Iltung'ana oata enkidimata ninche naa arriyiak te siai. Iltung'ana le Obed-edom ntomoni ile oare.

English: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
Masaai: Neeta sii apa Meshelemia ilayiok o lalashera iltung'ana oata enkidimata oora tomon o isiet.

English: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
Masaai: Ore Hosa loo layiok le Merari neeta ilayiok: Shimri aa ninye olkitok, (amu ore duoo ninye neme olkikau ninye, neitaa menye kitok).

English: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
Masaai: Naa Hikia osuju, naa Tebalia oliokuni naa Sekaria oliong'uan; ore ilayiok pooki o lalashera le Hosa naa tomon oo kuni.

English: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore kulo turrurri pooki loo larripok loo nchomito, negeluno ake aaipirare ltung'ana lenye kituaak, negelakino enkisiaayiare, anaa apa enataasa ilalashera lenye, eisiaaisho tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
Masaai: Neosh ninche enkukuo anaa too nkajijik oo loo menye, neitorisi nkutiti o sapuki, tenkaraki nchomito enye.

English: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
Masaai: Ore enkukuo enkalo oloo saen nedoiki Shelemia. Enyaakita sii aoshoki olayioni lenye Sekaria enkukuo, ilo autaroni ng'en nedoiki enkukuo enye enkalo e moikuape.

English: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
Masaai: Nelotu Obed-edom enkalo e kopikop ore ilayiok lenyena neishori enkaji nashumishoreki.

English: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
Masaai: Ore Shupim o Hosa nedoiki enkukuo enye enkalo o loo ntoluo, embata e nkishomi e Sheleket, teina oitoi kitok nalo ailep. Neipirakinore ake olarriponi olarriponi.

English: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo oloo saen netii ilarripok ile anaake, ore te nkalo e moikuape netii ilarripok oong'uan anaake, ore te nkalo e kopikop netii ilarripok oong'uan anaake, tenebo ake sii kulikae maaremaare te nkaji nashumishoreki.

English: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo o loo ntoluo netii ilarripok oong'uan enkoitoi kitok netii oare ine wueji neitobiraki aakus.

English: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilturrurri loo larripok loo nchomito tialo ile Kora o layiok le Merari.

English: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi, naa Ahija apa oata enkitasheikinoto tenkaraki enchumare oo masaa e nkaji e Nkai, o lchumat loo nkishorot naaitisinyaki.

English: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ladan, lelo ayiok le Gershom ooara ile Ladan, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa ile Ladan le Gershom: Yehiel.

English: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yehiel, naa Setam o Yoel olalashe lenye, naa ninche ooitasheiki ilchumat le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
Masaai: Ore too le Amram, lelo le Isharit,

English: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
Masaai: o le Shebuel ilo ayioni le Gershom, olayioni le Musa, naa ninye olkitok oitasheiki ilchumat.

English: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
Masaai: Ore ilalashera lenyena, ebaiki Eliesa; naa olayioni lenye Rehabia o layioni lenye Yeshaia, olayioni lenye Yoram, olayioni lenye Sikri, naa olayioni lenye Shelomot.

English: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
Masaai: Ore Shelemot o lalashera lenyena naa ninche ooitasheiki ilchumat le nena kishorot apa naaitisinya olaiguanani Daudi, tenebo ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, o lkituaak loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip loo larikok le njore naaitisinyaki.

English: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ntokitin naataaruaki to larrabal, neitisiny ninche nena kishorot pee eitobirieki enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
Masaai: O nena sii pooki naaitisinya Samuel oladuaani, o Saul olayioni le Kish, o Abna olayioni le Neer, o Yoab olayioni le Seruya - ore nena kishorot pooki naaitisinyaki naa abori enking'urata e Shelemot etii o lalashera lenyena.

English: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
Masaai: Ore too Lharisit, naa Kenaia o layiok lenyena, negeluni tenkaraki isiaaitin e boo too Siraeli, metaa ilkituaak o larishak.

English: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
Masaai: Ore too le Hebron, naa Hashabia o lalashera lenyena, iltung'ana enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana oata enkidimata, ooing'or aagolie Isirael, te nkalo o loo ntoluo olkeju le Yordan, te siaai pooki Olaitoriani, o te nkisiayiare olaiguanani.

English: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
Masaai: Ore too le Hebron, naa Yeriya olkitok loo le Hebron te pooki iishoritin o too nkajijik oo loo menye. (Ore to lari liartam le nkitoria e Daudi, netujurroki iltung'ana netumi iltung'ana oata enkidimata tiatua ninche te Yaser tiatua Gilead.)

English: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
Masaai: Etegelua olaiguanani Daudi ninye o lalashera lenyena, iltung'ana nkalifuni are o iip naapishana oata enkidimata, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, pee eitasheiki ile Ruben, o le Gad, olpisiai lo losho le Manase te pooki bae naipirta Enkai o too mbaa o laiguanani.

English: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Kuna nkarn oo ltung'ana le Israel, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, lelo arikok le njore loo nkalifuni o loo maa iip, o lkituaak lenye ooisiaai olaiguanani too mbaa pooki naaipirta nena orot oo lturrurri, te pooki apa o to lari pooki, ore ake olturrur obo naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Yoshobeam olayioni le Sabdiel apa oitasheiki olturrur le dukuya, to lapa le dukuya; ore ilo turrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
Masaai: Ole ishoi e Peres apa ninye, naa ninye olkitok too larikok pooki le njore to lapa le dukuya.

English: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Dodai le Ahohit apa oitasheiki olturrur lo lapa liare; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni le njore liokuni, to lapa liokuni, naa Benaia olayioni le Yehoida ilo apolosani, aa ninye olkitok; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
Masaai: Olapa taa Benaia ele ora oltung'ani magilani tiatua lelo tomoni uni naa ninye olarikoni le tomoni uni; Amisabad olayioni lenye apa oitasheiki olturrur lenye.

English: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Asahel ilo alashe le Yoab ninye apa oliong'uan, to lapa liong'uan, naa olayioni lenye Sebadia osujaki ninye; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olarikoni le njore le imiet, to lapa le imiet naa Shumhut, le Israhit; Ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan. Ore olayioni le ile to lapa le ile

English: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: naa Ira olayioni le Ikesh le Tekoa; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore oliopishana, to lapa liopishana, naa Heles le Peloni, loo layiok le Efraim; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le isiet to lapa le isiet naa Sibekia le Hushat le Serahit, ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore o lioudo to lapa lioudo naa Abiesa le Anatot, loo le Benchamen; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le tomon, to lapa le tomon naa Maharai le Netofa, loo le Serahit, ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le tomon oobo to lapa le tomon oobo naa Benaia le Piraton, loo layiok le Efraim; ore olturrur lenye lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
Masaai: Ore olayioni le tomon oare, to lapa le tomon oare naa Hildai le Netofat loo le Otiniel; ore olturrur lenye naa iltung'ana nkalifuni tikitam oong'uan.

English: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
Masaai: Ore tialo iloshon le Israel, ore too le Ruben, naa Eliesa olayioni le Sikri ninye olkitok; ore too le Simeon, naa Shefatia olayioni le Maaka;

English: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
Masaai: ore too Lawi naa Hashabia olayioni le Kemuel; ore too le Aron naa Sadok;

English: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
Masaai: ore too le Yuda naa Elihu, obo loo lalashera le Daudi; ore too le Isaakar, naa Umri olayioni le Mikael;

English: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
Masaai: ore too le Sebulon, naa Ishmaia olayioni le Obadia, ore too le Naftali, naa Yeremot olayioni le Asriel;

English: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
Masaai: ore too le Efraim, naa Hoshea olayioni le Asasia; ore to lpisiai lo losho le Manase, naa Yoel olayioni le Pedaia;

English: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
Masaai: ore to likae pisiai lo losho le Manase te Gilead naa, Ido olayioni le Sakaria, ore too le Benchamen, naa Yaasiel olayioni le Abna;

English: Of Dan, PrAzareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: ore too le Dan, naa Asarel olayioni le Yeroham, kulo apa lelo arikok loo loshon le Israel.

English: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
Masaai: Eitu apa eiken Daudi lelo ootii abori ilarin tikitam, amu eisiligishore apa Olaitoriani pee eitaa Isiraeli kumok anaa ilakir le shumata.

English: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
Masaai: Neiteru Yoab olayioni le Seroya aikenisho, kake eitu ninye eidip, neitoki engoro alotu shumata Israel tenkaraki ena, neitu epiki ina siana atua nkatinin o laiguanani Daudi.

English: And over the king's treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
Masaai: Ore apa olaitasheikinoni loo lchumat lo laiguanani naa Asmafet olayioni le Adiel. Naa ore olaitasheikinoni loo lchumat leina kop, tiatua nkanas, o tiatua nkang'itie kutiti, o too ltaleta, naaYonatan olayioni le Usia;

English: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
Masaai: ore oloitasheiki lelo oaasisho too nkurman, neturisho naa Esiri olayioni le Kelub;

English: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
Masaai: ore oloitasheiki inkurman oo lng'anayio naa Shimei le Rematil; ore oloitasheiki ilng'anayio ooitayuni te nkurma oo sabibu naa Sabdi le Shifamit.

English: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
Masaai: Ore oloitasheiki iloirienito o lkeek laaijo retet ootii atua Shefala naa Baalhanan le Gederi; ore oloitasheiki ineeshumieki iila naa Yoash.

English: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
Masaai: Ore oloitasheiki nchoo too ndaat te Sharon naa Shitrai le Sharon, ore oloitasheiki nchoo naadaa too erat naa Shefat olayioni le Adlai.

English: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
Masaai: Ore oloitasheiki ntamesin naa Obil le Ishmael; ore oloitasheiki isirkon lipong'a naa Yehedia le Meronot. Ore oloitasheiki Illuat oo nkerrai naa Yasis le Hagrit.

English: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
Masaai: Ore kulo pooki naa ilaitasheikinok loo masaa o laiguanani Daudi.

English: Also Jonathan David's uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king's sons:
Masaai: Ore apa Yonatan olenkapu le Daudi, naa ninye olaikooni le Daudi, amu oltung'ani ninye oata ening'unoto naa olaig'eroni; ninye o Yehiel olayioni le Hakmoni apa oiteng'en ilayiok lo laiguanani.

English: And Ahithophel was the king's counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king's companion:
Masaai: Ahitofel apa olaikooni lo laiguanani, naa Husai le Akit olchore lo laiguanani.

English: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king's army was Joab.
Masaai: Etijing'a apa Yehoida olayioni le Benaia tenebo Abiata erishata e Ahitofel. Naa Yoab apa olarikoni le njore olaiguanani.

English: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eiturrurro apa Daudi te Yerusalem ilkituaak pooki le Israel, ilkituaak loo loshon, o larikok le lelo turrurri apa ooisiaai olaiguanani, o larikok le njore le nkalifu, o larikok le njore le maa iip, o laitashiekinok loo masaa pooki, o nkishu o laiguanani, o layiok lenyena, tenebo o lkituaak le nkaji o laiguanani, o lelo tung'ana magil, o lelo murran pooki yiolot.

English: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
Masaai: Nedumunye Daudi aitashe nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu, ilalashera lainei oltung'ana laainei. Atadamua apa to ltau lai pee ashetu enkaji nairragieki osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani, neaku eneitasheyie nkejek e Nkai ang: naitobira nanu mbaa naashetieki,

English: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
Masaai: kake aatiaka nanu Enkai, ‘Mindim iyie atesheta enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai, amu ira iyie olmurrani nimbukoyie osarge sapuk.'

English: Howbeit the LORD God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia aategelua nanu Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel te nkaji e papaai pooki pee aaku olaiguanani le Israel ntarasi, amu etegelua Yuda metaa olarikoni, naa ore te nkaji e Yuda, teina aji e papa, o tiatua ilayiok le papa neitishipa ninye pee aaitaa olaiguanani le Israel pooki.

English: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
Masaai: Naa ore too layiok laainei pooki (amu aaishoo Olaitoriani ilayiok kumok) netegelua Solomon olayioni lai, pee eton to lorika le nkitoo le nkitoria o Laitoriani te Israel.

English: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
Masaai: Aatiaka ninye nanu, ‘Solomon olayioni lino olo ashet enkaji ai o lgorieti laainei, amu ategelua nanu ninye metaa enkerai ai, naa kaaku nanu menye lenye.

English: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
Masaai: Kaitasheyie nanu enkitoria enye ntarasi tenebik ninye aibung neitabaya nkitanapat aainei, o nkikoot aainei, anaa enatiu ninye taata.’

English: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the LORD, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the LORD your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
Masaai: Ore naa taata te dukuya Isirael pooki, ena umata o Laitoriani o te ning'oto e Nkai ang, entujurru ning'oruru nkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani Enkai inyi; pee itumutumu aawaita ena kop sidai aaitaa eninyi, ningueikiki nkera inyi metaa enjung'ore enye ntarasi.

English: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the LORD searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
Masaai: “Naa ore iyie Solomon enkerai ai, tayiolo Enkai e papaai lino, nisiaai ninye to ltau pooki o te ndamunoto e yieunoto amu kejur Olaitoriani iltauja pooki, neyiolo pooki kitobirat o endamunoto. Tening'oru iyie ninye, naa eitum iyie ninye, kake tenilam ninye, naa eikinturraa ninye iyie ntarasi.

English: Take heed now; for the LORD hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
Masaai: Toning'o naa taata, amu kitegelua iyie Olaitoriani pee ishet enkaji naaku ewueji sinyati; ntagoluoyu taasa ina.”

English: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
Masaai: Neisho Daudi Solomon eutaroto enkitobirata eina aji Enkai pooki, o enoo nkajijik enyena, o neeshumishoreki, o lgilat lenyena le shumata, o lgilat lenyena liatua, o lgilat lo lorika lolng'ur,

English: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the LORD, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
Masaai: o nena kitobirat pooki naata to ltau, tenkaraki ilgorieti le nkaji o Laitoriani, o lgilat pooki oomanita, o wuejitin pooki neeshumishoreki e nkaji e Nkai, o eneshumieki nkishorot naaitisinyaki;

English: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: tenkaraki lelo turrurri loo lapolosak o Lawi, o esiaai pooki enkisiaayiare tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, o masaa pooki e nkisiaayiare tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani,

English: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
Masaai: o enkiroishi e sahabu tenkaraki imasaa e sahabu te pooki kisiaayiare, o enkiroishi oo masaa e nkosholai te pooki kisiayiare.

English: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
Masaai: O enkiroishi oo nkitasheta oo ltaai, lenye, o enkiroishi e pooki kitashet oltaa o ltaai lenyena, o enkiroishi enkosholai tenkaraki enkiteshet oltaa, o ltaai lenyena, te risioroto enkisiaayiarete pooki kitashet o ltaa.

English: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
Masaai: O enkiroishi e sahabu te pooki mesa, e mukate e nkitoduaaroto, o enkosholai tenkaraki imisai naaitobiri te nkosholai.

English: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
Masaai: O sahabu nasila naitobirieki nkijikoni oo lala, o mbesenini, o nkikompeni, o nena girran e sahabu, o enkiroishi e sahabu naitobirieki pooki o ngirran e nkosholai.

English: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
Masaai: O te nkaraki olperere lo lasar le nkorropil le sahabu nasila, o enkiroishi e sahabu naitobirieki. Neisho sii nkitobirat tenkaraki engarri oo lbartan e sahabu nanapieki lelo kerubi oolak inaipuko enye aaitoip ilo sanduku lo sotua le Nkai.

English: All this, said David, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
Masaai: Eibalunye ninye kuna baa pooki too lkigerot le nkaina o Laitoriani, ooipirta ena bae. Keasi ena siaai pooki aaiturubare ina kitobirata e utaroto.

English: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the LORD God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki Solomon ilo ayioni lenye, “Ntagoluoyu nintagol oshoke, niaas ina, miureishoyu, milepori nimishalu; amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai ai, ee Enkai ai, netii tenebo iyie, mikintiak ninye iyie nimikinguanare ometaba anaa neidipayu esiaai pooki e nkisiaayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani. Naa ng'ura, ore ilturrurri loo lapolosak; o loo Lawi, teina kisiaayiare pooki enkaji e Nkai, netii tenebo iyie, ometaba anaa neidipayu esiaai pooki e nkisiaayiare e nkaji Olaitoriani.

English: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore ilturrurri loo lapolosak, o loo Lawi, teina kisiaayiare pooki enkaji e Nkai netii tenebo iyie, neeta ake pooki tung'ani eyieunoto, neeta pooki ng'ae enkarriyiano te pooki kisiaayiare; ore sii ilkituaak o ltung'ana pooki naa kening aakurraki tenintanap ninche.”

English: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Daudi ina umata pooki, “Ore Solomon enkerai ai laa ninye ake etegelua Enkai, naa oltung'ani oti lemeeta enkarriyiano, naa eikitok ena siaai, amu ore ena aji nemeaku ene tung'ani, kake eno Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
Masaai: Neaku aishoru nanu ntokitin naashetieki enkaji e Nkai, ai anaa enaidim. Aishorua sahabu tenkaraki ntokitin e sahabu, o enkosholai tenkaraki ntokitin e nkosholai, o suyai tenkaraki ntokitin o suyai, o esekenkei tenkaraki ntokitin e sekenkei o nkeek tenkaraki ntokitin oo nkeek, ore tenebo nena netii isoito kumok ooji oniks, o soito ooitasheyieki, o soito loo muain kumok, o mpukunot pooki oo soito oogol enkinyiang'a, o ltoto ooibor.

English: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
Masaai: Ore ake tenebo nena tokitin pooki naishorua nanu tenkaraki ina aji sinyati, naata nanu olchumati lai makewan le sahabu o enkosholai, naa ore tenkaraki enyorrata ai tenkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai, aishoo nanu enkaji e Nkai ai:

English: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
Masaai: ntalantani nkalifuni uni e sahabu, ina sahabu e Ofir, o ntalantani nkalifuni naapishana e nkosholai nasila, pee emurieki isunta eina aji,

English: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto the LORD?
Masaai: o tenkaraki ina siaai pooki naas lelo tung'ana arriyiak, o sahabu tenkaraki ntokitin e sahabu, o enkosholai tenkaraki ntokitin e nkosholai. Kaing'ae naa likae oishoru te yieunoto, neitisiny kewan ena olong, neitisinyaki kewan Olaitoriani?”

English: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king's work, offered willingly,
Masaai: Neitoki nena lukuny oo nkajijik o nkajijik oo loo menye aaishoru nena kishorot enye o lpela, anaa ake sii enataasa ilarikok loo loshon, o larikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maa iip, o lelo kituaak ooitasheiki esiaai o laiguanani.

English: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
Masaai: Neishoru ninche tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai ntalantani nkalifuni imiet e sahabu, o ntalantani nkalifuni tomon e nkosholai, o ntalantani nkalifuni tomon oisiet o suyai, o ntalantani nkalifuni iip nabo e sekenkei.

English: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the LORD, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oata soito oogol enkinyiang'a, nepik ilo shumati le nkaji Olaitoriani, naa Yehiel le Gershon apa olaing'urani.

English: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to the LORD: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
Masaai: Neng'idayu apa iltung'ana enkaraki eitayutuo kulo te nyorrata, amu to ltau pooki eishorutua ninche to lpela aaisho Olaitoriani; neng'idayu sii olaiguanani Daudi oleng.

English: Wherefore David blessed the LORD before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be thou, LORD God of Israel our father, for ever and ever.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi aisis Olaitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki; nejo Daudi: “Metaa iyie eisisi, iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel papa lang, ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Thine, O LORD, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine; thine is the kingdom, O LORD, and thou art exalted as head above all.
Masaai: Enino, iyie Olaitoriani enkitoo, o engolon, o enkitoria, o enkisulata, o enkishiaa; amu ore pooki natii shumata o enkop naa nkuninono; enino enkitoria, iyie Olaitoriani, naa iyie eilepieki aaitulusoo te pooki.

English: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
Masaai: Ore enkarsisisho o enkanyit naa iyie eing'uaa, naa iyie oitoreisho te shumata pooki. Enkaina ino etii engolon o enkidimata; naa enkaina ino; naitaa kitok neisho engolon pooki ng'ae.

English: Now therefore, our God, we thank thee, and praise thy glorious name.
Masaai: Ore taata nikincho iyie enashe, Enkai ang, nikisis Enkarna ino kitok.

English: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of thee, and of thine own have we given thee.
Masaai: “Kake kara nanu ng'ae, naa kainyoo olorere lai, eji metaa eikindim aaishoru kuna te yieunoto. Amu iyie eing'uaa ntokitin pooki naa nkuninono kitorrinyokito iyie.

English: For we are strangers before thee, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook omon te dukuya iyie, nikira lapuayak anaa apa enatiu loo papa pooki; etiu nkolong'i ang te nkop anaa oloip, nemeetae enebikieki.

English: O LORD our God, all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand, and is all thine own.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, ore ena kumoi e kuna tokitin nikintayutuo pee kishetakinye iyie enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ino sinyati, naa enkaina ino eing'uaa, naa nkuninono pooki.

English: I know also, my God, that thou triest the heart, and hast pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of mine heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy thy people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto thee.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu, Enkai ai, nchere, ijur oltau, nishipakino enkishui sidai; ore te sidano oltau lino naishorua nanu kuna pooki te nyorrata, natoduaa nanu taata kulikae tung'ana linono, ootoni tene, neishoru te nyorrata o te ng'ida.

English: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
Masaai: Olaitoriani, Na Ai e Abraham o Isaak o Israel, loo papa, tipika ntarasi kuna yieunot o ndamunot atua iltauja loo ltung'ana linono, niutaa iltauja lenye meetu enitii.

English: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep thy commandments, thy testimonies, and thy statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.
Masaai: Nchoo Solomon enkerai ai meibung'a to ltau lenye nkitanapat inono, pooki o enchakenisho ino, o nkikoot inono, neitabaya pooki, neshet ninye ine wueji apa naitobira.”

English: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless the LORD your God. And all the congregation blessed the LORD God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped the LORD, and the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Daudi ajoki ina umata, “Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.” Neisis ina umata pooki Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neirrug ninche ilukuny enye, neserem Olaitoriani, neisho enkanyit aaitaa Olaiguanani.

English: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto the LORD, and offered burnt offerings unto the LORD, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel:
Masaai: Neisho ninche Olaitoriani ilasarri, ore te nkolong nasuju, neishooyo ilasarri oopejori to Olaitoriani, iloing'ok enkalifu nabo, olmeregeshi enkalifu nabo, o lkuoo le kerra enkalifu nabo tenebo ilasarri lenye ooki, o lasaari kumok oleng te Israel pooki;

English: And did eat and drink before the LORD on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto the LORD to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.
Masaai: neokisho ninche nedaa te dukuya Olaitoriani ina olong te ng'ida sapuk oleng. Neitaa ninche Solomon ilo ayioni le Daudi olaiguanani te nkata e are, nebukoki ninche ninye eilata aaput aaitaa olkitok te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neitaa Sadok olapolosani.

English: Then Solomon sat on the throne of the LORD as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
Masaai: Neton Solomon to lorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani anaa olaiguanani te rishata e Daudi papaai lenye; nebul ninye, nening Israel pooki ninye.

English: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
Masaai: Ore ilarikok pooki o lelo tung'ana magil, o layiok sii le Daudi pooki, nelimu aaibalunye enkirukoto enye to laiguanani Solomon.

English: And the LORD magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani Solomon metoning'oyu oleng te dukuya Israeli pooki, nepik shumata ninye enkitoo neitu aekata eishori likae aiguanani too Siraeli.

English: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel.
Masaai: Neaku eitoreisho apa Daudi olayioni le Yese te Israel pooki.

English: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore apa enkata naitoria ninye Israel naa ilarin artam; eitoreishe ninye ilarin ile te Hebron, neitoreisho ilarin tomoni uni oo kuni te Yerusalem.

English: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neye ninye aa oltung'ani moruo oleng, oiputakinote nkolong'i eeta enkarsisisho o enkanyit kitok; neitoreisho Solomon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
Masaai: Ore apa nkiaasin o laiguanani Daudi, ebaiki enkiterunoto ometabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki te mbuku oo nkatinin e Samuel oladuaani, o too nkatinin e Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai, o too nkatinin e Gad oladuaani,

English: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
Masaai: tenebo mbaa pooki e nkitoria enye, o mbaa pooki e nkitoria enye, o emagilanisho enye, o mbaa pooki naaetuo shumata ninye o shumata Israel, o shumata nkitoriat pooki oo nkuapi.

English: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and the LORD his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
Masaai: Eitagolo apa Solomon olayioni le Daudi kewan te nkitoria, netii Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye, neitaa ninye kitok oleng.

English: Then Solomon spake unto all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Israel, the chief of the fathers.
Masaai: Neirorie Solomon Isiraeli pooki, neirorie ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni, o loo maaip, o larishak, o larikok pooki loo Siraeli, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye.

English: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore Solomon, oina umata pooki natii tenebo ninye, nepuo ine wueji e shumata natii Gibeon; amu ine apa etii olng'obor le Nkai oitobira Musa osinka lo Laitoriani.

English: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjathjearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake eyaua apa Daudi ilo sanduku le Nkai te Kiriat-Yearim neya ine wueji apa neitobiraka, amu etuuno apa ninye olng'obor tenkaraki ninye te Yerusalem.

English: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai oitobira Besalel olayioni le Uri, olayioni le Huri, netii dukuya ilo ng'obor lo Laitoriani. Nesai Solomon oina umata Olaitoriani.

English: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the LORD, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
Masaai: Neilep Solomon alo ine netii olperere lo lasar lo suyai te dukuya Olaitoriani. Atua ilo ng'obor le ntumo apa etii ilo perere lo lasar, neitayu Solomon ilasarri oopejori enkalifu nabo te nchumata enye.

English: In that night did God appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give thee.
Masaai: Ore teina kewarie neitalio Olaitoriani kewan te Solomon, nejoki ninye, “Toomonu entoki niyieu naaisho.”

English: And Solomon said unto God, Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father, and hast made me to reign in his stead.
Masaai: Nejoki Solomon Enkai, “Ntodolua iyie enyorrata kitok nauno te papaai lai Daudi, nikintaa nanu olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai, nchoo ina kisiligata ino tialo Daudi papa lai meitabari taata, amu kintaa iyie nanu olaiguanani te shumata olorere kitok oba anaa enterit e nkop.

English: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
Masaai: Nchooki naa taata nanu eng'eno nagut o yiolounoto pee alo najing'u naitashe te dukuya kulo tung'ana, amu aing'ae oidim aitoria ele orere lino kitok?”

English: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast asked long life; but hast asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people, over whom I have made thee king:
Masaai: Newaliki Enkai Solomon ajoki, “Ore enkaraki natii ena atua oltau lino, neitu iyie iomonu imasaa, o enkarsisisho, o enkanyit, anaa enkishui e lelo likimba iyie, neitu doi ninye iomonu enkishui naado, kake eng'eno o eyiolounoto te kewan ino, pee itum aitoria lelo tung'ana laainei laa te ninche nanu aaitaa olaiguanani,

English: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto thee; and I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.
Masaai: kinchooki iyie eng'eno nagut o eyiolounoto. Kaaisho sii karsisisho, o masaa, o enkanyit, neitu ae kata etum obo le lelo aiguanak apa ootii dukuya iyie, nemeeta te siadi iyie olotum mbaa naatiu anaa kuna.”

English: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon alotu teine wueji e shumata te Gibeon, te dukuya ilo ng'obor le ntumo, nelotu Yerusalem. Neitore ninye Israel.

English: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neiturrur Solomon tenebo ngarrin oo mbartan o lakedok loo-mbartan nkalifuni tomon oare, laa ninche apa etipika nkanas, oo ngarrin oo mbartan tenebo olaiguanani te Yerusalem.

English: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
Masaai: Neitotiu olaiguanani enkosholai o sahabu anaa isoito te Yerusalem neiput iltarakua pooki wueji anaa iretet le Shefela.

English: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king's merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
Masaai: Neinyang'u Solomon mbartan naaing'uaa Misiri o enkop naji Kue, ore lelo biasharani lo laiguanani neng'amu ninche te Kue te nkinyang'a.

English: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
Masaai: Naa keinyang'u apa ninche engarri oo mbartan naing'uaa Misiri te shekeli iip ile e nkosholai, neinyang'u embarta te shekeli iip nabo o onom. Neikunaki sii apa neijia aamiraki ilaiguanak pooki le Hiti o laiguanak le Siria.

English: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
Masaai: Neitobir apa Solomon pee eshet enkaji e Nkai tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, neitobiraki kewan enkaji e nkitoo.

English: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
Masaai: Neiteng'el Solomon iltung'ana nkalifuni ntomoni naapishana pee enap ilolan, neiteng'el iltung'ana nkalifuni ntomoni isiet pee eturu isoito teina kop oo ndonyio, neiteng'el iltung'ana nkalifuni uni o iip ile ooitasheiki ninche.

English: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As thou didst deal with David my father, and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Solomon olkilikuai Huram olaiguanani le Turo: Nejoki, “Ore apa anaa enintaasa Daudi papa, nirriwaki ninye iltarakua ooshetie enkaji enye nabikie, ntaasaki sii nanu ina.

English: Behold, I build an house to the name of the LORD my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of the LORD our God. This is an ordinance for ever to Israel.
Masaai: “Ng'ura etaa nanu kajo pee ashet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ai, naitisinya nanu ninye apejoki enkorropil, o sonkoyoni naarropil te dukuya ninye. Naishoru nanu anaake emukate enkitoduaarato, naishoru nanu ilasarri oopejori tadekenya o teipa, too sabatoni o too lapaitin ng'ejuko, o too siruai gelunot lo Laitoriani Enkai ang, anaa apa enaiteng'elaki ntarasi te Israel.

English: And the house which I build is great: for great is our God above all gods.
Masaai: Ore ina aji nalo nanu ashet naa keaku kitok, amu ore Enkai ang naa aikitok alang nkaitin pooki.

English: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
Masaai: Kake aing'ae oidim ateshetaki ninye keper, aa ore keper nalakua oleng nemeishaa? Kara nanu ng'ae oshetaki ninye enkaji, aa ore meteleku ake ewueji nepejieki enkorropil te dukuya ninye?

English: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
Masaai: Ore naa taata irriwakaki nanu oltung'ani arriyia te siaai e sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o sekenkei, o too muain pilei o naanyokie o nkilani pusi oltung'ani oiteng'enaki te nguetare, pee elo aaku tenebo lelo aisiaayiak arriyiak ootii tenebo nanu te Yuda o te Yerusalem, lelo apa ooishorua Daudi papa lai.

English: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that thy servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with thy servants,
Masaai: Irriwakaki sii iltarakua o lkeek oonyaanyukie iltarakua, o mbaoi naaing'uaa Lebanon, amu ayiolo nanu ajo keyiolo isinkan linono aatudung mbaoi te Lebanon. Naa keaku isinkan laainei tenebo isinkan linono,

English: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
Masaai: pee aaitobiraki nanu mbaoi kumok, amu ore ina aji nalo nanu ashet naa keaku kitok naa enenking'asia.

English: And, behold, I will give to thy servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
Masaai: Naa kaishoru nanu tenkaraki isinkan linono, lelo oodung'u mbaoi, mpirbili nkalifuni tikitam e nkano naidong'o, o mpirbili nkalifuni tikitam e shairi, o mboreitin iip ong'uan oltulet le naisho oo sabibu, o eilata mboreitin iip ong'uan oltulet.”

English: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
Masaai: Neitoki Huram ilo aiguanani le Turo awal te mpalai naigeroko Solomon, nejo, “Ore enkaraki nanyor Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, kintaa iyie olaiguanani lenye.”

English: Huram said moreover, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, that made heaven and earth, who hath given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for the LORD, and an house for his kingdom.
Masaai: Neitoki Huram, ajo, “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, ilo oitobira shumata o enkop, laa ninye oishoo olaiguanani Daudi olayioni ng'en, neiputaki enkarriyiano o eyiolounoto, laa ninye oshetaki Olaitoriani enkaji, neshetaki kewan enkaji e nkitoo.

English: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father's,
Masaai: “Airriwua naa taata nanu oltung'ani arriyia, obore eyiolounoto Huramabi

English: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with thy cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father.
Masaai: olayioni le ntito e Dan, ore apa menye naa oltung'ani le Turo. Eiteng'enaki ninye pee easishore sahabu, o enkosholai, o suyai, o esekenkei, o soito o nkeek, o muain pooki pilei o mpusi, o nkilani naanyokie o kitani napuyiapui. Neas mpukunot pooki e nguetare nedamu enkipirunoto ake ninye naishooki ninye meipiru. Keaku lelo tung'ana linono arriyiak tenebo iltung'ana arriyiak lo lkitok lai Daudi papaai lino.

English: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord hath spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
Masaai: Ore naa taata ina ano o shairi, o eilata o enaisho oo sabibu, naa ninche eimaka olkitok lai, nchoo ninye meirriwaki isinkan linono;

English: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as thou shalt need: and we will bring it to thee in flotes by sea to Joppa; and thou shall carry it up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa aikidung'u iyiook mbaoi naaba anaa iniyieu te Lebanon, nikiyaki iyie too rridat aaimunye enaiposha e Yopa, pee itum iyie aawa Yerusalem.”

English: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon aiken iltung'ana pooki dokunot apa ootii enkop e Israel, aiturubare ina kikenare apa naikenishe Daudi papaai lenye. Netumi iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o onom o okuni o iip ile.

English: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
Masaai: Ore ntomoni naapishana negelu metanapa ilolan. Ore nkalifuni ntomoni isiet nepuo aaturu isoito teina kop oo ldoinyio, ore nkalifuni uni o iip ile neitaa ilaitasheikinok pee etum iltung'ana aataas esiaai.

English: Then Solomon began to build the house of the LORD at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where the LORD appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
Masaai: Neiteru Solomon ashetu enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem, te nchumata o ldoinyo le Moria, teine wueji apa neibalunye Olaitoriani kewan te papaai lenye Daudi. Teine wueji apa netegelua Daudi, te nchumata ine apa neiutuutishoreki e Ornan ilo le Yebusi.

English: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
Masaai: Neiteru ninye ashet to lapa liare to lari liong'uan le nkitoria enye.

English: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of God. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
Masaai: Kuna apa ntemeta e Solomon te nchetata e nkaji e Nkai: ore enkadoro naa ntemat e nkaina tikitam oopishana, naa ntemat e nkaina naaudo endapasho.

English: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
Masaai: Ore ine wueji nejing'ieki neba anaa endapasho eina aji. Ore enkadoro oo sunta naa ntemat enkaina onom o ong'uan. Ore atua ina aji nemura te sahabu nasila.

English: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
Masaai: Ore ilo gilata sapuk neikodo too ltarakua nemura te sahabu nasila, neguetakino iltuka, o lpisia.

English: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
Masaai: Eikodo apa olaiguanani ina aji e Nkai too soito sidain oogol enkinyang'a, o te sahabu naing'uaa enkop e Paraim.

English: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
Masaai: Neaku etipika apa ninye sahabu atua ina aji, ing'apeta enyena, o loom lenyena o sunta enyena.

English: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
Masaai: Neitobir sii ine wueji nesinya aisul, nenyaanyuk enkadoro enye o endapasho eina aji, naa ntemat e nkaina naaudo ake enchoto nabo, nemur ninye te sahabu nasila oo ntalantani iip ile.

English: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
Masaai: Ore enkiroishi oo lmushumaani naa shekeli nabo ometabaiki shekeli onom e sahabu. Nemur ninye lelo gilat le shumata te sahabu.

English: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
Masaai: Ore teine wueji nesinya aisul nepik ilkerubi oare loo nkeek, nemur ninche te sahabu.

English: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
Masaai: Ore inaipuko e lelo kerubi pokira oare naa ntemat e nkaina are enkadoro.

English: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
Masaai: Ore enaipukoi olkerubi obo nelo atumore enaipukoi e likae kerubi te mpolos e nkaji.

English: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
Masaai: Ore inaipuko e kulo kerubi nebaya te nkadoro ntemat naaudo e nkaina, neitashe ake olkerubi too nkejek enyena eing'or olgos le kutukaji.

English: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
Masaai: Neitobir ilkarash liatua, pusi, o sinteti o loonyokie, o kitani napuyiapui neitobir ilkerubi.

English: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ina aji, neitobir ninye ing'apeta are naa ntemat e nkaina tomon o imiet o lpisiaai enkadoro, nepik inkopiyiani ilukuny naa ntemat imiet e nkaina enkadoro.

English: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye olpisiai anaa osaei le murt nepik ninche enchumata e nena ng'apeta; neitobir ilgululu iip nabo neripaki ilo pisiaai.

English: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
Masaai: Etipika apa ninye nena ng'apeta dukuya ina aji e Nkai, nepik ake nabo enkalo e kopikop nepik enkae enkalo e moikuape; ore ina natii enkalo e kopikop nejo ninye Yakin, ore ina natii enkalo e moikuape nejo Boas.

English: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
Masaai: Eitobira ninye olperere lo lasar lo suyai, naa ntemat e nkaina naaudo enkadoro, naa neijia etiu endapasho, naa ntemat ong'uan olpisiai enkadoro nailep.

English: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
Masaai: Neitoki aitobir olmoti le sekenkei natosholaki, naa intemat are olpisiai enkaina endapasho, naa ntemat ong'uan olpisiai e nkaina endapasho naa ntemat tomon ookuni e nkaina enkamanaa enye. Naa kepurupurana apa.

English: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
Masaai: Ore tiabori ilo moti netii intokitin naaijo ilmong'i ooitashe emanita; naa ilkererin oare apa ninche.

English: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
Masaai: Neitashe ilo moti te nchumata lelo mong'i, neing'or okuni enkalo e moikuape, neing'or okuni enkalo o loontoluo, neing'or okuni enkalo e kopikop, neing'or okuni enkalo o loosaen, naa ninche apa eiteleikiaki ilo moti, ore nkaloli enye oo lkidong'o naa enkalo e atua etii.

English: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
Masaai: Ore endapasho enye neba anaa endap e nkaina, ore emanaroto enye neikununo anaa enkikompe, netiu anaa entapukai sidai; neeta mboreitin nkalifuni uni o ltulet enkare natii.

English: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand,and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
Masaai: Neitobir sii ilmotio tomon ooitukuoreki, nepik imiet enkalo e kopikop nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape. Kuna apa eitukuyieki irubat eng'ues naitaae olasar opejori, ore ilo moti naa oloo lapolosak pee eitukuore.

English: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
Masaai: Neitobir ninye nkitasheta oo ltaai anaa enatuutuaki nepik ninche atua ina aji e Nkai, nepik imiet enkalo e kopikop, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape.

English: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
Masaai: Neitobir sii imesai tomon, nepik ninche atua ina aji e Nkai, nepik imiet enkalo e moikuape.

English: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
Masaai: Neitobir olgoriet loo lapolosak, o lgoriet kitok enejing'ieki olgoriet,

English: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
Masaai: nemur nena kutukie oo lgorieti to suyai; nepik ilo moti olpijata le nkalo e kopikop eina aji.

English: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of God;
Masaai: Neitobir sii Huram imotioo, o nchempei oo lala, o ngirran. Neaku eidipa apa Huram esiaai pooki nataasaka olaiguanani Solomon te nkaji e Nkai:

English: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
Masaai: nena ng'apeta pokira are, o lbakulini, o nena opiyiani naaishopokino, oina siaai oo usin naaripunyeki nkarash are naaimulumulieki nena girran naatii nchumat e nena ng'apeta;

English: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
Masaai: o lgululu iip ong'uan ooikodieki ina siaai e ripare oo usin, te nkarasha ake nabo, pee eimulumul nena girran pokira are naatii nchumat e nena ng'apeta.

English: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
Masaai: Neitobir sii nkitasheta neiteleiki lelo motioo nena kitasheta.

English: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
Masaai: O ilo moti obo, o lelo mong'i pokira tomon oare ootii abori enye.

English: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of the LORD of bright brass.
Masaai: O mbokishi o nchempei oo lala, o masaa pooki naaitobira Huram to suyai oidong'o, aitobiraki olaiguanani Solomon, tenkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
Masaai: Ore teina kisiajata e nkop e Yuda eipurjaki ninche, teina terit natii erishata e Sukot o Sereda.

English: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
Masaai: Neitobir Solomon kuna tokitin pooki te nkumoi sapuk oleng, o metaa meikenayu enkiroishi o suyai.

English: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of God, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
Masaai: Neaku eitobira Solomon ntokitin pooki apa naatii atua enkaji e Nkai: olperere lo lasar le sahabu, o misai tenkaraki emukate e nkitoduaaroto,

English: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
Masaai: o nkitasheta oo ltaai, o lelo taai lenye le sahabu nasila, pee eyupuyup te dukuya ilo gilata liatua osinya, anaa apa enatuutuaki.

English: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
Masaai: O ntapuka, oltaai, o nena tokitin naarieki iltaai e sahabu nasila;

English: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
Masaai: o ntokitin naaitobirieki iltaai, o mbeseni, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ngirran e nkima, e sahabu nasila, o lgos le nkaji e Nkai ojing'ieki kutukaji o lgilata liatua o metabaiki ine wueji nesinya aisul, ore nkutukie eine nejing'ieki ina aji e Nkai naa ine sahabu.

English: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of the LORD was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of God.
Masaai: Neaku eidipe ina siaai pooki apa nataasa Solomon tenkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani. Neyau Solomon aitijing'u nena tokitin apa naaitisinya Daudi papaai lenye, neshum ina osholai, o sahabu, o masaa pooki teneshumishoreki e nkaji e Nkai.

English: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the city of David, which is Zion.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon aiturrur ilpayiani loo Siraeli, o lukuny pooki oo loshon, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye too ltung'ana loo Siraeli, te Yerusalem, pee epuo aailepunye osanduku lo lning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani aaitupuku te nkanasa e Daudi, aa taa Sion.

English: Wherefore all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
Masaai: Neiturrurro iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli te dukuya olaiguanani to sirua lo lapa liopishana.

English: And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilpayiani pooki loo Siraeli, nenap ilawi ilo sanduku,

English: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
Masaai: neyau ilo sanduku oilo ng'obor le ntumo, o nena masaa naasinya pooki naatii atua ilo ng'obor; neyau ilapolosak o Lawi ninche.
