English: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani Solomon o lturrurr pooki le Israel apa oiturrurre te dukuya ninye, netii dukuya ilo sanduku, nepolos nkerra kumok o lmong'i lemeikenayu.

English: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the LORD unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
Masaai: Neaku eyautua ilapolosak ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua lo Laitoriani ewueji enye, tiatua olgilata liatua leina aji, tiatua ine wueji nesinya aisul, tiabori inaipuko oo lkerubi.

English: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
Masaai: Amu kelak apa lelo kerubi inaipuko enye te shumata ilo sanduku lo lning'o lo sotua, neaku keitoip lelo kerubi ilo sanduku lo sotua, o mbokishi enyena.

English: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
Masaai: Naa kaadoru apa nena bokishi oleng, ometaa ore ineeiting'ie nelioyu teine wueji sinyati te dukuya olgilata liatua osinya. Kake melioo te boo. Netii ninche ine ometabaiki ena olong.

English: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
Masaai: Metii apa toki atua ilo sanduku meteleku ake nena baoi dapashi oo soito apa naatipika Musa te Horeb, teine apa naitobirie Olaitoriani olning'o lo sotua o ltung'ana loo Siraeli, apa pee eipang'u te nkop e Misiri.

English: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
Masaai: Ore apa pee eipang'u ilapolosak teine wueji sinyati (amu ore apa lelo apolosak pooki ootii ine neitisinya ate, meshilaa ilturrurri lenye;

English: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
Masaai: ore lelo aranyak pooki le Lawi, o Asaf, o Heman, o Yedutum, o layiok lenye o lalashera lenye, neishop ilkilani sidain, neeta inkinantani dapashi, o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o lwululi loo usin, neitashe te nkalo o loo saen lo lperere lo lasar, tenebo ilapolosak iip nabo o tikitam ookut ntarumpetani.

English: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the LORD; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of the LORD;
Masaai: Naa esiaai apa oo lakutak loo ntarumpetani, o laranyak pee eitoning'oo ate te nkirukoto o sinkolio eisis neisho enashe Olaitoriani. Naa teneilepieki osinkolio too ntarumpetani o too nkinantani dapashi, o kulie ake kinantani naaranyishoreki eisisi Olaitoriani, aajo, “Eisupat ninye nebik enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi” ore ina aji, ina aji o Laitoriani neiput enkatampoi;

English: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of the LORD had filled the house of God.
Masaai: amu keiput apa enkitoo o Laitoriani enkaji e Nkai.

English: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon ajo, “Etejo Olaitoriani kebik ninye te misimisi nagut.

English: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
Masaai: Aateshetaka nanu iyie enkaji e shumata, ewueji ino nibikie ntarasi.”

English: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aibelekenya nemayian ina umata oo Siraeli, eitashe ina umata pooki oo Siraeli.

English: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, amu eitabayie ninye te nkaina enye ina apa naisiligie te nkutuk enye Daudi papaai lai, ejo,

English: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:
Masaai: ‘Ore ebaiki ina olong nayaua nanu iltung'ana laainei aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, eitu nanu agelu enkanasa tiatua Israel pooki, naa ninye eshetieki enkaji, pee etum enkarna ai ataa ine etii. Neitu nanu agelu oltung'ani aitaa kitok te shumata iltung'ana laainei loo Siraeli.

English: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.
Masaai: Kake ategelua nanu Yerusalem pee etum enkarna ai ataa ine etii, nategelua nanu Daudi pee eitasheiki iltung'ana laainei le Israel.’

English: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Eeta apa Daudi papaai lai to ltau lenye pee eshet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Olaitoriani Daudi papaai lai, ‘Ore hoo niata to ltau lino pee ishet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai, intobira amu iata ina to ltau lino;

English: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.
Masaai: ore ake eyia, milo iyie ashet ina aji, kake olayioni lino likiikini iyie, ninye olo ashet enkaji tenkaraki enkarna ai.’

English: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Eitabayie taata Olaitoriani ina kisiligata enye apa naisiligishore; amu aitasho nanu te rishata e Daudi, papaai lai, naton to lorika le nkitoo, le Israel, anaa apa enaisiligishore Olaitoriani natesheta nanu enkaji tenkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.
Masaai: Natipika ine osanduku laa ninye etii ilo sotua lo Laitoriani oitobira ninye tenebo iltung'ana loo Siraeli.”

English: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:
Masaai: Neitashe Solomon te dukuya ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te dukuya ina umata pooki neilepie nkaik enyena aitorioo.

English: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
Masaai: Eitobira apa Solomon ewueji o suyai neika ntemat are e nkaina enkadoro o endapasho, naa entemata nabo enkadoro nailep, nepik apa ine wueji olgoriet. neitashe te nchumata. Neitoki agil kung te nchumata ine te dukuya ina umata pooki oo Siraeli neitorioo nkaik enyena aing'orie shumata,

English: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:
Masaai: nejo, “Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, meetae Enkai natiu anaa iyie, te keper o te nkop, naibung osotua neitodolu enyorrata nauno too sinkan lenyena oopuo te dukuya iyie too ltauja lenye pooki.

English: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.
Masaai: Mbung'a iyie tialo osinka lino Daudi, papaai lai ina apa nimbalakinye ninye; ee iroro iyie te nkutuk ino, nintabayie te nkaina ino nena ena olong.

English: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, mbung'a to sinka lino Daudi, papaai lai, ina apa nisiligie ninye, ijo, “Mikiany ae kata oltung'ani kisiaai iyie te dukuya nanu, pee etonie olorika le nkitoo le Israel, oi duoo tenaa kejurru ilayiok linono nkoitoi enye nepuo too nkitanapat aainei anaa enishomie iyie te dukuya nanu.”

English: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, nchoo eunoyu ilo rorei lino, apa lirorie osinka lino Daudi.

English: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!
Masaai: “Kake amaa, kesipa kebik Olaitoriani tenebo iltung'ana te nkop? Ng'ura, ore keper o keper nalakua nemikiishaa iyie; kebaa naa mikiishaa iyie ena aji natesheta nanu!

English: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:
Masaai: Toning'o naa enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye, Olaitoriani Enkai ai. Toning'o enkishirata o enkomono nayau osinka lino dukuya iyie;

English: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.
Masaai: pee etum nkonyek inono aaing'ura ena aji dama o kewarie, ene wueji apa nisiligishore pee ipik enkarna ino, pee itum atoning'o enkomono naomon osinka lino tene wueji.

English: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.
Masaai: Toning'o iyie eomonokinoto o sinka lino o enoo ltung'ana linono le Israel, te neomon eing'or ene wueji, ee toning'o iyie itii emanyisho ino te keper, naa te nining nipalaki.

English: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;
Masaai: “Teneas oltung'ani eng'oki tialo ole latia enye, neinosieki olmumai lenye te dukuya ele perere lo lasar tena aji,

English: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie itii keper, nias, ninguanare isinkan linono, aitalaku entorroni ayau entorroni enye shumata endukuya enye makewan, nimbalunye ilo supat alaaki ninye te risioroto e supatisho enye.

English: And if thy people Israel be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against thee; and shall return and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house;
Masaai: “Tenemiri iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli te dukuya ilmang'ati, enkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki te iyie, tenelo neibelekenya ninche aaibalie enkarna ino, neomon, nesaisho tiatua ena aji,

English: Then hear thou from the heavens, and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest to them and to their fathers.
Masaai: toning'o ake iyie itii keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo ltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, nirrinyu ninche menyaaki aapuonu ina kop apa ninchoo ninche o loo menye.

English: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against thee; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess thy name, and turn from their sin, when thou dost afflict them;
Masaai: “Teneikeno keper, nelai enchan tenkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki tialo iyie, teneomon ninche eing'or ene wueji, neibalie enkarna ino, neibelekenya aaing'uaa ing'ok enye, itoosho iyie ninche,

English: Then hear thou from heaven, and forgive the sin of thy servants, and of thy people Israel, when thou hast taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land, which thou hast given unto thy people for an inheritance.
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie itii keper, nipalaki eng'oki oo sinkan linono, iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, niutaki ninche enkoitoi sidai naa ninye epuoyie; nirriwaki enchan ena kop ino, naa ninye inchoo iltung'ana linono metaa enjung'ore.

English: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
Masaai: “Tenelotu olameyu enkop anaa olmeitai, anaa erruoyo ndaiki naatii nkurman, anaa tenelotu olmaati, anaa enkurto; teneng'adu ilmang'ati lenye ninche te nabo ake ninye oo nkanas enye; o pooki meitai anaa pooki muoyian;

English: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all thy people Israel, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
Masaai: ore ake enkomono pooki o esayiata naomon oltung'ani obo anaa iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli, eyiolo ake oltung'ani eoshoto enye o sina lenye, neitorioo nkaik aaing'orie ena aji;

English: Then hear thou from heaven thy dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; (for thou only knowest the hearts of the children of men:)
Masaai: toning'o naa iyie te keper, teina manyisho ino, nipalaki, ore ake pooki tau liyiolo iyie nilaaki te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena (Amu iyie ake openy oyiolo iltauja loo nkera e tung'ana);

English: That they may fear thee, to walk in thy ways, so long as they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers.
Masaai: pee kitum ninche aatureita iyie, nepuo too nkoitoi inono, nkolong'i pooki naaishu teina kop apa ninchoo iloo menye.

English: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of thy people Israel, but is come from a far country for thy great name's sake, and thy mighty hand, and thy stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
Masaai: “Naa tenelotu oltung'ani loo loreren, ilo leme oloo ltung'ana linono loo Siraeli eing'uaa enelakua tenkaraki enkarna ino kitok, o enkarna ino magilani, tenelotu ninye aomon eing'or ena aji,

English: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
Masaai: toning'o iyie itii keper, ina manyisho ino, nias te risioroto e nena pooki nikimpotie ilo tung'ani loo loreren iyie; pee etum iloreren pooki le nkop aatayiolo enkarna ino, nikiureyu iyie, anaa enaasita iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli, netum aatayiolo nchere ore ena aji natesheta nanu te nkarna ino naa enkarna ino eipotieki.

English: If thy people go out to war against their enemies by the way that thou shalt send them, and they pray unto thee toward this city which thou hast chosen, and the house which I have built for thy name;
Masaai: “Tenepuo iltung'ana linono olarrabal aagilunore ilmang'ati lenye, ore te pooki oitoi niimie iyie ninche; nikiomon ninche iyie eing'or ena anasa nitegelua, iyie o ena aji natesheta nanu te nkarna ino,

English: Then hear thou from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
Masaai: toning'o iyie itii keper enkomono enye o esayiata enye, nintagol ninche.

English: If they sin against thee, (for there is no man which sinneth not,) and thou be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
Masaai: “Teneas ninche eng'oki te dukuya iyie, amu meetae oltung'ani lemias ing'ok, nigorokino iyie ninche, ninchooyo ninche too lmang'ati lenye nenapi ninche aaya eyararoto te nkop nalakua o enataana;

English: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto thee in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
Masaai: kake tenedamu ninche too ltauja teina kop apa nawaki ninche, neirridu, nikisai ninche iyie teina kop e yararoto enye, ejo, ‘Kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, nikitaasa ntorrok’;

English: If they return to thee with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which thou gavest unto their fathers, and toward the city which thou hast chosen, and toward the house which I have built for thy name:
Masaai: teneirridu ninche too ndamunot enye pooki o too ltauja lenye pooki teina kop e yararoto enye, apa naawaki ninche, neomon eing'or ina kop enye apa ninchoo iyie loo menye, oina anasa nitegelua iyie, o ina aji natesheta nanu tenkaraki enkarna ino,

English: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive thy people which have sinned against thee.
Masaai: toning'o iyie itii keper ina manyisho ino, enkomono enye o esayiata enye. Ntagolo ninche, nipalaki lelo tung'ana linono ootaasa eng'oki te iyie.

English: Now, my God, let, I beseech thee, thine eyes be open, and let thine ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Enkai ai nchoo eing'or nkonyek inono nening nkiyiaa inono enkomono ene wueji.

English: Now therefore arise, O LORD God, into thy resting place, thou, and the ark of thy strength: let thy priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, and let thy saints rejoice in goodness.
Masaai: “Naa tudumunye taata, Olaitoriani Enkai, shomo ewueji ino enkiyeng'iyeng, iyie oilo sanduku lino le magilanisho. Nchoo ilapolosak linono Olaitoriani Enkai meishopokini enjeunoto ino. Nchoo isinyat linono eshipakino esupatisho ino.

English: O LORD God, turn not away the face of thine anointed: remember the mercies of David thy servant.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai, mimbelekeny enkomom ino aitung'uaa ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput! Tadamu enyorrata ino nauno tenkaraki Daudi osinka lino.”

English: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the LORD filled the house.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Solomon enkomono enye nedou enkima naing'uaa shumata neinos ilo asar opejori o nkishorot neiput enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.

English: And the priests could not enter into the house of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD had filled the LORD'S house.
Masaai: Neitu eidim ilapolosak aatijing atua ina aji o Laitoriani.

English: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol nkera pooki oo Siraeli ina kima edou, o enkitoo o Laitoriani te shumata ina aji e Nkai, neirrugo ninche aaitabaiki nkomomi enkop, te ndung'oroto, neserem neisho Olaitoriani enashe ejo, “Amu aisupat ninye, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani o ltung'ana pooki aaishooyo ilasarri te dukuya o Laitoriani.

English: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
Masaai: Eishorua olaiguanani Solomon olasar ilmong'i nkalifuni tikitam oare, o nkerra nkalifuni iip o tikitam. Ore olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki neitisiny ina aji e Nkai.

English: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of the LORD, which David the king had made to praise the LORD, because his mercy endureth for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.
Masaai: Neitashe ilapolosak too wuejitin enye. Neitashe sii Ilawi aaiko neijia, eeta nena kinantani oo sinkolioitin, apa naaitobira olaiguanani Daudi pee eishorieki Olaitoriani enashe - amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi. Naa teneisis apa Daudi Olaitoriani te nkisiaayiare enye, ore te nda shoto neosh ilapolosak ntarumpetani; neitashe Israel pooki.

English: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the LORD: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
Masaai: Neitisiny Solomon empolos e ilo goriet apa otii dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani. Amu teine eitayio olasar opejori, o eilata o lasar le seriani. Amu ore apa ilo perere lo lasar lo suyai oitobira Solomon, nemeishaa olasar opejori, o lasar le ntapa, o eilata.

English: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata neibung Solomon osirua nkolong'i naapishana o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye, eumata kitok oleng nabaiki enejingieki Hamat ometabaiki oerata le Misiri.

English: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet neibung ninche eumata e nkitirring'a; amu eibung'a apa ninche enkitisinyata o lperere lo lasar nkolong'i naapishana, o sirua nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the LORD had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel his people.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam oo kuni o lapa liopishana neisho iltung'ana meshomo nkang'itie enye, eng'ida neeta enchipai too ltauja lenye tenkaraki ina supatisho naitoduaa Olaitoriani, Daudi, o Solomon o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli.

English: Thus Solomon finished the house of the LORD, and the king's house: and all that came into Solomon's heart to make in the house of the LORD, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
Masaai: Neidip Solomon ina aji o Laitoriani, o enkaji o laiguanani e nkitoo, o nena pooki apa naaitobira Solomon pee eas te nkaji enye makewan, neitabaya pooki aitobiraki.

English: And the LORD appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard thy prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani aitalioo kewan te Solomon kewarie nejoki ninye, “Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino, nategelua ene wueji te nkaraki kewan ai pee eaku enkaji o lasar.

English: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
Masaai: Tenaiken nanu keper ometaa meetae enchan, anaa aitanap olmaati pee emut enkop, anaa airriu olmeitai atua iltung'ana laainei,

English: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
Masaai: ore ake pee eitobir ate iltung'ana laainei, lelo laa enkarna ai eipotieki, neomon ninche neing'oru enkomom ai, neibelekenya aaing'uaa nkoitoi enye torrok, naa kaning nanu atii keper, napalaki eng'oki enye naishiunye enkop enye.

English: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
Masaai: Ore taa ina kata, nebolo nkonyek aainei neinining nkiyiaa aainei enkomono naomoni tene wueji.

English: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
Masaai: Amu ore taata ategelua nanu, naitisinya ena aji pee etum enkarna ai atobiko tene ntarasi; ore nkonyek aainei o ltau lai neaku ine etii nkatitin pooki.

English: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
Masaai: Naa ore tialo iyie, tenilo te dukuya nanu, anaa apa Daudi papaai lino, nias te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa nanu, nimbung nkikoot aainei, o nkiguanat aainei,

English: Then will I stablish the throne of thy kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David thy father, saying, There shall not fail thee a man to be ruler in Israel.
Masaai: naitasheyie nanu olorika lino le nkitoo; anaa apa anatoning'ore Daudi papaai lino, ajoki, ‘Melai aekata te iyie oltung'ani oitoreisho te Israel.’

English: But if ye turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
Masaai: “Kake tenimbelekenya iyie, ninturraa nkikoot aainei o nkitanapat aainei natipika nanu dukuya iyie; nilo aisiaai kulie aitin, niserem ninche,

English: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
Masaai: naadotu nanu teina kop apa naaishoo; ore ena aji naitisinya nanu tenkaraki enkarna ai, naiturraa aiwuang'ie too nkonyek aainei, naitaa nanu endung'et e rashe, o rorei ooimakini tiatua loreren.

English: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it; so that he shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
Masaai: Naa ore tiatua ena aji, naailepieki oleng, ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo neing'asia, nejo, ‘Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena kop o tena aji?’

English: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook the LORD God of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aajo “Enkaraki natanyaita ninche Enkai oo loo menye, apa nayaua ninche aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, neigarakino ninche kulie aitin, neserem ninche, neisiaai ninche; ore enkaraki ina eyaua Enkai ena torroni pooki shumata ninche.’ ”

English: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of the LORD, and his own house,
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ilarin tikitam laa ninche eteshetie Solomon enkaji o Laitoriani o enkaji enye makewan

English: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
Masaai: neitoki Solomon ashetu nena anas apa naaishoo Huram ninye, nepik iltung'ana loo Siraeli ine.

English: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon alo Hamatsoba, neisulie ninye.

English: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
Masaai: Neshet ninye Tadamor tiong'ata o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki apa naatesheta ninye te Hamat.

English: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Bethhoron the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
Masaai: Enyaaka sii ashet Bet-horon e shumata o Bet-horon e abori, nkanas naasheta isunta, o nchomito, naatii isekenke.

English: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
Masaai: O Baalat o nkanas naasheta too soito apa naara ine Solomon, o nkanas pooki oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, o nkanas oo lakedok lenyena loo mbartan, o pooki toki nayieu Solomon neshetu te Yerusalem, o te Lebanon, o teina kop pooki enkitoria enye.

English: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Israel,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki ootelekutua too Lhiti, o Lamori, o Lperisi, o Lhifi, o Lyebusi, lelo leme iloo Siraeli,

English: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
Masaai: ebaiki iishoritin enye, apa ootelekutua teina kop leitu eidaikie iltung'ana loo Siraeli - neitaa Solomon lelo ilenkisiaayiare nagol, naa neijia etiu o taata.

English: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
Masaai: Kake ore tialo iltung'ana loo Siraeli, eitu eitaa Solomom irrindiki le siaai enye. Isikarini apa ninche, o ltung'ana le nkitoo, o lkituaak le njore loo ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan.

English: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
Masaai: Naa kulo apa iltung'ana kituaak le Solomon, iip are o onom, laa ninche oata enkitoria tiatua olorere.

English: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Israel, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of the LORD hath come.
Masaai: Neyau Solomon entito e Farao aitung'uaa enkanasa e Daudi neriku ina aji apa nateshetaka ninye. Amu etejo ninye, “Meton enkitok ai te nkaji e Daudi olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Amu ore iwuejitin neeyauaki osanduku lo Laitoriani naa kesinya.”

English: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto the LORD on the altar of the LORD, which he had built before the porch,
Masaai: Neitaiki Solomon Olaitoriani olasar opejori te nchumata ilo perere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otesheta ninye te mbata e nkaji e Nkai.

English: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
Masaai: Ore anaa enayieuni te nkisiayiare e pooki olong'i, neitayuni ilasarri terisioroto enkitanapata e Musa too sabatoni, o too lapaitin ng'ejuko okuni to lari o sirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki, o sirua loo wikii, o sirua loo lng'oborri.

English: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of God commanded.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto e nkikoo e Daudi papaai lenye, etegelua ninye ilturrurri loo lapolosak tenkaraki enkisiaayiare enye, o Lawi tenkaraki isiaaitin enye e nkisisa o enkisiaayiare te dukuya ilapolosak metaasa esiaai te pooki olong nayieuni; o ilarripok loo nchomito loo lturrurri lenye too nchomito esiana naje; amu ina apa eitanapishe Daudi osinka le Nkai.

English: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
Masaai: Neitu ninche eibelekenya apaash ina naitanapa olaiguanani ilapolosak o Lawi tialo pooki bae o too lchumat.

English: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the LORD, and until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was perfected.
Masaai: Neaku eidipe apa esiaai pooki e Solomon ebaiki ina olong apa napiki olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani. O meidipayu, neidipayu ina aji o Laitoriani.

English: Then went Solomon to Eziongeber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
Masaai: Neitoki Solomon alo Esiong'eber o Elot te mbata e naiposha, te nkop e Edom.

English: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Huram ninye too sinkan lenyena imelin o sinkan ootamoo enaiposha, nepuo ninche Ofir tenebo isinkan le Solomon. Neyau teine ntalantani iip ong'uan o onom e sahabu nayaki olaiguanani Solomon.

English: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening'oo enkaiguanani e Sheba olnigo le Solomon, nelotu Yerusalem atem ninye too nkikilikuanat naagol. Nelotu ninye eeta ilaisiaayiak kumok o ntamesin naanapita isonkoyoni, o sahabu sapuk oleng, o soito oogol enkinyang'a. Ore ake pee elotu enetii Solomon, neliki ninye nena pooki apa naatii oltau lenye.

English: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
Masaai: Newal Solomon nkikilikuanat enyena pooki. Meetae entoki hoo nabo naisudoro to laiguanani Solomon neitu eibalakinye ninye.

English: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ina aiguanani e sheba eng'eno e Solomon, oina aji natesheta ninye;

English: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.
Masaai: o endaa natii emisa enye, o ltonei loo lkituaak lenyena, o enkisiaayiare oo sinkan lenyena, o nkilani enye, o lanapak loo nkikompeni enye o nkilani enye, o lasarri lenyena oo pejori ooitayio ninye te nkaji o Laitoriani, eitu eitoki ninye aidim atejo ae.

English: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts, and of thy wisdom:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye olaiguanani, “Ekesipa olkilikuai apa latoning'o nanu te nkop ai makewan tialo mbaa inono o eng'eno ino.

English: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me: for thou exceedest the fame that I heard.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa nanu anyorraa ilo kilikuai ometaba anaa nalotu adol too nkonyek aainei makewan, naa ng'ura, eitu apa nanu aalikini olpisiaai le ng'eno ino. Ilus iyie teilo kilikuai apa latoning'o nanu.

English: Happy are thy men, and happy are these thy servants, which stand continually before thee, and hear thy wisdom.
Masaai: Emunyak siaake nkituaak inono o sinkan linono ooitashe te dukuya iyie anaake nening eng'eno ino!

English: Blessed be the LORD thy God, which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the LORD thy God: because thy God loved Israel, to establish them for ever, therefore made he thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai ino amu kitishipakine ninye iyie nikipik iyie olorika lenye le nkitoo pee iyaku olaiguanani te rishata o Laitoriani Enkai ino! Ore amu kenyor Olaitoriani Enkai ino Israel naa keitasheyie ninche ntarasi, kintaa ninye iyie olaiguanani lenye, pee itum aiguanayu te sipata o te supatisho.”

English: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aisho olaiguanani shekeli iip o tikitam e sahabu, o sonkoyoni kumok, o soito oogol enkinyang'a: ooishoo enkaiguanani e Sheba olaiguanani Solomon.

English: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
Masaai: Ore lelo sinkan le Huram o sinkan le Solomon apa ooyautua sahabu naing'uaa Ofir neyau sii ilkeek ooji ilmusantali o soito oogol enkinyang'a.

English: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king's palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.
Masaai: Neitayunye Solomon lelo keek nkedeta naajing'ieki enkaji e Nkai o enkaji o laiguanani, o wululi loo usin, o nkinantani oo usin, tenkaraki lelo aranyak. Eitu aikata edoli embae naaijo ena te nkop e Yuda.

English: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
Masaai: Neisho Solomon enkaiguanani e Sheba nena pooki naayieu ninye, pooki toki ake ninye natoomonuo metii ntokitin naayaka ninye olaiguanani. Nerrinyo ninye alo enkop enye tenebo ilaisiaayiak lenyena.

English: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
Masaai: Ore apa enkiroishi e sahabu nayauaki enetii olaiguanani Solomon naa ntalantani iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.

English: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
Masaai: Ore nena naayautua ilainyang'ak o lamirak, eyautua sii ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o lbalusuni leina kop sahabu o enkosholai aayaki Solomon.

English: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
Masaai: Neitobir olaiguanani ilong'oi iip are sapuki e sahabu naidong'oki, ore ake elong'o nabo naa shekeli iip ile e sahabu naidong'oki.

English: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
Masaai: Neitoki aitobir ilong'oi iip uni e sahabu naidong'oki; naa shekeli iip uni e sahabu naidong'oki ake elong'o nabo. Nepik olaiguanani nena long'oi atua ina aji o sero le Lebanon.

English: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
Masaai: Neitobir sii olaiguanani olorika le nkitoo kitok loo lala loo lkanchaoni, nemur te sahabu nasila.

English: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
Masaai: Neeta ilo orika le nkitoo nkedeta ile o ewueji neiteleikini o nkejek e sahabu, neitatashakini ilo orika le nkitoo, ore ake enkalo nabo eilo orika le nkitoo netii ineeiteleikini Nkaik, o lng'atunyo oare ooitashe too mbat nena wuejitin neeiteleikini nkaik.

English: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
Masaai: Neitashe ake ilng'atunyo tomon oare teine, neitashe ake obo te nkalo e bayie e pooki kedet enena kedeta pokira ile, eitu aekata edoli entoki naaijo ina te pooki kitoria.

English: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
Masaai: Ore ntokitin pooki naaokishoreki o laiguanani Solomon naa ine sahabu, ore imasaa pooki eina aji entim e Lebanon naa ine sahabu nasila. Meikenari apa enkosholai aajo toki too nkolong'i e Solomon.

English: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
Masaai: Amu kepuo apa imelin o laiguanani Tarshishi tenebo isinkan le Huram kata nabo te rishata oo larin okuni ore nena melin e Tarshish naa kepuonu apa enapita sahabu, o enkosholai, o lala loo lkanchaoni, o yekenyi o motonyi sidain naaijo ilukunkuni.

English: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
Masaai: Neisulu Solomon ilaiguanak pooki le nkop te karsisisho o te ng'eno.

English: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
Masaai: Neing'oru ilaiguanak pooki le nkop enetii Solomon ejo pee ening eng'eno enye natipika Enkai atua endamunoto enye.

English: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
Masaai: Neyau ake pooki lenye enkishoroto, ntokitin e nkosholai o ne sahabu, o lkilani, o emanoo, o sonkoyoni, o mbartan o nyumpui te pooki ari.

English: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neeta apa Solomon ilaleta nkalifuni ong'uan loo mbartan, o ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni tomon o are, ootamanya nena anas oo ngarrin oo mbartan tenebo olaiguanani te Yerusalem.

English: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
Masaai: Neitore ninye ilaiguanak pooki ebaiki olkeju le Frati, ometabaiki enkop oo Lfilisti, o metabaiki olpolosie le Misiri.

English: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
Masaai: Neitotiu olaiguanani sahabu te Yerusalem anaa isoito nebayu iltarakua te nkumoi anaa ilng'abolo le Shefela.

English: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
Masaai: Neyakini Solomon mbartan naaing'uaa Misiri neing'uaa nkuapi pooki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Solomon ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto neigeroki tiatua embuku oo nkatinin e Natan ilo oiboni le Nkai o tiatua e naibon e Ahija le Shilon, o too nduaat e Ido ilo aduaani, eipirta Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

English: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
Masaai: Eitoreishe apa Solomon te Yerusalem neitore Israel pooki ilarin artam.

English: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Solomon etua anaa loo menye. Nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi papaai lenye. Neitoreisho Rehoboam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
Masaai: Eshomo apa Rehoboam Shekem, amu eshomo apa iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli Shekem aaitaa ninye olaiguanani.

English: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ina, (amu Misiri apa etii ninye, ine apa neisikaka ailany olaiguanani Solomon) neitoki Yeroboam arrinyunye te Misiri.

English: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche olkilikuai meipotuni ninye. Ore Yeroboam o Siraeli pooki nepuonu aajoki Reroboam,

English: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
Masaai: “Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto. Ore naa taata nteneneng'a ina kisiayiare nagol natii shumata iyiook, naa eikisiaai iyiook iyie.”

English: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enyaaki wootu enatii nanu te rishata oo nkolong'i uni.” Neaku etorrinyote iltung'ana aapuo.

English: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam aikilikuanishore ilpayiani, laa ninche apa ooitashe te dukuya olaiguanani Solomon papaai lenye, apa eton eishu, ejoki, “Kaa intae kiutakaki matiaaki kulo tung'ana?”

English: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be thy servants for ever.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Tiniaku iyie supat tialo kulo tung'ana, nintiship ninche, niro irorei supati tialo ninche, naa keaku ninche isinkan linono ntarasi.”

English: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
Masaai: Kake etanya ninye ina kikoo oo lpayiani, neing'oru enkikoo oo lbarnot le risiori enye.

English: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kaa intae iututu pee kiwaliki kulo tung'ana laatiaakita ninche nanu, “Nteneneng'a enchata ang oo murto apa natipika papaai lino shumata iyiook?’ ”

English: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee, saying, Thy father made our yoke heavy, but make thou it somewhat lighter for us; thus shalt thou say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father's loins.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo barnot le risiori enye ninye, “Nji iyie shomo tiaaki lelo tung'ana likitiaakitia, ‘Eiroshiyie apa papaai lino enchata ang oo murto, kake inteneneng'aki iyie iyiook;’ nji shomo tiaaki ninche, ‘Ore enkilinta ai naa ninye sapuk alang empolos e Papaai.

English: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
Masaai: Naa Ore naa taata, teneiteleikia apa papaai intae enchata oo murto nairoishi, naa kaponaa nanu enkiroishi eina shata inyi oo murto. Eitamio intae papaai too nkibokoni, kake kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.’ ”

English: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeroboam o ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli aapuonu enetii Rehoboam te nkolong e uni, anaa enatejo olaiguanani, “Enyaaki wootu enatii nanu te nkolong e uni.”

English: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
Masaai: Newaliki olaiguanani ninche tenkisikong'ata, neany ina kikoo oo lpayiani.

English: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
Masaai: Neirorie olaiguanani ninche te risioroto enkikoo oo lbarnot, ejoki, “Eiroshiyie apa papaai enchata inyi oo murto, kake kaponaa nanu enkiroishi. Eitamio apa intae papaai too nkibokoni, kake kaitame nanu intae too nkulupani.”

English: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of God, that the LORD might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
Masaai: Neaku eitu ening olaiguanani iltung'ana amu embae ena nayaua Enkai, pee etum Olaitoriani aitabai ororei lenye, apa oiroro aimunye Ahija le Shilon metoliki Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat.

English: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Israel: and now, David, see to thine own house. So all Israel went to their tents.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Isiraeli pooki aajo eitu ening olaiguanani ninche, newaliki iltung'ana olaiguanani aajoki, “Kaa rubata iyiook kiata te Daudi? Mikiata iyiook enjung'ore to layioni le Yese. Shomo pooki ng'ae olng'obor lino, intae Israel! Ing'ura taata enkaji ino makewan Daudi.” Nedumunye Isiraeli pooki aapuo ilng'oborri lenye.

English: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
Masaai: Kake eitoria apa Rehoboam iltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli ootii nkanas e Yuda.

English: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Rehoboam airriwaa Hadoram laa ninye apa olaitasheikinoni le siaai nagol, nenang iltung'ana loo Siraeli ninye too soito metua. Neisarrisar olaiguanani Rehoboam alo airot ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, pee eisikaki Yerusalem.

English: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
Masaai: Neaku etekepari Isiraeli te nkaji e Daudi ometabaiki ena olong.

English: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Rehoboam Yerusalem, neiturrur enkaji e Yuda o ene Benchamen, iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet gelunot, pee earare Israel, pee errinyoki Rehoboam enkitoria.

English: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
Masaai: Kake eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Shemaia ilo tung'ani le Nkai, ejo,

English: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
Masaai: “Tiaaki Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, olaiguanani le Yuda, o Siraeli pooki ootii Yuda, o Benchamen,

English: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Mipuopuo intae aarare ilalashera linyi. Torrinyoyu pooki tung'ani shomo enkang enye, amu ore ena bae naa nanu eing'uaa.” Neaku etoning'o ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, nerrinyo neitu epuo aarare Yeroboam.

English: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
Masaai: Etobiko apa Rehoboam te Yerusalem neshet nkanas naamitunye kewan tiatua Yuda,

English: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
Masaai: etesheta Betlehem, o Etam, o Tekoa,

English: And Bethzur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
Masaai: o Betsur, o Soko, o Adulam,

English: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
Masaai: o Gat, o Maresha, o Sif,

English: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
Masaai: o Adoraim, o Lakish, o Ashetak,

English: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
Masaai: o Sora, o Ahijalon, o Hebron, nkanas naasheta isunta naatii Yuda o Benchamen.

English: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
Masaai: Neitagol ninye isempewueti, nepik ilarikok le njore atua ninche, nepik ineeshumieki endaa o eilata o enaisho oo sabibu.

English: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
Masaai: Nepik sii iremeta o long'oi atua nena anas pooki, neitagol ninche oleng. Neaku eeta apa ninye Yuda o Benchamen.

English: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak o Lawi apa ootii atua Israel pooki, neing'uaa ninye too wuejitin pooki apa neetii ninche.

English: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:
Masaai: Amu etung'uaitie Ilawi iwuejitin enye, o ntokitin enye nepuonu Yuda o Yerusalem enkaraki nataarayie Yeroboam ninche o layiok lenyena aaitung'uaa enkisiaayiare anaa lapolosak lo Laitoriani,

English: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
Masaai: negelu ilapolosak lenyena loo wuejitin neeika, o too wuejitin neeseremieki nkitanyaanyukot, o Nkaitin oo lasho naaitobira ninye.

English: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootipika iltauja lenye pee eing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel nepuonu aasuju ninche eing'uaa iloshon pooki loo Siraeli o meetu Yerusalem, aapolosaki Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye.

English: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
Masaai: Neitagol ninche enkitoria e Yuda, ore too larin okuni neitaserian ninche Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, amu eshomo ninche too larin okuni aaibung orrekie le Daudi o Solomon.

English: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
Masaai: Eewa apa Rehoboam aitaa enkitok enye Mahalat entito e Yerimot olayioni le Daudi, apa ole Abigail entito e Eliab olayioni le Yese.

English: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
Masaai: Neiki ninye ilayiok, Yeush, o Shemaria, o Saham.

English: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ina neitoki aya Maaka entito e Absalom, naa ninye natoikio ninye Abija, o Atai, o Sisa, o Shelomit.

English: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
Masaai: Kenyor apa Rehoboam Maaka ina tito e Absalom aitalang nena kituaak enyena pooki, o nkapiak. (eyama apa ninye nkituaak tomon o isiet o nkapiak ntomoni ile neeta ilayiok tikitam o isiet, o ntoyie ntomoni ile.)

English: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
Masaai: Negelu Rehoboam Abija ilo ayioni le Maaka metaa ninye olkitok tiatua ilalashera lenyena, amu kejo apa pee eitaa ninye olaiguanani.

English: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
Masaai: Neas ninye ine ng'eno, neidapashaki kulikae ayiok lenyena aibulunye enkop e Yuda o Benchamen, eeta ndaiki kumok, neing'uraki ninche nkituaak.

English: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of the LORD, and all Israel with him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitashe enkitoria e Rehoboam negolu, neiturraa ninye enkitanapata o Laitoriani o Siraeli pooki tenebo ninye.

English: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against the LORD,
Masaai: Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria o laiguanani Rehoboam, enkaraki nataa ninche ilemeisiligayu to Laitoriani, nelotu Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri arasaki Yerusalem.

English: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubim, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
Masaai: Neeta ngarrin oo mbartan enkalifu nabo o iip are, o lakedok loo mbartan nkalifuni ntomoni ile. Nemeikenayu esiana e lelo tung'ana oo etuo tenebo ninye ooing'uaa Misiri ile Libia o le Sukiim o le Etiopia.

English: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neya ninye nena anas naasheta sunta e Yuda o meeu abaiki Yerusalem.

English: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Judah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Ye have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
Masaai: Neitoki Shemaia oloiboni le Nkai alotu enetii Rehoboam o lkituaak le Yuda, apa ooiturrurro te Yerusalem tenkaraki Shishak, nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kitung'uaitie intae nanu, atung'uayie naa sii nanu intae napik intae enkaina e Shishak.’ ”

English: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, The LORD is righteous.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak loo Siraeli o laiguanani neitobor ate nejo, “Olaitoriani olasipani.”

English: And when the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Olaitoriani ajo eitoborro ate, neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Shemaia ejo, “Eitoborro ninche ate nemaidaikie nanu ninche, kake kaisho nanu ninche enkiti oitoi napokie, nemebukokini engoro ai shumata Yerusalem te Nkaina e Shishak.

English: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia keaku ninche isinkan lenyena. Pee etum ninche aatayiolo enkisiaayiare ai o enkisiaayiare oo nkitoriat oo nkuapi.”

English: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo Shishak olaiguanani le Misiri arasaki Yerusalem; neya ninye ilchumat le nkaji o laitoriani o lchumat le nkaji o laiguanani. Eewa ninye pooki toki. Eewa sii nena long'oi e sahabu apa naaitobira Solomon.

English: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
Masaai: Neitobir olaiguanani Rehoboam te rishata e nena long'oi ilong'oi o suyai, nepik ninche Nkaik o lelo kituaak le rripore, laa ninche ooing'or kishomi e nkaji o laiguanani.

English: And when the king entered into the house of the LORD, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
Masaai: Naa ore ake tenelotu olaiguanani alo enkaji o Laitoriani nepuonu ilarripok aanap ninche, neyau atua ina aji e rripore.

English: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of the LORD turned from him that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Judah things went well.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eitobir ninye kewan neibelekenya engoro o Laitoriani apaash ninye, pee meidaikieki ninye tukul. Ore ake etiu neijia neme torrok apa mbaa te Yuda.

English: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. And his mother's name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
Masaai: Neaku eitagolo apa olaiguanani Rehoboam kewan te Yerusalem. Ilarin artam o obo apa Rehoboam pee eiteru aitoreisho. Eitoreishe ninye ilarin tomon o isiet te Yerusalem, teina anasa apa nategelua Olaitoriani tiatua iloshon pooki loo Siraeli pee epik enkarna enye ine. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Naama, e Amoni.

English: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.
Masaai: Neas ninye entorroni amu eitu ninye eing'oru Olaitoriani to ltau lenye.

English: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
Masaai: Ore apa nkiaasin e Rehoboam ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too mbukui oo nkatinin e Shemaia oloiboni le Nkai o ne Ido oladuaani. Ilarrabali apa lemeish kulo te rishata e Rehoboam o Yeroboam.

English: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Rehoboam etua anaa loo menye, nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi; neitoreisho Abija olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria o laiguanani Yeroboam, neiteru Abija aitoreisho te Yuda.

English: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
Masaai: Eitoreishe ninye ilarin okuni te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Mikaia, entito e Uriel le Gibea. Netii apa olarrabal erishata e Abija o Yeroboam.

English: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Neipang Abija alo olarrabal eeta enjore oo ltung'ana yiolot to larrabal, iltung'ana nkalifuni iip ong'uan oogeluno. Neitoloku Yeroboam iltung'ana lenyena to larrabal aitoluaaki ninye, naa iltung'ana nkalifuni iip isiet magil, gelunot.

English: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, thou Jeroboam, and all Israel;
Masaai: Neitashe Abija tenchumata oldoinyio le Semaraim otii ina kop oo ldoinyio e Efraim, nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu, iyie Yeroboam o Israel pooki!

English: Ought ye not to know that the LORD God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
Masaai: Aimeishiaakino teneyiolou nchere, eishoo o Laitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli, enkitoria oo Siraeli pooki Daudi ntarasi to lmumai le munyan?

English: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and hath rebelled against his lord.
Masaai: Ore Yeroboam olayioni le Nebat ilo sinka le Solomon olayioni le Daudi, nedumunye agilunore olkitok lenye.

English: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae tung'ana le pesho, nerrumoki ninche Rehoboam olayioni le Solomon, ilo leton aa oti nemeeta enkarriyiano, metaasa enkarruoisho. Nemeidimaa apa Rehoboam ninche.

English: And now ye think to withstand the kingdom of the LORD in the hand of the sons of David; and ye be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
Masaai: “Amaa taata, ijo iyie indim aitasheikinore enkitoria o Laitoriani too Nkaik oo layiok le Daudi, eji enkaraki nira iyie olorora, kitok, niata nkitanyaanyukot e Nkai oo lasho le sahabu, apa naaitobira Yeroboam aitaa nkaitin.

English: Have ye not cast out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
Masaai: Keitu iyie iaraa aipang'ie ilapolosak lo Laitoriani, ilayiok le Aron, o Lawi, nintobiraki kewan ilapolosak anaa iltung'ana le kulie kuapi? Ore pooki ng'ae olotu aitisiny kewan to loti oing'oni anaa too lmeregeshi oopishana neaku olapolosani le nena neme Nkaitin.

English: But as for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto the LORD, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
Masaai: Kake ore tialo iyiook, Olaitoriani ninye Enkai ang, neitu iyiook kipuo aaing'ua ninye. Kiata iyiook ilapolosak ooisiaaita Olaitoriani laa ilayiok le Aron, o Lawi te nkaraki enkisiaayiare enye.

English: And they burn unto the LORD every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of the LORD our God; but ye have forsaken him.
Masaai: Kepolosaki ninche Olaitoriani anaake tadekenya o teipa ilasarri oopejori, o enkorropil o sonkoyoni naarropil, neirragie emukate e nkitoduaaroto te mesa e sahabu nasila, neing'or nena kitasheta oo ltaai e sahabu pee etum iltaai lenyena aayupuyupo anaake teipa. Amu eikimbung iyiook enkitanapata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, kake itanyaita intae ninye.

English: And, behold, God himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Israel, fight ye not against the LORD God of your fathers; for ye shall not prosper.
Masaai: Ng'ura etii Enkai tenebo iyiook, ninye orikito iyiook, tenebo ilapolosak eeta ntarumpetani enye o larrabal pee eosh tenikinteru olarrabal o intae. Nakera, e Israel emiarare intae Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo minyi, amu mimirishosho.

English: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
Masaai: Neirriu apa Yeroboam iltung'ana olnukata aitaman ninche te siadi. Netii ilturrurri lenyena dukuya iltung'ana le Yuda. Netii lelo tung'ana oonuka siadi ninche.

English: And when Judah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto the LORD, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'orisho Yuda, ng'ura etii olarrabal dukuya o siadi, neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani nekut ilapolosak ntarumpetani.

English: Then the men of Judah gave a shout: and as the men of Judah shouted, it came to pass, that God smote Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
Masaai: Neitayu iltung'ana le Yuda embuakunoto o larrabal. Ore ake pee ebuaku iltung'ana le Yuda nemir Enkai Yeroboam o Siraeli pooki ootii dukuya Abija o Yuda.

English: And the children of Israel fled before Judah: and God delivered them into their hand.
Masaai: Neilanyisho iltung'ana loo Siraeli te dukuya iltung'ana le Yuda neishoru Enkai ninche apik atua Nkaik e Yuda.

English: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
Masaai: Nesesekuan Abija o ltung'ana lenyena iltung'ana kumok oleng; neaku etuata too Siraeli iltung'ana gelunot nkalifuni iip imiet.

English: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Neaku eidimuaki apa iltung'ana loo Siraeli ina kata, neisulu iltung'ana le Yuda, enkaraki naigarakinote ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Bethel with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
Masaai: Nesujaa Abija Yeroboam, neoru ninye nkanas, Betel o nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Yeshana tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti o Efron tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti.

English: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and the LORD struck him, and he died.
Masaai: Neitu aekata eitoki Yeroboam arrinyu engolon enye too nkolong'i e Abija. Neosh Olaitoriani ninye neye ninye.

English: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
Masaai: Kake etaa Abija magilani, neyam ninye nkituaak tomon oo ng'uan, netum ilayiok tikitam oare, o ntoyie tomon o ile.

English: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin pooki e Abija, nkoitoi enyena o nkirorot enyena, neigeroki too nkatinin o loiboni le Nkai oji Ido.

English: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
Masaai: Neaku eirure apa Abija etua anaa loo menye nenukari te nkanasa e Daudi; neitoreisho Asa olayioni lenye te rishata enye. Ore too nkolong'i enyena netum enkop enkiyeng'iyeng ilarin tomon.

English: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:
Masaai: Neas Asa imbaa supati naa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie apa ilperereni loo lasarri loo loreren, o wuejitin neeika, neuroo ing'apeta nedung'oo Asherim aauroo.

English: And commanded Judah to seek the LORD God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
Masaai: Neitanap Yuda pee eing'oru Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, neibung nkitanapat enyena.

English: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie sii too nkanas pooki e Yuda iwuejitin neeika lperereni oopejieki enkorropil. Netum enkitoria enkiyeng'iyeng too nkolong'i enyena.

English: And he built fenced cities in Judah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because the LORD had given him rest.
Masaai: Etesheta ninye nkanas naata isunta te Yuda, amu enoto enkop enkiyeng'iyeng. Eitu ninye etum olarrabal te nena olong'i amu eishoo Olaitoriani ninye eseriani.

English: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Yuda, “Mateshet iyiook kuna anas, nikintaman isunta o ltaleta, nikipik nchomito oo sekenke; eton aa enaang ena kop, amu king'orutua iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang; king'orutua iyiook ninye, neishoo ninye iyiook eseriani too nkaloli pooki.” Neaku eteshetishote ninche nedupoyu.

English: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Judah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
Masaai: Neeta apa Asa enjore oo ltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni le Yuda, oata ilong'oi o remeta. O ltung'ana nkalifuni iip are o ntomoni isiet oo ltung'ana le Benchamen, oata ilong'oi o nkai; ore kulo pooki naa iltung'ana magil yiolot.

English: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
Masaai: Nelotu Serak le Etiopia agilunore ninche eeta enjore oo ltung'ana milion nabo, o ngarrin oo mbartan iip uni, nepuonu o metabau Maresha.

English: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
Masaai: Nelo Asa anang'are ninye, neitolok ilkererin lenye aaluakino olarrabal to erata le Sefata te Maresha.

English: And Asa cried unto the LORD his God, and said, LORD, it is nothing with thee to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O LORD our God; for we rest on thee, and in thy name we go against this multitude. O LORD, thou art our God; let not man prevail against thee.
Masaai: Neishiraki Asa Olaitoriani Enkai enye ejo, “Olaitoriani, meetae likae likinyaanyukie te retoto, te rishata o lmagilani o loshal. Taretu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang, amu kingarakino iyiook iyie, naa te nkarna ino kiyetuo iyiook aagilunore ele orora. Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ang; mincho eisulu likae tung'ani te iyie.”

English: So the LORD smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.
Masaai: Neaku etimira Olaitoriani ile Etiopia te dukuya Asa o te dukuya Yuda, neilanyisho ile Etiopia.

English: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the LORD, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
Masaai: Ore Asa o lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninche, nesujaa ninche o meitabaiki Gerar. Nebatata ile Etiopia o metaa meetae obo otelekua eishu; amu etigilaki ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani o enjore enye. Nenap iltung'ana le Yuda intokitin kumok oleng naatarutua.

English: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of the LORD came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
Masaai: Neitoki sii aagil nkanas naamanita Gerar, amu etijing'a euriata o Laitoriani shumata ninche, neya ninche imasaa kumok te nena anas.

English: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Near ilng'oborri le lelo apa oata nchoo, neya nkerrai te nkumoi, o ntemesin. Neitoki taa aarrinyo aapuo Yerusalem.

English: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
Masaai: Eewuo apa enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Asaria olayioni le Oded,

English: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
Masaai: neipang ninye alo anang'are Asa. Nejoki ninye, “Toning'oki nanu Asa, o Yuda pooki o Benchamen: Etii Olaitoriani tenebo iyie, eton sii iyie itii tenebo ninye. Tening'oru iyie ninye nitum, kake tening'ua iyie ninye niking'uaa sii ninye iyie.

English: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
Masaai: Ore te nkata naado nemeeta Israel Enkai nasipa. Nemeeta olapolosani oiteng'enisho, nemeeta enkitanapata.

English: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel, and sought him, he was found of them.
Masaai: Kake teneibelekenyakino ninche to sina lenye Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, neing'oru ninye nenoto ninche ninye.

English: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena katitin nemeetae eseriani teilo oipang o teilo ojing'u amu etijing'aka enyamali sapuk lelo oomanya nkuapi.

English: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for God did vex them with all adversity.
Masaai: Eitaaki ninche ngiligilat. Negilunore olosho olosho, negilunore enkanasa enkanasa, amu eitanyamala Enkai ninche te pooki pukunoto o sina.

English: Be ye strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
Masaai: Kake ntagoluoyu iyie! Mincho elepori nkaik inono, amu eikilaakini esiaai ino.”

English: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Asa kulo rorei, ina aibon e Asaria olayioni le Aded, neitagoluo, neiwuang'ie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naa ninche olminong teina kop e Yuda o ene Benchamen, o te nena anas naawa ninye teina kop oo ldoinyio e Efraim. Neitoki ninye aitobir olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani apa otii dukuya olgoriet le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance, when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninye Yuda pooki o Benchamen, o lelo ooing'uaa Efraim, o Manase o Simion apa oobikito tenebo ninche, amu iltung'ana kumok ooisikakita ninye eing'ua Israel, ina kata pee edol aajo etii Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye.

English: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
Masaai: Eiturrurrote apa ninche te Yerusalem to lapa liokuni lo lari le tomon o imiet le nkitoria e Asa.

English: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
Masaai: Nepolosaki ninche Olaitoriani olasar teina olong, te nena masaa apa naataarutua ninche ilmong'i iip naapishana, o nkerra nkalifuni naapishana.

English: And they entered into a covenant to seek the LORD God of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
Masaai: Neibung ninche olning'o lo sotua pee eing'oru Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye, too ltauja lenye pooki o te nkishui enye pooki;

English: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
Masaai: naa ore pooki ng'ae lemeing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, neari metua, aa oti o aa moruo, aa olee anaa enkitok.

English: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
Masaai: Einosie ninche Olaitoriani olmumai to ltoilo sapuk, o te mbuakunoto o too ntarumpetani, o te oshoto oo mowuarak.

English: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and the LORD gave them rest round about.
Masaai: Neshipa Yuda pooki tenkaraki ilo mumai; amu einosa ninche too ltauja lenye pooki, neing'orutua ninche ninye te yieunoto enye pooki, nenoto ninche ninye, neishoo Olaitoriani ninche enkiyeng'iyeng too nkaloli pooki.

English: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye Maaka, ng'otonye, eiwuang'ie olaiguanani Asa pee meitoki aata enkitoo enye enkaraki nataasa embae olminong, aitobir enkitanyaanyukoto e Ashera. Nedung Asa ina kitanyaanyukoto auroo, neidong aitaa irrarrat, nelo apejoo to erata le Kidron.

English: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
Masaai: Kake eitu apa eiwuang'ieki iwuejitin neeika e Israel. Ore ake etiu neijia nemeeta apa oltau le Asa eleyiata too nkolong'i e nkishui enye pooki.

English: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
Masaai: Neyau ninye atua enkaji e Nkai nena tokitin apa naaitisinya menye o nkishorot naaitisinya ninye makewan, enkosholai o sahabu o masaa,

English: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
Masaai: neitu aikata eitokini aata olarrabal o metabau olari le tomoni uni o imiet le nkitoria e Asa.

English: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni o ile le nkitoria e Asa, nelo Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli agilunore Yuda, neshet Rama, ejo pee meipang hoo oltung'ani obo anaa ejing'u alo enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda.
