English: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the LORD and of the king's house, and sent to Benhadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
Masaai: Nedumu Asa enkosholai o sahabu te lelo shumat le nkaji o Laitoriani, o te nkaji o laiguanani, neirriwaki Benhadad olaiguanani le Siria, apa omanya Damaskas, nejoki,

English: There is a league between me and thee, as there was between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent thee silver and gold; go, break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
Masaai: “Nchoo metijing'a olning'o erishata ai o iyie, anaa enatiu te papaai o te papaai lino. Ng'ura kaairriwaki nanu iyie enkosholai o sahabu; shomo tigila olning'o lino o Baasha olaiguanani loo Siraeli; pee aalo aing'uaa nanu.”

English: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
Masaai: Nening Benhadad olaiguanani Asa, neirriwaa ninye ilarikok le njore enye meshomo aagilunore nkanas oo Siraeli, neibung ninche aaisulie Iyon, o Dan, o Abelnaim o nkanas pooki naashumishoreki e Naftali.

English: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Baasha ina neitu eitoki ashet Rama, neitasheyie esiaai enye.

English: Then Asa the king took all Judah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Asa aya Yuda pooki, nenap ninche lelo soito le Rama o mbaoi enyena, apa naa ninche eshetishore olaiguanani Baasha, nelo ashetie ninche Geba o Mispa.

English: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said unto him, Because thou hast relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on the LORD thy God, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of thine hand.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata nelotu Hanani oladuaani enetii Asa olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki ninye, “Ore enkaraki naa olaiguanani le Siria ingarakine, neitu ingarakino Olaitoriani Enkai ino, kitapaashare iyie enjore o laiguanani le Siria.

English: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.
Masaai: Amaa enjore e Etiopia o ene Libia, aime enjore kitok naata ngarrin oo mbartan kumok oleng? Eji ore enkaraki ningarakine Olaitoriani neishoru ninche apik nkaik inono.

English: For the eyes of the LORD run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein thou hast done foolishly: therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars.
Masaai: Amu ekuet nkonyek o Laitoriani idie o ene tiatua enkop pooki, pee eitodolu enkidimata enye te rishata e lelo lemeeta ileyiat too ltauja lenye tialo ninye. Itaasa iyie ena te modai, amu ore ebaiki ena kata neito idia alo, itum ilarrabali.”

English: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
Masaai: Negorokino Asa ilo aduaani, neikenoo ninye te korokoroni, amu eibayie ninye te nkaraki ena. Neitoki Asa aitaas mbaa e ngogong'i kulikae teina kata.

English: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
Masaai: Ore nkiaasin e Asa ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto neigeroki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Yuda o Israel.

English: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to the LORD, but to the physicians.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni ooudo le nkitoria enye, netum Asa emuoyian too nkejek nerruoyo ina muoyian enye oleng; ore ake teina muoyian enye neitu ninye eing'oru Olaitoriani. Kake eing'orua eretoto too labaak.

English: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
Masaai: Neirrag Asa etua anaa loo menye, neye ninye to lari liartam oobo le nkitoria enye.

English: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art: and they made a very great burning for him.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche ninye te nkurare apa nataguetua ninye, aguetaki kewan te nkanasa e Daudi. Neirragie ninche ninye too sisineta naaiputa ninye ina gumoto naabore mpukunot pooki oo sonkoyoni naaitobiraki te nkarriyiano o laitobirani loo sonkoyoni; neitobir ninche enkima kitok te nkanyit enye.

English: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Israel.
Masaai: Yehoshafat olayioni le Asa oitoreishe te rishata enye, neitagol kewan agilunore Isiraeli.

English: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltimito nena anas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda, nepik iltimito enkop e Yuda, o nkanas e Efraim apa naatarayie Asa papaai lenye.

English: And the LORD was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
Masaai: Etii apa Olaitoriani tenebo Yehoshafat, enkaraki nashomo ninye aibung olapa rrekie le menye; eitu ninye eing'oru Baal.

English: But sought to the LORD God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
Masaai: Kake eing'orua Enkai e papaai lenye, nelo too nkitanapat enyena, neitu eibung irrekiei loo Siraeli.

English: Therefore the LORD stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Judah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neitasheyie Olaitoriani enkitoria te nkaina enye, ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda neyaki Yehoshafat nkishorot, netum ninye enkarsisisho sapuk o enkanyit.

English: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of the LORD: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Judah.
Masaai: Keuno apa oltau lenye tialo nkoitoi o Laitoriani; neiwuang'ie sii iwuejitin neeika e Asherim te Yuda.

English: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria enye neiriwaa ninye iltung'ana lenyena kituaak, Benhail, o Obadiah, o Sekaria, o Netanel, o Mikaia, pee epuo aaiteng'enisho too nkanas e Yuda.

English: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninche netii Ilawi, Shemaia o Netania, o Sebadia, o Asahel, o Shemiramot, o Yehonatan, o Adonija, o Tobija, o Tobadonija. Ore tenebo kulo Lawi netii ilapolosak, Elishama, o Yehoram.

English: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho ninche te Yuda, eeta embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani tenebo ninche. Nepuo ninche aamanaa too nkanas pooki e Yuda aiteng'enisho tiatua olorere.

English: And the fear of the LORD fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
Masaai: Etipika apa Olaitoriani enkuretisho nena kitoriat pooki oo nkuapi naamanita Yuda, neitu ninche eitayunye Yehoshefat olarrabal.

English: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae Filisti neyaki Yehoshefat nkishorot. Neyaki nkishorot e nkosholai, neyau Ilmarabu ilmeregeshi enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana o loroi enkalifu nabo o iip naapishana.

English: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Judah castles, and cities of store.
Masaai: Neponari Yehoshefat agolu te nkitoria. Neshet ninye te Yuda isempewueti o nkanas naashumishoreki.

English: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neeta apa ninye ineeshumishoreki sapuki too nkanas e Yuda. Neeta isikarini magil yiolot, te Yerusalem.

English: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Judah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
Masaai: Eiturrurroki apa kulo te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye. Ore te Yuda netii ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni; etii olarikoni le njore e iip oji Adna, tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni magil yiolot.

English: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
Masaai: Ore oliare naa Yehohanan ilo arikoni le njore, tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip are o ntomoni isiet,

English: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
Masaai: ore olosujaki naa Amasia olayioni le Sikri, ilo oishorua kewan te nkisiaayiare o Laitoriani, tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip are magil yiolot.

English: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
Masaai: Ore too le Benchamen naa: Eliada, ilo tung'ani magilani yioloti, tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip are oata mbaa o long'oi.

English: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
Masaai: Ore olosujaki naa Yehosabad tenebo iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet ootanapate pee epuo olarrabal.

English: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
Masaai: Kulo apa ootii enkisiaayiare o laiguanani, metii lelo apa ootipika olaiguanani nkanas naasheta sunta te Yuda pooki.

English: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
Masaai: Eeta Yehoshafat enkarsisisho sapuk o enkanyit neitobir olning'o tenkaraki enkiyama o ltung'ana le Ahab,

English: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
Masaai: ore te siadi ilkuti arin nedoyio alo enetii Ahab te Samaria. Neyiang'aki Ahab ninye nkerra kumok o lmong'i tenebo lelo tung'ana apa ootii tenebo ninye, neilejilej ninye pee epuo aagilunore Ramot-Gilead.

English: And Ahab king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Wilt thou go with me to Ramothgilead? And he answered him, I am as thou art, and my people as thy people; and we will be with thee in the war.
Masaai: Nejoki Ahab, ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda, “Eilo iyie tenebo nanu Ramot-gilead?” Newal ninye ajo, “Atiu nanu anaa enitiu iyie, netiu iltung'ana laainei anaa iltung'ana linono. Kiaku iyiook tenebo iyie to larrabal.”

English: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel, Enquire, I pray thee, at the word of the LORD to day.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoshafat ajoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli, “Tang'asa nkilikuanishore ororei lo Laitoriani.”

English: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for God will deliver it into the king's hand.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aiturrurr iloibonok le Nkai tenebo, iltung'ana iip ong'uan, nejoki ninche, “Aikipuo iyiook olarrabal aagilunore Ramot-Gilead, anaa aimikipuo?” Nejoki ninche, enchom, amu keishoru Enkai apik nkaik o laiguanani.

English: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of the LORD besides, that we might enquire of him?
Masaai: Kake etejo ninye Yehoshafat, “Aimeetae likae oiboni le Nkai likinkilikuanishore?”

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehosafat, “Eton etii oltung'ani obo likindim iyiook aaikilikuanishore tialo Olaitoriani, Mikaia olayioni le Imala; kake manyor nanu ninye, amu meibonu aikata isupati tialo nanu, ntorrok ake eibonu.” Nejo Yehoshafat, mincho olaiguanani ejo neijia.”

English: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli aipotu olkitok obo, nejoki, “Iyau nabo kata Mikaia olayioni le Imala.”

English: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
Masaai: Ore ina kata netonita olaiguanani loo Siraeli o Yehoshafat, olaiguanani le Yuda too lorikan le nkitoo, neishopo ilkilani lenye, netonita ninche te wueji neituutishoreki, te mpolos e kishomi e Samaria; neibonisho iloibonok pooki te dukuya ninche.

English: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus saith the LORD, With these thou shalt push Syria until they be consumed.
Masaai: Ore Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana neitobiraki kewan imowuarak e sekenkei, nejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Te kuna ilo iyie arrumoo ile Siria o metaba anaa neidak ninche.’ ”

English: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramothgilead, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
Masaai: Ore iloibonok pooki neibonu ina, nejo, “Ilepa shomo Ramot-gilead pee ilo amirisho; aikincho iyie Olaitoriani apik enkaina o laiguanani.”

English: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae apa ooshomo aaipotu Mikaia nejoki ninye, “Ng'ura ore irorei loo loibonok le Nkai pooki neimaki embae nabo supat tialo olaiguanani; nchoo orerei lino etiu anaa orerei le obo lenye, niro te supatisho.”

English: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, even what my God saith, that will I speak.
Masaai: Kake etejo Mikaia, “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, ore ina najo Enkai ai ina nanu airo.”

English: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramothgilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go ye up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau enetii olaiguanani, nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Mikaia, eikipuo iyiook Ramot-gilead, olarrabal anaa aikipal?” Newalu ninye ajo, “Ilepa shomo timirisho; kepiki ninche enkaina ino.”

English: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the LORD?
Masaai: Kake etiaka olaiguanani ninye, “Aikatitin aja aasai nanu pee iro esipata ake te nkarna o Laitoriani?”

English: Then he said, I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and the LORD said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Atoduaa nanu Isiraeli pooki eidapashakinote ildoinyio anaa nkerra nemeeta olchekut; netejo Olaitoriani, ‘Meeta kulo olaitasheikinoni; nchoo pooki ng'ae errinyo alo enkang enye te seriani.’ ”

English: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli ajoki Yehoshafat, “Keitu nanu aajoki iyie nchere meibonu ninye esidai tialo nanu, kake entorroni ake eibonu?”

English: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of the LORD; I saw the LORD sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Toning'o naa orerei lo Laitoriani: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani etonita to lorika lenye le nkitoo, ore olorora pooki le shumata, neitashe te nkaina enye e tatene, o te ne kedienye.

English: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, ‘Aing'ae olo alej Ahab olaiguanani loo Siraeli, pee etum ninye ashomo atabatatayu te Ramot-gilead?’ Nejo obo embae nabo, nejo olikae enkae.

English: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?
Masaai: Neitoki alotu enkiyang'et neitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani, ejo, ‘Kalo nanu alej ninye.’ Nejoki Olaitoriani, ‘Tia oitoi?’

English: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And the LORD said, Thou shalt entice him, and thou shalt also prevail: go out, and do even so.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, ‘Kalo nanu, naaku oltau le lejare too nkutukie oo loibonok lenyena.’ Nejo ninye ilo iyie alej ninye, naa ndimu ninye, shomo naa taasa ina.

English: Now therefore, behold, the LORD hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets, and the LORD hath spoken evil against thee.
Masaai: Ore naa taata etipika Olaitoriani enkiyang'et e lejare nkutukie e kulo oibonok linono; eiroro entorroni tialo iyie.”

English: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of the LORD from me to speak unto thee?
Masaai: Neitoki Sedekia olayioni le Kenaana anyiku neosh Mikaia eseder, nejoki, “Kaji eimua enkiyang'et o Laitoriani pee epuku te nanu nikilotu airorie iyie?”

English: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Ng'ura, ilo iyie adol teina olong, tinilo iyie olgilata liatua aisudori.”

English: Then the king of Israel said, Take ye Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king's son;
Masaai: Nejo ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli, “Embung'a Mikaia, nirrinyirrinyi ninye aaya enetii Amon ilo balusui le nkanasa, o enetii Yoash ilo ayioni lo laiguanani.

English: And say, Thus saith the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
Masaai: Nilo ajo, ‘Nji ejo olaiguanani, Entipik ena tung'ani atua korokoroni, ninchosho ninye meinosa imukateni naatoito neok enkare, o metaba anaa nashukunye te seriani.’ ”

English: And Micaiah said, If thou certainly return in peace, then hath not the LORD spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all ye people.
Masaai: Nejo Mikaia, “Tenitushukunye iyie te seriani, neitu nanu aairorie Olaitoriani”, neitoki ninye ajo, “Entoning intae lo orere pooki!”

English: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramothgilead.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo olaiguanani loo Siraeli; o Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda Ramot-gilead.

English: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani loo Siraeli Yehoshafat, “Kaibelekeny nanu enkishopo ai nalo olarrabal, kake inchopo iyie ilkilani linono le nkitoo.” Neibelekeny olaiguanani loo Siraeli enkishopo enye nepuo ninche olarrabal.

English: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight ye not with small or great, save only with the king of Israel.
Masaai: Neitanapa apa olaiguanani le Siria ilkituaak loo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan, ajoki, “Emiarare ake oloti anaa olkitok, kake olaiguanani loo Siraeli ake entaarare.”

English: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Israel. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol lelo kituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan Yehoshafat nejo ninche, “Olaiguanani loo Siraeli ilo.” Neibelekenya ninche aarare ninye; neyietu Yehoshafat abuaku, neretu Olaitoriani ninye. Neboinaa Enkai ninche aitung'uaa ninye.

English: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
Masaai: Amu etoduaa ake lelo kituaak loo ngarrin oo mbartan aajo mme olaiguanani loo Siraeli ilo nerrinyo te sujata enye.

English: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
Masaai: Kake eteyietuo oltung'ani obo enkawuo enye nengoroo embae, neng'or olaiguanani loo Siraeli eripata enkila enye esekenkei, to lgoo; ore enkaraki ina nejoki ninye olarewani lenye le ngarri e mbarta, “Mbelekenyayu ntung'uayioki nanu olarrabal, amu aatipikaki nanu olbae.”

English: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
Masaai: Neirowuaju oleng olarrabal ina olong, neigarakino olaiguanani loo Siraeli eng'arri enye embarta aing'or ile Siria o metaa teipa. Ore ake pee edoyio enkolong neye.

English: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye te Seriani Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda alotu enkaji enye te Yerusalem.

English: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Shouldest thou help the ungodly, and love them that hate the LORD? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the LORD.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Yehu olayioni le Hanani, ilo aduaani anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye olaiguanani Yehoshafat, “Iretu iyie olarruoni ninyor lelo ooiba Olaitoriani? Ore enkaraki ena, eewuo engoro naing'ua Olaitoriani enkaraki iyie.

English: Nevertheless there are good things found in thee, in that thou hast taken away the groves out of the land, and hast prepared thine heart to seek God.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia enotoki kulie baa sidain te iyie, amu indaikie Ashera aishie tena kop, ning'oru Enkai to ltau lino.”

English: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beersheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Nebik Yehoshafat te Yerusalem; nelo ninye tiatua olorere, ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki ina kop oo ndoinyio e Efraim, neyau ninche aarrinyoki Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,
Masaai: Negelu ninye ilarishak teina kop tiatua nkanas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda. Te nkanasa ake o te nkanasa,

English: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.
Masaai: nejoki ninye lelo arishak, “Entadamu eniasiasa, amu mme oltung'ani nguanarere, kake Olaitoriani; etii ninye tenebo intae idung'udung'u enkiguana.

English: Wherefore now let the fear of the LORD be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with the LORD our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
Masaai: Ore naa taata nchoo euriata o Laitoriani eaku tenebo intae; entujurru eniasiasa; amu meetae enkibelekenyata e sipata to Laitoriani Enkai, anaa enyorrakinoto, anaa eng'amunoto oo ntokitin e ropare.”

English: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Israel, for the judgment of the LORD, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ake sii te Yerusalem negelu Yehoshafat kulikae Lawi o lapolosak, o lukuny oo lmareita loo Siraeli, pee edung enkiguana tenkaraki Olaitoriani nedung enkiguana tenetii enchankar. Yerusalem apa etii entonata enye.

English: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
Masaai: Neitanap ninye ninche, ejo, “Nji intae enkuna te uriata o Laitoriani, o te nkisiligata, o to ltauja linyi pooki:

English: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the LORD, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and ye shall not trespass.
Masaai: Tenelo nelotu enkiguana naing'uaa ilalashera linyi ootii kulie anas, eipirta enkibukoroto o sarge, o enkitanapata, anaa nkikoot, o nkiguanat, ninteng'en iyie ninche, pee meas ake entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani, melotu ake engoro napi shumata intae o lalashera linyi. Ena intae entaas nimbayuyu intae entorroni.

English: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, for all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and the LORD shall be with the good.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura Amaria ilo apolosani kitok otii te shumata intae tialo mbaa pooki o Laitoriani; naa Sebadia olayioni le Ishmael ninye olbalusui le nkaji e Yuda, too mbaa pooki naaipirta olaiguanani; naa Ilawi likisiai iyie anaa iltung'ana kituaak. Taasisho te mpijan naa nchoo eaku Olaitoriani tenebo ilo oitoriori mbaa enyena.”

English: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nepuonu Ilmoabu, o le Amon o kulikae ooing'uaa Meani, nepuonu aarasaki Yehoshafat to larrabal.

English: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be Hazazon-tamar, which is Engedi.
Masaai: Nepuonu kulikae tung'ana aajoki Yehoshafat, “Etii olorora kitok oing'ua Edom likipuonu aarare, ooing'uaa lido kekun le naiposha; naa ng'ura, etii ninche Hasasotama” (aa taa Enkedi).

English: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek the LORD, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
Masaai: Neureishoyu Yehoshafat, neing'oru Olaitoriani makewan, neitanapisho meteena iltung'ana ate aapukoo te Yuda pooki.

English: And Judah gathered themselves together, to ask help of the LORD: even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the LORD.
Masaai: Neiturrurro Yuda aaing'oru eretoto to Laitoriani; eing'uaa nkanas pooki e Yuda nepuonu aaing'oru Olaitoriani.

English: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the LORD, before the new court,
Masaai: Neitashe Yehoshafat tiatua eumata e Yuda o Yerusalem, tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, te dukuya ilo goriet ng'ejuk,

English: And said, O LORD God of our fathers, art not thou God in heaven? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in thine hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand thee?
Masaai: nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papa, aime iyie Enkai te keper? Aimintore iyie nkitoriat pooki oo loshon? Enkaina ino etii engolon o enkidimata, ore enkaraki ina meetae oltung'ani likindimaa iyie.

English: Art not thou our God, who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel, and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?
Masaai: Keitu iyie, Na Ai ang, iaraa lelo apa oomanya ena kop te dukuya iltung'ana linono loo Siraeli; ninchooyie ntarasi aisho eishoi e Abram ilo shore lino?

English: And they dwelt therein, and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name, saying,
Masaai: Netamanya ninche atua, nikiteshetakita ninche ewueji sinyati, tenkaraki enkarna ino, ejo,

English: If, when evil cometh upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in thy presence, (for thy name is in this house,) and cry unto thee in our affliction, then thou wilt hear and help.
Masaai: ‘Tenelotu entorroni shumata iyiook, olalem, o enkiguana, anaa olmeitai, anaa olameyu, nikintashe iyiook te dukuya ena aji, o te dukuya iyie, amu etii enkarna ino atua ena aji, nikinchiraki iyie tosina lang, nining iyie, nintajeu iyiook.’

English: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
Masaai: Ore naa taata ng'ura kulo tung'ana le Amon o le Moab, o to ldoinyio le Seir, nimincho iyie Isiraeli metarasaki ninche, apa eing'uaa enkop e Misiri, netapaasha apa ninche neitu eidaikie.

English: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of thy possession, which thou hast given us to inherit.
Masaai: Ng'ura elaaki ninche iyiook epuonu aaraa iyiook aaipang'ie te nkop ino, apa ninchoo iyiook matujung.

English: O our God, wilt thou not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon thee.
Masaai: Na Ai ang aimidung'oki iyie ninche enkiguana? Amu mikiata iyiook engolon tialo ele orora kitok olotu agilunore iyiook. Mikiyiolo iyiook aajo kaa kias, kake iyie eimariri nkonyek ang.”

English: And all Judah stood before the LORD, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
Masaai: Ore teina kata neitashe iltung'ana pooki le Yuda te dukuya Olaitoriani, tenebo nkera enye kutiti o nkituaak enye, o nkera enye.

English: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of the LORD in the midst of the congregation;
Masaai: Nelotu enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata Yahasiel olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Yerel, olayioni le Matania, Olawi loo layiok le Asaf, te mpolos eina umata.

English: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Entoning, Yuda pooki o loomanya Yerusalem, o laiguanani Yehoshafat: Nji ejoki intae Olaitoriani, ‘Emiureisho nimileporiri tenkaraki ele orora kitok; amu mme olinyi ele arrabal, kake olo Laitoriani.

English: To morrow go ye down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
Masaai: Ore taisere tadoi shomo tigilunore ninche; ng'ura keilepu ninche aaimu enkoitoi e Siis; ilo iyie ainepu ninche te nkiting'oto o erata, te nkalo o loo saen tiong'ota e Yeruel.

English: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand ye still, and see the salvation of the LORD with you, O Judah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for the LORD will be with you.
Masaai: Meeta tipat niarishore iyie tele arrabal; ntasho ake duoo, ntirring'ayu pee idol enkisulata o Laitoriani, te rishata ino. Iyie Yuda o Yerusalem.’ Miureishoyu nimilepori. Ore taisere tadoi shomo tigilunore ninche, naa keaku Olaitoriani tenebo intae.”

English: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the LORD, worshipping the LORD.
Masaai: Neirrugo Yehoshafat aitabaiki enkomom enye enkop, ore Yuda pooki, o lelo oo manya Yerusalem nebatata te dukuya Olaitoriani, neserem Olaitoriani.

English: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise the LORD God of Israel with a loud voice on high.
Masaai: Ore ilawi le Kohat o Lkorati neitashe aaisis Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel to ltoilo sapuk oleng.

English: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche tadekenya enasirie, nepuo ong'ata e Tekoa; ore epuito ninche neitashe Yehoshafat nejo, “Entoning'oki nanu Yuda o intae iloomanya Yerusalem! Eruko Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee eitasheyieki intae; entoning iloibonok lenyena pee idupoyuyu.”

English: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto the LORD, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise the LORD; for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip aiguana iltung'ana, negelu lelo oopuo aaranyaki Olaitoriani neisis ninye eishopito ilkilani sinyat, nepuo ninche te dukuya enjore, nejo “Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi.”

English: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiteru aaranyisho neisis Olaitoriani, nerasaki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Amon, o Moab o lo ldoinyio le Seir, laa ninche apa ooetuo aagilunore Yuda, neaku eishieki ninche.

English: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
Masaai: Amu etudumakinote iltung'ana le Amon o le Moab iltung'ana lo ldoinyo le Seir, neidaikie ninche katukul, ore ake pee eishie iltung'ana le Seir, neitoki ninche aaidaakino maate.

English: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu Yuda oltalet liong'ota, neing'or ilo orora naa ng'ura! mpopong'i ake naairragaa te nkop. Meetae oloilanyishe.

English: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yehoshafat o ltung'ana lenyena aaya iyarunot enye, netum ninche nkishu kumok, o masaa, o nkilani, o ntokitin naagol enkinyang'a, naawaita ninche o metaba anaa neaku menapayu. Nkolong'i uni eyaita ninche nena yarunot, eikumok apa oleng.

English: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the LORD: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan neiturrurro ninche to erata le Beraka, ore teine neisis Olaitoriani. Ore enkaraki ina naa keji enkarna eine wueji oerata le Bereka, o metabaiki ena olong.

English: Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the LORD had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
Masaai: Neitoki aarrinyo, pooki tung'ani le Yuda o Yerusalem, netii Yehoshafat dukuya ninche, errinyo aapuo Yerusalem te nchipai, amu eishoo ninche Olaitoriani enchipai tialo ilmang'ati lenye.

English: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche Yerusalem eeta nkai oo sinkolioitin o lwululi loo usin, o ntarumpetani, nepuo enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
Masaai: Neiput enkuretisho e Nkai nena kitoriat pooki e nena kuapi ina kata pee ening nchere, etaarare Olaitoriani ilmang'ati loo Siraeli.

English: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
Masaai: Neaku eitirring'e Yehoshafat te seriani, amu eishoo ninye Enkai enkiyeng'iyeng too nkaloli pooki.

English: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
Masaai: Metaa neijia apa eikuna Yehoshafat te neitore Yuda. Oloo larin tomoni uni o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilarin tikitam o imiet te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Asuba, entito e Shilhi.

English: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Neibung apa ninye orrekie le Asa papaai lenye, neitu eibelekenya apaash. Etaasa ninye isidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore apa iwuejitin neeika neitu eiwuang'ieki; eitu epik iltung'ana iltauja lenye nkaitin e kulikae tung'ana.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yehoshafat, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too nkatinin e Yehu olayioni le Hanani, apa naatisiraki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly:
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena, neibung'are olaiguanani Yehoshafat Ahasia olaiguanani loo Siraeli, apa oas entorroni.

English: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Eziongaber.
Masaai: Neibung'are ninye te nchetata oo melin naapuo Tarshish, neshetu ninche imelin te Esiong'eber.

English: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the LORD hath broken thy works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliesa olayioni le Dodawahu le Maresha, aibonisho tialo Yehoshafat, ejo, “Ore enkaraki nimbung'are Ahasia, keidaikie Olaitoriani ina nitaasa.” Nemuta nena melin neitu ninche epuo Tarshish.

English: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Yehoshafat etua anaa loo menye, nenukari tenebo loo menye tiatua enkanasa e Daudi, neitoreisho Yehoram olayioni lenye, te rishata enye.

English: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.
Masaai: Eeta apa ninye ilalashera, lelo ayiok le Yehoshafat: Asaria, o Yehiel, o Sekaria, o Mikael, o Shefatia. Ore apa kulo pooki naa ilayiok le Yehoshafat olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Judah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
Masaai: Eishoo apa ninche menye nkishorot sapuki, e nkosholai o sahabu, o ntokitin e tipat, tenebo nkanas naasheta isunta e Yuda. Kake Yehoram eishoo enkitoria, amu ninye apa olkikau.

English: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee etonie Yehoram olorika le nkitoo le papaai lenye, nebul, near ilalashera lenyena pooki metuata to lalem, tenebo sii kulikae tung'ana kituaak le Israel.

English: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni oare apa Yehoram pee eiteru aaku olaiguanani, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem.

English: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.
Masaai: Neibung ninye orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel anaa apa enataasa Ahab. Amu entito apa e Ahab enkitok enye. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: Howbeit the LORD would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
Masaai: Kake meidaikie ake Olaitoriani enkaji e Daudi, tenkaraki olning'o lo sotua apa oitobira ninye o Daudi, neisiligishore apa ninye pee eitoreisho eishoi enye, o layiok lenyena ntarasi.

English: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i enkitoria enye, nekepari Edom aing'uaa enkitoria e Yuda, negelaki ninche ate olaiguanani.

English: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yehoram tenebo ilarikok lenyena le njore, o ngarrin enyena oo mbartan pooki, nepuo kewarie aaidaikie iltung'ana le Edom apa oomanita ninye o lkituaak lenyena loo ngarrin oo mbartan.

English: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken the LORD God of his fathers.
Masaai: Neaku etekepari apa Edom aing'uaa enkitoria e Yuda o metabaiki ena olong. Ore apa teina kata nekepari sii ninye Libna aing'uaa enkitoria enye, enkaraki natanya ninye Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Judah thereto.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eshomo ninye aitobir iwuejitin neeika teina kop oo ldoinyio e Yuda, neitapong'oo lelo oo manya Yerusalem metapaasha Olaitoriani, neitapong'oo Yuda.

English: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of David thy father, Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
Masaai: Nelotu empalai enetii ninye naing'uaa oloiboni le Nkai oji Eliya, ejo, “Nji ejo o Laitoriani, Enkai e Daudi papaai lino, ‘Ore enkaraki neitu iyie imbung orrekie le Yehoshafat papaai lino, anaa orrekie le Asa olaiguanani le Yuda,

English: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father's house, which were better than thyself:
Masaai: kake orrekie loo laiguanak le Israel iturubare, nintapong'oyie Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem metaasa ing'ok, anaa apa enaitapong'oyie enkaji e Ahab Israel metaasa ing'ok, nitaara sii ilalashera linono metuata, lelo le nkaji e papaai lino, laa ninche supati te iyie;

English: Behold, with a great plague will the LORD smite thy people, and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy goods:
Masaai: ng'ura keyau Olaitoriani olmeitai kitok shumata iltung'ana linono, o nkera inono, o nkituaak inono, o ntokitin inono pooki.

English: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
Masaai: Ore iyie makewan nikijing enkeeya torrono, e nkoshoke, o metaba anaa nikipuku imonyit tenkaraki ina keeya.’ ”

English: Moreover the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
Masaai: Neputu Olaitoriani engoro oo Lfilisti olmarabu tenkaraki Yehoram. Etaaniki apa lelo Filisti o lmarabu Etiopia.

English: And they came up into Judah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche aarasaki Yuda, neibung ninye, nenap ninche aaya ntokitin pooki naanoto te nkaji o laiguanani, neya sii ilayiok lenyena o nkituaak enyena, neaku meetae olayioni otung'eikiaki ninye, meteleku ake Yehoahas ilo ayioni lenye oti te pooki.

English: And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie kuna pooki near Olaitoriani ninye teina keeya nemeishiunoyu enkoshoke enye.

English: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata etulusoitie ilarin oare, neipang'u imonyit enyena tenkaraki ina keeya. Neye ninye te mion sapuk. Neitu eitobir iltung'ana lenyena enkima, aasho ninye enkanyit anaa apa enaitobiraki enkima too loo menye.

English: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomoni uni oare apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin isiet te Yerusalem. Eiwuang'a ninye meetae oltung'ani otishilayie. Etunukaitie ninche ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, kake mme too nkuraren oo laiguanak.

English: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem neitaa Ahasia olayioni lenye oti olaiguanani terishata enye. Amu ore ilo wuampa apa loo ltung'ana ooetuo tenebo Ilmarabu atua ilng'oborri, netaara metuata lelo ayiok pooki botoro. Neaku Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram olaiguanani le Yuda ninye oitoreishe.

English: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
Masaai: Oloo larin artam oare apa Ahasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye olari obo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Atalia, enkakuyiaa e Omri.

English: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
Masaai: Eshomo sii apa aibung orrekie le nkaji e Ahab, amu ng'otonye apa naiguan metaasa entorroni.

English: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the LORD like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa enataasa enkaji e Ahab. Amu ore apa te siadi keeya e papaai lenye, ninche ooiguanaki ninche, neitasur ninye.

English: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramothgilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
Masaai: Etusujayie ninye enkikoo enye, o meshomo ninye tenebo Yehoram olayioni le Ahab, ilo aiguanani le Israel, nepuo aaitayunye Hasael olaiguanani le Siria olarrabal te Ramot-gilead. Nepik iltung'ana le Siria Yoram olbae.

English: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
Masaai: Nerrinyo ninye alo metabaki te Yesreel tenkaraki lelo baa apa ootipikaki ninye te Rama, ina kata apa pee elo aarare Hasael olaiguanani le Siria. Nedoyio Ahasia olayioni le Yehoram, olaiguanani le Yuda alo arum Yoram olayioni le Ahab te Yesreel, amu kemuoi apa ninye.

English: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
Masaai: Kake etegelua apa Enkai pee eyau embatatata e Ahasia tena lototo nashomo ninye abaiki Yoram. Ore apa pee elotu ninye ine, neipang ninye alo anang'are Yehu olayioni le Nimshi, laa ninye apa etubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput pee eidaikie enkaji e Ahab.

English: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Judah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
Masaai: Ore edung'ito Yehu enkiguana tenkaraki enkaji e Ahab, netumore ninye ilkituaak le Yuda o layiok loo lalashera le Ahasia, laa ninche apa ooing'orita Ahasia. Near ninche metuata.

English: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
Masaai: Neing'oru ninye Ahasia, neibung'i ninye eisudori tiatua Samaria, neyauni ninye enetii Yehu neari ninye metua. Nenukaa ninye amu etejo, “Nkakuyiaa lenye Yehosahafat, apa oing'oru Olaitoriani to ltau lenye pooki.” Ore te nkaji e Ahasia nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aitoreisho.

English: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
Masaai: Ore apa pee edol Atalia, ng'otonye Ahasia nchere etua olayioni lenye, nedumunye ninye, neidaikie lelo pooki le nkaji e nkitoo te Yuda.

English: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
Masaai: Kake eewa Yehoshabet ina tito o laiguanani Yoash olayioni le Ahasia nelo aisudoo ninye aitung'uaa ilkulikae ayiok lo laiguanani letaa keji pee eari metuata, nepik ninye tenebo enkaibung'ani enye olgilata oirragi. Neiko neijia Yehoshabet, ina tito o laiguanani Yehoram, ina kitok e Yehoida olapolosani. Ore enkaraki naa enkanashe apa ninye e Ahasia, eisudoyie ninye arishie Atalia, neaku eitu ear ninye metua.

English: And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
Masaai: Nebik ninye tenebo ninche ilarin ile, eisudori tiatua enkaji e Nkai, ina kata eitore Atalia ina kop.

English: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
Masaai: Ore to lari liopishana, neitagoluo Yehoida, neibung'are ninye ilarikok le njore le maa iip. Asaria olayioni le Yeroham, o Ishmael olayioni le Obed, o Maaseia olayioni le Adaia, o Elishafat olayioni le Sikri.

English: And they went about in Judah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah, and the chief of the fathers of Israel, and they came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aamanaa te Yuda pooki neiturrurru Ilawi too nkanas pooki e Yuda, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo Siraeli, nepuonu ninche Yerusalem.

English: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God. And he said unto them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as the LORD hath said of the sons of David.
Masaai: Ore ina umata pooki neitobir olning'o tenebo olaiguanani tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Nejoki Yehoida ninche, “Eng'ura olayioni lo laiguanani! Nchoo ninye eitoreisho, anaa enairoro Olaitoriani tialo ilayiok le Daudi.

English: This is the thing that ye shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
Masaai: Ena bae intae entaas, ore intae ilapolosak o Lawi oopuo aing'uaa esiaai te nkolong e Sabato, ore ematua inyi e uni neaku ilarripok loo nchomito.

English: And a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ematua nabo e uni nepuo enkaji o laiguanani, ore ematua nabo e uni nepuo kishomi o lkitamanyunoto. Ore iltung'ana pooki nepuo olgoriet le nkaji e Nkai.

English: But let none come into the house of the LORD, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of the LORD.
Masaai: Emincho ejing hoo ng'ae atua enkaji o Laitoriani meteleku ilapolosak o Lawi ooisiaaisho. Eidim ninche aatijing, amu eisinyat. Kake ore iltung'ana pooki neibung enkitanapata o Laitoriani.

English: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else cometh into the house, he shall be put to death: but be ye with the king when he cometh in, and when he goeth out.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi neman olaiguanani aang'adu, oltung'ani ake eeta imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina enye. Ore pooki ng'ae ojing e nkaji o Laitoriani neari metua. Entaa tenebo olaiguanani tenejing'u o teneipang.”

English: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi o Yuda pooki neas te risioroto e nena pooki naaitanapa Yehoida olapolosani ninche. Eyaua ake pooki ng'ae iltung'ana lenyena, lelo lemetii esiaai te nkolong e sabato, amu eitu apa eisho Yehoida olapolosani iltung'ana meidapashari too lturrurri.

English: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David's, which were in the house of God.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoida olapolosani aisho ilarikok le njore iremeta o long'oi dapashi o nkutiti apa naara ino laiguanani Daudi, naa atua enkaji e Nkai etii.

English: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltung'ana pooki metaa ilarripok lo laiguanani, eeta ake pooki tung'ani masaa enyena o larrabal te nkaina, ebaiki enkalo e kopikop enkaji o metabaiki enkalo e moikuape e nkaji, neman olperere lo lasar o enkaji.

English: Then they brought out the king's son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, God save the king.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ariku olayioni lo laiguanani, neishopoki ninye emaupe e nkitoo, neisho ninye enchakenisho nelimu ninche ninye aajo olaiguanani. Ore Yehoida o layiok lenyena nebukoki ninye eilata aaput, nejo ninche, “Metobikoi olaiguanani.”

English: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Atalia enkilepilep oo ltung'ana ekuet neisis Olaiguanani, nelo ninye atua enkaji o Laitoriani, ine netii iltung'ana.

English: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eing'orisho, nedol olaiguanani eitashe tembata e ng'ape te wueji nejing'ieki enkaji e Nkai, neitashe ilarikok le njore o laoshok loo ntarumpetani te mbata o laiguanani ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop neshipa neosh ntarumpetani. Ore ilaranyak neeta nkinantani enye oo sinkolioitin, erikoo osirua. Nepolos Atalia nkilani enyena, nebuaku ajo, “Enkarruoisho! Enkarruoisho.”

English: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso followeth her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Yehoida olapolosani ayau lelo kituaak le njore apa oitasheiki enjore, ejoki ninche, “Iyau ninye mpang'unye erishata oo lturrurri. Ore pooki ng'ae osuju ninye neari to lalem metua.” Amu etejo apa ilo apolosani, “Emiar ninye metua tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king's house, they slew her there.
Masaai: Neaku eibung'a ninche ninye, nelo ninye kishomi e mbarta natii enkaji o laiguanani, neari ninye metua teine.

English: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD'S people.
Masaai: Neitobir Yehoida olning'o terishata enye o ltung'ana pooki o laiguanani nchere, pee eaku ninche iltung'ana lo Laitoriani.

English: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana pooki enkaji e Baal, nepuo aadung aauroki enkop; ore ilperereni lenyena loo lasarri, o nkitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin nebel aaitaa mbelibelat, near ninche Matan ilo apolosani le Baal metua, te dukuya lelo pereren loo lasarri.

English: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.
Masaai: Nepik Yehoida ilarripok le nkaji o Laitoriani, abori erikoroto oo lapolosak o Lawi, o lelo Lawi apa ootegelua Daudi pee eitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani. Pee eitaiki Olaitoriani ilasarri oopejori, anaa apa enaigeroki too nkitanapat e Musa, te nchipai o te ranyare, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi.

English: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the LORD, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
Masaai: Nepik ninye ilarripok loo nchomito, nchomito e nkaji o Laitoriani, pee mejing'u ake oltung'ani hoo obo oiduruk.

English: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of the LORD: and they came through the high gate into the king's house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aya ilkituaak le njore, o nkasisin, o lbalusuni loo ltung'ana o ltung'ana pooki le nkop; neriku ninche olaiguanani aaitadou te nkaji o Laitoriani, erukunye aagilaki te nkishomi e shumata o meetu enkaji o laiguanani. Neitoton ninche olaiguanani to lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
Masaai: Neaku etishipate iltung'ana pooki leina kop; neitirring'a ina anasa, ina kata eidipaki aatar Atalia to lalem.

English: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Zibiah of Beersheba.
Masaai: Oloo larin oopishana apa Yoash pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin artam te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Sibia e Beer-sheba.

English: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the LORD all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
Masaai: Neas Yoash mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoida olapolosani.

English: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
Masaai: Neisho Yehoida ninye nkituaak are, netum ninye ilayiok o ntoyie.

English: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ena nemut Yoash pee eitobir e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Judah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year, and see that ye hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninye ilapolosak, o Lawi, nejoki ninche, “Enchom nkanas e Yuda nisotutu too Siraeli pooki mpisai naaitobirieki enkaji e Nkai inyi, te pooki ake ari. Naa eng'ura pee isosionienie ina bae.” Kake eitu eisosion Ilawi.

English: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the LORD, and of the congregation of Israel, for the tabernacle of witness?
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aipotu olkitok oji Yehoida, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo iyie pee eitu nkilikuanu too Lawi, meyauni te Yuda o te Yerusalem kodi apa natejo Musa, osinka lo Laitoriani, te umata oo Siraeli tenkaraki olng'obor le nchakenisho?”

English: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of God; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the LORD did they bestow upon Baalim.
Masaai: Amu etigila apa ilayiok le Atalia, ina kitok arruoni, enkaji e Nkai, netaasishore sii nena tokitin pooki apa naaitisinyaki e nkaji o Laitoriani tenkaraki Baal.

English: And at the king's commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku eitanapishe olaiguanani, neitobir ninche osanduku nepik ninye boo ina kishomi e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem, to bring in to the LORD the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness.
Masaai: Neibalunyeki tiatua Yuda pooki o Yerusalem, pee eyakini Olaitoriani ina kodi apa natejo Musa osinka le Nkai pee eitayu Isiraeli tiong'ota.

English: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki neshipa, neyau kodi enye aaitadoiki ilo sanduku o metaba anaa neidipayu.

English: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king's office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the high priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
Masaai: Naa ore apa teneyaki Ilawi ilo sanduku iltung'ana kituaak lo laiguanani, naa tenedol ninche aajo etii mpisai kumok, nelotu olaigeroni lo laiguanani o lkitok loo lapolosak aapiku teilo sanduku, nerriny osanduku ewueji duoo netii. Neas ninche ina anaake, nesotu mpisai kumok oleng.

English: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of the LORD, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of the LORD, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neisho olaiguanani o Yehoida lelo apa ooitasheiki esiaai enkaji o Laitoriani, neiger ilaguetak loo soito, o laguetak loo nkeek pee eitobir ninche enkaji o Laitoriani. Tenebo sii ilaitobirak loo sekenke o suyai, pee eram ninche enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
Masaai: Neaku etaasishote apa lelo ootipikaki esiaai, ore enkitobirata e nkaji nelo dukuya too nkaik enye, neitobir ninche enkaji e Nkai netiu anaa apake, neitagol ninye.

English: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of the LORD, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the LORD continually all the days of Jehoiada.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip neyau nena pisai naatelekutua dukuya olaiguanani o Yehoida. Neitobiraki nena pisai imasaa e nkaji o Laitoriani, tenkaraki enkisiaayiare o lasarri oopejori, o ntokitin e nkorropil, o ntokitin e sahabu o enkosholai. Neitayu ninche ilasarri oopejori tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani anaake too nkolong'i pooki e Yehoida.

English: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
Masaai: Kake etamorua Yehoida, neye; naa oloo larin iip o tomoni uni apa ninye ina kata pee eye.

English: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, both toward God, and toward his house.
Masaai: Nenukaa ninche ninye te nkanasa e Daudi tenebo ilaiguanak, amu etaasa apa ninye mbaa sidain te Israel, o tialo Olaitoriani o enkaji enye.

English: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie keeya e Yehoida, nepuonu ilkituaak le Yuda aailejilej olaiguanani nening olaiguanani ninche.

English: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninche enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, neisiaai Asherim o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin. Nelotu engoro napi shumata Yuda o Yerusalem tenkaraki ena kitarruoroto enye.

English: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto the LORD; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, neirriwua ninye iloibonok meetu aarrinyoki ninche Olaitoriani, neishakenoki kulo ninche, kake etanyaita ninche ening.

English: And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus saith God, Why transgress ye the commandments of the LORD, that ye cannot prosper? because ye have forsaken the LORD, he hath also forsaken you.
Masaai: Nejing enkiyang'et o Laitoriani Sakaria olayioni le Yehoida olapolosani; neitashe arumaki iltung'ana kop, nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Kainyoo pee igiligili intae nkitanapat o Laitoriani o metaa meekure ibulubulu? Ore enkaraki nitanyaita intae Olaitoriani, etanya sii ninye intae.’ ”

English: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake eing'orutua ninche pee ear ninye metua, ore te nkitanapata olaiguanani nenang ninye too soito to lgoriet le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, The LORD look upon it, and require it.
Masaai: Neaku eitu apa edamu olaiguanani Yoash esupatisho apa naitoduaa Yehoida, menye le Sakaria ninye, kake etaara olayioni lenye metua. Ore eye ninye, nejo, “Metoduaa Olaitoriani neitalaku.”

English: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie olari nelotu enjore e Siria agilunore Yoash. Nepuonu ninche Yuda o Yerusalem, neidaikie ninche ilkituaak pooki loo ltung'ana, neishie tiatua olorere, neirriwaki ninche nena masaa pooki naawaita o laiguanani le Dameski.

English: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the LORD delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
Masaai: Ore hoo naa ilkuti tung'ana apa ina jore e Siria, eishooyie Olaitoriani apik nkaik enye enjore kitok, enkaraki natanyaita ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye. Neaku etudung'okito ninche enkiguana, Yoash.

English: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
Masaai: Ore pee epuo ninche aaing'uaa ninye, neing'uaaa ninye eeta olbae sapuk, neiguanare isinkan lenyena ninye pee ear metua, aaitalaku osarge lo layioni le Yehoida ilo apolosani, near ninche ninye metua te nchumata endapash enye. Neye ninye; nenukaa ninche ninye te nkanasa e Daudi, kake eitu ninche enukaa ninye too nkuraren oo laiguanak.

English: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ooiguanare ninye pee ear metua naa Sabad olayioni le Shimeat le Amon, o Yehoshafat olayioni le Shimrit le Moab.

English: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore mbaa oo layiok lenyena o mbaa kumok naaibarieki ninye, o ne nchetata e nkaji e Nkai neigeroki too limunot tiatua embuku oo laiguanak. Neitoreisho Amasia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa Amasia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam te Yerusalem. Ore enkarna e ng'otonye naa Yehodan e Yerusalem.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, but not with a perfect heart.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, kake mme sidai ake oltau lenye.

English: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eibung enkitoria akurraki too nkaik enyena, near metuata isinkan lenyena apa ootara menye ilo aiguanani.

English: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where the LORD commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye ear nkera enye metuata terisioroto e nena naaigeroki too nkitanapat, tiatua embuku e Musa, teina apa naitanapishe Olaitoriani ajo, “Meari loo menye metuata tenkaraki nkera, anaa meari nkera metuata tenkaraki iloo menye. Kake keye ake pooki tung'ani te nkaraki eng'oki enye makewan.”

English: Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Judah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia aiturrurr iltung'ana le Yuda, neitoton ninche anaa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, tiabori ilarikok le njore loo nkalifuni o loo maa iip te Yuda pooki o te Benchamen. Nepik ninye lelo loo larin tikitam neilep. Ore esiana enye neaku iltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni gelunot, ooidim olarrabal, ooidim aatanap iremeta o long'oi.

English: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Israel for an hundred talents of silver.
Masaai: Neitoki sii aiger iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo magil ooing'uaa Isiraeli te shekeli iip nabo e nkosholai.

English: But there came a man of God to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Israel go with thee; for the LORD is not with Israel, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
Masaai: Kake eewuo oltung'ani le Nkai enetii ninye nejoki, “Lo aiguanani, mincho enjore e Israel elo tenebo iyie, amu metii Olaitoriani tenebo Isiraeli, tenebo kulo pooki le Efraim.

English: But if thou wilt go, do it, be strong for the battle: God shall make thee fall before the enemy: for God hath power to help, and to cast down.
Masaai: Kake tenaa ijo iyie tena oitoi ilo agolu to larrabal, naa aikilo anang'aa Enkai te dukuya ilmang'ati; amu eeta Enkai engolon naretishore o enanang'arie.”

English: And Amaziah said to the man of God, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? And the man of God answered, The LORD is able to give thee much more than this.
Masaai: Nejoki Amasia ilo tung'ani le Nkai, “Kaa iyiook kias tenkaraki nena talantani iip nabo naishoo nanu enjore oo Siraeli?” Newalu ilo tung'ani le Nkai ajo, “Eikindim iyie Olaitoriani aishoo nkumok naalang kuna.”

English: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in great anger.
Masaai: Neisho Amasia ina jore naing'uaa Efraim metorrinyoyu alo ang. Negorokino ninche Yuda oleng; nerrinyo aapuo ang te ngoro sapuk.

English: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
Masaai: Kake eitagoluo Amasia, nerikoo ninye iltung'ana lenyena, nepuo oerata le munyan, nesesekuan iltung'ana oogiroo nkalifuni tomon le Seir.

English: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
Masaai: Neibung iltung'ana le Yuda kulikae nkalifuni tomon eishu, neya ninche enchumata endapidapoi nesulaa ninche teine; nepurda pooki aaku mpurdat.

English: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Judah, from Samaria even unto Bethhoron, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
Masaai: Kake ore ilapa tung'ana le njore ootorrinyo Amasia, amitiki epuo olarrabal tenebo ninye, nedoiki nkanas e Yuda ebaiki Samaria o metabaiki Bet-horon, near iltung'ana nkalifuni uni tiatua ninche, neya iyarunot kumok oleng.

English: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
Masaai: Ore pee errinyunye Amasia eing'uaa-esesekuanata oo ltung'ana le Edom, neyau nkaitin oo ltung'ana le Seir, neitaa ninche nkaitin enyena, neserem ninche, neitaiki ninche ilasarri.

English: Wherefore the anger of the LORD was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why hast thou sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of thine hand?
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina negorokino Olaitoriani Amasia, neirriwaki ninye oloiboni le Nkai, otiaaka ninye, “kainyoo pee imbelekenyakine nkaitin oo ltung'ana neitu ninye ekordu iltung'ana lenye maate te nkaina ino?”

English: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
Masaai: Kake ore eton eirorita ninye nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Eikintaa iyiook iyie olaikooni lang? Tigirayu! Eijo iyie pee kiari tua?” Neaku etigire ilo oiboni le Nkai, kake etejo, “Ayiolo nanu ajo eitobira Olaitoriani pee kindaikie iyie, enkaraki nitaasa ena neitu ining enkikoo ai.”

English: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia aikilikuanishore iltung'ana lenyena, neirriwaki Yoash olayioni le Yehoahas olkilikuai. Naa Yehu olaiguanani loo Siraeli apa nkakuyiaa lenye. Nejoki Amasia Yoash, “Wou maing'urata too nkomomi.”

English: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give thy daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
Masaai: Neirriwaki Yoash ilo aiguanani loo Siraeli Amasia olkilikuai nejoki, “Eirriwaka enkiti aitubului e Lebanon olkilikuai oltarakuai, ajoki, ‘Nchoo entito ino meyama olayioni lai’; nelotu eng'ues e ntim e Lebanon aim ine neituny ina aitubului amut.

English: Thou sayest, Lo, thou hast smitten the Edomites; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast: abide now at home; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
Masaai: Ijo taata iyie, ‘Ng'ura, aidaikie nanu Edom,’ nikitudumua iyie oltau lino to lwuasa. Kake ore taata totona iyie tiang; kainyoo iyie pee impiru enyamali pee itum atua, iyie tenebo Yuda?”

English: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
Masaai: Kake etanya Amasia ening, amu enkitobirata e Nkai apa ina, pee etum atipika ninye atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, enkaraki nateserema ninche nkaitin e Edom.

English: So Joash the king of Israel went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo apa Yoash olaiguanani le Israel, netumo ninye o Amasia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, netumo to larrabal te Betshemesh, e Yuda.

English: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
Masaai: Nemir Israel Yuda neisik pooki tung'ani alo enkang enye.

English: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Bethshemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
Masaai: Neibung Yoash olaiguanani loo Siraeli Amasia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, olayioni le Yoash, olayioni le Ahasia te Betshemesh neyau ninye te Yerusalem, neuroo ninye esuntai e Yerusalem, erishata oo ntemat e nkaina iip ong'uan, ebaiki enkishomi e Efraim o metabaiki kishomi olpijata.

English: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Neya ninye sahabu pooki o enkosholai, o masaa pooki naatii atua enkaji e Nkai, netii Obed edom tenebo ninche. Neya sii ilchumat ootii enkaji o laiguanani, o ltung'ana ooibung'aki aaya, nerrinyo alo Samaria.

English: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
Masaai: Ore Amasia olayioni le Yoash olaiguanani le Yuda nebik ilarin tomon o imiet etulusoyie keeya e Yoash olayioni le Yehoahas, olaiguanani loo Siraeli.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Amasia, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigeroki too mbukui oo laiguanak le Yuda o Israel.

English: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata apa naibelekenye ninye apaash Olaitoriani, neitobir ninche pee ear ninye metua te Yerusalem. Neisikaki ninye Lakish. Kake etusujakita ninche ninye Lakish, near ninye metua teine.
