English: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah.
Masaai: Neyau ninche ninye too mbartan. Nenukari tenebo loo menye te nkanasa e Daudi.

English: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda, neibung Usia laa oloo larin tomon o ile, neitaa ninye olaiguanani terishata e papaai lenye Amasia.

English: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
Masaai: Etesheta apa ninye Elot nerrinyoki ninye Yuda, ina kata eidipa olaiguanani atua.

English: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tomon o ile apa Usia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin onom oare te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Yekolia e Yerusalem.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Amaziah did.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa papaai lenye Amasia.

English: And he sought God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of God: and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him to prosper.
Masaai: Eing'orua apa ninye Olaitoriani, too nkolong'i e Sakaria, laa ninye oiteng'ena ninye te uriata o Laitoriani; naa ore anaa enaserem Olaitoriani neisho Enkai ninye metubula.

English: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
Masaai: Eshomo ninye aitayunye Ilfilisti olarrabal, neuroo esuntai e Gat o e suntai e Yabne, o esuntai e Ashdod; neshetu ninye nkanas too lpolosien le Ashdod, te kulie wuejitin tiatua Ilfilisti.

English: And God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.
Masaai: Etaretuo Enkai ninye tialo Ilfilisti, o lelo Marabu apa oomanya Kurbal, o Lmeuni.

English: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
Masaai: Etalaa apa Ilamoni kodi aaisho Usia, ore olning'o lenye nelo o metabaiki ilpolosien le Misiri, amu etaa apa ninye oltung'ani ogol oleng.

English: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eteshetua apa Usia iltaleta te Yerusalem te kishomi o lpijata, o te kishomi oerata, o to lkutoto, neshetu ninche aitagol.

English: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye iltaleta tiong'ota, neturu ilchorroi kumok, amu eeta apa ninye nkishu kumok oleng too ldoinyio o te nkop naisiasha. Neeta apa ninye ilaramatak o laitobirak loo lng'anayio too ldoinyio o te wueji sidai enterit, amu kenyor apa ninye enturore e nkurma.

English: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
Masaai: Neeta sii apa Usia enjore oo sikarini, ooidim olarrabal, too lturrurri, terisioroto enkikena e Yeiel ilo aigeroni o Maaseia ilo kitok, tiabori erikoto e Hanania, obo apa loo larikok le njore lo laiguanani.

English: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ore esiana pooki oo lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, oo ltung'ana magil yiolot, naa nkalifuni are o iip ile.

English: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
Masaai: Ore ti abori erikoroto enye netii enjore oo ltung'ana nkalifuni iip uni o oopishana o iip imiet, ooidim aatigilunore engolon kitok, pee eretu olaiguanani tialo ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
Masaai: Neitobiraki Usia enjore pooki ilong'oi, o remeta, o maupen oo sekenke, o ruparen; o nkai o mbaa, o soito oo nang'ari le nkopito.

English: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
Masaai: Ore te Yerusalem neitobir iwuejitin neengororieki mbaa, too iltaleta, o too lpijat. Nengorori mbaa nenang'ari isoito sapuki. Nelo olning'o enelakua, amu etaretoki ninye oleng, o metaa oltung'ani ogol.

English: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against the LORD his God, and went into the temple of the LORD to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
Masaai: Kake ore apa pee eaku olaiguanani Usia oltung'ani ogol, newuasayu ninye, ina pee eidak ninye. Amu eitarruoyie apa ninye to Laitoriani Enkai enye, nejing atua enkaji o Laitoriani alo apej enkorropil to lperere lo lasar le nkorropil.

English: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of the LORD, that were valiant men:
Masaai: Kake eshomo apa Asaria olapolosani ajing'aki ninye, tenebo ilapolosak ntomoni isiet lo Laitoriani yiolot, nepuo ninche aaitasheiki olaiguanani Usia, nejoki ninye,

English: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto thee, Uzziah, to burn incense unto the LORD, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for thou hast trespassed; neither shall it be for thine honour from the LORD God.
Masaai: “Mme esiaai ino Usia, pee ipejoki Olaitoriani enkorropil, kake esiaai oo lapolosak, lelo ayiok le Aron, laa ninche apa eiteng'elaki pee epej enkorropil. Tupuku mpang'a te wueji sinyati, amu itaasa embae torrono, amu mikiyaki ina enkanyit to Laitoriani, Enkai.”

English: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the LORD, from beside the incense altar.
Masaai: Negoro Usia. Neeta ninye te nkaina entoki napejieki enkorropil, ore ake pee egorokino lelo apolosak, nejing enkeeya oo lbolot enkomom enye, te dukuya lelo apolosak ootii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, ooitashe tembata olperere lo lasar le nkorropil.

English: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because the LORD had smitten him.
Masaai: Ore Asaria ilo apolosani kitok, o lelo apolosak pooki neing'or ninye, naa ng'ura, etijing'a enkeeya oo lbolot enkomom enye! Neipang'ie ninye boo nabo kata, ore ninye makewan neisarrisar alo boo, amu etoosho Olaitoriani ninye.

English: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
Masaai: Neton olaiguanani Usia eeta enkeeya oo lbolot o metua. Naa ore anaa oltung'ani oata enkeeya oolbolot neton te nkaji enye makewan. Amu eiwuang'ieki ninye tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani. Naa Yotam olayioni lenye ninye apa oing'or ntokitin e nkaji o laiguanani, neitore iltung'ana leina kop.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
Masaai: Naa ore apa nkiaasin pooki e Usia, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, neigero oloiboni le Nkai oji Isaya olayioni le Amos.

English: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Usia etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye tenebo loo menye te wueji oo nkuraren oo laiguanak, amu etejo ninche, “Ole nkeeya oo lbolot ninye.” Neitoreisho Yotam olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother's name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa Yotam pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Yerusha entito e Sadok.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of the LORD. And the people did yet corruptly.
Masaai: Neas ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani terisioroto enena pooki apa naataasa papaai lenye Usia, kake eitu ninye elo aibung ntokitin e nkaji o Laitoriani. Kake eton ake eas iltung'ana mbaa torrok.

English: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
Masaai: Etesheta ninye kishomi e shumata e nkaji o Laitoriani neshet oleng esuntai e Ofel.

English: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
Masaai: Etesheta sii nkanas teina kop oo ndonyio e Yuda, o sempewueti, o ltaleta te nena doinyio e ntim.

English: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
Masaai: Etaarare ninye olaiguanani le Amon nemir ninye. Neisho Ilamoni ninye teilo ari shekeli iip nabo e nkosholai, o lbenia nkalifuni tomon le nkano, o lbenia nkalifuni tomon le shairi. Neisho Ilamoni ninye nena tokitin too larin okuni.

English: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.
Masaai: Neaku etaa Yotam oltung'ani magilani enkaraki naipirie ninye nkoitoi enyena dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yotam, o larrabali lenyena pooki, o nkoitoi enyena, ng'ura neigeroki tiatua embuku oo laiguanak loo Siraeli o Yuda.

English: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa ninye pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem.

English: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Yotam etua anaa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye te nkanasa e Daudi; neitoreisho Ahas olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of the LORD, like David his father:
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam apa Ahas pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon o ile te Yerusalem. Neitu ninye eas mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, anaa apa papaai lenye Daudi.

English: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for Baalim.
Masaai: Kake eibung'a ninye irrekiei loo laiguanak le Israel. Eitobira doi ninye nkitanyaanyukot o ntokitin naatosholaki aaitobiraki Baal.

English: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Nepej enkorropil to erata lo layioni le Hinom; nepejoo ilayiok lenyena anaa olasar, te risioroto e nena tabo apa oo loshon ooterewa Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.

English: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
Masaai: Neitayu ninye olasar nepejoo enkorropil, too wuejitin e shumata o too ldoinyio, o tiabori pooki shani onyori.

English: Wherefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who smote him with a great slaughter.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eishooyie Olaitoriani ninye apik nkaik o laiguanani le Siria. Nemir olaiguanani le Siria ninye, neibung iltung'ana lenyena kumok neya ninche Dameski. Eishooyioki sii apa aapik nkaik o laiguanani le Israel, ilo otimira ninye te sesekuanata sapuk.

English: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Amu ore olayioni le Remalia netasesekuana iltung'ana nkalifuni iip nabo o tikitam te Yuda te nkolong nabo. Ore lelo pooki naa iltung'ana yiolot, enkaraki natanyaita ninche Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
Masaai: Ore Sikri ilo tung'ani magilani le Efraim, nesesekuan Maaseia, olayioni lo laiguanani, o Asikam ilo kitok le nkaji e nkitoo, o Elkana ilo osujaki te nkitoo o laiguanani.

English: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Samaria.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel neibung iltung'ana nkalifuni iip are e lelo tung'ana lenye, nkituaak o layiok o ntoyie. Ewaita sii iyarunot kumok te ninche neya Samaria.

English: But a prophet of the LORD was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out before the host that came to Samaria, and said unto them, Behold, because the LORD God of your fathers was wroth with Judah, he hath delivered them into your hand, and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven.
Masaai: Kake etii apa oloiboni lo Laitoriani ine, oji enkarna enye Oded. Neipang ninye alo atumore ina jore naing'uaa Samaria, nejoki ninche, “Ng'ura, ore amu etagorokine apa Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi Yuda, eishorua ninche apik nkaik inyi, kake itasesekuana intae ninche te ngoro naing'uaa shumata.

English: And now ye purpose to keep under the children of Judah and Jerusalem for bondmen and bondwomen unto you: but are there not with you, even with you, sins against the LORD your God?
Masaai: Niyieuu taata intae nintaa irrindiki iltung'ana le Yuda o le Yerusalem, Ilewa o nkituaak. Aimiatata intae ing'ok inyi maate tialo Olaitoriani Enkai inyi?

English: Now hear me therefore, and deliver the captives again, which ye have taken captive of your brethren: for the fierce wrath of the LORD is upon you.
Masaai: Entoning'oki naa taata nirrinyirrinyi lelo apa limbung'a aayau, amu etii engoro napi o Laitoriani shumata intae.”

English: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against them that came from the war,
Masaai: Ore apa kulikae tung'ana kituaak too ltung'ana le Efraim, Asaria olayioni le Yohanan, o Berekia olayioni le Meshilemot, o Yehikia olayioni le Shalum, o Amasa olayioni le Hadalai, neitashe aagilunore lelo apa ooing'uaa olarrabal.

English: And said unto them, Ye shall not bring in the captives hither: for whereas we have offended against the LORD already, ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass: for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Miyauu intae lelo yarunot ene, amu ijojo intae pee iyauu shumata iyiook enkitarruroto to Laitoriani aaponiki ing'ok ang o nkitarrurot ang maate. Amu aikitok enkitarruoroto ang maate, netii engoro napi tenkaraki Israel.”

English: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
Masaai: Neaku etapala lelo tung'ana le njore lelo yarunot aaisho meshomo, tenebo nena masaa, te dukuya lelo kituaak o eumata pooki.

English: And the men which were expressed by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all that were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them upon asses, and brought them to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren: then they returned to Samaria.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana apa ooipotoki nkarn nedumunye aaya lelo yarunot, o masaa naatarayioki, neishopoki nkilani lelo lemeishopo. Neishopoki ninche nkilani, neisho ninche inamuka, neisho endaa o entoki naok, neyel ninche te ilata. Ore lelo lemeidimari nenapi too sirkon. Neyau ninche enkop enye maate, Yeriko enkanasa oo ltuka. Neitoki ninche aarrinyo aapuo Samaria.

English: At that time did king Ahaz send unto the kings of Assyria to help him.
Masaai: Ore apa teina kata neomonu olaiguanani Ahas eretoto to laiguanani le Asiria.

English: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
Masaai: Amu enyaakita iltung'ana le Edom aarasaki nemir Yuda, neya ninye nkanas e Betshemesh o Aijalon, o Gederot, o Soko tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti,

English: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country, and of the south of Judah, and had taken Bethshemesh, and Ajalon, and Gederoth, and Shocho with the villages thereof, and Timnah with the villages thereof, Gimzo also and the villages thereof: and they dwelt there.
Masaai: neya Timna tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti, o Gumso tenebo nkang'itie enyena kutiti, nemanyisho ninche tenena wuejitin.

English: For the LORD brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel; for he made Judah naked, and transgressed sore against the LORD.
Masaai: Amu eitadouo apa Olaitoriani Yuda tenkaraki Ahas olaiguanani le Israel, amu etaasa apa ninye inenkarruoisho tiatua Yuda, netaa olemeisiligayu to Laitoriani.

English: And Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria came unto him, and distressed him, but strengthened him not.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo Tilgat-pilnesa, ilo aiguanani le Asiria agilunore ninye, ore terishata naitagol ninye neidop ninye.

English: For Ahaz took away a portion out of the house of the LORD, and out of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave it unto the king of Assyria: but he helped him not.
Masaai: Amu eitayio apa Ahas te nkaji o Laitoriani, o te nkaji o laiguanani o too nkajijik oo lkituaak, ntokitin e kodi naaishoo olaiguanani le Asiria; kake eitu eretu nena tokitin ninye.

English: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the LORD: this is that king Ahaz.
Masaai: Ore teina kata enye o sina neponari ninye aaku olemeisiligayu to Laitoriani. Ore ake sii ele aiguanani oji Ahas,

English: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus, which smote him: and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them, therefore will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
Masaai: amu etopolosaka ninye nkaitin e Dameski, naa ninche apa naatimira ninye, nejo ninye, “Ore enkaraki natareto nkaitin oo ltung'ana le Asiria ninche, kapolosaki nanu ninche pee aatum aataretu nanu.” Kake etaa ninche enkidaata te ninye o te Israel pooki.

English: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God, and shut up the doors of the house of the LORD, and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neiturrur Ahab tenebo imasaa e nkaji nedung'udung nena masaa aitaa ndung'udung'ot, neiken ninye nkutukie oo nkajijik e nkaji o Laitoriani; neitobiraki kewan ilperereni loo lasarri te pooki pijata le Yerusalem.

English: And in every several city of Judah he made high places to burn incense unto other gods, and provoked to anger the LORD God of his fathers.
Masaai: Ore tiatua pooki anasa e Yuda, neitobir ninye iwuejitin neeika neepejokinye enkorropil kulie aitin, neitagor Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo menye.

English: Now the rest of his acts and of all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin enyena o nkoitoi enyena pooki, ebaiki enkiterunoto o metabaiki enkiting'oto, ng'ura eigeroki te mbuku oo laiguanak le Yuda o Israel.

English: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Jerusalem: but they brought him not into the sepulchres of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirrag Ahas etua anaa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye te nkanasa, tiatua Yerusalem, amu eitu ninche eyau ninche nkuraren oo laiguanak le Israeli. Neitoreisho Hesekia olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Hezekiah began to reign when he was five and twenty years old, and he reigned nine and twenty years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
Masaai: Eiterua apa Hesekia aitoreisho aa o loo larin tikitam o imiet, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tikitam ooudo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa Abija entito e Sekaria.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.
Masaai: Neas mbaa sidain te dukuya Olaitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki apa naataasa papaai lenye Daudi.

English: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of the LORD, and repaired them.
Masaai: Ore to lari le dukuya le nkitoria enye, to lapa le dukuya, nebol ninye nkutukie oo nkajijik e nkaji o Laitoriani, neram ninche.

English: And he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the east street,
Masaai: Neitijing'u ninye ilapolosak o Lawi, neiturrur ninche to lgoriet le nkalo oloo saen, nejoki ninye ninche, “Entoning'oki nanu lo Lawi!

English: And said unto them, Hear me, ye Levites, sanctify now yourselves, and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
Masaai: Entisinya ate, nintisinyinyi enkaji o Laitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi, niwuang'ieng'ie intae olduruk teine wueji sinyati.

English: For our fathers have trespassed, and done that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of the LORD, and turned their backs.
Masaai: Amu etaa apa iloo papa ilemeisiligayu, netaasa ninche entorroni too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai ang; etung'uitie ninche ninye, neibelekenyate aapaash emanyisho o Laitoriani, neisho ninche ninye oriong.

English: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
Masaai: Neiken sii kutukaji eine wueji sinyati, near iltaai, neitu epejoki enkorropil anaa eishooyo ilasarri teine wueji sinyati, aaisho Enkai e Israel.

English: Wherefore the wrath of the LORD was upon Judah and Jerusalem, and he hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, nelotu engoro o Laitoriani napi shumata e Yuda o Yerusalem, neitaa ninche entoki naitureisho, o enenking'asia, o entoki naimakini, anaa enidolidolo too nkonyek inyi.

English: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura to lalem apa etabatatate loo papa o ilayiok lang, o ntoyie ang, ore nkituaak ang naatii netii atua eyararoto tenkaraki ena.

English: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
Masaai: Etii naa taata oltau lai pee aitobir osotua lo lning'o o Laitoriani, Enkai e Israel, pee etum ina goro enye napi aibelekenyayu te iyiook.

English: My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.
Masaai: Na kera aainei, emimenaa naa taata, amu etegelua intae Olaitoriani pee ipuopuo aaitashe te dukuya ninye, pee isiayiayia ninye, niakuku ilaisiaayiak lenyena nipejokiki ninye enkorropil.”

English: Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:
Masaai: Neitoki aadumunye kulikae Lawi, Mahat olayioni le Amasia, o Yoel olayioni le Asaria loo layiok le Kohat; ore too layiok le Merari naa Kish olayioni le Abdi, o Asaria olayioni le Yahalel; Ore too le Gershon, naa Yoa olayioni le Sima, o Eden olayioni le Yoa.

English: And of the sons of Elizaphan; Shimri, and Jeiel: and of the sons of Asaph; Zechariah, and Mattaniah:
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Elisafan, naa Shimri o Yeul; ore too layiok le Asaf naa Sekaria o Matania;

English: And of the sons of Heman; Jehiel, and Shimei: and of the sons of Jeduthun; Shemaiah, and Uzziel.
Masaai: ore too layiok le Heman, naa Yehuel o Shimei; ore too layiok le Yedutum naa Shimeia o Usiel.

English: And they gathered their brethren, and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the commandment of the king, by the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninche ilalashera lenye neitisiny ate, nejing ninche atua anaa enaitanapishe olaiguanani, too rorei lo Laitoriani, pee eitisinyi enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took it, to carry it out abroad into the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Nepuo ilapolosak olgilata liatua le nkaji o Laitoriani aaitisiny, neitayu ninche olduruk pooki, apa otii atua enkaji o Laitoriani aayau boo, ilo goriet le nkaji o Laitoriani, nedumu Ilawi aaya oerata le Kidron.

English: Now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of the LORD: so they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days; and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
Masaai: Eiterutua apa ninche aaitisiny te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya, ore te nkolong e isiet o lapa nepuonu ninche olgoriet le kutukaji enkaji o Laitoriani; ore too nkolong'i isiet neitisiny ninche enkaji o Laitoriani ore te nkolong e tomon o ile o lapa le dukuya neidip ninche.

English: Then they went in to Hezekiah the king, and said, We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread table, with all the vessels thereof.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aapuo enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kintisinya iyiook enkaji o Laitoriani pooki, ilo perere lo lasar opejori o masaa enyena pooki, o ina mesa e mukate e nkitoduaaroto o masaa enyena pooki.

English: Moreover all the vessels, which king Ahaz in his reign did cast away in his transgression, have we prepared and sanctified, and, behold, they are before the altar of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore imasaa pooki apa naawa olaiguanani Ahas te nkitoria enye apa meisiligayu, nikintobira iyiook, nikintisinya; naa ng'ura etii ninche dukuya olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani.”

English: Then Hezekiah the king rose early, and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani Hesekia adumunye tadekenya neiturrur iltung'ana kituaak le nkanasa, neilep alo enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And they brought seven bullocks, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven he goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests the sons of Aaron to offer them on the altar of the LORD.
Masaai: Neyau ninche iloing'ok oopishana, o lmeregeshi oopishana o lkuoo le kerra oopishana, tenkaraki olasar loo ng'ok o tenkaraki enkitoria, o tenkaraki ewueji sinyati o tenkaraki Yuda. Neitoki ninye aitanap ilapolosak lelo ayiok le Aron pee eishooyo ninche anaa olasar te nchumata olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani.

English: So they killed the bullocks, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: likewise, when they had killed the rams, they sprinkled the blood upon the altar: they killed also the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood upon the altar.
Masaai: Neyieng ninche lelo oing'ok, neng'amu ilapolosak osarge neisuaki olperere lo lasar; neyieng lelo meregeshi neisuaki osarge lenye olperere lo lasar; neyieng ilkuoo le kerra neisuaki osarge lenye olperere lo lasar.

English: And they brought forth the he goats for the sin offering before the king and the congregation; and they laid their hands upon them:
Masaai: Neitokini aayau lelo kineji anaa olasar loo ng'ok, dukuya olaiguanani o eumata, neiteleiki ninche nkaik enye shumata ninche.

English: And the priests killed them, and they made reconciliation with their blood upon the altar, to make an atonement for all Israel: for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all Israel.
Masaai: Neyieng ilapolosak ninche neitobir olasar loo ng'ok to sarge le lelo kineji te nchumata olperere lo lasar, pee eitobir olning'o lo sotua tenkaraki Israel pooki. Amu eitanapishe olaiguanani nchere, ore olasar opejori, o lasar le ng'oki naa keitobiri tenkaraki Israel pooki.

English: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with psalteries, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, and of Gad the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for so was the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.
Masaai: Nepik ninye Ilawi atua enkaji o Laitoriani, eeta nkinantani dapashi oo saanini, o Nkai oo sinkolioitin, o lwululi loo usin, te risioroto enkitanapata e Daudi, o ene Gad ilo aduaani lo laiguanani o Natan oloiboni le Nkai. Amu ore apa ina kitanapata naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa eimunye iloibonok lenyena.

English: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.
Masaai: Neitashe Ilawi eeta nena kinantani e Daudi neitashe ilapolosak eeta ntarumpetani.

English: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering upon the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began also with the trumpets, and with the instruments ordained by David king of Israel.
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia aitanapisho pee eitobiri olasar opejori te nchumata olperere lo lasar. Ore ake pee eiteruni ilo perere lo lasar, neiteruni sii osinkolio oranyakini Olaitoriani, neitusuji eoshoto oo ntarumpetani, o nkinantani e Daudi ilo aiguanani le Israel.

English: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.
Masaai: Neserem ina umata pooki, neranyisho ilaranyak, nebuaku ntarumpetani. Neranyisho nena pooki o metaba anaa neishunye ilo asar opejori.

English: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidipayu olasar, neirrugo olaiguanani o lelo pooki ootii tenebo ninye aaserem.

English: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Hesekia o lapolosak, o ltung'ana kituaak ilapolosak, metaranyaki Olaitoriani enkisisa too rorei le Daudi, o Asaf ilo aduaani. Nerany ninche enkisisa o Laitoriani te nchipai, neirrugo ninche aaserem.

English: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia ajo, “Intisinyakita taata intae ate Olaitoriani; entinyiku ene; niyauu ilasarri o nkishorot e nashe atua enkaji o Laitoriani.” Neyau ina umata ilasarri, o nkishorot e nashe, ore lelo pooki oota enyorrata too ltauja, neyau ilasarri oopejori.

English: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo lasarri oopejori, ooyautua ina umata naa iloing'ok ntomoni naapishana, o lmeregeshi iip nabo, o lkuo le kerra iip are. Ore kulo pooki naa iloo lasarri oopejokini Olaitoriani.

English: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
Masaai: Ore olasar lenkitisinyata naa iloing'ok iip ile o nkerra nkalifuni uni.

English: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
Masaai: Kake aikuti apa ilapolosak oleng nemeidim aaitobira ilasarri oopejori pooki, neaku eitisinya apa ilapolosak ate, neretu ninche ilalashera lenye, o metaba anaa neidipayu esiaai. Amu kedupa apa Ilawi too ltauja aalang ilapolosak.

English: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance,with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ilo asar opejori kitok, netii eilata o lasar le seriani, netii ilasarri oopikuni tenkaraki ilasarri oopejori. Neikoni neijia aarrinyu enkisiaayiare e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
Masaai: Ore Hesekia o ltung'ana pooki neshipayu tenkaraki ina naitaasa Olaitoriani iltung'ana; amu eewuo ina bae nabo kata.

English: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Hesekia olkilikuai te Israel pooki o Yuda, neigeroki sii Efraim impala, o Manase, pee epuonu ninche enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem, pee epuonu aaibung pasaka o Laitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.
Masaai: Amu eibung'a olaiguanani, o ltung'ana pooki kituaak, o eumata pooki natii Yerusalem enkiguana, pee eibung pasaka to lapa liare.

English: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu metumoki apa ninche aaibung'a te rishata enye amu eitu eitisiny ilapolosak ate, te siana naishiaakino, neitu sii eiturrurro iltung'ana te Yerusalem.

English: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.
Masaai: Nedol olaiguanani aa sidai ina kitobirata, nedol sii ina umata aajo aisidai.

English: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.
Masaai: Nelikio ninche aaibalunye te Israel pooki ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki Dan, nchere pee epuonu iltung'ana aaibung sabato tenkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, te Yerusalem, amu eitu aikata eibung te nkumoi anaa apa enatolimuoki.

English: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.
Masaai: Nepuo ilkipaareta enkop e Israel pooki o Yuda eeta mpala naaing'uaa olaiguanani o ltung'ana lenyena kituaak, anaa enaitanapishe olaiguanani, ejo, “Lo tung'ana le Israel, entorrinyokinoto Olaitoriani, Enkai e Abraham, o Isaak, o Israel, pee eitoki sii ninye arrinyokino ilo pisiai linyi, apa otelekua too nkaik oo laiguanak le Asiria.

English: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.
Masaai: Emitiuu intae anaa loo papaai linyi anaa ilalashera linyi, apa lemeisiligayu to Laitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, ore enkaraki ina neitaaki ninche olmuate, anaa enidolitata.

English: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.
Masaai: Emiaku naa taata iloosho murto anaa apa enatiu iloo papaai linyi, kake embelekenyakinoto Olaitoriani, nipuonunu ewueji enye sinyati, apa naitisinya ninye ntarasi, nisiayiayia Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, pee etum ina goro enye napi aibelekenyayu atapaasha intae.

English: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.
Masaai: Amu tenimbelekenyakinono intae Olaitoriani, ore ilalashera linyi o nkera inyi netum olng'ur te lelo apa ootaraitie ninche, nerrinyunye ninche aapuonu ena kop. Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai inyi naa kenana oshoke neeta olng'ur, nemeboin enkomom enye aitapaash intae, te nimbelekenyakinono ninye.”

English: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo kipaareta aaimaa nkanas pooki, te nkop e Efraim pooki o Manase, nepuo o metabaiki Sebulon, kake etakueniyie iltung'ana ninche nesurdaany, neikordod ninche.

English: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ilkuti tung'ana ake le Asheri o le Manase o le Sebulon ooitoborruote nepuonu Yerusalem.

English: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Etii sii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata Yuda, pee eisho ninche oltau obo oasie nena naaitanapishe olaiguanani o lkituaak lenyena, tialo ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana kumok aaiturrurro tenebo aaibung osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki; to lapa liare, eumata sapuk oleng.

English: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
Masaai: Neasisho ninche, neiwuang'ie ilperereni loo lasarri apa ootii Yerusalem, o lperereni loo lasarri oopejorieki enkorropil, neya ninche nepuo aanang'aki oerata le Kidron.

English: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neyieng ninche ilkuoo le kerra le pasaka, te nkolong e tomon oo ng'uan o lapa liare. Ore ilapolosak o Lawi nekurru, nepuo ninche aaitisiny ate, neyau ilasarri oopejori atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.
Masaai: Nejing ninche irishat enye terisioroto enkitanapata e Musa, ilo tung'ani le Nkai. Neisuaya ilapolosak ilo sarge otang'amutua too nkaik oo Lawi.

English: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD.
Masaai: Amu etii apa ilkumok teina umata leitu eitisiny ate. Ore enkaraki ina eteyiang'a Ilawi ilkuoo le kera te pooki ng'ae leitu eitisinyi, pee eitaae sinyati to Laitoriani.

English: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one
Masaai: Ore teilo orora lo lorere naa Efraim eing'uaa ilkumok lenye, o Manase, o Isaakar, o Sebulon, neitu eitisiny ate, eji neinosa ake pasaka kake mme te nkoitoi natolimuoki. Amu etoomonoko Hesekia ninche ejo, “Metapalaki Olaitoriani supat pooki tung'ani,

English: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
Masaai: oing'oru to ltau lenye Enkai, Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, hoo duoo teneme too nkitanapat e wueji sinyati e nkitukuore.”

English: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
Masaai: Nening Olaitoriani Hesekia, neishiunye iltung'ana.

English: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel apa ootii Yerusalem neibung osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki nkolong'i naapishana, te nchipai sapuk oleng. Ore Ilawi o lapolosak neisis Olaitoriani anaake. Neranyaki te nkidimata enye pooki Olaitoriani.

English: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.
Masaai: Neirorie Hesekia aitagol lelo Lawi apa ooitodolutua enkarriyiano te nkisiayiare o Laitoriani. Neinos iltung'ana ina daa o sirua nkolong'i naapishana. Neitayu ilasarri leseriani, neisho enashe Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye.

English: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
Masaai: Neitoki eumata pooki aaning'okino tenebo pee eibung osirua nkulie olong'i naapishana. Neaku eibung'a ninche nkulie olong'i naapishana, te nchipai.

English: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
Masaai: Amu eishoo apa Hesekia, ilo aiguanani le Yuda eumata ilmong'i enkalifu nabo, o nkerra nkalifuni naapishana tenkaraki olasar. Ore ilkituaak neisho ina umata ilmong'i enkalifu nabo o nkerra nkalifuni tomon. Ore ilapolosak neitisiny ate te nkumoi oleng.

English: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
Masaai: Ore ina umata pooki e Yuda, oina umata pooki naing'uaa enkop e Israel, o lelo oomanya Yuda, neshipayu.

English: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neaku sapuk oleng enchipai te Yerusalem, amu ore ebaiki enkata e Solomon olayioni le Daudi olaiguanani le Israel, eitu aekata etumi entoki naaijo ena te Yerusalem.

English: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.
Masaai: Neinyototo ilapolosak o Lawi aamayian olorere, nening'i oltoilo lenye, nelotu enkomono enye ine wueji enye sinyati te keper.

English: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
Masaai: Ore apa pee eidipayu nena pooki, ore lelo Siraeli pooki apa ootii ine, neipang aapuo nkanas e Yuda nebel aaitaa mbelibelat ing'apeta neuroki Asherim enkop, nesulaa iwuejitin neeika, o lperereni loo lasarri te Yuda pooki, o te Benchamen, o te Efraim o te Manase, ometaba anaa neidaikie pooki. Neitoki iltung'ana pooki le Israel aarrinyo aapuo nkanas enye, nelo ake oltung'ani ewueji enye.

English: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.
Masaai: Negelu Hesekia ntukusi oo lapolosak o noo Lawi. Entukus ake o enkae tukus, negelu ake entukus te risioroto esiaai enye, ilapolosak o Lawi tenkaraki ilasarri oopejori o lasarri le seriani. Pee eisiaaisho too nchomito oo lng'oborri lo Laitoriani neishooyo enashe o enkisisa.

English: He appointed also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa enkishorunoto o laiguanani naing'uaa imasaa enyena makewan, naa tenkaraki ilasarri oopejori. Ilasarri oopejori le tadekenya o le nteipa. O lasarri oopejori le sabato, o lapaitin ng'ejuko, o siruai oogeluno, anaa enaigeroki tiatua enkitanapata o Laitoriani.

English: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.
Masaai: Neitanap ninye lelo tung'ana apa oomanya Yerusalem, pee eishooyo erubata oo lapolosak o Lawi, pee etum ninche aaishoo ate enkitanapata o Laitoriani.

English: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
Masaai: Ore ake ina kata pee eitubulari ina kitanapata, neishooyo iltung'ana le Israel te nkumoi, ilng'anayio lenye le dukuya le ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata, o enaisho oo lotorok o ntokitin pooki naanotoki te nkurma. Neyau ninche te leng'on erubata e tomon e pooki toki.

English: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Israel o le Yuda ootii nkanas e Yuda neyau sii ninche erubata e tomon oo nkishu o nkerra, o ntokitin apa naaitisinyaki neiteng'elakini Olaitoriani Enkai enye, neirragieki ninche aasot too lturrurri.

English: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
Masaai: Ore to lapa liokuni neiteru ninche aaiturrur lelo sotot neidip to lapa liopishana.

English: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elotu Hesekia o lkituaak aadol lelo sotot, neisis Olaitoriani nemayian iltung'ana lenyena le Israel.

English: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
Masaai: Neikilikuanishore Hesekia ilapolosak o Lawi tenkaraki lelo sotot.

English: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye Asaria ilo apolosani kitok le nkaji e Sadok, nejoki, “Ore anaa neiteru ninche aayau nkishorot atua enkaji o Laitoriani kitadaate iyiook, nikiraposho nikileku nkumok. Amu etamayiana Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, neaku kinoto iyiook ele shumati pooki otelekua.”

English: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them,
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia aitanap ninche meitobira ilgilat tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, neitobir ninche.

English: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.
Masaai: Neyau ninche nena kishorot, o ematua e tomon, o nena tokitin naaitisinyaki. Ore olaitasheikinoni kitok naa Konania olayioni le Lawi, tenebo Shimei olalashe lenye, aa ninye oliare.

English: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.
Masaai: Naa Yehiel apa, o Asasia, o Natan, o Asahel, o Yerimot, o Yosabad, o Elieli, o Ismakia, o Mahat, o Benaia, ninche ilaitasheikinok ooretu Konania o Shimei olalashe lenye. Ninche etegelua olaiguanani Hesekia o Asaria ilo kitok oitasheiki enkaji e Nkai.

English: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.
Masaai: Naa Kore olayioni le Imna, le Lawi, ninye olarriponi le nkishomi enkalo oloo saen, ninye oitasheiki nkishorot o lpela naaishori Enkai. Pee eiteng'el nkishorot naaiteng'elakaki Olaitoriani o nena kishorot naasinya oleng.

English: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:
Masaai: Naa Eden, o Miniamin, o Yoshua ninche apa ootonyuaa aaretu ninche te nena anas oo lapolosak, pee eorioriki ilalashera lenye irubat enye, ilbotoro o looti, aaitorisioki, too ntukusi.

English: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;
Masaai: Meteleku ake lelo ooigeroki anaa ilmareita, ilewa ebaiki ilarin okuni neilep. Lelo pooki oojing'u atua enkaji o Laitoriani, anaa enayieuni te pooki olong, te nkisiayiare enye terisioroto oo siaaitin enye, too lturrurri lenye.

English: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
Masaai: Ore apa enkigeroto oo lapolosak naa te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye. Aa taa Ilawi ooitabaya ilarin tikitam o imiet neilep naa te risioroto oo siaaitin enye too lturrurri lenye.

English: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
Masaai: Ore apa ilapolosak neigeroki tenebo nkera enye pooki, o nkituaak enye o layiok lenye, o ntoyie enye, o eumata pooki. Amu keisiligayu apa ninche egolie ate aaitaa sinyat.

English: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Aron, lelo apolosak, lelo apa ootii enkop namanya pooki ng'ae, o nkanas enye netii iltung'ana ootii atua kulie anas ootegelakaki too nkarn, pee eoriki irubat pooki lee tiatua ilapolosak, o pooki tung'ani tiatua Ilawi apa ooigeroki enkarna enye.

English: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.
Masaai: Neas Hesekia ina tiatua Yuda pooki, neas ninye mbaa sidain naaishiaakino te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
Masaai: Ore pooki siaai nataasa ninye te nkisiayiare e nkaji e Nkai, o te risioroto e nkitanapata eing'orua Enkai enye, neas ninye ina to ltau lenye pooki. Nebul ninye.

English: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie kuna baa o kuna kiaasin, e nkisiligata, nelotu Senakerib arasaki Yuda neun ilng'oborri aipirakinye nena anas naasheta isunta, eji ejo ninye tenaa keisulie.

English: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Hesekia ajo eewuo Senakerib, neyieu ninye niarare Yerusalem,

English: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.
Masaai: neitobir tenebo ilkituaak lenyena o ltung'ana lenyena magil, pee eibooyo enkare e nena shorroi naatii auluo enkanasa. Neret ninche ninye.

English: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?
Masaai: Neiturruro olorere kitok, neibooyo nkonyek oo nkariak pooki o erata apa naaruko teina kop, ejo, “Kainyoo pee epuonu ilaiguanak le Asiria aatum enkare sapuk?”

English: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.
Masaai: Neasisho ninye etumuta nabo, neshet ninye nena sunta apa naaturori, nepik iltaleta shumata enye. Ore tioriong ninye neshetu enkae suntai. Neitagol sii Milo teina anasa e Daudi. Eitobira sii apa imasaa o larrabal o long'oi te nkumoi.

English: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,
Masaai: Nepik ninye iltung'ana abori ilarikok le njore teina anasa. Neiturrurroki ninche kewan to lkurroto te mbata e kishomi, neirorie ninche aitagol ejo,

English: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:
Masaai: “Entagoluoto. Emiureishoyu nimileporiri te dukuya olaiguanani le Asiria oina jore pooki natii tenebo ninye. Amu etii obo kitok tenebo iyiook olang ninye.

English: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
Masaai: Ore tenebo ninye naa enjore oo ltung'ana lo sesen kake ore tialo iyiook netii Olaitoriani Enkai ang, pee eretu iyiook nearisho too larrabali lang.” Negolu iltung'ana oishua te lelo rorei le Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ena, neirriu Senakerib, olaiguanani le Asiria ilo apa otang'adua Lakish aman, tenebo enjore enye pooki, isinkan lenyena meetu Yerusalem enetii olaiguanani Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda o ltung'ana. Oltung'ana pooki le Yuda apa ootii Yerusalem ejo,

English: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?
Masaai: “Nji ejo Senakerib olaiguanani le Asiria, ‘Ainyoo intae isiligitata, eji pee intasheshe intae itang'adutua aairin Yerusalem?

English: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
Masaai: Keitu eitapong'oo intae Hesekia pee eisho intae entuata to lameyu o te nkure, ejoki intae, “Kekordu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang te nkaina o laiguanani le Asiria?”

English: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?
Masaai: Keitu ninye eiwang'ie Hesekia iwuejitin o lperereni loo lasarri neitanap Yuda o Yerusalem ejo, “To lperere obo lo lasar intae enteserem naa te nchumata enye intae entayutu ilasarri?”

English: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo intae enaitaasa nanu o loo papa iltung'ana le kulie kuapi? Keidim apa nkaitin e lelo oreren aatokordu iloshon lenye te nkaina ai?

English: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?
Masaai: Kake kaa tiatua nkaitin pooki e lelo oshon apa ooidaikie papa lai tukul naidima atokordu iltung'ana lenyena te nkaina ai, eji metaa keidim Enkai inyi atokordu intae te nkaina ai?

English: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?
Masaai: Ore naa taata emincho Hesekia meitapong'oi intae anaa elej intae, tena pukunoto enye, nimining'ining'i intae ninye. Amu meetae enkai e ae kop anaa enkitoria naidima atokordu iltung'ana lenyena te nkaina ai, anaa te nkaina oo loo papa. Kebaa naa meidim Enkai inyi atokordu intae te nkaina ai!’ ”

English: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.
Masaai: Neiro lelo sinkan lenyena mbaa kumok naaipirta Olaitoriani Enkai o sinka lenye Hesekia.

English: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.
Masaai: Neiger ninye mpala amor Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli neiro asukeny ninye ejo, “Anaa nkaitin oo loshon neitu eidim aatokordu iltung'ana lenye too nkaik aainei, neijia etiu Enkai e Hesekia, mekordu ninye iltung'ana te nkaina ai.”

English: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
Masaai: Nebuaku ninche aajo neijia te nkutuk e Yuda, aaitoning iltung'ana le Yerusalem apa ootii esuntai, ejo pee eiture neitashal, ejo pee etum aawaita enkanasa.

English: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.
Masaai: Neiro ninche aaimaki Enkai e Yerusalem, anaa enaimaki nkaitin oo loreren le nkop, naa esiaai oo nkaik oo ltung'ana.

English: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.
Masaai: Neomon Hesekia olaiguanani o Isaya oloiboni le Nkai, olayioni le Amos tenkaraki ena, neishiraki ninche keper.

English: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.
Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani olmalaika otara metuata lelo morran pooki magil, o larikok le njore o lkituaak loo lng'oborri lo laiguanani le Asiria. Neaku etorrinye ninye te nkurruna e nkomom enye alo enkop enye makewan. Ore pee elotu atua enkaji e nkai enye, near kulikae ayiok lenyena ninye metua.

English: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.
Masaai: Neitajeu Olaitoriani Hesekia, o lelo oomanya Yerusalem te nkaina e Senakerib, olaiguanani le Asiria, o te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena pooki. Neisho ninche enkiyeng'iyeng te pooki shoto.

English: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
Masaai: Neyau ilkumok nkishorot aaisho Olaitoriani te Yerusalem, neisho ntokitin e tipat Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, neaku keyanyiti ninye too loshon pooki, ebaiki ina kata neito idia alo.

English: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i nemuoyu Hesekia neaku keye, neomon ninye Olaitoriani, newal Olaitoriani enkomono enye, neisho ninye olmonekie.

English: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake eitu eishoru Hesekia olerrinyore te risioroto eina supatisho naitaasaki ninye, amu etawuase to ltau lenye. Neaku eewuo engoro napi shumata ninye o Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.
Masaai: Kake eitoborro Hesekia kewan teilo wuasa lo ltau lenye, ninye o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neaku eitu eitoki engoro napi o Laitoriani alotu shumata ninche too nkolong'i pooki e Hesekia.

English: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;
Masaai: Neeta apa Hesekia enkarsisisho sapuk o enkanyit, neitobiraki kewan ilchumat le nkosholai o le sahabu, o soito oogol enkinyang'a, o sonkoyoni, o long'oi o masaa pooki naagol enkinyang'a.

English: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.
Masaai: Etesheta sii apa nkajijik naashumishoreki tenkaraki entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata, o laleta tenkaraki mpukunot pooki oo nkishu, o muatat oo nkerra.

English: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.
Masaai: Neitobiraki sii kewan nkanas, o luaat oo nkerra, o nkishu kumok, amu eishoo apa Olaitoriani ninye imasaa kumok.

English: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.
Masaai: Eikeno sii apa Hesekia iwuejitin oo nkariak e shumata oo nkariak e Gishon, neboinaa ninche aipirie enkalo o loontoluo le nkanasa e Daudi. Nebul Hesekia too siaaitin pooki.

English: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
Masaai: Ore tialo ilbalusini le Babilon o lkituaak le Babilon, apa ooirriwakaki ninye meikilikuanishore tenkaraki ilo monekie otaasaki te nkop, nepalaa Enkai ninye, pee etum atetema ninye neyiolou nena pooki naatii oltau lenye.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Hesekia, o nkiaasin enyena sidain, ng'ura eigeroki te nduaata e Isaya ole Amos, ilo oiboni le Nkai, te mbuku oo laiguanak le Yuda o Israel.

English: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neirura Hesekia etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukari ninye te wueji neika oo nkuraren oo layiok le Daudi. Ore Yuda pooki o lelo oomanya Yerusalem neisho ninye enkanyit te keeya enye. Neitoreisho olayioni lenye Manase te rishata enye.

English: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:
Masaai: Oloo larin tomon oare apa Manase pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin onom o imiet te Yerusalem.

English: But did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena baa olminong loo loreren apa ooiwuang'ie Enkai te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.

English: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
Masaai: Amu enyaaka ninye ashet iwuejitin neeika apa neetigila papaai lenye Hesekia auroo. Neshetaki Baal ilperereni loo lasarri, neitobir Ashera, neserem olorora pooki le shumata, neisiaai ninche.

English: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
Masaai: Neshetu ilperereni loo lasarri tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, laa ninche apa etejo Olaitoriani “Atua Yerusalem etonie enkarna ai ntarasi.”

English: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neshetu ninye ilperereni loo lasarri tenkaraki olorora le shumata too lgorieti pokira oare le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
Masaai: Nepejoo ilayiok lenyena anaa olasar to erata loo layiok le Hinom. Neas ninye mbaa oo nkitumusumusot, neas ne naibon, o esakutore neton tenebo iloo ntaleng'o o lkuyantik. Etaasa ninye entorroni sapuk te dukuya Olaitoriani, neitagor ninye.

English: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
Masaai: Ore ina kitanyaanyukoto e nkai naitobira ninye nepik atua enkaji e Nkai, naa ninye apa etiaka Enkai Daudi o Solomon olayioni lenye, “Ore tiatua ena aji, o te Yerusalem, naa ninye ategelua too loshon pooki le Israel, kapik enkarna ai ntarasi.

English: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Nemaigil nanu aiwuang'ie enkeju e Israel teina kop apa nategelaka loo papaai linono teneing'or ninche aaibung nena pooki naitanapa ninche, o nkitanapat pooki, o nkikoot o nkiguanat apa naaishoruaki aaimunye Musa.”

English: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.
Masaai: Eteleja Manase Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o metaasa ntorrok aaitulus te lelo oshon apa ooidaikie Olaitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.
Masaai: Eirorie apa Olaitoriani aikok Manase o ltung'ana lenyena, kake eitu ninche ening.

English: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eyaka ninche Olaitoriani ilarikok le njore e Asiria, lelo ooibung'a Manase too lala oololo neen ninye too lpisia lo suyai, nenap ninche aaya Babilon.

English: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,
Masaai: Ore etii ninye atua osina, neomonu omom to Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitobir kewan oleng, te dukuya Enkai oo loo menye.

English: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.
Masaai: Neomon ninye, neng'amaa Enkai esayiata enye, o enkomono enye, neitoki Enkai arrinyoki ninye enkitoria enye tiatua Yerusalem. Neyiolou taa Manase ajo Olaitoriani ninye Enkai.

English: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina neshet esuntai e oriong e nkanasa e Daudi te nkalo oloo ntoluo le Gishon, to erata, tembata e wueji nejing'ieki enkishomi e dukuya, nelo aitamanaa te Ofel. Neilepie aitoodor oleng. Etipika sii ilarikok le njore nkanas pooki naasheta isunta e Yuda.

English: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie ninye nena aitin oo loreren, o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin aitung'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani, o lelo pereren loo lasarri apa ootesheta to ldoinyio le nkaji o Laitoriani o te Yerusalem, nenang'aki ninche auluo enkanasa.

English: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Neshuku sii apa olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, neitayu te nchumata enye ilasarri le seriani o lasarri le nashe. Neitanap ninye Yuda meisiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia neton ake eitayu iltung'ana ilasarri too wuejitin o neeika, kake Olaitoriani Enkai enye ake eitaiki.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Manase, o enkomono enye e Nkai enye, o rorei le lelo aduaak apa oirorie ninye te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai e Israel, etii atua ntepen oo laiguanak le Israel.

English: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.
Masaai: Ore ina omono enye, oina natang'amayie Enkai esayiata enye, o ng'ok enyena pooki, o enkisiligata enye, o wuejitin apa neeteshetie ilperereni loo lasarri, o eneitasheyie Asherim, o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, enapa kata eitu eitobor kewan, ng'ura eigeroki too ntepen oo laduaak.

English: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Neaku eirure Manase etua anaa apa loo menye, nenukaa ninche ninye tiatua enkaji enye; neitoreisho Amon olayioni lenye te rishata enye.

English: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o are apa Amon pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin oare te Yerusalem.

English: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninye ntorrok te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa apa enataasa papaai lenye Manase. Etopolosaka apa Amon nkitanyaanyukot pooki oo nkaitin naaitobira papaai lenye Manase, neisiaai ninche.

English: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.
Masaai: Neitu ninye eitobor kewan te dukuya Olaitoriani, anaa apa enaitoborro papaai lenye Manase kewan, kake etoponayie Amon aas entorroni oleng.

English: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
Masaai: Nerresh ilaisiaayiak lenyena ninye near metua tiatua aji.

English: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
Masaai: Kake etara iltung'ana leina kop metuata lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootarresho olaiguanani Amon; ore iltung'ana leina kop neitaa Yosia olayioni lenye olaiguanani te rishata enye.

English: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.
Masaai: Oloo larin isiet apa Yosia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomoni uni oobo te Yerusalem.

English: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye mbaa sidain too nkonyek o Laitoriani, neibung orrekie le Daudi papaai lenye, neitu eibelekenya alo enkalo e tatene anaa ene kedienye.

English: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.
Masaai: Amu ore to lari le isiet le nkitoria enye, eton aa oti, neiteru aing'oru Enkai e Daudi papaai lenye; ore to lari le tomon oare neiteru aituku Yuda o Yerusalem, aiwuang'ie iwuejitin neeika, o Asherim, nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuno o naatosholuaki.

English: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.
Masaai: Negil ninche ilperereni loo lasarri le Baal eitasheiki ninye. Neuroo ilperereni loo lasarri le nkorropil apa ootii shumata ninche. Nebel asherim aitaa mbelibelat, o nena kitanyaanyukot naaguetuno o naasholuno. Neitaa empunyua neisuaaki nkuraren e lelo apa ooitayu ilasarri too nchumat enye.

English: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Etapejoyie sii apa iloik le lelo apolosak too nchumat e lelo pereren lenye, neituku Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
Masaai: Ore tiatua nkanas e Manase o Efraim, o Simion o metabaiki Naftali, te nkidaata enye too nkaloli pooki,

English: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: eturoyie ninye ilperereni loo lasarri, neidong Asherim, o nkitanyaanyukot aitaa empunyua, nesulaki enkop ilperereni pooki le nkorropil te nkop e Israel pooki. Neitoki ninye arrinyo alo Yerusalem.

English: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.
Masaai: Ore apa to lari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria enye, eidipa aipoo ina kop o enkaji e Nkai, neirriwaki Shafan olayioni le Asalia olkilikuai, o Mesai ilo balusui le nkanasa o Yoa olayioni le Yoahas, ilo aigeroni, pee etum aaitobira enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche enetii Hilkia olapolosani kitok, neisho nena pisai apa naayawuaki enkaji e Nkai, apa naatasotutuo Ilawi, ebaiki Manase o Efraim o metabaiki ilo pisiai pooki le Israel o Yuda pooki, o Benchamen, o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:
Masaai: Neisho ninche lelo aisiaayiak apa ooitasheiki enkaji o Laitoriani. Ore lelo aisiaayiak apa oasisho tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani; neishooyo te nkaraki eramata o enkitobirata eina aji.

English: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.
Masaai: Neisho ninche ilaguetak loo nkeek, o lashetak, pee einyiang'u isoito, o nkeek, o loom, tenkaraki ina shetare apa naishoo ilaiguanak le Yuda erruoyo.

English: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.
Masaai: Neas iltung'ana esiaai aaitobiraki. Ore apa oloitasheiki ninche naa Yohat o Obadia loo Lawi, loo layiok le Merari naa Sakaria o Meshulam, too layiok le Kohat. Naa Ilawi pooki, naa arriyiak too nkinantani o sinkolio.

English: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
Masaai: Ninche apa ooitasheiki ilanapak loo lolan, neutaa pooki oas pooki pukunoto e nkisiaayiare. Ore ilkulikae Lawi naa ilasirak, o lkituaak, o larripok le kishomi.

English: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.
Masaai: Ore eitayu ninche nena pisai apa naayawuaki atua enkaji o Laitoriani, netum Hilkia olapolosani embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani apa naaishoruaki aaimunye Musa.

English: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
Masaai: Nejoki Hilkia Shafan olaigeroni, “Anoto nanu embuku oo nkitanapat tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.” Neisho Hilkia ina buku Shafan.

English: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.
