Masaai: Neyaki Shafan ina buku olaiguanani, neitoki aliki olaiguanani ajoki, “Ore nena pooki naaitanapaki isinkan linono, easita ninche.

English: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.
Masaai: Eishutua ninche nena pisai apa naanotoki te nkaji o Laitoriani, netipika ninche nkaik o laigerok o laitasheikinok.”

English: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
Masaai: Neitoki Shafan olaigeroni ajoki olaiguanani “Aishoo nanu Hilkia olapolosani embuku.” Neisumaki Shafan olaiguanani.

English: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani irorei loo nkitanapat nepolos nkilani enyena.

English: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Hilkia o Ahikam olayioni le Shafan, o Abdon olayioni le Mika, o Shafan olaigeroni, o Asaia ilo aisiaayiani lo laiguanani nejoki,

English: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.
Masaai: “Enchom enkilikuanishore Olaitoriani tenkaraki nanu, o tenkaraki lelo ootelekutua te Israel, o te Yuda, tialo kulo rorei lena buku nanotoki. Amu eikitok engoro napi o Laitoriani natubukokoki shumata iyiook, enkaraki apa neitu eibung loo papa irorei lo Laitoriani, neas te risioroto e kuna pooki naaigeroki tena buku.”

English: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.
Masaai: Nelo Hilkia o lelo pooki ooirriwayie olaiguanani enetii enkoiboni naji Hilda. Naa enkitok apa e Shalum olayioni le Takat, olayioni le Hasra, ilo aing'urani lo sanduku. (naa Yerusalem apa namanya ninye) neirorie ninche ninye aaikilikuanishore.

English: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ‘Tiaaki ilo tung'ani likirriua enatii nanu,

English: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ene wueji, o shumata lelo oomanya o lelo deketa pooki ooigero teina buku naisumakaki olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naatanyaita ninche nanu, netapejokitio enkorropil kulie aitin, pee aatum ninche aaitagoro nanu te siaai oo nkaik enye, kebukokini naa engoro ai napi shumata ene wueji nemeibooroyu ina goro ai.

English: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;
Masaai: Kake ore tialo ilo aiguanani le Yuda oirriwua intae pee ipuonunu aaikilikuanishore Olaitoriani, nji enchom entiaaki ninye, Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo Siraeli: Ore tialo lelo rorei litoning'o,

English: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.
Masaai: enkaraki nairridua oltau lino nintoborro kewan te dukuya Enkai, ina kata pee ining irorei lenyena ooipirta ene wueji o lelo oomanya, nintoborro iyie kewan tialo nanu, nitopolosa iyie nkilani inono ninchir te dukuya nanu, aatoning'o sii nanu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaaiturrurroki nanu iyie loo papaai lino, nikipiki iyie engumoto te seriani, nemedol nkonyek inono ina torroni nayau nanu shumata ene wueji, o lelo oomanya.’ ” Neyaki ninche olaiguanani olkilikuai.

English: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani airriwaa ilkiliku neiturrur ilpayiani pooki le Yuda o le Yerusalem.

English: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Neilep olaiguanani alo enkaji o Laitoriani, tenebo iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o lapolosak o Lawi, o ltung'ana pooki kituaak o looti. Neisum ninye ening'ito pooki irorei pooki leina buku o sotua apa nanotoki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.
Masaai: Neitashe olaiguanani te wueji enye neitobir olning'o, te dukuya Olaitoriani pee elo ninye asuj Olaitoriani o nkitanapat enyena o enchakenisho enye, o nkiguanat enyena, to ltau lenye pooki o te nkishui enye pooki. Pee eas lelo rorei lo lning'o ooigero teina buku.

English: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.
Masaai: Neisho ninye lelo pooki apa ootii Yerusalem o Benchamen meitasho aaibung ina. Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem neas te risioroto o sotua le Nkai ina Ai oo loo menye.

English: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. And all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ie Yosia ilo minong pooki otii enkop oo Siraeli, neisho lelo pooki ootii atua Israel meisiaayia Olaitoriani Enkai enye. Ore too nkolong'i enyena pooki neitu ninche eibelekenya te sujata o Laitoriani Enkai oo loo menye.

English: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
Masaai: Eibung'a apa Yosia osirua lo Laitoriani le pasaka te Yerusalem. Neyieng ninche olkuoo le pasaka te nkolong e tomon oong'uan o lapa le dukuya.

English: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Etegelua apa ninye ilapolosak tenkaraki enkisiaayiare neitagol ninche te nkisiaayiare e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye Ilawi pooki laa ninche apa ooiteng'en iltung'ana loo Siraeli, naa sinyat ninche to Laitoriani, “Entipik ilo sanduku sinyati atua ina aji apa natesheta Solomon olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani le Israel. Meeta tipat pee intokiki aanap too loilila linyi. Esiayia naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai inyi o ltung'ana lenyena le Israel.

English: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.
Masaai: Entobira ate te risioroto oo lmareita linyi, o lgilat linyi, nisujaa orrekie le Daudi olaiguanani loo Siraeli o rrekie le Solomon olayioni lenye.

English: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.
Masaai: Nintasheshe teine wueji sinyati te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo papaai linyi, o noo lalashera linyi. Naa nchoo ake metaa keeta pooki tung'ani erubata e nkaji e menye tiatua Ilawi.

English: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
Masaai: Niyieng'iyieng'e olkuoo le ker lo sirua le pasaka, nintisinyinyi ate. Nintobiriri ilalashera linyi pee easisho te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani oimunyeki Musa.

English: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.
Masaai: Neisho Yosia lelo apa tung'ana leme lapolosak, pooki ootii ine, ilkuoo le kerra o le kineji le luaata enye oobaya nkalifuni tomoni uni, o loing'ok nkalifuni uni. Ore kuna pooki naa imasaa o laiguanani eing'uaa.

English: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak lenyena neitayu nkishorot te nyorrata aaisho iltung'ana, o lapolosak, o Lawi. Ore Hilkia, o Sakaria o Yehiel lelo kituaak le nkaji e Nkai, neisho ilapolosak to sirua le pasaka anaa nkishorot oo lkuo le kerra, nkalifuni are o iip ile eshula o lkuoo le kineji. O loing'ok iip uni.

English: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.
Masaai: Ore sii Konania, o Shemaia, o Natanel o lalashera lenyena, o Hashanbia o Yeiel o Yosabad, lelo kituaak loo Lawi, neisho nkishorot e pasaka ilkuoo le kerra o le kineji nkalifuni imiet o loing'ok iip imiet.

English: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.
Masaai: Ore eidipaki aaitobira ilo sirua, neitashe ilapolosak te wueji enye, neitashe ilawi too ntukusi enye, te risioroto enkitanapata o laiguanani.

English: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.
Masaai: Neyieng ninche olkuoo le pasaka neisuaaya ilapolosak ilo sarge otang'amutua too Lawi, ore Ilawi neibung ina nateyieng'aki aapolos.

English: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.
Masaai: Neiteng'el ninche ilasarri oopejori pee etumi aatooriki iltung'ana terisioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, pee eishori Olaitoriani, anaa enaigeroki te mbuku e Musa. Neiko ninche neijia lelo oing'ok.

English: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.
Masaai: Nepej ninche nkiri eilo kuo le pasaka te nkima terisioroto oo nkoon. Neyier lelo asarri oosinya too motio o too ng'irran, o too saanini dapashi, nenap ninche nabo kata aayaki olorere.

English: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi ina neitobiraki iltung'ana ate endaa, o lapolosak amu ore apa lelo apolosak ayiok le Aron netanyamala, eitayu ilasarri oopejori, o nkiri naapir, o metaa kewarie. Neaku eitobirakita ate Ilawi o lapolosak lelo ayiok le Aron endaa.

English: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.
Masaai: Ore apa ilaranyak lelo ayiok, le Asaf netii ewueji enye, terisioroto enkitanapata e Daudi o Asaf, o Heman, o Yedutum ilo aduaani lo laiguanani. Ore ilarripok le kishomi netii kishomi. Meeta apa ninche tipat naing'uarie esiaai enye amu ore ilalashera lenye, loo lawi neitobirakita ninche endaa.

English: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.
Masaai: Neaku eitobiraki apa esiaai pooki o Laitoriani ina olong, pee eibung'i pasaka neitayuni olasar opejori, tenchumata olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani, terisioroto enkitanapata o laiguanani Yosia.

English: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana le Israel ootii ine, neibung osirua le pasaka teina kata. Neibung osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuijieki nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eitu aekata etumi pasaka nanyaayukie ena te Israel ebaiki nkolong'i e Samuel oloiboni le Nkai. Meetae too laiguanak le Israel oloibung'a pasaka anaa enaibung'a Yosia, o ilapolosak o Lawi, o Yuda pooki o Siraeli ootii ine, o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.
Masaai: Ore to lari le isiet le nkitoria e Yosia neibung'aki ena pasaka.

English: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Charchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie kuna pooki eidipa Yosia aitobira enkaji e Nkai, nelo Neko olaiguanani le Misiri aarare Karkemish te Frati, nelo Yoash agilunore ninye.

English: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.
Masaai: Kake eirriwaka ninye ilkiliku, ejoki, “Kainyoo iyiook kiporokino o iyie, olaiguanani le Yuda? Maatakinore nanu iyie ena olong, kake ina aji naatayie olarrabal ninye agilunore, naaitanapa nanu Enkai pee aisarrisar. Mintoki naa akeshare Enkai naa ninye natii tenebo nanu pee mikindaikie ake.”

English: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia eitu eibelekenya Yosia alo aing'uaa, kake etonyuaa ajo aarare. Eitu ninye ening irorei le Neko, ooing'uaa enkutuk Enkai, kake etijing'a ninye olarrabal tiong'ata e Megido.

English: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
Masaai: Neng'or ilang'orok loo mbaa olaiguanani Yosia, nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, “Ewuang'ieki nanu tene, amu aatipikaki olbae torrono.”

English: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.
Masaai: Neaku eitayutuo isinkan lenyena ninye te ngarri oo mbartan nenap ninche tenkae garri oo mbartan, neyau ninye Yerusalem. Neye ninye, nenukari ninye too nkuraren oo loo menye. Ore Yuda pooki o Yerusalem neishiraki Yosia.

English: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.
Masaai: Eishiraka sii apa Yeremia Yosia, ore ilewa pooki o nkituaak pooki aranyak neranyu aalimu Yosia o metabaiki ena olong. Neitobir ninche enkitanapata te Israel, ng'ura eigero te mbuku oo nkishirat.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the LORD,
Masaai: Ore nkulie kiaasin e Yosia, o nkiaasin enyena sidain te risioroto e nena naaigeroki too nkitanapat o Laitoriani,

English: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
Masaai: o nkiaasin enyena e dukuya o kulie e siadi, ng'ura eigeroki ninche te mbuku oo laiguanak le Israel o le Yuda.

English: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ewaita iltung'ana leina kop Yoahas olayioni le Yosia neitaa ninye olaiguanani terishata e papaai lenye te Yerusalem.

English: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam ookuni apa Yoahas pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilapaitin okuni te Yerusalem.

English: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani le Misiri aaraa ninye te Yerusalem, nepikaki iltung'ana leina kop kodi e talanta iip nabo e nkosholai o talanta e sahabu.

English: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.
Masaai: Neitaa olaiguanani le Misiri Eliakim olalashe lenye olaiguanani te Yuda o te Yerusalem, neibelekeny enkarna enye ajo Yehoiakim. Kake eewa Neko olalashe lenye Yoahas Misiri.

English: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam o imiet apa Yehoiakim pee eiteru aitoreisho neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem. Neas ninye ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
Masaai: Nelotu Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon agilunore ninye, neen ninye too lpisia neya ninye Babilon.

English: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.
Masaai: Etanapa sii apa Nebukadnesa aya kulie tokitin e nkaji o Laitoriani Babilon, nepik ninche atua enkaji e nkitoo o laiguanani te Babilon.

English: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore apa nkulie kiaasin e Yehoiakim o nena tokitin o ilo minong otaasa ninye, o mbaa torrok naaipirta ninye, ng'ura eigeroki tiatua embuku oo laiguanak le Israel o le Yuda. Neitoreisho Yehoiakin olayioni lenye terishata enye.

English: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.
Masaai: Oloo larin isiet apa Yehoiakin pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ilapaitin okuni o nkolong'i tomon te Yerusalem. Neas ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani.

English: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore to lapa lo loirujuruj leilo ari, neirriu olaiguanani Nebukadnesa olkilikuai meyauni ninye Babilon, tenebo nena tokitin e tipat apa naati atua enkaji o Laitoriani neitaa olalashe lenye Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Oloo larin tikitam oobo apa Sedekia pee eiteru aitoreisho, neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem.

English: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD.
Masaai: Etaasa ninye mbaa torrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai enye. Eitu ninye eitobor kewan te dukuya Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai, oiroro apa alimu ilomon lo Laitoriani.

English: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Eisero apa Sedekia apaashare olaiguanani Nebukadnesa, laa ninye apa oishoo ninye meinosa olmumai tialo Enkai; negolong'u ninye neitagol oltau lenye, neany eibelekenyakino Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel.

English: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak pooki kituaak, oltung'ana sii neponari aaku ilemeisiligayu, nesuj olminong le lelo oshon; neisarkionie enkaji o Laitoriani, apa naitisinya ninye te Yerusalem.

English: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani Enkai oo loo menye, neirriwaki ninche ilkiliku aimunye isinkan lenyena, enkaraki naing'urrie ninye iltung'ana lenyena, o tenkaraki emanyisho enye.

English: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.
Masaai: Kake etigirate ninche aamor lelo sinkan le Nkai, nemenaa irorei lenyena, nesurdaay iloibonok le Nkai, o metaba anaa nedumunye engoro o Laitoriani too iltung'ana lenyena, ometaba anaa neaku meetae olmairo.

English: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neyau aitaar ninche olaiguanani loo Lkaldayo ilo apa otasesekuana ilbarnot lenye metuata tiatua enkaji e Nkai, nemeetayie olng'ur olbarnoti anaa esila, anaa oltung'ani kitok aashu oltung'ani moruo. Neishooyo ninche apik atua enkaina enye.

English: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore nena masaa pooki e nkaji e Nkai nkutiti o sapuki, o lchumat pooki le nkaji o Laitoriani o lchumat lo laiguanani o lkituaak lenyena, neyai nena pooki Babilon.

English: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninche enkaji e Nkai neuroo esuntai e Yerusalem, nepejoo nkajijik enyena pooki e nkitoo te nkima. Neinyal nena tokitin pooki e tipat.

English: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:
Masaai: Eewa ninye eyararoto meshomo Babilon lelo apa ooilanya olalem, neaku isinkan lenyena, o metaba anaa neitasheyieki enkitoria e Parsia.

English: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.
Masaai: Pee eitabari ororei lo Laitoriani oimua enkutuk e Yeremia, o metaba anaa neshipakino enkop sabato. Ore te nena olong'i pooki naitomijoonoki, neibung sabato neitabaya ilarin ntomoni naapishana.

English: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
Masaai: Ore apa to lari le dukuya le nkitoria olaiguanani Sairos le Parsia, pee etumi aaitabai ororei lo Laitoriani oimunyeki enkutuk e Yeremia, neputu Olaitoriani oltau le Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, neaku etolimuo aibalunye te nkitoria enye pooki, neiger sii ajo,

English: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, ‘Ore Olaitoriani Enkai e keper, naaisho nanu nkitoriat pooki enkop, naaitanap ninye nanu pee ashetaki ninye enkaji te Yerusalem. Aa taa te Yuda. Ore pooki ng'ae tiatua intae, te kulo tung'ana pooki nchoo eaku Olaitoriani Enkai enye tenebo ninye, nchoo ninye eilep alo.’ ”

English: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le dukuya le nkitoria e Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, pee etumi aaitabai ororei lo Laitoriani te nkutuk e Yeremia, neputu Olaitoriani oltau le Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, pee eibalunye enkitanapata te nkitoria enye pooki, neiger sii aajo,

English: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia; Aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e keper, nkitoriat pooki enkop, naaitanapa ninye nanu pee ashetaki ninye enkaji te Yerusalem, te nkop e Yuda.

English: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae tiatua intae iltung'ana lenyena pooki, metaa Enkai enye tenebo ninye, naa nchoo ninye eilep alo Yerusalem, te nkop e Yuda, nelo ashet enkaji o Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli ninye ilo otii Yerusalem;

English: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa nchoo pooki tung'ani otelekua, te pooki wueji nemanya ninye, eretu ninye iltung'ana le manyisho enye te nkosholai o te sahabu, o too masaa o too ng'uesi, tenebo nena kishorot o lpela tenkaraki ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem.”

English: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nedumunye ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te Yuda o te Benchamen, o lapolosak o Lawi, o pooki ng'ae otuputuo Olaitoriani oltau lenye pee eilep alo ashet ina aji o Laitoriani natii Yerusalem.

English: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki oomanita ninche neretu ninche too masaa e nkosholai, o te sahabu, o too masaa, o too ng'uesi, o too ntokitin naagol enkinyiang'a tenebo nena pooki naaishoruaki to lpela.

English: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;
Masaai: Neyau sii Sairos ilo aiguanani nena masaa enkaji o Laitoriani apa naawa Nebukadnesa te Yerusalem nelo apik atua enkaji oo nkaitin enyena.

English: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
Masaai: Neyau Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia nena pooki eitasheiki Mitrehat ilo ashumani, laa ninye oikenaka ninye pooki Sheshbasa ilo kitok le Yuda.

English: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,
Masaai: Naa ena apa esiana enye: ngirran enkalifu nabo e sahabu, o ngirran enkalifu nabo e nkosholai, nkalema tikitam ooudo,

English: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.
Masaai: ilbakulini tomoni uni le sahabu, o lbakulini nkalifuni are o iip ong'uan le nkosholai, o kulie masaa enkalifu nabo;

English: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: ore imasaa pooki e sahabu o nenkosholai naa nkalifuni imiet o iip ong'uan o ntomoni ile o naaudo. Kuna pooki eyaua Sheshbasa ina kata pee eyauni ilootaarayioki metushukunye aaing'uaa Babilon nepuonu Yerusalem.

English: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo tung'ana leilo kerenket ooetuo te yararoto eing'uaa lelo apa ootarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon arik eenata te Babilon. Etorrinyunye ninche aapuonu Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki tung'ani enkang enye makewan.

English: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mizpar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
Masaai: Eetuo apa ninche tenebo Serubabel, o Yeshua, o Nehemia, o Seraia, o Reelaia, o Mordekai, o Balshan, o Mispar, o Bigfai, o Rehum, o Baana. Ena esiana oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli;

English: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: ore ilayiok le Parosh era esiana enye nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shefatia, nera esiana enye, iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ara, nera esiana enye iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o imiet.

English: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pahatmoab, aa taa ilayiok le Yeshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon oare.

English: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.

English: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Satu naa iip naaudo o artam o imiet.

English: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Sakai, naa iip naapishana o ntomoni ile.

English: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bani naa iip ile o artam o are.

English: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bebai, naa iip ile o tikitam o okuni.

English: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Asgad naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o tikitam oare.

English: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adonikam naa iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.

English: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bigfai naa nkalifuni are o onom o ile.

English: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adin, naa iip ong'uan o onom o ong'uan.

English: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ater, aa taa ile Hesekia, naa ntomoni naaudo o isiet.

English: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Besai naa iip uni o tikitam o okuni.

English: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yora naa, iip nabo o tomon oare.

English: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hashum naa, iip are o tikitam o okuni.

English: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gibar, naa ntomoni naaudo o imiet.

English: The children of Bethlehem, an hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Betlehem naa iip nabo o tikitam o okuni.

English: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Netofia naa onom o ile.

English: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Anatot naa iip nabo o tikitam o isiet.

English: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Asmafet naa artam oare.

English: The children of Kirjath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Kiriataim, Kefira o Beerot naa iip naapishana o artam o okuni.

English: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Rama o Geba, naa iip ile o tikitam o obo.

English: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Mikmas, naa iip nabo o tikitam oare.

English: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai naa iip are o tikitam o okuni.

English: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Nebo, naa onom o are.

English: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Makbish naa iip nabo o onom o ile.

English: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le likae le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.

English: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa iip uni o tikitam.

English: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Lod, o Hadid, o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o imiet.

English: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yeriko, naa iip uni o artam o imiet.

English: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Seena naa nkalifuni uni o iip ile o tomoni uni.

English: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak lelo ayiok le Yedaia, le nkaji e Yeshua naa iip naaudo o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.

English: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Imer naa, enkalifu nabo o onom oare.

English: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pashur, naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o artam oopishana.

English: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa enkalifu nabo o tomon oopishana.

English: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi, lelo ayiok le Yeshua o Kadmiel, loo layiok le Hadafia, naa ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan.

English: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilaranyak: lelo ayiok le Asaf, naa iip nabo o tikitam o isiet.

English: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.
Masaai: Ore lelo ayiok loo larripok loo nchomito; ilayiok le Shalum, o layiok le Ater, o layiok le Talmon o layiok le Akub, o layiok le Hatita, o layiok le Shobai, ore pooki tenebo, naa iip nabo o tomoni uni o oudo.

English: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
Masaai: Ore ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, naa lelo aisiaayiak, o layiok le Siha, o layiok le Hafusa, o layiok le Taabaot,

English: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
Masaai: o layiok le Keros, o layiok le Siaha, o layiok le Padon,

English: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
Masaai: o layiok le Lebana, o layiok le Habaga, o layiok le Akub,

English: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,
Masaai: o layiok le Hagab, o layiok le Shamlai, o layiok le Hanan,

English: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
Masaai: o layiok le Gidel, o layiok le Gahar, o layiok le Reaia,

English: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
Masaai: o layiok le Resin, o layiok le Nekoda, o layiok le Gasam,

English: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
Masaai: o layiok le Usa, o layiok le Pasea, o layiok le Besai,

English: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
Masaai: o layiok le Asna, o layiok le Meumin, o layiok le Nefisim,

English: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
Masaai: o layiok le Bakuk, o layiok le Hakufa, o layiok le Hahur,

English: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
Masaai: o layiok le Baslut, o layiok le Mehida, o layiok le Harsha,

English: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,
Masaai: o layiok le Barkos, o layiok le Sisera, o layiok le Tema,

English: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
Masaai: o layiok le Nesia, o layiok le Hatifa.

English: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,
Masaai: Ore too layiok loo sinkan le Solomon; naa ilayiok le Sotai, o layiok le Hosoferet, o layiok le Peruda,

English: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
Masaai: o layiok le Yaala, o layiok le Darkon, o layiok le Gidel,

English: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.
Masaai: o layiok le Shefatia, o layiok le Hatil, o layiok le Pokeret-hasebaim, tenebo ilayiok le Ami.

English: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
Masaai: Ore ilaisiaayiak pooki le nkaji e Nkai o layiok loo sinkan le Solomon naa iip uni o ntomoni naaudo oare.

English: And these were they which went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:
Masaai: Kulo apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, o Telhasha, o Kerub, o Adan, o Imer, hoo neitu apa ninche eidim aaibalie nkajijik oo loo menye anaa enetii ntipati enye, tenaa keitipat ninche Isirael:

English: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Delaia, o layiok le Tobia, o layiok le Nekoda, nera pooki iip ile o onom oare.

English: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:
Masaai: Ore sii too layiok loo lapolosak, lelo ayiok le Barsilai, laa ninye apa oyama nabo oo ntoyie e Barsilai le Gilead, laa ninye apa eipotieki enkarna enye.

English: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
Masaai: Eing'orutua kulo enkigeroto enye tiatua lelo ooigeroki too iishoritin, kake eitu etumi ninche teine, neaku eiwuang'ieki ninche te mpolosare aajo mesinya;

English: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.
Masaai: etiaaka ninche olbalusui nchere pee meinos ina daa sinyati oleng, meteleku ake tenaa ketii olapolosani oikilikuanishore Urim o Tumim.

English: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
Masaai: Ore apa ina umata pooki tenebo naa nkalifuni artam o are o iip uni o ntomoni ile,

English: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.
Masaai: metii isinkan lenye o nkaisiaayiak enye, laa ore tenebo ninche naa, nkalifuni naapishana o iip uni o tomoni uni oopishana, neeta apa ninche ilaranyak loo lewa o ngoruo iip are.

English: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;
Masaai: Ore mbartan enye naa iip naapishana o tomoni uni o ile, ore inyumpui enye naa iip are o artam o imiet,

English: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
Masaai: ore ntamesin enye naa iip ong'uan o tomoni uni o imiet, ore isirkon lenye naa nkalifuni ile o iip naapishana o tikitam.

English: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:
Masaai: Ore erubata oo lukuny oo lmareita, ina kata pee epuonu enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem, neishoru nkishorot olpela te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai, pee esheti ninye te wueji enye;

English: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests garments.
Masaai: te risioroto e nkidimata enye eishorutua ninche aapik olchumati le siaai nkiloi iip imiet e sahabu, o nkiloi nkalifuni are o ntomoni isiet e nkosholai, o lkilani iip nabo loo lapolosak.

English: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak o Lawi o embata oo ltung'ana nemany Yerusalem, o neemanita ninye, ore ilaranyak, o larripok loo nchomito, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai nebik too nkang'itie enye, ore Isiraeli pooki nebik too nkang'itie enye.

English: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebau olapa liopishana, netii iltung'ana loo Siraeli nkang'itie, neiturrurro iltung'ana aaku tenebo te Yerusalem.

English: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
Masaai: Neitoki adumunye Yeshua olayioni le Yohasadak, tenebo ilapolosak le ncholuek enye, o Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel tenebo iltung'ana lenye le sotua, neshetu ninche olperere lo lasar le Nkai e Israel, pee etum aaitayu olasar opejori te nchumata enye, anaa enaigeroki too nkitanapat e Musa ilo tung'ani le Nkai.

English: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.
Masaai: Eitasheyie apa ninche ilo perere lo lasar te ewueji enye, amu keureisho apa ninche, te nkaraki lelo tung'ana leina kop. Neitayu ninche ilasarri oopejori te nchumata enye aaitaiki Olaitoriani tadekenya o teipa.

English: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;
Masaai: Neibung ninche osirua loo lng'oborri, anaa enaigeroki, neiken te risioroto oo nkitanapat, anaa ake anaishiaakino te nkolong.

English: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ina neitayuni ilasarri oopejori lianaake, ilasarri lo lapa ng'ejuk too siruai pooki gelunot to Laitoriani, o lasarri le pooki ng'ae oitayu nkishorot o lpela aisho Olaitoriani.

English: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki enkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana neiteru ninche aaitayu olasar opejori aaisho Olaitoriani. Kake eton eitu eshetuni olkitamanyunoto le nkaji e Nkai.

English: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.
Masaai: Metaa eishoo apa ninche mpisai ilaguetak loo soito, o laguetak loo mbaoi, o endaa, o enaoki o eilata aaisho ile Sidon o le Turo, pee eyau iltarakua te Lebanon, aaya enaiposha, neya Yopa, te risioroto e nkishoroto nanoto apa ninche te Sairos olaiguananile Parsia.

English: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa to lari liare oetunye ninche enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, to lapa liare, neitobir Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel o Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak enkiterunoto, tenebo ilkulikae alashera lenye, lelo apolosak o Lawi o pooki ooetuo Yerusalem eing'ua eyararoto. Negelu ninche Ilawi ooitabaitie ilarin tikitam neilep, pee eitasheiki esiaai enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.
Masaai: Ore Yeshua o layiok lenyena o ltung'ana lenye le sotua oonyikare o Kadmiel, o layiok lenyena, lelo ayiok le Yuda, neitasheiki pooki ilaisiaayiak tiatua enkaji e Nkai, tenebo ilayiok le Hanadad o Lawi, o layiok lenye, o ltung'ana lenye le sotua oonyikare.

English: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiteru ilashetak olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani, ore ilapolosak eishopo nkilani enye e siaai nepuonu dukuya eeta ntarumpetani, ore Ilawi lelo ayiok le Asaf neyau isaanini dapashi enye, pee eisis Olaitoriani, te risioroto eutaroto e Daudi; olaiguanani loo Siraeli;

English: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.
Masaai: nerany ninche eirukokino, eisis neisho enashe Olaitoriani, ejo, “Amu aisupat ninye amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi tialo Isiraeli.” Nebuaku iltung'ana pooki te mbuakunoto sapuk, ina kata eisis Olaitoriani enkaraki naiteruaki olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:
Masaai: Kake ilapolosak kumok o Lawi o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ilpayiani kituaak apa ootoduaa enkaji e dukuya neyietu aaishir ina kata pee edol olkitamanyunoto lena aji eshetuni, hoo netabuakutua ilkumok te nchipai;

English: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.
Masaai: neaku meidim iltung'ana aaitirisha oltoilo le mbuakunoto e nchipai o ltoilo lo lkiyio loo ltung'ana; amu etabuakutua apa lelo tung'ana te mbuakunoto sapuk oleng, nening'ori ina buakunoto te nelakua.

English: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;
Masaai: Ore apa pee ening ilmang'ati le Yuda o Benchamen nchere ore ilapa yararot oo torrinyunye neshetita enkaji o Laitoriani, Enkai oo Siraeli,

English: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esar-haddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.
Masaai: nepuo ninche enetii Serubabel, o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye nejoki ninche, “Nchoo iyiook mateshet tenebo ntae; amu kiserem sii iyiook Enkai inyi anaa eninkoko intae, naa aikipolosaki apa iyiook ninye ebaiki nkolong'i e Esarhadon olaiguanani le Asiria, laa ninye apa oyaua iyiook ene.”

English: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.
Masaai: Kake etiaakita ninche Serubabel, o Yeshua o kulie lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te Israel, “Miatata eniporokiki iyiook te nchetata e nkaji e Nkai ang; kake iyiook ake oopeny ooshetaki Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, anaa enaitanapa iyiook Olaiguanani Sairos, ilo aiguanani le Parsia.”

English: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana leina kop neitashal iltung'ana le Yuda, neitukuret ninche te nchetata,

English: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
Masaai: neiger ninche ilautarok oogilunore ninche pee eitashal ninche teina kiaas enye, too nkolong'i pooki e nkitoria e Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia, ometabaiki enkitoria e Darias olaiguanani le Parsia.

English: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore te nkitoria e Ahasero te nkiterunoto e nkitoria enye, neiger ninche enkitang'oroto te nkaraki lelo oo manya Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.
Masaai: Ore apa too nkolong'i e Artaserses, o Bishlam o Mitredat, o Tabeel o lkulikae le ncholuek enye, neigeroki empalai Artaserser olaiguanani le Parsia. Eigeroki apa ina palai te nkutuk e Aramea neibelekenyi.

English: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:
Masaai: Ore apa Rehum olkitok le njore o Shimshai ilo aigeroni neiger empalai te nkaraki Yerusalem aigeroki Artaserses ilo aiguanani nejo nji

English: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,
Masaai: neitoki Rehum ilo kitok le njore aiger, o Shimshai ilo aigeroni, o lelo kulikae le ncholuek enye, o larishak, o lbalusuni, o lkituaak, o le Parsia, o ltung'ana le Erek, o le Babilon, o ltung'ana le Susa, aa taa ile Elam,

English: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnapper brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.
Masaai: tenebo ilkulikae oreren laa ninche etimirayie olkitok oji Osnapar nepuo aamany nkanas e Samaria, o kulie lo lkerenket otii idia alo olkeju, naa ore taata,

English: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.
Masaai: ena entashati eina palai apa nairriwaitie ninche - “Enetii Artaserses olaiguanani: Ore isinkan linono, lelo tung'ana lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, kirriu enkirorokino. Ore taata,

English: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.
Masaai: nchoo eyiolou olaiguanani nchere, ore ilapa Yahudi ooetuo eing'ua enitii, nepuonu enikitii neshomo Yerusalem. Enyaakita aashet enapa anasa kiserut e ntorroni; eidipa ninche isunta neramita ilkitamanyunot.

English: Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.
Masaai: Nchoo naa taata eyiolou olaiguanani nchere, teneigili aashet ena anasa neidipayu isunta, meitoki ninche aalak kodi; anaa mpisai olpolosie anaa ine nkoitoi, ore mpisai enkitoria nengoroo.

English: Now because we have maintenance from the king's palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king's dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;
Masaai: Ore naa enkaraki naa iyie kingarakino, nemeishiaakino iyiook nikiduaaki olaiguanani esulare, enkaraki ena pee kirriwakita olaiguanani olkilikuai aaitayiolo,

English: That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers: so shalt thou find in the book of the records, and know that this city is a rebellious city, and hurtful unto kings and provinces, and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time: for which cause was this city destroyed.
Masaai: pee itum aing'oru enjurrunoto tiatua embuku oo mbaa oo loo papaai lino. Itum iyie tiatua embuku oo mbaa, niyiolou nchere ore ena anasa naa aikiserut, naa enkaitooshoni too laiguanak, o too lkerenketi, netipikaki apa ninye enking'oling'ol ebaiki moitie, enkaraki ena apa pee eitaaki ena anasa olmuaate.

English: We certify the king that, if this city be builded again, and the walls thereof set up, by this means thou shalt have no portion on this side the river.
Masaai: Kintayiolo iyiook olaiguanani nchere, teneigili aashet ena anasa neidipayu isunta enyena, nimintoki aata enipor ilo kerenket otii lido kekun olkeju.”

English: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor, and to Shimshai the scribe, and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria, and unto the rest beyond the river, Peace, and at such a time.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani ewalata ejo: “Enetii Rehum ilo kitok le njore o Shimshai olaigeroni o lkulikae pooki le ncholuek enye ootii Samaria otii olkerenket teidia alo olkeju, airriu enkirorokino. Naa ore taata,

English: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.
Masaai: enapa palai nirriwakita iyiook neisumaki aaibalie te dukuya nanu.

English: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
Masaai: Aitayio nanu enkitanapata neitobiraki enjurrunoto, nenotoki nchere ore ena anasa ebaiki apa moitie netudumakine ilaiguanak agilunore, netii enkiser o enkarruoisho atua ninye.

English: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
Masaai: Netii apa ilaiguanak magil Yerusalem, ooitoreishote to lkerenket pooki le lido kekun olkeju, laa ninche apa elaakini kodi o mpisai o lpolosie, o mpisai oo nkoitoi.

English: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease, and that this city be not builded, until another commandment shall be given from me.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina entobira pee elikini kulo tung'ana metapala esiaai, nemeitoki aashet ena anasa, ometaba anaa naitobir enkitanapata.

English: Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?
Masaai: Naa entodol pee mintololong'ong'o ena bae; kainyoo pee eibulaa enkinyalata pee einyal ilaiguanak?”

English: Now when the copy of king Artaxerxes' letter was read before Rehum, and Shimshai the scribe, and their companions, they went up in haste to Jerusalem unto the Jews, and made them to cease by force and power.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eisumi entashati e mpalai o laiguanani Artaserser te dukuya Rehum o Shimshai olaigeroni o lelo le ncholuek enye, neisarrisar aapuo enetii Ilyahudi te Yerusalem ore te nkisikong'ata o te ngolon neitapal ninche esiaai.

English: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem. So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
Masaai: Ore ina siaai e nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem neitasheyieki; neitashe ometabau olapa liare le nkitoria e Darias olaiguanani le Parsia.

English: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.
Masaai: Ore apa iloibonok le Nkai, Hagai o Sakaria olayioni le Ido, neibonoki Ilyahudi ootii Yuda o Yerusalem, te nkarna e Nkai e Israel natii shumata ninche.

English: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem: and with them were the prophets of God helping them.
Masaai: Neitoki Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel o Yeshua olayioni le Yehosadak aadumunye neiteru aashet enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem; ore tenebo ninche netii iloibonok le Nkai, eretito ninche.

English: At the same time came to them Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and their companions, and said thus unto them, Who hath commanded you to build this house, and to make up this wall?
Masaai: Ore teina kata ake nelotu Tartenai, ilo balusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju o Shetar-bosenai tenebo lelo le ncholuek enye neirorie aajoki nji, “Kaing'ae oishoo ntae enkitanapata nishetietie ena aji nindipidipi olchetei lenye?”

English: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
Masaai: Enyaakita sii aaikilikuan ninche ena, “Kakua nkarn e kulo tung'ana ooshetita ena aji?”

English: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, that they could not cause them to cease, till the matter came to Darius: and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter.
Masaai: Kake etii apa enkong'u e Nkai enye shumata lelo payiani loo Lyahudi, neitu ninche eibooyo ninche ometabaiki ilo omoni Darias nerrinyuni ewalata naipirta ina te palai.

English: The copy of the letter that Tatnai, governor on this side the river, and Shethar-boznai, and his companions the Apharsachites, which were on this side the river, sent unto Darius the king:
Masaai: Ore entashati eina palai nairriwakita Tartanai, ilo balusui lo lpolosie otii teidia alo olkeju o Shotar-bosnai o lelo le ncholuek enye, lelo balusuni apa ootii olkerenket otii lido kekun olkeju, o Darias olaiguanani;

English: They sent a letter unto him, wherein was written thus; Unto Darius the king, all peace.
Masaai: neirriwaki ninche ninye olomoni, oigerore kuna baa: “Enetii Darias olaiguanani, eseriani te pooki.

English: Be it known unto the king, that we went into the province of Judea, to the house of the great God, which is builded with great stones, and timber is laid in the walls, and this work goeth fast on, and prospereth in their hands.
Masaai: Nchoo metayiolouni to laiguanani nchere kishomo iyiook olkerenket le Yuda, enkaji e Nkai kitok. Eshetitae ninye too soito sapuki, netipikaki isunta enyena mbaoi, eloito ena siaai dukuya aponari easita nkaik enye.

English: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
Masaai: Nikintoki iyiook aaikilikuan lelo payiani nikirorie iyiook ninche aajoki nji, ‘Kaing'ae oishoo intae enkitanapata pee ishetishete ena aji, nindipidipi olchetei lenye?’

English: We asked their names also, to certify thee, that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them.
Masaai: Kinyaakita sii aaikilikuan ninche nkarn enye, pee itum atayiolo, nikitum aaigero nkarn e lelo tung'ana too lukuny enye.

English: And thus they returned us answer, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and build the house that was builded these many years ago, which a great king of Israel builded and set up.
Masaai: Naa ena apa ninche etawalikitia iyiook, ‘Kira iyiook isinkan le Nkai e keper o enkop, naa eikingil iyiook aashet ena aji apa nateshetaki too larin kumok ootulusoitie, apa natesheta olaiguanani le Israel kitok neidip.

English: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath, he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house, and carried the people away into Babylon.
Masaai: Kake ore enkaraki apa naitagoro loo papa Enkai e keper, neishooyo ninye ninche apik enkaina e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, o Lkaldayo, laa ninche apa ooidaikie ena aji neya iltung'ana Babilon.

English: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia neijia, to lari le dukuya le nkitoria e Sairos olaiguanani le Babilon, neitayu Sairos ilo aiguanani enkitanapata, nchere pee eitokini aashet ena aji e Nkai.

English: And the vessels also of gold and silver of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple that was in Jerusalem, and brought them into the temple of Babylon, those did Cyrus the king take out of the temple of Babylon, and they were delivered unto one, whose name was Sheshbazzar, whom he had made governor;
Masaai: Ore nena masaa e sahabu o ne nkosholai e nkaji e Nkai, apa naaitayio Nebukadnesa teina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neyau ina aji e nkai e Babilon, eyaua Sairos olaiguanani kuna aitupuku te nkaji e nkai e Babilon nepiki enkaina e obo oji enkarna Sheshbasa, laa ninye apa eitaa olbalusui;

English: And said unto him, Take these vessels, go, carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be builded in his place.
Masaai: nejoki olaiguanani ninye, “Iwa kuna masaa, shomo tipika ninche atua enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, naa nchoo enkaji e Nkai eitokini aashet te wueji enye.”

English: Then came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God which is in Jerusalem: and since that time even until now hath it been in building, and yet it is not finished.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu ilo oji Sheshbasa neshet olkitamanyunoto le nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem; ore ebaiki ina kata o taata etaa ina aji enateshete, neitu eidipayu.’

English: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let there be search made in the king's treasure house, which is there at Babylon, whether it be so, that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina te nelioo aa sidai to laiguanani, nchoo ejurruni to lchumati loo mbaa musan o laiguanani teidie te Babilon, pee edoli tenaa keitayio apa Sairos olaiguanani enkitanapata nashetieki ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem. Naa nchoo olaiguanani eirriwaki iyiook enaitiship ninye tialo ena bae.”

English: Then Darius the king made a decree, and search was made in the house of the rolls, where the treasures were laid up in Babylon.
Masaai: Neitoki Darias olaiguanani aitayu enkitanapata, nejurruni te Babilon, te nkaji nashumieki mbaa musan, teine apa neshumieki mbaa naaigeroki.

English: And there was found at Achmetha, in the palace that is in the province of the Medes, a roll, and therein was a record thus written:
Masaai: Ore te Ebatana, teina anasa kitok natii olkerenket le Media, netumi teine olpiyayati oigerore ena: “Embae nadamuni.

English: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem, Let the house be builded, the place where they offered sacrifices, and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid; the height thereof threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof threescore cubits;
Masaai: Ore to lari le dukuya le nkitoria e Sairos olaiguanani, naitayu Sairos olaiguanani enkitanapata: Naipirta enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, ejo, nchoo metesheti ina aji, ine wueji apa neishoorieki ilasarri, neyauni ilasarri oopejori; ore enkadoro enye naa keaku ntemat e nkaina ntomoni ile ore endapasho naa ntemat e nkaina ntomoni ile,

English: With three rows of great stones, and a row of new timber: and let the expences be given out of the king's house:
Masaai: neeta nkererin uni oo soito sapuki, o enkereri nabo oo mbaoi; nchoo elaata e nchetata enye meitayuni to lchumati lo laiguanani.

English: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem, and brought unto Babylon, be restored, and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem, every one to his place, and place them in the house of God.
Masaai: Ore sii nchoo inapa masaa e sahabu o ne nkosholai e nkaji e Nkai naawa Nebukadnesa te nkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neya Babilon, errinyuni aayau atua ina aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem, neyauni ake pooki nabo ewueji enye, nipik ninche atua enkaji e Nkai.”

English: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar-boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
Masaai: “Neirriwaa Darias ena walata; ejo, Ore taata Tetanai, olbalusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, o Shetar-bosenai, o lelo le ncholuek ino, lelo balusuni ootii olkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju, entalamari;

English: Let the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in his place.
Masaai: entalam esiaai ena aji e Nkai; enchoo olbalusui loo lyahudi, o lpayiani loo Lyahudi eitoki aashet ena aji e Nkai te wueji enye.

English: Moreover I make a decree what ye shall do to the elders of these Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king's goods, even of the tribute beyond the river, forthwith expences be given unto these men, that they be not hindered.
Masaai: Ore ake sii aitayio nanu enkitanapata naipirta enintaasiasa kulo payiani loo Lyahudi te nchetata ena aji e Nkai; kelaakini kulo tung'ana te nkiputakinoto to lchumati le nkitoo nemeimutieki te kodi naing'uaa olkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju.

English: And that which they have need of, both young bullocks, and rams, and lambs, for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, and oil, according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day without fail:
Masaai: Ore entoki pooki nayieuni - ilooti oing'ok, ilmeregeshi, anaa nkerra tenkaraki ilasarri oopejokini Enkai e keper, o enkano, o emunyan, o enaisho oo sabibu, anaa eilata, anaa enayieu ilapolosak te Yerusalem, nchoo ninche ina anaake, nemepali,

English: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.
Masaai: pee etum ninche aaishooi ilasarri ooitishipisho te Nkai e keper, neomonoki enkishui o laiguanani o layiok lenyena.

English: Also I have made a decree, that whosoever shall alter this word, let timber be pulled down from his house, and being set up, let him be hanged thereon; and let his house be made a dunghill for this.
Masaai: Aitayio sii enkitanapata nchere teneibelekeny ake oltung'ani ena limunoto, neiwuang'ieki imbokishi te nkaji enye, nesheyieki ninye, neaku enkaji enye olkiu le modioi.

English: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
Masaai: Ore Enkai apa naitamanya enkarna enye ine wueji, metusulai pooki aiguanani o ltung'ana ooitorioo nkaik enye aaibelekeny ena, anaa einyal ena aji e Nkai natii Yerusalem. Nanu Darias oitayio ena kitanapata nchoo metaasi neibung'i aakurraki.”

English: Then Tatnai, governor on this side the river, Shethar-boznai, and their companions, according to that which Darius the king had sent, so they did speedily.
Masaai: Ore te risioroto eilo rorei oirriwayie olaiguanani Sairos, neas Tatenai ilo balusui lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju o Shetar-bosenai, o lelo le ncholuek enye, nena pooki naaitanapishe olaiguanani Darias.

English: And the elders of the Jews builded, and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. And they builded, and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the commandment of Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
Masaai: Ore ilpayiani loo Lyahudi neshetisho nebul, teina aibon apa e Hagai oloiboni le Nkai o Sakaria olayioni le Ido. Eidipa ninche ina aji enye te nkitanapata e Nkai oo Siraeli o te nkitanapata e Sairos o Darias o Artaseses olaiguanani le Parsia;

English: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
Masaai: neidipe apa ena aji te nkolong e uni o lapa le Adar, to lari le ile le nkitoria o laiguanani Darias.

English: And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy,
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ilapolosak o Lawi, o lelo kulikae apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto, neraposhoki enkitisinyata eina aji e Nkai te nchipai.

English: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; and for a sin offering for all Israel, twelve he goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Neishooyo ninche teina kitisinyata ena aji e Nkai iloing'ok iip nabo, o lmeregeshi iip are, o lkuo le kerra iip ong'uan, neitayu anaa olasar le ng'oki too Siraeli pooki ilkineji tomon oare, terisioroto e siana oo loshon loo Siraeli.

English: And they set the priests in their divisions, and the Levites in their courses, for the service of God, which is at Jerusalem; as it is written in the book of Moses.
Masaai: Nepik ninche ilapolosak ilturrurri lenye nepik Ilawi irishat enye e siaai, tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e Nkai te Yerusalem anaa enaigeroki te mbuku e Musa.

English: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tomon oo nguan o lapa le dukuya, neibung lelo apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto pasaka.

English: For the priests and the Levites were purified together, all of them were pure, and killed the passover for all the children of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves.
Masaai: Amu eitisinya apa ilapolosak o Lawi ate tenebo; etaa apa pooki ilemeiduruk. Neaku eteyiang'a ninche olkuoo lenye le pasaka tenkaraki lelo pooki ootorrinyunye te yararoto, te nkaraki lelo apolosak alashera lenye, o tenkaraki ninche maate,

English: And the children of Israel, which were come again out of captivity, and all such as had separated themselves unto them from the filthiness of the heathen of the land, to seek the LORD God of Israel, did eat,
Masaai: einosa apa ina pasaka iltung'ana loo Siraeli ootorrinyunye te yararoto, o pooki ng'ae oibung'are ninche, neitalam kewan olduruk loo ltung'ana leina kop, neserem Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel.

English: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy: for the LORD had made them joyful, and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
Masaai: Neibung ninche osirua loo mukateni neitu eisuishieki nkolong'i naapishana te nchipai; amu eitishipa ninche Olaitoriani, neibelekenya oltau lo laiguanani le Asiria aibelekenyakino ninche, ometaa etareto ninye ninche te siaai e nkaji e Nkai, Enkai e Israel.

English: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
Masaai: Ore apa te siadi ena, te nkitoria e Artaseses olaiguanani le Parsia, ore Esra olayioni le Seraia, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Hilkia,

English: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
Masaai: olayioni le Shalum, olayioni le Sadok, olayioni le Ahitab,

English: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
Masaai: olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Asaria, olayioni le Merariot,

English: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
Masaai: olayioni le Serahia, olayioni le Usii, olayioni le Buki,

English: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
Masaai: olayioni le Abishua, olayioni le Finehas, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Aron ilo apolosani kitok - neilepu sii ilo Esra eing'uaa Babilon.

English: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.
Masaai: Olaigeroni apa ninye arriyia too nkitanapat e Musa, apa naaishorua Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, neisho olaiguanani ninye nena pooki naatoomonuo, amu etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai enye shumata ninye.

English: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
Masaai: Neilep sii apa aapuo Yerusalem to lapa liopishana le nkitoria e Artaseses olaiguanani, embata oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli, o embata oo lapolosak o Lawi, o laranyak o larripok loo nchomito, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye Yerusalem to lapa le imiet, aa olari liopishana le nkitoria eilo aiguanani;

English: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
Masaai: amu ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya neiteru ninye alo te Babilon, ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le imiet nelotu ninye Yerusalem, amu etii enkaina supat e Nkai enye shumata ninye.

English: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.
Masaai: Amu etipika Esra oltau lenye pee eiteng'enuo enkitanapata o Laitoriani, neas ninye, neitengenisho nkiguanat enyena, o nkikoo enyena tiatua Israel.

English: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.
Masaai: Ena entashati e mpalai naishoo olaiguanani Artaseses Esra ilo apolosani, naa olaigeroni, ang'eni loo mbaa oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani o nkiguanat enyena tialo Isiraeli:

English: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.
Masaai: “Artaseses olaiguanani loo laiguanak oirriwaki Esra olapolosani, ilo aigeroni loo nkitanapat e Nkai e keper. Ore taata,

English: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.
Masaai: aitobira nanu enkitanapata ore pooki ng'ae too ltung'ana loo Siraeli anaa ilapolosak lenye anaa Ilawi tiatua enkitoria ai, onyorraa alo Yerusalem te yieunoto enye, neidim ashomo tenebo iyie.

English: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;
Masaai: Amu kirriwayie iyie olaiguanani o lautarok lenyena oopishana, pee eikilikuan mbaa e Yuda o Yerusalem te risioroto eina kitanapata natii nkaik inono, e Nkai ino,

English: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,
Masaai: nimbalunye sii enkosholai o sahabu apa naishoo olaiguanani tenebo ilautarok Enkai e Israel, natii emanyisho enye atua Yerusalem,

English: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:
Masaai: tenebo enkosholai pooki o sahabu nilo iyie atum to lkerenket pooki le Babilon, tenebo nkishorot o lpela oo ltung'ana o noo lapolosak, naainosaki olmumai pee eishoruni tenkaraki enkaji e Nkai enye natii Yerusalem.

English: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore naa te kuna pisai ilo iyie ainyiang'u iloing'ok, o lmeregeshi, o lkuo le kerra, tenebo ilasarri lenye le ntapa, o lasarri lenye ooki, nilo aishooyo ninche te nchumata olperere lo lasar le nkaji e Nkai ino natii Yerusalem.

English: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
Masaai: Ore pooki naba anaa enidol aa sidai te iyie o lalashera linono neasi teina ae osholai o sahabu, nindimidimi aataas, te risioroto e yieunoto e Nkai ino.

English: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore inapa masaa nikinchooki tenkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai ino, nilo aitayu te dukuya e Nkai e Yerusalem.

English: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king's treasure house.
Masaai: Ore pooki naba anaa enayieuni te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ino, niata erishata pee inchoru nindim aishoru te nena naatii olchumati lo laiguanani.

English: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,
Masaai: “Ore nanu Artaseses olaiguanani, naitobira enkitanapata too lashumak pooki lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju. Ore pooki nayieu Esra, ilo apolosani, aigeroni loo nkitanapat e Nkai e keper, nchoo easi aakurraki,
