English: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.
Masaai: neitabaikini ntalantani iip nabo e nkosholai, o rridat iip e nkano, o lbenia iip le nkano, o emunyan neitu eimakini eneba esapuko.

English: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?
Masaai: Ore pooki naaitanapishe Enkai e keper, nchoo metaasi aaitabaya te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai e keper, pee melotu ake engoro enye adoiki olaiguanani o layiok lenyena.

English: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.
Masaai: Kiliki sii iyie nchere meishiaakino pee eitalaki olapolosani kodi e arakinoto, anaa mpisai o lpolosie, anaa mpisai e nkoitoi, nemeitalaki Ilawi o laranyak, o laitasheikinok loo nkutukie oo nkajijik, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, anaa kulikae aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.
Masaai: “Naa ore iyie Esra te risioroto eina ng'eno nagut e Nkai ino niata te nkaina ino, tegelu ilooiguanare o larishak oorish iltung'ana to lkerenket pooki otii lido kekun olkeju, ore lelo pooki naa ilooyiolo nkitanapat Enkai ino: ore lelo lemeyiolo nkitanapat ninteng'en.

English: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lemeiruk nkitanapat e Nkai ino o nkitanapat o laiguanani, nchoo edung'okini ninye enkiguana narrish, aa te keeya, anaa erewe eyararoto anaa, eoruni imasaa enyena, anaa eeni te korokoroni.”

English: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king's heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papa, laa ninye otipika embae naikununo nji atua oltau lo laiguanani, pee eitisidan enkaji e Nkai natii Yerusalem,

English: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king's mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
Masaai: naa ninye laaitabaikia nanu enyorrata enye nauno te dukuya olaiguanani, o lautarok lenyena. O te dukuya iltung'ana pooki magil lo laiguanani. Naagolu nanu oshoke amu etii enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai ai shumata nanu, naiturrur nanu iltung'ana ooisul Isiraeli pee aapuo aairiamariyie.

English: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.
Masaai: Kuna apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, naa kuna nkarn oo ishoritin e lelo apa ooshomo tenebo nanu eing'uaa Babilon, te nkitoria o laiguanani Artaseses.

English: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Finehas naa Gershom. Ore too layiok le Itamar, naa Daniel, ore too layiok le Daudi naa Hatush,

English: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.
Masaai: ore too layiok le Shekania, o too layiok le Parosh, naa Sekaria, laa te ninye eigeroki ilewa iip o onom.

English: Of the sons of Pahath-moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Pahat-moab, naa Elieho-enai olayioni le Serahia, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa iip are o onom.

English: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Satu, naa Shekania olayioni le Yehasiel, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa iip uni.

English: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Adin, naa Ebed olayioni le Yonatan, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa onom.

English: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Elam, naa Yeshaia olayioni le Atalia, ore tenebo ninye netii ilewa ntomoni naapishana.

English: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Shefatia, o Sebadia olayioni le Mikael, netii tenebo ninye Ilewa ntomoni isiet.

English: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Yoab, o Obadia olayioni le Yehiel, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip are o tomon oisiet.

English: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bani, o Shelomit olayioni le Yosifia, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip o ntomoni ile.

English: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bebai, Sekaria olayioni le Bebai, netii tenebo ninye ilewa tikitam o isiet.

English: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Asgat, Yohanan olayioni le Hakatan, netii tenebo ninye ilewa iip o tomon.

English: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Adonikam, lelo apa ooetuo te siadi, ore nkarn enye naa Elifalet, Yeuel, o Shemaia, netii tenebo ninche ilewa ntomoni ile.

English: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bigfai, Utai o Sakur, netii tenebo ninche ilewa ntomoni naapishana.

English: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
Masaai: Aiturrurro apa nanu ninche te mbata olkeju orukokino Ahafa, ore teine nikibik too lng'oborri nkolong'i uni. Najo nanu ajur iltung'ana o lapolosak, nadol nchere metii Ilawi.

English: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.
Masaai: Nairriwaa nanu olkilikuai meipoti Eliesa, o Ariel, o Shemaia o Elinatan, o Yarib, o Elnatan, o Natan, o Sekaria, o Meshulam, lelo arikok, neipotuni sii Yoiarib o Elnatan, laa iltung'ana apa oota engeno nagut neiriwarri ninche meshomo enetii Ido,

English: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.
Masaai: ilo arikoni te wueji neji Kasifia, neliki ninche enapuo aajoki Ido o lalashera lenyena lelo sinkan le nkaji e Nkai, te wueji neji Kasifia, aa taa, pee eirriwakini iyiook ilaisiaayiak te nkaraki e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkaina supat e Nkai ang, natii te shumata iyiook eyakita ninche iyiook oltung'ani oata enkidimata, too layiok le Mahali, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Israel, oji enkarna enye Sherabia, ore tenebo ilayiok lenyena o ltung'ana lo lgilata lenye naa tomon oisiet,

English: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;
Masaai: tenebo sii Hashabia, ore tenebo ninye netii Yashabia, too layiok le Merari, ore ninche tenebo iltung'ana lo lgilata lenye, o layiok lenye naa tikitam.

English: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.
Masaai: Ore tenebo lelo aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai iip are o tikitam, apa ooiteng'ela Daudi, pee etum aaisiaayia Ilawi, neipotoki kulo pooki too nkarn.

English: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aibalunye eenata e mpukoroto to lkeju le Ahafa, pee kitum iyiook aitoborro ate te dukuya Enkai ang, pee king'oru te ninye enkoitoi naitoriori te nkaraki iyiook maate, o nkera ang o masaa ang pooki.

English: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
Masaai: Amu atoduaa apa nanu enkurruna tenaomon olaiguanani meishoo iyiook ilkuti sikarini, o lakedok loo mbartan, pee emitu iyiook too lmang'ati te nkoitoi, amu kindipa iyiook aatiaaki olaiguanani, “Ore enkaina e Nkai ang naa pee eyaki eretoto lelo pooki ooing'oru ninye. Ore engolon e ng'oro enye napi naa pee egilunore lelo oopaashare ninye.”

English: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.
Masaai: Nikiyen iyiook ate aaitupukoo, nikisai Enkai ang tena bae, nening ninye esayiata ang.

English: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,
Masaai: Naiteng'el nanu ilapolosak tomon oare te lelo apolosak kituaak: Sherabia, o Hashabia, o kulikae tomon loo lgilat lenye tenebo ninche.

English: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:
Masaai: Naineneng'aki nanu ninche enkiroishi e nkosholai o sahabu o masaa, o nena kishorot te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ang apa naaishorua olaiguanani, o lautarok lenyena, o lkituaak lenyena, elulung'a Israel pooki;

English: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
Masaai: naineneng nanu too nkaik enye enkiroishi e shekeli iip naa ntalantani iip ile e nkosholai, o masaa e nkosholai naabaya enkinyiang'a enye shekeli iip nabo, o sahabu ntalantani iip nabo.

English: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
Masaai: O lbakulini tikitam le sahabu loo nkiloi isiet enkiroishi enye, o masaa are sidain o suyai naanyaanyukie te nkiroishi nena e sahabu.

English: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninche, “Irara intae sinyat to Laitoriani, naa sinyat kuna masaa, ore enkosholai o sahabu naa nkishorot o lpela naaishori Olaitoriani, Enkai oo loo papaai linyi.

English: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Entagolie ninche, ning'oring'oro ninche ometaba anaa nimpimipimi ninche te dukuya ilapolosak kituaak o Lawi o lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye te Israel te Yerusalem, tiatua ilgilat le nkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.
Masaai: Metaa eibung'a ilapolosak o Lawi enkipimore e nkosholai o sahabu o masaa, neyau ninche Yerusalem atua ina aji e Nkai ang.

English: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.
Masaai: Nikintoki iyiook aadumunye to lkeju le Ahafa te nkolong e tomon oare o lapa le dukuya, aapuo Yerusalem. Netii enkaina e Nkai ang shumata iyiook, nekordu ninye iyiook te nkaina o lmang'atinta lang o too rresheta te nkoitoi.

English: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.
Masaai: Nikibau iyiook Yerusalem nikibik teine nkolong'i uni.

English: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ong'uan tiatua enkaji e Nkai ang, neipimi enkosholai o sahabu o masaa aapik nkaik e Meremot olapolosani, olayioni le Uria, netii tenebo ninye Eliesa olayioni le Finehas, netii tenebo ninche Ilawi, Yosabad olayioni le Binui.

English: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.
Masaai: Eikenayioki nena pooki aajo keipima, ore enkiroishi e pooki toki neigeri.

English: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ore teina kata lelo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto, lelo yararot ootorrinyunye, neishoru ilasarri oopejori aaisho Enkai e Israel, iloing'ok tomon oare tenkaraki Isiraeli pooki o lmeregeshi ntomoni naaudo o ile, o lkuoo le kerra ntomoni naapishana, neitayuni anaa olasar le ng'oki ilkineji tomon oare: ore kuna pooki naa ilasarri oopejokini Olaitoriani.

English: And they delivered the king's commissions unto the king's lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.
Masaai: Eyautua sii apa empalai naishorua olaiguanani aayaki ilkituaak o lbalusuni lo lkerenket otii teidia alo olkeju; neretu ninche iltung'ana o enkaji e Nkai.

English: Now when these things were done, the princes came to me, saying, The people of Israel, and the priests, and the Levites, have not separated themselves from the people of the lands, doing according to their abominations, even of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
Masaai: Ore eidipaki aataas kuna baa, nepuonu lelo kituaak enatii nejo, “Ore iltung'ana loo Siraeli, o lapolosak o Lawi, neitu egelaa ate aarishu too ltung'ana le kuna kuapi oata olminong oing'uaa ile Kanaan, o Lhiti, o Lperisi, O Ljebusi o Lamoni o Lmoabu, o Lmisiri o Lamori.

English: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
Masaai: Amu ewaita ninche embata oo ntoyie enye aayamaki ate o layiok lenye, metaa etushulare ilo osho osinya iltung'ana loo loreren. Ore te nkaraki ena nemeisiligayu ninche, eituruk lelo kituaak o laiguanak eitarruoitie.”

English: And when I heard this thing, I rent my garment and my mantle, and plucked off the hair of my head and of my beard, and sat down astonied.
Masaai: Ore ake pee aning ena, napolos nanu ilkilani laainei, olkila lai oado, naputu olpapita te ndukuya ai o to lmunyei naton aiputukuny.

English: Then were assembled unto me every one that trembled at the words of the God of Israel, because of the transgression of those that had been carried away; and I sat astonied until the evening sacrifice.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooikirikirate too rorei le Nkai e Israel, tenkaraki nemeisiligayu lelo ootorrinyunye te yararoto, neiturrurro naaman nanu, ina kata aitashe aiputukuny ometabau olasar le nteipa.

English: And at the evening sacrifice I arose up from my heaviness; and having rent my garment and my mantle, I fell upon my knees, and spread out my hands unto the LORD my God.
Masaai: Ore to lasar le nteipa nadumunye nanu te enata ai e mpukoroto, aishopito lelo kilani laainei o lkila lai oado epolosa, nagil nanu kung naitorioo nkaik aainei aitorioki Olaitoriani Enkai ai,

English: And said, O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face to thee, my God: for our iniquities are increased over our head, and our trespass is grown up unto the heavens.
Masaai: ajo, “Oi Enkai ai, aata enkurruna tenaashumaki nanu iyie enkomom ai, Enkai ai, amu eilepa entorroni ang shumata alang ilukuny ang, neilepa entorroni ang ebaiki keper.

English: Since the days of our fathers have we been in a great trespass unto this day; and for our iniquities have we, our kings, and our priests, been delivered into the hand of the kings of the lands, to the sword, to captivity, and to a spoil, and to confusion of face, as it is this day.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki nkolong'i oo loo papa o metabaiki ena olong kitii iyiook atua enkitarrurroto sapuk. Naa too nkitarruorrot ang, ewaki iyiook, o laiguanak lang o lapolosak lang aapik nkaik oo laiguanak loo nkuapi, nepiki iyiook olalem, nepiki eyararoto, neoruni iyiook imasaa, nepiki iyiook esulare anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
Masaai: Kake ore taata te nkiti rishata, neishorua omom Olaitoriani Enkai ang, alekaki iyiook oloti pisiaai, neisho iyiook ewueji e seriani, tiatua ewueji enye sinyati. Pee etum Enkai ang aitawang'a nkonyek ang neisho iyiook enkiti piunoto te rrindikisho ang.

English: For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook iltung'ana le rrindikisho; ore ake eyia eitu eiturraa iyiook Enkai ang te rrindikisho ang. Kake eitabaikia iyiook enyorrata enye nauno, te dukuya le Parsia pee eisho iyiook enkiti kiyagata maitasheyie enkaji e Nkai ang, nikiram iwuejitinneeidaaitie, neisho iyiook emitunoto te Yudea o te Yerusalem.

English: And now, O our God, what shall we say after this? for we have forsaken thy commandments,
Masaai: “Naa ore taata iyie Enkai ang, kaa iyiook kipuo aajo te siadi ena? Amu kinturraitie iyiook nkitanapat inono,

English: Which thou hast commanded by thy servants the prophets, saying, The land, unto which ye go to possess it, is an unclean land with the filthiness of the people of the lands, with their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their uncleanness.
Masaai: apa nintanapishe aimunye isinkan linono, iloibonok le Nkai, ijo, ‘Ore ina kop nipuopuo aajing, pee iyaya metaa eninyi, naa enkop nemesinya, naata olduruk loo loreren le kuna kuapi, tenebo ilo minong oiputa ninye, ebaiki enkiting'oto o metabaiki enkiting'oto teilo duruk lenye.

English: Now therefore give not your daughters unto their sons, neither take their daughters unto your sons, nor seek their peace or their wealth for ever: that ye may be strong, and eat the good of the land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children for ever.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina emincho ntoyie inyi meyama ilayiok lenye, nimiyaya sii ntoyie enye aayamaki ilayiok linyi. Niming'oruru aekata osotua o ninche o karsisisho enye eji pee igolulu, nitumutumu aainosa endaa sidai eina kop nintaa enjung'ore oo nkera inyi ntarasi.’

English: And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;
Masaai: Ore eidipa kuna pooki aatadoiki iyiook te nkaraki nkiaasin ang torrok o te nkitarruoroto ang kitok, nikidol aajo, iyie Enkai ang naitamio, aitodorropu too nkitarruorot ang, ninchoo iyiook olpisiai loo lekunot oba nji.

English: Should we again break thy commandments, and join in affinity with the people of these abominations? wouldest not thou be angry with us till thou hadst consumed us, so that there should be no remnant nor escaping?
Masaai: Eikingil iyiook aagil nkitanapat inono nikiyama o ltung'ana oas kuna baa olminong? Aimigorokino iyie iyiook, nimut iyiook ometaa metumi ninye olpisiai loo lekunot, nemeimisho ninye obo?

English: O LORD God of Israel, thou art righteous: for we remain yet escaped, as it is this day: behold, we are before thee in our trespasses: for we cannot stand before thee because of this.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, ira iyie asipani, amu etelekuaki iyiook olpisiaai oimishe, anaa enikitiu ena olong. Ng'ura kitii iyiook dukuya iyie te nkitarruorroto ang, amu meetae oloidim aitasho te dukuya iyie te nkaraki ena.”

English: Now when Ezra had prayed, and when he had confessed, weeping and casting himself down before the house of God, there assembled unto him out of Israel a very great congregation of men and women and children: for the people wept very sore.
Masaai: Ore eomonito Esra neirridu, neishir, nenang'ie kewan enkop te dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani, neiturrurrokino ninye eumata sapuk oo lewa, o nkituaak o nkera, eing'uaa Israel, amu eishira lelo tung'ana te mion.

English: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answered and said unto Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken strange wives of the people of the land: yet now there is hope in Israel concerning this thing.
Masaai: Ore Shekamia olayioni le Yehiel, loo layiok le Elam, neirorie Esra: ajoki, “Kinturraitie iyiook enkirukoto te Nkai nikiyama nkituaak oo loreren oo ltung'ana lena kop, kake ore ake o taata eetae osiligi too Siraeli hoo netii ena.

English: Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all the wives, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those that tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, maitobira iyiook olning'o lo sotua o Enkai ang, aaiwuang'ie kuna kituaak pooki o nkera enye, te risioroto e nkikoo o lkitok lai, o ene lelo ooikirikira te nkaraki enkitanapata e Nkai ang: naa nchoo easi ina te risioroto e nkitanapata.

English: Arise; for this matter belongeth unto thee: we also will be with thee: be of good courage, and do it.
Masaai: Tudumunye amu esiaai ino ina, nikitii iyiook tenebo iyie. Ntagoluoyu nias ina.”

English: Then arose Ezra, and made the chief priests, the Levites, and all Israel, to swear that they should do according to this word. And they sware.
Masaai: Nedumunye Esra neinosie olmumai ilapolosak kituaak, o Lawi o Siraeli pooki, pee eas anaa enatejoki. Neinos ninche olmumai.

English: Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Johanan the son of Eliashib: and when he came thither, he did eat no bread, nor drink water: for he mourned because of the transgression of them that had been carried away.
Masaai: Neitoki Esra alo te nkaji e Nkai nelo olgilata le Yehobadan olayioni le Eliaship, naa ine eshomo airrag. Neitu einos endaa anaa eok enkare; amu eishiraka apa ninye lelo ooshomo eyararoto lemeisiligayu.

English: And they made proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem unto all the children of the captivity, that they should gather themselves together unto Jerusalem;
Masaai: Neitayuni enkitanapata tiatua Yuda pooki o Yerusalem tenkaraki lelo yararot pooki ootorrinyunye, pee epuo ninche aaiturrurro te Yerusalem.

English: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.
Masaai: Naa teneitu elotu oltung'ani ake ninye obo too nkolong'i uni, te nkitanapata oo lkituaak o lpayiani, ore imasaa enyena pooki, neyai, ore ninye makewan, neiwuang'ieki te umata o yararot ootorrinyunye.

English: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered themselves together unto Jerusalem within three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people sat in the street of the house of God, trembling because of this matter, and for the great rain.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o Benchamen, neiturrurro te Yerusalem too nkolong'i uni, naa olapa lioudo apa ilo e nkolong e tikitam o lapa. Netoni iltung'ana pooki to lkurroto otumoreki te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, eikirikira te nkaraki ena bae o tenkaraki enchan sapuk.

English: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
Masaai: Neitashe Esra ilo apolosani nejoki ninche, “Itigila intae inkitanapat niyama nkituaak oo loreren, nitoponaitie enkitarrurroto te Israel.

English: Now therefore make confession unto the LORD God of your fathers, and do his pleasure: and separate yourselves from the people of the land, and from the strange wives.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entobira enkirridunoto to Laitoriani Enkai oo loo papaai linyi, niasiasa eyieunoto enye. Entegelari maate entung'uai iltung'ana lena kop, ning'uaa nkituaak enye.”

English: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
Masaai: Newal eumata pooki to ltoilo sapuk aajo, “Neijia etiu, meeta nchere keitu iyiook kiaas anaa enitejo.

English: But the people are many, and it is a time of much rain, and we are not able to stand without, neither is this a work of one day or two: for we are many that have transgressed in this thing.
Masaai: Kake aikumok iltung'ana, naa erishata e nchan sapuk, mikindim iyiook aaitasho tena kisiajata. Ore sii ena siaai, neme ene nkolong nabo anaa nkolong'i are, amu kintarruoitie iyiook oleng tena bae.

English: Let now our rulers of all the congregation stand, and let all them which have taken strange wives in our cities come at appointed times, and with them the elders of every city, and the judges thereof, until the fierce wrath of our God for this matter be turned from us.
Masaai: Nchoo ilkituaak lang eitashe te rishata e umata pooki, naa nchoo pooki tiatua nkanas ang apa oowaita nkituaak oo loreren epuonu too rishat naategeluaki, ore ilpayiani o larishak te pooki anasa neaku tenebo ninche, ometaba anaa neibelekenya engoro napi e Nkai ang aing'uaa iyiook.”

English: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah were employed about this matter: and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
Masaai: Yonatan ake olayioni le Asahel o Yohaseia olayioni le Tikfa otanya ena, ore Meshulam o Shebetai, ilo le Lawi, neibung'are ninche.

English: And the children of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain chief of the fathers, after the house of their fathers, and all of them by their names, were separated, and sat down in the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.
Masaai: Neas lelo yarunot apa ootorrinyunye ina. Negelu Esra olapolosani iltung'ana, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo menye, ore ake pooki ng'ae te ninche neigeri enkarna enye. Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le tomon netoni ninche pee ejurru ina bae.

English: And they made an end with all the men that had taken strange wives by the first day of the first month.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya o lapa le dukuya nebau ninche eneiting'ie lelo lewa apa ooyama nkituaak oo loreren.

English: And among the sons of the priests there were found that had taken strange wives: namely, of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren; Maaseiah, and Eliezer, and Jarib, and Gedaliah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok loo lapolosak apa ooyama nkituaak oo loreren, netumi, Maaseia, o Eliesa, o Yarib, o Gedaia, loo layiok le Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak, o lalashera lenyena.

English: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
Masaai: Etonyorraitie ninche maate pee eiwuang'ie nena kituaak enye oo loreren, ore apa olasar lenye le nkitarruorroto naa olmeregesh le luaata oo ntare te nkaraki enkitarrurroto enye.

English: And of the sons of Immer; Hanani, and Zebadiah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Imer netumi Hanani o Sebadia.

English: And of the sons of Harim; Maaseiah, and Elijah, and Shemaiah, and Jehiel, and Uzziah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Harim, netumi Maaseia, o Eliya, o Shemaia, o Yehiel o Usia.

English: And of the sons of Pashur; Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethaneel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Pashur: netumi Elioenai, o Maaseia, o Ishmael, o Natanael o Yosabad, o Elasa.

English: Also of the Levites; Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah, (the same is Kelita,) Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi: netumi Yosabad o Shimei o Kelaia, (aa taa Kelita) o Petahia, o Yuda, O Eliesa.

English: Of the singers also; Eliashib: and of the porters; Shallum, and Telem, and Uri.
Masaai: Ore too laranyak, netumi: Eliashib. Ore too larripok loo nchomito netumi: Shalum, o Telem, o Uri.

English: Moreover of Israel: of the sons of Parosh; Ramiah, and Jeziah, and Malchiah, and Miamin, and Eleazar, and Malchijah, and Benaiah.
Masaai: Ore te Israel: too layiok le Parosh netumi: Ramia, o Isia, o Malkija, o Mijamin, o Eleasa, o Hashabia o Benaia.

English: And of the sons of Elam; Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, and Abdi, and Jeremoth, and Eliah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Elam netumi: Matania, o Sekaria, o Yehiel, o Abdi, o Yeremot o Eliya.

English: And of the sons of Zattu; Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth, and Zabad, and Aziza.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Satu netumi: Elioenai, o Eliashib, o Matania, o Yeremot o Sabad, o Asisa.

English: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bebai naa Yehohanan, o Hanania, o Sabai, o Atalia.

English: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bani naa Meshulam, o Maluk, o Adaia, o Yashub, o Sheal, o Yeremot.

English: And of the sons of Pahath-moab; Adna, and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezaleel, and Binnui, and Manasseh.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Pahat-moab: netumi Adna, o Chelai, o Benania o Maaseia, o Matania, o Besalel, o Binui o Manase.

English: And of the sons of Harim; Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchiah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Harim: naa Eliesa o Ishija, o Malkija, o Shemaia, o Shimeon,

English: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
Masaai: o Benchamen, o Maluk, o Shemaia.

English: Of the sons of Hashum; Mattenai, Mattathah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Hashum: naa Matenai, o Matata, o Sabad, o Elifelet, o Yeremai, o Manase o Shimei.

English: Of the sons of Bani; Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Bani: naa Maadai, o Amram, o Uel,

English: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Chelluh,
Masaai: O Benania, o Bedeia, o Cheluki,

English: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Masaai: o Fenia, o Meremot, o Eliashib,

English: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasau,
Masaai: o Matania, o Matenai, o Yaasil.

English: And Bani, and Binnui, Shimei,
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Binui: naa Shimei,

English: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
Masaai: o Shelania, o Natan, o Adaia,

English: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Masaai: o Maknadebai, o Sheshai, o Sherai

English: PrAzareel, and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Masaai: o Asarel o Shelemia, o Shemaia,

English: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
Masaai: o Shalum, o Amaria, o Yosef.

English: Of the sons of Nebo; Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jadau, and Joel, Benaiah.
Masaai: Ore too layiok le Nebor: naa Yeil o Matitia, o Sabad, o Sebina, o Yadai, o Yoel, o Benaia.

English: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
Masaai: Eyama apa kulo pooki nkituaak oo loreren, neiwuang'ie ninche tenebo nkera enye.

English: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hachaliah. And it came to pass in the month Chisleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,
Masaai: Irorei le Nehemia kulo olayioni le Hekalia. Ore apa to lapa oji ole Kislep, to lari le tikitam, atii nanu Susa ina ang kitok,

English: That Hanani, one of my brethren, came, he and certain men of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped, which were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
Masaai: nelotu Hananai obo loo lalashera laainei tenebo kulikae tung'ana eing'uaa Yuda. Naikilikuan nanu ninche mbaa naaipirta lelo Yahudi ootelekutua, lelo apa ooimishote te yararoto, naikilikuan sii mbaa naapirta Yerusalem.

English: And they said unto me, The remnant that are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach: the wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and the gates thereof are burned with fire.
Masaai: Naajoki ninche nanu, “Ore lelo lekunot ootii olkerenket, apa ooimishote te yararoto, neeta enyamali sapuk o enkurruna. Etuurori esuntai e Yerusalem, ore nchomito enyena netumuta enkima.”

English: And it came to pass, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days, and fasted, and prayed before the God of heaven,
Masaai: Ore ake pee aning kulo rorei naton aishir, naisinanuo nkolong'i kumok; nabik nanu apukoo naomon te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai e shumata.

English: And said, I beseech thee, O LORD God of heaven, the great and terrible God, that keepeth covenant and mercy for them that love him and observe his commandments:
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Olaitoriani, Enkai e shumata, Enkai kitok naitureisho naibung osotua o enyorrata nauno, te lelo oonyor ninye, neibung nkitanapat enyena.

English: Let thine ear now be attentive, and thine eyes open, that thou mayest hear the prayer of thy servant, which I pray before thee now, day and night, for the children of Israel thy servants, and confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against thee: both I and my father's house have sinned.
Masaai: Nchoo enkiok ino einining, nincho nkonyek inono eing'orisho, pee ining enkomono o sinka lino, naomon taata nanu te dukuya iyie, dama o kewarie, te nkaraki iltung'ana linono le Israel, isinkan linono, airridu ing'ok oo ltung'ana le Israel, nikitaasa iyiook tialo iyie. Ee ore nanu o enkaji e papaai lai nikitaasa eng'oki.

English: We have dealt very corruptly against thee, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the judgments, which thou commandedst thy servant Moses.
Masaai: Kitaasa iyiook entorroni oleng tialo iyie, neitu kimbung nkitanapat, o nkiguanat, o nkikoot apa nintanapa osinka lino Musa.

English: Remember, I beseech thee, the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses, saying, If ye transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
Masaai: Tadamu ilo rorei apa lintanapa osinka lino Musa, ijo, ‘Tenirara intae ilemeisiligayu, nalo nanu aidapash intae tiatua iloreren.

English: But if ye turn unto me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though there were of you cast out unto the uttermost part of the heaven, yet will I gather them from thence, and will bring them unto the place that I have chosen to set my name there.
Masaai: Kake tenikirrinyokinono intae nanu nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei, niasiaasa ninche, ore hoo neba enkidapashari inyi anaa nkatampo te lakuani, kaiturur nanu ninche tene, nayau ninche ine wueji nategelua, pee aisho enkarna ai metobiko teine.’

English: Now these are thy servants and thy people, whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power, and by thy strong hand.
Masaai: Isinkan linono ninche naa iltung'ana linono, lelo litokordua iyie te ngolon ino kitok, o te nkaina ino nagol.

English: O Lord, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, nchoo enkiok ino metoning'o enkomono o sinka lino, o enkomono oo sinkan linono, ooshipakino euriata e nkarna ino. Nchoo enkishuroto osinka lino ena olong, nincho ninye olng'ur too nkonyek ele tung'ani.” Ara apa nanu olanapani le nkikompe o laiguanani.

English: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.
Masaai: Ore apa to lapa le Nisan to lari le tomon oare le nkitoria o laiguanani Artaserses, ina kata apa etii enaisho dukuya ninye, naya nanu enaisho alo aisho olaiguanani. Neitu ae kata nanu aaku olemeshipa te dukuya Olaiguanani.

English: Wherefore the king said unto me, Why is thy countenance sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very sore afraid,
Masaai: Naajoki nanu olaiguanani, “Kainyoo pee eeta enkomom ino osina, nadolita ajo mimuoi? Meeta ae toki osina lo ltau ele.” Nairut nanu oleng.

English: And said unto the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my countenance be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers' sepulchres, lieth waste, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire?
Masaai: Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Metobikoi olaiguanani ntarasi! Kainyoo pee meisinanuo enkomom ai, aa ore enkanasa, ine netii nkuraren oo loo papa, netaa olmuate, ore nchomito enyena, netumuta enkima?”

English: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
Masaai: Naaitoki nanu olaiguanani ajoki, “Naa kainyoo iyie iomonu?” Naomon nanu Enkai e keper.

English: And I said unto the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight, that thou wouldest send me unto Judah, unto the city of my fathers' sepulchres, that I may build it.
Masaai: Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, naa tenenoto osinka lino omom too nkonyek inono, pee kirriwaa nanu mashomo Yuda, ina anasa natii nkuraren oo loo papa, pee alo ashet.”

English: And the king said unto me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu olaiguanani, etii enkitok o olaiguanani embata enye etonita, “Kenkata nabaa iyie ilo naa kanu ishukunye?” Tenaa taa keitiship olaiguanani pee aairriwaa nanu, naa kadung'oki ninye enkata.

English: Moreover I said unto the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may convey me over till I come into Judah;
Masaai: Najoki nanu olaiguanani, “Tenaa keitiship olaiguanani, nchoo nanu maaishori mpala nayaki ilbalusuni le lido kekun otii lido kerenket olkeju, pee aaisho ninche nanu maima ina kop o matabai Yuda;

English: And a letter unto Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the palace which appertained to the house, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.
Masaai: neishoruni sii imapala naayakini Asaf ilo aing'urani le ntim o laiguanani, pee aatum nanu aishoo mbaoi naitobirie iloom te nkaraki nena shomito o sempewuet le nkaji e Nkai, o esuntai pooki e nkanasa, o ina aji nalo nanu amany.” Naaisho nanu olaiguanani nena pooki naatoomonuo, amu etii apa enkaina supat o laitoriani shumata nanu.

English: Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu alotu ilo kerenket le lelo balusuni ootii lido kekun o lkeju, naisho ninche nena pala o laiguanani. Neirriwayie apa olaiguanani tenebo nanu ilkituaak le njore o lakedok loo mbartan.

English: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening' Sanbalat le Heroni ena, o Tobia ilo sinka, ilo le Amori, neitagor ninche oleng' pee ening nchere, eewuo oltung'ani obo aing'oru olmabarishoi loo nkera e Israel.

English: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.
Masaai: Metaa aeuo apa nanu Yerusalem naton teine nkolong'i uni.

English: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God had put in my heart to do at Jerusalem: neither was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu adumunye kewarie, nanu o lkuti tung'ana apa ootii tenebo nanu; neitu nanu aliki oltung'ani hoo obo, ina natipika Enkai ai atua oltau lai, pee alo aitaas Yerusalem. Meetae apa eng'ues natii ine meteleku ake ina apa natakedo alotunye.

English: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
Masaai: Ashomo apa nanu auluo kewarie aim kishomi enkalo o Erata nalo olchorro loo mbariak, o kishomi e Modioi. Naing'or nanu asipu isunta e Yerusalem apa naaturori, tenebo o nchomito enyena apa naatumuta e nkima.

English: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu alo kishomi e nkong'u enkare o lchorro lo laiguanani; kake meetae apa ewueji neeim ina ng'ues nakedito nanu teine.

English: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu alo kewarie aim embata o erata, naing'or asipu ina suntai. Naitoki nanu aibelekenya najing kishomi natii enkalo o erata. Naitoki arrinyunye.

English: And the rulers knew not whither I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest that did the work.
Masaai: Neitu apa eyiolou lelo tung'ana kituaak aajo kaji nanu ashomo anaa kaa aasita; neton apa nanu eitu aliki Ilyahudi, o lapolosak, o ltung'ana le nkaji e nkitoo, o lkulikae kituaak, o lelo kulikae laa ninche oas esiaai.

English: Then said I unto them, Ye see the distress that we are in, how Jerusalem lieth waste, and the gates thereof are burned with fire: come, and let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we be no more a reproach.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki ninche, “Idolitata ena nyamali nikitii iyiook atua, entodol aajo eirragita Yerusalem aa olmuate, netapejoki nchomito enyena. Wootu mateshet iyiook esuntai e Yerusalem, peemikingil aata esulare.”

English: Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king's words that he had spoken unto me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.
Masaai: Naliki nanu ninche ina aina e Nkai ai oshi natii shumata nanu, naliki sii lelo rorei laairorie nanu olaiguanani. Nejo ninche, “Matudumunye iyiook aashet.” Neaku eitagolo ninche nkaik enye tenkaraki ina siaai sidai.

English: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Sanbalat le Heroni o Tobia ilo sinka, le Amoni o Geshem ilo marabui ina, nekueniyie iyiook, nemenaa iyiook nejo, “Kainyoo ena toki niaasitata intae?” Aigolong'akiki intae olaiguanani?

English: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu awaliki ninche ajoki, “Ore Enkai e shumata keisho iyiook matudupoto, naa ore iyiook isinkan lenyena aikidumunye aashetisho. Kake ore intae miaatata erubata, anaa esipata, anaa endamunoto te Yerusalem.”

English: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests, and they builded the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up the doors of it; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it, unto the tower of Hananeel.
Masaai: Nedumunye Eliashib ilo apolosani kitok, tenebo ilalashera lenyena, lelo apolosak, neshet ninche kishomi oo nkerra. Neitisiny ninche ina kishomi, nepik nkikeneta enyena. Neitisiny ninche ina kishomi o meitabaiki oltalet le iip nelo abaiki oltalet le Hananel.

English: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho. And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninye neshet Iltung'ana le Yeriko. Ore enetashare ninche neshet Sakar olayioni le Imri.

English: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build, who also laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hasena neshet kishomi oo sinkir; eitoluaa ninche iloom, nepik nkikeneta enyena o lmushumaani lenyena, o sekenke enyena.

English: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah, the son of Koz. And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabeel. And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baana.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir aram Meremot olayioni le Uria, olayioni le Hakos. Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Meshulam olayioni le Berekia, olayioni le Meshesabel. Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Sadok olayioni le Baana.

English: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aaram iltung'ana le Tekoa, kake ore lelo kituaak lenye eitu ninche epik imurto ina siaai o Laitoriani lenye.

English: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah, and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah; they laid the beams thereof, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
Masaai: Ore Yoida olayioni le Pasea o Mehulam olayioni le Besodia, neitobir aaram enkishomi musana. Nepik iloom lenyena o nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena; o sekenke enyena.

English: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, unto the throne of the governor on this side the river.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir aram Melatia le Gebeon o Yadon le Meron, o ltung'ana le Gebeon o le Mispa, apa ootii abori enkitoria o lbalusui leilo kerenket te lido kekun o lkeju.

English: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche neitobir aram Usiel olayioni le Harbaia, ilo kunoni. Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Hanania, ilo obo loo laitobirak loo sonkoyoni; Neshet ninche Yerusalem o meitabaiki e suntai dapash.

English: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninche, neitobir Aram Refaia olayioni le Huri, ilo aitoriani le nchoto e Yerusalem.

English: And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph, even over against his house. And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah.
Masaai: Ore olotashare ninche neitobir aram Yedia olayioni le Harumap, ina kipirakinoto e nkaji enye. Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Hatush olayioni le Hashabneia.

English: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahath-moab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
Masaai: Ore Malkija olayioni le Harim o Hashub olayioni le Pahat Moab neitobir aaram enkae rishata tenebo oltalet lo lkokuet.

English: And next unto him repaired Shallum the son of Halohesh, the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem, he and his daughters.
Masaai: Ore enetashare ninye neitobir aram Shalum olayioni le Halohesh, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo e Yerusalem, neshet ninye o ntoyie enyena.

English: The valley gate repaired Hanun, and the inhabitants of Zanoah; they built it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate.
Masaai: Ore Hanam o lelo oomanya Senoa, neitobir aaram enkishomi o erata; neshetu ninche ninye nepik nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena o sekenke enyena, neram ntemat e nkaina e nkalifu nabo e suntai, o meitabaiki kishomi e modioi.

English: But the dung gate repaired Malchiah the son of Rechab, the ruler of part of Beth-haccerem; he build it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof.
Masaai: Ore Malkija olayioni le Rekab, ilo aitoriani lo lkerenket le Bethashekem, neitobir aram enkishomi e modioi, neitoki ashet ninye nepik nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena, o sekenke enyena.

English: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of part of Mizpah; he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, the locks thereof, and the bars thereof, and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king's garden, and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David.
Masaai: Ore Shalum olayioni le Galhose, ilo aitoriani lo lkerenket le Mispa neram aitobir, enkishomi e nkong'u enkare. Etesheta ninye neimulumul nepik nkikeneta enyena, o lmushumaani lenyena, o sekenke enyena. Neshet ninye esuntai o lchorro le Shela, le nkurma o laiguanani, omeitabaiki nkedeta naadoyio aapuo enkanasa e Daudi.

English: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Bethzur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye, neitobir aram Nehemia olayioni le Asbak, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo o lkerenket le Betsar o meitabaiki enkipirakinoto oo nkuraren e Daudi, o meitabaiki olchorro oitobiruaki, o meitabaiki enkaji oo ltung'ana magil.

English: After him repaired the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani. Next unto him repaired Hashabiah, the ruler of the half part of Keilah, in his part.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir Ilawi aaram: Reham olayioni le Bani; ore te siadi ninye naa Shashabia, ilo aitoriani lo lpisiaai lo lkerenket le Keila, neram aitobir olkerenket lenye.

English: After him repaired their brethren, Bavai the son of Henadad, the ruler of the half part of Keilah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aaram ilalashera lenye; Bafai olayioni le Hanadad, ilo aitoriani le nchoto nabo o lkerenket le Keila;

English: And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall.
Masaai: ore olosujaki ninye naa Eser olayioni le Yoshua, ilo aitoriani le Mispa, neitobir aram enkae rishata, enkipirakinoto e wueji neshumieki imasaa o larrabal teine nelojare e suntai.

English: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece, from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Baruk enkae rishata ebaiki elojata e suntai o meitabaiki kutukaji e nkaji e Eliaship ilo apolosani kitok.

English: After him repaired Meremoth the son of Urijah the son of Koz another piece, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Meremot olayioni le Uria, olayioni le Hakos oitobira enkae rishata, ebaiki kutukaji e nkaji e Eliab o metabaiki enkiting'oto, e nkaji e Eliaship.

English: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa ilapolosak, lelo tung'ana le nkisiajata, ooitobira aaram.

English: After him repaired Benjamin and Hashub over against their house. After him repaired Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah by his house.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninche neitobir aaram Benchamen o Hashab enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye. Ore te siadi ninche neitobir aram Asaria olayioni le Maaseia, olayioni le Anania embata e nkaji enye makewan.

English: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece, from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall, even unto the corner.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye naa Benui olayioni le Hanadad oitobira aram enkae rishata, ebaiki enkaji e Asaria ometabaiki elojata e suntai.

English: Palal the son of Uzai, over against the turning of the wall, and the tower which lieth out from the king's high house, that was by the court of the prison. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh.
Masaai: Nelo abaiki olpijata. Ore Palal olayioni le Usai neitobir aram enkipirakinoto elojata o ilo talet oipang'u te nkaji e shumata o laiguanani to lgoriet le rripore. Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aaram Pedaia olayioni le Parosh,

English: Moreover the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel, unto the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that lieth out.
Masaai: tenebo ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai ootii Ofel ewueji neipirakinore kishomi e nkare, te nkalo o loo saen oilo talet oilep shumata.

English: After them the Tekoites repaired another piece, over against the great tower that lieth out, even unto the wall of Ophel.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir iltung'ana le Tekoa enkae rishata te nkipirakinoto eilo talet oilep shumata, o metabaiki esuntai e Ofel.

English: From above the horse gate repaired the priests, every one over against his house.
Masaai: Ore shumata enkishomi oo mbartan neitobir ilapolosak aaram, oltung'ani ake enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye makewan.

English: After them repaired Zadok the son of Immer over against his house. After him repaired also Shemaiah the son of Shechaniah, the keeper of the east gate.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninche neitobir aram Sadok olayioni le Imer enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye. Ore te siadi ninye neram Shemaia olayioni le Shekemia, ilo arriponi le kishomi e nkalo o loosaen.

English: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, another piece. After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Hanania olayioni le Shelemia, o Hanam ilo ayioni le ile le Selap neitobir aram enkae rishata. Ore te siadi ninye neitobir aram Meshalam olayioni le Berekia enkipirakinoto e nkaji enye.

English: After him repaired Malchiah the goldsmith's son unto the place of the Nethinims, and of the merchants, over against the gate Miphkad, and to the going up of the corner.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ninye, neshet aram Malkija obo loo lkunono omeitabaiki enkaji oo laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, o ewueji oo lamirak enkipirakinoto e kishomi e rripore, o meitabaiki enkaji e shumata natii olpijata.

English: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki olgilata le shumata o metabaiki kishomi oo nkerra, neitobir aaram ilkunono le sahabu.

English: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall, he was wroth, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.
Masaai: Ore apa pee ening Sanbalat nchere kishetita iyiook esuntai negoro oleng, neim engoro enye oleng. Nesurdaany ninye Ilyahudi.

English: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?
Masaai: Nejo ninye te dukuya ilalashera lenyena, o te dukuya enjore e Samaria, “Kainyoo easita kulo Yahudi tashala? Keigil ninche aaitobir ntokitin? Keigil ninche aapolosisho? Keidip ninche te nkolong nabo? Keigil ninche aaiturrur isoito, aaitayu teilo sototi loo suut naapejore.

English: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
Masaai: Netii apa Tobia olayioni le Amori embata enye, nejo ninye, “Ee, ore ina nashetita ninche, tenelo embarie shumata ninye, neuroo ina suntai enye oo soito!”

English: Hear, O our God; for we are despised: and turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them for a prey in the land of captivity:
Masaai: Naomon nanu najo, “Toning'o na Ai ang, amu etemenaki iyiook; mbelekenya iyie esurdaanyata enye meeu shumata ilukuny enye maate, naa nchoo ninche meitoroki teina kop enye e yararoto.

English: And cover not their iniquity, and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee: for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders.
Masaai: Mintemoo iyie enkitarruorroto enye, nimincho metujuti eng'oki enye metujuti aaiwuang'ie too nkonyek inono. Amu kintagoro ninche iyie te dukuya ilashetak.”

English: So built we the wall; and all the wall was joined together unto the half thereof: for the people had a mind to work.
Masaai: Ina pee kishet iyiook esuntai; neiruburuba esuntai pooki tenebo, to lpisiaai le nkadoro enye. Amu eeta apa lelo tung'ana endamunoto pee eas esiaai.

English: But it came to pass, that when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites, heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and that the breaches began to be stopped, then they were very wroth,
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Sanbalat, o Tobia, o Lmarabu, o Lamori le Ashdod nchere eloito dukuya e ramata e suntai e Yerusalem, netunukaki ilusien enyena, negoro ninche oleng.

English: And conspired all of them together to come and to fight against Jerusalem, and to hinder it.
Masaai: Neitobir ninche tenebo pee erasaki Yerusalem neyau olmilo atua ninye.

English: Nevertheless we made our prayer unto our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.
Masaai: Nikiomon iyiook Enkai ang, nikipik ilarripok ooibooyo ninche, dama o kewarie.

English: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.
Masaai: Kake etejo apa Yuda, “Eishunye engolon oo lanapak loo lolan, naa kumok isuut, mikindim iyiook aateshet esuntai.”

English: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
Masaai: Nejo ilmang'ati lang, “Meyiolou ninche toki, anaa edolisho, ometaba anaa nikipuonu empolos enye, nikiaar ninche metuata, nikintasheyie esiaai.”

English: And it came to pass, that when the Jews which dwelt by them came, they said unto us ten times, From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu lelo Yahudi apa ootashare ninche, nejoki ninche iyiook katitin tomon, ore too wuejitin pooki neemanya ninche, nepuonu ninche aagilunore iyiook.

English: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall, and on the higher places, I even set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
Masaai: Neaku ore too wuejitin neegum oorishat e oriong e suntai, too loingengen, atipika nanu iltung'ana te risioroto oo lmareita lenye, eeta ilalema, o remeta enye o nkai enye.

English: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
Masaai: Naing'orisho nanu, nadumunye, najoki lelo kituaak, o larikok, o lkulikae tung'ana, “Emiureyu ninche. Entadamu Olaitoriani, laa ninye olkitok neitureisho, naa ninye omitu ilalashera linyi, o layiok linyi, o ntoyie inyi, o nkituaak inyi, o nkang'itie inyi.”

English: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that it was known unto us, and God had brought their counsel to nought, that we returned all of us to the wall, every one unto his work.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilmang'ati lang nchere kitayioloito nena kitobirat enye, neibooyie Olaitoriani, nikirrinyokino pooki esuntai, nelo ake oltung'ani esiaai enye.

English: And it came to pass from that time forth, that the half of my servants wrought in the work, and the other half of them held both the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the habergeons; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina olong neito idia alo, ore olpisiaai loo laisiaayiak laainei neas esiaai e nchetare, neibung likae pisiaai iremeta, o long'oi o nkai, o nkilani oo lgooitie, neitashe ilarikok tioriong enkaji pooki e Yuda,

English: They which builded on the wall, and they that bare burdens, with those that laded, every one with one of his hands wrought in the work, and with the other hand held a weapon.
Masaai: laa ninche apa ooshetita esuntai. Ore lelo oonap ilolan, neitanapi te nkaina nabo ilolan ore te nkae aina neibung imasaa o larrabal.

English: For the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded. And he that sounded the trumpet was by me.
Masaai: Ore ake obo loo lashetak, neenita olalem te mpolos enye eshetisho. Ore ilo tung'ani apa oosh entarumpeta naatashare nanu.

English: And I said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, The work is great and large, and we are separated upon the wall, one far from another.
Masaai: Najoki nanu lelo kituaak, o larikok, o lkulikae tung'ana pooki, “Aisapuk esiaai, netalala oleng, neidapasha iyiook esuntai, kitalamate maate.

English: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet, resort ye thither unto us: our God shall fight for us.
Masaai: Ore te wueji nining'ieng'ie oltoilo le ntarumpeta, enkuetu ene nikitii. Kearisho Enkai ang te rishata ang.”

English: So we laboured in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared.
Masaai: Neaku kitaasishote iyiook teina siaai, ore olpisiaai loo ltung'ana, neibung iremeta ebaiki tadekenya o metaliooto ilakir teipa.

English: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people, Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and labour on the day.
Masaai: Atiaaka sii apa iltung'ana, “Nchoo pooki tung'ani o sinka lenye eirrag Yerusalem, pee etum aatorrip iyiook kewarie, neidim aataasisho dama.”

English: So neither I, nor my brethren, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard which followed me, none of us put off our clothes, saving that every one put them off for washing.
Masaai: Metaa mme nanu, neme lalashera laainei, neme isinkan laainei, neme larripok laasujita nanu, meetae hoo obo oitayio nkilani enyena; neibung'ita ake oltung'ani imasaa enyena o larrabal te nkainaenye.

English: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews.
Masaai: Nedumunye apa olkiyioi kitok loo ltung'ana o nkituaak enye, te nkaraki Ilyahudi alashera lenye.

English: For there were that said, We, our sons, and our daughters, are many: therefore we take up corn for them, that we may eat, and live.
Masaai: Amu etii apa lelo oojo, “Ore iyiook tenebo ilayiok lang o ntoyie ang naa eikira kumok, maing'oru iyiook entapa pee kitum aainosa nikinchu.”

English: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.
Masaai: Eetae sii apa lelo oojo, “Kiteena te sile nkurman ang, o nkurman ang oo sabibu o nkajijik ang, pee kitum entapa te nkaraki olameyu.”

English: There were also that said, We have borrowed money for the king's tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.
Masaai: Netii sii lelo oojo, “Kisilenoitie mpisai te kodi o laiguanani te nkaraki nkurman ang o nkurman ang oo sabibu.

English: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren, our children as their children: and, lo, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already: neither is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.
Masaai: Etotiutuo taata iseseni lang anaa iseseni loo lalashera lang; netotiutuo nkera ang anaa nkera enye; eji neton ake kirrumoki ilayiok lang o ntoyie ang metaa rrindiki; ore kulie oo ntoyie ang neidipaki aaitaa rrindiki; amu mikiaata engolon nikiretunye. Amu ewaita kulikae tung'ana nkurman ang o nkurman ang o sabibu.”

English: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
Masaai: Atagore apa oleng pee aning olkiyioi lenye o kulo rorei.

English: Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
Masaai: Aiguane nanu makewan, nadung'oki enkiguana lelo kituaak o larikok. Najoki nanu ninche, “Ntulusoitie elaakinoto e dupoto o ltung'ani ake olalashe lenye.” Naibung ina umata kitok agilunore ninche,

English: And I said unto them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, which were sold unto the heathen; and will ye even sell your brethren? or shall they be sold unto us? Then held they their peace, and found nothing to answer.
Masaai: najoki ninche, “Ore iyiook anaa enikindim nikinyiang'utua aarrinyu ilyahudi alashera lang apa ootimirakaki iloreren; kake eji imir iyie ilalashera linono eji pee etumi aatimiraki iyiook!” Etigirate ninche neitu etum ororei owalu.

English: Also I said, It is not good that ye do: ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies?
Masaai: Kaae najo nanu, “Ore ina bae niaasitata intae neme sidai. Aimeishiaakino intae nipuopuo te uriata e Nkai ang, pee imbooyoyo nkinyalat e lelo oshon mang'ati lang?

English: I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, might exact of them money and corn: I pray you, let us leave off this usury.
Masaai: Ore ake sii nanu o lalashera laainei nikisilenoki ninche mpisai o entapa. Matung'uai iyiook ena dupoto.

English: Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.
Masaai: Entorrinyoki ninche ena olong taata nkurman enye, o nkurman enye oo sabibu, o nkurman enye oo loirienito, o nkajijik enye, o maaip oo ropiyiani enye, o entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o ina ilata apa niwaita aaitung'uaa ninche.”

English: Then said they, We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do as thou sayest. Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they should do according to this promise.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajo, “Eikirrinyu iyiook kuna nimikinkilikuanu toki te ninche. Eikiaas iyiook anaa enijo.” Naipotu nanu ilapolosak nainosie ninche olmumai pee eas anaa enaisiligishore.

English: Also I shook my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, that performeth not this promise, even thus be he shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the LORD. And the people did according to this promise.
Masaai: Naitoki sii aipirripir enkila ai, najo, “Meikuna neijia Enkai aipiripiroo pooki tung'ani te nkaji enye, o te siaai enye tenemeitabaya ena kisiligata. Meipiripiri ninye neitoroki.” Nejo eumata pooki, “Esai” Neisis Olaitoriani. Neas lelo tung'ana aanaa enaisiligishore ninche.

English: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even unto the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brethren have not eaten the bread of the governor.
Masaai: Ore ake sii ebaiki ina kata apa naageluni mataa olbalusui te nkop e Yuda, ebaiki olari le tikitam o metabaiki olari le tomoni uni o are le nkitoria e Arteserses ilo aiguanani, ilarin tomon o are, eitu nanu o lalashera laainei aainos ina daa o lbalusui.

English: But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people, and had taken of them bread and wine, beside forty shekels of silver; yea, even their servants bare rule over the people: but so did not I, because of the fear of God.
Masaai: Ore lelo balusuni apa le dukuya ootii te dukuya nanu neitanap iltung'ana ilolan ooiroishi, neoru ninche endaa o enaisho oo sabibu, metii shekeli artam e nkosholai. Neitore sii isinkan lenye olorere. Kake eitu nanu aas ina, te nkaraki euriata e Nkai.

English: Yea, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work.
Masaai: Aibung'a sii apa enchetata ena suntai, neitu aing'oru enkop. Ore isinkan laainei pooki neiturrurro teine tenkaraki esiaai.

English: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers, beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us.
Masaai: Ore ake sii etii apa emisa ai iltung'ana iip nabo o onom, Ilyahudi o lkituaak metii lelo apa ooetuo enikitii eing'uaa lelo oreren oomanita iyiook.

English: Now that which was prepared for me daily was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.
Masaai: Ore apa endaa naitobiri te nkolong nabo naa olkiteng obo o nkerra ile gelunot; eitobiraki sii apa ilukunkuni te nkaraki nanu. Ore ake too nkolong'i tomon netii ilbenia le naisho oo sabibu te nkumoi; ore ake etii kuna pooki eitu nanu aikilikuanu endaa naipirare olbalusui, amu keiroishi apa esinkaisho te kulo tung'ana.

English: Think upon me, my God, for good, according to all that I have done for this people.
Masaai: Tadamu te nkaraki esupatisho tialo nanu na Ai ai, nena pooki nataasa te nkaraki kulo tung'ana.

English: Now it came to pass, when Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had builded the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)
Masaai: Ore apa pee elikini Sanbalat o Tobia le Geshem ilo Marabui o kulikae mang'ati lang nchere atesheta nanu ina esuntai nemeekure etii olong'eng'e, hoo naa ore ebaiki ina kata eton eitu apik nkikeneta e kishomi,

English: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me, saying, Come, let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
Masaai: naairriwaki Sanbalat o Geshem olkilikuai ejo, “Wou manototo tenebo te nkang nabo e nkisiajata e Ono.” Kake keyieu apa ninche naaitaas entorrono.

English: And I sent messengers unto them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?
Masaai: Airriwaka nanu ninche ilkiliku ajoki, “Aasita esiaai kitok nemaidim aeu. Kainyoo pee eitashe esiaai eji pee alotu enitii?”

English: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort; and I answered them after the same manner.
Masaai: Naairriwaki ninche nanu ilkiliku katitin ong'uan aaiko nji, nawaliki ninche aiko nji.

English: Then sent Sanballat his servant unto me in like manner the fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
Masaai: Ore ake teina oitoi neirriu Sanbalat olkilikuai lenye te nkata e imiet, nereu olaisiaayiani lenye eeta empalai nabolo te nkaina enye.

English: Wherein was written, It is reported among the heathen, and Gashmu saith it, that thou and the Jews think to rebel: for which cause thou buildest the wall, that thou mayest be their king, according to these words.
Masaai: Ore tiatua ina palai neigero, ajo, “Etolimuoki tiatua iloshon, netejo sii Geshem neijia, nchere ore iyie o Lyahudi nintobiritata pee iseriser ina pee ishetitata esuntai, naa ijo pee iyaku olaiguanani lenye te risioroto eina limunoto.

English: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem, saying, There is a king in Judah: and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.
Masaai: Itegelua sii iloibonok pee eibalie aalimu mbaa naaipirta Yerusalem, ‘Etii olaiguanani Yuda.’ Ore naa taata kelikini olaiguanani te risioroto e kulo rorei. Ore naa taata wou matoning'oto.”

English: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
Masaai: Nairriwaki nanu olkilikuai ajoki, “A-a, ore nena baa nijoito netaasate, amu iyie oipirua ninche too ndamunot inono.”

English: For they all made us afraid, saying, Their hands shall be weakened from the work, that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.
Masaai: Amu keyieu apa pooki neiture iyiook, edamu aajo, “Keidim nkaik enye aatalepori neitiak esiaai, nemeitokini aas” kake ore iyie na Ai ntagolo iyie nkaik aainei.

English: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
Masaai: Ore apa pee alo enkaji e Shemaia olayioni le Delaia, olayioni le Mehatabel, apa oikenoyioki, nejo ninye, “Manototo iyiook tenebo tiatua enkaji e Nkai, tiatua ewueji sinyati, nikinken nkikeneta e nkaji e Nkai; amu aikipuonu ninche aar iyie tua, kewarie kipuonu ninche aar iyie tua.”

English: And I said, Should such a man as I flee? and who is there, that, being as I am, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.
Masaai: Kake atiaaka nanu ninye, “Kaisik ailanyisho toltung'ani laaijo nanu? Ijo iyie kaitajeu enkishui ai tenalo aisudori tiatua enkaji e Nkai. Maas nanu ina.”

English: And, lo, I perceived that God had not sent him; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me: for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
Masaai: Nayiolou nanu aitisip, nadol ajo eitu eirriu Enkai ninche, kake eibalunye ninye enaibon pee aagilunore nanu, enkaraki naigero Tobia o Sanbalat ninye.

English: Therefore was he hired, that I should be afraid, and do so, and sin, and that they might have matter for an evil report, that they might reproach me.
Masaai: Tenkaraki ena bae apa eigeroki ninye pee aitukureti mataasa eng'oki tena oitoi, naatumoki ninche aaishoo enkarna torrono ejo pee aaitongu.

English: My God, think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.
Masaai: Tadamu Tobia o Sanbalat, na Ai ai te risioroto e kuna baa naataasa ninche, o enkoiboni sii naji No-adia o lelo kulikae oibonok laayieu naaitukuret.

English: So the wall was finished in the twenty and fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty and two days.
Masaai: Eidipe apa ina suntai te nkolong e tikitam o imiet o lapa oji le Israel Elul, too nkolong'i onom oare.

English: And it came to pass, that when all our enemies heard thereof, and all the heathen that were about us saw these things, they were much cast down in their own eyes: for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilmang'ati lang pooki ina, neirut iloshon pooki oomanita iyiook, neibung oloputukunyi kitok amu etumusutuo aajo etaasaki ena siaai te retoto e Nkai ang.

English: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah, and the letters of Tobiah came unto them.
Masaai: Ore ake sii apa te nena olong'i, eirriwaitie ilkituaak le Yuda mpala aairriwaki Tobia, neirriwaki sii ninye Tobia ninche mpala.

English: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him, because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah; and his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
Masaai: Amu ore apa iltung'ana kumok te Yuda neinosakinote olmumai o ninye, amu olaputani apa ninye le Shekania olayioni le Ara: naa olayioni lenye Yehohanan apa oyama entito e Meshulam, olayioni le Berekia.

English: Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
Masaai: Eimakita sii apa nkiaasin sidain te dukuya nanu, nepuo aaliki ninye irorei latejo. Naairriwaki Tobia mpala ejo pee aaiture.

English: Now it came to pass, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,
Masaai: Ore apa pee eidipayu esuntai naidipa nkikeneta oo nchomito, neidipaki aategelu ilarripok loo nchomito, o laranyak, o Lawi,

English: That I gave my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the ruler of the palace, charge over Jerusalem: for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.
Masaai: naisho nanu, olalashe lai Hanani o Hanania meitasheiki Yerusalem. Amu oltung'ani apa oisiligayu neure Enkai alang ilkumok.

English: And I said unto them, Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun be hot; and while they stand by, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, every one in his watch, and every one to be over against his house.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninche, “Emincho ake nchomito e Yerusalem eboli ometaba anaa neilepu enkolong; naa ore eton eitashe aarripisho nchoo ninche eiken nepik isekenke ooikenieki nchomito. Entegelu ilarripok tiatua lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neitashe ake pooki ng'ae te rishata enye, neipirare ake oltung'ani enkaji enye.”

English: Now the city was large and great: but the people were few therein, and the houses were not builded.
Masaai: Aisapuk apa ina anasa nelala, kake ore iltung'ana ootii atua naa kuti nemetii nkajijik naaidipaki aateshet.

English: And my God put into mine heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. And I found a register of the genealogy of them which came up at the first, and found written therein,
Masaai: Nepik apa Enkai ndamunot aainei pee aiturrur ilkituaak, o larikok, o ltung'ana pee eiger pooki anaa ntipati oo lmareita, lelo apa ootangasa aapuonu, natum nanu eigeroki aaiko nji:

English: These are the children of the province, that went up out of the captivity, of those that had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and came again to Jerusalem and to Judah, every one unto his city;
Masaai: Iltung'ana lo lkerenket kulo apa ooetuo eing'uaa eyararoto e lelo apa ootarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon nenap aya, etorrinyunye ninche Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye.

English: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
Masaai: Eetuo apa ninche tenebo Serubabel, o Yoshua, o Nehemia, o Asaria, o Raamia o Nahamani, o Mordekai, o Bilshan o Misparet o Bigfai, o Nehum o Baana. Ore esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel:

English: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Perosh, naa nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Shefatia naa iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oare.

English: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ara, naa iip ile o onomm oare.

English: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand and eight hundred and eighteen.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pahatmoab, aa taa ilayiok le Yoshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon o isiet.

English: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
