Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.

English: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Setu naa iip isiet o artam o imiet.

English: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Sakai, naa iip naapishana o ntomoni ile.

English: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Binui, naa iip ile o artam o isiet.

English: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bebai naa iip ile o tikitam o isiet.

English: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Asgad, naa nkalifuni are o iip uni o tikitam o are.

English: The children of Adonikam, six hundred threescore and seven.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adonikan naa iip ile ontomoni ile oopishana.

English: The children of Bigvai, two thousand threescore and seven.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Bigfai naa nkalifuni are o ntomoni naapishana.

English: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Adin naa iip ile o onomm o imiet.

English: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Ater, a taa ile Hesekia naa ntomoni naaudo o isiet.

English: The children of Hashum, three hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Hashum naa iip uni o tikitam o isiet.

English: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Besai, naa iip uni o tikitam o ong'uan.

English: The children of Hariph, an hundred and twelve.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Harif naa iip o tomon oare.

English: The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Gibeon naa ntomoni naaudo o imiet.

English: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Betlehem o Netofa naa iip ontomoni isiet o isiet.

English: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Anatot naa iip o tikitam o isiet.

English: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty and two.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Bet-asmapet naa artam oare.

English: The men of Kirjathjearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty and three.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Kiriat-yearim, Kepira o Beerot, naa iip naapishana o artam o kuni.

English: The men of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Rama o Geb, naa iip ile o tikitam o obo.

English: The men of Michmas, an hundred and twenty and two.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Mikmas naa iip o tikitam o are.

English: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai, naa iip o tikitam okuni.

English: The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le nkae Nebo naa onomm o are.

English: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le likae oji Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onomm o ong'uan.

English: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa iip uni o tikitam.

English: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yeriko naa iip uni o artam o imiet.

English: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and one.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Lod, Hadid o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o obo.

English: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred and thirty.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Senaa naa nkalifuni naapishana o iip naaudo o tomoni uni.

English: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Yedaia aa taa enkaji e Yoshua, naa iip naaudo o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.

English: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Imer, naa enkalifu nabo o onomm o are.

English: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Pashur, naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o artam o oopishana.

English: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Harim naa enkalifu nabo o tomon oopishana.

English: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, and of the children of Hodevah, seventy and four.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi: lelo ayiok le Yoshua, aa taa ile Kadmiel loo layiok le Hedefa, naa ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan.

English: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred forty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilaranyak lelo ayiok le Asaf, naa iip nabo o artam o isiet.

English: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, an hundred thirty and eight.
Masaai: Ore ilarripok loo nchomito: lelo ayiok le Shalum, ilayiok le Ater, lelo ayiok le Talmon, lelo ayiok le Akub, lelo ayiok le Hatita, lelo ayiok le Shobai, naa iip nabo o tomoni uni o isiet.

English: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hashupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
Masaai: Ore lelo aisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, lelo ayiok le Siha, lelo ayiok le Hasufa, lelo ayiok le Taabaot,

English: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Keros, lelo ayiok le Sia, lelo ayiok le Padon

English: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Shalmai,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Lebana, lelo ayiok le Hagaba lelo ayiok le Shalmai,

English: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Hanan, lelo ayiok le Gidel, lelo ayiok le Gahar,

English: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Reia, lelo ayiok le Resin, lelo ayiok le Nekoda,

English: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Phaseah,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Gesam, lelo ayiok le Usa, lelo ayiok le Pasea,

English: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephishesim,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Besai, lelo ayiok le Meunim, lelo ayiok le Nefushesim,

English: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Bakbuk, lelo ayiok le Hakufa, lelo ayiok le Hashur,

English: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Bashit, lelo ayiok le Mehida, lelo ayiok le Harsha,

English: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Tamah,
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Barkos lelo ayiok le Sisera, lelo ayiok le Tema,

English: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
Masaai: lelo ayiok le Nesia, lelo ayiok le Hatifa.

English: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
Masaai: Ore ilayiok loo sinkan le Solomon, ilayiok le Sotai, ilayiok le Soferet, ilayiok le Persida,

English: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
Masaai: ilayiok le Yaala, ilayiok le Darkon, ilayiok le Gidel,

English: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
Masaai: ilayiok le Shefatia, ilayiok le, Hatil, ilayiok le Pokeret-Lasebaim, lelo ayiok le Amon.

English: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
Masaai: Ore isinkan pooki le nkaji e Nkai, o sinkan loo layiok le Solomon pooki naa iip uni o ntomoni naaudo oare.

English: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
Masaai: Kulo oodukino apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, Telhasha, Keurub, Adon, o Imer, kake meidim apa ninche aaibalie ilmareita loo loo menye aashu ineeikino ninche, tenaa ke ltung'ana le Israel ninche.

English: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
Masaai: Ilayiok le Delaia, ilayiok le Tobia, ilayiok le Nekoda, naa iip ile o artam oare.

English: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
Masaai: Ore sii ilapolosak: lelo ayiok le Hobaia, lelo ayiok le Hakos, ilayiok le Barsilai, laa ninye apa oyama entito nabo too ntoyie e Barsilai le Gilead neaku ninche eipotieki).

English: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
Masaai: Eing'orutua kulo enkigeroto oo nkarn enye tenebo lelo ooigeroki too lmareita, kake eitu etumi teine, neaku etundung'oyioki too lapolosak aajo keiduruk;

English: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
Masaai: etiaaka olbalusui ninche pee mejing ninche enkinosata eina daa sinyati aisul, ometaba anaa nedumunye olapolosani oata Urim o Tummim.

English: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
Masaai: Ore apa eumata pooki tenebo naa nkalifuni artam oare o iip uni o ntomoni ile

English: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
Masaai: metii isinkan lenye lewa o sinkan enye ng'oruo, nera apa ninche nkalifuni naapishana o iip uni o ntomoni ile o opishana; neeta apa ninche ilaranyak iip are o artam o imiet, ilewa o ng'oruo.

English: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
Masaai: Ore mbartan enye naa iip naapishana o tomoni uni o ile. Ore inyumpui enye naa iip are o artam o imiet.

English: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
Masaai: Ore ntamesin enye naa iip ong'uan o tomoni uni o imiet. Ore isirkon lenye naa nkalifuni ile o iip naapishana o tikitam.

English: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.
Masaai: Ore apa ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo nkishorot tenkaraki esiaai. Eishooyie olbalusui apik olchumati nkiloi isiet e sahabu, o ngirran onomm, o lkilani loo lapolosak iip imiet o tomoni uni.

English: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pounds of silver.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae oora ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye neishooyo aapik olchumati le siaai sahabu nkiloi iip o ntomoni ile, o imiet, o enkosholai nkiloi enkalifu nabo o iip are o onomm.

English: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae tung'ana neishooyo sahabu nkiloi iip nabo o ntomoni ile o isiet, o nkiloi iip nabo o artam e nkosholai, o lkilani ntomoni ile oopishana loo lapolosak.

English: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilapolosak, lelo le Lawi, o larripok loo nchomito, o laranyak, o embata oo ltung'ana, o embata oo sinkan le nkaji e Nkai, o Siraeli pooki; netoni too nkang'itie enye. Ore pee ebau olapa liopishana, netii nkera e Israel nkang'itie enye maate.

English: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
Masaai: Neiturrurro iltung'ana pooki aatiu anaa oltung'ani obo to lkurroto ooipirakinore enkishomi e Nkare. Nejoki ninche Esra ilo aigeroni pee eyau embuku oo nkitanapat e Musa, apa naishoo Olaitoriani Israel.

English: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
Masaai: Ore Esra ilo apolosani neyau nena kitanapat dukuya ina umata, oo lewa o ng'oruo, o lelo pooki ooidim aatoning neyiolou, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa liopishana.

English: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
Masaai: Neisum ninye ina kitanapata eing'orita olkurroto eipirare kishomi e Nkare eiteru tadekenya enasirie o metabaiki dama eipire enkolong, te dukuya iltung'ana lelo lewa o ng'oruo o ltung'ana pooki ooidim aatoning'u nening'u lelo tung'ana too nkiyiaa enye ina buku oo nkitanapat.

English: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
Masaai: Neitashe Esra ilo aigeroni te nchumata ewueji oo nkeek neikarere neitobira iltung'ana te nkaraki ina siaai; ore te mbata enye neitashe Matitia o Shema, o Anaia, o Uria, o Hilkia o Maaseia te nkaina enye e tatene. Neitashe Pedaia o Mishael o Malkija, o Hashum o Hashbadana, o Sakaria, o Meshulam te nkaina enye e kedienye.

English: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
Masaai: Nebol Esra ina buku te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, amu etii apa ninye shumata iltung'ana pooki. Ore ake pee ebol ina buku neitashe iltung'ana pooki.

English: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
Masaai: Neisis Esra Olaitoriani, ina Ai kitok, newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Esai, Esai,” eilepie nkaik enye; neirrug ninche ilukuny enye neserem Olaitoriani eitabaiki nkomomi enye enkop.

English: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
Masaai: Ore sii Yoshua o Bani o Sherebia o Yamin, o Akub, o Shabetai, o Hodia, o Maaseia, o Kelita, o Asariaf, o Yosabad, o Hanan, o Pelaia lelo apolosak neretu iltung'ana aaitoning'u nkitanapat, ina kata etii iltung'ana iwuejitin enye.

English: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
Masaai: Neisum ninche ina buku, natii nkitanapat e Nkai, aaibalie, neitobiraki neaku etoning'utuo iltung'ana enkisumata.

English: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
Masaai: Ore Nehemia laa ninye apa olbalusui, o Esra ilo apolosani naa olaigeroni, o Lawi laa ninche ooiteng'en iltung'ana, nejoki iltung'ana pooki, “Ore ena olong naa aisinyati to Laitoriani Enkai inyi; emisinanuo niminchirishiri.” Amu eishira apa iltung'ana pooki ina kata pee ening irorei loo nkitanapat.

English: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajoki ninche, “Enchom iwuejitin, enosa ntokitin naapir, niokioko enaisho oo sabibu namelok nirriwakiki erubata ilo leitu eitobirakini toki, amu ore ena olong naa aisinyati to laitoriani, nimisinanuonuo ntae, amu enchipai o Laitoriani ninye engolon inyi.”

English: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
Masaai: Kaae neitigir Ilawi iltung'ana pooki, ejo, “Entigirata, amu ore ena olong naa aisinyati; emisinanuo.”

English: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
Masaai: Nepuo iltung'ana pooki iwuejitin enye aadaa neokisho, neirriwaa irubat, neitobir osirua kitok le nchipai. amu etoning'utuo ninche lelo rorei ooibalakinyeki ninche.

English: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e are, ore ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, too ltung'ana pooki, tenebo ilapolosak o Lawi, nepuonu tenebo enetii Esra ilo aigeroni pee etum aaiteng'enuoto irorei loo nkitanapat.

English: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
Masaai: Netum ninche eigeroki tiatua nkitanapat nchere, eitanapa apa Olaitoriani Musa pee etoni iltung'ana too lng'oborri to sirua to lapa liopishana,

English: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
Masaai: neji pee elimuni aaibalie too nkang'itie enye pooki o te Yerusalem, entejo, “Empang'a enchom ndoinyo niyauu ilng'osil lo loirien, oloirien le ntim olng'osil o ltuka, okulikae keek eeta mbenek pee eitainyeki ilng'oborri, anaa enaingeroki.”

English: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo iltung'ana neyau ninche, neitobiraki ate ilng'oborri ore ake oltung'ani neitushur olng'obor lenye, o lgoriet lenye, o lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai, o lkurroto otii kishomi e Nkare, o lkurroto otii kishomi e Efraim.

English: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
Masaai: Ore ina umata pooki e lelo apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto neitobir ilng'oborri nebik too lng'oborri amu ore ebaiki nkolong'i e Yoshua olayioni le Nuni ometabaiki ina olong eitu aekata eas iltung'ana le Israel ina. Netii apa enchipai sapuk.

English: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i pooki, ebaiki enkolong e dukuya o metabaiki enkolong nabayie, neisum ninye ina buku oo nkitanapat e Nkai. Neibung ninche osirua nkolong'i naapishana; ore te nkolong e isiet neibung'i eumata nasinya, terisioroto eina kiguana.

English: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
Masaai: Ore apa te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan ele apa, neiturrurro iltung'ana le Israel te eenata empukoroto neishop ilkuniyiani, nepik enterit ilukuny enye.

English: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
Masaai: Nekepu ate iltung'ana le Israel aalam iltung'ana leeiking'a, neitashe aaibalie ing'ok enye o entorroni oo loo menye.

English: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
Masaai: Neitashe ninche te wueji enye neisum embuku oo nkitanapat o Laitoriani Enkai enye te nkolong e ong'uan: ore tiae rishata e ong'uan nelimu ninche aaibalie ing'ok enye, neserem Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
Masaai: Ore too nkedeta oo Lawi neitashe Yeshua o Bani, o Kadmeil, o Shebania o Buni, o Sherebia, o Bani, o Kenani; nebuaku ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
Masaai: Neitoki Ilawi, o Yeshua, o Kadmiek, o Bani, o Hashabneia, o Sherebia, o Hodia, o Shebania, o Petahia aajo, “Entasho esisa Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ntarasi o ntarasi. Meisisi enkarna ino kitok neyanyiti oleng too mayianat o te nkisisa.”

English: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
Masaai: Nejo Esra: “Iyie Olaitoriani, iyie ake openy; iyie oitayio keper, o lororani pooki le keper, enkop o pooki naatii oriong enkop; naaiposha o pooki naatii atua ninche, igolie iyie ninche pooki; naa iyie eserem olorora pooki le shumata.

English: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ina Ai nategelua Abraham niyau ninye aitupuku te Uri, oo Lkaldayo ninchoo ninye enkarna ajo Abraham;

English: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:
Masaai: nidol iyie ajo keisiligayu oltau lenye te dukuya iyie, nintobir iyie o ninye osotua lo lning'o pee incho eishoi enye enkop oo Lkanaan; o enoo Ihiti, o ene Amori, o enoo Lperisi, o enoo Lyebusi, o enoo Lgirshi, nintabayie iyie ina kisiligata ino, amu ira iyie asipani.

English: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
Masaai: “Nitoduaa apa iyie osina loo loo papa lang te Misiri nining enkomono enye te Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
Masaai: Niaas iyie nkitoduaat o mbaa e nking'asia agilunore Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki o ltung'ana pooki le nkop enye. Amu iyiolo iyie ajo etaasa apa ninche mbaa e nkinyala too loo papa, nintobiraki iyie kewan enkarna, anaa enatiu taata.

English: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
Masaai: Ni tirisha iyie enaiposha te dukuya ninche, neaku eshomo ninche aaim empolos e naiposha te nkop natoyio; ninturraa iyie lelo oomirta ninche anang'aki enguton, anaa osoit onang'akini enkare, kitok.

English: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
Masaai: Ore te ng'ape e nkatampoi nirikoo iyie ninche dama, ore te ng'ape e nkima nirikoo ninche te nkewarie, pee ilang'ilang'aki ninche ina oitoi naaim.

English: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
Masaai: Itadowuo apa iyie alotu enchumata o ldoinyo le Sinai, nirorie ninche itii keper nincho ninche nkikoot sidain o nkitanapat naasipa, o nkiguanat supati.

English: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
Masaai: Nintayiolo iyie ninche sabato ino sinyati nintanap ninche nkitanapat o nkikoot o enkitanapata aimunye Musa osinka lino.

English: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie ninche imukateni naaing'uaa keper tenkaraki esumash enye, niyaki ninche enkare naing'uaa endapidapoi te nkaraki enkure enye. Nijoki iyie ninche meshomo aaya ina kop apa ninosie olmumai pee incho ninche.

English: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
Masaai: Kake ore ninche o loo papa netaasa mbaa olwuasa neitagol ilukuny enye, neitu eiruk nkitanapat.

English: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
Masaai: Etanyaita ninche ening, neitu eshilaa nena baa e nking'asia apa nitaasa tiatua ninche. Kake eitagolo ninche ilukuny enye negelu olarikoni pee errinyo aapuo esinkaisho enye te Misiri. Kake ira iyie Enkai nasioki apalaki, osupat, neeta olng'ur, nemesioki agoro nebik te nyorrata nauno neitu iyie inturaa ninche.

English: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
Masaai: Ore doi ninye apa pee eitobiraki ate olashe le sahabu nashola nejo, “Ena ninye Enkai inyi apa nayaua intae ailepunye te Misiri,’ neas mbaa kituaak e morore.

English: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
Masaai: Ore iyie to lng'ur lino kitok, neitu inturraa ninche tiong'ota. Ore ina ng'ape e nkatampoi apa natorikoyie ninche te nkoitoi, neitu elo aing'uaa ninche te ndama, neitu elo eng'ape e nkima aing'uaa ninche te nkewarie, pee eitawang enkoitoi enye napuo aaim ninche.

English: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie Enkiyang'et supat meiteng'ena ninche, neitu iyie mbooyo mana ino amitiki ninche einos. Nincho ninche enkare te nkaraki enkure enye.

English: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
Masaai: Ilarin artam iyie ntotio ninche tiong'ota, neitu elau toki neitu emuta nkilani enye neitu ejeyu nkejek enye.

English: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
Masaai: Ninchoo iyie ninche nkitoriat oo loreren nioriki iyie ninche pooki shoto. Neaku ewaita ninche ina kop e Sihon olaiguanani le Heshbon o enkop e Oog olaiguanani le Bashan,

English: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
Masaai: Itoponayie iyie eishoi enye aitaba anaa ilakir le keper, nitorikuo ninche atua ina kop apa nitolikio loo menye pee ejing aamany.

English: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
Masaai: Metaa eshomo ina ishoi enye aaya ina kop, nipik iyie lelo oomanya ina kop abori enkitoria enye, lelo Kanaani, ninchooyo ninche apik nkaik enye, tenebo ilaiguanak lenye o ltung'ana leina kop. Pee etum aaitaasa ninche anaa enayieu.

English: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
Masaai: Neibung ninche nena anas enye naasheta sunta o enkop sidai. Neya nkajijik naabore ntokitin sidain, o lchorroi ooturo, o nkurman oo sabibu, o loirienito o lkeek loo lng'anayio kumok, neinos ninche neraposho nepiru neshipayu ninche te supatisho ino.

English: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eisero ninche nikigolong'aki iyie, nenang'aa nkitanapat inono aainyaaya oriong, near iloibonok linono metuata. laa ninche apa ooikoo ejo pee errinyu ninche enitii, neas ninche mbaa sapuki e morore.

English: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina inchooyie iyie ninche apik nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, ooisilisilo ninche, ore teina kata enye o sina, kinchirakitia ninche iyie, nining iyie ninche itii keper. Ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino kitok ninchoo iyie ninche olaitajeunoni oitajeu ninche aitayu te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenye.

English: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
Masaai: Kake ore eidipa ninche aayagie neitoki ninche aas entorroni too nkonyek inono, nintoki iyie aiturraa ninche apik nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, pee atum aaitoria ninche. Kake ore ake eyia teneibelekenya ninche nikinchiraki iyie, nining iyie ninche itii shumata, naa katitin kumok itokordua iyie ninche te risioroto olng'ur lino.

English: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
Masaai: Inkoo apa iyie ninche ijo pee itum atorrinyoki ninche nkitanapat inono. Kake etawuasate apa ninche, neitu eibung nkitanapat inono, kake etaasa ninche eng'oki too nkiguanat inono, naa ninche eishuyie oltung'ani teneibung, neisho ninche oriong, neitagol ilukuny enye, neany ening.

English: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
Masaai: Too larin kumok iting'iriakine iyie ninche, ninkok ninche te Nkiyang'et ino, iimunye iloibonok linono; ore ake eyia eitu ninche ening. Ore enkaraki ina inchooyie iyie ninche apik nkaik oo loreren.

English: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia te nkaraki olng'ur lino kitok eitu iyie iishie ninche anaa inturraa ninche; amu ira Enkai supat naata olng'ur.

English: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
Masaai: Ore naa taata na Ai ang, Enkai kitok magilani naitureisho, naibung o sotua o enyorrata nauno, mincho kuna golikinot naaetuo shumata iyiook elioyu aa kutiti te iyie o shumata ilaiguanak lang, o lkituaak lang, o lapolosak lang, o loibonok lang, o loo papa, o shumata iltung'ana linono pooki ebaiki enkata oo laiguanak le Siria, o metabaiki ena olong eaku entoki kiti te iyie.

English: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia itaa iyie asipani te nena pooki naaetuo shumata iyiook, amu itaasishe iyie te sipata nikitaasishote iyiook te ntorroni.

English: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak lang, o lkituaak lang, o lapolosak lang, o loo papa, neitu eibung nkitanapat inono, o nkikoot inono ninchoo iyie ninche.

English: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
Masaai: Eitu ninche kisiaai iyie te nkitoria enye, naa ore te supatisho ino kitok ninchoo iyie ninche, o te nkop sidai nalala nitipika iyie dukuya ninche, neitu ninche errinyunye aaing'uaa isiaaitin enye torrok.

English: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
Masaai: Ng'ura kira iyiook irrindiki ena olong; tiatua ena kop apa ninchoo loo papa pee eshipakino ilng'anayio lenyena o nkishorot enyena sidain, ng'ura, kira iyiook irrindiki.

English: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
Masaai: Ore ilng'anayio lenyena neinos lelo aiguanak apa litipika shumata iyiook tenkaraki ingok ang; eeta ake sii lelo aiguanak engolon naitoreyie iseseni lang, o nkishu ang, pee eitaas anaa enayieu, nikitii iyiook osina kitok.”

English: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki kuna pooki, aikintobir iyiook olning'o lo sotua niking'er. ore ilkituaak lang, o lawi lang, o lapolosak lang, nepik ilmishiren lenye.

English: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
Masaai: Ore apa lelo ootipika olmishire lenye naa Nehemia ilo balusui, olayioni le Hekalia, o Sedekia,

English: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Masaai: o Seraia, o Asaria o Yeremia,

English: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,
Masaai: o Pashur, o Amaria o Malkija,

English: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
Masaai: o Hatush, o Shebania, o Maluk, o

English: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
Masaai: Harim, o Meremot, o Obadia,

English: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
Masaai: o Daniel, o Gineton, o Baruk,

English: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
Masaai: o Meshulam, o Abijia, o Mijomin,

English: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.
Masaai: o Maasia, o Bilgai, o Shemaia. Kulo apa ninche ilapolosak.

English: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
Masaai: Ore Ilawi naa: Yoshua olayioni le Asania, o Binui loo layiok le Henadad, o Kadimiel,

English: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
Masaai: o lalashera lenye, o Shebania, o Hodia, o Kelita, o Pelaia, o Hanan,

English: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,
Masaai: o Mika, o Rehob, o Hashabia,

English: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
Masaai: o Sakur, o Sherebia o Shebania,

English: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
Masaai: o Hodia, o Bani, o Bininu.

English: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak loo iltung'ana naa Parosh, o Pahatmoab, o Elam, o Satu, o Bani,

English: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
Masaai: o Buni, o Asgad, o Bebai,

English: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
Masaai: o Adonija, o Bigfai, o Adin,

English: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
Masaai: o Ater, o Hesekia, o Asur,

English: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
Masaai: o Hodia, o Hashum, o Besai,

English: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
Masaai: o Harif, o Anatot, o Nebai,

English: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
Masaai: o Magpiash, o Meshulam, o Hesir,

English: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,
Masaai: o Meshesapel o Sadok, o Yadua

English: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
Masaai: o Pelatia, o Hanan, o Hanaia, o

English: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
Masaai: Hoshea, o Hanania, o Hashub,

English: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
Masaai: o Halohesh, o Pilha, o Shobek,

English: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
Masaai: o Rehum, o Hashabana, o Maaseia,

English: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
Masaai: o Ahia, o Hanan, o Anan,

English: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
Masaai: o Maluk, o Harim o Baana.

English: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae tung'ana, ilapolosak, o Lawi, o larripok le kishomi, o laranyak, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, o lelo pooki ooitekeputua ate aaitalam iloreren le nena kuapi, aaibelekenyakino nkitanapat e Nkai, tenebo inkituaak enye, o layiok lenye, o ntoyie enye, lelo pooki oata engeno o eyiolounoto,

English: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and his judgments and his statutes;
Masaai: neibung'are ilalashera lenye, o lkituaak lenye, nejing ninche oldeket, o lmumai pee eibung nkitanapat e Nkai apa naaishoruaki aaimunye Musa osinka le Nkai. Pee esipu neas nkitanapat pooki o Laitoriani, Olaitoriani lang, o nkikoot enyena o nkiguanat enyena.

English: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:
Masaai: Mikincho iyiook ntoyie ang meyama iltung'ana lena kop, nimikiyamaki iyook ilayiok lang ntoyie enye:

English: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
Masaai: naa teneyau iltung'ana lena kop ntokitin naamiri o entapa e pooki pukunoto te nkolong e sabato pee emir, nimikinyiang'u iyiook te ninche, te nkolong e sabato anaa te nkolong sinyati; nimikitur iyiook nkurman to lari liopishana, nikipalaa pooki sile.

English: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
Masaai: Kinteleikitia sii ate olola pee kintalak ate te pooki ari erubata e uni e shekeli te nkaraki enkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai.

English: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
Masaai: te nkaraki emukate e nkitoduaaroto, o lasar le ntapa le anaake, o lasar opejori le anaake, o sabatoni, o lapaitin ng'ejuko, o siruai gelunot, o ntokitin sinyat, o lasarri le ng'oki ooitobirieki olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki Isirael, o te nkaraki esiaai pooki e Nkai ang.

English: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law:
Masaai: Kitoosho sii enkukuo, ilapolosak, o Lawi, o ltung'ana, te nkaraki nkiri olasar loo lkeek, pee eyauni atua enkaji e Nkai ang, te risioroto oo nkajijik oo loo papa, too nkatitin naategeluaki, te pooki ari. Pee einoki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani Enkai ang anaa enaigero too nkitanapat.

English: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Kitudung'okitio iyiook ate, pee kiyau ilng'anayio le dukuya te nkop ang, o lng'anayio le dukuya le pooki shani, te pooki ake ari, enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
Masaai: Nikiyau sii atua enkaji e Nkai ang, aayaki lelo apolosak ooisiaaisho tiatua enkaji e Nkai ang, ilkikaunot lang o lkikaunot loo nkishu ang, anaa enaigero too nkitanapat, o lkikaunot loo nkishu ang o loo ntare ang.

English: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
Masaai: Nikiyaki sii ilapolosak ina tapa ang e dukuya e nkisampuare, o nkishorot ang, o lng'anayio le pooki shani o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata nikiya ilgilat le nkaji e Nkai ang, nikiyaki Ilawi ematua e tomon naing'uaa nkurman ang, amu Ilawi oosotu imatuan e tomon, too nkang'itie ang pooki.

English: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
Masaai: Ore olapolosani olayioni le Aron, naa keetii tenebo Ilawi ina kata nang'amu imatuan e tomon neyau Ilawi ematua e tomon oo matuan e tomon e nkaji e Nkai ang nepik ilgilat o mpechen.

English: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
Masaai: Amu keyau iltung'ana le Israel o layiok le Lawi nkishorot e ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata atua lelo gilat, ine netii imasaa e wueji sinyati, o lapolosak ooisiaaisho o larripok le kishomi o laranyak. Mikipalaa iyiook enkaji e Nkai ang.

English: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
Masaai: Ore apa ilarikok loo ltung'ana netoni te Yerusalem; ore ilkulikae tung'ana, neosh enkukuo, pee eyau oltung'ani obo te tomon meeu amany Yerusalem ina anasa sinyati, nebik lelo ooudo te kulie ang'itie.

English: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nemayian apa iltung'ana lelo pooki ootonyorraitie aatoni te Yerusalem.

English: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
Masaai: Kulo apa ilkituaak loo lkerenketi ootamanya Yerusalem; kake ore too nkang'itie e Yuda, etii ake pooki ng'ae enkang enye neton tiatua imasaa enyena: ile Israel, o lapolosak, o Lawi, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, o le ishoi o laisiaayiak le Solomon.

English: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
Masaai: Netii apa Yerusalem embata oo layiok le Yuda o layiok le Benchamen. Ore too layiok le Yuda naa Ataia olayioni le Usia, olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Shefatia, olayioni le Mahalalel, loo layiok le Peres:

English: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
Masaai: o Maaseia olayioni le Baruk olayioni le Kolhose olayioni le Hasaia, olayioni le Aidaya, olayioni le Yairib, olayioni le Sakaria, olayioni le Shilonit.

English: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok pooki le Peres apa oomanya Yerusalem naa iip ong'uan o ntomoni ile o isiet, iltung'ana yiolot oopi.

English: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
Masaai: Naa kulo ilayiok le Benchamen: Salu olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Yoed, olayioni le Pedaia, olayioni le Kolaia, olayioni le Maaseia, olayioni le Itiel, olayioni le Yeshai.

English: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
Masaai: Nesujaki ninye Gebai, o Saalai, iltung'ana iip naaudo o tikitam o isiet.

English: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
Masaai: Yoel olayioni le Sikri apa olaitasheikinoni lenye, naa Yuda olayioni le Hasenua oliare te nkitoria ena anasa.

English: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
Masaai: Ore too lapolosak naa: Yedaia olayioni le Yairib, o Yakin,

English: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
Masaai: o Seraia olayioni le Hilkia, olayioni le Meshulam, olayioni le Sadok, olayioni le Merairiot, olayioni le Ahitab, olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e Nkai,

English: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchiah,
Masaai: ore ilalashera lenye oaas esiaai eina aji naa, iip isiet o tikitam o are; ore Adai olayioni le Yeroham, olayioni le Pelalia, olayioni le Amsi, olayioni le Sekaria, olayioni le Pashur, olayioni le Malkija,

English: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of PrAzareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
Masaai: o lalashera lenyena, nena lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye naa iip are o artam o are; o Amashai, olayioni le Asarel, olayioni le Asai, olayioni le Meshilemot, olayioni le Imer,

English: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
Masaai: o lalashera lenye, lelo tung'ana magil yiolot, iip o tikitam o isiet; ore olaitasheikinoni lenye naa Sibdiel olayioni le Hagedolin.

English: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
Masaai: Ore too Lawi: naa Shemaia olayioni le Hashub, olayioni le Asrikam, olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Buni;

English: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
Masaai: o Shabetai o Yasabad, loo lkituaak loo lawi laa ninche apa ooitasheiki esiaai e oriong e nkaji e Nkai;

English: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
Masaai: o Matania olayioni le Mika olayioni le Sabdi, olayioni le Asaf, laa ninye oiterua enkishoroto e nashe te nkomono, o Bakukia laa ninye oliare too lalashera lenyena; o Abda olayioni le Shamaua, olayioni le Falal, olayioni le Yedutum.

English: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
Masaai: Ore Ilawi pooki teina anasa sinyati naa iip are o ntomoni isiet o ong'uan.

English: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
Masaai: Ore ilarripok le kishomi naa: Akub, o Talmon o lalashera lenye, laa ninche apa oorrip nchomito, naa iip nabo o ntomoni napishana o are.

English: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae Siraeli, o lapolosak o Lawi netii nkang'itie e Yuda, etii ake oltung'ani enjung'ore enye.

English: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
Masaai: Kake ore ilaisiaayiak le Nkaji e Nkai nemanya Ofel; naa Siha, o Gispa apa ooitasheiki ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai.

English: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
Masaai: Ore apa olaitasheikinoni loo Lawi te Yerusalem naa Usi olayioni le Bani, Olayioni le Hashabia, olayioni le Matania, olayioni le Mika loo layiok le Asaf, lelo aranyak, ooitasheiki esiaai e nkaji e Nkai.

English: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
Masaai: Amu etii apa enkitanapata naing'uaa olaiguanani naipirta ninche, o enkitobirata oo laranyak anaa enaiyieuni te pooki olong.

English: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.
Masaai: Naa Petahia olayioni le Meshesabel, loo layiok le Sera olayioni le Yuda, ninye apa olaretoni lo laiguanani too mbaa pooki naaipirta iltung'ana.

English: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
Masaai: Ore tialo nkang'itie, etamanya apa embata oo ltung'ana le Yuda Kiriat-arba, o nkang'itie enyena, o Dibon o nkang'itie enyena o Yekabseel o nkang'itie enyena, o

English: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Beth-phelet,
Masaai: Yeshua, o Molada, o Betber Betpeler, o

English: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,
Masaai: Harshulal, o Beer-sheba o nkang'itie enyena,

English: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
Masaai: o Siklag, o Mekona, o nkang'itie enyena,

English: And at En-rimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
Masaai: o Enrimon o Sora o Yemut,

English: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
Masaai: o Sanoa, o Adulam nkang'itie enyena, o Lakish o nkong'at enyena, a Aseka o nkong'at enyena. Neaku etipika apa ninche ilng'oborri ebaiki Beer-sheba o metabaiki oerata le Hinom.

English: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages,
Masaai: Ore sii ninche iltung'ana le Benchamen nemany ebaiki Geba neito idia alo, te mbata e Mikmash, o Aija, o Betel o nkang'itie enyena,

English: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
Masaai: o Anotot, o Noab, o Anania, o

English: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
Masaai: Hasor, o Rama, o Gitaim,

English: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
Masaai: o Hadid, o Seboim, o Nebalot,

English: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
Masaai: o Lod, o Ono, ilo erata loo laguatak.

English: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae turrurri loo Lawi te Yuda neshulare Benchamen.

English: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
Masaai: Kulo ninche ilapolosak o Lawi apa ooetuo tenebo Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, o Yeshua: o Seraia o Yeremia o Esra,

English: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
Masaai: o Amaria, o Maluk, o Hatush,

English: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
Masaai: o Shekemia, o Rehum, o Meremot,

English: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
Masaai: o Ido, o Ginetoi, o Abija,

English: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
Masaai: o Mijamin, o Maadia, o Bilga,

English: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
Masaai: o Shemia, o Yoiarib, o Yedaia,

English: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
Masaai: o Sulu, o Amok, o Hilkia o Yedaia. Kulo ninche apa ilkituaak loo lapolosak o lalashera lenye too nkolong'i e Yeshua.

English: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi; naa Yeshua o Binui o Kadmiel, o Sherebia, o Yuda, o Matania, laa ore tenebo ilalashera lenyena, naa ninye oitasheiki isinkolioitin le nkishooroto e nashe.

English: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
Masaai: O Bakbukia, o Uno, neitashe ilalashera lenye aaipirakinore ninche te nkisiaayiare.

English: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
Masaai: Naa Yeshua apa menye le Yoiakim, naa Yoiakim menye le Eliashib naa Elishiab menye le Yoiada,

English: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
Masaai: naa Yoiada menye le Yonatan, naa Yonatan menye le Yadua.

English: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
Masaai: Ore apa too nkolong'i e Yoiakim, netii ilapolosak oora lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye: te Seraia, o te Meraia, o te Yeremia, o te Hanania;

English: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
Masaai: ore te Esra naa Meshulam; ore te Amaria naa Yehohanan;

English: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
Masaai: ore te Maluki naa Yonatan; ore te Shebania naa Yosef:

English: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
Masaai: ore te Harm naa Adna; ore te Merariot naa Helkai;

English: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
Masaai: ore te Ido naa Sekaria; ore te Gineton naa Meshulam;

English: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
Masaai: ore te Abija naa Sikri; ore te Miniamin o te Moadia naa Piltai;

English: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
Masaai: ore te Bilga, naa Shamua; ore te Shemaia naa Yehonatan,

English: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
Masaai: ore Yoiarib naa Matenai; ore te Yedaia naa Usi,

English: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
Masaai: ore te Salai naa Kalai; ore te Amok naa Eber,

English: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
Masaai: ore te Hilkia naa Hashabia; ore te Yedaia, naa Natanel.

English: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
Masaai: Ore too Lawi, apa too nkolong'i e Eliashib, o Yoiada o Yohanan o Yadua, kulo apa eigeroki metaa lukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye; naa lapolosak sii o metabaiki enkitoria e Darias le Parsia.

English: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Lawi, ilukuny oo nkajijik oo loo menye, neigeroki te mbuku oo ntepen, o metabaiki nkolong'i e Yohanan olayioni le Eliashib.

English: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak loo Lawi naa: Hashabia, o Sherabia, o Yeshua olayioni le Kadmiel tenebo ilalashera lenye ooipirakinore ninche, pee eisis Enkai neishooyo enashe, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi ilo tung'ani le Nkai pee easi aairukokino.

English: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
Masaai: Matahia apa, o Bakbukia, o Obadia, o Meshulam, o Talmon, o Akub ninche ilarripok le kishomi ooitashe aarrip nkajijik naashumishoreki o nchomito.

English: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
Masaai: Ore apa kuna baa naa too nkolong'i e Yoaikim olayioni le Yeshua olayioni le Yosadak, o too nkolong'i e Nehemia ilo balusui o Esra ilo apolosani naa olasirani.

English: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
Masaai: Ore teina kitisinyata e suntai e Yerusalem, neyauni Ilawi too wuejitin pooki meetu Yerusalem aaraposhoki ina kitisinyata te nchipai, o te nkishooroto e nashe o te ranyata e oshoto oo nkinantani, o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, o lwululi loo usin.

English: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
Masaai: Ore nkera e lelo aranyak, neiturrurro too manyishoritin enye naamanita Yerusalem, o too nkang'itie e Netofati;

English: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
Masaai: neiturrurro sii te Bet-gilgal o te nkop e Geba o Asmafet; amu eteshetakita apa ate ilaranyak nkang'itie aaitaman Yerusalem.

English: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak o Lawi neitisiny ate; neitisiny olorere, o nchomito o esuntai.

English: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aiturrurru ilkituaak le Yuda te nchumata eina suntai, nagelu ilturrurri oare sapuki ooishooyo enashe nepuo ninche too lkererin. Nelo olturrur obo enkalo e tatene teina suntai ometabaiki kishomi e modioi;

English: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
Masaai: nesuju ninche Hoshaia, o lpisiaai le lelo kituaak le Yuda,

English: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
Masaai: o Asaria, o Esra, o Meshulam,

English: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
Masaai: o Yuda, o Benchamen, o Shemaia, o Yeremia,

English: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
Masaai: o kulikae ayiok loo lapolosak oata ntarumpetani: Sekaria olayioni le Yonatan, olayioni le Shemaia, olayioni le Matamia, olayioni le Mikaia, olayioni le Sakur, olayioni le Asaf;

English: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and PrAzarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
Masaai: o ltung'ana lenye, Shemaia, o Asarel, o Milalai, o Gilalai, o Maai, o Natanel, o Yuda, o Hanani, eeta nkinantani oo sinkolioitin e Daudi ilo tung'ani le Nkai. Ore Esra ilo aigeroni nelo te dukuya ninche.

English: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
Masaai: Ore te kishomi e nchorro, neitoriori ninche aapuo te dukuya ninche aaim nkedeta e nkanasa e Daudi, te wueji neilepakinyeki esuntai, te shumata enkaji e Daudi; aapuo enkishomi e Nkare te nkalo o loosaen.

English: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
Masaai: Ore olikae turrur le lelo ooishooyo enashe, nepuo enkalo e kedienye, nasujaa nanu ninche tenebo olpisiaai le lelo tung'ana ootii enchumata e suntai, te nchumata o ltalet le wueji nepejishoreki, o metabaiki esuntai nalala,

English: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
Masaai: o metabaiki kishomi e Efraim, o embata e kishomi musana, o embata e kishomi o sinkirri o ltalet le Hananel, o ltalet le iip o metabaiki kishomi oo nkerra. Nepuonu ninche aaitashe te kishomi oo larripok.

English: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
Masaai: Metaa ore lelo turrurri pokira oare le lelo ooishooyo enashe neitashe tiatua enkaji e Nkai; ore nanu o lpisiaai loo nkituaak tenebo nanu;

English: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
Masaai: o lapolosak, Eliakim o Maaseia, o Miniamin, o Makaia, o Elioenai, o Sekaria, o Hanania, eeta ntarumpetani;

English: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
Masaai: o Maaseia, o Shemaia, o Eleasa, o Eusi, o Yehoahanan, o Malkija, o Elam, o Eser. Neranyisho ilaranyak erikoo Yesrahia.

English: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche ilasarri sapuki ina olong, neshipayu amu Enkai naitishipa ninche te ng'ida sapuk; neshipa sii nkituaak o nkera. Nening'ori enchipai e Yerusalem tenelakua oleng.

English: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong negeluni iltung'ana ooitasheiki ilgilat ooshumishoreki, oopiki nkishorunot, o lelo ng'anayio le dukuya, o matuan e tomon, pee eiturrurri tiatua nena ajijik nena rubat pooki naaishiaakino too nkitanapat te nkaraki ilapolosak o Lawi, te risioroto oo nkurman e nena ang'itie; amu etishipe apa Yuda te nkaraki lelo apolosak o Lawi oisiaaishote.

English: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
Masaai: Etaasa apa ninche esiaai e Nkai enye o esiaa nkitisinyata anaa enataasa ilaranyak o larripok le kishomi, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Daudi o layioni lenye Solomon.

English: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
Masaai: Amu ore apa too nkolong'i e Daudi o Asaf, tiapa, neetae olkitok loo laranyak, neetae isinkolioitin le nkisisa o enkishooroto e nashe te Nkai.

English: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
Masaai: Ore Israel pooki too nkolong'i e Serubabel o too nkolong'i e Nehemia, neisho erubata e anaake lelo aranyak, o larripok le kishomi; neiteng'el ninche ina rubata oo Lawi; neiteng'el ile Lawi ina rubata oo layiok le Aron.

English: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong neisuma ninche embuku e Musa aaitoning olorere; netumi eigero teina buku nchere meetae Olamori aashu Olmoabui ojing ae kata eumata e Nkai;

English: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
Masaai: amu eitu apa ninche enang'are nkera e Israel aaisho endaa o enkare, kake eishoo ninche Balaam mpisai metigilunore ninche nedek ninche - ore ake eyia eibelekenya Olaitoriani oldeket aitaa emayianata.

English: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening' iltung'ana ina kitanapata, nekepaa ninche aaitung'uaa Israel lelo pooki loo loreren.

English: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:
Masaai: Ore apa eng'or ena, ore Eliashib olapolosani laa ninye etegeluaki meitasheiki ilgilat le nkaji e Nkai ang, laa ninye sii apa oyiolore Tobia,

English: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
Masaai: neitobiraki ninye Tobia olgilata olala teine apa netang'asa ninche aapik nkishorot e ntapa, oina orropil, o masaa, o matuan e tomon e ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata, naa ninche apa eishoruaki te nkitanapata meishori Ilawi, o laranyak, o larripok le kishomi, o nkishorot oo lapolosak.

English: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
Masaai: Ore apa easayu kuna, nematii nanu Yerusalem, amu ore to lari le tomoni uni oare le nkitoria e Artaserses olaiguanani le Babilon, nashomo nanu enetii olaiguanani. Ore etulusoyie enkiti rishata naomon nanu olaiguanani maaisho mashomo,

English: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
Masaai: nalotu nanu Yerusalem, nairrash nanu ina torroni naitaasa Eliashib Tobia, aitobiraki ninye olgilata too lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai.

English: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
Masaai: Atagore apa nanu oleng nanang'aa imasaa enkaji e Tobia aitupuku boo.

English: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aitanapisho neitisinyi ina aji, naitoki nanu arrinyu nena masaa e nkaji e Nkai, tenebo olasar le ntapa o enkorropil.

English: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
Masaai: Atayiolo sii ajo eitu eishori Ilawi irubat enye; metaa ore Ilawi o laranyak apa oasisho, neisika ake pooki ng'ae alo enkurma enye.

English: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
Masaai: Neaku aisikong'a nanu lelo kituaak najoki, “Kainyoo pee etung'uayioki enkaji e Nkai?” Naiturrur nanu ninche tenebo napik iwuejitin enye.

English: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
Masaai: Neya Yuda imatuan e tomon e ntapa, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata aaya nena ajijik naashumishoreki.

English: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
Masaai: Nagelu nanu metaa ilashumak ooitasheiki nena ajijik naashumishoreki, Shelemia ilo apolosani, o Sadok olaigeroni, o Pedaia loo Lawi, ore olaretoni lenye naa Hanan olayioni le Sakur, olayioni le Matamia, amu ninche apa eisiligaki. Ore apa esiaai enye naa pee eoriki ilalashera lenye ntokitin.

English: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
Masaai: Tadamuaki nanu, Enkai, ai, tialo ena, nimijut iyie aiwuang'ie nena kiasin aainei sidain nataasa nanu te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai ai o te nkaraki enkisiaayiare enye.

English: In those days saw I in Judah some treading winepresses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, atoduaa nanu lelo tung'ana te Yuda eironyu enaisho oo sabibu too nkironyata te nkolong e sabato, neyau isotot le ntapa neirotoki ninche isirkon; neyau sii enaisho oo sabibu, o lng'anayio loo sabibu, o lng'abolo, o lolan loo mpukunot pooki ooyautua ninche atua Yerusalem te nkolong e Sabato. Aikoo apa nanu ninche teina olong natimira endaa.

English: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore sii iltung'ana le Turo apa ootii ina anasa, neya isinkir o ntokitin oo mpukunot pooki naamiri, nemiraki ninche te nkolong e Sabato iltung'ana le Yuda te Yerusalem.

English: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
Masaai: Naisikong nanu lelo kituaak le Yuda najoki ninche, “Kainyoo ena bae torrono niaasitata, aaisarkionie enkolong e Sabato?

English: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
Masaai: Ketaasa apa iloo papaai linyi ena, naa keitu eyau Enkai ang ena torroni pooki shumata iyiook o shumata ena anasa? Ore ake eyia, iyauu intae engoro kitok shumata Israel, aaisarkionie Sabato.”

English: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eiteru amisimisu too nchomito e Yerusalem eng'or Sabato, naitanapisho nanu pee eikeni nkutukie oo nkajijik nemeboli ometulusoi Sabato. Napik nanu embata oo sinkan laainei meitasheiki nchomito, pee meetae olola oitijing'uni te nkolong e sabato.

English: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
Masaai: Ore lelo ainyiang'ak o lamirak loo mpukunot pooki neirrag auluo Yerusalem enkolong nabo anaa nkolong'i are.

English: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
Masaai: Kake aikoo nanu ninche najoki ninche, “Kainyoo intae pee irragirraga tioriong e suntai? Teningiligili aaiko neijia, naibung nanu intae.” Ore ebaiki ina olong neito idia alo eitu ninche eigil aapuonu te nkolong e Sabato.

English: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
Masaai: Naitanap nanu Ilawi pee eitisiny ate nepuonu aarrip nchomito, neitaa enkolong e Sabato Sinyati. Tadamuaki sii ena te nkaraki nanu, na Ai ai, nikileku nanu te risioroto e nkitoo e nyorrata ino.

English: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:
Masaai: Ore sii apa te nena olong'i, atoduaa nanu Ilyahudi ooyama nkituaak e Ashdod, o Amon, o Moab;

English: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.
Masaai: ore olpisiaai loo nkera enye neiro enkutuk e Ashdod, nemeidim ninche aairoro enkutuk e Yuda, kake keidim aairoro nkutukie e lelo tung'ana.

English: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
Masaai: Nailepilepaki nanu ninche, nadek ninche, naidong kulikae lenye nayiet ilpapit lenye, nainosie ninche olmumai te nkarna e Nkai, ajoki, “Mincho iyie ntoyie inono ilayiok lenye, nimiyaki ilayiok linono ntoyie enye, nimiyamiyama intae maate.

English: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
Masaai: Keitu apa eas olaiguanani Solomon eng'oki tenkaraki kuna kituaak? Ore tiatua iloshon kumok meetae olaiguanani otiu anaa ninye, naa kirotet te Nkai enye, neitaa Enkai ninye olaiguanani te shumata Israel pooki; ore ake eyia, etorikokitio nkituaak oo loreren ninye metaasa ing'ok.

English: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
Masaai: Eikining naa iyiook intae nikias ena torroni sapuk aagolong'aki Enkai ang, aayam nkituaak oo loreren?”

English: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
Masaai: Ore apa obo loo layiok le Yehoiada olayioni le Eliashib, ilo apolosani kitok, naa olaputani le Sanbalat le Horoni; ore enkaraki ina aterewa nanu ninye aitalam kewan.

English: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
Masaai: Tadamu ninche, Enkai ai, Amu eisarkionie ninche empolosare o lning'o lo sotua le mpolosare oo lawi.

English: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;
Masaai: Naitisiny nanu ninche te pooki toki oo loreren, naitobir mbaa naaipirta, isiaaitin oo lapolosak o Lawi, o ltung'ani ake te siaai enye;

English: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
Masaai: naishoru nanu ilkeek oopejorieki olasar, too rishat enye naageluno, o too rishat oo lng'anayio le dukuya. Tadamuaki nanu Enkai ai, te mbae supat.

English: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)
Masaai: Ore apa too nkolong'i e Serser, Serser laa ninye apa oitore ebaiki India ometabaiki Etiopia, ilkerenketi oobaya iip o tikitam oopishana.

English: That in those days, when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the palace,
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i ina kata pee eton olaiguanani Serser to lorika lenye le nkitoo te Susa, naa ninye enkang kitok.

English: In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:
Masaai: Ore to lari liokuni le nkitoria enye neitobiraki osirua ilkituaak lenyena, o sinkan, Netii sii ilkituaak le njore le Parsia o Media o larikok o laiguanak loo lkerenketi dukuya ninye,

English: When he shewed the riches of his glorious kingdom and the honour of his excellent majesty many days, even an hundred and fourscore days.
Masaai: ina kata eitoduaya enkarsisisho e nkitoo enye e nkisisa, o enkishiaa e nkitoo enye too nkolong'i kumok. Inkolong'i iip o ntomoni isiet.

English: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ebaya nena olong'i, neisho olaiguanani lelo tung'ana pooki ootii Susa, ina ang kitok, ilkituaak o looti osirua too nkolong'i naapishana, ti atua enkaji e ntumo natii atua olgoriet le nkurma e ina manyisho o laiguanani.

English: Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.
Masaai: Netii ilkarash ooibor o lpusi ooika eisiong'are iusin sidain naanyokie olgiso le nkosholai o ng'apeta naashetuno too soito oowang, netii sii ilorikan dapashi le sahabu o enkosholai shumata oleng'oti loo soito oonyokie o loonyori, netii isoito oogol enkinyang'a.

English: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.
Masaai: Neisho ninche metookisho too nkikompeni e sahabu oo mpukunot kumok, naa eisapuk oleng enaisho oo sabibu anaa enaikununo enkaminino o laiguanani.

English: And the drinking was according to the law; none did compel: for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house, that they should do according to every man's pleasure.
Masaai: Ore eokore naa anaa enaitanapishoteki, mearakini hoo ng'ae, amu eitanapishe olaiguanani too lkituaak lenyena pooki ootii enkaji enye e nkitoo nchere nchoo metaasa pooki tung'ani enayieu.

English: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus.
Masaai: Neisho sii Fashiti ina kitok o laiguanani inkituaak o sirua te ina aji e nkitoo o laiguanani Serser.

English: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was merry with wine, he commanded Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven chamberlains that served in the presence of Ahasuerus the king,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong' e naapishana, etishipe oltau lo laiguanani te nkaraki enaisho oo sabibu, neitanap ninye Mehuman, o Bista, o Harbona, o Bigta, o Abaguta o Setar o Karkas, lelo sunaishi oogelema oopishana ooisiaisho te dukuya olaiguanani Serser,

English: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people and the princes her beauty: for she was fair to look on.
Masaai: pee eyau Fashiti dukuya olaiguanani eishopito emaupe enye e nkitoo pee eitodol iltung'ana pooki o lkituaak pooki e nkishiaa enye, amu eisidai apa oleng te nking'urata.

English: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
Masaai: Kake etanya apa Fashiti ina kitok o laiguanani, elotu te ina kitanapata o laiguanani anaa enatolimutuo lelo sunaishi oogelema. Neitagor ina olaiguanani oleng, netiu engoro enye anaa enkima nayupuyup ti atua ninye.

English: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king's manner toward all that knew law and judgment:
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani ilang'eni ooyiolo nkatitin, amu ilo apa olkerreti lo laiguanani ti alo lelo pooki arriyiak too nkitanapat o te nkiguana.

English: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king's face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)
Masaai: Ore apa iltung'ana ootashare ninye naa Karshena o Shetar, o Admata, o Tarshish, o Meres, o Marsena, o Memukan, lelo kituaak oopishana le Parsia o Media, ootoduaa enkomom o laiguanani, naa ninche ootang'asa aatoni te nkitoo enye.
