Masaai: najo, ‘Ene taa ilotu abaiki, nimigiroo, naa ene ebaiki olwuasa loo lopir linono’?

English: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
Masaai: “Intanapa ae olong entadekenya anaa ninteru nkolong'i inono, nincho entadekenya metayiolo ewueji enye.

English: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
Masaai: Peyie etum aibung'a ineeiting'ie enkop, neipiripirori iltorrok aaitung'uaa ninye?

English: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
Masaai: Eibelekenyi ninye anaa enterit natii abori olmishire, neibelekenye emua enye anaa enkila.

English: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
Masaai: Ore too ltorrok eibooki ewang'an enye, ore enkaina enye natudumuaki aailepie negili.

English: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
Masaai: “Itijing'a oshi aikata atua nkonyek enaiposha arashu ilo tiatua enegut enaiposha too nkejek?

English: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
Masaai: Aikintoduaki iyie inchomito e keeya, anaa itodua iyie nchomito enaimin nagut?

English: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
Masaai: Itoning'uo iyie asipu endapasho enkop? Imbalunye tiniyiolo kuna pooki.

English: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
Masaai: “Koree doi ina oitoi nalo emanyisho e wang'an, naa koree emanyisho e enaimin,

English: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
Masaai: peyie itum aitabaiki ninye olpolosie lenye, peyie itum atumusu atayiolo nena oitoi naapuo enkang enye?

English: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie amu kitoiwuoki apa ina kata, ore esiana oo nkolong'i inono naa kumok!

English: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
Masaai: “Itijing'a iyie impechen naashumieki enkare nataa osoit le nkirobi, anaa itodua iyie nena ajijik naashumishoreki oo soito le nchan,

English: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
Masaai: lelo apa laiteng'ela nanu te nkaraki enkata enyamali, te nkolong olarrabal o enjore?

English: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
Masaai: Koree enkoitoi nalo ine wueji neidapashieki ewang'an arashu ewueji neidapashieki olkutati lo loo saen tioriong enkop?

English: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
Masaai: “Aing'ae otuturo olbaata oim enkare enchan, neitobir enkoitoi te nkaraki endarata.

English: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
Masaai: Pee eyau enchan enkop ine nemetii tung'ani, ilo purkel lememanya tung'ani.

English: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
Masaai: Pee eitaraposh ina kop mijooni nememanya, neisho enkop metubulaki nkujit?

English: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
Masaai: “Keeta enchan papaai lenye, naa aing'ae ilo oitobirua ilkitong'at le nkoileelio?

English: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
Masaai: Ke ng'uset eng'ae etupukunye isoito le nchan, naa aing'ae otoiwuo isoito le nchan le shumata?

English: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
Masaai: Etoyu nkariak negolu anaa soito, ore oriong eng'uton netoyu agolu te nkirobi.

English: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
Masaai: “Indim iyie ateena ilpisia loo lakir, anaa intololong ieneta e orion?

English: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
Masaai: Indim iyie atuutai ilakir too nkatitin enye, arashu indim iyie atorikoi olgarurumi tenebo ilkuoo lenyena?

English: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie nkiguanat e keper? Indim iyie aitasheyie enkitoria enye te nkop?

English: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
Masaai: “Indim iyie atudumu oltoilo lino aitabaiki nkatampo, pee kitum olairrag loo nkariak aaitoipoi iyie?

English: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
Masaai: Indim iyie airriwai inkiwuang'at pee etum aashom, nikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Noona iyiook?’

English: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
Masaai: Aing'ae otipika eng'eno nagut atua nkatampo, arashu aing'ae naishoo eyioulounoto enkinuku?

English: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim aikena nkatampo te ng'eno nagut? Anaa aing'ae oidim atipika ilbenia le nkare.

English: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
Masaai: Ina kata eibung'a enterit aaku esarng'ab, neibung'a pooki aaku nabo?

English: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
Masaai: “Indim iyie atarreshoki olng'atuny entoki nanya, arashu intaraposho enkoshoke oo nkiyioitin olng'atuny,

English: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
Masaai: ina kata eisudori too nkapuniaa enye, arashu eirrag aanyisho too rrumati lenye?

English: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
Masaai: Aing'ae oitoti ilkurruki, ina kata eishiraki inkiyioitin enye Enkai, nemanimanaa eitu etum endaa?

English: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
Masaai: “Iyiolo iyie enkata naisho nkineji oo ldoinyio? Itodua iyie enkolii eisho?

English: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
Masaai: Indim iyie aikena ilapaitin ooitabaya ninche, niyiolou enkata napuo aaisho?

English: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie enkata nairrugo neiu nkera enye?

English: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
Masaai: Ore nkera enye neiteru aagolu nebulu too nkisiajat; nepuaya nemeitoki aarrinyokino ninche.

English: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
Masaai: “Aing'ae oishoo iloitikoishi meidapashari aapuaya? Aing'ae otalaa ieneta enkurrarru naten.

English: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
Masaai: Aishoo ninche olpurkel metaa emanyisho enye, ore enkop emunyan neaku emanyisho enye.

English: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
Masaai: Elam ninche inkanas naabore enkilepilep, nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aitoborro ninche, neisiaaishore ninche.

English: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
Masaai: Nchumat oo ldoinyo ninche ndaat enyena, nelimana aaing'oru pooki toki nanyori.

English: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
Masaai: “Keyieu olkiteng le ntim nikisiaai iyie? Keirrag ninye ilo ale lino?

English: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
Masaai: Indim iyie aibung'a ninye te nkeene mikituturoki enkurma, arashu incho ninye mikitaaraki ilboro te nkurma ino?

English: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
Masaai: Indim iyie aisiliga ninye te nkaraki naa sapuk engolon enye, naa aing'ueiki iyie ninye esiaai ino?

English: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
Masaai: Isilig iyie ninye ajo keshukunye, neyau entapa ino olkurroto oidong'ishoreki?

English: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
Masaai: “Eyuko inaipuko e sidai to lwuasa; kake amaa, keeta ninche olng'ur?

English: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
Masaai: Amu eing'uaa ninye ilmosor lenyena te nkop, neisho ninche eirowuajieki te nkop,

English: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
Masaai: nerikino ajo eidim enkeju atadanya ninche, ore ng'uesi entim neitunyoo ninche.

English: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
Masaai: Meing'urrie ninye nkera enyena, meitaas ninche anaa nkera enyena; ore hoo tenaa enepesho esiaai enye, meureisho ninye;

English: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
Masaai: amu eishoo Enkai ninye metorikinoyu eng'eno nagut, neitu eoriki ninye erubata ening'unoto.

English: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
Masaai: Ore tenedumunye ninye aisik, nekueniyie embarta olokedito ninye.

English: Hath thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
Masaai: Incho embarta engolon enye? Ieniki emurt enye engolon?

English: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
Masaai: Incho ninye eipid alo anaa olmaati? Ore enkitoo enye o ltoilo oitayu neitureisho.

English: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
Masaai: Etur ninye atua nong'ot, neng'idare engolon enye, neipang ninye alo ong'ata anang'are te ngolon olarrabal.

English: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
Masaai: Ekueniyie ninye enkuretisho, nemeirut ninye; nemeibelekenya ninye apaashare olalem.

English: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
Masaai: Eikirikirie emootian to loililai lenye neeta empere naimerlel.

English: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
Masaai: Ore te mpijan o te ngoro sapuk neijoo ninye enkop; meidim ninye aitasho aitirring'ayu te nkorui e ntarumpeta.

English: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
Masaai: Ore teneru entarumpeta, nejo ninye ‘Aha!’ Eing'uaya ninye olarrabal tenelakua endarata e lelo kituaak le njore, o nena buakunot.

English: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
Masaai: “Aiteng'eno ino nagut eyiolou lenkalem ailepa shumata oleng, nelak inaipuko enyena aipirie kopikop?

English: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
Masaai: Aitenkitanapata ino edumunye olkurragos alo ashet enkaji enye te shumata?

English: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
Masaai: Te ndapidapoi eton aitobiraki kewan enkang, neitaa ineepi oo soito osempewuet lenye.

English: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
Masaai: Eikeernu ninye entoki nainos, nedol inkonyek enyena ninye tenelakua.

English: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
Masaai: Ore nkiyioitin enyena neibibiu osarge; ore ewueji pooki neteyieng'ishoreki ine etii ninye.”

English: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajoki Yoab:

English: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
Masaai: “Keidim oloing'oru entorroni atekeshare ilo Magilani? Ore ilo oishankarrare Enkai, inchoo ninye ewal ina.”

English: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoab awaliki Olaitoriani, ejo:

English: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
Masaai: “Ng'ura ajo mara toki naikenaroyu; ainyoo nanu aawaliki iyie? Atipika nanu enkaina ai anuk enkutuk ai aiken.

English: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
Masaai: Airoro apa te nkata nabo, nemaitoki awal; kat are, nemaitoki alo dukuya.”

English: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
Masaai: Newaliki Olaitoriani Yoab to lkutati ejo:

English: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
Masaai: “Terretena empolos ino anaa olee; kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, nikimbalakinye nanu.

English: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
Masaai: Aikipik sii nanu enkitapong'oto? Aikidung'oki iyie nanu enkiguana peyie itum aitaa kewan olasipani?

English: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
Masaai: Iyata iyie enkaina natiu anaa ene Nkai? Naa indim iyie atadara to ltoilo laaijo olenye?

English: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
Masaai: Tukusoyu te nkitoo o te nkanyit. Inchopoki kewan enkitoo o esikar.

English: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
Masaai: Tubuku intayu ina goro ino nadooyo, ning'or pooki ngae owuasa, nintadoyio ninye.

English: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
Masaai: Ing'ura pooki ng'ae owuasa, nintadou ninye, nintunyoki enkop lelo torrok te pooki neitasheyie.

English: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
Masaai: Isudoi ninche pooki tenebo tiatua enterit, nkenoi inkomomi enye te nkop e abori.

English: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
Masaai: Naalotu sii nanu anyorraa, nchere enkaina ino e tatene makewan nayau enkisulata.

English: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
Masaai: “Ing'ura sii iyie ina kukuu naji Behemot ina naitobirua nanu anaa pee aaitobirua iyie; enya ninye olkujita anaa olkiteng.

English: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, empolos enye etii engolon enye, netii engolon enye nkirnyany e nkoshoke enye.

English: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
Masaai: Neitagol ninye olkidong'oe lenye anaa oltarakuai; ore isinigi loo nkejek enyena neibung'a tenebo.

English: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
Masaai: Ore iloik lenyena netiu anaa indulen o suyai; netiu inkejek enyena anaa ing'apeta e sekenkei.

English: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
Masaai: Ninye ene nkiterata too siatin pooki Enkai; inchoo ilo oitobirua ninye eitinyiku olalem lenye!

English: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
Masaai: Amu too ldoinyio epuku endaa enye, teine neiguranie ng'uesi pooki entim.

English: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
Masaai: Eirrag ninye tiabori entim oo lkiku, tiatua ine netii iseyia to lbalbal.

English: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
Masaai: Amu tiabori lelo oipi loo lkiku elo ninye ashur; neman ninye nchorroi oo nkariak.

English: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
Masaai: Ing'ura, tenenang'unye oreyiet nemeiture ninye; meeta enkuretisho hoo tenenang'unye olkeju le Yordan.

English: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
Masaai: Keetae oloidim aawa ninye too ntokitin naibung'ieki isinkir? arashu een enkume enye torreshet?

English: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
Masaai: Indim iyie aibung'a aitupuku Lefiatan to rreshet loo sinkir? Arashu ikurraki olng'ejep lenye nkeene?

English: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
Masaai: Indim iyie atipika olgosoi enkume enye: arashu iremoki olboony lenye orreshet oo lolo?

English: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
Masaai: Aikiyaki ninye esayiata sapuk aikirorie ninye iyie te mborron?

English: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
Masaai: Aikining'ore ninye iyie? Pee iya ninye metaa olaisiaayiani lino ntarasi?

English: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
Masaai: Inguranie iyie ninye anaa eninguranie emotonyi arashu intaa entoki naiguranie inkaisiaayiak inono?

English: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
Masaai: Keimaki ilainyangak enkinyang'a enye? Keorrioor ninche ninye aaoriki ilainyangak?

English: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
Masaai: Indim aiputa olchoni lenye iltidii loo sinkir; arashu ipik elukunya enye entoki naibung'ieki isinkir?

English: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
Masaai: Imbung'a sii iyie ninye; tadamu sii olarrabal, mintoki aigil aas!

English: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
Masaai: Ng'ura ore osiligi le tung'ani naa pesho; eitadouoki ninye teina duaata enye.

English: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
Masaai: Meetae hoo olopi oleng oidim atuputu ninye aing'ae naa doi ilo oidim aitasho te dukuya nanu?

English: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
Masaai: Aing'ae laishoo nanu, metaa kalaaki nanu ninye? Ore pooki toki natii abori e keper naa enaai.

English: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
Masaai: Magirakino nanu eitu alimu irubat oo nkejek enyena, arashu engolon enye, arashu ilo ning'o lenye.

English: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim aitayu olkila lenye lioriong? Aing'ae oidim ataremo ina kila enye nagol.

English: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim atabolo iltagiligil lenyena? Emanita ninye ilala lenyena ooitureisho.

English: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
Masaai: Ore enkoriong enye neitobiruaki too long'oi naaripakino, neripakino oleng anaa inaamishirakino.

English: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
Masaai: Etiripaki ninche aaitinyik oleng, ometaa meim enkijape erishata enye.

English: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
Masaai: Eibung'ieki aitutum tenebo; eibungieki metaa meekure erishayu.

English: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
Masaai: Ore pee esing ninye neidapashaa ewang'an, ore nkonyek enyena netiu anaa entadekenya nawang'u.

English: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
Masaai: Epuku te nkutuk enye ilkilang'ilang'eta le wang'an neng'orunye iltiil le nkima teine.

English: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
Masaai: Nepuku too nkumeishin enyena empuruo, naikununo anaa empuruo oo suut naayupuyup tiabori emoti.

English: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
Masaai: Ore enkiyang'et enye neinok inkuk enkima, nepuku olang'at le nkima te nkutuk enye.

English: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
Masaai: Etii emurt enye engolon, eiture ninye pooki odol ninye.

English: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
Masaai: Ore ngilat o lchoni lo sesen lenye neibung'a tenebo, ekurrakino pooki ninye metaa meigusugus.

English: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
Masaai: Egol oltau lenye anaa osoit, agol anaa osoit oturuno to lodo le nkop.

English: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
Masaai: Ore tenedumu kewan ailepie neirut lelo magil; ore te nkaraki enkuretisho enye, nemilo.

English: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
Masaai: Ore hoo nebaiki ninye olalem nemedung ninye; arashu eremet, o embae o empere naado, naji mataarie naaijo eremet.

English: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
Masaai: Edol ninye esekenkei etiu anaa olkujita, ore osuyai netiu anaa oltiapurusi.

English: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
Masaai: Meiture ninye embae meilanyisho; amu ore isoito oonang'ieki ninye netiu anaa ng'uetat.

English: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
Masaai: Ore irinkan te ninye netiu anaa olkujita, ekueniyie ninye engororoto e mpere.

English: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
Masaai: Ore ilpala lenyena le nkoshoke netiu anaa mbelibelat e moti oo nkulukuok, ekur ninye enkop neitaa esarng'ab.

English: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
Masaai: Eitokitokie ninye eng'uton anaa emoti; neitotiu enaiposha anaa emoti e ilata.

English: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie ninye neing'uaa ewang'an te nkoitoi, neibelekeny enaiposha aiborrie anaa olaburra.

English: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
Masaai: Ore tioriong enkop meeta ninye enanyaanyukie, ore ninye naa entoki nemeeta enkuretisho.

English: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
Masaai: Eing'or ninye pooki toki natii shumata; naa ninye olaiguanani oitore nkera pooki olwuasa.

English: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yoab awaliki Olaitoriani ejo,

English: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
Masaai: “Ayiolo nanu ajo indim ataasa pooki toki, nayiolo ajo meeta eyieunoto ino nemeitabari.

English: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
Masaai: ‘Aing'ae ele oisudoo enkikoo meeta eng'eno?’ ore enkaraki ina atejo imbaa neitu aning'u, intokitin enking'asia te nanu, neitu apa aidip atayiolo.

English: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
Masaai: ‘Toning'o amu kairo nanu; kaaikilikuanishore nanu iyie, nikimbalakinye iyie nanu?’

English: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
Masaai: Aatoning'oyie nanu iyie te ning'oto e nkiok, kake ore tena kata naadolita too nkonyek aainei.

English: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina atemenayie nanu kewan tukul, nairridu te nterit o too nkuruon.”

English: And it was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Olaitoriani airorie Yoab te kulo rorei, nejoki Olaitoriani Elifas le Teman: “Eyupuyupieki engoro ai te nkaraki iyie tenebo lelo shoreta linono pokira aare; amu eitu iroro intae tialo nanu imbaa naasipa anaa enairoro osinka lai Yoab.

English: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
Masaai: Ore naa taata iwa iloing'ok oopishana olmeregeshi oopishana, nilo enetii osinka lai Yoab, nilo aitayu teine te nkaraki kewan ino olasar opejori; pee kiomonoki osinka lai Yoab, amu kang'amaa enkomono enye nemaaitaas nanu iyie terisioroto emodai ino; amu eitu iro te nanu ina nasipa anaa enairoro osinka lai Yoab.”

English: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.
Masaai: Metaa eshomo Elifas le Tema tenebo Bildad le Shuhi tenebo Sofa le Naaman aas ina natiaaka Olaitoriani ninche, neng'amaa Olaitoriani enkomono e Yoab.

English: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani arrinyoki Yoab imasaa enyena, ina kata eomonoki ilchoreta lenyena. Neisho Olaitoriani Yoab katitin are oo ntokitin apa pooki naata te dukuya.

English: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
Masaai: Neitoki aapuonu enetii ninye ilalashera lenyena pooki o nkanashera o lelo pooki apa ooyiolo ninye te dukuya, nenya ninche endaa tenebo ninye te nkaji enye; neing'urrie ninche ninye neitagol too ntorrok pooki apa naayaka Olaitoriani ninye; ore pooki lenye neisho ninye mpisai tenebo olpisiai le sahabu.

English: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
Masaai: Nemayian Olaitoriani nkolong'i e siadi e Yoab oleng alang ine dukuya; neeta apa ninye intare nkalifuni tomon oong'uan, o ntamesin nkalifuni ile, o lmong'i ooturishore enkalifu nabo, osirkon enkalifu nabo.

English: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
Masaai: Eeta sii ninye apa ilayiok oopishana o ntoyie uni.

English: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
Masaai: Nedung'oki enkarna enkikau enye ajo Yemima; ore eniare neipot ajo enkarna enye Kesia, ore eneuni nedung'oki enkarna ajo Karen Happuk.

English: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
Masaai: Naa ore teina kop pooki, meetae apa ntoyie naainepu intoyie e Yoab te sidano; neitujung menye pooki tenebo lalashera lenye.

English: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu ena, enyaaka Yoab abik ilarin iip o artam, nedol ilayiok lenyena, o layiok loo layiok lenyena, iishoritin ong'uan.

English: So Job died, being old and full of days.
Masaai: Neirura Yoab, etaa olpayian kitok netobikoyie nkolong'i kumok oleng.

English: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani lemelo enkiguana oo ltung'ana torrok, nemeitashe te nkoitoi oo laing'okok, nemeton to lturrur le lelo loo lderrat torrok;

English: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
Masaai: kake ore eng'ida enye naa enkitanapata o Laitoriani, naa enkitanapata eibirribir ninye dama o kewarie.

English: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
Masaai: Eikununo ninye anaa olchani otuunoki te mbata e nkare e nchorro, oiu ilng'anayio lenyena te rishata enye, nemetoyu mbenek enyena. Ore te nena pooki naas ninye, nedupoyu.

English: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
Masaai: Mme neijia etiu lelo torrok, kake eikununo anaa suut naakutaa osiuo.

English: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etudung'okoki enkiguana lelo torrok, negeluni aaitalam olturrur le lelo supati

English: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
Masaai: amu eyiolo Olaitoriani enkoitoi e lelo supati, kake ore enkoitoi e lelo torrok naa keidak.

English: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eitobirita iloshon enkarruoisho, kainyoo pee eitobir iloreren nkitobirat enye e ntorroni e pesho?

English: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, saying,
Masaai: Eiturrurrote ilaiguanak le nkop, neiguana lelo ooitoreisho te nebo, aagilunore Olaitoriani o ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput, ejo,

English: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
Masaai: “Matalak ienat enye nabo kata, nikinturraa nkeenta enye aaitalam ate.”

English: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
Masaai: Ore ilo oton te shumata nekueni; neikordod nena kitobirat enye e pesho.

English: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
Masaai: Naa keitoki ninye airorie ninche te ngoro enye napi, neiture ninche te ngoro namutisho, ejo,

English: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
Masaai: “Atipika nanu olaiguanani lai shumata Sion, ilo doinyo lai sinyati.”

English: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
Masaai: Kalikioo nanu ina natejo Olaitoriani: Aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Ira iyie enkerai ai, ore ena olong, aatoiuo nanu iyie.

English: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.
Masaai: Toomonoki nanu, naa kaitaa nanu lelo oshon enjung'ore ino, naitaa ineeiting'ie enkop iwuejitin inono.

English: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
Masaai: Nigil iyie ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei, nintaa ninche mbelibelat anaa emoti oo nkulupuok.”

English: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, lo aiguanak, entaa ng'eni; nchoo eikok intae lo aitoriak le nkop.

English: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Masaai: Esiaayia Olaitoriani te nkuretisho, te nkikirikirata,

English: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
Masaai: entung'utut nkejek enyena, megoro ake, nindaayaya te nkoitoi; amu keyupuyup engoro enye asioki. Emayiana lelo pooki oosaru ninye.

English: LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, meikenayu ilmang'ati laainei! Aatudumakinote nanu ilkumok aagilunore;

English: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.
Masaai: ejoito ilkumok ti alo nanu, metii eretoto naing'uaa Enkai te nkaraki ninye.

English: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira elong'o naamanita nanu, iyie enkitoo ai, naa iyie likishumu endukuya.

English: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
Masaai: Atabuakua nanu aishiraki Olaitoriani, naawaliki ninye nanu te ilo doinyo lenye sinyati.

English: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
Masaai: Airraga nanu nairura; naitoki ainyototo, amu Olaitoriani laarripito.

English: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
Masaai: Maure nanu iltung'ana nkalifuni tomon, lelo laatudumakinote nanu aarare naamuat.

English: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
Masaai: Inyo, iyie Olaitoriani! Tokorduaki nanu na Ai ai! Amu itoosho iyie ilmang'ati laainei pooki eseder, itigila iyie ilala le lelo arruok.

English: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.
Masaai: Eno Laitoriani enkordunoto meetu mayianat inono shumata iltung'ana linono.

English: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
Masaai: Tawalikiaki nanu te naipot, iyie na Ai e sipata ai! Kinchoo iyie nanu erishata ina kata atii atua osina. Ing'urrieki nanu, nining enkomono ai.

English: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
Masaai: Lo tung'ana, eikintukurrurru akenya o anu? Inyorrurru intae irorei le pesho o anu, nirubarere elejare?

English: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
Masaai: Kake tayiolo nchere, etegelaka Olaitoriani kewan ilo oure ninye; kening Olaitoriani te naipot nanu ninye.

English: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
Masaai: Entagoroto kake emiaas ingok enguanata too ltauja linyi too ndapashi inyi, nigirara.

English: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
Masaai: Ntayu ilasarri oosipa nipik osiligi lino atua Olaitoriani.

English: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
Masaai: Etii ilkumok oojo, “Oi naaji tenaa eikidol iyiook embae sidai. Ntorioki iyiook ewang'an e nkomom ino, Olaitoriani!”

English: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
Masaai: Itipika iyie eng'ida kitok oltau lai nalang eng'ida naata ninche teneponari entapa enye o enaisho oo sabibu.

English: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
Masaai: Te seriani nanu airrag airura, amu iyie ake Olaitoriani likincho matobiko te seriani.

English: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
Masaai: Toning'o irorei laainei, iyie Olaitoriani; toduaa ndamunot aainei o ltau.

English: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
Masaai: Toning'o oltoilo le nkishirata ai, Olaiguanani lai naa Enkai ai, amu iyie aomon nanu.

English: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ining iyie oltoilo lai tadekenya; ore tadekenya naaitobiraki nanu iyie olasar, naton aanyisho.

English: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
Masaai: Amu mira iyie Enkai nashipakino entorroni; meton entorroni te nebo iyie.

English: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
Masaai: Meidim ilo oitokoos aitasho te dukuya nkonyek inono; imba iyie ilaasak loo ntorrok pooki.

English: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
Masaai: Indaikie iyie lelo ooiro elejare; neitame Olaitoriani lelo oata enkure o sarge o ltung'ana.

English: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino sapuk nauno, naa kajing atua enkaji ino; kaseremisho nanu aipirare ina aji ino sinyati te uriata ino.

English: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
Masaai: Torikoyioki nanu Olaitoriani te supatisho ino, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei; ntorioi enkoitoi ino te dukuya nanu.

English: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
Masaai: Amu metii esipata nkutukie enye; ore iltauja lenye naa enkidaata, ore olgos lenye naa enkurare nang'a, neikordodisho to lng'ejep lenye.

English: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche enap enkitarruorroto enye, iyie Enkai; nchoo ninche ebatata too nkiguanat enye maate; ore te nkaraki nkitarruorot enye kumok taarai ninche mpang'ie, amu kitogolong'akita ninche iyie.

English: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
Masaai: Kake nchoo lelo pooki likisaru iyie meting'idata, nchoo ninche metaranyisho anaake te ng'ida; naa tomitu iyie ninche, paa ore lelo pooki oonyor enkarna ino niking'idakino iyie.

English: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
Masaai: Amu imayian iyie ilo asipani, iyie Olaitoriani; nintushur iyie ninye enyorrata ino anaa elong'o.

English: O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, mikisikong nanu te ngoro ino, nimikintame nanu te ngoro ino napi.

English: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Olaitoriani, amu ataa oloishunye nanu: Olaitoriani, nchiunyeki, amu etororonyate iloik laainei.

English: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
Masaai: Netanyamala sii oltau lai. Kake amaa iyie Olaitoriani, o anu kenya?

English: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu Olaitoriani, ntajeu enkishui ai; tokorduaki nanu te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino nauno.

English: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
Masaai: Amu ore ti atua keeya nimikintokini aadamu iyie; amaa, ti atua enemeneng'a kaing'ae likisis iyie?

English: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
Masaai: Atalepori nanu te nkishirata ai; ore pooki kewarie neibalibala ilkiyio laainei te ndapash, neilibilib endapash ai too lkiyio.

English: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
Masaai: Eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina, eimisiloitie te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei.

English: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
Masaai: Enchom entung'uayioki, intae pooki aasak loo ntorrok; amu etoning'o Olaitoriani oltoilo le nkishirata ai.

English: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
Masaai: Etoning'o Olaitoriani enkomono ai, etang'amayie Olaitoriani enkomono ai.

English: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
Masaai: Keitukurruni ilmang'ati laainei pooki, neitanyamali, keibelekenya ninche aarrinyo, neitukurruni te nkata nabo.

English: O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyie nanu asaru; ntajeuoki nanu te lelo pooki laasujita, nikikordu nanu,

English: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
Masaai: maaibung ake anaa olng'atuny, naaing'irtitoo aanya, metii hoo obo laamitu.

English: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, te nataasa nanu ena, te netii entorroni nkaik aainei,

English: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
Masaai: tenaa katalaaka nanu olchore lai te ntorroni, tenaa kaitajeuo nanu ilo mang'atinta lai pesho,

English: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
Masaai: nchoo ninye ilo mang'tinta lai aasuj naainepu nanu, naa nchoo ninye eitunyoki enkishui ai enkop, neipurrupur oltau lai.

English: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.
Masaai: Tudumunye Olaitoriani te ngoro ino, ntaisheikinore tigilunore ina pushuna oo lmang'ati laainei; inyo na Ai ai; amu itudung'uo iyie enkiguana.

English: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
Masaai: Nchoo eumata oo ltung'ana kinturrurrokino iyie, aaman; ore te shumata tipika olorika lino.

English: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oiguanare loreren; nguanareki nanu iyie Olaitoriani, te risioroto oo sipat aainei, o te risioroto e ina biotisho e supatisho ai

English: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
Masaai: nchoo eiting entorroni e lelo torrok, kake ntubulai ilo supat, iyie ilo otem ndamunot o ltauja, iyie Enkai oo sipat.

English: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
Masaai: Enkai ninye elong'o ai, ninye oitajeu ilo supat to ltau.

English: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry with the wicked every day.
Masaai: Enkai olaiguanani loo sipat, naa Enkai naata engoro nkolong'i pooki.

English: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
Masaai: Te nemeirridu oltung'ani, neii Enkai olalem lenye, eteyietuo ninye enkawuo enye;

English: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
Masaai: neitobira ninye nena masaa enyena o larrabal torrok, nepik mbaa enyena esayiet napi.

English: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore ilo tung'ani torrono nedamu entorroni, nenuta ninche ntabo, neiu elejare.

English: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
Masaai: Neitobiru ninye engumoto aturu, nedoiki atua ina gumoto natuturuo.

English: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
Masaai: Ore ina taboi enye nerrinyokino enkorrok enye makewan, naa endukuya enye makewan edoiki entaboi enye.

English: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe nairirikino esupatisho enye, naranyaki nanu te nkisisa enkarna o Laitoriani, Ilo otii shumata Aisul.

English: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lang, kebaa enkitoo e nkarna ino te nkop pooki! Ore enkisisa e nkitoo ino nebaiki keper

English: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
Masaai: too nkutukie oo nkera kutiti o naanakita, intobira iyie olkitamanyunoto le negol, te nkaraki ilmang'ati linono, pee imbooyo ilo mang'atinta o ilo oitalaku elap.

English: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
Masaai: Te naing'or nanu keper ino, ina siaai oo lkimojik linono, olapa o lakir litipika iyie;

English: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
Masaai: kainyoo oltung'ani lilo iyie ashilaa, o enkerai e tung'ani ligolie iyie ninye?

English: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
Masaai: Nintaa iyie ninye kiti penyo te Enkai, ninchopoko iyie ninye enkitoo o enkanyit.

English: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
Masaai: Nchoo iyie ninye enkitoria te shumata isiaaitin oo nkaik inono; itipika iyie ntokitin pooki abori nkejek enyena,

English: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
Masaai: ore nkerra pooki o lmong'i, ng'uesi sii e ong'ata.

English: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
Masaai: Imotonyi o loing'ang'e, o sinkir le naiposha, pooki toki ake ninye nalo ti atua enaiposha.

English: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lang, kebaa enkitoo e nkarna ino ti atua enkop pooki!

English: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe to ltau lai pooki; kalikioo nena kiaasin inono e nking'asia.

English: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu naa kaaranyaki iyie, karanyisho nanu te nkisisa e nkarna ino, iyie Olotii Shumata Aisul.

English: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
Masaai: Te neibelekenya ilmang'ati laainei, kerrorro neidak te dukuya iyie.

English: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
Masaai: Amu ntasheyie iyie esipata ai; itotona iyie to lorika le nkitoo ninguana te sipata.

English: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Isikong'a iyie iloshon, ndaikie iyie lelo torrok; aitujutoyie iyie aiwuang'ie enkarna enye ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
Masaai: Eisha ilmang'ati te nkidaata oo ntarasi; nitadotuo iyie nkanas enye; ore endamunoto enye neisha.

English: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
Masaai: Kake eton Olaitoriani to lorika le nkitoo ntarasi, neitasheyie olorika lenye le nkitoo pee etum atudung'o enkiguana;

English: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
Masaai: nedung'oki ninye enkop enkiguana te sipata, nedung'oki loreren enkiguana too nkiririkinot.

English: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye osempewuet le ilo oitorogonyi, osempewuet too nkatitin e nyamali.

English: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooyiolo enkarna ino nepik osiligi lenye atua iyie, amu ore iyie Olaitoriani, neitu inturraa lelo likisilig iyie.

English: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
Masaai: Entaranyaki enkisisa Olaitoriani, ilo oton te Sion! Entolikioi ti atua loreren nkiaasin enyena!

English: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oitalaku elap o sarge, nedamu ninche; merikino ninye olkiyioi le ilo oata osina.

English: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu Olaitoriani! Toduaa enyamali naata te nkaraki lelo laaiba, Iyie ilo laadumu nanu aitung'uaa nchomito e keeya,

English: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
Masaai: pee atum atolimu enkisisa ino, paa ore too nchomito e ina tito e Sion, nang'idakino nanu enkordunoto ino.

English: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
Masaai: Eimiso iloshon tiatua ina gumoto natuturo ninche; ore te ilo rreshet oisudoitie ninche nerruesh nkejek enye maate.

English: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
Masaai: Eibalunye Olaitoriani kewan, etudung'o ninye enkiguana; etijing'a lelo torrok orreshet ti atua esiaai oo nkaik enye maate.

English: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.
Masaai: Kepuo lelo torrok aajing enemeneng'a, lelo oshon pooki lemedamu Enkai.

English: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
Masaai: Ore ilaisinak nemeitokini aapalaa anaake ore osiligi loo laisinak nemerrarri ntarasi.

English: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
Masaai: Tudumunye Olaitoriani! Mincho oltung'ani meisula; nchoo iloreren eiguanareki te dukuya iyie!

English: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
Masaai: Tipika ninche atua enkuretisho, Olaitoriani! Nchoo iloreren eyiolou aajo iltung'ana ake ninche!

English: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee intashe alamari, iyie Olaitoriani? Kainyoo iyie pee isudoo kewan too nkatitin oo ng'olikinot.

English: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
Masaai: To lwuasa emir lelo torrok ilaisinak; nchoo meibung'a ninche lelo rresheta ooitobira.

English: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.
Masaai: Amu keitokoos ilo torrono too yieunot o ltau lenye, ore ilo tung'ani oata olorok loo masaa nemenaa Enkai.

English: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
Masaai: Ore to lwuasa le nkomom enye nemeing'oru ninye Enkai; ore too ndamunot enyena pooki naa, “Meetae Enkai.”

English: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
Masaai: Nebul too nkoitoi enyena nkatitin pooki; ore nkiguanat inono netii shumata, mebaiki ninye; ore ilmang'ati lenyena pooki neikordod ninche.

English: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
Masaai: Nedamu ninye to ltau lenye ajo, “Maaigusugusieki nanu; ore ti atua iishoritin pooki matum nanu batisho.”

English: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
Masaai: Ebore enkutuk enye ildeketa o elejare o enkitorogonyare; ore abori olng'ejep lenye netii ntabo o entorroni.

English: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
Masaai: Neton ninye to lnukata too nkang'itie, ore ti atua iwuejitin neeisudoriyie nesesekuan lelo supati. Neikeern lelo ooshal,

English: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
Masaai: neirrag ninye to lnukata lenye anaa olng'atuny; neirrag ninye pee etum aibunga ilo aisinani, neibung ninye ilo aisinani te nemiraki ninye atua orreshet lenye.

English: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
Masaai: Nerrarri ilo oshal, neimisieki te nkop, nebatata te ngolon enye.

English: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see it.
Masaai: Nejo to ltau lenye, “Etorikine Enkai, eisudoyie ninye enkomom enye, medol ae kata ina.”

English: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
Masaai: Tudumunye, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie Enkai, tudumu enkaina ino; mincho kirikino ilo oata osina.

English: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require it.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eany ilo torrono Enkai, nejo to ltau lenye, “Maaitamie ninye nanu.”

English: Thou hast seen it; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
Masaai: Idol iyie; ee, itoduaa iyie enyamali o sina, pee itum iyie aiwuang'ie too nkaik inono; ore ilo oshal naa iyie eigarakino; iyie otaa olaretoni loo lokishin.

English: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.
Masaai: Tigila iyie enkaina e ilo torrono o eno larruoni; tusuja entorroni enye o metaba anaa neishunye.

English: The LORD is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye olaiguanani ntarasi o ntarasi; keidak iloshon te nkaina enye.

English: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ining iyie eyieunoto eilo obor; nintagol iyie ninye oshoke nirrugoki enkiok ino

English: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
Masaai: pee inguenare te sipata ilo okishi o ilo oibookoki enkop, paa ore ilo tung'ani le nkop nemeigil ae kata aitureisho.

English: In the LORD put I my trust: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
Masaai: Atua Olaitoriani nanu asaru; kaji iyie inko pee kijoki nanu, “Isika anaa emotonyi shomo ildoinyo;

English: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
Masaai: amu ng'ura, eteyietutuo lelo torrok enkawuo enye, etipika ninche embae enye empito, pee etum aatang'or te naimin ilo supat to ltau;

English: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
Masaai: amaa te neidaikieki ilkitamanyunot kaa eas ilo supat?”

English: The LORD is in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
Masaai: Etii Olaitoriani atua enkaji enye sinyati, etii olorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani keper; neing'orisho too nkonyek enyena, netem too nkonyek enyena, nkera e tung'ana.

English: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
Masaai: Ketem Olaitoriani ilo supat o ltorrono, neiba to ltau lenye olarruoni.

English: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
Masaai: Ore te lelo torrok, naa keitashaiki nkuk e nkima o enchan oo soito; o lkutati opejisho olo aaku erubata e nkikompe enye.

English: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
Masaai: Amu aisupat Olaitoriani, nenyor ninye nkiaasin supati; ilo oata oltau sidai odol enkomon enye.

English: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
Masaai: Taretu iyiook, Olaitoriani: amu meekure eetae hoo obo oata euriata e Nkai; amu eishunye ilooisiligayu tiatua nkera e tung'ana.

English: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
Masaai: Eiro pooki ng'ae elejare tialo ole latia enye; to lkoroj o te nkilelemare eiro ninche.

English: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
Masaai: Metudung'oi Olaitoriani nkutukie pooki naaikorojisho lelo ng'ejepa le nkitokoos kitok,

English: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
Masaai: lelo oojo, “Ore olng'ejep lang nikisulie, kiaata nkutukie ang, kaing'ae naitore iyiook.”

English: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki naitorogonyaki olaisinani, oe nkaraki naigorito ilo oata osina kadumunye taata nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo; “Kapik nanu ninye atua ina seriani naa ninye eng'uar.”

English: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
Masaai: Ore nkisiligat o Laitoriani naa nkisiligat naasila, naaikununo anaa enkosholai natisilaki to lkokuet te nkop, nesili katitin naapishana.

English: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
Masaai: Torripo iyie iyiook Olaitoriani, torripo iyiook anaake tena ishoi.

English: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
Masaai: Ore too nkaloli pooki, nemanimanaa anaa olng'atuny lelo torrok anaa enatudumuye entorroni aponari ti atua nkera e tung'ana.

English: How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
Masaai: Ke nkata nabaa iyie Olaitoriani? mikidamu iyie nanu? Kenkata nabaa isudoo iyie enkomom ino te nanu.

English: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
Masaai: Kanap nanu emion to ltau lai o anu, naisinanuo to ltau lai endama pooki? Keitokoos akenya olmang'atinta lai ti alo nanu o anu?

English: Consider and hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
Masaai: Ing'uraki nanu, nikiwaliki, iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai ai; ntawang'a nkonyek aainei, pee mairura ake too njo e keeya;

English: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
Masaai: pee mejo ake olmang'atinta lai, “Aisula nanu te ninye”; pee meng'ida ake ilo mang'atinta lai tenkaraki embatata ai.

English: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
Masaai: Kake aisiliga nanu ina nyorrata ino nauno; naa keng'ida oltau lai te nkaraki enjeunoto ino.

English: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
Masaai: Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani, amu aaitaasa ninye nanu ine supatisho te nkumoi.

English: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that doeth good.
Masaai: Ejo ilo modai to ltau lenye, “Meetae Enkai.” Etarruoitie ninche, neas mbaa o lminong, meetae hoo obo oas mbaa sidain.

English: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
Masaai: Eing'or Olaitoriani kop etii keper, neing'or nkera e tung'ana, pee edol tenaa ketii iloasisho te ng'eno, lelo ooing'oru Enkai.

English: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Masaai: Eshomo ninche pooki aapong'ori, enyaanyuk pooki; meetae hoo obo oas isupati, meetae, metii hoo obo.

English: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
Masaai: Aimeeta ninche eng'eno, kulo aasak loo ntorrok pooki, ooinos iltung'ana laainei, anaa enainos ninche endaa, nemeserem ninche Olaitoriani?

English: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
Masaai: Ore te ine kepuo ninche aajing olkirutoto sapuk, amu etii Enkai te nebo ina ishoi e lelo supati.

English: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
Masaai: Inyalinyala intae nena kitobirat e ilo aisinani, kake Olaitoriani esarunoto enye.

English: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
Masaai: Oi siaake elotu enkordunoto e Israel eing'uaa Sion! Te neitopok Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, naa keng'ida Yakobo, neshipayu Israel.

English: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, kaing'ae olo aton to lng'obor lino? Kaing'ae olo amany ilo doinyo lino sinyati.

English: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
Masaai: Ilo olo meeta entioto, neas isupati, neiro esipata to ltau lenye;

English: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
Masaai: nemeiro mbaa e nkiteenikino to lng'ejep lenye, nemeitaas entorroni olchore lenye, nemekur aitubulaa olmarenke teilo le latia enye;

English: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.
Masaai: laa ore too nkonyek enyena nemenaa looiba Enkai, neyanyit lelo ooure Enkai, ilo oinos olmumai nemeibelekenya;

English: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
Masaai: nemeitayu mpisai enyena te nkaraki dupoto, nemeng'amaa ninye entoki e ropare pee einyal esipata. Ore ilo oas kuna baa nemeigusugusieki ae kata.

English: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
Masaai: Tagolieki nanu Olaitoriani, amu iyie nanu asaru.

English: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to thee;
Masaai: Atiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Ira iyie Olaitoriani lai; ore pooki toki sidai naata naa iyie eing'uaa.”

English: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
Masaai: Ore ti alo lelo sinyat ootii enkop, naa ile tipat ninche, laa ninche nanu ashipakino.

English: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
Masaai: Ore lelo oogelu ae kitanyaanyukoto oo nkaitin neponaa isinaitin lenye; ore lelo asarri lenye lo sarge nemaibukoo nanu, nemaipot nkarn e nena kitanyaanyukoto te nkutuk ai.

English: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye erubata ai nageluno naa enkikompe ai, mbung'ita iyie enkishui ai.

English: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
Masaai: Kebaa enking'asia oo nkishorot inono te nanu, kebaa esidano enye!

English: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani laa ninye laaikok, ore sii te nkewarie naaiteng'en oltau lai.

English: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Masaai: Kapik nanu anaake Olaitoriani dukuya ai; amu etii ninye enkaina ai e tatene, maaigusugusieki nanu.

English: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keng'ida oltau lai, neshipa enkishui ai; neton sii osesen lai te seriani.

English: For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Masaai: Amu eitu iyie kipalaa mashomo atua enemeneng'a, neitu ncho ilo oure Enkai edoiki engumoto.

English: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
Masaai: Kintodol iyie nanu enkoitoi e nkishui; ore enitii iyie, netii eng'ida nabore, ore enkaina ino e tatene netii ntokitin sidain ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goeth not out of feigned lips.
Masaai: Toning'o esipata, iyie Olaitoriani; toning'o enkishirata ai! Nchoo enkiok ino enkomono ai naing'uaa enkutuk nemetii elejare!

English: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.
Masaai: Nchoo eaku iyie eing'uaa esipata ai! Nchoo nkonyek inono edol esipata!

English: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
Masaai: Ti nitem iyie oltau lai, ti nikimutan iyie nanu kewarie, ti nikijur iyie nanu, nimitum iyie entorroni ti atua nanu; eitu apong'ori too nkirorot aainei.

English: Concerning the words of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
Masaai: Ore ti alo isiaaitin e tung'ana, ore to rorei lino, natapaasha nanu nkoitoi oo larruok.

English: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip not.
Masaai: Ore roruat aainei neibung'a nkoitoi inono, eitu eideketari nkejek aainei.

English: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.
Masaai: Aaipoto nanu iyie, amu eikiwaliki iyie, Olaitoriani; irrugokoki enkiok ino, toning'o irorei laainei.

English: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.
Masaai: Ntodolu enyorrata ino nauno te mpukunoto e nking'asia, iyie Laaitajeunoni le lelo likisaru, too lmang'ati lenye te nkaina ino e tatene.

English: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
Masaai: Tagolieki nanu anaa enerok e nkong'u; isudoyioki nanu to loip loo naipuko inono,

English: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
Masaai: te nkaraki ilo torrono laainyal nanu, lelo mang'ati laainei laamanita nanu.

English: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
Masaai: Neitagol ninche iltauja lenye; pee meitoki aata olng'ur, ore too nkutukie enye neiro te nkitokoos.

English: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
Masaai: Naasuj ninche nanu; naatamana taata ninche; naaing'or nanu pee aatum aatanang'ie enkop.

English: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
Masaai: Eikununo ninche anaa olng'atuny oibung eng'ues, etiu anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny erreshito eng'ues.

English: Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:
Masaai: Tudumunye, Olaitoriani! Intoriokinoyu ninche taarare, tanang'ai ninche! Tokordu enkishui ai ti alo ilo torrono to lalem lino,

English: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
Masaai: tokorduaki too ltung'ana te nkaina ino, iyie Olaitoriani, tialo lelo tung'ana laa ore erubata enye te nkishui naa ena kop. Ntamio ninche teilo sina litushumaka ninche, menoto nkera enye osina olang ilo, metelekakini ilo sina nkera oo nkera enye.

English: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
Masaai: Ore nanu, naa kaing'or enkomom ino te supatisho, te nainyototo, naraposho te nduaata ino.

English: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
Masaai: Kaanyor nanu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, iyie engolon ai.

English: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye endapidapoi ai, o sempewuaet lai, naa olakordunoni, Enkai ai, endapidapoi ai naa ninye asaru, elong'o ai, naa emowuo e njeunoto ai, naa ninye osempewuet lai.

English: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.
Masaai: Aipoto nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye eishiaakino neisisi, naaitajeuo nanu too lmang'ati laainei.

English: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
Masaai: Aatamana nanu nkeenta e keeya, naaiputukunyie nanu olairrag le nkare e ntorroni.

English: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
Masaai: Aatamana nanu nkeenta e nemeneng'a, naaipirakinore nanu irresheta le keeya.

English: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
Masaai: Ore ti atua osina lai naipoto Olaitoriani; Enkai ai nanu aishiraka maataretu. Ore etii enkaji enye sinyati nening oltoilo lai, ore ina kishirata naishiraka ninye nelo abaiki nkiyiaa enyena.

English: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
Masaai: Neikirikira taa enkop neigirigiro; ore sii ilkitamanyunot loo ldoinyo neikirikira, nejing enkop olokirikiri te nkaraki natagore ninye.

English: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
Masaai: Nepuku empuruo too nkumeishin enyena, nepuku enkima nanyaisho te nkutuk enye, o nkuk naaishu naapuku te ninye.

English: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
Masaai: Neirrugu ninye shumata, nedou alotu kop; netii emisimisi kitok abori nkejek enye.

English: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
Masaai: Neked ninye enchumata olkerubi, nelo tiaai, nelo too naipuko o siwuo.

English: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
Masaai: Neitaa ninye enaimin enkimulumulet ore enkitushuret enye naa nkatampo naairrusha naabore enkare.

English: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
Masaai: Ore te ina wang'an e nkiwuang'ata natii dukuya ninye, nepuku isoito sapuki le nchan o nkuk e nkima.

English: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
Masaai: Etadara sii Olaitoriani to loing'ang'e, ore Ilo otii Shumata Aisul neitayu oltoilo lenye, neitayu enchan oo soito o nkuk naaishu.

English: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninye mbaa enyena, neidapash ninche; neyau nkiwuang'at o enkimerlel, neidapash ninche.

English: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.
Masaai: Nelioyu nkoitoi e nkare tiatua enaiposha, ore ilkitamanyunot le nkop neibalayu aalioyu, te mbuakunoto ino, Olaitoriani, te nkutata e nkiyang'et oo nkumeishin inono.

English: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
Masaai: Naabaiki ninye atii enkop, naaya nanu, naaitayu ninye nanu ti atua nkariak kumok.

English: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
Masaai: Naakordu ninye nanu te ilo mang'atinta lai ogol, o te lelo laaiba nanu; amu kegol ninche oleng te nanu.

English: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.
Masaai: Eetuo ninche shumata nanu te ina olong o sina lai, kake Olaitoriani ninye entonata ai.

English: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
Masaai: Aayaua ninye ewueji nelala; aatokordua ninye nanu amu aatishipakine nanu.

English: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.
Masaai: Aatalaaka nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto oo sipat aainei; te risioroto e sinyatisho oo nkaik aainei aatalaaka ninye nanu.

English: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
Masaai: Amu aibung'a nanu nkoitoi o Laitoriani, neitu nanu alo aing'uaa Olaitoriani Enkai ai te ntorroni.

English: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
Masaai: Amu ore nkiguanat enyena pooki netii dukuya nanu, ore nkikoot enyena neitu nanu aiwuang'ie aitalam kewan.

English: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
Masaai: Maata apa nanu eleyiata te dukuya ninye, naitalam nanu kewan nkitadiaat.

English: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
Masaai: Ore nkaraki ina, aatalaaka nanu Olaitoriani te risioroto e supatisho ai, te risioroto e sinyatisho oo nkaik aainei, te dukuya ninye.

English: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;
Masaai: Ore te lelo supati nintodolu esupatisho ino, ore to ltung'ani lemeeta entioto nintodol esinyatisho ino.

English: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.
Masaai: Ore te ilo lemeiduruk nintodol ajo minduruk iyie; ore te ilo otolo nintodol entoloi ino.

English: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
Masaai: Amu ikordu iyie lelo oobor; kake ore lelo oowuasa nerup ate nintadou.

English: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
Masaai: Ee, inok iyie oltaa lai; Olaitoriani Enkai ai oitawang enaimin ai.

English: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.
Masaai: Ee, ore te nkaraki iyie namir oltim loo lmang'ati; ore te nkaraki Enkai ai naidim aida esuntai.

English: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
Masaai: Ore ena Ai, nesipa enkoitoi enye; ore enkisiligata o Laitoriani neuno asipayu; elong'o ninye te lelo pooki oosaru ninye.

English: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
Masaai: Amu kaing'ae Enkai leme Olaitoriani? Naa, kaing'ae endapidapoi neme Enkai ang?

English: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
Masaai: Ina Ai naaterretena nanu te ngolon, neitaserian enkoitoi ai.

English: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet, and setteth me upon my high places.
Masaai: Neiteneneng nkejek aainei anaa entarakuet, naaitaserian ninye nanu too neeika.

English: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.
Masaai: Neitaarriyian ninye nkaik aainei to larrabal, neaku keidim nkaik aatoriuo enkawuo o suyai.

English: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.
Masaai: Kinchoo iyie nanu elong'o e njeunoto ino, ore enkaina ino e tatene naaitagol nanu, ore eretoto ino naaitaa nanu kitok.

English: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
Masaai: Kinchoo iyie nanu ewueji nelala te nkaraki nkejek aainei, neitu eideketari nkejek aainei.

English: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
Masaai: Atimira nanu ilmang'ati laainei nainepu ninche; neitu nanu arrinyo o metaba anaa neidak ninche.

English: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
Masaai: Atoosho ninche anang'ie enkop nemeigil ninche aadumunye nebatata ti abori nkejek aainei.

English: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
Masaai: Amu kiterretena iyie nanu te ngolon, te nkaraki olarrabal; ninchoo ilmang'ati laainei meimiso tiabori nanu.

English: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
Masaai: Iyie oishoo ilmang'ati laainei meibelekenyata aailanyisho, ore lelo apa laaiba naidaikie nanu ninche.

English: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.
Masaai: Eishira ninche eing'oru eretoto, kake meetae oloitajeu ninche, eishirakitia ninche Olaitoriani kake eitu ninye ewaliki ninche.

English: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
Masaai: Aidong'o nanu ninche metotiwuo anaa enterit te dukuya; atanang'ayie nanu ninche anaa esarng'ab oo nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa.

English: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
Masaai: Kitokordua iyie nanu aitung'uaa enkesha oo ltung'ana, kintaa iyie nanu endukuya oo loshon; ore iloreren apa lemayiolo naaisiaai nanu.

English: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
Masaai: Ore ake pee aaning ninche nanu naairuk ninche; ore iltung'ana omon naayanyitu nanu.

English: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
Masaai: Etalepori iltung'ana omon, nepuonu ninche eikirikira eing'uaa isempewueti lenye.

English: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
Masaai: Keishu Olaitoriani; meisisi ina dapidapoi ai, meitaae kitok Enkai e njeunoto ai,

English: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
Masaai: ina Ai naitalaku elap nepik iloreren abori nanu;

English: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.
Masaai: ilo laakordu nanu too lmang'ati laainei; ee, eikilepunye iyie aitulusoo too lmang'ati laainei; kitokordua iyie nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal.

English: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ena kaarrep nanu iyie, Olaitoriani ti atua iloreren, narany arrep enkarna ino.

English: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye enkisulata kitok ilo aiguanani lenye, neitodolu enyorrata nauno te ilo lenye otubukoki eilata aaput, Daudi o eishoi enye ntarasi.

English: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
Masaai: Eitodolu keper enkitoo o Laitoriani; ore oloing'ang'e neitodolu esiaai oo nkaik enyena.

English: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
Masaai: Ore enkolong o enkolong neinosakino lomon, ore enkewarie o enkewarie neibalunye eng'eno.

English: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
Masaai: Meetae enkiroroto, nemeetae irorei; mening'o iltoiloishi lenye;

English: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
Masaai: ore ake eyia, nelo oltoilo lenye aim enkop pooki, ore rorei lenye nebaiki ineeiting'ie enkop. Ore atua ninche netipika olng'obor le nkolong,

English: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
Masaai: ina olong nailepu anaa oloyamisho eipang'u te nkaji enye, o anaa oltung'ani ogol okuet ailanyisho te ng'ida.

English: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
Masaai: Ore enkilepunoto enye naa ineeiting'ie keper eing'uaa, ore manarot enyena nelo ineeiting'ie ninche, nemeetae entoki naisudoyioki te nkirowuaj enye.

English: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
Masaai: Ore enkitanapata o Laitoriani naa keikishiaan, neitopiu oltau; ore enchakenisho o Laitoriani naa kedede, neiteng'en olmodai;

English: The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
Masaai: ore nkikoot o Laitoriani naa sidain, neiting'id oltau; ore nkitanapat o Laitoriani naa kesila, nepik nkonyek ewang'an;

English: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.
Masaai: ore euriata o Laitoriani nemeiduruk, nebikoo ntarasi, ore nkiguanat o Laitoriani nesipa naa supati pooki.

English: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
Masaai: Neng'uarrayu ninche oleng aalang sahabu, aalang ninye sahabu sidai, nemelok sii aalang enaisho nelang olkenkei le mulug.

English: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
Masaai: Naa ninche eikokieki osinka lino; ore te nkibung'ata enye netii olerrinyore kitok.

English: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
Masaai: Kake kaing'ae omusu nkitarruorot enyena? Ntisinyaki iyie nanu too nkitarruorot naaisudoro.

English: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
