Masaai: Imbooi iyie osinka lino too ng'ok o lwuasa, mincho ninche etum engolon ti atua nanu! Pee atum ataa maata entioto nasinyayu too nkitarruorot sapuki.

English: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
Masaai: Nchoo irorei le nkutuk ai, o nkibirribirrat o ltau lai, eng'amaroyu too nkonyek inono, iyie Olaitoriani, endapidapoi ai, naa olakordunoni lai.

English: The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;
Masaai: Mikitawaliki Olaitoriani iyie te nkolong e nyamali! Mikitorripo enkarna e Nkai e Yakobo!

English: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;
Masaai: Mikirriwaki ninye iyie eretoto naing'uaa enkaji enye sinyati, nikintagolo ninye iyie te ina golon naing'uaa Sion!

English: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
Masaai: Metadamu ninye ilasarri linono pooki, neing'or te nyorrarota ilasarri linono oopejori!

English: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
Masaai: Mikinchoo ninye iyie iyieunot o ltau lino, neitabaya nkitobirat inyi pooki!

English: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
Masaai: Nchoo iyiook matabuaku te ng'ida te nkaraki enkisulata ino, ore te nkarna e Nkai ang nikiun iyiook inankan ang! Meitabai Olaitoriani iomonunot inyi pooki.

English: Now know I that the LORD saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
Masaai: Ayiolo taata nanu ajo keretu Olaitoriani ilo lenye otubukokoki eilata aaput, kewaliki ninye te ine wueji sinyati te shumata, eeta nkisulat sapuki naaisula te nkaina enye.

English: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Eng'idare kulikae ngarrin oo mbartan, neng'idare kulikae mbartan; kake king'idare iyiook enkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang.

English: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
Masaai: Keurori ninche aabatata; kake kidumunye iyiook nikintashe aaitoriori.

English: Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.
Masaai: Nchoo olaiguanani meisula, Olaitoriani; tawaliki iyiook ti nikimpot iyie.

English: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
Masaai: Te ngolon ino eng'ida olaiguanani iyie, Olaitoriani; naa te retoto ino eisulie ninye oleng.

English: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
Masaai: Inchoo iyie ninye eyieunoto oltau lenye neitu iyie mbooyo eomonunoto e nkutuk enye.

English: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.
Masaai: Amu inang'are iyie ninye too mayianat sidain, ninchopoki ninye enkopiyia e nkitoo e sahabu nasila endukuya enye.

English: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
Masaai: Neomonu ninye enkishui te iyie, nincho iyie ninye, nkolong'i kumok ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.
Masaai: Eisapuk enkitoo enye te nkaraki eretoto ino; nchopoko iyie ninye enkikodo o enkitoo.

English: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.
Masaai: Ee, ntaa iyie ninye olomayiana oleng ntarasi, ninting'id iyie ninye te dukuya enkomom ino.

English: For the king trusteth in the LORD, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani eisilig olaiguanani; naa ore te nkaraki ina nyorrata nauno e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul, nemeigusugusuieki ninye.

English: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.
Masaai: Ore enkaina ino ninye nalo aing'oru ilmang'ati linono pooki; neing'oru enkaina ino e tatene lelo pooki likimba.

English: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the LORD shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
Masaai: Nintotiu iyie ninche anaa olang'at le nkima te liooto ino. Keijoo Olaitoriani ninche te ngoro enye; neinos ninche enkima.

English: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
Masaai: Nindaikie iyie eishoi enye te nkop, niwuang'ie nkera enye aishie ti atua ltung'ana.

English: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
Masaai: Ti nikintobiraki ninche iyie entorroni, te neiguenu entaboi nemerasaa ninche.

English: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
Masaai: Amu ncho iyie ninche mekueta aailanyisho, niimul iyie nkomomi enye too mbaa inono.

English: Be thou exalted, LORD, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.
Masaai: Nchoo kisisi iyie Olaitoriani, te nkaraki engolon ino! Eikiranyisho iyiook nikisis engolon ino.

English: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
Masaai: Enkai ai, Enkai ai, kainyoo pee kitung'uayie? Kainyoo pee kitalama nanu eitu kiret, nilam irorei laainei le nkigoroto?

English: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
Masaai: Iyie na Ai ai, aaishiraka nanu dama kake eitu iyie kiwaliki; naaishiraki kewarie, kake eitu nanu atum enkiyeng'iyeng.

English: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
Masaai: Kake ira iyie sinyati, niton iyie te nkitoo e nkisisa e Israel.

English: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
Masaai: Iyie apa eisiliga loo papa; kisiliga apa ninche, nitokordua iyie ninche.

English: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
Masaai: Iyie apa eishirakita ninche, neitajeuni; iyie apa eisiliga ninche, neitu eitukurruni.

English: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
Masaai: Kake ara nanu olkurto, mara oltung'ani; naaikordod iltung'ana, naailap iloreren.

English: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head saying,
Masaai: Ore pooki laaing'or nanu naakueniyie, naadasaki nkineji, neipirripir ilukuny;

English: He trusted on the LORD that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
Masaai: nejo, “Eisiliga ninye Olaitoriani; nchoo eitajeu ninye, nchoo ekordu ninye, amu ninye eshipakino!”

English: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother's breasts.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, iyie apa likintayio te nguset e yieyio lai; kintaseriana iyie nanu atii ilki le yieyio.

English: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother's belly.
Masaai: Shumata iyie apa aatanang'akaki ebaiki pee aaini, ore anaa naaiu yieyio lai ira iyie Enkai ai.

English: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
Masaai: Mikilam iyie nanu, amu etataana enyamali nemeeta likae laaretu.

English: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
Masaai: Aatang'adutua nanu iloing'ok kumok, aatamana nanu iloing'ok oogol le Bashan;

English: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
Masaai: naang'aki nanu nkutukie enye, netiu anaa olng'atuny oikurrukur.

English: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
Masaai: Aaibukoyioki nanu anaa enkare, netirishate iloik laainei pooki too rubat; netotiwuo oltau lai anaa enkapoi, etoshole oltau lai ti atua olgoo lai;

English: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
Masaai: etoyio engolon ai anaa oleleo le moti, neterepa olng'jep lai ntakul aainei; nikirragie iyie nanu te nterit e keeya.

English: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
Masaai: Ee, aamanita nanu ildiein; aatang'adua nanu olturrur loo laasak loo ntorrok, etaremo ninche ndapi oo nkaik aainei o nkejek -

English: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
Masaai: kaidim nanu aikena loik laainei pooki - aaing'orita ninche naashil;

English: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
Masaai: neorikino ninche ilkilani laainei maate, ore to lkila lai neosh ninche enkukuo.

English: But be not thou far from me, O LORD: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
Masaai: Kake, ore iyie Olaitoriani, mikilakuaniki! Iyie la aretoni lai, tasieku taretoki!

English: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
Masaai: Tokordu oltau lai to lalem, nikordu enkishui ai aitung'uaa engolon e ilo dia.

English: Save me from the lion's mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
Masaai: Ntajeuoki nanu te nkutuk o lng'atuny, ntajeu ele tau lai oaata osina too mowuarak o olosokuan!

English: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
Masaai: Kaibalunye nanu enkarna ino too lalashera laainei, naaisis iyie te mpolos e umata:

English: Ye that fear the LORD, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani intae ilooure ninye! Ore intae ilayiok pooki le Yakobo, entaa ninye kitok, nintasheshe te uriata enye, intae ilayiok pooki le Israel!

English: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
Masaai: Amu eitu ninye emenu aashu eiteeng lelo oaata osina; neitu ninye eisudoo enkomom enye te ninye, kake etoning'o ninye ina kata pee eishiraki ninye te nkaraki eretoto.

English: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
Masaai: Iyie eing'uaa enkisisa ai ti atua eumata kitok; naa kalak nanu olmumai lai te dukuya lelo ooure ninye.

English: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the LORD that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
Masaai: Kedaa ilo oata osina neraposho, ore lelo ooing'oru ninye neisis Olaitoriani! Metaa keishu iltauja linyi ntarasi!

English: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the LORD: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
Masaai: Kepuo aadamu ineieting'ie enkop pooki, neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani; neserem ilmareita pooki loo loshon te dukuya ninye.

English: For the kingdom is the LORD'S: and he is the governor among the nations.
Masaai: Amu eno Laitoriani enkitoria, neitore ninye iloshon.

English: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
Masaai: Ee, ninye epuo aairrugokino lelo pooki oowuasa lena kop; te dukuya ninye epuo aairrugo lelo pooki oopuo enkop, o ilo lemeidim aitopiu oltau lenye.

English: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
Masaai: Naa kelo eishoi enye aisiaai ninye, nepuo iltung'ana aaimaki Olaitoriani too ishoritin naapuonu,

English: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
Masaai: neibalunye enkordunoto enye too ltung'ana leton meino, nchere ninye otaasa ina.

English: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye olchekut lai, maang'oriki nanu toki;

English: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
Masaai: aairragie ninye nanu too nkujit naanyori, naarikoo ninye nanu te nkiopata oo nkariak naaitirring'a

English: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name's sake.
Masaai: neitagol ninye oltau lai. Naarikoo ninye nanu te nkoitoi oo sipat te nkaraki enkarna enye.

English: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
Masaai: Tenaa napaji ninye kalo aim oerata lo loip le keeya, nemaure entorroni; amu itii iyie te nebo nanu; eng'udi ino o rinka lino ninche naaitagol nanu.

English: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
Masaai: Ntobira iyie emisa te dukuya nanu, teine netii ilmang'ati laainei; nibukoki endukuya ai eilata, nipik enkikompe ai metaa kedooyo.

English: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
Masaai: Esipa aasuju esidano o lng'ur inkolong'i pooki e nkishui ai, naa kabik nanu ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani ntarasi.

English: The earth is the LORD'S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Masaai: Eno Laitoriani enkop o ntokitin pooki naabore, enkop o lelo oomanya;

English: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
Masaai: amu ninye oitamanyua too naaiposha, neitasheyie too lkejek.

English: Who shall ascend into the hill of the LORD? or who shall stand in his holy place?
Masaai: Kaing'ae olo aked ilo doinyo lo Laitoriani? Naa kaing'ae olo aitashe te wueji enye sinyati?

English: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
Masaai: Ilo osinya nkaik neeta oltau owang, ilo lemedumaki oltau lenye entorroni, nemeinos olmumai le lejare.

English: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
Masaai: Keng'amu ninye emayianata naing'uaa Olaitoriani, neng'amu esupatisho naing'uaa Enkai e njeunoto enye.

English: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.
Masaai: Ore ileeijo kulo, naa eishoi e lelo ooing'oru ninye, lelo ooing'oru enkomom e Nkai e Yakobo.

English: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Masaai: Entudumu lukuny inyi na shomito! nidumunyenye intae na shomito musan! pee etum Olaiguanani le nkitoo atijing'u.

English: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Masaai: Kaing'ae Olaiguanani le nkitoo? Olaitoriani ogol magilani, Olaitoriani magilani to larrabal!

English: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
Masaai: Entudumu lukuny inyi na shomito! nidumunyenye intae, na shomito musan! pee etum Olaiguanani le nkitoo atijing'u.

English: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.
Masaai: Kaing'ae Olaiguanani le nkitoo? Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye Olaiguanani le nkitoo!

English: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
Masaai: Iyie nanu Olaitoriani adumaki oltau lai.

English: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.
Masaai: Na Ai ai, iyie nanu aisilig, mincho nanu aaitukurruni; mincho ilmang'ati laainei eng'ida te nkaraki nanu.

English: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
Masaai: Ee, mincho hoo obo likingarakino iyie meitukurruni; nchoo meitukurruni lelo aitang'orok le pesho.

English: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
Masaai: Ntayioloki nanu nkoitoi inono, Olaitoriani; nteng'enaki nanu inkoitoi inono.

English: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
Masaai: Torikoki nanu ti atua esipata ino, nikinteng'en nanu, amu ira iyie Enkai e njeunoto ai; amu iyie nanu aanyita endama pooki.

English: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
Masaai: Tadamuaki nanu to lng'ur lino, Olaitoriani, o te nyorrata ino nauno, amu eetae apa ninche ebaiki moitie.

English: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
Masaai: Midamu iyie ing'ok e kitisho ai, anaa nkitarruorot aainei; ore te risioroto e nyorrata nauno, tadamuaki nanu, te nkaraki esupatisho ino Olaitoriani!

English: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
Masaai: Eisupat naa asipani Olaitoriani; ore enkaraki ina neiteng'en ninye ilaing'okok te nkoitoi.

English: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
Masaai: Nerikoo ninye lelo oobor te nkoitoi sidai, neiteng'en lelo oobor te nkoitoi enye.

English: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
Masaai: Ore nkoitoi pooki o Laitoriani naa enyorrata nauno o esupatisho, te lelo ooibung olning'o lenye lo sotua o enchakenisho enye.

English: For thy name's sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, tapalakaki entorroni ai, amu ai sapuk.

English: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
Masaai: Kalo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani? Ore ilo tung'ani eiteng'en ninye te nkoitoi nagelu.

English: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
Masaai: Ore ninye makewan neton te nkiputakinoto, ore nkera enyena nejung enkop.

English: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
Masaai: Ore shoruetisho o Laitoriani naa ene lelo ooure ninye, neitayiolo ninye ninche olning'o lenye lo sotua.

English: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
Masaai: Etii nkonyek aainei dukuya Olaitoriani anaake, amu keitayu ninye nkejek aainei to rreshet.

English: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
Masaai: Torrinyokinoyioki Olaitoriani, niking'urrie nanu, amu kaliyio naata osina.

English: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.
Masaai: Nchooki enkiyagata te nyamali oltau lai, nikintupuku nanu ti atua isinaitin laainei.

English: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
Masaai: Ing'ura osina lai o enyamali ai, nikipalaki ing'ok aainei pooki.

English: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
Masaai: Ng'ura eneba ilmang'ati laainei, o eneba enkiba naaiba ninche nanu te ntoloi.

English: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.
Masaai: Torripo siaake enkishui ai, nikikordu nanu; mikincho nanu aaitukurruni, amu iyie nanu asaru.

English: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
Masaai: Nchoo aagolie nanu esupatisho o emborron, amu iyie nanu aanyu.

English: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
Masaai: Talaku Israel, Iyie Enkai, ti atua inyamalaritin enyena pooki.

English: Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; therefore I shall not slide.
Masaai: Nguanareki nanu, iyie Olaitoriani, amu ashomo nanu te supatisho ai, naaisiliga nanu iyie Olaitoriani metii enking'aing'ai.

English: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
Masaai: Tujurroki nanu Olaitoriani nikitem; tetema oltau lai o ndamunot aainei.

English: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
Masaai: Amu etii ina nyorrata ino nauno dukuya nkonyek aainei, nalotu nanu te sipata enitii.

English: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
Masaai: Maton nanu te nebo iltung'ana torrok, nemashulare nanu isunkuro.

English: I have hated the congregation of evildoers; and will not sit with the wicked.
Masaai: Kaiba nanu encholiek o laasak loo ntorrok, nematon nanu te nebo ilarruok.

English: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
Masaai: Naa kaituku nkaik aainei ajo maata entioto, nalo aman olasar lino, iyie Olaitoriani,

English: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
Masaai: abuaku aranyita osinkolio le nashe, nalimu nkiaasin inono e nking'asia.

English: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kanyor nanu emanyisho e nkaji ino, o ewueji netii enkitoo ino.

English: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
Masaai: Mikioroo nanu aiwuang'ie te nebo laing'okok, teleku enkishui ai te lelo oota enkure o sarge

English: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
Masaai: iltung'ana laa ore nkaik enye nebore osarge, ore nkaik enye oo ntateniaa nebore ntokitin e ropare.

English: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu naa te supatisho ino alo; talakuaki nanu niking'urrie nanu.

English: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
Masaai: Eitashe nkejek aainei te wueji neitoriori; ore ti atua eumata kitok naisis nanu Olaitoriani.

English: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
Masaai: Olaitoriani ewang'an ai naa enjeunoto ai; kaing'ae nanu aure? Olaitoriani osempewuet le nkishui ai; kaing'ae naa aure?

English: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
Masaai: Te nepuonu ilarruok shumata nanu, aainos nkiri osesen lai, lelo mang'ati laainei o larak, nerrorro ninche nebatata.

English: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
Masaai: Ore ninye te naamuat olorora aaman nemeureishoyu oltau lai; te naadumakino ninye nanu enjore, ore ake etiu neijia naisiliga nanu Olaitoriani.

English: One thing have I desired of the LORD, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD, and to enquire in his temple.
Masaai: Entoki nabo nanu atoomono Olaitoriani naa ninye nanu aing'oru; nchere pee abik nanu ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ai, pee aaing'or enkishiaa o Laitoriani, naikilikuanisho ti atua enkaji enye sinyati.

English: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
Masaai: Amu kaaitushur ninye nanu ti atua olng'obor lenye, te nkolong e nyamali; naaikenoo ninye nanu ti abori o lng'obor lenye, naailepie ninye nanu apik shumata endapidapoi.

English: And now shall mine head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
Masaai: Naa keshumuni endukuya ai aailepie neitulusori te lelo mang'ati laainei laamanita, naa kalo nanu aishooyo ti atua olng'obor lenye, ilasarri te mbuakunoto o te ng'ida; naa karanyisho nanu narrep Olaitoriani.

English: Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
Masaai: Toning'oki iyie Olaitoriani, te nabuaku nanu aishir, ing'urrieki nanu nikiwaliki nanu!

English: When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
Masaai: Itejo iyie, “Ing'oru iyie enkomom ai.” Nikijoki oltau lai iyie, “Enkomom ino, Olaitoriani, ninye nanu aing'oru.”

English: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Masaai: Mikisudorie nanu enkomom ino. Mirriny iyie osinka lino te ngoro, iyie apa otaa eretoto ai. Mikinturraa nanu, miking'uaa nanu, Na Ai e njeunoto ai!

English: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
Masaai: Amu aatung'uaitie nanu papa o yieyio, kake kaadumu nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi ino, iyie Olaitoriani; nikirikoo nanu te neserian, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei.

English: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
Masaai: Mikinchooyo nanu too lmang'ati laainei, amu aatudumakinote nanu ilchakenini le lejare, neipang'ipang ninche te ntorroni.

English: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Masaai: Kairuk nanu ajo kadol esupatisho o Laitoriani, te ina kop oo looishu!

English: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
Masaai: Taanyu Olaitoriani; ntagoluoyu, nintagol oltau lino, ee, taanyu Olaitoriani!

English: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
Masaai: Iyie nanu aipoto Olaitoriani; endapidapoi ai, mikigirare nanu, amu ti nikigirare iyie nanu natiu anaa lelo oopuo aadoiki Engumoto.

English: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
Masaai: Toning'o oltoilo le sayiata ai, enkata naaishiraki nanu iyie te nkaraki eretoto, ina kata ailepie nanu nkaik aainei, aing'orie ewueji ino sinyati aisul.

English: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
Masaai: Mikiya iyie nanu te nebo larruok, te nebo lelo aasak loo ntorrok, ooiro eseriani te nebo lelo le latia enye, ore too ltauja lenye neeta entorroni.

English: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
Masaai: Ntalaa ninche te risioroto e siaai enye, o te risioroto oo nkiaasin e ntorroni enye, ntalaa ninche te risioroto e siaai oo nkaik enye, nchoo ninche olerrinyore oiririkino.

English: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
Masaai: ore enkaraki meshilaa ninche isiaitin o Laitoriani, anaa esiaai oo nkaik enyena, kegil ninye ninche nemeigil ae kata ashetu ninche.

English: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninye oltoilo le nkomono ai.

English: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye engolon ai naa elong'o ai; ninye eisilig oltau lai; naataretuo ninye nanu, ore enkaraki ina neting'ide oltau lai, naa kaisho nanu ninye enashe to sinkolio lai.

English: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye engolon oo ltung'ana lenyena, iyie enjeunoto nasaru ilo lenye otubukoki eilata aaput.

English: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
Masaai: Ntajeu iltung'ana linono, nimayian enjeunoto ino; laa iyie olchekut lenye ninap ninche ntarasi.

English: Give unto the LORD, O ye mighty, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkisisa intae ntokitin pooki e shumata, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon.

English: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name; worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo e nkarna enye; enteserem Olaitoriani te nkishiaa e sinyatisho enye.

English: The voice of the LORD is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the LORD is upon many waters.
Masaai: Etii oltoilo lo Laitoriani shumata nkariak; etadara Enkai e nkitoo, Olaitoriani te shumata nkariak kumok.

English: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
Masaai: Kegol oltoilo lo Laitoriani, ebore oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkitoo.

English: The voice of the LORD breaketh the cedars; yea, the LORD breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.
Masaai: Egil oltoilo lo Laitoriani iltarakua egil Olaitoriani iltarakua le Lebanon.

English: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
Masaai: Keisho ninye Lebanon meipido anaa olashe, neipidie oldoinyo le Hormon anaa oloti oing'oni.

English: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
Masaai: Eeta oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkimerlel olng'ejep le nkima.

English: The voice of the LORD shaketh the wilderness; the LORD shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
Masaai: Eikirikirie oltoilo lo Laitoriani olpurkel, eikirikirie Olaitoriani olpurkel le Kadesh.

English: The voice of the LORD maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.
Masaai: Oltoilo lo Laitoriani oibirunye ing'uesi, near entim aisiajayie, naa ti atua enkaji enye sinyati eishir pooki aajo, “Enkitoo!”

English: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
Masaai: Etonita Olaitoriani to lorika lenya le nkitoo te shumata nkariak; etonita Olaitoriani to lorika le nkitoo aaku olaiguanani ntarasi.

English: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
Masaai: Meishoo Olaitoriani engolon iltung'ana lenyena! Metamayiana Olaitoriani kulo tung'ana lenyena aisho eseriani!

English: I will extol thee, O LORD; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.
Masaai: Kaaisis nanu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani, amu kitudumua iyie nanu ailepunye, neitu ncho ilmang'ati laainei aang'idakino.

English: O LORD my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai, iyie nanu aishiraka pee kiretu, nikinchiunye iyie nanu.

English: O LORD, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ilepunye iyie oltau lai aitupuku te nemeneng'a, nikirrinyoki nanu enkishui ti atua lelo ooshomo aadoiki Engumoto.

English: Sing unto the LORD, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani enkisisa, intae isinyat lenyena, ninchosho enkisisa enkarna enye sinyati.

English: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
Masaai: Amu ore engoro enye naa enkata kiti, ore omom enye naa ene nkishui pooki. Eruko ilkiyio te nkewarie, kake ore tadekenya nelotu eng'ida.

English: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
Masaai: Ore nanu, atejo apa te nkitumurrunoto ai, “Maaiwuang'ieki ae kata nanu.”

English: LORD, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nanoto nanu omom te iyie, Olaitoriani, nikintagolo iyie nanu anaa oldoinyo; kisudorie iyie nanu enkomom ino, natum osina.

English: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
Masaai: Iyie nanu Olaitoriani aishiraka, naa Olaitoriani ayaka enkomono ai;

English: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?
Masaai: “Kaa retoto eeta keeya ai, te nadoyio ajing Engumoto? Eikisis iyie enterit? Kelimu ninye esupatisho ino?

English: Hear, O LORD, and have mercy upon me: LORD, be thou my helper.
Masaai: Toning'oki, Olaitoriani, niking'urrie nanu! Olaitoriani, taa iyie Olaretoni lai!”

English: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
Masaai: Mbelekenya iyie enkishirata ai aitaa osinkolio le ng'ida; italaayie iyie ilkuniyiani laainei nikinchopoki nanu eng'ida,

English: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
Masaai: pee kitum oltau lai aisisa iyie nemegira. Olaitoriani Enkai ai, kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ntarasi.

English: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
Masaai: Ti atua iyie nanu Olaitoriani aing'oru esarunoto; mikincho iyie nanu maaitukurruni ae kata; ore te supatisho ino tokorduaki nanu!

English: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
Masaai: Irrugokoki nanu enkiok ino, tasaruaki nanu tasioki! Taa iyie endapidapoi nasaru nanu, osempewuet lajeunye nanu.

English: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name's sake lead me, and guide me.
Masaai: Ee, ira iyie endapidapoi o sempewuet lai; ore te nkaraki enkarna ino torikoyioki nanu nikiutaa nanu,

English: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
Masaai: ntayioki nanu ti atua orreshet oisudoyioki te nkaraki nanu, amu ira iyie esarunoto ai.

English: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
Masaai: Nkaik inono nanu apik enkishui ai, kintajeuo iyie nanu Olaitoriani, na Ai oo sipat.

English: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
Masaai: Mba iyie lelo ooserem nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, kake Olaitoriani nanu aisilig.

English: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu nashipa te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno, amu itoduaa iyie osina lai, itoduaa iyie ilmang'ati laainei,

English: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
Masaai: neitu iyie kinchooyo nanu apik nkaik olmang'atinta; itipika iyie nkejek aainei ewueji nelala.

English: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu Olaitoriani amu atii atua osina; etimitari nkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina, o ltau lai o sesen lai sii.

English: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
Masaai: Amu eisha enkishui ai to sina, neishunye enkishui ai te nkishirata, eishunye engolon ai te nkaraki osina lai, netororonyate iloik laainei.

English: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
Masaai: Ataa nanu entoki nailapi too lmang'ati laainei, ataa enkitureisho too le latia ai, entoki naitureisho too lchoreta laainei; ore lelo laadol nanu te nkoitoi naaipirri aailany.

English: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
Masaai: Aiwuang'a nanu too ndamunot anaa oltung'ani otua; atotiuo nanu anaa entoki natebele.

English: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
Masaai: Ee, aning'ito nanu enking'oming'om oo lkumok - etii enkuretisho pooki shoto - aaiguanare ninche nanu pee eitayu enkishui ai.

English: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
Masaai: Kake iyie nanu aisiliga, Olaitoriani, atejo nanu, “Ira iyie Enkai ai.”

English: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
Masaai: Etii nkatitin aainei nkaik inono, tokorduaki nanu too nkaik oo lmang'ati laainei o lelo laaisilisil nanu!

English: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
Masaai: Nchoo enkomom ino meitawang'aki osinka lino; ntajeuoki iyie nanu te ina nyorrata ino nauno!

English: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
Masaai: Mikincho nanu aaitukurruni, amu iyie Olaitoriani nanu aipoto; nchoo ilo arruoni meitukurruni, nchoo ninche edoyio aapuo enemenenga.

English: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
Masaai: Nchoo nena kutukie e lejare metunukata, amu ninche naairo te ntorroni tialo ilo asipani, to lwuasa o te ng'ogong'i.

English: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
Masaai: Oi kebaa esapuko e supatisho ino, nirragakinye lelo likiure iyie, nintaas iyie lelo likipuonu aasaru, te dukuya nkera e tung'ana!

English: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
Masaai: Naa eisudoo iyie ninche te seriani e ine nitii, intaserian iyie ninche tiabori olchurie lino, te nkaraki nena kirorot torrok.

English: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitodolua ninye te nking'asia ina nyorrata enye nauno ti alo nanu, ina kata apa pee aaibung'i anaa enkanasa natang'aduaki aaman.

English: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
Masaai: Atejo nanu to lkirutoto lai, “Aaterewaki nanu aaitalamaa too nkonyek inono.” Kake itoning'o iyie esayiata ai, ina kata pee aaishiraki nanu te nkaraki eretoto.

English: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
Masaai: Entonyor Olaitoriani intae isinyat lenyena! Kegolie Olaitoriani lelo ooisiligayu, kake kelaaki te nkumoi lelo oas to lwuasa.

English: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
Masaai: Entagoluoto niminchosho iltauja linyi epalari, intae pooki oanyu Olaitoriani!

English: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo otapalakaki ing'ok enyena, ilo oimulumulayioki ing'ok enyena.

English: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo lemeikenaki Olaitoriani entorroni, laa ore atua enkishui enye metii elejare.

English: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
Masaai: Te neitu nanu alimu eng'oki ai aibalunye, neibiitiari osesen lai te nkaraki enkishirata ai e mion endama pooki.

English: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
Masaai: Amu ore te ndama o te nkewarie naa keiroishi enkaina ino te nanu; netoyu engolon ai anaa enainosa enkolong te nkata e nkirowuaj.

English: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
Masaai: Aaibalakinyie nanu iyie eng'oki ai te iyie neitu nanu aisudoo entorroni ai; atejo nanu, “Kairridu nkitarruorot aainei to Laitoriani;” nikitapalaka iyie esuujisho e ng'oki ai.

English: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, nchoo pooki ng'ae lo rrekie le Nkai, kiomon iyie. Ore te nkata o sina, o enang'unoto oo nkariak kituaak, nemebaiki ninye.

English: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
Masaai: Ira iyie ewueji enkisudoroto te nanu, eikigolie iyie nanu te ng'olikinoto nikintaman nanu enkordunoto.

English: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
Masaai: Kaaitaarriyian nanu iyie naaiteng'en enkoitoi niim. Kaaiguan nanu iyie etii nkonyek aainei shumata iyie.

English: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
Masaai: Mitiu iyie anaa embarta anaa enyumpu nemeeta ndamunot e ning'unoto, naa keeni te nkeene nepiki olgisoi pee eitoborri, naa te nemeikoni neijia nimikirukorukore ninye iyie.

English: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
Masaai: Eikumok nkitamiot naatum lelo torrok kake ore enyorrata nauno nemanita ilo oisilig Olaitoriani.

English: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
Masaai: Enting'idata ti atua Olaitoriani, nishipapa intae lelo supati, nibuakuku te ng'ida, intae pooki lelo sidain iltauja!

English: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
Masaai: Enting'idata ti atua Olaitoriani, intae lelo supati! Eishiaakino enkisisa lelo sidain ltauja.

English: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani to lwulul loo usin enterrep ninye to lkerempe te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin naata iusin tomon!

English: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
Masaai: Entaranyaki ninye osinkolio ng'ejuk, entoosh iusin enkinanta te nkarriyiano, too mbuakunot kituaak.

English: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
Masaai: amu keitoriori ororei lo laitoriani; ore siaitin enyena pooki neasi te nkitoriori.

English: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
Masaai: Kenyor ninye esupatisho o esipata; ebore enkop pooki enyorrata nauno o Laitoriani.

English: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
Masaai: Ore to rorei lo Laitoriani neitobiruaki apa keper, o lorora lenye pooki te nkiyang'et e nkutuk enye.

English: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninye nkariak e naiposha anaa enkare natii atua oltulet; nepik ninye enguton atua ilaleta oo shumishoreki.

English: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
Masaai: Nchoo enkop pooki eureyu Olaitoriani, nchoo lelo pooki oomanya enkop meitasho te nkanyit te dukuya ninye!

English: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
Masaai: Amu eiroro apa ninye, netabayie ina natejo; neitanapishe ninye, netuune ina.

English: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
Masaai: Eitaa Olaitoriani nkiguanat oo loshon pesho; neitukurru ninye nkitobirat oo loreren.

English: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
Masaai: Ore enkiguana o Laitoriani neitashe ntarasi, ore ndamunot o ltau lenye nebaiki iishoritin pooki.

English: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD: and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo osho laa Enkai Olaitoriani lenye, ilo orere otegelua ninye aitaa enjung'ore enye!

English: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
Masaai: Eing'or Olaitoriani kop etii keper, nedol ninye nkera e tung'ana;

English: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
Masaai: ore etii ninye ine wueji e nkitoo neing'orisho, neing'or lelo pooki oomanya enkop,

English: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
Masaai: ninye ilo oitobirua iltauja lenye pooki, nejurru nkiaasin enye pooki.

English: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
Masaai: Meitajeuni olaiguanani te nkaraki enjore enye kitok; mejeu olmurrani te nkaraki engolon enye kitok.

English: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
Masaai: Pesho osiligi le mbarta o larrabal te nkisulata, ore te ngolon enye kitok nemeitajeusho.

English: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
Masaai: Ng'ura, etii enkong'u o Laitoriani shumata lelo ooure ninye, shumata lelo ooisilig enyorrata enye nauno,

English: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
Masaai: naa keidim ninye atokordu enkishui enye te keeya, nemeisho ninche eye te nkata o lameyu.

English: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.
Masaai: Olaitoriani eanyu enkishui ai; ninye eretoto ang naa elong'o.

English: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Masaai: Ee, keng'ida enkishui ang ti atua ninye, enkaraki nikisiliga iyiook enkarna enye sinyati.

English: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
Masaai: Nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, meeu shumata iyiook, anaa enikisilig iyiook iyie.

English: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani nkatitin pooki; etii enkisisa enye enkutuk ai anaake.

English: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye eng'idare oltau lai, nchoo ilo oata osina ening neng'ida.

English: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
Masaai: Embalunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te nebo nanu, nikirrep enkarna enye te nebo!

English: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Masaai: Aing'orua nanu Olaitoriani naawaliki ninye, naakordu ninye nanu te nkuretisho ai pooki.

English: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
Masaai: Eng'ura ninye pee iwang'ung'u; nemeitoki ae kata enkurruna atii nkomomi inyi.

English: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
Masaai: Eishira ele tung'ani aisinani, nening Olaitoriani ninye, neitajeu Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa ingolikinot enyena pooki.

English: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
Masaai: Keman olmalaika le Nkai aitushur lelo pooki ooure ninye, nekordu ninche.

English: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
Masaai: Wootu enchamishama pee idolidolo aajo eisupat Olaitoriani! Emayiana ilo tung'ani osaru ninye!

English: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
Masaai: Entureita Olaitoriani intae isinyat lenyena, amu ore lelo ooure ninye nemeng'oriki toki!

English: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
Masaai: Keng'oriki nkiyioitin olng'atuny netum esumash, kake ore lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani nemelau ntokitin sidain.

English: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
Masaai: Wootu, na kera, entoning'oki nanu, kaiteng'en nanu intae euriata o Laitoriani.

English: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?
Masaai: Kalo tung'ani te kuldo oyieu enkishui, neng'uar nkolong'i kumok pee etum atishipakinoyu isupati?

English: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
Masaai: Ntalama olng'ejep lino entorroni, nimincho enkutuk ino eiro elejare.

English: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Masaai: Talama entorroni nias isupati, ing'oru eseriani, nisuj ninye.

English: The eyes of the LORD are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
Masaai: Eing'orita nkonyek o Laitoriani lelo supati, neinining'ito nkiyiaa enyena enkishirata enye.

English: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
Masaai: Keiba enkomom o Laitoriani lelo oas ntorrok, neiwuang'ie ninche meitokini aadamu te nkop.

English: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
Masaai: Te neishir oltung'ani supat te nkaraki eretoto, nening Olaitoriani, nekordu ninye ninche aitayu ti atua enyamali enye pooki.

English: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
Masaai: Ketaaniki Olaitoriani lelo ootigilate ltauja, neitajeu ninye lelo ooisha osiligi.

English: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
Masaai: Eikumok isinaitin le ilo supat, kake kekordu Olaitoriani ninye aitung'uaa te pooki.

English: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
Masaai: Negolie iloik lenyena pooki; meisho ninye metigilayu obo.

English: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
Masaai: Kear entorroni ilo arruoni; ore lelo ooiba o supat nedung'okini enkiguana.

English: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
Masaai: Kekordu Olaitoriani enkishui oo sinkan lenyena, meetae obo le lelo oosaru ninye otum oldeket.

English: Plead my cause, O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani tigilunore, lelo laagilunore nanu; taarare lelo laarare nanu!

English: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
Masaai: Tudumu elong'o ino o emasaai ino o larrabal, taretuoki nanu!

English: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
Masaai: Ntayu empere ino taarare lelo laasujita! Tiaaki oltau lai, “Ara nanu ilo likikordu!”

English: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
Masaai: Nchoo meitukurruni neitadouni lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai! Nchoo meibelekenyata ninche nekurru lelo ooiguanu entorroni te nkaraki nanu!

English: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase them.
Masaai: Ntotiwuo ninche anaa suut naakutita osiwuo, ereuta olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninche!

English: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
Masaai: Nchoo emisimisu enkoitoi enye neideketu, esujita olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninche!

English: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
Masaai: Amu ore metii emporeet neisudoo ninche irresheta lenye te nkaraki nanu; ore metii emporeet netuturo ninche engumoto te nkaraki enkishui ai.

English: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metaluama enkidaata! Naa nchoo ilo rreshet oisudoitie ninche meibung'a ninche; nchoo ninche metadoiki enkidaata!

English: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
Masaai: Keng'idakino oltau lai Olaitoriani, neshipakino enjeunoto enye.

English: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
Masaai: Nejo iloik laainei pooki, “Iyie Olaitoriani, kaing'ae likinyaanyukie, iyie okordu ilo omena aitajeu aitung'uaa ilo ogol oleng alang ninye, nintajeu ilo oshal naa aisinani aitung'uaa ilo oitorogony ninye?”

English: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
Masaai: Etudumunye ilchakenini le lejare; naaikilikuan ninche mbaa nemayiolo nanu.

English: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
Masaai: Naalaaki ninche ntorrok too supati naitaasa ninche, etalepori oltau lai.

English: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, enkata namuei ninche - naishop ilkuniyiani, naitame kewan te enata e mpukoroto naomon nanu eirruge elukunya ai abaiki olgoo

English: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
Masaai: natiu anaa oltung'ani oishiraki olchore anaa olalashe; namanimanaa anaa oltung'ani oishiraki ng'otonye, nairrugo te nkishirata o sina.

English: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
Masaai: Kake ore te rrorroto ai neiturrurro ninche aashipa, naaiturrurrokino aagilunore ilmaiman lemayiolo, naasukeny ninche metii enkiyagata;

English: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
Masaai: neinosisho ninche too nkala pee etum aatakuenia too siruai, neony ninche ilala lenye te nkaraki nanu.

English: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa Olaitoriani iton iyie aing'or? Tokorduaki nanu te rasakinoto enye, tokordu enkishui ai te lelo ng'atunyo!

English: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
Masaai: Naa kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ti atua eumata kitok; ore ti atua olorora kitok naaisis iyie.

English: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
Masaai: Mincho lelo mang'ati laainei eng'ida te nkaraki nanu, nimincho lelo ooimul nkonyek laaiba nanu pesho.

English: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
Masaai: Amu meiro ninche ine seriani, kake lelo oobor te nkop egilunore neipiru ninche irorei le lejare.

English: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
Masaai: Naaboloki ninche nkutukie enye aagilunore; nejo ninche, “Aha, Aha! Etoduaa nkonyek ang!”

English: This thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, itoduaa iyie, migira! Olaitoriani, mikilam iyie nanu!

English: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
Masaai: Tuputunye, tudumunye te nkaraki esipata ai, te nkaraki ewalata ai, Enkai ai naa Olaitoriani lai!

English: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
Masaai: Nguanareki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai ai, te risioroto e supatisho ino; nimincho ninche eng'ida te nkaraki nanu!

English: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
Masaai: Mincho ninche ejokino maate, “Aha, kinoto iyiook eyieunoto oo ltauja lang!” Mincho ninche ejo, “Kitoijoitie iyiook ninye.”

English: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche meitukurruni nepiki olmilo te nebo, lelo oong'ida te nkaraki enyamali ai! Nchoo ninche meishopokini enkurruna o esulare lelo oojukaa ate laaitainore!

English: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo oong'uar esupatisho ai metabuaku te ng'ida, neshipa, nejo ntarasi moitie, “Eikitok Olaitoriani, neshipakino ninye eseriani o sinka lenye!”

English: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.
Masaai: Netum taa olng'ejep lai atolimu esupatisho ino o enkisisa ino endama pooki.

English: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.
Masaai: Ore enkarruoisho neiro ti atua ilo arruoni, te nguton o ltau lenye; metii euriata e Nkai dukuya nkonyek enyena.

English: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
Masaai: Amu keikoroj ninye kewan nchere meyiolouni entorroni enye neibayuni.

English: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.
Masaai: Ore rorei le nkutuk enye naa ntorrok o lejare; meekure ninye easisho te ng'eno neas isupati.

English: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.
Masaai: Ntorrok edamu ninye te ndapash enye; nepik ninye kewan enkoitoi neme sidai; nemeiturraa entorroni.

English: Thy mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
Masaai: Ore ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, nelo abaiki shumata, ore esupatisho ino nelo abaiki nkatampo.

English: Thy righteousness is like the great mountains; thy judgments are a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
Masaai: Etiu esupatisho ino anaa ildoinyo le Nkai, eikununo nkiguanat inono anaa enguton kitok; Olaitoriani, iyie oitajeu oltung'ani o eng'ues.

English: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
Masaai: Kebaa esidano e nyorrata ino nauno, iyie Enkai! Oloip loo naipuko inono esaru nkera e tung'ana.

English: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
Masaai: Nedaa ninche te nena naabore enkaji ino, nincho iyie ninche entoki naok te ilo keju lino le ng'ida.

English: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
Masaai: Amu iyie etii enkong'u e nkishui; te wang'an ino iyiook kidol ewang'an.

English: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
Masaai: Nchoo ebikoo ina nyorrata ino nauno te lelo likiyiolo iyie, nebikoo enjeunoto ino te lelo loo ltauja sidain!

English: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
Masaai: Mincho enkeju e lelo oowuasa meeu shumata nanu, nimincho enkaina e ilo torrono aarrumoo nanu.

English: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
Masaai: Eirrabalakinote lelo arruok e nkop, etanang'ieki enkop nemeigil aadumunye.

English: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
Masaai: Ming'aing'ai te nkaraki ilo torrono, niming'uar lelo aasak loo ntorrok.

English: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
Masaai: Amu kesioki ninche aaishunye anaa nkujit, netiu anaa mbenek naatoito.

English: Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
Masaai: Isiliga Olaitoriani nias esidai; pee itum atobiko tena kop, nitum eseriani.

English: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
Masaai: Tishipakinoyu Olaitoriani, naa aikincho ninye iyieunot o ltau lino.

English: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
Masaai: Tipika nkoitoi inono Olaitoriani; isiliga ninye, amu eikintaas ninye.

English: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
Masaai: Amu keibalunye ninye esipata ino anaa ewang'an, o enchunet ino aitotiu anaa dama.

English: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
Masaai: Ntirring'ayu te dukuya Olaitoriani, nianyu ninye te ng'iriata; ming'aing'ai te nkaraki ilo odupoyu te nkoitoi enye, te nkaraki ilo tung'ani olo too nkoitoi enyena oo nkitobirat torrok!

English: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
Masaai: Talama engoro ninturraa eserserisho! mintanyamal kewan, amu entorroni ake eyau ina.

English: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo torrono naa kedung'ori; ore lelo oanyu Olaitoriani naa kejung ina kop.

English: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkiti rishata, nemeitoki ilo torrono atii; ore ninye te ning'oru oleng te wueji enye, metii ninye ine.

English: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
Masaai: Kake ilo obor olo ajung enkop, neshipakino ninche ina kumoi e dupoto.

English: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
Masaai: Kepik ilo torrono orreshet ilo supat, neony ilala te nkaraki ninye;

English: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
Masaai: kake kekueniye Olaitoriani te nkaraki ilo torrono, amu edolita ninye nchere kelotu enkolong enye.

English: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
Masaai: Etushututua ilarruok ilalema lenye neyietu nkai enye, pee ear metuata lelo aisinak oomena;

English: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
Masaai: kejing ilalema lenye atua iltuaja lenye maate, ore nkai enye naa kegila.

English: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
Masaai: Eikash enkiti toki naata oltung'ani supat alang nkumok o ltung'ani torrono.

English: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
Masaai: Amu kegili nkaik e ilo torrono; kake egolie Olaitoriani ilo supat.

English: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
Masaai: Eyiolo Olaitoriani nkolong'i e ilo lemeeta entioto; ore enjung'ore enye nebikoo ntarasi;

English: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
Masaai: meitukurruni ninche too nkatitin e ntorroni, ore too nkatitin o lameyu neeta ninche enkiputakinoto.

English: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
Masaai: Kake keidak ilo torrono; ore lelo mang'ati lo Laitoriani neikununo anaa olari loo nkujit, keish ninche - ore anaa empuruo keishari ninche.

English: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
Masaai: Keisilenisho oltung'ani torrono, nemelak ninye esile, kake keleng ilo supat neishooyo;

English: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
Masaai: amu ore lelo ootamayiana Olaitoriani naa kejung enkop, ore lelo ootediaa ninye naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
Masaai: Olaitoriani eing'uaa iroruat e tung'ana naa keitubul ilo oitiship enkoitoi enye;

English: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
Masaai: ore ninye te nebatata nemepetikino enkop amu Olaitoriani oibung enkaina enye.

English: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
Masaai: Ara apa nanu oti, nara taata moruo; ore ake eyia, eitu nanu adol oltung'ani supat eiturrayioki anaa eomonu nkera enyena endaa.

English: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
Masaai: Keeta ninye olng'ur anaake neishooyo te sile, ore nkera enyena neaku emayianata.

English: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
Masaai: Talama entorroni, nias esidai; pee itum atobikoi ntarasi.

English: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
Masaai: Amu kenyor Olaitoriani esupatisho; meiturraa ninye lelo sinyat lenyena. Kegolieki ilo supat ntarasi, kake ore nkera e ilo torrono naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
Masaai: Ilo supat olo ajung enkop, nemany ina kop ntarasi.

English: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk e ilo supat neiro ine ng'eno, neiro olng'ejep lenye isipat.

English: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
Masaai: Netii enkitanapata e Nkai enye atua oltau lenye; nemeideketari too roruat enyena.

English: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
Masaai: Ore ilo torrono nejurru ilo supat, neing'oru eneiko pee ear ninye metua.

English: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
Masaai: Mepalaa Olaitoriani aisho meshomo ajing engolon enye, aashu eisho metudung'oki ninye enkiguana te neyauni aaiguanare.

English: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
Masaai: Taanyu Olaitoriani nimbung nkoitoi enyena, amu eikincho ninye esipata nilo ajungie enkop; naa ilo iyie aing'or enkidaata e ilo torrono.

English: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu oltung'ani torrono te ntorroni enye, nebul netiu ninye anaa oltarakuai le Lebanon.

English: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Masaai: Najo nanu agiroo, ng'ura meekure etii; ore hoo natejo nanu aing'oru, meekure etumi.

English: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
Masaai: Tisipu tujurru ilo tung'ani supat, ning'or ilo oitoriori nkoitoi enyena, amu ore enkiting'oto e ilo tung'ani naa eseriani.

English: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo agilak loo nkitanapat naa keidaikieki pooki te nebo; ore ilnganayio le ilo torrono naa kedung'ori.

English: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
Masaai: Ore enjeunoto e ilo supat naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa; ninye esarunoto enye te nkata e engolikinoto.

English: And the LORD shall help them and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oretu ninche nekordu ninche; nekordu ninche te ilo torrono, neitajeu ninche; enkaraki natasarutua ninche ninye.

English: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, mikisikong nanu te ngoro ino, nimikintame nanu te mpijan e ngoro ino!

English: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
Masaai: Amu aaibitakinote nanu mbaa inono, naatadoikio nanu enkaina ino.

English: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
Masaai: Metii embiotisho atua osesen lai, te nkaraki engoro ino; metii embiotisho iloik laainei te nkaraki eng'oki ai.

English: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
Masaai: Amu eshomo ntorrok aainei aalus te ndukuya ai; olola oiroishi oleng ninche te nanu.

English: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
Masaai: Eirrokirrok ilbaa laainei netong'ueita aasioki, te nkaraki emodai ai,

English: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
Masaai: airruge nanu oleng abaiki enkop; nalo nanu aishirita endama pooki.

English: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
Masaai: Amu eiputa empolos ai emion, nemetii embiotisho osesen lai.

English: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
Masaai: Aidaayie nanu natarrarre, nayietu aishir te nkaraki emion o ltau lai.

English: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie eyieunoto ai pooki, nemeisudoro emion ai te dukuya iyie.

English: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
Masaai: Keitiko oltau lai, neishunye engolon ai; ore ewang'an oo nkonyek aainei - neishunye sii te nanu.

English: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
Masaai: Ore ilchoreta laainei o encholuek ai, naaitashe aalam to lmeitai lai, ore iltung'ana lang le mudung neitashe te nelakua.

English: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai neirragie aaitolok irresheta lenye, ore lelo ooing'oru enkitamioto ai neiro ine nkidaata, neibirribir ninche elejare endama pooki.

English: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
Masaai: Kake atiu nanu anaa oltung'ani ming'ani, maning'isho nanu, atiu anaa oltung'ani otoonye olng'ejep lemeidim airoro.

English: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
Masaai: Ee, aikununo nanu anaa oltung'ani ming'ani lemetii enkutuk enye ilomon torrok.

English: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
Masaai: Amu iyie Olaitoriani nanu aanyita; iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai likiwaliki.

English: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
Masaai: Amu aatoomono, “Mincho ninche meting'idata te nkaraki nanu, lelo ooitokoos ti atua nanu te neideketari enkeju ai!”

English: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
Masaai: Amu etaa nanu kabatata, neton ake aata emion ai.

English: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
Masaai: Aibalunye nanu entorroni, aainosua nanu eng'oki ai.

English: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
Masaai: Ore lelo mang'ati laaiba nanu metii emporeet, naa eimagil, naa ilkumok laaiba nanu too mbaa nemesipa.

English: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
Masaai: Ore lelo laalaaki nanu too ntorrok aitaasa nanu ninche isupati, naa ilmang'ati laainei te nkaraki nasujita isupati.

English: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
Masaai: Miking'uaa nanu iyie Olaitoriani! iyie Na Ai, mikilam nanu!

English: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
Masaai: Taretuoki nanu tasioki, iyie Olaitoriani, enjeunoto ai!

English: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
Masaai: Atejo nanu, “Kagolie nkoitoi aainei, pee maas eng'oki to lng'ejep lai; kaen nanu enkutuk ai, enkata naba anaa enatii iltorrok ewueji natii nanu.”

English: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
Masaai: Atunuke nanu agira, naitirring'a nanu eitu ajo ae, neponari emion ai,

English: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
Masaai: neirowuaju oltau lai ti atua nanu. Ore anaa enadamisho, neyupuyup enkima; nairo nanu to lng'ejep lai:

English: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani, ntayioloki nanu enkiting'oto ai, o eneikununo enkikenata oo nkolong'i aainei; ntayioloki nanu enkisarrisar e nkishui ai!

English: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ntaba iyie nkolong'i aainei anaa nkuti temat e ndap e nkaina, ore nkolong'i e nkishui ai naa pesho too nkonyek inono. Esipa keitashe pooki tung'ani aa enkijape ake!

English: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
Masaai: Esipa, kemanimanaa oltung'ani aa oloip ake! Esipa, enepesho ake enkuretisho enye; eiturrurrisho tung'ani nemeyiolo ololo asotu!

English: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.
Masaai: “Naa amaa, taata, Olaitoriani, Kainyoo nanu aanyu? Atua iyie etii osiligi lai.

English: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu matung'uai nkitarruorot aainei pooki. Mikintaa nanu olorojareki te lelo oomoda!

English: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
Masaai: Atigire nanu, mabol enkutuk ai; amu iyie otaasa ina.

English: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie eoshoto ino te nanu; aisha nanu te oshoto e nkaina ino.

English: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
Masaai: Ti nintame iyie oltung'ani te nkisikong'ata oo ng'ok, nintotiu anaa entoki nainosa oriri ina kirotet te ninye; esipa ore pooki tung'ani naa enkiyang'et ake!

English: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with thee, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
Masaai: “Toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani, nining olkiyioi lai migirare ilkiyio laainei! Amu ara nanu olomoni lino olo, nara olalotoni anaa loo papa pooki.

English: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
Masaai: Miking'ode nanu, pee atum atayiolo enchipai, eton eitu alo nemaitoki atii.”

English: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
Masaai: Ataanyua nanu Olaitoriani te ngiriata; naairrugokino ninye nening enkomono ai.

English: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
Masaai: Aaitayio ninye nanu ti atua engumoto e ntorroni, ti atua oloonyionyi le sarng'ab, neitasheyie nkejek aainei te nchumata e ndapidapoi, neitaserian nkejek aainei.

English: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
Masaai: Nepik osinkolio ng'ejuk enkutuk ai, osinkolio le nkisisa te Nkai ang. Kepuo ilkumok aadol neureishoyu, nepik osiligi lenye Olaitoriani.

English: Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
Masaai: Emayiana oltung'ani oitaa Olaitoriani osiligi lenye, ilo tung'ani lemeibelekenyakino lelo oowuasa, alo enetii lelo oopong'ori esujaa nkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot!

English: Many, O LORD my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
Masaai: Itoponayie iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, nkiaasin inono e nking'asia o ndamunot inono ti alo iyiook; meetae olikinyaanyukie iyie! Tenaa napaji kaibalunye alimu ninche, naa eikumok oleng meikenayu.

English: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
Masaai: Ming'uar iyie ilasarri o nkishorot; kake kinchoo iyie enkiok naning'isho Ore lasarri oopejori o lasar loo ng'ok eitu iyie ing'uar.

English: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Ng'ura aeuo; ore to lpiyayati le mbuku nesira inaaipirare nanu:

English: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu aas eyieunoto ino, Na Ai; etii enkitanapata ino atua oltau lai.”

English: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
Masaai: Atolikioyie nanu ilomon supati le nkordunoto ti atua eumata sapuk; ng'ura, eitu nanu agira, anaa eniyiolo iyie, Olaitoriani.

English: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aisudoo ina retoto ino naitajeusho ti atua oltau lai, atolimuo nanu esupatisho ino o enjeunoto ino; eitu nanu anuk ina nyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino, aaibalakinyie nanu te umata sapuk.

English: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
Masaai: Mimbooyo iyie Olaitoriani olng'ur lino ti alo nanu, nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino aagolie nanu anaake!

English: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
Masaai: Amu aatamuata nanu ntorrok nemeikenayu; aaidimutua nanu ntorrok aainei, o metaba anaa neaku meekure aidim atodolisho; eikumok ntorrok aainei aalang ilpapit te ndukuya ai, netalepori oltau lai.

English: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
Masaai: Tonyorrai, Olaitoriani, tokorduaki nanu! Olaitoriani, taretuoki nanu tasioki!

English: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche meitukurruni nipik olmilo te nebo, lelo ooing'oru pee eiwuang'ie enkishui ai; nchoo ninche meibelekenyi neitadouni lelo ooing'oru pee aainyal!

English: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
Masaai: Nchoo meirriang'ieki ninche te nkaraki enkurruna enye, lelo laajoki nanu, “Aha, Aha.”

English: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo pooki liking'oru iyie nchoo eng'idayu neshipa ti atua iyie; nchoo lelo pooki oonyor enjeunoto ino emooki aajo, “Eikitok Olaitoriani!”

English: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
Masaai: Ore nanu, kara aisinani namena, kake Olaitoriani laagolie. Ira iyie eretoto ai olakordunoni lai; mimutie iyie, na Ai ai!

English: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo oiken olaisinani! Kekordu Olaitoriani ninye te nkolong e nyamali;

English: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
Masaai: kemitu Olaitoriani ninye neitopok; keji olomayiana te nkop; minchooyo iyie ninye apik eyieunoto oo lmang'ati lenyena.

English: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
Masaai: Keitagol Olaitoriani ninye te ndapash enye; ore te muoyian enye ninchiunye iyie pooki leyiata.

English: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
Masaai: Ore ti alo nanu, atejo, “Olaitoriani, ing'urrieki nanu; nchiunyeki nanu, amu ataasa nanu eng'oki ti alo iyie!”

English: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
Masaai: Eiro ilmang'ati laainei entorroni tialo nanu, ejo, “Kanu kenya eye ninye, pee eish enkarna enye!”

English: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.
Masaai: Naa te naalotu oltung'ani aduaare neiro ninye irorei le pesho, nesot ntorrok to ltau lenye; ore pee eipang alo neidapashaki enkop pooki.

English: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki laaiba nanu neing'oming'om te nebo aaimaki nanu; nemusu ninche ntorrok ti alo nanu.

English: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Etijing'a ninye entaboi; meekure ae kata edumunye te ine neirragie.”

English: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up his heel against me.
Masaai: Ore ninye olchore lai lo ltau apa laisiliga nanu, oshi ooinos endaa ai, naatudumakine ninye nanu.

English: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
Masaai: Kake ing'urrieki iyie, Olaitoriani, tudumuaki nanu, pee atum aitalaku elap te ninye!
