English: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
Masaai: Tena nanu ayiolou nchere, eikishipakino iyie nanu, nchere eitu eisulu olmang'atinta lai te nanu.

English: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
Masaai: Kimbung'a iyie nanu te nkaraki naas isupati, nikipik nanu dukuya ino ntarasi.

English: Blessed be the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ntarasi o ntarasi! Esai o Esai.

English: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
Masaai: Ore anaa enayieu enkoilii enkare naruko neijia etiu oltau lai, kiyieu iyie, Enkai.

English: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
Masaai: Eeta oltau lai enkure te nkaraki Enkai, Enkai naishu. Kanu kenya alotu aing'or enkomom e Nkai?

English: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?
Masaai: Etaa ilkiyio laainei ninche endaa ai dama o kewarie, aajoki nanu iltung'ana anaake, “Koree Enkai ino?”

English: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
Masaai: Te nadamu nanu kuna baa nelepori oltau lai ti atua nanu, amu ashomo nanu arikoo olorora nikipuo e nkaji e Nkai, too mbuakunot e nchipai o sinkolioitin le nashe, neitobir ilo orora osirua.

English: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee itapalari iyie, lo tau lai, naa kainyoo pee itanyamala iyie ti atua nanu? Isiliga Enkai; amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, ninye eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.

English: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
Masaai: Etalepori oltau lai ti atua nanu, ore enkaraki ina kaadamu nanu iyie, ebaiki enkop e Yordan o ene Hermon, ebaiki oldoinyo le Misar.

English: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
Masaai: Eishiraka enguton e nguton te mbuakunoto oo nkariak inono; ore ndoorot oo nkariak o lopir le nkare naaitemoitie nanu.

English: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
Masaai: Ore tendama neitanap Olaitoriani enyorrata enye nauno, ore te nkewarie netii osinkolio lenye te nebo nanu, enkomono e Nkai e nkishui ai.

English: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Masaai: Atiaaka nanu Enkai, endapidapoi ai, “Kainyoo pee mikidamu nanu? Kainyoo nanu pee alo aishirita, te nkaraki enkitorogonyata naaitorogony olmang'atinta?”

English: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?
Masaai: Etotiutuo anaa ilbaa torrok to sesen lai, imorot oo lmang'ati laainei, aajoki ninche anaake, “Koree e Nkai ino?”

English: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee itapalari, lo tau lai, naa kainyoo iyie pee itigire ti atua nanu? Isiliga Enkai, amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.

English: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
Masaai: Mbalie na Ai nchere maata entorroni nikimitu nanu. tokorduaki nanu too lalejak o te lelo lemeitoriori!

English: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Masaai: Amu ira iyie Enkai naa ninye nanu asaru; Kainyoo iyie pee kinturrayie nanu? Kainyoo nanu pee alo aishirita, te nkaraki enkitorogonyata o lmang'atinta lai?

English: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
Masaai: Oi irriu ewang'an ino o esipata ino; nchoo ninche maatorikoi nanu, nchoo ninche maatoriku nanu ilo doinyo lino sinyati o emanyisho ino!

English: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
Masaai: Pee atum nanu ashomo olperere lo lasar le Nkai, alo enetii Enkai naa ninye eng'ida ai nadooyo; naa kaalo nanu arrep iyie te nkinanta na Ai, Enkai ai.

English: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee itapalari lo tau lai, naa kainyoo iyie pee itanyamala ti atua nanu? Isiliga Enkai, amu kaitoki ake aisis ninye, eretoto ai naa Enkai ai.

English: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
Masaai: Kitoning'o iyiook too nkiyiaa ang, iyie Enkai, etolikitio iyiook iloo papa, nena kiaasin apa nitaasa iyie too nkolong'i enye, apa moitie:

English: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
Masaai: iyie makewan oturrumoyie iloshon te nkaina ino, kake ntubula olorere lino; nipik iloreren osina, kake nchoo olorere lino etoni te seriani;

English: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
Masaai: amu mme to lalem lenye apa eisulie ninche ena kop, neme enkaina enye maate naishoo ninche metimirisho; kake enkaina ino e tatene, ee enkaina ino, o ewang'an e nkomom ino; amu itishipakine iyie ninche.

English: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
Masaai: Ira iyie Olaiguanani lai o Enkai ai, naa iyie oisho Yakobo metimirisho.

English: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
Masaai: Te iyie iyiook kisulie ilmang'ati lang; te nkarna ino iyiook kintunyoo lelo oogilunore iyiook.

English: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
Masaai: Amu mme enkawuo ai nanu aisilig, nemaaidim olalem lai aitajeu.

English: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
Masaai: Kake ntajeuo iyie iyiook too lmang'ati lang, nitipika olmilo lelo ooiba iyiook.

English: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
Masaai: Enkai kiting'idare iyiook anaake, naa eikinchooyo enashe te nkaraki enkarna ino ntarasi.

English: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, nturrayie iyie iyiook nintadou iyiook, neitu iyie ilo airiamariyie njorin ang.

English: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie iyiook maibelekenyata aailany ilmang'ati lang; ore lelo mang'ati lang neibung aaraya masaa ang.

English: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
Masaai: Ntotiuo iyie iyiook anaa ntare naayieng'i, nindapashaka iyiook iloreren.

English: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
Masaai: Itimira iltung'ana linono neitu inosie toki, eitu iyie ing'oru enkinyang'a nagol te nkaraki ninche.

English: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
Masaai: Itipika iyie iyiook elap too lmang'ati lang, neikoroj neyiet iyiook lelo oomanita iyiook.

English: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
Masaai: Ntaa iyie iyiook endung'et e rashe ti atua iloreren, entoki nakueniyieki ti atua iloshon.

English: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
Masaai: Ore endama pooki netii esulare ai dukuya nanu, neimulumula enkurruna enkomom ai,

English: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
Masaai: te nkaraki irorei le ilo oikordodisho nemorisho, te nkaraki ilo mang'atinta o ilo oitalaku elap.

English: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
Masaai: Eetuo kuna pooki shumata iyiook, hoo neitu kipal mikidamu iyie, neitu kipong'ori to lning'o lino.

English: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
Masaai: Eitu eibelekenya iltauja lang, neitu elam iroruat ang enkoitoi ino,

English: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
Masaai: nitigiligila iyiook ti atua ewueji oo mbariak, nimulumul iyiook te naimin namisimis.

English: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
Masaai: Amaa naaji te naa ketorikine iyiook enkarna e Nkai ang, anaa eikintoriokitio nkaik ang enkai omoni,

English: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
Masaai: aimeirrash Enkai ena? Amu eyiolo ninye nkisudorot o ltau.

English: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
Masaai: Ee, te nkaraki enkorrok ino pee eari iyiook endama pooki, neikoni iyiook anaa nkerra naayieng'i.

English: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
Masaai: Tuputunye! minturraa iyiook ntarasi Kainyoo pee irura, iyie Olaitoriani? Tudumunye, minturraa iyiook anangaki enelakua.

English: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee isudoo enkomom ino? Kainyoo iyie pee kitorikine osina lang o enkitorogonyata ang?

English: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
Masaai: Eirrugote iltauja lang aabaiki enkop; eirragita iseseni lang te nkop.

English: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
Masaai: Tudumunye, wou taretu iyiook! Tokordu iyiook te nkaraki ina nyorrata ino nauno!

English: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
Masaai: Eiputa aadooyo to ltau lai ilomon supati; naliki nanu olaiguanani irorei lo sinkolio lai; eikununo olng'ejep lai aanaa enkalamu o lasirani arriyia.

English: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
Masaai: Ira iyie sidai too nkera e tung'ana; etubukokoki empiris enkutuk ino; ore enkaraki ina, kitamayiana Enkai ntarasi.

English: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
Masaai: Teena olalem lino to mpolos ino, iyie ele magilani, ti atua enkitoo ino o enkishiaa!

English: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
Masaai: Ore te nkishiaa ino shomo isula te nkaraki esipata nimitu ilo asipani; nchoo enkaina ino e tatene mikinteng'ena nkiaasin naaitureisho!

English: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.
Masaai: Kepi mbaa inono, netii atua iltauja loo lmang'ati lo laiguanani, nebatata iloreren ti abori iyie.

English: Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.
Masaai: Ore ilo orika lino le nkitoo, Enkai, nebikoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Ore ina ng'udi ino e nkitoria naa eng'udi oo sipat;

English: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
Masaai: inyor iyie esupatisho nimba enkarruoisho. Metaa ore Enkai, ina Ai ino kitubukoko eilata aput teina ilata e ng'ida nikintulusoo too lchoreta linono

English: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
Masaai: ore ilkilani linono neitorropili te nkorropil o too sonkoyoni, o erropili o sinantei ore ti atua nena ajijik e nkitoo oo lala loo lkanchaoni, netii nkinantani oo usin nikintishipieki iyie;

English: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
Masaai: ore ntoyie oo laiguanak netii te nebo nena kituaak inono naayanyiti; ore te nkaina ino e tatene neitashe enkaiguanani eishopito sahabu naing'uaa Ofir.

English: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
Masaai: Toning'o, iyie na tito, tadamu, nirrugu enkiok ino; nchoo kirikino olorere linyi o enkaji e papaai lino,

English: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.
Masaai: pee etum olaiguanani atishipakinoyu enkishiaa ino. Ore amu olkitok lino ninye, irrugokinoyu ninye;

English: And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
Masaai: ore iltung'ana le nkop e Turo neyau nkishorot, lelo karsisi aalang iltung'ana pooki,

English: The king's daughter is all glorious within: her clothing is of wrought gold.
Masaai: eeta enkarsisisho oo mpukunot pooki. Eikodoki entito o laiguanani to lgilata lenye te nkaji e nkitoo, too ilkilani lenyena ooripuno too usin e sahabu;

English: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
Masaai: ore etukuse too lkilani loo muain kumok, nerikokini olaiguanani, te nebo nena selenken naairukurukore ninye.

English: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
Masaai: Nerikuni ninche te nchipai o te ng'ida, ina kata ejing atua ina aji e nkitoo o laiguanani.

English: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo loo papaai linyi naa keaku ilayiok linono; naa ilo iyie aitaa ninche kituaak te nkop pooki.

English: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu enkarna ino metoning'oyu too ishoritin pooki, metaa eikisis iyie iloreren ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Masaai: Enkai osempewuet lang naa engolon ang, eretoto nataana ninye te nkata e nyamali.

English: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina mikiureisho hoo duoo ninye tenaa keibelekenya enkop, hoo duoo ninye tenaa keikirikira ildoinyo te mpolos e naiposha;

English: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
Masaai: hoo tenaa keikurrukur nkariak e naiposha neitayu labur, hoo tenaa keikirikira ildoinyo te nkaraki olarrabal.

English: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.
Masaai: Etii olkeju oitiship nchorroi enyena enkanasa o Laitoriani, ina manyisho sinyati e ilo Otii Shumata Aisul.

English: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.
Masaai: Etii Enkai atua ina anasa, nemeigusugusieki ninye; keretu Enkai ninye tadekenya.

English: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
Masaai: Etagorote iloshon, neikirikirate nkitoriat; neiro ninye to ltoilo lenye, neshola enkop.

English: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
Masaai: Etii Olaitoriani loo lororani te nebo iyiook; Enkai e Yakobo ninye esarunoto ang.

English: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
Masaai: Wootu eng'ura isiaaitin o laitoriani, eneikuna ninye pee eitomijoon e nkop.

English: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
Masaai: Ninye oishie ilarrabali o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop; ninye ogil enkawuo nedot empere, nepejoo ngarrin oo mbartan te nkima!

English: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
Masaai: “Ntirring'ayu, niyiolou nchere nanu Enkai. ara nanu kitok ti atua iloshon, aaitaaki nanu kitok te nkop!”

English: The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
Masaai: Etii Olaitoriani loo lororani te nebo iyiook; Enkai e Yakobo ninye esarunoto ang.

English: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
Masaai: Entoosh nkaik, te ng'ida lo oreren pooki! Esisa Enkai too mbuakunot oo sinkolioitin.

English: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani, ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, naa keitureisho, ninye olaiguanani kitok te nkop pooki.

English: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
Masaai: Ninye oyau iloshon apik abori iyiook, nepik iloreren abori nkejek ang.

English: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
Masaai: Ninye otegelaka iyiook enjung'ore ang, ina kishiaa e Yakobo otonyorra ninye.

English: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
Masaai: Eilepa Enkai shumata te mbuakunoto, etii Olaitoriani te mbuakunoto e ntarumpeta.

English: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Enkai enkisisa, entarany enkisisa! Entaranyaki Olaiguanani lang entarany enkisisa!

English: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
Masaai: Amu Enkai olaiguanani le nkop pooki; entarany enkisisa to lkerempe!

English: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
Masaai: Enkai naitoreisho loo loreren; etonita Enkai to lorika lenye le nkitoo sinyati.

English: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
Masaai: Eiturrurrote ilkituaak loo loreren anaa iltung'ana le Nkai e Abraham. Amu ine Nkai ilong'oi pooki e nkop; neishori ninye enkitoo sapuk!

English: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
Masaai: Eikitok Olaitoriani naa keisisi ninye oleng ti atua enkanasa e Nkai ang! Te ilo doinyo lenye sinyati

English: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
Masaai: sidai te nkadoro enye, naa ninye eng'ida e nkop pooki. Etii oldoinyo le Sion enelakua te moikuape, ina anasa o laiguanani kitok.

English: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
Masaai: Ore ti atua nkajijik enyena neitodolua Enkai kewan nchere ninye omitu.

English: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, eiturrurrote laiguanak, nepuonu te nebo.

English: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ninche ina, neing'asia, neirut ninche, nedumunye aaisik;

English: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
Masaai: neibung ninche olokirrikir te ine, o emion neeijo ene nkitok nasaisai.

English: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
Masaai: Ore to siwuo le nkilepunoto e nkolong nigil imelin e Tarshishi.

English: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
Masaai: Ore anaa enikitoning'o, ina kitoduaa iyiook ti atua enkanasa o Laitoriani loo lororani, ti atua ina anasa e Nkai ang, apa naitasheyie Enkai ntarasi.

English: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
Masaai: Kitadamutua iyiook te ina nyorrata ino kitok, Olaitoriani, te mpolos e nkaji ino.

English: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatiu enkarna ino, na Ai, neijia etiu enkisisa ino, elo abaiki ineeiting'ie enkop. Neeta enkaina ino e tatene enkisulata;

English: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
Masaai: nchoo oldoinyo le Sion eng'idayu! Nchoo nena toyie e Yuda eng'idayu te nkaraki nkiguanat inono!

English: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
Masaai: Shomo tamanai te Sion, shomo tamana ninye, nkena iltaleta lenyena,

English: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
Masaai: entadamu entisipu isunta enyena o nkajijik enyena, pee itumutumu aatiaaki eishoi nasuju,

English: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
Masaai: nchere Enkai ena, ninye Enkai ang ntarasi o ntarasi. Ninye oaku olarikoni lang ntarasi.

English: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
Masaai: Entoning ena lo oreren! Enchoru nkiyiaa, intae pooki oomanya enkop,

English: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
Masaai: o liabori o le shumata, o lkarsis o laisinani te nebo!

English: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
Masaai: Keiro enkutuk ai ine ng'eno nagut; ore nkibirribirrat o ltau lai naa keaku eyiolounoto.

English: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
Masaai: Kairrugoki nanu enkiok ai endung'et e rashe; nawalu nanu oloyiote lai te oshoto e nkinanta.

English: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
Masaai: Kainyoo nanu pee aureisho te nkata e nyamali, te naaman nanu entorroni oo laisilisilok laainei,

English: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
Masaai: lelo tung'ana ooisilig karsisisho enye, neitokoos te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa enye?

English: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
Masaai: Esipa meetae oltung'ani okordu kewan, anaa oloisho Enkai enkinyiang'a e nkishui enye,

English: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
Masaai: amu ore enkordunoto e nkishui enye naa kegol, nemeidimi ae kata aainyiang'u,

English: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
Masaai: pee etum oltung'ani ataa keishu ntarasi, nemejing ae kata Engumoto.

English: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
Masaai: Ee, kedol ninye nchere, ekeye sii ninye ilo ng'en, ore ilo modai o lkiminchali naa keidak te nebo neing'ueiki ina arsisisho enye ilkulikae.

English: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
Masaai: Nkuraren enye ninche nkang'itie enye ntarasi, ninche imanyishoritin enye ti atua iishoritin pooki, hoo neipot ninche nkuapi aajo nkunenye.

English: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
Masaai: Mebikoo oltung'ani te nkitoo enye, eikununo ninye anaa eng'ues naidaaya.

English: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
Masaai: Ena enkoitoi e lelo oomoda, enkiting'oto e lelo ooshipakino erubata enye.

English: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
Masaai: Etiu ninche anaa ntare naayae enemeneng'a, neaku keeya olchekut lenye; neitoriori ninche aadoiki Engumoto, ore esidano e nkitobirunoto enye neidaaya aish; neaku enemeneng'a enkang enye.

English: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
Masaai: Kake kekordu Enkai enkishui ai aitung'uaa engolon e Nemeneng'a, amu kaang'amu ninye nanu.

English: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
Masaai: Mirut iyie te neaku oltung'ani karsis, te neponari enkitoo enkaji enye.

English: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
Masaai: Amu te neye ninye nemenap toki, melo enkitoo enye asujaa ninye.

English: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
Masaai: Ore hoo neikenaa kewan ajo keshipa eton eishu, anaa hoo netum oltung'ani enkisisa te neitaas kewan esidai,

English: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
Masaai: keyooki ake alo enetii ilporori loo loo menye, lelo lemeigil ai kata aadol ewang'an.

English: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
Masaai: Mebikoo oltung'ani ti atua enkitoo enye, etiu ninye anaa eng'ues naidaaya.

English: The mighty God, even the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
Masaai: Ilo magilani, Olaitoriani Enkai, ninye oiro neipotu enkop ebaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong metabaiki endoyioroto.

English: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
Masaai: Ore te Sion, te ine neiting'ie e nkishiaa, Enkai naitawang.

English: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
Masaai: Kelotu Enkai ang, nemegira ninye, ore te dukuya ninye naa enkima nanyaisho, ore oriong ine namanita ninye naa osiwuo kitok.

English: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
Masaai: Neipot shumata e keper o abori kop, pee etum ninye aiguanare iltung'ana lenyena:

English: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
Masaai: “Enturrurrokoki nanu lelo ooisiligayu laainei; lelo ooitobira olning'o lo sotua o nanu to lasar!”

English: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.
Masaai: Eibalunye shumata esupatisho enye, amu Enkai kewan nadung enkiguana.

English: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.
Masaai: “Entoning lo tung'ana laainei, amu kairo nanu, iyie Israel, kaaishakenoki nanu iyie. Ara nanu enkai, Enkai ino.

English: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aaisikong iyie te nkaraki ilasarri linono; ore lelo asarri linono oopejori netii anaake dukuya nanu.

English: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.
Masaai: Mang'amaa o lasar loo loing'ok oing'uaa enkaji ino, nemang'amaa olkine oing'uaa eluaata ino.

English: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ng'ues ti atua entim naa enaai, o nena kishu naatii ndoinyo inkalifuni.

English: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu imotonyi pooki o loing'ang'e, ore pooki toki nalo ti oriong enkop naa enaai.

English: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.
Masaai: “Tenaa naaji esumash aata, nemaaliki iyie; amu enaai enkop o pooki toki natii.

English: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Masaai: Kainos nanu nkiri oo loing'ok, anaa aok osarge loo nkineji?

English: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
Masaai: Nchoo iyie Enkai olasar le nashe, nilaaki ninye nkishorot inono ilo otii Shumata Aisul;

English: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
Masaai: nikimpot nanu te nkata e nyamali; kaakordu nanu iyie, nikiisis iyie nanu.”

English: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
Masaai: Kake ore te ilo arruoni, ejo Enkai: “Kaa sipata iyie iata nilimunye nkitanapat aainei, anaa iya olning'o lai lo sotua te nkutuk ino?

English: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
Masaai: Amu mba iyie eutaroto, ninang'aa irorei laainei aidie kewan.

English: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
Masaai: Te nidol iyie olapurroni, niaku olchore lenye, nira o le ncholiek oo loo loloito.

English: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
Masaai: “Nipalaa enkutuk ino too nkirorot torrok, neitobiru olng'ejep lino elejare.

English: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
Masaai: Iton iyie airo entorroni tialo olalashe lino, ninteeniki enkerai ning'arie kina.

English: These things hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself: but I will reprove thee, and set them in order before thine eyes.
Masaai: Kuna baa oshi iasita natigirakine nanu; itejo apa iyie kara obo otiu anaa iyie, kake kaaisikong taata nanu iyie, naibalunye mbaa te dukuya iyie.

English: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
Masaai: “Entisipu naa ena, intae ilemedamu Enkai, pee mayooki ake apolos intae, nemetumi hoo obo oitajeu!

English: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo oyau olasar le nashe ninye laayanyit nanu; ore ilo oitorioo nkoitoi enyena, naa kaitodol nanu enjeunoto e Nkai!”

English: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Enkai, te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno; ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino kitok, tujutoi nkitarruorot aainei.

English: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
Masaai: Ntukuoki nanu tukul meishunye entorroni ai, nikintisiny too ng'ok aainei!

English: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu nkitarruorot aainei, netii ing'ok aainei anaake dukuya nanu.

English: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.
Masaai: Tialo iyie ake ataasa nanu eng'oki, naas ina torrono too nkonyek inono, metaa ira iyie asipani te nkiguana ino, nimiaata entioto te nkiguana ino.

English: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ti atua ntorrok nanu aatoiuoki, naa ti atua ing'ok aatoiuo yieyio.

English: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
Masaai: Ng'ura, esipata e atua oltau iyieu iyie; ore enkaraki ina inteng'enaki nanu eng'eno nagut ti atua enkisudoroto o ltau lai.

English: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Masaai: Mpooki nanu te hisopo, pee asinyayu; ntukuoki, pee awang'u alang enturoto.

English: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.
Masaai: Mputaki nanu eng'ida o enchipai, nchoo lelo oik apa litigila iyie meting'idata.

English: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
Masaai: Isudoi enkomom ino too ng'ok aainei, nijutoo ntorrok aainei pooki.

English: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Masaai: Ntobiru ti atua nanu oltau sidai, iyie Enkai, nipik enkishui ng'ejuk sidai atua nanu.

English: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
Masaai: Mikinturraa nanu aitung'uaa ine nitii, nimiwuang'ie ina kiyang'et ino sinyati ti atua nanu.

English: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
Masaai: Torrinyokoki nanu eng'ida e njeunoto ino, nikimbung nanu to ltau le yieunoto ino.

English: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
Masaai: Pee atum aiteng'ena ilaitarruorrok nkoitoi inono, nikirrinyokino ilaing'okok aapuonu enitii.

English: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, tokorduaki nanu te lelo loo sargeta, iyie, Enkai e njeunoto ai, naa kerany olng'ejep lai te mbuakunoto e nkordunoto ino.

English: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, tabolo iyie enkutuk ai pee eibalunye enkutuk ai enkisisa ino.

English: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
Masaai: Amu mishipakino iyie ilasarri; te naitayu ninye olasar opejori nimikintiship iyie.

English: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
Masaai: Ore olasar ong'amaroyu te Nkai naa oltau obor; ore oltau obor neitadou kewan, mimenaa iyie Olaitoriani.

English: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ntaasa Sion esidai te supatisho ino; teshetu isunta e Yerusalem.

English: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
Masaai: Pee itum taa atishipakinoyu ilasarri oodede, o lasarri oopejori, o lasarri oolulung'a oopejori; nitum taa aitayu ilasarri loo loing'ok, to lperere lino lo lasar.

English: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee intokoos, lo tung'ani magilani, te nkaraki entorroni naitaasaki ilo tung'ani le Nkai?

English: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.
Masaai: Ore endama pooki, ntobirita iyie enkidaata. Eikununo olng'ejep lino anaa olmurunya opi, iyie olaitobirani le nkeleekisho.

English: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
Masaai: Inyor iyie entorroni aitalang esupatisho, o elejare alang esipata.

English: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
Masaai: Inyor iyie irorei oomutisho, iyie o lolng'ejep olejisho

English: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
Masaai: kake eikigiligil iyie Enkai ntarasi; nikimbung ninye iyie nikipolos ti atua olng'obor lino; Nikidotu ninye iyie aitung'uaa enkop oo looishu.

English: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
Masaai: Ore lelo supati naa kedol, neureishoyu, nekueniyie ninche ninye, ejo,

English: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
Masaai: “Eng'ura oltung'ani lemeitaa Enkai esarunoto enye, laa enkumoi oo masaa enyena eisiliga, nelo ninye aing'oru enesaru ti atua imasaa enyena!”

English: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kake aikununo nanu anaa oloirien onyori mbenek ti atua enkaji e Nkai. Aisiliga nanu ina nyorrata nauno e Nkai ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe ntarasi, amu itaasa iyie ena. Kaibalunye nanu enkarna ino amu eisidai, to dukuya lelo ooure Enkai.

English: The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.
Masaai: Ejo olmodai to ltau lenye, “Metii Enkai.” Etarruoitie ninche, neas olminong torrono, meetae ninye obo oas isidain.

English: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.
Masaai: Neing'or Enkai kop etii shumata, aing'or nkera e tung'ana pee edol tenaa ketii obo ng'en oing'oru Enkai.

English: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
Masaai: Etorrinyote pooki aapuo siadi etarruoitie pooki; meetae hoo obo oas esidai, a-a, metii hoo obo.

English: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
Masaai: Aimeeta kulo ooas ntorrok indamunot, kulo ooinos iltung'ana laainei anaa endaa, nemeipotu ninche Enkai?

English: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
Masaai: Etijing'a ninche olkirutoto kitok, olkirutoto leitu ae kata etumi! Amu keidapash Enkai iloik le lelo lemeure Enkai, keitukurruni ninche, amu etanya Enkai ninche.

English: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
Masaai: Oi elotu enkordunoto e Israel eing'uaa Sion! Ina kata errinyu Enkai iltung'ana lenyena, neng'idayu Yakobo neshipayu Israel.

English: Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
Masaai: Ntajeuoki nanu, iyie Enkai, te nkarna ino, ng'uanareki nanu te nkidimata ino.

English: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Toning'o enkomono ai, iyie Enkai; tipika enkiok ino kulo rorei le nkutuk ai.

English: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
Masaai: Amu aatudumakinote nanu iltung'ana omon aagilunore, eing'oru iltung'ana lemeeta olng'ur enkishui ai, nemeiturukie ninche Enkai too mbaa enye.

English: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.
Masaai: Ng'ura, Enkai ninye olaretoni lai; Olaitoriani ninye olaibung'ani le nkishui ai.

English: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
Masaai: Keitalaku ninye entorroni too lmang'ati laainei; ore te supatisho ino nting'ie ninche.

English: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
Masaai: Ore too lasarri lo lpela kaapolosaki nanu iyie; kaisho nanu enkarna ino enashe, iyie Olaitoriani, amu aisidai ninye.

English: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.
Masaai: Amu kitokordua iyie nanu aitung'uaa pooki nyamali, netoduaa nkonyek aainei enkisulata ino too lmang'ati laainei.

English: Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
Masaai: Toning'o te nkiok ino enkomono ai, na Ai; nimisudoo kewan te nkomono ai!

English: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
Masaai: Toning'oki nanu, nikiwaliki; aaidimua nanu eng'olikinoto ai atalepunye nanu,

English: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
Masaai: te nkaraki ilo toilo lo lmang'atinta, te nkaraki ilo kibookinoto enkop eilo torrono amu keyau ninche enyamali shumata nanu; ore te ngoro neitobir ninche mang'atisho ti alo nanu.

English: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
Masaai: Etamio oltau lai ti atua nanu, neewuo olkirutoto le keeya shumata nanu.

English: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
Masaai: Eewuo olkirutoto o lokirrikir shumata nanu, naaibulua nanu enkiputukuny.

English: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Oi naaji tenaa kaata inaipuko anaa enturkulu, anaata aipirri enelakua ayeng'iyeng'a;

English: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
Masaai: ee, anaata alo enelakua, nalo nanu airrag ong'ata,

English: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
Masaai: anaata aipirri alo aing'oru olng'obor aing'ataa olemua o lkutati kitok.”

English: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
Masaai: Ndaikie iyie nkitobirat enye, Olaitoriani, nipik olmilo ilng'ejepa lenye amu adolita nanu olarrabal o enchankar ti atua enkanasa.

English: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.
Masaai: Ore dama o kewarie, nemanaa ninche too sunta enyena; netii enkaruoisho o enyamali atua ninye.

English: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
Masaai: Etii enkidaata empolos enye, nemepuku enkibookinoto e nkop o esunkureisho te wueji enye nemirishoreki.

English: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
Masaai: Mme olmang'atinta laatusukenya nanu, amu anaata nanu airisha; ime ilo laaiba oitokoos ti alo nanu - amu anaata nanu ashomo aisudori.

English: But it was thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
Masaai: Kake iyie, ele, larisiore, iyie ole ncholuek ai, ele shore lai latamoo.

English: We took sweet counsel together, and walked unto the house of God in company.
Masaai: Eikiaata apa iyiook nkirorot naamurru te nebo; ore ti atua enkaji e Nkai nikipuo apa iyiook te nchula.

English: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.
Masaai: Meeu keeya shumata ninche, metadoi ninche aapuo enemeneng'a eishu, meshomo ninche to lkirutoto aajing atua nkuraren enye.

English: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
Masaai: Kake kaipot nanu Olaitoriani; naa kaaitajeu nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
Masaai: Ore teipa o tadekenya o te ndama nairo nanu enyamali ai naisinanuo, naa kening ninye oltoilo lai.

English: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.
Masaai: Kekordu ninye oltau lai te seriani te ilo arrabal laatoluaakine, amu ilkumok laakeshare nanu.

English: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
Masaai: Kening Enkai, neitobor ninche, ilo apa ototonie olorika le nkitoo ebaiki moitie, enkaraki nemeibung ninche nkitanapat, nemeure ninche Enkai.

English: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
Masaai: Eitorioyie ilo le ncholuek ai enkaina enye agilunore ilchoreta lenyena, etigila ninye olning'o lenye.

English: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.
Masaai: Kenana enkiroroto enye anaa eng'orno, kake eeta olarrabal to ltau lenye; nenana irorei lenyena anaa eilata, kake eikununo ninche anaa lalema ootushutuaki.

English: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
Masaai: Nteleiki Olaitoriani olola lino, naa aikintagol ninye iyie; menyorraa ae kata ninye meiwuang'ieki ilo asipani.

English: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
Masaai: Kake, ore iyie, Enkai, inang'aa ninche aitadou meetu abori tiatua engumoto nagut. Ore lelo tung'ana lo sarge o enkeleekisho metaa mebikoo ninche eishu to lpisiai le nkishui enye kake kaaisilig nanu iyie.

English: Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu, iyie Enkai, amu aaitunyokito iltung'ana enkop; ore endama pooki naaisilisil nanu iltung'ana;

English: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.
Masaai: aaitunyokito ilmang'ati laainei enkop endama pooki, amu ilkumok laarare nanu te nkitokoos.

English: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
Masaai: Te naureishoyu nanu napik osiligi lai atua iyie.

English: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
Masaai: Atua ina Ai naisisita nanu ororei lenye, Enkai naisiligita metii enkuretisho. Kaa nanu aaidim tung'ani aitaasa?

English: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
Masaai: Ore endama pooki neing'oru ninche pee eibelekeny irorei laainei; ore ndamunot enye pooki naa nanu egilunore te ntorroni.

English: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
Masaai: Neiturrurro ninche te nebo, neisudori, neing'oru iroruat aainei. Anaa enataanyutua ninche enkishui ai,

English: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.
Masaai: ntalaa ninche te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye; ore te ngoro ino, iyie Enkai, tusulaki ninche enkop!

English: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
Masaai: Nkena iyie enkirrang'irrang ai; tipika iyie ilkiyio laainei oltulet lino! Aimetii ninche atua embuku ino?

English: When I cry unto thee, then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God is for me.
Masaai: Naa kerrinyi ilmang'ati laainei siadi te ina kata naaishiraki nanu iyie. Ayiolo nanu ena, nchere etii Enkai enchoto ai.

English: In God will I praise his word: in the LORD will I praise his word.
Masaai: Atua ina Ai naisisita nanu ororei lenye, Olaitoriani laisisita nanu irorei lenyena,

English: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
Masaai: Enkai naisiliga nanu metii enkuretisho. Kaa nanu aaidim tung'ani aitaasa?

English: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
Masaai: Ore lelo muma laainei te iyie naa kaitabaya, kaishoru nanu olasar le nashe te iyie.

English: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: wilt not thou deliver my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
Masaai: Amu itokordua iyie enkishui ai te keeya, ee, nintajeu nkejek aainei te mbatatata, pee atum nanu ashomo te dukuya Enkai ti atua ewang'an e nkishui ai.

English: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
Masaai: Ing'urrieki nanu iyie Enkai, ing'urrieki nanu, amu iyie esaru oltau lai; oloip loo naipuko inono nanu asaru, o metaba anaa nelusoo ilo kutati te nkidaata.

English: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
Masaai: Aishiraka nanu Enkai natii shumata aisul, Enkai naitabaya eyieunoto enyena te nanu.

English: He shall send from heaven, and save from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
Masaai: Ninye oirriu olkilikuai te keper naaitajeu nanu; keitukurru ninye lelo laaitunyoki nanu enkop. Keirriu Enkai ina nyorrata enye nauno o esupatisho enye!

English: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
Masaai: Airraga nanu te mpolos oo lng'atunyo ooinos te nkowuarisho inkera e tung'ana iremeta o mbaa ilala lenye, naa ilalema oopi ilng'ejepa lenye.

English: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
Masaai: Mikisisi iyie Enkai, aaitulusoo te keper! Nchoo meibulu enkitoo ino enkop pooki!

English: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
Masaai: Etipika ninche orreshet nkejek aainei; neirrugi oltau lai aaing'orie enkop. Etuturutuo ninche engumoto te nkoitoi ai, kake etusulakinote ninche maate.

English: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, eitashe oltau lai auno, euno oltau lai! Karany nanu naosh olkerempe!

English: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
Masaai: Tudumunye lo tau lai! Tudumunye na awuo oo sinkolioitin o lwulul loo usin! Kainyeyie nanu entadekenya!

English: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
Masaai: Ekaaisho nanu iyie enashe, iyie Olaitoriani, ti atua iloshon; kaaranyaki nanu iyie enkisisa ti atua iloreren.

English: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
Masaai: Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno naa eikitok o metabaiki keper, nebaiki esupatisho ino nkatampo.

English: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.
Masaai: Nchoo mikisisi iyie, Iyie Enkai aaitulusoo te shumata nkatampo! nchoo enkitoo ino eibulu enkop pooki!

English: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
Masaai: Kesipa, lokituaak, idung'udung'u intae enkiguana te sipata? Inguanarere intae nkera e tung'ana too sipat?

English: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
Masaai: A-a, ore ti atua iltauja linyi nidamumu ntorrok; niasiasa ntorrok too nkaik inyi te nkop.

English: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
Masaai: Ore lelo torrok netapong'ori apa ake ebaiki etii eng'uset, etapong'ori apa ebaiki pee eini neiro elejare.

English: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
Masaai: Eeta ninche esayiet neeijo eno lasurai, eikununo ninche anaa enturbubua ming'ani nemening'isho,

English: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
Masaai: nemening oltoilo loo lasakutok anaa oltoilo loo laitobirak loo ntaleng'o ng'eni hoo neibonisho ninche te nkarriyiano.

English: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai tigila ilala lenye too nkutukie enye; Olaitariani, tadotu iltagiligil loo lkuoo loo lng'atunyo!

English: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
Masaai: Nchoo meishunye ninche anaa nkare; nchoo meitunyokini ninche enkop anaa nkujit naatoito.

English: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metotiwuo anaa olosiki otoshole, nchoo metaa olkibiroto leitu ae kata edol enkolong.

English: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu ening imotioo inyi enkima oo lkiku, naa kaitayu nanu ninche to siwuo akutaa, oloshal o lotoyio!

English: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
Masaai: Kelo ilo supat ang'idayu te nedol enkitalakunoto e lap, nelo ninye aituku nkejek enyena to sarge le lelo arruok.

English: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
Masaai: Naa kejo iltung'ana, “Esipa keetae elaakinoto teilo supat, esipa keetae Enkai nadung'oki enkop enkiguana.”

English: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu too lmang'ati laainei, iyie Enkai, Tomituoki nanu te lelo laadumakino aagilunore,

English: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
Masaai: tokorduaki nanu te lelo ooitobir entorroni, nikintajeu nanu too ltung'ana oata enkure o sarge.

English: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
Masaai: Amu, ng'ura, keirrag ninche pee aarresh nanu aar matua, neiturrurro lelo pushunot te nebo pee aar nanu. Neme te nkaraki enkitarruorroto ai anaa eng'oki ai, Olaitoriani,

English: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
Masaai: ore ninye maata enataasa, nekuet ninche aapuo aanapa. Tudumunye, wou taretoki nanu, ning'orisho!

English: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie, Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, iyie Enkai e Israel. Tudumunye ntamio iloshon pooki; mileku ninye obo le lelo ooipiru entorroni.

English: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
Masaai: Ore too nteipan nerrinyunye ninche, nebuak anaa ildiein neman enkanasa.

English: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?
Masaai: Ng'ura ninche, eimujumuj nkutukie enye, netiu nkutukie enye anaa lalema - nejo ninche, “Kaing'ae oning iyiook?”

English: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, ikueniyie ninche; ninkoroj iyie iloreren pooki.

English: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.
Masaai: Na golon ai, kaaranyaki nanu isinkolioitin le nkisisa; amu ore, iyie Enkai, iyie osempewuet lai.

English: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.
Masaai: Ore Enkai te ina nyorrata enye nauno naa kelotu enatii; kaaisho nanu Enkai ai matoduaa enkishuroto too lmang'ati laainei.

English: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
Masaai: Miar ninche metuata, merikino ake iltung'ana laainei; ndapasha ninche te ngolon ino, nintadou ninche, Olaitoriani, iyie elong'o ang!

English: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki eng'oki oo nkutukie enye, lelo rorei lenye, nchoo ninche metijing'a orreshet lo lwuasa lenye. Te nkaraki ildeketa o elejare naitayu ninche,

English: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
Masaai: tumuta ninche te ngoro ino, tumuta ninche o metaba anaa neishunye, pee etum iltung'ana aatayioloito nchere Enkai naitoreisho ti atua Yakobo o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.

English: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
Masaai: Ore too nteipan nerrinyunye ninche, nebuak anaa ildiein neman enkanasa.

English: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
Masaai: Nemanimanaa ninche aaing'oru endaa, neing'unyung'uny enkewarie pooki te neitu eraposho.

English: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
Masaai: Kake karanyaki nanu emagilanisho ino karany nanu abuaku isinkolioitin le nyorrata ino tadekenya. Amu itaa iyie osempewuet te nanu, itaa esarunoto ai te nkolong o sina lai.

English: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.
Masaai: Na golon ai, kaaranyaki nanu iyie isinkolioitin le nkisisa, amu iyie, iyie Enkai, osempewuet lai, iyie Enkai naaitodol nanu enyorrata nauno.

English: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, nturrayie iyie iyiook, nitigila iltimito; itagore iyie, tokordu siaake iyiook.

English: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
Masaai: Iyie oikirikirie enkop, iyie oiperra abol; tarama ine netabee, amu keikirikira.

English: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
Masaai: Itipika iyie iltungana linono, osina kitok inchoo iyie iyiook enaisho oo sabibu naitemera,

English: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
Masaai: Ituuno iyie enanka te nkaraki lelo likiure, pee etumi aaitoduaai te nkaraki esipata.

English: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
Masaai: Pee etumi atokordu ilo lino linyor, nchoru enkisulata te nkaina ino e tatene, niwaliki iyiook!

English: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
Masaai: Eiroro Enkai ti atua enkaji enye sinyati: “Naa kaor nanu Shekem te ng'ida kitok, narishu ierat le Sukot.

English: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
Masaai: Enaai Gilead; enaai Manase; ore Efraim naa enkopiyia ai o larrabal; ore Yuda naa eng'udi ai e nkitoo.

English: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
Masaai: Ore Moab naa engirra ai naitukuore; shumata Edom nanu aiteleiki ina amuke ai; naa te shumata Filistia nanu abuaku te nkisulata.”

English: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Masaai: Kaing'ae laayau nanu atua ina anasa nasheta? Kaing'ae laarik nanu Edom?

English: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
Masaai: Keitu iyie inturraa iyiook, iyie Enkai? Miloito iyie, iyie Enkai, tenebo njorin ang.

English: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Masaai: Nchoo iyiook engolon te nkaraki ilmang'ati lang, amu pesho eretoto e tung'ani!

English: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
Masaai: Ore te retoto e Nkai nikiaas iyiook mbaa sapuki, amu ninye olo aitunyoo ilmang'ati lang.

English: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
Masaai: Toning'o enkishirata, iyie Enkai, inining'o enkomono ai;

English: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Masaai: ore too neeiting'ie enkop naaipot nanu iyie, elepori oltau lai. Torikoyioki iyie nanu mashomo ina dapidapoi naado alang nanu;

English: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
Masaai: amu iyie enkisudoroto ai, iyie ewueji negol nasaru too lmang'ati laainei, oltalet ogol lagilunore ilmang'ati laainei.

English: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu matobiko ti atua olng'obor lino ntarasi! Ee, pee atum ataseriana tiabori inaipuko inono!

English: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
Masaai: Amu itoning'o, Enkai, ilmuma laainei, kinchoo iyie nanu enjung'ore e lelo ooure enkarna ino.

English: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: and his years as many generations.
Masaai: Ntobikoi olaiguanani; metabaiki ilarin lenyena iishoritin pooki!

English: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
Masaai: Meitotonieki ninye olorika le nkitoo ntarasi te dukuya Enkai; irriu enyorrata nauno o esupatisho metorripo ninye!

English: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
Masaai: Naa karany enkisisa e nkarna ino anaake.

English: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
Masaai: Enkai ake eanyu oltau lai te nkitirring'ata; ninye eing'uaa enjeunoto ai.

English: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
Masaai: Ninye ake openy endapidapoi ai naa enjeunoto ai, ninye osempewuet lai, nemaaigusugusieki.

English: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa akenya mbung'ubung'u oltung'ani pee itumutumu aataar pooki te nebo, nitiuu anaa esuntai netaa keurori, anaa olpaashe letaa keurori?

English: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
Masaai: Neitobir ninche pee esulaa ninye aaitadou to lorika lenye. Neshipakino ninche entorroni. Nemayian too nkutukie enye, ore ti atua iltauja lenye nedekisho.

English: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
Masaai: Amu Enkai ake eanyita oltau lai te nkitirring'ata, amu atua ninye etii osiligi lai.

English: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
Masaai: Ninye ake endapidapoi ai naa enjeunoto ai, ninye osempewuet lai, maaigusugusieki nanu.

English: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
Masaai: Enkai etii enkordunoto ai o enkitoo ai; ninye endapidapoi ai, Enkai esarunoto ai.

English: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
Masaai: Esiliga ninye nkatitin pooki lo tung'ana; entabol iltauja linyi te dukuya ninye; Enkai ninye esarunoto te iyiook.

English: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana li abori naa enkijape ake, ore iltung'ana le nkitoo naa elejare; te nejing ninche orrantili ore ninche pooki naa keneneng aalang enkijape.

English: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
Masaai: Misilig enkitorogonyare nimipik osiligi empurrorre; te neponari karsisisho, mipik oltau lino ine.

English: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.
Masaai: Eiroro apa Enkai; atoning'o nanu ena katitin are, nchere Enkai eing'uaa engolon,

English: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
Masaai: naa iyie sii, Olaitoriani, ina nyorrata nauno. Amu ilaaki iyie oltung'ani te risioroto e siaai enye.

English: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
Masaai: Ira iyie Enkai, iyie Enkai ai, iyie nanu aing'oru, iyie eetayie oltau lai enkure; kaiterre nanu te yieunoto ino, atiu anaa oltung'ani te nkop natoyio nemetii enkare.

English: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
Masaai: Neaku, aaing'orua nanu iyie ti atua ine wueji ino sinyati, naing'or engolon ino o enkitoo ino.

English: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
Masaai: Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno, naa eisidai alang enkishui, kaaisis nanu iyie te nkutuk ai.

English: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
Masaai: Naa kaaisis nanu iyie anaa naishu; kailepie nanu nkaik aainei naipot enkarna ino.

English: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
Masaai: Etaraposhe oltau lai te mpiron o te ilata, nikisis enkutuk ai te ng'ida,

English: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
Masaai: te naadamu nanu iyie te ndapash ai, naibirribir mbaa inono airragita kewarie;

English: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
Masaai: amu itaa apa iyie eretoto ai, naa ti abori oloip loo naipuko inono nanu aranyisho te ng'ida.

English: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
Masaai: Iyie eigarakino oltau lai, enkaina ino e tatene naairishu nanu.

English: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ooing'oru pee eidaikie enkishui ai, naa kedoyio aapuo olodo le nkop;

English: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
Masaai: keishoori ninche aapik engolon o lalem, keaku ninche endaa oo mbariak.

English: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
Masaai: Kake keng'idakino olaiguanani Enkai; ore lelo ooinos olmumai te ninye neaku kituaak; amu ore nkutukie e lelo alejak naa keitigiri.

English: Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
Masaai: Toning'o oltoilo lai, le nkilepilep ai, iyie Enkai, tagolie enkishui ai te mbatisho e ilo mang'atinta,

English: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
Masaai: isudoyioki nanu ntung'uayioki ilnukat le ilo torrono, ntung'uayioki mpuot oo laasak loo ntorrok,

English: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:
Masaai: lelo ooitotiu ilng'ejepa lenye anaa lalema, lelo ooing'oru irorei oopi anaa mbaa,

English: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
Masaai: neng'or etii atua ilnukat ilo asipani, neng'or ninye aaluam metii enkuretisho.

English: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
Masaai: Neibung ninche aakurraki nena kitobirat enye torrok, neimaki ninche pee eirragie irresheta loo nkisudorot, edamu aajo, “Aing'ae oidim atoduaa iyiook?

English: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.
Masaai: Kaing'ae oidim aing'oru nkitarruorot ang? Kitadamutua iyiook nikintobir olnukata te ng'eno.” Amu ore endamunoto e atua o ltau le tung'ani naa kegut!

English: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
Masaai: Kake keng'or Enkai ninche te mbae enye, nepiki ninche ilbaa nabo kata.

English: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nkirorot enye, kelo ninye aidaikie ninche; ore pooki oodol ninche neipirripir ilukuny enye.

English: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
Masaai: Netum taa iltung'ana pooki aatureita; nelimu ninche ina nataasa Enkai, nedamu ina nataasa ninye.

English: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
Masaai: Nchoo ilo asipani eng'ida ti atua Olaitoriani, nisaru ninye! Nchoo lelo pooki sidain iltauja menoto enchipai sapuk.

English: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
Masaai: Kinchiaakino enkisisa te Sion, iyie Enkai; naa iyie einosieki ilmuma,

English: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
Masaai: iyie ele oning enkomono! Enitii elotu pooki toki naishu,

English: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
Masaai: te nkaraki ing'ok enye. Te neidimu iyiook nkitarruorot ang, nipalaki iyie iyiook.

English: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo litegelua iyie niyau aitinyiku, pee eton ti atua indung'orot inono! Eikindipakino iyiook te supatisho e nkaji ino, ina aji ino sinyati!

English: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
Masaai: Ore too nkiaasin naaitureisho niwaliki iyie iyiook te nkordunoto, iyie, iyie Enkai Ai e njeunoto ang, iyie osiligi loo wuejitin pooki neeiting'ie enkop, o inaaiposha naalakua;

English: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:
Masaai: laa te ngolon ino intasheyie ildoinyo, irretenita enkidimata ino;

English: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
Masaai: iyie oitirring'ie enkikurrukur oo naaiposha, ina kikurrukur oo lopir lenye, ilo oilepilepi loo ltung'ana;

English: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
Masaai: neaku etureishote lelo oomanya ineelakua te nkop, te nkaraki nkitoduaat inono; nchoo iyie ineelusorie enkakenya o enteipa metabuaku te ng'ida.

English: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
Masaai: Iyie omutan enkop nibukoki enkare, iyie oitubulu oleng; ebore ilo keju le Nkai enkare; iyie oisho ninche enkurma enye, amu neijia iyie ntobira aiko.

English: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
Masaai: Iyie opik ierat lenyena enkare, nintobir anuk ilbaat pooki, nintanana enterit te nkirujuruj, nebulu emayianata.

English: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
Masaai: Nchopoko iyie olari esupatisho ino, ore rrekiei le ngarri ino neitong eilata.

English: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
Masaai: Ore ndaat oo nchoo ti ong'ata neitong, ore ildoinyo nemanita eng'ida,

English: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
Masaai: ore nkong'at naaisiaja neiput nkerrai, neiput enkurma ierat, nebuaku ninche te nebo aarany te ng'ida.

English: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
Masaai: Tabuaku taranyaki Enkai te ng'ida, na kop pooki;

English: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
Masaai: entaranyaki enkitoo e nkarna enye; enchoo ninye enkisisa e nkitoo!

English: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
Masaai: Entiaaki Enkai, “Kebaa eitureisho nkiaasin inono! Naa kitok engolon ino, o metaa kepuonu ilmang'ati linono aaborru te dukuya iyie.

English: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie eserem enkop pooki; nikiranyaki iyie isinkolioitin le nkisisa, nerany enkisisa te nkaraki enkarna ino.”

English: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
Masaai: Wootu entodol inaataasa Enkai: keitureisho nkiaasin enyena ti atua iltung'ana.

English: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
Masaai: Keibelekeny ninye enaiposha aitaa enkop natoyio; nepuo iltung'ana aaim olkeju too nkejek. Te ine iyiook kiting'idakinote ninye,

English: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
Masaai: ilo oitoreisho te nkidimata enye ntarasi, ilo laa nkonyek enyena naaing'or iloshon - mincho lelo ooisero eisis ate.

English: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
Masaai: Esisa Enkai ang, lo oreren, nchoo metoning'ori oltoilo le nkisisa enye,

English: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
Masaai: ilo apa otagolie iyiook te nebo ilooishu, neitu eisho nkejek ang metarrorroto.

English: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
Masaai: Amu itetema iyie iyiook, Enkai, itetema iyie iyiook anaa enkosholai, anaa enkosholai natemi.

English: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
Masaai: Itipika iyie iyiook orreshet; nieniki mpolosi ang olola oiroishi;

English: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
Masaai: nchoo iyie iltung'ana meitunyoi ilukuny ang; kishomo iyiook aaim atua enkima o atua enkare; kake iyaua ake iyie iyiook enkop nalala.

English: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
Masaai: Kalotu nanu atua enkaji ino aata ilasarri oopejori; kaalaaki nanu iyie ilmuma laainei,

English: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
Masaai: apa lairoro nanu te nkutuk ai, naisiligishore apa nanu te nkutuk ai atii enyamali.

English: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
Masaai: Kaaitaiki nanu iyie olasar opejori loo ntokitin naapir, te nebo empuruo o lasar loo lkerra; kaitobir nanu olasar loo loing'ok o nkineji.

English: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
Masaai: Wootu entoning intae pooki ooure Enkai, naa kalimu nanu ina naaitaasa ninye.

English: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
Masaai: Aishiraka nanu ninye abuaku, neisis olng'ejep lai ninye.

English: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
Masaai: Tenaa kaata apa nanu entorroni to ltau lai, anaata maaning nanu Olaitoriani.

English: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
Masaai: Kake esipa aatoning'o nanu Olaitoriani, etoning'o ninye oltoilo le nkomono ai.

English: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitu ninye eany enkomono ai, neitu eiwuang'ie ina nyorrata enye nauno te nanu.

English: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
Masaai: Meing'urrie iyiook Enkai nemayian iyiook neitawang'aki iyiook te nkomom enye,

English: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
Masaai: pee etumi aatayiolo enkoitoi ino te nkop pooki, neyiolouni ina golon ino naitajeusho too loshon pooki.

English: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
Masaai: Nchoo mikisisa iyie iltung'ana, na Ai; nchoo loreren pooki mikisisa iyie!

English: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
Masaai: Nchoo meting'idata loshon nerany te ng'ida, amu nguanare iyie te nkaraki entorroni nirikoo iloshon ootii oriong enkop.

English: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
Masaai: Nchoo loreren mikisisa iyie, na Ai, nchoo loreren pooki mikisisa iyie!

English: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.
Masaai: Etoponayie enkop ilng'anayio lenyena; Ore Enkai, Enkai ang etamayiana iyiook.

English: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
Masaai: Etamayiana iyiook Enkai; nchoo ineeiting'ie enkop pooki metureita ninye!

English: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
Masaai: Nchoo Enkai metudumunye, nchoo meidapashata ilmang'ati lenyena; nchoo lelo ooiba ninye meisika te dukuya ninye.

English: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
Masaai: Ore anaa enakutari empuruo tukutai ninche nkuna neijia; anaa enashola enkapoi te nkima nchoo ilarruok meidaai te dukuya Enkai.

English: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
Masaai: Kake nchoo lelo supati meting'idata; nchoo ninche meting'idata te dukuya Enkai; nchoo ninche metishipata oleng!

English: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani, entarany enkisisa e nkarna enye; elepie osinkolio entaranyaki ninye, ilo olo te shumata nkatampo; ore enkarna enye naa Olaitoriani, enting'idata te dukuya ninye!

English: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Masaai: Menye le lelo okishin, naa olamitunoni loo nkolia, Enkai te ine wueji enye sinyati.

English: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
Masaai: Enkai naisho ilo lemeeta ang ewueji nemany, nerikoo lelo ooena metudupoto; kake ore lelo maisero netoni te nkop natoyio.

English: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, ore apa pee ilo arikoo iltungana linono, ore apa pee ilo iyie aim olpurkel,

English: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
Masaai: neikirikira enkop, neshau shumata enkare, te ine netii Enkai; eikirikire oldoinyo le Sinai te dukuya Enkai, ina Ai e Israel.

English: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
Masaai: Irriwua iyie enchan kitok, Enkai, nintagol enjung'ore ino enaurate;

English: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
Masaai: netum nkerra inono emanyisho ti atua ninye; te supatisho ino, na Ai, intoti iyie ilaisinak.

English: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
Masaai: Eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata; eikitok olorora le lelo oonap ilomon supati:

English: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
Masaai: “Ore laiguanak loo njorin, neilanyisho aaisik!” Ore nkituaak naaing'uari ti ang neor nena yarunot

English: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
Masaai: ore hoo neirrag ninche ti atua imuatat, eikununo inaipuko enye anaa ine nturkulu naamura te nkosholai, ore nkopir enye neiyia anaa sahabu nanyori.

English: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
Masaai: Ore te neidapash olmagilani lelo aiguanak, nedoiki empaso Salmon.

English: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
Masaai: Lo doinyo le Nkai, lo doinyo le Bashan; lo doinyo loo mowuarak kumok, lo doinyo le Bashan!

English: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell in it for ever.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee ing'or to lom, lo doinyo loo rruka kumok, ilo doinyo oyieu Enkai neitaa emanyisho enye, ee, ine nelo Olaitoriani abikie ntarasi?

English: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
Masaai: Too ngarrin oo mbartan magil, nkalifuni tomon katitin are, nkalifuni o nkalifuni, apa eeunye Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sinai, nelotu atua ine wueji sinyati.

English: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
Masaai: Ilepa iyie alo shumata oleng, nirik lelo yarunot araya, ning'amaa nkishorot too ltung'ana, ning'amaa sii ine lelo torrok, pee etum Olaitoriani Enkai atobiko te ine.

English: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, laa ninye onap iyiook anaake; Enkai ninye enjeunoto ang.

English: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.
Masaai: Enkai ang ninye Enkai e njeunoto; naa eno Laitoriani, Enkai, enkordunoto te keeya.

English: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
Masaai: Kepurd Enkai ilukuny oo lmang'ati lenyena, o enkopiyia naju e nkitoo e ilo olo too nkoitoi enyena torrok.
