English: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
Masaai: Etejo Olaitoriani, “Karrinyu nanu ninche aitung'uaa Bashan, Karrinyu nanu ninche aitung'uaa ineegut e naiposha,

English: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
Masaai: pee itum iyie aitukuo nkejek inono to sarge, ore ilng'ejepa loo ldiein linono netum erubata enye te lelo mang'ati.”

English: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
Masaai: Edolitae ilotot inono, iyie Enkai, nena gilakinot e Nkai ai, Olaiguanani lai, elo atua ewueji sinyati -

English: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
Masaai: etii ilaranyak dukuya, netii ilaoshok loo ntampurini siadi, ore erishata enye netii ntoyie naakut ndulen:

English: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
Masaai: “Meisisi Olaitoriani ti atua eumata kitok, ee, iyie, Olaitoriani, amu iyie entalipa e Israel!”

English: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
Masaai: Etii Benchamen, ilo oti te ninye, dukuya, netii lelo kituaak le Yuda iwuejitin enye, o lelo kituaak le Sebulon o lelo le Naftali.

English: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, mpotu enkidimata ino; ntodolu engolon ino, iyie Enkai, amu iyie apa oitaasa iyiook ene nking'asia.

English: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
Masaai: Te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai te Yerusalem, te ine kiyaki iyie ilaiguanak nkishorot.

English: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
Masaai: Tabuaaki iyie nena ng'uesi naatii atua enarau, o ina luaata oo loing'ok natii te nebo ilasho le tung'ana. Nkirikirie tiabori nkejek inono lelo oong'uar kodi; ndapasha lelo oreren ooshipakino olarrabal.

English: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
Masaai: Nchoo meyauni osuyai te Misiri; nchoo Etiopia metasioki aitorioki Enkai nkaik enyena.

English: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
Masaai: Entaranyaki Enkai na kitoriat pooki e nkop; entaranyaki Olaitoriani enkisisa,

English: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
Masaai: ninye ilo okedito nkatampo te keper, ina keper e apa moitie; ng'ura, neirriu ninye oltoilo lenye, ilo toilo lenye magilani.

English: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
Masaai: Embalunye engolon e Nkai, ilo otii enkidimata enye shumata Israel, netii engolon enye atua nkatampo.

English: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
Masaai: Keitureisho Enkai ti atua ine wueji enye sinyati, ina Ai e Israel, neisho ninye engolon o enkidimata iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.
Masaai: Ntajeuoki nanu, iyie Enkai! Amu aatabaikitia nkariak emurt.

English: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
Masaai: Aimiso nanu ti atua esarng'ab te ine nemetii ewueji napik enkeju; atijing'a nanu nkariak naagut, naaya nanu olairrag le nkare.

English: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
Masaai: Anaure nanu te nkishirata ai; aatirridate ilgoso. Neiliilaitie nkonyek aainei, aanyita Enkai ai.

English: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, being mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored that which I took not away.
Masaai: Eikumok aalang ilpapit le ndukuya ai lelo laaiba nanu pesho metii emporeet; eimagil lelo laaidim nanu aaidaikie, lelo laarasaki nanu te lejare. Amaa, ina neitu nanu apurroo, kaaitalaki nanu matorrinyo taata?

English: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, iyiolo iyie emodai ai; ore ntorrok nataasa, meisudoro te iyie.

English: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
Masaai: Mincho lelo likisilig iyie meitukurruni te nkaraki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani; mincho lelo liking'oru iyie etum enkurruna te nkaraki nanu, iyie Enkai e Israel.

English: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
Masaai: Amu te nkaraki iyie pee anoto esulare, neiputa enkurruna enkomom ai.

English: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
Masaai: Atotiwuo nanu anaa oltung'ani omoni too lalashera laainei, naaku ole boo too nkera e yieyio.

English: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
Masaai: Amu aainosa nanu olom te nkaraki enkaji ino, ore nena sukenyat e lelo likisukeny iyie, naatadoikitio nanu.

English: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
Masaai: Te naitobor nanu oltau lai te mpukoroto, neaku ina enkurruna.

English: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
Masaai: Te naitaa nanu ilkuniyiani nkilani aainei, naaku nanu entoki naimakini te ninche.

English: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.
Masaai: Etaa nanu ederrie lelo ootoni te kishomi, netaa nanu eokore ilamerak.

English: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, naa iyie airriwaki enkomono ai, Olaitoriani. Ore te nkata nang'amaroyu, iyie Enkai, tang'amayioki nanu te ina nyorrata ino nauno.

English: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
Masaai: Te ina retoto ino naisiligunoyu tokorduaki nanu maimis ti atua esarng'ab; nchooki nanu manoto enkordunoto too lmang'ati laainei, o too nkariak naagut.

English: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
Masaai: Mikincho nanu maawa oloirrag le nkare, anaa aaijoo nanu ina guton, anaa aagamaa engumoto.

English: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
Masaai: Tawalikiaki nanu, Olaitoriani, amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno naa eisidai; ore te risioroto o lng'ur lino, mbelekenyunye enatii nanu.

English: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
Masaai: Misudoo enkomom ino to sinka lino; amu atii nanu atua osina, tasioki tawalikiaki nanu.

English: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
Masaai: Tataanikiaki nanu, tokorduaki nanu, talakuaki nanu, te nkaraki ilmang'ati laainei!

English: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie esulare ai, o esulare ai o enkurruna ai; iyiolo iyie ilmang'ati laainei pooki.

English: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; and for comforters, but I found none.
Masaai: Etigila imorot oltau lai, neaku atapalari nanu, naing'oru olaaing'urrie, kake metii obo; naing'oru olaaitagol oshoke, kake eito nanu atum obo.

English: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
Masaai: Aaishoo ninche esayiet aaitaa endaa, ore aata enkure naaisho ninche siki.

English: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.
Masaai: Nchoo emesa enye te dukuya ninche metaa orreshet; nchoo lelo siruai lenye loo lasarri metaa entoki narruesh ninche.

English: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
Masaai: Nchoo meitamodoki nkonyek enye pee medolisho; neikirikira mpolosi enye anaake.

English: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
Masaai: Tubukoki engoro ino shumata ninche, nincho ina goro ino nayupuyup metumurutu ninche.

English: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
Masaai: Metomijoono enkang enye, metaa metumi ae kata olojing ilng'oborri lenye.

English: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
Masaai: Amu keisilisil ninche ilo litoosho, o ilo litipika iyie olbae, neponiki ninche ninye emion oleng.

English: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
Masaai: Toponiki ninche nkitamiot te shumata nkitamiot; metaa metum ae kata ninche elaaroto te iyie.

English: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
Masaai: Nchoo metujuti nkarn enye aaiwuang'ie ti atua embuku oo looishu; nchoo metaa meigeri ninche te nebo lelo supati.

English: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
Masaai: Kake aata nanu osina naata emion; nchoo enjeunoto ino, iyie Enkai maatudumu nanu ailepunye!

English: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu enkarna e Nkai to sinkolio; narrep nanu ninye te nkishoroto e nashe.

English: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
Masaai: Keitiship ena Olaitoriani alang olkiteng anaa oloing'oni loo mowuarak neeta loisotok.

English: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
Masaai: Nchoo ilo oitorogonyaki metoduaa ena neng'idayu, ore intae lelo ooing'oru Enkai, enchoo epiu iltauja linyi.

English: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
Masaai: Amu kening Olaitoriani ilo oata enyamali nemerikino lelo lenyena ooena.

English: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
Masaai: Nchoo shumata o enkop meisisa ninye, o enaiposha o pooki toki naatii atua.

English: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
Masaai: Amu keitajeu Enkai Sion, neigil ashetu nkanas e Yuda; nepuo isinkan lenyena aamany ine, neya ine;

English: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
Masaai: ore nena kera oo sinkan lenyena naa kejung ine, ore lelo oonyor enkarna enye nepuo aamany ine.

English: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
Masaai: Tonyorrai iyie Enkai, tokorduaki nanu! Olaitoriani, tasioki taretuoki nanu!

English: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
Masaai: Nchoo metukurru nemilo lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai! Nchoo meibelekenyi ninche nesuli, lelo ooyieu naainyal!

English: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
Masaai: Nchoo meing'asiata ninche te nkaraki enkurruna enye, lelo oojo, “Alda, Alda!”

English: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo pooki liking'oru iyie meting'idata neshipa ti atua iyie! Nchoo lelo pooki oonyor enjeunoto ino metejo ntarasi, “Eikitok Enkai!”

English: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
Masaai: Kake ara nanu aisinani namena; Tasieku enatii, iyie Enkai! Iyie eretoto ai naa iyie likikordu; Olaitoriani, mimutie!

English: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
Masaai: Iyie nanu asaru, Olaitoriani; mikincho ae kata nanu maaitukurruni!

English: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
Masaai: Ore te supatisho ino tokorduaki nanu nikintajeu; irrugokoki enkiok ino, nikintajeu nanu!

English: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.
Masaai: Taa iyie te nanu endapidapoi e sarunoto, osempewuet ogol laaitajeu nanu, amu ira iyie endapidapoi ai nira osempewuet lai.

English: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu na Enkai ai te nkaina e ilo torrono, te nkibung'ata e ilo ogogong.

English: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
Masaai: Amu ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira osiligi lai, iyie enkisiligata ai, Olaitoriani, ebaiki kitisho ai.

English: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.
Masaai: Iyie nanu aigarakine ebaiki apa pee aaini, iyie apa likintayio nanu te nkoshoke e yieyio. Iyie nanu aaisis anaake.

English: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
Masaai: Atotiuo nanu anaa enking'asia too lkumok, kake ira iyie esarunoto ai nagol.

English: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.
Masaai: Eiputa enkutuk ai enkisisa ino, o enkitoo ino endama pooki.

English: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
Masaai: Mikinturraa nanu te nkata e moruao; mikinturaa nanu te neishunye engolon ai.

English: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
Masaai: Amu nanu eimaki ilmang'ati laainei, ore lelo ooing'oru enkishui ai neiguana te nebo,

English: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Eiturrayie Enkai ninye; enepu embung'a ninye, amu meetae olokordu ninye.”

English: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, mikilam iyie nanu; iyie Enkai, tasioki taretuoki nanu!

English: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
Masaai: Nchoo meitukurruni lelo aitang'orok laainei nemuti; meitoipo ninche enkurruna o esulare, lelo ooing'oru pee aainyal.

English: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
Masaai: Kake kaaisilig nanu iyie anaake, naa kaaisis akenya o akenya.

English: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
Masaai: Neibalunye enkutuk ai nena kiaasin inono supati, nena kiaasin inono e njeunoto endama pooki, amu etogiroitie esiana enye eng'eno ai.

English: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.
Masaai: Too nkiasin magil o Laitoriani nanu alotu, naa kaaisis nanu esupatisho ino, esupatisho ino ake.

English: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
Masaai: Na Ai, ore ebaiki kitisho ai kinteng'ena iyie nanu, neton ake aibalunye nkiasin inono e nking'asia.

English: Now also when I am old and greyheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto this generation, and thy power to every one that is to come.
Masaai: Neaku, ore ninye te moruao o te naaiborru endukuya, na Ai, mikintorraa nanu, o metaba anaa naibalunye enkidimata ino, too ishoritin pooki naapuonu.

English: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!
Masaai: Ore engolon ino o esupatisho ino, na Ai, nebaiki keper oleng. Iyie otaasa mbaa sapuki, na Ai, kaing'ae likinyaanyukie?

English: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
Masaai: Iyie likintoduaa nanu isinaitin kumok, iyie likintopiu nanu; ore te nguton e nkop naa eikilepunye iyie.

English: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
Masaai: Iponaa iyie enkanyit ai, nikintoki nanu aitagol oshoke.

English: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Kaaigil nanu aisis iyie te nkauo oo sinkolioitin te nkaraki esupatisho ino, na Ai ai, kaaranyaki nanu arrep to lwulul loo usin, iyie Lo Sinyati le Israel.

English: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
Masaai: Kabuaku te nkutuk ai te ng'ida, te naaranyaki nanu isinkolioitin le nkisisa, neng'idayu sii oltau lai, ilo apa litokordua.

English: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
Masaai: Neimaki olng'ejep lai ina retoto ino e supatisho, endama pooki, amu eitukurruaki ninche nesuli, lelo apa ooing'oru pee aainyal.

English: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
Masaai: Nchoo olaiguanani esipata ino, na Ai, nincho esupatisho ino ilo le nkaji e nkitoo!

English: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye meiguanaki iltung'ana linono te supatisho, neiguanaki lelo aisinak te sipata!

English: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
Masaai: Nchoo enkop meitumurru dupoto, neyau ndoinyo esupatisho!

English: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
Masaai: Metomitu ninye ewalata e lelo aisinak le tung'ana, nchoo enkordunoto lelo oomena, nirrar ilo oitorogonyisho!

English: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
Masaai: Metobikoi ninye anaa enkolong, metobikoi ninye nkolong'i nabaa anaa ino lapa, ti atua iishoritin pooki.

English: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
Masaai: Metotiuo ninye anaa enchan nashaiki nkujit naatudung'oki, netiu anaa enkoirujuruji naitipitipaki enkop.

English: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
Masaai: Meibulai esupatisho too nkolong'i enyena, metuunoyu eseriani nkolong'i naabaa anaa inaabik olapa.

English: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Meitoria ninye ebaiki enaiposha o metabaiki enkae aiposha, neitoreisho ebaiki Olkeju le Farite o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop!

English: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
Masaai: Meirrugoto ilmang'ati lenyena te dukuya ninye, metamejo ilmang'ati lenyena enterit!

English: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
Masaai: Meitaiki ilaiguanak le Tarshishi o lelo loo lepolosi ninye nkishorot, nchoo meyau ilaiguanak le Sheba o Seba nkishorot!

English: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
Masaai: Metabatatata ilaiguanak pooki te dukuya ninye, nchoo meisiaaiyia iloshon pooki ninye.

English: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
Masaai: Amu kekordu ninye ilo onyamal te neishiraki, neretu ilo aisinani o ilo lemeeta olaretoni.

English: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
Masaai: Keing'urrie ninye ilo oshal nemena, neitajeu enkishui e lelo oonyamal.

English: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
Masaai: Kekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkitorogonyata o entorroni; naa eikirotet osarge lenye too nkonyek enyena.

English: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
Masaai: Metobikoi ninye eishu, nchoo meyakini ninye sahabu e Sheba! Nchoo metoomonokini ninye anaake, meetu imayianat shumata ninye nkatitin pooki!

English: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
Masaai: Meiputa endaa enkop; nchoo meipiripiro ninye te nchumata oldoinyo; metotiutu ilng'anayio lenyena anaa Lebanon; naa nchoo ebul iltung'ana too nkanas aabayu anaa nkujit e ong'ata.

English: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
Masaai: Metobikoi enkarna enye ntarasi, metaa ning'oti enkarna enye anaa enkolong! nchoo metamayiana iltung'ana ate te ninye, neipot iloshon pooki ninye aajo olomayiana!

English: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, laa ninye ake oas mbaa e nking'asia.

English: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
Masaai: Meisisi ina arna enye nabore olng'ur ntarasi; meiputa enkitoo enye enkop pooki! Esai, Esai!

English: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
Masaai: Enkiting'oto e nkomono e Daudi, olayioni le Yese.

English: Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.
Masaai: Esipa eisupat Enkai te ilo oitoriori nkoitoi enyena, te lelo sidain iltauja.

English: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
Masaai: Kake ore ti alo nanu eyieu errorro nkejek aainei, eyieu eideketari nkejek aainei.

English: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
Masaai: Amu aata nanu olom te lelo ooitokoos, ina kata pee adol nanu dupoto e lelo arruok.

English: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
Masaai: Amu meeta ninche emion, negol naa sidain iseseni lenye.

English: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
Masaai: Meeta ninche enyamali anaa enaata iltung'ana, nemeitamei ninche anaa ilkulikae tung'ana.

English: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them as a garment.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, olwuasa ninye osaei lenye le murt, olarrabal oimulumul ninche anaa olkila.

English: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
Masaai: Etejieita nkonyek enye te mpiron, netulusoitie mbaa enye aalang iltauja lenye.

English: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
Masaai: Neikordodisho ninche, neiro mbaa torrok; ore te nkitokoos neiro mbaa naaitorogonyie ilkulikae.

English: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
Masaai: Nebol ninche nkutukie enye aaing'orie shumata, neidapashaki ilng'ejepa lenye enkop.

English: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neibelekenya iltung'ana aaisis ninche; nemetumie ninche entioto.

English: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Kaji eiko Enkai te neyiolou? Keeta eng'eno Ilo otii Shumata Aisul?”

English: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
Masaai: Ng'ura, iltung'ana torrok kulo; neisikarra ninche anaake, neponari ninche te karsisisho.

English: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
Masaai: Pesho ake nanu aitisinya oltau lai, naituku nkaik aainei te sinyatisho.

English: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
Masaai: Amu ore endama pooki naatooshoki nanu, naaitamei nkakeny pooki.

English: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of thy children.
Masaai: Naa te najo nanu, “Kalimu kuna,” anaata maaku asipani te ishoi oo nkera aainei.

English: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
Masaai: Naa te nadamu nanu ajo ayiolou kuna, naa enyamali te nanu.

English: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
Masaai: Ore ake pee alo atua ewueji sinyati e Nkai, namusu taa enkiting'oto enye.

English: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
Masaai: Esipa itipika iyie ninche iwuejitin neeideket; nchoo iyie ninche metabatatata aaidak.

English: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
Masaai: Kaji eikunakaki ninche enkidaaroto nabo kata, eishieki ninche tukul te nkiputukuny.

English: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
Masaai: Etiu ninche anaa enkidetidet te neinyototo oltung'ani, te nidumunye iyie, Olaitoriani, niwuang'ie ina golon enye.

English: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
Masaai: Te netum oltau lai emion, te neitagori oltau lai,

English: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.
Masaai: naa kamoda apa nanu mayiolo toki, natiu apa nanu anaa eng'ues ti alo iyie.

English: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia natii nanu te nebo iyie; kimbung'a iyie enkaina ai e tatene.

English: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
Masaai: Iyie likitorikoyie nanu te nkiguana ino, ore te siadi niking'amaa nanu te nkitoo ino.

English: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
Masaai: Kaing'ae nanu aata te keper leme iyie? Nemetii ai toki natii oriong enkop nang'uar nanu naadutie.

English: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
Masaai: Keidim inkiri osesen lai o ltau lai aaishunye, kake Enkai e ngolon oltau lai naa erubata ai ntarasi.

English: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ore lelo likilamita iyie naa keidak; inting'ie iyie lelo arruok ti alo iyie.

English: But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu eisidai te nataaniki Enkai; aitaa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai esarunoto ai, pee atum atolimu isiaaitin inono pooki.

English: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
Masaai: Na Ai, kainyoo iyie pee nturraa iyiook ntarasi? Kainyoo pee epuru engoro ino too ntare e luaata ino?

English: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
Masaai: Tadamu olturrur lino apa litegelaka kewan moitie, ilo apa litokordua pee eaku enjung'ore ino! Tadamu oldoinyo le Sion apa litobikie.

English: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
Masaai: Ntorioki iroruat inono iwuejitin neeidaa; einyala olmang'atinta pooki toki te wueji ino sinyati!

English: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
Masaai: Eikurrukurro ilmang'ati linono te mpolos e ine wueji sinyati; neun ninche inankan enye pee eaku olmonekie lenye le nkisulata.

English: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
Masaai: Ore te njing'et e shumata nedung'udung ninche nkeenta too ntoluo.

English: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
Masaai: Ore nena keek naagueta negiligil too nyuntui.

English: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
Masaai: Nepejoo ninche ine wueji ino sinyati, nepik olduruk ine wueji ino sinyati o metabaiki enkop.

English: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
Masaai: nejo ninche maate, “Eikimut iyiook ninche katukul;” etapejoitie ninche iwuejitin pooki e Nkai neetumoreki ti atua ena kop.

English: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
Masaai: Meekure iyiook kiaata ilmonek lang, meekure eetae oloiboni hoo obo, nemeetae hoo obo ti atua iyiook oyiolo ajo kenkata nabaa.

English: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
Masaai: Ke nkata nabaa, Olaitoriani, eikoroj iyiook olmang'atinta? Kesukeny olmang'atinta enkarna ino ntarasi?

English: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee inunuk enkaina ino, kainyoo iyie pee ipik enkaina ino olgoo?

English: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
Masaai: Ore eyia, Enkai, Olaitoriani lai naa oliapa, neitobir ninye enjeunoto te mpolos e nkop.

English: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
Masaai: Iyie otooro enaiposha te nkidimata ino; itadanya iyie endukuya o lasurai ti atua nkariak.

English: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
Masaai: Itupurda iyie ilukuny e Lefitan, nincho iyie ninye ing'uesi e ntim meitaa endaa.

English: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
Masaai: Iyie oipirua nkonyek oo nkariak o erat; iyie oitoyio nkonyek oo nkariak naaruko.

English: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
Masaai: Enino endama naa enino enkewarie; iyie oitobira ewang'an o enkolong.

English: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
Masaai: Iyie otipika ilpolosien pooki le nkop; iyie oitobira enkata e nkirowuaj o enkata e nkirobi.

English: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
Masaai: Tadamu ena, Olaitoriani, ng'ura olmang'atinta eikorojisho, ore iltung'ana oomoda nesukeny enkarna ino.

English: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
Masaai: Minchooyo oltau le ina turkuluo ino aisho ing'uesi e ntim; mincho kirikino enkishui e ilo tung'ani lino aisinani ntarasi.

English: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
Masaai: Tishilai olning'o lino; amu ore iwuejitin neemisimis e nkop nebore imanyishoritin e nkarruoisho.

English: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
Masaai: Mincho ilo oitorogonyaki meitukurruni, nchoo ilo aisinani omena meisisa enkarna ino.

English: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
Masaai: Tudumunye, Na Ai, tomitu kewan; tadamu ena nikinkordod ilo omoda endama pooki!

English: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
Masaai: Mincho kirikino oltoilo loo lmang'ati linono, ilo odoo loo nchankarri oilep anaake.

English: Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
Masaai: Kincho iyiook iyie enashe, Enkai, kinchoru enashe; kimpot iyiook enkarna ino nikinken nkiaasin inono e nking'asia.

English: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata nategeluaki, naa kaiguana nanu too sipat.

English: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
Masaai: Te neikirikira enkop o lelo pooki oomanya, nanu ilo oitasheyie ing'apeta enyena.

English: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
Masaai: Atiaaka nanu ilo owasa, “Mintoki awuasa,” najoki ilo torrono, “Midumu emowuo;

English: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
Masaai: mishum iyie emowuo ino ailepunye, anaa iro imolesh emurt.”

English: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
Masaai: Amu mme oloo saen, neme oloo ntoluo, neme ong'ata enkilepata;

English: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
Masaai: kake Enkai naiguana te sipata; neitadou obo neilepunye olikae.

English: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
Masaai: Amu enkaina o Laitoriani etii enkikompe, etii enaisho naitokitok naing'oling'olaki aaitobiraki, nepiku ninye, neok lelo aarruok pooki.

English: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Kake kang'ida nanu ntarasi, karanyaki enkisisa e Nkai e Yakobo.

English: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
Masaai: Ore nena mowuarak pooki e ilo torrono naa kedung'oo ninye, ore mowuarak e ilo supat naa keilepieki.

English: In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.
Masaai: Keyioloi Enkai ti atua Yuda, eikitok enkarna enye ti atua Israel.

English: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
Masaai: Neteshetaki emanyisho enye te Salem, ewueji enye nebikie te Sion.

English: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
Masaai: Te ine wueji etigila ninye mbaa, o elong'o, o lalem, o masaa o larrabal.

English: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
Masaai: Ira iyie kitok, niata enkishiaa, alang lelo doinyo loo ntarasi.

English: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
Masaai: Ore lelo lenye oogol tauja, netooruoki pooki naata, neirragaitie ninche aaye; ore lelo tung'ana pooki lo larrabal, meidim aataasishore nkaik enye.

English: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
Masaai: Ore te nkisikong'ata ino, Na Ai e Yakobo, neirrag aaye pokira, olakedoni o embarta.

English: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
Masaai: Kake, ore iyie, naa intoreisho, kaing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya iyie te nedumunye ngoro ino nabo kata.

English: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
Masaai: Ore itii keper nidung enkiguana ino, neureishoyu enkop neitirring'a,

English: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
Masaai: ena kata edumunye Enkai aitobir enkiguana, pee eitajeu lelo pooki ooitorogonyaki te nkop.

English: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
Masaai: Esipa eikisis iyie engoro e tung'ani; ore ilo pisiai le ngoro nien anaa enkimeita.

English: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
Masaai: Entobira ilmuma linyi to Laitoriani Enkai inyi, nintabayaya ninche; nchoo lelo pooki oomanita ninche meyau nkishorot aayaki ilo ourei,

English: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
Masaai: naa kedung ninye iltauja le lelo kituaak, ilo laa ninye eure ilaiguanak pooki le nkop.

English: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
Masaai: Aishiraka nanu Olaitoriani te mbuakunoto nabuaki Enkai pee aatum atoning'o nanu.

English: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e ng'olikinoto ai, naing'oru nanu Olaitoriani; ore te ina kewarie neitoriori enkaina ai menauru, neany oltau lai eitigiri.

English: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
Masaai: Kadamu nanu Enkai, naisina; naibirribir neiterre oltau lai.

English: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
Masaai: Iyie obol nkonyek aainei pee meikeno; atanyamala nanu neaku maidim airoro.

English: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
Masaai: Atadamua nanu nkolong'i e apa, nadamu ilarin liapa moitie.

English: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
Masaai: Naibirribir to ltau lai kewarie: nalimana adamisho to ltau lai.

English: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
Masaai: “Amaa, keiturraa iyiook Olaitoriani ntarasi, nemeitoki aata esupatisho katukul?

English: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
Masaai: Keishunye enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi? Keeuo enkiting'oto oo nkisiligat enyena nkatitin pooki?

English: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
Masaai: Ketorikine Olaitoriani olng'ur? Keibooyie ninye olng'ur lenye te ngoro enye?”

English: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Osina lai ele, ore enkaina e tatene e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul neibelekenye.”

English: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
Masaai: Kapik nanu ndamunot aainei nena kiaasin e nking'asia o Laitoriani; ee, kadamu nanu nena apa e nking'asia nitaasa.

English: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
Masaai: Kadamu nanu isiaaitin inono pooki, naing'asia te nena kiasin magil.

English: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
Masaai: Kesinya enkoitoi ino, Olaitoriani, kaa ai kitok anaa Enkai ang?

English: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai naas ine nking'asia, naa iyie oibalunye emagilanisho ino ti atua iloreren.

English: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie otokordua iltung'ana te nkaina ino, lelo ayiok le Yakobo o Yosef.

English: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
Masaai: Ore ake pee kidol iyie nkariak, Olaitoriani, ore ake pee kidol iyie nkariak, neureishoyu ninche, ee, neikirikira enguton.

English: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
Masaai: Nebuku nkatampo enkare; neitayu oloing'ang'e enkikurrukur; neimerlel mbaa inono te pooki shoto.

English: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
Masaai: Etii oltoilo le ndarata ino atua oleimua; ore nkiwuang'at inono neitawang enkop; neikirikira enkop, neigirigiro.

English: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
Masaai: Netii apa enkoitoi ino atua enaiposha, neim enkoitoi ino atua inkariak kumok; nemelioo sii iroruat inono.

English: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Masaai: Iyie otorikoyie iltung'ana linono anaa eluaata oo ntare, te nkaina e Musa o Aron.

English: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Enchoru nkiyiaa lo tung'ana laainei te nkiteng'enare ai; errugu nkiyiaa inyi too rorei le nkutuk ai!

English: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
Masaai: Kabol nanu enkutuk ai te nkitanyaanyukoto, nalimu nkirorot musan e apa,

English: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
Masaai: ntokitin apa nikitoning'o nikiyiolou, nena apa naatolikitio iyiook loo papa.

English: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
Masaai: Mikisudorie iyiook nkera enye, kake eikiliki iishoritin naapuonu, nena kiasin kituaak o Laitoriani o enkidimata enye, o nena e nking'asia apa naataasa ninye.

English: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
Masaai: Eteshetua ninye shakenisho ti atua Yakobo, negelu enkitanapata ti atua Israel, ina apa naitanapa loo papa pee eiteng'en nkera enye;

English: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
Masaai: pee etum eishoi nasuju aaitayiolo ninche nena kera neton meino, nedumunye ninche aaliki nkera enye,

English: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
Masaai: pee etum ninche aatipik osiligi lenye Enkai, nemerikino isiaaitin e Nkai, kake pee eibung nkitanapat enyena;

English: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
Masaai: nemetiu sii anaa loo menye, ilo porror apa ogolong'u torrono, ilo porror apa lemeuno iltauja lenye, ore enkishui enye meisiligayu te Nkai.

English: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Efraim ootanapate too nkai, neibelekenya te nkolong o larrabal.

English: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
Masaai: Eitu ninche eibung olning'o le Nkai, kake etanyaita epuo te risioroto e nkitanapata enye.

English: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
Masaai: Nerikino ninche ina nataasa ninye, o ina apa e nking'asia naitoduaa ninye ninche.

English: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
Masaai: Ore apa too nkonyek oo loo menye neas ninye enenking'asia, tiatua enkop e Misiri, ti ong'ata e Sion.

English: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
Masaai: Etooro ninye enaiposha neisho ninche meima atua, neisho enkare meturupayu anaa olkiu.

English: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
Masaai: Ore dama nerikoo ninye ninche te nkatampoi, naa ore kewarie pooki nerikoo ninche te wang'an kitok.

English: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
Masaai: Neiper ninye ndapidapo to lpurkel, neisho ninche metooko enkare sapuk naba anaa eno lchorro.

English: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
Masaai: Neisho ninye nchorroi oo nkariak metupuku te ndapidapoi, neisho enkare meturukoyu anaa olkeju.

English: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, netaasa ninche ing'ok oleng ti alo ninye, negolong'aki apa ninche Ilo otii Shumata Aisul to lpurkel.

English: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
Masaai: Netem ninche Enkai too ltauja lenye, eikilikuanu endaa too ng'uarrat enye.

English: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
Masaai: Neiro ninche entorroni ti alo Enkai, ejo, “Keidim Enkai aisalaashaki iyiook emesa tene tiong'ota.

English: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
Masaai: Etoosho ninye endapidapoi nerukunye enkare, neruko ilkejek aadooyo. Keidim sii ninye aishoru imukateni, anaa eisho iltung'ana lenyena nkiri?”

English: Therefore the LORD heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki etoning'o ake Olaitoriani ina neiput engoro; neyupuyupieki engoro metigilunore Yakobo, neitashe engoro enye te shumata Israel;

English: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:
Masaai: enkaraki nemeeta ninche enkirukoto te Nkai, neitu eisilig ina golon enye naitajeusho.

English: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
Masaai: Ore ake eyia eitanapa ninye nkatampo te shumata, nebol ildirishani le keper;

English: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
Masaai: neitashaiki ninye ninche mana pee einos, neisho ninche enkurma e shumata.

English: Man did eat angels' food: he sent them meat to the full.
Masaai: Neinos tung'ani endaa oo lmalaika, neirriwaki Enkai ninche endaa te nkumoi.

English: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye olkutati lo loo saen metukutu te keper, ore te ngolong enye nerikoo osiwuo le kopikop;

English: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
Masaai: neshau nkiri te shumata ninche anaa enterit, ntaritik naata naipuko naaba anaa osinyai loo naiposha;

English: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
Masaai: neisho ninye ninche metadoiki empolos oo lng'oborri lenye, te manaroto pooki e manyisho enye.

English: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
Masaai: Neinos ninche neraposho oleng, amu eishoo ninye ninche ina natang'uarra.

English: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
Masaai: Kake ore eton eitu eisho ninche ing'uarrat enye, eton etii ina daa nkutukie enye,

English: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.
Masaai: nedumakino engoro o Laitoriani ninche, near ninye metuata lelo lenye oogol aaisul, neirragarie lelo gelunot le Israel.

English: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
Masaai: Ore ake etii kuna pooki neton ake eas ninche ing'ok; ore hoo netii nena baa enyena e nking'asia eitu ninche eiruk.

English: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neishie ninye nkolong'i enye anaa enkiyang'et, neishie ilarin lenye te nkuretisho.

English: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ear ninye ninche metuata, neing'oru ninche ninye; neirridu ninche neing'oru Enkai oleng.

English: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.
Masaai: Nedamu ninche aajo Enkai endapidapoi enye Enkai natii shumata aisul olalakunoni lenye.

English: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
Masaai: Kake eikoroja ninche ninye too nkutukie enye, nelej ninche ninye too lng'ejepa lenye.

English: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
Masaai: Meuno iltauja lenye te ninye, medede ninche to lning'o lenye.

English: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia te nkaraki olng'ur lenye, etapalaka nkitarruorot enye, neitu ninye eidaikie ninche; neibooyo ninye engoro enye nkatitin pooki, neitu ninye eputu engoro enye pooki.

English: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
Masaai: Nedamu ninye ajo iseseni ake ninche, enkijape naloito nemeigil arrinyunye.

English: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
Masaai: Ae katitin aja apa etogolong'akita ninche ninye ti ong'ata, neitagor ninye to lpurkel!

English: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Etetema ninche ninye aaigiligil, neitagor ninche ilo Sinyati le Israel.

English: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
Masaai: Eitu ninche epik ndamunot enye engolon enye, neitu edamu ina olong apa naitajeuo ninye ninche too lmang'ati lenye;

English: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
Masaai: ina kata apa pee eas ninye nkitoduaat enyena te Misiri, o mbaa enyena e nking'asia naataasa ti ong'ata e Sion.

English: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
Masaai: Eibelekenya ninye ilkejek lenye aitaa osarge, pee meitoki ninche aaok nena Shorroi enye.

English: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
Masaai: Neirriwaki ninye ninche emus oo lojong'a ooinosa ninche, o ntuaan naa ninche naaidaikie ninche.

English: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye endaa enye meinosa olkurto, neisho ilng'anayio le siaai enye meinosa olmaati.

English: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
Masaai: Neinyal ninye isabibu lenye te nchan oo soito, near iretet lenye te nkirobi.

English: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
Masaai: Neisho nkishu enye metaara enchan oo soito, near nkerrai enye endarata.

English: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
Masaai: Neitadoiki ninye ninche ina pijan e ngoro enye, o engoro, o empushuna, o sina, te nebo entukus oo lmalaika ooidaikie ninche.

English: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
Masaai: Neitobir ninye enkoitoi te nkaraki engoro enye; eitu ninye emitiki ninche metuata, kake eishoo ninye enkishui enye olmeitai.

English: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
Masaai: Near ninye metuata lelo kikaunot pooki le Misiri, lelo ng'anayio lenye le dukuya ti atua olng'obor le Haam.

English: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
Masaai: Neitoki arikoo iltung'ana lenyena anaa nkerra, nerikoo ninche ti ong'ata anaa eluaata oo ntare.

English: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
Masaai: Nerikoo ninye ninche te seriani, pee meureishoyu; kake eimisie enaiposha ilmang'ati lenye.

English: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
Masaai: Neriku ninye ninche atua ina kop sinyati, enetii ilo doinyo oisulie ninye te nkaina enye e tatene.

English: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
Masaai: Nearaa ninye iloshon te dukuya ninche, neoriki ina kop enye iltung'ana lenyena neitamany iloshon le Israel ilng'oborri lenye.

English: Yet they tempted and provoked the most high God, and kept not his testimonies:
Masaai: Kake ore eyia, etetemishote ninche, negolong'aki ilo otii Shumata Aisul, neitu eshilaa shakenisho enye,

English: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
Masaai: kake eibelekenyate ninche neas mbususi anaa apa loo menye; nemerregela ninche anaa enkawuo torrono.

English: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
Masaai: Amu eitagoro ninche ninye te nena wuejitin enye neeika; nepik ninche ninye olom te nena kitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno.

English: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Enkai ina, neiput ninye engoro, neany ninye tukul Israel.

English: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninye emanyisho enye te Shilo, ilo ng'obor apa otii ninye ti atua iltung'ana,

English: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
Masaai: neya ninye engolon enye atua eyararoto, neya enkitoo enye atua enkop oo lmang'ati.

English: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
Masaai: Neishooyo ninye iltung'ana lenyena metaari to lalem, nepik ninye engoro enye shumata ina jung'ore enye.

English: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
Masaai: Neinos enkima ilbarnot lenye, ore ntoyie enye, nelau kiyama.

English: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
Masaai: Ore lapolosak lenye nebatata too lalema, ore nena olia enye nemeishir.

English: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani adumunye anaa oltung'ani oirora, anaa oltung'ani ogol te nebuaku etemere.

English: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
Masaai: Neosh ilmang'ati lenyena arriny siadi; nepik ninche enkurruna oo ntarasi.

English: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
Masaai: Etanya ninye olng'obor le Yosef, eitu ninye egelu olosho le Efraim;

English: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.
Masaai: kake etegelua olosho le Yuda, o ilo doinyo le Sion otonyorra ninye.

English: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.
Masaai: Neshet ninye ina aji enye sinyati anaa keper, neitotiu anaa ewueji neitobiraki ntarasi.

English: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
Masaai: Etegelua ninye Daudi osinka lenye, neya ninye aitung'uaa eluaata oo ntare;

English: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.
Masaai: neitung'uaa ninye eramatata e lelo kuoo apa oonakita ooyakaki ninye, pee atum ataa olchekut le Yakobo lelo tung'ana lenyena, o Israel ina jung'ore enye.

English: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
Masaai: Ore te mborron o ltau lenye neramat ninye ninche, nerikoo ninche te nkaina e nkarriyiano.

English: O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
Masaai: Na Ai, eetuo lelo limikiyiolo aajing atua enjung'ore ino; etipika ninche olminong atua enkaji ino sinyati; eitaa ninche Yerusalem olmuaate.

English: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: Eishoo ninche mpopoki oo seseni loo sinkan linono, ilmotoni lo loing'ang'e meitaa endaa, ore lelo sinyat linono neinos ing'uesi e nkop nkiri oo seseni lenye.

English: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
Masaai: Eibukoitie isargeta lenye anaa enkare te manaroto pooki e Yerusalem, nemeetae hoo obo onukaa ninche.

English: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
Masaai: Kitaa iyiook entoki nailapi te lelo le latia ang, nesukenyi neikuyukuyaki lelo oomanita iyiook.

English: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa Olaitoriani? Igoro iyie ntarasi? Keyupuyup ina goro o lom lino anaa enkima?

English: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
Masaai: Tubukoki engoro ino lelo oshon limikiyiolo iyie, o shumata nena kitoriat nemeipot enkarna ino!

English: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
Masaai: Amu eidaikie ninche Yakobo, neitomijoon emanyisho enye.

English: O remember not against us former iniquities: let thy tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
Masaai: Midamu te iyiook entorroni oo loo papa; nchoo olng'ur lino metasieku anang'are iyiook, amu eitadouoki iyiook oleng.

English: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of thy name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for thy name's sake.
Masaai: Taretu iyiook, Na Ai e njeunoto ang, te nkaraki enkitoo e nkarna ino; tokordu iyiook, nipalaki iyiook ing'ok ang, te nkaraki enkarna ino!

English: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ejo iloshon, “Koree Enkai enye?” Nchoo ina lap, apa enkibukoroto o sarge loo sinkan linono metayiolouni too loshon pooki te dukuya nkonyek ang!

English: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;
Masaai: Nchoo ilo kiyioi le lelo ooena meeu dukuya iyie; ore te risioroto e ngolon ino kitok tagolie lelo ootudung'okoki keeya!

English: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.
Masaai: Ntalaa katitin naapishana lelo le latia ang too lgooitie lenye nena kilapat apa nikilapa ninche iyie, Olaitoriani!

English: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
Masaai: Ore taa iyiook iltung'ana linono, ina luaata e nkirrita ino, nikincho iyie enashe ntarasi; ore ebaiki iishoritin o ishoritin, nikilimu enkisisa ino.

English: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.
Masaai: Nchoru enkiok Lo Airritani le Israel, iyie ilo orikoo Yosef anaa eluaata oo ntare! Iyie ilo otii olorika le nkitoo te nchumata oo lkerubi,

English: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.
Masaai: nintawang'isho te dukuya Efraim o Benchamen o Manase, tuputu enkidimata ino, nilotu aitajeu iyiook!

English: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
Masaai: Torrinyu iyiook, Na Ai; nchoo enkomom ino ewang'u, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!

English: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, kenkata nabaa iyie igorokino enkomono oo ltung'ana linono?

English: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
Masaai: Nintotio iyie ninche te mukate oo lkiyio, nincho ninche metooko ilkiyio te nkumoi.

English: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
Masaai: Nintaa iyiook ilmang'ati too le latia ang; ore ilmang'ati lang nekueni maate.

English: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
Masaai: Torrinyu iyiook, Na Ai oo lororani; nchoo enkomom ino metawang'a, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!

English: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
Masaai: Iyie oyaua isabibu aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri; iyie otarayie iloshon niun ilo sabibu.

English: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
Masaai: Iyie oitukut enkop te nkaraki ninye; neibung ntona naapuo atua enkop neiput enkop.

English: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
Masaai: Neitoip oloip lenye ildoinyo, neitoip ilng'osil lenyena iltarakua sapuki;

English: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
Masaai: nereu ilng'osil lenyena aitabaiki enaiposha, neitabaiki ntona enyena olkeju.

English: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa iyie pee itigila enkikarrata enye, neaku ore pooki oogiroo aaim enkoitoi, neng'osilu ilng'anayio lenyena?

English: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
Masaai: Neinyala ilbitiro le ntim ninye, ore nena pooki naapuo ti ong'ata neinos ninye.

English: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
Masaai: Nyaaki mbelekenyunye, Na Ai oo lororani! Ing'ura kop itii shumata, nidol, tishilai ele sabibu,

English: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.
Masaai: ilo shani lituuno iyie te nkaina ino e tatene.

English: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
Masaai: Etapejoitie ninche ninye te nkurma, netudung'o ninche aauroo; meidaa ninche te nkisikong'ata e nkomom ino!

English: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.
Masaai: Kake nchoo enkaina ino elotu shumata ilo le nkaina ino e tatene, ina kerai e tung'ani nintagolo iyie te nkaraki kewan ino!

English: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
Masaai: Nemikingil ae kata iyiook aaibelekenya aaing'uaa iyie; nchoo iyiook enkishui, pee kitum aaipoto enkarna ino!

English: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
Masaai: Torrinyu iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani! Nchoo enkomom ino metawang'a, pee etumi aaitajeu iyiook!

English: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Entabuaku entaranyaki Enkai engolon ang; entabuaaki te ng'ida Enkai e Yakobo!

English: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
Masaai: Elepie osinkolio, nioshiosho enkinanta, ina kinanta e nkopito sidai enkorui o endule.

English: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
Masaai: Entoosh entarumpeta te nduaata o lapa, te nepurupuranayu olapa, te ina olong ang o sirua.

English: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Amu enkitanapata ina te Israel, elimunoto e Nkai e Yakobo.

English: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
Masaai: Eibalunye apa ninye te Yosef, ina kata apa pee eipang ninye alo te nkop e Misiri. Aning'ito nanu oltoilo leitu ayiolou:

English: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
Masaai: “Aiwuang'ie nanu olola to loililai lino; eyeng'iyeng'ate nkaik inono te napata e nkikapu.

English: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
Masaai: ore te nkata o sina kimpoto iyie nanu, naatokordua nanu; aatawalikia nanu iyie te ine wueji e nkisudoroto e ndarata; aatetema nanu iyie too nkariak e Meriba.

English: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
Masaai: Entoning, lo tung'ana laainei, te naikok nanu intae! Oo Israel, oi siaake tenaa eikining nanu!

English: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
Masaai: Mejing enkai omoni atua intae; emirrugo aaserem enkai omoni.

English: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo apa likiyaua aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri. Tang'a enkutuk ino pe aiput nanu.

English: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
Masaai: “Kake eitu ening iltung'ana laainei oltoilo lai; nemaayieu nanu Israel.

English: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
Masaai: Neaku aishooyie nanu te ina golon oo ltauja lenye, metusuja nkiguanat enye.

English: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
Masaai: Oi napaji tenaa kaaning iltung'ana laainei, pee etum Israel ashomo too nkoitoi aainei!

English: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
Masaai: Etaa nanu kasioki amir ilmang'ati lenye, naibelekenyaki nanu enkaina ai ilmang'ati lenye.

English: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooiba Olaitoriani nepuonu aaitoborruo te dukuya ninye, ore ina kitamioto enye nebik ntarasi.

English: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
Masaai: Kaaitoti nanu iyie te nkano sidai aisul, ore te ina aisho naing'uaa endapidapoi naaitaraposh iyie.”

English: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
Masaai: Etii Enkai ewueji enye ti atua eumata enye; ore te mpolos oo nkaitin neiguana ninye:

English: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
Masaai: “Kenkata nabaa iyie inguana too ntorrok, nintodolu oloshomitore te ilo torrono?

English: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
Masaai: Nguanaki te sipata ilo omena o ilo okishi; mbung'a esipata e ilo oata osina o ilo okishi.

English: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
Masaai: Tokordu ilo oshal o ilo aisinani; tokordu ninche ntung'uai enkaina e ilo torrono.”

English: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
Masaai: Meeta ninche eng'eno nemedamisho, nepuo ninche aamanimanaa te naimin; eikirikirate ilkitamanyunot pooki le nkop.

English: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Irara intae nkaitin, nkera e ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, intae pooki;

English: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
Masaai: ore ake eyia, iyeye intae anaa iltung'ana, nibatatata anaa pooki tung'ani kitok.”

English: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
Masaai: Tudumunye, iyie Enkai, nguanare enkop; amu ilkulinono iloreren pooki!

English: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, mintoki iyie agira; migira nemintirring'a, Iyie Enkai!

English: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ebuakita ilmang'ati linono; neilepie lukuny lelo likimba iyie.

English: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
Masaai: Neitobir nkitobirat torrok too ltung'ana linono, neiguanakino te nebo pee ear lelo litomituo iyie.

English: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Wootu, matujutu ninche aaishie anaa olosho, nchoo enkarna e Israel eaku meigili ae kata aadamu!”

English: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
Masaai: Ee, neiguanakino ninche to ltau obo; neitobir ninche olning'o pee kitum aataarare iyie -

English: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
Masaai: o lelo ng'oborri le Edom o le Ishmael, o le Moab o le Hagari,

English: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
Masaai: o Gebal, o Amon o Amaleki, o Filistia te nebo lelo oomanya Turo;

English: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
Masaai: eibung'are sii Asiria ninche; ninche engolon oo nkera e Lutu.

English: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
Masaai: Intaasa ninche enapa nintaasa Midian, o Sisera o Yabin to lkeju le Kishon,

English: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
Masaai: lelo apa ooidaikieki te Endor, lelo otaa nkik te nkop.

English: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
Masaai: Intotiwuo lelo kituaak lenye anaa Orebu o Seebu, nintotiu ilkituaak lenye pooki anaa Seba o Salmuna,

English: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
Masaai: lelo apa ootejo, “Mawaita ena kop e Nkai aaitaa enaang.”

English: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai ai, ntaa ninche olemua, nchoo etiu anaa suut naakutaa osiwuo.

English: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
Masaai: Ore anaa enaaibung enkima entim, o anaa enalo olng'ejep le nkima enchumata o ldoinyo,

English: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
Masaai: neijia nkuna, tusujai ninche to lkutati lino, nturia ninche to lemua lino!

English: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
Masaai: Mputa nkomomi enye enkurruna, pee etum ninche aaing'oru enkarna ino, iyie Olaitoriani.

English: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
Masaai: Nchoo ninche meitukurruni, neidang ntarasi; nchoo ninche meidaa te sulare.

English: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metayiolo nchere iyie ake openy eji enkarna Olaitoriani, iyie Otii Shumata Aisul te nkop pooki.

English: How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
Masaai: Kebaa esidano e nkaji ino, Olaitoriani loo lororani!

English: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
Masaai: Keyieu oltau lai, ee, naa keiterriakino enkaji o Laitoriani; neranyaki te ng'ida oltau lai o sesen lai Enkai naishu.

English: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
Masaai: Enoto sii ninye entiitiit ewueji, netum enkomerei enkaji, ewueji neirragakinyie nkera enyena, too lpereren linono loo lasarri, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, Olaitoriani lai naa Enkai ai.

English: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
Masaai: Emayiana iloobik ti atua enkaji ino, nebik aarany enkisisa ino!

English: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo tung'ana laa atua iyie etii engolon enye, lelo oata too ltauja lenye, nena oitoi kituaak naapuo Sion.

English: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
Masaai: Ore epuoito ninche aaim oerata le Baka, neitotiu ninche ine anaa nkonyek oo nkariak; ore ilkisirat le dukuya le nchan neiput ine ilchorroi.

English: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
Masaai: nepuo ninche eponari engolon enye ore ina Ai oo nkaitin nepuoi aadol te Sion.

English: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyie Enkai oo lororani, toning'o enkomono ai; irrugu enkiok, iyie Enkai e Yakobo!

English: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
Masaai: Toduaa iyie Enkai, na long'o ang, ing'ura enkomom e ilo lino litubukoko eilata aput!

English: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
Masaai: Amu enkolong nabo ti atua enkaji ino naikash alang nkolong'i enkalifu nabo te dikae. Enaikash nanu te naaku olarriponi te kutuk aji e nkaji e Nkai ai, alang te nabik too lng'oborri le nkarruoisho.

English: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai naa enkolong naa elong'o; naa keishoru ninye omom o enkitoo. Meetae entoki sidai namit Olaitoriani te lelo oopuo too ltauja sidain.

English: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
Masaai: Olaitoriani loo lororani, emayiana ilo tung'ani likisilig iyie.

English: LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ira apa iyie supat te nkop ino; itorrinyuo iyie olpisiai le Yakobo.

English: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
Masaai: Itapalaka iyie entorroni oo ltung'ana linono, nipalaki iyie ing'ok enye pooki.

English: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.
Masaai: Itorrinyo iyie engoro ino pooki; nimbelekenya iyie aing'uaa ina goro ino napi.

English: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
Masaai: Ngila torrinyu iyiook, Iyie Enkai e njeunoto ang, niwuang'ie engoro ino te iyiook!

English: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
Masaai: Eigorokino iyie iyiook ntarasi? Eintoodor iyie engoro ino aitabaiki iishoritin pooki?

English: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
Masaai: Eimingil iyie aitopiu iyiook, pee etum iltung'ana linono aating'idata te iyie?

English: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
Masaai: Ntoduaa iyiook enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, nincho iyiook enjeunoto ino.

English: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
Masaai: nchooki nanu matoning'o enajo Olaitoriani Enkai, amu keiro ninye eseriani too ltung'ana lenyena, too sinyat lenyena o te lelo ooibelekenyakino ninye too ltauja lenye.

English: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
Masaai: Esipa ketaana enjeunoto enye te lelo ooure ninye, pee etum enkitoo atobiko te nkop ang.

English: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Masaai: Ketumo enyorrata nauno o esupatisho, neng'ututa esupatisho o eseriani te nebo.

English: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
Masaai: Nebulu ailepu te nkop esupatisho, neirrugo esupatisho te shumata aing'or enkop.

English: Yea, the LORD shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
Masaai: Ee, keishoru Olaitoriani ina sidai, ore enkop ang neiu ilng'anayio kumok.

English: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
Masaai: Kelo esupatisho te dukuya ninye, neitaa iroruat enyena enkoitoi.

English: Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.
Masaai: Irrugu enkiok ino, iyie Olaitoriani, nikiwaliki nanu, amu kara nanu aisinani namena.

English: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
Masaai: Tagolie enkishui ai, amu ara nanu olaseremani le Nkai; ntajeu osinka lino likisilig iyie.

English: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
Masaai: Ira iyie Enkai ai; ing'urrieki nanu, Olaitoriani, amu iyie nanu aishiraki endama pooki.

English: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Masaai: Ntishipa oltau lo sinka lino, amu iyie nanu, Olaitoriani, ailepakinye oltau lai.

English: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
Masaai: Amu iyie, iyie Olaitoriani osupat, nipalaki ing'ok, nibik te nyorrata nauno te lelo pooki likimpot iyie.

English: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
Masaai: Toning'o, Olaitoriani, enkomono ai; toning'o enkomono ai e sayiata.

English: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong ai oo ng'olikinot, aaipoto nanu iyie, amu eikiwaliki iyie nanu.

English: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.
Masaai: Meetae likae likinyaanyukie iyie ti atua nkaitin, Olaitoriani, nemeetae kulie siaitin naanyaanyukie nkuninono.

English: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
Masaai: Ore lelo oreren pooki lintobira iyie naa kepuonu, neirrugo te dukuya iyie, Olaitoriani, naa keisis ninche enkarna ino.

English: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
Masaai: Amu ira iyie kitok nias mbaa e nking'asia, iyie ake openy Enkai.

English: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi ino, Olaitoriani, pee atum nanu ashomo te sipata ino; nchoo oltau lai meturia enkarna ino.

English: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, Enkai ai, to ltau lai pooki, naa kaisis nanu enkarna ino ntarasi.

English: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
Masaai: Amu eikitok ina nyorrata ino nauno ti alo nanu, itokordua iyie enkishui ai aitung'uaa enguton e nemeneng'a.

English: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai, aatudumakinote nanu iltung'ana oouasa aarare; eing'oru entukus oo ltung'ana oouasa enkishui ai, nimikishilaa ninche iyie.

English: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, ira Enkai o lng'ur niata osotua, nimisioki agoro, nibik te nyorrata nauno, nira oloisiligayu.

English: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu ng'uraki nanu, niking'urrie nanu; nchoo osinka lino engolon ino, nintajeu ina kerai e sinka ino.

English: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
Masaai: Ntoduaaki nanu olmonekie le omom ino, paa ore lelo laaiba nanu nedol nekurru, amu iyie, Olaitoriani, likitareto nanu nikintagol nanu.

English: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
Masaai: Enchumata eilo doinyo sinyati etii ina anasa nateshetua ninye;

English: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Masaai: kenyor Olaitoriani nchomito e Sion, aitalang imanyishoritin pooki e Yakobo.

English: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
Masaai: Mbaa e nkitoo eimakini ti alo iyie, na anasa e Nkai.

English: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
Masaai: Ore te lelo laayiolo nanu, aimaki Rahabu o Babilon; ng'ura, etii Filistia, o Turo o Etiopia - nejo ninche, “Etoiuoki ele teine.”

English: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
Masaai: Naa ore ti alo Sion naa keji, “Ore elde o elde netoiuoki ti atua ninye”; amu Ilo otii Shumata Aisul olo aitasheyie ninye.

English: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
Masaai: Keiken Olaitoriani nesir iltung'ana, “Ore ele netoiuoki apa teine.”

English: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
Masaai: Ore lelo aranyak o looiguran, nejo, “Ore nchorroi aainei pooki naa atua iyie etii.”

English: O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before thee:
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, Enkai ai, iyie nanu aipot taretuoki dama; naishir nanu kewarie te dukuya iyie.

English: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
Masaai: Nchoo enkomono ai meeu dukuya iyie, irrugu enkiok ino toning'o enkishirata ai!
