English: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
Masaai: Amu eiputa oltau lai enyamali; netataanikia enkishui ai enemeneng'a!

English: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:
Masaai: Aaikenakaki nanu lelo oodoiki engumoto; ara nanu oltung'ani lemeeta engolon,

English: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
Masaai: atotiuo anaa oltung'ani oiturrayioki ti atua ilootuata, anaa oltung'ani otaraki metua neirragieki te ngumoto, anaa ltung'ana lemeekure edamuni, amu eiwuang'ieki ninche te nkaina ino.

English: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
Masaai: Kitipika iyie nanu atua enguton e ngumoto, iwuejitin neemisimis negut.

English: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.
Masaai: Eirragita engoro ino nairoishi te shumata nanu, nikindaikie nanu too lopir lo siwuo lino.

English: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie lelo le ncholuek ai maaitiaa nanu, kintaa iyie nanu entoki naitureisho te ninche. Aaikenoyioki nanu metaa maidim atuluai,

English: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
Masaai: eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei te nkaraki osina. Ore nkolong'i pooki naipot nanu iyie Olaitoriani, Nailepie aitorioo nkaik aainei te nkomono.

English: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.
Masaai: Ias iyie mbaa e nking'asia too lootuata? Eikinyototo iloipi aaisis iyie?

English: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
Masaai: Keibalunyeki ina nyorrata ino nauno ti atua enkurare, anaa esupatisho ino te Abadon?

English: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
Masaai: Keyioloi mbaa inono e nking'asia ti atua enaimin, anaa ina retoto ino naitajeusho te nkop nemedamuni?

English: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, Olaitoriani, iyie aishiraka; ore tadekenya nelotu enkomono ai dukuya iyie.

English: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kainyoo pee kinturrayie nanu, kainyoo iyie pee kisudorie nanu enkomom ino?

English: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
Masaai: Aainosa nanu osina neyieu aye apa ebaiki kitisho ai, aisilisile nanu too nkituriat inono; ataa nanu pesho.

English: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
Masaai: Aaisiasha nanu engoro ino; aaidaikie nanu ioshot inono.

English: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
Masaai: Aatamana ninche anaa olairrag le nkare endama pooki; naaman ninche aang'adu te nebo.

English: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie ilchoreta laainei laning'ore maaitiaa nanu, netaa iltung'ana enaimin ake aisiritore.

English: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
Masaai: Karany nanu osinkolio le ina nyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ntarasi; ore te nkutuk ai, naa kalimu nanu esupatisho ino ti atua iishoritin pooki.

English: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
Masaai: Amu ore ina nyorrata ino nauno neitasheyieki ntarasi, ore esupatisho ino nemeigusugusieki, etiu anaa keper.

English: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
Masaai: Itejo iyie, “Aitobira nanu olning'o lai te nebo ilo lai gelunoti, ainosie nanu Daudi osinka lai olmumai:

English: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
Masaai: ‘Kaitubul nanu eishoi ino ntarasi, nashetu olorika lino le nkitoo too ishoritin pooki.’ ”

English: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
Masaai: Nchoo keper meisisa mbaa inono e nking'asia, iyie Olaitoriani, o esupatisho ino ti atua eumata e lelo sinyat!

English: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
Masaai: Amu kaing'ae to loing'ang'e eidimi aaitanyaanyukie Olaitoriani? Kaing'ae ti atua lelo le keper onyaanyukie Olaitoriani.

English: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
Masaai: Iyie Enkai naurei ti atua enkiguana e lelo sinyat, kitok neitureisho, nelusoo ninye te lelo pooki oomanita ninye?

English: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, kalo olmagilani anaa iyie, Olaitoriani, nikimanita iyie esupatisho ino?

English: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
Masaai: Iyie oitore engolon e naiposha, naa te nedumunye ilopir lenyena, nintirring'ie ninche.

English: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
Masaai: Iyie otarrarra Rahabu anaa empopong, iyie oidapasha ilmang'ati linono te nkaina ino.

English: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
Masaai: Enino keper naa enino enkop; o enkop o pooki toki natii atua, iyie oitobirua ninche.

English: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
Masaai: Ore moikuape o kopikop iyie oitobirua ninche; ore Tabori o Hermon neisis enkarna ino te ng'ida.

English: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
Masaai: Iata iyie enkaina magilani; kegol enkaina ino, neado enkaina ino e tatene.

English: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
Masaai: Esupatisho o esipata ninche olkitamanyunoto lo lorika lino le nkitoo; nelo esupatisho o enyorrata nauno te dukuya iyie.

English: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo tung'ana ooyiolo embuakunoto o sinkolio lo sirua, lelo, Olaitoriani, oopuo te wang'an e nkomom ino,

English: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
Masaai: lelo oong'ida te nkaraki enkarna ino endama pooki, neisis ninche esupatisho ino.

English: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
Masaai: Amu iyie enkisisa e ngolon enye; ore te nkaraki omom ino neishur iyiook emouo.

English: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
Masaai: Amu ore elong'o ang naa eno laitoriani, ore olaiguanani lang naa oleilo sinyati le Israel.

English: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
Masaai: Ore tiapa, nirorie iyie te nduaata, ilo lino oisiligayu nijo, “Atipika nanu enkopiyia e nkitoo endukuya e obo magilani, aishoo nanu enkitoo ilo otegelutua iltung'ana.

English: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
Masaai: Anoto nanu Daudi osinka lai; atubukoko nanu ninye eilaata sinyati aput;

English: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
Masaai: pee etum enkaina ai ataa te nebo ninye, neitagol sii enkaina ai ninye.

English: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
Masaai: Memir ae kata ilmang'ati ninye, nemelo ilo torrono aitore ninye.

English: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
Masaai: Karrar nanu ilmang'ati lenyena te dukuya ninye, naosh anang'ie enkop lelo ooiba ninye.

English: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho ai o enyorrata ai nauno naa keaku te nebo ninye, ore te nkarna ai neishur emowuo enye.

English: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
Masaai: Kalo nanu apik enkaina enye enchumata e naiposha, napik enkaina enye e tatene shumata ilkejek.

English: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
Masaai: Kaaishiraki ninye nanu, ejo, ‘Ira iyie Papa, Enkai ai o endapidapoi e njeunoto ai.’

English: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu ninye olkikau lai, ole shumata too laiguanak le nkop.

English: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
Masaai: Kaibung nanu ti alo ninye ina nyorrata ai nauno ntarasi, ore olning'o lai nemeigusugus ti alo ninye.

English: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
Masaai: Kaitubul nanu eishoi enye ntarasi, nebikoo olorika lenye le nkitoo anaa inkolong'i e keper.

English: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
Masaai: Te neany nkera enyena enkitanapata ai, nemepuo te risioroto oo nkikoot aainei,

English: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
Masaai: te nepaashare ninche nkikoot aainei, nemeibung nkitanapat aainei,

English: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Masaai: naa kaitame nanu nena kitarruorot enye te ng'udi; naitame entorroni enye te nkitamioto nairoua;

English: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
Masaai: kake maiwuang'ie nanu te ninye ina nyorrata ai nauno, aashu ariat esupatisho ai.

English: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
Masaai: Magil nanu olning'o lai lo sotua, anaa aibelekeny ilo rorei otupukuo te nkutuk ai.

English: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
Masaai: Atimitunye nanu ainos olmumai te sinyatisho ai; malej nanu Daudi.

English: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
Masaai: Kebikoo eishoi enye ntarasi, nebikoo olorika lenye le nkitoo anaa enkolong te dukuya nanu.

English: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
Masaai: Ketiu anaa olapa, keitasheyieki ntarasi; keitashe ninye auno anaa enabik oloing'ang'e.”

English: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
Masaai: Kake ore taata inturrayie iyie nimbayie, kimputa iyie engoro te nkaraki ilo lino litubukoko eilata aput.

English: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
Masaai: Itanya iyie olning'o te nebo osinka lino, nimpurupuro iyie enkopiyia enye e nkitoo te nterit.

English: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
Masaai: Ituroyie iyie isunta enyena pooki; intomijoono iyie lelo sempewueti lenyena.

English: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki oogiroo nepur ninye, etaa ninye entoki nakueniyie ile latia enye.

English: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
Masaai: Ntagolo iyie enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye; ntishipa iyie ilmang'ati lenyena pooki.

English: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
Masaai: Mbelekenya iyie empijan o lalem lenye, neitu ncho ninye meitasho to larrabal.

English: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie iyie eng'udi e nkitoria te nkaina enye, ninang'aki olorika lenye le nkitoo enkop.

English: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
Masaai: Ntodorropa iyie nkolong'i enyena e kitisho, nimulumula ninye te nkurruna.

English: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa, Olaitoriani, isudoo iyie kewan, ae ntarasi? Kenkata nabaa eyupuyup engoro ino anaa enkima?

English: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
Masaai: Tadamu Olaitoriani eneba entemata e nkishui, ae te nyoo iyie intobira nkera pooki e tung'ana!

English: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
Masaai: Kalo tung'ani oishu nemedol ae kata keeya? Kalo oidim atokordu oltau lenye aitung'uaa engolon e nemeneng'a?

English: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
Masaai: Olaitoriani, koree enapa nyorrata ino nauno, enapa ninosie iyie olmumai o Daudi te nkaraki esupatisho ino?

English: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
Masaai: Tadamu, Olaitoriani, ina nakueniyie osinka lino; anapita nanu to lgoo lai imorot e tung'ana,

English: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
Masaai: nena naamor ilmang'ati, linono Olaitoriani, nena naamorie iroruat e ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput.

English: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani ntarasi! Esai, Esai.

English: LORD, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, iyie emanyisho ang, ti atua iishoritin pooki.

English: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.
Masaai: Ore apa eton eitu eitobiruni ildoinyo, aashu enkop pooki, ebaiki ntarasi o ntarasi, iyie Enkai.

English: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
Masaai: Irrinyoki iyie tung'ani meshomo enterit, nijo, “Entorrinyoto, na kera e tung'ana!”

English: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
Masaai: Amu ore ilarin enkalifu nabo too nkonyek inono netiu anaa ng'ole te nelusoo, aashu anaa erripore e nkewarie.

English: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
Masaai: Ioroo iyie iltung'ana aiwuang'ie; netiu ninche anaa enkidetidet, netiu anaa nkujit naaipilipil tadekenya;

English: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
Masaai: ore tadekenya neitapuku neipilipil, ore teipa nemuguta netoyu.

English: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
Masaai: Amu eidaikie iyiook engoro ino; ore te nkaraki engoro ino nikiruto iyiook.

English: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.
Masaai: Itipika iyie nkitarruorot ang dukuya iyie, ore nena ng'ok ang naaisudoro netii dukuya nkonyek inono.

English: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
Masaai: Amu etulusoitie nkolong'i ang pooki tiabori engoro ino, naa keiting ilarin lang anaa enkiyang'ata.

English: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
Masaai: Ore larin te nkishui ang naa ntomoni naapishana, naa ntomoni isiet te nikigol; ore to lelo arin naa enkisiaayiare ake o sina; nalusoo aasiooyo, nikipuo sii iyiook aish.

English: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, so is thy wrath.
Masaai: aing'ae oiguanare engolon e ngoro ino, o empushuna ino te risioroto e uriata ino?

English: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
Masaai: Nteng'ena naa iyiook enkikenata oo nkolong'i ang, pee kitum aanoto oltau le ng'eno nagut.

English: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
Masaai: Torrinyunye, Olaitoriani, O anu akenya? Ing'urrie isinkan linono!

English: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
Masaai: Ntaraposho iyiook anaake tadekenya te ina nyorrata ino nauno, pee kitum aating'idata nikishipa too nkolong'i ang pooki.

English: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
Masaai: Nting'ida iyiook too nkolong'i kumok naaba anaa ininosie iyiook osina, too larin ooba anaa ilikitodolie entorroni.

English: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
Masaai: Nchoo meibalunyeki esiaai ino too sinkan linono, neibalunyeki ina golon ino kitok too nkera enye.

English: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
Masaai: Nchoo esupatisho o Laitoriani Enkai ang elotu shumata iyiook, nintagol iyie esiaai oo nkaik ang te shumata iyiook, ee, ntagolo iyie esiaai oo nkaik ang.

English: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Masaai: Ore ilo obik to lng'obor le ilo otii Shumata aisul; ilo obik ti atua oloip lo lmagilani,

English: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
Masaai: kelo ajoki Olaitoriani, “Esarunoto ai naa osempewuet lai; Enkai ai naa ninye aisilig.”

English: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
Masaai: Amu eikikordu ninye iyie aitayu te ilo rreshet lo larreshoni, o too lmeita torrok;

English: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Masaai: eikimulumul ninye too naipuko enyena, ore ti abori inaipuko enyena nitum esarunoto; ore esupatisho enye naa elong'o o emitunoto.

English: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
Masaai: Mitum iyie enkuretisho kewarie, nimikitum embae nang'oruni dama,

English: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
Masaai: anaa olmeitai olo ti atua enaimin, anaa te nkidaata namutisho te ndama.

English: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.
Masaai: Keidim aatabatata iltung'ana enkalifu nabo te mbata ino, nebatata nkalifuni tomon te nkalo ino e tatene, kake mikinyikaki iyie.

English: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
Masaai: Eing'or ake too nkonyek inono, nidol elaakinoto oo larruok.

English: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nintaa Olaitoriani esarunoto ino, nintaa Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul emanyisho ino,

English: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
Masaai: meetae entorroni nalotu enitii, meetae olmeitai onyikaki olng'obor lino.

English: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
Masaai: Amu keisho ninye olmalaika lenye mikitagolie iyie, nikirrip too nkoitoi inono pooki.

English: They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
Masaai: Nikinap ninche too nkaik enye, pee minkob ake osoit te nkeju ino.

English: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
Masaai: Ilo iyie aroro olng'atuny o enturbubua, intuny iyie olng'atuny o lasurai too nkejek inono.

English: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
Masaai: Ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore enkaraki naatonyorra ninye nanu, kakordu nanu ninye; kamitu nanu ninye, enkaraki nayiolo ninye enkarna ai.

English: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
Masaai: Te naaipot ninye nanu nawaliki nanu ninye; kaaku nanu te nebo ninye te nkata e nyamali, kamitu nanu ninye nayanyitu ninye.

English: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
Masaai: Naitaraposh ninye te nkishui naado, naitodol ninye enjeunoto ai.

English: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
Masaai: Eisidai te neishori Olaitoriani enashe, pee eranyi enkisisa e nkarna ino, iyie Olotii shumata Aisul;

English: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
Masaai: pee eibalunyeki ina nyorrata ino nauno tadekenya, o esupatisho ino te nkewarie,

English: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
Masaai: to sinkolio le nkinanta o usin, o enkawuo oo sinkolioitin o to lkerempe lo lwulul loo usin.

English: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
Masaai: Amu iyie, Olaitoriani, likintishipa nanu te siaai ino; ore too siaitin oo nkaik inono narany nanu te ng'ida.

English: O LORD, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.
Masaai: Kebaa enkitoo oo siaitin inono, Olaitoriani! Kegut oleng ndamunot inono!

English: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
Masaai: Meyiolou oltung'ani omoda, meyiolou olkiminchali kuna baa:

English: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
Masaai: nchere, ore hoo nebul ilarruok anaa olkujita, nedupoyu ilarruok pooki, enkidaata ninche epuo ntarasi,

English: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
Masaai: kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, itii shumata ntarasi.

English: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ilmang'ati linono, Olaitoriani, ng'ura, keidak ilmang'ati linono, ore lelo arruok naa keisardakieki.

English: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
Masaai: Amu itudumua iyie emowuo ai anaa emowuo olosokuan; nikitubukoko nanu eilata ng'ejuk.

English: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
Masaai: Etoduaa nkonyek aainei embatatata oo lmang'ati laainei, etoning'o nkiyiaa aainei entorroni e lelo mang'ati laainei.

English: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Masaai: Kebul ilo supat anaa oltukai, nebulu anaa oltarakuai te Lebanon.

English: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
Masaai: Etuunoki ninche ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nebul ninche too lgorieti le Nkai ang.

English: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
Masaai: Neton ake eiu ninche ilng'anayio te moruao enye, nebulu ninche aalitu nenyori anaake,

English: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
Masaai: pee eitodolu nchere eisupat Olaitoriani; ninye endapidapoi ai, nemetii entorroni atua ninye.

English: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oitoreisho; eishope ninye te nkitoo; eishope Olaitoriani, neterretene ninye aishop engolon. Ee, eitasheyieki enkop, nemeigusugusieki ae kata;

English: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.
Masaai: eitasheyieki olorika lino le nkitoo apa moitie; itii iyie ebaiki apa ntarasi.

English: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
Masaai: Etudumutua inaaiposha iltoiloishi lenye, iyie Olaitoriani nedumu ninche oltoilo lenye o enkikurrukur.

English: The LORD on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
Masaai: Magilani ninye alang indarat oo nkariak kumok, kitok alang ilopir le naiposha, Ore Olaitoriani otii shumata naa magilani.

English: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
Masaai: Esipa nkitanapat inono eishiaakino esinyatisho enkaji ino iyie Olaitoriani, ntarasi.

English: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai e lap, Iyie Enkai e lap, tawang'a!

English: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
Masaai: Tudumunye, lo adung'oni le nkiguana le nkop, nchoo lelo oouasa inaairirikino ninche!

English: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, o anu kenya kulo torrok, o anu kenya eisulie kulo torrok.

English: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
Masaai: Neruku ninche irorei lenye le pesho, neitokoos ninche te ntorroni pooki.

English: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
Masaai: Nerratany ninche iltungana linono, Olaitoriani, neisilisil enjung'ore ino.

English: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
Masaai: Near ninche metua enkoliai o ilo tung'ani omoni, nesesekuan ilo okishi;

English: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard it.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Medol Olaitoriani; memusu Enkai e Yakobo.”

English: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
Masaai: Tayiolo, ele omoda aisul! Lo moda, kanu akenya ingenunu?

English: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
Masaai: Amaa, ilo oitobira enkiok, ae mening'isho ninye? Amaa, ilo oitibira enkong'u, ae medolisho ninye?

English: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, shall not he know?
Masaai: Amaa, ilo oitame iloshon, ae meitameisho ninye? Ilo oiteng'en iltung'ana te ng'eno,

English: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
Masaai: eyiolo Olaitoriani ndamunot oo ltung'ana nchere enkijape ake.

English: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani lintame iyie, Olaitoriani, ilo linteng'en iyie too nkitanapat inono

English: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
Masaai: pee incho ninye enkiyeng'iyeng'ata te nkata e nyamali, o metaba anaa neturokini ilo torrono engumoto.

English: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
Masaai: Amu meituraa Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena; meing'uaa ninye enjung'ore enye;

English: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
Masaai: amu kelotu esipata enetii lelo supati, ore lelo pooki sidain iltauja, nesuj.

English: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
Masaai: Kalo odumunye te nkaraki nanu agilunore ilo torrono? Kalo oitashe te rishata ai agilunore ilaasak loo ntorrok?

English: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
Masaai: Te neme Olaitoriani otaa eretoto ai, anaata etobiko enkishui ai te nkop e ngira.

English: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
Masaai: Te nadamisho nanu, “Neideketari enkeju ai,” enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ninye naaibung'ita.

English: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
Masaai: Ore te nkumoi oo ndamunot aainei, naa enkitagoloto ino naaitagol oshoke.

English: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
Masaai: Keidim ilarikok arruok aaibung'ata o iyie, lelo ooitobiru ntabo te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat?

English: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
Masaai: Keiturrurro ninche te nebo aagilunore ilo supat, nedung'oki ilo asipani enkiguana e keeya.

English: But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.
Masaai: Kake etaa Olaitoriani osempewuet lai, etaa Enkai ai endapidapoi e sarunoto ai.

English: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the LORD our God shall cut them off.
Masaai: Kerrinyoki ninye ninche ntorrok enye, nejut ninche aiwuang'ie te nkaraki enkarrueisho enye; kejutoo Olaitoriani Enkai ang ninche aiwuang'ie.

English: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
Masaai: Wootu mataranyaki Olaitoriani matishipakinoto endapidapoi e njeunoto ang!

English: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
Masaai: Wootu maape dukuya enkomom enye kiaata enashe; mataranyaki iyiook ninye kiata eng'ida, too sinkolioitin le nkisisa!

English: For the LORD is a great God, and a great King above all gods.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani naa ninye Enkai kitok, naa Olaiguanani kitok te shumata nkaitin pooki.

English: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
Masaai: Etii nkaik enyena enguton e nkop, naa enenye sii enkadoro oo ldoinyo.

English: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
Masaai: Enenye enaiposha amu ninye oitobira, naa nkaik enyena naaitobira enkop natoyio.

English: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
Masaai: Wootu mateserem nikirrugokino, matigil kung te dukuya Olaitoriani oitobira iyiook!

English: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
Masaai: Amu ninye Enkai ang, nikira iyiook iltung'ana le nkirrita enye, o nkerra e nkaina enye. Te nining'ining'i taata oltoilo lenye!

English: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
Masaai: Emintagol iltauja linyi, anaa apa te Meriba, anaa apa te nkolong e Masa ti ong'ata,

English: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
Masaai: ina kata apa pee aatem iloo papaai linyi, naaineneng ninche nanu, hoo netoduaa ninche esiaai ai.

English: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
Masaai: Too larin artam nanu aaitagoro ina ishoi najo nanu, “Iltung'ana ootapaashaitie iltauja, nemeshilaa ninche nkoitoi aainei.”

English: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
Masaai: Neaku, ainosa nanu olmumai te ngoro ai, pee mejing ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.

English: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk; entaranyaki Olaitoriani na kop pooki!

English: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani, esisa enkarna enye; entolimu enjeunoto enye nkolong'i pooki.

English: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
Masaai: Embalunye enkitoo enye ti atua loshon, embalunye isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia ti atua iloreren!

English: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
Masaai: Eikitok Olaitoriani, naa keisisi ninye oleng; keureyuni ninye aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.

English: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
Masaai: Amu ore nkaitin pooki oo loreren naa nkitanyaanyukot; kake Olaitoriani oitobira keper.

English: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
Masaai: Etii enkanyit o enkitoo dukuya ninye; etii engolon o enkishiaa atua ewueji enye sinyati.

English: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo, intae ilmareita loo ltung'ana, enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo o engolon!

English: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo nairirikino enkarna enye; eyau enkishooroto, nipuonunu atua ilgorieti lenyena!

English: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
Masaai: Enteserem Olaitoriani te sinyatisho e nkishiaa enye, inkirikirayu te dukuya ninye, na kop pooki!

English: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
Masaai: Tejo tiatua iloshon, “Olaitoriani oitoreisho! Ee, eitasheyieki enkop, nemeigusugusieki ae kata; kelo ninye aiguanare iloshon te sipata.”

English: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
Masaai: Nchoo metishipayu keper, naa nchoo nkop meting'idayu; nchoo enaiposha meikurrukurro o nena pooki naabore atua;

English: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
Masaai: nchoo metishipayu enkop, o pooki toki natii atua! Neranyisho taa ilkeek pooki le ntim te ng'ida

English: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
Masaai: te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu elotu ninye, amu elotu ninye pee eiguanare enkop. Keiguanare ninye enkop te supatisho, neiguanare iloreren te sipata enye.

English: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oitoreisho; nchoo metishipayu enkop; nchoo metishipata iloomanaa le naiposha!

English: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
Masaai: Emanita nkatampo o emisimisi nagut ninye; esupatisho o esipata ninche olkitamanyunoto lo lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
Masaai: Nelo enkima te dukuya ninye, nepejoo lelo mang'ati oomanita ninye.

English: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
Masaai: Nkiwuang'at enyena naaitawang enkop; nedol enkop neikirikira.

English: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
Masaai: Etosholate ildoinyo netiu anaa nkapo te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

English: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
Masaai: Eibalunye keper esupatisho enye; neing'or iloreren pooki enkitoo enye.

English: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
Masaai: Eitukurruaki lelo aseremak pooki loo nkitanyaanyukot, lelo oowuasare nkitanyaanyukot e pesho; neirrugo nkaitin pooki te dukuya ninye.

English: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
Masaai: Nening Sion neshipa, neng'ida nena toyie e Yuda, te nkaraki nena kiguanat inono, Enkai.

English: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
Masaai: Amu ore iyie, Olaitoriani, itii shumata aisul te nkop pooki; nikilepieki aaitulusoo too nkaitin pooki.

English: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
Masaai: Enyor Olaitoriani lelo ooiba enkarruoisho, negolie ninye enkishui oo sinyat lenyena; nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa enkaina e ilo arruoni.

English: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Masaai: Ewang'an naitawang ilo asipani, netum enchipai ilo oata oltau sidai.

English: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
Masaai: Ting'idayu ti atua Olaitoriani, iyie ilo ora asipani, nincho enashe enkarna enye sinyati.

English: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, amu etaasa ninye mbaa e nking'asia! Ore ina aina enye e tatene, o ina aina enye sinyati, netimirishe.

English: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
Masaai: Eibalunye Olaitoriani enkisulata enye, eibalunye ninye enkitoo te dukuya iloreren pooki.

English: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Masaai: Etadamua ninye ina nyorrata enye nauno o esupatisho enye te nkaji e Israel. Ore nkiting'ot e nkop pooki netoduaa enkisulata e Nkai ang.

English: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te ng'ida, na kop pooki; entabuaku to sinkolio le nchipai entarany te nkisisa!

English: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
Masaai: Entaranyaki enkisisa Olaitoriani to lwulul loo usin, to lwulul loo usin o to ltoilo lo sinkolio!

English: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
Masaai: Too ntarumpetani o to ltoilo le mouo entayu oltoilo le nchipai te dukuya Olaiguanani, laa ninye Olaitoriani!

English: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
Masaai: Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha o pooki toki natii atua; o enkop o pooki oomanya!

English: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
Masaai: Ilugoyu enaiposha te nchipai; nchoo eranyisho ildoinyo te ng'ida te nebo,

English: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
Masaai: te dukuya Olaitoriani, amu kelotu ninye aiguanare enkop. Keiguanare ninye enkop te supatisho neiguanare iloreren too sipat.

English: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oitoreisho; nchoo meikirikirata loreren! Etonita ninye to lorika le nkitoo too lkerubi; nchoo meikirikirayu enkop!

English: The LORD is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
Masaai: Eikitok Olaitoriani te Sion; etii ninye shumata iloreren pooki.

English: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
Masaai: Nchoo meisisa loreren ina arna ino kitok naitureisho! Ninye osinyati!

English: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
Masaai: Olaiguanani magilani, onyor isipat; intasheyie iyie esipata; ninguana iyie te sipata o te supatisho ti atua Yakobo.

English: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai ang; enteseremisho too nkejek enyena! Ninye osinyati!

English: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
Masaai: Musa o Aron apa ilapolosak lenyena, etii sii apa Samuel lelo ooipot enkarna enye. Eishirakita ninche Olaitoriani, newaliki ninye ninche.

English: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
Masaai: Eirorie ninye ninche te ng'ape e nkatampoi; neimbung ninche enchakenisho enye, o nena kiguanat apa naaishoo ninche.

English: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai ang, itawalikia iyie ninche; ira iyie Enkai napalaki ninche, hoo sii nira oloitalaku ntorrok enye.

English: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God is holy.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani Enkai ang, niserememe to ldoinyo lenye sinyati; amu kesinya Olaitoriani Enkai ang!

English: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te ng'ida, na kuapi pooki!

English: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
Masaai: Esiaayia Olaitoriani te nchipai! Wootu dukuya ninye to sinkolio!

English: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
Masaai: Entayiolo nchere Olaitoriani ninye Enkai! Ninye oitobira iyiook, nikira iyiook ilenyena; kira iyiook iltung'ana lenyena, o nkerra e nkirrita enye.

English: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
Masaai: Eimutu nchomito enyena nchooyoyo enashe, entijing ilgorieti lenyena te nkisisa! Enchoo ninye enashe, nisisisisi enkarna enye!

English: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
Masaai: Amu eisupat Olaitoriani; nebik enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi, nebikoo esupatisho enye too ishoritin pooki.

English: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
Masaai: Karanyisho nanu te nkaraki enkirukoto o esipata; iyie Olaitoriani nanu aranyaki.

English: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
Masaai: Kaibung nanu ina oitoi oo nkitoriorot. Oi kanu akenya ilotu enatii?

English: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
Masaai: Mapik nanu dukuya nkonyek aainei entoki ake pooki torrono. Kaiba nanu esiaai e lelo ooibelekenyate aaing'uaa Enkai; manyikaki nanu.

English: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
Masaai: Nchoo elamari oltau lo lwuasa te nanu; maata nanu enaporoki enkarruoisho.

English: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
Masaai: Ore ilo okur aitong'u ole latia enye too nkisudorot naa kaidaikie ninye. Ore ilo tung'ani oitokoos newuasa to ltau lenye, magirakino nanu.

English: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu omom lelo ooisiligayu te nkop, pee etum ninche aatobik te nebo nanu; ore ilo olo te nkoitoi nemetii entioto ninye laaisiaai nanu.

English: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani oas esunkureisho obik ti atua enkaji ai; meetae oltung'ani oiro elejare oton te dukuya nanu.

English: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore too nkakeny pooki naa kaidaikie nanu lelo pooki torrok te nkop, aiwuang'ie lelo pooki torrok te nkop aitung'uaa enkanasa o Laitoriani.

English: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
Masaai: toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani; nchoo enkishirata ai meeu enitii!

English: Hide not thy face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
Masaai: Mikisudorie iyie nanu enkomom ino te nkolong o sina lai! Irrugokoki enkiok ino tawalikiaki nanu tasioki teina olong naipotisho!

English: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
Masaai: Amu kelusoo nkolong'i aainei anaa empuruo, neyupuyup iloik laainei anaa olkokuet.

English: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
Masaai: Etooshoki oltau lai aapurd anaa olkujita netoyu, naarikino enkinosata e ndaa ai.

English: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki embuakunoto e nkishirata ai, neibiitiari osesen lai.

English: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
Masaai: Atotiwuo nanu anaa olkurragos li ong'ata onyaisho, anaa kokesena oo wuejitin neeliyio,

English: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
Masaai: kairrag nanu nemaapuku njo, atiu nanu anaa emotonyi naliyio te nchumata e nkaji.

English: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
Masaai: Ore endama pooki naainyal nanu ilmang'ati laainei, ore lelo laasukeny nanu neitaa enkarna ai oldeket.

English: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
Masaai: Amu nkuruon nanu ainos aitaa endaa, naitushulaki ilkiyio laainei ina naok,

English: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
Masaai: ore enkaraki empushuna ino o engoro ino; amu kitudumua nanu nikinang'aa.

English: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
Masaai: Etotiuo nkolong'i aainei anaa oloip le nteipa; atoyio nanu atiu anaa nkujit.

English: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Olaitoriani, itii olorika le nkitoo ntarasi; nebaiki enkarna ino iishoritin pooki.

English: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
Masaai: Idumunye iyie aing'urrie Sion; etabaua enkata pee ncho ninye omom, etabaua enkata apa nategaluaki.

English: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
Masaai: Amu iletipat isoito lenyena too sinkan linono, neing'urrie ninche enterit enye.

English: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
Masaai: Kepuo iloshon aaureyu enkarna o Laitoriani, neureyu ilaiguanak pooki enkitoo ino.

English: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
Masaai: Amu kelo Olaitoriani ashet Sion, neliooyu ninye te nkitoo enye;

English: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
Masaai: neshilaa ninye enkomono e ilo aisinani, nememenaa ninye enkomono enye.

English: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo meigeri kuna too ishoritin naapuonu, pee etum lelo tung'ana lemeino aaisisa Olaitoriani:

English: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
Masaai: nchere eing'ura ninye kop te ine wueji e shumata nesinya, te keper eing'ura Olaitoriani enkop,

English: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
Masaai: pee etum atoning'o olkiyioi loo looena, pee etum atalaai lelo ooigerokoki keeya;

English: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
Masaai: pee etum iltung'ana te Sion aaibalunyie enkarna o Laitoriani, neibalunyie enkisisa enye te Yerusalem,

English: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
Masaai: te neiturrurro iloreren te nebo, o nkitoriat, pee eserem Olaitoriani.

English: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
Masaai: Etigila ninye engolon ai te mpolos; eitodorropu ninye nkolong'i aainei.

English: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.
Masaai: “Iyie Enkai,” atejo nanu, “Mikiya nanu tene, te mpolos oo nkolong'i aainei, iyie olobikoo ilarin lenyena ti atua iishoritin pooki!”

English: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.
Masaai: Apa moitie iyie itipika olkitamanyunoto le nkop, ore keper naa esiaai oo nkaik inono.

English: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
Masaai: Neidak ninche, kake ibikoo iyie; keidaaya ninche pooki anaa ilkilani. Mbelekeny iyie ninche anaa nkilani neishari ninche.

English: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.
Masaai: Kake mimbelekenya iyie, nemeeta ilarin linono enkiting'oto.

English: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
Masaai: Ketoni nkera oo sinkan linono te seriani, ore eishoi enye naa keitasheyieki te dukuya iyie.

English: Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
Masaai: Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie lo tau lai, o pooki natii atua nanu, isisa enkarna enye sinyati!

English: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
Masaai: Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie lo tau lai, nimincho kirikino nkitaasat enyena pooki,

English: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
Masaai: ninye likipalaki nkitarruorrot inono pooki, ninye likinchiunye imueyiaritin inono pooki,

English: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
Masaai: ninye okordu enkishui ino aitung'uaa engumoto, ninye likinchopoki enyorrata enye nauno o lng'ur,

English: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
Masaai: ninye likintaraposh iyie too supati enkata naba anaa eninchu, metaa keitang'ejuki kitisho ino nitiu anaa olkurragos.

English: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oas isupati neisho isipat lelo ooitorogonyi.

English: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ninye oitayiolo Musa nkoitoi enyena, neitayiolo iasat enyena iltung'ana le Israel.

English: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
Masaai: Keeta Olaitoriani olng'ur naa aipirisioni, mesioki agoro neeta enyorrata nauno.

English: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
Masaai: Meisikong'isho ninye anaake, nemeibung engoro enye ntarasi.

English: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
Masaai: Meitaas ninye iyiook te risioroto oo ng'ok ang, nemeosh ninye iyiook te risioroto oo nkitarruorrot ang.

English: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
Masaai: Amu ore eneba anaa enalakuaniki keper enkop, neijia eba enkitoo e nyorrata enye nauno te lelo ooure ninye;

English: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Masaai: ore anaa enalakuaniki oloo saen oloontoluo, neijia eiko ninye aitalamaa nkitarruorrot ang te iyiook.

English: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaing'urrie olpayian nkera enyena, neijia eiko Olaitoriani eing'urrie lelo ooure ninye.

English: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
Masaai: Amu eyiolo ninye enkitobirunoto ang, edamu ninye ajo kira iyiook enterit.

English: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
Masaai: Ore ti alo tung'ani, etiu nkolong'i enyena anaa nkujit; kebul ninye anaa entapukai e ong'ata;

English: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
Masaai: amu kekutaa osiwuo nedung'ori alo, ore ewueji enye nemeitoki ayiolou.

English: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
Masaai: Kake ore ina nyorrata nauno o Laitoriani naa enoo ntarasi o ntarasi te lelo ooure ninye, neton esupatisho enye too nkera oo nkera enye,

English: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
Masaai: te lelo ooibung olning'o lenye nedamu aaibung nkitanapat enyena.

English: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
Masaai: Etipika Olaitoriani olorika lenye le nkitoo keper, naa enkitoria enye naitoreisho te pooki.

English: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani intae lo mailaika lenyena, intae kulo magil oas ororei lenye, entoning oltoilo lo rorei lenye!

English: Bless ye the LORD, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani, o lororani lenyena pooki lelo aisiaayiak lenyena oas eyieunoto enye!

English: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani, nasiaitin enyena pooki, too wuejitin enyena pooki e nkitoria enye, isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai!

English: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
Masaai: Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai! Olaitoriani Enkai ai, ira iyie kitok! Kinchopokoki iyie enkanyit o enkitoo,

English: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
Masaai: iyie oishopoki kewan ewang'an anaa olkila, iyie oisalaasha keper anaa olng'obor,

English: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
Masaai: iyie otipika ing'apeta e nkaji ino shumata nkariak, nintaa nkatampo engarri ino oo mbartan, niked inaipuko o siwuo,

English: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
Masaai: nintaa osiwuo ilkiliku linono, nintaa olang'at le nkima ilaisiaayiak linono.

English: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
Masaai: Iyie otipika enkop ilkitamanyunot lenyena, pee meigusugus ae kata.

English: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
Masaai: Nimulumul te nguton anaa olkila; neitashe nkariak too nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
Masaai: Ore te mbuakunoto ino neilanyisho ninche, ore to ltoilo le ndarata ino neilanyisho ninche.

English: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
Masaai: Neilepu ildoinyo, nedoyio ierat aagutu nepuo iwuejitin nitegelaka ninche.

English: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
Masaai: Itipika iyie ilpolosien lemegiroo ninche, pee meigil ninche aaiput enkop.

English: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie nkonyek oo nkariak meturukunye too erat; nenang'ari aaim irishat oo ldoinyo,

English: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
Masaai: neitook pooki ng'ues e ong'ata; neishu iloitikoishi enkure.

English: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
Masaai: Embata enye etipika ntaritik emanyisho enye; neranyisho ninche ti atua ilng'osil lenyena.

English: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
Masaai: Ore te wueji ino neika nintook ildoinyo enkare; netaraposhe enkop too lng'anayio le siaai ino.

English: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
Masaai: Iyie oitubulu nkujit te nkaraki nkishu, o nkaitubulu te nkaraki iltung'ana, pee etum ninye aitayu endaa te nkop,

English: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man's heart.
Masaai: o enaisho oo sabibu pee eitiship oltau le tung'ani, o eilata pee eitawang enkomom enye, o endaa pee eitagol enkishui e tung'ani.

English: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
Masaai: Etipikaki ilkeek lo Laitoriani enkare aaitaraposh, lelo tarakua le Lebanon apa ootuuno ninye.

English: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
Masaai: Te ninche eshetu ntaritik nkajijik; neeta ntilagosi nkajijik too lkeek sapuki oonyori.

English: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
Masaai: Netii nkineji oo soito ildoinyo aadoru, netii nkijijuri ndapidapo.

English: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
Masaai: Intobira iyie olapa pee eutu irishat; eyiolo enkolong erishata enye nadoyiorie.

English: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
Masaai: Ntobir iyie enaimin neaku kewarie, ina kata eikurtutari ing'uesi entim aapuo.

English: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
Masaai: Neipur ilkuoo loo lng'atunyo erreshisho, eing'oru endaa enye naing'uaa Enkai.

English: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eilepu enkolong nepuo ninche, neirrag ninche too rrumati lenye.

English: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
Masaai: Nelo tung'ani esiaai enye neas esinkaisho enye o memuto.

English: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kebaa enkumoi oo siaitin inono! Te ng'eno iyie intobira pooki; ebore enkop seuseu oo ntokitin inono.

English: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
Masaai: Idie etii enaiposha, naa kitok nelala, neuma ntokitin ti atua nemeikenayu ntokitin naaishu sapuki o nkutiti.

English: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
Masaai: Nepuo imelin te ine, o enkukuu naji Lefiatam nintobira iyie pee eiguran teine.

English: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.
Masaai: Iyie eing'or kuna pooki, pee incho ninche endaa enye too rishat enye.

English: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
Masaai: Ore te nincho iyie ninche, neiturrur ninche, te nilak iyie enkaina ino neiput ninche ntokitin sidain.

English: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
Masaai: Te nisudoo iyie enkomom ino, neidang ninche, ti niya enkiyang'et enye, neye ninche nerrinyokino enterit enye.

English: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
Masaai: Ti nirriu iyie Enkiyang'et lino, neitobiri ninche; nintang'ejuk iyie oriong enkop.

English: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
Masaai: Metobikoi enkitoo o Laitoriani ntarasi, metishipayu Olaitoriani too siaitin enyena,

English: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
Masaai: ilo laa te neing'or enkop neikirikira, ilo laa te neiseyie ildoinyo neitupuru!

English: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
Masaai: Karanyaki nanu Olaitoriani anaa naishu; arany nanu enkisisa e Nkai eton aata enkishui.

English: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
Masaai: Inchoo mikintishipa inkibirribirrat aainei amu Olaitoriani nanu ang'idakino.

English: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo ilaing'okok metumuti te nkop, naa inchoo ilarruok eishieki! Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai! Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalunye nkiaasin enyena ti atua iloreren!

English: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Masaai: Entaranyaki ninye, entaranyaki ninye enkisisa, embalunye nkiaasin enyena pooki e nking'asia.

English: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
Masaai: Enting'idata tiatua enkarna enye sinyati; nchoo iltauja le lelo ooing'oru Olaitoriani meting'idata.

English: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
Masaai: Eng'orutu Olaitoriani o engolon enye, eng'orutu entasho te dukuya ninye anaake!

English: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
Masaai: Entadamu isiaaitin e nking'asia naataasa ninye, mbaa enyena e nking'asia, o nkiguanat naairoro ninye.

English: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
Masaai: Na ishoi e Abraham osinka lenye, lo ayiok le Yakobo, lo gelunot lenyena!

English: He is the LORD our God: his judgments are in all the earth.
Masaai: Ninye Olaitoriani Enkai ang; etii nkiguanat enyena enkop pooki.

English: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
Masaai: Keibung ninye olning'o lenye ntarasi, te ilo rorei apa oitanapishe, too ishoritin naabaya enkalifu nabo,

English: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
Masaai: ilo ning'o apa oitobira ninye o Abraham, ilo mumai apa oinosa te nkaraki Isaak,

English: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:
Masaai: ilo apa oitudupayie te Yakobo pee eaku enkikoo, te Israel neaku olning'o loo ntarasi,

English: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
Masaai: ejo, “Kaaisho iyie enkop e Kanaan metaa erubata e njung'ore ino.”

English: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
Masaai: Apa aa kuti ninche oleng, neme toki, naa ilomon te ina kop,

English: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
Masaai: nelimana ninche too loshon pooki, nepuo te nkitoria o metabaiki likae orere,

English: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
Masaai: eitu ninye eisho oltung'ani meitorogonya ninche, eisikong'a ninye ilaiguanak te nkaraki ninche,

English: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
Masaai: ejo, “Miseyie ele lai ootubukokoki eilata aaput, minyal iloibonok laainei!”

English: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
Masaai: Te neipotu ninye olameyu meeu enkop, neiwuang'ie endaa pooki,

English: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
Masaai: neirriwayie ninye oltung'ani dukuya ninche, Yosef, ilo apa otimiraki aaitaa orrindik.

English: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
Masaai: Einyala ilpisia le enata nkejek enyena, nepiki emurt enye engotoo e sekenkei;

English: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
Masaai: ore anaa nebaya ina apa natejo ninye eitisipa ororei lo Laitoriani ninye.

English: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
Masaai: Eirriwayie olaiguanani olkilikuai metalakuni ninye, ore ilo oitore iloreren neisho ninye meshomo;

English: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
Masaai: eitaa ninye olkitok le nkaji enye, o Laitoriani loo masaa enyena pooki,

English: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
Masaai: pee eiteng'en ilkituaak lenyena anaa enayieu, neiteng'en ilpayiani lenye eng'eno.

English: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
Masaai: Nelotu sii Israel Misiri; nemany Yakobo enkop e Ham.

English: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
Masaai: Neitubul Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, neitagol ninche aitalang ilmang'ati lenye.

English: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
Masaai: Neibelekeny ninye iltauja lenye meibai iltung'ana lenyena, nepik isinkan lenyena olosek te nkeleekisho.

English: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
Masaai: Eirriwayie Musa osinka lenye o Aron laa ninye etegelua.

English: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
Masaai: Neyau nkitoduaat enyena atua iltung'ana, neyau inenking'asia atua enkop e Ham.

English: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
Masaai: Neirriu ninye enaimin neitomisimis enkop, negolong'u ninche aany irorei lenyena.

English: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
Masaai: Neibelekeny ninye inkariak enye aitaa osarge, near isinkir lenye metuata.

English: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
Masaai: Neiput enkop enye ntuaan e nkare, o metijing'a nkajijik oo laiguanak lenye.

English: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
Masaai: Eiroro ninye nelotu emus oo lojong'a, o lashe enkop enye pooki.

English: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
Masaai: Eirriwaka ninye ninche enchan oo soito o enkimerlel e nkima ti atua enkop enye pooki.

English: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
Masaai: Etoosho ninye isabibu o lng'abolo near ilkeek le nkop enye.

English: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
Masaai: Eiroro ninye nelotu olmaati, o nkiyioitin o lmaati nemeikenayu;

English: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
Masaai: naa ninche naaidaikie pooki toki nanyori te nkop, neinos ilng'anayio le nkop enye.

English: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
Masaai: Etoosho ninye ilkikaunot pooki le nkop enye, ilo ng'anayioi le dukuya le ngolon enye.

English: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye arikoo Israel te nkosholai o te sahabu, nemeetae obo te lelo loo loshon lenyena otarrorre.

English: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
Masaai: Neng'idayu Misiri ina kata pee edumunye ninche aapuo, amu etijing'a enkuretisho te nkaraki ninche.

English: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
Masaai: Neirriu ninye enkatampoi meitushura ninche, o enkima naitawang'aki ninche te nkewarie.

English: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
Masaai: Eikilikuanutua olorere endaa neirriwaki ninche nkurleen, neisho ninche imukateni naaing'uaa keper te nkumoi.

English: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
Masaai: Etabolo ninye endapidapoi nengorunye enkare; neruko aim olpurkel anaa olkeju.

English: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
Masaai: Amu edamu ninye enkisilgata enye sinyati, o Abraham osinka lenye.

English: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
Masaai: Neaku etorikoyie ninye iltung'ana lenyena te ng'ida, nerikoo lelo gelunot lenyena to sinkolio.

English: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
Masaai: Neisho ninye ninche nkuapi oo loreren; neya ninche aajung ilng'anayio le siaai oo ltung'ana,

English: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: pee etum ninche aaibung'a nkiguanat enyena, nejurru nkitanapat enyena.

English: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu eisupat ninye; amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi!

English: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
Masaai: Kaing'ae oidim aimaki mbaa e nking'asia o Laitoriani, arashu aitodolu enkisisa enye pooki?

English: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo ooing'oru isipat, lelo ooing'oru isipat nkatitin pooki!

English: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
Masaai: Tadamuaki nanu, Olaitoriani, tinintodolu omom too ltung'ana linono; taretoki nanu ti nikordu ninche;

English: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.
Masaai: pee atum atoduaa dupoto e lelo gelunot linono, pee atum ating'idayu te nchipai o losho lino, pee atum ating'idare enjung'ore ino.

English: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
Masaai: Ore iyiook o loo papa kitaasa eng'oki; kitaasa entorroni, kintarruoitie iyiook.

English: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
Masaai: Ore apa etii loo papa enkop e Misiri, neitu eshilaa isiaaitin inono e nking'asia; eitu ninche edamu eneba enyorrata ino nauno, kake etogolong'akita ninche Ilo otii Shumata Aisul te Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
Masaai: Kake eitajeuo ninye ninche te nkaraki enkarna enye, pee etum aibalunye engolon enye magilani.

English: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
Masaai: Eisikong'a ninye Enaiposha Nanyokie, netoyu; nerikoo ninye ninche aimie enguton etotiuo anaa olpurkel.

English: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
Masaai: Neaku eitajeuo ninye ninche te nkaina o lmang'atinta lenye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa engolon o lmang'atinta.

English: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
Masaai: Neimulumul nkariak ilmang'ati lenye; eitu ninye elo obo.

English: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
Masaai: Neiruk taa ina kata irorei lenyena; nerany enkisisa enye.

English: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
Masaai: Kake etorikine ninche nabo kata isiaaitin enyena; neitu ninche eanyu enkiguana enye.

English: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.
Masaai: Kake etijing'a ninche inguarrat torrok ti ong'ata, nepuo aatem Enkai to lpurkel;

English: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
Masaai: eishoo ninye ninche nena naatoomonutuo, kake eirriwaka ninche emueyian e saso.

English: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina kata too lng'oborri pee etum iltung'ana olom te nkaraki Musa o Aron, ilo sinyati lo Laitoriani,

English: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
Masaai: neng'a enkop enkutuk neijoo Datan, neimisie encholuek e Abiran.

English: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
Masaai: Eipang'aka sii enkima ina sholuek; nepejoo olang'at le nkima ilarruok.

English: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
Masaai: Eitobirutua ninche olashe te Horeb, neserem ina kitanyaanyukoto nasholuno.

English: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.
Masaai: Eibelekenya ninche enkitoo e Nkai aaitaa enkitanyaanyukoto o lkiteng oinos nkujit.

English: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
Masaai: Eitu ninche edamu Enkai Olaitajeunoni lenye, laa ninye apa otaasa mbaa sapuki te Misiri,

English: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
Masaai: o isiaaitin e nking'asia ti atua enkop e Ham, o mbaa naaitureisho te mbata Enaiposha Nanyokie.

English: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
Masaai: Neaku etejo ninye, keidaikie ninche - keitu ninye eitashe Musa, ilo gelunoti lenye, te dukuya ninye, pee eibelekeny ina goro enye napi pee meidaikie ninche.

English: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
Masaai: Nemenaa ninche ina kop sidai, nemeeta ninche enkirukoto too nkisiligat enyena.

English: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
Masaai: Neing'unyung'uny ninche too lng'oborri lenye, neitu ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani.

English: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eilepie ninye enkaina enye neiro olmumai ti alo ninche nchere keisho ninche metabatatata ti ong'ata,

English: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
Masaai: neisardaikie sii eishoi enye ti atua loreren, aidapashaki ninche nkuapi.

English: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaibung'are Baal e Peor, neinos nkishorot naatopolosakaki iloo tuata;

English: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
Masaai: neitagor ninche Olaitoriani too nkiaasin enye, nedoiki olmeitai ninche.

English: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
Masaai: Neitashe Finehas asaisho, neiwuang'ieki olmeitai.

English: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
Masaai: Neikenakini ninye ina aajo esipata too ishoritin pooki ntarasi.

English: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
Masaai: Neitagor ninche ninye too nkariak e Meriba, netum Musa enyamali te nkaraki ninche;

English: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
Masaai: amu etipika ninche enkishui enye emion, neiro ninye irorei le ngoro.

English: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:
Masaai: Neitu ninche eidaikie iltung'ana, anaa enaitanapa Olaitoriani ninche,

English: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
Masaai: kake etushulare ninche nkuapi neitamok ate easata anaa enataasa ninche.

English: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
Masaai: Neisiai ninche nena kitanyaanyukot enye, naa ninche naataa orreshet te ninche.

English: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
Masaai: Neyieng aapolos ilayiok lenye, o ntoyie enye aapolosaki iloiriruani;

English: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
Masaai: neibukoo ninche osarge lemeeta eleyiata, ilo sarge loo layiok lenye o ntoyie enye, apa naatopolosakitia nkitanyaanyukot e Kanaan, neisarkionieki ina kop te nkaraki ilo sarge.

English: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
Masaai: Neaku etaa enemesinya te nkaraki nena kiasin enye, neiborrie ninche onyek too nkiasin enye.

English: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
Masaai: Neirowuaju engoro o Laitoriani te nkaraki iltung'ana lenyena, neibayu ninye enjung'ore enye;

English: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
Masaai: neishooyo ninye ninche apik nkaik oo loreren, pee etum ilapa ooiba ninche aaitoria ninche.

English: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
Masaai: Neibooki ilmang'ati lenye ninche enkop, neyauni ninche aapik abori engolon enye.

English: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
Masaai: Ore nkatitin kumok netokordua ninye ninche, kake etogolong'utua ninche too otikinot enye, neitadouni ninche te nkaraki ntorrok enye.

English: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia etishilayie ninye osina lenye, ina kata pee eishir ninche.

English: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
Masaai: etadamua ninye te nkaraki ninche osotua lenye, neirridu ninye te risioroto e nyorrata enye nauno.

English: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
Masaai: Eishoo ninche meing'urrieki, lelo pooki apa ooibung'a ninche.

English: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.
Masaai: Ntajeu iyiook, Olaitoriani Enkai, ninturrurru iyiook aaitayu too loreren, pee kitum aaishoo enashe enkarna ino sinyati niking'idare enkisisa ino.

English: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, ebaiki ntarasi o ntarasi! Naa nchoo ejo iltung'ana pooki, “Esai!” Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu eisupat ninye; amu ore enyorrata enye nauno nebikoo ntarasi!

English: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
Masaai: Nchoo lelo ootokordua Olaitoriani metejo neijia, lelo ootokordua ninye aitayu ti atua enyamali

English: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
Masaai: neiturrur aitung'uaa nkuapi, aitung'uaa oloo saen o loo ntoluo, neitung'uaa moikuape o kopikop.

English: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
Masaai: Etilimanate embata aairrang'irrang to lpurkel, neitu etum enkoitoi nalo enkanasa nayeng'iyeng'areki;

English: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
Masaai: ore te nkaraki esumash o enkure, neiterre iltauja lenye ti atua ninche.

English: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani ti atua enyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa osina lenye;

English: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
Masaai: etorikoyie ninye ninche aimie enkoitoi naitoriori, o metabaiki enkanasa napuo aamany.

English: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Masaai: Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe, te nkaraki enyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ana!

English: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
Masaai: Amu keitaraposh ninye ilo oata enkure, ore ilo oisumash neiputaki ntokitin sidain.

English: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
Masaai: Etotona embata ti atua enaimin o ti atua oloip le keeya, neikenori ti atua isinaitin too sekenke,

English: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:
Masaai: amu etogolong'akitia ninche irorei le Nkai, nemenaa nkitanapat e Ilo otii Shumata Aisul.

English: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
Masaai: Neisinanuo iltauja lenye te nkaraki enkisiaayiare nagol; nebatata ninche, nemeetae oloret ninche.

English: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitayu ti atua isinaitin lenye;

English: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
Masaai: eyaua ninye ninche aitupuku ti atua enaimin o loip le keeya, negil iyenat enye tukul.

English: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Masaai: Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe te nyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ana!

English: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
Masaai: Amu etigila ninye nchomito o suyai nedung aitaa are eng'udi e sekenkei.
