English: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
Masaai: Etamueyia embata te nkaraki ing'ok enye, o te nkaraki entorroni enye netum isinaitin;

English: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
Masaai: neibayu iltauja lenye empukunoto pooki e ndaa, nenyikaki ninche kishomi e keeya.

English: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche aitung'uaa osina lenye;

English: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
Masaai: neirriu ninye ororei lenye, neishiunye ninche, nekordu ninche aitung'uaa enkidaata.

English: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Masaai: Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe te nkaraki enyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ana!

English: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
Masaai: Naa nchoo ninche eishooyo ilasarri le nashe, nelimu nkiasin enyena too sinkolioitin le ng'ida!

English: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
Masaai: Eshomo embata enaiposha too melin, aas biashara ti oriong nkariak kumok;

English: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
Masaai: nedol ninche nkiaasin o Laitoriani, isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia ti atua enguton.

English: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.
Masaai: Amu eitanapa ninye, neinyeyie olkutati ogol, otudumua ilopir le naiposha.

English: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
Masaai: Neilep ninche shumata, nedoyio aapuo enguton; nelepori iltauja lenye te nkaraki osina;

English: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit's end.
Masaai: nepuo ninche tenkiesies neiterriarri anaa lamerak, neiting eng'eno enye.

English: Then they cry unto the LORD in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani te nyamali enye, nekordu ninye ninche to sina lenye;

English: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
Masaai: neitigir ninye olkutati, neitirring'ieki ilopir le naiposha.

English: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
Masaai: Neng'idayu ninche enkaraki naitirring'ieki, neyau ninye ninche ewueji enye neyieu.

English: Oh that men would praise the LORD for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
Masaai: Nchoo eisho ninche Olaitoriani enashe te nkaraki enyorrata enye nauno, te nkaraki isiaaitin enyena e nking'asia too nkera e tung'ana!

English: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
Masaai: Nchoo eisis ninche ninye te umata oo ltung'ana, neisis ninye ti atua eumata oo lpayiani.

English: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
Masaai: Eibelekeny ninye ilkejek aitaa olpurkel, neibelekeny nchorroi aitaa enkop oo lbaat,

English: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
Masaai: neibelekeny enkop sidai aitaa ewueji e munyan nemebulu toki, te nkaraki enkarruoisho oo loomanya.

English: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
Masaai: Neibelekeny ninye olpurkel aitaa nchorroi oo nkariak, neibelekeny enkop natoyio oolbaat aitaa nchorroi oo nkariak.

English: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
Masaai: Neitamany ninye ine ilo oaata esumash, neshetu ninche enkanasa nabikie;

English: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
Masaai: etuuno ninche nkurman, neun nkurman oo sabibu netum enkisampuare kitok.

English: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
Masaai: Ore te mayianata enye nebul ninche oleng; nemeisho ninche nkishu enye engoroo.

English: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
Masaai: Naa te neitoki aang'oroo nedou esiana, te nkaraki enkibookinoto e nkop, o enyamali o osina,

English: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
Masaai: nebukoki ninye olmena lelo kituaak, neisho ninche metilimanata too nkoitoi misili;

English: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
Masaai: kake kedumu ninye aitasheyie olomena aitayu ti atua osina, neitaba ilmareita lenye anaa iluaat oo ntare.

English: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
Masaai: Ore lelo supati nedol neshipayu; ore lelo torrok neidang.

English: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ng'en, nchoo ening'u kuna baa; nchoo iltung'ana edamu enyorrata o Laitoriani nauno.

English: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
Masaai: Etuune oltau lai, Iyie Enkai, etuune oltau lai! Karanyisho nanu, naosh olkerempe! Tuputunye lo tau lai!

English: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
Masaai: Tuputunye na auo oo sinkolioitin o endule! Kainyototo nanu enasirie!

English: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe Olaitoriani, ti atua olorere, kaaranyaki nanu iyie enkisisa ti atua nkuapi.

English: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.
Masaai: Amu ore enyorrata ino nauno naa eikitok te keper, nebaiki isipat inono keper.

English: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
Masaai: Nchoo kirrepi iyie, Iyie Enkai, te keper! Nchoo enkitoo ino meeu shumata enkop pooki!

English: That thy beloved may be delivered: save with thy right hand, and answer me.
Masaai: Pee etumi aatokordu ilo kirotet lino, nchoru eretoto te nkaina ino e tatene, tawalikiaki nanu!

English: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
Masaai: Eisiligishore Enkai te wueji enye sinyati: ejo, “Ore te nkisisa kaor nanu Shekem, naorrior o yerata le Sukot.

English: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
Masaai: Enaai Gilead; enaai Manase; enkopiyia ai nagol e lukunya Efraim; eng'udi ai e nkitoria Yuda.

English: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
Masaai: Embesen ai naitukuoreki Moab; shumata Edom nanu aiteleiki nkejek aainei; te Filistia nanu abuaku te nkisulata.”

English: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Masaai: Kaing'ae laariku nanu enetii enkanasa nasheta? Kaing'ae laarik nanu Edom?

English: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
Masaai: Keitu iyie iyany iyiook Iyie Enkai? Milo iyie, Olaitoriani, te nebo ilmang'ati lang.

English: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Masaai: Nchoo siaake iyiook eretoto te nkaraki ilmang'ati lang, amu ene pesho eretoto e tung'ani!

English: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
Masaai: Ore etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyiook naa eikiaas mbaa sapuki; Olaitoriani ninye oitunyoki enkop ilmang'ati lang.

English: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
Masaai: Migira, iyie Enkai e nkisisa ai!

English: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
Masaai: Amu etaboloki nkutukie torrok e lejere te nkaraki nanu, pee eiro ti alo nanu mbaa e lejare.

English: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
Masaai: Naaitag'or ninche too rorei le nkiba, naarasaki ninche pesho.

English: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
Masaai: Enkitang'oroto ninche aalaakinye enyorrata ai, hoo duoo ninye te naomonoki ninche.

English: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Masaai: Neaku aatalaakitia ninche enkiba te nyorrata, o mang'atisho te nyorrata ai.

English: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
Masaai: Tegelu oltung'ani torrono metigilunore ninye, nchoo eiguanare ninye olaitang'oroni.

English: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
Masaai: Te neiguanareki ninye nchoo etumieki ninye enkitadiaata; nchoo enkomono enye eikenari aajo eng'oki!

English: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
Masaai: Metaa kuti nkolong'i enyena; metaa likae oya imasaa enyena!

English: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
Masaai: Metaa okishin nkera enyena, neaku enkoliai enkitok enye!

English: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
Masaai: Metaa iloorook kutukie nkera enyena; metaarari ninche aaipang'ie to lmuaate omanya!

English: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
Masaai: Meibung'a oloisileno apa ninye ntokitin enyena pooki, meidaikie ilomon ilng'anayio le nkinyinyiret enye!

English: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
Masaai: Metaa meetae hoo obo otumie ninye omom, anaa obo ninye oing'urrie nena kera enyena okishin!

English: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
Masaai: Meishieki eishoi enye; meimisieki enkarna enye te ishoi e are!

English: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
Masaai: Metadamuni entorroni oo loo menye te dukuya Olaitoriani, naa nchoo eaku meiwuang'ieki eng'oki e ngotonye aajutoo.

English: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eaku ketii dukuya Olaitoriani anaake; nchoo eiwuang'ieki endamunoto enye te nkop!

English: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa ninye edamu aitodolu esupatisho, kake etusujayie ninye olaisinani o ilo omena, o ilo otalepori oltau aar metuata.

English: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
Masaai: Enyor apa ninye atedekisho; nchoo ldeketa epuonu shumata ninye! Menyor apa ninye imayianat; metalama ninche ninye!

English: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
Masaai: Eishopoko ninye kewan ildeketa anaa olkila lenye, meibulu ninche osesen lenye anaa enkare, meima iloik lenyena anaa eilata!

English: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
Masaai: Metotiwuo anaa olkila oimulumulare ninye, metotiwuo anaa enkimeita naa ninye erretenare anaake!

English: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
Masaai: Metaa ena elaakinoto oo laitang'orok laainei naing'uaa Olaitoriani, te lelo ooiro ntorrok ti alo enkishui ai!

English: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai ai, taasisho te rishata ai te nkaraki enkarna ino; amu eisupat enyorrata ino nauno, tokorduaki nanu!

English: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu aisinani namena, netalepori oltau lai ti atua nanu.

English: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
Masaai: Aisha nanu anaa oloip le nteipa; aaipiripiroyioki nanu anaa olmaati.

English: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
Masaai: Etashala nkung aainei te nkaraki eenata empukoroto e kewan; netasasa osesen lai aaku iloik ake.

English: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
Masaai: Ataa naa enkikordo te lelo laaitang'or; te naadol ninche nanu neipirripir ilukuny enye.

English: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
Masaai: Taretoki, Olaitoriani Enkai ai! Ntajeuoki te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno!

English: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, LORD, hast done it.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche metayiolo nchere enkaina ino ena; iyie, Olaitoriani otaasa ena!

English: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche edekisho, kake tamayianisho iyie! Nchoo lelo ainyalak laainei meitukurruni; metishipayu osinka lino.

English: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
Masaai: Meishopokini ilaitang'orok laainei esulare; meimulumula ninche enkurruna enye anaa olkila.

English: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
Masaai: Ore te nkutuk ai kaisho Olaitoriani enashe sapuk; kaisis nanu ninye ti atua eumata.

English: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
Masaai: Amu eitashe ninye te nkaina e tatene e ilo omena, pee eitajeu ninye te lelo oiguanare pee ear metua.

English: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
Masaai: Etiaaka Olaitoriani olkitok lai: “Totona te nkaina ai e tatene, o metaba anaa napik ilmang'ati linono, abori nkejek inono.”

English: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
Masaai: Eirriwua Olaitoriani eing'uaa Sion eng'udi ino e nkitoria, nintoreisho te mpolos oo lmang'ati linono!

English: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana linono neishoru ate te nyorrata te ina olong nirikoo olorora lino te ilo doinyo sinyati. Ebaiki tadekenya enasirie ore anaa enkoileelio kelotu kitisho ino aikununye neijia.

English: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai, nemeibelekenya ninye, “Ira iyie olapolosani ntarasi, to lkerreti le Melkisedek.”

English: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
Masaai: Etii Olaitoriani enkaina ino e tatene; near ninye ilaiguanak te nkolong e ngoro enye.

English: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
Masaai: Kedung'oki ninye nkuapi enkiguana, neiput nkuapi mpopoki; near ninye ilaiguanak te ina kop nalala.

English: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
Masaai: Keokisho ninye too nchorroi naatii embata e nkoitoi; ore enkaraki ina keraposhu ninye endukuya enye.

English: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani. Kaisho nanu Olaitoriani enashe to ltau lai pooki, ti atua eumata oo supati, ti atua olturrur.

English: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
Masaai: Eikituaak isiaaitin o Laitoriani, neiteng'ena pooki ooshipakino.

English: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ebore enkanyit o enkitoo isiaaitin enyena, nebikoo esupatisho enye ntarasi.

English: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD is gracious and full of compassion.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye metadamuni isiaaitin enyena; aipirisioni Olaitoriani neeta olng'ur.

English: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
Masaai: Neisho ninye endaa lelo ooure ninye; merikino ae kata ninye osotua lenye.

English: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
Masaai: Eitoduaa ninye iltung'ana lenyena isiaaitin enyena, aisho ninche enjung'ore oo nkuapi.

English: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
Masaai: Ore esiaai oo nkaik enyena naa isipat o supati; ore nkiguanat enyena naa keirukoyu,

English: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
Masaai: eitasheyieki ntarasi o ntarasi, pee easi te sipata o te supatisho.

English: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
Masaai: Eirriwaka ninye enjeunoto iltung'ana lenyena; neitanapisho ninye to sotua lenye ntarasi. Eisinyati neitureisho enkarna enye!

English: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani enkiterunoto e ng'eno nagut; eeta eyiolounoto lelo pooki oasishore. Ebikoo enkisisa enye ntarasi!

English: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani. Emayiana ilo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani, ilo oshipakino oleng nkitanapat enyena!

English: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Masaai: Keaku eishoi enye magilani te nkop; ore eishoi e lelo supati naa kemayiani.

English: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
Masaai: Etii dupoto o karsisisho atua enkaji enye; ore esupatisho nebikoo ntarasi.

English: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
Masaai: Keilepaki ewang'an ti atua enaimin ilo supat; aipirisioni Olaitoriani, neeta olng'ur naa asipani.

English: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
Masaai: Eisupat ilo tung'ani oasisho te leng'on neishooyo te sile, ilo oas mbaa enyena too sipat.

English: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
Masaai: Amu meiwuang'ieki ae kata olasipani; kedamuni ninye ntarasi.

English: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
Masaai: Meure ninye elimunoto oo lomon torrok; keitashe oltau lenye auno, aisilig Olaitoriani.

English: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
Masaai: Keitirring'a oltau lenye, meureisho ninye, o metaba anaa nedol eyieunoto enye too lmang'ati lenyena.

English: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
Masaai: Eishooyie ninye pesho, eishoo ninye ilo aisinani; kebikoo esipata enye ntarasi; keishur emowuo enye te nkisisa.

English: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
Masaai: Nedol oltung'ani torrono ina negoro; neony ilala nelepori; ore eyieunoto oltung'ani torrono naa keish.

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Esisa, intae, isinyat lo Laitoriani, esisa enkarna o Laitoriani!

English: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
Masaai: Meisisi enkarna o Laitoriani ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi!

English: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.
Masaai: Ebaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong o metabaiki endoyioroto, keisisi enkarna o Laitoriani!

English: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
Masaai: Olaitoriani otii shumata alus too nkuapi pooki, nelusoo enkitoo enye te keper!

English: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
Masaai: Kaing'ae onyaanyukie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, natonita te shumata,

English: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
Masaai: neing'or ninye enkop elakuaniki ore etii keper neing'or enkop.

English: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
Masaai: Ninye odumu olaisinani too nkulukuok, nedumu olomena aitung'uaa olchala loo nkuruon,

English: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
Masaai: pee eisho ninche metotona te nebo ilkituaak, te nebo ilkituaak loo ltung'ana lenyena.

English: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Neisho ninye enkitok olupi ang, neitaa ninye entomononi nashipa naata nkera. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
Masaai: Ore apa pee epuo Isiraeli aaing'uaa Misiri, nelo enkaji e Yakobo aing'uaa olorere oiro enkutuk neme enenye,

English: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
Masaai: etaa Yuda ewueji enye sinyati, neaku Israel enkitoria enye.

English: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
Masaai: Neing'or enaiposha neilanyisho, nerrinyo olkeju le Yordan alo siadi.

English: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
Masaai: Neitigiran ildoinyo anaa ilmeregeshi, neitigiran ndoinyo anaa ilkuoo le kerra.

English: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?
Masaai: Kainyoo nikinosita iyie, enaiposha, pee isikita? O iyie, Yordan, eji pee itorrinye siadi?

English: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
Masaai: O intae, ildoinyo, pee ntigiranana anaa ilmeregeshi? O intae, ndoinyo, pee intigiranana anaa ilkuoo le kerra?

English: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;
Masaai: Nkirikirayu na kop, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya e Nkai e Yakobo,

English: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
Masaai: laa ninye oibelekeny endapidapoi aitaa enchorro e nkare, neitaa oltotoi ogol enkong'u e nkare.

English: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth's sake.
Masaai: Mme iyiook, Olaitoriani, mme iyiook, kake enkarna ino nchoo enkisisa, te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno o sipat inono!

English: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ejo loshon, “Koree Enkai enye?”

English: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
Masaai: Etii Enkai ang keper, neas ninye anaa enayieu.

English: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
Masaai: Ore nkitanyaanyukot enye naa enkosholai o sahabu, esiaai oo nkaik e tung'ana.

English: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
Masaai: Neeta nkutukie kake meiro; neeta nkonyek kake medolisho.

English: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
Masaai: Neeta nkiyaa kake mening'isho; neeta nkumeishin kake meing'uaisho.

English: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
Masaai: Neeta nkaik kake meirrapirrapisho, o nkejek, kake meyiolo aashom; nemeitayu oltoilo too lng'ejepa lenye.

English: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooitobira nenyaanyukie ninche; naa neijia etiu lelo pooki ooisilig ninche.

English: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Masaai: Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto enye naa ninye elong'o enye.

English: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Masaai: Na aji e Aron, tipika osiligi lino Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto enye naa ninye elong'o enye.

English: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
Masaai: Ntae kulo ooure Olaitoriani, esiliga Olaitoriani! Ninye eretoto enye naa elong'o enye.

English: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.
Masaai: Etadamua Olaitoriani iyiook; kemayian ninye iyiook; kemayian ninye enkaji e Israel; kemayian ninye enkaji e Aron;

English: He will bless them that fear the LORD, both small and great.
Masaai: kemayian ninye lelo ooure Olaitoriani, ilooti o lkituaak.

English: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
Masaai: metopona intae Olaitoriani, intae o nkera inyi!

English: Ye are blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Metamayiana intae Olaitoriani, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop!

English: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
Masaai: Ore keper naa eno Laitoriani, kake ore enkop neishoo ninye nkera e tung'ana.

English: The dead praise not the LORD, neither any that go down into silence.
Masaai: Meisis ilootuata Olaitoriani, nemeisis hoo obo le lelo oodoyio aapuo engira.

English: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
Masaai: Kake eikisis iyiook Olaitoriani ebaiki ena kata taata o ntarasi. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
Masaai: Anyor nanu Olaitoriani amu etoning'o ninye oltoilo lai o enkomono ai.

English: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
Masaai: Amu aairrugoko ninye nanu enkiok enye, ore enkaraki ina kaipot nanu ninye nkolong'i naaba anaa inaishu.

English: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
Masaai: Aatang'adutua nanu irresheta le keeya; aaibung'a nanu nkeenta emion kitok e nemeneng'a; natum nanu osina o emion.

English: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aipot enkarna o Laitoriani: “Olaitoriani, aatasayia nanu, ntajeu enkishui ai!”

English: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.
Masaai: Aipirisioni Olaitoriani, naa asipani; eeta Enkai ang olng'ur.

English: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
Masaai: Kegolie Olaitoriani olobor; ore pee aaibookini enkop, naaitajeu ninye.

English: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
Masaai: Torrinyokinoyu lo tau lai enkiyeng'iyeng ino; amu kimpirisie iyie Olaitoriani.

English: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
Masaai: Amu itokordua iyie enkishui ai te keeya, o nkonyek aainei too lkiyio, o nkejek aainei te rrorroto.

English: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
Masaai: Alo nanu te dukuya Olaitoriani ti atua enkop oo looishu.

English: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
Masaai: Aibung'a nanu enkirukoto ai, hoo ninye te natejo, “Aaisilisiloki nanu oleng”;

English: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
Masaai: natejo nanu te siokinoto ai, “Ilepesho iltung'ana pooki.”

English: What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
Masaai: Kainyoo nanu aisho Olaitoriani too nkishorot enyena pooki naaishoo nanu?

English: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Kang'amaa nanu enkikompe e njeunoto, naipot enkarna o Laitoriani,

English: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
Masaai: nalaaki Olaitoriani olmumai lai te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena pooki.

English: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
Masaai: Ene tipat te dukuya Olaitoriani keeya oo sinyat lenyena.

English: O LORD, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, ara nanu osinka lino, ara osinka lino, olayioni le nkaisiaayiani ino. Iyie otalaa ienat aainei.

English: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie olasar le nashe naipot enkarna o Laitoriani.

English: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people,
Masaai: Kalak nanu ilmuma laainei to Laitoriani te dukuya iltung'ana lenyena pooki,

English: In the courts of the LORD'S house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: too lgorieti le nkaji o Laitoriani, te mpolos ino, iyie Yerusalem. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani iloreren pooki! Esisa ninye intae iltung'ana pooki!

English: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Amu eikitok enyorrata enye nauno ti alo iyiook; ore esipata o Laitoriani mebikoo ntarasi. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, amu eisupat ninye; ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi!

English: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Nchoo Israel ejo, “Ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Nchoo nkaji e Aron ejo, “Ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo ooure Olaitoriani ejo, “Ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.”

English: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, and set me in a large place.
Masaai: Ti atua osina lai nanu aipoto Olaitoriani; naawaliki nanu Olaitoriani naalaku nanu.

English: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
Masaai: Ore etii Olaitoriani enkalo ai maureisho nanu. Kaa nanu aaidim oltung'ani aitaasa?

English: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
Masaai: Etii Olaitoriani enkalo ai pee aaretu nanu, kaing'or nanu te nkisulata lelo laaiba nanu.

English: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
Masaai: Enaikash te nesaruni Olaitoriani alang te neisiligi iltung'ana.

English: It is better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
Masaai: Enaikash te nesaruni Olaitoriani alang te neisiligi ilkituaak.

English: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
Masaai: Aatamana aamuat nanu iloreren pooki; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!

English: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
Masaai: Aatamana aamuat ninche nanu, naaimu too nchot pooki; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!

English: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
Masaai: Aatamana ninche anaa lotorok, neyupuyup anaa enkima oo lkiku; ore te nkarna o Laitoriani namir nanu ninche!

English: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
Masaai: Aaturrumoyioki nanu oleng, eyieu arriaa, kake aatareto Olaitoriani.

English: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
Masaai: Olaitoriani engolon ai naa osinkolio lai; etaa ninye enjeunoto ai.

English: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
Masaai: Enining'o isinkolioitin sidain le nkisulata ti atua ilng'oborri le lelo sinyat: “Te nkaina enye e tatene eas Olaitoriani e nking'asia,

English: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
Masaai: eilepieki enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, te nkaina enye e tatene eas Olaitoriani inenking'asia!”

English: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
Masaai: Maye nanu, kake kalo aishu, naiken nkiasin o Laitoriani.

English: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
Masaai: Aaitamio nanu Olaitoriani oleng, kake eitu ninye aapalaa matua.

English: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the LORD:
Masaai: Tabolokoki nanu nchomito oo sipat, pee atum nanu aima ninche nalo aisho Olaitoriani enashe.

English: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
Masaai: Ena ninye kishomi o Laitoriani; ninye eimu ilo asipani.

English: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe amu kitawalikia nitaa iyie enjeunoto ai.

English: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
Masaai: Ore ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak netaa ole ndukuya olmairroto.

English: This is the LORD'S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
Masaai: Enkiaas o Laitoriani ena; enking'asia too nkonyek ang.

English: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Masaai: Enkolong ena naitobira Olaitoriani; matishipakinoto niking'ida te ninye.

English: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
Masaai: Ntajeu iyiook, kitasayia iyie, Olaitoriani! Olaitoriani, kitasayia iyie, nchoo iyiook dupoto!

English: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani! Kimayian iyie too mayianat naaing'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: God is the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye Enkai, neishoo ninye iyiook ewang'an. Embung'a ilng'osil too lkererin ipuopuo, o entabaiki imouarak o lperere lo lasar!

English: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.
Masaai: Ira iyie Enkai ai, kaaisho nanu iyie enashe; ira iyie Enkai ai, naa kaarrep nanu iyie.

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Oi enchoo Olaitoriani enashe amu eisupat ninye; amu obikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo lemeeta ileyiat too nkoitoi enye, lelo oopuo too nkitanapat o Laitoriani!

English: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo ooibung enchakenisho enye, lelo ooing'oru ninye too ltauja lenye pooki,

English: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
Masaai: lelo lemeas entorroni, kake nkoitoi enyena epuoyie!

English: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
Masaai: Ntanapishe iyie too nkitanapat inono pee eibung'i ninche aakurraki.

English: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
Masaai: Oi naaji te neitashe nkoitoi aainei te nkibung'ata oo nkitanapat inono!

English: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.
Masaai: Nemaaitukurruni naa nanu, amu aipirakinye nkoitoi aainei nkitanapat inono.

English: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
Masaai: Kaaisis nanu iyie to ltau sidai te nayiolou nkiguanat inono naasipa.

English: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
Masaai: Kasuj nanu nkitanapat inono; mikinturraa nanu tukul!

English: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
Masaai: Kaji eiko olbarnoti pee eitisidan nkoitoi enyena? Tenegolie ninye te risioroto o rorei lino.

English: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
Masaai: To ltau lai pooki nanu aaing'oru iyie; mikincho nanu matalamari aing'uaa nkitanapat inono!

English: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
Masaai: Atushuma nanu ororei lino to ltau lai, pee maas ake eng'oki ti alo iyie.

English: Blessed art thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Mikisisi iyie Olaitoriani; nteng'enaki nanu nkitanapat inono!

English: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.
Masaai: Te nkutuk ai nanu aibalunye nkiguanat pooki naaing'uaa enkutuk ino.

English: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.
Masaai: Too nkoitoi e nchakenisho ino nanu ashipa anaa te neshipakinoi karsisisho sapuk.

English: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
Masaai: Kaibirribir nanu nkiguanat inono, naipirakinye nkonyek aainei nkoitoi inono.

English: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.
Masaai: Kashipakino nanu nkitanapat inono; maarikino nanu ororei lino.

English: Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.
Masaai: Ntaasa mbaa supati osinka lino, pee atum nanu ataa kaishu, nasuj ororei lino.

English: Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
Masaai: Taboloki nkonyek aainei pee atum atoduaa mbaa e nking'asia naaing'uaa enkitanapata ino.

English: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.
Masaai: Ara nanu olomoni te nkop, mikisudoriyie nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.
Masaai: Etalepori oltau lai te yieunoto oo nkiguanat inono nkatitin pooki.

English: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.
Masaai: Iyie oisikong'a iloowuasa, lelo oodiaa, lelo oolimana aaing'uaa nkitanapat inono;

English: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.
Masaai: iwuang'ie te nanu elap enye o lmena lenye, amu aibung'a nanu enchakenisho ino.

English: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
Masaai: Ore sii eirragita ilkituaak aarreshito nanu, nkiguanat inono ninche eibirribir osinka lino.

English: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.
Masaai: Enchakenisho ino naaitiship nanu, ninche naaiguen nanu aautaa.

English: My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.
Masaai: Eirruge oltau lai abaiki enkop; ntopiuoki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino!

English: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Te nairo nanu aimaki nkoitoi aainei, nikiwaliki iyie nanu; nteng'enaki nanu nkiteng'enat inono!

English: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu matayiolo asipu nkitanapat inono, naa kaibirribir nanu isiaaitin inono e nking'asia.

English: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.
Masaai: Etalepori oltau lai te nkaraki osina; ntagoloki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino!

English: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
Masaai: Ntalamaki nanu nkoitoi e lejare; ore te mpiris ino nteng'enaki nanu nkitanapat inono!

English: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.
Masaai: Ategelua nanu enkoitoi oo sipat, atipika nanu nkiguanat inono dukuya nanu.

English: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
Masaai: Aigarakine nanu shakenisho ino, Olaitoriani; mikincho nanu maaitukurruni!

English: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.
Masaai: Kalo nanu aipirri te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono ti nikintalalaki nanu eyiolounoto ai!

English: Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu, Olaitoriani, enkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono; naa kaibung nanu o metabaiki enkiting'oto.

English: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu eyiolounoto, pee atum aibung'a enkitanapata ino, nasipu to ltau lai pooki.

English: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Masaai: Torikoyioki nanu te nkoitoi oo nkitanapat inono, amu ninye ashipakino.

English: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
Masaai: Ntonyorra oltau lai enchakenisho ino, nimintonyor dupoto.

English: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.
Masaai: Mbelekenya nkonyek aainei pee meing'or mbaa e pesho, nikincho nanu enkishui too nkoitoi inono.

English: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.
Masaai: Ntudupa to sinka lino enkisiligata ino, naa ninye ene lelo likiure iyie.

English: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
Masaai: Mbelekenya ntung'uayioki ina sulare naure, amu eisupati nkitanapat inono.

English: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.
Masaai: Ng'ura, nkitanapat inono nanu aanyita; ore te supatisho ino nchooki nanu enkishui!

English: Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, even thy salvation, according to thy word.
Masaai: Nchoo ina nyorrata ino nauno elotu enatii nanu, Olaitoriani, nchoo enjeunoto ino elotu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino;

English: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
Masaai: pee atum taa enawalata te lelo laaikordod, amu ororei lino nanu aisilig.

English: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.
Masaai: Nimiwuang'ie ororei le sipata te nkutuk ai, amu ore osiligi lai netii atua nkiguanat inono.

English: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kaibung nanu nkitanapat inono anaake, ntarasi o ntarasi;

English: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
Masaai: naa kalo nanu te lakunoto, amu aing'orua nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
Masaai: kalo sii airo enchakenisho ino te dukuya ilaiguanak, nemaaitukurruni nanu;

English: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.
Masaai: amu too nkitanapat inono nanu atum enchipai, amu ninche nanu anyor.

English: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.
Masaai: Kayanyit nanu nkitanapat inono, amu ninche anyor, naa kaibirribir nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
Masaai: Tadamu ororei lino to sinka lino, laa ninye nanu kinchoo maisiliga.

English: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitagoloto ai te nkata o sina, nchere kaaisho nanu enkisiligata ino enkishui.

English: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
Masaai: Aasukenyita nanu oleng lelo lemeure Enkai, kake maibelekenya nanu aing'uaa enkitanapata ino.

English: I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.
Masaai: Te nadamu nanu nkiguanat inono ebaiki apa moitie, naitagoluo nanu, Olaitoriani.

English: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
Masaai: Aaibung'a nanu emion oleng te nkaraki lelo arruok, lelo ootanyaita nkitanapat inono.

English: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
Masaai: Nkitanapat inono naataa isinkolioitin laainei ti atua enkaji ai e omonisho.

English: I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.
Masaai: Adamu nanu enkarna ino kewarie, Olaitoriani, naibung nkitanapat inono.

English: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
Masaai: Aatadoikio nanu ena mayianata, nchere aibung'a nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Thou art my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye erubata ai; atonyorrayie nanu nchere kaibung nkitanapat inono.

English: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
Masaai: Ore to ltau lai pooki atonyuaa nanu aing'oru omom ino; ng'urrieki nanu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino.

English: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.
Masaai: Te nadamu nanu inkoitoi inono, naibelekeny nkejek aainei aipirie enchakenisho ino;

English: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
Masaai: naisarrisar nanu eitu aimutie aibung nkitanapat inono.

English: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.
Masaai: Ore ninye te naarresh nkeenta e ilo torrono, maarikino nanu enkitanapata ino.

English: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos e nkewarie naainyototo nanu aisis iyie, te nkaraki inkitanapat inono naasipa.

English: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.
Masaai: Ara nanu ole ncholuek e lelo likiure iyie, ole lelo ooibung nkitanapat inono.

English: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Ore enkop pooki, Olaitoriani, ebore enyorrata ino nauno; nteng'enaki nanu nkikuanat inono!

English: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
Masaai: Ntaasa iyie osinka lino isupati, Olaitoriani, te risioroto o rorei lino.

English: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu enkiguana sidai o eng'eno, amu airuko nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
Masaai: Ore apa eton eitu aaitamei natapong'ori nanu; kake aibung'a taata ororei lino.

English: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Ira iyie supat nias isupati, nteng'enaki nanu nkoitoi inono.

English: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.
Masaai: Ore lelo lemeure Enkai naaiteenikitia ninche elejare, kake aibung'a nanu to ltau lai pooki nkitanapat inono;

English: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
Masaai: meeta kulo tung'ana ening'unoto kake ashipakino nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.
Masaai: Eisidai apa te naaitamioki nanu, pee atum atayiolo nkitanapat inono.

English: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.
Masaai: Ore enkitanapata naing'uaa enkutuk ino naa eisidai alang nkalifuni e sahabu o enkosholai.

English: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.
Masaai: Nkaik inono naaitayutuo nanu naaitobiru; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto pee atum aiteng'enuo too nkitanapat inono.

English: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
Masaai: Ore lelo likiure iyie naadol nanu neng'idayu, enkaraki naisiliga nanu ororei lino.

English: I know, O LORD, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu, Olaitoriani, nchere nkiguanat inono naasipa, nayiolo nchere te sipata iyie kintamio nanu.

English: Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant.
Masaai: Nchoo enyorrata ino nauno etaanu pee aaitagol nanu, te risioroto e nkisiligata nisiligie osinka lino.

English: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.
Masaai: Nchoo olng'ur lino elotu enatii, pee atum nanu ataa kaishu, amu nkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu.

English: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.
Masaai: Nchoo meitukurruni lelo lemeure Enkai, amu aaiteenikitia ninche elejare; ore nanu, naa nkitanapat inono ninche aibirribir.

English: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo likiure iyie aaibelekenyakino nanu, pee etum aatayiolo enchakenisho ino.

English: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.
Masaai: Metaa meeta oltau lai entioto too nkitanapat inono, pee maaitukurruni nanu.

English: My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.
Masaai: Etalepori oltau lai eyieu enjeunoto ino; ororei lino nanu aisiligita.

English: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?
Masaai: Eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei aanyita enkisiligata ino; naikilikuanu ajo, “Kanu kenya kintagol nanu?”

English: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
Masaai: Atotiuo nanu anaa olbene le naisho oo sabibu otii atua empuruo, kake eitu ake aarikino nkitanapat inono.

English: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa engiri eanyisho osinka lino? Kanu iyie inguanare lelo laaisilisil nanu?

English: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.
Masaai: Aatuturokitio lelo lemeure Enkai ngumot, lelo tung'ana lemeibung nkitanapat inono.

English: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.
Masaai: Ore nkitanapat inono pooki naa kesipa, naaisilisil nanu iltung'ana te lejare; taretuoki nanu!

English: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.
Masaai: Enkiti wueji pee eitu aaishie nanu te nkop; kake eitu nanu aiturraa nkitanapat inono.

English: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.
Masaai: Ore te ina nyorrata ino nauno telekuaki nanu pee atum aibung'a enchakenisho e nkutuk ino.

English: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
Masaai: Ebikoo ororei lino, Olaitoriani, ntarasi te keper.

English: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho ino nebaiki iishoritin pooki; iyie oitayio enkop nintasheyie ninye.

English: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.
Masaai: Ore te nkitanapata ino neitashe ntokitin pooki o metabaiki ena olong; amu ore ntokitin pooki naa iyie eisiaai.

English: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.
Masaai: Te neme apa nkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu, anaata nanu aidaaiyie te nkitamioto ai.

English: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.
Masaai: Maarikino ae kata nanu nkitanapat inono; amu te ninche nanu kinchoo iyie enkishui.

English: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.
Masaai: Ara nanu olino, ntajeuoki; amu aing'orua nanu nkiteng'enat inono.

English: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.
Masaai: Eirragita ilarruok pee aaidaikie nanu; kake atadamua nanu shakenisho ino.

English: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu engorikinoto oo ntokitin pooki sidain, kake meeta inkitanapat inono eng'orikinoto.

English: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
Masaai: Ebaa enyorrata nanyor nanu nkitanapat inono! Ninye nanu aibirribir endama pooki.

English: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.
Masaai: Enkiteng'enata ino naaiteng'en nanu matalang'a ilmang'ati laainei, amu etii te nebo nanu nkatitin pooki.

English: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.
Masaai: Aata nanu eyiolounoto alang ilaiteng'enak laainei pooki, amu enchakenisho ino ninye nanu aibirribir.

English: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu mbaa oleng alang oltung'ani moruo, amu aibung'ita nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.
Masaai: Narishie nanu nkejek aainei pooki oitoi torrono, pee atum aibung'a ororei lino.

English: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.
Masaai: Maibelekenya nanu apaash nkitanapat inono, amu kinteng'ena iyie nanu.

English: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
Masaai: Kemelok oleng irorei linono te nainyorrinyor, kemelok aalang enaisho te nkutuk ai!

English: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.
Masaai: Ore too nkitanapat inono natum nanu eyiolounoto; ore enkaraki ina kaiba nanu pooki oitoi torrono.

English: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Masaai: Ore ororei lino naa oltaa loo nkejek aainei naa ewang'an te nkoitoi ai.

English: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.
Masaai: Ainosa nanu olmumai naitadedeyie pee atum atisipu inkitanapat inono naasipa.

English: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
Masaai: Anoto nanu osina kitok; nchooki nanu enkishui, Olaitoriani, te risioroto o rorei lino!

English: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
Masaai: Tang'amu nkishorot aainei e nkisisa, Olaitoriani, nikinteng'en nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.
Masaai: Aibung'ita nanu enkishui ai te nkaina ai anaake, kake eitu nanu aarikino nkitanapat inono.

English: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.
Masaai: Aatipikaka nanu oltorrono orreshet, kake mapaashari nanu alam nkitanapat inono.

English: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
Masaai: Enchakenisho ino ninye enjung'ore ai ntarasi; ee, ninche eng'ida o ltau lai.

English: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.
Masaai: Aibelekenya nanu oltau lai aipirie nkitanapat inono, ntarasi o metabaiki enkiting'oto.

English: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
Masaai: Aiba nanu iltung'ana ooing'ashing'ash, kake anyor nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
Masaai: Ira iyie enkisudoroto ai o elong'o ai; ororei lino nanu aisiliga.

English: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
Masaai: Entalamaki nanu intae ilarruok, pee atum aibung'a nkitanapat e Nkai ai.

English: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Masaai: Mbung'aki nanu te risioroto e nkisiligata ino, pee aton aishu, nimikincho nanu manoto enkurruna to siligi lai!

English: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.
Masaai: Mbung'aki nanu ilepieki, pee atum ataseriana, natum atishilai nkitanapat inono nkolong'i pooki!

English: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
Masaai: Itanya iyie lelo oopaash nkitanapat inono; ee, ore enkeleekisho enye naa pesho.

English: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.
Masaai: Ore ilarruok pooki le nkop niwuang'ie anaa isuut; ore enkaraki ina anyor nanu shakenisho ino.

English: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.
Masaai: Eikirikira osesen lai kiure iyie, naure nanu nkiguanat inono.

English: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.
Masaai: Ataasa nanu embae nasipa naishiaakino; mikipalaki nanu ilaitorogonyak laainei.

English: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
Masaai: Taa iyie olaitaishekinoni lo sinka lino te nkaraki isupati; mincho lelo lemeure Enkai aaibooki enkop.

English: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.
Masaai: Eiliilaitie nkonyek aainei aing'orita enjeunoto ino, naing'or enkitabaroto enkisiligata ino supat.

English: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Ntaasa osinka lino te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno, nikinteng'en nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.
Masaai: Ara nanu osinka lino; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto, pee atum atayiolo shakenisho ino!

English: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
Masaai: Etaa enkata naasisho Olaitoriani, amu etigilaki inkitanapat inono.

English: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
Masaai: Anyor nanu inkitanapat inono, aitalang sahabu, aitalang sahabu nasila.

English: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina aiturubare nanu iroruat aainei nkiguanat inono pooki; aiba nanu pooki oitoi torrono.

English: Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.
Masaai: Ene nking'asia enchakenisho ino; ore enkaraki ina neibung oltau lai ninche.

English: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
Masaai: Ore embolokinoto o rorei lino neyau ewang'an, neitaarriyian ilo lemeeta eng'eno.

English: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
Masaai: Aipang'ipang nanu ang'aita enkutuk, amu aanyita inkitanapat inono.

English: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu ing'uraki, niking'urrie nanu, anaa oshi ake enintaas lelo oonyor enkarna ino.

English: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Masaai: Ntirring'ie iroruat aainei te risioroto e nkisiligata ino, nimincho entorroni maaitoria nanu.

English: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
Masaai: Talakuaki nanu too ltung'ana laaibooki enkop, pee atum aibung'a nkitanapat inono.

English: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.
Masaai: Nchoo meitawang'aki enkomom ino osinka lino, nikinteng'en nanu nkitanapat inono.

English: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
Masaai: Eturukote nchorroi oo lkiyio too nkonyek aainei, enkaraki nemeibung iltung'ana enkitanapata.

English: Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.
Masaai: Ira iyie asipani, Olaitoriani, nesipa nkiguanat inono.

English: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.
Masaai: Itegelua iyie enchakenisho ino too sipat o te supatisho pooki.

English: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
Masaai: Aainosita nanu olom, enkaraki narikino ilmang'ati laainei irorei linono.

English: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
Masaai: Ore enkisiligata ino netetemaki oleng, nenyor osinka lino ninye.

English: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
Masaai: Ara nanu oti naatemenaki, kake maarikino nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.
Masaai: Ore esipata ino nesipa ntarasi, ore inkitanapat inono nesipa.

English: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.
Masaai: Eeuo enyamali o sina shumata nanu, kake inkitanapat inono naaitiship nanu.

English: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.
Masaai: Esipa enchakenisho ino ntarasi; nchooki nanu eyiolounoto pee aton aishu.

English: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.
Masaai: Aishirita nanu to ltau lai pooki; tawalikiaki nanu Olaitoriani! Kaibung nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu iyie; ntajeuoki nanu; pee atum atisipu enchakenisho ino.

English: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
Masaai: Adumunye nanu aishir enamanarie enkakenya, naishir te nkaraki eretoto; naisilig nanu irorei linono.

English: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
Masaai: Maiken nanu nkonyek enkewarie pooki, pee atum aibirribirra enkisiligata ino.

English: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
Masaai: Toning'o oltoilo lai te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno; Olaitoriani, ore te nkaraki isipat inono tagolie enkishui ai.

English: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.
Masaai: Etinyikutua lelo laaisilisil nanu too ntorrok; elakuaniki ninche nkitanapat inono.

English: Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
Masaai: Kake itaana iyie, Olaitoriani, nesipa nkitanapat inono pooki.

English: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.
Masaai: Atayiolo apa nanu moitie te nchakenisho ino nchere ntobira apa ninche ntarasi.

English: Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.
Masaai: Ing'ura iyie osina lai, nikikordu nanu, amu maarikino nanu enkitanapata ino.

English: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.
Masaai: Taa iyie liking'or nikilaku nanu; nchooki nanu enkishui te risioroto e nkisiligata ino!

English: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.
Masaai: Elakuaniki enjeunoto ilarruok, amu meing'oru ninche inkiguanat inono.

English: Great are thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments.
Masaai: Eikitok olng'ur lino, Olaitoriani; nchooki nanu enkishui te risioroto oo sipat inono.

English: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
Masaai: Kumok ilaisilisilok laainei o lmang'ati laainei; kake malimana nanu apaash enchakenisho ino.

English: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.
Masaai: Aaing'or nanu lelo lemeisiligayu te ngoro, amu meibung ninche inkitanapat inono.

English: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
Masaai: Toduaa eneba enyorrata nanyor nanu inkiguanat inono! Tagolie enkishui ai te risioroto e nyorrata ino nauno.

English: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ore esiana o rorei lino naa esipata, ore pooki ng'ae loo sipat oo inkiguanat inono nebikoo ntarasi.

English: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.
Masaai: Aaisilisil nanu ilkituaak metii emporeet, kake eitashe oltau lai eanyit irorei linono.

English: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.
Masaai: Ashipakino nanu ororei lino, anaa oltung'ani otum imasaa kumok.

English: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
Masaai: Aiba nanu namen entorroni, kake anyor inkitanapat inono.

English: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.
Masaai: Katitin naapishana nanu aaisis iyie te nkolong te nkaraki inkiguanat inono naasipa.

English: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
Masaai: Eeta eseriani kitok lelo oonyor enkitanapata ino; meetae entoki narror ninye.

English: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
Masaai: Aisiligita nanu enjeunoto ino, Olaitoriani, naas nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
Masaai: Eibung oltau lai enchakenisho ino; nanyor nanu enchakenisho ino oleng.

English: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.
Masaai: Aibung nanu inkiguanat inono o enchakenisho ino, amu etii nkoitoi aainei pooki dukuya iyie.

English: Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.
Masaai: Nchoo enkishirata ai elotu dukuya iyie, Olaitoriani; nchooki nanu ening'unoto te risioroto o rorei lino.

English: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
Masaai: Nchoo enkomono ai elotu dukuya iyie; tokorduaki nanu te risioroto o rorei lino.

English: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.
Masaai: Elimu enkutuk ai enkisisa ino amu kinteng'en nanu nkiteng'enat inono.

English: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
Masaai: Erany olng'ejep lai irorei linono, amu ore inkitanapat inono pooki nesipa.

English: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.
Masaai: Nchoo enkaina ino etaanu pee aaret nanu, amu ategelua nanu nkiguanat inono.

English: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law is my delight.
Masaai: Aanyita nanu enjeunoto ino, Olaitoriani, naa nkitanapat inono naaitiship.

English: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu aishu, pee aatum aisisa, naa nchoo nkiguanat inono aaret nanu.

English: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
Masaai: Ashomo nanu apong'ori anaa enker naimina; ing'oru osinka lino, amu maarikino nanu inkitanapat inono.

English: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
Masaai: Ore to sina lai aishiraka nanu Olaitoriani, pee aatum atawaliki nanu.

English: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
Masaai: “Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too ltung'ana le lejare, te ilo ng'ejep olejisho.”

English: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?
Masaai: Kainyoo kenya kinchori iyie? Naa kainyoo kenya kintokini aaitaas, iyie lo lng'ejep le lejare?

English: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Masaai: Mbaa naapi o lang'oroni, naaitagoloki too nkuk naaishu o lchani!

English: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
Masaai: Oi nanu, olomanya atua Meshek, obikito too lng'oborri le Kedar!

English: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.
Masaai: Atobiko te nkata naado ti atua lelo ooiba eseriani.

English: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
Masaai: Anyor nanu eseriani; kake te nairo naa lo larrabal ninche

English: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
Masaai: Araposhu nanu nkonyek aainei aing'or ildoinyo. Kaji eing'uaa eretoto ai?

English: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Olaitoriani eing'uaa eretoto ai, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop.

English: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
Masaai: Nemeisho ninye meigusugusieki enkeju ino, ore ilo likirrip iyie nemeimug.

English: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore ilo orrip Israel nemeimug nemeirura.

English: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye olarriponi lino; Olaitoriani ninye oloip lino te nkalo enkaina ino e tatene.

English: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
Masaai: Nimikiosh iyie enkolong te ndama, anaa olapa te nkewarie.

English: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
Masaai: Olaitoriani likirrip iyie too ntorrok pooki; naa kerrip ninye enkishui ino.

English: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
Masaai: Kerrip Olaitoriani enkipang'ata ino o enjing'unoto ino, ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi.

English: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Atishipe pee aajoki ninche, “Maape enkaji o Laitoriani!”

English: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eitasheito nkejek ang too nchomito inono, iyie Yerusalem!

English: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
Masaai: Yerusalem, nateshetaki anaa enkanasa, nateshetuaki meibung'ayu te nebo,

English: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.
Masaai: naa ninye eilep iloshon aapuo, lelo oshon lo Laitoriani, anaa apa enaitanapaki Israel, pee eisho enkarna o Laitoriani enashe.

English: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Masaai: Eirragieki ilorikan le nkiguana te ine, lelo orikan le nkitoo le nkaji e Daudi.

English: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
Masaai: Entoomon te nkaraki eseriani e Yerusalem! “Metubula lelo likinyor iyie!

English: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.
Masaai: Meeu eseriani isunta inono, nelotu erripoto atua iltaleta inono!”

English: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.
Masaai: Ore too lalashera laainei o le ncholuek ai, ajo nanu, “Metijing'a eseriani atua iyie!”

English: Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai ang, ekaing'oru nanu esupatisho ino.

English: Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
Masaai: Iyie nanu araposhoki nkonyek aainei, iyie olotonita to lorika le nkitoo te keper!

English: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the LORD our God, until that he have mercy upon us.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore anaa enaing'or nkonyek oo sinkan olkitok lenye, anaa enaing'or nkonyek enkaisiaayiani enkaina e eina naitore ninye, neijia etiu nkonyek ang eing'or Olaitoriani Enkai ang, o metaba anaa neing'urrie ninye iyiook.

English: Have mercy upon us, O LORD, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
Masaai: Ing'urrie iyiook, Olaitoriani, ing'urrie iyiook, amu kinoto iyiook nkisilisilot naalus.

English: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
Masaai: Te nkata naado eeta iltauja lang isukenyat e lelo ooisikarra, isukenyat e lelo oowuasa.

English: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, now may Israel say;
Masaai: Te neme apa Olaitoriani otii enkalo ang nchoo taa Israel ejo tena kata

English: If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
Masaai: te neme taa apa Olaitoriani otii enkalo ang, ina kata pee edumakino iyiook iltung'ana aagilunore,

English: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
Masaai: anaata etoijoitie ninche iyiook kinchu, ina kata pee eyupuyup engoro enye ti alo iyiook;

English: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
Masaai: naa anaata etooroyie iyiook oloirrag le nkare, anaata eimisie iyiook enkare;

English: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
Masaai: anaata eima ilopir le nkare shumata iyiook.

English: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani, amu eitu ninye eishooyo iyiook matotiu anaa eng'ues natarreshoki te rishata oo lala lenye.

English: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
Masaai: Kilanyishote iyiook anaa emotonyi te ilo rreshet lo larreshoni etigile orreshet, nikilanyishote iyiook.

English: Our help is in the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
Masaai: Etii eretoto ang atua enkarna o Laitoriani, laa ninye oitobira keper o enkop.

English: They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooisilig Olaitoriani netiu anaa oldoinyo le Sion, lemeidimi aaigusugusie, kake ebik ninye ntarasi.

English: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
Masaai: Ore anaa enamanita ildoinyo Yerusalem, neijia etiu Olaitoriani emanita iltungana lenyena, ebaiki ena kata o intarasi.

English: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
Masaai: Amu melotu eng'udi e nkitoria e lelo arruok shumata ina kop natudung'okoki isupati pee meitorioo ake isupati nkaik enye aas entorroni.

English: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
Masaai: Ntaasa isupati, Olaitoriani, lelo oonyor isupati, o lelo supati too ltauja lenye!

English: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ooibelekenya aapuo aaim nkoitoi enye naalojiloja, nelo Olaitoriani arikoo ninche te nebo lelo torrok! Meeu eseriani Israel!

English: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
Masaai: Ore apa pee errinyu Olaitoriani lelo ootaarayioki le Sion, nikitiu iyiook anaa ilooidetidet.

English: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
Masaai: Neitoki enkuenia aiput nkutukie ang, neiput ilng'ejepa lang mbuakunot e ng'ida; nejo ninche ti atua nkuapi, “Etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki te nkaraki ninche.”

English: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
Masaai: Etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki te nkaraki iyiook; kitishipate iyiook.

English: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
Masaai: Torrinyu lelo lang apa ootaarayioki, Olaitoriani, meikununye anaa nchorroi e Negeb!

English: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo oounisho too lkiyio eisampu too mbuakunot e ng'ida!

English: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
Masaai: Ore ilo olo eishirita, enapita olantererai olo aun, nelotu ang too mbuakunot e ng'ida, enapita enkisampuare enye.

English: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
Masaai: Te neitu eshet Olaitoriani enkaji, ore lelo ooshet pesho eekenya. Te neitu errip Olaitoriani enkanasa, ore lelo oorrip pesho eshololo.

English: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
Masaai: Te mpesho inyototo intae tadekenya, nimutietie eitu ipuopuo aairura, ninosinoso endaa osina; amu eisho ninye ilo onyor lenye njo.

English: Lo, children are an heritage of the LORD: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
Masaai: Ng'ura, nkera ninche enjung'ore naing'uaa Olaitoriani, ore nkera naa nkishorot naaing'uaa ninye.

English: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
Masaai: Ore nkera naatum oltung'ani te kitisho, netiu anaa mbaa te nkaina olmurrani

English: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani oiputa emootian enye mbaa! Medol ninye enkurruna te neirorie ilmang'ati lenyena te kishomi.

English: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
Masaai: Emayiana pooki ng'ae oure Olaitoriani, ilo olo too nkoitoi enyena!

English: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.
Masaai: Amu inos iyie ilng'anayio le nkisiayiare oo nkaik inono; ishipayu iyie neaku sidain mbaa ti alo iyie.

English: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.
Masaai: Naa ketiu enkitok ino anaa olchani loo lng'anayio ti atua enkaji ino; netiu nkera inono anaa nkaitubulu oo loirienito emanita emesa ino.

English: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, neijia eikunakini emayianata eilo tung'ani oure Olaitoriani.

English: The LORD shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
Masaai: Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani etii Sion, toduaa iyie dupoto e Yerusalem, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ino!

English: Yea, thou shalt see thy children's children, and peace upon Israel.
Masaai: Tobikoi toduaa nkera oo nkera inono! Meeu eseriani Israel!

English: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:
Masaai: “Aaisilisilo ninche nkatitin kumok ebaiki kitisho ai,” nchoo Israel ejo -

English: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
Masaai: “Aaisilisilo ninche nkatitin kumok ebaiki kitisho ai, kake eitu aaisulu ninche.

English: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
Masaai: Ore ilaturok netuturo ninche enkoriong ai, neitoodor ninche ilbaat lenye.”

English: The LORD is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani naa olasipani; etudung'o ninye nkeenta e ilo arruoni.

English: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooiba Sion, nchoo meitukurruni nerrinyi siadi!

English: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:
Masaai: Metotiuo ninye anaa olkujita otii shumata e nkaji, ilo otoyu eton eitu ebulu,

English: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.
Masaai: ilo lemeiput enkaina o ladung'oni, lemeaku erridata te ilo oenisho.

English: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore lelo oogiroo nemejo ninche, “Meeu emayianata o Laitoriani shumata iyie! Kimayian intae te nkarna o Laitoriani!”

English: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
Masaai: Ti atua enguton aaishiraka nanu, Olaitoriani!

English: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, toning'o oltoilo lai! Nchoo nkiyiaa inono meinining'o oltoilo le sayiata ai!

English: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
Masaai: Amaa, tenaa isir intorrok ang, Olaitoriani, kanaata aa ng'ae oidim aitasho?

English: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
Masaai: Kake iata iyie empalikinoto pee kitumi aatureita.

English: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
Masaai: Aanyita nanu Olaitoriani, ninye eanyu oltau lai naa ororei lenye nanu aisiliga.

English: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
Masaai: Eanyita oltau lai Olaitoriani alang eanyunoto naanyu ilarripok enkakenya, elusoo te anyunoto naanyu ilarripok enkakenya.

English: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
Masaai: Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani! Amu Olaitoriani etii enyorrata nauno, naa ninye etii enkordunoto kitok.

English: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.
Masaai: Naa kekordu ninye Israel too ntorrok enye pooki.

English: LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, eitu epashipashu oltau lai, neitu eshumunye nkonyek aainei aaing'or shumata; maitanyamal nanu kewan too mbaa kituaak o too mbaa e nking'asia te nanu.

English: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
Masaai: Kake aitirring'ie nanu naitobir oltau lai, anaa enkerai naitigiraki to lkina le ng'otonye; etotiuo oltau lai anaa enkerai naitigiraki.

English: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
Masaai: Iyie Israel, isiliga Olaitoriani ebaiki ena olong o ntarasi.

English: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
Masaai: Tadamu, Olaitoriani, te nkaraki Daudi, ilo sina pooki apa onoto ninye;

English: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
Masaai: einosa ninye olmumai to Laitoriani, neinos ninye olmumai te ilo magilani le Yakobo,

English: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
