Masaai: “Majing nanu atua enkaji ai nemajing endapash ai;

English: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
Masaai: maiken nanu nkonyek aainei airura nemaimug aimul nkonyek aainei,

English: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
Masaai: o metaba anaa naing'uraki Olaitoriani ewueji, ewueji nebikie ilo magilani le Yakobo.”

English: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
Masaai: Ng'ura kitoning'o iyiook te Efrata, nikitum iyiook too nkong'at e Yaar.

English: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
Masaai: “Maape iyiook emanyisho enye; mateserem iyiook ti abori nkejek enyena!”

English: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
Masaai: Tudumunye, Olaitoriani, shomo ewueji ino e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, iyie o sanduku lino le nkidimata.

English: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
Masaai: Nchoo meishopokini ilapolosak linono esupatisho, naa nchoo isinyat linono metabuaku te ng'ida.

English: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki osinka lino Daudi mimbelekeny enkomom e ilo lino otubukokoki eilata aaput.

English: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani ti alo Daudi olmumai le dede, nemeitoki ninye aibelekenya te ilo mumai: “Ore obo loo layiok lo sesen lino naa kaitotonie nanu olorika lino le nkitoo.

English: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
Masaai: Te neibung ilayiok linono olning'o lai o enchakenisho ai nalo nanu aiteng'en ninche, ore sii ilayiok lenye ntarasi nepuo aatonie olorika lino le nkitoo.”

English: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
Masaai: Amu etegelua Olaitoriani Sion; etonyorra ninye aitaa emanyisho enye:

English: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
Masaai: “Ewueji ai nayeng'iyeng'are ena ntarasi; ene nanu abikie amu atonyorra nanu ene.

English: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Masaai: Naa kamayian nanu ndaiki enyena oleng; naitaraposh lelo aisinak lenyena too ndaiki.

English: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak lenyena naishopoki enjeunoto, ore isinyat lenyena naisho mbuakunot e ng'ida.

English: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
Masaai: Ore te ine naisho nanu emowuo e Daudi meishuro; aitobira nanu oltaa te nkaraki ilo otubukokoki eilata aaput.

English: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
Masaai: Ore ilmang'ati lenyena naishopoki enkurruna, kake ore te dukuya enye neishopokini enkopiyia e nkitoo naikishiaan.”

English: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
Masaai: Ng'ura, kebaa esidano o enchipai te netoni ilalashera to lning'o!

English: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron's beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
Masaai: Etiu anaa eilata nagol enkinyang'a te ndukuya, eruko ajing olmunyei, ajing olmunyei le Aron, eruko adoiki emurt olkila lenye!

English: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the LORD commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
Masaai: Etiu anaa enkoileelio e Hermon, nadoiki ildoinyo le Sion! Amu te ine eitanapishe Olaitoriani imayianat, enkishui ntarasi.

English: Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Wootu, maisisa Olaitoriani, intae isinkan pooki lo Laitoriani, lelo ooitashe kewarie ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani!

English: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
Masaai: Elepie nkaik inyi te ine wueji sinyati, esisa Olaitoriani!

English: The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
Masaai: Mikitamayiana Olaitoriani etii Sion, ilo oitobira keper o enkop!

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the name of the LORD; praise him, O ye servants of the LORD.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani. Meisisi enkarna o Laitoriani, enchoru enkisisa intae isinkan lo Laitoriani,

English: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God,
Masaai: intae lelo ooitashe ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, too lgorieti le nkaji e Nkai ang!

English: Praise the LORD; for the LORD is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani, amu aisupat Olaitoriani; enterrep enkarna enye, amu ninye aipirisioni!

English: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
Masaai: Amu etegelaka Olaitoriani kewan Yakobo, etegelua Israel aitaa olenye.

English: For I know that the LORD is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu ajo eikitok Olaitoriani, nayiolo nchere etii Olaitoriani lang te shumata nkaitin pooki.

English: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
Masaai: Ore enaba anaa enayieu Olaitoriani neas ninye te keper o te nkop, ti atua inaaiposha o too neegut pooki.

English: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.
Masaai: Ninye oishoo nkatampo meilepa too neeiting'ie enkop, ninye oitobira nkiwuang'at te nkata e nchan neyau olkutati aitung'uaa nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki.

English: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
Masaai: Ninye apa otara ilkikaunot le Misiri metuata, o lenkiteng o le ng'ues;

English: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
Masaai: laa ore ti atua empolos ino, iyie Misiri, neirriu nkitoduaat e nking'asia, agilunore Farao o sinkan lenyena pooki,

English: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
Masaai: Ninye apa ilo otoosho nkuapi kumok nesesekuan ilaiguanak magil,

English: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
Masaai: Sihon, olaiguanani le Amori, o Oog, olaiguanani le Bashan, o nkitoriat pooki e Kanaan,

English: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
Masaai: neishooyo enkop enye aitaa enjung'ore, enjung'ore too ltung'ana lenye loo siraeli.

English: Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.
Masaai: Ebikoo enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, ntarasi o ntarasi, ira iyie ning'oti ti atua iishoritin pooki.

English: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
Masaai: Amu keitasheyie Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena too sipat, neing'urrie isinkan lenyena.

English: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin oo nkuapi naa enkosholai o sahabu, isiaaitin oo nkaik e tung'ana.

English: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
Masaai: Eeta ninche nkutukie, kake meiro, eeta nkonyek kake medolisho,

English: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
Masaai: Eeta nkiyiaa kake mening'isho, nemeeta enkiyang'et too nkutukie enye.

English: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.
Masaai: Metotiwuo anaa ninche lelo ooitobiru ninche! ee metotiwuo neijia pooki ng'ae oisilig ninche!

English: Bless the LORD, O house of Israel: bless the LORD, O house of Aaron:
Masaai: Na aji e Israel, esisa Olaitoriani! Na aji e Aron, esisa Olaitoriani!

English: Bless the LORD, O house of Levi: ye that fear the LORD, bless the LORD.
Masaai: Na aji e Lawi, isisa Olaitoriani! Intae kulo ooure Olaitoriani, esisa Olaitoriani!

English: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Esisa Olaitoriani te Sion, ilo obikito le Yerusalem! Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe amu eisupat ninye, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo enashe Enkai oo nkaitin, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo enashe Olaitoriani loo laitoriak, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: ilo laa ninye ake oas ine nking'asia sapuki, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: ilo oitobira keper te nkarriyiano, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: ilo oisalaasha enkop natoyio te shumata nkariak, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: ilo oitobira iwang'aritin sapuki, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: neitobir enkolong meitoria endama, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: neitobir olapa o lakir meitoria enkewarie, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: ilo apa otara metuata ilkikaunot le Misiri, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: neipang'unye Isiraeli aitung'uaa atua ninche, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: te nkaina nagol naitoriori, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: ilo oiperra Enaiposha Nanyokie aitaa are, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: neisho Isiraeli meima atua ninye, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: kake etusulayie Farao o lorora lenye ti atua Enaiposha Nanyokie, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Ilo otorikoyie iltung'ana lenyena ti ong'ata, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: ilo otasesekuana ilaiguanak kituaak, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: near to lalem ilaiguanak ning'ot, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: Sihon, olaiguanani le Amori, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: o Oog, olaiguanani le Bashan, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: neishooyo enkop enye metaa enjung'ore, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: enjung'ore to sinka lenye Israel, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Masaai: Ninye otadamua iyiook apa kishal, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: nekordu iyiook aitung'uaa ilmang'ati lang, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi;

English: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: ninye oisho endaa ntokitin pooki naaishu, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Masaai: Enchoo enashe Enkai e keper, amu ebikoo enyorrata enye nauno ntarasi.

English: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
Masaai: Too mbat oo lkejek le Babilon iyiook kitotoni, te ine iyiook kinchira kidamu Sion.

English: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Too lkeek ootaaniki ine kitiika iyiook nkinantani ang.

English: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
Masaai: Amu ore apa te ine, ore lelo ootaaraitie iyiook, neyieu nikiranyaki ninche osinkolio, ore lelo ooisilisil iyiook, nejo, “Entaranyaki iyiook obo loo sinkolioitin le Sion!”

English: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land?
Masaai: Kaji iyiook kinko te nikirany osinkolio le Nkai te nkop eiking'a?

English: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
Masaai: Te naarikino nanu iyie, Yerusalem, nchoo enkaina ai e tatene etoyu!

English: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Masaai: Meibung'a olng'ejep lai enoret e nkutuk ai, te nemaadamu nanu iyie, te nemapik nanu Yerusalem aitulus te nchipai ai pooki!

English: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
Masaai: Tadamu, Olaitoriani, ti alo iltung'ana le Edom, ina batatata apa e Yerusalem, etejo apa ninche, “Endaikie ninye, endaikie ninye! Entigil o metabaiki olkitamanyunoto!”

English: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
Masaai: Na tito e Babilon, iyie naainyalani! Emayiana ilo oing'oru te iyie ina apa nintaasa iyiook!

English: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo oitayu nkera inono kutiti nenang'ie ninche endapidapoi!

English: I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, to ltau lai pooki; ore te dukuya nkaitin narany nanu enkisisa ino;

English: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.
Masaai: airrugo nanu aing'or enkaji ino sinyati naisho enashe enkarna ino te nkaraki enyorrata ino nauno o esupatisho ino; amu ilepie aitulus te pooki enkarna ino o rorei lino.

English: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong naaipoto nanu, nikitawalikia, ore engolon ai oltau nikitoponikia.

English: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O LORD, when they hear the words of thy mouth.
Masaai: Ore laiguanak pooki le nkop naa eikisis iyie, Olaitoriani, amu etoning'o ninche irorei le nkutuk ino;

English: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of the LORD: for great is the glory of the LORD.
Masaai: naa kepuo ninche aarany isinkolioitin loo nkoitoi o Laitoriani, amu aikitok enkitoo o Laitoriani.

English: Though the LORD be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo netii Olaitoriani shumata, keing'or ninye, keing'or ninye ilo obor; ore ilo owuasa neyiolo ninye elakua.

English: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
Masaai: Ore ninye te nalo aim empolos e nyamali, igolie ake enkishui ai; intorioo iyie enkaina ino aibooyo engoro napi oo lmang'ati laainei, naa enkaina e tatene naakordu nanu.

English: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
Masaai: Keitabaya Olaitoriani enyorrata enye te nanu; ore enyorrata ino nauno, Olaitoriani, ebikoo ntarasi. Minturraa iyie esiaai oo nkaik inono.

English: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kitujurro iyie nanu nikitayiolo nanu!

English: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie enkata naton o enkata nadumunye; imusu iyie ndamunot aainei ilakua.

English: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.
Masaai: Ijurru iyie enkoitoi ai o enkirragata ai, niyiolo iyie oleng nkoitoi aainei pooki.

English: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.
Masaai: Ore ninye eitu elotu ororei ajing olng'ejep lai, ng'ura, Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie pooki.

English: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.
Masaai: Kitamana nanu te siadi o te dukuya, ninteleikia enkaina ino shumata nanu.

English: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
Masaai: Ore ena ng'eno naa eikitok oleng te nanu; etii shumata, maidim nanu aibung'a.

English: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
Masaai: Kaji nanu alo pee ailany Enkiyang'et ino? Anaa kaji nanu alo pee aailany iyie?

English: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
Masaai: Te nailep nanu alo shumata, itii iyie ine! Te naitobir nanu endapash ai te nemeneng'a itii iyie ine!

English: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
Masaai: Te nalo nanu too naipuko e nkakenya, nalo amany enaiposha

English: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
Masaai: ore sii te ine naa enkaina ino naarikoo, naa enkaina ino e tatene naaibung nanu.

English: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
Masaai: Te najo nanu, “Ncho maaitemoi nanu enaimin, ore ewang'an naamanita nanu neaku enkewarie,”

English: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
Masaai: ore ninye enaimin nememisimis te iyie, kewang enkewarie anaa endama; amu etiu enaimin anaa ewang'an te iyie.

English: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.
Masaai: Iyie oitobira osesen lai ti atua, iyie likiruburuba nanu ti atua enkoshoke e yieyio.

English: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
Masaai: Aaisis nanu iyie amu iyie eurei naa iyie olenking'asia. Inenking'asia isiaaitin inono! Kiyiolo iyie nanu oleng;

English: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
Masaai: meisudoro enkidikidikoto o sesen lai te iyie, ina kata pee aaitobiruni nanu te nkisudoroto, ina kata aaitubuluni nanu te nguton e nkop.

English: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
Masaai: Naaing'or nanu nkonyek inono eton eitu aaku toki; neigero te mbuku ino inkarn e pooki, nena olong'i pooki naategeluaki eton eitu ebau.

English: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
Masaai: Kebaa tipat oo ndamunot inono te nanu, iyie Enkai! Kebaa enkumoi enye!

English: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
Masaai: Te naiken nanu ninche, nelang osinyai. Te nainyototo nanu, natii ake te nebo iyie.

English: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.
Masaai: Oi naaji te naa isesekuan olarruoni, Iyie Enkai, pee aatum nanu iltung'ana lo sarge aatalam,

English: For they speak against thee wickedly, and thine enemies take thy name in vain.
Masaai: lelo tung'ana torrok likikeshare iyie, lelo ooilepie ate te ntorroni likigilunore te ntorroni!

English: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?
Masaai: Aimaiba nanu lelo likimba iyie, Olaitoriani? Aimamen nanu lelo likigilunore iyie?

English: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
Masaai: Kaiba nanu ninche oleng, aitaa nanu ninche ilmang'ati laainei.

English: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
Masaai: Tujurroki nanu, iyie Enkai, niyiolou oltau lai! Ineneng'aki nanu niyiolou ndamunot aainei!

English: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
Masaai: Nidol tenaa ketii enkoitoi torrono atua nanu, nikirikoo nanu te nkoitoi ntarasi!

English: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too ltung'ana torrok, tagolieki nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal,

English: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
Masaai: te lelo ooitobir nkitobirat torrok too ltauja lenye, nedumu ninche olarrabal anaake.

English: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders' poison is under their lips. Selah.
Masaai: Eitipij ninche ilng'ejepa lenye anaa ilasuriaa, ore nkutukie enye netii esayiet oo nturbubuani.

English: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
Masaai: Torripoki nanu, Olaitoriani, too nkaik e ilo torrono; tagolieki nanu too ltung'ana lo larrabal, te lelo ooitobira pee eitapong'oo nkejek aainei.

English: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
Masaai: Eisudoitie lelo oowuasa oreshet te nkaraki nanu, neitoluaa ninche too nkeenta orreshet, ore te mbata e nkoitoi aatipikakita ninche orreshet.

English: I said unto the LORD, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
Masaai: Atiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ai; toning'o oltoilo le nkomono ai, Olaitoriani!

English: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lai, olakordunoni lai ogol, intoipo iyie endukuya ai te nkolong o larrabal.

English: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
Masaai: Minchooyo iyie, Olaitoriani, iyieunot e ilo torrono; mintabaya ina yieunoto enye e ntorroni!

English: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
Masaai: Ore lelo laamanita nanu neshumu ilukuny enye, nchoo ina torroni oo nkutukie enye meibung'a ninche!

English: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
Masaai: Nchoo metusulakinoto ninche nkuk naairowua! Nchoo ninche metusulakini ngumot, nemeigil ae kata aailepu!

English: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
Masaai: Nchoo ilo oiro mbaa torrok eaku megolu ae kata te nkop; nchoo entorroni metanang'ie enkop oltung'ani lo larrabal!

English: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu ajo keitobir Olaitoriani mbaa e ilo oata osina, nedung enkiguana e ilo omena.

English: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
Masaai: Esipa keisho ilo supat enkarna ino enashe; ore ilo supat nebik ninye te dukuya iyie.

English: LORD, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.
Masaai: Aaipoto nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, tasioku enatii nanu! toning'o oltoilo lai, te naaipot nanu iyie!

English: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
Masaai: Nchoo enkomono ai meikenari anaa enkorropil te dukuya iyie, ore enkilepata oo nkaik aainei neikenari anaa olasar le nteipa!

English: Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
Masaai: Tipika olarriponi enkutuk ai, Olaitoriani, torripo enkutuk ai, Olaitoriani!

English: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
Masaai: Mincho oltau lai metonyorra entorroni, pee aitanyamal kewan too nkiasin torrok te ncholuek oo ltung'ana oas ntorrok; nimikincho nanu mainosa ndaiki enye e sikar!

English: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
Masaai: Nchoo oltung'ani supat maatoosho, naaisikong te supatisho, kake mincho ae kata eilata e ilo torrono metipiki endukuya ai, amu ore enkomono ai e anaake negilunore nkiasin enye torrok.

English: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
Masaai: Ore te neishoori ninche aaitarasaki lelo oodung'oki enkiguana, nepuo taa aayiolou nchere kesipa ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore anaa osoit oidong'ishoreki te neiper enkop, neijia etiu iloik lenye eidapasha te nkutuk e nemeneng'a.

English: But mine eyes are unto thee, O GOD the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
Masaai: Kake iyie eing'or nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani Enkai; te iyie nanu aing'oru esarunoto; miking'uaa nanu maata olaamitu!

English: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
Masaai: Ntalamaki nanu ilo rreshet laairragakinye ninche nanu, o too rresheta loo laasak loo ntorrok!

English: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
Masaai: Nchoo ilarruok metadoiki pooki rresheta lenye maate, napuku nanu ailanyisho.

English: I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu to ltoilo lai, Olaitoriani, ore to ltoilo lai naomon Olaitoriani.

English: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
Masaai: Atubukuo nanu osina lai te dukuya ninye, nalimu nanu enyamali ai te dukuya ninye.

English: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
Masaai: Te neiterre oltau lai, niyiolo iyie enkoitoi ai! Ore te ina oitoi naaim nanu eisudoitie ninche orreshet te nkaraki nanu.

English: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
Masaai: Aing'ura nanu enkalo e tatene, naing'orisho, kake metii hoo obo laaing'or nanu, meetae esarunoto te nanu, meetae oltung'ani laashilaa nanu.

English: I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu iyie, Olaitoriani; najo, Ira iyie esarunoto ai, ira erubata ai te nkop oo looishu.

English: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
Masaai: Toning'o enkishirata ai; amu aaitadoyioki nanu oleng! Tokorduaki nanu te lelo laaisilisil; amu egol ninche oleng te nanu!

English: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.
Masaai: Ntupukuoki nanu ti atua korokoroni, pee atum aishoru enashe te nkaraki enkarna ino! Naaman nanu lelo supati; amu kintaasa iyie isupati o ne lengon.

English: Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.
Masaai: Toning'o enkomono ai, Olaitoriani; nchoo metoning'o nkiyiaa inono eomonokinoto ai! Ore te nkaraki isipat inono tawalikiaki nanu ti atua esupatisho ino!

English: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
Masaai: Minguenare iyie osinka lino, amu meetae oltung'ani hoo obo oishu oata esipata te dukuya iyie.

English: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
Masaai: Amu aatimira nanu olmang'atinta; negiligil enkishui ai aoshie enkop; naaisho ninye matotona te naimin anaa lootuata.

English: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neiterre oltau lai ti atua nanu; ore oltau lai ti atua nanu neiputukunyo.

English: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
Masaai: Adamu nanu nkolong'i e apa, naibirribir nanu nena apa nitaasa; naing'asia te siaai oo nkaik inono.

English: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
Masaai: Naaitorioki nanu nkaik aainei; nikiatayie oltau lai enkure anaa enkop natoyio.

English: Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
Masaai: Tasioki tawalikiaki nanu, Olaitoriani! Amu eiterria oltau lai! Mikisudorie nanu enkomom ino, matiu ake anaa lelo oopuo aajing engumoto.

English: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
Masaai: Nchooki nanu matoning'o tadekenya ina nyorrata ino nauno, amu iyie nanu atipika osiligi lai. Nteng'enaki nanu enkoitoi naaim, amu iyie nanu ailepakinye oltau lai.

English: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu, Olaitoriani, too lmang'ati laainei! Iyie nanu akuetikia asaru!

English: Teach me to do thy will; for thou art my God: thy spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
Masaai: Nteng'enaki nanu mataasa eyieunoto ino, amu ira iyie Enkai ai! Nchoo oltau lino supat maatorikoi nanu te nkoitoi naitoriori!

English: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, Olaitoriani, tagolie enkishui ai! Ore te supatisho ino ntayioki nanu ti atua enyamali!

English: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.
Masaai: Naa ore te nyorrata ino nauno iwuang'ie ilmang'ati laainei, nindaikie ilmang'ati laainei pooki, amu ara nanu osinka lino.

English: Blessed be the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
Masaai: meisisi Olaitoriani, endapidapoi ai, laa ninye oitaarriyian nkaik aainei to larrabal, neitayiolo ilkimojik laainei olarrabal;

English: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
Masaai: endapidapoi ai naa osempewuet lai, enkisudoroto ai naa olakordunoni lai, elong'o ai naa ninye ilo lasaru nanu, laa ninye opik iloreren abori ninye.

English: LORD, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kainyoo tung'ani lishilaa ninye, anaa enkerai e tung'ani eji nidamu ninye?

English: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.
Masaai: Etiu oltung'ani anaa enkiyang'et, etiu nkolong'i enyena anaa oloip oloito.

English: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
Masaai: Irrugu keper ino, Olaitoriani, nilotu adou! Iseyie ildoinyo pee epuru!

English: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
Masaai: Imerlelie nkiwang'at nindapashaa ninche, ning'oru mbaa inono aitanyamal ninche!

English: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
Masaai: Ntorioi enkaina ino te keper, tokorduaki nanu nikintayu nanu ti atua nkariak kumok, ntung'uayioki nkaik oo leeiking'a,

English: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
Masaai: lelo ooiro elejare too nkutukie enye, laa ore enkaina enye e tatene, naa enkaina e tatene e lejare.

English: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
Masaai: Naa kaaranyaki nanu iyie osinkolio ng'ejuk, Iyie Enkai; te nkauo oo sinkolioitin naata iusin tomon nanu aaranyaki iyie,

English: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
Masaai: iyie oisho ilaiguanak meisula, iyie otokordua Daudi osinka lino.

English: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
Masaai: Tokorduaki nanu te ilo alem torrono, nikikordu nanu aitung'uaa enkaina e lelo leeiking'a, lelo ooiro elejare too nkutukie enye, laa ore enkaina enye e tatene naa enkaina e tatene e lejare.

English: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
Masaai: Metotiwuo ilayiok lang te lelero enye anaa nkaitubulu naatubulutua aabaya, metotiutu ntoyie ang anaa ing'apeta oo lmairrot, naatudung'uoki pee eshetieki enkaji e nkitoo o laiguanani;

English: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
Masaai: metaboreita nkajijik ang naashumishoreki meiputa mpukunot pooki oo ntokitin; metubula nkerrai ang, aaku nkalifuni o nkalifuni tomon too ndaat;

English: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
Masaai: menoto nkishu ang oloing'oni, nemetum olkibiroto anaa ae torroni; metaa metumi olkiyioi lo sina too nkoitoi ang!

English: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the LORD.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo tung'ana ootum ena mayianata! Emayiana iltung'ana laa Enkai ninye Olaitoriani lenye!

English: I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Kaarrep nanu iyie, Enkai ai, Olaiguanani, naisis enkarna ino ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore nkolong'i pooki naaisis nanu iyie, naisis enkarna ino ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
Masaai: Kitok Olaitoriani, naa kitok enkisisa enye, ore enkitoo enye nemelimunoyu.

English: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.
Masaai: Neinosakino iishoritin o lajijik isiaaitin inono, neibalunye ninche nkiasin inono sapuki.

English: I will speak of the glorious honour of thy majesty, and of thy wondrous works.
Masaai: Enkishiaa e nkitoo ino, enking'asia oo siaitin inono ninche nanu aibirribir.

English: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.
Masaai: Neibalunye iltung'ana enkidimata oo nkiasin inono, naibalunye nanu enkitoo ino.

English: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.
Masaai: Nebuku ninche ening'oi e supatisho ino, nerany ninche aabuaku isinkolioitin le supatisho oo sipat inono.

English: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
Masaai: Aipirisioni Olaitoriani neeta olng'ur, mesioki agoro nebore enyorrata nauno.

English: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
Masaai: Eisupat Olaitoriani te pooki, ore olng'ur lenye netii shumata nena pooki naaitobira ninye.

English: All thy works shall praise thee, O LORD; and thy saints shall bless thee.
Masaai: Ore isiaaitin inono pooki naa eikincho iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, ore isinyat pooki nikiisis iyie!

English: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, and talk of thy power;
Masaai: Neiro ninche aaimaki enkitoo e nkitoria ino, nelimu engolon ino,

English: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
Masaai: neitayiolo nkera e tung'ana nkiasin inono e ngolon, o enkishiaa kitok e nkitoria ino.

English: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
Masaai: Ore enkitoria ino naa enoo ntarasi, nebikoo enkitoo e nkitoria ino too ishoritin pooki. Asipani Olaitoriani too rorei lenyena pooki, naa aipirisioni too nkiasin enyena pooki.

English: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
Masaai: Eibung Olaitoriani airishu lelo pooki oobatata, nedumu ailepunye lelo pooki oolepokino enkop.

English: The eyes of all wait upon thee; and thou givest them their meat in due season.
Masaai: Iyie eing'or nkonyek e pooki, nincho iyie ninche endaa too rishat enye.

English: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
Masaai: Ilak iyie enkaina ino, nintaraposh pooki toki naishu.

English: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
Masaai: Asipani Olaitoriani too nkoitoi enyena pooki, naa supat too iasat enyena pooki.

English: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
Masaai: Etaana Olaitoriani te pooki ooipot ninye, te pooki ooipot ninye te sipata.

English: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Masaai: Eitabaya ninye iyieunot e pooki ooure ninye, nening sii olkiyioi lenye, neitajeu ninche.

English: The LORD preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
Masaai: Egolie Olaitoriani lelo pooki oonyor ninye, kake ore iltorrok pooki naa keidaikie ninye.

English: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
Masaai: Keiro enkutuk ai enkisisa o Laitoriani, nchoo pooki naaishu eisis enkarna enye sinyati ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
Masaai: meisisi Olaitoriani! Isisa Olaitoriani lo tau lai!

English: While I live will I praise the LORD: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.
Masaai: Kaisis nanu Olaitoriani nkolong'i naaba anaa naishu; arany nanu enkisisa e Nkai ai eton aishu.

English: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.
Masaai: Mipik osiligi lino ilkituaak, mipik atua tung'ani lemetii eretoto atua ninye.

English: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
Masaai: Te nepuku enkiyang'et enye nerrinyokino ninye enkop; ore te ina olong neish nkitobirat enyena.

English: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
Masaai: Emayianaa ilo laa Enkai e Yakobo ninye eretoto enye, laa Olaitoriani Enkai osiligi lenye,

English: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keepeth truth for ever:
Masaai: ilo oitobira keper o enkop, o enaiposha o pooki naatii atua; ilo ooibung enkirukoto ntarasi;

English: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners:
Masaai: ilo oiguanare too sipat oloitorogonyaki; ilo laa ninye oitoti olooisumash. Olaitoriani olaaya ilooena;

English: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind: the LORD raiseth them that are bowed down: the LORD loveth the righteous:
Masaai: Olaitoriani obol ilmodook nkonyek. Olaitoriani odumu ailepunye ilootalepokinote enkop; enyor Olaitoriani ilo asipani.

English: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
Masaai: Errip Olaitoriani ilo omoni, neibung ninye enkoliai o ilo lemeeta menye, kake ore enkoitoi e ilo torrono neyau ninye enkidaata.

English: The LORD shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Olaitoriani olo aitoreisho ntarasi, Enkai ino, iyie Sion, too ishoritin pooki. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Praise ye the LORD: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Amu eisidai te neranyakini enkisisa e Nkai ang; amu kaaipirisioni, naa keishiaakino osinkolio le nkisisa.

English: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
Masaai: Olaitoriani oshet Yerusalem; neiturrurru ilooidapashari apa le Israel.

English: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
Masaai: Neishiunye ilootigilate iltauja, neen ilbaa lenye.

English: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
Masaai: Neiken ninye neyiolou esiana oo lakir, neisho ninche pooki nkarn enye.

English: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
Masaai: Kitok Olaitoriani lang naa kitok engolon enye; ore eng'eno enye nemeimakinoyu.

English: The LORD lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.
Masaai: Edumu Olaitoriani oloitunyokoki enkop, nenang'ie olarruoni enkop.

English: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani ninchosho enashe; entaranyaki Olaitoriani to lwulul loo usin kumok!

English: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.
Masaai: Eimulumul ninye keper too nkatampo, neitobir ninye enchan pee eshaiki enkop, neitubulu ninye nkujit too ldoinyo.

English: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
Masaai: Ninye oisho ing'uesi e ntim ndaiki enye, neisho nkiyoitin oo motonyi naaishir endaa.

English: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.
Masaai: Ore enchipai enye neme engolon e mbarta, neme nkejek e tung'ana eng'idare;

English: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
Masaai: kake lelo ooure ninye eshipakino Olaitoriani, lelo ooisilig enyorrata enye nauno.

English: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
Masaai: Isisa Olaitoriani, iyie Yerusalem! Isisa Enkai ino, iyie Sion!

English: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.
Masaai: Amu ninye oitagol isenkenke loo nchomito inono; ninye omayian ilayiok linono ootii atua iyie.

English: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.
Masaai: Ninye oitaserian ilpolosien linono; ninye oiputaki intae enkano sidai.

English: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
Masaai: Ninye oirriwaki enkop inkitanapat enyena; nelo ororei lenye asiooyo.

English: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoar frost like ashes.
Masaai: Neishoru empaso naikununo anaa enturoto; neisalaashaki enkinuku enkop anaa nkuruon.

English: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
Masaai: Neyau ninye isoito le nchan anaa ilbelibelat, kalo oidim aitasheiki enkirobi enye?

English: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
Masaai: Ninye oirriu ororei lenye, neshol lelo soito; neisho osiuo lenye metukutunye, neruko nkariak.

English: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.
Masaai: Eibalakinyie ninye Yakobo ororei lenye, eibalakinye inkiguanat o nkitanapat enyena Israel.

English: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Eitu ninye eas ena te likae osho, meyiolo ninche nkitanapat enyena. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise ye the LORD from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Meisisi Olaitoriani te keper, meisisi ninye te wueji e shumata!

English: Praise ye him, all his angels: praise ye him, all his hosts.
Masaai: Esisa ninye ilmalaika lenyena pooki, esisa ninye ilororani lenyena pooki!

English: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
Masaai: Esisa ninye enkolong o lapa, esisa ninye intae ilakir pooki oowang!

English: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
Masaai: Isisa ninye iyie keper nalakua, o intae nkariak naatii shumata keper!

English: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for he commanded, and they were created.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eisis enkarna o Laitoriani! Amu ninye apa oitanapishe, neitobir ninche.

English: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
Masaai: Naa ninye oitasheyie ninche ntarasi o ntarasi, naa ninye oitayio enkitanapata enye nemeibelekenya.

English: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani te nkop, o iyie enaiposha o ntokitin pooki naatii atua,

English: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
Masaai: enkima o enchan oo soito, o empaso, o lkutati lo siwuo oitabaya enkitanapata enye!

English: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
Masaai: Ildoinyo o ndoinyo pooki, ilkeek loo lng'anayio o ltarakua!

English: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
Masaai: Ing'uesi o nkishu pooki, ntokitin naaiserpepiari te nkop o motonyi naapuo tiaai!

English: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
Masaai: Ilaiguanak le nkop o ltung'ana pooki, ilkituaak o laitoriak le nkop pooki!

English: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
Masaai: Ilbarnot o selenken te nebo, iltung'ana moruak o nkera te nebo!

English: Let them praise the name of the LORD: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eisis enkarna o Laitoriani amu enkarna enye ake kitok; etii enkitoo enye shumata keper o enkop.

English: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye meishuro emowuo oo ltung'ana lenyena, esisa te nkaraki isinyat lenyena pooki, te nkaraki iltung'ana loo Siraeli ootaaniki ninye. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, entarany enkisisa enye te umata oo supati!

English: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Masaai: Nchoo Israel eshipakino ilo oitobira ninye, nchoo ilayiok le Sion eshipakino Olaiguanani lenye!

English: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye eisis enkarna enye neinoe, neranyaki ninye te ntampuri o to lwulul loo usin kumok.

English: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
Masaai: Amu keshipakino Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena; neikod ninye olobor te nkisulata.

English: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo supati metishipata te nkitoo; nchoo ninche eranyisho te ng'ida too ndapashi enye.

English: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
Masaai: Nchoo enkisisa kitok e Nkai ejing iltoiloishi lenye, nejing ilalema oopi nkaloli pokira nkaik enye,

English: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
Masaai: pee eitalaku elap too loshon neitame lelo lemeure Enkai,

English: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
Masaai: pee een ilaiguanak lenye too lpisia neen lelo kituaak lenye too sekenke,

English: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: pee edung'oki ninche enkiguana naigero! Enkitoo ena te lelo pooki lenyena supati. Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
Masaai: Meisisi Olaitoriani! Meisisi Enkai ti atua ewueji enye sinyati; meisisi ninye to loing'ang'e lenye kitok!

English: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye too nkiasin enyena sapuki; meisisi ninye te risioroto e nkitoo enye sapuk!

English: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye to ltoilo le ntarumpeta; meisisi ninye te ndule o te nkawuo oo sinkolioitin!

English: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye te ntampuri o te nkinoyata o sinkolio; meisisi ninye too usin o te nkinanta nakuti!

English: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
Masaai: Meisisi ninye te nkinanta naru oleng; meisisi ninye te ndarata e nkinanta!

English: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo pooki toki naata enkiyang'et eisis Olaitoriani! Meisisi Olaitoriani!

English: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
Masaai: Indung'eta e rashe kuna e Solomon, olayioni le Daudi, olaiguanani le Israel.

English: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
Masaai: Etisiraki kuna dung'eta e rashe pee etum iltung'ana aatayiolo eng'eno o enkiteng'enare, nening'u irorei oogut le ng'eno,

English: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
Masaai: neng'amu enkiteng'enare te ng'eno naretisho, neng'amu esipata, o enkiguana nasipa, o emborron.

English: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
Masaai: Pee etumi aishoo eng'eno sidai olmodai netum ilbarnot eng'eno naiyiolounye eneikunari te nkishon.

English: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
Masaai: Ore sii ninye oltung'ani ng'en nening neponaa eyiolounoto, ore oltung'ani oota ening'unoto, netum anoto enkarriyiano sapuk.

English: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
Masaai: Pee itum atoning'u endung'et e rashe, o enkipirta enye, o lelo rorei loo lang'eni o loyietiaa lenye.

English: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa ninye enkiterunoto e ng'eno; eany ilmoda eng'eno o utarot.

English: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
Masaai: Toning'o enkerai ai enkikoo e papaai lino, nimiany enkiteng'enare e yieyioo lino;

English: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
Masaai: amu keaku nena utarot enkishili te ndukuya ino, neaku olpisiai te murt ino.

English: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
Masaai: Olayioni lai, tinikilejaa ake ilaasak loo ng'ok, minyorraa mikitelejari.

English: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
Masaai: Naa tinikijoki ninche, “Wou tenebo iyiook mairraga aanyu osarge likimbukoo. Matarresh kisudori aaluam ilo le meeta entioto;

English: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
Masaai: anaa enemeneng'a matoijoi ninche eishu, nelulung'a, anaa lelo oopuo aadoiki eng'umoto;

English: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
Masaai: aikitum imasaa pooki e tipat, nikimput inkajijik ang intokitin nikitaarutua;

English: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
Masaai: tipika sii iyie erubata ino atua iyiook neaku olbene obo kiata.”

English: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, miim ina oitoi tenebo ninche, imboo enkeju ino pee meim inkoitoi enye;

English: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
Masaai: amu ekuetiki inkejek enye aas intorrok, nesiooyo aaibukoo osarge.

English: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
Masaai: Amu te mpesho isalaash orreshet, te dukuya emotonyi ake pooki edolita.

English: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo tung'ana eirrag aanyisho naa osarge lenye erreshoo, enkishui enye ninye erreshoo.

English: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
Masaai: Neijia etiu inkoitoi e lelo pooki ootum dupoto te nkikonya; eitayu enkishui aaitung'uaa iloopeny.

English: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
Masaai: Eishir eng'eno abuaku te nkoitoi dapash e nkanasa, neitayu oltoilo lenye too wuejitin neemirishoreki.

English: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nchumata oo sunta eishira abuaku; neiro too nchomito enkanasa ejo:

English: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
Masaai: “Kerishata nabaa, intae iloo moda inyorraa aaku ilmoda? Kerishata nabaaa enyor iloo lderrat torrok aimaki ilderrat torrok. Neiba ilmoda eng'eno?

English: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
Masaai: Embung'a intae enking'odiata ai o eutaroto; eng'ura, kabukoki intae iutarot oo ndamunot aainei naa kaitayiolo intae irorei laainei.

English: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
Masaai: Amu aipotishe nianyianya kining'ining'i, aitorioyie enkaina ai nemetii hoo obo otishilayie,

English: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
Masaai: neitu ishilaa enkikoo ai pooki, neitu ishilaa enking'odia ai o utarot aainei pooki.

English: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
Masaai: Ekakueniyie sii nanu intae te nkata engolikinoto inyi, naa kasurdaany intae te neosh intae olkirutoto,

English: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
Masaai: teneosh intae olkirutoto anaa olkutati, nelotu engolikinoto inyi anaa osiwuo torrono te nelotu osina o emion shumata intae.

English: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
Masaai: Neaku kaapuonu ninche aaipot nanu, nemawaliki nanu ninche; naa kaaing'oru ninche nanu oleng nemaatum nanu.

English: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
Masaai: Amu keiba ninche eng'eno, neitu egelu euriata o Laitoriani.

English: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
Masaai: Meyieu enkikoo ai hoo nabo, netemenaitie enkisikong'ata o eutaroto ai pooki.

English: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
Masaai: Metaa kenya ninche ilng'anayio le nkoitoi enye, neitarruoo inkoitoi enye maate.

English: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
Masaai: Amu etaara engogong'i enye ilmoda metuata, ore enkiyagata oo lmoda neidaikie ninche;

English: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
Masaai: kake ore ilo laaning nanu naa kebik eserian, naa keyeng'iyeng'a eton, meeta enkuretisho o entorroni.”

English: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
Masaai: Enkerai ai, tining'amaa irorei laainei, nishum aiteng'el inkitanapat aainei tenebo iyie,

English: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
Masaai: nincho inkiyiaa inono einining aasipu eng'eno, nirrugu oltau lino aaku oloyiolou;

English: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
Masaai: ee tininchiru aomonu ening'unoto oo rorei oogut, nidumu oltoilo lino aaku oloning'u.

English: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
Masaai: Tining'oru ninye anaa enkosholai, nijurru aing'oru ninye oleng anaa enoshi toki e tipat naisudoro.

English: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
Masaai: Neaku iyiolou iyie euriata o Laitoriani, nitum eng'eno e Nkai.

English: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani ninye oishoru eng'eno; enkutuk enye epukunye eng'eno o eyiolounoto.

English: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
Masaai: Eiteng'ela ninye eng'eno sidai te lelo ooitashe too sipat; ninye elong'o e lelo oopuo te mborron.

English: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
Masaai: Errip inkoitoi oo sipat negolie enkoitoi oo sinyat lenyena.

English: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
Masaai: Ina pee indimidimi aatayiolo esipata o enkiguana e sipata o emborron, o pooki oitoi sidai.

English: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
Masaai: Amu kelotu eng'eno atua oltau lino, ore eyiolounoto neaku aisidai tiatua oltau lino.

English: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
Masaai: Aikirrita iyie eyiolounoto; nikirrip eyiolounoto iyie.

English: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
Masaai: Nikintajeu iyie aitung'uaa enkoitoi oo ntorrok, aitung'uaa iltung'ana ooiro nkirorot torrok,

English: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
Masaai: lelo oing'uaa inkoitoi e nkitashoto sidai aaim inkoitoi e naimin.

English: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
Masaai: Neshipa te neas intorrok, neshipakino ina kiminata e ntorroni,

English: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
Masaai: iltung'ana laa ore inkoitoi enye naa keriwuo naa inaapaashaa neimin ninche tiatua inkoitoi enye.

English: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
Masaai: Aikintajeuni iyie te ina kitok naibor onyek, ina kitok nairo te nkutuk enye irorei oo melook.

English: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
Masaai: Ina kitok apa natung'uayie olpayian lenye le lelero, nerikino ninye osotua le Nkai enye.

English: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaji enye naa keimis adoiki keeya, ore inkoitoi enyena nepuo enetii ilootuata.

English: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
Masaai: Meeta ololo enetii ninye oitoki ashukunye nemeitoki aatum inkoitoi empuaan.

English: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
Masaai: Metaa ilo iyie te nkoitoi oo ltung'ana supati, nimbung nena oitoi oo lasipak.

English: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
Masaai: Amu lelo ooitashe too sipat oomany ena kop, ore iltung'ana oobor naa kebikoo tiatua,

English: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
Masaai: kake kedung'ori ilarruok te ina kop, ore ilaitang'orok nedotuni too ntona.

English: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, mincho kirikino inkiteng'enat aainei kake inchoo oltau lino eibung inkitanapat aainei.

English: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
Masaai: Amu keaku inkolong'i kumok o larin le nkishui ino, nikincho enkiputakinoto e enkishon.

English: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
Masaai: Mincho esujata oo sipat o enkirukoto kiorore; teeniki ninche emurt ino, tisira ninche te mbao o ltau lino.

English: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
Masaai: Metaa itum omom o enkisisa sidai te dukuya Enkai o tung'ani.

English: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
Masaai: Isiliga Olaitoriani to ltau lino pooki, nimipik osiligi le ng'eno ino metaa ninye nikirik.

English: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Masaai: Ore too nkoitoi inono pooki imbalie ninye naa keitorioo ninye inkoitoi inono pooki.

English: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
Masaai: Miaku oloota eng'eno too nkonyek inono makewan, turia Olaitoriani, nimbelekenya aing'uaa ntorrok.

English: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
Masaai: Keaku enkishiunoto to sesen lino, neaku olchani too loik linono.

English: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
Masaai: Iyanyita Olaitoriani too ntokitin inono, o too lng'anayio le dukuya le nkurma ino.

English: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
Masaai: Neaku ebore impechen inono enkumoi, neiput imalasin inono enaisho oo sabibu nedooyo.

English: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, mimenaa enkitamioto e utaroto nikiosh Olaitoriani; arashu inauru te rerioroto nikirere,

English: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
Masaai: amu kererioo Olaitoriani ilo onyor anaa olpayian orerioo enkerai enye nanyor.

English: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
Masaai: Emayiana oltung'ani otum eng'eno nagut, oltung'ani otum eyiolounoto.

English: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
Masaai: Amu ore dupoto enye nelang dupoto e nkosholai ore sii dupoto enye nelang sahabu.

English: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
Masaai: Eeta ninye tipat alang isoito oogol enkinyang'a, nemeeta entoki niyieu nindim aitanyaanyukie ninye.

English: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
Masaai: Etii enkishui naado atua enkaina enye e tatene, ore atua enkaina enye e kedienye netii enkarsisisho o enkanyit.

English: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
Masaai: Ore inkoitoi enyena naa inaaitishipisho, ore nkoitoi enyena pooki naa eseriani.

English: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
Masaai: Ore ninye naa olchani le mpuaan te lelo ooibung ninye; ore lelo oibung aakurraki naa keji ilooshipa.

English: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
Masaai: Eitobira Olaitoriani enkop te ng'eno nagut, ore te yiolounoto eitasheyie keper o ntokitin naatii.

English: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
Masaai: Te ng'eno enye eitayio ineegut, ore inkatampo neitadou enkoileelio.

English: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, imbung'a eng'eno sidai o eyiolounoto; mincho ninche kisik aaing'uaa,

English: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
Masaai: naa keaku enkishui to ltau lino, naa emasaai sidai e murt ino.

English: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
Masaai: Neaku ilo te nkoitoi ino iserian, nemerrorro enkeju ino.

English: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
Masaai: Tinilo niton, nimiata enkuretisho; tinirrag airura, naa kemelok injo inono.

English: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
Masaai: Miure olkirutoto likiluam, arashu emutata oo larruok te nelotu.

English: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
Masaai: Amu keaku Olaitoriani osiligi le nkitashoto ino, naa kerrip enkeju ino pee meibung'i.

English: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
Masaai: Mimitiki isidain ilooishaakino ina kata aa iyie oota enkidimata pee ias.

English: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
Masaai: Mijoki olelatia lino, “Shomo pee intoki ashukunye, ekaaisho metabaiki” — ti niata ina kata ina toki.

English: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
Masaai: Mintobiraki ole latia ino entorroni ainyal, lelo ootoni kisilig tembata ino.

English: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
Masaai: Miarare oltung'ani metii esipata, eitu kintaas iyie entorroni.

English: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
Masaai: Migilaki ong'u oltung'ani onyor olarrabal, nimigelu hoo nabo oo nkoitoi enyena.

English: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
Masaai: Amu ore oltung'ani ogolong'u naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore lelo ooitashe too sipat netii atua enkisiligata enye.

English: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
Masaai: Etii oldeket le Nkai shumata enkaji oo larruok, kake kemayian ninye emanyisho oo supati.

English: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomenisho naa kemanaa ninye, kake ore iloobor neisho omom.

English: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kejung enkanyit, kake ore ilmoda netum enkurruna.

English: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
Masaai: Entoning nkiteng'enat e papaai linyi nkera aainei, nining'ining'i aasipu itumutumu aanoto eng'eno nagut.

English: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
Masaai: Amu kaaisho iyie iutarot sidain; miorore enkiteng'enata ai.

English: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
Masaai: Ore apa ara enkiti kerai nanana atii tenebo papa lai, naa nanu ake eeta yieyio.

English: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
Masaai: Naaiteng'ena ninye nanu, naajoki, “Inchoo oltau lino eibung akurraki irorei laainei tushuma inkitanapat aainei pee iton inchu.

English: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Mincho kirikino, nimimbelekenya aing'uaa irorei le nkutuk ai. Noto eng'eno nagut, noto sii ening'unoto.

English: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
Masaai: Mimenaa ninye, naa aikirrip ninye iyie; tonyora ninye naa aikirrip ninye iyie.

English: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
Masaai: Ore enkiterunoto e ng'eno naa ena; noto eng'eno nagut, naa ore pooki nitum, noto sii ening'unoto;

English: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
Masaai: intagolo enkinyang'a enye oleng, naa aikintaa ninye iyie kitok; aikianyitu ninye iyie tininbung'are ninye.

English: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
Masaai: Kepik ninye endukuya ino enkishili e nkisisa nikipik sii emaupe sidai e nkitoo.”

English: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
Masaai: Toning'o enkerai ai, ning'amaa irorei laainei, pee etum ilarin le nkishui ino aataa kumok.

English: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
Masaai: Aaiteng'ena nanu iyie nkoitoi e ng'eno; aatoriko iyie too nkoitoi naaitoriori.

English: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
Masaai: Ore pee ilo iyie, nemetum enkeju ino olkob, naa tinikuet nimirrorro.

English: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
Masaai: Imbung'a tukurraki iutarot, mincho kipuo aing'uaa; torripo ninche, amu ninye enkishui ino.

English: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
Masaai: Mijing enkoitoi oo larruok nimiim ina oitoi e lelo tung'ana torrok.

English: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
Masaai: Tapaasha ninye, milo aim ninye; imbelekenyunye tung'uai milo agiroo.

English: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
Masaai: Amu meidim ninche aairurata o metaasa entorrono; meeta ninche injo ometaba anaa nerrorr obo metabatatayu.

English: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
Masaai: Amu einos ninche endaa enkarruoisho, neok enaisho oo sabibu naikonyuno te ng'olon.

English: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
Masaai: Kake ore enkoitoi oo supati netiu anaa ewang'an e nkakenya ina naponari awang'u newang'u o metaa dama.

English: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi oo ltorrok netiu anaa enaimin nagut; meyiolo ninche aajo aitenyoo etarrorrote.

English: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
Masaai: Enkerai ai inining'u tukurraki irorei laainei, irrugu enkiok ino inining'u inkikoot aainei.

English: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
Masaai: Mincho ninche kilany aaing'uaa enkomom ino; tushuma ninche tiatua oltau lino.

English: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
Masaai: Amu enkishui ninche teilo otum ninche naa olmairo lo sesen lenye pooki.

English: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
Masaai: Ing'ura oleng tagolie oltau lino, amu ninye epukunye inchorroi e nkishui.

English: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
Masaai: Intalama kewan nkirorot torrok, nishurtu inkirorot torrok te iyie.

English: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
Masaai: Inchoo inkonyek inono eing'or aaitoriokino dukuya; neaku enking'urata ino enaitoriori te dukuya iyie.

English: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
Masaai: Ing'ura tagolie enkoitoi oo nkejek inono, pee eunoyu inkoitoi inono pooki.

English: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
Masaai: Nimiwuang alo tatene arashu kedienye; tushuku enkeju ino intung'uai e ntorroni.

English: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
Masaai: Enkerai ai inining'u tukurraki eng'eno ai, irrugu enkiok ino inining'u eng'eno ai.

English: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
Masaai: Pee itum atorripo te yiolounoto naiguana, ore enkutuk ino nerrip e ng'eno.

English: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
Masaai: Amu ore enkutuk e nkitok naibor onyek neitong'u enaisho, ore ilomon lenyena nepuiyiapui aalang eilata;

English: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
Masaai: kake ore te nkiting'oto nedua anaa esayiet nepi anaa olalem opi imbat pokira.

English: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
Masaai: Ore inkejek enyena nepuo aadoiki keeya; nesujaa iroruat enyena enkoitoi e nemeneng'a;

English: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
Masaai: meinining'u ninye enkoitoi e puaan, eirrang'irrang inkoitoi enyena, nemeyiolo ninye.

English: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Neaku ore naa te ina kata inkera aainei, entoning'oki nanu nimipuopuo aaing'uaa irorei le nkutuk ai.

English: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
Masaai: Intalama enkoitoi ino enenye nimilo anyikaki kutuk aji e nkaji enye;

English: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
Masaai: pee mincho ake enkisisa ino ilkulikae, nimincho ilarin linono lelo le meeta olng'ur,

English: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
Masaai: pee meiput ate ilomon te ngolon ino ore isiaitin inono nepuo enkaji o lomoni.

English: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
Masaai: Ore te nkiting'oto e nkishui ino ninchir, etumutaki inkiri o sesen lino,

English: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
Masaai: naa ijo, “Ekaiba apa enkitamioto naautarieki netanya oltau lai ererioroto!

English: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
Masaai: Eitu apa ainining'u oltoilo loo laiteng'enak laainei arashu airrugoki enkiok ai ilautarok laainei,

English: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
Masaai: atinyikaka apa nanu embata enkidaaroto tiatua eumuta olorere!”

English: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
Masaai: Tooko enkare naing'uaa enchorro ino makewan, ina are narukunye aing'uaa enchorro ino.

English: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
Masaai: Keidapasha inkonyek inono oo nkariak tiong'ota, inchorroi enkare too nkoitoi dapashi?

English: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
Masaai: Inchoo ninche eaku ininono aa iyie ake, neme pee eaku enino olomon likiboitare.

English: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
Masaai: Inchoo enchorro ino emayiani, nishipakino enkitok e lelero ino, ololii oikishiaan anaa enkolii nadeenyari.

English: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
Masaai: Inchoo enyorrata enye kimput iyie, inkatitin pooki te nchipai, inchoo enyorrata enye kidumu anaake.

English: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
Masaai: Aainyo enkerai ai pee incho enyorrata enkitok naibor onyek kidumu? Nimbung olgoo le ntang'oroi?

English: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
Masaai: Amu ore inkoitoi oltung'ani netii dukuya Olaitoriani, naa keing'orita ninye irrekiei lenyena pooki.

English: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
Masaai: Ore enkarruoisho oo larruok naa kerresh ninye, neibung'i ninye te siaai oo ng'ok enyena.

English: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
Masaai: Neye ninye meeta enkitamioto e utaroto, ore enkaraki emodai enye sapuk neimina ninye.

English: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
Masaai: Enkerai ai, tinitonyorrayie te nkutuk ino aitasheiki ole latia ino te sile enye, ninosa olmumai te nkaraki olomoni;

English: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
Masaai: tinitarresho kewan to rorei lintayio te nkutuk ino, tinikimbung'a ororei le nkutuk ino,

English: Do this now, my son, deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
Masaai: neaku taasa naa ena, enkerai ai pee intajeu kewan, amu itijing'a inkaik ole latia ino; shomo tasioi tasayia ninye pee kilaku.

English: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
Masaai: Mincho inkonyek inono meirurata, nimincho nkonyek inono meimugo;

English: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
Masaai: intajeu kewan anaa enkolii nailanya olang'oroni, anaa emotonyi natunuta olotarresho.

English: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
Masaai: Shomo enetii enkalaoni, iyie lo tashalai; ing'ura inkoitoi enyena, nitum eng'eno.

English: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
Masaai: Inemeeta olaiguanani lenye, o laitasheikinoni arashu oloitore,

English: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
Masaai: eshum ninche endaa enye te nkata enkirowuaj neiturrurru endaa enye te nkata enkisampuare.

English: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
Masaai: Kenkata nabaa iton iyie airrag te ine? Kanu kenya inyototo too njo inono?

English: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
Masaai: “Ekaitoki airura penyo, kaimug penyo,” ejo ninye “Ekashuk inkaik aainei ayeng'iyeng'a penyo.”

English: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
Masaai: Ore eirura nebaiki ninye aisinanisho anaa olkirikoi, o esumash anaa oltung'ani otanape.

English: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le meeta tipat naa oltung'ani arruoni, neloolo einosaa ilomon le lejare.

English: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
Masaai: Nerojisho too nkonyek enyena, neirorie oltung'ani too nkejek, neutisho too lkimojik lenyena.

English: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
Masaai: Ore to lwuasa lo ltau lenye neun intorrok, eunito anaake ninye empeu emang'atisho.

English: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
Masaai: Neaku kepulusokino ninye eng'olikinoto aluam; ore te nkiti kata naa kegila enemeishiunoyu.

English: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
Masaai: Etii intokitin ile naaiba Olaitoriani, mbaa naapishana naa olminong te ninye:

English: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
Masaai: Inkonyek olwuasa, o olng'ejep olejisho, o inkaik naaibukoo osarge le meeta entioto,

English: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
Masaai: oltau oipiru indamunot torrok, inkejek naasioyo aakuetiki enetii entorroni.

English: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
Masaai: Olchakeni le lejare olimu te nkutuk elejare, oltung'ani oun empeu engogong'i tiatua ilalashera.

English: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
Masaai: Enkerai ai, imbung'a inkitanapat e papaai lino, niming'uaa enkiteng'enare e yieyioo lino.

English: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
Masaai: Teeniki ninche oltau anaake; teeniki ninche emurt ino.

English: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
Masaai: Ore tinilo te nkoitoi, naa aikirikoo ninche iyie; naa tinirrag airura, naa aikirrip ninche iyie, ore tininyototo neiro ninche tenebo iyie.

English: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
Masaai: Amu ore enkitanapata naa oltaa ore iutarot naa ewang'an, naa ore inkitamiot oo utarot naa ninche enkoitoi e nkishui.
