English: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
Masaai: Pee kirrip te ina kitok torrono, teilo ng'ejep opuyiapui le ina tang'oroi.

English: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
Masaai: Ming'uar enkishiaa enye to ltau lino, nimincho ninye kimbung too nkonyek enyena.

English: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
Masaai: Amu eidimi ainyiang'u enkitok naibor onyek te mukate nabo, kake eishu enkitok naloloito entonata e nkishui o lee.

English: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
Masaai: Keidim olee atanapa enkima to lgoo lenye, nemepejoo inkilani enyena?

English: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
Masaai: Anaa keidim oltung'ani ashomo aitunyoi inkuk naaishu, aimenya indapi enyena enkima?

English: So he that goeth in to his neighbour's wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
Masaai: Metaa neijia sii etiu ilo olo aloloitore enkitok olelatia enye meetae hoo obo oibung ninye olo eitu eitamei.

English: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
Masaai: Aimeiba iltung'ana olapurroni te nepurrisho, pee eitaraposh enkoshoke enye eeta esumash?

English: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
Masaai: Naa te neibung'i, kelak katitin naapishana; ekeishooyo imasaa pooki e nkaji enye.

English: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
Masaai: Ore ilo ololoito nemeeta elukunya sidai; ore ilo oas ina neidaikie kewan.

English: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
Masaai: Etum ilbaa torrok netum sii enkarna torrono nemejutoyu enkurruna enye tukul.

English: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
Masaai: Amu eitaa olom oltung'ani oloarisho, nemepalaki te nelo neitalakisho elap.

English: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
Masaai: Meng'amaa ninye elaata ake ninye pooki; meetae enkumoi oo nkishorot naidim aitoborro ninye.

English: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
Masaai: Enkerai ai, imbung'a irorei laainei, ninteng'el inkitanapat aainei tiatua iyie.

English: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
Masaai: Imbung'a inkitanapat aainei pee inchu, tagolie nkiteng'enat aainei anaa enerok enkong'u ino.

English: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
Masaai: Teeniki ninche ilkimojik linono, ingero ninche te mbao o ltau lino.

English: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
Masaai: Tiaaki eng'eno, “Ira iyie enkanashe ai” nimpot eng'eno nagut ajo olchore lai oleng;

English: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
Masaai: pee kitum atagolie te ina kitok naibor onyek, te ina aitang'oroni napuyiapui irorei.

English: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
Masaai: Amu ore te lusie e nkaji ai, aturumishe aing'or boo te lusie ai,

English: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
Masaai: nadol tiatua ilmoda, namusu olbarnoti obo tiatua ilbarnot, oloti barnoti lemedamisho.

English: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
Masaai: Eim enkoitoi dapash e nkanasa embata enkaji e ina kitok, eibung enkoitoi alo enkaji enye

English: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
Masaai: pee mirimiru e nteipa, te nkata enkewarie o enkata enaimin.

English: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nenang'are ninye enkitok, neishope anaa emulayoi, neeta enareuta.

English: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
Masaai: Neiro ninye meeta enkuretisho, metoni inkejek enyena tiang;

English: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
Masaai: etii te ina kata enkoitoi dapash e nkanasa netii tena kata enemirishoreki, ore te pooki lojata oo nkoitoi neton ninye aanyisho.

English: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
Masaai: Neibung ninye ang'utut, ore inkonyek enyena nekurraki ninye:

English: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
Masaai: nejoki ninye, “Aidipa atalaa ilasarri, neaku ore ena olong atalaa ilmuma laainei.

English: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
Masaai: Metaa ore taata aaewuo atumore, aaing'orua iyie oleng, neaku aanoto.

English: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
Masaai: Aitobira endapash ai too lkarash oo puyiapui le katani naing'uaa Misiri.

English: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Masaai: Aitorropilo endapash ai te manoo o esonkoyo o sinantei.

English: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
Masaai: Wou, maiputa ate enchipai ang omekenyu; matishipakinoto ate te nyorrata.

English: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
Masaai: Amu metii olpayian lai ang'; eshomo enelakua.

English: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
Masaai: Newa olbene loo ropiyiani nelo naa keshukunye kenya ang te mpolos o lapa.”

English: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
Masaai: Ore too rorei kumok le mpakasata, nearaki ninye; ore too rorei lenyena oo puyiapui neidimu ninye.

English: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
Masaai: Ore ina kata ake, nesuj ninye ninye, anaa olkiteng opuoi aayieng arashu enkolii najing atua orreshet.

English: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
Masaai: Ometaba anaa neng'or embae oltau lenye. Anaa emotonyi nakuetiki ajing atua orreshet; meyiolo duoo ajo keinosie enkishui enye.

English: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, nakera aainei, entoning'oki nanu niakuku ilooning'u lelo rorei le nkutuk ai.

English: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
Masaai: Mincho oltau lino eibelekenya asuj inkoitoi enyena, mipong'okino inkoitoi enyena;

English: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
Masaai: amu eitayio ninye ilmeneng'a kumok lemeikenayu. Ee, ore ilmeneng'a lenyena naa olorora kitok.

English: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
Masaai: Ore enkaji enye naa enkoitoi nalo enemeneng'a, nedoyio alo ilgilat le keeya.

English: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
Masaai: Aimeipotisho eng'eno, aimedumu eyiolounoto oltoilo lenye?

English: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
Masaai: Ore too neerupa oo mbat enkoitoi, ore too nkoitoi neitashe ninye.

English: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
Masaai: Ore tembata oo nkishomin te dukuya enkanasa, o te kishomi neipotisho ninye ejo:

English: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
Masaai: “Intae taa doi iltung'ana aipotito, naa ore enkishirata ai naa intae inkera e tung'ana eipirta.

English: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
Masaai: Lo moda kulo entamoo ate eng'eno; intae iltung'ana oo moda, enining'o enajo.

English: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
Masaai: Entoning amu kaimaki imbaa e tipat, naapuku te nkutuk ai imbaa naasipa.

English: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
Masaai: Amu eibalunye enkutuk ai esipata; ore intorrok naa olminong te nkutuk ai.

English: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
Masaai: Ore irorei pooki le nkutuk ai naa esupatisho; metii entoki nabo namonira anaa enariwuo te ninche.

English: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
Masaai: Keitoriori teilo oyiolo, naa keitoriori te lelo oonoto eng'eno.

English: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
Masaai: Imbung'a iutarot aainei aitalang enkosholai, o eng'eno alang sahabu gelunoti.

English: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
Masaai: Amu aisidai eng'eno nagut alang isoito oogol enkinyiang'a ore pooki naaba anaa ining'uar, meidimi aaitanyaanyukie ninye.

English: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
Masaai: Ore nanu eng'eno nagut, natii atua enkidimata e ning'unoto e ng'eno, naa katum eng'eno o eyiolounoto.

English: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani, naa enkibayunoto e ntorroni. Ore olwuasa o enkitokoos o enkoitoi e ntorroni, o nkirorot naapaashaa naa kaiba.

English: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
Masaai: Aata enkikoo o eng'eno sidai, naata eng'eno nagut, naata engolon.

English: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
Masaai: Te nanu eitoreisho ilaiguanak, neibalunye ilooitoreisho ina nasipa.

English: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
Masaai: Te nanu eitoreisho ilkituaak, ore ilaitoriak neitore enkop.

English: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
Masaai: Kanyor lelo laanyor nanu, ore lelo laaing'oru nanu te nyuaata naa kaatum.

English: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
Masaai: Etii enkarsisisho o enkanyit tenebo nanu, imasaa naabikoo o puaan.

English: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
Masaai: Ore olng'anayioi lai nelang sahabu, o sahabu ninye nasila. Ore ntumot aainei nelang enkosholai gelunoti.

English: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
Masaai: Alo nanu te nkoitoi e supatisho, too nkoitoi oo sipat enkiguana.

English: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
Masaai: Naitujung karsisisho lelo laanyor nanu, neiput ilchumat lenye masaa.

English: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
Masaai: “Aaitobira Olaitoriani nanu, te nkiterunoto e siaai enye, esiaai e dukuya enye te pooki musana.

English: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
Masaai: Ore too lporori ootulusoitie aaitasheyieki, te nkiterunoto eng'or enkiterunoto e nkop.

English: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
Masaai: Ore eton meetae ineegut aaitobiruaki nanu, ore eton meetae inchorroi naatii enkare.

English: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eitamanyuni ildoinyio, ore eton meetae indoinyo naaitobiruaki nanu.

English: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eitobiru ninye enkop tenebo nkong'at enyena arashu enterit e dukuya e nkop.

English: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
Masaai: Ore pee eitasheyie ninye keper, atii nanu ine Atii apa ina kata pee eitasheyie ninye keper. Ore pee eigeru olokelel tioriong e nguton e nkop.

English: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
Masaai: Ina kata pee eitasheyie oloing'ang'e le shumata, ina kata pee eitayu nchorroi e ng'uton.

English: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
Masaai: Ina kata pee epik enaiposha olpolosie metaa megil inkariak enkitanapata enye. Ina kata pee epik olkitamanyunoto le nkop.

English: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
Masaai: Natii apa tenebo ninye anaa olaitobirani arriyia; nara anaake enchipai enye, ashipa te dukuya ninye anaake.

English: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
Masaai: Ashipakino enkop enye namanyi, nashipakino inkera oo ltung'ana.

English: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata nakera aainei, entoning'oki nanu; emayiana lelo ooimbung inkoitoi aainei.

English: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
Masaai: Toning'o enkikoo pee ing'enu, nimiorore ninye.

English: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
Masaai: Eshipa oltung'ani laaning nanu, oing'or anaake nchomito aainei, laanyu too mbat oo nkutukie oo nkajijik aainei.

English: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore ilaatum nanu netum enkishui; netum omom to Laitoriani.

English: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo laapong nanu, nepik kewan olbae; ore lelo laaiba nanu nenyor keeya.”

English: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
Masaai: Etesheta eng'eno enkaji enye, eitasheyie ing'apeta enyena pokira naapishana.

English: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
Masaai: Neteyieng'a nkishu enyena, eitushula enaisho enye oo sabibu, neitobira sii emisa enye.

English: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
Masaai: Eirriwayie ninye nkaisiaayiak enyena meipotisho, toowuejitin neeika e nkanasa ejo,

English: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
Masaai: “Ore ilo pooki omoda, inchoo eibelekenyunye alotu ene.” Oilo le meeta ndamunot, ejo ninye,

English: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
Masaai: “Wou, inosa endaa ai, niok ina aisho oo sabibu naitushula.

English: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
Masaai: Tung'uai emodai pee inchu. Nilo te nkoitoi e ng'eno nagut.”

English: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
Masaai: Ore ilo orerioo olasukenyani netum ninye emoroto, naa ore oloisikong oltung'ani torrono netum olbae.

English: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
Masaai: Minkok olasukenyani arashu kimbayu iyie; inkoo oltung'ani ng'en naa aikinyorru ninye iyie.

English: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
Masaai: Inchoo enkiteng'ena oltung'ani ng'en, naa keponaa eng'eno oleng, inteng'ena oltung'ani supat naa keponaa eng'eno enye.

English: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa ninye enkiterunoto e ng'eno, naa ore eng'eno e ilo Sinyati naa eng'eno nagut.

English: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
Masaai: Amu te nanu eponari inkolong'i inono, aikiponikini iyie ilarin le nkishui.

English: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
Masaai: Tenaa ira iyie ng'en, naa aira ng'en te nkorrok ino; naa tinisukenyisho, naa iyie ake openy onap.

English: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
Masaai: Ore enkitok namoda neilepilep; nemeutaroyu, nemeeta enkurruna nayiolo.

English: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
Masaai: Eton te nkutuk enkaji enye, neton too wuejitin neerupa enkanasa.

English: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
Masaai: Eipotu lelo oogiroo ine, lelo oopuo inkoitoi enye maate,

English: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
Masaai: ore pooki ng'ae omoda, inchoo eibelekenyunye alotu ene ore pooki ng'ae le meeta endamunoto ejoki,

English: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
Masaai: “Ore enkare napurruno naa kemelok, ore emukate nainosi too nkisudorot naa aisidai.”

English: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
Masaai: Kake meyiolo ninye ajo etii keeya ine, inchere ore lomon lenyena netii ineegut e nemeneng'a.

English: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
Masaai: Ore enkerai ng'en neitiship menye, kake ore enkerai namoda naa osomit te ng'otonye.

English: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
Masaai: Ore imasaa naatumi te nkoitoi torrono nemeeta dupoto kake aikilaku esupatisho aitung'uaa keeya.

English: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
Masaai: Meisho Olaitoriani isupati epuo eisumash, kake ore iyieunot e lelo torrok neitalamaa.

English: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
Masaai: Ore enkaina nashal neyau aisinanisho kake ore enkaina olarriyia neyau enkarsisisho.

English: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
Masaai: Ore enkerai nasotisho te nkata enkirowuaj naa aing'en, kake ore enkerai nairura te nkata enkisampuare neyau enkurruna.

English: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
Masaai: Etii imayianat endukuya e ilo supat kake ore enkutuk eilo torrono nemuk enapiak.

English: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
Masaai: Ore indamunot oo supati naa emayianata; kake ore enkarna o ltorrono naa keng'uoyu.

English: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
Masaai: Ore eng'eno oltau naa kening'u inkitanapat, kake ore olmodai loo rorei kumok naa keidaaya.

English: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
Masaai: Ore ilo olo te nkoitoi naitoriori nelo te seriani, kake ore ilo oibelekeny inkoitoi enyena naa ketumi.

English: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
Masaai: Ore ilo orojisho te nkong'u enye aitunyoo esipata neyau enyamali, kake ore ilo oibalie te mpijan esipata neyau eseriani.

English: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o supat naa enchorro e nkishui, kake ore enkutuk oltorrono nenuk entorroni.

English: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
Masaai: Eyau enkiba enchankar sapuk, kake ore enyorrata neimulumul nkitarruorrot pooki.

English: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
Masaai: Etumi te nkutuk eilo oota ening'unoto eng'eno, kake ore eng'udi neishaakino enkoriong e ilo le meeta endamunoto sidai.

English: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana ng'eni neshum eng'eno, kake ore enkilepilep olmodai neitinyiku enkidaaroto.

English: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
Masaai: Ore imasaa o ltung'ani karsis naa ninche enkanasa enye nagol, ore emenai oo laisinak naa ninye enkidaaroto enye.

English: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
Masaai: Ore elaakinoto o supat naa ketum enkishui, ore intumot oo ltorrok naa ing'ok.

English: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
Masaai: Ore ilo oning'u enkikoo netii enkoitoi enkishui; kake ore ilo oany enkikoo nelo apong'ori.

English: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
Masaai: Ore ilo onuk enkiba neeta enkutuk e lejare, ore ilo oiro irorei le nkiteenikinoto naa olmodai.

English: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
Masaai: Ore te neaku irorei kumok, nemelai inkitadiat, kake ore ilo onuk enkutuk enye naa aing'en.

English: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
Masaai: Ore olng'ejep le ilo asipani naa enkosholai sidai gelunoti, ore endamunoto olaasani loo ng'ok nemeeta tipat.

English: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk e ilo supat neitoti ilkumok, kake ore ilmoda nemut emodai.

English: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
Masaai: Ore emayianata o Laitoriani neitaa karsis, nemeponaa osina te nebo ninye.

English: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
Masaai: Etiu ana enkiguran to lmodai eas entorroni, kake ore olkuaak le ng'eno naa enchipai to ltungani oota ening'unoto.

English: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
Masaai: Ore nena naaure ilo torrono neipang'aki ninye; kake ore iyieunot oo supati naa keishori.

English: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
Masaai: Ore pee eish osiwuo, nemeitoki ilo torrono atii, kake eitasheyieki osupat intarasi.

English: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
Masaai: Anaa enatiu enaisho naisuisho oo sabibu too lala, anaa empuruo too nkonyek, nejia sii etiu oltashalai te lelo ooirriwaa ninye.

English: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani neitoodor enkishui, kake ore ilarin loo larruok neitodorropi.

English: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
Masaai: Ore osiligi loo supati neiting te nchipai, kake ore enkisiligunoto oo ltorrok nemeaku toki.

English: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani naa ninye osempewuet leilo asipani, kake enkidaaroto too laasak loo ng'ok.

English: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
Masaai: Meiwuang'ieki aekata isupati kake ore iltorrok nemebik te enkop.

English: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o supat neyau eng'eno nagut, kake ore olng'ejep olejisho naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o lasipani neyiolo ina nang'amaroyu, kake ore enkutuk oltorrono, neyiolo ina napaashari.

English: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
Masaai: Ore entemet natii olejet naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore entemet nemetii olejet naa ninye eng'ida enye.

English: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu olwuasa, nelotu sii enkurruna; kake eboitare eng'eno lelo oobor.

English: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
Masaai: Ore enkitabaroto e lelo ooitashe too sipat naa kerik ninche. Kake ore enkarruoisho e lelo airrikinok ninye naidaikie ninche.

English: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
Masaai: Meeta enkarsisisho dupoto te ina olong e ngoro, kake elaku esipata aitung'uaa keeya.

English: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho e lelo le meeta entioto neitaa enkoitoi enye enaitoriori, kake ore oltorrono nerrek intorrok enyena.

English: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho e lelo loo sipat naa kelaku ninche. Kake ore ilairrikinok naa keibung ing'uarrat enye.

English: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
Masaai: Ore te neye oltung'ani torrono, neish osiligi lenye, ore enkisiligata e lelo lemeyieu Enkai neaku ene pesho.

English: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
Masaai: Ore osupat naa kelakuni te nyamali enye, ore oltorrono netum ina nyamali.

English: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
Masaai: Emut oltung'ani lemeure Enkai te nkutuk enye ole latia lenye. Kake te ng'eno elakuni lelo supati.

English: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
Masaai: Ore teneitobirari mbaa too supati, neshipa enkanasa, ore pee eish iltorrok nening'i mbuakunot e nchipai.

English: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
Masaai: Te mayianata oo supati eisisi nerrepi enkanasa, kake kemuti too nkutukie oo ltorrok.

English: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
Masaai: Ore ilo omenaa olelatia enye nemeeta endamunoto sidai, kake ore oltung'ani oota ening'unoto neton agira.

English: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
Masaai: Ore ilo oloolo ainosaa imbaa olmarenke nebolu imbaa naaisudoro, kake ore ilo oisiligayu to ltau neshum embae aisudoo.

English: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
Masaai: Ore enemetii erikore, naa kebatata olorere; kake ore enetii ilaikook kumok netii eseriani.

English: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
Masaai: Ore ilo onyorraa te nkutuk ajo kelaaki olomoni esile, naa kelotu anyamalu te siadi, kake ore ilo oany enyorraa neserian.

English: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
Masaai: Ore enkitok nabor netum enkanyit; ore iltung'ana ooisimisho netum enkarsisisho.

English: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat neret kewan, kake ore oltung'ani otolo naa kewan eitame.

English: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani torrono netum olekoisiaayio lelejare, kake ore ilo oun esupatisho netum olerrinyore osipa.

English: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitashe too sipat nebik eishu. Kake ore ilo osuj intorrok naa keye.

English: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana oota indamunot naapaashaa naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore lelo le meeta entioto too nkoitoi enye naa enchipai te ninye.

English: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
Masaai: Tayiolo miata olng'ash ajo, melo oltung'ani torrono eitu eitamei, kake ore lelo supati naa kelakuni.

English: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
Masaai: Anaa enaikununo olgisoi le sahabu te nkume embitir, nejia etiu enkitok sidai nemeeta eng'eno naret.

English: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
Masaai: Ore eyieunoto eilo supat neiting'oki esidano; ore enkisiligata oo ltorrok neiting'oki e ngoro.

English: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
Masaai: Eishooyo oltung'ani obo pesho, ore ake sii neitoki aponaa e enkarsisisho; ore olikae neibok ina naishiakino neishooyo, nenyamalu oleng te yieunoto sapuk.

English: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oleng naa keitaae ninye karsis, ore ilo opiku enkare, naa kepikakini sii ninye enkare.

English: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
Masaai: Edek iltung'ana ilo omit entapa kake eeta emayianata ilo omir.

English: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
Masaai: Ore ilo oing'oru isupati te nyuaata neing'oru omom, kake ejing'aki intorrok ilo olo aing'oru.

English: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisilig enkarsisisho enye naa ketoyu, kake ore ilo supat naa keipilipil anaa embeneyioi nanyori.

English: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitanyamal enkaji enye naa kejung enkijape, ore olmodai naa keaku osinka leilo ng'en.

English: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
Masaai: Ore olng'anayioi leilo supat naa olchani le nkishui, ore enemetii euriata oo nkitanapat neiwuang'ie enkishui oo lkumok.

English: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
Masaai: Amaa taa tenelaakini ilo supat tena kop, kebaa elang elaakinoto eilo torrono o laing'okoni!

English: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae onyor enkitamioto e utaroto, naa kenyor eng'eno, kake ore ilo oiba enkisikong'ata naa olmodai.

English: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat netum omom to Laitoriani, kake ore oltung'ani oipiru intorrok naa kedung'okini enkiguana.

English: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
Masaai: Meitasheyie oltung'ani intorrok, kake ore intona eilo supat nemeigutieki aekata.

English: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
Masaai: Ore enkitok supat naa enkopiyia enkitoo to lpayian lenye; kake ore ina nayau enkurruna netiu anaa eng'uan too loik lenyena.

English: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
Masaai: Ore indamunot oo supati naa esipata, ore inkikoot oo ltorrok naa enkirrikino.

English: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
Masaai: Ore irorei leilo torrono neirrag eanyu osarge, kake ore enkutuk eilo supat nelaku iltung'ana.

English: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
Masaai: Ore iltorrok naa kenang'ari nemeitokini aata, kake ore enkaji o supat naa keitashe.

English: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
Masaai: Eisisi oltung'ani anaa enatiu endamunoto enye sidai, kake ore ilo opaashaa endamunoto naa kemenuni.

English: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
Masaai: Eikash oltung'ani oitashe te mborron neasaki kewan esiai, alang ilo orup kewan nemeeta endaa nanya.

English: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat negolie enkishui enkiteng enye, kake ore olng'ur lo ltorrono naa entoloi.

English: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
Masaai: Ore ilo otur enkop enye naa ketum endaa sapuk kake ore ilo osuj imbaa e pesho nemeeta endamunoto.

English: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
Masaai: Ore oltalet ogol loo ltorrok naa kelotu amuta, kake ore intona oo supati neitashe aauno.

English: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani torrono nejing orreshet too ntorrok enkutuk enye, kake keilany ilo supat entorroni.

English: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompense of a man's hands shall be rendered unto him.
Masaai: Ore too lng'anayio loo rorei lenyena, neitaraposhi oltung'ani too supati, ore esiaai oo nkaik oltung'ani nerrinyokino ninye.

English: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi olmodai nelioo aa sidai too nkonyek enyena makewan, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en nening enkikoo.

English: A fool's wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
Masaai: Ore engoro o lmodai neibala asioki, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en nemeshilaa emoroto.

English: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiro esipata neishoru enduaata nasipa, kake ore olchakeni olejisho, nelimu elejare.

English: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
Masaai: Etii obo laa ore irorei oitasieku netiu anaa enang'unoto olalem. Kake ore olng'ejep lo lng'en neyau enkishiunoto.

English: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk nairo isipat nebik intarasi, kake ore olng'ejep le lejare naa ole nkiti kata.

English: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
Masaai: Etii elejare atua iltauja le lelo ooipiru intorrok, kake ore lelo ooun isupati neeta enchipai.

English: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
Masaai: Medoiki entorroni isupati kake ebore iltorrok enyamali.

English: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
Masaai: Ore inkutukie naalejisho naa olminong to Laitoriani. Kake ore lelo oisiligayu naa ninche enchipai enye.

English: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en, neisudoo eng'eno enye, kake ore ilmoda neibalie emodai enye.

English: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
Masaai: Ore enkaina eilo onyok eyooki aitoreisho, ore oltashalai naa kepiki aaisikong'aki esiaai nagol.

English: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
Masaai: Ore enkiroishi eyieunoto oltau lo ltung'ani naa kepetaa ninye, kake ore ororei sidai neitiship ninye.

English: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat, neibelekenya aing'uaa intorrok, kake ore inkoitoi oo ltorrok nerik ninche aitapong'oo.

English: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oshal nemeibung toki naing'oru, kake ore oltung'ani onyok aing'oru, ninye otum imasaa naagol enkinyiang'a.

English: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
Masaai: Ore atua enkoitoi oo sipat ninye etii enkishui, kake ore enkoitoi enkiminata nelo keeya.

English: A wise son heareth his father's instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
Masaai: Ore enkerai ng'en nening'u enkiteng'enare e menye kake ore elde asukenyani nemening'u enkisikong'ata.

English: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
Masaai: Etum oltung'ani supat mbaa supati too lng'anayio le nkutuk enye, kake ore iyieunot oo lairrikinok naa olarrabal.

English: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
Masaai: Ore ilo orrip enkutuk enye neitobikoo enkishui enye; ore ilo obol enkutuk enye oleng neidaaya.

English: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
Masaai: Ore oltau lo ltashalai naa keng'uarrisho, nemetum hoo pito, ore oltau leilo onyok naa keishori ninye te nkumoi.

English: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani loo sipat neiba elejare, kake ore oltorrono neas inenkurruna one sulare.

English: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
Masaai: Erikoo esipata ilo laa ore enkoitoi enye naa esipata, kake ore eng'oki nenang'aa ilo torrono.

English: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
Masaai: Eitaakuno oltung'ani obo aikarsis, nemeeta hoo pito, ore likae neitaakuno olaisinani, neeta imasaa kumok.

English: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
Masaai: Ore elakunoto e nkishui o ltung'ani naa karsisisho enye, kake meeta olaisinani enakordunye kewan.

English: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
Masaai: Ore ewang'an oo loo sipat neshipa, kake ore oltaa loo ltorrok naa keari.

English: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
Masaai: Ore to lwuasa neishankarra lelo lemening'isho, kake ore lelo ooibung enkikoo netum eng'eno nagut.

English: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
Masaai: Ore imasaa naanotoki aasioki naa kengoroo, kake ore ilo osotu aakutiti naa keponaa.

English: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
Masaai: Ore osiligi oimutieki neitamuoi oltau, kake ore eyieunoto naidipaki naa olchani le nkishui.

English: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
Masaai: Ore ilo omenaa ororei le nkikoo neyaki kewan enkidaata, kake ore ilo oyanyit enkitanapata naa ketum olerrinyore.

English: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
Masaai: Ore inkitamoot eilo ng'en naa enchorro enkishui, pee eidim oltung'ani atapaasha irresheta le keeya.

English: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto sidai netum omom, kake ore enkoitoi e lelo le meeta enkirukoto naa enkidaaroto enye.

English: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
Masaai: Eas oltung'ani ng'en pooki bae naas te ng'eno, kake ore olmodai neitoduaaya emodai enye.

English: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
Masaai: Ore olkilikuai torrono nesulaki iltung'ana kumok enyamali, kake ore olkilikuai oisiligayu neyau enkishiunoto.

English: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
Masaai: Ejing'aki aisinanisho o esulare ilo lemeitaa toki iutarot, kake ore ilo oning'u inkisikong'at naa keanyituni.

English: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
Masaai: Ore eyieunoto naitabayioki naa kemelok to ltau; kake ore empaashata oo ntorrok naa olminong too lmoda.

English: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiriamariyie iltung'ana ng'eni, naa keaku ng'en, kake ore ole ncholiek oo lmoda naa ketum enkitamioto.

English: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repaid.
Masaai: Kesuj ilbuketa ilaing'okok, kake elaaki karsisisho lelo supati.

English: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani supat neing'ueki enjung'ore inkera oo nkera enyena, kake ore enkarsisisho olaing'okoni netushumakaki lelo supati.

English: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
Masaai: Ore enkurma natang'asaki aapal meturo, neiu endaa sapuk kake etawuapayioki metii esipata.

English: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
Masaai: Ore ilo oirragie eng'udi naa keiba enkerai enye, kake ore ilo onyor ninye nenyok aitame arerioo ninye oleng.

English: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
Masaai: Eeta ilo supat enaitigir esumash enye, kake ore enkoshoke oltorrono neisumash.

English: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
Masaai: Eshet eng'eno e nkitok ng'en enkaji enye, kake ore emodai near enkaji enye too nkaik enyena.

English: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
Masaai: Ore ilo olo too sipat naa keure Olaitoriani, ore ilo lemelo too sipat too nkoitoi enyena nemenaa ninye.

English: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
Masaai: Ore enkiroroto o lmodai naa eng'udi te nkoriong enye, kake ore inkutukie oo lng'eni naa kerrip ninche.

English: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
Masaai: Ore enemetii ilmong'i, nemetii sii entapa; kake elotu enkumoi, oo ndaiki te ngolon olkiteng.

English: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni osipa nemelejisho, kake ore olchakeni lemesipa neitayu entooma e lejare.

English: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
Masaai: Eing'oru olomenisho eng'eno nagut te mpesho, kake elelek eng'eno to ltung'ani oota ening'unoto.

English: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
Masaai: Tung'uai ine netii olmodai, amu ore teine minepu irorei le ng'eno.

English: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
Masaai: Ore eng'eno oltung'ani ng'en naa pee emusu enkoitoi enye, kake ore emodai oo lmoda naa elejare.

English: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
Masaai: Keisikong' Enkai lelo torrok, ore lelo supati neshipakino omom enye.

English: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
Masaai: Eyiolo oltau enduaran enye, meeta olomoni ong'arie enchipai enye.

English: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
Masaai: Ore enkaji eilo torrono naa keidakieki kake ore olng'obor leilo supat naa kebul.

English: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
Masaai: Etii enkoitoi nalioo to ltung'ani aa sidai, kake ore enkiting'oto enye naa keeya.

English: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
Masaai: Ore ake sii te nkuenia neeta oltau osina, ore enkiting'oto e nchipai naa osina.

English: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani opaashari inkoitoi enyena, naa keiputakini ninye ilng'anayio loo nkoitoi enyena, ore oltung'ani supat naa keiputakini ninye ilng'anayio loo nkiasin enyena.

English: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
Masaai: Ore ilo omoda neiruk pooki toki, kake ore olng'en neing'or enkoitoi enye.

English: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani ng'en naa kerripo neibelekenya aing'uaa intorrok, kake ore olmodai nemerrip kewan eas intorrok.

English: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oirowua elukunya neas inkumok te modai kake ore oloota eng'eno naa keng'iri.

English: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
Masaai: Ore olmodai netum inemodai, kake ore ilng'eni neishopokini eng'eno anaa emaupe e nkitoo.

English: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
Masaai: Eirrugokino oltorrono ilo supat, ore ilo torrono nesaisho too nchomito e lelo supati.

English: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani aisinani naa keiba olelatia enye, kake ore olkarsis neeta ilchoreta kumok.

English: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
Masaai: Ore ilo omenaa olelatia enye naa olaing'okoni, kake eshipa ilo oitanana oshoke too laisinak.

English: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
Masaai: Aimepong'ori lelo ooun intorrok? Ore lelo ooun isupati einepu enkanyit o enkisiligata.

English: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
Masaai: Ore te pooki siaai netii dupoto kake ore too nkirorot e pesho neyau osina.

English: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
Masaai: Ore emaupe e nkitoo oo lng'eni naa eng'eno enye nagut, kake ore emodai naa enkishili oo lmoda.

English: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni osipa neitajeu enkishui oo lkumok, kake ore ilo oiro elejare naa olakaldaroni.

English: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
Masaai: Tiatua euriata o Laitoriani etum oltung'ani osiligi oitashe, ore inkera enyena netum osempewuet.

English: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa enchorro e nkishui, pee etum oltung'ani atapaasha irreshata le keeya.

English: In the multitude of people is the king's honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
Masaai: Atua esiamo oo ltung'ana etii enkitoo olaiguanani, kake te nemeetae iltung'ana neidaaya olkitok.

English: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
Masaai: Ore ilo lemesioki agoro neeta eng'eno sapuk, kake ore ilo osioki agoro neitasapuk emodai.

English: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
Masaai: Ore enchipai o ltau, neitaa osesen bioto, kake ore eng'uarrata neitong'u apurd iloik.

English: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitorogony oltung'ani aisinani, naa ilo oitobirua Ninye etamoro, kake ore ilo supat te lelo oomena naa keanyit ninye.

English: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
Masaai: Enang'ari oltorrono te nena baa enyena torrok, kake etum isupati osempewuet tiatua esupatisho enye.

English: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
Masaai: Eton eng'eno nagut te ina damunoto oltung'ani oota ening'unoto, kake meyioloi tiatua iltauja loo lmoda.

English: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
Masaai: Esipata naisho olosho meisisi, kake ore eng'oki naa enkurruna te pooki orere.

English: The king's favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
Masaai: Ore osinka oasisho te ng'eno netum omom to laiguanani, kake ore engoro enye nedoiki ilo oas inenkurruna.

English: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
Masaai: Ore ewalata e mborron nerriny engoro napi, kake ore ororei le nkisikong' neinyeyie engoro.

English: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
Masaai: Ore olng'ejep lo lng'en neitubulaa eng'eno, kake ore inkutukie oo lmoda nebuku ine modai.

English: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
Masaai: Etii inkonyek o Laitoriani pooki wueji, eing'orita lelo torrok o lelo supati.

English: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
Masaai: Ore irorei le mborron naa olchani le nkishui, kake ore irorei le ntorroni negil oltau.

English: A fool despiseth his father's instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
Masaai: Emenaa olmodai enkiteng'enata e menye, kake ore ilo oinining'u iutarot naa ng'en.

English: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
Masaai: Etii enkaji olasipani olchumati kitok, kake edoiki enyamali tumoto eilo torrono.

English: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk oltung'ani ng'en neitubulaa eng'eno, nemeneija etiu indamunot oo lmoda.

English: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Masaai: Ore olasar leilo torrono naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake ore enkomono eilo oitashe too sipat naa enchipai enye.

English: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi eilo torrono naa olminong to Laitoriani, kake enyor ninye ilo osuj aing'oru esupatisho.

English: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
Masaai: Etii enkitamioto eutaroto name ilo otapalayie ina oitoi; ore ilo oiba iutarot naa keye.

English: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
Masaai: Ore enemeneng'a o Abadon neibala te dukuya Olaitoriani, kebaa eibala oleng iltauja loo ltung'ana! Abadon: Etii ewueji oo rorei lemeibala.

English: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
Masaai: Meyieu olasukenyani neutari aaitorioo, melo enetii ilo ng'en.

English: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
Masaai: Ore oltau ong'ida, nepik enkomom enchipai, kake tosina lo ltau egila oltau.

English: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
Masaai: Ore oltau leilo oota endamunoto e ning'unoto neing'oru eng'eno, kake ore inkutukie oo lmoda neitoti ate too nemodai.

English: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
Masaai: Ore inkolong'i pooki e lelo ooisilisili naa torrok, kake ore oltau oshipa neeta osirua anaake.

English: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
Masaai: Eikash ina kiti etii euriata o Laitoriani alang olchumati kitok otii enyamali atua.

English: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
Masaai: Eikash endaa oo mbenek naanyori etii enyorrata atua, alang olkiteng opir otii enkiba atua.

English: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oirowua elukunya naa keyau enchankar, kake ore ilo lemesioki agoro neitigir enchankar.

English: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi olturuai netubulakita ilkiku, kake ore enkoitoi eilo oitashe too sipat naa enkoitoi nalala naitoriori.

English: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
Masaai: Ore enkerai ng'en neitiship menye kake ore oltung'ani omoda nemen ng'otonye.

English: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
Masaai: Ore emodai naa enchipai teilo le meeta endamunoto, kake ore ilo oota ening'unoto nelo aitoriori.

English: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
Masaai: Ore enemetii eutaroto nerruoyo nkitobirat naaji mataas; kake ore etii ilaikook kumok naa kedupayu.

English: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
Masaai: Ore ewalata nairirikino naa enchipai to ltung'ani, kebaa esidano ororei te nkata naishiaakino!

English: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi oltung'ani ng'en neilepie arik enkishui, pee etum atapaasha enemeneng'a tiabori.

English: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
Masaai: Kepolol Olaitoriani auroo enkaji eilo owuasa, kake keitashayie lelo polosien le nkoliai.

English: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
Masaai: Ore indamunot oo ltorrok naa olminong to Laitoriani, ore irorei leilo le meeta entioto naa keitiship ninye.

English: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
Masaai: Ore ilo oota olorok too masaa naatumi te nkoitoi torrono neyaki enyamali enkaji enye, kake ore ilo oiba eropare nebikoo.

English: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto o lasipani nejurru enejo te newal, kake ore enkutuk eilo torrono nebuku intokitin torrok.

English: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
Masaai: Elakuaniki Olaitoriani lelo torrok, kake ening ina omono oo supati.

English: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
Masaai: Ore ewang'an oo nkonyek neitiship oltau, naa ore ilomon sidain neitagol iloik.

English: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
Masaai: Ore ilo oirrugu enkiok enye aning'u enkikoo, nebik te nebo ilang'eni.

English: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitaa parmetii enkikoo naa kewan emen, kake ore ilo oning'u enkikoo netum ening'unoto.

English: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa enkiteng'enare tiatua eng'eno nagut, ore emborron nelo te dukuya enkanyit.

English: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
Masaai: Ore inkitobirat endamunoto naa ene tung'ani, kake ore ewalata olng'ejep naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa.

English: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
Masaai: Ore inkoitoi pooki oltung'ani naa sidain too nkonyek enyena, kake Olaitoriani ninye oineneng' oltau.

English: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Masaai: Inteleiki esiaai ino Olaitoriani, naa keitasheyieki inkitobirat inono.

English: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
Masaai: Eitobirua Olaitoriani pooki toki te nkipirta enye, neija sii etiu ilarruok teina olong e nyamali.

English: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oota olwuasa le nkitokoos naa olminong' to Laitoriani; tayiolo miata olng'ash, esipa tayiolo, melo ninye eitu eitamei.

English: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
Masaai: Te nkanyit o te nkisiligata epalakini ing'ok, naa te uriata o Laitoriani epaash oltung'ani intorrok.

English: When a man's ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
Masaai: Ore te neitiship inkoitoi o ltung'ani Olaitoriani, neitainye ilmang'ati lenyena ooboitare osotua.

English: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
Masaai: Enaikash enkiti etii esupatisho alang imasaa kumok nemetii esipata.

English: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
Masaai: Eitobir indamunot o ltung'ani enkoitoi enye, kake Olaitoriani ninye outaa iroruat enyena.

English: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
Masaai: Etii enkutuk olaiguanani iwalat naatipikaki engolon: nemeitadiak enkutuk enye te nkiguana.

English: A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
Masaai: Ore enkineneng'ata o entemet nadede naa ino Laitoriani, ore isoito ooineneng'ishoreki otii olbene naa esiai enye.

English: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
Masaai: Olminong torrono too laiguanak te neas ing'ok, amu ore olorika le nkitoo neitasheyieki too sipat.

English: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
Masaai: Ore inkutukie naairo isipat naa ninche enchipai olaiguanani, nenyor ninye ilo oiro ina nasipa.

English: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
Masaai: Ore engoro napi o laiguanani netiu anaa olkilikuai le keeya, kake ore oltung'ani ng'en naa keitiship ninye.

English: In the light of the king's countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
Masaai: Ore te newang' enkomom o laiguanani neetai enkishui ore omom enye netiu anaa inkatampo naayau enchan oloirujuruj.

English: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
Masaai: Tinitum eng'eno, neikash alang sahabu, tinitum ening'unoto naa keisul alang enkosholai.

English: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
Masaai: Ore enkoitoi nalala eilo oitashe too sipat nepaash entorroni; ore ilo orrip enkoitoi enye, negolie enkishui enye.

English: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
Masaai: Eng'asunye olwuasa nesuju enkidaaroto, naa neijia etiu oltau oisis kewan eng'asunye nesuju embatatata.

English: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
Masaai: Enaikash ti niata oltau obor te nebo ilaisinak alang tiniorioro iyarunot te nebo iloowuasa.

English: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
Masaai: Ore ilo oning'u ororei naa kebulaa, neshipa oleng ilo oisilig Olaitoriani.

English: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
Masaai: Ore ilo ng'en to ltau naa keji oltung'ani odolu mbaa, naa ore ilomon ooitishipisho neponaa enkarriyiano.

English: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
Masaai: Ore eng'eno naa enkong'u enchorro e nkishui teilo oota, kake ore emodai naa enkitamioto oo lmoda.

English: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto olng'en eitaa ilomon lenyena le nkiguana, neponaa enkarriyiano te nkutuk enye.

English: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
Masaai: Ore irorei ooitishipisho netiu anaa olkenkei le naisho, emeloni tiatua oltau naa embiotisho tiatua osesen.

English: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
Masaai: Etii enkoitoi nalioo to ltung'ani aa sidai, kake ore enkiting'oto enye naa enkoitoi e keeya.

English: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
Masaai: Errumoki esumash olaisiaayiani metaasisho oleng, ore ina sumash enye nerrumoki ninye metaasisho.

English: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani lemeeta tipat neitobiru enkarruoisho, ore ilomon lenyena netiu anaa enkima nadalisho.

English: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani loo ntorrok eidapashaa olomang'ati, naa ore oltung'ani lo lmarenke eor ilchoreta ooning'o oleng.

English: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani otolo eitapong'oo olelatia enye, nerikoki ninye enkoitoi neme sidai.

English: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
Masaai: Ore ilo orojisho too nkonyek enyena nenyor ataasa nkitobirat naapaashaa, ekurraki enkutuk enye ayau imbaa torrok.

English: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
Masaai: Ore ilpapit ooibor te ndukuya naa enkopiyia e nkitoo, etumi ninche te nkishui naitoriori.

English: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
Masaai: Ore ilo lemesioki agoro neikash alang ilo ogol, ore ilo oitore oltau lenye elang ilo oya enkanasa.

English: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
Masaai: Eosh iltung'ana enkukuo aaing'oru enayieu, kake ore ewalata naa Olaitoriani oishoru pooki.

English: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
Masaai: Enaikash tininya enkiti mukate natoyio iata eseriani, alang ti niata emasho sapuk tiatua enkaji nabore enchankar.

English: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
Masaai: Ore osinka oas ineng'eno naa keitore olayioni inoti oas inenkurruna, naa ketum sii ninye ematua e njung'ore anaa obo le lelo alashera.

English: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
Masaai: Etemi enkosholai te moti, netemi sahabu to lkokuet, naa Olaitoriani otem iltauja.

English: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
Masaai: Ore olaasani loo ntorrok nening nkirorot torrok; ore olalejani neinining olng'ejep arruoni.

English: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae osukeny ilo aisinani, naa olaitobirani lenye etusukenya; ore ilo oshipa te ng'olikinoto nemelo eitu eitamei.

English: Children's children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
Masaai: Ore inkera oo nkera naa ninche enkopiyia enkitoo, ore enkisisa oo layiok naa loo menye.

English: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
Masaai: Ore ilomon sidain nemeishaakino olmodai, nemeiro ilomon le lejare olayioni lo laiguanani.

English: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
Masaai: Etiu eropet anaa osoit le ntasim too nkonyek eilo oropisho; ore pooki wueji neibelekenyakino nebul.

English: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
Masaai: Ore ilo opalaki enkitarruorroto neing'oru enyorrata, kake ore ilo oigil embae tiae kata, neorore olchore oning'ore.

English: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
Masaai: Ore enkisikong'ata nejing'aa oleng oltung'ani ooata ening'unoto, alang ioshot iip naaoshi olmodai.

English: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani torrono neing'oru ake inenkarruoisho, keirriwakini ninye olkilikuai otolo metigilunore ninye.

English: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
Masaai: Enaikash tininang'are olng'arurumi otooruoki inkiyoitin enyena, alang tininang'are olmodai oreuta emodai enye.

English: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
Masaai: Tenerrinyu oltung'ani entorroni te sidai, nemeigut intorrok te nkaji enye.

English: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
Masaai: Ore enkiterunoto e nchankar netiu anaa oltung'ani opolol olong'elu le nkare; metaa shomo tung'uai eton eitu ebau olarrabal.

English: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ilo onyorraki lelo torrok e sipata, oilo oiguanare lelo supati, ore pokira naa olminong to Laitoriani.

English: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee eeta olmodai enkinyang'a te nkaina enye nainosie eng'eno nagut, nemeeta ninye endamunoto?

English: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
Masaai: Ore olchore nenyorrisho te pooki kata, ore olalashe netoiwuoki tenkaraki ing'olikinot.

English: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le meeta endamunoto, neitayu enkisiligata, neaku ninye oitasheiki esile olelatia enye.

English: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
Masaai: Ore ilo onyor inkitadiat nenyor enchankar; ore ilo oilepie kutuk aji enye oleng, neing'oru enkidaaroto.

English: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani lemeisiriri ndamunoto nemebulaa, ore sii ilo oota olng'ejep opaashaa ebatatakino atua engolikinoto.

English: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
Masaai: Ore olayioni omoda naa osomit te menye; ore menye ilo modai nemeeta enchipai.

English: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
Masaai: Ore oltau oshipa naa olmairo sidai, kake ore oltau otigile neitoi iloik.

English: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani torrono enap eropet to lgoo lenye, pee etum aiminie inkoitoi esipata.

English: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani oota ening'unoto neitorioki enkomom enye eng'eno, kake ore inkonyek olmodai netii nkiting'ot enkop.

English: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
Masaai: Ore olayioni omoda naa osomit te menye, naa emion nadua te ina kitok natoiwuo ninye.

English: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
Masaai: Imesidai tiniaraki oltung'ani supat metalaa entoki nemesipa, aitorrono te neitamei nkasisin.

English: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibooyo irorei lenyena eeta eng'eno, ore ilo oota oltau obor naa oltung'ani oota ening'unoto.

English: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye olmodai ogira meiro neji aing'en; ore pee eiken enkutuk enye nedoli ajo aing'en.

English: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
Masaai: Ore ilo okepari makewan naa iyieunot enyena eing'oru, pee etum atoorunye te pooki kiguana nasipa.

English: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
Masaai: Meshipakino olmodai embae naning'unoyu meteleku embae enye ake eibalie.

English: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
Masaai: Tenelotu entorroni nelotu sii enkurruna ore te nebo enkurruna netii sii esulare.

English: The words of a man's mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
Masaai: Ore irorei le nkutuk oltung'ani naa nkariak naagut; ore enkong'u e ng'eno naa enchorro naitokitoku enkare.

English: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
Masaai: Meishaakino tinijing' enkoriong oltung'ani arruoni, arashu imitiki oltung'ani supat esipata.

English: A fool's lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk olmodai neyau enchankar, ore enkutuk enye neipotu ioshot.

English: A fool's mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
Masaai: Ore enkutuk o lmodai naa enkidaaroto enye, ore enkutuk enye naa orreshet te ninye.

English: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
Masaai: Ore irorei le nking'oming'om netiu anaa embelati e mukate namelok, nejing'aa atua osesen lenye.

English: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
Masaai: Ore ilo oshal te siaai enye, naa olalashe le ilo oidaikie.

English: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
Masaai: Ore enkarna o Laitoriani naa oltalet ogol, ekuetiki oltung'ani supat neserianu.

English: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
Masaai: Ore imasaa o lkarsis naa enkanasa enye nagol, netiu anaa esuntai naado namitu ninye.

English: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
Masaai: Eisis oltau lo ltung'ani kewan eton ebau emutata, kake eng'asunye emborron eitu nesuju enkanyit.

English: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
Masaai: Teneishooyo oltung'ani ewalata eton eitu ening'u, naa emodai enye o enkurruna.

English: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
Masaai: Eng'iri oltau lo ltung'ani emuoyian; paa amaa oltau otigile aing'ae oidim ating'iria?

English: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto oltung'ani ng'en netum eng'eno, ore enkiok oltung'ani ng'en neing'oru eng'eno.

English: A man's gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
Masaai: Iyieu nitumore oltung'ani kitok? Iyaki ninye enkishooroto naa kelelek itum ninye.

English: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
Masaai: Ore ilo ong'as airo te dukuya nelioo aa kesipa enkiroroto enye o metaba anaa nelotu likae ajur ninye.

English: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
Masaai: Ore eoshoto enkukuo neiting'ie enchankar nerishu autu iloogol ooishankarra.

English: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
Masaai: Ore olalashe otaretoki netiu anaa enkanasa nagol, kake ore enchankar, netiu anaa iasheta oo sekenke o sempewuet.

English: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
Masaai: Eraposho oltung'ani too lng'anayio le nkutuk enye, eitaraposhi too naing'uaa enkutuk enye.

English: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
Masaai: Etii keeya o enkishui atua engolon olng'ejep, ore lelo oonyor ninye naa keinos ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ilo otum enkitok nenoto entoki sidai, nenoto omom to Laitoriani.

English: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
Masaai: Ore te neiro oltung'ani aisinani, naa keomonisho to sayia, kake ore olkarsis newal te ng'olon.

English: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
Masaai: Etii ilchoreta oitaakuno ilchoreta, kake etii olchore likimbung'are anyikaki alang olalashe.

English: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
Masaai: Enaikash oltung'ani aisinani olo too sipat enyena alang ilo oitadiak too nkirorot enyena naa olmodai sii.

English: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
Masaai: Meishaakino oltung'ani te nemeeta eng'eno, naa ore ilo oitasiooyo nkejek enyena, nepong enkoitoi enye.

English: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te nerikoki emodai oltung'ani enkoitoi enkidaaroto, negorokino oltau lenye Olaitoriani.

English: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
Masaai: Eyau enkarsisisho ilchoreta kumok ng'ejuko, kake ore oltung'ani aisinani nepuo aaing'uaa ilchoreta lenyena.

English: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni lemesipa nemelo eitu eitamei, naa ore ilo oiro elejare nemeilanyisho aisik.

English: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
Masaai: Eing'oru ilkumok omom o ltung'ani aminin, ore pooki tung'ani naa olchore le ilo tung'ani oishooyo inkishorot.

English: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
Masaai: Ore ilalashera pooki lo laisinani naa keibayu ninye, kebaa pasa elakuani nepuo ilchoreta lenyena aalam ninye! Esuj ninye ninche too rorei, nemetum ninye ninche.

English: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
Masaai: Ore ilo oata eng'eno nagut naa kenyor kewan; ore ilo oiteng'el ening'unoto naa kebul.

English: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni lemesipa melo eitu eitamei, ore ilo oiro inelejare naa keimin.

English: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
Masaai: Meishaakino olmodai teneton tiatua olkar, naa neija sii etiu orrindik meitore ilaiguanak.

English: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
Masaai: Ore endamunoto sidai nemeitasieku engoro oltung'ani, naa enkisisa te ninye te neitunyoo entorroni.

English: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
Masaai: Ore engoro napi o laiguanani netiu anaa enkikurrukur olng'atuny, kake ore omom enye netiu anaa enkoileelio natii inkujit.

English: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
Masaai: Ore olayioni omoda naa enkidaaroto te menye, ore enkitok enchankar netiu anaa enkirujuruj e nchan.

English: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaji o enkarsisisho naa enjung'o naing'uaa iloopapa, kake ore enkitok ng'en naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa.

English: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
Masaai: Epik enchalan oltung'ani injo naairoishi, ore oltung'ani oshal naa ketum esumash.

English: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibung inkitanapat nerrip enkishui enye; ore ilo omenaa ororei naa keye.

English: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitanana oshoke too laisinak naa Olaitoriani eisilenoko, naa kelaaki olaitoriani ninye enkias enye.

English: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
Masaai: Intamio tuutai enkerai ino eton eetae osiligi; mincho oltau lino ejing errorroto enye.

English: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani le ngoro napi naa kelak enkitamioto enye; amu tinilaku ninye taata, naa iyooki ake aigil alaku.

English: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
Masaai: Toning'u enkikoo ning'amaa enkiteng'enare, pee itum anoto eng'eno too nkolong'i naapuonu.

English: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
Masaai: Etii nkitobirat kumok endukuya e tung'ani, kake ina nayieu Olaitoriani ninye ake naitashe aaku.

English: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
Masaai: Ore entoki nayieuni te tung'ani naa enkanyit, naa olaisinani oikash alang o lalejani.

English: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
Masaai: Ore euriata o Laitoriani naa aikirikoki enkishui; naa ore ilo oota neyeng'iyeng'a etaraposhe, melotu entorroni enetii ninye.

English: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
Masaai: Ore oltashalai, nenukaa enkaina enye tiatua engira, nemeitoki hoo ninye ayau apik enkutuk enye.

English: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
Masaai: Toosho ilo asurdaanyani, ore ilo modai neyiolou ine ng'eno; intodua elde oota ening'unoto, naa ketum eng'eno.

English: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
Masaai: Ore ilo oorare menye, nearaa ng'otonye tiang, naa olayioni oyau esulare neyau sii esulare.

English: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
Masaai: Ore tinipal enkerai ai inining'u nkiteng'enat aainei, nipong'ori alo apaash irorei le ng'eno.

English: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
Masaai: Ore olchakeni le meeta tipat te likae nekueniyie enkiguana nasipa, ore enkutuk oltorrono naa keijoo intorrok.

English: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
Masaai: Eidipaki endung'okinoto enkiguana te lelo oosukeny isipat, o oshot too nkoriong'i oo lmoda.

English: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
Masaai: Enkasukenyani enaisho oo sabibu naa embuaaroto enaisho napi, naa ore pooki ng'ae oitapong'oyie ninye nemeng'en.

English: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
Masaai: Ore engoro naitureisho o laiguanani, netiu anaa enkikurrukur olng'atuny. Ore ilo oitagor ninye neiturraa enkishui enye.

English: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
Masaai: Enkanyit telde tung'ani oibooyo kewan aitalam enchankar; kake ore pooki modai nenyor enchankar.

English: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
Masaai: Metur oltashalai enkurma enye te nkata e nkirobi, keing'oru te nkata enkisampuare nemetum hoo pito.

English: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
Masaai: Ore enkiguana natii atua endamunoto e tung'ani netiu anaa enkare nagut, kake ore ilo oota ening'unoto naa kebuku ninye aipang'unye.

English: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
Masaai: Elimu pooki tung'ani aisis kewan aibalie esupatisho o enkisiligata enye, kake tetema sii iyie tujurro ilo tung'ani enaikununo!

English: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
Masaai: Emayiana nkera naata menye supat, naas nena naasipa.

English: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani oton to lorika le nkiguana, negel asilu ntorrok pooki te nedol too nkonyek.

English: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
Masaai: Aing'ae oidim atejo, “Aitukuo nanu oltau lai; ara nanu sinyati maata eng'oki?”

English: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ntemeta enkiroishi naapaashipaasha o ntemeta naapaasha nenyaanyuk pokira, olminong' to Laitoriani.
