Masaai: Ekaarik nanu iyie o maaitijing'a enkaji e yieyio, olgilata le ina apa naatoiwuo nanu, Naaisho nanu iyie enaisho oo sabibu natii enkorropil tooko, ina are oo lng'anayio le kukumanka.

English: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
Masaai: Oi naaji tenaa ketii enkaina enye e kedienye abori endukuya ai, naamuataki enkaina enye e tatene!

English: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
Masaai: Enosa olmumai intae na toyie e Yerusalem, inchere mipututu enyorrata ai, o metaba anaa nenyorru openy.

English: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
Masaai: Aing'ae lido olotu to lpurkel, eirishakino olanyor lenye? Tiabori olchani onyaanyukie olamai aatuputuo iyie. Te ine apa earita ng'utunyi enkop kiini iyie, te ine apa earita enkop ina nikitoiwuo.

English: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
Masaai: Intaaki nanu matotiwuo anaa olmishire tiatua oltau lino, anaa olmishire otii enkaina ino; amu ore enyorrata naa kegol anaa keeya, ore olom netolo anaa enkurare. Ore inkiwuang'at enyena naa nkiwuang'at e nkima, enkima napejisho oleng to lang'at.

English: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
Masaai: Mear inkariak kumok enyorrata nemeidim olairrag le nkare aawa ninye. Teneitayu oltung'ani enyorrata, too masaa pooki e nkaji enye, naa kemenari tukul.

English: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
Masaai: Kiaata enkiti anashe, nemeeta ninye ilki. Kaa kintaas enkanashe ang, teina olong nasai ninye?

English: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
Masaai: Tenaa kesuntai ninye, naa aikishetaki te shumata ninye oltalet le nkosholai, kake tenaa aikutukaji ninye, nikiripaa ninye too mbaoi o ltarakuai.

English: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
Masaai: Ara apa nanu esuntai, netiu apa ilki laainei anaa iltaleta; neaku atii atua nkonyek enyena, anaa ilo oyau eseriani.

English: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
Masaai: Eeta apa Solomon enkurma oo sabibu te Baalhamon; neishooyo enkurma oo sabibu aisilenoki ilaramatak; ore ake pooki lenye te lelo ng'anayio mpisai enkalifu nabo enkosholai.

English: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
Masaai: Ore enkurma ai oo sabibu, ina naa enaai ake, naa enaai makewan, ore iyie Solomon indim aawa ina alifu nabo, ore ilaramatak loo lng'anayioi netum iip are.

English: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
Masaai: Oi intae oomanya atua nena kurman, einining'ito ilencholuek ai oltoilo lino; nchooki matoning'o ninye.

English: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
Masaai: Tasioki isarisara olanyor lai, totiuo anaa enkolii arashu oloti oing'oni le nkolii, otii oldoinyo loo sonkoyoni.

English: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
Masaai: Enduaata e Isaya olayioni le Amos, apa natoduaa, naipirta Yuda o Yerusalem, too nkolong'i e Usia, o Yotam, o Ahas, o Hesekia, aiguanak le Yuda.

English: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
Masaai: Toning'o, iyie keper, ninchoru enkiok na kop; amu eiroro Olaitoriani: “Aitotio nanu nkera naitubulu, naatogolong'akitia ninche.

English: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master's crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
Masaai: Eyiolo olkiteng olopeny, neyiolo osikiria ewueji neitotiyieki kake meyiolo ninye Israel, mening ninche iltung'ana laainei.”

English: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
Masaai: Ee, olosho loo laing'okok, olorere onapita enkarruoisho, eishoi oo larruok, ilayiok oas inemeitoriori! Etung'uatie ninche Olaitoriani, etemenaitie ninche ilo sinyati le Israel, etapong'ori ninche tukul.

English: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee iyieuu neoshi intae, eji metaa ipuopuo dukuya aagolong'u? Kemuei endukuya pooki, neiterre oltau pooki.

English: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki entutunyo e nkeju o metabaiki endukuya, metii embiotisho, kake ilbaa, o ltuduta, o ngoldonyot naaruko nkimek; neitu eironyuni, aashu eeni, neitu eelieki eilata.

English: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
Masaai: Eirragita enkop inyi aa mijooni, netapejoyioki nkanas inyi te nkima; te dukuya intae idolitata einosa iltung'ana leeiking'a enkop inyi; netomijoono ninye, anaa ina nainyala iltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
Masaai: Etung'uayioki ina tito e Sion anaa olng'obor ti atua enkurma oo sabibu, anaa olkirragarie ti atua enkurma e entoki naaijo nkaimalasia anaa enkanasa natang'aduaki.

English: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
Masaai: Te neme Olaitoriani loo lororani otelekaka iyiook oloti pisiai, anaata kitotiutuo anaa Sodom, nikitiu anaa Gomora.

English: Hear the word of the LORD, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
Masaai: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae ilaitoriak le Sodom! Enchoo enkiok enkiteng'enare e Nkai ang intae iltung'ana le Gomora!

English: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
Masaai: “Kainyoo te nanu enkumoi oo lasarri linyi? Olaitoriani ojo; Ataraposhe nanu ilasarri oopejori loo lmerregeshi o eilata e lelo kerra linyi oopir; mashipakino nanu osarge loo loing'ok, aashu loo lkerra aashu o loo lkineji.

English: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
Masaai: Amu ore oshi ti nipuonunu aaitalioo ate te dukuya nanu, aing'ae naikilikuan intae nipuonunu aaituny ndung'orot aainei.

English: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
Masaai: Mintokiki aayau ilasarri le pesho; olminong enkorropil te nanu. Ore olapa ng'ejuk o sabato o enkipototo e umata - maidim nanu aing'ura ena torroni o eumata.

English: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
Masaai: Ore lelo apaitin linyi ng'ejuko o lelo siruai linyi oogeluno, keiba oltau lai; netaa ninche olola te nanu, atanaure anapita ninche.

English: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
Masaai: Ti nintorioo nkaik inyi, naisudoo nkonyek aainei te ntae; ore hoo niomonono katitin kumok, mainining nanu; ebore nkaik inyi osarge.

English: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
Masaai: Entukuo ate, entobira ate; ewuang'ie entorroni oo nkiaasin inyi, te dukuya nkonyek aainei; entapal entorroni,

English: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
Masaai: entamoo ate easata oo mbaa sidain; eng'oru esipata, entobira enkibookinoto e nkop, entomitu ilo okishi, entasaru ina nara enkoliai.

English: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
Masaai: Wou naa matoning'oto te nebo, Olaitoriani ojo; ore hoo neyia ing'ok inono anaa enkarasha nanyokie, keyooki aaiboru netiu anaa enkatampoi naibor oleng ore hoo nedo anaa osarge, keyooki aaiborru anaa ilpapit loo ntare naaibor.

English: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
Masaai: Ti ninyoraa nirukuruku, ninosinoso olkar le nkop;

English: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: kake ti niaanyianya nigolong'ung'u, nemuti intae to lalem; amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro.”

English: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
Masaai: Kaji eikuna ina anasa naisiligayu, pee etaa enaibor onyek, ore apa ina nabore esipata! Naa enkiguana nasipa naton ti atua ninye, kake ore taata netaa ilarak.

English: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
Masaai: Etaa enkosholai ino isuut, netushulare enaisho ino enkare.

English: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak linono netogolong'utua, naa ile ncholiek oo lapurrok. Nenyor ake pooki te ninche eropare nekuet aasujaa nkishorot. Memitu ninche ilo okishi, nemeshilaa ninche enyamali oo nkolia.

English: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, Olaitoriani ojo, Olaitoriani loo lororani, ilo magilani le Israel: “Ee kaitalaku nanu engoro ai too lmang'ati laainei, kaitalaku nanu makewan te lelo laaiba.

English: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
Masaai: Kaaipirakinye nanu enkaina ai Naasil anaa enasil olkunoni esekenkei naiwuang'ie nanu oloirerio lino pooki.

English: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie nanu ilarishak linyi anaa apake, o lelo arikok linyi anaa apake te nkiterunoto. Ore te siadi ina neaku eikiji, enkanasa e supatisho, ina anasa naisiligayu.”

English: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
Masaai: Kekorduni Sion te sipata, ore lelo ootii atua nekorduni te supatisho.

English: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo oogolong'u o laing'okok, neidaikieki te nebo, ore lelo ootanyaita Olaitoriani nemuti.

English: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
Masaai: Amu iyookiki aakurru te nkaraki lelo keek apa laaijo ilng'abolo lishipakinono, neitukurruni intae te nena kurman apa nitegelutua.

English: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
Masaai: Amu iyookiki intae aatiu anaa olchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli otoyu mbenek enyena, aashu anaa nkurman nemetii enkare.

English: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani ogol netiu anaa suut, ore esiaai enye netiu anaa suut naapiki enkima neyupuyup te nebo, nemeetae oltung'ani oidim aibooi ina kima.

English: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ele rorei etoduaa Isaya olayioni le Amos eipirta Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD'S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
Masaai: Keyooki alotu too nkolong'i e siadi, paa ore ilo doinyo le nkaji o Laitoriani neitasheyieki aaitoodor too ldoinyo, neilepieki aaitogiroo too ldoinyo, ore loshon pooki nerukokino ninye,

English: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa kepuonu iltung'ana kumok aajo: “Wootu, maape oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, maape enkaji e Nkai e Yakobo; pee etum ninye aiteng'ena iyiook nkoitoi enyena, nikitum iyiook aashom too nkoitoi enyena.” Amu Sion ninye epukunye enkitanapata, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani eing'uaa Yerusalem.

English: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Masaai: Kelo ninye aiguanare iloreren, naa kemut ninye nabo ti alo loshon kumok, naa keitaa ninche lalema lenye nchempei, neitaa remeta enye ilalema le nkisampuare, nemeitoki olosho adumakino olikae osho to lalem, nemeitoki ae kata ninche aata olarrabal.

English: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD.
Masaai: Iyie na aji e Yakobo, wou, maape iyiook ti atua ewang'an o Laitoriani.

English: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
Masaai: Amu itung'uayie iyie iltung'ana linono, ina aji e Yakobo, enkaraki nabore ninche lasakutok ooing'uaa oloosaen, o lelo aitumusumusok anaa iltung'ana loo Lfilisti, neoshore ninche nkaik iltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
Masaai: Eiputa enkop enye enkosholai o sahabu, nemeeta ilchumat lenye eneiting'ie; neiputa nkop enye mbartan, nemeeta eneiting'ie ngarrin enye oo mbartan te nkumoi.

English: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
Masaai: Eiputa enkop enye nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, neirrugokino ninche ina siaai oo nkaik enye, ina naitobira ilkimojik lenye.

English: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
Masaai: Keitoborri iltung'ana, neitadouni iltung'ana - mipalaki ninche!

English: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty.
Masaai: Tijing'a atua endapidapoi, nilo aisudori ti atua enterit ailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani, nilany ina kitoo e nkisisa enye.

English: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
Masaai: Ore ina kitokoos oo ltung'ana naa keitadouni, ore ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana naa keitoborri; neaku Olaitoriani ake eitaae kitok te ina olong.

English: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
Masaai: Amu eeta Olaitoriani loo lororani enkolong nagilunore ilo pooki owuasa neitokoos, agilunore ina pooki nailepieki aadumu;

English: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
Masaai: agilunore lelo tarakua pooki le Lebanon, lelo adoru ooilepieki shumata, negilunore lelo keek oogol le Bashan;

English: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
Masaai: negilunore lelo doinyo adoru pooki, negilunore nena doinyo naaitokoos pooki;

English: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
Masaai: negilunore pooki wueji neika, o pooki suntai nasheta;

English: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
Masaai: negilunore imelin pooki e Tarshishi negilunore pooki toki e nkarriyiano.

English: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
Masaai: Ore enkitokoos oo ltung'ana neitadouni, ore ilo wuasa loo ltung'ana neitadouni abori; neaku Olaitoriani ake eitaae kitok te ina olong.

English: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin neishieki tukul.

English: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
Masaai: Nejing iltung'ana nkapuniaa oo ndapidapo, o ngumot e nkop, aailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani, neilany ina kitoo e nkisisa enye, te nedumunye aiture enkop.

English: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina olong nenang'aa iltung'ana aaiturraa nena kitanyaanyukot enye e nkosholai o nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin e sahabu, apa naaitobirakita ate pee eserem, nenang'aki ilkirrumun o sarampalani,

English: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
Masaai: pee etum aatijing ilbaat loo ndapidapo o nkapuniaa oo soito sapuki aailany ina kituriata o Laitoriani o ina kitoo e nkisisa enye, te nedumunye ninye aiture enkop.

English: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
Masaai: Mbelekenyayu tung'uai tung'ani laa ore nkumeishin enyena netii enkiyang'et, Amaa kole tipat ninye?

English: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa keiwuang'ie te Yerusalem o te Yuda, ina naisiligi o ina naishuyieki, eneisiligi te ndaa o nkare;

English: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
Masaai: ilo tung'ani magilani o sikari, o larishani o loiboni le Nkai, o laitumusumusoni o lpayian,

English: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
Masaai: ilo arikoni le njore e onom o ilo tung'ani oata enkitoo, ilo arikoni o ilo arriyia too nkitoduaat, o ilo arriyia te naibon.

English: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu ilayiok ilkituaak lenye, naa nkera naapuo aaitore ninche.

English: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
Masaai: Naa kepuo iltung'ana aaibookino enkop maate, neitorogony ake oltung'ani olikae oltung'ani ake ole latia enye; neitokoos olbarnoti te dukuya olpayian, neitokoos oltung'ani li abori te dukuya ilo kitok.

English: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
Masaai: Kelotu enkata naibung oltung'ani olalashe lenye ti atua enkaji e menye, ejo, “Iata iyie olkila; iyie olo aaku olarikoni lang, ore ele sototi pooki le nkidaata naa keaku abori enkitoria ino;”

English: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
Masaai: ore te ina olong naa keiro ninye ajo, “Maaku nanu olabaani, ore atua enkaji ai metii endaa nemetii olkila; mikintaa intae nanu olarikoni loo ltung'ana.”

English: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
Masaai: Amu etarrorre Yerusalem, netabatate Yuda; enkaraki naa ore nkirorot enye o nkiaasin enye negilunore Olaitoriani, nemor dukuya nkonyek enyena.

English: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
Masaai: Ilo kep lenye oishakenoki ninche; keibalunye ninche ing'ok enye anaa Sodom, meisudoo ninche. Woi ninche Amu eyautua entorroni shumata ate.

English: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
Masaai: Tiaaki lelo asipak nchere aisidain mbaa ti alo ninche, amu keinos ninche ilng'anayio loo nkiaasin enye.

English: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
Masaai: Woi ilo tung'ani torrono! Kerruoyo mbaa te ninye, amu ore enaba anaa enataasa nkaik enyena, ina eyookini aaitaas ninye.

English: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana laainei, nkera naaitorogony ninche, naa nkituaak naaitore ninche. Lo tung'ana laainei, eitapong'oitie intae ilarikok linyi, nemil enkoitoi inyi.

English: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
Masaai: Eitasho Olaitoriani pee eishankarra, eitasho pee eiguanare iltung'ana lenyena.

English: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
Masaai: Etijing'a Olaitoriani enkiguana aiguanare ilpayiani o lkituaak loo ltung'ana lenyena: “Intae apa ooinosa enkurma oo lng'anayio, ore nena nitoorutuo intae ilaisinak netii atua nkajijik inyi.

English: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the LORD GOD of hosts.
Masaai: Kainyoo intodolulu pee intorogonyonyo iltung'ana laainei, nindong'idong'o aarepeny nkomomi e lelo aisinak?” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
Masaai: Etejo Olaitoriani: Ore enkaraki naitokoos ntoyie e Sion nepuo te nkitaragirag neing'orisho to lwuasa, neyagiyag epuoito eipidie nkejek enye;

English: Therefore the LORD will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.
Masaai: keosh Olaitoriani to lpepedoi nena lukuny oo ntoyie e Sion, naa keibalunye Olaitoriani emasipaisho enye.

English: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keiwuang'ie Olaitoriani nena masaa naang'idare,

English: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
Masaai: o lmiintoni, o lkataarri o nkarash oo murto; o nkarash

English: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
Masaai: oo lukuny, o sekenke oo nkaik, o ntoren, o ltuleta le sonkoyo, o ntaleng'o

English: The rings, and nose jewels,
Masaai: o lelo giso oomishira o lgiso loo nkumeishin;

English: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
Masaai: o lelo kilani loo siruai, lelo karash li oriong, o lelo kilani, o lbenia loo nkaik;

English: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
Masaai: o lelo kilani oobebek, o lelo kilani oo puyiapui, o nkarash oo lukuny, o lelo karash oo imulumulieki nkonyek.

English: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
Masaai: Ore te rishata e rropili naa eng'uan; ore te rishata e nkimeita naa olgosoi; naa ore te rishata oo lpapit ooitobiraki, naa enkurroto; naa ore te rishata o olkila sidai naa enkishopo oo lkuniyiani; naa ore te rishata e nkikishaan naa enkurruna.

English: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
Masaai: Ore ilewa linyi naa kebatat olalem nemuta lelo lewa linyi magil to larrabal.

English: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
Masaai: Ore nchomito enyena neyietu aaishir; neirrag ninye te nkop meishopo.

English: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
Masaai: Naa keibung kenya nkituaak naapishana olee obo te ina olong ejo, “Eikinya iyiook endaa ang maate nikinchop nkilani ang maate, nchoo ake duoo eipotieki iyiook enkarna ino, iwuang'ie enkurruna ang.”

English: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong kesidanu olng'osila lo Laitoriani, ore lng'anayio le ina kop naa keaku esikar o enkitoo e ilo pisiai otelekua loo Siraeli.

English: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
Masaai: Naa ore ilo otelekua te Sion neton te Yerusalem, neipoti aajo sinyati, pooki ng'ae ake ninye oigeroki enkarna enye te nkaraki puaan te Yerusalem,

English: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
Masaai: ina kata eidipa Olaitoriani aitukuo olduruk too ntoyie e Sion neitukuo iltipot lo sarge le Yerusalem, aiwuangie te mpolos enye, to ltau le nkiguana o to ltau le mpejoroto.

English: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
Masaai: Netum taa Olaitoriani aitobira te shumata o ldoinyo pooki le Sion o te shumata ilturrurri lenyena pooki enkatampoi te ndama, o empuruo o enkimerlel e nkima te nkewarie, amu ore te shumata naa kelo atii enkitushurata o lng'obor.

English: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
Masaai: Keaku ninye oloip te ndama te nkaraki enkirowuaj, o te nkaraki sii enesaruni o enelutori te nkaraki olkutati o enchan.

English: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
Masaai: Ntasho mataranyaki nanu olanyor lai osinkolio le nyorrata oipirta enkurma enye oo sabibu: eeta apa ilo lanyor enkurma oo sabibu te ndoinyo sidai enterit.

English: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
Masaai: Etuturo ninye neiwuang'ie soito, neun isabibu ooshiluno; neshetu oltalet orripishoreki te mpolos e nkurma, neitobiru eneironyishoreki te ine; neton aanyu metoiu enkurma isabibu, kake isabibu le ntim etoiuo.

English: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
Masaai: Ore naa, intae iloomanya Yerusalem o ltung'ana le Yuda, atoomono intae, enguanareki nanu o ina kurma ai oo sabibu.

English: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
Masaai: kainyoo nanu aitong'oro eitu aas te nkurma ai oo sabibu? Ore pee aanyu nanu metoiu ilng'anayio, kaainyo pee aa isabibu le ntim etoiuo?

English: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
Masaai: Ore naa taata kaaliki nanu enalo aitaas enkurma ai oo sabibu Kaiwuang'ie nanu enkikarrata enye, pee eidaikieki; naa kagil nanu isunta enyena pee eitunyori.

English: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu ninye mijooni; meisampuni ae kata te ninye nemeturi naa kebulunye endiati o lkiku; naa kaitanap sii nkatampo pee meshaiki enchan ninye.

English: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
Masaai: Amu ore ina kurma oo sabibu o Laitoriani loo lororani naa enkaji e Israel, ore lelo tung'ana le Yuda ninche enkurma natuunoki naitiship ninye; neing'oru ninye esipata, kake ng'ura, enkibukooroto osarge natii; neing'orua esupatisho, naa ng'ura, olkiyioi otii!

English: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
Masaai: Wooi ninche lelo ooruk nkajijik, lelo ooponiki ate ilchampai, o metaba anaa neishunye pooki wueji, nikintaae iyie oloton openy te mpolos e nkop.

English: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai aning'ito too nkiyiaa aainei: “Esipa kemijoonu nkajijik kumok, nena ajijik sidain sapuki nememanya.

English: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
Masaai: Amu ore iyekai tomon oo lng'anayio naa iltuleta isiet ake eitayu le naisho oo sabibu ore enkikapu nabo oo lanterera naa emborei nabo empirbil ake entapa.”

English: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooinyototo aayooki tadekenya, pee etum aakuet aatusujai inaishi naapi, lelo ootoni oleng o metaa kewarie o metaba anaa neidimu ninche enaisho!

English: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
Masaai: Neeta ninche nkinantani o nkai oo sinkolioitin, o ndulen, o naishi too siruai lenye; kake meshilaa ninche nkiaasin o Laitoriani, anaa edol ina siaai oo nkaik enyena.

English: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kepuo iltung'ana laainei eyararoto te nkaraki emodai enye; kemut olameyu ilkituaak lenye, nemuta olorere lenye pooki te nkure.

English: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
Masaai: Neaku eibung'a enemeneng'a esumash, netang'a enkutuk enye aitulus, ore enkitoo e Yerusalem o ilo orora lenye, naa kepuo aadoyio, olorora lenye, o ilo ong'idare.

English: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
Masaai: Eirrugoki tung'ani aaing'orie enkop, neitadowuoki iltung'ana aayau kop, ore nkonyek e ilo oitokoos neitoborraki.

English: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
Masaai: Kake ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, neitaaki kitok te sipata, ore Enkai Sinyati neitodolu kewan te sinyatisho te sipata.

English: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
Masaai: Ore ilkuoo le kerra, nedaa anaa ilootii endaata enye, ore ilkuoo le kineji nedaa to lmuaate.

English: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooyietu enkarruoisho too nkeenta e lejare, lelo ooyietu ng'ok anaa too nkeenta e ngarri,

English: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
Masaai: lelo oojo: “Nchoo ninche eisarrisar, nchoo ninche eitasiooyo esiaai enye pee kitum iyiook aatodol; nchoo eyiolounoto e ilo Sinyati le Israel etaanu, naa nchoo ninye elotu, pee kitum iyiook aatayiolo!”

English: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo oojo entorroni eisidai nejo esidano entorroni, nepik enaimin erishata e wang'an, nepik ewang'an erishata e naimin, lelo oopik enduaran erishata e meloni nepik emeloni erishata e nduaran!

English: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooiteng'enuo too nkonyek enye maate, lelo ooitaa ate kalamasi!

English: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo oorup ate te neokieki enaisho, lelo arriyiak te nkitushulata oo naishi naapi,

English: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
Masaai: lelo oo laaya olarruoni te nkaraki eropata, neoru ilo asipani esipata enye!

English: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Neaku, ore anaa enamut olng'ejep le nkima isuut, o anaa enaibung nkujit naatoito o lng'ejep le nkima, neijia etiu ntona enye, ketiu anaa entoki natong'ua apurda, ore te rishata naitapuku, netiu anaa enterit; enkaraki natanyaita ninche enkitanapata Olaitoriani loo lororani, netemenaitie ninche ororei le Ilo Sinyati le Israel.

English: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eyupuyupo engoro o Laitoriani ti alo iltung'ana lenyena, neitorioyie ninye enkaina enye, aarare ninche neosh ninche, neikirikira oldoinyo; netiu mpopoki enye anaa suut too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa. Amu ore te kuna pooki meibooroyu engoro enye, neton ake eitoriori enkaina enye.

English: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
Masaai: Neyuku ninye olosho olakua, neisulu ninye aipotu meetu aaing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop; naa ng'ura, nekuetu te ngolon oleng!

English: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
Masaai: Meetae obo lenye onauru, meetae obo lenye orrorro, meetae oloimug neirura, meetae olololong'u enkimeita, nemedung'o enkeene e namuke enye;

English: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses' hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
Masaai: naa kepi mbaa enye, neteyietuoki nkai enye, negol iloisotok loo mbartan enye anaa soito, ore nkejek oo ng'arrin enye epuo anaa osiwuo.

English: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
Masaai: Neikununo enkikurrukur enye anaa eno lng'atuny, neikurrukur ninche anaa ilkuoo loo lng'atunyo; keikurrukur ninche neibung'isho, neripaa ninche ina ng'ues naaibung'a, nemeetae ololo arrinyu.

English: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keikurrukurroki ninche nena naaibung'a, te nkikurrukur naaijo ene naiposha. Naa te neingor oltung'ani enkop, ng'ura, enaimin ake o osina; ore ewang'an neitomisimis nkatampo enyena.

English: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
Masaai: Ore te ilo ari apa otuayie olaiguanani oji Usia, atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani etonita to lorika le nkitoo. Neilepieki ninye oleng. Ore olkila lenye neiput enkaji e Nkai.

English: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
Masaai: Ore te shumata ninye neitashe iserafi. Neeta ake obo inaipuko ile. Ore are neimulumulie enkomom enye, ore are neimulumulie nkejek enyena, ore are nelotie tiaai.

English: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
Masaai: Neipoto ake maate ejo: “Sinyati, Sinyati, Sinyati Olaitoriani loo lororani; eiputa enkop pooki enkitoo enye.”

English: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
Masaai: Neikirikira olkitamanyunoto le Nkaji e Nkai te nkaraki ina buakunoto, neiput ina aji empuruo.

English: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Najo nanu: “Woi kewan ai! Amu aimina nanu; amu ara nanu oltung'ani loo nkirorot torrok; naton tiatua iltung'ana loo nkirorot torrok; amu etoduaa nkonyek aainei Olaiguanani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani!”

English: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
Masaai: Nelotu obo le lelo serafi enatii, neibung'ita te nkaina enye enkukuo naishu, nayaua to lperere lo lasar.

English: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
Masaai: Neiseyie enkutuk ai, nejo, “Ng'ura, eiseyie ena enkutuk ino; eiwuang'ieki entorroni ino, nikitapalakaki ing'ok inono.”

English: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
Masaai: Naning nanu oltoilo lo Laitoriani ejo, “Kaing'ae nanu airriwaa, naa kaing'ae olo te nkaraki iyiook?” Najo nanu, “Nele nanu! Irriwayioki.”

English: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Shomo, tiaaki ele orere: ‘Ining'ining'i, kake miyiolouu; Idolidolo kake mimususu.’

English: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
Masaai: Iroshiyie iltauja le kulo tung'ana, nintiming'ana nkiyiaa enye, ninkeno nkonyek enye; pee medolisho too nkonyek enye, nemening'isho too nkiyiaa enye, neyiolou too ltauja lenye, neibelekenya pee eishiunyeki.”

English: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Oi anu, Olaitoriani?” Nejo ninye: “O metaba anaa nemijoonu nkanas memanya toki, o nkajijik metii iltung'ana, ore enkop neliyioyu tukul,

English: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
Masaai: neiwuang'ie Olaitoriani iltung'ana aitalamaa oleng, neaku ilmuaateni kumok te mpolos e nkop.

English: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
Masaai: Ore hoo duoo ninye te neleku ematua nabo e tomon, keitokini aapejoo, ketiu ninye anaa enkobei o lchani onyaanyukie olng'aboli naing'uari eitashe, eidipaki aatuuroi.” Ilo antererai sinyati ninye ina obei.

English: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
Masaai: Ore apa too nkolong'i e Ahas olayioni le Yotam, olayioni le Usia, olaiguanani le Yuda, nelotu Resin olaiguanani le Siria o Peka olyioni le Remalia, ilo aiguanani le Israel, Yerusalem pee eitainye olarrabal. Kake eitu ninche emir ninye.

English: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
Masaai: Ore ake pee elikini enkaji e Daudi nchere, “Eibung'ate Siria o Efraim,” neikirikira oltau lenye o iltauja loo ltung'ana lenyena anaa ilkeek le ntim ookutita osiwuo.

English: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field;
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani Isaya, “Shomo tanang'are Ahas, iyie o Shearyashub olayioni lino, amu inang'arere ninye, te nkiting'oto o lkiperrata le nkare o lchorro le shumata, te wueji oo laitobirak loonkilani,

English: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
Masaai: nijoki ninye, ‘Terretenayu, ntirring'ayu, nimiureishoyu, nemishalu te nkaraki nena oben are e nkima netaa keimisiloo, te nkaraki engoro e Resin o Siria o layioni le Remalia.

English: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naipirutua Siria, te nebo Efraim entorroni te nebo olayioni le Remalia, ejo,

English: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
Masaai: “Maape iyiook aaitayunye Yuda olarrabal, nikinture ninye, nikisulie iyiook aaya, nikipik iyiook olayioni le Tabel metaa olaiguanani ti atua ninye,”

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
Masaai: nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meitashe ina, nemeaku ae kata.

English: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
Masaai: Amu ore entonata e Siria naa Dameski, ore entonata e Dameski naa Resin. (Ore te rishata oo larin ntomoni ile o imiet naa keitaae Efraim mpurdat o metaa meitoki aaku olorere.)

English: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
Masaai: Ore endukuya e Efraim naa Samaria, ore endukuya e Samaria naa olayioni le Remalia. Ti nimirukuruku, intae, meeta nchere pee ntasheito.’ ”

English: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani airorie Ahas,

English: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
Masaai: nejoki, “Ing'oru olmonekie to Laitoriani Enkai ino; nchoo egutu anaa enemeneng'a aashu eado abaiki keper.”

English: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.
Masaai: Kake etejo Ahas, “Maikilikuanu nanu, nematem nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ajo, “Toning'o naa, na aji e Daudi! Kentoki nalelek ena pee intanaururu intae iltung'ana, nintokiki sii aaitanaur Enkai ai?

English: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
Masaai: Ore naa Olaitoriani makewan oisho intae olmonekie. Ng'ura, kenutayu eselenkei neiu enkayioni naa keisho ninye enkarna aajo Emanuel.

English: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
Masaai: Naa keaku ninye neinos eng'orno o enaisho, te neyiolou atirisha intorrok o supati.

English: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
Masaai: Amu ore eton eitu eyiolou ina kerai atanya entorroni negelu ina sidai, ore ina kop e lelo aiguanak pookira oare ooiture intae, naa kepuoi aaing'uaa.

English: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Keyau Olaitoriani shumata iyie, o shumata iltung'ana linyi, o shumata e nkaji e papaai lino nkolong'i neitu ae kata etumi ina olong apa nalo Efraim te Yuda - ilo aiguanani le Asiria.”

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keipotu Olaitoriani te nkisulata lelo oopuonu anaa lojong'a ooing'uaa nchorroi e Misiri o ilo olotu anaa olotoroki oing'uaa enkop e Asiria.

English: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
Masaai: Naa kepuonu ninche pooki nemany ineegum oo erat, o nkapuniaa oo ndapidapo, o sanagi pooki loo lkiku, o wuejitin pooki neenyori.

English: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa kelo Olaitoriani abarnisho to lmurunya oisilenuoki te lido kekun o lkeju - to laiguanani le Asiria. Nebarn endukuya o lpapit loo nkejek enye, nebarn sii olmunyei tukul.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina olong naa keramat oltung'ani enkashe o nkerra are;

English: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
Masaai: naa ore enkaraki enkumoi e kule naata ninche, keinos ninye eng'orno; amu ore pooki ng'ae otelekua te ina kop naa keinos eng'orno o enaisho.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong pooki wueji netii apa isabibu enkalifu nabo oata enkinyang'a e shekeli enkalifu nabo enkosholai, naa keaku entim oo lkiku.

English: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
Masaai: Kepuonu iltung'ana ine eeta nkai o mbaa amu keaku enkop pooki entim oo lkiku;

English: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
Masaai: ore nena doinyo apa naaturi too nchempei nimintokiki intae aapuonu ine iurere entim oo lkiku; kake keaku nene wuejitin ineeidapashakino nkishu o nkerra.

English: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man's pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu, “Iwa embao dapash ngero too sirat sapuki, ‘Ene Maher-shalal-hash-bas.’ ”

English: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
Masaai: Natum nanu olchakeni osipa, Uria ilo apolosani o Sakaria olayioni le Yeberekia, pee aaishakenoki.

English: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
Masaai: Nalo nanu aboitare enkitok ai, nenutayu ninye neiu enkayioni. Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, “Tejo enkarna e ina ayioni Maher-shalal-hash-bas;

English: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
Masaai: amu ore eton eitu eyiolou ina kerai atejo ‘Mpapa’ aashu ‘Nini’, ore ina arsisisho e Dameski o nena apa naatarutua Samaria naa keyae eduaaya olaiguanani le Asiria.”

English: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,
Masaai: Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani airorie, naajoki,

English: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah's son;
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki natanyaita ele orere nkariak e Shiloa naaruko akiti, netalepori ninche eure Resin olayioni le Remalia;

English: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
Masaai: ore enkaraki ina kerewaki Olaitoriani aitaar ninche nkariak o Lkeju, kumok negol, ilo aiguanani le Asiria o enkitoo enye pooki; naa kenang'ari ninche aaimu imartin nepuo aaim mbat o lkeju.

English: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
Masaai: Naa keor nena ariak Yuda, nenang'ari neruko aapuo, neitabaiki olorere murto. Naa te nelak inaipuko enyena neibulu enkop ino pooki, iyie Emanuel.”

English: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
Masaai: Entigilata intae oreren niureishoyuyu; entoning intae na kuapi naalakua; enterreten ate niruturutu.

English: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
Masaai: Enguanata te nebo, kake meaku ina toki; eimaki ororei kake melo auno, amu etii Enkai te nebo iyiook.

English: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
Masaai: Amu nji eiroro Olaitoriani ajoki, eiteleikia ina aina enye nagol shumata nanu, naaikok pee maibung orrekie le kulo tung'ana, ajoki:

English: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
Masaai: “Mijo iyie nena kitobirat torrok, nena pooki naajo kulo tung'ana nkitobirat torrok, nimiureyu iyie ina naure ninche, nimimputukuny.

English: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
Masaai: Kake ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye ake intaa sinyati, nchoo eaku ninye iure, nchoo eaku ninye oloputukunyi lino.

English: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa keaku ninye ewueji sinyati, neaku osoit oluaa, neaku endapidapoi e rrorroto too nkajijik pokira e Israel. Neaku eloket o rreshet te lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
Masaai: Naa kerrorrokino ilkumok enchumata enye, nebatata negila, nerreshi ninche neyae.”

English: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
Masaai: Teena ina shakenisho, entimishir ina kiteng'enare ti atua ilooiteng'eni laainei.

English: And I will wait upon the LORD, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
Masaai: Kaanyu nanu Olaitoriani, laa ninye oisudoo enkomom enye aitung'uaa enkaji e Yakobo, naa kaisilig ninye.

English: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore nanu o kuna kera naaishoo Olaitoriani nikira iyiook olmonekie o embae e nking'asia ti atua Israel, eing'uaa Olaitoriani loo lororani obik te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion.

English: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
Masaai: Naa tenejoki ninche intae, “Enkilikuanishore ilaitumusumusok o lasakutok ooing'oming'om neyietu,” aimeikilikuanishore iltung'ana Enkai enye? Ke lootuata ninche eikilikuanishore te rishata oo looishu?

English: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
Masaai: Tawaliki ninche, tiaki, “Entoning ina naiteng'en intae Olaitoriani! Emining ilaitumusumusok - ore enajoki ninche intae nemeret intae.”

English: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aadung enkop, eeta osina kitok o esumash; naa ore te neisumashu, negoro nedek olaiguanani lenye o Enkai enye, nedumu nkomomi enye aaing'orie shumata;

English: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
Masaai: neitoki aaing'or enkop, kake ng'ura, osina ake o enaimin, ina misimisi o sina. Naa kenang'akini ninche atua enaimin narok ong'u.

English: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
Masaai: Kake meetae osina te ina apa naata emion. Ore too nkatitin e dukuya neishoo ninye metemenare enkop e Sebulon o enkop e Naftali, kake ore too nkolong'i e siadi naa keisho ninye meitaai kitok ina oitoi e naiposha, ina kop natii lido kekun le Yordan, Galilaya oo loreren.

English: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana apa oopuo te naimin netoduaa ewang'an kitok; ore apa lelo oomanya enegut e misimisi, neitawang'aka ninche ewang'an.

English: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
Masaai: Itoponayie iyie olorere itoponikia iyie eng'ida enye; neng'ida ninche te dukuya iyie te ng'ida neeijo ene nkisampuare, neikununo anaa tene ng'ida lewa eor nena naataarutua.

English: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
Masaai: Amu ore ina shata e murt e ilo ola lenye, o ina shata o loililai lenye, ina ng'udi e ilo aitorogonyani, nitigila iyie anaa te nkata e Midian.

English: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
Masaai: Amu ore enamuke ake pooki e ilo otii enjore naa kemut enkima, ore pooki kila oata oltipoti lo sarge naa kepejori anaa ilkeek le nkima.

English: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
Masaai: Amu etoikioki iyiook enkerai, eishooki iyiook enkayioni, naa keaku oloililai lenye etii enkitoria, naa kepuoi aajo enkarna enye, “Olaiguanani le Nking'asia, Enkai Magilani, Papa loo Ntarasi, Olkitok le Seriani.”

English: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
Masaai: Ore emponaroto e nkitoria enye o eseriani, nemeeta enkiting'oto, to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi, o te shumata enkitoo enye, pee eitubulaa, neitasheyie te sipata o te supatisho, ebaiki ena kata taata oo ntarasi moitie. Olokiyo lo Laitoriani loo lororani oitabaya ena.

English: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
Masaai: Eirriwayie Olaitoriani olkilikuai lo larrabal te nkaraki Yakobo, naa kelo aitawang'aki Israel.

English: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
Masaai: Naa kepuo iltung'ana pooki aayiolou, aa taa, Efraim o lelo oomanya Samaria, lelo oojo to lwuasa o te nkitokoos oo ltauja:

English: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
Masaai: “Etusulari isoito kake eikishet iyiook too soito oogueta; eturoyioki oreteti aadung, kake eikipik iyiook iltarakua erishata enye.”

English: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
Masaai: Neaku kedumaki ninche Olaitoriani ilmang'ati, neputu ilmang'ati lenye.

English: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Siria ootii enkalo o loo saen o lelo le Filisti ootii enkalo o loo ntoluo, kepuo aamut te nkutuk nang'a. Amu ore te kuna pooki eitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neitorioyioki enkaina enye.

English: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Eitu eibelekenyakino iltung'ana ilo otoosho ninche, neitu eing'oru Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina etudung'oyie Olaitoriani te Israel endukuya o lkidong'oi; nedung ilng'osil loo ltuka o seyia te nkolong nabo -

English: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
Masaai: lelo payiani kituaak ooyanyit ninche endukuya, ore ilo oiboni oibonisho te lejare ninye olkidong'oe;

English: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
Masaai: amu ore lelo oorikoo ele orere naa keitapong'oo ninche, ore lelo oorikori naa keijori.

English: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina meshipakino Olaitoriani elelero enye, nemeetayie olng'ur lelo okishin o nkolia; amu ore pooki ng'ae lenye nepaashare orrekie le Nkai naa laasak loo ntorrok, ore pooki kutuk neiro ine modai. Ore te kuna pooki neitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neitorioki enkaina enye.

English: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
Masaai: Amu eyupuyupito entorroni anaa enkima, neinos isuut o lkiku; neinos isanagi le ntim, neilep ninche shumata te mpuruo kitok.

English: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
Masaai: Ti atua engoro o Laitoriani loo lororani etapejoki enkop, netotiutuo iltung'ana anaa ilkeek le nkima; meetae oltung'ani oing'urrie olalashe lenye.

English: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
Masaai: Ewuapaa ninche too ntateniaa, neton ake eisumash, nedaa ninche too nkedienyaa, kake eitu eraposho; neinos ake oltung'ani nkiri e ilo le latia enye.

English: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Neinos Manase Efraim, neinos Efraim Manase, ore ninche pokira nedumakino Yuda. Ore te kuna pooki neitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye, Neitorioki enkaina enye.

English: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooiguana nkiguanat torrok, o lelo ooiger enkitorogonyare,

English: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
Masaai: neibelekeny ilo omena aaitapaash esipata neoru ilo aisinani loo ltung'ana laainei esipata enye, neitaa ninche nkolia entoki nataarutua, netum aaibung'a nena okishin aawaita!

English: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
Masaai: Kaa kenya intae iasiasa te ina olong e nkitamioto, te ilo kutati olotu eing'uaa enelakua? Kaing'ae iyie isaru mikitaretu, naa kaing'ae iyie ing'ueiki karsisisho ino?

English: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
Masaai: Meleku toki, meteleku ake pee isukudo te nebo lelo ooena, aashu ibatata te nebo lelo ootasesekuanaki. Amu ore te kuna pooki eitu eiwuang'ieki engoro enye neton ake etudumuaki enkaina enye pee eoshisho.

English: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
Masaai: Ee, Asiria, ninye eng'udi e ngoro ai, ninye orinka le mpijan e ngoro ai!

English: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
Masaai: Airriua nanu metaarare ilo osho lemeure Enkai, naitanapa nanu ninye te nkaraki ilo orere laaitagoro, pee eibung aaraya ntokitin enye, neitunyoki enkop anaa esarng'ab e nkoitoi.

English: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
Masaai: Kake mme ina eyieu ninye, neme ina edamu ninye; kake ore ndamunot enyena naa pee einyalisho, nedung'oo iloshon leme kuti;

English: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
Masaai: amu ejo ninye: “Aime ilaiguanak pooki ilarikok laainei?

English: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
Masaai: Aimetiu kulo anaa Karkemish? Aimetiu Hamat anaa Arpad? Aimetiu Samaria anaa Dameski?

English: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
Masaai: Amaa anaa enatabaikia enkaina ai nkitoriat oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin, naa ore nkitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno naa eikituaak aalang nena naatii Yerusalem o Samaria,

English: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
Masaai: aimaitaas nanu Yerusalem o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena anaa enaitaasa Samaria o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena.”

English: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Olaitoriani esiaai enye pooki to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem, naa keitame ilo owuasa o ina kitokoos o laiguanani le Siria o ina kitaragirag enye.

English: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
Masaai: Amu ejo Ninye: “Te ngolon e nkaina ai ataasa nanu ena, o te ng'eno ai, amu kara nanu ng'en; naiwuang'ie nanu lpolosien loo loreren, natarayie nanu ilchumat lenye; ore anaa oloing'oni atusulua nanu lelo ootoni too lorikan le nkitoo.

English: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
Masaai: Eibung'a enkaina anaa enkaji e motonyi karsisisho oo loreren; naa ore anaa enasotu iltung'ana ilmosor ootung'uayioki, neijia aikuna asotu enkop pooki; nemeetae hoo obo oiwuang'ie enaipukoi, aashu obol enkutuk, aashu eyietu.”

English: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
Masaai: Keaku entolu kitok alang ilo oasishore, arashu keisis emusumeno kewan te ilo odung'ishore? Eji netiu anaa eng'udi nadumu oltung'ani! Anaa netiu anaa eng'udi nadumu ilo leme enchata.

English: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ore Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, kelo airriwaki esaso lelo morran lenyena oopir, ore ti abori enkitoo enye neinoki enkiyupuyup, neeijo enkiyupuyup e nkima.

English: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
Masaai: Ore ina wang'an e Israel naa keaku enkima, ore ilo lenye sinyati neaku olng'ejep le nkima, naa keinos ninye nemut lelo kiku lenyena o suut pooki te nkolong nabo.

English: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
Masaai: Ore ina kishiaa e ntim enye o ene ina kop enye nalepo, naa keidakie Olaitoriani, osesen o enkishui, netiu anaa oltung'ani omuei te nemenayu.

English: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
Masaai: Ore olpisiai le lelo keek lenyena ooleku naa keaku kuti, o metaa ninye keidim enkerai aikena.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong ilo pisiai le Israel o lelo oolekuni le nkaji e Yakobo, nemeitoki aairishakino ilo apa otaara ninche, kake Olaitoriani eirishakino ninche. Ilo sinyati le Israel eirishakino te sipata.

English: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
Masaai: Olpisiai olo arrinyunye, ilo pisiai le Yakobo orrinyokino Enkai magilani.

English: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo neba iltung'ana linono le Israel anaa osinyai le naiposha olpisiai ake lenye orrinyunye. Etudung'okoki enkiguana e nkidaata te sipata.

English: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
Masaai: Amu ore Olaitoriani loo lororani naa kelo aiting'ie anaa enatudung'oki ti atua enkop pooki.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani: “Lo tung'ana laainei, kulo oomanya Sion, emiureyu ile Asiria te neoshisho te ng'udi aashu te nedumu orinka lenye aar intae anaa apa enaikuna ile Misiri.

English: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
Masaai: Amu ore te nkiti rishata naa keish engoro ai, neibelekenyakino engoro ai enkidaata enye.

English: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
Masaai: Nedumu Olaitoriani loo lororani eng'udi agilunore ninche anaa apa pee eosh Midian te ndapidapoi e Oreb. Ore eng'udi enye kelo shumata enaiposha, naa kedumu ninye anaa apa enaikuna te Misiri.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
Masaai: Ore te ina te neiwuang'a ilo ola lenye to loililai lino, negili ina shata enye emurt nanapishoreki te murt ino.”

English: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
Masaai: Eilepa ninye alo Rimon, eewuo ninye Aiat; etudung'o ninye enkop e Migron, ore te Mikmash neshum ninye olola lenye;

English: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
Masaai: etalang'a ninche te lang'ata, neirrag Geba enkewarie nabo, neikirikira Rama, ore Gibea e Saul neilanyisho.

English: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
Masaai: Teyietu nchira, na tito e Galim! Entoning lo tung'ana le Laisha! Tawaliki ninye, iyie, Anatot!

English: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
Masaai: Eisikita Madmena, ore lelo oomanya Gebin neilanyishote aaing'oru enesaru.

English: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ena olong kelo ninye aitashe te Nobu, nelo aikirikirie enkaina enye te ilo doinyo le nkidaata le Sion, te ilo doinyo le Yerusalem.

English: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore Olaitoriani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, kedung lelo ng'osil te ngolon naitureisho; ore ilo magilani oado naa kedung'i, ore lelo oorup ate neitadouni.

English: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
Masaai: Kedung ninye ina asuri e ntim te ntolu, ore Lebanon o lelo keek lenyena sidain neurori.

English: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
Masaai: Kepuku enkaitubului te nkobei e Yese, nebulu olng'osila te nena tona enyena.

English: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD;
Masaai: Naa ketonie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata ninye, enkiyang'et e ng'eno o enkarriyiano, enkiyang'et e utaroto o enkidimata, enkiyang'et e ng'eno o euriata o Laitoriani.

English: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
Masaai: Ore enchipai enye naa euriata o Laitoriani. Nemedung ninye enkiguana too naadol nkonyek enyena, aashu edung too naaning too nkiyiaa enyena;

English: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
Masaai: kake too sipat ninye eiguanare laisinak, neikok ninye te mborron lelo oobor ootii enkop; naa kear ninye enkop te ng'udi e nkutuk enye, near ilo arruoni metua te nkiyang'et e nkutuk enye.

English: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
Masaai: Esipata ninye naaku enkimeita e mpolos enye, naa ina kisiligata naisiligayu ninye naaku enkeene narreten ninye.

English: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
Masaai: Neton osuyiani te nebo olkuoo le ker, neirrag olowuaru keri te nebo olkuoo le kine, ore olashe o lng'atuny neirrag te nebo nerikoo enkiti kerai ninche.

English: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
Masaai: Ore enkiteng olng'arurumi ng'iro nedaa te nebo; ore lasho lenye neirrag te nebo, ore olng'atuny neaku nkujit einos anaa olkiteng.

English: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
Masaai: Neiguran enkerai nanakita te nkutuk e ngumoto o lasurai, nepik enkerai kiti enkaina enye enkutuk e engumoto e nturbubua.

English: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
Masaai: Meiko ninche ae nemeinyal ti atua ilo doinyo lai pooki sinyati; amu keiput enkop eyiolounoto o Laitoriani, anaa enaiputa nkariak enaiposha.

English: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keitashe entonai e Yese anaa enkitoduaaroto too loreren; keaku ninye eing'oru loreren, ore emanyisho enye neaku ewueji e nkitoo.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina naa keitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye aigil eni are, pee errinyu ilo pisiai apa otelekua loo ltung'ana lenyena, aitung'uaa Asiria, o Misiri, o Patros, o Etiopia, o Elam, o Shina, o Hamat, neitung'uaa sii olomanaa le naiposha.

English: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
Masaai: Naa kedumaki ninye nkuapi olmonekie pee eiturrurru lelo apa ooidapashari le Israel, neiturrur lelo ooidapashari le Yuda meetu aaing'uaa ilubot pokira oong'uan e nkop.

English: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
Masaai: Keiwuang ilo lom le Efraim, ore lelo ooiture Yuda neiwuang'ieki; meigil Efraim aatayie olom Yuda, nemeigil Yuda aiture Efraim.

English: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
Masaai: Naa keor ninche ebaiki oloililai loo filisti te nkalo o loo ntoluo, neibung'a ninche te nebo aaidaikie iltung'ana lo loosaen. Nepik ninche nkaik enye enkop e Edom o Moab, ore ile Amon neiruk ninche.

English: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
Masaai: Naa keishie Olaitoriani katukul olkina le naiposha e Misiri; naa keyuk ninye enkaina enye te shumata olkeju, te ilo kutati lenye opejisho, naa keosh ninye aitaa inong'ot naapishana pee eim iltung'ana anaa enkop natoyio.

English: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Naa keaku keetae enkoitoi kitok naing'uaa Asiria, te nkaraki ilo pisiai otelekuaki loo ltung'ana lenyena, ina kata apa pee epuonu ninche eing'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
Masaai: Eilo kenya iyie ajo te ina olong: “Kaaisho nanu iyie enashe, Olaitoriani, amu ore hoo nikitagorokine iyie nanu, neibelekenye engoro ino, nikintagolo iyie nanu.

English: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, Olaitoriani ninye enjeunoto ai; kaisilig nanu ninye, nemaureishoyu; amu Olaitoriani Enkai ninye engolon ai o sinkolio lai, netaa ninye enjeunoto ai.”

English: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
Masaai: Ore te ng'ida nilo iyie aoku enkare naig'uaa lelo shorroi le njeunoto.

English: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
Masaai: Nilo iyie ajo te ina olong: “Enchoo Olaitoriani enashe, empoto enkarna enye, embalunye nkiaasin enyena too loreren, embalunye nchere eikitok enkarna enye.

English: Sing unto the LORD; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
Masaai: “Entaranyaki Olaitoriani te nkisisa, amu etaasa ninye ine nkitoo; nchoo eyiolouni kuna ti atua enkop pooki.

English: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
Masaai: Entabuaku entarany te ng'ida, intae iloomanya Sion, amu eikitok ilo otii atua intae, Ilo Osinya le Israel.”

English: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Babilon apa otabolokoki Isaya olayioni le Amos.

English: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
Masaai: Ore te nchumata e ndoinyo naisiaja tudumu olmonekie tabuaku nchiraki ninche; iyuku ninche te nkaina metijing'u nena shomito oo lkituaak.

English: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
Masaai: Aitanapa nanu makewan lelo gelunot laainei, aipotuo nanu lelo tung'ana laainei magil, pee eitalaku engoro ai, te lelo latagorokine.

English: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
Masaai: Toning'o, embuakunoto too ldoinyo eba anaa eno lorora kitok! Toning'o, embuakunoto oo nkitoriat, e lelo oshon oosoto te nebo! Olaitoriani loo lororani oitobirita olarrabal.
