English: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
Masaai: Kepuonu ninche eing'uaa enkop nalakua, eing'uaa enkiting'oto e keper, nelotu Olaitoriani eeta iruparen enyena pee eidaikie enkop pooki.

English: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
Masaai: Enteyietu enchira amu etataana enkolong o Laitoriani; pee elotu ina kidaata naing'uaa olmagilani!

English: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man's heart shall melt:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kelepori nkaik pooki, neiropijaa empijan e pooki tung'ani.

English: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
Masaai: Naa keiputukuny ninche. Nejing ninche emion naikununo anaa ene nkitok nasaisai. Neing'ura ninche maate to lkirutoto; neiput enkurruna nkomomi enye.

English: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelotu enkolong o Laitoriani, ina olong torrono engoro, o empijan e mpushuna, pee eitaa enkop olmuaate neidaikie lelo aing'okok lenyena aishie.

English: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
Masaai: Amu ore ilakir le keper, nemeitoki aaishoru ewang'an enye; nemisimisu enkolong eilepu nemeitoki olapa aitawang'isho te wang'an enye.

English: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
Masaai: Kaitame nanu enkop te nkaraki eng'oki enye, naitame lelo arruok te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye; kaiting'ie nanu ilo wuasa le lelo ooitokoos, naitadou nanu olwuasa le lelo ooing'ola.

English: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu iltung'ana iloodoorieki anaa sahabu nasila netiu iltung'ana anaa sahabu e Ofir.

English: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kaikirikirie nanu keper, neigusugusieki enkop te ine wueji enye, te ina goro o Laitoriani loo lororani te ina olong e ngoro enye napi.

English: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
Masaai: Ore anaa entarakuet narreshitoi, aashu anaa nkerra nemeetae oltung'ani oiturrur, keibelekenyakino ake oltung'ani olorere lenye, neisik ake oltung'ani alo enkop enye.

English: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
Masaai: Ore oloba anaa oloinepuni neari metua; ore oloba anaa oloibung'i nebatata to lalem.

English: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
Masaai: Ore nkera enye kutiti naa kedung'udung'i te dukuya nkonyek enye, keibung'i nkajijik enye, ore nkituaak enye neikonyi.

English: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaputu nanu lelo le Amedi metarasaki ninche, lelo lemeshilaa enkosholai; nemeshipakino sahabu.

English: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
Masaai: Nkai enye naar ilbarnot metuata; nemeing'urrie ninche ina natii enkoshoke e ng'otonye; ore nkonyek enye nemeeta olng'ur too nkera kutiti.

English: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
Masaai: Ore Babilon, ina kitoo oo nkitoriat, ina kishiaa nawuasare Ilkaldayo, nelo atiu anaa Sodom o Gomora ina kata te nenang'aa Enkai ninche.

English: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
Masaai: Meigili ae kata aamany ninye aashu aatoni ti atua ninye too ishoritin pooki; meetae Olmarabui oigil aun olng'obor lenye te ine; nemeetae ilairritak loo ntare ooigil aairragie nkerrai enye te ine.

English: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
Masaai: Kake ing'uesi e ntim naapuo aairrag te ine, ore inkajijik enye neiput nkeenta enkop; nemany isidan ine, neitigiran ntarakueti te ine.

English: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
Masaai: Nekueni ilng'ojiniaa too ltaleta lenyena, nebuaku mbariak too nkajijik sidain e nkitoo; etataana ina kata enye, nemeimutieki nena olong'i enyena.

English: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
Masaai: Keing'urrie Olaitoriani Yakobo naa keitoki ninye agelu Israel, nepik ninche atua enkop enye. Naa kepuonu iltung'ana loo loreren aashulare ninche neidikidikore enkaji e Yakobo.

English: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
Masaai: Naa kepuonu iltung'ana aaya ninche neriku ninche ewueji enye. Ore ina aji e Israel neng'amaa ninche te nkaina o Laitoriani aa rrindiki lewa o ng'oruo. Neya ninche aaraya lelo apa ootaaraitie ninche, neitore ninche lelo apa ooibooki ninche enkop.

English: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina kata nikilo Olaitoriani aisho enkiyagata te ina mion o to sina lino, o te ina kisiaayiare nikitipikaki isiaaisho,

English: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
Masaai: teyietai olaiguanani le Babilon. Tejo: “Eng'ura eiting'ieki ilo apa aitorogonyani, eng'ura eiting'ieki enkisikong'are!

English: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
Masaai: Etigila Olaitoriani eng'udi eilo torrono, ina ng'udi e nkitoo oo looitoreisho,

English: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
Masaai: ilo apa otoosho iltung'ana te ngoro te nena oshot nemeish, ilo apa oitoria iloshon te ngoro o to losilisili metii olng'ur.

English: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
Masaai: Eitirring'e enkop pooki neyagaa; neranyisho ninche.

English: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
Masaai: Kiting'idakinote iyie ilkeek laaijo iltarakua ore lelo tarakua le Lebanon, nejo, ‘Ore ebaiki ina kata apa nikirragieki aaitadou, meetae oladung'oni loo lkeek olotu adung.’

English: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
Masaai: Etudumunye enemeneng'a to lodo le nkop pee kinang'are te nilotu, etudumua ninye iloipi pee kiroroki iyie, ee, lelo pooki oora ilarikok le nkop; etudumunye too lorikan lenye le nkitoo le lelo apa oora ilaiguanak loo loshon.

English: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
Masaai: Eikirorie ninche pooki iyie aajoki, ‘Itashala sii iyie anaa iyiook! Itanyaanyukie sii iyie iyiook!’

English: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
Masaai: Eitadoyioki enkishiaa ino aaya enemeneng'a, ina orui oo nkinantani inono; eisalaashaki aatadoyio abori iyie, ore ilkuru nikimulumul iyie.

English: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
Masaai: “Kaji iyie inkuna pee itusulunye te keper iyie lo Akira le Nkakenya, enkerai Enkakenya! Ng'ura ajo kitudung'oki aapudaki enkop, iyie olapa oitadowuo iloreren kop!

English: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
Masaai: Itejo apa iyie to ltau lino, ‘Kailep alo keper; te idia alo ilakir le Nkai kapik olorika lai le nkitoo shumata oleng; katon nanu to ldoinyo le umata te nelakua te nkalo e moikuape;

English: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
Masaai: kailep nanu alo te idia alo nkatampo, kaitotiu nanu kewan anaa Ilo Otii Shumata aisul.’

English: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
Masaai: Kake kintadouoki aayau enemeneng'a, nenen neegut e nemenenga eululu.

English: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
Masaai: Ore lelo likidol iyie nikishumaki nkonyek, nikiimaki iyie, ejo: ‘Kele tung'ani apa oikirikirie enkop, neigusugusie nkitoriat,

English: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
Masaai: oitaa enkop olpurkel neibelekeny nkanas enyena, neitu eisho lelo ooena meshomo ang?’

English: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
Masaai: Ore lelo aiguanak pooki loo loreren neirrag te nkitoo, olaiguanani ake ti atua enkurare enye.

English: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
Masaai: Kake kitanang'ayioki iyie aaiturraa, aaitalam enkurare ino, anaa enkaitubului nemeyieuni, neitemori too mpopoki e lelo ootuata, te lelo ootaaraki to lalem, lelo oosulakino isoito le ululu, anaa empopok naitunyi too nkejek.

English: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
Masaai: Mikinukari iyie aaitaboitaki ninche enkaraki nindaikie enkop ino, itara iyie iltung'ana linono metuata. “Ore eishoi e lelo aasak loo ntorrok, nchoo eaku meigili ai kata aaipot!

English: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
Masaai: Entobira esesekuanata oo layiok lenyena te nkaraki entorroni oo loo menye, pee mebul ake neibung enkop, neiput oriong enkop nkanas.”

English: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Kadumunye nanu aitayunye ninche olarrabal,” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, “naa kaiwuang'ie nanu te Babilon enkarna o lpisiai, olmarei, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu ina kop emanyisho oo lkirrumun, naitaa ilturot le nkare, naa kaor nanu te oret e nkidaata, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.”

English: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai: “Ore anaa enaitobira nanu, neijia elo atiu, naa ore anaa enatudung'o, neijia etiu keunoyu,

English: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
Masaai: nchere kalo nanu agil ilo le Asiria ti atua enkop ai, ore te shumata lelo doinyo laainei naitunyoki nanu ninye enkop too nkejek; ore ina shata enye oo murto neiwuang'a te ninche, o ilo ola lenye otii oloililai.”

English: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
Masaai: Ena ninye ina yieunoto natuutuaki eipirta enkop pooki; naa ena ninye ina aina naitorioyioki te shumata iloshon pooki.

English: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
Masaai: Amu etuutua Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa aing'ae oiwuang'ie ina? Eitorioyioki enkaina enye, naa aing'ae oshuk?

English: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
Masaai: Ore apa te ilo ari otanang'a olaiguanani Ahas, nelotu ele kilikuai ojo,

English: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent's root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
Masaai: “Ming'ida iyie Filistia, o intae pooki, eji nchere, etigile ina ng'udi apa natoosho intae; amu te eishoi o lasurai epuku olasurai torrono aisul, ore olng'anayioi lenye naa olasurai olo tiaai.

English: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
Masaai: Ore ilo kikau lo laisinani nedaa, ore ilo oata osina neirrag te seriani; kake kamut nanu entonai eishoi ino to lameyu, ore ilo pisiai lino naar nanu to lalem.

English: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
Masaai: Teyietu, na kishomi; nchira, na anasa; talepori to lkirutoto, iyie Filistia, intae pooki! Amu kelotu empuruo eimu moikuape, nemeetae oloisiadu to ltim lenye.”

English: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
Masaai: Kainyoo ewaliki oltung'ani olkilikuai loo loshon? “Olaitoriani oitobirua Sion, naa ore ti atua ninye netum lelo tung'ana lenyena apa ooisilisiloki esarunoto.”

English: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Moab. Enkaraki naitomijoonoki enkanasa e Aar te ina kewarie apa naishieki Moab; o enkaraki naitomijoonoki enkanasa e Kir, te ina kewarie apa, naishieki Moab.

English: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
Masaai: Eshomo ina tito e Dibon iwuejitin neeika aishir; aishiraki Nebo neishiraki Medeba, eishirita Moab. Etabarnoki lukuny enye o lmunyo lenye,

English: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
Masaai: ore too nkoitoi neishopo ilkuniyiani; ore too nchumat oo nkajijik o too nkisiajat eishirita pooki ng'ae netashala too lkiyio.

English: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
Masaai: Eishirita Heshbon o Eleale, etoning'e oltoilo le nkishirata enye te Yahas; ore enkaraki ina keishir lelo lewa le Moab oata ruparen aabuaku; Eikirikire oltau lenye.

English: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
Masaai: Eishirita oltau lai te nkaraki Moab; ekuetikitia lelo aisikak lenyena Soar, eshomo Eglat-shelishia. Amu ore eilepaki Luhit, nepuo ninche eishir, ore eimita ina oitoi nalo Horonaim neyietu enkishirata e nkidaaroto;

English: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
Masaai: etoito nchorroi e Nimrim; netoito nkujit nemeetae inaabulu, meekure eetae nkaitubulu.

English: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ore nena tokitin kumok apa naanoto ninche, o nena apa naatushuma ninche, keyae ninche aaitalang nchorroi o seyiai.

English: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
Masaai: Amu eshomo olkiyioi, aibulu enkop e Moab; etabaikia enkishirata Eglaim, etabaikia enkishirata Beerelim.

English: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
Masaai: Amu eiputa nkariak e Dibon osarge, ore ake eyia, kaitoki nanu ayau shumata Dibon aitulusoo, kesuj olng'atuny lelo ooisik le Moab, o ilo pisiai oleku le ina kop.

English: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
Masaai: Eirriwakitia ninche ilkuoo le kerra ilo oitore enkop, eing'uaa Sela eimunye ina oitoi o lpurkel, aayau ilo doinyo le ntito e Sion.

English: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
Masaai: Etotiutuo nena toyie e Moab anaa ntaritik naaidapashari tiaai, anaa nkajijik oo motonyi naaidapasha too mpoorri o lkeju le Arnon.

English: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
Masaai: “Nchoru eutaroto, tudung'o enkiguana te sipata; ntotiwuo oloip lino anaa enkewarie te nkata e nkipirata e nkolong; isudoi lelo oo tarayioki aaipang'ie, mincho meibung'i lelo aisikak.

English: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo le Moab ootaarayioki aaisikie metamanyisho te nebo iyie, taa enkisudoroto te ninche te lelo ooidaikie ninche. Te neishieki kenya ilo aitorogonyani neish enkidaata, ore te neiwuang'ieki ilo oibooki ninche enkop te ina kop,

English: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
Masaai: netumi taa aaitotona olorika le nkitoo te nyorrata nauno, ore te shumata e ilo orika neton ninye te sipata ti atua ilo ng'obor le Daudi, ilo obo oiguana te sipata amu keneneng ninye pee eas esipata.”

English: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
Masaai: Kitoning'oitie iyiook ilo wuasa le Moab, enetiu apa olwuasa lenye; ore enkilashilash enye, o lwuasa lenye o ina goro enye - ore enkitokoos enye naa elejare.

English: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nchoo Moab eyietu aishir, nchoo pooki ng'ae eyietu aishiraki Moab. Enchira to sina kitok te nkaraki nena mukateni oo sabibu e Kir-Hareseti.

English: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
Masaai: Amu etoito nena ong'at e Heshbon, o lelo sabibu le Sibma; ore lelo kituaak loo loshon netudung'o ilng'osil lenyena, lelo apa oopuo aabaiki Yaser, neidapashaki olpurkel; ore lelo ngosil lenyenanepuo aaidapashari nelang enaiposha.

English: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, kaishir nanu te nkishirata e Yaser te nkaraki ilo sabibu le Sibma; kaaitashaiki nanu ilkiyio laainei, iyie Heshbon o Eleale; amu ore shumata ilng'anayio linono o enkisampuare ino netadoikio embuaakinoto o larrabal.

English: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
Masaai: Neiwuang'ieki eng'ida o enchipai te ina kop sidai; ore te nkurma oo sabibu nemetii osinkolio oranyi, meetae mbuakunot naabuakuni; meetae olaironyani oirony isabibu te nkironyet; eitigiraki inabuakunoto e nkisampuare.

English: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keishir oltau lai anaa olwulul loo usin aishiraki Moab, neishiraki oltau lai Kir-heres.

English: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
Masaai: Naa te nelotu Moab aibalunye kewan, naa te neitanaur kewan too wuejitin neeika, te nelotu ninye atua ine wueji enye sinyati pee eomon, meret ninye ina.

English: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
Masaai: Ororei ele oing'uaa Olaitoriani oipirta Moab too nkolong'i naatulusoitie.

English: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
Masaai: Kake ore taata ejo Olaitoriani, “Too larin okuni, anaa larin le nkigeroto o ltung'ani, keitaae ina kitoo e Moab pesho, hoo duoo naa olorora kitok ninche. Ore lelo ooleku naa lkuti oleng leme toki.”

English: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Dameski. Ng'ura, meitoki Dameski aaku enkanasa, naa keaku ninye osototi loo suut.

English: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
Masaai: Kepuoi aaing'uaa nkanas enyena o akenya; neaku ninche ndaat oo nkerrai, neirragie ninche ine nemeetae entoki naiture.

English: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Keiwuang'a ina ang nagol aitung'uaa Efraim, neiwuang'a enkitoo aitung'uaa Dameski; ore ilo pisiai oleku le Siria netiu anaa enkitoo oo nkera e Israel, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong neitadouni enkitoo e Yakobo aaitabaiki enkop, ore ina piron o sesen lenye nesasu.

English: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
Masaai: Naa ketiu ninye anaa te neisampisho olaisampuani, negilu ilng'osil le nkurma, netiu anaa ina kurma naitashe te nesuli ilng'osil lenyena netiu anaa oerata le Refaim.

English: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.
Masaai: Ina natung'uayie olaisampuani ake naleku, anaa te neisampu olaisampuani ilng'anayio neing'uaa oare anaa okuni ootii shumata oleng, aashu oong'uan anaa imiet too lng'osil lo lchani loo lng'anayio, Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel ojo.

English: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong neaku keshilaa iltung'ana Ilo oitobira ninche, ore too nkonyek enye neing'or Ilo Sinyati le Israel;

English: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
Masaai: meitoki ninche aaisilig ilperereni loo lasarri, ina siai oo nkaik lenye, nemeitoki ninche aaing'or ina naitobira ilkimojik lenye, aa Asherim aashu ilperereni le nkorropil.

English: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong nena anas enye naagol, nepuo aatiu anaa nene wuejitin neeisikieki oo le Hafi o le Amori, nenen apa neeisikie ninche te nkaraki nkera oo Siraeli. Nepuo aaku ilmuaateni.

English: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
Masaai: Enkaraki nikitorikine iyie Enkai e njeunoto ino, neitu iyie idamu ina dapidapoi e sarunoto ino; enkaraki ina pee ituno iyie nkaitubulu sidain, nipik iyie ntokitin oo nkaitin omon,

English: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
Masaai: ore hoo nintubulu iyie ninche ina olong ake nituuno ninche, nincho ninche meitapuka pee ekenyu ake, ore ake eyia, kelo aimin enkisampuare, te ina olong o sina o ina mion nemeishiuni.

English: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
Masaai: Kuaak, ening'o oltoilo loo ltung'ana kumok, eikurrukur ninche anaa enkikurrukur e naiposha! kuak, enkikurrukur oo loreren kumok eikurrukur ninche anaa e nkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok!

English: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
Masaai: Keikurrukur iloshon anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok, kake kelo ninye aisikong ninche, neilanyisho ninche aaisik, nepuo ninche anaa suut too ldoinyio netiu anaa enterit nakutita olkutati.

English: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
Masaai: Ore teipa, ng'ura, nelotu olkirutoto! Ore eitu eaku tadekenya meekure eetae ninche! Ena ninye erubata e lelo ooibung iyiook aaraya, elaakinoto e lelo ooisim iyiook.

English: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
Masaai: Kuaak, enkop oo naipuko naaikurrukur natii lido kekun ilkejek le Etiopia;

English: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
Masaai: ina nairriwaa ilbalusuni lenyena aimie olkeju le Nail, too mpeuti naaitobiraki te narau oo nkujit naapor nkariak! Enchom intae, intae olkilikuai oneneng ina kop e lelo adoru oosipa seseni, enetii ilo orere ourei te netaana o te nelakua, ilo osho magilani otimirishe, odung ilkejek enkop enye.

English: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
Masaai: Ore intae kulo ootii enkop pooki, intae lelo oomanya enkop, te nedumuni olmonekie too ldoinyo, eng'ura! Te neoshi emowuo, entoning!

English: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
Masaai: Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani: “Kaitirring'a nanu aing'orisho te manyisho ai, aing'or asipu anaa te ndama eirowuaja, anaa enkatampoi e nkoiliolio te nkata e nkisampuare eirowuaju.”

English: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruninghooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
Masaai: Amu ore eng'or enkisampuare, eidipa enkurma aitapuka, neibelekenya ntapuka aaku ilng'anayio, nedung'oo ninye lelo ng'osil to lalem odung'ishoreki, ore lelo ng'osil oo luaari nedung'oo.

English: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
Masaai: Neing'uari ninche pooki, meinosa nena taritik e ong'ata naatoni too ldoinyo, neing'ueikini ing'uesi e ntim. Neked ilmotonyi shumata ninche te nkata e nkirowuaj, netonie ing'uesi e ntim ninche te nkata e nkirobi.

English: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina kata neyauni nkishorot aaisho Olaitoriani loo lororani, naaing'uaa lelo tung'ana adoru nesipa seseni, lelo tung'ana oourei te netaana o te nelakua, ilo osho magilani omirisho, odung ilkejek enkop enye, o metabaiki oldoinyo le Sion, ine wueji e nkarna o Laitoriani loo lororani.

English: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Misiri. Ng'ura, ekedito Olaitoriani enkatampoi nakuet, naa Misiri elotu; naa keikirikira nena kitanyaanyukot e Misiri oo nkaitin te dukuya ninye, nelepori iltauja loo ltung'ana le Misiri ti atua ninche.

English: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
Masaai: Naa kaputu nanu ile Misiri metudumakinoto maate, nearare ninche oltung'ani ake o lalashe lenye, nearare oltung'ani olayioni le latia enye, nearare enkanasa enkanasa, nearare enkitoo enkitoo;

English: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
Masaai: ore olokiyo loo le Misiri ti atua ninche, neishieki katukul, nainyal nanu nkitobirat enye; naa kepuo ninche aaikilikuanishore nena kitanyaanyukot oolaitumusumusok, o loosh nkidong'i o lasakutok;

English: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: naa kaishooyo nanu ile Misiri apik nkaik o laitasheikinoni ogogong, naa olaiguanani otolo olo aitore ninche, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
Masaai: Ore nkariak e ilo keju le Nail neitoi, ore ilo keju netoyu;

English: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
Masaai: ore nena nong'ot neing'usilu, ore ilkejek ooibung'are ilo keju le Nail le Misiri nemitari aatoyu, ore oseyiai o lkujita netoyu.

English: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
Masaai: Keaku iorro mbat o lkeju le Nail, ore nena tokitin apa naatuunoki te mbata olkeju netoyu, nekutaa osiwuo.

English: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
Masaai: Ore lelo arreshok loo sinkir neishir te mion o sina, lelo pooki oonang'aki irresheta lenye olkeju le Nail, neyietu ninche aaishir, lelo pooki ooisalaashaki irresheta lenye shumata enkare.

English: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
Masaai: Ore lelo aitobirak loo nkilani naapuyiapui nepalari, o lelo ooitobir nkilani naaibor.

English: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
Masaai: Ore lelo laa ninche ing'apeta enkop nerratanyi, ore lelo oas esiaai ooropiyiani netum osina.

English: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak le Soan naa ilmoda; ore lelo ang'eni aikook le Farao neishooyo enkikoo e modai. Kaji iyie inko pee ijoki Farao, “Ara nanu olayioni lo lang'eni, olayioni lo laiguanani li apa moiti?”

English: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
Masaai: Koree naa lelo ang'eni linono? Nchoo ninche mikitoliki neisho metayiolouni, ina naiguanua Olaitoriani loo lororani pee egilunore Misiri.

English: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak le Soan netaa lmoda, ore lelo kituaak le Memfis neteleja ate; ore lelo apa laa ninche eitasheyie iloshon lenye, neitapong'oitie Misiri.

English: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
Masaai: Eishoo Olaitoriani ninche olmilo; neisho Ilmisiri meyukuyukori too nkiaasin enyena pooki, anaa enayukuyukori olamerani elopisho.

English: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
Masaai: Nemeitoki ae bae nabo atii Misiri aa endukuya aashu olkidong'oe, olng'osila lo ltukai aashu oseyiai nadimi aataas.

English: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, naa ketiu ile Misiri anaa ng'oroyiok, neikirikira te dukuya ina aina naikirikirie Olaitoriani loo lororani ninche.

English: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
Masaai: Ore ina kop e Yuda naa keaku entoki naiture ile Misiri; ore pooki tung'ani oba anaa ololikini neureishoyu, enkaraki ina naiguanua Olaitoriani pee egilunore ninche.

English: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku keetae nkanas imiet ti atua enkop e Misiri, naairo enkutuk e Kanaan. Neinos olmumai pee eiruk Olaitoriani loo lororani. Ore nabo e kuna naa kepuoi aajo Enkanasa e Nkolong.

English: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku keetae olperere lo lasar lo Laitoriani te mpolos e nkop e Misiri, o eng'ape o Laitoriani to lpolosie lenye.

English: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
Masaai: Naa keaku ina olmonekie o enchakenisho o Laitoriani loo lororani ti atua enkop e Misiri; ina kata te neishiraki ninche Olaitoriani te nkaraki lelo ooibooki ninche enkop, neirriwaki Olaitoriani ninche olaitajeunoni. Nemitu, nekordu ninye ninche.

English: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD, and perform it.
Masaai: Neisho Olaitoriani metayiolouni ninye too le Misiri. Neyiolou lelo le Misiri Olaitoriani te ina olong, neserem ninye to lasar o too nkishorot o lasar opejori. Neinos ninche olmumai te nkaraki Olaitoriani, neitabaya.

English: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
Masaai: Naa kelo Olaitoriani aosh Misiri, neosh neitoki ashukunye, naa kerrinyokino ninche Olaitoriani, nening ninye esayiata enye neishiunye ninche.

English: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku keetae enkoitoi kitok nadumunye te Misiri alo Asiria. Nepuonunye ile Misiri Asiria, nepuo ile Misiri aaseremisho te nebo ile Asiria.

English: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa keaku Israel ene uni te nebo Misiri o Asiria, neaku ninche emayianata te mpolos e nkop.

English: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
Masaai: Naa ninche emayian Olaitoriani loo lororani ejo, “Emayiana Misiri, olorere lai o Asiria ina siaai oo nkaik aainei, o Israel enjung'ore ai.”

English: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
Masaai: Ore apa te ilo ari oewunye ilo kitok le njore, oirriwua Sargon ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu Ashdod, neitainye olarrabal neya ninye

English: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
Masaai: ore te ina kata neirorie Olaitoriani Isaya olayioni le Amos, ejo, “Shomo, talaku ilo kuniyia lirrotianita te mpolos nidotu inamuka too nkejek inono,” netaasa apa ninye ina alo meishopo nemeeta namuka.

English: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ore anaa enashomo osinka lai Isaya meishopo nemeeta namuka too larin okuni anaa olmonekie le ngolon ogilunore Misiri, o Etiopia,

English: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
Masaai: nejia naa elo atiu olaiguanani le Asiria erikoo lelo le Misiri ootarayioki o le Etiopia epuo eyararoto. Ore ndung'ot pokira ilooti o lkituaak nepuo meishopo nemeeta namuka. Nemeeta toki too ltuli neaku enkurruna e Misiri.

English: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
Masaai: Naa keitukurruni ninche te nkaraki Etiopia naisiligie osiligi lenye Misiri natawuasare.

English: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha nepuo kenya aajo te ina olong, ‘Ng'ura, ena nataase te kuldo laa ninche apa kisiliga, naa ninche kisikakitia aaing'oru, eretoto pee ekordu iyiook aitung'uaa ilo aiguanani le Asiria! Naa amaa, iyiook, kaji kinko pee kiimisho?’ ”

English: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Babilon. Ore anaa enadumunye olkutati te Negeb neor enkop, olpurkel eing'uaa, ina kop torrono oleng.

English: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
Masaai: Aatolikioki nanu te nduaata entoki torrono; keisimisho olaisimani, neinyalisho o lainyalani. Ilepa shomo, iyie Elam, irraga kitang'aduaki, iyie Media; ore lelo sinaitin pooki ooyaua ninye kaishie nanu.

English: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina aaiputa nanu olkirutoto; aaibung'a nanu emion naikununo anaa enenkitok nasaisai; atashala nanu o metaa meekure aning'isho, airuto nanu o metaa meekure adolisho.

English: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
Masaai: Aaisurito endukuya, aaiputa nanu olkirutoto, ore enteipa duoo naanyita neibelekenye aaku enkiputukuny.

English: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
Masaai: Eitobira ninche emesa, eisalaasha ninche ilkarash oopiki oltiren, nedaa ninche neokisho. Entudumunye intae, lo kituaak, eelie long'oi eilata!

English: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
Masaai: Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani: “Shomo ngero olarriponi, nchoo ninye elimu aibalunye ina nadol.

English: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
Masaai: Te nedol ninye ilakedok, lelo akedok loo mbartan epuo maare, o lakedok loo sirkon, o lakedok loo ntamesin, nchoo ninye einining'isho asipu, nchoo esipu oleng.”

English: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
Masaai: Ore ilo otoduaa neyietu ajo: “Te nchumata oltalet orripishoreki nanu aitashe, anaake te ndama iyie o Laitoriani. Ore te siaai ai natii nanu nkewaritin pooki.

English: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nadol epuonu ilakedok, nadol ilakedok loo mbartan epuonu maare!” Newal ninye ajo, “Etabatate, etabatate Babilon, ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin, netarrarrakinote enkop.”

English: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
Masaai: Lo tung'ana laainei, kulo ooidong'oki neipiripiri, ore ina natoning'o nanu to Laitoriani loo lororani, ina Ai e Israel, atolikio nanu intae.

English: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oipirta Edom. Etii obo oipotisho te Seir, nejo, “Lo arriponi, kejaa enkewarie? Lo arriponi, kejaa enkewarie?”

English: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.
Masaai: Nejo ilo arriponi: “Kelotu enkakenya nelotu sii enkewarie. Te naa e ilo aikilikuanisho, nkilikuanisho; nyaaki torrinyunye.”

English: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta Arabia. Too sanagi le Arabia intae ipuopuo aairrag, na tamesin oo le Dedan.

English: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
Masaai: Eyaki enkare ilo oata enkure, entanang'are lelo aisikak endaa, intae kulo oomanya enkop e Tema.

English: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
Masaai: Amu eisika ninche aaing'uaa ilalema, aailany ina shutati o lalem, neilany ina awuo nakurruno, neilany ilo arrabal otirrisha.

English: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
Masaai: Amu inji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani, “Ore te rishata olari obo, te risioroto oo larin le nkigeroto, ore ina kitoo pooki e Kedar naa keiting;

English: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it.
Masaai: ore lelo ooleku, le lelo tung'ana magil oongoroo mbaa Kedar naa keaku kuti; amu Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, nairoro.”

English: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta oerata le nduaata. Kainyoo ena, eji ishomo intae shumata, ishomo pooki nchumat oo nkajijik,

English: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
Masaai: iyie enabore enkilepilep, na anasa ena nailugo, na ang ena nabore eng'ida? Ore lelo tung'ana linono ootaraki neme to lalem, neme to larrabal etuata.

English: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
Masaai: Eisika ilaitoriak linono pooki te nebo, eibung'aki eitu ninye engoroo embae. Ore intae pooki ooinepuaki neibung'aki, hoo neisika ninche aapuo enelakua.

English: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina atejo nanu: “Mbelekenyayu miking'or nanu, nchooki nanu maishira olkiyioi le mion; mintanaur kewan kintigir nanu, te nkaraki enkidaata e ina tito o lorere lang.”

English: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani neeta enkata e nkiputukuny o enkitunyoto o enkinyalata ti atua ilo erata le nduaata, nena naauroo isunta e nkanasa, nebaiki embuaakinoto ldoinyo.

English: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
Masaai: Ore Elam nenap imootiani ekedito ngarrin oo mbartan, ore Kir nebolu long'oi.

English: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
Masaai: Ore lelo erat linono sidain neiput ngarrin oo mbartan, ore lakedok loo mbartan netumoki nkitashot too nchomito.

English: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie ninye elong'o e Yuda. Ore apa te ina olong ning'oru iyie iruparen te nkaji e ntim.

English: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
Masaai: Nidol ajo eikumok ilusien e nkanasa e Daudi, nioku enkare too lchorroi li abori,

English: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
Masaai: ninken nkajijik e Yerusalem, nigil nkajijik pee ishet esuntai aitagol.

English: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
Masaai: Nintobir olchumati le nkare te rishata e nena sunta pokira are. Kake eitu ing'or ilo apa oitobira ilo shorro, neitu ishilaa ilo oipirua kuna pooki apa moitie, laa ninye oishoo metaa.

English: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong neipotu Olaitoriani loo lororani olkiyioi o enkishirata, nebarni iltung'ana te nkaraki osina neishop ilkuniyiani;

English: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
Masaai: naa ng'ura, eng'ida o enchipai, o eyieng'ata oo lmong'i o lkerra, enkinosata oo nkiri o eokoto e naisho oo sabibu. Ijojo: “Matadaata iyiook nikiokisho, amu ore taisere nikiye.”

English: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
Masaai: Eibalunye Olaitoriani loo lororani kewan too nkiyiaa aainei: “Esipa ore ena kitarruorroto mikipalakini iyie, o metaba anaa niye.” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, “Wou, shomo enetii ele aitasheikinoni, shomo enetii Shebna laa ninye oitasheiki enkaji, nijoki ninye:

English: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
Masaai: Kainyoo iasita tene naa kaing'ae iata iyie tene, eji o itaguetaka iyie kewan enkurare. Ee, iyie, ilo oturu enkurare te wueji e Shumata, niguetu enimany te ndapidapoi?

English: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eikinang'aa iyie Olaitoriani aiturraa, lo tung'ani ele ogol. Eikimbung ninye akurraki,

English: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord's house.
Masaai: nikiyuk ninye aitamanaa anaa empira anang'aki enelakua; nilo aye te ine. Naa ine epuo aatii nena garrin inono oo mbartan, iyie ilo ora enkurruna e nkaji o lkitok lino.

English: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
Masaai: Kaanang'aa nanu iyie te ine niaasishore, nikintadouni te ilo orika le shumata.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa kaipotu nanu osinka lai Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia,

English: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
Masaai: naishopoki nanu ninye olkila lino, narreten nanu ninye te nkimeita ino, ore enkitoria ino naitarasaki nanu ninye. Naa keaku ninye papa te lelo oomanya Yerusalem o te nkaji e Yuda.

English: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
Masaai: naiteleiki nanu oloililai lenye olbolet le nkaji e Daudi; nebol ninye nemeetae oloiken. Neiken nemeetae olobol.

English: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father's house.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie nanu ninye netiu anaa encheitoi nauno oleng, neaku ninye olorika le nkitoo te nkaji e papaai lenye.

English: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father's house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
Masaai: Neitanapi ninye olola le nkaji e papaai lenye pooki, eishoi pooki o nkera, ebaiki nkikompeni o metabaiki nkukurto e nkare.

English: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, ore ina sheitoi apa natuunoki oleng nelolong'u, nedotunye asulunye; ore ilo ola apa oikare nesulunye adou, amu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oipirta Turo. Enteyietu enchira, na melin e Tarshishi, amu eitomijoonoki Turo neaku metii enkaji aashu ewueji neitasheyieki! Ore ebaiki enkop e Kupro eibalakinyeki ninche.

English: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
Masaai: Entirring'ata intae kulo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha, lo ainyiang'ak le Sidon, etalang'a apa lelo lirriwaitie intae enkare nepuo ninche aaim nkariak kumok;

English: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
Masaai: ore ropiyiani inyi naa ina tapa e Shihor, ina kisampuare o lkeju le Nail; iyie apa olbiasharai loo loreren.

English: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
Masaai: Tukurru iyie Sidon, amu eiroro enaiposha, ine nerripieki enaiposha ejo, “Eitu nanu atum emion e saisai neitu aisho, neitu nanu aitubulu layiok aashu ntoyie.”

English: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
Masaai: Te nelotu ilo omoni Misiri, nejing ninche osina tenkaraki ilo omoni oipirta Turo.

English: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
Masaai: Entulusoi enchom Tarshishi, enteyietu enchira, intae lelo oomanya olomanaa le naiposha.

English: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
Masaai: Kena ninye enkanasa ino e ng'ida, naa ore enkiterunoto enye naa apa moitie, ore nkejek enyena netanapa ninye meshomo amanyisho te nkop nalakua?

English: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
Masaai: Kaing'ae oipirua ena, agilunore Turo, naa ninye naishooyo maupen e nkitoo. Ore apa lelo ainyiang'ak lenyena naa eikituaak, ore lelo amirak lenyena naa ilooyanyiti te nkop?

English: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
Masaai: Eipirua Olaitoriani loo lororani ina, pee einyal ilo wuasa ena kitoo pooki, nesul ilo pooki oyanyiti te nkop.

English: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
Masaai: Mputa ntadooi te nkop ino anaa olkeju le Nail, na tito e Tarshishi; meekure eetae entoki nikimbooyo.

English: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
Masaai: Eitorioyie ninye enkaina enye aitalang enaiposha, eigirigirie ninye nkitoriat; eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata naipirta Kanaan, pee eidaikie lelo sempewueti lenyena.

English: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
Masaai: Nejo ninye: “Mingil ae kata iyie ang'ida na tito ena natusulaki e Sidon; tudumunye shomo Kupro, ore ake sii te ine milo atum enkiyeng'iyeng.”

English: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, til the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
Masaai: Ng'ura ina kop oo Lkaldayo! Ilo orere apa, mme ile Asiria, oopuo aaishooyo Turo metaa enoo lowuarak le ntim. Neirrag ninche aang'adu ninye, nerasaki nena ajijik enyena e nkitoo, neing'uaa ina anasa etaa enkidaata.

English: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
Masaai: Teyietu nchira iyie Tarshishi, amu ore osempewuet lino neitomijoonoki.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, nemeitokini aadamu Turo too larin ntomoni naapishana, naaba anaa nkolong'i o laiguanani obo. Ore te siadi lelo arin ntomoni naapishana netiu te Turo anaa enatiu te ilosinkolio le mulayoi:

English: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
Masaai: “Tudumu enkawuo oo sinkoliotin, tamanimanai te nkanasa, na mulayoi ena nemedamuni! Taranyisho to ltoilo sidai, taranya isinkolioitin kumok, pee kitumi aatadamu.”

English: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilarin ntomoni naapishana naa emutan Olaitoriani Turo. Naa kerrinyokino ninye olekoisiaayio lenye, nelo aiborrie onyek te nena kitoriat e nkop naatii oriong e nkop.

English: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
Masaai: Ore ina biashara enye o lekoisiaayio lenye neiteng'elakini Olaitoriani; meshumi ninye nemeirragieki aaisudoo, kake ore ina biashara enye kelo ainyiang'u endaa sapuk o nkilani sidain ainyang'aki lelo ootoni te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelo Olaitoriani aitomijoon enkop neitaa mitil, naa kelo aibelekeny neidapash lelo oomanya.

English: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
Masaai: Naa ore ina nalo atiu too ltung'ana, naa neijia etiu to lapolosani; ore enatiu to rrindik, neijia etiu to lkitok lenye; ore enatiu te nkaisiaayiani, neijia etiu te ina naigero ninye; ore enatiu te ilo oinyang'isho, neijia etiu te ilo omirisho; ore enatiu te ilo oisilenisho neijia etiu te ilo oisilenokini; ore enatiu te ilo oishooyo esile, neijia etiu te ilo oisilenokini.

English: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.
Masaai: Keitomijooni enkop katukul neitarruorri oleng; amu eiroro Olaitoriani ele ororei.

English: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
Masaai: Eishirita enkop neisha, etemene enkop nalulung'a neisha, etemene shumata amitari te nebo enkop.

English: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
Masaai: Etaa enkop olminong, ti abori lelo oomanya; amu etigila ninche nkitanapat, negolong'aki nena kikoot, negil ilo ning'o loo ntarasi.

English: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keinos oldeket enkop, ore lelo oomanya kemeyu te nkaraki enkitarruorroto enye; ore naa kepejori lelo oomanya enkop, naa ilkuti ake elekuni.

English: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
Masaai: Eishirita enaisho oo sabibu, ore olchani loo osabibu netasara, ore lelo apa oong'ida nejing osina.

English: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
Masaai: Ore oltoilo le nkinanta netigire, ore ilo toilo le nchipai netigire, ore oltoilo lolwulul loo usin neitigiraki.

English: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata aaok enaisho oo sabibu eranyisho; keduaru ina aisho napi te lelo ook.

English: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
Masaai: Ore ina anasa naing'oling'ole neturori ninye, eikenoki pooki aji metaa meetae olojing.

English: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
Masaai: Etasapuka olkiyioi too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa eiting'o enaisho oo sabibu; neishieki eng'ida pooki; neishieki enchipai pooki e nkop.

English: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
Masaai: Eitomijoonoki enkanasa, etigilaki nchomito aainyal.

English: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
Masaai: Amu ena nalo aaku te mpolos e nkop, ti atua loshon, ore anaa enaigusugusieki oloirien, o anaa enasotuni ilng'anayio to sabibu.

English: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
Masaai: Neilepie ninche iltoiloishi lenye, neranyisho te ng'ida; ore te nkitoo o Laitoriani kebuaku ninche te nkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
Masaai: Ore naa te nkalo o loo saen nchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo; ore to lomanaa le naiposha nchoo Olaitoriani enkitoo, Enkai e Israel.

English: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
Masaai: Ore too neeiting'ie enkop nikining'oo isinkolioitin le nkisisa, le nkitoo te ilo Obo Osipa. Kake atejo nanu, “Aibiitiari nanu, aibiitiari nanu. Woi keon ai! Amu ore lelo aitang'orok netarasutua, etarasutua ilaitang'orok oleng.”

English: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
Masaai: Olkirutoto o engumoto, o rreshet shumata iyie, shumata iyie ilo omanya enkop!

English: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
Masaai: Ore ilo oilanyisho to ltoilo lo lkirutoto, naa kelo adoiki engumoto; naa ore ilo oilepu te ngumoto neibung orreshet. Amu etaboloki ilusien e shumata, ore olkitamanyunot le nkop neikirikira.

English: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
Masaai: Etigiligilaki enkop tukul, etabee neaku mbelibelat, eikirikirieki enkop oleng.

English: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
Masaai: Eyukuyukori enkop anaa olamerani, etotiuo anaa enkaji nakutita osiuo; etii nkitarruorot enyena shumata ninye, naa kenang'aa ninye nemeigil adumunye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa kelo Olaitoriani aitame olorora le shumata te keper, nelo aitame ilaiguanak le nkop teina kop.

English: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
Masaai: Neiturrurri ninche te nebo anaa ilooena te ngumoto; neikenori ninche te korokoroni, ore te siadi nkolong'i kumok neitamei ninche.

English: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
Masaai: Neitomisimisi olapa nemeitoki enkolong awang'u; amu Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aitoreisho to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem, naa ore te dukuya ilpayiani lenyena nelo ninye aibalunye enkitoo enye.

English: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ira iyie Enkai ai; kaarrep nanu iyie, kaisis nanu enkarna ino; amu itaasa iyie mbaa e nking'asia, ntabayie te sipata nena kitobirat inono e apa moitie.

English: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
Masaai: Amu intaa iyie ina anasa osototi le nkidaata ore ina anasa nagol nintaa olmuaate; ore apa ina aji e nkitoo oo ltung'ana leeikinga meigili ae kata aashet.

English: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eikisis iyie iloreren oogol; ore nkanas e lelo oshon lemeeta olng'ur naa eikiureyu iyie.

English: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
Masaai: Amu itaa iyie osempewuet le ilo aisinani, aitaa osempewuet le ilo onyamal te nyamali enye; olchurie to lkutati naa oloip te nkirowuaj, amu ore eoshoto e ilo lemeeta olng'ur neikununo anaa olkutati oipony esuntai

English: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
Masaai: eikununo anaa enkirowuaj te wueji netoyio Intigira iyie oltoilo loo lmang'ati lang; anaa enkirouaj ti abori oloip le nkatampoi, neaku eishieki osinkolio le ilo lemeeta olng'ur.

English: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
Masaai: Ore te le doinyo, kelo Olaitoriani loo lororani aitobiraki olorere pooki osirua loo ntokitin naapir, osirua le naisho oo sabibu, osirua loo ntokitin naabore eilata, o enaisho oo sabibu, osirua loo ntokitin naabore eilata, o enaisho oo sabibu nasila oleng.

English: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye aidaikie tele doinyo ina kimulumulet apa natanang'akaki shumata iloreren pooki, ilo karasha apa oidapashakaki shumata iloshon pooki.

English: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Neijoo ninye keeya ntarasi, nejutoo Olaitoriani Enkai ilkiyio too nkomomi pooki, ore ina sulare oo ltung'ana lenyena neiwuang'ie ninye te nkop pooki; amu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
Masaai: Kepuoi kenya aajo te ina olong, “Ng'ura, Enkai ang ena; kitaanyutua apa iyiook ninye, pee elotu aitajeu iyiook. Olaitoriani ele, kitaanyutua iyiook ninye, mating'idata iyiook nikishipakino enjeunoto enye.”

English: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
Masaai: Amu kemitu enkaina Olaitoriani oldoinyo le Sion, naa kepuoi aaitunyoki Moab enkop te wueji enye, anaa enaitunyi olkujita te wueji olokidong'oi.

English: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye aitorioo nkaik enyena te neitorit ninye, anaa enaitorioo nkaik o ltung'ani oisompira te nkare, kake kelo Olaitoriani airragie ilo wuasa lenye te nebo ina arriyiano oo nkaik enyena.

English: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
Masaai: Ore nena sunta adoru e nkang enye nesulu ninye, neitadou, nenang'aki enkop, neitabaiki enterit.

English: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong nepuoi aarany ele sinkolio te nkop e Yuda: “Kiata iyiook enkanasa nagol; eishoo ninye iyiook enjeunoto naikununo anaa sunta enkang nagol

English: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
Masaai: Entabol nchomito, pee etum ilo osho loo sipat oibung enkirukoto aimu.

English: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Masaai: Nchoo iyie meitiring'ayu te seriani, ilo laa iyie edamu enkaraki nikisiliga ninye iyie.

English: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
Masaai: Isiliga Olaitoriani ntarasi, amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai, naa endapidapoi oo ntarasi.

English: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
Masaai: Amu eitadouo ninye lelo ooilepie ate ina anasa naitokoos. Eitadouo ninye, etanang'aka ninye enkop, nenang'aki enterit.

English: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
Masaai: Eitunyito nkejek ninye, nkejek e lelo aisinak, iroruat e lelo oomena.”

English: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
Masaai: Keitoriori enkoitoi e ilo asipani; itooro iyie enkoitoi e ilo asipani.

English: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
Masaai: Ina oitoi oo nkiguanat inono, kiaanyunyie iyiook, iyie Olaitoriani; ina arna nikidamunye iyie, ninye eyieunoto oo ltauja lang.

English: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
Masaai: Iyie eng'uar oltau lai kewarie, ore enkishui ai ti atua nanu naa iyie elilitu. Ore enkata natii nkiguanat inono enkop, neiteng'enuo lelo oomanya enkop te sipata.

English: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
Masaai: Tenaa keitoduaaki ilo torrono olng'ur, meyiolou ae kata ninye esipata; ore ti atua enkop oo sipat, neas ake ntorrok, nemedol enkitoo o Laitoriani.

English: LORD, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, eilepieki enkaina ino, kake medol ninche. Nchoo ninche metoduaa olom too ltung'ana linono, nekurru ninche. Nchoo ina kima te nkaraki ilmang'ati linono einos ninche.

English: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, intobiraki iyie iyiook eseriani, iyie oishoo iyiook nena siaitin ang pooki.

English: O LORD our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang, eitoreita apa iyiook kulikae aitoriak leme iyie, kake enkarna ino ake kewan kiyiolo iyiook.

English: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
Masaai: Etuata ninche, nemeitoki aapiu, etaa ninche loipi, nemeigil ninche aaitashe; ore te ina, nitumutana iyie ninche aishie, niwuang'ie ninche pee meigili ai kata aadamu.

English: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Kake itoponayie iyie ilo orere, aitoriani, itoponayie iyie ele orere; kintaaki iyie kitok; intalala iyie ilpolosien lena kop.

English: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ore to sina niking'oru ninche iyie, nebuku ninche enkomono, ina kata etii enkitamioto shumata ninche.

English: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
Masaai: Ore anaa entuaa natashala, neyietu aishir te mion e saisai, neijia iyiook kitiu te nkaraki iyie, Olaitoriani;

English: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
Masaai: kitunutate apa iyiook, kitasaisayia, kitotiutuo anaa eikitoiutuo enkijape. Mikiaata enkordunoto nikiyautua enkop, ore lelo oomanya enkop neitu ebatata.

English: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
Masaai: Ore lelo linono ootuata naa kepiu kedumunye aaitashe iseseni lenye. Lo tung'ana kulo oomanya atua enterit, enyeito entaranyisho te ng'ida! Amu ore ina oileelio ino naa enkoileelio e wang'an, ore te ina kop e nemeneng'a naa ilo iyie aitopiu ninche.

English: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
Masaai: Wootu lo tung'ana laainei, entijing ilgilat linyi, ninkenikene nkutukie oo nkajijik, esudori intae maate te nkiti rishata, o metaba anaa nelusoo ina goro.

English: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
Masaai: Amu, ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani aipang'u te wueji enye pee elotu aitame lelo oomanya enkop te nkaraki enkarruoisho enye. Ore enkop nelo aibalunye ilo sarge apa oibukoyioki ti oriong ninye, nemeigil ae kata aitemoo lelo apa ootaraki metuata.

English: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong eibung'ita Olaitoriani ilo alem lenye kitok ogol, nelo ninye aitame Lefiatan, ilo asurai oisikita, ilo asurai ojo lefiatan omerregela, near ninye metua ina kukuu natii atua enaiposha.

English: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong: “Neranyaki enkurma sidai oo sabibu ninye!

English: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
Masaai: Nanu Olaitoriani olaing'urani lenye; kabukoki nanu enkare pooki kata. Melotu ake likae tung'ani ainyal, karrip nanu kewarie o dama.

English: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
Masaai: Maata nanu engoro. Tenaa naaji kaata nanu ilkiku o entiaati pee airragakinye ninche, anaata apejoo ninche pooki.

English: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
Masaai: Anaa nchoo ninche eibung esarunoto ai, nchoo ninche eitobir osotua o nanu, nchoo ninche eitobir osotua o nanu.”

English: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naapuonu neibung Yakobo ntona, neitapuku Israel neiu ntilitan neiput enkop pooki ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
Masaai: Ketoosho ninye ninche anaa apa enatoosho lelo mang'ati lenye? Anaa ketasesekuana ninye ninche anaa apa enatasesekuanaki lelo asesesekuanak?

English: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
Masaai: Te nkiririkinoto iyie intamio ninche, airreu ninche meshomo eyararoto; iwuang'ie ninche te ngoro ino napi, te ina olong o lkutati lo loo saen.

English: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina naa kepalakini enkitarruorroto e Yakobo naa kelo ena aaku olng'anayioi olulung'a le nkitayunoto e ng'oki enye: te nelo ninye aitobir isoito pooki loo lperereni loo lasarri, nerrorro anaa ilboro le nturoto, meitoki atii Asherim anaa lasarri le nkorropil ooitoki aaitashe.

English: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
Masaai: Amu ore ina anasa nasheta netomijoono emanyisho apa naidurrieki nepuoi aaing'uaa, etotiuo anaa ong'ata, te ine edaa lasho, neirrag te ine negil ilng'osil lenyena.

English: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
Masaai: Ore kenya te netoyu lelo ng'osil lenyena, negili; nepuonu nkituaak aaitayunye enkima. Amu olorere ele lememuso; ore enkaraki ina, ore ilo oitobira ninche meduaaki ninche olng'ur, ore ilo oitobirua ninche meisho ninche omom.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong, ebaiki olkeju le Frati o metabaiki oerata le Misiri, naa keiturrur Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena moobo, anaa oltung'ani osilu isuut te nkano.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa ore akenya te ina olong kepuoi aaosh entarumpeta kitok, ore lelo apa ooimina te nkop e Asiria, o lelo oopuonu ootarayioki Misiri nepuonu aaserem Olaitoriani te nchumata ele doinyo sinyati te Yerusalem.

English: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo owuasa oata emaupe e nkitoo oo lamerak le Efraim, o ina tapukai natoyio oshi nara enkishiaa enye; naa ninye natii endukuya e ilo erata oleng le lelo ooidimua enaisho!

English: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eeta Olaitoriani ilo obo magilani negol; ore anaa olkutati le nchan oo soito otiu anaa olkutati le nkidaata netiu anaa enkare nagol nadooyo kelo ninye anang'aki enkop te ngoro.

English: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
