Masaai: Ore ilo oata emaupe e nkitoo loo lamerak le Efraim, naa kepuoi aaitunyoki enkop too nkejek.

English: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
Masaai: Ore ina tapukai natoyio enkishiaa enye, natii endukuya e ilo erata oleng, naa ketiu anaa ilng'abolo le dukuya ooton eng'or te nkata e nkirowuaj: te nedol oltung'ani ilo ng'anayioi neinos nabo kata anaa ake pee eibung te nkaina.

English: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aaku emaupe enkitoo, neaku enkishili e nkishiaa te ilo pisiai loo ltung'ana lenyena;

English: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
Masaai: o ltau le sipata te ilo oton te nkiguana, o engolon te ilo oibelekeny olarrabal te kishomi.

English: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
Masaai: Etarruoitie sii lekua te naisho, neyukuyukori te merai e naisho napi, ore olapolosani o laiboni netarruoitie te naisho; etomilote ninche te naisho neyukuyukori ninche te merai e naisho napi, etapaashari ninche te nduaata, nerrorro ninche edung enkiguana.

English: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
Masaai: Amu eiputa lopat imesai pooki, meetae ewueji nemetii olduruk.

English: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
Masaai: “Kaing'ae ninye elo aiteng'en aitaarriyian, naa kaing'ae elo ninye ainosaki ilo kilikuai? Lelo ooereki, lelo lemeekure enakita?

English: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
Masaai: Amu enkiteng'enata te shumata nkiteng'enat, enkitanapata te shumata enkitanapata, olkereri te shumata olkereri, olkereri te shumata olkereri, etii enkiti ene netii enkiti idie.”

English: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
Masaai: A-a, kake too ltung'ana ooiro nkutukie nemeyioloi, neiro too lng'ejepa loo loreren, kelo Olaitoriani airorie iltung'ana lenyena,

English: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
Masaai: laa ninche apa etiaaka, “Ena enkiyeng'iyeng inyi, enchoo eyeng'iyeng'a ilo onaure, naa ena enkiyagata inyi”; kake ore eyia mening'isho ninche.

English: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kelo ororei lo Laitoriani aaku te ninche, enkiteng'enata te shumata nkiteng'enat, enkiteng'enata te shumata enkiteng'enata, olkereri te shumata olkereri, olkereri te shumata olkereri, enkiti tene, o enkiti te idie; pee etum ninche aashom, nebatatakino siadi, negila, nerreshi, neibung'i aaya.

English: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, entoning naa ororei lo Laitoriani intae iloo menisho, intae lelo ooitore kulo tung'ana le Yerusalem!

English: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
Masaai: Amu itejo apa intae, “Kintobira iyiook olning'o o keeya, ore enemeneng'a nikitoning'ote; te nelotu enkidaata nemeeta eneiko iyiook; amu kintaa iyiook elejare esarunoto ang, naa lomon lemesipa kilutoo iyiook”;

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
Masaai: ore naa, nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Kairragie nanu te Sion osoit oaku olkitamanyunoto, osoit otujurruoki aatem, osoit ogol e nkinyiang'a lo lmairroto: ‘Ore ilo oiruk ninye nemeisarrisar.’

English: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu esipata olgiita naitaa esupatisho ina temet e nkitorioroto; naa keoroo enchan oo soito ina lejare o mbaa nemesipa, neya enkare ilo ng'obor olutori.”

English: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
Masaai: Ore ilo ning'o linyi o keeya neaku parmetii, ore ina nitoning'okinote o enemeneng'a nemeitoki auno; te nelotu enkidaata, naa eikiosh iyie.

English: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
Masaai: Naa ore ake enkata naba anaa enalotu nikiya iyie, amu kelotu ninye anaake tadekenya, o endama o enkewarie; ore eyiolounoto e ilo kilikuai naa olkirutoto ake.

English: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
Masaai: Amu kedorropu endapash te neitorioo oltung'ani nkejek, naa ronkai olkarasha te nejo oltung'ani aitoipore.

English: For the LORD shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
Masaai: Amu kedumunye Olaitoriani anaa apa to ldoinyio le Perasim, naa kegoro ninye anaa apa to erata le Gibeon; pee atum ataasa enkiaas enye, napaashaa, neas esiaai enye, ina siaai enye nemeyioloi!

English: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
Masaai: Ore naa taata emimenaa, pee meitirrishi ake ienat inyi, amu atoning'oyie nanu endung'okinoto e nkiguana e mutai, eing'uaa Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, eipirta enkop pooki.

English: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
Masaai: Nchoru enkiok, toning'o oltoilo lai; toning'isho, naa toning'o enajo.

English: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
Masaai: Amaa ilo oturisho pee eunisho keturisho anaake? ketur ninye enkop enye neitupuyiapui enterit anaake?

English: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and rie in their place?
Masaai: Amaa te neidip ninye aitobira enterit, emeisuaaki ninye enkop ilanterera lenyena loo mpukunot pooki, neun enkano too lkererin nepik shairi ewueji enye, neitobiraki enerishare?

English: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.
Masaai: Amu eiteng'enaki ninye aaitobiraki; Enkai enye naiteng'en ninye.

English: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
Masaai: Amu meidong'i ilmomo to soit oituutishoreki, nemeimieki ilanterera leijo lelo enkeju e ngarri; amu ore ilmomo o lanterera leijo lelo naa te ng'udi eidong'i.

English: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
Masaai: Keidong'i entapa oo mukateni? A-a, meidong'i o akenya; te nereu oltung'ani enkeju e ngarri enye te shumata e nkano eyiataa embarta, nemeidong ninye nagut.

English: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
Masaai: Olaitoriani loo lororani sii eing'uaa ena; ole nking'asia ninye too nkikoot, naa arriyia aisul te ng'eno.

English: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
Masaai: Woi ninye Ariel, Ariel, ina anasa apa natamanya Daudi Toponai ake to lari to lari; nchoo siruai emanikino.

English: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
Masaai: Kapik nanu Ariel osina, nelo aaku olkiyioi o enkishirata, nelo ninye atiu te nanu anaa Ariel.

English: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
Masaai: Naa kaalo nanu aman ang'adu too nkaloli pooki, naang'adu nanu too ltaleta naaitaman nanu iyie enkang.

English: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
Masaai: Neaku te negut te nkop ilo iyie airo, abori enterit eimu irorei linono; enkop eimu oltoilo lino anaa oltoilo, neing'oming'om oltoilo lino eimu enterit.

English: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
Masaai: Nebayu ilmang'ati linono anaa enterit napuyiapui, ore olorora loo larruok nebayu anaa suut. Naa keluamisho ninche too nkaitin,

English: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
Masaai: eikimutan iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani te ndarata, o te nkikirikirata e nkop, o to ltoilo kitok, o to siuo o to lkutati o te nkima nanyaisho.

English: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
Masaai: Ore ilo orora loo loshon pooki, oitayunye Ariel olarrabal, lelo pooki oarare ninye o wuejitin enyena neesheta, nepik ninye osina, nepuo aatiu anaa enkidetidet, enduaata e kewarie.

English: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
Masaai: Anaa te neidetidetu oltung'ani oata esumash einosita endaa, neinyototo te sumash enye eitu eraposho, aashu anaa te neidetidetu oltung'ani oata enkure eokito enkare neinyototo ninye te nkure enye eitu eok enkare, neaku neijia epuo aatiu ilororani loo loshon, lelo oarare oldoinyo le Sion.

English: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
Masaai: Entaa ate ilmoda, ninyanya kutukie, entaa ate ilemedolisho nimodokuku! Entaa lamerak, neme te naisho; eyukuyukori neme enaisho napi itooko!

English: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
Masaai: Amu etubukoko intae Olaitoriani oltau loo njio naairoishi, neikeno ninye nkonyek inyi intae iloibonok, neikeno lukuny inyi lelo aduaak.

English: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
Masaai: Ore enduaata ena pooki netotiwuo te iyie anaa irorei le mbuku natimishiraki aaiken neishooyo oltung'ani meisuma ilo oyiolo aisuma, ejo, “Isuma ena,” nejo ninye, “Maidim nanu, amu etimishiraki aaiken.”

English: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
Masaai: Naa te neisho ninche embuku oltung'ani lemeyiolo aisuma nejo, “Isuma ena,” nejo ninye, “Mayiolo aisumayu.”

English: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo, “Ore enkaraki naanyikaki naanyor nanu kulo tung'ana too nkutukie naayanyit ninche nanu too nkutukie, aalamita iltauja lenye, ore euriata enye te nanu naa enkitanapata oo ltung'ana nayiolo ake too lukuny;

English: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ng'ura kaigil nanu aitaas mbaa e nking'asia kulo tung'ana, mbaa e nking'asia sapuki; ore ina ng'eno oo lang'eni lenye neish, ore ina musunoto e lelo amusok lenye neishieki.”

English: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooturoki enkop aaisudoriyie Olaitoriani mbaa enye, lelo ootii mbaa enye enaimin, lelo oojo, “Kaing'ae nadol iyiook? Kaing'ae nayiolo iyiook?”

English: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter's clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
Masaai: Imbelekenyenye intae mbaa e atua aayau oriong! Amaa olaitobirani loo motioo oo nkulukuok, keitanyaanyukieki nkulukuok; eji metaa kejoki entoki naitayioki ilo oitayu, “Eitu ninye aitayu nanu,” aashu ejoki entoki naitobiraki ilo oitobira, “Meeta ninye ening'unoto”?

English: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
Masaai: Aime enkiti rishata nang'or pee eitaa Lebanon enkurma naleng, ore ina kurma naleng neibelekenyi aaitaa entim?

English: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
Masaai: Ore kenya te ina olong naa kelo ilo ming'ani aning irorei le mbuku, ore te misimisi o enaimin nedolishoyu nkonyek e ilo modooni.

English: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ilo obor neng'amu ninye eng'ida ng'ejuk naing'uaa Olaitoriani, ore olaisinani aisul iltung'ana nelo ashipakino ilo sinyati le Israel.

English: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
Masaai: Amu, ore ilo le meeta olng'ur naa keishieki neiting'ieki ilo oitokoos, ore lelo pooki ooing'or pee eas entorroni nedung'ori aaiwuang'ie,

English: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
Masaai: lelo ooitapong'oo iltung'ana too rorei aaitasur, nepikaki orreshet ilo oisikong'isho te kishomi, ore to sayia le pesho neibelekeny arriny ilo asipani.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
Masaai: Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani, laa ninye apa otokordua Abraham ti alo enkaji e Yakobo: “Meigil ae kata Yakobo adol enkurruna, nemeigil ae kata enkomom enye aipusu.

English: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
Masaai: Amu te neing'or ninye nkera enyena, ina siaai oo nkaik aainei ti atua ninye, neitisiny ninche enkarna ai; neitisiny ninche ilo Osinya le Israel.

English: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
Masaai: Ore lelo oopong'ori too ltauja nepuonu aayiolou, ore lelo ooing'unyung'uny neng'amaa nkitanapat.”

English: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
Masaai: “Woi ninche nena kera kiseruti,” Olaitoriani ojo, “lelo ooitobir enkitobirata neme enaai; lelo ooitayu mbaa enye nemetii oltau lai, pee etum ninche aatoponai eng'oki te shumata eng'oki;

English: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
Masaai: lelo oonapa pee edoyio aapuo Misiri nemaaikilikuanishore ninche, pee epuo aasaru emitunoto e Farao, nepuo aaing'oru eneigara to loip le Misiri!

English: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keibelekenya ina mitunoto e Farao aaku enkurruna, ore ine ning'arara to loip le Misiri, neibelekenya aaku osina linyi.

English: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo netii ilkituaak lenyena Soan nepuo ilbalusuni lenyena aabaiki Hanes,

English: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
Masaai: kepuonu ake aakurru pooki ti alo ilo orere lemeidim aataret ninche, nemeyau eretoto aashu dupoto, kake enkurruna ake o esulare.”

English: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
Masaai: Olkilikuai oipirta ing'uesi naatii Negeb, ina kop pooki natii enyamali o sina, ine nepukunye elipong olng'atuny o lng'atuny, entara o enturbubua, nenap ninche karsisisho enye too nkoriong'i nenap ilchumat lenye too ntamesin aayaki ilo orere lemeret ninche.

English: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
Masaai: Amu ore eretoto e Misiri naa pesho, ina pee atejo nanu ninye, “Rahabu ina naton aitirring'a.”

English: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
Masaai: Ore naa taata, shomo ngero ina te dukuya ninche too soito dapashi oogueta nintoki asiraki ninye embuku, pee etum ataa te nkata nalotu enchakenisho ntarasi.

English: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD:
Masaai: Amu olorere kiseruti ninche nkera naalejisho, nkera nemening ninche enkiteng'enare o Laitoriani;

English: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
Masaai: lelo oojoki iladuaak, “Emidolisho” nejoki iloibonok, “Emimbonoki iyiook esipata; entoliki iyiook mbaa nemeitureisho, embonu mbaa o lng'am,

English: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
Masaai: tung'uai enkoitoi, mbelekenyayu tapaasha enkoitoi, mincho king'il iyiook aaning mbaa e ilo Osinya le Israel.”

English: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
Masaai: Ore naa nji ejo Ilo Osinya le Israel, “Ore enkaraki nitemenaitie intae ele rorei, nisiligigi olwuasa o enkiser, ningarakino ninche,

English: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
Masaai: ore enkaraki ina, kelo ena ng'oki atiu te ntae anaa olbaata le suntai naado netaa kejo pee eurori, naa ore euroroto enye naa nabo kata;

English: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters' vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
Masaai: ore embelata nalo abela netiu anaa emoti oo nkulukuok naitiaaki aaotiki ore mbelat enyena nemeitoki asotunoyu, meitokini ninye aatum embelati nayayieki enkima aashu naokunyeki enkare to lchorro.”

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ilo Osinya le Israel, “Ti nishukunye ayeng'iyeng'a nikintajeuni; te nkitirring'ata o te nkisiligata elotu engolon ino.” Nimiyieuu intae.

English: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
Masaai: Kake itejo, “A-a! Eikikuet iyiook too mbartan,” ore enkaraki ina, ikuetikuete aapuo, “Ore iyiook nikikuetie mbartan aakuet oleng,” neaku keten oleng lelo oosuj intae.

English: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
Masaai: Keisik aailanyisho ilkulinyi oora enkalifu te nebuak oltung'ani obo, ore te mbuakunoto oo ltung'ana imiet nikuet ailanyisho o mikitung'uari, nitiu anaa enchata naunieki enanka te nchumata oldoinyo.

English: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
Masaai: Ore naa kiaanyita iyie Olaitoriani pee king'urrie; neaku keisisi ninye, pee etum aing'urrie intae. Amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai oo sipat; emayiana lelo pooki ooanyu ninye.

English: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
Masaai: Ee, lo tung'ana le Sion kulo oomanya Yerusalem; mingiligili ae kata aaishir. Esipa keing'urrie ninye intae te ina kishirakinoto inyi; te nening ninye ilo kiyioi linyi, naa kewaliki intae.

English: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
Masaai: Naa ore hoo neisho intae Olaitoriani endaa e nyamali o enkare o sina, meigil Olaiteng'enani linyi aisudoo kewan, kake kedol nkonyek inyi Olaiteng'enani linyi.

English: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
Masaai: Ore nkiyiaa inyi te siadi intae, nening oltoilo ojo, “Nena enkoitoi, eima intae ine,” ti nimbelekenyanya intae aapuo enkalo e tatene aashu enkalo e kidienye.

English: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
Masaai: Nipikipiki intae olduruk nena kitanyaanyukot naapising'a te nkosholai, o nena naasholuno e sahabu. Nindapashaa intae ninche anaa ntokitin nemesinya; nijokiki intae ninche, “Enchom nimiitutu!”

English: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
Masaai: Naa keirriwaki intae Olaitoriani enchan te nkaraki lelo anterera lituuno o ina kurma nabulu te nkop, nalo aisho te nkumoi. Ore kenya te ina olong naa kepuo nchoo inyi aadaa too ndaat naalala.

English: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
Masaai: Ore ilmong'i o sirkon ooturisho neinos olkujita otudung'oki oisukutieki.

English: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
Masaai: Ore te pooki doinyo oado, o pooki doinyo naikarere, naa kejing nkonyek oo nkariak ina olong kenya eyiang'are kitok te neurori iltaleta.

English: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa kelo ewang'an o lapa atiu anaa ewang'an e nkolong. Ore ewang'an e nkolong neaku katitin naapishana, anaa ewang'an oo nkolong'i naapishana, te ina olong kenya nalo Olaitoriani aen olbae too ltung'ana lenyena, neishiunye lelo baa apa le oshoto enye.

English: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
Masaai: Ng'ura kelotu enkarna o Laitoriani eing'uaa enelakua, neyupuyup engoro enye netii empuruo kitok; ore enkutuk enye nebore engoro, ore olng'ejep lenye neikununo anaa enkima nanyaisho;

English: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
Masaai: ore enkiyang'et enye neikununo anaa enchorro naruko adooyo neilepu enkare o metaa keitabaiki oltung'ani olgos; pee esil ina are lelo oshon te silet e nkidaata entorroni, nepiki nkutukie oo loreren nkeenta naaitapong'orieki.

English: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae aatiu anaa iloata osirua osinya kewarie iranyishosho. Nitumutumu eng'ida o ltau nitiuu anaa te neoshi enkinanta pee epuoi oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, ina dapidapoi e Israel.

English: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
Masaai: Naa keisho Olaitoriani ilo toilo lenye le nkitoo metoning'o pooki ng'ae, ore ina oshoto e nkaina enye nedou metodoli te ngoro napi o te nkima namutisho, te nebo olkutati o enchan oo soito.

English: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Asiria naa keiput enkiputukuny o lkirutoto te nening ilo toilo lo Laitoriani, ina kata eoshisho ninye te ng'udi enye.

English: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
Masaai: Ore eosh Olaitoriani, ninche aigil, netoni iltung'ana lenyena aaranyisho too lwululi o too nkai oo sinkolioitin Enkai makewan naarare ile Asiria.

English: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
Masaai: amu eidipaki apa aaitobira ewueji neyupuyup; ee te nkaraki ilo aiguanani, eitobiraki endapasho o enguton, netii ilkeek kumok o enkima kitok. Naa enkiyang'et o Laitoriani naikununo anaa enkima nakutu isoito.

English: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD!
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo oodoyio aapuo Misiri aaing'oru eretoto, neisilig mbartan, lelo oong'idare ngarrin oo mbartan eji amu aikumok, o lelo akedok loo mbartan eji amu kegol ninche oleng, kake meing'orninche Ilo Sinyati le Israel, aashu eikilikuanishore ninye!

English: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
Masaai: Naa ng'en ake sii ninye neyau enkidaata, merrinyokino ninye irorei lenyena, kake kedumakino ninye ina aji oo larruok, nedumakino lelo aretok le lelo oas entorroni.

English: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Misiri naa iltung'ana, mme Enkai; ore nena bartan enye naa nkiri, mme nkiyang'eta. Te neitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye, neikirikira ilo oretisho, ore ilo oretitoi nebatata, neidak pooki te nebo.

English: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
Masaai: Amu nji nanu aatiaaka Olaitoriani, “Ore anaa enaikurrukur olng'atuny anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny te ina ng'ues natara, naa te neipotuni olturrur loo lairritak meetu aarare ninye, nemeiture ninye nena buakunot enye aashu eirutie enkilepilep enye, neijia eikununye Olaitoriani te nedou alotu aitayu olarrabal te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion, o te shumata endoinyo enye.

English: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaitoip e motonyi, nkera enyena neijia eiko Olaitoriani loo lororani emitu Yerusalem; kerrip neitajeu ninye, kemitu nekordu ninye.”

English: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
Masaai: Embelekenyakinoto ilo apa litogolong'akitia oleng, lo tung'ana loo Siraeli.

English: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
Masaai: Amu ore kenya te ina olong, naa kenang'aa pooki ng'ae nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin e nkosholai, o nkitanyaanyukot e sahabu, apa naaitobirutua nkaik inyi too ng'ok, te nkaraki intae.

English: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
Masaai: “Naa kebatata ile Asiria to lalem, leme olayioni le tung'ani; ore ilo alem leme olayioni le tung'ani neinos ninye; naa kelo ninye ailany ilo alem, ore elelero enye nepuoi aapik esinkaisho.

English: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitaa ninye endapidapoi neisik to lkirutoto, ore lelo kituaak lenyena neilanyisho aaing'uaa inankan enye te nkiputukuny,” neijia ejo Olaitoriani otii enkima enye Sion netii olkokuet lenye atua Yerusalem.

English: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
Masaai: Ng'ura kelo olaiguanani aitoreisho too sipat, nepuo ilkituaak aaitoreisho too nkiguanat naasipa.

English: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
Masaai: Kelo ake atiu te pooki lenye anaa eneigarae te nkaraki olkutati, olchurie te nkaraki olkutati, netiu anaa nchorroi oo nkariak te nkop natoyio, netiu anaa oloip le ndapidapoi kitok te nkop e nauri.

English: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
Masaai: Ore nkonyek e lelo oodol nemeitokini aaiken, ore nkiyiaa e lelo ooning nening.

English: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
Masaai: Ore oltau le ilo opuny netum mbarakinot, ore olng'ejep le ilo oiramiram neiro aitorioki.

English: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
Masaai: Nemeigili aajo oltung'ani omoda kedupa, nemeji lelo aisimak eji keleng.

English: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
Masaai: Amu mbaa e modai eiro olmodai nedamu mbaa entorroni to ltau lenye; pee etum ataasa ntorrok, neiro mbaa naapaashaa ti alo Olaitoriani, neing'uaa lelo ooisumash meeta toki, nemitiki ilo oata enkure enkare.

English: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
Masaai: Ore enkeleekisho e ilo kiminchali naa entorroni, entorroni eipiru ninye pee einyal ilo omena too rorei le lejare, hoo duoo ninye tenaa kesipa ewalata e ilo omena.

English: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo supat neiro mbaa e supatisho, ore too mbaa e supatisho neitashe ninye.

English: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
Masaai: Enyeito intae kuna kituaak naaisikarra, entoning oltoilo lai; natoyie kuna nemeshilaa toki, entoning enkiroroto ai.

English: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata naba anaa olari obo, nipuopuo intae aatum enyamali, intae kuna naaishiliga; amu meitoki aatii ilng'anayio, meitoki atii enkisampuare oo lng'anayio.

English: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
Masaai: Enkirikirata intae nakituaak kuna naaisikarra, entayu nkilani metaa minchopopo, nirretenene ilkuniyiani.

English: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
Masaai: Entooshiosh ilgooitie linyi te nkaraki nena kurman sidain, te nkaraki nena kurman oo sabibu naatoishete oleng.

English: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
Masaai: Ore te ina kurma oo ltung'ana laainei nebulu ilkiku o endiati ee too nkajijik e nchipai te ina anasa e ng'ida.

English: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
Masaai: Amu kepuoi aaing'uaa ina aji e nkitoo, neing'uari ina anasa naning'o; ore endoinyo o ine nerripishoreki nepuo aaku iwuejitin oo ng'uesi ntarasi, ewueji neitigiranie loitikoishi, neaku ndaat oo nkerrai;

English: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
Masaai: ometaba anaa nebukokini iyiook Enkiyang'et naing'uaa shumata, neaku ong'ata ewueji neisho oleng, ore ine neisho neiu ilng'anayio kumok.

English: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
Masaai: Netum taa esupatisho atamanya ina ong'ata, nemany eseriani atua ina kurma naisho.

English: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
Masaai: Ore esupatisho neiu eseriani, ore esupatisho neyau enkitirring'ata o nkirukoto ntarasi.

English: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
Masaai: Kepuo iltung'ana laainei aabik te manyisho e seriani ntarasi, ti atua ewueji e nkirrita oo wuejitin neeitirring'areki aayeng'iyeng'are.

English: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
Masaai: Ore entim neurori katukul, neurori katukul ina anasa.

English: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
Masaai: Imayianana intae lelo oounisho te mbata oo nkariak pooki, lelo ooisho ilmong'i o sirkon eidapashari aapuo.

English: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
Masaai: Woi iyie ora olainyalani, leton eitu kinyali iyie, niaata enkeleekisho, neitu iyie kintaasi embae e nkeleekisho! Ore ake pee indip ainyalisho nikinyali sii ninye iyie; ore pee indip mbaa inono e nkeleekisho nikintaasi iyie inenkeleekisho.

English: O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ing'urrie iyiook, iyie iyiook kiaanyita. Taa enkaina ang anaake tadekenya, neaku enjeunoto ang te nkata e nyamali.

English: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
Masaai: Ore to ltoilo le ndarata neisik iltung'ana, ore ti nidumunye iyie neidapasha loreren.

English: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
Masaai: Naa kearari intokitin inono neishunye anaa enaishu oimaat enkop; anaa enaitiam olmaati te nkop, neitiam iltung'ana te nkop.

English: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
Masaai: Keisisi Olaitoriani, amu etii ninye shumata oleng; keiput ninye Sion esipata o esupatisho.

English: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
Masaai: Naa ninye olo aaku enkitashoto too nkatitin inyi, neaku kitok enjeunoto, o eng'eno o eyiolounoto; naa euriata o Laitoriani ninye olchumati lenye.

English: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
Masaai: Ng'ura lelo oing'ok, eishirita ninche ti auluo; ore lelo balusuni le seriani, neishirita te mion.

English: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
Masaai: Etoliyiote nkoitoi sapuki meekure eetae olalotoni. Etigile olning'o, netemenayioki ilchakenini, meetae oltung'ani oshilaa olikae.

English: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
Masaai: Eishirita enkop netalepori to sina; etumute Lebanon netoyio; etotiuo Sharon anaa olpurkel; ore Bashan o Karmel neipiripiroitie mbenek enye.

English: Now will I rise, saith the LORD; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
Masaai: “Kadumunye nanu taata,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Ore taata kaitashe nanu; naa kaayiolouni nanu taata.

English: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
Masaai: Ntobiribiri intae mbaa naaijo suut, nipuopuo aayau mbaa e pesho; ore enkiyang'et inyi naa enkima namut intae.

English: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
Masaai: Netiu olorere anaa ilootapejoyioki aaitaa enkuruoni, netiu anaa ilkiku ootudung'oki nepejori te nkima.”

English: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
Masaai: Entoning intae lelo oolakua, ina nataasa nanu; ore intae kulo oolakua, entayiolo enkidimata ai.

English: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
Masaai: Ore lelo aing'okok ootii Sion neiruto; eibung'a olokirikiri lelo lemeyiolo Enkai: “Kalo ti atua iyiook oidim atotona te nkima nanyaisho? Kalo ti atua iyiook oidim atobiko te nkima oo ntarasi?”

English: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
Masaai: Ore ilo olo too nkoitoi naaitoriori neiro sipat, ilo omenaa tumoto e nkitorogonyare, ilo oipirripir nkaik enyena meibung ntokitin e ropare, ilo oiken nkiyiaa enyena pee mening enkibukoroto o sarge; neiken nkonyek enyena pee meing'or entorroni.

English: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
Masaai: Ilo ninye olo aton too wuejiitin e shumata; ore ewueji e nkirrita naa isempewueti too soito; nepuoi aaisho ninye endaa o enkare.

English: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
Masaai: Keyooki nkonyek inono aaing'or olaiguanani te nkishiaa enye; neing'or ninche aaing'or ina kop dapash oleng.

English: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
Masaai: Nepuo indamunot inyi aaing'asia te ilo kirutoto, nijojo, “Koree ninye ilo apa oikenisho, Koree ninye ilo apa oineneng atem kodi? Koree ninye ilo apa oiken iltaleta?”

English: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
Masaai: Mingiligili ae kata aadol lelo tung'ana leeiking'a, lelo tung'ana limiyiololo intae enkutuk enye nimindimidimi aatoning'u ooiramiram te nkutuk nimining'ung'u.

English: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
Masaai: Eng'ura Sion, ina anasa gelunoti nikipolosishore iyiook! Kepuo nkonyek inono aadol Yerusalem, ina manyisho naitirring'a, ilo ng'obor lemeigusugus, lemedotunye ae kata nena sheito naaunore, nemedung'o nena keenta naaenare.

English: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
Masaai: Ore te ine nelo Olaitoriani te nkitoo aaku te nebo iyiook ewueji ine netii ilkejek dapashi o erat, nemeim ine imelin e enkitoo.

English: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani ninye olarishani lang Olaitoriani ninye olo aitore iyiook, Olaitoriani ninye olaiguanani lang; keitajeu ninye iyiook.

English: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
Masaai: Eitololong'ita nkeenta e meli; meitirrishayu ninche. Ore nena masaa kumok neori keyae o mewaita ilmaiman.

English: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
Masaai: Nemeetae obo omanya ina kop ojo, “Kamuei nanu”; ore lelo tung'ana oomanya ine naa kepalakini ing'ok enye.

English: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
Masaai: Entinyiku intae looreren, pee ining'ining'i, entoning intae lo tung'ana! Nchoo metoning'o enkop o nena pooki naatii atua Nchoo metoning'o enkop o nena pooki naapuku tiatua enkop.

English: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
Masaai: Amu etagorokine Olaitoriani iloshon pooki netagorokine ilmang'ati lenye, eiturrayie ninye ninche, eishooyie ninche aisho lelo oomut ninche.

English: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
Masaai: Kenang'ari mpopoki neye, nerupa mpopoki enye eidapashakino enkop, neruko osarge lenye aim nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
Masaai: Ore olorora le keper nerrarra aaku enterit. Ore oloing'ang'e pooki nepiyaya anaa endapana ore ilo orora pooki nerrarrunye anaa enasulunye mbenek o lng'aboli, anaa enasulunye ilng'abolo ooto to lchani.

English: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
Masaai: Amu etudumunye olalem lai netaraposhe te shumata; ng'ura kesulakino ninye Edom te nkiguana, eumata lelo tung'ana latudung'oko nanu enkiguana.

English: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
Masaai: Eeta Olaitoriani olalem oiputa osarge, neimulumulita eilata, te nebo osarge loo lkerra o lkineji, te nebo enkurriny oo lairakuj oo lkerra, amu kelo Olaitoriani aibung olasar te Bosara, kelo ninye aitayu esesekuanare kitok te Edom.

English: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
Masaai: Naa kedoiki ilosokuani ninche, te nebo ilmong'i o loing'ok magil. Ore ina kop enye neiput osarge, ore ina kop enye nenyilu te ilata.

English: For it is the day of the LORD'S vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
Masaai: Amu eeta Olaitoriani enkolong e lap, ina olong nalo aitalaku elap te nkaraki Sion.

English: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
Masaai: Ore ilkejek le Edom neibelekenya aatiu anaa enkoronko, neaku enkulukuoni enye enkima nakutu isoito neaku ina kop enkoronko nayupuyup.

English: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore dama o kewarie nemeye ina kima; neilep empuruo enye alo shumata ntarasi. Ore too ishoritin pooki neaku ina kop mijooni; nemeitoki oltung'ani aim ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
Masaai: Kake kelo aaku le nkalem o yiyai otii ina kop ore emotonyi oo nkiyiaa o lkurruk nemany ine. Neitorioki Olaitoriani olmilo ina kop nedoiki enyamali lelo kituaak lenyena.

English: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
Masaai: Neipoti ine aajo, “Enemetii enkitoria”, ore lelo kituaak lenyena pooki neaku pesho.

English: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
Masaai: Nebulaki ilkiku lelo sempewueti lenyena nebulaki olkurushashi o suut lelo sempewueti lenyena o nkang'itie enyena naagol. Nelo ine aaku emanyisho oo mbariak ewueji nemany isidan.

English: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
Masaai: Nepuo mbariak aashulare ilng'ojiniaa, neipotu oloirirua le ntim olikae, nejokino, ee, eisidai enkewarie tene, neing'uraki kewan ewueji neyeng'iyeng'are.

English: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
Masaai: Te ine elo entaritiki aitobir enkaji enye, nepik inkiyioitin enyena abori oloip lenye; ee te ine epuo aaiturrurro ilkurragoso epuo maare.

English: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
Masaai: Ing'oru isuma te mbuku o Laitoriani; meetae hoo nabo e kuna nemelo aaku; nemeetae ake enemelotu eboitare enkae. Amu enkutuk o Laitoriani naitanapishe, naa Enkiyang'et enye naiturrurro pooki.

English: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
Masaai: Etooshoko ninye ninche enkukuo, enkaina enye natoorikia ninche rubat enye too lkererin; kepuo ninche aaya ina kop ntarasi, ore too ishoritin naa kepuo ninche aamany ina kop.

English: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
Masaai: Keng'idayu olpurkel o enkop natoyio, neng'idayu ilo purkel neleng'u oleng; neiput ntapuka

English: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD, and the excellency of our God.
Masaai: keleng'u ninye oleng, neranyisho te ng'ida. Ore ina kitoo e Lebanon neishori ninye, ore ina kitoo o enkishiaa e Karmel o Sharon. Nedol enkitoo o Laitoriani, ina kitoo e Nkai ang.

English: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
Masaai: Ntagolo nena aik naatalepori, ntasheyie ilo oikirikira te nkuretisho.

English: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
Masaai: Tiaaki lelo ootureishote, “Entagoluoto, emiureishoyu! Eng'ura Enkai inyi elotu te lap, eeta olerrinyore le Nkai, Kelotu ninye aitajeu intae.”

English: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
Masaai: Ore ilo modooni neboli nkonyek enyena, neitoning'ishoi ilo ming'ani;

English: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
Masaai: neipid olmaima anaa enkoilii, neranyisho olng'ejep lo lemeyiolo airoro te ng'ida. Amu keijirrijirru nkariak to lpurkel, neiput nkonyek oo nkariak enkop natoyio.

English: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
Masaai: Ore ilo sinyai oirowua naa kelo aaku olchorro, ore ina kop oo lbaat neijirrijirru enkare, ore ina manyisho oo mbariak nelo aaku engilata naleng, netiu nena kujit anaa oseyiai o enarau.

English: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
Masaai: Nejing enkoitoi kitok ine, naji Enkoitoi Sinyati; nemepuo aaim ine iltung'ana lemesinya, ore ilmoda nemepong'okino ine.

English: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
Masaai: Nemejing olng'atuny ine, nemelotu ae ng'ues ake ninye torrono; mepuoi aatum ninche te ine, kake lelo ootokorduaki ake oopuo aaim ine.

English: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
Masaai: Naa lelo ooinyiang'ua Olaitoriani ake oopuo aarrinyunye, nepuonu Sion eranyisho; nejing eng'ida oo ntarasi shumata ninche; nepuo ninche aatum enchipai o eng'ida, ore osina o emion neilanyisho aapuo.

English: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oong'uan le nkitoria e Hesekia, nelotu Senakerib ilo aiguanani le Asiria nena anas pooki naasheta e Yuda, neibung ninche.

English: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller's field.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani le Asiria neirriwaa olkitok obo le nkitoria enye te Lakish meshomo enetii olaiguanani Hesekia te Yerusalem eeta enjore kitok. Nelo ninye aitashe te mbata olchorro le shumata, te ina oitoi natii olaitobirani loo nkilani.

English: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah's son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph's son, the recorder.
Masaai: Nelotu Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia enetii ninye laa ninye apa oitaisheiki ina aji e nkitoo. Nelotu sii Shebna ilo aigeroni, o Yoa olayioni le Asafu laa ninye oikenisho.

English: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo kitok le njore ninche, “Entiaaki Hesekia, ‘Nji ejo ilo aiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria: Kainyoo iyie ing'idare?

English: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
Masaai: Eijo iyie keaku rorei ake duoo enkoitoi nagol napuoyieki olarrabal? Kaing'ae taata iyie ingarakino, eji peyie kimpirakinore nanu?

English: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
Masaai: Ng'ura, Misiri iyie ingarakino, naikununo anaa eng'udi o ltiyani natigile, nerem enkaina e pooki ng'ae otirman ninye.

English: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
Masaai: Kake ti nikijoki, “Olaitoriani Enkai ang iyiook kingarakino,” aime ilo otii ilperereni lenyena loo lasarri shumata, eiwuangie Hesekia lelo perereni, ejoki Yuda o Yerusalem, “Ipuopuo intae aaserem te dukuya ele perere lo lasar”?

English: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
Masaai: Wou naa taata, toning'ore olkitok lai, ilo aiguanani le Asiria, amu kaaisho nanu mbartan nkalifuni are, tenaa indim iyie te nkalo ino anoto ilakedok pee eked ninche.

English: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master's servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
Masaai: Kaji naa iyie inko pee intukurru ilo arikoni obo le njore ti atua lelo kulikae aisiaayiak ti abori, eji isiligita Misiri, mikirriwaki mbartan oo ngarrin o lakedok lenye.

English: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
Masaai: Amaa, ijo kaewuo nanu ena kop metii Olaitoriani aidaikie nainyal? Aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, Shomo taarare ena kop, ninyal ninye.’ ”

English: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews' language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliakim o Shebna o Yoa aajoki ilo kitok le njore, “Kitoomono iyie, irorie isinkan linono ti ae kutuk nikiyiolo, mirorie iyiook te nkutuk e Yuda metoning'o iltung'ana ootii esuntai.”

English: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
Masaai: Kake etejo ilo kitok le njore, “Kaairriwua nanu olkitok lai maeu airorie olkitok linyi, o intae, nemairorie lelo ootoni te suntai, laa ore ninche te nebo nipuopuo aainos nkik inyi niokioko nkulak inyi?”

English: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo kitok le njore aitashe nebuaku to ltoilo kitok te nkutuk oo ltung'ana le Yuda, ajo, “Entoning irorei lo laiguanani kitok, ilo aiguanani le Asiria!

English: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
Masaai: Nji ejo olaiguanani, ‘Emincho Hesekia meteleja intae, amu meidim ninye atokordu intae.

English: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Emincho Hesekia ejoki intae eji maigarakinoto Olaitoriani, eji ejo, “Kelo Olaitoriani akordu iyiook; ore ena anasa nemelo ninye ajing nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.”

English: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
Masaai: Emining intae Hesekia, amu nji ejo olaiguanani le Asiria. Entobira intae osotua o nanu nipuonunu enatii nanu, pee etum pooki ng'ae te intae ainosa isabibu lenyena, o lng'abolo lenyena, neok pooki ng'ae te intae enkare o lchorro lenye;

English: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
Masaai: o metaba anaa nalotu nanu aya intae ina kop nanyaanyukie enkop inyi, ina kop e ntapa o sabibu, ina kop natii endaa o lng'anayio.

English: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
Masaai: Enteng'enuoto melej ake intae Hesekia ejo, “Kelo Olaitoriani akordu iyiook.” Keetae ae kata enkai oo loshon natokordua enkop aitung'uaa enkaina o laiguanani le Asiria?

English: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
Masaai: Koree nena aitin e Hamat o Arpadi? Koree nena aitin e Serfarfaim? Ketokordutua ninche Samaria aaitayu te nkaina ai?

English: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
Masaai: Kaa too nkaitin pooki e kuna kuapi natokordua enkop enye aitayu te nkaina ai, eji metaa kelo Olaitoriani akordu Yerusalem te nkaina ai?’ ”

English: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
Masaai: Kake etigirate apa ninche neitu ewaliki olomoni hoo obo, amu ore apa enkitanapata o laiguanani naa, “Eming'amaa intae ninye.”

English: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
Masaai: Neitoki Eliakim olayioni le Hilkia laa ninye olaitasheikinoni le nkaji e nkitoo, o Shebna, laa ninye olaigeroni, o Yoa olayioni le Asafu, ilo aikenani, aapuonu enetii Hesekia etopolosa ilkilani lenye. Neinosaki ninye irorei le ilo kitok le njore.

English: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Hesekia ina, nepolos ilkilani lenyena, neimulumul kewan too ilkuniyani, nelo ajing atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Eliakim laa ninye apa oitasheki ina aji e nkitoo, o Shebna ilo aigeroni, o lelo apolosak kituaak, eishopo ilkuniyani, meshomo enetii oloiboni le Nkai Isaya, olayioni le Amos.

English: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Nji etejo Hesekia, ‘Ore ena olong naa enkolong o sina, enkolong e moroto, o esulare; etaa keini nkera nemeetae engolon naiunyeki.

English: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
Masaai: Ebaiki netoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino irorei le ilo kitok le njore, oirriwua olkitok lenye, ilo aiguanani le Asiria meeu asukeny Enkai naishu, nesurdaanyisho te lelo rorei ootoning'o Olaitoriani Enkai ino; ore enkaraki ina ilepie enkomono ino te nkaraki ilo pisiai otelekua.’ ”

English: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
Masaai: Ore ake pee epuonu ilaisiaayiak lo laiguanani Hesekia enetii Isaya,

English: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
Masaai: nejoki Isaya ninche, “Entiaaki olkitok linyi, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Emiureishoyu te nkaraki lelo rorei litoning'o, laa ninche aaisikong'ie osinka lo laiguanani le Asiria.

English: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kapik nanu ninye enkiyang'et nelo aning olmarenke, nerrinyokino ninye enkop enye makewan, naa kaisho nanu ninye metua to lalem oibung'ita ninye te nkaina enye makewan.’ ”

English: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
Masaai: Nerrinyo ilo kitok le njore, nelo ainepu olaiguanani le Asiria earare Libna; amu etoning'o apa ninche ajo eshomo olaiguanani te Lakish.

English: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
Masaai: Nening ilo aiguanani mbaa naaipirta Tihaka olaiguanani le Etiopia nchere, “Kirriwaka ninye olkilikuai pee kilotu aarare.” Ore ake pee ening ninye ina neirriwaki ilkiliku Hesekia, ejo,

English: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
Masaai: “Nji enchom entiaaki Hesekia ilo aiguanani le Yuda, ‘Mincho kilej ina Ai ino naa ninye isiligita, ejo esiligie olorere ajo meishoori Yerusalem aapik atua nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria.

English: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
Masaai: Ng'ura, itoning'o enaitaasa ilaiguanak le Asiria nkuapi pooki, neinyal ninche aaidaikie katukul. Eikipuoi doi aakordu iyie?

English: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
Masaai: Ketokordutua nena aitin oo loshon ninche, lelo oshon apa ooidaikie loo papa, Gosan, o Haran, o Resef o lelo tung'ana le Eden apa ootii Telasar?

English: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
Masaai: Koree taata olaiguanani le Hamat, o laiguanani le Arpad, o laiguanani le nkanasa naji Sefana o laiguanani le Hena aashu olaiguanani le Efaa?’ ”

English: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
Masaai: Neng'amaa olaiguanani Hesekia ina palai te lelo ooirriwuaki, neisum ninye, Neilep Hesekia alo enkaji o Laitoriani, nelo aisalaash ina palai te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Neomon Hesekia Olaitoriani, nejo,

English: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani loo lororani, na Ai e Israel, niton to lorika lino le nkitoo te shumata ilkerubi, naa iyie Enkai, iyie ake, ore too nkitoriat pooki e nkop nintobira iyie shumata o enkop.

English: Incline thine ear, O LORD, and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
Masaai: Irrugu enkiok ino, Olaitoriani, toning'o, nibol nkonyek inono Olaitoriani aing'or; nining kulo rorei pooki le Senakerib, ooirriua ninye pee emor Enkai naishu.

English: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
Masaai: Ore te sipata Olaitoriani, eitomijoono laiguanak le Asiria iloshon pooki o nkuapi pooki.

English: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men's hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
Masaai: Netanang'akitia nkaitin enye atua enkima; amu mme nkaitin apa ninche, kake esiaai oo nkaik e tung'ana, nkeek o soito; neaku eidaikieki apa ninche.

English: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD, even thou only.
Masaai: Ore naa taata Olaitoriani Enkai ang, ntajeu iyiook te nkaina enye, pee etum nkitoriat pooki enkop aatayiolo nchere iyie ake Olaitoriani.”

English: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya olayioni le Amos airriwaki Hesekia olkilikuai ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel: Ore enkaraki nikitoomono iyie nanu te nkaraki Senakerub olaiguanani le Asiria,

English: This is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
Masaai: ele ninye ilo rorei oiroro Olaitoriani eipirta ninye: ‘Eikimen ninye iyie, eikisukeny ninye iyie - ena tito e Sion; neipirripir endukuya enye te siadi iyie - na tito e Yerusalem.

English: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: ‘Kaing'ae doi ilo litamoro nisurdaany? kaing'ae ilo litabuaka nishumaki nkonyek inono to lmena? Aime Ilo Osinya le Israel!

English: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
Masaai: Ore ti alo isinkan linono nitamoro Olaitoriani, nitejo iyie, ore too ngarrin aainei kumok or mbartan, nashomo nanu ailep enchumata oo ldoinyo, o atua Lebanon; naturoyie nanu ltarakua lenyena adoru, lelo keek lenyena sidain; ashomo nanu abaya shumata aisul, ina tim enye nasur.

English: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
Masaai: Atuturuo nanu ilchorroi naok nena ariak, natunuka too ndapi oo nkejek aainei nena onyek oo nkariak pooki e Misiri.

English: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
Masaai: Keitu iyie ining nchere aitobira apa nanu moitie? Ina taata nalotu aas, eji nipuopuo intae aaitaa nkanas naasheta osototi loo mauti.

English: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
Masaai: Ore apa meeta lelo oomanya ine engolon, neiruto neiputukuny, netiu ninche anaa nkaitubulu e ong'ata, netiu anaa nkujit naanana netiu anaa nkujit naatii shumata e nkaji, naaidaikieki eitu ebulu.

English: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
Masaai: ‘Ayiolo nanu olwuanet lino o eninkunari te nimpang o ti nijing'u, o ina nikigorokino nanu.

English: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nikitagorokine iyie nanu neewuo ilo wuasa lino abau nkiyiaa aainei, kapik nanu olororoi lai nkumeishin inono napik esekenkei enkutuk ino, abaaya naaibelekeny iyie aipirie ewueji duoo ning'uaa.’

English: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
Masaai: “Naa kelo ena aaku olmonekie te iyie: ore tele ari inosa pooki toki nabulu openy. Ore to lari li are inosa ina nabulu aikununye neijia; ore to lari li okuni tuunisho, nisampisho, niun isabibu, ninos ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
Masaai: Ore ilo pisiai oleku le nkaji e Yuda, neitoki aaibung ntona ti abori, neiu ilng'anayio te shumata.

English: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.
Masaai: Amu te Yerusalem eipang'u ilo pisiai naa oldoinyo le Sion eimu ina tukus e lelo ooleku. Amu Olaitoriani loo lororani olo aitabaya ena.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina, nji ejo Olaitoriani ti alo ilo aiguanani le Asiria. Melotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, anaa engoroo embae te ine, aashu elotu anyikaki eeta elong'o aashu eng'adu ninye.

English: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ina oitoi naimu ninye eigil aim errinyo, nemelotu ninye ajing'u atua ena anasa, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David's sake.
Masaai: Amu kamitu nanu ena anasa aitajeu, te nkaraki kewan ai o te nkaraki osinka lai Daudi.”

English: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
Masaai: Nelo olmalaika lo Laitoriani, nelo aar metuata iltung'ana nkalifuni iip o ntomoni isiet o imiet te lelo ng'oborri loo ltung'ana le Asiria. Ore ake pee einyototo iltung'ana tadekenya ng'ura, etaa duoo kulo pooki mpopoki.

English: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
Masaai: Neitoki Senakerib ilo aiguanani le Asiria arrinyo nelo aton te nkang enye te Ninawi.

English: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esarhaddon his son reigned in his stead.
Masaai: Ore eseremisho ninye te nkaji e Nisrok, ina ai enye, nepuonu Adramalek o Shereser, lelo ayiok lenyena, aasesekuan ninye to lalem, neisik aapuo oldoinyo le Ararat. Neitoreisho olayioni Esar-hadon te rishata enye.

English: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i etamueyia Hesekia eyieu eye. Nelo ilo oiboni le Nkai Isaya olayioni le Amos enetii ninye, nejoki ninye, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani; Ntobira enkaji ino, amu iye iyie, minchiu.”

English: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD,
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino Hesekia esuntai neomon Olaitoriani ejo,

English: And said, Remember now, O LORD, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
Masaai: “Tadamu taata Olaitoriani, aatasayia inchere ashomo nanu te dukuya iyie te nkisiligata pooki o to ltau pooki nataasa nanu ina sidai too nkonyek inono.” Neishir Hesekia oleng.

English: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Isaya, nejo,

English: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
Masaai: “Shomo tiaaki Hesekia, Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Daudi papaai lino: Atoning'o nanu enkomono ino, natoduaa nanu ilkiyio linono; ng'ura kaponiki nanu enkishui ino ilarin tomon o imiet.

English: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
Masaai: Kaakordu nanu iyie o ena anasa aitung'uaa nkaik o laiguanani le Asiria, namitu ena anasa.

English: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD, that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;
Masaai: “Ele olmonekie te iyie oing'uaa Olaitoriani, nchere kelo Olaitoriani aas ena naisiligishore:

English: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
Masaai: Ng'ura, karrinyu nanu oloip iroruat tomon, te ine netabaikia te wueji nekedi e Ahas.” Neaku etorrinye apa enkolong siadi iroruat tomon te wueji duoo netabaikia.

English: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
Masaai: Ilkigerot kulo le Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, ina kata apa etamueyia ninye nenyaaka aishiu:

English: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
Masaai: Atejo nanu eitoritote nkolong'i aainei etaa kalo; aipirakinore nanu kishomi enemeneng'a, too larin pooki le nkishui ai.

English: I said, I shall not see the LORD, even the LORD, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
Masaai: Najo nanu, madol Olaitoriani te ina kop oo looishu; maigil ae kata nanu adol iltung'ana ti atua lelo oomanya enkop.

English: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd's tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
Masaai: Etadotuoki emanyisho ai neiwuang'ieki te nanu, eikunaki anaa olng'obor lo lchekut; atununuko nanu enkishui ai anaa endapana, aaikuna nanu anaa enkila naitobiri te wueji neripishoreki; ore dama o kewarie nikiyau iyie nanu enkiting'oto.

English: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
Masaai: Aishira nanu o mekenyu aing'oru eretoto; negiligil ninye iloik laainei pooki anaa olng'atuny; ore dama o kewarie nikiyau iyie nanu enkiting'oto.

English: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
Masaai: Abuaku nanu anaa emotonyi aishirita anaa enturkulu, enaurate nkonyek aainei aimariri shumata. Iyie Olaitoriani, aaisoruoki nanu, taa iyie esarunoto ai!

English: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
Masaai: Kake kaa nanu ajo? Amu aairorie ninye nanu, netaasa ninye makewan ina. Eidurra njo aainei pooki te nkaraki ina mion o ltau lai.

English: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, te kuna baa eishu iltung'ana, ore enkishui o ltau lai netii atua kuna pooki. Ooi, torrinyokoki nanu embiotisho nikincho manyaaki aishu!

English: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
Masaai: Ng'ura, te nkaraki eseriani ai apa pee anoto emion sapuk kake mbooyie iyie enkishui ai arishie ina gumoto e nkidaata, amu itanang'aka iyie ng'ok aainei oriong ino.

English: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
Masaai: Amu mikindim iyie enemeneng'a aishoo enashe, mikindim keeya aterrepa iyie; ore lelo oopuo aadoiki engumoto nemeidim aaisiligisho, te nkaraki ina supatisho ino.

English: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
Masaai: Ore ilo oishu, ilo oishu, ninye likincho enashe, anaa enaasita nanu ena olong; neitayiolo menye nkera enyena esupatisho ino.

English: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Kaaitajeu nanu Olaitoriani, naa eikipuo aaranyisho too nkinantani oo usin too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ang te nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
Masaai: Netejo apa Isaya, “Nchoo ninche eya emukate oo lng'abolo neelie ninche ilo tudutai pee etum ninye aishiu.”

English: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD?
Masaai: Netejo sii ninye Hesekia, “Kainyoo olmonekie nchere kalo nanu Enkaji o Laitoriani?”

English: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
Masaai: Ore apa te ina kata neirriu Merodek-baladan olayioni le ilo aiguanani le Babilon olkilikuai eeta mpala o enkishoroto nayaki Hesekia, amu etoning'o apa ninye nchere etamueyia nenyaaka aishiu.

English: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
Masaai: Neitoomon Hesekia ninche; neitodol ninche ina aji enye nashumishoreki; neitodol enkosholai, o sahabu, o eilata nagol enkinyang'a, o kulie tokitin te nebo imasaa o iruparen o nena pooki apa naatii atua ina aji enye nashumishoreki. Meetae apa entoki hoo nabo natii atua enkaji enye aashu ina ang enye pooki neitu eitodol ninche.

English: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo oiboni Isaya alotu enetii olaiguanani Hesekia nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo etejo kulo tung'ana? Naa kaji eing'uaa pee epuonu enitii?” Nejo Hesekia, “Eetuo ninche eing'uaa enkop nalakua, Babilon eing'uaa.”
