English: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Kainyoo ninche etoduaa te nkaji ino?” Newal Hesekia ajo, “Etodua ninche nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ai; meetae entoki natii atua enkaji ai neitu nanu aitodol ninche.”

English: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
Masaai: Neitoki Isaya ajoki Hesekia, “Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani:

English: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, ore nena pooki naatii atua enkaji ino, o nena pooki apa naatushuma loo papaai linyi o metabaiki ena olong, naa kenapi aaya Babilon, meetae entoki naleku, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Ore embata e lelo ayiok linono likitoikioki naa keyai sii ninche. Naa kepuo aaku sunaishi oogelema ti atua enkaji o laiguanani le Babilon.”

English: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
Masaai: Neitoki Hesekia ajoki Isaya, “Ore ilo rorei lo Laitoriani liroro iyie naa eisidai.” Amu etejo apa ninye, “Kelo atii eseriani too nkolong'i aainei.”

English: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
Masaai: Ntagolo iltung'ana laainei, ntagolo ltung'ana laainei, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD'S hand double for all her sins.
Masaai: Irorie Yerusalem te mborron, ninchiraki ninye tiaaki eisha olarrabal lenye, netapalakaki ninye ing'ok enyena, amu etang'amua apa ninye te nkaina o Laitoriani enkitalakunoto oo ng'ok enyena katitin are.

English: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
Masaai: Ening'o oltoilo oishirita: “Ore ti ong'ata ntobira enkoitoi o Laitoriani, Ntorioi to lpurkel enkoitoi tenkaraki Enkai ang.

English: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
Masaai: Ore pooki nong'oto negum neilepunyeki, ore pooki doinyo o ewueji nerupa neitadouni; ore ewueji nemeitoriori neitoriori, ore ewueji nemeisiaja neisiajayieki.

English: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Amu kepuoi aaibalunye enkitoo o Laitoriani, nedol iltung'ana pooki te nebo, amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro kuna.”

English: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
Masaai: Ejo ilo toilo, “Nchira!” Najo nanu, “Kaaishir ajo aa?” Ore pooki naata osesen netiu anaa nkujit, ore ina kishiaa enye pooki etiu anaa entapukai e ong'ata.

English: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
Masaai: Etoyu nkujit, nerrarrarri ntapuka, te nekut enkiyang'et o Laitoriani ninye; esipa etiu iltung'ana anaa nkujit.

English: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Masaai: Etoyu nkujit nerrarrarri ntapuka; kake ore ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai ang neuno ntarasi.

English: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
Masaai: Ilepa iyie shomo enchumata o ldoinyo oado, Iyie Sion, ntadarai lelo omon supati; ilepunye oltoilo lino te ngolon, Oo Yerusalem, ntadarai lelo omon supati, ilepie oleng, miureshoyu; tiaaki nena anas e Yuda, “Eng'ura Enkai inyi!”

English: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani te ngolon, naa enkaina enye nalotu aitoreisho; ng'ura netii enkishooroto enye te nebo ninye, netii nchuneti enyena dukuya ninye.

English: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
Masaai: Keirrita ninye eluaata enye anaa olchekut, neibung ninye ilkuoo too nkaik enyena, nenap ninche to lgoo lenye, nerikoo maakutiti nena oijoo.

English: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
Masaai: Kalo otetema enkare te ndap e nkaina enye netem shumata te nkitorioroto e nkaina enye, neishaki enterit e nkop pooki te ntemet neineneng ildoinyo o ndoinyo to orrantili

English: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
Masaai: kalo otuutayie Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani, aashu anaa olaikooni lenye neiteng'en ninye?

English: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
Masaai: Kaing'ae eikilikuanishore ninye pee etum ataarriyiana, naa aing'ae oiteng'ena ninye te ina neitodol ninye enkoitoi e Yiolounoto?

English: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
Masaai: Ng'ura, etiu iloshon anaa olkitong'ati le enkare naitong to ltoo, eikununo nkuapi anaa enkinyi terit napuyiapui; ng'ura, kedumu ninye lemankale pooki anaa enkini terit napuyiapui.

English: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
Masaai: Meidip ilkeek le Lebanon enkima, nemeidip ing'uesi e enyena pooki olasar opejori.

English: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
Masaai: Etiu iloshon pooki anaa pesho te dukuya ninye, eikenayie ninye ninche anaa pesho, aashu olng'am.

English: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
Masaai: Kaing'ae naa kintanyaanyukie Enkai, aashu ainyoo narisiore ninye?

English: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
Masaai: Kenkitanyaanyukoto e Nkai! ina naitobirua oltung'ani, ina namur olkunoni te sahabu, nepik ninye ilpisia le nkosholai.

English: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
Masaai: Ore ilo omena lemeidim ainyiang'u olasar, negelu olchata lemeitiapurus; neing'uraki kewan olaguetani arriyia, ounoki enkitanyaanyukoto nemeigusugus.

English: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
Masaai: Keitu iyie iyiolou? Keitu iyie ining? Keitu apa kilikini iyie te nkiterunoto? Keitu apa iyiolou iyie ebaiki olkitamanyunoto le nkop?

English: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
Masaai: Ninye ilo oton te shumata enkop, ore lelo oomanya enkop neikununo anaa ntargeet; kaing'ae ilo oisalaash shumata anaa olkarasha, nelak anaa olng'obor olo amany;

English: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
Masaai: ninye ilo oitadou ilkituaak, aitaa pesho ore lelo aitoriak le nkop neitaa pesho.

English: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
Masaai: Penyo netunoki ninche, penyo neibung'a ntona, narumishoyu te nkop, penyo neibung'a ntona enye enkop, te nekut ninye ninche netoyu, neya osiwuo ninche anaa suut.

English: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
Masaai: Kaing'ae naa intae kintanyaanyukiekie nanu, eji pee atiu nanu anaa ninye? Ilo Sinyati Obo ojo.

English: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
Masaai: Tushumu nkonyek inono toduaa shumata; kaing'ae oitobirua kuna pooki? Ilo oyau ilo orora lenye te nkumoi, neipotu ninche pooki too nkarn enye, te ina kitoo e nkidimata enye, naa ore enkaraki nagol ninye oleng meimin ninye nabo.

English: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee ijo iyie Yakobo, niro iyie Israel ajo, “Eisudoyie Olaitoriani enkoitoi ai, ore esipata ai neitu eshilaa Enkai ai?”

English: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
Masaai: Keitu iyie iyiolou? Keitu iyie ining? Ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai oo ntarasi, ninye oitobira ineeiting'ie enkop. Menauru ninye nemelepori, ore eyiolounoto enye nemejurrunoyu.

English: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Masaai: Keisho ninye engolon ilo oiterria, ore ilo lemeeta enkidimata neponiki engolon.

English: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
Masaai: Keiterre doi ninye elelero nenauru nebatata iltung'ana ooti te nauri;

English: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
Masaai: kake ore lelo oanyu Olaitoriani naa keitang'ejuk engolon enye, keilep ninche too naipuko anaa lkurragoso, nepuo aakuet nemenauru, nepuo ninche kake meiterre te nauri.

English: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
Masaai: Entirring'ata entoning'oki nanu na kuapi, kuna o lmanie le naiposha; nchoo iltung'ana eitang'ejuk engolon enye; nchoo ninche enyiku, netum taa aairoro; maigutu pooki te nebo aanyikaki enkiguana.

English: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
Masaai: Kaing'ae otuputuo ilo obo oing'uaa enkalo o loosaen, laa ore ake enelo neisulu? Nepalaa ninye iloreren te dukuya ninye, pee etum ninye aitunyoi ilaiguanak atupudaki enkop; neitotiu ninye ninche anaa enterit to lalem lenye, netiu anaa isuut naatang'oroyioki te nkawuo enye.

English: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
Masaai: Nesujaa ninye ninche nelo agiroo te seriani, te ina oitoi neitu ae kata eroro nkejek enyena.

English: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD, the first, and with the last; I am he.
Masaai: Kalo ilo otaasa ena bae, aipotu iishoritin ebaiki enkiterunoto? Nanu, Olaitoriani, ilo le dukuya, nara ole siadi; Nanu ilo.

English: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
Masaai: Etoduaa olomanaa le naiposha neureishoyu, eikirikirate ineeiting'ie enkop; eetuo ninche aanyiku.

English: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
Masaai: Etaretuo ake oltung'ani ole latia enye, nejoki olalashe lenye, “Ntagoluoyu!”

English: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
Masaai: Neitagol olaguetani loo nkeek olkunoni oshoke, ore oloyutuutisho neitagol oshoke ilo oidong'isho; ore te nkiruburubare nejo ninche, “Eisidai,” neitirrish ninye too lmushomaani pee meing'unung'un.

English: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Israel, osinka lai, Yakobo lategelua nanu, ina ishoi e Abraham, olchore lai;

English: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
Masaai: iyie apa layaua nanu aitung'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop, naaipotu too neelakua oleng, aajoki nanu iyie, “Ira iyie osinka lai, aategelua nanu iyie, nemaanang'aa nanu aiturraa;”

English: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Masaai: miureishoyu, amu atii nanu te nebo iyie, ming'aeng'ae, amu ara nanu Enkai ino; kaaitagol nanu iyie, kaaretu nanu iyie, kaaibung nanu iyie te nkaina ai e tatene naata engolon.

English: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore lelo pooki likitagorokinote naa keitukurruni nemiri; ore lelo oo ekenya te nkaraki iyie naa kepuo aaku pesho, neidak.

English: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
Masaai: Ilo iyie aing'oru lelo likikeshare, kake midol ninche; ore lelo likintayunye olarrabal naa kepuo aaku pesho.

English: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
Masaai: Amu nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, likimbung enkaina e tatene; nanu ilo likijoki iyie, “Miureisho, kaaretu nanu.”

English: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Miureishoyu Yakobo, hoo niba anaa olkurto, lo tung'ana le Israel! Karetu nanu intae, Olaitoriani ojo; ilo Osinya le Israel ninye okordu intae.

English: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu iyie entoki nadung'ishoreki, ng'ejuk, nepi, neeta lala; naa eilo iyie adung ildoinyo niuroo ninche, nintotiu iyie oldoinyo anaa suut.

English: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie aipirripir ninche neya osiwuo, neidapash olkutati ninche. Nilo iyie ang'ida ti atua Olaitoriani; ti atua ilo Obo Osinya le Israel ilo iyie ang'ida.

English: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
Masaai: Te neing'oru lelo aisinak enkare nelau, netoyu ilng'ejepa lenye te nkure, nawaliki nanu Olaitoriani ninche, ore nanu, Enkai e Israel nemaiturraa ninche.

English: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
Masaai: Kabolu nanu lkejek le nkare too ldoinyo, o nkonyek oo nkariak ti atua ierat; kaisho nanu ong'ata metaa olchorro le nkare, ore enkop natoyio neruko nkariak.

English: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
Masaai: Kaun nanu to lpurkel iltarakua, o ltepes, o oloirienito kaitubulu nanu te nkop natoyio, ilkeek kumok lo supuko,

English: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
Masaai: pee etum iltung'ana aatodol neyiolou, nedamu neyiolou te nebo, nchere enkaina o Laitoriani nataasa ina, ilo Obo Osinya le Israel oitobira ina.

English: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
Masaai: Iyau lomon linono, Olaitoriani ojo; iyau shakenisho ino, Olaiguanani le Yakobo ojo.

English: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye meyau, neliki iyiook ina nalotu aaku, entoliki iyiook mbaa e apa eneikununo pee kitum iyiook aaiguanare ninche, pee kitum iyiook aatayioloito enepukoki ninche, aashu eibalakinye iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu.

English: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
Masaai: Entoliki iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu, pee kiyiolou iyiook nchere irara nkaitin; entaas esidai anaa entorroni pee kimputukuny iyiook nikiureishoyu.

English: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
Masaai: Ng'ura, mira iyie toki, naa pesho esiaai ino; naa olminong nikitegelua iyie.

English: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
Masaai: Atuputuo nanu ilo obo te nkalo e moikuape, neewuo ninye, eewuo ninye eing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, naa kelotu ninye aipot enkarna ai; naa kelotu ninye aituny lelo aitoriak anaa esarng'ab, anaa enaipurj olaitobirani loo motioo oo nkulupuok e sarng'ab.

English: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
Masaai: Kaing'ae apa oibalunye te dukuya, pee kitum iyiook aatayiolo, nelimu eng'or enkata, pee kitum iyiook aatejo, “Etisipa ninye”? Metii apa hoo obo oibalunye ina meetae olotolimuo, meetae olotoning'o irorei linono.

English: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
Masaai: Atang'asa apa nanu aibalakinye Sion, naisho nanu Yerusalem olkilikuai loo lomon supati.

English: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
Masaai: Kake te naing'orisho nanu metii hoo obo, ore atua kulo metii olaikooni, laa te naikilikuanisho newalu.

English: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
Masaai: Ng'ura, pesho kuna pooki, naa pesho esiaai enye; ore nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin naatosholuaki naa enkijape e pesho.

English: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
Masaai: Ng'ura osinka lai laitagol nanu, ilo gelunoti lai, oshipakino oltau lai; atipika nanu enkiyang'et ai shumata ninye, naa kelo ninye aiguanaki iloshon too sipat.

English: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
Masaai: Meishir ninye nemebuaku, aashu ening'i ninye too nkoitoi.

English: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
Masaai: Megil ninye entiyani naiperre nemekut aar oltaa oiliilayie; keyau ninye aitobiru enkiguana nasipa.

English: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
Masaai: Melaikino ninye ae toki nemepalari o metaba anaa neibulunye esipata enkop; ore loo manaa le naiposha neanyu enkitanapata enye.

English: Thus saith God the LORD, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
Masaai: Nji ejo Enkai, Olaitoriani, ilo oitayio shumata neisalaash, ilo olak enkop aitorioo o pooki naimu ninye, ilo oisho enkiyang'et lelo tung'ana ootii oriong enkop, neisho enkishui lelo oopuo ti oriong enkop.

English: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
Masaai: “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, aaipoto nanu iyie te supatisho, aaibung'a nanu iyie enkaina naagolie; aaishorua nanu iyie taa olning'o too loreren, ore te iyie naa kayaki nanu ewang'an iloshon,

English: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
Masaai: ilo aitodolisho ilmodook, nilo alaaya lelo ooena te naimin, nintayu ilooena aitung'uaa olgilata liatua korokoroni nintayu te korokoroni lelo ootoni tiatua enaimin.

English: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina enkarna ai, ore enkitoo ai nemaisho nanu likae, nemaisho enkisisa ai nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuno.

English: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
Masaai: Ng'ura, etulusoitie ntokitin e apa, naa kaibalunye taata nanu ntokitin ng'ejuko; ore eton eitu eipang'u aaliooyu naa kaaliki nanu ninche.”

English: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani osinkolio ng'ejuk, nchoo enkisisa enye eimu ilubot e nkop! Nchoo eikurrukur enaiposha, o nena naabore atua, o loo manaa le naiposha o lelo oomanya ninche.

English: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
Masaai: Nchoo nkop natoyio o nkanas enye eilepunye iltoiloishi lenye, o nena ang'itie naamanya Kedar; nchoo lelo oomanya Sela eranyisho te ng'ida, nchoo ninche ebuaku too nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: Let them give glory unto the LORD, and declare his praise in the islands.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eisho Olaitoriani enkitoo, neibalunye enkisisa enye too loomanaa le naiposha.

English: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
Masaai: Kelo Olaitoriani anaa oltung'ani magilani, nepush anaa oltung'ani lo larrabal; neyietu aishir, nebuaku, neitoduaaya kewan ajo ai magilani alang ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
Masaai: Ore te nkata naado natigire nanu, aitirring'e nanu naibooyo kewan, ore taata kaishir nanu anaa enkitok nasaisai, kaipang'ipang nanu naiyiogiyiog.

English: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
Masaai: Kaitomijoon nanu ildoinyo o ndoinyo, naitoi nanu nkujit o lkeek; naitaa nanu ilkejek enkop natoyio, naitoi ilchorroi.

English: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
Masaai: Nalo nanu arikoo lelo modook te ina oitoi apa neitu eyiolou ninche, aimie atua ina oitoi nemeyiolo ninche karikoo nanu ninche. Kaibelekeny nanu ina aimin natii dukuya ninche aitaa ewang'an, naisiajayie iwuejitin neesur. Kuna baa nanu aas, nemalo nanu aing'uaa ninche.

English: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
Masaai: Kerrinyuni ninche neitukurruni katukul, lelo ooisilig nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naaguetuni, lelo oojoki nkitanyaanyukot naasholuni, “Irara intae nkaitin ang.”

English: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
Masaai: Entoning intae ilming'anta, ning'oring'oro intae ilmodook, pee itumutumu aatodolisho!

English: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD'S servant?
Masaai: Kalo modooni leme ilo sinka lai, aashu kalo ming'ani anaa ol kipaaret lairriwaa nanu?

English: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
Masaai: Kedol ninye ntokitin kumok kake mesipu; nebolo nkiyiaa enyena kake mening'isho ninye.

English: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness' sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
Masaai: Eitiship apa Olaitoriani, te nkaraki esupatisho enye makewan, pee eibalunye enkitanapata enye neitaa kitok.

English: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
Masaai: Kake iltung'ana kulo ootupurroyioki nerayae, etarreshoki ninche pooki too ngumot neisudori ti atua korokoroni; meeta ninche oltung'ani okordu ninche, nemeetae ololo arrinyu ninche?

English: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
Masaai: Kalo te intae olo aning ena, nelo ajing ine ainining'isho te nkaraki ina kata nayooki alotu.

English: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
Masaai: Kaing'ae apa oishooyie Yakobo meibung'i aaya, neisho Israel ilapurrok? Aime Olaitoriani, laa te ninye kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, laa nkoitoi enyena etanyaita ninche, ore nkitanapat enyena neitu ninche eiruk?

English: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
Masaai: Neaku etubukoko shumata ninye engoro enye, o larrabal kitok; nepik ninye enkima aitaman kake eitu ninye emuso ayiolou; nepej ina kima ninye, kake eitu edamu to ltau lenye.

English: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
Masaai: Kake ore taata nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo likintayio iyie Yakobo, ilo likintobirua Israel: “Miureishoyu amu aatokordua nanu iyie, Aaipotuo nanu iyie te nkarna ai, ira iyie olalai.

English: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
Masaai: Tinilo iyie aim atua nkariak, naaku nanu te nebo iyie; naa ti nilang ilkejek nimikiya ninche; naa ti nilo iyie aim atua enkima nimikipej iyie, nimikinos iyie olng'ejep le nkima

English: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, Ilo Sinyati le Israel, Olaitajeunoni lino. Aishorua nanu Misiri pee kinyang'unyeki iyie, naishooyo Etiopia o Seba pee aawalunye iyie.

English: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nira iyie kirotet too nkonyek aainei, nikiyanyitaki, naatonyorra nanu, aishooyie nanu iloreren pee aawalunye iyie, aishooyie ilororen awalu enkishui ino.

English: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
Masaai: Miureishoyu, amu atii nanu te nebo iyie; kayau nanu eishoi ino aitung'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, nalo aiturrur intae te nkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
Masaai: kalo nanu ajoki ina kop e moikuape, nchoru, najoki kopikop, mimbooyo iyie; ilayiok laainei ooing'uaa enelakua o nena toyie aainei naaing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop,

English: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ake ninye oipotieki enkarna ai, ilo oitayioki te nkaraki enkitoo ai, ilo laitobirua nanu naitaa.

English: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
Masaai: Iyau lelo tung'ana modook hoo neeta nkonyek, lelo ming'an hoo neta nkiyiaa!

English: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
Masaai: Nchoo loreren pooki eiturrurro te nebo, naa iloreren euma te nebo. Kalo tiatua ninche oidim aibalunye ena, neitodol iyiook mbaa e apa? Nchoo ninche eyau enchakenisho enye pee eitisip kuna, naa nchoo ninche ening nejo, Ee ekesipa.

English: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
Masaai: “Irara intae ilchakenini laainei,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Nirara ilo sinka lai lategelua nanu, pee kitumutumu aatayiolo nikirukuruku nanu, niyiolouu nchere nanu ilo. Ore apa te dukuya nanu meetae ae ai naitobiruaki, nemeetae enaitokini aata te siadi nanu.

English: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani, nemeetae likae Aitajeunoni leme nanu.

English: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD, that I am God.
Masaai: Aibalie apa nanu, naitajeu, nalimu, ina kata metii Enkai omoni atua intae, nirara intae ilchakenini laainei,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
Masaai: “Ara nanu Enkai, naa neijia etiu o akenya Nanu ilo; Meetae oloidim atokordu te nkaina ai; kaasisho nanu, naa kaing'ae oidim aibooi ina siai?”

English: Thus saith the LORD, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo okordu intae, ilo Sinyati le Israel, “Ore te nkaraki intae, kairriwaa nanu olkilikuai Babilon, meshomo agil nchomito pooki, ore ina buakunoto oo Lkaldayo, neibelekenyi aaitaa enkishirata.

English: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani, ilo Sinyati linyi, ilo Aitobirani le Israel, Aiguanani linyi.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oitobir enkoitoi ti atua enaiposha, nepik enkoitoi atua nkariak kumok,

English: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
Masaai: ilo oyau ngarrin o mbartan, o lakedok o enjore; neirragie te nkop, nemeitoki aadumunye, neiliilaa ninche anaa oltaa:

English: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
Masaai: “Mintoki adamu mbaa e apa, niminguanare mbaa musan.

English: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aasita nanu embae ng'ejuk, egira taata ninye ailepu, aimimusu iyie? Kaitobir nanu enkoitoi ti ong'ata, napik ilkejek olpurkel.

English: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
Masaai: Ore ng'uesi e ntim naayanyitu ninche nanu, mbariak o sidan; enkaraki naisho nanu ninche enkare ti ong'ata, napik ilkejek olpurkel, pee aisho nanu lelo gelunot laainei eneokishore,

English: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
Masaai: lelo tung'ana apa laitobiraka kewan, pee etum ninche aaibalunye enkisisa ai.

English: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
Masaai: “Ore ake eyia, eitu iyie kimpot nanu Yakobo; kake inaure iyie ti alo nanu, Israel!

English: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
Masaai: Eitu iyie kiyaki nkerra inono o lasar opejori, neitu kiyanyitu nanu too lasarri linono. Eitu nanu aaek too lasarri, anaa aaitanaur te nkorropil.

English: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
Masaai: Eitu iyie kinyang'aki nanu enkorropil too mpisai, neitu kintaraposh eilata oo lasarri linono. Kake kiteeka iyie too ng'ok inono, kintanaura iyie nanu te nkarruoisho ino.

English: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
Masaai: “Nanu ilo ojutoo nkitarruorot inono, te nkaraki kewan ai, nemaitoki nanu adamu ng'ok inono.

English: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
Masaai: Tipikaki nanu ndamunot, maishankarrata iyiook te nebo; iyau enkiguana ino, pee kitumi aaitisipa nchere iata esipata.

English: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
Masaai: Etaasa apa papaai lino le dukuya eng'oki, ore lelo aitutumok linono naatapaashare nanu.

English: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, aisarkionie nanu lelo kituaak le wueji sinyati, ayaua nanu Yakobo enkidaata naitaa Israel oldeket.

English: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
Masaai: “Kake ore taata toning'o, iyie Yakobo lo sinka lai, Israel laa iyie ategelua!

English: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani ilo likintobira, ilo likintobirua te nkoshoke e ng'utunyi naa ninye likilo aret. Miureishoyu iyie, Yakobo lo sinka lai, Yeshurun laa iyie ategelua.

English: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
Masaai: Amu kabukoki nanu enkare ina kop e nkure, napik nkonyek oo nkariak ina kop natoyio; kabukoki nanu Enkiyang'et ai shumata eishoi inyi, nabukoki imayianat aainei eishoi inyi.

English: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
Masaai: Kebulu ninche anaa nkujit naatii atua enkare, anaa iseyia oobulu too reyieta naaruko

English: One shall say, I am the LORD'S; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
Masaai: Nejo ake oltung'ani, ‘Ara nanu olo Laitoriani,’ ore olikae neipotie kewan enkarna e Yakobo, ore olikae neiger te nkaina enye ajo, ‘Olo Laitoriani,’ nedung'oki kewan enkarna metaa keji Israel.”

English: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo aiguanani le Israel naa ninye Olakordunoni lenye, Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ara nanu ole dukuya nara ole nkiting'oto, meetae ae Ai neme nanu.

English: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
Masaai: Kalo otiu anaa nanu? Nchoo ninye elimu aibalunye, nchoo ninye meibalunye neitodolu te dukuya nanu. Kaing'ae apa otolimuo aibalunye mbaa naapuonu? nchoo ninche eliki iyiook mbaa naayooki aapuonu.

English: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
Masaai: Miureishoyu nimimputukuny; keitu apa nanu aliki intae aibalakinye? Nirara intae ilchakenini laainei! keetae ae ai neme nanu? Meetae likae ora endapidapoi; mayiolo nanu likae.”

English: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
Masaai: Pesho lelo pooki apa ooitobira nkitanyaanyukot, ore nena tokitin naang'idare ninche nemeret ninche. Ore ilchakenini lenye nemedolisho nemeyiolo, pee etumi aaitukurru ninche.

English: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
Masaai: Aing'ae oitobiru nkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot nemeret hoo toki?

English: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore lelo tung'ana lenyena pooki naa keitukurruni. Ore lelo aguetak arriyiak naa iltung'ana ake; nchoo ninche pooki esoto, nchoo ninche eitashe, kepuo ninche pooki aairut, kepuoi aaitukurru ninche te nebo.

English: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
Masaai: Eidong'u olkunoni ninye neitobiru te nchumata oo nkuk, neitobiru too sekenke oo idong'ishoreki, neriu ninye te ina aina enye nagol; netir ninye esumash neishunye engolon enye, naa te nelau enkare naok neiterre.

English: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
Masaai: Eitorioo olaguetani olkereri, nesir te nkalamu; neitobiru ina naguetu too ntokitin naaguetishoreki, nesir te ntoki naipimishoreki neitobiru entoki naikununo anaa oltung'ani, nepik enkishiaa e tung'ani, pee etum atipika enkaji enye.

English: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
Masaai: Nedung ninye iltarakua; anaa egelu ilkulikae keek, neisho ninche metubulu ti atua ilkeek le ntim, neun ninye iltarakua neitubulu enchan.

English: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
Masaai: Neitoki aaku ilkeek le enkima, neya oltung'ani embata nelo aij, neinok ninye ina kima nepej emukate, neitoki sii aitobiru enkai te ilo shata neserem ninye. Neitobiru ninye enkitanyaanyukoto enkai neserem ninye, neitobiru ninye enkitanyaanyukoto e nkainagueta nebatata te dukuya ninye.

English: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
Masaai: Ore olpisiai lenye nepejoo ninye te nkima, ore to likae pisiai neinosie ninche nkiri. Nepej nkiri neraposho; neij sii enkima neitoki ajo, “Ee, airowuaja nanu, atoduaa nanu enkima!”

English: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
Masaai: Ore enkae rubata pooki neitobirunye ninye enkae, ina kitanyaanyukoto enye, nebatatakino ninye ina kitanyaanyukoto aserem. Neomon ninye ina kitanyaanyukoto ejo, “Tokorduaki nanu, amu ira iyie enkai ai!

English: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
Masaai: Meyiolo ninche nememuso; amu eikeno Olaitoriani nkonyek enye, pee medolisho ninche, o ndamunot enye pee meyiolou ninche.

English: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo oshilaa, aashu olojurru ayiolou nemusu ajo, “Etapejoki olpisiai lenye te nkima, atapejo sii imukateni too nkuk enyena, natapejie nanu nkiri nainosa ninche. Paa amaa lelo ootelekutua, kaitaa nanu entoki olminong? Kabatata nanu te dukuya osototi loo lkeek?

English: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
Masaai: Nkuruon einos ninye; ore ina ng'eno enye nemelulung'a neitapong'oyie ninye, nemeidim ninye aitayu kewan anaa atejo, “Ae metii elejare enkaina ai e tatene?”

English: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
Masaai: Tadamu kuna tokitin, iyie Yakobo, o Israel, amu ira iyie osinka lai; aaitobira iyie, ira iyie osinka lai Oo Israel, maarikino aikata nanu iyie.

English: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
Masaai: Atikinyayie nanu nkitarruorot inono anaa enkatampoi, aishie ing'ok inono anaa enkinuku; torrinyunye wou enatii nanu, amu aatokordua nanu iyie.

English: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
Masaai: Taranyisho, iyie shumata, amu etaasa Olaitoriani ina; Entabuaku intae ineegut e nkop; entang'amai entaranyisho intae ildoinyo, o iyie natim o pooki shani otii atua! Amu etokordua Olaitoriani Yakobo, naa kepuoi aaitaa ninye kitok te Israel.

English: Thus saith the LORD, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo likikordu iyie, laa ninye apa likintobirua te nkoshoke e yieyioo lino: “Ara nanu Olaitoriani, ilo oitobira ntokitin pooki, ilo apa oisalaasha keper openy, ilo oisalaasha enkop - Kaing'ae apa otii te nebo nanu? -

English: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
Masaai: ilo oibooyo enaibon oo laimonkok, neitaa iloibonok le lejare; ilo oibelekenyu ilang'eni arrinyu, neitaa ina ng'eno enye emodai;

English: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
Masaai: ilo oun ororei lo sinka lenye, neitabaya enkiguana oo lkipaareta lenyena; ilo ojo ti alo Yerusalem, ‘Kepuoi aamany ninye,’ nejo ti alo nkanas e Yuda, ‘Kepuoi aashet ninche, naitasheyie nanu ineeturori apa’;

English: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
Masaai: ilo ojoki ewueji negut, ‘Toyio, kaitoi nanu ilkejek linono’;

English: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
Masaai: ilo ojoki Sairos, ‘Olchekut lai ninye, naa keitabaya ninye eyieunoto ai’; ejo ti alo Yerusalem, ‘Kepuoi aashet,’ ore ti alo ina aji e Nkai, nejo, ‘Kepuoi aaitamanyu olkitamanyunoto lino.

English: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
Masaai: Nji etiaka Olaitoriani ilo otubukoko eilata, aput, ilo oji Sairos, ilo laibung'a nanu enkaina enye e tatene, pee elo ninye aitore iloreren te dukuya ninye neoru ilaiguanak imasaa enye, nebol nkutukie oo nkajijik te dukuya ninye pee meitoki nkutukie oo nkajijik aaikeno:

English: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
Masaai: “Kalo nanu te dukuya iyie naitorioo ildoinyio, kagiligil nanu nena shomito o suyai nagiligil nena shomito e sekenkei,

English: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
Masaai: kaalo nanu aisho iyie ilo shumati le naimin o nena naaisudoro, pee itum iyie atayiolo nchere, ee nanu Olaitoriani, ina Ai e Israel, nikimpotuo iyie te nkarna ino.

English: For Jacob my servant's sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki osinka lai Yakobo o Israel ilo gelunoti lai, aaipotu nanu te nkarna ino aaipotu nanu enkarna ino hoo nimikiyiolo iyie.

English: I am the LORD, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani, nemeetae likae, meetae ae Ai neme nanu; aarripito nanu hoo nimikiyiolo iyie nanu,

English: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD, and there is none else.
Masaai: pee etum lelo tung'ana le nkilepunoto e nkolong, o lo loo ntoluo aatayiolo nchere meetae ae Ai neme nanu; nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae.

English: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things.
Masaai: Aitobirua nanu ewang'an naitayu enaimin, nanu oyau emayianata o enkidaata, nanu Olaitoriani oas kuna baa pooki.

English: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.
Masaai: “Tasha iyie shumata, te keper, naa nchoo shumata eshau esupatisho; naa nchoo enkop eng'amaa, pee etum enjeunoto aibulai, naa nchoo eitubulu esupatisho; nanu Olaitoriani oitobirua ina.

English: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
Masaai: “Woi ninye ilo okeshare oloitayio ninye, keishankarrare emoti oo nkulupuok ilo oitobira! Keikilikuan enterit ilo oitobir ajoki, ‘Kainyoo iyie intobirita’? aashu ejoki, ‘Meeta ena toki ino ineeibung'i’?

English: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo ojoki menye, ‘Kainyoo iyie iiu?’ aashu ilo ojoki enkitok, ‘Kainyoo iyie nikintasaisai?’ ”

English: Thus saith the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo Osinya le Israel, ilo oitayio ninye: “Eikinkilikuanishore nanu ti alo nkera aainei, anaa eikisikong nanu ti alo esiaai oo nkaik aainei?

English: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
Masaai: Aitobira nanu enkop, naitayu oltung'ani apik oriong enkop; nkaik aainei apa naaisalaasha shumata, naitaisheiki nanu lelo ororani lenye pooki.

English: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ailepunye nanu ninye te sipata, naa kaitorioo nanu nkoitoi enyena pooki; kelo ninye ashet enkanasa ai ore lelo tung'ana laainei ooena nelaaya meshomo, neme te nkaraki enkishoroto anaa olerrinyore,” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Thus saith the LORD, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore ina arsisisho e Misiri o ina kinyang'a e Etiopia, o lelo tung'ana le Sabean adoru, naa kepuonu enitii neaku linono, nikipuo ninche aasujaa iyie; kepuonu ninche enitii eena too lpisia nikipuonu aairrugokino iyie. Eikipuo ninche aasai iyie ejo, ‘Etii Enkai te nebo iyie ake, meetae ae Ai neme ninye ake.’ ”

English: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
Masaai: Esipa ira iyie Enkai naisudoo kewan, iyie na Ai e Israel, Olaitajeunoni.

English: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
Masaai: Eitukurruaki ninche pooki netusulaki, ore lelo aitobirak loo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nepuo to lmilo te nebo.

English: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
Masaai: Kake eitajeuo Olaitoriani Israel, te njeunoto oo ntarasi; mikintukurruni iyie nimikisuli o akenya.

English: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD; and there is none else.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oitobira shumata (ninye Enkai!), ilo oitobirua enkop neitayu (ninye oitotona; eitu ninye eitobir olmuate, eitayio ninye pee emanyi!): “Ara nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae.

English: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
Masaai: Eitu apa nanu airo too nkurrat, ti atua ewueji e misimisi; eitu apa nanu ajoki eishoi e Yakobo, ‘Eng'oruaki to lmuate.’ Airo nanu Olaitoriani esipata, naibalunye ina nasipa.

English: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
Masaai: “Enturrurrunye nipuonunu, entinyiku wootu te nebo, intae lo pisai loo loshon! Meyiolo ninche toki lelo oonap nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye oo nkeek, netoni aaomon ina ai nemeidim aitajeusho.

English: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
Masaai: Iyau lomon linono nimbalunye; nchoo ninche eiguana te nebo! Kaing'ae apa otolimuo ena te musano? kaing'ae apa oibalunye? Aime nanu Olaitoriani? Nemeetae ae Ai neme nanu, Enkai nairo too sipat naa Olaitajeunoni; meetae ae Ai neme nanu.

English: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
Masaai: “Embelekenyata wootu enatii pee eitajeuni intae; intae ilubot pooki e nkop! Amu ara nanu Enkai, nemeetae ae.

English: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
Masaai: Ainosa nanu olmumai te kewan ai, eimua enkutuk ai te sipata ilo rorei lemaaitoki arrinyokino: ‘Ore nanu kaagilakini pooki kung'u, neinos pooki ng'ejep olmumai.’

English: Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
Masaai: “Tiatua Olaitoriani ake, epuoi aajo tialo nanu, isipat o eng'olon. Ore lelo laaiba neitukurruni ninche.

English: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
Masaai: Ore ti atua Olaitoriani kelo ina ishoi pooki e Israel amirisho netum enkitoo.”

English: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
Masaai: Etusulari Beli, neijulujule Nebo, etii nkitanyaanyukot enye shumata ng'uesi o nkishu; ore kuna tokitin ninapinapa naa keiroishi anaa lolan ooek ing'uesi.

English: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
Masaai: Neijulujula ninche, nesulunye te nebo, meidim ninche aataretu ilo ola, kake ore ninye nkorroki enye kepuo eyararoto.

English: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
Masaai: “Toning'oki nanu, na aji e Yakobo, o ele pisiai pooki le nkaji e Israel, apa laatoikioki nanu ebaiki pee eini intae, oowaki apa ebaiki itii nguseti;

English: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
Masaai: ore ninye o te moruao inyi Nanu ake Ilo, ore eiborrita intae lukuny naa kanap intae. Aitobira nanu naa kanap; kaya nanu naa kalo agolie.

English: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
Masaai: “Kaing'ae intae kintanyaanyukiekie nikintorisiokiki, nikidutietie intae pee kinyaanyuku?

English: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
Masaai: Ore lelo oobuku sahabu too lbenia, neineneng enkosholai too ntemet e nkiroishi naa keiger olkunoni, neitayunye nena enkai; paa keitoki aabatata aaserem!

English: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
Masaai: Nedumu ninche ina kitanyaanyukoto aaiteleiki iloilila lenye, nenap ninye, nepuo aapik ewueji enye, neitasheyie te ine, nemeidim ninye ashomo te ine. Naa te neishiraki oltung'ani ninye, nemeidim atawaliki, aashu eitajeu ninye te nyamali enye.

English: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
Masaai: Tadamu ena ninguanare, tadamu nkitarruorot inono,

English: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
Masaai: tadamu inapa baa e apa musan; amu ara Olaitoriani nemeetae likae; ara nanu Olaitoriani nemeetae likae laanyaanyukie,

English: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
Masaai: naibalunye nanu mbaa e nkiting'oto te nkiterunoto o ebaiki apa moitie naibalunye nena neton eitu eaku, ajo, ‘Kelo enkiguana ai aitashe, naa kalo nanu aitabaya iyieunot aainei pooki.’

English: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
Masaai: aipotu ilo motonyi oinosisho te nkalo o loosaen, o ilo tung'ani le nkiguana ai meeu te nkop nalakua. Airoro nanu naa kaitabaya; aiguana nanu naa kaas ina.

English: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
Masaai: “Entoning'oki nanu intae iloogol onyek, intae kulo oo lakuaniki enkordunoto.

English: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
Masaai: Aitataanua nanu enkordunoto ai, meekure elakua, nemeekure eimutie enjeunoto ai; naa kapik nanu enjeunoto atua Sion, te nkaraki Israel ina kitoo ai.”

English: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
Masaai: Tadou iyie totona te nterit na selenkei to e Babilon; totona te nkop metii olorika le nkitoo, naatito oo Lkaldayo! Amu meekure ae kata kingili aajo, enasipa osesen naisikarra

English: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
Masaai: Iwa lelo soito ooyutuutishoreki, ndong'u entapa, iwuang'ie ilo karasha limulumulare, intayu ilo kila lino, ting'ishai too nkejek inono, iima atua lkejek talang'a.

English: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
Masaai: Kepuoi aaibalunye ina masipaisho ino, nepuoi aadol enkurruna ino. Kaitalaku nanu elap, nemaleku oltung'ani.

English: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Ore Ilo okordu iyiook - naa Olaitoriani loo lororani, ninye enkarna enye - ninye Ilo Osinya le Israel.

English: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
Masaai: Totona ntirring'ayu, nilo atua enaimin, na tito oo Lkaldayo; amu mikingili ae kata aajo enkaiguanani oo nkitoriat

English: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
Masaai: Atagorokine apa nanu iltung'ana laainei, aisarkionie nanu enjung'ore ai; aaishorua nanu apik atua nkaik inono, neitu iyie ing'urrie ninche; ore lelo moruak ntanapa iyie olola oiroishi oleng.

English: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
Masaai: Itejo apa iyie, “Kaaku nanu enkaiguanani ntarasi,” ore enkaraki ina eitu iyie ipik kuna baa atua oltau lino, aashu idamu nkiting'ot enye.

English: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
Masaai: Ore naa taata toning'o ena, iyie ena aisikarrani, ena naton eidipakine, ina najo to ltau lino, “Atii nanu, nemetii ae neiijo nanu; maton nanu anaa enkoliai nemeye nkera aainei.”

English: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
Masaai: Eikitum iyie kuna baa pokira, te nkata nabo, te nkolong nabo; ore keeya oo nkera inono o enkoliasho naa eikitum iyie te nkiputakinoto hoo niata iloibonok kumok o engolon kitok oo lasakutok.

English: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
Masaai: Ndipakine apa iyie ti atua entorroni ino, nijo, “maadolita nanu oltung'ani;’ ” ore eng'eno ino o enkarriyiano ino nikintapong'oyie, nijo iyie to ltau lino, “Atii nanu, nemetii likae.”

English: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
Masaai: Kake kelotu entorroni shumata iyie, nemiindim iyie aibooi; kelotu enkidaata shumata iyie, nimindim iyie aitukuoi; nelotu enkidaata enitii nabo kata, neitu aekata idamu.

English: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
Masaai: Ntasho tuunoyu ti atua esakutore ino o lelo oibonok linono kumok, laa ninche itanyamalikia ebaiki kitisho ino; eidimayu pee imirisho, eidimayu pee intureisho.

English: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
Masaai: Inaure iyie te nena kiguanat inyi kumok, nchoo naa ninche eitashe pee kintajeu, lelo oor shumata, ootoni aing'or ilakir, laa ore te nedoli olapa neibonu ina nayooki alotu.

English: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eikununo ninche anaa suut, neinos enkima ninche; meidim ninche aaitajeu ate te ina golon o lng'ejep le nkima. Mme inoshi kuk kuna naaiji, neme enkima nanyikakinoyu!

English: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
Masaai: neijia etiu te iyie ti alo nena baa apa nitanyamalikia, laa ninche apa iyie imbung'are ti atua enkishui ino pooki; kelo ake oltung'ani aim enkoitoi enye; meetae hoo obo likilo aitajeu iyie.

English: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
Masaai: Toning'o ena, na aji e Yakobo, intae ilooipotieki e nkarna e Israel, lelo oora ile ishoi e Yuda; ooinos olmumai te nkarna o Laitoriani, nelimu aaibalunye Enkai e Israel, kake mme te sipata neme te nkitorioroto.

English: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts is his name.
Masaai: Amu ina anasa sinyati ninche eipotie ate, neisiligie ate ina Ai e Israel; Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.

English: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
Masaai: “Ore ntokitin e apa naibalunye apa nanu te musano, neipang'u nena aaimu enkutuk ai naisho nanu metayiolouni; naitoki taa nabo kata aas naitabaya.

English: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
Masaai: Amu ayiolo apa nanu ajo igolong'u iyie, nikigol emurt anaa esekenkei netiu enkomom ino anaa osuyai,

English: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
Masaai: atolimuo apa nanu aibalunye te musano, ore eton eitu ebaya, naaitoning'o iyie aibalakinye, pee milo ake ajo, ‘Enkitanyaanyukoto ai nataasa kuna, ina kitanyaanyukoto ai naguetuni, o ina naipurjuno nayaua kuna.’

English: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
Masaai: “Itoning'o apa iyie; toduaa naa taata kuna pooki; ai milo naa iyie aibalunye? Ore ebaiki ena kata neito idia alo kaaitoning nanu iyie mbaa ng'ejuko, mbaa naaisudoro neitu ae kata iyiolou.

English: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
Masaai: Taata eitobiraki ninche, mme apa; ore apa neitu ae kata iyie ining ninche, pee milo ake ajo, ‘Ng'ura, atayiolo apa nanu.’

English: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata ining, eitu ae kata iyiolou, ore ebaiki apa eitu ae kata ebolokini enkiok ino. Amu atayiolo apa nanu ajo iasisho iyie te nkeleekisho, naa ore ebaiki pee kiini nira iyie oloipotokoki enkiseroto.

English: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
Masaai: “Ore te nkaraki enkarna ai aibooyie engoro ai, ore te nkaraki enkisisa ai aiwuang'ie nanu te iyie, pee maaiwuang'ie nanu iyie.

English: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aatisila nanu iyie, kake mme anaa enkosholai; aatetema nanu iyie to lkokuet loo nkisilisilot.

English: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
Masaai: Te nkaraki kewan ai, te nkaraki kewan ai ake, ataasa nanu ina, amu kaji eiko pee eisarkionieki enkarna ai? Ore enkitoo ai maisho nanu likae.

English: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
Masaai: “Toning'oki nanu, iyie Yakobo, o Israel, apa laipoto nanu iyie! Nanu ilo, nanu ole dukuya, naa nanu ole siadi.

English: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
Masaai: Enkaina ai nairragie olkitamanyunoto le nkop, naa enkaina ai e tatene naisalaasha oloing'ang'e te naipot nanu ninche, neitashe pooki te nebo.

English: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
Masaai: “Enturrurroto intae pooki pee ining'ining'i! Kalo ti atua ninche apa oibalunye kuna baa? Enyor Olaitoriani ninye; naa kelo ninye aas eyieunoto o Laitoriani te Babilon, nelo agilunore lelo Kaldayo.

English: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
Masaai: Nanu, ee, nanu oiroro naipotu ninye, ayaua nanu ninye naa kelo ninye adupoyu te nkoitoi enye.

English: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
Masaai: Entinyikakaki nanu, entoning ena: ore ebaiki apa te nkiterunoto eitu nanu airo too nkisudorot, ore ebaiki ina kata apa naeuo ina aaku, atii apa nanu ine.” Ore taata naairriua nanu Olaitoriani Enkai te nebo Enkiyang'et enye.

English: Thus saith the LORD, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Ilo likikordu iyie, Ilo Osinya le Israel: “Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo likinteng'en iyie tudupoyu, ilo likinkoo iyie te nkoitoi nilo aim.

English: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
Masaai: Oi apa tenaa itoning'o nkitanapat aainei, amu anaata etotiuo eseriani ino anaa olkeju, netiu esupatisho ino anaa lopir le naiposha;

English: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
Masaai: anaata etaba eishoi ino anaa osinyai, ore lelo litoiuo iyie nebayu anaa soito lo sinyai; ore enkarna enye nemeiwuang'ieki ae kata arashu eishieki te dukuya nanu.”

English: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
Masaai: Shomo tung'uai Babilon, isika ilanya Ilkaldayo, mbalunye ena te mbuakunoto e ng'ida, embalunye ena, nchoo elo abaya ina enkiting'oto e nkop; tejo, “Etokordua Olaitoriani osinka lenye Yakobo!”

English: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
Masaai: Eitu apa ninche etum enkure ina kata erikito ninche aimie ilpurkeli; eishoo enkare meturukunye te nkaraki ninche eing'uaa endapidapoi; etoosho ninye endapidapoi nerukunye enkare.

English: There is no peace, saith the LORD, unto the wicked.
Masaai: “Meetae eseriani too ltorrok,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
Masaai: Entoning'oki nanu, intae ilmanien le naiposha, nining'ining'i intae iloreren oo lakua. Aaipotuo apa nanu Olaitoriani atii enkoshoke, ore atii enkoshoke e yieyio neipot ninye enkarna ai.

English: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
Masaai: Eitotiuo ninye enkutuk ai anaa olalem opi, naaisudoo ninye nanu to loip le nkaina enye; aaitaa ninye nanu embae nayopiroki, naapik atua emootian enye aisudoo.

English: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “ira iyie osinka lai, Israel, laa te ninye aitaae nanu kitok.”

English: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD, and my work with my God.
Masaai: Kake atejo nanu, “Aisiaishe pesho, ataasishore nanu engolon ai te pesho o to lng'am; kake ore ake eyia, etii esipata ai te nebo o Laitoriani, ore ole koisiayio lai neeta Enkai ai.

English: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD, and my God shall be my strength.
Masaai: Ore taata nejo Olaitoriani, ilo apa laaitobirua nanu te nkoshoke pee aaku osinka lenye, pee ayau Yakobo arrinyoki ninye, netumi sii aaiturrurroki Israel ninye, amu aayanyitaki nanu too nkonyek o Laitoriani, netaa Enkai ai engolon ai -

English: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
Masaai: ejo ninye, “Kentoki nalelek oleng ena nchere iaku iyie osinka lai, pee idumu iloshon le Yakobo nirrinyu lelo ootelekutua le Israel; kaaisho nanu iyie taa ewang'an too loreren, pee etum enjeunoto ai atabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo okordu Israel naa Ilo Sinyati, ajoki ilo otemenayioki oleng too ltung'ana, ilo oiba oleng iloshon, ilo sinka loo laitoriak: “Kepuo ilaiguanak aadol nedumunye; ore larikok o ninche nepuo aaserem maate, te nkaraki Olaitoriani oisiligayu ninye, Ilo Sinyati obo le Israel, laa ninye likitegelua iyie.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore te nkata e omom aatang'amayie nanu iyie, ore te nkolong e njeunoto aatareto nanu iyie; aatorripo nanu iyie naaishooyo aaitaa olning'o too ltung'ana, pee idumu ena kop, pee ioriki enjung'ore lelo ooliyio;

English: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
Masaai: ijoki lelo ooena, ‘Wootu ene,’ nijoki lelo ootii enaimin, ‘Entalioto.’ Nepuo ninche aadaa too mbat oo nkoitoi, ore nkisiajat pooki naaika neaku endaata enye.

English: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
Masaai: Mepuo ninche aatum esumash o enkure, nemeitoki olkutati anaa enkolong napi aar ninche, amu ore ilo oing'urrie ninche naa ninye olo arikoo ninche, naa too nchorroi oo nkariak erikoo ninche.

English: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
Masaai: Naitaa nanu ildoinyo laainei pooki enkoitoi, ore nena oitoi aainei kituaak naa keilepieki shumata.

English: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kepuonu kulo eing'uaa enelakua, naa ng'ura, eing'uaa kulo moikuape, neing'uaa oloo ntoluo, neing'uaa kulo enkop e Sirini.”

English: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
Masaai: Taranyisho te ng'ida, iyie shumata, nishipayu na kop; entaranyisho intae lo doinyo! Amu eitagolo Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, naa kelo aing'urrie lelo apa ooisilisiloki.

English: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
Masaai: Kake etejo Sion, “Aaiturrayie nanu Olaitoriani, meekure aadamu Olaitoriani lai.”

English: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
Masaai: “Kerikino enkitok enkerai enye nanakita, eji meitoki aing'urrie ina kerai e nkoshoke enye?” Ee keidim atorikinoyu, kake maarikino nanu iyie.

English: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aatisira nanu too ndapi oo nkaik aainei, etii isunta inono anaake dukuya nkonyek aainei.

English: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
Masaai: Etumuruto ilashetak linono lelo apa likitigila, ore apa lelo likitomijoon nikipuo aaing'uaa iyie.

English: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
Masaai: Tushumu nkonyek inono ntamanai ing'orisho; eiturrurrote pooki, nepuonu ninche enitii. Ore anaa enaishu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo iyie aishop ninche pooki anaa emasaai, nienikino ninche anaa enaenikino esiankiki narikori imasaa enyena.

English: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
Masaai: “Esipa ore ilmuateni linyi o wuejitin apa neetomijono, o ina kop inyi apa nainyalaki - naa kepuo aapiriku te lelo oomany; ore apa lelo oo toijoitie intae naa kelamari oleng.

English: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
Masaai: Ore nena kera apa naatoiwuoki te nkata o sina, nepuo sii ninche aajo ining'itoto, ‘Kepirik ene wueji te nanu; ing'urakaki ewueji namany.’

English: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
Masaai: Nilo ajo to ltau lino: ‘Kaing'ae laatoikio nanu kuna? Aatung'uayioki apa aa nanu ake nara olupi, nashomo eyararoto naayae enelakua, kake aing'ae naitubulua kuna? Ng'ura, aatung'uayioki apa aa nanu ake; Kaji naa eimutua kuna?’ ”

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ng'ura, kailepakinye nanu iloshon enkaina ai, nailepakinye olmonekie lai iloreren; neyau ninche ilayiok linyi too lgooitie lenye, ore ntoyie inyi nepuoi aanap too leilila lenye.

English: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
Masaai: Kepuo laiguanak aaku loo papaai linyi ooitubulu intae, ore nkaiguanak enye neaku ninche naaing'or intae aaitoti. Neitabaiki ninche nkomomi enye enkop eirrugokino intae, nemej ina terit oo nkejek inyi. Nilo taa ayiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani; ore lelo laanyu nanu nemeitukurruni.”

English: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
Masaai: Keidimi aawaita entoki naibung'ita ilo ogol, anaa keidimi aawaita ilo oibung'aki otii nkaik e ilo torrono?

English: But thus saith the LORD, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
Masaai: Esipa, Olaitoriani ojo: “Ekeidimi ninye aawaita lelo ooena le ilo ogol, neidimi aatokordu ina naibung'ita ologol, amu kagilunore nanu lelo oogilunore intae; naa kaitajeu nanu nkera inyi.

English: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu lelo ooitorogony intae meinosa nkiri enye maate, nemera eok isargeta lenye anaa ilootooko enaisho oo sabibu. Netum taa pooki toki naishu atayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani, Olaitajeunoni linyi, nara ilo Okordu intae, Ilo Magilani le Yakobo.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, Where is the bill of your mother's divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Koree empalai naarieki enkiyama e ng'utunyi amu ataarayie apa nanu ninye? Anaa kalo te lelo laatakinore esile apa atimiraka intae? Ng'ura, te nkaraki ntorrok inono apa pee kitimiraki iyie, naa te nkaraki engilata ino oo nkitanapat apa pee etaarayioki ng'utunyi.

English: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa, amaa apa pee alotu, keitu ninye ainepu oltung'ani obo? Amaa, pee aipotisho, aimeetae ninye oltung'ani oirukisho? Keitodorropaki enkaina ai eji metaa meidim atokordu likae? Anaa aimaata nanu engolon naitajeunye? Ng'ura, ore te nkisikong'are ai, naitoi nanu enaiposha, naitaa nanu ilkejek e nkop natoyio; neng'ueyu isinkir lenye etalaita enkare, neye te nkure.
