English: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
Masaai: Kaishop nanu oloing'ang'e te misimisi, naitotiu anaa enaishopokoki ilkuniyiani.”

English: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
Masaai: Aaishoo nanu Olaitoriani Enkai olng'ejep te nkaraki lelo ooiteng'eni, pee atum nanu aitagolo to rorei ilo otalepori. Ore anaake tadekenya, naaputu ninye matoning'o te nkiok ai, matoning'o anaa lelo ooiteng'eni.

English: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
Masaai: Etabolo Olaitoriani Enkai enkiok ai, neitu nanu agolong'aki; eitu nanu arrinyo siadi.

English: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
Masaai: Aisho nanu enkoriong lelo ooshisho, naisho isederi lelo laayiet olmunyei; eitu nanu aisudoo enkomom ai pee maasuli anaa aanotakini.

English: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani Enkai laaret nanu; ore enkaraki ina eitu nanu aing'aeng'ae neaku aitirring'e nanu, nayiolo nanu ajo maaitukurruni nanu;

English: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
Masaai: ore ilo laailepie nanu naa ketaana. Kalo laagilunore nanu? Maitasheikinoto te nebo. Kalo olmang'atinta lai? Nchoo ninye aalotu anyikaki.

English: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
Masaai: Ng'ura, Olaitoriani Enkai laaret nanu; kalo laadung'oki nanu enkiguana? Ng'ura, keishunye ninche pooki anaa enkila: keinos ninche olasai.

English: Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.
Masaai: Kalo ti alo intae oure Olaitoriani neiruk oltoilo lo sinka lenye, lelo oopuonu te naimin metii ewang'an, kake ore eyia, neisilig enkarna o Laitoriani neigarakino Enkai enye?

English: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore intae pooki ooinok enkima, lelo ooinok ilkilang'ilang'eta! Ipuopuo te wang'an e nkima inyi, o te lelo kilang'ilang'eta linuaa intae! Ipuopuo intae aatum ena te nkaina ai: ipuopuo intae aairrag to sina le mion.

English: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
Masaai: “Entoning'oki nanu intae ilooing'oru enkordunoto, intae kulo oolilitu Olaitoriani; eng'ura intae ina dapidapoi apa naa ninye etaguetunyeki intae, o ina gumoto oo soito apa natuturunyeki intae.

English: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
Masaai: Eng'ura Abraham papaai linyi o Sara apa natoiuo intae; amu ore apa eton aa nabo aipotuo nanu ninye, namayian nanu ninye naitaa kumok.

English: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
Masaai: Amu kelo Olaitoriani aitagol Sion; nelo aitagol nene wuejitin pooki apa neeinyalaki, neitotiu ilo purkel lenye anaa Eden, netiu ilo purkel anaa enkurma o Laitoriani; keaku eng'ida o enchipai etumi ti atua ninye, o enkishooroto e nashe o ltoilo lo sinkolio.

English: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
Masaai: “Entoning'oki lo tung'ana laainei, nikinchosho nanu enkiok, lo orere lai; amu kelotu enkitanapata naing'uaa enatii, o esupatisho naaku ewang'an too ltung'ana.

English: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
Masaai: kenyiku enkordunoto ai asioku, eeuo enjeunoto ai, naa kelo enkaina ai aitore iloreren, nanu eanyita lelo ootii ilmanien le naiposha, naa enkaina ai eisiligita ninche.

English: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
Masaai: Entudumu nkonyek inyi eng'ura shumata, nirrugogo aaing'or enkop ti abori; amu keish shumata anaa empuruo, neish enkop anaa olkila, ore lelo oomanya ninye naa keye anaa lojong'a; kake keaku enjeunoto ai enoo ntarasi, ore ina kordunoto ai nemeish ae kata.

English: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
Masaai: “Entoning'oki nanu intae ilooyiolo esipata, kulo tung'ana ootii enkitanapata ai iltauja lenye; emiureyu imorot oo ltung'ana, niming'aeng'ae te neinyal intae nesukeny.

English: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
Masaai: Amu keinos ninche olasai anaa nkilani, neinos ninche olkurto anaa ilpapit loo nkerra; kake ore enkordunoto ai naa enoo ntarasi, ore enjeunoto ai naa enoo ishoritin pooki.”

English: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
Masaai: Tudumunye, tudumunye, ntagoluoyu, Na aina o Laitoriani; tudumunye anaa apa, te nena ishoritin e apa moitie. Aime iyie apa otudung'udung'o Rahab aitaa ndung'ot, aime iyie apa otaremo enkukuu?

English: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
Masaai: Aime iyie apa oitoyio enaiposha, nena ariak e ine wueji kitok negut; aime iyie apa oitaa enguton e naiposha enkoitoi, pee etum lelo ootokorduaki aaima?

English: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
Masaai: Naa keshukunye lelo ooinyang'ua Olaitoriani aapuonu Sion eranyisho; kelo eng'ida nemeeta enkiting'oto shumata lukuny enye; kepuo ninche aang'amu eng'ida o enchipai, ore osina o somit nepuo aailanyisho.

English: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
Masaai: “Nanu, nanu ilo oitagol intae ira iyie ng'ae eji metaa iure oltung'ani laa keye, ina kerai e tung'ani naitayioki anaa nkujit,

English: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
Masaai: nikirikino Olaitoriani, Ilo likintobirua, Ilo laa ninye oisalaasha oloing'ang'e nepik olkitamanyunoto le nkop, niureishoyu endama pooki te nkaraki ina engoro napi e ilo oitorogonyisho, ina kata te nelotu ninye amutisho? Koree naa ina goro napi e ilo oitorogonyisho?

English: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibookoki enkop naa kelaari nabo kata; meye ninye nedou alo atua engumoto, nemeishunye ae kata endaa enye.

English: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.
Masaai: Amu ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo oputu enaiposha o metaa keikurrukur ilopir lenyena - Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.

English: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
Masaai: Natipika nanu irorei laainei enkutuk ino, naaisudoo iyie ti atua oloip le nkaina ai, neisalaash oloing'ang'e naitobir olkitamanyunoto le nkop, najoki Sion, ‘Irara intae iltung'ana laainei.’ ”

English: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
Masaai: Tushumunye, tushumunye, ntasho, iyie Yerusalem, iyie anaa ina natookishe te nkaina o Laitoriani te ina kikompe e ngoro enye, iyie enatookishe to lbakuli amera, niyukuyukori

English: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo orikoo ninye ti atua lelo ayiok pooki ooitoiuo; meetae oltung'ani oibung enkaina ti atua lelo ayiok pooki ooitubulua.

English: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
Masaai: Kitijing'a kuna tabo pokira are - kaing'ae likintigir iyie? - eliyio, o enkidaata, o lameyu o lalem; kaing'ae likintagol iyie?

English: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD, the rebuke of thy God.
Masaai: Eiterritia ilayiok linono, eirragaa te dukuya pooki eitoi anaa entarakuet natijing'a orreshet; ebore ninche engoro o Laitoriani, ina kisikong'ata e Nkai ino

English: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, entoning ena, intae kulo ooinosa osina, kulo ootemerate neme te naisho:

English: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani Enkai ino Ilo ogol le ltung'ana lenyena: “Ng'ura, aiwuang'ie nanu te nkaina ino ina kikompe e merai nikiyukuyukie; ina girra e ngoro ai mingil ae kata iyie aok;

English: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
Masaai: naa kalo nanu apik nkaik e lelo aisilisilok linono, lelo apa likitiakita, ‘Irrugoyu pee kitum iyiook aashom’; nintotiu iyie enkoriong ino anaa enkop netiu anaa enkoitoi naaim ninche.”

English: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
Masaai: Tuputunye, tuputunye, ntagoluoyu iyie Sion; nchopo lelo kilani linono sidain, iyie Yerusalem, na anasa sinyati, amu meigil ae kata alotu enitii ilo lememurata o ilo oiduruk.

English: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
Masaai: Mpiripiroi ina terit natii osesen lino, tuputunye; iyie ena naena, Yerusalem; ntololong'a nena keenta naatii emurt ino, iyie ena tito naena e Sion.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Etimiraki apa intae pesho, naa kepuoi sii aakordu intae metii enkinyang'a.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Etang'asa apa iltung'ana laainei aadoyio aapuo Misiri aamany ine, neisomit lelo le Asiria ninche pesho.

English: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
Masaai: Amaa, naa taata kainyoo nanu aata te ine, Olaitoriani ojo, idolita ajo eewaki iltung'ana laainei pesho? Kedar lelo aitoriak lenye, Olaitoriani ojo, ore endama pooki anaake nemenaa ninche enkarna ai.

English: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kepuo iltung'ana laainei aayiolou enkarna ai; ore enkaraki ina akenya te ina olong naapuo ninche aayiolou nanu ilo oirorita; nele nanu.”

English: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
Masaai: Kebaa esidano too nchumat oo ldoinyo nkejek e lelo ooyau ilomon supati, lelo oolimu aaibalunye eseriani, lelo ooyau ilomon supati le seriani, lelo oolimu aaibalunye enjeunoto, lelo oojoki Sion, “Enkai ino naitoreisho.”

English: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.
Masaai: entoning, ilarripok linyi eilepie iltoiloishi lenye, eranyisho ninche te nebo te ng'ida; amu etoduaa ninche too nkonyek ina rrinyunoto o Laitoriani elotu Sion.

English: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
Masaai: Entijing pooki osinkolio te nebo, intae iwuejitin apa neeinyalaki e Yerusalem; amu eitagolo Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, etokordua ninye Yerusalem.

English: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
Masaai: Etudumua Olaitoriani enkaina enye sinyati te dukuya nkonyek oo loshon pooki; naa kedol ineeiting'ie enkop pooki enjeunoto e Nkai ang.

English: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD.
Masaai: Enchom, enchom, empang'a enchom idie, eminyikaki ake entoki nemesinya; empang'a entung'uai ninye, entisinya ate, intae lelo oonapita imasaa o Laitoriani.

English: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
Masaai: Amu mipuopuo intae te nkisarrisar, nimipuopuo te nkisikata, amu Olaitoriani olo te dukuya intae, naa Enkai e Israel naing'or intae te siadi.

English: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelo osinka lai adupoyu, keitaae ninye kitok neilepieki, naa kelo ninye shumata oleng.

English: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
Masaai: Ore anaa enaing'asiate ilkumok te nkaraki ninye - ore elioto enye, neibelekenya, meekure enyaanyukie enkomom o ltung'ani, ore empukunoto neibelekenya arruoyo alang ene tung'ani.

English: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
Masaai: neaku keing'asiayie ninye iloshon kumok; nenuka ilaiguanak nkutukie te nkaraki ninye; amu ore ina neitu elikini ninche naa kepuo aadol, ore ina neitu ae kata ening nepuo aayiolou.

English: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
Masaai: Kaing'ae otonyorrayie ina nikitoning'o? Naa ae te ng'ae etabolokoki enkaina o Laitoriani?

English: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
Masaai: Amu etubulua ninye te dukuya Olaitoriani anaa enkaitubului kiti, o anaa entonai te nkop natoyio; meeta ninye enkishiaa anaa eneing'ori, eji metaa eiking'or iyiook ninye, nemeeta esidano eji metaa eiking'uar.

English: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
Masaai: Etanyaita apa nemenaa iltung'ana ninye, oltung'ani loo sinaitin ninye netamoo osina; ore anaa obo lemeyieu iltung'ana neing'or, netemenayioki, neitu iyiook kishilaa ninye.

English: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
Masaai: Esipa etanapa ninye emion ang nenap isinaitin lang; ore ake eyia nikidol ninye etooshoki, etoosho ninye Enkai, neisilisil.

English: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
Masaai: Kake etipikaki ninye olbae te nkaraki nkitarruorot ang, eitamorroojoki ninye tenkaraki ntorrok ang. shumata ninye etii enkitamioto naa ninye naishiunye iyiook, naa too oshot enyena eishiunyeki iyiook.

English: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
Masaai: Kitiu iyiook pooki anaa nkerra naaimina, kishomo aaidapashari; kimbelekenyakinote oltung'ani ake enkoitoi enye; neiteleikia Olaitoriani shumata ninye entorroni ang pooki.

English: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
Masaai: Eitorogonyaki apa ninye neisilisili, kake eitu ebol enkutuk enye; ore anaa olkuo le ker opuoi aayieng, o anaa enker natii dukuya lelo oodung ilpapit lenyena, mebol enkutuk, neijia sii apa eikuna ninye, eitu ebol enkutuk.

English: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
Masaai: Ore te nkitorogonyata e ndung'okinoto e nkiguana, newaki ninye; naa ore to lporror lenye aing'ae otishilayie, nchere eiwuang'ieki ninye te ina kop e lelo ooishu, etooshoki te nkitarruoroto oo ltung'ana laainei?

English: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
Masaai: Neitobir ninche enkurare enye te nebo lelo arruok etunukayioki ninye te nebo olkarsis, hoo duoo ninye nemeeta entorroni nataasa, neitu ae kata ejo elejare te nkutuk enye.

English: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.
Masaai: Kake eyieunoto apa Olaitoriani pee epik ninye olbae; etipika Olaitoriani ninye osina; neitaa ninye kewan olasar loo ng'ok, nelo adol eishoi enye, neitoodori nkolong'i enyena; kelo eyieunoto o Laitoriani adupoyu te nkaina enye;

English: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
Masaai: kelo ninye adol ilng'anayio le mion o ltau lenye neshipayu; ore te yiolounoto enye ilo osipa, ilo sinka lai, keisho ilkumok meikenakini isipat; naa kenap ninye nkitarruorot enye.

English: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kaoriki ninye erubata te nebo lelo kituaak, neor ninye nena naataaruaki te nebo lelo oogol; enkaraki natubukoko ninye enkishui enye keeya, neikenakini lelo arruok; ore enkaraki ina netanapa ng'ok oo lkumok, neaku oloomonoki lelo aitarruorok.

English: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Taranyisho iyie na olupi, ina neitu eisho; tabuaku taranyisho to ltoilo sapuk, iyie ina neitu ae kata esaisayu! Amu ore nkera e ina apa naiturrayioki naa eikumok aalang ine ina nayama, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
Masaai: Ntalala ewueji o lng'obor lino, nincho lelo karash le manyisho ino elaari; minunuk, ntoodoro nkeenta inono nintagol ncheito inono

English: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
Masaai: Amu eilo iyie aisuaa te tatene o te kedienye, naa kelo eishoi ino aya iloreren nepuo aamany nena anas apa naatung'uayioki.

English: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
Masaai: “Miureishoyu amu mikipuoi aaitukurru; ming'aing'ai amu mikintukurruni; amu mingil ae kata adamu enkurruna e kitisho ino, ore ilo sina lino apa ira enkoliai nimingil ae kata adamu.

English: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
Masaai: Amu Ilo Likintobira iyie ninye olpayian lino, Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye; naa Ilo Sinyati le Israel Olakordunoni lino, naa keji ninye Enkai e nkop pooki.

English: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
Masaai: Amu kimpoto iyie Olaitoriani, itiu anaa enkitok nataarayioki netum osina to ltau, anaa esiankiki naiturrayioki, Enkai ino najo.

English: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
Masaai: Te rishata dorrop apa aaiturrayie nanu, kake to lng'ur kitok aaiturrur nanu.

English: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.
Masaai: Te ngoro nadooyo nanu aisudoyie enkomom ai te iyie, te nkiti rishata, kake te nyorrata oo ntarasi nanu aaing'urrie iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, Ilo akordunoni lino.

English: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
Masaai: “Amu kelo ena atiu anaa nkolong'i e Noa te nanu: ore anaa apa enainosa olmumai nchere meigil nkariak e Noa aapuonu enkop, ainosa sii olmumai nchere maaigil ae kata agorokino, nemaigil ae kata aisikong.

English: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
Masaai: Amu eidim aaidurra ildoinyo, neidimi aaiwuang'ie ildoinyo, kake melo ae kata ina nyorrata ai nauno aing'uaa intae, ore ilo sotua lai le seriani nemeiwuang'ieki, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo oata olng'ur tialo iyie.

English: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
Masaai: “Iyie ena nainosa osina, ena natara olkutati neitu eitagoli, ng'ura, kairragie nanu isoito linono aitobiraki, naitobir ilkitamanyunot linono too ltoto oogol enkinyang'a ooji safira.

English: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
Masaai: Naitobir nanu iltaleta linono too soito oji agate, naitobir nchomito inyi too ltoto ooji almasi, naitobir isunta inono pooki too soito oogol e nkiyang'a.

English: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
Masaai: Ore layiok linono pooki naa Olaitoriani olo aiteng'en, naa kepuo lelo ayiok linono aadupoyu oleng.

English: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
Masaai: Naa kepuoi aaitubul intae te sipata; nipuopuo aalakuaniki olosilisili, amu mintokiki intae aaureishoyu; ore too ntabo, nemenyikaki ninche intae.

English: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
Masaai: Te nedumakino intae likae tung'ani neme nanu eing'uaa ina; ore ilo oba anaa olodumakino intae nebatata te nkaraki intae.

English: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aitobira nanu olkunoni laa ninye okut enkima oo nkuk, neitobiru imasaa o larrabal pee easishoreki. Aitobira sii ilo oitalaku elap pee eidaikie;

English: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: meetae iruparen naitobiraki pee earieki intae naapuo aaku, ore pooki ng'ejep odumakino intae te nkiguana, nintukurrurru. Ena ninye enjung'ore oo sinkan lo Laitoriani naa kailepie nanu ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
Masaai: “Wou pooki ng'ae oata enkure, wootu entook nkariak; wou, iyie ilo lemeeta mpisai inyang'u endaa inosa! Wou, inyang'u enaisho o kule, wou, miata ropiyiani nemetii enkinyang'a.

English: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
Masaai: Kaainyo pee inchang'itie iropiyiani te ina neme endaa? Kaainyo pee inchang'itie ole koisiayio te ina nemeraposhisho? Toning'oki nanu nias ina naajoki, pee itum ina daa sidai aisul, nishipakino nena naapir.

English: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
Masaai: Irrugokoki nanu enkiok nilotu enatii; toning'o pee etum oltau lino atopuaa; pee aitobir nanu te nebo iyie osotua loo ntarasi, ilo sotua lai ouno te nkaraki Daudi.

English: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aitaa apa nanu ninye shakeni too loreren, pee eaku olarikoni o Laitoreisho too loreren.

English: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ipuopuo intae aaipuotu lelo oreren limiyiololo intae, ore lelo oreren lemeyiolo intae nekuetiki intae, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, o Ilo Osinya le Israel, amu eitaa ninye intae olosho kitok.

English: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
Masaai: “Eng'oru Olaitoriani eton etumoyu, empoto ninye eton etaana;

English: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
Masaai: nchoo ilo torrono epaash nkoitoi enyena torrok, ore ilo lemeas isipat nepal ndamunot enyena; nchoo ninye errinyokino Olaitoriani, pee etum Olaitoriani aing'urrie ninye, nchoo errinyokino Enkai ang, amu kepalaki ninye oleng.

English: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore ndamunot aainei neme ndamunot inyi, ore nkoitoi aainei neme nkoitoi inyi, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enalakuaniki keper enkop, neijia etiu nkoitoi aainei elakuaniki nkuninyi, o ndamunot aainei elakuaniki ndamunot inyi.

English: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
Masaai: “Amu ore anaa enadou enchan o enkinuku eing'uaa keper, nemerrinyo kake kepuo aaitashal enkop, neitubulu nkaitubulu, neisho ilanterera lelo oounisho neisho endaa ilo oinos,

English: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
Masaai: neijia sii etiu ilo rorei lai oimu enkutuk ai; maarrinyokino nanu erok, kake kelo aitabaya inaipirie, nelo aitubul ina toki apa nairriwaka.

English: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
Masaai: “Amu mpang'ipang'a intae aapuo te ng'ida, nerikori intae te seriani; ore lelo doinyio o ndoinyio naatii dukuya intae, nebuaku aaranyisho, ore lelo keek pooki li ong'ata neosh nkaik.

English: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
Masaai: Ore erishata nabulu ilkiku naa iltarakua oobulu, ore erishata nabulu endiati naa olchani onyaanyukie olarrashi ore ena to Laitoriani naa kelo aaku entoki nadamuni, olmonekie loo ntarasi lemeiwuang'ieki ae kata.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Embung'a esipata niasiasa nena sidain, amu kelotu enjeunoto ai asieku, ore enkordunoto ai neibalunyeki.

English: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo tung'ani oas ena, o enkerai e tung'ani naibung akurraki, ilo oibung sabato, nemeisarkionie, neibooyo enkaina enye pee meas entorroni ake pooki.”

English: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD, speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
Masaai: Nchoo ilo leeiking'a oeuo aibung'are Olaitoriani ejo, “Esipa kaakepu nanu Olaitoriani too ltung'ana lenyena.” Naa nchoo ake mejo ilo sunash ogelema, “Ng'ura, ara nanu olchani otoyio.”

English: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore lelo sunaishi oogelema ooibung sabato ai, lelo oogelu mbaa naaitiship nanu neibung aakurraki olning'o lai lo sotua,

English: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
Masaai: naa kalo nanu aisho ti atua enkaji ai o ti atua isunta e nkaji ai, entoki nadamunyeki sidai nalang ilayiok o ntoyie; kaisho nanu ninche enkarna oo ntarasi nemeiwuang'ieki ae kata.

English: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
Masaai: “Ore lelo tung'ana leeiking'a oopuonu aaibung'are Olaitoriani, pee esiaai ninye, pee enyorru enkarna o Laitoriani, pee eaku isinkan lenyena, ore pooki ng'ae ooibung sabato, nemeisarkionie ninye, neibung olning'o lai lo sotua akurraki

English: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
Masaai: ore kulo nariku nanu ilo doinyio lai sinyati naisho nanu ninche meting'idata ti atua ina aji ai e nkomono; ore lelo asarri lenye oopejori o nkishorunot enye, naa kepuoi aang'amaa te nchumata ilo perere lai lo lasar; amu kepuoi aajo enkaji ai enkaji enkomono too loreren pooki.

English: The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ilo oiturrur lelo apa ooiturrayioki le Israel, kaigil nanu aiturrur kulikae te nebo lelo ooidipaki aaiturruro.”

English: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
Masaai: Na ng'uesi kuna pooki e ong'ata wootu enosa - o intae na ng'uesi e ntim pooki.

English: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
Masaai: Aimodook ilarripok lenyena naa ilmoda pooki; ildiein oomoda ninche pooki, meidim aatabuak, ooidetidet eirrag oonyor aaimugo.

English: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
Masaai: Eeta lelo diein enkuli kitok, meraposho ae kata ninche. Ore sii lelo shekuti naa kemoda; eibelekenyakinote pooki nkoitoi enye maate, oltung'ani enkoitoi enye nadupore, neijia eikuna pooki.

English: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Wootu”, maatook enaisho, maitaraposho ate enaisho napi; ore taisere naa ketiu anaa ena olong, keaku kitok alus.”

English: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
Masaai: keidak iltung'ana supati nemeetae oltung'ani oshilaa; eiwuang'ieki lelo tung'ana le Nkai aaya, nemetii oltung'ani oyiolo, amu ewaki ilo tung'ani supat aaitung'uaa entorroni,

English: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
Masaai: nejing ninye atua eseriani; neeng'iyeng'a ninche too rruatin enye, lelo oopuo te supatisho.

English: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
Masaai: Kake ore intae, entinyiku wootu ene, intae ilayiok loo lasakutok, eishoi oo looibor onyek o mulayoni.

English: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
Masaai: Kaing'ae ilo linguranienie intae? Kaing'ae ilo libolokiki nkutukie aakueniki, nintarasusu ilng'ejepa? Aimirara intae nkera e nkitarruoroto, eishoi e lejare,

English: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
Masaai: intae lelo oata enkiyupuyup o lng'uarra ti atua lkeek, ti abori pooki shani onyori; intae lelo ooyieng nkera enye too erat, ti abori ndapidapo sapuki?

English: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
Masaai: Atua lelo soito oopuyiapui lo earata ninye erubata ino; ninche, eluata ino; amu ninche iyie itubukoko olasar ooki, iyaua iyie olasar le ntapa. Kaaitiship nanu kuna tokitin?

English: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
Masaai: Shumata oldoinyo oado etii erruat ino, naa ine iyie ilepa alo aitayu olasar.

English: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
Masaai: Ore te njoolata e kutuk aji o ng'apeta e kutuk aji nitipika iyie nkitanyaanyukot inono; amu ore kitung'uaitie, niwuang'ie ilkarash loo ndapashi inyi, nikedikede intae nena rruatin dapashi; nipuopuo intae aainyang'a maate o ninche, nitonyorra intae ina dapash enye, ning'ura intae ina masipaisho.

English: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
Masaai: Itudumunye iyie alo Molek iata eilata niponaa iyie enkorropil ino, nirriwaa iyie olkilikuai lino enelakua, nirriwaa enelakua omeshomo enemeneng'a.

English: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
Masaai: Iteekenye iyie te nkadoro e lototo ino, kake eitu iyie ijo, “Metii osiligi”; inoto iyie enkishui ng'ejuk nikinyaaka aitagol, neaku eitu iyie nterre.

English: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
Masaai: Kaing'ae apa ilo liurere, neaku itelejishe, neitu kidamu nanu, eitu ninye kipik ndamunot? Keitu nanu ang'iri ena kata pooki, neitu ake kiureyu nanu?

English: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
Masaai: Kalikioo isipat inono o yasat inono, kake mikiret.

English: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
Masaai: Ti ninchir iyie, nchoo ilo sototi lino loo nkitanyaanyukot mikitokordu! Kenap ninche osiuo aya, keya ninche enkiyang'et. Kake ore oloisudori ti atua nanu naa kelo aya ina kop, nelo ajung ilodoinyo lai sinyati.

English: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
Masaai: Naa kepuoi kenya aajo, “Teshetu, teshetu, ntobira enkoitoi, iwuang'ie pooki toki naikobisho te nkoitoi oo ltung'ana laainei.”

English: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo ilo otii shumata osinya, enye Sinyati: “Aamanya nanu ewueji e shumata sinyati te nebo ilo oata oltau supat obor, pee etum aitopiu enkiyang'et e ilo obor, neitopiu oltau le ilo supat nebor.

English: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
Masaai: Amu magilunore nanu ninche ntarasi, nemagorokino nanu ninche anaake; amu nanu eimu enkiyang'et, naitobira nanu ina kiyang'et e nkishui.

English: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
Masaai: Te nkaraki eng'oki enye o lorok apa atagore nanu, atoosho nanu ninye, naisudoo enkomom ai nagoro, kake eshomo ninye siadi aitalaaya too nkoitoi o ltau lenye makewan.

English: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu nkoitoi enyena, kake kaishiunye nanu ninye; karikoo nanu ninye naitagol ninye, naitigir lelo ooishir.

English: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him.
Masaai: Eseriani to lolakua o to lotaana, Olaitoriani ojo; naa kaishiunye nanu ninye.

English: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
Masaai: Kake etiu ilo torrono anaa enaiposha nailugo, ore enkare enye neilugu isuut o esarng'ab.

English: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
Masaai: Meetae eseriani too larruok, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
Masaai: “Teyietu nchira, nimigira, tabuaku ilepunye oltoilo lino anaa entarumpeta; mbalakinye iltung'ana laainei nkitarruorot enye, mbalakinye enkaji e Yakobo ing'ok enye.

English: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
Masaai: Ore eyia, kaaing'oru ninche anaake, neng'ida ninche te neyiolou nkoitoi aainei, eji netiu anaa olosho oas isupati, leitu epuo aaing'uaa nkiguanat e Nkai enye; kaaikilikuan ninche nkiguanat naasipa, neng'ida ninche etaaniki Enkai.

English: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
Masaai: ‘Kainyoo pee kiteena iyiook ate, aaitupukoo? nimidol iyie. Kainyoo pee kintoborro iyiook ate, neitu iyie ishilaa ina?’ Ng'ura, ore te nkolong e enata ino, ning'oru iyie murruna ino makewan, nintorogony ilaisiaayiak linono pooki.

English: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
Masaai: Ng'ura, iyeniyene intae ate pee itumokiki aailepilepa nintayuyu olarrabal. Ore eenata neeijo ena inyi ena olong, nemeisho iltoiloishi linyi metoning'i te shumata.

English: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD?
Masaai: Kena enata empukuroto ategelua nanu, ina olong naitobor oltung'ani kewan? Ke nkolong nairrug oltung'ani endukuya enye anaa enkujita, neisalaash ilkuniyiani o nkuruon ti abori ninye? Ilo iyie ajo ena eenata e mpukuroto, naa enkolong nang'amaroyu to Laitoriani?

English: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
Masaai: “Aime ena eenata empukoroto nategelua nanu: pee elaari ienat e ntorroni, neitololong'i nkeenta e nchata too murto, ore ilo oitorogonyaki nelaari meshomo, negili pooki shata oo murto?

English: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
Masaai: Aime pee ing'arie endaa ino ilo oisumash, neyau ilo aisinani le meeta ang atua enkaji ino; ore pee idol ilo lemeishopo ninchop, neme pee isudoo kewan te lelo tung'ana leeijo iyie?

English: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.
Masaai: Netum taa ewang'an ino atotiuo anaa enkakenya, ore enkishiunoto ino nelotu asieku; ore esupatisho ino nelo te dukuya ino, ore enkitoo o Laitoriani neaku ninye nikirrip te siadi.

English: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
Masaai: Nimpotisho iyie, nikiwaliki Olaitoriani; ore pee nchir iyie, nejo ninye, Nele nanu. “Tiniwuang'ieng'ie ti atua ate ina shata e murt. o ina utata o lkimojino, o enkiroroto torrono,

English: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:
Masaai: ti nipukokiki intae maate lelo ooisumash, nintaraposhosho eyieunoto e ilo oata osina, netum taa ewang'an inyi ailepu te naimin ore emisimisi inyi netiu anaa enkipirata e nkolong.

English: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
Masaai: Nikirikoo iyie Olaitoriani anaake, nikintaraposh Olaitoriani iyieunot inono too mbaa sidain, neitagol iloik linono, nitiu iyie anaa enkurma natubukokoki enkare, nitiu anaa enchorro e nkare, nemeishunye ae kata.

English: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
Masaai: Ore wuejitin inono apa naaidaikieki nesheti; naa ilo iyie adumu olkitamanyunoto loo ishoritin kumok; nikipuoi aajo olaramani too lusien olaitobirani loo nkoitoi naalala enkanasa.

English: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
Masaai: “Ti nimbelekeny iroruat inono apaash sabato, nipaash isiaitin inono te nkolong ai sinyati, nintaa iyie sabato enkolong e nchipai o enkolong sinyati o Laitoriani nayanyiti; ti niyanyitu iyie ina olong, nimilo too nkoitoi inono makewan, anaa ing'oru enchipai ino makewan, anaa iro mbaa e pesho;

English: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: nitumoki taa atishipakinoyu ina olong o Laitoriani, naaisho nanu iyie shomo too wuejitin e shumata e nkop; naaitoti nanu iyie te ina jung'ore e Yakobo papaai lino, amu enkutuk o Laitoriani nairoro kuna.”

English: Behold, the LORD'S hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
Masaai: Ng'ura, eitu edorropu enkaina o Laitoriani, eji metaa meekure meidim aitajeu, anaa eitoming'anaki enkiok enye, eji metaa meekure ening'isho;

English: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
Masaai: kake entorroni inyi nayaua eoro, te rishata intae o Enkai inyi, naa ng'ok inyi naaisudoitie enkomom enye te intae, o metaa meekure ening intae.

English: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
Masaai: Amu eisarkionieki nkaik inyi to sarge neisarkionieki ilkimojik linyi te ntorroni; eiroro nkutukie inyi elejare, neitobiru ilng'ejepa linyi entorroni.

English: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo olo enkiguana te sipata, meetae ololo aiguana te sipata, osayia le pesho eng'idare ninche, neiro elejare, neipiru ninche esuujisho neyau entorroni.

English: They hatch cockatrice' eggs, and weave the spider's web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
Masaai: Neiu ninche ilmosor le nturbubua neitobiru ninche orreshet te nkaji e surusuri; ore ilo oinos lelo mosor neye, ore ilo mosori odanyi nedanyuni olasurai.

English: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
Masaai: Ore lelo rresheta ooshetu ninche nemeaku inkilani, meimulumul iltung'ana ate te nena naaitobiru ninche. Ore esiai enye naa esiaai e ntorroni, netii nkiasin o larrabal nkaik enye.

English: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
Masaai: Nekuetiki nkejek enye enkarrueisho, neisarisaraki aaibukoo osarge lemeeta entioto; ore ndamunot enye naa ndamunot e nkarruoisho, eliyio o enkidaata naatii nkoitoi enye.

English: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
Masaai: Meyiolo ninche nkoitoi e seriani, nemetii esipata nkoitoi enye; meetae oloim nena oitoi oyiolo eseriani.

English: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kelakuaniki iyiook esipata, nemeinepu ae kata iyiook esupatisho; king'oru iyiook ewang'an, naa ng'ura, enaimin kitum, king'oru ewang'an kake te misimisi kipuo.

English: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
Masaai: Nikirrapirrapu iyiook esuntai kipuo anaa iltung'ana modook, nikirrapirrapisho anaa iltung'ana lemeeta nkonyek; nikirroro dama nikitiu anaa iloopuoito te nkinuku, ore ti atua lelo tung'ana oogol kitotiutuo anaa iltung'ana ootuata.

English: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
Masaai: Kinkurrukur pooki anaa lng'arurum le ntim nikinchir aayietu anaa nturkuluni; niking'oru esipata, kake meetae, niking'oru enjeunoto, kake kelakuaniki iyiook.

English: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
Masaai: Amu etoponari nkitarruorot ang te dukuya iyie, ore ing'ok ang neishakenoki iyiook; ore nena kitarruorot ang netii te nebo iyiook, nikiyiolo iyiook ntorrok ang:

English: In transgressing and lying against the LORD, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
Masaai: kitigila nkitanapat nikiany Olaitoriani, nikimbelekenyate aaing'uaa esujata Enkai ang, kiimaki enkitorogonyare o engolon e nkong'u, nikidamu too ltauja nikiro ilomon le lejare.

English: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
Masaai: Eibelekenyaki esipata, ore esupatisho netalakuana; amu eimina esipata too umat oo ltung'ana, ore enkitoriori nemetumi.

English: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
Masaai: metii esipata, ore ilo oiwuang'a te ntorroni nepik kewan batisho. Etoduaa Olaitoriani ina, neitu eitiship ninye nchere eji meetae esipata.

English: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
Masaai: Etoduaa ninye ajo metii oltung'ani, neing'asia pee edol ajo meetae oltung'ani omitu ilo oitorogonyitae, neaku enkaina enye kewan nayaka ninye enkisulata, ore esipata enye neitasheyie ninye.

English: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
Masaai: Eishopo ninye esipata anaa enkila o lgoo, neishop emaupe e njeunoto ten dukuya enye; neishop ninye ilkilani le lap, neimulumul kewan te mpushuna napi.

English: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
Masaai: Te risioroto oo nkiasin enye elo ninye aitalak ninche, neitalak te ngoro lelo mang'ati lenyena; ore lelo ootii olmanie le naiposha neitalaku te ninche.

English: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aaureyu enkarna o Laitoriani tenkalo o loo ntoluo, neimin enkitoo enye enkilepunoto e nkolong, amu kelotu ninye anaa enkare olkeju nanang'unye

English: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Naa kelotu ninye Sion anaa olalakunoni too lelo le nkaji e Yakobo ooibelekenya aaing'uaa enkitarruoroto, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed's seed, saith the LORD, from henceforth and for ever.
Masaai: “Naa ore ti alo nanu, ele olning'o lai lo sotua o ninche, Olaitoriani ojo. Ore ina kiyang'et ai natii shumata iyie, o lelo rorei laainei latipika nanu enkutuk ino, nemepuku ninche te nkutuk ino, aashu too nkutukie oo nkera inono, Olaitoriani ojo, ebaiki ena kata neito idia alo o ntarasi.”

English: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
Masaai: Tudumunye, tawang'a, amu eeuo ewang'an ino, netudumunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te shumata iyie

English: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kelotu enaimin aiput enkop, neiput enaimin kitok olorere; kake kedumunye Olaitoriani ti alo intae, nedoli enkitoo enye te shumata intae.

English: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
Masaai: Naa kepuonu iloshon ina wang'an inyi, nepuonu ilaiguanak ina kitawang'ata e nkilepunoto inyi.

English: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
Masaai: Tushumu iyie nkonyek inono ntamanai, toduaa; eiturrurrote ninche pooki te nebo, nepuonu enitii; kepuonu ilayiok linono eing'uaa enelakua, naa kenapi ntoyie inono too nkaik.

English: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
Masaai: Ore pee idol iyie ina ning'idayu, neiput oltau lino enchipai, amu ore ina kumoi e naiposha naa eikimbelekenyakini iyie, kelotu ina arsisisho oo loshon enitii.

English: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD.
Masaai: Keiput intae o lorora loo ntamesin, nena tamesin kutiti e Midian o Efa; kepuonu nekua pooki naaing'uaa Sheba. Keyau ninche sahabu o enkorropil, neibalunye ninche enkisisa o Laitoriani.

English: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
Masaai: Ore nena luat pooki oo ntare e Kedar, nikinturrurrokini iyie, ore lelo meregeshi le Neba-iot nikipuo aaisiai iyie; kepuonu ninche eng'amaroyu to lperere lai lo lasar, ore ina aji ai e nkitoo naitaa kitok.

English: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
Masaai: Kakua kulo oopuo tiaai anaa enkatampoi, netiu anaa nturkuluni eim ilusien enye?

English: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
Masaai: Amu kaanyu nanu ilmanien loo naaiposha, ore nena melin e Tarshish neng'as aayau lelo ayiok linyi ooing'uaa enelakua, neyau enkosholai enye o sahabu enye te nebo ninche, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai ino, o te nkaraki Ilo Osinya le Israel, amu kintaa ninye iyie kitok.

English: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
Masaai: Kepuonu iltung'ana leeiking'a aashet isunta inono, nikipuonu ilaiguanak lenye aaisiai iyie; amu ore apa te ngoro ai naatoosho nanu iyie, kake ore te nyorrata ai naaing'urrie nanu iyie.

English: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
Masaai: Keaku kebolo nchomito inono anaake, ore dama o kewarie nemeikeni ninche; pee kitum iltung'ana aayaki iyie ina arsisho oo loshon, eriku ilaiguanak lenye erukunye aapuonu.

English: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo osho o enkitoria nimikisiai iyie neidak; ore lelo oshon naa keidaikieki katukul.

English: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
Masaai: Kelotu ina kitoo e Lebanon enitii, o lelo keek pooki sidain, pee epuonu aapik enkishiaa ene wueji e nkaji ai; ore ene wueji neitasheyie nkejek aainei naitaa kitok.

English: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Ore layiok le lelo apa ooitorogony intae naa kepuonu enitii eirrugo; ore lelo pooki apa oomen intae nepuonu aairrugo too nkejek inyi; naa keipot ninche intae aajo Na anasa o Laitoriani, Sion e Ilo Sinyati le Israel.

English: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
Masaai: Ore kinturrayioki apa nikimbayuni, nemeetae obo oim atua iyie, kaaitaa nanu iyie kitok te nkishiaa ntarasi, eng'ida oo ishoritin pooki.

English: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
Masaai: Ilo iyie anaku kule oo loshon, nilo iyie anak ilki loo laiguanak, naa ilo ayiolou nchere, nanu, Olaitoriani, Olaitajeunoni lino, naa nanu Olalakunoni, Ilo Magilani le Yakobo.

English: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
Masaai: Ore te rishata o suyai naa kayau nanu sahabu, ore te rishata e sekenkei naa kayau nanu enkosholai; ore te rishata e nchata nayau osuyai, ore te rishata oo soito naa esekenkei. Kaitaa nanu lelo aitasheikinok linono eseriani, naitaa lelo likintore te ngolon esupatisho.

English: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
Masaai: Meigili ae kata aaning olarrabal te nkop ino, nemening'i eliyio aashu enkinyala too lpolosien linyi; impotipoto intae isunta inyi aajo Enjeunoto, nijojo nchomito inyi Enkisisa.

English: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata enkolong aaku ewang'an inyi te dama, anaa eaku ewang'an o lapa itum kewarie; kake Olaitoriani olo aaku ewang'an ino oo ntarasi, naa Enkai ino naaku enkitoo ino.

English: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata enkolong adoyio te iyie, nemeigil olapa aaku enaimin, amu Olaitoriani ole aaku ewang'an ino oo ntarasi, ore nkolong'i inono e nkishirata neishieki.

English: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana linono naa keaku pooki supati; naa keya ninche ena kop aaitaa enenye ntarasi, ina aitubului natuuno nanu, ina siaai oo nkaik aainei, pee aatumi aaitaa kitok.

English: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.
Masaai: Ore ilo oti te ninche naa kelo aaku olmarei kitok, ore ilo oti aisul neaku olosho magilani; ara nanu Olaitoriani; ore te nkata enye naa kaitasieku nanu ina.

English: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
Masaai: Etii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani shumata nanu, amu aatubukoko nanu Olaitoriani eilata aput pee ayaki lomon supati lelo aisinak aairriwayie ninye nanu pee alo aruburub lelo ootigilate iltauja, pee aibalunye elakunoto te lelo ooena, o emboloroto te lelo ooikenoro te korokoroni.

English: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
Masaai: Pee aibalunye ajo etabawua olari lo Laitoriani, o enkolong e lap e Nkai ang; pee aitagol lelo pooki ooishir;

English: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
Masaai: pee aisho lelo ooishir ti atua Sion - olmarisian te rishata oo nkuruon, o ina ilata e ng'ida te rishata osina, o olkila le nkisisa te rishata e lepori o ltau; pee etumi aatejo ninche ilkeek le supatisho, ina unore o Laitoriani, pee etumi aaitaa ninye kitok.

English: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aaigil aashet iwuejitin apa neeidaaitie neshetu ninche nene wuejitin apa neetomijoonito, neram ninche nena anas apa naaidaitie, ina mijoonisho oo ishoritin kumok.

English: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
Masaai: Naa keitashe iltung'ana leeiking'a aairrita nkerrai inyi, naa iltung'ana loo loreren oopuo aaku ilaturok linyi o laitobirak loo sabibu;

English: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
Masaai: kake keipoti intae aajo ilapolosak lo Laitoriani, keimaki intae iltung'ana aajo ilaisiaayiak le Nkai ang; ipuopuo intae aainos olkar loo loshon, ore enkarsisisho enye nipuopuo intae aaisikarrare.

English: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
Masaai: Ore te rishata e nkurruna inyi naa itumutumu intae erubata katitin are, ore te rishata e sulare nipuopuo intae aang'idakino ewueji enye; metaa ore ti atua ina kop inyi naa ipuopuo aatum erubata katitin are, nitumutumu eng'ida oo ntarasi.

English: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
Masaai: Amu ore nanu Olaitoriani naa esipata ayieu, kaiba empurrore o enkitarruoroto; kalo nanu aisho ninche elaakinoto nasipa, nalo aitobir osotua loo ntarasi o ninche.

English: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.
Masaai: Ore eishoi enye naa kepuo aayiolou ti atua loshon, neyiolouni nkera enye ti atua iloreren; ore pooki oodol ninche neyiolou ninche. nchere olorere ele otamayiana Olaitoriani.

English: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu oleng ti atua Olaitoriani, keshipa oltau lai ti atua Enkai ai; amu aaishopo ninye nanu to lkila le njeunoto, aaimulumula ninye nanu to lkila le supatisho, anaa oloyamisho te nekus kewan too mporro anaa esiankiki narikori te neikod kewan too masaa enyena sidain.

English: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enaiu enkop nkaitubulu enyena, aashu anaa enaiu enkop nkaitubulu enyena neijia eiko Olaitoriani, Enkai; keitubulu esupatisho o enkisisa, te dukuya iloshon pooki.

English: For Zion's sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki Sion magira nanu, naa ore te nkaraki Yerusalem mayeng'iyeng'a nanu, o metaba anaa neibalayu esipata enye anaa ewang'an, netiu enjeunoto enye anaa oltaa oilang'isho oleng.

English: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
Masaai: Kepuo iloshon aadol ina kilepunoto e sipata, nedol ilaiguanak pooki enkitoo ino, naa eikipuoi aaisho iyie ina arna ng'ejuk, naa enkutuk o Laitoriani naishoru.

English: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
Masaai: Ilo iyie aaku emaupe e nkishiaa te nkaina o Laitoriani, niaku enkishili e nkitoo te nkaina e Nkai ino.

English: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
Masaai: Miking'ili aekata aajo Enaiturrayioki, nemeigili ae kata aajo enkop ino Olmuate; kake keaku eikiji iyie Enatii eng'ida ai atua ninye, naa keji enkop inyi Nayamaki; enkaraki nashipakino Olaitoriani intae, ore enkop inyi neaku keyama.

English: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaayam olmurrani eselenkei, neijia eiko ilayiok linyi keyam intae, ore anaa enang'idakino oloyamisho esiankiki enye, neijia eiko Olaitoriani eng'idakino intae.

English: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
Masaai: Ore shumata sunta inono iyie Yerusalem, atipika nanu ilarripok; endama pooki o enkewarie pooki, nemegira ae kata ninche. Ore intae lelo oodamu Olaitoriani nemiyeng'iyeng'ang'a,

English: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
Masaai: Neminchosho ninye enkiyagata o metaba anaa neitasheyie Yerusalem, neitaa ninye enkisisa te nkop.

English: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te nkaina enye e tatene o te nkaina enye magilani, ejo, “Maaigil nanu aishooyo entapa inyi metaa endaa oo lmang'ati linyi, nemeok iltung'ana leeiking'a ina aisho inyi oo sabibu naa ninye itanaurikitia;

English: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
Masaai: kake ore lelo ooisampu ninche ooinos neisis Enkai, ore lelo oosotu ilng'anayio ninche ook ti atua ilgorien le nkaji ai.”

English: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highways; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
Masaai: Shomo iima, shomo iima nchomito, ntobiraki iltung'ana enkoitoi; ntobira, ntobira enkoitoi kitok, iwuang'ie isoito, tudumu olmonekie metoduaa iloreren.

English: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
Masaai: Ng'ura, eibalunye Olaitoriani aitabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop: Tiaaki ina tito e Sion, “Ng'ura, eewuo enjeunoto ino; ng'ura, eeta ninye olerrinyore lenye te nebo ninye neeta olekoisiayio lenye te dukuya ninye.”

English: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
Masaai: Naa keipoti ninche aajo Iltung'ana sinyat, Ilookorduno lo Laitoriani; naa kepuoi aajo intae Ilooing'oruaki enkanasa neitu eing'uari.

English: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
Masaai: Kalo ele olotu eing'uaa Edom, oishopito ilkilani oonyokie ooing'uaa Bosara, kalo ilo olotu eishopo ilkilani le nkitoo, olotu te nkitoo o te ngolon? “Nanu ilo oibalunye esipata, Olmagilani oitajeusho.”

English: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
Masaai: kainyoo pee enyokioo ilkilani linono, neikununo ilkilani linono anaa ile, ilo olo aim eneironyieki isabibu?

English: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
Masaai: “Aitunyo nanu enkironyet oo sabibu openy, ore too ltung'ana nemetii hoo obo otaa te nebo nanu; naitunyoo nanu ninche te ngoro ai naitame nanu ninche te mpushuna ai; ore ilo sarge lenye neisuakino ilkilani laainei, naidurukie nanu ilkilani laainei pooki.

English: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
Masaai: Amu etii apa ina olong e lap atua oltau lai, ore ilo ari lai le nkordunoto netabaua.

English: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
Masaai: Aing'ura nanu, kake meetae hoo obo laaretu, naing'asia amu meetae hoo obo laatijing'a enkoriong, neaku te nkaina ai ake anoto enkishuroto, naaitasheyie nanu empushuna ai.

English: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
Masaai: Aitunyoyie nanu olorere te ngoro ai, naitemer nanu ninche te ngoro ai napi, nabukoki nanu osarge lenye enkop.”

English: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD, and the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
Masaai: kalimu nanu ina nyorrata o Laitoriani nauno, ina kisisa o Laitoriani, te risioroto e nena pooki naaishoo iyiook Olaitoriani, o ina supatisho kitok te nkaji e Israel, apa naishoo ninye ninche terisioroto o lng'ur lenye, te risioroto e ina kitoo e nyorrataenye.

English: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
Masaai: Amu etejo ninye, Esipa iltung'ana laainei ninche, nkera aainei nemeeta elejare; netaa ninye Olaitajeunoni lenye.

English: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
Masaai: Ore to losilisili lenye pooki, neisilisiloki ninye, naa ilo malaika otii te nebo ninye oitajeuo ninche; te nyorrata enye o to lng'ur lenye eitajeuo ninye ninche; etudumua ninye ninche nenap ninche nkolong'i pooki ti apa.

English: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
Masaai: Kake etogolong'utua ninche nepik osina Enkiyang'et enye sinyati; neaku eibelekenye ninye aaku olmang'atinta lenye, ore ninye openy negilunore ninche.

English: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
Masaai: Neitoki ninye adamu nkolong'i e apa moitie, e Musa ilo sinka lenye. Koree ilo apa oyaua ailepunye te naiposha lelo shekuti loo nkerrai enyena? Koree ilo opik atua ninche enkiyang'et enye sinyati,

English: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
Masaai: ilo oisho ina aina enye e nkitoo meshomo te nkaina e tatene e Musa, ilo apa otooro nkariak te dukuya ninche, pee eitobiraki kewan enkarna oo ntarasi,

English: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
Masaai: kaing'ae otorikoyie ninche aimie ine negut? Anaa embarta naimita olpurkel, eitu apa ninche errorro.

English: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
Masaai: Anaa nkishu naadoyio aapuo oerata, eishoo ninche Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani enkiyeng'iyeng'ata. Neaku itorikoyie apa iyie iltung'ana linono, pee intobiraki kewan enkarna e nkitoo.

English: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
Masaai: ng'ura kop te shumata toduaa, te ine wueji ino e nkitoo nesinya. Koree olokiyo lino o enkidimata ino? Ore eyieunoto ino o lng'ur lino neiboori te nanu.

English: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
Masaai: Amu ira iyie Papa lang, hoo nemeyiolo iyiook Abraham nemelimu iyiook Israel; ore iyie, Lo Aitoriani, ira Papa lang, ore enkarna ino, Olokordu iyiook ebaiki apa moitie.

English: O LORD, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants' sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, kainyoo iyie pee ncho iyiook matapaash nkoitoi inono nintagol iltauja lang metaa mikiure iyie? Torrinyunye te nkaraki isinkan linono, lelo oshon le njung'ore ino.

English: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana linono sinyat netujung'o enkaji ino sinyati te nkiti rishata; neitunyo ilmang'ati lang ina aji ino sinyati.

English: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
Masaai: Kitotiutuo iyiook anaa iltung'ana leitu ae kata ing'as aitore, kitotiutuo anaa iltung'ana lemeipotieki enkarna ino.

English: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
Masaai: Oi naaji tenaa eipolos oloing'ang'e alotu enkop, pee etum ildoinyo aaikirikirata te dukuya iyie -

English: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
Masaai: neikirikira anaa emoti naitokitok pee eibalieki enkarna ino too lmang'ati linono, netum iloreren aikirikirata te dukuya iyie!

English: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
Masaai: Ore apa pee ias iyie mbaa naaitureisho neitu iyiook king'oru, nidou alotu enkop, neikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya iyie.

English: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki apa moitie meetae oltung'ani otoning'o, aashu olotumusuo te nkiok, nemeetae olotoduaa te nkong'u Enkai nikinyaanyukie, naasisho te nkaraki lelo ooisilig ninye.

English: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
Masaai: Intoomon iyie ilo oshipakino easata oo supati, lelo likidamu ninche too nkoitoi inono. Ng'ura, itagore apa iyie, nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki; kitobiko iyiook ti atua ng'ok ang te nkata naado, naaamaa, keitajeuni iyiook?

English: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
Masaai: Kitotiutuo iyiook pooki anaa oltung'ani oiduruk, ore esupatisho ang pooki netotiuo anaa olkila loo lkereu. Kitoito pooki anaa embeneyoi netiu entorroni ang anaa osiuo, nekutaa iyiook aya enelakua.

English: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina meetae hoo obo oipot enkarna ino, meetae oliking'oru aibung'are, amu isudoyie iyie enkomom ino te iyiook, nitanapua iyie iyiook apik enkaina oo nkitarruorot ang.

English: But now, O LORD, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
Masaai: kake ore ake eyia, Olaitoriani ira iyie Papa lang, kira iyiook nkulupuok, nira iyie olaitobirani; kira iyiook pooki esiai oo nkaik inono.

English: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
Masaai: Migorokino iyie iyiook oleng, Olaitoriani, nimidamu nkitarruorot ang ntarasi. Ng'ura, tadamu nchere kira iyiook pooki iltung'ana linono.

English: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
Masaai: Etotiutuo nena anas inono sinyat anaa ong'ata, etotiuo Sion anaa ong'ata, etaa Yerusalem olmuate.

English: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
Masaai: Ore ina aji ang sinyati naa sidai, naa atua ninye apa kisisie loo papa, netapejoioki te nkima, ore nene wuejitin ang pooki sidain neidaa.

English: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O LORD? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
Masaai: Eimbooyo iyie kewan te kuna baa, Olaitoriani? Eigira iyie nintame iyiook aitulus?

English: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
Masaai: Aanyita nanu maaing'oru lelo apa leitu aaikilikuanu nanu, aanyita nanu maanoto lelo apa leitu aaing'oru nanu, atejo nanu, “Nele nanu, nele nanu,” teilo osho apa leitu eipot enkarna ai.

English: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
