Masaai: Aitorioko nanu nkaik aainei endama pooki aipotu olorere kiserut, lelo oopuo te nkoitoi nemesidai, esujaa mbaa enye maate;

English: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
Masaai: iltung'ana laaitagor ninche oas mbususi anaake te dukuya nkonyek aainei, epolosisho ti atua nkurman neinok enkorropil te shumata isoito;

English: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine's flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
Masaai: ilootoni ninche too nkuraren, netoni te nkewarie too lnukat lenye; lelo ooinos nkiri oo lbitiro, ore motori o lminong netii iltooi lenye;

English: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
Masaai: nejo ninche, “Talamari minyiku, mikinyikaki nanu, amu aaiteng'elaki nanu aaitalam iyie.” Empuruo naimu nkumeishin aainei ena, enkima nayupuyup endama pooki.

English: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
Masaai: Ng'ura, eigeroki te dukuya nanu aajo, “Magira nanu, kake kaitalaku nanu, ee, kaitalaku nanu too lgooitie lenye,

English: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
Masaai: te nena kitarruorot enye o too nkitarruorot oo loo menye te nebo, Olaitoriani ojo; enkaraki apa natapejo ninche enkorropil too nchumat oo ndoinyo, naasukeny ninche nanu te nchumata oo ldoinyo, katemaki nanu ilgooitie lenye elaakinoto oo nkitarruorotenye e apa.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants' sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa enatiu enaisho oo sabibu te nkimarrimarrati nejo ninche, Minyal ninye, amu etii emayianata atua ninye’, neijia alo aas te nkaraki osinka lai, nemaidaikie ninche pooki.

English: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
Masaai: Kayau nanu ina ishoi e Yakobo, o ene Yuda, lelo ajung'ok lo ldoinyo lai; lelo gelunot laainei oopuo aajung ine, nepuo lelo sinkan laainei aabik te ine.

English: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
Masaai: kelo Sharon aaku endaata oo nkerra, ore Oerata le Akor neaku ewueji neirragie nchoo, e lelo tung'ana laainei laaing'oru nanu.

English: But ye are they that forsake the LORD, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
Masaai: Kake ore intae iloany Olaitoriani, lelo lemedamu oldoinyo lai sinyati, lelo ooirragie emesa oo mbaa oo nkitumusumusot, nimputuputu nkikompeni e naisho naitushula.

English: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
Masaai: karewaki nanu intae olalem, nipuopuo intae pooki aairrugokino ilo oar intae entuata; amu ore apa pee aipotisho, neitu irukishosho, ore pee airo, neitu ining'ining'i, kake itaasa intae ina torrono too nkonyek aainei, nitegelutua ina nemaaitiship.”

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aadaa, kake ilo iyie aisumashu; ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aaokisho, kake ketir intae enkure; ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aang'idayu, kake kepuoi aaitukurru intae;

English: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
Masaai: ng'ura, kepuo isinkan laainei aaranyisho te ng'ida o ltau, kake ipuopuo intae aaishir te mion o ltau, niyietutu aaishir te nkaraki emion o ltau.

English: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
Masaai: Ning'ueikiki intae enkarna inyi lelo gelunot laainei meitaa oldeket, naa kear intae Olaitoriani Enkai entuata; kake ore lelo sinkan lenyena naa keipot ninye ti ae arna.

English: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
Masaai: neaku ore ilo omayian kewan tena kop, nemayian kewan te Nkai e sipata, ore ilo oinos olmumai te nkop, neinos te Nkai e dede; amu meekure edamuni inyamalitin e apa, neisudoyioki ninche too nkonyek aainei.

English: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kaitobiru nanu oloing'ang'e ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk; nemeitokini aadamu ntokitin e apa musan, nemeitoki aajing ilukuny.

English: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
Masaai: kake tishipayu ning'idayu ntarasi te nkaraki ina naitobiru; amu ng'ura, kaitobiru nanu Yerusalem natii eng'ida, ore lelo tung'ana lenyena neiput enchipai.

English: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
Masaai: kang'idakino nanu Yerusalem, nashipakino iltung'ana laainei; meigili ae kata aaning ti atua ninye oltoilo le nkishirata, anaa olkiyioi lo sina.

English: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
Masaai: Meigil ae kata nkera kutiti aaye ti atua ninye, nemeitokini aata iltung'ana kituaak lemebikoo, amu keaku keye enkerai etaa enoo larin iip, ore olaing'okoni loo larin iip netum oldeket.

English: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
Masaai: keaku keshet ninche nkajijik nemany ninche; neun ilkeek loo lng'anayio neinos ilng'anayio lenye.

English: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
Masaai: Meigil ninche aashetisho nepuonu kulikae aamany; nemeigil ninche aaunisho nepuonu ilkulikae aainos; amu ketiu nkolong'i oo ltung'ana laainei anaa nkolong'i o lchani, naa kepuo lelo gelunot laainei aashipakino te nkata naado ina siai oo nkaik enye.

English: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the LORD, and their offspring with them.
Masaai: mepuo ninche aanauru pesho anaa eiu nkera to sina; amu keaku ninche eishoi e ilo omayiana to Laitoriani, o nkera enye te nebo ninche.

English: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eipotisho ninche nawaliki nanu ninche, ore eton eirorita ninche naning nanu.

English: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kelo olkuoo le ker o osuyiani aadaa te nebo, neinos olng'atuny nkujit anaa olkiteng; neaku enterit endaa o lasurai. Nemeitoki ninche aata batisho anaa einyalisho te ilo doinyo lai sinyati, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Olorika lai le nkitoo keper naa ewueji oo nkejek aainei enkop; kaji eikununo enkaji nikindim ateshetaki nanu kaji eikununo ewueji ai naeng'ieng'are.?

English: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the LORD: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
Masaai: Ore kuna tokitin pooki naa enkaina ai naitobira, metaa nkunaainei kuna tokitin pooki, Olaitoriani ojo. Kake ele tung'ani nanu aing'oru, ilo obor neirridu to ltau lenye, neikirikira eure ororei lai.

English: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog's neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine's blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
Masaai: “Ore ilo oyieng olkiteng nenyaanyukie ilo osesekuan oltung'ani; ore ilo apolos olkuo le ker nenyaanyukie ilo ogil oldia emurt; ore ilo oitarasu olasar le ntapa, nenyaanyukie ilo oitarasu osarge le mbitir; ore ilo oitobir olasar le ndamunoto le nkorropil, nenyaanyukie ilo omayian enkitanyaanyukoto oo nkaitin. Etegelutua kulo nkoitoi enye maate, ore iltauja lenye neshipakino nena baa olminong;

English: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
Masaai: kagelaki sii nanu ninche enkitamioto metadoiki ninche, nayau enkuretisho shumata ninche; amu ore apa pee aipotisho, nemeetae hoo obo oirukishe, ore pee airo nanu nemeetae hoo obo laainining'o, kake etaasa ninche ina torrono too nkonyek aainei, negelu ninche nena nemaaitiship nanu.”

English: Hear the word of the LORD, ye that tremble at his word; your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name's sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
Masaai: entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae lelo ooikirikira te nening ororei lenye: “Etejo lelo alashera linyi ooiba intae, nenang'aki intae auluo te nkaraki enkarna ai, ‘Enchoo meisisi Olaitoriani pee kitum iyiook aatodol eng'ida ino’; kake ninche epuoi aaitukurru.

English: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
Masaai: “Toning'o ina kilepilep te nkanasa! Ilo toilo oing'uaa enkaji e Nkai! Ilo toilo lo Laitoriani, eitalaku elap too lmang'ati lenyena!

English: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
Masaai: “Ore eton eitu esaisayu ninye, neisho; ore eton eitu ebaiki emion ninye neiu ninye enkayioni.

English: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
Masaai: Kaing'ae ae kata otoning'o entoki naikununo nji? Kaing'ae ae kata otodua ntokitin naikununo nji? keidimi aatoiu olosho te nkolong nabo? keidim olosho ataa te nkata nabo? Amu etasaisayia ake Sion nabo kata neiu ilayiok lenyena.

English: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu ninche metoini nemaretu? Olaitoriani ojo, Amaa, nanu ilo oretu kaiken eng'uset? Enkai ino najo.

English: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
Masaai: “Ting'idayu te nebo Yerusalem, nishipa te nkaraki ninye, intae pooki oonyor ninye; tishipayu te nebo ninye te ng'ida, intae lelo pooki ooishiraki ninye;

English: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
Masaai: pee itumutumu aatanak niraposhosho, lelo ki lenyena ooitigirisho; pee itumutumu aatook ishipakinono ina kumoi enkitoo enye.”

English: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura, kaiputaki nanu ninye enkarsisisho anaa olkeju, naiputaki enkarsisisho oo loshon anaa olkeju odooyo enkare; nipuopuo intae aanak, nenapi intae te nkoriong enye, neipoipoi intae too nkejek enyena

English: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore anaa enkerai nailejilej ng'otonye, kaailejilej nanu iyie aiko neijia; eikipuoi aaitigir iyie te Yerusalem.

English: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
Masaai: Ipuopuo intae aadol neng'idayu iltauja linyi; nebulu iloik linyi anaa nkujit; naa kepuoi aayiolou nchere etii enkaina o Laitoriani te nebo isinkan lenyena, ore engoro enye negilunore ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani te nkima, ore ngarrin enyena nepuonu anaa olkutati, pee eitalaku engoro enye te mpijan, neisikong'isho too lng'ejepa le nkima.

English: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.
Masaai: Amu te nkima edung Olaitoriani enkiguana, naa to lalem edung'oki enkiguana pooki tung'ani; ore lelo oar Olaitoriani to lalem naa keaku kumok.

English: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine's flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore lelo ooitukuo neitisiny ate pee etum aashom atua enkurma esujaa ilo otii empolos enye, neinos nkiri oo lbitiro, neinos olming, neinos ilkirrumun, kelotu enkiting'oto enye nabo kata, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
Masaai: “Amu ayiolo nanu isiaitin enye o ndamunot enye, naa kalotu nanu aiturrur iloshon pooki o lng'ejepa; naa kepuonu ninche nedol enkitoo ai,

English: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
Masaai: naa kapik nanu olmonekie atua ninche. Naa ore te ninche naa kairriwaa nanu ilo pisiai oleku meshomo iloreren, meshomo Tarshish o Puti, o Ludi, lelo tung'ana oyietu nkai, nepuo Tubal o Yafan, nepuo iloomanaa le naiposha oolakua, lelo leitu ening enkisisa ai o enkitoo ai ti atua iloshon.

English: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche aayau lelo alashera linyi pooki ooing'uaa loshon pee eaku olasar lo Laitoriani, nepuonu too mbartan, o too ngarrin oo mbartan, o too ngarrin naaimulumula, o nyumpui, o ntamesin ilo doinyo lai sinyati, Yerusalem, Olaitoriani ojo, aaikununye anaa ake duoo Israeli te neyau olasar lenye le ntapa too ngirran nemeiduruk atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore sii ilkulikae lenye, naya aitaa ilapolosak o Lawi, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD, so shall your seed and your name remain.
Masaai: “Amu ore anaa ina keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk nalo nanu aitobiru, nelo atii dukuya nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, neijia elo atiu iishoritin ino, o enkarna ino, kepuo aabikoo.

English: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ebaiki olapa ng'ejuk o metabaiki olikae apa, o ebaiki sabato o metabaiki enkae sabato, kaapuonu iltung'ana pooki aaserem, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
Masaai: “Naa kepuo ninche aaing'oru mpopoki oo ltung'ana apa laatogolong'akita, amu meye aekata olkurui lenye, nemeyagaa enkima enye, naa keaku ninche entoki naitureisho too ltung'ana pooki.

English: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
Masaai: Irorei le Yeremia, olayioni le Hilkia, loo lapolosak apa ootii Anatot tiatua enkop e Benchamen,

English: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.
Masaai: laa ninye eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii too nkolong'i e Yosia olayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda, to lari le tomon ookuni le nkitoria enye.

English: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.
Masaai: Eewuo sii too nkolong'i e Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, ometabaiki enkiting'oto o lari le tomon oobo le Sedekia, olayioni le Yosia olaiguanani le Yuda, ometabaiki ina kata apa naibung'i Yerusalem to lapa le imiet.

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu apa ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo,

English: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
Masaai: “Ore apa eton eitu aaitobiru iyie te ng'uset e yieyioo lino aatayiolo nanu iyie naa ore apa eton eitu kiini naaitisinya nanu iyie; aategelua nanu iyie aitaa oloiboni le Nkai too loreren.”

English: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai! ng'ura, mayiolo nanu airoro amu kara ake olbarnoti.”

English: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.
Masaai: Kake aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Mijo iyie, ‘Kara ake olbarnoti’; amu ore lelo pooki laairriwaki iyie naa ilo. Ore pooki naba anaa enaaitanap iyie naa ilo airo.

English: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Miureyu iyie ninche, amu atii nanu tenebo iyie pee aakordu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.
Masaai: Neitorioo Olaitoriani enkaina enye neiseyie enkutuk ai; naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura atipika nanu irorei laainei atua enkutuk ino.

English: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.
Masaai: Toduaa ajo, aatipika nanu iyie ena olong shumata iloreren o shumata nkitoriat, pee idotu nisulaa, pee inyal nimbelekeny pee ishet niun.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo, “Yeremia, kainyoo idolita?” Najoki nanu, “Adolita olng'osila lo lchani laaijo oseki.”

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki, “Itoduaa iyie aitobiraki, amu arripito nanu ororei lai pee aitabaya ninye.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani, enatii nanu tenkata e are ejo, “Kainyoo idolita?” Najo nanu, “Adolita emoti naitokitok, eing'orita enkalo e moikuape.”

English: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Moikuape eipang'unye entorroni alotu shumata lelo pooki oomanya enkop.”

English: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Amu, ng'ura kaipotu nanu iloshon pooki loo nkitoriat e moikuape, ejo Olaitoriani, naa kepuonu ninche ore ake pooki te ninche nepik olorika lenye le nkitoo tenejing'ieki nchomito e Yerusalem, aaigaraki isunta enyena pooki naamanita neman sii nkanas pooki e Yuda.

English: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.
Masaai: Naa kairo nanu endung'okinoto ai enkiguana tialo ninche, teina torroni enye pooki aatung'uaitie nanu; etapejokito ninche enkorropil kulie aitin, neserem esiaai oo nkaik enye maate.

English: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, terretena empolos ino; tudumunye tiaaki ninche pooki toki naba anaa enaaitanap iyie. Mincho kinture ninche maaiture ake nanu iyie te dukuya ninche.

English: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.
Masaai: Ore nanu, ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu iyie ena olong enkanasa nasheta sunta, eng'ape e sekenkei, o sunta o suyai, pee igilunore enkop pooki, o ilaiguanak le Yuda, o ilkituaak lenyena, o lapolosak lenyena o lelo tung'ana leina kop.

English: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD, to deliver thee.
Masaai: Eikiarare ninche iyie; kake mikimir ninche iyie, amu atii nanu tenebo iyie, ejo Olaitoriani, peyie aakordu iyie.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo,

English: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.
Masaai: “Shomo inosai tening'oto e Yerusalem ena natejo Olaitoriani, adamu nanu eseremata e kitisho ino, enyorrata ino anaa esiankiki narikori, ina kata kisujita nanu tiong'ota, tiatua ina kop neitu eunishoreki.

English: Israel was holiness unto the LORD, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Eisinyati apa Israel to Laitoriani, ilng'anayio le dukuya le nkisampuare enye. Ore pooki ooinosa netum enkitarruorroto; eewuo entorroni shumata ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Hear ye the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:
Masaai: Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani iyie enkaji e Yakobo, olmareita pooki le nkaji e Israel.

English: Thus saith the LORD, What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani: “Kaa torroni enotito loo papaai linyi te nanu pee aashomo aalam nanu, nepuo aasujaa empesho, neaku pesho?

English: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?
Masaai: Eitu ninche ejo, ‘Koree Olaitoriani laa ninye oilepunye iyiook aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri. Laa ninye otorikoyie iyiook tiong'ota, tiatua enkop olpurkel o ngumot, tiatua ina kop olameyu o enaimin nagut, tiatua enkop nemedung hoo ng'ae, nemetii hoo oltung'ani omanya.’

English: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.
Masaai: Nayau nanu intae atua enkop sidai, pee ishipakinono ilng'anayio lenyena o ntokitin enyena sidain. Kake ore pee ipuonunu atua ninturujuju enkop ai, nintaa enjung'ore ai olminong.

English: The priests said not, Where is the LORD? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.
Masaai: Eitu ejo ilapolosak, ‘Koree Olaitoriani?’ Ore kuldo loo nkitanapat neitu aayiolou nanu; aatogolong'akitia nanu ilaitoriak; ore ilo oibonisho neibonisho te Baal, nepuo aasujaa nena tokitin nemeretisho.

English: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD, and with your children's children will I plead.
Masaai: “Metaa eton aatakinore iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, ore nkera oo nkera inono naatakinore.

English: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.
Masaai: Tudung'o shomo olomanaa le Kupro toduaa, arashu irriwaa olkilikuai Kedar metujurru asipu; toduaa tenaa kenotoki ae kata entoki naikununo nji.

English: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
Masaai: Keibelekenya olosho nkaitin enyena, hoo duoo ninye neme nkaitin? Kake eibelekenya iltung'ana laainei enkitoo enye, teina nemeretisho.

English: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Mputukunyo iyie shumata, tena iruto, ingasiayu tukul, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.
Masaai: Amu etaasa iltung'ana laainei ntorrok are: aatung'uaitie nanu, ina ong'u oo nkariak naaishu, neguetaki ate ilmotioo, ilmotioo oodanya lemeidim aatushum enkare.

English: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
Masaai: “Ko rrindik Israel? Kosinka oino liang? Kainyoo naa pee etaa ninye olorreshitoi?

English: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.
Masaai: Eipurrokito ilng'atunyo ninye, eipurrokito aabuaku. Neitaa ninche enkop enye mitil; neidaaitie nkanas enyena, metii iloomanya.

English: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.
Masaai: Ore sii etadanya iltung'ana le Memfis o Tafnhel olmarisian le nkitoo le ndukuya ino.

English: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?
Masaai: Aime kewan iyie iyaka ena te nking'uaroto o Laitoriani Enkai ino, ina kata pee kirikoo ninye te nkoitoi?

English: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?
Masaai: Amaa taata kainyoo dupoto nitum tenilo Misiri, aok nkariak e Nail? Arashu kainyoo dupoto nitum tenilo Asiria, aok nkariak e Farite?

English: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.
Masaai: Entorroni ino nikintame iyie, naa ina kibelekenyata nimbelekenye niking'uanare iyie. Tayiolo nidol nchere entorroni naa kedua te iyie tening'uaa Olatoriani Enkai ino; metii euriata ai atua iyie, Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani ojo.

English: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.
Masaai: “Apa moitie itigila iyie enchata ino emurt nilak ienat inono, nijo iyie ‘Maisiaaisho nanu.’ Ee, te nchumata oldoinyo oado oleng o tiabori olchani onyori oleng irruge iyie anaa emulayoi.

English: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?
Masaai: Ore iyia naatuuno nanu anaa osabibu gelunoti, entipat nadupa tukul kaji naa iyie nkuna pee mbelekenye niaku osabibu liong'ata?

English: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much sope, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore hoo nintukito kewan te munyan niaasishore osabuni sapuk, ore olduruki le ntorroni ino neton etii dukuya nanu, Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

English: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;
Masaai: Kaji iyie inko pee ijo ‘Eitu aaisarkionieki nanu, eitu nanu alo asujaa noo Baal?’ Ng'ura enkoitoi ino to eyarata; tayiolo ina nitaasa itiu iyie anaa entames lipong, naipirri nkaloli pooki,

English: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.
Masaai: esikiria e ong'ata natamoo olpurkel, ore pee eyieu oloing'oni neisugaa osiwuo! Kaing'ae oidim aibooi eng'uarrata enye? Meetae ilooyieu ninye ooinaur ate, ore too lapaitin lenyena neinepu ninye.

English: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.
Masaai: Torripo nkejek inono milo ake miata namuka, olgos lino pee mikitir enkure. Kake itejo iyie, ‘Meetae osiligi, amu atonyorra nanu ilomon, naa ninche nanu asujaa.’

English: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,
Masaai: “Anaa enakurru olapurroni teneibung'i, neijia etiu sii enkaji e Israel keitukurruni: ninche, o laiguanak lenye, o lkituaak lenye o lapolosak lenye, o loibonok lenye.

English: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
Masaai: Ninche ootiaakita olchani, Ira iyie papa lai, nejoki osoit, ‘Kitoiwuo iyie nanu’. Amu aaibelekenyakita ninche enkoriong enye, neitu aaibelekenyaki enkomom. Kake ore tenkata enyamali enye nejo ninche, ‘Tudumunye ntajeu iyiook!’

English: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.
Masaai: Kake koree nkaitin inono nena nintaikia kewan? Nchoo ninche edumunye, tenaa eikindim ninche aaitajeu iyie, tenkata ino enyamali; amu ore eneba nkang'itie inono neijia eba nkaitin inono, iyie Yuda.

English: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Kainyoo pee kilepilepaka iyie nanu? Kitogolong'akitia intae pooki, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.
Masaai: Pesho nanu ataara nkera inono, eitu ninche eitoriori, olalem lino kewan oinosa iloibonok linono anaa olng'atuny otupusha.

English: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD. Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?
Masaai: Naa ore iyie, naishoi ena, toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani. Kataa nanu olpurkel te Israel, arashu enkop e misimisi kitok? Kainyoo naa pee ejo iltung'ana laainei, ‘Kilakuno iyiook, meekure iyiook kingil aapounu enitii?’

English: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.
Masaai: Kerikino entito imasaa enyena, arashu esiankiki narikori ilkilani lenyena? Kake maadamu nanu iltung'ana laainei too nkolong'i nemeikenayu.

English: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.
Masaai: Iyiolo oleng aitobira nkoitoi inono aing'oru sanchan! Neaku ore ninye nkituaak arruok ninteng'en inkoitoi inono.

English: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.
Masaai: Ore olkila lino netii osarge le nkishui e lelo aisinak lemeeta entioto; eitu iyie inepu ninche egilita nkajijik, kake ore etii kuna tokitin pooki

English: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.
Masaai: ijo iyie, ‘Maata nanu entioto; esipa eibelekenye engoro enye te nanu.’ Ng'ura, kaayau nanu iyie enkiguana teina nitejo, ‘Eitu nanu aas eng'oki.’

English: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.
Masaai: Kebaa eleleki nilotie iyie, mbelekeny enkoitoi ino! Eikipik iyie Misiri enkurruna anaa apa enikitipika Asiria enkurruna.

English: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
Masaai: Ninye iyie ilotu aing'uaa etii nkaik inono shumata endukuya ino, amu etanya Olaitoriani lelo laa ninche iyie isilig, nimidupoyu iyie te ninche.

English: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man's, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Amaa tenearaa olee enkitok enye nelo ninye aing'uaa ninye neaku enkitok e likae lee, keitoki ilo apa lee ashukokino ninye? Aimeitarruoo ina enkop oleng? Itaa iyie emulayoi too sanchan kumok naa eikintoki arrinyokino nanu? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.
Masaai: Taraposhu nkonyek inono ingura nena kisiajat naaika eitiaaji eitu kiboitareki iyie? Ore too mbat oo nkoitoi niton aanyu isanchan, anaa e marabui tiong'ota. Intarruoyie enkop ino teina mulayaisho ino.

English: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore's forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eibooki oloirujuruj ore enchan oo nkokua neitu elotu, kake ore eyia eton ake inkununo anaa e mulayioi itanya iyie ikurru.

English: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?
Masaai: Keitu iyie taata kimpot nanu ajo ‘Papa lai, ira iyie olchore le leleroisho ai

English: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
Masaai: kegoro ninye ntarasi, keibung ninye engoro o akenya? Ng'ura iroro iyie, kake itaasa iyie entorroni pooki naba anaa enindim.”

English: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
Masaai: Aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani too nkolong'i o laiguanani Yosia, “Itoduaa iyie ina nataasa ninye, ina nemeisiligayu Israel, ina nashomo ailep shumata endoinyo pooki naika o abori pooki shani onyori, ore teine neas anaa emulayoi?

English: And I said after she had done all these things, Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it.
Masaai: Najo apa nanu, ‘Ore pee eidip ataasa kuna pooki naashukokino nanu kake eitu ninye eshukunye,’ ore ina anashe enye nemeisiligayu Yuda nedol ina.

English: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
Masaai: Etodua nchere ore te nkiborra enye enkong'u nemeeta enkirukoto, Israel, nadung'oki nanu enkiguana eyararoto, ore eyia ore ina anashe enye Yuda nemeisiligayu neitu eureyu, kake eshomo sii ninye aaku emulayoi.

English: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naa kelelek enkiborra enkong'u te ninye, neitarruoyie ninye enkop, aloloito to soit o to lchani.

English: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore eyia te kuna pooki, ore ina anashe enye nemeisiligayu, Yuda, neitu eshukunye enatii nanu to ltau lenye pooki, kake te nkitaakuno, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ore Israel nemeisiligayu neitodolua kewan ajo aikiti enkitarruorroto enye alang Yuda nemeisiligayu.

English: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD, and I will not keep anger for ever.
Masaai: Shomo, ntudupai kulo rorei te nkalo e moikuape, ijo, ‘Tushukunye Israel nemeisiligayu, Olaitoriani ojo. Maaing'or nanu iyie te ngoro, amu kara ololng'ur, Olaitoriani ojo; magoro nanu ntarasi.

English: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Tonyorrai ake duoo iyie enkitarruoroto ino, nchere itogolong'aka Olaitoriani Enkai ino nindapashaa enyorrata ino tiatua ilomon tiabori pooki shani onyori, oina neitu ining oltoilo lai, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:
Masaai: “ ‘Entushukunye, intae nkera nemeeta enkirukoto, Olaitoriani ojo; amu ara nanu olkitok linyi; kaya nanu intae, obo aitung'uaa enkanasa oare aitung'uaa olmarei, nayau nanu intae Sion.

English: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.
Masaai: Naa kaisho nanu intae ilchekuti laaitiship oltau lai, ooitoti intae te ng'eno o te yiolounoto.

English: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD, they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD: neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.
Masaai: Ore ake pee iponariri niakuku kumok teina kop, te nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitoki ninche aajo, “Osanduku lo sotua lo Laitoriani.” Melotu ina damunoto arashu edamuni, arashu eetayieki tipat meitokini aaigil aaitayu.

English: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD, to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.
Masaai: Ore teina kata Yerusalem neaku keji olorika le nkitoo lo Laitoriani, neitururrokino nkuapi pooki ninye, ine netii Olaitoriani te Yerusalem, nemeitoki ae kata aasuj te ngolong'u enye o ltau lenye torrono.

English: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i neibung'are enkaji e Yuda enkaji e Israel, ore tenebo nepounu ninche aaing'uaa enkop e Moikuape aapuonu ina kop apa naishoo nanu loo papaai linyi metujung'o.

English: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
Masaai: “ ‘Atejo apa nanu kebaa ayieu nanu naapik atua ilaiyiok laainei, naaisho iyie enkop sidai, ina jung'ore nalang nkuapi pooki. Najo nanu eikijo iyie papa lai, nimimbelekenyanya te sujata ai.

English: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Esipa ore anaa enaing'uaa enkitok nemeisiligayu olmoruo lenye, neijia sii iyie itotiwuo aaku misiligayu te nanu, iyie na aji e Israel, Olaitoriani ojo.’ ”

English: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.
Masaai: Etoning'oki oltoilo le nena kisiajat naaika, lelo ayiok ooishirita nesaisho le Israel, enkaraki natapong'o ninche enkoitoi enye etorikine ninche Olaitoriani enkai enye.

English: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.
Masaai: Entushukunye intae ilayiok lemeisiligayu kaishiunye nanu ina nimisiligayuyu intae ng'ura kiyetuo iyiook enitii iyie, amu ira iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.
Masaai: Metii eretoto eseremata too nchumat oo ldoinyo esipa atua Olaitoriani enkai ang etii enjeunoto e Israel.

English: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
Masaai: “Kake ore ebaiki leleroisho ang neidaikie ina toki e nkurruna nena pooki naaisiaayutua loo papa, nkerrai enye o nchoo enye, ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye.

English: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Mairraga iyiook tiatua enkurruna ang nchoo esulare ang eitoip iyiook, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki to Laitoriani Enkai ang, iyiook o loo papa, ebaiki kitisho ang ometabaiki ena olong; neitu iyiook kining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD, return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.
Masaai: “Tinirrinyunye iyie, Israel, Olaitoriani ojo, naa nanu irrinyokino. Tiniwuang'ie iyie ilo minong lino, aitung'uaa enatii, nimintoki aing'aing'ai,

English: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.
Masaai: Naa tininya iyie olmumai, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,’ tiatua esipata, tiatua enkitorisiokinoto, o tiatua enkitorioroto, naa kemayian nkuapi ate te ninye, naa te ninye ewuasa ninche.”

English: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.
Masaai: Amu nji ejoki Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem: “Entutur nena kurman inyi nemeturo nimiunishosho tiatua ilkiku.

English: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
Masaai: Entumurataki ate Olaitoriani ewuang'ie isuaaten oo ltauja linyi, intae iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem; mepuku ake engoro ai anaa enkima, neyupuyup nemeeta hoo ng'ae oar, tenkaraki entorroni oo nkiaasin inyi.”

English: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.
Masaai: Embalie tiatua Yuda, nintudupaa tiatua Yerusalem, nijojo, “Toosho entarumpeta tiatua enkop pooki; nchira tabuaku nijo, ‘Enturrurroto, maape iyiook atua nena ang'itie naasheta sunta!’

English: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
Masaai: Tuuno enanka ing'orie enkalo e Sion. Isika ing'oru eseriani, miton ake amu kayau nanu entorroni aitung'uaa enkalo e moikuape o enkidaata kitok.

English: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Eilepa olng'atuny alo to sanag lenye, etii ilo oidakie nkuapi enkoitoi enye eshomo ninye teine wueji enye pee eitaa enkop ino mitil; neidaikieki inkanas inyi metaa meetae olomanya.

English: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.
Masaai: Neaku terretena kewan too lkuniyiani tenkaraki osina nchira niyietu; amu ina goro napi o Laitoriani neitu eibelekenya aing'uaa iyiook.”

English: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.
Masaai: “Ore akenya teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, naa keing'uaa empijan olaiguanani o lkituaak; neiputukuny ilapolosak neing'asia iloibonok.”

English: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa iteleja apa iyie kulo tung'ana o Yerusalem, ijo, ‘Ekesidanu te intae,’ aa olalem otabaikia enkishui enye katukul.”

English: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,
Masaai: Ore akenya teina kata nejokini kulo tung'ana o Yerusalem, “Osiwuo oirowua oing'uaa inkisiajat naaika to lpurkel eing'or enkalo entito oo ltung'ana laainei neme pee ekut arashu esil.

English: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.
Masaai: Ore ilo siwuo olotu te nkitanapata ai naa kegol oleng te nanu. Naa Nanu ilo oiro tendung'okinoto e nkiguana enye.”

English: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.
Masaai: Ng'ura, elotu ninye ailepu anaa nkatampo, neikununo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan anaa olkutati, neneneng mbartan enyena aalang ilkurragoso - oi iyiook, amu kindaaitie!

English: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?
Masaai: Iyie Yerusalem, ntukuoi entorroni to ltau lino, pee kitumi aaitajeu keton akenya endamunoto ino torrono tiatua iyie o anu?

English: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.
Masaai: Amu eibalunye oltoilo oing'uaa Dan neitudupaa entorroni ebaiki oldoinyo le Efraim.

English: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Enkoo iloreren nchere kelotu ninye; embalunye te Yerusalem nchere kepuonu lelo oomuat aaman enkang te nkop nalakua, nebuaaki ninche nkanas e Yuda.

English: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neman ninche Yerusalem anaa larripok le nkurma enkaraki naatanya Yerusalem nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.
Masaai: Ore nkoitoi inono o nkiaasin inono nikintadoikitio iyie ena, entorroni ino makewan ena, naa kedua, etabaikia atua oltau lino kewan.

English: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trump, the alarm of war.
Masaai: Emion ai, emion ai! aainosita emion! oi mbat oltau lai keng'oring'oro oltau lai oleng; maidim nanu atigirayu; amu aning'ito oltoilo le ntarumpeta, oltoilo lo larrabal.

English: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
Masaai: Esujita enkidaata enkidaata ore enkop pooki neirragita metii toki nabo kata einyalaki ilng'oborri laainei ilkarash laainei tenkata nabo.

English: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
Masaai: Kaing'or nanu enanka o anu naning oltoilo le ntarumpeta?

English: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.
Masaai: “Amu kemoda iltung'ana laainei, nemaayiolo ninche nanu; nkera naakilo ninche, meeta ninche ening'unoto. Arriyiak ninche te asata oo ntorrok, kake ore eneiko teneas esidai meyiolo ninche.”

English: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.
Masaai: Aing'ura nanu oriong enkop, naa ng'ura keliyio naa mitil; o shumata, nemeeta ninche ewang'an.

English: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
Masaai: Aing'ura nanu shumata ildoinyo, naa ng'ura, keikirikira ninche, ore ndoinyo pooki nepuo idie o idie.

English: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.
Masaai: Aing'orishe nanu, naa ng'ura, metii apa hoo oltung'ani, ore ntaritik pooki oloing'ang'e neisika.

English: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD, and by his fierce anger.
Masaai: Aing'orishe nanu, naa ng'ura, ore ina kop oo lng'anayio etaa olpurkel, ore nkanas enyena pooki neirragaa eidaa, te dukuya Olaitoriani, te dukuya ina goro enye napi.

English: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Keaku enkop pooki mitil; ore eyia maitaa nanu enkiting'oto.

English: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.
Masaai: Amu keishir ena kop, ore shumata neroku; amu airoro nanu, atootikio nanu eitu nanu aainosu nemashuko siadi.”

English: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.
Masaai: To ltoilo lo lakedoni le mbarta oltung'ani le nkawuo eilany nkanas pooki olarrabal, nejing ninche ntimi; neked nchumat oo ndapidapo; etung'uayioki nkanas pooki nemetii oltung'ani oton tiatua ninche.

English: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
Masaai: Naa ore iyie, ena nara mijooni, kainyoo intodolu nchere, eji nchopo iyie too nkilani sinteti, nchere inkod iyie kewan too masaa e sahabu, nchere isir iyie nkonyek inono? Te mpesho iyie ikus kewan kimen iyie isanchan linono; eing'oru ninche enkishui ino.

English: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying, Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.
Masaai: Amu atoning'o nanu enkishirata naaijo ene nkitok nasaisai, naishirita te mion anaa enaiu enkerai enye e dukuya, enkishirata eina tito oo ltung'ana le Sion eng'a enkutuk pee etum enkijape, neitorioo nkaik enyena, “Woi nanu!; Ekaiterre nanu te dukuya lelo ooitayu loikop.”

English: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.
Masaai: Kueta nikuetu too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem, ing'orisho niyiolou! Tujurru olkurroto lenye otumoreki toduaa tenaa indim iyie anoto oltung'ani obo, obo oas te nkitorioroto neing'oru esipata pee atum nanu atapalaki ninye.

English: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.
Masaai: Ore hoo nejo ninche, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,” kake ore eyia, enya ninche olmumai te lejare.

English: O LORD, are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, aime esipata eing'oru nkonyek inono? Itoosho iyie ninche, kake eitu ninche emeyu; indaikie iyie ninche, kake etanyaita ninche engamaa ererioroto. Eitagolito ninche nkomomi enye aaitulus te endapidapoi; etanyaita ninche eirridu.

English: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD, nor the judgment of their God.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Ore kulo naa laisinak ake, meeta ninche endamunoto; amu meyiolo ninche enkoitoi o Laitoriani, enkitanapata e Nkai enye.

English: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD, and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.
Masaai: Alo nanu enetii lelo kituaak, pee airorie ninche; enkitanapata e Nkai enye.” Kake enyaanyuk pooki etigila enchata oo murto, etalaa ninche ilidat oo enat.

English: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.
Masaai: Metaa kear ninche olng'atuny oing'uaa entim metuata, keidaikie ninche osuyiani oing'uaa olpurkel. Erreshito olkinyalasho nkanas enye, ore pooki ng'ae ooipang tiatua ninche nepolosi aaitaa ndung'udung'ot; amu eikumok nkitarruorrot enye, ore nchukot enye errinyo siadi naa aikumok.

English: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots' houses.
Masaai: “Kaji nanu aiko tenaapalaki iyie? Aatung'uaitie nanu nkera inono neinosa olmumai te nena neme nkaitin ore aidipa nanu aitotio ninche aitaraposho, neloloito ninche neiturrurrokino nkajijik oo mulayioni.

English: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour's wife.
Masaai: Eikununo ninche anaa lamuyeishi pushunot ootaraposhote meetae ake olemeishir eyieu enkitok olelatia enye.

English: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Masaai: Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna baa? Olaitoriani ojo; naa aimaitalaku nanu to losho laaijo ele?

English: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD'S.
Masaai: “Elepa enchom atua ilkererin lenye loo sabibu enyiala kake minyialinyala katukul; entong'osilu ilng'osil lenye, amu mme ilo Laitoriani ninche.

English: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda neitu ninche tukul ening'isho tialo nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: They have belied the LORD, and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:
Masaai: “Amu eiroro ninche te lejare tialo Olaitoriani, nejo ninche, ‘Meeta ninye enaas; meetae entorroni nalotu shumata iyiook, nimikidol olalem arashu olameyu.

English: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.
Masaai: Netiu iloibonok anaa enkijape; metii ororei atua ninche. Neijia eitaasi ninche!’ ”

English: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani: “Ore enkaraki nairoro ninche ele rorei, ng'ura, kaitaa nanu irorei laainei tiatua enkutuk ino enkima, ore kulo tung'ana neaku ilkeek, nenya enkima ninche.

English: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD: it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kayau nanu shumata iyie, iyie na aji e Israel, olorere oing'uaa enelakua, Olaitoriani ojo. Olorere ogol ninche olorere li apa ninye olorere laa ore enkutuk enye miyiolo iyie nimiyiolou enajo ninche.

English: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
Masaai: Netiu emootian enye anaa enkurare nabolo iltung'ana magil ninche pooki.

English: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.
Masaai: Kenya ninche enkisampuare ino o endaa ino, neinos ninche ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi; nenya ninche nkerrai inyi o nchoo inyi nenya ninche isabibu linyi o lng'abolo linyi; ore nkang'itie inyi naasheta isunta naa ninche isiligigi naa keidaikie ninche.”

English: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end with you.
Masaai: “Kake ore ake sii te nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, maamut nanu iyie katukul.

English: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo iltung'ana linono, kainyoo pee eitaasa Olaitoriani Enkai iyiook kuna baa pooki? Nijokiki intae ninche, ‘Anaa enikitung'uaitie intae nanu nisiayiayia nkaitin oo loreren tiatua enkop inyi, neaku ipuopuo aisiaai iltung'ana leeiking'a teinakop neme eninyi.’ ”

English: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,
Masaai: Mbalunye ena tiatua enkaji e Yakobo, ntudupai tiatua Yuda.

English: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
Masaai: “Entoning ena intae iltung'ana oomoda lemedamisho, lelo oata nkonyek kake medolisho lelo oata nkiyiaa, kake mening'isho.

English: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD: will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?
Masaai: Aimikiurere intae nanu? Olaitoriani ojo; Aiminkirikirara intae te dukuya nanu? Atipika nanu osinyai aitaa olpolosie le naiposha, olpolosie loo nkolong'i pooki lemeidim ninye atogiroi; ore hooneilugo lopir le naiposha, meidim ninche aaima, ore hoo neikurrukur meidim aaima shumata enye.

English: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
Masaai: Kake eeta kulo tung'ana oltau ogol le ngolong'u; eibelekenyate ninche aapuo.

English: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.
Masaai: Mejo ninche too ltauja lenye, ‘Matureita iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang, laa ninye oishoru enchan terishata enye, enchan oo nkokua o enchan oltumuret, nepikaki iyiook nkatitin naageluno enkisampuare.’

English: Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.
Masaai: Eibelekenya entorroni inyi kuna aiwuang'ie, neitalamaitie ing'ok inyi mbaa supati aitung'uaa intae.

English: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.
Masaai: Amu etii iltung'ana torrok atua iltung'ana laainei; nerreshisho anaa larreshok ooirrag aarreshisho neitayu ninche orreshet; neibung ninche iltung'ana.

English: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
Masaai: Ore anaa enabore ntaritik orreshet ebore nkajijik enye enkeleekisho; neaku etaa ninche kituaak nekarsisu,

English: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
Masaai: etopiro ninche nesipayu netuluso too inkiaasin enye e torroni meiguanare ninche te sipata ororei leilo lemeeta menye, pee eitaa ninye karsis, nememitu ninche isipat e ilo omena.

English: Shall I not visit for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Masaai: Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna tokitin? Olaitoriani ojo, naa aimaitalaaki nanu kewan to lorere leeijo ele?”

English: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
Masaai: Entaboi torrono oleng nataase tiatua ena kop;

English: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
Masaai: eibonisho iloibonok te lejare neitoreisho ilapolosak te nena naayieu ninche; ina enyor iltung'ana laainei, kake kaa iyie ias tenebau enkiting'oto.

English: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.
Masaai: Enkuet eng'oru eseriani, intae iltung'ana le Benchamen, entung'uai empolos e Yerusalem! Entoosh entarumpeta te Tekoa, nidumumu olmonekie te Bet-hakerem; amu edakunye entorroni aipang'u te nkalo e moikuape, o enkidaata kitok.

English: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
Masaai: Ore ina sidai naata enkishaa kaidaikie nanu ina tito e Sion,

English: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.
Masaai: ore lchekuti tenebo nkerrai enye nepuonu aarare ninye neun ninche ilng'oborri lenye aaitaman ninye, neirritisho ninche, oltung'ani ake te wueji enye.

English: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.
Masaai: “Ntobira olarrabal taarare ninye; matudumunye, pee kirasaki te nkipirata enkolong! Woi iyiook, amu etinyikayie enkolong, amu etoodorita iloipi le nteipa!”

English: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
Masaai: “Matudumunye, matarasaki kewarie, nikindaikie inkajijik enyena e nkitoo!”

English: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Entudung ilkeek lenyena; nimuatimuata aaman Yerusalem. Enkanasa ena nemeeta nchere pee meitamei; metii ae toki neme enkibookinoto enkop atua ninye.

English: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
Masaai: Ore anaa enashum olchorro enkare enye neijia sii ninye eiko ashum entorroni enye; emarmalisho o enkidaata naning'o tiatua ninye; etii emuoyian o lbaa dukuya nanu anaake.

English: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
Masaai: Nkooyu, iyie Yerusalem, pee maaorieki ake iyie; pee maaitaa ake olmuaate enkop, nememanya.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Kesotuni anaa isabibu olpisiai le Israel, anaa olasotunoni loo lng'anayio nyaaki ntogiroi enkaina ino shumata ilng'osil.”

English: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
Masaai: Kaing'ae nanu airorie naikok, pee etum ninche aatoning ng'ura eikeno nkiyiaa enye meidim ninche aatoning'isho; ng'ura, ore ororei lo Laitoriani te ninche netiu anaa emoroto, meshipakino ninche ninye.

English: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
Masaai: Neaku aabore nanu engoro napi o Laitoriani; anaure aibookino. “Tubukoki ninye shumata nkera te nkoitoi nalala enkanasa, o shumata sii iumat oo lbarnot; neyae olmoruo o enkitok, lelo moruak olelo kituaak lenye.

English: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nkajijik enye neibelekenyakini ilkulikae, inkurman enye o nkituaak enye tenebo; amu kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aarare lelo omanya ena kop.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
Masaai: “Amu ore ebaiki oloti o metabaiki olkitok lenye, meetae ake olemeng'uar dupoto e lejare; ore ebaiki oloiboni ometabaiki olapolosani, meetae ake olemeas inelejare.

English: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
Masaai: Eishiunye ninche olbae loo ltung'ana laainei te nkitaakunoto, ejo, ‘Eseriani, eseriani’ nemetii eseriani.

English: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ketukurrutua apa ninche ina kata apa pee eas mbaa olminong? Aa, eitu ninche ekurru tukul; menya ninche orere. Neaku kebatata ninche tenebo lelo oobatata; ore teina kata naitame nanu ninche, kenang'ari ninche,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Entasheito too nkoitoi naalaa ning'orishosho, ninkilikuanunu nkoitoi e opa, ine apa netii nkoitoi sidain, niimiimi intae atua nitumutumu enkiyeng'iyeng too ltauja linyi. Kake etejo ninche, ‘Mikiim iyiook atua ninye.’

English: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
Masaai: Atipika nanu ilarripok shumata intae, ejo, ‘Entoning oltoilo le ntarumpeta’ Kake etejo ninche, ‘Mikinining iyiook.’

English: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
Masaai: Metaa entoning, intae iloshon, niyiolouu, intae ilturrurri, ina nayooki atiu te ninche.

English: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
Masaai: Toning'o iyie enkop; ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata kulo tung'ana, ilng'anayio loo mbaa enye torrok, enkaraki neitu ninche ening irorei laainei; ore tialo enkitanapata ai, etanyaita ninche.

English: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
Masaai: Aitenkaraki nyoo naa nanu aayakini enkorropil naing'uaa sheba, arashu esonkoyo naarropil naing'uaa enkop nalakua? Ore lasarri linono oopejori meng'amaroyu, nemaaitiship nanu nkishorunot inono.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Ng'ura, kairragakinye nanu kulo tung'ana iloketa naa ninche errorrore ninche; iloomenye o layiok tenebo, ore olelatia olchore neidak.’ ”

English: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura, epuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa enkop e moikuape, eilepu olosho kitok eing'uaa enelakua oleng te nkop.

English: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.
Masaai: Eirraga ninche eibung'ita enkawuo o empere kegogong ninche nemeeta olng'ur, ore oltoilo lenye neikununo anaa enaiposha naikurrukur; neked ninche mbartan, nenapa ninche anaa oltung'ani le njore, pee kiarare iyie, ena tito e Sion!”

English: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
Masaai: Kitoning'o iyiook olomoni lenye, nelepori inkaik ang; neibung iyiook osina o emion anaa enkitok nasaisai.

English: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
Masaai: Emimpang aapuo ong'ata, arashu ipuopuo te nkoitoi; amu eeta olmang'atinta olalem, etii olkirutoto pooki shoto.

English: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
Masaai: Iyie na tito oo ltung'ana laainei, terretenayu too lkuniyiani, nimperipera too nkuruon; nchira anaa enatua olayioni obo oata, to lkiyioi le mion oleng, amu nabo kata nelotu olamutani shumata iyiook.

English: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.
Masaai: Aaitaa nanu iyie entemet o esilet tiatua iltung'ana laainei, pee itum atayiolo nitem nkoitoi enye.

English: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
Masaai: Kegolong'u ninche pooki, nepuoopuo too nkiteenikinot; osuyai ninche o esekenkei, eas ninche pooki ine ntorroni.

English: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
Masaai: Eyupuyup olkokuet oleng nenya enkima olduruk lioriong ore ilo osholishol sekenkei pesho ake esholishol amu eitu eiwuang'ieki entorroni.

English: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
Masaai: Enkosholai nemeeta tipat ninche, amu etanya Olaitoriani ninche.

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ele ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Stand in the gate of the LORD'S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD, all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD.
Masaai: “Ntasho te kishomi enkaji o Laitoriani, nilikio teine ele rorei, nijo, Entoning ororei lo laitoriani, intae iltung'ana pooki le Yuda ooimu kuna shomito aaserem Olaitoriani.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, embelekenya nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, naa kaisho nanu intae ibikibiki teine wueji.

English: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, The temple of the LORD, are these.
Masaai: Emisilig kulo rorei le lejare: ‘Enkaji Olaitoriani ena, enkaji Olaitoriani, enkaji o Laitoriani.’

English: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
Masaai: “Amu tenimbelekenyanya intae te dede aaing'uaa nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, tinimbung'ubung'u te dede esipata o ltung'ani ake olikae,

English: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
Masaai: tenimimbookiki enkop ilo omoni, ilo lemeeta menye arashu enkoliai arashu imbukoo osarge leilo lemeeta entioto tene wueji, nimintokiki aasujaa kulie aitin te nkitamioto inyi,

English: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
Masaai: naa kaisho nanu intae entobik tene wueji, tiatua ena kop apa naishoo nanu loo papaai linyi ntarasi.

English: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, isiligigi intae irorei le lejare lemeeta eretoto.

English: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;
Masaai: Ipurisho iyie, nintayu loikop, niloloito, ninya olmumai te lejare, nipejoki Baal enkorropil, nirubare kulie aitin neitu iyiolou,

English: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
Masaai: paa intokiki aapuonu aitashe te dukuya nanu tena aji, naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, nijojo, ‘Etokorduaki iyiook!’ nipuopuo dukuya iasiasa kuna pooki olminong?

English: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ketaa ena aji, naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, enkapune oo lapurrok too nkonyek inyi? Ng'ura, atoduaa nanu enkorrok ai ina, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.
Masaai: Enchom taata ine wueji ai apa netii shilo, naa ine aishoo enkarna ai metobikie te dukuya; pee idolidolo enaitaasa ninye te ntorroni oo ltung'ana laainei Israel.

English: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;
Masaai: Ore taata, enkaraki nitaasa intae kuna baa pooki, Olaitoriani ojo, ore pee airorie intae aitirrishaki neitu ining'ining'i, ore pee aipot intae neitu irukishosho, ore pee aaipot intae neitu irukishosho,

English: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
Masaai: neaku kaitaas nanu ina aji naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, naa ninye isiligigi, oine wueji apa naishoo nanu intae o loo papaai linyi anaa enaitaasa Shilo.

English: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
Masaai: Naa kanang'aa nanu intae too nkonyek aainei, anaa enatanang'ayie nanu ilalashera linyi, o eishoi pooki e Efraim.

English: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.
Masaai: “Ore iyie miomonoki kulo tung'ana, arashu ilepiepie olkiyioi arashu enkomono te nkaraki ninche nimiomonoki te nanu, amu maaning nanu iyie.

English: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
Masaai: Aimidol iyie inaasita ninche too nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem?

English: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
Masaai: Esotu nkera ilkeek, neinok loo menye enkima, neipurj nkituaak enkurma, pee eitobiraki imukateni enkaiguanani e shumata; nebukoki ninche ilasarri ooki kulie aitin, pee aaitagor nanu.

English: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
Masaai: Kainanu ninche eitagor? Olaitoriani ojo. Aime ate, to lmilo lenye.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ng'ura keibukori engoro ai o engoro ai napi tene wueji, te shumata oltung'ani o eng'ues, shumata ilkeek liong'ota olng'anayio le nkop: keyupuyup ninye nemearayu.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani Enkai e Israel: “Entoponai nkishorot inyi oo lasarri oopejori, ninyanya nkiri.

English: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
Masaai: Amu ore apa teina olong nayawua nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, eitu nanu airorie loo papaai linyi arashu aaraki ninche tialo nkishorunot naapejori o lasarri.

English: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
Masaai: Kake ena kitanapata nanu aishoo ninche; ‘Entoning oltoilo lai, naa kaaku nanu Enkai inyi, niakuku intae iltung'ana laainei; nipuopuo teina oitoi pooki naitanapa nanu intae, pee etum atisidana te intae.’

English: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening arashu eishoru enkiok enye, kake eshomo ninche too ndamunot enye o engolon oo ltauja lenye torrok, nepuo siadi neitu epuo dukuya.

English: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina olong apa napuonu loo papaai linyi aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri ometabaiki ena olong, aitirrishaka nanu airriwaa isinkan laainei pooki lelo oibonok le Nkai enetii ninche te nkolong ake o te nkolong,
