English: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
Masaai: ore eyia neitu ninche aainining nanu, arashu eishoru enkiok enye, kake eitagolo lukuny enye. Etaasa ninche ntorrok aalang loo papaai lenye.

English: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.
Masaai: “Neaku iliki iyie ninche kulo rorei pooki, kake mikining ninche iyie. Impot iyie ninche kake mikiruk ninche iyie.

English: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie ajoki ninche, ‘Olosho ele leitu ening oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, neitu eng'amu enkitamito e rerioroto; eidaayie esipata; eiwuang'ieki too nkutukie enye.

English: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
Masaai: “Entudung'oi ilpapit linyi ninturraa; to sina elepie olkiyioi too nkisiajat naaika; amu etanya Olaitoriani netung'uayie ina ishoi e ngoro enye napi.’

English: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
Masaai: “Amu etaasa ilaiyiok le Yuda entorroni too nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani ojo; etipika ninche ilo minong lenye atua enkaji naa ninye eipotieki enkarna ai, pee eisarkionie ninye.

English: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
Masaai: Netesheta ninche olperere lo lasar te wueji neika neji Tofel, ina natii oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, pee etum aatapejoi ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye tiatua ina kima neitu nanu aitanap ninche neitu elotu atua ndamunot aainei.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
Masaai: Metaa, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitokini aajo Tofel, arashu oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, kake oyarata le sesekuanare amu te Tofel ninche enukaa ilootuata, enkaraki metii erishata dikae.

English: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
Masaai: Ore mpopoki e kulo tung'ana neaku endaa too motonyi o loing'ang'e, o too ng'uesi enkop; nemeetae oloiture ninche meshomo.

English: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
Masaai: Naa kaitobir nanu meishunye too nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem oltoilo le nkuenia o ltoilo le nchipai, o ltoilo lo loyamisho oltoilo le nayami; amu keaku enkop mijooni.

English: At that time, saith the LORD, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
Masaai: “Ore kenya teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, ore iloik loo laiguanak le Yuda, o loik loo lkituaak lenyena, o loik loo lapolosak, o loik loo loibonok le Nkai o loik le lelo oomanya Yerusalem neyauni aitung'uaa nkuraren enye;

English: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
Masaai: neidapashi ninche te dukuya enkolong o lapa, o lorora pooki le keper, naa ninche apa etonyorra ninche neisiaai, aa ninche apa etusujaitie, aa ninche eing'orutua neserem; nemeiturrurri ninche arashu enukari; netiu ninche anaa modiok ti oriong enkop.

English: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kenyorrarri kenya keeya aaitudutie enkishui ilo pisiai oleku lele marei torrono too wuejitin pooki naterewa nanu ninche, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
Masaai: “Ijoki iyie ninche, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Amaa tenebatata oltung'ani aimeitoki ninye adumunye? Amaa teneibelekenya oltung'ani alo, aimeitoki ninye ashukunye?

English: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eibelekenyate kulo tung'ana aapuo aashuko siadi anaake? Neibung ninche aakurraki elejare, neany ninche eshukunye.

English: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
Masaai: Ainining'ishe nanu, kake eitu ninche eiro aaitorioki; meetae oltung'ani oirridu te ntorroni enye, ejo ‘Kainyoo nanu ataasa?’ Eibelekenyakino ake pooki ng'ae nkoitoi enyena, anaa embarta nakuetiki olarrabal.

English: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD.
Masaai: Ekeyiolo ninye entilagos te shumata nkatitin enyena; ore enturkuluo o emotoroki, o enkaileeri neibung nkatitin enye naapuonunye; kake meyiolo iltung'ana laainei nkitanapat Olaitoriani.

English: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
Masaai: “Kaji intae inkoko tenijojo, ‘Kira iyiook ng'eni, ore enkitanapata O Laitoriani netii tenebo iyiook?’ Kake, ng'ura, ina alamu elejare oo lasirak ajo eitaa ninye emonkoi.

English: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD; and what wisdom is in them?
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana ng'eni naa keitukurruni, keidang'ieki ninche neyae; Oi, etanyaita ninche ororei lo Laitoriani, naa kaa ng'eno natii atua ninche?

English: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
Masaai: Neaku kaisho nanu nkituaak enye ilkulikae naisho nkurman enye lelo ooisulu, enkaraki naa ore ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok eeta pooki ng'ae olorok le dupoto te nkoitoi elejare. Eiteru to loiboni le Nkai o metabaiki olapolosani ometabaiki olapolosani meetae ake ole measisho te lejare.

English: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
Masaai: Eishiunye ninche olbae loo ltung'ana laainei te nkitaakunoto ejo, ‘Eseriani, eseriani’, nemetii eseriani.

English: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ketukurrutua ninche ina kata pee eas olminong A-a, eitu ninche ekurru tukul; menya ninche orere. Neaku kebatata ninche tiatua lelo ootabatatate; ore ake pee aitame nanu ninche, nenang'ari ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
Masaai: Ore tenajo aiturrur ninche; Olaitoriani ojo, nemetii ilng'anayio o sabibu arashu ilng'abolo olng'aboli etoito ninye mbenek, ore apa ina naishoo nanu ninche netulusoyie alo aing'uaa ninche.”

English: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee kitoni iyiook aaitirring'a enturrurroto tenebo, maape iyiook atua nena anas naasheta, pee kindak teine; amu etudung'oko iyiook Olaitoriani Enkai ang enkidaata, neishoo iyiook enkare natii esayiet matook, enkaraki nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki to Laitoriani.

English: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
Masaai: Kisiligu iyiook eseriani kake meetae esidai naewuo, enkata enkishiunoto, kake ng'ura, enkuretisho.

English: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
Masaai: “Ore enkikurrukur oo mbartan enye nening'o te wueji neji Dan. Ore to ltoilo loo mbartan enye e njore neikirikira enkop pooki. Kepuonu ninche aaidaikie enkop o pooki toki nabore, enkanasa o lelo oomanya atua.

English: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kairriu nanu tiatua intae ilasuriaa o nturbubuani naata esayiet nemeibooyo intalengo, naa keony ninche intae.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
Masaai: Meishiunoyu osina lai? kemuoi oltau lai.

English: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
Masaai: Toning'o olkiyioi le ntito oo ltung'ana laainei eing'uaa enkadoro o endapasho enkop. “Aimetii Olaitoriani atua Sion? Aimetii olaiguanani lenye atua ninye?” Kainyoo pee aaitagoro ninche too nkitanyaanyukot enye naaguetuno, o too nkitanyaanyukot enye omon?

English: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
Masaai: “Etulusoyie enkisampuare; eishunye enkata enkirowuaj, neitu eitajeuni iyiook.”

English: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo bae leina tito oo ltung'ana laainei naa oltau lai etipikaki olbae, aishir nanu, naaiputa nanu enking'asia.

English: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
Masaai: Aimetii olchani atua Gilead? Aimetii olabaani ine? Kainyoo naa pee eitu eshukuni embiotisho eina tito oo ltung'ana laainei?

English: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
Masaai: Oi naaji aa nkariak ake endukuya ai, naa nkonyek oo lkiyio nkonyek ainei, pee atum nanu aishira dama o kewarie te sesekuanata eina tito oo ltung'ana laainei!

English: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
Masaai: Oi naaji aa kaata to lpurkel ewueji neirragari pee atum nanu atung'uai iltung'ana laainei nalo enelakua aing'uaa ninche! amu ile loloito ninche pooki, olturrur loo ltung'ana le nkaldoroto

English: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: neriu ilng'ejepa lenye anaa enkawuo; elejare neme esipata natubulayie tiatua ena kop; amu kepuo ninche dukuya te ntorroni o te ntorroni, nemaayiolo ninche nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
Masaai: Enchoo pooki ng'ae erripo to lelatia enye nemepik osiligi atua likae alashe; amu ore pooki alashe naa olairrikinoni amu ore pooki lelatia enye neloolo ainosaa olmarenke.

English: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
Masaai: Kelej pooki ng'ae olelatia enye, nemeetae oloiro esipata; eitamoo ninche ilng'ejepa lenye meiroro elejare neas ninche ntorrok neshal oleng te nkirridunoto.

English: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nesot enkibookinoto e nkop te shumata enkibookinoto enkop, o elejare te shumata e lejare, neany ninche aayiolou nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura kashol nanu ninche natem ninche, amu kaa ae naas nanu, te nkaraki iltung'ana laainei?”

English: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.
Masaai: Embae e sayiet olng'ejep lenye; keiro ninye te lejare; ore te nkutuk enye meetae ake olemeirorie olelatia enye te seriani, kake ore tiatua oltau lenye neitobiraki ninye orreshet.

English: Shall I not visit them for these things? saith the LORD: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
Masaai: Aimaitame nanu ninche te kuna baa, Olaitoriani ojo; naa aimaitalaaki nanu kewan to lorere laaijo ele.

English: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
Masaai: Teyietu nchiraki ldoinyo ninchiraki to sina ndaat e ongata enkaraki naitaaki mitil neaku meetae oltung'ani oim atua, ore enkorui oo nkishu nemening'o ore ntaritik o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi neisika nepuo.

English: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu Yerusalem osototi loo suut, olmuaate emanyisho oo mbariak naitaa nanu nkanas e Yuda mijoonto, meetae olomanya.

English: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?
Masaai: Kaing'ae ilo tung'ani ng'en oleng oidim atayiolo ena: laa ninye eirorie enkutuk o Laitoriani, pee etum ninye aibalunye? Kainyoo pee einyalaki enkop aaidaikie anaa ong'ota, metaa meetae hoo obo ooim atua?

English: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani: “Enkaraki natung'uaitie ninche enkitanapata ai apa natipika nanu dukuya ninche, neitu ening oltoilo lai, arashu epuo te risioroto enye,

English: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
Masaai: kake te ngolong'akinoto etusujaitie iltauja lenye maate neshomo aasujaa nena Baali, anaa enaiteng'ena loo menye ninche.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kaitoti nanu kulo tung'ana te sayiet, naisho ninche enkare natii esayiet metooko.

English: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
Masaai: Kaidapashaki nanu ninche iloshon leitu apa eyiolou ninche arashu loo menye; naitoki nanu airriwaa olalem aitusuj ninche ometaba anaa namut nanu ninche.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Entadamu, nimpotutu nena kituaak naaishir meetu; erriu nena kituaak arriyiak meetu.

English: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eisarisaru neilepakinye iyiook olkiyioi pee etum nkonyek ang aaturukoto too lkiyio, neshalu nchonito oo nkonyek te nkare.

English: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
Masaai: Amu etoning'oki oltoilo lo lkiyioi te Sion. ‘Eneikunakaki iyiook enkidaata! Eitukurruaki iyiook oleng, enkaraki nikitung'uaitie iyiook ina kop, enkaraki naturoitie ninche imanyishoritin ang.’ ”

English: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
Masaai: Entoning, intae na kituaak, ororei lo laitoriani, ninchosho nkiyia inyi eng'amu ororei le nkutuk enye; enteng'ena ntoyie inyi enkishirata, oltung'ani ake neiteng'en enelatia enye olkiyioi linchirishiri.

English: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
Masaai: Amu eilepua keeya alotu atua ilusien ang, etijing'ua ninye iwuejitin ang enkitoo edung'oo metuata nkera too nkoitoi naalala enkanasa, o lbarnot too lkurrot ootumoreki.

English: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
Masaai: Eroro, “Inji ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Ore mpopoki oo ltung'ana naa keirragaa anaa modiok te nkisiajata, anaa suut enkano te siadi olaisampuani nemeetae oloiturrur ninche.’ ”

English: Thus saith the LORD, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Minchosho ilo tung'ani ng'en eng'idare eng'eno enye, minchosho ilo tung'ani magilani eng'idare emagilanisho enye, minchosho ilo tung'ani karsis eng'idare karsisisho enye;

English: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD.
Masaai: kake enchoo ilo ong'ida eng'idare ena, nchere kaayiolo nanu, nchere ara Olaitoriani ilo oibung enyorrata nauno, esipata, o enkitorioroto tiatua enkop; amu te kuna tokitin ashipa nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aitame nanu lelo pooki oomurata kake memurata sii

English: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
Masaai: Misiri, o Yuda, o Edom, lelo ayiok le Amon, o Moab o lelo pooki, oomanya olpurkel oiriri ilpapit lenye! Amu ore kulo oshon pooki nememurata, ore enkaji pooki e Israel nememurata iltauja.”

English: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
Masaai: Entoning ilo rorei oirorie intae Olaitoriani, intae enkaji e Israel.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Emisuj nkoitoi oo loreren niming'asiasia ake too nkitoduaat e shumata amu eing'asiate loreren te ninche,

English: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
Masaai: amu ore ilkuaaki loo ltung'ana naa eitorrok. Keurori olchani te ntim, neitayuni enchata entolu too nkaik oltung'ani arriyia.

English: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
Masaai: Neikod iltung'ana te nkosholai o te sahabu; neitirrishi ninye te nyuntu o too lmushumaani, pee mepuku ashurtunye.

English: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
Masaai: Ore nkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin neikununo anaa nkitanyaanyukot oo ltung'ana naaitasheyieki metorripo nkurman, nemeidim aairoro; kenapi ninche, amu meidim aashom. Miureyu iyie ninche, amu meidim aataas entorrono, nemetii atua ninche easata e sidai.”

English: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.
Masaai: Metii likae likinyaanyukie iyie Olaitoriani; ira iyie kitok, naa kitok enkarna ino te magilanisho.

English: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.
Masaai: Kaing'ae limikiureyu iyie, Iyie Olaiguanani loo loreren? amu erishata ino ena; amu ore tiatua lelo pooki ng'eni loo loreren otiatua nkitoriat enye pooki meetae likae likinyaanyukie.

English: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
Masaai: ilkilo pooki nemoda; ore enkiteng'enare enye oo nkitanyaanyukot naa nkeek ake!

English: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
Masaai: Eyauaki enkosholai naidong'i aaitung'uaa Tarshish, neyauni sahabu aaitung'uaa Ufas. Esiaai oltung'ani arriyia ninche o enoo nkaik olaitobirani le sahabu; ore nkilani enye naa pilei o sinteti; esiaai oo ltung'ana arriyiak pooki.

English: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
Masaai: Kake ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai nasipa; ninye Enkai naishu olaiguanani loo ntarasi naa tengoro enye eikirikira enkop, nemeidimu iloshon engoro enye.

English: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
Masaai: Nji iyie tiaaki ninche, “Ore nena aitin neitu eitayu shumata o enkop naa keidak te nkop o tiabori enkop.”

English: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ninye oitobira enkop te ngolon enye, ninye oitasheyie enkop pooki te ng'eno enye nagut, naa te yiolounoto enye eitorioyie shumata.

English: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
Masaai: Teneitayu ninye oltoilo lenye netii enkikurrukur oo nkariak shumata neisho ninye enkinuku metunukunye too neeitingie e nkop. Neitayu ninye nkiwuang'at e nchan, neyau ninye osiwuo aitung'uaa nkajijik enyena naashumishoreki.

English: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
Masaai: Kekilo pooki tung'ani nemeeta eng'eno, eitukurruaki pooki aitobirani le sahabu too nkitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin; amu ore nkitanyaanyukot enyena naa ine lejare, nemetii enkiyang'et atua ninche.

English: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
Masaai: Ine pesho ninche, esiaai e lejare, ore te nkata enkitamioto enye naa keidak ninche.

English: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.
Masaai: Metiu ninye inji ilo ora erubata e Yakobo amu ninye oitamanyua intokitin pooki, ore Israel naa olosho le njung'ore enye; Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.

English: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
Masaai: Nturrurro orridati lino te nkop, iyie ele obikito tiabori emanata!

English: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura kanang'aa nanu boo lelo oomanya ena kop tena kata, nayau nanu osina shumata ninche, pee etum ninche aatayiolo.”

English: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
Masaai: Oi nanu tenkaraki enkitamioto ai! ore olbae lai naa olosina, kake ore nanu atejo, “Esipa olosilisili ele lemeeta nchere pee mangiriakino nanu.”

English: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
Masaai: Eidaikieki olng'obor lai, ore nkeenta aainei pooki netudung'ote; naashomo aaing'uaa nkera ainei metii ninche; metii hoo obo oigil akas olng'obor lai, nepik ilkarash laainei.

English: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
Masaai: Amu kemoda ilchekuti loo ntare nemeikilikuanishore Olaitoriani; neaku eitu edupo ninche, ore luaat enye pooki neidapashate.

English: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.
Masaai: Inining'o, olmarenke! Ng'ura elotu! embuakunoto sapuk naipang'u te nkop e moikuape, pee eitaa nkanas e Yuda ilmuateni, emanyisho oo mbariak.

English: O LORD, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu, Olaitoriani, nchere ore nkoitoi e tung'ani nemetii atua ninye kewan, nchere mme atua tung'ani etii pee elo neutaa iroruat enyena.

English: O LORD, correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.
Masaai: Ntorioyoki nanu, Olaitoriani kake te sipata; neme te ngoro ino, pee mikintaa ake nanu olemetii.

English: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
Masaai: Tubukoki engoro ino napi shumata lelo oreren limikiyiolo ninche, o shumata lelo tung'ana lemeipot enkarna ino; amu einosa ninche Yakobo; einosa ninche ninye nemut ninye, neitomijoono ninche emanyisho enye.

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
Masaai: “Toning'o irorei lele ning'o lo sotua, nirorie iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
Masaai: Tiaaki iyie ninche, nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: ediaa ilo tung'ani lemening irorei lele ning'o lo sotua.

English: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:
Masaai: Ilo laitanapa apa iloo papaai linyi pee ayau nanu ninche aitupuku te nkop e Misiri, aitung'uaa ilo kokuet le sekenkei, ajo, “Entoning oltoilo lai, niasiasa nena pooki naitanap nanu intae. Pee iyakuku intae iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai inyi,

English: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD.
Masaai: pee atum ataasa olmumai lai apa lainosa nanu too loo papaai linyi, pee aisho nanu ninche enkop naruko kule o naishi, anaa enatiu ena olong.” Nawal nanu ajo, “Metotiwuo neijia Olaitoriani.”

English: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Ntudupai kulo rorei pooki tiatua nkanas e Yuda, o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem. Entoning irorei lele ning'o lo sotua niasiasa.

English: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
Masaai: Amu aikoo nanu loo papaai linyi akurraki ina kata apa pee ayau nanu ninche ailepunye aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, naikok aitirrishaki, o tena olong, ajo, entoning oltoilo lai.

English: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu ninche ening kake eshomo ake pooki ng'ae te ngolon oltau lenye torrono. Neaku ayawua nanu shumata ninche irorei pooki lele ning'o lo sotua apa laitanapa nanu ninche metaasa, kake eitu ninche eas.”

English: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naaigil nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, “Etii enkiseroto atua iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
Masaai: Eibelekenyate ninche aashukokino ntorrok oo loo nkakuyiaa lenye, apa ootanyaita ening irorei laainei; eshomo ninche aasujaa kulie aitin pee eisiaai ninche; etudung'o enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda osotua lai apa laitobira nanu tenebo loo papaai lenye.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
Masaai: Neaku, nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ninche nemeidim aatapaashare; ore hoo naaishiraki ninche nanu, maning nanu ninche.

English: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
Masaai: Nepuo nkanas e Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem aaishiraki nena aitin naapejoki ninche enkorropil, kake meidim ninche aaitajeu ninche te nkata e nyamali enye.

English: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
Masaai: Amu etaa kumok nkaitin inyi anaa nkanas inyi, iyie Yuda; naa kumok anaa nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem lperereni loo lasarri nintobira pee intukurrurru ate te lelo perereni loo lasarri oopejokinyeki Baal enkorropil.

English: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
Masaai: “Metaa miomonoki iyie kulo tung'ana, arashu ilepie enkishirata arashu enkomono te rishata enye, amu mainining nanu tenaaipot ninche nanu tenkata enye enyamali.

English: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.
Masaai: Kaa sipata eeta ina nanyor nanu tiatua enkop ai, eidipa ataasa nkiaasin torrok? Keidim ilmuma o nkiri naaitaikiaki olasar aaiwuang'ie enkidaata ino? Eikintiship naa iyie ina?

English: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
Masaai: Kimpoto apa iyie Olaitoriani ajo, “Oloirien onyori, obore ilng'anayio sidain;’ kake te nkikurrukur e ndarata sapuk epik ninye atua enkima, ore ilng'osil lenyena nemut enkima.

English: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa ninye apa likituuno iyie, kitudung'oko iyie entorrono, te nkaraki ina torrono nataasa enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda, naaitagor nanu aapejoki Baal enkorropil.”

English: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.
Masaai: Naaitayiolo nanu Olaitoriani nayiolou nanu; nikintoki iyie aitodol nanu nkiaasin enye torrok.

English: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
Masaai: Kake atiu apa nanu anaa olkuoo le ker obor oriki aapuo aayieng. Eitu apa nanu ayiolou ajo nanu eitobiraki ninche entorroni ejo, “Mainyala iyiook olchani tenebo ilng'anayio lenyena, matudung iyiook aaiwuang'ie te nkop oo looishu, pee meitokini ae kata aadamu enkarna enye.”

English: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.
Masaai: Kake ore, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, oiguana te sipata, ilo otem oltau o ndamunot nchooki nanu matoduaa elap ino te shumata ninche, amu iyie nanu aigarakine too mbaa aainei.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD, that thou die not by our hand:
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo tung'ana le Anatot, lelo ooing'oru enkishui ino nejo, “Mimbonisho te nkarna Olaitoriani, arashu iye te nkaina ang”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
Masaai: neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura, kaitame nanu ninche; keye lelo barnot to lalem; ore layiok lenye o ntoyie enye neye to lameyu;

English: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
Masaai: nemeetae obo lenye oleku. Amu kayau nanu entorroni shumata iltung'ana le Anatot, teilo ari le nkitamioto enye.”

English: Righteous art thou, O LORD, when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
Masaai: Ira iyie asipani, Olaitoriani, tenaaishankarrare nanu iyie; ore eyia kaitirrish nanu ororei lai te dukuya iyie. Kainyoo pee edupoyu enkoitoi oo larruok? Kainyoo pee edupoyu iltung'ana le nkeleekisho?

English: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
Masaai: Iun iyie ninche, neibung ninche ntona; nebulu ninche neiu ilng'anayio; nitaana iyie too nkutukie enye nilakua too ltauja lenye.

English: But thou, O LORD, knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, kiyiolo nanu kidolita iyie nanu, nikitem endamunoto ai tialo iyie. Teyietai ninche mpang'ie anaa nkerra naapuoi aayieng, nirragie ninche aiteng'el aitaany ina olong e yiang'are.

English: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
Masaai: Keishir akenya enkop o anu, netoyu nkujit e pooki ong'ata? Tenkaraki entorroni e lelo oomanya atua ore ng'uesi o ntaritik nejutori aaishie enkaraki natejo iltung'ana, “Medol ninye ae kiting'oto ang.”

English: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee, then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?
Masaai: “Amaa tenikueta akeshare ninche too nkejek, nikintanaura ninche kaji naa inko tenikeshare mbartan? Naa amaa tenibatata te nkop naserian kaji naa inko tiatua osero lo lkeju le Yordan?

English: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.
Masaai: Amu ore ninye ilalashera linono o enkaji e papaai lino, eji kitakaldaitie sii ninche; niruk ninche, hoo neiro irorei supati te iyie.”

English: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
Masaai: Aiturrayie nanu enkaji ai, aitaa nanu enjung'ore ai aishooyie nanu ina nanyor to ltau lai, apik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenyena.

English: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.
Masaai: Etotiwuo enjung'ore ai te nanu anaa olng'atuny tiatua entim, eilepunye ninye oltoilo lenye aarare nanu; neaku kaiba nanu ninye.

English: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
Masaai: Ketotiwuo enjung'ore ai anaa emotonyi narreshitoi, kemanita ninye motonyi naareshito too nkaloli pooki? Shomo inturrurro ing'uesi pooki e ntim iyau ninche meetu aapolol aainos.

English: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
Masaai: Einyala ilairritak kumok loo ntare enkurma ai oo sabibu eitunyokitio ninche enkop erubata ai, eitaa ninche ewueji ai sidai e ong'ata mitil.

English: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.
Masaai: Eitaa ninche ninye mitil; naaishiraki nanu ina nataa mitil eitaaki enkop pooki mitil kake meetae oltung'ani oshilaa.

English: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
Masaai: Ore nena kisiajat pooki naaika to lpurkel neetuo lelo ooidaikie; amu keinos olalem lo Laitoriani enchoto nabo enkop o metabaiki enkae; meetae o loata eseriani.

English: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
Masaai: Etuuno ninche enkano neisampu ilkiku, eitanaurita ninche ate kake eitu edupore toki. Keitukurruni ninche te nkisampuaare enye tenkaraki engoro O Laitoriani napi.

English: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo, kulo le latia ai pooki torrok ooinyal ina jung'ore naishoo nanu iltung'ana laainei Israel metujung'o: “Ng'ura, kadotu nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop enye, naa kadotu enkaji e Yuda aitung'uaa ninche.

English: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
Masaai: Ore peyie aidip nanu atadotu ninche, naitoki nanu aing'urrie ninche, naitoki nanu ayau ninche pooki ng'ae enjung'ore enye o pooki ng'ae enkop pooki.

English: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
Masaai: Naa kelotu aaku teneibung ninche aakurraki nkoitoi oo ltung'ana laainei, pee enya olmumai te nkarna ai, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani,’ anaa sii apa enaiteng'ena ninche iltung'ana laainei meinosa olmumai te Baal, naa keshetuni ninche tiatua iltung'ana laainei.

English: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kake tenetii olosho lemening'isho, naa kadotu nanu tukul naidaikie ninye, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
Masaai: Nji aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani, “Shomo inyiang'u enkarasha e kitani, nipik empolos ino nimintadoiki ake atua enkare.”

English: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
Masaai: Neaku ainyiang'ua enkarasha empolos te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani napik empolos ai.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii nanu te nkata e are ejo,

English: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
Masaai: “Iwa ina arasha e mpolos ninyang'ua ina natii empolos ino, nidumunye, shomo olkeju le Farite, isudoi ninye teine to lbaata le ndapidapoi.”

English: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
Masaai: Nalo nanu, naisudoo te Farite, anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
Masaai: Ore etulusoite nkolong'i kumok naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Tudumunye, shomo Farite, ntayu teine enkarasha empolos apa naaitanapa iyie isudoi teine.”

English: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
Masaai: Nalo nanu Farite, naturu, naitayu ina karasha teine wueji apa naisudorie ninye. Naa ng'ura etarruoyie apa ina arasha e mpolos; meekure apa eeta tipat.

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Neijia aiko ainyal olwuasa le Yuda o ilo owuasa kitok le Yerusalem.

English: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
Masaai: Ore kulo tung'ana torrok, oany ening irorei laainei, oosuj te ngolon enkong'u iltauja lenye maate neshomo aasujaa kulie aitin pee eisiaai ninche neserem ninche ketiu anaa ena arasha empolos naidaaie, nemeeta tipat.

English: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enaenikino enkarasha empolos o ltung'ani, neijia aikuna enkaji pooki e Israel o enkaji pooki e Yuda maateenikinoto ninche nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, pee etum ninche aataa te nanu iltung'ana, o enkarna, o enkisisa o enkitoo te nanu, kake mening'isho ninche.

English: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
Masaai: “Irorie iyie ninche ele rorei ijoki, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, “Keiputi pooki siang'au e naisho oo lsabibu.” ’ Naa eikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Eimikiyiolo iyiook aaitisip aajo keiputi pooki siang'au e naisho oo lsabibu?’

English: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
Masaai: Nitum iyie atiaki ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kaiput nanu emerai lelo pooki oomanya ena kop: lelo aiguanak ootonie olorika le Daudi le nkitoo, o lapolosak, o loibonok o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
Masaai: Naitaar nanu ninche oltung'ani ake o likae, iloo menye o layiok lenye tenebo, Olaitoriani ojo. Maing'urrie nanu arashu aleku, arashu aitananaki enkoshoke pee mainyal nanu ninche.’ ”

English: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
Masaai: Entoning ninchoruru enkiok; emiwuasa, amu eiroro Olaitoriani.

English: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
Masaai: Enchoo enkitoo Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, eton eitu eyau ninye enaimin eton eitu errorro nkejek inyi te nchumata ildoinyo ooitomisimisoki, ore ing'oru iyie ewang'an neibelekeny ninye aitaa emisimisi neitaa ninye enaimin nagut.

English: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD'S flock is carried away captive.
Masaai: Kake tenimining iyie, neishir oltau lai te nkisudoroto tenkaraki olwuasa lino; neishir nkonyek aainei te mion nerukunye ilkiyio, enkaraki nataraiyioki eluaata Olaitoriani.

English: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
Masaai: Tiaaki Olaiguanani o ng'otonye enkitok olaiguanani “Ewaita olorika liabori, amu etadowuo enkopiyia ino e nkitoo sidai aing'uaa endukuya ino.”

English: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
Masaai: Eikenoki nkanas e Negeb, nemeetae olobol ninche. Ewaki Yuda pooki eyararoto, etarayioki tukul.

English: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
Masaai: Tushumu nkonyek inono toduaa lelo oopuonu ooing'uaa moikuape. Koree ina luaata apa nikinchooki iyie, ina luaata ino sidai?

English: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
Masaai: Kaa iyie ijo tenepik ninche ate shumata iyie lelo apa laa iyie makewan oiteng'ena? Pee eaku ilchoreta te iyie? Eimikimbung iyie emion, anaa emion enkitok nasaisai?

English: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
Masaai: Naa tenijo iyie to ltau lino, kainyoo pee eetuo kuna baa shumata nanu? Tenkaraki esapuko e ntorroni ino pee engishari ilkilani linono, nikisomiti iyie.

English: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
Masaai: Keidim ilo le Etiopia aibelekenya olchoni lo sesen lenye arashu olowuaru keri aibelekenya iltipot lenyena? Indimidimi naa aataas esidai intae ilootamoo eas entorroni.

English: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
Masaai: Kaaidapash nanu iyie anaa suut, naayaita olkutati oing'uaa olpurkel.

English: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
Masaai: Erubata ino ena, erubata naategelaka nanu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo, amu meekure kidamu iyie nanu nisiliga elejare.

English: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
Masaai: Kangishaa nanu makewan olokesena lino apik shumata enkomom ino, naa kedoli enkurruna ino.

English: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu olminong lino, o eloloito ino o enkisijore ino, o lduruk le loloito ino too nchumat oo ldoinyo o too nkong'at. Oi iyie, Yerusalem! Keaku akenya o anu, eton eitu kintaai sinyati.

English: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
Masaai: Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Yeremia eipirta olameyu:

English: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
Masaai: “Eishirita Yuda netameito nchomito enyena; neishir iltung'ana lenyena etoni te nkop neilep olkiyioi le Yerusalem alo shumata.

English: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak lenyena neirriwaa isinkan lenye meyau enkare; nepuonu ninche nchorroi nelau ninche enkare, nerrinyo ninche too imotioo naarook, etukurrutua ninche neidang'a neimulumul ilukuny enye.

English: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki enkop natabee, enkaraki neitu eshaiki enchan enkop netukurrutua ilaramatak, neimulumul ilukuny enye.

English: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
Masaai: Keituraa ninye enkolii enkuo enye amu meetae nkujit.

English: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
Masaai: Neitashe isirkon ti ong'ata too nkisiajat naaika, neipang'ipang aaok enkijape anaa mbariak neiliilaa nkonyek enye, amu meetae nkujit.

English: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
Masaai: “Ore hoo neishakenoki iyiook entorroni ang, taasa, iyie Olaitoriani tenkaraki enkarna ino, amu eikumok nchukot ang e siadi, kitaasa iyiook ing'ok tialo iyie.

English: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?
Masaai: Iyie losiligi le Israel, Olaitajeunoni lenye te nkata e nyamali kainyoo iyie pee itiu anaa olomoni te nkop, anaa olalotoni oun olng'obor lenye te nkaraki enkewarie.

English: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee itiu anaa iltung'ana oidang'a? anaa oltung'ani ogol lemeidim aitajeusho? Ore eyia, iyie Olaitoriani, itii empolos ang, neipotoki iyiook te nkarna ino; ming'uaa iyiook.”

English: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani tiaalo kulo tung'ana: “Etonyorra ninche aaidapashari aaiko nji, eitu ninche eibooyo nkejek enye; neaku meng'amu ninche Olaitoriani, kedamu ninye entorroni enye neitame ing'ok enye.”

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Miomon tenkaraki olmabarishoi le kulo tung'ana.

English: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Masaai: Ore hoo neen ate aaitupukoo, maning nanu olkiyioi lenye, naa ore hoo neishoru ninche ilasarri oopejori o lasar le ntapa, mang'amu nanu ninche; kake kamut nanu ninche to lalem, o to lameyu o tolmeitai.”

English: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
Masaai: Najo nanu; “Oi Olaitoriani Enkai, ng'ura, ejoki iloibonok ninche, ‘Midolidolo intae olalem arashu itumutumu olameyu, kake kaisho nanu intae eseriani nadede tiatua ene wueji.’ ”

English: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani: “Elejare eibonu lelo oibonok tenkarna ai: eitu nanu airriwaa ninche, neitu nanu aitanap ninche arashu airorie ninche. Kimbonokito ninche iyie enduaata e lejare, o enaibon e pesho, o elejare oo ndamunot enye.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo oibonok ooibonisho te nkarna ai hoo neitu nanu airriwaa ninche, o lelo oojo melotu olalem arashu olameyu ena kop: to lalem o to lameyu emuti lelo oibonok.

English: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana laa ninche eibonoki nenang'ari boo tiatua nkoitoi e Yerusalem, pee ear ninche olameyu o lalem, metii hoo obo onukaa ninche o nkituaak enye, o layiok lenye o ntoyie enye. Amu kabukoki nanu entorroni enye shumata ninche.

English: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
Masaai: “Tiaaki iyie ninche ele rorei: ‘Nchoo nkonyek aainei enang'ari too lkiyio kewarie o ndama, naa nchoo ninche eaku medung'o ae kata, amu ore ina selenkei oo ltung'ana laainei netooshoki aapik olbae sapuk te oshoto sapuk oleng.

English: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
Masaai: Tenaipang nanu alo ong'ata, ng'ura, lekua ootaraki to lalem! tenajing nanu enkang, ng'ura ilootara olameyu! Amu ore pooki oloiboni o lapolosani neas biashara enye te nkop pooki, nemeeta eng'eno.’ ”

English: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
Masaai: Itanya iyie Yuda katukul? ketonyimo oltau lino Sion? Kainyoo iyie pee itoosho iyiook, ometaa meetae olchani te iyiook? King'oru iyiook eseriani, kake meetae esidai naewuo; kisiligu enkata enkishiunoto, naa ng'ura oloputukunyi.

English: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.
Masaai: Kimbalie iyiook entorroni ang, iyie Olaitoriani, o entorroni oo loo papa lang, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki tialo iyie.

English: Do not abhor us, for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkarna ino, minturaa iyiook. Mintadou olorika lino le nkitoo; tadamu nimigil olning'o lino lo sotua tenebo iyiook.

English: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things.
Masaai: Ketii kulie tiatua nena aitin e lejare oo loreren naaidim aayau enchan? Arashu tenaa keidim shumata aishoru enkirujuruj? Aimira iyie ninye, Olaitoriani Enkai ang? Kipik iyiook osiligi lang iyie, amu ias iyie kuna baa pooki.

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani ajoki nanu, “Ore naaji ninye teneitashe Musa o Samuel te dukuya nanu, meibelekenya oltau lai aing'or kulo tung'ana. Taarai ninche meshomo too nkonyek aainei, naa nchoo ninche meshomo!

English: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
Masaai: Ore ake pee kinkilikuan ninche iyie, aajoki, ‘Kaji iyiook kipuo?’ Nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore lelo lo lmeitai nepuo olmeitai, ore lelo laa ilo lalem nepuo enetii olalem ore lelo; laa ilo lameyu, nepuo enetii olameyu, ore lelo laa ile yararoto nepuo eyararoto.” ’

English: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
Masaai: “Kagelaki nanu shumata ninche mpukunot ong'uan oo looidaikie, Olaitoriani ojo: olalem oar, ildien oopolos, olmotonyi lo loing'ang'e o ng'uesi enkop pee emut ninche aaidaikie.

English: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa nanu ninche entoki naitureisho too nkitoriat pooki enkop tenkaraki ina nataasa Manase olayioni le Hesekia, olaiguanani le Yuda tiatua Yerusalem.

English: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?
Masaai: “Kaing'ae liking'urrie iyie oo Yerusalem, arashu kaing'ae likinchiraki iyie? Kaing'ae oibelekenya aikilikuanu olmabarishoi lino?

English: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD, thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.
Masaai: Kitanya iyie nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, iton arrinyo siadi; neaku aaitorioki nanu enkaina ai pee aagilunore naaidaikie iyie, anaure nanu tenkibooroto engoro ai.

English: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
Masaai: Atisila nanu ninche te silet nasilishoreki, too nkang'itie pooki eina kop; aishirie nanu ninche, aidaikie nanu iltung'ana kumok; neitu ninche eibelekenya aaing'uaa nkoitoi enye.

English: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
Masaai: Aitaa nanu esiana oo nkolia enye kumok alang osinyai loo naaiposha; ayaka nanu noo ng'otonye ilmurran ooti olainyalani te nkipirata enkolong; aishoo nanu emion o lkirutoto metadoiki ninche aluam.

English: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina natoiwuo nkera naapishana neiterre; etadoyie enkolong enye eton aa dama; eitukurruaki netusulaki. Ore inkera naatelekutua, naisho metaari to lalem te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.
Masaai: Woi nanu, yieyio lai, amu kitoiwuo nanu, oltung'ani o ekenya okeshare enkop pooki, neitu aisilenisho, kake aadekita ninche pooki.

English: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
Masaai: Metaa nchoo etiu neijia, Olaitoriani, teneitu nanu aaisiaai aitobiraki teneitu nanu aasai iyie terishata oo lmang'ati laainei etii ninche atua enyamali o sina.

English: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
Masaai: Ketii obo oidim atigila esekenkei naing'uaa moikuape o suyai?

English: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
Masaai: “Ore karsisisho ino o lchumati lino naa kaisho metarari, metii enkinyang'a, tenkaraki ing'ok inono pooki, tiatua enkop ino pooki.

English: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.
Masaai: Kaaisho nanu iyie isiaayia ilmang'ati linono tiatua enkop nimiyiolo, amu ore te engoro ai neinuaaki enkima nayupuyup ntarasi.”

English: O LORD, thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.
Masaai: Olaitoriani iyiolo iyie; tadamuaki nanu nikimutan nanu, nintalaku elap tiaalo nanu too laisilisilok laainei. Ore te ng'iriata ino mikiya nanu; tayiolo ajo tenkaraki iyie pee anap imorot.

English: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.
Masaai: Enotoki rorei linono, nanya nanu ninche, neaku irorei linono te nanu eng'ida o enchipai oltau lai; amu te nkarna ino aaipotoki nanu, Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani.

English: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aton to lturrur loo looshipa, ang'ida; atotona nanu openy, amu etii apa enkaina ino shumata nanu, amu kimputa nanu engoro.

English: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee meish emion ai. Nemeishiunoyu olbae lai ketanya eishiunyeki? Itiu iyie te nanu anaa ereyiet nalejisho, anaa nkariak naaishiunye?

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD, If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Tenishukunye, naang'amu nanu, naa intashe iyie te dukuya nanu. Teniro iyie ina sidai, neme ina nara pesho, nitiu iyie anaa enkutuk ai.

English: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaaitaa nanu iyie te kulo tung'ana esuntai nasheta osuyai; nikiarare ninche iyie, kake mikimir ninche iyie, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.
Masaai: Kaakordu nanu iyie aitung'uaa enkaina eilo torrono, naalaku iyie aitung'uaa enkibung'ata eilo lemeeta olng'ur.”

English: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:

English: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.
Masaai: “Miyamisho aashu iiu ilayiok aashu ntoyie tene wueji.

English: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo ilayiok o ntoyie naaini tene wueji, o tiaalo ntomonok naatoiwutuo ninche o lpayian ooiu ninche tiatua ena kop:

English: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: keye ninche too nkeyaitin torrok. Meishirakini ninche, aashu enukari; ketiu ninche anaa emodiei ti oriong enkop, keidak ninche to lalem o to lameyu, ore mpopoki enye neaku endaa too lmotonyi lo loing'ang'e, o too lowuarak le ntim.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD, even lovingkindness and mercies.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Mijing enkaji naishirieki, aashu ilo aishir, aashu aishiraki ninche, amu aiwuang'ie nanu eseriani ai te kulo tung'ana, Olaitoriani ojo, enyorrata ai nauno o lng'ur.

English: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
Masaai: Ore pooki, lkituaak o looti naa kepuo aaye tiatua ena kop; nemenukari ninche, nemeetae hoo obo oishiraki ninche aashu edung'udung kewan aashu ebarn kewan tenkaraki ninche.

English: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo onya emukate eilo oishir, pee eitigir teilo otua; aashu eetae hoo oloisho ninye enkikompe enkitagoloto metooko tenkaraki menye lenye aashu ng'otonye.

English: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
Masaai: Milo iyie atua enkaji osirua aton tenebo ninche; adaa niokisho.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: ng'ura kaisho nanu meishunye tene wueji, te dukuya nkonyek inyi o too nkolong'i inyi, oltoilo le ng'ida, oltoilo le nchipai, oltoilo lo loyamisho oltoilo le nayami.

English: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?
Masaai: “Naa tiniliki iyie kulo tung'ana kulo omon, nikijoki ninche iyie, ‘Kainyoo pee etudung'oko iyiook Olaitoriani ena torroni kitok? Kainyoo entorroni ang? Kainyoo eng'oki nikitaasa iyiook to laitoriani Enkai ang?’

English: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
Masaai: Nijoki iyie ninche: ‘Enkaraki naatung'uaitie iloo papaai linyi nanu Olaitoriani ojo, nepuo aasujaa kulie aitin neisiayia neserem ninche, naaing'uaa nanu neitu eibung enkitanapata ai,

English: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
Masaai: naa ore enkaraki nitaasa intae entorroni nalang enoo loo papaai linyi, amu ng'ura, etusuja ake pooki ng'ae te intae engolong'u enye torrono, eany aaning nanu;

English: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
Masaai: metaa kanangaa nanu intae aitung'uaa ena kop apik atua enkop nimiyiololo nemeyiolo apa loo papaai linyi, ore teine nitum taa aisiaayia kulie aitin dama o kewarie, amu maaisho nanu iyie omom!

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
Masaai: “Metaa, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitokini aajo, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani laa ninye oyaua ailepunye iltung'ana le Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri.’

English: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
Masaai: Kake ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani laa ninye oyawua iltung'ana loo Siraeli aitung'uaa enkop e moikuape o nkuapi apa pooki naaterewa ninche.’ Amu kayau nanu ninche ashuku meetu enkop enye ate apa naishoo loo papaai lenye.

English: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kairriwu nanu ilarreshok kumok loo sinkir, Olaitoriani ojo naa kerresh ninche; ore te siadi nairriu ilang'orok kumok loo ng'uesi, naa keng'or ninche te pooki doinyo o te pooki oigululu, o too nchumat oo ndapidapo.

English: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.
Masaai: Amu etii nkonyek aainei shumata nkoitoi enye pooki, meisudoo ninche te nanu, nemeisudoro entorroni enye too nkonyek aainei.

English: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
Masaai: Naa kaitalaku nanu katitin are entorroni enye o eng'oki enye enkaraki naituruja enkop ai too mpopoki oo nkitaanyaanyukot, neiputa ninche enjung'ore ai nena o lminong lenye.”

English: O LORD, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, engolon ai naa osempewuet, naa esarunoto ai te nkolong e nyamali enitii iyie epuonu iloreren. Eing'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop nepuonu aajo: “Eitu ejung loo papaai toki neme elejare, o ntokitin e pesho nemeeta dupoto.

English: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
Masaai: Keidim oltung'ani aitobiraki kewan nkaitin? Ore kuna mme nkaitin!”

English: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD.
Masaai: “Metaa, ng'ura, kaisho nanu ninche metayiolo, ore ena kata nabo kaisho ninche metayioloito engolon ai o enkidimata ai, naa keyiolou ninche aajo ore enkarna ai naa Olaitoriani.”

English: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
Masaai: “Eigeroki eng'oki e Yuda te nkalamu e sekenkei, ore te ntopij e almasi, etisiraki te mbao oltau lenye, o too mowuarak oo lperereni lenye loo lasarri.

English: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
Masaai: Ina kata edamu nkera enye ilperereni lenye loo lasarri o enkai enye naji Asherim, te mbata e pooki shani onyori, o te nchumata e pooki doinyo adoru,

English: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.
Masaai: too nchumat oo ldoinyo te nkop naisiaja. Ore karsisisho ino o lchumat linono pooki kaisho metaari anaa enkinyang'a eng'oki ino, tiatua enkop ino pooki.

English: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.
Masaai: Iorore iyie enjung'ore ino apa naaishoo, naa kaaisho nanu iyie isiaayia ilmang'ati linono tiatua enkop nimiyiolo, amu ore te ngoro ai, neinuaaki enkima nayupuyup ntarasi.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ediaa oltung'ani oisilig iltung'ana neitaa osesen le tung'ani emasaai o larrabal. Ilo oibelekeny oltau lenye aitung'uaa Olaitoriani.

English: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
Masaai: Etiu ninye anaa enkiti shani nabulu olpurkel, nemedol ninye ae sidai elotu. Keton ninye too worro tiong'ota, te nkop naisukut nememanya.

English: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
Masaai: “Emayiana ilo tung'ani oisilig Olaitoriani, otii osiligi lenye atua Olaitoriani.

English: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
Masaai: Etiu ninye anaa olchani otunoki te mbata enkare, oreu ntona enyena embata olkeju, nemeureishoyu tenelotu enkirowuaj, amu ketoni ake mbenek enyena enyori, nemesi ninye te nkata olameyu, amu mepal ae kata ninye meiu ilng'anayio.”

English: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
Masaai: Olalejani oltau alang ntokitin pooki, naa torrono oleng. Kaing'ae oidim atayiolo ninye?

English: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
Masaai: “Kajur nanu Olaitoriani ndamunot natem oltau, pee aisho pooki tung'ani te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena te risioroto oo lng'anayio loo nkiaasin enyena.”

English: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
Masaai: Anaa enkurlee naiturrur nkera neitu edanyu, neijia eikununo ilo otum karsisisho kake mme te sipata; ore te mpolos oo nkolong'i enyena neing'uaa ninche ninye, ore te nkiting'oto enye neaku olmodai.

English: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
Masaai: Olorika le nkitoo le nkisisa otipikaki apa shumata ebaiki enkiterunoto, ninye ewueji ang sinyati.

English: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD, the fountain of living waters.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani osiligi le Israel, ore pooki liking'uaa iyie netum enkurruna; ore lelo likimbelekenya aaing'uaa iyie, neigeri tiatua enkop, too kulukuok amu etanyaita ninche Olaitoriani, ina ong'u enkare naishu.

English: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.
Masaai: Nchiunyeki nanu Olaitoriani, naa kaishiu; ntajeuoki naa kajeu; amu ira iyie enkisisa ai.

English: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaajoki ninche nanu, “Koree ororei oing'uaa Olaitoriani? nchoo elotu!”

English: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.
Masaai: Eitu nanu aaitirrishaki iyie pee irriu entorroni, neitu nanu ang'uar enkolong e mutai, iyiolo iyie; ore ina napuku tiatua enkutuk ai netii dukuya enkomom ino.

English: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.
Masaai: Meaku olkirutoto te nanu; ira iyie esarunoto ai te nkolong entorroni.

English: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
Masaai: Nchoo metukurru lelo laaisilisil nanu, kake mikincho nanu aaitukurruni. Nchoo ninche eirut, kake mikincho nanu airut! Intadoiki ninche enkolong entorroni; ingilie ninche kat are enkidaata.

English: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
Masaai: Nji aatiaaka nanu Olaitoriani: “Shomo ntasho te nkishomi e Benchamen, naa ninye ejing'unye ilaiguanak le Yuda naa ninye eipang'ie, o too nchomito pooki e Yerusalem,

English: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
Masaai: nijo, ‘Entoning ororei lo laitoriani intae ilaiguanak le Yuda, o Yuda pooki, o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem, oojing'u te kuna shomito.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: entorripoto tenkaraki enkishui inyi, niminapinapa olola te nkolong e sabato aashu iimunyenye nchomito e Yerusalem.

English: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
Masaai: Niminapinapa olola aaitayu too nkajijik inyi te nkolong e sabato aashu iasiasa ae siaai, kake entaa enkolong e sabato sinyati, anaa apa enaitanapa loo papaai linyi.

English: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu apa ninche ening'isho neitu eishoru enkiok enye, kake etogolong'utua, pee mening nemeng'amu inkiteng'enat.

English: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
Masaai: “ ‘Kake tenikining'ining'i intae nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, nimintijing'ung'u olola too nchomito ena anasa te nkolong e sabato, kake nintaa enkolong e sabato sinyati nimiasishosho teina olong,

English: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
Masaai: netum aaimu nchomito ena anasa ilaiguanak ootonie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi, ekedito ngarrin oo mbartan o mbartan, ninche o lkituaak lenye, lelo tung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem; nemanyi ena anasa ntarasi.
