English: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa nkang'itie e Yuda o wuejitin neemanita Yerusalem, eing'uaa enkop e Benchamen, eing'uaa Shefela, eing'uaa ina kop oo ldoinyo, o looing'ua negeb, eyau ilasarri oopejori o nkishorot, nkishorot e nkurma o lbani, neyau nkishorot e nashe enkaji Olaitoriani.

English: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Kake tenimikining'ining'i intae nanu, aaitaa enkolong e sabato sinyati, niminapinapa olola niimumu nchomito e Yerusalem te nkolong e sabato, nainok nanu enkima too nchomito enyena, naa kemut nkajijik e nkitoo e Yerusalem nemeari ae kata.’ ”

English: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei ninye oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.
Masaai: “Tudumunye tadoi shomo enkaji o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok ore tene naaisho nanu iyie toning'o irorei laainei.”

English: Then I went down to the potter's house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
Masaai: Nadoyio nanu alo enkaji o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok, ore teine neasisho ninye te nkeju enye engarri.

English: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
Masaai: Ore apa ina masaai naitobirita ninye te nkulukuoni nerruoyo te nkaina o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok, neitoki aitobir aitayunye enkae masaai, anaa enadol o laitobirani too ntokitin oo nkulupuok enaa enadol aa sidai te neas.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii ejo:

English: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
Masaai: “Na aji e Israel, aimaidim nanu aikuna te intae anaa enaikuna ele aitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok? Olaitoriani ojo: ng'ura, ore anaa esarng'ab te nkaina o laitobirani loo ntokitin oo nkulupuok neijia itiuu intae te nkaina ai, na aji e Israel.

English: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
Masaai: Ore te pooki kata tenaibalunye tialo olosho aashu enkitoria, nchere kadotu nagil nainyal,

English: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
Masaai: naa ore ilo osho, laa tialo ninye airoro, teneibelekenya aing'uaa entorroni enye, nairridu ina torroni apa natejo kaitaas ninye.

English: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
Masaai: Naa ore te pooki kata tenaibalunye nanu tialo olosho aashu enkitoria nchere kashet naun ninye,

English: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
Masaai: naa teneas entorroni too nkonyek aainei, mening oltoilo lai, nairridu nanu teina sidai natejo pee aitaas ninye.

English: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
Masaai: Ore naa, tiaaki iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura, aitobirita entorroni tialo iyie naipiru enkitobirata tialo intae. Tushukunye, pooki ng'ae aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, nintobiriri nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi.’

English: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
Masaai: “Kake ejo ninche, ‘Pesho ina! Kisuj iyiook nkitobirat ang maate, neas pooki ng'ae te risioroto engolon oltau lenye torrono.’

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
Masaai: “Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: Nkilikuanu tiatua iloreren, kaing'ae otoning'o enanyaanyukie ena? Etaasa ina tito selenkei e Israel embae suuji oleng.

English: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
Masaai: Kepal enturoto e Lebanon endapidapoi e Sirion? Ketoyu nena ariak o ldoinyo naaimu lelo yerat ooirobi?

English: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
Masaai: Kake maadamu nanu iltung'ana laainei, epejoki ninche enkorropil nkaitin e lejare; netarrorrote ninche tiatua nkoitoi enye, too ilbaribarani musan, neshomo aaim nkoitoi naangel mme enkoitoi kitok,

English: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
Masaai: eitaa enkop enye enaitureisho, entoki naing'asiakinie intarasi. Ore pooki ng'ae oim embata neiputukuny neipirripir elukunya enye.

English: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
Masaai: Anaa osiwuo ogol le nkilepunoto enkolong kaidapash nanu ninche te dukuya olmang'atinta. Kaisho nanu ninche oriong ai, mme omom ai, te nkolong enye o sina.”

English: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Wootu, maitaikiti iyiook Yeremia irresheta, amu merruoyo enkitanapata to lapolosani, aashu enkiguana to lang'eni, aashu ororei to loiboni. Wootu, matar ninye to lng'ejep, nimikining iyiook hoo obo loo rorei lenyena.”

English: Give heed to me, O LORD, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
Masaai: Ng'uraki nanu Olaitoriani, nining olkiyioi lai.

English: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.
Masaai: Kentorroni elakieki esidai? Ore eyia etuturutuo ninche engumoto tenkaraki enkishui ai. Tadamu ina naitasho te dukuya iyie pee airo esidai tenkaraki ninche, pee aibelekeny aiwuang'ie aitung'uaa ninche.

English: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
Masaai: Neaku iwa nkera enye meshomo aatum olameyu; nchooi ninche meshomo engolon empijan olalem, nchoo nkituaak enye eaku olupeno o nkolia. Metanang'are ilewa lenye keeya to lmeitai, metaari eleleroenye to lalem to larrabal.

English: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
Masaai: Metoning'ori olkiyioi eing'uaa nkajijik enye, tiniyau iyie lelo ooarr ninche metuata te luamata! Amu etuturutuo ninche engumoto pee aaya nanu, neirragakinye nkejek aainei irresheta.

English: Yet, LORD, thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.
Masaai: Ore eyia, iyiolo iyie Olaitoriani ilnukat lenye laarieki nanu matua. Mipalaki ninche entorroni enye, nimijut eng'oki enye too nkonyek inono. Nchoo ninche metanang'ari te dukuya iyie; ntaasa ninche te nkata engoro ino.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Go and get a potter's earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
Masaai: Nji etejo Olaitoriani, “Shomo, inyiang'u endukuny o laitobirani loo nkulupuok, niya embata oo lpayiani loo ltung'ana o embata oo lapolosak kituaak,

English: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,
Masaai: nimpang alo oyarata lo layioni le Hinom tenejing'ieki enkishomi e Poshed, nimbalunye teine lelo rorei laaliki nanu.

English: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
Masaai: Nijo iyie, ‘Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae ilaiguanak le Yuda oloomanya Yerusalem. Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, ng'ura kayau nanu entorroni shumata ene wueji ometaa ore nkiyiaa e pooki ng'ae oning ena neng'eyu.

English: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
Masaai: Enkaraki naatung'uaitie nanu iltung'ana, neisarkione ninche ene wueji etapejokito enkorropil tiatua ine kulie aitin neitu eyiolou ninche arashu iloomenye arashu ilaiguanak le Yuda; o enkaraki naiputa ninche ene wueji osarge le lelo lemeeta ntiot,

English: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
Masaai: netesheta iwuejitin neeika e Baal pee epejie ilayiok lenye te nkima anaa ilasarri oopejori te Baal, lelo leitu nanu aitanapisho aashu alimu, neitu ejing atua endamunoto ai,

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
Masaai: ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitokini aajo ene wueji Tofet, aashu oyarata lo layioni le Hinom, kake oyarata le sesekuanare o lalem.

English: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: Naa ore tiatua ene wueji kainyal nanu nkitobirat e Yuda o Yerusalem, naisho ene metabatatayu to lalem te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, o te nkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye kaisho nanu mpopoki enye metaa endaa oo motonyi oloing'ang'e o ng'uesi enkop.

English: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
Masaai: Naitaa nanu ena anasa entoki naitureisho, entoki naing'asiakinoi; ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo ninye neiputukuny neing'asia tenkaraki enkidaaroto enye pooki.

English: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
Masaai: Naisho nanu meinosa ninche nkiri oo layiok lenye o noo ntoyie enye, nenya pooki ng'ae nkiri e ilo lelatia enye emanitae ninche o to sina, opik ninche ilmang'ati lenye, o lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye neisomit ninche.’

English: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,
Masaai: “Nibel iyie ina dukuny te dukuya lelo tung'ana oopuo tenebo iyie!

English: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter's vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
Masaai: Nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Neaku kadanyidany nanu kulo tung'ana o ena anasa anaa enadany oltung'ani entoki oo nkulupuok, o metaa meigili ae kata aaram. Nenukaa iltung'ana ninye te Tofet amu meitokini aata ewueji nenukarieki.

English: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
Masaai: Nji nanu aitaas ene wueji, Olaitoriani ojo, o lelo oomanya, aitotiu ena anasa anaa Tofet.

English: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
Masaai: Ore nkajijik e Yerusalem o nkajijik oo laiguanak le Yuda nena ajijik pooki naatapejorieki enkorropil inchumat enye tenkaraki olorora pooki le shumata neibukorieki ilasarri ooki tenkaraki nkulie aitin naa keisarkionieki anaa ewueji e Tofet.’ ”

English: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD'S house; and said to all the people,
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia alotu eing'uaa Tofet, ine apa neirriwayie Olaitoriani ninye meshomo aibonisho, neitashe ninye to lgoriet le nkaji e Nkai, nejoki ninye iltung'ana pooki:

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, ng'ura kayaki nanu shumata ena anasa o shumata nkang'itie enyena ina torroni, pooki natejo kaitaas ninye, enkaraki naitagolo ninche lukuny enye, eany ening irorei laainei.”

English: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
Masaai: Nening apa Pashur olapolosani, olayioni le Imer, laa ninye apa olkitok tiatua enkaji Olaitoriani, Yeremia eibonisho te kuna baa.

English: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Near Pashur Yeremia, oloiboni le Nkai, neeniki ninye lelo pisia apa ootii shumata kishomi e Benchamen te nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.
Masaai: Ore taisere, ina kata elaku Pashur Yeremia aitayu too lpisia, nejoki Yeremia ninye, “Mikintoki iyie Olaitoriani ajo enkarna ino Pashur, kake enkuretisho te pooki shoto.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu enkuretisho te kewan ino o too lchoreta linono pooki. Kebatata ninche to lalem loo lmang'ati lenye ing'orita iyie. Naa kaishooyo Yuda pooki apik atua enkaina o laiguanani le Babilon; neya ninye ninche eyararoto te Babilon near ninche to lalem.

English: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore sii, kaishooyo nanu karsisisho pooki ena anasa, dupoto enye pooki, nena masaa enyena pooki naagol enkinyang'a, o nena masaa pooki naashuma o laiguanak le Yuda apik atua nkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, pee eya ninche pooki nenap aaya Babilon.

English: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.
Masaai: Ore iyie, Pashur, o lelo pooki ootoni tiatua enkaji ino nipuopuo eyararoto; Babilon intae ipuopuo; naa teine ipuopuo aaye, naa teine kipuoi aanukaa, iyie o lchoreta linono pooki, apa limbonoko te lejare.”

English: O LORD, thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.
Masaai: Iyie, Olaitoriani, kiteleja iyie nanu; nateleje nanu; igol iyie alang nanu, isula iyie. Ataa nanu entoki nakueniyieki endama pooki; naamor nanu pooki ng'ae.

English: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
Masaai: Amu ore ake anaa enairo nanu, naishir, nabuaku ajo, “Olarrabal o enkidaaroto!” Amu etotiwuo ororei lo laitoriani te nanu anaa emoroto o enkitang'oroto! endama pooki.

English: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
Masaai: Tenajo nanu, “Maitoki aimaki ninye, arashu aigil airo te nkarna enye.” Nejing atua oltau lai anaa enatiu enkima nayupuyup naikenoro tiatua iloik laainei, nanaure nanu ajo aibookino, nemaidim nanu.

English: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
Masaai: Amu aning'ito nanu ing'omakinot kumok. Etii enkuretisho pooki shoto! “Intang'oro ninye! Maitang'oro iyiook ninye!” Tejo ore ilchoreta laainei latamoore, neanyita embatatata ai. “Ekeidimi aatelej ninye, nikisulie iyiook ninye, nikintalaku iyiook elap te ninye.”

English: But the LORD is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
Masaai: Kake etii Olaitoriani tenebo nanu anaa olmurrani opi, neaku keikirikira lelo laaisilisil nanu, maaidimu ninche nanu. Keitukurruni ninche oleng, amu medupayu ninche, ore ina nemeyanyitisho ninche nemerikinishoi ae kata.

English: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.
Masaai: Olaitoriani loo lororani, laa iyie otem olasipani kaing'ae odol oltau o ndamunot, nchooki nanu matoduaa elap ino te shumata ninche, amu iyie nanu atipika mbaa aainei.

English: Sing unto the LORD, praise ye the LORD: for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
Masaai: Entaranyaki Olaitoriani; esisa Olaitoriani! Amu eitajewuo enkishui eilo omena, aitung'uaa nkaik oo laasak loo ntorrok.

English: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
Masaai: Metedeki ina olong apa naatoiwuoki! Ina olong apa naatoiwuo yieyio nanu. Nchoo metaa memayiana!

English: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
Masaai: Metedeki ilo tung'ani, apa oyaka papaai lai ilomon ajoki, “Kitoikioki olayioni” aitiship ninye oleng.

English: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
Masaai: Nchoo ilo tung'ani metotiwuo anaa nkanas naaibelekenya Olaitoriani metii olng'ur; nchoo ninye ening olkiyioi tadekenya oltoilo le batisho dama,

English: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
Masaai: amu eitu apa aar ninye nanu matua te nguset; neaku anaata apa etaa yieyioo enkurare ai, nebik enguset aa kitok intarasi.

English: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
Masaai: Kainyoo apa pee atupukuo te nguset alotu adol enyamali o sina, naton nkolong'i aainei te nkurruna?

English: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani, ina kata apa pee eirriwaki ninye olaiguanani Sedekia Pashur olayioni le Malkia o Sefania olapolosani, Maasia, ejo,

English: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
Masaai: “Inkilikuanishore Olaitoriani tialo iyiook, amu eitobirita Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon olarrabal pee earare iyiook; eidim Olaitoriani aitaasa iyiook te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena e nking'asia, neisho ninye metorrinyoyu aing'uaa iyiook.”

English: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia ajoki ninche:

English: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
Masaai: “Nji intae entiaaki Sedekia, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, Kashuku nanu nena masaa o larrabal naatii atua nkaik inyi naa te ninche iararere olaiguanani le Babilon niaararere Ilkaldayo oomanita intae tioriong isunta; naa kayau nanu ninche tenebo atua empolos ena anasa.

English: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
Masaai: Nanu enkorrok ai oarare intae te nkaina naitoriori o enkaina nagol, te ngoro, o te mpushuna, o te ngoro kitok.

English: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
Masaai: Naa kaosh nanu lelo oomanya ena anasa, oltung'ani o eng'ues, keye ninche to lmeitai kitok nepi.

English: And afterward, saith the LORD, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
Masaai: Ore te siadi, Olaitoriani ojo, naisho nanu Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, o sinkan lenyena, o ltung'ana ootii ena anasa, ooleku lmeitai to olalem, o lameyu, naisho nanu metaarai enkaina e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o te nkaina oo lmang'ati lenye, atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye. Keosh ninyeninche te nepi o lalem, meing'urrie ninye ninche, aashu epal ninche, aashu eeta olng'ur.’

English: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
Masaai: “Ore tialo kulo tung'ana tiaaki iyie: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, Kapik nanu dukuya iyie enkoitoi enkishui o enkoitoi e keeya.

English: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
Masaai: Ore ilo oton tiatua ena anasa neye to lalem, o to lameyu, o to lmeitai; kake ore ilo oipang alo neisho kewan lelo kaldayo oo manita intae nepok netiu enkishui enye anaa enkishoroto olarrabal.

English: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
Masaai: Amu eitu nanu aarare ena anasa aarare te ntorroni neme te sidai, Olaitoriani ojo; keishoori ninye aapik atua enkaina olaiguanani le Babilon, naa kepejoo ninye te nkima.’

English: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
Masaai: “Ore tialo enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda tejo, ‘Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani,

English: O house of David, thus saith the LORD; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
Masaai: na aji e Daudi! Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Tudung'o enkiguana te sipata tadekenya, niyau aitung'uaa enkaina e ilo oitorogonyisho ilo oitorongonyaki mepuku ake engoro ai anaa enkima, neyupuyup nemeetae oltung'ani oidim atara, tenkaraki nkiaasin inyi torrok.

English: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the LORD; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaarare nanu intae, iloomanya oyarata, iyie nadapidapoi enkisiajata, Olaitoriani ojo; intae oojo, Kaing'ae oidim atadou ataarare iyiook, aashu kaing'ae oidim atijing'a emanyisho ang?’

English: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
Masaai: Kaitame nanu intae te risioroto oo lng'anayio loo nkiaasin inyi, Olaitoriani ojo kainok nanu enkima tiatua entim enye, naa kemut ninye ina pooki namanita ninye.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Tadoi shomo enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda, niro teine ele rorei,

English: And say, Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:
Masaai: nijo, Toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani la aiguanani le Yuda, ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi; iyie o sinkan linono, o ltung'ana linono ooimu kuna shomito.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Taasa esipata o esupatisho, intayu te nkaina e ilo oitorogonyisho ilo oitorogonyaki. Niminyalinyala aashu iariara olomoni, o lokishi, o enkoliai, aashu imbukoo osarge lemetii entioto tene wueji.

English: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
Masaai: Amu esipa tinimbung ele rorei, neimu ilgorieti lena aji ilaiguanak ootonie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi, ekedito ngarrin oo mbartan o mbartan, ninche o sinkan lenye, o ltung'ana lenye.

English: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD, that this house shall become a desolation.
Masaai: Kake tinimining kulo rorei, ainosa olmumai te kewan ai, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere ore ena aji naa keaku mijooni.

English: For thus saith the LORD unto the king's house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda: Ira iyie sidai anaa Gilead te nanu, itiu iyie anaa endukuya e oldoinyo le Lebanon kake esipa kaaitaa nanu iyie olpurkel o enkanasa neme manya.

English: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
Masaai: Kairriu nanu ilainyalak likiarare iyie, oltung'ani ake o masaa enyena o larrabal naa kedung ninche iltarakua inono gelunot nenang'aki ninche atua enkima.

English: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?
Masaai: “Naa kegiroo iloreren kumok ena anasa, nejoki ake pooki ng'ae olelatia enye, Kainyoo pee etaasa Olaitoriani ena tena anasa kitok?”

English: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.
Masaai: Naa kewaliki ninche aajo, “Enkaraki natung'uaitie ninche osotua lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, neserem kulie aitin neisiaai ninche.”

English: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
Masaai: Minchirakiki ninye ilo otua aashu isinanuo tenkaraki ninye kake nchirakiki te mion ilo olo, amu meitoki ninye ashukunye adol enkop enye.

English: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo Shalom olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, laa ninye oitoreisho te rishata e Yosia papaai lenye. Naa ninye oshomo aing'uaa ewueji enye: “Meitoki aekata ninye ashukunye ene,

English: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
Masaai: kake tiatua ine wueji netanapaki ninye aaya eyararoto, teine eye ninye, nemeitoki ae kata ninye aigil adol ena kop.”

English: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour's service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;
Masaai: “Woi ninye ilo oshet enkaji enye te ntorroni, o nkajijik enyena e shumata te lejare ilo oisho olelatia enye meisiaayia ninye te mpesho, nemeisho ninye olmushaara lenye;

English: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
Masaai: ilo ojo, ‘Kashetaki nanu kewan enkaji sapuk tenebo inkajijik e shumata naalala’ naguetaki ilusien ninye neikod ninye too ltarakua, nael toranki onyokie.

English: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
Masaai: Ijo iyie ira olaiguanani enkaraki nishet inkajijik oo ltarakua? Keitu apa edaa papaai lino neokisho neas esipata o esupatisho? Neaku etaa sidai te ninye.

English: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Eiguanare ninye mbaa olaisinani ono lomena; neaku sidai. Aime nanu eyiolo tena? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
Masaai: Kake iata iyie inkonyek o oltau, tenkaraki ake, dupoto o e lejare o te nkibukoroto o sarge lemeeta entioto, o easata enkitorogonyare o larrabal.”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda: “Meishiraki ninche ninye ejo, oi olalashe lai! aashu ejo oi enkanashe ai!

English: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Meishiraki ninche ninye ejo, oi olkitok, anaa ejo oi oloyanyiti! kenukari ninye anaa osikiria, eing'irtitori nenang'ari aaitogiroo nchomito e Yerusalem.”

English: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.
Masaai: “Ilepa shomo Lebanon, niyietu aishir, ailepunye oltoilo lino tiatua Bashan; nchira te Abarim, amu ore lelo sanchan linono pooki neidaikieki.

English: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.
Masaai: Aairorie nanu iyie tiatua karsisisho ino, kake itejo iyie, ‘Mainining nanu.’ Ena apa nataa enkoitoi ino ebaiki lelero ino, nchere eitu iyie ining oltoilo lai.

English: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.
Masaai: Keirrita olkutati ilchekuti linono pooki, ore isanchan linono pooki nepuo eyararoto; nitum taa atukurru nindang te nkaraki entorroni ino pooki.

English: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
Masaai: Iyie olomanya Lebanon oton tiatua iltarakua kebaa sii iyie enkigoroto tenelotu emion shumata iyie, emion naikununo anaa ene nkitok nasaisai!”

English: As I live, saith the LORD, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;
Masaai: “Ore anaa enaishu Olaitoriani ojo, hoo naa ore Konia olayioni le Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda, naa olgisoi omishirakino enkarna ai te nkaina ai e tatene, ore ake eyia, aidim nanu atopolosai

English: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
Masaai: naaishooyo iyie apik atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui ino, lelo liure iyie naapik atua enkaina e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o atua nkaik oo Lkaldayo.

English: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
Masaai: Kaanang'aa nanu iyie o ina ng'utunyi nikitoiwuo iyie anang'aki atua ae kop, ine neitu apa kiinieki, naa teine ilo iyie aye.

English: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
Masaai: Kake ore ina kop nang'uar ninche pee eshukokino, meshukokino ninche.”

English: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
Masaai: Amaa ele tung'ani oji Konia kemoti natemenayioki natadanye, entoki nemeshilaa hoo ng'ae? Kainyoo paa ore ninye o nkera enyena netanang'ayioki aaiturraa tiatua enkop nemeyiolo ninche?

English: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Iyie na kop, na kop, na kop, toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ngero ele tung'ani ajo meeta nkera, ele tung'ani lemedupoyu too nkolong'i enyena; amu meetae hoo obo tiatua eishoi enye odupoyu atonie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi, neitoki aitoreisho te Yuda.”

English: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Oi kulo shekuti ooidaikie neidapash ntare enkirrita ai?” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, tialo lelo shekuti ooing'or iltung'ana laainei: “Indapasha intae eluaata ai, nitaaraitie ninche meshomo, neitu intae ing'oring'oro ninche. Ng'ura, kaitame nanu intae te nkaraki nkiaasin inyi torrok, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
Masaai: Naitoki taa aiturrur olpisiai le luaata ai aitung'uaa nena kuapi apa naterewa ninche naa kepuo neponari.

English: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kapik nanu ilchekuti shumata ninche laa ninche ooing'or ninche, nemeitoki aikata aaureisho, arashu aaiputukuny, nemeitoki hoo nabo aimin, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee atum ailepakinye Daudi olng'osila le supatisho, naa keitoreisho anaa olaiguanani neasisho te ng'eno, nedung enkiguana te sipata o te supatisho te nkop.

English: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
Masaai: Ore tiatua nkolong'i enyena neitajeuni Yuda, nebik Israel te seriani. Naa ena enkarna naa ninye eipotieki ninye, ‘Olaitoriani esupatisho ang.’

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
Masaai: “Neaku, ng'ura kepounu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nemeitoki iltung'ana aajo, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani oitayio iltung'ana le Israel ailepunye te nkop e Misiri,’

English: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
Masaai: kake, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani oitayio nerikoo eishoi e nkaji e Israel aitung'uaa enkop e moikuape oatua nkuapi apa naaterewa ninye ninche.’ Netum taa aatobik tiatua enkop enye maate.”

English: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
Masaai: Ore tiatua iloibonok: Aatigile oltau lai tiatua nanu, keikirikira iloik laainei pooki; atiu nanu anaa oltung'ani otemere, anaa oltung'ani oidimua enaisho, te nkaraki Olaitoriani o te nkaraki irorei lenyena sinyat.

English: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
Masaai: Amu ebore enkop iloololoito; ore te nkaraki oldeket neishir enkop, ore nkujit naanyori e ong'ata neitoi. Ore olkuaak lenye naa entorroni, ore engolon enye neme sidai.

English: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore pokira oloiboni o lapolosani neme ilorrekie le Nkai; ore ninye tiatua enkaji ai nanoto entorroni enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku ketiu enkoitoi enye te ninche anaa enkoitoi naideket te naimin, atua ninye emirakini ninche nebatata amu kayau nanu entorroni shumata ninche tiatua ilo ari le nkitamioto enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
Masaai: Ore tiatua iloibonok le Samaria atoduaa nanu entoki e modai eibonishote ninche te Baal nerik iltung'ana laainei Israeli aaitapong'oo.

English: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
Masaai: Kake ore tiatua iloibonok le Yerusalem atoduaa nanu entoki suuji: eas ninche eloloito nepuo te lejare; eitagol ninche inkaik oo laasak loo ntorrok, metaa meetae hoo obo oibelekenya aing'uaa nkiaasin enyena torrok; etotiutuo ninche pooki anaa Sodom te nanu, neikununo anaa lelo oomanya Gomora.”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani tialo iloibonok: “Ng'ura kaitoti nanu ninche te sayiet, naisho ninche enkare natipikaki esayiet metooko; amu iloibonok le Yerusalem etupukunye orrekie leme ole Nkai alo enkop pooki.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of the LORD.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Mining iyie, irorei leilo oiboni likimbonoki iyie nikimput iyie inkisilagat e pesho; eiro ninche induaat oo ndamunot enye, mme naaing'uaa enkutuk o Laitoriani.

English: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
Masaai: Ejoki ninche anaake lelo lemeshilaa ororei lo laitoriani, ‘Ekesidanu te intae’ nejoki pooki ng'ae ogolung'u osuj oltau lenye ake, ‘Metii entorroni nalotu shumata iyie.’ ”

English: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard it?
Masaai: Amu kaing'ae tiatua ninche oitasho tiatua enkiguana o Laitoriani pee emusu nening ororei lenye aashu aing'ae oibung'a ororei lenye neinining?

English: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
Masaai: Ng'ura, osiwuo lo Laitoriani! eipang'ua engoro napi enye o lkutati ogol kedanyakino ninye elukunya e ilo torrono.

English: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
Masaai: Meshuko engoro o Laitoriani ometaba anaa nedung ninye enkiguana neitabaya iyieunot endamunoto enye. Ore too nkolong'i e siadi naa iyiolou iyie aibalie.

English: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
Masaai: “Eitu nanu airriwaa iloibonok, kake ekueta ninche, eitu nanu airorie ninche, kake eibonishote ninche.

English: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
Masaai: Kake tenaa naaji keitasheito ninche te nkiguana ai, anaata etolimutuo irorei laainei too ltung'ana laainei, naa anaata aibelekenya ninche metung'uai nkoitoi enye torrok, o entorroni oo nkiaasin enye.

English: Am I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
Masaai: “Ara nanu Enkai nataana, Olaitoriani ojo, neme Enkai nalakua?

English: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Keidim oltung'ani aisudoi kewan too wuejitin oo nkisudorot pee madol nanu ninye? Olaitoriani ojo. Eimaborei nanu shumata o enkop? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu enatejo lelo oibonok ooibonisho te lejare te nkarna ai, ejo, ‘Aidetideta nanu, aidetideta nanu!’

English: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
Masaai: Keaku kenya elejare o nanu tiatua oltau le lelo oibonok ooibonu elejare oltau lenye maate,

English: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
Masaai: lelo oojo maishoo iltung'ana laainei erikino enkarna ai te nena kidetidetat enye naa ninche ejokino maate, anaa apa enatorikine loo menye enkarna ai tenkaraki Baal?

English: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nchoo ilo oiboni oata enkidetidet elimu enkidetidet, kake nchoo ilo oata ororei lai elimu ororei lai te sipata. Kainyoo ebaikino mbenek o enkano? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
Masaai: Aimetiu ororei lai anaa enkima, Olaitoriani ojo, netiu anaa enyuntu nabelibel endapidapoi?

English: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
Masaai: Neaku, ng'ura, kagilunore nanu iloibonok, Olaitoriani ojo, lelo oopurro to rorei laainei te ninche maate.

English: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaarare nanu lelo oibonok, Olaitoriani ojo, oasishore ilng'ejepa lenye nejo, ‘Olaitoriani ojo.’

English: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kaarare nanu lelo ooibonu enkidetidetat e lejare, Olaitoriani ojo, laa ninche oojoki ninche nerikoo iltung'ana laainei aaitapong'oo te lejare enye o te nkitokoos enye, eitu nanu airriwaa ninche aashu aitanap ninche; metaa meret ninche ele orere katukul, olaitoriani ojo.

English: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What is the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Tinikinkilikuan iyie oltung'ani obo te kulo aashu oloiboni, aashu olapolosani, ajoki, ‘Kainyoo olola lo Laitoriani?’ Tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Ntae ilo ola, naa kanang'aa intae aiturraa, Olaitoriani ojo.’

English: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
Masaai: Naa ore tialo oloiboni, olapolosani aashu obo loo ltung'ana ojo, ‘Olola lo Laitoriani’ naitame nanu ilo tung'ani o enkaji enye.

English: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
Masaai: Nji iyie tejo, ore pooki ng'ae to lelatia enye o pooki ng'ae to lalashe lenye, ‘Kainyoo etawalua olaitoriani ajo?’ aashu ‘Kainyoo eiroro Olaitoriani?’

English: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
Masaai: Kake ore ‘Olola lo Laitoriani’ mingil aekata aimaki, amu ore ilo ola naa ororei le pooki ng'ae makewan, nimbelekenyenye irorei le Nkai naishu, Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai ang.

English: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
Masaai: Neaku tiaaki iyie oloiboni, ‘Kainyoo kitawalikia Olaitoriani ajoki?’ aashu ‘Kainyoo eiroro Olaitoriani?

English: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
Masaai: Kake te nijo iyie, ‘Olola lo Laitoriani’ nji ejo Olaitoriani, ‘Ore enkaraki nitejo kulo rorei, “Olola lo Laitoriani,” ina kata apa pee aairriwaki iyie olkilikuai, ajoito, “Mijo ake, ‘Olola lo Laitoriani.’ ”

English: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
Masaai: Metaa, ng'ura, edede kaadumu nanu iyie aing'atie enkop naanang'aa aitung'uaa enaatii nanu, iyie o ina anasa apa naaishoo nanu iyie o loo papaai lino.

English: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
Masaai: Naa kayau nanu shumata iyie esulare oo ntarasi o enkurruna e anaake, ina nemerikinishoi ae kata.’ ”

English: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon ataarai aitung'uaa Yerusalem Yekonia olayioni le Yehoiakin, olaiguanani le Yuda, tenebo ilkituaak le Yuda, o lelo arriyiak o lkunono, neyau ninche Babilon, naaitodol nanu Olaitoriani ena duaata: ng'ura nkikapuni are naabore ilng'abolo eirragieki te dukuya enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
Masaai: Ore enkikapu nabo neeta ilng'abolo sidain oleng, laa ninche ooitera aaku, kake ore enkae kikapu neeta ilng'abolo torrok oleng lemeinosayu.

English: Then said the LORD unto me, What seest thou, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Kainyoo iyie idolita, Yeremia?” najo nanu ilng'abolo, “Ilng'abolo, sidain sidain oleng, o lng'abalo torrok torrok oleng, torrok, oleng lemeinosayu.”

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii nanu ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Anaa enatiu kulo ng'abolo sidain neijia adol aa sidain lelo yararot ooing'uaa Yuda, apa lairriwayie nanu meshomo aaing'uaa ene wueji aapuo enkop oo Lkaldayo.

English: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
Masaai: Kapik nanu nkonyek aainei shumata ninche te sidai, naa kayau nanu ninche arrinyu meetu ena kop. Kashetu nanu ninche, nemadung'udung'oki ninche enkop; kaun nanu ninche, nemadotu ninche.

English: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am the LORD: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu ninche oltau oyiolounye ninche nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei naaku nanu Enkai enye, amu kaashukokino ninche nanu to ltau lenye pooki.

English: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus saith the LORD, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Kake nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa lelo ng'abolo torrok oleng lemeinosayu neijia nanu aiko Sedekia olaiguanani le le Yuda, o ilkituaak lenyena, ilo pisiai le Yerusalem otelekua tiatua ena kop, o lelo ootonita tiatua enkop e Misiri.

English: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
Masaai: Kaitaa nanu ninche olkirutoto too nkitoriat pooki e nkop neaku enkurruna, enaileti o enkitakuenisho, o oldeket tiatua iwuejitin pooki nareu nanu ninche.

English: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
Masaai: Naa kairriwaa nanu olalem, o lameyu o lmeitai shumata ninche, o metaba anaa neidaikieki tukul teina kop apa naishoo nanu ninche o loo menye.”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
Masaai: Eewuo ele rorei enetii Yeremia oipirta iltung'ana pooki le Yuda, tiatua olari liong'uan le Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda (ilo apa olari le dukuya le Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon),

English: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
Masaai: laa ninye etolikio Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai iltung'ana pooki le Yuda o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem:

English: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of the LORD hath come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye have not hearkened.
Masaai: “Too larin tikitam oo kuni, ebaiki olari le tomon ookuni le Yosia olayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda, ometabaiki ena olong, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu, nairorie nanu intae akurraki, kake eitu intae ining'ining'i.

English: And the LORD hath sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
Masaai: Eitu ninye ining'ining'i neitu irugugu nkiyiaa inyi aaning, hoo neirriwaka intae Olaitoriani akurraki sinkan lenyena iloibonok,

English: They said, Turn ye again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that the LORD hath given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
Masaai: ejo ‘Embelekenyata taata, pooki ng'ae te intae, aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono o nkiaasin torrok, nibikibiki ti oriong ina kop apa naishoo Olaitoriani intae ebaiki apa o ntarasi;

English: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
Masaai: emipuo aasujaa kulie aitin aaisiaai niserememe ninche, aashu kintagorigoro nanu te siaai oo nkaik inyi. Nemaitaas nanu intae entorrono.’

English: Yet ye have not hearkened unto me, saith the LORD; that ye might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia eitu intae kining'ining'i nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, pee kitumutumu intae aaitagoro nanu teina siaai oo nkaik inyi naar intae.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Because ye have not heard my words,
Masaai: “Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore enkaraki neitu ining'ining'i irorei laainei,

English: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, saith the LORD, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
Masaai: ng'ura, kairriu nanu lelo oshon pooki le moikuape, Olaitoriani ojo, o Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, osinka lai, naa kayau nanu ninche metaarare ena kop o lelo oomanya, o lelo oreren pookioomanita, kaidaikie nanu ninche katukul, naitaa ninche olkirutoto, o enkiputukuny, o enkurruna oo ntarasi.

English: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
Masaai: Ore ake sii, kaiwuang'ie te ninche oltoilo le nkuenia o ltoilo le ng'ida, oltoilo lo loyamisho o ltoilo le nayami, enkiyutuyutore oo soito oo yutuyutishoreki o ewang'an o ltaa.

English: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
Masaai: Ore ena kop pooki keaku emutata o enkidaata, naa keisiaai kuna kuapi olaiguanani le Babilon ilarin ntomoni naapishana.

English: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, saith the LORD, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo ilarin ntomon naapishana, naitame nanu olaiguanani le Babilon o ina kop oo Kaldayo, tenkaraki entorroni enye, Olaitoriani ojo, aitaa ina kop mitil intarasi.

English: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah hath prophesied against all the nations.
Masaai: Kayau nanu shumata ina kop lelo rorei laainei pooki apa latejo nanu tialo ninche pooki toki naigero tiatua ena buku apa naibonoko Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai nkuapi pooki.

English: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
Masaai: Amu ore doi ninye nkuapi kumok o laiguanank kituaak naa keitayu rrindiki te ninche; naa kalaaki nanu ninche te risioroto oo nkiaasin enye o siaatin oo nkaik enye.”

English: For thus saith the LORD God of Israel unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: “Aatiaka ninye nanu, Iwa iyie te nkaina ai ena kikompe e naisho e ngoro, nincho nena kuapi pooki naairriwaki iyie metooko.

English: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
Masaai: Keok ninche nemera nerruoyo lukuny tenkaraki ilo alem lairriwaki nanu atua ninche.”

English: Then took I the cup at the LORD'S hand, and made all the nations to drink, unto whom the LORD had sent me:
Masaai: Naya nanu ina kikompe te nkaina o Laitoriani, naisho nanu lelo oreren pooki laairriwaka Olaitoriani metooko:

English: To wit, Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and the kings thereof, and the princes thereof, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, an hissing, and a curse; as it is this day;
Masaai: Yerusalem o nkanas e Yuda, ilaiguanak lenyena o lkituaak lenyena, pee eitaa ninche olmuaate o neitaa mitil o enkiputukuny o ldeket, anaa enatiu ena olong;

English: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;
Masaai: Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, o isinkan lenyena, o lkituaak lenyena, o ltung'ana lenyena pooki,

English: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
Masaai: o lelo pooki omon ootii atua ninche; laiguanak pooki le nkop e Usi o laiguanak pooki le nkop e Filisti (Ashkelon, o Gasa, o Ekron o ilo pisiai le Ashdod),

English: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon,
Masaai: Edom, o Moab o layiok le Amon;

English: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
Masaai: o ilaiguanak pooki le Turo, o laiguanak pooki le Sidon, o laiguanak lo lomanaa le naiposha;

English: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
Masaai: o Dedan, Tema, o Busi, o pooki oo dung ilpijat loo lpapit lenye;

English: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mingled people that dwell in the desert,
Masaai: o ilaiguanak pooki le Arabia o laiguanak pooki loo loshon ooshula oomanya olpurkel;

English: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
Masaai: o ilaiguanak pooki le Simri, ilaiguanak pooki le Elam, o ilaiguanak pooki le Amedi;

English: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another, and all the kingdoms of the world, which are upon the face of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.
Masaai: ilaiguanak pooki le moikuape oolakua o lootaana, obo te siadi o likae, o nena kitoriat pooki enkop naatii oriong enkop. Naa ore te siadi ninche neok olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
Masaai: “Nintoki iyie ajoki ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Tooko, temerayu nilopisho, tabatatayu niming'il ae kata adumunye, tenkaraki ilo alem lairriu nanu atua intae.’

English: And it shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at thine hand to drink, then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ye shall certainly drink.
Masaai: “Naa teneany ninche eng'amu ina kikompe te nkaina ino aaok, nijoki iyie ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, loo lororani: Meeta nchere pee miokioko!

English: For, lo, I begin to bring evil on the city which is called by my name, and should ye be utterly unpunished? Ye shall not be unpunished: for I will call for a sword upon all the inhabitants of the earth, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kaiteru nanu aas entorroni too nkanas naaipotieki enkarna ai, naa eilo iyie mintamio? Milo iyie mintamio, amu aipotoko nanu olalem lelo pooki oomanya enkop, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.’

English: Therefore prophesy thou against them all these words, and say unto them, The LORD shall roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he shall mightily roar upon his habitation; he shall give a shout, as they that tread the grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
Masaai: “Ore naa iyie, shomo imbonisho tigilunore ninche te kulo rorei pooki, nijoki ninche, ‘Keikurrukur Olaitoriani te shumata, tiatua ina manyisho sinyati neitayu oltoilo lenye; keikurrukur ninye te ngolon aarare iltung'ana lenyena, nebuaku, anaa iltung'ana ooitunyoo isabibu, tenkaraki lelo pooki oomanya enkop.

English: A noise shall come even to the ends of the earth; for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations, he will plead with all flesh; he will give them that are wicked to the sword, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Elo enkorui e nkikurrukur ineeiting'ie enkop. Amu kegilunore Olaitoriani nkuapi; kejing ninye atua enkiguana tenebo pooki tung'ani ore ilo torrono nepik ninye enetii ilo alem, Olaitoriani ojo.’

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: ng'ura, kelotu entorroni aipang'u to lorere o to lorere, neyuko osiuo sapuk oing'uaa imatuan naalakua e nkop.

English: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung upon the ground.
Masaai: “Ore lelo ootara Olaitoriani teina olong neponari ebaiki enkiting'oto nabo enkop ometabaiki enkae. Meishirakini ninche, aashu eiturrurrokinoi, aashu enukari; keaku ninche emodiei ti oriong enkop.

English: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.
Masaai: Enteyietu, intae ilairritak loo ntare, ninchirishiri, nimperiperara too nkurruon intae ilaitoriak loo ntare, amu ore nkolong'i eyiang'are inyi o sina linyi neetuo, naa ibatatata intae anaa ilmeregeshi gelunot.

English: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
Masaai: Meetae esarunoto naitokini aata too luaat oo ntare, aashu eneisudoriyie ilaitoriak loo ntare.

English: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
Masaai: Entoning, olkiyioi loo lairritak, o eyiolounoto oo laitoriak lo lturrur! Amu einyalita Olaitoriani eneirritishoreki enye,

English: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
Masaai: ore ilo turrur le seriani neitigiraki tenkaraki ina goro napi o Laitoriani.

English: He hath forsaken his covert, as the lion: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor, and because of his fierce anger.
Masaai: Etung'uayie ninye orrumat linyi anaa olng'atuny, amu etaa enkop enye mitil tenkaraki ilo alem leilo oitorogonyisho, o tenkaraki engoro enye napi.”

English: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto e nkitoria e Yohoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, ele rorei oewuo eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD; Stand in the court of the LORD'S house, and speak unto all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in the LORD'S house, all the words that I command thee to speak unto them; diminish not a word:
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ntasho to lgoriet le nkaji o Laitoriani nirorie nena anas pooki e Yuda naapuonu aaserem tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani kulo rorei pooki laaitanap nanu iyie tiaaki ninche; mimbooyo ake ororei,

English: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
Masaai: eidimayu nening ninche; neibelekenya pooki ng'ae aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, pee atum nanu aibelekenyayu teina torroni apa natonyorra ajo kaitaas ninche tenkaraki nkiaasin enye torrok.

English: And thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD; If ye will not hearken to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,
Masaai: Tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Tinimikining'ning'i intae nanu, pee ipuopuo te nkitanapata ai nairragie nanu te dukuya intae,

English: To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I sent unto you, both rising up early, and sending them, but ye have not hearkened;
Masaai: nining'ining'i irorei loo sinkan laainei lelo oibonok le Nkai lairriwaka nanu intae te siokinoto, hoo neitu intae ining'ining'i,

English: Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.
Masaai: naitotiu nanu ena aji anaa Shilo, naa kaitaa sii ena anasa oldeket too loreren pooki le nkop.’ ”

English: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Etoning'o ilapolosak o loibonok o ltung'ana pooki Yeremia eirorita kulo rorei tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Now it came to pass, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that the LORD had commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people took him, saying, Thou shalt surely die.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip Yeremia airoro ina pooki naitanapa Olaitoriani ninye pee eirorie iltung'ana pooki, neibung ilapolosak ninye, o loibonok, iltung'ana pooki ejoito, ejo, “Iye iyie!

English: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee imbonishe te nkarna o Laitoriani, ijo, ‘Keyooki ena aji atiu anaa Shilo ore ena anasa neaku olmuaate memanya toki’?” Ore iltung'ana pooki neiturrurrokino Yeremia tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD'S house.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilkituaak le Yuda kuna baa, nepuonu te nkaji o laiguanani enkaji o Laitoriani netonie olorika lenye tenejing'ieki kishomi ng'ejuk eina aji o Laitoriani.

English: Then spake the priests and the prophets unto the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy to die; for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard with your ears.
Masaai: Nejoki ilapolosak o loibonok lelo kituaak o lelo tung'ana pooki, “Eishaakino ele endung'okinoto e nkiguana e keeya, enkaraki naibonoko te ntorroni ena anasa, anaa enitoning'o too nkiyiaa inyi.”

English: Then spake Jeremiah unto all the princes and to all the people, saying, The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that ye have heard.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia airorie lelo kituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki ejo, “Olaitoriani, laairriwua maibonoki entorroni ena aji o ena anasa lelo rorei pooki litoning'o.

English: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entobira nkoitoi inyi o nkiaasin inyi, nining'ining'i oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi, naa keirridu Olaitoriani te ina torrono natudung'ie enkiguana tialo intae.

English: As for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, ng'ura atii atua nkaik inyi. Entaasaki nanu anaa enidolidolo aa sidai neishiaakino te intae.

English: But know ye for certain, that if ye put me to death, ye shall surely bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon the inhabitants thereof: for of a truth the LORD hath sent me unto you to speak all these words in your ears.
Masaai: Entayiolo ake duoo intae te nkitisipata nchere tenikiariara nanu matua, niyauu osarge lemeeta eleyiata shumata intae maate o shumata ena anasa o lelo oomanya, amu ore te sipata o Laitoriani laairriwua nanu enitii pee airo kulo rorei pooki ootii nkiyiaa inyi.”

English: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets; This man is not worthy to die: for he hath spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo kituaak o ltung'ana pooki lelo apolosak o loibonok, “Meishiaakino ele tung'ani endung'okinoto e nkiguana e keeya, amu eirorie ninye iyiook te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spake to all the assembly of the people, saying,
Masaai: Neinyototo embata oo lpayiani leina kop neirorie ina umata pooki oo ltung'ana ejo,

English: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and spake to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Zion shall be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
Masaai: “Ore apa Mika le Moreshet neibonishe too nkolong'i e Hesekia olaiguanani le Yuda, nejoki iltung'ana pooki le Yuda: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, keturi sion anaa enkurma neaku Yerusalem osototi loo suut ore enkaji e Nkai neaku entim oo lkeek.’

English: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him at all to death? did he not fear the LORD, and besought the LORD, and the LORD repented him of the evil which he had pronounced against them? Thus might we procure great evil against our souls.
Masaai: Ketaara ninye metua Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda o Yuda pooki? Keitu ninye eureyu Olaitoriani nesayu esupatisho o Laitoriani, naa keitu ninye eirridu Olaitoriani te ina torroni apa natudung'oko ninche? Kake etaa iyiook enikijo pee kiyau entorroni shumata ate.”

English: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the LORD, Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjathjearim, who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:
Masaai: Etii sii likae tung'ani oibonishe te nkarna o Laitoriani, Uria olayioni le Shemia eing'uaa Kiriat-Yearim. Eibonuo entorroni tialo ena anasa o ena kop too rorei ooikununo anaa kuldo le Yeremia.

English: And when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death: but when Urijah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening olaiguanani Yehoiakim, tenebo enjore enye pooki o lkituaak pooki, irorei lenyena, neing'oru olaiguanani ajo aar ninye metua; kake ore ake pee ening Uria ina, neureisho neisikalo aisudori te Misiri.

English: And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, namely, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him into Egypt.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani Yehoiakim kulikae tung'ana meshomo Misiri, Elnatan olayioni le Akbo o kulikae tenebo ninye,

English: And they fetched forth Urijah out of Egypt, and brought him unto Jehoiakim the king; who slew him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.
Masaai: neyau ninche Uria aaitung'uaa Misiri neyaki ninye olaiguanani Yehoiakim, laa ninye otaara ninye to lalem nenang'aki empopok enye atua ewueji e nkurare oo ltung'ana pooki.

English: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.
Masaai: Kake etii apa enkaina e Ahikam olayioni le Shafan tenebo Yeremia neaku eitu apa eishori iltung'ana metaara metua.

English: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto e nkitoria e Sedekia olayioni le Yosia olaiguanani le Yuda, ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani ejo.

English: Thus saith the LORD to me; Make thee bonds and yokes, and put them upon thy neck,
Masaai: Nji aatiaka nanu Olaitoriani: “Ntobiraki kewan nkeenta o enchata oo lmong'i, nipik ninche emurt ino.

English: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the Ammonites, and to the king of Tyrus, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of the messengers which come to Jerusalem unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
Masaai: Irriwaki olkilikuai olaiguanani le Edom, o laiguanani le Moab, o laiguanani le lelo ayiok le Amon, o laiguanani le Turo, o laiguanani le Sidon too nkaik elelo kiliku ooetuo Yerusalem enetii Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: And command them to say unto their masters, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say unto your masters;
Masaai: Nchoo ninche ena kitanapata too lkituaak lenye: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: ena intae ipupuo aajoki ilkituaak linyi:

English: I have made the earth, the man and the beast that are upon the ground, by my great power and by my outstretched arm, and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me.
Masaai: “Nanu ilo laa ore te ngolon ai sapuk o te nkaina ai naitoriori oitayio enkop, tenebo iltung'ana o ng'uesi naatii oriong enkop naa kaisho nanu ilo pooki ladol eishiaakino te nanu.

English: And now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the beasts of the field have I given him also to serve him.
Masaai: Aishooyie taata nanu kuna kuapi pooki apik nkaik e Nebukadnesa, olaiguanani le Babilon, osinka lai, naishoo sii ninye ing'uesi e ong'ata meisiayia ninye.

English: And all nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son's son, until the very time of his land come: and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him.
Masaai: Keisiaai ninye iloreren pooki o layioni lenye o layioni lo layioni lenye ometaba anaa nelotu enkata enkop enye makewan; netum taa nkuapi kumok o laiguanak kituaak aaitaa ninye orrindik.

English: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
Masaai: “ ‘ “Kake tenetii ake ninye enkop aashu enkitoria nemeisiaai Nebukadnesa ele aiguanani le Babilon, nepik emurt enye abori enchata olaiguanani le Babilon, naa kaitame nanu ina kop to lalem, o to lameyu o to lmeitai, Olaitoriani ojo, ometaba anaa namut nanu ninye te nkaina enye.

English: Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreamers, nor to your enchanters, nor to your sorcerers, which speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon:
Masaai: Metaa emining iloibonok linyi, o ilaitumusumusok linyi, o ilaidetidetak linyi, o lalimunok linyi arashu ilasakutok linyi, lelo oojoki intae, ‘Misiaayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon.’

English: For they prophesy a lie unto you, to remove you far from your land; and that I should drive you out, and ye should perish.
Masaai: Amu elejare ina naibonoki ninche intae, aa ore intae naa keyae enelakua aaitung'uaa enkop inyi, naa kaaraa nanu intae aipang'ie, naa eindaayaya.

English: But the nations that bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, those will I let remain still in their own land, saith the LORD; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pooki orere oyau emurt enye apik abori enchata olaiguanani le Babilon aisiaai ninye, napalaki ninche enkop enye, pee etur ninye nebik teine, Olaitoriani ojo.” ’ ”

English: I spake also to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
Masaai: Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda airorie tena oitoi: “Eyautu imurto inyi abori olchata lo laiguanani le Babilon, nisiaayiayia ninye o ltung'ana lenyena pee ipokipoko.

English: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie o ltung'ana linono pee iyeye to lalem, o to lameyu o to lmeitai, anaa enairoro Olaitoriani tialo pooki orere lemeisiaai olaiguanani le Babilon?

English: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you, saying, Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
Masaai: Emining ororei le lelo oibonok oojoki intae, ‘Misiayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon,’ amu elejare ina naibonoki ninche intae.

English: For I have not sent them, saith the LORD, yet they prophesy a lie in my name; that I might drive you out, and that ye might perish, ye, and the prophets that prophesy unto you.
Masaai: Eitu nanu airriu ninche, Olaitoriani ojo, kake keibonisho ninche te lejare te nkarna ai, eji ejo kaaraa nanu intae naa eindaayaya, intae o loibonok o lelo oibonok ooibonoki intae.”

English: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD'S house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu airorie ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki, ajoki, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Emining irorei le lelo oibonok ooibonoki intae, ejo, ‘Ng'ura, keshukuni nena masaa enkaji o Laitoriani aaitasieku aaitung'uaa Babilon,’ amu elejare ina naibonoki ninche intae.

English: Hearken not unto them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: wherefore should this city be laid waste?
Masaai: Emining intae ninche; esiaayia olaiguanani le Babilon pee ipokipoko. Kainyoo pee eitaae ena anasa olmuaate.

English: But if they be prophets, and if the word of the LORD be with them, let them now make intercession to the LORD of hosts, that the vessels which are left in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, go not to Babylon.
Masaai: Tenaa eloibonok ninche, naa tenaa ketii ororei lo Laitoriani tenebo ninche, nchoo naa ninche esaisho to Laitoriani loo lororani, paa ore nena masaa naatung'uayioki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda, o tiatua Yerusalem nemepuo Babilon.
