English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that remain in this city,
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani tialo ng'apeta, o lmoti le nkare, o nkitasheyieta o kulie masaa pooki naatung'uayioki tiatua ena anasa,

English: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
Masaai: neitu eya Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, ina kata apa pee eya te yararoto aitung'uaa Yerusalem aya Babilon Yekonia olayioni le Yehoiakim, olaiguanani le Yuda, o lkituaak pooki le Yuda o Yerusalem.

English: Yea, thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that remain in the house of the LORD, and in the house of the king of Judah and of Jerusalem;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, tialo nena masaa naatung'uayioki tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani o tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda, o tiatua Yerusalem:

English: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be until the day that I visit them, saith the LORD; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.
Masaai: kenapi ninche aaya Babilon netoni teine ometabau ina olong naing'or nanu ninche ashukoki ene wueji.

English: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake teilo ari, te nkiterunoto e nkitoria e Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le imiet lo lari liong'uan naairorie nanu Hanania olayioni le Asuri, ilo oiboni oing'uaa Gibeon, tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani, te dukuya ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki, ejo,

English: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Atigila nanu ina shata e murt o laiguanani le Babilon.

English: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD'S house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo larin oare naa kashuku nanu ayau ene wueji nena masaa pooki e nkaji o Laitoriani, apa naatanapa Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon aitung'uaa ene wueji neya Babilon.

English: And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, that went into Babylon, saith the LORD: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Kayau sii ashuku ene wueji Yekonia olayioni le Yehoiakim, olaiguanani le Yuda, o lelo yararot pooki ooing'uaa Yuda apa ooshomo Babilon, Olaitoriani ojo, amu kagil nanu enchata e murt o laiguanani le Babilon.”

English: Then the prophet Jeremiah said unto the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people that stood in the house of the LORD,
Masaai: Neitoki oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia airorie Hanania ilo oiboni te dukuya ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki apa ooitashe tiatua enkaji o Laitoriani;

English: Even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: the LORD do so: the LORD perform thy words which thou hast prophesied, to bring again the vessels of the LORD'S house, and all that is carried away captive, from Babylon into this place.
Masaai: nejo oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia, “Esai! Metaasa Olaitoriani neijia; meitobira Olaitoriani lelo rorei limbonuo iyie metisipata, neshuku ayau ene wueji aitung'uaa Babilon nena masaa e nkaji o Laitoriani, o lelo yararot pooki.

English: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people;
Masaai: Ore eyia toning'o taata ele rorei lairo nanu ining'ito iyie nening'ito iltung'aa pooki.

English: The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.
Masaai: Ore apa iloibonok ooiturukutuo te dukuya iyie o nanu ebaiki apa neibonutuo olarrabal, o lameyu o lmeitai tialo nkuapi kumok o nkitoriak kituaak.

English: The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the LORD hath truly sent him.
Masaai: Ore oloiboni oibonu eseriani, ore ake pee ebaya ororei leilo oiboni, neyioulouni taa aajo esipa Olaitoriani oiriwua ilo oiboni.”

English: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah's neck, and brake it.
Masaai: Neya ilo oiboni oji Hanania nena keek naatii emurt e Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai, negil ninche,

English: And Hananiah spake in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the neck of all nations within the space of two full years. And the prophet Jeremiah went his way.
Masaai: neiro Hanania te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, ejo, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, kaiko nanu neijia agil enchata e murt e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon aitayu te murt oo nkuapi pooki te rishata oo larin oare.” Kake eshomo Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai enkoitoi enye.

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the prophet, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkiti rishata eidipa oloiboni Hanania atigila nkeek aitayu te murt e Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ejo:

English: Go and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron.
Masaai: “Shomo, tiaaki Hanania, nji ejo Olaitoriani: itigila iyie nkeek, kake akaitobir nanu te rishata enye isekenke.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the beasts of the field also.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Atipika nanu shumata emurt e kuna kuapi pooki esekenkei e sinkaisho te Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, naa keisiaai ninche ninye, amu aishoo nanu ninye ebaiki ing'uesi e ong'ata.”

English: Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah; The LORD hath not sent thee; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie.
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai ilo oiboni oji Hanania, “Toning'o Hanania: eitu iyie kirriu Olaitoriani ninchoo iyie kulo tung'ana meisiliga elejare.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will cast thee from off the face of the earth: this year thou shalt die, because thou hast taught rebellion against the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Ng'ura, kaaiwuang'ie nanu iyie ti oriong e nkop. Ore tele ari ake niye iyie, enkaraki niroro inenkiser tialo Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
Masaai: Ore teilo ari ake, to lapa li opishana, neye oloiboni oji Hanania.

English: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the residue of the elders which were carried away captives, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon;
Masaai: Kulo ninche irorei leina palai nairriwayie ilo oiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia etii Yerusalem airriwaki lelo payiani apa le yararoto, o lapolosak, o loibonok, o ltung'ana pooki apa, ootarayie Nebukadnesa aitung'uaa Yerusalem nepuo Babilon.

English: (After that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the carpenters, and the smiths, were departed from Jerusalem;)
Masaai: Ina kata apa eidipa olaiguanani Yekonia, o ng'otonye enkitok olaiguanani, o lelo sunaishi oogelema, o lkituaak le Yuda o Yerusalem, o lelo arriyiak tenguetare o lkunono, aatudumunye aatung'uai Yerusalem.

English: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon) saying,
Masaai: Eirriwayioki apa ina palai te nkaina e Elesa olayioni le Shafan o Gemaria olayioni le Hilkia, laa ninche eirriwayie Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda Babilon enetii Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon. Nejo apa ina palai,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all that are carried away captives, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, te lelo pooki le yararoto apa natarayie nanu meshomo eyararoto aaing'uaa Yerusalem nepuo Babilon:

English: Build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them;
Masaai: Enteshet nkajijik nitonini tiatua ninche; entuun nkurman ninyanya enkisampuare enye.

English: Take ye wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; that ye may be increased there, and not diminished.
Masaai: Eyamisho niiuu ilayiok o ntoyie; eyamaki ilayiok linyi, ninchosho ntoyie inyi meyami, pee etum aatoiu ilayiok o ntoyie; entoponari teine, nimiakuku kuti.

English: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
Masaai: Kake engoru olmabarishoi leina anasa apa naterewa intae te yararoto, niomonono Olaitoriani te rishata enye, tialo ninye amu ore tiatua olmabarishoi lenye nitumutumu intae olmabarishoi linyi.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Let not your prophets and your diviners, that be in the midst of you, deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Emincho iloibonok linyi o laitumusumusok linyi otii atua intae elej intae, nimining'ining'i nena kidetidetat naidetidetu,

English: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith the LORD.
Masaai: amu ore ina naa elejare naibonoki ninche intae te nkarna ai, eitu nanu airriu ninche, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For thus saith the LORD, That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Teneishunye ilarin ntomoni naapishana te Babilon, namutan nanu intae, naa kaitabaya nanu te intae enkisiligata ai narrinyu intae ayau ene wueji.

English: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu nkitobirat naata te intae, Olaitoriani ojo, nkitobirat olmabarishoi neme ine ntorroni, pee eisho intae osiligi too nkolong'i naapuonu.

English: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
Masaai: Naa eikimpotipoto intae nanu nikipoununu aaomon nanu, naa kaning nanu intae.

English: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
Masaai: Eiking'oruru intae nanu nikitumutumu; teniking'oruru to ltauja linyi pooki,

English: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.
Masaai: nikitumutumu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaitopok nanu intae naiturrur intae aitung'uaa iloshon pooki o wuejitin pooki apa naterewa intae, Olaitoriani ojo, narrinyu nanu intae ayau ine wueji apa naterewa intae enchom eyararoto.

English: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki nitejo intae, ‘Etudumaka iyiook Olaitoriani iloibonok tiatua Babilon,’

English: Know that thus saith the LORD of the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and of all the people that dwelleth in this city, and of your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;
Masaai: nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo ilo aiguanani otonita to lorika le nkitoo le Daudi, o tialo lelo tung'ana pooki oomanya atua ena anasa, lelo alashera linyi leitu apa eipang aapuo tenebo intae tiatuaeyararoto.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will send upon them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, ng'ura, kairriwaki nanu ninche olalem, o lameyu, o lmeitai, naa kaitotiu nanu ninche anaa ilng'abolo ootarruoitie lemeinosayu.

English: And I will persecute them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse, and an astonishment, and an hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I have driven them:
Masaai: Nasujaa nanu ninche to lalem, to lameyu o to lmeitai, naitaa ninche enkuretisho too nkitoriat pooki e nkop, pee eaku oldeket, o enkuretisho, o enkiputukuny o esulare tiatua iloreren pooki laterewa nanu ninche,

English: Because they have not hearkened to my words, saith the LORD, which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but ye would not hear, saith the LORD.
Masaai: amu eitu ninche ening ilomon laainei, Olaitoriani ojo, lelo laitirrishaka nanu airriwaki intae too sinkan laainei lelo oibonok, kake mining'ining'i intae, Olaitoriani ojo!’

English: Hear ye therefore the word of the LORD, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon:
Masaai: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae pooki le yararoto apa laterewa nanu aitung'uaa Yerusalem nareu Babilon:

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, of Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, which prophesy a lie unto you in my name; Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall slay them before your eyes;
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, tialo Ahab olayioni le Kalaya o Sedekia olayioni le Ma-asea, lelo ooibonu elejare te intae te nkarna ai: Ng'ura, kayau nanu ninche apik atuaenkaina e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, naa kear ninye ninche metuata te dukuya nkonyek inyi.

English: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon, saying, The LORD make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;
Masaai: Ore tenkaraki ninche ketumi aadekishore ele deket lelo pooki le yararoto ooing'uaa Yuda ootii atua Babilon: “Mikintotiwuo Olaitoriani anaa Sedekia o Ahab, ootapejo olaiguanani le Babilon te nkima.”

English: Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nataasa entaboi tiatua Israel, etololoitote too nkituaak oo lelatia enye, neiroro ninche, te nkarna ai irorei le lejare leitu nanu aitanap ninche. Nanu ilo oyiolo naa nanu olchakeni, Olaitoriani ojo.’ ”

English: Thus shalt thou also speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,
Masaai: Tiaaki Shemaia le Nehelam:

English: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Irriwaka iyie mpala te nkarna ino iltung'ana pooki le Yerusalem, o Sefania olayioni le Maaseia ilo apolosani, o lapolosak pooki, ijo,

English: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
Masaai: ‘Kintaa iyie Olaitoriani olapolosani te rishata e Yehoida ilo apolosani, pee intore enkaji o Laitoriani te pooki ng'ae oata oloirirua oibonisho, apik ninye olpisiai emurt.

English: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee eitu isikong abuaaki Yeremia le Anatot likimbonoki iyie?

English: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon, saying, This captivity is long: build ye houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
Masaai: Amu eirriwaka ninye iyiook olkilikuai te Babilon, ejo, “Keadoru eyararoto inyi; enteshet nkajijik nimanyimanya, niununu nkurman ninyanya enkisampuare enye.” ’ ”

English: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
Masaai: Eisuma Sefania olapolosani ena palai metoning'o Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai.

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yeremia ejo:

English: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith the LORD concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite; Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he caused you to trust in a lie:
Masaai: “Irriwaki olkilikuai lelo pooki le yararoto ijo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo Shemaya le Nehalam: Enkaraki naibonoko Shemaya intae eitu nanu airriwu ninye, neisho intae esiliga elejare,

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
Masaai: metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, kaitame nanu Shemaya le Nehelam o eishoi enye; metum ninye hoo ng'ae oishu tiatua kulo tung'ana oaku olenye odol ina sidai naitaas nanu iltung'ana laainei, Olaitoriani ojo, amu eiroro ninye enapaashari tialo Olaitoriani.’ ”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Thus speaketh the LORD God of Israel, saying, Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Ngero tiatua embuku lelo rorei pooki laatiaaka iyie.

English: For, lo, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, saith the LORD: and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kepounu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, pee arrinyu aitopok iltung'ana laainei, Israel o Yuda, Olaitoriani ojo, nayau nanu ninche ashuku meetu enkop apa naishoo loo menye, naa keya ninche ninye.”

English: And these are the words that the LORD spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah.
Masaai: Kulo rorei ninche eiroro Olaitoriani tialo Israel o Yudas:

English: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, kitoning'o iyiook enkishirata o enkirutoto enkuretisho, neme eseriani.

English: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?
Masaai: Nkilikuanu taata pee idol, keidim olee anoto enutai enkerai? Kainyoo naa pee adol pooki lee etii nkaik enyena enkoshoke anaa enkitok nasaisai? kainyoo pee eipusa pooki ng'ae?

English: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.
Masaai: Kelotu enkolong torrono oleng; meetae ae olong naitanyaanyukieki enkata o sina too ltung'ana kumok kake kekorduni ninye aaitayu teine.

English: For it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him:
Masaai: “Naa kelotu ina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, nchere kagil nanu enchata emurt aitung'uaa imurto enye nalak nanu ienat enye, nemeigil ae kata ilomon aaitaa ninche isinkan.

English: But they shall serve the LORD their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up unto them.
Masaai: Kake keisiaai ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye o Daudi olaiguanani lenye laa ninye nanu aput tenkaraki ninche.

English: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make him afraid.
Masaai: “Miureishoyu naa, iyie Yakobo osinka lai, Olaitoriani ojo, aashu ing'aing'ai iyie Israel, amu itayiolo ajo kaaitajeu nanu iyie aitung'uaa enelakua naitajeu eishoi ino aitung'uaa enkop enye eyararoto. Keshukunye Yakobo netum enkitirring'ata o enkiyeng'iyeng, nemeitoki hoo ng'ae aiture ninye.

English: For I am with thee, saith the LORD, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.
Masaai: Amu atii nanu tenebo iyie pee aaitajeu iyie, Olaitoriani ojo: Kaiting'ie nanu iloshon pooki apa laidapashaka nanu intae, kake ore iyie maaiting'ie nanu iyie. Kaaitame nanu iyie te nkiririkinoto, nemaaing'uaa nanu hoo tiae oitoi mintamio.

English: For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Meishiunoyu olbae lino netarruoyie empaldaka ino.

English: There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.
Masaai: Metii hoo obo likinyor iyie meetae olchani to lbae lino meetae enkishuinoto te iyie.

English: All thy lovers have forgotten thee; they seek thee not; for I have wounded thee with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the multitude of thine iniquity; because thy sins were increased.
Masaai: Aaikidamu lelo sanchan pooki linono; mikishilaa ninche iyie amu aaikuna nanu anaa olmang'atinta enkitamioto o lmang'atinta lemeeta, olng'ur, amu eikitok enkitarruoroto ino enkaraki natoponari ing'ok inono.

English: Why criest thou for thine affliction? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity: because thy sins were increased, I have done these things unto thee.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee nchir te mion meishiunoyu emion ino. Amu eikitok entorroni ino, ore enkaraki natoponari ing'ok inono, aaitaasa nanu iyie kuna baa.

English: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.
Masaai: Neaku ore pooki likinya iyie naa keinosi ninche, ore ilmang'ati linono pooki, pooki ng'ae te ninche naa kelo eyararoto; ore lelo pooki oorresh naitobiraki ninche orreshet.

English: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
Masaai: Amu kaarrinyoki nanu embiotisho, ore ilbaa linono naishiunye, Olaitoriani ojo, enkaraki nikitejo ninche iyie, ‘Oloiturrayioki, Sion ina, nemeetae oloshilaa!’

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: ng'ura, karriny nanu lelo ootarayioki too lng'oborri le Yakobo, naing'urrie imanyishoritin enyena. Neitokini aashet nkanas too wuejitin apa neetelekutua neitashe enkaji enkitoo te wueji apake neitasheyie.

English: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.
Masaai: Atua ninche epukunye isinkolioitin le nkishoroto e nashe o ltoiloishi le lelo ooshipa. Kaponaa nanu ninche nemeitoki ninche aaku kuti; kaisho nanu ninche meyanyituni nemeitoki aaku ooti.

English: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
Masaai: Netiu inkera enye anaa enatiu apake ore irumat enye neitasheyieki te dukuya nanu, naa kaitame nanu lelo pooki ooibooki ninche enkop.

English: And their nobles shall be of themselves, and their governor shall proceed from the midst of them; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach unto me: for who is this that engaged his heart to approach unto me? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore olkitok lenye naa keaku obo lenye maate, ore olarikoni lenye naa kepuku tiatua ninche; kaisho nanu ninye metinyiku nayiaya ninye, amu kaing'ae laaitasim te kewan enye ayiaya nanu? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
Masaai: Na iakuku intae iltung'ana laainei naaku nanu Enkai inyi.”

English: Behold, the whirlwind of the LORD goeth forth with fury, a continuing whirlwind: it shall fall with pain upon the head of the wicked.
Masaai: Ng'ura olkutati lo Laitoriani! Eipang'ua engoro enye napi, olkutati ogol kedanyakino ninye endukuya eilo torrono.

English: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
Masaai: Merrinyo ina goro napi o Laitoriani, ometaba anaa nedung'oki enkiguana neitabaya iyieunot oltau lenye. Ore too nkolong'i e siadi naa ilo ayiolou ena.

English: At the same time, saith the LORD, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: “Ore kenya teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaaku nanu Enkai oo lmareita pooki le Israel, neaku ninche ilaainei.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, The people which were left of the sword found grace in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore lelo tung'ana apa ootelekutua to lalem nenoto empiris ti ong'ota; ina kata apa eing'oru Israel enkiyeng'yeng.

English: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
Masaai: Eipang'aka Olaitoriani ninye tenelakua ajoki. Aatonyorra nanu iyie te nyorrata oo ntarasi. Neaku atobiko nanu aisiligayu te intae,

English: Again I will build thee, and thou shalt be built, O virgin of Israel: thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets, and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry.
Masaai: ore ake sii kaashet iyie, naa eishetayu, na selenkei e Israel! Ore ake sii einkod iyie kewan too ntarumpetani naa e ilo dukuya to sinkolio le lelo ooshipa.

English: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa eiun inkurman oo sabibu too nchumat oo ldoinyo le Samaria neunisho ilaunok neitumurru ilng'anayio.

English: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry, Arise ye, and let us go up to Zion unto the LORD our God.
Masaai: Amu kelotu kenya enkolong naipotisho ilarripok tiatua ina kop oo ldoinyo o Efraim. Tudumunye maape Sion enetii Olaitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: For thus saith the LORD; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O LORD, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Entarany entabuaku te ng'ida tenkaraki Yakobo, niliepiepie mbuakunot too laiguanak loo loshon; embalie, ninchosho enkisisa, nijojo, ‘Eitajeuo Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena, ilo pisiai le Israel!’

English: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
Masaai: Ng'ura kayau nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e moikuape. Naiturrur ninche aitung'uaa ilubot enkop naalakua, ore tiatua ninche netii olmodooni o lmaima, o enkitok nairoshiwuo o enasaisai, tenebo; olturrur kitok, keshukunye ninche ene.

English: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
Masaai: Te nkishirata epuonu ninche naa tenkitigirata ariku nanu ninche ashuku, naisho nanu ninche meshomo too nchorroi oo nkariak, tiatua enkoitoi naitoriori nemerrorrore ninche. amu ara nanu papaai te Israel, naa olkikau lai Efraim.

English: Hear the word of the LORD, O ye nations, and declare it in the isles afar off, and say, He that scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as a shepherd doth his flock.
Masaai: “Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani intae iloreren nimbalunyenye ninye too loomanaa le naiposha oo lakua; entejo, ‘Ore ilo oidapasha Israel naa keiturrur ninye, naa keing'or ninye anaa enaing'or olairritani eluaata enye oo nkerra.’

English: For the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he.
Masaai: Amu etalakua Olaitoriani Yakobo, nelaku ninye aitung'uaa nkaik naagol oleng te ninye.

English: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.
Masaai: Kepuonu ninche aabuaku aaranyisho te nchumata oldoinyo le Sion, naa keaku keng'ida ninche teina supatisho o Laitoriani te nkurma, te naisho oo sabibu te ilata, o to lkuo le luaata oo ntare o lashe loo nkishu; ketiu enkishui enye anaa enkurma natipikaki enkare, nemeitoki ae kata aatum osina.

English: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, both young men and old together: for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.
Masaai: Neranyisho taa ntoyie te ng'ida. Ore ilbarnot loo ltung'ana kituaak neshipayu kaibelekeny nanu enkishirata enye metaa eng'ida, kaitagol nanu ninche, naisho ninche eng'ida to sina.

English: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kaisho osirua iltauja loo lapolosak tenkiputakinoto, neidipakino iltung'ana laainei te supatisho ai, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping; Rahel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children, because they were not.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Etoning'oki oltoilo tiatua Rama, olkiyioi, o enkishirata e mion. Eishirita Rahel tenkaraki nkera enyena, etanya ninye eitagoli too nkera enyena, amu meekure eetae.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; Refrain thy voice from weeping, and thine eyes from tears: for thy work shall be rewarded, saith the LORD; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Torripo oltoilo lino pee minchir, o nkonyek inono too lkiyioi; amu kelaki esiaai ino, Olaitoriani ojo, naa keshukunye ninche aaing'uaa ina kop olmang'atinta.

English: And there is hope in thine end, saith the LORD, that thy children shall come again to their own border.
Masaai: Etii osiligi too nkolong'i inono e dukuya, Olaitoriani ojo, naa keshukunye nkera inono aapuonu enkop enye maate.

English: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu Israel eishiraki kewan, ‘Kintamio apa nanu, nameyu nanu, anaa olashe lemeyiolo eenata; torrinyuoki nanu pee aatumi aaitopuaa, amu ira iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai.

English: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I smote upon my thigh: I was ashamed, yea, even confounded, because I did bear the reproach of my youth.
Masaai: Amu ore aidipa aibelekenyayu atapaashai nairridu ore aaidipaki aataarriyiana naosh enkupes ai, atukurrua nanu naanya sura enkaraki nanapita esulare e kitisho ai.’

English: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kolayioni lai kirotet Efraim? kenkerai ai ninye nanyor? Amu ore anaake te nairo aarare ninye naa kadamu ake ninye. Neaku keng'uar oltau lai ninye; meeta nchere pee maing'urrie ninye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.
Masaai: “Tipikaki kewan enkoitoi ilmonek, ntobiraki kewan ilmonek likiutaa tadamu oleng ina oitoi kitok, ina oitoi apa naa ninye iima. Tushukunye, na selenkei e Israel tushukunye wou kuna anas inono.

English: How long wilt thou go about, O thou backsliding daughter? for the LORD hath created a new thing in the earth, A woman shall compass a man.
Masaai: Ing'aeng'ae akenya o anu iyie na selenkei nemeisiligayu? Amu eitayio Olaitoriani entoki ng'ejuk te nkop; enkitok namitu olee.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As yet they shall use this speech in the land of Judah and in the cities thereof, when I shall bring again their captivity; The LORD bless thee, O habitation of justice, and mountain of holiness.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: “Keigil ake ninche aasishore kulo rorei tiatua enkop e Yuda o tiatua nkanas enyena tenarriny nanu ninche enkop enye. ‘Mikitamayiana iyie Olaitoriani, iyie namanyisho e supatisho, iyie to ldoinyo sinyati!’

English: And there shall dwell in Judah itself, and in all the cities thereof together, husbandmen, and they that go forth with flocks.
Masaai: Nebik Yuda o nkanas enyena teine tenebo, o laramatak o lelo oopuopuo tenebo nkerrai enye.

English: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
Masaai: Amu kaitaraposh nanu ilo tau oshal ore pooki tau otashala naitagol.”

English: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aputunye, naing'orisho naa eisidain njo aainei te nanu.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of beast.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, pee aun nanu enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda tenebo olantererai le tung'ani o lantererai le ng'ues aitubul.

English: And it shall come to pass, that like as I have watched over them, to pluck up, and to break down, and to throw down, and to destroy, and to afflict; so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kelotu enkata, ore anaa enaing'ura nanu ninche, pee adotu nanang'aa, nainyal nayau entorroni, neijia sii aiko aing'oru ninche pee ashet naun, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
Masaai: Ore akenya te nena olong'i nemeigil ae kata ninche aajo: ‘Einosa iloomenye ilng'anayio ooisuisho, nesirayu ilala loo nkera too mbat.

English: But every one shall die for his own iniquity: every man that eateth the sour grape, his teeth shall be set on edge.
Masaai: Kake keye pooki ng'ae te ng'oki enye makewan; ore pooki lee onya isabibu ooisuijo nesirayu ilala lenyena too mbat.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepounu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aitobir nanu olning'o ng'ejuk tenebo enkaji e Israel o enkaji e Yuda,

English: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they brake, although I was an husband unto them, saith the LORD:
Masaai: nemeikununo anaa ilo apa ning'o lo sotua apa laitobira tenebo iloomenye ina kata apa pee aibung ninche enkaina aitayu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, ilo ning'o lo sotua lai apa otigila hoo nara apa nanu olmoruo lenye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel; After those days, saith the LORD, I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts; and will be their God, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: Kake ore ele sotua laitobiru nanu tenebo enkaji e Israel te siadi nena olong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, kapik nanu e nkitanapata ai atua ninche nasir nanu too ltauja lenye; naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye neaku sii ninche iltung'ana laainei.

English: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the LORD: for they shall all know me, from the least of them unto the greatest of them, saith the LORD; for I will forgive their iniquity, and I will remember their sin no more.
Masaai: Nemeigil ae kata oltung'ani aiteng'en olelatia enye o pooki ng'ae olalashe lenye, ejo, ‘Tayiolo Olaitoriani’; amu kaayiolou ninche pooki nanu, ebaiki oloti lenye ometabaiki olkitok, Olaitoriani ojo: amu kapalaki nanu entorroni enye, nemaitoki aekata nanu adamu eng'oki enye.”

English: Thus saith the LORD, which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; The LORD of hosts is his name:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oishoru enkolong dama meitawang'isho o nkatitin olapa naaishiaakino o lakir ooitawang'isho te nkewarie, laa ninye oing'oling'ol enaiposha neaku keikurrukur ilopir lenyena Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye enkarna enye.

English: If those ordinances depart from before me, saith the LORD, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever.
Masaai: “Teneiwuang'a ena kitobirata apa naitoriokoki alo te dukuya nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, netum taa iishoritin e Israel aaishunye, meitoki aaku olosho te dukuya nanu ntarasi.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Tenaa keidimi napaji aatetem shumata keper, neyiolouni ilkitamanyunot le nkop tiabori, natum taa aiturrai iishoritin pooki e Israel te nena pooki naataasa, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the city shall be built to the LORD from the tower of Hananeel unto the gate of the corner.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee eshetakini Olaitoriani enkanasa aaigil ebaiki oltalet le Hananel o metabaiki kishomi olpijata.

English: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
Masaai: Ore olkereri otemieki neipang alo auluo oleng, neitoriori abaya oldoinyo le Gareb, neitoki taa arrinyo alo Goa.

English: And the whole valley of the dead bodies, and of the ashes, and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron, unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy unto the LORD; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more for ever.
Masaai: Ore oyarata pooki loo lmeneng'a o nkuruon, o nkong'at pooki naalakua aabaya ereyiet e Kidron, ometabaiki olpijata le nkishomi oo mbartan te nkalo enkilepunoto enkolong naa keiteng'elakini Olaitoriani. Meigili ae kata aadotu aashu eibelekenyi aanang'aa ntarasi.”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
Masaai: Ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani to lari le tomon le Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, laa ninye apa olari le tomon o isiet le nkitoria e Nebukadresa.

English: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata nemanita enjore o laiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem, ore Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai neikenoro apa to lgoriet le rripore otii enkaji enkitoo o laiguanani le Yuda.

English: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
Masaai: Amu etipika apa Yuda Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda ninye korokoroni, ejo, “Kainyoo iyie pee imbonisho nijo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kaishooyo nanu ena anasa apik nkaik o laiguanani le Babilon, naa keya ninye.

English: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
Masaai: Meimisho tukul Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda too nkaik oo Lkaldayo kake kepiki enkaina o laiguanani le Babilon, naa keiro ninye tenebo ninye eing'ura too nkomomi;

English: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper?
Masaai: naa keya ninye Sedekia Babilon, nebik ninye teine ometaba anaa namutan nanu ninye, Olaitoriani ojo. Ore hoo niaarare iyie Ilkaldayo mimirisho iyie.’ ”

English: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nejo Yeremia, “Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo:

English: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kelotu Hanamel olayioni le Shalom olenkapu lino enitii nejo, ‘Inyiang'u enkurma ai natii Anatot, amu iyie eishiaakino tenikordu ainyiang'u.’

English: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Nelotu Hanamel olenkapu lai enatii tiatua olgoriet le rripore, terisioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani, naajoki nanu, ‘Inyiang'u enkurma ai natii Anatot tiatua enkop e Benchamen, amu iyie eishiaakino te niya ainyiang'u; inyiang'aki iyie kewan.’ Nayiolou taa nchere ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
Masaai: Nainyiang'u nanu ina kurma natii Anatot te Hanamel olayioni lo lenkapu lai, naipimoki ninye mpisai naaji shekeli tomon oopishana enkosholai.

English: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
Masaai: Naiger te nkarna ai teina palai enkurma, nemisir neyau ilchakenini, neipim mpisai to rratili.

English: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aitayu ina palai namishira e nkinyiang'unoto, natii olning'o o ndung'eta o ina boitati enye;

English: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
Masaai: naisho nanu ina palai e nkinyiang'unoto Barak olayioni le Neria olayioni le Mahasia, te dukuya Hanamel olenkapu lai, te dukuya ilchakenini ootimishira ina palai e nkinyang'unoto, o te dukuya Ilyahudi pooki apa ootonita to lgoriet le rripore.

English: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
Masaai: Naitanap nanu Barak te dukuya ninche olchakenini ajoki,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
Masaai: ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Iwa kuna pala pokira, ena namishira e nkinyang'unoto o ena tashati enye nememishira, nipik ninche atua emoti oo nkulukuok, pee etum aatobik te nkata naado.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel keitokini aainyiang'u nkajijik o nkurman.’

English: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
Masaai: “Ore aidipa aishoo ina palai e nkinyang'unoto Barak olayioni le Neria, naomon nanu Olaitoriani ajo,

English: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
Masaai: ‘Ee Olaitoriani Enkai! iyie oitobira shumata o enkop te ngolon ino kitok o te nkaina ino naitoriori! Meetae entoki nagol te iyie,

English: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,
Masaai: oitoduaya enyorrata nauno too nkalifuni, kake intalaku entorroni oo loo menye too nkera enye te siadi ninche, Iyie Enkai olmagilani oji enkarna enye Olaitoriani loo lororani,

English: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
Masaai: kitok too nkiguanat naa magilani te yasata; obolo nkonyek enyena too nkoitoi pooki oo ltung'ana, nilaaki pooki tung'ani te risioroto oo nkoitoi enyena o terisioroto oo lng'anayio loo nkiaasin enyena;

English: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
Masaai: oitodolua ilmonek o nenking'asia te nkop e Misiri, ometabaiki ena olong tiatua Israel o too loreren pooki, nintobiraki kewan enkarna, anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
Masaai: Iyaua apa iyie iltung'ana linono Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri too lmonek o too nenking'asia, te nkaina nagol naitoriori, o to lkirutoto sapuk;

English: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
Masaai: nincho ninche ena kop, apa ninosie iyie olmumai tenebo loo menye pee incho ninche, enkop naruko inaishi o kule;

English: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
Masaai: nejing ninche atua neya aaitaa enenye. Kake eitu ninche ening oltoilo lino aashu epuo te nkitanapata ino; eitu ninche eas hoo toki te nena pooki apa nintanapa iyie ninche metaasa. Neaku nchoo iyie ena torroni pooki meeu shumata ninche.

English: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
Masaai: Ng'ura enjore namanita amuat enkanasa pee eya, naa ore te nkaraki olalem o lameyu olmeitai eishooyioki enkanasa aapik nkaik oo Lkaldayo, laa ninche oarare ninye. Ore apa ina niroro iyie netabayie, naa ng'ura, idolita iyie.

English: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia Olaitoriani, kitiaaka nanu, “Inyiang'u enkurma too mpisai ning'oru ilchakenini” - hoo neishooyioki enkanasa aapik nkaik oo Lkaldayo.’ ”

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ejo:

English: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
Masaai: “Ng'ura ara nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e pooki naishu; keetae hoo toki nagol te nanu?

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kaishooyo nanu ena anasa apik nkaik oo Lkaldayo o atua nkaik e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon; naa keya ninye.

English: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
Masaai: Ore lelo Kaldayo oarare ena anasa naa kepuonu aapik ena anasa enkima, nepejoo ninye, tenebo nkajijik naa ore nchumat enye netapejokinyeki Baal enkorropil neibukorieki inaishi enkishoroto e nashe aabukoki kulie aitin, pee aaitagor nanu.

English: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu ore ilayiok le Israel o layiok le Yuda meeta ae nataasa neme entorroni too nkonyek aainei ebaiki kitisho enye; meeta ilayiok le Israel ae nataasa neme kaaitagoro nanu te siaai oo nkaik enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
Masaai: Etuputuo ena anasa engoro ai o engoro ai napi ebaiki enkolong apa nateshetaki ometabaiki ena olong, neaku kaiwuang'ie nanu ninye too nkonyek aainei.

English: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Tenkaraki entorroni pooki oo ilayiok le Israel o layiok le Yuda apa nataasa pee aaitagor ilaiguanak lenye o lkituaak lenye, ilapolosak lenye o loibonok lenye, iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
Masaai: Aaibelekenyakita ninche nanu enkoriong enye, neitu aaitorioki inkomomi enye; naa ore hoo naiteng'ena nanu ninche aitirrishaki eitu ninche ening'isho aang'amu nkiteng'enat.

English: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
Masaai: Etipika ninche olminong atua ina aji naipotieki enkarna ai, pee eisarkionie ninye.

English: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
Masaai: Etesheta ninche iwuejitin e shumata e Baal to yarata lo layioni le Hinom, pee etum aaitayunye ilayiok lenye o ntoyie olasar oishori Molek, hoo neitu nanu aitanap ninche, neitu ninye ejing aata e ndamunoto ai, nchere pee eas ena olminong napik Yuda ing'ok.

English: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
Masaai: “Nji naa taata ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, tialo ena anasa nijojo intae, ‘Eishooyioki aapik atua enkaina o laiguanani le Babilon to lalem, o to lameyu, o to lmeitai’:

English: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaiturrur nanu ninche aitung'uaa nkuapi pooki apa naterewa ninche te ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi te mpushuna kitok; kashuku nanu ninche meetu ene wueji, naisho nanu ninche metobiko te seriani.

English: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
Masaai: Naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.

English: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
Masaai: Kaisho nanu ninche oltau obo o enkoitoi nabo pee aatum ninche aatureita nanu ntarasi tenkaraki ninche maate o nkera enye te siadi ninche.

English: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
Masaai: Kaitobir nanu tenebo ninche osotua loo ntarasi, nchere maibelekenya nanu eitu aitaas ninche esidai; naa kapik nanu olturiaki lai atua oltau lenye, pee maaitoki ninche aaibelekenya aaing'uaa.

English: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
Masaai: Kang'ida nanu tenaitaas ninche esidai, naa kaun nanu ninche tiatua ena kop naitubulu to ltau lai pooki o te nkishui ai pooki.

English: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: ore anaa enayaua nanu ena torroni kitok shumata kulo tung'ana, neijia sii aiko, kayau nanu shumata ninche ina pooki sidai apa naisiligie ninche.

English: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
Masaai: Keinyiang'uni nkurman tena kop nijoitoto intae, olmuaate, metii oltung'ani aashu eng'ues; eishooyioki aapik atua nkaik oo Lkadayo.

English: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Keinyiang'uni nkurman too mpesai neigerokini mpala nkarn nemishiri neikeni, tiatua enkop e Benchamen, tiatua iwuejitin naamanita Yerusalem, o tiatua nkanas e Yuda, tiatua nkanas e nkop oo ldoinyo, tiatua nkanas e Shefela, o tiatua nkanas e Negeb; amu kashuku nanu ilooena lenye, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia enkata e are, eton eikenoro to lgoriet le rripore ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani laa ninye oitobira enkop, Olaitoriani oipirua ninye neitobiru ninye, Olaitoriani enkarna enye:

English: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
Masaai: Mpotoki nanu naa kaairuk iyie; naa kaaliki iyie ntokitin sapuki naaisudoro neitu iyie iyiolou.

English: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, tialo nkajijik ena anasa o nkajijik oo laiguanak le Yuda apa naatuuroyioki aasulaki enkop pee eitobirieki isempewueti

English: They come to fight with the Chaldeans, but it is fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury, and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city.
Masaai: o te nkaraki o lalem loo lmang'ati. Kepuonu Ilkaldayo aagilunore intae neiput ninche mpopoki oo ltung'ana laar nanu te ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi, amu aisudoyie nanu enkomom ai pee maing'or ena anasa tenkaraki entorroni enye pooki.

English: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them, and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kayau nanu atua ninye embiotisho e nkishiunoto, naa kaishiunye nanu ninche naboloki ninche enkiputakinoto e dupoto o eseriani.

English: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
Masaai: Naa kashuku nanu lelo ootaarayioki le Yuda o loo taarayioki le Israel, naitoki ashetu ninche metotiwuo anaa enatiu apake te dukuya.

English: And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, whereby they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned, and whereby they have transgressed against me.
Masaai: Naa kaitisiny nanu ninche te ntorroni pooki oo ng'ok enye o engolong'akinoto naatogolong'akitia nanu.

English: And it shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and an honour before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do unto them: and they shall fear and tremble for all the goodness and for all the prosperity that I procure unto it.
Masaai: Naa keaku ena anasa te nanu enkarna e ng'ida, enkisisa o enkitoo te dukuya iloreren pooki le nkop ooning nena kenya pooki sidain naitaas nanu ninche; keureshoyu ninche neikirikira tenkaraki inapooki sidai o karsisisho pooki naisho nanu ninye.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Again there shall be heard in this place, which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man, and without inhabitant, and without beast,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ore tiatua ene wueji nijojo intae, ‘Olmuaate metii oltung'ani aashu eng'ues;’ ore tiatua nkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi e Yerusalem naatomijoonito, metii oltung'ani aashu olomanya aashu eng'ues, keitokini aaning

English: The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of them that shall say, Praise the LORD of hosts: for the LORD is good; for his mercy endureth for ever: and of them that shall bring the sacrifice of praise into the house of the LORD. For I will cause to return the captivity of the land, as at the first, saith the LORD.
Masaai: oltoilo le ng'ida o enchipai, oltoilo lo loyamisho o ltoilo le nayami, oltoilo le lelo ooranyisho eyau nkishorunot e nashe enkaji e Nkai. ‘Enchoo enashe Olaitoriani loo lororani, amu eisupat Olaitoriani amu ore ina nyorrata enye nauno ebik intarasi!’ Amu kashuku nanu lelo apa ootarayioki tena kop metotiwuo anaa apake te dukuya, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Again in this place, which is desolate without man and without beast, and in all the cities thereof, shall be an habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore taata ene wueji naa olmuaate, metii oltung'ani aashu eng'ues, o tiatua nkanas enyena pooki keitoki aaigil aajing imanyishoritin oo lairritak loo ntare eing'or nkerrai enye.

English: In the cities of the mountains, in the cities of the vale, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore tiatua nkanas eina kop oo ldoinyo, tiatua nkanas e Shefala, o tiatua nkanas e Negeb tiatua enkop e Benchamen, nene wuejitin neemanita Yerusalem, o tiatua nkanas e Yuda, keitoki nkerrai aaim abori nkaik eilo oiken ninche; Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aitabaya nanu nkisiligat apa naitayio nanu te nkaji e Israel o te nakaji e Yuda.

English: In those days, and at that time, will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land.
Masaai: Ore akenya te nena olong'i o teina kata naisho nanu olng'osila osinya metubulu te Daudi, naa kedung ninye enkiguana te sipata o te supatisho te nkop.

English: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely: and this is the name wherewith she shall be called, The LORD our righteousness.
Masaai: Ore akenya te nena olong'i neitajeuni Yuda nebik Yerusalem te seriani. Naa ena arna kenya eipotieki: ‘Olaitoriani esupatisho ang.’

English: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: Melau ae kata Daudi oltung'ani otonie olorika le nkitoo le nkaji e Israel,

English: Neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to kindle meat offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.
Masaai: ore lelo apolosak le Lawi nemelau ae kata oltung'ani te dukuya nanu oitayu ilasarri oopejori, nepejoo entapa o lasar, neitayu ilasarri ntarasi.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD; If ye can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, and that there should not be day and night in their season;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Tenaa indim iyie atigila olning'o lai o enkolong olning'o lai o enkewarie, metaa meekure elotu endama o enkewarie nkatitin naategelakaki,

English: Then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he should not have a son to reign upon his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.
Masaai: naa keidim sii olning'o lai o Daudi osinka lai atigilayu, metaa metum ninye olayioni oitoreisho to lorika lenye le nkitoo, o lning'o lai lo sotua o lapolosak le Lawi lelo aisiaayiak laainei.

English: As the host of heaven cannot be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured: so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites that minister unto me.
Masaai: Ore anaa enemeikenayu olorora le shumata o anaa enemetemayu osinyai le naiposha, neijia aiko aponaa eishoi e Daudi osinka lai, o lelo apolosak le Lawi laisiaai nanu.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ejo,

English: Considerest thou not what this people have spoken, saying, The two families which the LORD hath chosen, he hath even cast them off? thus they have despised my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.
Masaai: “Keitu iyie iyiolou enajeito kulo tung'ana, ‘Etanya Olaitoriani ilmareita oare apa ootegelua?’ Nji eikuna aamenu iltung'ana laainei ometaa meekure ninche aa olosho te dukuya ninche.

English: Thus saith the LORD; If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani teneitu nanu aun aitagol olning'o lai lo sotua te ndama o te nkewarie o too nkitanapat e shumata o enkop,

English: Then will I cast away the seed of Jacob, and David my servant, so that I will not take any of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and have mercy on them.
Masaai: anaata naa aany iishoritin e Yakobo o Daudi osinka lai nemagelu hoo obo le ishoi enye meitoria eishoi e Abraham, Isaak o Yakobo. Amu kashuku nanu lelo lenye ootarayioki, naa kaing'urrie nanu ninche.”

English: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth of his dominion, and all the people, fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities thereof, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani, teina kata apa egilunore Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o enjore enye pooki o nkitoriat pooki e nkop naatii abori enkitoria enye o ltung'ana pooki le Yerusalem o nkanas enyena pooki ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Go and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Shomo irorie Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda nijoki ninye, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura kaishooyo nanu ena anasa apik atua nkaik o laiguanani le Babilon, naa kepejoo ninye te nkima.

English: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand, but shalt surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth, and thou shalt go to Babylon.
Masaai: Mijeu iyie te nkaina enye, kake meeta nchere mikimbung'i nikiyauni aapik atua enkaina enye; ingurara intae too nkonyek o le Babilon nirorie ninye inchororo nkomomi, naa ilo iyie Babilon.’

English: Yet hear the word of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of thee, Thou shalt not die by the sword:
Masaai: Ore ake eyia toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani, Iyie Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda! Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo iyie: ‘Miye iyie to lalem.

English: But thou shalt die in peace: and with the burnings of thy fathers, the former kings which were before thee, so shall they burn odours for thee; and they will lament thee, saying, Ah lord! for I have pronounced the word, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Te seriani iyie ilo aye.’ Naa ore apa anaa enatapejoki enkorropil too loo papaai lino, lelo aiguanak apa ootii te dukuya iyie, neijia kipuoi aaiko aapejoki enkorropil, nikinchiraki iyie, ejo, “Aha, Olaitoriani!” ’ Amu airoro nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai aliki kulo rorei pooki Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, tiatua Yerusalem ejo,

English: When the king of Babylon's army fought against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish, and against Azekah: for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah.
Masaai: ina kata apa earare enjore o laiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem o nena anas pooki e Yuda naatelekutua, Lakish o Aseka amu kuna apake nkanas e Yuda naasheta isunta naatelekutua sunta.

English: This is the word that came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people which were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty unto them;
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani, eidipa olaiguanani Sedekia aitobira olning'o tenebo iltung'ana pooki tiatua Yerusalem pee eibalie elakunoto te ninche,

English: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.
Masaai: nchere pee elaku pooki ng'ae Ilhebrania rrindik lenyena olee o eng'oruoi, metaa metii hoo obo oitaa Olyahudi olalashe lenye orrindik.

English: Now when all the princes, and all the people, which had entered into the covenant, heard that every one should let his manservant, and every one his maidservant, go free, that none should serve themselves of them any more, then they obeyed, and let them go.
Masaai: Nening ninche, lelo kituaak pooki o ltung'ana pooki ooibung'akinote olning'o nchere pee elaaya pooki ng'ae orrindik lenye olee aashu eng'oruoi meitokini aaigil aairrindikishore; neiruk ninche nelaaya ninche.

English: But afterward they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.
Masaai: Kake ore te siadi neibelekenya ninche neitoki aarriny ilewa o nkituaak rrindiki apa ootang'asa aalaaya, neitoki aasishore ninche anaa rrindiki.

English: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondmen, saying,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel: Aitobira apa nanu olning'o tenebo loo papaai linyi ina kata apa pee aitupuku nanu ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, aitung'uaa enkaji e sinkaisho, ajo,

English: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
Masaai: ‘Ore te siadi oo larin ile nelaaya ake pooki ng'ae te ntae o Iheburaniai alashe lenye apa likitimirakaki iyie nikisiaaia ninye ilarin ile; meeta nchere pee milaaya ninye aaitung'uaa enkisiaayiare ino;’ kake eitu apa aainining loo papaai lino aashu aaisho nanu nkiyiaa enye.

English: And ye were now turned, and had done right in my sight, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:
Masaai: Irridutua oshi det niasiasa esidai too nkonyek aainei te nkibalunoto e lakunoto, oltung'ani ake o to le latia enye, nintayuyu intae olning'o te dukuya nanu tiatua ina aji naipotieki enkarna ai;

English: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom ye had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
Masaai: kake inyaakita intae aaibelekenya nisarkionienie enkarna ai ina kata apa erriny pooki ng'ae irrindiki lenyena olee o eng'oruoi, apa nitalaaitie te risioroto e yieunoto enye, niyauwu ninche aaisiaaishore anaa irrindik linyi.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ye have not hearkened unto me, in proclaiming liberty, every one to his brother, and every man to his neighbour: behold, I proclaim a liberty for you, saith the LORD, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
Masaai: Neaku, nji ejo Olaitoriani: Eitu nanu kining'ining'i teina kibalunoto o elakunoto, pooki ng'ae to lalashe lenye o to lelatia enye; ng'ura, aibalunye nanu te ntae elakunoto to lalem o to lmeitai o to lameyu Olaitoriani ojo. Kaitaa nanu intae enkuretisho too nkitoriat pooki enkop.

English: And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, which have not performed the words of the covenant which they had made before me, when they cut the calf in twain, and passed between the parts thereof,
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana ootigila olning'o lai lo sotua leitu eibung nkitanapat olning'o lai lo sotua oitobira ninche te dukuya nanu, kaitaas nanu ninche anaa oloshi ashe odung'i aaiper kat are neimi erishata nena rubat.

English: The princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, which passed between the parts of the calf;
Masaai: Ilkituaak le Yuda, o ilkituaak le Yerusalem o sunaishi oogelema, o ilapolosak o ltung'ana pooki leina kop ooima erishata oo matuan eilo ashe

English: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life: and their dead bodies shall be for meat unto the fowls of the heaven, and to the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: naa kaishooyo nanu ninche apik atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye o atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye. Ore mpopoki enye naa keaku endaa too motonyi o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi enkop.

English: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of them that seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which are gone up from you.
Masaai: Ore Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda, olkituaak lenyena kaishooyo nanu ninche apik atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lenye o atua enkaina oo lmang'ati ooing'oru enkishui enye, atua ena jore o laiguanani le Babilon nikitorrinye aaing'uaa iyie.

English: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaitanap nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, nashuku nanu ninche meetu ena anasa, nepuonu aagilunore ninye; neya ninye, nepejoo ninye te nkima, kaitaa nanu nkanas e Yuda olmuaate lememanya toki.

English: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
Masaai: Ele ororei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani too nkolong'i e Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda ejo:

English: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
Masaai: “Shomo ina aji oo Lkabii nirorie ninche, niyau ninche atua enkaji o Laitoriani, atua olgilata obo, nincho enaisho oo sabibu metooko.”

English: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;
Masaai: Naya nanu Yaa-asama olayioni le Yeremia, o layioni le Habasania, o lalashera lenyena, o layiok lenyena pooki, o enkaji pooki e Rekabi.

English: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan, the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door:
Masaai: Ayaua nanu ninche enkaji o Laitoriani atua olgilata loo layiok le Hanan olayioni le Igdalia, ilo tung'ani le Nkai, apa otii embata olgilata loo lkituaak, shumata olgilata le Maaseia olayioni le Shalum, olarriponi le kutukaji.

English: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
Masaai: Nairragie nanu te dukuya ilkabi imotioo naabore enaisho oo sabibu, o nkikompeni, najoki nanu ninche, “Entook enaisho oo sabibu.”

English: But they said, We will drink no wine: for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, Ye shall drink no wine, neither ye, nor your sons for ever:
Masaai: Kake etawalutua ninche ejo, “Mikiok iyiook enaisho, amu ore Yonadabu olayioni le Aekab, papaai lang neitanapa iyiook ajo, ‘Emiok ake enaisho oo sabibu, intae aashu ilayiok linyi ntarasi;

English: Neither shall ye build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any: but all your days ye shall dwell in tents; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers.
Masaai: mishetishete intae enkaji; misampumpu intae olantererai, miunuunu intae aashu itumutumu enkurma oo sabibu; kake itonini intae too lng'oborri too nkolong'i inyi pooki, pee itumutumu aatobikoi nkolong'i kumok teina kop nimanyimanya.’

English: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
Masaai: Kiruko iyiook oltoilo le Yonadabu olayioni le Rekab, papa lang, te nena pooki naaitanapa ninye iyiook, pee mikiok enaisho oo sabibu too nkolong'i ang pooki, maate, nkituaak ang, ilayiok lang, aashu ntoyie ang,

English: Nor to build houses for us to dwell in: neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:
Masaai: nimikishetu inkajijik nikimany atua. Mikiata iyiook isabibu, aashu enkurma aashu olantererai,

English: But we have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.
Masaai: kake kitobiko iyiook too lng'oborri nikitoning'o nikias nena pooki naaitaanapa iyiook Yonadabu papa lang.

English: But it came to pass, when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians: so we dwell at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Kake ore apa pee elotu Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon aarare enkop, nikijo iyiook, ‘Wootu maape Yerusalem te nkuretisho nikiure enjore oo Lkadayo o enjore oo le Siria.’ Neaku kitii iyiook Yerusalem.”

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yeremia ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words? saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Shomo tiaaki iltung'ana le Yuda o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, aiming'amumu intae enkiteng'enare nimining'ining'i irorei laainei? Olaitoriani ojo.

English: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are performed; for unto this day they drink none, but obey their father's commandment: notwithstanding I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but ye hearkened not unto me.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kitanapata naishoo Yonadabu olayioni le Rekab ilayiok lenyena, pee meok enaisho oo sabibu, neibung'aki, nemeok aaitasim ometabaiki ena olong, amu eibung'a ninche enkitanapata e papaai lenye. Airorie nanu intae aitirrishaki kake eitu intae kining'ining'i nanu.

English: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return ye now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and go not after other gods to serve them, and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto me.
Masaai: Airriwaka nanu intae isinkan laainei pooki iloibonok, airriu ninche aitirrishaki, ajoito, ‘Mbelekenyayu taata pooki ng'ae te intae aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, nintobir nkiaasin inono, nimilo asujaa kulie aitin pee isiaai ninche, pee itum taa atobiko tiatua ina kop apa naaishoo iyie o loo papaai linono!’ Kake eitu iyie kincho nanu enkiok.

English: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened unto me:
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Yonadabu olayioni le Rekab neibung'a ninche ina kitanapata naishoo ninche papaai lenye, kake eitu nanu aairuk kulo tung'ana.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon Judah and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them: because I have spoken unto them, but they have not heard; and I have called unto them, but they have not answered.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kayaki nanu shumata Yuda o lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem nena natudung'oko nanu ninche; enkaraki nairorie nanu ninche neitu ninche ening, aipoto nanu ninche neitu ninche eirukisho.”

English: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
