Masaai: Kake ore tialo enkaji o Lrekab nejo Yeremia, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ore enkaraki nimbung'a enkitanapata e Yonadabu papaai linyi nintabaitie pooki, nitaasa nena pooki naaitanapa ninye intae,

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever.
Masaai: nji naa ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Melau ae kata Yonadabu olayioni le Rekab oltung'ani oitashe te dukuya nanu.”

English: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that this word came unto Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan le nkitoria e Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, eewuo ele rorei enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani ejo:

English: Take thee a roll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even into this day.
Masaai: “Iwa olpiyayati ninger tiatua ninye lelo rorei pooki laairorie iyie tialo Israel o Yuda o loreren pooki, ebaiki apa enkolong naairorie nanu iyie ebaiki nkolong'i e Yosia ometabaiki taata.

English: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.
Masaai: Ekeidimayu nchere kening enkaji e Yuda ina torroni pooki naitobirita pee aitaas nanu ninche, pee etum pooki ng'ae aibelekenyayu atung'uai enkoitoi enye torrono, natumoki nanu atapalaki entorroni enye o eng'oki enye.”

English: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah: and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the LORD, which he had spoken unto him, upon a roll of a book.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia aipot Baruk olayioni le Neria, nesir Baruk tiatua olpiyayati nena naalimu Yeremia, lelo rorei pooki lo Laitoriani oirorie Yeremia ninye.

English: And Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I cannot go into the house of the LORD:
Masaai: Neitanapa Yeremia Baruk, nejoki, “Aateenaki nanu pee malo enkaji Enkai;

English: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD'S house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
Masaai: metaa ilo iyie, ore te nkolong e dukuya ening'ito iltung'ana pooki tiatua enkaji e Nkai nisuma iyie irorei lo Laitoriani teilo piyayati lingero le limunoto ai. Nilo sii aisum ninche metoning'olelo tung'ana pooki le Yuda ootupukutuo aaing'uaa nkanas enye.

English: It may be they will present their supplication before the LORD, and will return every one from his evil way: for great is the anger and the fury that the LORD hath pronounced against this people.
Masaai: Ekeidimayu pee elotu esayiare enye dukuya o laitoriani, neibelekenya pooki ng'ae aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, amu eikitok engoro o engoro napi natudung'oko Olaitoriani kulo tung'ana.”

English: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD'S house.
Masaai: Neaku etaasa Baruk olayioni le Neria nena pooki naaitanapa ninye oloiboni Yeremia nchere pee eisum to lpiyayati irorei lo Laitoriani tiatua enkaji o laitoriani.

English: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore to lari le imiet le nkitoria e Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa lioudo, ore iltung'ana pooki ooing'uaa nkanas e Yuda nepuonu Yerusalem neibalunye eenata aaitupukoo ate te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of the LORD, in the chamber of Gemariah the son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the entry of the new gate of the LORD'S house, in the ears of all the people.
Masaai: Ore ina kata ening'ito iltung'ana pooki, neisum Baruk irorei le Yeremia to lpiyayati, tiatua enkaji e Nkai, tiatua olgilata le Gemaria olayioni le Shefan ilo aigeroni, apa otii olgoriet le shumata, teine nejing'ieki enkishomi ng'ejuk e nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: When Michaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of the LORD,
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Mikaia olayioni le Gemaria, olayioni le Shefan lelo rorei pooki lo Laitoriani eing'uaa olpiyayati,

English: Then he went down into the king's house, into the scribe's chamber: and, lo, all the princes sat there, even Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.
Masaai: nedoyio ninye alo enkaji o laiguanani, atua olgilata lo laigeroni netonita apa lkituaak pooki teine. Elishama ilo aigeroni, o Delaia olayioni le Shemaia, o Enatan olayioni le Akber, o Gemaria olayioni le Shafan, o Sedekia olayioni le Hanania, olkituaak pooki.

English: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.
Masaai: Neliki Mikaia ninche lelo rorei pooki ootoning'o ninye, ina kata pee eisum Baruk olpiyayati ening'ito iltung'ana.

English: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, unto Baruch, saying, Take in thine hand the roll wherein thou hast read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the roll in his hand, and came unto them.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak pooki aairriwaa Yehudi olayioni le Netania, olayioni le Shelemia, olayioni le kushi, metiaki Baruk, “Tudumu te nkaina ino ilo piyayati lisuma ening'ito iltung'ana nilotu.” Nedumu Baruk olayioni le Neria olpiyayati te nkaina enyenelotu enetii ninche.

English: And they said unto him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Totona isuma.” Neisumaki Baruk ninche.

English: Now it came to pass, when they had heard all the words, they were afraid both one and other, and said unto Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche irorei pooki, neibelekenyakino maate te nkuretisho; nejoki ninche Baruk, “Meeta nchere mikiliki olaiguanani kulo rorei pooki.”

English: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaikilikuan Baruk ejo, “Toliki iyiook, kaji iyie nkunaka enkigeroto e kulo rorei pooki? Aitelimunoto apa e Yeremia?”

English: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
Masaai: Newaliki Baruk ninche, “Aatolikio ninye nanu kulo rorei pooki, ina kata apa aigerito nanu ninche to ranki to lpiyayati.”

English: Then said the princes unto Baruch, Go, hide thee, thou and Jeremiah; and let no man know where ye be.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak aajoki Baruk, “Shomo isudori, iyie o Yeremia niminchosho ake oltung'ani eyiolou enitii.”

English: And they went in to the king into the court, but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and told all the words in the ears of the king.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche atua olgoriet enetii. Eidipa aairragie ilo piyayati to lgilata le Elishama ilo aigeroni; neinosaki olaiguanani mbaa pooki.

English: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe's chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani Yehudi meyau olpiyayati, neya ninye aitung'uaa olgilata le Elishama ilo aigeroni; neisumaki Yehudi olaiguanani o lelo kituaak pooki apa ooitashe aatashare olaiguanani.

English: Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.
Masaai: Olapa lioudo apa ina rishata, netonita apa olaiguanani tiatua enkaji enye enkirobi netii enkima nayupuyupito dukuya ninye.

English: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eisum Yehudi imatuan uni aashu ong'uan, nedung olaiguanani te nkalem nenang'aki atua ina kima nayupuyup ometaba anaa nemut enkima nayupuyup ilo piyayati.

English: Yet they were not afraid, nor rent their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants that heard all these words.
Masaai: Ore eyia eitu eirut olaiguanani aashu lelo sinkan lenyena ootoning'o kulo rorei neitu epolos nkilani enye.

English: Nevertheless Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the roll: but he would not hear them.
Masaai: Ore ninye Elnatan o Delaia o Gemaria pee esai olaiguanani pee mepej olpiyayati, mening duoo ninye ninche.

English: But the king commanded Jerahmeel the son of Hammelech, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet: but the LORD hid them.
Masaai: Neitanap olaiguanani Yerameel olayioni lo laiguanani o Seraia olayioni le Asriel o Shelemia olayioni le Abdeel pee epuo aaibung Baruk ilo aigeroni o Yeremia oloiboni, kake eisudoyie Olaitoriani ninche.

English: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the roll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Ore te siadi, eidipa olaiguanani atapejo olpiyayati tenebo lelo rorei ooigero Baruk te limunoto e Yeremia ejo:

English: Take thee again another roll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first roll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah hath burned.
Masaai: “Iwa olikae piyayati ning'er ninye lelo rorei apa pooki ootii olpiyayati le dukuya, otapejo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: And thou shalt say to Jehoiakim the king of Judah, Thus saith the LORD; Thou hast burned this roll, saying, Why hast thou written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from thence man and beast?
Masaai: Naa ore tialo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda tejo, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani, itapejo iyie ele piyayati, ijo, “Kainyoo iyie pee ingero tiatua ninye nchere esipa kelotu olaiguanani le Babilon neinyal ena kop neishie tiatua ninye tung'ani o eng'ues?”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of Jehoiakim king of Judah; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David: and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani tiaalo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda, metum ninye hoo obo otonie olorika le nkitoo le Daudi, ore empopok enye naa kenang'ari nepej oldalati dama neinosie endeem kewarie.

English: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring upon them, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and upon the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them; but they hearkened not.
Masaai: Naa kaitame nanu ninye o eishoi enye o sinkan lenyena tenkaraki entorroni enye; kayau nanu shumata ninche, o shumata lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o shumata ilewa le Yuda, ina torroni pooki natudung'oko nanu ninche, kake mening ninche.’ ”

English: Then took Jeremiah another roll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire: and there were added besides unto them many like words.
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia adumu likae piyayati neisho Baruk ilo aigeroni, ayioni le Neria, laa ninye oigero te limunoto e Yeremia lelo rorei pooki lo lpiyayati otapejo Yehoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda te nkima; neponiki kulikae rorei laaijo lelo.

English: And king Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.
Masaai: Ore Sedekia olayioni le Yosia, laa ninye eitaa Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Yuda, neitoreisho te rishata e Konia olayioni le Yehoiakim.

English: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, did hearken unto the words of the LORD, which he spake by the prophet Jeremiah.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninye aashu isinkan lenyena aashu iltung'ana leina kop ening lelo rorei lo Laitoriani ooiroro aimunye Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai.

English: And Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now unto the LORD our God for us.
Masaai: Neirriwaa olaiguanani Sedekia Yehukal olayioni le Shelemia o Sefania olapolosani, olayioni le Maaseia meshomo enetii Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai, ejo, “Toomonoki iyiook to Laitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people: for they had not put him into prison.
Masaai: Neton apa elo Yeremia aipang nejing'u tiatua iltung'ana, amu eton apa eitu epiki ninye korokoroni.

English: Then Pharaoh's army was come forth out of Egypt: and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them, they departed from Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neipang'ua apa enjore e Farao tiatua Misiri, ore ake pee ening lelo Kaldayo apa oomanita Yerusalem ilomon lenye, nepuo aaing'uaa Yerusalem.

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto the prophet Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yeremia oloiboni:

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah, that sent you unto me to enquire of me; Behold, Pharaoh's army, which is come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel: Nji iyie tiaaki ilo aiguanani le Yuda likirriwua iyie enatii nanu pee kinkilikuanishore nanu, ‘Ng'ura, ore enjore e Farao duoo nikiyewuo aretu iyie netaa keshuko alo Misiri, enkop enye makewan.

English: And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.
Masaai: Naa keshukunye Ilkaldayo aapuonu aarare ena anasa; keya ninche ninye nepejoo ninye te nkima.

English: Thus saith the LORD; Deceive not yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us: for they shall not depart.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Emileja maate, ijojo, “Kepuo Ilkaldayo aaing'uaa iyiook,” amu mepuo ninche aaing'uaa iyiook.

English: For though ye had smitten the whole army of the Chaldeans that fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yet should they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.
Masaai: Amu ore naaji ninye te nimirimiri enjore pooki oo Lkaldayo oarare intae, neing'uari te ninche iltung'ana oata ilbaa ake, oltung'ani ake to lng'obor lenye, naa kedumunye ake ninche nepejoo ena anasa te nkima.

English: And it came to pass, that when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh's army,
Masaai: Ore ina kata pee eshuko enjore oo Lkaldayo aing'uaa Yerusalem etataana enjore e Farao,

English: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to separate himself thence in the midst of the people.
Masaai: nelo Yeremia te Yerusalem alo enkop e Benchamen pee eng'amu erubata enye teine tiatua iltung'ana.

English: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the ward was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he took Jeremiah the prophet, saying, Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans.
Masaai: Ore apa etii ninye enkishomi e Benchamen netii olkitok loo larripok oji Irija olayioni le Shelemia, olayioni le Hanania otimira aibung Yeremia oloiboni, ejo, “Isikaka iyie enkalo oo Lkaldayo.”

English: Then said Jeremiah, It is false; I fall not away to the Chaldeans. But he hearkened not to him: so Irijah took Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.
Masaai: Nejo Yeremia, “Elejare ina: maisik nanu alo enkalo oo Lkaldayo.” Kake mening Irija ninye, neibung Yeremia neyau ninye enetii ilkituaak.

English: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe: for they had made that the prison.
Masaai: Netagorokinote apa oleng lelo kituaak Yeremia neidong ninche ninye neikenoo ninye tiatua enkaji e Yonatan olaigeroni, amu eitaaki apa korokoroni.

English: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon, and into the cabins, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata pee elo Yeremia nena ajijik eenata naatii atua enkop, nebik teine nkolong'i kumok,

English: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took him out: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from the LORD? And Jeremiah said, There is: for, said he, thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: neirriwaa olaiguanani Sedekia olkilikuai meyauni ninye, neng'amu ninye. Neikilikuanishore olaiguanani ninye too nkurrat tiatua enkaji enye, nejo, “Ketii ororei oing'uaa Olaitoriani?” Nejo Yeremia “Etii” Neitoki ajo, “Eikiyauni iyie aapik atua nkaik olaiguanani le Babilon.”

English: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah, What have I offended against thee, or against thy servants, or against this people, that ye have put me in prison?
Masaai: Neitoki sii Yeremia ajoki olaiguanani Sedekia, “Kaa torroni ataasa te iyie aashu too sinkan linono aashu te kulo tung'ana pee kitipika nanu korokoroni?

English: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?
Masaai: Koree lelo oibonok linono apa likimbonokito iyie, ejo, ‘Mikilotu olaiguanani le Babilon agilunore iyie nearare ena kop?’

English: Therefore hear now, I pray thee, O my lord the king: let my supplication, I pray thee, be accepted before thee; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.
Masaai: Toning'o taata, aatoomono iyie, olkitok lai olaiguanani nchoo esayiata ai enkanyit elotu dukuya iyie, nimikingil nanu areu enkaji e Yonatan olaigeroni, maye ake nanu teine.”

English: Then Zedekiah the king commanded that they should commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, and that they should give him daily a piece of bread out of the bakers street, until all the bread in the city were spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
Masaai: Neishooyo Sedekia nkitanapat, nepik ninche Yeremia enkaji erripore; neishori ninye emukate anaake eing'uaa enepejunyeki te nkoitoi, ometaba anaa neishunye imukateni eina anasa. Neaku etobiko apa Yeremia tiatua enkaji e rripore.

English: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
Masaai: Ore apa Shefatia olayioni le Matan, o Gedalia olayioni le Pashur olayioni le Malkia, o Yukal olayioni le Shelemia nening lelo rorei apa oojoki Yeremia iltung'ana pooki,

English: Thus saith the LORD, He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live; for he shall have his life for a prey, and shall live.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ore ilo oton tena anasa neye to lalem, o to lameyu o to lmeitai; kake ore ilo oipang alo Ilkaldayo nepok, netum ninye enkishui enye anaa enkishoroto to larrabal, nepok.

English: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which shall take it.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Esipa keishoori ena anasa aapik atua enkaina e njore o laiguanani le Babilon neyai ninye.”

English: Therefore the princes said unto the king, We beseech thee, let this man be put to death: for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words unto them: for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people, but the hurt.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo kituaak aajoki olaiguanani, “Nchoo ele tung'ani metaari metua, amu eitashalita ninye nkaik e lelo sikarini oo tung'uayioki tiatua ena anasa, o nkaik oo ltung'ana pooki, tena kiroroto nairorie ninye ninche kulo rorei. Amu ore ele tung'ani mme olmabarishoi le kulo tung'ana eing'oru, kake enkitamioto enye.”

English: Then Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand: for the king is not he that can do any thing against you.
Masaai: Nejo olaiguanani Sedekia, “Ng'ura, etii ninye atua nkaik inyi; amu meidim olaiguanani ataasa ae toki napaashare intae.”

English: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech, that was in the court of the prison: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. And in the dungeon there was no water, but mire: so Jeremiah sunk in the mire.
Masaai: Neaku etudumutua ninche Yeremia nesulaki ninye atua olchorro le Malkia olayioni lo laiguanani, apa otii atua olgoriet le rripore, eitadoyio Yeremia abori too lgoso. Nemetii apa enkare atua ilo shorro, kake esarng'ab ake, neimis Yeremia tiatua ina sarng'ab.

English: Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ebed Melek ilo apa le Etiopia, ilo apa sunash ogelema kitok otii atua enkaji o laiguanani, nchere etipika ninche Yeremia atua olchorro. Netonita apa olaiguanani tiatua enkishomi e Benchamen.

English: Ebed-melech went forth out of the king's house, and spake to the king, saying,
Masaai: Nelo Ebedmelek te nkaji o laiguanani nejoki olaiguanani,

English: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is: for there is no more bread in the city.
Masaai: “Olkitok lai olaiguanani, etaasa kulo tung'ana entorroni teina pooki naitaasa ninche Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai tesulakinoto natusulakitia ninye atua olchorro: naa keye ninye te sumash, amu meetae emukate natelekua tiatua ena anasa.”

English: Then the king commanded Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from hence thirty men with thee, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he die.
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aitanap Ebedmelek ilo apa le Etiopia ajoki, “Iwa iltung'ana okuni tene nipuopuo aailepunye Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai aaitayu tiatua olchorro eton eitu eye.”

English: So Ebed-melech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.
Masaai: Nerik Ebedmelek iltung'ana tenebo ninye enkaji o laiguanani, enetii osanduku loo nkilani teneshumishoreki, neitayu ninye teine mpurdat o nkilani naatopolosate, apa naaitadoikio ninye Yeremia tiatua olchorro too lgoso.

English: And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
Masaai: Nejoki Ebedmelek ilo le Etiopia Yeremia, “Tipika nena purdat oo nkilani nkitikit inono o lgoso.” Neiko neijia Yeremia.

English: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche Yeremia aailepunye too lgoso neilepunye ninye aaitayu tiatua ilo shorro. Nebik Yeremia to lgoriet le rripore.

English: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the LORD: and the king said unto Jeremiah, I will ask thee a thing; hide nothing from me.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Sedekia olkilikuai meyauni Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai neng'amu ninye te nejing'ieki e uni e nkaji o Laitoriani. Nejoki olaiguanani Yeremia, “Kaaikilikuan nanu iyie enkikilikuanata; misudoo toki te nanu.”

English: Then Jeremiah said unto Zedekiah, If I declare it unto thee, wilt thou not surely put me to death? and if I give thee counsel, wilt thou not hearken unto me?
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia Sedekia, “Amaa tenaaliki nanu, aimintisip iyie pee kiar nanu matua? Naa tenaaisho iyie enkikoo nimikining iyie nanu.”

English: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah, saying, As the LORD liveth, that made us this soul, I will not put thee to death, neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life.
Masaai: Nenya olaiguanani Sedekia olmumai te nkisudoroto te Yeremia, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani, laa ninye oitayio iltauja lang, maar nanu iyie tua aashu aapik atua nkaik e kulo tung'ana ooing'oru enkishui ino.”

English: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah, Thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon's princes, then thy soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and thou shalt live, and thine house:
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia Sedekia, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, Enkai e Israel, tenintayu iyie kewan aishooyo too lkituaak lo laiguanani le Babilon, neitajeuni enkishui ino, nemepejori ena anasa te nkima, ore iyie o enkaji ino nipokipoko.

English: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon's princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and thou shalt not escape out of their hand.
Masaai: Kake tenimintayu iyie kewan aishooyo too ilkituaak ooya lo laiguanani le Babilon, neishoori ena anasa aapik atua enkaina oo Lkaldayo, naa kepejoo ninche ninye te nkima, nimisik iyie apuku te nkaina enye.”

English: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani Sedekia Yeremia, “Kaure nanu lelo Yahudi apa ooshomo aajing atua Ilkaldayo, maapuoi ake aaitarasaki ninche naamor ninche.”

English: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver thee. Obey, I beseech thee, the voice of the LORD, which I speak unto thee: so it shall be well unto thee, and thy soul shall live.
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia ninye, “Mikipuoi aishooyo te ninche, toning'o taata oltoilo lo Laitoriani teina naajoki nanu iyie, amu kelo asidanu te iyie, neitajeuni enkishui ino.

English: But if thou refuse to go forth, this is the word that the LORD hath shewed me:
Masaai: Kake tiniany iyie intayu kewan aishooyo, ena duaata nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani:

English: And, behold, all the women that are left in the king of Judah's house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon's princes, and those women shall say, Thy friends have set thee on, and have prevailed against thee: thy feet are sunk in the mire, and they are turned away back.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore nkituaak apa pooki naatung'uayioki tiatua enkaji o laiguanani le Yuda netorikokoki ilkituaak lo laiguanani le Babilon nejoito ninche, ‘Ore ilchoreta linono apa lisilig nikiteleja iyie nikisulaa ninche iyie; ore taata eimiso nkejek inono tiatua esarng'ab kimbelekenyate ninche aing'uaa iyie.’

English: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans: and thou shalt not escape out of their hand, but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire.
Masaai: Ore nkituaak inono pooki o layiok linono naa keyookini aaipang'ie aarikoki ilkaldayo, ore iyie enkorrok ino nimijeu te nkaina enye, kake eikimbung olaiguanani le Babilon; ore ena anasa nepejori te nkima.”

English: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and thou shalt not die.
Masaai: Nejoki Sedekia Yeremia, “Mincho hoo oltung'ani eyiolou kulo rorei aashu iye iyie.

English: But if the princes hear that I have talked with thee, and they come unto thee, and say unto thee, Declare unto us now what thou hast said unto the king, hide it not from us, and we will not put thee to death; also what the king said unto thee:
Masaai: Tenening ilkituaak nchere aairorie nanu iyie nepuonu enitii nikijoki iyie, ‘Toliki iyiook ina nitiaaka olaiguanani naa kaa kitiaka olaiguanani, misudoo hoo toki te iyiook amu mikiar iyiook iyie tua.’

English: Then thou shalt say unto them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan's house, to die there.
Masaai: Tiaaki iyie ninche, ‘Atasayia nanu olaiguanani te nkanyit pee maaigil ake areu enkaji e Yonatan mashomo aye teine.’ ”

English: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah, and asked him: and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.
Masaai: Nepuonu ilkituaak pooki enetii Yeremia neikilikuan ninye, newaliki ninche anaa enatiaka ninye olaiguanani. Nepuo ninche aaing'uaa ninye, amu ore ina kiroroto neitu apa ening'i.

English: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was there when Jerusalem was taken.
Masaai: Nebik Yeremia te nkaji e rripore o metabau ina olong apa naawaki Yerusalem.

English: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and they besieged it.
Masaai: Ore to lari lioudo le nkitoria e Sedekia, olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le tomon, nelotu Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o enjore enye pooki aarare Yerusalem nemuat aman ninye,

English: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, the city was broken up.
Masaai: ore to lari le tomon oobo le nkitoria e Sedekia, to lapa liong'uan, te nkolong e naaudo o lapa, negili isunta e nkang.

English: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, even Nergal-sharezer, Samgar-nebo, Sarsechim, Rab-saris, Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Ore apa ina kata pee eyae Yerusalem, ore ilkituaak pooki lo laiguanani le Babilon nepuonu aatoni te nkishomi empolos: Negal-Sharesa, o Samgarebo, o Sarsekim ilo apa kitok, tenebo lelo kulikae kituaak apa lo laiguanani le Babilon.

English: And it came to pass, that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them, and all the men of war, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king's garden, by the gate betwixt the two walls: and he went out the way of the plain.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda o sikarini pooki ninche, neisik ninche, nepuo auluo enkanasa te nkewarie aaim enkoitoi o enkurma o laiguanani aaim ina kishomi natii erishata oo sunta pokira are; nepuo ninche aaipir enkalo e Araba.

English: But the Chaldeans' army pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he gave judgment upon him.
Masaai: Kake etusujaitie ninche enjore oo Lkaldayo, neinepu Sedekia too nkisiajat e Yeriko ore ake pee eibung ninche ninye, neyau ninche ninye enetii olaiguanani Nebukadnesa le Babilon, te Ribla, te nkop e Hamat; nedung'okini ninye enkiguana.

English: Then the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon slew all the nobles of Judah.
Masaai: Near olaiguanani le Babilon ilayiok le Sedekia te Ribla; metuata te dukuya nkonyek enyena; near olaiguanani le Babilon ilkituaak pooki le Yuda metuata.

English: Moreover he put out Zedekiah's eyes, and bound him with chains, to carry him to Babylon.
Masaai: Naitayu ninye nkonyek e Sedekia, neyau ninye too lpisia pee eya ninye Babilon.

English: And the Chaldeans burned the king's house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nepejoo Ilkaldayo enkaji o laiguanani o enkaji oo ltung'ana, neurori isunta e Yerusalem.

English: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.
Masaai: Neitoki Nebusaradan, olkitok le rripore aya te yararoto meshomo Babilon lelo kulikae tung'ana ootelekutua tiatua ina anasa, lelo apa ooshomo enetii ninye, o lelo tung'ana otung'uayioki.

English: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, which had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.
Masaai: Neing'uaa Nebusaradan olkitok le rripore tiatua enkop e Yuda o embata oo ltung'ana aisinak lemeeta toki, neisho ninche nkurman oo sabibu o nkurman teina kata ake.

English: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, saying,
Masaai: Neishooyo Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon enkitanapata tialo Yeremia eimaa Nebusaradan, ilo kitok le rripore ejo,

English: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee.
Masaai: “Ewaita ninye eng'ura ninye oleng nimintaasiasa ake entorrono, kake entaasa ninye anaa enajoki intae.”

English: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushasban, Rab-saris, and Nergal-sharezer, Rabmag, and all the king of Babylon's princes;
Masaai: Ore Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore, neirriwaa olkilikuai, o Nebusaradan, o Rabsaris, o Negal Saresa, o Rabmag, o lkituaak pooki lo laiguanani le Babilon.

English: Even they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he dwelt among the people.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche olkilikuai, neitayu Yeremia tiatua olgoriet le rripore. Neisho ninche ninye Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, olayioni le Shefan, nchere pee erik ninye ang. Neaku etotona ninye tiatua iltung'ana.

English: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the prison, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo apa ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia ina kata apa eikenoro to lgoriet le rripore ejo.

English: Go and speak to Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring my words upon this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished in that day before thee.
Masaai: “Shomo naa tiaaki Ebedmelek ilo le Etiopia, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: ng'ura kaitabaya nanu irorei laainei tialo ena anasa te ntorroni neme te sidai, naa keitabari kenya te dukuya iyie teina olong.

English: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.
Masaai: Kake kaakordu kenya nanu iyie teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, nimikinchoori iyie aapik atua enkaina e lelo tung'ana liure.

English: For I will surely deliver thee, and thou shalt not fall by the sword, but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee: because thou hast put thy trust in me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Amu esipa kaaitajeu nanu iyie, nimibatata iyie to lalem, kake itum iyie enkishui ino anaa enkishoroto o larrabal, enkaraki nitipika osiligi lino atua nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.’ ”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah, which were carried away captive unto Babylon.
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eing'uaa Olaitoriani eidipa Nebusaradan olkitok le rripore aishoo ninye meshomo aing'uaa Rama, ina kata apa pee eya ninye eena too lpisia tenebo lelo pooki apa le Yerusalem o Yuda ootarayioki meshomo Babilon.

English: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.
Masaai: Neya ilo kitok le rripore Yeremia nejoki ninye, “Olaitoriani Enkai ino otudung'oko ene wueji entorroni:

English: Now the LORD hath brought it, and done according as he hath said: because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing is come upon you.
Masaai: eyaua Olaitoriani, netaasa ninye anaa enatejo. Enkaraki nitaasa iyie eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani, neitu ining oltoilo lenye, pee eewuo ena toki shumata iyie,

English: And now, behold, I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand. If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon, come; and I will look well unto thee: but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon, forbear: behold, all the land is before thee: whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go, thither go.
Masaai: ng'ura ore taata, kaalaku nanu aitung'uaa lelo pisia ootii nkaik inono. Tenidol eishiaakino te iyie pee ilo tenebo nanu Babilon, wou, anaa kaalo nanu agolie; kake tenidol ajo meishiaakino nilotu tenebo nanu Babilon, nimilotu. Ng'ura ajo etii enkop pooki dukuya iyie; shomo eneba anaa enidol ajo sidai neishiaakino nilo.

English: Now while he was not yet gone back, he said, Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people: or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go. So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward, and let him go.
Masaai: Tinitobiko iyie, torrinyoyu naa shomo enetii Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam olayioni le Shafan, laa ninye apa etegelua olaiguanani le Babilon aitaa olbalusui too nkanas e Yuda nibik tenebo ninye tiatua iltung'ana; aashu ilo eneba anaa enidol ajo sidai tinilo.” Neisho ilo kitok le rripore ninye endaa o enkishoroto, neisho ninye meshomo.

English: Then went Jeremiah unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and dwelt with him among the people that were left in the land.
Masaai: Nelo ninye Yeremia enetii Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, te Mispa nebik tenebo ninye tiatua iltung'ana apa ootung'uayioki teina kop.

English: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed unto him men, and women, and children, and of the poor of the land, of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon;
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening ilkituaak pooki loo njorin e Yuda teina kop naisiaja o ltung'ana lenye nchere etegelua olaiguanani le Babilon Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam aitaa olbalusui teina kop, neishoo ninye meitoria ilewa o nkituaak, o nkera, lelo apa aisinak oleng leitu eyae Babilon te yararoto,

English: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite, they and their men.
Masaai: eshomo apa ninche enetii Gedalia te Mispa Ore Ishmael olayioni le Netania, Yohanan olayioni le Karea, o Seraia olayioni le Tanhumet, ilayiok le Efai olnetofiti, Yetania olayioni le Maakasite, ninche o ltung'ana lenye.

English: And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men, saying, Fear not to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.
Masaai: Ore Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, olayioni le Shafan, nenya olmumai tenkaraki ninche o ltung'ana lenye, ejo, “Emiureishoyu tinisiaayiayia Ilkaldayo. Entobik tiatua ena kop, nisiaayiayia olaiguanani le Babilon, amu kesidanu te intae.

English: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah to serve the Chaldeans, which will come unto us: but ye, gather ye wine, and summer fruits, and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that ye have taken.
Masaai: Ore nanu, kabik te Mispa, pee aitashe te nkaraki intae te dukuya Ilkaldayo oopuonu enikitii iyiook; kake ore intae, enturrurro enaisho oo sabibu o lng'anayio le nkata enkirowuaj o eilata, nishumushumu ninche too ntokitin inyi naashumishoreki nibikibiki tiatua nkanas inyi apa nitegelutua.”

English: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab, and among the Ammonites, and in Edom, and that were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan;
Masaai: Neijia eikununo, ore apa pee ening Ilyahudi pooki ootii Moab o atua Ilamoni o atua Edom o atua kulie kuapi nchere etelekua olaiguanani le Babilon olpisiai tiatua Yuda netegelua Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, olayioni le Shafan aitaa olbalusui te shumata ninche.

English: Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, unto Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.
Masaai: Neitoki Ilyahudi pooki ashukunye eing'uaa iwuejitin apa naaterewaki ninche nepuonu enkop e Yuda, enetii Gedalia te Mispa; neiturrur ninche enaisho oo sabibu o lng'anayio le nkata enkirowuaj tenkumoi sapuk.

English: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,
Masaai: Nelotu apa Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin teina kop naisiaja aapuo enetii Gedalia te Mispa.

English: And said unto him, Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Iyiolo iyie nchere eirriwua olaiguanani loo Lamoni Ishmael olayioni le Netania pee elotu aiwuang'ie enkishui ino?” Kake menyorraa Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam ninche.

English: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spake to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Let me go, I pray thee, and I will slay Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: wherefore should he slay thee, that all the Jews which are gathered unto thee should be scattered, and the remnant in Judah perish?
Masaai: Neitoki Yohanan olayioni le Karea airorie Gedalia too nkurrat te Mispa ejo, “Nchooki nanu mashomo asesekuan Ishmael olayioni le Netania, nemeetae oltung'ani oyiolou. Kainyoo ninye pee eyieu neiwuang'ie enkishui ino, neaku ore Ilyahudi pooki likinturrurrokinote iyie neidapasha, ore ilo pisiai le Yuda neidak?”

English: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said unto Johanan the son of Kareah, Thou shalt not do this thing: for thou speakest falsely of Ishmael.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam Yohanan olayioni le Karea, “Miaas iyie ena bae, amu irorita iyie te lejare tialo Ishamel.”

English: Now it came to pass in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah the son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and the princes of the king, even ten men with him, came unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they did eat bread together in Mizpah.
Masaai: Ore to lapa liopishana, nelotu Ishmael ilo ayioni le Netania, olayioni le Elishama, leilo marei le nkitoria, laa ninye obo loo lkituaak lo laiguanani, tenebo iltung'ana tomon enetii Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, te Mispa. Ore enyaita ninche endaa tenebo teine te Mispa,

English: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men that were with him, and smote Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and slew him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.
Masaai: nedumunye Ishmael o lelo tung'ana tomon apa ootii tenebo ninye nedung to lalem Gedalia ilo ayioni le Ahikam olayioni le Shafan, near ninye metua, naa ninye apa etegelua olaiguanani le Babilon metaa olbalusui teina kop.

English: Ishmael also slew all the Jews that were with him, even with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans that were found there, and the men of war.
Masaai: Nesesekuan sii Ishmael Ilyahudi pooki apa ootii tenebo Gedalia te Mispa, o sikarini loo Lkaldayo apa otii ine.

English: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
Masaai: Ore apa teina olong te siadi esesekuanata e Gedalia, eton eitu eyiolou hoo ng'ae,

English: That there came certain from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even fourscore men, having their beards shaven, and their clothes rent, and having cut themselves, with offerings and incense in their hand, to bring them to the house of the LORD.
Masaai: nebau iltung'ana ntomoni isiet ooing'uaa Shekem o Shilo o Samaria ebarno ilmunyo lenye nepolosa nkilani enye, nedung'udung'o iseseni lenye, eyau nkishoorot e nkurma o enkorropil pee eishooyo te nkaji o Laitoriani.

English: And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it came to pass, as he met them, he said unto them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.
Masaai: Nelotu Ishmael olayioni le Netania te Mispa anang'are ninche, eishirita elotu. Ore enang'are ninche, nejoki ninche “Entijing'u wootu enetii Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam.”

English: And it was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah slew them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men that were with him.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu ninche atua enkanasa, nesesekuan ninche Ishmael olayioni le Netania o lelo tung'ana ootii tenebo ninye, nenang'akini ninche atua engumoto.

English: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael, Slay us not: for we have treasures in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he forbare, and slew them not among their brethren.
Masaai: Kake etii apa iltung'ana tomon atua ninche ootiaakitia Ishmael, “Miar iyie iyiook matuatua, amu kiata ilchumat le nkano, o eilata, o enaisho oo lotorok eisudoro ti ong'ata.” Neaku etoning'o ninye neitu ear ninche metuata tenebo lelo apa le ncholuek enye.

English: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men, whom he had slain because of Gedaliah, was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain.
Masaai: Ore apa ina gumoto natanang'aka Ishmael impopoki e lelo tung'ana ootasesekuana naa engumoto sapuk apa naitobira olaiguanani Asa arripore ina kata egilunore olaiguanani oji Baasha le Israel; neigany Ishmael olayioni le Netania impopoki oo lootuata.

English: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah, even the king's daughters, and all the people that remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam: and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the Ammonites.
Masaai: Neitoki Ishmael araya lelo kulikae tung'ana apa ootii Mispa, ntoyie o laiguanani o ltung'ana pooki apa ootung'uayioki te Mispa ootung'ueikia Nebusaradan, olkitok le rripore Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam. Neraya ninche Ishmael olayioni le Netania neboin ninche metalang'aki Ilamori.

English: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee ening Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin tenebo ninye ina torroni pooki naataasa Ishmael olayioni le Netania. Nerik ninche ilewa lenye pooki nepuo aarare Ishmael olayioni le Netania, nepuonu ninche aainepu ninye to lchorro apa otii Gibeon.

English: Then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.
Masaai: Neriku ninche iltung'ana lenye pooki nepuo aarare Ishmael olayioni le Natania. Nerik ninche ilewa lenye pooki nepuo aarare Ishmael olayioni le Natania. Neinepu ninye to lchorro sapuk otii Gibeon.

English: Now it came to pass, that when all the people which were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, then they were glad.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol iltung'ana pooki apa ootii tenebo Ishmael Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin tenebo ninye, neng'idayu ninche.

English: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
Masaai: Neaku ore iltung'ana pooki apa ootaarayie Ishmael aitung'uaa Mispa neibelekenya aashukunye, nepuo enetii Yohanan olayioni le Karea.

English: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
Masaai: Kake etuluayie Ishmael olayioni le Netania ailany Yohanan tenebo iltung'ana isiet, nelo atua Ilamoni.

English: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces that were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, even mighty men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought again from Gibeon:
Masaai: Neya Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin apa ootii tenebo ninye lelo tung'ana pooki apa ootarayie Ishmael olayioni le Netania aitung'uaa Mispa ina kata pee eidip atasesekuana Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam o sikarini, o nkituaak, o nkera, o sunaishi oo gelema apa ooyaua Yohanan ashuku te Gibeon.

English: And they departed, and dwelt in the habitation of Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,
Masaai: Nepuo ninche, aatoni te Geruut Chimham te mbata e Betlehem, ejo pee epuo Misiri,

English: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
Masaai: tenkaraki Ilkaldayo; amu keure apa ninche, enkaraki netasesekuana apa Ishmael olayioni le Netania Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, laa ninye eitaa olaiguanani le Babilon olbalusui oitore ina kop.

English: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even unto the greatest, came near,
Masaai: Ore ilarikok pooki loo njorin, o Yohanan olayioni le Karea o Asaria olayioni le Hoshaia, o ltung'ana pooki ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok, nepuonu aanyiku.

English: And said unto Jeremiah the prophet, Let, we beseech thee, our supplication be accepted before thee, and pray for us unto the LORD thy God, even for all this remnant; (for we are left but a few of many, as thine eyes do behold us:)
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai, “Nchoo esayiata ang elotu dukuya iyie, niomon Olaitoriani Enkai ino tenkaraki iyiook, tenkaraki ele pisiai pooki, (amu etelekuaki iyiook ilkuti too lkumok, anaa enidolita iyiook.)

English: That the LORD thy God may shew us the way wherein we may walk, and the thing that we may do.
Masaai: Pee etum Olaitoriani Enkai ino aitoduaa iyiook enkoitoi nikiim, o embae nikias.”

English: Then Jeremiah the prophet said unto them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray unto the LORD your God according to your words; and it shall come to pass, that whatsoever thing the LORD shall answer you, I will declare it unto you; I will keep nothing back from you.
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai ninche, “Atoning'o nanu intae, ng'ura, kaomon nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi te risioroto eomonunoto inyi, ore eneba anaa enawaliki intae Olaitoriani naa kaliki nanu intae; maisudoo nanu hoo toki te intae.”

English: Then they said to Jeremiah, The LORD be a true and faithful witness between us, if we do not even according to all things for the which the LORD thy God shall send thee to us.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche Yeremia, “Metaa Olaitoriani olchakeni osipa tiaalo iyiook tenikiaas iyiook terisioroto eilo rorei likirriwakinye Olaitoriani Enkai ino iyiook.

English: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of the LORD our God, to whom we send thee; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Tenaa sidai aashu torrono, eikiruk iyiook ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai naa ninye kirriwaa iyie enetii, pee etum atisidana te iyiook tinikiruk oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ang.”

English: And it came to pass after ten days, that the word of the LORD came unto Jeremiah.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i tomon nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yeremia.

English: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces which were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aipotu Yohanan olayioni le Karea o Larikok pooki loo njorin apa ootii tenebo ninye, o ltung'ana pooki ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok,

English: And said unto them, Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto whom ye sent me to present your supplication before him;
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel, naa ninye kirriwakita nanu mayaki enkomono inyi dukuya ninye:

English: If ye will still abide in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up: for I repent me of the evil that I have done unto you.
Masaai: tinibikibiki intae tiatua ena kop nashetu nanu intae nemauroo nanu intae; naun nanu intae, nemadotu nanu intae; amu airridua nanu ina torroni apa naitaasa nanu intae.

English: Be not afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom ye are afraid; be not afraid of him, saith the LORD: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.
Masaai: Emiureyu olaiguanani le Babilon, laa ninye iurere intae; emiureyu intae ninye, Olaitoriani ojo, amu atii nanu tenebo intae, pee aitajeu intae nakordu intae aitung'uaa enkaina enye.

English: And I will shew mercies unto you, that he may have mercy upon you, and cause you to return to your own land.
Masaai: Kaisho nanu intae olng'ur, pee etum ninye aing'urrie intae neisho intae itonini te nkop inyi maate.

English: But if ye say, We will not dwell in this land, neither obey the voice of the LORD your God,
Masaai: Kake tenijojo intae, ‘Mikitoni iyiook tiatua ena kop,’ aagolong'aki oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi;

English: Saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:
Masaai: nijojo, ‘A-a, eikipuo iyiook enkop e Misiri, ine nimikidolie iyiook olarrabal, aashu kining oltoilo le mowuo, aashu kiata esumash oo mukateni, naa eikipuo iyiook aabik teine,’

English: And now therefore hear the word of the LORD, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;
Masaai: toning'o naa ororei lo Laitoriani, lopisiai le Yuda. Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Tenipuopuo intae Misiri nimingiligili aashukunye,

English: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.
Masaai: ore ilo alem liurere nelo ainepu intae teine tiatua enkop e Misiri; ore ilo ameyu liurere nesuj intae te ngolon indipa aashom Misiri; nipuopuo aaye teine.

English: So shall it be with all the men that set their faces to go into Egypt to sojourn there; they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence: and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring upon them.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana pooki ooipirie nkomomi enye aapuo Misiri aatoni teine naa kepuo aaye to lalem, o to lameyu o to lmeitai; metum ninche olpisiai aashu ololeku teina torroni nayooki nanu ayau shumata ninche.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; As mine anger and my fury hath been poured forth upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem; so shall my fury be poured forth upon you, when ye shall enter into Egypt: and ye shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and ye shall see this place no more.
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ore anaa enapa natubukoko engoro ai o engoro ai napi lelo oomanya Yerusalem, neijia eikoni aabukoki engoro ai napi intae tenipuopuo Misiri. Naa iakuku intae entaboi, o olkirutoto o ldeket o esulare. Mingiligili ae kata aadol ene wueji.

English: The LORD hath said concerning you, O ye remnant of Judah; Go ye not into Egypt: know certainly that I have admonished you this day.
Masaai: Etiaaka intae Olaitoriani, lo pisiai le Yuda, ‘Milo Misiri tayiolo te sipata nchere aaikoo nanu iyie ena olong,

English: For ye dissembled in your hearts, when ye sent me unto the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us unto the LORD our God; and according unto all that the LORD our God shall say, so declare unto us, and we will do it.
Masaai: nchere ishomo intae aaimin tenkinyiang'a enkishui inyi. Amu kirriwaitie intae enetii Olaitoriani Enkai inyi, ijojo, ‘Toomonoki iyiook to Laitoriani Enkai ang, ore enaba anaa enajo Olaitoriani Enkai ang mbalakinye iyiook amu eikiaas iyiook.’

English: And now I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.
Masaai: Naibalakinye nanu ena olong intae, kake eitu irukuruku oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi te pooki toki naairriua nanu matoliki intae.

English: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go and to sojourn.
Masaai: Ore naa taata entayiolo entisipa nchere iyeye intae to lalem, o to lameyu o to lmeitai tiatua ine wueji nitang'uarra intae aapuo aatonie.”

English: And it came to pass, that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the LORD their God, for which the LORD their God had sent him to them, even all these words,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yeremia airorie iltung'ana pooki kulo rorei pooki lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, laa ninche eirriwayie Olaitoriani Enkai enye meshomo enetii ninche,

English: Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying unto Jeremiah, Thou speakest falsely: the LORD our God hath not sent thee to say, Go not into Egypt to sojourn there:
Masaai: ore Asaria olayioni le Hoshaiai o Yohanan olayioni le Karea o ltung'ana pooki oowuasa nejoki Yeremia, “Elejare iyie ijoito. Eitu iyie kirriu Olaitoriani Enkai ang tejo, ‘Emipuo intae Misiri aatoni teine.’

English: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us, for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they might put us to death, and carry us away captives into Babylon.
Masaai: Kake Barak olayioni le Neria ninye likimbayunye iyiook, pee iyau iyiook matuata aashu eya iyiook te yararoto Babilon.”

English: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, obeyed not the voice of the LORD, to dwell in the land of Judah.
Masaai: Neaku ore Yohanan olayioni le Karea o larikok pooki loo njorin o ltung'ana pooki neitu eiruk oltoilo lo Laitoriani, pee ebik tiatua enkop e Yuda.

English: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, that were returned from all nations, whither they had been driven, to dwell in the land of Judah;
Masaai: Kake ore Yohanan olayioni le Karea o lkituaak pooki loo njorin neya olpisiai pooki le Yuda apa otushukunye alotu aton tiatua enkop e Yuda eing'uaa iloshon pooki apa oowaki

English: Even men, and women, and children, and the king's daughters, and every person that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah.
Masaai: ilewa, o nkituaak, o nkera, o ilkituaak o pooki tung'ani apa otung'ueikia Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore e Gedalia olayioni le Ahikam, olayioni le Shafan; o Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai o Barak olayioni le Neria.

English: So they came into the land of Egypt: for they obeyed not the voice of the LORD: thus came they even to Tahpanhes.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche atua enkop e Misiri, amu eitu apa eiruk oltoilo lo Laitoriani. Nebau ninche Tefahes.

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yeremia tiatua Tafahes ejo:

English: Take great stones in thine hand, and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln, which is at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;
Masaai: “Iwa too nkaik inono isoito sapuki, nisudoo ninche te nkop teine nejing'ieki enkaji enkitoo e Farao tiatua Tafehes, te dukuya iltung'ana le Yuda,

English: And say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.
Masaai: nijoki ninche, ‘Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kairriu nanu nayau Nebukadresa ilo aiguanani le Babilon, osinka lai, naa kepik ninye olorika lenye le nkitoo shumata kulo soito laisudoiyie nanu, naa keisalaashaki ninye olng'obor lenye le nkitoo shumata ninche.

English: And when he cometh, he shall smite the land of Egypt, and deliver such as are for death to death; and such as are for captivity to captivity; and such as are for the sword to the sword.
Masaai: Kelotu ninye aar enkop e Misiri, aisho lelo apake lo lmeitai enya olmeitai, ore lelo apake ooigerokino eyararoto nepuo eyararoto, nepuo olalem lelo apake oigerokino olalem.

English: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
Masaai: Neinok ninye enkima tiatua nkajijik oo nkaitin e Misiri; naa kepejoo ninye ninche nenap ninche aya eyararoto; naa keituku ninye enkop e Misiri, anaa enaituku olairritani loo ntare olkila lenye meshomo lashe; naa kelo ninye aing'uaa ine te seriani.

English: He shall break also the images of Bethshemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of the Egyptians shall he burn with fire.
Masaai: Naa kegil ninye nena ng'apeta naasinya e Heliopolis naatii atua enkop e Misiri; ore nkajijik oo nkaitin e Misiri nepejoo te nkima.’ ”

English: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews which dwell in the land of Egypt, which dwell at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Noph, and in the country of Pathros, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei oewuo enetii Yeremia eipirta lelo Yahudi pooki apa oomanya enkop e Misiri, te Migdol, te Tafahes, te Memfis, o tiatua enkop e Patros ejo,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Ye have seen all the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, and upon all the cities of Judah; and, behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwelleth therein,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Itoduaa intae ina torroni pooki nayaua nanu shumata Yerusalem o shumata nkanas pooki e Yuda. Ng'ura, ore ena olong olmuaate ninche, nemetii hoo ng'ae omanya atua ninche,

English: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, and to serve other gods, whom they knew not, neither they, ye, nor your fathers.
Masaai: enkaraki ina torroni nataasa ninche, naaitagor nanu, teina nashomo ninche aapej enkorropil neisiaai kulie aitin apa neitu eyiolou ninche, ninche aashu o intae aashu loo papaai linyi.

English: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets, rising early and sending them, saying, Oh, do not this abominable thing that I hate.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia aitirrishaka nanu airriwaki intae isinkan laainei pooki lelo oibonok le Nkai, ajo, ‘Ee, miaas ena taboi naiba nanu!’

English: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense unto other gods.
Masaai: Kake eitu ninche ening aashu eishoru enkiok enye, pee eibelekenya aaing'uaa entorroni enye nemeitoki aapejoki enkorropil kulie aitin.

English: Wherefore my fury and mine anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as at this day.
Masaai: Neaku ore emion o engoro ai napi netubukuoki neyupuyupieki tiatua nkanas e Yuda o tiatua nkoitoi e Yerusalem; neaku ninche mijoonito o lmuaateni, anaa enatiu tena olong.

English: Therefore now thus saith the LORD, the God of hosts, the God of Israel; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls, to cut off from you man and woman, child and suckling, out of Judah, to leave you none to remain;
Masaai: Ore naa taata nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Kainyoo intae pee iasiasa ena torroni sapuk tialo intae maate, aadung'oo aaiwuangie tiatua intae olee o enkitok, elooyo o enkerai, aaitung'uaa empolos e Yuda, nemeing'uiekini intae olpisiai?

English: In that ye provoke me unto wrath with the works of your hands, burning incense unto other gods in the land of Egypt, whither ye be gone to dwell, that ye might cut yourselves off, and that ye might be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee kintagorigoro nanu te siaai oo nkaik inyi, ipejokiki enkorropil kulie aitin tiatua enkop e Misiri teine apa nietuo aatonie, pee etumi aaiwuang'ie intae niakuku oldeket o enkurruna tiatua iloreren pooki le nkop?

English: Have ye forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives, which they have committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?
Masaai: Ketorikine intae esuujisho oo loo papaai linyi, entorroni o laiguanani le Yuda, o entorroni oo kituaak enye, o entorroni inyi maate, o entorroni oo nkituaak inyi apa nataasa ninche tiatua enkope Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem?

English: They are not humbled even unto this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.
Masaai: Eitu ninche eitobor ate ometabaiki ninye ena olong, aashu eureishoyu, aashu epuo te nkitanapata ai o nkiguanat aainei apa natipika dukuya intae o dukuya loo papaai linyi.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, and to cut off all Judah.
Masaai: “Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura kaing'orie nanu enkomom ai intae te ntorroni, pee aiwuang'ie Yuda pooki.

English: And I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, and they shall all be consumed, and fall in the land of Egypt; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine: they shall die, from the least even unto the greatest, by the sword and by the famine: and they shall be an execration, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.
Masaai: Kaya nanu ilo pisiai le Yuda ooibelekenya inkomomi enye pee epuonu enkop e Misiri aatonie naa keidaikieki ninche pooki; tiatua enkop e Misiri epuo ninche aabatata to lalem, o to lameyu eidaikieki ninche; ebaiki oloti ometabaiki olkitok, keye nincheto lalem o to lameyu; naa keaku ninche enking'asia o enkuretisho o ldeket o enkurruna.

English: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence:
Masaai: Kaitame nanu lelo oobikito tiatua enkop e Misiri anaa enaidipa aitamio Yerusalem, to lalem to lameyu o to lmeitai,

English: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
Masaai: keaku meetae hoo obo teilo pisiai le Yuda apa oewuo aton tiatua enkop e Misiri, ojeu aashu epok aashu eshuko alo enkop e Yuda, naa ninye apa etang'uarra pee eshuko aapuo aabik teine, amu merrinyo ninche meteleku ake ilkuti aisikak.”

English: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods, and all the women that stood by, a great multitude, even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,
Masaai: Ore apa lelo lewa pooki ooyiolo aajo eishoo nkituaak enye enkorropil kulie aitin, o nkituaak pooki naaitasheto te mbata, o lturrur kitok, ore iltung'ana pooki oomanya Patros tiatua enkop e Misiri, newaliki Yeremia ejo:

English: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the LORD, we will not hearken unto thee.
Masaai: “Ore tialo ele rorei litolikio iyiook te nkarna o Laitoriani, mikining iyiook iyie.

English: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth, to burn incense unto the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, as we have done, we, and our fathers, our kings, and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem: for then had we plenty of victuals, and were well, and saw no evil.
Masaai: Kake eikiaas iyiook pooki toki naba anaa enikinosakita olmumai, aapejoki enkorropil enkaiguanani e shumata nikibukoki ninye ilasarri ooki, anaa apa enikitaasa iyiook o loo papa, o laiguanak lang o lkituaak lang, tiatua inkanas e Yuda o too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem; amu ore apa ina kata nikiata endaa sapuk nikidupoyu, neitu kidol entorroni.

English: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.
Masaai: Ore anaa nikipal iyiook eitu kipejoki enkorropil enkainguanani e shumata o embukokinoto o lasar ooki, nikitalaita iyiook pooki toki neidaikieki iyiook to lalem o to lameyu.”

English: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven, and poured out drink offerings unto her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings unto her, without our men?
Masaai: Nejo nkituaak, “Amaa apa pee kipejoki enkorropil enkaiguanani e shumata nikibukoki ninye olasar ooki, aimeyiolo apa ilmoruak lang pee kintayu imukateni naata enkitanyaanyukoto enye nikibukokininye ilasarri ooki?”

English: Then Jeremiah said unto all the people, to the men, and to the women, and to all the people which had given him that answer, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki Yeremia ajoki iltung'ana pooki, ilewa o nkituaak, o lelo tung'ana pooki ooishoo ninye ena walata:

English: The incense that ye burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, ye, and your fathers, your kings, and your princes, and the people of the land, did not the LORD remember them, and came it not into his mind?
Masaai: “Amaa tialo ina orropil apa nitapejo intae tiatua inkanas e Yuda, o too nkoitoi e Yerusalem, intae o loo papaai linyi, o laiguanak linyi olkituaak linyi, oltung'ana lena kop, keitu edamu Olaitoriani? Keitu elotu ena damunoto enye?

English: So that the LORD could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which ye have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
Masaai: Meekure eidim Olaitoriani ating'iriakinoyu entorroni oo nkiaasin inyi o nena o lminong nitaasa intae, neaku etaa enkop inyi olmuaate ewueji mitil oldeket meetae olomanya, anaa enatiu ena olong.

English: Because ye have burned incense, and because ye have sinned against the LORD, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki nitapejo intae enkorropil o enkaraki nitaasa intae eng'oki to Laitoriani aashu ipuopuo te nkitanapata enye o too nkiguanat enyena o te nchakenisho enye, pee etadoikio intae ena torroni, anaa enatiu ena olong.”

English: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of the LORD, all Judah that are in the land of Egypt:
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia iltung'ana pooki o nkituaak pooki, “Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae pooki le Yuda ootii atua enkop e Misiri,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saying; Ye and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: ye will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
Masaai: nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ore intae o nkituaak inyi nimbalie too nkutukie inyi, nintabaitie too nkaik inyi, ijojo, ‘Esipa eikiaas iyiook nena nikinosakita olmumai likintobira aapejoki enkorropil enkaiguanani e shumata nikibukoki ninye olasar ooki.’ Entudup naa ilmuma linyi niasiasa nena!

English: Therefore hear ye the word of the LORD, all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, saith the LORD, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, The Lord GOD liveth.
Masaai: Ore naa entoning ororei lo Laitoriani, intae pooki le Yuda oobikito tiatua enkop e Misiri: ng'ura, ainosa nanu olmumai te nkarna ai kitok, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere ore enkarna ai meitokini ae kata aaipot te nkutuk e pooki tung'ani le Yuda tiatua enkop pooki e Misiri, ejo, ‘Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani.’

English: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Judah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aing'orita nanu ninche te ntorroni neme te sidai, ore iltung'ana pooki le Yuda ootii atua enkop e Yuda naa keidaikieki to lalem o to lameyu, ometabau enkiting'oto enye.

English: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, and all the remnant of Judah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooimisho to lalem naa keshuko aaing'uaa enkop e Misiri aapuo enkop e Yuda, naa kuti esiana; ore ilo pisiai pooki le Yuda, apa oewuo enkop e Misiri aton, neyiolou aajo kalo rorei ouno, kolalai aashu olenye.

English: And this shall be a sign unto you, saith the LORD, that I will punish you in this place, that ye may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
Masaai: Ele olo aaku olmonekie te intae, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere kaitame nanu intae tene wueji, pee itumutumu aatayiolo nchere esipa keitashe ororei lai tialo intae te ntorroni:

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ng'ura, kaishooyo nanu Farao, aisho Hofra ilo aiguanani le Misiri apik atua enkaina oo lmang'ati lenyena o atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye, anaa apa enaishooyie Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda apik atua enkaina e Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon olaa olmang'atinta lenye apa neing'oru enkishui enye.”

English: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei eirorie Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai Barak olayioni le Neria, ina kata apa pee eiger ninye kulo rorei tiatua embuku te limunoto e Yeremia, to lari liong'uan le Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, unto thee, O Baruch;
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai e Israel tialo iyie Barak:

English: Thou didst say, Woe is me now! for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
Masaai: Itejo iyie, ‘Woi kewan ai, amu etoponayie Olaitoriani osina le mion ai, atalepori nanu too nkigorot aainei, nematum enkiyeng'iyeng.’

English: Thus shalt thou say unto him, The LORD saith thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
Masaai: Nji iyie tiaaki ninye, nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura ina natesheta nanu naa kasulaa, ore ina natuuno nanu naa kadotu taa enkop pooki.

English: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.
Masaai: Ing'oru doi iyie ntokitin pooki sapuki tialo kewan ino? Ming'oru iyie ninche; amu ng'ura, kayau nanu entorroni shumata pooki toki naishu naata osesen Olaitoriani ojo: kake ekaaisho nanu iyie enkishooroto o larrabal tiatua iwuejitin pooki neeba anaa nilo.”

English: The word of the LORD which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
Masaai: Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai eipirta iloreren ejo.

English: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.
Masaai: Ena naipirta Misiri, tenkaraki ina jore e Farao Neko, olaiguanani le Misiri, apa natii embata o lkeju le Farite te Karkemish naa ninye apa etimira Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon to lari liong'uan le Yehoiakim olayioni le Yosia, olaiguanani le Yuda:

English: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
Masaai: “Entobira ilong'oi kutiti o long'oi sapuki pee ingutakiki olarrabal!

English: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
Masaai: Entobira mbartan; entaked, intae ilakedok loo mbartan! Entoluaata iatata iruparen inyi, entisik iremeta inyi, enchopo nkilani inyi oo lgooitie!

English: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kainyoo nanu pee atoduaa ina? Etureishote ninche neibelekenyate aashuko. Earitae ilmuran lenye aaiting'ie, neipirritio aaisik te nkisarrisar; menang ninche silig enkuretisho te pooki shoto! Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Meidim ilo oten ailanyisho, nemeidim olmurrani aimisho te moikuape te mbata olkeju le Farite etarrorrote ninche nebatata.

English: Who is this that cometh up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
Masaai: “Kaing'ae ele, oilepu anaa olkeju le Nail, anaa ilkejek ooilugo nkariak?

English: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
Masaai: Eilepua Misiri anaa olkeju le Nail, anaa ilkejek ooilugo nkariak. Etejo ninye, kailepu nanu, kaiput nanu enkop, kainyal nanu nkanas o lelo oomanya.

English: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.
Masaai: Enchom oleng nabartan, nikuetikuete, na garrin oo mbartan enchoo ilmurran epuo lelo tung'ana le Etiopia o Puti ooyiolo long'oi, o lelo tung'ana le Ludi arriyiak tenkibung'ata e nkauo.
