English: For this is the day of the Lord GOD of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for the Lord GOD of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
Masaai: Ore idia olong naa enkolong o Laitoriani loo lororani, enkolong e lap, pee eitalaaki kewan too lmang'ati lenyena. Keinos olalem ometaraposhoyu, neok osarge ometirikayu. Amu Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani oibung'ita olasar, teina kop e moikuape te mbata olkeju le Farite.

English: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shalt thou use many medicines; for thou shalt not be cured.
Masaai: Ilepa shomo Gilead niyau olchani, na selenkei e Misiri! itooko iyie ilkeek kumok pesho; meetae enkishiunoto te iyie.

English: The nations have heard of thy shame, and thy cry hath filled the land: for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.
Masaai: Etoning'o iloreren nkuapi kumok enkurruna ino, neiputa enkop pooki olkiyioi linyi; amu etabatatakine olmurrani olikae murrani etabatatate tenebo.”

English: The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ele rorei eirorie Olaitoriani Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai oipirta elotunoto e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon pee eosh enkop e Misiri:

English: Declare ye in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say ye, Stand fast, and prepare thee; for the sword shall devour round about thee.
Masaai: “Mbalie tiatua Misiri, nintoning'oo tiatua Migdol; ntoning'oi tiatua Memfis o Tayahes; Tejo, ‘Ntasho tashololoyu nirretena, nirretena amu keman olalem amuat embata ino.’

English: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eisika Enkai inyi napi Apis kainyoo pee eitu eitashe oloing'oni linyi? Enkaraki natanang'aka Olaitoriani ninye enkop:

English: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
Masaai: Etarrorre esiamo inyi nebatata, nejokino ninche oltung'ani o likae, ‘Tudumunye, ematushukoto iyiook aapuo enetii iltung'ana lang maate. o enkop apa natoinyeki iyiook, tenkaraki ilo alem leilo oibooki iyiook enkop.’

English: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he hath passed the time appointed.
Masaai: Mpoto enkarna e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, ‘Olailepilepani oiturraa enkata.’

English: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
Masaai: “Ore anaa enaishu nanu, Olaiguanani ojo, laa ore enkarna enye naa Olaitoriani loo lororani, ore anaa Tabor tiatua ildoinyo, o anaa Karmel te mbata enaiposha, neijia etiu ilo olotu.

English: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Entobira ilolan linyi pee isikisiki, intae iloomanya Misiri! amu keaku Memfis olmuaate o enkidaata, meetae olomanya.

English: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
Masaai: “Enkashe sidai Misiri, kake eewuo olojong'ani torrono ooing'uaa moikuape shumata ninye.

English: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
Masaai: Ore ninye lelo sikarini lenyena ooigeroki ootii atua ninye netiu anaa ilasho ooitopiroki, ee, eibelekenyate ninche neisik tenebo, eitu ninche eitashe; amu eewuo enkolong enkidaata enye shumata ninche, enkata enkitamioto enye.

English: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
Masaai: “Eitayu ninye oltoilo leijo olasurai elotu te ngolon; amu eisarisarutua ilmang'ati lenyena te ngolon, nepuonu aarare ninye too ntoluo, anaa loshi oouroo ilkeek.

English: They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
Masaai: Kepuonu ninche aadung entim enye, Olaitoriani ojo. Hoo nemeikenayu amu eikumok ninche aalang olmaati; meeta ninche esiana.

English: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
Masaai: Ore ina tito e Misiri naa keitukurruni, keyauni ninye aapik atua enkaina oo ltung'ana ooing'uaa moikuape.”

English: The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, saith; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
Masaai: Etejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel, “Ng'ura kayau nanu enkitamioto shumata Amon le Sebes, o Farao, o Misiri, o nkaitin enyena o laiguanak lenyena, shumata Farao o lelo ooisilig ninye.

English: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kayau nanu ninche apik atua enkaina e lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye, atua enkaina e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon o lkituaak lenyena. Ore te siadi nemanyi Misiri anaa apake, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
Masaai: “Kake miureishoyu, iyie Yakobo osinka lai, aashu ing'aing'ai iyie Israel; amu ng'ura, kaaitajeu nanu aitung'uaa enelakua, ore eishoi ino naitung'uaa ina kop enye eyararoto. Keshukunye Yakobo netum enkitirring'a o enkiyeng'iyeng, nemeetae oloitore ninye.

English: Fear thou not, O Jacob my servant, saith the LORD: for I am with thee; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee: but I will not make a full end of thee, but correct thee in measure; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished.
Masaai: Miureishoyu, iyie Yakobo osinka lai, Olaitoriani ojo, amu atii nanu tenebo iyie. Kaiting'ie nanu katukul iloshon pooki lelo apa laaterewa nanu iyie. Kake ore iyie maaiting'ie tukul kaaitame nanu iyie te nkiririkinoto nasipa, nemeeta nanu nchere pee aatung'uayie mintamio.”

English: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
Masaai: Ele ororei lo Laitoriani apa oewuo enetii Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai eipirta Ilfilisti, eton eitu ear Farao Gasa ejo,

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura, keilepu nkariak naaing'uaa moikuape, naa keaku olkeju onang'ari; naa keiput enkop pooki o pooki nabore, enkanasa o lelo oomanya atua. Neyietu ilewa aaishir, ore pooki ng'ae omanya ina kop neyietu aishir

English: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
Masaai: to ltoilo loo loisotok loo mbartan enyena te nkuetata oo ngarrin enyena oo mbartan te manaroto oo nkejek oo ngarrin, ore iloomenye nkera nemeitoki aaibelekenya aaing'or nkera enye, etalepori nkaik enye.

English: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remaineth: for the LORD will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
Masaai: Tenkaraki ina olong nalotu aidaikie Ilfilisti pooki aiwuang'ie te Turo o Sidon pooki aretoni oing'uari amu emutita Olaitoriani Ilfilisti, ilo pisiai lo lmanie le nkare le Kafto.

English: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long wilt thou cut thyself?
Masaai: Eewuo osina kitok shumata Gasa, eidaa Ashkelon. Lopisiai o telekua le Anakim, eidung'udung'u akenya kewan to sina o anu?

English: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.
Masaai: La alem lo Laitoriani! kanu kenya intirring'a? Tipika kewan atua enchashur ino, iyeng'iyeng'ayu nintirring'a!

English: How can it be quiet, seeing the LORD hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there hath he appointed it.
Masaai: Kaji eiko ninye teneitirring'a teneisho ninye Olaitoriani enkitanapata? metaarare Ashkelon nearare olomanaa lenaiposha amu ine etegelua ninye.

English: Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
Masaai: Ena naipirta Moab. Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: “Woi Nebo, amu eitomijoonoki Eitukurruaki Kiriataim, ewaki ninye; eitukurruaki osempewuet negili ninye;

English: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also thou shalt be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue thee.
Masaai: meekure ening'o Moab. Tiatua Heshbon eitobira ninche entorroni tenkaraki ninye: ‘Wou, maiwuang'ie iyiook ninye meitoki aaku olosho!’ Ore sii intae, lo tung'ana oomoda, keitigiri intae; kesujaa intae olalem.

English: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
Masaai: “Etoning'e olkiyioi te Horonaim ‘Eyararoto o enkidaata sapuk!’

English: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
Masaai: Eidaikieki Moab; ening'itoi olkiyioi tenelakua anaa Soar.

English: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
Masaai: Amu ore eilepaki iltung'ana Luhit neilepaki eishirita; amu ore edoiki Horonaim netoning'o ninche olkiyioi le nkidaata.

English: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
Masaai: Eisika! Entajeu ate! kueta anaa oloitiko to lpurkel!

English: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures, thou shalt also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
Masaai: Amu, ore enkaraki nisiliga intae engolon inyi o lchumat linyi, keyae sii ninche intae; naa kelo Kemosh atua eyararoto, tenebo ilapolosak lenyena o lkituaak lenyena.

English: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as the LORD hath spoken.
Masaai: Kelotu olainyalani shumata pooki anasa, nemeetae enkanasa naimisho keidak oyarata, ore enkisiajiata neidaikieki anaa enairoro Olaitoriani.

English: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
Masaai: Enchoo Moab inaipuko, amu kelotu ninye tiaai, keaku nkanas enyena ilmuateni meetae olomanya atua ninche.

English: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the LORD deceitfully, and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood.
Masaai: Etediaki ilo oas esiaai Olaitoriani emereriana; netediaaki ilo oibooyo olalem lenye meibukoo osarge.

English: Moab hath been at ease from his youth, and he hath settled on his lees, and hath not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither hath he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
Masaai: “Eitirring'a apa Moab ebaiki kitisho enye eitirring'e ninye te mumit enye eitu epikuni te mpirbil aapik ae pirbil, neitu ninye elo atua eyararoto; neaku etii olnyorrie lenye atua ninye, neitu eibelekenya olng'usil lenye.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
Masaai: Neaku, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, nairriwaki nanu ninye lelo oopiku pee epikuni ninye, neitoroki empirbil enye nebelibel mpirbili enyena aaitaa mbelibelat.

English: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.
Masaai: Nekurru Moab tenkaraki kemosh, anaa apa enatukurrua enkaji e Israel tenkaraki Betel, osiligi lenye.

English: How say ye, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
Masaai: “Kaji intae inkoko pee ijojo, ‘Kira iyiook iloing'ok, iltung'ana ooidipa olarrabal?’

English: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore olainyalani le Moab o nkanas enyena neilepua alotu, ore ilbarnot lenyena gelunot nedoyio aapuo enkidaaroto Olaiguanani ojo laa ore enkarna enye naa Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
Masaai: Ore olkiyioi le Moab netataana ore osina lenye nekuetu.

English: All ye that are about him, bemoan him; and all ye that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
Masaai: Enchiraki ninye, intae pooki oomanita ninye, o pooki ooyiolo enkarna enye; entejo, ‘Eng'ura etigile eng'udi nagol, ina ng'udi enkitoo.’

English: Thou daughter that dost inhabit Dibon, come down from thy glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon thee, and he shall destroy thy strong holds.
Masaai: Wou tadou tung'uai enkitoo ino, niton te nkop e nkure iyie olomanya Dibon! Amu eewuo oloidaikie Moab pee kigilunore, neidaikie ninye isempewueti linono.

English: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
Masaai: Ntasho te mbata e nkoitoi ing'ura, iyie olomanya Areor! Nkilikuana ilo oisik oina naluaya; tejo, ‘Kaa nataase?’

English: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; and tell ye it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
Masaai: Eitukurruaki Moab, amu etigilaki; teyietu ninchir! Tolikioi te mbata olkeju le Aron, nchere eirragita Moab aa olmuaate.

English: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
Masaai: “Eewuo enkiguana shumata ina kop naitoriori, shumata Holon, o Yahasa, o Mefaat,

English: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,
Masaai: o Dibon, o Nebo, o Bet-diplataini,

English: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
Masaai: o Kiriataim, o Betagam, o Betmeon,

English: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
Masaai: o Keriot, o Bosra, o nkanas pooki enkop e Moab, naalakua o naataana.

English: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Etudung'oyioki esesekuan e Moab, ore enkaina enye netigilaki, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
Masaai: “Ntemera ninye, enkaraki nailepie ninye kewan aitorisioki Olaitoriani; neaku kelo Moab aiperipera tiatua irrugumat enyena, naa keaku sii entoki nakueniyieki.

English: For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy.
Masaai: Aime entoki apa nakueniyieki Israel te iyie? Keinepuaki apa ninye tiatua ilapurrok, eji peyie aa ore ake pee iimaki nimipirripir elukunya?

English: O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that maketh her nest in the sides of the hole's mouth.
Masaai: “Entung'uai nkanas nimanyimanya ndapidapo intae iloomanya Moab! Entotiu anaa nturkuluoni naaitobir nkajijik too mbat enkutuk e ngumoto.

English: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
Masaai: Kitoning'oitie iyiook olwuasa le Moab kewuasa ninye oleng tenkilashilash enye, olwuasa lenye, enkitokoos enye, o emusunoto oltau lenye.

English: I know his wrath, saith the LORD; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu enkilashilash enye, Olaitoriani ojo: ore enkitoo enye naa elejare, ore nkiaasin enyena naa elejare.

English: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; mine heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.
Masaai: Neaku kayietu nanu te nkaraki Moab; kaishir nanu te nkaraki Moab pooki; ore te nkaraki iltung'ana le Kiheres naishir nanu.

English: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer: thy plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage.
Masaai: Kaaishiraki nanu iyie oleng oleng alang enaishiraki Yaser, lo sabibu le Sibma! elang ilng'osil linono enaiposha, nepuo aabaya Yaser, ore shumata ilng'anayio linono te nkata enkirowuaj etadoikio olainyalani oidaikie.

English: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
Masaai: Ewaki enchipai o eng'ida aaitung'uaa ina kop naisho oleng e Moab; aishoo nanu enaisho oo sabibu meishunye too nkironyeta; meetae hoo ng'ae oirony ninche too mbuakunot eng'ida; ore ina buakunoto neme embuakunoto e ng'ida.

English: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
Masaai: “Ening'itoi oltoilo le nkishirata e Heshbon o Eleale te Yahas, eitayutuo iltoiloishi lenye eing'uaa Saor ometabaiki Horonaim o Eglat-shelishia. Amu etomijoono sii nkariak e Nimrim.

English: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
Masaai: Naa kayau nanu meiting'o te Moab, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo oitayu olasar tiatua ewueji e shumata nepejoki enkorropil enkai enye.

English: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
Masaai: Neaku keishiraki oltau lai Moab anaa endule, neishir oltau lai anaa endule te nkaraki iltung'ana le Kiheres; neaku ore enkarsisisho apa nanoto ninche neidaayie.

English: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
Masaai: “Amu etabarnoki pooki lukunya nedung'i pooki munyei; netii nkaik pooki indung'ot ore mpolosi neishopokino ilkuniyiani to sina.

English: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nchumat oo nkajijik e Moab o tiatua nkoitoi dapashi metii ae toki neme enkishirata, amu atigila nanu Moab anaa emasaai nemeetae oltung'ani oshilaa, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
Masaai: Eng'ura etigile! Eng'ura eyietu! Eibelekenye Moab te nkurruna! Neaku etaa Moab entoki nakueniyieki o enkuretisho te lelo pooki oomanita ninye.”

English: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura kelo obo tiaai aipirri anaa olkurragos, neisalaashaki inaipuko enyena shumata Moab;

English: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
Masaai: keyae nena anas neibung'i lelo sempewueti. Ore oltau loo loing'ok le Moab teina olong netiu anaa oltau le nkitok nasaisai;

English: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the LORD.
Masaai: keidaikieki Moab nemeitoki aatii iltung'ana, enkaraki nailepie ninye kewan aitorisioki Olaitoriani.

English: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Etii enkuretisho, o engumoto o rreshet dukuya intae, iloomanya Moab! Olaitoriani ojo.

English: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisik aing'uaa enkuretisho nedoiki atua engumoto, ore eked engumoto ailepu neibung orreshet. Amu kayau nanu kuna baa shumata Moab teilo ari le nkitamioto enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
Masaai: Tiatua oloip le Heshbon eitashe ilaisikak meeta engolon; amu eipang'a enkima alo eing'uaa Heshbon, enkiyupuyup naing'uaa enkaji e Sihon: einyala ninye enkomom e Moab, emaupe enkitoo o ruparen e lelo ayiok oonyor olarrabal.

English: Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth: for thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.
Masaai: Oi iyie Moab! Eishieki iltung'ana le Kemosh; amu ewaki ilayiok linyi aaraya ore ntoyie inyi neyae atua eyararoto.

English: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, saith the LORD. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
Masaai: Ore eyia kashuku nanu dupoto e Moab too nkolong'i naapuonu, Olaitoriani ojo.” Nji eikununo endung'okinoto e nkiguana e Moab.

English: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
Masaai: Ena ejo Olaitoriani tialo Ammon: “Aimeeta Israel ilayiok? Aimeeta ninye oloyooki ajung? Kainyoo naa pee ewa Milkom Gad, ore iltung'ana lenyena netamanya nkanas enyena?

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i, Olaitoriani ojo, pee aisho nanu olkiyioi lo larrabal metoning'oyu te nkaraki Raba oo Lamoni; naa keaku olmuaate mijooni, ore nkang'itie enyena nepejori te nkima; netum taa Israel aawa lelo apa oowaita ninye, Olaitorianiojo.

English: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, ye daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
Masaai: “Teyietu, iyie Heshbon, amu eitomijoonoki enkang e Ai! Nchira iyie, natito e Raba! Nchopoki kewan ilkuniyiani, nchira, nikuet alimana tiatua nkang'itie! Amu kelo Milko atua eyararoto, tenebo ilapolosak lenyena o lkituaak lenyena.

English: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys, thy flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee intokoos too yarat linono naselenkei nemeisiligayu, apa naisiliga olchumati lenye, ejo, ‘Kaing'ae laalo aarare nanu?’

English: Behold, I will bring a fear upon thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts, from all those that be about thee; and ye shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
Masaai: Ng'ura kayau nanu enkuretisho shumata iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, aitung'uaa lelo pooki likimanita iyie, naa kearari intae aaipang'ie, neilanyisho pooki ng'ae, nemeetae hoo ng'ae oiturrur lelo ooimin.

English: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore te siadi nashuku nanu lelo tung'ana loo Lamoni apa ootarayioki, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Concerning Edom, thus saith the LORD of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
Masaai: Ena bae etejo Olaitoriani naipirta Edom: “Aimeekure etii eng'eno atua Teman? Keidaayie enkiguana te lelo ang'eni? Keimisiloyie eng'eno enye?

English: Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
Masaai: Elanyisho entushukoto, entotoni tiatua ewueji negut, intae iloomanya Dedan! Amu kayau nanu entaboi e Esau shumata ninye, teina kata naitameyie nanu ninye.

English: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
Masaai: Amaa tenepuonu ilaiturrurrok loo sabibu enitii aimeleku ninche kulikae ng'anayio? Amaa tenepuonu ilapurrok kewarie, aime ina ake nairirikino ninche einyal?

English: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
Masaai: Kake atooruo nanu Esau nkilani, metaa olmasipai, ataboluo nanu iwuejitin enyena neeisudoriyie, nemeekure eidim aisudori. Eidaikieki nkera enyena, o lalashera lenyena o lelatia enye; nemeekureeetae ninye.

English: Leave thy fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let thy widows trust in me.
Masaai: Tapala nena kera inono nemeeta menye, kaitopok nanu; nchoo maaisiliga inyi nkolia nanu.”

English: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished? thou shalt not go unpunished, but thou shalt surely drink of it.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Amaa teneok, lelo lemeishiaakino teneok enkikompe enye enkitamioto ijo iyie ilo mintamio? Milo iyie mintamio, kake meeta nchere pee miok iyie.

English: For I have sworn by myself, saith the LORD, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
Masaai: Amu ainosa nanu olmumai te kewan ai, Olaitoriani ojo, nchere keaku Basara, entoki naitureisho, enkurruna, olmuaate oldeket, ore nkanas enyena pooki neaku ilmuaateni anaake.”

English: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu ilomon supati ooing'uaa Olaitoriani, neirriwakaki olkilikuai atua nkuapi pooki: “Enturrurroto maate tenebo, nipuonunu aarare ninye, nidumakinono olarrabal!”

English: For, lo, I will make thee small among the heathen, and despised among men.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kaaitaa nanu iyie kiti tiatua iloreren, nikimenuni tiatua iltung'ana.

English: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee, and the pride of thine heart, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, that holdest the height of the hill: though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nena baa naaitureishore nikiteleja iyie, oilo wuasa lo ltau lino, iyie oton too lbaat le ndapidapoi oibung entopij oldoinyo. Ore hoo nipik enkaji ino shumata oleng anaa olkurragos, kaaitadou nanu iyie aitung'uaa ine, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
Masaai: “Keaku Edom entoki naitureisho; ore pooki ng'ae oim embata enye neiputukuny, te nkaraki ina nataraki ninye.

English: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of man dwell in it.
Masaai: Ore anaa enapa natanang'ayioki Sodom o Gomora, o nkanas naatashare, Olaitoriani ojo, meetae oltung'ani oitoki alo aton teine, meetae oltung'ani omany atua ninye.

English: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore anaa olng'atuny oilepu alotu aing'uaa entim e Yordan ajing'aki emuatata nagol oo nkerra, kaisho nanu ninche mekueta nabo kata aapuo aaing'uaa ninye, nagelaki nanu shumata ninye oloba anaa olagelu. Amu kaing'ae laanyaanyukie nanu? Kaing'ae laaipotu nanu? Kalo shekut loo ntare oidim aitasho te dukuya nanu?

English: Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
Masaai: Neaku toning'o enkitobirata naitobira Olaitoriani tialo Edom o eyieunoto naipirakinye ninye lelo oomanya Teman: Keing'irtitori ninye lelo ooti le luaata aaya; ore iluaat enye neiputukuny teina.

English: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
Masaai: Ore to ltoilo le mbatatata enye neigirigiro enkop; ore oltoilo le nkishirata enye nening'i te naiposha nanyokie.

English: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
Masaai: Ng'ura kekedisho obo nekuet tiai anaa olkurragos, nelak inaipuko enyena agilunore Basara, ore oltau loo lmurran le Edom netiu akenya ina olong anaa oltau le nkitok te saisai enye.”

English: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
Masaai: Ena ejo Olaitoriani tialo Dameski: “Eitukurruaki Hamad o Arpad, amu etoning'o ninche mbaa torrok, etalepori ninche te nkuretisho, neilugo anaa enaiposha nemeidim aitirring'ayu.

English: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turneth herself to flee, and fear hath seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
Masaai: Etemene Dameski, eibelekenye ninye aisik, neterewa ninye olkirutoto; neibung ninye emion o sinaitin, laaijo ilenkitok nasaisai.

English: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
Masaai: Anaaijo ketung'uayioki enkanasa ning'oti, ina anasa e ng'ida!

English: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Neaku kepuo ilbarnot lenyena aabatata too lkurrot ootumoreki le nkanasa, ore isikarini lenyena pooki nemuti teina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
Masaai: Anaa kainok nanu enkima tiatua olpaashe, naa keidaikie lelo sempewueti le Benhadad.”

English: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus saith the LORD; Arise ye, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
Masaai: Ena ejo Olaitoriani tialo Kedar o enkitoria te Hasar apa natesesekuana Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon: “Entudumunye, enchom entaarare Kedar! Endaikie iltung'ana le nkilepunoto enkirowuaj!

English: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
Masaai: Keyae akenya ilng'oborri lenye o luaat enye oo nkerrai, o ilkarash lenye o masaa enye pooki; nerei ntamesin enye aaitung'uaa ninche neishiraki iltung'ana ninche: ‘Enkuretisho te pooki shoto!’

English: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O ye inhabitants of Hazor, saith the LORD; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you, and hath conceived a purpose against you.
Masaai: Esika endapashari te nelakua, entobik tiatua enguton, intae iloomanya Hasor! Olaitoriani ojo. Amu ore Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon, neitobira enkitobirata tialo intae neipirua ina nayieu tialo intae.

English: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
Masaai: Tudumunye, shomo taarare ina kop te leleki, etonita te seriani Olaitoriani ojo, ina nemeeta nchomito aashu isekenke, ina nabikito openy.

English: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kerayae akenya ntamesin enye ore luaat enye oo nchoo neaku iyararot. Naidapashaki nanu pooki siuo lelo oodung ilpijat loo lpapit lenye nayau nanu osina lenye aimunye pooki shoto enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of man dwell in it.
Masaai: Keaku Hasor emanyisho oo mbariak, olmuaate loo ntarasi. Meetae oltung'ani olo aton tiatua ninye.”

English: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,
Masaai: Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai eipirta Elam, te nkiterunoto enkitoria e Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda ejo:

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Ng'ura kagil nanu enkawuo e Elam, ine netii engolon e magilanisho enye;

English: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
Masaai: naa kayau nanu shumata Elam ilkutat pokira oong'uan eing'uaa imatuan ong'uan e shumata naa kaidapashaki nanu ninche lelo kutat pooki, nemeitoki atii olorere lemepuonu lelo ooterewa olkutati te Elam.

English: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them even my fierce anger, saith the LORD; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
Masaai: Kaiture nanu Elam te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, o te dukuya lelo ooing'oru enkishui enye; kayau nanu entorroni shumata ninche, o engoro ai napi, Olaitoriani ojo. Kairriwaa nanu olalem metusujaininche, ometaba anaa namut nanu ninche;

English: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, saith the LORD.
Masaai: naa kapik nanu olorika lai le nkitoo Elam, naidaikie olaiguanani lenye o lkituaak, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore too nkolong'i e siadi nashuku nanu lelo ooena le Elam, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
Masaai: Ele rorei eiroro Olaitoriani neipirta Babilon eipirta enkop oo Lkaldayo eimunye Yeremia ilo oiboni le Nkai ejo:

English: Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
Masaai: “Mbalie tiatua loreren nintudupaa, entipik enanka nintudupaa, emisudoo, naa entejo: ‘Ewaki Babilon neitukurruni enkai enye naji Bel, Etapalari Merodak eitukurruaki nkitanyaanyukot enyena ore nena kitanyaanyukot neme enkai neitapalari.’

English: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
Masaai: “Amu moikuape eing'uaa enkop nalotu aarare ninye, naa ninye nalotu aitaa enkop enye mitil, nemeitoki hoo ng'ae amanya; keisik oltung'ani o eng'ues aailanyisho.

English: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek the LORD their God.
Masaai: “Ore kenya te nena olong'i o teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, ore iltung'ana le Israel o ltung'ana le Yuda, nepuonu tenebo, neishir ninche epuonu neing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai enye.

English: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
Masaai: Neikilikuanu ninche enkoitoi nalo Sion, eibelekenya nkomomi enye aaing'or ina alo, ejo, ‘Wootu, matushulare iyiook Olaitoriani tiatua osotua loo ntarasi lemerikinishoi ae kata.’

English: My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
Masaai: Etaa apa iltung'ana laainei ntare naaimina, etorikoitie ninche ilairritak lenye aaitapong'oo, aaibelekeny ninche too ldoinyo nepuo ninche oldoinyo o endoinyo, etorikine ninche eluaata enye.

English: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the LORD, the habitation of justice, even the LORD, the hope of their fathers.
Masaai: Ore pooki oonoto ninche neinosa ninche, netejo ilmang'ati lenye, ‘Eitu iyiook kintarruoo; amu etaasa ninche eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani, laa ninye emanyisho enye nadede, Olaitoriani osiligi loo loo papaai lenye.’

English: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
Masaai: “Esika entung'uai empolos e Babilon, nipuopuo aaipang te nkop oo Lkaldayo, nitiuu anaa iloroi te dukuya iluaat oo ntare.

English: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kadumu nanu nayau metaarare Babilon olorora kitok loo loreren oogol, ooing'uaa enkop e moikuape; naa keitobirakino ninche olarrabal pee earare ninche; ore teine neyae ninye. Eikununo mbaa enye anaa olmurrani arriyia lemeshukunye ninye too nkaik naarook.

English: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Keaku kepuo Ikaldayo eyararoto; ore lelo pooki ooraya ninye netum pooki toki, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Because ye were glad, because ye rejoiced, O ye destroyers of mine heritage, because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
Masaai: “Ore hoo ning'ida, ore hoo nirup kewan, intae ilararok le njung'ore ai, ore hoo nintigiran anaa enkashe too nkujit, ninchirishiri anaa oloing'oni le mbarta,

English: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
Masaai: keitukurruni ng'utunyi katukul, ore apa ina natoiwuo intae nesuli. Ee, keaku ninye e nesiadi too loreren, ong'ata natoyio naa olpurkel.

English: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki engoro o Laitoriani memanyi ninye, kake keaku olmuaate mijooni; ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo Babilon neiputukuny, neing'asia te nkaraki ilbaa lenyena pooki.

English: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the LORD.
Masaai: Entobirakinoto pee iararere Babilon aaman aamuat te pooki shoto, intae pooki ooriu enkawuo, entang'or ninye, mileku mbaa, amu etaasa ninye eng'oki tialo Olaitoriani.

English: Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the LORD: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.
Masaai: Tabuaaki ninye te pooki shoto, ekueta ninye etuurori nkang'itie enyena, etusulari isunta enyena, amu elap Olaitoriani ena; intalaku elap te ninye, ntaasa ninye anaa apa enataasa.

English: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
Masaai: Iwuang'ie te Babilon olaunoni, o ilo oibung olalem le nkisampuare te nkata enkisampuare; ore te nkaraki ilo alem lo loitorogonyani, keibelekenyakino pooki ng'ae iltung'ana lenye maate, neisikaki pooki ng'ae enkop enye makewan.

English: Israel is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones.
Masaai: “Enker narreshitoi Israel namirta ilng'atunyo etang'asa olaiguanani te Asiria ainos ninye, ore taata te siadi neguenyita Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon iloik lenyena.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
Masaai: Neaku, nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Ng'ura, kayau nanu enkitamioto shumata olaiguanani o enkop enye, anaa apa enaitame nanu olaiguanani le Asiria.

English: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
Masaai: Kashukoki nanu Israel ewueji enye nedaare, naa kedaa ninye te nchumata e Karmel o tiatua Bashan, neiputakini ninye eyieunoto enye te nchumata oldoinyo le Efraim o tiatua Gilead.

English: In those days, and in that time, saith the LORD, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
Masaai: Ore akenya te nena olong'i o teina kata, Olaitoriani ojo, neing'oruni entorroni te Israel, nelai, neing'oruni ng'ok tiatua Yuda, nemetumi hoo nabo; amu kapalaki nanu lelo laleku metaa olpisiai.

English: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, saith the LORD, and do according to all that I have commanded thee.
Masaai: “Ilepa shomo taarare enkop e Merasaim, nilo aarare lelo oomanya Pekod, taara metuata, tusujai indaikie ninche katukul. Olaitoriani ojo, naa taasa nena pooki naaitanapa nanu iyie.

English: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
Masaai: Etii oltoilo lo Larrabal atua enkop, o enkidaata kitok!

English: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
Masaai: Kaji eikuna olnyuntu le nkop pooki pee etudung'oki aagil! Kaji eikuna pee etaa Babilon entoki naitureisho tiatua iloreren!

English: I have laid a snare for thee, and thou art also taken, O Babylon, and thou wast not aware: thou art found, and also caught, because thou hast striven against the LORD.
Masaai: Airragie apa nanu orreshet te nkaraki iyie, nikimbung'aki iyie Babilon, neitu apa iyie iyiolou; kinotoki apa iyie nikimbung'i, enkaraki nitekeshere iyie Olaitoriani.

English: The LORD hath opened his armoury, and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of the Lord GOD of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
Masaai: Etabolo Olaitoriani ewueji enye neshumieki imasaa o larrabal, neitayu imasaa o larrabal engoro enye napi, amu eeta Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani esiaai naas tiatua enkop oo Lkaldayo.

English: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
Masaai: Tarasaki ninye te pooki shoto; tabolo ilchumat lenyena le ndaa; tasoto ninye anaa isotot le nkano, nindaikie ninye tukul; mincho eleku toki te ninye.

English: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
Masaai: Taara metuata ilmurran lenyena pooki oingok nchoo ninche edoyio aapuo ewueji neyieng'ishoreki. Oi ninche, amu eewuo enkolong enye, enkata enkitamioto enye.

English: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of the LORD our God, the vengeance of his temple.
Masaai: “Enining'o oltoilo lenye eisik te nkop e Babilon, pee eibalunye tiatua Sion elap o Laitoriani Enkai ang, elap te nkaraki enkaji enye.

English: Call together the archers against Babylon: all ye that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she hath done, do unto her: for she hath been proud against the LORD, against the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: “Mpotu lelo oong'oroo mbaa meetu aarare Babilon lelo pooki ooriu enkawuo. Entamuat entaman ninye; emincho eluaya hoo obo. Entalaa ninye te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena, entaasa ninye te risioroto e nena pooki naataasa ninye; amu eisarkionie ninye to lwuasa lenye Olaitoriani, ilo sinyati le Israel.

English: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku kebatata ilbarnot lenyena too lkurrot ootumoreki le nkanasa, enye, ore isikarini lenye pooki neidaikieki teina olong, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Behold, I am against thee, O thou most proud, saith the Lord GOD of hosts: for thy day is come, the time that I will visit thee.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kaarare nanu iyie, lo tawuasai, Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani ojo; amu eetuo nkolong'i inono, e nkata naaitameyie nanu iyie.

English: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
Masaai: Kerrorro ilo wuasa nebatata, nemeetae olodumu ninye aitasheyie, naa kainok nanu enkima too nkanas enye naa kemut pooki toki namanita ninye.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Eibookoki iltung'ana le Israel enkop o ltung'ana le Yuda tenebo ninche, ore lelo pooki apa ootaraitie ninche neibung'a ninche aakurraki, etanyaita ninche eisho ninche meshomo.

English: Their Redeemer is strong; the LORD of hosts is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
Masaai: Ore ilo olaku ninche naa kegol; Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye. Kemitu ninye ninche tukul, pee etum aishoo enkop enkiyeng'iyeng, kake enyamali te lelo oomanya Babilon.

English: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the LORD, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
Masaai: “Etii olalem shumata Lkaldayo, Olaitoriani ojo, o shumata lelo oomanya Babilon o shumata lkituaak lenyena o lang'eni lenyena!

English: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
Masaai: Etii olalem shumata lelo aitumusumusok, pee etum aataa ilmoda! pee etumi aaidaikie ninche!

English: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
Masaai: Etii olalem shumata mbartan enyena o shumata ngarrin enyena oo mbartan o shumata lelo timito omon ootii atua ninye, pee etum aata ing'oruo! Etii olalem shumata ilchumat lenyena, pee etumi aawaita.

English: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
Masaai: Etii entoi shumata nkariak enyena pee etumi aaitoyio. Amu enkop oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin ninye netomodate ninche too nkitanyaanyukot neme inkaitin.

English: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
Masaai: “Neaku kemany ilouarak le ntim o lng'ojinia Babilon, nebik isidan tiatua ninye; meitoki aatii iltung'ana atua ninye ntarasi, nememanyi too lporori pooki.

English: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the LORD; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of man dwell therein.
Masaai: Amu ore apa enatotiuo pee enang'aa Enkai Sodom o Gomora o nkang'itie naatashare, Olaitoriani ojo, neijia etiu meitokini aata oltung'ani omanya ine nemeitokini aata oltung'ani obik teine.

English: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, epuonu iltung'ana ooing'uaa enkalo e moikuape; erretena olosho magilani o laiguanak kumok too wuejitin neelakua enkop.

English: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
Masaai: Eibung'ita ninche enkawuo o empere; kegogong ninche nemeeta olng'ur. Ore oltoilo le lototo enye etiu anaa enaiposha nailugo; neked ninche mbartan, neishopo anaa oltung'ani lo larrabal pee kiarare iyie, natito e Babilon!

English: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
Masaai: “Etoning'o Olaiguanani le Babilon oratioti lenye, neilepunye nkaik enyena; neiput ninye emion, emion naaijo ene nkitok nasaisai.

English: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ore anaa olng'atuny olotu te ntim e Yordan ajing'aki eluaata oo ntare, kaluam nanu ninche mekueta aaing'uaa Babilon; nagelu nanu meitoria ninye oloba anaa olagelu. Amu kaing'ae laanyaanyukie nanu? Kaing'ae laakesh nanu? Kalo shekut loo ntare oidim aitasho te dukuya nanu?

English: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the LORD, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
Masaai: Neaku toning'o enkitobirata naitobira Olaitoriani agilunore Babilon, o yieunot naaipirua ninye agilunore enkop oo Lkaldayo. Esipa ore lelo ooti le luaata enye naa keingirtitori aaya; esipa ore eluaata enye naa keiputukuny.

English: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
Masaai: Ore to ltoilo le yararoto e Babilon neigirigiro enkop, ore enkishirata enye nening'ori tiatua iloreren.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ng'ura, kaputu nanu enkiyang'et enkidaaroto metigilunore Babilon, negilunore lelo oomanya Kaldea;

English: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
Masaai: naa kairriwa Babilon ilasilak naa kepuo aasil ninye, naa keitorok ninche enkop enye, tenepuonu aarare ninye te pooki shoto teina olong e nyamali.

English: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine: and spare ye not her young men; destroy ye utterly all her host.
Masaai: Mincho ilo ong'orisho te nkauo eyietu enkawuo enye, nimincho ninye meitasho eeta imasaa enyena o larrabal mileku ilbarnot lenyena; indaikie tukul ilororani lenyena pooki.

English: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
Masaai: Kebatata ninche etaraki metuata te nkop oo Lkaldayo, netipikaki ilbaa too nkoitoi enyena naalala.

English: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.
Masaai: Amu eitu eing'ua Israel o Yuda Enkai enye, Olaitoriani loo lororani; kake ore enkop oo Lkaldayo nebore enkitarruoroto tialo ilo Sinyati le Israel.

English: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD'S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
Masaai: “Esika entung'uai empolos e Babilon, enchoo pooki tung'ani eitajeu enkishui enye! Emincho edung'ori intae te nkitamioto enye amu enkata e lap o Laitoriani ena, enkitalakunoto naitalak ninye.

English: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
Masaai: Etiu apa Babilon anaa enkikompe e sahabu te nkaina o laitoriani, eitemer enkop pooki; etemerate iloreren te naisho enye oo sabibu, neaku eshomo nkuapi etarruoitie ilukuny.

English: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so she may be healed.
Masaai: Etabatate nabo kata Babilon negila; teyietu nchiraki ninye! Ewaita olchani te nkaraki emion enye. Eidimayu pee eishiunyeki ninye.

English: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
Masaai: Anaata iyiook kinchiunye Babilon, kake eitu ninye eishiu tung'uai ninye, maape iyiook oltung'ani ake enkop enye makewan; amu ore endung'okinoto enye e nkiguana netabaikia shumata netudumuaki aailepie omeitabaikini nkatampo.

English: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
Masaai: Etabawua enkata pee eilepie iyiook Olaitoriani enkilepioto ang, wou, maibalunye iyiook tiatua Sion esiaai o Laitoriani Enkai ang.

English: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of the LORD, the vengeance of his temple.
Masaai: “Eiyio nena baa! Entudumu ilong'oi! Etuputuo Olaitoriani oltau loo laiguanak le Amedi, amu ore eyieunoto enye tialo Babilon naa pee eidakie ninye, amu ina elap o laitoriani, elap te nkaraki enkaji enye.

English: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
Masaai: Entipik ilmonek isunta e Babilon; Entagolo ilarripok. Entipik ilarripok; Entobira ilnukat. Amu eitobira Olaitoriani neitabayie ina apa nairoro tialo lelo oomanya Babilon.

English: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
Masaai: Oi iyie oton too nkariak kumok, karsis too lchumat etabawua enkiting'oto ino, etudung'oki olpiyayoil le nkishui ino.

English: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill thee with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against thee.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani loo lororani olmumai te kewan enye: Esipa kaaiput nanu iyie iltung'ana ooba anaa ilmaat, naa keilepie ninche embuakunoto e nkisulata nikisulie ninche iyie.

English: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
Masaai: “Ilo ninye oitayio enkop te ngolon enye, laa ninye oitobira enkop te ng'eno enye nagut, ore te yiolounoto enye neitorioo shumata.

English: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth: he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.
Masaai: Teneitayu oltoilo lenye netii enkikurrukur oo nkariak shumata, neisho ninye enkinuku metudumunye too nkiting'ot enkop. Eitayu ninye nkiwuang'at e nchan, neisho osiwuo metupuku aing'uaa ineeshumishoreki enyena.

English: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
Masaai: Kemoda pooki tung'ani nemeeta eng'eno; eitukurruaki pooki kunoni too nkitanyaanyukot enyena; amu ore nkitanyaanyukot enyena naa elejare, nemetii enkiyang'et atua ninche.

English: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
Masaai: Inepesho ninche, esiaai nemeeta tipat; ore te nkata enkitamioto enye nerruoyo ninche.

English: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: the LORD of hosts is his name.
Masaai: Mitiu iyie anaa kulo, ilo laa erubata e Yakobo, amu ninye oipirua ntokitin pooki, ore Israel naa olosho le njung'ore enye; Olaitoriani loo lororani enkarna enye.

English: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
Masaai: “Ira iyie enyuntu ai o emasaai o larrabal: te iyie nanu agil iloreren aitaa ingiligilat. te iyie nanu aidaikie nkitoriat,

English: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
Masaai: negiligili imbartan o lakedok, negiligili ingarrin oo mbartan o larewak lenye.

English: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
Masaai: Near metuata ilewa o ngoruo nesesekuan iltung'ana moruak o looti; near metuata nkayiok o ntoyie.

English: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
Masaai: Nesesekuan ilairritak loo ntare o nkerrai enye, nesesekuan ilaturok loo nkurman o mbartan enye, nepurd ilaitoriak o lelo oota enkitoo.

English: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Kalaaki nanu o lelo pooki oomanya atua Ilkaldayo te dukuya nkonyek inono teina torroni apa pooki nataasa ninche te Sion, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the LORD, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and roll thee down from the rocks, and will make thee a burnt mountain.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kaarare nanu iyie ele otiu anaa oldoinyo oinyalisho, Olaitoriani ojo, ilo oidaikie enkop pooki; kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai pee aarare iyie, naa kaibeleleng'oo nanu too ndapidapo naaitaa nanu iyie oldoinyo otapejoki.

English: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but thou shalt be desolate for ever, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nemeitayuni te iyie osoit oitaae o lo lmairroto, nemeitayuni osoit lo lkitamyunoto, kake iaku iyie mijooni anaake Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
Masaai: “Tuuno iyie enanka te nkop, toosho entarumpeta tiatua iloreren, ntobiraki nkuapi olarrabal tialo ninye, mpotoki ninye nkitoriat meetu aarare ninye, Ararat, o Mini, o Askenas; Entegelu olarikonile njore oarare ninye. Eyautu mbartan naaba anaa olmaati.

English: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
Masaai: Ntobiraki nkuapi olarrabal pee earare ninye lelo aiguanak le Mede, tenebo ilbalusuni lenye, o laretok lenye, o pooki kop natii abori enkitoria enye.

English: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of the LORD shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
Masaai: Eikirikira enkop te mion, amu eitashe nkitobirat o Laitoriani ear Babilon, pee eitaa enkop e Babilon mitil, nememanya tung'ani.

English: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might hath failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
Masaai: Etapala ilmurran le Babilon olarrabal, ebikito ninche too sempewueti lenye eishunye engolon enye etaa ninche nkituaak eibung'ita enkima imanyishoritin enye. Etigilate ntaloishin oo nchomito enye.

English: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
Masaai: Eipirri oltung'ani anang'are olikae nenang'are olkilikuai olikae pee eliki olaiguanani le Babilon nchere eibung'aki enkanasa enye te pooki shoto.

English: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
Masaai: Eibung'aki iwuejitin neelang'ieki too lkejek netapejoki iwuejitin neeisudoriyieki te nkima neiputukunyo isikarini lo larrabal.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai e Israel: Etotiwuo entito e Babilon anaa osoit oiutuutishoreki tenakata naitunyoki, ore ake eyia naa tenkiti kata naa kelotu enkata e nkisampuare enye.”

English: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me, he hath crushed me, he hath made me an empty vessel, he hath swallowed me up like a dragon, he hath filled his belly with my delicates, he hath cast me out.
Masaai: “Nebukadresa ilo aiguanani le Babilon laatumuta nanu, aatupurda ninye nanu, aaitaa ninye empirbil narok aatoijoie ninye anaa enkukuu. Eiputa ninye enkoshoke enye intokitin ainei e sikar, aaiturrayie ninye anotu.

English: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
Masaai: Metijing'a shumata Babilon ina kinyalata naainyalaki nanu o ltung'ana laainei.” Nchoo ilo omanya Sion ejo, “Metijing'a osarge lai shumata lelo oomanya Kaldayo. Nchoo Yerusalem ejo.”

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will plead thy cause, and take vengeance for thee; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ng'ura, kaamitu nanu naitalaku elap te nkaraki iyie. Kaitoi nanu enaiposha enye naitoi enkong'u enye e nkare,

English: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling place for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
Masaai: naa keaku Babilon osototi loo suut neaku emanyisho oo mbariak ewueji olkirutoto o enking'asia nememanya tung'ani.

English: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions' whelps.
Masaai: “Keikurrukur ninche tenebo anaa ilng'atunyo; neishir anaa ilkuoon lo lng'atuny.

English: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore te nkure enye naitobiraki nanu ninche, naitemer nanu ninche o metishipata neirura ninche nkolong'i pooki nemeigil aainyototo, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
Masaai: Kaitadou nanu ninche anaa ilkuoon le kerra oopuoi aayieng, anaa ilmeregeshi o loroi.

English: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
Masaai: “Eng'ura eneikunayioki Babilon, ewaki ina naikasie enkop pooki eng'ura aajo etaa Babilon entoki naitureisho too loreren!

English: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
Masaai: Eilepaka enaiposha Babilon, eitemoyioki ninye te lelo apir le naiposha kumok.

English: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.
Masaai: Etaa nkanas enyena entoki naitureisho enkop natoiwuo olpurkel, enkop nememanya hoo ng'ae nemeim hoo oltung'ani atua ninye.

English: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
Masaai: Naa kaitame nanu ina ai e Babilon naji Bel, naitayu tiatua enkutuk enye ina toki natoijoyie meitoki nkuapi aarukokino ninye etusulari esuntai e Babilon.

English: My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD.
Masaai: “Empang'a enchom te mpolos enye, lo tung'ana laainei! Nchoo pooki tung'ani eitajeu enkishui enye teina goro napi o Laitoriani!

English: And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
Masaai: Emimputukunyunyu nimiruturutu teilo marenke oning'o te nkop tenelotu olomoni to lari obo. Neitoki ake olomoni alotu to likae ari netii olarrabal enkop nearare oloitoreisho likae oitoreisho.

English: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
Masaai: “Neaku, ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i pee aitame nanu nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e Babilon; neitukurruni enkop enye pooki, ore lelo tung'ana lenyena pooki ootaraki metuata te mpolos enye.

English: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Netum taa shumata o enkop, o pooki natii atua ninche, aatarany te ng'ida tenkaraki Babilon amu kelotu oloidaikie aarare ninche oing'uaa moikuape, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
Masaai: Meeta nchere mebatata Babilon tenkaraki lelo ootuata le Israel, amu tenkaraki Babilon etabatatate lelo loo nkuapi pooki ootuata.

English: Ye that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember the LORD afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
Masaai: “Ore intae oo imishote to lalem, enchom, emintashe aaitirring'a! Entadamu Olaitoriani tenelakua enchoo Yerusalem elotu ndamunot inyi:

English: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame hath covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD'S house.
Masaai: ‘Eitukurruaki iyiook, amu kitoning'o embuaakinoto eimulumulayie esulare inkomomi ang amu eetuo iltung'ana loo loreren atua iwuejitin sinyat e nkaji o Laitoriani!’

English: Wherefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
Masaai: “Neaku, ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i Olaitoriani ojo, pee adung'oki nanu enkiguana nena kitanyaanyukot enyena naa ore tiatua enkop enye pooki neishir te mion lelo oata ilbaa.

English: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore hoo nerupa Babilon abaiki shumata ore hoo naa keitagol ailepie ine neshurie, ore ake eyia naa kepuonu ilainyalak ooidaikie ooing'uaa enatii nanu aapuonu enetii ninye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans:
Masaai: “Enining'o! enkishirata naing'uaa Babilon! oltoilo le nkidaata kitok eing'uaa enkop oo Lkaldayo!

English: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice; when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered:
Masaai: Amu emutita Olaitoriani Babilon neimisie ilo toilo lenye kitok. Ore ilopir lenye neikurrukur anaa ilopir loo nkariak kumok, ore embuakunoto oo ltoiloishi lenye neitabuakuni;

English: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite.
Masaai: amu eewuo olainyalani shumata ninye, shumata Babilon; ewaki ilmurran lenyena etigilaki nkai enyena aaitaa ngiligilat amu ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai e lap, esipa keitalaku ninye.

English: And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains, and her rulers, and her mighty men: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kaitemer nanu ilkituaak lenyena o lang'eni lenyena, ilbalusuni lenyena, ilarikok lenyena le njore, o lmurran lenyena; keirura ninche anaake nemeigil aainyototo, olaiguanani ojo, oji enkarna enye Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ina suntai dapash e Babilon naa keitorisiokini enkop aaitadou, ore nena shomito enyena adoru naa kepeji te nkima. Eisiaaisho iltung'ana te mpesho ore nkuapi pooki naa te nkima ake eitanaur ate.”

English: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. And this Seraiah was a quiet prince.
Masaai: Ele rorei apa eitanapa Yeremia oloiboni le Nkai Seraia olayioni le Neria, olayioni le Mahaseia ina kata apa pee elo tenebo Sedekia olaiguanani le Yuda Babilon, to lari liong'uan le nkitoria enye. Olaitasheikinoni apa Seraia.

English: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
Masaai: Neiger apa Yeremia tiatua embuku ina torroni pooki nalotu shumata Babilon, kulo rorei pooki apa eigeroki ooipirta Babilon.

English: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When thou comest to Babylon, and shalt see, and shalt read all these words;
Masaai: Nejoki Yeremia Seraia: “Tinilotu kenya Babilon, toduaa nchere isuma iyie kulo rorei pooki,

English: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off, that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast, but that it shall be desolate for ever.
Masaai: nijo iyie Olaitoriani, itejo inaaipirta ene wueji nchere iwuang'ie iyie ninye, pee meitoki amanya toki atua ninye, aa tung'ani aashu eng'ues, naa keaku olmuaate ntarasi.

English: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
Masaai: “Ore pee indip aisuma ena buku, teeniki ninye isoito ninang'aki empolos olkeju le Frati,

English: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
Masaai: nijo, ‘Nji eikoni Babilon aaimisie, pee meigil ae kata adumunye, tenkaraki ina torroni nayau nanu shumata ninye.’ ” Ene ebaiki irorei le Yeremia.

English: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
Masaai: Ilarin tikitam oo obo apa eeta Sedekia pee eiteru aitoreisho; neitoreisho ninye ilarin tomon oobo te Yerusalem. Ore apa enkarna e ng'otonye naa keji Hamutal entito e Yeremia le Libna.

English: And he did that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
Masaai: Neas apa ninye entorroni te dukuya Olaitoriani, te risioroto eina pooki nataasa Yehoiakim.

English: For through the anger of the LORD it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had cast them out from his presence, that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
Masaai: Esipa ore tenkaraki engoro o Laitoriani eetuo mbaa aaikunakino neijia Yerusalem o Yuda neaku etanang'ayie ninye ninche aitung'uaa kewan. netogolong'ua Sedekia apong'ore olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: And it came to pass in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and pitched against it, and built forts against it round about.
Masaai: Ore to lari lioudo le nkitoria enye, to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon olapa, nelotu Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon tenebo enjore enye pooki agilunore Yerusalem, nemuat aman ninye neshetu esuntai tiauluo aaitaman enkang.

English: So the city was besieged unto the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
Masaai: Neaku etamuataki apa aaman ina anasa ometabaiki olari le tomon oobo le nkitoria o laiguanani Sedekia.

English: And in the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e naaudo o lapa liong'uan nerasu olameyu tiatua ina anasa, nchere meetae apa endaa too ltung'ana leina kop.

English: Then the city was broken up, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldeans were by the city round about:) and they went by the way of the plain.
Masaai: Neitayuni elusie te suntai eina anasa kewarie, ore iltung'ana pooki lo larrabal neipang aaisik teina anasa kewarie, aaim enkoitoi natii erishata oo sunta are te mbata enkurma o laiguanani. Ore ina kata nemanita ilkaldayo enkanasa. Neim lelo tung'ana le Sedekia enkalo e Araba.

English: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
Masaai: Kake etusujaitie enjore oo Lkaldayo olaiguanani, neinepu ninche Sedekia te nkisiajata e Yeriko; ore enjore enye pooki neidapasha aaing'uaa ninye.

English: Then they took the king, and carried him up unto the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; where he gave judgment upon him.
Masaai: Neibung ninche olaiguanani, neyau ninye enetii olaiguanani le Babilon te Ribla tiatua enkop e Hamat, nedung'oki ilo aiguanani le Babilon ninye enkiguana.

English: And the king of Babylon slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he slew also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.
Masaai: Near olaiguanani le Babilon ilayiok le Sedekia metuata te dukuya ninye neitoki sii aar metuata ilkituaak pooki le Yuda te Ribla.

English: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
Masaai: Nekurtu ninye nkonyek e Sedekia neen ninye too lpisia, neya olaiguanani le Babilon ninye Babilon, nepik ninye korokoroni ometabaiki enkolong enkeeya enye.

English: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan, captain of the guard, which served the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem,
Masaai: Ore to lapa le imiet, te nkolong e tomon o lapa aa olari apa le tomon ooudo le nkitoria o laiguanani Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon ore Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore apa oisiaai olaiguanani le Babilon, nejing Yerusalem.

English: And burned the house of the LORD, and the king's house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, and all the houses of the great men, burned he with fire:
Masaai: Nepejoo ninye enkaji o Laitoriani, o enkaji o laiguanani, o nkajijik pooki e Yerusalem; ore pooki aji kitok nepejoo ninye.

English: And all the army of the Chaldeans, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down all the walls of Jerusalem round about.
Masaai: Ore ina jore pooki oo Lkaldayo apa natii tenebo ilo kitok le rripore negil isunta pooki naamanita Yerusalem.

English: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive certain of the poor of the people, and the residue of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.
Masaai: Neya Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore araya embata oo ltung'ana aisinak o kulikae tung'ana pooki apa ootung'uayioki teina anasa o lelo apa ooisikakitia olaiguanani le Babilon, tenebo lelo aisiaayiak arriyiak.

English: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.
Masaai: Kake etung'uayie apa Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore embata oo ltung'ana aisinak oleng pee eing'or isabibu neturisho.

English: Also the pillars of brass that were in the house of the LORD, and the bases, and the brasen sea that was in the house of the LORD, the Chaldeans brake, and carried all the brass of them to Babylon.
Masaai: Ore apa ing'apeta o suyai naatii atua enkaji o Laitoriani o nkitotoneta e ilo moti le nkare lo suyai apa otii atua enkaji o Laitoriani, nebel Ilkaldayo aaitaa mbelibelat, nenap osuyai pooki aaya Babilon.

English: The caldrons also, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the bowls, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
Masaai: Neya ninche imotioo, o nchempei o ntokitin o ltaa o ngirran, o masaa naapejieki enkorropil o masaa pooki osuyai apa naasishoreki te nkisiaayiare e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And the basons, and the firepans, and the bowls, and the caldrons, and the candlesticks, and the spoons, and the cups; that which was of gold in gold, and that which was of silver in silver, took the captain of the guard away.
Masaai: Ewaki sii ngirran kutiti, o ntokitin nainokieki enkima, o ngirran sapuki o motio, o iketa oo ltaai o ntokitin naapejieki enkorropil o lbakulini ooitukuoreki. Ore apa ina nara sahabu neya ilo kitok le rripore anaa sahabu, ore enapa nara enkosholai, neya anaa enkosholai.

English: The two pillars, one sea, and twelve brasen bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made in the house of the LORD: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
Masaai: Ore apa nena ng'apeta are, o ilo moti obo le nkare o lelo oing'ok tomon oare lo suyai apa otii abori ilo moti le nkare, o nena kitasheta apa naaitobira Solomon olaiguanani tenkaraki enkaji o Laitoriani, ore osuyai le kuna tokitin pooki nemeipimoyu te nkiroishi.

English: And concerning the pillars, the height of one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a fillet of twelve cubits did compass it; and the thickness thereof was four fingers: it was hollow.
Masaai: Ore ing'apeta enkadoro eng'ape nabo naa ntemat tomon o isiet e nkaina ore ne emanaroto enye naa ntemat tomon oare, ore enkirrushai enye naa ntemat oo lkimojik oong'uan naa keudo empolos.
