English: And a chapiter of brass was upon it; and the height of one chapiter was five cubits, with network and pomegranates upon the chapiters round about, all of brass. The second pillar also and the pomegranates were like unto these.
Masaai: Ore enchumata enye netii osuyai, ore enkadori e nchumata nabo naa ntemat imiet e nkaina, neikodo too lgululu oopurupurana, naa ilo suyai pooki netii enchumata enye aaman. Ore enkae ng'ape naaneijia eikununo, eeta ilgululu oopurupurana.

English: And there were ninety and six pomegranates on a side; and all the pomegranates upon the network were an hundred round about.
Masaai: Etii apa ilgululu oopurupurana ntomoni naaudo o ile mbat enye, ore lelo gululu oopurupurana naa iip nabo neikodokino te manarato.

English: And the captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the door:
Masaai: Neya ilo kitok le rripore Seraia ilo apolosani kitok, o Sefania ilo apolosani osujita ninye te nkitoo, o lelo arripok kituaak okuni le kishomi;

English: He took also out of the city an eunuch, which had the charge of the men of war; and seven men of them that were near the king's person, which were found in the city; and the principal scribe of the host, who mustered the people of the land; and threescore men of the people of the land, that were found in the midst of the city.
Masaai: ore te nkanasa neya olkitok apa laa ninye oitasheiki enjore, o ltung'ana oopishana le nkiguana o laiguanani, ooinepuaki tiatua enkanasa, o laigeroni lo lkitok le njore laa ninye apa oiger iltung'ana leina kop, o ltung'ana ntomoni ile loo ltung'ana leina kop ooinepuaki te mpolos eina anasa.

English: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.
Masaai: Neya ninche Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore ayaki olaiguanani le Babilon te Ribla.

English: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.
Masaai: Near olaiguanani le Babilon ninche metuata te Ribla tiatua enkop e Hamat. Neaku eibung'aki Yuda aaraya neitung'uari enkop enye.

English: This is the people whom Nebuchadrezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand Jews and three and twenty:
Masaai: Ena esiana oo ltung'ana oowa Nebukadresa eyararoto: ore to lari liopishana, naa Ilyahudi nkalifuni uni o tikitam oo kuni.

English: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty and two persons:
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oisiet le Nebukadresa neya ninye araya aitung'uaa Yerusalem iltung'ana iip isiet o tomoni uni o are.

English: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzar-adan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam oo kuni le Nebukadresa, neya Nebusaradan ilo kitok le rripore araya Ilyahudi iip naapishana o artam o imiet; era esiana oo ltung'ana pooki nkalifuni ong'uan o iip ile.

English: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the first year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,
Masaai: Naa ore to lari le tomoni uni oopishana le yararoto e Yohoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda, to lapa le tomon o are, te nkolong e tikitam o imiet o lapa, ore teilo ari otaarayie Efi-Merodak olaiguanani le Babilon, neitopok ninye Yehoiakim ilo aiguanani le Yuda, neitayu ninye aitung'uaa korokoroni;

English: And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,
Masaai: neirorie ninye te supatisho, neisho ninye olorika olang ilorikan loo laiguanak apa ootii tenebo ninye te Babilon.

English: And changed his prison garments: and he did continually eat bread before him all the days of his life.
Masaai: Neitayu Yehoiakim nena kilani enyena apa e korokoroni. Ore nkolong'i pooki te nkishui enye nedaa ninye anaake te misa o laiguanani;

English: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.
Masaai: ore tialo nkolati enyena, keisho apa ninye olaiguanani enkishooroto anaake te risioroto eyieunoto enye, ometabaiki enkolong e keeya enye, anaa ake duoo neishu.

English: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people how is she become as a widow she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary
Masaai: Ebaa ena liyio natii enkanasa e Yerusalem, nabore apa iltung'ana! Ina apa naa ninye enkitok alang nkuapi! Ina apa naata enkitoo too loreren, netotiwuo taata anaa enkoliai.

English: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
Masaai: Eishir ninye te mion kewarie, etii ilkiyio ntakul enyena; ore tiatua lelo sanchan lenyena pooki meetae hoo obo oitagol ninye eibelekenyate ilchoreta lenyena pooki etaa ninche ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
Masaai: Eshomo Yuda eyararoto te nkaraki osina. O te nkaraki enkisiaayiare nagol; ebikito taata ninye tiatua iloreren; kake eitu etum ewueji neyeng'iyeng'are. Ore lelo oomirita ninye neineputua ninye tiatua ilo sina lenye.

English: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.
Masaai: Ore nkoitoi naapuo Sion, naa olkiyioi, amu meetae oltung'ani olotu lelo siruai oogeluno, etoliyiote nchomito enyena pooki eig'orita ilapolosak lenyena te mion; neteyietayioki intoyie enyena aaya; ore ninye makewan neeta olosilisili te mion sapuk.

English: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
Masaai: Etaa ilmang'ati lenyena ooitoreisho. Etubula ilmang'ati lenyena enkaraki naishoo ninye Olaitoriani menoto osina, te nkaraki enkumoi oo nkitarruorrot eshomo nkera enyena eyararoto, ereuta ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
Masaai: Ore ina tito e Sion etung'uayie enkitoo pooki. Etotiutuo ilkituaak lenyena, anaa eng'ues natala enedaare. Eilanyisho ninche neeta engolon te dukuya ilo omirta ninye.

English: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.
Masaai: Edamu Yerusalem nkolong'i enyena olosilisili o emion, mbaa pooki naatulusoitie, apa naa nkunenyena ebaiki moitie. Ina kata apa pee ejing iltung'ana lenyena, enkaina olmang'atinta, nemeetae hoo obo oretu ninye. Neikordod olmang'atinta ninye, nesurdaany teina batatata enye.

English: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
Masaai: Etaasa Yerusalem eng'oki torrono ore enkaraki ina etaa ninye olminong; ore apa pooki ooyanyit ninye netemena, amu etoduaa ninye emasipaisho enye; ee eishirita ninye makewan te mion, neibelekeny enkomom enye aing'or idia alo.

English: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.
Masaai: Etii olduruk lenye olkila lenye eitu ninye edamu enkidaata enye ore enkaraki ina aikitok embatatata enye. Meeta ninye oltung'ani oitagol ninye. Olaitoriani, ing'ura osina lai, amu eisula olmang'atinta.

English: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.
Masaai: Etalaa olmang'atinta nkaik enyena, aisalaashaki ntokitin enyena pooki e tipat ee, etoduaa ninye iloreren eibung ewueji enye sinyati, lelo apa litomitioko iyie ejing atua eumata ino.

English: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
Masaai: Eigorito iltung'ana lenyena pooki, eing'oru endaa, newalunye ntokitin enye e tipat endaa, ejo pee eitoki aagolu. “Ng'ura Olaitoriani, naa toduaa, amu aatemenaki nanu.”

English: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
Masaai: “Aime toki te intae pooki, lelo oogiroo? eng'ura nidolidolo, tenaa keetae osina onyaanyukie osina lai oyawuaki shumata nanu, ilo laatipika Olaitoriani teina olong e ngoro enye napi.

English: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.
Masaai: “Eitadowuo ninye enkima te shumata; nereu apik iloik laainei neisalaashaki nkejek aainei orreshet; naaibelekeny ninye nanu, aatung'uayie ninye aidang'ita naiterre endama pooki.

English: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.
Masaai: “Eteenikiaki nkitarruorot aainei pooki enchata oo murto; te nkaina enye eteenaki aakurraki tenebo; nepiki ninche emurt ai, neisho ninye engolon ai meishunye; aaishooyie Olaitoriani apik nkaik e lelo lemaidim aitasheikinore.

English: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.
Masaai: “Eitaa Olaitoriani pesho iltung'ana laainei pooki magil, tiatua empolos ai; eipotuo ninye olturrur maatigilunore nanu. Pee epurdipurdi ilbarnot laainei; eitunyo Olaitoriani anaa enkironyet ina selenkei e Yuda.

English: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
Masaai: “Ore te nkaraki kuna baa naishir nanu; neruko ilkiyio too nkonyek aainei, amu elakua olaaitagol nanu, ilo laaputu manyaaki apiju; eliyio nkera aainei, amu etimirishe olmang'atinta.”

English: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
Masaai: Etaalaa Sion nkaik enyena, aitorioo, kake meetae oloitagol ninye, eitanapishe Olaitoriani tialo Yakobo, nchere ore ilelatia enye pooki naa keaku ilmang'ati lenyena; etaa Yerusalem entoki naiduruk olminong tiatua ninche.

English: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani ninye olasipani; amu atogolong'ua nanu apaash ororei lenye; kake entoning intae iloreren nidolidolo isinaitin laainei; ore ntoyie aainei o lbarnot laainei eshomo eyararoto.

English: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
Masaai: “Aipotuo nanu isanchan laainei, kake aateleja ninche, ore ilapolosak laainei o lpayiani neidaa tiatua enkanasa ina kata eing'oru ninche endaa pee eitang'ejuk engolon enye.

English: Behold, O LORD; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, Olaitoriani, amu atii nanu atua osina. Etii oltau lai atua enyamali, eibelekenye oltau lai tiatua nanu enkaraki nara apa nanu oltung'ani kiserut oleng, ore te nkoitoi nalala enkanasa neitayu olalem nkera okishin, ore tiatua aji netiu anaa keeya.

English: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
Masaai: “Toning'o enkigoroto ai metii hoo obo laaitagol nanu etoning'o ilmang'ati laainei pooki enyamali ai etishipate nchere itaasa iyie ina. Iyau iyie ina olong apa nitolimuo, nincho ninche etiu anaa nanu.

English: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
Masaai: “Nchoo nkiaasin enye pooki torrok epuonu dukuya iyie nintaas ninche anaa enikintaasa nanu te nkaraki nkitarruorot aainei pooki amu kumok nkishirat aainei e mion neiterria oltau lai.”

English: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
Masaai: Kebaa engoro Olaitoriani natipikie ninye ina tito e Sion abori enkatampoi! Etanang'ua ninye te keper anang'ie e nkop, ina sikar e Israel, eitu ninye edamu olorika loo nkejek enyena teina olong e ngoro enye.

English: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
Masaai: Eidaikie Olaitoriani metii olng'ur, emanyisho pooki e Yakobo ore te ngoro enye netigila ninye isempewueti pooki leina tito e Yuda. Etuuroko ninye ninche enkop asul enkitoria o laitoriak lenye.

English: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.
Masaai: Etusulaka enkop te ngoro napi emagilanisho pooki e Israel; eiwuang'ie te ninche enkaina enye e tatene, te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye. Eyupuyupo ninye anaa olang'at le nkima tiatua Yakobo, ainos pooki wueji.

English: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
Masaai: Eteyietuo ninye enkawuo enye anaa olmang'atinta, ore te nkaina enye e tatene nesesekuanisho anaa olmang'atinta, netasesekuana ninye ntokitin pooki niking'idare, tiatua ilo ng'obor le ntito e Sion; etubukuo ninye engoro enye napi anaa enkima.

English: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
Masaai: Etotiwuo Olaitoriani anaa olmang'atinta, eidaikie ninye Israel, eidaikie ninye wuejitin enyena pooki enkitoo neitomijoon isempewueti lenyena netopona ninye tiatua ina tito e Yuda osina o enkishirata.

English: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
Masaai: Etigila ninye olpaashe lenye anaa olpaashe le nkurma, neitomijoon ewueji oo siruai oogeluno; eishie Olaitoriani tiatua Sion isiruai oogeluno o sabato ore te ngoro enye napi netemenayie ilaiguanak o lapolosak.

English: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
Masaai: Eiturrayie Olaitoriani olperere lo lasar lenye, etanya ewueji enye sinyati; etipika ninye nkaik oo lmang'ati isunta oo wuejitin enkitoo; nejing embuakunoto atua enkaji Olaitoriani, anaa te nkolong o sirua otegeluaki.

English: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
Masaai: Etootikio Olaitoriani aitomijoon isunta e ina tito e Sion; etudung'uo olpolosie lenye apik olkereri eitu ninye eibooyo enkaina enye pee meidaikie; eyawua ninye oloputukunyi o enkishirata nena sunta, neishunye engolon enye nabo kata.

English: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
Masaai: Eimiso nchomito enyena te nkop eidaikie ninye negil isekenke enyena; eshomo olaiguanani lenye o lkituaak lenyena atua iloreren; meekure etii enkitanapata, ore iloibonok lenyena eitu eitoki aatum enduaata naing'uaa Olaitoriani.

English: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
Masaai: Ore ilpayiani leina tito e Sion, netoni te nkop aagira; etipika ninche enterit ilukuny enye neishop ilkuniyiani; ore nena toyie e Yerusalem neirrug ilukuny enye aaitabaiki enkop.

English: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
Masaai: Etanaurate nkonyek aainei te nkishirata eeta oltau lai emion o sina, eiputa oltau lai emion te nkaraki enkidaata e ntito oo ltung'ana laainei enkaraki naiterre nkera o looyoni, tiatua nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa.

English: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
Masaai: Eishiraki ninche noo ng'otonye ejo, “Koree endaa enaisho oo sabibu?” eiterriaa anaa iltung'ana oata ilbaa, too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, eishunye enkishui enye too lgooitie loo noo ng'otonye.

English: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?
Masaai: Kaa nanu ajo tialo iyie, kainyoo aaitanyaanyukie iyie, na tito e Yerusalem? Kainyoo nanu aaitanyaanyukie te iyie pee aatum aitagolo, na tito e Sion? Amu elala anaa enaiposha enkidaata ino; kaing'ae likinchiunye iyie?

English: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
Masaai: Etoduaakita intae iloibonok linyi elejare o nduaat naapong'ori; eitu ninche eitodolu entorroni inyi pee errinyu intae te araroto, kake etodua te nkaraki intae olkilikuai le lejare opong'ori.

English: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
Masaai: Ore pooki ooim enkoitoi neosh nkaik te nkaraki intae; neing'asia neipirripir ilukuny enye te nkaraki entito e Yerusalem; nejo, “Kena anasa apa eji enaiting'ie esidano, eng'ida e nkop pooki?”

English: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
Masaai: Ore ilmang'ati linono neng'a nkutukie te nkaraki iyie neing'asia neony ilala, neishir aajo, kindaikie iyiook ninye! Ee, ena olong apa kitaanyutua iyiook; kinotito taata, kidolita taata!

English: The LORD hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
Masaai: Etaasa Olaitoriani ina apa nayieu, eitabayie ena yieunoto enye; anaa apake enategelua te moitie, etigila metii olng'ur, eishoo ninye ilmang'ati meting'idata te nkaraki iyie, neitulusoo emagilanisho oo lmang'ati linyi.

English: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
Masaai: Tabuaku nchiraki Olaitoriani! Na tito e Sion! Nchoo ilkiyio linono eruko anaa olkeju dama o kewarie, miyeng'iyeng'a, miyeng'iyeng'ie nkonyek inono!

English: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
Masaai: Tuputunye nchira kewarie, te nkiterunoto e pooki kata e rripore! mbukoi oltau lino anaa enkare te dukuya Olaitoriani! Ilepie nkaik inono te dukuya ninye, te nkaraki enkishui oo nkera inono, naaiterre to lameyu te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi nalala e nkanasa.

English: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
Masaai: Ing'ura Olaitoriani nidol! Kaing'ae iyie intaasa ina? Keaku keinos nkituaak nkera enye naatoiutuo nena kera enye naamana naatii nkaik enye? Keaku keyieng'i olapolosani o loiboni tiatua ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani?

English: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.
Masaai: Eirragaa too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa ilooti o lbotoro; ore ntoyie aainei o lbarnot laainei netabatate to lalem; ore teina olong e ngoro ino nitasesekuana iyie ninche, nisesekuan metii olng'ur.

English: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD'S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
Masaai: Impotuo iyie ninche anaa iloopuonu osirua otegeluaki, neimu olkirutoto lai pooki shoto; naa ore teina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani meetae oloimishe arashu oloshomo eishu. Ore lelo apa latanapa naitubulu eidaikie olmang'atinta lai.

English: I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
Masaai: Ara nanu oltung'ani otoduaa osina tiabori eng'udi e ngoro enye napi;

English: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.
Masaai: aaterewa ninye naayau nanu enaimin metii hoo ewang'an;

English: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
Masaai: esipa nanu egilunore enkaina enye nkatitin pooki endama pooki.

English: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
Masaai: Aaitasasa nanu nemugut olchoni lo sesen lai negil iloik laainei;

English: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
Masaai: aatamuata ninye nanu naaimulumul te mion o sina.

English: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
Masaai: Aaishoo ninye nanu matobiko tiatua enaimin anaa olotua apa moitie.

English: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
Masaai: Aaitamana nanu esuntai pee maisik; naapik nanu olpisiai oiroishi.

English: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
Masaai: Ore hoo naipotishe naishiru eretoto neikeno ninye enkomon ai.

English: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
Masaai: Etunuka ninye inkoitoi aainei too soito, nelojiloj ninye inkoitoi aainei aboiboin.

English: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.
Masaai: Etiu ninye te nanu anaa olng'arurumi orreshisho, etiu anaa olng'atuny oisudori airrag.

English: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
Masaai: Aaitapaasha ninye enkoitoi ai naaitaa nanu mpurdat aaitoliyio ninye nanu;

English: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
Masaai: eteyietuo ninye enkawuo enye naiul nanu aarie osuyiet too mbaa enyena.

English: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
Masaai: Eishaka ninye atua oltau lai mbaa e mootian enye.

English: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
Masaai: Ataa nanu entoki nakueniyieki too ltung'ana pooki, ataa osinkolio lenye endama pooki.

English: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
Masaai: Aaiputa ninye nanu emion naairuji nanu olkurto.

English: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
Masaai: Etarrarra ninye ilala laainei to sinyai naaimulumul nanu too nkuruon.

English: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
Masaai: Eitalamayioki oltau lai aarishie eseriani, aatorikinote nanu mbaa e nchipai.

English: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
Masaai: Neaku ajo nanu, “Eshomo enkitoo ai neshomo enkisiligunoto ai naing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

English: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
Masaai: Tadamu osina lai o emion ai o lkurto o lodua.

English: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
Masaai: Edamu oltau lai kuna anaake neirrugo oltau lai tiatua nanu.

English: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
Masaai: Kake tenadamu nanu kuna, natum osiligi.

English: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
Masaai: Meish ae kata enyorrata o Laitoriani nauno, meish ae kata olng'ur lenye.

English: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Masaai: Ng'ejuko ninche anaake tadekenya, aikitok esupatisho enye.

English: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani ninye erubata ai” neijia ejo oltau lai, “Ore enkaraki ina kaisilig nanu ninye.”

English: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
Masaai: Aisupat Olaitoriani te lelo oanyu ninye, te lelo ooing'oru ninye.

English: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
Masaai: Eisidai teneitirring'a oltung'ani aanyu enjeunoto o Laitoriani.

English: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
Masaai: Eisidai tenenap oltung'ani enchata e murt nanapishoreki te kitisho enye.

English: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye egira aitirring'a openy teneiteleikini ninye;

English: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
Masaai: nchoo ninye eitabaiki enkutuk enye enterit, amu ebaiki netii osiligi.

English: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
Masaai: Nchoo ninye meishoo eseder enye ilo ooshisho; neiputi ninye imorot.

English: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
Masaai: Amu meiturraa Olaitoriani ninye ntarasi.

English: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
Masaai: Kake ore hoo neyau osina, ketum ninye olng'ur, te risioroto e sapuko e nyorrata enye nauno;

English: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
Masaai: amu meotiki ninye aitameisho arashu epik osina nkera e tung'ana.

English: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
Masaai: Apurdaki enkop too nkejek, lelo pooki ooena te nkop.

English: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
Masaai: Pee eibelekeny esipata oltung'ani te dukuya ilo otii shumata aisul,

English: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
Masaai: neibelekeny esipata too nkiguanat, menyorraa Olaitoriani nena.

English: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?
Masaai: Kaing'ae oiro embae nebaya aaku,

English: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
Masaai: teneme Olaitoriani otonyorrayie?

English: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
Masaai: Kainyoo pee eilepilep iltung'ana ooishu, kainyoo pee eilepilep oltung'ani te nkitamioto oo ng'ok enyena?

English: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
Masaai: Maineneng'a nikijurru nkoitoi ang, nikirrinyokino Olaitoriani!

English: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.
Masaai: Mailepie iltauja lang o nkaik ang, aailepakinye Enkai natii keper:

English: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
Masaai: “Kitapong'ori iyiook nikitogolong'utua, neitu iyie ipalaki iyiook.

English: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
Masaai: Kimputa iyie engoro oleng nimir iyiook nisesekuan metii olng'ur;

English: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.
Masaai: imulumula iyie kewan te nkatampoi neaku meetae enkomono, naimu abau enitii.

English: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
Masaai: Ntaa iyie iyiook isuut o ntokitin e pesho, tiatua iltung'ana.

English: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
Masaai: “Ore ilmang'ati lang pooki neng'a nkutukie te nkaraki iyiook.

English: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
Masaai: Eewuo olkirutoto o esulakinoto e ngumoto shumata iyiook, eliyio o enkidaata.

English: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Masaai: Eruko ilkejek loo lkiyio too nkonyek aainei, te nkaraki enkidaata e ntito oo ltung'ana laainei.

English: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
Masaai: “Keruko ilkiyio too nkonyek aainei nemeish, nemegem ae kata,

English: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
Masaai: ometaba anaa neing'or Olaitoriani te keper nedol asipu;

English: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
Masaai: aatipika nanu nkonyek aainei osina te nkaraki nena silan e nkanasa ai.

English: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
Masaai: “Aatarreshoki nanu anaa emotonyi, lelo mang'ati laainei metii emporeet.

English: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
Masaai: Aasulaki ninche engumoto naanang too soito;

English: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.
Masaai: naaimisie enkare endukuya ai; najo, ‘Aimina nanu.’

English: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
Masaai: “Aipoto nanu enkarna ino iyie Olaitoriani atii enguton e ngumoto.

English: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
Masaai: Ining iyie esayiata ai, ‘Minken iyie enkiok ino, te nkishirata ai te nkaraki eretoto!’

English: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
Masaai: Itinyikua iyie ina kata peyie aaipot nanu iyie, itejo iyie, ‘Miureishoyu!’

English: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
Masaai: “Kitomituo iyie nanu Olaitoriani, itokordua iyie enkishui ai.

English: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
Masaai: Itoduaa iyie entorrono naaitaasaki nanu, Olaitoriani, tudung'okoki iyie nanu enkiguana.

English: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
Masaai: Itoduaa iyie elap enye pooki nena kitobirat enye pooki te nkaraki nanu.

English: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;
Masaai: “Itoning'o iyie imorot enye, Olaitoriani nena kitobirat enye pooki te nkaraki nanu.

English: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
Masaai: Ore nkirorot o ndamunot oo lmang'ati laainei, naa nanu egilunore endama pooki.

English: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.
Masaai: Ng'ura ore etoni o eitashe, naa nanu ake eimaki eranyisho.

English: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
Masaai: “Ntalaku iyie te ninche Olaitoriani, te risioroto e siaai oo nkaik enye.

English: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
Masaai: Ipik iyie iltauja lenye emodai; nelotu oldeket lino shumata ninche.

English: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
Masaai: Nisujaa iyie ninche te ngoro nindaikie ninche; aiwuang'ie tiabori keper ino, Olaitoriani.”

English: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
Masaai: Kainyoo pee meekure ewang sahabu. Kainyoo pee eibelekenye sahabu nasila! Ore lelo soito oosinya neirragaa aaidapasha te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi nalala e nkanasa.

English: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Sion le tipat anaa sahabu sidan nesila, kainyoo pee etotiutuo anaa motioo oo nkulupuok, esiaai oo nkaik o laitobirani!

English: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore ninye mbariak keisho ilki neitanak nkera kake ore entito oo ltung'ana laainei netagogong'o, etotiuo anaa isidan tiong'ota.

English: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.
Masaai: Ore olng'ejep le nkerai nanakita, neibung enoret te nkure; neomonu nkera endaa, kake meetae oloisho ninche.

English: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
Masaai: Ore lelo oodaa te sikar, neidak too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa; ore lelo apa ootamoo eishop nkilani pilei neirrag too lchalai loo nkuruon.

English: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
Masaai: Ore enkitamioto entito oo ltung'ana laainei naa eikitok, alang enkitamioto e sodom, apa natusulayioki nabo kata, nemeetae enkaina naiteleikiaki ninye.

English: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
Masaai: Ore apa ilkituaak lenyena newang aalang enturoto, neibor aalang kule; ore iseseni lenye nenyokioo aalang intoto sidain, ore enkishiaa enye newang anaa oltotoi oji safire.

English: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
Masaai: Netorokita taata nkomomi enye aalang nkuk, meekure eyiolounoyu too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa; neibibiari iseseni lenye aarep iloik te saso netoito anaa nkeek.

English: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
Masaai: Enaikash apa lelo ootaraki to lalem, alang lelo ooya olameyu lelo oo temenate, ootomitiokoki ilng'anayio le nkop.

English: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
Masaai: Ore nkaik e nena kituaak naata olng'ur neitokitokie nkera enye maate; neitaa ninche endaa enye, teina kidaata e ntito oo ltung'ana laainei.

English: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
Masaai: Eitabayie Olaitoriani engoro enye etubukuo ninye engoro enye nairowua; neiyupuyup anaa enkima te Sion, nemut ilkitamanyunot lenyena.

English: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eitu apa enyorraa ilaiguanak le nkop anaa hoo obo le lelo oomanya enkop, nchere keidim olmang'atinta atijing'u nchomito e Yerusalem.

English: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
Masaai: Ore ena naa te nkaraki ing'ok oo loibonok le Nkai o ntorrok oo lapolosak lenyena lelo ooibukoo te mpolos enye osarge le lelo lemeeta entioto.

English: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
Masaai: Nelimana ninche too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa medolisho, eeta olduruk lo sarge. nemeetae ninye oltung'ani oiseyie ilkilani lenye.

English: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.
Masaai: Nejoki iltung'ana ninche, “Entalamari ilooiduruk Entalamari, Entalamari! Emiseyie!” Neaku etaa ninche ilaisikak oloolimana; nejo iltung'ana too nkuapi, “Meigil ae kata aatoni tenebo iyiook.”

English: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
Masaai: Olaitoriani makewan oidapasha ninche meigil ae kata ninye ashilaa ninche nemeigili aayanyitu ilapolosak nemeikiroteti ilpayiani.

English: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.
Masaai: Eiliilaitie nkonyek ang eisiligu eretoto nemetii, ore te rripore ang, nikiaanyu olorere lemeidim aaitajeusho.

English: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
Masaai: Nerreshu iltung'ana iroruat ang, ometaa meekure kipuo aaim nkoitoi ang naalala, nenyiku enkiting'oto ang, neaku kuti nkolong'i ang, amu etabawua enkiting'oto ang.

English: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
Masaai: Keneneng lelo oomirita iyiook aalang ilmotonyi oopuo tiaai nemir ninche iyiook too ldoinyo neirrag ninche aarresh iyiook tiong'ota.

English: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
Masaai: Ore enkiyang'et oo nkumeishin ang, ilo otubukoko Olaitoriani eilata aput, neyae too nkumeishin enye ilo apa likitejo iyiook, “Tiabori oloip lenye kipuo aatoni tiatua iloreren.”

English: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
Masaai: Ting'idayu nishipa na tito e Edom, ina namanya enkop e Usi, ore sii iyie eikiimarieki enkikompe; ilo iyie amera ninturraa ilkilani niaaku enemeishopo.

English: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
Masaai: Ore enkitamioto e ng'oki ino, na tito e Sion neitabayioki, meekure ninye kingil aibok te eyararoto ae kata, kake ore eng'oki ino naa tito e Edom, ninye eitamei, kebolu ninye ing'ok inono.

English: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
Masaai: Tadamu Olaitoriani ena bae natadoikio iyiook; ing'ura nidol enkurruna ang.

English: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
Masaai: Ore enjung'ore ang neibelekenyakaki iltung'ana leeiking'a, ore nkang'itie ang neaku inoo ltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
Masaai: Kitaa iyiook okishin, lemeeta loomenye etiu noo yieyio anaa nkolia.

English: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
Masaai: Meeta nchere mikilak enkare nikiok ore ilkeek likitum aainok keinyiang'uni.

English: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
Masaai: Eturrumoyioki iyiook kiaata enchata oo murto nanapishoreki too murto. Kinaurate iyiook neitu eishori iyiook enkiyeng'iyeng.

English: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
Masaai: Kisiaayia iyiook Misiri o Asiria, pee kitum endaa naraposh iyiook.

English: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.
Masaai: Etaasa apa loopapa eng'oki, nemeekure eetae; kinapita iyiook entorroni enye.

English: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.
Masaai: Eitoreita iyiook irrindiki; nemeetae olokordu iyiook aitayu too nkaik enye.

English: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
Masaai: Kipik iyiook enkishui ang batisho pee kitum endaa, te nkaraki ilo alem tiong'ota.

English: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
Masaai: Eirowuaja iseseni lang anaa olkokuet, te nkaraki enkolong napejisho o lameyu.

English: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
Masaai: Ebatata nkituaak te Sion, o selenken too nkang'itie e Yuda.

English: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
Masaai: Neiki ilkituaak aaisiong too nkaik enye; nemeyanyiti ilpayiani kituaak.

English: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
Masaai: Nearakini ilbarnot meidong'isho te wueji neidong'ishoreki neitaari inkayiok ilolan loo lkeek.

English: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
Masaai: Eisha ntonat oo lpayiani too leng'ot neisha eranyata o sinkolio too lbarnot.

English: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
Masaai: Eisha eng'ida oo ltauja lang, neibelekenye eranyata ang osinkolio aaku enkishirata.

English: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
Masaai: Eiwuang'ieki enkopiyia e nkitoo te ndukuya ang; oi iyiook, amu kitaasa iyiook eng'oki!

English: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee etamuoita iltauja lang, enkaraki ena pee eiliilaitie nkonyek ang,

English: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
Masaai: amu ore ilo doinyo le Sion otoliyie netamanya mbariak.

English: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, Olaitoriani, ntoreisho ntarasi; ebikoo olorika lino le nkitoo too ishoritin pooki.

English: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee midamu iyiook ntarasi, kainyoo iyie pee inturraa iyiook te nkata naado?

English: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
Masaai: Torrinyoki iyiook kewan ino Olaitoriani, pee kitum aatorrinyunye! Ntang'ejuko nkolong'i ang metotiwuo anaa apa!

English: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
Masaai: Anaa itanya iyiook tukul. Itagorokine doi iyiook tukul?

English: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomoni uni, to lapa liong'uan, te nkolong e miet, o lapa, ina kata atii tenebo yarunot te mbata olkeju le Keba, nebolo keper nadol induaat e Nkai.

English: In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e imiet olapa (naa olari le imiet le yararoto olaiguanani Yehoiakin),

English: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
Masaai: nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Esekiel ilo apolosani, olayioni le Busi teina kop oo Ilkaldayo te mbata olkeju le Keba; netii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata enye teine.

English: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.
Masaai: Ore aing'orisho, ng'ura, nadol osiwuo le nchan olotu aing'uaa enkalo e moikuape, o enkatampoi sapuk, o enkimerlel namanita ninye, olng'ejepa le nkima ooidikidiko, ore te mpolos enkima, netiu anaa entoki enkimerlel o suyai.

English: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures. And this was their appearance; they had the likeness of a man.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos enye nepuku enkitanyaanyukoto oo ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu. Naa nji apa eikununo eliooto enye: eeta apa pooki enyaanyukie e tung'ana,

English: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
Masaai: nemeeta ake nabo nemeeta nkomomi ong'uan, neeta ake nabo te ninche inaipuko ong'uan.

English: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
Masaai: Ore inkejek enye naa keitoriori, ore ndapi oo nkejek enye netiu anaa loisotok le nkeju olashe neitintil ninche anaa osuyiai otisikaki oleng.

English: And they had the hands of a man under their wings on their four sides; and they four had their faces and their wings.
Masaai: Ore tiabori oo naipuko enye too matuan enye pokira ong'uan neeta nkaik oo ltung'ana. Neeta pokira nena ong'uan inkomomi enye o naipuko enye eikununo nji:

English: Their wings were joined one to another; they turned not when they went; they went every one straight forward.
Masaai: Eibung'a nena aipuko, nepuo pooki dukuya, meibelekenya epuo.

English: As for the likeness of their faces, they four had the face of a man, and the face of a lion, on the right side: and they four had the face of an ox on the left side; they four also had the face of an eagle.
Masaai: Ore enyaanyukie oo nkomomi enye, eeta ake nabo te ninche enkomom o ltung'ani te dukuya; ore pokira ong'uan neeta enkomom olng'atuny te matua e tatene, ore pokira ong'uan neeta enkomom olkitengte nkalo e kedienye, neeta pokira ong'uan enkomom olkurragos tesiadi.

English: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
Masaai: Neijia apa etiu nkomomi enye. Ore inaipuko enye nelak aaitorioo meeta ake eng'ues nemeeta inaipuko are, nemeeta ake enemeibung'ita enaipukoi enkae, nenunua are too seseni lenye.

English: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
Masaai: Nelo ake pooki aitoriori dukuya, ore pooki wueji nelo enkiyang'et, nepuo sii ninche, nemeibelekenya epuo.

English: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos e nena ng'uesi naaishu netii apa entoki natiu anaa nkuk naaishu enkima, netiu anaa iltaai oopuoopuo tiatua nena ng'uesi naaishu; naa kewang apa enkima oleng, nepuku tiatua ina kima enkiwuang'ata.

English: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.
Masaai: Ore nena ng'uesi naaishu neipirri dukuya netiu, anaa enkiwuang'ata.

English: Now as I beheld the living creatures, behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures, with his four faces.
Masaai: Ore peyie aing'or nena ng'uesi naaishu, nadol enkeju e ng'arri te nkoriong enkop te mbata e nena ng'uesi naaishu, meeta ake eng'ues nemeitoriokino enkeju nabo te pokira ong'uan.

English: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl: and they four had one likeness: and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatiu empukunoto e nena kejek o enkitobirata enye: etiu empukunoto enye anaa enkitiil osoit barrikoi oji Krisolit; neeta pokira oong'uan empukunoto nabo; ore enkitobirata enye netiu apa anaa enkeju eng'arri natii atua enkae keju eng'arri.

English: When they went, they went upon their four sides: and they turned not when they went.
Masaai: Ore ina kata napuo, neim ake enkalo pooki te nena aloli enye pokira ong'uan eitu eibelekenya epuo.

English: As for their rings, they were so high that they were dreadful; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four.
Masaai: Ore nena kejek eng'arri pokira ong'uan neeta inkimanaa neeta enchata iltidii ooibung enkeju eng'arri inkejek, nebore enkamanaa oo nkejek eng'arri nkonyek naamanita too nkaloli pooki.

English: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went by them: and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
Masaai: Ore pee epuo nena ng'uesi naaishu, neiriamariyie nkejek ninche aashep; ore pee edumunye ng'uesi naaishu te nkop, nedumunye sii nena kejek.

English: Whithersoever the spirit was to go, they went, thither was their spirit to go; and the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji nelo enkiyang'et nepuo sii ninche, nedumunye nena kejek tenebo ninche eshepita, amu etii enkiyang'et e nena ng'uesi naaishu nena kejek.

English: When those went, these went; and when those stood, these stood; and when those were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up over against them: for the spirit of the living creature was in the wheels.
Masaai: Ore pee epuo nena nepuo sii kuna; ore pee eitashe nekua, neitashe sii kuna; ore pee edumunye nekua aing'uaa enkop, nedumunye nena kejek te nebo ninche; amu etii apa enkiyang'et e nena ng'uesi naaishu atua nena kejek oo ng'arrin.

English: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
Masaai: Ore te shumata e nena lukuny e nena ng'uesi naaishu netii entoki nanyaanyukie oloing'ang'e le keper, newang oleng anaa soito oibor oleng, neisalaashakino shumata ilukuny enye.

English: And under the firmament were their wings straight, the one toward the other: every one had two, which covered on this side, and every one had two, which covered on that side, their bodies.
Masaai: Ore tiabori oloing'ang'e neitoriori inaipuko enye aitoriokino dukuya, neipirare enkae enkae; nemeeta ake eng'ues nemeeta inaipuko are naitoipito osesen.

English: And when they went, I heard the noise of their wings, like the noise of great waters, as the voice of the Almighty, the voice of speech, as the noise of an host: when they stood, they let down their wings.
Masaai: Ore epuoito naning oltoilo loo naipuko enye, netiu anaa oltoilo loo nkariak kumok, netiu anaa endarata Olmagilani, oltoilo lo larrabal anaa oltoilo lo lorora; ore ake peyie eitashe inaipuko enye;

English: And there was a voice from the firmament that was over their heads, when they stood, and had let down their wings.
Masaai: nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa oloing'ang'e le keper, oimua shumata lukuny enye; ore pee eitashe aaitirring'a neshuk inaipuko enye.

English: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.
Masaai: Ore te shumata oloing'ang'e te nchumata oo lukuny enye netii enkitanyaanyukoto olorika le nkitoo, nenyaanyukie osoit pus oji Safi; ore entopij enye netonie enkitanyaanyukoto olorika le nkitoo netii enkitanyaanyukoto naa ijo oltung'ani.

English: And I saw as the colour of amber, as the appearance of fire round about within it, from the appearance of his loins even upward, and from the appearance of his loins even downward, I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and it had brightness round about.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki empolos enye neilep, nadol enkimerlel naikununo anaa osuyai otisikaki, netiu anaa enkima naikenoro te pooki alole; ore ebaiki empolos enye nedoyio nadol etiu anaa enkitanyaanyukoto enkima netii ewang'an namanita ninye.

English: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.
Masaai: Etiu anaa eliooto olokirrai too nkatampo teina olong enchan neijia apa etiu eliooto e wang'an sapuk namanita ninye. Neijia apa etiu elioto enkitanyaanyukoto enkitoo o Laitoriani. Ore peyie adol ninye, nabatata te nkomom ai naning oltoilo le ilo oirorita.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, stand upon thy feet, and I will speak unto thee.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, inyo ntasho too nkejek inono, amu kaairorie nanu iyie.”

English: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, and set me upon my feet, that I heard him that spake unto me.
Masaai: Ore peyie aairorie nanu, naajing Enkiyang'et Sinyati atua nanu naaitasheyie maitasho; naning ninye aairorie nanu.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, I send thee to the children of Israel, to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me: they and their fathers have transgressed against me, even unto this very day.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ekaairriwaa iyie airriwaki iltung'ana loo Siraeli, ilo orere ogolong'u; laatogolong'akita nanu; ore ninche o loo menye netaasa eng'oki te nanu o ena olong.

English: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore sii kulo tung'ana nemeeta enkanyit negolong'u sii: Ekaairriwaa iyie shomo enetii ninche; nijoki ninche, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.’

English: And they, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear, (for they are a rebellious house,) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them.
Masaai: Naa tenaa keinining'u arashu eany ening (amu enkaji kiserut ninche) ekeyiolou aajo etii oshi oloiboni atua ninche.

English: And thou, son of man, be not afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns be with thee, and thou dost dwell among scorpions: be not afraid of their words, nor be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
Masaai: “Ore iyie, enkerai e tung'ani, miureyu ninche, nimiureyu irorei lenye, hoo netii ilaimerrerruak o lkiku tenebo iyie nitonie nkulupani, miureyu irorei lenye, arashu kinture enking'odia enye, amu enkaji kiserut ninche.

English: And thou shalt speak my words unto them, whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear: for they are most rebellious.
Masaai: Naa ilo iyie airo irorei laainei airorie ninche, o tenaa keinining'u arashu eany einining amu enkaji ninche nataa kiserut.

English: But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house: open thy mouth, and eat that I give thee.
Masaai: “Kake ore iyie, enkerai e tung'ani, ininingu enaajoki iyie; miaku iyie kiserut anaa ina aji kiserut tabolo enkutuk ino inosa ina naaisho iyie.”

English: And when I looked, behold, an hand was sent unto me; and, lo, a roll of a book was therein;
Masaai: Ore peyie aing'or, ng'ura, aaitoriokoki nanu enkaina, naa ng'ura, etii olpiyayati le mbuku oigero ina aina;

English: And he spread it before me; and it was written within and without: and there was written therein lamentations, and mourning, and woe.
Masaai: neisalaash ninye te dukuya nanu; nesira inkaloli pokira e ilo piyayati le mbuku, nesira teine irorei le nkishirata o emion o nkigorot.

English: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, eat that thou findest; eat this roll, and go speak unto the house of Israel.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, inosa ina nikinchooki iyie; inosa ele piyayati le mbuku, nilo airorie enkaji e Israel.”

English: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
Masaai: Metaa atabolo nanu enkutuk ai, naaisho ninye nanu olpiyayati le mbuku mainosa.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, inosa ele piyayati le mbuku laaisho iyie nimput enkoshoke ino ninye.” Metaa ainosa ninye; naa ore etii enkutuk nemelok anaa olkenkei le naisho.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, shomo, tabaiki enkaji e Israel, niro too rorei laainei airorie ninche.

English: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
Masaai: Amu eitu kirriwari iyie aairriwaki iltung'ana le likae ng'ejep o enkutuk nagol enkiroroto, kake enkaji e Israel

English: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
Masaai: neme iloreren kumok loo lng'ejepa oopaashaa o enkutuk nagol, ilaa mining'u irorei lenye. Esipa tenaairriwaki iyie kulo, naa aikindim aatoning'u iyie.

English: But the house of Israel will not hearken unto thee; for they will not hearken unto me: for all the house of Israel are impudent and hardhearted.
Masaai: Kake ore enkaji e Israel nimikinining iyie; amu meyieu ninche naaning nanu amu ore enkaji pooki e Israel naa inoo logol lukuny negolong'u iltauja.

English: Behold, I have made thy face strong against their faces, and thy forehead strong against their foreheads.
Masaai: Ing'ura ajo aitaa elukunya ino enagol anaa ilukuny enye, naitagol elukunya ino anaa ilukuny enye.

English: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.
Masaai: Anaa enagol osoit oji almasi alang isoito aitaa elukunya ino neijia; miureyu ninche tukul, nimimputukuny too nking'urat enye, amu enkaji kiserut ninche.”

English: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart, and hear with thine ears.
Masaai: Aanyaaka ake sii ajoki nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore irorei laainei pooki lelo laaliki iyie tang'amai toltau lino nining'u too nkiyiaa inono.

English: And go, get thee to them of the captivity, unto the children of thy people, and speak unto them, and tell them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; whether they will hear, or whether they will forbear.
Masaai: Nilo enetii iltung'ana linono ootii eararoto nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; toliki ninche ening o meyieu nening.”

English: Then the spirit took me up, and I heard behind me a voice of a great rushing, saying, Blessed be the glory of the LORD from his place.
Masaai: Ina peyie aadumu enkiyang'et nanu ailepie, ore edumunye enkitoo o Laitoriani te wueji enye, naning te siadi nanu oltoilo sapuk le nkirikirata enkop.

English: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
Masaai: Naa oltoilo loo naipuko e nena ng'uesi naaishu eibung'a maate, naning sii nena kejek oo ngarrin naashepita te mbata enye, nening'oyu anaa olokirikiri sapuk le nkop.

English: So the spirit lifted me up, and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; but the hand of the LORD was strong upon me.
Masaai: Naadumu ina Kiyang'et nanu ailepie naaya, nalo te mion enkirowuaj oltau lai, eiroishi ina aina te shumata nanu;

English: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel-abib, that dwelt by the river of Chebar, and I sat where they sat, and remained there astonished among them seven days.
Masaai: nalotu enetii lelo yarunot te Telabib, lelo ootii enkiyopata olkeju le Keba. Naton teine atunume tenebo ninche nkolong'i naapishana.

English: And it came to pass at the end of seven days, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i naapishana, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nejo:

English: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, aaitaa iyie olarriponi te nkaji e Israel; ore ake pooki kata nining ororei eing'uaa enkutuk ai, nincho ninche enkikoo naing'uaa enatii.

English: When I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; and thou givest him not warning, nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way, to save his life; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Masaai: Tenajoki ilo torrono, ‘Meeta nchere aimiye,’ neitu inkok ninye aliki, neitu iro aikok ilo torrono metung'uai enkoitoi enye torrono, peyie etum aitajeu enkishui enye, keye oltung'ani torrono too ntorrok enyena; kake ore osarge lenye naa kaing'oru te nkaina ino.

English: Yet if thou warn the wicked, and he turn not from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
Masaai: Kake tininkok ilo torrono, nemeibelekenya ninye aing'uaa ntorrok enyena, arashu too nkoitoi enyena, naa keye ninye too ng'ok enyena; kake intajewuo iyie enkishui ino.

English: Again, When a righteous man doth turn from his righteousness, and commit iniquity, and I lay a stumblingblock before him, he shall die: because thou hast not given him warning, he shall die in his sin, and his righteousness which he hath done shall not be remembered; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii, teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa esupatisho enye neas intorrok, napik entoki narror dukuya enye, naa keye ninye; amu eitu inkok iyie ninye, keye ninye too ng'ok enyena, ore isiaaitin enyena sidain nena naataasa nemeitokini aadamu; kake ore osarge lenye nayieu too nkaik inono.

English: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man, that the righteous sin not, and he doth not sin, he shall surely live, because he is warned; also thou hast delivered thy soul.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, tininkok ilo tung'ani supat peyie meas eng'oki, neitu eas eng'oki, nemeeta nchere meton eishu, amu etang'amayie ninye enkikoo; nintajeu iyie enkishui ino.”

English: And the hand of the LORD was there upon me; and he said unto me, Arise, go forth into the plain, and I will there talk with thee.
Masaai: Netii apa enkaina Olaitoriani shumata nanu; naajoki nanu, “Tudumunye shomo enkisiajata peyie aatum airorie teine.”

English: Then I arose, and went forth into the plain: and, behold, the glory of the LORD stood there, as the glory which I saw by the river of Chebar: and I fell on my face.
Masaai: Metaa atudumunye nalo enkisiajata; naa ng'ura, neitashe enkitoo o Laitoriani teine, neikununo anaa enkitoo apa natoduaa te nkiyopata olkeju le Keba; nabatata te nkomom ai.

English: Then the spirit entered into me, and set me upon my feet, and spake with me, and said unto me, Go, shut thyself within thine house.
Masaai: Kake aatijing'a Enkiyang'et nanu, naadumu aitasheyie too nkejek; naairorie nanu naajoki, “Shomo inkenoi kewan tiatua enkaji ino.

English: But thou, O son of man, behold, they shall put bands upon thee, and shall bind thee with them, and thou shalt not go out among them:
Masaai: Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, ing'ura eikipiki iyie inkeenta, naa aikienieki iyie metaa mintoki alo tenebo iltung'ana;

English: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.
Masaai: naa kaiterep olng'ejep lino enoret ino, metaa iaku olemeidim airoro aikoo ninche; amu enkaji kiserut ninche.

English: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
Masaai: Kake tenaairorie iyie, naabol iyie enkutuk, naa aijoki iyie ninche, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;’ ore ilo oning, inchoo ening; ore ilo oany ening, inchoo eany amu enkaji kiserut ninche.

English: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
Masaai: “Ore iyie, Nakerai e tung'ani, iwa osoit nirragie te dukuya iyie, nisir ilkererin te ilo soit oitodolu enkanasa e Yerusalem;

English: And lay siege against it, and build a fort against it, and cast a mount against it; set the camp also against it, and set battering rams against it round about.
Masaai: nipik emanata amuat Yerusalem, nishetu esuntai aitaman, nituru olong'elu aitaman ninye, intasheyie sii ilng'oborri te mbata, niun ilkedeta aitaman ninye.

English: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan, and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city: and set thy face against it, and it shall be besieged, and thou shalt lay siege against it. This shall be a sign to the house of Israel.
Masaai: Niya esaani e sekenkei nipik ninye aitaa esuntai e sekenkei te rishata ino o enkanasa; nintorioki enkomom ino ninye, nincho metaa enatii ewueji osempewuet, nirrumoki osempewuet ninye. Keaku ena olmonekie le nkaji e Israel.

English: Lie thou also upon thy left side, and lay the iniquity of the house of Israel upon it: according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon it thou shalt bear their iniquity.
Masaai: “Nirrag iyie te nkalo ino e kedienye, naa kairragie enkitamioto enkaji e Israel te shumata ino; amu ore esiana oo nkolong'i nirrag apetaa, naa inapaki ninche enkitamioto enye.

English: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
Masaai: Amu kaaisho nanu iyie nkolong'i esiana oo nkolong'i iip uni o ntomoni naaudo, naarisiore esiana oo larin lenkitamioto enye; metaa erishata naba neijia imbung ina kitamioto enkaji e Israel.

English: And when thou hast accomplished them, lie again on thy right side, and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.
Masaai: Ore peyie indip ena, nintoki airrag eniare, kake ore te nkalo ino e tatene, ninap enkitamioto enkaji e Yuda; inkolong'i artam aatipika ena, enkolong ake to lari pooki.

English: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem, and thine arm shall be uncovered, and thou shalt prophesy against it.
Masaai: “Naa intorioki enkomom ino ina manata namuati Yerusalem, metii toki enkaina ino; nimbonoki ina anasa.

English: And, behold, I will lay bands upon thee, and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another, till thou hast ended the days of thy siege.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ekaapik iyie inkeenta, metaa mimbelekenyakino ae alo, ometaba anaa niishu nkolong'i inono nimanie ina anasa.

English: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.
Masaai: “Ore iyie, iwa enkano o shairi, mpoosho o lpompo, o loikempe, o enkurma napuyiapui nipik nena pooki eng'irra nabo, nintobiru emukate te ninche. Ore te siadi e nena olong'i nirrag te murte ino; inkolong'i iip uni o ntomoni naaudo ina mukate.

English: And thy meat which thou shalt eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day: from time to time shalt thou eat it.
Masaai: Naa ore endaa ninya naa keineneng'i, inchekelini tikitam te nkolong; ninya enkata nabo te nkolong.

English: Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.
Masaai: Neaku iok enkare te ntemata ematua e ile e hini; niok kata nabo te nkolong.

English: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes, and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man, in their sight.
Masaai: Naa inya ninye anaa emukate e shairi, naa ipeju ninye te nkima nainokieki nkik oo ltung'ana edolita pooki ng'ae.”

English: And the LORD said, Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles, whither I will drive them.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Neija eiko iltung'ana loo Siraeli tenenya emukate enye eeta oloirerio, tiatua iloreren laitarasaki ninche.”

English: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! behold, my soul hath not been polluted: for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself, or is torn in pieces; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth.
Masaai: Ina peyie ajo, “Aha, Olaitoriani Enkai! eitu aekata aisarkionie kewan; ina kata eton ara olbarnoti o matubulu taata eitu aekata anya entoki natua openy arashu enataara ing'uesi e ntim, arashu etijing'a enkutuk ai endaa torrono.”

English: Then he said unto me, Lo, I have given thee cow's dung for man's dung, and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ing'ura ekaaisho iyie ilboro le modiei e nkiteng te rishata oonkik o ltung'ani, neaku ninye ipejunye emukate ino.”

English: Moreover he said unto me, Son of man, behold, I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem: and they shall eat bread by weight, and with care; and they shall drink water by measure, and with astonishment:
Masaai: Aanyaaka ake sii ajoki, “Enkerai e tung'ani ing'ura ajo kadung'oo ine neimu emukate e Yerusalem; ee kenya ninche imukateni naaineneng'i te ntemet naineneng'ishoreki te nkuretisho; naa keok enkare naturuni tenking'ashing'ash sapuk.

English: That they may want bread and water, and be astonied one with another, and consume away for their iniquity.
Masaai: Ekaas ena peyie meitoki aatum emukate o enkare, neing'ura maate te nkidang'ata sapuk, neibiitiari tiatua enkitamioto enye.

English: And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber's razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.
Masaai: “Ore iyie, enkerai e tung'ani, iwa olalem opi; intaa olmurunya libarnie kewan, nibarnie elukunya ino tenebo olmunyei lino; niya intemeta naaineneng'ishoreki nior lelo papit.

English: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled: and thou shalt take a third part, and smite about it with a knife: and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind; and I will draw out a sword after them.
Masaai: Ore ematua e nabo te uni nipejoo te nkima te mpolos e nkanasa, ore peyie eishunye inkolong'i emanata e nkanasa; ore e matua e nabo te uni niya adung'udung to lalem aitaman enkanasa; ore ematua nabo te uni nindapashaki enkijape, naa kashurtu olalem asujaa ninche.

English: Thou shalt also take thereof a few in number, and bind them in thy skirts.
Masaai: Niya te kulo enkiti siana oo lpapit aeniki olcholoi lo lkila lino.

English: Then take of them again, and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel.
Masaai: Nintoki aitayu ilkuti te kulo, nipik ninche enkima, nipejoo ninche te nkima; ore te ine nelotu enkima adoiki atua ina aji pooki e Israel.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This is Jerusalem: I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ena Yerusalem; aitasheyie ninye te mpolos oo loreren, netii nkuapi naamanita ninye.

English: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations, and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her: for they have refused my judgments and my statutes, they have not walked in them.
Masaai: Neewuo ninye te ntorroni enkiseroto agilunore inkitanapat aainei alang iloreren, negilunore ninye inkitanapat aainei alang nkuapi naamanita ninye, te anyata natanyaita inkitanapat aainei neitu epuoyie nkikoot aainei.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my judgments, neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you;
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itarruoitie aalang iloreren oomanita intae neitu ipuopuo too nkiguanat aainei, anaa imbung'ubung'u nkikoot aainei, niasiasa enaas nkitanapat ooloreren oomanita intae;

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, am against thee, and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations.
Masaai: neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura nanu ilo oarare intae; naa kayau inkiguanat erishata inyi edolita iloshon pooki.

English: And I will do in thee that which I have not done, and whereunto I will not do any more the like, because of all thine abominations.
Masaai: Naa ore tenkaraki olminong linyi pooki, kaitaas intae eneitu aekata aitaas intae, anaa enanyaanyukie enemaitoki aikata aas aigil.

English: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
Masaai: Metaa kenya iloomenye ilayiok lenye tiatua intae, nenya ilayiok iloomenye, naa kadung'oki intae enkiguana, ore pooki ng'ae linyi oleku naidapashaki inkaloli pooki enkijape.

English: Wherefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish thee; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
Masaai: Neaku ore naa anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa tukul, ore amu isarkionie ewueji ai sinyati too ntokitin pooki torrok o siaaitin inyi pooki torrok, neaku kadung'oo intae, meleku enkong'u ai nemaata nanu olng'ur.

English: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
Masaai: Ore ematua inyi nabo e uni naa keye to lmeitai neijori to lameyu tiatua intae; ore ematua nabo e uni naa kebatatakino olalem te rishata namanita intae; ore ematua nabo e uni naa kaidapashaki ilubot pooki enkop, nashurtu olalem asuj ninche.

English: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken it in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
Masaai: “Neaku neijia eikununye engoro ai napi tenelotu naa kainuaaki engoro ai ninche naitaraposh kewan; netum ninche aatayiolo aajo ore nanu Olaitoriani airoro to lom lai, ina kata naitorioki engoro ai napi shumata ninche.

English: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa kaitomijoon intae, niakuku entoki enkurruna tiatua lelo oshon oomanita intae, o te dukuya lelo pooki oodol intae egiroo.

English: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Iyakuku enkurruna o entoki namenari, enkisikong'a oloputukunyi, te nena kuapi naamanita intae, ina kata nayau inkiguanat ayaki intae te ngoro, o te ngoro napi, o too oshot engoro enkitamioto, nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for their destruction, and which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
Masaai: Ina kata nalaku agilunore intae too imbaa aainei esayiet olameyu, imbaa emutata, nena nalaku meidaikie intae; ina kata naitasapuk olameyu oleng te intae, nadung'oo ineeimu indaiki inyi.

English: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Ekairriwaki intae olameyu ong'uesi entim metigilunore intae, naa keoru intae inkera inyi, neim olmeitai o sarge atua intae naa kayau olalem shumata intae. Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii; naajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo oo ldoinyio le Israel, nimbonoki agilunore ninche,

English: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, even I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
Masaai: nijo: intae lo doinyio le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai! Inji ejoki Olaitoriani Enkai ildoinyio o ndoinyo, o lashepak o nong'ot: ing'ura, ore nanu enkewan ai naa kayau olalem shumata intae, naar ainyal iwuejitin inyi neeika.

English: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain men before your idols.
Masaai: Ore ilpereren linyi naa keaku mijoonto ore ilpereren le nkorropil inyi naa kegili; ore lelo linyi ootaraki metuata nanang'aa ninche te dukuya inkitanyaanyukot inyi oo nkaitin.

English: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
Masaai: Naa kairragie lelo seseni ootuata loo ltung'ana le Israel te dukuya inkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin nemeishu; naidapash iloik linyi aitaman ilpereren linyi loo lasarri.

English: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
Masaai: Ore pooki nimanyimanya naa keaku nkanas inyi mijoonto nemuti iwuejitin inyi neeika, metaa ore ilpereren linyi loo lasarri neaku ile pesho netumutaki, negili aabelibel inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu, nedung'i ilpereren linyi le nkorropil aauroo, nejutori isiaaitin inyi.

English: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Nebatatakino ilkumok ootuata atua intae, niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
Masaai: “Naa kaleku ilkuti linyi eishu. Neaku iatata too loshon ilekunot ooilanya ilo alem, naa teneidapashi intae too nkuapi,
