English: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
Masaai: neaku ore lelo linyi ooilanyishote naadamu nanu te lelo oshon oowaita ninche aitaa iyarunot, ina kata atigila iltauja lenye lemaairuk naaing'uaa nanu, naitamodok inkonyek enye nena naaibelekenyakinote to lng'uarra nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin; naa keibayu te nduaata enye maate nena torrok naataasa, o lminong lenye pooki.

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
Masaai: Naa keyiolou ina kata aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani; eitu airo te mpesho inchere kaitaas ena torrono ninche.”

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Entoosh inkaik inyi, nioshieshie nkejek inyi enkop nijojo, Aha! ore enkaraki ina bae olminong le nkaji e Israel; amu kebatata ninche to lalem, o lameyu, o lmeitai.

English: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
Masaai: Ore ilo olakua oleng naa keye to lmeitai; ore ilo otaana nebatatakino olalem; ore ilo otelekua neitajeuoki naa keye to lameyu. Neaku neijia aikunaki engoro ai napi ninche.

English: Then shall ye know that I am the LORD, when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
Masaai: Niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata eirragaa impopoki enye tiatua inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu emanita ilpereren lenye, te shumata pooki doinyo oodo, o too nchumat pooki oo ldoinyo, o tiabori olchani pooki onyori, o tiabori pooki shani dapashi mbenek, o te pooki wueji ake neitainye esong'uana narropil aaitaiki inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaitorioo enkaina ai agilunore ninche, naitaa enkop mitil naitomijoon, too manyishoritin enye pooki, eiteru to lpurkel o meshomo Ribla. Ina kata eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki enkop e Israel: Enkiting'oto! Eewuo enkiting'oto shumata ilpijat pokira oong'uan le nkop.

English: Now is the end come upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
Masaai: Etabawua taata enkiting'oto shumata iyie, naa kabolu engoro ai meeu shumata iyie naa kaaiguanare iyie anaa enaikununo inkoitoi inono; naa kaaitame iyie to lminong lino pooki.

English: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Nimikileku iyie enkong'u ai, nemaata olng'ur; kake kaaitame iyie tenkaraki nkoitoi inono, ina kata etii olminong lino atua iyie. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ‘Emutata nasuju emutata!’ Ing'ura, neina nalotu.

English: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
Masaai: Etabawua enkiting'oto, eewuo enkiting'oto; kitudumakine ninye iyie agilunore. Ing'ura elotu.

English: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble is near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
Masaai: Eewuo emutata enitii iyie, oi intae oomanya ina kop; etabawua enkata, etinyikua ina olong enkolong enkishirata neme enkolong nabuakuni too nchumat e lelo doinyo.

English: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
Masaai: Ekayau aitasieku engoro ai shumata intae, nayaki intae engoro ai napi, agilunore intae, naiguanare intae te risioroto oo nkoitoi inyi; naa kaitame intae too lminong' linyi pooki.

English: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD that smiteth.
Masaai: Nemeleku enkong'u ai, nemaata nanu olng'ur, ekaitame intae te risioroto oo inkoitoi inyi, ina kata etii olminong linyi pooki atua intae. Ina pee iyiolouu aajo ara Olaitoriani ooshisho.

English: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
Masaai: “Ing'ura, ina olong! Ing'ura elotu ninye! Eewuo emutata inyi, eitapuka imbaa enkikonya, etubulutua ilukuny olwuasa.

English: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them shall remain, nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither shall there be wailing for them.
Masaai: Etubulua enkikonya aaku eng'udi oo ntorrok; meetae obo lenye oleku, arashu ninye enkumoi enye, arashu enkarsisisho enye; nemeitokini aata te ninche oloituruku.

English: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
Masaai: Etabawua enkata, etinyikua enkolong. Mincho ilo oinyang'isho eshipa, arashu olamirani eishir, amu etii engoro napi atua olorora lenye pooki.

English: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
Masaai: Amu merrinyunye olamirani arrinyokino ina natimira, eton eishu ninche. amu etii engoro napi sapuk shumata olorora lenye pooki; nemerrinyo siadi; naa ore te nkaraki ing'ok enyena, meeta oloidim aitasheiki enkishui enye.

English: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
Masaai: “Etoosho ninche entarumpeta nerretena pooki; nemeeta obo lenye olo olarrabal, amu etii engoro ai napi shumata olorora lenye pooki.

English: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that is in the field shall die with the sword; and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
Masaai: “Etii olalem auluo, netii olmeitai o lameyu atua boo. Ore pooki ng'ae otii atua enkurma neye to lalem, ore pooki ng'ae otii atua enkanasa nemuat olameyu o lmeitai.

English: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
Masaai: Naa teneilanyisho ake ninye obo loo lekunot, naa kepuo ildoinyo, anaa nturkuluoni oo nong'ot, eishir pooki, eishiraki pooki ng'ae intorrok enyena.

English: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.
Masaai: Ekelepori nkaik e pooki ng'ae, neshalu nkung enye anaa enkare.

English: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
Masaai: Neishopoki ate ilkuniyiani, neitoipoo ate to lkirutoto; netii enkurruna inkomomi enye pooki, nemetii ilpapit ilukuny enye pooki.

English: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
Masaai: Naa kenang'aa enkosholai enye too nkoitoi naalala e nkanasa, ore sahabu enye netiu anaa entoki naiduruk; ore enkosholai enye o sahabu nemeidim aaitajeu ninche te ina olong engoro napi o Laitoriani; meitaraposh ninche esumash enye arashu eiput inkoshuaa enye te ninye. Amu endapidapoi apa ina narror ing'ok enye.

English: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty: but they made the images of their abominations and of their detestable things therein: therefore have I set it far from them.
Masaai: Ore imasaa enye sidain naaishopo te nkisisa e pesho, neitobiru inkitanyaanyukot oo loipi lo lminong o ntokitin enye pooki torrok metaa kaitaa entoki naiduruk te ninche.

English: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.
Masaai: “Naa kapik ninye inkaik oo ltung'ana leeiking'a metarresho ninche aaibung naisho ilarruok mewaita ninche; naa kepuo aaisarkionie ninye.

English: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
Masaai: Akaiwuang'ie enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche, peyie etum ninche aaisarkionie ewueji ai e tipat; ejing ilaikonyak atua neisarkionie ninye,

English: Make a chain: for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
Masaai: neitaa olmuaate. “Ore amu ebore enkop esesekuanare osarge; nebore enkanasa enkikonya,

English: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.
Masaai: naa kayau nena kuapi torrok oleng meibung'a aaya inkajijik enye; ekaiting'ie ilo wuasa lenye le ngolon, ore wuejitin enye sinyat neisarkionieki.

English: Destruction cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
Masaai: Ore tenebau emion, naa keing'oru ninche eseriani, nemetum ninye.

English: Mischief shall come upon mischief, and rumour shall be upon rumour; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet; but the law shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the ancients.
Masaai: Elotu emutata nasuju ae mutata, nelotu olkilikuai leme sidai asuju olikae, neing'oru ninche enduaata to loiboni le Nkai, kake eisha enkitanapata to lapolosani, neisha enkikoo too lpayiani.

English: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Neishir olaiguanani neiting'o osiligi lo ltung'ani kitok, ore nkaik oo ltung'ana oopeny enkop neikirikira tenkuretisho sapuk. Ekaitaas ninche te risioroto oo nkoitoi enye, o terisioroto oo nkiguanat enye ekaiguanare ninche, naa keyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in mine house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
Masaai: Ore to lari le ile, to lapa le ile, te nkolong e miet o lapa, ore atonita te nkaji ai, tenebo ilpayiani le Yuda etoni te dukuya nanu, ore enkaina o Laitoriani Enkai naaiteleikino nanu.

English: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins even downward, fire; and from his loins even upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of amber.
Masaai: Ina peyie adol naa ng'ura, enkitanyaanyukoto natiu anaa eno ltung'ani; ore tiabori enye ine netiu anaa empolos enye naa enkima, ore te shumata empolos enye netiu anaa enkitanyaanyukoto naitiil oleng, anaa osuyai oitiil otisikaki.

English: And he put forth the form of an hand, and took me by a lock of mine head; and the spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the inner gate that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
Masaai: Neitorioo enkitanyaanyukoto neeijo enkaina, naaya nanu adumu aibung ilpapit le ndukuya ai; naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et ailepie aya erishata e nkop o keper, naayau nanu too nduaat Enkai Yerusalem, naapik kishomi najing'ieki endung'oroto e atua ina naipirare moikuape, ine apa netii olorika le nkitanyaanyukoto o lom, ina naipiru aaku olom.

English: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etii enkitoo e Nkai e Israel ine anaa apa enduaata natoduaa te nkisiajata.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north. So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, taraposhu nkonyek inono shumata ing'ura enkalo e moikuape.” Metaa ataraposhuo nkonyek aainei aitorioki moikuape, naa ng'ura, ore te moikuape e kishomi olperere lo lasar, teine nejing'ieki, netii apa enkitanyaanyukoto olom.

English: He said furthermore unto me, Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel committeth here, that I should go far off from my sanctuary? but turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, idolita enaasita ninche, olminong kitok oasita enkaji e Israel tene, aaraa nanu aitalam ewueji ai sinyati? Kake eton ake intoki adol likae minong sapuk.”

English: And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
Masaai: Naayau nanu kutuk aji e ilo odung'oro; ore peyie aing'or, ng'ura etii enaudoto natii esuntai.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, dig now in the wall: and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, tuturo atua esuntai”, ore peyie atur esuntai, ng'ura netii kutuk aji.

English: And he said unto me, Go in, and behold the wicked abominations that they do here.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Shomo atua, nidol intabo olminong naasita ninche tene.”

English: So I went in and saw; and behold every form of creeping things, and abominable beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, pourtrayed upon the wall round about.
Masaai: Metaa nalo atua nadol; ore teine, etisiraki te suntai aaitaman ing'uesi pooki naaiserpepiari, o ng'uesi pooki torrok o nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin pooki nemeishu enkaji e Israel.

English: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, with every man his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
Masaai: Neitashe te dukuya ninche iltung'ana ntomoni naapishana loo lpayiani le nkaji e Israel, tenebo Yaasania olayioni le Shafan eitashe tenebo ninche. Neeta ake pooki ng'ae lenye entoki napejieki enkorropil te nkaina enye, neilep empuruo enkorropil shumata.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, itodua enaasita ilpayiani le nkaji e Israel tenaimin, pooki tung'ani ake tiatua olgilata lenye too mpishai? Amu ejo ninche, ‘Medol iyiook Olaitoriani, eibayie Olaitoriani enkop.’ ”

English: He said also unto me, Turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do.
Masaai: Naaitoki ake ajoki nanu, “Intoki ake adol kulie tabo olminong naasita ninche.”

English: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD'S house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu kishomi enkalo e moikuape enkaji o Laitoriani; naa ng'ura, etoni inkituaak teine naaishiraki enkai enye naji Tammus.

English: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations than these.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Itodua iyie ena, iyie nakerai e tung'ani? Intoki ake adol intabo olminong sapuki naalang kuna.”

English: And he brought me into the inner court of the LORD'S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
Masaai: Naayau ninye nanu olgilata liatua le nkaji o Laitoriani: naa ng'ura ore te kutukaji e nkaji o Laitoriani, enerish eneimi olgoriet o lperere, netii iltung'ana oobaya tikitam o imiet, eisho nkoriong'i enye ina aji Olaitoriani, neing'orita nkomomi enye enkalo o loosaen, eomon enkolong te nkalo oloosaen.

English: Then he said unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? for they have filled the land with violence, and have returned to provoke me to anger: and, lo, they put the branch to their nose.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Itoduaa iyie ena, Nakerai e tung'ani? Kentoki nalelek te nkaji e Yuda pee eas intabo olminong naasita tene, eji metaa keiput enkop pooki enkikonya naainuaaki nanu oleng matagoroyu? Ng'ura, epik olng'osila lenye inkumeishin enye.

English: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
Masaai: Metaa kaitame te ngoro napi; meitoki enkong'u ai aleku, nemaitoki aata nanu olng'ur; ore hoo neishir too nkiyiaa aainei to ltoilo sapuk, mainining'u ninche.”

English: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice, saying, Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near, even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.
Masaai: Neishir ninye to ltoilo sapuk too nkiyiaa aainei ejo, “Entinyiku, intae oopuo aar enkanasa pooki ng'ae ake te ntoki nalo amutishore te nkaina enye.”

English: And, behold, six men came from the way of the higher gate, which lieth toward the north, and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand; and one man among them was clothed with linen, with a writer's inkhorn by his side: and they went in, and stood beside the brasen altar.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, eetuo iltung'ana ile te nkalo enkishomi e shumata, natii enkalo e moikuape pooki tung'ani ake eeta entoki enye namutishore te nkaina enye, netii tenebo ninche oltung'ani oishopito enkila napuyiapui, tenebo entoki naguetishoreki te matua enye. Nepuo atua neitashe te mbata olperere lo suyiai.

English: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer's inkhorn by his side;
Masaai: Ore ina kata neshomo enkitoo e Nkai e Israel aing'uaa lelo kerubi laa ninche etotonie teine nejing'ieki ina aji, neipot ilo tung'ani oishopito enkila napuyiapui, ilo oota entoki naigerishoreki te matua enye.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Shomo topolosa enkanasa turuko Yerusalem, nipik olmishire shumata oo nkomomi e lelo tung'ana pooki ootanyamala te nkishirata osina te nkaraki olminong otaasaki tiatua.”

English: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:
Masaai: Nejoki ilkulikae aning'ito, “Topolosa ina anasa isujaa ninye, niar mincho enkong'u ino eleku, nimintodolu hoo olng'ur;

English: Slay utterly old and young, both maids, and little children, and women: but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at my sanctuary. Then they began at the ancient men which were before the house.
Masaai: iishu iltung'ana pooki kituaak teine, ilbarnot o ntoyie, nkera kutiti o nkituaak, kake mishoroo ake pooki ng'ae oota olmishire. Naa interu te wueji ai sinyati.”

English: And he said unto them, Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain: go ye forth. And they went forth, and slew in the city.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninche, “Esarkionie ina aji, nimputuputu iloodung'oro ilmeneng'a. Enchom dukuya.” Metaa eshomo dukuya, nearisho tiatua ina anasa.

English: And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?
Masaai: Ore ina kata earisho, naatung'uayioki aa nanu ake, nabatata te nkomom ai aishir, “Aha Olaitoriani Enkai! Indaikie iyie ilekunot pooki le Israel tembukunoto engoro ino napi te Yerusalem?”

English: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore entorroni enkaji e Israel o Yuda netuluso aaku sapuk oleng; eiputa enkop pooki osarge, neiputa enkanasa imbaa nemesipa; amu ejo ninche, ‘Eibayie Olaitoriani enkop, nemedol Olaitoriani.’

English: And as for me also, mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will recompense their way upon their head.
Masaai: Ore te nanu meleku enkong'u ai, nemaata olng'ur, kake kaitalaku ninche anaa enatiu isiaaitin te shumata ilukuny enye.”

English: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, oltung'ani oishopito inkilani naapuiyapui, tenebo entoki naigerishoreki te matua enye nayau olkilikuai ojo: “Ataasa anaa inikintanapa.”

English: Then I looked, and, behold, in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
Masaai: Naing'orisho nanu, naa ng'ura, ore oloing'ange ilo otii shumata nena lukuny e lelo kerubi etii enchumata enye entoki neeijo olorika le nkitoo oitobiruno to soit pus oji Safire*g*.

English: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen, and said, Go in between the wheels, even under the cherub, and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui, “Shomo atua nena kejek e ngarri naapuo to loing'ang'e naatii abori lelo kerubi; imputa nkaik inono inkuk naaishu te rishata lelo kerubi, nindapashaki ninche ina anasa.” Naduaaya ninye elo,

English: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
Masaai: ore ina kata neitashe ilkerubi te nkalo e kopikop eina aji, ore peyie ejing oltung'ani atua; neiput enkatampoi olodung'oro liatua.

English: Then the glory of the LORD went up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD'S glory.
Masaai: Neilep enkitoo o Laitoriani aing'uaa olkerubi o metabaiki enejing'ieki enkaji; neiput ina aji enkatampoi, ore olodung'oro neiput ewang'an enkitoo o Laitoriani.

English: And the sound of the cherubims' wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh.
Masaai: Nening'i oltoilo loo naipuko oo lkerubi to lodung'oro liong'ota, etiu anaa oltoilo le Nkai Magilani teneiro.

English: And it came to pass, that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the cherubims; then he went in, and stood beside the wheels.
Masaai: Ore peyie eitanap ilo tung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui ajoki, “Iwa enkima te mpolos e nena kejek eng'arri naapuo to loing'ang'e, te rishata oo lkerubi”, nelo ninye atua neitashe te mbata enkeju e ng'arri.

English: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen: who took it, and went out.
Masaai: Neitorioo olkerubi enkaina enye te rishata oo lkerubi aitorioki enkima natii empolos oo lkerubi, neya embata enye, nepik atua nena aik e ilo tung'ani oishopito nkilani naapuyiapui, neya ninye, neipang boo.

English: And there appeared in the cherubims the form of a man's hand under their wings.
Masaai: Etiu ilo kerubi anaa oloota enkaina oltung'ani tiabori naipuko enye.

English: And when I looked, behold the four wheels by the cherubims, one wheel by one cherub, and another wheel by another cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
Masaai: Naing'orisho, naa ng'ura, etii nkejek eng'arri ong'uan naashepita ilo kerubi, eshepita ake nabo olkerubi, ore emua oo nkejek engarri netiu anaa osoit oimerlel oji Krisolit*g*.

English: And as for their appearances, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel.
Masaai: Ore empukunoto enye, eeta nena ong'uan emua nabo, anaa enkeju eng'arri natii atua enkeju eng'arri.

English: When they went, they went upon their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
Masaai: Ore peyie epuo ninche, neim enkalo ake nabo te nena ong'uan eitu eibelekenya epuoito, kake ore ake pooki alo neibelekenyakino enkeju engarri e dukuya nesuju nkulie pooki, eitu eibelekenya epuo.

English: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
Masaai: Ore nkaamanaa oo nkejek enye, o ltidii loo nkejek enye, o nkejek oo ngarrin nebore nkonyek naamanita.

English: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
Masaai: Ore nena kejek oo ng'arrin, neipoti aning'ito aajo nkejek osiwuo oloing'ang'e.

English: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae te ninche neeta nkomomi ong'uan: Ore enkomom e dukuya naa enkomom olkerubi, ore enkomom e are naa enkomom oltung'ani ore enkomom e uni naa enkomom olng'atuny, ore enkomom e ong'uan naa enkomom olkurragos.

English: And the cherubims were lifted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar.
Masaai: Nedumunye ilo kerubi ailep alo shumata. Ore kulo naa nena ng'uesi apa naaishu natoduaa te nkiyopata olkeju le Keba.

English: And when the cherubims went, the wheels went by them: and when the cherubims lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
Masaai: Ore peyie epuo lelo kerubi nemanaa aapuo nena kejek e ng'arri; ore pee edumu lelo kerubi inaipuko enye aadumunye aaing'at enkop, neitu eibelekenya nena kejek aaing'uaa meshep ninche.

English: When they stood, these stood; and when they were lifted up, these lifted up themselves also: for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
Masaai: Ore pee eitashe, neitashe sii kuna, ore pee edumunye aailep, neilep sii ninche tenebo, amu etii apa atua ninche enkiyang'et e nena ng'uesi naaishu.

English: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
Masaai: Nepuku enkitoo Olaitoriani aing'uaa kutuk aji e ina aji, neitashe te nchumata e ilo kerubi.

English: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD'S house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
Masaai: Nedumu ilkerubi inaipuko enye aailep aapuo to loing'ang'e aaing'uaa enkop adolita epuo, ore epuo, etii nkejek emurte enye; neitashe te kutuk aji enkishomi enkalo oloosaen enkaji Olaitoriani; netii shumata enye enkitoo Enkai e Israel.

English: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar; and I knew that they were the cherubims.
Masaai: Ore kuna naa ing'uesi naaishu nena natoduaa tiabori ina Ai e Israel te nkiyopata olkeju le Keba; nayiolou ajo ilkerubi apa ninche.

English: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
Masaai: Neeta ake pooki obo te ninche nkomomi ong'uan, neeta ake pooki inaipuko maa ong'uan, ore tiabori inaipuko enye nenyaanyukie nkaik oo ltung'ana.

English: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar, their appearances and themselves: they went every one straight forward.
Masaai: Ore empukunoto oo nkomomi enye, netiu anaa inapa omomi natoduaa te nkiyopata olkeju le Kebar. Nepuo pooki dukuya aaitoriori.

English: Moreover the spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD'S house, which looketh eastward: and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the princes of the people.
Masaai: Naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et shumata, naayau nanu kishomi oloosaen e nkaji o Laitoriani, ina naipirare oloosaen. Naa Ng'ura, ore te kutuk aji e ina kishomi netii iltung'ana tikitam o imiet; nadol tiatua ninche Yaasania olayioni le Asuri, o Peletia olayioni le Benaia o lkituaak loo ltung'ana.

English: Then said he unto me, Son of man, these are the men that devise mischief, and give wicked counsel in this city:
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, iltung'ana kulo laa ninche ooipiru enkarruoisho laa ninche ooishoru nkikoot torrok tena anasa;

English: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
Masaai: ninche oojo, ‘Eton eitu enyiku enkata nikishetie nkajijik; ore ena anasa naa emoti nayierishoreki ake nikira iyiook nkiri.’

English: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.
Masaai: Metaa imbonoki ninche, tigilunore ninche imbonoki iyie enkerai e tung'ani.”

English: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and said unto me, Speak; Thus saith the LORD; Thus have ye said, O house of Israel: for I know the things that come into your mind, every one of them.
Masaai: Naadoiki nanu Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani naajoki ninye nanu, “Tejo, Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Metaa idamu, iyie na aji e Israel; amu kayiolo nena baa pooki naajing endamunoto ino.

English: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
Masaai: Intaa kumok oleng ilmeneng'a linono tena anasa nimputa inkoitoi naalala enkanasa ilmeneng'a.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron: but I will bring you forth out of the midst of it.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ilmeneng'a linono lirragie ti atua ninye, naa nkiri ake, naa emoti nayierishoreki ena anasa, kake aikintaini iyie tiatua ninye.

English: Ye have feared the sword; and I will bring a sword upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ituria iyie olalem; naa kayau shumata iyie olalem, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And I will bring you out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
Masaai: Naa kaaitupuku nanu iyie tiatua ninye, naapik iyie nkaik oo ltung'ana leeiking'a, naadung'oki iyie enkiguana.

English: Ye shall fall by the sword; I will judge you in the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Kibatati iyie to lalem, ekaaiguanare iyie to lpolosie le Israel: niyiolou iyie ajo ara Olaitoriani.

English: This city shall not be your caldron, neither shall ye be the flesh in the midst thereof; but I will judge you in the border of Israel:
Masaai: Meaku ena anasa emoti ino nayierishoreki nimiaku iyie nkiri tiatua ninye; ekaaiguanare iyie to lpolosie le Israel;

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD: for ye have not walked in my statutes, neither executed my judgments, but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you.
Masaai: niyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani; amu eitu imbung alotie nkitanapat aainei, arashu isujaa nkiguanat aainei, kake itaasa anaa enatiu nkitanapat oo loshon lelo likimanita iyie.”

English: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?
Masaai: Ore pee ebau ina kata, aibonisho nanu, neye Peletia olayioni le Benaia. Nabatata te nkomom ai, naishir to ltoilo sapuk najo, “Aha Olaitoriani Enkai! Inting'ie aishu lelo lekunot le Israel?”

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo:

English: Son of man, thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel wholly, are they unto whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Get you far from the LORD: unto us is this land given in possession.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore iltung'ana linono, aa lelo alashera, lelo yarunot linono, ina aji pooki e Israel, ninche pooki, naa ninche lelo ootejo iloomanya Yerusalem inchere, ‘Eshomo ninche aalam Olaitoriani; eishooki iyiook ena kop metaa enaang.’

English: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come.
Masaai: Metaa tejo, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore hoo naitayio ninche aitalamaa too loshon naa ore hoo naidapashayie ninche tiatua nkuapi, nataa nanu enkaji Enkai te ninche te nkiti kata tenena kuapi, naashomo.’

English: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
Masaai: Metaa tejo, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaiturrurru intae too loreren, naiturrurru ntae aitung'uaa nena kuapi naaidapashakaki ntae, naa kaisho ntae ina kop e Israel.’

English: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
Masaai: Naa tenepuonu ninche ine, neitayu tiatua ninye intokitin pooki torrok o pooki toki olminong.

English: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them an heart of flesh:
Masaai: Naa kaisho ninche oltau obo, napik enkiyang'et ng'ejuk atua ninche; naitayu tiatua ninche ilo tau lo soit aitung'uaa iseseni lenye naisho ninche oltau le nkiring'o,

English: That they may walk in my statutes, and keep mine ordinances, and do them: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
Masaai: peyie etum aashomie nkitanapat aainei, neibung inkitanapat aainei neyanyit ninche; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.

English: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo oopuo aasuj too ltauja lenye intokitin torrok o mbaa olminong, ekayieu isiaaitin enye too lukuny enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
Masaai: Ina peyie edumu lelo kerubi inaipuko enye, eeta nkejek oo ngarrin too mbat enye; ore enkitoo Enkai e Israel neitoipito ninche.

English: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
Masaai: Nepuku enkitoo Olaitoriani aing'uaa atua ina anasa, neitashe te nchumata oldoinyio otii enkalo oloo saen eina anasa.

English: Afterwards the spirit took me up, and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from me.
Masaai: Naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et ailepie shumata naayau nanu te nduaata Enkiyang'et e Nkai atua Ilkaldayo, enetii lelo yarunot. Ore ina duaata natoduaa naalo aing'uaa nanu.

English: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shewed me.
Masaai: Naliki lelo yarunot imbaa pooki naaitodua Olaitoriani nanu.

English: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house, which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not: for they are a rebellious house.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imanya atua enkaji kiserut, lelo oota nkonyek naadolishore, nemedolisho, lelo oota nkiyiaa naaning'ishore, nemening'isho

English: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they be a rebellious house.
Masaai: amu enkaji kiserut ninche. Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, intobiraki kewan olola le yararoto, nilo eyararoto dama kiduaaya ninche; ilo anaa oloaruno aing'uaa ewueji ino alo dikae wueji kiduaaya ninche. Ebaiki neidim ninche aatoning'u hoo naa enkaji natogolong'ua ninche.

English: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
Masaai: Intupuku iyie olola lino dama kidolita ninche anaa olola le yararoto; naa ipuopuo intae teipa edolita ninche ntae, anaa enaas iltung'ana lelo oopuo e yararoto.

English: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
Masaai: Entutur intae esuntai edolita ninche niimiimi ina lusie.

English: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders, and carry it forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.
Masaai: Ore edolita ninche intae nidumumu olola aaiteleiki iloilila linyi, ninapinapa aaipang'ie te naimin, nintoipipi nkomomi inyi, peyie midolidolo ina kop; amu aaitaa iyie olmonekie te nkaraki enkaji e Israel.”

English: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought it forth in the twilight, and I bare it upon my shoulder in their sight.
Masaai: Naataasa ina anaa enaaitanapaki. Ayaua olola lai te ndama, anaa olola le yarunoto, ore teipa, natur esuntai too nkaik aainei, nalo te naimin, anapita pooki toki ai to loililai lai edolita ninche.

English: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore tadekenya nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,

English: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, amaa enkaji e Israel, ena aji kiserut keitu kijoki iyie, ‘Kaa doi iasita iyie?’

English: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden concerneth the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that are among them.
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ele kilikuai oiroishi neipirta ilo kitok otii Yerusalem oina aji pooki e Israel natii atua ninye.’

English: Say, I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove and go into captivity.
Masaai: Tejo, ‘Ara nanu olmonekie te iyie: anaa enataasa, neaku ina eitaasi ninche ekepuo ninche eyararoto aaku ilooena.’

English: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
Masaai: Ore ilo kitok otii tenebo ninche nedumu olola lenye aiteleiki oloililae lenye te naimin, neipang alo; ketur esuntai aaim; naa keimulumul enkomom enye, peyie medol ina kop too nkonyek enyena.

English: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
Masaai: Naa kaisalaash orreshet lai aitoipoki ninye, naa keyae ninye tiatua orreshet lai; naa kayau ninye Babilon ina natii enkop oo Lkaldayo, nemedol ake sii ninye; naa keye ninye te ine.

English: And I will scatter toward every wind all that are about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
Masaai: Naa kaidapashaki aing'orie pooki kijape lelo pooki oomanita ninye, ilaretok lenyena tenebo iltimito lenyena pooki; naa kashurt kashutu olalem asujaa ninche.

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
Masaai: Naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naidapashaki ninche iloshon naidapashaa ninche too nkuapi.

English: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Kake kaisho ilkuti lenye eilanyisho aailany ilo alem, aaing'uaa olameyu o lmeitai torrono, peyie etum aaisirayia olminong lenye pooki tiatua lelo oshon oojing atua, netum aatayiolo aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Masaai: Enyaaka ake sii ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii nanu ejo,

English: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani inosa endaa ino to lkirutoto, niok enkare to lokirikiri o te nkuretisho;

English: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
Masaai: nijo te nkaraki lelo tung'ana leina kop, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai te nkaraki lelo oomanya Yerusalem teina kop e Israel: Kenya ninche endaa enye te nkuretisho, neok enkare te nking'asia, amu keitayuni te nkop ina pooki natii, tenkaraki ina kikonya e lelo pooki oomanya atua ninye.

English: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore nena anas neitomijooni, neaku ina kop enememanyae; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo:

English: Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, kaa dung'et e rashe ena niata naipirta ena kop e Israel, ijo, ‘Etoodoro inkolong'i, ore pooki duaata nelotu aaku enemeetae.’ Tiaaki naa ninche,

English: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
Masaai: ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaiting'ie ena dung'et e rashe, nemeitoki aekata aasishore anaa endung'et e rashe te Israel.’ Kake tiaaki ninche, etinyikutua nena olong'i, oo nkitabarot e pooki duaata.

English: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
Masaai: Amu meitokini aata aekata enduaata nemesipa arashu enduaata elejare te nkaji e Israel.

English: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu Olaitoriani naa kairo ororei ilo lairo, naa keasi. Meekure eitokini aekata aaitumutiki, kake ore too nkolong'i inyi iyie na aji kiserut ekairo nanu ororei naas ina, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of the times that are far off.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ing'ura, ore lelo le nkaji e Israel ejo, ‘Ore ina duaata enye naa enoo nkolong'i kumok e dukuya, nelimu nduaat oo nkolong'i naatii dukuya oleng.’

English: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Neaku tiaaki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meetae ororei lai hoo obo oitokini aitumutiki, kake ore ilo rorei lairo naa keasi, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:

English: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonisho tigilunore iloibonok le Israel, imbonisho nijoki lelo ooibonisho too ndamunot enye maate: ‘Entoning ilo rorei lo Laitoriani!’

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, “Ekake ayia intae lelo oibonok oomoda lelo oosuj enkiyang'et enye maate, nemeeta toki natoduaa!

English: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
Masaai: Etotiwuo iloibonok linyi anaa mbariak tiatua ilmuaateni, iyie Israel.

English: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
Masaai: Eitu ilepaki ajing atua ilusien, arashu ishet esuntai te nkaraki enkaji e Israel, pee etum aitasho to larrabal te ina olong o Laitoriani.

English: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word.
Masaai: Eiroro ninche elejare neibonu elejare; nejo ninche, ‘Ejo Olaitoriani’ eitu eirriwaa Olaitoriani ninche, neisilig ninche meitabai irorei lenye.

English: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?
Masaai: Keitu idol iyie enduaata namilisho, nimbalie te nkutuk ino enaibon e lejare, te pooki kata nitejo, ‘Ejo Olaitoriani, hoo neitu nanu airo?’ ”

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu imbalie te nkutuk ino inemesipa nitoduaa elejare, neaku ng'ura, kaagilunore iyie, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ekegilunore enkaina ai lelo oibonok lelo oota nduaat olmilo neitayu nduaat elejare; mejing ninche atua olturrur loo ltung'ana laainei, arashu eigeri ninche te mbuku oo nkarn e nkaji e Israel, arashu ejing ninche ina kop e Israel; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki, ee enkaraki naitapong'oitie iltung'ana laainei, ejo, ‘Eseriani,’ ina kata meetae eseriani; te nkaraki, ina kata nashet iltung'ana esuntai, nepuonu iloibonok aamur te nturoto;

English: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
Masaai: tiaaki lelo oibonok oomur te nturoto kesulari ninye! Ekelotu olairrag le nchan, o isoito le nchan oodou nelotu olkutati kitok oleng;

English: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
Masaai: ore peyie esulari esuntai, aimejokini intae, ‘Koree apa emurata nitumurie ninye?’

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaitaa olkutati kitok opuku losiwuo metigila te ngoro ai; naa ketumi oloirrag le nchan te ngoro ai, o enchan sapuk te ngoro napi naidaikie ninye.

English: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kagil auroo ina suntai nitumurakita enturoto nauroo ninye te nkop, metaa ore olkitamanyunoto lenye neirrag metii toki; ore tenesulari, terishata enye; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
Masaai: Neaku neijia aiko tenaitayu engoro ai te ina suntai, o te lelo ootumura ninye te nturoto; naa kaajoki iyie, meekure eetae ina suntai, arashu lelo ootumura ninye,

English: To wit, the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: ore lelo oibonok le Israel lelo ooibonoki Yerusalem nedol induaat eseriani te nkaraki ninye, ina kata meetae eseriani ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino tigilunore nena toyie oo ltung'ana linono, nena naaibonisho too ndamunot enye maate; imbonoki tigilunore ninche

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?
Masaai: tiaki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekake ayia nena kituaak naeniki nkaik enye pooki intasimi, naaitobiraki entoki naitoipie ilukuny iltung'ana pooki, irreshoo iltauja! Irreshoo iltauja loo ltung'ana laainei, ninchosho ilkulikae tauja etoni aaisho tenkaraki dupoto inyi.

English: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear your lies?
Masaai: Kisarkionie nanu tiatua olorere lai te mborei e nkaina e shairi o te mbelati emukate, iariara metuata iltung'ana lemeishaakino neye ninchosho iltung'ana lemeishaakino neishu etoni eishu, te lejare inyi ilejileje iltung'ana laainei, lelo ooinining'u elejare.

English: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make them fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt to make them fly.
Masaai: “Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura kagilunore nena tasimi inyi nirreshieshie iltauja, naa kapolosu aiwuang'ie too nkaik inyi; naa kaisho lelo tauja litarresho epuo etalaayioki anaa imotonyi.

English: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore sii nena nintoipiepie ate naa kapolos aiwuang'ie, naitajeu iltung'ana laainei aitung'uaa nkaik inyi, nemeitoki aekata aatii nkaik inyi anaa eng'ues naibung'aki aanya; niyiolouu ina kata aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
Masaai: Amu itaara iltauja loo supati te monkoi, hoo neitu nanu aar ninye oltau, nintagolo ilo torrono, nemeibelekenya ninye aing'uaa enkoitoi enye e ntorroni pee eitajeu enkishui enye;

English: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: neaku meekure aekata intokiki aadol induaat olmilo anaa iasishorere ntasimi; ekaitajeu iltung'ana laainei aitung'uaa nkaik inyi. Niyiolouu ina kata aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
Masaai: Nepuonu kulikae payiani le Israel enatii, netoni te dukuya nanu.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii, aajoki:

English: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani ewaita kulo tung'ana inkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin nemeishu aapik iltauja lenye, nepik entoki narrueshisho oo ntorrok enye dukuya nkomomi enye; kaisho kewan maikilikuanishore tukul ninche?

English: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
Masaai: Neaku irorie ninche, nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore pooki tung'ani le nkaji e Israel opik inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena nemeishu oltau, nepik entoki narror oo ntorrok dukuya enkomom enye, neitoki ake alotu enetii ilo oiboni le Nkai, kawaliki nanu ninye makewan ara Olaitoriani, te nkaraki olorora loo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enyena nemeishu,

English: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
Masaai: peyie atum aibung'a lelo tauja leina aji e Israel, lelo pooki ootapong'ori te nanu too nkitayaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
Masaai: “Metaa tiaaki enkaji e Israel, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Erridutu nimbelekenyunyenye aaing'uaa nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu; nimbelekenyunyu inkomomi inyi to lminong linyi pooki.

English: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:
Masaai: Amu ore ake ninye pooki ng'ae le nkaji e Israel, arashu olomoni ake pooki tiatua Israel ooroo kewan te nanu, nepik nkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin nemeishu oltau lenye nepik entoki narror oo ntorrok enyena dukuya enkomom enye, eji neitoki ake alotu enetii oloiboni le Nkai pee elotu aikilikuanu imbaa enyena te nanu, ore nanu makewan Olaitoriani naa kawaliki ninye nanu enkorrok ai;

English: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: naa kaitorioki enkomom ai ilo tung'ani agilunore ninye, ekaitaa ninye olmonekie naitaa olo menuni nadung'oo ninye tiatua iltung'ana laainei; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
Masaai: Naa teneleji oloiboni lai neiro ororei, ore nanu, Olaitoriani oteleja ilo oiboni, naa kaitorioo enkaina ai agilunore ninye naidaikie ninye tiatua iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.

English: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him;
Masaai: Naa kenap ninche enkitamioto enye enkitamioto oloiboni naa ketiu neijia enkitamioto e ilo oikilikuanu,

English: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: peyie meitoki aekata enkaji e Israel aapuo aapong'ori aaing'uaa nanu, nemeitoki aaigil aaisarkionie ate too ng'ok enye pooki, kake pee etum aataa iltung'ana laainei, natum ataa nanu Enkai enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:

English: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani teneas enkop ing'ok aa nanu egilunore eas ine metii enkirukoto, naitorioki enkaina ai agilunore ninye, nagil ine netumie endaa nairriwaki ninye olameyu, nadung'oo te ninye tung'ani o eng'ues,

English: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: ore ninye naaji te kulo tung'ana okuni, Noa, o Daniel o Yakobo te netii atua, naa keitajeu ake enkishui enye maate te supatisho enye maate, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:
Masaai: “Tenaisho ing'uesi entim meima atua ina kop, neinyal ninye metaa mitil, metaa meetae oltung'ani oidim aima atua te nkaraki nena ng'uesi;

English: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
Masaai: o tenaa ketii duoo ninye lelo tung'ana pokira okuni atua, ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai meitajeu hoo nkayiok arashu intoyie, ninche ake enkorrok enye eitajeuni, kake keaku enkop mitil.

English: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:
Masaai: Arashu tenayau olalem shumata e ina kop, najo, inchoo olalem eim atua ina kop; nadung'oo te ninye tung'ani o eng'ues,

English: Though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
Masaai: ore hoo netii apa kulo tung'ana pokira okuni atua, ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, meitajeu hoo nkayiok arashu intoyie, kake ninche ake inkorroki enye eitajeuni.

English: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:
Masaai: Arashu tenairriu olmeitai atua ina kop, nabuku engoro ai napi abukoki shumata ninye tenebo osarge, pee adung'oo te ninye tung'ani o eng'ues;

English: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
Masaai: enyor duoo naa Noa otii, o Daniel o Yob atua ninye, ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, meitajueu hoo nkayiok arashu intoyie, enkishui enye ake eitajeu te supatisho enye.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
Masaai: “Amu neijia ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Kebaa elang tenairriwaki Yerusalem nena kitamiot aainei ong'uan enkiguana, olalem, olameyu, ing'uesi torrok o lmeitai, pee adung'oo tung'ani o eng'ues tiatua!

English: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, tenelo neing'uari tiatua ilooleku pee erik aaipang'ie ilayiok o ntoyie, tenepuo nepuonu enitii nidol inkoitoi enye o yasat enye, naa aikintagoli iyie teina torrono nayau shumata e Yerusalem, te nena pooki nayaua shumata ninye.

English: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa keitagol ninche intae, tinidolidolo inkoitoi enye o yasat enye; niyiolouu aajo eitu aas ina meeta enataasie pooki nataasa te ninye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:

English: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, kaji eiko enchata olchani loo sabibu tenegiroo te nkadori likae shani ake pooki, olng'osila lo sabibu otii atua ilkeek le ntim?

English: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
Masaai: Keyae enchata te ninye aaitobirie ae toki? Keya iltung'ana enchata te ninye aililiyie ake pooki girra?

English: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?
Masaai: Ng'ura, epiki ninye enkima metaa eilata enye; ore peyie emut enkima ineeiting'ie enyena pokira, ore empolos enye netumute, keitoki aata tipat tiae toki?

English: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for any work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
Masaai: Ing'ura, ore apa eton elulung'a ninye, nemeeta ae naitaasi; kebaa meeta tipat etumuta enkima ninye, keitoki aata tipat tiae toki.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: anaa enatiu ilkeek to olchani loo sabibu tiatua entim, ilo latipika enkima meitaa eilata, neaku neijia alo ake lelo oomanya Yerusalem.

English: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from one fire, and another fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set my face against them.
Masaai: Naa kaitorioki ninye enkomom ai agilunore ninche; hoo neilanyisho ninche aing'uaa enkima, kenya ina kima ninche amut; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani tenaitorioki ninche enkomom ai agilunore.

English: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa enkop mitil, amu etaa ninche ilemeeta enkirukoto, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ake ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii, ejo:

English: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intayiolo Yerusalem olminong lenye,

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan; thy father was an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
Masaai: nijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki Yerusalem: Ore entipat ino o einoto ino netii enkop oo Lkanaan; ore apa papaai lino naa Olamori, ore yieyio lino naa e Hiti.

English: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
Masaai: Ore te nkipirta e inoto ino, teina olong eitu edung'i osotua lino, neton eitu kisuji iyie te nkare neton eitu kiutuutieki emunyan, arashu kirridi too nkarash.

English: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
Masaai: Meetae obo liking'urrie iyie, pee eas embae nabo e kuna to lng'ur te nkaraki iyie; kake kitanang'akaki iyie ong'ata naisiasha, amu kinturrayioki, ina olong apa nikitoiwuoki iyie.

English: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee polluted in thine own blood, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live; yea, I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood, Live.
Masaai: “Ore peyie aim ine nitii iyie, naadol iyie ishuma tiatua osarge lino, naajoki iye tiatua osarge lino, taa oloishu,

English: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field, and thou hast increased and waxen great, and thou art come to excellent ornaments: thy breasts are fashioned, and thine hair is grown, whereas thou wast naked and bare.
Masaai: nibulu anaa enkaitubului e ong'ata nibulu niadoru abaiki enkiputakinoto enkaisiaayiani; netubulutua ilki linono, netubulutua ilpapit linono; nira ake emasipai nemeishopo.

English: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, behold, thy time was the time of love; and I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness: yea, I sware unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest mine.
Masaai: “Ore ina kata naim embata ine nitii naaing'or iyie, ing'ura, itaa apa olerisiori le nyorrata; naaisalaashaki iyie enkila ai, naitoipoo emasipaisho ino: ee naaliki ajoki ainosa olmumai te iyie nikintayu olning'o o iyie, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, niaku iyie olalai.

English: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I throughly washed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
Masaai: Naaitadoiki iyie enkare naisujaa osarge ilo liata, naael iyie te ilata.

English: I clothed thee also with broidered work, and shod thee with badgers' skin, and I girded thee about with fine linen, and I covered thee with silk.
Masaai: Aaishopo ake sii too nkilani naaikodo naishopoki iyie inamuka, naaishopoki iyie inkilani naapuyiapuy e katani naaitoip iyie te nkila napuyiapui.

English: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
Masaai: Naakus iyie too masaa, naishopoki iyie ilgiso inkaik inono, o olpisiai emurt ino.

English: And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.
Masaai: Naapik olgisoi enkume ino, naapik imuna nkiyiaa inono, napik emaupe enkitoo sidai endukuya ino.

English: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and broidered work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil: and thou wast exceeding beautiful, and thou didst prosper into a kingdom.
Masaai: Neaku neijia apa kinkunaki aakus te sahabu o te nkosholai, ore inkilani inono naa kitani napuyiapui sidai o enkila napuyiapui o enkila naikodo; ninos enkurma sidai tenebo enaisho o eilata. Nibulu asidanu oleng, nilotu abau enetii olkitok.

English: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore iyie niaku ningoti ti atua iloshon kumok te nkaraki enkishiaa ino, amu aisidai apa oleng eibulayie iloshon te nkaraki ina kishiaa naisul naaishopoko nanu iyie, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.
Masaai: “Kake isiliga iyie enkishiaa ino, nias ine nkiborra oo nkonyek te nkaraki nitoninge, nintubulaa enkiborra ino oo nkonyek te lelo likiimaa epuo.

English: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
Masaai: Iwaita embata oo nkilani inyi, nintobirakiki ate iwuejitin neeika, niasiasa inenkiborra oo nkonyek te nchumata enye; eitu aikata etumi inaanyaanyukie, nemeitokini aikata aatum.

English: Thou hast also taken thy fair jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given thee, and madest to thyself images of men, and didst commit whoredom with them,
Masaai: Iwaita sii kulikae soito le tipat laainei le sahabu o le nkosholai ai, lelo laaishoo iyie, nintobirakinye kewan inkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu oo ltung'ana, niasie ninche ine nkiborra oonkonyek;

English: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.
Masaai: niya inkilani inono naaikodo aitoipie ninche, nirragie eilata ai o enkorropil ai te dukuya ninche.

English: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and thus it was, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: O emukate ai sii, aaishoo iyie, aitotio iyie te nkurma napuyiapui o eilata o enaisho irragie te dukuya ninche metaa olgusil orropil, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Is this of thy whoredoms a small matter,
Masaai: Niya ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono, nena nikitoikio nanu, nintainye ninche olasar peyie emuti. Amaa isiaitin inono enkiborra oo nkonyek kenkiti toki apa

English: That thou hast slain my children, and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them?
Masaai: eji metaa iteyieng'a nkera aainei nintarasaa ninche anaa olasar te nkima aitaiki ninche?

English: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast polluted in thy blood.
Masaai: Ore to olminong lino pooki o te nkiborra ino oo nkonyek eitu idamu nena olong'i inono e kitisho, ina kata minchopo nira emasipai, itii atua osarge lino.

English: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD;)
Masaai: “Ore pee eish intorrok inono pooki (Woi, woi iyie! ejo Olaitoriani Enkai)

English: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee an high place in every street.
Masaai: iteshetaka kewan enkaji sidai, nintobiraki kewan ewueji neika too wuejitin pooki enkanasa, neesotoreki.

English: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy whoredoms.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya e pooki oitoi nalala e nkanasa nishetu ewueji nimborrie onyek esidano ino, nincho kewan pooki ng'ae ogiroo, niponaa esiaai ino enkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.
Masaai: Itaasa sii iyie esiaai enkiborra oo nkonyek too Lmisiri, tenebo lelo litashare oobore eng'uarrata, niponaa enkiborra oo nkonyek nikintagor nanu.

English: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.
Masaai: Ing'ura, metaa aitorioyie enkaina ai pee aagilunore iyie, naitong'oroo ina rubata nikinchooki iyie, naaitarasaki iyie ilo olubo loo lmang'ati linono, nena toyie oo Lfilisti, nena naatukurrutuate nkaraki olkuaak lino torrono.

English: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.
Masaai: Itaasa sii inenkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo ile Asiria, amu ira apa olemeraposho; ee nias inenkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo ninche, neton ake eitu iraposho.

English: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
Masaai: Intaa kumok isiaaitin inono enkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo ina kop e biashara enkop oo Ilkaldayo; ore ake sii tena neitu ake iraposho.

English: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
Masaai: “Kebaa emoyian enyorrata oltau lino, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, idol ajo itaasa kuna baa pooki isiaaitin naaijo osuyai enkiborra oo nkonyek;

English: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thine high place in every street; and hast not been as an harlot, in that thou scornest hire;
Masaai: nishetu inkajijik te dukuya pooki oitoi nalala enkanasa, nintobiru iwuejitin inono neeika too wuejitin pooki neetumoreki. Niminyaanyukie ake enkitok naibor onyek, amu itanya ing'amaa elaakinoto ole koisiaayio.

English: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
Masaai: Enkitok naibor onyek nang'amu ilomon terishata olpayian lenye!

English: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
Masaai: Eisho ilewa nkishorot ing'oruo pooki naibor onyek; kake inchoo iyie inkishorot inono lelo pooki linyor, irop ninche meetu ine nitii too nkaloli pooki te nkaraki isiaitin enkiborra oo nkonyek inono.

English: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.
Masaai: Metaa inyaanyukie apa iyie kulie kituaak te siaai ino enkiborra oo nkonyek, meeta olikitaaraka iyie taa enaibor onyek; nincho olekoisiaayio, eitu kinchori iyie olekoisiaayio; metaa ira iyie enapaashaa.

English: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
Masaai: “Neaku naa, iyie naibor onyek, toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore amu eibalunyeki enkurruna ino, neboluni emasipaisho ino ti atua enkiborra ino oo nkonyek tenebo isintan linono, o te nkaraki nena aitin inono pooki nemeishu, o te nkaraki ilo sarge loo nkera inono nena ninchoo ninche,

English: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
Masaai: neaku, ing'ura ekaiturrurru isintan linono pooki, lelo litishipakine lelo pooki linyor o lelo limbayie; ekaiturrurru ninche mikitaarare iyie too nkaloli pooki, naboloo emasipaisho ino eboloki ninche, pee etum aatodol emasipaisho ino pooki.

English: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.
Masaai: Naa kaaiguanare iyie anaa nkituaak naagil olning'o le nkiama neiguanareki ilooibukoo osarge, neyau shumata iyie ilo sarge lengoro napi o lom.

English: And I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and shall break down thy high places: they shall strip thee also of thy clothes, and shall take thy fair jewels, and leave thee naked and bare.
Masaai: Naa kaishooyo iyie apik inkaik oo sintan linono naa kasulaa ilgilat linono negil aauroo iwuejitin inono neeika, naa aikioru ninche iyie inkilani inono neya imasaa inono sidain, niking'uaa iyieira emasipai minchopo.

English: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
Masaai: Naa keyau ninche olorora likigilunore iyie, naa aikinang ninche iyie too soito nikidung ninche iyie aitaa ndung'udung'ot too lalema lenye.

English: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.
Masaai: Naa kepejoo nkajijik inyi neyau enkiguana shumata iyie te dukuya nkituaak kumok; naamitiki iyie pee mias esiai enkiborra oo nkonyek, nimintoki aikata aishoru olekoisiaayio.

English: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
Masaai: Metaa kaitaraposh engoro ai te iyie, neiwuang olom lai te iyie; kaaku nanu olobor, nemaitoki aigil agoro.

English: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.
Masaai: Ore amu eitu idamu nena olong'i e kitisho ino, kake kintagoro nanu oleng te kuna tokitin pooki; neaku ng'ura, kaitalaku sii nanu inkiaasin inono te shumata endukuya ino, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Keitu doi ias eloloito aitushulaki olminong lino pooki?

English: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying, As is the mother, so is her daughter.
Masaai: “Ing'ura ajo ore pooki ng'ae oasishore endung'et e rashe naa keasishore ena dung'et e rashe te nkaraki iyie, anaa enatiu ng'otonye, ‘Anaa enatiu entito.’

English: Thou art thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother was an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
Masaai: Ira iyie entito e yieyio lino, ina naiba olpayian lenye o nkera enyena; nira enkanashe oo nkanashera inono, nena naaiba ilpayiani lenye oo nkera enye, ore apa yieyio lino naa e Hiti ore papaailino naa Olamori.

English: And thine elder sister is Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
Masaai: Ore enkanashe ino botor naa Samaria, ina naboitare intoyie enyena te nkalo ino e moikuape; ore enkanashe ino kiti, ina namanya enkalo ino e kopikop naa Sodom tenebo intoyie enyena.

English: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
Masaai: Neitu ake kindip enkiimata oo nkoitoi enye arashu ias enatiu olminong lenye; ore te nkata kiti oleng nitarruoyie alang ninche too nkoitoi inono pooki.

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
