Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore enkanashe ino Sodom o ntoyie enyena eitu eas ninche anaa ina nitaasa iyie o intoyie inono.

English: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
Masaai: Ing'ura, ena apa entorroni naata enkanashe ino Sodom: ore ninye tenebo ntoyie enyena neeta olwuasa, o endaa sapuk, o embularoto metii engoloto, kake eitu eretu lelo aisinak o lemeeta toki.

English: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before me: therefore I took them away as I saw good.
Masaai: Ekewuasa apa ninche, netaasa imbaa olminong te dukuya nanu; neaku aiwuang'ie nanu ninche, ina kata nadol ninye.

English: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done.
Masaai: Eitu eas Samaria olpisiai loo ng'ok inono; itaasa intae imbaa kumok olminong aalang ninche, nintaa nkanashera inyi inaalioo aa supati ti atua nena baa pooki olminong nitaasa.

English: Thou also, which hast judged thy sisters, bear thine own shame for thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they: they are more righteous than thou: yea, be thou confounded also, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
Masaai: Tanapa esulare ino, iyie sii, amu iyopiruo enkiguana sidai too nkanashera inono; te nkaraki ing'ok inono nena nitaasa te ntorroni oleng alang ninche, etisipa ninche aalang iyie. Metaa tukurru, iyie sii, ninap esulare ino makewan, amu intaa nkanashera inono inemeeta entioto.

English: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
Masaai: “Ekashuku aiturrurru emunyani enye, emunyani e Sodom tenebo ntoyie enyena, o emunyani e Samaria tenebo ntoyie enyena, naa kashuku emunyani inyi ti atua ninche,

English: That thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be confounded in all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
Masaai: peyie itumutumu aatanap esulare inyi nikurrurru te pooki nitaasa, niyakuku enkilejilej te ninche.

English: When thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
Masaai: Ore too nkanashera inono, Sodom tenebo intoyie enyena naa kerrinyokino eneikununo apa te dukuya, ore Samaria o ntoyie enyena nerrinyo eneikununo apa te dukuya; ore iyie tenebo ntoyie inono naa irrinyokino eninkununo apa.

English: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride,
Masaai: Amaa apa enkanashe ino Sodom keitu eipoti tenkutuk ino teina olong apa olwuasa lino,

English: Before thy wickedness was discovered, as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria, and all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, which despise thee round about.
Masaai: eton eitu eboluni intorrok inono? Indipa taata atotiu anaa ninye entoki nadol esulare too ntoyie e Edom o lelatia enye pooki, o too ntoyie oo Lfilisti, lelo pooki likimanita likimenaa iyie.

English: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Inap iyie enkitamioto eloloito ino, tenebo olminong lino, ejo Olaitoriani.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
Masaai: “Ee, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaitaas iyie anaa ina nitaasa, ilo otemenayie ilo mumai agil ilo ning'o lo sotua.

English: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
Masaai: Kake kadamu osotua lai tenebo iyie too nkolong'i e kitisho ino, naa kaitasheyie te iyie olning'o lai lo sotua loo ntarasi.

English: Then thou shalt remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder and thy younger: and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not by thy covenant.
Masaai: Ina peyie ilotu adamu inkoitoi inono nikurru tenaya nkanashera inono, nkanashera inono botoro o nkutiti, naaisho ninche iyie anaa ntoyie, kake mme te nkaraki ilo sotua tenebo iyie.

English: And I will establish my covenant with thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD:
Masaai: Ekaitasheyie osotua lai tenebo iyie, naa iyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani,

English: That thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame, when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: peyie itum atadamu nimputukuny, nimintoki aekata abol enkutuk ino te nkaraki enkurruna ino, tenaapalaki iyie nena pooki nitaasa, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu ejo:

English: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, tolimu oloyiote niro enkitanyaanyukoto airorie enkaji e Israel;

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; A great eagle with great wings, longwinged, full of feathers, which had divers colours, came unto Lebanon, and took the highest branch of the cedar:
Masaai: tiaaki inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Eewuo olkurragos sapuk oota naipuko sapuki o nkopir naado too naipuko, nebore esidano oomuain kumok, nelotu Lebanon negil ilukuny ooltarakua;

English: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.
Masaai: negilu ilukuny oo ltarakua nena lukuny enye naaipilipil aya ninche enkop namirishoreki, nepik enkanasa oo lbiasharani.

English: He took also of the seed of the land, and planted it in a fruitful field; he placed it by great waters, and set it as a willow tree.
Masaai: Neitoki aya lelo anterera leina kop neun ninche te nterit napir; nepik ninye embata oo nkariak sapuki; Neitasheyie ninye anaa Enkaitubului nabulu,

English: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.
Masaai: nebulu ninye neaku osabibu oti oisalaashari, nerrinyokino ninye ilng'osil lenyena, ore ntona enyena nebik teine neitasheyie ninye. Metaa etaa ninye olchani lo sabibu, neiu ninye ilng'osil kumok neitayu ntapuka.

English: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.
Masaai: “Kake etii apa likae kurragos sapuk oata inaipuko sapuki naa sidai oleng emua; naa ng'ura, idol ilo shani lo sabibu neitorioki ntona enyena ninye peyie etum ninye atipika enkare ninye. Ore teine apa netuunieki ninye,

English: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
Masaai: neitoki ninye aun ninye te nterit sidai natii inkariak sapuki, peyie etum atoiu ilng'osil neiu ilng'anayio, neaku olchani lo sabibu le nkitoo.

English: Say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Shall it prosper? shall he not pull up the roots thereof, and cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring, even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof.
Masaai: Tejo, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: kebulaa ninye? Aimedotu ninye ntona enyena nedung'oo ilng'osil lenyena, neaku ore nena pilipil enyena ng'ejuko oo mbenek netoyu? Meya enkaina nagol oo ltung'ana kumok peyie edotuni ninye too ntona enyena.

English: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? it shall wither in the furrows where it grew.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore teneitokini aaun kebulaa ninye? Aimetoyu katukul teneosh enkijape oo loo saen ninye, netoyu teine netuunieki ninye?”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii ejo,

English: Say now to the rebellious house, Know ye not what these things mean? tell them, Behold, the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem, and hath taken the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and led them with him to Babylon;
Masaai: “Tiaki taata ina aji kiserut, Aimiyiolo enautu kuna baa? Toliki ninche tiaki, ng'ura, eewuo olaiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem, neya laiguanak lenyena tenebo ilkituaak lenyena neyaki ninche ninye te Babilon.

English: And hath taken of the king's seed, and made a covenant with him, and hath taken an oath of him: he hath also taken the mighty of the land:
Masaai: Neya olantererai obo le nkitoo neitayunye olning'o o ninye, nepik ninye abori olmumai. (Ore iltung'ana kituaak leina kop oowa ninye aitung'uaa enkop,

English: That the kingdom might be base, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand.
Masaai: peyie etumi aaitoborro ina kitoo nemeitoki ailepie kewan shumata, neaku teneibung olning'o lenye neidim aitasho.)

English: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? or shall he break the covenant, and be delivered?
Masaai: Kake eisero ninye eirriwaki ilbalusuni le Misiri, peyie etum ninche ninche aaishoo mbartan o enjore kitok. Keidim ninye aisula? Keidim oltung'ani ailanyisho oas nena baa? Keidim atigila olning'o neitoki ake ailanyisho?

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he brake, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
Masaai: Anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa ore teine wueji nemanya olaiguanani ilo oitaaki ninye olaiguanani, ilo otanya olmumai lenye, ilo otigila osotua lenye tenebo ninye, te Babilon elo eninye aye.

English: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war, by casting up mounts, and building forts, to cut off many persons:
Masaai: Ore Farao tenebo enjore enye kitok tenebo enkumoi enye meidim aataretu ninye to larrabal, ina kata nanang'ari inkang'itie nemani aamuat isunta naateshetaki peyie edung'oo enkishui oo lkumok.

English: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
Masaai: Ore amu etemenayie ninye ilo mumai, negil olning'o, neishoo enkaina enye metaasa ake kuna baa pooki, meimisho ninye.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely mine oath that he hath despised, and my covenant that he hath broken, even it will I recompense upon his own head.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore anaa enaishu nanu, esipa katukul ajo ore olmumai lai otemenayie ninye, osotua lai otigila ninye, ekaikilikuanu ninye te lukunya enye.

English: And I will spread my net upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his trespass that he hath trespassed against me.
Masaai: Ekaisalaashaki ninye orreshet lai, naa keyae ninye Babilon najing atua enkiguana tenebo ninye teine te nkaraki ina taboi nataasa aagilunore nanu.

English: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Ore lelo arikok le njore enye, nebatata to lalem, ore lelo ooleku neidapashakini pooki shoto naimu enkijape; naayiolou ajo nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore nanu enkorrok ai naa kaitayu elukunya oltarakuai oodo, naitayu ninye aipang'ie; nagilu te ntopij, elukunya enye elukunya embeneyioi, naa idol nanu naa kaun ninye te nchumata entopij eine neeika aisul oldoinyio;

English: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it: and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a goodly cedar: and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
Masaai: ore te nchumata oldoinyio le Israel naa kaun ninye peyie etum atoiu ilng'osil neiu ilng'anayio, neaku oltarakuai kitok; ore tiabori enye nemany impukunot pooki oo ng'uesi; ore to loip loo lng'osil lenyena ore impukunot pooki oo motonyi neponari aaisho.

English: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I the LORD have spoken and have done it.
Masaai: Neyiolou ilkeek pooki liong'ota aajo nanu Olaitoriani oitadoyio lelo keek adoru, naitubulu aitoodor lelo keek dorropu, naitoi lelo keek oonyori, naitonyorij lelo keek ootoito. nanu Olaitoriani oiroro naa kaas ina.

English: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani aigil alotu enatii ejo:

English: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
Masaai: “Ainyoo eutu ena ningil ena dung'et e rashe te nkop e Israel, ‘Einosa iloopapa isabibu ooisuijo, ore ilala loo nkera nenoto enkisuijo?’

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore ena dung'et e rashe mintokiki aikata aasishore te Israel.

English: Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine: the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
Masaai: Ing'ura, ore iltauja pooki naa ilaainei; o ltau sii le papa anaa enatiu oltau le nkerai olalai sii ninye: ore oltau pooki oas ing'ok naa keye.

English: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
Masaai: “Tenaa supat oltung'ani neas ina supat naishiaakino

English: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour's wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,
Masaai: tenemedaa too ldoinyo arashu edumu inkonyek enyena aing'or nena aitin nemeishu enkaji e Israel, nemeisarkionie enkitok olelatia enye arashu elo enetii enkitok te nkata enye oloirerio,

English: And hath not oppressed any, but hath restored to the debtor his pledge, hath spoiled none by violence, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
Masaai: nemeirony hoo likae tung'ani, kake elaaki ilo oota esile elaata enye, nemeas inenkikonya, neisho emukate enye lelo oota esumash neitoip olemeeta enkila te nkila,

English: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
Masaai: nemeisilenoo eponaa arashu eya pooki ponaroto, neibooyo enkaina enye aitung'uaa ntorrok, nedung enkiguana nasipa terishata oltung'ani o likae

English: Hath walked in my statutes, and hath kept my judgments, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: nelo too nkitanapat aainei neing'or oleng agolie nkitanapat aainei, naa supat ninye, eketon ninye eishu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,
Masaai: “Teneiu ninye olayioni laa olaikonyani, olaibukoroni lo sarge, ilo lemeas nabo e kuna siaitin,

English: And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour's wife,
Masaai: kake edaa te kulo doinyo, neisarkionie enkitok olelatia enye,

English: Hath oppressed the poor and needy, hath spoiled by violence, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
Masaai: neirony lelo aisinak o lelo oota enyamali, neas ine nkikonya, nemeiteng'el ilo mumai, nedumu nkonyek enyena adumaki inkaitin nemeishu, neas imbususi,

English: Hath given forth upon usury, and hath taken increase: shall he then live? he shall not live: he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him.
Masaai: neisilenoo te mponaroto neya emponaroto; keitoki pasa aton eishu? Meitoki ninye aton eishu. Etaasa ninye kuna baa pooki olminong, meeta nchere aimeye, naa ore osarge lenye neaku shumata enyeetii.

English: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father's sins which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
Masaai: “Kake teneiu ele tung'ani enkayioni nadol nena ng'ok pooki naataasa papaai lenye, neureishoyu, nemeas nena naataasa

English: That hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour's wife,
Masaai: nemedaa too nchumat oo ldoinyo arashu edumu inkonyek enyena adumaki nkaitin nemeishu enkaji e Israel, nemeisarkionie enkitok olelatia enye

English: Neither hath oppressed any, hath not withholden the pledge, neither hath spoiled by violence, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
Masaai: nemeinyal likae tung'ani, neshuku ina nainosie olmumai elulung'a nemeas inenkikonya, kake eisho endaa enye lelo oota esumash neishopoki lelo lemeishopo enkila,

English: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
Masaai: neibooyo enkaina pee meas intorrok, nemeya ina naponari arashu eponaa, neing'or ajurru irrekiei laainei, nelo ti atua nkitanapat aainei; nemeye ninye too ng'ok e papaai lenye; meeta nchere peemeton eishu.

English: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, spoiled his brother by violence, and did that which is not good among his people, lo, even he shall die in his iniquity.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki papaai lenye, amu eitamoo kewan imbaa enkiba, neikony olalashe lenye, neas ina neme sidai ti atua iltung'ana lenyena, ing'ura, keye ninye te nkaraki ing'ok enye.

English: Yet say ye, Why? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all my statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
Masaai: “Nijo ake, ‘Ainyoo peyie menyamalu ilo ayioni too ng'ok e menye?’ Teneas olayioni ina naishiaakino nesipa, netujurruo oleng inkitanapat aainei, metaa nchere pee meton eishu.

English: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
Masaai: Ore oltau oas eng'oki naa keye. Menyamalu olayioni te nkaraki ing'ok e menye, arashu enyamalu menye te nkaraki ing'ok o layioni lenye; ore esupatisho osupat neton te shumata e ilo oota, ore entorroni e ilo torrono netonie shumata ninye.

English: But if the wicked will turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all my statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Masaai: “Kake teneibelekenyunye ilo torrono too ntorrok enyena pooki naataasa neibung inkitanapat aainei neas ina naishiaakino nesipa, meeta nchere pee meton eishu; nemee ninye.

English: All his transgressions that he hath committed, they shall not be mentioned unto him: in his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
Masaai: Meetae entorroni enye nabo naataasa naitokini aadamu te nkaraki ninye; ore tesupatisho nataasa nemeeta nchere, meton eishu.

English: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD: and not that he should return from his ways, and live?
Masaai: Kaatayie nanu enchipai keeya e ilo torrono, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, neme nchere pee eibelekenya ninye te nkoitoi enye neton eishu?

English: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
Masaai: Kake teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa ina supatisho enye neas ing'ok neas nena bususi olminong pooki naasita ilo tung'ani torrono, keidim atotona eishu ninye? Meetae nabo oo siaitin naataasa supati naitokini aadamu; amu ore te nkitapong'oto nataayie ninye olarruoni o te ngoki nataasa ninye, naa kee.

English: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
Masaai: “Nijo ake, ‘Ore ina oitoi Olaitoriani nemesipa!’ Inining'o tena kata, iyie naaji e Israeli: Amaa enkoitoi ai aimesipa? Aime inkoitoi inyi nemesipa?

English: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and dieth in them; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
Masaai: Ore teneibelekenya oltung'ani supat aing'uaa esupatisho enye, neas ing'ok, naa keye te nkaraki ina; keye te nkaraki ina ng'oki nataasa.

English: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
Masaai: Ake sii, ore teneibelekenyunye oltung'ani aing'uaa nena torrok naataasa neas ina naishiaakino nesipa, naa keitajeu enkishui enye.

English: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Masaai: Amu etujurruo neibelekenyunye aing'uaa ntorrok pooki naataasa, meeta nchere peyie meton eishu, meye ninye.

English: Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?
Masaai: Nejoito ake enkaji e Israel, ‘Ore enkoitoi o Laitoriani nemesipa!’ Iyie na aji e Israel, amaa nkoitoi aainei aimesipa? Aime nkoitoi inono nemesipa?

English: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
Masaai: “Metaa ekaaiguanare iyie, iyie na aji e Israel, pooki ng'ae te risioroto oo inkoitoi enyena, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Irridu nimbelekenya aing'uaa intorrok inono pooki, arashu eyaku ing'ok inono enkidaaroto ino.

English: Cast away from you all your transgressions, whereby ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit: for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
Masaai: Taarai intung'uai kewan intorrok pooki nena nitaasa kigilunore nanu, nitumokiki ate oltau ng'ejuk o enkiyang'et ng'ejuk! Ainyoo peyie iye naaji e Israel?

English: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD: wherefore turn yourselves, and live ye.
Masaai: Amu maata enchipai e keeya e pooki ng'ae ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; metaa imbelekenyunye pee inchu.”

English: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
Masaai: Ore iyie tudumu enkishirata adumaki ilkituaak le Israel,

English: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
Masaai: nijo: Kaa lipong apa olng'atuny ng'utunyi ti atua ilng'atunyo! Eitubulua ing'atunyo kutiti ti atua ilng'atunyo.

English: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
Masaai: Eitubulua nabo oo ng'atunyo enyena, neaku oloti ng'atuny, neitamok kewan eneiko teneibung ing'uesi, neinos ninye iltung'ana.

English: The nations also heard of him; he was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore iloreren nening'oo ninche, nerreshi ninye te ngumoto enye neyau ninche ninye too lala oogamishoreki, aayau enkop e Misiri.

English: Now when she saw that she had waited, and her hope was lost, then she took another of her whelps, and made him a young lion.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ng'otonye ajo eisulieki, netaa eiting'o osiligi lenye, neya ninye likae kuoo, too lkuoo lenyena, neitaa oloti ng'atuny.

English: And he went up and down among the lions, he became a young lion, and learned to catch the prey, and devoured men.
Masaai: Neloolo ninye ti atua ilng'atunyo, neaku oloti ng'atuny; neitayiolo kewan eneiko teneibung ing'uesi; neinos iltung'ana.

English: And he knew their desolate palaces, and he laid waste their cities; and the land was desolate, and the fulness thereof, by the noise of his roaring.
Masaai: Nemut aidaikie isempewueti lenye, neitomijooni inkanas enye; ore enkop neiputukuny o lelo pooki oomanya ninye, to ltoilo lenkikurrukur enye.

English: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him: he was taken in their pit.
Masaai: Ina peyie edumakino ninye iloreren aarare ninye, nepik irresheta pooki alo; neisalaashaki orreshet lenye shumata enye; neyae ninye atua engumoto enye.

English: And they put him in ward in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon: they brought him into holds, that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
Masaai: Ore too lala oololo nepiki ninye osanduku, oibung'ieki nenapieki ing'uesi neyakini ninye olaiguanani le Babilon; nenapi ninye atua ewueji neikenorieki, peyie meitokini aekata aaning oltoilo lenye, te shumata lelo doinyo le Israel.

English: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood, planted by the waters: she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters.
Masaai: Etiu apa ng'utunyi anaa osabibu le nkurma, otuunokoki embata enkare, oiu ilng'anayio nebore sii ilng'osil, te nkaraki enkare sapuk.

English: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches, and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches.
Masaai: Ore enchata enye empolos neaku eng'udi olaiguanani; etubulua ninye alus pooki, ti atua nenen neesur oo lng'osil; nedoli enkadori enye, ti atua enkumoi oo lng'osil lenyena.

English: But she was plucked up in fury, she was cast down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit: her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire consumed them.
Masaai: Kake etadotuoki olchani lo sabibu te ngoro napi, aanang'aki enkop, ore olkutati loo loo saen neitoi ninye; ore ilng'anayio lenyena nedung'ori, ore entonata o lchani ogol neitoi, nemut ninye enkima aidaikie.

English: And now she is planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.
Masaai: Enyaakaki taata aaun to lpurkel, te nkop natoyio neeta enkure.

English: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches, which hath devoured her fruit, so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule. This is a lamentation, and shall be for a lamentation.
Masaai: Neshomo enkima aing'uaa entonata enye, nemut ilng'osil lenyena olng'anayio, metaa metii enetelekua te ninye teina tonata nagol, nemeetae eng'udi o laiguanani. Ore ena naa enkishirata, netaa enkishirata.

English: And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, the tenth day of the month, that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the LORD, and sat before me.
Masaai: Ore to lari le naapishana, to lapa le imiet te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nepuonu embata oo lpayiani le Israel aaikilikuanu mbaa to Laitoriani, netoni te dukuya nanu.

English: Then came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, speak unto the elders of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye come to enquire of me? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, irorie ilpayiani le Israel nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ainanu ipuonunu aaikilikuanishore pee ietuo? Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, mikinkilikuanishorere nanu.

English: Wilt thou judge them, son of man, wilt thou judge them? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers:
Masaai: Aiminguanare iyie ninche, enkerai e tung'ani, aiminguanare iyie ninche? Ina pee inchosho ninche metayiolo olminong loo loo menye lenye,

English: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when I chose Israel, and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob, and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt, when I lifted up mine hand unto them, saying, I am the LORD your God;
Masaai: nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong apa nategelua Israel, nanya olmumai teina ishoi e nkaji e Yakobo, naitayiolo kewan ninche te ina kop e Misiri, ainosa apa olmumai teninche ajo, Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them, to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands:
Masaai: Ore teina olong nainosa olmumai te nkaraki ninche inchere kayau ninche aitupuku te ina kop e Misiri aya ninche ina kop naing'uraka ninche, enkop naruko kule o enaisho, enkop sidai aisul too nkuapi pooki.

English: Then said I unto them, Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninche, entayu enturrai intokitin torrok naadaare nkonyek inyi, pooki ng'ae te intae, nimintokiki aaisarkionie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu e Misiri; Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake etaa ninche kiseruti te nanu nemaaning nanu; eitu eitayu aipang'ie ong'ata pooki tung'ani intokitin torrok naaingor nkonyek enye neitu eiturraa nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu e Misiri. “Amu atadamua nanu ajo kabukoki engoro ai napi shumata ninche, naishoru engoro ai aarare ninche ti atua enkop e Misiri.

English: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they were, in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake ataasa enataasa te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki te dukuya iloreren lelo oomanya atua, lelo laibalakinye kewan edolita aitupuku ninche teina kop e Misiri.

English: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt, and brought them into the wilderness.
Masaai: Metaa atorikoyie ninche aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri nayau ninche atua olpurkel.

English: And I gave them my statutes, and shewed them my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them.
Masaai: Naisho ninche nkiguanat aainei naitodol ninche nkitanapat aainei, laa ore pooki tung'ani ogolie asuj ninche, neton eishu.

English: Moreover also I gave them my sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am the LORD that sanctify them.
Masaai: Ore ake sii aishoo ninche isabatoni aainei, anaa olmonekie te rishata ai o ninche, peyie etum aatayiolo aajo nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny ninche.

English: But the house of Israel rebelled against me in the wilderness: they walked not in my statutes, and they despised my judgments, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; and my sabbaths they greatly polluted: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
Masaai: Kake ore enkaji e Israel netaa kiseruti te nanu to lpurkel, eitu ninche epuoyie nkiguanat aainei kake etanyaita nkitanapat aainei, naa tenesuj oltung'ani ninche neton eishu; ore isabatoni aainei neisarkionie oleng. “Ina peyie adamu ajo kabuku engoro ai abukoki shumata ninche to lpurkel peyie atum aishie ninche tukul.

English: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, in whose sight I brought them out.
Masaai: Kake ataasishe te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki ninye te dukuya iloreren, laa ninche aitupukunye ninche edolita.

English: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them, flowing with milk and honey, which is the glory of all lands;
Masaai: Ore ake sii nainosa olmumai te nkaraki ninche to lpurkel inchere mayau ninche ina kop naishoo ninche, enkop naruko kule o enaisho, enkop naisul te sidano,

English: Because they despised my judgments, and walked not in my statutes, but polluted my sabbaths: for their heart went after their idols.
Masaai: ore amu etanyaita ninche nkiguanat aainei neitu epuoyie ninche nkitanapat aainei, neisarkionie isabatoni aainei; amu etusuja iltauja lenye nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them, neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, eing'urrie enkong'u ai ninche, neaku eitu amut ninche aidaikie arashu aiting'ie ninche tiong'ota.

English: But I said unto their children in the wilderness, Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers, neither observe their judgments, nor defile yourselves with their idols:
Masaai: “Najoki nanu nkera enye tiong'ota, emipuoyie nena kitanapat o loo papaai linyi, arashu isujusuju inkiguanat enye, arashu indurukiekie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu.

English: I am the LORD your God; walk in my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them;
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; enchomie nkitanapat aainei ning'oring'oro oleng aajurru nkiguanat aainei,

English: And hallow my sabbaths; and they shall be a sign between me and you, that ye may know that I am the LORD your God.
Masaai: niyanyititi isabatoni aainei peyie etum aataa olmonekie te rishata ai o intae, peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi.

English: Notwithstanding the children rebelled against me: they walked not in my statutes, neither kept my judgments to do them, which if a man do, he shall even live in them; they polluted my sabbaths: then I said, I would pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.
Masaai: Kake ore nena kera kiseruti te nanu; eitu ninche epuoyie nkiguanat aainei, neitu ejurru aaing'or inkiguanat aainei, naa te njurrunoto najurruni eishu oltung'ani; eisarkionie ninche isabatoni aainei. “Ina peyie adamu ajo kairriu engoro ai napi shumata ninche naitorioki engoro ai agilunore ninche ti ong'ota.

English: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand, and wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen, in whose sight I brought them forth.
Masaai: Kake aibooyie nanu enkaina ai, naasisho te nkaraki enkarna ai, peyie meisarkionieki ninye te dukuya iloreren, laa too nkonyek enye eipang'unye nanu ninche.

English: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the heathen, and disperse them through the countries;
Masaai: Ore ake sii ainosie ninche olmumai tiong'ata inchere ekaisardakie ninche ti atua iloreren naidapashaa ninche too nkuapi,

English: Because they had not executed my judgments, but had despised my statutes, and had polluted my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' idols.
Masaai: amu eitu eas ninche nkiguanat aainei, kake etanyaita nkitanapat aainei neisarkionie isabatoni aainei, ore nkonyek enye neitoriokino nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu oo loo menye.

English: Wherefore I gave them also statutes that were not good, and judgments whereby they should not live;
Masaai: Ore ake eyia naishoo ninche nkitanapat nena nemesidain o nkiguanat naa te ninche meidim aanoto enkishui;

English: And I polluted them in their own gifts, in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb, that I might make them desolate, to the end that they might know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: naisarkionie nanu ninche te nena kishorot enye, aisho ninche meishooi to lasar le nkima lelo ilkikaunot lenye, pee atum aituria ninche; ataasa nanu ina pee etum ninche aatayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Therefore, son of man, speak unto the house of Israel, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me, in that they have committed a trespass against me.
Masaai: “Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, irorie enkaji e Israel nijoki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ake sii, nena ae toki naatamorie iloo papaai linyi, amu eitarruoitie ninche te dukuya nanu.

English: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
Masaai: Ore apa peyie ariku ninche ina kop apa nainosie olmumai ajo kaisho ninche, neaku ore pooki doinyo oodo odol arashu olchani ake ninye pooki oota mbenek, neishooyo ninche teine ilasarri lenye, neitarasaa ninche teine iolasar le ngoro; neirriwaa teine olasar le ngoro ooki.

English: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
Masaai: (Najoki nanu ninche, koree ine wueji neika nipuopuo? Neaku keji enkarna e ine Bama o metabaiki ena olong.)

English: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
Masaai: Neaku naa tiaaki enkaji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Indurukiekie ate anaa enaikuna iloo papaai linyi nipong'oriri aasuj nena tokitin enye naaiduruk?

English: For when ye offer your gifts, when ye make your sons to pass through the fire, ye pollute yourselves with all your idols, even unto this day: and shall I be enquired of by you, O house of Israel? As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will not be enquired of by you.
Masaai: Ore tinintayuyu inkishorot inyi nintayuyu inkera inyi too lasarri le nkima, nindurukiekie ate too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi nemeishu pooki o ena olong. Naa aikindimidimi intae aaikilikuanishore nanu, na aji e Israel? Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, mikinkilikuanishorere intae nanu.

English: And that which cometh into your mind shall not be at all, that ye say, We will be as the heathen, as the families of the countries, to serve wood and stone.
Masaai: “Ore ina natii indamunot inyi nemeaku ae kata ina damunoto, ‘Matotiu anaa iloreren anaa iloshon loo nkuapi, nikiserem inkeek o soito.’

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
Masaai: “Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, esipa te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o te ngoro natubukuoki, kaaku nanu Olaiguanani te shumata iyie.

English: And I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered, with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.
Masaai: Ekaaitayu iyie aitupuku tiatua iloreren naiturrurru intae aitung'uaa nkuapi nena nindapashakinote, te nkaina magilani o te nkaina naitoriori, o te ngoro nabukuni,

English: And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.
Masaai: naa kayau nanu intae ongota too loshon, najing te ine enkiguana tenebo intae king'ura too nkomomi.

English: Like as I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I plead with you, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Anaa enatijinga enkiguana tenebo iloo papaai linyi tiong'ota enkop e Misiri, naa kajing enkiguana tenebo intae, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And I will cause you to pass under the rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant:
Masaai: Ekaimie intae abori eng'udi, naisho intae entijing atua te nkikena.

English: And I will purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me: I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ekaisujaa lelo kiseruti tiatua intae, o lelo ooas intorrok aagilunore nanu; ekaitupuku ninche te ina kop nashomo kake mejing ninche enkop e Israel. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: As for you, O house of Israel, thus saith the Lord GOD; Go ye, serve ye every one his idols, and hereafter also, if ye will not hearken unto me: but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts, and with your idols.
Masaai: “Ore te iyie, iyie naaji e Israel, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Shomo pooki ng'ae isiayia inkaitin oo nkitanyaanyukot inono nemeishu, tenakata o te siadi ena, tinimikining'ining'i nanu; kake ore enkarna ai sinyati mintokiki aikata aaisarkionie too nkishorot inyi oo nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu.

English: For in mine holy mountain, in the mountain of the height of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, there shall all the house of Israel, all of them in the land, serve me: there will I accept them, and there will I require your offerings, and the firstfruits of your oblations, with all your holy things.
Masaai: “Amu ore te shumata oldoinyo lai sinyati, too nchumat oo ldonyo le Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, teine aaisiai enkaji pooki e Israel pooki ng'ae, akaaisiaiai nanu teina kop; naa kang'amaa nanu ninche te ine, naa teine aikilikuanu inkishorot inyi o ntokitin sidain oo nkishorot inyi, tenebo lasarri linyi oosinya.

English: I will accept you with your sweet savour, when I bring you out from the people, and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen.
Masaai: Anaa esong'uana narropil ekang'amaa intae, ina kata naitupuku intae too loreren, naiturrurru intae aitung'uaa nena kuapi pooki naaidapashakaki intae; naa kaibalunye esinyatisho ai tiatua intae edolita iloreren pooki.

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall bring you into the land of Israel, into the country for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to your fathers.
Masaai: Niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nayau intae enkop e Israel, ina kop apa nainosie iloo papaai linyi olmumai ajo kaisho ninche

English: And there shall ye remember your ways, and all your doings, wherein ye have been defiled; and ye shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for all your evils that ye have committed.
Masaai: ore teine naa idamumu inkoitoi inyi o pooki nitaasa te nena nindurukie ate, naa igorokinono ate te pooki torrono nitaasa.

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have wrought with you for my name's sake, not according to your wicked ways, nor according to your corrupt doings, O ye house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa iyiolouu inchere ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naitaas intae ina te nkaraki enkarna ai, neme te nkaraki inkoitoi inyi torrok neme te nkaraki isiaaitin inyi torrok, iyie naaji e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop thy word toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e kopikop tolikioi ororei tigilunore kopikop,

English: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
Masaai: nimbonoki agilunore entim e nkop e Negeb ijoki: entim e Negeb toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ing'ura ekaainuaaki iyie enkima, naa kemut pooki shani onyori otii atuaiyie o pooki shani otoyio; ore olang'a le nkima nemearaiyu, ore inkomomi pooki eiteru te kopikop o metabaiki moikuape naa keilang ninye.

English: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
Masaai: Ore iseseni pooki naa kedol aajo nanu Olaitoriani oinuaa ninye nemeari ninye.”

English: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
Masaai: Ina peyie ajo, “Aha Olaitoriani Enkai! aajoki ninche nanu, ‘Aime Olaitoriani ele loo nkitanyaanyukot too nkatinin?’ ”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop thy word toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e Yerusalem niliki ororei aarare nena wuejitin sinyat; imbonoki tigilunore enkop e Israel

English: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I am against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
Masaai: nijoki ina kop e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Ing'ura ekaarare iyie, naa kaaitorioki iyie olalem lashutu te nchashur enye, nadung'oo tiatua iyie lelo supati o ltorrok.

English: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
Masaai: Ore amu kadung'oo te iyie lelo supati o lelo torrok, neaku kepuku olalem lai aing'uaa enchashur enye aarare iltung'ana pooki eiteru te kopikop o meshomo moikuape;

English: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
Masaai: neyiolou iltung'ana pooki aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani otushutua olalem lai te nchashur; nemeitokini aaigil aashukoki olalem enchashur.

English: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of thy loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
Masaai: Iyagie naa, enkerai e tung'ani; iyagie oltau omu eeta osina to ltau le mion te dukuya nkonyek enye.

English: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak as water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa tinikinkilikuan ninche aajoki, ‘Ainyoo peyie iyagie?’ naa ijoki, ‘Te nkaraki lelo kiliku oopuonu. Ore peyie ebau, naa kelepori pooki tau ore nkaik pooki naa keshalu, ore pooki tau neiterre neshalu nkung pooki anaa enkare. Ing'ura, ajo elotu naa keitabari ninye.’ ” Ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,

English: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo, Ena ejo Olaitoriani: Olalem, eiyioki olalem, neiutuutoki aasik,

English: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, as every tree.
Masaai: aaii tenkaraki eyieng'are, netisikaki meimerlela anaa enkiwuang'ata! Arashu aikintobiru enkuenia? Itemenayie eng'udi, enkerai ai, o pooki toki e nchata.

English: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
Masaai: Metaa eishooyioki olalem metisiki, peyie etumi aaibung'a neiyioki nesiki, peyie etumi aatipik ina aina oloyieng'isho.

English: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it shall be upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon thy thigh.
Masaai: Inchira niyietu nakerai e tung'ani, amu kegilunore ninye iltung'ana laainei; kegilunore ninye iltung'ana pooki kituaak le Israel; etipikaki ninche pooki olalem tenebo iltung'ana laainei. Toosho naa enkupes ino.

English: Because it is a trial, and what if the sword contemn even the rod? it shall be no more, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Amu meaku ninye entemata kaa eas ninye tinimenaa iyie engudi?” ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite thine hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it is the sword of the great men that are slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
Masaai: “Imbonisho naa, enkerai e tung'ani, toosho inkaik inono nincho olalem meeu adou katitin are, ee kat uni, ilo alem le lelo ooari metuata; olalem leyieng'are kitok, laa ninye oman ninche,

English: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that their heart may faint, and their ruins be multiplied: ah! it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter.
Masaai: peyie etum iltauja lenye aatalepori, nebatata ilkumok too nkishomin enye. Aishorua ilo alem oimerlel; Aha! eitobiruno ninye anaa enkiwuang'ata, netisikaki peyie etum ateyiengisho.

English: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
Masaai: Tudung'o oleng tatene o kedienye ine wueji netuutakaki enepi olalem.

English: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said it.
Masaai: Ekaosh sii nanu nkaik aainei, naa kaitaraposh engoro ai; nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enatii naajoki:

English: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose it at the head of the way to the city.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, tuutu inkoitoi are tenkaraki ilo alem le ilo aiguanani le Babilon olotu; epuonu pokira are teina kop. Nintobiriri embao nautu eneimi, nipik ninye dukuya ina oitoi nalo enkanasa;

English: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
Masaai: tuutu enkoitoi naim ilo alem alo Raba oo Lamoni o meshomo Yuda o meshomo Yerusalem ina ang nasheta isunta.

English: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
Masaai: Amu eitasho olaiguanani le Babilon teine neorore inkoitoi te rishata e nena oitoi are, easishore enaibon; neikirikirie mbaa, neikilikuanishore enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai naji Terafi, neing'or emonyua eina ngues naibonishore.

English: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint battering rams against the gates, to cast a mount, and to build a fort.
Masaai: Ore atua enkaina enye e tatene nepuku enkukuo e Yerusalem pee ebol enkutuk enye te nkishirata, peyie eilepie oltoilo te mbuaata, pee eitorioki isekenke naagilieki nkishomin neitasheyie nenen neesheta te ng'olon neshetu iltaleta ooibung'ishore.

English: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
Masaai: Kake ore te ninche, netiu anaa enaibon elejare; einosa ninche ilmuma oogol; kake eyau ninye eng'oki enye metadamuni, peyie etumi aaibung'a.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, I say, that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu intaa ing'ok inono inaadamuni, te ina nemeekure eisudoroyu intorrok inono, neaku ore too siaaitin inono pooki naa keibalayu ing'ok inono; amu ieuo iyie adamu; naa aikiya ninche iyie.

English: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
Masaai: Ore iyie, intae iltung'ana torrok lemesinya, olkitok le Israel, ilo oewuo enkolong enye, erishata enkitamioto ino nabayie,

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this shall not be the same: exalt him that is low, and abase him that is high.
Masaai: inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Intayu enkarasha endukuya, nintayu ina maupe enkitoo; meitoki intokitin aatiu anaa enaikununo; isisa ina nidol etii abori, nintadou ina natii shumata.

English: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no more, until he come whose right it is; and I will give it him.
Masaai: Enkidaata, enkidaata, kaitobiru nanu enkidaata; metumi ninye eneima ninye o meeu ninye aa enenye esipata; naa ninye aisho nanu.

English: And thou, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites, and concerning their reproach; even say thou, The sword, the sword is drawn: for the slaughter it is furbished, to consume because of the glittering:
Masaai: “Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai tialo Ilamoni, neipirta sii enkurruna enye; tejo, Olalem, olalem etushurtuaki peyie eyieng'ishoi, netisikaki meimerlela anaa enkiwuang'ata,

English: Whiles they see vanity unto thee, whiles they divine a lie unto thee, to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain, of the wicked, whose day is come, when their iniquity shall have an end.
Masaai: ore edol ninche te ntae induaat elejare ina kata eibonoki ninche intae elejare, peyie eeniki imurto e lelo tung'ana lemesinya torrok, lelo ootabaikia ninche enkolong enye enkata enkitamioto enye nabayie.

English: Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.
Masaai: Tushukoki olalem enchashur enye. Teine wueji nikintobirieki iyie, teina kop apa ning'uaa ekaaiguanare nanu iyie.

English: And I will pour out mine indignation upon thee, I will blow against thee in the fire of my wrath, and deliver thee into the hand of brutish men, and skilful to destroy.
Masaai: Naa kabukoki shumata intae engoro ai; nakutaki intae enkima engoro ai; na kapik intae inkaik oo ltung'ana arruok meidaikie.

English: Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land; thou shalt be no more remembered: for I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Iakuku intae ilkeek le nkima; ore osarge linyi nejing empolos e ina kop; meitokini aekata aadamu intae; amu nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani ine natii naajoki:

English: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
Masaai: “Ore iyie enkerai e tung'ani, aiminguanare iyie, aiminguanare iyie enkanasa osarge? Nimbalakinye ninye nena baa pooki olminong enyena.

English: Then say thou, Thus saith the Lord GOD, The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it, that her time may come, and maketh idols against herself to defile herself.
Masaai: Naa ijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore enkanasa naibukoyie osarge te rishata enye; peyie etum enkata enye aeu, neitobiru nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu aidurukie kewan!

English: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near, and art come even unto thy years: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen, and a mocking to all countries.
Masaai: Itaa iyie torrono tenkaraki osarge limbukoitie; ninduruko te nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu nintobirutua, niyautua aaitinyiku enkolong inyi etabawua ina kata nageluno oo larin linyi. Neaku aaitaa iyie enkurruna too loreren, nikisurdaanyi iyie too nkuapi pooki.

English: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.
Masaai: Ore lelo ootaana o lelo oo lakua te iyie naa aikisurdaany iyie, iyie leme toki, obore enkingolingol.

English: Behold, the princes of Israel, every one were in thee to their power to shed blood.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ore lelo kituaak le Israel netii atua iyie, pooki ng'ae te ngolon enye, netemerregelaki to sarge oibukori.

English: In thee have they set light by father and mother: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow.
Masaai: Ore papa o yieyio neitaasaki inolmena tiatua iyie; ore olomoni otii atua iyie neisimaki te rishata ino; ore nkokishin o nkolia tiatua iyie neinyalaki.

English: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
Masaai: Itemenayie iyie intokitin aainei sinyat, nisarkionienie isabatoni aainei.

English: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.
Masaai: Etii iltung'ana ootii atua iyie ooiro imbaa enkarruoisho pee eibukori osarge, oltung'ana tiatua iyie oodaa too nchumat oo ildonyio; iltung'ana ooas enkarruoisho tiatua intae.

English: In thee have they discovered their fathers' nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
Masaai: Ore tiatua iyie neoru iltung'ana iloo menye ilkilani, ore tiatua iyie neibung inkituaak te rishata enye enkiduruk.

English: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour's wife; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law; and another in thee hath humbled his sister, his father's daughter.
Masaai: Eas obo olminong te nkitok ole latia enye; ore likae neotiki te nkoitoi torrono ainyal enkitok olayioni lenye; ore likae tiatua iyie neinyal enkanashe enye, entito e papaai lenye.

English: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood; thou hast taken usury and increase, and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion, and hast forgotten me, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore ake tiatua iyie neya iltung'ana eropare peyie eibukoo o sarge; niyaya ilaat emponaroto e dupoto inyi too lelatia linyi ironyironyo; nemeekure kidamumu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.
Masaai: “Ing'ura, ore naa, atoosho inkaik aainei tenebo te ina dupoto e lejare nintobirua o te ilo sarge otii arishata ino.

English: Can thine heart endure, or can thine hands be strong, in the days that I shall deal with thee? I the LORD have spoken it, and will do it.
Masaai: Keidim engolon ino e oshoke atobikoi, arashu keidim inkaik inyi aatagol, te nena olong'i naalotu aarare iyie? Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro, naa kaas ina.

English: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
Masaai: Ekaaidapash iyie tiatua iloreren naisardakie iyie too nkuapi, namut ilduruki linono te iyie.

English: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaaisarkionieki nanu te dukuya iyie tiatua iloreren; niyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, the house of Israel is to me become dross: all they are brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, in the midst of the furnace; they are even the dross of silver.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore enkaji e Israel netupuruko oleng te nanu, ninche pooki, ore enkosholai o suyiai o empirbil o esekenkei o risasi otii atua olkokuet, netupuruko pooki.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye are all become dross, behold, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itupuruko pooki, neaku ing'ura ekaiturrur intae terishata e Yerusalem.

English: As they gather silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, into the midst of the furnace, to blow the fire upon it, to melt it; so will I gather you in mine anger and in my fury, and I will leave you there, and melt you.
Masaai: Anaa enaiturrurru iltung'ana enkosholai o suyai o esekenkei o risasi o empirbil nepik atua olkokuet peyie ekutaki ninche enkima shumata ninye peyie etum aatoshol ninye; neaku kaiturrurru intaete ngoro ai o te ngoro ai napi, napik intae atua ashol intae.

English: Yea, I will gather you, and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Ekaiturrur intae nakutaki intae enkima engoro ai napi, naa kesholi intae te rishata enye.

English: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace, so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I the LORD have poured out my fury upon you.
Masaai: Anaa enasholi enkosholai to lkokuet, naa kesholi intae te rishata enye; naa iyiolouu ajo nanu Olaitoriani otubukoko engoro ai shumata inyi.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, say unto her, Thou art the land that is not cleansed, nor rained upon in the day of indignation.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani tiaaki ninye, ira iyie enkop nemesinya, arashu natashaikia te ina olong e ng'oro.

English: There is a conspiracy of her prophets in the midst thereof, like a roaring lion ravening the prey; they have devoured souls; they have taken the treasure and precious things; they have made her many widows in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak ootii atua ninye netiu anaa olng'atuny oikurrukur opolos engues, etumuta enkishui oo ltung'ana; ewaita ninche ilchumat o ntokitin naagol enkingang'a; eitaa ninche inkituaak kumok inkolia.

English: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.
Masaai: Ore ilapolosak lenye netaasa ine nkikonya too nkitanapat aainei neisarkionie intokitin aainei sinyat; eitu ninche erishu intokitin sinyat o ntokitin e pooki ng'ae, neitu eitamok olorere enepaashare entoki naiduruk o esidai, netemenaitie ninche isabatoni aainei, metaa aaisarkionieki nanu tiatua ninche.

English: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak ootii erishata enye netiu anaa isuyian oopolos inkiri engues naibung'a, neibukoo osarge, neishu enkishui peyie etum nena kishorot nemesipa. Ekairriu enchan sapuk oleng, isoito sapuki le nchan, nelotu olkutati kitok oleng.

English: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.
Masaai: Ore iloibonok lenye netumura te nturoto e monkoi, nedol induaat nemesipa, neibonoki ninche elejare ejoki: ‘Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai’, eitu ninye eiro Olaitoriani.

English: The people of the land have used oppression, and exercised robbery, and have vexed the poor and needy: yea, they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully.
Masaai: Etaasa iltung'ana lena nkop entorrono, netaasa inenkikonya; eironya ninche ilaisinak o lomena, netaasa ine mesipa too ldokunot eitu ejurru enyamali enye.

English: And I sought for a man among them, that should make up the hedge, and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I should not destroy it: but I found none.
Masaai: Naing'oru oltung'ani tiatua ninche olo ashet ina suntai neitashe teina lusie e suntai te dukuya nanu tenkaraki ina kop, peyie matum aidaikie ninye; kake eitu atum hoo obo.

English: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath: their own way have I recompensed upon their heads, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Metaa atubukuo nanu engoro ai shumata ninche; atumuta nanu ninche te nkima engoro ai napi; ore enkoitoi enye eitalakua too lukuny enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki;

English: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, etii apa inkituaak are naa intoyie enkitok nabo;

English: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt; they committed whoredoms in their youth: there were their breasts pressed, and there they bruised the teats of their virginity.
Masaai: neiborrie apa onyek te Misiri; neas inenkiborra oo nkonyek tekitisho ore teine, neirragi too lki lenye neirrapirrapi ilgooitie lenye.

English: And the names of them were Aholah the elder, and Aholibah her sister: and they were mine, and they bare sons and daughters. Thus were their names; Samaria is Aholah, and Jerusalem Aholibah.
Masaai: Keji apa enkarna eina botor Ohola neji enkarna enkanashe enye Oholiba. Neaku ninche inaainei, neiu ninche ilayiok o ntoyie. Ore too nkarn enye ore Ohola naa Samaria ore Oholiba naa Yerusalem.

English: And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,
Masaai: “Eiborrie ongu Ohola aa enaai ninye, netonyarra ninye isintan lenyena, le Asiria,

English: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
Masaai: ilmurran ooishopo inkilani naata emua morijoi, ilaitoriak o laitasheikinok, laa ore pooki naa ilbarnot oo ng'uarri oleng, nekedito ninche imbartan.

English: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them, with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria, and with all on whom she doted: with all their idols she defiled herself.
Masaai: Eishoo ninye kewan ninche anaa emulayoi lelo gelunot pooki le Asiria; neidurukie kewan too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e pooki ng'ae otaasie ine nkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: Neither left she her whoredoms brought from Egypt: for in her youth they lay with her, and they bruised the breasts of her virginity, and poured their whoredom upon her.
Masaai: Eitu ninye epal esiaai enye enkiborra oo nkonyek ina apa nataasa eiteru too nkolong'i naatiiyie Misiri; amu ore apa te nkitisho enye netaboitare ilewa ninye neibung'a olgoo netaboitare ninye etonaa eselenkei te mulayaisho nebukoki ninye enkiborra enye oo nkonyek.

English: Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, upon whom she doted.
Masaai: Metaa atanang'aka nanu ninye atua inkaik oo sintan lenyena, inkaik oo le Asiria lelo apa ootonyorra te nkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
Masaai: Nebolu lelo emasipaisho enye; neibung ilayiok lenyena o ntoyie enyena; ore tenebo ninye nedung to lalem; neaku ninye entoki naimakini tiatua inkituaak ina kata nadung'okini ninye enkiguana.

English: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
Masaai: “Ore enkanashe enye Oholiba netoduaa ena naa torrono apa ninye oleng alang ninye te nkiborra oo nkonyek, naa torrrono apa ninye alang enkanashe enye.

English: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.
Masaai: Eiborrie ninye onyek too le Asiria, ilkituaak o larikok, ilmurran ooishopo too masaa olarrabal, ilookedito imbartan, laa ore pooki naa ilbarnot oo ng'uarrayu.

English: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
Masaai: Nadol apa ajo eidurukieki ninye; neim pokira orrekie obo.

English: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
Masaai: Kake etanapa ninye enkiborra enye oo nkonyek aitulus; etoduaa ninye ilewa, ootaguetakaki inkitanyaanyukot enye isunta nena kitanyaanyukoto oo Ilkaldayo oo yela to ranki onyokie,

English: Girded with girdles upon their loins, exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads, all of them princes to look to, after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea, the land of their nativity:
Masaai: nerretena impolosi enye too nkimeitani o nkarash natii ilukuny enye netiu pooki anaa ilkituaak, empisha oo Babilon, laa ore enkop enye naa Ilkaldayo.

English: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
Masaai: Ore peyie edol ninye ninche neiborrie onyek te ninche neirriwaki ilkiliku ninche te Ilkaldayo.

English: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their whoredom, and she was polluted with them, and her mind was alienated from them.
Masaai: Nejing'aki Ilbabilon ninye tiatua endapash enye enyorrata, neidurukie ninye to lng'uarra lenye; ore peyie eidip ninche aaisarkionie ninye, nelo ninye aing'uaa ninche te ngoro.

English: So she discovered her whoredoms, and discovered her nakedness: then my mind was alienated from her, like as my mind was alienated from her sister.
Masaai: Ore teneas ninye inenkiborra oo nkonyek meeta enkuretisho neboloo emasipaisho enye aaibelekenya te ngoro aing'uaa ninye, anaa peyie aibelekenya aing'uaa enkanashe enye.

English: Yet she multiplied her whoredoms, in calling to remembrance the days of her youth, wherein she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Kake etoponayie ake ninye enkiborra oo nkonyek, edamu inkolong'i enyena e kitisho, ina kata eiborrie onyek te nkop e Misiri

English: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.
Masaai: neiborrie ninye onyek te lelo sanchan lenyena ooba irubat oo seseni lenye anaa inoo sirkon neeta esingate oo lamuyeishi loo mbartan. oonyaanyukie isirkon, neikununo eneing'uaa anaa enetiu eneing'uaa mbartan.

English: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
Masaai: Neaku neijia etiu eyieunoto entorroni oo lbarnot linono ina kata kimbung Ilmisiri olgoo lino neirony ilki linono kutiti.”

English: Therefore, O Aholibah, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will raise up thy lovers against thee, from whom thy mind is alienated, and I will bring them against thee on every side;
Masaai: Metaa, oi iyie Oholiba, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kadumakino isanchan linono limbelekenyakine te ngoro mikitigilunore iyie eing'uaa nkaloli pooki.

English: The Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: all of them desirable young men, captains and rulers, great lords and renowned, all of them riding upon horses.
Masaai: Ore ile Babilon tenebo Ilkaldayo pooki, o Pekod, o Shoa, o Koa, tenebo ile Asiria pooki tenebo ninche, o ltung'ana pooki ooti sidain, ilaiguanak o laitoriak pooki tenebo, ilarikok o lmurran, ekedito pooki imbartan.

English: And they shall come against thee with chariots, wagons, and wheels, and with an assembly of people, which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge thee according to their judgments.
Masaai: Naa aikipuonu aarare iyie eing'uaa enkalo e moikuape too ngarrin oo imbartan, o ngarrin o lorora kitok lo lorere; keiturrurro ninche peyie kiarare too nkaloli pooki eeta ilong'oi kutiti o sapuki, o nkopiyiani o larrabal, naa kapik enkiguana atua ninche, naa keiguanare intae anaa enatiu enkiguana enye.

English: And I will set my jealousy against thee, and they shall deal furiously with thee: they shall take away thy nose and thine ears; and thy remnant shall fall by the sword: they shall take thy sons and thy daughters; and thy residue shall be devoured by the fire.
Masaai: Naa kaibelekenyaki intae engoro ai aarare intae, peyie atum ataarare intae te ngoro napi. Kedung'oo ninche inkumeishin inyi o nkiyiaa inyi, ore ilekunot linyi nebatatakino olalem. Naa keibung aaya ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi, ore ilekunot linyi nemutite nkima.

English: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes, and take away thy fair jewels.
Masaai: Keoru sii intae inkilani inyi neya te intae isoito linyi gelunot.

English: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee, and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt: so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them, nor remember Egypt any more.
Masaai: Neaku neijia aiko tenaiting'ie enkiborra inyi oo nkonyek ina niyautua te nkop e Misiri; metaa mintokiki aaraposhoki nkonyek inyi Ilmisiri arashu intokiki aadamu ninche.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest, into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated:
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kapik intae atua nkaik e lelo limbaba, atua inkaik e lelo limbelekenyanya aaing'uaa te ngoro;

English: And they shall deal with thee hatefully, and shall take away all thy labour, and shall leave thee naked and bare: and the nakedness of thy whoredoms shall be discovered, both thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
Masaai: naa kearare ninche intae te nkiba, neya ninche aaitung'uaa intae ilng'anayio pooki le siaai inyi, neing'uaa intae irara imasipa nemeishopo, ore emasipaisho inyi enkiborra oonkonyek inyi neboluni. Ore olng'uarra lino tenebo enkiborra ino oo nkonyek

English: I will do these things unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen, and because thou art polluted with their idols.
Masaai: ninye nayaua ena shumata iyie, amu itaasa enkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo iloreren, nindurukie ate too nkitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin.

English: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand.
Masaai: Itusuja iyie ina oitoi enkanashe ino; metaa kapik enkikompe enye enkaina ino.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Iok iyie enkikompe enkanashe ino, ina nagut naa sapuk; aikikuneiyieki iyie nikimenuni, amu keeta ninye esapuk;

English: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
Masaai: aikimputi iyie emerei o sina Enkikompe enkuretisho sapuk o emutata, ina kikompe enkanashe ino Samaria;

English: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: iok iyie ninye nimitu pooki aishu, nidotu kewan ilpapit, nidung ilki linono; amu airoro nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu intorikino kewan nanu, nikinyaaya oriong ino, neaku tanapa naa enyamali ino olng'uarra lino o enkiborra ino oo nkonyek.”

English: The LORD said moreover unto me; Son of man, wilt thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? yea, declare unto them their abominations;
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ainguanare iyie Ohola o Oholiba? Neaku imbalakinye naa ninche imbaa enye olminong.

English: That they have committed adultery, and blood is in their hands, and with their idols have they committed adultery, and have also caused their sons, whom they bare unto me, to pass for them through the fire, to devour them.
Masaai: Amu etaasa ninche inenkiborra oo nkonyek, netii osarge atua inkaik enye; ore too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu netaasa eloloito; neishoo doi ninye endaa lelo ayiok laa nanu etoikitio.

English: Moreover this they have done unto me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my sabbaths.
Masaai: Ore ake sii eyia aaitaasa ninche nanu ena: eisarkionie ninche ewueji ai sinyati teina olong ake neisarkionie isabatoni aainei.

English: For when they had slain their children to their idols, then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it; and, lo, thus have they done in the midst of mine house.
Masaai: Amu ore peyie eidip aateyieng inkera enye te mpolosare too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye nemeishu, ore teina olong ake neetuo ninche atua ewueji ai sinyati aaisarkionie ninye. Naa ing'ura ena etaasa ninche te nkaji ai.

English: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,
Masaai: Eipotutuo doi ninye iltung'ana meetu tenelakua, ilo oirriwakaki olkilikuai, naa ng'ura eetuo ninche. Amu tiatua ninche isuja iyie kewan, niyel inkonyek inono, nikus kewan too masaa;

English: And satest upon a stately bed, and a table prepared before it, whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil.
Masaai: nitonini intae te shumata olorika sidai, niata emisa natipikaki dukuya iyie naa ninye itipika iyie enkorropil ai tenebo eilata ai.

English: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
Masaai: Netii atua ninye oltoilo loo lororani lemeshilaa toki; tenebo ilewa ookishore tenebo ootorikuoki tiong'ota, nepik ninche ilkataarri nkaik e nena kituaak, o maupen enkitoo sidain too ilukuny enye.

English: Then said I unto her that was old in adulteries, Will they now commit whoredoms with her, and she with them?
Masaai: “Ina peyie ajo, aimeasita tena kata ilewa eloloito teneas enkiborra oo nkonyek tenebo ninye?

English: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.
Masaai: Amu etijing'akita ninche ninye, anaa enajing'aki ilewa enkitok naibor onyek. Neaku neijia eikunakinote ninche Ohila o Oholiba peyie eas inenkiborra oo nkonyek.

English: And the righteous men, they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses, and after the manner of women that shed blood; because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
Masaai: Kake ore iltung'ana supati naa kedung'oki ninche enkiguana edung'oki ninche enkiguana enkiborra enye oo nkonyek, tenebo enkiguana oo nkituaak naaibukoitie osarge; amu inaaibor onyek ninche, netii osarge inkaik enye.”

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Iyau olorora taarare ninche, nintaa ninche entoki naitureisho naaruno.

English: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.
