Masaai: Naa kenang olorora ninche too soito neiwuang'ie ninche too lalema lenye; naa keyieng ninche ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye nepejoo inkajijik enye.

English: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness.
Masaai: Neaku neijia aiko tenaiting'ie enkiborra enye oo nkonyek te nkop peyie etum ing'oruo pooki aaibung'ie ina inkiyiaa nemeitoki aas inenkiborra oo nkonyek anaa enitaasa iyie.

English: And they shall recompense your lewdness upon you, and ye shall bear the sins of your idols: and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore enkiborra inyi oo nkonyek naa keitalakuni te intae, ninapinapa elaakinoto tenkaraki eng'oki oo inkitanyaanyukot inyi oo nkaitin nemeishu; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Again in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le naaudo to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: Son of man, write thee the name of the day, even of this same day: the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani ingero enkarna ena olong, etamuata olaiguanani le Babilon Yerusalem.

English: And utter a parable unto the rebellious house, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Set on a pot, set it on, and also pour water into it:
Masaai: Niro endung'et e rashe te nkaraki ina aji kiserut nijoki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai:

English: Gather the pieces thereof into it, even every good piece, the thigh, and the shoulder; fill it with the choice bones.
Masaai: Intasheyie ina moti, intasheyie ninye, tubukoki ninye enkare; tipika ninye indung'ot oo nkiri, nena dung'ot pooki sidain, enkupes o orony; nimput ninye too loik sidain gelunot.

English: Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.
Masaai: Iwa enker naisul eluaata, nipik ilkeek le nkima abori enye; nintokitokie indung'ot enyena, nintokitokie sii iloik lenyena tiatua.

English: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city, to the pot whose scum is therein, and whose scum is not gone out of it! bring it out piece by piece; let no lot fall up on it.
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Woi iyie ina anasa osarge, ina nanyaanyukie emoti nainosa enkop, neton ake eitu eing'uaa ninye oloirerio lenye! Intayu te ninye indung'ot iitu, miata enigelu te nkukuo.

English: For her blood is in the midst of her; she set it upon the top of a rock; she poured it not upon the ground, to cover it with dust;
Masaai: Amu ore osarge oibukoyie ninye neton ake etii atua erishata enye; eiteleiki ninye enchumata endapidapoi nasipa eitu ninye ebukoki pee eitoipoo enterit.

English: That it might cause fury to come up to take vengeance; I have set her blood upon the top of a rock, that it should not be covered.
Masaai: Peyie edumu engoro ai napi, peyie aitalaku, atipika ninye shumata endapidapoi nasipa ilo sarge oibukoyie ninye peyie meitoipori ake.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Wooi iyie ina anasa osarge! Kaitaa sii nanu olchala osototi.

English: Heap on wood, kindle the fire, consume the flesh, and spice it well, and let the bones be burned.
Masaai: Turupa ilkeek ninok enkima, nintokitokie oleng nena kiri nibuku nena tokitin naapiki ndaiki, nincho iloik epejori.

English: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.
Masaai: Nintasheyie ninye metii toki te shumata nkuk, peyie etum airowuaja, ore osuyai lenye nepeji peyie aa ore oloirerio lenye nesholi tiatua ninye, nemuti kuti lenye.

English: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
Masaai: Te mpesho aitanaura nanu kewan ore ina kutu enye nairrusha nemeim enkima.

English: In thy filthiness is lewdness: because I have purged thee, and thou wast not purged, thou shalt not be purged from thy filthiness any more, till I have caused my fury to rest upon thee.
Masaai: Ore ina kutu enye naa olduruk le nkiborra ino oo nkonyek. Amu anaata apa aaitukuo iyie neitu eitukuori olduruk lino. Mikintokini aaituku iyie aaigil o metaba anaa naidip aishu engoro ai te iyie.

English: I the LORD have spoken it: it shall come to pass, and I will do it; I will not go back, neither will I spare, neither will I repent; according to thy ways, and according to thy doings, shall they judge thee, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Nanu Olaitoriani oiroro; naa kelotu aasayu ina, ekaas nanu; marrinyo nanu siadi, maaleku nanu, mairridu nanu; ore terisioroto oo inkoitoi inono o siaaitin inono ekaaiguanare nanu iyie ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Also the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki,

English: Son of man, behold, I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke: yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep, neither shall thy tears run down.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ng'ura ajo etaa kaya enchipai oo nkonyek inono peyie aaitung'uaa iyie te oshoto, niminchir hoo arashu isinanuo nemedou ilkiyio linono.

English: Forbear to cry, make no mourning for the dead, bind the tire of thine head upon thee, and put on thy shoes upon thy feet, and cover not thy lips, and eat not the bread of men.
Masaai: Iyang'a kake mibuaku; minchiraki ake lelo meneng'a. Teena enkarasha ino elukunya, nipik inkejek inono inamuka; niminuk ake enkutuk ino, arashu inos endaa e lelo ooishir.”

English: So I spake unto the people in the morning: and at even my wife died; and I did in the morning as I was commanded.
Masaai: Neaku airorie nanu lelo tung'ana tadekenya, ore teipa neye enkitok ai, ore enkolong entadekenya nasuju naas ina naaitanapaki.

English: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
Masaai: Naajoki nanu iltung'ana, “Aimiliki iyiook enautu kuna baa te iyiook, paa ninche iasita?”

English: Then I answered them, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ina peyie ajoki ninche, “Eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
Masaai: ‘Tiaki ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ng'ura ajo kaisarkionie ewueji ai sinyati, o lwuasa le ng'olon ino o enchipai oo nkonyek inono, o eyieunoto oltau lino; ore ilayiok linono tenebo ntoyie inono nena nitung'uayie te siadi naa kebatata to lalem.

English: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
Masaai: Naa ias iyie anaa ina nataasa; minuk iyie enkutuk ino, arashu inos endaa e lelo ooishir.

English: And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.
Masaai: Ore inkarash inono e lukunya naa ketii ilukuny inyi netii inamuka nkejek inyi; nimisinanuonuo arashu inchirishiri, kake iishunyenye aamuta te nkaraki ing'ok inyi ning'orokinono maate.

English: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign: according to all that he hath done shall ye do: and when this cometh, ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Neaku neijia etiu Esekiel te iyie aaku olmonekie; terisioroto e nena pooki naataasa ias sii iyie. Ore peyie elotu ena naa iyiolouu taa aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai!’

English: Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, ore te ina olong naya aitung'uaa ninche isempewueti lenye, enchipai enye, o enkitoo enye, o enchipai oo nkonyek enye o iyieunot oo ltauja lenye, tenebo sii ilayiok lenye o ntoyie enye,

English: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee, to cause thee to hear it with thine ears?
Masaai: ore teina olong naa keisiku olaishirani ayaki intae lelo omon.

English: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped, and thou shalt speak, and be no more dumb: and thou shalt be a sign unto them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa ibolokiki ilo aishirani nkutukie inyi neaku iroro nimintokiki aaku ilemeidim aairoro. Neaku iakuku intae olmonekie te ninche; neyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki,

English: Son of man, set thy face against the Ammonites, and prophesy against them;
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorrioki enkomom ino enkalo oo Lamoni, imbonisho tigilunore ninche.

English: And say unto the Ammonites, Hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou saidst, Aha, against my sanctuary, when it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, when it was desolate; and against the house of Judah, when they went into captivity;
Masaai: Tiaaki Ilamoni: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai: Ore amu itejo ‘Aha!’ te nkaraki ewueji ai sinyati ina kata peyie eisarkionieki ninye, o te nkaraki ina kop e Israel ina kata peyie eitaa ninye mitil, o te nkaraki ina aji e Yuda ina kata peyie elo eyararoto;

English: Behold, therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession, and they shall set their palaces in thee, and make their dwellings in thee: they shall eat thy fruit, and they shall drink thy milk.
Masaai: neaku kaaitarasaa iyie aitarasaki iltung'ana le nkalo o loosaen peyie iaku entoki enye, naa keitasheyie ninche ilng'oborri lenye tiatua intae neitobiru imanyat enye tiatua intae; naa kenya ninche ilng'anayio linyi, neok ninche kule inyi.

English: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ekaitaa Raba olokeri loo ntamesin ore nkanas oo Lamori emuatata oo ntare. Niyiolouu taa aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore amu itoosho inkaik inyi nioshieshie inkejek inyi enkop nishipapa te nkaraki intorrok pooki naatii atua intae te nkaraki enkop e Israel,

English: Behold, therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee, and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen; and I will cut thee off from the people, and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries: I will destroy thee; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: metaa, eng'ura, aitorioyie nanu enkaina ai aagilunore iyie naa kaaitarasaa iyie anaa iyarunot aitarasaki iloreren; naa kaadung'oo iyie aaitung'uaa loreren; naaisho iyie indaai too nkuapi; ekaaidaikie iyie. Pee itum iyie atayiolo ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Moab and Seir do say, Behold, the house of Judah is like unto all the heathen;
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu etejo Yuda, ing'ura ajo ore ina aji e Moab netiu anaa ilkulikae oreren pooki,

English: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,
Masaai: neaku kaboloo inkanas oo lpolosien le Moab eiteru too nkanas naatii ilpolosien lenyena, o ina kop e Beteshimot o Baalmeon o Kiriatai.

English: Unto the men of the east with the Ammonites, and will give them in possession, that the Ammonites may not be remembered among the nations.
Masaai: Ekaishooyo ninye tenebo ile Amoni o metabaiki iltung'ana le nkalo o loo saen metaa enjung'ore, metaa meitokini aekata aadamu too loreren.

English: And I will execute judgments upon Moab; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kadung'oki Moab enkiguana; ina peyie etum aatayiolo nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because that Edom hath dealt against the house of Judah by taking vengeance, and hath greatly offended, and revenged himself upon them;
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu etaasa Edom entorrono aarare enkaji e Yuda, naaitagoro ninye aitalaku elap te ninche.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom, and will cut off man and beast from it; and I will make it desolate from Teman; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword.
Masaai: Metaa nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekaitorioo enkaina ai aarare Edom, nadung'oo tiatua ninye tung'ani o eng'ues; naa kaitaa ninye mitil; eiteru te Teman o metabaiki Dedan naa kebatata ninche to lalem.

English: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa kapik elap ai shumata Edom te nkaina oo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli; naa keas ninche te Edom anaa enatiu engoro ai anaa enatiu engoro ai napi; naa keyiolou ninche elap ai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore amu eitalakutua Ilfilisti elap neya ina to lwuasa lo ltau pee eidaikie teilo omang'ati lemeish;

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethims, and destroy the remnant of the sea coast.
Masaai: neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaitorioo enkaina ai agilunore Ilfilisti, naa kadung'oo ile Kereti, namut iloomanaa le naiposha.

English: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them.
Masaai: Ekairriu elap sapuk shumata ninche tengoro sapuk e nkitamioto. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata naiteleiki elap ai shumata ninche.”

English: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: Son of man, because that Tyrus hath said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is broken that was the gates of the people: she is turned unto me: I shall be replenished, now she is laid waste:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore amu etejo Turo embae naipirta Yerusalem ejo, ‘Aha, ore ina kishomi oo loreren netigilaki, etabole tukul aisiu te nkaraki nanu; ekaaitasheyieki nanu, ore naa amu eitomijoonoki,’ neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai:

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Tyrus, and will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.
Masaai: Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, iyie Turo, naa kayau iloshon kumok mikitaarare iyie, anaa enayau enaiposha ilopir lenyena.

English: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.
Masaai: Kemut ninche isunta e Turo, negil auroo iltaleta lenyena; naa keoroo enterit aitung'uaa ninye neitaa ninye endapidapoi nasipa.

English: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD: and it shall become a spoil to the nations.
Masaai: Keaku ketii ninye empolos e naiposha ewueji neisalaashieki irresheta; amu airoro nanu ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; naa keaku ninye entoki naaruno too loreren;

English: And her daughters which are in the field shall be slain by the sword; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: ore intoyie enyena naatii enkop natoyio naa keyieng'i to lalem. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring upon Tyrus Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, a king of kings, from the north, with horses, and with chariots, and with horsemen, and companies, and much people.
Masaai: “Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo ekayau shumata e Turo eiteru te moikuape Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon, olaiguanani loo laiguanak, eeta imbartan oo ng'arrin enye tenebo ilakedok loo mbartan tenebo olorora loo sikarini kumok.

English: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field: and he shall make a fort against thee, and cast a mount against thee, and lift up the buckler against thee.
Masaai: Kear ninye to lalem intoyie inyi naatii enkop natoyio; naa kemuat aaman ninche esuntai nagol nikiarare, nashetaki intae oltim aagilunore intae, neitasheyie ilchureta o long'oi aarare intae.

English: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
Masaai: Ekeitorioki ninye intae entoki oo sekenke agilunore isunta inyi ore too ntoluo enyena naa keuroo iltaleta linyi.

English: By reason of the abundance of his horses their dust shall cover thee: thy walls shall shake at the noise of the horsemen, and of the wheels, and of the chariots, when he shall enter into thy gates, as men enter into a city wherein is made a breach.
Masaai: Keaku kumok oleng imbartan enyena metaa ore enterit enye neitoipoo intae; ore isunta inyi naa keigusugus te ilo toilo le lelo akedok loo mbartan tenebo ngarrin oo mbartan, tenejing atua inchomito inyi anaa oltung'ani ojing enkanasa natumutaki naata ilusien too sunta.

English: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets: he shall slay thy people by the sword, and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground.
Masaai: Ore too loisotok loo mbartan enyena naa keituny inkoitoi dapashi e nkanasa inyi naa kear iltung'ana linyi to lalem; ore ing'apeta inyi kituaak naa kesulakini enkop.

English: And they shall make a spoil of thy riches, and make a prey of thy merchandise: and they shall break down thy walls, and destroy thy pleasant houses: and they shall lay thy stones and thy timber and thy dust in the midst of the water.
Masaai: Keitaa ninche iyarunot e karsisisho inyi imasaa enye; anaa eng'ues entim imasaa inyi e biashara naa kesulaa ninche isunta inyi neinyal inkajijik inyi sidain; ore isoito linyi o mbaoi o enterit naa kenang'akini empolos oo nkariak.

English: And I will cause the noise of thy songs to cease; and the sound of thy harps shall be no more heard.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie eranyare oo sinkolioitin linyi, ore oltoilo loo wululi loo usin inyi nemeitokini aekata aaning.

English: And I will make thee like the top of a rock: thou shalt be a place to spread nets upon; thou shalt be built no more: for I the LORD have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ekaitaa intae endapidapoi nasipa nemetii toki; iakuku intae ewueji neisalaashieki irresheta; nemeitokini aekata aashet intae; amu nanu Olaitoriani oiroro, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD to Tyrus; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall, when the wounded cry, when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee?
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki Turo: amaa olmanie le naiposha aimeikirikira tenening embuaata e mbatatata ino, ina kata naigor ilo otipikaki olbae, ina kata etii lelo ootipikaki ilbaa atua erishata inyi?

English: Then all the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and lay away their robes, and put off their broidered garments: they shall clothe themselves with trembling; they shall sit upon the ground, and shall tremble at every moment, and be astonished at thee.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo kituaak leina aiposha tenedou aaing'uaa ilorikan lenye le nkitoo, neitayu ilkilani lenye, nekinyaa nena kilani enye naaikodo; naa keishopoki ate enkuretisho; Eketoni ninche te nkop neikirikira anaa adake, neureyu intae oleng.

English: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!
Masaai: Naa kedumu enkishirata aaishiraki intae, nejoki intae ‘Kaji inkuna peyie iisha too naaiposha, iyie na anasa yioloti, ina apa magilani teina aiposha, iyie o lelo likimanya, lelo ooikonyu olkirutoto lino, tiatua enkop natoyio!

English: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.
Masaai: Eikirikira ile mankale teina olong ino embatatata; ee, lelo loo lemankale ootii enaiposha neing'asia ina kata niishunye!’

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall make thee a desolate city, like the cities that are not inhabited; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee, and great waters shall cover thee;
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Ore ake peyie aitaa enkanasa ino, anaa inkanas nememanya, ore peyie ayau ailepunye enegut peyie aaitoip iyie nikintoip iyie nkariak sapuki,

English: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit, with the people of old time, and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth, in places desolate of old, with them that go down to the pit, that thou be not inhabited; and I shall set glory in the land of the living;
Masaai: neaku kaanang'aa iyie abori tenebo lelo oodoyio aapuo engumoto, ine netii iltung'ana liopa, naaitaa iyie olobik to lodo le nkop, tenebo lelo apa ooidaaitie te dukuya tenebo lelo oopuo abori ina gumoto, metaa mikintokini aamanya arashu iatata ewueji te nkop oo looishu.

English: I will make thee a terror, and thou shalt be no more: though thou be sought for, yet shalt thou never be found again, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kaayau iyie apik enkiting'oto torrono, nimintoki aekata atii; hoo naa aiking'oruni iyie, kake mikintokini ae kata aatum aaigil, ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai.”

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
Masaai: “Ore tena kata nakerai e tung'ani tudumu enkishirata nchiraki Turo nijoki ninye,

English: And say unto Tyrus, O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea, which art a merchant of the people for many isles, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O Tyrus, thou hast said, I am of perfect beauty.
Masaai: nijoki Turo, ina naton namanya enejingieki enaiposha, olbiasharai le lelo tung'ana to loomanaa loo naaiposha, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ‘Oi Turo, itejo iyie, atimitunye nanu te nkishiaa.’

English: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas, thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
Masaai: Ore ilpolosien linono netii empolos oo naaiposha; ore ilashetak linono netimitunye kinkishiaanie iyie.

English: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.
Masaai: Eitobirutua ninche imbaoi inyi pooki too lkeek ooing'uaa Semir; neyau iltarakua aaitung'uaa Lebanon nikintobiraki iyie eng'ape naado.

English: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.
Masaai: Ore too lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo le Bashan, nintobiru ilkurteta le meli; neitobiru ewueji ino neitasheyieki too nkeek olchani oing'uaa olomanaa le naiposha e Kupro, nepik ine ilala loo lkanchaoni.

English: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail; blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee.
Masaai: Tenebo enkitani sidai naikodo naing'uaa Misiri, naa ninye apa olkarasha oreu emeli, naa ninye naitashe anaa enanka ino; enkarasha pus o emorijoi naing'uaa olomanaa le naiposha e Elisha, naa ninye apa enchuret ino.

English: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
Masaai: Ore lelo oomanya Sidon o Arfad naa ninche ilarewak linono loo melin, ore iltung'ana linyi arriyiak le Semer netii apa atua intae, ninche apa ilarewak linyi loo melin.

English: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise.
Masaai: Ore lelo ashetak lemeli, le Gebal o ltung'ana arriyiak netii atua iyie, kinukaki ilbaat loo melin inono. Ore nena melin pooki e naiposha tenebo isikarini le naiposha netii atua iyie, eitawalaa imasaa inono e biashara.

English: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army, thy men of war: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee; they set forth thy comeliness.
Masaai: “Ore apa Parsia o Lud o Put netii atua enjore inyi anaa iltung'ana linyi lo larrabal; neik ninche nena long'oi enye tenebo imaupen tiatua iyie; neisho ninche intae esidano enye.

English: The men of Arvad with thine army were upon thy walls round about, and the Gammadims were in thy towers: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about; they have made thy beauty perfect.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana le Arfad o Helek netii apa isunta inyi aamanita, ore iltung'ana le Gamad netii sii ninche iltaleta linono; neik ninche ilong'oi enye too isunta inono aaitaman; neitisidan aitaa bayarot enkishiaa inyi.

English: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches; with silver, iron, tin, and lead, they traded in thy fairs.
Masaai: “Ore Tarshish nikitoning'ore te siaai e biashara enye amu iata imasaa kumok e pooki pukunoto; enkosholai o esekenkei, empirbil o risasini. Eitawalunye ninche imasaa inyi e biashara.

English: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they were thy merchants: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market.
Masaai: Ore Yafan o Tubal o Meshek netimirishote tenebo iyie; eitawalunye ninche iltung'ana nena masaa o suyai aawalunye imasaa inyi.

English: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
Masaai: Ore Betogarma newalunye imasaa inyi mbartan olarrabal o nyumpui.

English: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.
Masaai: “Ore lelo tung'ana le Rode netaasa biashara tenebo intae; iloomanaa loo naaiposha iwuejitin inyi nimirishorere, eyakita intae te laata ilala loo lkanchaoni o nkeek oltiasika.

English: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds, purple, and broidered work, and fine linen, and coral, and agate.
Masaai: Ore Edom nikitoning'ore te siaai e biashara, te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa inono; eitawalunye ninche imasaa inyi isoito oonyori o nkilani morijo, intokitin naaikodo, kitani naapuyiapui, o sikira le naiposha o soit oji agate.

English: Judah, and the land of Israel, they were thy merchants: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith, and Pannag, and honey, and oil, and balm.
Masaai: Ore Yuda o ina kop e Israel netimirishote tenebo iyie; einyang'utua imasaa inyi emirare te nkano, too loirienito o lng'abolo le dukuya, o inaishi o ila, o lchani oji Seri.

English: Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.
Masaai: Ore Dameski netijing'a esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie te nkaraki enkumoi oo masaa inono, te nkaraki enkumoi ino oo masaa e pooki pukunoto; enaisho oo sabibu e Helbon, o ilpapit ooibor loo ntare,

English: Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.
Masaai: o enaisho oo sabibu naing'uaa Usal newalunye ninche too ntokitin inyi; isekenke naasika, o enkaitubului naji mdalasini, o enkaitubului naji mchai naatii apa atua imasaa inono e biashara.

English: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
Masaai: Ore Dedan netaasa esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie too nkilani naarewueki imbartan.

English: Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.
Masaai: Ore Arabia tenebo ilkituaak pooki le Kedar naa ilamirak linono linyor too ilkuoo linono le kerra, o lmeregeshi tenebo inkineji; neaku te nena apa etaasa biashara tenebo iyie.

English: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they were thy merchants: they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices, and with all precious stones, and gold.
Masaai: Ore ilbiasharani le Sheba o Rama netaasa biashara tenebo iyie; newalunye ninche imasaa inyi e nkorropil oo mpukunot pooki naaisul te sidano o soito pooki oogol enkinyang'a, o sahabu.

English: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
Masaai: Ore Haran, o Kane, o Eden o Ashur tenebo Kilmad netaasa esiaai e biashara tenebo iyie.

English: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
Masaai: Etaasa ninche biashara too nkilani sidain, te nena kilani pusi o nkilani naaikodo, o too ilkarash ooisalaashi tiatua iltirenito loo muain kumok neteenaki too lgoso aaitirrish; naa te kuna apa etaasie ninche biashara tenebo iyie.

English: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
Masaai: Ore imelin e Tarshish nepuo te nkaraki intae enapita imasaa inyi nimirimiri. “Metaa kimputaki apa iyie nikiroishiyieki oleng tiatua ineegut oo naaiposha.

English: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.
Masaai: Ore ilarewak linono loo melin nikintupukutuo iyie aapik inaaiposha naado. Ore olkutati lo loosaen nikitoosho amut te mpolos oo naaiposha.

English: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.
Masaai: Ore enkarsisisho ino, o masaa inono, o ntokitin inono e biashara, o sikarini linono le naiposha o lelo arewak le meli, lelo aripak linono le meli o lbiasharani linono, o ltung'ana linono pooki lo larrabal otii atua iyie, tenebo olorora lino pooki, lelo ootii atua erishata ino. Nedoiki pooki empolos oo naaiposha, teina olong ino enkidaaroto.

English: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
Masaai: Ore to ltoilo le nkishirata lo lkiyioi loo larewak linono le meli ore nkuapi naamanita neikirikira,

English: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
Masaai: ore tiabori imelin enye, mepuonu lelo pooki aaing'uaa. Ore lelo sikarini le naiposha tenebo pooki ootii atua emeli o larewak loo melin, neitashe pooki te nkop natoyio

English: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee, and shall cry bitterly, and shall cast up dust upon their heads, they shall wallow themselves in the ashes:
Masaai: nikinchiraki ninche iyie to ltoilo sapuk, neishir too lkiyio le mion. Nepik enterit ilukuny enye neiperipera too nkuruon;

English: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee, and gird them with sackcloth, and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing.
Masaai: nebarn ninche ilukuny enye te nkaraki iyie, neen ate too lkuniyiani neishiraki intae oleng te mion sapuk oltau, te nkishirata sapuk e mion.

English: And in their wailing they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and lament over thee, saying, What city is like Tyrus, like the destroyed in the midst of the sea?
Masaai: Ore to lkiyioi lenye, nikidumaki iyie enkishirata, nikinchiraki iyie ejo; ‘Aing'ae ae kata eidaikieki anaa Turo, te mpolos e naiposha?

English: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
Masaai: Ore tenepuku imasaa inyi too naaiposha, nintaraposh iyie iltung'ana kumok; te nkumoi ino oo masaa e biashara ino, inkarsisiyie lelo aiguanak le nkop.

English: In the time when thou shalt be broken by the seas in the depths of the waters thy merchandise and all thy company in the midst of thee shall fall.
Masaai: Ore taata nikitumutaki aaidaikie too naaiposha, too neegut e nena ariak; ore imasaa inono pooki nimirta tenebo iltung'ana linono pooki liaata neimiso pooki tenebo iyie.

English: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee, and their kings shall be sore afraid, they shall be troubled in their countenance.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki oomanya olomanaa le naiposha, neing'asiate te nkaraki iyie; ore ilaiguanak lenye neiruto oleng, ore inkomomi enye netanyamala.

English: The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.
Masaai: Ore lelo biasharani otii atua iltung'ana neisulisho te nkaraki iyie; ieuo iyie enkiting'oto torrono oleng' nimikintokini ae kata aata intarasi.’ ”

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, say unto the prince of Tyrus, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thine heart is lifted up, and thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God, in the midst of the seas; yet thou art a man, and not God, though thou set thine heart as the heart of God:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, tiaaki ilo kitok le Turo, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu kewuasa oltau lino, nitejo iyie, ‘Ara nanu Enkai. Aton nanu te ilo orika loo nkaitin, te mpolos oo naaiposha; nira ake sii tung'ani, nimira Enkai, hoo naa idol kewan anaa ira ng'en anaa Enkai,

English: Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee:
Masaai: neaku esipa ira iyie ng'en alang Daniel; metii entoki naisudoro te iyie;

English: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches, and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures:
Masaai: teng'eno ino o tening'unoto ino inotoko kewan imasaa, ninturrurruo sahabu o enkosholai apik atua arsisisho ino;

English: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches, and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches:
Masaai: teng'eno ino nagut e biashara itoponayie imasaa inono, netawuase oltau lino too masaa inono,

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God;
Masaai: neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore amu idol kewan anaa olotiu anaa Enkai te ng'eno,

English: Behold, therefore I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom, and they shall defile thy brightness.
Masaai: neaku, ing'ura, ekayau nanu ilomon atua iyie lelo ooitureisho oleng loo loreren, naa keshutu ninche ilalema lenye aarare esidano eng'eno ino nagut neisarkionie esikar ino.

English: They shall bring thee down to the pit, and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas.
Masaai: Naa kenang'aki ninche intae engumoto niyeye intae enkeeya e lelo ooyieng'i tempolos oo naaiposha.

English: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee, I am God? but thou shalt be a man, and no God, in the hand of him that slayeth thee.
Masaai: Eton ake ijo, ‘Ara nanu Enkai! te dukuya lelo likiyieng iyie, hoo nira tung'ani neme Enkai, tiatua inkaik e lelo likipik iyie ilbaa?

English: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Iye iyie aya enkeeya e ilo lememurata te nkaina oo ltung'ani leeiking'a, ilo omoni, amu airoro nanu ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.’ ”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo orerei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, take up a lamentation upon the king of Tyrus, and say unto him, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou sealest up the sum, full of wisdom, and perfect in beauty.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, teyietu olkiyioi intorioki olaiguanani le Turo, nijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ira apa iyie enkitanyaanyukoto bayaroti, kibore apa eng'eno nagut, nitimitunye te nkishiaa.

English: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God; every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created.
Masaai: Itii apa iyie Eden, ina kurma e Nkai; ore apa pooki soit ogol enkinyang'a naa ninye intoipore, isoito ooji Karnelian o Topas o Yaspa o Krisolit o Beril, o Oniks, o Safire, o Karbunkol, o emerald; ore sahabu nasiluno naa ninche apa ininono, ninche apa isoito liguetiguete, ore teina olong apa nikintobiruaki iyie ina kata eitobiruaki sii ninche.

English: Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth; and I have set thee so: thou wast upon the holy mountain of God; thou hast walked up and down in the midst of the stones of fire.
Masaai: “Aaitaboitaka iyie olmalaika likirrip. Itii apa iyie enchumata oldoinyio sinyati le Nkai, nishomo aimaa isoito le nkima.

English: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.
Masaai: Miata apa iyie entioto too nkoitoi inono, eiteru teina olong apa nikintobiruaki, o menoti ing'ok tiatua iyie.

English: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence, and thou hast sinned: therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God: and I will destroy thee, O covering cherub, from the midst of the stones of fire.
Masaai: Ore te nkumoi e biashara ino nikibore apa iyie olarrabal, nias iyie eng'oki; neaku aatanang'ayie iyie anaa entoki naisarkionieki aaitung'uaa oldoinyo le Nkai, ore ilo kerubi arriponi nikiaraa iyie aipungie ong'ata aitung'uaa empolos e lelo soito ooimerlel.

English: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty, thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness: I will cast thee to the ground, I will lay thee before kings, that they may behold thee.
Masaai: Ore apa oltau lino naa kewuasa te nkaraki enkishiaa ino; inyala iyie eng'eno ino nagut te sikar ino. Aatanang'aka iyie enkop; aataboloyie iyie te dukuya ilaiguanak meitaraposho nkonyek enye te iyie.

English: Thou hast defiled thy sanctuaries by the multitude of thine iniquities, by the iniquity of thy traffick; therefore will I bring forth a fire from the midst of thee, it shall devour thee, and I will bring thee to ashes upon the earth in the sight of all them that behold thee.
Masaai: Ore te nkumoi oo ing'ok inyi, teina nemetii esipata biashara inyi nisarkionie iwuejitin inono sinyat, neaku ayaua atua iyie enkima aitung'uaa erishata ino; nikinya ninye iyie amut, naaibelekeny iyie aitaa nkuruon tioriong enkop, te dukuya lelo pooki likitoduaa iyie.

English: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee: thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt thou be any more.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki likiyiolo iyie too loreren neing'asia te iyie, itabaikia iyie enkiting'oto torrono, nimintoki atii intarasi.”

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face against Zidon, and prophesy against it,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, intorioki enkomom ino enkalo e Sidon, nimbonoki aarare ninye

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
Masaai: nijo inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, oi iyie Sidon, naa kaibalie enkitoo ai tiatua iyie, naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nayau inkiguanat shumata ninye, naibalunye esinyatisho ai tiatua ninye;

English: For I will send into her pestilence, and blood into her street; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: amu kairriu olmeitai atua ninye, nairriwaki osarge inkoitoi enyena naalala enkanasa; ore lelo oari to lalem nebatata tiatuaninye, te ilo alem oarare ninye too nkaloli pooki. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Ore teina aji e Israel nemeitokini aata ilkiku oorem arashu eitame lelo oomanita ootaarare ninche. Ina pee eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tenaiturrur ina aji e Israel tiatua lelo oreren ooidapashakaki ninche, naibalie esinyatisho ai tiatua ninche te dukuya lelo oreren pooki, neaku kepuo aatoni te nkop enye maate ina naishoo apa osinka lai Yakobo.

English: And they shall dwell safely therein, and shall build houses, and plant vineyards; yea, they shall dwell with confidence, when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them; and they shall know that I am the LORD their God.
Masaai: Naa ketoni tiatua ninye te seriani naa keshet ninche inkajijik neun inkurman oo sabibu. Naa ketoni tiatua te seriani, ina kata nayau adung'oki enkiguana shumata lelo le latia enye lelo ootarare ninye te ng'oro sapuk. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye.”

English: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, in the twelfth day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon, lo lapa le tomon, te nkolong e tomon aare o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii nanu naajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against all Egypt:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare taarare Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, nimbonoki aarare ninye niarare sii Misiri pooki;

English: Speak, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers, which hath said, My river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
Masaai: irorie nijo, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie, Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, ilo asurai kitok olejisho, te mpolos oo nchorroi enyena, ina najo, ‘Ore olkeju le Nail naa olalai ake; nanu oitobirua ninye.’

English: But I will put hooks in thy jaws, and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales, and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers, and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales.
Masaai: Ekaapik ilala oololo iltagiligil linono, naisho lelo sinkir loonchorroi inyi mikimbung'a iyie akurraki, naa kaaitayu iyie aitupuku tempolos oo inchorroi inono, nena nikimbung iyie.

English: And I will leave thee thrown into the wilderness, thee and all the fish of thy rivers: thou shalt fall upon the open fields; thou shalt not be brought together, nor gathered: I have given thee for meat to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven.
Masaai: Naa kaanang'aki iyie ong'ota, iyie tenebo lelo sinkir pooki loo nchorroni inono; isulakinono enkoriong e ong'ota naisiasha, nemeiturrurri intae aapuo aanukaa. Meinosa intae ing'uesi e ina kop o montonyi o loing'ang'e aaishooyie iyie taa endaa enye.

English: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the LORD, because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
Masaai: “Ina peyie eyilou lelo pooki oomanya Misiri aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani. Amu itaa apa iyie eng'udi entiyani te nkaji e Israel.

English: When they took hold of thee by thy hand, thou didst break, and rend all their shoulder: and when they leaned upon thee, thou brakest, and madest all their loins to be at a stand.
Masaai: Ore tinikimbung ninche iyie te nkaina, nigiligili, nipolososo iloilila lenye pooki; naa tenepetaa ninche intae, nigiligili, ninchosho impolosi enye pooki meikirikirata;

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will bring a sword upon thee, and cut off man and beast out of thee.
Masaai: metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, ekayau olalem shumata iyie, naa kadung'oo te iyie oltung'ani o eng'ues;

English: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste; and they shall know that I am the LORD: because he hath said, The river is mine, and I have made it.
Masaai: ore ina kop e Misiri neaku mitil nemeeta toki natii. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo ara Olaitoriani. “Ore amu itejo iyie ore olkeju le Nail naa olalai, nanu oitobira,

English: Behold, therefore I am against thee, and against thy rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt utterly waste and desolate, from the tower of Syene even unto the border of Ethiopia.
Masaai: neaku ing'ura ajo kaarare iyie; naarare inchorroi inono, naa kaitaa enkop e Misiri enkop mitil nemetii toki, eiteru te Migdol ometabaiki Siene, o meshomo abaiki olpolosie le Etiopia.

English: No foot of man shall pass through it, nor foot of beast shall pass through it, neither shall it be inhabited forty years.
Masaai: Meetae enkeju e tung'ani naim atua ninye, nemeetae enkeju e ng'ues naim atua ninye; keaku ninye mitil ilarin artam.

English: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years: and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa enkop e Misiri enkop mitil tiatua nkuapi mitili; ore inkanas enyena neaku mijoonto ilarin artam tiatua nena anas naaidaikieki. Ekaidapashaki Ilmisiri iloreren, naidapash ninche toonkuapi.

English: Yet thus saith the Lord GOD; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered:
Masaai: “Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tenkiting'oto oo larin artam naa kaiturrurru Ilmisiri too loreren lelo pooki ooidapashakaki ninche;

English: And I will bring again the captivity of Egypt, and will cause them to return into the land of Pathros, into the land of their habitation; and they shall be there a base kingdom.
Masaai: naa kashukoki Misiri entonata enye e apake, nashukoki ninche ina kop e Patros, ina kop naa ninye apa eing'uaa; neaku ninye teine enkitoria nashal.

English: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations: for I will diminish them, that they shall no more rule over the nations.
Masaai: Keaku ninye enkitoria nashal too nkitoriat pooki nemeitoki ae kata aigil ailepie kewan too loreren; naa kaitaa ninche kiti oleng metaa meitoki ae kata aaitore iloreren.

English: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel, which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance, when they shall look after them: but they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Nemeitoki ae kata aaku osiligi leina aji e Israel, edamu ing'ok enye, ina kata eibelekenyakino ninche eing'oru eretoto enye. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And it came to pass in the seven and twentieth year, in the first month, in the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam o naapishana to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon neishoo enjore enye metaasisho oleng earare Turo, ore pooki dukuya netabarnoki ore pooki oililai netujutoki aasip; ore ake eyia eitu hoo etum ninye arashu enjore enye ae toki naing'uaa Turopeyie elak ina siaai nataasa earare ninye.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will give the land of Egypt unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon; and he shall take her multitude, and take her spoil, and take her prey; and it shall be the wages for his army.
Masaai: Neaku inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kaisho ina kop e Misiri Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon; naa kenap ninye arsisisho enye neitaa ninye enaaruno neidaikie ninye; naa keaku elaata enjore enye.

English: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it, because they wrought for me, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Aishoo ninye ina kop e misiri metaa olerrinyore teina naisiayua, amu nanu eisiaayia ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong naa kaitubulu emowuo ti atua enkaji e Israel, naa kabol inkutukie inyi tiatua ninche. Ina peyie eyilou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii; naajoki:

English: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonisho nijo, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Teyietu nchira, ‘Woi ina olong!’

English: For the day is near, even the day of the LORD is near, a cloudy day; it shall be the time of the heathen.
Masaai: Amu etinyikua ina olong! etinyikua ina olong o Laitoriani; keaku enkolong oo nkatampo enkata enkidaaroto too loreren.

English: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
Masaai: Kelotu olalem shumata Misiri, nejing oloputukunyi sapuk Etiopia, ina kata nabatata lelo oo yieng'i te Misiri, nenapi arsisisho enye aaya, ore ilkitamanyunot nepolosi aauroo.

English: Ethiopia, and Libya, and Lydia, and all the mingled people, and Chub, and the men of the land that is in league, shall fall with them by the sword.
Masaai: Ore Etiopia, o Put, o Lud o Arabia pooki, o Libya o iltung'ana pooki le nkop ooibung'are, naa kebatata te nebo to lalem.

English: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Ore lelo oretu Misiri naa kebatata, ore olwuasa lenye le ngolon enye nedou; eiteru te Migdol o meshomo Siene kebatatakino ninye to lalem, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate, and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted.
Masaai: Neaku ninye mitil tiatua nena kuapi mitili, ore inkanas enyena nejing empolos e nena anas naaitomijoonoki.

English: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have set a fire in Egypt, and when all her helpers shall be destroyed.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nainuaaki enkima Misiri, ore ilaretok lenye pooki negili.

English: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid, and great pain shall come upon them, as in the day of Egypt: for, lo, it cometh.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong nepuo lelo kiliku ooisarrisar ooing'uaa enatii, aaiture lelo le Etiopia meiteiki. Nejing ninche emion o sina teina olong e nkidaata e Misiri, amu, ng'ura, etabawua!

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaiting'ie karsisisho e Misiri, teina aina e Nebukadresa olaiguanani le Babilon.

English: He and his people with him, the terrible of the nations, shall be brought to destroy the land: and they shall draw their swords against Egypt, and fill the land with the slain.
Masaai: Ninye tenebo iltung'ana lenyena, inkuapi torrok oleng too loreren, eyauni ninche meidaikie ina kop; naa keshurtu ninche ilalema lenye aarare Misiri, neiput ina kop lelo meneng'a.

English: And I will make the rivers dry, and sell the land into the hand of the wicked: and I will make the land waste, and all that is therein, by the hand of strangers: I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Naa kaitoi nanu olkeju le Nail, namiraki ina kop inkaik oo ltung'ana torrok; Kayau ina kop aitaa mitil o pooki toki natii atua ninye te ina aina oo ltung'ana leeiking'a nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also destroy the idols, and I will cause their images to cease out of Noph; and there shall be no more a prince of the land of Egypt: and I will put a fear in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekaidaikie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin nemeishu, naiting'ie nena kitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin naatii Memfis; meitoki atii ae kata olkitok ina kop e Misiri; neaku kapik enkuretisho ina kop e Misiri.

English: And I will make Pathros desolate, and will set fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments in No.
Masaai: Ekaitaa Patros mitil, naisuroki enkima Soan nayau inkiaasin enkiguana shumata Tebes.

English: And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.
Masaai: Naa kabukoki engoro ai shumata Pelusium ilo sempewuet le Misiri, nadung'oo olorora le Tebes.

English: And I will set fire in Egypt: Sin shall have great pain, and No shall be rent asunder, and Noph shall have distresses daily.
Masaai: Naa kaisuroki enkima Misiri; ore Pelusium neigor enkigoroto kitok; ore Tebes nepiki ilusien, ore isunta enyena neurori aasulaki enkop.

English: The young men of Aven and of Pi-beseth shall fall by the sword: and these cities shall go into captivity.
Masaai: Ore ilbarnot le On o Pibeset, nebatatakino ilo alem; ore inkituaak nepuo e araroto.

English: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
Masaai: Ore te Tehafnehes keaku ina olong enaimin, ina kata nagil teine enkitoria e Misiri, ore ina golon enye olwuasa nebaiki enkiting'oto; keitoipi ninye te nkatampoi, ore ntoyie enyena nepuo eararoto.

English: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Neaku neijia aikunaki endung'okinoto enkiguana shumata e Misiri, Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo, to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e naapishana o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, atigila ina aina e Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, naa ing'ura, eton eitu erubi ninye, peyie eishiunyeki ninye teenata enkarasha, peyie metum ninye atagolo peyie meidimu ayuko olalem.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
Masaai: Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaarare nanu Farao olaiguanani le Misiri, naa kagil inkaik enyena, pokira are, aa ina nagol o ina natigile; naa kaisho olalem lenye epuku te nkaina enye.

English: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
Masaai: Ekaidapashaa Ilmisiri tiatua iloreren, naidapashaa ninche tiatua iloreren tiatua inkuapi.

English: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword in his hand: but I will break Pharaoh's arms, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
Masaai: Naa kaitagol enkaina e ilo aiguanani le Babilon, napik enkaina enye olalem lai; kake kagil nena aik e Farao naa keigor te dukuya ninye anaa oltung'ani otipikaki olbae aaidop.

English: But I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ekaitagol nena aik o laiguanani le Babilon, kake ore nena aik e Farao naa kebatata; naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani. Ore ina kata napik olalem lai nkaik olaiguanani le Babilon, naa keitorioo ninye aarare ina kop e Misiri;

English: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them among the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: naa kaidapashaki Ilmisiri atua iloreren, naidapashaa meshomo too nkuapi pooki. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon oobo, to lapa li okuni, te nkolong e dukuya olapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, tiaaki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri o lororani lenyena inchere: “Aing'ae doi inyaanyukie iyie te sapuko ino?

English: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, and of an high stature; and his top was among the thick boughs.
Masaai: Ing'ura, ekaaitanyaanyukie iyie oltarakuai otii Lebanon, oota ilng'osil sidain, neeta oloip le ntim, naa keado oleng, ore enkadori enye netii nkatampo.

English: The waters made him great, the deep set him up on high with her rivers running round about his plants, and sent out her little rivers unto all the trees of the field.
Masaai: Ore inkariak neitoti ninye, ore eng'uton enye neisho ninye metaadoro neitaa lelo kejek lenyena ilooruko, neitaman ine wueji netuunieki, neidapashaa inchorroi enyena, aidapashaki lelo keek pooki le ntim.

English: Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field, and his boughs were multiplied, and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters, when he shot forth.
Masaai: Metaa eilepa ninye oleng alus ilkeek pooki le ntim, ore ilng'osil lenyena sapuki nebul aasapuku; neado ilng'osil lenyena, te nkaraki enkare sapuk too ntona enyena.

English: All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young, and under his shadow dwelt all great nations.
Masaai: Ore imotonyi pooki o loing'ang'e, neitobira isinkin enye too lng'osil lenyena sapuki; ore abori ilng'osil lenyena netii ing'uesi pooki e ong'ata, neisho teina aaiu nkera enye; ore abori oloip lenye, netii iloreren kituaak.

English: Thus was he fair in his greatness, in the length of his branches: for his root was by great waters.
Masaai: Aisidai apa oleng te sapuko enye; o te nkadori oo lng'osil lenyena; amu eshomo intona enyena abori, ine netii inkariak kumok.

English: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him: the fir trees were not like his boughs, and the chesnut trees were not like his branches; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty.
Masaai: Ore iltarakua ootii enkurma e Nkai nemekeshare ninye, nemeirisiore lelo keek oo nyori ilng'osil lenyena; ore lelo keek oorisiore naa pesho, tinintanyaanyukie ilng'osil lenyena; meetae olchani te nkurma Enkai o nyaanyukie ninye te sidano.

English: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches: so that all the trees of Eden, that were in the garden of God, envied him.
Masaai: Aitobira ninye aikishiaan, tenkumoi oolng'osil lenyena, ore lelo keek pooki le Eden neng'uar ninye, lelo ootii apa enkurma e Nkai.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height, and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu etubulua ninye ajing atua inkatampo, ore oltau lenye newuasa te nkaraki enkadori enye,

English: I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen; he shall surely deal with him: I have driven him out for his wickedness.
Masaai: ekapik ninye atua enkaina e ilo magilani loo loreren naa kearare ninye anaa enatiu ing'ok enyena, atanang'ayie ninye ong'ota.

English: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, have cut him off, and have left him: upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow, and have left him.
Masaai: Ore ilomon lelo torrok oleng loo loreren, naa kedung ninye aauroo neing'uaa. Edoiki inchumat oo ldoinyo o nong'ot pooki ilng'osil lenyena, ore lelo ng'osil lenyena sapuki neirrag too wuejitin pooki neeim inchorroi eina kop; ore iloreren pooki le nkop nepuo aaing'uaa oloip lenye aaing'uaa ninye.

English: Upon his ruin shall all the fowls of the heaven remain, and all the beasts of the field shall be upon his branches:
Masaai: Ore teina kidaaroto enye netonie imotonyi pooki oloing'ang'e, ore atua ilng'osil lenyena, netonie ing'uesi pooki oo nkong'at.

English: To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height, neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs, neither their trees stand up in their height, all that drink water: for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: Ore kuna pooki naa inchere peyie meeta ilkeek le mbata enkare oobulu aaika oleng teshumata arashu epik ilukuny enye inkatampo, nemeetae likae shani ook enkare ebaiki shumata ninche te nkadori; amu eishooki ninche pooki metuata, teina kop oo lmeneng'a natii tung'ani oye, tenebo lelo oopuo olodo le nkop.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning: I covered the deep for him, and I restrained the floods thereof, and the great waters were stayed: and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore peyie elo abori enemeneng'a, naa kaitaa enegut pee eishir te nkaraki ninye, naibok lelo kejek lenyena pooki, ore inkariak kumok nedung'i; naishopoki Lebanon osina te nkaraki ninye, ore ilkeek pooki liong'ota netoito te nkaraki ninye.

English: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit: and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
Masaai: Ekaisho iloreren meikirikirata to ltoilo lembatata enye, ina kata nanang'aki ninye abori enemeneng'a tenebo lelo oopuo tenebo engumoto; ore lelo keek pooki le Eden, lelo ooisul gelunot sidain le Lebanon, lelo pooki ook enkare, neitagoli to lodo le nkop.

English: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword; and they that were his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen.
Masaai: Ekepuo sii ninche abori enemeneng'a tenebo ninye, ine netii lelo ootaraki to lalem; ee, lelo ootoni tiabori oloip too loreren naa keish.

English: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth: thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ira naa iyie ng'ae onyaanyuke te nkisisa o te nkitoo tiatua lelo kejek le Eden? Aikintadoiyiori iyie tenebo lelo keek le Eden aaya olodo le nkop; nirrag iyie tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem. “Ore ele naa Farao tenebo olorora lenye pooki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon aare, to alapa le tomon aare, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him, Thou art like a young lion of the nations, and thou art as a whale in the seas: and thou camest forth with thy rivers, and troubledst the waters with thy feet, and fouledst their rivers.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, teyietu inchiraki Farao olaiguanani le Misiri nijoki ninye: “Itadamua iyie aitaa kewan olng'atuny tiatua iloreren, kake itiu iyie anaa olasurai otii inaaiposha; idanya iyie apuku too lkejek linono, nintanyamal inkariak too nkejek inono, nindurukie ilkejek lenye.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people; and they shall bring thee up in my net.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ekanang'aki orreshet lai shumata iyie; tenebo olorora sapuk loo ltung'ana; naa kaaikurtutaa iyie tiatua orreshet lai.

English: Then will I leave thee upon the land, I will cast thee forth upon the open field, and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee, and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
Masaai: Naa kaanang'ie iyie enkop, ore te nkong'ata naisiaja naayieng iyie naisho ilmotonyi pooki lo loing'ang'e mikitadoiki iyie, naitaraposh ng'uesi enkop te iyie.

English: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, and fill the valleys with thy height.
Masaai: Naidapashaki inkiri inyi inchumat oo ldoinyo, naiput inong'ot too mpopoki inono.

English: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; and the rivers shall be full of thee.
Masaai: Naa kaitadooyo osarge lino te nkop o too ldoinyo; nimput iyie lelo shorroi.

English: And when I shall put thee out, I will cover the heaven, and make the stars thereof dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light.
Masaai: Ore peyie aajutoo iyie, naa kaitoip keper o loing'ang'e lenye, naitomisimis ilakir lenye; naa kaitoip enkolong te nkatampoi, nemeitoki olapa aitayu ewang'an enye.

English: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee, and set darkness upon thy land, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore ilkilang'ilang'eta pooki le shumata na kaitomisimis te shumata iyie, napik enaimin shumata enkop ino ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: I will also vex the hearts of many people, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
Masaai: “Ekaitanyamal sii iltauja loo ltung'ana kumok, ina kata naaya iyie eyarunoto tiatua iloreren, naapik iyie inkuapi neitu iyiolou.

English: Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
Masaai: Ekaisho iltung'ana kumok meing'asiata te nkaraki iyie, ore ilaiguanak lenye neilanyisho te nkaraki iyie, ina kata naiwul olalem lai te dukuya ninche; naa keikirikira pooki kata, pooki ng'ae te nkaraki enkishui enye, teina olong' embatatata ino.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore ilo alem lo laiguanani le Babilon naa kelotu shumata iyie.

English: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
Masaai: Ekaitaa olorora linyi metabatatata too lalema loo lmagil, ninche pooki lelo torrok oleng too loreren. “Naa kayau aitaa olemeetae ilo wuasa le Misiri, ore ilororani lenyena pooki naa keish.

English: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
Masaai: Kaidaikie nanu ing'uesi enyena pooki, too nkiyopat oo nkariak kumok; nemeetae enkeju e tung'ani naitoki aitanyamal ninche aigil, nemeitoki lelo oisotok loo ng'uesi aaitanyamal ninche.

English: Then will I make their waters deep, and cause their rivers to run like oil, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ina peyie aitaa nkariak enye inaasila, naisho ilkejek lenye meturukoto anaa eilata, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate, and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full, when I shall smite all them that dwell therein, then shall they know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ina kata naitaa enkop e Misiri mitil, o ina kata nakinyi enkop te pooki nabore, o ina kata naosh lelo pooki ootii atua ninye, naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament her: the daughters of the nations shall lament her: they shall lament for her, even for Egypt, and for all her multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore ele naa osinkolio lo lkiyioi opuoi aarany; ore nena toyie oo loshon nepuo aaranyaki; Misiri tenebo lelo pooki ororani lenyena, kepuo ninche aarany ilo sinkolio ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o are, to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon o imiet o lapa, nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, inchiraki ilo orora le Misiri nirriwaa ninche abori, ninye tenebo nena toyie kituaak oo loreren, ine olodo le nkop, enetii lelo ooshomo abori enemeneng'a ijoki ninye:

English: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
Masaai: ‘Aing'ae doi italang'a iyie te nkishiaa? Shomo abori, nikirragieki iyie tenebo ilememurata.’

English: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword: she is delivered to the sword: draw her and all her multitudes.
Masaai: “Kebatatakino ninche erishata e lelo ootaraki to lalem, ore tenebo ninye neirrag olorora pooki lenye.

English: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him: they are gone down, they lie uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak magil naa keimaki imbaa naaipirta ninche, tenebo ilaretok lenye, tiatua empolos e nemeneng'a ejo: ‘Etadoutuo ninche abori, neirrag aaitirring'a, lelo lememurata, ootaraki to lalem.’

English: Asshur is there and all her company: his graves are about him: all of them slain, fallen by the sword:
Masaai: “Etii sii Asiria ine, tenebo olorora lenye pooki, nemanita ninye inkuraren enye, lelo pooki ootaraki, ootumutaki to lalem;

English: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit, and her company is round about her grave: all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which caused terror in the land of the living.
Masaai: lelo ootipikaki nkuraren enye nenen wuejitin neeg'ut oleng e nemeneng'a nemanita olturrur lo lorora enkurare enye, etaraki pooki aabatat to lalem, ilo oidapashaa olkirutoto tiatua ina kop oo loishu.

English: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, which caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: “Eti sii Elam ine, nemanita ninye olorora lenye pooki enkurare enye; netaraki pooki, aabatat to lalem, lelo lememurata ooshomo atua olodo le nkop, lelo oidapashaa olkirutoto teina kop oo loishu, neya enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oopuo abori eng'umoto.

English: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword: though their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit: he is put in the midst of them that be slain.
Masaai: Eitobirakita ninye endapash tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem tenebo olorara nemanita ninye inkuraren enyena, lelo pooki lememurata lelo ootaraki to lalem; amu eidapashakaki olkirutoto lenye ninche ina kop oo looishu, nenap ninche enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oopuo adoyio aapuo eitaboitakaki ninche lelo ootaraki to lalem.

English: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
Masaai: “Etii sii ine Meshek, o Tubal, tenebo olorora lenye pooki, emanita inkuraren enye ninche, lelo pooki lememurata, ootaraki to lalem; amu eidapasha ninche olkirutoto teina kop oo loishu.

English: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised, which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war: and they have laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities shall be upon their bones, though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living.
Masaai: Nemeirrag ninche tenebo lelo ootabatatate magil liopa lelo ooshomo abori enemeneng'a tenebo imasaa enye olarrabal, lelo ooiteleikiaki ilalema lenye abori ilukuny enye, ore ilong'oi enye neiteleikino iloik lenye; amu ore olkirutoto le lelo tung'ana magil netii enkop e lelo ooishu.

English: Yea, thou shalt be broken in the midst of the uncircumcised, and shalt lie with them that are slain with the sword.
Masaai: Metaa aikigili iyie nikirragieki tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem.

English: There is Edom, her kings, and all her princes, which with their might are laid by them that were slain by the sword: they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: “Etii sii Edom ine, o ilaiguanak lenyena tenebo ilkituaak lenye pooki, laa ore te ngolon enye pooki neirragieki tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem; neirrag ninche tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo oopuo abori enemeneng'a.

English: There be the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, which are gone down with the slain; with their terror they are ashamed of their might; and they lie uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
Masaai: “Etii sii ilkituaak le moikuape ine ninche pooki tenebo ile Sidon pooki lelo ooshomo abori te nkurruna tenebo lelo ootaraki, tenebo ina kirutoto pooki nayautua te nkaraki olkirutoto lenye eirragie ninche memurata tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem, nenap enkurruna enye tenebo lelo oodoyio aapuo enemeneng'a engumoto.

English: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Ore peyie edol Farao ninche, neilejilej kewan to lorora lenye pooki, ore Farao tenebo enjore enye pooki, naaraa to lalem ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: For I have caused my terror in the land of the living: and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Amu eidapashayie olkirutoto te nkop oo loishu; metaa keirragieki ninye tenebo lelo lememurata, tenebo lelo ootaraki to lalem, Farao tenebo olorora lenye pooki, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them, When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man of their coasts, and set him for their watchman:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, irorie iltung'ana linono nijoki ninche, tenelo nayau olalem shumata enkop, negelu iltung'ana oltung'ani obo tiatua ate, neitaa ninye olarriponi lenye;

English: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
Masaai: naa tenedol ninye olalem elotu shumata enkop neosh entarumpeta aitayiolo iltung'ana;

English: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
Masaai: neaku ore pooki ng'ae otoning'o ilo toilo leina tarumpeta neitaa parmetii, nelotu olalem aar ninye, ore osarge lenye naa shumata endukuya enye eaku etii.

English: He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him. But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul.
Masaai: Etoning'o ninye ilo toilo leina tarumpeta, neitu esuj ina naitayioloki ninye; ekeaku etii osarge lenye shumata enkorrok enye. Kake tenetusuja ina naitayioloki, anaata eitajeuo enkishui enye.

English: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.
Masaai: Kake te nedolu olarriponi olalem elotu nemeosh ninye ina tarumpeta, metaa eitu eitayioloi iltung'ana, nelotu olalem, neya ake ninye obo lenye; ore ilo tung'ani newaki too ng'ok enyena, kake ore osarge lenye naa kaikilikuanu too nkaik e ilo arriponi.

English: So thou, O son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth, and warn them from me.
Masaai: “Metaa ore iyie enkerai e tung'ani, aaitaa iyie olarriponi te nkaraki enkaji e Israel; ore pooki kata nining ororei oing'uaa enkutuk ai, naa intayiolo ninche olkilikuai oing'uaa enatii.

English: When I say unto the wicked, O wicked man, thou shalt surely die; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at thine hand.
Masaai: Tenelo najoki ilo torrono, Oi iyie ele tung'ani torrono, meeta inchere pee miye neitu iyie irorie ilo torrono aitayiolo meibelekenyunye aing'uaa enkoitoi enye, ore ilo tung'ani torrono naa keye tiatua ing'ok enyena, kake ore osarge lenye naikilikuanu too nkaik inono.

English: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it; if he do not turn from his way, he shall die in his iniquity; but thou hast delivered thy soul.
Masaai: Kake tinintayiolo ilo torrono pee eibelekenyunye te nkoitoi enye, neitu eibelekenyunye ninye te nkoitoi enye; naa keye ninye too ng'ok enyena, kake intajeuo iyie enkishui ino.

English: Therefore, O thou son of man, speak unto the house of Israel; Thus ye speak, saying, If our transgressions and our sins be upon us, and we pine away in them, how should we then live?
