Masaai: “Ore iyie nakerai e tung'ani, tiaaki ina aji e Israel, Inji itejo iyie: ‘Ore inkitarruorot ang tenebo ing'ok ang netii shumata iyiook, nikiishunye iyiook pesho te nkaraki ninche, kaji naa kinko tinikinchu?’

English: Say unto them, As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, maata nanu enchipai te keeya e ilo torrono, kake peyie eibelekenya ilo torrono te nkoitoi enye peyie eishu; imbelekenyunye, imbelekenyunye too nkoitoi inono torrok; ainyoo doi peyie iye iyie, oi naaji e Israel?

English: Therefore, thou son of man, say unto the children of thy people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression: as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth.
Masaai: Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, tiaaki iltung'ana linono, ore esipata e ilo supat nemeitajeu ninye teneas entorroni; naa ore teina torroni e ilo torrono nemebatata te ninye teneibelekenyunye te nkitarruorroto enye; ore ilo supat nemeitoki aidim atotona te supatisho enye teneas eng'oki.

English: When I shall say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his own righteousness, and commit iniquity, all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, he shall die for it.
Masaai: Ore hoo natiaaka ilo supat meeta inchere peyie meton ninye eishu, kake ore ake peyie eisilig ninye esipata enye neas intorrok, meetae hoo nabo oosiatin enyena esupatisho naaitokini aadamu; kake ekeye ninye tiatua ina ng'oki nataasa.

English: Again, when I say unto the wicked, Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
Masaai: Ore ake sii, hoo natiaaka ilo torrono, ‘Meeta inchere aimiye,’ kake ilo teneibelekenyunye too ng'ok enyena, neas ina nasipa naishaakino,

English: If the wicked restore the pledge, give again that he had robbed, walk in the statutes of life, without committing iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
Masaai: tenelo neshuku ilo torrono ina nainosie apa olmumai, neshuku ina apa nawa te nkikonya, nelo too nkoitoi enkishon, nemeitoki aas enkarruoisho; naa kesipa keton katukul eishu, nemeye ninye.

English: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him: he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
Masaai: Meetae hoo eng'oki nabo oo naataasa apa ninye naitokini aadamu te nkaraki ninye; etaasa ninye ina naishaakino nesipa, nemeeta inchere pee meton ninye eishu.

English: Yet the children of thy people say, The way of the Lord is not equal: but as for them, their way is not equal.
Masaai: “Kake ejoito ake sii iltung'ana linono inchere, ‘Ore enkoitoi o Laitoriani nemetii esipata;’ naa inkoitoi enye maate metii esipata.

English: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
Masaai: Ore teneibelekenya osupat aing'uaa esipata enye makewan, neas enkarruoisho, naa keye ninye te nkaraki ina.

English: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
Masaai: Naa teneibelekenya ilo torrono aing'uaa entorroni enye, neas ina naishaakino neas nasipa, neton eishu teina.

English: Yet ye say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O ye house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.
Masaai: Nijojo ake sii, ‘Ore ina oitoi o Laitoriani nemesipa’; iyie na aji e Israel, ekaiguanare pooki ng'ae linyi terisioroto oo nkoitoi enyena.”

English: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying, The city is smitten.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon aare le araroto ang, to lapa le tomon, te nkolong e imiet o lapa nelotu oltung'ani oisikua aing'uaa Yerusalem enatii nanu naajoki: “Etabatate enkanasa.”

English: Now the hand of the LORD was upon me in the evening, afore he that was escaped came; and had opened my mouth, until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
Masaai: Etii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu ina teipa eng'or elotunoto e ilo oisikua; netabolo ninye enkutuk ai te ina kata naewuo ilo tung'ani enatii tadekenya; metaa etaboloki apa enkutuk ai, nemeekure ara olemeiro.

English: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak, saying, Abraham was one, and he inherited the land: but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore lelo oomanya kunen neetumutaki te nkop e Israel, nejoito; ore apa Abraham naa oltung'ani obo ake, kake enoto ninye aitaa ina kop enenye, nikira iyiook kumok, esipa tukul eishooki iyiook enkop maitaa enaang.”

English: Wherefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes toward your idols, and shed blood: and shall ye possess the land?
Masaai: Neaku, tiaaki ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Inyanya intae inkiri tenebo osarge, nidumakiki inkonyek inyi inkitanyaanyukot oo inkaitin inyi nemeishu, nimbukoo osarge; intokiki ake aaku iloopeny ena kop?

English: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour's wife: and shall ye possess the land?
Masaai: Ipikipiki ilo alem aaitaa osiligi linyi, niasiasa inolminong ore pooki ng'ae linyi neidurukie enkitok ole latia enye; ijojo iakuku iloopeny ena kop?

English: Say thou thus unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; As I live, surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
Masaai: Tiaaki ena ninche, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore anaa enaishu nanu, esipa tukul ajo ore lelo ootii iwuejitin neidaaitie naa kebatata to lalem; ore ilo otii enkong'ata naisiaja naa kaisho ninye ing'uesi entim meinosa, ore lelo ootii isempewueti o lootii nkapuniaa naa keye to lmeitai.

English: For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa ina kop mitil naidaayie, ore ina golon enye nawuasare nebaiki enkiting'oto; ore lelo doinyo le Israel neaku mitili oleng metaa meetae hoo oloim empolos enye.

English: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed.
Masaai: Ina pee eyilou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani ina kata naitaa ina kop enkop mitil naitomijoon naa ene pesho te nkaraki nena baa olminong lenye pooki naataasa ninche.

English: Also, thou son of man, the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying, Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD.
Masaai: “Ore te iyie, enkerai e tung'ani, ore iltung'ana linyi ooiro tenebo tenkaraki iyie too sunta, o too nkutukie oo nkajijik, ejokino ninche maate, pooki ng'ae ejoki olalashe lenye, ‘Wou sii iyietoning'o ajo kalo rorei ilo olotu aing'uaa Olaitoriani.’

English: And they come unto thee as the people cometh, and they sit before thee as my people, and they hear thy words, but they will not do them: for with their mouth they shew much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness.
Masaai: Nepuonu enitii anaa enapuonu iltung'ana enitii, netoni te dukuya intae anaa iltung'ana laainei; neinining ina nijo iyie kake meas ninche ina amu eibalunye oleng too nkutukie enye enyorrata sapuk, kake ore iltauja lenye netii atua dupoto enye.

English: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
Masaai: Naa, ing'ura, itiu iyie te ninche anaa ilo oranyaki isinkolioitin le nyorrata, to ltoilo sidai oleng neosh te nkarriyiano e nkinanda, amu ening ninche ina nijo, kake meas ninche ina.

English: And when this cometh to pass, (lo, it will come,) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.
Masaai: Ore peyie elotu ena, naa kelotu ninye, ina peyie eyiolou aajo etii apa oloiboni atua ninche.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii, naajoki:

English: Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto the shepherds; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the flocks?
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, imbonoki taarare lelo airritak le Israel, imbonoki tiaaki ninche, o metabaiki lelo airritak inchere: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Oi ilairritak le Israel lelo ooitotito ate! Amaa ilairritak aimeitoti intare?

English: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
Masaai: Inyanya intae nena naapir, ninchopokiki ate inkilani oo lpapit loo ntare, niyieng'iyieng'e nena naaisul te mpiron; kake mintotiti intae nena tare.

English: The diseased have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought again that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force and with cruelty have ye ruled them.
Masaai: Ore nena naashal neitu intagoligolo, ore nena naamuoi neitu inchiunyenye, ore nena ng'ojiniaa neitu iruburubu, ore nena naatapong'ori neitu irrinyunyu, ore inaaimina neitu ing'oruru, neaku te ngolon o te nking'odia intoria ninche.

English: And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.
Masaai: Metaa eidapashate ninche, amu metii apa olairritani; neaku ninche endaa oo ng'uesi pooki e ntim.

English: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
Masaai: Eidapashaki apa intare aainei, nepuaya ninche too ldoinyo pooki, o te pooki doinyo naado; ore intare aainei neidapashi te nkoriong enkop pooki, meetae obo oikilikuanua arashu oing'oru ninche.

English: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
Masaai: “Metaa, entoning intae lo airritak ororei lo Laitoriani ejo:

English: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely because my flock became a prey, and my flock became meat to every beast of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did my shepherds search for my flock, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not my flock;
Masaai: Ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ore amu etaa intare aainei entoki nainosi, netaa intare aainei endaa nanya ing'uesi pooki entim, anaa ae metii olairritani; neaku ore amu eitu eing'oru ilairritak laainei intare aainei, kake eitotito ate ilairritak, neitu eitoti intare aainei;

English: Therefore, O ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;
Masaai: neaku entoning intae ilairritak ororei lo Laitoriani:

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my flock at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the flock; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth, that they may not be meat for them.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ing'ura ajo kaarare lelo airritak; naa kayieu nanu intare aainei too nkaik enye, naiting'ie te ninche ina kitotio enye oo ntare; meigil ae kata ilairritak aaitoti ate. Ekaitajeu nanu intare aainei too nkutukie enye, peyie meitoki aaku endaa te ninche.

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
Masaai: “Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, nanu, nanu kewan oing'oru intare aainei, nalilitu ninche.

English: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are scattered; so will I seek out my sheep, and will deliver them out of all places where they have been scattered in the cloudy and dark day.
Masaai: Anaa enaing'oru olchekut intare enyena ina kata naidapashate kulie tare enyena too neelakua, neaku kaing'oru sii nanu ntare aainei; naa kaitajeu ninche too wuejitin pooki neeidapashakaki teina olong natii inkatampo netii sii enaimin narok ong'u.

English: And I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them to their own land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers, and in all the inhabited places of the country.
Masaai: Naa kaitupuku ninche too loreren, naiturrurru ninche too nkuapi naa kayau ninche enkop enye maate; naa kaitoti ninche too ldoinyo le Israel, too nkiyopat e nena shorroi, o too wuejitin pooki neemanyae eina kop.

English: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
Masaai: Kaitoti ninche too wuejitin neeleng, o too nchumat oo ldoinyo le Israel, keaku ninche ndaat enye; ore teine neiperipera ninche te ine te neleng sidai, o too wuejitin neebore olkujita ekedaa ninche too ldoinyo le Israel.

English: I will feed my flock, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore nanu enkewan ai naa kaaku olchekut loo ntare aainei, naa kaisho ninche meirraga, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: I will seek that which was lost, and bring again that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick: but I will destroy the fat and the strong; I will feed them with judgment.
Masaai: Ekaing'oru ina naimina, naa karrinyu ina natapong'ori, naa karub ina ng'ojine, naa kaitagol ina natashala, ore ina napir oina nagol naa kaing'or; naa kaitoti ninche te sipata.

English: And as for you, O my flock, thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, between the rams and the he goats.
Masaai: “Ore intae intare aainei, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, ekaiguanare enker o enker, naiguanare ilmeregeshi o loroi.

English: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have eaten up the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pastures? and to have drunk of the deep waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
Masaai: Aimebaiki intae entadaata too neeleng sidain eji metaa intunyoo ake too nkejek inyi olokeri pooki; niokioko enkare nasila, peyie intunyoo inkulie too nkejek inyi?

English: And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
Masaai: Naa kenya intare aainei nena nintunyoitie too nkejek inyi, neok ina are ning'ola too nkejek inyi?

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them; Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle.
Masaai: “Metaa, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki ninche; ing'ura, ore nanu, nanu enkewan ai ekapik enkiguana erishata oo nkerra naapir o nkerra sasin.

English: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
Masaai: Amu irrumoo te murte o too ronyi, nimponyaa nena pooki naashal too mowuarak inyi, o metaba anaa nindapashakiki ninche pooki wueji,

English: Therefore will I save my flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
Masaai: ekaitajeu nanu intare aainei, meitoki ae kata aaku inaainos ing'uesi; naa kaiguanare erishata e nker o enker.

English: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
Masaai: Naa kaitasheyie olchekut obo oitasheiki ninche, osinka lai Daudi, naa keitoti ninye ninche: ekeitoti ninye ninche neaku ninye olchekut lenye.

English: And I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David a prince among them; I the LORD have spoken it.
Masaai: Ore nanu, Olaitoriani, naa kaaku Enkai enye, ore osinka lai Daudi neaku olkitok tiatua ninche; nanu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land: and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
Masaai: “Ekaitobir tenebo ninche osotua le seriani, naishu ing'uesi pooki entim teina kop, peyie etum aatobik ninche te seriani ti ong'ata neirrag atua entim.

English: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa ninche o nenen wuejitin pooki neemanita ildoinyo laainei e mayianata; naa kairriu aitadou enchan terishata enye; naa ninye enkoirujuruji e emayianata.

English: And the tree of the field shall yield her fruit, and the earth shall yield her increase, and they shall be safe in their land, and shall know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bands of their yoke, and delivered them out of the hand of those that served themselves of them.
Masaai: Ore lelo keek liong'ota neiu ilng'anayio lenye, ore enkop neiu ilng'anayio lenyena, naa keaku ninche ilooserian te nkop enye; neyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nagil iloom le nchata enye oo murto, nalaku ninche aitung'uaa inkaik e lelo ooitaa ninche isinkan.

English: And they shall no more be a prey to the heathen, neither shall the beast of the land devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
Masaai: Meitoki aaigil ae kata aaku eng'ues nainosi iloreren, nemeitoki ilowuarak le ina kop aapolol ninche; eketoni ninche te seriani, nemeeta entoki naitoki aiture ninche.

English: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the heathen any more.
Masaai: Naa kaisho ninche embularoto oo ndaiki metaa meitoki amut ninche esumash teina kop, nemeitoki aatum enyamali enkurruna oo loreren.

English: Thus shall they know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, even the house of Israel, are my people, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa keyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, atii nanu tenebo ninche, naa ore ninche, ina aji e Israel naa iltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Nirara intae intare, intare o lokeri lai, nara nanu Enkai inyi, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare oldoinyo le Seir, nimbonoki aarare ninye

English: And say unto it, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O mount Seir, I am against thee, and I will stretch out mine hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
Masaai: nijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaarare iyie oldoinyo le Seir, naa kaaitorioki enkaina ai aarare iyie, naa kaaidapash iyie naaidaikie naitaa ene pesho.

English: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ekaidaikie inkanas inono niaku iyie mitil; ina pee iyiolou ajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
Masaai: Amu inyor iyie emang'atisho e anaake, ninchoo lelo tung'ana le Israel engolon o lalem te nkata e ngolikinoto enye, te nkata e mutata enye nabayie;

English: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee: sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.
Masaai: metaa, ore anaa enaishu nanu ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekarreten intae te nkaraki osarge naa kesuj intae osarge; amu irara intae arruok te nkaraki osarge, metaa kesuj intae osarge.

English: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth.
Masaai: Ekaitaa oldoinyo le Seir olemetii toki, naitaa mitil; naa kadung'oo te ninye lelo pooki oopuonu atua aaparan nepuo.

English: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men: in thy hills, and in thy valleys, and in all thy rivers, shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
Masaai: Naa kaiput ildoinyo linyi lmpopoki; o too ndoinyo inyi o too nong'ot inyi o iyarat o lashepak linyi pooki kebatata nena pooki to lalem.

English: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaitaa intae mitili anaake, ore inkanas inono nemeitokini aamany. Ina peyie iyiolou ajo ara nanu ilo Aitoriani.

English: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
Masaai: “Ore amu itejo, ‘Ore kulo oshon pokira o kuna kuapi pokira naa keaku inaainei, naa aikintaa ninche inkunaang,’ ore hoo netii apa Olaitoriani ine,

English: Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will even do according to thine anger, and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make myself known among them, when I have judged thee.
Masaai: neaku, ore anaa enaishu nanu, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ekaitaas intae anaa enatiu engoro o enkiba nintodolua te nkaraki enkiba aarare ninche; naa kaitayiolo nanu kewan tiatua intae, ina kata naiguanare intae.

English: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
Masaai: Naa iyiolouu aajo nanu, Olaitoriani otoning'o nena baa pooki torrok nitejo iararere lelo doinyo le Israel, ijojo, ‘Eitaaki ninche mitili, eishooki iyiook maidakie.’

English: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.
Masaai: Nirupurupu intae ate oleng kiararere nanu too nkutukie inyi, niponaa irorei aitaa kumok kiararere nanu; natoning'o nanu ina.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tenkaraki enchipai enkop pooki ekaaitaa iyie mitil.

English: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ore anaa enitishipakine ina jung'o enkaji e Israel, amu aimitil apa ninye, neaku kaarare sii nanu iyie; iaku sii iyie mitil, oldoinyo le Seir, o Edom pooki, pooki elulung'a. Ina peyie eyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Also, thou son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD:
Masaai: “Ore iyie enkerai e tung'ani imbonoki lelo doinyo le Israel, nijoki, intae ildoinyo le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the enemy hath said against you, Aha, even the ancient high places are ours in possession:
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; ore amu etejo ilo mang'atinda te iyie ‘Aha! Ore iwuejitin e apa neeika netaa enaang,’

English: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:
Masaai: neaku imbonoki nijoki, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore enkaraki, ee, ore enkaraki naitaa ninche intae mitili nepurd intae too nkaloli pooki, metaa itaa intae entoki e kulie kuapi, nitaa intae enkiroroto o entorroni olmarenke loo ltung'ana;

English: Therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes, and to the cities that are forsaken, which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about;
Masaai: metaa, oi intae ildoinyo le Israel, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai: Inji ejoki Olaitoriani Enkai lelo doinyo o ndoinyo, o lashepak o nenen neeidurrieki o nkanas naaidurraki aaing'uaa, nena naataa entoki nainos pooki toki netaa enameni iloreren pooki oomanita;

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.
Masaai: metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ekairo nanu to lom lai oirowua aarare ilkulikae oreren, naarare Edom pooki, lelo ooishoo enkop ai ate metaa enenye te nchipai oltau neimaki inolmena, pee etum aawaita ninye te ngolon.

English: Prophesy therefore concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my fury, because ye have borne the shame of the heathen:
Masaai: Metaa imbonoki ina kop e Israel, nijoki lelo doinyo o nena doinyo, lelo ashepak o yarat, tiaki: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, Ing'ura ajo, ekairo nanu to lom le ngoro ai, amu itaa intae iloonoto enkurruna too loshon;

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
Masaai: metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, ainos olmumai ajo ore iloshon oomanita intae naa ketum ninche enkurruna.

English: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to my people of Israel; for they are at hand to come.
Masaai: “Kake ore intae ildoinyo le Israel, naa keitubulu ninche ilng'osil lenye, neiki ilng'anayio linyi iltung'ana laainei Israel; amu kepuonu ninche aasieku ang.

English: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown:
Masaai: Amu, ing'ura, ara nanu olinyi, naa kaaibelekenyakino iyie naa aikituri nikiuni;

English: And I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the wastes shall be builded:
Masaai: naa kaponaa iltung'ana te iyie, enkaji pooki e Israel, ninye pooki; ore nena anas naa kemanyi ore iwuejitin mijoonto nesheti;

English: And I will multiply upon you man and beast; and they shall increase and bring fruit: and I will settle you after your old estates, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: naa kaponaa te iyie iltung'ana o ng'uesi; naa keponari ninche neisho oleng; naa kaaitaa iyie enamanyae anaa apa inkolong'i naatulusoitie, naa kaaitaas iyie esidai eneitu apa ae kata aaitaas. Ina peyie iyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel; and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance, and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men.
Masaai: Ee, ekaisho iltung'ana meshomo tiatua iyie, o ltung'ana laainei Israel; naa keya ninche intae, iyakuku intae enjung'ore enye, nemeitoki ae kata inkera ang aatum osina.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they say unto you, Thou land devourest up men, and hast bereaved thy nations;
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore amu ejoki intae iltung'ana, ‘Inyanya intae iltung'ana, nioruru olosho linyi inkera,’

English: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: neaku mintokiki ae kata aanya iltung'ana nimintokiki aaoru olosho linyi inkera, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;

English: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: nimintokiki intae aainining ae kata enkurruna e lelo oreren, nimintokiki ae kata aanap esulare oo ltung'ana nimintoki aaisho olorere linyi metorrorroto, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their own way and by their doings: their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore peyie emany enkaji e Israel enkop enye, neisarkionie ninye too nkoitoi enye o too nkiaasin enye; ore olkuaak lenye te dukuya nanu netiu anaa oloirerio le nkitok te nkata enkiduruk enye.

English: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land, and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it:
Masaai: Metaa atubukoko nanu engoro ai shumata ninche te nkaraki osarge oibukoitie ninche te nkop, te nkaraki nena aitin nemeishu naisarkionie ninche.

English: And I scattered them among the heathen, and they were dispersed through the countries: according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
Masaai: Aidapasha ninche tiatua iloreren, neidapashari ninche tiatua inkuapi, te risioroto oo lkuaaki lenye ore too siaitin enye naiguanare nanu ninche.

English: And when they entered unto the heathen, whither they went, they profaned my holy name, when they said to them, These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of his land.
Masaai: Kake tenepuonu ninche iloreren ore pooki wueji neetuo ninche, neisarkionie ninche enkarna ai sinyati, ore teina nejo iltung'ana tenkaraki ninche, ‘Ore kulo tung'ana naa iltung'ana lo Laitoriani, naa kepuku ake aapuo aing'uaa enkop enye.’

English: But I had pity for mine holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen, whither they went.
Masaai: Kake kaata endamunoto te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati, ina naitaa enkaji e Israel enaisarkionieki tiatua iloreren laa ninche eing'uaa.

English: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I do not this for your sakes, O house of Israel, but for mine holy name's sake, which ye have profaned among the heathen, whither ye went.
Masaai: “Metaa tiaaki ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ime te nkaraki intae, na aji e Israel, peyie ataa kaas embae, kake te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati ina nisarkionie intae tiatua lelo oshon lietuo.

English: And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the heathen, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
Masaai: Naa kaibalie esinyatisho enkarna ai kitok, ina apa naisarkionieki tiatua iloreren, naa intae oo isarkionie intae tiatua ninche; neyiolou iloreren ina kata aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ina kata naibalie esinyatisho ai aimaa intae te dukuya nkonyek enye.

English: For I will take you from among the heathen, and gather you out of all countries, and will bring you into your own land.
Masaai: Amu kaitupuku nanu intae aitung'uaa iloreren, naiturrurru intae too nkuapi pooki nayau intae atua enkop inyi maate.

English: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
Masaai: Kaisuaaki nanu intae enkare nasila niakuku sidain too ntorrok inyi pooki, o too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin inyi pooki ekaisuj nanu intae.

English: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
Masaai: Naisho nanu intae oltau ng'ejuk, naisho intae enkiyang'et ng'ejuk napik atua intae; naitayu aitung'uaa iseseni linyi ilo tau lo soit, naisho intae oltau le nkirring'o,

English: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do them.
Masaai: naa kapik enkiyang'et ai atua intae, naitaa intae iloopuo too nkiguanat aainei nijurrurru oleng aaing'or nkikoot aainei.

English: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
Masaai: Imanyimanya ina kop naishoo iloo papaai linyi; niakuku intae iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai inyi.

English: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
Masaai: Naa kaitajeu intae too loirerioni linyi pooki; naitanap entapa naitaa sapuk nemaitoki aiteleiki intae olameyu.

English: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
Masaai: Naa kaponaa ilng'anayio naitubul enkurma ino peyie mintokiki ae kata aatum enkurruna o lameyu tiatua iloreren.

English: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
Masaai: Ina peyie idamumu inkoitoi inyi torrok; o siatin inyi neme sidain; nimbayuyu ate te nkaraki ing'ok inyi, o lminong linyi litaasa.

English: Not for your sakes do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
Masaai: Ime tenkaraki iyie peyie aas ina, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; inchoo ina eyiolounoyu te iyie. Tukurru nimilo too nkoitoi inono, iyie na aji e Israel.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong naaituku iyie too ntorrok inono pooki, naa kaisho inkanas inono metamanyi, ore iwuejitin nememanya nesheti.

English: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
Masaai: Ore ina kop apa nememanyae neturi, alang enaitoki aaku mitil te lelo pooki oogiroo ninye.

English: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced, and are inhabited.
Masaai: Naa kejo ninche, ‘Ore apa ena kop mitil netotiwuo anaa ina kurma e Eden; ore nenen mijoonto naa mitil nememanya o nkanas naaidaitie, nemanya taata nesheta osempewuet.

English: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined places, and plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
Masaai: Ore ina kata dol lelo oreren ootung'uayioki oomanita iyie neyiolou aajo nanu, Olaitoriani, otesheta nenen wuejitin apa neeidaitie, naun ine apa netung'uayioki aa olmuaate; Nanu, Olaitoriani oiroro, naa kaas ina.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore sii ena naa kaisho ina aji e Israel maaikilikuana nanu maitaasa ninche; peyie aponaa ilewa lenye anaa inkerrai.

English: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Anaa inkerrai naaitainyieki ilasarri anaa nena kerrai e Yerusalem te lelo siruai lenye gelunot, metaa keaku keiputayu nena anas apa mijoonto too ntukusi oo ltung'ana. Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,
Masaai: Etii apa enkaina O Laitoriani shumata nanu naaitupuku nanu te Nkiyang'et o Laitoriani, naaitoton nanu te neitorit e nong'oto; naa kebore apa ninye iloik.

English: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
Masaai: Naarik nanu aitaman ninche; naa ing'ura, etii apa iloik kumok oleng ina nong'oto; naa ing'ura etoito ninche oleng.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu “Enkerai e tung'ani, keidim kulo oik aatopiu?” Nawalaii ajoki, “Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai, iyiolo iyie.”

English: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Naaitoki ake ajoki nanu, “Imbonoki kulo oik, nijoki ninche, intae kulo oik ootoito, entoning ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ajoki kulo oik: eng'ura, ajo kapik intae enkiyang'et najing atua intae, nipiuu.

English: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kapik intae imorlooishi, naisho nkiri metijing'a intae, neitoip intae tolchoni lo sesen, napik intae enkiyang'et, nipiuu; niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
Masaai: Metaa aibonoko anaa enaaitanapaki; ore ina kata aibonisho, nelotu oltoilo naa ng'ura, nadol enkop eikirikira; nepuonu lelo oik aaibung'a maate, oloito ake o loito lenye.

English: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
Masaai: Ore aingorisho netii ninche imorlooishi, neetuo nkiri osesen aaibung'are ninche, neitoip olchoni ninche; kake metii apa enkiyang'et atua ninche.

English: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Imbonoki enkiyang'et, imbonoki, enkerai e tung'ani, nijoki enkiyang'et, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Wou too nkaloli pokira ong'uan enkijape, iyie na kijape, niyang'aki kulo ootuata, peyie etum ninche aatopiu.”

English: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
Masaai: Metaa aibonoko ninche anaa enaaitanapa ninye nanu, nelotu enkiyang'et atua ninche, nepiu ninche neitashe too nkejek enye, olorora kitok oleng.

English: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore kulo oik naa enkaji pooki e Israel. Ing'ura ajo ejo ninche ‘Etoito iloik lang, neiting'o iyiook osiligi; etudung'oyioki iyiook katukul.’

English: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
Masaai: Metaa imbonoki ninche nijoki, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo kabol inkuraren inyi, naitopiu intae too nkuraren inyi, intae lo tung'ana laainei; naa kayau intae ang atua ina kop e Israel.

English: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
Masaai: Niyiolouu aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ina kata nabol inkuraren inyi, naitopiu intae too nkuraren inyi, intae iltung'ana laainei.

English: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken it, and performed it, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kapik nanu atua intae enkiyang'et ai, nipiuu intae, napik intae enkop inyi maate; ina peyie iyiolouu inchere Nanu ilo Aitoriani, oiroro, nataasa ina, ejo Olaitoriani.”

English: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and for all the house of Israel his companions:
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani iwa eng'udi nisir ninye ajo, ‘Ene Yuda o nkera e Israel ooboita o ninye;’ nintoki aya ae ng'udi nisir ninye te dukuya enye, ‘Te nkaraki Yosef (ina ng'udi e Efraim) o enkaji pooki e Israel ooboita o ninye;’

English: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
Masaai: nintutum ninche te nebo aitaa eng'udi nabo, peyie etum aataa nabo te nkaina ino.

English: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
Masaai: Ore peyie kijoki iltung'ana linono, ‘Aimintodol iyie iyiook enautu ena?’

English: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, even with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
Masaai: Tiaaki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, etinyikua peyie aya ina ng'udi e Yosef (ina natii ina aina e Efraim) o iloshon le Israel ooboitare ninye; naitutumoki ninye ina ng'udi e Yuda, naitaa ninche eng'udi nabo peyie etum aataa ninche nabo te nkaina ai.

English: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
Masaai: Ore nena keek nisirishore naatii enkaina ino te dukuya inkonyek enye,

English: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
Masaai: ina peyie ijoki ninche, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura ajo, kaya iltung'ana le Israel aitupuku te lelo oshon apa ooshomo lelo ootijing'a ninche, naiturrurru ninche too nkaloli pooki, nayau ninche enkop enye maate;

English: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
Masaai: naa kaitaa ninche olorere obo te nkop, o too nchumat lelo doinyo le Israel, naa olaiguanani obo oitasheiki ninche pooki; nemeitoki aaku ninche iloshon aare, nemeitoki aaoro aaku inkitoriat are.

English: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
Masaai: Nemeitoki aaisarkionie ate aaigil too nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin enye o ntokitin enye torrok, arashu te pooki ake ninye ng'oki enye nabo; kake kaitajeu ninche te pooki rrinyoto enye narrinyo siadi teina ng'oki nataasa ninche, naa kaituku ninche; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei, naaku nanu Enkai enye.

English: And David my servant shall be king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
Masaai: “Naa keaku osinka lai Daudi olaiguanani lenye oitore ninche; naa keaku ninche ololchekut obo. Naa kesuj ninche inkitanapat aainei, neing'or oleng aasuj inkiguanat aainei.

English: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, even they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David shall be their prince for ever.
Masaai: Ekebik ninche te nkop apa natotonie iloo papaai linyi ina apa naishoo osinka lai Yakobo; ninche te nebo nkera enye o nkera oo nkera enye etoni ninche te ine ntarasi; ore Daudi osinka lai neaku olkitok lenye intarasi.

English: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
Masaai: Ekaitobiru olning'o le seriani tenebo ninche; naa keaku ninche olning'o lo sotua intarasi tenebo ninche; naa kamayian ninche naitaa ninche kumok, naitasheyie tiatua ninche enkaji ai sinyati intarasi o ntarasi.

English: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: Ore emanyisho ai neaku tenebo ninche; naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye, neaku ninche iltung'ana laainei.

English: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
Masaai: Ore iloreren neyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani oitisiny Isiraeli, ina kata etii ewueji ai sinyati atua ninche intarasi pooki.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii naajoki:

English: Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, impirare Gog, leina kop e Magog, ilo arikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal, nimbonoki agilunore ninye

English: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
Masaai: ijoki ninye, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, ekaarare iyie, iyie Gog, olarikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal,

English: And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:
Masaai: naa kaaboin iyie arriny apik ilala oololo intakul inono; naa kaitupuku intae, tenebo enjore inyi pooki, imbartan o lakedok loo mbartan eishopo pooki imasaa o larrabal kitok oleng ninche pooki, eeta pooki ilong'oi kutiti, ilong'oi sapuki, o lalema,

English: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
Masaai: etii iltung'ana le Parsia o Kus o Put tenebo ninche, neeta pooki ilong'oi o nkopiyiani oo sekenke;

English: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.
Masaai: etii gomer tenebo ilturrurri lenyena pooki; o Bet-togaiman eing'uaa enkalo nalakua oleng e moikuape tenebo ilturrurri lenyena pooki o ltung'ana kumok tenebo iyie.

English: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou a guard unto them.
Masaai: “Terretenayu niton irretena, iyie tenebo lelo ororani pooki ooiturrurro tenebo iyie, niaku olarriponi te nkaraki ninche.

English: After many days thou shalt be visited: in the latter years thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel, which have been always waste: but it is brought forth out of the nations, and they shall dwell safely all of them.
Masaai: Ore eishunye inkolong'i kumok naa aikipuonunui aabaiki iyie, ore too larin le siadi nilo agilunore enkop ina kop nanyaaka aaku olosho eishunye olarrabal, ina kop naiturrurrore olorere oing'uaa kulikae oreren too ldoinyo le Israel, nataa tenkata naado mitil; ore iltung'ana lenyena neyauni aaitupuku too loreren, netoni taata ninche pooki te seriani.

English: Thou shalt ascend and come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many people with thee.
Masaai: Inyikakiki ninche anaa olkutati nitiu anaa enkatampoi naitoipito enkop, iyie tenebo ilturrurri linono pooki, tenebo iloreren kumok tenebo iyie.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; It shall also come to pass, that at the same time shall things come into thy mind, and thou shalt think an evil thought:
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong naa kepuonu atua iyie indamunot atua endamunoto ino, naa intobiruru endamunoto torrono.

English: And thou shalt say, I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates,
Masaai: Nijojo, ‘Ekalo ailepaki aarare ina kop nemetii isunta inkang'itie; naa kabatatakino shumata lelo tung'ana ooitirring'a te seriani lelo oomanya enemetii isunta nemeeta isekenke arashu inchomito;’

English: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
Masaai: peyie aibung iyarunot nanap nena naibung'aki; naim nenen pooki nemeekure emanyae tenebo lelo tung'ana ooing'uaa iloreren lelo oata inkishu o masaa, lelo oomanya empolos enkop.

English: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the young lions thereof, shall say unto thee, Art thou come to take a spoil? hast thou gathered thy company to take a prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take a great spoil?
Masaai: Ore Sheba, o Dedan o lbiasharani le Tarshish tenebo inkang'itie enye pooki naa kejoki intae, ‘Iyetuo intae aaibung iyarunot? Inturrurro ilororani linono peyie enap aaya iyarunot, peyie enap aaya enkosholai tenebo sahabu, neya nkishu tenebo imasaa, nenap iyarunot kumok?’

English: Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say unto Gog, Thus saith the Lord GOD; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?
Masaai: “Metaa, enkerai e tung'ani, imbonoki Gog tiaki, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore teina olong etoni iltung'ana laainei Isiraeli te seriani, aimiyiolouu intae?

English: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the north parts, thou, and many people with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company, and a mighty army:
Masaai: Idumumu ate nipuonunu aaing'uaa ewueji inyi aaing'uaa nenen wuejitin neelakua e moikuape, ntae tenebo olorora loo ltung'ana kumok tenebo iyie, ekedito ninche pooki mbartan enye, o lorora kitok, enjore sapuk;

English: And thou shalt come up against my people of Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the latter days, and I will bring thee against my land, that the heathen may know me, when I shall be sanctified in thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
Masaai: ipuonunu aailepu aagilunore aarare iltung'ana laainei Isirael, nimilumululu enkop anaa enkatampoi. Ore too nkolong'i naasuju naa kayau intae entaarare enkop ai, peyie aatum iloreren aatayiolo nanu, aa te iyie Gog aitoduaaya nanu esinyatisho ai te dukuya ninche.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel, which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them?
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ai iyie ilo apa laimaka too nkolong'i naatulusoitie to sinkan laainei lelo aidetidetak le Israel, laa ore te nena olong'i eibonishe te ninche too larin ejo kaayau iyie taarare ninche?

English: And it shall come to pass at the same time when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that my fury shall come up in my face.
Masaai: Kake ore te ina olong, ina kata nalotu Gog aarare ina kop e Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, naa kedumuni engoro ai.

English: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken, Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
Masaai: Amu to lom lai o te ngoro ai napejisho aibalie, ore kenya te ina olong naa ketumi olokirikiri sapuk tiatua enkop e Israel;

English: So that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at my presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
Masaai: ore isinkir le naiposha, o motonyi o loing'ang'e o nguesi e ong'ota, o ntokitin pooki naaiserpepiari tioriong e nkop, o ltung'ana pooki ootii oriong enkop, naa keilanyisho pooki te dukuya nanu, ore ildoinyo naa kenang'uni abori, ore imartin nesulari, ore pooki suntai naa keurokino enkop.

English: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD: every man's sword shall be against his brother.
Masaai: Kaipotu olkirutoto pooki metaarare Gog, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai; ore pooki alem lo ltung'ani nearare olalashe lenye.

English: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many people that are with him, an overflowing rain, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
Masaai: Tolmeitai o te nkibukoroto o sarge ajing'aki ninye enkiguana, naa kashaiki shumata ninye te nebo ilororani lenyena o tenebo iltung'ana kumok ootii tenebo ninye, enchan sapuk tenebo isoito le nchan, enkima o enkibiriti nayupuyup.

English: Thus will I magnify myself, and sanctify myself; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations, and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Metaa kaitodolu nanu enkitoo ai tenebo esinyatisho ai, naitayiolo kewan te dukuya inkonyek oo loreren kumok. Ina peyie eyilou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
Masaai: “Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, imbonoki tigilunore Gog, nijoki: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ing'ura, ekaarare iyie, iyie Gog, ilo arikoni kitok le Meshek o Tubal;

English: And I will turn thee back, and leave but the sixth part of thee, and will cause thee to come up from the north parts, and will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel:
Masaai: naa kaaibelekeny iyie naareu iyie dukuya, naayau iyie shumata aitung'uaa inkiting'ot pooki e moikuape, naarik iyie taarare lelo doinyo le Israel;

English: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
Masaai: naa kaaosh enkawuo ino te nkalo e nkaina ino e kedienye naisho imbaa inono metadoiki enkop te nkaina ino e tatene.

English: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the people that is with thee: I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort, and to the beasts of the field to be devoured.
Masaai: Ibatatakino iyie enchumata oo ldoinyo le Israel, iyie tenebo ilturrurri linono pooki tenebo iltung'ana pooki likiboitare iyie; ekaaisho iyie lelo motonyi oonya nkiri le pooki pukunoto tenebo nena ng'uesi e ong'ata peyie kinos.

English: Thou shalt fall upon the open field: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ibatata iyie te nkong'ata naisiaj; amu airoro nanu ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And I will send a fire on Magog, and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles: and they shall know that I am the LORD.
Masaai: Ekairriwaki enkima Magog, tenebo lelo ootoni te seriani to lomanaa le nkiyopat e naiposha; naa keyiolou ninche aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani.

English: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more: and the heathen shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
Masaai: “Ore enkarna ai Sinyati naa kaibalie ninye te rishata oo ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli; nemaitoki aisho enkarna ai sinyati eitokini aaisarkionie; neyiolou iloreren aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani, ilo Sinyati te Israel,

English: Behold, it is come, and it is done, saith the Lord GOD; this is the day whereof I have spoken.
Masaai: Ing'ura, elotu ninye, naa keyauni aaitabau, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai. Ina olong ina naimaka.

English: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall set on fire and burn the weapons, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the handstaves, and the spears, and they shall burn them with fire seven years:
Masaai: “Neaku ore lelo oomanya nena anas e Israel naa kepuo dukuya neitobiru inkimaitie too masaa olarrabal nepejoo ninche, ilong'oi sapuki o long'oi kutiti, o inkai o mbaa, irinkan o mperria. Naa keitobiru inkimaitie te ninche too larin oopishana;

English: So that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests; for they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: metaa meitoki ninche aayieu neya ilkeek le nkima aaitung'uaa olokeri arashu edung'u too ntimi, amu keitobiru enkima enye too masaa enye olarrabal; ekeinyal ninche lelo ooinyal ninche, nemut lelo oomut ninche ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon-gog.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong naa kaisho Gog ewueji nanukarieki te Israel, ina nong'oto oo lapuayak te nkalo o loo saen le naiposha; keibooyo ninye ilapuayak, amu keaku teine eturori Gog o lorora lenye pooki naa keipoti ninye aajo o yarata le Hamon-gog.

English: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land.
Masaai: Amu ore too lapaitin oopishana, eaku keturoo ina aji e Israel ninche peyie etum aaipoo ina kop.

English: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop naa keturoo ninche; naa keyanyiti ninche teina olong naitodolu enkitoo ai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And they shall sever out men of continual employment, passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it: after the end of seven months shall they search.
Masaai: Keitasheyie ninche iltung'ana ooim atua ina kop inkatitin pooki peyie epuo aanukaa lelo ootelekutua ti oriong e nkop, peyie etum aaipoo ninye; ore te nkiting'oto o lapaitin oopishana neitoki aaingoru impopoki aajurru.

English: And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man's bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.
Masaai: Naa dol teneim kulo atua ina kop nedol ake obo oloito lo ltung'ani, naa kepik ninye olmonekie enye, o metaba anaa neturoo lelo aturorok ninye teina nong'oto e Hamon-gog.

English: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
Masaai: (Etii sii enkanasa e Hamona netii sii ninye ine). Neaku neijia eiko teneipok ina kop.

English: And, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; Speak unto every feathered fowl, and to every beast of the field, Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you, even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh, and drink blood.
Masaai: “Ore te iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Irorie imotonyi e pooki pukunoto o pooki pukunoto eng'ues e ong'ata, ‘Enturrurrunye wootu, enturrurroto too nkaloli pooki enturrurrokinoto ina masho o lasar ilo laitobiraki intae, e masho kitok oleng o lasar te nchumata e lelo doinyo le Israel, naa inosinoso inkiri niokioko osarge.

English: Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty, and drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of rams, of lambs, and of goats, of bullocks, all of them fatlings of Bashan.
Masaai: Inosinoso nena kiri e lelo magil niokioko osarge loo lkituaak le nkop, o loo lmeregeshi, o loo lkuoo le kerra, o loo lkineji o loo loing'ok, lelo pooki oopir le Bashan.

English: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you.
Masaai: Naa inosinoso nena pooki naapir o entaraposhoto, niokioko osarge o entemerata, teina masho olasar naitobiraki intae.

English: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Naa iraposhosho intae te misa ai te nena bartan o lakedok lenye, tenebo iltung'ana magil o ilmurran loo mpukunot pooki; ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And I will set my glory among the heathen, and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed, and my hand that I have laid upon them.
Masaai: “Naa kaitasheyie enkitoo ai tiatua iloreren; naa kedol iloreren pooki enkiguana ai ina nayaua, o enkaina ai ina naiteleikia ninche.

English: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God from that day and forward.
Masaai: Ore enkaji e Israel naa keyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, eiteru ina olong nelo dukuya.

English: And the heathen shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity: because they trespassed against me, therefore hid I my face from them, and gave them into the hand of their enemies: so fell they all by the sword.
Masaai: Naa keyiolou iloreren aajo eshomo apa enkaji e Israel e araroto te nkaraki ing'ok enye, amu etaasa ninche ine nkarrueisho oleng te nanu metaa aisudoyie nanu enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche naisho ninche metijing'a inkaik oo lmang'ati lenye, nebatata ninche pooki to lalem.

English: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
Masaai: Aaitaasa ninche terisioroto olduruk o nkitarruorrot enye, naisudoo enkomom ai aitung'uaa ninche.

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob, and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel, and will be jealous for my holy name;
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore tena kata naa kashukoki Yakobo imayianat enyena, natum olng'ur te nkaji pooki e Israel; naaku oloota olom te nkaraki enkarna ai sinyati.

English: After that they have borne their shame, and all their trespasses whereby they have trespassed against me, when they dwelt safely in their land, and none made them afraid.
Masaai: Kerikino ninche enkurruna enye, o mbaa pooki torrok naataasa ninche aagilunore nanu, ina kata etoni te seriani te nkop enye meeta likae oiture ninche,

English: When I have brought them again from the people, and gathered them out of their enemies' lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations;
Masaai: ina kata nayau ninche ashuku too loreren naiturrurru ninche aitung'uaa ilmang'ati le nkop enye, naa tiatua ninche aibalie esinyatisho ai edolita iloreren kumok.

English: Then shall they know that I am the LORD their God, which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen: but I have gathered them unto their own land, and have left none of them any more there.
Masaai: Ina peyie eyiolou aajo ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye amu aterewa ninche eararoto tiatua iloreren, naitoki aiturrurroki ninche enkop enye maate. Maing'uaa hoo obo lenye eton tiatua iloreren aitoki;

English: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: nemaitoki aikata aisudoo enkomom ai aigil te ninche, ina kata nabuku Enkiyang'et abukoki ina aji Israel, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day the hand of the LORD was upon me, and brought me thither.
Masaai: Ore to lari le tikitam o imiet le yararoto ang, te nkiterunoto o lari te nkolong e tomon o lapa, to lari le tomon oong'uan eidipaki aaibung'a enkanasa, teina olong; netii apa enkaina o Laitoriani shumata nanu.

English: In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel, and set me upon a very high mountain, by which was as the frame of a city on the south.
Masaai: Naayau nanu too nduaat Enkai atua enkop e Israel naaitoton ninye nanu te nchumata oldoinyo oodo oleng, netii shumata enye olchetei laaijo enkanasa naipirare nanu.

English: And he brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
Masaai: Ore peyie aayau ninye ine, ng'ura, etii apa oltung'ani, laa ore empukunoto enye netiu anaa osuyai, neeta te nkaina enye enkopito natemishoreki o entiyani natemishoreki te nkaina enye; neitashe ninye te wueji e kishomi.

English: And the man said unto me, Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither: declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu ilo tung'ani, “Enkerai e tung'ani ing'ura, too nkonyek inono, nining too nkiyiaa inono, nipik indamunot inono nena pooki naaitodol iyie, amu kitorikuoki ene peyie aatum aitoduaa iyie ninye; imbalakinye nena pooki nidol enkaji e Israel.”

English: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man's hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth: so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed; and the height, one reed.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etii apa esuntai namanita ine wueji e oriong netii enkaji e Nkai, ore enkadori e ina tiyani natemishoreki natii enkaina e ilo tung'ani naa intemat ile enkaina enkadori, ore pooki nabo enye naa entemata enkaina nabo o endap te nkadori; metaa etetema ina kirrushai eina suntai, naa entiyani nabo.

English: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye alo ina kishomi naipirare oloosaen, eilep too nkedeta enyena, neipim entonata eina kishomi, entiyani nabo eng'uton; o lgilat oomanita, entiyani nabo enkadori,

English: And every little chamber was one reed long, and one reed broad; and between the little chambers were five cubits; and the threshold of the gate by the porch of the gate within was one reed.
Masaai: ore ilgilat loo mbaat naa entiyani nabo enkadoro ore erishata e lelo gilat loo mbaat naa intemat emiet e nkaina; ore ine neitasheyie ina kishomi te mbata o lgoriet tenejing'ieki kishomi naa entiyani nabo.

English: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye atem olgoriet le kishomi, intemat enkaina isiet;

English: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
Masaai: tenebo ineeitasheyie enyena, intemat are enkaina; ore olgoriet le kishomi netii enkalo enkiting'oto e atua e kishomi.

English: And the little chambers of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure: and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
Masaai: Netii ilgilat pokira okuni loo mbaat inkaloli pokira e kishomi oloosaen; ore nena pokira uni nerisio pooki; ore ing'apeta oo nkaloli pokira nerisioro.

English: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits.
Masaai: Ina peyie etem endapasho eine nebolieki kishomi, intemat tomon; o endapasho e ina kishomi, intemat tomon oo kuni.

English: The space also before the little chambers was one cubit on this side, and the space was one cubit on that side: and the little chambers were six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
Masaai: Netii apa enerisha dukuya lelo gilat okuni loo mbat naa entemata nabo enkaina te pooki shoto.

English: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another: the breadth was five and twenty cubits, door against door.
Masaai: Ina peyie atem ina kishomi tioriong enkalo olgilata obo ometabaiki oriong olikae, neeta endapasho o ntemat imiet o ntemat tikitam eiteru te kutuk aji ometabaiki enkae kutuk aji.

English: He made also posts of threescore cubits, even unto the post of the court round about the gate.
Masaai: Neitoki ake sii atem olgoriet, intemat tikitam enkaina; ore ine emanaroto e ilo goriet netii olodung'oro.

English: And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ina kishomi teine nejing'ieki o metabaiki ine enkiting'oto olgoriet liatua leina kishomi naa intemat onom.

English: And there were narrow windows to the little chambers, and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches: and windows were round about inward: and upon each post were palm trees.
Masaai: Ore ine wueji nejing'ieki kishomi neeta ilusien naamanita naapirik ijing atua nena ng'apeta enye tiatua lelo gilat loo mbat, neeta ake sii ilo goriet ilusien naamanita tiatua, ore too ng'apetae kutuk aji netii iltuka.

English: Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
Masaai: Naariku nanu atua endung'oroto e oriong; naa ng'ura, etii ilgilat olgos o manaa teilo odung'oro; ilgilat tomoni uni ootii dukuya ilo gos.

English: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
Masaai: Neim ilo gos embata nena shomito, eipirare ina adori e nena shomito; ele apa olgos le abori.

English: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, an hundred cubits eastward and northward.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye atem enkadori eiteru tiatua tenkalo e dukuya enkalo e atua eina kishomi e abori o metabaiki oriong tenkalo e dukuya ea atua olgoriet, intemat iip nabo enkaina.

English: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof, and the breadth thereof.
Masaai: Neituruk ninye te dukuya nanu alo enkalo e moikuape, naa ng'ura etii apa enkishomi naing'orita enkalo e moikuape, enaa ene nkalo olodung'oro lioriong. Netem enkadori enye o endapasho enye.

English: And the little chambers thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
Masaai: O lgilat lenyena loo mbat, okuni ake te pooki matua, o ng'apeta enyena tenebo olgorieti lenye laa erisiori o nekua e kishomi e dukuya; ore enkadori naa intemat enkaina onom o imiet.

English: And their windows, and their arches, and their palm trees, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and they went up unto it by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
Masaai: Ore ilusien enyena, o lgorieti enyena, tenebo iltuka lenyena naa erisiori nabo anaa lelo leina kishomi ina naing'orita enkalo oloosaen; naa inkedeta naapishana ninche naailepaki ine; netii olgoriet atua ine.

English: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north, and toward the east; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits.
Masaai: Ore tenkae alo naipirare kishomi tenkalo e moikuape, anaa enatiu tenkalo o loo ntoluo netii enkishomi natii atua olgoriet; netem eiteru te kishomi o metabaiki kishomi, intemat e nkaina iip nabo.

English: After that he brought me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south: and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures.
Masaai: Naarik ninye nanu enkalo e kopikop, naa ng'ura, etii apa enkishomi enkalo e kopikop; netem ninye ing'apeta enyena tenebo ilgilat lenyena; neeta apa pooki erisiori nabo anaa ilkulikae.

English: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
Masaai: Netii apa ilusien naamanita tiatua olgoriet lenye, anaa ilusien e kulie; ore enkadori enye naa intemat e nkaina onom, ore endapasho enye naa intemat tikitam o imiet.

English: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them: and it had palm trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
Masaai: Netii apa inkedeta naapishana naailepaki ninye, ore olgoriet lenye netii enkalo e atua; neeta apa iltuka too ng'apeta enye, obo ake tenkalo e atua; neeta apa ilkeek loo ltuka too ng'apeta enye, obo ake tenkalo nabo too nkaloli pooki.

English: And there was a gate in the inner court toward the south: and he measured from gate to gate toward the south an hundred cubits.
Masaai: Netii apa enkishomi tenkalo e kopikop te nkalo e atua olodung'oro; netem ninye eiteru te kishomi o meshomo kishomi tenkalo e kopikop, intemat e nkaina iip nabo.

English: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate: and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu atua olodung'oro li atua te nkalo e kishomi e kopikop, netem ninye ina kishomi e kopikop; naa erisio apa o nkulie.

English: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures: and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat, o ing'apeta enyena, olgorieti lenye naa erisio o nena kulie; netii apa ilusien naamanita tiatua tenebo olgilata lenye; ore enkadori naa intemat enkaina tikitam o imiet.

English: And the arches round about were five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
Masaai: Netii ilgorieti oomanita, intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet enkadori naa intemat imiet endapasho.

English: And the arches thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof: and the going up to it had eight steps.
Masaai: Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare olodung'oro li oriong netii iltuka ing'apeta enyena, ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.

English: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east: and he measured the gate according to these measures.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu oliatua lo lodung'oro tenkalo oloosaen, netem ninye ina kishomi; nerisiore nena kulie.

English: And the little chambers thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, were according to these measures: and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about: it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat, o ing'apeta enyena tenebo ilgorieti lenyena naa erisiori o lkulikae; netii atua ilusien naamanita tiatua tenebo olgoriet lenye ore enkadori enye naa intemat enkaina onom, ore endapasho enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet.

English: And the arches thereof were toward the outward court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
Masaai: Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare ilo odung'oro li oriong, neeta apa iltuka too ng'apeta enyena, obo ake te pooki shoto; ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.

English: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu enkalo e kishomi e moikuape, netem ninye; naa kerisioro o nkulie.

English: The little chambers thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, and the windows to it round about: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat lenyena loo mbat, o ng'apeta enyena, tenebo ilgorieti lenyena nerisioro o lkulikae; neeta ilusien naamanita, ore enkadori enye naa intemat e nkaina tikitam o imiet.

English: And the posts thereof were toward the utter court; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side: and the going up to it had eight steps.
Masaai: Ore olgoriet lenye neipirare olodung'oro lioriong, neeta iltuka too ng'apeta enyena, obo ake te pooki shoto; ore enekedieki enye neeta inkedeta isiet.

English: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates, where they washed the burnt offering.
Masaai: Netii apa olgilata sapuk oota kutuk aji enye to lgoriet le kishomi, naa teine apa eisuji ilo asar opejori.

English: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering.
Masaai: Ore tiatua ilo goriet le kishomi netii enkishomi natii imisai are too nkaloli pokira, naa ninche eyieng'ieki ilasarri oopejori, o lasarri le ngoki, o lasarri le nkitarruorroto.

English: And at the side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate, were two tables; and on the other side, which was at the porch of the gate, were two tables.
Masaai: Ore tioriong ilo goriet tenkalo najing'ieki e kishomi moikuape, netii imisai are, ore te nkae alo eilo goriet eina kishomi netii imisai are.

English: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon they slew their sacrifices.
Masaai: Netii apa imisai are atua, netii imisai ong'uan oriong, te nchoto e ina kishomi, imisai isiet, naa te nchumata enye eyieng'ieki ilasarri.

English: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering, of a cubit and an half long, and a cubit and an half broad, and one cubit high: whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice.
Masaai: Netii sii apa imisai ong'uan oo soito oogueta te nkaraki olasar opejori entemata enkaina nabo, o lpisiai enkadori, naa entemata nabo olpisiai endapasho, naa entemata nabo enkaina enkilepata, laa ninye eiteleikini intokitin pooki naayieng'ishoreki laa teine eteyieng'ieki olasar opejori.

English: And within were hooks, an hand broad, fastened round about: and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering.
Masaai: Ore ilala oololo, naa ore enkadori enye naa endap e nkaina, neenikino atua ninye tiatua. Ore tenchumata e nena misai naa ine eiteleikini nena kiri naaitaini olasar.

English: And without the inner gate were the chambers of the singers in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate; and their prospect was toward the south: one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu tiauluo aitijing'u atua olodung'oro liatua, naa ing'ura, etii apa ilgilat aare sapuki otii atua olodung'oro liatua, ore obo naa ole nkishomi e moikuape naipirare kopikop, ore enkae neipirare enkalo e kishomi naing'orita moikuape.

English: And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, ore ele gilata oipirare enkalo e kopikop naa enelelo apolosak ooitasheiki enkaji e Nkai,

English: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi, which come near to the LORD to minister unto him.
