Masaai: ore olgilata oipirare moikuape olgilata loo lapolosak ooing'or olperere lo lasar; naa kulo ninche ilayiok le Sadok, laa ninye openy tiatua ilayiok le Lawi eishoro enyikaki Olaitoriani aaisiyiai ninye.

English: So he measured the court, an hundred cubits long, and an hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar that was before the house.
Masaai: Netem ninye ina dung'oroto, intemat e nkaina iip nabo enkadori, o ntemat iip nabo endapasho, nerisio inkaloli pokira ong'uan; netii olperere dukuya ina aji Enkai.

English: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariku nanu olgoriet le nkaji e nkai, netem ing'apeta olgoriet, naa intemat imiet enkaina too nkaloli pokira; ore endapasho eina kishomi naa intemat e nkaina tomon oo ng'uan ore isunta enchoto naa intemat e nkaina uni te pooki shoto.

English: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it: and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
Masaai: Ore enkadori o lgoriet naa intemat e nkaina tikitam ore endapasho naa intemat e nkaina tomon aare naa inkedeta tomon naailepaki; netii apa inkitotoneta embata oo ng'apata too nkaloli pooki.

English: Afterward he brought me to the temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tabernacle.
Masaai: Naariku nanu atua olgilata le polos, netem ninye ing'apeta enyena, ore ake te nchoto nabo naa intemat enkaina ile apa endapasho oo ntoneta eng'ape.

English: And the breadth of the door was ten cubits; and the sides of the door were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side: and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits: and the breadth, twenty cubits.
Masaai: Ore endapasho e ine nejing'ieki naa intemat e nkaina tomon; ore isunta e ine nejing'ieki naa intemat imiet too nkaloli pokira; netem ninye enkadori e ilo gilata, intemat e nkaina artam, o endapasho enye, intemat e nkaina tikitam.

English: Then went he inward, and measured the post of the door, two cubits; and the door, six cubits; and the breadth of the door, seven cubits.
Masaai: Ina peyie ejing atua olgilata liatua netem ing'apeta e kutuk aji, intemat are; o endapasho eina kutuk aji, intemat ile; o suntai natii embata e kutuk aji intemat naapishana.

English: So he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits; and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple: and he said unto me, This is the most holy place.
Masaai: Netem enkadori e ilo gilata, intemat e nkaina tikitam, o endapasho enye, intemat e nkaina tikitam, tinigiroo olgilata le mpolos. Naajoki ninye nanu, ore ene naa ewueji sinyati aisul.

English: After he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
Masaai: Ina peyie etem ina suntai enkaji e Nkai, intemat ile enkirrushai; ore endapasho oo lgilat le nchoto, naa intemat e nkaina ong'uan, eman ina aji e Nkai.

English: And the side chambers were three, one over another, and thirty in order; and they entered into the wall which was of the house for the side chambers round about, that they might have hold, but they had not hold in the wall of the house.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat le nchoto neidikidikokino inkajijik uni te shumata, neipirare ake obo likae, tomoni uni ake te nkaji nabo natii shumata enkae. Netii ineeipiku naamanita ina suntai e nkaji e Nkai aa ninche naairishaa nena ajijik too nchot pooki kake meshetakino.

English: And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.
Masaai: Ore lelo gilat mbat nepuo alalau te nkaji e shumata o enkae e shumata, eipirare ine neirishakino te nkaji ake e shumata o te nkae te manaroto pooki enkaji e Nkai; Ore te matua enkaji e Nkai netii inkedeta naailep shumata, neaku neija eikunari oltung'ani teneilep eiteru te nkaji e abori o metabaiki enkaji e shumata eimaa enkaji e polos.

English: I saw also the height of the house round about: the foundations of the side chambers were a full reed of six great cubits.
Masaai: Atoduaa sii ajo ore enkaji e Nkai neeta eneika namanita; ore ilkitamanyunot loo lgilat le nchoto naa entiyani nalulung'a oo ntemat ile naalulung'a enkadori.

English: The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.
Masaai: Ore enkirrushai eina suntai e oriong to lgilata le nchoto naa intemat e nkaina imiet. Ore enchoto e ine neika nemetii toki, naa intemat enkaina imiet, ore te rishata e ine neika e ina aji e Nkai,

English: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
Masaai: o lgilat lo lodung'oro naa endapasho oo ntemat tikitam eman ina aji e Nkai te pooki shoto.

English: And the doors of the side chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south: and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.
Masaai: Ore inkutukie oo nkajijik e lelo gilat le nchoto oobolo embata eine neika netung'uayioki metii toki te kutuk aji e nkalo e moikuape, ore enkae kutuk aji netii e nkalo e kopikop; ore endapasho eine wueji natung'uayioki metii toki naa intemat imiet emanita.

English: Now the building that was before the separate place at the end toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
Masaai: Ore ina aji apa naipirare olodung'oro lena aji e Nkai te nkalo oloontoluo naa intemat intomoni naapishana e lalai; ore ina suntai eina aji naa intemat imiet te nkirrushai emanita, ore enkadoro naa intemat intomoni naaudo.

English: So he measured the house, an hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, an hundred cubits long;
Masaai: Netem ninye ina aji e Nkai, intemat enkaina iip nabo enkadori; o lodung'oro tenebo ina aji o sunta enyena, intemat iip nabo enkadori;

English: Also the breadth of the face of the house, and of the separate place toward the east, an hundred cubits.
Masaai: tenebo endapasho te nkalo oloontoluo te dukuya enkaji e Nkai, tenebo olodung'oro intemat enkaina iip nabo.

English: And he measured the length of the building over against the separate place which was behind it, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, an hundred cubits, with the inner temple, and the porches of the court;
Masaai: Netem enkadori eina aji eipirare ilo odung'oro otii enkalo oloontoluo o sunta enyena too nkaloli pooki, intemat e nkaina iip nabo. Ore ilo gilata olala leina aji e Nkai, o lgilata liatua oilo lioriong neeta ineerupa

English: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;
Masaai: ore emanaroto e pokira okuni neeta ilusien o ng'apeta. Ore te ntonata naipirare enetonie enkaji e Nkai nerupa too nkeek emanita, eiteru toltiren o meilepaki ilusien (ore ilusien naa kemura),

English: To that above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and by all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
Masaai: o metabaiki ine nemetii toki te shumata kutuk aji, o tenebo ilo gilata liatua, o tenkalo e oriong; Ore too sunta pooki naamanita tiatua olgilata liatua o ilo gilata sapuk liatua neguetuno te nkitanyaanyukoto o lkerubi,

English: And it was made with cherubims and palm trees, so that a palm tree was between a cherub and a cherub; and every cherub had two faces;
Masaai: o lchani loo ltuka, netii ake oltukai erishata o lkerubi o lkerubi.

English: So that the face of a man was toward the palm tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm tree on the other side: it was made through all the house round about.
Masaai: Neeta ake olkerubi obo inkomomi are: enkomom o ltung'ani oipirare oltukai te nkalo nabo, o enkomom oloti ng'atuny eipirare oltukai te nkae alo. Neguetakino ninche enkaji pooki e Nkai temanaroto;

English: From the ground unto above the door were cherubims and palm trees made, and on the wall of the temple.
Masaai: ore eiteru toltiren o meshomo shumata e kutuk aji naguetakino olkerubi oltuka ina suntai.

English: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.
Masaai: Ore nena molinkaishi e kutuk aji e ilo gilata nerisioro pooki aloli. Ore te dukuya ine wueji sinyati netii entoki nanyaanyukie olperere loo nkeek,

English: The altar of wood was three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits; and the corners thereof, and the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were of wood: and he said unto me, This is the table that is before the LORD.
Masaai: intemat e nkaina uni enkadoro enkilepata, intemat are enkadori, intemat are endapasho; ore ilpijat lenyena entonata enye, o sunta enyena naa inoo nkeek. Naajoki ninye nanu, “Nena ina mesa natii dukuya Olaitoriani.”

English: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
Masaai: Ore ilo gilata liatua tenebo ine wueji sinyati neeta ake nabo kikenet naidikidiko katitin are.

English: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
Masaai: Neeta nena kikeneta imatuan are imatuan are naamanaa too yeneta te pooki kikenet.

English: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.
Masaai: Ore te nena kikeneta e ilo gilata neguetakino ilkerubi o ltuka, anaa lelo ooguetakino nena sunta; netii ilkeek kumok oonukita ilo gilata lioriong.

English: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
Masaai: Netii ilusien enchoto e ilo gilata too nkaloli pokira, neikodoki nena sunta too lkeek loltukai.

English: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was before the building toward the north.
Masaai: Ina peyie aariki nanu atua olgoriet liatua le nkalo e moikuape, naariku nanu atua ilgilat ooipirare enkalo olodungoro le nkaji e Nkai netii sii enkae alo eina aji natii moikuape.

English: Before the length of an hundred cubits was the north door, and the breadth was fifty cubits.
Masaai: Ore enkadori eina aji natii enkalo e moikuape naa intemat iip nabo, ore endapasho enye naa intemat onom.

English: Over against the twenty cubits which were for the inner court, and over against the pavement which was for the utter court, was gallery against gallery in three stories.
Masaai: Neibung'are intemat e nkaina tikitam naatii atua olodung'oro liatua, neipirare enkiyopata naimi enkaji e oriong olodung'oro. Oltapeet le nkaji oipirare olikae too nkajijik uni naakedo aaidikidiko.

English: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.
Masaai: Ore eitu ijing lelo gilat netii enkoitoi najing atua, intemat enkaina tomon endapasho o ntemat e nkaina iip te nkadori netii inkutukie oo nkajijik enye enkalo e moikuape.

English: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat le shumata naa aironkeni, amu ewaita iltapeeti le shumata erishata sapuk aalang ilgilat liabori o le mpolos le nkaji.

English: For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.
Masaai: Amu inkajijik apa uni naakedo, nemeeta apa ing'apeta anaa ing'apeta ololodung'oro liauluo; metaa ore ilgilat le shumata neingat enkop aalang ile abori o le polos.

English: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
Masaai: Netii apa esuntai boo naipirare lelo gilat te nkalo olodung'oro lioriong; eipirare lelo gilat, intemat enkaina onom enkadori.

English: For the length of the chambers that were in the utter court was fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple were an hundred cubits.
Masaai: Ore ilgilat lolodung'oro lioriong naa intemat onom te nkadori, ore lelo ootii enkae alo enkaji e Nkai naa intemat iip nabo enkadoro.

English: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the utter court.
Masaai: Ore tiabori lelo gialat netii kutuk aji te nkalo oloosaen, ejing iltung'ana ninche eing'uaa oriong endung'oroto, ine neiterunye esuntai e oriong.

English: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
Masaai: Ore sii te nkalo e kopikop, eipirare olodung'oro o eipirare sii ina aji; etii ilgilat oota enejing'ieki te dukuya ninche;

English: And the way before them was like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they: and all their goings out were both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.
Masaai: nenyaanyukie ninche lelo gilat ootii enkalo e kopikop, nabo enkadoro o endapasho, neeta ewueji nebo neipang'ieki, naa nabo o nkutukie oo nkajijik.

English: And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.
Masaai: Ore tiabori ilgilat le kopikop netii enejing'ieki te nkalo oloosaen, teine nejing'ieki ina oitoi, ore te nkalo e kurum netii esuntai narish esuntai.

English: Then said he unto me, The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they be holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ilgilat le nkalo e moikuape o lgilat le kopikop lelo ooipirare ilo odung'oro naa lgilat Sinyat, laa teine epuo lelo apolosak oopuonu enetii Olaitoriani aanyalelo asarri sinyat oleng ilo asar le ntapa, ilo asar le ng'oki, o ilo asar le nkitarruoroto, amu ore ine wueji naa aisinyati.

English: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they are holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to those things which are for the people.
Masaai: Ore tenejing ilapolosak ine wueji sinyati, nemeipang auluo teine aapuo ina dung'oroto e auluo eitu eitayu te ine nena kilani enye a enkisiaayiare, amu aisinyat kuna; neishop ninche kulie kilani eton eitu epuo aanyikaki ina oo nara ine tung'ana.”

English: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip atetema atua ine wueji e nkaji e Nkai, naarik nanu aipang'ie teina kishomi naipirare enkalo oloosaen, netem ewueji e nkaji e Nkai aman.

English: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
Masaai: Netem enkalo oloo saen te ntiyani natemishoreki intemat enkaina iip imiet te ntiyani natemishoreki.

English: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
Masaai: Neitoki aibelekenya netem enkalo e moikuape, intemat enkaina iip imiet te ntiyiani natemishoreki.

English: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
Masaai: Neitoki aibelekenya netem enkalo e kopikop, intemat iip imiet e nkaina teina tiyani natemishoreki.

English: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
Masaai: Neitoki aibelekenyakino enkalo oloontoluo, netem, intemat iip imiet e nkaina teina tiyani natemishoreki.

English: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred reeds long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
Masaai: Etetema ninye too inkaloli pokira ong'uan. Neeta apa esuntai namanita ninye, intemat enkaina iip imiet te nkadori, o ntemat iip imiet e nkaina endapasho, pee etum atirishu ewueji sinyati o ene pooki ng'ae.

English: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east:
Masaai: Ore te siadi naayau ninye nanu kishomi, ina kishomi naipirare enkalo oloosaen.

English: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east: and his voice was like a noise of many waters: and the earth shined with his glory.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, eeuo enkitoo e Nkai e Israel eing'uaa enkalo oloosaen; ore oltoilo le lotunoto enye netiu anaa oltoilo loo nkariak kumok; newang'u enkop te nkitoo enye.

English: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city: and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
Masaai: Ore ina duaata natoduaa, netiu anaa enduaata apa natoduaa apa ina kata nalotu aidaikie ina anasa, netiu anaa enduaata apa natoduaa te mbata o lkeju le kebar; nabatata te nkomom ai.

English: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
Masaai: Ore ejing'ita enkitoo e Nkai atua ina aji e Nkai eimu ina kishomi natii enkalo o loosaen,

English: So the spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
Masaai: naadumu nanu Enkiyang'et ailepie, naayau atua olgoriet liatua; naa ng'ura, eiputa enkitoo o Laitoriani ina aji e Nkai.

English: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house; and the man stood by me.
Masaai: Ore eitashe ilo tung'ani te mbata nanu, naning obo laairorie nanu tiatua enkaji e Nkai; naajoki ninye nanu,

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever, and my holy name, shall the house of Israel no more defile, neither they, nor their kings, by their whoredom, nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places.
Masaai: “Enkerai e tung'ani, ore ene wueji naa ewueji olorika lai le nkitoo, naa ewueji oo ndapi oo nkejek aainei, ewueji namany tiatua iltung'ana le Israel intarasi. Nemeitoki ae kata enkaji e Israel aaisarkionie enkarna ai Sinyati, nemeitoki ninche, arashu ilaiguanak lenye, teina kiborra enye oo nkonyek, o too mpopoki oo laiguanak lenye ootuata

English: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds, and their post by my posts, and the wall between me and them, they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed: wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger.
Masaai: eitasheyie ineeidong'ishoreki enye te wueji ai neidong'ishoreki, o ntaloishin e kutuk aji enye tembata oo ntaloishin e kutuk aji aainei, metaa esuntai ake natii erishata e nanu o ninche. Eisarkionie ninche enkarna ai sinyati teilo minong otaasa ninche, metaa atumuta nanu ninche te ng'oro ai.

English: Now let them put away their whoredom, and the carcases of their kings, far from me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
Masaai: Inchoo taata eitalamaa ninche enkiborra enye oo nkonyek o mpopoki oo laiguanak lenye ootuata aaitalamaa te nanu, naa kamany nanu atua ninche intarasi.

English: Thou son of man, shew the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities: and let them measure the pattern.
Masaai: “Ore iyie, nakerai e tung'ani, toliki ina aji e Israel enkaji e Nkai o enaikununo o enaikunuuni, peyie etum aatukurru too ntorrok enye.

English: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, shew them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof: and write it in their sight, that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
Masaai: Naa tenaa kekurru te pooki nataasa ninche, imbalie enkaji e Nkai, enkitobirata enye neeipang'ieki, o ineejing'ieki enyena o pooki kitamanyunoto enye nintayiolo ninche pooki nkiguanat enye o nkitanapat enyena pooki; ninger ninche edolita, peyie etum aatujurru neibung inkitanapat pooki tenebo nkiguanat pooki.

English: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
Masaai: Ena ninye enkitanapata e Nkaji e Nkai: ina kop pooki namanita te shumata e ilo doinyo keaku enasinya oleng. Ing'ura ajo ena ninye enkitanapata e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits: The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth; even the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span: and this shall be the higher place of the altar.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche ntemat olperere lo lasar too ntemat (entemata enkaina nalulung'a o ndapasho enkaina.) Ore entonata enye naa keaku entemata enkaina nabo eilep naa entemata enkaina nabo endapasho, tenebo enkamanaa nabo namanita osegel lenye. Naa ena ninye naaku enkadori olperere lo lasar.

English: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth one cubit.
Masaai: Ore eiteru te ntonata enkop o metabaiki enkedet enye e abori, naa intemat are enkaina, neeta endapasho entemata enkaina nabo; ore eiteru te nkedet kiti o metabaiki enkedet sapuk, naa intemet ong'uan e nkaina, neeta endapasho entemet enkaina nabo;

English: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
Masaai: ore ewueji enkima olperere lo lasar, naa intemat ong'uan enkaina; ore epuku te wueji enkima olperere lo lasar eilep shumata naa imowuarak ong'uan entemata nabo enkaina eilep.

English: And the altar shall be twelve cubits long, twelve broad, square in the four squares thereof.
Masaai: Ore ine wueji enkima olperere lo lasar naa keaku kerisioro pooki intemat tomon aare enkaina enkadoro, naa intemat tomon oare enkaina endapasho.

English: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long and fourteen broad in the four squares thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and his stairs shall look toward the east.
Masaai: Ore sii ninye enkedet naa kerisioro te pooki aloli, intemat enkaina tomon oong'uan enkadoro, naa intemat enkaina tomon oong'uan endapasho, neeta enkamanaa namanita ninye olpisiai le ntemata e nkaina endapasho, ore entonata enye naa entemata nabo e nkaina emanita. Ore inkedeta e ilo perere lo lasar neipirare enkalo o loosaen.”

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt offerings thereon, and to sprinkle blood thereon.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Kuna ninche inkitanapat naaipirta olperere lo lasar: Ore teina olong naitasheyieki ninye peyie eitaini olasar opejori teshumata ninye o pee ebukokini osarge shumata ninye,

English: And thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that be of the seed of Zadok, which approach unto me, to minister unto me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin offering.
Masaai: incho ilo apolosani loo Lawi lolmarei le Sadok, ilo laanyikaki nanu aisiai, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai oloing'oni meitainyie olasar le ng'oki.

English: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about: thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it.
Masaai: Naa iya iyie embata osarge lenye, nipik ninye nena mowuarak ong'uan o lperere lo lasar, nipik ilpijat oong'uan le nkedet, nipik ina amanaa aitaman neaku neijia inko tinimpok olperere lo lasar aitisiny, nintayu olning'o lo sotua te ninye.

English: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering, and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
Masaai: Iya sii ilo oing'oni lo lasar le ng'oki, nepeji ninye te ine wueji negeluno e nkaji e Nkai, tiauluo ine wueji nesinya.

English: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as they did cleanse it with the bullock.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e are nintayu oloro lemeeta entioto te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki; naa keipoki olperere lo lasar, anaa apa peyie eipoki te ilo oing'oni.

English: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
Masaai: Ore peyie indip aipoo ninye, nintayu oloing'oni lemeeta entioto olmeregesh oing'uaa intare nemeeta entioto.

English: And thou shalt offer them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
Masaai: Ninchooyo ninche te dukuya Olaitoiriani, naa keisuaaki ilapolosak emunyan shumata ninche neitayu ninche anaa olasar opejori aitaiki Olaitoriani.

English: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i naapishana, naa intayu anaake enkine te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki, tenebo oloing'oni tenebo olmeregesh oing'uaa intare, lemeeta entioto, ninye eitaini.

English: Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.
Masaai: Neitayu ninche olasar lo lning'o lo sotua too nkolong'i naapishana te nkaraki olperere lo lasar aipok ninye aitisiny, neiteng'elakini ninye.

English: And when these days are expired, it shall be, that upon the eighth day, and so forward, the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar, and your peace offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore peyie eishu kuna olong'i, neaku ore te nkolong e isiet nelo dukuya neitayu ilapolosak to lperere lo lasar lelo asarri linyi oopejori tenebo ilasarri linyi le seriani, naa kang'amaa intae, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.”

English: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
Masaai: Naaitoki ariku nanu ina kishomi e auluo e ine wueji sinyati, naipirare enkalo oloosaen, naa keikeno apa.

English: Then said the LORD unto me; This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no man shall enter in by it; because the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it, therefore it shall be shut.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Keton ena kishomi eikeno; meboli ninye, nemeeta oltung'ani ojing'u aimu ina kishomi; amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel, naa ine etijing'unye, neaku keton ninye eikeno.”

English: It is for the prince; the prince, he shall sit in it to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.
Masaai: Olkitok ake oton tiatua ninye peyie etum ainosa emukate te dukuya Olaitoriani; naa kejing ninye atua te nkoitoi olgilata le kishomi, neitoki ake aipang teina oitoi.”

English: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house: and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD: and I fell upon my face.
Masaai: Naariku ninye nanu aimunye enkalo e kishomi e moikuape omatabaiki enkalo e dukuya e nkaji e Nkai, naing'or naa ng'ura, eiputa enkitoo Olaitoriani e nkaji o Olaitoriani; nabatata te nkomom ai.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
Masaai: Naajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, tujurru oleng, toduaa too nkonyek inono, nining too nkiyiaa inono nena pooki naaliki iyie naaipirta inkitanapat pooki e nkaji o Laitoriani tenebo nkitanapat enyena pooki; nijurru oleng ayiolou lelo pooki ooishori metijing'a enkaji e Nkai o lelo pooki oodung'ori tewueji sinyati.

English: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
Masaai: Nijoki ina aji kiserut, ina aji e Israel, Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Naaji e Israel, incho eish ilo minong lino pooki,

English: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers, uncircumcised in heart, and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to pollute it, even my house, when ye offer my bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations.
Masaai: teine ning'amaa ilomon ile memurata too ltauja o seseni, peyie ejing ewueji ai sinyati, neisarkionie ninye, ina kata nikinchosho nanu endaa ai, nena naapir o ilo sarge. Itigila intae olning'o lai lo sotua, tenebo ilo minong linyi pooki.

English: And ye have not kept the charge of mine holy things: but ye have set keepers of my charge in my sanctuary for yourselves.
Masaai: Neitu iramatata intokitin aainei sinyat; kake itipika ilomon meing'ura atua ewueji ai sinyati.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; No stranger, uncircumcised in heart, nor uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any stranger that is among the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Metaa inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Meetae olomoni olememurata oltau o sesen lenye, o pooki omoni lelo ootii atua iltung'ana le Israel, oojing ewueji ai sinyati.

English: And the Levites that are gone away far from me, when Israel went astray, which went astray away from me after their idols; they shall even bear their iniquity.
Masaai: “Kake ore lelo le Lawi laashomo aalam nanu, ootapong'ori te nanu aasuj nena kitanyaanyukot enye oo nkaitin ina kata peyie epong'ori Israel, naa kenap enkitamioto enye maate.

English: Yet they shall be ministers in my sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering to the house: they shall slay the burnt offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
Masaai: Keaku ninche ilaisiaayiak te wueji ai sinyati, neitasheiki too nkishomin e nkaji e Nkai, neisiaaisho te nkaji e Nkai; naa keyieng ninche olasar opejori te nkaraki iltung'ana, naa keramat ninche olorere, eisiaai ninche.

English: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and caused the house of Israel to fall into iniquity; therefore have I lifted up mine hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
Masaai: Amu eisiaayia ninche te dukuya inkaitin enye oo nkitanyaanyukot neaku ninche ilooibooyo ng'ok te nkaji e Israel, neaku ainosa olmumai te ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai, inchere kenap ninche maate enkitamioto enye.

English: And they shall not come near unto me, to do the office of a priest unto me, nor to come near to any of my holy things, in the most holy place: but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
Masaai: Maapuonu ninche aanyikaki nanu aaisiai nanu anaa ilapolosak, arashu epuonu aanyikaki intokitin aainei sinyat o ntokitin naa sinyat oleng; kake kenap ninche enkurruna enye, te nkaraki ilo minong otaasa ninche.

English: But I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
Masaai: Ore ake sii naa kagelu ninche meitasheiki ina aji e Nkai, peyie atum aas esiaai pooki naasi tiatua ninye.

English: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:
Masaai: “Kake ore ilapolosak loo Lawi, lelo ayiok le Sadok, lelo oogolie ewueji ai sinyati, ina kata nashomo iltung'ana le Israel aapong'ori aaing'uaa nanu, kepuonu ninche enatii aanyiku peyie aasiai nanu, naa kaaisiaai nanu aaitaiki nanu nena naapir tenebo ilo sarge, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai;

English: They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister unto me, and they shall keep my charge.
Masaai: naa kejing ninche ewueji ai Sinyati, naa kejing ninche emisa ai, peyie aaisiai nanu, naa keibung ninche enkitanapata ai.

English: And it shall come to pass, that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, whiles they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing ninche atua inchomito o lgoriet liatua, naa keishop ninche inkilani e kitani naapuyiapui; meishop hoo ninche toki naitobiruno too lpapit loo ntare, ina kata aaisiaai too nchomito o lgoriet tiatua aji.

English: They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
Masaai: Naa keishop ninche inkarash e kitani too lukuny enye o surualini e kitani too mpolosi enye; merrotian ninche ae toki naitaar ninche enkima.

English: And when they go forth into the utter court, even into the utter court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments.
Masaai: Naa tenebo eipang aapuo olodung'oro lioriong enetii iltung'ana, naa keitayu nena kilani nena apa naaisiaaishore, neirragie ninche too lgilat sinyat; neishop ninche kulie kilani, pee mepik ake esinyatisho iltung'ana too nkilani enye.

English: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
Masaai: Nemebarn ninche ilukuny enye aarashu eisho ilpapit lenye ebulu aadoru, keisor ake ninche ilpapit lenye loo lukuny enye.

English: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
Masaai: Meetae olapolosani ook enaisho oo sabibu, ina kata ejing olgoriet liatua.

English: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away: but they shall take maidens of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that had a priest before.
Masaai: Meyam ninche enkoliai, arashu enkitok natung'uayie o lpayian lenye, kake eselenkei ake o lorere le nkaji e Israel, arashu enkoliai naa enkoliai o lapolosani.

English: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
Masaai: Keiteng'en ninche iltung'ana laainei enepaashare ina nasinya o ina nemesinya, neitodol ninche eneiko teneirishu ina naiduruk o enemeiduruk.

English: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment; and they shall judge it according to my judgments: and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies; and they shall hallow my sabbaths.
Masaai: Ore tembae pooki natii enchankar, neaku ninche ilarishak te risioroto oo nkiguanat aainei. Keibung ninche inkitanapat aainei tenebo inkiguanat too siruai laainei pooki gelunot, neitisiny isabatoni aainei.

English: And they shall come at no dead person to defile themselves: but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
Masaai: Meisarkionie ninche ate aapuo aanyikaki olmeneng'ani; ore ake eyia, te papaai arashu yieyioo to layioni arashu te ntito, to lalashe arashu teina anashe nemeyama keidim aaisarkionie ate.

English: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
Masaai: Ore peyie eidip aiduruko, neikenaki kewan nkolong'i naapishana neaku ninye olemeeta olduruk.

English: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, unto the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin offering, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore teina olong nalo ninye ine wueji sinyati, atua olgoriet liaatua, peyie aaisiai tiatua ewueji sinyati, naa keitayu ninye olasar lenye le ng'oki ejo, Olaitoriani Enkai,

English: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance: and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
Masaai: “Meitoki ninche aata enjung'ore; nanu enjung'ore enye; nimincho ninche toki naitaa enenye tiatua Israel; ara nanu entoki enye.

English: They shall eat the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs.
Masaai: Kenya ninche olasar le ntapa, olasar le ng'oki tenebo olasar le ntorroni; ore pooki toki te Israel naiteng'elaki neaku enenye.

English: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things, and every oblation of all, of every sort of your oblations, shall be the priest's: ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house.
Masaai: Ore pooki nganayio le dukuya le pooki pukunoto o pooki kishoroto e pooki pukunoto too nkishorot inono pooki, naa keaku inoo lapolosak; nincho sii ninche lelo apolosak olng'anayioi lino le dukuya le mukate, peyie etum emayianata atotona te nkaji ino.

English: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself, or torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
Masaai: Menya ilapolosak pooki toki, aa emotonyi arashu eng'ues, ina natua makewan arashu enataara nkulie.

English: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall offer an oblation unto the LORD, an holy portion of the land: the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand. This shall be holy in all the borders thereof round about.
Masaai: “Ore tenelo niorikinono enkop aaya, entooriki Olaitoriani erubata teina kop metaa enkop sinyati. Intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet enkadoro; o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam endapasho, naa keaku sinyati te pooki nebaiki pooki.

English: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
Masaai: Ore teina kurma nedung'uni ewueji nerisioro inkaloli pooki oo ntemat enkaina iip imiet naaku ine wueji sinyati neeta intemat onom enkaina e wueji nemetii toki namanita ninye.

English: And of this measure shalt thou measure the length of five and twenty thousand, and the breadth of ten thousand: and in it shall be the sanctuary and the most holy place.
Masaai: Ore teina kop sinyati nirishu aoru erubata intemat nkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadoro o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te ndapasho, naa ninche ejing ina aji sinyati, ewueji sinyati oleng.

English: The holy portion of the land shall be for the priests the ministers of the sanctuary, which shall come near to minister unto the LORD: and it shall be a place for their houses, and an holy place for the sanctuary.
Masaai: Keaku ninye esashati sinyati teina kop; naa keaku enelelo apolosak ooasisho tiatua ine wueji sinyati; nejing ine wueji sinyati aaisiai Olaitoriani; naa keaku ninye ewueji oo nkajijik enye, naa ewueji Sinyati te nkaraki ine wueji sinyati.

English: And the five and twenty thousand of length, and the ten thousand of breadth, shall also the Levites, the ministers of the house, have for themselves, for a possession for twenty chambers.
Masaai: Ore enkae sashati, intemat e nkaina nkalifuni tikitam o imiet tenkadoro naa ntemat e nkaina nkalifuni tomon endapasho, naa keaku enoo le Lawi lelo ooisiaisho te nkaji e Nkai, pee eaku ewueji oo nkanas enye naamany.

English: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, over against the oblation of the holy portion: it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
Masaai: “Ore ake sii teina sashati natudung'uoki aitaa enkop nasinya, nidung'u aitaa ewueji e nkanasa, enkop oo ntemat nkalifuni imiet te ndapasho naa ntemat enkaina inkalifuni imiet te nkadoro neaku ene nkaji pooki e Israel.

English: And a portion shall be for the prince on the one side and on the other side of the oblation of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, before the oblation of the holy portion, and before the possession of the city, from the west side westward, and from the east side eastward: and the length shall be over against one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border.
Masaai: “Naa keaku eno lkitok enkop pooki natii nkaloli pokira ina kop sinyati o ine wueji e nkanasa, emanita ine wueji sinyati o ine wueji enkanasa, te nkalo oloontoluo o te nkalo o loosaen, eipirarete nkadoro nabo sashati olorere, nenyikaa eiteru te nkalo o loontoluo o meshomo oloo saen lo lpolosie leina kop. Keaku ina enkop enye te Israel.

English: In the land shall be his possession in Israel: and my princes shall no more oppress my people; and the rest of the land shall they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
Masaai: Ore ilkituaak laainei nemeitoki ae kata airony iltung'ana laainei; kake keisho ina aji e Israel menoto ina kop te risioroto oo loshon lenye.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel: remove violence and spoil, and execute judgment and justice, take away your exactions from my people, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: itaasa ingok, lo kituaak le Israel! Ewuang'ie enkikonya o enkitorogonyare, nimbalilie esipata o esinyatisho; entapal eyararoto oo ltung'ana laainei, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath. I
Masaai: “Entaa iloota intemat naasipa naaineneng'ishoreki, efa nemetii emonkoi, o bati nemetii emonkoi.

English: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of an homer, and the ephah the tenth part of an homer: the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
Masaai: Ore efa tenebo e bati naa erisiori nabo, ore bati neeta ematua nabo e tomon e Homa, ore efa ematua nabo e tomon e Homa; neaku ore Homa ninye erikorieki enkiroishi pooki.

English: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.
Masaai: Ore shekeli naa keaku ing'erai tikitam; ore shekeli imiet neaku shekeli imiet, ore shekeli tomon neaku shekeli tomon, ore mina ino neaku shekeli onom.

English: This is the oblation that ye shall offer; the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah of an homer of barley:
Masaai: “Ena ninye enkishooroto naa ninye intayu; ore ematua nabo e ile e efa te pooki homa e nkano e ematua nabo e ile e pooki homa e shairi,

English: Concerning the ordinance of oil, the bath of oil, ye shall offer the tenth part of a bath out of the cor, which is an homer of ten baths; for ten baths are an homer:
Masaai: o erubata nauno e ilata, ematua nabo e tomon bati te pooki Kori (ore kori netiu anaa homa, eeta bati tomon);

English: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: ore enker nabo te luaata oo nkerrai iip are, too lmarei pooki le Israel. Ena ninye enkishooroto te nkaraki olasar le ntapa, olasar opejori, o lasar le seriani, peyie itum aitobira olasar lo lning'o lo sotua te nkaraki ninche, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana pooki leina kop, neisho ena kishooroto ilo kitok otii atua Israel.

English: And it shall be the prince's part to give burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and drink offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all solemnities of the house of Israel: he shall prepare the sin offering, and the meat offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings, to make reconciliation for the house of Israel.
Masaai: Keaku esiaai o lkitok peyie eitobir ilasarri oopejori, ilasarri le ntapa, o lasarri ooki, te lelo siruai, teina rishata nadoli olapa too sabatoni, o te lelo siruai pooki gelunot le nkaji e Israel: keitayu ninye ilasarri le ng'oki, o lasarri le ntapa, o lasarri oopejoro, o lasarri le seriani, peyie etum aitaiki olning'o lo sotua ina aji e Israel.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: ore to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, niyaya oloti oing'oni lemeeta entioto, nimpok ine wueji sinyati.

English: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering, and put it upon the posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
Masaai: Naa keya olapolosani oloti sarge lo lasar le ng'oki nepik ninye intaloishin e kutuk aji eina aji e Nkai, nepik sii inkedeta pokira ong'uan o lperere lo lasar, o ng'apeta e kishomi e ine wueji olgoriet liatua.

English: And so thou shalt do the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple: so shall ye reconcile the house.
Masaai: Niasiasa ina te nkolong e naapishana o lapa te pooki ng'ae otaasa eng'oki te ntorroni arashu te modai; metaa intayuyu olning'o lo sotua te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai.

English: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
Masaai: “Ore to lapa le dukuya, te nkolong e tomon oong'uan o lapa, naa ishipakinono ilo sirua le ngiroroto oji Pasaka ore too nkolong'i naapishana naa kenyae emukate neitu eisiujieki.

English: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin offering.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa keitayu olkitok te nkaraki enkewan enye tenebo iltung'ana pooki leina kop oloti oing'oni te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki.

English: And seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a kid of the goats daily for a sin offering.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i naapishana e ilo sirua, naa keitaiki anaa olasar opejokini Olaitoriani iloing'ok ooti oopishana o lmeregeshi oopishana lemeeta entioto, te pooki olong e nena naapishana; o loro pooki olong te nkaraki olasar le ng'oki.

English: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
Masaai: Naa keitayu anaa olasar le ntapa e efa te pooki oing'oni, e efa te pooki meregesh, o hini e ilata te pooki efa.

English: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, shall he do the like in the feast of the seven days, according to the sin offering, according to the burnt offering, and according to the meat offering, and according to the oil.
Masaai: Ore to lapa le naapishana, te nkolong e tomon o imiet olapa o too nkolong'i naapishana e ilo sirua, naa keitobiri ina kishorunoto tenkaraki olasar loo ng'ok ilasarri oopejori, o lasarri le ntapa, o te ilata.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Ore kishomi o lodung'oro liatua oipirare oloo saen naa keikeni te nena olong'i ile naasishoi; kake ore teina olong e sabato naa keboli o enkolong nadoli olapa.

English: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate: then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
Masaai: Kejing olkitok eimu olgoriet leina kishomi eing'uaa auluo, neitashe ninye te mbata entaloishi e kishomi. Neitayu ilapolosak ilasarri lenye oopejori, ilasarri lenyena le seriani, neseremisho tempolos e kishomi, neipung alo auluo, kake meikeni kishomi o metaa teipa.

English: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of this gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana leina kop neseremisho te nejing'ieki ina kishomi te dukuya Olaitoriani too sabatoni te nedoli olapa.

English: And the burnt offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD in the sabbath day shall be six lambs without blemish, and a ram without blemish.
Masaai: Ore ilo asar opejori oitayio ilo kitok aitaiki Olaitoriani te ina olong e sabato naa keaku ilkuoo le kerra ile lemeeta entioto, o lmeregesh lemeeta entioto;

English: And the meat offering shall be an ephah for a ram, and the meat offering for the lambs as he shall be able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
Masaai: o lasar le ntapa te nebo olmeregesh neaku e efa, te nebo olasar le ntapa tenebo ilkuoo keaku ake duoo anaa enaidim, tenebo eilata te pooki efa.

English: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish, and six lambs, and a ram: they shall be without blemish.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong nadoli olapa naa keitayu ninye oloti oing'oni lemeeta entioto, olkuoo le kerra o lmeregesh, lemeeta entioto;

English: And he shall prepare a meat offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs according as his hand shall attain unto, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
Masaai: anaa olasar le ntapa neitayu e efa tenebo oloing'oni tenebo e efa tenebo olmeregesh, tenebo olkuoo le kerra anaa enaidim aitayu, tenebo hini e ilata te pooki efa.

English: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of that gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing olkitok, nejing'u atua eimu ilo goriet le kishomi, naa ina oitoi ake naimua eitoki aim.

English: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the solemn feasts, he that entereth in by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate: he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth over against it.
Masaai: “Ore peyie epuonu iltung'ana leina kop dukuya o Laitoriani te lelo siruai oogeluno, ore ilo ojing'u te kishomi e moikuape aseremisho neipang alo te kishomi e kopikop; ore ilo ojing'u te kishomi e kopikop neipang auluo te kishomi e moikuape; meetae oltung'ani oshuko aipang eimaa kishomi natijing'ie, kake keipang ake pooki ng'ae aitoriori alo dukuya.

English: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
Masaai: Ore peyie ejing ninche atua naa kejing olkitok atua tenebo ninche; naa teneipang ninche boo neipang sii ninye boo.

English: And in the feasts and in the solemnities the meat offering shall be an ephah to a bullock, and ephah to a ram, and to the lambs as he is able to give, and an hin of oil to an ephah.
Masaai: “Ore te lelo siruai o nena rishat naageluno, ore olasar le ntapa tenebo oloti oing'oni naa keaku efa nabo, ore tenebo olkuoo le ker naa efa, ore tenebo ilkuoo le kerra anaa ake duoo enaidim oltung'ani aishoru, tenebo hini e ilata te efa.

English: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
Masaai: Teneitayu olkitok enkishooroto to lpela aa olasar opejori arashu olasar le seriani anaa enkishooroto o lpela to Laitoriani, ore ina kishomi naipirare oloo saen naa kebolokini ninye; naa keitayu ninye olasar lenye opejori arashu olasar lenye le seriani anaa enaas ninye te nkolong e sabato. Naa keipang ninye auluo, ore peyie eipang ninye auluo, neikeni kishomi.

English: Thou shalt daily prepare a burnt offering unto the LORD of a lamb of the first year without blemish: thou shalt prepare it every morning.
Masaai: “Naa keitayu ninye olkuoo le ker lo lari obo lemeeta entioto metaa olasar opejori to Laitoriani anaake; tadekenya eitayu ninye.

English: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.
Masaai: Neitayu tenebo ninye olasar le ntapa tenebo ninye anaake tadekenya, ematua nabo e ile e efa, o ematua nabo e uni e hini e eilata peyie eitashal ina tapa, anaa olasar le ntapa lo Laitoriani; ena ninye enkitanapata naipirta ilo asar opejori le anaake.

English: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meat offering, and the oil, every morning for a continual burnt offering.
Masaai: Neaku neijia eikununi ilo kuoo le ker tenebo olasar le ndaa tenebo eilata eitaini, anaake tadekenya metaa olasar ouno anaake.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, the inheritance thereof shall be his sons'; it shall be their possession by inheritance.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Tenelo neitayu olkitok enkishooroto aitaiki obo loo layiok lenyena tiatua enjung'ore enye, naa keaku enoo layiok lenyena, entoki nara enenye te njung'ore.

English: But if he give a gift of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it shall be his to the year of liberty; after it shall return to the prince: but his inheritance shall be his sons' for them.
Masaai: Kake tenelo neitayu enkishooroto aitaiki obo loo sinkan lenyena neaku enenye o metabaiki ilo ari le lakunoto; nerrinyokino aaku enolkitok; keaku ilayiok lenyena ake ooidim aatushum enkishooroto te njung'ore enye.

English: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people's inheritance by oppression, to thrust them out of their possession; but he shall give his sons inheritance out of his own possession: that my people be not scattered every man from his possession.
Masaai: Meya olkitok enjung'ore hoo nabo oo ltung'ana nemerrumoo ninche te wueji enye; keisho ninye ilayiok lenyena enjung'ore enye teine wueji enye makewan, metaa meetae hoo obo loo ltung'ana laainei ooruni entoki enye.”

English: After he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers of the priests, which looked toward the north: and, behold, there was a place on the two sides westward.
Masaai: Ina peyie aaitijing'u nanu te wueji najing'ieki, ina apa naatii embata eina kishomi, te nkalo e moikuape oo lgilat sinyat tenkaraki ilapolosak; ore teine nadol ewueji te bayie o loontoluo te nkiting'oto enye.

English: Then said he unto me, This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, where they shall bake the meat offering; that they bear them not out into the utter court, to sanctify the people.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Nena ewueji nepejie ilapolosak enkishooroto o lasar le nkitarruorroto tenebo enkishooroto o lasar le ngoki naa teine sii epej olasar le ntapa peyie metum ninche aayau ninche aaitupuku ine wueji olgoriet le boo, neitabaiki esinyatisho olorere.

English: Then he brought me forth into the utter court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
Masaai: “Naariku nanu dukuya atua ilo goriet lioriong naarik nanu ilpijat pokira oong'uan lo lgoriet; ore te pooki pijata lo lgoriet netii olgoriet

English: In the four corners of the court there were courts joined of forty cubits long and thirty broad: these four corners were of one measure.
Masaai: ore tiatua nena matuan pokira ong'uan o lgoriet netii gorieti dung'orot, intemat enkaina artam te nkadoro o ntemat enkaina tomoni uni endapasho; ore nena pokira ong'uan nerisioro.

English: And there was a row of building round about in them, round about them four, and it was made with boiling places under the rows round about.
Masaai: Ore tiatua, ine nemanita lelo gorieti pokira oong'uan, netii isoito oo gueta netii ewueji neinokieki enkima namanita.

English: Then said he unto me, These are the places of them that boil, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifice of the people.
Masaai: Ina peyie aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore kuna naa iwuejitin neeyierie lelo oasisho te nkaji e Nkai ilasarri ooishorutua iltung'ana.”

English: Afterward he brought me again unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward: for the forefront of the house stood toward the east, and the waters came down from under from the right side of the house, at the south side of the altar.
Masaai: Naariku nanu arrinyu oriong e kutuk aji e nkaji e Nkai; naa ng'ura epuku enkare tiabori ine neitasheyie enkaji e Nkai te nkalo oloo saen (amu ore enkaji e Nkai neipirare oloosaen); neruko enkare abori naing'uaa kopikop o eneitasheyie ina aji e Nkai, kopikop olperere lo lasar.

English: Then brought he me out of the way of the gate northward, and led me about the way without unto the utter gate by the way that looketh eastward; and, behold, there ran out waters on the right side.
Masaai: Naaipang'unye ninye nanu te nkalo e kishomi e kopikop, naarik nanu aitaman oriong ina kishomi e oriong, ina naipirare enkalo oloosaen; nepuku enkare te nkalo e kopikop.

English: And when the man that had the line in his hand went forth eastward, he measured a thousand cubits, and he brought me through the waters; the waters were to the ancles.
Masaai: Ore eloito enkalo o loo saen eeta enkopito te nkaina enye, netem ilo tung'ani intemat enkaina enkalifu nabo, naarik nanu aimie atua ina are; naa oloure kokoyo ebaiki eng'uton enye.

English: Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through the waters; the waters were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and brought me through; the waters were to the loins.
Masaai: Neitoki atem intemat enkaina enkalifu, naarik nanu aimie atua enkare; naa enkung'u ebaiki eng'uton, neitoki atem intemat enkalifu, naarik nanu aimie atua enkare; nebaiki empolos ai ina are.

English: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
Masaai: Neitoki atem intemat enkaina enkalifu, naa olkeju lemaidim aima atalang'a, amu eilepua enkare; ekegut apa oleng enaa indim aisompirayu tiatua olkeju lemelang'ayu.

English: And he said unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen this? Then he brought me, and caused me to return to the brink of the river.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Enkerai e tung'ani, itoduaa iyie ena?” Naarriny nanu aimie enkiyopata o lkeju.

English: Now when I had returned, behold, at the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
Masaai: Ore arrinyo, nadol te nkiyopata olkeju ilkeek kumok te nchoto nabo o te nkae.

English: Then said he unto me, These waters issue out toward the east country, and go down into the desert, and go into the sea: which being brought forth into the sea, the waters shall be healed.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ena are nerukokino enkalo enkop oloosaen, nelo arukokino atua Araba; ore peyie ejing atua nkariak nemeruko e naiposha, nesilayu ina are.

English: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
Masaai: Ore pooki wueji nelo ilokeju ore pooki toki naishu nalo tiatua neton eishu, naa keaku ketii isinkir kumok; amu ine wueji elo ina are, peyie etum nena ariak enaiposha aatisilata; metaa etii pooki toki ine nelo ilo keju.

English: And it shall come to pass, that the fishers shall stand upon it from Engedi even unto En-eglaim; they shall be a place to spread forth nets; their fish shall be according to their kinds, as the fish of the great sea, exceeding many.
Masaai: Ore lelo arreshok loo sinkir neitashe te nkiyopata enaiposha; eiteru te En-gedi, ometabaiki Eneglaim, keaku ewueji neidapashieki irresheta; ore isinkir lenyena naa keaku iloompukunot kumok, anaa isinkir le naiposha kitok.

English: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
Masaai: Kake ore olng'arua o lkishankual lenye; nemesila asidanu ekeing'uaa ninche metaa emunyan.

English: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.
Masaai: Ore too nkiyopat o lkeju too lkekuno pokira lo lkeju, naa kebulu impukunot kumok oo lkeek aaku endaa. Metoyu mbenek enye arashu elau ilng'anayio lenye, kake keiu ilng'anayio sidain te pooki apa, amu ore ina are enye nerukunye aing'uaa ine wueji sinyati. Ore ilng'anayio lenye naa keaku ile ndaa ore imbenek enye neaku olmairo oishiunye olorere.

English: Thus saith the Lord GOD; This shall be the border, whereby ye shall inherit the land according to the twelve tribes of Israel: Joseph shall have two portions.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: Kulo ninche ilpolosien laa ninche iorie enkop te njung'ore tiatua lelo oshon loo Siraeli tomon aare. Ore Yosef naa ketum irubat are.

English: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another: concerning the which I lifted up mine hand to give it unto your fathers: and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
Masaai: Naa ior iyie ninye aitoris; ainosa apa olmumai ajo kaisho ninye iloo papaai linyi, naa keaku ena kop te intae enjung'ore.

English: And this shall be the border of the land toward the north side, from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, as men go to Zedad;
Masaai: “Keaku ena olpolosie leina kop: ore te nkalo e moikuape, eiteru te Naiposha kitok te nkalo enkoitoi e Hetlon, o metabaiki ine nejing'ieki e Hamat, o te nkalo e Sedad, o Berota,

English: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-hatticon, which is by the coast of Hauran.
Masaai: o Sibraim (ina natii olpolosie orish Dameski o Hamat) o metabaiki Haseratikon, ina natii olpolosie le Hauran.

English: And the border from the sea shall be Hazarenan, the border of Damascus, and the north northward, and the border of Hamath. And this is the north side.
Masaai: Metaa kepuku olpolosie le naiposha e Hasarenon, ina natii moikuape olpolosie le Dameski, tenebo olpolosie le Hamat o meshomo moikuape. Keaku ena enkalo e moikuape.

English: And the east side ye shall measure from Hauran, and from Damascus, and from Gilead, and from the land of Israel by Jordan, from the border unto the east sea. And this is the east side.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo oloosaen, naa kepuku olpolosie te Hasarenom te rishata Hauran o Dameski; eimaa Yordan te rishata e Gilead o enkop e Israel; o meshomo enkalo oloosaen enaiposha o metabaiki Tamau. Keaku ina enkalo oloosaen.

English: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo e kopikop, naa kepuku te Tamar o metabaiki nena ariak e Meribatkadesh, o meshomo lelo motioo le Misiri, o metabaiki enaiposha kitok. Keaku ina enkalo e kopikop.

English: The west side also shall be the great sea from the border, till a man come over against Hamath. This is the west side.
Masaai: “Ore te nkalo o loontoluo, ore ina aiposha kitok neaku ninye olpolosie o metabaiki ewueji enkae alo ine nejing'ieki Hamat. Keaku ina enkalo oloontoluo.

English: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: “Neaku iorioro ena kop tiatua intae te risioroto oo loshon le Israel.

English: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you, and to the strangers that sojourn among you, which shall beget children among you: and they shall be unto you as born in the country among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Idung'okiki ate metaa enjung'ore te ntae o tenebo ilomon oomanya atua intae netoiutuo nkera tiatua intae. Keaku ninche te intae olayioni oino loo layiok le Israel; ore tenebo intae naa keishori enjung'ore tiatua iloshon le Israel.

English: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: “Ore te pooki ake ninye osho omanya ilo omoni, neaku teine idung'okiki ninye enjung'ore enye, ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: Now these are the names of the tribes. From the north end to the coast of the way of Hethlon, as one goeth to Hamath, Hazarenan, the border of Damascus northward, to the coast of Hamath; for these are his sides east and west; a portion for Dan.
Masaai: “Kuna ninche inkarn oo loshon: Eiteru to lpolosie le moikuape, eiteru te naiposha te nkalo enkoitoi e Hetlon o meshomo enejing'ieki Hamat, o metabaiki Hasarenon (ina natii olpolosie le moikuape e Dameski o metabaiki Hamat), nepuku te nkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo, Dan erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Asher.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Dan, eiteru te nkalo oloosaen o metabaiki Asheri, naa erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
Masaai: Ore epuku to lpolosie le nkop e Asheri, te nkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo, naa Naftali, naa erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Manasseh.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Naftali, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Manase, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Ephraim.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Manase, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o metabaiki enkalo oloontoluo, naa Efraim, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Reuben.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le Efraim, eiteru te nkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Ruben, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side, a portion for Judah.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Ruben, eiteru tenkalo oloosaen o metabaiki oloontoluo naa Yuda, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall offer of five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the other parts, from the east side unto the west side: and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
Masaai: “Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Yuda, eiteru te nkalo o loosaen, o metabaiki oloontoluo, naa keaku erubata naitaini aaiteng'el, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet e ndapasho, ore tenkadori nerisiore eneba nabo e nena rubat olosho, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o metabaiki oloontoluo, etii ewueji sinyati empolos enye.

English: The oblation that ye shall offer unto the LORD shall be of five and twenty thousand in length, and of ten thousand in breadth.
Masaai: Ore ina rubata ninteng'elakiki Olaitoriani, naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori, o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam tendapasho.

English: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Kuna ninche naaku iorot ewueji sinyati, naa keishori ilapolosak eoroto nabaiki intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkalo e moikuape, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te ndapasho te nkalo oloontoluo, intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo oloo saen o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadoro te nkalo e kopikop, netii ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani eneitorit.

English: It shall be for the priests that are sanctified of the sons of Zadok; which have kept my charge, which went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
Masaai: Keaku ena enoo lapolosak ooitisinyaki lelo ayiok le Sadok, lelo ooibung'a enkitanapata ai, lelo leitu epuo aapong'ori ina kata napuo iltung'ana le Israel aapong'ori, anaa enataasa ile Lawi.

English: And this oblation of the land that is offered shall be unto them a thing most holy by the border of the Levites.
Masaai: Naa keaku enenye anaa erubata e tipat naing'uaa ine wueji sinyati eina kop, e wueji neisul te sinyatisho eiteru to lpolosie le Lawi.

English: And over against the border of the priests the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth: all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
Masaai: Ore tembata ina kop oo lapolosak keaku keeta Ilawi ewueji oo ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon endapasho. Ore enkadori enye pooki naa keaku intemat e nkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet ore endapasho naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam.

English: And they shall not sell of it, neither exchange, nor alienate the firstfruits of the land: for it is holy unto the LORD.
Masaai: Nememir arashu ewalaa ina rubata enkop ake pooki, amu aisinyati ninye to Laitoriani.

English: And the five thousand, that are left in the breadth over against the five and twenty thousand, shall be a profane place for the city, for dwelling, and for suburbs: and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
Masaai: “Ore ina naleku, intemat enkaina inkalifuni imiet te ndapasho, o ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet te nkadori, naa keaku ene pooki siaai teina anasa eiana anasa, ee nemanyi oe wueji nemetii toki. Ore te mpolos enye netii enkanasa;

English: And these shall be the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
Masaai: naa kuna ninche intemet enyena: ore enkalo e moikuape naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet, ore enkalo e kopikop intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet, ore te nkalo oloontoluo naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet.

English: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
Masaai: Naa keeta enkanasa enkop nalala: ore te nkalo e moikuape intemat e nkaina iip are oo onom, ore te nkalo e kopikop naa intemat enkaina iip are o onom, ore tenkalo o loontoluo naa intemat enkaina iip are o onom.

English: And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy portion shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward: and it shall be over against the oblation of the holy portion; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
Masaai: Ore ina adori natelekua ina natashare ine wueji sinyati naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo oloosaen, naa intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon te nkalo o loontoluo, naa keaku enatashare ina rubata sinyati. Ore ina naiu ninye naa keaku endaa e lelo aisiaayiak lenkanasa.

English: And they that serve the city shall serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Ore ilaisiaayiak le nkanasa, too loreren pooki le Israel, naa ketur ninye.

English: All the oblation shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand: ye shall offer the holy oblation foursquare, with the possession of the city.
Masaai: Ore ine wueji pooki ninteng'el naa keaku intemat e nkaina nkalifuni tikitam o imiet erisioro nkaloli pooki, aa taa, ina rubata nasinya tenebo nena tokitin naara ineina anasa.

English: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy oblation, and of the possession of the city, over against the five and twenty thousand of the oblation toward the east border, and westward over against the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, over against the portions for the prince: and it shall be the holy oblation; and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
Masaai: “Ore enaleku te pooki alo eina rubata sinyati o ina nara ene nkanasa naa keaku ino lkitok. Eiteru too ntemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o imiet eina rubata nasinya o meshomo olpolosie lo loosaen, neito oloontoluo eiteru too ntemat enkaina inkalifunitikitam o imiet o meshomo olpolosie lo loontoluo, ine neshepita isashat oo loshon, naa keaku eneilo kitok. Ore inewueji sinyati tenebo ina aji sinyati Enkai natii empolos enye,

English: Moreover from the possession of the Levites, and from the possession of the city, being in the midst of that which is the prince's, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, shall be for the prince.
Masaai: tenebo ina nara enoo le Lawi, tenebo ina nara ene nkanasa, naa keaku enatii empolos eina nara enoo lkitok. Ore erubata eilo kitok naa keaku enatii ilo polosie le Yuda olpolosie le Benchamen.

English: As for the rest of the tribes, from the east side unto the west side, Benjamin shall have a portion.
Masaai: “Ore tenkaraki ilkulikae oshon: Eiteru te nkalo oloosaen o meshomo oloo ntoluo, naa Benchamen, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side, Simeon shall have a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Benchamen, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloontoluo, naa Simion, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side, Issachar a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Simion, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloontoluo, naa Isaakar, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side, Zebulun a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Isaakar, eiteru te nkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo naa Sebulon, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Sebulon, eiteru tenkalo oloo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo naa Gad, erubata nabo.

English: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of strife in Kadesh, and to the river toward the great sea.
Masaai: Ore eiteru to lpolosie le nkop e Gad o meshomo kopikop, naa kepuku olpolosie te Tamar o meshomo nkariak e Meribatkadesh, aa keim enkiyopata ina shorro e Misiri o metijing'a enaiposha kitok.

English: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Ore ena naa enkop nidung'oki metaa enjung'o tiatua iloshon le Israel, naa kuna ninche irubat enye ejo Olaitoriani Enkai.

English: And these are the goings out of the city on the north side, four thousand and five hundred measures.
Masaai: “Keaku keetae ineepukunyeki enkanasa: Ore te nkalo e moikuape ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tikitam o ong'uan o iip imiet te ntemet, inchomito uni,

English: And the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel: three gates northward; one gate of Reuben, one gate of Judah, one gate of Levi.
Masaai: e nkishomi e Ruben, e nkishomi e Yuda, o enkishomi e Lawi, ore nchomito enkanasa naa keipotieki iloshon le Israel.

English: And at the east side four thousand and five hundred: and three gates; and one gate of Joseph, one gate of Benjamin, one gate of Dan.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo oloosaen, ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni oong'uan o iip imiet, naa inchomito uni, kishomi e Yosef, kishomi e Benchamen, o kishomi e Dan.

English: And at the south side four thousand and five hundred measures: and three gates; one gate of Simeon, one gate of Issachar, one gate of Zebulun.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo e kopikop, ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet te ntemet, naa inchomito uni, kishomi e Simion, kishomi e Isaakar, o kishomi e Sebulon.

English: At the west side four thousand and five hundred, with their three gates; one gate of Gad, one gate of Asher, one gate of Naphtali.
Masaai: Ore te nkalo oloo ntoluo ina naaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni ong'uan o iip imiet naa nchomito uni, kishomi e Gad, o kishomi e Asheri, o kishomi e Naftali.

English: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
Masaai: Ore emanaroto e nkanasa naa keaku intemat enkaina inkalifuni tomon o isiet. Ore enkarna e nkanasa eiteru teina kata nelo dukuya naa keji, Etii Olaitoriani ine!”

English: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon unto Jerusalem, and besieged it.
Masaai: Ore to lari li okuni le nkitoria e Yohoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda, nelotu Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon, Yerusalem nemuat ninye near.

English: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God: which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.
Masaai: Neishooyo Olaitoriani Yohoiakim olaiguanani le Yuda apik atua inkaik enyena, te nebo embata oo masaa e nkaji e Nkai, neyau ninye ninche enkop e Shinari atua enkaji e Nkai enye, nepik nena masaa e wueji neshumieki ntokitin e tipat e nkai enye.

English: And the king spake unto Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring certain of the children of Israel, and of the king's seed, and of the princes;
Masaai: Neitoki olaiguanani aitanap Ashpenas, ilo aitasheikinoni lenye kitok sunash ogelema, pee eyau embata oo ltung'ana le Israel, lelo le nkaji e nkitoo o lelo kituaak,

English: Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king's palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.
