English: And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.
Masaai: Keiro ninye mbaa naapaashare Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, naa kelo ninye aitanaur lelo sinyat le Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul, nedamu pee eibelekeny nkatitin o nkitanapat; naa keishoori ninche aapik atuaenkaina enye te nkiti kata, nkatitin are o lpisiai le nkata.

English: But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end.
Masaai: Kake keton enkiguana aiguana, ore enkitoo enye naa keyae aaitung'uaa ninye, pee eishieki neinyali aaiting'ie.

English: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.
Masaai: Ore enkitoria o enkitoo o engolon oo nkitoriat naatii abori shumata pooki, neishori iltung'ana loo sinyat le Ilo Otii Shumata Aisul; ore enkitoria enye naa keaku enkitoria oo ntarasi, ore enkitoo pooki neisiai nening ninche.’

English: Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.
Masaai: “Ene enkiting'oto e ina bae. Ore tialo nanu Daniel, aaitanyamala ndamunot aainei oleng, neibelekenya emua o sesen lai; kake atushuma ina bae too ndamunot aainei.”

English: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
Masaai: Ore to lari li okuni le nkitoria o laiguanani Belshasa nadol nanu enduaata eare.

English: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
Masaai: Nadol nanu te ina duaata; naa ore apa pee adol, natii Susa ina anasa kitok, natii olkerenket le Elam; nadol apa nanu te nduaata, atii embata olkeju le Ulai.

English: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
Masaai: Naraposhu nkonyek aainei nadol, naa ng'ura, olmeregesh oitashe te ngilata o lkeju. Neeta imowuarak are; ore nena mowuarak pokira are naa kaadoru oleng, kake keado nabo alang enkae, ore ina naado neilep oleng, nelotu ina naado te siadi enkae.

English: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
Masaai: Nadol nanu ilo meregesh eipusho te nkalo o loo ntoluo, o moikuape o kopikop; nemeetae eng'ues naidim aitasho te dukuya ninye; nemeetae hoo obo oidim atokordu enatii abori engolon enye; etaasa anaa enayieu makewan nerup kewan aitaa sidai.

English: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
Masaai: Ore aibirribirrita, ng'ura, nelotu oloro eing'uaa enkalo o loo ntoluo eimu oriong enkop pooki eitu eibung enkop; neeta ilo oro emowuo e nking'asia te rishata oo nkonyek enyena.

English: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye enetii ilo meregesh oata imowuarak are, ilo duoo latoduaa nanu eitashe te ngilata o lkeju, nekuetiki ninye te ngoro enye kitok.

English: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
Masaai: Nadol ninye eeuo anyikaki ilo meregesh neiponyare ninye, neosh ilo meregesh negil nena mowuarak enyena pokira are; neitu eitoki ilo meregesh aata engolon naitasheyie te dukuya ninye, kake etanang'ie ilo oro ninye enkop neituny ninye; nemeetae hoo obo oidim atokordu ilo meregesh aitung'uai engolon enye.

English: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
Masaai: Neisis ilo oro kewan oleng, kake ore ina kata egol ninye, negila ina mouo enye kitok, ore te rishata enye, nepuonu imowuarak ong'uan e nking'asia naaing'uaa ilkutat pokira ong'uan le shumata.

English: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
Masaai: Etubulua emowuo nabo teina kiti mouo, natubulua oleng aipir enkalo e kopikop, neipir enkalo o loo saen neipir ina kop kitok.

English: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
Masaai: Nebulu ninye oleng o metabaiki olorora le shumata, ore embata o lorora loo lakir nesulaki ninye enkop, neituny ninche.

English: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
Masaai: Nerup ninye kewan o te ilo kitok lo lorora; ore olasar opejori anaake neiwuang'ieki te ninye, ore ewueji e manyisho enye nenang'ari.

English: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
Masaai: Neishori ninye ilo orora te nebo ilo asar opejori anaake te ngilata oo nkitanapat; ore esipata nenang'akini enkop, neas ina mouo anaa enayieu nedupoyu.

English: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aning osinyati eiro; ore likae sinyati nejoki ilo oiroro, “Ae te nkata nabaa eetae ina duaata naipirta ilo osar opejori anaake, o ina gilata oo nkitanapat naitaa olmuaate, o ina naishooyioki emanyisho enye, o lorora meitunyi too nkejek?”

English: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Too nkalifuni are o iip uni oo nteipai o nkakeny; nerrinyokini taa ine wueji sinyati enapake wueji enye.”

English: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
Masaai: Ore nanu, Daniel, pee aidip atoduaa ina duaata, nanyok ajo ayiolou, naa ng'ura, eitashe te ine te dukuya nanu obo oata empukunoto o ltung'ani.

English: And I heard a man's voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
Masaai: Naning nanu oltoilo lo ltung'ani te rishata oo ngilat o lkeju le Ulai, neipotisho ilo toilo ajo, “Gabriel, nchoo ele tung'ani ening'u neyiolou enduaata.”

English: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
Masaai: Neaku etinyikua ninye alotu ine apa naitasheyie nanu; ore pee elotu nairut nabatata te nkomom. Kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Toning'o iyie nakerai nchere ore ena duaata naa te nkaraki enkata e nkiting'oto.”

English: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
Masaai: Ore aairorie ninye nanu, naaibung njo oleng nairrag aitabaiki enkomom enkop; kake aaiseyie ninye naadumu nanu maitasho too nkejek aainei.

English: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ng'ura, kaaitayiolo nanu iyie ina nayooki aaku te nkata e siadi e ngoro, amu ina kata apa nageluno e nkiting'oto eipirta.

English: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
Masaai: Ore ilo meregesh litoduaa oata imowuarak are, ore nena mowuarak are naa ilaiguanak le Media o Parsia.

English: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
Masaai: Ore ilo oro naa olaiguanani loo Lyunani; ore ina mouo kitok natii erishata oo nkonyek enyena naa ilo aiguanani oituruku.

English: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
Masaai: Ore ina mouo apa natigile te ine netubulunye kulie ong'uan naa keyooki aadumunye nkitoriat ong'uan te nkop enye, kake mme te ngolon enye.

English: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
Masaai: Ore te nkata e siadi e nkitoria enye, eidipa ilaitarruorrok aatimitunye, nelotu olaiguanani ogogong netolo oyiolo oleng ndung'eta e rashe.

English: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
Masaai: Naa kesapuku engolon enye, naa keyau enkidaata naitureisho naa keisul ninye te naba anaa enaas, naa keidaikie ninye iltung'ana magil o ltung'ana le lelo sinyat.

English: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
Masaai: Ore te nkalamasisho enye naa keponaa aitubul elejare te nkaina enye ore too ndamunot enyena makewan nerup kewan. Keidaikie ilkumok metii enkikoo naa kedumakino doi ninye o metabaiki Olkitok loo lkituaak, kake kepuoi aagil ninye metii enkaina e tung'ani.

English: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
Masaai: Ore ina duaata oo nteipai o nkakeny duoo natolimuoki naa kesipa; kake tunuka ina duaata, amu enoo nkolong'i naapuonu.”

English: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
Masaai: Ore nanu, Daniel, naaidimuni naairrag nkuti olong'i atamuoyia; naitoki nanu adumunye nalo enkisiaayiare o laiguanani; kake aiputukunyo nanu te ina duaata aningu ayiolou.

English: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
Masaai: Ore to lari le dukuya le Darias olayioni le Ahaseuro, laa ore te inoto naa Olmedei, ilo otaa olaiguanani le nkitoria oo Lkaldayo

English: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
Masaai: ore to lari le dukuya le nkitoria enye, namusu nanu Daniel ti atua mbukui esiana oo larin, laa ore te risioroto ororei lo Laitoriani otolikioki Yeremia ilo oiboni meeta nchere pee mebaya te dukuya enkiting'oto e nkidaata e Yerusalem, naa ilarin ntomoni naapishana.

English: And I set my face unto the Lord God, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
Masaai: Naitoki aibelekenyakino Olaitoriani Enkai, aing'oru ninye te nkomono o te sayiata te enata e kewan o te nkishopoto oo lkuniyiani o nkuruon.

English: And I prayed unto the LORD my God, and made my confession, and said, O Lord, the great and dreadful God, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
Masaai: Atoomono nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ai nairridu ajo, “Olaitoriani Na ai kitok magilani, oibung ninye olning'o lo sotua o enyorrata nauno te lelo oonyor ninye neibung nkitanapat enyena,

English: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from thy precepts and from thy judgments:
Masaai: kitaasa iyiook eng'oki nikintarruoitie nikiaasisho te suujisho nikigolong'u, kimbelekenyate aaing'uaa nkitanapat inono o nkiguanat inono;

English: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets, which spake in thy name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
Masaai: eitu iyiook kining isinkan linono lelo oibonok le Nkai, apa ooirorie ninche te nkarna ino ilaiguanak lang, o ilkituaak lang o loo papa, o ltung'ana pooki lena kop.

English: O Lord, righteousness belongeth unto thee, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Israel, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither thou hast driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee.
Masaai: Enino Olaitoriani esipita, kake kiaata iyiook enkurruna anaa enikitiu ena olong too ltung'ana le Yuda, te lelo oomanya Yerusalem, o Israel pooki, lelo ootaana o lelo oolakua pooki, ti atua nenakuapi pooki apa niterewa iyie ninche. Te nkaraki ina taboi nataasa ninche ti alo iyie.

English: O Lord, to us belongeth confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against thee.
Masaai: Enaang, Olaitoriani, enkurruna, o laiguanak lang, o lkituaak lang, o loo papa enkaraki nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki.

English: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
Masaai: Eno Laitoriani Enkai ang olng'ur o empalakino amu kitogolong'akitia iyiook ninye,

English: Neither have we obeyed the voice of the LORD our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
Masaai: neitu iyiook kining oltoilo lo Laitoriani Enkai ang aasuj nkitanapat enyena, apa naatipika ninye dukuya iyiook too sinkan lenyena lelo oibonok le Nkai.

English: Yea, all Israel have transgressed thy law, even by departing, that they might not obey thy voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him.
Masaai: Etigila Israel pooki enkitanapata ino neibelekenye, neany ening oltoilo lino. Ore ilo deket o lmumai naaigeroki ti atua nkitanapat e Musa ilo sinka le Nkai netubukokoki iyiook, enkaraki nikitaasa iyiook eng'oki ti alo ninye.

English: And he hath confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.
Masaai: Eitabayie ninye irorei lenyena, lelo apa ooiroro ninye ti alo iyiook o ti alo lelo kituaak ooitore iyiook, ayau shumata iyiook enkitamioto sapuk; amu ore ti abori shumata pooki eitu ae kata etumi embae nanyaanyukie enaitaasaki Yerusalem.

English: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before the LORD our God, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand thy truth.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaigeroki ti atua nkitanapat e Musa, eeuo ena kitamioto pooki shumata iyiook, neitu ake kiomonu omom o Laitoriani Enkai ang, aaibelekenya aaing'uaa ntorrok ang nikining ina sipata.

English: Therefore hath the LORD watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth: for we obeyed not his voice.
Masaai: Neaku eitobira Olaitoriani ina kitamioto neyaua ninye shumata iyiook; amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai ang naa asipani too siaitin pooki naataasa ninye, neitu iyiook kining oltoilo lenye.

English: And now, O Lord our God, that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and hast gotten thee renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
Masaai: Naa ore taata, Olaitoriani Enkai ang, laa iyie oyaua iltung'ana linono aitupuku ti atua enkop e Misiri te nkaina magilani, nintobiraki kewan enkarna, anaa enatiu ena olong, kitaasa iyiook eng'oki, kitaasishote te ntorroni.

English: O Lord, according to all thy righteousness, I beseech thee, let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem, thy holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, ore te risioroto oo nkiaasin inono naasipa, nchoo engoro ino o empijan ino eibelekenya apaash ena anasa ino Yerusalem, ena doinyo ino sinyati; amu te nkaraki ing'ok ang o entorroni oo loo papa pee eimakini Yerusalem o ltung'ana linono ti atua kulo tung'ana pooki oomanita iyiook.

English: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
Masaai: Ore naa Olaitoriani, na Ai ang, toning'o enkomono o sinka lino o esayiata enye, naa ore te nkaraki kewan ino Olaitoriani, nchoo enkomom ino meitawang'aki ewueji ino sinyati ina nataa olmuaate.

English: O my God, incline thine ear, and hear; open thine eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by thy name: for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses, but for thy great mercies.
Masaai: Na Ai ai, irrugu enkiok ino toning'o; tabolo nkonyek inono toduaa emijoonisho ang o ina anasa naipotieki enkarna ino; amu mikintarasu dukuya iyie isayiat ang te nkaraki esipata ang, kake te nkaraki olng'ur lino kitok.

English: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive; O Lord, hearken and do; defer not, for thine own sake, O my God: for thy city and thy people are called by thy name.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, toning'o; Olaitoriani tapalaki iyiook; Olaitoriani toning'o iyiook niasisho; mimutie, te nkaraki kewan ino, na Ai ai, ore te nkaraki ena anasa ino o ltung'ana linono naa enkarna ino eipotieki.”

English: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;
Masaai: Ore ina kata airorita nanu naomonito, airridu ing'ok aainei o ng'ok oo ltung'ana laainei Israel, naitarasaa esayiata ai te dukuya Olaitoriani Enkai te nkaraki ina doinyo sinyati e Nkai ai;

English: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
Masaai: ore ina kata airorita nanu aomon, ore ilo tung'ani oji Gabriel, duoo latoduaa te nduaata e dukuya, nelotu ine natii nanu akuetu oleng te ina kata o lasar le teipa.

English: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye naajoki nanu, “Oo Daniel, aewuo taata pee aaisho iyie eng'eno nagut o eyiolounoto.

English: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
Masaai: Ore te nkiterata e sayiata ino eewuo ororei abau, naewuo nanu pee aaliki iyie, amu eikinyorri iyie oleng; metaa tadamu ilo rorei niyiolou ina duaata.

English: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
Masaai: “Etudung'oki iwikii ntomoni naapishana oo larin te nkaraki iltung'ana linono o ina anasa ino sinyati, pee eiting'ieki enkitarruorroto, pee eishieki easata oo ng'ok, pee eitaikinyeki osotua ilaing'okok, pee eyauni esupatisho oo ntarasi, nemishiri enduaata o loiboni, nebukokini eilata ine wueji sinyati aisul.

English: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
Masaai: Toning'o niyiolou naa nisipu nchere ore ebaiki elototo e ilo rorei pee eitobiri neitokini aashet Yerusalem o metabau elotunoto e ilo otubukokoki eilata aaput, ilo kitok, naa keaku iwikii naapishana. Ore too wikii ntomoni ile oare naa keaku keigili aashet too lkurrat oo tumoreki o wuejitin neegol, kake te nkata e nyamali.

English: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena wikii ntomoni ile o are neiwuang'ieki ilo otubukokoki eilata aaput, ilo kitok nemeitoki aata toki, ore lelo tung'ana le ilo kitok olotu neidaikie ina anasa o ewueji sinyati. Kelotu enkiting'oto enye anaa to loirrag le nkarenetii olarrabal o metabaiki enkiting'oto; neibalunyekiemijoonisho.

English: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
Masaai: Naa keitobir ninye olning'o ogol te wiki nabo; ore to lpisiai le wiki naa keisho ninye ilasarri o nkishorot meishunye; ore te ina rishata nepiki olkirutoto torrono entopij e nkaji e Nkai, naa keton ninye teine, ometaba anaa neitabaya ilo otipika ine ina naitobiraka Enkai.”

English: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
Masaai: Ore to lari li okuni le Sairos olaiguanani le Parsia nebolokini ororei Daniel, ilo oji enkarna Belteshasa. Naa kesipa apa ilo rorei, naa olarrabal kitok. Nesipu ninye ilo rorei netum eyiolounoto e ina duaata.

English: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, naishirita nanu Daniel too wikii uni. Eitu nanu ainos ndaiki sidain, neitu ejing nkiri aashu enaisho oo sabibu enkutuk ai,

English: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
Masaai: neitu nanu aitasim aela te ilata te nena wikii uni naalulung'a.

English: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam oong'uan olapa le dukuya aitashe nanu te ngilata e ilo keju kitok, aa taa, Tigris,

English: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
Masaai: naraposhu nanu nkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, oltung'ani oishopo too nkilani naapuyiapui, laa keena empolos enye te sahabu e Ufas.

English: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
Masaai: Neikununo osesen lenye anaa osoit oji beril, neikununo enkomom enye anaa enkiwuang'ata, neikununo nkonyek enyena anaa ilkilang'eta ooyupuyup, neikununo nkaik enyena o nkejek enyena anaa enkitiil o suyai osika, ore oltoilo loo rorei lenyena neikununo anaa oltoilo lo lorora.

English: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
Masaai: Ore nanu Daniel aa nanu ake, nadol ina duaata, amu ore lelo tung'ana apa ootii te nebo nanu eitu edol ina duaata.

English: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
Masaai: Neaku aatung'uayioki aa nanu ake nadol ina duaata kitok, nemeetae engolon natelekua ti atua nanu; ore emua o sesen lai neibelekenya oleng, nashalu oleng.

English: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu aning oltoilo loo rorei lenyena; ore ake pee aning oltoilo loo rorei lenyena, nabatata nanu te nkomom too njo kumok naitabaiki nanu enkomom ai enkop.

English: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, aaibung'a nanu enkaina naaikirikirie nanu nkaik aainei o nkung.

English: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto thee, and stand upright: for unto thee am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Oo Daniel lo tung'ani onyorri oleng, toning'o kulo rorei laajoki nanu, nintashe too nkejek amu ore taata aairriwuaki nanu enitii.” Ore ina kata aaliki ninye ele rorei, naitashe nanu aikirikira.

English: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
Masaai: Naaitoki ninye ajoki nanu, “Miureisho iyie Daniel, amu ore ebaiki ina olong apa e dukuya nitipika ndamunot inono ijo pee ining'u nintobor kewan te dukuya Enkai ino, etoning'oki irorei linono, naewuo nanu te nkaraki e lelo rorei linono.

English: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
Masaai: Ore olkitok le nkitoria e Parsia aaibooyie nanu nkolong'i tikitam o obo; kake aaweuo Mikael aretu, ilo obo kitok loo lkituaak, neaku atung'uayie nanu ninye te ine te nebo ilo kitok le nkitoriae Parsia,

English: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
Masaai: naaewuo nanu aitayiolo ina nayooki adoiki iltung'ana linono too nkolong'i e siadi. Amu ore ina duaata naa enoo nkolong'i e siadi.”

English: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
Masaai: Ore pee aaidip ninye airorie nanu te risioroto e kulo rorei, naibelekenya nanu aing'orie enkomom ai enkop neaku mairo.

English: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore obo onyaanyukie nkerai e tung'ana naaiseyie enkutuk ai, nabol enkutuk ai airo. Najoki nanu ilo oitasho te dukuya nanu, “Olaitoriani lai, ore te nkaraki ina duaata aatijing'a nanu emion, nemeekure aata engolon.

English: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
Masaai: Kaji eiko osinka lo Laitoriani lai te neirorie Olaitoriani lai? Amu meekure taata aata engolon nemetii enkiyang'et atua nanu.”

English: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
Masaai: Naaitoki aiseyie nanu obo oata empukunoto e tung'ani naaitagol nanu.

English: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Lotung'ani ele onyorri oleng, miureishoyu, metaa eseriani te nebo iyie; tagolo nintagol oshoke.” Ore ake pee aairorie nanu nagolu najo, “Nchoo Olaitoriani lai eiro, amu kintagolo iyie nanu.”

English: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye ajo, “Amaa, iyiolo iyie ajo kainyoo pee aewuo enitii? Kake karrinyo taata nanu alo aarare ilo kitok le nkitoria e Parsia; ore pee aidip ataarare ninye, neeitu olkitok loo Lyunani.

English: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
Masaai: Kake kaaliki nanu iyie ina natisiraki ti atua ina buku oosipat; meetae likae laaretu nanu aarare kulo meteleku Mikael ake ilo kitok linyi.

English: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
Masaai: Ore ti alo nanu te ilo ari le dukuya le Darias loo Lmede, aitasho aitisip ninye napik engolon.

English: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
Masaai: “Naa ore taata kaaitodol nanu esipata. Ng'ura keitoki aailepu laiguanak okuni te Parsia; ore oliong'uan eikarsis alang ninche pooki; ore ake pee egolu te nkaraki karsisisho enye neisisaki ninye ninche pooki metaarare enkitoo oo Lyunani.

English: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
Masaai: Neitoki adumunye olaiguanani magilani laa kelotu aitoreisho te nkitoria kitok neasisho te risioroto e yieuna enye.

English: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
Masaai: Ore eidipa ninye atudumunye negila enkitoria enye neoro aipir isiwuon okuni le shumata, kake mme taa te nkaraki dupoto enye, neme te nkaraki ina kitoria naitore ninye; amu kedotuni ina kitoria enye neishori ilkulikae leme ninye.

English: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
Masaai: “Negolu ilo aiguanani le kopikop, kake ore obo loo lkituaak lenyena naa kegolu alang ninye ore enkitoria enye naa keaku enkitoria kitok.

English: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king's daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ilarin oata esiana, neitobir ninche enchula, ore ina tito o laiguanani le kopikop nelotu enetii olaiguanani le moikuape aitayu osotua; kake mebikie engolon enkaina enye, ore ninye o eishoi enye nemebik; kake keishieki ninye, te nebo lelo ooisiai ninye, o enkerai enye o ilo ora olkitok lenye.

English: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
Masaai: “Ore akenya te nena katitin naa kedumunye olng'osila le ntonai enye te rishata enye; kelotu ninye aarare enjore nelo ajing osempewuet lo laiguanani le moikuape, neitainye ninche olarrabal nemirisho.

English: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
Masaai: Kelo sii anap aya Misiri nkaitin enye te nebo nkitanyaanyukot naaipurjuno te sarng'ab te nebo imasaa e tipat e nkosholai o ne sahabu; naa ore too larin oora esiana nepal ninye eitu eitainye olarrabal olaiguanani le moikuape.

English: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
Masaai: Neitoki ilo aiguanani alotu atua enkitoria e kopikop kake kerrinyo alo atua enkop enye makewan.

English: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
Masaai: “Keipiru ilayiok lenyena olarrabal neiturrur olorora kitok le njore laa keilepu alotu neimisie neim atua, nereu ninye olarrabal o metabaiki osempewuet lenye.

English: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani le kopikop etagore oleng keipang'u alotu aarare ilo aiguanani le moikuape; naa kedumu ninye olorora kitok, kake keishoori ilo orora aapik atua enkaina o lmang'atinta lenye.

English: And when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
Masaai: Ore pee eyae ilo orora, neng'idayu oltau lenye newuasayu, nenang'ie ninye enkop iltung'ana nkalifuni maa tomon, kake melo ninye amirisho.

English: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
Masaai: Amu keitoki ilo aiguanani le moikuape adumu olorora, kitok alang ola duoo le dukuya; ore te siadi ilarin oata esiana naa kelotu ninye te nebo enjore kitok o masaa kumok.

English: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te nena katitin naa kedumunye ilkumok aarare ilo aiguanani le kopikop; ore lelo tung'ana lo larrabal ti atua iltung'ana linono naa kerup ate pee etum aaitabai ina apa natolimuoki kake kepuo ninche aabatata.

English: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
Masaai: Kelotu ilo aiguanani le moikuape ayau eng'adunoto, neya ina ang nasheta isunta. Ore nena jorin e kopikop nemeitashe, aashu ilo orora lenye ogeluno, amu metumi engolon naitasheyie.

English: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo olotu aarare ninye naa keas anaa enayieu ninye makewan, nemeetae oloidim aitasho te dukuya ninye; naa kelo ninye aitashe te ina kop e nkishiaa, ore pooki e ina kop naa keaku atua enkitoria enye etii.

English: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
Masaai: Naa keipirakinore ninye te nkomom enye pee elotu atua enkitoria enye pooki, naa keyau ninye olning'o lo sotua neas ninche. Naa keisho ninye entito e nkitok meidaikie enkitoria, kake meitashe ninye nemetum dupoto.

English: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
Masaai: Ore te siadi neibelekenya ninye aing'or olemankale, naa kelo aya ilkumok lenye; kake kelotu likae kitok aishie ilo wuasa lenye le sulare. Ee kerrinyokino ninye ilo wuasa lenye le sulare alotushumata ninye.

English: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
Masaai: Neitoki ninye aibelekenya alo lelo sempewueti le nkop enye, kake kelo ninye arrorro nebatata, nemeitokini aatum.

English: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
Masaai: “Neitoki adumunye te rishata enye likae oirriu iladung'ok le kodi pee eirony iltung'ana te nkaraki enkitoria enye; kake too nkuti olong'i ake negila ninye, neme te ngoro aashu to larrabal.

English: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
Masaai: “Ore te rishata enye neitoki adumunye olomeni leitu eishori enkanyit anaa olaiguanani; kelotu ninye aluamisho neya enkitoria to losek.

English: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
Masaai: Keiwuang'ieki njorin aaishie tukul te dukuya ninye, te nebo ilo kitok lo sotua.

English: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata naning'oi o ninye neasisho ninye te lejare; nelo ninye agolu eeta ilkuti tung'ana.

English: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers' fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
Masaai: Ore eluamisho nelotu ninye atua nene wuejitin sidain e ina kop; nelo ninye aas ina neitu ae kata eas iloomenye anaa iloo nkakuyiaa lenye, eidapash ti atua ninche imasaa o nena naataarua ninye te njore. Keipiru ninye nkiguanat pee ear isempewueti, kake te nkiti kata ake.

English: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
Masaai: Naa keputu ninye engolon enye o empijan enye pee elo aitayunye olarrabal o laiguanani le kopikop eeta enjore kitok; ore ilo aiguanani le kopikop nelo olarrabal te nebo enjore kitok oleng magilani; kake melo ninye aitashe, amu keitobirakini ninye ilnukat.

English: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
Masaai: Ore ninye lelo oinos endaa enye sidai ninche oar ninye. Ore enjore enye neishieki, nebatata ilkumok etaraki too lalema.

English: And both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
Masaai: Ore ti alo lelo aiguanak oare neibelekenyakino ndamunot enye entorroni, neiro ninche elejare te mesa nabo, kake metum toki; amu ore enkiting'oto naa te nkata natudung'uoki.

English: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
Masaai: Naa keshukunye ninye alotu enkop enye eeta masaa kumok; kake ore oltau lenye eibelekenye aibayu ilo sotua sinyati. Naa keas ninye anaa enayieu, nerrinyo alo enkop enye makewan.

English: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina kata nategeluaki nerrinyo ninye alo enkalo e kopikop; kake melo atiu te ina kata anaa enatiu apa.

English: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
Masaai: Amu kepuonu imelin e Kitim aaitainye ninye olarrabal, naa keureishoyu ninye nerrinyo nelo aigorokino ilo sotua sinyati. Kerrinyo ninye aning lelo ooany ilo sotua sinyati.

English: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
Masaai: Nelotu enjore naing'uaa ninye neisarkionie ina aji e Nkai o sempewuet neya ilo asar opejori le anaake. Neitasheiyie ninche olminong aaitaa ine olmuaate.

English: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
Masaai: Neitapong'oo te nkilelemare lelo ooany ilo sotua. Kake ore lelo tung'ana ooyiolo Enkai enye neitashe aauno neas enkiaas.

English: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
Masaai: Ore lelo ti atua olorere oora ng'eni neidimie ilkumok metayiolo hoo naa kepuo ninche aabatata to lalem o to lng'ejep le nkima, o te yararoto o te enata, too nkuti olong'i.

English: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
Masaai: Ore te nebatata ninche naa ketum enkiti retoto. Naa keibung'a ilkumok maate to lkoroj.

English: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
Masaai: Ore embata e lelo oora ng'eni nebatata, pee esil neitisiny ninche neiborrie ninche, o metabau enkata e nkiting'oto, amu eton ina aa ene nkata apa nategeluaki.

English: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
Masaai: “Naa keas olaiguanani anaa enayieu; kerup ninye kewan neilepie kewan aitulus te pooki ai, naa keiro ninye mbaa esulare ti alo Enkai oo nkaitin. Kedupayu ninye o metaba anaa neitabari engoro; amu ore ina apa natudung'oki kepuoi aas.

English: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
Masaai: Mening ninye nkaitin oo loo menye, aashu ina nanyor nkituaak; meshilaa ninye hoo ae ai, amu keilepie ninye kewan aitulus te pooki.

English: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
Masaai: Keyanyitu ninye enkai oo sempewueti te rishata e kuna; ina ai neitu ae kata eyiolou loo menye eyanyit ninye te sahabu o te nkosholai, too soito oogol enkinyiang'a o too nkishorot naagol enkinyiang'a.

English: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
Masaai: Naa kear ninye osempewuet ogol oleng te retoto e nkai omoni. Ore lelo oonyorraa ninye nerup ninye ninche aisho enkanyit. Neitaa ninche ilkituaak te shumata ilkumok naa keor ninye enkop te nkinyiang'a.

English: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
Masaai: “Ore te nkata e nkiting'oto kelotu ilo aiguanani le kopikop arasaki ninye; kake ore ilo aiguanani le moikuape agilunore ninye anaa olemua, eeta ngarrin oo mbartan, o lakedok loo mbartan, te nebo imelin kumok; naa kelotu nena kuapi, neiput aaibulu enkop pooki.

English: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
Masaai: Naa kelotu ninye atua ina kop e nkishiaa. Ore nkalifuni maa iip tomon nebatata, kake ore kulo kekorduni aaitayu te nkaina enye: Edom o Moab o erubata kitok oo Lamori.

English: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
Masaai: Keitorioo enkaina enye aarare nkuapi, ore ina kop e Misiri nemeimisho.

English: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
Masaai: Neaku ninye oitore ilchumat le sahabu ole nkosholai, ore nena tokitin pooki e tipat e Misiri; o ne Libia o ne Etiopia neirukurukore iroruat enyena.

English: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
Masaai: Kake keitanyamal ninye ilomon ooing'uaa oloo saen o moikuape, naa kelo ninye te ngoro kitok napi pee einyal neidaikie ilkumok.

English: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye aunoki lelo ng'oborri lenyena le nkitoo erishata e naiposha e ilo doinyo kitok sinyati; ore eyia kelotu ake enkiting'oto enye, nemetii hoo obo oret ninye.

English: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina kata naa kedumunye Mikael, ilo kitok oitore iltung'ana linono. Naa kelotu enkata e nyamali, neitu ae kata etumi ebaiki apa meetae olorere o metabaiki ina kata; kake ore inakata naa kepuoi aakordu iltung'ana linono, pooki ng'ae otumi enkarna enye eigero ti atua embuku.

English: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
Masaai: Ore ilkumok le lelo ooirurate ti atua enterit e nkop neinyototo, ore kulikae nedumakino enkishui nemeiting, ore ilkulikae naa enkurruna o esulare oo ntarasi.

English: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo ng'eni newang'u anaa ewang'an e shumata; ore lelo ooboiniki ilkumok enkoitoi oosipat newang'u anaa ilakir ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: But thou, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Daniel, tunuka lelo rorei; nimishir aiken ina buku, o metabau enkata e nkiting'oto Keyooki ilkumok aakuet nekuetu, naa keponari eng'eno.”

English: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
Masaai: Ore nanu Daniel naing'orisho, naa ng'ura, eitashe kulikae oare, obo tele kekun e olkeju o likae te lido kekun o lkeju.

English: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
Masaai: Najoki nanu ilo tung'ani oishopo too nkilani naapuyiapui, ilo otii shumata eilo keju, “Kenkata nabaa pee ebau enkiting'oto e kuna baa e nking'asia?”

English: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani oishopo too nkilani naapuyiapui, ilo otii shumata nena ariak e olkeju nedumu enkaina enye e tatene o enkaina enye e kedienye aipirie shumata; naning nanu ninye einos olmumai teilo oishu ntarasi nchere te nkata, o inkatitin are, o lpisiai le nkata; naa te neidip ninche aatigil engolon e lelo tung'ana sinyat aaiting'ie ore kuna baa pooki neaku eitabayioki.

English: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu kake eitu aning'u ayiolou. Najo nanu, “Olaitoriani lai, kainyoo akenya epuo kuna baa aaku.”

English: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Shomo enkoitoi ino Daniel, amu eikenoyioki lelo rorei nemishiri o metabau enkata e nkiting'oto.

English: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
Masaai: Keipok ilkumok ate, neiborrie ate, nesilayu; kake ore lelo arruok neasisho te nkarruisho; nemeetae obo le lelo arruok olo aning'u; kake ore lelo ng'eni naa kepuo aaning'u.

English: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that maketh desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
Masaai: Naa ore ebaiki ina kata neiwuang'ieki ilo asar opejori anaake aaitasheyie ilo minong le mijoonisho, naa keaku nkolong'i enkalifu nabo, o iip are o ntomoni naaudo.

English: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo oanyisho nelotu nena olong'i enkalifu, iip uni o tomoni uni.

English: But go thou thy way till the end be: for thou shalt rest, and stand in thy lot at the end of the days.
Masaai: Kake shomo enkoitoi ino o metabau enkiting'oto; amu ilo ayeng'iyeng'a, nilo aitashe te wueji ino negeluno te nkiting'oto e nena olong'i.”

English: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
Masaai: Ele rorei apa lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Hosea olayioni le Beeri, too nkolong'i, e Usia, o Yotam, o Ahas, o Hesekia ilaiguanak le Yuda, o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel.

English: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the LORD.
Masaai: Ore apa pee eng'as Olaitoriani airo eimunye enkiroroto enye Hosea, nejoki Olaitoriani Hosea, “Shomo, iyamaki kewan enkitok naibor onyek niiu nkera e nkibor oo nkonyek, amu eiborrie ena kop onyek oleng ainguaa Olaitoriani.”

English: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
Masaai: Nelo ninye ayam Gomer ina tito e Diblaim, neiroshiu ninye neiki ninye olayioni.

English: And the LORD said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Tejo enkarna enye Yesreel; amu enkiti kata ake nang'or, pee aitame nanu enkaji e Yehu te nkaraki osarge le Yesreel, naa kaishie nanu enkitoria e nkaji e Israel.

English: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina olong, nagil nanu enkawuo e Israel to erata le Yesreel.”

English: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
Masaai: Neitoki ina kitok anutayu neiu entito. Nejoki Olaitoriani Hosea, “Tejo enkarna enye Enemeing'urrieki, amu maigil nanu aing'urrie enkaji e Israel, mapalaki ninche katukul.

English: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
Masaai: Kake kaing'urrie nanu enkaji e Yuda naa kakordu ninche to Laitoriani e Nkai enye; makordu nanu ninche te nkauo aashu to lalem, nemakordu to larrabal, aashu too mbartan aashu too lakedok loo mbartan.”

English: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
Masaai: Ore pee eoru Gomer ilki, “Enemeing'urrieki,” nenutayu neiu olayioni.

English: Then said God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Tejo enkarna enye Mme iltung'ana laainei, amu mirara intae iltung'ana laainei nemara nanu Enkai inyi.”

English: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
Masaai: Kake ore esiana oo ltung'ana le Israel naa kebayu anaa osinyai le naiposha, lemeidimi aatetem anaa aaikena, naa ore to ine wueji apa netiakinyeki ninche, “Mirara iltung'ana laainei,” keaku keji ninche, “Nkera e Nkai naishu.”

English: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana le Yuda o ltung'ana le Israel nepuo aaiturrurr te nebo negelaki ate o lkitok obo; naa keilep ninche aapuo te ina kop, amu eikitok kenya ina olong e Yesreel.

English: Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.
Masaai: Tejo olalashe lino, “Iltung'ana laainei,” nijo enkanashe ino, “Enanoto olng'ur.”

English: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
Masaai: “Tasayia ng'utunyi, tasayia amu mme enkitok ai ninye, nemara nanu olpayian lenye pee etum aiwuang'ie enkibor oo nkonyek te nkomom enye, neiwuang'ie eloloito enye to lki lenyena;

English: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
Masaai: pee masul ake aoru ilkilani naitotiu ninye anaa ina olong apa naini, naitotiu ninye anaa ong'ata, naitotiu ninye anaa enkop natoyio, naar ninye te nkure.

English: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
Masaai: Ore sii ti alo nkera enyena maing'urrie nanu amu inkera e nkibor oo nkonyek ninche.

English: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
Masaai: Amu eiborrie ng'otonye onyek; ore ina natunute ninche netaasa embae enkurruna. Amu etejo ninye, ‘Kalo arubare isintan laainei, laa ninche laaisho nanu emukate ai o enkare ai, o enkila ai napuyiapui, o kitani ai, o eilata ai o enaisho.’

English: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
Masaai: “Tenkaraki ina kanuk nanu enkoitoi enye too lkiku; nashetaki nanu esuntai, pee metum ninye eneim.

English: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
Masaai: Kemir ninye isintan lenyena, kake meinepu; neing'oru ninche, kake metum ninche. Neitoki ninye ajo, ‘Kalo nanu narrinyokino olapa moruo lai le dukuya, amu keikash apa ina kata te nanu alang taata.’

English: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
Masaai: Neitu eyiolou ninye inchere nanu apa ilo oishoo ninye entapa, o enaisho oo sabibu o eilata, naiputaki ninye enkosholai o sahabu naa ninche etaasishore te Baal.

English: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina ekarriny ilpaek laainei te nkata enye, o enaisho ai oo sabibu te rishata enye, narriny nanu ina kila ai napuyiapui o kitani, naa ninche apa naaitemoo emasipaisho enye.

English: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
Masaai: “Ore taata naa kasul nanu ninye aoru nkilani te dukuya isintan lenyena, nemeetae olokordu ninye aitayu te nkaina ai.

English: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
Masaai: Naa kaishie nanu isiruai lenyena pooki, o mashoi, o lapaitin lenyena ng'ejuk o sabatoni enyena, o siruai lenyena pooki gelunot.

English: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
Masaai: Nainyal nanu isabibu lenyena o lkeek loo lng'anayio, laa ninche ejo ninye, ‘Elaakinoto ai kulo, laa ninche aaishoo isanchan laainei.’ Kaitaa nanu ninche entim, naa keinos ninche ing'uesi e ntim.

English: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kaitame nanu ninye te nkaraki nena olong'i o sirua le Baal ina kata apa pee epejoki enkorropil ninche, nekuso ninye too lgiso o too masaa, nelo asujaa isintan lenyena, nemaadamu ninye nanu, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ina, ng'ura, kalejaa, narik ninye ong'ata, nairorie ninye te mborron.

English: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore te ine naisho enkurma enye oo sabibu, naitaa ilo erata le Akor elusie o siligi. Ore te ine newal ninye anaa apa too nkolong'i e kitisho enye, anaa apa pee eipang'u aing'uaa enkop e Misiri.

English: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
Masaai: “Naa ore kenya te ina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, nikimpot iyie nanu ijo, ‘Olpayian lai,’ nimikingil iyie ajo, ‘Baal ai.’

English: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
Masaai: Amu kaiwuang'ie nanu nkarn e Baal te nkutuk enye, nemeigili ae kata aaipot ninche katukul.

English: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
Masaai: Naa kaaitobiraki nanu iyie osotua te ina olong te nebo ing'uesi e ntim, o ntaritik o loing'ang'e o ng'uesi naaiserpepiari te nkop; naiwuang'ie nanu enkawuo, o lalem, o larrabal tena kop; naaisho nanu iyie irraga te seriani.

English: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
Masaai: Naa kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ntarasi; kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ai te supatisho o te sipata, te nyorrata nauno o to lng'ur.

English: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
Masaai: Kaasiraki nanu iyie kewan ai te nkitisipata; naa eyiolou iyie Olaitoriani.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
Masaai: “Naa ore kenya te ina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, kawaliki nanu keper newaliki sii ninche enkop;

English: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
Masaai: newaliki sii ninye enkop ilpaek o sabibu o eilata, naa kewaliki sii ninche Yesreel;

English: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
Masaai: naa kaun nanu ninye, aunoki kewan ti atua ena kop. Naa kaing'urrie nanu ilo leitu eing'urrieki, naa kajoki nanu lelo leme iltung'ana laainei, ‘Irara intae iltung'ana laainei,’ nejo ninye, ‘Ira iyie Enkai ai.’ ”

English: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Nyaaki shomo tonyorra ina kitok nanyor osintani lenye, naa enaibor onyek, tonyorra anaa enanyor Olaitoriani iltung'ana le Israel, hoo neibelekenyakino ninche kulie aitin nenyorru imukateni o sabibu naatoito.”

English: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
Masaai: Neaku ainyang'ua nanu ninye te shekeli tomon o imiet e nkosholai o ntemet nabo e shairi olpisiai lo ntemet e shairi.

English: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninye, “Meeta nchere pee mibik ira enaai too nkolong'i kumok; mintoki aiborrie onyek, aashu iaku ene likae lee; neijia sii nanu atiu te iyie.”

English: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
Masaai: Amu kebik nkera oo Israeli nkolong'i kumok meeta olaiguanani aashu olkitok, meeta olasar aashu eng'ape, meeta enkila o lgoo aashu enkitanyaanyukoto.

English: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nerrinyunye nkera e Israel neing'oru Olaitoriani Enkai enye, o Daudi olaiguanani lenye; naa kepuonu ninche te nkuretisho enetii Olaitoriani o esupatisho enye too nkolong'i e siadi.

English: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
Masaai: Entoning ororei lo Laitoriani lo tung'ana le Israel; amu eeta Olaitoriani olarrabal too ltung'ana lena kop. Metii esipata aashu esupatisho, nemetii eyiolounoto e Nkai ena kop.

English: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
Masaai: Etii enkinosata o lmumai, o elejare, o esesekuanare, o empurrorre, o eloloito; elang'u ninche ilpolosien pooki neitusuj iloikop iloikop.

English: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina neishir enkop, ore pooki ootii atua neye, o ng'uesi e ong'ata sii, o ntaritik o loing'ang'e ore sii isinkir le naiposha neiwuang'ieki.

English: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia mincho hoo ng'ae ekesha, nimincho hoo ng'ae eitang'orisho amu iyie etii enkesha ai, lo apolosak.

English: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
Masaai: Irrorrorro intae dama, nerrorro sii oloiboni te nebo intae kewarie, naa kaar nanu ng'utunyi.

English: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
Masaai: Eidaikieki iltung'ana laainei te nkaraki emodai nemeeta eng'eno enkaraki nitanyaita intae eng'eno, aatanya nanu iyie pee miaku olapolosani te nanu. Naa ore anaa enikitorikine enkitanapata e Nkai ino madamu sii nanu inkera inono.

English: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatoponari, neponari aas ing'ok ti alo nanu; kaibelekeny nanu enkisisa enye metaa enkurruna.

English: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
Masaai: Eitoti ninche ate too ng'ok oo ltung'ana laainei; neeta ninche olorok too ntorrok enye.

English: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
Masaai: Naa ketiu ake anaa enatiu too ltung'ana, to lapolosani, kaitame nanu ninche te nkaraki nkoitoi enye, naitalaku te ninche nkiaasin enye.

English: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
Masaai: Kedaa ninche nemeraposho; neiborrie ninche onyek, kake meponari; amu etung'uaitie ninche Olaitoriani ejo pee eitumurru eloloito.

English: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
Masaai: Ore enaisho musana o eng'ejuk, neoru iltung'ana ndamunot.

English: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
Masaai: Entoki e nchani eikilikuanishore iltung'ana laainei, neisho eng'udi oo nkitanapat. Amu eitapong'oyie ninche oltau le nkiborra oo nkonyek, neitung'uaitie ninche Enkai enye aapuo aaiborrie onyek.

English: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
Masaai: Eitayu ninche ilassarri too nchumat oo ldoinyo, neitobir nkishorot too nchumat oo ldoinyo ti abori ilkeek sapuki amu eisidan iloipi lenye. Neaku keibor onyek ntoyie inono, ore siankikin inono naayama neloloito.

English: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
Masaai: Maitame nanu ntoyie inyi te nkiborra enye oo nkonyek, aashu nena siankikin inono naayama te neloloito; amu ore lelo lewa maate nepudariyie nkituaak naaibor onyek neitayu ilasarri te nebo nkituaak naibor onyek naa kepuonu olorere le meeta eyiolounoto aaidak.

English: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
Masaai: Ore hoo nikimbor onyek, iyie Israel, mincho Yuda etiu neijia. Mijing atua Gilgal, nimilep alo Bet-afen, niminya olmumai ajo, “Anaa enaishu Olaitoriani.”

English: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
Masaai: Ore anaa enkashe nape, kepe Siraeli; keidim taata Olaitoriani aitotio ninche anaa olkuo le ker to lokeri o lala?

English: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
Masaai: Eibung'are Efraim inkitanyaanyukot, talama ninye.

English: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
Masaai: Olturur loo lamerak, eishooitie ate te nkiborra oo nkonyek; kenyor ninche enkurruna alang enanyor enkitoo enye.

English: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
Masaai: Etununukoyie ninye osiwuo too naipuko enyena, naa kekurru ninche te nkaraki ilperereni lenye loo lasarri.

English: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
Masaai: Entoning ena, intae ilapolosak! Enchoru enkiok, na aji e Israel! Toning'o na aji o laiguanani! Amu intae eipirta ena kiguana; amu itaa intae orreshet te Mispa o orreshet ooisalaashakaki Tabor.

English: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
Masaai: Neituguto ninche engumoto e Shitim, kake kaitame nanu ninche pooki.

English: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Israel is defiled.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu Efraim, neitu eisudori Israel te nanu, amu ore taata Efraim, nimborrie iyie onyek, neidurukie Israel.

English: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
Masaai: Meisho ninche nkiasin enye errinyokino Enkai enye. Amu etii oltau le nkibor oo nkonyek atua ninche, nemeyiolo ninche Olaitoriani.

English: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
Masaai: Ore olwuasa le Israel neishakenu enkomom enye; kelo Efraim arrorro te ntorroni enye; kerrorro sii Yuda te nebo ninche.

English: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
Masaai: Kepuo ninche te nebo iluaat enye oo nchoo o noo nkerrai, aaing'oru Olaitoriani, kake metum ninye, etung'uayie ninye ninche.

English: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
Masaai: Eitaasa ninche te nkeleekisho Olaitoriani; amu etoiutuo ninche nkera oo naataluno. Ore taata ele apa ng'ejuk kemut ninche te nebo o nkurman enye.

English: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
Masaai: Toosho emouo ti atua Gibea, toosho esekekua ti atua Rama, te Bet-afen; nkirikirayu iyie Benchamen!

English: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
Masaai: Keaku Efraim olmuate te ina olong e nkitamioto; ti atua lelo oshon le Israel aibalunye nanu ina nasipa.

English: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
Masaai: Etotiutuo ilkituaak le Yuda anaa iltung'ana ooiwuang'ie ilpolosien; ore shumata ninche, kabukoki nanu ninche engoro ai anaa enkare.

English: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
Masaai: Eibookoki Efraim enkop, neidimuaki te nkiguana, enkaraki nateenikine ninye asujaa entoki nemeetae olng'am.

English: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, atotiuo nanu anaa olasai to Efraim natiu anaa oltiapurusi te nkaji e Yuda.

English: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Efraim emueyian enye nedol Yuda olbae lenye, neitoki Efraim alo Asiria, neirriwaki olkilikuai ilo aiguanani kitok; kake mikindim ninye atabaa iyie aashu aishiunye olbae lino.

English: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
Masaai: Amu katiu nanu anaa olng'atuny te Efraim, natiu anaa olng'atuny oti te nkaji e Yuda. Amu nanu, ee nanu, opolos nalo aing'uaa nanu aya, nemeetae olokordu.

English: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
Masaai: Naa kaitoki nanu arrinyokino ewueji ai, o metaba anaa neirridu entorroni enye neing'oru enkomom ai, naa ore ti atua osina lenye naaing'oru ninche nanu, ejo,

English: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
Masaai: “Wootu, matorrinyokinoto Olaitoriani; amu etopolosa pee etum aishiunye iyiook; etoosho ninye naa kelo aen iyiook.

English: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nkolong'i are neitopiu ninye iyiook; ore te nkolong e uni nedumu ninye iyiook maitasheito, pee kitum aataa aikinchu te dukuya ninye.

English: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
Masaai: Matayiolo iyiook, matonyok aapuo dukuya, aayiolou Olaitoriani; Ore elotunoto enye, esipa kelotu ninye anaa enkakenya anaa enchan o loirujuruj naitashal enkop.”

English: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
Masaai: Kaa nanu aaitaas iyie Efraim? Kaa nanu aaitaas iyie Yuda? Etiu enyorrata ino anaa enkatampoi o sina, anaa enkoileelio nasiooyo aishunye.

English: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina atudung'udung'o nanu ninche too loibonok laainei, atara nanu ninche metuata too rorei le nkutuk ai, naa keipang'aki ninche enkiguana ai anaa ewang'an.

English: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
Masaai: Amu enyorrata nauno nanu ayieu, mme olasar, eyiolounoto e Nkai alang nkishorunot.

English: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
Masaai: Kake ore te Adam netigila ninche olning'o; ore teine naaitaasa ninche nanu te nkeleekisho.

English: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
Masaai: Ore Gilead naa enkanasa oo larruok, naitunyokino osarge.

English: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
Masaai: Ore anaa enairrag ilapurrok aanyu oltung'ani, neijia eikununo ilapolosak eibung'ate te nebo; neitayu iloikop te nkoitoi e Shekem, ee, neas mbaa torrok oleng.

English: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkaji e Israel atoduaa nanu embae busus oleng; ine etii eloloito e Efraim, neidurukie Israeli.

English: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
Masaai: Ore sii ti alo iyie Yuda, kitegelakaki enkisampuare Ina kata te narrinyu nanu lelo tung'ana laainei te sinkaisho.

English: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
Masaai: Te najo nanu aishiunye Israel, neibalunyeki entorroni e Efraim, o nkiasin torrok e Samaria; amu te ntorroni easisho ninche, egil olapurroni inkajijik, ore laisimak neisimisho ti ong'ata.

English: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
Masaai: Kake mejo ninche nchere kadamu nanu esiaai enye pooki torrono. Etang'adutua nkiasin enye ninche, etii dukuya enkomom ai.

English: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
Masaai: Ore te ntorroni enye neiting'ie olaiguanani, o lkitok le lejare enye.

English: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
Masaai: Keibor onyek ninche pooki; eikununo ninche anaa ewueji nepejieki imukateni nainuaaki, ore ilo oasishore nepal eitu ekut ebaiki ina kata naipurji o metabaiki ina kata naisuijieki.

English: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
Masaai: Ore teina olong o laiguanani lang etamueita lelo kituaak te mpijan e naisho; neitorioo ninye enkaina enye te nebo lelo torrok.

English: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enatiu ewueji nepejieki imukateni, neijia eikununo iltauja lenye eyupuyup erreshisho; ore kewarie pooki etiu engoro enye anaa olang'at ore tadekenya neyupuyup anaa ilng'ejepa le nkima.

English: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
Masaai: Ore ninche pooki naa keirowua anaa olkokuet, nemut ninche ilaitoriak lenye. Ore ilaiguanak lenye pooki netabatatate nemeetae hoo obo lenye laaipot nanu.

English: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
Masaai: Eitushulaka Efraim kewan iloreren; ore Efraim naa emukate neitu eibelekenyi.

English: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
Masaai: Einosa iltung'ana loo loreren eng'olon enye, nemeyiolo ninye; eisuaaki ilpapit ooibor shumata ninye, nemeyiolo ninye.

English: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
Masaai: Ore olwuasa le Israel neishakenoki te dukuya ninye; ore eyia merrinyokino ninche Olaitoriani Enkai enye, are ake eing'oru ninye te kuna pooki.

English: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
Masaai: Eikununo Efraim anaa enturkulu namoda nemeeta endamunoto naipotu Misiri, neloito Asiria.

English: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
Masaai: Naitadou ninche anaa ntaritik o loing'ang'e naitame ninche too nkiasin enye torrok.

English: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
Masaai: Woi ninche, amu aashomo aaing'uaa nanu! Enkidaata te ninche, amu aatogolong'akitia ninche! Anaata naaji akordu ninche, kake kelejisho ninche tiaalo nanu.

English: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
Masaai: Maaishiraki ninche nanu too ltauja, kake keyietu ninche aaishir too ndapashi enye; ore te nkaraki enkurma o enaisho nedung ate, naagolong'aki ninche aapaashare nanu.

English: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
Masaai: Ore hoo naitaarriyiana naitagol nanu inkaik enye, entorroni aaipiraki ninche nanu.

English: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
Masaai: Eibelekenyakinote ninche Baal; etotiutuo ninche anaa enkawuo nemeisiligayu, ore lelo kituaak lenye, naa kepuo aabatata to lalem te nkaraki ina keilasilas ilng'ejepa lenye. Keaku te ninche ena embae e nakueniyieki te nkop e Misiri.

English: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
Masaai: Tipika entarumpeta enkutuk ino pee iosh, amu eewuo olkurragos shumata enkaji o Laitoriani, enkaraki natigila ninche olmumai lai, negil nkitanapat aainei.
