English: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
Masaai: Nanu eishiraki ninche aajo, Enkai ai, kiyiolo iyiook Israel iyie.

English: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
Masaai: Etanya Israel ina sidai; kelo olmang'atinta asujaa ninche.

English: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
Masaai: Kegelu ninche laiguanak, kake mme nanu eikilikuan. Negelu iltung'ana kituaak, kake metii eyiolounoto ai. Ore te nkosholai enye o sahabu neitobir ninche nkitanyaanyukot te nkidaata enye maate.

English: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
Masaai: Atanya nanu ilo ashe lino, iyie Samaria. Eyupuyup engoro ai tiaalo ninche. Ketoni kenya o anu, pee esinyayu ninche ti alo Israel?

English: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
Masaai: Olaitobirani oitayio, mme Enkai. Ore ilo ashe le Samaria, kepuoi aabel metaa imbelibelat.

English: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
Masaai: Amu etuuno ninche enkijape, naa kepuo ninche aaisampu olkutati.

English: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
Masaai: Etoijoyioki Israel, eidipa aatotiu ti atua iloreren anaa emasaai nemeeta.

English: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
Masaai: Amu eilepa ninche aapuo Asiria eikununo anaa osikiria li ong'ata olimana openy; einyang'ua Efraim isintan.

English: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
Masaai: Ore hoo neinyang'ua ninche iltung'ana leeiking'a ti atua iloreren, kaiturrur nanu ninche asioki. Naa keitirring'a ninche te nkiti kata eitu eitoki aaput olaiguanani o ilkituaak.

English: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
Masaai: Enkaraki natoponayie Efraim ilperereni lo lasarri le asata oo ng'ok, etaa lelo asarri ing'ok te ninye.

English: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
Masaai: Tenaa naaji ninye kaigeroki nanu ninye nkitanapat aainei naa nkalifuni tomon, keitaae ake entoki ng'ejuk nemeyioloi.

English: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
Masaai: Kenyor ninche olasar; neitayu ninche olasar loo nkiri neinos; kake meshipakino Olaitoriani ninche. Ore taata kedamu ninye entorroni enye neitame ing'ok enye; kerrinyo ninche aapuo Misiri.

English: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
Masaai: Amu etorikine Israel ilo oitobira ninye neshet inkajijik e nkitoo; netoponayie Yuda inkang'itie naagol; kake kairriwaa nanu enkima shumata nena anas enyena. Nemut isempewueti lenyena pooki.

English: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
Masaai: Ming'ida iyie Israel! Nimishipa te ng'ida anaa loreren; amu imborrie iyie onyek, ning'uaa Enkai ino. Itonyorra iyie olekoisiaayio le nkiborra oo nkonyek too wuejitin pooki neeiutuutishoreki.

English: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
Masaai: Ore eneituutishoreki o eneironyieki ilng'anayio meitoti ninche.

English: They shall not dwell in the LORD'S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
Masaai: Nebatat ninche enaisho ng'ejuk. Nebik ninche tiaatua ina kop o Laitoriani; kake kerrinyo Efraim alo Misiri, nepuo ninche aainos endaa nemesinya te Asiria.

English: They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Meigil ninche aabukoki Olaitoriani ilasarri ooki le naisho oo sabibu; nemeitiship ninye too lasarri lenye. Ore imukateni enye naa ketiu anaa imukateni o lkiyioi; ore naa pooki oinos ninche neisarkioneki amu ore imukateni enye naa keaku inesumash enye ake; meyauni atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
Masaai: Kaa kenya iasiasa teina olong o sirua, o teina olong o sirua lo Laitoriani?

English: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura kepuo Asiria; keiturrur Misiri ninche; nenukaa Memfis ninche. Nebulaki endiati nena masaa enye sidain e nkosholai; nejing ilkiku atua ilng'oborri lenye.

English: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
Masaai: Eetuo nkolong'i enkitamioto, eetuo nkolong'i e nkitalaata; naa keyiolou Israel ina. Kemoda ilo oiboni, ore ilo tung'ani le nkiyang'et neeta oloirirua, te nkaraki ina arruoisho ino kitok o enkiba kitok.

English: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiboni, naa olarriponi le Efraim, lelo tung'ana le Nkai ai, ore eyia netii orreshet laaijo olo larreshoni loo ntaritik inkoitoi enyena pooki, netii enkiba atua enkaji e Nkai enye.

English: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
Masaai: Neisarkionie ninche ate oleng anaa too nkolong'i e Gibea: keyooki ninye adamu entorroni enye nelo aitame ingok enye.

English: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
Masaai: Anoto apa Israel eikununo anaa isabibu ti ong'ata. Nadol iloo papaai linyi eikununo anaa ilng'anayio lo lng'aboli le nkiterata. Kake eetuo apa ninche enetii Baal-peor, neitisinyaki ate Baal, neaku ninche enkitagoroto anaa nena tokitin naatonyorra ninche.

English: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
Masaai: Ore ina kitoo e Efraim naa kelo aaing'uaa ninye anaa entaritiki meitoki atii eishoi, nemetii enutai, nemetii enkibung'aroto.

English: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
Masaai: Ore ninye te neitubulu ninche nkera, naoru nanu ninche o metaba anaa metii enaleku. Woi ninche te nalo nanu aing'uaa ninche!

English: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
Masaai: Ore ilayiok le Efraim anaa enatoduaa nanu, nepuoito enkidaata; meeta nchere merik Efraim ilayiok lenyena enepuoi aar metuata.

English: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
Masaai: Nchoo ninche iyie Olaitoriani, kainyoo incho iyie? Nchoo ninche olkibiroto le ng'uset o lki oo toito.

English: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
Masaai: Ore pooki arruoisho enye netii Gilgal; teine apa nanu atang'asa aibayu ninche. Ore te nkaraki entorroni oo nkiasin enye aaraa ninche aaitung'uaa enkaji ai. Maigil nanu anyorru ninche; ore lelo kituaak lenye pooki naa larruok.

English: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
Masaai: Etooshoki Efraim, etoito ntona enye, meitoki aaiu ilng'anayio. Ore hoo duoo ninye neisho ninche, kaar nanu metuata nena kera enye kiroteti.

English: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
Masaai: Keiturraa Enkai ai ninche, ore enkaraki neitu ening ninche ninye; keaku ninche ilapuayak ti atua iloreren.

English: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
Masaai: Olchani loo sabibu Israel oiu ilng'anayio lenyena. Ore anaa enaponari ilng'anayio lenyena neponaa ashet ilperereni loo lasarri kumok; ore anaa enaponari enkop enye asidanu, neponaa ing'apeta enyena.

English: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
Masaai: Etelejishote iltauja lenye; meeta taata nchere meitalaki entorroni enye. Kegil Olaitoriani lelo perereni lenye loo lasarri, neparripar nena ng'apeta enye.

English: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
Masaai: Amu kepuo taata ninche aajo: “Mikiaata iyiook olaiguanani, amu mikiure iyiook Olaitoriani, amaa olaiguanani, kaa eidim ninye aitaasa iyiook?”

English: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
Masaai: Eiro ninche irorei le pesho; ore too lmuma le lejare keitayu osotua; nebulu nkiguanat enye anaa sayieti naabulu too nkong'at e nkurma.

English: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
Masaai: Keikirikira lelo oomanya Samaria te nkuretisho, te nkaraki ilo ashe le Babel. Keishiraki iltung'ana lenyena ninye, ore lelo apolosak lenyena ooserem nkitanyaanyukot neyietu aaishiraki ninye, teina kitoo enye nashomo aing'uaa ninye.

English: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
Masaai: Ee kenapi ina toki kewan aaya Asiria, pee eaku enkishooroto te ilo aiguanani kitok. Keitukurruni Efraim, nekurru sii Israel te nkaraki enkitanyaanyukoto enye.

English: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
Masaai: Ore ilo aiguanani le Samaria naa kelo aidaaya, anaa olaburra ti oriong enkare.

English: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
Masaai: Ore nena wuejitin e shumata e Afen, ina ng'oki e Israel, naa keidaikieki. Kebulu ilkiku o laimerrerruani te nchumata lelo perereni lenye loo lasarri; naa kepuo ninche aajoki ildoinyo, Entemoi iyiook, nejoki indoinyo, enturokinoto iyiook.

English: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
Masaai: Ore apa ebaiki nkolong'i e Gibea itaasa eng'oki, iyie Israel; ore teine neshomo ninche aas ing'ok. Ae meinepu ninche olarrabal te Gibea?

English: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
Masaai: Kalotu nanu aarare kulo tung'ana aing'okok pee aitame ninche, naa keiturrurro iloshon aarare ninche, neitame ninche te nkaraki ina ng'oki enye natatashe.

English: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
Masaai: Ore Efraim enkashe apa naitamooki, nanyor aidong'o entapa. Naitajeuo apa nanu ina murt enye sidai, kake kalo nanu apik Efraim enchata emurt meeta nchere pee meturisho Yuda, meeta nchere meitupuyiapui Yakobo enkulukuoni makewan.

English: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
Masaai: Entuunoki ate esupatisho, nisampumpu ilng'anayio le nyorrata nauno; entutur ina kulukuoni inyi nayeng'iyeng'ieki amu etabaua enkata naing'orunyeki Olaitoriani, pee etum ninye aeu aitashaiki enjeunoto shumata intae.

English: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
Masaai: Ituuno apa intae entorroni, nisampupu enkarruoisho, inosa intae ilng'anayio le lejare. Amu isiliga apa intae ngarrin inyi o larrabal o ina siamo oo lmurran linyi.

English: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kejing olarrabal atua iltung'ana linono, ore lelo sempewueti linono neidaikieki, anaa apa enaidaikie Shalaman Bet-arbelon teina olong o larrabal; nedung'udung'i nkera o noo ng'otonye.

English: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
Masaai: Ena ninye eyookini aaitaas intae, iyie na aji e Israel, te nkaraki ina torroni ino kitok. Ore enasirie neishieki ilo aiguanani le Israel katukul.

English: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore apa aa enkerai Israel atonyorra nanu ninye, ore te Misiri naipotuo nanu enkerai ai.

English: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaipotu nanu ninche, naapuo ninche aaing'uaa nanu; netotoni ninche epolosaki Baal, nepejoki nkitanyaanyukot enkorropil.

English: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
Masaai: Ore eyia nanu apa oitamoo Efraim meshomo, atudumua nanu ninche too nkaik aainei; Kake eitu ninche eyiolou nchere aishiunye nanu ninche.

English: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
Masaai: Atorikoyie nanu ninche too nkeenta o lng'ur, too enat e nyorrata, natiu nanu te ninche anaa ilo oitololong enchata too iltagiligil lenye too murto enye, nairrugokino nanu ninche naitoti ninche.

English: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
Masaai: Kerrinyo ninche aapuo enkop e Misiri, naa kelo Asiria aaku olaiguanani lenye, enkaraki natanyaita ninche aarrinyokino nanu.

English: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
Masaai: Olalem olo ashurt nena anas enye, neidaikie ninche tiatua nena wuejitin enye neegol.

English: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
Masaai: Eteenikinote iltung'ana laainei enkibelekenyakinoto pee aapuo aaing'uaa nanu; neaku etegelakaki ninche enchata e murt nemeetae ololaku.

English: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
Masaai: Kaji nanu aiko te naitarasaa intae; iyie Efraim? Kaji nanu aiko te naitarasaa intae; iyie Israel! Kaji nanu aiko te naitanyaanyukie intae Adama! Kaji nanu aiko te naitaas intae anaa Seboim! Eibelekenye oltau lai ti atua nanu, eirowuaja olng'ur lai neborru.

English: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
Masaai: Maasishore nanu engoro ai napi, maigil nanu aidaikie Efraim amu ara nanu Enkai mara oltung'ani Ilo Sinyati otii atua intae, nemalotu nanu aidaikie.

English: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
Masaai: Kepuo ninche aasujaa Olaitoriani, naa keikurrukur ninye anaa olng'atuny, ee keikurrukur, ore layiok lenyena nepuonu eikirikira eing'uaa enkalo o loo ntoluo.

English: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nepuonu ninche eikirikira anaa ntaritik naaing'uaa Misiri, o anaa nturkuluni eing'uaa enkop e Asiria; naa karriny nanu ninche meshomo inkang'itie enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
Masaai: Aatang'adua nanu Efraim te lejare, naang'adu enkaji e Israel too monko; kake eton eyioloi Yuda te Nkai, naa keisiligayu ninye te ilo Osinya.

English: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
Masaai: Osiwuo eirrita Efraim, nemirare ninye olkutati lo loosaen endama pooki; neponaa ninche elejare o larrabal; nening'ore ninche te nkinyang'a enkop e Asiria, nenapi eilata aaya Misiri.

English: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
Masaai: Eeta Olaitoriani enaikilikuanu tiaalo Yuda, naa kelo aitame Yakobo te risioroto oo iasat enyena, neitalak ninye te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena.

English: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkoshoke e ng'otonye neibung ninye olalashe lenye entutunyo, o e etaa oltung'ani kitok nekeshare Enkai.

English: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
Masaai: Etekeshare ninye olmalaika neisulu, eishira ninye neing'oru omom enye. Enotore ninye Enkai te Betel, neirorie ninye Enkai teine.

English: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
Masaai: Olaitoriani Enkai oo lororani, Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye:

English: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
Masaai: “Neaku ore iyie te retoto e Nkai ino, tushukunye, mbung'a enyorrata o esipata tukurraki nibik aanyu Enkai ino.”

English: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
Masaai: Olbiasharai oata entemet e lejare te nkaina enye.

English: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
Masaai: Eji etejo Efraim, “Ee kara nanu karsis, anotoko kewan imasaa.” Kake ore ina arsisisho enye, nemeiwuang'ie enkarruoisho oo ng'ok enyena.

English: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino aitupukuo apa intae te nkop e Misiri; naa kaigil areu intae entobik too lng'oborri; anaa apa too nkolong'i o sirua otegeluaki.

English: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
Masaai: Airorie apa nanu iloibonok; nanu apa ilo otoponayie induaat, ore too loibonok naishoru nkitanyaanyukot.

English: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
Masaai: Tenaa ketii entorroni Gilead meeta nchere pee mepuonu ninche aaku pesho; Tenaa kepolosi iloing'ok te Gilead, ore lelo perereni lenye naa kepuo aatiu anaa sotot loo soito too nong'ot e nkurma.

English: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
Masaai: (Eisikaka apa Yakobo enkop e Aram, ore teine neisiaisho Israel te nkaraki enkitok, naa ore te nkaraki enkitok neirrita nkerra.)

English: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
Masaai: To loiboni le Nkai eilepunye Olaitoriani Israel aitung'uaa Misiri; naa to loiboni le Nkai eitagolieki ninye.

English: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
Masaai: Eyaua Efraim embae naitagorisho oleng; neaku ore Olaitoriani lenye, keing'uaa ina kitarrurroto o sarge te shumata ninye, nerrinyoki ninye ina kurruna enye.

English: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
Masaai: Teneiro apa Efraim, neikirikira iltung'ana; eilepieki apa ninye tiatua Israel; kake etaasa ninye entorroni te Baal neye.

English: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
Masaai: Ore taata neponaa ninche aas ing'ok, neitobiraki ate nkitanyaanyukot naasholuni, o nkitanyaanyukot naaitayuni te nkarriyiano te nkosholai enye, ore ninche pooki naa esiaai oo ltung'ana arriyiak. Nejo, “Entopolosaki kuna. Neng'utut iltung'ana ilasho.”

English: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina ketiu ninche anaa enkinuku e nkakenya, arashu anaa enkoileelio nayooki aishunye, anaa suut naakutaa osiwuo te wueji neidong'ishoreki arashu anaa empuruo naipang'u te lusie.

English: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
Masaai: Ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino ore apa te nkop e Misiri; miyiolo ae Ai neme nanu, nemetii likae aitajeunoni leme nanu.

English: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
Masaai: Nanu apa ilo laatayiolo ti ong'ata, tiatua ina kop o lpurkel;

English: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
Masaai: kake ore apa pee edaa ninche aaraposho, neiputakino ninche, ore iltauja lenye nedumunye; neaku aatorikinote ninche nanu.

English: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina katiu nanu te ninche anaa olng'atuny, karresh ninche te mbata e nkoitoi anaa olowuaru keri.

English: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
Masaai: Kadoiki nanu ninche anaa olng'arurumi otooruoki nkera enyena, kapolos nanu olgoo lenye, ore teine naidaikie nanu ninche anaa olng'atuny, anaa enaiko enkukuu.

English: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
Masaai: Kaidaikie nanu intae, Israel; kaing'ae oidim atareto intae?

English: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
Masaai: Koree taata olaiguanani lino pee kintajeu; koree lelo kituaak linono pooki pee kimitu lelo apa litejo iyie, “Inchooki nanu olaiguanani o ilkituaak?”

English: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
Masaai: Aaishoo nanu iyie olaiguanani te ngoro, naiwuang'ie ninche te ngoro ai.

English: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
Masaai: Ore enkarruoisho e Efraim netirridaki, ore eng'oki enye netushumaki te mpere.

English: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
Masaai: Etabawua emion esaisai te nkaraki ninye, kake olayioni omoda ninye, amu ore o taata melotu ninye aimu eng'uset e ishoi.

English: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
Masaai: Kakordu nanu ninche te ng'olon e nemeneng'a? Kainyang'u nanu ninche aitung'uaa keeya? Nakeeya, koree ilmeita linono? Nemeneng'a koree enkidaata ino? Eiwuang'ieki olng'ur too nkonyek aainei.

English: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
Masaai: Ore hoo duoo ninye tenaa kebul ninye anaa oseyiai kelotu olkutati oing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong, kelotu olkutati lo Laitoriani, ailepu eing'uaa olpurkel; ore inkonyek enyena oo nkariak netoyu, ore nchorroi enyena neishieki; neishie ilo kutati olchumati lenye te pooki toki e tipat.

English: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
Masaai: Kelo Samaria anap enkitarruoroto enye, enkaraki natogolong'aka ninye Enkai enye; kepuo ninche aabatata to lalem, ore nkera enye kutiti neitaa ndung'udung'ot, ore nkituaak naanuta, nebuli nkoishuaa.

English: O Israel, return unto the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
Masaai: Tushukunye iyie Israel, torrinyokinoyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino amu itarrorre iyie te nkaraki enkarruoisho ino.

English: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
Masaai: Shomo iata rorei nirrinyokino Olaitoriani; tiaaki ninye, “Iwuang'ie enkarruoisho pooki; tang'amai ina sidai naa ekinchoru iyiook ilng'anayio loo nkutukie ang.

English: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
Masaai: Meitajeu iyiook Asiria, mikipuo iyiook aaked mbartan; nimiking'il ae kata aajo, ‘Enkai ang, too siaaitin oo nkaik ang. Ti atua iyie etum enkerai okishi olng'ur.’ ”

English: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
Masaai: Kaishiunye nanu ina golong'akinoto enye; kanyorru nanu ninche to ltau lai, amu eibelekenye engoro ai aing'uaa ninche.

English: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
Masaai: Katiu nanu anaa enkoileelio te Israel; naitupuku ninye anaa entapukai, naa keibung ntona anaa olchani onyaanyukie olchartuyian,

English: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
Masaai: neisuaa ilng'osil lenyena; netiu esidano enye anaa oloirien, ore erropili enye netiu anaa iltarakua ootii Lebanon.

English: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
Masaai: Kerrinyunye ninche nepuonu aamany abori oloip lai, naa kebul ninche anaa enkurma nebul anaa osabibu, nepuo ninche aaning'oyu anaa enaisho e Lebanon.

English: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
Masaai: Oo Efraim kaa nanu aporokinore nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin? Nanu doi ilo likiwaliki nikigolie iyie. Atiu nanu anaa olchani onyori, onyaanyukie oltarakuai, nanu eing'uaa ilng'anayio linono.

English: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
Masaai: Ore ilo ora ng'en, nchoo eyiolou kuna baa; ore ilo ojurrisho, nchoo eyiolou ninche; amu keitoriori nkoitoi o Laitoriani, ore ilasipak neim ninche, kake kerrorro ilaitarruorok te ninche.

English: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
Masaai: Ororei lo Laitoriani ele oirriwaka Yoel olayioni le Petuel.

English: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
Masaai: Entoning ena intae iltung'ana moruak, nining'ining'i intae iloomanya ena kop! Ketaase aekata embae naikununo nji too nkolong'i inyi, anaa too nkolong'i oo loo papaai linyi?

English: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
Masaai: Entoliki nkera inyi, naa nchoo nkera inyi metoliki nkera enye, neliki nkera enye eishoi enye.

English: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
Masaai: Ore entoki naleku ilo maati o dung'isho, neinos ina mus oo lmaat. Ore entoki naleku ina mus oo lmaat, neinos olmaati le mpukunoto oo ntargeet ore entoki naleku ilo maati le mpukunoto oo ntargeet neinos ilo maati le nkidaata.

English: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
Masaai: Enyeito intae ilamerak; enchira intae ilaokok le naisho, te nkaraki ina aisho namelok, amu eiwuang'ieki aaitung'uaa nkutukie inyi.

English: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
Masaai: Amu eewuo olosho agilunore enkop ai, negol nemeikenayu te nkumoi; netiu ilala lenyena anaa ilala lo lng'atuny, neeta iltagiligil le lipong o lng'atuny.

English: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
Masaai: Eitomijoono ninche ilkeek laainei loo sabibu, neidaikie ninche ilng'abolo laainei, etikinyutua ninche nkabobok enye nenang'aki enkop; eiborrieki ilng'osil lenye.

English: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
Masaai: Nchira anaa esila naishopokoki ilkuniyiani, eishiraki keeya eilo ojo pee eyam ninye.

English: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the LORD; the priests, the LORD'S ministers, mourn.
Masaai: Ore olasar lenye le ntapa o lasar lenye ooki neiwuang'ieki, te nkaji o Laitoriani. Eishira ilapolosak, lelo aisiaayiak lo Laitoriani.

English: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
Masaai: Eitomijoonoki nkong'at, neishir enkop; enkaraki naidaikieki entapa, etoito isabibu neishunye eilata.

English: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
Masaai: Esinanuoto intae ilaturok le nkop, enchira intae iloota nkurman oo sabibu, enchiraki enkano o shairi amu eidaayie enkisampuare e nkurma.

English: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
Masaai: Etoyio olchani loo sabibu, netoyio olng'aboli, ore kukumanka, o ltukai, o lchani loo lng'anayio, netoito pooki. Neiting'o enchipai too nkera e tung'ana.

English: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
Masaai: Enchopo ilkuniyiani, niyietutu aaishir intae ilapolosak. Enteyieutu enchira intae ilaisiaayiak lo lperere lo lasar. Entijing'u intae, entotoni enkewarie, pooki nchopitoto ilkuniyiani, intae ilaisiaayiak le Nkai ai! Amu ore olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, neiwuang'ieki te nkaji e Nkai inyi.

English: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the LORD your God, and cry unto the LORD,
Masaai: Entisinya eenata inyi e mpukoroto, empotu eumata nasinya enturrurro ilpayiani, o lelo pooki oomanya ina kop meetu enkaji o Laitoriani Enkai inyi; nipuonunu aaishiraki Olaitoriani.

English: Alas for the day! for the day of the LORD is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
Masaai: Oi ina olong! Amu etataana ina olong o Laitoriani, nelotu anaa enkidaaroto naing'uaa ilo magilani.

English: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
Masaai: Keitu eiwuang'ieki endaa aaitung'uaa te dukuya nkonyek ang, neiwuang'ieki eng'ida o enchipai te nkaji e Nkai ang?

English: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
Masaai: Etumutate ilanterera te nkop natoyio, netomijoonito nkajijik naashumishoreki einyalaki mpechen enkaraki nemeetae entapa.

English: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
Masaai: Eng'ura eneba olkiyioi loo ng'uesi! Ore iluaat oo nchoo neidang'a enkaraki nemeetae ndaat oo nchoo tenkaraki ninche. Ore sii iluaat oo nkerrai neiputukunyo.

English: O LORD, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
Masaai: Aaishiraka nanu iyie Olaitoriani. Amu etumuta enkima ndaat e ong'ata, neinos olng'ejep le nkima ilkeek pooki liong'ata.

English: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
Masaai: Eikinchiraki sii ninche ing'uesi e ntim, amu etoito nchorroi oo nkariak, netumuta enkima ndaat e ong'ata.

English: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
Masaai: Entoosh entarumpeta te Sion; entoosh entadara teilo doinyo lai sinyati! Nchoo eikirikira lelo pooki oomanya ena kop, amu kelotu enkolong o Laitoriani etataana.

English: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
Masaai: Enkolong e naimin o sina, enkolong oo nkatampo o enaimin nagut! Etotiuo anaa erokan eisalaashakino ildoinyo, olorere kitok ogol, eitu aekata etumi enanyaanyukie ninche ebaiki moitie, nemetumi aekata enanyaanyukie ena too larin loo ishoritin pooki.

English: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
Masaai: Kemutisho enkima te dukuya ninche. Ore te siadi ninche neinosisho olang'at le nkima. Eikununo ina kop anaa enkurma e Eden te dukuya ninche, kake ore te siadi ninche naa ong'ata nememanya, nemeetae entoki naidim ailanya ninche.

English: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
Masaai: Ore eliooto enye neikununo anaa mbartan, nekuet ninche anaa mbartan o larrabal.

English: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
Masaai: Ore anaa elototo oo ng'arrin oo mbartan, neipid ninche too nchumat oo ldoinyo, anaa endarata enkima nainos isuut, anaa enjore nagol, natoluaakine olarrabal.

English: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ninche neirut olorere, neipusita nkomomi enye.

English: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
Masaai: Nerasaa ninche anaa ilmurran, neked isunta anaa sikarini, nepuo ninche dukuya oltung'ani ake te nkoitoi enye, meibelekenya ninche aapaash nkoitoi enye.

English: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
Masaai: Meetae olorruesh olikae, enkoitoi enye ake eibung pooki lenye, epuo ninche eeta imasaa enye o larrabal, nemeibooroyu.

English: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
Masaai: Neipid ninche te nchumata eina anasa, nekuet too nchumat oo sunta; neked nkajijik, neim ilusien anaa lapurrok.

English: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
Masaai: Neikirikira enkop te dukuya ninche, neikirikira shumata. Neitomisimisi enkolong o lapa, neibooyo ilakir ewang'an enye.

English: And the LORD shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the LORD is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
Masaai: Neitayu Olaitoriani oltoilo lenye, te dukuya enjore enye, amu aikitok oleng olorora lenye ore ilo olimu ororei lenye neeta engolon. Amu ore ina olong o Laitoriani naa kitok neitureisho oleng, aing'ae oidim ating'iria?

English: Therefore also now, saith the LORD, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
Masaai: “Ore ake sii o taata,” Olaitoriani ojo, “Torrinyunye wou enatii to ltau lino pooki, te enata e mpukoroto o te nkishirata o to sina.

English: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the LORD your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
Masaai: Nipolososo iltauja linyi, mme ilkilani linyi.” Torrinyokinoyu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, amu aisupat ninye neeta olng'ur, mesioki agoro, neeta enyorrata nauno, neirridu entorroni.

English: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the LORD your God?
Masaai: Kalo oyiolo tenaa keibelekenya ninye neirridu, neing'uaa emayianata etulusoyie ninye, olasar le ntapa o lasar ooki, te nkaraki Olaitoriani Enkai ino.

English: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
Masaai: Entoosh entarumpeta te Sion. Entisinya eenata e mpukoroto; empotu eumata nasinya;

English: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
Masaai: enturrurro iltung'ana. Entisinya eumata; enturrurro ilpayiani; enturrurro nkera ometabaiki nkutiti naanakita. Nchoo oloyamisho eing'uaa olgilata lenye neing'uaa ina nayami olgilata lenye.

English: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O LORD, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
Masaai: Ore te rishata enjing'et o lperere lo lasar, nchoo lapolosak lelo aisiaayiak lo Laitoriani eishir, nejo, “Teleku iltung'ana linono, Olaitoriani, nimintaa enjung'ore ino enkurruna, entoki naimakini tiatua iloreren. Kainyoo pee ejo ninche tiatua iloreren, ‘Koree Enkai enye?’ ”

English: Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
Masaai: Neitoki Olaitoriani atum olom tenkaraki enkop enye, neing'urrie iltung'ana lenyena.

English: Yea, the LORD will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
Masaai: Newal Olaitoriani nejoki iltung'ana lenyena, “Kairriwaki nanu intae entapa o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata. Naa ipuopuo intae aaraposho; nemaigil aekata nanu aitaa intae enkurruna too loreren.

English: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
Masaai: “Kaiwuang'ie nanu ilo le moikuape aitung'uaa intae, nareu nanu ninye empusel mitil. Ore lelo lenye le lukunya nepuo enaiposha o loosaen, ore lelo le siadi nepuo atua enaiposha o loontoluo; ore olng'usil o eng'uan enye nedumunye, amu etaasa ninye mbaa sapuki.

English: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the LORD will do great things.
Masaai: Miureishoyu iyie na kop tishipayu iyie ning'ida, amu etaasa Olaitoriani mbaa sapuki.

English: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
Masaai: Emiureishoyu intae ing'uesi e ong'ata, amu kenyori ndaat e ong'ata; eiu olchani ilng'anayio lenyena, neiu olng'aboli o sabibu ilng'anayio lenye te nkumoi.

English: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
Masaai: “Entishipata intae ilayiok le Sion, ning'idakinono Olaitoriani Enkai inyi; amu eitasiekuo ninye enchan tenkaraki intae. Eitashaikia ninye intae olari seur; eirriwua enchan naituruku o ene siadi anaa apake.

English: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
Masaai: “Keiput entapa ilkurrot ooidong'ishoreki, nedooyo enaisho oo sabibu o eilata too lbenia.

English: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
Masaai: Kaarrinyoki nanu iyie, ilarin apa ooinosie emus olmaati enkop, o ntargeet, o enamutisho, o enadung'isho ina jore ai kitok nairriwua nanu atua intae.

English: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
Masaai: “Inos iyie endaa endaa sapuk nikiraposh, nilo aisis Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo laa ninye otaasa inenking'asia te nkaraki iyie. Maigil aekata aaitukurru iltung'ana laainei.

English: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
Masaai: Iyiolouu intae nchere atii nanu atua Israel, naa nanu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi nemetii likae. Nemeigili aekata aaitukurru iltung'ana laainei.

English: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
Masaai: Naa kepuonu nkolong'i te siadi ena, naa kabukoki nanu enkiyang'et ai pooki tung'ani; ore ilayiok linyi o ntoyie inyi neibonisho, ore ilpayiani linyi neidetidet ore ilbarnot linyi neidetidet nedol ilbarnot linyi nduaat.

English: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye isinkan linyi isinkan linyi lewa o sinkan inyi ng'orou, kenya te nena olong'i, naa kabukoki nanu enkiyang'et ai.

English: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
Masaai: “Naa kaishoru nanu nkikoot te keper o te nkop, osarge o enkima, o empuruo nairrusha.

English: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of the LORD come.
Masaai: Keitomisimisi enkolong, neitotiuni olapa anaa osarge, eng'or ina olong kitok o Laitoriani naitureisho.

English: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the LORD hath said, and in the remnant whom the LORD shall call.
Masaai: Naa keaku ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani, nekorduni. Amu ore to ldoinyo le Sion o te Yerusalem netii lelo oopuo aaimisho, anaa enatejo Olaitoriani; ore te lelo ooleku, ninche etii lelo ooipot Olaitoriani.

English: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ore kenya te nena olong'i, o teina kata, tenarrinyu nanu lelo ootarayioki le Yuda o le Yerusalem,

English: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
Masaai: naa kaiturrur nanu iloreren pooki, nayau ninche aitadou oerata le Yehoshafat, naiguanare nanu ninche te nkaraki iltung'ana laainei o enjung'ore e Israel amu eidapashakaki apa ninche atua iloreren, netooro ninche enkop ai,

English: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
Masaai: netooshokitio ninche iltung'ana laainei enkukuo, neishooyo ninche enkayioni aainosie emulayoi, nemir entito aainosie enaisho oo sabibu, netooko ninche ina aisho.

English: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
Masaai: “Ira iyie nyoo te nanu iyie Turo o Sidon, o kulo kirinen le Filistia? Kaa toki kirrinyoki nanu alaaki? Tenaa eikilaaki iyie nanu, naitalaku nanu enkias ino te nchumata endukuya ino makewan, te wuapunoto o te nkisarrisar.

English: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
Masaai: Amu iwa iyie enkosholai ai o sahabu ai, nitanapa iyie ilchumat laainei le karsisisho atua nkajijik oo nkaitin inyi.

English: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
Masaai: Itimiraka iyie iltung'ana le Yuda o le Yerusalem Ilgiriki, niya ninche aitalamaa oleng to lpolosie lenye.

English: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
Masaai: Kake ore taata kaputu nanu ninche teine wueji nitimiraka ninche, naitalaku nanu enkias ino te ndukuya ino makewan.

English: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Kamir nanu ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono apik nkaik oo layiok le Yuda, naa kepuo ninche aamiraki lelo oshon le Sabea, oolakua, amu Olaitoriani oiroro.”

English: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
Masaai: Entolimu ena embalie tiatua iloshon: entobira olarrabal, entuputu iltung'ana magil. Nchoo iltung'ana pooki lo larrabal enyiku, nchoo ninche epuonu aailepu.

English: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
Masaai: Endogo ilchempei linyi metaa lalema, nintaa ilalema linyi oodung'ishoreki iremeta; nchoo ilo oshal ejo, “Ara nanu olmurrani.”

English: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD.
Masaai: Entasieku wootu, intae iloreren pooki ootaana, enturrurro ate teine. Ntadou ilmurran linono, iyie Olaitoriani.

English: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
Masaai: Nchoo iloreren eputu ate, nepuonu oerata le Yehoshafat; amu teine nanu alo aton adung'oki enkiguana, lelo oreren pooki ootaana.

English: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
Masaai: Tipika olalem oololo amu eo enkisampuare. Entijing'u entunyo amu eipute enkironyet. Eilogilog iltooi aadooyo, amu aikitok entorroni enye.

English: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
Masaai: Ilororani, ilororani, tiatua oearata odung'ieki enkiguana. Amu etinyikua enkolong o Laitoriani tiatua ilo erata odung'ieki enkiguana.

English: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
Masaai: Eitomisimisoki enkolong o lapa netajaaitie ilakir ewang'an enye.

English: The LORD also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the LORD will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Neikurrukur Olaitoriani te Sion neitayu oltoilo lenye te Yerusalem, ore keper o enkop neikirikira. Kake Olaitoriani esarunoto too ltung'ana lenyena, osempewuet too ltung'ana lenyena le Israel.

English: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
Masaai: “Metaa ilo iyie ayiolou nchere ara nanu Olaitoriani Enkai ino, ilo obik te Sion, to ldoinyo lai sinyati. Naa keaku Yerusalem sinyati, nemeigil aekata iltung'ana omon aaim atua ninye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
Masaai: “Ore kenya teina olong neitong'u ildoinyo enaisho oo sabibu namelok, neruko ndoinyo te kule, ore inongot pooki e Yuda neruko enkare; nerukunye enchorro e nkare naing'uaa enkaji o Laitoriani, nepik oerata le Shitim enkare.

English: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
Masaai: “Kelo Misiri aaku olmuate, neaku Edom ong'ata mitil tenkaraki enkarruoisho apa naitaasaki iltung'ana le Yuda, amu eibukoitie apa osarge lemeeta entioto te nkop enye.

English: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
Masaai: Kake kemanyi Yuda ntarasi nememanyi Yerusalem too iishoritin pooki.

English: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
Masaai: Kaitalaku nanu osarge lenye, naiwuang'ie nanu entorroni enye, amu ebik Olaitoriani te Sion.”

English: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
Masaai: Kulo irorei le Amos, apa laa obo loo lairritak loo ntare le Tekoa. Etoduaa apa ninye kuna naaipirta Israel too nkolong'i e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda o too nkolong'i e Yeroboam olayioni le Yoash, olaiguanani le Israel ilarin oare eng'or enkikirikirata e nkop.

English: And he said, The LORD will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
Masaai: Nejo ninye: “Eikurrukur Olaitoriani te Sion, neitayu oltoilo lenye te Yerusalem; eishir ndaat oo lairritak loo ntare, netoyu enchumata e Karmel.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Dameski, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; Amu eironya ninche Gilead too nkironyeta e sekenkei.

English: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Benhadad.
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata enkaji e Hasael, naa kemut ninye isempewueti le Benhadad.

English: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kagil nanu esekenkei e Dameski naiwuang'ie lelo oomanya aitung'uaa oerata le Afen, naiwuang'ie ilo oibung'ita eng'udi e nkitoo aitung'uaa Besedan; naa kepuo iltung'ana le Siria eyararoto te Kir, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Gasa, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie enkitamioto enye; amu ewaita ninche eyararoto olosho olulung'a pee eyaki ninche Edom.

English: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata esuntai e Gasa, naa kenya isempewueti lenye.

English: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn mine hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Kaiwuang'ie nanu lelo oomanya Ashdod, o ilo oibung'ita eng'udi e nkitoo aitung'uaa Ashkelon; kaibelekeny nanu enkaina ai aarare Ekron ore ilo pisiai loo Lfilisti neidaaya.” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Turo, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie enkitamioto enye; Amu etokordutua eyakita ninche olosho olulung'a le Edom, neitu edamu osotua loo lalashera.

English: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata esuntai e Turo, naa kenya isempewueti lenyena.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Edom o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu etimira ninye olalashe lenye to lalem, neiturraa olng'ur pooki, neibung ninye engoro anaake, neshum engoro napi ntarasi.

English: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaa nanu enkima shumata Teman, naa kenya lelo sempewueti le Bosra.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni oo Lamoni o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu etadanya ninche inkoshuaa oo nkituaak e Gilead, pee etum ninche aaitalala olpolosie lenye.

English: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
Masaai: Naa kainok nanu enkima te suntai e Raba, naa kenya isempewueti lenyena too mbuakunot e ina olong o larrabal to sina teina olong olemua te ilo arrabal oikununo anaa osiuo.

English: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani lenye o lkituaak lenye nepuo eyararoto,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Moab, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye, amu etapejo ninye aitaa nkuruon iloik lo laiguanani le Edom.

English: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kirioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaa nanu enkima shumata Moab, naa kenya isempewueti le Keriot, naa keye Moab te mpolos e enkishirata te mpolos e mbuata o to ltoilo le ntarumpeta.

English: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kaiwuang'ie nanu olaiguanani te mpolos e Moab, naar metuata ilkituaak lenyena te nebo ninye Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Yuda, o tiong'uan, maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye, amu etanyaita ninche nena kitanapat o Laitoriani neitu eibung nkiguanat enyena kake eitapong'oiyie ninche elejare enye, naa ninye etusuja iloo menye.

English: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neaku kairriwaki nanu enkima shumata Yuda, naa kenya isempewueti le Yerusalem.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkitarruorrot uni e Israel, o tiong'uan maiwuang'ie nanu enkitamioto enye; amu kemir ninche ilo asipani te nkosholai nemir ilo omena aainosie inamuka are.

English: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
Masaai: Ninche lelo ooitunyoki endukuya o laisinani enterit e nkop, neibelekeny enkoitoi eilo oibookoki enkop nelo olayioni o menye ayiaya enkitok nabo, neidurukie ninche enkarna ai sinyati.

English: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
Masaai: Neirrag ninche te mbata e pooki perere lo lasar too nkilani naalakieki isilen; naa ore tiatua enkaji e Nkai enye neok ninche enaisho e lelo ooitalaaki esile.

English: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
Masaai: “Ore eyia aidaikie apa nanu Ilamori te dukuya ninche, ooba enkadoro enye anaa enkadoro oo ltarakua negol oleng anaa ilkeek sapuki; aidaikie nanu ilng'anayio lenyena te shumata, o ntona enyena te kop.

English: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
Masaai: Ayaua sii nanu intae aitayu te nkop e Misiri, narik intae ilarin artam tiong'ota, pee ipuonunu aaya enkop oo Lamori.

English: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Aitaa nanu embata oo layiok linyi iloibonok le Nkai ore embata oo lbarnot linyi Ilnasari, aimesipa ena, lo tung'ana le Israel?” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
Masaai: “Kake intooko intae Ilnasari enaisho, nintanapinapa iloibonok le Nkai aajoki ‘Emimbonisho’.

English: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, karogonyaki nanu intae enkop te wueji inyi, anaa enarogony enkop engarri nabore lolan.

English: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
Masaai: Keimin enkuetata te ilo oneneng, ore ilo ogol nemeitoki aata engolon enye; nemeitoki ilo magilani aidim aitajeu enkishui enye.

English: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself.
Masaai: Ore ilo oibung enkawuo nemeitashe, ore ilo oneneng too nkejek nemeitajeu kewan, nemeitajeu ilo oked embarta enkishui enye;

English: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith the LORD.
Masaai: naa ore ilo ogol tau tialo lelo magil naa keyooki aisik ailanyisho meishopo te ina olong.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
Masaai: Entoning'o ele ororei laa ninye eiroro Olaitoriani tialo intae: lo tung'ana le Israel, tialo ilo marei pooki apa ailepunye nanu aitayu tiatua enkop e Misiri.

English: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
Masaai: “Intae ake atayiolo nanu, too lmareita pooki le nkop; neaku kaitame nanu intae te ntorroni inyi pooki.

English: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
Masaai: “Amaa keiriamari iltung'ana oare te nebo te neitu ening'o?

English: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
Masaai: Amaa, Keikurrukur olng'atuny te ntim eitu ninye eibung toki, Keikurrukur olkuoo lo lng'atuny te nkapune enye meeta ninye toki?

English: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
Masaai: Amaa kedoiki emotonyi orreshet te nkop eitu epikakini ninye orreshet? Kegamisho irresheta te nkop eitu eibung toki?

English: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the LORD hath not done it?
Masaai: Amaa keoshi entarumpeta te nkanasa nemeirut iltung'ana? Kejing entorroni enkanasa te neme Olaitoriani oyaua?

English: Surely the Lord GOD will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
Masaai: Esipa meeta enaas Olaitoriani Enkai, eitu eibalunye enkisudoroto enye too sinkan lenyena, lelo oibonok lenyena.

English: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord GOD hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
Masaai: Eikurrukurro olng'atuny; ai ng'ae lemeureishoyu: Eiroro Olaitoriani Enkai; aing'ae lemeibonisho?”

English: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
Masaai: Enosai too sempewueti te Asiria, o too sempewueti tiatua enkop e Misiri, nijojo, “Enturrurroto maate te nchumata oldoinyo le Samaria, eng'ura embuakunoto o lkiyioi tiatua ninye o enkitorogonyare tiatua ninye.”

English: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
Masaai: “Meyiolo ninche eneiko teneas esipata.” Olaitoriani ojo. “Kulo ooshum ilchumat le ntorroni e nkikonya too sempewueti lenye.”

English: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
Masaai: Neaku nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Kelotu olmang'atinta airin enkop neibung imasaa nimitunyenye ate neraya intokitin naatii isempewueti linyi.”

English: Thus saith the LORD; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani: “Ore anaa enasaru olchekut loo ntare nkejek are aashu endung'oti e nkiok te nkutuk olng'atuny, naatelekua olng'atuny neijia etiu iltung'ana le Israel oomanya Samaria ilkuti ake ooleku, eeta embelati o lorika o enchoto e rruat.”

English: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts,
Masaai: “Entoning naa, ninchakenokiki enkaji e Yakobo” Olaitoriani Enkai, Enkai oo lororani, ojo.

English: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
Masaai: Nchere te ina olong naitame nanu Israel te nkitarruorroto enye, naa kaitame nanu ilperereni loo lasarri le Betel, ore mouarak o lperere lo lasar nedung'ori nesulakini enkop.

English: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Kagil nanu enkaji e nkata enkirobi o enkaji enkata enkirouaj; ore nkajijik naaikodo too lala loo lkanchaoni nerruoyo, ore nkajijik kituaak neidaaya,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
Masaai: “Entoning ele rorei, ntae nkishu e Bashan, naatii oldoinyo le Samaria, nena naaibooki olaisinani enkop neitorogony olomena nena naajoki ilpayiani lenye, ‘Eyau pee kitum atook!’

English: The Lord GOD hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te sinyatisho enye, nchere, ng'ura kepuonu nkolong'i shumata intae, peyie eyau intae too lala oo loolo o metabaiki iloobayie linyi too lala oo loolo loo sinkir.

English: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and ye shall cast them into the palace, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ipuopuo intae aaim esuntai nataaraki neitashe pooki ng'ae te dukuya ninye nepuoi aanang'aki intae Harmon,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
Masaai: “Wou Betel, tigila nkitanapat, Wou Gilgal, toponai engilata oo nkitanapat; iyau ilasarri linono anaake tadekenya, o matuan inono e tomon te pooki olong e uni.

English: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Intayu olasar le nashe; eina naisuijieki nimbalie inkishorunot e mpiris nilikioo ninche amu inyorrinyorro aaikuna neijia, lo tung'ana le Israel!” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Nanu oyaua olameyu atua nkanas inyi pooki o enkiishunoto oo mukateni too nkajijik inyi pooki, ore ake eyia neitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
Masaai: “Naa nanu sii oibooyie enchan meshaiki intae eton eng'or ilapaitin okuni le nkisampuare nairriwaki; nanu enchan shumata e nkanasa nabo napal enkae anasa atashaikia ewueji nebo ore ewueji neitu eshaiki netoyu;

English: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: neaku ore iloo nkanas are aashu uni nepuo enkanasa nabo pee eok enkare, nemeishunye ninche enkure; ore eyia neitu intae kirinyokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Ataara indaiki inyi te nkeeya naitomijoon inkurman inyi aitoi isabibu linyi; ore ilng'abolo o loirienito linyi neinos olmaati; ore eyia neitu kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Airriwaka nanu atua intae olmeitai anaa apa enaikununo te Misiri; naar nanu ilbarnot linyi to lalem; naya nanu imbartan inji aiwuang'ie naya nanu olng'usil loo lng'oborri linyi apik nkumeishin inyi; ore eyia eitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Aidakie nanu ilkulikae te ntae, anaa apa pee eidaikie Enkai Sodom o Gomora, nitiuu apa anaa olmishire oitayioki tiatua enkima nayupuyup; ore eyia eitu intae kishukokinono nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: and because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
Masaai: “Neaku ena nanu aaitaas, iyie Israel, ore enkaraki naa kaas nanu ena terretenayu pee itumore Enkai ino iyie Israel!”

English: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, is his name.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oitobira ildoinyo neitayu osiuo, neibalakinye iltung'ana enaikununo endamunoto enye; ilo oitomisimis enkakenya neroro ineeika enkop — Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, ninye enkarna enye!

English: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Israel.
Masaai: Entoning ele rorei lajo nanu te nkishirata te nkaraki intae na aji e Israel:

English: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
Masaai: “Etabatate nemeigil ae kata adumunye ina selenkei e Israel; eiturrayioki te nkop enye nemeetae olodumu ninye.”

English: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai: “Ore enkanasa napukunye iltung'ana enkalifu nabo iip ake ooleku, ore ina napukunye iltung'ana iip, tomon ake oolekaki enkaji e Israel.”

English: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
Masaai: Amu nji ejoki Olaitoriani enkaji e Israel: “Eng'oruaki nanu pee ipokipoko;

English: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
Masaai: kake eming'oruru intae Betel, nimijing'ijing'i Gilgal aashu idung'udung'u aapuo Beer-sheba; amu meeta nchere melo Gilgal eyararoto, naa keaku Betel entoki nemeetae.”

English: Seek the LORD, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel.
Masaai: Eng'orutu Olaitoriani pee ipokipoko, pee melotu ake ninye anaa enkima ajing enkaji e Yosef, nenya ninye nemetii oloar ninye te Betel,

English: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
Masaai: Intae kulo ooibelekeny esipata aaitaa esayiet, nenang'aki esipata enkop!

English: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:
Masaai: Ore ilo oitobira Inkokua o Inkapiak uni neibelekeny enaimin nagut aitaa enkakenya neitomisimis endama aitaa enkewarie ilo oipotu nkariak e naiposha neitashaiki ninche shumata oriong e nkop, Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye,

English: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
Masaai: ilo oyau enkidaaroto anaa enkiwuang'ata egilunore ilo ogol neaku kelotu enkidaaroto shumata ine negol.

English: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
Masaai: Eiba ninche ilo oisikong'isho te kishomi neinyal ilo oiro esipata.

English: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.
Masaai: Neaku ore enkaraki nimbookiki olaisinani enkop nioruru ninye enkano enye, itesheta intae nkajijik oo soito oogueta, kake mibikiekie intae ninche; ituno intae isabibu sidain, kake miokioko enaisho enye.

English: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
Masaai: Amu ayiolo nanu eneba nkitarruorrot inyi o enaba esapuko oo ng'ok inyi, intae ilooibooki enkop olasipani, niyaya ntokitin e ropare, nimbelekenyenye ilo omena aarriny te kishomi.

English: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilo ng'en negira te nkata naikununo nji; amu enkata e ntorroni.

English: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the LORD, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye have spoken.
Masaai: Eng'orutu isidain, mme ntorrok, pee ipokipoko; pee etum Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani ataa te nebo intae, anaa enitejo intae.

English: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that the LORD God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
Masaai: Embai entorroni, ninyorrurru esupatisho, nintubulaa esupatisho te kishomi; amu eidimayu to Laitoriani, Enkai oo lororani pee eipirisie Enkai olpisiaai le Yosef.

English: Therefore the LORD, the God of hosts, the Lord, saith thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
Masaai: Nji naa ejo Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, Olaitoriani: “Ore too nkoitoi pooki kituaak naa keaku enkishirata; ore too nkoitoi pooki nejo ninche, ‘Aha, aha!’ Naa keipotu ninche ilaturok le nkurma meetu aaishir, neyietu lelo arriyiak te nkishirata,

English: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: ore too wuejitin pooki oo sabibu naa keaku e nkishirata, amu kaim nanu atua empolos inyi.” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! to what end is it for you? the day of the LORD is darkness, and not light.
Masaai: Intae lelo oong'uar enkolong o Laitoriani! Kainyoo pee iyieuu intae enkolong o Laitoriani? Enaimin ninye neme ewang'an;

English: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
Masaai: ketiu anaa oltung'ani okuet ailany olng'atuny nenang'are olng'arurumi, aashu elo atua aji neigaraki enkaina enye esuntai neony olasurai ninye.

English: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
Masaai: Aime enaimin enkolong o Laitoriani neme ewang'an, o emisimisi nemewang?

English: I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies.
Masaai: “Kaiba nanu namen isiruai linyi nemashipakino lelo turrurri linyi.

English: Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts.
Masaai: Ore hoo nikintaikiki nanu ilasarri linyi oopejori o lasarri le nkurma, mang'amaa nanu ninche, ore lelo asarri linyi le seriani loo nchoo inyi naapir, maning'ore nanu.

English: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
Masaai: Ewaita entung'uayioki nanu enkilepilep oo sinkolioitin linyi; mainining nanu oltoilo loo nkinantani inyi.

English: But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
Masaai: Kake enchoo esipata erukunye anaa nkariak nerukunye esupatisho anaa enchorro nemetoyu ae kata.

English: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
Masaai: Amaa eikiyakita apa intae ilasarri o nkishorot to lpurkel too lapa arin artam, naaji e Israel?

English: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
Masaai: Ewaita intae Sakuti olaiguanani linyi, o Kaiwana ina ai inyi o lakira o nkitanyaanyukot inyi apa nintobirakita ate;

English: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith the LORD, whose name is The God of hosts.
Masaai: neaku kaya nanu intae enchom eyararoto te idia alo Dameski,” Olaitoriani ojo, laa ore enkarna enye naa Enkai oo Lororani.

English: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, which are named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came!
Masaai: “Oi lekua ooisikarra te Sion, o lekua oodol eserian to ldoinyo le Samaria, lelo tung'ana ning'ot le dukuya too loshon, laa ninche esaru olosho le Israel!

English: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: be they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
Masaai: Entalang enchom Kalne entodol; nidumunyenye te ine aapuo Hamat kitok; nintokiki aapuo Gat oo Lfilisti. Keikash ninche aalang kuna kitoriat pooki aashu aisapuk enkop enye alang enkop inyi.

English: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
Masaai: Intalakuanana intae enkolong e ntorroni, niyauu aaitataanu entonata o larrabal?

English: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall;
Masaai: “Oi lekua ooirrag too ndapashi naaikodo too lala loo lkanchaoni, neitoriori too lorikan dapashi, nenya ilkuoo le kerra too luaat nenya ilasho to lale;

English: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;
Masaai: lelo oorany isinkoliotin le pesho to ltoilo le nkinanta, neitobiraki ate ntokitin oo sinkolioitin anaa Daudi;

English: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.
Masaai: ook enaisho too lbakulini neeyel ate te ilata sidai oleng, kake meisina ninche te nkidaata e Yosef!

English: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.
Masaai: Neaku keaku taata ninche ile dukuya te lelo oopuo eyararoto, ore isiruai linyi o sikarri inyi neishunye.”
