English: The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani Enkai olmumai te kewan enye (Olaitoriani ojo, Enkai oo lororani): “Kaiba nanu olwuasa le Yakobo, naiba isempewueti lenye; naa kaishooyo nanu enkanasa o pooki natii atua.”

English: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
Masaai: Naa te neleku iltung'ana tomon te nkaji nabo neye ninche.

English: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is by the sides of the house, Is there yet any with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa ore oltung'ani opejoo olalashe lenye, te neitayu loik lenye tiatua aji, nejoki ilo otii atua aji, “Keton etii likae tung'ani te nebo iyie?” Nejo ninye “A-a nejo, tigirayu! mikintoki iyiook aaipot enkarna o Laitoriani.”

English: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, eitayu Olaitoriani enkitanapata neari enkaji sapuk aaitaa mbelibelat, neitaae enkaji kiti irrarrat.

English: Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:
Masaai: Amaa, kekuet mbartan te nchumata indapidapo Ketur oltung'ani enaiposha too lmong'i? Kake mbelekenya intae esipata aaitaa esayiet o lng'anayio le sipata nintaa olchani odua

English: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?
Masaai: intae kulo oong'ida te Mpesho, oojo, “Keitu iyiook te ngolon ang maate kiya Karnaim?”

English: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kadumaki nanu intae olosho, lo tung'ana le Israel,” Olaitoriani ojo, Enkai oo lororani; naa keibooki ninche intae enkop ebaiki enejing'ieki Hamat o metabaiki Ereyiet e Araba.”

English: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
Masaai: Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani: ng'ura, eitobirita ninye olmaati te nkiterunoto embulunoto e ndaa natuunoki to loirujuruj, naa ng'ura embulunoto e are eidipa olaiguanani atudung'o.

English: And it came to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land, then I said, O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip ilo maati ainosa inkujit e ina kop, najo nanu, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tapalaki ninche, aatasayia iyie! Kaji naa eiko pee eitashe Yakobo? Eikiti ninye oleng!”

English: The LORD repented for this: It shall not be, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neirridu Olaitoriani ena bae; Meekure eaku, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire, and it devoured the great deep, and did eat up a part.
Masaai: Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani; ng'ura, eipotu Olaitoriani Enkai enkiguana e nkima, nenya ina kima ineegut oleng, neinosita sii enkop.

English: Then said I, O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Olaitoriani Enkai, tapala, aatasayia iyie! Kaji naa eiko pee eitashe Yakobo? Eikiti ninye oleng!”

English: The LORD repented for this: This also shall not be, saith the Lord GOD.
Masaai: Neirridu Olaitoriani ena; “Meitoki sii ena atiu,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

English: Thus he shewed me: and, behold, the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in his hand.
Masaai: Aaitoduaa ninye: ng'ura, eitashe Olaitoriani te mbata e suntai nateshetaki te ntemet e nkitorioroto, eibung'ita entemet te nkaina enye.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumbline. Then said the Lord, Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more:
Masaai: Naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, “Amos, kainyoo iyie idolita?” Najoki nanu, “Entemet e nkitorioroto.” Neitoki Olaitoriani ajo. “Ng'ura, kapik nanu entemet e nkitorioroto empolos oo ltung'ana laainei Israel; maigil ae kata nanu agiroo ninche;

English: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
Masaai: ore iwuejitin neeika e Isaak naa keitomijooni ore iwuejitin e Israel neeseremishoreki neitomijooni, naa kadumakino nanu enkaji e Yeroboam to lalem.”

English: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
Masaai: Neitoki Amasia olapolosani le Betel airriwaki olkilikuai Yeroboam olaiguanani le Israel, ejoki, “Eitobirita Amos entorroni tialo iyie te mpolos e nkaji e Israel; meidimaa ena kop ilomon lenyena pooki.

English: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
Masaai: Amu nji apa etejo Amos, ‘Keye Yeroboam to lalem nemeeta nchere pee melo Israel eyararoto aing'uaa enkop enye.’ ”

English: Also Amaziah said unto Amos, O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there:
Masaai: Nejoki Amasia Amos, “Iyie oladuaani shomo, isika shomo enkop e Yuda, inosa endaa te ine, nimbonisho te ine;

English: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel: for it is the king's chapel, and it is the king's court.
Masaai: kake mingil ae kata aibonisho te Betel, amu enkaji o laiguanani naseremishore naa enkaji e nkitoo naseremieki Enkai.”

English: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
Masaai: Neitoki Amos awaliki Amasia ejo, “Mara nanu oloiboni le Nkai nemara olayioni lo loiboni, kake kara olairritani o laitobirani loo lkeek oonyaanyukie ilng'abolo,

English: And the LORD took me as I followed the flock, and the LORD said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
Masaai: naaya apa nanu Olaitoriani aitung'uaa esujata oo ntare, naajoki nanu Olaitoriani, ‘Shomo, mbonoki iltung'ana laainei Israel.’

English: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and drop not thy word against the house of Isaac.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata toning'o ororei lo Laitoriani. Ijo iyie ‘Mimbonoki Israel niminosu ilomon le nkikoo tialo enkaji e Isaak?’

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided by line; and thou shalt die in a polluted land: and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land.
Masaai: Nji naa ejo Olaitoriani: ‘Keaku enkitok ino enaiborrie onyek tiatua ena anasa, ore ilayiok linono o ntoyie inono naa kebatata to lalem, ore olokeri lino naa kedung'i aaorrior to lgosoi, ore iyie makewan naa iye te nkop nemesinya, nemeeta nchere pee melo Israel eyararoto aing'uaa enkop enye.’ ”

English: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
Masaai: Ena nanu aaitoduaa Olaitoriani: ng'ura, enkikapu nabore ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj.

English: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then said the LORD unto me, The end is come upon my people of Israel; I will not again pass by them any more.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye, “Amos, kainyoo iyie idolita?” Najoki nanu, “Oljilchil obore ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj.” Naaitoki nanu Olaitoriani ajoki, “Etabaikia enkiting'oto iltung'ana laainei Israel; maigil ae kata nanu agiroo ninche.

English: And the songs of the temple shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord GOD: there shall be many dead bodies in every place; they shall cast them forth with silence.
Masaai: Ore isinkolioitin le nkaji e Nkai naa keaku olkiyioi te ina olong,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo; “Ore mpopoki oo ltung'ana ootuata naa keaku kumok, ore te pooki wueji naa kepuoi aaiturraa ninche egirae.”

English: Hear this, O ye that swallow up the needy, even to make the poor of the land to fail,
Masaai: Entoning ena, intae ilooibooki iloomena enkop, niyauu lelo aisinak le nkop aaishie,

English: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?
Masaai: ijojo, “Kanu eishunye olapa ng'ejuk pee kitum aatimir enkurma. Keishunye sabato, pee kitum aatimir enkano, pee kitum aaterepeny entemet naji eta nikiponaa shekeli, nikilej iltung'ana too ntemat e lejare,

English: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
Masaai: Pee kitum iyiook aainyang'u olaisinani te nkosholai ore olomena nikinyang'u too namuka are nikimir isuut e nkano?”

English: The LORD hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob, Surely I will never forget any of their works.
Masaai: Einosa Olaitoriani olmumai te nkaraki olwuasa le Yakobo: “Esipa maarikino ae kata hoo nabo oo nkiasin enye.

English: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood; and it shall be cast out and drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
Masaai: Aimeikirikira enkop te nkaraki ena, Neishir to sina pooki ng'ae omanya atua ninye, nedumunye ninye pooki anaa olkeju le Nail neilugo neitoki aimis, anaa olkeju le Nail te Misiri?”

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord GOD, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day:
Masaai: “Naa ore akenya te ina olong.” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, “Naitadoyio nanu enkolong tenkipirata enkolong, naitomisimis enkop dama.

English: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son, and the end thereof as a bitter day.
Masaai: Kaibelekeny nanu isiruai linyi aitaa osina, ore isinkolioitin linyi pooki neaku olkiyioi; karrotianaki nanu inkilani o lkuniyia pooki tung'ani napik enkurroto pooki lukunya, kaitotiu nanu anaa enkishirata naishirakini olayioni obo laa ninye ake eetae ore enkiting'oto enye netiu anaa enkolong nadua.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, “Nairriwaki nanu enkop olameyu; mme olameyu le ndaa aashu olameyu le nkure e nkare, kake oloning'ieki ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, and shall not find it.
Masaai: Kelimana ninche ebaiki enaiposha o metabaiki enaiposha, moikuape o metabaiki enkilepunoto e nkolong; kekuet ninche aapuo neitu, aaing'oru ororei lo Laitoriani, kake metum ninche.

English: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong isilan sidain o lbarnot naa keiterre te nkure.

English: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, Thy god, O Dan, liveth; and, The manner of Beersheba liveth; even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
Masaai: Ore lelo oonya olmumai te Ashima e Samaria, nejo ‘Ore anaa enaishu enkai ino, Dan;’ naa ‘Ore anaa enaishu enkoitoi e Beer-sheba;’ kebatata ninche nemeigil ae kata aadumunye.”

English: I saw the LORD standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu Olaitoriani eitashe te mbata olperere lo lasar, nejo ninye: “Toosho lukuny oo ng'apeta, o meikirikirata ntonat oo ng'apeta, tebelibelaki ninche inchumat oo ilukuny oo ltung'ana pooki; ore ilooleku lenye naar nanu ninche to lalem; melo ninye obo lenye aisik nemeimisho ninye obo lenye.

English: Though they dig into hell, thence shall mine hand take them; though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down:
Masaai: “Ore hoo naaji ninye te netur enkop aapuo enemeneng'a, naa keitayu ake enkaina ai ninche te ine, ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keilep aapuo shumata, naa kaitadou nanu ninche te ine.

English: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them:
Masaai: Ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keisudori te nchumata oldoinyo oji Karmel naa kaing'oru nanu ninche naitayu ninche; naa ore hoo naaji ninye tenaa keisudori too nkonyek aainei aapuo abori enaiposha naa kairriwaa nanu olasurai ine metoonyo ninche.

English: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
Masaai: Naa ore naaji tenaa kepuo ninche eyararoto te dukuya ilmang'ati lenye, naitanap nanu olalem teine pee ear ninche naa kaing'or nanu ninche te ntorroni neme te sidai.”

English: And the Lord GOD of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it shall melt, and all that dwell therein shall mourn: and it shall rise up wholly like a flood; and shall be drowned, as by the flood of Egypt.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani, Enkai oo lororani, ilo laa te neiseyie enkop neshola, ore lelo pooki oomanya atua neishir to sina nedumunye pooki anaa olkeju le Nail, neitoki adou, anaa olkeju le Nail te Misiri;

English: It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name.
Masaai: ilo oshet enkaji enye e shumata te keper nepik olkitamanyunoto lenye shumata enkop ilo oipotu nkariak e naiposha nebukoki ninche shumata oriong e nkop Olaitoriani ninye enkarna enye.

English: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
Masaai: “Aimitiuu intae anaa Olosho le Etiopia te nanu, intae lo tung'ana le Israel?” Olaitoriani ojo. “Keitu nanu aitayu ailepunye Israel aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri naitung'uaa Ilfilisti Kafta naitung'uaa Siria Kir?

English: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ng'ura, etii nkonyek o Laitoriani Enkai shumata enkitoria oo ng'ok, naa kaidaikie nanu aitung'uaa oriong e nkop; Meteleku ake nchere maidaikie nanu tukul enkaji e Yakobo,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations, like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura, kaitanapisho nanu, pee aipirripir asilu nanu enkaji e Israel tiatua loreren pooki anaa enasil oltung'ani te silet, kake meetae olantererai odoiki enkop.

English: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.
Masaai: Ore lelo aing'okok loo ltung'ana laainei pooki naa keye to lalem, lelo oojo, ‘Meinepu ae kata entorroni iyiook aashu etum iyiook.’

English: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up his ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong naitasheiyie nanu enkaji e Daudi apa naturori naitobir nanu ineetarruoitie, nashumu nanu ineeturori, naitoki nanu ashet metotiuo anaa apa.

English: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, and of all the heathen, which are called by my name, saith the LORD that doeth this.
Masaai: Pee etum ninche aawaita olpisiai le Edom o lelo oreren pooki ooipoti te nkarna ai,” Olaitoriani ilo oas ena, ojo nji.

English: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i,” Olaitoriani ojo, “ore ilo oturisho neinepu ilo oisampisho ore ilo oirony ilng'anayio neinepu ilo ounisho; ore ildoinyo neitong'u enaisho namelok, neruko too ildoinyo pooki.

English: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
Masaai: Kashuku nanu emunyani oo ltung'ana laainei Israel naa keshet ninche nkanas apa naaidaaitie nemany ninche; keun ninche isabibu neok enaisho enye; naa keitayu ninche nkurman neya ilng'anayio lenye.

English: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
Masaai: Kaun nanu ninche te nkop enye, nemeigili ae kata aadotu ninche, aaitayu tiatua ina kop naishoo nanu ninche,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo.

English: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.
Masaai: Enduaata e Obadia. Inji ejo Olaitoriani ti alo Edom: Kitoning'o iyiook ilomon supati ooing'uaa Olaitoriani, neirriwuaki olkilikuai atua iloreren. “Tudumunye! matudumakinoto iyiook ninye to larrabal!”

English: Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaaitaa iyie kiti ti atua iloreren, eikipuoi aamenu iyie oleng.

English: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?
Masaai: Kiteleja iyie ilo wuasa lo ltau lino, iyie ilo omanya enchumata endapidapoi, laa keika oleng emanyisho enye, ilo ojo to ltau lino, “Kaing'ae laaitadou nanu ayau enkop!”

English: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore hoo nilepa alo shumata anaa olkurragos, ore hoo naa atua lakir etii enkaji ino, kaayau ake aitadou enkop, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough? if the grapegatherers came to thee, would they not leave some grapes?
Masaai: Amaa te nepuonu lapurrok enitii kewarie, kebaa enkidaata nikindakieki iyie! Aimepurroo ninche ina ake naidip ninche? Amaa te nepuonu lasotok loo sabibu aimeleku ninche embata?

English: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
Masaai: Kebaa elilituni Esau, neing'oruni ilchumat lenyena!

English: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee: there is none understanding in him.
Masaai: Kiteleja lelo pooki lining'ore, kitimiraitie ninche aareu olpolosie; ore apa lelo liatayie eseriani nikitimira ninche; ore lelo shoreta linono lisilig netipika orreshet abori iyie embae nemeyiolounoyu ina.

English: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, even destroy the wise men out of Edom, and understanding out of the mount of Esau?
Masaai: Amaa kenya te ina olong, Olaitoriani ojo, aimaidaikie nanu lelo tung'ana ang'eni te Edom, o eyiolounoto to ldoinyo le Esau?

English: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana linono magil, Teman, neitukureti, o metaa ore pooki oing'uaa oldoinyo le Esau neiwuang'ieki aar metua.

English: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, and thou shalt be cut off for ever.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina kinyalata nainyalaki olalashe lino Yakobo, eikimulumul iyie enkurruna, naa eikiwuang'ieki ntarasi.

English: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side, in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces, and foreigners entered into his gates, and cast lots upon Jerusalem, even thou wast as one of them.
Masaai: Ore apa te ina olong nintasho aitirring'a, ore apa te ina olong nawaita iltung'ana leiking'a imasaa enyena, neimu ilmang'ati nchomito enyena, neoshoki enkukuo Yerusalem, nitotiwuo iyie anaa obo lenye.

English: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress.
Masaai: Enyor apa neitu ishipakino ina olong o lalashe lino te ina olong apa natijing'a ninye olbuket; enyor apa neitu ing'idakino ina olong e lelo tung'ana le Yuda, te ina olong e nkidaata enye; enyor apa neitu iwuasayu te ina olong o sina.

English: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity; yea, thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity, nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity;
Masaai: Enyor apa neitu ijing kishomi oo ltung'ana laainei, te ina olong o sina lenye; enyor apa neitu ing'idakino ashil enkidaata enye, te nena olong'i e nkidaata enye; enyor apa neitu imbung imasaa enyena te ina olong e nkidaata enye.

English: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, to cut off those of his that did escape; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress.
Masaai: Enyor apa neitu intashe te rishata oo nkoitoi pee imbung lelo ooisik; enyor apa neitu iyau ilo pisiai lenye te ina olong o sina.

English: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
Masaai: Amu etataama ina olong o Laitoriani te shumata iloreren pooki. Ore anaa enitaasa, ina eyookini aitaas intae, keshukokino nkiaasin inyi shumata ilukuny inyi maate.

English: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain, so shall all the heathen drink continually, yea, they shall drink, and they shall swallow down, and they shall be as though they had not been.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enitookishote intae te nchumata e ilo doinyo lai sinyati, keokisho sii ninche lelo oshon pooki oomanita ntae keokisho ninche neimisiloo, netiu ninche anaa keitu ae kata eng'as aaku.

English: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
Masaai: Kake Oldoinyo le Sion epuo aatii lelo ooilanyisho, naa keaku sinyati ine; ore enkaji e Yakobo neya wuejitin enye.

English: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the LORD hath spoken it.
Masaai: Neaku enkaji e Yakobo enkima, ore enkaji e Yosef olang'at le nkima, neaku enkaji e Esau nkabobok; nepej ninche neishu ninche, nemetum hoo obo oleku te nkaji e Esau; amu Olaitoriani oiroro.

English: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau; and they of the plain the Philistines: and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim, and the fields of Samaria: and Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
Masaai: Ore lelo le Negeb naa keya oldoinyo le Esau, ore lelo le Shefela neya enkop oo Lfilisti; neya ninche ina kop e Efraim o enkop e Samaria neya Benchamen Gilead.

English: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath; and the captivity of Jerusalem, which is in Sepharad, shall possess the cities of the south.
Masaai: Ore lelo aisikak le Hala laa ilo lorere le Israel neya Foenike o metabaiki Serefait; ore lelo ooibung'aki le Yerusalem ootii atua Sefarad nepuo aaya nena anas e Negeb.

English: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD'S.
Masaai: Keilep ilaitajeunok aapuo Oldoinyo le Sion aaitore Oldoinyo le Esau; neaku enkitoria eno Laitoriani.

English: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
Masaai: Eewuo apa ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Yona olayioni le Amitai, ejo,

English: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry against it; for their wickedness is come up before me.
Masaai: “Tudumunye, shomo Ninawi, ina anasa kitok, ninchiraki ninye; amu eilepua entorroni enye alotu dukuya nanu.”

English: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake etudumunye Yona aisikaki Tarshishi ailany Olaitoriani. Nedoyio ninye alo Yopa netum emeli naloito Tarshishi; metaa etalaa entikit, neked ajing, pee elo te nebo ninche Tarshishi, enelakua ailany Olaitoriani.

English: But the LORD sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
Masaai: Kake eirriwua Olaitoriani olkutati sapuk shumata enaiposha, nejing enkilugo kitok enaiposha, o metaa kejo emeli pee egila.

English: Then the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god, and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it of them. But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
Masaai: Neiputukuny to lkirutoto lelo ootii emeli, neishiraki ake oltung'ani enkai enye; nenang'aki ninche lelo olan apa ootii emeli atua enaiposha, pee eiteneneng. Kake eshomo apa Yona adoyio alo olgilata li abori emeli neirrag, neirura aitayu njo.

English: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo olkitok le meli nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo iyie idamu, laairragani? Tuputunye, impoto enkai ino! Eidimayu pee edamu iyiook ina ai pee mikindaaya.”

English: And they said every one to his fellow, Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us. So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
Masaai: Nejokino ninche maate, “Wootu, matoosh enkukuo, pee kitum aatayiolo nchere kaing'ae eimua ena torroni naewuo shumata iyiook.” Neosh ninche enkukuo, nedoiki enkukuo Yona.

English: Then said they unto him, Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us; What is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajoki ninye, “Toliki iyiook, kaing'ae eimua ena torroni naewuo shumata iyiook? Kainyoo esiaai ino? Naa kaji ing'uaa? Kaa enkop inyi? Naa eira iyie oli alo orere?”

English: And he said unto them, I am an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, which hath made the sea and the dry land.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ara nanu Olheburaniai; naure nanu Olaitoriani, Enkai e shumata, laa ninye oitobira enaiposha o enkop natoyio.”

English: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him, Why hast thou done this? For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo tung'ana aairut oleng, nejoki ninye, “Kainyoo ena nitaasa iyie!” Amu etayioloito iltung'ana nchere keisikita apa ninye ailany Olaitoriani, enkaraki natolikio ninye ninche.

English: Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajoki ninye, “Kaa iyiook kintaas iyie, pee etum enaiposha aitirring'ayu te iyiook?” Amu etoponari enaiposha ailugo oleng.

English: And he said unto them, Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you: for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Entudumuaki nanu entanang'akaki atua enaiposha; pee etum enaiposha aitirring'ayu te intae; amu ayiolo ajo enkaraki nanu pee eewuo ele kutati kitok shumata intae.”

English: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia neijia netonyuaa lelo tung'ana aajo kireu emeli meeu enkop natoyio, kake etalaikinote amu etoponari enaiposha ailugo oleng oleng ti alo ninche.

English: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD, and said, We beseech thee, O LORD, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD, hast done as it pleased thee.
Masaai: Neaku eishirakitia ninche Olaitoriani, ejo, “Kisai iyie, Olaitoriani, mincho iyiook kindak te nkaraki enkishui ele tung'ani, niminteleiki iyiook osarge le meeta entioto; amu itaasa iyie Olaitoriani anaa enikintiship iyie.”

English: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea: and the sea ceased from her raging.
Masaai: Nedumu ninche Yona nenang'aki ninye atua enaiposha; neitirring'a enaiposha te nkilugoto enye.

English: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice unto the LORD, and made vows.
Masaai: Neureyu lelo tung'ana Olaitoriani oleng, neitaiki ninche Olaitoriani olasar, neinos olmumai.

English: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Masaai: Neirriu Olaitoriani osinkirri sapuk metoijoi Yona; netii apa Yona enkoshoke o sinkirri nkolong'i uni o nkewarieitin uni.

English: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish's belly,
Masaai: Neomon Yona Olaitoriani Enkai enye ti atua enkoshoke e ilo sinkirri,

English: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
Masaai: ejo, “Aipoto nanu Olaitoriani, ti atua osina lai, naawaliki ninye nanu; ti atua enkoshoke e nemeneng'a aishira nanu, nitoning'o iyie oltoilo lai.

English: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
Masaai: Amu kitanang'aka nanu atua enguton, atua enguton oo naaiposha, naaman nanu nkariak pooki wueji; ore lopir pooki o nang'arot oo nkariak neim shumata nanu.

English: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
Masaai: Najo nanu, ‘Aatanang'ayioki aaiturraa aaitung'uaa dukuya ino; kaji pasa nanu aiko pee aigil adol enkaji ino sinyati?’

English: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
Masaai: Aaimulumulaitie nanu nkarriak, aatamana nanu enguton nkaloli pooki; neteene olairampai aman endukuya ai,

English: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
Masaai: too ntonat oo ldoinyo. Nadoyio nanu alo ina kop naaikenorieki nanu ntarasi; ore ake eyia, niyaua iyie enkishui ai ailepunye ti atua engumoto, Iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai.

English: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
Masaai: Ore pee eiterre oltau lai ti atua nanu, nadamu nanu Olaitoriani; nelotu enkomono ai enitii atua enkaji ino sinyati.

English: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooyanyit nkitanyaanyukot oo nkaitin e pesho neituraa enkisiligata enye nasipa.

English: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu to ltoilo le nkishoroto e nashe naa kaapolosaki iyie olasar; ore ina nainosie olmumai kalak nanu. Eno Laitoriani enkordunoto!”

English: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
Masaai: Neirorie Olaitoriani osinkirri, nelopu Yona te nkop natoyio.

English: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Yona enkata e are, ejo,

English: Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and preach unto it the preaching that I bid thee.
Masaai: “Tudumunye shomo Ninawi, idia anasa kitok, nimbalakinye ninye ilo kilikuai laaliki nanu iyie.”

English: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days' journey.
Masaai: Nedumunye Yona nelo Ninawi, te risioroto o rorei lo Laitoriani. Ore apa Ninawi naa enkanasa kitok oleng, elototo oo nkolong'i uni endapasho.

English: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day's journey, and he cried, and said, Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.
Masaai: Neiteru Yona alo atua ina anasa, nelo elototo e nkolong nabo. Neishir ninye ajo, “Nkolong'i artam ake naangor pee eidaikieki Ninawi!”

English: So the people of Nineveh believed God, and proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
Masaai: Neiruk iltung'ana le Ninawi Enkai; neibalie ninche eenata e ate e mpukoroto, neishop ilkuniyiani, ebaiki olkitok lenye o metabaiki oloti lenye.

English: For word came unto the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and he laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
Masaai: Nebaiki lelo omon olaiguanani le Ninawi, nedumunye ninye to lorika lenye le nkitoo, neitayu olkila lenye, neimulumul kewan too lkuniyiani, neton too nkuruon.

English: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing: let them not feed, nor drink water:
Masaai: Nedung'u ninye enkitanapata neitubulaa ti atua Ninawi pooki ejo, “Ore te nkitanapata o laiguanani o lkituaak lenyena: Mincho oltung'ani aashu eng'ues, o inchoo aashu nkerrai eishamisham hoo toki; inchoo ninche etoni medaa, aashu eok enkare,

English: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily unto God: yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
Masaai: kake nchoo oltung'ani o eng'ues eimulumuli too lkuniyiani, naa nchoo ninche eishiraki oleng Enkai; ee nchoo pooki ng'ae eibelekenya aing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono neing'uaa ina torroni nataasa too nkaik enyena.

English: Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
Masaai: Kaing'ae nayiolo nchere eidim Enkai airridu neibelekenya te ina goro enye napi, pee mikindaaya iyiook?”

English: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, that he had said that he would do unto them; and he did it not.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol Enkai ina nataasa ninche, ina naibelekenyate ninche aaing'uaa enkoitoi enye torrono, neirridu Enkai ina torroni apa natejo ninye aitaas ninche; neitu ninye eas ina.

English: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
Masaai: Kake eitu eitiship ena Yona tukul, etagore ninye oleng.

English: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
Masaai: Neomon ninye Olaitoriani nejo, “Aatoomono nanu iyie, Olaitoriani, aime ena apake nanu atejo eton atii enkop ang? Enkaraki ena apa pee aisarisara nanu aisikaki Tarshishi; amu atayiolo apa nanu nchere ira iyie Enkai o sotua naata olng'ur, nemegoro asioki, nikibore enyorrata nauno, nirridu entorroni.

English: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
Masaai: Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani, intayu enkishui ai intung'uayioki nanu, aatasayia iyie, amu enaikash te nanu te naye alang te naishu.”

English: Then said the LORD, Doest thou well to be angry?
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Amaa, itaasa iyie esidai itagore?”

English: So Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
Masaai: Neitoki Yona aipang alo auluo enkanasa neton te nkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong e ina anasa neitobiraki kewan olng'obor te ine. Neton ninye ti abori oloip o metaba anaa nedol enapukoki ina anasa.

English: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his grief. So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd.
Masaai: Negelu Olaitoriani Enkai enkaitubului neisho ninye metubulu te shumata Yona, pee etum ataa oloip te shumata endukuya enye, pee eitajeu ninye te nyamali e nkolong. Neng'idayu Yona oleng te nkaraki ina aitubului.

English: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee emanaa enkakenya te nkolong e are, negelu Enkai olkurto oinosa ina aitubului, neaku etoyio.

English: And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eilepu enkolong, neirriu Enkai olkutati oirowua oing'uaa nkilepunoto e nkolong, near enkolong endukuya e Yona o meiterria, neikilikuanu ninye pee eye, nejo, “Enaikash nanu te naye alang te naishu.”

English: And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Enkai Yona, “Itaasa iyie esidai ti nigorokino enkaitubului?” Nejo ninye, “Ataasa nanu esidai agoro, atagore ene keeya.”

English: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
Masaai: Nejo Olaitoriani, “Ing'urrie iyie ina aitubului neitu iasaki esiaai, neitu iyie intubulu ninye, ina naaku kewarie neidaaya te nkewarie.

English: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
Masaai: Aimaing'urrie naa nanu Ninawi, idia anasa kitok, natii atua ninye ilkumok oogiroo inkalifuni iip o tikitam lemeyiolo ninche aaitirrisha enkaina enye e tatene o ene kedienye, netii sii nchoo kumok?”

English: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ororei lo Laitoriani ele oewuo enetii Mika le Moreshet, too nkolong'i e Yotam, o Ahas, o Hesekia, lelo aiguanak le Yuda. Etoduaa apa ninye kuna baa naaipirta Samaria o Yerusalem.

English: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
Masaai: Entoning intae, intae lo oreren pooki; toning'o na kop, o pooki naatii atua, naa nchoo Olaitoriani Enkai eaku olchakeni tialo intae, Olaitoriani oiro teina aji enye Sinyati.

English: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, kelotu Olaitoriani aipang'u teine wueji enye, nedou alotu aituny iwuejitin neeika e nkop.

English: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
Masaai: Neshola ildoinyo tiabori ninye, neaku ierat iwululuni, netiu anaa suut te dukuya enkima, netiu anaa nkariak naatubukokoki enegut.

English: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
Masaai: Ore ena pooki naa te nkaraki enkitapong'oto e Yakobo, o ng'ok e nkaji e Israel. Kainyoo enkitapong'oto e Yakobo? Aime Samaria? Naa kainyoo eng'oki e nkaji e Yuda? Aime Yerusalem?

English: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina kaitaa nanu Samaria osototi te nkop naisiaja, ewueji neunieki isabibu; naa kabukoki nanu isoito lenyena atua oearata, nanuk ilkitamanyunot lenyena.

English: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin neidong'i aaitaa mbelibelat, ore nena tokitin e marmalisho nepejori te nkima. Ore nena kitanyaanyukot enyena oo nkaitin neirrag te mijoonisho. Amu too mpisai e mulayoi etasotuo ninye ninche, naa nena pisai e mulayoi errinyokino ninye.

English: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ena kayietu nanu aishir; kalo nanu ara olmasipai maishopo; kaitayu nanu enkishirata anaa mbariak, naishir anaa isidan.

English: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu meishiunoyu olbae lenye neewuo Yuda, etabawua kishomi oo ltung'ana laainei, eewuo Yerusalem.

English: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
Masaai: Milimu ena te Gat minchir aitasim ore tiatua Betlefara mperiperayu te nterit.

English: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
Masaai: Eima enkoitoi inyi iloomanya Shafir, te masipaisho o te nkurruna; mepuonu lelo oomanya Saanan emipuonu aaipang'u; Ore enkishirata e Betesel naa kaiwuang'ie te iyie enkitashoto enye.

English: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo oomanya Marot neanyisho te yieunoto oleng amu etoduaa entorroni eing'uaa Olaitoriani nelotu nchomito e Yerusalem.

English: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
Masaai: Enteen ingarrin oo mbartan iloomanya Lakish; intae apa enkiterunoto oo ng'ok nirikokiki entito e Sion, amu tiatua iyie enotoki inkitarruorrot e Isirael.

English: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina ilo iyie aisho nkishorot ole sere Moreshetgat; ore nkajijik e Akisib naa keaku entoki nalejisho, too laiguanak le Israel.

English: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
Masaai: Kaigil nanu ayau oloisulie shumata intae, iloomanya Maresha; ore enkitoo oo Siraeli nelotu Adulam.

English: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
Masaai: Entukur ilukuny inyi nibarnibarna ilpapit linyi, te nkaraki nena kera e ng'ida inyi; nchoo esipayu ilukuny inyi, anaa ilkurragoso, amu kepuo nkera inyi eyararoto.

English: Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.
Masaai: Woi ninche lelo ooipiru entorroni neas entorroni too rruatin enye! Ore ake pee ekenyu neas ina naiguanutua, amu engolon oo nkaik enye etii.

English: And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
Masaai: Eng'uar ninche nkurman neya ninche; neng'uar nkajijik neya ninche; eibooki ninche oltung'ani enkop o enkaji enye, o ltung'ani o enjung'ore enye.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina nji ejo Olaitoriani: Ng'ura kagilunore nanu ele marei aipiru entorroni ometaa mindimidimi aaibelekenya imurto inyi. Nimintokiki aapuo te nkitokoos amu keaku enkata e ntorroni.

English: In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.
Masaai: Ore teina olong nerany ninche osinkolio le nkitumusumuset te nkaraki iyie, neishir ninche te nkishirata e mion ejo, “Eidaikieki iyiook katukul, eibelekenya ninye erubata oo ltung'ana laainei; eiwuang'ie ninye te nanu! tiatua lelo ootaraitie iyiook etooro ninye nkurman ang.”

English: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the LORD.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina mintoki aata hoo obo onang'aa enkopito te oshoto e nkukuo, tiatua eumata o Laitoriani.

English: Prophesy ye not, say they to them that prophesy: they shall not prophesy to them, that they shall not take shame.
Masaai: “Mintoki naa alimu irorei le naibon.” Ejo ninche elimu ilomon, “Meishiaakino nelimu oltung'ani ilomon le kuna baa; meinepu iyiook esulare.”

English: O thou that art named the house of Jacob, is the spirit of the LORD straitened? are these his doings? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
Masaai: Keimakini ena na aji e Yakobo? Aimeeta Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani eng'iriata? Ke nkiaasin enyena kuna? Aimeeta enaitaas irorei laainei ilo olo too sipat?

English: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.
Masaai: Kake itudumakine iyie iltung'ana laainei anaa olmang'atinta; nioru olkila ilo oata eseriani, lelo oopuo eisiligayu lelo lemeeta ndamunot o larrabal.

English: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever.
Masaai: Ore nkituaak oo ltung'ana laainei, niaraa boo, aitung'uaa ninche nkajijik enye sidain, nintung'uaa ninche nkera enye kutiti, nintung'uaa enkitoo ai ntarasi.

English: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
Masaai: Tudumunye shomo amu mme ewueji neyeng'iyeng'areki ene, te nkaraki olduruk omutisho, te nkidaaroto torrono.

English: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink; he shall even be the prophet of this people.
Masaai: Tenelo oltung'ani airo mbaa e nkijape o elejare, ejo, “Kaaliki nanu iyie ilomon le naisho oo sabibu o enaisho napi?” Neidim ninye ataa olalikioroni lele orere!

English: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as the flock in the midst of their fold: they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
Masaai: Esipa kalo nanu aiturrur intae Yakobo, kaiturrur nanu ilo pisiai loo Siraeli kapik nanu ninche te nebo anaa eluaata nabo, anaa ntare te ndaata te nkilepilep olorora loo ltung'ana.

English: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
Masaai: Ore ilo obol elusie, neituruk alo te dukuya ninche, nepuo ninche aaim kishomi, neipang auluo aaim ine. olaiguanani lenye nelo dukuya ninche, Olaitoriani otii endukuya enye.

English: And I said, Hear, I pray you, O heads of Jacob, and ye princes of the house of Israel; Is it not for you to know judgment?
Masaai: Atejo nanu: entoning intae ilukuny e Yakobo o larikok le nkaji e Israel! Aimeishiaakino intae niyiolouu esipata,

English: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who pluck off their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
Masaai: intae ilooiba esupatisho ninyorrinyorro entorroni, intae ilooyieng iltung'ana laainei, nirishushu nkiri enye too loik lenye

English: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them; and they break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
Masaai: intae ilooinos nkiri oo ltung'ana laainei, nenang'aa ilonito lenye aaidie ninche, nigiligili iloik lenye aaitaa ng'iligilat, nigiligil anaa iloik oopiki emoti, netiu anaa nkiri naatii emoti.

English: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, but he will not hear them: he will even hide his face from them at that time, as they have behaved themselves ill in their doings.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aaishiraki Olaitoriani, kake mewaliki ninye ninche; eisudoo ninye enkomom enye te ninche teina rishata, enkaraki naitaa ninche nkiaasin enye torrok.

English: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people err, that bite with their teeth, and cry, Peace; and he that putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani tialo lelo oibonok ooitapong'oo iltung'ana laainei. Lelo ooishir aajo, “Eseriani” ina kata eeta ninche endaa nainos, neitayu olarrabal te ilo lemeeta endaa naisho meinosa.

English: Therefore night shall be unto you, that ye shall not have a vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down over the prophets, and the day shall be dark over them.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, kemutu te ntae nimintokiki aata nduaat nemisimisu te ntae nimintokiki aata nkitumusumusot. Kedoyio enkolong too loibonok, neman emisimisi ninche;

English: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
Masaai: ore lelo aduaak netusulaki, neitukurruni lelo aitumusumusok; kepuo pooki aaiken nkutukie enye, amu metii ewalata naing'uaa Enkai.

English: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of judgment, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, aaiputa engolon, o enkiyang'et o Laitoriani, te sipata o te nkidimata, pee aibalakinye Yakobo enkitapong'oto enye, naibalekinye Israel eng'oki enye.

English: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.
Masaai: Entoning ena, intae ilarikok le nkaji e Israel, intae ooibooyo esipata, nimbelekenyenye enkiguana nasipa.

English: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
Masaai: Ilo oshet Sion to sarge neshet Yerusalem te ntorroni.

English: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money: yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say, Is not the LORD among us? none evil can come upon us.
Masaai: Edung ilarikok lenye enkiguana te ropare, neiteng'enisho ilapolosak lenye te laakinoto, neibonisho iloibonok lenye too ropiyiani; eji neigarakino ake sii Olaitoriani ejo, “Aimetii Olaitoriani atua iyiook? Meetae entorroni nalotu shumata iyiook.”

English: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of the forest.
Masaai: Ore naa te nkaraki iyie kepuoi aatur Sion anaa enkurma; keaku Yerusalem osototi le nkidaata; neaku ilo doinyo le nkaji entim.

English: But in the last days it shall come to pass, that the mountain of the house of the LORD shall be established in the top of the mountains, and it shall be exalted above the hills; and people shall flow unto it.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i e siadi, ore ilo doinyo le nkaji o Laitoriani neitasheyieki anaa oldoinyo ooado aisul neilepieki aaitulusoo too ldoinyo nepuo iltung'ana kumok ine.

English: And many nations shall come, and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for the law shall go forth of Zion, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa kepuonu iloshon kumok nejo: “Wootu mailepa aapuo oldoinyo lo Laitoriani, maape enkaji e Nkai e Yakobo; pee etum ninye aiteng'ena iyiook nkoitoi enyena, nikipuo iyiook too rrekiei lenyena.” Amu Sion epukunye enkitanapata, neing'uaa ororei lo Laitoriani Yerusalem.

English: And he shall judge among many people, and rebuke strong nations afar off; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up a sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
Masaai: Keiguanare ninye iloreren kumok nedung'oki enkiguana iloshon oogol oo lakua; neidong ninche ilalema lenye aaitaa ntokitin naaturishoreki neitaa iremeta enye ntokitin naasilieki enkurma; nemeitoki olosho adumaki olosho olalem, nemeigil aekata aaitamok ate olarrabal.

English: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and none shall make them afraid: for the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken it.
Masaai: Kake kelo ake pooki tung'ani oton tiabori osabibu lenye o tiabori olng'aboli lenye, nemeetae oloiture ninche; amu enkutuk o Laitoriani loo lororani nairoro.

English: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god, and we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
Masaai: Amu epuoito iltung'ana pooki, oltung'ani ake te nkarna e Nkai enye. Kake eikipuo iyiook te nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai ang ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, and I will gather her that is driven out, and her that I have afflicted;
Masaai: Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kalo nanu aiturrur ilmaiman, naiturrur lelo apa ootarayioki o lelo apa laaisilisilo.

English: And I will make her that halted a remnant, and her that was cast far off a strong nation: and the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from henceforth, even for ever.
Masaai: Ore lelo maiman naitaa nanu olpisiai oleku; ore lelo apa ooiturrayioki, naitaa olorere ogol; nelo Olaitoriani aitore ninche to ldoinyo le Sion; ebaiki ena kata o ntarasi.

English: And thou, O tower of the flock, the strong hold of the daughter of Zion, unto thee shall it come, even the first dominion; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa ore iyie lo talet loo ntare, na doinyo e ntito e Sion iyie kenya epukunye, iyie epukunye enkitoria nalotu, ina kitoria e ntito e Yerusalem.

English: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa pee inchir abuaku? Aimetii olaiguanani atua iyie keidaa olautaroni lino, eji metaa kitijing'a emion anaa enkitok nasaisai?

English: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail: for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon; there shalt thou be delivered; there the LORD shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
Masaai: Temerregelayu ning'or aishir, na tito e Sion, anaa enkitok nasaisai; amu ore taata naa ilo aing'uaa ena anasa, nilo abik teina kop naisiaja ilo iyie Babilon. Naa teine kipuoi aakordu, teine kilo Olaitoriani alaku iyie aitung'uaa nkaik oo lmang'ati linono.

English: Now also many nations are gathered against thee, that say, Let her be defiled, and let our eye look upon Zion.
Masaai: Eiturrurrote taata iloshon kumok, pee kigilunore iyie ejo, “Nchoo ninye eisarkionieki, naa nchoo nkonyek ang eing'or Sion.”

English: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, neither understand they his counsel: for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor.
Masaai: Kake meyiolo ninche ndamunot o Laitoriani, mening'u ninche nkitobirat enyena nchere eiturrurro ninche anaa suut to lkurroto oidong'ishoreki.

English: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion: for I will make thine horn iron, and I will make thy hoofs brass: and thou shalt beat in pieces many people: and I will consecrate their gain unto the LORD, and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
Masaai: Tudumunye ndong'o ninche na tito e Sion, amu kaitaa nanu emowuo ino esekenkei, naitaa iloisotok linono osuyai; iar iyie iloreren kumok aitaa mpurdat, ore imasaa enye nintisinyaki Olaitoriani. Ore enkarsisisho enye nintisinyaki Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

English: Now gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops: he hath laid siege against us: they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
Masaai: Eitamanaki intae esuntai, etamanaki iyiook aamuat to ngudi etoosho ninche eseder o Laitoriani le Israel.

English: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie Betlehem Efrata, iyie ora kiti too lgilat le Yuda, iyie epukunye ilo olotu te nkaraki nanu, ilo olo aaku Olaitoriani loo Siraeli; ilo laa ore enkiterunoto enye naa e niopa, ebaiki nkolong'i e moitie.

English: Therefore will he give them up, until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth: then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, kepalaa ninye ninche ometabau ina kata, pee eiu ina nanuta ninye, netum taa ilalashera lenyena pooki aatorrinyokinoto iltung'ana le Israel.

English: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; and they shall abide: for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Naa keitashe ninye aitoti nkerra enyena te ngolon o Laitoriani te nkitoo e nkarna o Laitoriani Enkai enye.

English: And this man shall be the peace, when the Assyrian shall come into our land: and when he shall tread in our palaces, then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, and eight principal men.
Masaai: Naa kelo ninye ayau eseriani. Pee kitum iyiook aatudumakinoto ninye ilchekuti oopishana, o ltung'ana isiet kituaak loo ltung'ana.

English: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof: thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, and when he treadeth within our borders.
Masaai: Kepuo ninche aaitore enkop e Asiria to lalem, neitore enkop e Nimrod te nchutati o lalem; naa kepuo ninche aakordu iyiook too le Siria, tenepuonu ninche enkop ang nepuonu aaituny ilpolosien lang.

English: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the LORD, as the showers upon the grass, that tarrieth not for man, nor waiteth for the sons of men.
Masaai: Netum taa ilo pisiai le Yakobo atijing'a empolos oo ltung'ana kumok, anaa enkoiliolio naing'uaa Olaitoriani, anaa enchan nashaiki nkujit nemeanyu iltung'ana anaa nkera e tung'ana.

English: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest, as a young lion among the flocks of sheep: who, if he go through, both treadeth down, and teareth in pieces, and none can deliver.
Masaai: Naa kelo ilo pisiai le Yakobo aaku tenebo iloshon, nejing empolos oo ltung'ana kumok netiu anaa olng'atuny otii atua ing'uesi e ntim, anaa olkuoo lo lng'atuny oti atua eluaata oo nkerra, naa teneimaa atua nenang'ie enkop; neitaa ndung'udung'ot, nemeetae olokordu.

English: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries, and all thine enemies shall be cut off.
Masaai: Kepuoi aailepie enkaina ino te shumata ilmang'ati linono, ore ilmang'ati linono pooki naa keiwuang'ieki.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, and I will destroy thy chariots:
Masaai: Ore kenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaiwuang'ie nanu mbartan inyi aitung'uaa intae, naidaikie ngarrin inyi oo mbartan;

English: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
Masaai: naa kaiwuang'ie nanu nena anas e nkop inyi nauroo lelo sempewueti linyi pooki;

English: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:
Masaai: naiwuang'ie nanu esakutore te nkop inyi, niming'iligili aekata aata esakutore.

English: Thy graven images also will I cut off, and thy standing images out of the midst of thee; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands.
Masaai: Naa kaiwuang'ie nanu nkitanyaanyukot inyi, naiwuang'ie ng'apeta inyi te ntae, niming'iligili intae aairrugokino esiaai oo nkaik inyi;

English: And I will pluck up thy groves out of the midst of thee: so will I destroy thy cities.
Masaai: naa kadotu nanu Asherim inyi aiwuang'ie tiatua intae naidaikie nkanas inyi.

English: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
Masaai: Naa ore te ngoro o te ngoro napi naitalaku elap, te lelo oshon leitu ening'isho.

English: Hear ye now what the LORD saith; Arise, contend thou before the mountains, and let the hills hear thy voice.
Masaai: Toning'o enajo Olaitoriani: “Tudumunye, tasaisho te dukuya ildoinyo, nincho ndoinyo metoning'o oltoilo lino.

English: Hear ye, O mountains, the LORD'S controversy, and ye strong foundations of the earth: for the LORD hath a controversy with his people, and he will plead with Israel.
Masaai: Entoning intae lo doinyo, enchankar o Laitoriani, o ntae ilkitamanyunot oo bikoo te nkop; amu eeta Olaitoriani enchankar o ltung'ana lenyena, naa kelo ninye aitang'or Israel.

English: O my people, what have I done unto thee? and wherein have I wearied thee? testify against me.
Masaai: “Lo tung'ana laainei, kaa nanu aitaasa intae? Kainyoo nanu aitanaurie intae? Entawalikiaki nanu!

English: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
Masaai: Amu ayawua nanu intae ailepunye te nkop e Misiri, nalaku intae te nkaji e sinkaisho; nairriu nanu Musa meshomo te dukuya intae, o Aron, o Miriam.

English: O my people, remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal; that ye may know the righteousness of the LORD.
Masaai: Lo tung'ana laainei, entadamu ina apa naipirua Balak olaiguanani le Moab, o ina natawalikia Balaam olayioni le Boer ninye, o ina nataasa ebaiki Shitim o metabaiki Gilgal pee itumutumu aatayiolo iasat naaitajeusho o Laitoriani.

English: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
Masaai: “Kainyoo nanu ayau dukuya Olaitoriani, nalotu airrugo te dukuya Enkai natii shumata aisul? Kalotu nanu dukuya ninye oo lasarri oopejori too lasho lo lari obo?

English: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, or with ten thousands of rivers of oil? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
Masaai: Keitiship Olaitoriani ilmeregeshi enkalifu nabo, o lkejek enkalifu nabo le ilata? Kaishooyo nanu olkikau lai te nkaraki nkitarruorrot aainei, ilo ng'anayioi lo sesen lai te nkaraki eng'oki o ltau lai?”

English: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
Masaai: Kintoduaa ninye iyie lo tung'ani embae sidai o ina nayieu Olaitoriani te iyie, pee ias esipata ninyorru isupati nilo te mborron tenebo Enkai ino?

English: The LORD'S voice crieth unto the city, and the man of wisdom shall see thy name: hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
Masaai: Eishiraki oltoilo lo Laitoriani enkanasa naa eng'eno nagut teneurei enkarna enye: “Toning'o lo osho o eumata ena anasa.

English: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?
Masaai: Ilchumat le nkarrueisho tiatua enkaji o larruoni, o ina temet natii elejare naata oldeket?

English: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
Masaai: Kapalaa nanu oltung'ani oata entemet naineneng'ishoreki e lejare o lbene otii isoito ooineneng'ishoreki le lejare?

English: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, and the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
Masaai: Eeta ilkarsisi linono olarrabal; neiro lelo le nkop ino elejare, neeta ilng'ejepa lenye elejare.

English: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee, in making thee desolate because of thy sins.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, aaiterua nanu aosh iyie, naitomijoon te nkaraki ing'ok inono.

English: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; and thy casting down shall be in the midst of thee; and thou shalt take hold, but shalt not deliver; and that which thou deliverest will I give up to the sword.
Masaai: Ilo iyie adaa nimiraposho naa kelo olameyu atii iwuejitin inono e atua. Inteng'el iyie kake mintagol, ore ina ninteng'el nemeaku. Ore ina nisudoo aiteng'el naisho nanu metara olalem.

English: Thou shalt sow, but thou shalt not reap; thou shalt tread the olives, but thou shalt not anoint thee with oil; and sweet wine, but shalt not drink wine.
Masaai: “Iun iyie kake misampu; iramat iyie iloirienito kake mielare eilata enye; Irony iyie isabibu, kake miok enaisho enye.

English: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab, and ye walk in their counsels; that I should make thee a desolation, and the inhabitants thereof an hissing: therefore ye shall bear the reproach of my people.
Masaai: Amu imbung'a iyie nkikoot e Omri, o siaaitin pooki e nkaji e Ahab; nimbung'a iyie nkikoot enye, pee aatum nanu aitaa iyie olmuaate naitaa emanyisho ino entoki naimakini; neaku inap iyie esukeny oo ltung'ana.”

English: Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: there is no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit.
Masaai: Woi nanu, amu atotiwuo anaa enkata naiturrurri ilng'anayio le nkata e nkirowuaj anaa enkata naisampuni isabibu, eitu eleku toki naidimi aainosa meetae nkimarrimarrat oo lng'abolo le nkiterata ooshipakino oltau lai.

English: The good man is perished out of the earth: and there is none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net.
Masaai: Eidaayie oltung'ani le Nkai te nkop, nemeetae oltung'ani supat too ltung'ana eirragita pooki aanyu embukoroto o sarge, nerresh ake pooki tung'ani olalashe to rreshet.

English: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.
Masaai: Etii nkaik enye shumata entorroni, pee eas te nkarriyiano, eikilikuanu olkitok o ladung'oni le nkiguana eropare, ore oltung'ani kitok neimaiki ntorrok naang'uar oltau lenye; nena ninche eas tenebo.

English: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.
Masaai: Ore ilo supat aisul te ninche netiu anaa enkaitubului, ore ilo lenye oji olasipani netiu anaa olpaashe loo lkiku. Etabawua enkata oo larripok lenye le nkitamioto enye. Etataana taata olmilo lenye.

English: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.
Masaai: Mipik osiligi lino ole latia, niming'arakino olchore; torripo enkutuk ino teina nikilej etii olgoo lino;

English: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies are the men of his own house.
Masaai: amu keitaas olayioni menye mbaa e sulare, nedumakino entito ng'otonye, nedumakino entito nayamaki enkaputani; ore ilmang'ati lo ltung'ani naa lelo le nkaji enye makewan.

English: Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu, kaing'or Olaitoriani naanyu nanu Enkai e njeunoto ai; kaaning nanu Enkai ai.

English: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
Masaai: Mikishipakino nanu, lo mang'atinta lai; tenabatata nanu naa kadumunye; tenaton nanu te naimin, neaku Olaitoriani ewang'an te nkaraki nanu.

English: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, and I shall behold his righteousness.
Masaai: Kang'iri nanu engoro o Laitoriani, amu ataasa nanu eng'oki tialo ninye, ometaba anaa naamitu ninye, naadung'oki ninye nanu enkiguana. Kaayau ninye nanu enetii ewang'an naa kaing'or nanu enkordunoto enye.

English: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
Masaai: Nedol taa olmang'atinta lai, neiput enkurruna teina naatiaaka nanu, “Koree Olaitoriani Enkai ino?” Neing'or nkonyek aainei ninye; naa kepuoi aaitunyoki ninye enkop, anaa esarng'ab e nkoitoi.

English: In the day that thy walls are to be built, in that day shall the decree be far removed.
Masaai: Enkolong nashetieki isunta inono! Ore teina olong naa kepuoi aaitalala ilpolosien aaponaa.

English: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and from the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa kepuonu enitii eing'uaa Asiria o metabaiki Misiri, o ebaiki enaiposha ometabaiki enaiposha, o ebaiki oldoinyo ometabaiki oldoinyo.

English: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.
Masaai: Kake keaku enkop mijooni te lelo oo manya, te nkaraki ilng'anayio loo nkiaasin enye.

English: Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily in the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
Masaai: Taramata iltung'ana linono te ng'udi ino, ina luaata e njung'ore ino. Oobik maate tiatua entim, te mpolos e nkurma eina kop. Nchoo ninche edaa te Bashan o te Gilead, anaa apa too nkolong'i e apa.

English: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things.
Masaai: Anaa apa too napa olong'i nitupukunye te Misiri, kaitodol nanu ninche mbaa e nking'asia.

English: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay their hand upon their mouth, their ears shall be deaf.
Masaai: Kedol iloshon nekurru te nkidimata enye pooki; neibung ninche nkutukie enye too nkaik, neming'anu nkiyiaa enye;

English: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee.
Masaai: nemej ninche enterit anaa olasurai, anaa nkeenta e nkop; nepuonu ninche eikirikira eing'uaa isempewueti lenye; neibelekenyakino ninche to lkirutoto Olaitoriani Enkai ang, neureishoyu ninche te nkaraki iyie.

English: Who is a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth in mercy.
Masaai: Kaa Ai natiu anaa iyie, apalaki ntorrok, negiroo nkitarruorrot te nkaraki olpisiai le njung'ore enye? Meibung ninye engoro enye ntarasi amu keshipakino ninye enyorrata nauno.

English: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
Masaai: Keig'il ninye atum olng'ur te nkaraki iyiook, neitunyoo ninye ntorrok ang too nkejek enyena. Inturraa iyie ing'ok ang, anang'aki enguton e naiposha.

English: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
Masaai: Intodolu iyie esupatisho o enkisiligata te Yakobo, nintodolu enyorrata nauno te Abraham anaa apa eninosa olmumai too loo papa ebaiki nkolong'i e moitie.

English: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oipirta Ninawi. Embuku ena oo nduaat e Nahum le Elkosh.

English: God is jealous, and the LORD revengeth; the LORD revengeth, and is furious; the LORD will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani naa Enkai o lom neitalaku elap, eitalaku Olaitoriani elap neeta engoro napi, eitalaku Olaitoriani elap too lmang'ati lenyena, negorokino ilmang'ati lenyena.

English: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: the LORD hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
Masaai: Mesioki Olaitoriani agoro neeta enkidimata kitok, nemeeta kata nemeitalaku Olaitoriani entorroni. Ore enkoitoi enye naa olkutati o siwuo, ore nkatampo naa enterit oo nkejek enyena.

English: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
Masaai: Eisikong ninye enaiposha neitoi, eitoi ninye ilkejek pooki neitoi Bashan o Karmel, ore ina kishiaa e sikar e Lebanon netoyu.

English: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
Masaai: Eikirikira ildoinyo te dukuya ninye, neshola ndoinyo; neirrag enkop eitomijoonoki te dukuya ninye, o enkop o pooki namanya atua ninye.

English: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
Masaai: Kaing'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya engoro enye? Kaing'ae oidim ating'iria enkirowuaj e ngoro enye? Etubukuoki engoro enye napi anaa enkima, netebelaki ndapidapo aaidapash te dukuya ninye.

English: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
Masaai: Aisupat Olaitoriani osempewuet ninye te nkolong e nyamali; eyiolo ninye lelo oosaru ninye.

English: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
Masaai: Kake to loirrag le nkare nadooyo eishie ninye tukul ilmang'ati lenyena, nemir ilmang'ati lenyena amiraki enaimin.

English: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie irreshie Olaitoriani? Eikindaikie ninye iyie, meetae hoo obo ogilunore ninye katitin are.

English: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
Masaai: Kemuti ninche anaa orrarrati loo lkiku, anaa olkujita otoyio.

English: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.
Masaai: Keitu elotu obo oing'uaa atua iyie, oitobira entorroni tiaalo Olaitoriani, oiguanu mbaa torrok?

English: Thus saith the LORD: Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
Masaai: Nji ejo Olaitoriani, “Ore hoo negol ninche naa kumok keiwuang'ieki ninche neitarasari. Ore hoo naaisilisilo nanu iyie maaigil nanu aisilisil iyie.

English: For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.
Masaai: Kagil taata nanu enchata enye oo murto aiwuang'ie te iyie nadung inkeenta nikiteenieki iyie aidapash.”

English: And the LORD hath given a commandment concerning thee, that no more of thy name be sown: out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make thy grave; for thou art vile.
Masaai: Eishorua Olaitoriani enkitanapata nikimpirta iyie: “Meigili aekata aadumu enkarna ino; kaiwuang'ie nanu te nkaji oo nkaitin inono, kitanyaanyukoto e nkai naguetuno oina nasholuno. Kaitobir nanu enkurare ino amu ira iyie arruoni.”

English: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
Masaai: Ng'ura roruat enyena too ldoinyo, eilo oyau ilomon supati, ilo olimu eseriani! Imbung'a isiruai linono iyie, Yuda, intabai ilmuma linono, amu mikingil aekata olarruoni agilunore iyie, eiwuang'ieki ninye tukul.

English: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.
Masaai: Kiewuo olainyalani arasaki iyie, intagolo iltimito, ing'ura enkoitoi terretena empolos ino; enturrurro engolon inyi pooki.

English: For the LORD hath turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
Masaai: (Amu kerrinyu Olaitoriani enkishiaa e nkitoo e Yakobo. Anaa enkishiaa e nkitoo e Israel, amu eibung'a apa ilainyalak ninche, neinyal ilngosil lenye.)

English: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
Masaai: Ore ina long'o oo ltung'ana lenye magil naa kenyokie, neishopito isikarini lenye nkilani pilei neiwuang ngarrin enyena oo mbartan anaa olng'ejep le nkima, teneipotuni olarrabal neitureisho lelo ookuetu.

English: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
Masaai: Neruko ngarrin oo mbartan too nkoitoi e nkanasa nepuo idia alo neitu ena alo too wuejitin neetumoreki e nkanasa. neiwuang'u te nkimerlel anaa sitimani, neimerlel anaa nkiwuang'at e nchan.

English: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
Masaai: Neipotuni lelo kituaak, nerrorro ninche epuoito, nekuetiki ninche esuntai, neidipaki aaitolok iloketa.

English: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
Masaai: Etaboloki nkishomin o lkeju neiputa enkaji e nkitoo enkuretisho.
