English: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
Masaai: Ore ina aiguanani enye, etooruoki ilkilani, etanapaki aaya, neishirita nkaisiayak enyena neishir anaa nturkuluoni, neoshiosh ilgooitie lenye.

English: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
Masaai: Eikununo Ninawi anaa olchorro oruko enkare enye neishir ninche aajo, “Ntasho! ntasho!” kake meetae olorrinyunye.

English: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
Masaai: Ewaita enkosholai ewaita sahabu, meeta olchumati eneiting'ie anaa karsisisho e pooki toki e tipat.

English: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
Masaai: Olmuate! emijoonisho o enkidaata! Etalepori iltauja, neikirikira nkejek, eiputa olkirutoto mpolosi enye pooki, neipusita nkomomi enye pooki!

English: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion's whelp, and none made them afraid?
Masaai: Koree enkapune oo lng'atunyo ina apune oo lkuoo loo lng'atunyo ine neyau olng'atuny engues natara, ine netii nkiyioitin enyena nemeeta entoki naitanyamal?

English: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
Masaai: Eibung'a olng'atuny engues nainos neyiataa ina ngues neyaki ilkuoo lenyena, negor ina meinosa iliponga enyena. Neiput enkapune enye inguesi naatara ninye neiput isanagi lenyena nkiri.

English: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour thy young lions: and I will cut off thy prey from the earth, and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaagilunore nanu iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kapejoo ngarrin inono oo mbartan te mpuruo nemut olalem lelo ng'atunyo linono ooti; Kaiwuang'ie nanu nena ng'uesi inono te nkop. Nemeigili aekata aaning oltoilo loo lkiliku linono.

English: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departeth not;
Masaai: Woi ena anasa o sarge ebore elejare o enkisima nemeiting aekata eyararoto enye.

English: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
Masaai: Entoning endarata e oshoto enkeene, o ltoilo loo nkejek oo ngarrin enkuetata oo mbartan o elototo oo ngarrin oo mbartan!

English: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
Masaai: Ekuetu ilakedok loo mbartan, eimerlel ilalema neiwuang'u iremeta, olorora olo aye osototi loo mpopoki. Meeta eneiting'ie mpopoki enye nerrorro ninche te nena popoki enye!

English: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ina kibor oo nkonyek eina mulayoi, ina kitok nasakutisho naata esulare, ina nakaldaa iloshon enkibor enye oo nkonyek, nekaldaa iloreren too ntaleng'o enyena.

English: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts; and I will discover thy skirts upon thy face, and I will shew the nations thy nakedness, and the kingdoms thy shame.
Masaai: Ng'ura kaagilunore nanu iyie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kadumu nanu olkila lino lirrotianita apik enkomom ino, naisho nanu iloshon metoduaa emasipaisho ino, nedol nkitoriat enkurruna ino.

English: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
Masaai: Kaairriwaki nanu iyie olduruk naaitaas iyie mbaa e sulare, naitaa entoki torrono naing'asiakinoi.

English: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for thee?
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki liking'or iyie, nikilam ejo, “Etumute Ninawi; kaing'ae naishiraki ninye? Kaji nanu atumie iltung'ana ooitagol ninye?”

English: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
Masaai: Ira supat alang Tebes, apa natotona te mbata Nail, neman enkare ninye, anaa enaiposha esuntai olpaashe lenye?

English: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
Masaai: Etiopia apa engolon enye o Misiri, nemeeta engolon enye enkiting'oto; Ilaretok lenyena apa ile Libia.

English: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia etarayioki ninye neyae, eshomo ninye eyararoto, ore nkera enyena neitaaki ndung'udung'ot, te nkiterunoto e pooki oitoi kitok, amu etooshoki enkukuo oo ltung'ana lenyena ooyanyiti, ore iltung'ana lenyena pooki kituaak eteenaki too lpisia.

English: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
Masaai: Ilo sii iyie amera, ilo sii iyie aisudori, nilo aing'oru, enkisudoroto tenkaraki ilmang'ati.

English: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
Masaai: Ore isempewueti linono pooki, neikununo anaa ilng'abolo, ooto ilng'anayio le dukuya teneipiripiri, nerrarrunye, aadoiki enkutuk eilo oinos.

English: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women: the gates of thy land shall be set wide open unto thine enemies: the fire shall devour thy bars.
Masaai: Ng'ura ilturrurri linyi ajo nkituaak naatii empolos inyi. Ore nkishomin e nkop inyi naa kebolo aang'a too lmang'ati linyi, einosa enkima isekenke inyi.

English: Draw thee waters for the siege, fortify thy strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
Masaai: Entooku enkare enterreten emanata inyi, entagolo isempewueti linyi, enchom atua enterit entunyo esarng'ab, embung'a entobira enkitobirata oo lmatofali.

English: There shall the fire devour thee; the sword shall cut thee off, it shall eat thee up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
Masaai: Eikilo enkima ainos teine, eikilo olalem ashurtu eikimut iyie anaa olmaati. Entoponai ate anaa olmaati, entoponari anaa ntargeet!

English: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoileth, and fleeth away.
Masaai: Itoponaiyie ilamirak linono aitulusoo too lakir le shumata. Eisalaash olmaati inaipuko nepuo.

English: Thy crowned are as the locusts, and thy captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun ariseth they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
Masaai: Eikununo ilkituaak linono anaa ntargeeti neikununo ilaigerok linono pooki anaa emus o lmaati, neirragita too lpaashen te nkolong e nkirobi ore ake pee eilepu enkolong, nelaari aapuo; meetae oltung'ani oyiolo enetii ninche.

English: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: thy nobles shall dwell in the dust: thy people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathereth them.
Masaai: Eirura ilairritak linono, lo aiguanani le Asiria; neimug iltung'ana linono kituaak. Eidapashate iltung'ana linono too ldoinyo, nemeetae oloiturrurr ninche.

English: There is no healing of thy bruise; thy wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee: for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
Masaai: Meetae embaata too lbaa linono, aitorrono oleng olbae lino. Ore lelo pooki ooning mbaa inono, neosh nkaik tenkaraki iyie. Amu kaing'ae eitu ebaiki ina torroni ino nemeish aekata?

English: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
Masaai: Olkilikuai lo Laitoriani ele otoduaa oloiboni le Nkai oji Habakuki.

English: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani ke nkata nabaa aishir nanu te nkaraki eretoto, nimining iyie? Aishir nanu ajo olarrabal! neitu iyie kintajeu?

English: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
Masaai: Kainyoo iyie pee kincho nanu matoduaa ntorrok, naing'or enyamali? Etii enkidaata o larrabal dukuya nanu; naatudumakine enyamali o enchankar.

English: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
Masaai: Etaa enkitanapata pesho nemeas aekata esipata esiaai amu etamuata iltorrok aaman lelo loo sipat, neaku keibelekenyi esipata.

English: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
Masaai: Ing'ura atua iloshon, pee idol; ning'asia nimputukuny. Amu aasita nanu esiaai too nkolong'i inyi, nimindimidimi intae aairuko tenelikini intae.

English: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
Masaai: Amu eng'ura, kailepunye nanu Ilkaldayo ilo osho odua neisosion, nelo aibulu enkop pooki, nepuonu aaya imanyishoritin neme nkunenye.

English: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
Masaai: Iltung'ana ooitureisho ninche; ore isipat enye o nkiguanat enye naa ninche maate epukunye.

English: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
Masaai: Eneneng mbartan enye aalang ilowuarak kerin, nepi aalang isuyian le nteipa; ore lakedok lenye loo mbartan nenyok oleng to lwuasa. Ee enelakua eing'uaa lakedok lenye loo mbartan, nepuo tiai anaa olkurragos oipirri alo ainos eng'ues.

English: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
Masaai: Eetuo pooki te nkaraki olarrabal; ore olkirutoto te nkaraki ninche nelo te dukuya ninche. Neiturrur ninche iyarunot anaa osinyai.

English: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya ilaiguanak nesukenyisho ninche. Ore ilaitoriak neiguranie ninche. Ekueniyie ninche pooki sempewuet, amu kerup ninche enterit neya ine.

English: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche neor, enkop epuo anaa olkutati, aapuo ninche eeta entioto, kulo tung'ana ooitaa engolon enye enkai enye.

English: Art thou not from everlasting, O LORD my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O LORD, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
Masaai: Aimira iyie oloo ntarasi, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ai lo Sinyati lai? Mikiye iyiook, Olaitoriani itegelua iyie ninche aitaa iladung'ok le nkiguana; ore iyie na dapidapoi, nintasheyie ninche pee eitameisho.

English: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
Masaai: Iyie oloata nkonyek sidain nemeidim aaing'ura entorroni nemeidim aaing'ura enkarruoisho, kainyoo iyie pee ing'or iltung'ana lemeisiligayu, nintirring'a iyie eijoo ilarruok, lelo supati aalang ninche.

English: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
Masaai: Amu ntotiu iyie iltung'ana anaa sinkir le naiposha, anaa nena tokitin naaikurtutari nemeeta oloitore.

English: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
Masaai: Eyau ninye ninche pooki to ltarge, neyietu ninche pooki to rreshet neiturrur ninche to rreshet lenye sapuk; netum taa atishipayu neitokoos.

English: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eitayio ninye olasar te nkaraki orreshet lenye, nepej enkorropil te nkaraki orreshet lenye sapuk; amu te nkaraki ninche pee eishu ninye te sikar, nepir endaa enye.

English: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
Masaai: Keitayu ninye lelo ootii orreshet lenye, near ninye iloshon metuata nemeing'urrie ntarasi?

English: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
Masaai: Kaitashe nanu te rishata ai arripisho. Naton nanu to ltalet orripishoreki naing'orisho nanu, pee adol ina naajoki ninye nanu, o ina nawalu nanu tialo enking'unyung'uny ai.

English: And the LORD answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
Masaai: Naawaliki nanu Olaitoriani ejo, “Ngero ena duaata; ngero mbalie too soito dapashi, pee etum akueta ilo oisum.

English: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
Masaai: Amu eton ake eanyu enduaata enkata enye; kesieku ninye alotu erishata enye - nemelejisho ninye. Tenelioo ninye aa yietut, taanyu ninye, esipa kelotu ninye, meimutie ninye.

English: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore ilo leme sidai oltau lenye, nemetum puan, kake ore ilo asipani eishu te nkirukoto.”

English: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
Masaai: Ore ake sii enkalejani enaisho; mebikoo ilo tung'ani oitokoos nelala olorok lenye eba anaa enemeneng'a; etiu anaa keeya meraposho ae kata. Eiturrurroki ninye kewan iloshon pooki neiturrur iloreren pooki anaa iltung'ana lenyena makewan.

English: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
Masaai: Aimeibelekenyakino kulo pooki ninye, neitalaku elap, nesukeny ninye ejo, “Woi ninye ilo osot ntokitin neme nkunenyena - ae te nkata nabaa ilo asotoki kewan elaakinoto oo silen.”

English: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee, and awake that shall vex thee, and thou shalt be for booties unto them?
Masaai: Aimedumunye lelo lintalak isilen nabo kata, ore lelo oodumunye nikinkirikirie iyie? Nilo iyie aaku oloyaruno te ninche.

English: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil thee; because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nimbung'a araya iloshon kumok, eikimbung iyie aaraya ilo pisiai oleku loo ltung'ana te nkaraki osarge loo ltung'ana o larrabal te nkop, too nkanas e lelo pooki oomanya atua.

English: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo otum tumoto e ntorroni te nkaji enye, ilo oilepunye orreshet lenye, pee medoiki entorroni!

English: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
Masaai: Mpiraka iyie enkaji ino enkurruna, ore teine niwuang'ie iloreren kumok ninturrayie enkishui ino makewan.

English: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
Masaai: Amu keishir osoit te suntai, neng'amaa iloom.

English: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo oshetu enkang to sarge, neitayu enkanasa te ntorroni.

English: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
Masaai: Ng'ura mme Olaitoriani loo lororani eing'uaa, nchere pee easisho iltung'ana te nkaraki enkima, neitanaur ilosho ate te mpesho?

English: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.
Masaai: Amu keyookini aaiput enkop, te ng'eno e nkitoo o Laitoriani, anaa enaibulua enkare enaiposha.

English: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, that puttest thy bottle to him, and makest him drunken also, that thou mayest look on their nakedness!
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo oitook ile latia enye, enkikompe e ngoro enye, neitemer ninche, pee etum atishila enkurruna enye!

English: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD'S right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.
Masaai: Eikipuoi iyie aaishopoki esulare te rishata e nkitoo, tookisho iyie, niesiesari. Ore enkikompe natii enkaina e tatene o Laitoriani, naa keitamanuni aayau enitii, nelotu enkurruna shumata ekitoo ino!

English: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover thee, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men's blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
Masaai: Ore olarrabal oitayioki te Lebanon naa eikimisie iyie; Ore enkidaata oo ng'uesi naa eikirutie iyie, te nkaraki ilo sarge loo ltung'ana o larrabal te nkop, nejing'aki nkanas o lelo pooki oomanya atua.

English: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?
Masaai: Kaa dupoto eeta enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai, teneidip olaitobirani lenye aitobiru, enkitanyaanyukoto e nkai e sekenkei, olaiteng'enani le lejare? Amu keisilig oloasisho ina kitobirunoto naitobirua ninye, nemeitobiru ninye nkitanyaanyukot nemeiro!

English: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
Masaai: Woi ninye ilo ojoki enchata, inyo; nejoki osoit lemeiro, tudumunye! Ng'ura etumuraki ninye te sahabu o te nkosholai, kake metii enkiyang'et tukul atua ninye.

English: But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
Masaai: Kake etii Olaitoriani atua enkaji enye Sinyati; nchoo enkop pooki eitirring'a te dukuya ninye.

English: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
Masaai: Enkomono ena e Habakuki oloiboni le Nkai, te risioroto e Shiginot.

English: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
Masaai: Iyie Olaitoriani, atoning'o nanu mbaa inono, ore esiaai ino, iyie Olaitoriani kaure nanu. Ore te mpolos oo larin intang'ejuko iyie ninye ore te mpolos oo larin nchoo metayiolouni; ore te ngoro, tadamu olng'ur.

English: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
Masaai: Na Ai wou te Teman, nelotu ilo obo Sinyati eing'uaa oldoinyo le Paran. Neiput enkitoo shumata, neiput enkop e nkisisa enye.

English: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
Masaai: Ore enkimerlel enye netiu anaa ewang'an, neng'orunye ewang'an te nkaina enye; ore teine neimulumul engolon enye.

English: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
Masaai: Nelo olbuket te dukuya ninye, nesuju olmeitai ninye etaaniki.

English: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
Masaai: Eitashe ninye netem endapasho e nkop; neing'orisho ninye neiposhiposh iloreren, neitokini aaidapash lelo doinyo ootii atua. Ore lelo doinyo loo ntarasi neidapasha ore nena doinyo oo ntarasi nedoyio aaimis. Ore nkoitoi enyena naa iniapa moitie.

English: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
Masaai: Atoduaa nanu ilng'oborri le Kushan tiatua emion ore iltung'ana le Midian neikirikira.

English: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
Masaai: Itagorokine apa iyie ilkejek iyie Olaitoriani? Itagorokine iyie ilkejek anaa ke naiposha igilunore. Pee itakedo iyie mbartan inono, nena bartan inono e nkishuroto.

English: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.
Masaai: Itabolo iyie emootian ino, nipik mbaa empito e nkawuo. Imperra iyie enkop apik ilkejek.

English: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
Masaai: Kidol iyie ildoinyo neikirikira, nenang'ari nkariak aaruko, ore enguton neitayu oltoilo lenye, nedumu nkaik enyena ailepie.

English: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
Masaai: Neitashe enkolong o lapa too wuejitin enye, te wang'an e nkimerlel oo mbaa inono epuo etangoroyioki, o te nkimerlel e ina remet ino naimerlel.

English: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
Masaai: Ntunyoyie iyie aimaa enkop te mpushuna, ntunyoyie iyie iloshon te ngoro.

English: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed; thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
Masaai: Ishomo iyie te nkaraki enjeunoto oo ltung'ana linono, te nkaraki enjeunoto eilo litubukoko eilata aput. Itupurda iyie endukuya eilo arruoni, irragie ninye meishopo ebaiki enkupes o metabaiki emurt.

English: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
Masaai: Itangoro iyie too mbaa inono endukuya oo lmurran lenyena, ilo oewuo anaa olkutati aidapash iyiook, neng'ida ninye anaa oloidaikie olaisinani te nkisudoroto.

English: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.
Masaai: Ntunyo iyie enaiposha too mbartan inono, ine wueji oo nkariak kumok.

English: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
Masaai: Atoning'o nanu naikirikira, naaonyo enkutuk, teilo toilo latoning'o. Neng'ueyu iloik laainei tiatua nanu, neikirikira nkejek aainei. Kaitirring'a nanu aanyu enkolong e nyamali, pee elotu shumata lelo oorasaki iyiook.

English: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
Masaai: Ore hoo nemeitapuku olng'aboli, nemeiu osabibu ilng'anayio, neimin ilng'anayio lo loirien, nemeiu nkurman endaa, neiwuang'ieki aaishie iluaat oo ntare nemeitoki aatii nchoo nkang'itie.

English: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
Masaai: Ore ake eyia, kashipakino nanu Olaitoriani, kang'idakino nanu Enkai e njeunoto ai.

English: The LORD God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds' feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
Masaai: Enkai, Olaitoriani ninye engolon ai; neitotiu nkejek aainei anaa ine ntarakuet te neneng'i, naaidimie ninye maimai nchumat oo ldoinyo.

English: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
Masaai: Ele rorei lo Laitoriani oewuo enetii Sefania olayioni le Kushi, olayioni le Gedalia, olayioni le Amaria, olayioni le Hesekia, too nkolongi e Yosia ilo ayioni le Amon, olaiguanani le Yuda.

English: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Kajutu nanu tukul pooki toki aiwuang'ie ti oriong enkop,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, saith the LORD.
Masaai: “Kajutu nanu tung'ani o eng'ues; kajutu nanu aiwuang'ie ntaritik o loing'ang'e o sinkir le naiposha. Kanang'aa nanu aiturraa lelo torrok; kaishie nanu iltung'ana, aiwuang'ie ti oriong e nkop,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: I will also stretch out mine hand upon Judah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
Masaai: “Kaitorioo nanu enkaina ai aarare Yuda, naarare sii lelo pooki oomanya Yerusalem; naa kaishie nanu aiwuang'ie tene wueji ilo pisiai le Baal o ina arna e lelo apolosak ooserem nkitanyaanyukot;

English: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by the LORD, and that swear by Malcham;
Masaai: lelo ooirrugokino too nchumat oo nkajijik olorora le shumata; lelo ooirrugo neinosie Olaitoriani olmumai neitoki ake sii aainos olmumai te nkarna e nkai naji Milkom;

English: And them that are turned back from the LORD; and those that have not sought the LORD, nor enquired for him.
Masaai: lelo ooibelekenyate ootapala esujata o Laitoriani, lelo lemeing'oru Olaitoriani anaa eikilikuanishore ninye.”

English: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
Masaai: Ntirring'ayu te dukuya olaitoriani Enkai! Amu etataana enkolong o Laitoriani; eitobira Olaitoriani olasar neitisinya ilomon lenyena.

English: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD'S sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king's children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
Masaai: Naa ore te ina olong o lasar lo Laitoriani, “Kaitame nanu lelo kituaak o lelo ayiok lo laiguanani o lelo pooki ooishopote too nkilani oo loreren.

English: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters' houses with violence and deceit.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong naitame nanu lelo pooki ooseremisho anaa iltung'ana lemeyiolo Enkai lelo oopurrisho near iltung'ana metuata pee etumi aaiputa nkajijik o lkitok lenye iyarunot.”

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong,” Olaitoriani ojo, “naa kening'i olkiyioi teina Kishomi o Sinkirri, eyietunoto e nkishirata naing'uaa Endung'oto e Are, esulunoto kitok too ldoinyo.

English: Howl, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
Masaai: Enteyietu enchira intae iloomanya Motar! Amu meekure eetae ilbiasharani; ore lelo pooki ooipim enkosholai nedungori aaiwuangie.

English: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong naa kajur nanu Yerusalem too ltaai, naa kaitame nanu lelo tung'ana ooishiligate te okoto e naisho enye, oojo too ltauja lenye, ‘Meas Olaitoriani esidai nemeas entorrono.’

English: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
Masaai: Kerayae imasaa enye, neitomijooni nkajijik enye. Ore hoo neshet ninche nkajijik memany ninche; ore hoo neun ninche nkurman oo sabibu meok ninche enaisho enye.”

English: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
Masaai: Ore ina olong kitok o Laitoriani netinyikua, etinyikua naa kesieku; kedua oltoilo le ina olong o Laitoriani, keyietu aishir oltung'ani magilani te ine.

English: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
Masaai: Enkolong e ngoro napi ina olong, enkolong o sina o emion, enkolong e nkidaata o emutata, enkolong e naimin o enkimuntut, enkolong oo nkatampo o enaimin nagut,

English: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
Masaai: enkolong e oshoto e ntarumpeta o lkiyioi lo larrabal, egilunore nena anas naasheta isunta negilunore iltaleta lo larrabal.

English: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
Masaai: Kayau nanu osina shumata iltung'ana, o metaa kepuo ninche anaa ilmodook, enkaraki nataasa ninche eng'oki ti alo Olaitoriani; keibukori osarge lenye anaa enterit, neikoni inkiri oo seseni lenye anaa emodioi.

English: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD'S wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
Masaai: Mekordu ninche enkosholai enye aashu sahabu enye te ina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani. Ore ti atua enkima e ina goro enye o lom, keinosi aamut enkop pooki; amu te nkiting'oto nara ee enkiting'oto naluamisho keiting'ie ninye asioki lelo pooki oomanya enkop.

English: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
Masaai: Wootu enturrurroto entuumata ele osho lemedol enkurruna,

English: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, before the day of the LORD'S anger come upon you.
Masaai: eton eitu kirewi anaa nguetat, eton eitu elotu shumata iyie engoro o Laitoriani napi, eton eitu elotu shumata iyie ina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani.

English: Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD'S anger.
Masaai: Eng'oru Olaitoriani, intae pooki oobor lena kop, lelo ooas nkitanapat enyena; eng'oru esupatisho, eng'oru emborron; eidimayu neisudori intae te ina olong e ngoro o Laitoriani.

English: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
Masaai: Amu keing'uari Gasa, naa keaku Ashkelon mijooni; nearari iltung'ana le Ashdod enaipirie enkolong, nedotuni Ekron.

English: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of the LORD is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
Masaai: Woi intae iloomanya olomanaa le naiposha, intae ilo osho le Kereti! Eipirare intae ororei lo Laitoriani, iyie Kanaan na kop oo Lfilisti; kaidurukie nanu intae o metaa meleku ninye obo.

English: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
Masaai: Ore iyie, Loomanaa le naiposha, naa iaku endaata oo ntare, ilokerin loo lchekuti o muatat oo luaat oo ntare.

English: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the LORD their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
Masaai: Keaku olomanaa le naiposha ewueji e ilo pisiai otelekua le nkaji e Yuda, naa ninye eirritishore ninche, ore ti atua nkajijik e Askelon neirragie ninche teipa. Amu ore Olaitoriani Enkai enye kedamu ninche neitopok ninche.

English: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
Masaai: “Atoning'o nanu imorot e Moab o esukeny oo le Amon, ina natusukenya ninche iltung'ana laainei nerup ate ti alo enkop enye.

English: Therefore as I live, saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
Masaai: Neaku ore anaa enaishu nanu,” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, Enkai e Israel, “Ketiu Moab anaa Sodom, ore ile Amon netiu anaa Gomora, enkop oo suut o ngumot e munyan, neaku olmuate ntarasi. Ore ilo pisiai otelekua loo ltung'ana laainei neraya ninche, ore ilo pisiai otelekua lo losho lai neya ninche.”

English: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ena eitalakuni te ninche to lwuasa lenye, enkaraki natusukenya nerup ate ti alo iltung'ana lo Laitoriani loo lororani.

English: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
Masaai: Kegilunore Olaitoriani ninche; keishie ninye nkaitin pooki e nkop, neaku ninye eirrugokinoi, pooki ake te wueji enye, nkuapi pooki oo loreren.

English: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
Masaai: Ore sii intae, ile Etiopia, keari intae to lalem lai.

English: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
Masaai: Naa keitorioo ninye enkaina enye aarare moikuape, neidaikie Asiria; neitaa ninye Ninawi olmuate, ewueji netoyio anaa olpurkel.

English: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
Masaai: Keirrag iluaat te mpolos enye, ing'uesi pooki e ong'ata; ore olmotonyi o enjolis nemany ilpaashen lenyena; neishiraki emotonyi oo nkiyiaa ilusien enye neru olkurruk tembata e kishomi enye ore nkeek oo lpaashen lenye neitomijooni.

English: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passeth by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
Masaai: Enkanasa naturupa kewan ena apa natobiko te seriani, apa najo ninye makewan, “Nanu ake nemeetae ae.” Ketaa ninye olmuate anaa nyoo, ewueji neirragie ing'uesi e ntim! Ore pooki ng'ae ogiroo ninye neiputukuny nenunuk enkaina enye aikirikirie.

English: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
Masaai: Woi ninye ina natogolong'ua neinosieki olminong ina anasa naitorogonyisho!

English: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the LORD; she drew not near to her God.
Masaai: Mening ninye hoo likae toilo, meng'amaa ninye ererioroto enkikoo. Meisilig ninye Olaitoriani, menyikaki ninye Enkai enye.

English: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
Masaai: Ore lelo kituaak lenyena ootii atua naa ilng'atunyo ooipur; ore ilarishak lenyena naa isuyian le nteipa lelo lemeing'uaa toki o mekenyu.

English: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
Masaai: Pesho iloibonok lenyena, iltung'ana lemeeta enkirukoto; ore ilapolosak lenyena neisarkionie ina sinyati, neinyala ninche nkitanapat.

English: The just LORD is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning doth he bring his judgment to light, he faileth not; but the unjust knoweth no shame.
Masaai: Ore Olaitoriani otii atua ninye naa kaasipani, meitarruoo ninye; ore anaake tadekenya neitodolu ninye esupatisho e nkiguana enye, ore anaake ekenyu melai; kake ore lelo torrok nemeyiolo aatodol enkurruna.

English: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passeth by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
Masaai: “Aiwuang'ie nanu iloshon; eidaa nkanas enye; aitomijoono nanu nkoitoi enye e nkanasa o metaa melo hoo ng'ae aim ninche; eitaaki nkanas enye ilmuateni, nemetii oltung'ani, nemetii olomanya.

English: I said, Surely thou wilt fear me, thou wilt receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
Masaai: Atejo nanu, ‘Esipa kaaureyu ninye, keng'amu ninye enkikoo; merikino ninye nena pooki naitanapa nanu ninye.’ Kake etoponari ninche aayieu neitarruoo nkiasin enye.”

English: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
Masaai: “Metaa entaanyuaki nanu,” Olaitoriani ojo, “te ina olong nadumunye nanu ara olchakeni. Amu ore enatudung'o nanu naa pee aiturrur nkuapi, pee aum nkitoriat, nabukoki ninche engoro ai, ina kirowuaj pooki e ngoro ai; amu te ina kima e ngoro o lom lai emuti enkop pooki.

English: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the LORD, to serve him with one consent.
Masaai: “Ee, te ina kata kenya aibelekeny nanu nkirorot oo ltung'ana, aitaa nkirorot sidain, pee etum ninche pooki aaipoto enkarna o Laitoriani, neisiaai ninye to ltau obo.

English: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
Masaai: Ebaiki te idia alo ilkejek le Etiopia aayaki nanu lelo laasai nkishorot, ina tito oo looidapashari laainei.

English: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, wherein thou hast transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride, and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
Masaai: “Ore akenya te ina olong nimikintukurruni iyie te nkaraki nena kiasin nikitogolong'aka nanu; amu kaiwuang'ie nanu te ina kata te mpolos inyi lelo linyi oowuasa oorup ate, nimintoki iyie awuasa te ilo doinyo lai sinyati.

English: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
Masaai: Amu kaleku nanu ti atua iyie iltung'ana supati oobor. Naa keing'oru ninche enkisudoroto te nkarna o Laitoriani,

English: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
Masaai: ore lelo ootelekuaki te Israel; nemeas ninche entorroni nemeiro elejare, nemetumi too nkutukie enye olng'ejep le lejare. Amu kedaa ninche neirrag nemeetae oloiture ninche.”

English: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
Masaai: Tabuaku taranya, na tito e Sion; tabuaku Israel! Ting'idayu nishipayu to ltau lino pooki, na tito e Yerusalem!

English: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy: the king of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.
Masaai: Eiwuang'ie Olaitoriani nena dungokinot e nkiguana ti alo iyie, etaarayie ninye ilmang'ati linono. Ilo aiguanani le Israel, Olaitoriani ninye otii empolos inyi; mingil ae kata iyie aureyu entorroni.

English: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack.
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina olong naa keji te Yerusalem: “Miureshoyu iyie Sion; mincho nkaik inono elepori.

English: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
Masaai: Olaitoriani, Enkai ino, otii empolos ino, olmurrani oishoru enkishuroto; eikishipakino ninye iyie te nchipai, eikintang'ejuk ninye iyie te nyorrata enye kepik ninye shumata iyie embuakunoto o sinkolio

English: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of thee, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
Masaai: anaa te nkolong o sirua. “Kaiwuang'ie nanu osina te iyie, pee mitum iyie esulare te ninye.

English: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore akenya te ina kata naa Kagilunore nanu lelo likintorogony pooki. Naa kaitajeu nanu lelo maiman naiturrurru lelo ooidapashari, naibelekeny nanu enkurruna enye metaa errepet neyiolouni ti atua enkop pooki.

English: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ore akenya te ina kata naa kayau nanu intae ang, te ina kata naiturrur nanu intae te nebo; ee, kaisho nanu metayiolouni intae nerrepi ti atua iloreren pooki le nkop, te ina kata nalo nanu arrinyoki karsisisho inyi dukuya nkonyek inyi,” Olaitoriani ojo.

English: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lari li are le Darias ilo aiguanani, to lapa le ile, te nkolong e dukuya o lapa, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, alotu enetii Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, olbalusui le Yuda, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok.

English: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD'S house should be built.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ejo kulo tung'ana inchere eton eitu ebau enkata pee eigili aashet enkaji o Laitoriani.”

English: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Neitoki ororei lo Laitoriani alotu eimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, ejo,

English: Is it time for you, O ye, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?
Masaai: “Kenkata naishiaakino nitonini intae ti atua nena ajijik inyi naaikodo too mbaoi, eton etii ena aji enkidaaroto.

English: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
Masaai: Ore naa nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani; Entadamu eninkunariri intae.

English: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
Masaai: Ituunishote oleng, nisampumpu nkuti; idaa intae, kake miraposhosho; niokishosho, kake miishushu ae kata enkure; ninchopishopo ate, kake meetae oloirouaju; naa ore ilo ong'amu olmushaara, neng'amu olmushaara nepik embene naudo.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Entadamu eninkunariri intae.

English: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Elepa enchom ildoinyo niyauu ilkeek lishetietie ena aji, pee atum atishipakinoyu natum sii ataliooyu te nkitoo ai, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of mine house that is waste, and ye run every man unto his own house.
Masaai: Isiligutua intae nkumok, naa ng'ura, etaa kuti; ore pee iyauu intae ang, nakutaa nanu. Aainyo? Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo. Te nkaraki ena aji ai nairragita te nkidaaroto amijoonu, intanyamaluoluo maate oltung'ani ake te nkaji enye makewan.

English: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, eibooyie keper natii shumata intae enkoiliolio, ore enkop neibooyo ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
Masaai: Naipotuo nanu olameyu meeu shumata enkop o ldoinyo, meeu shumata nkurman, o sabibu, o eilata, te nena pooki naabulu te nkop, too ltung'ana o nkishu, o too siaaitin enye pooki.”

English: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him, and the people did fear before the LORD.
Masaai: Neiruk Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok, te nebo nena lekunot oo ltung'ana ilo pisiai pooki loo ltung'ana ororei lo Laitoriani Enkai enye, o rorei le Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai anaa enairriwayie Olaitoriani Enkai enye ninye; neureishoyu iltung'ana te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: Then spake Haggai the LORD'S messenger in the LORD'S message unto the people, saying, I am with you, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Neitoki Hagai, ilo kilikuai lo Laitoriani, airorie iltung'ana to lkilikuai lo Laitoriani, ejo, “Atii nanu te nebo intae, ejo Olaitoriani.”

English: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,
Masaai: Neputu Olaitoriani enkiyang'et e Serubabel le Shealtiel, ilo balusui le Yuda, o enkiyang'et e Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok, o enkiyang'et e lelo lekunot pooki loo ltung'ana; nepuonu ninche aas esiaai e ina aji o Laitoriani loo lororani Enkai enye,

English: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
Masaai: te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa, to lapa le ile.

English: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by the prophet Haggai, saying,
Masaai: Ore ti atua olari li are le nkitoria e Darias ilo aiguanani, to lapa li opishana, te nkolong e tikitam o obo o lapa, eeuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai

English: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
Masaai: ejo, “Irorie taata Serubabel olayioni le Shealtiel ilo balusui le Yuda, o Yoshua olayioni le Yehosadak, ilo apolosani kitok, o nena lekunot pooki oo ltung'ana, nijoki,

English: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
Masaai: ‘Kaing'ae etung'uayioki te intae, apa ootodua ena aji te nkishiaa e nkitoo enye? Aidolitata taata intae etiu aja? Ae me pesho taata too nkonyek inyi?

English: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia entagoluoto, iyie Serubabel, Olaitoriani ojo, ntagoluoyu, iyie Yoshua, olayioni le Yehosadak, ele olapolosani kitok, intagoluoyu intae lo tung'ana pooki lena kop, Olaitoriani ojo; entaasisho, amu atii nanu te nebo intae; Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo,

English: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt, so my spirit remaineth among you: fear ye not.
Masaai: te risioroto oo nkisiligat apa naisiligie intae ipukuku te Misiri. Etii Enkiyang'et ai te nebo intae; emiureisho.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
Masaai: Amu nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ake sii, te nkiti rishata, naa kaikirikirie keper o enkop o enaiposha o enkop natoyio,

English: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: naikirikirie nanu iloreren pooki, ore ilchumat lenye neyauni ene neiput enkaji e Nkai esikar, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Enaai enkosholai naa enaai sahabu, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith the LORD of hosts: and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore ina sikar nayooki alotu ena aji naa keaku kitok alang enapa, e dukuya Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa ti atua ene wueji aaishooyo nanu dupoto, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.’ ”

English: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan, o lapa li oudo to lari li are le nkitoria e Darias, eeuo ororei lo Laitoriani aimu Hagai ilo oiboni le Nkai, ejo,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
Masaai: “Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Nkilikuana lelo apolosak metolimu ewalata ena kikilikuanata,

English: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
Masaai: ‘Amaa te nenap oltung'ani enkiring'o nasinya to lcholoi lo lkila lenye, neiseyie te ilo sholoi lenye emukate, aashu enkurma, aashu enaisho oo sabibu, aashu eilata, aashu ae pukunoto e ndaa, keaku ina sinyati?’ ” Newal ilapolosak aajo, “A-a.”

English: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
Masaai: Neitoki Hagai ajo, “Amaa oltung'ani oiduruk te nkaraki olmeneng'ani te neiseyie nabo e kuna, keiduruku?” Newal ilapolosak, aajo “Keaku keiduruk.”

English: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
Masaai: Neitoki Hagai ajo, “Neijia sii etiu kulo tung'ana, o kulo oshon ootii dukuya nanu ejo Olaitoriani; naa neijia sii etiu pooki siaai oo nkaik enye; ore ina kishorunoto naishoru ninche teine keiduruk naa.

English: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD:
Masaai: “Asai naa taata intae, entadamu ina nayooki aaku ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo. Amaa eton eitu eiteleikini osoit olikae soit ti atua enkaji o Laitoriani, kainyoo intae inotito?

English: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
Masaai: Tenelotu oltung'ani orupati loo mboreitin tikitam, tomon ake etum; te nelotu oltung'ani olchumati le naisho oo sabibu, ajo aaoku mboreitin onom, tikitam ake naatii.

English: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Atoosho nanu intae o lng'anayio pooki le nkinyinyiret inyi to lasai o te mpurukunyi o te nchan oo soito, neitu ake kishukokinono nanu, ejo Olaitoriani.

English: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD'S temple was laid, consider it.
Masaai: Entadamu ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo, ebaiki enkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa li oudo. Ebaiki ina olong apa natipikaki olkitamanyunoto le nkaji o Laitoriani, entadamu:

English: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, hath not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.
Masaai: Amaa keton etii olantererai hoo obo atua empeche, keton eiu osabibu, o lng'aboli, o kukumanka, o loirien hoo toki? Ore ebaiki ena olong neito idia alo, kaamayian nanu iyie.”

English: And again the word of the LORD came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
Masaai: Enyaaka ororei lo Laitoriani alotu enetii Hagai enkata e are te nkolong e tikitam o ong'uan o lapa, ejo,

English: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
Masaai: “Irorie Serubabel, olbalusui le Yuda, tiaki, etaa enkiti kata pee aikirikirie nanu keper o enkop,

English: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
Masaai: naibelekeny ilorikan le nkitoo loo nkitoriat; etaa enkiti kata pee ainyal nanu engolon oo nkitoriat oo loreren, naibelekeny nena garrin oo mbartan o lakedok lenye; ore mbartan o lelo ookedito nedoyio, o ltung'ani ake to lalem lo likae.

English: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet: for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa kaaya nanu iyie, Serubabel osinka lai, olayioni le Shealtiel, ejo Olaitoriani naaitotiu nanu iyie anaa olgisoi oata olmishire; amu aategelua nanu iyie, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.”

English: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Ore to lapa le isiet tiatua olari liare le nkitoria e Darias, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria olayioni le Berekia olayioni le Ido, ilo oiboni le Nkai ejoki,

English: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
Masaai: “Etagore apa Olaitoriani oleng tenkaraki iloo papaai linyi.

English: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye unto me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Metaa tiaaki ninche, ena ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Entushukunye enatii, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa kashukokino sii nanu intae, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Turn ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Emitiuu anaa enaikununo apa iloo papaai linyi, laa ore apa lelo oibonok le Nkai le dukuya eishirakita ninche ejoki, Nji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, Entushukunye entung'uai nkoitoi inyi torrok o nkiasin inyi torrok! Kake eitu ninche aaning arashu aashilaa nanu, ejo Olaitoriani.

English: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
Masaai: Amaa taata iloo papaai linyi koree taata ninche? O loibonok, kebikoo sii ninche intarasi?

English: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the LORD of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
Masaai: Kake ore irorei laainei o nkiguanat aainei, nena apa naitanapa isinkan laainei lelo oibonok le Nkai, keitu ninche egiroo iloo papaai linyi? Metaa eirridutua ninche ejo, Anaa enatumuta Olaitoriani loo lororani pee eitame iyiook tenkaraki inkoitoi ang o siaaitin ang, neaku ina eitaasa ninye iyiook.”

English: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e tikitam oo ng'uan o lapa le tomon oobo, olapa le Shebat to lari liare le nkitoria olaiguanani Darias, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria olayioni le Berekia olayioni le Ido ilo oiboni le Nkai; nejo Sakaria,

English: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
Masaai: “Atoduaa tena kewarie naa ing'ura, oltung'ani okedito embarta nanyokie! Negira duoo aitashe tiatua ilkeek oo nyori ooji mihadasi tiatua oyerata ore tesiadi ninye netii kulie bartan pilei, o naanyokie o naaibor.

English: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew thee what these be.
Masaai: Naitoki ajo, ‘Ainyoo doi kuna Olaitoriani lai?’ Ore ilo malaika laairorie nanu, aatiaaka, ‘Ekaaitodol aitayiolo ajo ainyoo ninche.’

English: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
Masaai: Metaa etawala ilo tung'ani oitashe tiatua lelo keek ooji mihadasi ajoki ‘ore kuna naa inaairriwua Olaitoriani meetu aaman enkop pooki.

English: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani otii atua ilkeek ooji mihadasi ejo, ‘Kishomo aarrip enkop pooki, naa ng'ura, nikitoduaa aajo eeta enkop pooki enkiyeng'iyengata!’

English: Then the angel of the LORD answered and said, O LORD of hosts, how long wilt thou not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
Masaai: “Neitoki ilo malaika lo Laitoriani ajoki, iyie Olaitoriani loo lororani, kerishata nabaa miata olng'ur tiatua Yerusalem o nkanas e Yuda, nena nitagorokine tiatua kulo arin intomoni naapishana?

English: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
Masaai: Newaliki Olaitoriani ilo malaika laairorie too rorei supati le nkitagoloto e oshoke.”

English: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry thou, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
Masaai: Metaa ore ilo malaika laairorie aatiaaka, Inchira tabuaku tejo, ena ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Aata olom sapuk tenkaraki Yerusalem o Sion.

English: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
Masaai: Natagorokine oleng lelo oshon oodol ate anaa keserian. Amu ore apa pee agorokino ninche penyo, neitaa lelo oshon osina sapuk te ninche.

English: Therefore thus saith the LORD; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
Masaai: Metaa, ina ejo Olaitoriani, atushukokine Yerusalem to lng'ur sapuk; naa ekesheti enkaji ai tiatua ninye, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani nepiki enkopito e nkitorioroto shumata Yerusalem.

English: Cry yet, saying, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nyaaki inchira tejo, nji Olaitoriani loo lororani; Ekeitoki inkanas aainei aatum dupoto nalus, naa keitoki Olaitoriani aitagol Sion oshoke neigil agelu Yerusalem.

English: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
Masaai: Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aingorisho, naa ng'ura, imowuarak ong'uan!

English: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
Masaai: Najoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna?” Naawaliki ninye ajoki, “Ore kuna mowuarak naa ninche naaidapasha Yuda, o Israel o Yerusalem.”

English: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.
Masaai: Naaitoki Olaitoriani aitodol ilkunono oong'uan.

English: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Judah to scatter it.
Masaai: Najo nanu, “Kainyoo doi epuonu kulo aas?” Newal ajo, “Ore kuna naa imowuarak naa ninche naaidapasha Yuda metaa meetae oltung'ani oraposhu endukuya; neetuo kuna aaiture ninche, pee etum aitadou abori imowuarak oo loshon, lelo ootudumutua imowuarak enye aaitame ina kop e Yuda aaidapash ninye.”

English: I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
Masaai: Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, oltung'ani oota enkopito natemishoreki te nkaina enye.

English: Then said I, Whither goest thou? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo, “Kaji doi iloito iyie?” Naajoki ninye nanu, “Kalo atem Yerusalem, pee ayiolou eneba endapasho enye o eneba enkadori enye.”

English: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore ilo malaika laairorie eewuo dukuya, nelotu likae malaika dukuya anang'are ninye, nejoki ninye,

English: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
Masaai: “Kueta, shomo tiaaki lido barnoti, ekeaku Yerusalem enkanasa nemeeta isunta tenkaraki enkumoi o lorere o nkishu naatii atua.

English: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
Masaai: Amu kaaku nanu te ninye esuntai enkima namanita ninye, Olaitoriani ojo, naaku sii enkisisa tiatua ninye!”

English: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Oi! Oi! Enkuet entung'uai ina kop e kopikop, Olaitoriani ojo; amu aidapasha intae aitalamaa anaa enatii inkaloli ong'uan enkijape e keper, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.
Masaai: Oi! Isikaki Sion, iyie ilo oboitare ina tito e Babilon.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, te nkitoo enye laa ninye makewan laairriwaka lelo oreren ooidaikie intae, amu ore ilo likiseyie iyie, naa enerok enkong'u ai eiseyie:

English: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
Masaai: Ing'ura, ekaikirikirie enkaina ai te shumata ninche, naa keidaikie ninche lelo ooisiaai ninche. Nitum taa atayiolo nchere Olaitoriani loo lororani ninye lairriwua nanu.

English: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Taranya nishipayu, iyie na tito e Sion; Amu ng'ura ajo, kalotu naa kabik tiatua intae, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
Masaai: Naa keibung'are iloreren kumok Olaitoriani teina olong, naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei; naa katon nanu tiatua intae, niyiolouu aajo Olaitoriani loo lororani laairriwua nanu atua intae.

English: And the LORD shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
Masaai: Naa kejung Olaitoriani Yuda anaa erubata enye tiatua ina kop enye sinyati, neitoki ake agelu Yerusalem!

English: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
Masaai: Entigirata, pooki toki naishu te dukuya Olaitoriani; amu etudumunye ninye tiatua ina manyisho enye sinyati.

English: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
Masaai: Naaitoki ninye aitodol nanu Yoshua olapolosani kitok eitashe te dukuya ilo malaika lo Laitoriani, neitashe sii ninye shetani te nkaina e tatene aitangor ninye.

English: And the LORD said unto Satan, The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan; even the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani shetani, “Mikisikong'a iyie Olaitoriani, iyie shetani! Metaa ilo Aitoriani otegelua Yerusalem likisikong iyie! amaa ele aime olchata oishu otawuapuaki te nkima.”

English: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
Masaai: Ore ina kata egira Yoshua aitashe te dukuya ilo Malaika, eishopokoki inkilani naaiduruk naang'u.

English: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika lelo ooitashe te dukuya ninye, “Entayu nena kilani naang'u naaiduruk naaishopito entung'uai ninye.” Nejoki ninye, ninye “Ing'ura, aiwuang'ie ing'ok inono te iyie naa kaaishopoki nanu iyie inkilani sidain.”

English: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of the LORD stood by.
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajo “Enchoo ninche epik aaishopoki enkarasha sidai endukuya enye neishopokini ninye inkilani; ore olmalaika lo Laitoriani neitashe te mbata ninye.

English: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,
Masaai: Neitanap olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yoshua ejoki,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If thou wilt walk in my ways, and if thou wilt keep my charge, then thou shalt also judge my house, and shalt also keep my courts, and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: ‘Tinilo tiatua inkoitoi aainei nimbung enkitanapata ai, neaku iyaku oloitore enkaji ai nintore sii indung'orot aainei, naa kaaisho iyie esipata nijing'ie tenebo kulo ooitashe tene.

English: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou, and thy fellows that sit before thee: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.
Masaai: Toning'o naa taata, iyie Yoshua olapolosani kitok iyie tenebo ilchorueta linono ootoni te dukuya iyie, amu iltung'ana supati ninche ooitodolu imbaa naapuonu. Ng'ura, ekayaki osinka lai ilo oji Olng'osila.

English: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ore shumata eilo soit laitasheyie te dukuya Yoshua, enchumata osoit obo oota imatuan naapishana, naguetaki osirata, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kaitayu ina kitarruorroto ena kop te nkolong nabo.

English: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
Masaai: Ore teina olong ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, naa keitoomon pooki te intae olelatia enye meetu aatoni te ntonata o sabibu lenye o te ntonata olng'aboli lenye.”

English: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
Masaai: Ore ilo malaika laairorie nanu, enyaaka arrinyunye, naainyoyie nanu, anaa oltung'ani otuputuoki too njo.

English: And said unto me, What seest thou? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ainyoo idolita?” iyie. Najo nanu, “Adolita naa ng'ura, enkitashet oltaa naitobiruno pooki te sahabu, neeta olbakuli otii shumata ninye, o ltaai oopishana te nchumata ninye, o ltampii oopishana otii lelo taai otii shumata e ina kitashet.

English: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
Masaai: Netii embata iloirienito aare, obo te nkalo e tatene ilo bakuli netii olikae kedienye enye.”

English: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
Masaai: Naajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna, olkitok lai?”

English: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
Masaai: Ina pee aawaliki nanu ilo malaika laairorie ejo, “Aimiyiolo doi ajo ainyoo kuna?” Najo, “A'a, olkitok lai.”

English: Then he answered and spake unto me, saying, This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying, Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ele naa ororei lo Laitoriani oirriwakaki Serubabel: Ime te nkidimata, neme te ngolon, kake te Nkiyang'et ai Sinyati, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.
Masaai: Koree iyie, iyie lo doinyo sapuk? Ore te dukuya Serubabel naa iyaku enkisiashata; naa keyau ninye dukuya ilo soit le shumata ebuakitae aajo, ‘Empiris, Empiris te ninye!’ ”

English: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ore ake sii eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enatii aajoki,

English: The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.
Masaai: “Inkaik e Serubabel naaitasheyie olkitamanyunoto lena aji; naa inkaik enyena ake sii naaidip ninye. Ina pee iyiolouu aajo aairriwua nanu Olaitoriani loo lororani enitii.

English: For who hath despised the day of small things? for they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven; they are the eyes of the LORD, which run to and fro through the whole earth.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ng'ae otemenayie ina olong oo ntokitin kutiti naa keshipa, naa kedol ina temet te nkaina e Serubabel. Ore kuna naapishana naa nena onyek o Laitoriani, nena naapuo tiatua enkop pooki.

English: Then answered I, and said unto him, What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?
Masaai: Naitoki nanu ajoki ninye, “Ainyoo eutu kulo oirienito aare ootii enkaina e tatene o enkaina e kedienye tene netii enkitashet oltaa?”

English: And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?
Masaai: Naitoki ajoki ninye eniare, “Ainyoo eutu kulo ng'osil pokira lo loirien, lelo ootii embata lelo goso ooitobiruno te sahabu oobukunyeki ina ilata aaitayu?”

English: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Aimiyiolo ajo ainyoo kulo?” Najo, “A'a olkitok lai.”

English: Then said he, These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the LORD of the whole earth.
Masaai: Ina pee ejo, “Ore kulo naa lelo aare ootubukoki eilata aaput ooitashe te mbata Olaitoriani laa olopeny enkop pooki.”

English: Then I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and behold a flying roll.
Masaai: Naitoki ake araposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, ng'ura olpiyayati le mbuku olo to loing'ang'e!

English: And he said unto me, What seest thou? And I answered, I see a flying roll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ainyoo idolita?” Nawal ajo, “Adolita olpiyayati le mbuku nalo to loing'ang'e; naa ore enkadori enye naa intemat enkaina tikitam ore endapasho naa intemat e nkaina tomon.”

English: Then said he unto me, This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth: for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki ninye nanu, “Ore ena naa oldeket olo oriong enkop pooki, amu ore ake ninye pooki opurrisho naa kedung'ori aaiwuang'ie ebaiki ena kata nelo dukuya te risioroto eina purrorre, anaa pooki ng'ae onya olmumai te lejare naa kedung'ori aaiwuang'ie te risioroto ele mumai.

English: I will bring it forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name: and it shall remain in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.
Masaai: Ekairriwaa nanu meshomo dukuya, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, naa kejing enkaji o lapurroni, nejing sii enkaji e ilo onya olmumai te lejare te enkarna ai; naa kebik te nkaji enye anya ninye, enya imbaoi tenebo isoito.”

English: Then the angel that talked with me went forth, and said unto me, Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.
Masaai: Ina pee elotu dukuya ilo malaika laairorie nanu naajoki, “Taraposhu inkonyek inono nidol ena toki nalotu?”

English: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
Masaai: Najo, “Ainyoo doi?” Nejo ninye, “Ore ena naa enkikapu, neitodolu ena kikapu ing'ok enkop pooki.”

English: And, behold, there was lifted up a talent of lead: and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etaboloki ninye aadumu enkikenet enye, netii atua enkitok natonita tiatua enkikapu.

English: And he said, This is wickedness. And he cast it into the midst of the ephah; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Ore ina kitok naa Entorroni eutu.” Nerrumoki ninye atua enkikapu nerrinyoki enkikenet enye aiken enkikapu.

English: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came out two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven.
Masaai: Naraposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, inkituaak are naapuonu dukuya! Etii osiwuo inaipuko enye; neeta inaipuko naatiu anaa inaipuko emotonyi nanyaanyukie entilagos, nedumu aailepie ina kikapu metaa etii erishata enkop o keper.

English: Then said I to the angel that talked with me, Whither do these bear the ephah?
Masaai: Ina pee ajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Kaji doi eyaita ina kikapu?”

English: And he said unto me, To build it an house in the land of Shinar: and it shall be established, and set there upon her own base.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu, “Enkop e Shimor, aa te ine epuo aashetaki ninye enkaji, naa ore pee eidip aitobira, nepik ina kikapu pee ebik teine.”

English: And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
Masaai: Naitoki ake araposhu inkonyek aainei aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, ing'arrin ong'uan oo mbartan naatupukutuo te rishata oo ldoinyo aare, naa ore lelo doinyo naa ildoinyo lo suyai.

English: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
Masaai: Ore engarri e dukuya neeta imbartan naanyokie, ore eniare neeta imbartan naarook,

English: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
Masaai: ore ene uni neeta imbartan naaibor, ore eniong'uan neeta imbartan pusi naata iltipot.

English: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord?
Masaai: Ina pee ajoki ilo malaika laairorie nanu, “Ainyoo doi kuna, olkitok lai?”

English: And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.
Masaai: Naawaliki nanu olmalaika ajoki, “Ore kuna naa inaapuo ilkutat oong'uan le nkijape e keper, eidipa aaitayu ate te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop pooki.

English: The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.
Masaai: Ore ngarrin oo imbartan naarook, naa enkop e moikuape epuo, ore ngarrin oo mbartan naaibor naa enkop oloontoluo epuo teneidip kunda aashom, ore ngarrin oo mbartan pusi naata iltipot naa enkop e kopikop epuo.”

English: And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku nena bartan naagol, neenyiyenyu eyieu nepuo aarrip enkop. Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Enchom, entorrip enkop.” Metaa eshomo aarip enkop.

English: Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.
Masaai: Ina pee aaishiraki ninye nanu ajoki, “Ng'ura ore nena naapuo ina kop e moikuape neitoborro Enkiyang'et ai te nkop e moikuape.”

English: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enatii ejo:

English: Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, which are come from Babylon, and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
Masaai: Iwa te lelo oararo, Heldai, o Tobiya, o Yedaia, laa ninche ootabautua eing'uaa Babilon nilo ina olong ake ina aji e Yosia olayioni le Sefania.

English: Then take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest;
Masaai: Iwa te ninche enkosholai o sahabu, nintobiru enkopiyia e nkitoo, nipik ninye endukuya e Yoshua, olayioni le Yehosadak olapolosani kitok;
