English: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of the LORD:
Masaai: nijoki ninye, inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, “Ng'ura, ore ilo tung'ani oji enkarna enye Olng'osila: naa kebulaa ninye teine netii, naa keshetaki ninye Olaitoriani enkaji e Nkai.

English: Even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
Masaai: Ninye oshetu ina aji o Laitoriani naa keishopokini ninye enkisisa o enkanyit, naa keton aitoreisho to lorika lenye le nkitoria. Naa keaku ketii olapolosani embata o lorika lenye le nkitoo. Nejing olning'o le seriani erishata enye pokira.”

English: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
Masaai: Naa kejing enkopiyia e nkitoo atua enkaji Olaitoriani metaa endamunoto te Heldai o Tobiya o Yedaia o Yosia olayioni le Sefania.

English: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And this shall come to pass, if ye will diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.
Masaai: “Naa ore lelo oo lakua naa kepuonu aaretu aashet ina aji Olaitoriani, naa iyiolouu aajo ilo Aitoriani loo lororani ninye laairriwua nanu enetii. Naa kelotu ina bae abaya tininyorraa katukul aairuk ilo toilo lo Laitoriani Enkai inyi.”

English: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu;
Masaai: Ore to lari liong'uan le nkitoria o olaiguanani Darias, eewuo ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria te nkolong e ong'uan o lapa le naaudo laa ninye eji Kislef.

English: When they had sent unto the house of God Sherezer and Regem-melech, and their men, to pray before the LORD,
Masaai: Ore ina kata eirriwaitie iltung'ana le Betel Sharese o Regemelek oltung'ana lenye pee epuo aomonu omom to Laitoriani.

English: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ilo apolosani le nkaji Olaitoriani loo lororani tenebo iloibonok le Nkai, ena kikilikuanata: “Amaa kaishir napukoo aaomon to lapa le imiet, anaa enataasa too larin kumok ooishari?”

English: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying,
Masaai: Ina pee elotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki:

English: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
Masaai: Tiaaki iltung'ana pooki leina kop tenebo ilapolosak, “Amaa ina kata nipukoo pee iomon, ninchir sii to lapa le imiet, o to liopishana, te kulo arin intomoni naapishana, itupukoyie apa te nkaraki nanu kiomon?

English: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?
Masaai: Amaa ina nidaa, niokishosho aimidaa tenkaraki nkorroki inyi, niokishosho tenkaraki nkorroki inyi?

English: Should ye not hear the words which the LORD hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, when men inhabited the south and the plain?
Masaai: Aeme irorei apa kulo ooiroro Olaitoriani too loibonok le Nkai te dukuya ina kata apa eton egol Yerusalem o nkanas naamanita, nebore iltung'ana atua ninche, atua o neemanita olkerenket le kopikop te nkalo oo ntonat oo ldoinyo lo loontoluo?

English: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani enetii Sakaria ejoki,

English: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying, Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother:
Masaai: “Ena etejo Olaitoriani loo lororani apa: ng'ura oleng metaasi esipata te nkiguana intodolu esupatisho olng'ur tiatua olalashe lino,

English: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
Masaai: mimbooki enkop enkoliai anaa oltung'ani okishi anaa olomoni, midamu intorrok to ltau lino tenkaraki olalashe lino.”

English: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.
Masaai: Kake etanyaita ninche ening, neuno aagolong'u neany ening, nenuk inkiyiaa enye pee mening.

English: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts hath sent in his spirit by the former prophets: therefore came a great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Neitagol iltauja lenye anaa osoit pee mening, ake ina kitanapata o rorei oirriwua Olaitoriani loo lororani te Nkiyang'et enye aimunye lelo oibonok le Nkai le dukuya. Metaa eewuo engoro sapuk naing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Therefore it is come to pass, that as he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the LORD of hosts:
Masaai: “Ore aipotisho nanu nemaaning ninche nanu, ore pee eipotisho sii ninche, nemaning sii nanu ninche” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not. Thus the land was desolate after them, that no man passed through nor returned: for they laid the pleasant land desolate.
Masaai: “Naidapash ninche to siwuo torrono aidapashaki lelo oreren lemeyiolo ninche. Neaku ore ina kop natung'uaitie neaku mijooni metaa meetae oltung'ani ojing arashu opuku, neitaae ina kop sidai naitishipisho e mijooni.”

English: Again the word of the LORD of hosts came to me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; I was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I was jealous for her with great fury.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, ekaata olom sapuk oleng te nkaraki Sion, naata olom sapuk tenkaraki ninye te ngoro sapuk.

English: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani: Kashukokino Sion, naa kalotu amany atua Yerusalem, naa keitokini aaipot Yerusalem aajo enkanasa naisiligayu, oldoinyo lo Laitoriani loo lororani, ilo doinyo sinyati.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; There shall yet old men and old women dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, and every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ilpayiani kituaak o ntasati moruak, ekeitoki aatoni too nkoitoi naalala e Yerusalem, pooki ng'ae eeta entirma te nkaina enye tenkaraki enkitoo.

English: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
Masaai: Naa Ore inkoitoi naalala eina anasa, neiput inkayiok o ntoyie eiguran teine.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days, should it also be marvellous in mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Amaa tenaa embae enking'asia te nduata e lelo lekunot tiatua lelo oreren ootung'uayioki te kuna olong'i, Keaku sii embae enking'asia too nkonyek aainei, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Behold, I will save my people from the east country, and from the west country;
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Ng'ura, kaitajeu iltung'ana laainei te nkalo enkop oloosaen, o te nkalo enkop oloontoluo;

English: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
Masaai: naa kayau ninche metotoni tiatua Yerusalem; naa keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei naaku nanu Enkai enye, te dede o te sipata.”

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets, which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, that the temple might be built.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Enchoo inkaik inyi etum engolon, intae lelo te kuna olong'i ooning'ito kulo rorei oing'uaa enkutuk oo Loibonok le Nkai, eiteru ina olong apa nairragieki olkitamanyunoto le ina aji o Laitoriani loo lororani, nchere pee etumi aateshet enkaji e Nkai.

English: For before these days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the affliction: for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
Masaai: Amu ore apa eng'or nena olong'i, meetae apa oltung'ani oidim aigero oltung'ani arashu eng'ues meitaiki esiaai. Nemeetae sii oltung'ani oserian too lmang'ati lenyena te pooki ng'ae oipang'a arashu olotijing'ua. Amu eibelekanyaka aitaar pooki tung'ani olelatia enye.

English: But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kake ore naa tena kata, meekure aitaas ilekunot le kulo tung'ana anaa enaikuna too nkolong'i naatulusoitie, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo.

English: For the seed shall be prosperous; the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
Masaai: Naa keun ninche nkurman enye te seriani; naa keiu o sabibu ilng'anayio lenyena naa keiu enkop te nkumoi enye naa keishoru keper enkoileelio enye. Naa kaisho kulo lekunot le kulo tung'ana meitaa kuna tokitin pooki inkunenye.

English: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
Masaai: Ore apa anaa enira entoki naimakini aadiaare too loreren, Iyie na aji e Yuda o enkaji e Israel, kaitajeu nanu intae niakuku emanyianata. Emiureisho, kake enchoo egolu nkaik inyi.

English: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; As I thought to punish you, when your fathers provoked me to wrath, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not:
Masaai: Amu inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Anaa enatonyorra apa aitaas intae intorrok aitame ina kata pee aaitagor iloo papaai linyi te ng'oro sapuk, neitu arriny endamunoto ai, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani,

English: So again have I thought in these days to do well unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah: fear ye not.
Masaai: neaku ore te kuna olong'i atipika endamunoto peyie eitaas esidai Yerusalem o enkaji e Yuda; metaa emiureisho.

English: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
Masaai: Kuna imbaa nayieu niasiasa: eroro esipata o likae o to likae, entayu too nkishomin inyi inkiguanat naasipa nintayuyu sii osotua.

English: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath: for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Nimimpiru entorroni to ltau lino tenkaraki olikae. Niminyorru enkinosata olmumai le lejare, amu ore kuna tokitin pooki naa kaiba, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying,
Masaai: Nelotu ororei lo Laitoriani loo lororani enatii aajoki,

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful feasts; therefore love the truth and peace.
Masaai: “Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ore ina enata nintupukoo ate to lapa liong'uan o enata enkitupukoroto nintupukoo ate to lapa le imiet, o ina enata enkitupukoroto o lapa liopishana, o enata nintupukoo ate to lapa le tomon, keaku ninche te nkaji e Yuda irishat e ng'ida o enchipai o sirua lo lkerempe. Metaa entonyor esipata o eseriani.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come people, and the inhabitants of many cities:
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: Ekelotu enkata naaku kepuonu olorere le kulie anas Yerusalem.

English: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go also.
Masaai: Keaku kepuo olorere le ae anasa enkae anasa aajoki, “Emaape nabo kata aaomonu omom to Olaitoriani, niking'oru Olaitoriani loo lororani; aloito nanu!

English: Yea, many people and strong nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to pray before the LORD.
Masaai: Ore iloshon kumok o loreren oogol naa kepuonu aaserem Olaitoriani loo lororani te Yerusalem, neomonu omom to Laitoriani.

English: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations, even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying, We will go with you: for we have heard that God is with you.
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani; ore te nena olong'i, keibung iltung'ana tomon ooing'uaa iloreren le pooki ng'ejep olkila lo Lyahudi, ejoki, ‘Maape tenebo aairiamari, amu kitoning'o aajo etii Enkai tenebo iyie.’ ”

English: The burden of the word of the LORD in the land of Hadrach, and Damascus shall be the rest thereof: when the eyes of man, as of all the tribes of Israel, shall be toward the LORD.
Masaai: Ore ele naa ororei lo Laitoriani ogilunore ina kop e Hadrak, tenebo ina anasa e Dameski. Amu ino Laitoriani inkanas e Aram anaa enatiu iloshon le Israel;

English: And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.
Masaai: neijia sii etiu Hamat natii olpolosie le Hadrak, tenebo Turo o Sidon tenebo enkarriyiano e ng'eno enye.

English: And Tyrus did build herself a strong hold, and heaped up silver as the dust, and fine gold as the mire of the streets.
Masaai: Eteshetaka Turo kewan esuntai nagol, netasoto ninye enkosholai naba anaa enterit, tenebo sahabu naba anaa enterit oo nkoitoi.

English: Behold, the Lord will cast her out, and he will smite her power in the sea; and she shall be devoured with fire.
Masaai: Kake ng'ura, ekeya Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie nena pooki naata ninye, nenang'aki enkarsisisho enye atua enaiposha naa kepejori ninye aamut te nkima.

English: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear; Gaza also shall see it, and be very sorrowful, and Ekron; for her expectation shall be ashamed; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
Masaai: Kedol Ashkelon ina neureishoyu; neijia sii etiu Gasa, nemerregela te mion sapuk, neijia sii etiu Ekron, amu keiting osiligi lenye. Ekeidaikieki olaiguanani le Gasa, nepuoi aaisik aaing'uaa Ashkelon memanya.

English: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
Masaai: Kemany Ashdod iloreren ooshulushula, naa kaiting'ie nanu ilo wuasa le Filistia.

English: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth: but he that remaineth, even he, shall be for our God, and he shall be as a governor in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.
Masaai: Meitoki aekata ninche aanya inkiri naatii osarge arashu kulie daiki naaiturujaki. Ore lelo lekunot naa keaku ile nchoto oo ltung'ana laainei, netiu anaa olgilata tiatua olosho le Yuda, neaku sii Ekron ile nchoto oo ltung'ana laainei anaa enataasa Ilyebusi.

English: And I will encamp about mine house because of the army, because of him that passeth by, and because of him that returneth: and no oppressor shall pass through them any more: for now have I seen with mine eyes.
Masaai: Ekamany nanu enkaji ai arrip, pee metii ololotu nelo; nemetii olaitorogonyani oitoki aitunyoo ninche. Amu ore taata, adolita too nkonyek aainei.

English: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
Masaai: Iltung'ana le Sion! Entabuaku te nchipai sapuk, intae iltung'ana le Yerusalem! Eng'ura, elotu olaiguanani linyi atua intae, elotu eisula etimirishe, nelotu te mborron ekedito enkurrarru e sikiria.

English: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow shall be cut off: and he shall speak peace unto the heathen: and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea, and from river even to the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Ejo Olaitoriani, “Ekaiwuang'ie ing'arrin oo mbartan e njore te Israel; naa kaiwuang'ie imbartan te Yerusalem; naa keinyali aaisho enkawuo olarrabal, naa keitobir olaiguanani lino osotua o iloreren; ore enkitoo enye neiteru te naiposha o metabaiki enaiposha neiteru to lkeju te Frati o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.

English: As for thee also, by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water.
Masaai: Ejo Olaitoriani, Ore sii tialo iyie, “Te nkaraki olning'o lo sotua o iyie, apa otimishiraki to sarge loo lasarri, kalaku nanu iltung'ana linyi ooena nepuku teina gumoto nemetii enkare.

English: Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope: even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee;
Masaai: Entorrinyokinoto isempewueti linyi, intae ilooena oota osiligi. Aibalunye nanu ena olong nchere karrinyoki intae eseriani.

English: When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.
Masaai: Atoriwuo nanu Yuda aitaa enkawuo ai. Naitotiu Efraim anaa mbaa enyena. Naa kaasishore ilewa le Sion anaa olalem, pee earare ilayiok loo Lyunani.

English: And the LORD shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning: and the LORD GOD shall blow the trumpet, and shall go with whirlwinds of the south.
Masaai: Ekeliooyu Olaitoriani te shumata iltung'ana lenyena; naa kengoroo ninye imbaa enyena anaa enkiwuang'ata, Olaitoriani Enkai ninye oosh entarumpeta; naa kelotu te ngolon tiatua osiwuo ogol oing'uaa kopikop.

English: The LORD of hosts shall defend them; and they shall devour, and subdue with sling stones; and they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar.
Masaai: Olaitoriani loo lororani omitu ninche, naa kemut ninche neitunyoki enkop ilmang'ati lenye. Naa keok ninche osarge lenye anaa enaisho oo sabibu, neiputayu anaa olbakuli; nedooyo anaa too lpijat lo lperere lo lasar.

English: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
Masaai: Ore tenebau ina olong, naa keitajeu Olaitoriani iltung'ana lenyena. Amu ore ninche naa intare oo ltung'ana lenyena. Naa kewang'u ninche te nkop enye anaa enawang isoito ooripakino enkopiyia.

English: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! corn shall make the young men cheerful, and new wine the maids.
Masaai: Kebaa esidano natum ina kop! Ore lelo barnot naa kabul tenkaraki entapa enye tenebo enaisho o sabibu.

English: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain; so the LORD shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.
Masaai: Entoomon Olaitoriani enchan te nkata oloirujuruj, Olaitoriani ninye oitobiru olkutati o nkatampo, naa ninye oisho iltung'ana enkirujuruj e nchan, neitonyorij pooki toki tiong'ota.

English: For the idols have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie, and have told false dreams; they comfort in vain: therefore they went their way as a flock, they were troubled, because there was no shepherd.
Masaai: Eikilikuanishore iltung'ana nkitanyaanyukot o laitumusumusok kake ore iwalat naatum naa elejare o emodai. Eibelekeny kulikae nkidetidetat neitapong'oo intae. Enepesho enkikoo enye. Neaku kelimana iltung'ana anaa ntare naaimina. Etii ninche atua enyamali amu meeta olarikoni.

English: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I punished the goats: for the LORD of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah, and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle.
Masaai: “Eirowuaja engoro ai tenkaraki lelo shekuti, naa kaitame nanu lelo arikok; amu kegolie Olaitoriani loo lororani eluata enye ina aji e Yuda. Eketiu ninche anaa imbartan aainei naagol o larrabal.

English: Out of him came forth the corner, out of him the nail, out of him the battle bow, out of him every oppressor together.
Masaai: Atua ninche epukunye ilaitoriak, o larikok o lkituaak ooitore iltung'ana laainei.

English: And they shall be as mighty men, which tread down their enemies in the mire of the streets in the battle: and they shall fight, because the LORD is with them, and the riders on horses shall be confounded.
Masaai: Ore pooki tenebo naa keaku iltung'ana magil to larrabal, eitunyoki ilmang'ati lenye atua esarng'ab oo nkoitoi naalala; naa kearisho ninche amu etii Olaitoriani tenebo ninche, naa kemir ninche lelo akedok loo mbartan.

English: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph, and I will bring them again to place them; for I have mercy upon them: and they shall be as though I had not cast them off: for I am the LORD their God, and will hear them.
Masaai: “Ekaitagol iltung'ana le Yuda; naa kaitajeu enkaji e Yosef. Ekashuku ninche amu aata olng'ur te ninche, naa ketiu ninche anaa keitu aekata ang'as aany ninche: Amu are nanu Olaitoriani Enkai enye, naa kawaliki ninche.

English: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, and their heart shall rejoice as through wine: yea, their children shall see it, and be glad; their heart shall rejoice in the LORD.
Masaai: Ketiu Efraim anaa olmorrani magilani, neshipa iltauja lenye anaa iltung'ana ootooko enaisho oo sabibu. Edol inkera enye ina naa keshipa, neshipakino ina mirata naishoo Olaitoriani ninche.

English: I will hiss for them, and gather them; for I have redeemed them: and they shall increase as they have increased.
Masaai: “Kaipot iltung'ana laainei aiturrurr tenebo, amu atokordua nanu ninche, naa keaku ninche kumok anaa apa te moitie.

English: And I will sow them among the people: and they shall remember me in far countries; and they shall live with their children, and turn again.
Masaai: Ore hoo naidapashaka nanu ninche atua iloreren, kake ore too nkuapi naalakua naa kaadamu ninche, nanu, neaku ore ninche tenebo inkera enye naa kepok nerrinyunye ang tenebo.

English: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria; and I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and place shall not be found for them.
Masaai: Ayau ninche aitung'uaa Misiri o Asiria enkang enye nalotu aitamany ninche enkop enye. Ekaitamany sii ninche enkop e Gilead o Lebanon, o metaa meekure eeta enkop enemanyi te nkumoi o lorere.

English: And he shall pass through the sea with affliction, and shall smite the waves in the sea, and all the deeps of the river shall dry up: and the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, and the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away.
Masaai: Naa keeim ninche enaiposha e Misiri ore ilopir le naiposha naa kepuoi aaishie ore eng'uton pooki olkeju le Nail naa keitoi. Ore olwuasa le Asiria naa keitadoyiori aaitobor, ore engolon e Misiri nelo aing'uaa ninye.

English: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; and they shall walk up and down in his name, saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ekaitagol ninche tiatua Olaitoriani, naa kepuo ninche tiatua enkitoo e nkarna enye, Olaitoriani ojo.

English: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.
Masaai: Tabolo nchomito inono, iyie Lebanon, Pee etum enkima ainosa atumuta iltarakua linono!

English: Howl, fir tree; for the cedar is fallen; because the mighty are spoiled: howl, O ye oaks of Bashan; for the forest of the vintage is come down.
Masaai: Teyietu inchira iyie lo shani onyaanyukie oltarakuai, amu eturori oltarakuai, ore lelo keek oota enkishiaa sidai einyalaki pooki. Enchira niyietutu lo keek oogol le Bashan; ore ina tim nasur too lkeek netumutaki aadung!

English: There is a voice of the howling of the shepherds; for their glory is spoiled: a voice of the roaring of young lions; for the pride of Jordan is spoiled.
Masaai: Entoning olkiyioi le lelo shekuti; amu eiwuang'ieki aaoru enkitoo enye! Entoning, enkikurrukur e lelo ng'atunyo ore entim natii embata e Yordan, netumutaki aaidaikie.

English: Thus saith the LORD my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter;
Masaai: Inji ejo Olaitoriani Enkai ai: “Taa olchekut le nena tare naapuoi aayieng.

English: Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the LORD; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooinyang'u ninche neyieng ninche nepuo eitu eitamei ninche. Emir ninche inkiri nejo, ‘Meisisi Olaitoriani ataa nanu karsis.’ Ore ilchekuti lenye maate nemeatayie ninche olng'ur.

English: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD: but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour's hand, and into the hand of his king: and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.
Masaai: Amu maitoki nanu aing'urrie lelo oomanya ena kop, Olaitoriani ojo, ng'ura, kaisho nanu iltung'ana metabatatakinoyu, oltung'ani ake, inkaik olchekut lenye, oltung'ani ake nkaik o laiguanani lenye, naa kepuo ninche aarrarrakino enkop, nemakordu nanu hoo obo too nkaik enye.”

English: And I will feed the flock of slaughter, even you, O poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Beauty, and the other I called Bands; and I fed the flock.
Masaai: Metaa ataa nanu olchekut le nena tare naaiguanareki pee eyiengi te lelo oomir intare, naya nanu ing'udisin are. Ore nabo naisho enkarna ajo “Empiris,” ore enkae naisho enkarna aajo, “Naboisho,” Nairrita nanu ntare.

English: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
Masaai: Ore to lapa obo, naidaikie lelo shekuti okuni. Ataa nanu olemeeta eng'iriata te ninche, naaibayie sii.

English: Then said I, I will not feed you: that that dieth, let it die; and that that is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another.
Masaai: Metaa atejo, “Maaku nanu olchekut linyi. Ore ilo oye inchoo eye; ore ina namuta inchoo emuta; ore lelo ootelekutua nchoo eidaikie iseseni loo lkulikae maate.”

English: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
Masaai: Nadumu eng'udi ai naji “Empiris,” nagil ninye pee atum atujuto ilo sotua apa oitayio Olaitoriani too loshon pooki.

English: And it was broken in that day: and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the LORD.
Masaai: Metaa etua apa ilo sotua ina olong. Ore lelo amirak o lainyang'ak le nena tare naagira aaing'or, neyiolou aajo ororei lo Laitoriani.

English: And I said unto them, If ye think good, give me my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver.
Masaai: Ina pee ajoki ninche, “Tinidolidolo eishaakino too nkonyek inyi, enchooki olekoisiaayio lai naa tenemeishaakino, niminchoruru.” Metaa aatalaakita ninche nanu olekoisiaayio lai shekeli tomoni uni e nkosholai.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Tipika ninche atua olbene le nkaji Enkai.” Ina laata sapuk natejo ninche ekaaishaakino. Meeta atudumua nena shekeli tomoni uni enkosholai napik atua olchumati otii atua enkaji o Laitoriani.

English: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Bands, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
Masaai: Naitoki agil eng'udi ai e are naji “Naboisho.” Neaku etaraki Naboisho oo lalashera, Yuda o Israel.

English: And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
Masaai: Ina pee aajoki Olaitoriani nanu, “Nyaaki ake iwa imasaa olchekut lemeeta tipat.

English: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
Masaai: Amu ng'ura, ekadumu aitasheyie tena kop olchekut lemeret lelo ooye, arashu eing'oru nena naaidapashari, arashu eishiunye nena ng'ojiniaa, arashu eitoti nena naatelekutua, kake nenya nkiri e nena naapir nepolol o metabaiki iloisotok lenye.

English: Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
Masaai: Oi ele shekut lai lemeeta tipat, ilo olo aing'uaa intare! Metara olalem enkaina enye tenebo enkong'u enye e tatene! Inchoo enkaina enye eikaolo pooki, ore enkong'u enye e tatene nemodoku tukul!”

English: The burden of the word of the LORD for Israel, saith the LORD, which stretcheth forth the heavens, and layeth the foundation of the earth, and formeth the spirit of man within him.
Masaai: Ele ninye ororei lo Laitoriani oipirta Israel. Nji ejo Olaitoriani, ilo oisalaasha keper neitobir enkop, neisho tung'ani enkishui natii atua ninye,

English: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege both against Judah and against Jerusalem.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, etaa nanu enajo pee aitotiu Yerusalem anaa enkikompe e naisho oo sabibu; ore lelo oshon oomanita ninye naa keok netiu epuo anaa oltung'ani otemere. Naa ore teneman Yerusalem, naa kemani sii nena anas e Yuda.

English: And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces, though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa kaitaa Yerusalem osoit oiroishi too loreren pooki le nkop tenetem ninche aadumu ninye, naa keitame ate oleng. Naa kedumakino ninye iloreren pooki le nkop aarare ninye.

English: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with astonishment, and his rider with madness: and I will open mine eyes upon the house of Judah, and will smite every horse of the people with blindness.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong Olaitoriani ojo, naa kaosh nanu pooki barta to lkirutoto, naosh olakedoni lenye to lmilo, kake ore tialo enkaji e Yuda, naa kamitu nanu ninche, ina kata aosh nanu pooki barta oo loreren te modoki.

English: And the governors of Judah shall say in their heart, The inhabitants of Jerusalem shall be my strength in the LORD of hosts their God.
Masaai: Ina pee ejokino ilgilat le Yuda maate, ‘Ore lelo oomanya Yerusalem eeta engolon tiatua Olaitoriani loo lororani, Enkai enye.’

English: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
Masaai: “Ore teina olong naa kaitotiu nanu ilgilat le Yuda anaa olmoti le nkima te mpolos entim, arashu enkima nayupuyup natii atua irridat le nkano; naa kemut ninche eiteru te tatene o metabaiki kedienye olorere pooki omanita ninche. Ore Yerusalem neton ake emanyae.

English: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of the house of David and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem do not magnify themselves against Judah.
Masaai: “Naa keng'as Olaitoriani aisho enkisulata lelo ng'oborri le Yuda, pee eaku ore enkitoo e nkaji e Daudi o enkitoo e lelo oomanya Yerusalem, nemelus te nkitoo Yuda.

English: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the LORD before them.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong, naa keitaman Olaitoriani elong'o lelo oomanya Yerusalem, metaa ore ninye oloshal aisul tiatua ninche teina olong netiu anaa Daudi. Ore enkaji e Daudi netiu anaa Enkai, netiu anaa olmalaika lo Laitoriani olo te dukuya ninche.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
Masaai: Naa ore teina olong, naa kaing'oru amut lelo oshon pooki oopuonu aarare Yerusalem.

English: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
Masaai: “Naa kabukoki nanu enkaji e Daudi o lelo oomanya Yerusalem enkiyang'et o lng'ur o esayiare, metaa, tenelo neing'or aakurraki ilo otaremo ninche, naa keishiraki ninye, anaa oltung'ani oishiraki ina kerai nabo naa ninye ake eeta. Neishir te mion sapuk oleng te ninye anaa ilo oishiraki olkikau lenye otua.

English: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, as the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
Masaai: Ore teina olong, naa ketiu olkiyioi te Yerusalem anaa olkiyoi le Hadadrimon te nkisiashata e Megido.

English: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
Masaai: Ekeishir enkop pooki, neishir pooki marei openy; neishir ilo marei le Daudi openy, neishir inkituaak enye maate; neishir olmarei le Natan makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate.

English: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of Shimei apart, and their wives apart;
Masaai: Neishir olmarei le nkaji e Lawi makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate; neishir olmarei le Shemeit makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate;

English: All the families that remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.
Masaai: ore lelo marei ootelekutua, neishir ake olmarei makewan, neishir inkituaak enye maate.

English: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness.
Masaai: “Ore akenya teina olong, naa ketumi enkong'u enkare nabolo te nkaraki enkaji e Daudi o lelo oomanya Yerusalem pee eitukuoo ing'ok enye o pooki nemesinya.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
Masaai: Naa ore teina olong, Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo, ekajutoo aiwuang'ie nkarn oo nkitaanyaanyukot oo nkaitin teina kop, ometaa meigili aekata aadamu; naiwuang'ie sii iloibonok o nkiyang'eta torrok.

English: And it shall come to pass, that when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
Masaai: Naa teneitoki ake ninye oltung'ani alotu anaa oloiboni naa kejoki ninye menye otoiwuo tenebo ng'otonye, ‘Mintoki taa aishu, amu iroro elejare te nkarna o Laitoriani;’ ore menye o ng'otonye naatoiutuo ninye nengor ninche ninye meipang'a ina kata eibonisho.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive:
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong naa kekurru pooki oiboni teneibonisho te nduata enye; meitoki aishop olkila oju pee etum atelejisho.

English: But he shall say, I am no prophet, I am an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.
Masaai: Ekeaku kejo, ‘Mara nanu oloiboni, ara olaturoni le nterit; amu ara apake olaturoni ebaiki lelero ai.’

English: And one shall say unto him, What are these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
Masaai: Naa teneikilikuan likae ajoki ninye, ‘Ainyoo doi kulo baa ootii enkoriong ino?’ Naa kejo, ‘Ilbaa laatipikaki tiatua enkaji oo lchoreta laainei.’ ”

English: Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man that is my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.
Masaai: “Inyo lo alem tudumakinoyu olchekut lai, tigilunore ilo tung'ani oitashe te mbata nanu:” Olaitoriani loo lororani ojo. “Toosho ilo shekut, pee etum ntare aaidapashata; naa kaibelekeny, enkaina ai agilunore lelo ooti.

English: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
Masaai: Ore tiatua enkop pooki, Olaitoriani ojo, ore ematua e are te uni tiatua iltung'ana naa kemuta, neaku ematua nabo te uni eing'uari eishu.

English: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
Masaai: Naa kapik nanu ina matua nabo te uni atua enkima, naa kasil nanu ninche anaa olosil enkosholai naitoki atem ninche anaa enatemi sahabu. Naa keipot ninche enkarna ai, nawaliki nanu ninche. Naa kajo nanu, ‘Iltung'ana laainei ninche, Olaitoriani Enkai ang.’ ”

English: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
Masaai: Ngura, elotu enkolong o Laitoriani, naa ore iyarunot naawaki aitung'uaa intae naa keori te dukuya inkonyek inyi.

English: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
Masaai: Amu kaiturrurru iloreren pooki metudumakinoto Yerusalem to larrabal, naa keyai ina anasa, nepurri inkajijik, neikonyi inkituaak. Eyae ematua e nkanasa te yararoto. Ore ilkulikae tung'ana nemeyae ninche te nkanasa.

English: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
Masaai: Ina pee elo Olaitoriani aarare lelo oshon, anaa enataarishe ninye te nkolong o larrabal.

English: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong naa keitashe nkejek enyena toldoinyo loo loirienito, ilo otii dukuya Yerusalem te nkalo o loosaen. Ore ilo doinyo loo loirienito naa keiperra kat are eiteru to loo saen o meshomo oloo ntoluo aaku eululu sapuk. Metaa ore ematua nabo oldoinyo nelo enkalo e moikuape ore enkae seshati oldoinyo nelo enkalo e kopikop.

English: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
Masaai: Ore ina ululu oo ldoinyo laainei nemeitoki aponari agutu neaku keibung'are isunta pokira oldoinyo, nitumutumu aaisika anaa apa ina kata nisikisiki aailany olokirikiri too nkolong'i e Usia olaiguanani le Yuda. Ina pee elotu Olaitoriani Enkai inyi tenebo lelo pooki sinyat eboitare ninye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
Masaai: Ore akenya teina olong, meetae hoo enkirobi arashu enkurriny e ndeem.

English: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
Masaai: Naa keaku endama enaado oleng (Olaitoriani oyiolo ena), ime endama neme enkewarie, amu ore enoshi kata nikijo iyiook emuto, eton ake etii ewang'an.

English: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
Masaai: Ore teina olong naa keruko inkariak e mpuaan naapuku aing'uaa Yerusalem. Ore ematua enye nabo nerukokino enaiposha enkalo oloo saen ore enkae matua nerukokino enaiposha e nkalo oloontoluo; naa keruko to lari pooki.

English: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
Masaai: Naa keaku Olaitoriani Olaiguanani le nkop pooki, ore kenya te ina olong neaku Olaitoriani obo o enkarna enye nabo.

English: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin's gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king's winepresses.
Masaai: Ore enkop pooki naa keibelekenyi aitaa enkop naisiasha eiteru te Geba o metabaiki Rimon natii kopikop e Yerusalem. Ore Yerusalem neaku ketala etii shumata ina kop namanita ninye; ebaiki enkanasa e Yerusalem epuku te nkishomi e Benchamen o metabaiki ewueji e nkishomi musana, ine apa ebaiki oltalet le Hananel o meshomo ina aji naironyieki enaisho oo sabibu o laiguanani.

English: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
Masaai: Naa kemany iltung'ana ninye amu meitokini aata oldeket, keton Yerusalem te seriani.

English: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
Masaai: Naa ele olmeitai laa ninye emutie Olaitoriani iloreren pooki lelo oodumaki olarrabal Yerusalem. Ekeng'uoyu iseseni lenye eton eitashoo, naa keng'uoyu inkonyek enye etii atua ilukuny enye, naa keng'uoyu ilng'ejepa lenye tiatua inkutukie enye.

English: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
Masaai: Naa ore akenya teina olong naa kedoiki ninche olkirutoto sapuk oing'uaa Olaitoriani, ometaa keibung ake oltung'ani enkaina o likae, ore nkaik enye, nedumakino olikae olikae aarare.

English: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
Masaai: Ore sii iltung'ana le Yuda naa keara emitu Yerusalem. Naa kearu ninche enkarsisisho oo loshon pooki oomanita sahabu, o enkosholai tenebo inkilani te nkumoi.

English: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
Masaai: Naa kedoiki olmeitai laaijo oloo mbartan, o nyumpui, o ntamesin, o sirkon o pooki ng'ues ake ninye natii atua lelo ng'oborri.

English: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
Masaai: Ore taa pooki ng'ae oimisho te lelo oshon pooki ooetuo aadumakino Yerusalem, neaku keilepu too larin pooki aapuonu aaserem olaiguanani, ilo Aitoriani loo lororani, neibung osirua loo lng'oborri.

English: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
Masaai: Naa tenetii olmare obo te nkop lemelo Yerusalem aserem Olaiguanani, Olaitoriani loo lororani, nemetum ninche enchan.

English: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
Masaai: Naa tenemelo olmarei loo Lmisiri aapuo aaitarasaa ate, nedoiki ninche olmetai laa Olaitoriani ninye oosh lelo oshon lemeilep aapuo aaibung osirua loo lng'oborri.

English: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
Masaai: Ena nalo aaku enkitamioto te Misiri o enkitamioto oo loshon pooki lemeilep aapuo aaibung osirua loo lng'oborri.

English: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD'S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
Masaai: Naa ore akenya teina olong, naa keaku keetae iltualan loo mbartan nesirakino irorei oojo, “Sinyati to Laitoriani.” Ore imotioo naayierishoreki naatii atua enkaji Enkai naa keaku sinyat anaa ilbakulini otii dukuya olperere;

English: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: neaku ore pooki moti natii atua Yerusalem o Yuda neaku pooki sinyati to Laitoriani loo lororani, metaa ore lelo pooki ooitayu olasar, nepuonu aaya ninche neitokitokie nena kiri o lasar tiatua ninche. Nemeitokini aata olamirani tiatua ina aji Olaitoriani loo lororani ina olong.

English: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele oishoo Olaitoriani Malaki metoliki Israeli.

English: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, Wherein hast thou loved us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? saith the LORD: yet I loved Jacob,
Masaai: Ejo Olaitoriani: Atonyorra intae. Kake itejo intae “Kaji doi inkuna tininyorru iyiook?” “Amaa Esau aime olalashe le Yakobo?” Olaitoriani ojo. “Natonyorra nanu Yakobo

English: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
Masaai: naibayu Esau, naitomijoono nanu enkop enye oo ldoinyo, naing'ueiki enjung'ore enye imbariak o lpurkel.”

English: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.
Masaai: Tenejo Edom; “Etumutaki iyiook kake kintoki aashet ineeidaaitie”; ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani: “Eidim ninche aateshet, kake kasulaki nanu enkop ometaba anaa neipoti aajo enkop e ntorroni, iltung'ana ootagorokine Olaitoriani intarasi.”

English: And your eyes shall see, and ye shall say, The LORD will be magnified from the border of Israel.
Masaai: Idolidolo ena too inkonyek inyi maate, nijojo ina kata; “Aikitok Olaitoriani negiroo enkitoo enye ilpolosien loo Siraeli!”

English: A son honoureth his father, and a servant his master: if then I be a father, where is mine honour? and if I be a master, where is my fear? saith the LORD of hosts unto you, O priests, that despise my name. And ye say, Wherein have we despised thy name?
Masaai: “Eyanyit olayioni menye, neyanyit osinka olkitok lenye. Amaa naa tenaa kara papaai linyi, koree enkanyit ai? Naa tenaa kara olkitok, koree euriata ai? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Lo apolosak kulo oomen enkarna ai. Ijojo intae, ‘Kaji doi kinkuna tinikimenu enkarna ino?’

English: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD is contemptible.
Masaai: Aliki intae ajoki; tinintayuyu endaa naiduruk aapik shumata olperere lo lasar lai. Nijojo sii; ‘Kaji doi kinkuna tinikindurukie ninye?’ Ajoki intae: Amaa enidamumu to lmena emisa o Laitoriani, nintemenimene sii ilkulikae meibayu.

English: And if ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it not evil? and if ye offer the lame and sick, is it not evil? offer it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee, or accept thy person? saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Amaa tinintayuyu ilasarri loo masaa modook, aime eng'oki ina sapuk? Amaa sii tinintayuyu ilasarri loo ntokitin ng'ojiniaa anaa inaamuoi, aime eng'oki ina? Entetem sii intae enchoo nena olkitok linyi, aijojo keshipakino intae anaa eisho intae omom? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: And now, I pray you, beseech God that he will be gracious unto us: this hath been by your means: will he regard your persons? saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: “Ajoki intae teina kata, engoru omom e Nkai peyie eidim aing'urrie iyiook. Amaa teina kishooroto naing'uaa inkaik inyi, aijojo keidim aing'urrie hoo obo linyi? Ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
Masaai: Oi te naa ketii obo linyi oidim aikeno kutuk aji peyie mikintokiki aainuaaki enkima e pesho to lperere lo lasar! Mashipakino nanu intae, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, nemang'amaa sii olasar linyi too nkaik inyi.

English: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same my name shall be great among the Gentiles; and in every place incense shall be offered unto my name, and a pure offering: for my name shall be great among the heathen, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Amu ore eiteru te nkilepunoto enkolong o metabaiki endoyioroto, kitok enkarna ai too loreren pooki, ore te pooki wueji, neitayuni enkorropil te nkaraki enkarna ai, neitayuni sii ilasarri oosinya amu aikitok enkarna ai neyanyiti too loreren pooki, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: But ye have profaned it, in that ye say, The table of the LORD is polluted; and the fruit thereof, even his meat, is contemptible.
Masaai: Kake isarkionie intae ninye pee ijojo eidurukieki emisa o Laitoriani, ore sii endaa enye nemenuni.

English: Ye said also, Behold, what a weariness is it! and ye have snuffed at it, saith the LORD of hosts; and ye brought that which was torn, and the lame, and the sick; thus ye brought an offering: should I accept this of your hand? saith the LORD.
Masaai: Ijojo intae; eng'ura sii intae eneba enauri, nikidasakiki nkineji, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Kiyakiki sii intokitin naapurruno anaa ing'ojiniaa, o naamuoi, eji naa ninche kipuonunu aaitaikinye olasar! Aijojo kang'amaa ina too nkaik inyi? Ejo Olaitoriani.

English: But cursed be the deceiver, which hath in his flock a male, and voweth, and sacrificeth unto the LORD a corrupt thing: for I am a great King, saith the LORD of hosts, and my name is dreadful among the heathen.
Masaai: Metedeki olalejani pooki ooata olkuoo supat te luaata enye, neinos olmumai ejo ekaishoru eji neitoki apolosaki Olaitoriani ina naata eleyiata. Amu ara nanu olaiguanani kitok, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani naa keurei enkarna ai too loreren pooki.

English: And now, O ye priests, this commandment is for you.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata lo apolosak, eninyi ena kitanapata.

English: If ye will not hear, and if ye will not lay it to heart, to give glory unto my name, saith the LORD of hosts, I will even send a curse upon you, and I will curse your blessings: yea, I have cursed them already, because ye do not lay it to heart.
Masaai: Ti nimining'ining'i, tinimipikipiki atua iltauja ninchosho enkitoo enkarna ai, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, kaae nairriu oldeket shumata intae nadek sii imayianat inyi. Nesipa ajo aidipa nanu atediaa ninche, enkaraki mipikitata ntae ltauja linyi.

English: Behold, I will corrupt your seed, and spread dung upon your faces, even the dung of your solemn feasts; and one shall take you away with it.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kaisikong nanu eishoi inyi, napik inkomomi inyi emodioi, nena modiok oo lasarri linyi, naitalamaa intae te dukuya nanu.

English: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that my covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, niyiolouu aajo airriwua nanu ena kitanapata atua intae, pee etum olning'o lai lo sotua o Lawi aitasho, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him for the fear wherewith he feared me, and was afraid before my name.
Masaai: Ore apa olning'o lai lo sotua o ninye, naa olning'o lo osotua le nkishui o eseriani, naishoo apa nanu ninye kuna peyie etum ninye aturia; naaureyu ninye nanu, neitashe te nkanyit euriata e nkarna ai.

English: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
Masaai: Etii apa enkiteng'enata nasipa enkutuk enye, neitu etumi enkitapong'oto te enkutuk enye. Eshomo tenebo nanu te seriani o te nkitashoto nanare, neibelekenya ninye ilkumok metung'uai intorrok.

English: For the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Amu ore enkutuk olapolosani neishiaakino nerrip eng'eno, ore sii iltung'ana neishiaakino neing'oru enkiteng'enare te nkutuk enye, amu ore ninye naa olkilikuai lo Laitoriani loo lororani.

English: But ye are departed out of the way; ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kake mbelekenye iyie apaash enkoitoi; nchoo ilkumok errorro too nkiteng'enat inono, indurukie iyie olning'o lo sotua le Lawi

English: Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.
Masaai: naa kaisho nanu mikitemenuni nikintadouni te dukuya iltung'ana pooki, anaa ina neitu iyie imbung nkoitoi aainei, kake intodolua olkep too nkiteng'enat inono.”

English: Have we not all one father? hath not one God created us? why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, by profaning the covenant of our fathers?
Masaai: Aimikiaata iyiook pooki papa obo? Aime Enkai nabo naitobira iyiook? Ainyoo naa peyie mikisiliga iyiook maate, nikisarkionie olning'o loo loo papa lang?

English: Judah hath dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loved, and hath married the daughter of a strange god.
Masaai: Etaa Yuda olemeisiligayu, netaasaki embae o lminong te Israel o tiatua Yerusalem, amu eisarkionie Yuda ewueji sinyati o Laitoriani, teina natonyorra neyam entito e nkai oo loreren.

English: The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Metudung'oi Olaitoriani aiwuang'ie too lng'oborri le Yakobo tenebo oltung'ani oas ina, o loishakenoki, anaa olowal anaa oloyaki olasar Olaitoriani loo lororani!

English: And this have ye done again, covering the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping, and with crying out, insomuch that he regardeth not the offering any more, or receiveth it with good will at your hand.
Masaai: Niaasita ake sii ena. Imulumul olperere lo lasar to Laitoriani too lkiyio, te nkishirata o too nkigorot eshipakino te nkaina ino.

English: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
Masaai: Ninkilikuanu ajo, “Ainyoo doi pee meng'amaa ninye?” Enkaraki nataa Olaitoriani shakeni lo lning'o te rishata eina kitok niyama te kitisho, itaa iyie olemeisiligayu te ninye hoo duoo naa enkitok ino te naboisho o to lning'o.

English: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
Masaai: Aime Enkai nabo naitaa neitopok enkiyang'et e nkishui te iyiook? Naa kainyoo ninye eyieu? Eyieu ninye eishoi naure Enkai. Metaa ng'ura entagolie ate emincho obo linyi eaku olemeisiligayu teina kitok e kitisho enye.

English: For the LORD, the God of Israel, saith that he hateth putting away: for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the LORD of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously.
Masaai: “Amu kaiba nanu, eoro o lpayian o enkitok ejo Olaitoriani Enkai e Israel naiba enkimulumulata o lkila le nkarruoisho, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Metaa eng'ura ate, nimiakuku ilemeisiligayu.”

English: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the LORD, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?
Masaai: Intanaura intae Olaitoriani too rorei linyi. Nijojo ake sii: “Kaji doi kinkuna ti nikintanaur ninye?” Intanaura ninye te nijojo: “Aisupat pooki tung'ani oas ntorrok too nkonyek o Laitoriani, naa keshipakino ninye ninche.” Anaa inkilikuanunu ijojo, “Koree doi Enkai oo sipat?”

English: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, ekairriu nanu olkilikuai lai pee eitobir enkoitoi te dukuya nanu ore ilo Aitoriani ling'oruru, nelotu nabo kata atua enkaji enye. Ore olkilikuai leilo ning'o lishipakinono, ng'ura elotu ninye, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner's fire, and like fullers' sope:
Masaai: “Kake aing'ae oidim ating'iria ina olong elotunoto enye? Naa aing'ae oidim aitasho tenelioyu ninye? Amu etiu ninye anaa enkima o lasikani, netiu sii anaa osabuni oishu oloirerio.

English: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.
Masaai: Kelo ninye aton anaa olasilani osil enkosholai, naa kesil aitisidan ilayiok le Lawi neitisidan ninche anaa sahabu o enkosholai o metaba anaa neitarasaki Olaitoriani ilasarri ooishiaakino.

English: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.
Masaai: Neaku ore olasar le Yuda o Yerusalem neitiship Olaitoriani anaa inkolong'i apa e moitie oo larin ootulusoitie.

English: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: “Natum taa atinyikaki intae te nkiguana, aaku olchakeni osieku agilunore ilkuyandik, nagilunore iloololoito, nagilunore lelo oonya ilmuma le lejare, nagilunore lelo ooitorogonyisho too laakinot enye, tenebo inkolia o nkera okishin, nagilunore lelo ooinyal ilomon nemaaure ninche nanu; ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.
Masaai: “Ore nanu maibelekenya nanu Olaitoriani; ore naa intae, lo ayiok le Yakobo, neitu emuti intae.

English: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts. But ye said, Wherein shall we return?
Masaai: Ore ebaiki nkolong'i oo loo papaai linyi itapaasha nkiguanat aainei neitu imbung'ubung'u ninche. Entushukunye enatii, naa kashukokino sii nanu intae ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani. Kake ijojo ntae; ‘Kaji kinko tenikishukunye?’

English: Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.
Masaai: Kepur oltung'ani Enkai? Eji nikipurritoto intae nanu. Nijojo ake sii, ‘Kaji doi kinkuna tinikipur iyie?’ te matua inyi e tomon o too lasarri.

English: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.
Masaai: Etediaaki intae to ldeket, amu kipurritoto intae nanu, intae olosho pooki.

English: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
Masaai: Eyau ematua e tomon pooki atua enkaji ai nashumishoreki pee eaku ketii endaa atua enkaji ai; entetemaki sii iyie, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani tenemaboloki intae ilusien e shumata, nabuku abori imayianat naadooyo.

English: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Kaisikong sii ilo maati omutisho te nkop peyie meitoki aainyal ilng'anayio le nkop ino. Ore osabibu otii enkurma nemeitoki aalau eishoi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Ore iloshon pooki nikimpot aajo olomayiana, amu iaku enkop nashipakinoi, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?
Masaai: “Ore irorei linyi naaitame nanu katukul Olaitoriani ojo. Nijojo ake: ‘Kaji kinkuna tinikiro mbaa torrok tialo iyie?

English: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?
Masaai: Itejo intae ‘Pesho ti nikisiaai Enkai,’ ainyoo esidano ti nikimbung enkitanapata enye anaa tinikipuo anaa ilooata osina te dukuya Olaitoriani loo lororani?

English: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatiu iloo wuasa anaa kemayiana, ore ilarruok, neme kebul ake, kake tenetem ninche Enkai neimisho.”

English: Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooure Olaitoriani, neiro maate, naa keirrugoki Olaitoriani ninche enkiok ainining ninche. Neigeri embuku nadamunyeki te dukuya ninye, o lelo pooki ooure Olaitoriani, neing'oru sii enkarna enye.

English: And they shall be mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels; and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.
Masaai: “Keaku ninche iltung'ana laainei ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, intokitin aainei kiroteti teina olong naasisho nanu naa kaleku nanu ninche anaa oltung'ani opalaki enkerai enye naisiaaita.

English: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
Masaai: Nitum taa ina kata ategela ilo oitashe too sipat o laasani loo ng'ok, o ilo oisiaai Enkai o lemeisiaai ninye.

English: For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
Masaai: “Amu ng'ura; elotu enkolong napejisho anaa olmoti le nkima, ina pee eaku ilooitokoos o laasak pooki loo ng'ok isuut; ore ina olong nalotu napejoo ninche, ejo Olaitoriani loo lororani, melekaki ninch entonai anaa olng'osila.

English: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie oure enkarna ai, keilepaki intae enkolong e supatisho eetae enkishiunoto too naipuko enyena. Ipuopuo intae intigiranana anaa ilasho ooti ooitigiran epuku to lale.

English: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the LORD of hosts.
Masaai: Naa intunyokiki enkop iltorrok. Amu keaku nkuruon tiabori ndapi oo nkejek inyi ina olong naas ina Olaitoriani loo lororani.

English: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, with the statutes and judgments.
Masaai: “Entadamu inkiguanat o sinka lai Musa, o nkitanapat naitanapa ninye to ldoinyo le Horeb naaipirta Israel pooki.

English: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kairriwaki nanu intae Eliya oloiboni le Nkai eton eitu elotu ina olong torrono o Laitoriani.

English: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.
Masaai: Naa keibelekenyaki ninye iltauja loo menye inkera enye, neibelekenyaki sii iltauja loo nkera iloo menye, malotu ake aosh enkop to ldeket.”

English: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
Masaai: Embuku e ntipat e Yesu Kristo, enkerai e Daudi, enkerai e Abraham.

English: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
Masaai: Etoiwuo Abraham Isaak, neiu Isaak Yakobo, neiu Yakobo Yuda o lalashera lenyena;

English: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
Masaai: neiu Yuda Peres o Sera te Tamar; neiu Peres Hesron; neiu Hesron Aram;

English: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
Masaai: neiu Aram Aminadab; neiu Aminadab Nashon; neiu Nashon Salmon;

English: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
Masaai: neiu Salmon Boas; neiu Boas Obed te Ruti; neiu Obed Yese;

English: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
Masaai: neiu Yese olaiguanani Daudi. Neiu Daudi Solomon te nkitok e Uria;

English: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
Masaai: neiu Solomon Rehoboam; neiu Rehoboam Abiya; neiu Abiya Asa;

English: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
Masaai: neiu Asa Yehoshafat; neiu Yehoshafat Yoram; neiu Yoram Usia;

English: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
Masaai: neiu Usia Yotam; neiu Yotam Ahas; neiu Ahas Hesekia;

English: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
Masaai: neiu Hesekia Manase; neiu Manase Amon; neiu Amon Yosia;

English: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
Masaai: neiu Yosia Yekonia o lalashera lenyena te nkata e yararoto e Babilon.

English: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
Masaai: Ore te siadi e yararoto e Babilon, neiu Yekonia Shealtiel; neiu Shealtiel Serubabel;

English: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
Masaai: neiu Serubabel Abiud; neiu Abiud Eliakim; neiu Eliakim Asor;

English: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
Masaai: neiu Asor Sadok; neiu Sadok Akim; neiu Akim Eliud;

English: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
Masaai: neiu Eliud Eleasar neiu Eleasar Matan; neiu Matan Yakobo;

English: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
Masaai: neiu Yakobo Yosef, ilo payian le Mariamu natoiwuo Yesu oji Kristo.

English: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
Masaai: Metaa era iishoritin ebaiki Abraham o metabaiki Daudi iishoritin tomon o ong'uan; ore ebaiki Daudi o metabaiki yararoto e Babilon era iishoritin tomon o ong'uan; ore ebaiki e yararoto e Babilon o metabaiki Kristo nera iishoritin tomon o ong'uan.

English: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Inji eikununo einoto e Kristo; ore eidipa Yosef atisira Mariamu ng'otonye Yesu, eton eitu enyikakino, nedoli eeta enutai e Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
Masaai: Ore amu oltung'ani loo sipat Yosef, olpayian lenye, nemeyieu nesul, neyieu neleliari aing'uaa.

English: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Ore eton eiguanare kuna baa, ng'ura neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani te nkidetidet, nejoki, “Yosef, olayioni le Daudi, miureyu irik esiankiki ino Mariamu, amu ore enutai naata ninye, naa ene Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
Masaai: Naa keiu enkayioni, nijo enkarna enye Yesu, amu ninye oyooki aitajeu iltung'ana lenyena too ng'ok enye.”

English: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Etaasate kuna pooki pee ebaya inaatejo Olaitoriani to lkilikuai lo loiboni le Nkai otejo,

English: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
Masaai: “Ng'ura kenutayu entito neiu enkayioni; nejo ninche enkarna enye Immanuel;” naa eji, “Enkai te nebo iyiook.”

English: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
Masaai: Ore pee eputunye Yosef too injo neas anaa enaitanapa olmalaika lo Laitoriani nerik esiankiki enye ang;

English: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
Masaai: neitu eyiolou ninye o metoiu enkayioni, nejo enkarna enye Yesu.

English: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
Masaai: Ore pee eini Yesu te Betlehem e Yudea te nkata o laiguanani Herode ng'ura, nepuonu ilang'eni ooing'uaa oloosaen, nebau Yerusalem, ejo,

English: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
Masaai: “Kaji etii olaiguanani loo Lyahudi, otoiwuoki? Amu kitoduaa olakira lenye eilepu to loosaen, nikietuo iyiook aaserem ninye.”

English: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Herode ina, neing'aeng'ai ninye o Yerusalem pooki.

English: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
Masaai: Ore pee eiturrur ninye ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat le ilo orere, neipar ajoki, “Kaji eiunyeki Kristo?”

English: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
Masaai: Nejokini, “Te Betlehem e Yudea; amu inji etisiraki aajo to loiboni le Nkai:

English: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
Masaai: ‘Ore iyie Betlehem te nkop e Yuda, mira hoo kini tiatua ilaitoriak le Yuda; amu iyie epukunye olarikoni oyooki aitore ltung'ana laainei Isiraeli.’ ”

English: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
Masaai: Ina pee eipotu Herode ilang'eni too nkurrat, netem asipunye oleng enkata apa nataliee ilo akira.

English: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ninche Betlehem nejoki, “Enchom, emparu imbaa e ina kerai, ore pee itumutumu ninye nikiyakiki olomoni pee alotu sii nanu aserem ninye.”

English: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip ninche aatoning olaiguanani nepuo; ng'ura, ore ilo akira apa otoduaa ninche to loo saen nerikoo ninche o metaba anaa neitashe te shumata ewueji netii enkerai.

English: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ninche ilo akira neng'ida te ng'ida kitok oleng.

English: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing aji, nedol ina kerai o Mariamu ng'otonye, negil kung aaserem ninye; nebol ilbenia lenye neitaiki ninye inkishorot; sahabu o enkorropil o emanoo.

English: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
Masaai: Ore pee eikok Enkai ninche te nkidetidet pee meshukokino Herode nerrinyo ti ae oitoi aapuo enkop enye.

English: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
Masaai: Ore pee errinyo, ng'ura, neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yosef te nkidetidet nejoki, “Inyo, tudumu enkerai o ng'otonye, isikaki Misiri, niton te ine o metaba anaa naaliki, amu eing'oru Herode ina kerai pee ear metua.”

English: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
Masaai: Neinyototo nedumu enkerai o ng'otonye arik kewarie Misiri;

English: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
Masaai: neton te ine o metua Herode; pee ebaya enapa natejo Olaitoriani to loiboni le Nkai pee ejo, “Aipotuo enkerai ai aitung'uaa Misiri.”

English: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Herode ajo etipika lelo ang'eni olosek negoro metiminisa, neirriwaa iltung'ana metaara metuata inkayiok pooki naatii Betlehem o neemanita pooki naatabaitie ilarin aare nedou aishiaakinye ina kata natisipunye lelo ang'eni.

English: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Nebaya ina kata ororei oiroro oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia etejo,

English: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
Masaai: “Etoning'oki oltoilo te Rama, olkiyioi o enkishirata sapuk, eishiraki Raheli inkera enyena, nemeitigirayu amu meekure eetae.”

English: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atua Herode, ng'ura neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani Yosef te nkidetidet te Misiri.

English: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child's life.
Masaai: ejo, “Inyo tudumu enkerai o ng'otonye, shomo enkop e Israel amu etuata lelo apa ooing'oru enkishui e ina kerai.”

English: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
Masaai: Neinyototo arik enkerai o ng'otonye nepuo enkop e Israel.

English: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening inchere etaa Arkelaus olaiguanani le Yudea, te rishata e papaai lenye Herode neureyu errinyo ina alo; neikoki te nkidetidet neboina alo olkerenket le Galilaya.

English: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
Masaai: Nelo aton te nkang naji Nasaret, pee ebaya enatejo oloiboni le Nkai nchere: “Keaku keji Olnasarayoi.”

English: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i nelotu Yohana Olaibatisani elikioo ti ong'ata e Yudea, ejo,

English: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
Masaai: “Erridutu, amu etinyikua enkitoria e shumata.”

English: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
Masaai: Amu ore ele, ninye eimaka oloiboni le Nkai oji Isaya otejo, “Etii oltoilo obuaku ti ong'ata Entobiraki Olaitoriani enkoitoi nalala entorioi nkoitoi enyena.”

English: And the same John had his raiment of camel's hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
Masaai: Neishopito apa ninye Yohana enkila oo lpapit le ntames, o enkeene te mpolos enye; ore endaa enye na lmaat o naishi e ong'ata.

English: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
Masaai: Nepuo apa enetii ninye ina kata Yerusalem o Yudea pooki o lkirinen pooki le Yordan;

English: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
Masaai: neibatisai pooki to lkeju le Yordan eirridu ng'ok enye.

English: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Masaai: Ore pee edolu ninye Ilfarisayo kumok o Sadukayo epuonu meibatisae nejoki ninche, “Naishoi oo lasuriaa ai ng'ae otoroja intae elanya engoro nalotu?

English: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
Masaai: Entoiu ilng'anayio ooishiaakinore enkirridunoto.

English: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
Masaai: Nimijojo ti atua ate, ‘Kiaata iyiook Abraham aa papa lang’; amu ajoki intae, keidim Enkai aishoo Abraham nkera te kulo soito.

English: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
