Masaai: Keitasheikinore iltung'ana le Ninawi te nkiguana ltung'ana le na ishoi, naa keiguanaki ninche nchere, eitarruoitie amu eirridutua ninche to lkilikuai le Yona; netii ene olkitok olang Yona.

English: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
Masaai: Keitasheikinore enkaiguanani e moikuape te nkiguana ltung'ana le na kata naa keiguanaki ninche nchere eitarruoitie, amu eewuo ninye te nkop nalakua alotu ainining eng'eno e Solomon, netii ene olkitok olang Solomon.

English: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest, and findeth none.
Masaai: “Te nepuku oloirirua torrono aing'uaa oltung'ani neimaa wuejitin neetoito eing'oru eneyeng'iyeng'are, nelau;

English: Then he saith, I will return into my house from whence I came out; and when he is come, he findeth it empty, swept, and garnished.
Masaai: nejo, ‘Kashukokino enkaji ai natung'uayie’; ore pee elotu nedol ajo mijooni etooroki enkaji neikodi.

English: Then goeth he, and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself, and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation.
Masaai: Nelo ariku kulikae oiriruani oopishana torrok aalang ninye, nejing aatoni, neaku mbaa e ilo tung'ani torrok aalang enkiterata; neijia sii etiu te kulo tung'ana le na ishoi torrono.”

English: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorie olorora neitashe ng'otonye o lalashera te boo eyieu neirorie.

English: Then one said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to speak with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki oltung'ani, “Eitashe ng'utunyi te boo, o lalashera linono, kiyieu nikirorie,”

English: But he answered and said unto him that told him, Who is my mother? and who are my brethren?
Masaai: Newaliki ilo tung'ani nejoki, “Ae ng'ae yieyio anaa ae loo ng'ae ilalashera laainei?”

English: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!
Masaai: Neutaki te nkaina enye lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Kulo yieyio o lalashera laainei.

English: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
Masaai: Amu ore oloas enanyor Papa otii shumata, ninye olalashe lai o enkanashe ai, o yieyio lai.”

English: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
Masaai: Nepuku Yesu te ina olong ti ang, nelo aton te mbata e naiposha.

English: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
Masaai: Neiturrurrokino ilororani kumok, nejing empeut aton, neitashe olorere te mbata e naiposha.

English: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
Masaai: Neirorie ninye too nkitanyaanyukot ajoki, “Etupukuo olaunoni alo aunisho.

English: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
Masaai: Ore eunisho, nedoiki kulikae anterera embata e nkoitoi, nepuonu ntaritik aanya.

English: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae olkarkar loo soito ewueji nemetii enkulupuoni sapuk, nebulu nabo kata, amu metii enkulupuoni sapuk.

English: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
Masaai: Ore pee edalu enkolong nepej, ore enkaraki meeta ntona netoyu.

English: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae atua ilkiku negor ilkiku nkaitubulu.

English: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
Masaai: Nedoiki kulikae enetii enkulupuoni sidai, neiu obo iip neiu likae ntomoni ile, neiu likae tomoni uni.”

English: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: “Oloata nkiyiaa toning'o.”

English: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
Masaai: Nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki ninye, “Kaji etiu pee irorie ninche too nkitanyanyukot?”

English: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
Masaai: Neng'amaa ajoki, “Enkaraki naishooki intae entayiolo inkisudorot e nkitoria e shumata, kake eitu eishori ninche.

English: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
Masaai: Amu ore oloata naa keishori neponikini ninye enadooyo, ore olemeeta neoruni ninye in naata.

English: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee airorie nanu ninche too nkitanyaanyukot amu edolisho too nkonyek nemedol, nening'isho too nkiyiaa nemening, nemejing'aa.

English: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
Masaai: “Naa te ninche eitabari enaibon e Isaya pee ejo, ‘Ining'ining'i nimining'ung'u hoo pito, ning'oring'oro, nimidolidolo toki,

English: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
Masaai: amu eiroshiutuo ltauja le kulo tung'ana, netiripate nkiyiaa mening, neikeno nkonyek enye, pee medolisho ake too nkonyek enye, nening'ishoyu too nkiyiaa enye, neyiolou ltauja lenye, naaibelekenyakino nanu pee aishiunye ninche.’

English: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
Masaai: “Kake emayiana inkonyek inyi amu idolishosho, nemayiana nkiyiaa inyi amu ining'ishosho.

English: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, kumok iloibonok le Nkai o ltung'ana supati oong'uar apa pee edol kuna baa nidolitata intae, neitu edol, o pee ening kuna baa nining'ining'i intae, neitu ening.

English: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
Masaai: “Entoning naa intae enkitanyaanyukoto o launoni.

English: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
Masaai: Ore pooki tung'ani oning ororei le nkitoria e shumata nemejing'aa, nelotu ilo torrono awuapaa inaatuunoki to ltau lenye. Nena etuunoki te mbata e nkoitoi.

English: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
Masaai: Ore inaatuunoki to lkarkar loo soito, na elde oning ororei neng'amaa nabo kata te ng'ida;

English: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
Masaai: kake meeta intona makewan, kake eton penyo, ore pee epuonu isinaitin anaa enkinyala, enkaraki e ilo rorei nerrorro.

English: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
Masaai: Naa ore inaatuunoki ti atua lkiliku, naa ilo oning ororei, neirony isinaitin le na kop, o elejare oo masaa e na kop, negor ororei nemeisho.

English: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
Masaai: Ore nena naatuunoki te nkulupuoni sidai, naa ilo oning ororei nejing'aa naa keiu ilng'anayio aiu obo iip, neiu likae intomoni ile, neiu likae tomoni uni.”

English: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
Masaai: Neitoki aliki ae kitanyaanyukoto ajo, “Etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa oltung'ani otuuno enkano te nkurma enye.

English: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
Masaai: Kake ore eirura ltung'ana nelotu olmang'atinta aun endiati ti atua, nelo.

English: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
Masaai: Ore pee ebulu enkano, neiu ilng'anayio nebulu sii ninye endiati.

English: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
Masaai: Nepuo isinkan enetii olopeny enkaji nejoki, ‘Lo kitok, keitu iyie iun enkano te nkurma ino? Kaji eing'uaa endiati?’

English: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
Masaai: Nejoki, ‘Olmang'atinta lai oikona neijia.’ Nejoki isinkan, ‘Iyieu nikipuo aadotu aaiturrurru?’

English: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
Masaai: Nejoki, ‘Emipuo pee midotunyenye endiati enkano.

English: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
Masaai: Entapal metubulu pokira are o metaa enkata nadung'i, paa ore enkata e nkisampuare, najoki iladung'ok entang'as enturrurro endiati, enteen irridat, entapejoi, ninturrurrokiki enkano empeche ai.’ ”

English: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
Masaai: Neitoki aliki ninche ae kitanyaanyukoto ajo, “Etiu enkitoria e shumata enaa enkantererai naji karadali natuuno oltung'ani te nkurma enye.

English: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
Masaai: Naa kiti ninye alang ilanterera pooki, kake ore pee ebulu neaku sapuk alang inkaitubulu o metaa olchani, o meetu intaritik aapik isinkin ilng'osil lenyena.”

English: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
Masaai: Neitoki aliki ninche ae kitanyaanyukoto nejo. “Etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa enkaisiijoi natudumua enkitok neitushulaki imboreitin uni e nkurma e nkano o metaba anaa neisuijoyu pooki.”

English: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
Masaai: Einosaka Yesu olorora mbaa pooki too nkitanyaanyukot, neitu hoo einosaki likae rorei metii enkitanyaanyukoto.

English: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
Masaai: Pee etum atabai enatolimuo oloiboni le Nkai ejo, “Too nkitanyaanyukot abol enkutuk ai, alimu mbaa naaisudoro apa moitie pee eitamanyuni enkop.”

English: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
Masaai: Neing'uaa siamon nejing aji, nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Imbalakinye iyiook enkitanyaanyukoto o ndiati e nkurma.”

English: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
Masaai: Neng'amaa ajoki, “Ore oloun ilanterera sidain, naa Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
Masaai: Ore enkurma naa enkop, ore ina antererai sidai naa nkera e ina Kitoria, ore endiati na nkera e ilo torrono.

English: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
Masaai: Ore ilo mang'atinta oun naa shetani, ore enkisampuare, naa enkiting'oto e nkop, ore ilooisampu naa ilmalaika.

English: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatasotuoki endiati aapejoo te nkima, nejia sii etiu te nkiting'oto e nkop.

English: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
Masaai: Keirriu Enkerai e Tung'ani ilmalaika lenyena, meitayu ti atua enkitoria enye inkitadiaat pooki o loas intorrok.

English: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: Nenang'aki ninche olmoti le nkima, neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.

English: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata newang'u isupati anaa enkolong te nkitoria e Menye. Oloata nkiyiaa naaning'ie, toning'o.

English: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
Masaai: “Etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa olchumati oisudoyioki tiatua enkurma, netum oltung'ani neturoo aisudoo, ore te nchipai enye, nelo amir pooki toki naata nelotu ainyiang'u ina kurma.

English: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
Masaai: “Etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa oltung'ani omirisho, oing'oru soito oogol enkinyang'a.

English: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
Masaai: Ore pee etum obo, nelo amir intokitin pooki naata, neinyang'u ina.

English: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
Masaai: “Ore ake sii etiu enkitoria e keper anaa orreshet otanang'akaki atua enaiposha, nejing impukunot pooki oo sinkir.

English: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
Masaai: Ore pee eboreyu neyietuni embata e naiposha, netoni aagelaki isupati iltutuan, neiturrarri iltorrok.

English: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
Masaai: Neijia etiu te nkiting'oto e nkop. Kepuonu ilmalaika aagelu iltorrok aarishie isupati.

English: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: Nenang'akini ninche atua olmoti le nkima, neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.”

English: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Itoning'utuo nena pooki?” Nejoki ninche, “Ee.”

English: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Enkaraki ina, ore pooki aiteng'enani loo nkitanapat ng'en te nkitoria e shumata, netiu anaa oltung'ani openy enkaji oitayu te nkaji enye nashumishoreki olchumati lenye, ing'ejuko o musan.”

English: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu atolimu kuna kitanyaanyukot nelo.

English: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya enkang enye, neiteng'enisho te nkaji e ntumo, neing'asia ninche oleng, nejo, “Kaji enotie ele tung'ani eng'eno o enkidimata naasie kuna naas e nking'asia?

English: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
Masaai: Ae mme ele doi olayioni lo laguetani? Neji ng'otonye Mariamu? Nemeji lalashera lenyena Yakobo o Yosef o Simon o Yuda?

English: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
Masaai: Ae metii sii nkanashera enyena pooki atua iyiook? Kaji enotie ele tung'ani kuna baa pooki?”

English: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
Masaai: Neaku etanyaita ninche ninye, kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “Melau oloiboni le Nkai enkanyit mme te nkop enye aashu te nkaji enye.”

English: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
Masaai: Neitu eas inenking'asia kumok te ine enkaraki enkirukoto nemeeta ninche.

English: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
Masaai: Ore ina kata nening'oo olaiguanani Herode olning'o le Yesu

English: And said unto his servants, This is John the Baptist; he is risen from the dead; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
Masaai: nejoki sinkan lenyena, “Yohana Olaibatisani taa ele otopiwuo aing'uaa lootuata, paa ina magilanisho naasisho ti atua ninye.”

English: For Herod had laid hold on John, and bound him, and put him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife.
Masaai: Amu eibung'a apa Herode Yohana aen apik korokoroni, enkaraki e Herodias enkitok e Filipo olalashe lenye.

English: For John said unto him, It is not lawful for thee to have her.
Masaai: Amu etiaaka Yohana, “Mikinchoro too nkitanapat ti niaata ninye.”

English: And when he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.
Masaai: Ore pee eyieu near metua, neureyu olorere amu ejo pooki oloiboni le Nkai Yohana.

English: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enkolong e inoto e Herode, neranyisho entito e Herodias te mpolos o lorere, neitiship Herode.

English: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.
Masaai: Nenya olmumai nchere, ore entoki pooki naomon ninye, neisho.

English: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
Masaai: Neiguan ng'otonye, nejo, “Inchooki tena mbesen elukunya e Yohana Olaibatisani.”

English: And the king was sorry: nevertheless for the oath's sake, and them which sat with him at meat, he commanded it to be given her.
Masaai: Neisina Olaiguanani, kake ore enkaraki lmuma lenyena o lelo ooboitare neitanapisho meishori.

English: And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.
Masaai: Neirriwaa oltung'ani meshomo adung'u elukunya e Yohana te korokoroni.

English: And his head was brought in a charger, and given to the damsel: and she brought it to her mother.
Masaai: Neyauni elukunya enye te mbesen neishori entito, neyaki ina tito ng'otonye.

English: And his disciples came, and took up the body, and buried it, and went and told Jesus.
Masaai: Nepuo ilooiteng'eni lenyena aaya osesen aanukaa, nepuo aainosaki Yesu.

English: When Jesus heard of it, he departed thence by ship into a desert place apart: and when the people had heard thereof, they followed him on foot out of the cities.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu lelo omon, neinyototo ajing empeut alo ewueji neliyio, ore pee ening olorere, nesuj too nkejek eing'uaa nkang'itie enye.

English: And Jesus went forth, and saw a great multitude, and was moved with compassion toward them, and he healed their sick.
Masaai: Ore pee edou Yesu te mpeut, nedol olorere kitok, neing'urrie neishiunye ltamueyia lenye.

English: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku teipa, nepuo ilooiteng'eni lenyena enetii nejoki, “Ore ene nikitii naa ewueji neliyio, netaa teipa tiaaki olorere meshomo kuna ang'itie pee epuo aainyiang'aki ate endaa.”

English: But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Meeta tipat napuoyie, enchoo intae endaa.”

English: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Mikiaata iyiook toki neme mukateni miet o sinkir aare.”

English: He said, Bring them hither to me.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eyakaki.”

English: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the grass, and took the five loaves, and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, and brake, and gave the loaves to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
Masaai: Nejoki olorere metotona too nkujit, nedumu nena mukateni imiet o sinkir aare, neing'or shumata, nemayian, negil nena mukateni, neisho ilooiteng'eni lenyena, neisho ilooiteng'eni lenyena olorere.

English: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.
Masaai: Nenya pooki neraposho, nesotuni naatelekutua nkikapuni tomon o aare, naabore.

English: And they that had eaten were about five thousand men, beside women and children.
Masaai: Ore ilooinosa naa inkalifuni imiet ilewa metii nkituaak o nkera.

English: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship, and to go before him unto the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.
Masaai: Neitanap ina kata ilooiteng'eni lenyena meituruko aapuo te mpeut lido kekun metaba anaa neitanapare olorere.

English: And when he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into a mountain apart to pray: and when the evening was come, he was there alone.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aitanapare esiamo, neilepaki oldoinyo alo aomon; ore pee eaku teipa neaku ninye ake openy.

English: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea, tossed with waves: for the wind was contrary.
Masaai: Netalama empeut enkop natoyio, eyukito lopir le nkare amu kenang'are osiwuo.

English: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them, walking on the sea.
Masaai: Ore pee enyiku esiran, nelotu Yesu enetii ninche elo too nkejek ti oriong enkare.

English: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they cried out for fear.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilooiteng'eni lenyena eloito too nkejek ti oriong enkare neureishoyu nejo, “Oloip doi!” nebuak aaishir te nkuretisho.

English: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
Masaai: Neirorie taa Yesu nejoki, “Entagoluoto, Nanu doi! Emiureisho.”

English: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.
Masaai: Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa eiyie, tiaakaki maeu enitii too nkejek ti oriong enkare.”

English: And he said, Come. And when Peter was come down out of the ship, he walked on the water, to go to Jesus.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Wou.” Nedou Petero te mpeut nelo too nkejek ti oriong enkare enetii Yesu.

English: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
Masaai: Ore pee edol osiwuo neureishoyu neiteru aimis, nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Lo Kitok, tasaruaki!”

English: And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?
Masaai: Neitorioo Yesu enkaina nabo kata aibung nejoki, “Oi iyie oloti enkirukoto, aainyo pee inyaaka aing'ash?”

English: And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
Masaai: Ore pee eilepaki, empeut, negira osiwuo.

English: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him, saying, Of a truth thou art the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore ilootii ina peut neserem ninye nejoki, “Esipa ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai.”

English: And when they were gone over, they came into the land of Gennesaret.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatalang, nebaiki enkop e Genesaret.

English: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him, they sent out into all that country round about, and brought unto him all that were diseased;
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou iltung'ana le ina kop ninye neirriwaa ilkiliku lubot pooki e ilo kirine neyakini ltamueyia.

English: And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.
Masaai: Nesai meiseyie olcholoi lo lkila lenye, ore ilooiseyie pooki neishiu.

English: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying,
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo oo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ooing'uaa Yerusalem enetii Yesu ejo,

English: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.
Masaai: “kainyoo pee einyal ilooiteng'eni linono nkoon oo lpayiani? Amu einos endaa meisuja inkaik.”

English: But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki ninche, “Ainyoo pee inyalinyala intae inkitanapat e Nkai enkaraki e nena koon inyi?

English: For God commanded, saying, Honour thy father and mother: and, He that curseth father or mother, let him die the death.
Masaai: Amu etejo Enkai, ‘Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi; ore oloitarriki menye aashu ng'otonye, inchoo metua.’

English: But ye say, Whosoever shall say to his father or his mother, It is a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me;
Masaai: Kake ijojo intae, ore oltung'ani ojoki menye anaa ng'otonye inchere, ‘Ore toki naata naaretie iyie etaa enaisho Enkai to lasar,’ neaku meyanyit menye aashu ng'otonye.

English: And honour not his father or his mother, he shall be free. Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki nkoon inyi niwuang'ieng'ie nkitanapat e Nkai.

English: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
Masaai: Lo sunkuro, enotoko Isaya te naibon enye pee ejo,

English: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
Masaai: ‘Aayanyit ele orere too nkutukie, kake kaalakuaniki iltauja lenye;

English: But in vain they do worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.
Masaai: naa pesho aaserem ninche nanu, aa nkitanapat oo ltung'ana eitudupaa anaa ae ninche enkiteng'enare nasipa.’ ”

English: And he called the multitude, and said unto them, Hear, and understand:
Masaai: Neipotu olorora nejoki, “Enining'o niyiolouu.

English: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man; but that which cometh out of the mouth, this defileth a man.
Masaai: Mme entoki naim enkutuk naidurukie oltung'ani, kake enapuku te nkutuk naidurukie oltung'ani.”

English: Then came his disciples, and said unto him, Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended, after they heard this saying?
Masaai: Nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Itayioloito ajo etirikate Ilfarisayo pee ening ilo rorei?”

English: But he answered and said, Every plant, which my heavenly Father hath not planted, shall be rooted up.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ajoki ninche, “Ore pooki aitubului neme Papa le shumata otuuno kedotuni.

English: Let them alone: they be blind leaders of the blind. And if the blind lead the blind, both shall fall into the ditch.
Masaai: Entapal ilarikok modook loo lmodook. Naa te nerik olmoodooni olikae modooni nesulakino pokira aare engumoto.”

English: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Declare unto us this parable.
Masaai: Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Imbalakinye iyiook ena kitanyaanyukoto.” Nejoki Yesu,

English: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
Masaai: “Keton ake sii mejing'aa intae?

English: Do not ye yet understand, that whatsoever entereth in at the mouth goeth into the belly, and is cast out into the draught?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo aajo ore pooki toki najing enkutuk o ltung'ani, enkoshoke elo neipang?

English: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart; and they defile the man.
Masaai: Kake ore enapuku te nkutuk, oltau eing'uaa; naa ninye naisarkionie oltung'ani;

English: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts, false witness, blasphemies:
Masaai: amu oltau epukunye indamunot torrok, enkitayunoto oo loikop eloloito, enkibor oo nkonyek, enkiteenikinoto, o emorore.

English: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
Masaai: Kuna naaisarkionie oltung'ani, kake te nedaa meisuja inkaik, nemeisarkinonie oltung'ani.”

English: Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.
Masaai: Nelo Yesu te ine aito enkalo o lkerenket le Turo o Sidon.

English: And, behold, a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts, and cried unto him, saying, Have mercy on me, O Lord, thou Son of David; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil.
Masaai: Ng'ura, nelotu enkitok e Kanaan naing'uaa ina kop neishiraki ajoki, “Lo Kitok, ng'urrieki, ara Daudi, eitanyamalita enkerai ai oloirirua.”

English: But he answered her not a word. And his disciples came and besought him, saying, Send her away; for she crieth after us.
Masaai: Kake eitu hoo eng'amaa. Nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena aasai aajoki, “Inchoo ena kitok elo amu, esujita iyiook eishirita.”

English: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ntare kiminat ake e nkaji e Siraeli aairriwakaki.”

English: Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.
Masaai: Nelotu neserem nejoki, “Lo Kitok, taretuoki.”

English: But he answered and said, It is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it to dogs.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Meishiaakino te nenang'akini ildiein endaa oo nkera.”

English: And she said, Truth, Lord: yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Edede, Lo Kitok; kake einos sii ildiein inaadoyio te mesa oo lkituaak lenye.”

English: Then Jesus answered and said unto her, O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt. And her daughter was made whole from that very hour.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Na kitok, aisapuk enkirukoto ino, metotiwuo te iyie anaa ina niyieu;” neishiu entito enye te ina kata.

English: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
Masaai: Nelo Yesu te ine ashep enaiposha e Galilaya; neilepaki oldoinyo neton te ine.

English: And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus' feet; and he healed them:
Masaai: Neyiaya isiamon kumok, erikito iltung'ana ng'ojiniaa o lmodook o lemeiro, o lmaiman, o lkulikae kumok neirragie too nkejek enyena, neishiunye pooki,

English: Insomuch that the multitude wondered, when they saw the dumb to speak, the maimed to be whole, the lame to walk, and the blind to see: and they glorified the God of Israel.
Masaai: metaba anaa neing'asia olorora pee edol eiroro ilemeiro, neishiu ilmaiman, nepuo iltung'ana ng'ojiniaa, nedolishoyu ilmodook, neisis Enkai e Israel.

English: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him, and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days, and have nothing to eat: and I will not send them away fasting, lest they faint in the way.
Masaai: Neipot Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena meetu enetii nejo, “Kaing'urrie esiamo amu, nkolong'i uni taata aaboitare nemeeta entoki nanya, nemayieu naisho meshomo eeta esumash, meiterriaa te nkoitoi.”

English: And his disciples say unto him, Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness, as to fill so great a multitude?
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Kaji kitumie tena ong'ata imukateni naaitaraposh ena siamo kitok naba inji?”

English: And Jesus saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven, and a few little fishes.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Kaja mukateni niaatata?” Nejoki, “Naapishana o lkuti sinkir kutiti.”

English: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.
Masaai: Neitanap esiamo metotona te nkop;

English: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes, and gave thanks, and brake them, and gave to his disciples, and the disciples to the multitude.
Masaai: nedumu nena mukateni naapishana o lelo sinkir, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe, nebelibel neisho ilooiteng'eni lenyena pee eisho ilooiteng'eni esiamo.

English: And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.
Masaai: Neinos pooki neraposho; neiturrur mbelat naatelekuaki naaiputa nkikapuni naapishana.

English: And they that did eat were four thousand men, beside women and children.
Masaai: Ore ilooinosa nera ilewa nkalifuni ong'uan, metii inkituaak o nkera.

English: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.
Masaai: Neisho esiamo meshomo nejing ninye empeut nelo enkop e Magadani.

English: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came, and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo o Sadukayo enetii aatem eyieu neitodol olmonekie ooing'uaa shumata.

English: He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ore te nteipa nijojo, ‘Mesha ade taata amu kenyokie shumata.’

English: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
Masaai: Nijojo tadekenya, ‘Keidis ade taata amu kenyokie shumata netunukua.’ Indimidimi intae aatumusu ilmonek le shumata kake mindimidimi aaibalie ilmonek le kuna katitin.

English: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.
Masaai: Eing'oru kulo tung'ana torrok lena kata olmonekie kake meishori likae leme olapa le Yona.” Nelo aing'uaa ninche.

English: And when his disciples were come to the other side, they had forgotten to take bread.
Masaai: Ore pee epuo ilooiteng'eni lido kekun, nerikino eitu eya mukateni.

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entorrip ate te nkisuijo oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.”

English: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
Masaai: Nejokino maate, “Enkaraki neitu kiyau mukateni.”

English: Which when Jesus perceived, he said unto them, O ye of little faith, why reason ye among yourselves, because ye have brought no bread?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ilo rorei nejo, “Oi intae ilooti enkirukoto, ainyoo pee ijokinono maate mukateni miaatata?

English: Do ye not yet understand, neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
Masaai: Keitu ejing'aa intae? Aimidamumu mukateni imiet naainosa iltung'ana nkalifuni imiet, kaja nkikapuni ninturrurrutuo?

English: Neither the seven loaves of the four thousand, and how many baskets ye took up?
Masaai: Aashu mukateni naapishana naainosa inkalifuni ong'uan oo ltung'ana, kaja nkikapuni ninturrurrutuo?

English: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread, that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee mejing'aa intae nchere mme mukateni aimaka? Kake entorrip ate te nkisuijo oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.”

English: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread, but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees.
Masaai: Nejing'aa te ina kata inchere, mme enkisuijo oo mukateni eimaka kake inenkiteng'enare oo Lfarisayo o Sadukayo.

English: When Jesus came into the coasts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Whom do men say that I the Son of man am?
Masaai: Ore pee elo Yesu enkalo e Kaisari e Filipi neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena ajoki, “Kejo iltung'ana ae ng'ae Enkerai e Tung'ani?”

English: And they said, Some say that thou art John the Baptist: some, Elias; and others, Jeremias, or one of the prophets.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ejo kulikae Yohana Olaibatisani; nejo kulikae Eliya; nejo kulikae Yeremia, anaa obo loo loibonok le Nkai.”

English: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
Masaai: Nejoki, “Paa aijojo intae kara nanu ng'ae?”

English: And Simon Peter answered and said, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.
Masaai: Newaliki Simon Petero ajoki, “Ira Iyie Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai naishu.”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Blessed art thou, Simon Barjona: for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee, but my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Imayiana Simon ara Yona, amu eitu kiboloki ena entoki naata osesen o sarge, kake Papa lai otii shumata.

English: And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu iyie, ira Petero naa te nchumata ena soit ashet enkanisa ai; nemegilu ae kata ltimito le nemeneng'a.

English: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
Masaai: Naa kaaisho iyie ilboleta le nkitoria e shumata ore eniyooki aen te nkop, neaku eidipaki aateen te shumata; ore enilak te nkop eidipaki aatalak te shumata.”

English: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
Masaai: Neitanap ilooiteng'eni lenyena pee meliki oltung'ani nchere ninye Kristo.

English: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
Masaai: Neiteru Yesu te ina kata aibalakinye looiteng'eni lenyena inchere meeta kata nemelo Yerusalem meisilisili too mbaa kumok ilpayiani o lapolosak kituaak, o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat neari metua, neitopiuni te nkolong e uni.

English: Then Peter took him, and began to rebuke him, saying, Be it far from thee, Lord: this shall not be unto thee.
Masaai: Nerik Petero enkilepata nekurraki ajoki, “Mikintapaasha Enkai, Lo Kitok, mikitalama nena.”

English: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
Masaai: Neibelekenyakino Petero ajoki, “Shomo oriong ai shetani, amu aikirror; amu mme imbaa e Nkai idamu kake noo ltung'ana.”

English: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu te ina kata ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Ore pooki tung'ani oyieu naasuj inchoo eany kewan nenap osalaba lenye naasuj.

English: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki tung'ani ojo aitajeu enkishui enye neiminie, ore pooki oiturraa enkishui enye te nkaraki nanu, neitoki atum.

English: For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?
Masaai: Amu kaa dupoto etum oltung'ani te netum enkop pooki, neiturraa enkishui enye?

English: For the Son of man shall come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he shall reward every man according to his works.
Masaai: Amu kelotu Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkitoo e Menye te nebo o lmalaika lenyena; nelaaki pooki tung'ani te ina kata aitorisioki inaataasa.

English: Verily I say unto you, There be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, etii kulikae ooitashe te ne, lemeinyorrinyor keeya katukul metaba anaa nedol Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu te nkitoria enye.”

English: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter, James, and John his brother, and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart,
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo inkolong'i ile, nerik Yesu Petero o Yakobo o lalashe lenye Yohana ailepie ninche oopeny shumata oldoinyo oado.

English: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
Masaai: Neibelekenya empukunoto enye newang'u enkomom enye anaa enkolong, neiborru inkilani enyena aatiu anaa ewang'an.

English: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, neipang'aki Musa o Eliya aairorie ninye.

English: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
Masaai: Neirorie Petero Yesu nejoki, “Lo Kitok, ai sidai kitii ene, naa te naa iyieu naitobir ilng'oborri okuni, olino obo, o le Musa obo, o le Eliya obo.”

English: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
Masaai: Ore eton eiro, ng'ura, neitushur enkatampoi nawang; naa ng'ura, nepuku oltoilo te ina atampoi ojo, “Enkerai ai ena nanyor, natishipe te ninye. Entoning ninye.”

English: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilooiteng'eni lenyena neirut oleng nebatata aairrabalakino enkop.

English: And Jesus came and touched them, and said, Arise, and be not afraid.
Masaai: Nelotu Yesu neiseyie nejoki, “Enyeito emirut.”

English: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.
Masaai: Nejo entaraposhu nkonyek, neitu edol likae tungani Yesu ake openy.

English: And as they came down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, saying, Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.
Masaai: Ore edou ninche to ldoinyo neitanap Yesu ajoki, “Emiliki oltung'ani nena nitoduaa metaba anaa nepiu Enkerai e Tung'ani aing'uaa ilootuata.”

English: And his disciples asked him, saying, Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena aajoki, “Ainyoo naa pee ejo ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eji eng'as Eliya alotu?”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Elias truly shall first come, and restore all things.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Esipa eng'as Eliya alotu neitobir imbaa pooki.

English: But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.
Masaai: Kake ajoki intae, eidipa Eliya aeu, neitu eyiolou ninche ninye, kake eitaasa pooki ninye naayieu. Neijia sii etiu Enkerai e Tung'ani, keisilisil ninche.”

English: Then the disciples understood that he spake unto them of John the Baptist.
Masaai: Neyiolou taa te ina kata ilooiteng'eni aajo Yohana Olaibatisani eimaka.

English: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya enetii esiamo nelotu oltung'ani obo agilaki kung nejoki,

English: Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.
Masaai: “Lo Kitok, ing'urrie enkerai ai amu eeta enkiterria neisilisilo oleng amu katitin kumok eurokino enkima nesulakino enkare.

English: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
Masaai: Natorikoko ilooiteng'eni linono, neitu eidim aaishiunye.”

English: Then Jesus answered and said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him hither to me.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Oi intae iltung'ana lena ishoi lemeeta enkirukoto, ootapong'ori, kaboitare intae o anu? Kang'iri te intae o anu? Entorikokoki.”

English: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
Masaai: Neisikong Yesu oloirirua, nepuku ninye aing'uaa neishiu enkayioni te ina kata.

English: Then came the disciples to Jesus apart, and said, Why could not we cast him out?
Masaai: Nepuo ina kata ilooiteng'eni enetii Yesu oopeny nejoki, “Ainyoo pee eitu kindim iyiook aataarai?”

English: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Enkaraki naa kiti enkirukoto inyi, amu esipa ajoki intae, ti niaatata enkirukoto naba anaa ene kantererai naji karadali, naa indimidimi aatiaaki ele doinyo ‘Tadotunye te ne, shomo idie;’ nedotunye; nemetii embae nemeidimayu te intae.

English: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.
Masaai: Kake mepuku eneeijo ena mme te nkomono o te mpukoroto.”

English: And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men:
Masaai: Ore eiturrurro te Galilaya nejoki Yesu ninche, “Etaa epiki Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo ltung'ana;

English: And they shall kill him, and the third day he shall be raised again. And they were exceeding sorry.
Masaai: near ninche ninye metua, ore te nkolong e uni neitopiuni.” Neisinanuo ninche oleng.

English: And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu Kapernaum, nepuo iloosotu olpisiai le shekeli e kodi enetii Petero nejoki, “Aimelak Olaiteng'enani linyi shekeli e kodi?”

English: He saith, Yes. And when he was come into the house, Jesus prevented him, saying, What thinkest thou, Simon? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute? of their own children, or of strangers?
Masaai: Nejo, “Kelak.” Ore pee ejing aji nemurutoki Yesu aikilikuan ajoki, “Ijo aa Simon? Ai ng'ae eitalak ilkituaak le na kop kodi oo masaa arashu enoo ltung'ana, ai nkera enye ana ineeiking'a.”

English: Peter saith unto him, Of strangers. Jesus saith unto him, Then are the children free.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo Petero, “Ineeiking'a.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Neijia etiu, metii nkera enye siana.

English: Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an hook, and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.
Masaai: Kake ore pee mikintagor, shomo iyie enaiposha tanang'aki erreshet nintayu osinkirri ling'as aibung; nibol enkutuk, nitum shekeli, niya aitainye kodi ai o enino.”

English: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus, saying, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
Masaai: Nepuonu ina kata ilooiteng'eni enetii Yesu nejoki, “Kaing'ae olkitok te nkitoria e shumata?”

English: And Jesus called a little child unto him, and set him in the midst of them,
Masaai: Neipot enkerai neitasheyie te mpolos enye.

English: And said, Verily I say unto you, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Nejo, “Esipa ajoki intae, te neitu imbelekenyanya aatiu anaa inkera kutiti, nimijing'ijing'i katukul enkitoria e shumata.

English: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child, the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Ore pooki oitadou kewan anaa ena kerai, ninye olkitok aisul te nkitoria e shumata.

English: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae ong'amu enkerai naba anaa ena te nkarna ai, naa nanu etang'amua.

English: But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.
Masaai: “Kake ore oloitapong'oo nabo kiti te kuna naairuk nanu metaasa inyok, eishiaakino neenikini osoit oituutishoreki emurt nenang'akini olmegut le naiposha.

English: Woe unto the world because of offences! for it must needs be that offences come; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh!
Masaai: Oi enkop te nkaraki mbaa naayau empong'oroto, amu meeta nchere pee mepuonu mbaa e nkitapong'oroto. Kake ee kake ayia te ilo laa ninye eimu empong'oroto.

English: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
Masaai: “Ti nikintapong'oo enkaina ino aashu enkeju ino, tudung'o’ nturrai amu enaikash te nijing enkishui miaata enkaina aashu enkeju alang ti niaata inkaik are o nkejek are, nikinang'akini enkima oo ntarasi.

English: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkong'u ino, tukurtu nturrai amu enaikash ti nijing enkishui iata enkong'u nabo alang ti nikinang'akini enkima e Gehena iata nkonyek pokira are.

English: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones; for I say unto you, That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: “Eng'ura emimenaa nabo e kuna kutiti; amu ajoki intae ore te shumata, eing'orita oshi ake ilmalaika lenye enkomom e Papa lai otii shumata.

English: For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.
Masaai: Amu eewuo Enkerai e Tung'ani pee eitajeu inaaimina.

English: How think ye? if a man have an hundred sheep, and one of them be gone astray, doth he not leave the ninety and nine, and goeth into the mountains, and seeketh that which is gone astray?
Masaai: “Aijojo aa intae? Amaa te neeta oltung'ani nkerra iip nabo, aimeing'uaa kunda ntomoni naaudo o naaudo too ldoinyo nelo aing'oru ina naimina?

English: And if so be that he find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoiceth more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray.
Masaai: Ore pee etum, esipa ajoki intae, eshipakino oleng ina alang nena ntomoni naaudo o naaudo neitu eimin.

English: Even so it is not the will of your Father which is in heaven, that one of these little ones should perish.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu mme eyieunoto e Papa linyi otii shumata, pee eimin nabo e kuna kutiti.

English: Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.
Masaai: “Ti nikinyal olalashe lino, shomo toliki enikinyalie aa intae ake pokira aare; naa ti nikining inoto olalashe lino.

English: But if he will not hear thee, then take with thee one or two more, that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.
Masaai: Naa te neitu kining, torikoki likae tung'ani obo aashu aare, pee esipuni pooki bae too nkutukie oo lchakenini oare aashu okuni.

English: And if he shall neglect to hear them, tell it unto the church: but if he neglect to hear the church, let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican.
Masaai: Naa te neany ening ninche toliki kanisa; naa te neitu ening sii kanisa, inchoo etiu te iyie anaa oloo loreren lemeiruk, anaa olosotu kodi.

English: Verily I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven: and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.
Masaai: “Esipa ajoki intae, ore pooki niyeniyene te nkop, neeni te shumata; ore pooki nitalaa te nkop, nelaki sii te shumata.

English: Again I say unto you, That if two of you shall agree on earth as touching any thing that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my Father which is in heaven.
Masaai: “Esipa aitoki ajoki intae, te nining'okinono oare linyi embae ake pooki te nkop niomonunu, naa keitaas intae Papa lai otii shumata.

English: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
Masaai: Amu ore enetumore oare anaa akuni te nkarna ai, natii nanu ine atua ninche.”

English: Then came Peter to him, and said, Lord, how oft shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? till seven times?
Masaai: Nelotu Petero te ina kata nejoki, “Lo Kitok, ae katitin aja aainyal olalashe lai, napalaki? Kemetabaiki katitin naapishana?”

English: Jesus saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Maajoki metabaiki katitin naapishana, kake metabaiki ntomoni naapishana katitin naapishana.

English: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king, which would take account of his servants.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa olaiguanani otayiewua neikenisho te nebo isinkan lenyena.

English: And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.
Masaai: Ore pee eiteru aikenisho nerikokini oltung'ani obo oata esile enye intalantani nkalifuni tomon.

English: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.
Masaai: Ore pee elau entoki nalakie, neitanapisho olkitok lenye metimiri ninye o enkitok enye o nkera enyena o ntokitin pooki naata, aalakie ina sile.

English: The servant therefore fell down, and worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
Masaai: Nebatata ilo sinka too nkejek enyena nesai nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok, ting'iriakaki metaba anaa naalaaki pooki.’

English: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
Masaai: Neig'urrie olkitok ilo sinka nelaku nepalaki ina sile pooki.

English: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.
Masaai: “Ore pee eipung ilo sinka nedol likae sinka oboita te siaai oata esile enye dinari iip nabo; neibung olgos agor nejoki, ‘Talaakaki esile ai pooki.’

English: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
Masaai: Nebatata ilo sinka oboita te siaai too nkejek enyena nesai ejo, ‘Ting'iriakaki metaba anaa naalaaki pooki.’

English: And he would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt.
Masaai: Neany nerik apik korokoroni metaba anaa nelak esile pooki.

English: So when his fellowservants saw what was done, they were very sorry, and came and told unto their lord all that was done.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilkulikae ooboitare te siaai enatotiwuo, neisinanuo oleng nepuo aaliki olkitok lenye inaataasate pooki.

English: Then his lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me:
Masaai: Neipot olkitok ilo sinka nejoki, ‘Lo sinka arruoni, kaatapalaka idia sile pooki enkaraki nikitasayia:

English: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant, even as I had pity on thee?
Masaai: paa aimeishiaakino sii iyie ning'urrie osinka liboitare te siaai anaa enaaing'urrie nanu iyie?’

English: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.
Masaai: Negoro olkitok nepik inkaik oo looitameisho metaba anaa nelak esile enye pooki.

English: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.
Masaai: “Neijia sii eiko intae Papa lai otii keper ti nimipalakiki too ltauja pooki tung'ani olalashe lenye.”

English: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan;
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu atejo kuna baa neing'uaa Galilaya nelotu enkop e Yudea te lido kekun Yordan;

English: And great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
Masaai: nesuj ninye isiamon kumok; neishiunye ninche te ine.

English: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo enetii aatem aajoki, “Kebara te neorore oltung'ani enkitok enye te pooki bae?”

English: And he answered and said unto them, Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female,
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Keitu isomama aajo ore oloitobira ninche te nkiterunoto, eitobira olee o eng'oruoi?

English: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
Masaai: Nejo ninye te nkaraki ena eing'uaa olee menye o ng'otonye neibung'are enkitok enye, neaku ninche pokira osesen obo?

English: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
Masaai: Metaa meekure aa are, kake osesen obo. Ore enaidikidiko, Enkai, mincho erish oltung'ani.”

English: They say unto him, Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Ainyoo naa pee eitanapishe Musa meishori empalai e oro, neing'uaro?”

English: He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eishoo Musa intae entoorore inkituaak inyi enkaraki engolon oo ltauja linyi, kake mme neijia apa etiu te nkiterunoto.

English: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except it be for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery.
Masaai: Ajoki nanu intae, ore pooki ng'ae oorore enkitok enye neme enkaraki eloloito neyam ae, netololoite, ore oloyam enda natoororeki naa keloloito.”

English: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni ninye, “Te naa inji naa etiu, embae o lmoruo o enkitok enye, meeta tipat enkiyama.”

English: But he said unto them, All men cannot receive this saying, save they to whom it is given.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Mme pooki ooidim aatang'amai ele rorei, kake lelo ake ooishoro.

English: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother's womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven's sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
Masaai: Amu etii ilooini aa sunashi too nkoishuaa oo noo ng'otonye, netii iloogelem iltung'ana, netii ilooitaa ate sunashi te nkaraki enkitoria e shumata. Ore ilo oidim atang'amu ena, inchoo eng'amu.”

English: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
Masaai: Neyakini ninye inkera kutiti pee eiteleiki nkaik enyena, neomonoki; neisikong ilooiteng'eni lenyena ilooyautua.

English: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Entapal inkera kutiti emimitiki epuonu enatii, emimitiki amu enoo naatiu anaa kuna enkitoria e shumata.”

English: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
Masaai: Neiteleiki ninche inkaik enyena nelo te ine.

English: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
Masaai: Ng'ura, nelotu oltung'ani nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kaa bae naikishiaan aas pee atum enkishui nemeish?”

English: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Ainyoo pee kinkilikuan nanu inenkishiaa? Obo ake eetai aa supat; te naa iyieu nijing atua enkishui, imbung'a inkitanapat.”

English: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
Masaai: Nejoki, “Akua?” Nejoki Yesu, “Kuna, miar metua, miloloito, mipurrisho, minchakenoki elejare.

English: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: Iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi, tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.”

English: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
Masaai: Nejoki ilo barnoti ninye, “Aidipa aibung'a nena pooki: ainyoo ae naatong'orikia?”

English: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Te naa iyieu niaku bayaroti, shomo timira masaa pooki niaata, inchoo ilaisinak, neaku iata olchumati te shumata, nikilotu asuj.”

English: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilo barnoti ilo rorei, nelo eisinanuo amu eata masaa kumok.

English: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Esipa ajoki intae nchere egol pee ejing olkarsis enkitoria e keper.

English: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Naitoki ajoki intae, kelelek te ntames eim enaudoto o ltidu alang olkarsis ejing enkitoria e keper.”

English: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilooiteng'eni lenyena neing'asia oleng nejo, “Aing'ae naa oidim atajeu?”

English: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
Masaai: Nekurraki Yesu nkonyek nejoki ninche, “Meidimayu ina too ltung'ana, kake eidimayu pooki te Nkai.”

English: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
Masaai: Newaliki Petero te ina kata ajoki, “Ng'ura kitung'aitie iyiook pooki toki, nikisuj iyie, ainyoo naa kenya kitum?”

English: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa ajoki intae, ore intae likitusuja nanu, ore te nkop ng'ejuk te neton akenya Enkerai e Tung'ani to lorika le nkitoo enye, ore intae likitusuja nanu nitonini sii intae too lorikan tomon o aare aaiguanare lelo oshon tomon o aare le Israel.

English: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki ng'ae otung'uayie inkajijik, anaa lalashera, anaa nkanashera, anaa menye anaa ng'otonye, anaa nkera, anaa nkurman te nkaraki enkarna ai naa ketum ninche enaalus enkishui nemeish.

English: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
Masaai: Kake keaku ilkumok le dukuya ile siadi, neaku ile siadi ile dukuya.

English: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
Masaai: “Amu etiu enkitoria e shumata anaa oltung'ani openy enkang otayoo enasirie alo aing'oru iltung'ana ootur enkurma enye oo Ing'anayio.

English: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atoning'ore ilaisiaayiak pee elaaki dinari te nkolong, nerik enkurma enye oo sabibu.

English: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
Masaai: Neitoki alo saa uni, netum kulikae eitashoo te nemirishoreki meeta esiaai,

English: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
Masaai: nejoki sii lelo, ‘Enchom sii intae enkurma oo sabibu naisho intae entoki nairirikino.’ Nepuo.

English: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
Masaai: Neitoki ake alo anaa saa ile, o saa naaudo, neiko ake neijia.

English: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
Masaai: Ore saa tomon o obo, nelo netum kulikae ooitashoo nejoki, ‘Ainyoo pee intasheshe intae te ne endama pooki, miatata esiaai?’

English: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, ‘Amu eitu kitum oltung'ani oishoo iyiook esiaai.’ Nejoki, ‘Enchom sii intae enkurma oo sabibu.’

English: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
Masaai: “Ore pee eaku teipa nejoki olopeny enkurma oo lng'anayio olaitasheikinoni lenye, ‘Impoto laisiaayiak, inchoo olmushaara, tang'asu to lobayie o mpung'ie to loiturukuo.’

English: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu laduoo ooiterutua saa tomon o obo netum ake pooki tung'ani dinari.

English: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
Masaai: Nepuonu ile dukuya ejo ketum ninche nkumok, netum sii ninche pooki tung'ani dinari.

English: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip ninche aatang'amu neing'unyung'unyaki ilo openy enkang.

English: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
Masaai: Nejo, ‘Ore kulo ooisiadutua esaa nabo ake etaasishote, nintorisioko iyiook ooting'iria esiaai nagol o ldalati pooki.’

English: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
Masaai: “Newaliki obo lenye ajoki, ‘Olchore eitu nanu aainyal. Keitu duoo kining'okino o iyie dinari?

English: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
Masaai: Imbung'a enino shomo. Amu atonyorrayie aisho ele oisiadua anaa enaaisho iyie.

English: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
Masaai: Aimaaishiaakino te naas anaa enayieu too naainei? Ana keiba enkong'u ino te nkaraki nara nanu aminin?’

English: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
Masaai: “Neijia etiu, keaku ile siadi ile dukuya, neaku ile dukuya ile siadi.”

English: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
Masaai: Ore pee eaku eilep Yesu alo Yerusalem nerik lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena tomon o aare enkilepata te nkoitoi nejoki,

English: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
Masaai: “Ng'ura kilepita aapuo Yerusalem, naa kepiki Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo lapolosak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat neiguanare ninye enkiguana e keeya.

English: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
Masaai: Neisho iloreren meikordodo, near, too nkeenta, neshei neitopiuni te nkolong e uni.”

English: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
Masaai: Nelotu ng'otonye layiok le Sebedayo enetii Yesu eboitare ilayiok lenyena pokira aare neserem eeta enaomonu.

English: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Ainyoo iyieuu?” Nejoki, “Intanapisho metotona kulo ayiok laainei pokira aare obo te nkaina ino e tatene, neton olikae te nkaina e kedianye te nkitoria ino.”

English: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Miyiololo eniomonunu, aa ndimidimi aatook enkikompe naok nanu?” Nejoki, “Ee kindim.”

English: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ee esipa iokioko enkikombe ai kake ore entonata te nkaina ai e tatene ana te ne kedienye, mme nanu oishoru, kake eaku ene lelo ooitobiraka Papa lai.”

English: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
Masaai: Ore pee ening kuldo tomon ina, negorokino lelo alashera pokira aare.

English: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
Masaai: Neipot Yesu ajoki, “Iyiololo aajo, ore laitoriak loo Loreren eitaa ate kituaak, neitoreisho te ngolon.

English: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
Masaai: Ore te intae metiu nejia; kake ore pooki tung'ani te intae oyieu neaku kitok; inchoo eaku olaisiaayiani linyi,

English: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
Masaai: ore oloyieu neaku ole dukuya te intae neaku osinka linyi;

English: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
Masaai: anaa eneitu elotu e nkerai e Tung'ani meisiaai kake eewuo aisiaaisho neitayu enkishui enye metaa elakunoto oo lkumok.”

English: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
Masaai: Ore epuo aaing'uaa Yeriko nesuj olorora kitok.

English: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, etii ltung'ana aare modook ootoni te mbata e nkoitoi, ore pee ening inchere Yesu ilo oimita ine nebuak aajo, “Lo Kitok ara Daudi, ing'urrie iyiook.”

English: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou Son of David.
Masaai: Neisikong olorere ninche aaitigir, kake enyaakita aaitulusoo aabuak aajo, “Lo Kitok ara Daudi, ing'urrie iyiook.”

English: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
Masaai: Neitashe Yesu neipot ninche nejoki, “Kaa iyieuu naitaas intae?”

English: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Lo Kitok, pee eboli iyiook inkonyek.”

English: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
Masaai: Neing'urrie Yesu ninche neiseyie inkonyek enye; nedolishoyu ninche te ina kata nesuj ninye.

English: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
Masaai: Ore pee enyikaki Yerusalem nebaiki Betfage to Ildoinyo loo loirienito neirriwaa Yesu ilooiteng'eni oare, nejoki ninche,

English: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
Masaai: “Enchom enkang natii dukuya intae na idolidolo nabo kata te ine esikiria naena o lkurrarru, entalaku enterewakaki.

English: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
Masaai: Naa te neng'amaa intae oltung'ani entiaaki, ‘Olkitok oatayie enkolat’; nerewakini te ina kata.”

English: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
Masaai: Netaasate nena pee ebaya enatejo oloiboni le Nkai,

English: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
Masaai: “Entiaki entito e Sion, ng'ura, elotu enitii iyie olaiguanani lino, nebor nekedito esikiria, akedito olkurrarru le sikiria.”

English: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
Masaai: Nepuo ilooiteng'eni neas anaa inaitanapa Yesu,

English: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
Masaai: nereu ina sikiria o enkurrarru neirotoki inkilani enye neked Yesu atonie.

English: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
Masaai: Neisalaash ilkumok lo lorora ilkilani lenye te nkoitoi nedung'u kulikae ilng'osil loo lkeek neisalaashaki enkoitoi.

English: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the Son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
Masaai: Ore olorere oituruko o losujita, nebuak aajo, “Hosana, Enkerai e Daudi; metamayiani ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani; Hosana te shumata naisul pooki.”

English: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
Masaai: Ore pee ejing ninye Yerusalem, neing'oling'ola enkang pooki, aajo, “Ai ng'ai ele?”

English: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
Masaai: Nejo esiamo, “Yesu ele, oloiboni le Nkai le Nasaret e Galilaya.”

English: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
Masaai: Nejing Yesu enkaji e Nkai nearaa lelo pooki oomirisho o looinyiang'isho aitupuku te nkaji e Nkai neibeloo mesai oo looitawal mpesai o lorikan loo loomir inturkuluni.

English: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Etisiraki inchere, ore enkaji ai keji enkaji e nkomono kake intaa intae enkapune oo laisimak.”

English: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii ninye ti atua enkaji e Nkai ilmodook o lng'ojiniaa; neishiunye ninye.

English: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the Son of David; they were sore displeased,
Masaai: Kake ore pee edol ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat imbaa e nking'sia naataasa ninye o nkera eilepie iltoiloishi lenye te nkaji e Nkai ejo, “Hosana, Enkerai e Daudi.” Negoro ninche,

English: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
Masaai: nejoki ninye, “Aa ining'ito enajoito kuna?” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ee, keitu isomama ai kata nchere, ‘Intabayie enkisisa too nkutukie oo nkera kutiti naanakisho’?”

English: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
Masaai: Neing'uaa ninche, neipung te ina anasa nelo Betania neirrag ine.

English: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya eloito arrinyokino ina anasa netir esumash.

English: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
Masaai: Nedol olng'aboli te mbata e nkoitoi neiwuang'aki, neitu etumie toki, imbenek ake; nejoki ilo shani, “Tala Ing'anayio ntarasi.” Netoyu nabo kata olng'aboli.

English: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilooiteng'eni ina bae, neing'asia nejo, “Kaji eikuna pee etoyio olng'aboli nabo kata?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu, ajoki, “Esipa ajoki intae, te naa iatata enkirukoto ming'ashing'asha, neme ena ake naitaasaki olng'aboli iasiasa kake ti nijokiki oldoinyo, ‘Tadotunye tanang'akinoyu enaiposha,’ neaku ina.

English: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
Masaai: Ore pooki toki ninkilikuanunu te nkomono te nkirukoto nitumutumu.”

English: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
Masaai: Ore pee ejing enkaji e Nkai nepuonu ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani lo lorere enetii, eiteng'enisho nejoki, “Ai ti aa kidimata ias iyie kuna baa? Naa ai ng'ae likinchoo ena kidimata?”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Aikilikuan sii nanu intae embae nabo, naa tinikiwalikiki, naliki sii nanu intae enkidimata naasie kuna baa.

English: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
Masaai: Amaa, enkibatisa e Yohana, kaji eing'uaa? Keshumata eing'uaa ana iltung'ana?” Nejokino maate, “Te nikijo, ‘Shumata eing'uaa;’ naa kejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?’

English: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
Masaai: Naa ti nikijo, ‘Iltung'ana eing'uaa’ nikiure olorere, amu kejo ltung'ana pooki oloiboni le Nkai Yohana.”

English: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche Yesu aajoki, “Mikiyiolo.” Nejoki sii ninye, “Maliki sii nanu intae enkidimata naasie kuna baa.

English: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
Masaai: “Ijojo aa? Eeta apa oltung'ani ilayiok aare; nelo enetii obo nejoki, ‘Enkerai ai, shomo taata ntayu esiaai te nkurma oo sabibu.’

English: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
Masaai: Neng'amaa ajoki, ‘Malo’ ore te siadi neirridu nelo.

English: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
Masaai: Neitoki alo enetii olikae nejoki neijia. Neng'amaa ilo ajoki, ‘Alo Papa’, kake eitu elo.

English: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
