Masaai: Kalo te lelo pokira aare otaasa enanyor menye?” Nejoki, “Lido le dukuya.” Nejoki Yesu, “Esipa ajoki intae, iloosotu kodi o loololoito oong'as aajing enkitoria e Nkai te dukuya intae.

English: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
Masaai: Amu eewuo Yohana enitii, te nkoitoi e supatisho, neitu irukuruku; kake eiruko iloosotu kodi o loololoito; kake ore pee indolidolo intae ina, neitu irridudu te siadi, aairuk ninye.

English: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
Masaai: “Enining'o sii ai kitanyaanyukoto: Etii apa oltung'ani oata enkang, neun enkurma oo lng'anayio neitaman enkikarrata netur ewueji neironyie lng'anayio, neshetaki oltalet, neing'ueiki ilaturok, nelo ninye paran.

English: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku enkata naku lng'anayio, neirriwaki isinkan lenyena lelo aturok, meishoo lng'anayio lenyena.

English: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
Masaai: Neibung ilaturok isinkan lenyena, neidong obo, near likai metua, near likai too soito.

English: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
Masaai: Neitoki airriwaki kulikae sinkan kumok oolang lelo le dukuya, neiko sii ninche neijia.

English: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
Masaai: Ore te siadi neirriwaki enkerai enye ejo, ‘Keyanyit ninche enkerai ai.’

English: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
Masaai: “Kake ore ake pee edol ilaturok enkerai, nejokino maate, ‘Ele olajung'oni, mataar pee kitum enjung'ore enye.’

English: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
Masaai: Neibung ninye nearaa aaipung'ie oriong enkurma oo lng'anayio near metua.

English: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
Masaai: Amaa kenya te nelotu olopeny ina kurma oo lng'anayio, kaa eitaas lelo aturok?”

English: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Kear oleng lelo tung'ana torrok metuata neisho enkurma oo lng'anayio kulikae aturok ooitabaiki ninye ilng'anayio too rishat enye.”

English: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Keitu ae kata isomama too lkigerot, ‘Ore ilo soit otanyaita lashetak otaa osoit kitok lo lmairroto. Ore ilo rorei naa Olaitoriani eing'uaa, naa ole nking'asia too nkonyek ang.’

English: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee ajoki intae, keoruni intae enkitoria e Nkai aaisho olorere oiki lng'anayio,

English: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
Masaai: naa ore olosulakino ilo soit, negiligil. Ore olosulakino ilo soit ninye neidong aitaa emposio.”

English: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo kuna kitanyaanyukot, neyiolou aajo ninche eipirta.

English: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
Masaai: Ore eing'oru eneiko pee ibung, neureyu olorere amu ejo ninche, oloiboni le Nkai.

English: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu airorie ninche, too nkitanyaanyukot ejo:

English: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
Masaai: “Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa olaiguanani oitobiraka enkerai enye osirua le nkiyama.

English: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
Masaai: Neirriwaa isinkan lenyena meipoto ilooitoomonoki meetu osirua le nkiyama neany ninche epuonu.

English: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
Masaai: Neitoki airriwaa kulikae sinkan ajoki, ‘Entiaki lelo ooipotoki, Eng'ura aidipa aitobira endaa osirua, eyiang'a ilmong'i o lasho oopir eidipate intokitin pooki, wootu osirua le nkiyama.’

English: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
Masaai: Neitu ninche eshilaa ina, nepuo pooki nkolati enye, nelo likae enkurma enye, nelo likai emirare enye.

English: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
Masaai: Ore ilkulikae ootelekutua, neibung isinkan lenyena aainyal near metuata.

English: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
Masaai: Ore pee ening olaiguanani ina negoro oleng, neirriwaa iltimito loo lmurran lenyena metaara lelo tung'ana aarak, nepejoo enkang enye.

English: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
Masaai: Nejoki olopeny enkiyama isinkan lenyena, ‘Eoto indaiki o sirua le nkiyama, kake ore lelo ooipotoki nemeishiaakino.

English: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
Masaai: Enchom ineerishare inkoitoi ore pooki lidolidolo, empotoki osirua le nkiyama.’

English: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
Masaai: Nepuo lelo inkoitoi naalala enkanasa, neiturrurru pooki oonoto ninche, iltorrok o supati, neiput ilomon ina aji e nkiyama.

English: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
Masaai: Nejing'u olaiguanani aing'or ilomon, nedol oltung'ani obo lemeishopito enkila e nkiyama; nejoki,

English: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
Masaai: ‘Olchore kaji nkununye ene miaata enkila e nkiyama?’ Negira

English: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: Nejoki olaiguanani isinkan lenyena, ‘Enteen ninye inkaik o nkejek, ninang'akiki enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.’

English: For many are called, but few are chosen.
Masaai: “Amu kumok ilooipotoki kake ilkuti oogeluno.”

English: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
Masaai: Nepuo ina kata Ilfarisayo aaiguana eneiko pee erresh ninye too nkirorot enyena.

English: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
Masaai: Neirriwaki ninche ninye iloointeng'eni lenye te nebo le Herode aajoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo ira olasipani nintayiolo ltung'ana; enkoitoi e Nkai te sipata amu miing'or empukunoto o ltung'ani. Toliki naa iyiook.

English: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
Masaai: Ijo aa iyie? Kebara ti nikincho Kaisari kodi ana eimebara?”

English: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
Masaai: Kake neyiolou Yesu esunkureisho enye nejoki, “Lo sunkuro, aainyo pee kitemiteme intae?

English: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
Masaai: Entoduaaki empesai e kodi.” Neyaki ninche ninye empisai.

English: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
Masaai: Neikilikuan Yesu ninche ajoki, “Koleng'ae ele oip o ele kigeroto?”

English: They say unto him, Caesar's. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's; and unto God the things that are God's.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ole Kaisari.” Nejoki ina kata, “Enchoo Kaisari ine Kaisari, ninchosho Enkai ine Nkai.”

English: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche ina, neing'asia oleng nepuo aaing'uaa ninye.

English: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
Masaai: Ore te ina olong' nepuonu Isadukayo, lelo oojo meetae empiunoto, neikilikuan aajoki,

English: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
Masaai: “Lo Aiteng'enani, etejo Musa te neye oltung'ani neitu eiu inkera, neyam olalashe enkitok enye aiki olalashe.

English: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
Masaai: Etii apa atua iyiook ilalashera oopishana, neyamisho ole dukuya neye meeta inkera, neing'ueiki olalashe enkitok enye.

English: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
Masaai: Neiko neijia ole aare o le okuni o metabaiki ole oopishana.

English: And last of all the woman died also.
Masaai: Ore te siadi pooki neye sii enkitok.

English: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
Masaai: Amaa, kenya te mpiunoto, keaku enkitok ene ng'ae te lelo oopishana? Amu eyama pooki.”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ipong'oriri amu miyiololo ilkigerot anaa engolon e Nkai.

English: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
Masaai: Amu ore te mpiunoto nemeyamishoi, nemeishoori meyami, kake etiu anaa ilmalaika te keper.

English: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
Masaai: “Kake ore too naaipirta empiunoto oo lootuata, keitu isomama enatiaaka intae Enkai pee ejo,

English: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
Masaai: ‘Ara Enkai e Abraham nara Enkai e Isaak nara Enkai e Yakobo?’ Mme Enkai oo lootuata, enoo looishu.”

English: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
Masaai: Ore pee ening esiamo, neing'asia too nkiteng'enat enyana.

English: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening Ilfarisayo inchere eitigira Isadukayo nepuo aatumo.

English: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
Masaai: Neikilikuan olang'eni obo lenye atem ninye, ajoki,

English: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
Masaai: “Lo Aiteng'enani kaa kitanapata naisul inkitanapat?”

English: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki ote nkishui ino pooki o te ng'eno ino pooki.

English: This is the first and great commandment.
Masaai: Ena kitanapata ene dukuya naa ninye naisul.

English: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: Ore eni are nenyaanyukie naa ena, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.’

English: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
Masaai: Ore kuna kitanapat pokira are ninche naaun nkitanapat o loibonok le Nkai.”

English: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
Masaai: Ore pee eiturrurro lelo Farisayo neikilikuan Yesu ninche ajoki,

English: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
Masaai: “Ijojo aa too mbaa e Kristo? Kole ng'ae?” Nejoki, “Ole Daudi.”

English: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Kaji naa etiu pee eipot Daudi te Nkiyang'et Sinyati ajo ‘Olaitoriani’, ejo,

English: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
Masaai: ‘Etiaaka Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani lai, Totona te tatene ai, metaba anaa naitadou ilmang'ati linono apik abori nkejek inono.’

English: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
Masaai: Amaa naa te naa kejo Daudi ninye Olaitoriani, kaji eiko pee eitoki ninye aaku enkerai enye?”

English: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
Masaai: Nemetii ho obo oidima atawaliki ninye ororei hoo obo, nemetii oltung'ani ebaiki ina olong onyaaka aitieu aikilikuana likai rorei.

English: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
Masaai: Neirorie Yesu ina kata siamon o looiteng'eni lenyena ajoki,

English: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat:
Masaai: “Laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo ootonita to lorika le Musa.

English: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
Masaai: Ore imbaa pooki naajoki ninche intae entaas, niaasiasa; amu eiro ninche nemeas.

English: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
Masaai: Amu eeniki ilolan sapuki ooiroishi aaiteleiki iloilila loo ltung'ana; nemeyieu ninche neigusie to lkimojino lenye.

English: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
Masaai: Neas isiaaitin enye pooki pee edol iltung'ana, amu eitalala lkerreti lenye neitulus enkikodo oo nkilani enye.

English: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
Masaai: Nenyor iwuejitin enkanyit too siruai, o lorikan sidain tiatua inkajijik entumo,

English: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
Masaai: neshipa te neirorokini too wuejitin neemirishoreki, nenyor te neipoti aajo ‘Olaiteng'enani’.

English: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
Masaai: Kake eminchosho eipoti intae aajo ‘Olaiteng'enani’ amu obo olaiteng'enani linyi, nirara pooki ilalashera.

English: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
Masaai: Nimijojo oltung'ani papa te nkop, amu obo Papa linyi otii keper.

English: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
Masaai: Niminchosho eji intae ilarikok amu obo olarikoni linyi naa Kristo.

English: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
Masaai: Ore ilo ora kitok te intae, keaku osinka linyi.

English: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
Masaai: Ore oloilepie kewan, neitadouni; ore oloitadou kewan neilepieki.

English: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
Masaai: “Oi! intae sunkuro loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo! amu irishieshie ltung'ana enkitoria e keper, nimijing'jing'i intae maate, ore ilooyieu nejing, nimitikiki ejing.

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
Masaai: ‘Ee kake ayia! sunkuro o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o Lfarisayo, amu idaarere nkajijik oo nkolia, niomonono enkomono naado aaitaakuno; ore enkaraki ina itumutumu enkiguana nagol oleng.’

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak olfarisayo isunkuro! amu imanimana naaiposha o enkop natoyio aaing'oru obo osuj intae, ore pee eibelekenya, nintaa ninye ololmoti le nkima katitin are alang ninye intae.

English: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilarikok modook oojo, ‘Te nenyayie oltung'ani enkaji e Nkai olmumai neme toki; kake te nenyayie olmumai sahabu e nkaji e Nkai neen ilo mumai.’

English: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
Masaai: Lo moda modook; kaa nalusoo, ai sahabu ana kenkaji e Nkai naitisiny ina sahabu?

English: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
Masaai: Ijojo sii ore oloinosie olmumai olperere lo lasar, neme toki kake ore oloinosie olmunmai enkishorunoto natii olperere lo lasar, neen ilo mumai.

English: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
Masaai: Lo tung'ana modook, kaa nalusoo, e ina kishorunoto ana kolperere lo lasar oitisiny ina kishorunoto?

English: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
Masaai: Ore oloinosie olmumai olperere lo lasar, einosie olperere lo lasar o pooki toki natii enchumata enye.

English: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
Masaai: Ore oloinosie olmumai enkaji e Nkai neinosie o ilo obik ti atua.

English: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
Masaai: Ore oloinosie keper olmumai neinosie olorika le nkitoo le Nkai neinosie ilo otonita.

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak o lfarisayo isunkuro! amu intayuyu ematua e tomon oe nkorropil o sinantei o empeu naitorropil endaa, nitapalaitie mbaa kituaak oo nkitanapat, aa isipat e nkiguana, o lng'ur o enkirukoto; kuna eishiaakino nitaasa nimipalipala nena kulie.

English: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
Masaai: Lo arikok modook, isilisili enkojong'ani nimurgutaa entames!

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak o lfarisayo sunkuro amu isujusuju oriong enkikompe o engirra kake ebore atua intae eului o enkarri nemeeta enkiririkinoto.

English: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
Masaai: Lo Farisayoi modooni! tang'asa isuja atua enkikompe o engirra pee etum sii oriong ataa sidai.

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak olfarisayo! amu itiuu intae anaa nkuraren naaelieki enturoto meiborra, nedoli anaa ai sidain ti oriong kake ore atua eiputa loik loo lmeneng'a o loirerioni pooki.

English: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
Masaai: Naa neijia sii itiuwu intae, edoli intae ti oriong aaijo irara supati kake ore ti atua, nebore esunkureisho o enkarruoisho.

English: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia! ilasirak o lfarisayo isunkuro amu ishetishete inkuraren oo loibonok ninkodikodo inkuraren e lelo oiloonok le Nkai,

English: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
Masaai: nijojo, ‘Te naa ai kitii apa too nkolong'i oo loo Papa, anaata eitu kishulare ninche te nkibukoroto osarge loo loibonok.’

English: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
Masaai: Nitaa intae shakeni nchere irara inkera e lelo ootara lelo oibonok le Nkai.

English: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
Masaai: Emputa eneitong'oro iloo minyi.

English: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
Masaai: Naishoi oo lasuriaa o nturbubuani, kaji inkoko pee ilanyilanya enkiguana o lmoti le nkima.

English: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
Masaai: “Ore enkaraki ena, eng'urai airriwaki intae iloibonok o ltung'ana ng'eni o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat; niariara kulikae, metuata nisheshe, niariara kulikae too nkajijik inyi e ntumo, niaraa kulikae too nkang'itie aaisikie;

English: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
Masaai: pee etum ainepu intae osarge loo ltung'ana le Nkai oibukori te nkop ebaiki osarge le Abel lemeeta entiyoto, o metabaiki osarge le Sakaria le Barakia litaara intae te rishata ewueji sinyati o olperere lo lasar.

English: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, kepuonu kuna baa pooki shumata kulo tung'ana le na kata.

English: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
Masaai: “Woi Yerusalem, Yerusalem naar iloibonok le Nkai, nenang too soito lelo ooirriwakini ninye! Ai katitin aja atonyuaa ajo aiturrur inkera inono anaa enkuku naiturrur inkuoo enyena too naipuko enyena, nitanyaita!

English: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
Masaai: Neina enkaji inyi natung'eikiaki eliyio.

English: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
Masaai: Amu ajoki intae, mikintokiki aadol katukul, metaba anaa nijojo, ‘Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani.’ ”

English: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
Masaai: Nepuku Yesu te nkaji e Nkai alo, nepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena enetii pee eitodol enchetunoto e nkaji e Nkai.

English: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ai midolitata kuna pooki? Esipa ajoki intae meing'uari te ne wueji osoit obo te shumata olikae, lemesulakini enkop.”

English: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
Masaai: Ore eton to ldoinyo loo loirienito, nepuonu enetii ilooiteng'eni too nkurrat nejoki, “Toliki iyiook ajo kanu ebau kuna baa? Naa ainyoo olmonekie le lotunoto ino o ene nkiting'oto e na kop?”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Yesu nejoki, “Entorrip ate meitapong'oo intae oltung'ani.

English: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
Masaai: Amu kepuonu ilkumok te nkarna ai oojo, ‘Ara nanu Kristo,’ neitapong'oo ilkumok.

English: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
Masaai: Naa aining'ining'i intae ilarrabali o mbaa oo njoreitin eimakini, naa entodol ake emirut amu meeta inchere pee mebau kuna baa; kake eton eng'or enkiting'oto.

English: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
Masaai: Amu kedumakino olorere olikae orere, nedumakino enkitoria enkae kitoria; naa kepuonu ilameitin o nkikirikirat e nkop too wuejitin kumok.

English: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
Masaai: Kake ore nena baa pooki naa ine nkiterunoto oo sinaitin.

English: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
Masaai: Te ina kata taa eishoori intae meisilisili neari intae entuata; neibayu intae iloreren pooki te nkaraki enkarna ai.

English: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
Masaai: “Te ina kata taa errorro ilkumok nekaldaa olikae olikae, neibayuno ninche maate.

English: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
Masaai: Naa kepuku iloibonok kumok le lejare neiminie lkumok.

English: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
Masaai: Naa ore te nkaraki naponari entorroni neiropiju enyorrata oo lkumok.

English: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
Masaai: “Kake ore olongiri ometabaiki enkiting'oto nejeu.

English: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
Masaai: Naa kelikiori kulo omon supati le na kitoria e Nkai te nkop pooki metaa shakenisho too loreren pooki; ore ina kata nebau enkiting'oto.

English: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
Masaai: “Ore pee idolidolo ina torroni nabau e mutata natolimuo oloiboni le Nkai oji Daniel eitashe te wueji sinyati. (Inchoo ilo oisomita metayiolo.)

English: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
Masaai: Ore ina kata lootii Yudea neipukoki ldoinyo.

English: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
Masaai: Ore olotii shumata enkaji nemedou alo aitayu intokitin te nkaji enye.

English: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
Masaai: Ore olotii enkurma nemeshukunye adumu enkila enye.

English: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
Masaai: Wooi nena naairoshiutuo o naaitanakisho te nena olong'i!

English: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
Masaai: Entoomon pee meaku enaipuk inyi ene nkata o loirujuruj anaa enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.

English: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
Masaai: Amu keaku elotu ina kata entaboi sapuk neitu ae kata etumi, anaa pee eiteruni enkop o taata, nemeitoki aaku katukul.

English: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.
Masaai: Naa te neme keitodorropaki nena olong'i anaata mejeu toki naishu; kake ore te nkaraki oo lgelunot lenyena eitodorropaki nena olong'i.

English: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
Masaai: “Te nejoki intae ina kata oltung'ani, ‘Nele Kristo otii ene!’, anaa ‘Nelido otii idie!’; emiruk.

English: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
Masaai: Amu kepuonu ilooitaa ate ilkristoi te lejare o looitaakuno loibonok ooitoduaaya ilmonek o nenking'asia kituaak o ne nking'asia pee te naa keidimayu naaji neiminie ninche lelo gelunot le Nkai.

English: Behold, I have told you before.
Masaai: Ng'ura aidipa atoliki intae te dukuya eitu abau.

English: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
Masaai: Metaa te nejoki intae, ‘Ng'ura, etii ong'ata’, emipuku; anaa, ‘Ng'ura etii lgilat li atua aji’ emiruk.

English: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enatiu enkiwuang'ata naing'uaa eneilepunye enkolong nelioyu te nedoyiorie; neijia etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.

English: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
Masaai: Amu enetii empopok eiturrurrokino lmotonyi.

English: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
Masaai: “Ore ake pee eish isinaitin le nena olong'i, neitomisimisi enkolong nemeitoki olapa awang'u, nesulunye ilakir to loing'ang'e, neigirigiro engolon o loing'ang'e.

English: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
Masaai: Nelioyu ina kata olmonekie le Nkerai e Tung'ani te keper neaku olkiyioi lo lauui too loreren pooki le nkop, nedoli Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu too nkatampo e keper te ngolon o te nkitoo sapuk.

English: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
Masaai: Naa keirriwaa ninye ilmalaika lenyena te ndarata kitok e ntarumpeta meiturrurru ilgelunot lenyena too lubot pokira ong'uan naaing'uaa osiwuo, neitung'uaa ineeiting'ie keper, too lubot pooki.

English: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
Masaai: “Entuutarie ate enkitanyaanyukoto o lng'aboli ore te neiteru aitayu imbenek niyiolouu aajo etinyikua olodalu.

English: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
Masaai: Ore sii intae ti nidolidolo nena pooki, entayiolo aajo etinyikua, ee etii inkutukie oo nkajijik.

English: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, meishari kulo tung'ana le na kata eitu ebau kuna baa.

English: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
Masaai: Keish shumata o enkop kake meish irorei laainei katukul.

English: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
Masaai: “Kake meetae oloyiolo ina olong anaa ina saa, aa ilmalaika le shumata anaa Enkerai, Papa ake oyiolo.

English: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enatiu apa too nkolong'i e Noa, neijia sii etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.

English: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
Masaai: Amu ore te nena olong'i eton etioyo oloirrag le nkare, kedaae, neokishoi, neyamishoe, neishoori meyami, o metabau ina olong natijing'a Noa esafina,

English: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
Masaai: neitu eyiolou o meeu oloirrag le nkare aya pooki; neijia sii etiu elotunoto e Nkerai e Tung'ani.

English: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
Masaai: Ore ina kata te netii ilewa oare enkurma, neyae obo neing'uari olikae.

English: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
Masaai: Neiutuutisho nkituaak are to soit neyai nabo neing'uari enkae.

English: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
Masaai: “Entorripisho naa, amu miyiolo enkolong nalotu Olaitoriani linyi.

English: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
Masaai: Kake iyiololo aajo, te naa keyiolo olopeny enkaji enkata nalotu olapurroni, anaata etorripishe pee meisho enkaji enye metigili.

English: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
Masaai: Enterretenata sii intae; amu te nkata niminteikiki elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
Masaai: “Kalo naa sinka ilo oisiligayu naa ng'en otung'eikia olkitok lenye enkaji enye, meitotio ltung'ana te nkata naishiaakino?

English: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo sinka laa te nelotu olkitok lenye nenyorriki easita enatung'eikia.

English: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, eisho meitoria intokitin enyena pooki.

English: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
Masaai: Kake te nejo ilo sinka torrono to ltau lenye, ‘Keimutie olkitok lai’;

English: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
Masaai: neng'as aar isinkan ooboitare, nedaa neokisho te nebo lamerak;

English: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
Masaai: kelotu olkitok le ilo sinka te nkolong nemeiteikini o te saa nemeyiolo,

English: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: naa kedung'udung neitaboitaki sunkuro. Neaku enkishirata oenyoto oo lala.

English: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
Masaai: “Etiu enkitoria e keper anaa ntoyie tomon, naatudumutua ltaai lenye aapuo aanang'are oloyamisho.

English: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
Masaai: Ore imiet nemoda, ore inkulie imiet naa ng'eni.

English: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
Masaai: Amu ore nekua naamoda ewaita iltaai lenye neitu eya eilata

English: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
Masaai: Ore nekua ng'eni, neya eilata too ltuleta lenye te nebo iltaai.

English: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
Masaai: Ore pee eimutie oloyamisho, neimug pooki neirura.

English: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
Masaai: Ore te mpolos e nkewarrie, nebuaki aajo, ‘Neilo oloyamisho, entupuku entanang'are.’

English: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
Masaai: Neinyototo ina kata nena toyie aaitobir iltaai lenye.

English: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
Masaai: Nejoki naamoda kunda ng'eni, ‘Enchoo iyiook enkiti ilata inyi; amu keye iltaai lang.’

English: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
Masaai: Kake newaliki ng'eni nejoki, ‘Aa mebaiki iyiook o intae; neikash ti nipuopuo enetii loomir aainyang'aki ate.’

English: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
Masaai: Ore pee einyototo aapuo aainyiang'u, nebau olayamisho, nejing nena naaterretenate tenebo oloyamisho atua osirua le nkiyama; neikeni kutuk aji.

English: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
Masaai: Neitoki te siadi aapuonu nekua toyie aajo, ‘Lo kitok, Lo, kitok, tabolu iyiook.’

English: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, ‘Esipa ajoki, intae, mayiolo intae.’

English: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
Masaai: Entorripisho, naa, amu miyiololo intae ina olong aashu esaa.

English: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
Masaai: “Amu etiu anaa te neyieu oltung'ani nelo enkop nalakua neipot isinkan lenyena neitaaki ntokitin enyena.

English: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
Masaai: Neitaaki obo talanta imiet, neitaaki olikae are neitaaki likae nabo; aisho pooki tung'ani anaa enkidimata enye; nelo.

English: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
Masaai: Ore lido oitaakaki talanta imiet nelo nabo kata aasishore netum kulie talanta imiet.

English: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
Masaai: Netumie sii elde oitaakaki are kulie are.

English: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.
Masaai: Kake ore elde oitaakaki nabo, nelo aturoo aisudoo empesai o lkitok lenye.

English: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie enkata naado nelotu olkitok le lelo sinkan, neyieu esiana oo ntokitin enyena.

English: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
Masaai: Neng'asunye oloitaakaki talanta imiet ayau kulie talanta imiet; nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok kinchoo talanta imiet; ng'ura anoto kulie imiet.’

English: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
Masaai: Nejoki olkitok lenye, ‘Ee osinka supat laisilig, itaa oloisiligayu too nkuti, kaaisho intoria kumok; tijing'a eng'ida o lkitok lino.’

English: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
Masaai: Nelotu oloitaakaki talanta are nejoki, ‘Lo Kitok, kintaaka talanta are, ing'ora, anotie kulie are.’

English: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
Masaai: Nejoki olkitok lenye, ‘Ai sidai enitaasa iyie osinka supat oisiligayu; tijing'a eng'ida o lkitok lino.’

English: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
Masaai: Nelotu sii elde oitaakaki talanta nabo nejo, ‘Lo Kitok, ayiolo ajo ira iyie oltung'ani ogol odung ineitu iun, ninturrur ineitu isuaaya.

English: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
Masaai: Neaku atureishe nanu nalo aturoo aisudoo ina talanta ino ti atua enkop, ing'ura, nena enino inko.’

English: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
Masaai: Neng'amaa olkitok lenye ajoki, ‘Lo sinka torrono oshal, itayiolo ajo adung ineitu aun, nasotu ineitu aisuaaya;

English: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
Masaai: anaata naa inchoo ina pesai ai lelo ooasishore pee te alotu natum enaai o kulie.

English: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
Masaai: Entooru naa ina talanta enchoo ilo oata talanta tomon.

English: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki ota neponikini pee eaku naata kumok, kake ore olemeeta, ore ninye enda naata neoruni.

English: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Masaai: Entanang'aki ilo sinka le meeta tipat enaimin e auluo; neaku enkishirata o eonyoto oo lala.’

English: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
Masaai: “Ore te nelotu Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkitoo enye, eboitare ilmalaika pookin, neton ina kata to lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
Masaai: Neiturrurrukino loreren pooki dukuya ninye negel ninche anaa olchekut ogelu nkerra arishie nkineji.

English: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
Masaai: Nepik nkerra enkaina enye e tatene, nepik inkineji ene kedianye.

English: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
Masaai: Naa kejoki ina kata olaiguanani lelo ootii enkaina enye e tatene, ‘Wootu intae ilootamayiana Papa lai, entujung enkitoria naitobirakaki apa intae apa ebaiki enkiterunoto e nkop.

English: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
Masaai: Amu aata apa esumash nikinchosho endaa; naata enkure nikinchosho enaok; nara omoni nikirikiriki ang;

English: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
Masaai: nemaishopo nikinchopishopo; namuei nikirumurumu, naena nikibaikiki.’

English: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
Masaai: Neng'amaa ina kata ltung'ana le Nkai aajoki, ‘Lo kitok, kanu kitaduaa iyie iata esumash nikintoti iyie? Aashu iata enkure nikintook iyie?

English: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
Masaai: Ana kanu kitaduaa iyie ira omoni nikirik iyie ang? Anaa minchopo nikinchop iyie?

English: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
Masaai: Ana kanu kitaduaa iyie imuei anaa iena nikibaiki iyie?

English: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
Masaai: Naa keng'amaa olaiguanani ajoki, ‘Esipa, ajoki intae, ore anaa enintaasa lelo alashera laainei ooti, nanu intaasa.’

English: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu ina kata ajoki ilootii enkaina enye e kedienye, ‘Enyeito intae entung'uayioki iloodiaa, enchom enkima oo ntarasi naitobirakaki shetani o lmalaika lenyena.

English: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
Masaai: Amu aata apa esumash neitu kintotiti; naata enkure neitu kinchosho enaok.

English: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
Masaai: Nara omoni neitu kirikiriki ang; nemaishopo neitu kinchopishopo; namuei, naena neitu kibaikiki.’

English: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
Masaai: Neng'amaa sii ninche aajoki, ‘Kanu kitaduaa iyie iata esumash, anaa enkure, anaa ira omoni, anaa minchopo, anaa imuei anaa iena neitu kisiai iyie?’

English: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
Masaai: Naa keng'amaa ajoki, ‘Esipa ajoki intae, ore anaa eneitu intaasiasa obo le kulo ooti, nanu eitu intaasiasa.’

English: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
Masaai: Naa kepuo ninche enkitamioto oo ntarasi; nejing iltung'ana le Nkai enkishui nemeish.”

English: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu lelo rorei pooki, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena,

English: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
Masaai: “Iyiololo aajo inkolong'i are naatiooyo pee eaku Pasaka, naa keishoori Enkerai e Tung'ani metashei.”

English: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
Masaai: Neiturrurro lapolosak kituaak o lpayiani te wueji olapolosani kitok oji Kaiafa;

English: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
Masaai: neiguana maate te nebo pee etum aaibung'a Yesu to losek aataar metua.

English: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
Masaai: Neitoki aajo, “Neme to sirua pee mejing olong'oling'oli atua ltung'ana.”

English: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
Masaai: Ore etii Betania enkaji e Simon le nkeeya oo lbolot,

English: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
Masaai: nelotu enetii ninye enkitok naata oltulet lo soit oji alabasta le ilata narropil nagol enkinyang'a nebukoki elukunya enye te ine einosita endaa.

English: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilooiteng'eni lenyena ina negoro naleng nejo, “Ijo meima ena ilata siu?

English: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
Masaai: Amu anaata etimiraki aainosie mpesai kumok pee eishori ilaisinak.”

English: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
Masaai: Kake etayiolo Yesu ina nejoki, “Aainyo pee intanyamalala ena kitok? Naa esupat aaitaasa.

English: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
Masaai: Amu iatata ilaisinak anaa ake kake mikiatata nanu anaa ake.

English: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
Masaai: “Amu ore ina ilata narropil naatubukoko, osesen lai eitobiraki enukaroto.

English: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, ore pooki wueji nelikiorieki ele rorei supat te nkop pooki, naa keimakini ena naaitaasa ena kitok metaa enadamunyeki ninye.”

English: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
Masaai: Nelo ina kata obo te lelo tomon o aare oji Yudas Iskariot enetii ilapolosak kituaak,

English: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
Masaai: nejoki, “Ainyoo kinchosho te naitarasaki intae ninye?” Nelaaki ninche impisai tomoni uni e nkosholai.

English: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata neing'oru erishata nakaldare ninye.

English: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e dukuya o sirua loo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki, nepuonu ilooiteng'eni enetii Yesu nejoki, “Kaji kintobiraki iyie pee inyayie osirua le Pasaka?”

English: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Entijing enkanasa enchom enetii oltung'ani oje entiaki, ‘Eji Olaiteng'enani, etinyikua enkiririkinoto e nkata ai; te nkaji ino aitobir Pasaka te nebo o looiteng'eni laainei.’ ”

English: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
Masaai: Neas ilooiteng'eni ina natiaka Yesu, neitobiraki Pasaka.

English: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku tara, neton te misa tenebo looiteng'eni lenyena tomon aare.

English: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
Masaai: Ore einosita endaa nejoki, “Esipa ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi.”

English: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
Masaai: Neisinanuo oleng neikilikuana moo obo, “Ai nanu sa Lo Kitok?”

English: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Elde oitadoikio enkaina enye engirra te nebo nanu, ninye laakaldaa nanu.

English: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
Masaai: Elo Enkerai e Tung'ani anaa enatisiraki, kake, ee kake ayia elde la ninye oitarasaa Enkerai e Tung'ani. Enaikash apa te neitu eini.”

English: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Yudas laa ninye oishooyie ajoki, “Aijo, sa ai nanu, Olaiteng'enani?” Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie otejo.”

English: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
Masaai: Ore einosita endaa nedumu Yesu emukate nemayian negiligil; neisho ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejo, “Enkoito enosa; osesen lai ele.”

English: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
Masaai: Nedumu enkikompe, neisho Enkai enashe, neitarasaki ninche nejoki, “Entook pooki;

English: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
Masaai: amu osarge lai ele lo sotua oibukori te nkaraki oo lkumok te mpalakinoto oo ng'ok.

English: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
Masaai: Ajoki intae, ore ebaiki taata, maitoki ae kata aok enaisho oo lng'anayio loo sabibu o metabau enkolong naok eokoto ng'ejuk te nebo intae te Nkitoria e Papa.”

English: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
Masaai: Ore pee erany osinkolio neipung aapuo oldoinyo loo Loirienito.

English: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ore tena kewarie, naa aikisikisiki pooki aaing'uaa nanu amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaosh olchekut neisardaka emboo oo nkerra.’

English: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
Masaai: Kake ore pee aaitopiuni naituruk alo Galilaya.”

English: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
Masaai: Newaliki Petero ajoki, “Te naa aiking'uaa pooki, maaing'uaa aekata nanu.

English: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Esipa aajoki iyie, ore te na kewarie, eitu eru olkuku, nikimiki iyie katitin uni.”

English: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero, “Te naa kaye te nebo iyie maamiki nanu iyie.” Nejo sii neijia ilooiteng'eni pooki.

English: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
Masaai: Nelotu Yesu o ninche ewueji neji Getsemane nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Entotoni te ne mashomo ende aomon.”

English: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
Masaai: Nerik Petero o layiok pokira aare le Sebedayo. Neiteru aisinanuo nenyamalu oltau.

English: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eeta oltau lai osina kitok o metaa kaye; entotoni te ne enchololoto te nebo nanu.”

English: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
Masaai: Nelo penyo aigut neirrabalakino enkop neomon nejo, “Papa lai, te naa keidimayu intapaashaki ena kikompe, kake mme anaa enayieu nanu kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”

English: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
Masaai: Nelotu enetii ilooiteng'eni neinepu eirurate, nejoki Yesu Petero, “Amaa ai mindimidimi hoo aaishololoto te nebo nanu esaa nabo?

English: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
Masaai: Enchololoto niomonono pee mijing'ijing'i intemat; esipa eyieu oltau, kake eshal osesen.”

English: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
Masaai: Neitoki alo enkata e are neomon nejo, “Papa lai, te nemeidimayu pee aapaash ena kikompe eitu aok, inchoo metotiwuo anaa eniyieu.”

English: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu, neinepu ninche eirurate, amu eiroshiutuo inkonyek enye.

English: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
Masaai: Neitoki aing'uaa ninche nelo aomon enkata e uni te lelo ake rorei.

English: Then cometh he to his disciples, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
Masaai: Neitoki ashukokino ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejoki, “Keton doi ake irurara aayeng'iyeng'a! Eng'ura etinyikua esaa napikieki Enkerai e Tung'ani inkaik oo looata ng'ok.

English: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that doth betray me.
Masaai: Enyeito emaape; eng'ura, nelde olaakaldaa otabawua.”

English: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
Masaai: Ore eirorita, ng'ura, nelotu Yudas laa obo le lelo tomon o aare, eboitare empikas sapuk naata lalema o siaren ooing'uaa lapolosak o lpayiani lo lorere.

English: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
Masaai: Naa ore ilo oitarasayie eidipa aishoo ninche olmonekie ejoki, “Ore elde lang'utut, ninye ilo embung'a.”

English: And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
Masaai: Nelo ina kata enetii Yesu nejoki, “Supa Olaiteng'enani;” neng'utut.

English: And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore art thou come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Olchore, ainyoo pee itii ene? tasioki taasa ina nikiyawua.” Nepuonu taa enetii neibung aakurraki.

English: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
Masaai: Neshutu obo le lelo ooboitare Yesu olalem, neosh osinka lo lapolosani nedung'u enkiok.

English: Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again thy sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Tushukoki olalem lino enchashur amu ore pooki oibung olalem nemuta to lalem.

English: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
Masaai: Aijo iyie eimaidim atasayia Papa maairriwaki nabo kata mpuot tomon o aare oo lmalaika?

English: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
Masaai: Paa kaji naa eiko pee eitabari ilkigerot nemeeta nchere pee eitu ebaya?”

English: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and ye laid no hold on me.
Masaai: Ore ina kata nejoki Yesu ina siamo, “Aikipuonunu aaibung iatata ilalema o siaren anaa ilooibung olaisimani? Natii oshi ake enkaji e Nkai aiteng'enisho neitu kimbung'ubung'u?”

English: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
Masaai: Kake etaasate kuna pooki pee ebaya ilkigerot loo loibonok le Nkai. Neilanyisho ina kata ilooiteng'eni pooki aaing'uaa.

English: And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooibung'a Yesu nerikoki olapolosani kitok, oji Kaiafas, enotote te ine laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat o lpayiani.

English: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
Masaai: Kake esujita Petero ninye te nelakua, o metabaiki olgoriet lo lapolosani kitok. Ore pee ejing atua, neton ninye te nebo ilarripok adol eneiting'oki.

English: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death;
Masaai: Neing'oru ilapolosak kituaak o enkiguana pooki shakenisho e lejare naiteeniki Yesu pee eari metua.

English: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
Masaai: Kake eitu etum hoo pito hoo neetuo lchakenini kumok le lejare.

English: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nepuonu aare ootejo, “Etejo ele tung'ani kaidim atigila enkaji e Nkai naitoki ashet too nkolong'i uni.”

English: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
Masaai: Neitashe olapolosani kitok ajoki ninye. “Aimeeta eniwalu? Kakua baa kuna nikinteeniki kulo tung'ana?”

English: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.
Masaai: Kake etigire Yesu. Nejoki taa olapolosani kitok, “Aainosie olmumai te Nkai naishu, toliki iyiook te naa ira iyie Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai.”

English: Jesus saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie otejo; kake ajoki intae, ore ebaiki taata idolidolo Enkerai e Tung'ani eton te nkaina e tatene naata engolon edou too nkatampo e shumata!”

English: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He hath spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now ye have heard his blasphemy.
Masaai: Nepolos olapolosani kitok ilkilani lenyena nejo, “Etamorishe ele, ainyoo shakenisho neton kiyieu? Itoning'o emorore enye.

English: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
Masaai: Ijojo aa?” Newaliki aajoki, “Keiririkino ele tung'ani keeya.”

English: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
Masaai: Ore te ina kata nenotaki enkomom neikum, nedam, neosh kulikae te ndap.

English: Saying, Prophesy unto us, thou Christ, Who is he that smote thee?
Masaai: Ejoki, “Kristo, imbonoki yiook, ai ng'ae likitoosho?”

English: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
Masaai: Neton Petero te boo to olgoriet. Nelo enkaisiaayiani enetii nejoki, “Ira sii iyie obo loo loboitare Yesu le Galilaya.”

English: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what thou sayest.
Masaai: Nemiki ninye te dukuya ninche pooki ejo, “Maiyiolo enijoito.”

English: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
Masaai: Ore pee eipung alo entaloishi e kishomi nedol ai tito ninye nejoki ilootii ine, “Eiriamariyie sii ele tung'ani Yesu le Nasaret.”

English: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
Masaai: Neitoki anya olmumai amiki ajo, “Maiyiolo ilo tung'ani.”

English: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely thou also art one of them; for thy speech bewrayeth thee.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti kata nepuonu lelo ooitashoo te ine nejoki Petero, “Esipa ira sii iyie obo le lelo; amu aikilikioo ororei lino.”

English: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
Masaai: Neiteru, adek kewan nenya olmumai nejo, “Maiyiolo ilo tung'ani.” Neru nabo kata olkuku.

English: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
Masaai: Nedamu Petero lido rorei otiaaka Yesu inchere, “Ore eitu eru olkuku, aikimiki katitin uni.” Neipung alo aishir te mion.

English: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu, netumo ilapolosak pooki o lpayiani lo lorere neiguanare pee ear Yesu metua.

English: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
Masaai: Neen ninye nerik aaitarasaki olbalusui oji Pilato.

English: Then Judas, which had betrayeth him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
Masaai: Ore Yudas ilo oitarasayie pee edol ajo eidipaki aaiguanare, neitoki ainosu neshuku nena pisai tomoni uni e nkosholai ashukoki ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani,

English: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see thou to that.
Masaai: ejo, “Aitarruoyie aitarasayie oltung'ani lemeeta entiyoto metari.” Kake etiaakita ninche, “Ainyoo natii ninche iyiook? Iyie ine.”

English: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
Masaai: Nenang'aki nena pisai e nkosholai atua enkaji e Nkai neipung; nelo agor kewan.

English: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
Masaai: Nedumu ilapolosak nena pisai enkosholai nejo, “Mebara ti nikipik olbene le Nkai amu osarge einosieki.”

English: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in.
Masaai: Neiguana te nebo neinyiang'unye enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo pee enukarieki iltung'ana leeiking'a.

English: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee eji ina kurma, enkurma o sarge o taata.

English: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value;
Masaai: Ina kata eitabayioki ina natejo oloiboni le Nkai oji Yeremia pee ejo, “Neya ninche impisai tomoni uni e nkosholai nainosieki ilo otudung'oki enkinyiang'a, otudung'okito enkinyiang'a lkulikae ayiok le Israel.

English: And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me.
Masaai: Neishooyo aainosie enkurma o laitobirani loo motioo anaa enaaitanapa nanu Olaitoriani.”

English: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
Masaai: Neitasheyieki Yesu te dukuya olbalusui neikilikuan olbalusui ninye ajoki, “Aa ira iyie olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Nejoki Yesu, “Iyie ojo.”

English: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
Masaai: Ore pee eitang'or ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani, neitu hoo ewaliki.

English: Then said Pilate unto him, Hearest thou not how many things they witness against thee?
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato, “Ai mining eneba imbaa nikinteenikini?”

English: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
Masaai: Kake eitu ewaliki te mbae hoo nabo, o meing'asiayu olbalusui oleng.

English: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
Masaai: Naa ore apa ake to sirua le Pasaka, naa kelaaki olbalusui esiamo oltung'ani obo oena anaa oloyieu ninche.

English: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
Masaai: Netii ina kata oltung'ani obo yioloti te nkarruisho oena oji Barabas.

English: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will ye that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ?
Masaai: Ore pee etumo, nejoki Pilato ninche, “Kalo iyieuu nalaaki intae? Ai Barabas anaa Yesu oji Kristo?”

English: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
Masaai: Amu eyiolo ajo to lom eishooitie ninye.

English: When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have thou nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.
Masaai: Ore pee eton Pilato to lorika le nkiguana neirriwaki enkitok enye olkilikuai ajoki, “Toduaa miaas ae te ilo tung'ani lemeeta entiyoto amu atanyamala duoo too mbaa kumok te nkidetidet te nkaraki ninye.”

English: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.
Masaai: Kake etukurrakita ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani lolorere metoomonu Barabas, neishooyo Yesu metaari.

English: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.
Masaai: Neitoki ake olbalusui ajoki ninche, “Kaing'ae te kulo pokira aare iyieuu nalaaki intae?” Nejo, “Barabas.”

English: Pilate saith unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato, “Kaa naa aitaas Yesu oji Kristo?” Nejoki pooki, “Inchooi metashei.”

English: And the governor said, Why, what evil hath he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified.
Masaai: Nejo, “Aainyo, kaa torroni etaasa ninye?” Neitoki aaitulusoo aabuak aajo, “Inchoo metashei.”

English: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see ye to it.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Pilato ajo meeta ae naidim ataasa, kake keponari ake oloilole nedumu enkare, neisuj inkaik te dukuya olorere nejo, “Maata taa nanu entiyoto to sarge lele tung'ani eng'urai maate ena bae.”

English: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.
Masaai: Newal iltung'ana pooki aajo, “Inchoo osarge lenye meeu shumata iyiook o nkera ang.”

English: Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified.
Masaai: Nelaaki te ina kata Barabas; neari Yesu too nkeenta, neishori metashei.

English: Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers.
Masaai: Nerik isikarini lo lbalusui Yesu atua enkaji o lbalusui naji Praitorio neiturrurrokinote oltim pooki.

English: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
Masaai: Neoru nkilani enyena neishopoki olkila onyokie.

English: And when they had platted a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!
Masaai: Neshetu olmarisian loo lkiku nepik elukunya enye, nepik entiyani enkaina enye e tatene, negilaki kung aakueniyie nejoki, “Supa olaiguanani loo Lyahudi!”

English: And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and smote him on the head.
Masaai: Nenotaki ninye neoru ina tiyani naibung'ita, neoshioshie endukuya enye.

English: And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatakueniyie, neoru olkila onyokie neishopoki nkilani enyena, nerik ninye aapuo aashe.

English: And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross.
Masaai: Ore epuku aapuo neinepu oltung'ani le Kirene oji Simon nearaki ninye pee enap osalaba.

English: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki ewueji neji Golgata, aa keji ewueji e mborbor,

English: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
Masaai: neisho ninche Yesu enaisho oo sabibu naitushulakaki olodua metooko. Ore pee eishamisham neany eok.

English: And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatasho ninye, neor nkilani enyena aaoshie enkukuo.

English: And sitting down they watched him there;
Masaai: Netoni ninche aarrip ninye te ine.

English: And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Masaai: Nepik ele sirata shumata elukunya enye aajo “YESU ELE OLAIGUANANI LOO LYAHUDI.”

English: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
Masaai: Neshei te ina kata te nebo ninye ilapurrok aare, obo te nkaina e tatene, o likae te nkaina e kedienye.

English: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
Masaai: Nemor iloogiroo eipirripir ilukuny, aajo,

English: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.
Masaai: “Eiyie doi ogil enkaji e Nkai nishet too nkolong'i uni, intajeu kewan; te naa iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tadou to salaba.”

English: Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,
Masaai: Neiko sii ninche neijia lapolosak o lasirak te nebo lpaiyiani ejo,

English: He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him.
Masaai: “Kulikae ake eitajeu nemeidim aitejeu kewan, olaa ninye olaiguanani loo Siraeli. Inchoo taata edou to salaba pee kiruk ninye.”

English: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore amu Enkai etipika osiligi lenye inchoo naa eitajeu taa Enkai ninye tenaa keetayie tipat; amu etejo naa, “Ara Enkerai e Nkai!”

English: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
Masaai: Nemor sii lelo apurrok ootashoki te nebo o ninye.

English: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki saa ile, nerip enaimin enkop o metabaiki saa naaudo.

English: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya saa naaudo, neishir Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eli, Eli, lama sabaktani?” Naa inchere, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, aainyo pee kitung'uayie?”

English: Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calleth for Elias.
Masaai: Ore pee ening kulikae te lelo ooitashe te ine nejo, “Eliya eipoto.”

English: And straightway one of them ran, and took a spunge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink.
Masaai: Nekuet nabo kata obo le lelo nepik osuguroi enaisho naisuijo oo sabibu neremoki eng'udi naado neisho metooko.

English: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.
Masaai: Nejoki ilkulikae, “Tapala maing'urai te naa kelotu Eliya aitajeu.”

English: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu aishir to ltoilo sapuk, nedung'o tau.

English: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;
Masaai: Neiperra nabo kata olkarasha le nkaji e Nkai aaku are, aiteru te shumata o metabaiki abori, neikirikira enkop nedanya ndapidapo;

English: And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,
Masaai: nebolo inkuraren neitopiuni seseni kumok loo sinyat ooirurate;

English: And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many.
Masaai: ore pee epuku too nkuraren eidipa Yesu atopiu, nejing ina ang sinyati neipang'aki ltung'ana kumok.

English: Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo kitok loo sikarini oorripito Yesu o lelo ootii te nebo ninye, pee edol eikirikire enkop o kulie baa naatotiwuo, neureishoyu oleng ejo, “Esipa Enkerai e Nkai ele tung'ani.”

English: And many women were there beholding afar off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him:
Masaai: Netii ine wueji inkituaak kumok naaing'orita te nelakua naatusujutua Yesu eing'uaa Galilaya eisiaaita ninye.

English: Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's children.
Masaai: Ore te nebo ninche etii Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo o Yosef, o ng'otonye layiok le Sebedayo.

English: When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple:
Masaai: Ore pee eaku teipa nelotu oltung'ani karsis oing'uaa Arimatea oji Yosef, otaa apa olointeng'eni le Yesu.

English: He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered.
Masaai: Nelo sii apa ninye enetii Pilato neomonu osesen le Yesu. Neitanapisho Pilato pee eishori.

English: And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
Masaai: Neitayu Yosef osesen, neirin te nkarasha sidai e kitani,

English: And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre, and departed.
Masaai: neirragie te nkurare enye ng'ejuk nataguetua to soit, neibeleleng'oki osoit sapuk enkutuk e ngumoto, nelo.

English: And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting over against the sepulchre.
Masaai: Netii ine Mariamu Magdalene o enkae Mariamu etoni aaipirare enkurare.

English: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
Masaai: Ore taaisere aa enkolong nasujita ene Nkitobirare, neiturrurrokino lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo Pilato,

English: Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again.
Masaai: aajoki, “Lo kitok, kitadamutua aajo etejo, apa ilo kalamas eton eishu, ‘Ore pee elusoo nkolong'i uni, napiu.’

English: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.
Masaai: Intanapisho naa metorripi enkurare metabaiki enkolong e uni, pee mepuonu ilooiteng'eni lenyena aapurroo nejoki olorere, ‘Etopiwuo’; neaku elejare e siadi kitok alang ene dukuya.”

English: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato, “Iatata larripok loo sikarini, enchom entorrip anaa enindimidimi.”

English: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
Masaai: Nepuo aaitagol erripoto e nkurare, nepik olmishire osoit te nebo ilarripok.

English: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata ekenyua enkolong e nkiterata e wiki, nelotu Mariamu e Magdalene oo enkae Mariamu aaing'uraa enkurare.

English: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.
Masaai: Ing'ura, etijing'a enkikirikirata kitok enkop, amu etadowuo olmalaika lo Laitoriani oing'uaa shumata, nelotu neibeleleng'oo osoit netonie enchumata.

English: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
Masaai: Netiu enkomom enye anaa enkiwuang'ata, neibor inkilani enyena anaa empaso.

English: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
Masaai: Neikirikira ilarripok te nkaraki ninye, netiu anaa ilootuata.

English: And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not ye: for I know that ye seek Jesus, which was crucified.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo malaika inkituaak, “Emiureishoyu intae; amu ayiolo ajo Yesu ing'oruru otashoki.

English: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
Masaai: Metii ene amu etopiwuo anaa enatejo ninye. Wootu eng'urai ewueji neirragieki.

English: And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he is risen from the dead; and, behold, he goeth before you into Galilee; there shall ye see him: lo, I have told you.
Masaai: Naa enchom entasiooi entoliki ilooiteng'eni lenyena entiaaki, ‘Etopiwuo aing'uaa lootuata; neituruko alo Galilaya, naa te ine idolidolo.’ Eng'ura aidipa atoliki intae.”

English: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word.
Masaai: Nepuo nabo kata aaing'uaa enkurare te nkuretisho o te ng'ida sapuk, nekuet aaliki ilooiteng'eni.

English: And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, nenang'are Yesu ninche nejoki, “Entakuenya.” Nenyikaki ninche aaibung inkejek enyena aaserem.

English: Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Emiureishoyu; enchom entoliki ilalashera laainei meshomo Galilaya naa kaadol te ine.”

English: Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and shewed unto the chief priests all the things that were done.
Masaai: Ore epuo te nkoitoi, ng'ura, nejing kulikae loo larripok atua enkanasa neliki ilapolosak kituaak imbaa pooki naatotiwuo.

English: And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers,
Masaai: Netumo ilpayiani te nebo ore pee eidip aaiguanata, neisho isikarini impesai kumok aajoki,

English: Saying, Say ye, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.
Masaai: “Entiaaki olorere, ilooiteng'eni lenyena ooetuo kewarie aapurroo kirura.

English: And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
