English: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Esipa eng'as Eliya alotu neitang'ejuk imbaa pooki. Paa amaa, ainyoo pee ejo lkigerot ti alo Enkerai e Tung'ani, eji keitamei too mbaa kumok nemenuni?

English: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
Masaai: Kake ajoki nanu intae, eewuo Eliya, neitaas ninche ninye enapa ake nayieu neitaas, anaa enatisirakaki ninye.”

English: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu enetii ilkulikae ooiteng'eni, nedol emanita olorere kitok, neishankarrarre ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ninche.

English: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ilo orere Yesu, neing'asia oleng, nekuetiki aairoroki.

English: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ajoki, ninche, “Ainyoo doi ena shankar niaatata o ninche?”

English: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;
Masaai: Newaliki oltung'ani obo te ina siamo ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani, atorikuo duoo enkayioni ai enitii, eeta oloirirua lemeiro;

English: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.
Masaai: olaa ore pee eibung, nenang'ie enkop; neitayu ilabur, nenya lala neikaolo; najo ajoki ilooiteng'eni linono metaarai, nelaikino.”

English: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki ninche, “Wooi ena ishoi nemeeta enkirukoto! Kebaa aton aboitare intae? Kapal intae o anu? Entoriku ninye ene natii.”

English: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
Masaai: Nerikokini; ore pee edol ilo oirirua Yesu neiterreyie nabo kata, nebatata te nkop neiperipera, neitayu ilabur te nkutuk.

English: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Yesu menye enkerai ajoki, “Kebaya aa nkat eeta ena pukunoto?” Nejo, “Te kereisho eiterua.

English: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.
Masaai: Naa katitin kumok etanang'aka ninye atua enkima nenang'aki enkare ejo aar; kake te nindim iyie ataasa ae, ing'urrie iyiook taretu iyiook.”

English: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Eji te nindim! Eidimayu imbaa pooki to loiruk.”

English: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
Masaai: Nebuak nabo kata menye ina ayioni nejo, “Airuko, ore eneton eitu airuk taretokoki!”

English: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu olorere ekuetu aasotokino, neing'ode ilo oirirua oiduruk, nejoki, “Lo oirirua ming'ani lemeiro, nanu laaitore, tupuku tung'uai, nimingil ajing ae kata.”

English: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.
Masaai: Nebuaku aishir neiterreyie aipushupush oleng, nepuku, netiu enkayioni anaa olmeneng'ani o metejo lkumok, “Ae etua!”

English: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.
Masaai: Kake eibung'a Yesu enkaina nedumu, neinyototo aitashe.

English: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?
Masaai: Ore pee ejing atua aji, neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena too nkurrat aajoki, “Oo pee eitu kindim iyiook aataaarai ninye?”

English: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Meararoyu ena pukunoto ti ae neme te nkomono ake.”

English: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.
Masaai: Nepuo te ine neimaa Galilaya. Nemeyieu Yesu neyiolou hoo oltung'ani:

English: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.
Masaai: amu ilooiteng'eni lenyena eiteng'enita, ajoki, “Eitarasakini Enkerai e Tung'ani nkaik oo ltung'ana, near ninche ninye metua; ore pee eidipi aatar metua, neishari nkolong'i uni nepiu.”

English: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
Masaai: Kake eitu ening'u ninche ina natejo, neureyu sii eikilikuan.

English: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?
Masaai: Nepuonu Kapernaum; ore etii Yesu aji neikilikuan ninche ajoki, “Ainyoo naaji enchankar niaatata te nkoitoi?”

English: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.
Masaai: Negira ninche; amu keishankarrate aajo kalo olkitok te pooki.

English: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.
Masaai: Neton neipot lelo tomon o aare; nejoki ninche, “Ore oloyieu neaku ole dukuya, nchoo metaa ninye obayie te pooki neaku osinka le pooki.”

English: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,
Masaai: Nedumu enkerai, neitasheyie te mpolos enye; nedumu aibung too nkaik enyena nejoki ninche,

English: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.
Masaai: “Ore pooki ong'amu enkerai anaa ena te nkarna ai, nanu eng'amu; ore olaang'amu, neme nanu ake eng'amu kake ilo laairriwua.”

English: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.
Masaai: Nejoki Yohana ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, kitoduaa oltung'ani earaa iloiriruani te nkarna ino, nikimitiki, amu mme ole ncholiek ang.”

English: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Yesu, “Emimitiki, amu meetae hoo oloas embae sapuk te nkarna ai, laa ore aa enaidipie ina, naaitoki aidim atusukenya.

English: For he that is not against us is on our part.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo lemegilunore iyiook naa ole nkalo ang.

English: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
Masaai: Esipa, ajoki intae, ore ake oloisho intae enkikompe e nkare entook te nkaraki naipotieki intae Kristo, nemeeta nchere pee etala olerrinyore lenye.

English: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.
Masaai: “Ore ake oloitapong'oo nabo e kuna kutiti naairuk nanu, enaikash te neenikini ninye osoit kitok oiutuutishoreki emurt, nenang'akini enaiposha.

English: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkaina ino, tudung'oi; enaikash te nijing enkishui iata enkumur alang te ti niata nkaik pokira are, nilo Gehanum, atua enkima nemeye ntarasi;

English: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
Masaai: (enemeye lkuru lenye nemeye enkima.)

English: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkeju ino, tudung'oi; amu enaikash te iyie ti nijing enkishui ira ng'ojine, alang ti nikinang'akini Gehanum, iata nkejek pokira are;

English: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
Masaai: (ewueji nemeye ilkuru lenye, nemeye enkima.)

English: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:
Masaai: Naa ti nikintapong'oo enkong'u ino, tukurtu; enaikash ti nijing enkitoria e Nkai iata enkong'u nabo alang ti nikinang'akini Gehanum iata inkonyek pokira are;

English: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
Masaai: ewueji nemeye ilkuru lenye, nemeye enkima.

English: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.
Masaai: “Amu keitisinyi pooki ng'ae te nkima, anaa enaitisinyi olasar te munyan.

English: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.
Masaai: Sidai emunyan; kake amaa te nelau emunyan enkisukut enye, kaji eikoni pee eitokini aaisukutie? Enoto emunyan ti atua ate, nitonini te seriani intae maate.”

English: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.
Masaai: Nedumunye te ina alo, nelotu olkirine le Yudea o lido kekun le Yordan, neiturrurrokino ninye aaitoki isiamon kumok enetii ninye; neitoki ake aiteng'en anaa enatamoo apake.

English: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.
Masaai: Nepuonu Ilfarisayo enetii ninye neikilikuan aajoki, ejo pee etem, “Keishiaakino te neiturraa oltung'ani enkitok enye?”

English: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Kaa eitanapa intae Musa?”

English: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eishorua Musa meigeroki oltung'ani enkitok enye empalai naiturrarie, nearaa.”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “Enkaraki engolon oo ltauja linyi pee etisiraka intae ina kitanapata.

English: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.
Masaai: Kake ore ebaiki enkiterunoto e nkop, eitobira Enkai olee o eng'oruoi.

English: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee eing'uaa olee menye o ng'otonye, neibung'are enkitok enye,

English: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.
Masaai: neaku ninche pokira are osesen obo, Metaa meekure era are kake etaa osesen obo.

English: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
Masaai: Ore naa inaaitutumo Enkai mincho ake erish oltung'ani.”

English: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
Masaai: Ore ti aji neitoki ake ilooiteng'eni lenyena aaikilikuan ena bae.

English: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ore ake oloiturraa enkitok enye neyam ae, keloloito.

English: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
Masaai: Naa te neiturraa enkitok olmoruo lenye, nelo meyama likae, keloloito.”

English: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.
Masaai: Neyakini Yesu nkera kutiti pee etum aiteleiki nkaik nebuaaki ilooiteng'eni lenyena lelo ooriku.

English: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ina, negoro, nejoki, “Enchoo nkera epuonu enatii emimitiki; amu enoo naatiu anaa kuna enkitoria e Nkai.

English: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, ore olemeng'amu enkitoria e Nkai anaa enang'amu enkerai kiti, nemejing katukul.”

English: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
Masaai: Nemuataki nkera nkaik amayian, neiteleiki nkaik nemayian ninche.

English: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?
Masaai: Ore te nkoitoi epuku Yesu alo, nekuetiki oltung'ani negilaki kung, neikilikuan ajoki, “Olaiteng'enani supat, kaji aiko pee ajung enkishui nemeish?”

English: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Kaji etiu pee kijo nanu supat? Meetae hoo obo supat, Enkai ake esupat.

English: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.
Masaai: Iyiolo iyie nkitanapat, inchere, ‘Miar metua, miloloito, mipurrisho, minteeniki likae elejare, minkonyisho to losek, iyanyita minyi o ng'utunyi.’ ”

English: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, aibung'a kuna pooki ebaiki apa ara enkerai.”

English: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.
Masaai: Neing'or Yesu ninye akurraki nkonyek nenyorru, nejoki, “Nabo ake nikitong'orikia; shomo, timira iniata pooki nincho laisinak, naa itum olchumati te shumata; nikilotu taa asuj.”

English: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
Masaai: Nesot enkomom enye te ina bae, nelo eisinanuo; amu keeta masaa kumok.

English: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
Masaai: Neing'or Yesu nkaloli pooki, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Egol atiu aja to lkarsis pee ejing enkitoria e Nkai!”

English: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
Masaai: Neing'asia ilooiteng'eni too rorei lenyena. Kake eigilie Yesu ajoki, “Nakera, egol atiu aja pee ejing oltung'ani enkitoria e Nkai!

English: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Entames nalelek te neim enaudoto o ltidu alang olkarsis ejing enkitoria e Nkai.”

English: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
Masaai: Neing'asia ninche oleng, nejoki ninche ninye, “Ae ng'ae naa kenya oidim atajeu?”

English: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
Masaai: Neing'or Yesu ninche nejoki, “Meidimayu too oltung'ana, kake mme neijia etiu te Nkai; amu keidimayu mbaa pooki te Nkai.”

English: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.
Masaai: Neiter Petero ajoki ninye, “Ng'ura, kitung'uaitie iyiook pooki toki aasuj iyie.”

English: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Esipa ajoki intae, meetae hoo obo otung'uayie enkaji anaa lalashera anaa nkanashera anaa ng'otonye anaa menye anaa nkera anaa nkurman, te nkaraki nanu o te nkaraki kulo omon supati,

English: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.
Masaai: lemetum inkatitin iip taata te na kata, aa nkajijik o lalashera o nkanashera o noo ng'otonye o nkera o nkurman te nebo oloisilisili, naa ore te idia kata nalotu netum enkishui nemeish.

English: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.
Masaai: Kake etii ilkumok ooiturukutuo ooyooki aaku ile siadi, neaku ilooisiadutua ile dukuya.”

English: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
Masaai: Ore etii enkoitoi, eilep aapuo Yerusalem eituruko Yesu dukuya ninche; neing'asia ninche, ore iloosujita netureishote. Neitoki ake arik lelo tomon o aare neiter aliki nena naapuo aatum ninye.

English: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:
Masaai: Ejo, “Ng'ura, Yerusalem kilep aapuo; naa keitarasakini Enkerai e Tung'ani ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, nedung'oki ninche ninye enkiguana e keeya, neitarasaki Iloreren;

English: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.
Masaai: nesurdaany ninche ninye, nenotaki, neosh aaitame near metua ore pee eishari nkolong'i uni nepiu.”

English: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
Masaai: Neisho Yakobo o Yohana, ilayiok le Sebedayo, nepuonu enetii ninye, nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyieu nintaas iyiook embae ake pooki nikiomon iyie.”

English: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ainyoo iyieuu naitaas intae?”

English: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, ninye, “Inchoo iyiook meitoton obo lang te nkaina ino e tatene neton olikae te ne kedienye, te nkitoo ino.”

English: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?
Masaai: Kake etiaaka Yesu ninche, “Miyiololo intae ina niomonunu. Indimidimi sa aatook enkikompe naok nanu, aashu meibatisai intae te nkibatisa naaibatisai nanu?”

English: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ee kindim.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Iokioko taa ninye enkikompe naok nanu, neibatisae intae te nkibatisa naaibatisai nanu;

English: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.
Masaai: kake ore entonata te nkaina ai e tatene aashu te ne kedienye, mme nanu oishoru, kake ene lelo laa ninche eitobirakaki.”

English: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.
Masaai: Ore pee ening lelo pokira tomon ina, neiter aagorokino Yakobo o Yohana.

English: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.
Masaai: Neipotu Yesu ninche enetii nejoki, “Iyiololo aajo ore lelo ooitaa ate ilaitoriak loo Loreren neitoreisho te ng'olon, negilu iltung'ana lenye kituaak ninche.

English: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:
Masaai: Kake mme neijia etiu te intae; kake ore olinyi oyieu neaku kitok neaku olaisiaayiani linyi,

English: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.
Masaai: ore oloyieu neituruk neaku osinka le pooki.

English: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
Masaai: Amu eitu elotu Enkerai e Tung'ani meisiaai kake keewuo aisiaaisho, neishoru enkishui enye metaa elakunoto oo lkumok.”

English: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.
Masaai: Nepuonu Yeriko; ore epuo aaing'uaa Yeriko eiriamariyie ilooiteng'eni lenyena o lorora kitok, netii olmodooni oomonisho oji Bartimayo ole Timayo, oton te mbata e nkoitoi.

English: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
Masaai: Ore pee ening eji Yesu le Nasaret ilo neiteru abuak eishiraki ajo, “Yesu, olayioni le Daudi, ing'urrieki!”

English: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me.
Masaai: Nebuaaki ilkumok aajoki metigirayu; kake etabuaa oleng ejo, “Olayioni le Daudi, ing'urrieki nanu!”

English: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.
Masaai: Neitashe Yesu nejo, “Empoto.” Neipoti ilo tung'ani modooni aajoki, “Intagoluoyu; inyo amu kimpot ninye.”

English: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.
Masaai: Nenang'aa olkila lenye, neipid nelo enetii Yesu.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Yesu ajoki, “Kaa iyieu naaitaas?” Nejoki ilo modooni, “Lo kitok kayieu nadolishoyu.”

English: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Shomo, kinchiunye enkirukoto ino.” Nedolishoyu ina kata ake neirukurukore te nkoitoi.

English: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,
Masaai: Ore pee etaaniki ninche embata Yerusalem, aabaiki Betfage o Betania, to ldoinyo loo Loirienito, neirriwaa ilooiteng'eni aare lenyena,

English: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
Masaai: nejoki, “Enchom enda ang naipirare intae, ore ake pee ijing'ijing'i nitumutumu olkurrarru oena, leitu ae kata eked likae tung'ani. Entalaku entereu ene.

English: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.
Masaai: Ore te nejoki intae oltung'ani, ‘Oo pee inkoko inji?’ Entejo, ‘Olkitok oatayie enkolat naa keshuku ene nabo kata.’ ”

English: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche, neinepu olkurrarru eena te kishomi ti auluo enkoitoi nalala e nkanasa, nelaku ninche.

English: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?
Masaai: Nejoki lelo ooitashe te ine, “Kaa iasitata aalak olkurrarru?”

English: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.
Masaai: Neliki ina natiaaka Yesu, neisho ninche meshomo.

English: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
Masaai: Nerewaki Yesu ilo kurrarru, neirotoki lkilani lenye, neked atonie.

English: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
Masaai: Neisalaash ilkumok lenye lkilani te nkoitoi naalala, neisalaash kulikae ilng'osil oota mbenek ootudung'utuo too nkurman.

English: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:
Masaai: Ore lelo ooituruk o loosujita nebuaku aajo, “Hosana! Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani!

English: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
Masaai: Emayiana enkitoria nalotu e papa lang Daudi! Hosana te shumata naisul!”

English: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.
Masaai: Nejing Yerusalem, nelo atua enkaji e Nkai, ore pee eshil pooki toki, nemuto, neipung alo Betania o lelo pokira tomon o aare.

English: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina, pee eshukunye te Betania, netir esumash.

English: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.
Masaai: Ore pee edol te nelakua olng'aboli oata mbenek, nelo ejo ebaiki netumie toki. Nejo abaiki, mbenek ake eeta, amu mme enkata oo lng'abolo.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo, “Metaa mikingil likae anyayie lng'anayio ntarasi.” Nening ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;
Masaai: Nepuonu Yerusalem. Nejing enkaji e Nkai neiteru aaraa lelo oomirisho o looinyang'isho te nkaji e Nkai, neibeleleng'oo mesai oo laitawalak loo mpesai o lorikan le lelo omir nturkuluni;

English: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.
Masaai: nemit meitoki oltung'ani anap toki aitudung enkaji e Nkai.

English: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho, nejoki ninche, “Keitu eigeri aajo, ‘Keaku enkaji ai ene sayiare too loreren pooki’? Kake intaa intae enkapune oo laisimak.

English: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.
Masaai: Nening ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat ina neing'oru enkoitoi pee ear ninye; kake etureita ninye, amu eing'asiayie enkikoo enye ilo orora pooki.

English: And when even was come, he went out of the city.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enteipa neipung te ina anasa.

English: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.
Masaai: Ore epuo te nkakenya, nedol olang'ole ng'aboli etoyio o metabaiki ntana.

English: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.
Masaai: Nedamu Petero nejoki ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, ng'ura! Etoyio olang'ole ng'aboli litediaa.”

English: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eruko Enkai.

English: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, ore ake olojoki ele doinyo, ‘Tadotunye tanang'akinoyu enaiposha’, nemeing'ash to ltau lenye, kake eiruk ina najo nchere keaku, neaku te ninye anaa enatejo.

English: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
Masaai: Metaa ajoki intae, ore embae ake pooki nisaishosho niomonunu, eruko nchere itumutumu neaku ina.

English: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
Masaai: Naa ore nkatitin pooki ni nintasheshe aaomon, entapalakinoto toki; pee epalaki sii ninche intae Papa linyi otii shumata nkitarruorot inyi.

English: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
Masaai: (Kake ti nimipalakinono, nemepalaki sii ninye Papa linyi otii shumata intae nkitarruorot inyi.)”

English: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,
Masaai: Neitoki ake aapuonu Yerusalem. Ore eloolo ninye te nkaji e Nkai, nepuonu aayiaya ninye ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak o lpayiani,

English: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?
Masaai: nejoki ninche ninye, “Kaa golon ena niaasie iyie kuna baa, naa ae ng'ae likinchoo ena golon niasie?”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kaikilikuan intae embae nabo; entawalikiaki pee, aliki intae engolon naasie kuna baa.

English: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.
Masaai: Amaa apa enkibatisare e Yohana ae keper eing'uaa anaa ei ltung'ana? Entawalikiaki.”

English: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?
Masaai: Neishankarra ejo maate, “Ti nikijo, ‘Keper eing'uaa,’ naa taata nejoki iyiook, ‘Oo naa pee eitu irukuruku?’

English: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.
Masaai: Kake aikijo, ‘Ltung'ana eing'uaa?’ ” neureyu iltung'ana, amu etonyorraitie pooki inchere oloiboni le Nkai le dede Yohana.

English: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.
Masaai: Neaku etawalikitia Yesu aajoki, “Mikiyiolo.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Maliki sii nanu intae enkitoria naasie kuna baa.”

English: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.
Masaai: Neiteru airorie ninche too nkitanyaanyukot ejo, “Etuuno oltung'ani enkurma oo sabibu, neitaman enkikarrata, neturu engumoto naironyieki lng'anayio, neshetu ol talet oado, neitaaki aisilenoki laturok enkurma enye, nelo enkop nalakua.

English: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enkata enye, neirriwaki lelo aturok osinka, meishoo ematua oo lng'anayio le ina kurma.

English: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.
Masaai: Neibung ninche ninye near, nearaa meeta toki.

English: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.
Masaai: Neitoki ake airriwaki likae sinka, nebor ilo elukunya, neinyal aasul.

English: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
Masaai: Neirriwaki ake likae, near ilo metua; neiko sii neijia kulikae kumok, neosh kulikae near kulikae metuata.

English: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.
Masaai: Neaku eton apa eeta likae obo, laa oinoti lenye kirotet; neirriwaki aitabayie ninye, ejo, ‘Keyanyit oinoti lai.’

English: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.
Masaai: Kake etiakinote lelo aturok ooisilenokoki enkurma, ‘Ele doi olajung'oni; wootu, mataar metua pee eaku enaang enjung'ore.’

English: And they took him, and killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
Masaai: Neibung ninche ninye near metua, nenang'aki auluo ina kurma oo sabibu.

English: What shall therefore the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the husbandmen, and will give the vineyard unto others.
Masaai: Kaa kenya eitaas olopeny ina kurma oo sabibu? Kelotu kenya aidaikie lelo aturok neisho ninye kulikae enkurma oo sabibu.

English: And have ye not read this scripture; The stone which the builders rejected is become the head of the corner:
Masaai: Keitu doi isomama ele kigeroto ojo, ‘Ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak otaa ole lukunya o lmairroto;

English: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
Masaai: Olaitoriani eing'uaa ena, naa ene nking'asia too nkonyek ang’?”

English: And they sought to lay hold on him, but feared the people: for they knew that he had spoken the parable against them: and they left him, and went their way.
Masaai: Neing'oru ninche eneiko pee eibung, kake etureita olorere, amu etayioloito aajo ninche eipirta ina kitanyaanyukoto; neaku eshomo aaing'uaa.

English: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
Masaai: Neirriwakini ematua oo Lfarisayo o ematua oo lencholiek e Herode, pee epuonu aarresh too rorei lenyena.

English: And when they were come, they say unto him, Master, we know that thou art true, and carest for no man: for thou regardest not the person of men, but teachest the way of God in truth: Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar, or not?
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii nejoki, “Olaiteng'enani, kiyiolo aajo ira iyie, asipani, nimishilaa hoo iyie likae tung'ani; amu mishilaa enkitoo oo ltung'ana, kake enkoitoi ake e Nkai iutaa too sipat. Keishiaakino te nikincho Kaisari kodi, anaa aimeishiaakino?

English: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said unto them, Why tempt ye me? bring me a penny, that I may see it.
Masaai: Aikilak, ana aimikilak?” Kake ore amu etayiolo esunkureisho enye, nejoki, “Ainyoo pee kitemiteme? Eyakaki empisai, maing'ura.”

English: And they brought it. And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription? And they said unto him, Caesar's.
Masaai: Neyakini. Nejoki ninye ninche, “Ai ng'ae ele osirakino naa ae ng'ae eigero?” Nejokini, “Kaisari.”

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. And they marvelled at him.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Enchoo Kaisari ine Kaisari, ninchosho Enkai ine Nkai.” Neing'asiae te ninye oleng.

English: Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,
Masaai: Nepuonu Sadukayo enetii, lelo taa oojo eji meetae empiunoto; neikilikuan aajoki,

English: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If a man's brother die, and leave his wife behind him, and leave no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
Masaai: “Olaiteng'enani, eigeroko Musa iyiook nchere te neye oltung'ani alashe olikae, neing'uaa enkitok meeta enkerai, neyam olalashe ina kitok, pee eiki olalashe nkera.

English: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
Masaai: Eetae apa lalashera oopishana; neyam olbotor enkitok, ore pee eye neitu eing'uaa nkera.

English: And the second took her, and died, neither left he any seed: and the third likewise.
Masaai: Neyam oliaare, neye neitu eiu nkera; naa neijia eikuna oliookuni;

English: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
Masaai: neaku eitu eing'uaa nkera pokira oopishana. Ore te nkiting'oto neye ina kitok.

English: In the resurrection therefore, when they shall rise, whose wife shall she be of them? for the seven had her to wife.
Masaai: Omaa kenya te mpiunoto oo lootuata, keaku ene ng'ae ina kitok? Amu eyama naa pokira oopishana?”

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, Do ye not therefore err, because ye know not the scriptures, neither the power of God?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eijojo mme nji taa doi etiu pee ipong'oriri, mme ilkigerot miyiololo nimiyiololo sii engolon e Nkai?

English: For when they shall rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage; but are as the angels which are in heaven.
Masaai: Amu te nepiu kenya lelo too lootuata, meyamisho nemeyami, kake ketiu anaa lmalaika te shumata.

English: And as touching the dead, that they rise: have ye not read in the book of Moses, how in the bush God spake unto him, saying, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
Masaai: Naa amaa doi enkitopiunoto oo lootuata, keitu isomama te mbuku e Musa, te noshi nesirakino enapa shani, pee ejoki Enkai ninye. ‘Ara nanu Enkai e Abraham, o Enkai e Isaak, o Enkai e Yakobo?’

English: He is not the God of the dead, but the God of the living: ye therefore do greatly err.
Masaai: Mme Enkai oo lootuata ninye, kake enoo looishu, itapong'ori oleng.”

English: And one of the scribes came, and having heard them reasoning together, and perceiving that he had answered them well, asked him, Which is the first commandment of all?
Masaai: Nelotu obo loo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat nening eishankarra, ore pee ening ajo etawalikia aitobiraki, neikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Kaa kitanapata naituruk?”

English: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ena naituruk, ‘Toning'o iyie Siraeli; Enkai ang Olaitoriani; obo Olaitoriani;

English: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
Masaai: naa tonyorra Olaitoriani Enkai ino to ltau lino pooki, o te nkishui ino pooki, o te ng'eno ino pooki, o te ngolon ino pooki.’

English: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
Masaai: Naa ena eniare, ‘Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa kewan.’ Meetae ae kitanapata kitok nalang kuna.”

English: And the scribe said unto him, Well, Master, thou hast said the truth: for there is one God; and there is none other but he:
Masaai: Nejoki ilo aiteng'enani loo nkitanapat, “Itisipa, Olaiteng'enani; itisipa nchere nabo Enkai, nemeetae likae leme ninye;

English: And to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, and with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbour as himself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
Masaai: naa ti ninyorru ninye to ltau lino pooki o te ng'eno ino pooki, o te ngolon ino pooki, ninyorru sii ole latia ino anaa kewan, nelang nena nkishorunot pooki naapeji elulung'a nelang ilasarri ake pooki.”

English: And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ajo etawalikia te ng'eno, nejoki, “Milakuaniki iyie enkitoria e Nkai.” Ore ebaiki ina kata, metii oltung'ani onyaaka aitieu aikilikuana ae bae.

English: And Jesus answered and said, while he taught in the temple, How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David?
Masaai: Ore eiteng'enisho Yesu te nkaji e Nkai, nejo, “Kaji etiu pee ejo laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat Kristo eji olayioni le Daudi?

English: For David himself said by the Holy Ghost, The Lord said to my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
Masaai: Netejo Daudi openy, etuutaka Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nchere, ‘Etiaka Olaitoriani Olaitoriani lai, Totona te nkaina ai e tatene, o matipika lmang'ati linono abori nkejek inono.’

English: David therefore himself calleth him Lord; and whence is he then his son? And the common people heard him gladly.
Masaai: Eipoto Daudi openy ajo Olaitoriani; kaji eitoki aakunye enkerai enye?” Neinining ilo orora kitok ninye te ng'ida.

English: And he said unto them in his doctrine, Beware of the scribes, which love to go in long clothing, and love salutations in the marketplaces,
Masaai: Ore eiteng'enisho nejo, “Entodol ake ate too laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, oonyor aaishopo lkilani adoru neyieu neirorokini too neemirishoreki,

English: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
Masaai: nenyor ilorikan le nkitoo too nkajijik e ntumo o wuejitin e nkitoo too mashoi,

English: Which devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
Masaai: nedaare nkajijik oo nkolia neitaakuno eitoodor esayiare. Keyooki lelo aatum enkiguana kitok.

English: And Jesus sat over against the treasury, and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury: and many that were rich cast in much.
Masaai: Neton ninye aishiaakinore eneitadoikini mpisai e nkaji e Nkai, nejur olorere epik mpisai ilo sanduku. Nepik iltung'ana kumok karsisi te nkumoi.

English: And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.
Masaai: Nelotu enkoliai aisinani, nepik elai are naanyokie naabaya esenti nabo.

English: And he called unto him his disciples, and saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That this poor widow hath cast more in, than all they which have cast into the treasury:
Masaai: Neipotu Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena enetii, nejoki, “Esipa, ajoki intae, etipika ena oliai aisinani nkumok alang lelo kulikae pooki ootipika ilo sanduku.

English: For all they did cast in of their abundance; but she of her want did cast in all that she had, even all her living.
Masaai: Amu etipika pooki te nkumoi naata; kake ore ninye to sina lenye netipika entoki duoo pooki naata, entoki duoo pooki naishuyie.”

English: And as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples saith unto him, Master, see what manner of stones and what buildings are here!
Masaai: Ore ina kata epuku Yesu te nkaji e Nkai, nejoki obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena ninye, “Olaiteng'enani, ng'ura eneba kulo soito le nking'asia o kuna ajijik e nking'asia!”

English: And Jesus answering said unto him, Seest thou these great buildings? there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Idol kuna kituaak ajijik sapuki? Meing'uari tene osoit obo oiteleikino olikae lemesulakini enkop.”

English: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives over against the temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew asked him privately,
Masaai: Ore eton to ldoinyo loo loirienito eipirare enkaji e Nkai, neikilikuan Petero o Yakobo o Andrea too nkurrat aajoki,

English: Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled?
Masaai: “Toliki iyiook, kanu ebau kuna baa, naa kalo olmonekie oitodolu enkata nataanu kuna baa pee eitabari?”

English: And Jesus answering them began to say, Take heed lest any man deceive you:
Masaai: Neiteru Yesu ajoki, “Enteng'enuoto meitapong'oo intae oltung'ani.

English: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
Masaai: Kepuonu lkumok te nkarna ai, ejo, ‘Nanu ilo!’ neitapong'oo lkumok.

English: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
Masaai: Naa te nining'ining'i njoreitin o lmarenke loo njoreitin, eming'aing'ae; amu meeta nchere pee metiu neijia; kake eton eng'or ina kiting'oto.

English: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.
Masaai: Amu kedumakino olorere olikae orere, nedumakino enkitoria enkae kitoria; netumi olokirikiri le nkop too wuejitin kumok, netumi lameitin; naa ena enkiterata oo sinaitin.

English: But take heed to yourselves: for they shall deliver you up to councils; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten: and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them.
Masaai: “Kake entodol ate. Amu keitarasakini intae nkiguanat; neari intae too nkajijik enye e ntumo; nintasheshe te dukuya lbalusini o laiguanak te nkaraki nanu, pee iakuku shakeni te dukuya ninche.

English: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
Masaai: Nemeeta nchere meng'asi aalikioo ele rorei supat too loreren pooki.

English: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Naa ore pee erikuni intae enkiguana aaitarasaa, eming'aing'ae te dukuya aajo aikijo aa; kake ina naishori intae te ina saa entejo, amu mme intae ooiro, kake Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
Masaai: Naa keitarasaa olalashe olalashe lenye metari metua, neitarasaa menye enkerai enye, nedumakino nkera iloomenye, neitarasaa metari metuata.

English: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name's sake: but he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
Masaai: Naa keibayuni intae iltung'ana pooki te nkaraki enkarna ai. Kake ore olong'iri metabaiki enkiting'oto naa keitajeuni.

English: But when ye shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not, (let him that readeth understand,) then let them that be in Judaea flee to the mountains:
Masaai: “Kake ore pee idolidolo ina taboi nayau emutata eitashe te wueji nemeishiaakino (tayiolo taa ake oloisoma ena), esikaki ildoinyo ilootii Yudea.

English: And let him that is on the housetop not go down into the house, neither enter therein, to take any thing out of his house:
Masaai: Ore olotii shumata enkaji nemedou ajing aji ashoroo ae toki.

English: And let him that is in the field not turn back again for to take up his garment.
Masaai: “Ore olotii enkurma nemeshuko ang ajo ashoroo olkila lenye.

English: But woe to them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
Masaai: Wooi nena tuaan o naaitanakisho te nena olong'i!

English: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
Masaai: Entasaisho pee mebau nena te nkata e nkirobi.

English: For in those days shall be affliction, such as was not from the beginning of the creation which God created unto this time, neither shall be.
Masaai: Amu ore te nena olong'i kepuonu isinaitin leitu ae kata etumi anaa apa pee eitayu Enkai enkop o te nne, nemeitokini ae kata aatum intarasi.

English: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect's sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.
Masaai: Te neme Olaitoriani oitodorropa nena olong'i, anaata meetae hoo oltung'ani obo opok. Kake ore te nkaraki ilgelunot lenyana ootegelua ninye, neitodorropa ninye nena olong'i.

English: And then if any man shall say to you, Lo, here is Christ; or, lo, he is there; believe him not:
Masaai: Ore ina kata te nejoki intae oltung'ani, ‘Ng'ura, nele Kristo otii ende!’ anaa ‘Ng'ura, nelido otii ende!’ emiruk.

English: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.
Masaai: Keinyototo ilkristiano le lejare o loibonok le lejare neitoduaaya lmonek o mbaa e nking'asia, ejo maitapong'oi, te naa keidimayu, ebaiki lelo ootegeluaki.

English: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
Masaai: Kake entodol ate; aidipa atoliki intae mbaa pooki te dukuya.

English: But in those days, after that tribulation, the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light,
Masaai: “Kake ore te nena olong'i, etulusoitie lelo sinaitin, nemisimisu enkolong, nemeitoki olapa awang'u

English: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
Masaai: nesulunye ilakir te keper, neikirikirieki engolon o loing'ang'e.

English: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
Masaai: Nedoluni ina kata Enkerai e Tung'ani elotu too nkatampo te ngolon sapuk o te nkitoo.

English: And then shall he send his angels, and shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven.
Masaai: Neirriwaa te ina kata ilmalaika, meiturrurro lelo gelunot lenyena aaitung'uaa ilubot pokira ong'uan, neitung'uaa ineeiting'ie enkop o neeiting'ie keper.

English: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:
Masaai: “Enteng'ena ate te nkitanyaanyukoto o lng'aboli; laa ore ake pee enanau ilng'osil neiturumisho mbenek, niyiolouu aajo etinyikua olari.

English: So ye in like manner, when ye shall see these things come to pass, know that it is nigh, even at the doors.
Masaai: Neijia naa etiu, ti nidolidolo nena baa etabautua, niyiolouu aajo etataana ninye, auluo etii.

English: Verily I say unto you, that this generation shall not pass, till all these things be done.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, meishari ena ishoi eitu eitabari kuna baa pooki.

English: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
Masaai: Keishari shumata o enkop, kake meishari irorei laainei.

English: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
Masaai: “Kake ore ina olong o ina saa, meetae hoo obo oyiolo, aimeyiolo ninche lmalaika le shumata, nemeyiolo Enkerai e Tung'ani, Papa ake oyiolo.

English: Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
Masaai: Entodol ate, enchololoto; amu miyiololo aajo kanu ebau ina kata.

English: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey, who left his house, and gave authority to his servants, and to every man his work, and commanded the porter to watch.
Masaai: Etiu anaa oltung'ani oshomo elototo, ore elo ti ang, neing'ueiki ilaisiaayiak, neisho ake oltung'ani eramatare enye, neitanap olorrip kishomi meishololoyu.

English: Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:
Masaai: Enchololoto naa amu miyiololo aajo kanu elotu olopeny enkaji, anaa ae te nteipa, anaa ae te nasirie

English: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.
Masaai: pee melotu ake neluamisho neinepu intae irurara.

English: And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.
Masaai: Naa ore ina najoki intae, neijia ajoki pooki: enchololoto.”

English: After two days was the feast of the passover, and of unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft, and put him to death.
Masaai: Ore etaa nkolong'i are naatiooyo pee ebau Pasaka, nebau sii osirua loo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki. Neing'oru ilapolosak kituaak o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat eneiko pee eibung to losek, aar metua;

English: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
Masaai: amu etejo ninche, “Neme taa te nkata o sirua, mepuku ake olong'oling'oli lo lorere.”

English: And being in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at meat, there came a woman having an alabaster box of ointment of spikenard very precious; and she brake the box, and poured it on his head.
Masaai: Ore etii Betania enkaji e Simon le nkeeya oo lbolot, ore einosita endaa, nejing'u enkitok naata oltulet lo soit oji alabasta nebore eilata narropil naleng naji nardo, nagol oleng enkinyang'a, nedany ilo tulet nebukoki ina ilata elukunya enye.

English: And there were some that had indignation within themselves, and said, Why was this waste of the ointment made?
Masaai: Kake etii ilootagorote nejokino, “Ainyoo pee eitarruoyioki ena ilata narropil aaiko inji?

English: For it might have been sold for more than three hundred pence, and have been given to the poor. And they murmured against her.
Masaai: Amu anaata etimiraki ena ilata aainosie dinari iip uni, neishori laisinak.” Neing'unyung'unyaki ina kitok.

English: And Jesus said, Let her alone; why trouble ye her? she hath wrought a good work on me.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Entapal, ainyoo pee intanyamalala? Nanu eitaasa embae naikishiaan oleng.

English: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
Masaai: Amu iatata laisinak anaake, naa te niyieuu, indimidimi ake aaitaasa ninche isupati; kake mikiaatata nanu anaake.

English: She hath done what she could: she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying.
Masaai: Etaasa anaa enaidima; osesen lai eitera ael eton eitu enukari.

English: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world, this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her.
Masaai: Naa esipa, ajoki intae, ore pooki wueji nelikiorieki ele rorei supat te nkop pooki, neinosari ena nataasa edamunyeki ninye.”

English: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
Masaai: Nelo Yudas Iskariot laa obo le lelo tomon o aare enetii ilapolosak kituaak pee etum atakaldai ninye te ninche.

English: And when they heard it, they were glad, and promised to give him money. And he sought how he might conveniently betray him.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche neshipayu neitayu ole kutuk aajo keisho mpisai. Neing'oru ninye erishata nakaldarie ninye.

English: And the first day of unleavened bread, when they killed the passover, his disciples said unto him, Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e nkiterata e nkata oo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki, enkolong apa nayieng'i ilkuoo, oodamunyeki Pasaka, nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena ninye, “Kaji iyieu nikipuo aaitobir pee inyayie Pasaka?”

English: And he sendeth forth two of his disciples, and saith unto them, Go ye into the city, and there shall meet you a man bearing a pitcher of water: follow him.
Masaai: Neirriwaa ilooiteng'eni lenyena aare, nejoki, “Enchom enda anasa, ore pee enang'are intae oltung'ani onapita emoti e nkare; erukurukore,

English: And wheresoever he shall go in, say ye to the goodman of the house, The Master saith, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
Masaai: ore ake enejing, entiaaki olopeny enkaji. ‘Etejo Olaiteng'enani, Koree enkaji ai oo lomon, nainosie Pasaka te nebo ilooiteng'eni laainei?’

English: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared: there make ready for us.
Masaai: Naa keitodol intae enkaji e shumata nalala naitobira; te ine entobiraki iyiook.”

English: And his disciples went forth, and came into the city, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
Masaai: Nedumunye ilooiteng'eni lenyena nepuo ina anasa, neinepu etiu anaa enatiaakaki neitobiraki Pasaka.

English: And in the evening he cometh with the twelve.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku teipa nelotu Yesu o lekua tomon o aare.

English: And as they sat and did eat, Jesus said, Verily I say unto you, One of you which eateth with me shall betray me.
Masaai: Ore etoni aainos endaa, nejo Yesu, “Esipa, ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi, oloinosita endaa te nebo nanu.”

English: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
Masaai: Neiteru ninche aaisinanuo, nejoki maa obo ninye, “Kae nanu sa?”

English: And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Obo doi le kulo tomon o aare, obo oitadoiki emukate engirra te nebo nanu.

English: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.
Masaai: Amu elo ake Enkerai e Tung'ani aikunari anaa enatisirakaki ninye, kake ooi ilo tung'ani laa ninye okaldaa Enkerai e Tung'ani! Enaikash apa te neitu eini ilo tung'ani.”

English: And as they did eat, Jesus took bread, and blessed, and brake it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat: this is my body.
Masaai: Ore einosita endaa, nedumu emukate nemayian, nebelibel, neisho ninche, nejo, “Enkoito; osesen lai ele.”

English: And he took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them: and they all drank of it.
Masaai: Nedumu enkikompe, ore pee eishooyo enashe neisho ninche, neok pooki.

English: And he said unto them, This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Osarge lai ele lo sotua, oibukori te nkaraki ilkumok.

English: Verily I say unto you, I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Esipa, ajoki intae, meekure aigil aok ae kata enoo lng'anayio loo sabibu o metabau ina olong naok eokoto ng'ejuk te nkitoria e Nkai.”

English: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatarany osinkolio nepuku aapuo oldoinyo loo loirienito.

English: And Jesus saith unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Isikisiki ade pooki aailanyisho; amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaosh olchekut, neisardak intare!’

English: But after that I am risen, I will go before you into Galilee.
Masaai: Kake ore pee aaitopiuni, naituruk te intae alo Galilaya.”

English: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero, “Te naa keisik pooki, maaorore nanu.”

English: And Jesus saith unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this day, even in this night, before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Esipa aajoki iyie, ore ade te na kewarie, eton eitu eru olkuku katitin are nikimiki iyie katitin uni.”

English: But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.
Masaai: Neisimu ejo oleng, “Te naa kaye te nebo o iyie, maamiki nanu iyie.” Nejo ninche pooki neijia.

English: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
Masaai: Nepuo ewueji neji Getsemane; nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Entaanyisho te ne, o maidipa enkomono.”

English: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very heavy;
Masaai: Nerik Petero o Yakobo o Yohana, pee eiriamariyie, neiteru aiputukuny oleng nenyamalu.

English: And saith unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Keeta oltau lai osina kitok oba anaa keeya; entotoni tene enchololoto.”

English: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.
Masaai: Neigut penyo, neirrabalakino enkop eomon inchere, te naa keidimayu metogiroi ina kata ninye.

English: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
Masaai: Nejo, “Abba, Papa, eidimayu imbaa pooki te iyie; tooruoki ena kikompe; kake mme enaa enayieu nanu, kake anaa eniyieu iyie.”

English: And he cometh, and findeth them sleeping, and saith unto Peter, Simon, sleepest thou? couldest not thou watch one hour?
Masaai: Neshukunye neinepu eirurate, nejoki Petero, “Simon, iyie ilo oirura? Italaikine aishololoyu ena ninye nabo?

English: Watch ye and pray, lest ye enter into temptation. The spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is weak.
Masaai: Enchololoto naa entasaisho pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat; keyieu oltau, kake eshal osesen.”

English: And again he went away, and prayed, and spake the same words.
Masaai: Neitoki ake alo neomon, neigil iladuoo ake rorei.

English: And when he returned, he found them asleep again, (for their eyes were heavy,) neither wist they what to answer him.
Masaai: Neitoki aitu neinepu eirurate, amu eiroshiutuo nkonyek oleng; nelau ninche enawaliki ninye.

English: And he cometh the third time, and saith unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: it is enough, the hour is come; behold, the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
Masaai: Neitu ene uni nejoki ninche, “Keton ake duoo irurara aayeng'iyeng'a? Eidipe; etabawua esaa; naitarasari Enkerai e Tung'ani aaitarasaki nkaik oo larruok.

English: Rise up, let us go; lo, he that betrayeth me is at hand.
Masaai: Enyeito, emaape; idol etabaua ilo laakaldaa.”

English: And immediately, while he yet spake, cometh Judas, one of the twelve, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priest and the scribes and the elders.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata, eton eirorita, nelotu Yudas, obo le lelo tomon o aare, neiriamunore ninye empuoto neeta lalema o siaren, eirriutua ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak o lpayiani.

English: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
Masaai: Eishoo taa duoo ilo otakaldayie olmonekie, ajoki, “Ore taa olang'utut ninye ilo; embung'a entorik entirrisha.”

English: And as soon as he was come, he goeth straightway to him, and saith, Master, master; and kissed him.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yudas, nelo nabo kata enetii Yesu, nejoki, “Lo kitok!” Neng'utut.

English: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
Masaai: Nesaru aaibung ninye.

English: And one of them that stood by drew a sword, and smote a servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
Masaai: Kake etushutua obo le lelo ooitashe te ine olalem, neosh osinka lo lapolosani kitok nedung'u enkiok.

English: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Are ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and with staves to take me?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ietuo itanapate anaa iloopuo aaibung olaisimani, aa nanu ipuonunu aaibung inapitata ilalema o siaren?

English: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and ye took me not: but the scriptures must be fulfilled.
Masaai: Natii oshi ake enkaji e Nkai te nebo intae aiteng'enisho, neitu kimbung'ubung'u? Kake nchoo eitabari ilkigerot.”

English: And they all forsook him, and fled.
Masaai: Neing'uaa ilooiteng'eni lenyena pooki ninye, neilanyisho.

English: And there followed him a certain young man, having a linen cloth cast about his naked body; and the young men laid hold on him:
Masaai: Neirukurukore oloti barnoti laa olkarasha ake errotianita; neibung ninche ninye.

English: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
Masaai: Kake eitiaa ninye ilo karasha neisik meishopo.

English: And they led Jesus away to the high priest: and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes.
Masaai: Nerikoki ninche Yesu olapolosani kitok, netumo lapolosak pooki kituaak o lpayiani o lasirak.

English: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
Masaai: Nesujita Petero ninye elakuaniki, o metijing'a abaiki olgoriet lo lapolosani kitok; neton te nebo ilarripok aij enkima.

English: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
Masaai: Neing'oru lapolosak kituaak o ina kiguana pooki shakenisho naarie Yesu metua; kake etalaita.

English: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
Masaai: Amu eetuo lkumok ooiteenikitia ninye mbaa, kake eitu eipira enkiteenikinoto enye.

English: And there arose certain, and bare false witness against him, saying,
Masaai: Neinyototo kulikae aaiteeniki, ejo,

English: We heard him say, I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and within three days I will build another made without hands.
Masaai: “Kitoning'o iyiook ejo, ‘Kagil nanu ena aji e Nkai naitobiraki too nkaik, ore nkolong'i uni nashetu ae, neitu eitobiri too nkaik.’ ”

English: But neither so did their witness agree together.
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, eitu eipira ina shakenisho enye.

English: And the high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, saying, Answerest thou nothing? what is it which these witness against thee?
Masaai: Neinyototo olapolosani kitok nelo aitashe te mpolos, neikilikuan Yesu ajoki, “Ai miata ewalata niwalu? Kaa shakenisho ena nikintang'orie kulo tung'ana?”

English: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
Masaai: Kake etigire neitu ewaliki. Neitoki ake olapolosani kitok aikilikuan ajoki. “Ira iyie Kristo, Oinoti lo Lomayiana?”

English: And Jesus said, I am: and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Ee, ara, naa iyookiki aadol Enkerai e Tungani eton te nkaina e tatene o Lopeny Engolon, elotu too nkatampo e keper.”

English: Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?
Masaai: Nepolos olapolosani kitok ilkilani lenyena nejo, “Ainyoo kintoki aayieunye lchakenini?

English: Ye have heard the blasphemy: what think ye? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death.
Masaai: Itoning'okito ate emoroto namor Enkai. Ijojo aa?” Nedung'oki pooki enkiguana aajo keishiakino keeya.

English: And some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to buffet him, and to say unto him, Prophesy: and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands.
Masaai: Neiteru kulikae aanotaki, neimulumul enkomom, nedam, nejoki, “Imbonisho!” Neitanang'are ilarripok ninye ioshot.

English: And as Peter was beneath in the palace, there cometh one of the maids of the high priest:
Masaai: Ore etii Petero olgoriet ti abori ine, nelotu enkaisiaayiani nabo o lapolosani kitok;

English: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.
Masaai: ore pee edol Petero eijito enkima, neing'or ninye, nejo, “Iboitare sii oshi iyie Yesu le Nasaret.”

English: But he denied, saying, I know not, neither understand I what thou sayest. And he went out into the porch; and the cock crew.
Masaai: Kake etomikio ejo, “Mayiolo nemaning'u enijoito.” Nepuku ninye alo kishomi.

English: And a maid saw him again, and began to say to them that stood by, This is one of them.
Masaai: Nedol ina aisiaayiani, neitoki ake ajoki lelo ooitashe te ine, “Ore ele tung'ani, obo lenye.”

English: And he denied it again. And a little after, they that stood by said again to Peter, Surely thou art one of them: for thou art a Galilaean, and thy speech agreeth thereto.
Masaai: Kake enyaaka ake amiki. Ore ake sii te nkiti rishata nejoki lelo ooitashe te nebo Petero, “Edede taa ninye ira iyie obo lenye; amu ira ole Galilaya.”

English: But he began to curse and to swear, saying, I know not this man of whom ye speak.
Masaai: Kake eiterua adek kewan nenya lmuma ejo. “Mayiolo nanu ele tung'ani liimakiki.”

English: And the second time the cock crew. And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him, Before the cock crow twice, thou shalt deny me thrice. And when he thought thereon, he wept.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata ake neru olkuku ene are. Nedamu Petero enatiaaka Yesu nchere, “Ore eton eitu eru olkuku katitin are, nikimiki iyie katitin uni.” Nedanya aishir.

English: And straightway in the morning the chief priests held a consultation with the elders and scribes and the whole council, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him to Pilate.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ekenyu, neiguana ilapolosak kituaak, o lpayiani o lasirak o enkiguana pooki nalulung'a. Neen Yesu, nerik neitarasaki Pilato.

English: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Pilato ajoki, “Ira doi iyie Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?” Newaliki ajoki, “Iyie otejo neijia.”

English: And the chief priests accused him of many things: but he answered nothing.
Masaai: Neitang'or ilapolosak kituaak ninye too mbaa kumok.

English: And Pilate asked him again, saying, Answerest thou nothing? behold how many things they witness against thee.
Masaai: Neigil Pilato aikilikuan ninye ajoki, “Aimiata hoo embae niwalu? Nidol eneba mbaa nikintang'orie ninche?”

English: But Jesus yet answered nothing; so that Pilate marvelled.
Masaai: Kake eitu hoo ewaliki Yesu, metaba anaa neing'asia Pilato.

English: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
Masaai: Naa ore apake te ilo sirua kelaaki apa ninye ninche oltung'ani obo oena, naa olotoomonutuo ake.

English: And there was one named Barabbas, which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him, who had committed murder in the insurrection.
Masaai: Ore too ltung'ana oopidilare enkitoria ooena te korokoroni, neitayutuo loikop ina kata, netii oltung'ani oji Barabas.

English: And the multitude crying aloud began to desire him to do as he had ever done unto them.
Masaai: Nelotu ina siamo neiter aaikilikuan Pilato meitaasa enoshi ake naitaas.

English: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Iyieuu nalaaki intae Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?”

English: For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.
Masaai: Amu etayiolo Pilato ajo olom ake eitarasarie ilapolosak kituaak Yesu.

English: But the chief priests moved the people, that he should rather release Barabbas unto them.
Masaai: Kake einuaakita ilapolosak kituaak olorere metejo pee elaakini ninche Barabas.

English: And Pilate answered and said again unto them, What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews?
Masaai: Neitoki ake Pilato ajoki ninche, “Paa kaa naa aitaas ele tung'ani lijojo Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?”

English: And they cried out again, Crucify him.
Masaai: Neilepilep aaigil aajo, “Tasho ninye.”

English: Then Pilate said unto them, Why, what evil hath he done? And they cried out the more exceedingly, Crucify him.
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato ninche, “Ainyoo, kaa torrono etaasa ninye?” Kake eilepilepa oleng aajo, “Tasho ninye.”

English: And so Pilate, willing to content the people, released Barabbas unto them, and delivered Jesus, when he had scourged him, to be crucified.
Masaai: Ore amu keyieu Pilato neitiship ina siamo, nelaaki Barabas neng'as aishooyo Yesu metooshi too nkeenta neitoki aitarasaa metashei.

English: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
Masaai: Neriku sikarini ninye atua enkaji e nkitoo naji praitorio; neipotu esikari e sirit nalulung'a.

English: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
Masaai: Neishopoki ninye olkila mugie neshetu olmarisian loo lkiku neishopoki Yesu elukunya.

English: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
Masaai: Neiter aairoroki aajoki, “Olele Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi!”

English: And they smote him on the head with a reed, and did spit upon him, and bowing their knees worshipped him.
Masaai: Neigilie aaosh elukunya te ntiyani, nenotaki, negilaki kung aaitaakuno keserem.

English: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple from him, and put his own clothes on him, and led him out to crucify him.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatadalare, neoru ilo kila mugie neishopoki nkilani enyena. Nerik auluo pee epuo aashe.

English: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
Masaai: Nearaki olpayian obo oji Simon le Kirene, odoku ti ae kop, menye taa Aleksanta o Rufus, metanapa osalaba le Yesu.

English: And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.
Masaai: Nerik o meitabaiki Golgota eji ewueji e mborbor.

English: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.
Masaai: Neisho enaisho natipikaki entoki naji manemane, kake etanya ninye eok.

English: And when they had crucified him, they parted his garments, casting lots upon them, what every man should take.
Masaai: Neshe ninche ninye, neorikino lkilani lenyena, neoshie enkukuo pee etum oloya.

English: And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.
Masaai: Naa saa uni ina kata pee eshe ninche ninye.

English: And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Masaai: Ore embae naitanang'aki ninye neigero ajo, “Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi.”

English: And with him they crucify two thieves; the one on his right hand, and the other on his left.
Masaai: Netashoki lapurrok aare te nebo ninye, atii obo te tatene netii olikae te kedienye.

English: And the scripture was fulfilled, which saith, And he was numbered with the transgressors.
Masaai: Neitabari olkigeroto ojo, “Eikenayioki ninye te nebo ilarruok.”

English: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
Masaai: Ore lelo oopuaya oloim ine, nesurdaany ninye eing'unie lukuny, nejo, “Hoo! Eiyie doi ojo agil enkaji e Nkai nintoki ashetu too nkolong'i uni?

English: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
Masaai: Intajeu kewan tadou te ilo salaba!”

English: Likewise also the chief priests mocking said among themselves with the scribes, He saved others; himself he cannot save.
Masaai: Neiko sii ninche neijia ilapolosak kituaak aaikordod ejokino maate, “Kulikae ake eitajewuo; nemeidim aitajeu kewan.

English: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reviled him.
Masaai: Nchoo naa duoo Kristo. Olaiguanani le Siraeli, edou to salaba matodol pee kiruk.” Ore lelo ootashoki te nebo ninye nemor sii ninche.

English: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
Masaai: Ore pee eipir enkolong, nerip enaimin enkop pooki o metabaiki saa naaudo.

English: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
Masaai: Ore pee eaku saa naaudo nebuak Yesu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” eji, “Enkai ai, Enkai ai, ainyoo pee kitung'uayie?”

English: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
Masaai: Ore pee ening kulikae ooitashe te ine nejo, “Ining, Eliya eipoto.”

English: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.
Masaai: Nekuet obo, neiput osuguroi enaisho naisuisho naji siki, nepik oloomi neisho metooko, ejo, “Ntasho matodol te naa kelotu Eliya aitadou.”

English: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
Masaai: Nebuaku Yesu oleng, nedung'o tau.

English: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
Masaai: Neiperra aaku are olkarasha oor enkaji e Nkai, eiteru te shumata o meiting'o ti abori.

English: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore pee edol osajini oitashe aipirare ninye, ajo etaa etundung'e tau, nejo, “Edede Oinoti le Nkai ele tung'ani.”

English: There were also women looking on afar off: among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
Masaai: Netii sii nkituaak naaing'orita elakuaniki inaatii Mariamu Magdalene, o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo oti o Yosef, netii sii Salome,

English: (Who also, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him;) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: ninche napa, etii ninye Galilaya, naatusujutua neisiaai. Netii sii kulie kituaak kumok naairiamunore ninye epuonu Yerusalem.

English: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
Masaai: Ore pee eaku teipa, naa enkolong e Nkitobirakinoto, aa enoshi olong taa pee eyookini enkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.

English: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
Masaai: Neshirraki Yosef le Arimatea, obo loo looyanyiti le nkiguana, olaa keanyita ninye enkitoria e Nkai, nelo enetii Pilato neomonu osesen le Yesu.

English: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
Masaai: Neing'asia Pilato pee eji eidipa Yesu atua, ore pee eipotu osajini, neikilikuan te naa keidipa atua.

English: And when he knew it of the centurion, he gave the body to Joseph.
Masaai: Ore pee ening to sajini ajo etua, neisho Yosef ilo sesen.

English: And he bought fine linen, and took him down, and wrapped him in the linen, and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock, and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre.
Masaai: Neinyang'u ninye olkarasha le kitani, neirragie te nkurare nataguetuaki to soit, neibeleleng'oki osoit enkutuk e ina kurare.

English: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
Masaai: Netoduaa Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'otonye Yosef eneirragieki ninye.

English: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
Masaai: Ore pee eishari enkolong nayeng'iyeng'areki, neinyang'u Mariamu Magdalene o Mariamu ng'oto Yakobo, o Salome iila naarropil pee epuo aael ninye.

English: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
Masaai: Ore tadekenya oleng te nkolong e nkiterata e wiki, nepuonu enkurare eilepua enkolong,

English: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
Masaai: ejokino maate, “Ae ng'ae ade oret iyiook aibeleleng'oo, osoit te nkutuk e nkurare?”

English: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
Masaai: Nejo maing'ura, nedol aajo eidipaki aaibeleleng'oi osoit aaiwuang'ie amu ae sapuk apa oleng.

English: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
Masaai: Ore pee ejing enkurare, nedol oltung'ani lelerue eitashe te nkalo e tatene, neishopito olkila oibor; neing'asia ninche.

English: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo ninche, “Eming'asia; Yesu le Nasaret ing'oruru, otashoki. Etopiwuo, metii ene; eng'ora enapa wueji neirragieki ninye.

English: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
Masaai: Kake enchom, entoliki ilooiteng'eni lenyena o Petero nchere, keituruk alo Galilaya; te ine ipuopuo aadol, anaa enatiaaka intae.”

English: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
