Masaai: Nepuku aapuo neipirri aaing'uaa enkurare; amu einepua olokirikiri o enkiputukuny, neitu eliki likae tung'ani, amu etureishote.

English: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
Masaai: Ore pee epiu Yesu enasirie te nkolong e nkiterata e wiki. Mariamu Magdalene etang'asa aipang'aki enapa nataararie loiriruani oopishana.

English: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
Masaai: Nelo ninye aliki lelo apa ooiriamariyie ninye, eishirita ninche neilisho.

English: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening ninche aajo eishu netoduaa ninye, neitu sii eiruk.

English: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, etawale ninye atum ae mua, neitalioo kewan te kulikae aare lenye epuo nkurman.

English: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
Masaai: Nerrinyo lelo aapuo aaliki lkulikae, kake eitu ninche eiruk.

English: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, neipang'aki lelo tomon oobo etoni aadaa; neisikong ninche te nkaraki engolon oo lukuny enye o te nkaraki nemeeta enkirukoto amu eitu eiruk lelo ootoduaa ninye eidipa atopiu.

English: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Enchom enkop pooki entoliki ltung'ana pooki ele rorei supat.

English: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
Masaai: Ore oloiruk neibatisae nejeu; ore olemeiruk nedung'okini enkiguana.

English: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
Masaai: Naa kulo lmonek ooiriamariyie lelo ooiruk te nkarna ai earaa loiriruani; neiro too nkutukie ng'ejuko.

English: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
Masaai: Nedumu lasuriaa, naa te neok entoki ake pooki nayaisho nemeeta enaiko ninche; neiteleiki ltamueyia nkaik, neishiu.”

English: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee eidip Olaitoriani Yesu airorie ninche, neilepieki aaya shumata, neton te nkaina e tatene e Nkai.

English: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
Masaai: Nedumunye ninche aapuo aalikioo ilo rorei too wuejitin pooki, neasisho Olaitoriani te nebo ninche neitadedeyie ilo rorei too lmonek ooiriamariyie. Esai.   Kake etolikio Petero too ndorropu, o lelo ooboitare nena naatolikioki ninche.  Ore te siadi nena, neitanap Yesu makewan ninche mewaita enkilepunoto neya endoyioroto elikioroto sinyati e njeunoto nemeish nebik intarasi.

English: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki natii lkumok ootonyuaakita aaiger imbaa naatupukutuo ti atua iyiook,

English: Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word;
Masaai: neigero anaa enainosakaki iyiook lelo apa ootoduaa te nkiterunoto too nkonyek enye, oora ninche laisiaayiak ooinosu ele rorei le Nkai.

English: It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus,
Masaai: Nadol sii nanu, Oloyanyiti Teofilo, ajo keishiaakino, natisipua mbaa pooki te rishata naado, naaigeroki mbaa naaitobirakino aitisipaki,

English: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.
Masaai: pee itum atayiolo esipata e kuna baa nikinosakaki.

English: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
Masaai: Etii apa te nkata o laiguanani Herode, le Yudea, olapolosani oji Sakaria, lo lkekun le Abija; ore enkitok enye naa ene ntalipa e Aaron, neji enkarna enye Elisabet.

English: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
Masaai: Naa supati ninche pokira are ti alo Enkai, nesuj inkitanapat o nkitoriat pooki o Laitoriani, meitong'or.

English: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
Masaai: Nemeeta enkerai, amu koolupi Elisabet, naa moruak pokira are.

English: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
Masaai: Neaku ore eitayu Sakaria esiaai e mpolosare too nkatitin olkekun lenye te dukuya Enkai,

English: According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord.
Masaai: anaa enaikununo olokishoni loo lapolosak, nedoiki enkukuo metaa ninye ojing enkaji o Laitoriani, ainok olasar le nkorropil.

English: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.
Masaai: Neomon olorora te boo, ina kata einoki enkorropil.

English: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense.
Masaai: Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkalo e tatene olperere lo lasar le nkorropil.

English: And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Sakaria neirut,

English: But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for thy prayer is heard; and thy wife Elisabeth shall bear thee a son, and thou shalt call his name John.
Masaai: nejoki olmalaika, “Sakaria, miureishoyu, etoning'oki enkomono ino: naa aikiiki enkitok ino Elisabet enkayioni, naa eimpot enkarna enye ajo Yohana.

English: And thou shalt have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
Masaai: Naa itum iyie enchipai o eng'ida to ltau lino, neng'ida ltung'ana kumok te inoto enye.

English: For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost, even from his mother's womb.
Masaai: Amu eaku ninye kitok te dukuya Olaitoriani, nemeok enaisho oo sabibu arashu enaisho napi, naa keigany Enkiyang'et Sinyati ebaiki etii enkoshoke e ng'otonye.

English: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God.
Masaai: Naa kerrinyoki Siraeli kumok Olaitoriani Enkai enye,

English: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
Masaai: neituruk dukuya ninye aaku olkilikuai lenye, te nkiyang'et o te ngolon e Eliya, eitaiki osotua enkerai o menye, neibelekeny iloogol onyek menoto eng'eno e lelo supati pee eitobiraki Olaitoriani iltung'ana ooishiaakino.”

English: And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years.
Masaai: Nejoki Sakaria olmalaika, “Ainyoo ayiolounye ena bae? Nataa moruo, naa moruo sii ninye enkitok ai?”

English: And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto thee, and to shew thee these glad tidings.
Masaai: Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Ara nanu Gabriel, oitashe te dukuya Enkai; naairriwuaki maairorie naaitabaiki ele kilikuai supat.

English: And, behold, thou shalt be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because thou believest not my words, which shall be fulfilled in their season.
Masaai: Ng'ura kionyo enkutuk mintoki airo, o metabau ina olong naibalayu nena, amu eitu iruk irorei laainei, kake eitabari ake te nkata naikenakaki.”

English: And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple.
Masaai: Naa keanyita ake lekua tung'ana Sakaria neing'asia te nkimutioto naimutie ti atua Enkaji e Nkai.

English: And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku, neitu eidim airorie ninche, neyiolou ninche aajo eeta enatoduaa te neinokieki olasar. Neitodol too lmonek meidim airorie.

English: And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu ilkekuno le nkisiayiare enye, nelo ang.

English: And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying,
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo nena olong'i, neiroshiu enkitok enye Elisabet, neisudoo kewan ilapaitin imiet, ejo,

English: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men.
Masaai: “Ena aaitaasa Olaitoriani te nkata natoduaa naaoru esulare te dukuya iltung'ana.”

English: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,
Masaai: Ore to lapa le ile, neirriwaa Enkai olmalaika oji Gabriel, meshomo enkang e Galilaya naji Nasaret,

English: To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
Masaai: enetii eselenkei natisira oltung'ani oji Yosef, lo lgilata le Daudi; naa keji ina selenkei Mariamu.

English: And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, thou that art highly favoured, the Lord is with thee: blessed art thou among women.
Masaai: Nejing'aki nejoki, “Takuenya na kirotet! Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie!”

English: And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be.
Masaai: Neirut oleng te nkaraki lelo rorei, nejo to ltau, “Kaji eikununo ena kirorokino?”

English: And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for thou hast found favour with God.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika, “Mariamu, miureishoyu, itaa kirotet te Nkai.

English: And, behold, thou shalt conceive in thy womb, and bring forth a son, and shalt call his name JESUS.
Masaai: Naa ing'ura inutayu, niiu enkayioni, nimpot enkarna enye ajo Yesu.

English: He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David:
Masaai: Naa keaku kitok neji Oinoti lo Lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki naa keisho Olaitoriani Enkai ninye olorika le nkitoo le Daudi menye lenye,

English: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end.
Masaai: neitore olgilata le Yakobo intarasi, nemeiting enkitoria enye.”

English: Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man?
Masaai: Nejoki Mariamu ilo malaika, “Kaji eiko pee eaku ena nemayiolo olee?”

English: And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God.
Masaai: Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Elotu Enkiyang'et Sinyati shumata iyie, nikintoip engolon o Lotii Shumata Aisul, ore te nkaraki ina, ore enkerai naini, neji sinyati, Enkerai e Nkai.

English: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
Masaai: Naa ing'ura, ore enkanashe ino Elisabet nenuta te moruo enye, naa keiu enkayioni, naa ole ile ele apa, te nutai enye, enatejoki oshi koolupi.

English: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
Masaai: Amu meetae embae nemeidimayu te Nkai.”

English: And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word. And the angel departed from her.
Masaai: Nejo Mariamu, “Kara nanu esinka o Laitoriani; metotiwuo te nanu anaa enitejo.” Nelo olmalaika aing'uaa ninye.

English: And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda;
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i, nedumunye Mariamu aisarrisar alo enkop oo oldoinyo, enkanasa e Yuda,

English: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
Masaai: nejing enkaji e Sakaria, neiroroki Elisabet.

English: And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Elisabet enkirorokino e Mariamu, neipid enkerai te nkoshoke; neigany Elisabet Enkiyang'et Sinyati,

English: And she spake out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb.
Masaai: nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Kitamayianaki iyie too nkituaak, nemayiani eishoi e ng'uset ino!

English: And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
Masaai: Kaji eikununo ele rorei, eji ng'otonye Olaitoriani lai nalotu enatii?

English: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
Masaai: Amu ore ake pee aning too nkiyiaa aainei enkiroroto ino, neipid enkerai te nchipai te nkoshoke ai.

English: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
Masaai: Emayiana enairuko inchere keitabari inaatiaakaki ninye eing'uaa Olaitoriani.”

English: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
Masaai: Nejo Mariamu, “Alimu te nkorrok ai enkitoo o Laitoriani;

English: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
Masaai: neshipakino enkiyang'et ai Enkai Olaitajeunoni lai,

English: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
Masaai: amu etoduaa enchalan e rrindik enye. Amu ore ebaiki taata, kaajo ishoritin pooki namayiana;

English: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name.
Masaai: amu aaitaasa ologol isapuki, ai sinyati enkarna enye.

English: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation.
Masaai: Ore olng'ur lenye netii shumata lelo ooure ninye too ishoritin pooki.

English: He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.
Masaai: Etaasa ine ngolon te nkaina enye; neisardakie iloowuasa o nkiguanat oo ltauja lenye.

English: He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.
Masaai: Eitadowuo ilaitoriak too lorikan lenye le nkitoo, neilepie iloomeni.

English: He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away.
Masaai: Eitaraposho iloata esumash too ntokitin sidain, nearaa ilkarsisi erook.

English: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
Masaai: Etasarua Israel osinka lenye, etadamua olng'ur lenye,

English: As he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.
Masaai: anaa enatiaaka iloo papa, Abraham o eishoi enye intarasi.”

English: And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house.
Masaai: Neton Mariamu aboitare ninye ilapaitin oobaya okuni, nerrinyo alo ang.

English: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
Masaai: Nebau enkata neisho Elisabet, neiu enkayioni.

English: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her.
Masaai: Nening elatia enye, o lgilata lenye nchere, eing'urrie Olaitoriani, neshipayu te nebo ninye.

English: And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e isiet, nepuonu aa murat enkerai, neyieu nedung'oki enkarna aaipotie Sakaria menye lenye.

English: And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John.
Masaai: Nejoki, ng'otonye, “Mme neijia, keipoti aajo, Yohana.”

English: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
Masaai: Nejokini, “Meetae oltung'ani lo lmarei linyi oji neijia.”

English: And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called.
Masaai: Neikilikuan menye too lmonek enayieu neji.

English: And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all.
Masaai: Neipotu osoit dapash neiger ajo, “Keji enkarna Yohana!” Neingasia pooki.

English: And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spake, and praised God.
Masaai: Nebolo Sakaria enkutuk ina kata ake, nelaa olng'ejep lenye, neiro, aisis Enkai.

English: And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea.
Masaai: Neureishoyu pooki oomanya ina latia, nelikiori nena baa pooki to ldoinyo le Yudea.

English: And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him.
Masaai: Ore lootoning'o pooki neiteng'el too ltauja lenye ejo, “Keaku pasa ena kerai keniaa pukunoto?” Amu eiriamunore enkaina e Nkai ninye.

English: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Ghost, and prophesied, saying,
Masaai: Neiput Sakaria, menye lenye Enkiyang'et Sinyati neibonisho ajo,

English: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,
Masaai: “Meisisi Olaitoriani Enkai e Siraeli, amu etabaikia nekordu ltung'ana lenyena,”

English: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David;
Masaai: eishorua Olaitajeunoni Magilani to lgilata lo sinka lenye Daudi,

English: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began:
Masaai: anaa enatejo apake too nkirorot oo sinyat, enoo loibonok le Nkai liapa moitie

English: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us;
Masaai: pee kijeu too lmang'ati lang, o too nkaik e lelo pooki ooiba iyiook;

English: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant;
Masaai: neitabaya olng'ur oisiligie iloo papa lang, nedamu osotua lenye sinyati,

English: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
Masaai: olmumai oinosaka papa lang Abraham,

English: That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear,
Masaai: nchere, ore pee eitajeu iyiook, too nkaik oo lmang'ati lang, nikisiaai ninye,

English: In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life.
Masaai: te sinyatisho o te supatisho, too nkolong'i pooki e nkishui ang.

English: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
Masaai: Ore sii iyie na kerai, aikiji oloiboni lo Lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki. Amu inturuk te dukuya Olaitoriani, aitobiraki nkoitoi enyena.

English: To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,
Masaai: Aliki ltung'ana lenyena enjeunoto, te mpalakinoto oo ng'ok enye,

English: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
Masaai: te nkaraki enanai o lng'ur le Nkai ang, laa te ninye ekenyiki iyiook enjeunoto eing'uaa shumata,

English: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
Masaai: eitawang'aki ilootoni te naimin, o lootoni to loip le nkeeya, pee eutaki nkejek ang inkoitoi o sotua.”

English: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.
Masaai: Nebulu enkerai, neponari engolon e nkiyang'et, nebik ti ong'ata o metabau enkolong naipang'akinyeki olorere le Israel.

English: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i nepuku enkitanapata naing'uaa olaiguanani kitok Kaisari Augustus inchere kesiri iltung'ana pooki inkarn.

English: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
Masaai: Naa ena enkigerore oo nkarn e nkiterata naigeroki te nkata e Kirinius olbalusui le Siria.

English: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
Masaai: Nelo ake oltung'ani enkang enye meigeri.

English: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
Masaai: Nelo sii Yosef te Galilaya aing'uaa enkang e Nasaret, ailep alo enkang e Daudi naji Betlehem amu ole nkaji e Daudi te ntalipa,

English: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
Masaai: pee eigeri te nebo enkitok enye, Mariamu, natasayia aa entuaa.

English: And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered.
Masaai: Ore ebikito te ine, nebaya inkolong'i pee eisho.

English: And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.
Masaai: Neiu enkerai enye kikau, neishopoki nkilani e keraisho, neirragie ninye te mpeut oo nkishu, amu eitu etum enejing te nkaji oo lomon.

English: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night.
Masaai: Naa ore te ina kop etii ilchekuti ootoni aarrip intare kewarie.

English: And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid.
Masaai: Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani, neimerlelu esikar o Laitoriani too nkaloli pooki, neureishoyu ninche oleng.

English: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika ninche, “Emiureishoyu amu ilomon supati le ng'ida kitok ayau naaku too ltung'ana pooki,

English: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
Masaai: amu ore te nkang e Daudi, etoiwuoki Olaitajeunoni, te nkaraki intae, laa ninye Kristo, Olaitoriani.

English: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
Masaai: Naa ele olmonekie te intae: itumutumu elooyo naishopokino nkilani e keraisho, neirragita te mpeut oo nkishu.”

English: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying,
Masaai: Neboitare ilo malaika, olorora kitok le shumata oisis Enkai ejo,

English: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Masaai: “Meisisi Enkai te shumata naisul te pooki, neaku osotua te nkop, too ltung'ana pooki laa ninche eshipakino ninye!”

English: And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing which is come to pass, which the Lord hath made known unto us.
Masaai: Ore pee epuo lelo malaika shumata aaing'uaa ninche, nejokino ilchekuti, “Enyeito emaape aabaya Betlehem, aadol ena bae nataase naitayiolo iyiook Olaitoriani.”

English: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
Masaai: Neisarrisar aapuo neinepu Mariamu o Yosef, neirrag elooyo te mpeut.

English: And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child.
Masaai: Ore pee edol neinosu ninche lomon ootiaakaki te nkaraki ina looyo.

English: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ootoning'o nena naatolimutuo ilchekuti neing'asia.

English: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
Masaai: Kake eiteng'ela Mariamu nena baa pooki edamu to ltau lenye.

English: And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them.
Masaai: Neshuko lelo shekuti eisho Enkai enkitoo neisis too mbaa pooki naatoning'o o naatoduaa anaa enatiaakaki ninche.

English: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku enkiting'oto e nkolong e isiet, nemurati neipoti aajo Yesu, ina arna apa natudung'oko olmalaika eton eitu enutaini.

English: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya nkolong'i e nkata e nkipooto anaa enatiu too nkitanapat e Musa, neriku ninye Yerusalem pee eitarasakini Olaitoriani,

English: (As it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;)
Masaai: anaa enatisiraki too nkitanapat o Laitoriani nchere, “Ore pooki lee kikau pooki, neipoti aajo sinyati to Laitoriani.”

English: And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.
Masaai: Ejo sii pee eishooyo olasar anaa enajo nkitanapat o Laitoriani, aa, “Nturkuluni are, aashu nkera are e nturkulu.”

English: And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Ghost was upon him.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura etii apa Yerusalem oltung'ani oji Simeon, naa oltung'ani supat nenyor Enkai, oanyita ninye meitajeu Enkai Siraeli, netii Enkiyang'et Sinyati atua ninye.

English: And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Ghost, that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ.
Masaai: Neitayiolo Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninye nchere meye eitu edol Kristo lo Laitoriani.

English: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
Masaai: Nelotu enkaji e Nkai, erikito Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninye: ore pee eyaki intoiwuo enkerai Yesu meitaasa anaa entipat oo nkitanapat e Musa,

English: Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said,
Masaai: neng'amu ninye Yesu too nkaik enyena, neisis Enkai nejo,

English: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
Masaai: “Olaitoriani, inchoo taata osinka lino meshomo te seriani, anaa enitejo.

English: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
Masaai: Amu etoduaa nkonyek aainei enjeunoto ino

English: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
Masaai: nintobira meibalayu too loreren pooki:

English: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.
Masaai: ewang'an naboloki loreren enkoitoi ino, neaku errepet oo Siraeli linono.”

English: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him.
Masaai: Neingasia menye o ng'otonye te nena naairoroki te nkaraki ninye.

English: And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against;
Masaai: Nemayian Simeon ninche nejoki Mariamu, ng'otonye, “Ng'ura, eitaaki ena kerai olobatatare naa olodumunore sii ilkumok ootii Siraeli. Neaku olmonekie oirori aasukeny,

English: (Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.
Masaai: naa aikiim olalem oltau lino iyie, pee eibalunyeki indamunot oo ltauja kumok.”

English: And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity;
Masaai: Netii enkoiboni naji Ana ene Fanuel, o losho le Asheri: naa entasat moruo, naa larin oopishana ake etotona eeta, olmoruo.

English: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day.
Masaai: Na enkoliai oo larin ntomoni isiet o oong'uan. Nemepuku ti atua enkaji e Nkai, neen kewan aitupukoo.

English: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nelotu ninye te ina kata, neisho Enkai enashe, neimaki ina kerai aliki lelo pooki ooanyita metalaku Enkai Yerusalem.

English: And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aaitabai inaaitanapishoteki pooki, too nkitanapat o Laitoriani, nerrinyo aapuo Galilaya, enkang enye te Nasaret.

English: And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him.
Masaai: Nebulu ina kerai negolu, neiput eng'eno nagut, netii enkirotetisho e Nkai shumata ninye.

English: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover.
Masaai: Nepuo apake ntoiwuo enyena Yerusalem to lari ake pooki pee emanu osirua le Pasaka.

English: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku oloo larin tomon o aare neilep aapuo anaa entipat e ilo sirua.

English: And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya nkolong'i naashukore, neing'uari enkayioni Yesu te Yerusalem. Nemeiyiolo intoiwuo enyena.

English: But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.
Masaai: Kake ore ejo ninche etii ake atua encholiek enye, nepuo endama nalulung'a, neing'oru te lelo lo lgilata lenye, o too le latia enye.

English: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
Masaai: Ore pee elau ninye, neshuko Yerusalem aapuo aaing'oru.

English: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i uni, netum te nkaji e Nkai, eton te rishata ilaiteng'enak, einining'ito neikilikuanishore.

English: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers.
Masaai: Ore ilooinining'ito pooki, neing'asia te ng'eno enye o too naawalu.

English: And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why hast thou thus dealt with us? behold, thy father and I have sought thee sorrowing.
Masaai: Ore pee edol intoiwuo neing'asia. Nejoki ng'otonye, “Na kerai; aainyo pee inkuna iyiook inji? King'orutua iyie, nanu o papaai lino te nkirutoto o to sina.”

English: And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ainyoo pee king'oruru? Aimiyiololo aajo eishiaakino tenatii enkaji e Papa?”

English: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
Masaai: Neitu ejing'aa ele rorei otiaaka.

English: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
Masaai: Nedou Yesu airiamunore ninche nebau Nazaret, nening ninye ninche. Neshum ng'otonye nena baa pooki to ltau lenye.

English: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
Masaai: Neponari Yesu eng'eno, nebulu, neitiship Enkai o ltung'ana.

English: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene,
Masaai: Ore to lari le tomon o miet le nkitoria o laiguanani kitok oji Tiberia Kaisaria, aa Pontio Pilato olbalusui le Yudea, naa Herode olkitok le Galilaya, naa Filipo olalashe lenye olkitok le Iturea o Trikoniti, naa Lisenias olkitok le Abilene,

English: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
Masaai: naa Annas o Kaiafas ilapolosak kituaak, nebaiki ororei le Nkai Yohana olayioni le Sakaria ti ong'ata.

English: And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins;
Masaai: Nelo ina kop pooki oo mbat o lkeju le Yordan elikioo enkibatisa naitoduaaya enkirridunoto nayau e mpalakinoto oo ng'ok,

English: As it is written in the book of the words of Esaias the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
Masaai: anaa enasira te mbuku e Isaya oloiboni le Nkai ajo, “Oltoilo lo lobuakita ti ong'ata, entobiraki Olaitoriani enkoitoi, entorioi irrekiei lenyena

English: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
Masaai: nenuki nong'ot pooki, ore pooki doinyo o lkiushin neitodorropi; ore ineekordilo nererei, ore nkoitoi naasur neisiashayieki;

English: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
Masaai: pee edol iltung'ana pooki enjeunoto e Nkai.”

English: Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
Masaai: Nejoki Yohana lelo ororani ooetuo enetii ninye meibatisa, “Na ishoi oo lasuriaa! Ae ng'ae naikoo intae eng'atai engoro nalotu?

English: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
Masaai: Entadedeyie naa enkirridunoto inyi too lng'anayio lenyena; nimintokiki ake ajo, ‘Kiata Abraham aa papa lang.’ Ajoki intae, keidim Enkai ainyeyieki Abraham nkera te kulo soito.

English: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
Masaai: Eidipaki taata aaiteleiki entolu ntonat oo lkeek; ore olchani ake pooki lemeiu lng'anayio sidain nedung'i aauroo nenang'akini enkima.”

English: And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then?
Masaai: Neikilikuan lelo ororani ninye aajoki, “Kaa naa kiaas?”

English: He answereth and saith unto them, He that hath two coats, let him impart to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do likewise.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Ore oloata nkilani are, inchoo eisho nabo ilo lemeeta, ore oloata endaa neng'arie olemeeta.”

English: Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?
Masaai: Nepuonu sii ninche iloosotu kodi meibatisai, neikilikuan aajoki, “Lo aiteng'enani, kaa kiaas iyiook?”

English: And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Emintulus aaoru ltung'ana enalang ina naitanapaki intae.”

English: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
Masaai: Neikilikuan sii ninche sikarini aajoki, “Oo iyiook, kaa kiaas?” Nejoki ninche, “Emisim oltung'ani anaa nteenikiki elejare, ninchosho sii ebaiki intae olekoisiayio linyi.”

English: And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;
Masaai: Ore elimana ltung'ana eanyita enaaku, neitiko ltauja le pooki te nkaraki Yohana, emusumusu aajo ebaiki naa Kristo ninye, ana mme ninye,

English: John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I cometh, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire:
Masaai: newaliki Yohana ninche pooki ajoki, “Esipa aibatisa nanu intae te nkare, kake kelotu ologol te nanu lemeishiaakino nalak enkeene e namuke enye. Ilo oibatisa intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o te nkima;

English: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
Masaai: neibung'ita ninye esilet enye te nkaina pee eor asip katukul olkurroto lenye oidong'ishoreki, nesotoki enkano empeche; kake ore suut, nepej te nkima nemearayu ntarasi.”

English: And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people.
Masaai: Ore te kulie kumok nereiki aikok olorere eliki lomon supati.

English: But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,
Masaai: Kake ore Herode ilo balusui pee eisikong ninye te nkaraki nayama Herodias enkitok o lalashe lenye, o sii te nkaraki kulie bususi naataasa Herode,

English: Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison.
Masaai: neponiki ena nena pooki neikenoo Yohana te korokoroni.

English: Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened,
Masaai: Ore eibatisaki iltung'ana pooki neidipaki aaibatisa sii ninye Yesu, eomonito Enkai nebolo shumata,

English: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
Masaai: nedou Enkiyang'et Sinyati etiu anaa enturkulu adoiki ninye. Nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa shumata ojo, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai lanyor, kaashipakino iyie.”

English: And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli,
Masaai: Ore pee eiteru Yesu enkisiaayiare enye naa oloo larin oobaya tomoni uni. Ore ninye anaa enajo iltung'ana, olayioni le Daudi, olayioni le Heli,

English: Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph,
Masaai: olayioni le Matat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Matat, olayioni le Lawi, olayioni le Melki, olayioni le Yanai, olayioni le Yosef,

English: Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge,
Masaai: olayioni le Matatias, olayioni le Amos, olayioni le Nahum, olayioni le Elsi, olayioni le Nagai,

English: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,
Masaai: olayioni le Maat, olayioni le Matatias, olayioni le Semein, olayioni le Yosek, olayioni le Yuda,

English: Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri,
Masaai: olayioni le Yonan, olayioni le Resa, olayioni le Serubabel, olayioni le Shealtiel, olayioni le Neri,

English: Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
Masaai: olayioni le Melki, olayioni le Adi, olayioni le Kosam, olayioni le Elmadam, olayioni le Er,

English: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
Masaai: olayioni le Yoshua, olayioni le Eliesa, olayioni le Yorim, olayioni le Matar, olayioni le Lawi,

English: Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim,
Masaai: olayioni le Simeon, olayioni le Yuda, olayioni le Yosef, olayioni le Yonam, olayioni le Eliakim,

English: Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David,
Masaai: olayioni le Melea, olayioni le Mena, olayioni le Matata, olayioni le Natan, olayioni le Daudi,

English: Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson,
Masaai: olayioni le Obed, olayioni le Boas, olayioni le Sala, olayioni le Nashon,

English: Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,
Masaai: olayioni le Aminadab, olayioni le Admin, olayioni le Arni, olayioni le Hesron, olayioni le Peres, olayioni le Yuda,

English: Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor,
Masaai: olayioni le Yakobo, olayioni le Isaak, olayioni le Abraham, olayioni le Tera, olayioni le Nahor, olayioni le Serug,

English: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
Masaai: olayioni le Reu, olayioni le Peleg, olayioni le Eber, olayioni le Shela,

English: Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech,
Masaai: olayioni le Kainan, olayioni le Alfasad, olayioni le Shem, olayioni le Noa, olayioni le Lamek,

English: Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan,
Masaai: olayioni le Metusela, olayioni le Enok, olayioni le Yared, olayioni le Mahalalel, olayioni le Kainan,

English: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.
Masaai: olayioni le Enos, olayioni le Seti, olayioni le Adam, olayioni le Nkai.

English: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness,
Masaai: Neiganya Yesu Enkiyang'et Sinyati apa pee errinyunye eing'uaa olkeju le Yordan, Nerik Enkiyang'et ninye ong'ata,

English: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
Masaai: nkolong'i artam, metetema shetani. Neitu enya toki te nena olong'i, ore pee eitabaya netir esumash.

English: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.
Masaai: Nejoki shetani ninye, “Te naa ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai, tiaaki ele soit metaa endaa.”

English: And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etisiraki aajo, ‘Mme endaa ake eishuyie oltung'ani.’ ”

English: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
Masaai: Neilepie shetani Yesu enchumata o ldoinyo oodo, neitodol enkitoo pooki e nkop, te nkiti kata,

English: And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give thee, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it.
Masaai: nejoki Shetani ninye, “Aaisho ntoria kuna pooki, o enkitoo enye, pee aisho pooki, o enkitoo enye, pee aisho pooki layieu naisho;

English: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
Masaai: metaa te nikiserem iyie nanu neaku nkuninono pooki.”

English: And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get thee behind me, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Etisiraki aajo, ‘Olaitoriani Enkai ino ake iserem, naa ninye ake isiaai.’ ”

English: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:
Masaai: Nerik Yerusalem neitasheyie te ntopij e enkaji e Nkai, nejoki, “Te naa ira Enkerai e Nkai, tusulai kewan,

English: For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee:
Masaai: amu etisiraki aajo, ‘Kaikirriwaki lmalaika, mikitorripo,’ netejoki sii,

English: And in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
Masaai: ‘Niking'amaa too nkaik enye, pee mikinkob osoit enkeju ino.’ ”

English: And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Etejoki, ‘Mitem iyie Olaitoriani Enkai ino.’ ”

English: And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season.
Masaai: Ore pee emitunye shetani too ntemat enyena pooki nelo aing'uaa eanyu ai rishata enye.

English: And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about.
Masaai: Nerrinyo Yesu Galilaya ebore engolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, neibulaa enkisisa, nkuapi naamanita.

English: And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.
Masaai: Neiteng'enisho too nkajijik enye e ntumo nerrep iltung'ana pooki ninye.

English: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up for to read.
Masaai: Neito ninye Nasaret ine netubulaka, nejing enkaji e ntumo te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaa enaiko apake, neitashe aisoma.

English: And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Esaias. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written,
Masaai: Neishori embuku o loiboni le Nkai Isaya. Nebol ina buku netum ewueji netisiraki aajo,

English: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised,
Masaai: “Etii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani atua nanu, amu aatubukoko ninye e ilata, aput, naairriwua matoliki laisinak ororei supat, nalaku te sinkaisho ilooena, naliki lmodook emboloto oo nkonyek enye, nalaku aisho epuo, lelo ooitorogonyaki,

English: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
Masaai: nalimu olari osarunye Enkai ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him.
Masaai: Neiken embuku, neshukoki olashumani neton; neibelekenya lelo pooki ootoni te nkaji e ntumo aaing'or ninye.

English: And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears.
Masaai: Neiter ajoki ninche, “Eitabayioki taata kulo sirat ining'itoto too nkiyiaa inyi.”

English: And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son?
Masaai: Neimaki pooki ninye aarrep eing'asia too rorei le mpiris ooimu enkutuk enye. Nejo, “Ae mme olayioni le Yosef doi ele?”

English: And he said unto them, Ye will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal thyself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in thy country.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Meeta nchere pee eitu kiyookiki aadung'ie rashe aajoki, ‘Olabaani tabaa kewan,’ nijojo, ‘Taasa sii iyie te ine nitubulaka, mbaa nijo nena nikitoning'o nchere itaasa te Kapernaum.’ ”

English: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
Masaai: Nejo, “Esipa ajoki intae, meetae oloiboni le Nkai oyanyiti te murua nabulaki.

English: But I tell you of a truth, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land;
Masaai: Esipa nchere keetae apa nkolia kumok ti atua Siraeli te nkata o loiboni Eliya, pee elai enchan too larin okuni o lapaitin ile, neibulu olameyu ina kop pooki;

English: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.
Masaai: kake ore eyia, eitu eirriwakini Eliya hoo nabo e nena, enkoliai e Sarepta ake eirriwakaki te nkop e Sidon.

English: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.
Masaai: Kumok sii iltung'ana le nkeeya oo lbolot oatae te Siraeli te nkata o loiboni le Nkai Elisha, nemeetae hoo likae obo oitukuoki, leme Naaman ake le Siria.”

English: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
Masaai: Ore pee ening nena baa pooki etoni ti atua enkaji e ntumo neiput engoro.

English: And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong.
Masaai: Neinyototo, nearaa auluo e ina anasa neriku embata e marti namanya ina anasa, ejo pee esulaa te ina marti;

English: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
Masaai: kake etapaashare apolos atua ninche nelo ninye.

English: And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days.
Masaai: Nedou alotu Kapernaum, aa enkanasa e Galilaya, neiteng'en ninche te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.

English: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word was with power.
Masaai: Neing'asia te nkiteng'enare enye, amu keiro anaa oloata enkitoria.

English: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
Masaai: Netii atua ina aji e ntumo oltung'ani oata oloirirua oiduruk. Nebuak aishir to ltoilo sapuk ejo,

English: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art; the Holy One of God.
Masaai: “Ooi Yesu le Nasaret, ainyoo iatakinore iyiook? Iyewuo aidaikie iyiook? Kaayiolo ajo ira ng'ae: ira ilo obo Sinyati le Nkai.”

English: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not.
Masaai: Neisikong Yesu nejoki, “Tigirayu! Tupuku tung'uai ninye.” Nebatat ilo oirirua torrono te dukuya ninye nepuku aing'uaa meeta enaitaasa ninye.

English: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
Masaai: Neing'asia pooki nejokino, “Kaa kiroroto ena nairo? Aaku kearaa te nkitoria o te ngolon iloiriruani ooiduruk, nepuku ninche.”

English: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about.
Masaai: Neibulu enkisisa enye pooki wueji te nena murua naamanita.

English: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'uaa enkaji e ntumo nejing enkaji e Simon. Neitirrishaka olkirobi enkaputani e Simon, neikilikuani enkaraki ninye.

English: And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them.
Masaai: Neitashe arumaki ninye kop nearaa ilo kirobi, nepuku olkirobi aing'uaa. Neinyototo nabo kata aisiaai ninche.

English: Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.
Masaai: Ore edoyio enkolong, neyau lelo pooki ooata ltamueyia loo mpukunot kumok aayaki ninye meishiunye. Neiteleiki ake pooki tung'ani nkaik neishiunye ninche.

English: And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, Thou art Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ.
Masaai: Nepuku sii iloiriruani ooiduruk kumok, aaing'uaa ltung'ana ebuaaya aajo, “Ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai.” Neing'ode amitiki eiro, amu keyiolo ninche aajo Kristo ninye.

English: And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu nelo ewueji neliyio; kake eing'oru olorere ninye. Nepuonu enetii, nejo maiboo neing'uaa ninche;

English: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
Masaai: kake etiaaka ninche, “Kalo ake pee aliki sii ninche kulie ang'itie kulo omon supati le nkitoria e Nkai. Ina pee aairriwuaki.”

English: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
Masaai: Nelikioo lelo omon too nkajijik e ntumo e Yudea.

English: And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret,
Masaai: Ore eiding'akino ltung'ana aamanita einining'u lomon le Nkai, neitashe ninye te mbata e naiposha e Genesaret,

English: And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.
Masaai: nedol impeuti are eirrag te mbata e naiposha. Etupukutuo larreshok loo sinkir aapuo aaisuj irresheta lenye.

English: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
Masaai: Nejing atua empeut nabo, naa ene Simon nejoki meturrumoi peno aitalam enkop natoyio. Neton aiteng'en olorere eton ninye ti atua empeut.

English: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip airoro nejoki Simon, “Terewa enegut nintadoikiki rresheta inyi enaiposha aaibung isinkir.”

English: And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon, “Lo Kitok, kitaasishote enkewarie nalulung'a neitu kitum toki, kake ore amu itejo, kaitadoyio resheta.”

English: And when they had this done, they inclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake.
Masaai: Ore pee eiko neijia neibung olkito turrur loo sinkir neiteru aang'era resheta lenye.

English: And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink.
Masaai: Neyuku ilenchuluek enye ootii enkae peut meetu aaret. Nepuonu, neiput impeuti pokira are, o metaa keimis.

English: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Simon Petero ina nebatata too nkejek e Yesu, ejoki, “Olaitoriani, tung'uayioki nanu amu, kara oltung'ani loo ng'ok.”

English: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
Masaai: Amu eing'asie ninye o lelo ooboitare, te nkumoi oo sinkir ooibung'a;

English: And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth thou shalt catch men.
Masaai: eing'asiate sii ninche layiok le Sebedayo, aa Yakobo o Yohana, oora le ncholiek e Simon, Nejoki Yesu Simon, “Miureishoyu; ore ebaiki taata, iltung'ana intorioo aibung.”

English: And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him.
Masaai: Neyau mpeuti enkop natoyio, neing'uaa pooki toki nesuj ninye.

English: And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
Masaai: Ore etii ninye ae ang, ng'ura, netii oltung'ani oata enkeeya oo lbolot, ore pee edol ninye Yesu, nebatata te nkomom, neserem ajoki, “Olaitoriani, te niyieu eikindim aishiunye atisika.”

English: And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be thou clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him.
Masaai: Neitorioo enkaina enye neiseyie nejoki, “Ekayieu, ninchiu tisikayu.” Neishiu asika nabo kata ina keeya oo lbolot.

English: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
Masaai: Neitanap Yesu ninye pee meliki likae tung'ani; nejoki, “Kake inyo, intoduaai kewan mikitisipu olapolosani ninchooyo olasar le nkishiunoto naaitanapishe Musa pee eitadedeyie ina sikata ino te ninche.”

English: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.
Masaai: Kake etoponari lomon lenyena aaibulu enkop pooki, nepuonu siamon kumok enetii aainining neishiunye mueyiaritin enye pooki.

English: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
Masaai: Kake kekepari ake nelo ong'ata, aomon Enkai openy.

English: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong eiteng'enisho, netii ine ilfarisayo olasirak ooing'uaa nkang'itie pooki e Galilaya, o Yudea o Yerusalem. Netii engolon e Nkai atua Yesu pee etum aishiunye olorere.

English: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
Masaai: Nepuonu ina kata ltung'ana oonapita te rruat, oltung'ani maima, netem aajo mayaki Yesu ti atua aji.

English: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki enkiding'a o lorere nelaikino aayaki. Nedumu aailepakinye shumata enkaji, nebol aaitayu elusie, neitadou te rruat aaitadoiki nkejek e Yesu te mpolos o lorere.

English: And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, thy sins are forgiven thee.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu enkirukoto naata ninche, nejoki ilo tung'ani, “Olchore, kitapalakaki ng'ok inono.”

English: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?
Masaai: Neiteru lasirak o Lfarisayo aaishankarra ejo, “Ae ng'ae ele oiro amor Enkai? Ai mme Nkai ake naidim atapalaki oltung'ani ng'ok?”

English: But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason ye in your hearts?
Masaai: Nedol Yesu eishankarra newaliki ajoki, “Ainyoo pee inchankarrarra maate?

English: Whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Rise up and walk?
Masaai: Kaa nalelek, te najo, ‘Kitapalakaki ng'ok inono,’ ana te najo, ‘Inyo shomo?’

English: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy couch, and go into thine house.
Masaai: Kake ore pee iyiolouu aajo keeta Enkerai e Tung'ani enkitoria te nkop napalakinye ng'ok,” nejoki ilo tung'ani maima, “Aajoki inyo tudumu erruat ino shomo ang.”

English: And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God.
Masaai: Neinyototo nabo kata te dukuya ninche, nedumu enaduoo rruat napetita, nelo ang eisisita Enkai.

English: And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day.
Masaai: Neing'asia pooki nesis Enkai, neureishoyu, nejo, “Kitoduaa ake taata mbaa e nking'asia!”

English: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu nena nelo Yesu, nedol oltung'ani osotu kodi oji Lawi, eton te wueji nesotunye kodi; nejoki, “Tusujuki nanu.”

English: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
Masaai: Neing'uaa pooki toki, neinyototo asuj Yesu.

English: And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them.
Masaai: Neitoomon Lawi ninye to sirua kitok netii esiamo kitok oo loosotu kodi o kulikae ake oodaa te nebo ninche.

English: But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do ye eat and drink with publicans and sinners?
Masaai: Neing'unyung'unyaki Lfarisayo o lasirak ilooiteng'eni lenyena ajo, “Oo pee ing'arierie endaa niokishosho te nebo iloosotu kodi o laing'okok?”

English: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Imeyieu iltung'ana biyot olabaani, iloomuoi ooyieu.

English: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
Masaai: Eitu alotu aipot lelo supati kake ilaing'okok meetu aairridu.”

English: And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but thine eat and drink?
Masaai: Nejoki taa ninche ninye, “Anaa eijo keen ate aapukoo oshi ilooiteng'eni le Yohana neomon Enkai naleng sii, naa neijia eiko ilooiteng'eni loo Lfarisayo, nedaa ninche linono neokisho?”

English: And he said unto them, Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Indimidimi aaitupukoi ilomon lo loyamisho eton eboitare oloyamisho?

English: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.
Masaai: Kake keyooki aapuonu nkolong'i naayae oloyamisho aaitung'uaa, nepukoo taa ninche te nena olong'i.”

English: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
Masaai: Neitoki aliki enkitanyaanyukoto nejoki, “Meetae oltung'ani oboru erashe to lkila ng'ejuk aripaki olkila musana, pee meinyal ilo ng'ejuk elde musana.

English: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.
Masaai: Meetae sii olobukoki enaisho oo sabibu ng'ejuk ilbenia musan pee medany ina aisho oo sabibu lelo benia musan, neibukori ninye neidaaya ilbenia.

English: But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.
Masaai: Kake ilbenia ng'ejuko epiki enaisho ng'ejuk.

English: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.
Masaai: Meetae sii oltung'ani otooko enaisho nao oitoki ayieu enajon, amu kejo, ‘Enao esidai.’ ”

English: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkolong e sabato, neim Yesu atua nkurman e nkano. Negilu ilooiteng'eni lenyena lukuny e nkano nepupu too nkaik aanya lanterera.

English: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
Masaai: Nejoki lkulikae loo Lfarisayo, “Kaji etiu pee iasiasa enemeishoruno too nkitanapat ang te nkolong e sabato?”

English: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Keitu ai kata isomama enataasa Daudi o looisiritore pee etir esumash?

English: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
Masaai: Ajo etijing'a enkaji e Nkai, neitayu emukate e nkitoduaaroto, nenya, neng'arie sii lelo ooisiritore. Neibala nchere meishoruno too nkitanapat meinosa likae tung'ani ina mukate leme lapolosak?”

English: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Olkitok le nkolong e sabato doi Enkerai e Tung'ani.”

English: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
Masaai: Ore ti ae olong e sabato nejing Yesu enkaji e ntumo aiteng'enisho. Netii oltung'ani ine tasat enkaina e tatene.

English: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
Masaai: Neing'oru ake kulikae asirak o Lfarisayo embae naitang'orie Yesu aajo eitarruoyie; nejur pee edol te naa keeta oltung'ani oishiunye te nkolong e sabato.

English: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
Masaai: Kake etayiolo Yesu ndamunot enye nejoki ilo tung'ani tasat o aina, “Inyo wou dukuya tene.” Neinyototo ilo tung'ani neitashe te ine.

English: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
Masaai: Nejoki taa Yesu ninche, “Aikilikuan intae ena? Kaa naishoruno too nkitanapat mataas te nkolong e sabato? Keishoruno mataar ana mataret?”

English: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
Masaai: Nekurraki pooki inkonyek aing'or, neitoki ajoki ilo tung'ani, “Intorioi enkaina ino!” Neiko neijia, neishiu enkaina enye.

English: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
Masaai: Kake eiputa ninche engoro napi neiguana maate eing'oru enaitaas Yesu.

English: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i, neilep alo oldoinyo aomon, neton enkewarie pooki eomonito Enkai.

English: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu neipot ilooteng'eni lenyena negelu tomon o aare ti atua ninche nejo ninche lkipaareta.

English: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
Masaai: Naa Simon oipoto ajo Petero o Anterea olalashe lenye; o Yakobo o Yohana, o Filipo o Bartolomayo;

English: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
Masaai: Matayo o Tomas, Yakobo ole Alfayo o Simon oji olkirowuai;

English: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
Masaai: Yudas olayioni le Yakobo o Yuda Iskariot laa ninye otaa olakaldoroni.

English: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
Masaai: Neiriamunore adou to ldoinyo nelotu enkisiashata. Netii ine ilooiteng'eni lenyena kumok o siamon naaing'uaa Yudea o Yerusalem o lomanaa le Turo o Sidon;

English: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
Masaai: laa ninye oetuo aainining ninye nejo sii pee eishiunye nkeyaitin enye; ore lelo ooitanyamalita loiriruani ooiduruk, neishiunye.

English: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
Masaai: Neyietu pooki ng'ae te ina siamo neiseyie ninye amu, kepuku engolon ti atua ninye neishiunye pooki.

English: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for yours is the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Neraposhu ninye nkonyek aing'or ilooiteng'eni lenyena nejo, “Imayianana intae ilaisinak amu eninyi enkitoria e Nkai.

English: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
Masaai: “Imayianana ilooata taata esumash; amu keitaraposhi intae. “Imayianana ilooishir taata amu iyookiki aakueni.

English: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
Masaai: “Imayianana te neibayu intae iltung'ana, nekepaa intae nemor, nemit eipoti nkarn inyi ejo torrok, te nkaraki Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
Masaai: Ore ina olong entishipata niranyiranya aaipidipid te ng'ida, amu kesipa ai kitok enkishorunoto naishori intae te shumata; amu ina apa eitaasa iloo papaai linyi iloibonok li apa.

English: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
Masaai: “Kake woi ee ekake ayia intae ilkarsisi taata; indipa intae aanoto olkar linyi.

English: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia intae ilooraposho taata; keyooki atir intae esumash. “Woi ake intae ilookueni taata; iyookiki ake aaishir.

English: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
Masaai: “Ee kake ayia te neimaki intae ltung'ana aaisis; neijia taa apake eikuna iloo papaai linyi aaisis iloibonok le lejare.

English: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
Masaai: “Kake ajoki intae kulo laaning'ito

English: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
Masaai: entonyor ilmang'ati linyi; entaasa isupati ilooiba intae; entamayian iloodek intae; ore iloosukeny intae neinyial, entoomonoki.

English: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
Masaai: Ore pee kiosh oltung'ani eseder nyaaki inchoo sii enkae; ore pee eya oltung'ani engoti ino; inchoo sii enchati meewa.

English: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
Masaai: Inchoo pooki likiomon; ore pee eya oltung'ani enino, mimpotu aoru.

English: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
Masaai: Intaasa ilkulikae tung'ana anaa eniyieu nikintaas ninche iyie.

English: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
Masaai: “Amaa te naa iloonyor intae ake inyorrinyorro, kaji eret ina te intae? Kenyor sii ninche larruok iloonyor ninche.

English: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
Masaai: Amaa sii te naa lelo ake ooitaas intae isupati intaasiasa sii intae, kaji eret ina te intae? Neijia eiko sii ninche ilarruok.

English: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
Masaai: Naa omaa te naa pooki ake olisilen naa elde ake liyiolo ajo kilaaki, ainyoo eret ina te iyie? Keisilenokino sii ninche larruok eyiolo aajo kelaakini aaiputaki.

English: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
Masaai: Kake ore intae, entonyor ilmang'ati linyi niaasiasa isupati; enchooi te sile misiligugu toki naitu; naa itumutumu enkishorunoto kitok; niaakuku nkera o lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki, amu ore ninye eing'urrie ilarruok o lemeeta enashe.

English: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
Masaai: Enoto olng'ur anaa Papa linyi oata ong'ur.

English: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
Masaai: “Minguanare pee mikinguanareki; minor pee mikinorri, entapalaki pee epalakini intae.

English: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
Masaai: Enchooi pee eishori intae; aaisho emborei sidai narujakino, neiposhakino, o metadooi nepiki ilbenia too lgooitie linyi; amu ore ake ina nitemakinyenye lkulikae naa ninye ake etemakinyeki sii ninche intae.”

English: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
Masaai: Neitoki aisho enkitanyaanyukoto ejo, “Keidim olmodooni atoriko likae modooni? Aimesulakino pokira aare engumoto?

English: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
Masaai: Megiroo oloiteng'eni oloiteng'en; kake ore eidipaki aaiteng'ena netiu anaa oloiteng'ena ninye.

English: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
Masaai: Ainyoo pee ing'or entubuloi natii enkong'u o lalashe lino, nimidol olchata otii enkong'u ino makewan?

English: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
Masaai: Kaji nko pee ijoki olalashe lino, ‘Olalashe lai, ntasho maaitayu entubuloi nikitii enkong'u ino makewan,’ eji nimidol olchata likitii enkong'u, ino makewan? Lo sunkuroi, tang'asa intayu ilo shata likitii enkong'u ino pee itum taa atodolisho, nintayu entubuloi natii enkong'u o lalashe lino.

English: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
Masaai: “Amu meetae olchani sidai oiu lng'anayio torrok; aashu olchani torrono oiu lng'anayio sidain;

English: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
Masaai: amu eyiolouni ake olchani too lng'anayio lenyena. Amu metumieki olaimurunyai ilng'abolo, nemetumieki isabibu intulele.

English: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
Masaai: Eitadou oltung'ani supat isupati naaitung'uaa olchumati supat otii oltau lenye, neitadou oltung'ani torrono ntorrok naaitung'uaa olchumati torrono otii oltau lenye, amu inaabore oltau lo ltung'ani eiro te nkutuk enye.

English: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
Masaai: “Ainyoo pee kijojo, ‘Olaitoriani, Olaitoriani,’ nimiaasiasa enajoki intae?

English: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
Masaai: Aliki intae enetiu ololotu enatii nening enajoki, neas nena natejo.

English: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
Masaai: Etiu ninye anaa oltung'ani oshet enkaji, neng'as atur enkop aitugut, neunoki osoit olkitamanyunoto. Ore pee enang'unye enkare nenang'akino ina aji, kake eitu eidim aigusugusie amu enotokoki olkitamanyunoto.

English: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oning nemeas ae, etiu anaa oltung'ani otesheta enkaji eitu eng'as apik olkitamanyunoto. Ore pee enang'unye enkare neipony te ngolon enaduoo aji, neurori nabo kata, neme euroroto ina naturori enaduoo aji.”

English: Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu aishaki nena baa nkiyiaa enye, nejing Kapernaum.

English: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
Masaai: Nemuei naleng osinka kirotet lo lkitok loo sikarini, etaa keye.

English: And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant.
Masaai: Ore pee ening eimakini Yesu, neirriwaki lpayiani loo Lyahudi meeu ninye aishiunye ilo sinka lenye.

English: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu ninche enetii Yesu, neitirrishaki aasai aajoki, “Keishiaakino nintaasa ninye ena:

English: For he loveth our nation, and he hath built us a synagogue.
Masaai: amu kenyor olorere lang, neteshetaka ninye iyiook enkaji e ntumo.”

English: Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not thyself: for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof:
Masaai: Neiriamariyie Yesu ninche. Ore etataanikia enkaji enye, neirriwaki ilo kitok loo sikarini ilchoreta lenyena ajoki, “Olaitoriani, mintanyamal kewan, amu maaishiaakino nanu te nijing'u enkaji ai:

English: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
Masaai: nemajo kara hoo ng'ae likilotu anang'are: kake ororei doi ake tejo neishiu osinka lai.

English: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
Masaai: Amu ara sii nanu oltung'ani otii enkitoria, naaitorei, naata sii nanu sikarini laitore. Naitore ele ajoki, ‘Shomo!’ nelo; najoki elde ‘Wou!’ nelotu; naitore osinka lai ajoki, ‘Taasa ena!’ neas.”

English: When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu nena, neing'asia te nkaraki ninye, neibelekenya, nejoki lelo tung'ana oosujita, “Ajoki intae, eitu ai kata atum enkirukoto kitok naba nji tiatua Siraeli, eitu atum.”

English: And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick.
Masaai: Nejo matorrinyoto aji iladuoo ooirriwuaki eishiwuo oladuoo sinka omuei.

English: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti kata nelo enkanasa naji Nain; neiriamariyie ninye ilooiteng'eni lenyena o lorora kitok.

English: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her.
Masaai: Ore etii auluo etinyikaka kishomi e ina anasa, ng'ura, enapitai olmeneng'ani aaya, naa ilo otua ake eeta ng'otonye, naa enkoliai; nerubare ltung'ana kumok le ina anasa.

English: And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Olaitoriani ninye neing'urrie nejoki, “Minchir.”

English: And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto thee, Arise.
Masaai: Nenyikaki neiseyie osanduku neitashe lewa oonapita. Nejoki Yesu, “Lo barnoti! Inyo!”

English: And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother.
Masaai: Neinyototo ilo duoo otua aton, neiteru airo. Neisho ng'otonye.

English: And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet is risen up among us; and, That God hath visited his people.
Masaai: Neureishoyu ninche pooki; neisis Enkai nejo, “Einyo oloiboni kitok le Nkai ti atua iyiook,” nejo sii, “Eewuo Enkai abaiki ltung'ana lenyena.”

English: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
Masaai: Neibulu enkisisa e ina nataasa Yudea pooki, o ina kop namanita.

English: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things.
