Masaai: Nenyorraa, neing'oru erishata naitarasarie ninye metii olorere.

English: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
Masaai: Nebau enkolong oo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki, ina olong nayieng'i olkuoo lo sirua le Pasaka.

English: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yesu Petero o Yohana, ajoki, “Enchom entobiraki iyiook Pasaka pee kitum aainosa.”

English: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kaji iyieu nikipuo aaitobirie?”

English: And he said unto them, Behold, when ye are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he entereth in.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eng'ura, ore ijing'ijing'i ena anasa, nenang'are intae olee onapita oltoo le nkare, enturubare nijing'ijing'i enkaji najing,

English: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
Masaai: nijokiki olopeny enkaji, ‘Kitiaaka Olaiteng'enani, koree ake olgilata loo lomon, lainosie Pasaka o looiteng'eni laainei?'

English: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
Masaai: Naa keutaki intae olgilata le shumata oidipaki aaitobira; entobira te ine.”

English: And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover.
Masaai: Nepuo, neinepu etiu anaa enatiaaka; neitobiraki Pasaka.

English: And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya esaa, neton adaa, netoni lkipaareta lenyena te nebo ninye.

English: And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer:
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Atayiewua te yieuna sapuk nanya ena Pasaka te nebo intae eton eitu aaisilisili.

English: For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Amu ajoki intae, meekure aitoki ai kata anya o meitabari te nkitoria e Nkai.”

English: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves:
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amu enkikompe, neisho Enkai enashe nejo, “Entudumu ena entang'ar;

English: For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come.
Masaai: amu ajoki intae ore ebaiki taata meekure aitoki ai kata aok ena oo lng'anayio lo sabibu o meeu enkitoria e Nkai.”

English: And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me.
Masaai: Nedumu emukate, ore pee eisho Enkai enashe nebel neisho ninche ejo, “Osesen lai ele oishoori te nkaraki intae. Entaas ena kidamumu nanu.”

English: Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you.
Masaai: Neiko neijia enkikompe eidipa endaa, ejo, “Ore ena kikompe osotua ng'ejuk oitaiki intae osarge lai, oibukori te nkaraki intae.

English: But, behold, the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table.
Masaai: Kake eng'ura amu etii ilo laaitarasaa ena mesa te nebo nanu.

English: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
Masaai: Amu eikunari Enkerai e Tung'ani anaa enatejoki apake; kake ee kake aiyia ilo laa ninye oitarasaa!”

English: And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing.
Masaai: Neiteru ninche aaikilikuana maate, aajoki kalo pasa oiko neijia.

English: And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest.
Masaai: Nepuku sii enchankar ti atua ninche eji kalo lenye oaku olkitok aisul te ninche.

English: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Eitoreisho laiguanak loo Loreren; ore lelo ooata enkitoria te ninche neji ninche ilooduporeki.

English: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
Masaai: Kake mme neijia etiu te intae; enchoo ilo kitok aisul te intae pooki metotiwuo anaa ai ninye oloti aisul, netiu olarikoni anaa oloisiaisho.

English: For whether is greater, he that sitteth at meat, or he that serveth? is not he that sitteth at meat? but I am among you as he that serveth.
Masaai: Amu kalo olkitok, koloton te mesa, anaa keilo oisiaaisho? Aime ilo oton te mesa? Kake atii nanu atua intae atiu anaa oloisiaaisho.

English: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
Masaai: “Naa intae ootobiko kiboitarere too ntemat aainei

English: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
Masaai: ore anaa enaaishoo Papa enkitoria, aisho sii nanu intae aiko neijia

English: That ye may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
Masaai: pee itonini aadaa te nebo nanu te nkitoria ai, nitonini too lorikan le nkitoo aaiguanaki lelo oshon tomon o aare le Israel.

English: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:
Masaai: “Simon, Simon, ng'ura, kitoomonu iyie Shetani neishooki pee kitum ninye aipiripiro, anaa enkano,

English: But I have prayed for thee, that thy faith fail not: and when thou art converted, strengthen thy brethren.
Masaai: kake aatoomonoko iyie pee meish enkirukoto ino, naa ore pee iitu, ntagolo lalashera linono.”

English: And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with thee, both into prison, and to death.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, atonyorrayie nanu pee aarubare korokoroni aashu keeya.”

English: And he said, I tell thee, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that thou shalt thrice deny that thou knowest me.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Aajoki, Petero, meru olkuku ade taata, eitu kimiki iyie, katitin uni ajo mikiyiolo.”

English: And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and scrip, and shoes, lacked ye any thing? And they said, Nothing.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Amaa apa pee airriwaa intae miatata mbenia oo mpesai aashu olbene aashu namuka, italaita toki?” Nejo, “Eitu.”

English: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Kake ore ilo oota olbene inchoo eya, naa inchoo ilo lemeeta olalem emir enkila enye pee einyang'u.

English: For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
Masaai: Amu meeta nchere pee eitu eitabari ele sirata te nanu ojo, ‘Amu eikenakini ninye ilwushuush;’ amu epuonu o metimitunye inaatisiraki ti alo nanu.”

English: And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Olaitoriani, ng'ura doi, noolo lalema aare.” Nejoki ninche, “Eidipe.”

English: And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.
Masaai: Nepuku anaa enaiko apake, nelo oldoinyo loo Loirienito, nesuj ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that ye enter not into temptation.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki ine wueji nejoki ninche, “Entoomon pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat.”

English: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
Masaai: Nelam ninche alo eneba anaa enang'aroto o soit, negil kung aomon ejo,

English: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.
Masaai: “Papa, ti niyieu, tirishieki ena kikompe; kake ore ake eyia mme anaa enayieu nanu, kake nchoo metotiwuo anaa eniyieu iyie.”

English: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him.
Masaai: Neipang'aki ninye olmalaika oing'uaa shumata, aitagol.

English: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki naisina neitirrish oleng aomon netiu enkinyinyiret enye edoiki enkop anaa lkituaa kitong'at lo sarge.

English: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
Masaai: Ore pee einyototo te nkomono, nelotu enetii loointeng'eni lenyena neinepu eirurate te nkaraki osina,

English: And said unto them, Why sleep ye? rise and pray, lest ye enter into temptation.
Masaai: nejoki, “Ainyoo pee irurara? Enyeito entoomon pee mijing'ijing'i atua ntemat.”

English: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
Masaai: Ore eton eirorita, nelotu esiamo tenebo ltung'ani oji Yudas, obo le lelo tomon o aare, erikito. Nenyikaki Yesu ang'utut;

English: But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?
Masaai: kake etiaka Yesu, “Yudas, ai te ng'ututata intarasaa Enkerai e Tung'ani?”

English: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?
Masaai: Ore pee edol lelo ooboitare enapuku, nejo, “Olaitoriani, eikiosh to lalema?”

English: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.
Masaai: Neosh obo osinka le lapolosani kitok nedung'u enkiok e tatene.

English: And Jesus answered and said, Suffer ye thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him.
Masaai: Kake etejo Yesu, “Entapal ena!” Neiseyie enkiok enye neishiunye.

English: Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be ye come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves?
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu ajoki lapolosak kituaak o laitoriak loo sikarini le nkaji e Nkai, o lpayiani, ooetuo aarasaki, “Amaa, eikipuonunu aarasaki anaa kara olaisimani, iatata lalema o siaren?

English: When I was daily with you in the temple, ye stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness.
Masaai: Aboitare intae anaa ake te nkaji e Nkai, neitu kimbung'ubung'u. Kake esaa inyi ena, o engolon e naimin.”

English: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aaibung'a nerik, neitabaiki enkang o lapolosani kitok. Nesuju Petero tenelakua;

English: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them.
Masaai: ore pee einoki enkima te mpolos o lgoriet netoni te nebo, neton Petero te nebo ninche.

English: But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol enkaisiaayiani eton te newang neunoki enkong'u nejo, “Ore ele tung'ani eboitare oshi ninye.”

English: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
Masaai: Kake etomikio ninye, ejo, “Naa kitok, maiyiolo nanu ninye.”

English: And after a little while another saw him, and said, Thou art also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not.
Masaai: Ore te nkiti kata nedol likae ejo, “Ira sii iyie obo lenye.” Kake etejo Petero, “Ero, mara nanu.”

English: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.
Masaai: Ore eshomo enkata naba anaa esaa nabo neitoki ake likae aitirrishaki, ejo, “Edede eboitare sii oshi ake ele tung'ani ninye amu Olgalilayai.”

English: And Peter said, Man, I know not what thou sayest. And immediately, while he yet spake, the cock crew.
Masaai: Kake etejo Petero, “Lo lee, maiyiolo nanu enijoito.” Ore nabo kata, eton eirorita, neru olkuku.

English: And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
Masaai: Neibelekenya Olaitoriani aing'or Petero. Nedamu Petero ororei lo Laitoriani otiaka, “Ore ade taata eitu eru olkuku aikimiki iyie katitin uni.”

English: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
Masaai: Neipung alo aishir te mion.

English: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
Masaai: Ore ina kata lelo ooibung'ita Yesu nesurdaany near ninye;

English: And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that smote thee?
Masaai: neitoki sii aarrid nkonyek neikilikuan aajoki, “Imbonu! Ai ng'ae likitoosho?”

English: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
Masaai: Nejo sii kulikae rorei kumok aayietaa ninye neinyal.

English: And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying,
Masaai: Ore ekenyu, netumo olkiama loo lpayiani lo lorere, ilapolosak kituaak o lasirak neriki ninye enetii olkiama, nejoki,

English: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:
Masaai: “Te nira Kristo, toliki iyiook.” Nejoki ninche, “Te naliki intae, mikirukuruku;

English: And if I also ask you, ye will not answer me, nor let me go.
Masaai: naa te naikilikuan intae embae nimikiwalikiki.

English: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.
Masaai: Kake ore ebaiki taata keton Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkaina e tatene e ngolon e Nkai.”

English: Then said they all, Art thou then the Son of God? And he said unto them, Ye say that I am.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Metaa eira doi Enkerai e Nkai?” Nejoki ninye ninche, “Intae ootejo kara.”

English: And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Ainyoo ai shakenisho neton kiyieu? Kitoning'okito ate eimunye enkutuk enye.”

English: And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.
Masaai: Nedumunye olorora pooki, nerikokini Pilato.

English: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
Masaai: Neiter aaitang'or ninye, ejo, “Kineputua ele tung'ani eiwushie olorere lang nemitiki iyiook kincho Kaisari kodi, nejo kewan Kristo naa olaiguanani.”

English: And Pilate asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, Thou sayest it.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Pilato ninye ajoki, “Ai yie doi Olaiguanani lo Lyahudi?” Newaliki ajoki, “Iyie otejo neijia.”

English: Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man.
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato lapolosak kituaak o lorora, “Eitu atum entiyoto te le tung'ani.”

English: And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.
Masaai: Kake eitirrishakita ejo, “Keing'oling'ol olorere, eiteng'enita te Yudea pooki, ebaiki Galilaya o meeu ene.”

English: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Pilato ina, neikilikuan te na kole Galilaya.

English: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ajo ole nkalo naitore Herode, neirriwaki Herode etii ninye Yerusalem ina kata.

English: And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Herode Yesu, neshipa oleng, amu keyieu apa nedol te nkata naado, amu ketoning'o imbaa enyena, nejo sii pee edol neas embae e nking'asia.

English: Then he questioned with him in many words; but he answered him nothing.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina neikilikuanishore te nkata naado; kake eitu ewaliki.

English: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
Masaai: Neitashoo lapolosak kituaak o lasirak aaitirrishaki aaitang'or ninye.

English: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.
Masaai: Nesul Herode o sikarini lenyena, neikordod; neitoki neishopoki olkila nerrinyoki Pilato.

English: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
Masaai: Neaku lchoreta Herode o Pilato ade ina olong, amu ore eton eitu ebau ena, neeta apa ninche mang'atisho pokira.

English: And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,
Masaai: Neitoki Pilato aipot ilapolosak kituaak o laitoriak lo lorere

English: Said unto them, Ye have brought this man unto me, as one that perverteth the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man touching those things whereof ye accuse him:
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Intae likitorikokito ele tung'ani anaa oloiwushie olorere; naiguanare te dukuya intae, ng'ura, eitu atumie ele tung'ani entiyoto hoo nabo te nitipika;

English: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
Masaai: eitu sii atumie Herode amu etorrinyoko iyiook. Ng'ura, eitu hoo eas ai nairirikino keeya;

English: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
Masaai: metaa kaitame naisho elo.”

English: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
Masaai: Nemeeta kata ake nemelaaki Pilato ninche oltung'ani obo te ilo sirua.

English: And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas:
Masaai: Kake etabuakutua pooki te nebo ejo, “Iwuang'ie ele tung'ani, naa Barabas talaaki iyiook”

English: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
Masaai: oltung'ani taa otanang'akaki korokoroni, te nkaraki enkitarrikinoto natijing'a ina anasa, o te nkaraki natarishe.

English: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
Masaai: Neitoki Pilato airorie, eyieu nelaku Yesu;

English: But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him.
Masaai: kake nebuaku ninche aajo, “Tasho ninye tasho!”

English: And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil hath he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go.
Masaai: Neigilie ene uni ajoki, “Ainyoo kaa torroni eitayio? Eitu atumie nanu ninye entiyoto nairirikino keeya; metaa kaitame nalak.”

English: And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed.
Masaai: Kake eitirrishakita nekurraki to ltoilo sapuk ejo metashei. Neidimu oltoilo lenye ninye.

English: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
Masaai: Nedung'oki Pilato enkiguana meitaasi ina nayieu ninche.

English: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will.
Masaai: Nelaku ilo tung'ani otanang'akaki korokoroni te nkaraki enkitarrikinoto o te nkaraki natarishe, ilo oipotutuo, kake eishoyie Yesu meitaasi ina nayieu ninche.

English: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
Masaai: Ore erikitoi, neibung'i oltung'ani obo oji Simon le Kirene, oewuo eing'uaa nkurman, neitanapa osalaba, metanapa esujita Yesu.

English: And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him.
Masaai: Nesuj olorora kitok le lelo tung'ana, o nkituaak naaishiraki eoshiosh ilgooitie.

English: But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children.
Masaai: Kake eibelekenye Yesu aing'or nejoki, “Na toyie e Yerusalem, emikinchiraki nanu, kake ate enchiraki o nkera inyi,

English: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.
Masaai: amu ng'ura, kepuonu nkolong'i naaku keji, ‘Emayiana nkolupeno, nemayiana nkoishuaa neitu eisho, nemayiana ilki leitu enaki!’

English: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
Masaai: Neaku kejokini ldoinyo, ‘Entuurokinoto iyiook,’ nejokini ndoinyo, ‘Entoipoi iyiook.’

English: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?
Masaai: Amu, pasa taa eikoni nji olchani onyori, kaji eikoni olotoyio?”

English: And there were also two others, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
Masaai: Neriki sii kulikae wushuush aare, metari te nebo ninye.

English: And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaiki ewueji naji Emborbor, neshe ninye te ine, o lelo maisero, atii obo te tatene netii olikae te kedianye.

English: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Papa, tapalaki ninche, amu ai meyiolo enaasita.” Neosh ninche enkukuo pee etum aatoor nkilani enyena.

English: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.
Masaai: Neitashoo ltung'ana te ine, aaing'or; kake kesurdaany ilaitoriak, ejo, “Eitajeuo kulikae, nchoo naa eitajeu kewan te naa ai ninye doi Kristo le Nkai, ilo gelunoti lenye.”

English: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
Masaai: Nesurdaany sii ninche isikarini, epuonu aayaki enaisho naisuijo

English: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.
Masaai: ejo, “Te naa ira Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi, intajeu kewan!”

English: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Masaai: Etisiraki sii olkigeroto te shumata elukunya enye ojo, “Ele Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi.”

English: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
Masaai: Nemor obo le lelo wushuush ootashoki te nebo ninye, ejo, “Ai mira doi Kristo? Intajeu kewan o iyiook!”

English: But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Dost not thou fear God, seeing thou art in the same condemnation?
Masaai: Neisikong olikae ajoki, “Ai miure iyie Enkai, nidol ajo ina kiguana kitudung'okoki sii iyie?

English: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
Masaai: Neishiaakino ninche iyiook; amu inikitaasa eitalakitae iyiook; kake meeta hoo ele entorrono nataasa.”

English: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Yesu, tadamuaki nanu te nilotu te ngolon ino e nkitoria.”

English: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Esipa aajoki iyie, ejing ade Paradiso te nebo nanu.”

English: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
Masaai: Neaku ina kata enaipirie enkolong, nerip enaimin enkop pooki o metabaiki saa naaudo,

English: And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.
Masaai: neimis ewang'an e nkolong; nepolosa olkarasha orish enkaji e Nkai aaku are.

English: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit: and having said thus, he gave up the ghost.
Masaai: Ore Yesu, nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk, nejo, “Papa, inkaik inono apik enkiyang'et ai!” Ore pee ejo neijia nedung'o tau.

English: Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.
Masaai: Ore pee edol olkitok loo sikarini enatotiwuo, neisis Enkai, nejo, “Edede meeta hoo ele tung'ani entiyoto!”

English: And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, smote their breasts, and returned.
Masaai: Ore ilo orora pooki ooetuo enking'urare, pee edol enatotiwuo, nerrinyo nkang'itie enye eoshiosh ilgooitie eisina.

English: And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.
Masaai: Ore ilooyiolore pooki o nkituaak naatusujutua eing'uaa Galilaya neitashe te nelakua aadol kuna baa.

English: And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just:
Masaai: Netii apa oltung'ani oji Yosef le nkang oo Lyahudi naji Arimatea. Naa obo ninye lo lkiama, naa oltung'ani supat asipani,

English: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
Masaai: leitu enyorraa ninye ina nayieu o enataasa ninche, amu keanyita enkitoria e Nkai.

English: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
Masaai: Nelo ilo tung'ani enetii Pilato aomonu osesen le Yesu.

English: And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a sepulchre that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid.
Masaai: Neitadou neirin to lkarasha le kitani, neirragie te nkurare naguetuno to soit, neitu ai kata epiki likae.

English: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
Masaai: Naa enkolong e Nkitobirare, etaa keiteru sabato abau.

English: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
Masaai: Nesuj nkituaak naairiamunore Yesu eing'uaa Galilaya, nedol enkurare, nedol eneikunakaki;

English: And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.
Masaai: nerrinyo aapuo ang, nepuo aaitobir sonkoyoni o ila narropil. Neyeng'iyeng'a te nkolong e sabato anaa enajo inkitanapat.

English: Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the sepulchre, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkolong e dukuya e wiki, enasirie, nepuo enkurare, neshoroo sonkoyoni naaitobira.

English: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
Masaai: Neinepu osoit eibeleleng'oyioki te nkurare,

English: And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: kake ore pee ejing atua neitu etum ilo sesen.

English: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:
Masaai: Ore pee erriang te nkaraki ina bae, ng'ura neipang'aki iltung'ana aare ooata nkilani naaimerlel;

English: And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek ye the living among the dead?
Masaai: ore pee eirut neirrugo aaing'orie nkomomi enye enkop, nejoki lelo lewa, “Ainyoo pee ing'oruru oloishu to lootuata?

English: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spake unto you when he was yet in Galilee,
Masaai: Metii ninye ene, kake etopiwuo. Entadamu anaa enatiaka intae, eton etii Galilaya.

English: Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.
Masaai: nchere, eitarasari ake Enkerai e Tung'ani aaitarasaki nkaik oo looas ing'ok, neshei, nepiu te nkolong e uni.”

English: And they remembered his words,
Masaai: Nedamu nena kituaak irorei lenyena,

English: And returned from the sepulchre, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest.
Masaai: ore pee errinyo aaing'uaa enkurare neinosaki lelo pokira tomon o obo nena baa neliki sii lkulikae.

English: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles.
Masaai: Naa Mariamu e Magdalene, Yohana o Mariamu ng'otonye Yakobo o nkulie kituaak naatii te nebo ninche naatolikitio lkipaareta kuna baa.

English: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
Masaai: Kake etiutuo lelo rorei te ninche anaa le mpesho, neaku eitu eiruk ninche.

English: Then arose Peter, and ran unto the sepulchre; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass.
Masaai: Kake einyo Petero neipirri alo enkurare; neirrugo aing'or atua, nedol lkarash le kitani eirrag oopeny; nerrinyo alo ang eing'asia te nena naatotiwuo.)

English: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, ore te ina olong ake epuo aare lenye enkang naji Emmaus, naa mael naapishana ing'uaa Yerusalem,

English: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
Masaai: neimaki pokira aare nena baa naatotiwuo.

English: And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them.
Masaai: Ore einosaa lomon eiguana pokira aare, neinepu Yesu openy airiamariyie ninche.

English: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
Masaai: Neikeno nkonyek enye pee meyiolou.

English: And he said unto them, What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another, as ye walk, and are sad?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Kakua omon kulo liimakiki ipuopuo pokira aare?” Neitashe, neisinanuo.

English: And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem, and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days?
Masaai: Ore obo lenye, oji Kleopas, newaliki ajoki ninye, “Keiyie doi ake olomoni te Yerusalem lemeyiolo kuna baa naatotiutuo te ine te kuna olong'i?”

English: And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people:
Masaai: Nejoki, “Akua baa?” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Mbaa e Yesu le Nasaret, ora apa oloiboni le Nkai ogol too nkiasin o to rorei ti alo Enkai o te dukuya ltung'ana pooki

English: And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him.
Masaai: o eneikuna lapolosak lang kituaak o laitoriak pee eitarasaa metudung'okini enkiguana metari metua, neshei ninye.

English: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
Masaai: Kake kisilig apa iyiook aajo ninye olaku Siraeli. Ee pae naa ore etii nena pooki, enkolong e uni duoo taata anaa netiu nena baa.

English: Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the sepulchre;
Masaai: Ore sii, eing'asiayie iyiook kulie kituaak e ncholiek ang. Etayookito enkurare duoo enasirie

English: And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive.
Masaai: neitu einepu ilo sesen; neshukunye aajoki iyiook eji etoduaa ilmalaika, ootiaakita keishu.

English: And certain of them which were with us went to the sepulchre, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not.
Masaai: Nepuo sii kulikae lang enkurare, nepuo ainepu etiu ake anaa ina natolimutuo nkituaak; kake ninye ake eitu edol.”

English: Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken:
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Lo tung'ana moda, nirara yietuti ltauja mirukuruku nena pooki naatejo loibonok le Nkai!

English: Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?
Masaai: Keeta apa kata nemeitamei Kristo aaiko neijia pee ejing enkitoo enye?”

English: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.
Masaai: Neiteru too mbukui e Musa o too loibonok pooki, neibalakinye ninche ilkigerot ooipirta enkorrok enye.

English: And they drew nigh unto the village, whither they went: and he made as though he would have gone further.
Masaai: Ometaa nenyikaki ina ang apa napuo. Neiko ninye anaa keyieu negiroo.

English: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
Masaai: Kake neibok ninche ninye, aajoki, “Irraga iyiook amu emuto netaa kewarie.” Nejing taa aton te nebo ninche.

English: And it came to pass, as he sat at meat with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them.
Masaai: Ore enya endaa te nebo ninche, nedumu emukate nemayian, negil, neisho ninche.

English: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
Masaai: Nebolo nkonyek enye neyiolou ninye; neimisilori ina kata ake neitu eitoki nkonyek enye aadol.

English: And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures?
Masaai: Nejokino, “Keitu eyupuyup iltauja lang eirorie iyiook te nkoitoi, eboloki iyiook, ilkigerot?”

English: And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them,
Masaai: Neinyototo ake te ina saa nerrinyo Yerusalem; neinepu lelo tomon o obo o lelo ooboitare,

English: Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.
Masaai: ootiaakita, “Etopiwuo taa ninye Olaitoriani neipang'aka Simon!”

English: And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread.
Masaai: Neliki taa ninche nena baa naatotiwuo te nkoitoi, o eneikuna pee eitayiolo kewan ninche ebelaki emukate.

English: And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
Masaai: Ore ejoito ninche nena, neitashe Yesu makewan ti atua ninche, nejoki, “Entaseriana!”

English: But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.
Masaai: Kake eirriang'a ninche, neureishoyu, ejo koloip etoduaa.

English: And he said unto them, Why are ye troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Ainyoo pee inyamalala? Naa kaji etiu pee etii olng'ash iltauja linyi?

English: Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me have.
Masaai: Eng'ora nkaik aainei o nkejek nchere kewan ai nanu kewan ele; embung'aki pee idolidolo; amu meeta enkiyang'et nkiri o loik anaa kulo lidolitata aata.”

English: And when he had thus spoken, he shewed them his hands and his feet.
Masaai: Ore pee ejoki neijia, neitodol nkaik enyena o nkejek.

English: And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?
Masaai: Ore eton ake meiruk te nkaraki eng'ida e nking'asia nejoki ninche, “Iatata tene toki nanyae?”

English: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
Masaai: Neisho embelati o sinkirri oyiera,

English: And he took it, and did eat before them.
Masaai: nedumu nenya te dukuya ninche.

English: And he said unto them, These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Ilapa rorei laainei kulo latiaaka intae, eton atii te nebo intae, nchere ore mbaa pooki naatisiraki aaipirta nanu too nkitanapat e Musa o too loibonok le Nkai o to Lkerempe le Nkai, meeta nchere meitabari.”

English: Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures,
Masaai: Nebol iltauja lenye metayiolo ilkigerot,

English: And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day:
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Etisiraki aajo, keitamei Kristo naa ore te nkolong e uni nepiu aing'uaa lootuata,

English: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.
Masaai: naa te nkarna enye elikiori enkirridunoto o empalakinoto oo ng'ok too loreren pooki, neiteruni te Yerusalem.

English: And ye are witnesses of these things.
Masaai: Irara intae shakeni le kuna baa.

English: And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem, until ye be endued with power from on high.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, kairriwaki intae ilo otejo Papa keisho intae; kake entotoni te na anasa, o meishopokini intae engolon naing'uaa shumata.”

English: And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
Masaai: Neitoki arik o metabaiki Betania, neilepie nkaik enyena nemayian.

English: And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven.
Masaai: Ore emayianita ninye ninche, neilep aing'uaa ninche.

English: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
Masaai: Nerrinyo ninche aapuo Yerusalem te ng'ida sapuk,

English: And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
Masaai: netii anaa ake enkaji e Nkai eisisita Enkai.

English: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
Masaai: Ore te nkiterunoto etii apa Ororei, netii ilo Rorei te nebo Enkai, naa Enkai ilo Rorei.

English: The same was in the beginning with God.
Masaai: Etii ninye te nkiterunoto te nebo Enkai.

English: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
Masaai: Etaa pooki toki te ninye, nemeetae hoo toki te nena naataa, naitaaki metii ninye.

English: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
Masaai: Atua ninye etii enkishui, ore ena kishui naa ewang'an oo ltung'ana.

English: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
Masaai: Newangu ewang'an ti atua enaimin neitu eidimu enaimin ninye.

English: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani oirriwuaki oing'uaa Enkai; oji enkarna enye Yohana.

English: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
Masaai: Neewuo ele te nkaraki shakenisho, pee eishakenoki ina wang'an, pee etum pooki aairuko te ninye.

English: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
Masaai: Neme ina wang'an ninye, kake eewuo pee eishakenoki ina wang'an.

English: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
Masaai: Ewang'an nadede naitawang pooki tung'ani, nalotu enkop.

English: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
Masaai: Netii ninye enkop, naa te ninye eitaa Enkai enkop, neitu eyiolou enkop ninye.

English: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
Masaai: Neewuo enetii ilenyena, neitu eng'amu ltung'ana lenyena ninye.

English: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
Masaai: Kake ore lelo pooki ootang'amutua ninye lelo ooiruko enkarna enye, neishoo engolon naakunye nkera e Nkai,

English: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
Masaai: ilo otoiwuoki neme to sarge neme te yieunoto o sesen aashu te yieunoto o lee, kake ene Nkai.

English: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
Masaai: Neaku Ororei osesen neton ti atua iyiook, nikitoduaa enkitoo enye, naa enkitoo o Inoti Obo le Papa, obore empiris o esipata.

English: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
Masaai: Neishakenoki Yohana ninye nebuak ajo, “Ele taa atolimuo ajo, ‘Ore ololotu te siadi nanu ninye oituruk te nanu, amu etii apa ninye te dukuya nanu.’ ”

English: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
Masaai: Enaing'uaa emborei enye kitang'amutua pooki, empiris naiteleikino empiris.

English: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu te Musa eishoruaki Nkitanapat; nelotu empiris o esipata te Yesu Kristo.

English: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani ai kata otoduaa Enkai; ilo inoti obo laa Enkai otii olgoo le Papa, oibalunye ninye.

English: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
Masaai: Naa ena shakenisho e Yohana pee eirriwaki Lyahudi lapolosak o Lawi ooing'uaa Yerusalem pee epuo aaikilikuan ninye aajoki, “Ira iyie ng'ae?”

English: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
Masaai: Neibalunye, neitu emiki, neibalunye ajo, “Mara nanu Kristo.”

English: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
Masaai: Neikilikuan aajoki, “Ira Eliya?” Nejoki, “Mara.” Nejoki, “Ira ilo oiboni?” Newaliki ajoki, “A'a,”

English: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
Masaai: Nejokini, “Ira ng'ae, pee kitum ewalata nikiyaki lelo ooirriutua iyiook? Aijo iyie aa te nkaraki enkorrok ino?”

English: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ara oltoilo lo lobuak ti ong'ata, ‘Entorioi enkoitoi o Laitoriani,’ Anaa enatejo oloiboni Isaya.”

English: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooirriwakaki Yohana naa Ilfarisayo eing'uaa.

English: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ninche ninye aajoki, “Aainyoo naa pee imbatisisho iyie, ti nimira ilo Kristo, aashu Eliya aashu ilo oiboni?”

English: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
Masaai: Newaliki Yohana ajoki ninche, “Te nkare aibatisisho nanu. Eitashe ti atua intae Obo limiyiololo,

English: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
Masaai: laa ninye ilo olotu te siadi nanu, lemaaishiakino nalak enkeene e namuke enye.”

English: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
Masaai: Etaasate kuna baa te Betania te lido kekun le Yordan, teine apa naibatisishore Yohana.

English: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina nedol Yohana Yesu elotu enetii, nejo, “Ing'ura, olkuoo le ker le Nkai oya eng'oki e nkop.

English: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
Masaai: Ele taa atolimuo ajo, ‘Ore te siadi nanu elotu oltung'ani oituruk te nanu, amu etii ninye te dukuya nanu.’

English: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
Masaai: Neitu ayiolou nanu ninye, kake te nkaraki ena pee aeuo nanu aibatisisho te nkare, pee aataboloki ninye Israel.”

English: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
Masaai: Neishakenoki Yohana ejo, “Atoduaa Enkiyang'et edou anaa enturkulu eing'uaa shumata netonie shumata ninye.

English: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Neitu ayiolou nanu ninye, kake ilo laairriwua maibatishisho te nkare, ninye laatiaaka nanu, ‘Ore olidol edoiki Enkiyang'et netonie, ninye oibatisisho te Nkiyang'et Sinyati.’

English: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
Masaai: Natoduaa nanu naishakenoko nchere Enkerai e Nkai ele.”

English: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
Masaai: Neitoki te nkolong nasujita ina, neitashe Yohana o looiteng'eni aare lenyena;

English: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
Masaai: neing'or Yohana Yesu elo nejo, “Ing'ura olkuoo le ker le Nkai!”

English: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
Masaai: Nening lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena aare nesuj ninche Yesu.

English: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
Masaai: Neibelekenya Yesu, nedol esujita nejoki, “Ainyoo ing'oruru?” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Rabbi, aa keji enkitawalata olaiteng'enani, kaji nikimanya?”

English: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Wootu entodol.” Nepuonu nedol enemanya; nebik o ninye ina olong. Netaa eaku saa tomon ina kata.

English: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
Masaai: Ore obo le lelo oare ootoning'o Yohana eiro, nesuj ninye, naa Andrea, olashe le Simon Petero.

English: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
Masaai: Olalashe lenye Simon etang'asa atum nejoki ninye, “Kinoto Mesia,” laa ninye eji Kristo.

English: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
Masaai: Neriku Simon arikoki Yesu. Neing'or Yesu nejoki, “Ira iyie Simon, enkerai e Yohana, naa aikiji Kefa.” Aa keji enkitawalata Petero aashu Osoit.

English: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina, neyieu Yesu nelo Galilaya, netum Filipo. Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Tusujaki.”

English: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
Masaai: Ore apa Filipo naa Betsaida eing'uaa, enkanasa oo Andrea o Petero.

English: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
Masaai: Netum Filipo Natanael nejoki, “Kinoto olapa otisira Musa ti atua nkitanapat nesir too loibonok, le Nkai Yesu le Nasaret olayioni le Yosef.”

English: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
Masaai: Nejoki Natanael, “Keidim atupukunye Nasaret entoki sidai?” Nejoki Filipo, “Wou toduaa.”

English: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
Masaai: Nedolu Yesu Natanael elotu enetii, nelimu ninye ajo, “Ing'ura Osiraeli le dede lemeeta emonkoi.”

English: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Natanael, “Ai ti aji kitayiolo?” Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Aatoduaa eton eitu kimpot Filipo, itii entonata o lng'aboli.”

English: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
Masaai: Newaliki Natanael ajoki, “Rabbi, ira iyie Enkerai e Nkai, Iyie Olaiguanani le Israel.”

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Kenkaraki naatiaaka aatoduaa te ntonata o lng'aboli pee iruko? Iyooki adol imbaa kituaak naalang kuna.”

English: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, aidolidolo keper etabole neilep nedou ilmalaika le Nkai te aadoiki Enkerai e Tung'ani.”

English: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there:
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e uni neetae apa enkiyama te Kana e Galilaya: netii ng'otonye e Yesu ine.

English: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
Masaai: Neipotoki sii Yesu o looiteng'eni lenyena te ina kiyama.

English: And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus saith unto him, They have no wine.
Masaai: Ore pee emita enaisho oo sabibu nejoki ng'otonye Yesu, “Meetae enaisho o sabibu.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, what have I to do with thee? mine hour is not yet come.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Na kitok, kaa kiatayie neton eng'or enkata ai?”

English: His mother saith unto the servants, Whatsoever he saith unto you, do it.
Masaai: Nejoki ng'otonye laisiaayiak, “Entaas pooki najoki intae.”

English: And there were set there six waterpots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece.
Masaai: Netii ine iltooi loo soito, naa iloo mboreitin are aashu uni obo, netushumaki te ine to lkerreti le nkitukuore oo Lyahudi.

English: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Emputa iltooi enkare.” Neiput metabaiki nkutukie.

English: And he saith unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki, “Entooku enkiti, eyaki olaitasheikinoni lele sirua.” Neyaki.

English: When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom,
Masaai: Ore pee eishamisham olkitok le nkiyama enaduoo are naitaaki enaisho oo sabibu, nemeyiolo eneing'uaa, hoo neyiolo laduoo sinkan ootookokito enkare, neipot olkitok le nkiyama oloyamisho,

English: And saith unto him, Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but thou hast kept the good wine until now.
Masaai: nejoki, “Eng'as oshi ake pooki ng'ae aishoru enaisho oo sabibu sidai ore etookishoteki, neishoru eneme sidai oleng; imboo iyie idia sidai o taata.”

English: This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him.
Masaai: Atua Kana e Galilaya etaasie Yesu ena anaa enkiterunoto oo nkitoduaat, neitoduaaya enkitoo enye; neiruk ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days.
Masaai: Ore etulusoyie ina nedoiyio aapuo Kapernaum, ninye o ng'otonye, o lalashera o looiteng'eni lenyena; nebik inkuti olong'i te ine.

English: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
Masaai: Netinyikua osirua oji Pasaka loo Lyahudi, neilep Yesu alo Yerusalem.

English: And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting:
Masaai: Neinepu lamirak loo nkishu o loo nkerra oo loo nturkuluni ti atua enkaji e Nkai, netoni laitawalak loo mpesai.

English: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;
Masaai: Ore pee eitobir elishie oo nkopit, nearaa ntare o nkishu pooki aipangie te enkaji e Nkai, neisuaaya mpesai oo laitawalak, neibeleleng'oo mesai enye.

English: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.
Masaai: Nejoki lamirak loo nturkuluni, “Ewaita kuna tokitin te ne emintaa enkaji e Papa ene biashara.”

English: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
Masaai: Nedamu looiteng'eni lenyena enatisiraki nchere, “Kaanya olom le nkaji ino amut.”

English: Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign shewest thou unto us, seeing that thou doest these things?
Masaai: Newaliki Lyahudi aajoki, “Ainyoo enkitoduaata nintodol iyiook, oo pee ias kuna baa?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Entarruoi enkaji e Nkai, ore too nkolong'i uni naitasheyie.”

English: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
Masaai: Nejoki taa Ilyahudi, “Artam o ile ilarin eshetitai ena aji e Nkai hekalo, eji nijo iyie intasheyie too nkolong'i uni?”

English: But he spake of the temple of his body.
Masaai: Kake enkaji e Nkai o lo sesen lenye eimaka ninye.

English: When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.
Masaai: Ore pee eitopiuni too lootuata nedamu ilooiteng'eni lenyena inchere etiaaka neijia, neiruk ilkigerot, o rorei oiroro Yesu.

English: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did.
Masaai: Ore etii ninye Yerusalem, to sirua oji Pasaka, neiruk ilkumok enkarna enye etoduaa nkitoduaat naasita.

English: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men,
Masaai: Kake eitu eiruk Yesu aisho makewan ninche, amu keyiolo ltung'ana pooki,

English: And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.
Masaai: nemeetayie tipat shakenisho te tung'ani amu keyiolo openy naatii atua tung'ani.

English: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani loo Lfarisayo oji enkarna Nikodemo, aitoriani loo Lyahudi.

English: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
Masaai: Nelotu ele tung'ani enetii Yesu kewarie, nejoki ninye, “Rabbi, kiyiolo aajo ira iyie olaiteng'enani oing'uaa Enkai: amu meetae oltung'ani oidim ataasa kuna kitoduaat nias iyie te nemeboitare Enkai ninye.”

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninye, “Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, te neitu eini oltung'ani aaigil te inoto naing'uaa shumata, nemeidim atoduaa Enkitoria e Nkai.”

English: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
Masaai: Nejoki Nikodemo ninye, “Kaji eiko pee eidimi aatoiu oltung'ani etaa moruo? Keidim ninye atushukokinoyu eniare enkoshoke e ng'otonye metoini?”

English: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, te neitu eini oltung'ani te nkare o te Nkiyang'et, nemeidim atijing'a Enkitoria e Nkai.

English: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
Masaai: Ore ina natoiwuoki to sesen, naa osesen, ore enatoiwuoki te Nkiyang'et naa enkiyang'et.

English: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
Masaai: Ming'asia te naajoki iyie, ‘Meeta nchere pee miking'ili aaiu.’

English: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
Masaai: Eisiusiu enkijape nelo eneyieu, nining oltoilo lenye, nimiyiolo eneing'uaa, aashu enelo: neijia etiu pooki ng'ae oini te Nkiyang'et.”

English: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
Masaai: Newaliki Nikodemo ajoki ninye, “Kaji eiko pee eidim aataa kuna baa?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Amaa, aa ira iyie olaiteng'enani le Siraeli nimiyiolo kuna baa?

English: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, inikiyiolo kilimu, nikinchakenoki inikitoduaa niming'amaa intae shakenisho ang.

English: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
Masaai: Amaa te natolikio intae mbaa e nkop nimirukuruku, kaji nkoko pee irukuruku te naliki intae mbaa e shumata?

English: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
Masaai: Meetae oloilepa shumata, leme ilo otadowuo aing'uaa shumata.”

English: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
Masaai: Ore anaa enailepie Musa olasurai ti ong'ata meeta nchere pee eitu eilepieki Enkerai e Tung'ani aaiko neijia,

English: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
Masaai: paa ore pooki ng'ae oiruk ninye netum enkishui nemeish.

English: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
Masaai: Amu etonyorra Enkai enkop aiko nji o meishoru Enkerai enye nabo, paa ore pooki ng'ae oiruk nemeimin kake netum enkishui nemeish.

English: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
Masaai: Amu eitu erriu Enkai Enkerai enye enkop, meeu aiguanare enkop, kake pee etum enkop atajeunye.

English: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiruk ninye; nemeiguanareki, ore ilo lemeiruk neidipaki aaiguanare, amu eitu eiruk enkarna e Nkerai inoti nabo e Nkai.

English: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
Masaai: Naa ena enkiguana, eewuo ewang'an enkop, kake etonyorra iltung'ana enaimin aaitalang ewang'an amu ai torrok iasat enye.

English: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oas ntorrok naa keiba ewang'an, nemelotu enewang pee meibalieki iasat enyena,

English: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
Masaai: kake ore oloas esipata, kelotu enewang pee eibalayu iasat enyena inchere etaasaki ti atua Enkai.

English: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna baa nelotu Yesu o looiteng'eni lenyena enkop e Yudea, nebik te ine te nebo ninche olorere.

English: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
Masaai: Eibatisa sii apa ninye Yohana olorere te Enon nataaniki Salim, amu ai sapuk enkare te ine; naa kepuonu ninche ine meibatisae;

English: For John was not yet cast into prison.
Masaai: amu eton eitu epiki Yohana korokoroni.

English: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
Masaai: Nepuku enchankar oo looiteng'eni le Yohana o Lyahudi obo too mbaa e nkitukuo enkitisinyare.

English: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
Masaai: Nepuonu enetii Yohana nejoki, “Rabbi, ore olapa liboitare te lido kekun le Yordan, liimaka aishakenoki, ing'ura, eibatisisho, nepuonu pooki enetii ninye.”

English: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
Masaai: Newaliki Yohana ajo, “Meidim oltung'ani atang'amai hoo toki te neme keishooki eing'uaa keper.

English: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
Masaai: Kinchakenokiki intae maate nchere atejo, ‘Mara nanu Kristo, kake kaairriwuaki te dukuya ninye.’

English: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
Masaai: Ore olorikito esiankiki e nkiyama, ninye oyamisho; kake ore olchore lo loyamisho, oitashe ainining, neshipakino oleng oltoilo lo loyamisho. Etaboreyia naa ena shipai ai.

English: He must increase, but I must decrease.
Masaai: Meeta nchere pee mebul ninye nang'oroo nanu.”

English: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
Masaai: Ore oloewuo eing'uaa keper netii shumata e pooki; ore oloing'uaa enkop naa enkop eing'uaa neiro ninye ine nkop. Ore ilo oing'uaa keper netii shumata pooki.

English: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
Masaai: Eishakenu ninye ina natoduaa, o enatoning'o ore ake eyia, nemeetae olong'amaa shakenisho enye.

English: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
Masaai: Ore olotang'amayie shakenisho enye netipika olmishire lenye ena nchere asipani Enkai.

English: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
Masaai: Ore ilo oirriwua Enkai ninye oiro orerei le Nkai, amu meishoru Enkai Enkiyang'et te ntemakinoto.

English: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
Masaai: Enyor papa Enkerai, neishoo intokitin pooki metijing'a atua enkaina enye.

English: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
Masaai: Ore oloiruk Enkerai eeta enkishui oo ntarasi; ore ologolong'aki Enkerai nemedol enkishui: kake keipirare ninye enkiguana e Nkai.

English: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
Masaai: Ore apa pee eyiolou Yesu nchere etoning'o Ilfarisayo aajo eitaa Yesu iltung'ana kumok ilooiteng'eni neibatisa lkumok oolang ile Yohana,

English: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
Masaai: hoo neitu eibatisisho Yesu makewan, ilooiteng'eni lenyena ake,

English: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
Masaai: neing'uaa Yudea nerrinyo aito alo Galilaya.

English: And he must needs go through Samaria.
Masaai: Kake meeta kata nemeimaa Samaria.

English: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
Masaai: Nelotu taa enkanasa e Samaria naji Sikar, nanyikita enkurma apa naishoo Yakobo olayioni lenye Yosef.

English: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
Masaai: Netii enchorro e Yakobo ine. Neton Yesu te mbata e nchorro etiu neijia, etanaure te lototo enye. Netaa enaaku saa ile ina kata.

English: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
Masaai: Nelotu enkitok e Samaria aoku enkare. Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Inchooki enaok,”

English: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
Masaai: amu eshomo ilooiteng'eni lenyena aainyiang'u endaa te ina anasa.

English: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
Masaai: Nejoki ina kitok e Samaria ninye, “Kaji etiu pee kiomon iyie Olyahudi enkare nara nanu Esamariai?” Amu mejing'a Lyahudi o Samaria.

English: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Te naa iyiolo enkishorunoto e Nkai anaa ilo likijoki ‘inchooki enaok,’ anaata aa iyie naomon ninye naa eikincho ninye enkare naishu.”

English: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Lo Kitok, miaata toki niokunye negut olkesumet: ai ti aji iata enkare naishu?

English: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
Masaai: Aira iyie kitok alang papa lang Yakobo, oishoo iyiook ele kesumet netooko ninye o layiok lenyena, o nkishu enyena?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Ore pooki ng'ae ook ena are naa keitoki atir enkure,

English: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
Masaai: kake ore olook ina are naisho nanu, nemetir enkure ntarasi; amu ore ina are naisho nanu keaku enchorro ti atua ninye, naitootuaakino enkishui oo ntarasi.”

English: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Lo Kitok, inchooki ina are, pee maaitoki atir enkure, nemaitoki alotu ene neba inji aoku enkare.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Shomo impoto olpayian lino wootu ene.”

English: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
Masaai: Newaliki enkitok ajoki ninye, “Maata nanu olpayian.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Intorioko ina nitejo, ‘Maata nanu olpayian,’

English: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
Masaai: amu imiet ilpayiani likiwaita, neme olino olikiaata taata. Ore tena iroro esipata.”

English: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Lo Kitok, adol ajo ira iyie oloiboni.

English: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
Masaai: Eteseremishote apa loo papa te le doinyo, nijojo intae eji atua Yerusalem etii ewueji nemeeta kata nemeseremishoreki.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Irukoki nanu na kitok, kelotu esaa neme tele doinyo, neme te Yerusalem iserememe Papa.

English: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
Masaai: Iserememe intae enimiyiololo, nikiserem iyiook enikiyiolo, amu Ilyahudi eing'uaa enjeunoto.

English: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
Masaai: Kake kelotu esaa, netaa taata, naserem ilaseremak oosipa Papa te nkiyang'et o te sipata; amu ileeijo lelo eing'oru Papa pee eserem ninye.

English: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
Masaai: Enkiyang'et Enkai, ore ilooserem ninye, neishiaakino ake neserem te nkiyang'et o te sipata.”

English: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
Masaai: Nejoki enkitok ninye, “Ayiolo ajo kelotu Mesia laa ninye eji Kristo, Naa te nelotu neboloki iyiook imbaa pooki.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Nanu doi ele laairorie, iyie,”

English: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
Masaai: Nepuonu te ina kata ilooiteng'eni lenyena, neing'asia enkaraki nairorie enkitok: kake metii olotejo, “Ainyoo ing'oru?” aashu, “Oo pee irorie iyie ninye?”

English: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
Masaai: Neing'uaa ina kitok oltoo lo soit le nkare, nelo ina anasa nejoki olorere,

English: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
Masaai: “Wootu entodol oltung'ani laatolikio mbaa pooki apa nataasa: kebaiki sa naa ele Kristo?”

English: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
Masaai: Neipang taa ninche te nkanasa nepuonu enetii Yesu.

English: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
Masaai: Ore te ina rishata ake nesai ilooiteng'eni lenyena aajoki, “Rabbi, tadaayu.”

English: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Aata endaa nanya nimiyiololo intae.”

English: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
Masaai: Nejokino ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Keetae oloyaka endaa?”

English: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ore endaa ai naa te naas eyieunoto e lido laairriwua, naidip esiaai enye.

English: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
Masaai: Aimijojo intae, eng'or ilapaitin oong'uan, pee ebau enkisampuare? Eng'ura, entudumu nkonyek inyi, ajoki intae, eng'ura nkurman, eidipa aaiborrita pee eisampuni.

English: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
Masaai: Etumito olaisampuaani olmushaara, neiturrurrito lng'anayio oobaiki enkishui oo ntarasi pee eshipa te nebo olaunoni o laisampuani.

English: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
Masaai: Ele rorei osipa ilo otejoki nchere, eun obo neisampu likae.

English: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
Masaai: Airriwayie intae esampu eneitu iyekarere; kulikae ooteekare, nietuo intae aajing enkisampuare enye.”

English: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
Masaai: Neiruko Isamaria kumok le ina anasa te nkaraki ororei oishakenoko ina kitok inchere: “Aatolikio nataasa apa pooki.”

English: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu Isamaria enetii Yesu, nesai metotona te nebo ninche, nebik inkolong'i are te ine.

English: And many more believed because of his own word;
Masaai: Neiruk kulikae kumok te nkaraki ororei lenye.

English: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
Masaai: Nejoki ina kitok, “Meekure aa enkaraki e nkiroroto ino pee kiruk, amu kitoning'o iyiook maate, naa eikiyiolo aajo esipa ele Olaitajeunoni le nkop.”

English: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
Masaai: Ore pee elusoo nena olong'i pokira are neing'uaa ine alo Galilaya.

English: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
Masaai: Amu etejo Yesu makewan nchere, “Metum oloiboni enkanyit te nkop enye.”

English: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Galilaya, neng'amu Ilgalilaya ninye; etoduaa pooki naataasa te Yerusalem, to sirua; amu eshomo sii ninche ilo sirua.

English: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu Kana e Galilaya ine neitaayie enkare enaisho oo sabibu. Netii apa oltung'ani kitok omuei olayioni lenye te Kapernaum.

English: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ele tung'ani nchere eewuo Yesu eing'uaa Yudea alo Galilaya nelo enetii, nesai metadoi alo aishiunye olayioni lenye; amu etaa keye.

English: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Te neitu idolidolo ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia nimirukuruku.”

English: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo tung'ani kitok ninye, “Lo Kitok, tadou eton eitu ee enkerai ai.”

English: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Shomo, ekeishiu olayioni lino.” Neiruk ilo tung'ani ororei otiaaka Yesu, nelo.

English: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
Masaai: Ore eton edoyio alo nenang'are isinkan lenyena neliki ninye aajoki, “Eishu enkerai ino.”

English: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
Masaai: Neikilikuan esaa naishiunye. Nejoki ninche ninye, “Ng'ole saa naapishana, eing'ueiki olkirobi.”

English: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
Masaai: Neyiolou menye ina kata ajo, enang'ole saa natiaakinye Yesu, “Ekeishiu olayioni lino.” Neiruk ninye makewan o enkaji enye pooki.

English: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
Masaai: Ele taa olmonekie li are nataasa Yesu pee elotu eing'uaa Yudea alo Galilaya.

English: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, neetae osirua loo Lyahudi neilep Yesu alo Yerusalem.

English: Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches.
Masaai: Ore ti atua Yerusalem te mbata o lturoto loo nkerra, netii ewueji neji te nkutuk oo Lhebrania Betsaida, neeta nchomito imiet.

English: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
Masaai: Neirrag te nena olorora kitok loo ltamueyia, ilmodook, ilng'ojiniaa, ilmaiman, eanyu meing'oling'oli enkare.

English: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had.
Masaai: Amu keeta nkatitin naadoiki olmalaika ilo turoto neing'oling'ol enkare. Ore oloiteru ajing aa enaing'oling'olieki enkare neishiunyeki emueyian ake ninye pooki naata.

English: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
Masaai: Netii ine oltung'ani otobiko emuei ilarin tomoni uni o isiet.

English: When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he saith unto him, Wilt thou be made whole?
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ninye eirrag, neiyiolou ajo etobiko enkata naado te ine, nejoki ninye, “Iyieu nikinchiunyeki?”

English: The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steppeth down before me.
Masaai: Newaliki oltamueyiai ajoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, maata nanu oltung'ani laaitadoiki olturoto te neing'oling'oli enkare; ore ajo alotu, nedoiki likae te dukuya nanu.”

English: Jesus saith unto him, Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Inyo tudumu erruat ino shomo.”

English: And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath.
Masaai: Neishiu nabo kata ilo tung'ani, nedumu erruat enye nelo. Naa enkolong e sabato apa ina olong.

English: The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina nejoki Lyahudi ilo oishiunyeki, “Sabato taata, nimikinchoro inap erruat ino.”

English: He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up thy bed, and walk.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ninche ajoki, “Ilo laaishiunye nanu laatiaaka, ‘Tudumu erruat ino shomo.’ ”

English: Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto thee, Take up thy bed, and walk?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ninche ninye aajoki, “Aing'ae ilo likitiaaka, ‘Tudumu erruat ino shomo?’ ”

English: And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place.
Masaai: Nemeyiolo ilo oishiunyeki ajo aing'ae, amu eiwuang'a Yesu, etii olorere ine wueji.

English: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.
Masaai: Ore eidipate nena netum Yesu ninye to nkaji e Nkai, nejoki ninye, “Ing'urai, inchiwuo; mintoki ae kata aas ing'ok mikijing entorrono nalang ena.”

English: The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole.
Masaai: Nelo ilo tung'ani, neliki Ilyahudi nchere Yesu oishiunye.

English: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki e ina neiteru Ilyahudi aaing'orunore Yesu te nkaraki nataasa nena baa te enkolong e sabato.

English: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Easisho Papa o te na kata, naa kaasisho sii nanu.”

English: Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, nenyok Ilyahudi aaing'oru enkoitoi naarie metua, neme enkaraki ake natigila enkolong e sabato kake enkaraki sii natejo menye lenye Enkai, aitorisioki makewan Enkai.

English: Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he seeth the Father do: for what things soever he doeth, these also doeth the Son likewise.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, meidim Enkerai ataasa ae toki openy, te neme naduaaki menye easita; amu ore pooki naas menye neas sii ninye Enkerai aiko neija.

English: For the Father loveth the Son, and sheweth him all things that himself doeth: and he will shew him greater works than these, that ye may marvel.
Masaai: Amu enyor Papa Enkerai enye, neitodol pooki naas, naa keitodol kulie yasat sapuki naalang kuna, pee ing'asiasia intae.

English: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaitopiu Papa ilootuata neisho ninche enkishui neijia sii ninye etiu Enkerai enye eisho enkishui, oloyieu neisho.

English: For the Father judgeth no man, but hath committed all judgment unto the Son:
Masaai: Amu edede meiguanare hoo Papa oltung'ani, Kake eishoo ninye Enkerai enye enkiguana pooki,

English: That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him.
Masaai: pee eyanyitu pooki Enkerai anaa te neyanyit Papa. Ore pooki ng'ae lemeyanyit Enkerai, nemeyanyit Papa oirriwua ninye.
