English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that heareth my word, and believeth on him that sent me, hath everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ore oloinining'u ororei lai, neiruk ilo laairriwua, eeta enkishui oo ntarasi, nemejing enkiguana, kake etupukuo te keeya ajing atua enkishui.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live.
Masaai: “Esipa esipa, ajoki intae, kelotu enkata netii taata, naning ilootuata oltoilo le Nkerai e Nkai, ore lelo ootoning'o neishu.

English: For as the Father hath life in himself; so hath he given to the Son to have life in himself;
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enaata Papa enkishui makewan, neijia sii eikuna aisho Enkerai metaa keeta enkishui makewan;

English: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man.
Masaai: enyaaka sii aisho enkitoria aiguanayu, amu Enkerai e Tung'ani ninye.

English: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,
Masaai: Eming'asia te na, amu kelotu enkata nayooki pooki ootii nkuraren aaning oltoilo lenye.

English: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.
Masaai: Neipang'u; ore ilootaasa isupati nejing empiunoto e nkishui; ore ilootaasa intorrok nejing empiunoto e nkiguana.

English: I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which hath sent me.
Masaai: “Maidim ataasa toki te nkitoria ai makewan; aiguanare anaa enaning; naa enoo sipat enkiguana ai, amu mme eyieunoto ai aing'oru, kake eyieunoto e Papa laairriwua.

English: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
Masaai: Te naishakenoki makewan, nemesipa shakenisho ai.

English: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
Masaai: Etii likae laaishakenoki, nayiolo ajo ore ilo laaishakenoki kesipa shakenisho enye.

English: Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.
Masaai: Irriwakita Yohana olkilikuai, neishakenoki esipata.

English: But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that ye might be saved.
Masaai: Kake mang'amaa nanu shakenisho naing'uaa tung'ani, kake kairo nanu kuna baa pee ijeuu.

English: He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.
Masaai: Netaa Yohana oltaa oinuaaki newang, nitonyorraitie intae aang'idakino te nkiti kata ewang'an enye.

English: But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father hath given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father hath sent me.
Masaai: Kake ore shakenisho naata nanu kitok alang ina e Yohana; amu ore isiaaitin naaishoo Papa maitabai, nena siaaitin naasita ninche maate naishakenoki nchere, Papa laairriwua.

English: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
Masaai: Ore Papa laairriwua ninye makewan laaishakenoko. Eitu ae kata ining'ining'i intae oltoilo lenye, neitu idolidolo eneikununo;

English: And ye have not his word abiding in you: for whom he hath sent, him ye believe not.
Masaai: nimiaatata ororei lenye eton ti atua intae, amu ore ilo oirriwua ninye nimirukuruku.

English: Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.
Masaai: Ijurrujuru intae ilkigerot amu idamumu aajo ninche itumiemie enkishui oo ntarasi, naa kulo kigerot lelo laaishakenoki nanu.

English: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
Masaai: Niminyorraa intae aapuonu enatii pee itumutumu enkishui.

English: I receive not honour from men.
Masaai: Mang'amu nanu enkitoo te tung'ani,

English: But I know you, that ye have not the love of God in you.
Masaai: kake ayiolo intae ajo, miatata enyorrata e Nkai ti atua ate.

English: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
Masaai: Aewuo te nkarna e Papa, nimiking'amumu intae nanu. Te nelotu likae te nkarna enye makewan ilo intae ingamumu.

English: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
Masaai: Te nelotu likae te nkarna enye makewan, ilo intae ing'amumu. Enkai nara openy?

English: Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuseth you, even Moses, in whom ye trust.
Masaai: Emijojo ake kaitang'or intae te Papa. Etii oloitang'or intae naa Musa laa ninye isiligigi.

English: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.
Masaai: Te naa iruko Musa, anaata kirukuruku sii nanu, amu imbaa aainei etisira ninye.

English: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
Masaai: Amaa, ti nimirukuruku ilkigerot lenyena, kaji nkoko ti nirukuruku irorei laainei?”

English: After these things Jesus went over the sea of Galilee, which is the sea of Tiberias.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu kuna baa nelo Yesu alang enaiposha e Galilaya, aa taa enaiposha e Tiberia

English: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
Masaai: netii olorere kitok osujita, amu etoduaa ilmonek lenyena ooitaasita iltamuoyia.

English: And Jesus went up into a mountain, and there he sat with his disciples.
Masaai: Neilepaki Yesu endoinyo neton te ine te nebo ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
Masaai: Netinyikua Pasaka, aa osirua loo Lyahudi.

English: When Jesus then lifted up his eyes, and saw a great company come unto him, he saith unto Philip, Whence shall we buy bread, that these may eat?
Masaai: Ore pee edumu nkonyek enyena nedol esiamo kitok elotu enetii, nejoki Filipo, “Kaji kinyang'unye mukateni pee etum kulo aainosa?”

English: And this he said to prove him: for he himself knew what he would do.
Masaai: Ketejo neijia aa ketem: amu keyiolo ninye makewan enaitaas.

English: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
Masaai: Newaliki Filipo ajoki, “Mebaiki ninche inaainosieki dinarii iip are, te neishori pooki ng'ae enkiti.”

English: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,
Masaai: Ore Andrea, obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena, olalashe le Simon Petero, nejoki ninye,

English: There is a lad here, which hath five barley loaves, and two small fishes: but what are they among so many?
Masaai: “Etii enkiti ayioni natii ene naata mukateni imiet e shairi o sinkir aare; kake ainyoo ninche too lkumok ooba inji?”

English: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Entotona ltung'ana.” Etii ine wueji nkujit kumok, netoni taa lewa, nebaya esiana nkalifuni miet.

English: And Jesus took the loaves; and when he had given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to them that were set down; and likewise of the fishes as much as they would.
Masaai: Nedumu taa Yesu nena mukateni, neishooyo enashe neoriki lelo ootoni; neikunaki sii neijia isinkir anaa naatayieutua ninche.

English: When they were filled, he said unto his disciples, Gather up the fragments that remain, that nothing be lost.
Masaai: Ore pee eraposho ninche nejoki ninye ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Enturrurru ilmong'oishi ootelekutua pee meimin toki.”

English: Therefore they gathered them together, and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves, which remained over and above unto them that had eaten.
Masaai: Neiturrurru taa ninche, neiput nkikapuni tomon o aare ilmong'oitie loo naduoo mukateni miet e shairi ootelekutua lelo ooinosa.

English: Then those men, when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did, said, This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world.
Masaai: Ore lelo tung'ana ootoduaa ina kitoduaata nataasa Yesu nejo, “Esipa ele oloiboni olotu enkop.”

English: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force, to make him a king, he departed again into a mountain himself alone.
Masaai: Ore Yesu, etayiolo ajo kepuonu ninche aaibung ninye te ngolon aaitaa olaiguanani neiwuang ninye openy arrinyokino oldoinyo.

English: And when even was now come, his disciples went down unto the sea,
Masaai: Ore pee eaku teipa nedoiyio ilooiteng'eni lenyena aapuo enaiposha,

English: And entered into a ship, and went over the sea toward Capernaum. And it was now dark, and Jesus was not come to them.
Masaai: ore pee ejing atua empeut, neaku epuo aalang enaiposha aalang'aki Kapernaum. Neidipa atomisimiso, neton eitu elotu Yesu enetii ninche;

English: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
Masaai: neiterua enaiposha ailugo, amu etukutua osiwuo kitok.

English: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatukurtoi empeut mail uni aashu ong'uan nedol Yesu elo te shumata e naiposha elotu anyikaki empeut; neureishoyu ninche.

English: But he saith unto them, It is I; be not afraid.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Nanu ele; emiureishoyu.”

English: Then they willingly received him into the ship: and immediately the ship was at the land whither they went.
Masaai: Neyieu taa neng'amu aapik empeut, ore nabo kata nebaiki empeut enkop duoo napuo.

English: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina nedol enang'ole siamo naitashe te lido kekun le naiposha nchere, metii ai peut ine nabo ake, neitu eiriamariyie Yesu ilooiteng'eni lenyena ajing atua empeut amu eshomo ilooiteng'eni lenyena oopeny.

English: (Howbeit there came other boats from Tiberias nigh unto the place where they did eat bread, after that the Lord had given thanks:)
Masaai: Kake ore ake eyia, eetuo mpeuti te Tiberia aanyikaki ine wueji neinosie mukateni eidipa Olaitoriani aishooi enashe.

English: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, ore pee edol esiamo ajo metii Yesu ine anaa ilooiteng'eni lenyena, nejing ninche oopeny atua e mpeut nepuonu Kapernaum, eing'oru Yesu.

English: And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi, when camest thou hither?
Masaai: Ore pee etum ninche ninye te lido kekun le naiposha, nejoki ninye, “Rabii kanu ilotu ene?”

English: Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, ore pee king'oruru intae nanu, mme te nkaraki nitoduaa ilmonek kake te nkaraki ninosa mukateni niraposhosho.

English: Labour not for the meat which perisheth, but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life, which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.
Masaai: Emisiayu endaa narruoyo kake esiaayu idia daa nabikoo eyau enkishui nemeish, naisho intae Enkerai e Tung'ani, amu ninye etipika Enkai Papa olmishire lenye.”

English: Then said they unto him, What shall we do, that we might work the works of God?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Kaji kinko pee kitum aataas isiaaitin e Nkai?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, This is the work of God, that ye believe on him whom he hath sent.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Ena esiaai e Nkai, pee irukuruku ilo oirriwua ninye.”

English: They said therefore unto him, What sign shewest thou then, that we may see, and believe thee? what dost thou work?
Masaai: Nejoki taa ninche ninye, “Kaa kitoduata ias, pee kidol nikiruk iyie? Kaa iasita iyie?

English: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.
Masaai: Einosa iloo papa enapa mana ti ong'ata, anaa enatisiraki aajo, ‘Eishoo ninche emukate naing'uaa shumata meinosa.’ ”

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Moses gave you not that bread from heaven; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, eitu eisho intae Musa emukate naing'uaa shumata. Kake eishorita intae Papa lai ina mukate nasipa naing'uaa shumata.

English: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven, and giveth life unto the world.
Masaai: Ore emukate naishoru Enkai naa ina nadou aing'uaa shumata neisho enkop enkishui.”

English: Then said they unto him, Lord, evermore give us this bread.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Lo Kitok, inchoo iyiook anaa ake ina mukate.”

English: And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ara nanu emukate e nkishui; ore ololotu enatii metum esumash, naa ore olaairuk nanu meitoki ai kata atir enkure.

English: But I said unto you, That ye also have seen me, and believe not.
Masaai: Kake atiaaka intae nchere, kitoduaa kake eton mirukuruku.

English: All that the Father giveth me shall come to me; and him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.
Masaai: Ore pooki laaisho Papa epuonu enatii, ore ololotu enatii nemanang'aa boo katukul,

English: For I came down from heaven, not to do mine own will, but the will of him that sent me.
Masaai: amu atadowuo aing'uaa shumata neme pee alotu aas eyieunoto ai, kake eyieunoto e ilo laairriwua.

English: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
Masaai: Ena eyieunoto e ilo laairriwua inchere pee maiturraa hoo obo le lelo laaishoo, kake kaitopiu nanu ninche te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: And this is the will of him that sent me, that every one which seeth the Son, and believeth on him, may have everlasting life: and I will raise him up at the last day.
Masaai: Amu ena eyieunoto e Papa inchere, ore pooki odol Enkerai neiruk ninye, netum enkishui nemeish; naa kaitopiu nanu ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto.”

English: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
Masaai: Neaku keing'unyung'unyaki Lyahudi ninye, enkaraki natejo, “Ara nanu emukate natadowuo aing'uaa keper.”

English: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? how is it then that he saith, I came down from heaven?
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Aime Yesu ele enkerai e Yosef, likiyiolo menye o ng'otonye? Kaji naa etiu pee etejo, ‘Atadowuo aing'uaa shumata?’ ”

English: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Eming'unyung'uny maate.

English: No man can come to me, except the Father which hath sent me draw him: and I will raise him up at the last day.
Masaai: Metii oltung'ani oidim aeu enatii, te neme Papa laairriwua oyietu ninye; naa kaitopiu nanu ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: It is written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God. Every man therefore that hath heard, and hath learned of the Father, cometh unto me.
Masaai: Eigeroki too mbaa oo loibonok le Nkai aajo, ‘Naa keaku Enkai naiteng'en pooki.’ Ore naa pooki ng'ae otoning'o neiteng'enuo kewan te papa nelotu enatii.

English: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.
Masaai: Mme taa ketoduaa hoo obo Papa, leme ilo oing'uaa Enkai, ninye otoduaa Papa.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me hath everlasting life.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ore olaairuk nanu eeta enkishui nemeish.

English: I am that bread of life.
Masaai: Ara nanu emukate e nkishui.

English: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
Masaai: Einosa loo papaai linyi mana ti ong'ata netuata.

English: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven, that a man may eat thereof, and not die.
Masaai: Ena mukate nadou aing'uaa shumata, ore olonya ninye nemeye.

English: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.
Masaai: Ara nanu emukate naishu natadowuo aing'uaa shumata. Ore pooki ng'ae onya ena mukate neishu intarasi; naa ore emukate naishoru naa osesen lai, te nkaraki enkishui e nkop.”

English: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
Masaai: Neaku keishankarra Lyahudi aaitirrishakino maate, ejo, “Kaji eiko te neidim aishoo iyiook ele tung'ani osesen lenye mainosa?”

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, te neitu inyanya osesen le Nkerai e Tung'ani niokioko osarge lenye, miaatata enkishui ti atua ate.

English: Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.
Masaai: Ore olonya osesen lai neok osarge lai, eeta enkishui nemeish, naa kaitopiu nanu ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
Masaai: Amu endaa nasipa osesen lai, naa eokoto nasipa osarge lai.

English: He that eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, dwelleth in me, and I in him.
Masaai: Ore olonya osesen lai neok osarge lai, neton ti atua nanu naton nanu ti atua ninye.

English: As the living Father hath sent me, and I live by the Father: so he that eateth me, even he shall live by me.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaairriwua Papa oishu, naishuyie nanu Papa, neijia sii etiu elde laanya nanu, nanu eishuyie.

English: This is that bread which came down from heaven: not as your fathers did eat manna, and are dead: he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever.
Masaai: Ena mukate natadowuo aing'uaa shumata, mme anaa enapa nainosa loo papaai, netuata; ore olonya ena mukate neishu ntarasi.”

English: These things said he in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.
Masaai: Etejo ninye kuna baa ti atua enkaji e ntumo, eiteng'enisho te Kapernaum.

English: Many therefore of his disciples, when they had heard this, said, This is an hard saying; who can hear it?
Masaai: Ore pee ening ilkumok loo looiteng'eni lenyena kuna, nejo, “Kegol ele rorei. Aing'ae oidim atoning'o?”

English: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it, he said unto them, Doth this offend you?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu makewan nchere keing'unyung'uny ilooiteng'eni lenyena te nkaraki ina, nejoki ninche, “Amaa keikob intae ena?

English: What and if ye shall see the Son of man ascend up where he was before?
Masaai: Oo naa ti nidolidolo Enkerai e Tung'ani eilepieki enetii apa te dukuya?

English: It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.
Masaai: Enkiyang'et naishoru enkishui; meeta osesen dupoto. Ore lelo rorei latiaaka intae, enkiyang'et naa enkishui.

English: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
Masaai: Kake etii kulikae te intae leton meiruk.” Amu eyiolo apa ake Yesu te nkiterunoto ajo kakua leitu eiruk, naa kalo olo akaldaa ninye.

English: And he said, Therefore said I unto you, that no man can come unto me, except it were given unto him of my Father.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Te nkaraki ina atiaaka intae nchere meetae oloidim aeu enatii, te neme keishoro te Papa.”

English: From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki ina kata, te nkaraki nena, nerrinyo ilkumok loo looiteng'eni lenyena neitu eitoki aairiamariyie ninye.

English: Then said Jesus unto the twelve, Will ye also go away?
Masaai: Nejoki taa Yesu lekua tomon o aare, “Amaa, aiyieuu sii intae nipuopuo?”

English: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
Masaai: Newaliki Simon Petero ajoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, aing'ae kipuo enetii? Iyie aota rorei le nkishui nemeish,

English: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ, the Son of the living God.
Masaai: nikiruko iyiook nikitayioloito nchere, ira iyie Ilo Obo Sinyati le Nkai.”

English: Jesus answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejo, “Keitu agelu intae, pokira tomon oare, ore obo linyi naa oloirirua?”

English: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon: for he it was that should betray him, being one of the twelve.
Masaai: Eimaka Yudas olayioni le Simon Iskariot, amu obo apa ninye te lelo tomon oare, laa ninye oyooki akaldaa.

English: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu kuna baa neloolo Yesu te Galilaya, amu meyieu neloolo te Yudea te nkaraki naing'oru Lyahudi pee ear ninye metua.

English: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.
Masaai: Netinyikua osirua loo Lyahudi, aa osirua loo lng'oborri.

English: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
Masaai: Neaku etiakitia lalashera ninye, “Tung'uai ene shomo Yudea, pee edol sii ninche looiteng'eni linono isiaaitin niasita.

English: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.
Masaai: Amu meetae oloas ai bae too nkisudorot laa keyieu ninye openy nelioyu aibalayu. Te naa iasita iyie nena baa aibalunye, imbalakinye kewan enkop.”

English: For neither did his brethren believe in him.
Masaai: Amu eitu doi eiruk ilalashera lenyena ninye.

English: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eton eitu ebau enkata ai, kake etii enkata inyi oshi ake.

English: The world cannot hate you; but me it hateth, because I testify of it, that the works thereof are evil.
Masaai: Meidim enkop aibayu intae, kake kaaiba nanu, amu kaishakenoki nchere arruok iasat enyena.

English: Go ye up unto this feast: I go not up yet unto this feast; for my time is not yet full come.
Masaai: Elepa intae enchom osirua. Mailep nanu alo ele sirua amu eton eitu ebaya enkata ai.”

English: When he had said these words unto them, he abode still in Galilee.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atiaki ninche neijia, nebik te Galilaya.

English: But when his brethren were gone up, then went he also up unto the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
Masaai: Ore eidipa lalashera lenyena aailepa aashom ilo sirua, neitoki sii ninye alo, neitu eitalio kewan, kake etiu anaa keisudori.

English: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
Masaai: Neaku keing'oru ninye Lyahudi te ine to sirua, nejo, “Koree ninye?”

English: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.
Masaai: Netii olong'unyung'unyi atua esiamo te nkaraki ninye, ejo kulikae, “Oltung'ani supat,” nejo kulikae, “A'a keitapong'oo ninye olorere.”

English: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia neijia metii obo oimaki ninye aibalunye eurei Lyahudi.

English: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple, and taught.
Masaai: Ore pee eitorito ilo sirua, neilep Yesu ajing enkaji e Nkai, neiteru aiteng'enisho.

English: And the Jews marvelled, saying, How knoweth this man letters, having never learned?
Masaai: Neing'asia Ilyahudi nejo, “Kaji eiko pee eyiolo ele tung'ani sirat, neitu ae kata eiteng'eni?”

English: Jesus answered them, and said, My doctrine is not mine, but his that sent me.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki ninche, “Mme enaai enkiteng'enare ai, kake ene ilo laairriwua.

English: If any man will do his will, he shall know of the doctrine, whether it be of God, or whether I speak of myself.
Masaai: Te nenyorraa oltung'ani aas eyieunoto e Nkai, keyiolou ineina kiteng'enare, te naa ke Nkai eing'uaa aashu te naa ai te nkitoria kewan ai airo.

English: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory: but he that seeketh his glory that sent him, the same is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.
Masaai: Ore oloiro makewan, enchunet enye makewan eing'oru; kake ore ilo oing'oru enchunet e ilo oirriwua, nesipa ninye, nemetii inemesipa atua ninye.

English: Did not Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keepeth the law? Why go ye about to kill me?
Masaai: Keitu eisho intae Musa nkitanapat? Nemetii obo linyi oibung'ita nena kitanapat. Ainyoo pee king'oruru aar nanu?”

English: The people answered and said, Thou hast a devil: who goeth about to kill thee?
Masaai: Newaliki olorere aajoki, “Aiata oloirirua. Aing'ae liking'oru aar?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, I have done one work, and ye all marvel.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche, “Ataasa esiaai nabo ning'asiate pooki.

English: Moses therefore gave unto you circumcision; (not because it is of Moses, but of the fathers;) and ye on the sabbath day circumcise a man.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena pee eishoo intae Musa emuratare, neme Musa doi eing'uaa kake lekua loo papa, nimuratata intae oltung'ani te nkolong e sabato.

English: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?
Masaai: Amaa amu kemurati oltung'ani te nkolong e Sabato pee megili nkitanapat e Musa, oo pee kigorokinono intae nanu amu aitaa oltung'ani biyoto katukul te nkolong e Sabato?

English: Judge not according to the appearance, but judge righteous judgment.
Masaai: Eminguanare anaa inaalioo, kake enguanare te nkiguana oo sipat.”

English: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
Masaai: Nejo kulikae le Yerusalem, “Aime ele doi eing'oruni aar metua?

English: But, lo, he speaketh boldly, and they say nothing unto him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ?
Masaai: Kake eng'urai, eiro aibalie, neitu ejoki ninche ae. Keidimayu sa metaa keyioloi ilooitoreisho aajo ele Kristo?

English: Howbeit we know this man whence he is: but when Christ cometh, no man knoweth whence he is.
Masaai: Kake ore ele eikiyiolo eneing'uaa.” Naa tenelioyu kenya ilo oji Kristo eibalunye nemeetae oloyiolo eneing'uaa ninye.

English: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught, saying, Ye both know me, and ye know whence I am: and I am not come of myself, but he that sent me is true, whom ye know not.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ina etabua Yesu to nkaji e Nkai eiteng'enisho ejo, “Eikiyiololo nanu niyiololo enaing'uaa. Neitu alotu te yieunoto ai makewan, kake ore elde laairriwua ninye osipa, naa ninye miyiololo.

English: But I know him: for I am from him, and he hath sent me.
Masaai: Kayiolo nanu ninye, amu ninye aing'uaa naa ninye laairriwua.”

English: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
Masaai: Neing'oru ninche eneiko pee eibung ninye, kake metii obo oiteleikia enkaina ninye, amu eton eitu ebau esaa enye.

English: And many of the people believed on him, and said, When Christ cometh, will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done?
Masaai: Neiruk ilkumok ninye ti atua olorere, nejo, “Amaa te nelotu Kristo, keas inkitoduaat kumok naalang inaasita ele tung'ani?”

English: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him.
Masaai: Nening Ilfarisayo eimaki esiamo nena baa enyana, neirriwaa lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo larripok meshomo aaibung ninye.

English: Then said Jesus unto them, Yet a little while am I with you, and then I go unto him that sent me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eng'or enkiti kata eton atii te nebo intae, pee aitoki alo enetii ilo laairriwua.

English: Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come.
Masaai: Aikiyookiki aaing'oru, kake mikitumutumu, ore enatii nimindimidimi aaetu.”

English: Then said the Jews among themselves, Whither will he go, that we shall not find him? will he go unto the dispersed among the Gentiles, and teach the Gentiles?
Masaai: Nejokino Lyahudi maate, “Kaji ejo pee elo, nimikitumie? Kejo pee elo enetii Lyahudi ooidapashakinote Ilyunani, nelo aiteng'en Ilyunani?

English: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
Masaai: Kalo rorei ele otejo, ‘Aikiyookiki aaing'oru nimikitumutumu, ore enatii nimindimidimi aaetu?’ ”

English: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nabayie, naa ninye enkolong kitok e ilo sirua, neitashe Yesu nebuak ajo, “Te neeta oltung'ani enkure, inchoo elotu enatii aokisho.

English: He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.
Masaai: Ore olaairuk nanu, ore anaa enajo ilkigerot. ‘Keyooki aarukunye nchorroi e nkare naishu to ltau lenye.’ ”

English: (But this spake he of the Spirit, which they that believe on him should receive: for the Holy Ghost was not yet given; because that Jesus was not yet glorified.)
Masaai: Ore pee etejo ninye neijia, Enkiyang'et eimaka natum lelo pooki ooiruk ninye, amu eton eitu ebau ina Kiyang'et ina kata, amu eton eitu eilepieki Yesu metaa kitok.

English: Many of the people therefore, when they heard this saying, said, Of a truth this is the Prophet.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ematua e siamo kulo rorei nejo, “Esipa ilo oiboni ele.”

English: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, Shall Christ come out of Galilee?
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, “Ele Kristo.” Nejo kulikae, “Ai Galilaya epukunye Kristo?

English: Hath not the scripture said, That Christ cometh of the seed of David, and out of the town of Bethlehem, where David was?
Masaai: Keitu ejo lkigerot eishoi e Daudi eimu Kristo, apukunye Betlehem, enkang natii apa Daudi?”

English: So there was a division among the people because of him.
Masaai: Ore te ina nejing empong'o atua esiamo te nkaraki ninye.

English: And some of them would have taken him; but no man laid hands on him.
Masaai: Neyieu kulikae neibung ninye, kake metii oloitabaikia ninye enkaina.

English: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
Masaai: Nepuonu ilarripok enetii lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo, nejokini ninche, “Ainyoo pee eitu iyauu ninye?”

English: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
Masaai: Newaliki larripok nejo, “Eitu ae kata eiro oltung'ani anaa enairo ele tung'ani.”

English: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
Masaai: Newaliki Lfarisayo ninche nejoki, “Keitapong'oyioki sii intae?

English: Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed on him?
Masaai: Keetae too laitoriak anaa too Lfarisayo oloiruko ninye?

English: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.
Masaai: Kake ore ena siamo nemeyiolo nkitanapat, kedia.”

English: Nicodemus saith unto them, (he that came to Jesus by night, being one of them,)
Masaai: Nejoki Nikedemo ninche, olapa taa otang'asa alotu enetii Yesu, laa obo te lelo,

English: Doth our law judge any man, before it hear him, and know what he doeth?
Masaai: “Amaa kedung'oki nkitanapat ang oltung'ani enkiguana eton eitu eng'asi aainining neyiolouni enaasita?”

English: They answered and said unto him, Art thou also of Galilee? Search, and look: for out of Galilee ariseth no prophet.
Masaai: Newaliki aajoki ninye, “Aa Galilaya sii yie ing'uaa? Ing'oru tisipu: inchere meetae oloiboni opuku eing'uaa Galilaya.”

English: And every man went unto his own house.
Masaai: Nelotu pooki tung'ani enkaji enye.

English: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Yesu Oldoinyo loo Loirienito.

English: And early in the morning he came again into the temple, and all the people came unto him; and he sat down, and taught them.
Masaai: Ore enasirie neitoki ajing atua enkaji e Nkai, nepuonu ltung'ana pooki enetii ninye; neton neiteru aiteng'en ninche.

English: And the scribes and Pharisees brought unto him a woman taken in adultery; and when they had set her in the midst,
Masaai: Nerikoki ninye lasirak o Lfarisayo enkitok nairrashaki eloloito. Neitasheyie ninye te mpolos.

English: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Lo Aiteng'enani, eirrashaki ena kitok eloloito.

English: Now Moses in the law commanded us, that such should be stoned: but what sayest thou?
Masaai: Ore ti atua nkitanapat e Musa neitanapa iyiook mataar too soito nkituaak naatiu neijia; aijo iyie aa tiaalo ninye?”

English: This they said, tempting him, that they might have to accuse him. But Jesus stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground, as though he heard them not.
Masaai: Netejo ninche nji, aa entemata etem, pee etum aaitang'oro Yesu. Kake eirruge Yesu nesir enkop to lkimojino.

English: So when they continued asking him, he lifted up himself, and said unto them, He that is without sin among you, let him first cast a stone at her.
Masaai: Ore pee ekurraki aaikilikuan neapunye, nejoki ninche, “Enchoo eng'as olinyi lemeeta ng'ok, anang ninye to soit.”

English: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
Masaai: Neitoki aigil airrugo, asir enkop to lkimojino.

English: And they which heard it, being convicted by their own conscience, went out one by one, beginning at the eldest, even unto the last: and Jesus was left alone, and the woman standing in the midst.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche, neiteru aaipung maa obo, aaiteru too lbotor lenye, neing'uari Yesu aa ninye ake, o enaduoo kitok eitashe te mpolos.

English: When Jesus had lifted up himself, and saw none but the woman, he said unto her, Woman, where are those thine accusers? hath no man condemned thee?
Masaai: Neapunye Yesu nejoki ninye, “Naa kitok, koree ninche? Ai meetae olikitudung'oko enkiguana?”

English: She said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said unto her, Neither do I condemn thee: go, and sin no more.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Metii Lo Kitok.” Nejoki Yesu, “Maaiguanare sii nanu. Shomo, ore ebaiki taata mintoki aas ing'ok.”

English: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu airorie ninche nejoki, “Ara nanu ewang'an e nkop. Ore olaasuj nanu nemelo ai kata te naimin, kake keeta ewang'an e nkishui.”

English: The Pharisees therefore said unto him, Thou bearest record of thyself; thy record is not true.
Masaai: Nejoki Lfarisayo ninye, “Iyie oishakenoki kewan. Mesipa shakenisho ino.”

English: Jesus answered and said unto them, Though I bear record of myself, yet my record is true: for I know whence I came, and whither I go; but ye cannot tell whence I come, and whither I go.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Te naa kaishakenoki duoo ninye kewan, kesipa shakenisho ai, amu kayiolo enaing'uaa nayiolo enalo; kake miyiololo intae enaing'uaa, aashu enalo.

English: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
Masaai: Inguanarere intae anaa to sesen; maiguanare nanu oltung'ani.

English: And yet if I judge, my judgment is true: for I am not alone, but I and the Father that sent me.
Masaai: Kake te naiguanare, nesipa enkiguana ai, amu mme nanu ake, kake nanu o ilo laairriwua.

English: It is also written in your law, that the testimony of two men is true.
Masaai: Etisiraki ti atua nkitanapat inyi nchere, kesipa shakenisho oo ltung'ana aare.

English: I am one that bear witness of myself, and the Father that sent me beareth witness of me.
Masaai: Ara nanu ilo olimu shakenisho enye makewan, naa kaaishakenoki nanu Papa laairriwua.”

English: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.
Masaai: Nejoki taa ninche ninye, “Koree Papa lino?” Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Mikiyiololo nanu nimiyiololo sii Papa te naa eikitayioloito nanu, naa anaata iyiololo sii ninye Papa.”

English: These words spake Jesus in the treasury, as he taught in the temple: and no man laid hands on him; for his hour was not yet come.
Masaai: Eiroro Yesu kulo rorei te wueji nepiki mpesai, eiteng'enisho te Nkaji e Nkai. Nemetii oltung'ani oibung'a ninye, amu eton eitu ebau esaa enye.

English: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ninche, “Kalo nanu, naa eiking'oruru intae, kake niyeye ti atua ing'ok inyi. Ore enalo mindimidimi aaetu.”

English: Then said the Jews, Will he kill himself? because he saith, Whither I go, ye cannot come.
Masaai: Nejo Ilyahudi, “Kear kewan? Amu etejo, ‘Ore enalo nanu nimindimidimi aaetu’?”

English: And he said unto them, Ye are from beneath; I am from above: ye are of this world; I am not of this world.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Irara intae ile abori; nara nanu ole shumata; nirara intae ile na kop; nemara nanu ole na kop.

English: I said therefore unto you, that ye shall die in your sins: for if ye believe not that I am he, ye shall die in your sins.
Masaai: Ore te ina atiaaka intae, iyeye ti atua ing'ok inyi amu ti nimirukuruku nchere ‘Ara nanu’ niyeye ti atua ing'ok inyi.”

English: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? And Jesus saith unto them, Even the same that I said unto you from the beginning.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Aira iyie ng'ae?” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Anaa ake ina natolikio intae te nkiterunoto.

English: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
Masaai: Aata mbaa kumok naimaki ti alo intae, naiguanare; kake olaairriwua ninye osipa, naa inatoning'o te ninye, ninche ajoki enkop.”

English: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
Masaai: Neitu eyiolou ninche inchere Papa eimaki.

English: Then said Jesus unto them, When ye have lifted up the Son of man, then shall ye know that I am he, and that I do nothing of myself; but as my Father hath taught me, I speak these things.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche. “Ti nilepiepie intae Enkerai e Tung'ani niyiolouu nchere ‘Ara nanu’, nemeeta nanu enaas te nkitoria ai makewan, kake airo kuna baa pooki anaa enaatolikio Papa.

English: And he that sent me is with me: the Father hath not left me alone; for I do always those things that please him.
Masaai: Ore olaairriwua netii te nebo nanu. Eitu aaing'uaa aa nanu ake, amu inaaitiship ninye oshi ake aas.”

English: As he spake these words, many believed on him.
Masaai: Ore ejoito kuna baa neiruk ilkumok ninye.

English: Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him, If ye continue in my word, then are ye my disciples indeed;
Masaai: Akaae, nejoki Yesu lelo Yahudi ooiruko ninye, “Ti nitonini to rorei lai nirara ilooiteng'eni laainei oosipa;

English: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
Masaai: naa iyiolouu esipata; nelaku intae esipata.”

English: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
Masaai: Newaliki ninche ninye aajoki, “Kira eishoi e Abraham; neitu ae kata kiaaku isinkan le likae tung'ani; kaji etiu pee ijo iyie, ‘Kelakuni intae?’ ”

English: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, osinka loo ng'ok pooki ng'ae oas ing'ok.

English: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
Masaai: Mebik osinka te nkaji o kenya; nebik enkerai o kenya.

English: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
Masaai: Te nelaku intae ina Kerai, ilakunono aaitorioki.

English: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
Masaai: Kayiolo ajo irara eishoi e Abraham; kake king'oruru intae nanu aar, amu metii atua intae ororei lai.

English: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
Masaai: Alimu enatoduaa te Papa; niaasiasa intae enitoduakita papaai linyi.”

English: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche aajoki ninye, “Abraham papa lang.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Te naa irara nkera e Abraham, anaata iasiasa nena naataasa Abraham;

English: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
Masaai: kake king'oruru taata intae aar matua oltung'ani otolikio intae esipata natoning'o te Nkai. Eitu eas Abraham ena.

English: Ye do the deeds of your father. Then said they to him, We be not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.
Masaai: Iasiasa intae enataasa papaai linyi.” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Mikitaluno; kiaata Papa obo, naa Enkai.”

English: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Te naa Papaai linyi Enkai, anaata kinyorrinyorro, amu Enkai aing'uaa, pee atii ene, Neitu alotu makewan, kake ninye laairriwua.

English: Why do ye not understand my speech? even because ye cannot hear my word.
Masaai: Ainyoo pee mining'ung'u intae enajo? Enkaraki nimindimidimi aatoning ororei lai.

English: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
Masaai: Irara le papaai linyi, ilo oirirua, ore eyieunoto inyi naa easata oo ng'uarrat naaing'uaa papaai linyi. Olarani apa ake ninye te nkiterunoto, meitashe ninye te sipata, amu metii esipata, atua ninye. Te nejo ninye elejare, nejo te risioroto olkuaak lenye makewan; amu olalejani naa menye le lejare.

English: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
Masaai: Kake ore nanu te nkaraki naa esipata airo, nimikirukuruku.

English: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?
Masaai: Kalo linyi laatoduaaka ng'ok? Omaa te nairo esipata aainyo pee mikirukuruku intae nanu?

English: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo le Nkai nening irorei le Nkai. Ore te nkaraki ena nimining'ining'i intae amu mirara le Nkai.”

English: Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?
Masaai: Newaliki Lyahudi aajoki ninye, “Keitu kisip ti nikijo aira Osamariai naa iata oloirirua?”

English: Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Maata nanu oloirirua, kake Papa ayanyit, nikioruru intae enkanyit ai.

English: And I seek not mine own glory: there is one that seeketh and judgeth.
Masaai: Maing'oru nanu enkitoo ai makewan; kake etii oloing'oru naa ninye oladung'oni le nkiguana.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, If a man keep my saying, he shall never see death.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, te neibung oltung'ani ororei lai nemedol ai kata keeya.”

English: Then said the Jews unto him, Now we know that thou hast a devil. Abraham is dead, and the prophets; and thou sayest, If a man keep my saying, he shall never taste of death.
Masaai: Nejoki Ilyahudi ninye, “Kitisiputua taata aajo iata oloirirua. Etua Abraham neijia sii etiu iloibonok le Nkai, eji nijo iyie, ‘Ore pooki ng'ae oibung ororei lai meishamisham ai kata keeya?’

English: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
Masaai: Ai iyie olkitok alang papa lang Abraham, otua? Netuata sii loibonok le Nkai. Aing'ae doi iyie ijo aitaa kewan?”

English: Jesus answered, If I honour myself, my honour is nothing: it is my Father that honoureth me; of whom ye say, that he is your God:
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajo, “Te naa ai nanu oitaa kewan kitok, neme toki enkitoo ai. Papa doi laaitaa kitok ilo lijojo intae, Enkai ang ninye.

English: Yet ye have not known him; but I know him: and if I should say, I know him not, I shall be a liar like unto you: but I know him, and keep his saying.
Masaai: Kake miyiololo doi intae ninye, nayiolo nanu ninye; naa te najo nanu mayiolo ninye, naaku olalejani anaa intae; kake kayiolo doi ninye nasuj ororei lenye.

English: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.
Masaai: Eting'ide papa linyi Abraham, pee edol enkolong ai; nedol ninye, neng'ida.”

English: Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
Masaai: Nejoki Lyahudi ninye, “Eton eitu ntabaya larin onom, pa nijo kitoduaa Abraham iyie?”

English: Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Before Abraham was, I am.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ore eton meetae Abraham, ‘Atii nanu.’ ”

English: Then took they up stones to cast at him: but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple, going through the midst of them, and so passed by.
Masaai: Nedumu ninche soito pee ear, kake eisudori Yesu, nepuku to nkaji e Nkai.

English: And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth.
Masaai: Ore elo ninye nedol oltung'ani otoiwuoki aa modooni.

English: And his disciples asked him, saying, Master, who did sin, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?
Masaai: Neikilikuan ilooiteng'eni lenyena ninye aajoki, “Rabbi, aing'ae otaasa eng'oki, kele tung'ani, anaa ilootoiutuo, pee etoiwuoki ninye aa modooni?”

English: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Eitu eitarruoo ele tung'ani, anaa ilootoiutuo, kake esiaai e Nkai eji pee eibalunyeki ti atua ninye.

English: I must work the works of him that sent me, while it is day: the night cometh, when no man can work.
Masaai: Kenare nikias isiaaitin e ilo laairriwua eton aa dama; amu kelotu enkewarie, nemeidim oltung'ani aitayu esiaai.

English: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
Masaai: Ore eton atii enkop, ara nanu ewang'an e nkop.”

English: When he had thus spoken, he spat on the ground, and made clay of the spittle, and he anointed the eyes of the blind man with the clay,
Masaai: Ore pee ejo ilo rorei, nenotaki enkop, neipurjaki nkamulak inkulupuok; neyelie nkonyek e ilo modooni.

English: And said unto him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam, (which is by interpretation, Sent.) He went his way therefore, and washed, and came seeing.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Shomo sujai to lmoti le Siloam.” (Keji ina arna oirriwayioki). Neaku eshomo aisuja neshukunye etodolishe.

English: The neighbours therefore, and they which before had seen him that he was blind, said, Is not this he that sat and begged?
Masaai: Neaku, ore ile latia, o lelo ootoduaa apa inchere olaomononi, nejo. “Ai mme ele oshi oton aomonisho?”

English: Some said, This is he: others said, He is like him: but he said, I am he.
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, “Ninye.” Nejo kulikae, “Mme ninye, kake kenyaanyukie ninye.” Nejo ninye openy. “Nanu ilo.”

English: Therefore said they unto him, How were thine eyes opened?
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye. “Kaji kinkunaki pee etabolote nkonyek inono?”

English: He answered and said, A man that is called Jesus made clay, and anointed mine eyes, and said unto me, Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash: and I went and washed, and I received sight.
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Oltung'ani oji Yesu oipurja esarng'ab, naaelie nkonyek aainei, naajoki, ‘Shomo Olmoti le Siloam isujai.’ Nalo aisujaa nadolishoyu.”

English: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Kaji etii?” Nejoki, “Mayiolo nanu.”

English: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
Masaai: Nerik ninche elde apa modooni enetii Ilfarisayo.

English: And it was the sabbath day when Jesus made the clay, and opened his eyes.
Masaai: Naa enkolong e sabato ina olong pee eipurj Yesu esarng'ab, abol inkonyek enyena.

English: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. He said unto them, He put clay upon mine eyes, and I washed, and do see.
Masaai: Neitoki sii Lfarisayo aaikilikuan ninye eneikuna pee etodolishe. Nejoki ninche, “Esarng'ab aaelie nkonyek aainei, naisuja, nadolishoyu.”

English: Therefore said some of the Pharisees, This man is not of God, because he keepeth not the sabbath day. Others said, How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles? And there was a division among them.
Masaai: Nejo kulikae loo Lfarisayo, “Mme Nkai eing'uaa ele tung'ani, amu meibung enkolong e sabato.” Nejo kulikae, “Keidim oltung'ani arruoni ataasa inaaing'asiaisho neeijo kuna?” Nejing empong'o atua ninche.

English: They say unto the blind man again, What sayest thou of him, that he hath opened thine eyes? He said, He is a prophet.
Masaai: Naeku etiakitia ninche ilo tung'ani modooni, “Aijo iyie aa ninye, amu kitabolo naa nkonyek?” Nejo, “Oloiboni ninye.”

English: But the Jews did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and received his sight, until they called the parents of him that had received his sight.
Masaai: Kake ore ake etiu neijia, eitu eiruk Ilyahudi mbaa enyena nchere modooni apa netodolishe, o metaba anaa neipot intoiuo eilo tung'ani otodolishe,

English: And they asked them, saying, Is this your son, who ye say was born blind? how then doth he now see?
Masaai: neikilikuan ninche aajoki, “Kele ayioni linyi litejo apa etoiwuoki aa modooni? Kaji etiu taata pee edolisho?”

English: His parents answered them and said, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind:
Masaai: Newaliki ilootoiutuo aajoki. “Kiyiolo aajo olayioni lang, netoiwuoki apa aa modooni;

English: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
Masaai: kake mikiyiolo eneikuna pee edolisho taata, nimikiyiolo olotabolo nkonyek enyena. Ai botor doi, enkilikuana ninye; kelimu mbaa enyena makewan.”

English: These words spake his parents, because they feared the Jews: for the Jews had agreed already, that if any man did confess that he was Christ, he should be put out of the synagogue.
Masaai: Etejo intoiuo ena te nkaraki naure Ilyahudi; amu eidipa Lyahudi aatoning'okinoto nchere, “Ore ake oltung'ani oibalie ajo ninye Kristo, nearari aaipang'ie te nkaji e ntumo.

English: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
Masaai: Neaku ina pee etejo intoiuo, ‘Ai botor doi, enkilikuana ninye,’ ”

English: Then again called they the man that was blind, and said unto him, Give God the praise: we know that this man is a sinner.
Masaai: Neitoki taa aaipot ene are elde tung'ani ora apa modooni, nejoki ninye, “Inchoo Enkai enkisisa. Kiyiolo iyiook aajo olarruoni ele tung'ani.”

English: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
Masaai: Newaliki ninye ajoki, “Te naa kolarruoni mayiolo nanu; nabo ayiolo, inchere kara apa modooni nadolisho taata.”

English: Then said they to him again, What did he to thee? how opened he thine eyes?
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aajoki, “Kaji kinkuna? Kaji eikuna pee kitabolo nkonyek inono?”

English: He answered them, I have told you already, and ye did not hear: wherefore would ye hear it again? will ye also be his disciples?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki ninche, “Aidipa duoo atoliki intae, neitu ining'ining'i. Kaji etiu pee iyieuu nintokiki ake aaning? Iyieuu sii intae niakuku ilooiteng'eni lenyena?”

English: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.
Masaai: Nemor ninche ninye nejoki, “Ira iyie oloiteng'eni lenye; kake kira iyiook ilooiteng'eni le Musa.

English: We know that God spake unto Moses: as for this fellow, we know not from whence he is.
Masaai: Kiyiolo iyiook aajo eirorie Enkai Musa; kake ore ele, mikiyiolo eneing'uaa.”

English: The man answered and said unto them, Why herein is a marvellous thing, that ye know not from whence he is, and yet he hath opened mine eyes.
Masaai: Newaliki ilo tung'ani ninche ajoki, “Ainyoo, ene nking'asia eji miyiololo eneing'uaa ninye kake etabolo nkonyek aainei!

English: Now we know that God heareth not sinners: but if any man be a worshipper of God, and doeth his will, him he heareth.
Masaai: Kiyiolo aajo mening Enkai ilaing'okok; kake ore oloserem Enkai neas enayieu ninye, kening Enkai ninye.

English: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
Masaai: Eitu ae kata ening'i olotabolo nkonyek o ltung'ani oini aa modooni.

English: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.
Masaai: Te neme Enkai eing'uaa ele tung'ani meidim ataasa toki.”

English: They answered and said unto him, Thou wast altogether born in sins, and dost thou teach us? And they cast him out.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche ninye aajoki, “Aa iyie olotu aiteng'en iyiook oltung'ani otoikioki atua elulung'ata oo ng'ok?” Nearaa ninche ninye aaipang'ie.

English: Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and when he had found him, he said unto him, Dost thou believe on the Son of God?
Masaai: Nening Yesu nchere etaaraitie ninche ninye aaipang'ie; ore pee elo netum nejoki ninye, “Iruko iyie Enkerai e Tung'ani?”

English: He answered and said, Who is he, Lord, that I might believe on him?
Masaai: Newaliki ajoki, “Lo Kitok, ai ng'ae ilo pee atum airuko ninye?”

English: And Jesus said unto him, Thou hast both seen him, and it is he that talketh with thee.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Itoduaa iyie, naa ninye ele likirorie.”

English: And he said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped him.
Masaai: Nejo ninye, “Olaitoriani, airuko,” neserem ninye.

English: And Jesus said, For judgment I am come into this world, that they which see not might see; and that they which see might be made blind.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Te nkaraki enkiguana pee aewuo nanu enkop, pee edolishoyu lelo lemedolisho, neaku modook iloodolisho.”

English: And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words, and said unto him, Are we blind also?
Masaai: Nening ele rorei kulikae Farisayo ooboitare nejo, “Eikira sii iyiook modook?”

English: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Te naa naaji irara modook anaata miatata eng'oki. Ore enatiu, ijojo, ‘Kidolisho;’ nebik enkitarruoroto inyi.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold, but climbeth up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.
Masaai: “Esipa esipa, ajoki intae, ore elde lemeimu kishomi ejing emuatata, kake dikae ekedu aimu, olapurroni naa olaisimani,

English: But he that entereth in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
Masaai: kake ore ilo oimu kishomi ninye olchekut loo nkerra.

English: To him the porter openeth; and the sheep hear his voice: and he calleth his own sheep by name, and leadeth them out.
Masaai: Naa ninye ebolu olarriponi; nening nkerra oltoilo lenye; neipot inkerra enyena too nkarn enye nerik auluo.

English: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aitupuku nkerra enyena pooki nerik ninche, nesuj inkerra ninye; amu keyiolo oltoilo lenye.

English: And a stranger will they not follow, but will flee from him: for they know not the voice of strangers.
Masaai: Mesuj olomoni, kake keituria amu meyiolo oltoilo loo lomon.”

English: This parable spake Jesus unto them: but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them.
Masaai: Etolikio Yesu ninche ena kitanyaanyukoto, kake eitu eyiolou ninche enatiaaka.

English: Then said Jesus unto them again, Verily, verily, I say unto you, I am the door of the sheep.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu ajoki nchere, “Esipa, esipa ajoki intae, ara nanu kishomi oo nkerra.

English: All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.
Masaai: Ore pooki ooiturukutuo te dukuya nanu naa lapurrok o laisimak, kake eitu ening inkerra ninche.

English: I am the door: by me if any man enter in, he shall be saved, and shall go in and out, and find pasture.
Masaai: Ara nanu kishomi; ore olaaimu nanu keitajeuni, nejing atua nepuku netum endaata.

English: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
Masaai: Melotu olapurroni mme kelotu apurroo neiyieng neitarruoo. Aewuo nanu pee etum aanoto enkishui, netum te nkiputakinoto.

English: I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.
Masaai: Ara nanu olchekut supat. Eitayu olchekut supat enkishui enye te nkaraki oo nkerra.

English: But he that is an hireling, and not the shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, seeth the wolf coming, and leaveth the sheep, and fleeth: and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep.
Masaai: Ore olchekut oigero, leme olopeny inkerra, edolu osuyiani elotu, neing'uaa nkerra aisik, neibung osuyiani ninche, neisardaikie.

English: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
Masaai: Amu ore olchekut oigeroki nemeetayie tipat inkerra.

English: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine.
Masaai: Ara nanu olchekut supat; nayiolo inaainei, naayiolo sii nanu inaainei,

English: As the Father knoweth me, even so know I the Father: and I lay down my life for the sheep.
Masaai: anaa enaayiolo Papa, nayiolo sii nanu Papa; naa kaitayu nanu enkishui ai te nkaraki oo nkerra.

English: And other sheep I have, which are not of this fold: them also I must bring, and they shall hear my voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd.
Masaai: Naata sii kulie kerra, neme ine na muatata. Meeta kata nemareu sii ninche naa kening oltoilo lai, naa keaku emboo nabo, o lchekut obo.

English: Therefore doth my Father love me, because I lay down my life, that I might take it again.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena pee aanyor Papa, amu kaitayu enkishui ai, pee aitoki adumu.

English: No man taketh it from me, but I lay it down of myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. This commandment have I received of my Father.
Masaai: Meetae olaaoru enkishui ai, kake kaitayu openy te yieunoto ai. Aata enkidimata pee aitayu, naata enkidimata naitoki ang'amunye. Papa atangamayie ena kitanapata.”

English: There was a division therefore again among the Jews for these sayings.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ajing eoro atua. Lyahudi te nkaraki kulo rorei.

English: And many of them said, He hath a devil, and is mad; why hear ye him?
Masaai: Nejo ilkumok lenye, “Keeta oloirirua netijing'aki. Oo pee ining'ining'i?”

English: Others said, These are not the words of him that hath a devil. Can a devil open the eyes of the blind?
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, “Mme loata oloirirua kulo rorei. Keidim oloirirua atabolo nkonyek oo lmodook?”

English: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
Masaai: Neetae apa osirua le Nkitisinyata te Yerusalem, naa te nkata e nkirobi;

English: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.
Masaai: neloolo Yesu to nkaji e Nkai, to lgoriet le Solomon.

English: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
Masaai: Neman Ilyahudi ninye nejoki, “O anu kenya ing'ashing'ashieshie iyiook? Te naa iyie Kristo toliki iyiook imbalakinye.”

English: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Atolikio intae neitu irukuruku; isiaaitin naas te nkarna e Papa, kuna naaishakenoki nanu;

English: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
Masaai: kake mirukuruku intae, amu mirara loo nkerra aainei, anaa enatiaaka intae.

English: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:
Masaai: Kening inkerra aainei oltoilo lai, nayiolo ninche, naa kaasuj ninche,

English: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
Masaai: naa kaisho ninche enkishui nemeish, nemeimin ninche ntarasi, nemetii olaaidim aikonyarie ninche aitung'uaa enkaina ai.

English: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.
Masaai: Ore Papa laaishoo nanu ninche naa kitok te pooki, nemetii hoo oloidim aikonyai te nkaina e Papa.

English: I and my Father are one.
Masaai: Kira nabo nanu o Papa.”

English: Then the Jews took up stones again to stone him.
Masaai: Neitoki Ilyahudi aadumu soito aanang ninye.

English: Jesus answered them, Many good works have I shewed you from my Father; for which of those works do ye stone me?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninche. “Aitoduaa intae isiaaitin kumok naaing'uaa Papa lai. Kaa nabo te kuna siaaitin kinang'ieng'ie nanu too soito?”

English: The Jews answered him, saying, For a good work we stone thee not; but for blasphemy; and because that thou, being a man, makest thyself God.
Masaai: Newaliki Lyahudi aajoki, “Mikinang iyie too soito te siaai supat, kake te nkaraki nitamoro Enkai, o te nkaraki nintaa iyie kewan Enkai, nira oltung'ani.”

English: Jesus answered them, Is it not written in your law, I said, Ye are gods?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Aimesira ti atua Nkitanapat inyi nchere, ‘Atejo irara nkaitin?’

English: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;
Masaai: Amaa te netejo ninche nkaitin, lelo ootabaikia ororei le Nkai, nemeidimi aaiwuang'ie ilkigerot,

English: Say ye of him, whom the Father hath sanctified, and sent into the world, Thou blasphemest; because I said, I am the Son of God?
Masaai: nijokiki intae oloitisinyua Papa, neirriu enkop, ‘Itamoro Enkai,’ enkaraki natejo, ‘Ara nanu Enkerai e Nkai?’

English: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.
Masaai: Te nemaas isiaaitin e Papa, emikiruk;

English: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
Masaai: kake te naas ninche, ore hoo ti nimikirukuruku nanu eruko nena siaaitin, pee imusoso niyiolouu aajo etii Papa atua nanu natii nanu atua Papa.”

English: Therefore they sought again to take him: but he escaped out of their hand,
Masaai: Neitoki ake aaing'oru eneibung'ie ninye; kake etuluarie ninye ninche.

English: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized; and there he abode.
Masaai: Neitoki alo lido kekun le Yordan ewueji neibatisishore apa Yohana te nkiterunoto; neton te ine.

English: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
Masaai: Nepuo ilkumok enetii ninye; nejo, “Eitu eas Yohana olmonekie kake ore pooki natejo Yohana eimaki ele tung'ani kesipa.”

English: And many believed on him there.
Masaai: Neiruk iltung'ana kumok ninye te ine.

English: Now a certain man was sick, named Lazarus, of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
Masaai: Etii apa oltung'ani obo omuei, oji Lasaro le Betania, le nkang oo Mariamu enkanashe Marisa.

English: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
Masaai: Enapa Mariamu naelie Olaitoriani eilata narropil nejut nkejek too lpapit lenyena, ninye emuei olalashe lenye Lasaro.

English: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
Masaai: Neirriwaki taa nkanashera olkilikuai ejo, “Lo Kitok, ng'urai, emuei oloshi linyor.”

English: When Jesus heard that, he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Yesu ina nejo, “Mme ene keeya ena mueyian, kake ene nkitoo e Nkai, paa ore te ina neitaae kitok Enkerai e Nkai.”

English: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
Masaai: Nenyor apa Yesu Marisa o enkanashe o Lasaro.

English: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
Masaai: Ore pee ening inchere emuei, nebik nkolong'i are te ine netii;

English: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
Masaai: ore pee eidipayu nena, nejoki ninye ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Enyeito manyaai Yudea.”

English: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
Masaai: Nejoki looiteng'eni lenyena, “Rabbi king'oru det Ilyahudi aar too soito; nintoki ake aito ine?”

English: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ai mera saai e ndama tomon o are? Ore te nelo oltung'ani dama nemerrorro, amu edol ewang'an ena kop.

English: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
Masaai: Kake te nelo oltung'ani kewarie nerrorro amu metii ewang'an atua ninye.”

English: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo kuna baa, neitoki ajoki ninche, “Eirure olchore lang Lasaro; kake kalo pee alo ainyeyie ninye.”

English: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Lo Kitok, te naa keirure ninye, keishiu.”

English: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
Masaai: Naa dolita enaimaka Yesu, enkeeya enye. Kake nejo ninche enkirurata oo njo eimaka.

English: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
Masaai: Neliki taa Yesu ninche aibalakinye nejoki, “Etua Lasaro,

English: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
Masaai: nang'ida nanu te nkaraki intae inchere matii ine, pee itumutumu aairuko. Kake enyeito maape enetii ninye.”

English: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
Masaai: Nejoki Tomas oji Olmaoi lkulikae ooiteng'eni, “Emaape sii yiook pee kiye te nebo ninye.”

English: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Yesu nenyorriki etobiko Lasaro te nkurare nkolong'i ong'uan.

English: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
Masaai: Naa ketaaniki Betania Yerusalem, enyikaki mail are.

English: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
Masaai: Neetuo ltung'ana kumok loo Lyahudi enetii Marisa o Mariamu o aaitigir tenkaraki lo lalashe lenye.

English: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Marisa nchere elotu Yesu nelo anang'are; kake etotona Mariamu ti aji.

English: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
Masaai: Nejoki taa Marisa Yesu, “Lo Kitok, te naa itii apa ene anaata eitu eye olalashe lai.

English: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
Masaai: Kake ore o taata, ayiolo ajo ore embae pooki niomonu te Nkai, aikincho iyie.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Kepiu olalashe lino aitoki.”

English: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
Masaai: Nejoki Marisa, “Ayiolo ajo keitoki apiu te mpiunoto e nkiting'oto.”

English: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Ara nanu empiunoto nara enkishui. Ore ilo laairuk nanu, ore ninye te neye, neishu;

English: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
Masaai: ore pooki oishu laairuk nanu nemeye ntarasi Iruko iyie kuna?”

English: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Ee Olaitoriani, airuko nchere ira Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai nalotu enkop.”

English: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, nelo arojaa enkanashe enye Mariamu, arik enkilepata ajoki, “Eewuo Olaiteng'enani nikimpot.”

English: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Mariamu ina neinyototo asioki nelotu enetii.

English: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
Masaai: Neton eitu ejing Yesu ina ang kake eton etii enaduoo wueji netii pee enang'are Marisa.

English: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
Masaai: Ore Ilyahudi ootii aji te nebo ninye aaitigir, pee edol Mariamu einyototo asioki neipang, nesuj ejo, “Enkurare elo aishir te ine.”

English: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
Masaai: Ore pee elotu Mariamu enetii Yesu nedol nebatata too nkejek enyena nejoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa itii apa ene anaata eitu eye olalashe lai.”

English: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ninye eishir, neishir sii Lyahudi ooiriamunore, nenyamalu to ltau lenye netum osina,

English: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
Masaai: nejo, “Ai ti aji irragie?” Nejoki ninche, “Lo Kitok, wou toduaa.”

English: Jesus wept.
Masaai: Neishir Yesu.

English: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
Masaai: Nejo taa Lyahudi, “Eng'ura eneba enyorrata nanyor ninye!”

English: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
Masaai: Kake etejo kulikae lenye, “Ai meidim apa ninye, olotabolo nkonyek o lapa tung'ani modooni, ataasa ai pee meye ele tung'ani?”

English: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
Masaai: Neitoki Yesu aisinanuo, nebaiki enkurare. Enkapune ina kurare, neigarakino osoit.

English: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Ewuang'ie osoit.” Ore Marisa, enkanashe lido otua, nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, etong'ua taata, amu nkolong'i ong'uan anaa neye.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Keitu duoo aajoki ti niruk iyie nidol enkitoo e Nkai?”

English: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
Masaai: Neaku, eiwuang'ie ninche osoit te idie neirragie olotua; nedumu Yesu nkonyek aing'or shumata nejo, “Papa aaisho enashe amu kitoning'o.

English: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
Masaai: Nayiolo nanu makewan ajo kining oshi ake; kake te nkaraki ele orere laamanita pee atejo nji, pee etum aairuko nchere iyie likirriwua.”

English: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, nebuak ninye to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Lasaro tupuku boo.”

English: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
Masaai: Nepuku lido otua, neena nkaik o nkejek too nkarash naanukarieki ltung'ana; neena enkomom enye te nkarasha. Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Entalak ninchosho ninye meshomo.”

English: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
Masaai: Ore lkumok loo Lyahudi, ooetuo tenebo Mariamu, pee edol kuna baa naataasa Yesu, neiruk ninye,

English: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
Masaai: kake eshomo kulikae enetii Lfarisayo neliki enataasa Yesu.

English: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
Masaai: Neaku eipoto ilapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo, entumo e Nkiguana nejo, “Kaa kiaas iyiook? Amu easita ele tung'ani ilmonek kumok.

English: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
Masaai: Tinikipalaa iyiook ninye etiu nji, neiruk pooki ninye, neyooki Ilroma aapuonu aaidaikie ene wueji ang sinyati neidaikie olorere lang.”

English: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
Masaai: Ore Kaiafas, obo lenye, laa ninye Olapolosani Kitok te ilo ari nejoki ninche, “Miyiololo intae toki

English: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
Masaai: nimidamishosho aajo keikash te yiook te nenang oltung'ani obo olosho pee meidaaya olorere olulung'a.”

English: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
Masaai: Kake eitu ejo ninye nena te ngolon enye makewan; kake te nkaraki nara ninye Olapolosani Kitok te ilo ari nelimu ajo kenang Yesu ilo orere,

English: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
Masaai: neme ilo orere ake kake keji sii pee eiturrurru nkera e Nkai pooki naaisardaka aitaa nabo.

English: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
Masaai: Neaku ore ebaiki ina olong nemut enkiguana pee ear Yesu.

English: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina neitu eitoki Yesu aibalie kewan aloolo ti atua Lyahudi, kake eshomo enkalo e nkop nanyikita ong'ata, nelo enkanasa naji Efraim, nebik te ine te nebo ilooiteng'eni lenyena.

English: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
Masaai: Netinyikua Pasaka oo Lyahudi, neilep ilkumok aapuo Yerusalem eing'uaa ina kop eton eitu ebau Pasaka, pee epuo aaipok ate.

English: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
Masaai: Neing'oru Yesu, ejokino maate eitashe to hekalo, “Aijojo aa? Eji melotu tukul ele sirua?”

English: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it, that they might take him.
Masaai: Ore lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo neitanapishe paa tenetii oltung'ani oyiolo enetii, neitayiolo ninche, pee etum aaibung'a ninye.

English: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
Masaai: Ore eng'or inkolong'i ile pee ebau Pasaka, nelotu Yesu Betania, enetii Lasaro, ilo oitopiwuo Yesu aitung'uaa keeya.

English: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
Masaai: Neitobiraki ninche ninye endaa e teipa te ine neisiaaisho Marisa; ore Lasaro naa obo le lelo ootonita te ndaa te nebo ninye.

English: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
Masaai: Neitayu taa Mariamu orratili le ilata narropil e nardo, nagol enkinyang'a, neyelie nkejek e Yesu, nejut nkejek too lpapit lenyena. Neiput enkaji erropili e ina ilata.

English: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
Masaai: Nejo Yudas Iskariot, obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena, (ilo oyooki akaldaa)

English: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
Masaai: “Oo pee eitu emiri ena ilata narropil aainosie dinarii iip uni neishori laisinak.”

English: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
Masaai: Ore pee etejo neijia, mme nkaraki naing'urrie laisinak, kake enkaraki naa olapurroni ninye nenapita olbene loo mpesai, neya nena naapik ine.

English: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
Masaai: Nejo Yesu, “Tapala; aaitobiraka ena te nkaraki enkolong enukaroto ai;

English: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
Masaai: amu ore laisinak iatata anaa ake te nebo intae, kake mikiaaata nanu anaa ake.”

English: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou esiamo kitok oo Lyahudi aajo etii ninye ine nepuonu kake mme te nkaraki Yesu ake, kake eetuo sii aadol Lasaro, oitopiwuo aitung'uaa keeya.

English: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
Masaai: Neiguanate lapolosak kituaak eyieu near sii Lasaro metua.

English: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
Masaai: Amu ore te nkaraki ninye etoorori Lyahudi kumok aairuk Yesu.

English: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita, nening ina siamo kitok naewuo osirua nchere elotu Yesu Yerusalem.

English: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
Masaai: Nedumu lng'osil loo ltuka nepuo aanang'are ninye. Nebuakita aajo, “Hosana! Emayiana ilo olotu te nkarna o Laitoriani. Laa Olaiguanani le Israel!”
