English: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
Masaai: Ore pee etum Yesu olkurrarru netonie; anaa enatisiraki aajo,

English: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.
Masaai: “Miureisho, na tito e Sion! ing'ura, elotu olaiguanani lino, ekedito olkurrarru le sikiria.”

English: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
Masaai: Neitu eyiolou ilooiteng'eni lenyena kuna baa te dukuya, kake ore pee eidipi aaitaa Yesu kitok, nedamu ninche ina kata nchere etisiraki kuna baa te nkaraki ninye, naa kuna eitaasa ninche ninye.

English: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
Masaai: Ore ina siamo naboitare netolimutuo pee eipot Lasaro metung'uai enkurare eitopiu aitung'uaa lootuata.

English: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
Masaai: Enkaraki ina sii pee eshomo ina siamo anang'are amu etoning'o aajo etaasa ele monekie.

English: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
Masaai: Nejokino Lfarisayo maate, “Idolitata taa aajo mitumutumu toki. Eng'urai, eirukurukore enkop pooki ninye.”

English: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
Masaai: Naa Ilyunani kulikae ooetuo aaseremisho te ilo sirua.

English: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo nepuonu lelo enetii Filipo le Betsaida te Galilaya, neikilikuan ninye nejoki, “Lo Kitok, aikiyieu nikidol Yesu.”

English: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
Masaai: Nelotu Filipo neliki Andrea; nepuonu Andrea o Filipo neliki Yesu.

English: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche nejoki, “Etabawua esaa pee eitaae kitok Enkerai e Tung'ani.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, te neitu edoiki enkantererai e nkano enkop neye, nebik aa ninye ake openy; kake te neye, neiu ilng'anayio kumok.

English: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
Masaai: Ore olonyor enkishui enye neiminie, ore oloibayu enkishui enye te nkop nerrip ti atua enkishui nemeish.

English: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
Masaai: Te naaisiaai oltung'ani nanu, inchoo aairukurukore, ore enatii nanu neaku ine etii sii olaisiaayiani lai. Ore pooki ng'ae laaisiaai, neyanyitu Papa ninye.

English: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
Masaai: “Aatanyamala oltau lai taata, naa kajo aa? Kajo ‘Papa intajeuoki te na saa?’ Kake te nkaraki ena bae e mion pee atabaikia ena saa.

English: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
Masaai: Papa, intaa kitok enkarna ino.” Nelotu oltoilo oing'uaa shumata, “Aitaa kitok, naa kaigil aitaa kitok.”

English: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
Masaai: Ore ina siamo naitashe te ine, nening nejo etadara. Nejo kulikae, “Olmalaika oirorie ninye.”

English: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejo, “Mme te nkaraki nanu pee eewuo ele toilo, kake te nkaraki intae.

English: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
Masaai: Taata enkiguana e na kop; taata earari olaitoriani le na kop aaitupuku.

English: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
Masaai: Te naailepieki nanu te nkop nayietu iltung'ana pooki enatii.”

English: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
Masaai: Netejo ninye ena eutu ajo kaa keeya eye ninye.

English: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
Masaai: Newaliki esiamo aajoki, “Kitoning'o too nkitanapat nchere ebik Kristo ntarasi; oo naa pee ijo iyie meeta nchere pee meilepieki Enkerai e Tung'ani. Ai ng'ae doi ena Kerai e Tung'ani?”

English: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Enkiti kata eton etii ena wang'an atua intae. Enchom eton iatata ina wang'an, pee meidimu intae enaimin, ore ilo olo te naimin nemeyiolo enelo.

English: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
Masaai: Ore eton iatata ewang'an, eruko ina wang'an, pee itumutumu aataa nkera e wang'an.” Ore pee ejo Yesu kuna baa nelo aisudori pee medol ninche.

English: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
Masaai: Ore hoo netaasa ilmonek kumok etii ninche eitu eiruk ninche ninye,

English: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
Masaai: pee eitabari ororei lo loiboni le Nkai Isaya otejo, “Olaitoriani aing'ae oiruko elikioroto ang? Naa aing'ae etabolokoki enkaina e Nkai?”

English: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
Masaai: Te ina eitu eidim ninche aairuko amu enyaaka sii Isaya ajo,

English: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
Masaai: “Eitamodoo nkonyek enye, neitagol iltauja lenye, pee medol ake too nkonyek enye, neyiolou too ltauja lenye, neibelekenya, pee aishiunye.”

English: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
Masaai: Netejo Isaya kuna baa amu etoduaa enkitoo enye nelimu mbaa enyena.

English: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
Masaai: Kake ore etiu neijia, eiruko ilkumok loo lkituaak, kake ore te nkaraki Ilfarisayo, eitu eibalunye pee merishieki enkaji e ntumo;

English: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
Masaai: amu etonyorra enkisisa oo ltung'ana aaitalang enkisisa e Nkai.

English: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
Masaai: Nebuak Yesu ajo, “Ore olaairuk nanu mme nanu eiruk kake lido laairriwua eiruko;

English: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
Masaai: ore olaaing'or nanu eing'orita lido laairriwua;

English: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
Masaai: aewuo nanu pee aaku ewang'an e nkop paa ore pooki laairuk nanu nemeton ti atua enaimin.

English: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
Masaai: Te nening oltung'ani irorei laainei nemeibung nemaiguanare nanu ninye, amu eitu alotu pee aiguanare enkop, kake pee aitajeu enkop.

English: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
Masaai: Ore ilo laany nanu, nemeng'amu irorei laainei, neeta oloiguanare. Ilo rorei lairoro oiguanare ninye te nkolong e nkiting'oto;

English: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
Masaai: amu eitu airo nanu makewan; kake Papa laairriwua, ninye openy laaishoo enkitanapata e nena najo o nena nalimu.

English: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
Masaai: Nayiolo nanu nchere ore enkitanapata enye naa empuaan oo ntarasi; metaa ore nena najo nanu, naa inaatiaaka Papa ninche alimu.”

English: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
Masaai: Ore eton engor enkolong osirua oji le Pasaka, etayiolo Yesu ajo etabawua esaa enye nalotie aing'uaa ena kop, alo enetii Papa. Netonyorra lelo lenyena ootii enkop, netonyorra ninche metabaiki enkiting'oto.

English: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him;
Masaai: Ore einosita endaa, neidipa oloirirua atijing'a oltau le Yudas Iskariot, enkerai e Simon, nchere pee ekaldaa.

English: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ajo eishoo Papa enkaina enye pooki toki, neyiolo ajo enetii Enkai eing'uaa naa enetii Enkai eito.

English: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
Masaai: Neinyototo aing'uaa endaa, neirragie nkilani enyena, nerrapu enkarasha arreten kewan.

English: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
Masaai: Nebukoki enkare embesen neiteru aisuj inkejek oo looiteng'eni nejut te nkarasha narretenare.

English: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
Masaai: Nelotu enetii Simon Petero. Nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, aa inkejek aainei intuku?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
Masaai: Neng'amaa Yesu ajoki ninye, “Ore enaasita nimiyiolo iyie taata kake iyooki ayiolou te siadi.”

English: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Mikintuku nkejek aainei ai kata!” Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Te neitu aaisuj iyie, nimira ole nkalo ai.”

English: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon Petero ninye, “Lo Kitok, mme naa nkejek aainei ake, kake o nkaik o endukuya ai.”

English: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninye, “Ore oloidipa aitukuoyu meitoki ayieu enkitukuo meteleku nkejek enyena, tuan pooki wueji enye, nirara intae tuani, kake mme intae pooki;”

English: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
Masaai: amu keyiolo apa olokaldaa. Ina pee etejo, “Mirara tuani intae pooki.”

English: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aitukuo nkejek enye neishopo nkilani neitoki aton, nejoki ninche, “Aiyiololo enaitaasa intae?

English: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
Masaai: Kijojo intae nanu, ‘Lo Aiteng'enani’, o ‘Lo Kitok’ nitisipa amu kara.

English: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.
Masaai: Omaa te naituku nanu intae Olkitok, nara Olaiteng'enani nkejek inyi, keishiaakino sii ninche intae neituku olikae olikae nkejek.

English: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
Masaai: Aishoo intae enkitanyaanyukoto, paa ore ena naitaasa intae, nintaasasa sii intae,

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
Masaai: esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, mme kitok orrindik to lkitok lenye, neme kitok oloipaayioki to loipaayie.

English: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
Masaai: Ti niyiololo kuna baa, imayianana ti niaasiasa.

English: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
Masaai: Mme intae pooki aimaki. Ayiolo ilo lategelua; kake nchoo eitabari lkigerot oojo, ‘Ore ilo oinosa emukate ai aatudumaka entutunyo enye aagilunore nanu.’

English: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki taata, aliki intae eton eitu eaku, pee te neaku, nirukuruku nchere, Ara nanu.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ore olong'amu pooki ng'ae lairriwaa, nanu eng'amu, ore olaang'amu naa ilo laairriwua eng'amu.”

English: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu atejo neijia, nenyamalu to ltau nejo, “Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, kaakaldaa obo linyi nanu.”

English: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
Masaai: Neing'urung'ura ilooiteng'eni maate amu meyiolo aajo kalo eimaki.

English: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
Masaai: Neirishakino olgoo le Yesu, obo loo looiteng'eni onyor Yesu.

English: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
Masaai: Neyuk Simon Petero te nkaina nejoki, “Nkilikuana tiaaki ai ng'ae eimaki.”

English: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
Masaai: Neirishakino olgoo le Yesu nejoki ninye, “Lo Kitok, aing'ae?”

English: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ilo laisho endung'oti aidipa aitadoiki.” Ore pee eidip aitadoiki, neitayu neisho Yudas Iskariot olayioni le Simon.

English: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yudas atang'amai endung'oti nejing Shetani atua ninye. Neaku etiaka Yesu ninye, “Tasioki taasa eniaas.”

English: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
Masaai: Nemetii te lelo ooinosita endaa, oloyiolo ajo aainyo pee etiaka neijia.

English: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
Masaai: Nejo kulikae, amu Yudas apa onap olbene loo mpesai, eji ketiaaka Yesu, “Inyang'u ntokitin nikiyieu to sirua,” aashu etiaka meishoo laisinak toki.

English: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amaa ninye endung'oti neipang nabo kata; naa kewarie.

English: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yudas aipung'o boo nejo Yesu, “Eitaaki taa kitok Enkerai e Tung'ani, neitaaki Enkai kitok ti atua ninye.

English: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
Masaai: Te neitaaki Enkai kitok ti atua ninye, keitaa sii ninye Enkai ninye kitok ti atua kewan, naa taata inji eitaa ninye kitok.

English: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
Masaai: Nkera aainei, eng'or enkiti kata eton aboitare intae. Eikiyookiki aaing'oru nanu, naa ore anaa enatiaaka Lyahudi, ‘Ore ine nalo mindimidimi aaetu,’ neijia sii ajoki intae taata.

English: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
Masaai: Aisho intae enkitanapata ng'ejuk, entonyorrata anaa enatonyorra nanu intae.

English: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
Masaai: Te ina eyiolou pooki aajo, irara looiteng'eni laainei, ti niatata enyorrata olikae o likae.”

English: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon Petero ninye, “Lo Kitok, kaji ilo?” Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ore enalo, nimikindim atusuju taata, kake eikisuju te siadi.”

English: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Lo Kitok, Aainyo pee maaidim atusuju taata? Ekaitayu enkishui ai te nkaraki iyie.”

English: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki ninye, “Eji intayu enkishui ino te nkaraki nanu? Esipa, esipa, aajoki, meru olkuku eitu kimiki iyie katitin uni.

English: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
Masaai: “Emincho enyamalu iltauja linyi, eruko Enkai nikirukuruku sii nanu.

English: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
Masaai: Etii enkaji e Papa ilgilat kumok amaa, te neme neijia etiu kanaata atiaaka intae, amu kalo aitobiraki intae ewueji?

English: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
Masaai: Naa te nalo aitobiraki intae ewueji, naitoki ashukunye, naa karikoki intae kewan paa ore enatii nitii sii intae.

English: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
Masaai: Ore enalo, iyiololo intae enkoitoi.”

English: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
Masaai: Nejoki Tomas ninye, “Lo Kitok mikiyiolo enilo; kaji kinko ti nikiyiolou enkoitoi?”

English: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Ara nanu enkoitoi o esipata, o enkishui. Metii oltung'ani olotu enetii Papa mme nanu eimayie.

English: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
Masaai: Te naa aikitayioloito nanu, anaata iyiololo sii Papa. Ore ebaiki taata iyiololo ninye; nitoduaa ninye.”

English: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
Masaai: Nejoki Filipo ninye, “Lo Kitok, intoduaa iyiook Papa, amu eidip iyiook.”

English: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then, Shew us the Father?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Kaboitare oshi intae ena kata pooki, neton ake mikiyiolo iyie Filipo? Ore olaatoduaa nanu netoduaa Papa: aainyo pee itejo intoduaa iyiook Papa?

English: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
Masaai: Ai miruk inchere atii nanu atua Papa netii Papa atua nanu? Ore irorei laliki intae malimu te nkitoria ai makewan, kake Papa oton ti atua nanu oas isiaaitin enyena.

English: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.
Masaai: Irukoki inchere atii nanu atua Papa, netii Papa atua nanu: aashu naa kiruk te nkaraki oo siaaitin ate.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, aajoki, ore elde laairuk nanu, ore kuna siaaitin naas neas ninye, naa keas isapuki naalang kuna amu kalo enetii Papa;

English: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
Masaai: naa ore pooki niomonunu te nkarna ai, ina aas, pee etumi aaterrep Papa te nkaraki Enkerai.

English: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
Masaai: Ti nikiomonono entoki te nkarna ai naa kaas ina.

English: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
Masaai: “Te naa aikinyorrinyorro nanu nimbung'ubung'u nkitanapat aainei;

English: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
Masaai: naa kaomon nanu Papa, naa keisho intae likae Autaroni metobiko te nebo intae intarasi;

English: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
Masaai: laa Enkiyang'et e sipata, lemeng'amu enkop amu medol ninye nemeyiolo ninye. Iyiololo intae ninye amu keton ti atua intae, netii atua intae.

English: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
Masaai: “Maing'uaa intae irara okishin; kalotu enitii.

English: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
Masaai: Eng'or enkiti kata pee maaitoki adol ena kop, kake kidolitata intae nanu, ore amu kaishu ninchushu sii intae.

English: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong niyiolouu intae aajo atii atua Papa, nitii intae atua nanu, nanu natii atua intae.

English: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
Masaai: Ore oloata nkitanapat aainei, neibung ninche, ninye laanyor; naa ore olaanyor kenyorru Papa ninye, naa kanyorru nanu ninye. Naa kaibalakinye kewan ninye.”

English: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
Masaai: Nejoki Yudas ninye kake mme Iskariot, “Kaji inko lo Kitok, ti niboloki iyiook kewan, nimiboloki enkop?”

English: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Te naanyor oltung'ani nanu, keibung ororei lai, naa kenyorru Papa ninye, naa aikipuonu enetii ninye nikimany nebo o ninye.

English: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.
Masaai: Ore olemaanyor nanu, nemeibung irorei laainei, ore ele rorei lining'ining'i neme olalai kake ole Papa laairriwua.

English: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
Masaai: “Atolikio intae kuna baa, eton aboitare intae.

English: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
Masaai: Kake lido Autaroni, ora Enkiyang'et Sinyati oirriu Papa te nkarna ai, oitayiolo intae imbaa pooki neitadamu intae nena pooki natolikio intae.

English: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
Masaai: Atung'eikia intae eseriani, aishoo intae eseriani ai. Aisho intae neme anaa enaishoru enkop. Emincho ltauja linyi enyamalu; emincho eureishoyu.

English: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
Masaai: Itoning'o enatiaaka intae ajo, ‘Kalo, naa kashukokino intae.’ Te naa napaji ai kinyorrinyorro anaata ing'idada nchere enetii Papa alo, amu kitok Papa te nanu.

English: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
Masaai: Ore o taata, atolikio intae eton eitu eaku, pee te neaku nirukuruku.

English: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
Masaai: Meekure aitoki airorie intae oleng, amu elotu olkitok le na kop, kake meeta engolon te shumata nanu,

English: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
Masaai: kake aas nanu anaa enaaitanapa papa pee etum enkop atayiolo nchere kanyor nanu Papa. Enyeito emaape te ne.

English: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
Masaai: “Ara osabibu odede, naa Papa olaramatani.

English: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
Masaai: Ore olng'osila ti atua nanu lemeiu lng'anayio, neiwuang'ie ninye, ore olng'osila pooki oiu lng'anayio, neitobir metisidana, peyie eiu lng'anayio kumok.

English: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
Masaai: Neitaaki taata intae sidain te nkaraki o rorei latiaaka intae.

English: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
Masaai: Entotoni ti atua nanu anaa te naton ti atua intae. Ore anaa enemeidim olng'osila otoiu lng'anayio makewan, te nemetii olchani, mindimidimi sii intae ti ni mitonini ti atua nanu.

English: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
Masaai: Nanu osabibu; intae ilng'osil. Ore oloton ti atua nanu, anaa te naton sii nanu ti atua ninye, neiu lng'anayio kumok, amu ore matii nanu mindimidimi intae aataas toki.

English: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
Masaai: Te nemeton oltung'ani ti atua nanu nenang'ari boo anaa olng'osila, netoyu, nesotu iltung'ana ninche nenang'akini enkima, metapejo.

English: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
Masaai: Ti nitonini intae ti atua nanu, neton ororei lai ti atua intae, entoomonu entoki pooki niyieuu naa keitaasi intae.

English: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
Masaai: Te ina errepi Papa, inchere iatata lng'anayio kumok, niakuku taa ilooiteng'eni laainei.

English: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaatonyorra Papa, atonyorra sii nanu intae. Entotoni ti atua enyorrata ai.

English: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.
Masaai: Tinimbung'ubung'u intae nkitanapat aainei, na aitonini ti atua enyorrata ai, anaa enaibung'a nkitanapat e Papa naton ti atua enyorrata enye.

English: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
Masaai: Atolikio intae kuna baa pee etum eng'ida ai atotona ti atua intae, pee etum eng'ida inyi ataboreyia.

English: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
Masaai: Ena enkitanapata ai, inchere tonyorra olikae anaa enatonyorra nanu intae.

English: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
Masaai: Meetae oloata enyorrata sapuk nalang ena, eji aitayu oltung'ani enkishui enye te nkaraki lchoreta lenyena.

English: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
Masaai: Irara intae lchoreta laainei ti niaasiasa pooki ake bae naitanapa intae.

English: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
Masaai: Maitoki ajo intae isinkan, amu meyiolo osinka enaasita olkitok lenye; kake atejo intae ilchoreta, amu atolikio intae pooki natoning'o te Papa.

English: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
Masaai: Mme intae likitegelutua nanu kake kategelua intae naitanap intae enchom entoiu ilng'anayio, nebik ilng'anayio linyi, paa ore pooki niomonono Papa te nkarna ai, neisho, intae.

English: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
Masaai: Ena aitanap intae, inchere entonyorrata.

English: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
Masaai: “Te neibayu intae enkop, entayiolo nchere nanu etang'asa aibayu eton eitu eibayu intae.

English: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
Masaai: Te naa irara le nkop, naa anaata enyor enkop ilenyena; kake mirara ile nkop, amu ategelua intae aitung'uaa enkop, te nkaraki e ina pee eiba intae enkop.

English: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
Masaai: Entadamu ilo rorei latiaaka intae, ‘Mme kitok osinka to lkitok lenye.’ Te naaisilisilo nanu keisilisil sii ninche intae; te neibung'a ororei lai, keibung sii ninche intae; te neibung'a ororei lai, keibung sii ninye olinyi.

English: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.
Masaai: Kake keitaas intae kuna baa pooki te nkaraki enkarna ai, amu meyiolo ninche ilo laairriwua.

English: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
Masaai: Te neitu apa alotu airorie ninche, anaata meeta eng'oki; kake meekure taata eeta eneitolonyaki te ng'oki enye.

English: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
Masaai: Ore olaaiba nanu neiba sii ninye Papa.

English: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
Masaai: Te neitu apa aas ti atua ninche isiaaitin neitu eas likae, anaata meeta eng'oki; ore taata netoduaa naaibayu nanu o Papa lai.

English: But this cometh to pass, that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
Masaai: Kake ororei oigeroki ti atua nkitanapat enye eitabari, ‘Aaibaitie nanu pesho'.

English: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
Masaai: Ore te nelotu olautaroni, Enkiyang'et e sipata, olotu aing'uaa papa intae oing'uaa Papa ninye laaishakenoki nanu;

English: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
Masaai: niraa sii intae ilchakenini, amu ore ebaiki enkiterunoto kiboitarere intae nanu.

English: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
Masaai: “Atolikio intae kuna baa pooki pee merrorri intae.

English: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
Masaai: Kearaa intae aaipung'ie too nkajijik e ntumo: ee kelotu enkata naa kejo pooki ng'ae oar intae entuata nedamu ajo ke Nkai eisiaita.

English: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
Masaai: Neitaas intae kuna baa amu eitu eyiolou Enkai aashu nanu.

English: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
Masaai: Kake atolikio intae kuna baa pee te nebau enkata enye, nidamumu ninche nchere atolikio intae. “Neitu aliki intae kuna te nkiterunoto, amu aboitare apa intae.

English: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
Masaai: Kake alo taata enetii lido laairriwua, kake metii obo linyi laaikilikuan ajoki, ‘Kaji ilo?’

English: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
Masaai: Kake ore amu atolikio intae kuna baa, eiputa iltauja linyi osina.

English: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
Masaai: Kake esipata ena naliki intae, intae eret te nalo; amu te neitu alo nemelotu Olautaroni enitii; kake te nalo, nairriwaki intae ninye.

English: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
Masaai: Ore te nelotu ninye neitumus enkop enetii eng'oki o esipata o enkiguana;

English: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
Masaai: te ng'oki amu maairuk nanu.

English: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
Masaai: Too sipat amu kalo enetii Papa nimikintokiki aadol:

English: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
Masaai: te nkiguana amu eiguanareki olkitok le na kop.

English: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
Masaai: “Eton aata mbaa kumok najoki intae, kake mindimaa taata;

English: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
Masaai: kake te nelotu ninye, ina Kiyang'et e sipata nerik intae atua esipata pooki, amu melotu airo anaa makewan, kake enaning pooki elimu, neliki intae imbaa naapuonu.

English: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
Masaai: Naa ninye laaitaa nanu kitok; amu inaainei eng'amu neitodol intae.

English: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
Masaai: Ore nena pooki naata Papa inaainei; ina pee atejo, inaainei; eng'amu neitodol intae.

English: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
Masaai: “Eng'or enkiti kata, pee mikintokiki aadol ore ake sii te nkiti kata, nikintokiki aa dol.”

English: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
Masaai: Nejokino, nejokino ematua oo looiteng'eni, “Kalo rorei ele ojoki ninye iyiook, ‘Enkiti kata, nimikintokiki aadol ore ake sii te nkiti kata nikintokiki aadol?’ Nejo naa, ‘Enkaraki naa kalo enetii Papa?’ ”

English: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
Masaai: Nejo, “Kalo rorei ele ojo, ena ‘kiti kata?’ Mikiyiolo iyiook enajoito.”

English: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
Masaai: Neyiolou Yesu ajo keyieu neikilikuanishore, nejoki ninche, “Kenadoi iyieuu nikinkilikuanana natejo, ‘Eng'or enkiti kata pee mikintokiki aadol, ore ake sii te nkiti kata nikintokiki aadol’?

English: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ainchirishiri niyietutu to sina, kake keng'ida enkop; keinosieki intae osina, kake keibelekenya osina linyi aaku eng'ida.

English: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
Masaai: Ore eisho enkitok neeta osina le mion sapuk amu etabawua enkata enye; kake ore pee eidip atoiu enkerai, meitoki adamu osina te nkaraki eng'ida to ltung'ani otoiwuoki te nkop.

English: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
Masaai: Ore sii intae iatata taata osina; kake kaitoki ake adol intae, neng'ida iltauja linyi, nemetii oltung'ani ooru intae eng'ida inyi.

English: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong mikinkilikuanana nanu toki. Esipa, esipa, ajoki intae, ti niomonunu toki te Papa, neisho intae te nkarna ai.

English: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
Masaai: Ore o taata eton eitu iomonunu toki te nkarna ai; entoomonu, naa itumutumu, pee eboreyu eng'ida inyi.

English: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time cometh, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall shew you plainly of the Father.
Masaai: “Airorie intae too nkitanyaanyukot te kuna baa. Kelotu enkata nemaitoki airorie intae too nkitanyaanyukot, kake kaibalakinye intae aliki imbaa e Papa.

English: At that day ye shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you:
Masaai: Ore te ina olong, niomonono te nkarna ai, nemajoki intae kaomonoki intae te Papa;

English: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
Masaai: amu kenyor ninye Papa openy intae, amu kitonyorra intae nanu niruko nchere kaewuo aing'uaa Enkai.

English: I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.
Masaai: Enetii Papa aing'uaa, nalotu enkop; naa kaitoki aing'uaa enkop alo enetii Papa.”

English: His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speakest thou plainly, and speakest no proverb.
Masaai: Nejoki ilooiteng'eni lenyena, “Aha, iroro taata aibalie, neme te nkitanyaanyukoto iroro.

English: Now are we sure that thou knowest all things, and needest not that any man should ask thee: by this we believe that thou camest forth from God.
Masaai: Kitayioloito taata aajo iyiolo iyie pooki toki, nimikinare nikinkilikuanishore oltung'ani; te na kiruko inchere iewuo iyie aing'uaa Enkai.”

English: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ninche ajoki, “Iruko taata?

English: Behold, the hour cometh, yea, is now come, that ye shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
Masaai: Eng'ura, kelotu enkata, neewuo taata, naisardakieki intae, nelo pooki tung'ani enkang enye, naaing'uari aa nanu ake; kake mme nanu ake, amu aaboitare Papa.

English: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
Masaai: Atolikio intae kuna baa pee iatata osotua ti atua nanu. Iatata osina ti atua ena kop, kake entagoluoto! Atimira nanu enkop!”

English: These words spake Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour is come; glorify thy Son, that thy Son also may glorify thee:
Masaai: Ore pee etejo Yesu kuna baa, neing'orie nkonyek enyena keper, ajo, “Papa etabawua esaa; intaa kitok Enkerai ino pee kintaa sii Enkerai ino iyie kitok.

English: As thou hast given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as thou hast given him.
Masaai: Amu inchoo meitoria pooki tung'ani pee eisho enkishui nemeish lelo pooki linchoo iyie ninye.

English: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom thou hast sent.
Masaai: Naa ena enkishui nemeish, inchere pee kiyiolou iyie Enkai nasipa nabo ake, neyiolou Yesu Kristo, ilo lirriwua.

English: I have glorified thee on the earth: I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do.
Masaai: Aaitaa nanu iyie kitok te nkop; aitabayie esiaai nikinchoo mataasa.

English: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
Masaai: Ore taata Papa, intaaki iyie nanu kitok, te nebo iyie te nkitoo naata apa te nebo iyie eton eitaae enkop.

English: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world: thine they were, and thou gavest them me; and they have kept thy word.
Masaai: “Aibalakinye enkarna ino lelo tung'ana likinchoo iyie aitung'uaa enkop. Ilinono apa ninche, nikinchoo iyie ninche, neibung'a ororei lino.

English: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
Masaai: Netayioloito taata ninche aajo ore pooki nikinchoo naa iyie eing'uaa;

English: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
Masaai: amu ore irorei likinchoo iyie naishoo nanu ninche, netang'amutua ninche, netisiputua aayiolou inchere, iyie aing'uaa, neiruko inchere iyie likirriwua.

English: I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which thou hast given me; for they are thine.
Masaai: Ninche aomonoki; maomonoki enkop, kake lelo likinchoo, amu ilkulinono ninche;

English: And all mine are thine, and thine are mine; and I am glorified in them.
Masaai: naa ore ntokitin aainei pooki inkuninono, naa inaainei ininono, naaitaaki kitok ti atua ninche.

English: And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me, that they may be one, as we are.
Masaai: Meekure atii nanu enkop, netii ninche enkop; etaa alotu nanu enitii. Papa Sinyati, torripo ninche te ngolon e nkarna ino, te ina arna apa nikinchoo nanu, pee eaku nabo anaa enikira sii iyiook nabo.

English: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
Masaai: Ore oshi eton atii te nebo ninche natorripo ninche, te nkarna ino, lelo likinchoo nanu atagolie nanu ninche, nemetii hoo obo oimina, meteleku ina kerai e nkiminata pee eitabari ilkigerot.

English: And now come I to thee; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
Masaai: Alotu taata enitii iyie, najo kuna baa te nkop pee eiputakino ninche eng'ida ai.

English: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
Masaai: Aishoo ninche ororei lino; neibayu ninche enkop, amu mme le nkop anaa enemara nanu ole nkop.

English: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world, but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil.
Masaai: Maomonoki intayu ninche te nkop, kake pee intajeu iyie ninche te ilo torrono.

English: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
Masaai: Mme le nkop ninche anaa enemara nanu ole nkop.

English: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
Masaai: Intisinya ninche te sipata ino. Esipata ororei lino.

English: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
Masaai: Ore anaa enikirriwua iyie nanu atua enkop, airriwayie sii nanu ninche atua enkop;

English: And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth.
Masaai: naa kaitisiny kewan te nkaraki ninche pee esinyayu sii ninche te sipata.

English: Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word;
Masaai: “Neme ninche ake aomonoki, kake o lelo pooki laairuk nanu enkaraki ororei lenye;

English: That they all may be one; as thou, Father, art in me, and I in thee, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that thou hast sent me.
Masaai: pee eaku pooki nabo, anaa iyie Papa itii atua nanu natii nanu atua iyie, pee etii sii ninche atua iyiook, pee etum enkop airuko nchere iyie likirriwua.

English: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one:
Masaai: Aishoo ninche ina kitoo nikinchoo iyie nanu, pee etum aataa nabo anaa enikira iyiook nabo;

English: I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
Masaai: atii nanu atua ninche nitii iyie atua nanu, pee eitaai ninche ilooiputakinote o metaa nabo, pee etum enkop atayiolo nchere iyie likirriwua, nitonyorra ninche anaa enikitonyorra nanu.

English: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which thou hast given me: for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world.
Masaai: “Papa, ayieu netii, lelo likinchoo enatii nanu, pee edol enkitoo ai nikinchoo iyie, amu kitonyorra iyie nanu eton etioyo enkitamanyunoto e nkop.

English: O righteous Father, the world hath not known thee: but I have known thee, and these have known that thou hast sent me.
Masaai: Iyie Papa sinyati, eitu kiyiolou enkop, kake aatayiolo nanu netayioloito kulo nchere iyie likirriwua nanu.

English: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
Masaai: Netaiyioloito ninche enkarna ino naa kaitoki aitayiolo, pee etii atua ninche ina nyorrata nikitonyorrie nanu, natii nanu atua ninche.”

English: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip Yesu atejo kuna baa nepuku o looiteng'eni lenyena, aapuo lido kekun le reyiet e Kidron enetii olokeri oshomo ninye o looiteng'eni lenyena.

English: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
Masaai: Ore Yudas, ilo otakaldayie ninye, neyiolo sii ninye ine wueji amu kesesh apa elo Yesu ine o looiteng'eni lenyena.

English: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
Masaai: Nedumu Yudas empikas oo sikarini o larripok ooing'uaa lapolosak kituaak o Lfarisayo, nepuonu ine eeta ltaai o lkilang'ilang'eta o masaa o larrabal.

English: Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek ye?
Masaai: Ore Yesu, eyiolo inaaitaasi ninye pooki, nepuku nejoki, “Ai ng'ae ing'oruru?”

English: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Yesu le Nasaret.” Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ara ninye.” Ore sii Yudas ilo otakaldayie ninye neitashe te nebo ninche.

English: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atiaaki ninche, “Ara ninye,” nerrinyo siadi nebatata te nkop.

English: Then asked he them again, Whom seek ye? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth.
Masaai: Neigil, aikilikuan ajoki, “Ai ng'ae ing'oruru?” Nejo ninche, “Yesu le Nasaret.”

English: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Atiaka intae ara ninye, te naa nanu ing'oruru, enchoo kulo epuo.”

English: That the saying might be fulfilled, which he spake, Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none.
Masaai: Pee eitabari ororei apa oiroro, ajo, “Ore te lelo likinchoo maata olaiturrayie.”

English: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
Masaai: Neeta Simon Petero, olalem, neshutu, neoshie osinka lo Lapolosani Kitok nedung'u enkiok e tatene. Keji enkarna e ilo sinka Malkus.

English: Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up thy sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father hath given me, shall I not drink it?
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu Petero, “Inyaaki olalem lino enchashur. Amaa enkikompe naaishoo Papa, ai ninye maok?”

English: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him,
Masaai: Ore ina pikas o sikarini o lkitok lenye o larripok loo Lyahudi, neibung Yesu neen,

English: And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year.
Masaai: neng'as aarikoki Annas, amu olaputani le Kaiafas, laa ninye Olapolosani Kitok te ilo ari.

English: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
Masaai: Kaiafas olapa otiaaka Lyahudi nchere keishiaakino naa oltung'ani obo onang olorere.

English: And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest.
Masaai: Nesuj Simon Petero o ilo likae oiteng'eni Yesu. Neyiolo ilo likae oiteng'eni Olapolosani Kitok, nejing ninye o Yesu atua olgoriet lo Lapolosani Kitok.

English: But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spake unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter.
Masaai: Kake eitashe Petero ti auluo te mbata e kutuk aji. Nelotu taa ilo likae oiteng'eni oyiolo Olapolosani Kitok, neirorie enkarriponi e kutuk aji, neitijing'u Petero atua.

English: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.
Masaai: Ore ina tito narrip kutuk aji, nejoki Petero, “Aa ira sii iyie obo loo looiteng'eni lele tung'ani?” Nejo, “Mara.”

English: And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself.
Masaai: Neinuaa isinkan o larripok enkima oo nkuk amu keirobi, naa ore eitashoo te ine, eijito enkima, neitashe Petero o ninche, eijito enkima.

English: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine.
Masaai: Neikilikuan Olapolosani Kitok Yesu mbaa oo looiteng'eni lenyena o mbaa naaiteng'enishe.

English: Jesus answered him, I spake openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, whither the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Airorie enkop aibalakinye mbaa. Aiteng'enisho oshi ake too nkajijik e ntumo o te nkaji e Nkai natumore Lyahudi pooki, nemeeta embae nairoro too nkisudorot.

English: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
Masaai: Aainyo paa nanu inkilikuan? Inkilikuana ilaatoning'o enatiaaka. Eyiolo ninche enatejo.”

English: And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answerest thou the high priest so?
Masaai: Ore pee ejo ninye neijia, neosh obo loo larripok oitashe te mbata eseder te nkaina, nejoki, “Ai neijia ijo ti niwaliki Olapolosani Kitok?”

English: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki ninye, “Te naa katejo ntorrok, tolimu shakeni e ina torroni; kake amaa te naa sipat, aainyoo pee kiosh?”

English: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Annas ninye eena enetii Olapolosani Kitok Kaiafas.

English: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Art not thou also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not.
Masaai: Neitashe Simon Petero aij enkima. Nejoki ninche ninye, “Oo iyie, aa ira obo loo looiteng'eni lenyena?” Nemiki, nejo, “Mara.”

English: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
Masaai: Ore osinka obo lo Lapolosani Kitok alashe le ilo otundung'oyie Petero enkiok, nejo, “Keitu duoo aadol to lokeri te nebo ninye?”

English: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Petero amiki, ore ina kata neru olkuku.

English: Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover.
Masaai: Nerik ninche Yesu aaitung'uaa Kaiafas, aarik enkaji o Lbalusui; naa enasirie. Eitu ejing ninche maate enkaji o Lbalusui pee meidurukieki. Amu kejo pee etum aainosa Pasaka.

English: Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring ye against this man?
Masaai: Neaku eipang'aka, neipang'aki Pilato ninche nejo, “Kaa kitarruorroto iyaunye ele tung'ani?”

English: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.
Masaai: Newaliki ninche aajoki, “Te neme olaasani loo ntorrok ele tung'ani, anaata eitu kirikoki iyie.”

English: Then said Pilate unto them, Take ye him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death:
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato ninche, “Ewaita intae ninye eng'uanare too nkitanapat inyi.” Nejoki Lyahudi ninye, “Meishoro iyiook matar oltung'ani metua.”

English: That the saying of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spake, signifying what death he should die.
Masaai: Etotiwuo neijia pee etum atabai enatejo Yesu pee eutu ajo kaa keeya eye ninye.

English: Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Art thou the King of the Jews?
Masaai: Neitoki Pilato ajing atua enkaji o Lbalosi neipot Yesu nejoki, “Aa ira iyie olaiguanani lo Lyahudi?”

English: Jesus answered him, Sayest thou this thing of thyself, or did others tell it thee of me?
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Ai yie makewan ojo nji ana ail kulikae likitolikitio mbaa aainei?”

English: Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me: what hast thou done?
Masaai: Newaliki Pilato, “Kara nanu Olyahudi? Olorere lino o lapolosak kituaak likiyakita nanu. Kaa itaasa iyie?”

English: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Ore enkitoria ai mme ene na kop. Te naa napaji ke ne na kop enkitoria ai anaata aatang'oro ilooiteng'eni laainei, pee maapiki nkaik oo Lyahudi; kake ore enatiu, mme ene ne enkitoria ai.” Nejoki Pilato ninye, “Metaa ira iyie olaiguanani?”

English: Pilate therefore said unto him, Art thou a king then? Jesus answered, Thou sayest that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu ajoki, “Iyie otejo nchere ara nanu olaiguanani. Aatoiwuoki nanu enkaraki ena, naa enkaraki ena pee aewuo enkop pee aishakenoki esipata, Ening ole sipata pooki oltoilo lai.”

English: Pilate saith unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and saith unto them, I find in him no fault at all.
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato ninye, “Ainyoo esipata?” Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, neitoki aipang'aki Lyahudi nejoki, “Eitu atumie hoo ninye entiyoto naishiakinore enkiguana.

English: But ye have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will ye therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
Masaai: Kake iatata olkerreti lalaakinye intae oltung'ani obo te Pasaka. Iyieuu nalaaki intae olaiguanani loo Lyahudi?”

English: Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.
Masaai: Nebuak pooki aaitoki aajo, “Mme ele tung'ani, kake Barabas.” Naa olaisimani apa Barabas.

English: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
Masaai: Nerik Pilato Yesu neidong te nkeene;

English: And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,
Masaai: neshetu isikarini olmarisian loo lkiku, nepik elukunya enye, neishopoki olkila onyokie.

English: And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they smote him with their hands.
Masaai: Neaku kepuonu enetii aajoki, “Supa, lo aiguanani loo Lyahudi!” Nedam isederi.

English: Pilate therefore went forth again, and saith unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that ye may know that I find no fault in him.
Masaai: Neitoki Pilato aipang nejoki ninche, “Eng'urai, aipang'akinye intae ninye pee iyiolouu aajo eitu atumie hoo enkitarruorroto.”

English: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
Masaai: Neipang'u taa Yesu eishopito olmarisian loo lkiku o lkila onyokie. Nejoki ninye ninche, “Eng'ura ele tung'ani.”

English: When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Take ye him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him.
Masaai: Ore pee edol ilapolosak kituaak o larripok ninye, nebuak aajo, “Tasho! Tasho!” Nejoki Pilato ninche, “Ewaita intae oopeny, entasho; amu eitu atumie nanu ninye hoo enkitarruorroto.”

English: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.
Masaai: Newaliki Lyahudi ninye aajoki, “Kiata iyiook enkitanapata naa ore te ina kitanapata keishiaakino keeya te nkaraki naitaa kewan Enkerai e Nkai.”

English: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he was the more afraid;
Masaai: Ore pee ening Pilato ilo rorei neureishoyu oleng,

English: And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.
Masaai: neitoki ajing atua enkaji o Lbalusui, nejoki Yesu, “Kaji ng'uaa iyie?” Kake eitu eisho Yesu ewalata hoo nabo.

English: Then saith Pilate unto him, Speakest thou not unto me? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee, and have power to release thee?
Masaai: Nejoki Pilato, “Aimikirorie nanu? Ai miyiolo ajo kaata engolon naalakie naata engolon naasheyie?”

English: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.
Masaai: Newaliki Yesu nejoki, “Miata hoo napaji engolon te nanu te neme eikinchooki eing'uaa shumata. Enkaraki e ina pee eeta olaatorikoko iyie eng'oki nalusoo.”

English: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ena walata neing'oru Pilato eneiko pee elak. Neidikidik Ilyahudi aabuak ejo, “Ti nilak ele tung'ani, nimira olchore le Kaisari. Ore pooki ng'ae oitaa kewan olaiguanani, naa Kaisari egilunore.”

English: When Pilate therefore heard that saying, he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha.
Masaai: Ore pee ening Pilato lelo rorei neipang'unye Yesu boo, neton to lorika le nkiguana te wueji neji olpura loo soito, neji te nkutuk oo Lhebrania Gabata.

English: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Jews, Behold your King!
Masaai: Naa te Nkitobirakinoto e Pasaka, anaa saa ile. Nejoki ninye Lyahudi, “Eng'ura olaiguanani linyi!”

English: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.
Masaai: Nebuak aajo, “Iwuang'ie Iwuang'ie ninye, tasho ninye!” Nejoki Pilato, “Kashe olaiguanani linyi?” Newaliki lapolosak kituaak, “Mikiaata iyiook olaiguanani leme Kaisari.”

English: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away.
Masaai: Neishoo taa Pilato ninye meshomo aashe. Neibung neya ninche Yesu nerik;

English: And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha:
Masaai: neipang enapita openy osalaba aya eneji Ewueji e Mborbor, neji te nkutuk oo Lyahudi Golgota.

English: Where they crucified him, and two others with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst.
Masaai: Neshe ninche ninye te ine, o kulikae aare te nebo ninye, atii ake obo enkae matua netii olikae enkae netii Yesu erishata.

English: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS.
Masaai: Nesir Pilato olkigeroto nepetoki osalaba, osira ajo, “Yesu le Nasaret, Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi.”

English: This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.
Masaai: Neisum Ilyahudi kumok ilo kigeroto amu ore ine wueji netasheyieki Yesu kenyikita ina anasa, natisiraki te nkutuk oo Lhebrania o enoo Roma o enoo Lyunani.

English: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee etiaakita ilapolosak kituaak loo Lyahudi Pilato, “Misir ajo, ‘Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi’, kake nchere etejo ninye, ‘Ara Olaiguanani loo Lyahudi.’ ”

English: Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.
Masaai: Newaliki Pilato ajo, “Ore enatisira, atisira.”

English: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip isikarini aatasho Yesu neya nkilani enyena neitaa orot ong'uan, neya ake osikari eoroti nabo, o lkila sii. Nemeeta ilo kila lenye osugat keshetuno te shumata o meiting'o.

English: They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which saith, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did.
Masaai: Naa ina pee etiaakinote, “Emikipolos, ematooshie ole nkukuo, pee kitum oloya,” pee ebaya ilo kigeroto ojo, “Etoorikinote nkilani aainei neoshie ole nkukuo olkila lai.”

English: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
Masaai: Kuna baa etaasa isikarini. Ore te mbata o salaba le Yesu neitashe ng'otonye, o Mariamu enkanashe ng'otonye, o enkitok e Kleopas, o Mariamu Magdalena.

English: When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
Masaai: Ore pee edol Yesu ng'otonye, eitashe te ine, o oloiteng'eni apa onyor, nejoki Yesu ng'otonye, “Yieyio, ng'ura enkerai ino.”

English: Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki ilo oiteng'eni, “Ng'ura ng'utunyi.” Ore ebaiki ina kata nerik ilo oiteng'eni ninye enkang enye.

English: After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena, etayiolo Yesu ajo eitabayioki mbaa pooki, pee etumi aaitabai olkigeroto katukul, nejo, “Aata enkure.”

English: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a spunge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth.
Masaai: Netipikaki emoti ine, nabore siki; nepik osuguroi obore ina siki oloomi le hisopo netuloki enkutuk enye.

English: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amu Yesu ina siki nejo, “Eidipe!” Neirrug elukunya nedung tau.

English: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
Masaai: Ore Ilyahudi te nkaraki naa enkolong e Nkitobirakinoto, ejo pee meing'uari seseni te shumata o salaba te nkolong e sabato amu enkolong kitok sabato, neomon Pilato metigili ninche nkejek neiwuang'ieki aaya.

English: Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him.
Masaai: Neaku eetuo isikarini apa negil inkejek ole dukuya o no likae apa otashoki te nebo ninye.

English: But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs:
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu enetii Yesu, nedol aajo eidipa atua, neitu egil inkejek enyena.

English: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.
Masaai: Kake etaremo osikari obo ematua te remet, nepuku osarge o enkare.

English: And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knoweth that he saith true, that ye might believe.
Masaai: Ore ilo otoduaa neishakenoko, naa kesipa shakenisho enye, neyiolo ninye ajo esipata ejoito, pee irukuruku sii intae.

English: For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken.
Masaai: Etotiutuo kuna baa pee ebaya olkigeroto ojo, “Meetae oloito lenye ogili.”

English: And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
Masaai: Enyaaka sii ajo likae kigeroto, “Eyooki ninche aaing'or ilo otaremo.”

English: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
Masaai: Ore te siadi nena, neisho Yosef le Arimatea, laa oloiteng'eni le Yesu, kake too nkurrat te nkaraki naure Ilyahudi, neomon Pilato meishoo meewa osesen le Yesu; neisho Pilato. Nelotu neya osesen lenye.

English: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.
Masaai: Nelotu sii Nikodemo, olapa otang'asa alo ayiaya ninye kewarie, neshoru enkitushulati e ilata narropil o emanoo o esonkoyo nabaya rrantilini iip.

English: Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury.
Masaai: Neya osesen le Yesu neirin too nkarash e kitani napuyiapui te nebo ina ilata narropil, anaa enatiu olkerreti loo Lyahudi le nukaroto.

English: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
Masaai: Netii ine wueji netasheyieki ninye enkurma, netii atua ina kurma enkurare ng'ejuk neton eitu ae kata eirragieki likae.

English: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki Enkitobirakinoto oo Lyahudi, netaana ina kurare, neirragie Yesu te ine.

English: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
Masaai: Ore enasirie te nkolong e dukuya e wiki, ore eton emisimis nelotu Mariamu Magdalena enkurare nedol ajo eiwuang'ieki osoit te nkurare.

English: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the Lord out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
Masaai: Neaku ekueta alo enetii Simon Petero o enetii olikae oiteng'eni apa onyor Yesu, nejoki ninche, “Eitayutuo Olaitoriani te nkurare, nimikiyiolo enetipika ninye.”

English: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
Masaai: Nepuku Petero o ilo likae oiteng'eni aapuo enkurare.

English: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
Masaai: Nekuet aairiamari pokira aare; kake neing'ataa ilo likae oiteng'eni Petero nemurutoki enkurare.

English: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
Masaai: Neirrugo arum nedol inkarash e kitani napuyiapui eirrag teine, kake eitu ejing atua.

English: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
Masaai: Nelotu sii ninye Simon Petero, esujita, nejing atua enkurare; nedol nena arash e kitani napuyiapui teine, kake eitu ejing atua,

English: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
Masaai: o ina anka natii apa endukuya enye. Nemeboitare inkarash e kitani napuyiapui, kake keirina ti ai wueji openy alamita.

English: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
Masaai: Nejing taa sii ninye ilo likae oiteng'eni otumurutoko olikae enkurare, atua nedol neiruk;

English: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
Masaai: amu eton apa eitu eyiolou olkigeroto ajo meeta nchere mepiu aing'uaa lootuata.

English: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
Masaai: Neitoki lelo ooiteng'eni aapuo nkang'itie enye.

English: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
Masaai: Kake eitasho Mariamu te nkutuk e nkurare, eishirita. Ore eishir neirrugo arum enkurare,

English: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
Masaai: nedol ilmalaika oare ooishopito nkilani naaibor, neton obo te nkalo e ndukuya ore olikae neton te nkalo oo nkejek e ine neirragie osesen le Yesu.

English: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I know not where they have laid him.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche ninye, “Na kitok, aainyoo pee inchirita?” Nejoki ninche, “Amu ewaita ninche Olaitoriani lai, nemayiolo nanu eneshomo aapik ninye.”

English: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
Masaai: Ore pee ejo neijia, neibelekenya nedol Yesu eitashe, neitu eyiolou ajo Yesu.

English: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Na kitok, ainyoo pee nchirita? Ai ng'ae ing'oru?” Ore amu kejo kolaturoni le nkurma nejoki, “Lo Kitok, te naa iyie owa ninye, tolikioki enishomo apik ninye, pee alotu aya.”

English: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Mariamu!” Neibelekenya nejoki te nkutuk oo Lhebrania, “Rabboni!” Eji Olaiteng'enani.

English: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Mikimbung, amu eton eitu ailep alo enetii Papa, kake shomo enetii lalashera laainei tiaaki ninche, ‘Kailep alo enetii Papa lai laa Papa linyi, enetii Enkai ai naa Enkai inyi.’ ”

English: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
Masaai: Nelo Mariamu e Magdalena aliki lelo ooiteng'eni ajoki, “Atoduaa Olaitoriani,” neliki nena baa naatiaakaki ninye.

English: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
Masaai: Ore ina olong teipa aa enkolong e dukuya e wiki, eikeno nkutukie e ina aji nasotore lelo ooiteng'eni te nkaraki naure Ilyahudi, nelotu Yesu neitashe te mpolos, nejoki ninche, “Entaseriana.”

English: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, neitodol ninche inkaik enyena o ematua enye. Neng'ida lelo ooiteng'eni pee edol Olaitoriani.

English: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
Masaai: Neitoki ake Yesu ajoki ninche, “Entaseriana. Ore anaa pee aairriwayie Papa, airriwaa sii nanu intae.”

English: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia neyang'aki ninche nejoki, “Entang'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
Masaai: Tenipalakiki oltung'ani ingok nepalakini, tenimipalakiki oltung'ani ingok, nemepalakini.

English: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
Masaai: Ore Tomas oji Olmaoi, laa obo le lelo tomon o aare, nemetii te nebo ninche pee elotu Yesu.

English: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the Lord. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
Masaai: Nejoki lelo kulikae ooiteng'eni, “Kitoduaa Olaitoriani.” Nejoki, “Te neitu adol nanu inkiporo oo lmushumaani too nkaik enyena napik olkimojino lai ine wueji oo lmushumaani napik enkaina ai ematua enye, mairuk nanu katukul.”

English: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i isiet neitoki aatii lelo ooiteng'eni atua aji, netii Tomas te nebo ninche. Nelotu Yesu eikeno nkutukie e ina aji, neitashe te mpolos nejo, “Entaseriana.”

English: Then saith he to Thomas, reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki Tomas, “Tipika olkimojino lino ene, ing'ura inkaik aainei; nipik enkaina ino ene mbung'a ematua ai nimiaku olemeeta enkirukoto kake iruko.”

English: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My Lord and my God.
Masaai: Newaliki Tomas ajoki, “Olaitoriani lai naa Enkai ai!”

English: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Iruko iyie te nkaraki nikitoduaa nanu? Emayiani lelo leitu edol neiruko.”

English: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
Masaai: Etaasa, Yesu kulikae monek kumok etii lelo oiteng'eni lenyana neitu esiri tena buku;

English: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
Masaai: kake etisiraki kuna pee itumutumu aairuko nchere ore Yesu ninye Kristo, Enkerai e Nkai, naa tenirukuruku, nitumutumu enkishui tiatua enkarna enye.

English: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and on this wise shewed he himself.
Masaai: Ore te siadi kuna baa neitoki Yesu aitoduaaya kewan te lelo ooiteng'eni lenyena te naiposha e Tiberias; neitoduaaya kewan tena oitoi.

English: There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.
Masaai: Ore eboita Simon Petero, o Tomas oji Olmaoi, o Natanael le Kana e Galilaya, o layiok le Sebedayo o kulikae ooiteng'eni aare lenyena.

English: Simon Peter saith unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with thee. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing.
Masaai: Nejoki Simon Petero lkulikae, “Kalo arresh isinkir.” Nejoki ninche ninye, “Aikiriamariyie sii iyiook iyie.” Nepuku aapuo nejing nabo kata empeut enye, neitu eibung ninche toki ina kewarie.

English: But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus.
Masaai: Ore enasirie neitashe Yesu te mbata e naiposha, kake eitu eyiolou lelo ooiteng'eni aajo Yesu.

English: Then Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat? They answered him, No.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Loyie ooti, iatata isinkir?” Newaliki aajoki, “Mikiaata.”

English: And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and ye shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Entanang'aki orreshet tatene e mpout, naa itumutumu.” Nenang'aki orreshet ore te nkaraki enkumoi oo sinkir eitu eitoki aaidim aateyietu.

English: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
Masaai: Nejoki ilo oiteng'eni onyor Yesu Petero, “Olaitoriani doi!” Ore pee ening Simon Petero meishopo, neidaki atua enaiposha;

English: And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes.
Masaai: kake eetunye lelo kulikae ooiteng'eni empeut enye, eikurtutu orreshet loo sinkir amu melamita enkop natoyio, keba anaa iroruat iip nabo.

English: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
Masaai: Ore pee epuku aabaiki enkop natoyio nedol te ine enkima oo nkuk naiteleikino sinkir, o emukate.

English: Jesus saith unto them, Bring of the fish which ye have now caught.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Eyau ene ematua oo sinkir limbung'a te na kata.”

English: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, and hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
Masaai: Neked Simon Petero empeut neikurtutu orreshet enkop natoyio ebore sinkir sapuki oora iip o onom o okuni; kake ore hoo naa kumok aaba neijia eitu epolosa orreshet.

English: Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Wootu entadaata.” Nemeetae hoo obo loo looiteng'eni oikilikuana ajoki, “Aira iyie ng'ae?” etayioloto aajo Olaitoriani.

English: Jesus then cometh, and taketh bread, and giveth them, and fish likewise.
Masaai: Nelotu Yesu nedumu emukate neisho, neikunaki sii neijia sinkir.

English: This is now the third time that Jesus shewed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead.
Masaai: Ena taa taata enkata e uni eipang'aki Yesu lelo ooiteng'eni eidipa atopiu too lootuata.

English: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip aatadaata nejoki Yesu Simon Petero, “Simon olayioni le Yohana, ai kinyor iyie nanu alang kulo?” Nejoki, “Ee Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie ajo kaanyor.” Nejoki ninye, “Intotio lkuoo laainei le kerra.”

English: He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
Masaai: Neitoki ajoki eni are, “Simon olayioni le Yohana, ai kinyor iyie nanu?” Nejoki, “Ee Olaitoriani, iyiolo ajo kaanyor.” Nejoki, “Irrita nkerra aainei.”
