English: He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ajoki ninye ene uni, “Simon olayioni le Yohana, ai kinyor iyie nanu?” Neisinanuo Petero amu etiaaka ene uni, “Ai kinyor iyie nanu?” Nejoki ninye, “Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie pooki toki; iyiolo ajo kaanyor.” Nejoki Yesu ninye, “Intotio nkerra aainei.

English: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, When thou wast young, thou girdedst thyself, and walkedst whither thou wouldest: but when thou shalt be old, thou shalt stretch forth thy hands, and another shall gird thee, and carry thee whither thou wouldest not.
Masaai: Esipa, esipa, aajoki iyie, ore apa ira oti irreten kewan nilo eniyieu; kake ore kenya pee imoruau iyooki aitorio nkaik inono, nikirreten likae nikiya ewueji nimiyieu nilo.”

English: This spake he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he saith unto him, Follow me.
Masaai: Etejo neijia eutu enkeeya nayaki Enkai enkitoo. Ore pee eidip atejo neijia nejoki ninye, “Tusujuaki nanu.”

English: Then Peter, turning about, seeth the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrayeth thee?
Masaai: Neibelekenya Petero nedol olapa oiteng'eni onyor Yesu esujita. Aa ninye olapa oirishakine olgoo lenye te ndaa e teipa nejoki, “Olaitoriani, ai ng'ae ilo likirojaa?”

English: Peter seeing him saith to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do?
Masaai: Ore pee edol Petero ilo nejoki Yesu, “Olaitoriani, oo ninye ele?”

English: Jesus saith unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee? follow thou me.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu, “Amaa te nayieu nebik ninye o maeu, ainyoo nikitii iyie? Tusujuaki iyie nanu.”

English: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to thee?
Masaai: Neibulaa ilo rorei too lalashera nchere ore ele oiteng'eni nemeye, hoo neitu ejo Yesu, meye ninye, “Kake, Amaa tenaa eyiunoto ai pee eton ninye o metushukunye, kainyoo nikitii iyie?”

English: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
Masaai: Ilo oiteng'eni ele oishakenu kuna baa neigero ninche, nikiyiolo iyiook aajo kesipa shakenisho enye.

English: And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.
Masaai: Netii sii kulie baa kumok naataasa Yesu; naa te neigeri naaji maa naabo, kajo nanu meishaa enkop imbukui naaji naaigeri.

English: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,
Masaai: Aigero te embuku naitera, Oloyanyiti Teofilo, mbaa pooki aaitera Yesu aas o naaiteng'enishe,

English: Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen:
Masaai: o metabaiki ina olong apa nailepieki aaya shumata. Ore eton eitu eilepieki neitanapisho te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, aitanap lelo tung'ana apa ootegelua metaa lkipaareta, lenyena.

English: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
Masaai: Ore te rishata oo nkolong'i artam, etulusoyie enkeeya enye, neitodol kewan ninche nkatitin kumok, too nkoitoi naaitadedeyie aaoru ninche olng'ash nchere keishu; netoduaa ninche ninye, eirorie ninche aimaki mbaa e nkitoria e Nkai.

English: And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, saith he, ye have heard of me.
Masaai: Ore pee etumo ninche te nebo, neitanap Yesu ajoki, “Emipuo aaing'uaa Yerusalem, kake entaanyu enkishorunoto natejo Papa keishoru, anaa enatiaaka intae.

English: For John truly baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
Masaai: Amu te nkare apa eibatisishe Yohana, kake ore too nkuti olong'i, keibatisai intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati.”

English: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?
Masaai: Ore enotote ilkipaareta te nebo neikilikuan Yesu aajoki, “Olaitoriani, ei te na rishata irrinyoki Siraeli enkitoria?”

English: And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father hath put in his own power.
Masaai: Nejoki Yesu ninche, “Ore rishat o nkatitin Papa lai ake openy oitore makewan, nemeishoro intae entayiolo enkata naaku.

English: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
Masaai: Kake ing'amumu intae engolon, tene elotu Enkiyang'et Sinyati shumata intae, niaakuku intae lchakenini laainei ti atua Yerusalem, o ti atua Yudea pooki o Samaria, o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.”

English: And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atejo neijia, eing'orita ninche, neilepieki aaya keper neitemoo enkatampoi arishie nkonyek enye.

English: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
Masaai: Ore eimariri keper eduaaya ninye eloito, ore nabo kata nemaniki ltung'ana aare ooishopito nkilani naaibor eitashe.

English: Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.
Masaai: Nejo, “Lo lewa le Galilaya, oo pee intasheshe te ne aaing'or keper? Ore Yesu, ele oilepieki aaitung'uaa intae aaya keper keitu aikununye anaa ina nitoduaaitie elo keper.”

English: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.
Masaai: Neitoki ninche aashuko Yerusalem aaing'uaa oldoinyo oji Olooloirienito otaaniki Yerusalem oba anaa elototo e nkolong e sabato.

English: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
Masaai: Nejing ninche Yerusalem nepuo aailepaki olgilata le shumata le nkaji apa natijing'a: Aa Petero, Yohana, Yakobo o Anterea, Filipo o Tomas, Bartolomayo o Matayo, Yakobo le Alfayo o Simon loo olkirowuai, o Yudas ole Yakobo.

English: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren.
Masaai: Neiturrurro pooki anaa ake aasaisho te nebo, netii nkituaak naaisiritore, inaatii Mariamu ng'otonye Yesu o lalashera lenyena.

English: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,)
Masaai: Ore tenena olong'i neitashe Petero tiatua ilalashera, oobaya eumata oo ltung'ana oobaya esiana iip o tikitam.

English: Men and brethren, this scripture must needs have been fulfilled, which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus.
Masaai: Nejo, “Ilalashera laainei, meeta kata apake nemeitabari ilkigerot anaa enatejo Enkiyang'et Sinyati, alimunye Daudi, eimaki Yudas, laa ninye otorikuo ltung'ana ooetuo aaibung Yesu.

English: For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.
Masaai: Amu ole siana ang apa Yudas neishooki ematua enye te na siaai.”

English: Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.
Masaai: “Neinyiang'ua ele tung'ani enkurma to lerrinyore le nkarrueisho enye, naa ine etanang'a etusulari neng'era adanya neitiakunye enkoshoke pooki.

English: And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.
Masaai: Nening iltung'ana pooki oomanya Yerusalem ina, nedung'oki ina kurma enkarna te nkutuk enye aajo Akeldama, (eji ‘Enkurma osarge’).

English: For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take.
Masaai: Amu etisiraki te Mbuku e Olkerempe le Nkai aajo, ‘Metomijoono enkaji enye; nelaii oltung'ani omany.’ Ore sii nchoo, ‘Meisiaaisho likae te rishata enye.’

English: Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
Masaai: Ore naa oltung'ani obo le lelo ooisiritore iyiook te ina kata pooki etii Yesu atua iyiook,

English: Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection.
Masaai: eiteru te nkibatisare e Yohana, o metabaiki ina olong nailepieki Yesu aaya keper, aaitung'uaa iyiook, meeta kata nemeaku obo le lelo shakenini le mpiunoto te nebo iyiook.”

English: And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.
Masaai: Neaku etegelutua ltung'ana aare: Yosef oji Barsabas (neji sii Yustus), o Matias.

English: And they prayed, and said, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen,
Masaai: Neomon ninche nejo, “Olaitoriani, iyiolo iyie ltauja loo ltung'ana pooki. Ore te nkaraki ina, Olaitoriani, tuutaki iyiook olitudutayie te kulo pokira aare,

English: That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place.
Masaai: ojing ena rishata aaku olkipaaret neisiaaisho amu eshomo Yudas ewueji enye apake.”

English: And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.
Masaai: Neosh enkukuo aadut nena arn pokira are. Nedoiki enkukuo Matias neikenakini encholiek e lelo kipaareta tomon o obo.

English: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.
Masaai: Ore pee ebau enkolong o Pentekoste, netii apa pooki ewueji nebo.

English: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata nelotu enkikurrukur naing'uaa keper neeijo eno lkutati, neiput ina aji pooki natii ninche.

English: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
Masaai: Nedol ninche entoki neeijo lng'ejepa le nkima eisuaari: neiseyie ake ina ng'ejep neeijo enkima o lng'ejep le pooki tung'ani otii ine.

English: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
Masaai: Neigany Enkiyang'et Sinyati ninche pooki neiteru aairo kulie kutukie, anaa enaidimie Enkiyang'et Sinyati meiroro.

English: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.
Masaai: Nemanya Yerusalem Ilyahudi laa iltung'ana asayiak le Nkai, ooetuo ninche eing'uaa nkuapi pooki e nkop.

English: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ina kikurrukur neiturrurro olorora kitok. Neiputukuny neing'asia pooki amu meetae ake oleitu ening ninche eiro enkutuk naikini ninye.

English: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
Masaai: Neiputukuny neing'asia nejo, “Amaa kulo tung'ana aime Lgalilaya pooki!

English: And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?
Masaai: Aainyo naa pee kining'ito iyiook pooki eiro nkutukie ang naaikini iyiook?

English: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
Masaai: King'uaa iyiook Partia, Media, Elam; niking'uaa Mesopotamia, Yudea, o Kapodokia; niking'uaa Ponto o Asia,

English: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
Masaai: niking'uaa Frigia o Pamfiliam niking'uaa Misiri o lkirinen le Libya o Kirene, neing'uaa kulikae lang Roma,

English: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
Masaai: ndung'ot pokira, Lyahudi o Loreren ooibelekenyate aaku Lyahudi; niking'uaa kulikae lang Krete o Arabia kake eji nikining pooki eiro ninche nkutukie ang eimaki mbaa kituaak naataasa Enkai!”

English: And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What meaneth this?
Masaai: Ore eing'asiate pooki nemilo neikilikuana taa ake aajo, “Ainyoo eutu ena bae?”

English: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
Masaai: Kake etii ilookueniyie ilairukok ejo, “Ketemerate kulo tung'ana!”

English: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judaea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
Masaai: Kake neinyototo Petero eboitare ninye lelo kulikae tomon o obo, neiteru airorie olorere to ltoilo sapuk ajoki, “Lo lewa lang loo Lyahudi, o intae pooki oomanya Yerusalem, entoning enajo, matoliki intae enautu ena bae.

English: For these are not drunken, as ye suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day.
Masaai: Eitu emera kulo tung'ana anaa ina nijojo, ene uni ena saa anaa pee ekenyu.

English: But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel;
Masaai: Maa, enapa bae ena natolimuo oloiboni le Nkai oji Yoel pee ejo,

English: And it shall come to pass in the last days, saith God,I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams:
Masaai: ‘Kaas ena bae te nena olong'i naabayie, Enkai najo, kabukoki ltung'ana pooki Enkiyang'et ai. Keyooki aaibonisho layiok linyi o ntoyie inyi; nedol ilbarnot linyi nduaat, netum ilpayiani linyi nkidetidetat.

English: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:
Masaai: Ee, o metabaiki sii ninche sinkan laainei, loo lewa o loo ng'oruo, kabukoki Enkiyang'et ai te nena olong'i, naa keibonisho kenya ninche.

English: And I will shew wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke:
Masaai: Naa kaitodolu ine nking'asia te ntaiya e shumata, o sapiipiyieti ti abori te nkop. Nedoli osarge o enkima, o empuruo nairrusha:

English: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:
Masaai: neitomisimisi enkolong, nedoru olapa atiu anaa osarge, eton etiooyo ina olong o Laitoriani, enkolong kitok e nkisisa.

English: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata, ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani neitajeuni.’

English: Ye men of Israel, hear these words; Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as ye yourselves also know:
Masaai: “Lo lewa le Israeli! Entoning kulo rorei. Ore Yesu le Nasaretii, oltung'ani otisirua Enkai abaraki te intae too mbaa e ngolon o ine nking'asia o nkitoduaat o lmonek ooitaasa intae Enkai te nkaina enye; niyiololo intae ina amu atua intae etaasieki.

English: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
Masaai: Enkai openy natudutayie te yieunoto o te ng'eno enye makewan apake nchere, keitarasari Yesu, nitara intae ninye, aaisho ltung'ana arruok metasho.

English: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
Masaai: Kake eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata: nelaku aoru emion e keeya amu meidimayu apa neenikino enkeeya ninye.

English: For David speaketh concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved:
Masaai: Amu eimaka Daudi ninye nejo, ‘Atoduaa Olaitoriani etii dukuya nanu nkatitin pooki: aatii te tatene, metaa maaigusugusieki.

English: Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope:
Masaai: Amu ore te nkaraki ena keng'ida oltau lai, nebore irorei laainei enchipai; ore nanu, nara ake olenye, nayeng'iyeng'a aanyisho to siligi,

English: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell, neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Masaai: amu ming'uaa iyie oltau lai te nemeneng'a, nimincho osinka lino sinyati metupurdayu ang'uoyu.

English: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
Masaai: Kituutaka iyie nanu inkoitoi enkishui, ore amu itii iyie, ei kilo aiput enchipai.’

English: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
Masaai: “Ilalashera laainei, enchooki maibalakinye intae ashirraki too mbaa e papa lang Daudi, Etua ninye, nenukari, netii enkurare enye atua iyiook o tene.

English: Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne;
Masaai: O loiboni le Nkai apa metaa ketayiolo ina naisiligie Enkai ajoki, ore eishoi enye keikini likae aiguanani kitok oitoreisho anaa apa Daudi.

English: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
Masaai: Ina etodolua Daudi naas kenya ake Enkai, paa keiroro aimaki empiunoto e Kristo pee ejo: ‘Eitu eing'uari ninye te nemeneng'a. Neitu epurda osesen lenye ang'uoyu.’

English: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
Masaai: “Ele Yesu likiimaki eitopiwuo Enkai aitung'uaa ilootuata, nikira iyiook lchakenini le ina bae.

English: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost, he hath shed forth this, which ye now see and hear.
Masaai: Ore pee eilepieki nepiki tatene e Nkai, neng'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati te Menye anaa enatejo apake; naa ore ena nidolitata nining'itoto ina kishorunoto enye etubukoko iyiook.

English: For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he saith himself, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,
Masaai: Amu eitu elo Daudi makewan keper; kake etejo ninye kewan, ‘Etiaka Olaitoriani Olaitoriani lai: Totona te tatene ai,

English: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
Masaai: pee aitadou ilmang'ati linono metotiutu anaa olorika loo nkejek inono.’

English: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God hath made that same Jesus, whom ye have crucified, both Lord and Christ.
Masaai: Entayioloito naa taata enkaji pooki e Israel ena nadede nchere, ele Yesu, lishomo intae aashe to salaba, eitaa Enkai Olaitoriani o Kristo.”

English: Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do?
Masaai: Kuna ake etoning'o ninche nerem ilo rorei iltauja, nejoki Petero o lkulikae kipaareta, “Kaa naa kiaas, ilalashera lang?”

English: Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninche, “Erridutu pooki tung'ani, neibatisai pooki te intae te nkarna e Yesu Kristo, pee epalakini intae ng'ok inyi; naa ing'amumu enkishorunoto e Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are afar off, even as many as the Lord our God shall call.
Masaai: Amu ore ena kisiligata eninyi apa o nkera inyi, o lelo pooki oolakua lelo pooki ooipotoki Enkai kewan.”

English: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.
Masaai: Neitirrishaki Petero aitadedeyie te kulie baa kumok, nejoki, “Entajeu ate te ina nainepu kulo tung'ana arruok.”

English: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls.
Masaai: Neiruk ilkumok nena baa naainosua ninye, neibatisai; neponikini ilo turrur iltung'ana oobaya nkalifuni uni te ina olong.

English: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
Masaai: Neaku ketumo ninche anaa ake te nkiteng'enare oo lkipaareta, neshulare aaisiritore, neng'arie endaa, neshulare te nkomono.

English: And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles.
Masaai: Nejing aiput enkuretisho pooki ng'ae; neasi inenking'asia, olmonek too lkipaareta.

English: And all that believed were together, and had all things common;
Masaai: Nebik ilairukok pooki te nebo te nchula neyau masaa enye aang'ar.

English: And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.
Masaai: Neaku kemir masaa enye o ntokitin naata neorikino pooki mpesai, anaa enaatayie oltung'ani enkolat.

English: And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,
Masaai: Netumo anaa ake ilo turrur te nkaji e Nkai, neng'ar ndaiki too nkajijik enye, neng'ida edaa to ltau obo,

English: Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.
Masaai: neisis Enkai, neshipakino iltung'ana pooki ninche. Neponaa Olaitoriani ilo turrur lenye anaa ake te lelo ooitajeuni.

English: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong, nepuo Petero o Yohana enkaji e Nkai saa naaudo etushuke enkolong, te nkata e nkomono.

English: And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple;
Masaai: Ore te Kishomi Sidai, amu neijia eji, netii oltung'ani laa olmaima eiteru te inoto enye. Naa kenapi anaa ake aaya ina kishomi meshomo aomonu mpesai too ltung'ana oopuo aajing enkaji e Nkai.

English: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
Masaai: Ore pee edolu Petero o Yohana epuonu aajing ine, neomon meishoo enkiti toki.

English: And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us.
Masaai: Neipirie ninche nkonyek aaing'or, nejoki Petero, “Ng'ura iyiook!”

English: And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them.
Masaai: Neing'or ninche eisiligu toki te ninche.

English: Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I thee: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Maata enkosholai o sahabu, kake kaaisho enaata. Te nkarna e Yesu Kristo le Nasareti, aajoki shomo!”

English: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ancle bones received strength.
Masaai: Neibung enkaina e tatene aitasheyie. Negolu nabo kata ndapi o rubat oo nkejek e ilo tung'ani;

English: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
Masaai: neipid, neitashe too nkejek enyena, neiteru alo amanimanaa. Neitoki airiamariyie ninche ajing atua enkaji e Nkai, eloito neipid neisisita Enkai.

English: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
Masaai: Nedol olorere pooki eloito neipid eisisita Enkai.

English: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him.
Masaai: Ore ade pee epuonu aaiyiolou aajo ninye oloshi aomononi oton te Kishomi Sidai e Nkaji e Nkai, neing'asia pooki, neiputukuny te ina naitaasaki ninye.

English: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.
Masaai: Ore eibung'ita ilo tung'ani Petero o Yohana, neing'asia ltung'ana pooki nekuetu enetii ninche to lgoriet le Solomon, amu neijia eji ine.

English: And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, Ye men of Israel, why marvel ye at this? or why look ye so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk?
Masaai: Ore pee edol Petero ina, nejoki ninche, “Lo lewa lang le Israel, ainyoo naing'asiayie intae te ne, naa kaji etiu paa iyiook ing'oring'oro? Ijojo pasa ai te nkaraki ongolon ang maate arashu te nkaraki esupatisho ang pee eishiunyeki ele tung'ani meinyo alo?

English: The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, hath glorified his Son Jesus; whom ye delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go.
Masaai: Enkai e Abraham, o Isaak o Yakobo, Enkai oo loo papa, naishoo Osinka lenye Yesu, enkitoo, Intae ooitarasaitie ninye aaisho lelo ooitoreisho, nitanyaita intae ninye te dukuya Pilato, etejo ninye alaku aisho elo.

English: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
Masaai: Kake itanyaita intae Ilo Sinyati naa Supat. Niomonunu olarani meishori intae.

English: And killed the Prince of life, whom God hath raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses.
Masaai: Niariara metua ilo aishoroni le nkishui. Kake eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata, nikira iyiook lchakenini le ina bae.

English: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong, whom ye see and know: yea, the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
Masaai: Enkarna e Yesu o enkirukoto e nkarna enye naitagolo ele tung'ani lidolitata niyiololo, ore enkirukoto ti atua Yesu neisho ele tung'ani ena biyotisho nalulung'a nidolitata pooki.

English: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
Masaai: “Ore naa taata, ilalashera laainei, ayiolo ajo ore intae o lelo aitoriak linyi, te nkaraki emodai pee itaasa ina.

English: But those things, which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he hath so fulfilled.
Masaai: Etolimuo apake Enkai too nkutukie oo loibonok lenyena pooki ajo, meeta nchere meitamei Kristo lenye; netaa te kuna naatasate eitabayie.

English: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
Masaai: Erridutu naa, embelekenyakinoto Enkai, pee ejutori ng'ok inyi,

English: And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:
Masaai: o pee epuonu nkatitin naayagieki enkishui, naaing'uaa enetii Olaitoriani, Enkai, oo sii pee eirriu Yesu, laa ninye ilo Kristo lenye otisiraka apake intae.

English: Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.
Masaai: Meeta kata nemeng'as ninye abik te shumata o metaba anaa neitang'ejuki pooki toki anaa enatolimuo apake Enkai te dukuya too nkutukie oo loibonok lenyena sinyat.

English: For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you.
Masaai: Amu etejo Musa, ‘Keirriwaki intae Olaitoriani oloiboni anaa apa pee aairriu nanu, olaa ololorere linyi. Entoning ake mbaa pooki naaliki ninye intae.

English: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani pooki lemening enajo ilo oiboni le Nkai, neari aaidaikie to lorere.’

English: Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days.
Masaai: Netolimutuo lelo oibonok le Nkai, pooki ooiroro, ebaiki Samuel o lelo ootusujutua ninye, eibalunye sii apa ninche kuna olong'i.

English: Ye are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed.
Masaai: Irara intae inkera e lelo oibonok le Nkai, o ne ilo sotua oishoo Enkai iloo minyi, anaa pee ejoki Abraham, ‘Te ishoi ino emayiani iloreren pooki le nkop.’

English: Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.
Masaai: Metaa Enkai nainyeyie Osinka lenye, naa intae eiteru airriwaki, pee emayian intae pooki aibelekeny entung'uai nkoitoi inyi e nkarrueisho.”

English: And as they spake unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them,
Masaai: Ore eirorie Petero o Yohana olorere nepuonu ilapolosak o lkitok loo larripok le nkaji e Nkai o Sadukayo enetii ninche.

English: Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead.
Masaai: Netagorote enkaraki naiteng'enita ilkipaareta olorere aaliki te Yesu empiunoto o lootuata.

English: And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now eventide.
Masaai: Neibung ninche aapik jela o mekenyu, amu emuto ina kata.

English: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand.
Masaai: Kake eiruko ilkumok le lelo ootoning'o ilo rorei; nebaya lewa anaa nkalifuni imiet.

English: And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,
Masaai: Ore taaisere neiturrurro larikok o lpayiani loo Lyahudi, o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat te nebo te Yerusalem.

English: And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Netii etii Olapolosani Kitok oji Ananias, netii Kaiafas, o Yohana o Aleksanta o kulikae ake lo lmarei lo Lapolosani Kitok.

English: And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have ye done this?
Masaai: Neitasheyie lelo kipaareta te dukuya ninche neikilikuan aajoki, “Kaji intae nkuna pee itaasa ena? Kaa golon ena niatata, naa keneng'ae enkarna nitaasishore?”

English: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said unto them, Ye rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,
Masaai: Ore eiganya Petero Enkiyang'et Sinyati, newaliki ajoki, “Lo kituaak lo lorere, o lpayiani,

English: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
Masaai: te naa taa keikilikuanishoreki iyiook te le kekun te mbae supat naitaasaki oltung'ani maima o eneikuna pee eishiunyeki ele tung'ani,

English: Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom ye crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him doth this man stand here before you whole.
Masaai: neishiaakino te niyiolouwu intae pooki, neishiaakino neyiolou olorere pooki le Israeli nchere, ore pee eitashe ele tung'ani te dukuya intae aa biyoto katukul, enkaraki engolon e nkarna e Yesu Kristo le Nasareti lishomo intae aashe neitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata.

English: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders, which is become the head of the corner.
Masaai: Yesu eimakita lkigerot pee ejo, ‘Ilo soit litemenaitie intae ilashetak otaa osoit kitok lo lmairroto.’

English: Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is none other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved.
Masaai: Meetae tukul likae otumieki enjeunoto, nemeetae ai arna naishoruno ti abori shumata, naishooki ltung'ana pee kijeunye.”

English: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Enkiguana ina natishirrakita Petero o Yohana, nemusu aajo ltung'ana ake ninche lemeeta enkisuma nashomo, neme ng'eni sii, neing'asia; neyiolou aajo ninche lapa ooisiritore Yesu.

English: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nadolita ilo tung'ani oishiunyeki eitashe te nebo ninche, nelau enawaliki.

English: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
Masaai: Kake ore pee eitanap ninche meipung'o te nkaji e nkiguana, neiteru lpayiani aaiguana oopeny,

English: Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it.
Masaai: ejo kuna, “Kaa kintaas kulo tung'ana? Amu eibale ake ninye too ltung'ana pooki oomanya Yerusalem nchere ninche etaasishoreki te na bae naba nji e nking'asia, nimikiindim sii aatomiki.

English: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
Masaai: Kake ore naa pee meitadarari ena bae ti atua olorere, maing'odia, nikirishie kulo tung'ana pee meigil aairorie likae tung'ani te na arna.”

English: And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.
Masaai: Neipotu ninche neitanap nereiki aajoki pee meigil ake aairorie aashu eiteng'en likae tung'ani te nkarna e Yesu.

English: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
Masaai: Kake etawalikitia Petero o Yohana aajoki ninche, “Entirish intae o openy enaishiaakino te Nkai, te naa ai intae kining ana ke Nkai.

English: For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard.
Masaai: Amu mikiindim ake iyiook aatapal mikilimu inikitoduaa o nikitoning'o.”

English: So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ina kiguana aaing'ode ninche neitirrishaki oleng, neitoki aaisho epuo. Etalaita taa katukul enaitameyie ninche amu errepita ltung'ana pooki Enkai te ina nataasaki.

English: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
Masaai: Amu ore ilo tung'ani oitaasaki ina e nking'asia aaishiunye neitogiroyie larin artam.

English: And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'ueikini ninche, nepuonu enetii lchoreta lenye, nelikioo nena pooki naatiaakita ninche ilapolosak kituaak o lpayiani.

English: And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, thou art God, which hast made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is:
Masaai: Neisho ninche pee ening nena, neilepie tenebo iltoiloishi lenye aailepakinye Enkai ejo: “Olaitoriani, oitobira shumata o enkop o enaiposha, o nena pooki naatii,

English: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?
Masaai: naa iyie oirorie Papa lang Daudi ilo sinka lino, te Nkiyang'et Sinyati, pee ejo, ‘Aainyo pee epush Iloreren leme Lyahudi, neipiru ltung'ana enkiguana nemeaku?

English: The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.
Masaai: Etanapate laiguanak kituaak le nkop, nesoto laitoriak te nebo, aa Olaitoriani Enkai earare, o ilo lenye otubulokoki eilata aaput.’

English: For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together,
Masaai: Amu esipa nchere tiatua ena anasa apa esotokinoi Osinka lino Yesu, osinka lino sinyati laa ninye itubukoko eilata aput, ninye etasotokinote Herode o Pontio Pilato o Loreren leme Lyahudi o ltung'ana le Israel,

English: For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.
Masaai: pee eitaas enapake naidipa magilanisho ino o enkiguana ino makewan atejo keaku.

English: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
Masaai: Ore naa taata, Olaitoriani, toduaa iyie ina king'odia enye, nincho isinkan linono meiroro te ororei lino mpijan pooki;

English: By stretching forth thine hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus.
Masaai: nintorioo iyie enkaina ino aishiunye olorere; ninchoru metaasi ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia te nkarna e Yesu, Osinka lino sinyati.”

English: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
Masaai: Ore pee eomon neigirigiro ine netumore, neiput ninche pooki Enkiyang'et Sinyati neshirraki aairo ororei le Nkai.

English: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common.
Masaai: Neaku lelo pooki ooiruko ilo ltau obo o le yieunoto nabo, nemeetae olojo nkunenyena masaa naata, amu etang'ara ninche ntokitin pooki naata.

English: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all.
Masaai: Nelimu ilkipaareta te ngolon shakenisho e mpiunoto o Laitoriani Yesu; nelotu empiris e Nkai shumata ninche pooki.

English: Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold,
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo te ninche olau toki, amu ore lelo apa ooata masaa oo nkurman aashu inoo nkajijik, nemir neyau mpesai naainosieki nena masaa,

English: And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
Masaai: neirragie too nkejek oo lkipaareta pee eorikini pooki tung'ani, anaa naabaiki.

English: And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus,
Masaai: Neetae Yosef, oishoo lkipaareta enkarna aajo Barnabas (kejo ina oloitagol ilkulikae oishuaa) naa oloo Lewi, laa ole nkop e Kipros,

English: Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
Masaai: neaku eeta ninye enkurma, nemir, neyau iropiyiani naainosie, neirragie too nkejek oo lkipaareta.

English: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
Masaai: Kake etii oltung'ani oji Ananias, o enkitok enye naji Safira, otimira erubata enkurma enye,

English: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.
Masaai: kake neshumaki kewan ematua oo mpesai, neyiolo enkitok enye, neyaki ilkipaareta nkulie naatelekutua.

English: But Peter said, Ananias, why hath Satan filled thine heart to lie to the Holy Ghost, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
Masaai: Nejoki Petero, “Ananias, aainyo pee nchoo Sheitani mikintoria oltau lino teleja Enkiyang'et Sinyati adung'oo ematua oo mpesai nitimirie te nkurma ino?

English: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
Masaai: Aemme nkuninono apa eton eitu imir, naa nkuninono mpesai indipa atimira. Kaji naa etiu pee, itudutayie to ltau lino ajo aas ina. Mme taa oltung'ani iteleja kake Enkai iteleja!”

English: And Ananias hearing these words fell down, and gave up the ghost: and great fear came on all them that heard these things.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening Ananias ina nebatata neye. Ore lelo pooki ootoning'o neiput enkuretisho.

English: And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him.
Masaai: Nejing'u lbarnot, neirin osesen lenye, neipung'ie, nepuo aanukaa.

English: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie saai uni nejing'u enkitok enye nemeyiolo ninye nena naatupukutuo.

English: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Tolikioki sii iyie, amaa, kena siana inosie enkurma inyi? Ei mpesai esiana naje ake inosie?” Nejoki, “Ee esiana naje ake.”

English: Then Peter said unto her, How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door, and shall carry thee out.
Masaai: Nejoki taa Petero, “Kaji etiu pee itoning'okinote intae aatem Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani? Ng'ura nenena nkejek oo laduoo ooshomo aanukaa olpayian lino naatii kutuk aji, naa iyie sii epuonu aaipung'ie aaya.”

English: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
Masaai: Nebatata nabo kata te nkalo oo nkejek enyena neye; nejing'u lelo barnot neinepu etua, neipung'ie aaya, nepuoi aanukaa aaitatashaki olpayian lenye.

English: And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things.
Masaai: Neiput enkuretisho sapuk ina sirit e lelo ooiruko pooki, o lelo pooki ootoning'o kuna baa.

English: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.
Masaai: Etaasaki apa ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia tiatua iltung'ana too nkaik oo lkipaareta. Netii apa pooki tenebo to lgoriet le Solomon.

English: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.
Masaai: Nemeetae oltung'ani leme ole ina sirit oitieu atushulare, hoo neimaki ake ltung'ana pooki esupatisho enye,

English: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
Masaai: neponari ake sii esiana enye too lewa o nkituaak kumok naairuk Olaitoriani.

English: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki nena pooki naasita ilkipaareta, neaku kenapuni ltamueyia mbat oo nkoitoi oo nkaulele, neirragieki too rruatin o too lkarash paa ore eim Petero ine, neporoo oloip lenye kulikae lenye.

English: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed every one.
Masaai: Neiturrurrunye sii ltung'ana loo nkang'itie naamanita Yerusalem, eyau ltamueyia lenye o lelo ooata loiriruani; neishiunyeki ninche pooki.

English: Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation,
Masaai: Kake einyio Olapolosani Kitok, o lelo pooki ooboitare (oora le sirit oo Sadukayo), eiputa lelo pooki olom,

English: And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.
Masaai: nepik ilkipaareta nkaik, nepuo aaen te korokoroni napiki olorere.

English: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
Masaai: Kake etabolo olmalaika lo Laitoriani nkishomin e korokoroni kewarie, neitupuku, nejoki,

English: Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
Masaai: “Enchom intae, entasho eroro te nkaji a Nkai entoliki Iltung'ana mbaa pooki e na kishui.”

English: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel and sent to the prison to have them brought.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche ina neyooki ajing enkaji e Nkai enasirie neiteng'enisho. Kake eewuo Olapolosani Kitok, o lelo ooboitare, neiturrur enkiguana nalulung'a te nebo, o erikore pooki e Israel, neirriwaa olkilikuai korokoroni metorikuni ninche.

English: But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned, and told,
Masaai: Kake etejo sikarini maetu korokoroni nelau; neitu aalimu,

English: Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within.
Masaai: aajo, “Kineputua korokoroni eikeno osupatei, neitashoo larripok too nkishomin: kake kitejo matabol, metii oltung'ani otii atua.”

English: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
Masaai: Ore taa pee ening olkitok loo sikarini le nkaji e Nkai o Lapolosak kulo rorei, nemilo oleng etalaita enapukoki ina.

English: Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people.
Masaai: Nelotu oltung'ani obo nejoki ninche, “Ng'ura! Ore lang'ole tung'ana litipika korokoroni, etii enkaji e Nkai eitashe aaiteng'en olorere.”

English: Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned.
Masaai: Nelo taa olkitok loo sikarini erikito sikarini lenyena neriku lkipaareta, kake eitu earu amu etureita olorere, meari ake ninche too soito.

English: And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them,
Masaai: Ore pee eriku, neitasheyie te dukuya enkiguana. Neikilikuan Olapolosani Kitok.

English: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.
Masaai: ajoki, “Kitutukunyakita apa intae nikintanap intae pee mintokiki ake aiteng'enisho te na arna: naa ng'ura! noolo intae ooibulunye Yerusalem pooki ena kiteng'enare inyi, ijojo pee iyauwu osarge le le tung'ani shumata iyiook.”

English: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men.
Masaai: Kake etawalikitia Petero o lelo kulikae kipaareta nejoki, “Enkai pae kining iyiook alang te nikining iltung'ana.

English: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom ye slew and hanged on a tree.
Masaai: Enkai oo loo papa naitopiwuo Yesu, lishomo intae aar, aashe to lchani.

English: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
Masaai: Ninye eilepie Enkai te nkaina enye e tatene metaa ninye Olaiguanani Kitok, neaku Olaitajeunoni, oisho Siraeli enkirridunoto o empalakinoto oo ng'ok.

English: And we are his witnesses of these things; and so is also the Holy Ghost, whom God hath given to them that obey him.
Masaai: Nikira iyiook lchakenini te kuna baa, naa shakeni Enkiyang'et Sinyati, naisho Enkai lelo ooning metoning'o ninche, nerem oltau nejo mataar.

English: When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche ena, negoro oleng neyieu near ninche metuata.

English: Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;
Masaai: Kake einyo obo le ina kiguana, loo Lfarisayo oji Gamaliel, laa olaiteng'enani kitok loo nkitanapat, oyanyit iltung'ana pooki, nejo meitupukuni lelo lewa te nkiti kata.

English: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
Masaai: Nejoki ninye ninche, “Lo lewa le Israel, entodol ake ate te kulo tung'ana, te na bae niyieuu nintaasiasa.

English: For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nought.
Masaai: Amu einyo apa ai kata Teudas, neitaa kewan likae taani kitok, nesuj iltung'ana oobaya iip ong'uan. Neari ninye, o lelo pooki ootoning'o ninye, neisardakieki, neaku pesho.

English: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed.
Masaai: Ore eshomo ilo neinyototo Yudas le Galilaya, too napa olong'i e nkikenare, nerik sii ninye ltung'ana ootusuja, neidaaya sii ninye; olelo pooki ootusuja, neisardak.

English: And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nought:
Masaai: Najoki naa nanu intae taata, entalam kulo tung'ana entapal. Amu tenaa kenoo ltung'ana ena kitobirata aashu ena siaai naa kebatata.

English: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
Masaai: kake te naa kene Nkai, nimindimidimi intae aatabatat ninche; naa entodol ake meaku Enkai iararere!”

English: And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.
Masaai: Nening ninche ina kikoo enye: ore pee eipotu lkipaareta meetu enetii, near, neitanap meitoki ake aairo te nkarna e Yesu, neisho epuo.

English: And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
Masaai: Nepuo ninche aaing'uaa ine netii enkiguana eng'ida etoduaa aajo keishiaakino ninche enkitamioto te nkaraki ina Arna.

English: And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i pooki, eitu egira ninche meiteng'enisho te nkaji e Nkai o too nkang'itie enye nchere ore Yesu, ninye Kristo.

English: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
Masaai: Ore apa te nena olong'i, eponari esiana oo looiteng'eni abul nejing olong'unyung'unyi erishata oo Lyahudi ooiro enkutuk oo Lgiriki o Lyahudi ooikini enkop enye. Ejo lelo loo Lgiriki eji eitololoikiaki inkolia enye te ndaa naorikini anaa ake.

English: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
Masaai: Neipot lelo Tomon o Aare esirit nalulung'a o looiteng'eni te nebo nejoki, “Meishiaakino te nikipal iyiook elikioroto o rorei le Nkai pee kitumoki aaisiaayia ltung'ana too mpesai.

English: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
Masaai: Ilalashera lang, entegelu intae iltung'ana oopishana liyiololo ti atua ate nchere kebore Enkiyang'et Sinyati nebore eng'eno, pee kincho lelo meitasheiki ena bae.

English: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
Masaai: Kake ore iyiook maate, enkomono kisheikino, o elikioroto e le rorei.”

English: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
Masaai: Neitiship ina walata ilo turrur pooki; negelu Stefano, oltung'ani naa obore enkirukoto o Enkiyang'et Sinyati, Filipo, Prokorus, o Nikanor, o Timos, o Parmenas o Nikolaus, oltung'ani leme oloo Lyahudi laa Antiok eing'uaa, oibelekenye apa ninye ang'amu enkirukoto oo Lyahudi.

English: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
Masaai: Neriku ilo turrur lelo aarikoki Lkipaareta; ore pee eomon, neiteleikini nkaik.

English: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
Masaai: Neponari ororei le Nkai, ore esiana oo looiteng'eni neponari oleng te Yerusalem, ore ilapolosak kumok neunokino enkirukoto.

English: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
Masaai: Ore Stefano, obore empiris o engolon, neas imbaa e nking'asia o olmonek ti atua olorere.

English: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
Masaai: Kake einyieito kulikae le nkaji e ntumo naji enoo Lkilakuno (amu neijia eji), o Lkirene, o le Aleksantria o Lkilikia o looing'uaa Asia, aaishankarrarre Stefano.

English: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
Masaai: Kake nelaikino aairisha eng'eno o Enkiyang'et nairorie Stefano.

English: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
Masaai: Nepuo too nkisudorot aarop iltung'ana ooetuo aajo, “Kitoning'o ninye eiro amor Musa, nemor Enkai.”

English: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
Masaai: Neinuaaki olorere, o lpayiani o laiteng'enak loo nkitanapat, nepuonu lelo enetii ninye, neibung aayaki enkiguana.

English: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
Masaai: Nesotu ltung'ana ooaku lchakenini le lejare, nejo lelo, “Megira ele tung'ani eitu esukeny ene wueji sinyati, nesukeny inkitanapat.

English: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
Masaai: Amu kitoning'o iyiook ninye ejo, eji keyooki ilo oji Yesu le Nasareti aar ene wueji, neibelekeny nkoon naaitanapa iyiook Musa.”

English: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ootii ina kiguana pee eing'or enkomom e Stefano, neyia anaa enkomom o lmalaika.

English: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
Masaai: Nejoki Olapolosani Kitok, “Ei neijia etiu nena baa?”

English: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,
Masaai: Nejo Stefano, “Ilalashera laainei, o loo papa! Entoning'oki! Enkai e nkitoo naipang'aka papa lang Abraham eton emanya Mesopotamia, eitu eidur alo Haran,

English: And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.
Masaai: nejoki, ‘Tung'uai olmarei linyi o enkop inyi, shomo enkop naautaki.’

English: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.
Masaai: Neaku etung'uayie enkop e Kaldea nelo amany Haran. Ore pee eitianya menye Abraham, nejoki Enkai meidurraki ena kop taata namanya intae.

English: And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child.
Masaai: Eitu taa eisho Enkai ninye hoo enkiti wueji metujung'o aitaa enenye, eitu hoo eisho enkiti rashe e nkop, kake eishoo Enkai ninye o siligi ajoki keaku ene ishoi enye eshomo ninye. Naa ore taa ejoki Enkai ninye neijia, meeta Abraham enkerai.

English: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
Masaai: Inji etiaaka Enkai ninye, ‘Kepuo kenya ilng'anayio linono aamany ai kop eeiking'a, nepuoi aaisinkanishore te ine neinyali too larin iip ong'uan.

English: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place.
Masaai: Kake kadung'oki enkiguana ilo orere oisinkanishore ejo Enkai. Naa ore te siadi neidurru te ina kop naapuonu aaserem nanu tene wueji.’

English: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham begat Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs.
Masaai: Neisho Enkai ina kata Abraham olkerreti le muratare. Abraham Isaak, nemurat te nkolong e isiet; Neiu Isaak Yakobo, neiu Yakobo lelo loo papa pokira tomon o aare.

English: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
Masaai: “Ore te nkaraki olom oatayie apa lelo loo papa Yosef, olalashe lenye, nemiraki Misiri, kake etii apa Enkai te nebo ninye,

English: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
Masaai: nesaru too sinaitin enyena pooki, neisho ninye omom o eng'eno nagut te dukuya Farao, olaiguanani le Misiri; neisho ninye meitoria Misiri neitore enkaji enye pooki.

English: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
Masaai: Neaku eewuo olameyu Misiri, o Kanaan, nelotu osina sapuk; nelau lelo loo papa entoki nanya.

English: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first.
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening Yakobo nchere keetae entapa te Misiri, neirriwaa lelo loo papa te nkata e nkiterata.

English: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.
Masaai: Ore te nkata e are neibalakinye Yosef kewan ilalashera lenyena, neyiolou Farao, olorere le Yosef.

English: Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls.
Masaai: Neirriwaa Yosef olkilikuai aipotu menye, Yakobo, o lmarei lenye pooki, iltung'ana oobaya ntomoni naapishana o miet.

English: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
Masaai: Nedoyio Yakobo alo Misiri, te ine eitianye ninye o lelo loo papa.

English: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
Masaai: Nenapuni seseni lenye aayau Shekem nenukari te nkurare apa nainyiang'ua Abraham ainyiang to layiok le Hamor te Shekem te nkosholai.

English: But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
Masaai: “Kake ore pee etaanu enkata apa naisiligie Enkai Abraham, nebul olorere oleng te Misiri,

English: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
Masaai: o metaba anaa netumi likae aiguanani kitok te Misiri lemeyiolo Yosef.

English: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
Masaai: Neesek ilo olorere lang, nearaki te ngolon iloo papa metanang'ai nkera naaini ong'ata peyie eye.

English: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:
Masaai: Te ina kata eini Musa naa sidai apa ninye oleng te dukuya Enkai; neitubuluni ninye lapaitin okuni te nkaji e menye:

English: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
Masaai: ore pee eyai ninye ong'ata, nedumu entito e Farao, neitubulu aitoti, neitaa olenye.

English: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words and in deeds.
Masaai: Neiteng'eni Musa aaishaki eng'eno pooki oo Lmisiri; neaku magilani to rorei o too nkiaasin.

English: And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel.
Masaai: “Ore pee eaku Musa oloo larin artam nejo kelo abaiki ilalashera lenyena.

English: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
Masaai: Nedol obo lenye einyalitai oltung'ani le Misiri; nelo amitu aitalaku te ilo Misiri near metua.

English: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
Masaai: (Aa kejo ninye keyiolou olorere lenye aajo ninye eyooki Enkai aisiaaishore elaku ninche te sinkaisho; kake eitu eyiolou ninche ina).

English: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them at one again, saying, Sirs, ye are brethren; why do ye wrong one to another?
Masaai: Ore te nkolong nasujita ina nedol Siraeli aare ooara, nejo aitaiki osotua. Nejoki, ‘Loyie, irara doi lalashera, ainyoo iorrorro pokira?’

English: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
Masaai: Kake eiponyayie ilo oinyal olikae nejoki, ‘Ai ng'ae doi likinchoo iyie ntoria nirish iyiook?

English: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
Masaai: Ijo sa pee kiaar matua anaa eninkuna olang'ole Misiri?’

English: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
Masaai: Neisik Musa te nkaraki ilo rorei, nelo aaku olomoni te nkop e Midian, nelo aiu layiok aare te ine.

English: And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush.
Masaai: “Ore etulusoitie larin artam, neipang'aki olmalaika ti ong'ata o ldoinyo le Sinai, te nchani nayupuyup.

English: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the Lord came unto him,
Masaai: Ore pee edol Musa neing'asiayie ina, nejo anyikaki adol, nelotu oltoilo lo Laitoriani ojo,

English: Saying, I am the God of thy fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold.
Masaai: ‘Ara Enkai oo loo minyi, Enkai e Abraham o Isaak, o Yakobo.’ Neikirikira Musa meitieu aing'ora.

English: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, ‘Talaku namuka too nkejek inono, amu ore ene nintasheyie, ewueji nesinya.

English: I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send thee into Egypt.
Masaai: Esipa nchere atoduaa osina loo ltung'ana laainei te Misiri, naning olkiyioi lenye, naewuo pee asaru: wou naa taata amu, kaairriwaa Misiri.’

English: This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush.
Masaai: “Olapa taa Musa ilo otanyaita ninche ejo, ‘Ai ng'ae doi likinchoo iyie ntoria nirish iyiook?’ Ninye eirriwaka Enkai metaa oloitore nesaru te nkaina e ilo malaika oipang'aka to lnchani.

English: He brought them out, after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years.
Masaai: Ilo tung'ani otorikuo, eidipa ataasa ine nking'asia o nkitoduaat te Misiri o te naiposha nanyokie, o ti ong'ata, larin artam.

English: This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall ye hear.
Masaai: Ilo Musa otiaaka nkera e Siraeli, ‘Keputoki intae Enkai oloiboni too lalashera linyi, leeijo nanu.’

English: This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us:
Masaai: Olapa taa otii atua ina siamo ti ong'ata te nebo olmalaika apa oirorie ninye to ldoinyo le Sinai, neirorie loo papa netang'amua sii nkitanapat naaishu naaishoo iyiook.

English: To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt,
Masaai: Ninye eitu ening iloo papa, neaku etaaraitie aarishie ate, nerrinyo ltauja lenye aaito Misiri,

English: Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
Masaai: nejoki Aaron, ‘Ntobiraki iyiook inkaitin naarik iyiook; amu ore ele oji Musa, otorikuo iyiook aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, mikiyiolo inaanoto ninye.’

English: And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands.
Masaai: Neitobiru enkitanyaanyukoto o lashe te nena olong'i, neyaki lasarri lenye enkitanyaanyukoto, neng'idakino esiaai oo nkaik enye.

English: Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O ye house of Israel, have ye offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness?
Masaai: Kake eibelekenya Enkai neishooyo ninche meteserema lakir le shumata anaa enatisiraki aajo te mbuku oo loibonok le Enkai, ‘Ei nanu nchoo ng'uesi naayieng'i o, te lelo arin pokira artam ti ong'ata, na aji e Siraeli?

English: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.
Masaai: Itudumutua olng'obor le Molok, o lakira le nkai e Rafan, nkitanyaanyukot nintobirakita ate iteserema; kaidurrie naa intae aitogiroo Babilon.’

English: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen.
Masaai: “Neeta apa iloo papa olapa ng'obor le shakeni ti ong'ata. Neitobiraki ninye ilo anaa enaitanapa Enkai Musa meiturubare anaa enaitoduaaki.

English: Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drave out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David;
Masaai: Ilo ng'obor enyaakita loo papa aanapu te nebo Yoshua pee epuonu aajung enkop etaarayie Enkai kulikae oreren aing'atarie ninche, Nebik ilo ng'obor o metabaiki enkata e Daudi.

English: Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.
Masaai: Enoto ninye kirotetisho te Enkai, neomonu meishoo meteshetaki Enkai e Yakobo enkaji.

English: But Solomon built him an house.
Masaai: Kake Solomon oteshetaka enkaji.

English: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands; as saith the prophet,
Masaai: Hoo nememany Olotii Shumata Aisul te pooki inkajijik naashetuni too nkaik: ana enatejo oloiboni,

English: Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will ye build me? saith the Lord: or what is the place of my rest?
Masaai: ‘Olorika lai le nkitoo shumata, naa olorika loo nkejek aainei enkop. Kenkaji natiu aja pasa kishetakiki? Olaitoriani ojo: Naa kaji ine nayeng'iyeng'are?

English: Hath not my hand made all these things?
Masaai: Mme nkaina ai naitobira kuna pooki?’

English: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, ye do always resist the Holy Ghost: as your fathers did, so do ye.
Masaai: “Lo tung'ana oosho murto, lememurata ltauja nememurata nkiyiaa, igolong'akiki oshi ake Enkiyang'et Sinyati; ore enapake nataasa iloo minyi, neijia nkona sii intae.

English: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers:
Masaai: Kalo oiboni eitu einyal iloo minyi? Netara metuata lelo apa ooitera aalimu elotunoto e ilo obo supat, lietuo intae aaitarasaa niariaara metua;

English: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.
Masaai: naa intae ootang'amutua nkitanapat, anaa enaishorutua lmalaika kake eitu ntabayaya.”

English: When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ening kuna baa, neminisu neonyiki lala te ngoro.

English: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
Masaai: Ore ninye, eiganya Enkiyang'et Sinyati neitirring'a aing'or shumata, nedol enkitoo e Enkai o Enkerai e Tung'ani eitashe te nkaina e tatene e Enkai,

English: And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God.
Masaai: nejo, “Ng'ura, adolita etabole shumata, neitashe Enkerai e Tung'ani te nkaina e tatene e Enkai.

English: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
Masaai: Kake etabuaa ninche to ltoilo sapuk, neiken inkiyiaa enye, neitiamaki pooki te nebo;

English: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.
Masaai: nearaa auluo e ina anasa neirrui too soito: ore lelo ootaa shakeni neirragie nkilani enye te nkalo oo nkejek o lbarnoti oji Saulo.

English: And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.
Masaai: Neirrui ninche Stefano too soito, eomonito ninye Olaitoriani, ejo, “Olaitoriani Yesu, tang'amai enkiyang'et ai.”

English: And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.
Masaai: Negil kung, nebuak ajo to ltoilo sapuk, “Olaitoriani, mintalak ninche ena ng'oki.” Ore pee ejo neijia, neirura.

English: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.
Masaai: Netonyorrayie sii ninye Saulo ina keeya, nataaraki ninye. Nedumakino ina olong ake osina kitok ina sirit oo looiruko natii Yerusalem, neidapashakino pooki olkirine pooki le Yudea o le Samaria, ilkipaareta ake otelekutua.

English: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
Masaai: Nedumunye ltung'ana asayiak le Enkai aapuo aanukaa Stefano, eishiraki to ltoilo sapuk.

English: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.
Masaai: Kake etetema ninye Saulo ajo amut ina sirit, oi aa lewa arashu nkituaak, nejing'aki too nkajijik, neikurtutaa anang'aki korokoroni.

English: Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo ooidapashakinote nena kuapi nepuo ninche aalikioo ilo rorei.

English: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them.
Masaai: Nelo Filipo enkanasa oo Samaria neinosaki ninche Kristo.

English: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
Masaai: Ore ina siamo pooki neinining oleng, neng'amu pooki te nebo ilo rorei oinosaka Filipo, te nebo ilo rorei oinosaka Filipo, etoning'o nedol ninche nkitoduaat naataasa.

English: For unclean spirits, crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed.
Masaai: Amu ore lkumok lenye te neeta loiriruani torrok, nepuku aaing'uaa eishir to ltoilo sapuk: ore lkumok ooilenyate o lmaiman, neishiunyeki.

English: And there was great joy in that city.
Masaai: Nejing eng'ida sapuk ina anasa.

English: But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:
Masaai: Kake eetae apa oltung'ani obo te ine oji Simon oosh enkidong te ina anasa, neing'asiayie ilo orere le Samaria, eitaa kewan likae taani kitok,

English: To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.
Masaai: nening pooki ninye oloti o lbotor, ejo, “Ore ele tung'ani, ele taa oshi enoshi naji ‘Engolon Kitok Enkai.’ ”

English: And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries.
Masaai: Neinining ninche ninye amu keing'asiayie ninche te nkata naado, eing'asiayie nena kidong'i enyena.

English: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
Masaai: Kake ore pee epuonu aairuk ilomon supati le nkitoria e Enkai ooinosu Filipo, neimaka enkarna e Yesu Kristo, neibatisae ninche ndung'ot pokira, ilewa o nkituaak.

English: Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done.
Masaai: O meiruko sii ninye Simon; ore pee eibatisae, neaku Filipo eisiritore. Ore pee edol nkitoduaat o mbaa sapuki e ngolon naas Filipo neitoki ninye aing'asia.

English: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent unto them Peter and John:
Masaai: Ore pee ening lekua kipaareta ootii Yerusalem nchere etang'amutua iltung'ana loo Samaria ororei le Enkai, neirriwaki Petero o Yohana.

English: Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya ninche, neomonoki lelo ooiruko pee eng'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati;

English: (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.)
Masaai: amu eton apa meetae olenye otadoikio Enkiyang'et Sinyati, keidipaki ake aaibatisa te nkarna o Laitoriani Yesu.

English: Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Neiteleiki Petero o Yohana ninche nkaik neng'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
Masaai: Ore taa pee edol Simon ajo te neiteleiki lkipaareta oltung'ani nkaik neishori ilo Enkiyang'et Sinyati, neisho Petero o Yohana mpesai,

English: Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: nejoki, “Enchooki sii ninye nanu ena kidimata paa ore ake oltung'ani laiteleiki nkaik neng'amu Enkiyang'et Sinyati.”

English: But Peter said unto him, Thy money perish with thee, because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Petero ninye, “Indaa o nena pesai inono! Amu itejo ainosie enkishorunoto e Enkai mpesai!

English: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter: for thy heart is not right in the sight of God.
Masaai: Miata iyie ematua aashu erubata te na bae. Amu meisiriri oltau lino ti alo Enkai.

English: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.
Masaai: Irridu naa enkarrueisho ino niomon Olaitoriani pee idol te naa eikipalakini ina yieunoto o ltau lino.

English: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity.
Masaai: Amu adol ajo kibore enduaran o lodua, niteenikine atua ng'ok.”

English: Then answered Simon, and said, Pray ye to the Lord for me, that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me.
Masaai: Newaliki Simon ajoki, “Entoomonokoki intae to Laitoriani pee maatum ake nena baa pooki nitejo.”

English: And they, when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee eidip aaitadedeyie neinosaa ororei lo Laitoriani, nerrinyori aapuo Yerusalem, neimaa nkang'itie kumok oo Samaria, einosaa ilo rorei supat.

English: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert.
Masaai: Kake eirorie olmalaika lo Laitoriani Filipo nejoki, “Inyo tanapayu shomo enkalo e kopikop, enkalo e idia oitoi oshi naing'uaa Yerusalem elo Gasa, (enoshi e mpusel).”

English: And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem for to worship,
Masaai: Neinyototo alo. Naa ng'ura! Nedol oltung'ani kitok le Etiopia. Naa osunash ele tung'ani naa kitok te nkitoria e Kandake, aa taa, enkaiguenani kitok e Etiopia. Naa ilo tung'ani oitore masaa enyena pooki. Neewuo ilo Yerusalem aseremisho:

English: Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Esaias the prophet.
Masaai: paa enkop enye errinyo alo, neton te ngarri enye oo mbartan aisum embuku o loiboni le Nkai oji Isaya.

English: Then the Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, and join thyself to this chariot.
Masaai: Nejoki Enkiyang'et Sinyati Filipo, “Shomo tinyikaki, turubare ina garri.”

English: And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Esaias, and said, Understandest thou what thou readest?
Masaai: Nekuet Filipo alo enetii, nening ajo embuku e Isaya eisuma, neikilikuan ajoki, “Ining'u sa nena baa nisumita?”

English: And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Kaji aiko te naning'u eitu atum oltung'ani laautaa?” Neikilikuan Filipo meilepaki ina garri enye aton atashare.

English: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
Masaai: Ore ine wueji neisuma ilo tung'ani too lkigerot naa ewueji nejo, “Etorikoki anaa olkuoo le ker opuoi aayieng; anaa enoshi ker nemebol enkutuk edung'i ilpapit, eitu sii ninye ebol enkutuk enye.

English: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
Masaai: Ore te nborron enye, neoruni ninye esipata: naa ae ng'ae naa olimu eishoi enye? Amu eisha enkishui enye te nkop.”

English: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
Masaai: Newaliki ilo kitok sunash Filipo nejoki, “Aatasayia tolikioki, ae ng'ae doi eimaki ele oiboni le Nkai, ai kewan eimaki anaa ai likae?”

English: Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus.
Masaai: Nebol taa Filipo enkutuk neiteru te ilo kigeroto, neinosaki ninye ilomon supati le Yesu.

English: And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what doth hinder me to be baptized?
Masaai: Ore epuoito, nebaiki ewueji netii enkare. Nejo ilo sunash, “Nena enkare ainyoo namit aaibatisai?”

English: And Philip said, If thou believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
