Masaai: Nejoki Filipo ninye, “Kindimi pae aaibatisa te naa iruko iyie to ltau lino pooki.” Nejo, “Airuko nchere Yesu Kristo oinoti le Enkai.”

English: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
Masaai: Neitanapisho meitasheyieki engarri; nedoyio pokira aare aapuo enkare, Filipo o ilo sunash, neibatisae ninye.

English: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
Masaai: Ore pee eilepu ninche te nkare, newuapaa Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani Filipo te ine. Neitu eitoki ilo sunash adol, nelo ninye enkop enye te ng'ida.

English: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
Masaai: Nelo Filipo amaniki kewan etii Asotos. Ore eim ine, neinosaka ilo rorei supat te nena ang'itie pooki o metabai Kaisaria.

English: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
Masaai: Kake ore eton ake eiture Saulo nejo aar metuata ilooiteng'eni lo Laitoriani, nelo enetii Olapolosani Kitok

English: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: aomon impala lelo ooitore nkajijik e ntumo te Dameski, paa te netum iloosujita ina Oitoi te ine, neidim atipika nkaik, aa lewa o aa nkituaak, neriku Yerusalem eena.

English: And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven:
Masaai: Neaku ore etii enkoitoi eloito netinyikaka Dameski, neimerlelu nabo kata ewang'an naing'uaa keper neman ninye.

English: And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?
Masaai: Nebatata aosh enkop nening oltoilo ojoki, “Saulo, Saulo, aainyoo pee kinosie osina?”

English: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
Masaai: Neikilikuan ajoki, “Eira ng'ae, Olaitoriani.” Nejoki, “Ara Yesu linosie osina;

English: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
Masaai: kake inyo tijing'a ena anasa paa te ine kilikini eniaas.”

English: And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man.
Masaai: Neisirng'ang'a lelo ooisiritore ninye negira aaitashe, naa oltoilo ake etoning'o neitu edol oltung'ani.

English: And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.
Masaai: Neinyototo Saulo nebol inkonyek, nemedol toki. Neaku enkaina eibung'aki aarik atua Dameski.

English: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
Masaai: Neya nkolong'i uni aa modooni nemedaa nemeok toki.

English: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord.
Masaai: Neetae oloiteng'eni te Dameski oji Ananias. Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye te nduaata, “Ananias,” nejo ninye, “nele nanu, Olaitoriani.”

English: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
Masaai: Nejoki Olaitoriani ninye, “Inyo shomo enoshi oitoi naji Naisiriri, nkilikuanu te nkaji e Yudas oltung'ani le Tarso oji Saulo; amu ng'ura, eomonito ninye,

English: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight.
Masaai: netoduaa oltung'ani te nduaata oji Ananias elotu enetii aiteleiki nkaik pee eitoki adolishoyu.”

English: Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem:
Masaai: Kake etawalikia Ananias nejoki, “Olaitoriani, atoning'oyie ele tung'ani too ltung'ana kumok, eneba entorroni naitaasa isinyat linono te Yerusalem;

English: And here he hath authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on thy name.
Masaai: naa ore te ne keeta enkidimata naisho lapolosak kituaak naenie lelo pooki ooipot enkarna ino.”

English: But the Lord said unto him, Go thy way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel:
Masaai: Kake etiaka Olaitoriani, “Shomo amu, emasaai ai nageluno ninye pee eya enkarna ai aitayiolo iloreren, o laiguanak o nkera e Israel;

English: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
Masaai: amu kaliki nanu eneba enkitamioto naitamei ninye te nkaraki enkarna ai.”

English: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Nelo Ananias nejing ina aji, neiteleiki ninye nkaik nejoki, “Olalashe lai Saulo, ilo likimpang'aka te nkoitoi niimua, Yesu kewan laairriwua pee ngil adolishoyu, nikingany Enkiyang'et Sinyati.”

English: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized.
Masaai: Ore ina kata ake neing'abobunye entoki neeijo lpala too nkonyek enyena neitoki a dolishoyu. Neinyototo neibatisae.

English: And when he had received meat, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus.
Masaai: Ore pee enya endaa netum engolon. Nebik Saulo te nebo o lelo ooiteng'eni otii Dameski nkolong'i naaje.

English: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata ake too nkajijik e ntumo nelikioo ninye Yesu, nejo, “Enkerai e Enkai ninye.”

English: But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came hither for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests?
Masaai: Neing'asia lelo pooki ootoning'o ninye nejo, “Ai mme olapa tung'ani ele oitayio ntabo te Yerusalem ear lelo ooipot ena arna? Naa ina pee eewuo ene, pee etum ateena kulo neyaki lapolosak kituaak?”

English: But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ.
Masaai: Kake etoponari ninye Saulo agolu, neitala enkalo Ilyahudi ootii Dameski eitadedeyie nchere ore Yesu ninye Kristo.

English: And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him:
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkolong'i kumok, netumo Lyahudi aaiguana peyie ear ninye metua;

English: But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.
Masaai: Kake etayiolo Saulo ina kiguana enye. Neaku kerrip nkishomin e ina anasa dama o kewarie, pee eari ninye metua;

English: Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket.
Masaai: kake neaku etoriko ilooiteng'eni lenyena ninye kewarie, neitadooyo te suntai e ina anasa, neililioo te nkikapu o metadoi.

English: And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple.
Masaai: Ore pee elo Saulo Yerusalem netem ajo ashulare lelo ooiteng'eni le ine, kake etureita ninche pooki, amu meiruk ninche aajo etaa ninye oloiteng'eni.

English: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus.
Masaai: Kake etudumua Barnabas ninye, nerikoki lkipaareta, neinosaki ninche eneikuna pee edol Olaitoriani te nkoitoi, neirorie ninye, o naataasa te Dameski alikioo enkarna e Yesu te mpijan.

English: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Neparana o lelo neibulu Yerusalem pooki,

English: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
Masaai: nelikioo lomon te mpijan te nkarna o Laitoriani. Neiro aishankarrarre lelo ooiro enkutuk oo Lyunani; neaku kejo maing'oru aasesekuan.

English: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou ilalashera, neitadou aariku Kaisari, neirriwaa meshomo Tarso.

English: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.
Masaai: Netum esirit eseriani te Yudea pooki o te Galilaya o te Samaria neitubuluni; nelotie enkuretisho o Laitoriani neitagol Enkiyang'et Sinyati, neponari.

English: And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda.
Masaai: Neaku kelo Petero idie o idie abaiki ninche pooki o meeu enetii isinyat oomanya Luda.

English: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
Masaai: Netum oltung'ani otii ine oji Aeneas oirraga te rruat larin isiet naa keilenye.

English: And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
Masaai: Nejoki Petero ninye, “Aeneas, kinchiunye Yesu; inyo ntobira erruat ino.” Neinyototo nabo kata.

English: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord.
Masaai: Nedol iltung'ana pooki oomanya Luda o Sharon ninye neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani.

English: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and almsdeeds which she did.
Masaai: Neetae te ine te Yopa enaiteng'eni naji Tabisa, (eji Dorkas arashu Enkoilii). Naa kumok isiaaitin sidain o nkiaasin o lng'ur naataasa ninye.

English: And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i nemueyu neye. Ore pee eidip ninche aaisuja, nepuo aairragie to lgilata le shumata.

English: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them.
Masaai: Ore amu kenyikita Luda Yopa, ore pee ening ilooiteng'eni nchere etii Petero ine, neirriwuaki lewa aare nesai aajoki, “Wou sii ake ene nikitii nimimutie.”

English: Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them.
Masaai: Neinyototo Petero airiamariyie ninche. Ore pee ebau, nerik ninche ninye ilo gilata le shumata. Neitashoo nkolia pooki te ine aatashare ninye eishirita, neitodol lngotin o nkilani naatiripaka apa Dorkas eton eboitare ninche.

English: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
Masaai: Kake eipang'ie Petero ninche pooki boo negil kung aomon: neitoki aibelekenyakino ilo sesen nejoki, “Tabisa, topiu!” Nebol ninye nkonyek enyena, ore pee edol Petero, neinyototo aton.

English: And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive.
Masaai: Neitarasaki ninye enkaina neitasheyie. Neitoki taa aipot lelo sinyat o nena olia neitarasaki ninche eishu.

English: And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord.
Masaai: Neyiolouni ina bae te Yopa pooki, neiruk ilkumok Olaitoriani.

English: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
Masaai: Nebik inkolong'i kumok te Yopa te nkaji e Simon, olaitobirani loo lonito.

English: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
Masaai: Etii apa Kaisaria, oltung'ani oji Kornelio, laa osajini kitok te sikari oo Roma naji, “Esirit oo Ltalian.”

English: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
Masaai: Oltung'ani apa aseremani neure Enkai ninye o enkaji enye pooki, naa aminin naleng too ltung'ana aisinak loo Lyahudi, neomon ninye Enkai anaa ake.

English: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
Masaai: Ore nabo olong anaa saa naaudo e ndama, nedol te nduaata eibale olmalaika le Enkai elotu enetii, nejoki, “Kornelio!”

English: And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God.
Masaai: Ore ninye, nekurraki nkonyek te nkirutoto nejoki, “Ainyoo lo Kitok?” Nejoki ninye, “Etadamua Enkai enkomono ino o enkaminino ino o lng'ur.

English: And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter:
Masaai: Irriwai naa taata ltung'ana meshomo Yopa, aariku Simon oji Petero,

English: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
Masaai: laa olomoni te nkaji e likae oji Simon, olaitobirani loo lonito, omanya embata e naiposha.”

English: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
Masaai: Ore pee elo ilo malaika aing'uaa ninye, neipot ilaisiaayiak aare le nkaji enye, o sikari obo oserem Enkai, oisiritore ninye anaa ake.

English: And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa.
Masaai: Ore pee einosaki nena pooki naatotiwuo neirriwaa ninche Yopa.

English: On the morrow, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour:
Masaai: Ore taaisere, etii lelo enkoitoi, etinyikakita ina anasa, nelo Petero aomon te shumata enkaji, etaa enaipirie enkolong.

English: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
Masaai: Netir ninye esumash oleng, neyieu endaa. Kake ore eton eitobiritai, neimug aidetidet.

English: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
Masaai: Nedol shumata etabole nedou entoki neeijo olkarasha oililio too lcholo pokira oong'uan eililiunye adoiki enkop;

English: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
Masaai: nebore ng'uesi pooki oo nkejek maa ong'uan o naaikurtutari te nkop o motonyi e shumata.

English: And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat.
Masaai: Nelotu oltoilo ojoki ninye, “Inyo Petero, teyiang'a nosa.”

English: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean.
Masaai: Kake etiaka Petero, “Mme neijia Olaitoriani; amu eitu ai kata anya nanu entoki naiduruk anaa enturuj.”

English: And the voice spake unto him again the second time, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
Masaai: Neigil ake oltoilo alotu enetii nejoki, “Ore entoki naa Enkai naitukuo, nimintaa iyie enturuj.”

English: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
Masaai: Neigilieki ina bae katitin uni: neito ilo karasha keper.

English: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,
Masaai: Ore enoshi kata eing'asie ninye Petero oleng eiguana makewan aing'oru enajoki ina duaata natamanikia, ng'ura! noolo lang'ole tung'ana ooirriwua Kornelio, ooikilikuanu enkaji e Simon ooitashe te kishomi.

English: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.
Masaai: Neipotisho aaikilikuanu te naa ketii Simon oji Petero ina aji.

English: While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee.
Masaai: Ore eton edamu Petero ina natamanikia, nejoki Enkiyang'et ninye, “Ng'ura, nelelo ltung'ana okuni liking'oru.

English: Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.
Masaai: Kake inyo, tadoi shomo, naa iriamariyie, nimiaata ake olng'ash, amu nanu oirriwua ninche.”

English: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom ye seek: what is the cause wherefore ye are come?
Masaai: Nedoyio Petero alo enetii lelo tung'ana, nejoki, “Ng'ura, nanu ele doi ling'oruru; ainyoo nayawua intae?”

English: And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that feareth God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house, and to hear words of thee.
Masaai: Nejo ninche, “Kornelio, osajini kitok, oltung'ani supat oserem Enkai naa yioloti eyanyit olorere pooki loo Lyahudi, eirriwaka Enkai olmalaika neirorie ajoki mikirriwaki olkilikuai wou shomo enkaji enye, meshomo ninye aning irorei lijoki.”

English: Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the morrow Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him.
Masaai: Nepuonu aji neisho ninche enkirragata. Ore pee ekenyu neinyototo airiamariyie ninche, nerik kulikae alashera ooing'uaa Yopa aitaa encholiek.

English: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
Masaai: Ore taaisere nejing Kaisaria. Neanyita Kornelio ninche, neipoto aiturrur olmarei lenye pooki o lchoreta le latia enye.

English: And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku eewuo Petero ajing ine, nenang'are Kornelio ninye nebatata te nkalo oo nkejek enyena aserami.

English: But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man.
Masaai: Kake eitasheyie Petero ninye, nejoki, “Inyo ntasho. Kara sii nanu makewan oltung'ani ake.”

English: And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together.
Masaai: Ore eirorie, nejing aji, neinepu etasotote ltung'ana kumok:

English: And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.
Masaai: nejoki ninche, “Iyiololo intae pooki aajo kemito ena amu meshulare oltung'ani loo Lyahudi ole likae orere, nemejing enkaji enye; paa Enkai naatiaaka nanu mijo ake enturuj likae tung'ani nimijo mesinya;

English: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me?
Masaai: naa ina pee aaipotoki nalotu neitu aing'ash. Naikilikuan naa intae ajoki, aainyoo pee kietuo aaipot?”

English: And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,
Masaai: Nejoki Kornelio ninye, “Ong'uan ade taata nkolong'i naashomo, are aomonito anaa oshi ake saa naaudo e ndama te nkaji ai; ng'ura, neitashe oltung'ani oimerlel nkilani te dukuya nanu,

English: And said, Cornelius, thy prayer is heard, and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God.
Masaai: nejo, ‘Kornelio! Etoning'oki enkomono ino, netadamua Enkai enkaminino ino o lng'ur too laisinak.

English: Send therefore to Joppa, and call hither Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he cometh, shall speak unto thee.
Masaai: Irriwai naa lkiliku Yopa, meipoto Simon oji Petero; naa olomoni ninye te nkaji e Simon laa olaitobirani loo lonito, omanya embata e naiposha.’

English: Immediately therefore I sent to thee; and thou hast well done that thou art come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded thee of God.
Masaai: Naairriwaki ltung'ana te ina kata ake; nintobira naa iewuo. Ore naa etiu neijia, noolo iyiook pooki ootii ene te dukuya Enkai, pee kining nena pooki nikintanapa ninye tejo.”

English: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:
Masaai: Nebol Petero enkutuk enye nejo, “Esipa atayiolo nchere ore Enkai, meeta olkep,

English: But in every nation he that feareth him, and worketh righteousness, is accepted with him.
Masaai: kake ore pooki ng'ae oure ninye aa ololorere ora, neas isupati te Enkai, nenyorraa ninye.

English: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:)
Masaai: Iyiololo intae olapa rorei oirriwaka nkera oo Siraeli, otolikioyioki lomon supati lo sotua te Yesu Kristo (olaa ninye Olaitoriani le pooki),

English: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
Masaai: ilo rorei ilo liyiololo intae maate, oitadarayioki te Yudea pooki, aaiteru te Galilaya, eidipe enkibatisa apa nalikioo Yohana.

English: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.
Masaai: Yesu le Nasareti etuputo Enkai te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o engolon nelotoo aas isupati, neishiunye lelo pooki ooibooko oloirirua enkop, amu ketii naa Enkai te nebo ninye.

English: And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree:
Masaai: Nikira iyiook shakeni le nena baa pooki naataasa te nkop oo Lyahudi, o te Yerusalem. Ninye doi etara ninche, aashe to lchani.

English: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
Masaai: Neitopiu Enkai ninye te nkolong e uni, neishoru metodoli,

English: Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before of God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead.
Masaai: neme too ltung'ana pooki, kake te lelo apake ootegelua Enkai te dukuya metaa lchakenini, naa iyiook lelo ootang'arie endaa kiokisho te nebo ninye eidipa atopiu too lootuata.

English: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
Masaai: Ninye oitanapa iyiook matolikioi too ltung'ana pooki, nikinchakenoki nchere ninye osiruno te Enkai metaa oloiguanaki ilooishu o lootuata.

English: To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins.
Masaai: Ninye eitaikitia iloibonok le Enkai pooki shakenisho, nchere ore pooki oiruk enkarna enye netum empalakinoto oo ng'ok.”

English: While Peter yet spake these words, the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word.
Masaai: Ore eton ejoito Petero kulo rorei, nedoiki Enkiyang'et Sinyati lelo pooki ootoning'o ilo rorei.

English: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Ore pee edol lelo airukok Lyahudi neing'asia, lelo taa ooiriamunore Petero, te nkaraki natubukokoki sii ninche Loreren enkishorunoto e Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
Masaai: Amu ketoning'o ninche eiro te kulie kutukie aaisis Enkai. Newaliki Petero nejo,

English: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
Masaai: “Keetae oltung'ani omit enkare ajo meibatisai kulo ootang'amutua Enkiyang'et Sinyati anaa enikitang'amutua apa sii iyiook?”

English: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.
Masaai: Neitanapisho meibatisai te nkarna e Yesu Kristo Nesai ninche ninye metobiko nkuti olong'i.

English: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
Masaai: Neaku etoning'o apa ilkipaareta o lalashera ootii Yudea nchere etang'amutua sii ninche loreren ororei le Enkai.

English: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him,
Masaai: Ore pee eilepu Petero alotu Yerusalem, neishankarrarre lelo le muratare ninye,

English: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
Masaai: aajoki, “Ishomo iyie ajing enetii Lmemurata, nilo ang'arie endaa.”

English: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
Masaai: Kake eiterua Petero aibalakinye ina bae osupatei, ajoki,

English: I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me:
Masaai: “Enkanasa naji Yopa apa atii naomonito: naainepu enduaata, e ntoki natiu anaa olkarasha oing'uaa shumata oitadouni too lcholo pokira oong'uan, nelotu enatii.

English: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee akurraki nkonyek aing'or, nadol ajo, ng'uesi e nkop oo nkejek maa ong'uan, o ng'uesi e ong'ata, o ntokitin naaikurtutari o motonyi e shumata.

English: And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat.
Masaai: Naning sii oltoilo laajoki, ‘Inyo, Petero, teyiang'a naa nosa.’

English: But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth.
Masaai: Kake atejo, ‘Olaitoriani, Mme neijia, amu eitu ae kata eim enkutuk ai entoki e nturuj anaa enemesinya.’

English: But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God hath cleansed, that call not thou common.
Masaai: Kake aatawalikia ilo toilo ajoki te nkata e are eing'uaa keper, ‘Ore entoki naitisinya Enkai, nimintaa iyie enturuj.’

English: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
Masaai: Neikoni neijia katitin uni, neitokini aainyaaya pooki keper.

English: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, eitashe ina kata ltung'ana okuni ti auluo ina aji nikitii, eirriwuaki eing'uaa Kaisaria pee epuonu enatii.

English: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:
Masaai: Naajoki Enkiyang'et maturubare, nemapik olng'ash. Naairiamariyie kulo alashera pokira ile; nikijing enkaji e ilo tung'ani.

English: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter;
Masaai: Neliki ninye iyiook olmalaika otoduaa te nkaji enye, nejoki, ‘Irriwai ltung'ana Yopa, mpoto Simon oji Petero;

English: Who shall tell thee words, whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved.
Masaai: pee kilotu aliki irorei lijeunye, iyie o enkaji ino pooki.’

English: And as I began to speak, the Holy Ghost fell on them, as on us at the beginning.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee aiter airo nedoiki ninche Enkiyang'et Sinyati, anaa apa enatadoikio iyiook te nkiterunoto.

English: Then remembered I the word of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Nadamu ororei lo Laitoriani, otejo apa, te nkare eibatisishe Yohana, kake keibatisae intae te Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?
Masaai: Amaa naa te neishoo Enkai ninche enkishorunoto neeijo enapa naishoo ninye iyiook pee kiruk Olaitoriani Yesu Kristo kara nanu ng'ae oibooyo Enkai?”

English: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.
Masaai: Ore pee ening ninche nena baa negira neisis Enkai nejo, “Eishoo naa Enkai sii ninche Loreren enkirridunoto nayau puaan.”

English: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.
Masaai: Neaku ore lelo ooisardakieki to lapa sina otupukuo te nkaraki Stefano nepuo o metabaiki Foenike o Kupro o Antiokia, naa Lyahudi ake einosakita ilo rorei.

English: And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: Kake etii kulikae lenye, ltung'ana ooing'uaa Kupro o Kirene, laa ore pee ebaya Antiokia neinosaki sii ninche Ilyunani, nelikioo Olaitoriani Yesu.

English: And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord.
Masaai: Neiriamariyie engolon o Laitoriani ninche; ore lkumok ooiruko neibelekenyakino Olaitoriani.

English: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch.
Masaai: Nebaiki ina nataasa ninche nkiyiaa e ina sirit natii Yerusalem: neirriwaa ninche Barnaba meshomo Antiokia.

English: Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord.
Masaai: Ore pee ebaya, nedol enkiaas e mpiris e Nkai, neng'ida, neisisaki pooki nejoki metaa ilooisiligayu to Laitoriani te nkitashoto nauno oo ltauja.

English: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Ghost and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord.
Masaai: Amu oltung'ani supat ninye obore Enkiyang'et Sinyati o enkirukoto. Neponikino Olaitoriani olturrur sapuk.

English: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
Masaai: Neaku eshomo Barnaba Tarso aing'oru Saulo.

English: And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.
Masaai: Ore pee etum, neriku Antiokia. Neya olari olulung'a etumore ake ina sirit, neiteng'en esiamo kitok e ilo orere; naa te Antiokia eiteraki aajo ilooiteng'eni Ilkristiano.

English: And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch.
Masaai: Ore te nena olong'i nepuonu loibonok le Nkai ooing'uaa Yerusalem aapuo Antiokia.

English: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.
Masaai: Ore obo lenye oji Agabus neinyototo aibonu te Nkiyang'et ajo kelotu olameyu kitok e nkop pooki; (neewuo ina aaku too nkolong'i e Klaudius).

English: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:
Masaai: Nedung ilooiteng'eni anaa ake enaidima oltung'ani, aajo keirriwaki eretoto ilalashera oomanya Yudea.

English: Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.
Masaai: Neiko neijia, neyaki lpayiani too nkaik e Barnaba o Saulo.

English: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
Masaai: Ore te ina kata neibung olaiguanani Herode kulikae tung'ana le ina sirit pee einosie osina.

English: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
Masaai: Nejo ninye metaari Yakobo olalashe Yohana to lalem.

English: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
Masaai: Ore pee edol ajo keitiship ina Lyahudi, neitulus aibung sii Petero. Naa to sirua loo Nkolong'i oo Mukateni Nemeisuijieki.

English: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.
Masaai: Ore pee eya Petero, nepik korokoroni, neitarasaki ndung'ot ong'uan oo sikarini maa oong'uan metorripo ninye, aa kejo pee eyooki arikoki olorere etulusoyie osirua oji Pasaka.

English: Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him.
Masaai: Nerripi Petero te korokoroni; kake eitirrisha ina sirit aasai Enkai naleng te nkaraki ninye.

English: And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison.
Masaai: Ore ina kewarie, etaa kejo Herode pee elaku Petero, ore te ina kewarie ake, neirura Petero te rishata isikarini aare, neenikino lelo pokira too munyororoni: nerripito kulikae sikarini kutuk aji e ina korokoroni.

English: And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he smote Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura! Neitashe olmalaika lo Laitoriani atashare ninye, neitawang ewang'an ina aji: neosh ilo Petero ematua, neinyeyie, nejoki, “Inyo tasioki?” Neitiaari inaduoo munyororoni naatii nkaik te ine.

English: And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
Masaai: Nejoki olmalaika ninye, “Terretenayu, nchopo namuka.” Neiko neijia. Nejoki, “Nchopo olkila tusujuaki.”

English: And he went out, and followed him; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision.
Masaai: Neipung alo nesujaa sii ninye: neton meyiolo ajo kesipa ina naasita olmalaika, kejo kenduaata ake.

English: When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him.
Masaai: Ore pee egiroo larripok le dukuya o li aare, nepuonu kishomi e sekenkei naipang'aki ina anasa; nebolo openy neipung aapuo, negiroo neng'eliki ai oitoi nabo nelo nabo kata olmalaika, ainguaa ninye.

English: And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know of a surety, that the Lord hath sent his angel, and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews.
Masaai: Ore pee eputunye Petero ayiolou enaasita, nejo, “Atayiolo taa taata ajo Olaitoriani oirriwua olmalaika lenye maatasaru ang'adie enkaina e Herode, o nena pooki naayiewuaki olorere lo Lyahudi.”

English: And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou ina bae, nelotu enkaji e Mariamu, ng'otonye Yohana oji Marko naa ine esotore esiamo kitok eomonito.

English: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
Masaai: Ore pee eoshiosh kishomi, nelotu enkaisiaayiani ainining'isho, naa keji ina Rhoda.

English: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
Masaai: Ore pee eyiolou oltoilo le Petero, neng'as apal kishomi mebolo, nekuet aji te ng'ida alikioo nchere eitashe Petero te kishomi.

English: And they said unto her, Thou art mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel.
Masaai: Nejokini, “Oloirirua iata iyie.” Kake etareikio ninye ajo neijia etiu. Nejo ninche, “Olmalaika lenye pae!”

English: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.
Masaai: Ore eirorita ninche eton ake eitashe Petero eoshito elusie e kishomi, ore ade pee eboluni, nedoli ninye neing'asiai.

English: But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go shew these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place.
Masaai: Kake eiyuko ninye ninche te nkaina metigirata, neibalakinye eneikuna Olaitoriani pee esaru aitung'uaa korokoroni. Nejoki, “Entoliki kuna baa, Yakobo nilikiki sii lalashera.” Nelo ninye, dikai wueji.

English: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter.
Masaai: Ore ake pee ekenyu, mme nenguala sikarini ejo ainyoo nawa Petero.

English: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode.
Masaai: Ore pee eing'oru Herode, nelau, nejur lelo sikarini ootorripo neitanapisho meewai aar metuata. Neing'uaa ninye Yudea nedoyio alo Kaisaria, nebik te ine.

English: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country.
Masaai: Netagorokine Herode oleng lelo le Turo o Sidon: nepuonu ninche etoning'ote enetii ninye. Neng'as aaning'ore ninche Blastus aa ninye olaing'urani le nkaji o laiguanani, nepuonu aaing'oru osotua, amu enkop e ilo aiguanani etumie ninche endaa.

English: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
Masaai: Ore te ina olong negeluno neisikarra Herode aishop ilkilani le nkitoo, neton to lorika le nkitoo, neirorie olorere.

English: And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man.
Masaai: Nebuakita lelo tung'ana aajo, “Ole nkai ele toilo, mme olo ltung'ani.”

English: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata ake neosh olmalaika lo Laitoriani ninye, amu mme Nkai eishoo enkitoo, neiruj; ilkurt nedung'o tau.

English: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
Masaai: Kake etubula ninye ororei le Nkai neponari.

English: And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.
Masaai: Nerrinyunye Barnaba o Saulo eing'uaa Yerusalem, eidipa esiaai enye, neriku Yohana oji Marko.

English: Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.
Masaai: Neetae apa te sirit e Antiokia, te sirit natii ine, iloibonok le Nkai o laiteng'enak Barnaba Simeon oji Olorok, o Lukio le Kirene, o Manaen oyati lo lmarei lo laiguanani Herode o Saulo.

English: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
Masaai: Ore eserem ninche nesaita Olaitoriani neitupukoo ate, nejo Enkiyang'et Sinyati “Entegelakaki Barnaba o Saulo te nkaraki esiaai naipotoko.”

English: And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
Masaai: Neaku ore pee eidip empukoroto neomon, neiteleiki ninche lelo nkaik, neirriwaa meshomo.

English: So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.
Masaai: Neisho ninche, eirriwayie Enkiyang'et Sinyati, nedoyio aapuo Seleukia; nejing empeut te ine aapuo Kupro.

English: And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister.
Masaai: Ore etii Salamis, nelikioo ororei le Nkai te nkaji oo Lyahudi e ntumo; nerikito Yohana eretito ninche.

English: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
Masaai: Ore pee epolos ilo odung'oro pooki aabaiki Pafo, netum olkuyantiki, oloiboni le lejare, Olyahudi, oji Bar-Yesu;

English: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
Masaai: neboitare ilo olbalusui oji Sergio Paulo, oltung'ani ng'en. Neipot ilo tung'ani Barnaba o Saulo meshomo enkang enye, eyieu nening ororei le Nkai.

English: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith.
Masaai: Kake etirishie Elimas, (amu nejia eji ewalunoto e nkarna enye), ilo taa kuyantiki ejo pee eng'adie ilo balusui enkirukoto.

English: Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Ghost, set his eyes on him,
Masaai: Kake ore Saulo, oji Paulo, eiganya Enkiyang'et Sinyati, neing'ode ninye,

English: And said, O full of all subtilty and all mischief, thou child of the devil, thou enemy of all righteousness, wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?
Masaai: nejoki, “Aish ele obore olosek o enkarrueisho pooki, ai mipal ake mikordil nkoitoi supati o Laitoriani?

English: And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon thee, and thou shalt be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand.
Masaai: Ng'ura! Kitabaikia enkaina o Laitoriani. Naa imodoku, nimidol enkolong o metulusoi enkata.” Nedoiki nabo kata ninye enkirupurup o enaimin; nemana eing'oru olorik aibung enkaina.

English: Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.
Masaai: Ore ilo balusui, pee edol ina nataasaki, neiruk, eing'asie te nkaraki enkiteng'enare o Laitoriani.

English: Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem.
Masaai: Nejing Paulo o encholiek enye empeut te Pafos, nepuonu Perga te Pamfilia; nelo Yohana aing'uaa ninche te ine nerrinyo Yerusalem.

English: But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down.
Masaai: Kake etudumunye ninche te Perga, nepolos aapuonu Antiokia e Pisidia, nepuo enkaji e ntumo te nkolong e sabato, netoni.

English: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.
Masaai: Ore eidipaki aaisoma nkitanapat e Musa o loibonok le Nkai, ore ilaitoriak le ina aji e ntumo, nejoki, “Ilalashera, te niatata ororei oret olorere, eroro.”

English: Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and ye that fear God, give audience.
Masaai: Neinyototo Paulo, neyuk te nkaina nejo, “Lo lewa loo Siraeli o intae ilooure Enkai, enining'o.

English: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it.
Masaai: Enkai e le orere le Siraeli nategelua iloo papa, neitaa olorere kitok eton emanya Misiri neilepie enkaina enye neriku aitung'uaa ine.

English: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
Masaai: Naa ore te rishata oo larin artam neng'iri empeepeen enye ti ong'ata.

English: And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot.
Masaai: Ore pee eidip atumuta loreren oopishana te nkop e Kanaan, neisho ninche enkop enye metujung'o, te rishata oo larin iip ong'uan o onom.

English: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nena neisho ninche larishak o metabaiki enkata e Samuel olapa oiboni le Nkai.

English: And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years.
Masaai: Ore tesiadi neomonu ninche olaiguanani, neisho Enkai ninche Saulo ole Kishi, oltung'ani lo losho le Benchamen, te rishata oo larin artam.

English: And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfil all my will.
Masaai: Ore pee eiwuang'ie ninye, neitasheyie Daudi metaa olaiguanani lenye, oloitaikia Enkai shakeni, nejo, ‘Anoto Daudi ole Yese, oltung'ani onyor oltau lai, oas nena pooki nayieu.’

English: Of this man's seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
Masaai: Te ishoi e ilo tung'ani eitaikia Enkai Siraeli, Olaitajeunoni, Yesu anaa apa enaisiligie.

English: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel.
Masaai: Netang'asa apa Yohana alikioo etiooyo elotunoto enye, enkibatisa naitoduaaya enkirridunoto natolikio ltung'ana pooki loo Siraeli.

English: And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think ye that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there cometh one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose.
Masaai: Naa ore eitabaya ninye Yohana inaaitanapaki, nejo, ‘Ijojo intae kara nanu ng'ae? Mara nanu ninye. A'a kake ng'ura, kelotu likae te siadi nanu, laa kaamakua te nalak inamuka enyena.’

English: Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you feareth God, to you is the word of this salvation sent.
Masaai: “Lo alashera, kira e ntalipa e Abraham, o intae kulo ooure enkai, iyiook eirriwakaki irorei le na jeunoto.

English: For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him.
Masaai: Tenkaraki lekua oomanya Yerusalem o laitoriak lenye, amu ninye eitu eyiolou, arashu eyiolou iltoiloishi loo loibonok le Nkai ooisomai anaa ake too nkolong'i e sabato, ninche ooitabaitie ena pee edung'oki ninye enkiguana e keeya.

English: And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain.
Masaai: Naa ore hoo netalaita te ninye ai naitanang, etoomono Pilato meishoo ninye metari.

English: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
Masaai: Ore pee eitabaya nena pooki naasirakino ninye, neitadou ninye to lchani neirragie te nkurare.

English: But God raised him from the dead:
Masaai: Kake eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata:

English: And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people.
Masaai: netoduaaki too nkolong'i kumok lelo opa ooiriamunore ninye eing'uaa Galilaya alotu Yerusalem, naa ninche taata shakeni to lorere.

English: And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,
Masaai: Nikiyaki intae ilomon supati le nkisiligata naishoo apa Enkai iloo papa,

English: God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he hath raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee.
Masaai: eneikona Enkai pee eitabaya ina te iyiook inkera enye, aitopiu Yesu anaa enaigero to Lkerempe le Nkai, le are nchere, ‘Ira iyie Enkerai ai, te le kekun aatoiwuo.’

English: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said on this wise, I will give you the sure mercies of David.
Masaai: Naa ore ina naitopiwuo aitung'uaa ilootuata, nemeitoki naa ai kata arrinyokino erruorroto, eiroro nejo, ‘Ekaaisho iyie ilo sinyati imayianat naadede e Daudi.’

English: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm, Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption.
Masaai: Amu etejo sii to Lkerempe le Nkai, ‘Nimincho iyie Ilo Sinyati lino edol erruorroto.’

English: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
Masaai: Amu ore Daudi, eidipa too rishat enyena aitabai inaaitanapishe Enkai, neirura, neirragieki te nebo iloo menye, netum erruorroto.

English: But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oitopiwuo Enkai eitu etum ninye erruorroto.

English: Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins:
Masaai: Entayioloito naa aajo, ilalashera laainei, te le tung'ani elikini intae enkitayunoto oo ng'ok:

English: And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses.
Masaai: naa te ninye eoruni ntiyot pooki ng'ae oiruk ninye, neikenakini esupatisho te Nkai nemetum too nkitanapat e Musa.

English: Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets;
Masaai: Entodol naa ate, meinepu intae enapa nairoro iloibonok le Nkai aajo:

English: Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.
Masaai: ‘Eng'ura intae, ilasurdaanyak, ning'asiasia nindaayaya; amu keeta enaas too nkolong'i inyi, o enkiaas nemeeta nchere iruko, te neliki intae likae.’ ”

English: And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
Masaai: Ore eipung aapuo, nesai menyaaki aaigilie lelo omon te nkolong e sabato nasuju ina.

English: Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.
Masaai: Ore pee eidapasha entumo, nesuj Ilyahudi kumok o kulikae ooure Enkai Paulo o Barnaba: neirorie ninche lelo neitirrishaki metobiko te mpiris e Nkai.

English: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e sabato natusujua ina, peno eitu etumokino ine enkanasa nalulung'a aaning ororei le Nkai.

English: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spake against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming.
Masaai: Kake, ilo orere ake etoduaa Ilyahudi, neigany olom, neishankarru nena naatejo Paulo, nemor Enkai.

English: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
Masaai: Neiro Paulo o Barnaba aashirraki, nejo, “Keishiaakino naa intae eiteraki aaliki ororei le Nkai. Kake ore amu itanang'aitie, nitoduaa oopeny nchere meishiaakino intae enkishui nemeish, ng'ura, kipuo iyiook enetii Loreren.

English: For so hath the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.
Masaai: Amu ina doi eitanapa iyiook Olaitoriani, ajoki. ‘Aaitaa iyie ewang'an oo Loreren, peyie iyau iyie enjeunoto o metabaiki ineeiting'ie enkop.’ ”

English: And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed.
Masaai: Ina ake etoning'o loreren, neng'ida oleng, neisho ilo rorei le Nkai enkisisa: ore lelo oogelakino enjeunoto neiruk.

English: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.
Masaai: Neibulunyeki ororei lo Laitoriani ilo kirine pooki.

English: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts.
Masaai: Kake eshomo Lyahudi aaisur nkituaak naayanyiti, o lewa ooitore ina anasa, neing'oling'ol pee einyali Paulo o Barnaba, nearari metung'uai ilo Kirine lenye.

English: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
Masaai: Kake eipiripirokito ninche enterit oo nkejek enye, nepuonu Ikonio.

English: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Neiput ilooiteng'eni enchipai o Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
Masaai: Neaku ore te Ikonio, nejing enkaji e ntumo oo Lyahudi te nebo, neiro, o meiruko esiamo kitok oo Lyahudi o enoo Ilyunani.

English: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
Masaai: Kake eing'oling'ola lelo Yahudi leitu eiruk iltung'ana loo Loreren, neitagogong iltauja ti alo lalashera.

English: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
Masaai: Neaku etobiko naleng te ine eshirraki aairo ti atua Olaitoriani, neitadedeyie ninye ilo rorei le mpiris enye, neishoru metaasi ilmonek o mbaa e nking'asia too nkaik enye.

English: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
Masaai: Kake etoorote olorere le ina anasa neibung'are kulikae Ilyahudi, neibung'are kulikae lkipaareta.

English: And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them,
Masaai: Ore pee edumakino ndung'ot pokira, Iloreren o Lyahudi o laitoriak lenye pee esuli ninche aaitukurru, nenang'i too soito,

English: They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lieth round about:
Masaai: neirrash ninche ina, neisikaki Listra o Derbe nena anas e Likonia o lelo kirinen oomanita:

English: And there they preached the gospel.
Masaai: nelikioo ororei le Nkai te nene wuejitin.

English: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:
Masaai: Ore apa te Listra netii oltung'ani otonita otuata nkejek, olaa olmaima pee eini, leitu ai kata elo too nkejek.

English: The same heard Paul speak: who stedfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed,
Masaai: Nening ilo Paulo eiro, ore Paulo, nekurraki nkonyek nedol ajo keeta enkirukoto pee eishiunyeki,

English: Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on thy feet. And he leaped and walked.
Masaai: nejo to ltoilo sapuk, “Ntasho ntoriori too nkejek inono!” Neitiamu aitashe nelo.

English: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men.
Masaai: Ore pee edol esiamo ina nataasa Paulo, neilepie ltoiloishi, ejo te nkutuk oo Likonia, “Etadoutuo nkaitin naatiu anaa ltung'ana!”

English: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
Masaai: Nejo Barnaba Seu; nejo Paulo Herme, amu ninye oljartan to rorei.

English: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.
Masaai: Nereu olapolosani le Seu otii olkitaret lenye auluo ina ang ilmong'i neyau lmarisiani kishomi, naa anaata etopolosishote te nebo o nena siamon.

English: Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out,
Masaai: Kake ore pee ening ilkipaareta ina, Barnaba o Paulo, nepolos ilkilani lenye, neipangu te siamo, ebuakita neishir,

English: And saying, Sirs, why do ye these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein:
Masaai: nejo, “Lo kituaak! Ainyoo pee nkoko nji? Kira sii yiook iltung'ana ake leeijo intae, naa lomon supati kiyaki intae, pee imbelekenyanya, aaing'uaa kuna nemeeta tipat aaing'or Enkai naishu, naitobira shumata o enkop o naaiposha, o nena naatii pooki:

English: Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways.
Masaai: olaa ninye oishoo loreren pooki too lajijik ooishari meshomo loshon too nkoitoi enye maate.

English: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.
Masaai: Kake eitu sii epal kewan meeta ake shakeni enye, amu etaasa supati, neisho intae enchan eing'uaa shumata neisho intae larin oosinyunye, neitaraposh iltauja linyi te ndaa o te ng'ida.”

English: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
Masaai: Naa te mpesho ade te kulo rorei etomitikio Paulo nena siamon epolosaki ninche.

English: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
Masaai: Kake eetuo Lyahudi ine ooing'uaa Antiokia o Ikonio: ore pee eitoosh isiamon, nenang Paulo too soito neikurtutaa auluo ina anasa, ejo ninche ketua.

English: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
Masaai: Kake ore eitashe ilooiteng'eni aamanita, neinyototo, nejing ina anasa: ore pee ekenyu nepuku o Barnaba aapuo Derbe.

English: And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch,
Masaai: Ore pee elikioo ororei supat te ina anasa, neitaa lkumok ilooiteng'eni, nerrinyo aapuo Listra, o Ikonio o Antiokia,

English: Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
Masaai: eitagol ilooiteng'eni ltauja, nekurraki metobiko tiatua enkirukoto, amu kumok isinaitin likiimaa kijing enkitoria e Nkai.

English: And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed.
Masaai: Ore pee egelaki ninche lpayiani te sirit ake pooki, neomon eitupukoo ate, neomonoki ninche Olaitoriani, ilo laa ninye eiruko ninche.

English: And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia.
Masaai: Neimaa Pisidia, nepuonu Pamfilia.

English: And when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down into Attalia:
Masaai: Ore pee einosaa ilo rorei te Perga, nedoyio aapuo Italia;

English: And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.
Masaai: nejing empeut e ine aapuo Antiokia, enapa wueji neisiligieki ninche empiris e Nkai te nkaraki ina siaai naitabaitie.

English: And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu, neiturrur esirit te nebo, neinosaki nena pooki naataasishore Enkai ninche, ina nataboloko loreren enkoitoi e nkirukoto.

English: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
Masaai: Neme kuti nkolong'i naatobiko ninche te nebo lelo ooiteng'eni.

English: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
Masaai: Nedou kulikae tung'ana ooing'uaa Yudea neiteng'en ilalashera, aajoki, “Te nememurati intae anaa enaitanapishe Musa, nimindimidimi aatajeu.”

English: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
Masaai: Ore pee eishankarrarre Paulo o Barnaba ninche neirish aaiguanare too mbaa neme kuti, negelu lalashera Paulo o Barnaba o kulikae ake lenye, meshomo Yerusalem eitarioo esirit ninche, neimaa Foenike o meshomo Yerusalem enetii lkipaareta o lpayiani te ina bae.

English: And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren.
Masaai: Ore taa pee eitarioo esirit ninche, neimaa Foenike o Samaria, einosaa enkibelekenyata oo ltung'ana loo Loreren; neyaki lalashera pooki eng'ida kitok oleng.

English: And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu Yerusalem, neng'amu ina sirit o lkipaareta o lpayiani, neinosaki mbaa pooki naataasie Enkai ninche.

English: But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.
Masaai: Kake einyieito kulikae te ncholiek oo Lfarisayo ooiruko, nejo, “Meeta nchere pee memurati ninche, neitanapi meibung'a nkitanapat e Musa.”

English: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter.
Masaai: Netumo lkipaareta o lpayiani te nebo aaimaki ena bae.

English: And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel, and believe.
Masaai: Ore etoodoro enkiguana narrish, neinyototo Petero, nejoki ninche, “Ilalashera laainei, iyiololo aajo ore apa te nkata naado etegelua Enkai obo linyi, peyie aa te nkutuk ai ening ltung'ana loo Loreren ororei supat, neiruk.

English: And God, which knoweth the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Ghost, even as he did unto us;
Masaai: Ore Enkai nayiolo ltauja, neaku shakeni te ninche aisho Enkiyang'et Sinyati, anaa enapake naishoo iyiook;

English: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
Masaai: neitu epik olgelati arish iyiook o ninche, neituku ltauja lenye te nkirukoto.

English: Now therefore why tempt ye God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?
Masaai: Oo naa taata pee itemiteme intae Enkai, aaiteleiki enchata murto oo lalashera, eneitu eidim iloo papa neitu kindim iyiook aatanap?

English: But we believe that through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they.
Masaai: Paa kake, kiruko iyiook nchere te mpiris e Yesu Kristo kijeu iyiook, naa neijia etiu ninche.”

English: Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them.
Masaai: Negira olturrur pooki; neinining Barnaba o Paulo einosaki nkitoduaat o ne nking'asia naataasie Enkai ninche too ltung'ana lo Loreren.

English: And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me:
Masaai: Ore pee egira ninche, newalu Yakobo nejo, “Ilalashera, entoning'oki:

English: Simeon hath declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name.
Masaai: einosua Simeon eneikona apa Enkai pee ebaiki ltung'ana loo Loreren, agelu ti atua ninche ltung'ana le nkarna enye.

English: And to this agree the words of the prophets; as it is written,
Masaai: Neitadedeyie ina naairoro iloibonok le Nkai anaa enatisiraki nchere,

English: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
Masaai: ‘Ore pee elusoo kuna karrinyunye nanu, naa kaitoki ashetu enkaji e Daudi e nkomono naturori; naa kaitoki ashet ilmuaateni lenye: naitasheyie nanu:

English: That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, saith the Lord, who doeth all these things.
Masaai: pee eing'oru ltung'ana ootelekutua Olaitoriani, lelo tung'ana pooki loo loreren, ooipotieki enkarna ai.

English: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.
Masaai: Olaitoriani ojo, ololimu apa kuna baa te nkiterunoto e nkop.’

English: Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God:
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina, neiguana aajo, emikintanyamal lelo loo Loreren ooibelekenyakino Enkai;

English: But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.
Masaai: kake emaigeroki metalama lkereu loo nkiri naapolosakini ntokitin naaitaai nkaitin, nelam eloloito, o ntokitin naagori, o sarge.

English: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day.
Masaai: Amu eeta Musa too lajijik o lajijik te nkanasa ake pooki lelo oolikioo ninye, eisumitai ninye anaa ake too nkolong'i e sabato too nkajijik e ntumo.”

English: Then pleased it the apostles and elders, with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas, and Silas, chief men among the brethren:
Masaai: Nedol ilkipaareta o lpayiani o ina sirit pooki aajo sidai te negeluni ltung'ana le ina sirit enye, neirriwari Antiokia te nebo Paulo o Barnaba. Negelu Yudas oji Barnaba o Sila, laa larikok too lalashera.

English: And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia:
Masaai: Neigeroki lelo nejo, “Ilkipaareta o lpayiani alashera ooigeroki ilalashera oora iloo Loreren te Antiokia o te Siria o Kilikia, kiroroki intae;

English: Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, subverting your souls, saying, Ye must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment:
Masaai: te nkaraki naa ai kitoning'o aajo etii kulikae ooing'uaa atua iyiook ooetuo aaitanyamal intae too rorei neitapong'oo ltauja linyi; neitu kincho iyiook ninche imbaa naayaki ninche intae;

English: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
Masaai: nikidol iyiook eishiaakino, kitoning'okinote nabo, nikigelu lewa likirriwaki intae meiriamunore ilaisotuak lang Barnaba o Paulo,

English: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: iltung'ana ootipika bata enkishon enye te nkaraki enkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth.
Masaai: Kirriutua naa Yudas o Sila naa ninche maate ooliki intae kuna baa te nkutuk.

English: For it seemed good to the Holy Ghost, and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things;
Masaai: Amu etoduaa Enkiyang'et Sinyati o iyiook; nchere pee mikinteleiki intae likae ola olusoo te kuna baa naata tipat;

English: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if ye keep yourselves, ye shall do well. Fare ye well.
Masaai: nchere entirishie ate nkiri oo ntokitin naapolosakini nkitanyaanyukot naaitaai nkaitin, o sarge o ntokitin naagori, o eloloito; amu te nintalamilama ate nena, nintobira osupatei. Ayia sere.”

English: So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:
Masaai: Ore ninche, pee eishori epuo, nedoiyio aapuo Antiokia; ore pee eiturrurru olorere te nebo, neitarasaki ina palai.

English: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
Masaai: Ore pee eisum ninche, neng'ida te nkaraki ina kilejilejata.

English: And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, and confirmed them.
Masaai: Ore Yudas o Sila amu loibonok le Nkai sii ninche maate, neinosaki lalashera nkumok neitagol.

English: And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles.
Masaai: Ore ewaita enkata ebikito te ine, neitanapare ilalashera ninche te seriani neisho enetii lelo apa ooirriutua ninche.

English: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
Masaai: Kake etoduaa ninye Sila ajo keishiakino neton te ine.

English: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.
Masaai: Kake etobiko ninche Paulo o Barnaba te Antiokia eiteng'enisho nelikioo ororei lo Laitoriani, te nebo sii kulikae kumok.

English: And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word of the Lord, and see how they do.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie nkuti olong'i nejoki Paulo Barnaba, “Manyaai aabaiki ilalashera too nkanas apa pooki nikinosakita ororei lo Laitoriani, pee kidol eneikununo.”

English: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
Masaai: Neyieu Barnaba neshoroo Yohana oji Marko meiriamariyie.

English: But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work.
Masaai: Kake etoduaa Paulo ajo mme sidai te nerik oltung'ani apa otorrinye aing'uaa ninche te Pamfilia, leitu erubare ninche te siaai.

English: And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus;
Masaai: Nejing empong'o o metooroto olikae o likae, nerik Barnaba Marko pee eiriamari nejing empeut aapuo Kupro.

English: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
Masaai: Kake etegelua ninye Paulo Sila, nepuo, neitanap ilalashera ninche neomonoki empiris e Nkai.

English: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.
Masaai: Neimaa Siria o Kilikia neitagol nena sirito.

English: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
Masaai: Nelotu sii Derbe o Listra, naa ng'ura, eetae apa oloiteng'eni te ine oji Timoteo, olayioni le nkitok Yahudi nairuko, kake Olyunani menye.

English: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium.
Masaai: Neimaki lalashera ninye aarrep ilootii Listra o Ikonio.

English: Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek.
Masaai: Ninye etegelua Paulo pee eiriamariyie; neibung nemurat te nkaraki lelo Yahudi le ilo kirine; amu keyiolo pooki aajo Olyunani apa menye.

English: And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees for to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Ore epuoito te nkoitoi eimaa nkang'itie, neisho napa baa meibung'a, naaitanapishote lkipaareta o lpayiani ootii Yerusalem.

English: And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily.
Masaai: Metaa nedupayu nena sirito enkirukoto, neponari esiana anaa ake.

English: Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Ghost to preach the word in Asia,
Masaai: Neimaa olkirine le Frigia o Galatia, etirishie Enkiyang'et Sinyati pee melikioo ilo rorei te Asia.

English: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
Masaai: Ore pee epuonu aaipirare Misia, netem aajo matijing Bitinia; neitu eisho Enkiyang'et e Yesu meshomo;

English: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
Masaai: neim embata e Misia nedou aapuonu Troas.

English: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us.
Masaai: Neipang'aki Paulo enduaata kewarie, oltung'ani oitashe le Makedonia, osaita ninye ajoki, “Wou talang'u Makedonia, taretu iyiook.”

English: And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them.
Masaai: Ore pee edol Paulo ina, neiteru nabo kata aing'oru elototo nalo Makedonia, etumuta ajo Enkai naipoto iyiook maape aaliki ninche ele rorei supat.

English: Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis;
Masaai: Ore pee kijing empeut te Troas, nikipolos aaitoriokino Samotrake, nikiyiooki te ntaaisere aapuo Neapolis;

English: And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days.
Masaai: nikidumunye te ine aapuo Filipi; enkanasa e Makedonia, naa ninye enkanasa kitok te ilo kerenket, naa abori oo Roma etii: nikibik te ina anasa nkolong'i naaje.

English: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was wont to be made; and we sat down, and spake unto the women which resorted thither.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e sabato nikimpang auluo kishomi e ina anasa, te mbata o lkeju, kijo ebaiki neetae ewueji e nkomono te ine; nikitoni, aairorie nkituaak naatoni te nebo.

English: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul.
Masaai: Netii enkitok naji Lidia naa enkamirani oo lkarash oodo, naa ene nkanasa naji Tiatira, naserem ninye Enkai, nening iyiook. Nebol Olaitoriani e ltau lenye, metoning'o mbaa naairoro Paulo.

English: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.
Masaai: Ore pee eibatisai ninye o enkaji enye, nesai iyiook, ajoki, “Te nikitoduaa intae aajo kaisiligayu to Laitoriani, wootu entijing enkaji ai, entotoni.” Neidimu iyiook.

English: And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying:
Masaai: Neaku ore kipuoito ine wueji e nkomono, nenang'are iyiook esila naata e nkiyang'et e naibon nadol imbaa, netopokie lkituaak lenyena ninye too masaa naayaki te ina aibon.

English: The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which shew unto us the way of salvation.
Masaai: Nesuj ninye Paulo o iyiook nebuaku eishir ajo, “Ore kulo tung'ana ilaisiaayiak le Nkai natii Shumata Aisui te pooki, naa intae eliki enkoitoi e njeunoto.”

English: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
Masaai: Neiko neijia nkolong'i kumok. Kake ore Paulo, etanyamala oleng neibelekenya nejoki ilo oirirua, “Aaitanapa iyie te nkarna e Yesu Kristo tupuku tung'uai ninye.” Nepuku aing'uaa te ina saa ake.

English: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers,
Masaai: Kake ore pee edol ilopeny aajo eshomo osiligi le ina dupoto enye, neibung Paulo o Sila, neikurtutaa aaya enetii laitoriak te nemirishoreki,

English: And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,
Masaai: ore pee eyau enetii iladung'ok le nkiguana, nejo, “Ore kulo tung'ana, loo Lyahudi, eitanyamalita naleng ena anasa ang,

English: And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.
Masaai: aalimu lkerreti lemeishoruno matang'amai arashu kisuj, kira Iroma.”

English: And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them.
Masaai: Nedumakino esiamo pooki te nebo nepololoki lkilani lenye aaoru, neitanapisho meidong'i too ng'udisin.

English: And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely:
Masaai: Ore eitudupaki ninche iwoshot kumok, nenang'akini korokoroni, neitoriakini olarriponi meitirrisha oleng.

English: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
Masaai: Ore pee eng'amu ilo ina kitanapata, nepik ninche korokoroni e atua, neen nkejek enye akurraki too lgarrameta.

English: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
Masaai: Kake ore etaa keitorito enkewarie eomonito Paulo o Sila neranyaki Enkai isinkoliotin; neinining'ito ilooena ninche;

English: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.
Masaai: ore nabo kata, neikirikira enkop, neigirigiro lkitamanyunot le ina aji e korokoroni; nebolo nabo kata nkutukie enyena pooki; nelaa lgarrameta loo looena pooki.

English: And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled.
Masaai: Ore pee einyiototo olarriponi etuputuoki too njo, nedol inkutukie e korokoroni ebolo, neshutu olalem neaku kejo aar kewan, ejo keisika ilooena aapuo.

English: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
Masaai: Kake etabuaa Paulo to ltoilo sapuk, nejo, “Miar kewan, kitii pooki ene.”

English: Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas,
Masaai: Neipotu lkilangilang'eta, nengorokino atua, eikirikira te nkuretisho, nebatatakino Paulo o Sila,

English: And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?
Masaai: neitupuku, nejoki, “Lo kituaak, kaji aiko pee ajeu?”

English: And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved, and thy house.
Masaai: Nejoki ninche, “Iruko Olaitoriani Yesu, pee ijeu iyie o enkaji ino.”

English: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord, and to all that were in his house.
Masaai: Neinosaki ninye ororei lo Laitoriani, te nebo lelo pooki ootii enkaji enye.

English: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
Masaai: Nedumu ninye ninche te ina saa ake e nkewarie, neisuj nena oshot enye, neibatisae ninye nabo kata o lelo lenyena pooki.

English: And when he had brought them into his house, he set meat before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house.
Masaai: Neriku ninche enkaji enye, neisho endaa, neshipa oleng o enkaji enye pooki, eiruko Enkai.

English: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
Masaai: Ore pee ekenyu, neirriu iladung'ok le nkiguana lsikarini nejoki, “Enchoo lelo tung'ana epuo.”

English: And the keeper of the prison told this saying to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace.
Masaai: Neyaki olarriponi le korokoroni Paulo ilo rorei, ajoki, “Eirriutua iladung'ok le nkiguana olkilikuai meishori intae enchom, enyeito naa taata naa enchom te seriani.”
