Masaai: Amu kayiolo ajo, metii entoki supat namanya atua nanu, aa taa osesen lai, amu ore hoo naata eyiolounoto naasie esupat, maata enkidimata.

English: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
Masaai: Kayieu naas isupati kake maas; neaku ntorrok nemayieu ninche aas.

English: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
Masaai: Ore pee aas enda nemayieu naas nemeekure aa nanu oas kake eng'oki natii atua nanu.

English: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
Masaai: Nena duoo enkewan natayiolo nanu; ekayieu nanu naas isupati kake maaing'uaa ai kata entorroni.

English: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkorrok ai kewan nashipakino aning'ore nkitanapat e Nkai.

English: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
Masaai: Kake nadol ake ae golon naarare ake nena nadamu openy. Ina kitanapata oo ng'ok naasisho ti atua osesen lai aaitaa orrindik.

English: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
Masaai: Oi ele oibe oji nanu! Ainyoo kenya naakordu nanu tele sesen le keeya!

English: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
Masaai: Ashe te Nkai, tiatua Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, ore naa, nanu enkorrok ai, naisiai enkitanapata e Nkai te ndamunoto ai, kake ore to sesen lai, naisiai enkitanapata oo ng'ok.

English: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
Masaai: Metii naa taata enkiguana te lelo ootii atua Kristo Yesu.

English: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
Masaai: Amu aatalakutua nanu nkitanapat e Nkiyang'et e nkishui natii atua Kristo Yesu aaitung'uaa nkitanapat oo ng'ok o enkeeya.

English: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
Masaai: Amu Enkai nataasa ina natalaikinote nkitanapat, to lbae le nchalan o sesen, aataas; eirriwua Oinoti lenye te mpukunoto o sesen loo ng'ok ti atua osesen,

English: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
Masaai: pee etumi aaitabai nena sipat naajo nkitanapat ti atua iyiook, ilemerubare mbaa o sesen kake kirubare Enkiyang'et.

English: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo oopuo erubare osesen naa mbaa o sesen naaitore ltauja lenye, kake ore lelo oopuo erubare Enkiyang'et naa mbaa e Nkiyang'et naaitore ltauja lenye.

English: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
Masaai: Ore paa osesen oitore mbaa o ltau neaku ina keeya, ore paa Enkiyang'et naitore oltau neaku ina enkishui o eseriani.

English: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
Masaai: Amu ore oltau oitore osesen naa olmang'atinta te Nkai; amu meishoru meitoria nkitanapat e Nkai; nemeidim;

English: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
Masaai: naa ore lelo laa osesen oitore nemeidim aaitishipa Enkai.

English: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
Masaai: Kake mme osesen oitore intae, Enkiyang'et naitore intae, te nesipa nchere etamanya atua intae Enkiyang'et e Nkai. Ore pooki ng'ae ake lemeeta Enkiyang'et e Kristo neme olenye ilo.

English: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
Masaai: Kake ore ake pee etii Kristo atua intae, te neye ninye iseseni linyi te nkaraki ng'ok,

English: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
Masaai: neishu enkiyang'et e ilo oitopiwuo Yesu, ore ilo oitopiwuo Kristo Yesu too lootuata neisho sii lelo seseni linyi ooye enkishui te ina kiyang'et enye namany atua intae.

English: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, lalashera laainei, eikiaata esile, kake mme eno sesen, metaa osesen oitore iyiook kinchu —

English: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
Masaai: amu ore ake pee eaku osesen irubarere inchushu niyeye, kake ti niaariara intae te nkiyang'et inkiaasin o sesen metuata ninchushu.

English: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo pooki laa Enkiyang'et e Nkai narikito, ninche nkera e Nkai.

English: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
Masaai: Amu mme enkiyang'et e rrindikisho eishooki intae entushukokinoto enkuretisho, kake eishooki intae enkiyang'et oo nkera inot. Ore te nikijo “Abba! Papa!”

English: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
Masaai: Enkiyang'et kewan naishakenu te nebo enkiyang'et ang nchere kira nkera e Nkai,

English: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
Masaai: naa ti nikira nkera, nikira ilajung'ok, kira lajung'ok le Nkai te nebo Kristo, te naa keisilisili iyiook te nebo ninye pee eyookini sii aaisho iyiook enkitoo te nebo ninye.

English: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu ajo ore nkisilisilot ena kata meitorisiokini ina kitoo nayookini aaboloki yiook.

English: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
Masaai: Keanyita seseni pooki toki naitayioki, te yieunoto kitok, metaboluni nkera e Nkai.

English: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
Masaai: Amu etipikaki seuseu erruorroto, neme nkaraki naa enkop nayieu, kake to siligi,

English: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
Masaai: amu keyookini aalaku seuseu pooki aaitung'uaa rrindikisho enye e nkidaaroto, neng'amu elakunoto e nkitoo oo nkera e Nkai.

English: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
Masaai: Amu kiyiolo aajo ore o tena kata, eigorito te mion seuseu pooki naitayioki losilisili le mion o metabaiki ena olong.

English: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
Masaai: Neme seuseu ake, kake ore sii ninche iyiook, ooidipa aanoto enkishorunoto e Nkiyang'et naiturukuo te kulie naapuonu, nikinchirita sii iyiook ti atua ate kiaanyu meitaa Enkai iyiook inkera enyena, neitabaya elakunoto ang.

English: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
Masaai: Amu tele siligi apa eitajewuoki iyiook. Te naa eikidolita entoki nikisiligu, nemeitoki ilo siligi aata tipat. Keisiligu pasa oltung'ani entoki nadolita?

English: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
Masaai: Kake ti nikisiligu entoki nemelioo, naa eikiaanyu te ng'iriata.

English: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
Masaai: Neijia eiko Enkiyang'et pee elotu aretu iyiook te nchalan ang; amu aimikiyiolo iyiook aajo ainyoo kiomonu nimikiyiolo enikijo ti nikiomonu, kake Enkiyang'et makewan naomonoki iyiook te mion nagut nemeinosunoyu.

English: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
Masaai: Ore ilo laa ninye ojur iltauja neyiolo ninye enajo Enkiyang'et, amu Enkai nayieu neaku enkiyang'et nanyikaki ninye too mbaa oo ltung'ana lenyena.

English: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
Masaai: Nikiyiolo aajo ore te pooki toki neasisho Enkai too mbaa supati te lelo oonyor ninye, te lelo oo ipotoki te risioroto e yieuna enye.

English: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
Masaai: Amu etayiolo apake Enkai ilenyena negelu metotiutu anaa ilo Inoti lenye, pee eaku ilo Inoti olkikau loo lalashera kumok.

English: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooidipa ninye ategelu, neiteng'el; ore lelo ooiteng'ela ninye neipot, ore lelo ooipoto neikenaki esipata, ore lelo ooikenaka esipata neisho ake sii enkitoo.

English: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
Masaai: Kaa naa kijo te na? Amaa te netii Enkai enkalo ang, kalo oidim atigilunore iyiook?

English: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
Masaai: Eitu eibooyo ninye ilo Inoti lenye kake eishorua ninye te nkaraki iyiook pooki. Amaa etaasa ina, ainyoo ae naitoki amitiki ninye, eisho iyiook pooki toki pesho?

English: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
Masaai: Ae ng'ae oitoki aitang'or ilgelunot le Nkai? Mme Enkai, amu ninye makewan naishoo ninche isipat.

English: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
Masaai: Ae ng'ae naa odung'oki ninche enkiguana? Ae Kristo Yesu otua, oonyaaka apiu aing'uaa keeya, netii taata, enkaina e tatene e Nkai, nesipa nchere ninye oomonoki iyiook.

English: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
Masaai: Ainyoo naidim atirishie iyook enyorrata e Kristo? Keidim ingolikinot, anaa emion, anaa enkisilisiloto? anaa olameyu, anaa enikipuo mikinchopo, anaa batisho, anaa enkeeya o anaa olalem?

English: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
Masaai: Ejo Ilkigerot oojo: “Ore te nkaraki iyie earitai iyiook dama o kewarie matuata; kitotiutuo anaa noshi tare naapuoi aayieng.”

English: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
Masaai: A'a, ore te kuna pooki kisulie kimirisho aaisulie te nkaraki ilo otonyorra iyiook.

English: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
Masaai: Amu aitisipa nanu nchere mme keeya, neme enkishui, neme ilmalaika, neme engolon e naimin, ne ntokitin naatii, ne ntokitin naapuonu neme nkitoriat neme enguton, neme ae toki to seuseu pooki, naidim atirishie iyiook enyorrata e Nkai natii Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Masaai: Neme kulie kiyang'eta o loing'ang'e, aashu naatii olodo le nkop, neme hoo ae toki natii enkop o loing'ang'e pooki naidim atirishie iyiook enyorrata e Nkai natii Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
Masaai: Isipat ajoito tiatua Kristo, malejisho nanu; naaishakenoki nanu oltau lai te Nkiyang'et Sinyati,

English: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
Masaai: nchere kaara sapuk oleng osina o emion ti atua oltau lai.

English: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
Masaai: Amu ketaa kayieu napaji naa nanu makewan edeki naadung'ori aarishie Kristo te nkaraki lalashera, laainei entalipa o lorere lai.

English: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
Masaai: Isiraeli ninche, naa ninche eitaa nkera enyena, neisho enkitoo, ilkulenye isotuaitin, ninche eishooki Nkitanapat, o esayiata e Nkai o nkisiligat enyena;

English: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
Masaai: ilkulenye iloo Akuiyiaa, naa ole ilo orere Kristo. Metamayiani Enkai natii shumata pooki ntarasi. Esai.

English: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
Masaai: Kake mme taa doi keetae enaturua ororei le Nkai. Amu mme Siraeli ate lelo pooki le ishoi e Siraeli,

English: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
Masaai: neme nkera e Abraham lelo pooki le ishoi enye; kake, “Nkera e Isaak eji nkera inono.”

English: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
Masaai: Nejo ina nchere mme nena kera o sesen naara nne Nkai, kake nkera e nkisiligata enye eikenakini aajo eishoi enye.

English: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.
Masaai: Amu inji etejo enkisiligata enye, “Kalotu kenya tena rishata netum Sara enkayioni.”

English: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
Masaai: Neme neijia ake, kake inoolpayian obo papa lang Isaak nkera e Rebeka.

English: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
Masaai: Kake, ore meino eton eitu eas ninche ae supat aashu entorrono, ore eji peyie eitobirari eyieunoto e Nkai o engelunoto enye, neme te nkaraki isiaaitin kake te nkaraki e nkipototo enye,

English: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
Masaai: nejokini Rebeka, “Keaku olbotor oisiaai oloti.”

English: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
Masaai: Anaa enatisiraki aajo, “Yakobo atonyorra kake aibayie Esau.”

English: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
Masaai: Aikijo aa iyiook? Aikijo mme asipani Enkai te nkiguana enye? Mme neijia pae!

English: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
Masaai: Amu etiaaka ninye Musa, “Nanu oing'urrie olayieu naing'urrie, naitanana oshoke to layieu naduaya.”

English: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
Masaai: Ore pooki nemeigarakino enayieu oltung'ani, kake eigarakino olng'ur le Nkai.

English: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
Masaai: Amu etiaakita Ilkigerot Farao, “Nanu laailepie naa kajo paa te iyie aitoduaaya engolon ai, nelikiori enkarna ai tiatua enkop pooki.”

English: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
Masaai: Neaku ninye oing'urrie oloyieu neing'urrie, neitagol oltau lo loyieu neitagol.

English: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
Masaai: Naa ore taata nikijoki, “Oo naa pee eitokini ake aajo eitarruoitie ltung'ana?” Ae ng'ae oidim aibooi eyieunoto enye?

English: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
Masaai: Kake aira ng'ae lo tung'ani owaliki Enkai? Kejoki entoki naitobiruni ilo oitobirita, “Oo pee kintayio aikunu inji?

English: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
Masaai: Eimeitore esarng'ab oloitobiru motioo e sarng'ab, neitainyie ae entoki sidai nashili, neitobirie ae entoki ake naasishoreki?

English: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
Masaai: Oo te naa Enkai nayieu, ejo pee etumoki aitoduaai engoro enye neyiolouni sii engolon enye, netang'asa ang'iriaki oleng lelo oora ile ngoro laa enkitarruorroto ake eitobirakaki,

English: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
Masaai: naa ore pee eyiolouni eneba enkarsisisho e nkitoo enye te lelo laa olng'ur eitobirakaki, naa ninye sii oitera aitobiraki ninche te dukuya te nkitoo enye,

English: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
Masaai: iyiook taa lelo laa ninye oitopiwuo, neme too Lyahudi ake kake too Loreren sii?”

English: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
Masaai: Nesipa etejo ninye te Hosea, “Iltung'ana apa leme laainei ayooki nanu aipot ajo, ‘ltung'ana laainei’, ore apa ina tinki nayooki nanu ajo, ‘Enkirotet ai.’ ”

English: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
Masaai: “Ore te napa ake wueji netiaakinyeki ninche, ‘Mirara ltung'ana laainei’ te ina eyookini aajo ninche ‘Nkera e Nkai naishu.’ ”

English: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
Masaai: Netabuaa Isaya ajo ti alo Siraeli: “Ore hoo neba nkera e Siraeli anaa osinyai le naiposha, oloti pisiai ake eitajeuni ti atua ninche;

English: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
Masaai: amu keitabaiki Enkai enkop enkiguana natudung'oko asioki o te ngolon.”

English: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
Masaai: Naa ore anaa enatoduaa Isaya, “Te neme Olaitoriani loo lororani otelekaka iyiook nkera, anaata kitotiutuo anaa Sodom, neikoni iyiook anaa Gomora.”

English: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
Masaai: Aikijo aa naa iyiook? Iloreren leitu eing'oru ninche esupatisho ninche oonoto, naa to rrekie le nkirukoto;

English: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
Masaai: kake eji ore ninche Siraeli ooing'orutua esupatisho aa nekua kitanapat eitasheyie neitu eidim ninche aaitabai nena kitanapat.

English: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
Masaai: Aainyo? Enkaraki neitu eing'oru to rrekie le nkirukoto, kake etiu anaa too nkiaasin. Ketarrorrote te ilo soit orrorrisho,

English: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
Masaai: anaa enatisiraki, “Ng'ura, nanu oirragie te Sion osoit orror iltung'ana, osoit kitok obatat ninche, kake ore oloiruk ninye nemeitukurruni.”

English: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei, ore enayieu oleng oltau lai te ninche naa pee eitajeuni.

English: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
Masaai: Ara nanu shakeni te ninche nchere keeta olokiyo kitok te Nkai, kake mewang eyiolounoto.

English: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaraki nemeyiolo esupatisho naa Enkai eing'uaa, nejo ninche maing'oru enenye naitasheyie, neaku eito eisho meitoria esupatisho naing'uaa Enkai.

English: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
Masaai: Amu eitabayie Kristo enajo nkitanapat, peyie aa ore pooki ng'ae oata enkirukoto neisho Enkai ninye esipata.

English: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
Masaai: Eigero Musa ajo, “Ore oltung'ani oitabaya esupatisho naa nkitanapat eitabari, neishuyie ina supatisho.”

English: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
Masaai: Kake inji ejo esupatisho naa enkirukoto eimu, Nimijo to ltau lino, “Ae ng'ae oilep alo keper?” eji, alo aitadou Kristo enkop,

English: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
Masaai: aashu “Ae ng'ae odoyio alo olodo le nkop?” eji, ailepunye Kristo too lootuata.

English: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
Masaai: Kake kejo aa? “Kinyikita ilo rorei, enkutuk ino etii, netii oltau lino,” eji, ilo rorei le nkirukoto likilikioo;

English: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
Masaai: amu ti nimbalunye iyie te nkutuk ino nchere ninye Olaitoriani Yesu niruk sii to ltau nchere eitopiwuo Enkai ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata, nikintajeuni.

English: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
Masaai: Amu to ltau eiruk oltung'ani neaku te ina eishori sipat, nelimu te nkutuk enye neitajeuni te ina.

English: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
Masaai: Ejo Lkigerot, “Meetae hoo oloiruk ninye oitukurruni.”

English: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
Masaai: Amu meeta enepaashare Ilyahudi o Lgiriki; ilo Aitoriani obo Olaitoriani le pooki naa ninye oitadoiki enkarsisisho enye lelo pooki ooipot ninye.

English: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
Masaai: Amu, “Ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani naa neitajeuni.”

English: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
Masaai: Kake amaa, kaji eiko iltung'ana te neipot ilo leitu eiruk? Naa kaji eiko te neiruk ninye oleitu ae kata elikini metoning'o? Naa kaji eiko te nening meeta olalikioroni?

English: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
Masaai: Naa kaji eiko tenelikioo eitu eirriwari, “Kebaa esidano oo nkejek e lelo ooyau lomon supati.”

English: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
Masaai: Kake mme pooki ootishilaitie lelo omon supati; amu ejo Isaya, “Olaitoriani, aing'ae oiruko inaatoning'o te iyiook?”

English: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
Masaai: Neaku nena naaning'i eimu enkirukoto, ore ina naning'i naa elikioroto e Kristo.

English: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
Masaai: Kake aikilikuanu nanu ajo, keitu doi ening ninche? Eibala ajo etoning'o; amu, “Eshomo oltoilo lenye enkop pooki, nepuo irorei lenye ineeiting'ie enkop.”

English: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
Masaai: Naitoki ake nanu aikilikuanu ajo, keitu pasa ening'u Siraeli? Musa oitera ajo, “Apik intae olom too ltung'ana leme olorere; naitagor intae to lorere omoda.”

English: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
Masaai: Nenyaaka Isaya ajo te mpijan, “Aanotito lelo leitu aaing'oru nanu, naitoduaayie kewan te lelo leitu aaikilikuanu nanu.”

English: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
Masaai: Kake etejo ninye tialo Siraeli, “Aitorioko nkaik aainei endama pooki ailejileju ltung'ana lemening'isho naatanyaita nanu.”

English: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
Masaai: Naikilikuanu naa ajo, keidipa ninye Enkai atanya ltung'ana lenyena? Mme neijia pae! ara nanu makewan Osiraeli, ole ishoi e Abraham, ole ntalipa o losho le Benchamen.

English: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
Masaai: Eitu eany Enkai ltung'ana lenyena laa ninche apake etayiolo, Aimiyiololo enajo Ilkigerot te Eliya o ina natasayia Enkai agilunore Isiraeli ejo?

English: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
Masaai: “Olaitoriani, etara ninche iloibonok linono metuata, eturoitie lperereni loo lasarri linono, nanu ake openy otelekua, naa enkishui ai taata eing'oru.”

English: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
Masaai: Ketawalikia ninye Enkai ajoki aa? “Atelekaka kewan ilewa oora inkalifuni naapishana leitu egilaki kung Baal.”

English: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
Masaai: Neijia sii taata etiu keetae olpisiai, laa te mpiris egeluno.

English: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
Masaai: Kake te naa te mpiris nemeekure aa too nkiasin amu meitoki naa empiris aaku empiris.

English: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
Masaai: Ainyoo naa? Siraeli leitu etum ina apa naing'oru ninche. Nenoto ninche lelo oogeluno, kake neitiming'ani lelo kulikae,

English: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
Masaai: anaa enatisiraki aajo, “Eishoo Enkai ninche ltauja o lukuny nemening'u toki o nkonyek nemedolisho o nkiyaa ometabaiki ena olong, nemening'isho o te ne.”

English: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
Masaai: Nejo Daudi, “Enchoo metaa osirua lenye orreshet o eloket, neaku enarror o enaitalakuni te ninche;

English: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
Masaai: nchoo emisimisu nkonyek enye pee medolishoyu, neirrugori too nkoriong'i enye ntarasi.”

English: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
Masaai: Naikilikuanu naa ajo, amaa, amu etabatatate Ilyahudi teine metaa meekure esarunoyu? Mme neijia pae! Kake enkaraki natagolo onyek pee eewuo enjeunoto Loreren, peyie epiki Siraeli olom.

English: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
Masaai: Amaa te nenyaaka taata engolon enye oo nkonyek aaku enkarsisisho too loreren, naa amaa te netaa ina natalaikinote ninche naitaa Iloreren karsisi, kebaa kenya elusoo ina nayau emborei e ning'oto te nening'ishoyu ninye!

English: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
Masaai: Ore taata, intae Iloreren airorie. Naa enkaraki nara nanu olkipaaret oirriwakaki Iloreren, esiaai ai aitasapuk

English: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
Masaai: peyie atumoki atipika Ilyahudi lang olom, pee ebaiki neitajeu ina kulikae lenye.

English: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
Masaai: Amu te naa ina natanyaita ninche nayaka enkop metoning'ore Enkai, keeta ae nayau enyorrarroto enye neme empiunoto too lootuata?

English: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
Masaai: Te nesinya eoroti e nkurma naipurji naiteri aaisho Enkai aaitaa ilng'anayio ooiteruni aatum, nesinya sii ninye enkae lulung'ata pooki; naa te nesinya entonai, nesinya sii ninche ilng'osil.

English: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
Masaai: Kake amaa te netigiluaki kulikae ng'osil, ore iyie olng'osila lo loirien le ntim, nikirubakini ine netigilunyeki pee king'arieki ina arsisisho e ilo oirien,

English: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
Masaai: nimiwuasa naa ake ti alo lelo kulikae ng'osil. Naa ti niwuasa, tadamu tejo mme iyie doi onapita ina tonai, kake ina tonai nikinapita.

English: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
Masaai: Naa iyie oyooki ajo, “Etigiluaki ilng'osil peyie aarubakini nanu.”

English: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
Masaai: Nesipa ina. Etigiluaki enkaraki neitu eiruk, kake te nkirukoto ake sii pee intashe iyie. Metaa miwuasa ake iyie, kake tureisho intashe.

English: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
Masaai: Amu te neitu eingurrie Enkai ilng'osil ate le ilo shani, mikiduaaya sii ninye iyie.

English: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
Masaai: Toduaa naa olng'ur o empijan e Nkai, ina pijan enye te lelo ootabatatate, kake ore olng'ur le Nkai, tenebik tiatua, te neme neijia nikidung'ori sii ninye iyie.

English: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
Masaai: Naa ore sii ninche lelo kulikae, te neibelekenya aapal ina neitu eiruk, kerubakini sii ninche, amu keeta Enkai engolon naitoki arubakinye ninche.

English: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
Masaai: Amu ti nikitudung'uoki to loirien le ntim, nikipuonunui aarubaki oloirien oramati, kebaa naa etumoki lelo ng'osil le ilo oirien oramati enkibung'ata einyakuaki oloirien openy.

English: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
Masaai: Ore pee miaakuku iloo wuasa te ng'eno inyi, ayieu niyiolouu ena naisudoro, ilalashera laainei, nchere einepua engoloto ae shoto e Israel, o metaba anaa neiputayu esiana oo Loreren oopuonu,

English: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
Masaai: neaku keitajeuni kenyake Israeli pooki; anaa enatisiraki aajo, “Ekelotu Olasarunoni eing'uaa Sion, neoru Yakobo enkiba naiba Enkai;

English: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
Masaai: naa nelo osotua lai o ninche ina kata alotu aiwuang'ie ng'ok enye.”

English: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
Masaai: Ore ti alo ororei supat ilmang'ati le Nkai ninche, naa enkaraki intae; kake ore te nkalo e ngelunoto nenyorri te nkaraki lekua loo menye.

English: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
Masaai: Amu meibelekenyayu nkishorunot aashu engelunoto e Nkai.

English: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
Masaai: Ore anaa enapa nining'ining'i intae Enkai nitang'amutua olng'ur lenye te nkaraki natagolong'utua ninche,

English: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
Masaai: neijia sii taata etiu ore te nkaraki engolong'u enye neing'urrieki intae naa, keyookini aaing'urrie sii ninche.

English: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
Masaai: Amu eteenikia Enkai ltung'ana pooki engolong'u pee etum aing'urrie pooki.

English: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
Masaai: Wooi kebaa enguton o enkarsisisho o enkarriyiano e ng'eno nagut e Nkai! Meing'orunoyu nkiguanat enyena nemeturunoyu nkoitoi enyena!

English: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
Masaai: “Amu ai ng'ae doi otayiolo oltau le Nkai amu ai ng'ae otaa oloiguen ninye?”

English: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
Masaai: “Amaa ai ng'ae oishoo ninye enkishorunoto metaa keyookini aalaaki?”

English: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
Masaai: Amu ninye eing'uaa naa ninye eimu naa enetii ninye epuo intokitin pooki. Metaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi. Esai.

English: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
Masaai: Aishiraki naa intae, ilalashera laainei, te ilo ng'ur le Nkai, enchoru iseseni linyi metaa olasar oishu, osinya neng'amunoyu te Nkai, amu ina eseremata inyi e nkiyang'et.

English: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
Masaai: Eminturubare ate ena kop kake embelekenyata enchoo eitang'ejuki intae indamunot pee itumutumu aaitadedeyie eyieunoto e Nkai, naa supat ninye neng'amunoyu naa bayaroti.

English: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
Masaai: Amu ore te nkaraki empiris naaishooki nanu, ajoki pooki ng'ae linyi pee medamu ajo ailepie kewan alang enairirikino kake pee etem aiguanare kewan too naatiu, aitorisioki tung'ani kewan entemet e nkirukoto naishoo Enkai ninye.

English: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
Masaai: Amu ore anaa enikiaata irubat kumok to sesen obo, neme nabo esiaai oo rubat pooki,

English: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
Masaai: neijia sii kitiu iyiook, ore hoo nikira kumok, kira osesen obo ti atua Kristo, nikira rubat olikae o likae.

English: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
Masaai: Ore kiaata nkishorunot naapaasha anaa eneba empiris naishooki iyiook, mataasishore nena: ore paa enaibon e Nkai, neiririkino enkirukoto ang;

English: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
Masaai: ore paa ene nkisiaayiare nikisiaaishore, ore paa ene nkiteng'enare, nikinteng'enishore;

English: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
Masaai: ore paa ene nkikoo nikinkokishore; ore paa ene leng'on te nkaminino; ore paa eretore, neaku te nkisosion; ore paa eno lng'ur, niking'urrie te nchipai.

English: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
Masaai: Emincho enyorrata ejing esunkureisho; embai intae intorrok, entirrisha isupati;

English: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
Masaai: entonyorrata intae maate to sotua loo lalashera; entukujata te nkanyit.

English: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
Masaai: Emincho enkisosion inyi edukenya, entaa lkirowua te Nkiyang'et, esiayia Olaitoriani.

English: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Masaai: Enting'idata to siligi linyi enting'iria to sina, entasheikinoto enkomono.

English: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
Masaai: Enchooi te nkaraki lelo sinyat ooata ngolikinot, entaa loonyor enkitoomono oo lomon.

English: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
Masaai: Entamayian lelo ooisilisil intae; entamayian emidek ninche.

English: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
Masaai: Enting'idata o lelo oong'ida ninchirishiri o lelo ooishir.

English: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
Masaai: Entotoni ining'ong'o olikae o likae emiika, entushulare lelo oomeni; emitiira.

English: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
Masaai: Emilakie entorroni enkae torroni, kake ore enaishiaakino te pooki ng'ae entipik intae indamunot.

English: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
Masaai: Te naa keidimayu, paa intae etioorie, entotoni te seriani o pooki ng'ae.

English: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, emintalaku ilapi, kake entung'eiki mbaa inyi engoro e Nkai; amu etisiraki aajo, “Enaai elap, nanu oitalaku lapi, Olaitoriani ojo.”

English: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
Masaai: A'a, “Ore pee eeta olmang'atinta lino esumash, intotio; ore pee eeta enkure nchoo entoki naok; amu ore inko neijia, inkuk naayupuyup inteleikia elukunya enye.”

English: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
Masaai: Emincho entorroni emir intae, kake entimir entorroni too supati.

English: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
Masaai: Entoning pooki tung'ani oitoreisho. Amu meetae enkitoria neme Enkai eing'uaa, ore lelo ooatae naa Enkai naitasheyie.

English: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
Masaai: Neaku ore ake oloibooyo enkitoria te ngogong'i ina naa Enkai naitasheyie, ore lelo ooibooyo te ngogong'i naa ate eyaki enkiguana.

English: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
Masaai: Amu meiture laitoriak oltung'ani lo lkuaak supat, kake eiture olo ltorrono. Iyieu iyie nimiaata enkuretisho te ilo oitoreisho? Taasa naa isupati, naa itum errepet te ninye.

English: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
Masaai: Amu osinka le Nkai ninye likiyaki isupati. Kake ore ake pee ias intorrok, tureisho, amu menapita ninye olalem pesho; osinka le Nkai ninye oitabaiki engoro enye ilo oas intorrok.

English: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina entoning naa, neme enkaraki ake naa iurere engoro e Nkai kake te nkaraki oltoilo lo ltau.

English: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ake ina sii pee ilakilaka kodi, amu ore lelo ooitoreisho naa laisiaayiak le Nkai ooirrita ina bae.

English: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
Masaai: Enchoo lelo pooki nena naairirikino ninche, enchoo kodi ilooishori kodi, ninchosho esotore lelo le sotore, entureita ninchosho enkanyit lelo ooiririkino enkanyit.

English: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
Masaai: Emiaatayie esile oltung'ani hoo obo, ae neme ene nyorrata maate; amu ore ilo onyor ole latia enye neitabayie nkitanapat.

English: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: Ore nena kitanapat naajo, “Miloloito, miaar metua, mipurrisho, ming'uar” o kulie ake kitanapat, naa kulo rorei ooitululung. “Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.”

English: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
Masaai: Meitaas enyorrata ole latia entorrono; enkaraki ina paa enyorrata enkitabaroto oo nkitanapat.

English: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
Masaai: Ore etii nena niyiololo sii aajo kaa saa ena nchere etabawua tukul enkata pee iputunyenye aaing'uaa injo. Amu taata etataanikia iyiook enjeunoto alang enapa kata pee kinteru aairuk;

English: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
Masaai: etinyikayie enkewarie, etaa ekenyu. Ematuburukushu naa isiaaitin e naimin emaishopo masaa e wang'an;

English: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
Masaai: emaitobirai ate anaa loopuo dama, neme te sikar o te merai, neme te malmalisho oo ng'uarrat torrok, neme too nkitarrikinot o to lom.

English: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
Masaai: Kake enchopo Olaitoriani Yesu Kristo, naa emintoki ake aaisho osesen erishata, metaa nena ake naayieu intabayaya.

English: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
Masaai: Ore ilo tung'ani omena enkirukoto, entang'amu, kake mme pee eishankarrareki too ltau lenye.

English: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
Masaai: Eiruk likae ajo keidim ainosa pooki toki, ore olomena naa mbenek ake enya ninye.

English: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
Masaai: Toduaa olonya mimen olemenya, nimidung'oki olemenya enkiguana olonya; amu etang'amua Enkai ninye.

English: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
Masaai: Ira ng'ae olodung'oki enkiguana osinka le likae? To lkitok lenye makewan eitashe aashu ebatata. Naa keitasheyieki, amu Olkitok lenye eitasheyie ninye.

English: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
Masaai: Eitirrish likae tung'ani enkolong nabo aitulusoo te nkae, neitirrish likae nkolong'i pooki aitoris. Enchoo pooki tung'ani metonyorrai te ndamunoto enye makewan.

English: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
Masaai: Ore oloitirrish enkolong nabo neitirrish aa Olaitoriani eyanyit. Ore sii ilo onya nenya aa Olaitoriani eyanyit; amu Enkai eisho enashe; naa ore sii ilo lemenya, nemenya te nkaraki naa Olaitoriani eyanyit neisho Enkai enashe.

English: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
Masaai: Meetae hoo obo lang laa kewan ake eishuyie, nemeetae olalang laa kewan ake enang.

English: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
Masaai: Ti nikinchu, Olaitoriani kinchuyie, naa ti nikiye Olaitoriani kinang metaa ti nikinchu aashu te nikiye kira ake ilo Laitoriani.

English: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
Masaai: Amu enkaraki e ina pee etua Kristo neitoki aishu, pee etum ataa Olaitoriani loo lootuata o looishu.

English: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
Masaai: Oo doi pee idung'oki olalashe lino enkiguana? Oo, pee imen olalashe lino? Amu kintashe ake pooki te dukuya olorika le Nkai le nkiguana;

English: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
Masaai: amu etisiraki aajo, “Ore anaa pee aishu nanu, Olaitoriani ojo, ‘Aayooki pooki ng'ae agilaki kung, neyooki pooki ng'ejep aisis Enkai.’ ”

English: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
Masaai: Neaku kiyooki pooki ng'ae aaikenaki Enkai imbaa ang maate.

English: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
Masaai: Emikintoki naa aadung'okino enkiguana ae kata olikae o likae, kake ematumut aajo mikipikaki aekata iyiook likae alashe entoki narror anaa ae bae narruesh ninye.

English: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu naaitijing'ayioki sii ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu nchere meetae entoki naiduruk te kewan enye; kake eiduruk entoki te pooki ng'ae ojo eiduruk.

English: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
Masaai: Te naa keitarru olalashe lino entoki ninosita iyie, nemeekure ilotie iyie enyorrata. Mincho ake ina toki ninya eaku ninye nabatat obo otanang'a Kristo.

English: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
Masaai: Neaku mincho esupat te iyie eimakini aajo torrono.

English: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Amu ore enkitoria e Nkai mme endaata o eokore kake esupatisho o eseriani o eng'ida naaing'uaa Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
Masaai: Ore ilo oisiaai Kristo aiko neijia neng'amunoyu te Nkai nenyorrarri sii too ltung'ana.

English: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
Masaai: Ematusuj naa ina nayau eseriani o enchetunoto nashetu olikae olikae.

English: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
Masaai: Emintarruoo esiaai e Nkai te nkaraki endaa. Kesinya pooki toki, kake torrono te neaku kebatat oltung'ani ilkulikae te ntoki nanya;

English: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
Masaai: enaikash te nemenya oltung'ani nkiri aashu eok enaisho oo sabibu aashu ae ake bae nabatat likae alashe.

English: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
Masaai: Ore enkirukoto niata, tagolie te kewan o te Nkai. Emayiana ilo lemeeta ai naiguanare te kewan te nena naatonyorrayie ninye.

English: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oata ilng'ashi eidipaki aatudung'oki enkiguana, te nenya, amu mme te nkirukoto etaasa ina; amu ore pooki neme enkirukoto eing'uaa naa eng'oki.

English: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
Masaai: Ore iyiook iloogol neishiaakino nikinap enchalan oo looshal, pee me ate kintiship.

English: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
Masaai: Enchoo pooki ng'ae eitiship ole latia enye too supati enyena, neitagol ninye.

English: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
Masaai: Amu eitu eitiship Kristo kewan; kake ore anaa enatisiraki aajo, “Ore imorot le lelo likimor iyie nanu etuurokinote.”

English: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
Masaai: Amu ore nena apa pooki naaigeroki te nena olong'i naaishari naa iyiook eigerokoki pee eutarieki, paa ore enkitashoto o enkikoo oo lkigerot nikitumie iyiook osiligi.

English: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Meishoo intae Enkai e nkitashoto nauno o ene nkilejilej entobik to lning'o olikae o likae, oleeijo ole Yesu Kristo,

English: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: pee itumutumu to ltau obo aaisisa Enkai nara menye lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
Masaai: Entang'amu olikae olikae, naa enkuna anaa ina natang'amua intae Kristo, te nkaraki enkitoo e Nkai.

English: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
Masaai: Amu ajoki nanu intae etaa Kristo osinka le lelo oomurata pee eitoduaaya esipata e Nkai, netum aitabai enkisiligata naishoo apa iloo papa,

English: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
Masaai: o pee etum sii ninche Loreren aaisisa Enkai te nkaraki olng'ur lenye. Anaa enatisiraki aajo, “Ore te nkaraki ina kaaisis iyie ti atua Loreren, naranyaki enkarna ino;”

English: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
Masaai: nenyaakaki sii ajo, “Enting'idata Loreren, te nebo ltung'ana lenyena;”

English: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
Masaai: o sii, “Esisa Olaitoriani, Iloreren pooki;”

English: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
Masaai: nenyaaka sii Isaia ajo, “Kelotu entonai e Yese ninye ilo oinyototo aitore Iloreren; naa ninye eyooki Iloreren aaisilig.”

English: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: Meiputaki intae Enkai osiligi o enchipai pooki o eseriani ti atua enkirukoto, paa te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati ebul nedooyo osiligi linyi.

English: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
Masaai: Atonyorrayie nanu openy intae, ilalashera laainei, nchere ebore intae esupatisho, nebore intae eng'eno pooki, naa indimidimi aatuutai olikae olikae.

English: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
Masaai: Kake etii nkuti baa naigeroko intae te mpijan pee aitadamu intae, te nkaraki empiris naaishoo Enkai

English: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: mataa olaisiaayiani le Kristo Yesu too Loreren naas esiaai o lapolosani lo rorei supat le Nkai, pee eaku Iloreren olasar ong'amunoyu, oitukuoki Enkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
Masaai: Ore naa ti atua Kristo Yesu, kaata esipata nawuasare esiaai ai te Nkai.

English: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
Masaai: Amu maitieu aimaki ae toki neme ina nataasa Kristo te nanu pee etum Iloreren aatoning ninye, to rorei o too nkiaasin,

English: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: te ngolon oo nkitoduaat o too ne nking'asia e ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, metaa ore ebaiki Yerusalem o metamanai alo Ilirikum, atolikioyie tukul ororei supat le Kristo.

English: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
Masaai: Naitaa eyieunoto natii oltau elikioroto o rorei supat, neme te nene wuejitin neeidipaki aaipoto Kristo, pee meaku enkitamanyunoto e likae tung'ani alotu ashet,

English: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
Masaai: kake ore anaa enatisiraki, “Keyooki aadol lelo leitu ae kata elikini ninye, neyooki ajing'aa lelo leitu ae kata ening ninye.”

English: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee aaibooyioki nkatitin kumok eitu alotu abaiki intae.

English: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
Masaai: Kake ore taata, amu meekure aata dikai wueji naisiaaishore te kulo kirinen, naa larin kumok ayieu ake nalotu abaiki intae,

English: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
Masaai: kaisilig ajo kalotu adol intae agiroo alo Spein, nikintobiraa sii intae te ina lototo ai, atang'asa ashipakino aparanare intae te nkiti rishata.

English: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
Masaai: Ore te na kata, ake etiu neijia, alo Yerusalem ayaki lelo sinyat eretoto.

English: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
Masaai: Amu etishipakinote Makedonia o Akaia esotore te nkaraki lelo sinyat aisinak ootii Yerusalem;

English: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
Masaai: netishipate ninche eas ina, neibala ajo keetayie ninche esile, amu amaa te naa keetuo Loreren aang'arie ninche enkirukoto e nkiyang'et, neishiaakino sii ninche neret aaisiaai lelo too masaa e mayianata.

English: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
Masaai: Ore naa pee aidip ena, naitabaiki ninche kuna naatasotuoki, nalotu aimaa intae alo Spein;

English: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: nayiolo ajo ore pee alotu enitii intae naa kalotu te mborei e mayianata e Kristo.

English: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
Masaai: Asai naa intae ilalashera laainei, to Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o te nyorrata e Nkiyang'et entonyok te nebo nanu te nkomono niomonono Enkai kiomonokiki nanu,

English: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
Masaai: pee aarishieki lelo lemeiruk ootii atua Yudea, neaku sii esiaai ai naisiaai lelo sinyat te Yerusalem enang'amu te lelo sinyat

English: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
Masaai: pee te neyieu Enkai nayooki alotu enitii te ng'ida naitumurru aparan intae.

English: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa Enkai e seriani te nebo intae pooki. Esai.

English: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
Masaai: Arrepaki intae enkanashe ang Febe, enkaisiaayiani e sirit natii Kendrea,

English: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
Masaai: nchere entang'amu to Laitoriani anaa enaishiaakino lelo sinyat, niretutu te mbae ake pooki nayieu te intae, amu ninye nataa enkaretoni oo lkumok ebaiki latii nanu.

English: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Eroroki Priska o Akuila, aisiaayiak te nebo nanu ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
Masaai: etipika ate batisho te nkaraki nanu, neme nanu ake oisho ninche enashe, keishorita sii ninche sirito pooki oo Loreren;

English: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
Masaai: eroroki sii ina natii enkaji enye. Eroroki olanyor Epaeneto, laa ninye oiteru aibelekenyakino Kristo te Asia.

English: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
Masaai: Eroroki Mariamu nataasishe oleng ti atua intae.

English: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
Masaai: Eroroki Androniko o Yunias, le mudong ang likiriamakinote eenata; iltung'ana ooibala lelo ti atua lkipaareta, ooitera apa ninche aairuk Kristo eitu nanu.

English: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
Masaai: Eroroki Ampilato lanyor ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
Masaai: Eroroki Urbano, likisiaayia Kristo te nebo, o lanyor Stakis.

English: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
Masaai: Eroroki Apelle, otonyorrayioki ti atua Kristo. Eroroki lelo lo lmarei le Aristobolo.

English: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
Masaai: Eroroki oltung'ani le mudong lang oji Herodion. Eroroki lootii atua Olaitoriani le nkaji e Nakirso.

English: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
Masaai: Eroroki nena aisiaayiak ti atua Olaitoriani, Trifana, o Trifosa. Eroroki nanyor Persi, nataasishe oleng ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
Masaai: Eroroki Rufo, ogeluno ti atua Olaitoriani, o ng'otonye naa yieyio sii nanu.

English: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
Masaai: Eroroki Arinkristo, Flegon, Herme, Patroba, Herma, o lelo alashera ootii te nebo ninche.

English: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
Masaai: Eroroki Filologo o Yuliaa, Nerea o enkanashe enye, O Olimpa, o lelo sinyat pooki ootii te nebo ninche.

English: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
Masaai: Erorokinoto te ng'ututata nasinya. Eiroroki intae isirito pooki e Kristo.

English: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
Masaai: Asai intae, lalashera laainei, entodol ake lelo ooipiru enchankar o ngolikinot, earare ina kiteng'enare natuutakaki intae; entaapaash ninche.

English: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
Masaai: Amu ore ltung'ana leeijo lelo mme Olaitoriani lang Kristo eisiaaita ninche kake ng'uarrat enye maate, naa nkutukie eitamelon too rorei le nkisisa pee etumoki aatelej lelo oomaae.

English: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo neyiolo ltung'ana aajo ining'ishosho intae, o metaa kang'idare nanu intae, kayieu ning'enunu aayiolou nena supati nemetii elejare, niyiolouu sii nena torrok;

English: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Masaai: pee etum Enkai e seriani atasioki atupurda shetani ti alo nkejek inyi. Metaa te nebo intae empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae Timoteo, laaisiritore te siai; naa neijia etiu Lukio o Yason o Sosipater oora le mudong lang.

English: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
Masaai: Nanu Tertio, olaigeroni le na palai, oiroroki intae ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
Masaai: Eiroroki sii intae Gayo laa enkaji enye atii, o Erasto olashumani le nkanasa, o lalashera lang Kuarto.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa te nebo intae empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo. Esai.

English: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
Masaai: Metaa taata enkisisa ene ilo oidim aitagolo intae anaa enatejo te ilo rorei lai supat o te likioroto e Yesu Kristo, o enatiu embolunoto e ina naisudoro apa too lporori ootulusoitie apa moitie,

English: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
Masaai: netabolokoki taata, ore tiatua ilkigerot le naibon, neitayioloki iloreren, te risioroto e nkitanapata e Nkai oo ntarasi pee eyau e nkanyit e nkirukoto

English: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa ene Nkai ang enkitoo ntarasi, tiatua Yesu Kristo. Esai

English: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and Sosthenes our brother,
Masaai: Paulo eing'uaa ena palai, oloipotoki te yieunoto e Nkai metaa olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu, neing'uaa sii olalashe lang Sostene,

English: Unto the church of God which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord, both theirs and ours:
Masaai: aigeroki esirit e Nkai natii Korinto. Etegeluaki intae ti atua Kristo Yesu neipoti intae entaa ltung'ana le Nkai te nebo lelo pooki ootii pooki wueji ooipot enkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, ilo Aitoriani lenye naa olalang.

English: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ;
Masaai: Ashukoki oshi ake Enkai ai enashe te nkaraki intae. Ashukoki ninye enashe te mpiris enye naishooki intae ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
Masaai: amu ore te pooki oitoi intae karsisi too mpukunot pooki. Iatata eng'eno pooki, naa ndimidimi aatolimu katukul

English: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
Masaai: amu ore shakenisho ang te Kristo neitadedeyieki ti atua intae

English: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: neaku eitu eng'oriki intae enkishorunoto e nkiyang'et hoo nabo, ianyitata embolunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that ye may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Ninye ake sii oitasheyie intae o meiting'o miatata entorrono naiguanareki te intae te ina olong o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
Masaai: Keisiligayu Enkai, naa enchula enye eipotokoki intae te nebo ilo Inoti lenye, Yesu Kristo Olaitoriani lang.

English: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that ye be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
Masaai: Asai intae ilalashera laainei, te nkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo; entoning'oto pooki; emincho ejing iorot atua intae, kake enchoo errinyokini intae oltau obo o eyieunoto nabo.

English: For it hath been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
Masaai: Amu aatolikioki mbaa inyi, lalashera laainei, eing'uaa enkaji e Kloe nchere etii enchankar atua intae.

English: Now this I say, that every one of you saith, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Christ.
Masaai: Naa inji etiu: ejo obo linyi, “Ara nanu ole Paulo,” nejo likae, “Ara nanu ole Apolos,” nejo likae, “Ara nanu ole Kefas,” nejo likae, “Ara nanu ole Kristo.”

English: Is Christ divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul?
Masaai: Ketoore Kristo? Ei Paulo apa etashoki te nkaraki intae? Ei te nkarna e Paulo eibatisaki intae?

English: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
Masaai: Ajo ashe amu maata nanu lkulinyi laibatisa leme Krispo o Gaio,

English: Lest any should say that I had baptized in mine own name.
Masaai: pee mejo ake likae eji te nkarna ai eibatisaki intae.

English: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
Masaai: Aibatisa sii enkaji e Stefana; ore metii lelo majo kaata likae laibatisa nanu.

English: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect.
Masaai: Eitu aairriwaa Kristo maibatisa, kake pee alikioo lelo Omon Supati naitelelek enkutuk pee ening'unoyu meoruni ake osalaba le Kristo ina najo.

English: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God.
Masaai: Ore ina likioroto o salaba naa emodai te lelo ootii enkoitoi nalo mutata, kake ore iyiook ilootii enkoitoi e njeunoto naa ninye engolon e Nkai.

English: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
Masaai: Amu ejo lkigerot, “Kaitarruoo nanu eyiolounoto oo lang'eni, naiwuang'ie eng'eno e lelo ng'eni.”

English: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
Masaai: Koree ilo tung'ani ng'en? Koree ilo asirani. Koree olaiguanani le na kata? Keitu eitomod Enkai eng'eno ena kop?

English: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
Masaai: Amu ore ina neitu elotu enkop ayiolou Enkai te ng'eno enye, netaa ena naitiship Enkai neitajeu ninye lelo ooiruk te modai e le rorei likilikioo.

English: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
Masaai: Olmonekie eikilikuanu Lyahudi neing'oru Lyunani eng'eno,

English: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
Masaai: kake Kristo otashoki kilikioo iyiook, otaa ninye errorroto too Lyahudi neaku kemoda too Loreren;

English: But unto them which are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
Masaai: kake ore te lelo ooipotoki, aa Lyahudi aashu aa Lyunani, Kristo ninye, ora engolon e Nkai naa eng'eno e Nkai.

English: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.
Masaai: Amu ng'en emodai e Nkai alang eng'eno o ltung'ani, negol enchalan e Nkai alang engolon o ltung'ani.

English: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
Masaai: Entadamu enkipototo inyi, lalashera laainei. Mme kumok ilkulinyi oora apa ng'eni anaa naajo ltung'ana, neme kumok iloogol; neme kumok iloo lmarei kituaak;

English: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
Masaai: kake etegelua Enkai nena naamoda te nkop pee eitukurru nena naagol, etegelua lelo oojo enkop emodai pee eitukurru lelo oogol.

English: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
Masaai: Etegelua Enkai lelo lemejo enkop eeta tipat nemenari sii, o lelo lemeetae apa pee etum aitaa pesho nena naatae,

English: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
Masaai: pee metumi oltung'ani hoo owousa te dukuya Enkai.

English: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
Masaai: Te nkaraki easata enye pee itii intae atua Kristo Yesu oitaa te iyiook eng'eno naing'uaa Enkai o esupatisho, o esinyaroto o elakunoto.

English: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
Masaai: Peyie, anaa enajo lkigerot, “Ore ake oloyieu neng'ida nchoo eng'idare Olaitoriani.”

English: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
Masaai: Ore naa etiu neijia, lalashera laainei, eitu alotu enitii te nkarriyiano oo nkirorot aashu te ng'eno, apa pee alotu aliki intae ina sipata naisudoro e Nkai.

English: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
Masaai: Atumuta apa ajo mayieu nayiolou toki tiatua intae neme Yesu Kristo, naa ilo otashoki.

English: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
Masaai: Ore ina kata pooki atii atua intae kashal apa, naureisho naikirikira.

English: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
Masaai: Neitu aasishore rorei oomelok le ng'eno airorita, o te likioroto ai, kake aataasishore enkitoduaaroto e Nkiyang'et o engolon,

English: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.
Masaai: pee meaku eng'eno e tung'ani eitasheyie enkirukoto inyi kake te ngolon e Nkai eitashe.

English: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
Masaai: Nikiaasishore, ake etiu irorei le ng'eno te lelo ootubulutua, kake mme eng'eno ele porror neme ene lelo ooitoreisho te le porror amu eidipa ninche aataa keurori.

English: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory:
Masaai: A'a, eng'eno e Nkai naisudoro kilimu, eng'eno naisudoro apake, naa Enkai naiguanua eton eitu eiteruni aata enkata naa te nkaraki enkitoo ang.

English: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo le lelo aitoriak le na towuo otoning'uo ina, amu te naa ketoning'utuo, anaata eitu epuo aashe Olaitoriani le enkitoo;

English: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
Masaai: kake, ore anaa enajo lkigerot, “Eneitu hoo edol enkong'u neitu hoo ening enkiok, neitu hoo ejing oltau lo ltung'ani, ninye eitobiraka Enkai lelo oonyor ninye.”

English: But God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
Masaai: Iyiook etaboloko Enkai kuna baa te Nkiyang'et. Enkiyang'et najur pooki toki, o metabaiki enguton e Nkai.

English: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
Masaai: Aing'ae nayiolo naatii oltau lo ltung'ani neme enkiyang'et natii atua ilo tung'ani? Neijia naa etiu, Enkiyang'et e Nkai ake nayiolo naatii oltau le Nkai.

English: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.
Masaai: Mme nkiyang'et e na kop kitang'amutua iyiook kake enkiyang'et naing'uaa Enkai kitang'amutua, pee kitum aatayiolo nena kishoroto naaishoo Enkai iyiook.

English: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man's wisdom teacheth, but which the Holy Ghost teacheth; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
Masaai: Ninye ena nikilimu, neme too rorei oolimu eng'eno e tung'ani kake too rorei ootuutaka iyiook Enkiyang'et eitawaliki nena e nkiyang'et lelo tung'ana le nkiyang'et.

English: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
Masaai: Menyorra oltung'ani ake le nkop inkishorunot e Nkiyang'et e Nkai; kemoda nena te ninye; nemening'u nena amu te nkiyang'et ake eidimi aatujur.

English: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
Masaai: Nejur ninye oltung'ani le nkiyang'et pooki toki, hoo nemeetae olojur ninye.

English: For who hath known the mind of the Lord, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Christ.
Masaai: Ai ng'ae doi, otayiolo indamunot o Laitoriani metaa keutaa ninye? Kake kiata endamunoto e Kristo.

English: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Christ.
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, lalashera laainei, maidim apa airorie intae anaa ltung'ana ootamanya enkiyang'et e Nkai kake anaa ltung'anak ake, anaa nkera kutiti ti atua Kristo.

English: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto ye were not able to bear it, neither yet now are ye able.
Masaai: Kule aitotiyie intae, mme endaa nagol, amu mindimidimi apa aainosa ina neton doi ake mindimidimi,

English: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?
Masaai: amu eton aa enoshi ake netii lkulikae tung'ana itii. Amaa te neton etii olom o enchankar atua intae, aimirara intae ilo sesen? neton inkunariri ake anaa lkulikae tung'ana?

English: For while one saith, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are ye not carnal?
Masaai: Amu ore pee eaku kejo likae, “Ara nanu ole Paulo,” nejo likae, “Ara nanu ole Apolos,” nyorrikiki naa mirara iltung'ana ake?

English: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
Masaai: Ainyoo ninye Apolos? Ainyoo ninye Paulo? Kira ake sinkan laa te ninche ietuo intae aairuk. Neeta ake oltung'ani ina naa Olaitoriani oishoo.

English: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
Masaai: Nanu otuuno, nepik Apolos enkare, kake Enkai naitubulua lelo ng'anayio.

English: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but God that giveth the increase.
Masaai: Neaku mme toki ilo otuno neme toki olotipika enkare, kake Enkai nara naitubulu.

English: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
Masaai: Erisio ake olaunoni o lopik enkare, naa keyooki ake oltung'ani atum olekoisiaayio lenye eiririkino esiaai enye.

English: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God's husbandry, ye are God's building.
Masaai: Kira iyiook ilaisiaayiak te nebo Enkai; nirara intae enkurma enye, airara enkaji Enkai.

English: According to the grace of God which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another buildeth thereon. But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki empiris naaishoo Enkai, atotiwuo nanu anaa olashetani arriyia aitobir enkitamanyunoto; likae taata oshetisho te ine. Toduaa naa ake pooki tung'ani eninkunaa enchetata ino te ine.

English: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Meetae hoo oloidim anyaaki aitamanyu ae kitamanyunoto neme enapake naidipaki aatipik, naa ninye Yesu Kristo.

English: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
Masaai: Kake te naa keshetaki likae ena kitamanyunoto sahabu, anaa enkosholai, anaa sooito le tipat, aashu nkeek, aashu olkujita, aashu suut,

English: Every man's work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man's work of what sort it is.
Masaai: kelioyu kenyake esiaai o ltung'ani. Amu keyooki akenyu ina olong te nkima naibalunye enatiu esiaai o ltung'ani. Ina kima naitisip eneikununo esiaai o ltung'ani.

English: If any man's work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
Masaai: Ore pee etune enchetata naitayio oltung'ani, netum ilo olekoisiayio lenye;

English: If any man's work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
Masaai: ore pee eaku etapejoyioki; nemetum olekoisiayio lenye kake keitajeuni ninye enkorrok, kake ketiu anaa oloimunyeki enkima.

English: Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you?
Masaai: Aimiyiololo intae aajo irara enkaji e Nkai neidipa Enkiyang'et e Nkai atamanya atua intae?

English: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.
Masaai: Ore ake oloitarruoo enkaji e Nkai, neitarruoo Enkai sii ninye; amu sinyati enkaji e Nkai, naa intae doi ina aji.

English: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
