English: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
Masaai: Kake ore pee eidipi aaitadou ntokitin pooki abori ilo Inoti lenye, ina kata kenya eitadouni ninye kewan abori Enkai, neitadowuo ntokitin pooki abori ninye, peyie eitore Enkai pooki toki.

English: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
Masaai: Ore te nemeetae empiunoto kaji eret lelo tung'ana oopuo meibatisai te rishata e lelo ootuata? Amaa te nemeitopiuni tukul ilootuata,

English: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
Masaai: aainyo naa pee maserian saai pooki?

English: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
Masaai: Esipa ajoki intae, lalashera laainei, ore te nkaraki nawuasare intae Ilkiristiano laaijo nanu, kaye nanu anaa ake.

English: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
Masaai: Amaa te naa kataarare ng'uesi te Efeso te tung'anisho ai ake duoo, kaji napaji eret ina te nanu? Naa te netaa meitopiuni ilootuata, “Ematadaata naa nikiokisho, amu eikiyooki aaye taaisere,” anaa enajo Lkigerot.

English: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
Masaai: Emincho eitapong'ori intae: “Ore encholiek oo lkiminchal keinyal olkuaak.”

English: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
Masaai: Enoto intae olkuaak sidai, emienikino ng'ok. Etii kulikae linyi lemeeta eyiolounoto e Nkai. Najo neijia pee aitukurru intae.

English: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
Masaai: Kake taata nejo likae, “Kaji eikoni te neitopiuni ilootuata? Kaji eikununo osesen otum ninche?”

English: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
Masaai: Ebaa ena modai ninkilikuanua! Ore ina niun iyie openy nemeeta nchere eitu engas aye pee etum atubulu.

English: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
Masaai: Ore ina niun naa enkantererai ake, naa ene nkano aashu ene ae ake tapa.

English: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
Masaai: Enkai naishoo mpukunot enye anaa enayiewuaki ninye enkantererai ake pooki.

English: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
Masaai: Neme inempukunoto nabo nkiri pooki. Empukunoto nabo nkiri o ltung'ani, naa ai inoo ng'uesi, naa ai noo motonyi, naa ai noo sinkir.

English: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
Masaai: Eetaeseseni le keper neetae seseni le nkop; kake eeta seseni le keper enkishiaa enye neeta seseni le nkop enenye.

English: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
Masaai: Eeta enkolong enkishiaa enye neeta olapa enenye; keeta doi ninye olakira obo enkishiaa e wang'an nalang eno likae.

English: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
Masaai: Neijia etiu empiunoto oo lootuata. Etiu anaa enkantererai, kenukari osesen te nkop eidaaya, neitopiuni te mpukunoto nemeidaaya ai kata.

English: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
Masaai: Kenukari te menatisho, neitopiuni te nkishiaa. Keshal enukari, neitopiuni eiputa engolon.

English: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
Masaai: Enukari aa osesen le na kishon, neitopiuni aa ole nkiyang'et. Eetaeosesen le na kishon, kake eetae sii likae sesen le nkiyang'et.

English: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
Masaai: Ina doi pee ejo Lkigerot, “Neaku ilo tung'ani oiturukuo, Adam, osesen oishu,” ore Adam obayie, neaku oloishoru enkiyang'et enkishui.

English: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
Masaai: Eng'ura nchere mme ene nkiyang'et naiturukuo, kake ina e na kishon, neitoki taa ina e nkiyang'et.

English: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
Masaai: Enkop apa eing'uaa oltung'ani oiturukuo, too nkulupuok eitobiruaki; naa shumata eing'uaa ilo tung'ani li are.

English: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
Masaai: Ore apa anaa enatiu oltung'ani loo nkulupuok neijia sii etiu lelo laa loo nkulupuok, ore anaa enatiu oltung'ani le keper naa neijia sii etiu ile keper.

English: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
Masaai: Ore anaa enikiwaita nyaanyukie e ilo tung'ani loo nkulupuok, ai kiya sii nyaanyukie e ilo tung'ani le keper.

English: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
Masaai: Ore enajoito, lalashera laainei, naa ena; meidim nkiri o sarge aatujung enkitoria e Nkai, nemeidim entoki naidaaya atujung'o enkitoria e Nkai, nemeidim entoki naidaaya atujung'o enemeidaaya.

English: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
Masaai: Entoning, embae naisudoro aliki intae: mikiye pooki kake keibelekenyi kenya iyiook pooki,

English: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
Masaai: te nabo kata, te nkirriapata e nkong'u; amu keru ontarumpeta, neitopiuni ilootuata nelakuni aaoru keeya ntarasi, neibelekenyi iyiook.

English: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
Masaai: Amu ore nena pooki naaye neaku ake inemeye.

English: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
Masaai: Ore pee eaku etalakuaki nena naaye aaoru keeya, netaa nena naaye inemeye, neitabari ina kata ina nasira too Lkigerot nesipayu nchere. “Etoijoyioki keeya ti atua olkishuroto.”

English: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
Masaai: “Keeya, koree emirishoi ino? Keeya, koree enoshi bae ino?”

English: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
Masaai: Ore oshi embae nang'orishore keeya naa ng'ok, naa nkitanapat engolon oo ng'ok:

English: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: kake ashe te nkai naishoo yiook matimirisho to Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki nena, lalashera laainei lanyor, entasheito, entaa ilemeigusugusieki, entaboreyia anaa ake te siaai o Laitoriani, iyiololo aajo ore ti atua Olaitoriani mme ene pesho esiaai inyi.

English: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
Masaai: Ore ti alo esotore naishori isinyat enkona sii intae anaa ina naitanapa isirito e Galatia.

English: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
Masaai: Ore te nkolong e nkiterata e wiki ninchosho eitengel pooki tung'ani enkiti toki anaa enatudupe; paa te nalotu nemeitokini aata esotore.

English: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
Masaai: Entegelu kulikae linyi, ore pee abau, nairriwaa ninche naisho mpala mewaita ina kishorunoto inyi Yerusalem.

English: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
Masaai: Naa te neishiakino nalo sii nanu, nikiriamari.

English: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
Masaai: Kalotu ina alo atang'asa aimaa Makedonia amu kayieu naimaa Makedonia;

English: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
Masaai: nebaiki nang'as aton te nebo aashu abik te nebo intae te nkata e enkijape, paa intae likipuonunu aaitobiraa te nene wuejitin pooki nalo.

English: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
Masaai: Amu mayieu taata neaku kalotu ake aimaa intae, kaisilig ajo kabik te nebo intae te nkata naje, te neishoru Olaitoriani.

English: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
Masaai: Kang'as abik te Efeso o metabau Pentekoste;

English: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
Masaai: aatabolokoki empaash e siaai nadupa, naa kumok ilmang'ati.

English: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Masaai: Ore te nelotu Timoteo, entodol ake pee meaku ketum ae toki naure etii te nebo intae, amu esiaai o Laitoriani easita anaa nanu,

English: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
Masaai: neaku emincho ake etumi oltung'ani omenaa ninye. Entaretoi meshomo te seriani pee elotu enatii. Amu aanyita nanu neanyita sii lalashera.

English: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
Masaai: Ore ti alo olalashe lang Apolo, aitirrishaka oleng pee elotu ine nitii te nebo lelo alashera; kake meyieu ninye nelotu te taata, kake kelotu te nkata naatae erishata.

English: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
Masaai: Entorripoto, entasheito oleng te nkirukoto, nipijuju, entagol.

English: Let all your things be done with charity.
Masaai: Enchoo eaku ore pooki bae niasiasa, entaas te nyorrata.

English: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei, iyiololo intae enkaji e Stefana ninche naaitera aaibelekenyakino Enkai te Akaia netasheikinote aaisiaai isinyat.

English: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
Masaai: Aisisaki intae ajoki entonyorrai erikore oo ltung'ana leeijo lelo, o ene pooki ng'ae oisiaaisho te nebo intae, o sinka.

English: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
Masaai: Atishipe naleng etabawua Stefana, o Fortunatu o Akaika, amu erishata inyi nimitii etijing'a ninche

English: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
Masaai: amu aayeng'iyeng'ie embaunoto enye ndamunot naa neijia itiuu sii intae. Entayioloito ake tipat oo ltung'ana laaijo kulo.

English: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae sirito e Asia. Ore Akuila o Priska, te nebo esirit natii enkaji enye neirriwaki intae enkirorokino ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae ilalashera pooki. Erorokinoto te ng'ututata nasinya.

English: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
Masaai: Nanu Paulo, oirriwaki intae ena kirorokino te nkaina ai makewan.

English: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
Masaai: Te netii obo lemenyor Olaitoriani inchoo metaa kediaa ilo! Olaitoriani lang, wou!

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
Masaai: Metaa te nebo intae empiris o Laitoriani Yesu.

English: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
Masaai: Airriwaki intae pooki enyorrata ai ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu te yieunoto e Nkai, o lalashe lang Timoteo, esirit e Nkai natii Korintio aigeroki o lelo sinyat ootii pooki wueji te Akaia.

English: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
Masaai: Meisisi Enkai nara Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu, Papa lo lng'ur lemeish ntarasi enkilejilej enye.

English: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.
Masaai: Ninye oilejilej iyiook ti atua sinaitin lang pooki pee kindim sii iyiook aailejileja lkulikae ooata osina te ina kilejilej nailejilejie iyiook Enkai.

English: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
Masaai: Amu te neidimua sii ninche iyiook emion e Kristo, neijia sii ninye eikuna ina kilejilej nikitang'amutua te nkaraki Kristo.

English: And whether we be afflicted, it is for your consolation and salvation, which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is for your consolation and salvation.
Masaai: Te neinosieki iyiook osina keji pee eilejileji intae neitajeuni; naa te neilejileji iyiook kejo Enkai pee eilejilej intae ti nintasheshe to sina leeijo ele likitii;

English: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
Masaai: ore osiligi lang te intae nemeigusugus, amu eikiyiolo aajo, ore pee ing'arierie iyiook osina, ning'arierie sii iyiook ina kilejilej.

English: For we would not, brethren, have you ignorant of our trouble which came to us in Asia, that we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch that we despaired even of life:
Masaai: Amu mikiyieu nimiyiololo lalashera, lang eneba enyamali nikinoto te Asia. Eirotokoki iyiook inaalang engolon ang o metaba anaa neish iyiook osiligi le nkishui.

English: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raiseth the dead:
Masaai: O metaa aikitejo etudung'okoki iyiook enkiguana e keeya, naa keji apa pee mikingarakino ake ate kake nikingarakino Enkai, naitopiu ilootuata.

English: Who delivered us from so great a death, and doth deliver: in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us;
Masaai: Ninye otasarua iyiook te batisho naitureisho e keeya, naa keitoki ake aigil asaru iyiook. Ninye kitipika osiligi lang nchere keitoki ake aigil asaru te nkomono.

English: Ye also helping together by prayer for us, that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.
Masaai: Neaku Enkai eisho ltung'ana kumok enashe te nkaraki iyiook te easata enye e mpiris naitaasa iyiook.

English: For our rejoicing is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in simplicity and godly sincerity, not with fleshly wisdom, but by the grace of God, we have had our conversation in the world, and more abundantly to you-ward.
Masaai: Amu ena shakenisho ake oo ltoiloishi loo ltauja lang kingidare, nchere ore ti atua ltung'ana, neisul ti atua intae, kintoriokito iyiook aairo sipat naaisho Enkai iyiook, naa te mpiris e Nkai mme te nkarriyiano e ng'eno e tung'ani.

English: For we write none other things unto you, than what ye read or acknowledge; and I trust ye shall acknowledge even to the end;
Masaai: Ore kulo rorei lisomama taata nining'ung'u, kuna naajoito ake elimu ninche. Ore o taata nchot ake oo mbaa iyiololo te iyiook. Naisilig ajo iyookiki aayiolou tukul aamitu,

English: As also ye have acknowledged us in part, that we are your rejoicing, even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: te ina olong o Laitoriani Yesu, niyookiki ina kata aadol aajo iatata esipata niwuasarere te iyiook anaa enikiaata iyiook te intae.

English: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
Masaai: Enkaraki apa naa kang'idare ena pee atejo kalotu abaiki intae. Kayieu apa naitaas intae kuna are sidain,

English: And to pass by you into Macedonia, and to come again out of Macedonia unto you, and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea.
Masaai: eituruk ayieu apa naimaa intae alo Makedonia naitoki sii aimu intae ashukunye; nayieu sii apa nikiretoo alo Yudea.

English: When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?
Masaai: Amaa te kuna pooki, ijojo kanyaaka aing'ash? Ana ijojo te kiri ake duoo aidipa nkiguanat aainei neaku kairiamaki ajo “Ee” najo sii “A'a?”

English: But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.
Masaai: Ore anaa pee eisiligayu Enkai, mme ake ninye ororei lang te intae ole “Ee” o “A'a.”

English: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, even by me and Silvanus and Timotheus, was not yea and nay, but in him was yea.
Masaai: Ore ilo Inoti le Nkai Yesu Kristo, likitolikioitie iyiook ti atua intae, o Silfanos, o Timoteo, o nanu, neme ‘A'a;” kake ore te ninye naa Ee.

English: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of God by us.
Masaai: Ti atua ninye etejo Enkai “Ee” too nkisiligat enyena pooki; na ina paa te ninye kijo Esai kisis Enkai.

English: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ, and hath anointed us, is God;
Masaai: Enkai doi naitagol indung'ot pokira are, iyiook o intae ti atua Kristo. Enkai doi natubukoko iyiook eilata,

English: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
Masaai: nepik iyiook olmishire ojo kira ilenyena, neisho iyiook Enkiyang'et ti atua ltauja lang anaa embae naiturumu kulie naapuonu.

English: Moreover I call God for a record upon my soul, that to spare you I came not as yet unto Corinth.
Masaai: Enkai aipot metaa shakeni lai nchere intae atejo aduaaya pee eitu aigil alotu Korintio.

English: Not for that we have dominion over your faith, but are helpers of your joy: for by faith ye stand.
Masaai: Mme doi nena baa nemeeta nchere pee eitu irukuruku kisikong'aki intae; eidipa pae atuunoyu enkirukoto inyi. Eikisiaaisho doi te nebo intae too mbaa e nchipai inyi maate.

English: But I determined this with myself, that I would not come again to you in heaviness.
Masaai: Ina pee atejo malotu aigilie, intae ai baikinoto name.

English: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?
Masaai: Naa omaa te naitame nanu intae, aing'ae aitoki nanu ang'idare? Eilo laitame?

English: And I wrote this same unto you, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy is the joy of you all.
Masaai: Ina pee aigeroko intae aiko neijia, pee te nalotu nemaitame lelo ooishiaakino neaku ninche laaiting'id. Amu ayiolo intae ajo ang'ida nanu ning'idada sii intae.

English: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
Masaai: Aigeroko intae aabore osina kitok o emion atua oltau, o too lkiyio kumok, neme kajo pee aitame intae, kake kajo pee iyiolouu eneba enyorrata nanyor nanu intae.

English: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
Masaai: Te neyawua likae emion, neme nanu eyaka, kake kajo intae pooki, hoo nemayieu napon.

English: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.
Masaai: Ore ilo otiu neijia netabaikia ina aa kenoto earata naba neijia too ltung'ana kumok.

English: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.
Masaai: Intae taata etioorie naa enaikash te nipalakiki neilejileji ninye, pee meidimu emion nalusoo.

English: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him.
Masaai: Asai naa intae enyaaki entadedeyie enyorrata ninyorrinyorro ninye.

English: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.
Masaai: Naa ina doi apa pee aigeroko intae, pee atem intae ayiolou te naa irara ilooning'isho too mbaa pooki.

English: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lipalakiki embae ake pooki, natapalaka sii nanu. Amu ore olatapalaka, te naa kaata enatapalaka, nataasa ina te nkaraki intae, anaa ketii Kristo, ine.

English: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
Masaai: Eikiyiolo losekin le sheitani nimikiyieu neidimu iyiook.

English: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ's gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,
Masaai: Ore apa pee alotu Troas alikioo Lomon Supati le Kristo, kaabolokino tukul kutukaji maisiaayia Olaitoriani;

English: I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but taking my leave of them, I went from thence into Macedonia.
Masaai: kake eitu aapal maanyamal oltau amu eitu atum olalashe lai Tito; neaku atung'uayie ninche nalo Makedonia.

English: Now thanks be unto God, which always causeth us to triumph in Christ, and maketh manifest the savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
Masaai: Kake ashe te Nkai, narik iyiook maisula anaa ake te Kristo, neasishore iyiook maibulunye e yiolounoto e Kristo pooki wueji anaa esonkoyo narropil.

English: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:
Masaai: Eikira doi iyiook erropili e Kristo kewan naing'uaa Enkai alo enetii lelo oopuo erruorroto,

English: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
Masaai: erropili naa enkishui te lelo ooitajeuni, naa enkeeya te lelo ooye. Aing'ae doi ilo obaya te kuna pooki?

English: For we are not as many, which corrupt the word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ.
Masaai: Mikitiu iyiook anaa kulikae kumok oopuo aaitaa olkilikuai le Nkai anaa nkutiti baa nemeeta tipat; kiro iyiook anaa ltung'ana oojo mbaa naasipa, naa Enkai eing'uaa, naa te dukuya Enkai kiro, anaa ltung'ana ootii atua Kristo.

English: Do we begin again to commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation to you, or letters of commendation from you?
Masaai: Ketaa ate kinteru aaitadaraa aaigil? Eikiaatayie iyiook tipat, enaatayie kulikae, eikiaatayie tipat mpala naarrepakini iyiook intae aashu nirrepiepie intae iyiook?

English: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
Masaai: Intae ate empalai e rrepet ang, naigero to ltauja lang, nayioloi neisoma ltung'ana pooki.

English: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
Masaai: Eibala nchere irara intae empalai naing'uaa Kristo, naa iyiook ooitarasutua neme olbukoi eigerore kake Enkiyang'et e Nkai naishu, neme too soito eigero kake too ltauja loo ltung'ana.

English: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
Masaai: Te Kristo kidup iyiook aatejo neijia ti alo Enkai.

English: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
Masaai: Ore ti atua ate nimikiaata toki. Nimikijo atua iyiook ate eing'uaa ae toki. Enkai eing'uaa enkidimata ang,

English: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament; not of the letter, but of the spirit: for the letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life.
Masaai: naa ninye oishoo iyiook inaaidip nkolati ang pooki ina kata pee eitaa iyiook ilaisiaayiak lo sotua ng'ejuk leme too nkitanapat ake naasira kake te nkiyang'et; amu keeya eyau nena kitanapat naasira, kake te enkishui e Nkiyang'et.

English: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
Masaai: Ore enkishorunoto e nena kitanapat, naaigeroki too sirat lo soit, naa keeya eiting'oko. Kake ore ake eyia neewuo te nkishiaa e nking'asia o metaa meitieu Siraeli aaing'ura enkomom e Musa te nkaraki ewang'an enye, hoo naa enaishari apake.

English: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
Masaai: Kebaa elusoo, naa enkishiaa nalotu te nkishorunoto e Nkiyang'et?

English: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
Masaai: Naa amaa te neiriamunore enkishiaa naba neijia enkishorunoto oo nkitanapat naayau endung'okinoto e nkiguana, kebaa naa elusoo enkishiaa e nkishorunoto e ina Kiyang'et naitaa iyiook ilemeetakinore Enkai?

English: For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect, by reason of the glory that excelleth.
Masaai: Esipa, ore tena bae, eina apa naata enkishiaa neewuo aaku meeta enkishiaa tukul, te nkaraki ina kishiaa nalus teine.

English: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
Masaai: Amu te neeta apa ina nang'ishari enkishiaa enye, kebaa naa elusoo oleng enkishiaa e ina nabik intarasi?

English: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naa ele osiligi lang, eikiro kintieu.

English: And not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished:
Masaai: Mikitiu anaa Musa, laa keimul apa enkomom pee meduaaya Siraeli eishari ina wang'an.

English: But their minds were blinded: for until this day remaineth the same vail untaken away in the reading of the old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
Masaai: Eitagoloki apa lukuny enye; amu ore o taata, eton ake eitu eiwuang'ieki ina kimulata te neisomai Lkigerot lo sotua musana. Ti atua Kristo ake eiwuang'ieki.

English: But even unto this day, when Moses is read, the vail is upon their heart.
Masaai: Ee, ore o taata, te neisomai mbukui e Musa, netiu anaa keimulumula lukuny e lelo ooning;

English: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord, the vail shall be taken away.
Masaai: “Hoo naa” anaa enatejo Lkigerot ti alo Musa, “ore ake pee eibelekenyakino Olaitoriani neiwuang'ieki ina kimulata.”

English: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.
Masaai: Ore ilo “Aitoriani” naa ninye Enkiyang'et ore pooki wueji netii Enkiyang'et o Laitoriani, netii elakunoto.

English: But we all, with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as by the Spirit of the Lord.
Masaai: Ore iyiook, pooki nikitaa ilemeimula nkomomi, nikiwariwaru anaa kiok teina kishiaa o Laitoriani, eibelekenyitai iyiook matotiuo anaa ninye eponari ake ina kishiaa. Enkias o Laitoriani, ena naa Enkiyang'et ninye.

English: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
Masaai: Neaku, ore anaa ina naisho iyiook Enkai ena kisiaaiyiare to lng'ur lenye, mikidukenya iyiook.

English: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.
Masaai: Kitejo mikiyieu nkiaasin pooki e nkurruna o nemeeta anyit; nikinchu mikiaata losekin torrok. Nimikordil ororei le Nkai kake esipata kiyau enewang pee kirrep ate to ltoilo lo ltau le pooki ng'ae, anaa loodolita Enkai.

English: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
Masaai: Amu te naa keimulumularo Lomon lang Supati, naa te lelo ake oopuo enkiminata eimulumularo.

English: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
Masaai: Enkai e na kop naitamodoo nkonyek e kulo lemeiruk, pee medol ewang'an oo Lomon Supati le nkishiaa e Kristo, laa ninye nyaanyukie e Nkai.

English: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus' sake.
Masaai: Mme ate kilikioo iyiook; Kristo Yesu kilikioo aajo Olaitoriani, nikira iyiook isinkan linyi, te nkaraki Yesu.

English: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu ina Ai natejo, “Inchoo metawang'a ewang'an te naimin,” ninye natawang'a ti atua ltauja, lang ayaki iyiook ewang'an e yiolounoto e nkitoo e Nkai te nkomom e Kristo.

English: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
Masaai: Kake aikiaata iyiook ele shumata atua masaa oo nkulupuok pee eliooyu nchere ore ina golon magilani naa Enkai eing'uaa, mme atua iyiook ate.

English: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
Masaai: Eironyitai iyiook te pooki oitoi, kake eitu epurdi iyiook, neimagitai iyiook kake eitu kipalari; nenang'ieki iyiook enkop, nebatati iyiook kake eitu sii emuti,

English: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
Masaai: neinosieki iyiook osina kake eitu sii eiturrarri iyiook.

English: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
Masaai: Kinapita anaa ake too seseni lang keeya e Yesu, pee eitoduaari enkishui e Yesu ti atua seseni lang.

English: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
Masaai: Amu ore iyiook, hoo nikinchu keishoori ake iyiook pooki kata aaisho keeya te nkaraki Yesu, peyie eitoduaari sii enkishui e Yesu te kulo seseni lang ooye kenyake.

English: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
Masaai: Neaku easisho ake keeya ti atua iyiook, kake enkishui naasisho ti atua intae.

English: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
Masaai: Kake kiaata enkirukoto. Ejo Lkigerot, “Enkirukoto apa aata, pee airoro.” Ina kiyang'et ake e nkirukoto kiaata sii iyiook, naa ina sii iyiook pee kiro;

English: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
Masaai: amu aikiyiolo aajo ore ilo oitopiwuo Olaitoriani Yesu keitopiu sii ninche yiook te nebo Yesu neyau iyiook te nebo intae maetu enetii ninye.

English: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki intae pee etiu kuna pooki. Paa ore anaa enaponari empiris e Nkai too ltung'ana kumok o kulikae ake, neponaa enkishooroto e nashe te nkitoo e Nkai.

English: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
Masaai: Enkaraki e na pee mikidukenya. Ore hoo naa kemusanu ake ele tung'ani li oriong amuta, kake ore ilo tung'ani lang li atua neitang'ejuki nkolong'i pooki.

English: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
Masaai: Ole nkiti kata ake osina lang, kake eyaki iyiook enkishiaa kitok oo ntarasi nemeetae ae toki natemakini,

English: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
Masaai: amu mme kuna naalioo king'orita kake nena nemelioo. Ore kuna naalioo naa ne nkiti kata; ore nena nemelioo naa noo ntarasi.

English: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
Masaai: Amu aikiyiolo aajo te neidaikieki ele ng'obor te nkop likimanya nikiaata emanyisho naing'uaa Enkai, e nkaji neme too nkai eitobiraki, nabikoo te shumata ntarasi.

English: For in this we groan, earnestly desiring to be clothed upon with our house which is from heaven:
Masaai: Ore doi kitii ele ng'obor eikinchir kiyieu erripoto e ina ang e keper,

English: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.
Masaai: paa ore eitoipito iyiook ina nemeinepuni iyiook mikinchopo.

English: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.
Masaai: Amu ore kitii ele ng'obor, nikinchirita te le ola lang. Mikiyieu nikinturaa osesen le nkop, kake kiyieu nikitum erripoto e ilo ng'ejuk, paa ore ilo oye neijori te nkishui.

English: Now he that hath wrought us for the selfsame thing is God, who also hath given unto us the earnest of the Spirit.
Masaai: Ore ilo oitobiraka iyiook ena toki naa Enkai, laa ninye oishoo iyiook Enkiyang'et meitisipa.

English: Therefore we are always confident, knowing that, whilst we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina eikintieusho iyiook oshi ake, amu aikiyiolo aajo ore eton kitii ang te le sesen, nikilamita Olaitoriani.

English: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
Masaai: Enkirukoto kipuoyie, neme enduaata.

English: We are confident, I say, and willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.
Masaai: Eikintieusho iyiook, naa aikiyieu napaji naa eikipuo aing'uaa ele sesen pee kitii ang te nebo Olaitoriani.

English: Wherefore we labour, that, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
Masaai: Metaa ti nikitii ena ang, aashu ti nikitii idia, ninye kiyieu nikintiship oleng.

English: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.
Masaai: Amu kintashe ake pooki te dukuya olorika le Kristo le nkiguana, neng'amu pooki ng'ae inaairirikino nena naataasa to sesen aa supati aashu aa torrok.

English: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord, we persuade men; but we are made manifest unto God; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences.
Masaai: Ore naa kiyiolo euriata o Laitoriani, nikiyietu iltung'ana keyiolo Enkai iyiook tukul enikinkununo, naisilig iyiololo sii intae enikinkununo.

English: For we commend not ourselves again unto you, but give you occasion to glory on our behalf, that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance, and not in heart.
Masaai: Mme taa ate kintoki aaisisaki intae, intae doi kincho erishata entawuasare iyiook, nitumutumu eniwalikiki lelo oowuasare enkitoo o ltung'ani, neme enatiu oltau lenye.

English: For whether we be beside ourselves, it is to God: or whether we be sober, it is for your cause.
Masaai: Te naa koloirirua kiaata iyiook naa enkaraki Enkai naa tenelulung'a iyiook ilukuny naa enkaraki intae.

English: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
Masaai: Amu enyorrata e Kristo naitore iyiook. Ena bae kinting'okito iyiook nchere: etua ilo obo te nkaraki pooki; ore enkaraki ina etuata pooki.

English: And that he died for all, that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves, but unto him which died for them, and rose again.
Masaai: Etua ninye te nkaraki pooki, paa ore lelo ooishu nemeishu te nkaraki ate ake kake te nkaraki ilo otua nenyaakaki aaitopiu te nkaraki ninche.

English: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.
Masaai: Ore naa ebaiki ena kata neito dukuya, nimikishilaa iyiook oltung'ani, te mpukunoto e tung'anisho, hoo nikitishilaitie apa Kristo te mpukunoto e tung'anisho, meekure iyiook kishilaa ninye aaiko neijia

English: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
Masaai: neaku te netii oltung'ani atua Kristo, netaa enkitayunoto ng'ejuk etulusoyie enapa musana, ng'ura nelotu ng'ejuk.

English: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
Masaai: Enkai eing'uaa nena pooki, naa ninye oitoning'o iyiook o kewan te Kristo neisho iyiook esiaai maitoning'o ilkulikae,

English: To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.
Masaai: aa taa, Enkai apa tiatua Kristo naitoning'o e nkop o kewan enye. Meshum ninye nemeikenaki iltung'ana nkitadiaat enye, kake eisiliga iyiook aisho olkilikuai oning'oreki ninye.

English: Now then we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us: we pray you in Christ's stead, be ye reconciled to God.
Masaai: Neaku kira lkiliku le Kristo, Enkai makewan, nasaisho te iyiook. Kitasayia intae te Kristo entoning'ore Enkai.

English: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
Masaai: Meeta apa Kristo ng'ok. Kake eitaa Enkai ninye eng'oki te rishata ang iyiook, paa te ninye king'ar esupatisho e Nkai.

English: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
Masaai: Ore kira laisiaayiak te nebo ninye nikisai intae eming'amaa empiris e Nkai pesho;

English: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
Masaai: amu ejo ninye, “Ore te nkata namunyak aatoning'o nanu iyie; ore te nkolong e njeunoto naatareto nanu iyie.” Ng'ura, taata ina kata namunyak; ng'ura, taata ina olong e njeunoto.

English: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
Masaai: Mikiaata iyiook olkob likipikaki hoo likae tung'ani, pee metumi ake olopik esiaai ang entiyoto.

English: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
Masaai: Kira ilaisiaayiak le Nkai ooitobiraa ate to mbaa pooki etiu enatiu: niking'iri ti atua enkinyala, too ngolikinot o too nkirrikinot,

English: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
Masaai: too ooshot o too o larrabali ti atua olorere, too nkiaasin naagol, nikirripo, nikiaata esumash,

English: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
Masaai: ore mikiaata ntiyot, nikiaata eyiolounoto, o eng'iriata o lng'ur; te Nkiyang'et Sinyati, o te nyorrata,

English: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
Masaai: kilikioo esipata, naa te ngolon e Nkai; too masaa e supatisho te tatene o te kedianye,

English: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
Masaai: eyanyiti iyiook o meyanyiti; einorri iyiook o meinorri. Keitaai iyiook ilalejak, kake kira asipak;

English: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
Masaai: netiu anaa aimeyioloi iyiook neyioloi sii oleng; kiye, nikitiu anaa looyena, naa ng'ura kinchu iyiook, kake eitu eari iyiook matuata;

English: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
Masaai: neinyalitai iyiook, niking'ida anaa ake; kira aisinak, kake kintaa iyiook ilkumok karsisi; anaa ilemeeta toki, nikiaata pooki toki.

English: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
Masaai: Lo Korintio, eikirorie intae aabaraki, newang ltauja lang naleng;

English: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
Masaai: mikijo maibooi intae, intae ooning nimbooyoyo ate.

English: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
Masaai: Entawang'a sii taata ltauja linyi. Airorie intae anaa olpayian oirorie nkera enyena.

English: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
Masaai: Emishulare aaku nabo o lelo lemeiruk. Ai ti aji eshula supati o ntorrok? Kaa shula eeta ewang'an o enaimin?

English: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
Masaai: Kening'o ae kata Kristo o Belial? Ainyoo eng'ar oloiruko o leitu eiruk?

English: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
Masaai: Ainyoo eng'arie enkaji e Nkai enoo nkitanyaanyukot naaitaai nkaitin? Amu kira iyiook enkaji e Nkai naishu. Anaa enatejo Enkai, “Kamany atua ninche nairiamariyie ninche; naaku Enkai enye, neaku ninche ltung'ana laainei.

English: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
Masaai: Enkaraki ina entupuku ti atua ninche, entoorunye entung'uai ninche, Olaitoriani ojo. Emiseyie entoki naiduruk, naa kang'amu nanu intae,

English: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
Masaai: naaku nanu Papa linyi niaakuku intae layiok o ntoyie aainei, Olaitoriani Magilani ojo.”

English: Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nikiaata iyiook kuna kisiligat, ilanyor laainei, emaitukuoi enkiduruk pooki o sesen aashu ene nkiyang'et, nikintabaya esinyatisho te uriata e Nkai.

English: Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
Masaai: Enchoo iyiook erishata ti atua ltauja linyi. Mikiaata iyiook olikintaasa enemesipa, nimikiaata olikiminie nimikiaata olikimaga.

English: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
Masaai: Nemajo neijia aa intae adung'oki enkinguena; aidipa atiaaki intae nchere kinyor intae enaa eikiyieu ake niking'arie intae embae pooki nalotu nara keeya aashu puaan.

English: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
Masaai: Kaitieu nanu airorie intae; ekawuasare intae. Aabore enkilejilejata; ore sinaitin lang pooki kaadooyo nanu eng'ida.

English: For, when we were come into Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
Masaai: Ekesipa nchere ore pee kipuonu Makedonia neitu eishori iyiook mayagie. Kinoto osina too nkaloli pooki: eetae iarat ti oriong, o enkuretisho ti atua.

English: Nevertheless God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus;
Masaai: Kake ore Enkai, naa ninye naitagol ilooata, osina, neitagol iyiook te mbaunoto e Tito;

English: And not by his coming only, but by the consolation wherewith he was comforted in you, when he told us your earnest desire, your mourning, your fervent mind toward me; so that I rejoiced the more.
Masaai: neme te mbaunoto enye ake, kake o te nkitagolo nanoto ti atua intae. Etolikio iyiook ina niyiewu intae naleng nidolidolo, neliki iyiook olkiyioi linyi, nitaa intae ilaamitu nanu. Ina bae naaitishipa oleng.

English: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.
Masaai: Amu te naa kaitamio intae (hoo te naainosua) te mpalai ai, nemairridu, amu adol ajo eitamio intae ina palai, hoo te naa te nkiti rishata ake;

English: Now I rejoice, not that ye were made sorry, but that ye sorrowed to repentance: for ye were made sorry after a godly manner, that ye might receive damage by us in nothing.
Masaai: kashipa taata, neme te nkaraki naitamio intae, kake te nkaraki nayawua enkilishoto inyi enkirridunoto, iwaita ina mion inyi anaa enayieu apa Enkai, neaku meetae hoo enatalang'a intae neitu itumutumu enkaraki yiook.

English: For godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation not to be repented of: but the sorrow of the world worketh death.
Masaai: Ore emion nainyiaaya oltung'ani enkalo nanyor Enkai naa keyau enkirridunoto nabaiki enjeunoto nemeitoki aata enkusaka, kake ore emion e nkop keeya eyau.

English: For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what indignation, yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.
Masaai: Eng'ura enaba enayaka intae ena sipata niwaita ina mion to rrekie onyor Enkai: eng'ura entejo kebaa enkisosion, kebaa eyieunoto niyieuu nimbalielie sipat inyi; kebaa engoro, kebaa enkuretisho, kebaa yieuna, kebaa enyuaata, kebaa enkitamioto! Ore too nkoitoi pooki nintoduaaitie intae nchere miaatata entiyoto te ina bae.

English: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.
Masaai: Neaku taa, ore hoo naigeroko nanu intae, eitu aigeroki intae te nkaraki ilo oinyalishe, neme sii te nkaraki ilo oinyalaki, kake te nkaraki pee aitodol intae te dukuya Enkai nchere irowuarere ijing'ijing'i enkalo ang.

English: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort: yea, and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by you all.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee eitagoloki ltauja lang. Neme lkulalang ake eilejilejaki kake eikiting'idate naleng te nchipai e Tito. Iyeng'iyeng'ie intae pooki indamunot enyena.

English: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
Masaai: Te naa taa oshi katawuasare nanu intae te netii ninye, eitu kintukurrurru intae nanu. Mikiaata ai nikitejo te dukuya Tito natisipe.

English: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling ye received him.
Masaai: Enyaaka alusoo enyorrata nanyor ninye intae to ltau lenye te nedamu ina nitoning'ishote o to lokirikiri.

English: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
Masaai: Ang'ida nanu oleng amu kaidim aisiliga intae katukul.

English: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
Masaai: Eikiyieu niyiolouu intae ilalashera, enataasa empiris e Nkai naishooki sirito e Makedonia.

English: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
Masaai: Etetemaki naleng to sina, kake ore ti atua nena pooki nedooyo eng'ida enye, naa ore hoo naa aisinak naleng, neitulusoitie elengon te nkishooroto enye.

English: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
Masaai: Amu kaidim nanu atiaaki intae nchere eishorutua naairirikino nena naata neitoki aaitogiroo ine. Ore te yieunoto enye maate,

English: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
Masaai: eitirrishakita iyiook naleng eyieu neishori metang'ara eretoto nareti ltung'ana le Nkai.

English: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of God.
Masaai: Netogiroitie kuna pooki enikinteiki apa iyiook, amu ate etang'asa aaisho Olaitoriani paa keitoki taa, te yieunoto e Nkai, aaisho iyiook.

English: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
Masaai: Ina pee kitiaakita Tito meitabai enkitobirunoto e na kishooroto ti atua intae; aa ninye apake oitasheikio te nkiterunoto.

English: Therefore, as ye abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that ye abound in this grace also.
Masaai: Ore anaa enituluso te pooki toki, ti atua enkirukoto, ti atua rorei, ti atua eyiolounoto, ti atua enyuaata pooki o ti atua enyorata inyi te iyiook; entoduaai inchere ilusoo sii te na siaai e mpiris.

English: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
Masaai: Majo ena nkaraki intae. Kajo pee aitisip te nkirowuaj e kulikae inchere kedede sii ninye enyorrata inyi.

English: For ye know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that ye through his poverty might be rich.
Masaai: Iyiololo empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo. Iyiololo eneba enkarsisisho enye! Kake etaa aisinani te nkaraki intae, peyie iakuku intae karsisi te nkaraki aisinanisho enye.

English: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
Masaai: Neaku kaliki intae enajo nanu te ina bae. Ore te elde ari oishari naa intae ooitera aayieu niretishosho naa intae sii ooitera aaiko neijia.

English: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.
Masaai: Keishiaakino na taata nindipidipi ina apa ninterutua. Iyiewu apa oleng niretishosho ina kata, neaku entabai naa eririki anaa e niaatata.

English: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.
Masaai: Te nesipa eyieu oltung'ani neishooyo, nemejoki Enkai ninye meishooi entoki nemeeta, kake eng'amu ina naata eishorua.

English: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
Masaai: Eitu ajo meiteneneng'i ilolan le kulikae neponari olinyi. Enchoo easi anaa nkiririkinot.

English: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
Masaai: Ore taata, dupoto inyi naret laikin enye; nerisioroyu nkaloli pooki ina kata.

English: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
Masaai: Anaa enejo lkigerot, “Ore ilo otasotuo esapuk neitu etum enalusoo, ore olotasotuo enkiti neitu eing'atiki.”

English: But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
Masaai: Kake ashe te Nkai naishoo Tito enyuaata metaa keyieu neret intae anaa enikitiu iyiook.

English: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
Masaai: Iyiook apa ootiaakita meeu enitii nenyorraa, kake eyieu apake ninye openy nelotu abaiki intae.

English: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
Masaai: Kirriu taata te nebo ninye likae alashe oning'o too sirito pooki te siaai e likioroto oo Lomon Supati.

English: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
Masaai: Neme doi ina ake, ketegelutua sirito ninye meisiritore iyiook neaku ninye oya ena kishoroto nikiramatita te nkaraki enkitoo o Laitoriani kewan, neitoduaaya sii enyuaata ang maate.

English: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
Masaai: Kinyokita pee metumi ake entiyoto naipotokini iyiook likae te ramatata e na kishorunoto e lengon;

English: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
Masaai: kiyieu nikias esupat neme te dukuya Olaitoriani ake, kake o te dukuya iltung'ana.

English: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
Masaai: Nikirriwaa te nebo ninche likae ake alashe lang likitetema enkirowuaj enye nkatitin kumok too nkoitoi kumok, naa ninye taata oirowua oleng te nkaraki enkisiligata kitok naata ti atua intae.

English: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Christ.
Masaai: Ore te Tito, ole ncholiek ai naa olaisiaayiani te nebo nanu te nkaraki intae, ore ti alo kulo lalashera lang, ilkiliku loo sirito, neisisi Kristo te nkaraki ninche.

English: Wherefore shew ye to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
Masaai: Entoduaa naa enyorrata inyi o ina nikiwuasare intae te kulo tung'ana, ina edol isirito.

English: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
Masaai: Ore ti alo ena siaai naitaasi isinyat neme nanu oigeroki intae.

English: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.
Masaai: Kayiolo eneba eyieunoto niyieuu niretirete, kawuasare oshi aimaki intae too Lmakedonia, naliki ajoki eidipa apa Akaia esotore e pooki toki te lde ari oishari. Enyuaata inyi nairowuajie ilkumok lenye.

English: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, ye may be ready:
Masaai: Kake airriu lalashera pee aitadedeyie nchere ore nena pooki nikiimakita te intae te na bae neibalieki nchere esipa anaa enatejo neijia itiuu. Ayieu nelulung'a nkuninyi pooki anaa ina natejo nanu ndipa aaitabai.

English: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, ye) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
Masaai: Pee meaku ake te nairiamunore kulikae le Makedonia nikinepu intae, eitu ianyishosho, neme iyiook ake ookurru, kake neijia itiuu sii intae, amu keaku kintuluso olwuasa.

English: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
Masaai: Ina pee atoduaa ajo keishiaakino ake nairriu lalashera meituruku aapuonu enitii te dukuya neitobir ina kishoroto nitejo nchoruru. Naa te neetuo eirrag eidipe neitoduaaya ina nchere intae ate ootonyorra aaishoru, nemetii olmonir.

English: But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
Masaai: Entadamu ena nchere ore ilo oun te nkutisho nesotu te nkutisho, ore ilo oun te nkumoi nesotu sii te nkumoi.

English: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.
Masaai: Tumuta pooki tung'ani to ndamunot inono tayiolo entoki ninchooyo inyor metii olng'ash; ilo oishoru te nchipai enyor Enkai.

English: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
Masaai: Keidim Enkai aishoo intae inoo nkolati inyi neitulusoo, pee itumutumu aataret esiaai pooki supat enkaraki niaatata anaake inaaidip intae te pooki toki.

English: (As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.
Masaai: Anaa enajo Lkigerot, “Eidapashaka pesho, eishoo laisinak, nebik esupatisho enye ntarasi.”

English: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
Masaai: Ore ilo oisho olaunoni lanterera neisho emukate olonya, ninye oisho intae ilanterera neitubul; ninye oponaa esotore e nkaminino inyi.

English: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causeth through us thanksgiving to God.
Masaai: Ninye oitaa intae karsisi oleng pee itumutumu aataleng too nkoitoi pooki, nedumaki ina lkulikae meishoo Enkai enchunet too nikitaasa iyiook.

English: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God;
Masaai: Amu ore ena siaai nikiasita mme ltung'ana le Nkai ake eretito; kelusoo sii te nashe nashukokini Enkai eing'uaa ltung'ana kumok.

English: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection into the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
Masaai: Ore ena siaai e nkisiaayiare naa ninye naitadedeyie enkirukoto inyi, neisis ninche Enkai te ina; amu mme ororei supat le Kristo ake ilimumu kake itoning'o sii ing'aring'ara pooki niaatata te lengon inyi te ninche o too lkulikae pooki.

English: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you.
Masaai: Neyooki ninche aadol enking'asia e supatisho e Nkai te nkishorunoto enye, nemeinosunoyu.

English: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
Masaai: Ashe te Nkai te nkishorunoto enye nemeimakinoyu!

English: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
Masaai: Nanu Paulo taata osai intae te nkaripo o te mborron e Kristo kewan, nanu oloshi obor enotote nkomomi kake neitieu intae enoshi kata mitii.

English: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
Masaai: Aomon intae, te nalotu enitii pee meaku kaitodolu empijan natiu anaa enoshi naidim aitoduaa lelo oojo mbaa e nkop naadumu iyiook mataasisho.

English: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
Masaai: Ore hoo naa enkop kitii kinchu, mme enjore e nkop kitii.

English: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
Masaai: Ore masaa nikiarare neme ake masaa o larrabal; kake keeta nkunaang enkidimata e Enkai enaa keparripar isempewueti.

English: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
Masaai: Eikiparripar iyiook enchankar oo monko; o pooki toki naitashe to lwuasa aibooyo eyiolounoto e Enkai; nikimbung aaen nkibirribirrat ake pooki metoning'o Kristo;

English: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
Masaai: naa ore pee eaku italaari aaishoru ate katukul, nikiterretenate pee kintame enkiaas pooki e ilo lemening'isho.

English: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
Masaai: Eng'ura nena baa naatii dukuya nkonyek inyi. Ketayiolo oltung'ani tukul ajo ole Kristo? Sidai, kake enchoo ilo menyaaki aikenaa ena ai bae nchere: kira sii iyiook ile Kristo anaa pee era ninye.

English: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
Masaai: Ore te naa kanya naaji kutuk oleng awuasare enkidimata ai, naa Olaitoriani laaisho pee ashetunye intae, neme pee aar intae, kake makurru.

English: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
Masaai: Emijo ake eji intae atem ajo aiture too mpala.

English: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
Masaai: Amu ejo ninche, “Keiroishi mpala e Paulo negol, kake te ning'or ninye mijo hoo toki naa ore te neiro neme hoo nyoo ninye.”

English: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
Masaai: Enchoo olojo neijia eyiolou nchere ore ina nitoduaa too mpala aainei alakuaniki intae, nikiyooki aas atabawua ine nitii.

English: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
Masaai: Naa aimikintieu iyiook aaitorisioki aashu kintanyaanyukie ate likae le lelo ooipang'u taata eisis ate. Ore oltung'ani laa ate etemie ilkulikae, naa ate eitorisioki ate, neidang'a oleng.

English: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
Masaai: Kake mikiwuasa iyiook aaitulus inaairirikino iyiook. Neidipa Enkai makewan aishoru nena kiririkinot, nebaiki sii intae.

English: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
Masaai: Iyiook ooiteru aapuonu enitii kiyaki intae lelo Omon Supati le Kristo eton eitu hoo ebau likae, metaa ti nikiwuasare intae neitu taata kintogiroo nkiririkinot ang.

English: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
Masaai: Neme iyiook oopuo aagiroo nena kiririkinot kiwuasare enaa kulikae ootaasa kake kisilig nchere ore nkiririkinot ang naa pee eponari enkirukoto inyi, neponari murruna ang ti atua intae.

English: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
Masaai: Nikitumoki ina kata aatolikioi kulo Omon Supati too nkuapi naatii te idia alo intae, nemeitokini aata enalejishoi aajo kitawuasare iyiook esiaai naa kulikae ootaasa te wueji enye.

English: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
Masaai: “Te neyieu oltung'ani newuasa nchoo eaku Olaitoriani ewuasare.”

English: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
Masaai: Errepet o Laitoriani ake naata tipat, ene pesho errepet o ltung'ani makewan.

English: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
Masaai: Enting'iria peno emodai ai nayiolo ajo ndipa aating'iria.

English: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
Masaai: Kalom nanu intae to lom le Enkai kewan. Aishoo intae Kristo anaa entito naishoori meyiolo likae lee, naishoo intae ninye metaa ninye ake openy olpayian linyi.

English: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.
Masaai: Kake sunkuroi apake sheitani oteleja Hawa, naure ake pee meinyali ndamunot inyi neaku mirukurukorere Kristo te nyorrata naitoriori nemetii leyiata.

English: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.
Masaai: Omaa te nelotu likae aliki intae likae Yesu leme olikitolikitio intae aashu ti nitang'amutua ai kiyang'et neme enapa nitang'amutua, itasiokito pae aang'amu!

English: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
Masaai: Ajo nanu madou hoo ti ai bae ake pooki te lelo kipaareta kituaak oleng.

English: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
Masaai: Ebaiki nemara jartan to rorei, kake ajo sii ayiolo naaba anaa nayiolo likae ake pooki. Kimbalakinye intae ina bae too nkoitoi pooki o too ntokitin pooki.

English: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely?
Masaai: Atolikio intae Ilomon Supati neitu aitalak intae hoo toki. Aiturukie intae hoo naisiadunye kewan. Keng'oki apa ina?

English: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
Masaai: Atang'amayie eretoto e kulie sirito naasishore nena pesai aisiaai intae. Kempurrorre ina?

English: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
Masaai: Ore apa atii atua intae naata nkolati, neitu aitaa kewan olola le likae, amu ore pee ebau ilalashera ooing'uaa Makedonia naaiputakita nkolati aainei neitulusoo. Aing'ura oleng pee maaku hoo olola te intae ti ae oitoi ake pooki, naa neijia eton aikunita o te ne.

English: As the truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
Masaai: Ore anaa enatii esipata e Kristo atua nanu, meetae entoki hoo naamitiki awuasare ina ti atua Akaia.

English: Wherefore? because I love you not? God knoweth.
Masaai: Aainyo? Kenkaraki nemanyor intae? Eyiolo Enkai ajo anyor intae.

English: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
Masaai: Kake alotoo aasita ena ake naasita taata, pee maisho erishata lelo ooyieu ina, ilooyieu erishata naitoduaarie ate anaa kerisiore esiaai naishooki ninche enaang, amu etejo ninche ninye eeta.

English: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
Masaai: Ore ltung'ana leeijo lelo naa lkipaareta le lejare, ilaisiaayiak oolejisho, ooitaakuno lkipaareta le Kristo.

English: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
Masaai: Neme enking'asia ina amu keitaakuno ninye sheitani kolmalaika le wang'an.

English: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
Masaai: Neme enking'asia naa, te neitaakuno isinkan lenyena eitaa ate isinkan le supatisho; eyooki aaiting'oki enaishiaakino nena naataasa ninche.

English: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
Masaai: Aitoki ake ajo emincho ake ejo likae kamoda, anaa ti nijojo nikinchosho sii ilo oti wuasa lai.

English: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
Masaai: Ore kuna najoito taata naitieu atawuasare, neme nkirorot oo Lkiristiano, emodai nabaraki.

English: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
Masaai: Kenya ltung'ana kumok kutukie too mbaa enye e nkishon; ainyoo naa pee manya sii nanu kutuk?

English: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
Masaai: Ijo ming'idada aa ing'iriri Imoda! Ijo mirara pasa intae ng'eni maate!

English: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
Masaai: Ing'iriri te neitaa intae likae irrindiki, nedaare intae likae, neinos likae intae anaa olowuaru, nerumaki likae intae kop, nedam likae intae nkomomi.

English: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
Masaai: Atonyorrayie nanu te nkurruna nchere atashala oshi. Kake te neetae oloyieu nenya kutuk ti ai toki (kairorita taa doi anaa olmodai), kaidim sii nanu ainosa kutuk.

English: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
Masaai: Ae Lhebrania ninche? Ara sii nanu. Ae Siraeli ninche, ara sii nanu. Ae leishoi e Abraham ninche, ara sii nanu

English: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
Masaai: ae laisiaayiak le Kristo ninche, nanu olusoo. airorita anaa oloata oloirirua? Ateeke nanu te siaai nagol, te eenata te korokoroni, te earata oo nkeenta o te batisho e keeya nalang enayiolo ninche.

English: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
Masaai: Katitin imiet aatipika Lyahudi noshi oshot artam neng'oru nabo;

English: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
Masaai: katitin uni aatooshoki too nkeenta oo sekenke; aairruyaki kata nabo too soito, katitin uni eimiso emeli atii; aawa enkewarie nalulung'a o enkolong nabo ti atua enaiposha.

English: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
Masaai: Ore too lotot aainei nemayeng'iyeng'a, nanoto batisho too lkejek, batisho too laisimak, batisho to lorere lang, batisho too ltung'ana loo Loreren, batisho ti atua enkanasa, batisho ti ong'ata, batisho ti atua enaiposha, batisho ti atua lelo ooitaakuno lalashera.

English: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
Masaai: Ateeke natamio too ngolikinot. Kumok nkatitin alau njo, naata esumash o enkure, nkatitin kumok maata endaa, naanya enkijape nkatitin kumok maadupa nkilani.

English: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
Masaai: Ore metii nena kulie pooki, naata olola laainaur anaa nkakeny anyamaliki sirito pooki.

English: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
Masaai: Aing'ae oshal paa nanu lemeshal? Eimang'arie sii nanu ina shalan enye? Omaa te nebatata likae, eimaanya osina?

English: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.
Masaai: Te naa kanya ake kutuk, nanya too mbaa naaipirta enchalan ai.

English: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed for evermore, knoweth that I lie not.
Masaai: Enkai naa Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, laa ninye eisisi ntarasi, nayiolo ajo malejisho nanu.

English: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
Masaai: Ore te Dameski naa olbalosi otii ti abori Olaiguanani Aretas otorripo enkanasa e Dameski ejo pee aaibung nanu

English: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
Masaai: kake aaitadoyioki aaililioo te nkikapu aaimie elusie e suntai, naluarie nkaik enye.

English: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
Masaai: Anya ake kutuk hoo naamakua, metaa kalimu taata nduaat o mbolunot naaing'uaa Olaitoriani.

English: I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
Masaai: Ayiolo nanu oltung'ani ti atua Kristo, laa ore apa too larin tomon o ong'uan ooishari neilepieki aaya shumata e uni; naa te naa ei to sesen aashu metii osesen nemayiolo Enkai nayiolo.

English: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
Masaai: Ayiolo ajo ore ilo tung'ani (te naa taa to sesen, aashu metii osesen nemayiolo, Enkai nayiolo) eilepieki aaya Paradiso,

English: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
Masaai: nelo aning mbaa nemelimunoyu, nemeishoro oltung'ani meiroro.

English: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
Masaai: Kawuasare mbaa o ltung'ani leeijo ilo, kake ore ti alo kewan ai nanu nemanya kutuk, meteleku mbaa e menai ai.

English: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
Masaai: Ore hoo te naa kayieu nanya kutuk nemaaku olmodai, nanu, amu keaku sipat airo; kake mawuasa, amu ebaiki nejo likae kara kitok alang enaba, negiroo ina mbaa aainei naadolita ninye te nanu o nena naaning aa nanu eing'uaa.

English: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
Masaai: Naa ore pee majo ailepie kewan ajo kara kitok te nkaraki enkumoi oo mbaa naatabolokoki, aaishooki olkikuei to sesen lai, olkipaaret le sheitani, oirriwuaki maatarasaki, pee maailepieki aaitulusoo oleng.

English: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
Masaai: Katitin uni atasayia Olaitoriani maatooru aya.

English: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka ninye, “Eikibaiki iyie empiris ai, amu te wueji neshal eitabari engolon ai katukul.” Neaku kang'idakino oleng awuasare enchalan ai, pe eparnat engolon e Kristo atua nanu.

English: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
Masaai: Enkaraki ina pee ang'amu menatisho te ng'ida, o enkinyala o ngolikinot, sinaitin o nyamalitin, te nkaraki Kristo; amu ore enkata nashal nanu ina kata agol.

English: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
Masaai: Atomode! Intae likitaarakita neishiaakino naaji aa intae likirrepirrepe; amu eitu hoo adou ti ai bae te lelo kipaareta kituaak oleng, hoo nemara nanu toki.

English: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
Masaai: Aitoduaa intae ilmonek lo lkipaaret o sipa, too lmonek o mbaa e nking'asia o nkiaasin e ngolon.

English: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
Masaai: Ainyoo italaita nanoto nkulie sirito, ai neme ena nchere eitu aaku olola te ntae? Entapalakaki ena kitadiaata!

English: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
Masaai: Kayieu taata nalotu enitii te nkata e uni, nemaaku olola, amu mme doi masaa inyi ayieu kake intae ate. Mme nkera oshi naashumaki ntoiwuo kake ntoiwuo naashumaki nkera.

English: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
Masaai: Ore nanu, aishooyo kewan naleng te ng'ida, naishorua kewan katukulie maataasishoreki enkaraki iltauja linyi. Omaa te naituluso enyorrata nanyor intae, keng'oru enyorrata naanyorri nanu?

English: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
Masaai: Omaa hoo neitu aaku olola te intae, ijojo pasa kataa osunkuroi opik intae olosek?

English: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
Masaai: Ketaa kaesek intae to ltung'ani obo lairriwaki intae?

English: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
Masaai: Nanu otiaaka Tito meeu nairriu olalashe obo meiriamunore. Ketudupore pasa intae Tito? Keitu kipuoyie iyiook ina Kiyang'et nabo, nikiimu orrekie obo?

English: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
Masaai: Ijojo pasa kaate kiripaa ena kata pooki? Ijo mme neijia naa ijojo? Itapong'ori! Te dukuya Enkai kirorita, ti atua Kristo. Pooki enikiyieu iyiook nikiaas, lo shorueta lang, eikiyieu nikishetu intae aaitubulu.

English: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
Masaai: Amu kaure ajo te nalotu, nalotu ainepu intae mitiuwu anaa enayieu, nebaiki ninyorrikiki matiu nanu anaa eniyieuu intae. Kaure mepuku enchankar, olom, o engoro, o lorok, o lmarenke o lejare, o enkingolingol.

English: And lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
Masaai: Kaure ajo te nalotu naaigil aitukurru Enkai ai te dukuya intae neaku kaishiraki lelo ooidipa aataas ntorrok neitu eirridu aapal ilduruki o ng'ok e loloito o ng'uarrat torrok naatamoo apa ninche.

English: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
Masaai: Enkata e uni ena alotu enitii. Ore anaa enajo Lkigerot, “Too nkutukie oo lchakenini aare aashu okuni edung'i enkiguana ake pooki.”

English: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
Masaai: Ore enapa kata e are pee alotu eniti aikoo lelo apa ootaasa ntorrok, naikoo sii lkulikae pooki. Ore sii taata alamita intae naigil aikok intae; naa te naitoki taata alotu nemeekure aduaaya intae.

English: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
Masaai: Ena doi iyieuu naitadedeyie nchere Yesu oirorie intae ti atua nanu. Nemeshal taa ninye too nkiaasin naaitaas intae; keasisho engolon enye ti atua intae.

English: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.
Masaai: Eshal apa ninye pee eshei, kake enyaaka engolon e Enkai aisho ninye enkishui. King'arie sii iyiook ninye ina shalan, kake engolon e Enkai naisho iyiook enkishui enye, pee kitumoki aaipirare intae.
