English: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?
Masaai: Entujur ate te naa itii atua enkirukoto; entetem ate. Eimiyiololo aajo etii Yesu Kristo atua intae? Aashu te nesipa eturua intae.

English: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
Masaai: Aisilig nanu ajo iyiolouu ake ninye aajo mikitii iyiook lelo ootabatatate.

English: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
Masaai: Kiomon Enkai pee miaasiasa ntorrok, neme pee eji kitudupote iyiook, ti niaasiasa intae isupati, hoo naa keing'or kulikae iyiook nejo eturua iyiook.

English: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
Masaai: Amu mikindim hoo iyiook aataas ai bae naarare esipata, kake enaipirare esipata kiaas.

English: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
Masaai: Eiking'ida iyiook ti nikishal igoligolo intae. Ore enatii, intae kiomonoki pee imputakinono.

English: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.
Masaai: Ore pee aigerito nanu ena matii kajo paa te nabau nemaasishore enkidimata naata aitame intae. Olaitoriani laaishoo ena kidimata mateshetishore mme enaitarruorrie.

English: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
Masaai: Ore enabayie, lalashera laainei, ole sere. Entarerio nkoitoi inyi, entang'amu enkikoo ai, entoning'oto maate, entobikie eseriani; naa keaku Enkai e nyorrata o eseriani te nebo intae.

English: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
Masaai: Erorokinoto te ng'ututata nasinya.

English: All the saints salute you.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae isinyat pooki.

English: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o enyorrata e Enkai o enchula e Nkiyang'et Sinyati, te nebo intae pooki.

English: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
Masaai: Paulo olkipaaret leme ltung'ana ooitaa neme ltung'ana eimua, kake Yesu Kristo eimua o Enkai Papa, oitopiwuo ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata

English: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
Masaai: o kulo alashera ootii te nebo nanu. Isirito e Galatia aigeroki:

English: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Meeu empiris o eseriani atua intae eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo

English: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of God and our Father:
Masaai: ilo oishorua kewan te nkaraki ng'ok ang pee esaru iyiook te na towuo arruoni te risioroto eyieunuto e Enkai ang naa Papa;

English: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel:
Masaai: Aing'asia nanu eji intae lelo oosioki aaing'uaa Ilo oipoto intae te mpiris e Kristo aaibelekenyakino kulikae omon oopaashari ooji supati.

English: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
Masaai: Meetae kulikae omon supati. Iltung'ana ooetuo aaliman intae eyieu neitapong'oo Lomon Supati le Kristo.

English: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
Masaai: Kake te naa doi napaji eiyiook aashu olmalaika ooing'uaa shumata oopuonu aaliki intae kulikae “omon supati” leme lapa likitolikitio intae, nchoo ilo metaa kediaa.

English: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.
Masaai: Kindipa apa aatejo naa kaitoki ake nanu ajo, te naa keetae oltung'ani olikioo kulikae “omon supati” leme lapa litang'amutua, nchoo ilo metaa kediaa.

English: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.
Masaai: Ketiu pasa ena anaa kenkisisa oo ltung'ana aing'oru ana kene Nkai? Katiu pasa anaa eiltung'ana ayieu naitiship? Te naa ltung'ana napaji ayieu naitiship, nemaitoki aaku olaisiaayiani le Kristo.

English: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
Masaai: Amu, lalashera laainei ayieu niyiolouwu, nchere, ore lelo Omon Supati latolikio intae mme oltung'ani otang'asua.

English: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Eitu ang'amu te likae tung'ani, neitu aautaki likae tung'ani. Yesu Kristo laataboloko makewan.

English: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and wasted it:
Masaai: Itoning'o intae empukunoto ai apa eton aa lkerreti loo lyahudi aishuyie. Iyiololo enaikona ainosie osina esirit e Enkai maibooroyu aa kajo aidaikie,

English: And profited in the Jews' religion above many my equals in mine own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
Masaai: niyiololo aajo ore te sujata oo lkerreti lang nanu oisul to lporror lang aitirrish nkoon oo loo papa.

English: But when it pleased God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me by his grace,
Masaai: Kake Enkai naategelua apa eton maino naaipot aimunye empiris enye. Neaku ore pee edutaa ninye

English: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
Masaai: ajo kaaboloki ilo Inoti lenye peyie atum atolikioi Lomon Supati ti atua Loreren, eitu aikilikuanishore likae tung'ani loo nkiri o sarge.

English: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
Masaai: Keitu doi ninye alo Yerusalem enetii lelo apa oora lkipaareta eitu aaku nanu. A'a, Arabia atang'asa alo naitoki ashukunye alotu Dameski.

English: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie larin okuni, nashomo Yerusalem peyie alo abaiki Kefa. Atobiko nkolong'i tomon o miet kiboita o ninye.

English: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord's brother.
Masaai: Kake maata likae kipaaret laatoduaa meteleku Yakobo, olalashe Olaitoriani.

English: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
Masaai: Anya olmumai ajo kesipa kulo rorei pooki laigerito malejisho te dukuya Enkai.

English: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
Masaai: Anyaaka alo ilkirinen e Siria o Kilikia.

English: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
Masaai: Kake ore te nena sirito e Kristo naatii Yudea, eton apa maayiolo ninche enkorrok ai.

English: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed.
Masaai: Ketoning'o ake eji, “Ore olapa tung'ani oinosie iyiook osina, nele taata olikioo enapa kirukoto natang'asa ajo aidaikie,”

English: And they glorified God in me.
Masaai: neisis ninche Enkai enkaraki nanu.

English: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
Masaai: Ore etulusoitie larin tomon o oong'uan nanyaaka alo Yerusalem kiboita o Barnabas, narikito sii Tito.

English: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
Masaai: Ore pee ashomo ina kata, Enkai naataboloko mashomo. Anotore te nkilepata, lelo apa oitaaki larikok naibalakinye ninche kulo Omon Supati alikioo nanu ti atua Loreren; mayieu nanu neaku esiaai ai nataasa apa o ena naasita taata ene pesho.

English: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
Masaai: Kake ore ninye Tito laboitare te ine neitu earakini metumurati, hoo naa Olyunani ninye.

English: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
Masaai: Kanaata doi ninye eitu eimakini ina bae te neme keiseleejakinote atua iyiook ltung'ana ooitaakuno ilalashera epuonu aajur elakunoto nikiaata iyiook ti atua Kristo Yesu. Kejo apa pee eitaa iyiook irrindiki,

English: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
Masaai: kake eitu hoo king'as aaisho enkiti rishata. Esipata apa e kulo Omon Supati kiyieu neserian ti atua intae.

English: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man's person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
Masaai: Ore lelo apa ooji kituaak neme hoo ainyoo ina te nanu etiu o mme, amu meeta ninye Enkai olkep, netalaita hoo toki najo maanyaaki aaponiki.

English: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
Masaai: Ore hoo enatii, ketoduaa aajo aaisiligaki too Lomon Supati mayaki Ilmemurata anaa enaisiligaki Petero meyaki Iloomurata.

English: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
Masaai: Amu Enkai naidimie Petero metaa olkipaaret too Loomurata naaidimie sii nanu mataa olkipaaret too Loreren.

English: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
Masaai: Neaku Yakobo, Kefa o Yohana, lelo ooitaai ng'apeta e ina sirit ootoduaa kirotetisho naaishoo Enkai nanu neng'amaa Barnabas o nanu eitodolu aajo king'ar ena siaai. Neaku kipuo iyiook Iloreren nepuo ninche enetii Iloomurata.

English: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
Masaai: Ena bae nabo ake eitanapa iyiook nchere atadamu laisinak naa ina bae apake airowuare aas.

English: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
Masaai: Kake ore pee elotu Kefa Antiok naitasheiki ashirraki maing'urata, amu kelioo ajo eitarruoyie.

English: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
Masaai: Etang'asa aaku kedaa te nebo Loreren, kake ore pee epuonu ltung'ana ooing'uaa enetii Yakobo neitoki aaku kekepari, amu eturia lelo ooyieu nemurati Loreren.

English: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae Yahudi ooiriamunore nesuj sii ninche ilo kuaak le sunkureisho, o metaa doi keteyiatayioki sii ninye Barnabas te ina sunkureisho.

English: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
Masaai: Kake ore pee adol nanu ajo meiriamari olkuaak lenye o esipata e kulo Omon Supati, najoki Kefa te dukuya ninche pooki, “Ira iyie Olyahudi inoti, naa nele iyie olotie olkuaak loo Loreren, nimitiu anaa Olyahudi. Oo naa pee ijo aaraki Loreren metotiutu anaa Lyahudi?”

English: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
Masaai: Eikira doi iyiook iinot loo Lyahudi mikira, “Loreren aasak loo ng'ok.”

English: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
Masaai: Kake kiyiolo ake iyiook aajo mme te nkitabaroto oo Nkitanapat meitoki Enkai aatakinore oltung'ani, kake enkirukoto eimu ina ti atua Yesu Kristo; naa ore iyiook ate enkaraki enkirukoto ti atua Kristo Yesu meekure eetakinore Enkai iyiook, mme nkitanapat kintabaitie. Anaa enajo Lkigerot, “Meetae hoo obo laa enkitabaroto oo Nkitanapat eimua pee meekure eetakinore Enkai ninye.”

English: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
Masaai: Kake amaa te neaku te ina naitaasi iyiook te nkaraki Kristo meitoki Enkai aatakinore iyiook te nkaraki Kristo neitokini aanyorriki nchere kira laasak loo ng'ok anaa enatiu Loreren, keaku ina eji ng'ok eisiaaita Kristo? Mme neijia pae.

English: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
Masaai: Te neaku ilo rrekie loo Nkitanapat laturoyie aitoki aitasheyie, neitoduaaya naa ina nchere kesipa kara olotigila nkitanapat.

English: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
Masaai: Amu ore te nanu nena Kitanapat ate naaiting'ie enkishui ai naitore nena Kitanapat. Ore ti alo nena Kitanapat atua nanu, peyie atum ataa kaishu te nkaraki Enkai. Etashoki Kristo naatashoki nanu te nebo ninye.

English: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
Masaai: Aatashoki nanu tenebo Kristo, meekure aa nanu oishu, kake etaa Kristo oishu tiatua nanu. Ore enkishui naishu nanu taata to sesen, naishu te nkirukoto, natii atua enkerai e Nkai Ilo laatonyorra nanu neishoru kewan te nkaraki nanu.

English: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
Masaai: Nemaany nanu empiris e Nkai. Te neaku te nkitabaroto oo nkitanapat eikenakini oltung'ani esipata nemeitoki naa enkeeya e Kristo aata tipat.

English: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
Masaai: Lo Galatia oomoda, aing'ae natasakuto intae? Amu eibalakinyeki intae tukul enchoto natashoki Yesu Kristo metotiwuo anaa itoduaa too nkonyek inyi maate.

English: This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
Masaai: Entolikioki naa ena nabo; ei nena Kitanapat intabaitie pee itang'amutua Enkiyang'et anaa kenkirukoto niruko Lomon Supati apa pee ining'ining'i?

English: Are ye so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are ye now made perfect by the flesh?
Masaai: Kesipa nchere imodada enaba nji? Enkaraki Enkiyang'et e Enkai pee nterutua enkishui inyi ng'ejuk. Ijojo pasa indimidimi aaitabai mbaa katukul ti ae oitai neme nkiyang'et?

English: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
Masaai: Keton eeta tipat te intae nena baa pooki naaimunyeki intae? Mme neijia sii ake etiu.

English: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and worketh miracles among you, doeth he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
Masaai: Amaa ilo oisho intae Enkiyang'et enye neas ine nking'asia ti atua intae. Ketaasa enkaraki naa nkitanapat intabaitie ana kenkaraki niruko Lomon Supati apa pee ining'ining'i?

English: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
Masaai: Ejo Lkigerot, “Enkai eiruko Abraham; ore enkaraki ina neikenaki Enkai ninye ajo eeta esipata.”

English: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu te intae. Ajo naa sii ake idolidolo aajo lelo ooata enkirukoto oora nkera e Abraham.

English: And the scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In thee shall all nations be blessed.
Masaai: Ejo Lkigerot, ti alo Abraham, ilo tung'ani oiruko, “Ti atua iyie emayiani Loreren pooki;” naa te lelo rorei etolikioki apa ninye eton etiooyo kulo Omon Supati. Enkata eitodoluaki nayooki Enkai aikenaki Loreren isipat te nkaraki enkirukoto enye.

English: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
Masaai: Neaku ore ilooiruk pooki nemaiyiana te nebo ilo Abraham oiruko.

English: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooigarakino enkitabaroto oo Nkitanapat netii abori oldeket, amu ejo lkigerot, “Etediaaki pooki ng'ae lemeas nena pooki naaigero too nkitanapat.”

English: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith.
Masaai: Neibala nchere meetae hoo obo lemeetakinore Enkai enkaraki naitabayie ninye Nkitanapat, amu ejo Lkigerot, “Ore pooki ng'ae lemeetakinore Enkai ninye enkaraki enkirukoto nepok.”

English: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them.
Masaai: Kake mme nabo tukul Nkitanapat o enkirukoto, amu ejo Nkitanapat, “Ti niaas nena naajo Nkitanapat nipok.”

English: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
Masaai: Kristo oinyiang'ua iyiook asaru to ldeket loo Nkitanapat etanapa ninye makewan ilo deket te nkaraki iyiook, amu ejo Lkigerot, “Kediaa pooki ng'ae oilili to lchani.”

English: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
Masaai: Paa te Kristo Yesu ebaiki emayianata e Enkai natamayiana Abraham Iloreren, neaku enkirukoto eimu ina pee king'amu iyiook enkishorunoto e Nkiyang'et natolimuoki apake.

English: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man's covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
Masaai: Lalashera laainei aisho intae enkitanyaanyukoto oo ltung'ana. Entadamu embae natoning'okinote ltung'ana aare. Ore pee eaku eidipa nemeitokini aata oloiwuang'ie arashu eponaa, hoo naa olning'o ake otoning'okinote ltung'ana.

English: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He saith not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to thy seed, which is Christ.
Masaai: Ore too Lkigerot naa Abraham eishooki nkisiligat o ilo oiu ninye. Neitu eji, “O looiu ninye,” aajo ilkumok, kake obo etoiwuoki. Ore ilo obo naa Kristo.

English: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of God in Christ, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
Masaai: Ena doi ajo nanu; ore nena Kitanapat naaetuo enyaakita aalusoo larin iip ong'uan o tomoni uni, nemeidim ninche aaiwuang'ie osotua oidipa Enkai atuno, nemeidim aaibooi enkisiligata enye pee meaku.

English: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
Masaai: Te naa to Nkitanapat kitum enkishorunoto e Nkai, nemeitoki naa aaku enkisiligata enye eitabayioki; kake ore enkishorunoto e Enkai naishoo Abraham pesho naa enkisiligata enye eitabayie.

English: Wherefore then serveth the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
Masaai: Kaa tipat naa apake eeta ninche Nkitanapat pee eetae? Eishoruaki pee eyiolouni engilata oo nkitanapat aajo ainyoo oshi ninche, kake eishooki metobiko o metabau ilo oiu naa ninye apa eipirieki enkisiligata naitayioki. Too lmalaika apa eitarasuaki aaimunye nkaik o lkilikuai.

English: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
Masaai: Ore embae naa obo oas nemeetayieki tipat olkilikuai. Naa nabo Enkai.

English: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
Masaai: Kepaashare nena kitanapat enkisiligata e Nkai? Mme neijia pae. Te naa apa kepokie ltung'ana nkitanapat naaishoruaki, naa anaata eikenaka Enkai iyiook isipat enkaraki nena kitanapat.

English: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe.
Masaai: Kake euno Lkigerot nchere eena pooki toki too ng'ok, paa ina kisiligata, naa te nkirukoto ti atua Yesu Kristo eitashe, eishori lelo ake ooiruk.

English: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
Masaai: Ore etiooyo enkirukoto, eton apa kiena iyiook ti abori nkitanapat o metaba anaa neboluni ina kirukoto nalotu.

English: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.
Masaai: Neaku etotiutuo nena Kitanapat anaa olaramatani lang o metabau Kristo, pee eikenaki Enkai iyiook isipat enkaraki enkirukoto;

English: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
Masaai: kake ore taata eewuo enkirukoto nemeekure kitii abori ilo aramatani.

English: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Amu te nkirukoto irara nkera e Enkai ti atua Yesu Kristo.

English: For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ.
Masaai: Ore intae lelo pooki ooibatisaki aapik atua Kristo ninchopo Kristo.

English: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Meitokini aata Olyahudi anaa Olyunani, orrindik arashu ololakuno, olee arashu eng'oruoi; irara pooki nabo ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: And if ye be Christ's, then are ye Abraham's seed, and heirs according to the promise.
Masaai: Naa ti nirara ltung'ana le Kristo, nirara eishoi e Abraham, nirara ilajung'ok le Enkai te risioroto e ina kisiligata.

English: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
Masaai: Ajo doi nanu nji; ore olayioni te menye naa keidim ataa ninye ojung masaa pooki, kake ore eton aa oti nemerisha o rrindik;

English: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
Masaai: eton aa abori laramatak etii ilaitasheikinok o metabau enkata apa natejo menye.

English: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
Masaai: Neijia sii kitiu iyiook, ore apa eton kira ooti, neton kira rrindiki loo nkiyang'eta e nkop,

English: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
Masaai: kake ore pee ebau enkata sidai, neirriu Enkai Oinoti lenye, otoiwuo enkitok, netoiwuoki ninye te abori Nkitanapat,

English: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
Masaai: pee einyiang'u lelo leton etii abori nena kitanapat pee kitum iyiook aatang'amu kiela naitaa iyiook nkera enyena.

English: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
Masaai: Ore pee etum aitodolu nchere irara nkera enyena, eirriwua Enkai Enkiyang'et o Inoti lenye atua ltauja lang, nebuak ajo, “Aba, Papa.”

English: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.
Masaai: Neaku meekure ira orrindik, kake itaa enkerai, naa ti nitaa enkerai, itaa sii olajung'oni, te nkiaas e Enkai makewan.

English: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
Masaai: Ore apa miyiololo intae Enkai, neaku irara apa rrindiki loo ntokitin neme hoo nkaitin;

English: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?
Masaai: kake amaa taata itayioloito Enkai, aashu doi taata eewuo Enkai ayiolou intae, kaji etiu pee intokiki arrinyokino nkiyang'eta aisinak nemeeta tipat neshal, eji niyieuwu intae nintokiki ake aaku rrindiki lenye.

English: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
Masaai: Niaatata nkolong'i nieniene, o lapaitin, o nkatitin o larin.

English: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
Masaai: Kintureita nanu matejo ore esiaai pooki nagol nataasa te nkaraki intae netaa ene pesho.

English: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.
Masaai: Asai intae ilalashera, entotiu anaa enatiu nanu, amu atotiwuo sii nanu anaa enitiuwu intae. Eitu kintaasiasa nanu ae bae torrono,

English: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
Masaai: iyiololo aajo enkaraki emueyian o sesen pee anoto erishata nalikinye intae Lomon Supati te nkiterunoto,

English: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
Masaai: naa ore eyia, eitu ntodolulu olmena arashu enyimore te nkaraki naamena osesen, hoo netetemaki intae enkuna neijia, kake kitang'amutua anaa kara olmalaika le Nkai, anaa kara Kristo Yesu.

English: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
Masaai: Koree naa taata ina aripo inyi? Ara shakeni nchere te naa apa ndimidimi, anaata itukurtutuo nkonyek inyi pee kinchosho nanu.

English: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
Masaai: Amaa naa, kataa olmang'atinta linyi, amu atolikio intae isipat?

English: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.
Masaai: Einyeito lelo laaiba aaitirrish intae oleng, kake mme too supati; kejo pee erishie intae nanu pee eaku ninche enyokitai.

English: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
Masaai: Aisidai te nikirrepi too mbaa sidain, te naa sidai embae napukoki ina. Naa too nkatitin pooki mme enoshi kata ake atii te nebo intae.

English: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,
Masaai: Nkera aainei kutiti, kame asaisai ajo pee eigili aaiu intae, o metaba anaa nepurupuranayu Kristo ti atua intae.

English: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
Masaai: Kayieu napaji naa katii te nebo intae pee atum aibelekenya oltoilo, amu eimayiolo enaas enkaraki intae.

English: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?
Masaai: Entolikioki intae lelo ooyieu nitii intae abori nkitanapat, keitu pasa oshi ining'ining'i enajo nena Kitanapat?

English: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
Masaai: Amu ejo Lkigerot eji etoiwuo Abraham layiok aare, ole rrindik obo naa ole sayunoti nalakuno olikae.

English: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo le rrindik netoiwuoki to loshi ake rrekie loo ltung'ana, ore ole sayunoti nalakuno naa enkisiligata e Enkai eitabayioki.

English: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
Masaai: Neeta nena pooki enagut nalimu ninche, ore nena kituaak pokira are naa sotuaitin pokira aare eutu. Oldoinyo le Sinai eimua obo, are nkera naaiu naa nkera e sinkaisho eiting'oki; naa Hagar eimaka ina.

English: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
Masaai: Eitodolu Hagar Oldoinyo le Sinai otii Arabia. Netiu anaa ena Yerusalem natii taata, amu etii Yerusalem sinkaisho te nebo nkera enyena.

English: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
Masaai: Kake ore ina kitok sayunoti nalakuno naa Yerusalem e keper eutu ninye naa ninye yieyio ang iyiook.

English: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.
Masaai: Amu ejo Lkigerot, “Ting'idayu enkolupi nemeisho, tabuaa nchira, hoo nimisaisai; amu ina kitok naton openy naata nkera kumok naalang ine ina naata olmoruo.”

English: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
Masaai: Kake ore doi intae, lalashera laainei itiuwu anaa Isaak, irara nkera e nkisiligata e Nkai.

English: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
Masaai: Etii ae, ore apa te nena olong'i, ore elde otoiwuoki to loshi ake rrekie lo ltung'ana neinosie osina ilo otoiwuoki te ngolon e Nkiyang'et, naa neijia sii taata etiu.

English: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the free woman.
Masaai: Kake kejaa Lkigerot? “Taarai ina rrindik o ilo ayioni lenye; amu mejung'isho olayioni le rrindik te nebo olayioni le sayunoti.”

English: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
Masaai: Neaku, lalashera, mikira iyiook nkera e rrindik, kake ine nkitok sayunoti nalakuno.

English: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
Masaai: Etalakua iyiook Kristo pee kibik kilakuno, Entasheito naa oleng, emincho eitokini aaibooki intae abori enchata e sinkaisho.

English: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if ye be circumcised, Christ shall profit you nothing.
Masaai: Nanu Paulo, ele oirorie intae. Entisipu kuna najoito. Te neaku inchosho emurati intae, nimintokiki aata dupoto te Kristo.

English: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
Masaai: Kaigil ake aaishakenoki pooki ng'ae olo metumurati nchere, ketioorie ninye meitabai nena pooki naajo nena Kitanapat.

English: Christ is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; ye are fallen from grace.
Masaai: Etudung'oyioki intae aarishie Kristo, intae taa lelo ooimu nkitanapat eji pee eikenaki Enkai intae isipat; imbelokinote oriong empiris e Nkai.

English: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
Masaai: Ore iyiook, Enkiyang'et naidimie iyiook maape dukuya te nkirukoto kiaanyu ilo siligi oikenakinye Enkai iyiook isipat.

English: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which worketh by love.
Masaai: Amu ti nikitii atua Kristo Yesu nemeitoki aaku olomurata anaa olememurata ooata tipat; ore enatii naa enkirukoto naa enyorrata eimu.

English: Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?
Masaai: Aneeijo mpirrirri apa aaitobirari; ainyoo nanyaaka aibooyo intae pee mining'ining'i esipata?

English: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.
Masaai: Mme ake ninye mbaa e Enkai naipoto intae eiroro ilo oewuo aitapong'oo intae.

English: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
Masaai: Eisuijie enkini aisuijoi entapa naipurji pooki.

English: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that ye will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
Masaai: Aata osiligi to Laitoriani, nchere kuna najo ijojo sii intae; kake ore pooki ng'ae olotu aitanyamal intae, ketum ilo enkiguana enye, era toki nara.

English: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
Masaai: Amaa ninye nanu, lalashera laainei te naa napaji kemuratare eton alikioo ajo emuratishoi ake, oo naa doi pee eton ake aainosieki nanu osina? Te naa napaji keton aa emuratare alikioo, nemeitoki elikioroto nalikioo nanu osalaba aitagor likae.

English: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
Masaai: Keyieu napaji naa ore lelo ooliman intae naa kepuo aadung ate.

English: For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
Masaai: Ore intae, lalashera laainei, elakunoto eipotokoki intae; nabo emiaas, emincho elakunoto inyi eaku enakurore osesen; kake tareto olikae olikae te nyorrata;

English: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
Masaai: amu eitabari nkitanapat te le rorei obo, nchere, “Tonyorra ole latia ino anaa eninyor kewan.”

English: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.
Masaai: Kake te neaku ionyonyo ninosasa maate anaa ng'uesi, entodol naa ake pee mimutumutu ate.

English: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
Masaai: Kake nanu enchom te Nkiyang'et nimintabaya iyieunot o sesen;

English: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.
Masaai: amu ore iyieunot o sesen negilunore ine nkiyang'et ore iyieunot e nkiyang'et negilunore ino sesen, amu mening'o pokira are, neaku mindimidimi aataas nena niyieuu niaasiasa.

English: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
Masaai: Te naa Enkiyang'et narikito intae, nimitii intae abori nena Kitanapat.

English: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
Masaai: Keibala nkiaasin o sesen, naa ninche kuna, emarmalisho e loloito, loirerioni, ng'uarrat torrok,

English: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
Masaai: eomonoto e kulie tokitin neme Enkai, esakutore, mang'atisho, enchankar, olom, engoro, olorok, eoro, olarrabal le oro,

English: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God.
Masaai: enkiba neeta likae toki, emerai, enkului, o kulie naatiu neijia. Aikok nanu intae anaa, enaidipa oshi aikoo nchere, ore lelo ooas mbaa naaijo nena nemejung katukul Enkitoria e Nkai.

English: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
Masaai: Kake ore ilng'anayio le Nkiyang'et naa enyorrata, eng'ida, eseriani, eng'iriata, enanai e nkoshoke, esupatisho, enkisiligata,

English: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
Masaai: emboron, enkibooroto e kewan. Nemeetae nkitanapat naagilunore mbaa naaijo kuna.

English: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
Masaai: Ore lelo oora ile Kristo Yesu neidipa ninche aatasho enkewan o sesen o nena yieunot enyena.

English: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
Masaai: Te netaa Enkiyang'et taata kinchuyie iyiook, ematurubare naa erikore e Nkiyang'et.

English: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
Masaai: Ematalam olwuasa le modai; nimikintagor olikae olikae aashu kimbaikino olikae olikae.

English: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei, te neaku keirrashaki oltung'ani te nkitarruorroto naje, ore intae ile nkiyang'et nitemiteme aasaru te nkiyang'et e mborron; naa entodol ate, pooki ng'ae; mikitemi sii ninye iyie.

English: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Masaai: Entaretokinoto lolan olikae o likae, amu te ina ntabayaya enkitanapata e Kristo.

English: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
Masaai: Te neitaa likae kewan kitok mme toki ninye kewan elej.

English: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
Masaai: Enchoo ejur pooki tung'ani esiaai enye, paa te netonyorrayioki netum aisisa kewan neme to le latia enye;

English: For every man shall bear his own burden.
Masaai: amu enap ake pooki tung'ani olola lenye makewan.

English: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teacheth in all good things.
Masaai: Enchoo ilo oiteng'enani eng'arie mbaa pooki supati ilo oiteng'en ninye.

English: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
Masaai: Emilej ate; mederrieki Enkai. Amu inaaun oltung'ani elo ake sii aisampu.

English: For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
Masaai: Ore ilo ounoki enkulupuoni oe nkewan o sesen nelo aisampu te ina kewan o sesen erruorroto, ore olounoki enkulupuoni e Nkiyang'et nelo aisampu te Nkiyang'et enkishui oo ntarasi.

English: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Masaai: Ore aa isupati kiaasita emikidukenya, amu kelotu enkata nikisotisho te neitu kintololong enyuaata ang.

English: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ore ake irishat pooki nikitum, emaitaasa pooki ng'ae isupati, neisul lelo le nkaji e nkirukoto.

English: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
Masaai: Ore kulo kigerot sapuki lisomama ilatisira te nkaina ai makewan.

English: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooyieu newuasare intae eyiewuaki intae olkerreti lo sesen intae ejo pee earaki metumurati, aa kejo pee mepuoi aarare ninche te nkaraki osalaba le Kristo.

English: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
Masaai: Ore doi ninche lelo oojo meeta nchere pee memurati intae, mesujita ninche oopeny nena kitanapat, kake eyieu ake nemurati intae pee etum ninche maate aatawuasare ina dung'oto oo seseni linyi.

English: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
Masaai: Ore nanu, mawuasare ai kata ae toki neme osalaba lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, laa te ninye etashoki enkop ti alo nanu neaku aatashoki nanu ti alo enkop.

English: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
Masaai: Te naa kemurata oltung'ani arashu memurata neme toki; ore enatii naa te naa keitaaki enkitobirata ng'ejuk.

English: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God.
Masaai: Menoto lelo pooki oosuj ena kitanapata eseriani o lng'ur, naa taa, lelo oora Siraeli le Nkai.

English: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki taata, mayieu naaitoki likae tung'ani aitanyamal, amu ore nkiporo to sesen lai ilmishiren le Yesu ninche.

English: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo te nebo enkishui inyi, ilalashera laainei. Esai.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu te yieunoto e Nkai, enetii lelo sinyat ooisiligayu tiatua Kristo Yesu:

English: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
Masaai: Meisisi Enkai Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, olaa ninye otamayiana iyiook ti atua Kristo too mayianat pooki e nkiyang'et naaing'uaa iwuejitin e shumata.

English: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
Masaai: Ore eton eitu eitayuni enkop netegelua ninye iyiook ti atua Kristo mataa sinyat nimikiaata entibili te ninye.

English: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
Masaai: Etegelua apa ninye iyiook te nyorrata mataa nkera enyena tiatua Yesu Kristo, te risioroto enkipirta nyor laainei, ninye otonyorra iyiook, negelaki iyiook kewan neel iyiook mataa nkera enyena kiimutua Kristo Yesu. Neijia apa eikununo enyorrata e yieunoto enye.

English: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
Masaai: Neikuna ninye neijia pee kisipu iyiook nikiyiolou eneba enkishorunoto enye naikishiaan naishoo ninye iyiook pesho ti atua ilo Inoti lenye.

English: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
Masaai: Ti atua ninye kiaata iyiook enkordunoto te nkaraki osarge lenye, aa empalakinoto oo ntorrok ang, te risioroto e mpiris enye,

English: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
Masaai: natoponikia ninye iyiook,

English: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
Masaai: te ng'eno o te yiolounoto enye pooki te risioroto e mbarakinoto enye te atua Kristo

English: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
Masaai: te nebau enkata nairirikino; ore barakinoto enye naa keyooki aiturrur pooki toki naitayioki metaa nabo tiatua Kristo, ntokitin naatii shumata o naatii enkop.

English: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
Masaai: Ti atua ninye, te risioroto e ina nayieu ninye ilo oitabaya intokitin pooki te risioroto e nkiguana enye,

English: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
Masaai: ore iyiook ilooitera aairuk Kristo netegeluaki iyiook nesirakini enkitoo enye.

English: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
Masaai: Ti atua ninye intae ilootoning'o ilo rorei lesipata, lelo omon supati le njeunoto inyi, niruko ninye, nemishiri intae te ina Kiyang'et Sinyati e nkisiligata enye,

English: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
Masaai: naa ninye enkitisipata nauno e njung'ore ang, o metaba anaa niking'amu ina, te nkisisa oe nkitoo enye.

English: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena bae, ebaiki apa paa aning enkirukoto inyi ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu, o enyorrata ninyorrinyorro lelo sinyat,

English: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
Masaai: eitu apal maishooyo enashe te intae, nadamu intae te nkomono ai,

English: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
Masaai: pee eisho intae Enkai o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, iloo papa le nkitoo enkiyang'et nagut e ng'eno o ene mbolokinoto, entayiolo ninye.

English: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
Masaai: Aomon pee eitawang inkonyek oo ltauja linyi pee itumutumu aatayiolo ilo siligi oipotokoki intae,

English: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
Masaai: aatayiolo aajo kebaa ina golon enye nemetemayu naa ninye naasisho ti atua iyiook iloiruko, te risioroto easata enkidimata enye kitok.

English: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
Masaai: Enapa nataasishore ti atua Kristo pee eitopiu aitung'uaa enkeeya neisho metotona te nkaina enye e tatene too wuejitin e shumata.

English: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
Masaai: Te ine eitore tukul pooki ooitoreisho, o nkidimat pooki, o engolon e nkitoria, neitoreisho oleng te shumata pooki arna naipoti neme kuna ake e na kata kake o ne idia nalotu.

English: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
Masaai: Netipika Enkai ntokitin pooki inkejek enyena nepik ninye metaa elukunya oo ntokitin pooki te nkaraki esirit,

English: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
Masaai: nara osesen lenye, elulung'ata e ilo oitululung pooki toki ti atua pooki toki.

English: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
Masaai: Naa intae eitopiwuo ninye, enapa kata ituata te nkaraki oo nkitarruorrot o ng'ok,

English: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience:
Masaai: inaa ninche apa ipuoyieyie isujitata olkerreti le na kop, nisujitata ilo kitok le ngolon o loing'ang'e, ina kiyang'et naisiaaisho taata ti atua nena kera naagolong'u.

English: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
Masaai: Naa atua kuna apa kitii sii iyiook pooki too ng'uarrat oo seseni lang, nikisuj iyieunot o sesen o enoo ndamunot, nikiaku iyiook maate te ikinet inkera e ngoro, anaa ina natiu ilkulikae tung'ana pooki.

English: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
Masaai: Kake ore Enkai, naata olng'ur kitok, te nkaraki enyorrata kitok naa ninye etonyorrie iyiook,

English: Even when we were dead in sins, hath quickened us together with Christ, (by grace ye are saved;)
Masaai: hoo nikituata apa te nkaraki nkitarruorrot ang, enyaaka ninye aitopiu iyiook pee kinchu te nebo Kristo, (enkaraki empiris pee eitajewuoki intae)

English: And hath raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: neitopiwuo iyiook te nebo ninye neisho iyiook matotoni te nebo ninye too wuejitin e shumata ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
Masaai: paa ore too lporori oopuonu netum aitoduaai eneba enkarsisisho e mpiris enye nemetemayu te nanai e nkoshoke enye ti alo iyiook ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God:
Masaai: Amu te mpiris eitajewuoki intae to rrekie le nkirukoto: neme hoo te nkaraki ae nitaasa intae, enkishorunoto e Nkai,

English: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
Masaai: neme enkaraki nkiaasin, metum ake likae tung'ani enawuasare.

English: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook esiaai enye naitayioki ti atua Kristo Yesu te nkaraki isiaaitin sidain naaitobira apa Enkai te dukuya pee kipuo ti atua ninche.

English: Wherefore remember, that ye being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
Masaai: Neaku entadamu inchere ore apa ae kata intae Iloreren ti alo osesen, ooji ilmemurata lelo kulikae ooji iloomurata naa entoki naitobiri to sesen too nkaik

English: That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world:
Masaai: entadamu nchere ore apa ina kata miaatata Kristo niminkenaroro intae ti atua olorere loo Siraeli, nirara apa ileeiking'a minkenaroro too sotuaitin le ina kisiligata, nimiaatata osiligi nimiaatata Enkai te nkop.

English: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.
Masaai: Kake ore taata ti atua Kristo ore intae iloolakuaniki apa oleng neitinyikuaki intae ti atua ilo sarge le Kristo.

English: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
Masaai: Amu ninye eseriani ang, olaa ninye oitaa iyiook indung'ot pokira nabo, neturoyie enapa suntai e nkiba narish iyiook,

English: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
Masaai: naa to sesen lenye eiwuang'ie ninye nena kitanapat o nkoon naaitanapishoteki pee etum ninye aitaiki kewan oltung'ani obo ng'ejuk te lelo ootoorote are, neyau eseriani,

English: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
Masaai: netum aitutumoki iyiook pokira Enkai ti atua ilo sesen obo te nkoitoi o salaba, neishu ina kiba neiting'ie.

English: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
Masaai: Neewuo ninye aliki intae eseriani iloolakua apa neliki eseriani lelo apa ootaana,

English: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
Masaai: te ninye kindim indung'ot pokira are, te ina kiyang'et nabo, aatinyikaki Papa.

English: Now therefore ye are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of God;
Masaai: Meekure naa irara lomon o leeiking'a; kake ing'aring'ara olorere obo o lelo sinyat nitaa ile nkaji e Nkai,

English: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone;
Masaai: ooteshetakaki shumata enkitamanyunoto e lelo kipaareta o loibonok le Nkai, aa Kristo Yesu makewan ilo soit kitok lo lmairroto,

English: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord:
Masaai: laa atua eidikidikokini enchetata pooki te nebo, nebulu enkaji nasinya ti atua Olaitoriani,

English: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
Masaai: laa atua ninye sii eteshetakaki intae entaa ewueji nemanya Enkai ti atua ina Kiyang'et.

English: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena bae, ore nanu Paulo, oloena le Kristo Yesu te rishata inyi intae Iloreren

English: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to youward:
Masaai: amu ajo sii ake itoning'o enkitanapa e mpiris e Enkai naaishoki metaa eninyi intae

English: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
Masaai: o eneikuna pee aaboloki nkisudorot e yieunoto enye, anaa enaidipa aigeroki intae too ndorropu.

English: Whereby, when ye read, ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
Masaai: Ore pee isumama ena niyiolouwu aajo katabaraka ayiolou embae e kristo naisudoro,

English: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
Masaai: eneitu apa elikini nkera oo ltung'ana te kulikae porori anaa ena taata naibalakinyeki ilkipaareta lenyena sinyat o loibonok le Enkai te ina Kiyang'et,

English: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel:
Masaai: naa ena naishooki Iloreren metang'arieki enjung'ore neaku irubat o sesen obo, le ncholiek e ina kisiligata ti atua Kristo Yesu eimu lelo Omon Supati.

English: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
Masaai: Te kulo Omon Supati aaitaaki nanu olaisiaayiani te risioroto e nkishorunoto e mpiris e Enkai naaishooki nanu te ngolon enye.

English: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
Masaai: Nanu taa hoo nara oloti aisul too sinyat pooki, nanu eishooki ena piris, matoliki Iloreren lelo Omon Supati, le nkarsisisho nemejurroyu e Kristo,

English: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world hath been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ:
Masaai: naaishooki maitoduaa ltung'ana pooki eneikunari enkitabaroto e ina kishorunoto naisudoyioki apa too lporori ti atua Enkai naitayio pooki toki;

English: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God,
Masaai: nchere to rrekie le sirit eboluni taata eng'eno enye oo mpukunot kumok metayiolo laitoriak e enkitoo pooki too wuejitin e shumata.

English: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord:
Masaai: Ore ena nerubare enkiguana enye oo ntarasi naitabayie ninye ti atua Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang,

English: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
Masaai: laa te ninye kiaata empijan o enkitieunoto nikinyikakinye Enkai to rrekie le nkirukoto ang ti atua ninye.

English: Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
Masaai: Neaku ajoki intae emishalu to sina laainosieki enkaraki intae, amu ninye enkisisa inyi.

English: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee agilaki kung ilo Papa,

English: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
Masaai: laa ninye eipotieki olmarei ake pooki te keper o te nkop,

English: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
Masaai: paa te risioroto e nkarsisisho e nkitoo enye eisho meitagoli intae te ngolon naimu Enkiyang'et enye te ilo tung'ani li atua,

English: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
Masaai: nemany sii Yesu atua iltauja linyi eimu enkirukoto; paa ore intae, inoto ntona nitonini te nyorrata,

English: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
Masaai: nitumutumu engolon niyiolounyenye te nebo isinyat pooki eneba elalai o enkadori o elakuani e shumata o enguton,

English: And to know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fulness of God.
Masaai: niyiolouu enyorrata e Kristo nalusoo te ng'eno pooki, nimitunyenye aaboreyu te nkiputakinoto.

English: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
Masaai: Ore taata ilo laa te ngolon naisiaaisho ti atua iyiook eidim ninye ataasa neitulusoo oleng alang nena pooki nikinkilikuanu aashu kidamu,

English: Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
Masaai: metaa enenye enkitoo ti atua esirit o ti atua Yesu too lporori pooki intarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.

English: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,
Masaai: Ore naa nanu olora oloena te nkaraki Olaitoriani, asai intae entobik te nkishon naishiaakino ina kipototo naipotoki intae,

English: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
Masaai: te nkanyit pooki o te mborron, te nebo eng'iriata iretokinono olikae o likae ti atua enyorrata,

English: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
Masaai: inyuaakiki aata naboisho e Nkiyang'et ti atua eenata e seriani.

English: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as ye are called in one hope of your calling;
Masaai: Eetae osesen obo o Enkiyang'et nabo anaa ina ake naipotokoki intae ilo siligi obo le ina kipototo inyi,

English: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
Masaai: obo Olaitoriani, nabo enkirukoto, nabo enkibatisa,

English: One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
Masaai: nabo Enkai naa Papa lang iyiook pooki, laa ninye otii shumata pooki neim atua pooki netii atua pooki.

English: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ.
Masaai: Kake eishooki ake oltung'ani pooki te iyiook, empiris te risioroto e enkishorunoto e Kristo.

English: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
Masaai: Ina pee etejoki, “Ore pee eilep ninye alo shumata nerik olorora loo looena, neisho ltung'ana nkishorot.”

English: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
Masaai: (Ore pee eji “eilepa” kaa ae naji neme nchere etadoyie sii apa alo wuejitin e abori enkop?

English: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
Masaai: Ilo ake otadoyie onyaaka sii ailep agiroo shumata pooki, pee etum ninye aiputa pooki toki).

English: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
Masaai: Ore nena kishorunot enyena naa ketejo pee eaku kulikae ilkipaareta, neaku kulikae iloibonok le Nkai, neaku kulikae ilalikiorok, neaku kulikae ilairritak o laiteng'enak,

English: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ:
Masaai: peyie erreteni lelo sinyat, te nkaraki ina siaai e ramatare, ene nchetata o sesen le Kristo,

English: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ:
Masaai: o metabaiki pooki naboisho naimu enkirukoto o eyiolounoto e ilo Inoti le Nkai, nikiaku iltung'ana ootubulutua aamitunye, aabaiki entemet e mbotoro nalulung'a e Kristo;

English: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
Masaai: pee mikintoki aaku nkera, naanang'ari idie o idie to lkutati ake pooki le nkiteng'enare, o losek loo ltung'ana ti atua esunkureisho o losekin le lejare.

English: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
Masaai: Ore enatii, emairoro esipata ti atua enyorrata, nikibulu too nkoitoi pooki aabulaki atua ilo ora elukunya ang; aabulaki atua Kristo,

English: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
Masaai: olaa ti atua ninye eruba osesen pooki, neidikidikokino atua ninye pooki rubata naishoro, easisho nena rubat pooki aaitobiraki, neitubulu osesen neitubulu kewan ti atua enyorrata.

English: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
Masaai: Najo taata ena naishakenoki ti atua Olaitoriani nchere emintoki ake aaisho orrekie le nkishon inyi etiu anaa enatiu oloo loreren, too ndamunot enye e pesho;

English: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
Masaai: eitomisimisoki ening'unoto enye; neaku ina kishui naishoru Enkai eneeiking'a te ninche, te nkaraki nemeyiolo toki; te nkaraki engolon oo ltauja lenye;

English: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
Masaai: eikaolote ninche neishooitie ate aaisho iloirerioni, netum enkului e pooki bae naiduruk.

English: But ye have not so learned Christ;
Masaai: Neme nena eiteng'enieki intae ti atua Kristo!

English: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:
Masaai: Amu ajo sii indipa aatoning imbaa enyena naaiteng'enieki intae ti atua ninye, anaa enatiu esipata tiatua Yesu.

English: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
Masaai: Entuburukushu enkewan inyi musana, e napa kishon inyi musana narruoyo enkaraki ng'uarrat naalejisho,

English: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
Masaai: naa enchoo eitang'ejuki indamunot inyi,

English: And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.
Masaai: enchopo enkewan ng'ejuk, naitayioki enyaanyukie Enkai ti atua esupatisho nasipa o te sinyatisho.

English: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, enturrai elejare, eroro sipat pooki ng'ae eirorie ole latia enye, amu kira iyiook irubat olikae o likae.

English: Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
Masaai: Entagoroto kake emiaas ng'ok; emincho edoyio enkolong itagorote.

English: Neither give place to the devil.
Masaai: Emincho sii sheitani erishata.

English: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
Masaai: Nchoo olapurroni metapala empurrorre, enaikash enincho ninye metaasisho aas esiaai e nkanyit too nkaik enyena, pee etum entoki naisho lelo lemeeta toki.

English: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
Masaai: Emiimunye lderrat torrok inkutukie inyi, kake eroro nena sidan naaretisho, neishiaakino te ina kata, pee eshetu te mpiris lelo ooning.

English: And grieve not the holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
Masaai: Emintagor Enkiyang'et Sinyati e Nkai, natipikieki intae olmishire le ina olong e lakunoto.

English: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
Masaai: Enchoo enkiba pooki o engoro o ewuapa o enchankar o esulare metalama intae te nebo o emorore o entorroni pooki.

English: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
Masaai: Eng'urrie olikae olikae entaa loonana oishuaa, entapalakinoto olikae o likae anaa enatapalaka Enkai intae ti atua Kristo.

English: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina entanyaanyukie ate Enkai anaa nkera kutiti naanyorri.

English: And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweetsmelling savour.
Masaai: Naa enchomie enyorrata, anaa enatonyorra iyiook Kristo neishooyo kewan to lbae lang, neaku enkishooroto o lasar orropil oishooki Enkai.

English: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
Masaai: Kake ore eloloito o loirerioni pooki aashu ng'uarrat torrok, emincho ake eipoti ti atua intae, amu ina naishiaakino ti atua isinyat.

English: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
Masaai: Emintoki aata loirerioni, aashu lderrat loo mbaa naata sura, aashu le modai, lemeishiaakino; kake enkishooroto e nashe entoponai.

English: For this ye know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
Masaai: Entayiolo ena nasipa nchere meetae hoo olololoito aashu oloo loirerioni, aashu oloo ng'uarrat torrok (nkitanyaanyukot taa eomon olotiu neijia), otum hoo enjung'ore ti atua enkitoria e Kristo o ene Nkai.

English: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience.
Masaai: Emincho hoo elej intae oltung'ani too rorei le pesho, amu enkaraki oshi kuna baa pee edoiki engoro e Enkai nena kera nemening'isho.

English: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina emisiritore ninche,

English: For ye were sometimes darkness, but now are ye light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
Masaai: amu irara apa intae enaimin, kake irara taata ewang'an ti atua Olaitoriani; enchom anaa nkera e wang'an,

English: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
Masaai: (amu ore ilng'anayio le wang'an naa ninche etumieki nena pooki sidain neitoriori nesipa),

English: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
Masaai: naa entetem aajo mateng'ena te nena naaitiship Olaitoriani.

English: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
Masaai: Emiaata eniporokiki nkiaasin e naimin nemeeta lng'anayio, kake ore eninkoko intae entayu meibalata.

English: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
Masaai: Amu enkurruna doi ninye te neimakini nena naas ninche too nkisudorot;

English: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light.
Masaai: kake ore embae pooki nabolokini ewang'an naa keliooyu, amu ewang'an pooki toki nalioo.

English: Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
Masaai: Enkaraki pee eji, “Inyo oloirura, tudumunye, tung'uai ilootuata, naa eikincho Kristo ewang'an.”

English: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
Masaai: Eng'ura entabaraki eninkunariri elototo, mme anaa ltung'ana oomoda kake anaa lng'eni,

English: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Masaai: entaasishore enkata, amu torrok inkolong'i.

English: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
Masaai: Ore naa, emiaaku ilmoda, entoning'u eyieunoto o Laitoriani.

English: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
Masaai: Emimera te naisho oo sabibu amu emutata e nkishon ina; kake enchoo Enkiyang'et eiput intae,

English: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
Masaai: iranyakinono to lkerempe le Nkai o sinkolioitin o rrepeta e nkiyang'et, iranyishosho aaisis Olaitoriani too ltauja linyi pooki;

English: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
Masaai: ore anaake o too mbaa pooki enchooi enashe te nkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo aaisho Enkai Papa.

English: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
Masaai: Entoning'oto maate te nkaraki naa Kristo iyanyititi.

English: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
Masaai: Na kituaak, entoning ilpayiani linyi, anaa eninkoko Olaitoriani,

English: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
Masaai: amu olpayian elukunya e nkitok anaa paa Kristo elukunya e sirit, ilo sesen lenye, naa ninye Olaitajeunoni lenye.

English: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
Masaai: Ore anaa enaning esirit Kristo, enchoo etiu sii ninche inkituaak neijia aaning ilpayiani lenye to mbaa pooki.

English: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
Masaai: Lo payiani, entonyor inkituaak inyi, anaa enatonyorra Kristo esirit neishooyo kewan te nkaraki ninye,

English: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
Masaai: pee etum aitisinya ninye, eidipa aisuja te nkitukuoto e nkare o te nebo ilo rorei,

English: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
Masaai: pee etum aitaiki kewan ina sirit te sikar nemeeta entibili aashu emuguta aashu eeta ae ake toki nayia neijia, pee etum esirit ataa sinyati nemeeta eleyiata.

English: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu ilpayiani eishiaakino nenyor inkituaak enye anaa iseseni lenye maate. Ore olonyor enkitok enye kewan enyor.

English: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
Masaai: Amu meetae ae kata oltung'ani oiba osesen lenye makewan, kake eitoti neramat ninye, anaa enaramat Kristo esirit,

English: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
Masaai: amu kira iyiook irubat o sesen lenye!

English: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena “elo aing'uaa olee menye o ng'otonye neibung'are enkitok enye, neaku pokira are nabo.”

English: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
Masaai: Enkisudoroto kitok ena najo nanu Kristo elimu o kanisa;

English: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
Masaai: ore etiu neijia, nchoo ake pooki ng'ae linyi enyorru enkitok enye anaa kewan, naa nchoo enkitok edol ajo keyanyit olpayian lenye.

English: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
Masaai: Na kera, eyanyita intoiwuo inyi ti atua Olaitoriani, amu aisidai ina.

English: Honour thy father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
Masaai: “Iyanyita papaai lino o yieyio lino.” (ena kitanapata naituruk neeta enkisiligata),

English: That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.
Masaai: “pee eitobirari mbaa inono nibik inkolong'i kumok te nkop.”

English: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
Masaai: Ore intae iloo papa, emintagor inkera inyi, kake entubulu ninche te nkitamioto e utaroto o te nkiteng'enare o Laitoriani.

English: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;
Masaai: Lo rrindiki, entoning intae lelo oora ilaitoriak linyi te nkop te nkuretisho o lokirikiri, to ltau obo, anaa eninkoko Kristo;

English: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;
Masaai: neme eji pee edoli intae, anaa ilooitiship iltung'ana, kake anaa ilaisiaayiak le Kristo, iasiasa eyieunoto e Enkai eing'uaa atua ltauja,

English: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
Masaai: nisiaaishosho te yieunoto sidai anaa eninkoko to Laitoriani neme anaa too ltung'ana,

English: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
Masaai: iyiololo aajo ore esupat ake pooki naas oloas, neyooki ake atum ina nataasa eing'uaa Olaitoriani, aa osinka aashu ololakuno.

English: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
Masaai: Lo aitoriak, nena ake entaasa sii intae ninche, naa embooi olbuaa, iyiololo aajo etii shumata Olaitoriani lenye naa olinyi sii intae, nemeetae olkep te ninye.

English: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Masaai: Ore enabayie, entagol ti atua Olaitoriani naa te ngolon e nkidimata enye.

English: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
Masaai: Enchopo iruparen pooki e Nkai, pee indimidimi aaitasho aairisha ilosekin pooki le sheitani.

English: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
Masaai: Amu mikiarare iyiook osesen o sarge, kake ilaitoriak, nikiarare engolon oo mpukunot kumok, nikiarare ilaitoriak le nkop le na aimin taata, nikiarare lororani loo nkiyang'eta torrok too wuejitin e shumata.

English: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, entudumu iruparen pooki e Nkai, pee indimidimi intae aairishisho te ina olong torrono, ore indipa aataas pooki, nintasheshe.

English: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
Masaai: Entasheito naa, iterretena mpolosi inyi te sipata, ninchopo elong'o o lgoo e supatisho,

English: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
Masaai: ninchopokito nkejek inyi inamuka oo Lomon Supati le seriani;

English: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
Masaai: ore ene shumata nena pooki embung'a elong'o e nkirukoto naa ninye naidimie intae entushurie nena baa pooki e ilo torrono naayupuyup.

English: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
Masaai: Naa embung'a emaupe e njeunoto, o lalem le Nkiyang'et laa ninye ororei le Nkai.

English: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
Masaai: Entoomon inkatitin pooki te Nkiyang'et te nkomono pooki o eomonokinoto. Ore te ina enchololoto te ncheikinoto iomonokiki isinyat pooki,

English: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
Masaai: o nanu sii, pee aaishori enkiroroto te nabol enkutuk te mpijan alikioo mbaa naaisudoro e kulo Omon Supati,

English: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
Masaai: laa te nkaraki ninche pee ara olkilikuai oena too lpisia; pee atum atolikioi te mpijan, anaa enaishiaakino nairo.

English: But that ye also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
Masaai: Ore taata pee iyiolouwu sii intae enikinkununo, o enaasita, Tikikos olalashe lang onyorri naa olaisiaayiani oisiligayu ti atua Olaitoriani olotu ainosaki intae imbaa pooki.

English: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
Masaai: Nanu oirriwua ninye enitii te nkaraki ena pee iyiolouu enaikununo, netum ninye ailejileja iltauja linyi.

English: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Menoto ilalashera eseriani o enyorrata te nebo enkirukoto naing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
Masaai: Metobiko empiris te nebo lelo pooki oonyor Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo te nyorrata nemeye.

English: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
Masaai: Paulo o Timoteo, isinkan le Kristo Yesu ooigeroki lelo sinyat pooki ti atua Kristo Yesu ootii enkang e Filipi te nebo ilaitasheikinok le sirit e Nkai o laisiaayak.

English: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
Masaai: Ore oshi enkata pooki nadamu intae naisho Enkai ai enashe,

English: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
Masaai: naa te naomon nadamu intae pooki te nchipai sapuk,

English: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
Masaai: te nkaraki ina nitaa intae ilaasak te nebo nanu te nkitubularoto o rorei supat ebaiki apa te nkiterunoto o taata.

English: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Nayiolo aitisip nchere ore ilo oiterua esiaai sidai ti atua intae naa keitabaya te ina olong e Yesu Kristo.

English: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
Masaai: Eishiaakino te naata kuna ti alo intae pooki amu aibung'ita intae to ltau lai amu itii te nebo nanu ti atua empiris o te enata ai o te ng'oroto o te nkitisipata o rorei supat.

English: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu shakeni lai Enkai te ina yieunoto naata te intae te ina nyorrata e Yesu Kristo.

English: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
Masaai: Ore enkomono ai naa nchere pee eponari enyorrata inyi oleng ti atua eyiolounoto o erishunoto oo mbaa.

English: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;
Masaai: pee itumutumu aatonyorrai ina naisula, niaakuku biyot, ilemeeta leyiat te nkolong e Kristo.

English: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
Masaai: Neboreyu intae ilng'anayio le supatisho, ooimu atua Yesu Kristo, neyau enkitoo e enkisisa e Nkai.

English: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
Masaai: Ayieu niyiolouwu lalashera laainei nchere, ore nena naaitaasaki nanu, netaretutuo enkitubularoto o rorei supat,

English: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
Masaai: metaba anaa neyiolou isikarini pooki le nkaji enkitoo o ltung'ana pooki nchere ore pee aena naa te nkaraki Kristo;

English: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
Masaai: nenotito ilalashera kumok enkitagoloto ti atua Olaitoriani te enata ai neaku kelimu ororei le Enkai te nkitieunoto metii enkuretisho.

English: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
Masaai: Einosu kulikae Kristo to lom o te nkesha kake einosu kulikae to ltau sidai.

English: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
Masaai: Ore kulo neinosu te nyorrata eyiolo aajo aatipikaki nanu ene te nkaraki nangorito ilo rorei supat;

English: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
Masaai: ore kulo nelimu Kristo te nkitokoos ejo pee aaitang'or nanu te ina enata ai.
