English: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
Masaai: Kainyoo naa enkiting'oto? Ena, nchere, ore too nkoitoi pooki, te ina nang'ida.

English: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Ee naa kang'ida. Amu ayiolo ajo ore te nkaraki enkomono inyi o te retoto e Nkiyang'et e Yesu neyau nena elakunoto ai;

English: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
Masaai: aa ore eyieunoto e eanyunoto o siligi lai naa nchere pee makurru, kake ore te mpijan nabore taata anaa oshiake, neyanyituni Kristo to sesen lai, aa te nkishui aashu te keeya.

English: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
Masaai: Ore te nanu Kristo enkishui ore keeya naa dupoto.

English: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
Masaai: Kake te naishu to sesen, neaku ina lng'anayio le siaai ai kake mayiolo ajo kaa adutaa.

English: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
Masaai: Amu kang'aashana aaitirrishita oleng nkaloli pokira are. Ore eyieunoto ai naa pee aiwuang'a to sesen naaku te nebo Kristo, amu ina esidai oleng.

English: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
Masaai: Kake te nabik ti atua ele sesen naa ina naata tipat te intae.

English: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
Masaai: Aitisip ena nchere, kayiolo ajo katon naa kabik aret intae pooki, te nkaraki enkitubulunoto inyi o eng'ida ti atua enkirukoto,

English: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
Masaai: paa ore ti atua nanu nitumutumu esipata niwuasarere ti atua Kristo naibala te naitoki alotu enitii.

English: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
Masaai: Ore too mbaa pooki enkuna ena nabo enchoo orrekie le nkishui inyi meishiaakinore ororei supat le Kristo, peyie te naewuo adol intae aashu te nematii naning'oo ajo ituunote intasheshe to ltau obo, o te ndamunoto nabo, ninyokinyoko aairiamari te nkaraki enkirukoto o rorei supat,

English: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
Masaai: nemeiture intae ae toki e lelo mang'ati ookesh intae. Ele olmonekie oibala le mutata te ninche kake ole njeunoto te intae, naa Enkai eing'uaa ina.

English: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
Masaai: Amu eishooki intae nchere ore te nkaraki ninye,

English: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
Masaai: itii atua ilo arrabal apa ake litoduaa nining'itoto taata aajo eton ake atii.

English: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
Masaai: Metaa te naa keetae enkitagoloto oo nkoishuaa ti atua Kristo, te netii enkilejilejata e nyorrata, te netii enchula ti atua Enkiyang'et te netii enkaripo o lng'ur,

English: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
Masaai: entabai eng'ida ai, aaku le na damunoto ooata ena nyorrata nabo niaatata oltau obo nidamumu nabo.

English: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
Masaai: Emiaas ae bae to nkesha te nkitokoos. Kake te nkitadounoto e kewan meetae olemeitulusoo olikae aitalang kewan.

English: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
Masaai: Nchoo pooki te intae meaku mbaa enyena ake eing'or kake nchoo sii eing'or inoo lkulikae.

English: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Enoto ena damunoto ti atua intae maate niaatata sii ti atua Kristo Yesu,

English: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
Masaai: aa ore hoo neeta empukunoto e Nkai, neitu ninye eiken ina narisiore Enkai anaa ae toki naaji najo apidilakino,

English: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
Masaai: eitoroka kewan neitanyaayukie kewan osinka, neini anaa iltung'ana.

English: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edoli eeta empukunoto e tung'ani neitadou kewan, nening'isho o metabaiki keeya, o metabaiki ina keeya, te nchumata osalaba.

English: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ena neitaa ninye Enkai kitok oleng, neisho ninye enkarna nalang inkarn pooki,

English: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
Masaai: neaku ore te nkarna e Yesu naa kegil pooki ng'ae kung, te shumata o te nkop o ti abori enkop,

English: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
Masaai: neibalunye pooki ng'ejep inchere Yesu Kristo ninye Olaitoriani, te nkitoo e Enkai Papa.

English: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
Masaai: Ore naa ilanyor laainei, anaa enitoning'ishote oshi ake neijia sii o taata mme ake anaa atii kake eisul oleng matii, entabai enjeunoto inyi te nkuretisho o te nkikirikirata.

English: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
Masaai: Amu Enkai naasisho ti atua intae, te pokira are, te yieunoto o te asata inyi te nkaraki murruna enye sidai.

English: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
Masaai: Entaas mbaa pooki metii enking'unyung'uny anaa nkikilikuanat,

English: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
Masaai: pee metumi ake eleyiata napiki intae niaakuku nkera e Enkai nemeeta eleyiata ti atua ena kishon torrono niwang'ung'u aaku ewang'an te na kop;

English: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
Masaai: imbung'itata aakurraki ororei le mpuaan pee aa ore te nkolong e Kristo nawuasare intae nchere eitu akuet pesho aashu aisiaaisho pesho.

English: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
Masaai: Te naa naaji ninye kaabukokini shumata olasar le enkirukoto inyi naa kang'ida nashipa nanu te nebo intae pooki.

English: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
Masaai: Ore te ina, entishipata sii intae ning'idada te nebo nanu.

English: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
Masaai: Aisilig ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu ajo airriu Timoteo meeu enitii asieku, pee aaitiship ilomon linyi.

English: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
Masaai: Maata likae laaijo ninye oing'or negolie mbaa inyi oleng;

English: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
Masaai: mbaa enye ake eing'or ilkulikae, pooki neme nena e Yesu Kristo.

English: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
Masaai: Kake iyiololo intae tipat e Timoteo, nchere ore anaa enkerai o menye, netaasishe te nebo nanu ti atua ororei supat.

English: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
Masaai: Aisilig naa ajo airriu asioki te nayiolou mbaa ainei eneikunari;

English: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
Masaai: naisilig ti atua Olaitoriani nchere kalotu sii nanu makewan asieku.

English: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellow soldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
Masaai: Atoduaa ajo keishiaakino nairriwaki intae Epafroditas olalashe lai, naa olaisiaayiani te nebo nanu, osikari te nebo nanu, naa olkipaaret linyi naa olaisiaayiani too nkolati aainei.

English: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
Masaai: Amu eyieuta oshi neduaare intae pooki, nenoto osina oleng amu itoning'o aajo esipa etamuoyia.

English: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
Masaai: Etamuoyia o metinyikaki keeya kake eing'urrie Enkai neme ninye ake kake o nanu sii, pee matum ake osina aponiki likae sina.

English: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
Masaai: Nanu oyieu nairriu ninye, ajo pee ing'idayuyu te nintokiki aadol ninye, nemaitoki sii nanu aata osina.

English: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
Masaai: Entang'amu naa ti atua Olaitoriani te nchipai pooki niyanyititi iltung'ana ootiu inji.

English: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
Masaai: Amu eyieu eye te nkaraki esiaai e Kristo, etipika enkishui enye batisho pee eitabaya enkisiaayiare inyi.

English: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
Masaai: Ore enabayie, ilalashera laainei, enting'idata ti atua Olaitoriani. Te nasiraki intae aigil kuna nemaaitanaur, kake keitagol intae.

English: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
Masaai: Entodol ate te lelo diein, entodol ate te lelo aasak loo ntorrok, entodol ate te lelo oodung osesen.

English: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
Masaai: Amu iyiook emuratare nasipa, ilooserem Enkai te nkiyang'et, nikiwuasare Kristo Yesu, nimiking'idare osesen.

English: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
Masaai: Ore hoo duoo naata sii nanu makewan esipata pee ang'idare osesen, te netii likae tung'ani ojo keeta esipata pee eng'idare osesen, nanu olusoo:

English: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
Masaai: te nkolong e isiet aatumurataki, nara ololorere loo Siraeli, lo losho le Benchamen, Olhebraniai, ore ti alo nkitanapat nara Olfarisayoi,

English: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
Masaai: ore te nyuaata nara olaisilisiloni le sirit, ore te supatisho ti abori nkitanapat, nemaata eleyiata.

English: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
Masaai: Kake ore dupoto apa naata, naikena aitaa pesho te nkaraki Kristo.

English: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
Masaai: Aikenayie ntokitin pooki aitaa pesho te nkaraki nemeeta endutet katukul, eyiolounoto e Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lai. Ore te nkaraki ninye, naiturrayie ntokitin pooki naikenaa ajo etiu anaa nkik, pee atum Kristo.

English: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
Masaai: Naliooyu nanu ti atua ninye, maata esupatisho ai makewan naing'uaa nkitanapat, kake ina naing'uaa enkirukoto ti atua Kristo, ina supatisho naing'uaa Enkai nang'amuni te nkirukoto,

English: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
Masaai: pee ayiolou nanu ninye o engolon e mpiunoto enye, nang'arie olosilisili lenye, atiu anaa ninye ti atua enkeeya,

English: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
Masaai: paa te neidimayu natum empiunoto aing'uaa ilootuata.

English: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Mme taa kaidipa anoto ena neme kaidipa ataa bayaroti, kake kanyokita aitaa enaai amu Kristo Yesu laaitaa olenye.

English: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
Masaai: Ilalashera, mme taa kaikena kewan ajo kaidipa aitaa enaai; kake ena nabo aas, aishoo maatorikinoto inaatii siadi, naekenya alo dukuya abaiki idia naipirakinore,

English: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: nanyok aisarrisar pee abaiki idia rishata o enkishoroto o enkipototo e Enkai e shumata ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
Masaai: Enchoo lelo lang ootubulutua aabaya metadamu ena, naa te nepaashari intae indamunot ti ae toki, naa keibalakinye sii ninche intae Enkai.

English: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
Masaai: Emaibung'a ake intae te sipata ina nikindipa aatang'amu.

English: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
Masaai: Ilalashera, embung'ata entaa lasujak laainei, ning'oring'oro lelo ootiu neijia te nkishon enye amu iatata enkitanyaanyukoto te iyiook.

English: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
Masaai: Amu ore ilkumok laa ketii ilaidipa atoliki intae, naa kaliki sii taata intae, ebaiki too lkiyio, naa ilmang'ati lo salaba le Kristo

English: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
Masaai: te nkishui enye neng'idare enkurruna enye naa ntokitin e nkop eenikino ndamunot enye.

English: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Kake kira iyiook ile nkop natii shumata, naa ine eing'uaa Olaitajeunoni likiaanyita, Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo,

English: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
Masaai: laa ninye oyooki aibelekeny ele sesen lang odou metotiwuo anaa ilo sesen lenye le nkitoo te ina golon naidimie ninye metipika ebaiki ntokitin pooki abori enkitoria enye makewan.

English: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
Masaai: Ore naa ilalashera laainei lanyor nayieu naduaare, eng'ida ai o enkopiyia e nkitoo, entashoito enkuna neijia ti atua Olaitoriani, ilanyor laainei.

English: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
Masaai: Asai Eudia, nasai Sintike metoning'oto ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
Masaai: Naaikilikuan sii iyie encholuek ai nadede, taretu kuna kituaak amu aatang'arie ninche enyamali te enkaraki ororei supat, te nebo Klement o lelo kulikae ootaasishote te nebo nanu, ootii nkarn enye atua embuku e mpuaan.

English: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
Masaai: Enting'idata ti atua Olaitoriani anaake, naitoki ake ajo enting'idata.

English: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
Masaai: Nchoo iltung'ana pooki metayioloito emborron inyi. Etataana Olaitoriani.

English: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
Masaai: Emintanyamal ate ti ae toki, kake ore te pooki toki te nkomono o te nkishoroto e nashe. Enchoo Enkai metayiolo inkolati inyi

English: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
Masaai: neaku eseriani e Enkai nalang eyiolounoto pooki narrip iltauja linyi o ndamunot inyi ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
Masaai: Ore enabayie ilalashera naa inchere, ore pooki naasipa, ore pooki nayanyitayu, ore pooki naata errepet sidai, te netii orrekie sidai netii orrekie oiririkino enkisisa, kuna entadamu.

English: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
Masaai: Ore nena nitayioloto, nitang'amutua, nitoning'o, nitoduaa te nanu, entaas; neaku Enkai e seriani te nebo intae.

English: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
Masaai: Ekang'ida ti atua Olaitoriani lang nchere inyaakita aitopiu osotua te nanu, esipa kitadamutua sii apa kake eitu itumutumu erishata.

English: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
Masaai: Neme taa kaing'unyung'uny ayieu ae toki, amu ateng'enaka, aidipakinore mbaa pooki.

English: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
Masaai: Ayiolo eneikununo eng'orikinoto aashu te enkiputakinoto, ore te pooki toki oo too rishat pooki atayiolo olosek lashurakinye eraposhoi e esumash, ti ari o ti ameyu.

English: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Masaai: Aidim ataasa mbaa pooki ti atua ilo laa ninye laaidimie.

English: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
Masaai: Kake itaasa enaishiaakino te nkaraki kitang'arie osina lai.

English: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
Masaai: Niyiololo intae Ilfilipi oopeny nchere ore apa te nkiterunoto o rorei supat, ina kata pee aing'uaa Makedonia, nemetii esirit naatang'arie enkishooroto aashu eng'amunoto meteleku intae ake.

English: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
Masaai: Ore ninye apa atii Sesalonike, kirriwakita nanu eretoto e dukuya o ene nkaigil.

English: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
Masaai: Neme taa enkishorunoto aing'orua, kake aing'oru ilng'anayio ooponari ooikenakini intae.

English: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
Masaai: Atangamua te Epafroditas nkishorot nirriutua enkishorunoto e rropili, o lasar ong'amaroyu naa oloitiship Enkai.

English: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Naa keiputaki Enkai pooki olat inyi te risioroto e nkarsisisho enye te nkitoo ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa ene Enkai naa Papa lang, enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.

English: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
Masaai: Eroroki lelo pooki sinyat ti atua Kristo Yesu. Eiroroki intae ilalashera ootii te nebo nanu.

English: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae isinyat pooki neisulaki lelo le nkaji e Kaisari.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo te nebo enkishui inyi.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
Masaai: Paulo olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo te yieunoto e Enkai, o Timoteo olalashe lang.

English: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Kingeroki isinyat o lalashera ooisiligayu ti atua Kristo ootii Kolosai. Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang.

English: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
Masaai: Kishukoki oshi ake e nashe Enkai, Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, too nkatitin pooki kiomonoki intae;

English: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
Masaai: amu kitoning'oitie enkirukoto inyi ti atua Kristo Yesu o enyorrata ninyorrinyorro isinyat.

English: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
Masaai: Ore eneing'uaa nena pokira are naa ilo siligi litoning'o apa pee elotu enitii olkilikuai osipa loo Lomon Supati, naa te keper eiputakini intae ilo siligi.

English: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
Masaai: Nebulita lelo Omon Supati aaiu ilng'anayio te nkop pooki; naa enaikuna ti atua intae ebaiki ina olong apa nining'ining'i empiris e Enkai niyiolouwu te sipata,

English: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
Masaai: anaa eninteng'ena ate te Epafras lanyor naa osinka le ncholiek ai, naa osinka oisiligayu le Kristo ninye te rishata ang,

English: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
Masaai: naa ninye oinosaka iyiook eneba enyorrata naishoo Enkiyang'et intae.

English: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
Masaai: Ore naa, eitu kigira mikiomonoki intae ebaiki ina olong nikitoning'o pee eiput intae eyiolounoto e yieunoto enye ti atua eng'eno pooki e yiolounoto o ltau,

English: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
Masaai: nikisaisho pee ipuoyieyie enkishon naaku to Laitoriani, naitiship ninye katukul, nitumutumu aatoiu ilng'anayio too mpukunot pooki e supatisho, nitumutumu aatobikoi iponaa oleng oleng aayiolou Enkai.

English: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
Masaai: Meitagoli intae te ngolon pooki, te risioroto e ngolon kitok e nkisisa enye, te ng'iriata pooki ning'iriri te nebo enchipai,

English: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
Masaai: ninchosho Papa enashe, oisho iyiook esipata neng'arieki iyiook enjung'ore oo sinyat ti atua ewang'an.

English: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
Masaai: Ninye otalakua iyiook aitung'uaa enkitoria e naimin neidurrie iyiook maape enkitoria o Inoti lenye kirotet,

English: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
Masaai: laa te ninye kiaata elakunoto, naa empalakinoto oo ng'ok ang.

English: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
Masaai: Ninye nyaanyukie e ina Ai nemelioo, olkikau le pooki toki naitayioki;

English: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
Masaai: te nkaraki ninye pee eitayioki ntokitin pooki, naatii shumata o naatii enkop, inaalioo o nemelioo te naa lorikan loo looitoreisho, aashu nkitoriat, aashu looishoro engolon e nkitoria, te ninye eitayioki ntokitin naa ninye eitobirakaki.

English: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
Masaai: Ninye otii enkiterunoto oo ntokitin pooki, naa atua ninye eitasheyie aatumokino ntokitin pooki.

English: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
Masaai: Ninye elukunya o sesen, eji ene sirit, ninye ora enkiterunoto, olkikau oiterunye aing'uaa ilootuata, peyie eaku ninye oituruk te pooki toki.

English: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
Masaai: Amu atua ninye etonyorra aitamany emborei pooki e Enkai,

English: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
Masaai: naa kewan eitaikinye osotua ntokitin pooki, te naa inaatii enkop aashu inaatii shumata, neyau eseriani to sarge lo salaba lenye.

English: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
Masaai: Ore intae, iloora apa ae kata ileeiking'a ti alo Enkai nirara ilmang'ati ti atua ndamunot inyi, to lbae loo iasat inyi torrok,

English: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
Masaai: enotoko intae enkitobirakinoto too nkiri o sesen lenye te nkeeya enye, pee etum aitarasai intae irara sinyat nimiaatata ntiyot nimiaatata entibili naipotokini intae te dukuya ninye,

English: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
Masaai: te nesipa nchere ipuoyieyie enkirukoto, niunokinono nemeigusugusieki intae, nemeiwuang'ieki intae to siligi too Lomon Supati litoning'o, ootolikioki pooki oishu ti abori shumata, laa ninye ataa nanu Paulo olaisiaayiani lenye.

English: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church:
Masaai: Nang'ida taata nanu ti atua sinaitin laainosieki te nkaraki intae to sesen lai, aitabaya nena naang'or te nkisilisiloto e Kristo to lbae lo sesen lenye, eji naa esirit ina.

English: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
Masaai: Nataa nanu olaisiaayiani lenye te risioroto e siaai naaisho Enkai te nkaraki intae, maitudupai ilo rorei le Enkai katukul,

English: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
Masaai: naa ninye enkisudoroto naisudoyioki too nkatitin o too lajijik kake etabolokoki taata isinyat lenyena.

English: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
Masaai: Ninche etegelua Enkai aitayiolo eneba ti atua iloreren enkarsisisho e nkitoo ena kisudoroto, naa Kristo ti atua intae olora osiligi le nkitoo.

English: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
Masaai: Ninye kilikioo, kinkok pooki tung'ani nikinteng'en pooki tung'ani te ng'eno pooki, peyie kitum aaitarasai pooki tung'ani etabayie ti atua Kristo.

English: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena pee anyokita; nanyamaliki te ngolon pooki e nkidimata e ilo oisiaaisho ti atua nanu.

English: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
Masaai: Amu ayieu niyiolouwu eneba enyamali nanyamaliki intae, lelo ootii Laodikea, o lelo pooki leitu ae kata aadol enkomom,

English: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
Masaai: pee ailejileji iltauja lenye neitushuli te nebo ti atua enyorrata, pee etum endupai pooki e ning'unoto nasipuno eng'eno e nkisudoroto e Enkai, o Kristo,

English: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
Masaai: olaa ti atua ninye eisudoro masaa pooki sidain e yiolounoto o eng'eno.

English: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
Masaai: Najo kuna, pee melej intae likae too rorei le nkeleekisho.

English: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
Masaai: Amu ore hoo nematii ine to sesen, kake atii te nkiyang'et ang'ida te nadol orrekie linyi sidai o enkitashoto e nkirukoto inyi ti atua Kristo.

English: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
Masaai: Ore anaa apa enitang'amutua Olaitoriani Kristo Yesu, enchoo eaku ninye inchuyieyie,

English: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
Masaai: niunokinono neshetuni intae, niponana inchosho ninye enashe.

English: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
Masaai: Entodol ate mewuapaa intae likae te ng'eno oo losekin o elejare e pesho, nasuj inkoon e tung'ani, anaa inaajo nkiyang'eta o loing'ang'e, neme anaa naajo Kristo.

English: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
Masaai: Amu atua ninye emanya elulung'ata e pooki e Nkai to sesen,

English: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
Masaai: neewuo alulung'ayu enkishui inyi ti atua ninye, olaa ninye elukunya e nkitoria o enkidimata.

English: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
Masaai: Ti atua ninye etumurataki intae te murata neme enoo nkaik, eitayioki aaoru intae ina kewan o sesen ti atua emurata e Kristo;

English: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
Masaai: netunukayioki intae te nebo ninye ti atua enkibatisa, naa te ninye enyaakaki aaitopiu intae te nkirukoto ti atua enkiaas e Enkai, naitopiwuo ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata.

English: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
Masaai: Naa intae, ilootuata apa too nkitarruorrot o too seseni linyi lememurata eitopiwuo intae Enkai te nebo ninye, netapalaka iyiook inkitarruorrot ang pooki,

English: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
Masaai: netujuto enkiguana; ninye oiwuang'ie kuna, neshe to salaba.

English: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
Masaai: Ninye otuuruo nkitoriat o loogol pooki o masaa o larrabal neitoduaaya te neibala, nerik aitaa iarunot etigilua ninche.

English: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
Masaai: Emincho naa edung'oki likae intae enkiguana too mbaa e ndaa anaa te naoki aashu te masho, aashu te nkiborra o lapa aashu te nkolong e nkiyeng'iyeng'ata.

English: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
Masaai: Oloip ake kuna le kulie naapuonu; kake ore enkewan ene Kristo.

English: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
Masaai: Emincho hoo eoruni intae nchuneti eji meeta nchere pee eitu intadouwu ate anaa iserememe ilmalaika, eji neunore kulikae induaat, neipopong'a meeta esipata, too ndamunot enye e tung'ani,

English: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
Masaai: nemeenikino ilo ora Elukunya, olaa ninye etumie osesen pooki oladakite neruburuba to morlooshi o sinigi lenyena, nebulu te mbulunoto naa Enkai eing'uaa.

English: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
Masaai: Te naa eituata te nebo Kristo te nkalo e nena kiyang'eta o loing'ang'e, oo naa pee eton ake ipuopuo anaa leton era ile nkop? Oo pee inchosho eitore intae irrekiei leeiking'a?

English: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
Masaai: Eji, “Mimbung, Minyorrinyor, Miseyie?”

English: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
Masaai: (Eimaki ninche intokitin naapurda easishoreki), aasuj inkoon oo ltung'ana o enkiteng'enare enye?

English: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
Masaai: Kedoli doi kuna etiu anaa ine ng'eno etukunyaki ltung'ana esujata enye neitadou ate neitupukoo iseseni lenye kake, meeta hoo eneret te nkibooroto oo ng'uarrat o sesen.

English: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
Masaai: Tenaa keitopiwuoki intae te nebo Kristo, eng'oru nena baa naatii shumata, netii Kristo, etonita te nkaina e tatene e Enkai.

English: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
Masaai: Empirie indamunot inyi nena baa naatii shumata, mme nena naatii enkop.

English: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
Masaai: Amu indipa aatuata, neisudoyioki enkishui inyi te nebo Kristo ti atua Enkai.

English: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
Masaai: Ore pee eliooyu Kristo laa ninye enkishui ang, niliooyuyu sii intae te nebo ninye ti atua enkisisa.

English: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
Masaai: Entaar naa metuata ti atua intae, nena naara ine nkop; aa enkiborra oo nkonyek, iloirerioni, olorok, ng'uarrat torrok, olodoong'u, eomonoto oo kitanyaanyukot naaitaae nkaitin.

English: For which things' sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
Masaai: To kuna baa elotu engoro e Enkai.

English: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
Masaai: Kuna apa ipuoyieyie eton itii atua ninche.

English: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
Masaai: Kake ore taata, ewuang'ie nena pooki: aa ewuapa, engoro, enkiba, esukeny, o lderrat torrok ooing'uaa inkutukie inyi.

English: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
Masaai: Milej olikae olikae, idolitata aajo ituburushutua enkewan musana o rrekiei lenyena.

English: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
Masaai: Ninchopo enkewan ng'ejuk, naitang'ejuki te ng'eno metanyaanyukie ilo oitayio ninye.

English: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
Masaai: Ore naa nemeetae Olgiriki o Lyahudi, olomurata o lememurata, olmeeki, Osikite, orrindik, ololakuno, kake Kristo pooki toki, netii ninye atua pooki.

English: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
Masaai: Anaa ilgelunot, le Enkai, oosinya nenyorri enchopo enanai e nkoshoke, olng'ur, emoolisho emborron o eng'iriata,

English: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
Masaai: ning'iriri oltung'ani ake te likae, naa teneeta ake oltung'ani enkigunyung'uny to likae, nepalaki olikae anaa pee kitapalaka sii iyie Olaitoriani, neaku eishiaakino sii iyie pee ipalaki.

English: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
Masaai: Ore enaituruk te kuna pooki enchopo enyorrata, te naboisho nabaya.

English: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
Masaai: Naa enchoo eseriani e Kristo eitoreisho ti atua iltauja linyi, amu ina eipotokoki intae ti atua ilo sesen obo. Naa enoto enashe.

English: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
Masaai: Enchoo ororei le Kristo emany atua intae te nkarsisisho, inteng'enana niutaroro olikae o likae te ng'eno pooki, iranyiranya Olkerempe le Nkai o sinkolioitin le nkishui inchosho Enkai enashe ti atua iltauja linyi.

English: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
Masaai: Ore embae ake pooki niaasiasa, to rorei aashu too nkiaasin, entaas pooki toki te nkarna o Laitoriani Yesu. Inchosho Enkai Papa enashe te ninye.

English: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
Masaai: Na kituaak, entoning ilpayiani linyi, anaa enaitoriori ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
Masaai: Lo payiani, entonyor inkituaak inyi, emisomit.

English: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
Masaai: Na kera, entoning intoiwuo inyi too mbaa pooki, amu ena naitiship Olaitoriani.

English: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
Masaai: Ore intae iloo menye, emintagor inkera inyi, pee miariara iltauja.

English: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
Masaai: Lo rrindiki, entoning te pooki bae lelo oora ilkituaak linyi te nkop, neme te nkisiaayiare oo nkonyek anaa looitiship iltung'ana, kake to ltau obo, iurere Olaitoriani.

English: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
Masaai: Ore esiaai inyi pooki entaas too ltauja, anaa Olaitoriani iasakiki neme iltung'ana,

English: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
Masaai: iyiololo aajo to Laitoriani itumutumu enjung'ore anaa olekoisiaayio linyi; Olaitoriani Kristo isiaaitata.

English: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
Masaai: Amu keyookini aaitalak oloas intorrok nena torrok naataasa, nemeetae enyorrakinoto.

English: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
Masaai: Ore intae ilooitoreisho, entaasa rrindiki linyi too sipat o too nkiririkinot, iyiololo aajo iatata sii intae Olkitok linyi te shumata.

English: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
Masaai: Entasheikinoto enkomono emingusugus, irripishosho nisholololo, niomonokiki sii ninche iyiook,

English: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
Masaai: metaboloki Enkai iyiook enkoitoi ele rorei, matolikioi enkisudoroto naipirta Kristo naa te nkaraki ninye pee atii nanu korokoroni,

English: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
Masaai: peyie atum aibalunye enaaishiaakino nairo.

English: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
Masaai: Enchom irara ng'eni ti alo lelo ootii auluo entaasishore inkat pooki.

English: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
Masaai: Enchoo nkirorot inyi nkatitin pooki eaku ine mborron naata emunyan, pee itumutumu aatayiolo enijojo te niwalikiki pooki ng'ae.

English: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
Masaai: Tikikos olotu aliki intae mbaa aainei; olalashe lai lanyor naa olaisiaayiani oisiligayu naa osinka le ncholiek ai ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
Masaai: Nanu oirriwua enitii ajo pee, itumutumu aatayiolo enikitiu netum ailejileja iltauja linyi,

English: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
Masaai: neiriamunore Onesimas olalashe onyorri neisiligayu, laa obo linyi. Ninche oopuonu aainosaki intae mbaa pooki naataasate te ne.

English: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister's son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
Masaai: Eiroroki intae Aristakos oloena te nebo nanu, neiroroki intae Marko le nkanashe e Barnabas (Iindipa aanoto olkilikuai loo mbaa enyena - te neewuo ninye enitii, entang'amu),

English: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellow workers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
Masaai: neiroroki intae Yesu oji Yusto. Kulo tung'ana ake le lelo oomurata oora laisiaayiak le ncholiek ai kisiaai enkitoria e Enkai, naataretutuo ninche.

English: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
Masaai: Ore Epafras, ora obo linyi, osinka le Yesu Kristo, neiroroki intae, nedamu intae anaa ake te nkomono enye, peyie intasheshe itubulutua neitisipaki eyieunoto e Enkai ti atua intae.

English: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
Masaai: Ara shakeni lenye nchere etonyuaa aisiaai intae naleng o lelo ootii Laodikea o lelo ootii Hierapolis.

English: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae Lukas oloshi abaani lanyor, neiroroki intae Demas.

English: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
Masaai: Enchoo lalashera laainei ootii Laodikea enkirorokino ai, ninchosho Nimfa o ina sirit natii enkaji enye.

English: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
Masaai: Naa ore pee eidipi aaisumaki intae ena palai enchoo sii eisumakini esirit oo Laodikea; naa entodol pee eisumakini sii ninche intae ina palai naing'uaa Laodikea.

English: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
Masaai: Naa entiaaki Arkipus, “Toduaa ake pee intabaya ina siaai nitang'amua ti atua Olaitoriani.”

English: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
Masaai: Nanu, Paulo oigero ena kirorokino te nkaina ai makewan. Entadamu ilpisia laainei. Metaa empiris te nebo intae.

English: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Paulo, Silvano, o Timoteo, enetii esirit oo Lsesalonike, Ti atua Enkai Papa o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo, Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani.

English: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
Masaai: Kincho oshiaake Enkai enashe te nkaraki intae pooki kimpot intae anaake ti atua enkomono ang.

English: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
Masaai: Kidamu intae te dukuya Enkai ang Papa o esiaai inyi e nkirukoto o enyamali e nyorrata o enkitashoto o siligi ti atua Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
Masaai: Amu ilalashera oonyor Enkai kiyiolo aajo etegelua ninye intae,

English: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
Masaai: amu ime to rorei ake etabaikia intae ororei supat, kake te ngolon sii o te Nkiyang'et Sinyati o te sipunoto nalulung'a. Iyiololo empukunoto ang enaikununo apa kitii atua intae naa te nkaraki intae.

English: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
Masaai: Nitaa intae ilooduaaya iyiook o Laitoriani amu, itang'amutua ilo rorei te nkaripo sapuk, te ng'ida nadumaki intae Enkiyang'et Sinyati;

English: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
Masaai: itaa intae enkitanyaanyukoto too lairukok pooki ti atua Makedonia o ti atua Akaia.

English: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
Masaai: Amu ime taa ake ti atua Makedonia o Akaia etoning'e ele rorei lo Laitoriani na intae eing'uaa kake ore enkirukoto inyi ti atua Enkai neshomo neibulaa pooki wueji, neaku meeta tipat pee kijo ae.

English: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
Masaai: Amu ore ninche maate netolimutuo ti alo iyiook eneba enkitoomono nikinoto te intae o eninkuna pee imbelekenyakinono Enkai aaing'uaa inkitanyaanyukot, aaisiaai Enkai naishu nasipa,

English: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
Masaai: niaanyunyu Oinoti lenye eing'uaa shumata, ilo oitopiwuo ninye aitung'uaa lootuata, Yesu laa ninye olaku iyiook aitung'uaa engoro nalotu.

English: For yourselves, brethren, know our entrance in unto you, that it was not in vain:
Masaai: Amu iyiololo intae maate, ilalashera inchere ime ene pesho elotunoto ang nikietuo enitii intae.

English: But even after that we had suffered before, and were shamefully entreated, as ye know, at Philippi, we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention.
Masaai: Amu iyiololo, enkisilisiloto o morot nikinoto te Filipi, neme toki amu eishoo iyiook Enkai empijan nikilikinye intae Ilomon Supati, hoo netii kesha sapuk.

English: For our exhortation was not of deceit, nor of uncleanness, nor in guile:
Masaai: Amu ore esayiakinoto ang nemepuku eing'uaa enkitapong'oroto anaa ilduruki neme to losek eitobiruaki.

English: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel, even so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, which trieth our hearts.
Masaai: Kake ore anaa enatonyorrayie iyiook Enkai neisiligaki too Lomon Supati, neijia kijo iyiook neme pee kintiship iltung'ana, kake pee kintiship Enkai naineneng iltauja lang.

English: For neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness; God is witness:
Masaai: Amu ore iyiook neitu ae kata kiaasishore irorei le nkilelemare, anaa eniyiololo, aashu kiaata imbaa naisudoo eului, naa Enkai shakeni;

English: Nor of men sought we glory, neither of you, nor yet of others, when we might have been burdensome, as the apostles of Christ.
Masaai: neitu king'oru enkisisa too ltung'ana, aa te intae, arashu te kulikae, hoo naa anaata kinkuna neijia anaa ilkipaareta le Kristo.

English: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
Masaai: Kake aikibor apa ti atua intae anaa enkaibung'ani naing'or inkera enyena.

English: So being affectionately desirous of you, we were willing to have imparted unto you, not the gospel of God only, but also our own souls, because ye were dear unto us.
Masaai: Neaku ore te nkaripo kiyieu intae kiterretenate pee king'ar te nebo intae neme ilomon ake Supati maate, kake oyiook sii maate amu itaa intae kiroteti oleng te iyiook.

English: For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.
Masaai: Amu idamumu intae enyamali ang o esiaai nagol, ilalashera, kitaasishote dama o kewarie, pee mikiek hoo likae te intae, kiliki intae Ilomon Supati le Nkai.

English: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:
Masaai: Irara intae shakeni, naa neijia sii etiu Enkai, te sinyatisho o te supatisho nimikiaata entiyoto to lkuaak lang ti alo intae ilairukok.

English: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you, as a father doth his children,
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo kintaasa intae anaa enaitaas menye inkera enyena, kinkoo pooki ng'ae te intae nikintagol oshuaa, nikintanapa intae.

English: That ye would walk worthy of God, who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory.
Masaai: Pee ipuopuo te nkishon naishiaakino te Nkai, ilo oipotoki intae atua enkitoria enye makewan e nkitoo.

English: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing, because, when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us, ye received it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, the word of God, which effectually worketh also in you that believe.
Masaai: Nikincho sii iyiook oshiaake Enkai enashe te nkaraki ena, inchere pee ing'amumu ororei le Enkai litoning'o te iyiook, eitu intae ing'amumu anaa ororei loo ltung'ana, kake anaa enatiu te dede orerei le Enkai ti atua intae ilairukok.

English: For ye, brethren, became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus: for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen, even as they have of the Jews:
Masaai: Amu ore intae loo lalashera intoduaarie ate isirito e Enkai ti atua Kristo Yesu naatii atua Yudea. Amu inoto sii intae olosilisili too ltung'ana lo lorere linyi anaa enanoto sii ninche too Lyahudi,

English: Who both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted us; and they please not God, and are contrary to all men:
Masaai: laa ninche ootaara ndung'ot pokira metuata Olaitoriani Yesu o loibonok le Nkai, nearaa iyiook ong'ata, nemeitiship Enkai neibooyo ltung'ana pooki

English: Forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they might be saved, to fill up their sins alway: for the wrath is come upon them to the uttermost.
Masaai: emitiki iyiook kiliki Loreren enaiko pee eitajeuni, ejo pee etum aaiputu emborei o ng'ok enye pooki. Kake eewuo engoro e Enkai te nkiting'oto shumata ninche.

English: But we, brethren, being taken from you for a short time in presence, not in heart, endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
Masaai: Kake ore ilalashera anaa neorieki iyiook intae te nkiti kata, too seseni neme too ltauja, kitoinyua o te yieuna sapuk o te nyorrata kitok pee kiduaa inkomomi.

English: Wherefore we would have come unto you, even I Paul, once and again; but Satan hindered us.
Masaai: Amu kitayieutua nikiponu enitii intae, atetema nanu Paulo enkata neme nabo kake eibooyie iyiook shetani.

English: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming?
Masaai: Amu ainyoo osiligi lang aashu eng'ida aashu entoki naisul nikiwuasare te dukuya Olaitoriani lang Yesu te lotunoto enye? Aime intae?

English: For ye are our glory and joy.
Masaai: Amu irara intae enkitoo ang o eng'ida ang.

English: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear, we thought it good to be left at Athens alone;
Masaai: Ore te ina imeekure kindim aating'iria, nikinyorraa metung'uari iyiook oopeny te Atene.

English: And sent Timotheus, our brother, and minister of God, and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ, to establish you, and to comfort you concerning your faith:
Masaai: Nikirriutua iyiook Timoteo, olalashe lang naa osinka le Enkai ti atua Lomon Supati le Kristo pee elotu ashet intae ti Atua enkirukoto inyi neilejilej sii intae;

English: That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.
Masaai: pee metii hoo obo oigusugusie kulo sinaitin, amu iyiololo intae maate inchere erubata ang ina.

English: For verily, when we were with you, we told you before that we should suffer tribulation; even as it came to pass, and ye know.
Masaai: Amu ore apa kitii te nebo intae, kitolikitio intae eado kop inchere keyookini aaisilisil iyiook; anaa enayewuo ake atiu, anaa eniyiolo intae.

English: For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina neitu aitoki aidim ating'iria, nairriu olkilikuai enitii ayiolou enkirukoto inyi, amu aure ajo ebaiki netetema intae olatemani neaku esiaai ang ene pesho.

English: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
Masaai: Kake ore taata eewuo Timoteo enikitii eing'uaa enitii intae, neinosaki iyiook ilomon sidain le nkirukoto o enyorrata inyi, nelimu inchere idamumu oshiaake iyiook too sidain niyieuwu oleng nidolidolo iyiook anaa enikiyieu sii iyiook nikidol intae.

English: Therefore, brethren, we were comforted over you in all our affliction and distress by your faith:
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ena lo alashera, eilejilejaki yiook ti alo emion o sinaitin lang pooki te nkaraki nkirukoto inyi.

English: For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.
Masaai: Amu ore taata naa aikinchu iyiook, tinintasheshe intae nimiwuatiwuatata ti atua Olaitoriani.

English: For what thanks can we render to God again for you, for all the joy wherewith we joy for your sakes before our God;
Masaai: Amu kebaa enashe nikindim aaishoo Enkai te nkaraki intae, te ng'ida pooki nikiaata te nkaraki intae te dukuya e Nkai.

English: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face, and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
Masaai: Kiomon aaitirrish kewarie o dama pee kitum aatodol intae e notote inkomomi, pee kitum aaishoo intae ina nang'or ti atua enkirukoto inyi.

English: Now God himself and our Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way unto you.
Masaai: Ore taata Enkai ang naa Papa makewan, o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo meitorioki enkoitoi ang, enitii intae;

English: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we do toward you:
Masaai: metoponai Olaitoriani enyorrata te rishata inyi intae maate o too ltung'ana pooki anaa enikitiu iyiook te intae,

English: To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God, even our Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints.
Masaai: pee etum ninye aitagolo iltauja linyi meeta entiyoto te sinyatisho te dukuya e Enkai ang naa Papa lang te lotunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu te nebo isinyat lenyena pooki.

English: Furthermore then we beseech you, brethren, and exhort you by the Lord Jesus, that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God, so ye would abound more and more.
Masaai: Ore enabaiyie ilalashera, kiaata ae toki nikinkilikuan intae nikisai ti atua Olaitoriani Yesu, ore anaa enitayioloito te iyiook enaishiaakino te nitiuwu to lkuaak o te nkitishipata e Nkai, anaa eniaasitata, entaas ina oleng oleng.

English: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
Masaai: Amu iyiololo inkiteng'enat, nikincho iyiook intae eing'uaa Olaitoriani Yesu.

English: For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:
Masaai: Amu ena eyeiunoto e Enkai te intae, enkitisinyata inyi, entalam eloloito,

English: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
Masaai: inchere pee eiyiolou pooki ng'ae linyi enaiko te nerikoki kewan enkitok te sinyatisho o te nkanyit,

English: Not in the lust of concupiscence, even as the Gentiles which know not God:
Masaai: neme ti atua ing'uarrat torrok anaa iltung'ana lemeiyiolo Enkai;

English: That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.
Masaai: inchere mepong'ori oltung'ani meinyial olalashe lenye te na bae; amu Olaitoriani oitalaku ti atua kuna baa pooki, anaa enikinturukokito aaikok intae te dukuya.

English: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
Masaai: Amu eitu eipotoki iyiook Enkai olduruk kake atua esinyatisho.

English: He therefore that despiseth, despiseth not man, but God, who hath also given unto us his holy Spirit.
Masaai: Metaa ore oltung'ani pooki le meshilaa ena neme oltung'ani eitu eshilaa kake Enkai, naisho intae, Enkiyang'et enye Sinyati.

English: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you: for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
Masaai: Kake ore ti alo enyorrata oo lalashera, nemeeta tipat pee eigeroki likae tung'ani ae toki, amu ore intae maate eiteng'ena intae Enkai entonyorrata olikae o likae,

English: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia: but we beseech you, brethren, that ye increase more and more;
Masaai: nedede inchere inyorrinyorro ilalashera pooki ootii atua Makedonia. Kake kisai intae ilalashera entaas ina oleng oleng,

English: And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you;
Masaai: eng'oru pee itonini aaitirring'a nigolielie isiaaitin inyi. Niaasishosho too nkaik inyi anaa enikintanapa intae;

English: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.
Masaai: pee itilitili kuldo leme ile ncholuek inyi, nemeitoki aaku oltung'ani ingarakinono.

English: But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope.
Masaai: Kake mikiyieu intae nimiaatata eiyiolounoto ilalashera, ti alo lelo ooirura pee misinanuonuo anaa anaiko kulikae lemeeta osiligi.

English: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaraki nikiruko inchere etua Yesu neitoki apiu neijia sii etiu ti atua Yesu, kerrinyu Enkai te nebo ninye lelo ooirurate.

English: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep.
Masaai: Amu ena kimbalakinye intae to rorei lo Laitoriani inchere ore iyiook ilooishu, ootelekutua ometabau elotunoto o Laitoriani, nimikipuo aaituruk te lelo ooirurate.

English: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
Masaai: Amu Olaitoriani makewan odou eing'uaa shumata to ltoilo le nkitoria o to ltoilo lo lmalaika kitok o endarata e mowuo e Nkai. Ore ilootuata ti atua Kristo nepiu te dukuya.

English: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
Masaai: Ore iyiook ilooishu, ootelekutua, neibung'i iyiook aailepie te nebo ninche ti atua inkatampo pee kinang'are Olaitoriani to loing'ang'e, neaku keaku iyiook tenebo Olaitoriani anaake.

English: Wherefore comfort one another with these words.
Masaai: Metaa entagoloto olikae olikae te kulo rorei.

English: But of the times and the seasons, brethren, ye have no need that I write unto you.
Masaai: Kake ore anaa inkatitin o rishat ilalashera nemeeta tipat pee eigerokini intae ae bae.

English: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
Masaai: Amu iyiololo intae maate oleng inchere elotu enkolong o Laitoriani anaa olapurroni te nkewarie.

English: For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child; and they shall not escape.
Masaai: Ore ejo olorere, “Eetae eseriani nemeetae embatisho.” Ore nabo kata nelotu erruorroto shumata ninche anaa emion nainepu enkitok nairoshiwuo nemeeta eneilanyaki.

English: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
Masaai: Kake mitii intae atua enaimin ilalashera metaa keluam intae ina olong anaa olapurroni.

English: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
Masaai: Amu kira iyiook pooki inkera e wang'an o nkera e ndama, metaa imikira ile nkewarie aashu ile naimin.

English: Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina emikirura naa anaa enairura kulikae, kake matashololoto nikinteng'enuo.

English: For they that sleep sleep in the night; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night.
Masaai: Amu ore kuldo ooirura naa kewarie eirura ore kuldo oomera naa kewarie emera.

English: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
Masaai: Kake ore amu kira ile ndama emaiteng'enuoto nikinchop elong'o oo lgooitie inchere enkirutoto o enyorrata, ore enkopiyia e sekenkei osiligi le njeunoto.

English: For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ,
Masaai: Amu ime engoro enye eiyieu Enkai nikinting'oki kake pee kitum enjeunoto naimu Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo,

English: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
Masaai: otua te nkaraki iyiook paa te naa aikinchu aashu kirura nikinchu te nebo ninye.

English: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
Masaai: Neaku entagoloto oshuaa o likae o likae naa enteshet olikae olikae anaa ina niaasitata.

English: And we beseech you, brethren, to know them which labour among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you;
Masaai: Kake kisai intae, lalashera, enchoo enkanyit lelo ooasisho ti atua intae, naa ilairukok laikook linyi ti atua Olaitoriani neikok intae.

English: And to esteem them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
Masaai: Enchoo ninye enkanyit sapuk nalus o enyorrata te nkaraki esiaai enye, enchoo ejing eseriani atua intae maate.

English: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
Masaai: Nikisai intae ilalashera, enkoo ilturua nipikipiki enyuaata ilootapalari niretutu ilooshal, enting'iria te lelo pooki.

English: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
Masaai: Entodol pee melaaki oltung'ani olikae entorrono te ntorroni, kake entetem anaake entaasata isidain maate o ltung'ana pooki.

English: Rejoice evermore.
Masaai: Entishipata anaake.

English: Pray without ceasing.
Masaai: Entoomon pooki kata,

English: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Masaai: enchoo enashe te pooki pukunoto, amu ena doi eyieunoto e Enkai te intae ti atua Kristo Yesu.

English: Quench not the Spirit.
Masaai: Nimisiorogogo Enkiyang'et,

English: Despise not prophesyings.
Masaai: nimimenaa enaibon e Nkai.

English: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.
Masaai: Kake eneneng'a pooki toki, embung'a entukurraki ina sidai,

English: Abstain from all appearance of evil.
Masaai: entalam empukunoto pooki e ntorroni.

English: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Meitisinya intae tukul Enkai e siriani makewan, ore Enkiyang'et inyi o ltau o sesen, metaa biyoto meeta entibili o metaa enkata e lotunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
Masaai: Ore ilo ooipot intae, keisiligayu naa keitabaya ninye.

English: Brethren, pray for us.
Masaai: Ilalashera entoomonoki iyiook.

English: Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.
Masaai: Eroroki ilalashera pooki te ng'ututata sinyati.

English: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren.
Masaai: Nasai intae to Laitoriani pe eisomakini ena palai ilalashera pooki.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo tenebo intae.

English: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Paulo o Silvano, o Timoteo, Enetii esirit oo Lsesalonike e Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: Grace unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
Masaai: Meeta inchere pee mikincho Enkai enashe inkatitin pooki te nkaraki intae ilalashera, anaa enaishiaakino amu ebulu oleng enkirukoto inyi, ore enyorrata e pooki ng'ae te intae to likae o likae neponari.

English: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki aikiwuasare iyiook intae maate ti atua nena sirito e Enkai te nkitashoto inyi nemeiwuatiwuata o enkirukoto ti atua inkisilisilot inyi pooki, o ti atua isinaitin ling'iriri taata.

English: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God, that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer:
Masaai: Olmonekie ele le nkiguana nasipa e Enkai, pee etumi aaitaa intae ilooishiaakino enkitoria e Enkai naa te ninye eisilisilitoi intae

English: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;
Masaai: ore te nkaraki natoduaa Enkai inchere esipata te nelaaki te nkisilisiloto lelo ooisilisilito intae,

English: And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels,
Masaai: neisho intae ilooisilisiloki enkiyeng'iyeng'ata te nebo iyiook, te ina kata naibalunyeki Olaitoriani Yesu Kristo eing'uaa shumata te nebo ilmalaika lenyena magil,

English: In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: ti atua enkima nayupuyup neyau enkitamioto e nkitalaata shumata kuldo lemeyiolo Enkai, o shumata kuldo lemening Ilomon Supati lo Laitoriani lang Yesu.

English: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power;
Masaai: Amu keitamei te mutata oo ntarasi nekepari aaitalam enetii Olaitoriani o enetii enkitoo e nkidimata enye.

English: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
Masaai: Ore te nelotu ninye te ina olong pee eitaai kitok ti atua isinyat lenyena pee eing'asiakinoi ninye te atua lelo pooki ooiruko, amu ore shakenisho ang te intae neirukoki.

English: Wherefore also we pray always for you, that our God would count you worthy of this calling, and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness, and the work of faith with power:
Masaai: Ina pee kiomonoki oshiaake intae, pee eitaa intae Enkai ang ilooishiaakino te nkipototo enye, neitabaya pooki bae sidai o esiaai enkirukoto te ngolon enye.

English: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Pee aa ore enkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu, neisisi ti atua intae, neisisi intae tiatua ninye, te risioroto e mpiris e Enkai ang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,
Masaai: Ore ti alo elotunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o enkiturrurroto ang pee kinang'are ninye, kisai iyiook intae, ilalashera

English: That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled, neither by spirit, nor by word, nor by letter as from us, as that the day of Christ is at hand.
Masaai: eminchosho eirrirri indamunot inyi aasioki aashu eituria neme te nkiyang'et to rorei aashu te mpalai naji iyiook eing'uaa eji etabawua Enkolong o Laitoriani.

English: Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition;
Masaai: Eminchosho ake oltung'ani elej intae te pooki oitoi, amu melotu ina olong te neme eserserisho nalotu te dukuya, neibalunyieki ilo tung'ani le ngogong'i, enkerai e nkiminata,

English: Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.
Masaai: okeshisho neilepie kewan eiba pooki toki ake ninye naji enkai aashu ina naseremi, neitoton kewan to lorika te nkaji e Enkai, nelikioo kewan eitaa kewan Enkai.

English: Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?
Masaai: Aimidamumu intae aajo ore apa aboitare intae atolikio intae ena?

English: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
Masaai: Niyiololo intae entoki neton eibokito taata pee etumi aaibalunye ninye te nkata enye.

English: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work: only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.
Masaai: Amu ore ina kisudoroto e ngogong'i neasisho taata, ore ilo oibooyo ninye neiko neijia o metaba anaa neiwuang'ieki ninye.

English: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:
Masaai: Ore ina kata neibalunyieki ilo torrono, naa kear Olaitoriani Yesu te ntooma e nkutuk enye, naa keidaikie Ninye ninye te liooto enye o te lotunoto enye.

English: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
Masaai: Ore te lotunoto e ilo torrono te ngolon e shetani, neasi te nkidimata pooki ilmonek le lejare o ne nking'asia,

English: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.
Masaai: neleji lelo ooimin te monkoi e ntorroni amu etanyaita ninche enyorru esipata naidim aitajeu ninche.

English: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:
Masaai: Neaku eirriwaka ninche Enkai enkitarruorroto nagol, meiruko enda e monkoi,

English: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.
Masaai: pee etumi aaiguanara lelo pooki lemeiruk esipata kake eshipakino entorroni.

English: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you, brethren beloved of the Lord, because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth:
Masaai: Kincho oshiaake Enkai enashe te nkaraki intae ilalashera oonyorri to Laitoriani, amu etegelua apa intae Enkai ebaiki enkiterunoto pee eitajeuni te nkoitoi e nkitisinyata te Nkiyang'et o te nkirukoto ti atua esipata.

English: Whereunto he called you by our gospel, to the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Eipotoko ninye intae ena oo Lomon Supati likiyakita iyiook intae pee itumutumu enkitoo e nkisisa o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
Masaai: Ore naa ilalashera, entasheito emiseuseu embung'a entukurraki olkerreti likituutakita iyiook intae to rorei le nkutuk aashu te mpalai.

English: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
Masaai: Ore ninye Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo makewan, o Enkai Papa lang ootonyorra iyiook, neisho iyiook enkilejilej oo ntarasi o siligi sidai oing'uaa empiris,

English: Comfort your hearts, and stablish you in every good word and work.
Masaai: meilejileja iltauja linyi neitasheiyie ninche ti atua enkiaas pooki sidai o to rorei.

English: Finally, brethren, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course, and be glorified, even as it is with you:
Masaai: Ilalashera ore enabayie entoomokie iyiook, pee esioki ororei lo Laitoriani aidapasha nemirisho anaa enaikunaki ti atua intae,

English: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
Masaai: pee eitajeuni iyiook too ltung'ana arruok naa torrok; amu ime pooki ooata enkirukoto.

English: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
Masaai: Kake eisiligayu Olaitoriani naa keitagol ninye intae nerrip intae te ntorroni.

English: And we have confidence in the Lord touching you, that ye both do and will do the things which we command you.
Masaai: Aikiaata enkitieunoto ti atua Olaitoriani ti alo intae inchere iasitata naa imookiki aas imbaa nikintanap intae.

English: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.
Masaai: Metuutai Olaitoriani iltauja aitorioki enyorrata e Enkai o enkitashoto nemeiwuatiwuata e Kristo.

English: Now we command you, brethren, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly, and not after the tradition which he received of us.
Masaai: Intae ilalashera kintanap taata te nkarna o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo inchere entalam olalashe pooki oton te nturuaisho lemesuj ilo kerreti litang'amutua te iyiook.

English: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
Masaai: Amu iyiololo intae maate eninkoko te niduaayaya iyiook, amu ore apa kiboitare intae neitu kitoni pesho,

English: Neither did we eat any man's bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
Masaai: neitu kinya endaa o ltung'ani hoo obo eitu kilak kake kinaurita nikisiaaisho, aasisho kewarie o dama, pee mikiaaku ake olola le likae obo linyi.

English: Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
Masaai: Neme enkaraki naa esipata mikiaata kake pee kincho iyiook intae to lkuaak lang enkitanyaanyukoto niduaayaya.

English: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
Masaai: Ore doi ninye ina kata kiboitare intae nikinchoo intae ena kitanapata: Te nemeasisho oltung'ani emincho enya endaa.

English: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
Masaai: Amu kining ake inchere etii kulikae linyi ootoni ti atua enturuaisho neitanyamaluo too siaaitin e kulikae nemeeta esiaai naas.

English: Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.
Masaai: Kintanap iltung'ana anaa lelo nikinkok te nkarna o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo metaasa esiaai enye te ngira nenya endaa naisiaayu oopeny.

English: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
Masaai: Ilalashera eminauru te asata oo supati.

English: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
Masaai: Te neany oltung'ani ening enikiliki iyiook intae te na palai, entayiolo ilo tung'ani, nimintokiki aata eniporokiki ninye, pee ekurru ninye.

English: Yet count him not as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
Masaai: Eming'or ninye anaa olmang'atinta, kake enkoo anaa olalashe.

English: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
Masaai: Ore taata Olaitoriani le seriani meishoo ninye intae makewan eseriani inkatitin pooki ti tua nkoitoi pooki, metaa Olaitoriani te nebo intae pooki.

English: The salutation of Paul with mine own hand, which is the token in every epistle: so I write.
Masaai: Nanu Paulo oigero ena kirorokino te nkaina ai makewan. Ele olilmonekie le mpalai ai pooki, neijia oshiaake aiko te naiger.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo te nebo intae pooki.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Kristo Yesu te nkitanapata e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang, o te ne Kristo Yesu osiligi lang.

English: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.
Masaai: Oigeroki Timoteo, enkerai ai te sipata ti atua enkirukoto. Metaa enino empiris, o lng'ur, o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,
Masaai: Ore anaa enapa naaitanapa aloito Makedonia, tobiko te Efeso peyie intanap amitiki lelo kulikae elikioo pooki kiteng'enare napaashaa.

English: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.
Masaai: Aashu eitanyamal ate too nkatinin o lmakui nemeeta enkiting'oto, naayau nkikilikuanat naapaashari neme enchetunoto e atua Enkai natii enkirukoto atua.

English: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
Masaai: Amu ore enaipirta enkitanapata ang naa enyorrata naing'uaa oltau owang o ltau sidai lemeeta ileeni, enkirukoto nemetii esunkureisho.

English: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;
Masaai: Ore kulikae netapaashari aapong kuna neidapashakino enchankar e pesho,

English: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.
Masaai: eyieu ninche neaku ilaiteng'enak loo nkitanapat nemeyiolo nena naajoito aashu nena baa naaimaki aakurraki.
