English: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;
Masaai: Ore iyiook nikiyiolo aajo sidain inkitanapat te neasishore oltung'ani te sipata,

English: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
Masaai: kiyiolo ena nchere, ore nkitanapat, eitu eitanapisho te nkaraki lelo supati, kake te nkaraki lelo aasak loo ntorrok o loogolong'u, te nkaraki lelo lemeure Enkai o laing'okok, te nkaraki lelo lemesinya o loomorisho, te nkaraki lelo ooar iloo menye o looar inoo ng'otonye metuata, te nkaraki lelo ooitayu iloikop,

English: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
Masaai: iloololoito, iloosokorisho, ilapurrok loo ltung'ana, o ilaimonkok, o loonya olmumai le lejare, o lelo pooki oopaashare enkiteng'enare supat,

English: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
Masaai: naipirare ilomon supati kituaak le Enkai namayiana, laaishooki nanu aaisilig.

English: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;
Masaai: Aisho nanu Kristo Olaitoriani lang enashe, laa ninye laaishoo engolon naasishore nanu aatoduaa ajo kara olairukoni naagelaki ena kisiaayiare enye,

English: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
Masaai: hoo te natamoro apa enkarna enye naisilisil namor ninye: kake atang'amua olng'ur amu ataasa apa nena te modai maata enkirukoto,

English: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: naaiputakini empiris o Laitoriani lang aaitadooyo te nebo enkirukoto, o enyorrata natii atua Kristo Yesu.

English: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
Masaai: Ekesipa ena kiroroto, neishiaakino neng'amari nenyorrarri katukul inchere, eewuo Kristo enkop aitajeu ilooata ng'ok. Naa nanu oituruk too looata.

English: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
Masaai: Kake te nkaraki ena ore ti atua nanu ara oloituruk naibalunye Yesu Kristo o eng'iriata enye nalulung'a, pee aaku enkitanyaanyukoto te lelo ooyooki aairuk ninye, netum enkishui nemeiting.

English: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa eno laiguanani loo lporori pooki, lemeye ae kata, lemelioo, laa ninye ake Enkai, enkanyit o enkitoo intarasi o ntarasi, Esai.

English: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
Masaai: Ena kitanapata aaishoo iyie, Timoteo, enkerai ai, te risioroto oo nkirorot e naibon nikimpirta iyie, pee kidumu ninche tijing'a ilo arrabal sidai.

English: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
Masaai: Imbung'ita enkirukoto to ltau supat lemeeta ileeni. Ore kulikae netanyaita enkikoo oo ltauja lenye neidaikie enkirukoto enye,

English: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
Masaai: ore te lelo netii Hemanayo o Aleksanta laitarasaka shetani pee eiteng'eni meigil aamor Enkai.

English: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
Masaai: Ore naa enaituruk, aitirrish, esayiata o enkomono o eomonokinoto e enkishooroto e nashe metaasi too ltung'ana pooki,

English: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
Masaai: too laiguanak o lelo pooki ootii iwuejitin e nkitoo pee kitoni te mborron o te nkishon naserian, neure Enkai neyanyitisho too nkoitoi pooki.

English: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
Masaai: Ena esidai naa ninye nang'amaroyu too nkonyek e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang,

English: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
Masaai: laa keyieu ninye neitajeuni iltung'ana pooki nepuonu aatum eyiolounoto e sipata.

English: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
Masaai: Amu eetae Enkai nabo, naa obo olaitutumoni le Enkai o ltung'ana, oltung'ani oji Kristo Yesu,

English: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
Masaai: oishorua kewan enye pee eaku elakunoto te pooki, neitakiaki enchakenisho te nkata enye naishiaakino.

English: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena pee aategeluaki nanu mataa olalikioroni o lkipaaret (naasipa ajoito, malejisho nanu), ataa olaiteng'enani loo loreren te nkirukoto o te sipata.

English: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
Masaai: Ayieu naa neomon ilewa too wuejitin pooki, neilepie inkaik naasinya nemetii engoro aashu enchankar;

English: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
Masaai: neijia sii etiu inkituaak, inchoo ekus ate aaiririki te ng'eno o too lkilani ooishiaakino, neme te enchetata oo lpapit aashu te sahabu aashu too lului, aashu too nkilani naagol enkinyang'a

English: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
Masaai: kake too iasat sidain, anaa enaishiaakino inkituuak naajo keeta enkirukoto.

English: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
Masaai: Inchoo enkitok eiteng'enuo te ngira neaku enaning'isho.

English: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
Masaai: Manyorraki hoo enkitok meiteng'enisho aashu meitoria ilewa, inchoo ninye metigirayu.

English: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
Masaai: Amu Adam apa eiteraki aaitobir neitokini Hawa.

English: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
Masaai: Neme Adam apa etelejaki, kake enkitok apa etelejaki, neaku etigila nkitanapat.

English: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
Masaai: Kake keitajeuni enkitok te ishoi oo nkera te nebik ti atua enkirukoto, o enyorrata o esinyatisho, te nebo eng'eno o esupatisho te nebo eng'eno biyoto.

English: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
Masaai: Enkiroroto nasipa ena inchere, te neyieu oltung'ani neaku olaitasheikinoni le sirit, naa eyieunoto sidai.

English: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
Masaai: Eishiaakino olaitasheikinoni le sirit, nemeeta eleyiata olee le nkitok nabo loo nkiririkinot, naa ng'en, pirisut, naa aminin, neyiolo aiteng'enisho,

English: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
Masaai: nememera, nemearisho, kake oltung'ani supat, neme olaishankarrani, nemenyor impesai.

English: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
Masaai: Neitasheiki olmarei lenye aitobiraki, neitoning'isho inkera enyena, pee eyanyitisho too nkoitoi pooki.

English: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
Masaai: Amaa te nemeyiolo oltung'ani aitasheiki enkaji enye, kaji eiko te neing'or esirit e Enkai?

English: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
Masaai: Enyor neme ilo oibelekenye det pee merup kewan to Iwuasa nebatatakino enkiguana e shetani.

English: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
Masaai: Neme ina ake eishiaakino neeta errepet te lelo ootii boo pee medoiki ake atua esulare o rreshet le shetani.

English: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
Masaai: Neijia ake sii etiu ilaisiaayiak, inchoo emut nabo nemeitoki aaing'ashing'ash too nkirorot, neme ilooitabaitie enaisho, nemeeta olorok le dupoto,

English: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
Masaai: inchoo eibung enkirukoto to ltau owang.

English: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
Masaai: Nchoo sii eng'asi aatem ninche, ore ake peyie eitisipi nchere meeta ileyiat, nchoo easisho anaa ilaisiaayiak.

English: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
Masaai: Neijia ake sii eikununo inkituaak, nchoo emut nabo, neme inaakurrisho kake inoo nkiririkinot, naaisiligayu too mbaa pooki.

English: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
Masaai: Nchoo laisiaayiak eaku olmoruo le nkitok nabo, neitasheiki sii ninche inkera enye o nkajijik enye aaitobiraki.

English: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Amu ore lelo ooasisho aaitobiraki anaa ilaisiaayiak naa ketum errepet sidai maate, netum enkitieunoto kitok ti atua enkirukoto natii atua Kristo Yesu.

English: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
Masaai: Aisilig ajo kalotu enitii asieku, kake aasiraki kuna kiteng'enat peyie,

English: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
Masaai: te naimutie niyiolou enaishiaakino neas oltung'ani ti atua enkaji e Enkai. Naa ninye esirit e Enkai naishu, ninye eng'ape, o lkitamanyunoto loo sipat.

English: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
Masaai: Kitejo iyiook tukul inchere, kitok oleng enkisudoroto e nkirukoto ang: Eibalunyeki ninye to sesen, neitadedeyieki ninye te Nkiyang'et nedol ilmalaika, nelikiori too loreren, neiruk enkop, neyae ninye shumata te nkitoo.

English: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;
Masaai: Neaku ejo Enkiyang'et Sinyati aibalunye nchere, ore too nkatitin e nkiting'oto, naa keing'uaa kulikae enkirukoto nerubare lelo tauja le lejare o nkiteng'enat oo loiriruani

English: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
Masaai: eimu esunkureisho e lelo oolejisho ootokilote iltauja lenye,

English: Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats, which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth.
Masaai: oomit eyamishoe, nemit einosi kulie daiki naaitayio Enkai, nemit eng'amuni te nashe lelo ooata enkirukoto ooyiolo isipat.

English: For every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving:
Masaai: Amu ore pooki toki naitayio Enkai naa eisidai, nemeetae hoo ae toki nabo naanyi te naa te nashe eng'amuni;

English: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
Masaai: amu keitisiny ororei le Enkai o enkomono.

English: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things, thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ, nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine, whereunto thou hast attained.
Masaai: Te ninguan ilalashera te kuna kiteng'enat niaaku olaisiaayiani supat le Kristo Yesu, oitubuluaki too rorei le nkirukoto e nkiteng'enare sidai naa ninye iyie itusuja.

English: But refuse profane and old wives' fables, and exercise thyself rather unto godliness.
Masaai: Tapaasha nena atinin e modai neme ne Enkai. Intamoo kewan orrekie le Enkai;

English: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
Masaai: amu te naa keeta enkitamooto o sesen enkiti retoto, enkitamooto oo mbaa e Enkai naata te pooki oitoi, amu keeta enkisiligata tena kishui o te nkishui nalotu.

English: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
Masaai: Ororei osipa ele neishiaakino neng'amari katukul.

English: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach, because we trust in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
Masaai: Enkaraki kuna pee kintanyamal ate nikinyok, amu Enkai naishu kitipika osiligi lang naa ninye Olaitajeunoni le pooki tung'ani neisulaki lelo ooiruk.

English: These things command and teach.
Masaai: Intanapisho ninteng'enishore kuna baa.

English: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
Masaai: Mincho oltung'ani hoo obo kimenu te nkaraki kitisho ino, kake intoduaa ilairukok enkitanyaanyukoto ti atua enkiroroto o to lkuaak, ti atua enyorrata, ti atua enkirukoto, o ti atua esinyatisho.

English: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
Masaai: Tasheikinoyu enkisomata oo lkigerot te dukuya iltung'ana o elikioroto, o enkiteng'enare o metaba anaa nalotu.

English: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
Masaai: Mintololoiki ina kishoroto niaata, nikinchooki apa too nkirorot e naibon apa peyie kinteleiki ilpayiani inkaik.

English: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.
Masaai: Intamoo kewan kuna siaaitin tasheikinore ninche, pee edol pooki ng'ae eninkonari te nyuaata.

English: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
Masaai: Tonyuaa kewan o nena kiteng'enat inono, imbung'a, amu te niaas ina nintajeu kewan o lelo likinining.

English: Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father; and the younger men as brethren;
Masaai: Mibuaaki olpayian kitok kake tasayiaki anaa papaai lino, inkuna ltung'ana ooti anaa ilalashera linono,

English: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
Masaai: ninko nkituaak moruak anaa noo ng'utunyi, ninko nkituaak kutiti anaa nkanashera inono te sinyatisho pooki.

English: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
Masaai: Iyanyita nkolia naara te dede.

English: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
Masaai: Naa te neeta enkoliai nkera aashu inoo nkoko nchoo eng'as aitabaya nena siaaitin e nkirukoto too lmareita lenye neisho ntoiwuo enye olerrinyore amu keng'amaroyu ena te dukuya Enkai.

English: Now she that is a widow indeed, and desolate, trusteth in God, and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day.
Masaai: Ore naa enkoliai te dede, netung'uayioki aa ninye ake naa Enkai eisilig nebik te eomonokinoto o te nkomono dama o kewarie;

English: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
Masaai: kake ore ina naa enoo ng'uarrat ake, netua hoo neishu.

English: And these things give in charge, that they may be blameless.
Masaai: Intanapisho ena pee metum ake ninche ileyiat.

English: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
Masaai: Te netii oltung'ani lemegolie iltung'ana lenyena neisulaki lelo le nkaji enye, neiturrayie ninye enkirukoto, neaku torrono alang oleitu eiruk.

English: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old, having been the wife of one man,
Masaai: Nchoo eng'amuni aaiger enkoliai nemeitong'or ilarin ntomoni ile, naa enkitok apa o lpayian obo,

English: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints' feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.
Masaai: neeta ake sii enchakenisho oo mbaa enyena sidain anaa enaitubulua inkera neitoomonishe, neitukuo inkejek oo sinyat, netasarua lelo oonyamal, netasheikine aas impukunot pooki oo siaaitin sidain too nkoitoi pooki.

English: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
Masaai: Kake tanya ing'amu aiger inkolia kutiti: amu te nepaashari ninche neyieu neyami,

English: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
Masaai: neaku keiguanareki ninche amu eiturraitie enapa kiroroto natang'asa aaibung.

English: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.
Masaai: Ore ake etiu neijia, neitamok ate enturuaisho neirrang'irrang aaruk inkajijik, neme neijia ake, kake eeta sii olmarenke o enkilepilep nekurrisho neiro mbaa nemeishiaakino neiro.

English: I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.
Masaai: Metaa ajo nanu, keishiaakino neyami nkolia kutiti, neiu nkera, neitore nkajijik enye, peyie metum olmang'atinta erishata nasukenyie iyiook.

English: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
Masaai: Amu eidipa kulie aatapong'ori aasuj shetani.

English: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.
Masaai: Te netii enkairukoni naata inkolia too lmarei lenye, nchoo enap ninche; Mincho esirit eiteleikini olola, peyie etum ataretu nena olia te dede.

English: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo payiani laa larikok supati, nchoo edamuni neigilieki aaisho enkanyit, neisulaki lelo oonyok te likioroto o te nkiteng'enare.

English: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
Masaai: Amu ejo lkigerot, “Mien olkiteng enkutuk eidong'ito enkurma,” nejo sii, “Eishiaakino olaisiaayiani olekoisiaayio lenye.”

English: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.
Masaai: Minyorraa te neitang'ori olpayian aashu te naa ketii lchakenini oare anaa okuni.

English: Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ooenikino ng'ok tabuaaki etii pooki pee etum iltung'ana pooki enkuretisho.

English: I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.
Masaai: Ore te dukuya Enkai o Kristo Yesu o lelo malaika oogeluno aaitanap iyie nchere imbung'a kuna kitanapat miaata nyorrakino, nimiaas hoo ae bae to lkep.

English: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men's sins: keep thyself pure.
Masaai: Misioki enkiteleikinoto oo nkaik, niming'arie likae tung'ani ng'ok enyena, torripo kewan taa sinyati.

English: Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach's sake and thine often infirmities.
Masaai: Mintoki aok enkare narok, kake tooko enkiti aisho o sabibu te nkaraki enkoshoke ino o te ina mueyian e anaa ake.

English: Some men's sins are open beforehand, going before to judgment; and some men they follow after.
Masaai: Eibala ng'ok e kulikae tung'ana neutu edungokinoto e nkiguana, kake ore kulikae te siadi eyooki aaibalayu.

English: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
Masaai: Neijia sii etiu iasat supati e kulikae tung'ana, keibalayu aasioki, naa te nemeibala nemeidim aaisudori o akenya.

English: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour, that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed.
Masaai: Nchoo lelo pooki ootii abori enchata e rrindikisho eikenaa ilkituaak lenye aajo keiririkino enkanyit pooki peyie mesukenyi ake enkarna e Enkai aashu nkiteng'enat.

English: And they that have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brethren; but rather do them service, because they are faithful and beloved, partakers of the benefit. These things teach and exhort.
Masaai: Ore lelo ooata lkituaak ooidipa aairuko nemepal enkanyit enye amu ejo lelo ilalashera, kake peyie, easisho oleng amu ore lelo oodupore ena siaai enye naa ile tipat, amu lairukok nenyorri. Inteng'ena nintudup ninche kuna siaaitin.

English: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;
Masaai: Te neiteng'enisho oltung'ani ae kiteng'enare napaashaa neibung irorei supati lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo o enkiteng'enare naishiaakino orrekie le Nkai

English: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,
Masaai: nerup kewan te modai nemeyiolo toki. Eeta ninye enkure oe nchankar o empong'o, naa ine epukunye olom o lolepilepi, o emorore, o nkiteenikinot torrok,

English: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds, and destitute of the truth, supposing that gain is godliness: from such withdraw thyself.
Masaai: o enchankar ti atua iltung'ana lemelulung'a lukuny enye nemeeta esipata. Oojo ore orrekie le Enkai naa enkoitoi naduporeki.

English: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
Masaai: Etii dupoto sapuk orrekie le Enkai te nebo enkidipakinoto.

English: For we brought nothing into this world, and it is certain we can carry nothing out.
Masaai: Amu eitu apa kiyau ae toki atua enkop, nimikindim aawaita hoo toki aaitung'uai enkop.

English: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
Masaai: Kake ti nikiaata endaa o naaishopi, ore kiaata kuna, neidip iyiook nena.

English: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.
Masaai: Kake ore lelo ooyieu neaku karsisi naa kedoiki ntemat, atua orreshet, nedoiki atua mbaa kumok e modai, naaitameisho neitadoiki iltung'ana atua enkitarruorroto o enkidaaroto.

English: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
Masaai: Amu ore enyorrata oo mpesai ninye entonai oo ntorrok pooki, enkaraki kuna pee etapaashari lkulikae aaing'uaa enkirukoto nerem ltauja lenye too nkitamiot kumok.

English: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, lo tung'ani le Enkai, ilanya kuna pooki, ing'oru esupatisho, o rrekie le Enkai, o enkirukoto, o enyorrata o enkitashoto, o emborron.

English: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
Masaai: Taarisho te ilo arrabal sidai le nkirukoto; imbung'a ina kishui nemeiting, nikimpotokoki apa pee imbalie te dukuya ilchakenini kumok.

English: I give thee charge in the sight of God, who quickeneth all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate witnessed a good confession;
Masaai: Ore te dukuya Enkai laa ninye oishoo empuaan pooki toki; o te dukuya Kristo Yesu laa ore enchakenisho enye te dukuya Pontio Pilato neibalunye enkirukoto enye,

English: That thou keep this commandment without spot, unrebukeable, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ:
Masaai: aaitanap inchere, imbung'a inkitanapat miaata olduruki nimiaata enikimpotokini o metabau elioto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;
Masaai: Naa keibalunyeki ena te nkata naishiaakino, ilo omayiana naa ninye ake Olaitoriani loo laitoriak;

English: Who only hath immortality, dwelling in the light which no man can approach unto; whom no man hath seen, nor can see: to whom be honour and power everlasting. Amen.
Masaai: laa ninye ake le meye, obik te wang'an nemeing'urayu. Nemeetae ae kata oltung'ani otoduaa ninye nemeeta oloidim atoduaa. Metaa enenye enkanyit o enkitoria intarasi. Esai.

English: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
Masaai: Ore lelo karsisi le na kop inkoo pe mepik osiligi atua enkarsisisho enye nemebikoo, kake peyie eisilig Enkai naiputaki iyiook nena pooki pee kishipakino.

English: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
Masaai: Nchoo ninche eaku supati, nekarsisu too iasat sidain, neretisho neleng'u sii,

English: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold on eternal life.
Masaai: amu te nena eitobiraki ate olkitamanyunoto sidai too nkolong'i naapuonu, peyie eyooki aang'amu ina kishui naa ninye nara katukul.

English: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:
Masaai: Oo Timoteo, torripo ina toki apa nikisiligieki. Talama nena kirorot neme no rrekie le Enkai, o mpaashat e nena naaitaae eng'eno te lejare.

English: Which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with thee. Amen.
Masaai: Amu ena eibung'a kulikae nepong'ori neitu etil enkirukoto. Metaa empiris te nebo intae.

English: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
Masaai: Paulo, olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo te yieunoto e Enkai te risioroto e nkisiligata e mpuaan natii atua Kristo Yesu.

English: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
Masaai: Timoteo enkerai ai nanyor aigeroki: Metaa te nebo iyie empiris, o lng'ur o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitoriani lang.

English: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
Masaai: Te naadamu oshi te nkomono dama o kewarie naisho Enkai enashe, ina naisiaaita to oltoilo loltau owang, anaa apa iloo papa.

English: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
Masaai: Ore te nadamu ilkiyio linono ina kata apa nchirita, naayieu naadol dama o kewarie, peyie aaboreyu eng'ida.

English: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
Masaai: Adamu sii ina kirukoto ino nasipa, enkirukoto apa naitera amany kokoo ino Lois, o ng'utunyi Oinike, nayiolo taata aitisip nchere etamanya atua iyie.

English: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ina peyie aaitadamu nchere nyaaki ntopiu enkishoroto e Enkai natii atua iyie ninoto apa te nkiteleikinoto oo nkaik aainei.

English: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
Masaai: Amu eitu eisho iyiook Enkai oltau le nkuretisho kake oltau le ngolon o le nyorrata o le nkibooroto e kewan.

English: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
Masaai: Mikurru te nintayu shakenisho o Laitoriani lang aashu te nanu oloena lenye, kake tonyorrai erishata ino o sina litum te nkaraki ororei supat te ngolon e Enkai,

English: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
Masaai: naitajewuo iyiook neipot iyiook te ina kipototo nasinya, neme enkaraki esupatisho oo nkiaasin ang kake, te nkaraki esupatisho e yieunoto enye makewan, o te mpiris naishoo ninye iyiook ti atua Kristo Yesu apa moitie.

English: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
Masaai: Neibalunyeki taata te liooroto o Laitajeunoni lang Kristo Yesu, oiwuang'ie keeya neyau puaan o enkiishata e keeya.

English: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
Masaai: Te nkaraki ele rorei aategeluaki mataa olalikioroni o Lkipaaret o laiteng'enani,

English: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
Masaai: naa te nkaraki ena pee aata ele sina. Kake madol enkurruna amu ayiolo ilo lairuko natisipua nchere eidim ninye atorripo ina naaisiligieki nanu o metabau ina olong.

English: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Tusuja ilo rrekie loo rorei ooata empuaan apa litoning'uo te nanu. Te nkirukoto o te nyorrata natii atua Kristo Yesu.

English: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
Masaai: Torripo ina sipata nikinchooki iyie te Nkiyang'et Sinyati natamanya atua iyiook.

English: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
Masaai: Iyiolo ajo ore lelo pooki ootii Asia neibelekenyate, naaing'uaa nanu, ore te lelo netii Figelo o Ermogene.

English: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
Masaai: Meishoo Olaitoriani olng'ur enkaji e Onesiforo amu aaitagolo ninye oshoke katitin kumok, eitu edol isura too lpisia le enata ai,

English: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
Masaai: kake ore pee ebau Roma naalilitu o maanoto.

English: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
Masaai: Meidimie Olaitoriani menoto olng'ur te idia olong kenya o Laitoriani niyiolo sii eneba esiaai nataasishe te Efeso.

English: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Ore naa iyie, enkerai ai, tagolo te mpiris natii atua Kristo.

English: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
Masaai: Ore ina nitoning'o te nanu te dukuya lchakenini kumok, intarasaki lelo tung'ana ooisiligayu ooidim sii ninche aaiteng'ena ilkulikae.

English: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Tonyorrai tang'ara osina anaa osikari odupa le Kristo Yesu.

English: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
Masaai: Meetae osikari otii enjore oisho metarruesha mbaa neme ne njore, amu ore enayieu ninye naa pe eitiship ilo oigero.

English: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
Masaai: Meishori olokuet emaupe a e nkitoo mme ketekeshe te risioroto oo nkitanapat.

English: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
Masaai: Ore olaturoni le nkurma onyok eiririkino netum ilng'anayio le dukuya.

English: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
Masaai: Tadamu kuna najo amu eikincho Olaitoriani ening'unoto te pooki toki.

English: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
Masaai: Tadamu Yesu Kristo, otopiwuo aing'uaa ilootuata, le ntalipa e Daudi, anaa enainosuaki te ilo rorei lai supat.

English: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
Masaai: Lelo omon supati laa te ninye aainosieki osina o maateeni too lpisia anaa olarruoni. Kake ore ororei le Enkai nemeena.

English: Therefore I endure all things for the elect's sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
Masaai: Neaku kang'iri pooki te nkaraki lelo gelunot, pee etum sii ninche aanoto ina jeunoto ti atua Kristo Yesu, te nebo enkitoo oo ntarasi.

English: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
Masaai: Ororei osipa ele nchere: Te nikituata te nebo ninye, naa eikiyooki sii aaishu te nebo ninye.

English: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
Masaai: Te niking'iri nikiyooki sii aaitoreisho te nebo ninye; te nikimiki ninye nemiki sii ninye iyiook;

English: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
Masaai: te nimikisiligayu, neton ninye eisiligayu — amu meidim ninye atomiki kewan.

English: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
Masaai: Intadamu ninche ena, nintanap te dukuya Olaitoriani, metapaashare enchankar oo rorei amu meretisho, kake keiminie ake lelo ooning.

English: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
Masaai: Tonyuaa ntoduaai; kewan te Enkai ajo inyorraro, nira olaisiaayiani lemeeta enaitukurru, oasishore te nkitoriokinoto ilo rorei osipa.

English: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
Masaai: Tapaasha nena kirorot e pesho nemetii euriata e Enkai, amu iltung'ana ake erikoo oleng oleng metalama euriata e Enkai.

English: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;
Masaai: Ore nkirorot enye nedaari anaa enkeeya nayieng'i, ore te lelo netii Hermenayo o Fileto;

English: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
Masaai: ootapong'o enkoitoi nasipa, eji ejo eidipa empiunoto oo lootuata atulusoi, neibelekeny enkirukoto e kulikae.

English: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
Masaai: Kake etuno Enkai olkitamanyunoto le nkirukoto, nepik ele mishire ojo, “Eyiolo Olaitoriani lelo oora ilenyena,” neitoki ajo, “Ore pooki ng'ae oipot enkarna o Laitoriani nchoo eing'uaa entorroni.”

English: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
Masaai: Ore ti atua enkaji sapuk neme ntokitin e sahabu o enkosholai ake natii, kake etii sii noo nkeek o ne nkulukuoni, ore nkulie neasishoreki too mbaa naailep ore nkulie neasishoreki too mbaa naadou.

English: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
Masaai: Te neituku oltung'ani kewan nepaash iloirerioni neaku entoki naasishoreki te nkanyit, naitisinyaki pee easishore olopeny enkaji, neirragieki aaitaanyu nena siaaitin sidain.

English: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
Masaai: Neaku ilanya naa ng'uarrat e lelero, ning'oru esupatisho o enkirukoto, o enyorrata o eseriani, te nebo lelo ooipot enkarna o Laitoriani to ltau owang.

English: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
Masaai: Miaata eniporoki enchankar e modai nemeeta enajo, iyiolo iyie ajo ilarrabali ake eiu.

English: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
Masaai: Meishiaakino osinka lo Laitoriani te neaku olo larrabal kake oltung'ani oibor oshoke te pooki ng'ae olaiteng'enani onyor aiteng'enisho, ong'iri,

English: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
Masaai: nererioo te mborron lelo ookesh ninye, amu ebaiki neidim Enkai aishoo meirridu nepuonu aayiolou ina sipata.

English: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
Masaai: Pee ebaiki neisik aaing'uaa oorreshet le sheitani, otang'asa apa aibung metaasa enayieu ninye.

English: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
Masaai: Kake tayiolo ena nchere ore too nkolong'i e nkiting'oto naa kepuonu nkatitin oo sinaitin.

English: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
Masaai: Amu keaku iltung'ana iloonyor ate, iloonyor mpesai, iloowuasa, ilooilash, iloomorisho, iloogolong'aki ntoiwuo enye, ilemeeta ashe, nemeure Enkai.

English: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
Masaai: Iloorook oishuaa, ilemesayiayu, nekurrisho, nemeeta esupatisho, ilemeibooyo ate too ntorrok pushunot, ilooiba esupatisho.

English: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
Masaai: Ilooudoo ilkulenye, neipopong'a to lwuasa, iloonyor esikar alang enanyor Enkai.

English: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
Masaai: Oitaakuno kenyor Enkai netanyaita engolon enye. Talama iyie iltung'ana ooikununo neijia.

English: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
Masaai: Amu ore ti atua ninche netii lelo ooruk nkajijik, neibung nena kituaak naamoda naanapita lolan loo ng'ok naarikito ng'uarrat enye oo mpukunot kumok,

English: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
Masaai: naainining pooki ng'ae nemebaiki aikata eyiolounoto e ina sipata.

English: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
Masaai: Anaa Yanes o Yampres ootanyaita enatejo Musa, neijia sii etiu kulo tung'ana ootanyaita esipata, iltung'ana ootarruoitie ndamunot ninche.

English: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
Masaai: Kake meeta dikai nebaya ilenkirukoto e nkitaakuno amu keibalayu emodai enye te pooki anaa ene lelo tung'ana apa pokira oare.

English: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
Masaai: Kake indipa iyie atoduaa enkiteng'enare ai o rrekie lai o enaipirta te nkishui ai enkirukoto ai, eng'iriata ai, enyorrata ai, o enkitashoto ai,

English: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
Masaai: inkisilisilot aainei, sinaitin laainei, nena naaineputua te Antiok, te Ikonio o te Listra, eneba inkisilisilot nating'iria nanu; kake ore te nena pooki naatokordua Olaitoriani.

English: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
Masaai: Esipa ore lelo pooki ooyieu neibung orrekie le Enkai ti atua Kristo Yesu, nemeeta nchere pee meisilisili;

English: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
Masaai: ore kuldo tung'ana torrok o lalejak neponari aaku torrok, elejisho neleji sii ninche.

English: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
Masaai: Kake ore iyie, tobiko te nena nindipa atayiolo aitisip, amu iyiolo iyie ajo aing'ae likinteng'ena ina.

English: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: Naa ore ebaiki keraisho ino itayiolo lelo kigerot sinyat likindim aaiteng'ena te njeunoto naimu enkirukoto ti atua Yesu Kristo.

English: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
Masaai: Ore ilkigerot pooki naa Enkai naiyiang'ua, neeta dupoto te nkiteng'enare, o te nkisikong'at o ererioto, o te nkitubulunoto ti atua esupatisho,

English: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
Masaai: paa ore oltung'ani le Enkai neitabari te nkiaas pooki sidai.

English: I charge thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
Masaai: Aaitanap iyie te dukuya Enkai o Kristo Yesu, laa ninye oyooki aiguanare ilooishu o lootuata, o te ina liooto enye,

English: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
Masaai: tolikioi ele rorei isiosiono te nkata sidai o te ntorrono. Inguanaki intijing'ai, nisikong, ninkok niaaku otemesi te ngiriata o te nkiteng'enare.

English: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
Masaai: Amu kelotu enkata nemeyieu iltung'ana neng'iri ina kiteng'enare supat kake esuj ninche iyieunot enye neing'uraki ate ilturrurri loo laiteng'enak ooitabaya nena naayieu ninche, te ng'ion oo nkiyiaa enye,

English: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
Masaai: nepaash inaasipa aasuj inkatinin e lejare.

English: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
Masaai: Kake ore iyie ntasho anaake, ting'iria osina taasa esiaai o lalikioroni, ntabai enkisiaayiare ino.

English: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
Masaai: Amu aidipa atabaiki enkata pee aaitaai olasar. Etabawua enkata e lototo ai.

English: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
Masaai: Ataarare olarrabal sidai, aidipa ina kuetata, atagolie enkirukoto.

English: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
Masaai: Ore ebaiki taata naatushumakaki nanu emaupe e nkitoo e supatisho, naa Olaitoriani, ilo arishani asipani laayooki aisho, te ina olong, neme nanu ake eishori, kake keishori sii lelo ootonyorra enkata naliooyu ninye.

English: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
Masaai: Tonyuaa oleng, tasioku ene natii.

English: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
Masaai: Amu ore Demas, etonyorra ena kop e taata naashomo aing'uaa nelo Sesalonike, eshomo Kreskes Galatia neshomo Tito Dalmatia.

English: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
Masaai: Luka ake openy laaboitare. Ing'oru Marko pee ishoru, amu kaaretu oleng te siaai.

English: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
Masaai: Airriwayie Tikikos meshomo Efeso.

English: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
Masaai: Ore te nilotu iyie nishoru olkila apa latung'ueikia Karpo te Troas o mbukui sii neisulaki nena oo ndapan.

English: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
Masaai: Ore Aleksanta ele kunoni loo suyan aaitaasa ntorrok oleng, keitalak Olaitoriani te nkaraki nkiaasin enyena.

English: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
Masaai: Torripo naa kewan te ninye amu etishirraka aany olkilikuai lang.

English: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
Masaai: Ore apa ang'orito kewan te dukuya metii hoo obo laatijing'a enkoriong; aatung'uatie pooki. Oi ake eaku meikenakini ninche ena!

English: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
Masaai: Kake eitasho Olaitoriani te nkalo ai, naaisho nanu engolon nalimunye ororei te lulung'ata, pee etum iloreren pooki aatoning, neaku aatang'adieki enkutuk o lng'atuny.

English: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Ee kaakordu Olaitoriani te ntorroni ake pooki naitajeu aaitaany ina kitoo enye e shumata metaa enenye enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Eesai.

English: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
Masaai: Iroroki Priska o Akuila o enkaji e Onesiforos.

English: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
Masaai: Etobiko Erasto te Korinto natung'uayie Trofimo emuoi te Mileto.

English: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
Masaai: Tonyuaa tasioku eton eng'or enkata e nkirobi. Kirriwaki Eibulo enkirorokino naa neijia etiu Punten o Lino o Klaudia o lalashera pooki.

English: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa Olaitoriani te nebo enkishui ino. Metaa empiris te nebo intae.

English: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
Masaai: Paulo osinka le Enkai olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo, pee eitubulaa enkirukoto e lelo gelunot le Enkai, o eng'eno naishiaakino orrekie le Enkai,

English: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
Masaai: te ilo siligi le nkishui nemeiting, oisiligie apa Enkai, nemeeta elejare ninche apa moitie;

English: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;
Masaai: ore ake pee eiririkino enkata, neibalunye ti atua ororei lenye aimunye ina likioroto naaishooki nanu mainosai te nkitanapata e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang.

English: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
Masaai: Tito aigeroki, enkerai ai nasipa ti atua enkirukoto niking'er: Meeu enitii empiris, o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa o Kristo Yesu Olaitajeunoni lang.

English: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
Masaai: Enkaraki ena apa pee aatung'uayie te Krete, pee itum aitobira mbaa naang'or, nigelu ilpayiani too nkang'itie pooki anaa enaatuutaka,

English: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
Masaai: oltung'ani lemeeta eleyiata, olee le nkitok nabo, neiruko inkera nemekurri aajo keiser aashu mening'isho.

English: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
Masaai: Amu ore olaitasheikinoni te nkaji e Nkai, naa olaisiaayiani le Enkai, meishiaakino neeta eleyiata; nchoo eaku mme ole kewan aashu olosieku engoro asioki, aashu emera, aashu arruoni aashu eeta olorok le dupoto.

English: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
Masaai: Kake aminin, olonyor esupatisho, oloata tonata, oloitoriori, sinyati neibooyo kewan.

English: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
Masaai: Neibung akurraki ilo rorei osipa anaa enaiteng'enishoteki, pee eidim ninye aishooi eutaroto ti atua ina kiteng'enare supat, neibooyo lelo ooishankarra.

English: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
Masaai: Amu etii iltung'ana kumok lemening'isho, ooata rorei le pesho, oolejisho neisul lelo ooibung mbaa e muratare.

English: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
Masaai: Meeta nchere meitigiri ninche, meitoki aaibelekeny nkajijik naalulung'a eiteng'enisho nena nemeitoriori ejo pee etumisho te ntorroni nemeeta esipata naiteng'enishore.

English: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
Masaai: Ore obo lenye maate eji laa kejo ninche oloiboni, nejo, “Lalejak oshiaake Lkrete, ilowuarak torrok, ilaikoshuaak turua!”

English: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
Masaai: Ekesipa ena shakenisho. Metaa isikong'a ninche te mpijan pee etum aataa supati te nkirukoto

English: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
Masaai: alang te nesuj nkatinin oo Lyahudi aashu nkitanapat oo ltung'ana ooany isipat.

English: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
Masaai: Ore to supat naa eisidain ntokitin pooki kake ore te ilo torrono o too lemeiruk meetae entoki sidai. Eidurukieki eng'eno enye o ltoiloishi loo ltauja lenye.

English: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
Masaai: Ejo ninche keyiolo Enkai, kake neany ninye too nkiasin enye; ilainyialak ninche, oogolong'u lemeeta tipat ti ae siaai sidai hoo nabo.

English: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
Masaai: Kake ore iyie nteng'enisho nena naaishiaakino enkiteng'enare sidai.

English: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
Masaai: Tiaki ilpayiani kituaak meiririki mbaa, nedupayu naa ng'eni, sidain te nkirukoto, te nyorrata o te nkitashoto, o te nyorrata o te ng'iriata.

English: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
Masaai: Tiaki nkituaak moruak neijia, metaa inaayanyitayu to lkuaak, nepal olmarenke nemeaku rrindiki e merai; nchoo eiteng'enisho nena sidain;

English: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
Masaai: neiteng'eni sii isiankikin metonyorra Lmoruak lenye o nkera enye,

English: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.
Masaai: neaku ng'eni neisosion, neramatisho ti ang, naa supati, nening ilpayiani lenye pee memenuni ake ororei le Enkai.

English: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
Masaai: Neijia sii nkuna tiaaki ilpayiani ooti pee eibooyo ate.

English: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
Masaai: Intoduaai kewan too mbaa pooki, niaaku enkitanyaanyukoto, oo nkiasin sidain, ore te nkiteng'enare ino ntodolu esipata o ltau o entukunyakinoto,

English: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
Masaai: o enkiroroto sidai nemeidimi aatusukeny, pee etumi aaitukurru ilo okeshisho, meeta ae torrono najo ti alo iyiook.

English: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
Masaai: Tiaki rrindiki metoning'o ilaitoriak lenye, neitiship ninche te pooki bae, nemeeta oltawalu, pee eitoduaaya esupatisho pooki,

English: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
Masaai: paa ore too mbaa pooki nejukaa enkiteng'enare e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang.

English: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
Masaai: Amu eitaliooki empiris e Enkai te nkaraki enjeunoto oo ltung'ana pooki,

English: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
Masaai: eiteng'en iyiook maibai nena pooki neme nne Enkai, o ng'uarrat e nkop, nikitoni te nkiririkinoto, te nkitorioroto o to rrekie le Enkai tena kop,

English: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;
Masaai: nikiaanyu osiligi lang omayiana, ina lotunoto e nkitoo e Enkai ang kitok o Laitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo,

English: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
Masaai: oishorua kewan te nkaraki iyiook, pee elaku iyiook aitung'uaa entorroni pooki neitisinyaki kewan iltung'ana lenyena. Lelo ooata enyuaata te nkaraki nkiasin sidain.

English: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
Masaai: Mbalunye kuna baa, nkoo ninguen te ngolon pooki. Mincho hoo obo tung'ani mikitemena.

English: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
Masaai: Ntadamu ninche metaa ilooning'isho too laitoriak nening'isho, neas pooki siaai metii esunkureisho,

English: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
Masaai: nememor likae tung'ani, nepaash olarrabal, neaku loobor, neitoduaaya esupatisho too ltung'ana pooki.

English: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
Masaai: Amu eikira sii apa iyiook ilmoda, nikigolong'u, neitapong'oyioki iyiook, nikiaaku rrindiki loo ng'uarrat o sikarri oo mpukunot pooki, nikinturraa nkolong'i ang te ntorroni o lom, neibayuni iyiook iltung'ana nikimbayuno iyiook maate;

English: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
Masaai: kake ore ake pee eliooyu esidano oe enyorrata e supatisho e Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang,

English: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;
Masaai: neitajeu ninye iyiook neme te nkaraki nkiasin nikitaasa iyiook ti atua esupatisho, kake te nkaraki olng'ur lenye, te nkitukuoto o enkitang'ejukoto o einoto ti atua Enkiyang'et Sinyati,

English: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
Masaai: ina natubukoko ninye iyiook te nkiputakinoto ti atua Yesu Kristo Olaitajeunoni lang,

English: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
Masaai: pee eikenaki iyiook esupatisho te mpiris enye nikiaaku ilajung'ok to siligi le nkishui oo ntarasi. Ororei osipa ele.

English: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
Masaai: Ayieu naa nimbung akurraki kuna baa, peyie aa ore looiruko Enkai nejurru aaitayiolo ate nkiasin sidain; kuna ninche sidain naata dupoto too ltung'ana.

English: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
Masaai: Kake tapaasha nchankarri, iishoritin oo lmakui, impaashat o enchankar oo mbaa oo nkitanapat, amu meeta eretoto naa pesho.

English: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
Masaai: Ore oltung'ani okepari, indipa aikoo ninye ene dukuya o eniare, talama.

English: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
Masaai: Iyiolo ajo ore oltung'ani oikununo inji netapong'ori naa aing'okoni netudung'oko kewan enkiguana.

English: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
Masaai: Te nairriu nanu Atemas aashu Tikikos meeu enitii, tonyuaa oleng, wou ene natii te Nikapolis, amu atudung'o pee aton te ine te nkata e nkirobi.

English: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
Masaai: Tonyuaa isosionie Senos, ilo loo nkitanapat o Apolos te lototo enye; nimincho eng'oriki hoo toki.

English: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
Masaai: Naa nchoo iltung'ana lang meitamoo ate nkiasin sidain, pee eretu nkolati naarrish nemeaku ilemeeta ilng'anayio.

English: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Eirriwaki intae enkirorokino kulo pooki laboitare. Iroroki lelo pooki oonyor iyiook ti atua enkirukoto. Metaa empiris te nebo intae pooki.

English: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
Masaai: Paulo oloena te nkaraki Yesu Kristo o Timoteo olalashe lang. Filimon king'eroki likinyor oasisho te nebo iyiook.

English: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
Masaai: O Afia enkanashe ang o Arkipos osikari te nebo iyiook, o esirit natii atua enkaji ino.

English: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Meeu empiris enitii o eseriani eing'uaa Enkai Papa lang o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo.

English: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
Masaai: Aisho Enkai ai enashe te naadamu iyie te nkomono ai,

English: Hearing of thy love and faith, which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all saints;
Masaai: amu aning'ito enyorrata ino o enkirukoto niaata ti alo Olaitoriani Yesu o lelo sinyat,

English: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus.
Masaai: naomon pee aa ore ing'arie ilkulikae enkirukoto ino, neitubulaa eyiolounoto enena pooki supati naara nkunaang ti atua Kristo.

English: For we have great joy and consolation in thy love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by thee, brother.
Masaai: Amu anoto nanu eng'ida sapuk o enkilejilejata naayaka enyorrata ino, olalashe lai, amu eitagoloki iltauja loo sinyat te nkaraki iyie.

English: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient,
Masaai: Ore etiu neijia, hoo naaitieu ti atua Kristo aaitanap taasa ina naishiaakino,

English: Yet for love's sake I rather beseech thee, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Kake ore te nkaraki enyorrata nayieu naasai nanu Paulo, Olkilikuai lo Laitoriani naena taata te nkaraki Kristo Yesu

English: I beseech thee for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
Masaai: aasai nanu iyie te nkaraki enkerai ai Onesimas, lataa nanu menye ti atua eenata ai.

English: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
Masaai: (Ore apa te dukuya naa pesho ninye te iyie, kake ore taata netaa ole tipat oleng, te iyie o te nanu.)

English: Whom I have sent again: thou therefore receive him, that is, mine own bowels:
Masaai: Naa airriu nanu ninye metushukunye enitii, airriu oltau lai kewan.

English: Whom I would have retained with me, that in thy stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
Masaai: Kayieu naaji naa kaiboo maataboitare, peyie aatum aisiaayia te rishata ino, te enata ai te nkaraki Ororei Supat;

English: But without thy mind would I do nothing; that thy benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
Masaai: kake atejo maas toki eitu atum ewalata ino pee metiu esupatisho ino anaa earakinoto kake pee eaku eyieunoto ino makewan.

English: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
Masaai: Ebaiki naa ina apa pee kintung'uayioki ninye te nkiti kata, pee kintokini aaitaboitaki ntarasi,

English: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto thee, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
Masaai: meekure aa orrindik, kake etuluso alang orrindik, etaa olalashe onyorri, eisulaki te nanu kake eisul naa oleng te iyie, te pokira are to sesen o to Laitoriani.

English: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
Masaai: Metaa te naa eikinken ajo kira nabo, tang'amu ninye anaa naaji eniking'amu nanu.

English: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
Masaai: Te nikinyala apa ninye ti ae bae aashu te neeta esile ino e ae toki, nchoo eaku esile ai.

English: I Paul have written it with mine own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to thee how thou owest unto me even thine own self besides.
Masaai: Nanu Paulo, oigero ena te nkaina ai makewan, ekalak nemaimaki esile nikiaatayie nanu ebaiki kewan ino.

English: Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
Masaai: Ee, olalashe kayieu nanu dupoto te iyie ti atua Olaitoriani. Entagolo oltau lai ti atua Kristo.

English: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
Masaai: Ore amu kaaisilig ajo ining'isho, aaigeroki kuna ayiolo ajo ias oleng aitulus enatejo.

English: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
Masaai: Ore te nebo nena, intobirakaki olgilata loo lomon, amu aisilig ajo ore te nkaraki enkomono inyi naa kaaishori nanu maeu enitii intae.

English: There salute thee Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus;
Masaai: Kirriwaki enkirorokino Epafras, ilo o ena te nebo nanu te nkaraki Kristo Yesu.

English: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
Masaai: Naa neijia etiu Marko, o Aristakos o Demas o Luka ooasisho tenebo nanu.

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani Yesu Kristo te nebo enkiyang'et inyi.

English: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
Masaai: Eirorie apa Enkai iloo papa too nkoitoi kumok o too mpukunot kumok too loibonok le Enkai;

English: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
Masaai: kake ore te kuna olong'i naabayie neirorie iyiook to Inoti otegelua ninye metaa olajung'oni loo ntokitin pooki, olaa te ninye eitayioki enkop.

English: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
Masaai: Ninye oitodolu enatiu enkisisa e Enkai naa ninye otaa olmishire le naikununo Enkai, naa ninye oibung'ita shumata o enkop to rorei le ngolon enye. Ore apa pee eidip aitobira enkipooto oo ng'ok, neton te tatene e Nkitoo te shumata.

English: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
Masaai: Eidipa ninye aisula ilmalaika amu ore enkarna nanoto naa ninye nalusoo te nenye.

English: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
Masaai: Amu kalo malaika etiaaka Enkai ae kata nchere, “Ira iyie Oinoti lai latoiwuo te le kekun?” Aashu sii, “Kaaku nanu menye lenye, neaku ninye Oinoti lai?”

English: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of God worship him.
Masaai: O sii, pee eyau olkikau lenye enkop nejo, “Inchoo eserem ninye ilmalaika pooki le Enkai.”

English: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
Masaai: Ore ti alo ilmalaika nejo ninye, “Oloitaa ilmalaika lenyena isiwuon, neitaa isinkan lenyena ilng'ejepa le nkima.”

English: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
Masaai: Kake etejo ti alo Oinoti lenye, “Ore olorika lino, iyie Enkai naa oloo ntarasi o ntarasi orinka le supatisho ilo rinka le nkitoria ino.

English: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
Masaai: Itonyorra iyie esupatisho nimbayu engogong'i ore enkaraki ina nikitubukoko Enkai ino eilata aput, nikiela te ilata e ng'ida nalang ene sirit ino.”

English: And, Thou, Lord, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
Masaai: Ore sii, “Iyie, Olaitoriani, oitobira enkop te nkiterunoto, ore shumata naa esiaai oo nkaik inono.

English: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
Masaai: Keishari ninche, kake ibik ake iyie, kemusanu ninche, kake ibik ake iyie, kemusanu ninche anaa enkila,

English: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
Masaai: naa iyie oyooki apiyai ninche anaa enkila neibelekenya ninche. Kake itiu iyie anaa apake, nemeishunye ilarin linono ntarasi.”

English: But to which of the angels said he at any times, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
Masaai: Kake kalo malaika etiaaka ae kata, “Totona te nkaina ai e tatene, o metaba anaa naitaa ilmang'ati linono olorika loo nkejek inono?”

English: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
Masaai: Aime nkiyang'eta aisiaayiak ake ninche pooki naairriwayioki meisiaaisho, te nkaraki lelo ootum enjeunoto?

English: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina keishiaakino nikirrip nena nikitoning'o oleng, pee mikipaashare ake.

English: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
Masaai: Amu amaa te na keewuo olkilikuai apa otolimutuo ilmalaika neaku ore engilata enye aashu eanyata netum enkitamioto,

English: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
Masaai: kaji kijeunye iyiook ti nikintololoiki enjeunoto kitok naba inji? Olaitoriani otang'asa alimu te dukuya, neetuo aaishakenoki ti alo iyiook lelo apa ootoning'o ninye.

English: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
Masaai: Neishakenoko sii ninye Enkai too lmonek o too mbaa e nking'asia o too mpukunot kumok e nking'asia o too nkishorunot e Nkiyang'et Sinyati naori te risioroto e yieuna enye.

English: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
Masaai: Amu mme lmalaika eishoo Enkai meitoria enkop nalotu, naa ninye ena nikiimaki.

English: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
Masaai: Eishakenoki aajo te dikae, “Ainyoo ninye oltung'ani linkenaa iyie, anaa enkerai e tung'ani niramat iyie?

English: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
Masaai: Iyie oitadowuo ninye te nkiti rishata meeu abori lmalaika, naa iyie oishoo olmarisian le nkitoo o enkanyit,

English: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
Masaai: nintadowuo pooki toki meeu abori nkejek enyena.” Netipika pooki toki abori enkitoria enye, nemeetae ae toki natelekua nemeitore ninye. Ore anaa enatiu, eton mikidol iyiook pooki toki, tiabori enkitoria enye.

English: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
Masaai: Kake kidolita Yesu, otang'asaki aaitadou te nkiti rishata metadou abori ilmalaika, neishooki enkopiyia e nkitoo o enkanyit te nkaraki emion enye e nkeeya, peyie aa te mpiris e Enkai eishiamishama ninye enkeeya te rishata e pooki ng'ae.

English: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
Masaai: Amu ninye apa eiririkino, olaa nkunenyena naa ninye pee eetae ntokitin pooki, ore pee etumoki ninye atorikoki inkera kumok enkitoo neiteraka emion neitaa bayarot ilo oipirua enjeunoto enye te mion o larikoni.

English: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
Masaai: Amu ore ilo oitisinyi o lelo ooitisinyi nebo eing'uaa pooki. Naa ina pee mekurru ninye ejo ninche ilalashera

English: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
Masaai: ejo, “Kaliki lalashera laainei enkarna ino, naaisis iyie te mpolos e umata.”

English: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
Masaai: Nejo sii, “Ekapik nanu osiligi lai atua ninye” neigil ake ajo, “Nele nanu o nena kera naaishoo nanu Enkai.”

English: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
Masaai: Ore naa enkaraki nang'ar nkera nkiri o sarge, etang'arie sii ninye makewan ina pukunoto, paa te keeya etum ninye aitarruoi ilo oata engolon e nkeeya, aa ninye Sheitani,

English: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
Masaai: netum atokordu lelo pooki ooena te nkishui enye pooki enkaraki naure enkeeya.

English: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
Masaai: Amu esipa nchere mme lmalaika doi eimaki kake eishoi e Abraham.

English: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
Masaai: Enkaraki e ina pee eishooki metotiwuo anaa lalashera lenyena too mpukunot pooki, pee etum ataa olapolosani oata olng'ur neisiligayu te siaai e Enkai, netum aitayu enkitukuoroto oo ng'ok oo ltung'ana.

English: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
Masaai: Amu ore enkaraki natamio ninye makewan netetemaki, ekeidim ninye atareto lelo ootemi.

English: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nena, lo alashera sinyat, oong'ar enkipototo e shumata, entadamu Yesu, olkipaaret naa olapolosani kitok le na limunoto ang.

English: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
Masaai: Etaa ninye oloisiligayu ti alo ilo otegelua ninye, anaa apa sii ninye Musa otaa oloisiligayu ti atua enkaji e Enkai.

English: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
Masaai: Kake ore ninye Yesu neikenakaki nchere keiririkino enkitoo nalang ene Musa anaa te neeta oloshetu enkaji enkitoo nalang ene nkaji.

English: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God.
Masaai: Amu eeta ake enkaji pooki oloteshetua kake Enkai olashetani loo ntokitin pooki.

English: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
Masaai: Etaa apa Musa oloisiligayu, anaa olaisiaayiani te pooki naatii enkaji e Nkai, pee eishakenoki mbaa naanyaakaki aalimu te siadi.

English: But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
Masaai: Kake ore Kristo netaa oloisiligayu te nkaji e Enkai anaa Oinoti. Nikira iyiook enkaji enye ti nikimbung aakurraki empijan ang o lwuasa ti atua ilo siligi lang.

English: Wherefore (as the Holy Ghost saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
Masaai: Ore nkaraki ina, anaa enajo Enkiyang'et Sinyati, “Ore taata ena olong, ti nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye,

English: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
Masaai: emintagol iltauja linyi anaa te napa gogong'i, te napa olong e ntemata ti ong'ata,

English: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
Masaai: peyie atem iloo minyi, nedol isiaaitin aainei too larin artam.

English: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki naaitagoro ilo porror, najo, ‘Kepaashari oshi ake ninche ti atua iltauja lenye; neitu ae kata eyiolou nkoitoi aainei.’

English: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
Masaai: Ore anaa enainosa olmumai te ngoro ai, ‘Mejing ae kata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.’ ”

English: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
Masaai: Entodol ate, lo alashera, pee metii ake atua intae likae linyi lo ltau torrono, lemeiruk, orik intae nesulaa neitapaash Enkai naishu.

English: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
Masaai: Kake entaretunoto anaa ake, anaa neton ejoitoi, “taata ena olong,” pee megolu likae linyi lukunya te nkaraki elejaroto oo ng'ok.

English: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
Masaai: Amu Kristo king'ar iyiook, te nesipa kikurraki aaibung empijan ang o meiting'o,

English: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
Masaai: eton ejoitoi, “Ore taata ena olong, ti nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye, emintagol iltauja linyi anaa te napa gogong'i.”

English: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
Masaai: Kakua apa lelo ootoning'o neitoki aagolong'aki? Aime lapa pooki ootung'uaitie Misiri ootorikuo Musa?

English: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
Masaai: Naa kakua etagorokine ninye too larin artam? Aime lelo ootaasa ng'ok, ooitanang'a seseni lenye ilo purkel?

English: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
Masaai: Naa kakua einosaka olmumai ajo, mejing enkiyeng'iyeng'ata enye ntarasi, ei kulikae leme lelo ootogolong'akita?

English: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
Masaai: Neaku kidol aajo eitu eidim ninche aatijing ine te nkaraki neitu eiruk.

English: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina, ore eton eetae enkisiligata najing'ieki nkiyeng'iyeng'ata enye, ematureita pee meiguanareki ake likae linyi neji eturua ebaiki.

English: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
Masaai: Amu etabaikita iyiook lelo omon supati anaa enatabaikita sii ninche; kake ore ilo kilikuai otoning'o ninche neitu eret, amu eitu einepu enkirukoto ti atua lelo ootoning'o.

English: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
Masaai: Amu iyiook ilooiruko oojing ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaa ina natejo ninye eji, “Anaa enainosa olmumai ti atua engoro ai nchere, ‘Mejing aekata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai ntarasi.’ ” Hoo neidipate isiaaitin enyena ebaiki apake pee eitamanyu enkop.

English: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
Masaai: Amu eimaka enkolong e naapishana te dikae nejo nji, “Neyeng'iyeng'a Enkai te nkolong e naapishana eidipa isiaaitin enyena pooki.”

English: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
Masaai: Nenyaaka ake ajo te ine wueji, “Mejing aekata ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata ai.”

English: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
Masaai: Ore naa amu etiooyo pee ejing kulikae ine, ore lelo ootang'amutua lelo omon supati neitu ninche ejing te nkaraki eitu eiruk,

English: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
Masaai: enyaaka naa apik ae olong, “Taata” ena olong etejo te Daudi etulusoyie enkata naado, te lelo rorei ooidipaki aairoro, “Ore taata ena olong ti nining'ining'i oltoilo lenye, emintagol iltauja linyi.”

English: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
Masaai: Amu te naa keidipa apa Yoshua aishoo ninche enkiyeng'iyeng'ata, anaata eitu eitoki Enkai aimaki ae olong.

English: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
Masaai: Neaku eton ake eetae enkiyeng'iyeng'ata e sabato oo ltung'ana le Enkai;

English: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as God did from his.
Masaai: amu ore pooki ng'ae, ojing enkiyeng'iyeng'ata e Enkai nepal sii ninye isiaaitin enyena anaa enatapala Enkai nkunenyena.

English: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
Masaai: Ematonyok naa pee kijing ina kiyeng'iyeng'ata, pee mebatata hoo obo te ngolong'u neeijo ina apa enye.

English: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
Masaai: Amu keishu ororei le Enkai neeta engolon, nepi ninye alang olalem ake pooki opi mbat pokira, neimisho enarish oltau o enkiyang'et, neim irubat o ntolo, neyiolou ndamunot o nkiguanat o ltau.

English: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
