Masaai: Ore enkisampuare e supatisho neun ti atua osotua lelo ooitayu osotua.

English: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
Masaai: Ainyoo nayau injorin, ainyioo nayau ilarrabali ti atua intae? Aime ng'uarrat inyi naara ti atua intae?

English: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
Masaai: Iyieuwu nimitumutumu; ina pee, iariara metuata. Ning'uarring'uarra, nimindimidimi aanoto naa ina pee iarara nidumumu enjore. Miaatata toki amu miomonunu.

English: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
Masaai: Iomonunu intae nimitumutumu, amu iomonunu te nkoitoi torrono, pee itumokiki aaishang'itie too ng'uarrat oo seseni linyi.

English: Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.
Masaai: Intae iloololoito too ltauja, aimiyiololo aajo ore olchore le nkop naa olmang'atinta te Enkai? Ore pooki oyieu neaku olchore le nkop, neitaa kewan olmang'atinta le Enkai.

English: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
Masaai: Anaa aijojo keiroro ene mesipa isirat ootejo, “Ore ina kiyang'et natipika Enkai atua iyiook keeta olom too nguarrat o sesen?”

English: But he giveth more grace. Wherefore he saith, God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble.
Masaai: Kake eisho empiris nalus, amu ejo isirat, “Eany Enkai iloowuasa neisho empiris iloobor.”

English: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Masaai: Entoning naa Enkai, erisha oloirirua, naa keipirri ninye ailany intae.

English: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
Masaai: Entinyikaki, pee enyikaki sii ninye intae. Entukuo inkaik inyi, intae ilaing'okok, nintukuku iltauja linyi, intae iloo bukaasha.

English: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
Masaai: Esinanuoto, ninchirishiri, niyietutu aaishir. Enchoo enkuenia inyi metawalayu aaku enkishirata neaku eng'ida inyi enkimuntut.

English: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
Masaai: Entadou ate te dukuya Olaitoriani, pee eilepie ninye intae.

English: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
Masaai: Emisukenya maate ilalashera laainei, amu ore ilo osukeny olalashe lenye anaa eiguanare olalashe lenye, inkitanapat esukeny, aa ninche eiguanare. Amu te ninguanare inkitanapat, nimira naa olaibung'ani loo nkitanapat, kake itaa oloiguanare.

English: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?
Masaai: Obo ake olaishooroni loo nkitanapat o ladung'oni le nkiguana naa ninye oidim aitajeu anaa aitarruoi. Aira iyie ng'ae oiguanare olelatia ino?

English: Go to now, ye that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
Masaai: Entoning naa lelo oojo, “Kipuo taata anaa taaisere atua enkanasa naje o enaje nikibik te ine olari obo nikimirisho, nikitum dupoto.”

English: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appeareth for a little time, and then vanisheth away.
Masaai: Nimiyiololo enayooki atiu taaisere; anaa ainyioo enkishon inyi? Itiuwu ake anaa enkinuku naliooyu enkiti kata, kiti neishunye.

English: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
Masaai: Ore enaishiaakino te nijojo. “Naa inchere te neyieu Olaitoriani, nikinchu nikiaas ena anaa enda.”

English: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
Masaai: Kake ore eyia, isisisisi ate to lwuasa. Ore ina kinosata e kutuk pooki, entorroni.

English: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiyiolo ataasa esidai, nemeas, naa eng'oki te ninye.

English: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
Masaai: Aiyia naa, lo karsisi, enchira nibuakibuaka amu kelotu shumata intae osina.

English: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
Masaai: Netupurdate imasaa inyi, neinosa olasai inkilani inyi.

English: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
Masaai: Ore sahabu inyi o nkoshola inyi etodoro einosa enkop, ore ina doron e nkinosata e nkop neaku olmonekie te intae naa kenya inkiri oo seseni linyi anaa enkima. Irragie olchumati loo masaa too nkolong'i e nkiting'oto.

English: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ore olekoisiaayio loo laisiaayiak ootudung'o inkurman, litomito too losekin, etabuaa aishir, netabaikia olkiyioi loo laisiaayiak inkiyiaa o Laitoriani loo lororani.

English: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
Masaai: Inosa intae olkar te nkop, nitonini ti atua inaaitiship osesen, nintotiti iltauja linyi te nkolong e yieng'are.

English: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
Masaai: Itudung'okito enkiguana niaariara metua oltung'ani supat lemeirish ninye intae.

English: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
Masaai: Enting'iria, intae ilalashera; o metabau elotunoto o Laitoriani. Eng'ura eanyu olaturoni le nkurma ilng'anayio sidain le nkop. Neng'iri o metaba anaa netum enchan e dukuya o ene siadi.

English: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
Masaai: Enting'iria sii intae. Entagolo ltauja linyi, amu etinyikua elotunoto o Laitoriani.

English: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
Masaai: Eming'unyung'unyakino, ilalashera laainei pee meiguanareki ake intae, eng'urai eitashe Oladung'oni le nkiguana too nkutukie oo nkajijik.

English: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
Masaai: Entusuj, ilalashera laainei enkitanyaanyukoto o sina o eng'iriata oo loibonok le Enkai ooiroro te nkarna o Laitoriani.

English: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
Masaai: Eng'urai, kijo emayiana lelo oongiri. Itoning'o eng'iriata e Yoab, nitoduaa enaitaasa Olaitoriani ninye te nkiting'oto, amu kenana Olaitoriani enkoshoke neeta olng'ur.

English: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
Masaai: Kake ore enalang pooki, ilalashera laainei eminya olmumai te shumata anaa te nkop, anaa ti ae ake ninye toki, enchoo “ee” inyi metaa “ee” ake, ore “A'a” neaku “A'a” ake, pee mijing'ijing'i ake abori enkiguana.

English: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
Masaai: Ketii obo ti atua intae oata enyamali? Inchoo eomon. Ketii oloshipa? Inchoo erany isinkoliotin le nkisisa.

English: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
Masaai: Ketii obo ti atua intae omuoi Inchoo eipot ninye ilpayiani le sirit pee eomonoki, neelie ninye eilata te nkarna o Laitoriani;

English: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
Masaai: naa keitajeu enkomono e nkirukoto ilo tung'ani omuoi, neinyeyie Olaitoriani ninye, naa te netaasa ng'ok, nepalakini.

English: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
Masaai: Metaa, embalakinoto ng'ok inyi maate, niomonokinono, pee eishiunyieki intae. Amu eeta enkomono o ltung'ani supat enkidimata sapuk.

English: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
Masaai: Ore Eliya, oltung'ani apake le mpukunoto ang. Netoomono ekurraki pee mesha; neitu eshaiki enchan enkop too larin okuni o lapaitin ile.

English: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
Masaai: Neitoki ake aomon, neishoru shumata enchan, neiu enkop ilng'anayio lenyena.

English: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
Masaai: Ilalashera laainei te neibakibak obo linyi aing'uaa esipata, neshuku likae ninye,

English: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
Masaai: nincho ninye metaiyiolo inchere ore pooki oshuku olaasani loo ng'ok aitung'uaa enkoitoi enye e marmalisho, eitajewuo oltau lenye te nkeeya neitoipoo olorora loo ng'ok.

English: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
Masaai: Petero, olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo, enetii ilaisikak oo idapashaki Ponto, o Galatia, o Kapodokia, o Asia o Bitinia.

English: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
Masaai: Ootegeluaki apa neitaanya Enkai Papa te Nkiyang'et metoning'o Yesu Kristo te nkisuaakinoto o sarge lenye. Metoponari ti atua intae empiris o eseriani.

English: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
Masaai: Meisisi Enkai naa Papa lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, laa te nkaraki olng'ur lenye sapuk eishoo iyiook metoini aaigil ti atua osiligi oishu te mpiunoto e Yesu Kristo aing'uaa lootuata,

English: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
Masaai: pee kitum enjung'ore nemerruoyo, nemeiduruk, nememusanu naiteng'elaki te shumata te nkaraki intae.

English: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Masaai: Oorripi te ngolon e Enkai te nkaraki enkirukoto inyi, pee itumutumu enjeunoto nairragita ake pee eibalunyieki te nkolong e nkiting'oto.

English: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
Masaai: Entishipata te nkaraki ina hoo ninye, te naa aimeeta inchere pee mitumutumu intemat oo mpukunot kumok te nkiti kata,

English: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
Masaai: ore pee etiu inji enkirukoto inyi eji pee etemi nenyorrarri aajo eeta tipat alang sahabu narruoyo netetemaki te nkima nitumutumu enkisisa, o enkitoo o enkanyit te mbolunoto e Yesu Kristo.

English: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
Masaai: Oleitu idolidolo, ninyorrinyorro ninye, nirukuruku hoo nimidolitata ninye taata, nishipapa, enchipai nemeimakinoyu ebore enkisisa.

English: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
Masaai: Ning'amumu te nkiting'oto e nkirukoto inyi, enjeunoto oo ltauja linyi.

English: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
Masaai: Ena jeunoto apa eing'orutua, neikeni iloibonok le Nkai ooibonutuo empiris nalotu aaku eninyi.

English: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
Masaai: Etakekenutuo aajo kalo tung'ani naa kaa kata etuutua Enkiyang'et e Kristo natii atua ninche, ina kata apa namurutoo aalimu inkisilisilot e Kristo o enkitoo nasuju.

English: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
Masaai: Etabolokoki ninche metayiolo, inchere imme ate eisiaayiaki te nena kake intae, nena baa naainosakaki intae taata lelo oolikioo ilomon supati te ngolon e Nkiyang'et Sinyati nairriwuaki eing'uaa shumata naa imbaa naang'uar apa ilmalaika pee edol.

English: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
Masaai: Ore naa entirrisha ndamunot inyi, eririki mbaa nipikipiki osiligi linyi pooki shumata empiris nayakini intae te mbolunoto e Yesu Kristo.

English: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
Masaai: Anaa inkera naaning'isho, eminturubare inapa ng'uarrat niaatata enapa kata imodada.

English: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
Masaai: Kake ore anaa sinyati ilo oipoto intae entaa sii intae sinyat to lkuaak linyi pooki.

English: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
Masaai: Amu etisiraki aajo, “Entaa intae sinyat, amu ara Nanu Sinyati.”

English: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man's work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
Masaai: Naa te naa aimpotipoto ninye aajo Papa, ilo oiguenare pooki tung'ani metii enyorrakinoto eng'ura ate entotoni te nkuretisho tena rishata nitii ene anaa nkisikat.

English: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo, etalakuaki intae too rrekiei linyi lemeeta tipat litujung'utuo too loo papaai linyi, mme too ntokitin naaruoyo anaa enkosholai o sahabu

English: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
Masaai: kake to sarge ogol enkinyiang'a le Kristo, otiu anaa olkuoo lemeeta entiyoto anaa entibili.

English: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
Masaai: Oloitaanyitai apa eton eitu eitamanyuni enkop, kake eibalunyieki te nkiting'oto oo nkatitin te nkaraki inyi,

English: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
Masaai: naa te ninye ing'idarere intae Enkai, ilo oitopiwuo ninye aitung'uaa ilootuata, neisho ninye enkitoo paa ore enkirukoto o siligi linyi naa atua Enkai etii.

English: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
Masaai: Ore enkaraki nindipa aaitukuo iltauja linyi te nkibung'ata oo sipat, niaatata enyorrata nemetii esunkureisho too lalashera linyi, entonyorrata intae maate aakurraki too ltauja.

English: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
Masaai: Etoiwuoki intae aaigil neme te mpeu narruoyo kake te nemerruoyo, kake to rorei le Enkai oishu nebik intarasi.

English: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
Masaai: Amu “Etiu iseseni anaa nkujit, netiu enkitoo enye pooki anaa ene ntapukai oo nkujit. Etoyu inkujit, nedoiyio entapukai;

English: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
Masaai: kake ebik ororei lo Laitoriani intarasi.” Ore ilo rorei naa kuldo omon supati ooinosakaki intae.

English: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
Masaai: Enturrai elap pooki, o losek, o esunkureisho o esukeny pooki, nitiuwu anaa inkera naanana,

English: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
Masaai: entang'uar ororei le Nkiyang'et nemeeta olosek, paa te ninye ibululu aabaiki enjeunoto.

English: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
Masaai: Amu inchiamishama enanai e oshoke o Laitoriani.

English: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
Masaai: Wootu enetii ninye, osoit otanyaita iltung'ana, kake etegeluaki, neeta tipat too nkonyek e Enkai.

English: Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Anaa isoito ooishu, pee iakuku inkasisin e mumuaisho sinyati ooitayu ilasarri sinyat le Nkiyang'et oong'uarrayu te Enkai te Yesu Kristo.

English: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded.
Masaai: Amu etisiraki ti atua Ilkigerot aajo, “Ng'ura airragie te Sion Osoit kitok lo lmairroto, ogeluno negol enkinyiang'a, ore pooki oiruk nemeitukurruni.”

English: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
Masaai: Ore te intae ilooiruk keeta tipat oleng, kake ore te lelo lemeiruk, etaa “Ilo soit otanyaita ilashetak otaa kitok to lmairroto”

English: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
Masaai: naa “Osoit orror iltung'ana, osoit sapuk obatat iltung'ana,” errorro ninche amu etanyaita ening ororei, naa ina apake eitaanyaki ninche.

English: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
Masaai: Irara intae olorere ogeluno, inkasisin e nkaji e nkitoo, olorere sinyati, iltung'ana le Enkai makewan, pee itumutumu aainosai inkiaasin enyena e nking'asia, oloipotuo intae entung'uai enaimin aitijing atua ewang'an enye naing'asiasho.

English: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
Masaai: Intae ilemera olorere apa; kake irara taata olorere le Enkai Ileitu apa etum olng'ur kake itang'amutua olng'ur.

English: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei asai intae, anaa ilomon o laisikak pee ipaasharere ing'uarrat o sesen naashet enjore naarare iltauja linyi.

English: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
Masaai: Niaakuku ilooata orrekie sidai ti atua Loreren lemeiruk, pee te neiro neiteleiki intae mbaa anaa laasak loo ntorrok, neidim te nedol too nkiasin inyi sidain, aaisisa Enkai te nkolong e muta.

English: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
Masaai: Eyanyita pooki kitoria oo ltung'ana to lbae lo Laitoriani, te naa ko laiguanani kitok,

English: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
Masaai: anaa ilooti te ninye ooirriwuaki meitamio lelo ooas intorrok neisis lelo ooas isidain.

English: For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
Masaai: Amu eyieunoto e Enkai inchere ore te yasata oo sidain nintigiriri emodai oo ltung'ana oomoda.

English: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of God.
Masaai: Entotoni anaa iltung'ana oolakuno, nimintaa elakunoto inyi entoki nintiemorierie entorroni, kake entobik anaa ilaisiaayiak le Enkai.

English: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honour the king.
Masaai: Eyanyita iltung'ana pooki, entonyor ilalashera, entureita olaiguanani kitok.

English: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
Masaai: Lo aisiaayiak entadou ate, niyanyititi oleng ilaitoriak linyi, neme ake isupati nebor, kake o metabaiki lelo ooisomit intae.

English: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
Masaai: Amu keishori oltung'ani enchunet te naa, ore nkaraki nadamu Enkai neng'iri te neidong'i metii esipata.

English: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.
Masaai: Amu kaa dupoto ina, te neitamei intae enkata niaasiasa intorrok? Kake te niaasiasa isupati, ning'iriri te neisilisili intae niaatata enchunet te Enkai.

English: For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:
Masaai: Amu te ina eipotoki intae, amu eisilisiloki sii ninye Kristo te nkaraki intae, neing'ueki intae enkitanyaanyukoto, pee isujusuju iroruat enyena.

English: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
Masaai: Eitu eas ninye eng'oki, neitu etumieki te nkutuk enye ororei lo losek laa ore pee emori,

English: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:
Masaai: neitu eshukoki emorisho, ore pee e isilisili neitu ejo aarisho, kake eitarasaka imbaa enyena pooki ilo oiguenare te sipata.

English: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes ye were healed.
Masaai: Ninye makewan otanapa ing'ok ang to sesen lenye te shumata olchani, pee kitum aatuata too ng'ok, neaku aikinchu too supati, too lbaa lenyena eishiunyieki intae.

English: For ye were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
Masaai: Amu itapong'ori anaa intare naaimina, kake itorrinyokinote taata Olchekut naa Olaing'urani loo ltauja linyi.

English: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
Masaai: Neijia entotiu sii intae, na kituaak entadou ate too lpayiani paa te netii te ninche olemeiruk Ororei, netumi aateyietu metii ororei te nkaraki olkuaak loo nkituaak enye,

English: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
Masaai: te nkaraki nadol ninche olkuaak linyi sidai, le nkuretisho.

English: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
Masaai: Eminchosho eaku enkuso inyi enioriong osesen, o enchetata oo lpapit, o enkikodo oo ntokitin e sahabu anaa ene nkishopoto o nkilani,

English: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
Masaai: kake enaisudoro ti atua oltau, nememuta o emborron o engira, neeta tipat oleng too nkonyek e Enkai.

English: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
Masaai: Amu neijia ti apa eikuna inkituaak sinyat, naaisilig Enkai te nekus ate, aaning ilmoruak lenye.

English: Even as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
Masaai: Anaa enatoning'o Sara Abraham pee eipot ninye ajo laaitore lai. Nitaa intae inkera enyena, ti niaasiasa esidai, niminchosho toki meituria intae.

English: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
Masaai: Entotiu sii intae neijia lo payiani, entotoni o nkituaak inyi te ng'eno, nincho enkitok inaairirikino anaa entoki nashal, amu irara ilajung'ok te nebo le mpiris e mpuaan pee meiboori enkomono inyi.

English: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
Masaai: Ore enabayie entaa pooki ilooata endamunoto nabo, loobore olng'ur o enyorrata oo lalashera, iloonana oishuaa, iloobor indamunot.

English: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
Masaai: Neme iloolaakino entorroni te ntorroni, anaa oldeket to ldeket, kake entapaashare intae entamayianisho, amu te ina doi eipotoki intae pee itumutumu aatujung emayianata.

English: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
Masaai: Amu ejo ilkigerot “Ore ilo onyor enkishui neyieu nedol inkolong'i sidain, inchoo erishie olng'ejep lenye entorroni nerishie enkutuk enye pee mejo emonkoi.

English: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
Masaai: Inchoo eibelekenya apaashare entorroni neas esidai; inchoo eing'oru eseriani nesuj oleng.

English: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
Masaai: Amu etii inkonyek o Laitoriani shumata oo supati, nebolo inkiyiaa enyena te enkomono enye; kake egilunore enkomom o Laitoriani lelo ooas intorrok.”

English: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
Masaai: Kaing'ae oidim aitaasa intae entorrono, te naa airara intae ilanyuaak le nena sidain?

English: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
Masaai: Kake te naa keisilisili hoo ninye intae te nkaraki oo supati, nimayianana. Emiureyu ninche, nimiruturutu.

English: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
Masaai: Kake ore too ltauja linyi eyanyita Kristo anaa Olaitoriani, enterretenata anaake pee iwalikiki oltung'ani pooki oikilikuan intae olbae lo siligi otii atua intae. Kake te mborron o te nkanyit.

English: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
Masaai: Entisidana iltauja linyi, paa ore enkata nasukeny olkuaak linyi sidai ti atua Kristo, netumi aaitukurru.

English: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
Masaai: Amu enaikash te neitamei oltung'ani easita isupati te naa eyieunoto e Enkai, alang te naa intorrok.

English: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
Masaai: Amu etua sii Kristo nabo kata ake too ng'ok nemeigil, osupat too leme supati, pee etum atoriku iyiook enetii Enkai. Amu etaraki metua to sesen neitopiwuoki te Nkiyang'et

English: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
Masaai: te ninye sii eshomo ainosaki ilomon nkiyang'eta naaena.

English: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
Masaai: Lelo apa moitie ootanyaita ening, eton eanyisho eng'iriata e Enkai too nkolong'i e Noa eshetita emeli, ina naa ilkuti tung'ana isiet ake eitajewuoki te nkare.

English: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Naa enkare e nkibatisata naitajeunyeki ina, neme te nkisujata o loirerio lo sesen, kake enchirrakinoto e Enkai to ltoilo oisiasha lo ltau te mpiunoto e Yesu Kristo,

English: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
Masaai: oilepa alo shumata, neton te nkaina e tatene e Enkai, netipikaki te nebo ilmalaika, o enkitoria e ngolon meetu abori ninye.

English: Forasmuch then as Christ hath suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that hath suffered in the flesh hath ceased from sin;
Masaai: Ore naa te nkaraki naitamioki Kristo to sesen, enterreten sii intae ate te ina damunoto, amu ore pooki onoto emion to sesen etapala eyasata oo ng'ok,

English: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of God.
Masaai: pee meitoki ninye arubare imbaa o sesen too nkolong'i enyena naatelekutua te nkop anaa enatiu ing'uarrat oo ltung'ana kake anaa eyieunoto e Enkai.

English: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
Masaai: Nchoo enkata natulusoiyie eidip nena naayieu neas iloreren oolamita Enkai oopuoyie enkiborra oo nkonyek, o ng'uarrat e merai, ooitalala indaat, incholieki e okore, agilak loo nkitanapat oosai kulie aitin.

English: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
Masaai: Neing'asia te nedol intae mishularere ninche te nena baa e nkiminchalisho, nemor intae;

English: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
Masaai: kake epuo aaisho iwalat ilo oterretene pee eiguanare ilooishu o lootuata.

English: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to God in the spirit.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ena pee etolikioki sii ilootuata Ilomon Supati pee eiguanareki to sesen anaa iltung'ana, nepok te nkiyang'et anaa Enkai.

English: But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
Masaai: Etinyikua enkiting'oto oo ntokitin pooki, neaku enoto eng'eno oo ndamunot nauno nebor pee itumokiki enkomono.

English: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
Masaai: Ore enalusoo te pooki, embung'a enyorrata nauno olikae o likae amu eitoip enyorrata olorora loo ng'ok.

English: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
Masaai: Intoomono olikae olikae metii enking'unyung'uny.

English: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
Masaai: Taasishore inkishorot naaba anaa inikinchooki aisiaayie ilkulikae, anaa olaing'urani supat te mpiris e Enkai oo mpukunot kumok.

English: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Naa te neiro oltung'ani inchoo eiro anaa enatiu Ororei le Enkai; naa te neisiaaisho oltung'ani, inchoo eisiaaisho anaa enkidimata naishoo Enkai: pee eisiaai Enkai te pooki toki ti atua Yesu Kristo, laa enenye enkisisa, o enkitoria ntarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, eming'asia intae too ntemat naata emion e nkima naapuonu shumata intae, aatem intae anaa duoo kentoki omoni naipang'aka intae.

English: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ's sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy.
Masaai: Kake enting'idata te nkaraki ning'arierie Kristo isinaitin lenyena pee itumutumu sii intae aating'idata te ng'ida sapuk te nkata naibalieki enkisisa o enkitoo enye.

English: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
Masaai: Te naa imayianana intae te nesukenyi intae te nkaraki enkarna e Kristo, imayianana amu eton te shumata intae oltau le nkisisa e nkitoo o le Enkai.

English: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men's matters.
Masaai: Kake emincho obo te intae meitamei te nkaraki etara metua anaa olapurroni, anaa olarruoni, anaa olaisurusuroni.

English: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.
Masaai: Kake te neitamei oltung'ani, eji amu olkiristianoi, mincho edol enkurruna, kake inchoo eisis Enkai te ina arna.

English: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?
Masaai: Amu etabawua enkata e nkiguana naa te nkaji e Enkai eng'asu, amaa te naa iyiook eng'as, kaji pasa etiu enkiting'oto e kuldo lemeiruk Ororei supat le Enkai?

English: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
Masaai: Naa, “Amaa aa te mpesho eitajeuni Oltung'ani supat, ai ti aaji eliooyu oltung'ani lemeiruk Enkai naa olaasani loo ng'ok?”

English: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
Masaai: Enkaraki ena enchoo lelo pooki oomeyu te risioroto o enyorrata e Enkai, eas isupati neitarasaki iltauja lenye ilo oitayio enkop oisiligayu.

English: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
Masaai: Neaku airorie ilpayiani ootii atua intae, ara sii nanu olpayian anaa ninche nara shakeni loo nkisilisilot e Kristo Nang'arie enkitoo napuoi aabolu.

English: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
Masaai: Taramata ntare e Enkai niking'orieki, neme te arakinoto kake te nyorrata ino, neme te dupoto e nkurruna kake te yieunoto

English: Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
Masaai: neme anaa ilaitoriak ooimagarraki lelo ooishooki intae entaramat, kake aaku enkitanyaanyukoto naduaaya intare.

English: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
Masaai: Pee te neboluni ilo Shekut kitok, neishori intae enkopiyia e nkitoo e nkisisa nemeibil emua.

English: Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.
Masaai: Neijia enkuna sii intae iltung'ana leleru entoning enkitoo inyi, Enchopoki ate intae pooki emborron anaa enkila, nintadounyenye ate pee isiaayiayia maate, amu eany Enkai iloowuasa, “Kake eisho empiris ilooitadou ate.”

English: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
Masaai: Entadou naa ate ti abori enkaina nagol e Enkai, pee etum ninye ailepie intae te nkata nageluno.

English: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
Masaai: Enteleiki inkolati inyi shumata Ninye, amu kegolie Ninye intae.

English: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
Masaai: Enterretenata entashololoto. Amu emanimanaa olmang'atinta linyi, sheitani, anaa olng'atuny, oikurrukuru eing'oru olonya.

English: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
Masaai: Erisha ninye te nkirukoto nauno iyiololo aajo osina laaijo ele eimatie ilalashera linyi te nkop pooki.

English: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
Masaai: Ore pee indipidipi aanoto osina le nkiti kata, ore Enkai e mpiris pooki naa ninye naipotoko intae atua enkisisa e nkitoo enye oo ntarasi ti atua Kristo, ninye makewan oramat intae, neitirring'ie miwuatiwuatata neitopok, neitasheyie neitagol intae.

English: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa enenye enkitoo o enkitoria, intarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand.
Masaai: Te Silvano, olalashe laaijo nanu eisiligayu, atisiraka intae ena kiti palai, pee aruj intae naishakenoki intae inchere empiris e Enkai ena nasipa. Entasho emiwuatiwuata ti atua Ninye.

English: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so doth Marcus my son.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae esirit natii atua Babilion nageluno sii ninye anaa intae, neijia etiu enkerai ai Marko.

English: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
Masaai: Erorokinoto intae maate te ng'ututata e nyorrata, Metijing'a osotua intae pooki ootii atua Kristo.

English: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:
Masaai: Simon Petero osinka naa olkipaaret le Yesu Kristo, enetii lelo oonoto enkirukoto naba anaa enaang, ti atua esupatisho e Enkai ang o eno Laitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,
Masaai: Metoponari empiris o sotua te intae te yiolounoto e Enkai o Yesu o eno Laitoriani lang.

English: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
Masaai: Engolon e aisho Nkai naishoo iyiook intokitin pooki naaishiaakino te nkishon o te sinyatisho e Nkai, te yiolounoto enye ilo oipotoko iyiook enkitoo o enkikishiaan enye.

English: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
Masaai: Naa te na oitoi eishoo iyiook nkisiligat enyena e tipat naa sapuki oleng, pee ore te nkaraki nena nitumutumu aailanya errorroto natii enkop te nkaraki ing'uarrat, niaakuku ilooshulakino esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Enkai.

English: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena entipik enyuaata pooki, entoponiki eyiolounoto;

English: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
Masaai: ore eyiolounoto inyi niponikiki enkibooroto ate, ore enkibooroto e ate enkitashoto, ore enkitashoto esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Nkai.

English: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
Masaai: Ore esinyatisho e mpukunoto e Nkai entoponiki enkaripo e nyorrata too lalashera, ore enkaripo enyorrata too lalashera.

English: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Ore iyatata kuna tokitin te nkumoi nemeisho intae iliarara anaa ilauwu ilng'anayio ti atua eyiolounoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae lemeeta kuna baa naa modooni, nemedol enelakua, netorikine enkisujaroto oo ng'ok enyena musan.

English: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
Masaai: Te nkaraki ena, ilalashera. entonyok oleng entisipa enkipototo o engelunoto inyi, amu ti niaasiasa ina nimirrorrorro aekata.

English: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu te na oitoi eishori intae esipata te leng'on entijing atua enkitoria oo ntarasi o Laitoriani lang naa Olaitajeunoni Yesu Kristo.

English: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ena ayieuta oshiaake naitadamu intae kuna baa, hoo ninye te naa aindipa aatayiolo, nintirring'ang'a ti atua isipat naatii atua intae.

English: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
Masaai: Adol ajo eitoriori, eton atii ele ng'obor te nkop, te nainyeiyie intae te nkoitoi e nkitadamunoto,

English: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.
Masaai: amu ayiolo ajo, asioki airragie osesen lai le nkop, anaa enaitoduaa Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
Masaai: Anyok aas anaa enaidim, paa ore ninye aidipa ashomo, nindimidimi aatadamu kuna baa inkatitin pooki.

English: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
Masaai: Amu eitu kisuj iyiook inkatinin naaitobiruaki te ng'eno ina kata kintayiolo intae engolon o elotunoto o Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo, kake kira shakeni ootoduaa too nkonyek enkitoo enye e nkisisa.

English: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
Masaai: Amu ore pee eng'amu enchunet e nkisisa e nkitoo eing'uaa Enkai Papa, neewuo oltoilo enetii eing'uaa Enkitoo e nkisisa nalus, nejo, “Oinoti lai ele lanyor, natishipe oleng te ninye.”

English: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
Masaai: Kitoning'o iyiook ele toilo pee elotu eing'uaa shumata amu kiboitare apa iyiook ninye te ilo doinyo sinyati.

English: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
Masaai: Amu kiaata iyiook ilo rorei le naibon oitadedeyieki oleng nitaasa intae esidai te ning'amaa ninye anaa oltaa ooilang ewueji nemisimis o metaba naa nekenyu, neilepu olakira too ltauja linyi.

English: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
Masaai: Ore enaituruk te pooki, entayiolo ena inchere meetae enaibon o sirat nalotu ake to lbae lo ltung'ani makewan,

English: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
Masaai: amu metii ae kata enaibon naishoruaki te yieunoto o ltung'ani, kake eiroro iltung'ana sinyat ilomon le Enkai anaa enautaki Enkiyang'et Sinyati eing'uaa Enkai.

English: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
Masaai: Kake einyeito sii apa iloibonok le lejare ti atua olorere, anaa enayooki sii aainyototo ti atua ilaiteng'enak le lejare, ooyau too nkisudorot inkiteng'enat naaiminie neitarruoo, nemiki doi ninye Olaitoriani laa ninye oinyiang'ua ninche, neyaki ate enkidaaroto nasieku.

English: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
Masaai: Naa kesuj ilkumok irrekiei lenye torrok ore te nkaraki ninche nesukenyi enkoitoi oo sipat.

English: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
Masaai: Ore te nkowuarisho enye neitorogony intae too rorei loo monko, amu meiyiata enkiguana enye e opa, nemeirura erruorroto enye.

English: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
Masaai: Amu amaa te neitu eing'urrie Enkai ilmalaika apa pee eitarruoo, kake etanang'aka ninche atua enkima, meteeni too ngumot e naimin, pee eitaanyu enkiguana,

English: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
Masaai: amaa te neitu eing'urrie enapa kop musana, kake etalakua Noa eserian ilo alikioroni loo supati te nebo kulikae oopishana, pee eyau oloirrag le nkare shumata enkop oo ltung'ana torrok;

English: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
Masaai: amaa te neibelekenya inkang'itie e Sodom o Gomora metaa inkuruon, nedung'oki enkiguana neidaikie, neitaa enkitanyaanyukoto e natiu too nkolong'i naapuonu te lelo lemeure Enkai;

English: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
Masaai: naa amaa te neitajewuo Lutu supat, oitanyamala naleng orrekie lo duruk loo ltung'ani torrono,

English: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
Masaai: ebikito ti atua ninche, nemeyu oltau lenye supat too easat enye torrok oo nkolong'i pooki:

English: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
Masaai: neaku keyiolo Olaitoriani enaiko te nekordu too ntemat lelo ooure ninye, o enaiko pee eibooki enkitamioto lelo ooas intorrok o metabau ina olong e nkiguana

English: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
Masaai: neisulaki lelo oosuj ing'uarrat naaidurukie osesen nemen enkitoria. Ilootolo negogong, nemeure ninche aatamor ilo oata enkitoo le shumata,

English: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
Masaai: ore ninye ilmalaika, oo lusoo te nkidimata o te ngolon, eitu eyau enkitang'oroto e nkiguana torrono shumata ninche te dukuya Olaitoriani.

English: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
Masaai: Kake ore kulo, ootiu anaa ing'uesi nemedamisho, ooitore ing'uarrat e atua ate, ilootoiwuoki pee eibung'i neari metuata, iloomorisho too mbaa nemeyiolo, keidaikieki ninche te ina kidaaroto te nebo ninche.

English: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the daytime. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
Masaai: Netum osina torrono te nkaraki iyasat enye torrok, nedol ninche anaa olkar te nemera dama, intibil ninche o ntiyot, edaa te nkilepilep, epeipeeno enyaita osirua te nebo intae.

English: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
Masaai: Neeta nkonyek naabore eloloito, nemeraposho ae kata ing'ok nelejaa iltauja lemeuno, neeta iltauja ooitamooki ing'uarrat nemeishiaakino, Inkera o Ldeket!

English: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
Masaai: Etung'uaitie enkoitoi naitoriori, eibaabaa aasuj inkoitoi e Balaam olayioni le Beor, otonyorra dupoto naing'uaa eyasata oo ntorrok.

English: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
Masaai: Kake etabuaakaki te nkaraki natigila ninye makewan inkitanapat; airo osikiria lemeeta enkutuk to ltoilo lo ltung'ani; aibooyo oloirirua le ilo oiboni.

English: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
Masaai: Ore kulo naa inchorroi nemetii enkare, inkinukun naareu olkutati, amu ninche eitaanyaki emisimisi o lodo le nkop.

English: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
Masaai: Amu eiro ninche imbaa o lwuasa le pesho, neitasur too yieunot o sesen, o ng'uarrat torrok lelo tung'ana laa enailanyie kuldo ootoni ti atua inkitadiaat.

English: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
Masaai: Eisiligie ninche lelo elakunoto, ore ninche maate naa isinkan le ntorroni; amu ore pooki naidimu oltung'ani neaku ninye osinka le ina naidimua ninye.

English: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
Masaai: Amu amaa eidipa ailanya ilduruki le nkop te yiolounoto o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo, neitoki ake aaisho metarrueshi te ninche, neidimuni, ore imbaa enye e nkiting'oto neaku torrok te ninche oleng aalang ine dukuya.

English: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
Masaai: Amu enaikash te ninche te neitu apa eitasim aaiyiolou nkoitoi e sipata, alang teneyiolou ina oitoi, neitoki aaibelekenya aaing'uaa ina kitanapata sinyati naishooki ninche.

English: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
Masaai: Etotiwuo te ninche anaa endung'et e rashe nasipa inchere, “Eshukokino oldia irrugumat enyena,” neji sii “Naa keisuji embitir neitoki ashukokino olokidong'oi aiperipera.”

English: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
Masaai: Ena taata empalai e are nasiraki intae, ilanyor laainei, ore te pokira are natuputuo indamunot inyi nemetii enkeleekisho te nkoitoi e nkitadamunoto,

English: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
Masaai: inchere enyor nidamumu intae irorei ooiroro iloibonok sinyat le dukuya o enkitanapata o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni, oimua ilkipaareta linyi;

English: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
Masaai: entayiolo ena te dukuya inchere ore too nkolong'i e siadi kepuonu ilasukenyak te sukeny enye, oopuoyie ing'uarrat enye maate,

English: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
Masaai: neikilikuanu aajo, “Koree doi enkisiligata e lotunoto Enye? Amu ore apa ebaiki pee eirura iloo papa epuoito intokitin pooki aaikunari anaa enatiu apake te nkiterunoto pee eitaae enkop.”

English: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
Masaai: Etootikitio ninche aagiroo ena sipata, inchere to rorei le Nkai eetae shumata apa moitie o enkop naitobiraki te nkare naa enkare eitainyieki;

English: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
Masaai: naa te ninye etumutaki ina kop apa naatae aaitemoo to loirrag le nkare neidaaya.

English: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
Masaai: Naa te ilo rorei ake sii etushumaki keper taata natii o nkop aaitanyu enkima, nepali o metabaiki enkolong e nkiguana o mutata oo ltung'ana lemeure Enkai.

English: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
Masaai: Kake ore intae, ilchorueta laainei, emincho elang intae ena bae nabo, inchere ore enkolong nabo to Laitoriani netiu anaa ilarin enkalifu, ore ilarin enkalifu netiu anaa enkolong nabo.

English: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
Masaai: Meimutie Olaitoriani eitu eitabaya enkisiligata enye anaa enadamu kulikae enkimutioto, kake keng'iri te intae amu meyieu obo oimin, kake pee ebaiki pooki ng'ae enkirridunoto.

English: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
Masaai: Kake elotu enkolong o Laitoriani anaa olapurroni. Ore teina olong neishieki keper to ltoilo kitok. Ore wuejitin e shumata nepejori aaidaikie, ore enkop o pooki toki natii neishieki.

English: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
Masaai: Amaa taa te naa inji eikoni kuna tokitin pooki aaidaikie keishiaakino intae niaakuku iltung'ana ooikununo aja, to rrekie le sinyatisho o esidano e nkishiaa inyi too naaishiaakinore e Enkai?

English: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
Masaai: Iyanyitata nintasiekuku ina olong e Enkai, amu enkaraki ina pee epeji keper nesholi, ore intokitin naaitobirieki inkulie neshola te nkima.

English: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.
Masaai: Kake ore te risioroto e nkisiligata enye, kiaanyita iyiook keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk naa atua ninye emanya esupatisho.

English: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that ye look for such things, be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
Masaai: Ore enkaraki ina ilanyor amu kuna iyanyitata entonyok naa pee einepu ninye intae miaatata entibili anaa entiyoto, niserianana.

English: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you;
Masaai: Naa enkenai eng'iriata o Laitoriani lang inchere enjeunoto, neijia sii etiu olalashe lang onyorri Paulo etisiraka risioroto, e ng'eno naishooki ninye,

English: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
Masaai: eimaki ena anaa enajo too mpala enyena pooki. Amu etii atua ninche kulie naagol eyiolounoto naaboin iltung'ana lemeiteng'ena, nemeeta enkitashoto nauno nemerregel te nkidaaroto enye maate, anaa enaiko ilkulikae kigerot.

English: Ye therefore, beloved, seeing ye know these things before, beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
Masaai: Ore naa intae, ilanyor, iyiololo ena eton eado kop, entorrip ate pee meshoroo ake aaya intae te nkitapong'oroto oo ltung'ana lemeshilaa inkitanapat, neitiakieki intae enkitashoto inyi nauno.

English: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
Masaai: Kake entubulu te mpiris o te yiolounoto o Laitoriani naa Olaitajeunoni lang Yesu Kristo. Metaa enenye enkitoo te pokira, taata o metabaiki ina olong oo ntarasi.

English: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
Masaai: Ilo oatae apake te nkiterunoto. Ilo likitoning'o iyiook, nikitoduaa too nkonyek ang, niking'ura nikimbung'a too nkaik ang, ilo rorei le nkishui

English: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
Masaai: ina kishui olkipoket, nikitoduaa iyiook, naa ina kintayu shakeni aajoki intae nchere ina kishui oo ntarasi natii apake te nebo Papa, neibalakinyeki iyiook.

English: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Ilo likitoduaa nikitoningo kinosaki sii ninche intae pee itumutumu enchula te nebo iyiook; naa ene Papa enchula ang te nebo Oinoti lenye Yesu Kristo.

English: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
Masaai: Nikiinger ena pee elulung'ayu eng'ida ang.

English: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
Masaai: Olkilikuai ele laa ninye kitoning'o te ninye kinosaki intae nchere, ewang'an Enkai nemetii enaimin atua ninye tukul.

English: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
Masaai: Ti nikijo kiaata o ninye enchula neton ake kipuo te naimin, eikilejisho neme sipat kinchuyie;

English: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
Masaai: kake ti nikipuoyie ewang'an, anaa pee etii ninye ewang'an, nikiata enchula olikae o likae, neisuj iyiook osarge le Yesu Kristo, Oinoti lenye aoru ng'ok pooki.

English: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
Masaai: Ti nikijo mikiata ng'ok, ate kilej, nemetii esipata atua iyiook.

English: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Masaai: Ti nikimbalunye ng'ok ang keisiligayu ninye naa asipani, metaa kepalaki ninye iyiook ng'ok ang neisujaa ntorrok ang pooki.

English: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
Masaai: Ti nikijo eitu kias ng'ok, ninye kintaa olalejani, nemetii ororei lenye atua iyiook.

English: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
Masaai: Nkera aainei kutiti, intae aigeroki kuna pee miasiasa ng'ok; kake te neas oltung'ani ng'ok, nikiata olomitu iyiook te Papa, naa Yesu Kristo loo sipat;

English: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
Masaai: naa ninye olkituket loo ng'ok ang, neme nkunaang ake kake o ne nkop pooki.

English: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
Masaai: Naa te na kintadedeyie nchere eikiyiolo ninye, ti nikimbung nkitanapat enyena.

English: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
Masaai: Ore olojo, 'Kayiolo nanu ninye' kake nemeibung inkitanapat enyena naa olaimonkoni ilo, nemetii esipata atua ninye;

English: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
Masaai: kake ore pooki ng'ae oibung ororei lenye, naa ti atua ninye eitabayioki enyorrata e Nkai. Te ina kintisip inchere kitii iyiook atua ninye:

English: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
Masaai: ore olojo keton ti atua ninye neishiakino te neikunari anaa eneikunari apa ninye.

English: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, mme enkitanapata ng'ejuk aigeroki intae, kake enkitanapata musana niatata apake te nkiterata; ore ina kitanapata musana naa ilo rorei lindipa aatoning.

English: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
Masaai: Kake, aigeroki ake intae enkitanapata ng'ejuk, nasipa te ninye nesipa te intae amu keishari enaimin neidipa atawang'a ina wang'an nasipa.

English: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
Masaai: Ore ilo ojo te wang'an eloito neton ake eiba olalashe lenye neton etii ilo atua enaimin.

English: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
Masaai: Ore olonyor olalashe lenye neton ti atua ewang'an, ore tiatua ewang'an nemeetae entoki narrorrisho.

English: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
Masaai: Kake ore ilo oiba olalashe lenye enaimin etii neloito ti atua enaimin, nemeyiolo enelo, amu eitamodoo enaimin inkonyek enyena.

English: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
Masaai: Nkera aainei kutiti, aigeroki intae, amu, etapalakaki intae ng'ok inyi te nkaraki ninye.

English: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
Masaai: Naigeroki intae iloo papa amu, iyiololo ilo otii apake te nkiterunoto. Naigeroki intae lo murran, amu itimira ilo torrono. Naigeroki intae, nakera, amu iyiololo Papa.

English: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
Masaai: Naigeroki intae iloo papa, amu iyiololo ilo otii apake te nkiterunoto. Naigeroki intae, lo murran, amu igoligolo, neton ororei le Nkai intae, nitimira ilo torrono.

English: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
Masaai: Eminyorru enkop anaa ntokitin naatii enkop. Ore oltung'ani ake pooki onyor enkop, nemetii enyorrata nanyor Papa atua ninye.

English: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
Masaai: Amu ore nena pooki naatii enkop, ng'uarrat o sesen, ng'uarrat oo nkonyek o lwuasa le nkishui, ine nkop nena mme ne Papa.

English: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
Masaai: Naa keishari enkop, o ng'uarrat enyena; kake ore ilo oas enayieu Enkai nebik intarasi.

English: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
Masaai: Na kera esaa nabayie ena, naa ore amu itoning'o aajo kelotu Oloiba Kristo, eidipa doi taata aaetu ilooiba Kristo kumok, te ina kiyiolo aajo esaa nabayie ena.

English: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
Masaai: Ti atua iyiook etupukutuo aapuo, kake mme ilkulalang apake, amu te naa eilkulalang apa, anaata etotona aaisiritore iyiook; kake etupukutuo aapuo, pee eibalayu nchere mme lkulalang lelo pooki.

English: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
Masaai: Kake eidipaki aaela ninche intae ilo Obo Sinyati, niyiololo pooki.

English: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
Masaai: Ore pee aigeroki intae, neme enkaraki nimiyiololo esipata, kake enkaraki niyiololo, niyiololo sii aajo metii emonkoi atua esipata.

English: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
Masaai: Kalo doi olaimonkoni leme ilo otanya ejo ore Yesu ninye Kristo, Ilo doi Oloiba Kristo olotanya Papa neany Oinoti lenye.

English: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: (but) he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
Masaai: Meetae oloany ilo Inoti oitoki ninye aata Papa. Ore oloibalunye ilo Inoti keeta sii ninye Papa.

English: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
Masaai: Enchoo ina nitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto ebik ti atua intae. Te nebik ti atua intae ina nitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto naa eibikibiki sii ti atua ilo Inoti o ti atua Papa.

English: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
Masaai: Naa ena eisiligie iyiook, enkishui oo ntarasi.

English: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
Masaai: Aigeroki intae ena ti alo lelo oojo pee elej intae;

English: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
Masaai: kake etamanya intae enkielata nitang'amutua te ninye; nimiatayieyie tipat enkiteng'enata nalotu likae aitoki aiteng'en intae amu eiteng'ena intae enkielata too mbaa pooki, nesipa ninye, mme monko, ore ake anaa ina naiteng'ena intae, entotoni intae ti atua ninye.

English: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
Masaai: Ore taata, naa kera kutiti, entotoni ti atua ninye, paa ore pee elioyu nikintieu aaing'ura mikikurru te lotunoto enye.

English: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
Masaai: Ti nitayioloito ilo aajo oloo sipat ninye, ina naitadedeyie te intae nchere ore ake pooki ng'ae oas esupat keino te Nkai.

English: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
Masaai: Eng'ura eneba enyorrata natonyorra iyiook Papa, pee eipoti iyiook aajo nkera e Nkai; naa kesipa eikira. Ore pee meyiolo iyiook enkop enkaraki neitu eiyiolou ninye.

English: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, kira taata iyiook inkera Enkai neton eitu elioyu enikiyooki aatiu, kake kiyiolo aajo ore pee elioyu ninye nikitiu anaa ninye amu aikidol ninye eneikununo.

English: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki ng'ae oata ilo siligi te ninye neitisiny kewan anaa enasinya ninye.

English: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oas intorrok neeta entiyoto e mpaashata oo nkitanapat; ing'ok empaashata o nkitanapat.

English: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
Masaai: Iyiololo aajo eewuo ninye pee etum aawa ng'ok, nemetii ng'ok atua ninye.

English: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
Masaai: Meetae oloton ti atua ninye oas ng'ok, nemeetae oloas ng'ok etoduaa ninye aashu otayiolo ninye.

English: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
Masaai: Na kera kutiti, emincho elej intae oltung'ani. Ore ilo oas esidai naa olasipani, anaa paa asipani ninye.

English: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
Masaai: Ore ilo oas ing'ok naa ole sheitani, amu etaasa apa sheitani ing'ok ebaiki enkiterunoto. Ina pee etaliee Oinoti le Nkai pee eidaikie isiaaitin e Sheitani.

English: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
Masaai: Meetae oloino te Nkai oas ing'ok amu eton empukunoto e Nkai tiatua ninye. Nemeas ninye ing'ok amu keino te Nkai.

English: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
Masaai: Tena eidimi aatodol nchere kaku nkera e Nkai, naa kakua nkera e Sheitani: ore pooki ng'ae lemeas enaishaakino neme ole Nkai, naa neijia etiu ilo lemenyor olalashe lenye.

English: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
Masaai: Amu ele kilikuai itoning'o apake te nkiterunoto, nchere matonyorrata olikae o likae,

English: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
Masaai: pee mikitiu anaa Kain le ilo torrono otara apa ninye olalashe lenye metua. Naa ainyoo pee etara ninye metua? Enkaraki naa torrok nkiasin enye naasidain ino lalashe lenye.

English: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
Masaai: Eming'asia lalashera, nchere eiba intae enkop.

English: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
Masaai: Eikiyiolo iyiook aajo kitupukutuo te keeya aajing empuaan, amu kinyor ilalashera. Ore olemenyorrisho etii atua keeya.

English: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiba olalashe lenye naa olarani, niyiololo intae aajo meetae olarani omany enkishui nemeish atua ninye.

English: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye enyorrata, nchere eirragie ninye enkishui enye te nkaraki iyiook; neishiakino sii ninche iyiook te nikirragie enkishui ang te nkaraki lalashera.

English: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
Masaai: Kake te neeta ake oltung'ani masaa e nkop neduaaki olalashe enyamali, neitoki ake aiken oltau ti alo ninye, kaji naa etamanya enyorrata e Nkai ti atua ninye?

English: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
Masaai: Na kera kutiti emikinyorrisho to rorei ake aashu to lng'ejep kake te asata o te sipata.

English: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye aajo kira iyiook ile sipata, nikintadedeyie ltauja lang te dukuya ninye,

English: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
Masaai: enoshi kata naiguenare iyiook iltauja lang, amu kitok Enkai alang iltauja lang, neyiolo pooki toki.

English: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, te nemeiguenare iyook iltauja lang, nikiata enkitieunoto nikintoriokinore Enkai;

English: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
Masaai: naa eikitum pooki toki nikiomonu, amu eikimbung nkitanapat enyena nikias ina naitiship ninye.

English: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
Masaai: Naa ena enkitanapata enye, nchere mairuko enkarna o Inoti lenye Yesu Kristo nikinyorruno maate, anaa ina ake naitanapa iyiook.

English: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ooibung nkitanapat enyena netoni ninche tiatua ninye. Naa ena kiyiolounye nchere etonita ninye ti atua iyiook, te nkaraki ina Kiyang'et Sinyati naishoo ninye iyiook.

English: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, emiruk enkiyang'et ake pooki, kake entetem nkiyang'eta pee idolidolo te naa eine Nkai; amu etijing'a enkop iloibonok kumok le lejare.

English: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
Masaai: Ena iyiolounyenye Enkiyang'et e Nkai; ore enkiyang'et ake pooki naibalunye Yesu Kristo nchere eewuo to sesen naa ene Nkai;

English: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
Masaai: ore enkiyang'et ake pooki nemeibalunye Yesu neme ene Nkai. Enkiyang'et o Loiba Kristo ina, naa ninye apa itoning'o aajo kelotu, neidipa taata atijing'a enkop.

English: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
Masaai: Na kera kutiti, irara intae ine Nkai, nindipa aatimir ninche; amu ore ilo otii atua intae naa kitok alang ilo otii atua ena kop.

English: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
Masaai: Ile nkop ninche, metaa ore ina najo ninche naa ene nkop, naa ninche ening enkop.

English: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
Masaai: Kira iyiook ile Nkai nemeinining ninche iyiook. Ena kiyiolounye enkiyang'et e sipata o enkiyang'et e nkitadiata.

English: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, ematonyorrata maate amu ene Nkai enyorrata naa ore ilo onyorrisho keino te Nkai neyiolo Enkai.

English: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
Masaai: Ore ilo lemenyorrisho nemeyiolo Enkai; amu ore Enkai naa enyorrata.

English: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
Masaai: Inji eikuna Enkai pee eibalie enyorrata enye ti atua iyiook, nchere eirriwua Enkai Enkerai enye meeu enkop, metaa ninye kinchuyie.

English: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
Masaai: Ene doi etii enyorrata nchere, mme iyiook ootonyorra Enkai kake ninye natonyorra iyiook neirriu Enkerai enye metaa olkipoket loo ng'ok ang.

English: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, te netonyorra iyiook Enkai aiko neijia, keishiakino sii ninche iyiook te nikinyorru olikae olikae.

English: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
Masaai: Meetae oltung'ani otoduaa Enkai ae kata; te nikinyorra maate, nebik Enkai ti atua iyiook neitabari enyorrata enye ti atua iyiook.

English: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye nchere neton ti atua ninye, neton ninye ti atua iyiook, enkaraki naishoo iyiook Enkiyang'et enye.

English: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
Masaai: Nikitoduaa iyiook nikintayu shakenisho nchere eirriwua Papa Enkerai enye metaa Olaitajeunoni le nkop.

English: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oibalie nchere Enkerai e Nkai Yesu kebikito Enkai ti atua ninye, nebikito ninye tiatua Enkai.

English: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
Masaai: Metaa eikiyiolo iyiook nikiruko enyorrata naata Enkai te iyiook. Ore Enkai naa enyorrata, ore ilo obik ti atua enyorrata nebik ti atua Enkai, nebik Enkai ti atua ninye.

English: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
Masaai: Ena eitabarieki enyorrata ti atua iyiook, nchere eikiata enkitieunoto te nkolong e nkiguana, amu ore enatiu ninye naa neijia sii iyiook kitiu te na kop.

English: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
Masaai: Metii enkuretisho atua enyorrata, kake kearaa enyorrata nalulung'a enkuretisho. Amu ore enkuretisho naa enkitamioto eipirta, naa ilo oureisho melulung'a enyorrata te ninye.

English: We love him, because he first loved us.
Masaai: Kinyor iyiook ninye amu ninye otang'asa anyorru iyiook.

English: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
Masaai: Te nejo likae, “Kanyor nanu Enkai,” neiba olalashe lenye, kelejisho amu ore olemenyor olalashe lenye otoduaa, nemeidim ninye atonyorra Enkai neitu ae kata edol.

English: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
Masaai: Naa ena enkitanapata nikiata aa ninye eing'uaa, nchere ore ilo onyor Enkai neishiakino nenyorru sii ninye olalashe lenye.

English: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiruk nchere ore Yesu ninye Kristo naa enkerai e Nkai ilo ore pooki ng'ae onyor menye nenyor sii ninye enkerai enye.

English: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
Masaai: Ena kiyiolounye nchere kinyor nkera e Nkai te nikinyor Enkai nikimbung nkitanapat enyena.

English: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
