Masaai: Amu ena enyorrata e Nkai, nchere maibung'a nkitanapat enyena. Naa ore nkitanapat enyena nemeekisho.

English: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
Masaai: Amu ore pooki toki naino te Nkai nemir enkop; ina ena emirata namir enkop naa enkirukoto ang.

English: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
Masaai: Ai ng'ae doi omir enkop leme ilo oiruko nchere Enkerai e Nkai Yesu?

English: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
Masaai: Ninye doi ele oewuo te nkare o to sarge, Yesu Kristo, leme te nkare ake eewuo kake te nebo enkare o sarge.

English: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
Masaai: Naa Enkiyang'et shakeni, amu ore Enkiyang'et naa esipata.

English: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
Masaai: Eetae shakeni nara uni Enkiyang'et, enkare, o sarge; neishaki pokira uni ena nabo.

English: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
Masaai: Te naa eiking'amaa shakeni oo ltung'ana, shakeni e Nkai nalusoo; naa ena shakeni e Nkai nchere etaa ninye shakeni te Nkerai enye.

English: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
Masaai: Ore ilo oiruk Enkerai e Nkai neeta shakeni ti atua kewan. Ore ilo lemeiruk Enkai neitaa ninye olalejani, amu eitu eiruk shakenisho naitadedeyie Enkai te Nkerai enye.

English: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
Masaai: Naa ena shakeni, nchere eishoo iyiook Enkai enkishui oo ntarasi, naa atua Enkerai enye etii ina kishui.

English: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
Masaai: Ore oloata ina Kerai neeta enkishui; ore olemeeta ina Kerai e Nkai nemeeta enkishui.

English: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
Masaai: Intae lelo ooiruko Enkerai e Nkai aigeroki ena, pee iyiolouu intae aajo iatata enkishui oo ntarasi.

English: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
Masaai: Naa ena kitieunoto kiata iyiook ti atua ninye, nchere ti nikiomonu ake ninye entoki pooki te risioroto e yieunoto enye naa kening ninye iyiook.

English: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
Masaai: Naa ti nikiyiolo aajo kening ninye iyiook te pooki nikiomonu, nikiyiolo aajo kitang'amutua nena pooki nikitoomonutuo te ninye.

English: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
Masaai: Te neduaki likae lang olalashe eas entorrono neme ene keeya, neomonoki, naa kening'oki Enkai neisho enkishui lelo leme ine keeya ng'ok enye. Keetae ng'ok e keeya; eitu ajo metomonokini oltung'ani te ina.

English: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
Masaai: Ng'ok nkitarruorrot pooki, kake eetae ng'ok neme ne keeya.

English: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
Masaai: Kiyiolo iyiook aajo ore pooki ng'ae oino te Nkai nemeas ng'ok, kake Ilo oino te Nkai orrip ninye nemeiseyie ilo torrono ninye.

English: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
Masaai: Kiyiolo iyiook aajo kira ile Nkai, ore enkop pooki naa atua eng'olon eilo torrono etii.

English: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
Masaai: Nikiyiolo iyiook aajo eewuo Enkerai e Nkai neishoo iyiook enining'unoto, matayiolo olosipa; naa ilo osipa kitii iyiook atua, aatii atua Enkerai enye Yesu Kristo. Ele doi Enkai nasipa naa ninye enkishui oo ntarasi.

English: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
Masaai: Naa kera kutiti, entodol ate too nkitanyaanyukot naaitaae nkaitin.

English: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
Masaai: Olpayian oigeroki enkitok nageluno o nkera enyena, nanyor ti atua sipat, neme nanu ake, kake neijia etiu lelo pooki ooyiolo esipata,

English: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
Masaai: te nkaraki esipata nebikito ti atua iyiook naa keton te nebo iyiook ntarasi.

English: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
Masaai: Metaa te nebo iyiook empiris o lng'ur, o eseriani naing'uaa Enkai Papa neing'uaa Yesu Kristo Oinoti le Papa, te sipata o te nyorrata.

English: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
Masaai: Kang'ida naleng adol kulie kera inono esujita esipata anaa ina ake naitanapa iyiook Papa.

English: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
Masaai: Naasai naa taata na kitok, neme taa kaata ae kitanapata ng'ejuk naaigeroki, kake enapa ake nikiaata te nkiterunoto, nchere matonyorrata maate.

English: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
Masaai: Naa inji eikununo enyorrata te nikisuj iyiook nkitanapat enyena, naa ena enkitanapata anaa enikitoning'o apake te nkiterunoto, nchere enchomie enyorrata.

English: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
Masaai: Amu etijing'a lalejak kumok enkop, iltung'ana lemenyorraa elotunoto e Yesu Kristo to sesen; naa olalejani leeijo ilo oloiba Kristo.

English: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
Masaai: Entodol ate pee minturraa ina nikisiaayutua, kake pee itumutumu olekoisiaayio linyi ebore.

English: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
Masaai: Ore pooki oitulus nemebik te nkiteng'enare e Kristo nemeeta ilo Enkai; ore ilo obik te ina kiteng'enare neeta pokira aare Papa o Enkerai.

English: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
Masaai: Ore ake ololotu enitii lemeyau ena kiteng'enare eming'amu aaitijing aji aashu irorokiki;

English: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
Masaai: amu ore oloiroroki netang'arie esiaai enye torrono.

English: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
Masaai: Ore hoo naata nkumok naaigeroki, mayieu naasishore enkardasi o lbukoi, kake kaisilig ajo kalotu adol intae nairorie intae inotote nkomoni, pee elulung'ayu eng'ida ang.

English: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
Masaai: Eiroroki intae nkera e nkanashe ino nageluno.

English: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
Masaai: Olpayian oigeroki olanyor Gaius, ilo lanyor te sipata.

English: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.
Masaai: Olanyor lai, aaomonoki pee eitabari mbaa pooki te iyie niaku biyoto; kayiolo ajo biyoto oltau lino.

English: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
Masaai: Amu ating'ide oleng pee ebau kulikae alashera ootaa shakeni nchere inyok too sipat te nkishon ino, amu kesipa ajo isujita iyie esipata.

English: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
Masaai: Matum nanu ae ng'ida nalang ena, te naning eji kesujita nkera aainei esipata.

English: Beloved, thou doest faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the brethren, and to strangers;
Masaai: Olanyor lai, itaa oloisiligayu too nintaasa ilalashera, neisul too ltung'ana omon, lelo ooishakenutuo,

English: Which have borne witness of thy charity before the church: whom if thou bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, thou shalt do well:
Masaai: enyorrata ino te dukuya esirit. Embae sidai ina teneitobiraa ninche epuo anaa, enaishiaakino esiaai e Nkai.

English: Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
Masaai: Amu te nkaraki ninye pee etudumunye nemeeta toki natang'amutua te lelo leitu eiruk.

English: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
Masaai: Metaa keishiakino te nikiretu ltung'ana leeijo lelo, pee kiaku laisiayiak ti atua esipata.

English: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
Masaai: Aata enaigeroko esirit; kake ore Diotrefes, ilo oyieu neiturukie kewan, meyieu naaning maitoria nanu.

English: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.
Masaai: Metaa, te nalotu, nabolu nena naasita, nanu esukeny too rorei le nkarrueisho. Neitu doi eidip ina, etanya ninye makewan eng'amu lalashera, nemitiki sii lelo ooyieu neitoomon nearaa ninche te sirit.

English: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that doeth good is of God: but he that doeth evil hath not seen God.
Masaai: Olanyor lai, misuj iyie enkarrueisho kake isupati tusuja. Ore oloas isupati ninye ole Nkai; ore oloas enkarrueisho neitu edol Enkai.

English: Demetrius hath good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and ye know that our record is true.
Masaai: Eeta Demetrus shakenisho sidai te pooki ng'ae, o te sipata kewan, naitadedeyie sii nanu, nikira sii iyiook shakeni niyiolo ajo kesipa shakeni ang.

English: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
Masaai: Kaata nkumok naaigeroki paa ae mayieu naiger te nkalamu o to lbukoi;

English: But I trust I shall shortly see thee, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to thee. Our friends salute thee. Greet the friends by name.
Masaai: ekaisilig ajo ketaanu pee kitumo, nikiro te nebo enotote nkomomi.
Metaa eseriani tenebo iyie. Kiroroki lchorueta. Iroroki lchorueta, pooki ng'ae.

English: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called:
Masaai: Yuda, osinka le Yesu Kristo naa olalashe le Yakobo, oigeroki lelo ooipotoki, oonyorri ti atua Enkai Papa lang ooiteng'elaki te nkaraki Yesu Kristo.

English: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
Masaai: Metoponikini intae olng'ur o eseriani o enyorrata.

English: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
Masaai: Ilanyor laainei, ore anaa eyieunoto naata naleng pee aigeroki intae mbaa naaipirta enjeunoto ang niking'ar, nadol ajo meeta nchere maigeroki intae, asai intae erishisho aamitu enkirukoto e Nkai naishooki apa nabo kata te lulung'ata lelo sinyat.

English: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Amu etijing'aki atua intae te mpurrokinoto ilkulikae laa ninche apa etegelakaki endung'okinoto e nkiguana, iltung'ana lemeiruk Enkai ookur empiris e Nkai ang aaitaa enkoitoi naasie ntorrok nemiki ilo laa ninye ake olkitok lang, naa Olaitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
Masaai: Ayieu naitoki aitadamu intae, hoo naidipa apa aitayiolo intae nchere ore ilo oitajewuo iltung'ana aitung'uaa enkop e Misiri, nenyaaka amut lelo leitu eiruk.

English: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
Masaai: Ore lelo malaika leitu egolie ewueji enye neing'uaa emanyisho enye naishiaakino, neteena ninche too lpisia loo ntarasi ti abori te nemisimis metabau ina olong kitok e nkiguana;

English: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
Masaai: anaa enaikunaki Sodom o Gomora o nkang'itie naamanita naatusuja sii ninche ng'uarrat oo loirerioni torrok, neitamioki ninche te nkima oo ntarasi pee eaku enkitanyaanyukoto te pooki.

English: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
Masaai: Neton ake eiko neijia kulo tung'ana too nkidetidetat enye neidurukie osesen, neany enkitoria, nemor iloata enkitoo le shumata.

English: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke thee.
Masaai: Kake ore Mikael ilo malaika kitok, eishankarra o loirirua eorro osesen le Musa eitu ninye eitasim aipotoki emoroto e nkiguana, Kake etiaaka, “Metaa Enkai nikisikong.”

English: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
Masaai: Edekisho lelo tung'ana too ldeketa lemening'u ninche, ore too naayiolo te mpukunoto o sesen anaa pee eyiolo ng'uesi, neyaki ate embatisho nemuti ninche.

English: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
Masaai: Oi ninche! Amu etusujaitie orrekie le Kain netapalakita ate enkitapong'oroto e Balaam te nkaraki dupoto, nemuti ninche te nkiseroto e Kora.

English: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
Masaai: Ore ninche naa iltipot ooiduruk ti atua isiruai linyi le nyorrata epeipeeno te nebo meeta osul negolie ate meeta isura. Inkatampo nemeeta enkare, naaya osiwuo, o lkeek lemeeta ilng'anayio te siadi ari ootuata katitin are, ootadotuoki.

English: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
Masaai: Ilopir le naiposha ootarasutua ooitokitoku labur le nkurruna enye, lakir oopuaya laa ninche eitaanyitai emisimisi e naimin o lodo le nkop ntarasi.

English: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints,
Masaai: Kuna apa sii eibonuo Enok ilo apa le ishoi e naapishana ebaiki Adam ejo, “Ng'ura eewuo Olaitoriani te nebo iip inkuyu oo sinyat lenyena,

English: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
Masaai: pee edung'oki enkiguana pooki ng'ae nemir lelo pooki lemeure Nkai, too nkiaasin enye pooki torrok nemetii euriata e Nkai naatasa too rrekiei lemetii olturiaki le Nkai, o too mbaa pooki e nkisikong naatejo laasak loo ng'ok lemeure Enkai neiba ninye.”

English: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage.
Masaai: Kulo laing'unyung'unyak, iloata olorok, iloosuj ing'uarrat oo seseni lenye, iloorup ate te njartano enye, nepakas iltung'ana ejo pee edupore.

English: But, beloved, remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
Masaai: Kake entadamu intae ilanyor laainei nena apa naatolimutuo ilkipaareta lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo.

English: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
Masaai: Etiaakita intae, “Ore te nkata e nkiting'oto naa kepuonu ilasukenyak, oosuj ing'uarrat enye nemetii euriata e Nkai.”

English: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
Masaai: Kulo ninche ooyau eoro, ile na kop ninche lemeeta Enkiyang'et Enkai.

English: But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost,
Masaai: Kake ore intae ilanyor laainei, enteshetu ate ti atua ina kirukoto inyi nasinya, entoomon te Nkiyang'et Sinyati.

English: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.
Masaai: Entotoni intae maate ti atua enyorrata e Nkai, entaanyu olng'ur lo Laitoriani lang Yesu Kristo oitabaiki intae ina kishui oo ntarasi.

English: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
Masaai: Entudupa ilkulikae leton eing'ashing'ash.

English: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
Masaai: Entajeu ilkulikae entawuapu ninche ti atua enkima eng'urrie lelo kulikae to lturiaki nimbayuyu ebaiki ninye enkila naidurukie osesen.

English: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
Masaai: Ore taata ilo oidim atorripo intae mibatatata, neitoduaaya intae te dukuya enkitoo enye miaatata eleyiata, iatata eng'ida,

English: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
Masaai: laa ninye ake Enkai Olaitajeunoni lang, ti atua Yesu Kristo Olaitoriani lang, metaa enenye enkitoo, enkisisa, o enkitoo, o engolon, te dukuya nkatitin pooki o taata o ntarasi. Esai.

English: The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
Masaai: Embolunoto e Yesu Kristo, naishoo Enkai ninye meitaduaa isinkan lenyena, imbaa nemeeta nchere meaku aasioki; neisho metayiolouni te nkirriwakinoto nairriwaka olmalaika osinka lenye Yohana,

English: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
Masaai: oishakenoko ororei le Enkai o enchakenisho e Yesu Kristo, ebaiki nena pooki naatoduaa.

English: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
Masaai: Emayiana ilo oisoma metoning'i irorei le naibon nemayiana lelo ooning, neibung nena naaigero te ine, amu etataana enkata.

English: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
Masaai: Nanu Yohana oigeroki isirito naapishana e Asia: Metaa eninyi empiris o eseriani eing'uaa ilo otii taata, netii apa, naa ninye kenya olotu netii neing'uaa sii inkiyang'eta naapishana naatii dukuya olorika le nkitoo,

English: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
Masaai: neing'uaa Yesu Kristo olchakeni osipa, laa ninye olkikau loo lootuata, naa Olaitoriani loo laiguanak ootii enkop. Metaa ene ilo otonyorra iyiook nelaku iyiook too ng'ok ang to sarge lenye,

English: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: neitaa iyiook kituaak, o lapolosak le Enkai Menye lenye, metaa enenye enkisisa o enkitoo ntarasi o ntarasi. Esai.

English: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
Masaai: Ng'ura elotu ninye too nkatampo, naa kedol pooki ong'u ninye, lelo pooki ootaremo ninye ore loshon pooki le nkop, neyietu neishir te nkaraki ninye. Neijia taa Esai.

English: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
Masaai: “Ara nanu Alfa o Omega,” Olaitoriani Enkai ojo, Otii taata, netii apa, naa ninye olotu, Olaidimani.

English: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Nanu Yohana olalashe linyi ong'arie intae ti atua Yesu, osina o enkitoo o eng'iriata o enkisulata, atii apa lemankale le naiposha oji Patmos te nkaraki ororei le Enkai o enchakenisho e Yesu.

English: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
Masaai: Naainepu Enkiyang'et te nkolong o Laitoriani, naning oltoilo kitok te siadi nanu laaijo ole ntarumpeta,

English: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What thou seest, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
Masaai: ejo, “Ingero nena nidol ti atua embuku nirriwaki nena sirito pokira naapishana, ene Efeso, o Smirna o Pergamum o Tiatira o Sardis o ene Filadelfia o Laodikea.”

English: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
Masaai: Naibelekenya ajo pee adol ilo toilo laairorie, ore ake pee aibelekenya nadol ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le sahabu,

English: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
Masaai: naa ore te neitorit lelo kilang'ilang'eta netii ilo obo laaijo Enkerai e Tung'ani, eishopokoki olkila oado neenita enkimeita e sahabu to lgoo lenye;

English: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
Masaai: ore endukuya enye o lpapit lenyena naa keibor anaa lpapit loo ntare, neibor anaa enturoto, netiu nkonyek enyena anaa olng'ejep le nkima,

English: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
Masaai: netiu inkejek enyena anaa suya oosika te nkima, netiu oltoilo lenye anaa ltoilo loo nkariak kumok;

English: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
Masaai: neeta te nkaina enye e tatene ilakir oopishana, nepuku te nkutuk enye olalem opi nkaloli pokira are, netiu enkomom enye anaa enkolong te nedalu te ngolon enye pooki.

English: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
Masaai: Ore peyie adol ninye nabatatakino nkejek enyena natiu anaa oltung'ani olotua. Kake aaiteleikia enkaina enye e tatene, nejo, “Miureishoyu, ara nanu ole nkiterunoto o le nkiting'oto;

English: I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
Masaai: nara ilo oishu atua apa, naa ng'ura aishu taata o ntarasi, naa nanu oata imboleta e keeya o ewueji e nkima.

English: Write the things which thou hast seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
Masaai: Naa ngero taata nena nidol, enatii o enayooki aaku.

English: The mystery of the seven stars which thou sawest in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.
Masaai: Ore enkisudoroto e lelo akir oopishana litoduaa te nkaina ai e tatene, o lelo kilang'ilang'eta oopishana le sahabu, ore lakir oopishana naa ilmalaika loo sirito naapishana ore ilkilang'ilang'eta naa sirito, pokira naapishana.

English: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things saith he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walketh in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
Masaai: “Tisiraki ilo malaika le sirit natii atua Efeso nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo oibung'ita lakir oopishana te nkaina enye e tatene, olo ti atua ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le sahabu.

English: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo nkiaasin inono o eekenyata ino o eng'iriata ino, nchere mindim aisiritore iltung'ana torrok kake itetema lelo oojo ate ilkipaareta neme ninche, nirrasha ninche ajo lalejak,

English: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
Masaai: ayiolo ajo iata enyuaata ning'iri te nkaraki enkarna ai, neitu inauru.

English: Nevertheless I have somewhat against thee, because thou hast left thy first love.
Masaai: Kake aata ena namen te iyie. Nchere, itung'uaiyie enyorrata apa niaata te dukuya.

English: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.
Masaai: Tadamu naa eneba enitusulunore, irridu niaas isiaaitin niaasita apa te dukuya. Naa ti nimiaas, naa kalotu enitii naiwuang'ie olkilang'ilang'et lino te wueji enye, te neitu irridu.

English: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
Masaai: Kake iata ena nabo, imba isiaaitin oo Lnikolatin naiba sii nanu.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
Masaai: Ore oloata enkiok inchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho naisho meinosa ilng'anayio te ilo shani le mpuaan natii atua emparadiso e Enkai.’

English: And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things saith the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive;
Masaai: “Naa ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Smirna tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo le Nkiterunoto o le nkiting'oto, otua apa, nenyaaka apiu.

English: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo osomit lino o aisinanisho ino, kake ira karsis. Ayiolo sii imorot e lelo oojo ate Ilyahudi neme ninche, kake enkaji e ntumo e sheitani ninche.

English: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
Masaai: Miureyu ilo sina olotu. Ng'ura, etaa enajo pee enang'aki sheitani lkulikae te intae atua korokoroni pee etum atetema intae, naa ore too nkolong'i tomon nitumutumu intae osomit. Taa oloisiligayu o tabaiki keeya naa kaaisho iyie enkopiyia e nkitoo e nkishui.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok, inchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho nemeitame ninye ina keeya e are.’

English: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things saith he which hath the sharp sword with two edges;
Masaai: “Naa ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Pargamum, tisiraki, ‘Irorei lo loata olalem opi nkaloli pokira are.

English: I know thy works, and where thou dwellest, even where Satan's seat is: and thou holdest fast my name, and hast not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwelleth.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo enikimanya, ine etii olorika le nkitoo le sheitani; nimbung'ita enkarna ai akurraki, neitu imiki enkirukoto ai ebaiki inkolong'i e Antipas olchakeni lai, airukoni lai, otaraki metua ti tua intae te ine nemanya sheitani.

English: But I have a few things against thee, because thou hast there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumblingblock before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication.
Masaai: Kake aata nkuti namen te iyie; iata kulikae te ine ooibung inkiteng'enat e Balaam oiteng'ena Balak metipiki eloket narror inkera e Siraeli pee etum aainosa ndaiki oo lasarri ootopolosaki leme le Enkai, neas intorrok e loloito.

English: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.
Masaai: Metaa iata sii iyie kulikae ooibung nkiteng'enat oo Lnikolatin.

English: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
Masaai: Irridu naa. Naa te neitu, nalotu enetii asieku naitainyie ninche olarrabal to lalem le nkutuk ai.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok inchoo ening enajoki, Enkiyang'et nena sirito. Ore ilo omirisho naa kaisho ninye eoroti e mana naisudoro, naisho osoit oibor, osirakino enkarna enye ng'ejuk, nemeyiolo likae tung'ani meteleku ilo ake ong'amu.’

English: And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God, who hath his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass;
Masaai: “Ore olmalaika le sirit natii atua Tiatira, tisiraki nchere, ‘Irorei lo Inoti le Enkai, otiu nkonyek enyena anaa lng'ejepa le nkima, netiu nkejek enyena anaa suya ootisirakaki.

English: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last to be more than the first.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo isiaaitin inono, enyorrata ino, o enkirukoto o enkisiaayiare, o eng'iriata, o nchere etalang'a isiaaitin inono e det ine dukuya.

English: Notwithstanding I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols.
Masaai: Kake amen ena te iyie nchere, itapalayie ina kitok naji Yesebel naitaa kewan enkoiboni pee eiteng'enisho neitapong'oo isinkan laainei metaasa imbaa e loloito neinos indaiki naatopolosakaki inkitanyaanyukot.

English: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
Masaai: Aishoo ninye enkata meirridu, kake etanya eirridu te loloito enye.

English: Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.
Masaai: Ng'ura, ekanang'aki ninye erruat e mueyian ore lelo oololoito te nebo ninye nanang'aki atua olosilisili kitok aashu te neirridu inkiaasin enyena.

English: And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.
Masaai: Naa kaosh inkera enyena metuata. Naa keyiolou isirito pooki aajo nanu ilo ojur indamunot o ltau, naa nanu oisho pooki ng'ae linyi anaa erisioroto e siaai enye.

English: But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you none other burden.
Masaai: Kake ore intae kulikae ootii atua Tiatira leitu eibung ena kiteng'enare, leitu eiteng'en ate te nena naajo kulikae imbaa naagut e sheitani, ajoki intae, maitoki aiteleiki intae likae ola.

English: But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.
Masaai: Embung'a ake intae entukurraki ina niaatata, o metaba anaa nalotu.

English: And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations:
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho neibung isiaaitin aainei o metabau enkiting'oto naisho ninye engolon meitoria loreren.

English: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.
Masaai: Naa keitore ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei anaa te nedanyi motioo oo nkulukuok metaa mbelibelat, anaa sii ninye nanu enatang'amua engolon eing'uaa Papa lai.

English: And I will give him the morning star.
Masaai: Naa kaisho ninye olakira le nkakenya.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’

English: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars; I know thy works, that thou hast a name that thou livest, and art dead.
Masaai: “Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Sardis, ingero nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo oata nena kiyang'eta naapishana e Enkai o lelo akir oopishana. “ ‘Ayiolo isiaaitin inono, iata enkarna anaa oltung'ani oishu, nitua.

English: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.
Masaai: Tuputunye naa nintagol ina natelekua netaa keye, amu eitu ainepu isiaaitin inono aa bayarot too nkonyek e Enkai ai.

English: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
Masaai: Tadamu naa ina apa natang'amua nitoning'o torripo ina nirridu. Te nimiputunye nalotu anaa olapurroni, nimiyiolou ajo kaa saa alotunyie enitii iyie.

English: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy.
Masaai: Neton ake iatata nkuti arn ti atua Sardis, iltung'ana leitu epik oloirerio nkilani enye, naa kaairiamariyie ninche nanu eishopo nkilani naaibor amu keiririkino ninche.

English: He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho neikodi aaiko neijia too nkilani naaibor, nemajut enkarna enye te mbuku e mpuaan; naishakenoki enkarna enye te dukuya Papa lai o te dukuya lmalaika lenyena.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok, nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’

English: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
Masaai: “Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Filadelfia, ingeroki nchere, ‘Irorei le ilo Obo Sinyati, olosipa, oloata olbolet le Daudi, olobol nemeatae likae oiken, oloiken nemeetae likae obol.

English: I know thy works: behold, I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it: for thou hast a little strength, and hast kept my word, and hast not denied my name.
Masaai: “ ‘Aiyiolo nkiaasin inono. Ng'ura, atipika dukuya iyie kutukaji nabolo nemeidim hoo ng'ae aikeno; aiyiolo ajo enkiti golon iata, kake imbung'a ororei lai neitu imiki enkarna ai.

English: Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.
Masaai: Ng'ura, kareu lelo le nkaji e ntumo e sheitani oojo ate Ilyahudi neme ninche, kake kelejisho ng'ura, kareu ninche meetu aairrugokino nkejek inono neyiolou nchere aatonyorra nanu iyie.

English: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience, I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore amu imbung'a ororei lai te nyuaata o eng'iriata, ekaarrip te ina saa oo ntemat nalotu enkop pooki, atem lelo ootii enkop.

English: Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which thou hast, that no man take thy crown.
Masaai: Ekalotu asieku. Imbung'a tukurraki ina niaata pee mikioru ake likae enkopiyia ino e nkitoo.

English: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho naitaa ninye eng'ape ti atua enkaji e Enkai ai, nemeitoki ae kata aipang aing'uaa ine, naa kasiraki ninye enkarna e Enkai ai, o enkarna e nkanasa e Enkai ai, ina Yerusalem nadou eing'uaa Enkai ai te keper o enkarna ai kewan ng'ejuk.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok, nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’

English: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;
Masaai: “Naa ore to lmalaika le sirit natii atua Laodikea, ingeroki, ‘Irorei le ilo oji Esai, Oloisiligayu naa olchakeni osipa, naa ninye enkiterunoto e nkitobirata naitobira Enkai seuseu.

English: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
Masaai: “ ‘Ayiolo nkiaasin inono. Mirobi iyie nimirowua, oi imut airopiju aashu irowuaju.

English: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.
Masaai: Neaku ore amu imololong, mirobi nimirowua, ekaanotu aitayu te nkutuk ai.

English: Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:
Masaai: Amu ijo iyie, Kara nanu karsis, atudupe, malau toki. Nimiyiolo iyie ajo ira menati, ira tolut, nira olaisinani modooni niminchopo.

English: I counsel thee to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that thou mayest be rich; and white raiment, that thou mayest be clothed, and that the shame of thy nakedness do not appear; and anoint thine eyes with eyesalve, that thou mayest see.
Masaai: Ore te nkaraki ina aaikok iyie naa pee inyiang'u te nanu sahabu natisilaki te nkima, pee itum ataa karsis, ninchop ilkilani ooibor pee eitemoo enkurruna e masipaisho ino, meitokini aadol, o lchani liyelie nkonyek inono pee idolishoyu.

English: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
Masaai: Ore lelo lanyor naa kaisikong naitame metaa, tonyuaa naa irridu.

English: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Masaai: Ng'ura, aitashe te kutukaji naoshiosh, ore ake pooki ng'ae oning oltoilo lai nebol kutukaji, naa kajing'aki nanu;

English: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
Masaai: nalo adaa te nebo ninye, nedaa sii ninye te nebo nanu. Ore ilo omirisho naa kaisho ninye metotona te nebo nanu to lorika lai le nkitoo anaa apa enatimirishe nanu, naton te nebo Papa lai to lorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches.
Masaai: Oloata enkiok nchoo ening enajoki Enkiyang'et nena sirito.’ ”

English: After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up hither, and I will shew thee things which must be hereafter.
Masaai: Ore pee eidipayu ena, naing'orisho, ng'ura, etii atua keper kutukaji nabolo! Ore oladuoo toilo latang'asa aning aairorie te dukuya, etiu anaa ole ntarumpeta. Nejo, “Ilepu, tinyiku ene, pee aaitodol ina nemeeta nchere meaku asuju ena.”

English: And immediately I was in the spirit: and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne.
Masaai: Ore nabo kata naaigany Enkiyang'et, naa ng'ura, euno olorika le nkitoo te keper, netii obo otonita te ilo orika.

English: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
Masaai: Ore ilo otonita te ine neikununo anaa osoit oji Yaspa, o ltoto oonyori ooji karnelian nemanita olokirrai ilo orika oikununo anaa ltoto ooji emerald.

English: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold.
Masaai: Nemanita ilo orika ilorikan tikitam oong'uan le nkitoo. Netonita te lelo orikan le nkitoo ilpayiani tikitam o oong'uan ooishopito nkilani naaibor, neeta too lukuny enye nkopiyiani e nkitoo e sahabu.

English: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.
Masaai: Nepukunye ilo orika le nkitoo inkiwuang'at naaimerlel o ndarat o enkikurrukur. Ore te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo neyupuyup ilkilang'ilang'eta oopishana le nkima, naa ninche inkiyang'eta naapishana e Enkai.

English: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind.
Masaai: Ore dukuya, ilo orika le nkitoo netii entoki natiu anaa enaiposha e kiok nayia anaa oltotoi oibor, nemanita ilo orika le nkitoo too nkaloli pooki ing'uesi ong'uan naaishu, naabore nkonyek dukuya o siadi.

English: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues e dukuya naishu neikununo anaa olng'atuny, ore ina ng'ues e are naishu neikununo ana olkiteng, ore ina ng'ues e uni naishu neeta enkomom o ltung'ani, ore ina ng'ues e ong'uan naishu neikununo anaa olkurragos olo ti ai.

English: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
Masaai: Ore nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu neeta ake nabo inaipuko ile, nebore ninche nkonyek pooki wueji, oriong o atua. Ore dama o kewarie nemegira ae kata meranyisho ejo, “Osinyati, Osinyati, Osinyati, Osinyati, Olaitoriani Enkai, Olaidimani le pooki, otii apa netii taata, naa ninye olotu.”

English: And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who liveth for ever and ever,
Masaai: Naa ore ake pee eisho nena ng'uesi naaishu enkisisa, o enkitoo o enkanyit enashe ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, oishu ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that liveth for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
Masaai: Nebatata lelo payiani tikitam o oong'uan te dukuya ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, neserem ilo oishu ntarasi o intarasi, neirragie nkopiyiani enye e nkitoo te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo, neranyisho aajo,

English: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
Masaai: “Kinchiaakino iyie, Olaitoriani lang o Enkai ang, pee ing'amu enkisisa o enkanyit o engolon, amu iyie oitobirua intokitin pooki, naa te yieuna ino eetae ninche eitobiruaki ninche.”

English: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.
Masaai: Nadol sii te nkaina e tatene e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo olpiyayati le embuku naigero atua o oriong, netipikaki ilmishiren oopishana.

English: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
Masaai: Nadol sii olmalaika ogol elimu to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Ai eishiaakino nebol ele piyayati le mbuku nebol lelo mishiren lenyena.”

English: And no man in heaven, nor in earth, neither under the earth, was able to open the book, neither to look thereon.
Masaai: Nemeetae hoo obo te keper aashu te nkop aashu tiabori enkop oidima atabolo ilo piyayati aashu aing'ura atua.

English: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
Masaai: Naishir oleng amu eitu etumi oltung'ani hoo obo oishiaakino pee edol ilo piyayati arishu eing'or atua.

English: And one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.
Masaai: Naajoki nanu obo le lelo payiani lo losho le Yuda, mintoki aishir. Ng'ura, olng'ur le ntonai e Daudi etimirishe peyie etum atabolo ilo piyayati o lelo mishiren lenyena oopishana.

English: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth.
Masaai: Ore te rishata o lorika le nkitoo ore ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, o tiatua ilpayiani, nadol olkuoo le ker eitashe, etiu anaa keteyiang'aki apa, neeta mowuarak naapishana o nkonyek naapishana, naa ninche nkiyang'eta naapishana e Nkai, naairriwayioki meshomo enkop pooki.

English: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne.
Masaai: Nelo nedumu ilo piyayati le mbuku te nkaina e tatene e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo.

English: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edumu ilo piyayati le mbuku, nebatata nena ng'uesi naaishu ong'uan te dukuya ilo kuoo le ker, nemeetae ake enemeibung'ita enkawuo oo sinkolioitin, o ngirran e sahabu naabore empuruonarropil naa enkomono oo sinyat.

English: And they sung a new song, saying, Thou art worthy to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou wast slain, and hast redeemed us to God by thy blood out of every kindred, and tongue, and people, and nation;
Masaai: Nerany osinkolio ng'ejuk aajo, “Kinchiaakino iyie pee idumu olpiyayati le embuku, nibel ilmishiren lenyena. Amu kiteyieng'aki apa naa to sarge lino inyiang'aka Enkai iltung'ana aitung'uaa loshon pooki, o lng'ejepa, o ltung'ana o loreren.

English: And hast made us unto our God kings and priests: and we shall reign on the earth.
Masaai: Nintaa ninche enkitoria o lapolosak le Enkai ang, naa keyooki ninche aaitoreisho te nkop.”

English: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders: and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
Masaai: Naing'orisho nanu naning emanita olorika le nkitoo o nena ng'uesi naaishu o lelo payiani oltoilo loo lmalaika kumok. Ore esiana enye naa iip nkuyu iip nkuyu, iip nkuyu, nkalifuni o nkalifuni.

English: Saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.
Masaai: Nejo ninche to ltoilo sapuk, “Eishiakino ilo Kuoo le ker apa oteyiang'aki, te neng'amu engolon, o enkarsisisho, o eng'eno nagut, o enkidimata, o enkanyit, o enkitoo, o emayianata.”

English: And every creature which is in heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.
Masaai: Naning nena pooki naaiseuseu te keper o te nkop oti abori enkop o naatii enaiposha, o nena pooki naatae ejo, “Metaa ene ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo neaku eno lkuoo le ker, emayianata o enkanyit o enkisisa o enkidimata intarasi o ntarasi!”

English: And the four beasts said, Amen. And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever.
Masaai: Nejo nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, “Esai.” Nebatata ilpayiani aaserem.

English: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.
Masaai: Nadol ina kata pee elo ilo Kuoo le Ker abol obo le lelo mishiren oopishana, naning nabo e nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu ejo to ltoilo le ndarata, “Wou!”

English: And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.
Masaai: Nadol, naa ng'ura, embarta naibor, neeta ilo okedito enkawuo, o enkopiyia e nkitoo naishooki ninye, neipang alo.

English: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol ninye ilo mishire li aare, naning ina ng'ues e are naishu ejo, “Wou!”

English: And there went out another horse that was red: and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.
Masaai: Neipang'u enkai barta nanyokie oleng, ore ilo okedito neishooki engolon meiwuang'ie eseriani aitung'uaa e nkop pee eyiang'a iltung'ana maate, neishooki ninye olalem sapuk.

English: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol olmishire le okuni, naning ina ng'ues e uni naishu ejo, “Wou!” Ng'ura, nadol nanu, embarta narok, ore ilo okedito neeta entemet te nkaina enye.

English: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.
Masaai: Naning entoki naaijo oltoilo te mpolos e nana ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu ejo, “Emborei e mpilbil e nkano te mpesai nabo, o mboreitin uni o shairi te dinari. Kake mintarruoo eilata o enaisho oo sabibu.”

English: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol ninye olmishire li oong'uan, naning oltoilo le ina ng'ues e ong'uan naishu ejo, “Wou!”

English: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.
Masaai: Nadol nanu, naa ng'ura embarta pus, ore enkarna e ilo okedito naa keji Keeya, neirukurukore ninye Enemeneng'a. Neishooki ninye engolon meitoria ematua e ong'uan e nkop, peyie ear metuata to lalem o to lameyu o too lmeitai o too ng'uesi e ntim naatii enkop.

English: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God, and for the testimony which they held:
Masaai: Ore ebol ninye olmishire le imiet nadol ti abori olperere lo lasar iltauja le lelo apa ootaaraki te nkaraki ororei le Enkai o te nchakenisho naitayutuo.

English: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Lord, holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
Masaai: Neishir aajo to ltoilo sapuk, “Iyie Olaitoriani Kitok, Oyanyiti nesipa, kanu akenya inguana intalaku osarge lang te lelo ootii enkop?”

English: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.
Masaai: Neishori pooki te lelo olkila oibor, nejokini meyeng'iyeng'ata te nkiti kata, o metaba anaa neiputayu esiana e lelo ooisiaaishote te nebo ninche leton eitokini aar anaa apa ninche maate.

English: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal, and, lo, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;
Masaai: Ore pee ebol olmishire le ile, naing'orisho naa ng'ura, nadol etii enkikirikirata sapuk enkop, neroku enkolong netiu anaa olkila orok, neibelekenya olapa olulung'a netiu anaa osarge.

English: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth, even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.
Masaai: Nesulunye lakir to loing'ang'e nesulakino enkop anaa lng'abolo oorrarrunye ilng'anayio te nkata enkirobi eyukito olkutati.

English: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
Masaai: Neng'ishari oloing'ang'e anaa olpiyayati otununukoki. Neiwuang'ieki pooki doinyo, o pooki lemankale aaitung'uaa ewueji enye.

English: And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;
Masaai: Ore laiguanak le na kop, o ltung'ana kituaak, o larikok loo njorin, o lkarsisi o loogol, o pooki ng'ae, orrindik aashu ololakuno. Neisudori too nkapuniaa o too isoito loo ldoinyo,

English: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
Masaai: neipot nejoki ildoinyo o soito, “Entusulakinoto iyiook, nisudoo iyiook too nkonyek e ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo, o te ngoro e ilo Kuoo le Ker.

English: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
Masaai: Amu etabawua ina olong kitok e ngoro enye, naa ae ng'ae oidim aitasho te dukuya ninye?”

English: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nadol ilmalaika oong'uan eitashe too lubot pokira ong'uan e nkop, eibooyo isiwuon pokira oong'uan le nkop, pee meitoki olkutati akutu te nkop aashu te naiposha aashu akutaki olchani ake pooki.

English: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
Masaai: Naitoki adol likae malaika eilepu te nkilepunoto e nkolong, neeta olmishire le Enkai naishu, neipot to ltoilo sapuk lelo malaika oong'uan ooishooki engolon meinyiala enkop o enaiposha.

English: Saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.
Masaai: Nejoki, “Eminyial enkop aashu enaiposha aashu ilkeek, o metaba anaa nikimishir isinkan le Enkai ang inkomomi enye.”

English: And I heard the number of them which were sealed: and there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.
Masaai: Naning esiana, e lelo ootimishiraki; naa nkalifuni iip artam o oong'uan ilootimishiraki eing'uaa iloshon pooki loo layiok le Israel,

English: Of the tribe of Juda were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Reuben were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Gad were sealed twelve thousand.
Masaai: inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Yuda,

English: Of the tribe of Aser were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Nepthalim were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Manasses were sealed twelve thousand.
Masaai: inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Ruben, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Gad, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Asheri. Inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Naftali. Inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Manase.

English: Of the tribe of Simeon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Levi were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Issachar were sealed twelve thousand.
Masaai: Inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Simion, inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Lawi,

English: Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Joseph were sealed twelve thousand. Of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.
Masaai: inkalifuni tomon o aare ilo losho le Isaakar naa nkalifuni tomon o aare ilootimishiraki eing'uaa olosho le Sebulon, nkalifuni tomon aare ilo losho le Yosef, nkalifuni tomon oare ilootimishiraki to losho le Benchamen.

English: After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands;
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena, naing'orisho, naa ng'ura, olorora kitok lemeeta oltung'ani oidim aikena, eing'uaa pooki orere, neing'uaa loshon pooki, o ltung'ana o lng'ejepa, eitashe te dukuya olorika le nkitoo o te dukuya ilo Kuoo le Ker, neishopito ilkilani naaibor, neibung'ita ilng'osil loo ltuka too nkaik enye.

English: And cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God which sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb.
Masaai: Nebuaku to ltoilo sapuk aajo, “Ene Enkai ang enjeunoto: ina natonita to lorika le nkitoo o ene ilo Kuoo le Ker.”

English: And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
Masaai: Neitashe ilmalaika pooki aaman olorika le nkitoo o lelo payiani o nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, nebatata too nkomomi enye te dukuya ilo orika le nkitoo neserem Enkai.

English: Saying, Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
Masaai: Ejoito, “Esai, metaa emayianata o enkisisa o enkitoo, o eng'eno nagut o enkishooroto enashe o enkanyit o engolon o enkidimata ena Enkai ang intarasi o ntarasi. Esai.”

English: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, What are these which are arrayed in white robes? and whence came they?
Masaai: Naaitoki obo le lelo payiani airorie nanu ajoki, “Kakua kulo, ooishop ilkilani ooibor, naa kaji eing'uaa ninche?”

English: And I said unto him, Sir, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they which came out of great tribulation, and have washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Masaai: Najoki nanu ninye, “Olkitok, iyiolo iyie.” Naaitoki aajoki, “Kulo ninche lelo ooiturukutuo aaing'uaa ilo sina kitok neitukuo ilkilani lenye neiborrie to sarge lo Lkuoo le Ker.”

English: Therefore are they before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.
Masaai: Naa enkaraki ina pee etii dukuya olorika le nkitoo le Enkai neisiaai ninye dama o kewarie ti atua enkaji enye, ore ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo naa keitushur ninche te ine netii ninye.

English: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun light on them, nor any heat.
Masaai: Nemeitoki ae kata ninche aaisumashu aashu aatum enkure. Nemedal enkolong ninche aashu ae kirowuaj napejisho.

English: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
Masaai: Amu ilo Kuoo le Ker otii empolos o lorika le nkitoo oaku olchekut lenye, anaa kerikoo ninche too nchorroi oo nkariak naaishu. Naa kejut Enkai pooki kiyioi too nkonyek enye.

English: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.
Masaai: Ore pee ebol Olkuoo le Ker olmishire li oopishana, negira keper te rishata naba anaa enusu e saa.

English: And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.
Masaai: Nadol nanu lelo malaika oopishana, ooitashe te dukuya Enkai, neishori ninche ntarumpetani naapishana.

English: And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.
Masaai: Nelotu likae malaika aitashe te mbata o lperere lo lasar, eeta emoti e sahabu nairishoreki, neishori enkorropil sapuk, meitushulaki enkomono e lelo sinyat pooki te nchumata o lperere lo lasar le sahabu otii dukuya olorika le nkitoo.

English: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
Masaai: Neilep empuruo e nkorropil o lasar te nebo enkomono e lelo sinyat te nkaina o lmalaika otii dukuya Enkai.

English: And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth: and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.
Masaai: Nedumu olmalaika emoti neiput enkima naitayio to lperere lo lasar, neisuaaki enkop neaku kumok indarat sapuki o nkikurrukurrot naabuaku, o enkimerlel o nkiwuang'at, o enkikirikirata e nkop.

English: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
Masaai: Ore lelo malaika oopishana ooibung'ita ntarumpetani naapishana neitobir ejo pee eosh.

English: The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
Masaai: Neosh ilo malaika le dukuya entarumpeta enye, neshau enchan oo soito o enkima, nashulare osarge; nedoiki enkop; nepejori ematua e uni e nkop, nepejori ematua e uni oo lkeek, nepejori nkujit pooki naanyori.

English: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;
Masaai: Neosh olmalaika li aare entarumpeta enye. Ore enkito toki naaijo oldoinyo nayupuyup te nkima nenang'akini atua enaiposha.

English: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
Masaai: Neaku ematua e uni e naiposha osarge, neye ematua e uni oo ng'uesi naaishu naatii atua enaiposha, nemuti ematua e uni oo melin.

English: And the third angel sounded, and there fell a great star from heaven, burning as it were a lamp, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of waters;
Masaai: Neosh olmalaika li okuni entarumpeta enye, nedou olakira sapuk oing'uaa shumata eyupuyup anaa olkilang'ilang'et, nedoiki ninye ematua e uni oo lkejek, o enoo nkonyek oo nkariak.

English: And the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.
Masaai: Neji enkarna e ilo akira enduaran, neitaduari neye ematua e uni e nkare iltung'ana kumok te ina are, amu eitaduaraki.

English: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; so as the third part of them was darkened, and the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise.
Masaai: Neosh olmalaika li oong'uan entarumpeta enye, ore ematua e uni e nkolong neari, o ematua e uni o lapa, o ematua e uni oo lakir, neaku eitomisimisoki ematua e uni e wang'an enye. Nemitikini ematua e uni e ndama ewang'u naa neijia etiu ematua e uni enkewarie.

English: And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!
Masaai: Naitoki aing'orisho naning olkurragos oishirita to ltoilo sapuk eipirri te mpolos o loing'ang'e nejo, “Wooi, Wooi, Wooi, ninche lelo oomanya enkop, te nkaraki enkorui e nena tarumpetani netaa keosh ilmalaika okuni.”

English: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika le imiet aosh entarumpeta enye, nadol olakira otusulunye eing'uaa shumata elotu enkop. Neishori ninye olbolet lo lgos le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie.

English: And he opened the bottomless pit; and there arose a smoke out of the pit, as the smoke of a great furnace; and the sun and the air were darkened by reason of the smoke of the pit.
Masaai: Nebol ilo gos le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie, neilepu empuruo te ilo gos naikununo anaa empuruo o lkokuet sapuk, nemisimisu enkolong, o enkijape te ina puruo napuku te ina gumoto.

English: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth: and unto them was given power, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
Masaai: Nepuku te ina puruo ilmaat nepuonu enkop. Neishori engolon natiu anaa engolon oo nkolopani e nkop.

English: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.
Masaai: Nejokini ninche pee meinyal inkujit e nkop, aashu ae toki nabulu nanyori aashu pooki shani, kake lelo tung'ana ake lemeeta olmishire le Enkai too lpurai loo nkomomi enye.

English: And to them it was given that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented five months: and their torment was as the torment of a scorpion, when he striketh a man.
Masaai: Neishori ninche meisilisilo ninche too lapaitin imiet, kake pee mear metuata. Netiu enkitamioto enye anaa emion e nkolopa, te neng'or oltung'ani.

English: And in those days shall men seek death, and shall not find it; and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them.
Masaai: Naa ore te nena olong'i naa keing'oru oltung'ani keeya nemetum ninye. Neng'uar ninche keeya, neilany keeya ninche.

English: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
Masaai: Ore lelo maat te nidol, neikununo anaa mbartan naatanapate to larrabal. Netii ilukuny enye ntokitin naatiu anaa nkopiyiani e nkitoo e sahabu, neikununo nkomomi enye anaa nkomomi oo ltung'ana.

English: And they had hair as the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
Masaai: Neikununo ilpapit lenye anaa ilpapit loo nkituaak, neikununo ilala lenye anaa ilala loo lng'atunyo.

English: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
Masaai: Neeta ilpala laaijo nkilani oo lgooitie oo sekenke, ore enkikurrukur oo naipuko enye, netiu anaa enkikurrukur oo ngarrin oo mbartan kumok ekuetiki olarrabal.

English: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.
Masaai: Neeta ilkidong'o laaijo loo nkolopani oonyisho, ore engolon enye naitameiyie iltung'ana too lapaitin imiet naa atua lkidong'o lenye etii.

English: And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
Masaai: Ore olaiguanani oitore ninche naa ilo malaika le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie. Ore enkarna enye too Lhebrania naa Abadon neji te nkutuk o Lyunani Apolion (nchere olamutani).

English: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
Masaai: Eidipa entaboi e dukuya atulusoi, ng'ura eton eng'or intabo are naapuonu te siadi.

English: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika le ile aosh entarumpeta enye, naning oltoilo oing'uaa nena mowuarak pokira ong'uan o lperere lo lasar le sahabu otii dukuya Enkai,

English: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet, Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates.
Masaai: ejoki ilo malaika le ile, oata emowuo, “Talaku lelo malaika oong'uan ooena to lkeju sapuk le Frati.”

English: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
Masaai: Neaku nelakuni lelo malaika pokira oong'uan apa ooibooki aaitaanyu ina saa, o ina olong, o ilo apa, oilo ari, pee ear ematua e uni o ltung'ana.

English: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
Masaai: Ore esiana oo ltimito ookedito mbartan netasha are naa nkalifuni tomon katitin nkalifuni tomon. Atoning'o nanu esiana enye.

English: And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.
Masaai: Naa inji eikununo nena bartan natoduaa te nduaata ai, neeta lelo ookedito nkilani oo lgooitie oo sekenke naayia anaa enkima, neyia anaa soito pusi ooji Salfa neyia anaa enkima e nkibiriti. Neikununo lukuny oo mbartan anaa lukuny oo lng'atunyo Nepuku enkima e Nkibiriti too nkutukie enye.

English: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
Masaai: Ore te kulo meita pokira okuni near metuata ematua e uni oo oltung'ana te nkima, o te mpuruo o te nkima e nkibirti, naing'uaa nkutukie enye.

English: For their power is in their mouth, and in their tails: for their tails were like unto serpents, and had heads, and with them they do hurt.
Masaai: Amu ore engolon e nena bartam naa atua nkutukie enye etii, olkidong'o lenye. Netiu lkidong'o lenye anaa lasuriaa, keeta lukuny, naa ninche epikishore ilbaa.

English: And the rest of the men which were not killed by these plagues yet repented not of the works of their hands, that they should not worship devils, and idols of gold, and silver, and brass, and stone, and of wood: which neither can see, nor hear, nor walk:
Masaai: Ore iltung'ana ootelekutua, leitu eari metuata te kulo meita, neitu eirridu nkiaasin oo nkaik enye, neitu epal eseremata o eomonoto oo loiriruani, o nkitanyaanyukot neme Enkai e sahabu o enkosholai, o suyai, o soito o enoo nkeek nemedolisho, aashu ening'isho aashu aashom.

English: Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.
Masaai: Neitu sii eirridu too loikop lenye o te sakutore enye, o te loloito enye o te mpurrorre enye.

English: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:
Masaai: Naitoki adol likae malaika edou aing'uaa shumata, eimulumula te nkatampoi, netii olokirrai shumata endukuya enye, netiu enkomom enye anaa enkolong, neikununo nkejek enyena anaa ng'apeta e nkima.

English: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
Masaai: Neeta te nkaina enye enkiti piyayati e mbuku nabolo. Neroro te nkeju enye e tatene enaiposha, neroro te ne kedianye enkop natoyio.

English: And cried with a loud voice, as when a lion roareth: and when he had cried, seven thunders uttered their voices.
Masaai: Neipotisho abuaku to ltoilo sapuk, anaa olo lng'atuny oipur. Ore ake pee eipotisho nedaru nena kikurrukurrot naapishana.

English: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices, I was about to write: and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered, and write them not.
Masaai: Ore pee edar nena kikurrukurrot naapishana, najo aigerisho kake, naning oltoilo oing'uaa shumata ejo, “timishira nena naatejo ndarat naapishana, niminger ake.”

English: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
Masaai: Ore ilo malaika latoduaa eitashe te naiposha o te nkop natoyio, neilepie enkaina enye e tatene keper.

English: And sware by him that liveth for ever and ever, who created heaven, and the things that therein are, and the earth, and the things that therein are, and the sea, and the things which are therein, that there should be time no longer:
Masaai: Neinos ninye olmumai te ilo oishu ntarasi o ntarasi, laa ninye oitaa keper o pooki naatii atua, o enkop o pooki natii atua, o enaiposha oo pooki naatii atua pee meitoki atii enkimutioto.

English: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
Masaai: Kake pee ore ti atua nkolong'i naaoshi ina tarumpeta, naosh kenya ilo malaika li oopishana, o enkisudoroto neitabari enkisudoroto e Enkai anaa apa enatolikio ninye, sinkan lenyena lelo oibonok naa eitabari.

English: And the voice which I heard from heaven spake unto me again, and said, Go and take the little book which is open in the hand of the angel which standeth upon the sea and upon the earth.
Masaai: Ore ilo toilo duoo latoning'o eing'uaa shumata, naaitoki airorie, nejo, “Shomo tudumu ilo piyayati le mbuku obolo, otii enkaina e ilo malaika oitashe te naiposha o te nkop natoyio.”

English: And I went unto the angel, and said unto him, Give me the little book. And he said unto me, Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.
Masaai: Neaku ashomo enetii olmalaika najoki ninye maaishoo nanu ilo piyayati le mbuku. Naajoki ninye nanu, “Tudumu naa inosa. Kelo aduaru te nkoshoke kake kemelok anaa enaisho oo lotorok te nkutuk ino!”

English: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
Masaai: Nadumu ilo piyayati le mbuku te nkaina e ilo lmalaika, nanya. Naa kemelok anaa enaisho te nkutuk ai, kake ore ake pee aidip ainosa neitaduar enkoshoke ai.

English: And he said unto me, Thou must prophesy again before many peoples, and nations, and tongues, and kings.
Masaai: Naajokini, “Meeta nchere pee mintoki aibonisho too ltung'ana kumok, o too lng'ejepa o laiguanak.”

English: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and the angel stood, saying, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.
Masaai: Naaitokini aaisho entemet naikununo anaa eng'udi, naajokini nanu, “Inyo tetema enkaji e Enkai o ewueji o lperere lo lasar o lelo ooserem te ine.

English: But the court which is without the temple leave out, and measure it not; for it is given unto the Gentiles: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.
Masaai: Kake mitem ake olgoriet otii boo e nkaji e Enkai. Tapala ilo amu eishooki iloreren, naa keituny ninche ina ang sinyati too lapaitin artam o aare.

English: And I will give power unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.
Masaai: Naa kaisho ilchakenini laainei oare engolon naibonishore nkolong'i enkalifu nabo o iip are o ntomoni ile, eishopito ilkuniyiani.”

English: These are the two olive trees, and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth.
Masaai: Kulo ninche lelo oirienito aare, o lelo kilang'ilang'eta aare ooitashe te dukuya Olaitoriani le nkop.

English: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.
Masaai: Naa te neyieu oltung'ani neinyal ninche, nepuku enkima too nkutukie enye, nemut ilmang'ati lenye. Te neyieu oltung'ani near ninche neari metua aaiko neijia.

English: These have power to shut heaven, that it rain not in the days of their prophecy: and have power over waters to turn them to blood, and to smite the earth with all plagues, as often as they will.
Masaai: Eeta ninche engolon naikenie oloing'ang'e pee meshau enchan te nena olong'i e naibon enye. Neeta ninche engolon naitoreyie nkariak o enaibelekenyie metaa osarge. Near enkop to lmeitai ake pooki naaba anaa enayieu ninche.

English: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
Masaai: Ore ake pee eidip ninche enchakenisho enye, ore ina ng'ues nailepua te ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie nedumaki ninche enjore, nemir ninche, near ninche metuata.

English: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
Masaai: Neirrag impopoki enye te nkoitoi nalala eina anasa kitok, naji te nkiroroto e nkitumususet, Sodom o Misiri, naa te ine apa etashoki Olaitoriani lenye.

English: And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half, and shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves.
Masaai: Ore too nkolong'i uni o lpisiai ore iltung'ana loo loshon, o lng'ejepa o loreren neshil nena popoki enye, nemit enukari aapik inkuraren.

English: And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth.
Masaai: Ore lelo olomanya enkop, neshipakino ninche, neitayu isiruai neishoro nkishorot, amu ore kulo oibonok le Enkai pokira aare, naisomita oleng lelo ootii enkop.

English: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them which saw them.
Masaai: Kake ore te siadi nena olong'i uni o lpisiai, nejing enkiyang'et e nkishui naing'uaa Enkai, atua ninche neitashe ninche too nkejek enye, neiput enkuretisho sapuk lelo ootoduaa ninche.

English: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud; and their enemies beheld them.
Masaai: Ore ina kata nening oltoilo sapuk oing'uaa shumata ejoki ninche. “Elepu wootu ene!” Ore eing'orita ilmang'ati lenye neilep ninche aapuo shumata te nkatampoi.

English: And the same hour was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell, and in the earthquake were slain of men seven thousand: and the remnant were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
