Masaai: Ore te ina saa nejing olokirikiri kitok enkop, neurori ematua e tomon e ina anasa. Neari iltung'ana nkalifuni naapishana, metuata te ina kikirikirata. Neiputukuny lelo ootelekutua, neisho enkisisa Enkai e shumata.

English: The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.
Masaai: Etulusoyie entaboi e are. Ng'ura, kelotu entaboi e uni asioku.

English: And the seventh angel sounded; and there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord, and of his Christ; and he shall reign for ever and ever.
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika li oopishana aosh entarumpeta enye, netii iltoiloishi sapuki shumata oojo, “Etaa enkitoo e nkop enkitoo o Laitoriani lang o ene Kristo lenye, naa keitoreisho ninye intarasi o ntarasi.”

English: And the four and twenty elders, which sat before God on their seats, fell upon their faces, and worshipped God,
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani tikitam o oong'uan ootoni too lorikan lenye le nkitoo te dukuya Enkai nebatata too nkomomi enye aaserem Enkai.

English: Saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God Almighty, which art, and wast, and art to come; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power, and hast reigned.
Masaai: Nejo, “Kincho iyie enashe, Olaitoriani Enkai, olopeny enkidimata pooki, otii taata, netii apa amu iwa te ngolon ino sapuk, ninterua aitoreisho.

English: And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged, and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and them that fear thy name, small and great; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth.
Masaai: Etoopishote loreren, kake neewuo engoro ino, neewuo enkata naiguanareki ilootuata, nilaaki ole koisiaayio isinkan linono, iloibonok sinyat o lelo ooure enkarna ino, ilooti o lkituaak, o enkata namuti lelo amutak le nkop.”

English: And the temple of God was opened in heaven, and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunderings, and an earthquake, and great hail.
Masaai: Neitokini aabol enkaji e Enkai te shumata nedoli osanduku lo sotua lenye ti atua enkaji e Enkai. Netii enkimerlel oo nkiwuang'at o ltoiloishi oobuak, o ndarat e nkikurrukur o lokirikiri le nkop, o enchan oo soito sapuki oleng.

English: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
Masaai: Neliooyu entoki sapuk enking'asia te shumata, enkitok naishopokoki enkolong netii olapa abori inkejek enyena. Ore te ndukuya enye, neeta enkopiyia e nkitoo oo lakir tomon o aare.

English: And she being with child cried, travailing in birth, and pained to be delivered.
Masaai: Naa entuaa ninye, neishir te mion e saisai o te mion e ishoi.

English: And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns upon his heads.
Masaai: Neitoki aliooyu enkae toki sapuk e nking'asia te shumata, ng'ura enkito, tiamasi nanyokie, naata lukuny naapishana, o mowuarak tomon, neishopokino nkishiliaa e nkitoria naapishana ilukuny enyena.

English: And his tail drew the third part of the stars of heaven, and did cast them to the earth: and the dragon stood before the woman which was ready to be delivered, for to devour her child as soon as it was born.
Masaai: Neor olkidong'oe lenye ematua e uni oo lakir le shumata, nenang'aki ninche enkop. Neitashe ilo asurai te dukuya ina tuaa nasaisai, pee enya enkerai enye te neini.

English: And she brought forth a man child, who was to rule all nations with a rod of iron: and her child was caught up unto God, and to his throne.
Masaai: Neiu enkayioni naa ninye oyooki aitore iloreren pooki te ng'udi e sekenkei, kake etawuapayioki ina kerai enye aailepie enetii Enkai o enetii olorika lenye le nkitoo.

English: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she hath a place prepared of God, that they should feed her there a thousand two hundred and threescore days.
Masaai: Neipirri ina kitok ong'ata, ewueji neitobiraka Enkai, naa ine eitotiyieki aaitagol ninye too nkolong'i enkalifu nabo o iip are o ntomoni ile.

English: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,
Masaai: Nepuku olarrabal te shumata. Earare Mikael olmalaika le ilo asurai. Nearare sii ninye ilo asurai o lmalaika lenyana.

English: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.
Masaai: Kake etimiraki ninche neaku meeta ewueji netii ninche te shumata.

English: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.
Masaai: Nenang'uni ilo asurai kitok enkop, ilo asurai musana, laa ninye eji oloirirua o shetani, ilo alejani le nkop pooki, nenang'uni ninye enkop, ore ilmalaika lenyena nenang'akini enkop te nebo ninye.

English: And I heard a loud voice saying in heaven, Now is come salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God, and the power of his Christ: for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night.
Masaai: Naning oltoilo sapuk te shumata ejo, “Eewuo taata enjeunoto, o engolon, o enkitoria e Enkai ang, o enkidimata e Kristo lenye. Amu etanang'akaki enkop olaitang'oroni loo lalashera lang, laa ninye oitang'or ninche dama o kewarie te dukuya Enkai ang.

English: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
Masaai: Netimira ninche ninye te ilo sarge lo Lkuoo le Ker, o to rorei le nchakenisho enye, amu eitu enyorru ninche enkishui enye o metabaiki keeya.

English: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.
Masaai: Ting'idayu naa, iyie shumata o intae lelo pooki ootii atua. Kake wooi, intae nakop o enaiposha, amu etadowuo shetani enitii te ngoro sapuk. Amu eyiolo ajo dorrop enkata enye.”

English: And when the dragon saw that he was cast unto the earth, he persecuted the woman which brought forth the man child.
Masaai: Ore ake pee edol ilo asurai ajo etanang'aki enkop, nemir ina kitok natoiwuo enkayioni.

English: And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle, that she might fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.
Masaai: Kake eishooki ina kitok inaipuko are naaijo ino lkurragos sapuk loo lmurran, pee elotie ti ai ailany ilo asurai, nelo ong'ata, ine ewueji neitotiyieki aaitagol, te nkata, o too nkatitin, o lpisiai le nkata.

English: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.
Masaai: Nebuku ilo asurai enkare naaijo olkeju eing'uaa enkutuk enye te siadi ina kitok ejo pee eoroo to loirrag le nkare.

English: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed up the flood which the dragon cast out of his mouth.
Masaai: Kake etaretuo enkop ina kitok, neng'a enkop enkutuk neijoo ilo keju otonotua ilo asurai te nkutuk enye.

English: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Masaai: Negorokino taa ilo asurai ina kitok nelo aitainye olarrabal eishoi natelekua e ina kitok, lelo pooki leton eibung'ita nkitanapat e Enkai, neishakenoki Yesu. Neitashe ninye to sinyai le naiposha.

English: And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.
Masaai: Nadol nanu eng'ues eilepu aing'uaa atua enaiposha naata imowuarak tomon, o lukuny naapishana neishopokino nkishiliaa tomon e nkitoo nena mowuarak enyena. Netii enkarna e morore nena lukuny enyena.

English: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues natoduaa neikununo ana olowuaru keri. Netiu nkejek enyena anaa ino lng'arurumi, netiu enkutuk enye ana eno lng'atuny. Neisho ilo asurai ina ng'ues engolon enye o lorika lenye le nkitoo, o enkidimata sapuk.

English: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.
Masaai: Ore nabo oo lukuny enyena, eijo keeta olbae le nkeeya. Ore ilo bae lenye le keeya neishiwuo, nesuj enkop pooki ina ng'ues eing'asia.

English: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast: and they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?
Masaai: Neserem iltung'ana ilo asurai, amu eishoo ninye enkidimata enye ina ng'ues neserem, ninche ina ng'ues ejo “Ae ng'ae otiu anaa ina ng'ues, naa ae ng'ae oidima airisha?”

English: And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months.
Masaai: Neishori ina ng'ues enkutuk nairorie imbaa naarupie kewan o rorei le morore, neishori meitoreisho too larin artam o aare.

English: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.
Masaai: Nebol enkutuk enye emorisho, nemor Enkai, amor enkarna enye o emanyisho enye. Aa nchere lelo pooki oomanya shumata.

English: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.
Masaai: Neishori sii meitayunye olarrabal isinyat, nemir ninche. Neishori ninye enkitoria naitoreyie iloshon oltung'ana, o lng'ejepa, o loreren.

English: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.
Masaai: Ore lelo pooki ootii enkop neserem ninye, pooki ngae apa leitu eigeri enkarna enye apa eton eitu eitamanyuni enkop, ti atua embuku e mpuaan e ilo Kuoo le Ker apa otaraki.

English: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
Masaai: Te neetae oloata enkiok, nchoo ening.

English: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.
Masaai: Ore ake pooki ng'ae oarari, nelo eyaroto; ore ake pooki ng'ae oarisho to lalem meeta nchere meari sii ninye to lalem. Ene taa etii enkipototo te nkaraki eng'iriata o enkirukoto oo sinyat.

English: And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.
Masaai: Naitoki adol ae ng'ues natudumunye te nkop neeta mowuarak are anaa olkuoo le ker, neiro ninye anaa ilo asurai.

English: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him, and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed.
Masaai: Neitoreishore ninye enkidimata pooki e idia ng'ues e dukuya, te ine netii ninye, nearaki enkop o pooki oomanya enkop meteserema ina ng'ues e dukuya, apa naishiwuo olbae lenye le keeya.

English: And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men,
Masaai: Neas ilmonek sapuki o metaa ninye keitadou enkima eing'uaa keper meeu enkop edolita iltung'ana.

English: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast; saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live.
Masaai: Ore too lmonek ooishooki metaasa te ine netii ina ng'ues neitapong'oo lelo ootii enkop. Neitanap lelo oomanya enkop meitobira ninche enkitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues naata endung'oto o lalem neton ake eishu.

English: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed.
Masaai: Neishori ninye meishoo enkiyang'et ina kitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues, pee etum ninye ina kitanyaanyukoto ataa keiro. Nejo metaari metuata lelo pooki lemeserem ina kitanyaanyukoto e ina ng'ues.

English: And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads:
Masaai: Neisho sii pooki ng'ae, looti o lkituaak, ilkarsisi o laisinak, irrindiki o leme rrindiki, metipiki olmishire enkaina e tatene aashu enkomom,

English: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.
Masaai: pee meitoki hoo obo ainyiang'isho aashu emirisho, meteleku ake te neeta ilo mishire, aa taa enkarna e ina ng'ues, aashu esiana e ina arna enye.

English: Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six.
Masaai: Eyieu taa ena eng'eno nagut, nchoo ilo oata ening'unoto eikenisho atum esiana e ina ng'ues. Amu esiana e tung'ani. Ore esiana enye naa iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.

English: And I looked, and, lo, a Lamb stood on the mount Sion, and with him an hundred forty and four thousand, having his Father's name written in their foreheads.
Masaai: Naitoki aing'orisho, naa ng'ura, ore te nchumata o ldoinyo le Sion eitashe Olkuoo le Ker. Netii te nebo ninye nkalifuni iip artam o oong'uan ooata enkarna enye o ene menye lenye eigero too lpurai loo nkomomi enye.

English: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:
Masaai: Naning oltoilo eing'uaa shumata laaijo enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok, netiu sii anaa enkikurrukur sapuk. Ore ilo toilo latoning'o netiu anaa oltoilo loo laoshok loo nkinantani eoshito inkinantani enye.

English: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.
Masaai: Nerany osinkolio ng'ejuk te dukuya olorika le nkitoo o te dukuya nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, o te dukuya lelo payiani. Nemeetae hoo obo oidim aitayiolo kewan ilo sinkolio meteleku ake lelo nkalifuni iip artam o ong'uan ooidipaki aatokordu te nkop.

English: These are they which were not defiled with women; for they are virgins. These are they which follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth. These were redeemed from among men, being the firstfruits unto God and to the Lamb.
Masaai: Naa kulo leitu eidurukie ate too ng'oruo, amu meyiolo ninche nkituaak. Naa kulo ooirukurukore ilo Kuoo le Ker pooki wueji nelo. Etokorduaki kulo ti atua ltung'ana, pee eaku ilng'anayio le dukuya le Enkai o lo Lkuoo le Ker.

English: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God.
Masaai: Neitu etumieki nkutukie enye emonkoi, amu meeta eleyiata.

English: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth, and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people,
Masaai: Naitoki adol likae malaika eipirri te mpolos o loing'ang'e, neeta lomon supati loo ntarasi olo aliki lelo oomanya enkop, pooki kop, o pooki osho o pooki lng'ejep o ltung'ana.

English: Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him; for the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and the fountains of waters.
Masaai: Nejo to oltoilo sapuk, “Entureita Enkai ninchosho ninye enkisisa. Amu eewuo e nkiguana enye. Enteserem ilo oitobira shumata o enkop, o enaiposha o nchorroi oo nkariak.”

English: And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
Masaai: Ore likae malaika, li aare, nesuju, ejo, “Eturori, eturori Babilon kitok ina naitooko loreren pooki e naisho e mpushuna e loloito enye.”

English: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,
Masaai: Nelotu likae malaika li okuni asuju ninche, ejo to ltoilo sapuk, “Ore pooki ng'ae oserema ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye, netum olmishire to lpura le nkomom enye aashu te nkaina enye,

English: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb:
Masaai: neyooki sii aok e naisho e ngoro, e Enkai, natubukokoki enkikompe e ngoro eirrusha. Naa keitamei te nkima o te nkibiriti te dukuya lelo malaika sinyat o te dukuya ilo Kuoo le Ker?

English: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.
Masaai: Ore empuruo e nkisilisiloto enye neilep ntarasi o ntarasi. Nemeeta enkiyeng'iyeng'ata dama o kewarie lelo aseremak le ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye, o pooki ng'ae ong'amu olmishire le nkarna enye.”

English: Here is the patience of the saints: here are they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
Masaai: Ene taa etii enkipototo eng'iriata e lelo sinyat lelo ooibung inkitanapat e Enkai o enkirukoto e Yesu.

English: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.
Masaai: Naning oltoilo oing'uaa shumata ejo, “Ngero ena, Emayiana lelo ootuata laa ti atua Olaitoriani eye taata o akenya.” “Esipa emayiana,” ejo enkiyang'et, “pee etum aayeng'iyengata too sinaitin lenye, amu esuj ninche inkiaasin enye.”

English: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
Masaai: Naitoki aing'orisho naa ng'ura, enkatampoi naibor. Netonita te ina atampoi obo onyaanyukie enkerai e tung'ani, neishopito te lukunya enye enkopiya e nkitoo e sahabu, neibung'ita olalem opi oololo te nkaina enye.

English: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Thrust in thy sickle, and reap: for the time is come for thee to reap; for the harvest of the earth is ripe.
Masaai: Nepuku likae malaika eing'uaa atua enkaji e Enkai, eipotito to ltoilo sapuk ilo otonita te nkatampoi amu ejo, “Tudung'ishore ilo alem lino oololo nisampisho amu enkata e nkisampuare, eo abaya enkisampuare e nkop.”

English: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
Masaai: Neaku neyuk ilo otonita te nkatampoi olalem lenye oololo te nkop neisampuni enkop.

English: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
Masaai: Neitoki apuku likae malaika te ina aji e Enkai natii shumata, neeta sii ninye olalem opi oololo.

English: And another angel came out from the altar, which had power over fire; and cried with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Thrust in thy sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripe.
Masaai: Neitoki likae malaika apuku eing'uaa olperere lo lasar, laa ninye oota naitoreyie enkima. Neipot to ltoilo sapuk ilo oata olalem opi oololo nejoki, “Tudung'ishore olalem lino oololo tasotu nkimarrimarrat oo sabibu te nkop, amu eoto isabibu lenyena.”

English: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
Masaai: Neaku eyuko olmalaika olalem lenye oololo te nkop nesotu isabibu le nkop. Nenang'aki ninche atua enkironyet e ngoro e Enkai.

English: And the winepress was trodden without the city, and blood came out of the winepress, even unto the horse bridles, by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs.
Masaai: Neitunyi ina kironyet ti auluo ina anasa, nerukunye osarge te ina kironyet, o metabaiki mbartan inkeenta oo nkutukie, neba te nkadoro anaa kilometa iip uni.

English: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.
Masaai: Naitoki adol entoki sapuk enking'asia te shumata, kitok naa ene nking'asia, ilmalaika oopishana ooata ilmeita oopishana laa ninche oobayie, laa te ninche etimitunye engoro e Enkai.

English: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
Masaai: Naitoki adol entoki naikununo anaa enaiposha e kiook nashulare enkima. Ore lelo ootimira ina ng'ues o enkitanyaanyukoto enye o esiana e nkarna enye, neitashe te mbata e ina aiposha e kiook, neibung'ita nkinantani e Enkai too nkaik enye.

English: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvellous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
Masaai: Nerany osinkolio le Musa ilo sinka le Enkai o sinkolio lo Lkuoo le ker, ejo, “Eikituaak naa ine nking'asia nkiaasin inono, iyie Olaitoriani Enkai Magilani, keitoriori nesipa inkoitoi inono, Olaiguanani loo lporori.

English: Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee; for thy judgments are made manifest.
Masaai: Ae ng'ae lemeureisho neisis enkarna ino, Olaitoriani. Amu iyie ake openy osinyati. Eikipuonu nkuapi pooki aserem iyie, amu ore inkiguanat inono neidipaki aaibalunye.”

English: And after that I looked, and, behold, the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened:
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena naing'orisho, ore enkaji e Enkai o lng'obor le nchakenisho ti atua shumata neboli.

English: And the seven angels came out of the temple, having the seven plagues, clothed in pure and white linen, and having their breasts girded with golden girdles.
Masaai: Neipang'u ti atua ina aji e Enkai lelo malaika oopishana ooata ilmeita oopishana, eishopito nkilani nemeiduruk naawang oleng neenita too lgooitie lenye inkimeitani e sahabu.

English: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God, who liveth for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore nabo e nena ng'uesi ong'uan naaishu, neisho lelo malaika oopishana ngirran naapishana e sahabu naabore engoro e Enkai, naishu ntarasi o ntarasi.

English: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power; and no man was able to enter into the temple, till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled.
Masaai: Neigany enkaji e Enkai empuruo eing'uaa enkitoo e Enkai neing'uaa engolon enye. Nemeetae hoo obo oidima atijing'a atua ina aji e Enkai o metaba anaa nelusoo lelo meita oopishana le lelo malaika oopishana.

English: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.
Masaai: Naitoki aning oltoilo sapuk oing'uaa enkaji e Enkai ejoki lelo malaika oopishana, “Enchom entubukoki enkop lelo bakulini oopishana le ngoro e Enkai.”

English: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
Masaai: Neaku eshomo olmalaika le dukuya nebukoki olbakuli lenye oriong enkop. Nejing impaldakani torrok naang'u lelo tung'ana ooata olmishire le ina ng'ues neserem enkitanyaanyukoto enye.

English: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika li aare olbakuli lenye enaiposha, netiu ninye anaa osarge lo ltung'ani otua. Nee pooki toki naishu natii atua enaiposha.

English: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika li okuni olbakuli lenye atua lkejek o nchorroi e nkare, neaku ninche osarge.

English: And I heard the angel of the waters say, Thou art righteous, O Lord, which art, and wast, and shalt be, because thou hast judged thus.
Masaai: Naning ilo malaika loo nkariak ejo, “Ira iyie asipani te kuna kiguanat inono, iyie olotii taata nitii apake, losinyati obo, amu ena enkiguana ino.

English: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
Masaai: Amu eibukoitie iltung'ana osarge loo sinyat o loo loibonok le Enkai, ninchoo iyie ninche osarge metooko. Ina nairirikino ninche.”

English: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are thy judgments.
Masaai: Naning olperere lo lasar pee eishir ajo, “Ee Olaitoriani Enkai, Olmagilani, esipa neitoriori nkiguanat inono.”

English: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika liong'uan olbakuli lenye enkolong, neishori ninye metapejo ltung'ana te nkima.

English: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, which hath power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
Masaai: Nepeji iltung'ana te nkirowuaj napi, nedek ninche enkarna e Enkai naa ninye naata engolon te kulo meita. Neitu eirridu ninche anaa eisho ninye enkitoo.

English: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika le imiet olbakuli lenye ilo orika le nkitoo le ina ng'ues, nemisimisu enkitoria enye. Neony iltung'ana ilng'ejepa lenye te mion.

English: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
Masaai: Nedek Enkai e shumata te nkaraki emion o te nkaraki impaldakani, neitu eirridu nkiaasin enye.

English: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika le ile olbakuli lenye olkeju kitok le Freti, netoyu enkare e ilo keju, pee eitobiri enkoitoi naimu ilaiguanak ooing'uaa enkilepunoto e nkolong.

English: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
Masaai: Nadol nanu, epuku te nkutuk e ilo asurai, o te nkutuk e ina ng'ues, o te nkutuk e ilo le lejare, inkiyang'eta uni torrok naaijo ntuaan e nkare.

English: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.
Masaai: Amu inkiyang'eta oo loiriruani ninche naas inkitoduaat, nepuaya enetii ilaiguanak le nkop pooki pee eiturrurru ninche te njore ena olong kitok e Enkai Magilani.

English: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keepeth his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kalotu nanu anaa olapurroni. Emayiana ilo oshololo, ogolie inkilani enyena pee melo ake meishopo nedoli meishopo.”

English: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
Masaai: Neiturrur ninche te wueji neji te nkutuk oo Lhebrania Har-Magedon.

English: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
Masaai: Nebukoki olmalaika li oopishana olbakuli lenye atua enkijape. Nepuku oltoilo sapuk ti atua enkaji e Enkai, eing'uaa ilo orika le nkitoo ejo, “Etaasaki!”

English: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
Masaai: Nepuku nkiwuang'at e enkimerlel, o ltoiloishi sapuki, o ndarat o enkikurrukur, o enkikirikirata e nkop neitu ae kata etumi anaa nejing tung'ani oriong enkop. Kitok ilo okirikiri le nkop oleng.

English: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before God, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
Masaai: Neoro ina anasa kitok aaku matuan uni, neurori nkanas kituaak oo loreren. Nedamu Enkai Babilon kitok, pee eitook ninye metimita enkikompe e mpijan e ngoro enye.

English: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
Masaai: Neilanyisho aaisik pooki lemankale, neitu eitokini aadol ildoinyo.

English: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
Masaai: Neshau enchan oo soito sapukin oleng, laa nkiloi onom enkiroishi o soito obo, nedoiki ltung'ana eing'uaa shumata, o metaba anaa nedek iltung'ana Enkai te nkaraki ina shan oo soito, ilo meitai oitureisho naleng.

English: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters:
Masaai: Neitoki olmalaika obo le lelo oopishana ooata ilbakulini oopishana alotu enatii naajoki, “Wou, maaitoduaa nanu iyie enkiguana nadung'okini ena mulayoi kitok, natonita too nkariak kumok.

English: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
Masaai: Naa te ninye etololoitore ilaiguanak le nkop naa te naisho e loloito enye etemerate lelo ootii enkop.”

English: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
Masaai: Naaya ninye nanu te nkiyang'et ong'ata nadol enkitok natonita te nkoriong e ng'ues nanyokie nabore nkarn e morore neeta lukuny naapishana o mowuarak tomon.

English: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
Masaai: Netukusoki ina kitok too nkilani morijo o naanyokie. Neikodi te sahabu o too ntoto sidain o museitani naagol o too lului. Neibung'ita te nkaina enye enkikompe e sahabu nabore olminong o loirerioni le loloito enye.

English: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
Masaai: Ore to lpura le nkomom enye neigero enkarna e nkisudoroto: “Babilon kitok, ngoto mulayoni o ilo minong le nkop.”

English: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
Masaai: Nadol ina kitok etemere to sarge loo sinyat le Enkai o to sarge loo lchakenini le Yesu. Ore pee adol nanu ninye naing'asia oleng.

English: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore didst thou marvel? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which hath the seven heads and ten horns.
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka olmalaika, “Ainyoo pee ing'asia? Kaaliki taata enkisudoroto e na kitok, o ene ina ng'ues naata lukuny naapishana o mowuarak tomon nanapita ninye.

English: The beast that thou sawest was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues nitoduaa keetae apa, nemeekure eetae. Naa kepuku ailepu te ngumoto nemeeta enkiting'oto nelo atua enkidaaroto. Ore lelo oomanya enkop leitu esiri inkarn enye te mbuku e mpuaan ebaiki apa pee eitamanyuni enkop naa keing'asia te nedol ina ng'ues, amu etii apa, nemeetii taata, naa kelotu.

English: And here is the mind which hath wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sitteth.
Masaai: Eyieu ena eng'eno nagut. Ore nena lukuny naapishana naa ildoinyo oopishana ootonita ina kitok.

English: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he cometh, he must continue a short space.
Masaai: Naa ilaiguanak oopishana sii. Netabatatate imiet lenye, netii obo, neton eitu elotu olikae, naa ore te nelotu meeta nchere pee me nkiti kata ake eton.

English: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.
Masaai: Ore ina ng'ues apa natii nemetii taata, naa ene isiet kake ene nena naapishana sii, naa kelotu enkidaaroto.

English: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
Masaai: “Ore nena mowuarak tomon nitoduaa naa ilaiguanak tomon leton eitu eng'amu engolon naitoreishore. Kake keng'amu engolon anaa ilaiguanak te saa nabo te nebo ina ng'ues.

English: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
Masaai: Ile ndamunoto nabo kulo neishoo ina ng'ues engolon o enkidimata enye.

English: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
Masaai: Neitayunyie olarrabal ilo kuoo le ker, nemir Olkuoo le Ker ninche, amu ninye Olaitoriani loo laitoriak naa Olaiguanani loo laiguanak, ore lelo ooboitare ninye naa keipoto negeluno neisiligayu.”

English: And he saith unto me, The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Ore nena ariak nitoduaa te ine netonie emulayoi naa iltung'ana o lororani o nkuapi o lng'ejepa.

English: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
Masaai: Ore nena mowuarak tomon nitoduaa, ore ninche o ina ng'ues keibayu ina mulayoi, nekiny ninye aitalioo meishopo, nenya nkiri o sesen lenye nepejoo ninye te nkima.

English: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.
Masaai: Amu Enkai natipika atua oltau lenye meitabai inaayieu ninye, neaku ile ndamunoto nabo, neishooyo engolon enye, e nkitoria aaisho ina ng'ues, o metaba anaa neitabari ororei le Enkai.

English: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.
Masaai: Ore ina kitok nitoduaa naa ina anasa kitok naata enkitoria te shumata oo laiguanak le nkop.”

English: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena nadol likae malaika edou aing'uaa shumata neeta enkidimata sapuk, neitawang'i enkop te ina sikar enye.

English: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
Masaai: Nebuaku to ltoilo le ngolon ejo, “Eturori, eturori Babilon kitok! Etaa emanyisho oo loiriruani, orrumat le pooki kiyang'et torrono orrumat le pooki motonyi torrono naibaisho.

English: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
Masaai: Amu etooko iloreren pooki enaisho oo sabibu, oo ng'uarrat enyena torrok. Ore laiguanak le nkop neloloito te ninye, netaa karsisi ilbiasharani te nkop te nkiborra enye oo nkonyek.”

English: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
Masaai: Naitoki aning likae toilo oing'uaa shumata ejo, “Entupuku entung'uai ninye lo tung'ana laainei, pee mimbung'arere ake ninye ti atua ing'ok enyena, pee ming'arierie ake ilmeita lenyena.

English: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
Masaai: Amu eturupate ng'ok enyena oleng aabaya shumata. Netadamua Enkai intorrok enyena.

English: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
Masaai: Entalaaki ninye anaa enaitalakishe sii ninye makewan. Entalaaki katitin are te risioroto oo nkiaasin enyena. Eng'oling'olaki ninye mboreitin are te ina kikompe naing'ola sii ninye.

English: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
Masaai: Ore anaa ina naturupa ninye kewan neiborrie onyek nchoo sii ninye olosilisili o lkiyioi ntorisioki ena. Amu ejo to ltau lenye eton ara enkaiguanani, mara nanu enkoliai, ore olkiyioi madol ae kata.

English: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
Masaai: Metaa kepuonu ilmeita lenyena te nkolong nabo, inkeyaitin o lkiyioi o lameyu. Naa kepejori ninye te nkima. Amu eimagilani Olaitoriani Enkai odung'oki ninye enkiguana.”

English: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
Masaai: Ore ilaiguanak le nkop ootololoitare o ninye neiborrie onyek te nebo ninye naa keyietu neishir neishiraki ninye te nedol empuruo enye e mpejoroto.

English: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
Masaai: Neitashe ninche te nelakua te nkuretisho o enkitamioto enye ejo, “Wooi ina anasa kitok, naa magilani Babilon. Te saa nabo eewuo endung'okinoto ino enkiguana.”

English: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
Masaai: Ore ilbiasharani le nkop neishir aaishiraki ninye amu meekure eetae hoo obo oitoki ainyiang'u imasaa enyena.

English: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
Masaai: Masaa e sahabu, enkosholai, o soito oogol enkinyang'a o lului, o lkarash oopuyiapui o lmorijo, o loonyokie o mpukunot pooki oo lkeek oorropil o ntokitin pooki naaguetuni too lala loo lkanchaoni, o ntokitin pooki oo nkeek naagol enkinyang'a, o suyai, o esekenkei o ltoto ooibor.

English: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
Masaai: Olmadalasini oltankausi o enkorropil, o emanoo narropil, olbani, o enaisho oo sabibu, o eilata enkurma napuyiapui, o enkano, o nkishu o nkerrai o mbartan o ngarrin oo mbartan o rrindiki, aa taa iltauja loo ltung'ana.

English: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
Masaai: “Ore ilo ng'anayioi oshi otang'uarra oltau lino nikitung'uayie iyie, ore intokitin inono pooki e nkuso o esikar kitung'uaitie ninche, nemeitokini ae kata aatum.”

English: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
Masaai: Ore ilamirak le nena masaa ootudupore enkarsisisho naing'uaa ninye neitashe te nelakua te nkuretisho e mion enye, neishir neyietu abuaku ajo,

English: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
Masaai: “Wooi wooi ena kito anasa naishopo apa too nkilani naapuyiapui o morijo o naanyokie, neikodi, te sahabu o too soito oogol enkinyang'a o too lului.

English: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
Masaai: Te saa nabo eidaikieki ena arsisisho pooki.” Ore ilkituaak pooki loo melin, o ltung'ana oopuo too naaiposha, ilaisiaayiak loo melin o pooki laa ore enkinyang'a enye naa enaiposha etii neitashe te nelakua.

English: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
Masaai: Nebuaku aaishir ina kata pee edol empuruo e mpejoroto nejo, kaa anasa nanyaanyukie enkanasa kitok

English: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
Masaai: neisuaaki enterit ilukuny enye, eishiraki ninye. Neyietu nebuaku aaishir nejo, “Wooi, wooi, te nkaraki ena anasa kitok natudupore kulo pooki ooata melin, te naiposha te ina arsisisho enye. Te saa nabo eidaikieki.

English: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
Masaai: Ting'idakinoyu iyie ninye na shumata o intae isinyat, o lkipaareta, o loibonok le Enkai, amu etudung' oko Enkai ninye enkiguana te nkaraki intae.”

English: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
Masaai: Nedumu olmalaika ogol osoit kitok laaijo oloiwutuutishoreki nenang aki atua enaiposha nejo, “Neijia eikunakini Babilon kitok ina ang kitok esuluni enkop te ngolon, meitokini ae kata aatum;

English: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
Masaai: ore iltoiloishi loo loowosh nkinantani o laranyak, o lakutak loo ndulen, o ntarumpetani, nemeitokini ae kata aaning ti atua iyie. Nemeitokini ae kata aatum ti atua iyie oltung'ani le nkiaas e nkarriyiano hoo nabo. Ore Oltoilo lo soit ooiwutuutishoreki nemeitokini ae kata aaning ti atua iyie;

English: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
Masaai: ore ewang'an o ltaa nemeitoki ae kata awang'u ti atua iyie; ore oltoilo lo loyamisho o enayami nemeitokini ae kata aaning ti atua iyie amu ore lbiasharani linono naa ninche apa ltung'ana kituaak te nkop, netelejaki nkuapi pooki te ina sakutore ino.

English: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
Masaai: Naa ti atua ninye enotoki osarge loo loibonok le Enkai o loo sinyat, o lelo pooki ootaraki te nkop.”

English: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto the Lord our God:
Masaai: Ore te siadi ena naning entoki naijo oltoilo kitok lo lorora kitok te shumata ebuaku aajo, “Haleluya, ene Enkai ang enjeunoto o enkisisa o ngolon.

English: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he hath judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
Masaai: Amu ore nkiguanat enyena nesipa neitoriori; etudung'oko ninye enkiguana ina mulayoi kitok apa naitapong'oyie enkop te loloito enye, neitalakua te ninye osarge loo sinkan lenyena.”

English: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
Masaai: Neitoki ake ninche aaigil aabuaku aajo, “Haleluya eijukujuk empuruo enye ailep alo shumata ntarasi o ntarasi.”

English: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
Masaai: Ore lelo payiani tikitam oong'uan o nena ng'uesi naaishu nebatata neserem Enkai etonita te ilo orika le nkitoo, ejoito, “Esai Haleluya!”

English: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his servants, and ye that fear him, both small and great.
Masaai: Nepuku oltoilo oing'uaa olorika le nkitoo ebuaku aajo “Esisa Enkai ang intae isinkan lenyena pooki, intae olooure ninye, ilooti o lkituaak.”

English: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.
Masaai: Naitoki aning oltoilo laaijo olo lorora kitok oikununo anaa enkikurrukur oo nkariak kumok netiu sii anaa indarat oo nkikurrukurrot sapuki ebuaku aajo, “Haleluya! Amu Olaitoriani Enkai ang Magilani oitoreisho.

English: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.
Masaai: Mating'idata nikiosh olkerempe, nikincho ninye enkitoo, amu etabawua enkiyama o Lkuoo le Ker, netukuso kewan ina nayami.

English: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
Masaai: Neishooki ninye meishopo ilkarash oopuyiapui ooibor newang,” nemetii olduruki. Amu ore lelo karash sidain naa iasat supati e lelo sinyat.

English: And he saith unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he saith unto me, These are the true sayings of God.
Masaai: Naajoki ilo malaika, “Ingero, ena; emayiana lelo ooitoomonoki to sirua le nkiyama o Lkuoo le Ker.” Naajoki ninye nanu, “Irorei oosipa le Enkai kulo.”

English: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God: for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
Masaai: Nabatata too nkejek enyena aserem ninye, kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Mintoki aiko neijia! Amu kara ake osinka oasisho te nebo iyie o lalashera linono ooibung'ita enchakenisho e Yesu. Teserema Enkai!” Amu ore enchakenisho e Yesu ninye enkiyang'et e naibon.

English: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.
Masaai: Naitoki adol shumata etaboloki; ng'ura, nadol embarta naibor, ore ilo okedito ina naa keji, Oloisiligayu naa Asipani, naa too sipat eiguana neitayu olarrabal.

English: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
Masaai: Ore nkonyek enyena neikununo anaa olng'ejep le nkima neeta te lukunya enye nkaradan e nkitoria kumok, neeta enkarna nasirakino nemeyiolo likae tung'ani kake ninye ake oyiolo.

English: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.
Masaai: Neishopito olkila oitadoikioki osarge neji enkarna naipotieki Ororei le Enkai.

English: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
Masaai: Nesujita ninye njorin e shumata naaishopito nkilani sidain e kitani napuyiapui newang, nesujita ninye imbartan naaibor.

English: And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.
Masaai: Nepuku te nkutuk enye olalem opi laa ninye earie inkuapi, neitore ninche te ng'udi e sekenkei. Neituny ninye ewueji e nkironyet e naisho e ngoro napi e Enkai Magilani.

English: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
Masaai: Ore to lkila lenye o te nkupes enye neeta enkarna naigerokino ajo, Olaiguanani loo laiguanak naa Olaitoriani loo laitoriak.

English: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God;
Masaai: Naitoki adol olmalaika eitashe ti atua enkolong. Nebuaku aipotisho to ltoilo sapuk aipot imotonyi pooki naapuoto te mpolos o loing'ang'e, nejoki, “Wootu enturrurrunye osirua kitok le Enkai,

English: That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
Masaai: pee inosinoso nkiri oo ilaiguanak, o ilarikok loo njorin, o nkiri oo ltung'ana magil, nkiri oo mbartan o noo lookedito ninche, o nkiri oo ltung'ana pooki, loolakuno o rrindiki, ndung'ot pokira, ilooti o lkituaak.”

English: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
Masaai: Nadol nanu ina ng'ues o lelo aiguanak le nkop te nebo o njorin enye eiturrurrote pee earare ilo okedito ina barta nearare enjore neye.

English: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
Masaai: Neibung'i ina ng'ues, te nebo ilo oiboni lenye le lejare, otaasa ilmonek te dukuya ninye naa ninche etelejie lelo ootang'amaitie olmishire le ina ng'ues o lelo ooteserema ina kitanyaanyukoto enye ore lelo pokira o are, nenang'akini eishu atua ilo balbal le nkima, oyupuyup te nkibiriti.

English: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
Masaai: Ore ilootelekutua neari to lalem le ilo okedito ina barta. Te ilo alem opuku ti tua enkutuk enye; ore imotonyi pooki nenya inkiri enye omeisiligata.

English: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
Masaai: Naitoki adol olmalaika odou aing'uaa shumata, eibung'ita te nkaina enye olbolet le ina gumoto nemeeta eneiting'ie o lpisiai kitok.

English: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
Masaai: Neibung ninye ilo asurai, ilo asurai musana laa ninye oloirirua naa sheitani, neen ninye ilarin iip tomon.

English: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
Masaai: Nenang'aki ninye atua ina gumoto, neiken nemishiraa ninye te ine pee meitoki ae kata alej iloreren, o metaba anaa neishunye lelo arin iip tomon. Ore pee elusoo ina nemeeta nchere melakuni te nkiti rishata.

English: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.
Masaai: Naitoki adol ilorikan le nkitoo, ore lelo ootonita ninche naa ninche eishoro endung'okinoto e nkiguana. Naitoki sii adol iltauja le lelo ootudung'oyioki lukuny enye te nkaraki enchakenisho e Yesu o te nkaraki ororei le Enkai, naa lelo leitu eserem ina ng'ues aashu ina kitanyaanyukoto enye, neitu, eng'amu olmishire lenye too lpurai loo nkomomi enye aashu too nkaik enye. Nepiu ninche neitoreisho te nebo Kristo ilarin iip tomon.

English: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
Masaai: Ore lelo kulikae ootuata neitu epiu o metaba anaa neishunye ilarin iip tomon. Ena empiunoto e dukuya.

English: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
Masaai: Emayiana naa sinyati ilo ong'arieki empiunoto e dukuya. Ore te lelo, nemeeta keeya e are engolon. Kake keaku ninche ilapolosak le Enkai o le Kristo naa keitoreisho ninche te nebo ninye ilarin iip tomon.

English: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
Masaai: Ore pee eishunye lelo arin iip tomon, nelakuni sheitani te korokoroni enye.

English: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
Masaai: Naa kelotu alej nkuapi naatii lubot pokira ong'uan e nkop, aa taa Gog o Magog, neiturrur ninche te nkaraki olarrabal, neba esiana enye anaa osinyai le naiposha.

English: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from God out of heaven, and devoured them.
Masaai: Neidondorra ninche aailepaki endapasho e nkop, neman ina ang oo ilng'oborri loo sinyat, o ina anasa kirotet. Etadowuo enkima eing'uaa shumata neidaikie ninche.

English: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
Masaai: Ore oloirirua laa ninye apa oteleja ninche nenang'akini atua olbalbal le nkima o enkibiriti ine netii ina ng'ues o ilo oiboni le lejare, nepuoi aaitame ninche dama o kewarie intarasi o ntarasi.

English: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
Masaai: Naitoki adol olorika le nkitoo oibor kitok o ilo otonita neilanyisho enkop o keper aaing'uaa ine netii ninye nelaii ewueji neishaa ninche.

English: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
Masaai: Nadol nanu lelo apa ootuata, ilkituaak o looti eitashe te dukuya olorika le nkitoo, neboli mbukui. Neitokini sii aabol ae buku naa ninye embuku e mpuaan. Nedung'okini lelo ootuata enkiguana anaa enasira ti atua nena bukui, te nena apa naataasa ninche.

English: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
Masaai: Neitayu enaiposha ilootuata ootii atua ninye. Neitayu keeya o ene meneng'a ninche neiguanareki ninche too naataasa.

English: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
Masaai: Nenang'akini keeya o enemeneng'a atua ilo balbal le nkima; Ena ninye keeya e are, ilo balbal le nkima.

English: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
Masaai: Naa ore pooki ng'ae leitu etumi enkarna enye eigero ti atua ina buku e mpuaan, nenang'akini ninye atua olbalbal le nkima.

English: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
Masaai: Naitoki adol keper ng'ejuk o enkop ng'ejuk. Amu ore keper e dukuya o enkop e dukuya neidipa aatulusoi, meekure eetae enaiposha.

English: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
Masaai: Nadol ina anasa sinyati, Yerusalem ng'ejuk edou te shumata eing'uaa Enkai, eitobiraki anaa esiankiki naikodokini olpayian lenye.

English: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
Masaai: Naning oltoilo kitok oing'uaa olorika le nkitoo ejo, “Ng'ura etii emanyisho e Enkai te nebo iltung'ana. Keton ninye te nebo ninche neaku iltung'ana lenyena. Ore Enkai kewan neaku ketii te nebo ninche;

English: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
Masaai: naa kejut ninye pooki kiyioi too nkonyek enye, ore keeya nemeitokini ae kata aata aashu eitokini aata olkiyioi, aashu enkishirata aashu emion ae kata. Amu etulusoitie intokitin pooki e dukuya.”

English: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
Masaai: Ore ilo otonita to lorika le nkitoo nejo, “Ng'ura, ekaitaa intokitin pooki ng'ejuko.” Nejo sii, “Ngero ena, amu ore kulo rorei naa keisiligayu nesipa.”

English: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu. “Eidipe, ara nanu Alfa o Omega, enkiterunoto e enkiting'oto. Ore oloata enkure naa kaisho nanu enkare metii enkinyiang'a eing'uaa enchorro e nkare e mpuaan.

English: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.
Masaai: Ore ilo omirisho naa ketum ena jung'ore naa kaaku nanu Enkai enye neaku ninye enkerai ai.

English: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
Masaai: Kake ore ilkureti o lemeiruk, o looikereek, larak, o loololoito o lasakutok, o looserem inkitanyaanyukot, o lalejak pooki, ore ewueji enye naa keaku ilo balbal le nkima oyupuyup te nkima e nkibiriti. Naa ninye enkeeya e are.”

English: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.
Masaai: Neitoki alotu olmalaika obo le lekua oopishana ooata ilbakulini naapishana naabore ilmeita oopishana oobayie naairorie naajoki, “Wou, kaaitodol ina siankiki, ina kitok o Lkuoo le Ker.”

English: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
Masaai: Naaya enkiyang'et o maaitabaiki oldoinyo kitok oado, naaitodol ina anasa sinyati, Yerusalem, edou te shumata eing'uaa enetii Enkai te keper,

English: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
Masaai: eeta enkitoo e Enkai, naikununo enkitiil anaa eno soit lemetumoyu aashu osoit oji yasper, owang anaa oltotoi.

English: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:
Masaai: Neeta esuntai kitok naado, neeta nchomito tomon o aare, netii ilmalaika tomon o aare, nena shomito, nesira inkarn e lelo oshon tomon o aare loo layiok le Siraeli te nena shomito.

English: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
Masaai: Netii enkalo e nkilepunoto e nkolong inchomito uni, netii kopikop inchomito uni, netii moikuape uni, netii endoyioroto e nkolong inchomito uni.

English: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
Masaai: Neeta ina suntai e ina anasa ilkitamanyunot tomon o aare, nesirakino ninche inkarn tomon o aare o lkipaareta lo Lkuoo le Ker.

English: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
Masaai: Ore ilo laairorie nanu neeta ninye entemet e ng'udi e sahabu natemie ina anasa, o nchomito enyena o sunta.

English: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
Masaai: Ore ina anasa nerisio nkaloli pokira ong'uan, erisio enkadoro enye o endapasho enye, netem ninye ina ang te ina ng'udi, neaku kilometa nkalifuni are o iip ong'uan. Erisio enkadoro o endapasho o enkadoro nailep.

English: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
Masaai: Netem sii esuntai enye naa meta ntomoni ile te ntemata o ltung'ani aa taa enoo lmalaika.

English: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
Masaai: Ore ina suntai naa osoit oji yasper eshetare. Ore ina anasa naa ene sahabu nasila, newang anaa kiook.

English: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
Masaai: Ore ilkitamanyunot le suntai e ina anasa neikodoki te pooki soit oata tipat; ore ole dukuya naa yasper, ore oli aare naa soito pusi ooji safire, ore oli okuni naa soito ooji agate, ore oli oong'uan naa soito oonyori ooji emerald,

English: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
Masaai: ore ole imiet naa osoit oji oniks ore ole ile naa osoit oji karnelian, ore ole oopishana naa osoit oji krisolite, ore ole isiet naa osoit oji beril, ore oli ooudo naa osoit oji topas, ore ole tomon naa osoit oji krisopras, ore ole tomon o obo naa osoit oji yasinas, ore ole tomon o aare naa osoit oji ametist.

English: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
Masaai: Ore nena shomito tomon o aare naa ilului tomon o aare, ore ake enkishomi naa lulu nabo eitobirieki, ore enkoitoi e ina anasa naa sahabu nasila newang anaa kiook.

English: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
Masaai: Neitu adol enkaji e Enkai te ina anasa amu ore enkaji enye naa Olaitoriani Enkai Magilani, o Lkuoo le Ker.

English: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
Masaai: Ore ina anasa nemeetayie tipat enkolong aashu olapa oitawang ninye amu enkitoo e Enkai ewang'an enye naa ilo Kuoo le Ker Oltaa lenye.

English: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
Masaai: Naa ina wang'an enye epuoyie iloreren ore ilaiguanak neyau enkitoo enye atua ninye.

English: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
Masaai: Nemeikeni ae kata inchomito enyena dama nemeetae enkewarie te ine.

English: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
Masaai: Naa keyau ninche atua ina anasa enkitoo o enkanyit oo loreren.

English: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb's book of life.
Masaai: Kake mejing entoki hoo nabo naiduruk atua ninye aashu pooki ng'ae oas olminong aashu elejare, kake lelo ake ooigeroki inkarn enye ti atua embuku e mpuaan e ilo Kuoo le Ker.

English: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
Masaai: Naaitoki aitodol nanu olkeju le nkare e mpuaan, owang anaa oltotoi orukunye aing'uaa olorika le nkitoo le Enkai o lo Kuoo le Ker.

English: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
Masaai: Neruko aim empolos enkoitoi nalala e ina anasa. Ore sii too lkekuno pokira leilo keju netii ilo shani le mpuaan te nebo o mpukunot tomon o aare oo lng'anayio lenyena. Neiu ake to lapa lelo ng'anayio lenyena; ore imbenek e ilo shani naa ninche naaishiunye iloreren.

English: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
Masaai: Nemeitokini ae kata aata hoo toki nadiaa, kake ilo orika le nkitoo le Enkai o lo Lkuoo le Ker, ninche kenya ootii atua ine, naa keserem ninye isinkan lenyena;

English: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
Masaai: naa Kedol ninche enkomom enye, ore inkarn enye netii ilpurai loo nkomomi enye.

English: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for the Lord God giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
Masaai: Nemeitokini ai kata aata enkewarie nemeetayie ninche tipat ewang'an o ltaa aashu ene nkolong, amu Olaitoriani Enkai oaku ewang'an, naa keitoreisho ninche intarasi ontarasi.

English: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Keisiligayu nesipa kulo rorei. Naa Olaitoriani Enkai o nkiyang'eta oo loibonok le Enkai nairriwua olmalaika lenye meitoduaa isinkan lenyena nena nemeeta nchere pee eitu epuonu aasieku.

English: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
Masaai: Naa ng'ura, kalotu asioku.” Emayiana ilo oibung ororei le naibon e na buku.

English: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
Masaai: Nanu Yohana ilo otoning'o nadol kuna baa, Ore ake pee aning nadol ninche, nabatata too nkejek e ilo malaika laaitoduaa ninche aserem ninye.

English: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
Masaai: Kake aatiaaka ninye nanu, “Mintoki aiko neijia! Ara nanu osinka te nebo iyie o lalashera linono lelo oibonok le Enkai, o lelo ooibung irorei le na mbuku. Enkai teserema.”

English: And he saith unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
Masaai: Naajoki ninye nanu, “Minuk irorei le naibon e na buku, amu etinyikua enkata.

English: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
Masaai: Inchoo olarruoni eton aas enkarrueisho, nchoo oloiduruk eton eiduruk, nchoo osupat eton aas isupati. Neton osinyati aa sinyati.

English: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
Masaai: “Ng'ura, kalotu asioku naata olekoisiaayio lai te nebo nanu, pee alaaki pooki ng'ae anaa anataasa ninye.

English: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
Masaai: Ara nanu Alfa o Omega, ole dukuya o le siadi, enkiterunoto o enkiting'oto.”

English: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
Masaai: Emayiana lelo ooisuj ilkilani lenye pee etum esipata nabaikinye ilo shani le mpuaan netum sii aaima nchomito e ina anasa.

English: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.
Masaai: Auluo etii ildiein, o lasakutok, o loololoito, o looitayu iloikop, o looserem inkitanyaanyukot, o pooki tung'ani onyor elejare nelejisho.

English: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
Masaai: “Nanu Yesu laairriwaka iyie olmalaika lai meeu enitii, ayau ena shakenisho enkaraki sirito, nanu entonai e ishoi e Daudi, olakira owang le Nkakenya.”

English: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
Masaai: Ejo enkiyang'et o ina siankiki narikori. “Wou!” Nchoo ilo oning ejo, “Wou!” Nchoo ilo oata enkure, elotu, nchoo ilo oyieu eng'amu enkare e mpuaan metii enkinyiang'a.

English: For I testify unto every man that heareth the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, God shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
Masaai: Aikok pooki ng'ae oning irorei le naibon e na buku: te nepon ake oltung'ani, neponiki sii ninye Enkai lelo meita ootolimuoki ti atua ena buku.

English: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
Masaai: Ore pooki ng'ae oiwuang'ie ti atua ilo irorei le naibon e na buku, neiwuang'ie Enkai erubata enye ti atua ilo shani le mpuaan ti atua ina anasa sinyati, nalimuno imbaa enye ti atua ena buku.

English: He which testifieth these things saith, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Masaai: Ore ilo oishakenoki kuna baa, “Ejo kalotu asioku!” Esai. Wou, Olaitoriani Yesu!

English: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
Masaai: Metaa empiris o Laitoriani Yesu te nebo isinyat pooki. Esai.
